directions: Sift 2 cups flour with salt and cut in shortening as for pie crust., Mix egg yolks, lemon juice and water., Sprinkle over flour mixture., Blend lightly., Divide dough in half., Roll first piece to fit bottom and sides of a 9 x 13-inch baking pan., Arrange sliced apples in crust lined pan., Combine sugar, 2 tablespoons flour and cinnamon., Sprinkle over apples., Roll remaining dough to fit top and arrange over filling., Seal edges., Cut slits for steam to escape., Bake 40 minutes in a 400° oven., Frost with mixture of sugar, butter, vanilla and milk.

title: Hearty Hamburger Casserole
directions: In a skillet, cook beef until no longer pink, drain., Stir in soup and set aside., Prepare stuffing mix according to package directions, spoon half into a greased 2 quart, baking dish., Top with beef mixture, cheese and remaining stuffing., Bake uncovered at, 350 degrees for 30 to 35 minutes or until heated through. Yield: 4 servings.

title: Maple Onions
directions: Peel and cut onions in half., Place in a greased baking dish. Combine other ingredients and pour over onions., Bake at 350° for about an hour or until onions are soft., Serves 16.

title: Honey Orange Squash
directions: Microwave:, Combine honey, butter, salt and orange peel in 2 cup glass measure., Cover tightly with Saran Wrap, turning back edge to vent., Microcook at 100% power for 4 to 5 minutes or until butter melts., Set aside.

title: Hamburger Relish
directions: Grind all vegetables and drain well., Add remaining ingredients and place in jars; refrigerate., This recipe can be cut.

title: Banana Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Sift flour, sugar, soda, salt, nutmeg and cinnamon into bowl. Cut in margarine; add eggs, bananas, oats and raisins and mix until blended., Drop by teaspoon on ungreased cookie sheet., Bake at 400° for 12 minutes.

title: Ham And Rice Casserole
directions: Combine ham, onion and rice., Pack lightly in a baking dish. Add milk to beaten eggs., Stir in green pepper and cheese., Pour over ham mixture., Sprinkle with crumbs (made by crushing crackers and softened butter together., Bake for 45 minutes at 350°. Serves about 12.

title: Chocolate Raspberry Streusel Squares
directions: Heat oven to 375°., Combine flour, oats, sugars, baking powder and salt., Cut in margarine until mixture is crumbly., Reserve 1 cup oat mixture for streusel; set aside., Press remaining oat mixture into bottom of ungreased 9-inch square baking pan., Bake 10 minutes., Spread preserves over crust; sprinkle evenly with chocolate pieces., Combine reserved oat mixture and almonds; sprinkle over chocolate pieces, patting gently., Bake 30 to 35 minutes or until golden brown., Cool completely., Drizzle with melted chocolate, if desired., Let chocolate set before cutting bars., Store tightly covered. Makes 3 dozen.

title: Pear Pickles
directions: Boil pears 20 to 30 minutes in clear water., Boil the sugar, water, vinegar and spices in bag., Drain pears and put in vinegar mixture., Cook until pears are tender., Pack in hot jars., Process in hot water bath 5 minutes., Seal., Take jars out and place in dark place.

title: Oyster Crackers(Appetizer)
directions: Mix the oil and the creamy Italian style salad mix., Pour over the crackers and stir several times., If you put the crackers and mixture in a Tupperware bowl with lid, you can just turn the bowl upside down every so often to mix.

title: Fettucine Carbonara
directions: Brown bacon, drain and crumble; set aside., Saute onion and bell pepper in bacon grease until onion is barely transparent (pepper and onion should remain firm); set aside., Cook noodles per instructions; drain noodles., Do not rinse., Heat large pot until too hot to touch; turn off heat., Put butter in pot (get sides of pot coated with butter)., Pour heavy cream in pot., Add noodles, eggs, sour cream, black pepper, Parmesan cheese, bacon, onion and green pepper., Work fast after draining noodles; the heat from the noodles cooks the eggs.

title: Georgia Blueberry Muffins
directions: Beat egg., Stir in milk., Add blueberries and oil., Pour in flour mixture that has been sifted together (flour, salt and baking powder) all at once and stir until flour is moistened. Fill paper lined muffin tins about 3/4 full., Bake at 400° for 20 minutes., Makes 12 muffins.

title: Lillie'S Tikoy
directions: Mix ingredients together until smooth., Pour in a greased baking dish., Bake at 350° until toothpick or fork comes out clean.

title: Applesauce Bread
directions: Sift together flour, baking powder, baking soda, cinnamon, salt, allspice and cloves; set aside., Combine oil and sugar. Beat until well blended., Beginning and ending with dry ingredients, add dry ingredients alternately with applesauce to sugar mixture., Mix well after each addition., Fold in nuts, raisins and coconut.

title: Katjang Sauce(Peanut Sauce - Indonesian)
directions: Mix together all ingredients except peanut butter., Bring to a boil., Turn heat to medium and add peanut butter., Stir until smooth., Take off stove and serve over Sate.

title: Stir-Fried Vegetables
directions: Heat oil in skillet or wok over medium-high heat., Add garlic and ginger and cook 20 seconds., Add beans, carrots and onions; cook, stirring, 2 minutes., Add water, soy sauce and sugar. Reduce heat to medium; cover and simmer 5 to 7 minutes until vegetables are tender-crisp., Makes 6 servings.

title: Roast Turkey With Dressing
directions: Mix equal parts of bread stuffing and cornbread stuffing. Dice desired amounts of celery, onions, nuts, sage, mushrooms and sausage., Mix in applesauce, pineapple, marmalade and brandy. Stuff turkey with above., Place turkey breast side up on rack in an open roasting pan., Season to taste., Tent the bird with heavy-duty foil., Cook at 250° for several hours according to weight., Baste bird occasionally in beginning and frequently in last hours.

title: Carrot Cake
directions: Add sugar to eggs gradually, stirring well., Combine flour, soda, salt and cinnamon; reserve a small amount of flour., Add flour mixture and oil to egg mixture, alternately, beginning and ending with flour., Dredge pecans with reserved flour., Fold in pecans and carrots., Pour batter into greased waxed paper-lined layer cake pans., Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes., Remove cake pans from oven; cool cake in pan for 10 minutes., Turn onto racks to cool thoroughly.

title: "Knock Your Socks Off" Raisin Bread
directions: Dissolve yeast and honey in water., Heat milk with butter and pour into large bowl., Stir in honey, molasses, nutritional yeast, salt, yogurt, applesauce and oats., Beat in 1 cup flour, eggs and foamy yeast., Add 1 more cup flour, cinnamon, raisins, sunflower seeds, sesame seed, walnuts and carrots., Add remaining flour, 1 cup at a time, mixing well., Knead 10 minutes and let rise until doubled, about 1 hour., Punch down and let rise again., Shape into 3 loaves., Bake at 350° for 40 minutes., Brush top with butter and cinnamon., Bake 10 minutes longer., Cool on racks.

title: Pork Butt Roast
directions: Trim excess fat., Place meat and onions in a 3 to 4-quart casserole., Mix all ingredients and pour over top. Bake 3 hours at 300°., Serve with rice and veggies.

title: Ellen'S Brownies
directions: Melt butter, and chocolate or add powdered cocoa in saucepan. Remove from heat., Add sugar and eggs; mix., Add flour; mix., Bake in 350° oven for 20 to 30 minutes in 1 (8 x 8-inch) pan.

title: Cranberry Salad
directions: Dissolve jello., When chilled, add cranberries, pineapple and nuts., When set, mix sour cream and cream cheese and spread over top.

title: Pasta Salad
directions: Put cucumbers, green peppers and celery in medium bowl; pour 3/4 of Italian dressing in bowl and toss., Let marinate overnight. Cook shells as directed on box; rinse with cold water and drain. In large bowl, mix all ingredients and remaining 1/4 of Italian dressing.

title: Icicle Pickles
directions: Pour 1 gallon boiling water over the cucumbers., Add the salt. Let stand for 1 week, stirring each day., Drain water off., Add 1 gallon boiling water and the alum., Let stand 24 hours., Drain. Make a syrup of the sugar, vinegar and pickling spices., Bring to boil; pour over pickles., Drain and heat syrup for 3 mornings. Next morning:, Heat syrup and can or keep in a refrigerator in jar.

title: Corn Meal Pancakes
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Cook in skillet in hot oil.

title: Rice Pudding
directions: Bring milk, rice, sugar, salt and butter to a boil, stirring constantly to avoid burning., When mixture comes to a boil, turn heat down and cook for 1 hour, stirring often., Beat eggs well; add a few drops of vanilla., Pour eggs in a fine stream into rice mixture; then pour mixture from one pan to another 6 or 7 times (pour eggs slowly not all at once)., Pour into dish., If desired, add raisins that have been plumped, before pouring from one dish to another., Sprinkle cinnamon on top.

title: Black-Eyed Bean Salad
directions: Dice peppers, chop onion and rinse beans; toss all ingredients., Cover and refrigerate.

title: French Vinaigrette
directions: Whisk together all ingredients and toss with fresh salad. Serve at once.

title: Olive Nut Spread
directions: Put all ingredients in a small bowl and blend well., This will stay fresh in the refrigerator for 2 weeks., Serve with crackers or may be used as a sandwich spread.

title: Cranberry Bread
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Grease loaf pan, 9 x 5 x 3-inch., Cut shortening into flour, sugar, baking powder, salt, soda and orange peel., Add water to juice to make 3/4 cup., Blend in with cheese and egg., Fold in cranberries and nuts., Bake in prepared pan 60 to 70 minutes., Let loaf stand 8 hours before slicing.

title: Hershey Pie
directions: Melt candy bars., Blend Cool Whip, sour cream and xxx sugar. Mix until fluffy and melted., Spread into pie shell., Refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Easy Green Chili(Dieter'S Recipe)
directions: Preparation Time: 15 minutes., Cooking Time: 1 1/2 hours.

title: Pakistani Chicken Curry
directions: Saute the onions, garlic and ginger in the shortening until the onion is golden brown., Add the pieces of chicken, yogurt, tomato paste and the spices., Mix well and fry for about 15 minutes by which time it should become rather dry., Sprinkle in about 2 cups of hot water and allow to cook until chicken is tender., If necessary, add more water half way through., Makes about 6 servings.

title: Peach Cobbler
directions: Combine peaches, sugar and butter., Bring to boil and cook over low heat until peaches are tender and mixture thickens., Pour peach mixture into a lightly buttered oblong baking dish., Combine flour and salt; cut in shortening with a pastry blender until mixture resembles coarse meal., Sprinkle water evenly over flour mixture and stir with fork until all ingredients are moistened., Shape pastry into a ball., Roll out pastry to 1/8-inch thickness onto a lightly floured board; cut into 1-inch strips and arrange half of strips into lattice design over peaches., Bake at 350° for 35 minutes., Remove from oven; gently press baked pastry into peach mixture., Repeat lattice design over peaches with remaining pastry strips; return to oven and bake additional 40 minutes.

title: Hearty Beef "N" Potato Casserole
directions: Place potatoes in bottom of cake pan and bake at 400° for 10 minutes., Press each with a fork so it covers bottom of pan. Sprinkle browned hamburg and broccoli in potatoes with 1/2 can onions., Combine soup, milk, seasonings and cheese., Pour over beef mixture., Bake, uncovered, at 400° for 20 to 30 minutes., Top with remaining onions and bake 2 to 3 minutes more.

title: Toasted Walnut Madeleines(Dessert)
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Toast walnuts on baking sheet in oven until lightly browned, 5 to 7 minutes., Set aside to cool., Butter miniature muffin molds and place in refrigerator.

title: Easy Punch
directions: In one cup of water, dissolve Jell-O and sugar., Add to pineapple juice., Just before serving, add ginger ale or 7-Up and ice., Takes just a few minutes to make.

title: Aunt Bill'S Devil'S Food Cake
directions: Mix sugar, cocoa, oleo and eggs together., Alternately add and mix in flour, milk and vanilla., Add boiling water., Mix to a light creamy batter., Pour into 2 (9-inch) pans or a loaf pan. Bake 20 to 30 minutes at 350°., Use your favorite icing.

title: Caramels
directions: Stir and cook over low heat to good firm ball stage, 248°. Remove from heat; stir in 2 teaspoons vanilla and nuts., Stir just enough to mix., Pour into greased, shallow pan, 3/4-inch thick. When firm, invert onto cutting board; with sharp thin blade knife, cut into 3/4-inch squares., Wrap in waxed paper.

title: Zippy Taco Salad
directions: Brown meat; drain. Stir in beans and sauce., Cover., Simmer 10 minutes, stirring occasionally., Add Velveeta; stir until melted. For each serving, top chips with lettuce, tomato and meat mixture.

title: Quiche Lorraine
directions: Preheat oven to 425°., Brush surface of pie shell with egg white and bake 4 to 5 minutes., Place Swiss cheese and bacon evenly on bottom of shell., Combine eggs, cream, salt, nutmeg, sugar, pepper, cayenne and mustard., Mix thoroughly., Pour egg mixture over ingredients in shell., Bake 15 minutes at 425°, reduce oven to 300° and bake 40 minutes or until knife comes out clean.

title: Lasagna
directions: Cook ground round, olive oil, chopped onions and garlic until transparent., Add tomato sauce, tomato paste or puree, salt, basil, oregano, pepper and bay leaf., Cover and simmer for 1 hour until sauce is thick., Cook lasagna noodles in salted water., Cook in large pan; add oil to water., Rinse in cool water and cool. Slice noodles.

title: Apple-Pecan Cake
directions: Beat the first 4 ingredients together., In another bowl, mix the remaining ingredients., Combine the two mixtures and bake for about an hour at 350°., (This is a very old recipe.)

title: Chicken Tetrazzini(Low-Fat)
directions: Cook chicken and cut into 1-inch pieces., Cook pasta according to package directions., Saute garlic and mushrooms using cooking spray and a little water., Stir in soup, milk, cheese and chicken pieces., Heat through., Drain pasta and toss into mixture until well blended., Salt and pepper to taste.

title: Fresh Apple Bars
directions: Blend first four ingredients in large bowl., Sift in flour, salt, soda and cinnamon., Mix well., Fold in apples and nuts. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch greased baking pan., Bake at 375° for 45 minutes., Cool., Sprinkle with confectioners sugar., Cut into 2-inch bars.

title: Broccoli Soup
directions: Cook broccoli and broth until tender., Do not drain., Make cream sauce from next 5 ingredients, then add to broccoli mixture. Cook together, then add cheese as desired, and when served put cheese on top of soup.

title: Easy Salad
directions: Combine all ingredients and chill.

title: Easy Beef Stew
directions: Brown meat in skillet., Add all ingredients in crock-pot or slow cooker., Add meat., Let cook on high or medium for about 2 hours., Then turn to low., I make this at night before I go to bed, then when I get up it is done.

title: Pickles
directions: Cut both end off of the cucumbers. Stand up right in gal. containers (may use tupperware cake boxes). Cover completely with vinegar. Let stand 21 days; dump into sink. Wash vinegar off. Slice pickles. Use 2 c. pickles to 1 c. sugar. Add 3 drops oil of cloves. Fill gal. jug. Tighten caps. Ready	to eat. Keeps forever.

title: Taco Casserole
directions: Combine ground beef, onion and garlic in a large skillet; cook until meat is browned., Drain., Combine meat mixture, tomato sauce, water and seasonings in a medium bowl; stir well., Place half of meat mixture in a lightly greased 2-quart casserole., Top with half of kidney beans., Sprinkle with half of crushed corn chips., Repeat layers., Cover and bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Uncover and bake an additional 5 minutes., To serve, top with shredded lettuce.

title: Dipped Gingersnaps
directions: Combine sugar and oil; mix well., Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition., Stir in molasses., Combine dry ingredients; gradually add to creamed mixture and mix well., Shape in 3/4 inch balls and roll in sugar., Place 2 inches apart on ungreased baking sheets., Bake 350 degrees for 10-12 minutes; cool.

title: Crispy Coated Chicken
directions: Crush soup mix in pouch., Combine soup mix, bread crumbs and pepper., Beat together egg and water., Dip chicken into egg and then crumb mixture., Arrange breasts on baking sheet., Drizzle with margarine., Bake at 400° for 20 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink.

title: Osgood Pie
directions: Beat egg yolks until light and thick., Sift spices with sugar; add to yolks., Add pecans, raisins, butter and vinegar., Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites., Pour in unbaked pie shell., Bake 10 minutes at 400°., Reduce to 350° for 25 minutes.

title: Good Ol' Fashion Pound Cake
directions: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs, one at a time. Sift flour, measure and sift again with baking powder. Add flour and milk alternately. Add vanilla. Bake in tube pan at 300° for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Sauerkraut Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Let stand for 2 hours.

title: Ruth'S Carrot Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients well., Pour into two 8-inch round cake pans., (Pans should be prepared with Crisco and flour.) Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until cake springs back to touch.

title: Crawfish Maquechow
directions: Saute onion and bell pepper in butter., Add Ro-Tel; cook down. Add corn and cook approximately 20 minutes., Be careful not to scorch., Add well seasoned tails and cook another 20 to 30 minutes., Serve over rice.

title: Apricot Nectar Cake
directions: Mix all together except for confectioners sugar and 2 lemons. Bake 45 to 60 minutes at 350°., (If baked in a tube pan, 60 minutes.), Glaze while hot with confectioners sugar and lemon juice.

title: Lemon Chicken Primavera
directions: In a 10-inch skillet over medium-high heat, in hot margarine cook half of the chicken until browned, stirring often. Remove and set aside. Repeat with remaining chicken.

title: Butter Pecan Chess Cake
directions: Mix cake mix, 1 egg, and 1 stick butter well and spread in a greased 9 x 13 cake pan., Then, mix 1 stick butter, 8 oz. cream cheese, 1 box powdered sugar, 2 eggs, and 1 tsp. vanilla well and pour over bottom layer., Top with 1-2 c. chopped pecan pieces. Bake at 300 degrees for 45-50 minutes.

title: Southern Pecan Pie
directions: Melt butter and mix remaining ingredients., Pour into unbaked deep dish pie shell., Preheat oven to 350°., Bake for 50 minutes.

title: Garden Club Dessert
directions: Combine ingredients; put in a 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake for 15 minutes at 375°., Cool.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
directions: Mix all together and bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Delores' Double Crust Pastry
directions: Cut shortening into flour and salt until crumbly., Gently stir in cold water until pastry holds together., Divide into 2 parts. Roll out on floured surface.

title: Tuna Salad With A Twist
directions: Combine all ingredients; cover and chill., Makes about 4 cups.

title: Mini Spinach Quiches
directions: Separate each biscuit into 3 layers., Fit layers into 30 (1 3/4 x 1-inch) mini muffin pan cups., In a 2-quart saucepan stir together cornstarch, nutmeg, salt and pepper., Gradually stir in milk until smooth., Stirring constantly, bring to a boil. Gradually stir about 1/4 cup of the hot cornstarch mixture into the beaten egg until blended., Stir egg mixture into the remaining hot mixture in pan., Cool., Stir in cheese and spinach., Spoon about 2 teaspoons spinach mixture into each tart (should be full). Bake in 400° oven 15 minutes or until lightly browned., Remove from pans and serve., Quiches may be frozen in tightly covered container for 1 month., Bake frozen quiches 15 minutes at 400°.

title: String Pie
directions: In a baking dish, place cooked spaghetti in bottom of dish., In a separate bowl, mix eggs and Parmesan cheese with cottage cheese. Add onto noodles, then mix meat, spaghetti sauce, onion and green pepper and put over cheese mixture., Over the top, add shredded Mozzarella and bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

title: Round Steak And Gravy
directions: Put cream of mushroom soup and water in a 5-quart Dutch oven. In large skillet, put 1/4 cup oil., Roll steak pieces in flour; brown quickly., Drop in Dutch oven with soup and water., Leave oil in frying pan., Add 1/4 cup flour to pan and brown., Add salt and pepper., Add enough to make thin gravy., Add this to Dutch oven; cover and simmer until meat is tender, about 1 1/2 hours.

title: Pasta Primavera
directions: In a large saucepan, combine the first seven ingredients. Cook, uncovered, over medium heat until vegetables are tender, about 12 minutes., Stir in spaghetti; heat through.

title: Bucellato
directions: In a large bowl, cream butter and sugar., When thoroughly blended, add milk and eggs; mix well and add flour and baking powder., Add raisins, anise seed, glazed fruit, vanilla, brandy and rum extracts and Anisette.	Mix well and shape as desired. Decorate top with walnut halves, if desired., Bake in 400° oven for 10 minutes; reduce heat to 350° and bake for about 50 minutes.

title: Chicken Meatballs Japanese Style
directions: Mix chicken, 1 tablespoon sugar, 1 tablespoon soy sauce and egg in mixing bowl., Sprinkle on cornstarch and stir in well., In a saucepan, combine the broth, remaining soy sauce, sugar and sherry., Bring to a boil., Form meatballs with hands or drop from spoon into boiling broth., Poach 5 to 6 minutes., Remove with slotted spoon., You may then poach green beans or other vegetables in broth., Thicken broth with a cornstarch and water paste, if desired., Serve over rice.

title: Fruity Tea
directions: Brew tea bags and water until very strong tasting., Use a gallon jar, put tea, sugar, juice and lemonade in jar; mix well. Fill rest of jar with cold water.

title: Chocolate Fondue
directions: Mix all except fruit., Heat in fondue pot until chips are melted and mixture is hot.

title: Great Punch
directions: Mix pineapple juice, orange juice, ice cubes, fruit cocktail and cherries., You can refrigerate overnight before needed or freeze., When ready to use, pour into punch bowl., Add 2 quarts of the ginger ale., Mix., Top with sherbet., As needed, add more ginger ale.

title: Amaretto Dip
directions: Mix pudding with 1/2 cup milk (use mixer)., Blend in Cool Whip. Add Amaretto liqueur., Let stand for awhile., Serve with fresh fruit., Will keep for several days.

title: Yeast Rolls
directions: Dissolve yeast in 1 cup lukewarm water., Combine 1 cup lukewarm water, liquid shortening, sugar, salt and eggs., Add yeast mixture (after it has dissolved)., Gradually add flour; stir until blended and knead until desired texture., Grease bowl; put dough into it and set in warm place to rise., Cover with towel. Form into desired shapes and let rise again., Bake 15 minutes at 400°, on greased pan.

title: Aunt Betty'S Sherried Chicken And Cheese
directions: Arrange chicken in single layer in shallow baking pan. Scatter green onions over top; cover with sprinkling of cheese and paprika., Blend soups with sherry; pour over chicken., Bake, uncovered, at 325° for about 2 hours, or until fork-tender., (Do not cover; do not salt.), Excellent with pilaf-type rice.

title: Cherry Pie Cobbler
directions: Sweeten cherries to taste with sugar., Dump fruit in cobbler dish., Sprinkle with brown sugar., Sprinkle cake mix over all. Chip oleo on top., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: No-Bake Fudge Clusters
directions: Combine first 3 ingredients in saucepan; then add milk and syrup, stir., Cook to soft ball stage and remove from heat., Add margarine, vanilla, oats and coconut or walnuts., Stir well and drop by teaspoonfuls onto waxed paper., Makes 3 to 4 dozen.

title: Shenandoah Apple Cake
directions: Beat together oil, sugar, eggs and vanilla about 3 minutes. Add sifted dry ingredients , then stir in apples., Combine walnuts and 1 tablespoon flour; stir into batter., Pour into greased and floured 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until cake tests done., Cool in pan on rack.

title: Quick Chicken Casserole
directions: Break up chicken and line bottom of dish., Pour cream of chicken soup over chicken., Sprinkle stuffing over top as desired. Bake at 375° for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Buns
directions: Sift flour in large mixing bowl and add remainder of ingredients and stir well mixed, cover and let stand for 10 minutes., Sift 1 cup or more of flour on kneading board., Pour dough on board and knead until smooth with palm of the hand, add more flour if needed to handle easily., Place in greased bowl in warm place for 1 hour or until doubled., Punch down and let rise again., Then make in little balls, place 2-inches apart in greased baking pan, let rise about 1 hour or until light, bake about 20 to 25 minutes or until well browned in a 400° oven.

title: German Chocolate Caramel Bars
directions: In a pan, combine caramels and milk., Heat until all caramels are melted and set aside., In a large bowl, combine cake mix, oleo, 1/3 cup milk and nuts., Press 1/2 of the dough into a greased 9 x 11-inch pan or dish., Save the rest of the dough for topping., Bake at 350° for 8 minutes., Remove from oven and sprinkle chocolate chips over the mix., Spread the caramel mixture over the chocolate chips., Then, crumble the rest of the cake mixture over the caramels., Bake for 18 minutes at 350°., Cool before cutting.

title: Peanut Butter Candy
directions: Mix sugar, cocoa, Karo syrup and milk in a heavy boiler., Bring to a boil; turn to medium heat and continue boiling for approximately 5 minutes, until a small amount dropped in cold water forms a soft ball., Remove from heat; stir in oleo, peanut butter and vanilla., Beat until candy begins to stiffen., Pour into a buttered dish.

title: Ham Loaf
directions: Combine eggs and milk. Add crumbs and soak 5 minutes., Add ham, Worcestershire sauce, mustard and cloves; mix well., Pack in a greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan., Bake at 350° for 40 minutes. Remove from oven and reset oven to 425°., Invert loaf in center of greased and preheated plank., Spread marmalade on top and sides of loaf., Bake about 20 minutes until glazed., Makes 8 servings.

title: Crab And Avocado Salad
directions: In a large bowl, mix mayonnaise, lime juice, cumin and paprika. Add crab meat and celery; mix well. Add salt and pepper to taste. Gently stir in avocado cubes. Divide watercress on 4 plates; top with salad.

title: Buttermilk Pecan Waffles
directions: Combine the flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt; set aside., In a mixing bowl, beat eggs until light., Add buttermilk; mix well., Add dry ingredients and beat until batter is smooth. Stir in butter., Pour about 3/4 cup batter onto a lightly greased preheated waffle iron., Sprinkle with a few pecans., Bake according to manufacturer's directions until golden brown., Repeat until batter and pecans are gone., Yields 7 waffles (about 8 inches each).

title: Choc-Bark Candy
directions: Put almonds on cookie sheet and roast in oven., Melt chocolate bark in double boiler., Mix nuts in chocolate., Beat until cool enough to form mounds when dropped by spoon., You can make with pecans and peanuts the same way.

title: Dump Cake
directions: Grease a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Dump pineapple with juice and spread evenly., Dump pie filling and spread evenly., Dump cake mix and spread evenly., Sprinkle with pecans., Place butter pats over pecans.

title: Boston Baked Beans
directions: Simmer beans in 6 cups of water for 1 hour., Allow to stand, covered, for 2 hours or until softened., Drain., Put all ingredients in a crock-pot., Add 1 cup of water., Stir to blend. Cover pot and cook on low for 10 to 12 hours or on high 5 to 6 hours., Stir occasionally., Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Cowboy Cookies
directions: *Do not use Quick Quaker oats!

title: Saucy Pork Chops
directions: In a skillet, brown pork chops on both sides in small amount of oil., Season with salt and pepper., Top with onion slices. Combine remaining ingredients in mixing bowl., Pour over pork chops., Cover, simmer 45 to 60 minutes.

title: Chocolate Pies(Makes 3 Pies)
directions: Mix sugar, flour, cornstarch and cocoa., Add other ingredients, beating eggs well., Add milk, then add other ingredients., Pour in 3 unbaked pie shells., Bake about 30 minutes at 350° or until done.

title: Hamburger And Cheese Pizzas(Low-Fat)
directions: Heat oven to 350°., In small skillet, brown ground beef; drain., Place pocket breads on ungreased cookie sheet. Top each with 1 tablespoon pizza sauce and 3 tablespoons ground beef. Sprinkle each with 1 tablespoon cheese., Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes or until cheese is melted., Makes 4 pizzas., Serving:, 1 pizza., Calories:, 180., Fat grams: 6.

title: Quick Sheath Cake
directions: Mix together and beat., Pour into greased 9 x 12-inch pan. Bake at 350° for thirty minutes.

title: Raymond'S Pecan Pie
directions: Mix sugars and flour., Beat in eggs, milk and flavoring., Add melted margarine and pecans., Bake in unbaked pie shell 40 to 50 minutes at, 350°.

title: Old-Fashioned Doughnuts
directions: In mixing bowl, measure 1 1/2 cups flour and remaining ingredients., In mixer beat 1 minute, then stir in remaining flour to make soft dough., Refrigerate 1 hour., Roll out 1/2-inch thick and then fry in deep fat fryer with oil at 370°., Makes 24.

title: Barbecue Sauce
directions: Mix all ingredients in a saucepan., Cook over medium heat until bubbly., Reduce heat; simmer, uncovered, for 15 minutes, stirring often.

title: Vanilla Sugar
directions: Bury vanilla beans in a container holding granulated or confectioners sugar., Cover tightly and "flavor" for 2 weeks. Replace sugar as used as beans will be effective for many months.

title: Jingle Bell Fudge
directions: Combine butterscotch chips and peanut butter in top of double boiler., Place over hot, not boiling water, until butterscotch melts; remove from water., Stir until blended; add milk and stir until blended., Spread in foil-lined 8 inch square pan., Press chopped nuts into surface, if desired, and chill until firm., Cut into 1-inch squares., Yield:, 64 servings.

title: Zucchini Bread And Butter Pickles
directions: Bring vinegar, sugar, salt and spices to a boil., Pour over freshly sliced vegetables and let sit for 1 hour., Bring to a boil and cook for 3 minutes., Pack in hot sterilized jars., Seal. Process 10 minutes., Makes 6 to 7 pints.

title: Ukrainian Canapes
directions: Spread softened cream cheese onto slices of bread., Top each bread slice with a half slice of each type of luncheon meat. Place one slice of egg, pickle and radish on top of meat. Sprinkle chives, parsley and cheese to finish the canape. Refrigerate until ready to serve., Makes approximately 24 canapes.

title: Banana Nut Muffins
directions: Heat oven to 400°., Grease bottoms only of 12 medium muffin cups., Beat egg; stir in milk and oil., Stir in remaining ingredients all at once just until flour is moistened., Bake until golden brown, about 20 minutes., Immediately remove from pan. Makes about 1 dozen muffins.

title: Chicken Spaghetti
directions: Cook chicken, onion and celery together until chicken is tender, with salt to taste., Bone chicken and cut in small pieces. Add soup, cheese, cooked spaghetti and chicken broth., Mix well. Bake for 30 minutes at 350° or until heated through.

title: Chilled Rice Salad
directions: Toss rice, mushrooms and onion together in large bowl. Combine remaining ingredients in small bowl or jar with tight fitting lid and blend well.

title: Corn Pudding
directions: Beat eggs and sugar., Dissolve cornstarch in milk; combine all ingredients together., Cook until done.

title: Pat'S Corned Beef
directions: In medium saucepan, combine the corned beef, tomatoes, diced onion and baby limas., Cook over low heat for 30 minutes., Serve with creamed potatoes, salad and rolls for a quick and easy meal the kids will love.

title: Impossible Coconut Custard Pie
directions: Place all ingredients, except coconut, into blender or food processor (with chopping blade)., Blend for 2 minutes., Pour into lightly greased pie plate, preferably glass., Sprinkle coconut on top and pat down with back of large spoon. Let stand 5 minutes. Bake at 350° for 4 minutes or until knife comes out clean., Serves warm or cold.

title: Gooey Butter Bars
directions: Mix first 3 ingredients together and press into bottom of a 9 x 13-inch baking pan.

title: Chocolate No-Bake Cookies
directions: Add sugar, margarine, cocoa, salt and milk to saucepan., Boil 1 minute hard., Take off stove; add peanut butter, oats and vanilla., Mix well., Drop on wax paper and cool., (Good without cocoa, too.)

title: Glazed Acorn Rings
directions: Cut off ends of squash., Slice crosswise into 1-inch rings and remove seeds., Place in a single layer in large, shallow baking dish and add orange juice., Cover and bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Combine brown sugar and remaining ingredients; simmer 5 minutes. Pour over squash rings and bake, uncovered, 15 minutes longer, basting occasionally.

title: Pineapple Coconut Pie
directions: Combine ingredients., Pour into 2 prepared pie crusts., Bake at 300° for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Minced Lobster
directions: Pour a small amount of oil and 1 can of tomato paste in pan. Cook slowly for 2 minutes., Pour celery, onions and bell pepper in pan and let cook for 5 minutes., Pour diced lobster meat in mixture and simmer for 10 minutes or until fully cooked.

title: Dietetic Apple Cake
directions: Mix all dry ingredients first., Add remaining ingredients and mix well., Bake in a well-greased square pan at 375° for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Pepper Cabbage
directions: Quarter cabbage and remove core., Remove inside seeds from pepper., Grind on course blades of grinder., Make a mixture of water and vinegar (proportion 1/3 cup vinegar to 2/3 cup water). Make enough to thoroughly moisten cabbage and pepper., Some seasoning will be needed (salt, pepper, a little sugar to taste). Store in refrigerator in covered bowl.

title: Chicken Enchilada Soup
directions: Combine cornstarch and water in small bowl., Stir together all remaining ingredients, except cilantro, in saucepan., Add the cornstarch water mixture; bring to a boil, stirring occasionally. Add cilantro., Garnish with tortilla chips and shredded Cheddar cheese.

title: French Coconut Pie
directions: Mix all ingredients together and pour in unbaked shells and bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.	Makes 2 pies.

title: Apple Nut Cake #1
directions: Beat eggs, add sugar and beat., Add oil, half the apples and half of the flour and beat., Add vanilla, soda, salt and cinnamon and beat., Add remaining apples, flour, and nuts., Beat well and put in a greased tube pan., Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 15 minutes or until well done.

title: Loaded Mashed Potatoes
directions: Boil corn and cut off cob., Put in hot sterilized quart canning jars., Add 2 tablespoons of canning or pickling salt to each jar., Fill to neck of jar with boiling water., Seal.

title: Lasagna
directions: Start with Ragu., Add tomato paste, oregano, salt and pepper. Let simmer for about 20 minutes., Brown ground round in skillet until done., Drain very well., I use a paper towel to pat meat to absorb all the fat., Add to sauce., Cook lasagna noodles as directed and drain., In a 13 x 9-inch pan alternate noodles, meat mixture and Mozzarella cheese., Continue until you have used all mixture, finish on top with your Mozzarella cheese., Bake, covered, for about 35 minutes., There are 8 to 6 grams of fat per serving. Serve with a garden salad and Italian bread sticks.

title: Easy Beans
directions: Brown bacon until crisp., Remove from drippings., Saute onions and garlic in drippings., Remove from drippings., Mix all ingredients together except onion rings and pour into casserole. Place onion rings on top., Bake at 375° for 30 minutes.

title: Lime Congealed Salad
directions: Cream jello with cream cheese., Add 1 cup boiling water. Dissolve., Add 1 cup reserved pineapple juice., Mix well., Put into refrigerator until thickened., Add crushed pineapple, marshmallows and Cool Whip., Congeal.

title: Carrot Casserole
directions: Cook carrots, onions, water and salt until tender, about 15 minutes., Blend butter and bread crumbs; set aside., Drain vegetable stock from carrots and blend together with butter and flour., Cook until thickened and add cheese., Stir until cheese is melted., Pour over carrots and top with bread crumbs., Bake 20 minutes at 350°.

title: French Breakfast Puffs
directions: In a mixing bowl, combine flour, 1/2 cup sugar, baking powder, nutmeg, and salt., Make a well in the center of the dry ingredients., In another bowl, Beat egg slightly; stir in milk and 1/3 cup melted butter or margarine, add egg mixture to flour mixture., Stir just until moistened (the batter may be lumpy). Lightly grease muffin cups., Fill cups about 2/3 full with batter. Bake in a 350° oven for 20 minutes or until muffins are golden. Meanwhile, in a shallow bowl combine the 1/4 cup sugar and cinnamon., Immediately dip tops of hot muffins into the 1/4 cup melted butter or margarine, then into the cinnamon-sugar mixture until coated., Serve warm., Serves 12.

title: Dam Good Baked Chicken
directions: Combine seasonings., This is enough to coat 4 chickens., Shake all those ingredients in a bag., Wet the chicken; drain it and toss it in the bag., Arrange the coated chicken on an oven pan; brush with melted butter., Bake 1 hour at 350° without turning!!

title: Kentucky Corn Bread
directions: Mix all ingredients except cheese., Pour half of mixture into greased iron skillet., Sprinkle with half (1/4 cup) Cheddar cheese. Pour in remaining half of corn bread mixture., Top with remainder 1/4 cup cheese., Bake at 475° for 30 minutes.

title: Skillet Spaghetti
directions: Brown the first 4 ingredients in skillet., Drain well., Add the next 3 ingredients to meat mixture and simmer well., Add water and bring to a boil., Add spaghetti and cook until tender. Place in baking pan, top with cheese and brown under broiler.

title: Cool And Easy Pie
directions: Stir boiling water into Jell-O in bowl at least 2 minutes. Add enough ice to cold water to make 1 ; cup., Add Jell-O and stir until ice is melted., Add Cool Whip; stir with whisk until well blended., Refrigerate 15 to 20 minutes or until mixture is very thick and will mound., Spoon into crust., Refrigerate at least 4 hours or overnight.

title: Barbecue Hot Dog Appetizers
directions: Cut hot dogs and bacon pieces into thirds., Wrap each hot dog piece with 1 piece of bacon and secure with toothpick., Arrange in single layer on cookie sheets or shallow baking pans; bake at 250° for 30 minutes., Remove from oven., Pour barbecue sauce evenly over hot dogs; then drizzle molasses lightly over barbecue sauce. Sprinkle brown sugar over all., Return to oven and bake an additional 30 minutes., Serve hot or keep warm in a crock-pot. This will make a crock-pot full of appetizers., Makes 72 to 90 appetizers.

title: Black-Eyed Pea Relish
directions: Combine all ingredients., Cover and chill at least 3 hours. Drain and serve., Makes 7 cups.

title: Louisiana Shrimp
directions: Saute onions, green pepper and garlic in butter., Mix with remaining ingredients., Put in a casserole., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Tuna Casserole
directions: Cook macaroni until tender., Put aside., In a saucepan, melt the butter., Saute the onion and pepper in butter until tender. Set aside., In a bowl, place the tuna fish, onion, pepper, butter and macaroni., Add the mushroom soup; mix well., Add grated cheese. Add finally the sugar and pepper., Mix well., Pour milk over top and mix slightly., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Eggplant Casserole
directions: Wash eggplant and cut into 1-inch slices., Sprinkle with salt and allow to sit for 1/2 to 1 hour in colander., Squeeze water out of slices and pat dry with toweling., Dip slices in seasoned flour and brown in frying pan., Place in greased 9-inch square baking dish., Top each piece with a slice of Mozzarella cheese., Place a second slice of eggplant on cheese., Pour Ragu spaghetti sauce over the top., Bake at 350° for 45 to 60 minutes, covered for first 30 minutes.

title: Marinated Carrots
directions: Cut and cook carrots., Drain carrots and mix with other ingredients., Lasts two weeks., Save marinade to reuse.

title: Leek And Potato Soup
directions: Trim dark green leaves from leeks; slit leeks and clean carefully., Chop fine., Cook the leeks with the onion in butter. Add potatoes and stock., Bring to a boil., Simmer about 15 minutes or until the potatoes are tender., Add cream and bring to a boil. Season with salt and pepper., Serve hot, sprinkled with chives or scallions., Also good served cold.

title: Company Muffins
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., Combine flour, oat bran, baking soda, baking powder, salt and cinnamon in a large bowl., Stir in sugar. Add carrots, apples, raisins and nuts., Stir well., Make a well in the middle., Add oil, milk, eggs and vanilla., Stir until moistened.

title: Meat Corn Casserole
directions: Cook meat and onion until browned in large frying pan, breaking meat with fork., Blend in tomato paste, salt, chili powder and garlic powder and pepper; add corn (including liquid) and cook until mixture is thick, stirring occasionally., Arrange half the meat mixture over noodles., Repeat layers., Sprinkle cheese over top., Bake in moderate oven at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes or until hot and bubbling., Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Berry Cream Dressing
directions: Whisk together all ingredients, except the oil., Add the oil in a slow, steady stream until blended., Refrigerate., Use on a spinach-cucumber salad.

title: Spinach Dip
directions: Squeeze spinach until dry., In medium bowl, stir together spinach, sour cream, mayonnaise, soup mix, onions and water chestnuts., Cover and refrigerate 2 hours., Serve with bread or crackers., May be used as vegetable dip., Makes about 3 cups.

title: Chicken Lindsey
directions: Rinse chicken breasts and pat dry., Mix salt, pepper, celery salt and paprika together and sprinkle over chicken pieces., Next, sprinkle lemon juice over chicken pieces and place in a crock pot or slow cooker., Mix the two soups together in a bowl., Pour over chicken and sprinkle with cheese., Cover and cook on low setting for 6 to 8 hours., Serve chicken and sauce over hot rice or noodles., Serves 8-12.

title: Creamy Rice Pudding
directions: Combine rice, 1 1/2 cups milk, sugar and salt in a heavy saucepan., Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally until thick and creamy, 15 to 20 minutes., Blend remaining 1/2 cup milk and egg. Stir into rice mixture; add raisins., Cook 2 minutes longer, stirring constantly., Add margarine and vanilla., Sprinkle with nutmeg.

title: Banker'S Casserole
directions: Mix hamburger, ketchup, onion, eggs, milk and salt in mixing bowl., Cook macaroni and drain. Add mustard and mayonnaise to macaroni., Alternate layers of beef mixture and macaroni mixture in 13 x 9-inch pan., Sprinkle with cheese, then sprinkle with cornflake crumbs. Drizzle oleo over all., Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

title: Chicken Italian-Style
directions: Saute garlic in olive oil until golden and remove. Chop tomatoes and add to oil with salt, pepper, oregano and parsley. Simmer uncovered 25 minutes, stirring occasionally., Meanwhile, pound chicken breasts between pieces of waxed paper until thin. Dip chicken in eggs and then in mixture of bread crumbs and Parmesan cheese. Saute in butter until browned on both sides. Place chicken in shallow baking dish, top with sauce and slices of Mozzarella., Bake, uncovered in 350° oven for 20 to 25 minutes. Serves 12.

title: Spinach Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients and pour into a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Sprinkle with nutmeg. Bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Apple-Pineapple Dump Cake
directions: Place in 9 x 13-inch pan in this order:, apple pie filling, pineapple and dry cake mix., Melt oleo and drizzle over top., Bake 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Baked Acorn Squash
directions: Wash and cut squash in half lengthwise., Scrape out seeds. Brush cut surfaces and cavity with melted butter., Place close together, cut side down, on baking sheet., Bake at 350° until almost tender, about 30 to 40 minutes., Turn cut side up and brush again with butter., Sprinkle cavity with sugar and salt., Add a few drops of sherry., Bake 10 to 15 minutes more, until surface is glazed.

title: Cheese Dip Or Spread
directions: Mix 1 tablespoon cream with softened cream cheese., Add 5 tablespoons, oyster hot tomato ketchup and French dressing. Add, 1 small, finely chopped onion., Season with celery salt. Serve with crackers or potato chips.

title: Lobster Bisque
directions: This soup is not suitable for freezing., In large pot, combine lobster meat and cold water., Simmer, covered, for 15 minutes., In large saucepan, melt butter and blend in the flour., Gradually add the milk and cook until thickened, stirring frequently., Add the milk mixture to the lobster mixture., Stir well and reheat., Add salt and pepper and cayenne pepper to taste and serve., Yields 1 1/2 quarts.

title: Fruit Cocktail Cake
directions: Cream sugar, eggs, flour, salt and soda with juice from fruit cocktail., Add fruit cocktail and nuts., Pour into a flat pan. Bake for 40 minutes at 325°.

title: Perfect White Bread
directions: Soften yeast in 1/4 cup warm water; set aside until remaining hot water, shortening, salt and sugar cool to lukewarm., Stir in 2 cups flour; beat well., Add remaining flour to make a moderately stiff dough., Turn on floured surface and knead until satiny, 8 to 10 minutes., Let sit 10 minutes and knead again a few minutes. Place in greased bowl, turning once to grease surface., Let raise in warm place until double in bulk., Punch down; raise again 1 hour until double., Cut dough in two portions., Place in small ball; set 10 minutes., Place in loaves; let raise until double about 1 hour. Bake at 300° for 45 minutes.

title: Honey Bun Cake
directions: Combine cake mix, oil, eggs, sour cream and vanilla. Pour half of mixture into a 9 x 13-inch greased and floured pan. Mix brown sugar and cinnamon and sprinkle half over batter; swirl with a fork into cake. Pour remaining batter on top and spread. Top with brown sugar and cinnamon; swirl with fork. Bake at 325° for 40 to 45 minutes. When done, pour glaze on top.

title: Hamburger Casserole
directions: Place layers of vegetables in order given in crock-pot. Season each layer with salt and pepper (if desired)., Put hamburger on top of celery., Mix soup and water., Pour into pot. Cover; set on low for 6 to 8 hours., (Stir occasionally.)

title: Lemonade
directions: Slightly boil together until sugar is dissolved., Cool and store in bottle in refrigerator.

title: Apple Crisp
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., Peel apples and slice into a deep baking dish. Sprinkle with spices (if desired) and granulated sugar., Blend together the oats, flour, brown sugar, cornflake crumbs and oil., Press this mixture on top of the apple slices. Bake for 30 minutes or until apples are tender when tested with a fork., Yields 6 servings., Fat:, None.

title: 9 Minute Microwave Peanut Brittle
directions: In a glass pan with handles, stir together the peanuts, sugar, syrup and salt., Cook 8 minutes on High, stirring after 4 minutes. Add butter and vanilla., Cook one minute longer on High., Add baking soda and quickly stir until light and fluffy (foamy). Immediately pour on lightly buttered baking sheet., Spread out thin., When cool, break into pieces., Store in airtight container.

title: Dirt Pudding
directions: Mix cream cheese, milk and pudding mix together and sprinkle some crushed cookies in a dish or pan., Spread the mixture on cookies., Repeat., Refrigerate for 12 hours before serving.

title: Farmers Breakfast
directions: Peel and dice potatoes., Place oil in large nonstick frying pan., Heat oil until very hot, but not smoking., Add potatoes. Cook, turning frequently, until done, but not too brown., Add onion and red pepper., Saute until tender., Add ham., Saute until warmed through., Add eggs/Second Nature., Reduce heat and cover for 3 to 5 minutes., You want the eggs to cover ingredients and cook them as the eggs cook so don't stir the mixture at this point., Remove the lid and turn over the contents with a spatula. Cover and cook 3 to 5 additional minutes., Remove cover; season with salt and onion powder., Add green onions., mix well., Serves 4 to, 6.

title: Super Lo-Cal, Lo-Fat Creamy Broccoli Soup
directions: In saucepan, add broccoli, onion and water; cover and simmer until florets are tender, about 10 minutes., Remove from heat and let cool slightly., Pour vegetables and liquid into work bowl of food processor and process until smooth; set aside., (Blender can be used, but divide mixture in thirds to process.), In same saucepan, heat margarine until bubbly and hot., Add flour and cook, stirring constantly for 1 minute., Stir in broth and bring to a boil., Reduce heat and cook, stirring constantly, until mixture is smooth and thickened., Add pureed vegetables and seasonings to saucepan., Cook over low heat, stirring constantly until thoroughly combined and heated., Pour into soup bowls and sprinkle with parsley, if desired., Enjoy!, Makes 4 servings.

title: Grandma Jackson'S Sorghum Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients together except flour., Add flour gradually, enough to make a stiff batter., Pour in greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake at 350° until done., Top will fall.

title: Mexican Manicotti
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., Brown ground beef., Mix with refried beans, oregano and cumin., Fill uncooked manicotti shells. Arrange in a 9 x 13-inch pan., Combine taco or picante sauce and water and pour over shells., Bake 20 minutes., Turn shells over and bake 25 more minutes., Combine sour cream, onion and cheese over shells., Bake 5 minutes., Sprinkle with tomatoes., Serves 4.

title: Olive Cookies (Hors D'Oeuvres)
directions: Mix all ingredients. Take 1 tablespoon and wrap around each olive. You can freeze these, then bake when you need them. Bake in a 400° oven until brown. Grease pan.

title: Peanut Brittle Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees. Grease a 15X10 inch pan. In a medium bowl, cream together the butter and the sugar. Mix in egg and vanilla. Sift together the flour, baking soda and cinnamon. Stir into the creamed mixture, then stir in 1 cup of the peanuts. Spread the mixture evenly into the prepared baking pan. Sprinkle the remaining peanuts over the top. Bake in preheated oven for 20 to 25 minutes, until edges pull away from the sides of the pan. Cool and cut into bars.

title: Chocolate Zucchini Cake
directions: Sift together dry ingredients; set aside., In a large mixing bowl, cream butter, sugar and eggs., Alternately add milk and dry ingredients, beating after each addition., Stir in zucchini, peel and nuts. Bake at 350° for 1 hour in prepared tube pan or two loaf pans.

title: Plain Cake
directions: Cream oleo and sugar., Add eggs one at a time., Add soda and buttermilk., Add flour gradually., Add vanilla., Bake in Bundt pan 1 hour at 300°.

title: Caramel Brownies
directions: Melt caramels with 1/3 cup Milnot over low heat., Stir often until melted.

title: Chipped Beef Dip
directions: Blend cheese and milk., Add beef, onion and pepper to cheese mixture., Blend in sour cream., Put in ovenproof dish., Cover top with crushed pecans., Serve hot with crackers., Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Linda'S Zucchini
directions: Combine all ingredients and mix well., Spread into 13 x 9-inch greased pan., Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Blueberry Cake
directions: Cream butter and sugar, add eggs and beat until light., Sift flour, baking powder and nutmeg together and add alternately with milk to the sugar mixture., Gently fold in blueberries., Pour into buttered pans and bake at 350° until firm in center and lightly browned, about 30 minutes.

title: Hamburger Soup
directions: Brown the beef in microwave oven., Place in a crock-pot with the other ingredients and cook on low while at work., Delicious over rice.

title: Ham Stuff
directions: Cook pasta according to directions on box. While pasta is cooking, in large frying pan, heat oil. Once oil is ready, place garlic in pan. Once garlic turns light brown, add ham. Stir constantly. Add Parmesan cheese halfway during the cooking of the ham. The ham will be done when it becomes a little crispy, usually about 15 minutes.

title: Taco Dip
directions: Layer in order in shallow round casserole dish., Cook in microwave for 5 minutes on High.

title: Sour Cream Potatoes
directions: Mix ingredients., Pour into large casserole., Bake 45 minutes at 350°.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
directions: Combine and pour into baked pie shell., Place in freezer until firm.

title: Tom'S Hot Tomato Dip
directions: Mix ingredients well and let sit one or two days before eating., Sauce can be made milder using less pepper or hotter using more peppers and pepper sauce., Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Ricotta Snowflake Cookies
directions: Mix all ingredients; form into a ball and chill for 1 hour. Roll out the dough to a 1/8-inch thickness., Use a round cookie cutter or a fluted cookie cutter and cut out shapes., Bake at 350° for 15 minutes., Do not let them get too brown.

title: Banana Split Cake
directions: Mix together graham cracker crumbs, melted butter and 1/4 cup sugar., Press into 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake 8 minutes at 325°, then chill., Beat soft butter, eggs, powdered sugar and vanilla for 15 minutes., Pour over cooled crust., Sprinkle pineapple on top. Next, layer bananas., Spread with Cool Whip., Sprinkle nuts, dot with cherries and drizzle chocolate syrup., Chill overnight!

title: Baked Corn
directions: Mix well together and place in a greased casserole., Bake at 370° for 45 - 60 minutes.

title: Fruit Dip
directions: Mix first 3 ingredients., Add enough pineapple juice to make it dipping consistency., Serve with apple slices, grapes, oranges, pineapple chunks, banana slices or other fruits of your choice. Easy for children to make and great for showers or parties.

title: London Broil
directions: Combine soy sauce, honey, salt, pepper, sugar, garlic and sherry., Spread over meat., Marinate for 30 minutes to 1 hour in refrigerator., Place in preheated skillet with 1 tablespoon oil (cut meat in half)., Cook for 30 to 45 minutes on slow heat., Turn to opposite side halfway through cooking., May cook on grill.

title: Squash Casserole
directions: Cook squash, chop in small pieces., Combine with bread crumbs, cheese, onion, parsley, salt, eggs and pepper., Put into buttered casserole., Dot with butter., Bake at 350° until brown on top. Just before end of baking, sprinkle grated cheese on top and let melt.

title: Muddy Buddies
directions: Pour cereal into large bowl; set aside., In 1-quart microwave-safe bowl, combine chips, peanut butter and margarine. Microwave on High for 1 to 1 1/2 minutes., Stir in vanilla., Pour chocolate mixture over cereal, stirring until all pieces are evenly coated, then pour cereal mixture into large, resealable plastic bag. Add powdered sugar., Seal securely., Shake until all pieces are well coated., Spread on waxed paper to cool., Serve. Store leftovers in airtight containers.

title: Boiled Cookies
directions: Bring first four ingredients to rolling boil for 1 minute. Add remaining ingredients., Stir and drop by teaspoons on wax paper.

title: Spinach Balls
directions: Cook spinach as directed; drain well., Add bread crumbs and eggs., Add rest of ingredients and refrigerate overnight., Make small balls., Bake on cookie sheet in 350° oven for 20 to 25 minutes., Makes 60 balls.

title: Custard Pie(Makes Own Crust)
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Use shortening and heavily grease and flour deep dish pan., Mix ingredients together., Pour into pan and bake for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Cornmeal Drop Biscuits
directions: Combine first 5 ingredients in a large bowl., Combine milk, oil and egg; add to dry ingredients, stirring just until dry ingredients are moistened., Drop batter by heaping tablespoonfuls onto a baking sheet coated with cooking spray., Bake at 400° for 12 minutes, or until lightly browned., Cool on a wire rack. Yields 1 dozen biscuits.

title: Strawberry Kielbasa
directions: Cut uncooked kielbasa in slices., Sprinkle jello over kielbasa., Spread jam over mixture., Bake 40 minutes at 350°., Mix and serve.

title: Corn And Pea Salad
directions: At least 24 hours before serving, drain corn, peas and pimientos., Combine celery, green pepper and onion.

title: Pinto Beans
directions: Soak beans overnight., Cook all ingredients until tender.

title: Lasagna
directions: Mix sauce together:, meat, oregano, pepper, parsley, onion, garlic, pepperoni, tomato sauce, egg and mushrooms., (Best when making mix 1 day before eating.), Put uncooked noodles into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan, then add sauce mix, then cheese., Repeat layers., Cook at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Apple Dumplings
directions: Bring to a boil and cook until thickened., Pour over apple dumplings and finish baking.

title: Broccoli-Bacon Salad
directions: Mix together broccoli, onion, raisins and bacon., Combine remaining ingredients., Pour over salad, adding enough to moisten. Stir gently to mix., Chill.

title: Cheese Cake
directions: Blend graham crumbs and margarine and only 1/3 cup of sugar. Press firmly against bottom and sides of an 8-inch spring-form pan.

title: Potato Chip Cookies
directions: Cream shortening and sugars., Add eggs and mix well., Mix flour, salt and soda; add to batter., Add crushed chips and nuts. Shape into small balls, press down on cookie sheet with floured fork., Bake at 325° for 10 minutes.

title: Creamed Salmon
directions: Melt butter. Add flour and blend., Add milk, salt and pepper. Cook on medium heat until slightly thick, stirring often. Add dill weed, grated cheese and salmon., We like this over toast or mashed potatoes.

title: Squash Pickle
directions: Sprinkle salt over squash and onions and let stand 1 hour. Mix remaining ingredients and bring to a boil., Add squash and onions. Again bring to a boil., Pack in hot sterile jars and seal. Makes 2 quarts.

title: Sweetened Condensed Milk
directions: Combine ingredients in a 2-cup measuring cup., Microwave on High 3 minutes., Equals 1 can.

title: Baked Potato Mice
directions: Peel potatoes., Cut into thin slices (but not all the way through; use handle of a spoon to prevent knife from cutting all the way)., Put potatoes in a baking dish, fanning them slightly. Sprinkle salt and spread butter., Sprinkle herbs., Bake at 450° for 50 minutes., Remove from oven., Sprinkle on cheese., Bake for 7 to 10 minutes more., Add parsley ears and tail from parsley stem.

title: Dilly Shrimp Dip
directions: Drain and rinse shrimp., Mix all ingredients together., Serve with crackers, fresh vegetables or potato chips.

title: Mama'S Tea Cakes
directions: Mix all ingredients adding flour as needed to roll out and cut with cookie cutter.

title: Sweet Potato Stuff
directions: Mix all ingredients and spread in a 13 x 9 inch casserole dish., Top with topping and cook in 350 degree oven for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Barbecue Sauce
directions: Combine all ingredients., Boil and simmer 20 minutes., Makes 3 1/2 cups sauce., Store in refrigerator., Good on pork or chicken.

title: Appetizer Meatballs
directions: Combine all but chili sauce, jelly and oil., Form into small balls., Brown in hot oil and drain., Add combined chili sauce and jelly., Cover and simmer 20 to 30 minutes., Makes about 40 to 60 meatballs.

title: Bacon Tomato Cups
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Chop bacon, tomato, onion and grated cheese., Mix all ingredients except biscuits., Separate each biscuit into 3 thinner biscuits., Lay each biscuit over a mini muffin pan cup., Press biscuit into cup. Fill cups with bacon mixture and bake 10 - 12 minutes until golden brown., Yields 30.

title: Florence'S Old-Fashioned Chocolate Icing
directions: Cook this a little longer than	previously, and pour on cake.

title: Oven Caramel Corn
directions: Blend syrup ingredients (except soda) and boil slowly for 5 minutes., Take off heat., Add soda., Stir until blended., Pour over popped corn and mix., Bake in same pan., Stir until kernels are coated., Place in 200° to 225° oven for 1 hour., After baked, pour on counter to cool., Kernels will be separate.

title: Crab Bites
directions: Mix all ingredients together well. Spread on bread (without crust) or English muffin halves. Cut into fourths., Heat until cheese melts in a 350° oven.

title: Sesame Chicken(4 Grams Of Fat)
directions: Combine all ingredients., Pour over chicken and marinate. Barbecue or bake 40 minutes or until well done.

title: Corn Bread Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Grease casserole dish., Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours or until golden brown., Serves 6 to 8.

title: "Red" Fruit Salad
directions: Mix all together and chill.

title: Strawberry Jello Salad
directions: Dissolve jello in water; add crushed drained pineapple., Add strawberries, bananas and walnuts., Pour 1/2 mix in pan; put in fridge until jello is firm (about 1/2 hour), then spread 1 pint remaining jello mixture over sour cream., Chill and serve.

title: Ma-Mae'S Homemade Rolls
directions: Preparation: About 1 hour, plus rising time., Cooking Time: 10 to 15 minutes., Temperature: 350°.

title: Corn Bread
directions: Sift together flour, baking powder, sugar and salt., Add cornmeal., Beat in a separate bowl the egg., Beat into it butter and milk., Combine all ingredients with a few rapid strokes., Place the batter in the hot pan., Bake 20 to 25 minutes in 9 x 9-inch pan., Serve immediately.

title: Butter Pecan Ice Cream
directions: Prepare the instant pudding., Set aside to cool for 5 minutes. Mix the beaten eggs, sugar, pudding and cream., Put these in freezer can after they are mixed., Add enough milk to have can 3/4 full., Freeze., Makes 1 1/2 gallons.

title: Artichoke Rice Salad
directions: Cook the first 2 ingredients and add remaining ingredients. Chill before serving.

title: Party Fruit Salad
directions: Heat pineapple to boiling; add gelatin and stir until dissolved., Chill until partially set., Soften cream cheese; stir in pimiento., Add to gelatin mixture and blend., Fold in whipped cream, celery and nuts., Pour into 1 1/2-quart mold and chill until firm.

title: Squash Relish
directions: Mix squash and onions., Stir in 5 tablespoons of salt., Let soak overnight., In morning, drain and rinse off., Put in large kettle., Add all ingredients., Cook 1/2 hour and put in jars. Really good.

title: Banana Bread
directions: Cream Crisco, vanilla and sugar in a bowl., Add eggs and mix well., Add bananas and mix well., Add flour, soda and salt, alternating with milk., Add nuts., Spray Pam in pan., Bake at 350° for at least 60 minutes., Should make at least 2 loaves., Let cool and wrap in foil.

title: Benedictine Spread
directions: Combine all ingredients with 1 to 2 drops of food coloring in blender or food processor., Add more color if needed., Blend until smooth., Makes filling for 6 to 8 full size sandwiches.

title: Old Fashioned Sour Cream Sugar Cookies
directions: Sift dry ingredients; set aside., Cream together sugar and shortening; add eggs and lemon extract., Blend and add sour cream. Combine this mixture with sifted dry ingredients., Mixture will be stiff., Refrigerate overnight.

title: Brownies
directions: Beat eggs until thick and frothy;, beat in sugar., Melt chocolate and shortening together over slow heat., Add to first mixture., Mix together flour, baking powder and salt., For better results sift these together., Add the flour mixture to the first mixture., Stir in vanilla and nuts., To prepare the 8 x 12 pan, grease well and line with wax paper., Then grease the waxed paper. Spread into pan, and bake at 325° for 25 minutes., Cut into squares and let cool in pan.

title: Broccoli And Rice Casserole
directions: Saute until tender onions in oleo on low heat., Add chicken soup, cheese, milk, broccoli and rice., Mix all together, then pour into greased baking dish., Top with a little grated cheese. Bake in 300° to 325° oven until bubbly hot.

title: Chocolate Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Use large saucepan to combine and cook all ingredients. Combine cocoa and sugar., Add milk and butter., Then bring to a rolling boil and cook for 1 minute., Remove from heat., Add vanilla and peanut butter., Let the peanut butter melt and then add oats. Mix oats well and drop spoonfuls on a piece of wax paper to cool. Then serve.

title: Quick Rolls
directions: In a large bowl mix the ingredients in given order., Spray a muffin tin with nonstick vegetable spray., Fill each cup 2/3 full of mix., Bake at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes, until brown., Makes 12 rolls.

title: Pineapple Raisin Muffins
directions: Beat sugar and margarine until fluffy., Beat in egg, juice and orange peel., Combine remaining ingredients; stirring until blended., Spoon batter into greased muffin pan., Bake at 375° for 25 minutes., Serve warm.

title: Camp Beans
directions: Soak beans in water to cover in soup pot overnight., Drain; rinse., Add water to cover, onion, garlic, bay leaves and chicken bouillon., Simmer over low heat for 1 1/2 hours, stirring occasionally., Add tomatoes, green pepper, seasonings, ham chunks and brown sugar., Remove bay leaves before serving.

title: Peanut Brittle
directions: Bring 1/2 cup of water to a boil, then add 2 cups of sugar and 1 cup of white syrup., Stir until dissolved and boil until it will spin a thread., Now add 2 cups of raw peanuts and cook slowly over a low fire until it turns a golden brown., Take from fire and add 2 tablespoons of baking soda and 1 teaspoon of vanilla., Stir quickly., Spread on two large, well buttered cookie sheets., Place in cold area.

title: Party Size Fudgy Pudding Cake
directions: Heat oven to 375°., Grease 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan., In a large bowl, combine baking mix and cocoa., Stir in 2 cups of sweetened condensed milk, 1/2 cup syrup and vanilla until blended. Spoon evenly into prepared pan., In a small bowl, combine rest of milk, rest of syrup and hot water., Pour liquid mixture carefully over top of mixture in pan., Do not stir., Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until center is set and cake begins to pull away from sides of pan. Let stand 15 minutes., Spoon into dessert dish, spooning pudding from bottom of pan over top., Serve warm., Garnish with whipped topping or ice cream., Refrigerate leftovers., Makes 16 to 20 servings.

title: Easy Hershey Fudge
directions: Cook the first 3 ingredients until boiling; boil for 5 minutes., Remove from heat; let cool for 10 seconds., Add the chocolate bars., Stir until mixed., Pour into a 10 x 13-inch greased glass container.

title: Corn Pudding
directions: Mix all ingredients., Pour into 9 x 9-inch baking dish., Dot with butter before baking at 350° for 1 1/4 hours.

title: Mock Apple Pie
directions: Roll out half the pastry and line a 9-inch pie plate., Place crackers in crust., In saucepan over high heat, bring water, sugar and cream of tartar to boil; simmer for 15 minutes., Add lemon juice and rind; cool., Pour syrup over crackers., Dot with spread. Sprinkle with cinnamon., Roll out remaining pastry; place over pie. Trim, seal and flute edges., Slit top crust to allow steam to escape., Bake at 425° for 30 to 35 minutes or until crust is golden., Cool completely.

title: Sausage Cheese Balls
directions: Mix well and shape into balls the size of walnuts., Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes or until light brown.

title: Hungry Boy Casserole
directions: Saute beef, onions, green pepper and garlic until tender. Add tomato paste, water and salt. Mix well., Add beans and mushrooms., Simmer until all ingredients are thoroughly heated. Pour into baking dish and cover with canned biscuits., Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes or until biscuits are golden.

title: Mom'S Chicken Fricassee
directions: Take 2 tablespoons oil in large frying pan., Cut up large onions small., Put in large frying pan on medium heat until onions are a bit soft., Take parts of chicken and put salt and paprika on each piece., Put skin side down on onions., Lower to simmer and cook until tender.

title: Cheese Ball
directions: Cut chipped beef up small (use scissors or sharp knife). Combine all ingredients; roll in chopped pecans., Chill until ready to eat!

title: Broiled Tomatoes
directions: Slice tomatoes in half carefully; do not puncture bottom. Squeeze out some seeds and the juice., Add mixture of bread crumbs, cheese, oregano, salt and pepper and a few drops of oil to each tomato half., Put under broiler for 3 to 6 minutes.

title: Sky High Strawberry Pie
directions: In a large bowl, mash enough berries to equal 3 cups., In a saucepan, combine the sugar and cornstarch., Stir in the mashed berries and water; mix well., Bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring constantly., Cook and stir for 2 minutes., Remove from the heat; add food coloring if desired., Pour into a large bowl. Chill for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until mixture is just slightly warm., Fold in the remaining berries., Pile into pie shell., Chill for 2 to 3 hours.

title: Bacon Fat Cookies
directions: Mix bacon fat, brown sugar, white sugar and eggs until creamy. Add dry ingredients, vanilla and nuts., Divide and mold into 2 rolls., Wrap in waxed paper and chill until stiff., Slice and bake for 15 minutes at 350°.

title: Firecracker Casserole
directions: Cook the meat in skillet until it is no longer pink, drain. Add beans, chili pwd., cumin and salt., Transfer to a 9 by 13 in. baking dish., Arrange tortillas over the top; combine soup and tomatoes, then pour over the tortillas., Sprinkle with cheese. Bake uncovered at 350° for 25-30 min. Yields 8 servings.

title: Decorator Icing
directions: Mix together., Yields enough icing to do flowers and leaves for 350+ cake squares.

title: Spinach Dip
directions: Cook spinach and drain., Mix rest of ingredients., Mix with spinach., Cut out center of bread., Break into small pieces. Arrange pieces of bread around dip.

title: Red Velvet Cake
directions: Cream shortening, sugar and, eggs., Make, a, paste with food coloring and cocoa and add, to, mixture., Add, salt, and flour with buttermilk and, vanilla., Alternately, add soda and vinegar (mix vinegar and soda together); don't beat hard, just blend. Bake 30 minutes, at 350°,, in, two, 8-inch greased and floured cake pans., Frost with Red Velvet Cake Frosting.

title: Pumpkin Delight
directions: Mix and press into a 13 x 9-inch pan., Bake 15 minutes at 350°., Cool.

title: Shrimp Dip
directions: Mix all of above ingredients with a mixer and serve with chips.

title: Popcorn Balls
directions: Combine sugar, syrup, water, butter and salt., Stir until sugar is dissolved., Cook until 270° or brittle ball in cold water., Remove from heat., Pour over popped corn., Stir and mix. Shape corn into balls and place on wax paper.

title: Fruited Cabbage Salad
directions: Combine first five ingredients and set aside., In a jar with a tight fitting lid, combine the mayonnaise, milk, sugar, lemon juice; shake well., Pour over cabbage mixture and toss to coat.

title: Mignonette Of Beef
directions: Mix all ingredients well, except beef and vegetables, then add the beef, cut into 1 1/2 to 2-inch cubes., Refrigerate at least 5 hours or overnight., Alternate meat and vegetables of your choice on skewer., Broil about 20 minutes, brushing with sauce occasionally.

title: Black Walnut Pound Cake
directions: Have, all ingredients at room temperature., Sift flour, baking powder, and salt., Cream butter and sugar until silvery and light. Add, eggs,, one at a time, beating well after each addition. Combine milk and vanilla, then add to cream mixture alternately with flour mixture., Be sure to begin and end with dry ingredients., Beat	only, enough, to blend., Fold in nuts. Spoon batter, into, greased and floured 9-inch tube pan.	Bake at 350° for, 50, to, 60 minutes or until done., Cool in pan 15 minutes, then remove.

title: Swiss Fondue
directions: Rub inside of fondue pot or saucepan with cut edge of garlic, then discard., In fondue pot, simmer apple juice., Blend in soup. Combine cheese and cornstarch; stir into soup mixture., Heat until cheese melts; stir now and then., Spear bread with fondue fork and dip into fondue., Makes about 4 cups.

title: Chicken Noodle Casserole
directions: Heat oven to 350°., In medium saucepan, melt margarine; blend in flour., Stir in milk, salt and chicken broth., Cook until thickened, stirring constantly., Grease 13 x 9-inch pan., Mix chicken and noodles with sauce., Pour in pan., Sprinkle with bread crumbs and cheese., Bake, uncovered, for 45 minutes to 1 hour, until top is lightly browned.

title: One Dish Ham Bake(Chicken, Turkey Or Beef Can Be Used.)
directions: Mix broccoli, soups, 1 cup milk, meat and onion., Put in 9 x 13-inch pan., Mix Bisquick and 1 1/2 cups milk and pour evenly over soup mixture., Bake 25 to 30 minutes in 450° oven., Let stand for 5 minutes before serving., Serve with tossed salad and French bread for complete meal.

title: 1, 2, 3, 4 Cake
directions: Cream butter and sugar thoroughly., Add eggs and beat well. Add baking powder to flour., Add alternately with milk to batter. Add vanilla and mix well., Makes 3 or 4 layers., Bake in 350° oven about 30 minutes., Use favorite filling and icing.

title: Jewel Cookies
directions: In medium bowl with wooden spoon, beat butter, sugar, egg yolk and vanilla until smooth., Stir in flour just until combined. Refrigerate 30 minutes., Meanwhile, preheat oven to 375°., Using hands, roll dough into balls 1-inch in diameter; dip in egg white, then roll in walnuts., Place 1 inch apart on ungreased cookie sheets., With thimble or thumb, press center of each cookie., Bake 10 to 12 minutes or until a delicate golden brown., Remove to wire rack; cool., Place 1/4 teaspoon jelly in center of each cookie.

title: Caramel Candy
directions: Mix sugar, milk, soda and corn syrup; cook until it forms soft ball in water; remove., Add vanilla, butter, salt and nuts; beat until stiff., Hurry and drop by spoonfuls onto oiled waxed paper. If cooked too much, add a little water to soften.

title: Dirty Rice
directions: Boil giblets in salted water with bay leaf and beef bouillon cubes., Brown ground beef and drain., Saute green pepper, onion and celery in saucepan with a little butter., Chop cooked giblets after they cook and cool a little., Add giblets, ground beef and sauteed vegetables to rice., Add a teaspoon of poultry seasoning and 1/2 teaspoon sage to rice mixture., Cover and cook until rice is done. Serve with baked chicken.

title: Curried Pears
directions: Preheat oven to 325°., Use a small baking dish., Peel, half and core pears., Combine butter, brown sugar, curry powder and salt; mix with a spoon., Cook 35 minutes., Makes 6 servings.

title: Jake Kalberer'S Spinach Dip
directions: Put all ingredients together (except rye bread) in food processor or blender., Hollow out bread; save extra bread for dipping., Pour dip into hollowed out rye bread.

title: Microwave Tomato Jalapeno Cheese Dip
directions: Combine all ingredients in 2-quart glass measure or microproof bowl., Cook 5 to 7 minutes on High, or until cheese is melted, stirring once during cooking time., Blend thoroughly with electric mixer., Pour into serving bowl., Serve with corn chips or dipping-style potato chips or raw, fresh vegetables., Makes about 4 cups., Total cooking time: 5 to 7 minutes.

title: Tuna Casserole
directions: In a small skillet, melt margarine and saute onion, green pepper and mushrooms, stirring often, until tender (about 5 minutes)., Stir together with next 6 items., Add noodles, mixing well., Turn into a greased 2-quart casserole., Top with cheese and bake, uncovered, at 400° for 20 minutes.

title: Key Lime Pie
directions: Preheat oven to 250°., Beat egg yolks; add condensed milk and lime juice and beat until thick., Pour into baked pie shell.

title: Streusel-Filled Coffee Cake
directions: Mix sugar, shortening and egg., Stir in milk., Sift together and stir 1 1/2 cups flour, baking powder and salt., The mixture for the struedel is the brown sugar, 2 tablespoons flour, cinnamon and butter., Spread half batter mixture in greased pan., Sprinkle 1/2 streusel mixture., Alternate rest., Bake in greased and floured pan 25 to 35 minutes at 375°., Double batter for 13 x 11 x 2-inch pan.

title: Cherry Pie Bars
directions: Mix margarine, sugar, vanilla and eggs., Add flour, baking powder and salt., Makes soft dough (sticky)., Spread 3/4 (plus) of dough on greased sheet cake pan, will seem thin (don't have bare spots)., Spread on pie cherries (get red everywhere)., Take a little at a time part of the 1/4 dough left; add flour and pat out real thin between hands., Place patchy over cherries., Looks real messy, cherries and red can show., Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes (when it starts to brown and is firm, just barely brown).

title: Apple-Pecan Caramel Salad
directions: Combine apples and pecans in bowl., Mix yogurt, light mayonnaise, sugar substitute and cinnamon together and pour mixture over apples., Toss gently to coat., Chill until ready to serve., Serves 6.

title: Mrs. Lynch'S Old Country Cake
directions: Mix and sift dry ingredients., Cut in shortening with 2 knives., Add beaten eggs., Stir in raisins and seed., Add milk; stir., Spread into a 9 x 13-inch greased and floured pan (or use cooking oil spray)., Bake for 45 to 50 minutes at 375°., Can also use 3 small 6-inch round pans and bake for 35 minutes.

title: Pesto Chicken Linguine
directions: For pesto sauce, in blender or food processor container, combine spinach, parsley, chicken broth, egg yolk, Parmesan cheese, basil and garlic., Cover and blend until mixture is pureed., Cook pasta according to package directions; drain., Keep hot.

title: Steak In A Bag
directions: You can roast the steak in dry heat in the oven, if you desire., Roast at 375° for 40 minutes., Wipe steak dry., Combine butter, garlic, oil, salt and pepper., Spread butter mixture on both sides of steak., Press crumbs firmly onto steak on both sides., Place in brown grocery type bag., Close with paper clips. Place on baking sheet., Bake at 375° for 45 minutes., Remove from oven., Let stand 5 minutes., Slide onto carving board., Carve into 1/4-inch diagonal slices to serve.

title: Deviled Eggs
directions: Boil eggs; cool and remove shells., Cut in half., Remove yolks to mixing bowl., With fork, crumble yolks for easy mixing., Add salt, pepper, sugar, green relish and mayonnaise and mix well., Do not use too much mayonnaise or mixture will be runny., Put 1/2 tablespoon of the yolk mixture back in egg white., Garnish with paprika.

title: Fruit Salad
directions: Mix together all ingredients and chill.

title: Strawberry Puff
directions: Blend all ingredients. Beat 2 minutes. Wash and stem berries and put in 8-inch square glass pan. Spoon mixture over berries. Bake at 375° for 35 to 40 minutes. Double recipe for 9 x 13 pan. (Substitute raspberries, blueberries, crushed pineapple or apples can be used.)

title: Cheese Olive Balls
