directions: Blend cheese and margarine (room temperature)., Add flour and other ingredients., Pinch off dough and form into balls around olives., Bake on greased cookie sheet at 400° for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Fudge
directions: Stir together first 3 ingredients., Boil 7 1/2 minutes or until it makes a soft ball when dropped in cold water., Remove from heat and add chocolate chips and marshmallows., Add vanilla., Do not use a mixer!, Stir until marshmallows are melted., Add nuts and pour into well buttered pan., Let cool at least 4 to 6 hours., Do not cut until cooled.

title: Quick And Hearty Soup
directions: In large saucepan, brown ground beef; drain off excess fat. Cut up tomatoes slightly., Add beef, along with mixed vegetables, water, onion soup mix, salt and pepper., Bring to a boil., Stir in macaroni, then lower heat and simmer, covered, for 15 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Peanut Butter Bars
directions: Mix all ingredients except chocolate chips., Pat in pan. Melt chocolate chips in, microwave and spread over peanut butter mixture., Cool.

title: Parmesan Round Steak
directions: Cut steak into 6 servings., Pound each to 1/2-inch thickness. Combine egg and milk., Mix bread crumbs, salt and pepper., Dip steaks into egg mixture., Dredge with seasoned crumbs., Brown meat in oil., Add water., Sprinkle oregano on steaks., Place 2 teaspoons Parmesan cheese on each steak., Combine salt and paprika., Sprinkle onions with salt mixture; add to meat., Cover tightly., Cook in a 325° oven for 1 1/4 to 1 1/2 hours.

title: White Fruit Cake
directions: Cut fruit in small pieces and mix with nuts and coconut. Combine flour, baking powder and soda., Add fruit., Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy., Add eggs one at a time, beating after each addition., Pour over fruit mixture and mix well., Bake in 2 greased tube pans at 250° for 3 hours., Yields 10 pounds. (Use a dishpan to mix fruit and flour and pour egg mixture over it., Makes a big mixture.)

title: Wiener Schnitzel
directions: Sprinkle veal with lemon juice, salt, pepper and grated cheese., Let sit for 5 minutes., Then roll in flour, egg and breadcrumbs., Fry on one side in hot butter., Turn., Reduce heat. Place cheese slice on each cutlet., Slowly fry other side., Serve with crisp salad.

title: Chinese Chicken Salad
directions: When chicken is cool, break into small pieces., Store each of the first 3 ingredients in a Ziploc bag until ready to use., In a skillet, brown the sesame seed, almonds and ginger., Store in Ziploc bag until ready to use.

title: Sausage Stir-Fry
directions: Heat a wok or large pot until hot., Add a small amount of oil to coat bottom., When oil is hot, add cabbage, onion and celery and stir-fry until it is about half done., Add sausage rings and continue stirring over high heat until sausage is heated through. Add V-8 juice, beef broth, soy sauce and pepper., Cook until heated., Thicken with cornstarch and a little of the reserved beef broth., Heat through., Add sesame oil just before serving., Serve over hot, fluffy rice.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Saute onion in butter; add rice and broccoli., Heat soup in double boiler., Add Cheez Whiz., Stir into broccoli.

title: Easy Deviled Eggs
directions: Mix yolks of hard-boiled eggs with Thousand Island dressing to desired consistency., Stuff eggs.

title: Salisbury Steak
directions: In bowl, mix thoroughly 1/4 cup soup, beef, bread crumbs, egg and onion., Shape firmly into 6 oval patties., In skillet over high heat in 1 tablespoon hot oil, cook patties until browned. Spoon off fat., Stir in remaining soup and mushrooms., Return patties to skillet., Cover and simmer 20 minutes or until done, turning patties occasionally.

title: Lemon Chiffon Pudding
directions: Cream, butter,, sugar, and, flour, together and add egg yolks, lemon, juice and milk., Fold in egg whites., Pour into buttered casserole., Place, in, pan of warm water and bake in preheated 375° oven for 45 to 60 minutes, until firm., Serves 8.

title: Gr. Aunt Frances' Celery Sauce
directions: Peel tomatoes and squeeze seeds out of them., Mix all ingredients together and boil., Seal while hot.

title: Coconut Pound Cake
directions: Separate eggs; let egg whites warm to room temperature., Beat yolks with shortening until well blended., Gradually add sugar and beat until light and fluffy., Add vanilla., Add on low speed and beat in flour alternately with milk., Add coconut and blend well. Beat egg whites until stiff and fold in., Bake in greased and floured 10-inch tube pan at 300° for 1 1/2 hours.

title: "Berry" Delicious Fruit Shortcake
directions: Combine, flour,, baking, powder,, salt	and, sugar. Add combined, milk,, melted margarine and beaten egg, mixing until well, moistened., Spread, into greased and floured 8-inch cake pan. Bake, at 450° for 12 to 15 minutes or until golden brown. Cool 10 minutes and remove from pan.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
directions: Layer in loaf pan in order given., Do not mix. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Chicken And Rice
directions: Place the chicken in a glass baking dish., Make the rice according to the directions on the box., Add the 2 cans of soup and 1 can of water., Pour the rice-soup mixture over the chicken and bake at 400° for 1/2 hour., Add the cooking sherry and bake approximately 1/2 hour longer.

title: Korean Fried Rice(Bokgeum Bahb)
directions: Separate cold rice grains with a knife or chopsticks., Chop ham into small pieces., Rinse frozen green peas under cold water and set aside., Heat 1 tablespoon oil in frypan and make Egg Pancakes.*, Chop Egg Pancakes into thin strips and set aside.

title: Corn Dog Twists
directions: Heat oven to 375°., Melt margarine in small saucepan over low heat or in microwave on High for 15 to 20 seconds., Unroll dough into 1 long sheet., Seal the short center perforation., Separate into 8 long strips., Wrap each strip around 1 hot dog., Place on ungreased cookie sheet., Brush each corn dog twist with melted margarine., Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese., Bake at 375° for 12 to 16 minutes or until dough is light brown.

title: Fudge Fruit And Cream Salad
directions: Mix, pudding and buttermilk., Fold in, whipping, cream. Break up cookies and fold into salad., Add oranges and pineapple. Chill.

title: Beer Nuts
directions: Boil on medium heat 25 to 30 minutes., Stir once or more to keep from burning., Boil until dry., Heat oven 300°, grease jelly roll pan and spread nuts in pan., Sprinkle coarse salt on nuts. Bake 20 minutes., Stir and salt again., Bake 20 minutes more., Stir so won't stick., Cool and store in container.

title: Cherry Charlies
directions: Boil cocoa, sugar, salt, milk and corn syrup on medium heat for 2 minutes., Stir in other ingredients., Shape into small balls and drop onto wax paper., Ready to eat when cool.

title: Skillet Or Wok Lasagna
directions: In a large saucepan, cook lasagna or noodles in boiling water for 10 to 12 minutes or just until tender., Drain lasagna noodles and set aside., Preheat wok or large skillet over high heat. Break up meat., Stir-fry meat and garlic for 2 to 3 minutes or until meat is brown., Spoon off fat., Stir in spaghetti sauce and cooked noodles.

title: Spinach Quiche
directions: Beat eggs in a medium bowl. Add milk and vegetable soup mix. Squeeze water out of the spinach., Add to other ingredients., Add the cheese; mix well., Pour into unbaked pastry shell., Bake at 350° for 50 to 55 minutes or until crust is golden brown.

title: Gloop(Gloop Can Be Pulled To And Fro For A Snap-And-Crackly Tug-Of-War!)
directions: Pour the white glue into a clean, empty peanut butter jar. Add 1/2 cup of water and 10 drops of food coloring and stir. Combine the Borax and a cup of water in a medium size plastic bowl., Slowly pour the glue mixture into the Borax solution and stir until well mixed., The Borax causes the mixture to congeal. Scoop the gloop out of the water and knead it in your hands until it becomes dry enough to play with., If stored in a sealed container or plastic bag, it should keep for several weeks., Gloop dries out after a lot of handling.

title: Sour Cream Corn Bread
directions: Mix altogether., Bake 45 minutes at 350° in 8 to 9-inch greased square pan for very thick pieces or larger pan for more servings!

title: Mexican Corn Bread
directions: Mix together and pour into hot skillet., Bake at 375° for 30 to 40 minutes., Can be made into muffins, also.

title: Cheerio Bars
directions: Put the first 3 ingredients in saucepan; cook over low heat until it comes to a full boil., Stir in the peanut butter; stir until melted in., Add rest of ingredients; stir until well coated. Press into a 9 x 9-inch greased pan., Cut into squares when cool.

title: Chocolate Creams
directions: Melt chocolate with butter in saucepan over very low heat, stirring constantly until smooth., Blend in sugar, cream and vanilla., Chill about 30 minutes., Shape into 1/2-inch balls and roll in nuts., Store in refrigerator., Makes about 4 dozen.

title: Double Cheese Meat Loaf
directions: Combine hamburger, crumbs, onion, pepper, egg, Italian seasoning and 1/4 cup tomato sauce., On a sheet of tinfoil, spread mixture into a 10 x 12-inch rectangle., Sprinkle with cheeses and roll into a log., Seal ends and bake at 375° for 1 hour., At the end of the hour, pour remaining tomato sauce over meat loaf and bake for another 15 minutes.

title: Fresh Peach Cake
directions: For Cake:, Cream sugar and butter., Beat in eggs, one at a time., Add soda to buttermilk., Then stir into first mixture, alternately with flour and salt., Add peaches and nuts., Bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan at 325° for 30 to 40 minutes., Let cool.

title: Good Rice
directions: Mix all together in casserole., Place margarine on top., Bake at 325° for 1 hour.

title: Baked Lamb Chop Casserole
directions: Brown chops on both sides., Place in greased casserole., Pour drippings over meat., Saute onion in butter until golden brown. Mix onion, potatoes, cucumbers, salt and pepper., Spread over chops., Add tomatoes., Cover., Bake at 400° for 2 hours.

title: Cool Vegetable Salad
directions: Cut vegetables into bite size pieces., Put in large bowl., Mix together and add dressing., Cover and refrigerate 6 hours or overnight., Stir and ready to serve., Serves approximately 10 people.

title: Coconut Cake
directions: Combine cake mix, pudding mix, water, eggs and oil in large mixer bowl., Blend and beat at medium speed for 4 minutes., Stir in nuts and coconut., Pour into greased pan at 325° for 60 minutes. Cool 15 minutes., Remove from pan and cool on rack.

title: Southern Pecan Pie
directions: Stir sugar, corn syrup, salt and vanilla into margarine. Blend into eggs. Add pecans., Pour into pie shell and bake at 350° for 40 minutes or until done.

title: Pepper Steak
directions: Cook meat, onion and pepper in oil until browned., Stir in remaining ingredients except rice., Simmer for 45 minutes or 1 hour, stirring occasionally., Serve over rice.

title: Garbage Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 325°., Stir all ingredients into large bowl in order given., (Butter should be soft.), Mix by hand, then beat on medium speed with mixer for 2 minutes., Pour into buttered 9 x 13-inch pan and bake 1 hour and 20 minutes until a toothpick comes out dry., Cool, then top with cream cheese frosting.

title: Millionaire Pie
directions: Mix the last four ingredients together., Fold in 1 (8 ounce) container of Cool Whip., Pour in pie shell and chill., Sprinkle coconut on top (optional).

title: Buttermilk Meat Loaf Ring
directions: Combine buttermilk, bread, onion, egg, salt and pepper., Mix lightly, just until blended., Pack firmly into buttered ring mold. Bake 1 hour and 15 minutes at 350°., Allow to stand, for 5 minutes., Drain off fat., Turn out onto serving dish and drizzle catsup over meat loaf.

title: Sweet Potato Slaw
directions: Combine vegetables in a bowl. Toss gently. Combine remaining ingredients and stir well. Add to cabbage mixture. Toss well. Cover and chill., Yields 6 servings., Serving Size:, 1/2 cup. Exchanges:, 1 bread/starch.

title: German Chocolate Upside-Down Cake
directions: Grease a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan., Line with wax paper., Grease again., Sprinkle coconut and pecans onto paper.

title: Refrigerated Cheese Torte
directions: Save 1/2 cup of this mixture for top., Blend ingredients as for pie crust., Grease 9 x 3-inch loose bottom torte pan and line sides and bottom with graham cracker crust., Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes., Cool before freezing.

title: Geneva'S Coffee Bars
directions: In a large bowl, cream together the shortening and sugar. Add the eggs and beat thoroughly., Add the hot coffee., Mix well. Sift together the flour, baking powder, baking soda and cinnamon. Stir into the egg mixture, blending well., Add the chocolate chips and nuts., Pour into a greased jelly roll pan and bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes., While still warm, frost with a powdered sugar glaze.

title: Oatmeal Drop Cookies
directions: Cream butter., Add sugar and mix until well blended., Add the eggs and beat thoroughly., Mix soda, salt and cinnamon with flour. Add to first mixture alternately with the milk., Fold in rolled oats, nutmeats and raisins., Drop from spoon onto greased baking sheets., Bake 10 minutes in a hot oven (400°).

title: Berried Delight
directions: Combine crumbs, 1/4 cup sugar and melted butter., Press firmly into the bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan., Chill.

title: Italian Beef
directions: Bake in a heavy Dutch oven for 3 1/2 hours at 325°., The last 30 minutes, cut strings., Serve on sub buns.

title: Seasoned Black-Eyed Peas
directions: Drain peas (if desired, instead of soaking, cover peas with water and bring to boil then let stand 1 hour)., Combine peas, water, bouillon, onion, pepper, garlic, thyme, vegetable oil and salt in Dutch oven or large saucepan., Bring to boil, then reduce heat and cover., Simmer gently for 1 hour or until tender., Add additional water if pea mixture becomes too thick., Serves 8.

title: Noodle-Pineapple Kugel
directions: Nadine Shirley, one of the volunteers known as Apple Pandowdies, passed away before last Apple Jubilee in Waverly, Missouri., Her daughter, Pat Maycock, continues Nadine's tradition of baking apple dumplings for the celebration, using local Jonathan apples., Baking powder lightens the flaky pastry.

title: French Dressing
directions: Mix well., Salt and pepper to taste.

title: Chocolate Meringue Pie
directions: Combine sugar, cocoa, cornstarch and milk in saucepan., Heat until smooth and very warm., Stir in margarine, vanilla and egg yolks., Pour into unbaked pie shell., Bake 10 minutes at 425°, turn heat to 350° and bake 10 more minutes., Prepare Never Fail Meringue while pie bakes.

title: Pumpkin Pie
directions: Mix filling in order given., Pour into pie shells., Bake in preheated 425° oven for 15 minutes., Reduce heat to 350° and continue baking for 30 to 35 minutes or until knife inserted in center of pie filling comes out clean., Let cool., Top with Cool Whip.

title: Brunch Souffle
directions: In a large casserole greased with margarine, break up bread. Grate Cheddar cheese and mix with bread., In a blender, mix quickly eggs and milk., Pour over bread and cheese mixture., Cover with foil and let sit in fridge overnight., Bake at 350° for 1 hour; 35 to 40 minutes covered, 20 to 25 minutes uncovered.

title: Buttermilk Biscuits
directions: In bowl, combine flour, baking powder, baking soda, and salt. Cut in Crisco until mixture is coarse crumbs., Stir in buttermilk. Knead dough gently., Roll out to 1/2 inch thick., Cut with 2 1/2 inch biscuit cutter and place on lightly greased baking sheet. Bake 450 degrees for 10 - 15 minutes or until golden brown., Makes 10 biscuits.

title: Ritz Cracker Pie
directions: Beat egg whites until stiff., Add 1/2 cup sugar; beat again. Add 1/2 cup more sugar and vanilla., Take 24 Ritz crackers and crush into mixture., Add chopped pecans., Pour into greased pie pan and bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Onion Rings
directions: Peel onion. Cut in 1/2-inch slices. Separate rings., Combine dry ingredients and stir well. Add eggs, milk and teaspoon oil. Beat until smooth. Dip onion rings into batter and fry in deep hot oil until golden brown., Drain on paper towels., Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Crisp Marshmallow Bars
directions: In a 2-quart saucepan, melt butter and marshmallows over low heat, stirring occasionally until marshmallows are melted., Remove from heat; blend in vanilla., In a large bowl, add mixture to cereal., Stir to coat., Spread into buttered 9 x 13-inch pan. Cool completely., Cut into bars.

title: Beefy Jalapeno Cornbread
directions: Combine cornmeal mix, eggs, buttermilk and corn. Saute ground beef; add onion and cook until onion is transparent, then drain. Pour 1/2 of the cornbread mix in a 9 x 13-inch pan that has been greased liberally. Crumble ground beef over cornbread mix and sprinkle cheese over this. Top with peppers, then rest of the cornbread mix., Bake at 350° for 50 minutes.

title: Pickle And Onion Salad
directions: Cut into chunks the onions and pickles., Mix with mayonnaise to make sauce., Salt and pepper to taste., Serve with fried fish.

title: Baked Eggplant Parmesiana
directions: Dip each slice of eggplant into well beaten egg and into seasoned bread crumbs., Fry breaded eggplant slices in medium to hot oil in frying pan, 2 minutes on each side., Drain cooked eggplant slices on paper towels., Layer in glass baking dish some of your favorite tomato sauce, then all of the cooked eggplant. Top with more sauce and finish by topping with some grated Mozzarella cheese and dried oregano.

title: Oven Roasted Potatoes
directions: Preheat oven to 450°., In a large plastic food bag or bowl, combine all ingredients., Toss until potatoes are coated evenly. Place into shallow baking or roasting pan., Bake, stirring occasionally, 40 minutes, or until potatoes are tender and golden brown., Garnish with chopped fresh parsley., Per serving:, 174 calories, 9 grams fat.

title: Easy Chicken Pot Pie
directions: Melt butter in pan., Add flour, stirring until smooth and thick., Cook one minute, stirring constantly., Gradually add broth and milk., Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly until thick and bubbly., Stir in all of the remaining ingredients., Pour into unbaked pie crust., Add top crust., Make several slits in top crust., Bake at 400° for 30 to 40 minutes., Makes 4 servings.

title: Mashed Potato Candy
directions: Add sugar and vanilla to cold potato., Roll with rolling pin dusted with flour., Spread with peanut butter., Roll up like a pinwheel; place in refrigerator., Cut into slices., May be frozen. Wrap in wax paper or plastic wrap so it doesn't dry out.

title: Chocolate Boiled Cookies
directions: Cook sugar, milk, margarine and cocoa over medium heat until it comes to a full rolling boil, stirring constantly., Remove from heat., Add nuts, oats, peanut butter and vanilla., Beat until well blended., Spoon onto waxed paper.

title: Vegetarian Four-Bean Chili(Low-Calorie, Low-Fat, Low-Cholesterol)
directions: Heat oil in large pot over medium heat., Add onion, green pepper and garlic; saute 4 minutes or until onion is softened. Add carrot; cover and cook 2 minutes., Add zucchini, summer squash, chili powder, oregano and cumin., Saute 1 minute., Add tomatoes breaking up with wooden spoon the beer and salt., Bring to boiling. Lower heat; simmer, partially covered 15 minutes. Stir in all the beans., Simmer, stirring, until heated through.

title: Rye Snacks
directions: In a bowl, combine the first 7 ingredients., Spread on bread slices and place on ungreased baking sheets., Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes or until bubbly., Yields 4 dozen.

title: Dill Dip
directions: Mix together., Refrigerate overnight or until ready to use. Serve with veggies or chips.

title: Beef And Vegetable Stir-Fry
directions: In a small bowl, mix beef broth with cornstarch and teriyaki sauce; set aside., In a large skillet, heat 1 tablespoon oil over high heat; add mushrooms, green pepper and onions., Stir-fry until tender., Remove to bowl., Add remaining oil and beef; stir-fry until cooked., Add beef broth mixture and cook, stirring constantly until thickened., Add vegetables., Serve in warm pastry shells.

title: Sugarless Apple Pie
directions: Simmer peeled, sliced apples in undiluted apple juice until apples are tender., Add cinnamon and cornstarch moistened with a small amount of water., Cook until thickened.

title: Meringue Cake
directions: Sift flour and baking powder., Mix in order given., Pour into 2 layer cake pans.

title: Biscotti
directions: Mix all ingredients together and knead., Bake at 350° until firm., Let cool for 10 minutes., Slice and rebake on ungreased cookie sheet.

title: Chicken Jerusalem
directions: Heat oil in frying pan., Dredge chicken pieces in flour and lightly brown in oil., Place in casserole with mushrooms and artichoke hearts., Stir in garlic and spices (with tomatoes). Pour over chicken., Bake at 350° for 1 to 1 1/2 hours or until tender, adding sherry during last few minutes of cooking time. Makes 4 servings.

title: Pumpkin Chocolate Chip Muffins
directions: Mix dry ingredients: flour, sugar, pumpkin pie spice, soda, powder and salt in one bowl.

title: Apple Butter
directions: Wash, stem and	quarter apples., Place cider in kettle. Add apples and	cook, slowly, until, soft., Put apples through strainer., Measure apples and for each cup, add 1/2 cup sugar. Mix well., Add	spices., Cook, slowly, over low heat, stirring until sugar is, dissolved,, then	cook rapidly until butter is thick.

title: Mississippi Pecan Pie
directions: Boil syrup and sugar together for two minutes., Pour slowly over eggs and stir well., Add margarine, vanilla and nuts. Pour into unbaked pie shell and bake at 375 degrees for 50 minutes.

title: Easy, Good Salad
directions: In a bowl, mix together cottage cheese, Cool Whip and jello. Drain fruit and blend in. Chill before serving.

title: Burrito Casserole
directions: Brown meat in skillet., Drain., Add can of beans and taco seasoning., Stuff tortillas and place in casserole dish., Mix chili and picante sauce in separate bowl., Pour over tortillas. Top with cheese and bake at 375° until bubbly.

title: Veg-All Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients together and pour in casserole., Top with crackers, crumbled and 1 stick margarine, mixed., Bake at 350° until hot and bubbly.

title: Barbecued Steak Platter(Cube Steaks)
directions: Combine all ingredients, heat and pour over 4 cube steaks. Let stand for 15 minutes., Drain and place steaks on rack 2 inches below broiler., Broil 5 minutes on each side, basting once or twice with sauce., Brown 4 bread slices in butter or margarine and arrange steaks on slices., Serve with onion and pickle.

title: Yum Yum Salad
directions: Boil pineapple and sugar together., Add Jell-O; when dissolved, add cup water., Refrigerate until almost jelled; add cheese, Cool Whip and nuts.

title: Artichoke Dip
directions: Drain artichokes well and chop., Grate cheese., Combine with mayonnaise and bake at 350° for 30 minutes., Serve warm with crackers.

title: Cocoa Fudge Icing
directions: Combine all except vanilla in pot., Slowly bring to a boil. Cook for 4 minutes, stirring constantly., Take from heat; add vanilla and beat until spreading consistency., Ready to frost 2 or 3 layer cake., (I usually use Pillsbury Plus yellow cake mix for layers.)

title: Italian Supper Casserole
directions: Cook the lasagna noodles according to directions., Drain rinse and separate., brown the beef and sprinkle the mix over the meat., Add tomatoes and blend well., Whip the cream cheese. In a buttered 1 1/2 quart casserole., Make 2 layers each of noodles, meat & dollops of cream cheese. Bake at 350 degree for 20 minutes or until bubbly., Makes 6 servings.

title: Chinese Goulash
directions: Brown beef; drain fat., Add onion and celery and continue cooking until tender, but not soft., Add bean sprouts and soup. Heat thoroughly., Add canned mushrooms if desired., Serve over chow mein noodles.

title: Chili
directions: Brown beef., While beef is cooking, cook all other ingredients together. Drain beef, then mix all together in a large pot. Cook for 10 more minutes. Very good!

title: Pizza Crust
directions: In a large bowl, combine flour, sugar, undissolved yeast and salt. Gradually add water and 2 tablespoons peanut oil to flour mixture. Beat 2 minutes at medium speed of mixer, scraping bowl occasionally. Stir in enough remaining flour to make a soft dough. Knead on lightly floured surface until smooth and elastic, about 8 to 10 minutes. Cover and let rest 10 minutes. Roll dough to a 12-inch circle; place on a greased pizza pan. Form a standing rim on crust. Prick dough with fork, randomly. Let rest 10 minutes. Prebake at 450° for 5 minutes.

title: Cajun Turkey
directions: Mix together m.s.g., cayenne pepper, paprika, white pepper and celery salt., Rub into turkey cavity and all over the skin., (Be careful and don't touch your hands to your eyes!), Separate garlic bud and clean cloves., Slit holes all over turkey and insert cloves., Also place cloves of garlic in stomach cavity of turkey. Mix a 4 ounce bottle of shrimp and crab boil with 4 (4 ounce) bottles of water and inject into turkey all over the body., Place turkey in stainless steel roasting pan and cover with foil. Refrigerate for 24 to 48 hours, occasionally basting with juices in pan., When ready to cook, heat oil., Place whole turkey in oil and fry until tender.

title: Satsuma Salad
directions: Peel the satsumas and cut crosswise into slices., Sprinkle powdered sugar over satsuma slices., Drain pineapple., Mix all ingredients together and let stand in refrigerator overnight (or at least 3 to 4 hours)., To serve, spoon mixture onto lettuce leaves.

title: Banana Bread
directions: Beat together all ingredients except bananas., Then mix well. Turn in bananas., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Green Pea Casserole
directions: Mix together peas, onions, soup, bacon and water chestnuts. Place in casserole dish. Top with Stove Top mix and melted butter. Bake at 350° about 20 to 25 minutes until brown.

title: Heavenly Fluff
directions: Mix all ingredients together; chill in a classy glass bowl.

title: Lite Meat Loaf
directions: Combine all ingredients., Mix well., Shape in 7 x 4 x 2-inch loaf pan which was coated with cooking spray (Pam)., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes., Let stand 5 minutes before slicing., Serves 6. Pepper slices can be placed on top of meat loaf before cooking for decoration.

title: Chicken Aspic Salad
directions: Sprinkle 1 envelope gelatin in tomato juice., Heat, stirring, until dissolved., Add 1/4 teaspoon salt, 1 tablespoon lemon juice and dash of Tabasco., Set aside to cool., In separate saucepan, sprinkle 1 envelope gelatin in chicken stock., Heat; stir until dissolved., Remove from heat and add 1/4 teaspoon salt and 1 tablespoon lemon juice., Let cool., Add chicken, celery and green pepper., Pour 1/2 of mixture into loaf pan that has been Pam coated., Chill., When firm, add tomato aspic mixture., When aspic is almost firm, spread last half of chicken mix., Chill., Serve on lettuce.

title: Rigatoni Casserole
directions: Cook noodles., Cook spaghetti sauce., Add mix and water., Cook for 20 minutes., Layer all ingredients in a casserole dish., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Sour Cream Corn Bread
directions: Mix and bake at 375° for 35 minutes.

title: 7-Up Cake
directions: Mix all together. Bake in a 325° oven for 30 minutes. Makes 3 layers.

title: Chocolate Cookie Sheet Cake
directions: Remove from heat., Add 1 box powdered sugar., Beat., Add 1/2 cup chopped nuts and 2 teaspoons vanilla., Spread on cake as soon as it is taken from the oven.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., In small bowl, combine flour, baking soda and salt; set aside., In a large bowl, beat butter, sugar, brown sugar and vanilla extract until creamy., Beat in eggs. Gradually beat in flour mixture., Stir in chocolate and nuts., Drop by rounded measuring tablespoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheets. Bake for 9 to 11 minutes, until golden brown., Yields 5 dozen cookies (using tablespoons of dough).

title: James Earl Jones' Chilean Sea Bass
directions: Slice and cook onions in a skillet on low heat until caramelized (between 1 and 2 hours)., Puree all ingredients except olive oil and chicken broth. Heat olive oil. Add ingredients and cook on low for 30 minutes. Add chicken broth as necessary. Season bass with salt and white pepper to taste., Cover bass with onions and bake at 425° for 10 to 12 minutes., Each of 6 servings should include one piece of bass over about 1/6 of the sauce.

title: Pecan Pie
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Cream sugar, syrup and margarine., Add salt, vanilla and eggs (one at a time)., Stir in pecans., Pour into pie crust., Bake for 1 hour.

title: Smoky Salmon Appetizer Ball
directions: Combine the first 6 ingredients in a large bowl., Place mixture on plastic wrap and form into a ball., Cover and chill overnight., Several hours before serving, roll in chopped nuts. Chill until ready to serve.

title: Japanese Fruit Pie(Makes 2 Pies)
directions: Bake at 300° for 55 minutes., Do not bake crust before pouring in the ingredients.

title: Hamburger Stroganoff
directions: Saute onion and garlic in butter over medium heat., Stir in meat and brown., Stir in flour, pepper, salt and soup.

title: Easy Peanut Butter Cookies
directions: Combine and shape into balls., Place on ungreased cookie sheet., Bake at 350° for 10 minutes., Press into center of hot cookies, 36 chocolate kisses., Remove to wire rack to cool., Makes about 3 dozen.

title: Best Meat Loaf
directions: Mix all together by hand until all ingredients are combined. Put in dish and put in oven at 350° for 1 hour., Top with ketchup. Cook uncovered.

title: Kosher Dill Pickles
directions: Wash and cut cucumbers in half lengthwise; pack in hot jars with the last 5 ingredients put in each pint jar., Combine sugar, salt, vinegar and water., Tie pickling spices in a cheesecloth bag; add to vinegar mixture., Simmer 15 minutes., Heat to boiling and pour over cucumbers; leave 1/4-inch headspace., Adjust caps. Process pints and quarts 15 minutes in boiling water bath., Yield: about 7 pints.

title: Orange Molded Salad
directions: Dissolve jello in boiling water., Add sherbet and place in refrigerator until partly set (watch carefully)., Add other ingredients and fold in Cool Whip last., Chill and enjoy.

title: Shrimp Dip
directions: Mix all ingredients, except chili sauce, shrimp and parsley. Spread on plate., Cover with chili sauce, then sprinkle tiny shrimp and parsley flakes., Serve with crackers.

title: Aunt Beta'S Beer Bread
directions: Blend beer, egg and sugar, then add flour., Put it in a bread pan and cover with towel., It rises in an hour or so., Bake at 350° for an hour., Cool and slice bread., Spread real butter on top., Mmmm!, Good!

title: Fruit Salad
directions: Drain all fruit well.

title: Taco Salad
directions: Brown meat and drain, then add seasoning mix, taco sauce and kidney beans., Let all this get hot, then its ready to eat.

title: Pecan Tarts
directions: Combine first 5 ingredients; mix well., Spoon 1 teaspoon filling into pastry shell., Bake tarts at 350° for 17 minutes. Garnish with cream., Makes 2 dozen.

title: Cowboy Cookies
directions: Cream the sugar and shortening., Add the egg and vanilla. Then the rest of the ingredients., Roll in balls and flatten. Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Broccoli Au Gratin
directions: Combine ingredients in 1 1/2-quart casserole., Top with 1/4 cup cracker crumbs and 2 tablespoons butter., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

title: Zucchini Walnut Bread
directions: Chop walnuts., Beat eggs; gradually beat in sugar, then oil. Combine first mixture, alternating with zucchini., Stir in raisins, walnuts and vanilla extract., Turn into 2 greased and lightly floured loaf pans., Bake at 350° or until loaves test done, approximately 1 hour., (Bake on lowest rack in oven.), Let stand about 10 minutes, turn out onto wire racks to cool., If desired, loaves may be lightly frosted with confectioners sugar, butter and vanilla mixed to a spreading consistency with milk. Makes two loaves., Freezes well!

title: Onion Pie
directions: Saute onions until clear., Pour onions into a prepared pie shell., Add grated cheese., Beat eggs; add milk and pour over cheese., Bake for 30 to 40 minutes at 350°.

title: Macaroni-Beef Skillet Supper
directions: Cook the macaroni in boiling water according to package directions., Drain and set, aside., Saute, the meat, onion and garlic in oil until the, meat, loses, its, pink, color and the onions are tender., Add, salt,, pepper,, tomato sauce, catsup, mushrooms, Worcestershire, sauce and Italian seasoning., Bring mixture to a boil and, then simmer gently for about 5 minutes. Mix in the cooked, macaroni and simmer 5 more minutes., Yields 8 servings., Contains 270 calories per serving.

title: Artichoke And Spinach Casserole
directions: Cook spinach., Saute onion in butter., Mix spinach, onion, artichoke hearts, sour cream and 1/4 cup of Parmesan cheese in a casserole dish., Add pepper and toss well., Put remaining 1/4 cup cheese on top., Bake, covered, at 325° for 30 minutes.

title: Delicious Cabbage
directions: Brown onions., Remove from pan., Place 1/3 cabbage in pan followed by 1/2 of bell pepper, one tomato and half the browned onion., Layer with another 1/3 of cabbage and remaining bell pepper, tomato and onions., Sprinkle remaining cabbage on top and add salt and pepper., Cover and simmer about 20 minutes or until vegetables are tender.

title: Homemade Spaghetti Sauce
directions: Saute onion in oil until limp., Add remaining ingredients. Simmer 30 minutes., Add cooked meat, if desired.

title: Coconut Grouper
directions: Combine lime juice, oregano and half the garlic., Marinate the fish in this for at least 1/2 hour.

title: Candied Dill Pickles
directions: Dissolve 1 pint of lime in 2 gallons of water., Peel, seed and cut cucumbers into strips., (Use large cucumbers, even the white ones; use the meat only., You can fix small ones the same way.) Pour lime mixture over cucumbers and let stand for 24 hours., Drain and rinse cucumbers., Fill with ice cold water and let stand for 3 hours., Drain., Mix vinegar, sugar, salt and spices together., Pour over cucumbers., Let stand overnight., Put on stove next morning and boil for 35 minutes., Put in jars and seal., Makes 10 pints.

title: Lasagne
directions: Brown meat in olive oil with garlic, basil, parsley and salt. Add tomatoes and paste., Simmer 1 hour., Cook noodles until tender (rinse with cold water)., In bowl, combining cottage cheese, eggs, Parmesan cheese, parsley and pepper., In 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan, put little meat on bottom, then noodles, half of cottage cheese mixture, half of Mozzarella cheese, half of meat., Bake at 375° for 45 minutes.

title: Meatballs With Gravy
directions: Mix well the first 6 ingredients; shape into balls., Brown in the shortening., Mix the soup with water; pour over meatballs. Simmer 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Rhubarb Crumble
directions: Combine rhubarb, apples and strawberries; spoon into a greased 8-inch square baking dish., Combine sugar and cinnamon; sprinkle over fruit., Set aside., In a bowl, combine flour, baking powder and salt., Cut in oleo until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Stir in brown sugar and oats., Sprinkle over rhubarb mixture. Bake at 350° for 40 to 50 minutes, or until lightly browned. Serve cold or warm with a scoop of ice cream if desired.

title: Stuffed Peppers
directions: Wash and clean peppers., Parboil peppers for 5 minutes., Let cool and drain., Combine rice, meat, salt, pepper and butter; mix well., Stuff peppers; place peppers in a pan, uncovered, with a little water in the bottom., Bake at 350° for 1 hour (check after 45 minutes)., Heat can of tomato sauce and serve with peppers.

title: Barbecue Coleslaw
directions: Combine vinegar and sugar in small saucepan., Cook over low heat just until sugar dissolves., Stir in barbecue sauce, water, mayonnaise, mustard powder and red pepper seasoning., Combine cabbage and carrots in large bowl., Pour dressing over; toss to combine.

title: Au Gratin Potatoes
directions: Combine all ingredients but potatoes and mix well., Add potatoes and mix gently., Place in a 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake at 375° for 1 hour.

title: Zucchini Casserole
directions: Mix all together and pour into greased pan. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. This, can be frozen and taken out when needed.

title: Garlic Spread
directions: Preheat the oven to 375°. Slice about 1/2-inch off the top of the garlic. Wrap it in aluminum foil and bake for 35 minutes. Remove foil and press until all flesh squeezes out. You should have 1 heaping tablespoonful of puree. Mix it with the yogurt, parsley, black pepper and salt.

title: Hot Fudge Cake
directions: Melt butter; stir in Eagle Brand milk and Hershey's syrup. For the cake just bake devil's food cake and follow directions on box., Cut cake and ice cream in squares and pour fudge over top.

title: Italian Pasta Salad
directions: Cook pasta according to package directions without adding fat or salt., Drain and rinse with cold water., Set aside., In a large bowl combine tomato sauce, dressing , basil, and oregano., Add tomatoes, cucumber, onion, and olives., Stir until coated., Add pasta and gently toss., Refrigerate at least 2 hours.

title: Dump Cake
directions: Bake in Magnolite pot., Pour in cherry filling., Layer can of crushed pineapple on top of cherry filling., Sprinkle dry cake mix on top of fillings., Sprinkle pecans over mixture., Pour melted margarine over mixture., Bake for 10 minutes at 450°., Then turn oven down to 350° and bake for 25 more minutes.

title: Corn Bread
directions: Mix all ingredients., Bake in greased iron skillet on 400° to 425° until brown.

title: Apple Dumplings
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Use 9 x 13-inch pan and 2-quart saucepan.

title: Sea Scallops With Lemon Butter Sauce
directions: Coat 1 lb. sea scallops in flour. Season with salt and pepper. Saute scallops in olive oil & butter in a large skillet over high heat for 2 minutes on each side.	Remove scallops., Add butter, lemon juice, parsley, salt & pepper and heat., Serve scallops over rice and top with sauce from skillet.

title: Papa Nick'S Dill Pickles
directions: Bring water, vinegar and salt to boil; let stand 20 minutes. When cool, pour over cukes and green tomatoes, prepared according to preference., Small tomatoes and cucumbers can be left whole, if desired, and larger vegetables can be cut into chunks., Cucumbers may be sliced open lengthwise and cut into quarters or eighths. Put vegetables in quart jars; to each jar, add 2 sprigs dill and 2 large garlic cloves, depending on taste.

title: Poppy Seed Chicken
directions: Season and cook chicken., Bone and cut in bite-size pieces. Place in buttered 9 x 13-inch casserole dish., Mix soup and sour cream and heat., Pour over chicken., Mix crackers and poppy seed and place on top of meat., Drizzle melted oleo on top., Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes, until bubbly.

title: Strawberry Salad
directions: Cut strawberries in half., Slice bananas., Drain pineapple. Cream sugar and cheese together., Fold in tub of Cool Whip and marshmallows., Mix together the frozen strawberries, pineapple and pecans., Add to cheese mixture., Refrigerate.

title: Easy Pecan Rolls
directions: Butter pan., Cover pan with frozen bread dough, then add pudding mix, brown sugar, cinnamon, pecans and butter., Cover; let sit out on counter overnight., Cook at 350° for 15 minutes uncovered, then 15 minutes covered.

title: Frozen Fruit Salad
directions: Cream the cream cheese and Miracle Whip and whip the cream in separate bowl., Fold crushed pineapple, marshmallows and chopped cherries into cream cheese and Miracle Whip., Last, add whipped cream., Put into 13 x 9-inch dish; freeze overnight., Let set at room temperature 1/2 hour before eating.

title: Fruit Cocktail Cake
directions: Mix thoroughly all ingredients. Pour into a greased and floured 9 x 12 3/4-inch oblong pan. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes in bottom rack of oven.

title: Quick Fruit Cake
directions: Combine all these ingredients. Bake at 325° for 30 minutes. Makes about a 3 pound fruit cake.

title: Johnny Marzetti
directions: Brown beef, onions, pepper and mushrooms., Add tomato paste, sauce, water and Worcestershire sauce., Cook over low heat for 30 minutes., Arrange in 2 small or one large oblong dish.

title: Apple Snack
directions: Preheat oven to 250°., Place apples in a single layer in a large, flat baking pan. Bake 20 minutes., Remove from oven, and stir in popcorn and pecans. Mix remaining ingredients in a cup and drizzle over apples, popcorn, and pecans. Return to oven, and bake for 30 minutes, stirring every 10 minutes.

title: Red Cake
directions: Mix butter, sugar and eggs., Make a paste of red coloring and cocoa., Add to creamed mixture., Add buttermilk, alternating with sifted flour and salt., Add vanilla., In small cup, mix soda and vinegar, then add to rest of mixture, blending instead of beating. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes at 350° in 2 (8-inch) greased and floured pans.

title: Punch
directions: Mix Kool-Aid, juice and sugar in a gallon jug., Add water to fill jug.

title: Crab Meat Dip
directions: Bake at 350° for 20 minutes and serve with Triscuits.

title: Miracle Brownies
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Sift first 5 ingredients in a bowl. Add shortening, eggs, vanilla and corn syrup., Mix for 2 minutes at low speed; scrape bowl., Stir in nuts; save some nuts to sprinkle on top., Pour into a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan., Cook 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Chicken Salad Stuffed Shells
directions: Cook pasta as directed; drain., Combine curry, yogurt, mayonnaise, lemon juice, mustard and garlic., Add chicken, red pepper, celery, scallions and sunflower seed., Toss lightly. Spoon 1 1/2 tablespoons into each shell., Chill., Serve on lettuce.

title: Choc' Gravy
directions: Mix well and cook over medium heat until thick., Serve over buttered toast or biscuits.

title: Party Mints
directions: Mix, with, fork until moist., Add milk., Do not get too moist. Mix with hands., Will be very stiff., Push into rubber molds.

title: Joe'S Cheesecake
directions: Combine ingredients, except sour cream., Beat until smooth, blending in sour cream., Pour into graham or nut crust, trim with reserved crumbs., Bake in moderate (375°) oven for 35 minutes or until just set., Let cool with oven door open., Do not overheat or cool too rapidly., Chill well.

title: Onion Casserole
directions: Peel and slice onions into thin rings., Saute in margarine until limp or opaque., Pour half of onions into a 1 1/2-quart casserole dish., Cover with Parmesan cheese, then crushed crackers., Repeat layers and bake, uncovered, in 325° oven until golden brown, about 30 minutes., Delicious with steak!!

title: Peach Cobbler Cake
directions: Pour undrained peaches in 9 x 13-inch pan., Sprinkle Jell-O over peaches., Sprinkle cake mix on top., Poke holes in cake mix and pour 1 1/2 cups water over all., Dot with 1 1/4 sticks butter and bake at 350° for 1 hour and 5 minutes.

title: Meat Loaf
directions: Set oven at 350°., Combine ingredients, except beef., Mix well. Add ground beef; mix., Press into an 8 x 4-inch loaf pan., Bake for 1 hour., Drain; let stand for 5 minutes.

title: Linda'S Strawberry Salad
directions: Mix jell-O with hot water., Add pineapple with the juice and the pie filling; mix well., Place in a 13 x 9 casserole dish., Let congeal in refrigerator., In a small bowl mix cream cheese, sour cream and sugar., Pour this mixture over congealed salad.

title: Turtle Cake
directions: Combine chocolate cake mix, butter, water, oil and 1/2 can sweetened condensed milk in mixing bowl., Mix well., Pour half of batter into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch baking dish., Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Kentucky Jam Cake
directions: Combine sugar, oil, buttermilk, eggs, blackberry jam and vanilla in large bowl., Beat well on low speed., Add combined ingredients and beat on medium speed to blend well., Bake at 350° in 2 greased and floured 9-inch cake pans for 40 minutes or until tests done., Cool completely and frost with Buttermilk Icing.

title: Sausage Balls
directions: Mix all together with your hands., Make into small balls and bake on ungreased baking sheet at 350° for about 25 minutes, until golden brown., Serve hot., These make such a hit with every one and are so easy.

title: Polka Dot Cake
directions: Mix dates and hot water., Let cool., Cream butter and sugar, then beat in eggs., Sift dry ingredients and add to cream mixture. Add dates, vanilla and 1/2 cup chocolate chips., Spread batter in greased pan., Top with remaining chocolate chips and nuts., Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

title: Pina Colada Punch
directions: Mix all ingredients and freeze in a covered container., When ready to serve, let defrost to a slushy consistency.

title: Applesauce Salad
directions: Heat applesauce in pan. Stir in gelatin until dissolved. Add orange juice and pineapple. Stir until smooth. Pour into mold and chill.

title: Orange Balls
directions: Melt butter., Mix all ingredients and roll into balls., Roll in chopped pecans or coconut, if desired.

title: Beef And Bean Casserole
directions: Brown ground beef with onions; drain grease., Add remaining ingredients., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Cup Cookies
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Drop by spoonfuls onto cookie sheet., Press flat., Bake at 325° for approximately eight minutes. Watch carefully for these goodies burn easily.

title: Pa'S Fruit Bread
directions: Mix sugar, cooking oil and eggs., Add fruit and nuts; mix well., Stir in flour; mix well., Pour in a 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Bake in a preheated 350° oven for 45 minutes.

title: Scalloped Pineapple
directions: Melt oleo in dish., Combine all other ingredients and mix lightly., Add to butter and bake at 350° for 1 hour., Serves 8 to 10.

title: Banana Bread
directions: Mix sugar, eggs, vegetable oil, mashed bananas and vanilla. Then add sifted flour with baking soda and salt., Add nuts if you like., Pour mixture into greased loaf pan., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Dessert Pizza
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., Arrange cut cookie dough (1/8 to 1/4-inch) rounds in slightly overlapping pattern on pizza pan. Press dough together to seal., Bake until puffed and golden, about 10 minutes., Cool completely.

title: Russian Tea
directions: Mix and store in tightly covered container., Use 3 to 4 teaspoons mixture in cup of hot water.

title: Sugar Pie
directions: Mix the flour with the sugar., Add the milk., Mix and pour into 1 pie crust and cover with the second crust., Bake at 325° for 25 minutes., Lower the heat to 300 degrees, and bake for approximately 15 minutes longer.

title: Broccoli Salad
directions: Combine ingredients and mix with sauce.

title: Rhubarb Custard Pie
directions: Place pastry in pie pan., Arrange rhubarb., Mix sugar with flour and add beaten egg yolks and butter., Spoon mixture over rhubarb., Bake in hot oven at 450° for 12 minutes., Reduce heat to 350° and continue baking for 25 minutes.

title: Potato Salad
directions: Boil potatoes in their jackets until done., Peel while still hot; let cool., Slice in thin round slices., Mix in mayonnaise, vinegar and sugar., Grate onion and add with salt and pepper., Mix again., Chill thoroughly for 3 hours.

title: Bluegill Parmesan
directions: Place butter in a shallow dish. In another dish, combine bread crumbs, Parmesan cheese and seasonings. Dip fillets in butter, then coat with crumb mixture. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes, uncovered, or until fish flakes easily with a fork.

title: Creamy Cauliflower Soup
directions: Cook cauliflower in saltwater 10 to 15 minutes; drain., In saucepan, cook onion in butter until tender., Blend in flour., Add chicken broth, milk and Worcestershire sauce., Cook until slightly thickened., Add cauliflower., Bring to boil; add cheese., Sprinkle chives over each serving.

title: Vegetable Pizza
directions: Unroll crescent rolls on cookie sheet, but do not take them apart. Bake until golden brown and let cool. Mix cream cheese and dry seasonings together. Spread mixture on baked crescent rolls and sprinkle on all chopped veggies. Let chill and serve.

title: Billy Faye'S Chip Dip
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Heat on low until melted and fairly smooth., Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Scott'S Sour Cream Biscuits
directions: Mix all, ingredients and spoon in miniature muffin pan. Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.

title: Mississippi Mud Pie
directions: Melt butter., Add brown sugar and water (boiled 1 minute to syrup)., In bowl mix egg yolks, flour and milk; slowly add syrup. Return to stove; boil until thick., Add vanilla; pour into baked pie shell., Sprinkle top with crushed graham crackers.

title: Plum Cake(This Is A Surprise!)
directions: Mix sugar, oil, eggs, plums, food coloring and vanilla., Add flour, soda, salt, cinnamon, cloves and pecans., Mix well and pour into greased and floured Bundt pan., Bake 1 hour at 350°., Glaze cake while still warm, after removing from pan.

title: Lasagna
directions: Brown meat slowly., Spoon off excess fat., Add next 4 ingredients., Cover and simmer 40 minutes, stirring occasionally. Salt to taste., Cook noodles in salted water until tender; drain. Rinse in cold water., Place half of the noodles in large baking dish., Cover with 1/3 of the sauce., Add half of the Mozzarella cheese, then half of the cottage cheese., Repeat layers, ending with sauce., Top with Parmesan cheese., Bake in a 350° oven for 25 to 30 minutes., Let stand 15 minutes., Cut into squares.

title: King Ranch Chicken
directions: Boil chicken until tender., Remove from bone., Line bottom and sides of greased 3-quart casserole dish with layer of tortillas., Sprinkle with 2 or 3 tablespoons chicken stock. Layer with 1/2 can undiluted mushroom soup and 1/2 of other ingredients in the order listed., Cover with another layer of tortillas; sprinkle with 2 or 3 tablespoons chicken stock and remaining ingredients., Top the last layer of cheese with can of tomatoes with chilies., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Sheila'S Potato Casserole
directions: Saute onion in margarine in skillet. Add to rest of ingredients in a rectangular dish; cook at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Mexican Cornbread
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Bake about 45 minutes at 350° to 400°.

title: Cherry Burgundy Ice Cream
directions: In saucepan, dissolve jello in 1/2 cup boiling water and juice from the cherries., Cool slightly., In mixing bowl, beat eggs well., Add sugar; beat well., Blend in the half and half., Cut cherries into fourths and add to mixture; stir in vanilla and jello mixture last., Pour into freezer canister., Add milk until about 3/4 full., An electric freezer takes about 15 minutes to freeze.

title: Whipped Cream Supreme
directions: Melt butter., Stir in flour and nuts., Press into bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 10 to 15 minutes, or until lightly browned., Cool.

title: Fresh Vegetable Dip
directions: Combine all ingredients., Chill., Serve with assorted vegetables (tomatoes, cauliflower, green pepper, cucumber, celery, etc.).

title: Vegetable Pizza
directions: Unroll crescent rolls and press flat into cookie sheet., Join all creases., Bake at 400° for 10 minutes., Remove from oven and cool in pan.

title: Harvard Beets
directions: Mix sugar and cornstarch; add vinegar, oil and water., Bring to boil., Add beets and cook over low heat 30 minutes or until thick.

title: Old Fashion Pumpkin Pie
directions: Combine pumpkin, sugars and all spices well., Beat eggs well with 1/4 cup melted oleo or butter., Add this to the pumpkin mixture and mix well., Pour into 10-inch unbaked pie shell. Bake at 450° for 10 minutes., Reduce heat to 350° and bake 40 minutes longer.

title: Strawberry Cobbler
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Pour melted butter into a shallow, 1 1/2-quart baking dish., In a large bowl, combine flour, 1/4 cup sugar and milk., Pour mixture evenly over butter., Combine strawberries, remaining 1/2 cup sugar and water in a separate bowl, then spoon evenly over the flour/milk layer., Do not stir. Bake for 40 to 45 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Biscuits
directions: Combine dry ingredients., Cut in shortening until it resembles coarse crumbs., Dissolve yeast in warm water., Add yeast and buttermilk to dry mixture., Mix well., Roll out desired amount on lightly floured surface to about 1/4-inch thick., Cut with 2-inch cutter., Let rise 10 minutes., Preheat oven to 450°., Bake 15 to 20 minutes., Watch carefully until you get the time right for your oven., Dough will keep in refrigerator a week in covered container or plastic bag.

title: Icebox Pie
directions: Blend ingredients well in blender., (If making lemon icebox pie, blend juice from 2 lemons in blender with cottage cheese.) Pour mixture into a bowl., Add 1 vanilla supplement and mix well.

title: Chicken Jambalaya
directions: Remove skin from chicken., Place chicken, water, salt and pepper in Dutch oven., Heat to boiling, reduce heat, cover and simmer 20 minutes., Remove chicken from broth., Skim fat from broth., Strain broth.

title: Crab Gumbo
directions: Heat oil in large kettle on medium heat., Add flour, stirring constantly until dark brown but not burned., Add onion and garlic. Cook until tender, stirring occasionally., Gradually stir in undrained tomatoes., Add sugar, worcestershire sauce, salt, hot pepper sauce and bay leaf., Stir to break up tomatoes., Bring to a boil., Reduce heat., Cover., Simmer 10 minutes to blend flavor, stirring occasionally., Add okra., Cook 5 minutes or until tender, stirring occasionally., Add crab., Stir gently and heat through. Discard bay leaf., Serve gumbo over rice., (4 servings.)

title: Tarheel Pie
directions: Melt margarine; pour over chocolate chips until dissolved. Combine eggs, sugar, vanilla, and nuts., Mix with chocolate mixture., Place in deep dish pie crust., Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

title: Vegetarian Chili With Rice
directions: Combine kidney beans, Northern beans, undrained tomatoes, tomato sauce, pepper, onion, chili powder, sugar, basil, garlic and water in a large saucepan., Bring to boiling and reduce heat. Simmer, covered, for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally., Top each serving with 1/2 cup rice., Serves 4.

title: Sparkling Punch
directions: Dissolve gelatin in water., Stir in lemonade., Add ginger ale and ice., Serve., Makes 1 gallon.

title: Buckeyes
directions: Mix first 4, ingredients like pie dough; roll to size of walnut., Set on wax paper., Melt chocolate chips and paraffin in a double boiler., Leave the pan of water under the melted chocolate while dipping the balls., Set on wax paper on cookie sheet and cool., Store in tight container in refrigerator.

title: Patty'S Peanut Butter Icing
directions: Mix together and beat at high speed for at least 5 minutes.

title: Quick And Easy Pizza
directions: You don't have to toast muffins.

title: Mushroom-Cheese Souffle("A Favorite From The '76 Cookbook.")
directions: Start heating oven to 300°., With hand beater, beat egg yolks until light and foamy., Stir milk gradually into flour., Add to egg yolks and beat well., Add salt, pepper and cheese and beat until blended., Gently fold in onion, mushrooms and egg whites, stiffly beaten., Turn into greased 1-quart casserole., Bake about 50 minutes or until golden brown on top., Makes 2 servings.

title: Quick Caramel Frosting
directions: Melt the butter in saucepan. Stir in the brown sugar. Cook 2 minutes on low heat, stirring constantly. Add the milk, stirring until mixture comes to a boil., Remove from stove., Stir in the confectioners sugar gradually. Add the vanilla and mix well. Spread immediately on cake., Frost 1 pound cake or 2 layers.

title: Frozen Waldorf Salad
directions: Place the eggs, pineapple juice, sugar and salt in a saucepan and blend and cook until it boils., Cool.

title: Savory Oven-Fried Eggplant
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., Slice eggplant into 1/2-inch slices. Beat eggs slightly., Drop crumbs and seasonings into blender jar and blend well., Pour crumbs on plate., Grease 11 x 17-inch jelly roll pan or baking pan with Crisco; heat pan for several minutes in hot oven., Dip eggplant in egg and then into crumbs., Place on hot baking sheet., Bake 15 minutes on each side., Serve immediately with lemon slices.

title: Fresh Pear Cake
directions: In large bowl, combine pears, sugar and pecans., Set aside for 1 hour., Preheat oven to 350°., Butter and flour large tube pan. Using wooden spoon, stir into pear mixture the oil, vanilla and eggs., Add remaining ingredients., Bake 1 hour.

title: Cream Of Mushroom Soup
directions: Chill broth so fat will raise., Mix cornstarch and broth together., Cook on medium heat., Stir in milk, Worcestershire sauce and mushrooms., Bring to boil., Cool and garnish with paprika.

title: Sin Cake
directions: Mix flour, melted oleo and nuts., Spread in pan; bake approximately 20 minutes at 350° or until light brown., Mix cream cheese, sugar and 1/2 cup Cool Whip., Spread over crust., Mix pudding and milk until thick; spread over 2nd layer., Spread cherry pie filling over all., Cover with the balance of Cool Whip. Refrigerate.

title: Tuna Dip
directions: Drain tuna., Mix with cream cheese until smooth., Add seasoning., Chill and serve with crackers.

title: Party Chicken Breast Bake
directions: Lightly, grease baking dish., Flatten breasts and place slice of	chipped, beef, and, shredded cheese on each breast. Roll, up each, breast, with ends down., Place in baking dish. Combine soup and, sour, cream, and spoon over rolled breasts. Bake at 350° for about 45 minutes.

title: Mexican Hero Sandwiches
directions: Saute ground beef and onion in skillet until ground beef is brown., Stir frequently., Add chilies, olives, catsup, salt and chili powder and mix well., Cook for 5 minutes., Stir occasionally., Place one slice Colby cheese on bottom half of each loaf., Spoon ground beef mixture over cheese., Arrange bacon slice and Muenster cheese slice over ground beef., Cover with remaining loaf halves., Wrap loaves with aluminum foil., Bake at 375° for 10 minutes.

title: Cashew Chicken
directions: Dip chicken pieces in beaten eggs., Shake chicken in a bag of flour (plus a little cornstarch)., Deep fry until brown., Place chicken in baking dish, cover with cashews, onion and sauce., Bake at 250° for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Mexican Bites
directions: Blend all ingredients, except muffins., Toast muffins until half dark., Top with mixture and bake at 350° for 15 minutes., Cut into 4 pieces.

title: Tomato Shrimp Aspic
directions: Sprinkle gelatine over cold water., Stir in sugar, salt, lemon juice and hot tomato juice until it's dissolved., Add shrimp, celery, onion and olives., Pour into mold and leave overnight. When ready to serve, set in hot water for a few seconds and unmold on platter. Arrange salad greens around outside and serve with side dish of salad dressing.

title: Helen'S Sugar Cookies
directions: Mix sugar, margarine, eggs and flavorings thoroughly., Measure flour and sift., Stir flour, baking powder and salt together. Blend well and chill at least 1 hour., Heat oven to 400°., Roll dough 1/8-inch thick on a lightly floured board., Cut with a 3-inch cookie cutter., Place on ungreased cookie sheet., Bake for 6 to 10 minutes or until golden brown., Makes 4 dozen cookies.

title: Corn Chowder
directions: Cut onions, celery, potatoes and add water., Bring to boil and simmer 15 minutes or until done., Melt margarine; add flour and make paste., Remove from pan; put in milk and heat., Add roux gradually (margarine and flour)., Stir until creamy., Add potatoes and corn., Heat and stir., Don't let boil.

title: Corn Casserole
directions: Mix well., Put in glass baking dish., Bake for 45 minutes or until brown at 350°.

title: Parslied Ham And Swiss Cheese Sandwiches
directions: Blend the first 4 ingredients and spread on sandwich buns. Fill with ham and cheese slices., Wrap in foil and bake 15 minutes at 300°.

title: Vegetable Pizza
directions: Sprinkle half of cheese over Crispy Pizza Crust; set aside. Saute vegetables, garlic and Italian seasoning in hot oil 3 to 5 minutes or until vegetables are barely crisp-tender. Spoon vegetables evenly onto pizza. Sprinkle with remaining cheese. Bake at 450 degrees 5 minutes or until cheese melts. Yield: one 12-inch pizza.

title: Quick Veggie Soup
directions: In large pot, brown meat and onion., Cook until onion is tender., Drain; salt and pepper to taste., Put in remaining ingredients; stir., Bring to boil., Reduce heat; simmer, covered, for 15 minutes, or until noodles are tender., Makes 6 servings.

title: Homemade Ice Cream
directions: Add milk to the line in your churn. Add sugar, sweetened condensed milk, and vanilla. Mix well. Add the beaten eggs last and keep the paddle on the churn stirring until you get the freezer ready. This will prevent the eggs from settling to the bottom. Churn and enjoy!

title: Three Cheese Cheese Ball
directions: Let cheese soften at room temperature., Combine all ingredients with hands and form a ball.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Cook chicken, saving 1/2 cup broth., Mix chicken, soups and milk., Pour in a greased glass 9 x 13-inch dish., Cover with Stove Top stuffing., Mix 1/2 cup chicken broth with 1/2 stick melted butter; pour over top., Place in oven and bake at 350° for 30 minutes., Serves 6.

title: Rhubarb Crunch
directions: Mix until crumbly the first 5 ingredients., Press 1/2 of crumbs in greased 7 x 9-inch baking pan., Top with rhubarb., Then combine in saucepan the next 4 ingredients., Cook until thick and clear., Pour over rhubarb., Top with remaining crumbs., Bake at 350° for 1 hour., Cut in squares and serve with whipped cream.

title: Potato Salad
directions: Cut potatoes into small cubes and boil until just tender. Drain and add onion, salt and pepper., Combine vinegar, 1/3 cup mayonnaise and 2 tablespoons of hot water., Add mixture to warm potatoes and let cool., Add green peppers, pimento, celery and the other 1/2 cup mayonnaise to potato mixture and mix well., Chill.

title: Christmas Cookies
directions: Cream butter and sugar; add eggs., Sift flour and cinnamon together and add alternately with milk., Add sherry, nuts and fruit., Drop on well-greased cookie sheet and bake 20 minutes at 300°., Makes about 12 dozen.

title: Chopped Apple Cake
directions: Sift together flour, soda, salt and spices., Blend shortening and sugar., Add eggs; beat well., Add dry ingredients alternately with coffee., Fold in chopped apples and raisins., Nuts may be added if desired., Bake in a greased and floured tube pan at 350° for 1 to 1 1/4 hours., Cake may be iced when cool.

title: Chicken And Corn Soup
directions: Bone chicken and discard skin., Mince the chicken and combine with 1 teaspoon cornstarch and the egg whites, beaten until frothy., Bring chicken broth to a boil., Dissolve remaining cornstarch in water and add gradually to broth., Add chicken mixture, corn, sherry and soy sauce and simmer a few minutes. Serve garnished with ham (boiled, baked or most flavorful and closest to the Chinese, Smithfield ham)., Serves 4.

title: Chicken, Zucchini And Red Pepper Stir-Fry
directions: Cut away tendon and any excess fat from chicken breasts., Place in freezer just until chicken firms up for easier slicing., Do not freeze solid., Meanwhile, insert metal chopping blade in mixer bowl of food processor., Process garlic (or chop fine with French knife)., Remove chopping blade and insert slicing blade., Place zucchini in feed tube vertically and process (or cut in slices with knife)., Insert red pepper in feed tube vertically., Process (or slice into 1/8 inch slices with knife)., Insert scallion vertically., Process (or slice by hand)., Process water chestnuts (or slice by knife)., Put mushrooms on their sides in feed tube. Process (or cut lengthwise into thirds)., Set aside in bowl., To process chicken using slicing blade, wedge chicken into feed tube so slicing disk will cut against grain (or cut by sharp knife into 1/4 inch thick slices).

title: Summertime Ice Tea
directions: In a glass or enamel pan, bring 4 cups cold water to a boil. Add the tea bags and steep about 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Take out tea bags and add the sugar, stirring until sugar is dissolved. Place tea mixture in a 1 gallon container and add frozen juices. Stir until juices dissolve.

title: Hot 'N Spicy Sun-Drop Punch
directions: *Or add to taste.

title: Shoe Peg Salad
directions: Rinse and drain the corn, green beans and garden peas., Bring to boil vinegar, sugar, oil, water, salt and pepper., Cool., Mix with corn, peas and beans and rest of the ingredients. Refrigerate.

title: Pie Crust
directions: Mix first four ingredients., Mix in shortening., Beat together egg, water and vinegar., Add to flour mixture and work well., Can leave in sealed Tupperware container in refrigerator for a week., (I have frozen it.)

title: Etta'S Pecan Pie
directions: Mix ingredients together and pour into pie shells. Bake at 350° until knife inserted in center comes out clean.

title: No-Bake Holiday Cookies
directions: Finely grind the first 3 ingredients., Add sugar and whiskey and form into small balls. Roll in colored sugar., Store in airtight container in refrigerator.

title: Special Scalloped Potatoes
directions: Put first 5 ingredients in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle casserole with paprika and parsley flakes., Bake in a preheated oven at 300° for 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

title: Berry Rich Shake
directions: Pour all ingredients into a blender and blend., Pour into a glass.

title: Picante Sauce
directions: Mix well., Can be mixed in blender, but don't process too much or it will be too runny., Makes 5 cups.

title: Busy Day Baked Chicken
directions: Grease an 11 3/4 x 4 1/2 x 1 3/4-inch pan., Add chicken breasts., Add soup mix on top of chicken., Cover tightly with aluminum foil., Bake 2 hours., Chicken will fall off the bone. It's so tender.

title: Delicious Peach Pie
directions: Beat egg white until foamy., Brush over the bottom and sides of pastry., In a small bowl combine flour and sugars., Cut in margarine until mixture resembles fine crumbs., Sprinkle 2/3 into bottom of pastry., Top with peaches., Sprinkle with remaining crumb mixture., Bake at 375° for 40 to 45 minutes or until filling is bubbly and peaches are tender.

title: Oven Barbecued Chicken Breasts
directions: Dredge chicken breasts in flour to which salt and pepper is added., Heat mixture of oil and margarine in skillet., Place chicken in the hot oil, turning to a light brown., Arrange pieces in a lightly greased baking dish., Blend and heat all ingredients for the sauce, pour over chicken., Cover and bake 325 for about 1 1/2 hour or until chicken is tender., Serves 4.

title: Brownies From Scratch
directions: Mix with electric mixer, margarine and sugar., Add eggs, vanilla, cocoa and flour., Blend all together.

title: Mexican Wedding Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Grease and flour pan., Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes., Spread cake with icing.

title: Sweet French Dressing
directions: Mix sugar and oil in the blender until well blended., Add the next 3 ingredients and blend., Add catsup; blend., You may use more catsup for the taste you desire., Refrigerate.

title: Banana Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Mix together and drop on a greased cookie sheet by spoonfuls. Bake at 400° for about 10 minutes., Nuts and/or raisins may be added.

title: Lasagna
directions: Saute until brown the oil, garlic, ground beef and onions. Drain fat., Add tomato paste, tomato soup, tomatoes, water, coffee, salt, pepper, mushrooms and oregano.

title: Milkless Potato Soup
directions: Boil the potatoes and process them through a colander, then mash them thoroughly., Add 6 cups of water., Brown the flour in the butter and add the potatoes and water with the chopped celery, parsley, thyme, salt and white pepper., Beat in two egg yolks just before serving., You will never miss the cow.

title: Cranberry Sauce Cake
directions: Cream together sugars, butter and egg yolks., Stir in cranberry sauce., Sift together flour, cinnamon, soda, cloves, salt and allspice; add to creamed mixture., Stir in pecans and raisins., Fold in egg whites., Bake in tube pan (greased) at 375° for 1 hour.

title: Toad-In-A-Hole
directions: Melt a bit of butter in skillet., Using the rim of a glass, press the center out of the slice of bread., Reserve center circle. Put slice of bread in pan., Crack egg into center hole of bread. Turn when egg is set., Cook over low heat until egg is done. Season with salt and pepper., Serve with bread hole covering egg center (Toad)!

title: Easy Day Lasagne
directions: Cook noodles; drain., Brown hamburger and Italian sausage together; drain., Put together cottage cheese and Ricotta cheese in bowl., Put spaghetti sauce in bowl and add meat mixture after browning., Stir both cheese and meat mixtures good.

title: Sausage Balls
directions: Mix together., Dipping hands in water, make small balls. Grease pans or use Teflon cookie sheets., Bake at 425° until brown.

title: Toll House Pie
directions: Preheat oven to 325°., Prepare a 9-inch pastry., Melt butter. Cool., Beat 2 eggs until foamy., Add flour, sugar and brown sugar and beat until smooth., Add melted butter., Mix well., Add chocolate chips., Stir., Pour batter into pie shell., Bake for 1 hour., It's heavenly!

title: Irish Soda Bread
directions: Place dry ingredients (except raisins) in large, deep bowl. Gradually add milk and margarine., Mix until firm enough to form ball; if still crumbly, add more butter or milk, one tablespoon at a time., Pat down to an 8-inch circle., Place on oiled cookie sheet., Cut the dough in the form of a cross to the depth of 1-inch., Bake at 375° for 30 to 40 minutes or until brown.

title: Fish Chowder
directions: Cut skinned and boned fish into 1 1/2 to 2-inch pieces., Then peel and slice potatoes into 1/2-inch pieces., Crush the garlic clove.

title: Teriyaki Chicken
directions: Cut chicken into nuggets. Batter chicken in egg and then in flour. Fry until golden brown. Dip chicken into teriyaki sauce and place in dish. Cook chicken for 20 to 25 minutes at 325°.

title: Cheese Spread
directions: Bring tomatoes and peppers to rolling boil., Pour over grated cheese and stir until cheese is melted. Good with crackers, Fritos and Mexican food.

title: Shrimp Dip
directions: Gradually add milk and lemon juice to softened cream cheese. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Chill and serve.

title: Peanut Butter Chocolate Kiss Cookies
directions: Cream the butter, sugars, peanut butter, egg and vanilla. Sift flour, soda and salt. Add to creamed mixture., Form into balls., Preheat oven to 375°., Place in oven for 8 minutes. Put chocolate kisses on top., Push them down on the cookie., Put back in oven for 2 to 3 minutes.

title: Marinated Mushrooms
directions: Parboil mushrooms., Mix other ingredients except onions., Pour over parboiled mushrooms and onions., Let stand several days (stir occasionally).

title: Skillet Dinner
directions: Cook until meat is brown; drain., Add salt and pepper, chili powder, garlic salt, bell pepper and onion., Put in Dutch oven. Put egg noodles on top., Don't stir., Pour water over mixture.

title: Marshmallow Marble-Top Fudge
directions: Line an 8 or 9-inch square pan with foil and set aside., In a heavy saucepan, over low heat, melt chocolate chips and 2 tablespoons butter with sweetened condensed milk, vanilla and salt., Remove from heat and stir in nuts., Spread evenly into prepared pan.

title: Potato Broccoli Soup
directions: Boil potatoes, onion, celery and bouillon in 4 cups water for 10 to 15 minutes or until potatoes are tender. Add cream of chicken soup and Velveeta. Heat, stirring often, until cheese is melted and soup is smooth. Add broccoli. Continue stirring occasionally until ready to serve.

title: Green Tomato Relish
directions: Mix vegetables., Let stand 5 minutes., Drain well., Cook in kettle for 30 minutes vegetables and vinegar mixture., Pour in jars and seal.

title: Fallen Fudge Cake
directions: Melt the butter in a 1 1/2-quart casserole dish., Mix the next 5 ingredients and pour over butter., Mix the next 4 ingredients and pour over the batter., Do not stir., Bake for 30 minutes in a 350° oven., Makes its own sauce., Serve warm.

title: Peanut Butter Cream Pie
directions: Beat cheese until fluffy., Add sugar and peanut butter., Beat until smooth., Prepare topping with milk as directed on package. Beat into peanut butter mixture., Pour or spoon into pie shell. Must be refrigerated overnight to set up before serving.

title: Chocolate Chip Cheesecake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., In a large bowl, beat together the cream cheese, eggs, sugar and vanilla until well blended; set aside., Slice cookie dough rolls into 1/3-inch slices., Arrange slices from 1 roll over bottom of greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Press together so no holes are left in dough., Spoon cream cheese mixture evenly over dough; top with remaining roll of dough, sliced., Bake 45 to 50 minutes until golden brown and center is slightly firm., Cool, then refrigerate., Cut into bars. May serve with chocolate sauce, fudge or Cool Whip.

title: Apple Dip
directions: In saucepan, combine all ingredients except apples., Melt over medium heat, stirring constantly., Cool., Slice apples., Dip into mixture and serve.

title: Old-Fashioned Egg Pie
directions: In a heavy pot, bring milk almost to a boil., Remove from heat and sprinkle in nutmeg to taste., Beat eggs and to them add sugar, vanilla and a pinch of salt., Add hot milk to egg mixture., Pour into unbaked 9-inch pie crust., Bake in slow oven at 325° to 350° for 30 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Peanut Butter Dessert
directions: Combine all until crumbly., Pat into a 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 15 minutes or until brown., Remove from oven and cool!

title: Magic Peach Cobbler
directions: Melt butter in 9 x 13-inch pan., Mix sugar, flour, baking powder and milk together and pour on butter., Do not stir., Add peaches on top of this in layers., Sprinkle with 2 or 3 tablespoons sugar., Bake 35 minutes at 350°.

title: Apple Dumplings
directions: Peel apples, quarter and cut in half., Pat out can of biscuits and put in 1/8 of apple., Seal apple inside biscuit., Place in 9 x 13-inch pan., Mix 1 cup water, 1 cup sugar and 1 stick of melted margarine., Pour over biscuits and sprinkle biscuits with allspice or spice of your choice., Bake at 350° until golden brown., Good hot or cold with ice cream or plain.

title: Cauliflower Salad
directions: Cook peas according to package directions; drain. While peas cool, break apart cauliflower and slice thin. Combine cauliflower and peas; add celery and onion. Mix together mayonnaise, salt and milk. Mix with the cauliflower mixture. Marinate in refrigerator 6 hours.

title: Five Hour Stew
directions: Do not brown beef., Put all ingredients in casserole., Put bay leaf on top., Cook in oven at 300°, covered., Do not peek.

title: Gingerbread
directions: Mix soda with sour milk and add to molasses., Sift together flour, ginger and salt; combine 2 mixtures and add butter., Bake in greased pan in moderate oven, 350°, for 25 minutes.

title: Fruit Punch Slush
directions: Puree the bananas in a food processor along with the thawed lemonade., Then add the other ingredients and mix well., This mixture is frozen and will fit in a gallon plastic milk jug. Before serving, partially thaw and add the following:, 1 (64-ounce) ginger ale and 1 (64-ounce) lemon-lime soft drink. Yields 50 (1/2-cup) servings., You can cut the amount of sugar in half.

title: Koulourakia(Greek Butter Cookies)
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., Cream butter gradually beating in sugar. Beat eggs until light; add to butter mixture and beat thoroughly. Add vanilla extract., Add lemon rinds., Sift together flour and baking powder., Carefully blend into butter-egg mixture to make soft dough.

title: Hearty Whole Wheat Bread
directions: Soften yeast in lukewarm water with honey., Melt margarine in saucepan., Cool slightly., When yeast is bubbly, add 4 more heaping cups warm water, milk, salt, the melted shortening, bran and wheat germ., Mix and add flours (the total amount will equal almost 5 pounds of flour)., Knead well., Place in a warm place in greased bowl.

title: Strawberry Topping
directions: Cook berries 3 minutes until full boil., Add 2 cups sugar and cook 3 more minutes., Add 1 more cup of sugar and boil 3 more minutes.

title: Baked Chicken N' Noodles
directions: Blend soup and milk., Add chicken, noodles, pimento and parsley., Spoon into 1-quart casserole., Sprinkle bread crumbs on top., Bake in 350° oven 25 minutes.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Cook chicken until tender and remove bones; save broth., In bottom of casserole dish, mix half of dressing with enough broth to moisten well., Pat down and pepper., In bowl, mix chicken with soup and enough broth to blend well., Mixture should remain thick., Pour over dressing in casserole dish., Mix remaining dressing with chicken broth to moisten well., Pour over chicken mixture and bake at 350° to 400° for 30 minutes.

title: Brandied Fruit Salad
directions: This is good served with the main meal and/or as a dessert.

title: Rosamarina Salad (Or) Hawaiian Macaroni Salad
directions: Rub a wooden bowl with garlic and mix the dressing right in the bowl., Use a variety of fresh torn greens such as lettuce, escarole, spinach, endive and watercress., Toss well until every leaf is coated with the dressing.

title: Chicken With Bell Pepper
directions: Brown chicken (unfloured) in shortening until golden brown. Remove chicken from skillet and make gravy in small amount of shortening., In same skillet return chicken and lay peppers and onions over gravy covered chicken.	Simmer for 1 hour to 1 1/2 hours.

title: Artichoke Nibbles
directions: Drain liquid from one jar of artichokes into pan., Chop artichokes and set aside., Add onion to liquid in pan and saute. (Add a little garlic salt.), Beat eggs; add bread crumbs and seasonings., Stir in cheese, parsley, artichokes and onion., Put in greased 9 x 9-inch pan., Bake at 325° for 30 minutes., Cut into 1-inch squares and serve hot or cold.

title: Delicious Zucchini And Yellow Squash
directions: Fry bacon; when almost crisp, add onion, squash, salt and pepper., Cook until tender (about 10 minutes)., Remove from stove; add sour cream and serve., Serves 6.

title: Real Mashed Potatoes!(From Potatoes, Not A Mix!)
directions: Cut up potatoes and put in a big pot of salted water. Bring to a boil. Put cover on pot and let cook 25 minutes on medium heat. Drain; add butter and milk. Whip using a hand mixer.

title: Baked Beans
directions: Mix together in a baking dish., Place bacon strips on top. Bake about 30 minutes in a medium oven.

title: Cherry Yum Yum
directions: Mix together and chill.

title: Red Rice
