directions: Fry bacon until brown., Remove from pan., Chop onion and green pepper., Saute onion and green pepper in grease., Add tomato sauce., Add one can of water., Mash stewed tomatoes and add to mixture., Break bacon into bits and add to mixture., Add Tabasco sauce and salt to taste., When mixture starts boiling, add shrimp and turn fire down low., Stir constantly to keep from sticking. Cook until rice dries out.

title: Spanish Cream
directions: In top of a double boiler, scald milk., Slowly add gelatin and honey., Pour a few tablespoonfuls over egg yolks, then add egg mixture to milk mixture in boiler., Place over hot water and cook until thick and smooth., Remove from heat., Add salt and vanilla, then fold in egg whites., Pour into a large mold and chill., The mixture will form 2 layers as it sets.

title: Impossible Pumpkin Pie
directions: Grease a 9-inch pie plate., Blend all ingredients in blender for one minute., Pour into pie plate and bake at 350° until set.

title: Dutch Pot Roast
directions: Dredge beef in flour and brown in Dutch oven., Add remaining ingredients and cook slowly on low heat for about 3 hours. Thicken gravy if necessary.

title: Garlic-Mayonnaise Potato Salad
directions: Boil potatoes until fork goes through, but not mashes., Let cool., Cut up into 1-inch squares., Whip up mayonnaise, chopped onion, cilantro (use less if using fresh), garlic powder, salt and pepper., Stir in potatoes and mix well to coat., Maybe eaten cold or warm.

title: Fiesta Nacho Platter
directions: Combine beans, picante sauce and 1 cup cheese; stir over low heat until cheese is melted., On serving platter, layer chips, bean mixture, lettuce, sour cream and tomatoes., Sprinkle with remaining cheese., Makes 8 servings.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
directions: Boil chicken., Pull off bones in bite size pieces., Add broth and cream of celery soup., Pour into a greased baking dish., Sift flour, salt and baking powder., Gradually add milk, then melted butter., Pour this over chicken mixture., Bake at 425° for about 30 minutes.

title: Cranberry Salad
directions: Chop cranberries in processor or food chopper., Pour 2 cups sugar over cranberries., Add the raspberry and orange Jell-O to juice., Add to cranberries., Mold in pans.

title: Chess Pie
directions: Cream sugar, eggs, spices and butter at low speed for 1 minute. Add cream and blend. Put in unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350°. Cool until firm.

title: Play Dough
directions: Mix all ingredients well., Cook and stir constantly until dough forms a ball and leaves side of pan., Store in airtight container., Great for children!!

title: Chocolate Cheesecake
directions: 1st Layer:, Mix first 3 ingredients., Press in an oblong baking dish., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

title: Cabbage Roll Casserole
directions: Brown beef., Add salt, pepper, onion, chili powder, rice, soup and water., Cook gently for 2 or 3 minutes., Put cabbage in casserole., Pour meat mixture over cabbage., Do not stir., Bake, covered, for 2 hours at 350° or longer, if desired.

title: Rancher'S Sunday Chicken
directions: Wash and dry chicken pieces., Dip into prepared salad dressing., Spoon crumbs over the dressing to cover., Place in foil lined pan., Sprinkle with salt, pepper and paprika to taste. Bake uncovered at 375° for 1 1/4 hours.

title: Fresh Corn-On-The-Cob
directions: Remove husks from ears of corn; brush off silks., Drop in kettle of boiling water to cover, adding 1 teaspoon salt and 1 teaspoon lemon juice to each quart of water., Cover and cook 5 to 8 minutes, or until milk is set and corn is tender., Cooking time depends on maturity of corn., Remove from water and serve with butter, salt and ground black pepper.

title: Cream Cheese Pound Cake
directions: Mix cream cheese, margarine and sugar. Add eggs, vanilla and cake flour. Bake at 325° for 1 hour in a tube pan.

title: Chow Mein Noodle Treats
directions: Melt chips and peanut butter., Add chow mein noodles and marshmallows., Mix together and spoon out on waxed paper.

title: Cream Of Cheese Soup
directions: Cook carrots and celery in boiling water until tender., Cook onion in margarine until tender, but not brown., Stir in flour. Add milk and chicken broth., Cook over low heat until thickened, stirring occasionally., Makes 6 cups.

title: Nanna'S Chocolate Frosting
directions: Soften cheese (I use microwave) on Low., Add chips and oleo until melted., Let cool for a few minutes and then add sugar. This recipe can be cut in half, if you don't want as much frosting., Mix until smooth.

title: Laurene'S Shortbread Cookies
directions: Mix margarine with sugar., Add vanilla, salt and flour; mix well., Add chips, nuts and shape into balls and press flat., Bake at 325° until light brown (approximately 13 minutes).

title: Russian Tea
directions: Mix ingredients together. Store in container.

title: Chicken Breasts
directions: Butter a 9 x 13-inch casserole dish., Put in chicken., Place a slice of swiss cheese over each breast., Add soup, mixed with the wine., Sprinkle the Pepperidge Farms Dressing over all., Melt margarine and pour over., Bake at 350° for 55 minutes.

title: Steaks Etouffe
directions: Heat the cooking oil in a Dutch oven., Add the meat and cover with the rest of the ingredients., Salt and pepper to taste. Cover and let cook over low heat for 2 to 3 hours.

title: Pistachio Salad
directions: Fold in one large container Cool Whip.

title: Hash And Corn Bread
directions: Mix hash, onion and egg together., Prepare muffin mix as directed on package., Add salt and cheese., Spread half the batter in greased 8-inch square or round baking dish., Spread on hash mixture., Top with remaining batter., Bake at 400° for about 25 minutes until corn bread is golden brown.

title: Mixed Vegetable Casserole
directions: Mix soup, cheese, onion and sour cream., Mix with vegetables., Place in a dish.

title: Pretzel Salad
directions: Mix together pretzels, butter and 1/2 cup sugar and put in 5 or 6 cup bowl., Cool., Mix cream cheese and sugar., Fold in Cool Whip. Mix. Pour over pretzels., Cool.

title: Cookie Whip Dessert
directions: Crumble cookies into shallow dish., Spread Cool Whip over cookies., Chill for one hour.

title: Chocolate Sheet Cake
directions: Sift together in large mixing bowl sugar and flour., Place in saucepan and bring to a boil butter or oleo, cocoa and water., Pour butter mixture over flour and sugar; mix well and add buttermilk, eggs, vanilla, baking soda and cinnamon., Mix and bake on a slightly greased 10 x 15-inch pan at 400° for 20 to 25 minutes. Before cake is done, make icing.

title: Potato Candy
directions: First, mash potato, then add flour., Next, add powdered sugar and mix until it makes a ball of dough., Next, take a sheet of wax paper and spread with dough., Then spread the peanut butter out on the dough., Roll up like a burrito., Chill for a couple of hours, then cut in little strips.

title: Chicken Vegetable Pasta Salad
directions: Toss all ingredients in a bowl., Chill until ready to serve.

title: Blueberry Yum Yum
directions: Mix crumbs and melted butter and press 3/4 of mixture into Pyrex dish., Cream sugar and cream cheese together., Mix milk, Dream Whip and vanilla until stiff and add to cheese mixture. Layer on top of crumbs the blueberry filling, then cheese mixture and sprinkle with remaining cracker crumbs.

title: Penne All'Arrabbiata(Penne With Hot Pepper And Tomatoes)
directions: Cut out tomato cores with a sharp knife., Fill a large saucepan 2/3 full with water., Bring water to a boil; add tomatoes., Boil 20 to 25 seconds or until skins begin to split., Place tomatoes in bowl of cold water., Peel cooled tomatoes and cut in half horizontally., Squeeze seeds and juice out of each tomato half. Dice tomatoes., Heat oil in a large skillet., Add hot pepper and garlic., Saute over medium heat about 1 minute., Before garlic changes color, add diced tomatoes., Season with salt., Cook, uncovered, over medium heat 8 to 10 minutes., Stir in parsley and cook 1 to 2 minutes longer., Fill a very large saucepan 2/3 full with salted water., Bring to a boil., Add penne., Bring water back to a boil and cook penne, uncovered, until tender but firm to the bite (al dente) 8 to 10 minutes., Drain penne and place in skillet with sauce., Toss penne and sauce over medium heat until sauce coats penne, 20 to 30 seconds., Serve immediately., Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Pie
directions: Mix peanut butter and powdered sugar together; smooth into bottom of pie shell., Make hot pudding by mixing remaining ingredients., Pour over filling.

title: Bernie'S Meatballs
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Form meatballs and brown.

title: Pistachio Torte
directions: Mix well and press into a 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.

title: Cabbage Casserole
directions: Chop cabbage and steam until limp, not soft. Drain well. Use a shallow baking dish and place in layers 1/2 of cabbage and 1/2 can of soup (spread over cabbage). Crumble 1/2 can onion, rings over this. Then slice Velveeta cheese over all. Repeat layers again. Bake at 350° until bubbly, about 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Spaghetti Crusted Ground Turkey Pie
directions: Cook spaghetti as directed on package and drain., Mix eggs, Parmesan cheese and warm spaghetti., Pour into generously buttered 9 x 1 1/4-inch pie plate., Pat in bottom and up sides to rim with back of spoon., Spread sour cream over bottom., Heat oven to 350°. Heat margarine over medium-high heat until melted., Crumble turkey into skillet., Add bell pepper and onion., Cook until turkey is no longer pink; drain., Add tomato sauce, garlic salt and oregano., Simmer 10 minutes, uncovered., Salt and pepper to taste., Spoon mixture over sour cream., Cover with aluminum foil. Bake 25 minutes., Sprinkle Mozzarella cheese on top and bake until melted.

title: Mississippi Mud Pie
directions: Crush Oreo cookies and mix with melted margarine., Press into 9-inch pie plate and freeze (2 to 3 hours)., Put ice cream in a bowl and stir until smooth. Place in prepared crust and sprinkle with pecans., Freeze for at least 1 hour (more time in freezer may be needed depending on how much the ice cream has melted)., When ready to serve, slice pie., Top each slice with hot fudge followed by whipped cream.

title: Raisin Cookies
directions: Boil raisins and water 5 minutes; let cool and add baking soda., Let stand., Mix the rest of ingredients together., Combine with raisins., Drop by teaspoonful on greased cookie sheet., Bake at 350° for 10 to 15 minutes., Very good and stay moist.

title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
directions: Sift and measure flour., Sift again with soda and salt., Cream shortening and sugar well., Add eggs one at a time, beating well after each addition., Add flavorings., Add dry ingredients alternately with sour cream., Bake in a greased and floured 10-inch tube pan at 325° for approximately 1 hour and 20 minutes (time will vary with individual ovens).

title: Spaghetti Salad
directions: Cook spaghetti as directed on box and drain., In large bowl, add remaining ingredients with spaghetti., Refrigerate., Serve cold.

title: Spinach Dip
directions: Cook the spinach according to box directions., Drain well. Mix all other ingredients., Hollow the center of the bread so it looks like a bowl., Save the bread from the middle., Cube into torn bite-size pieces to place around the loaf to use for dip.

title: Easy Cheese Potatoes
directions: In large bowl, combine all ingredients, except 1/2 cup Colby cheese., Mix well and turn into buttered 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Bake at 350° for 55 to 60 minutes or until potatoes are tender. Top with remaining cheese and bake 3 to 5 minutes or until cheese melts., Let stand 5 minutes., Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Apricot Mousse(Serves 8)
directions: Puree the apricots after they have been soaked and cooked according to the package directions; add the sugar and extract. Soak the gelatin in the cold water, add the hot milk and stir over hot water until gelatin is dissolved., Add this to the puree. Whip the cream and fold it into the puree., Spoon it into a wet 8-cup mold and chill it in the freezer for about 3 hours. This may be unmolded or served directly from the mold.

title: Blueberry Salad
directions: Mix salad well and let congeal., Cream sour cream, cream cheese, sugar and vanilla., Spread on top of salad., Sprinkle top with nuts.

title: Baked Cranberry Dessert
directions: Sift dry ingredients together in mixing bowl., Add shortening and milk., Blend other ingredients except cranberries., Beat 2 minutes., Stir in cranberries., Bake in greased 9-inch square pan at 350° for 40 minutes or until tested done., Serve with hot butter sauce.

title: Pear Honey
directions: Cook the pears and sugar until real thick, then add coconut and pineapple about 1/2 hour before you take it up., Process in jars for long period of keeping.

title: Raspberry Cream Dip
directions: In small bowl, combine cream cheese, brown sugar, ginger and vinegar; blend until smooth., Stir in raspberries., Serve as a dip or dressing for fresh fruit., Makes 1 1/4 cups.

title: Santacafe Chile Pepper Brioche
directions: In the bowl of an electric mixer with a paddle attachment, combine the flour, sugar, yeast, salt, ground chile and black pepper., Mix briefly on low speed., Increase speed to medium and add the water, milk, poblano chile and bell pepper; beat well. Add the eggs, one at a time, mixing well after each addition. Change to the dough hook and knead for 3 minutes., The dough will be very sticky., Add the butter to the dough, one piece at a time, and continue to knead until dough is smooth and shiny and the butter is completely incorporated, 10 to 20 minutes.

title: Flan
directions: Burn the sugar on stove top on medium heat; set aside to cool. Use an 8-inch cake pan., Place the last 5 ingredients in blender; blend until smooth., Pour over burnt sugar in pan., Steam approximately 1 1/2 hours on very low heat., Check water level from time to time.

title: Banana Nut Bread
directions: Sift together dry ingredients., Add nuts., Combine remaining ingredients; add to dry ingredients., Stir only until flour is moistened., Pour into a greased 9 x 5-inch loaf pan., Bake 1 hour in 350° oven.

title: Monkey Bread
directions: Cut each biscuit into 4 pieces., Then dip into sugar-cinnamon mixture., Coat each piece well., Drop in Bundt cake pan., Sprinkle over the nuts., Then melt the butter and brown sugar., Pour this mixture over biscuits., Place in cold oven., Set at 350° and bake for 20 minutes., Turn pan upside down over plate after removing from oven.

title: Kahlua Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients together well with mixer; fold in chocolate chips., Spray Bundt pan with Pam or grease and flour. Pour mixture into Bundt pan., Bake in the oven preheated to 350° for approximately 1 hour., After cake is cooled on serving plate, can poke holes in top with toothpick and brush on extra Kahlua.

title: Peach Pudding Dessert
directions: Dissolve Jell-O in 2 cups boiling water., Add 2 cups reserved peach syrup (if not enough, add water until there is)., Put mixture in fridge to set a bit (about 1 1/2 hours)., Beat peaches with mixer until very mushy., Beat the whipping cream, adding the powdered sugar., Fold in the Jell-O mixture., Stir very well., Pour into 13 x 9-inch pan and keep in fridge until set.

title: Pumpkin Pie
directions: Mix filling ingredients in order given., Pour into unbaked pie shell., Bake in preheated 425° oven for 15 minutes., Reduce temperature to 350° and continue baking for 45 minutes until knife inserted in center of pie filling comes out clean., Cool. Garnish with whipped cream., Makes one 9-inch pie or two smaller ones.

title: Apple Rings
directions: Peel and core apples, leaving them whole then slice into 1/2-inch slices., Set aside., Mix together the water, sugar, candies and food coloring in a saucepan., Bring mixture to a boil. Drop in apple rings. Simmer until tender, about 10 to 12 minutes. Remove from syrup., Serve as an accompaniment to any type wild meat.

title: Taco Casserole
directions: Heat oven to 400°., Grease pie plate., Cook and stir beef and onion; drain., Stir in seasoning., Spread in plate; top with chillies., Beat milk, Bisquick and eggs until smooth., Pour into plate., Bake 25 minutes., Top with tomatoes and cheese; bake 10 minutes longer.

title: Dinner Party Chicken
directions: Melt margarine in large skillet., Add salad dressing mix., Add chicken and brown slowly until golden., Place contents of skillet in baking dish., Blend soup (undiluted), cream cheese and wine until smooth., Spread over chicken., Bake, uncovered, 1 hour at 325°., Serve over rice., Serves 4 to 6.

title: Sawdust Salad
directions: Using a large serving bowl or 9 x 13-inch glass dish, prepare the Jell-O with the boiling water and 1 1/4 cups cold water., Add the drained pineapple. Chill until firm.

title: Pineapple Butterscotch Squares
directions: Combine flour, baking powder and salt in small bowl; set aside. Beat together margarine, brown sugar and granulated sugar in large bowl until creamy. Add pineapple, eggs and vanilla; beat until blended. Stir in flour mixture, butterscotch and nuts until blended. Pour in 13 x 9-inch baking pan sprayed with vegetable cooking spray. Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Cheese Krispies
directions: Mix all ingredients well with hands., Roll into balls the size of a walnut., Place on ungreased cookie sheet and press with the tines of a fork in a criss-cross pattern., Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes or until lightly browned., Cool on a cake rack. Serve at room temperature., They freeze very well.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Cook broccoli crisp-tender., Combine eggs, cheeses, onion, Worcestershire sauce, salt and pepper., Arrange broccoli in baking dish; add cheese mixture and sprinkle with bread crumbs., Add margarine., Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Ginger Tea
directions: Make the tea as instructed on the package. Add ginger slices. Let them remain for a few minutes. Add sugar if needed and serve.

title: Chicken Bologna
directions: Wipe off bologna and, leave, skins, on., Cut, into 4 or 5-inch lengths., Pack in jars lengthwise and add 1/2 cup water to each quart., Cook 1 hour in hot water bath or 30 minutes at 10 pound pressure.

title: Oatmeal M&M'S
directions: Cream butter, sugars and eggs., Add vanilla, dry ingredients and M&M's., Bake 12 minutes at 350°.

title: Swiss Steak
directions: Flour and brown steaks in a pan., Put browned steaks in a casserole dish., Put chopped onions and cut up mushrooms on steak. Mix soups together and pour over tops of steaks., Bake for 2 1/2 hours at 350° in a covered casserole dish.

title: Heavenly Coconut Pie
directions: In small bowl, mix flour, melted butter and 1 cup chopped pecans. Press into a 2-quart dish or 10-inch pie pan and bake at 350° for 20 minutes. Cool. Place 1/2 cup chopped nuts in shallow pan and bake in oven with pastry until slightly browned.

title: Chewy Chocolate Brownies
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Grease 9x13 pan., Bring sugar, butter and water to a boil., (Microwave works well.), Add chocolate and stir until melted., Add eggs, vanilla and mix well., Add dry ingredients., Bake 16-20 minutes or until toothpick inserted in middle comes out sticky.

title: Pimento Cheese Salad
directions: Dissolve Jell-O and sugar in boiling water. Cool until syrupy and beat in cheese spread and pineapple., Let congeal to syrupy stage and fold in prepared dessert topping mix., Refrigerate until set.

title: Strawberry Dream Cake
directions: Mix well and pour over cake.

title: Egg Strata
directions: Brown sausage, drain and crumble into a 13 x 9-inch dish. Saute hash browns in oleo, then spread over sausage., Sprinkle cheese over potatoes., Mix eggs, milk and seasonings., Pour over mixture., Bake at 325° for 30 minutes.

title: Crispy Baked Chicken
directions: Combine bread crumbs, brown sugar, chili powder, garlic powder, dry mustard, celery seed and cayenne., Season chicken with salt and pepper., Brush each chicken piece with butter., Roll in crumb mixture to coat., Arrange chicken, skin side up, so that pieces do not touch, in a shallow baking pan., Sprinkle with remaining crumb mixture., Bake, uncovered, at 375° for 50 minutes or until tender. Do not turn., Makes approximately 6 servings.

title: Turkey Loaf
directions: Mix and put in greased casserole. Bake 1 hour at 350°.

title: Corn Casserole
directions: Mix together., Pour into greased dish and dot with margarine. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Broccoli-Corn Bake
directions: Blend broccoli, corn, egg, 1/4 cup crumbs, onion, 2 tablespoons melted butter, salt and pepper., Turn into 1-quart casserole; top with 1/4 cup crumbs mixed with 1 tablespoon melted butter., Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 10 minutes.

title: Sour Cream Apple Pie
directions: In a large bowl, beat eggs; add sour cream., Stir in sugar, 2 tablespoons flour, vanilla and salt; mix well., Stir in apples. Pour into pie shell., Bake at 375°, for 15 minutes.

title: Frozen Strawberry Pie
directions: Put can of milk in icebox over night., Add sugar and lemon juice to strawberries., Beat until berries are a fine pulp.

title: Breakfast Pizza
directions: Spread crescent rolls in a 9 x 12-inch baking dish., Spread hash browns on top., Fry sausage and drain., Spread over potatoes. Whip eggs and pour over; top with cheese., Depending on how many you wish to serve, use six to twelve eggs., Use sharp cheese. Bake at 350° for one half hour.

title: Cappuccino Pie
directions: Mix liquids and coffee together with pudding mix and beat with hand., Mix in Cool Whip and put in crust., Freeze., Remove and dollop extra Cool Whip on top and sprinkle with toasted almonds., Serve semi-frozen., Take out of freezer 10 minutes before serving.

title: Spice Candied Nuts
directions: Place first 3 ingredients in saucepan over medium heat, stirring constantly until mixture forms soft-ball stage; add vanilla, then coat nuts., Turn out onto wax paper., Allow to cool and then separate into pieces., Place in candy dish.

title: Potato-Bean Soup
directions: In a large saucepan, melt the margarine and cook the garlic, celery and carrots on medium heat for 4 minutes., Carefully stir in broth, potatoes and dill., Heat to boiling., Reduce heat and simmer, covered, for 20 to 25 minutes or until potatoes are tender., Mash about 1/2 of the potatoes in the broth. Add drained beans to mixture.

title: Stuffed Bell Peppers
directions: Saute onion, turkey and celery in margarine., Add 1 2/3 cups water and seasoning., Mix. Cook 5 minutes., Then add stuffing mix and let set.

title: Salmon Roll
directions: Use king, silver or red salmon., Stir all ingredients together., Shape into roll, ball, log, or leave in bowl., Chill for 3 hours., Serve with crackers.

title: Jewish Coffee Cake
directions: Cream butter, Crisco and sugar., Beat eggs in one at a time. Add flour, sifted together with salt and baking powder., Alternate with Pet milk., Add vanilla and nuts last., Put a thin layer of dough in a greased angel food pan and sprinkle with cinnamon mixture., Alternate the layers of dough and cinnamon mixture until pan is filled., Do not put cinnamon mixture on top., Bake 60 to 70 minutes in a 350° oven or until done.

title: Punch Bowl Cake
directions: Bake cake according to box directions., Let cool, then crumble half of cake in a punch bowl., Layer strawberries, pineapple, banana slices and pudding., Repeat layers and top with Cool Whip.

title: Forgotten Cookies
directions: Add egg whites and salt together and beat until stiff. Add sugar and beat. Add chocolate chips and nuts.

title: Chicken And Rice
directions: Bring water to boil in a large, deep skillet., Stir in 1 envelope golden onion soup mix and skinned chicken thighs., Reduce heat., Cover and simmer 10 minutes., Stir in white converted rice and vegetables., Cover again and cook 20 minutes or until rice is tender, the liquid is absorbed and the chicken is no longer pink near the bone., Serves 4.

title: Butterscotch Delight
directions: Make crust from first 3 ingredients., Mix and put in a 13 x 9-inch pan., Bake for 15 minutes., Cool well., Mix Cool Whip, cream cheese and powdered sugar together., Spread on crust., Mix pudding and milk, cook until thick., Let cool; pour over cream cheese mixture., Toast coconut, sprinkle over top and let chill.

title: Ultimate Chip Cookies
directions: Cream first 4 ingredients., Add eggs., Mix flour, salt and soda; add gradually., Blend well., Stir in 2 cups each chips and pecans., Bake at 375° for 8 to 10 minutes for chewy, 11 to 13 minutes for crisp., Makes 6 dozen (3-inch) cookies.

title: Crock-Pot Roast
directions: Brown roast., Put into crock-pot., Add Lipton onion soup mix and mushroom soup with water and pour over roast., Cook overnight on low., Melts in your mouth!

title: Saucy Chicken
directions: In a glass 9 x 13-inch pan, combine soup mix, dressing and liquid., Mix well., Place chicken pieces in sauce., Turn to coat each piece., Cover., Microwave 9 1/2 minutes per pound at 70% power., Rearrange chicken piece halfway through cooking time., Let stand 3 to 5 minutes, covered., Serve with rice, buttered noodles or stuffing.

title: Spooned Halva
directions: Melt butter in deep pan; add farina and cook until golden color, stirring constantly., Stir in chopped nuts., Reduce heat. Meanwhile, bring water and sugar to a slow boil., Cook 3 minutes. Pour syrup slowly over farina, stirring with wooden spoon until halva is slightly thickened., Remove from heat., Cover; let stand 10 minutes., Shape with individual molds or with spoon., Place on large platters and sprinkle with cinnamon.

title: Cranberry Salad
directions: Pour hot water over Jell-O., When dissolved, add sugar., Cut orange in pieces with peelings and put in blender with cranberries and orange juice., Blend., Combine all ingredients and chill in refrigerator overnight.

title: Beef Rounds
directions: Cut round steak into thin strips., Cut onions into chunks. Wrap round steak around onion chunk, then wrap with a piece of bacon., Secure with a toothpick., Brown on all sides., Make broth with bouillon cube and simmer for 1 hour., Use tongs to pick up.

title: Spicy Bean Salsa With Tortilla Chips
directions: In a large bowl, combine all ingredients except tortilla chips; mix well. Cover and refrigerate several hours or overnight to blend flavors. Serve with tortilla chips as an appetizer. May also serve as a side dish. Makes 12 servings.

title: Microwave Peanut Butter Fudge
directions: Combine first 5 ingredients., Cook on Full power for 8 to 10 minutes., Stir mixture a couple of times., Add marshmallow cream and peanut butter., Stir until it thickens or your arms fall off. Pour into buttered pan., Let cool., Enjoy.

title: Rye Loaf Dip
directions: Shred beef and mix all ingredients., Make the night before. Cut top out of loaf bread., Dig bread out, leaving a 1-inch rim. Pour mixture in bowl., Cut bread in dip sizes., When all bread cubes are gone, then cut loaf in bite sizes.

title: Baked Spanish Rice(6 Servings)
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., In 12-inch skillet, over medium heat, fry bacon crisp; drain on paper towels., Crumble and set aside.

title: Poppy Seed Cake
directions: Prepare cake mix according to package directions., Add poppy seed and extract., Bake in 2 (9-inch) layer pans according to directions on package., Frost with favorite white fluffy icing.

title: Peanut Blossoms
directions: Combine all ingredients, except candy, in large bowl., Mix until dough forms., Shape dough into balls, using a rounded teaspoonful for each., Roll balls in sugar., Place on ungreased cookie sheet., Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes., Top each cookie immediately with a candy kiss; press firmly so cookie cracks around edge., Return to oven for 4 to 5 minutes.

title: Chocolate Zucchini Cake
directions: Cream sugar and eggs. Add oil and zucchini. Sift and add dry ingredients. Add vanilla. Cook in Bundt pan at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Company Carrots
directions: Place carrots in an ungreased 9 inch square baking dish. Add water and dot with butter., Sprinkle with oregano and salt. Cover and bake for 1 hour and 15 minutes at 325 degrees.

title: Chocolate Eclair Cake
directions: Combine pudding, milk and sugar. Beat until thickened. Gently fold in cool whip. Lightly butter bottom and sides of 9 x 13 inch cake pan. Line bottom with whole graham crackers. Pour pudding mixture over crackers. Top with another layer of graham crackers. Spread chocolate frosting over graham crackers. Chill.

title: Chocolate Eclair Cake
directions: Butter bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan., Line bottom of pan with graham crackers., Prepare pudding with 3 1/2 cups milk and beat until thick., Carefully fold in Cool Whip., Spread 1/2 of pudding mixture over crackers., Cover with another layer of graham crackers., Pour the rest of pudding mixture over crackers., Cover with another layer of graham crackers., Cover pan with plastic wrap or wax paper., Chill 2 hours.

title: Pumpkin Bread
directions: In a large bowl, combine pancake mix, sugar, cinnamon, ginger, cloves, pumpkin, oil, milk and eggs., Beat 3 minutes at medium speed., Stir in walnuts and turn batter into greased 9 x 5-inch loaf pan., Bake at 350° for 45 to 55 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean., Remove from pan and cool. Makes 1 loaf.

title: Welsh Rabbit
directions: Melt butter, add flour and blend., Add milk and cook over low heat until thick, stirring constantly., Add cheese and stir over low heat until melted., Add seasonings., Serve over hot toast or crackers., Serves 6.

title: Bohemian Pot Roast
directions: Combine flour and pepper; dredge pot roast., In a Dutch oven, brown roast in oil., Drain., Add water, tomatoes, caraway seed, onion soup mix and bay leaves., Bring to a boil., Reduce heat; cover tightly and simmer for 2 to 3 hours or until roast is tender., Remove to a warm platter., Discard bay leaves.

title: Hash Brown Potato Casserole
directions: Combine potatoes, 1/2 cup margarine, onion, soup, sour cream and cheese; stir well., Spoon into a greased 2 1/2-quart casserole., Crush cereal and stir in remaining butter., Sprinkle over potato mixture., Bake at 350° for 50 minutes.

title: Soup For Freezer
directions: Cook butter beans until tender., Cook all for about 35 minutes. Cool., Put in containers and freeze.

title: Stuffed Mushrooms
directions: Wash and clean mushrooms, remove stems and mince., To stems, add garlic, bread crumbs, cheese, onion, salt and pepper, parsley, butter and half of olive oil and mix well., Stuff mushroom caps, use remaining oil to grease baking pan and drizzle over tops of mushrooms., Bake at 400° for 20 minutes.

title: Fried Okra
directions: Slice okra into 1/4-inch slices., Wash okra in cold water. Mix cornmeal, flour, salt and pepper together., Roll okra in cornmeal mix., Fry in hot skillet for 10 minutes until golden brown., Drain on paper towel., Serves 6.

title: Cream Cheese Crescents
directions: Beat cream cheese, sugar and egg yolk. Separate dough in 16 triangles. Place on greased baking sheet. Spread 1 tablespoon of cream cheese near edge of the short side of each triangle. Top with 1 tablespoon of pie filling. Fold long section of each triangle over filling and tuck under dough. Lightly beat egg white and brush over rolls. Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Sour Cream And Noodle Casserole
directions: Cook noodles as directed; rinse and drain., Brown meat; add salt, pepper and garlic salt, then tomato sauce., Simmer 5 minutes; combine cheese, sour cream, onions and noodles., In a 2-quart casserole, alternate layers of noodle mixture and meat, beginning with noodles and ending with meat., Top with Cheddar cheese., Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

title: Pickled Eggs
directions: Bring beet juice, white vinegar and sugar to a boil., Cool before adding beets and eggs., Start eggs with cold water., Bring to a rolling boil., Turn stove off and let eggs set in water for 20 minutes., Run cold water over eggs and peel., Eggs will pickle overnight.

title: Hot Clam Dip
directions: Cut top off one loaf of bread and scoop out soft bread., Mix all remaining ingredients (except the other loaf of bread) and fill scooped out bread shell., Replace top., Wrap in foil and bake at 250° for 3 hours., Cut up second loaf of bread to use for dipping.

title: Banana Nut Bread
directions: In bowl, combine dry ingredients., Stir in eggs and bananas. Add melted shortening and nuts., Pour into greased loaf pan and bake 45 to 60 minutes in 325° oven.

title: Audra'S Squash
directions: Top with bread crumbs over cheese., Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

title: Mocha Brownies
directions: In a small heavy saucepan, melt chocolate with butter or margarine over low heat; cool., Combine next 3 ingredients; set aside., Beat eggs and sugar at medium speed until light., Beat in chocolate mixture and vanilla extract., Stir in flour mixture, cracker crumbs and nuts., Pour into a greased 9 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake in a preheated 350° oven 40 to 45 minutes., Glaze while hot. When cold, cut into squares using a sharp knife., Makes 25 brownies.

title: Baked Carrots
directions: Cut up carrots and cook until almost done., Melt butter with cheese., Put carrots in baking dish (approximately 8 x 11-inch). Pour melted cheese and butter over carrots., Crush the crackers and sprinkle over carrots., Bake at 350°, approximately 15 to 20 minutes, until cheese bubbles., Serve hot.

title: Graham Cracker Crust
directions: Melt butter., Stir in graham cracker crumbs and sugar., Pack in a pie shell and let cool for 10 minutes, then put in freezer for 30 minutes., Now it is ready to fill.

title: Good Friday Rice
directions: Saute onions in butter until golden and limp., Add rice and saute until golden., Pour in cans of broth and mix well., Bake in a 2-quart casserole at 350° for approximately 40 to 45 minutes or until liquid is absorbed (microwave approximately 15 minutes).

title: Cherry Coconut Bars
directions: Combine flour, confectioners sugar and margarine. Press into a buttered 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

title: Watergate Salad
directions: Beat pudding mix with juices you drain off fruit., Mix in fruit and Cool Whip., Refrigerate.

title: No-Knead Dinner Rolls
directions: Soften yeast in 1 cup warm water., Cream sugar and shortening together., Add boiling water, mixing well, with mixer at medium speed., Beat in eggs, one at a time., Mix salt and flour together and add to the batter alternately with the yeast., Cover and let rise in a warm place 1 hour., Turn out on a floured surface and pat into a large rectangle., Cut into rounds with a biscuit cutter or floured glass; dip both sides in melted butter and place in baking pans., Cover and let rise an additional hour., Preheat oven to 425°., Bake 10 to 15 minutes or until nicely browned., Makes about 48 rolls.

title: Perfect Pie Crust
directions: Mix flour, salt and sugar in a large bowl., Add shortening and mix until crumbly., In small bowl, beat together water, vinegar and egg., Combine the 2 mixtures until all ingredients are moistened., Divide dough into 5 portions and shape into flat, round patties ready for rolling., Wrap each patty in plastic wrap and chill at least 1/2 hour., When ready to roll, lightly flour both sides of patty and roll on lightly floured surface., For shells, bake at 450°., Will keep 3 days in refrigerator., Makes 2 double and 1 single crust or 20 tart shells.

title: Chicken And Andouille Smoked Sausage Gumbo
directions: Remove excess fat from chicken., Rub with salt, garlic powder and red pepper., Let stand 30 minutes., Combine onions, bell peppers and celery in a medium bowl; set aside., Combine flour, 1/2 teaspoon salt, 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder and 1/2 teaspoon red pepper in paper or plastic bag., Add chicken pieces and shake until chicken is coated., Reserve 1/2 cup of the flour.

title: Hot Pepper Relish
directions: Chop peppers and onions., Pour boiling water over peppers and onions, then drain., Cover with cold water., Bring to boiling point, then drain again., Put vinegar, salt, sugar and mustard seed in another pan and bring to boil., Add to peppers and onions and boil 1 minute., Fill jars and seal.

title: Chow Chow
directions: Peel onions and cucumbers., If cucumbers are large, remove the seeds., Slice tomatoes thin., Chop onions, cucumbers and peppers small., Cut cauliflower into small pieces., Soak vegetables overnight in brine made of 1 cup salt to 1 quart water. Stir and mix well., Next day, drain well.

title: Gaye'S Pepper Steak
directions: Trim fat from beef., For sauce, mix together the water, soy sauce, cornstarch, bouillon granules and pepper., Set the mixture aside., Cook fettuccine according to package directions, except omit the cooking oil and salt., Drain well.

title: One Step Lasagna
directions: Combine 1 1/2 cups water with spaghetti sauce in bowl., Cover bottom of sprayed 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish with 1 1/2 cups of sauce.

title: Hamburger-Meat-Rice-Tomato Sauce Pie
directions: Combine ingredients; mix well., Put into greased 9-inch pie plate.

title: Baked Eggs
directions: Preheat oven to 325°., Grease custard cup., Crack egg into cup., Sprinkle with cheese., Place custard cup on tray., Bake 18 to 20 minutes., Yields 1 serving.

title: Chicken Kiev
directions: Beat, chicken breasts (any number desired)., Mix butter (start with, small amount and melt more as needed) with small amount, of oregano;, brush, breasts.	Put, cube, of cheese in center; roll up, dip in butter and roll in bread crumbs (mixed with Parmesan cheese, just guess at amount)., Place in greased casserole	and refrigerate, until	ready, to bake., Bake in a preheated, 350° oven, 45, minutes, or until done., This is my favorite company recipe as can be prepared well in advance.

title: Mexican Cornbread
directions: Mix all ingredients together. Pour into a large greased iron skillet or a 11 x 13 inch pan. Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Chocolate Chip Coffee Cake
directions: Beat egg., Add 1/2 cup sugar gradually., Stir margarine in lightly., Alternately add pancake mix and milk-vanilla mixture. Pour into greased 8-inch square pan., Sprinkle with mixture of 2 tablespoons sugar and cinnamon and chips., Bake at 400° for 20 minutes.

title: Baked Chicken Breast
directions: Place chicken breast in pan, put cheese slices over chicken. Mix soup and water, pour over chicken. Spread bread crumbs on top of chicken. Melt butter and drizzle on top. Bake for 1 hour.

title: Zesty Sauerkraut
directions: Saute onion and pepper in butter., Broil bacon and crumble. Rinse sauerkraut and place in baking dish., Add the beer, molasses and mustard to onions, peppers and bacon., Cook and stir for 3 minutes., Pour over sauerkraut and bake 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Ratatouille
directions: Heat oil in heavy duty saucepan, add garlic, onion, eggplant, zucchini and green pepper; saute vegetables until they are barely tender., Add seasoning, mixing well., Add tomatoes and simmer until tender, about 20 to 25 minutes.

title: California Blend Casserole
directions: Combine all ingredients and top with onions., Bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Chicken Divan
directions: Place cooked broccoli in a 9 x 13-inch buttered casserole; cover with chicken., Make a sauce of chicken soup, mayonnaise, evaporated milk, cheese and curry powder., Mix and spread over casserole., Sprinkle with slivered almonds and bread crumbs. Bake at 350° for about 30 minutes., Serves 6 to 8.

title: Yellow Squash Casserole
directions: In 16 ounce Pyrex dish, boil yellow squash in 1/2 cup water until slightly tender. Drain off water. Mix milk, egg, margarine and cheese in separate bowl. Next, pour over squash; mix lightly. Sprinkle bread crumbs over top. Bake until golden brown. Let stand 15 to 20 minutes. Serve.

title: Rum Nut Swirl Brownies
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Grease 8-inch square baking pan., In medium bowl, stir butter, sugar and cocoa until blended., Add vanilla and eggs; beat with spoon until blended., Add flour, baking powder and salt., Beat with spoon until well blended., Spread half of batter into prepared pan., Gently spread Rum Nut Swirl over batter., Spoon remaining chocolate batter over top., With spatula or knife, cut through batters to marble., Bake for 25 minutes. Reduce oven temperature to 325°., Continue to bake for 10 minutes or until brownies begin to pull away from sides of pan., Cool completely in pan on wire rack., Cut into 20 bars and serve warm.

title: Mexican Wedding Cookies
directions: Combine all ingredients. Form into 1 1/2-inch balls. Bake on cookie sheet at 350° for about 10 to 15 minutes until set. Roll in powdered sugar while still warm.

title: Lucky Cake 1-2-3
directions: First Layer:, Mix first 3 ingredients and spread in a 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Hamburger Casserole
directions: Chop onion and garlic., Season (with seasoned salt) and brown hamburger meat with onion and garlic, then drain., Stir soup into hamburger meat., Place in an ungreased ovenproof casserole dish. Put grated cheese on top., Place in oven at 350° and bake, uncovered, for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Layered Vegetable Salad
directions: Place lettuce in a 3-quart glass dish. Top lettuce with tomatoes (make layers). Next green pepper, red cabbage, water chestnuts, broccoli, red onion, cauliflower., Just arrange it colorfully., Use your favorite salad dressing., Creamy Italian is great.

title: Tina'S Hot Crab Meat Dip
directions: Melt cream cheese in double boiler., Add all ingredients except for crab. When smooth, fold in crab., Serve hot (over sterno) with Pepperidge Farm pumpernickel and cheese cracker sticks.

title: Old-Fashioned Buttermilk Pound Cake
directions: Cream butter and shortening., Gradually add sugar, beating well at medium speed., Add eggs, one at a time, beating after each addition., Dissolve soda in buttermilk., Combine flour and salt. Add to creamed mixture alternately with buttermilk, beginning and ending with flour mixture., Stir in flavorings., Bake in greased and floured 10-inch tube pan., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Wild Rice With Mushrooms And Onions
directions: In a 3-quart lidded saucepan, bring 6 cups of water to a boil. Add salt and the wild rice., Cover and simmer on low heat for 30 minutes., Add the converted rice, mushrooms and onion to the pot without stirring., Cover and continue cooking another 5 minutes. Do not remove the lid., Let the rice sit for 5 minutes after finishing the cooking., Yields 6 servings.

title: Stuffed Cabbage Rolls
directions: In a covered skillet, cook cabbage leaves in boiling water. Drain and set aside., In same skillet, heat margarine over medium heat., Add onion; cook until tender., Add tomato sauce, sugar, 1 teaspoon salt and 1/4 teaspoon pepper; mix well and set aside., In large bowl, combine remaining ingredients; divide into 12 equal portions., Place 1 portion in center of each cabbage leaf., Fold leaf sides toward center, then from one edge roll up leaf., Place in sauce in skillet, seam side down., Cover and simmer over medium heat for 45 minutes.

title: Bourch
directions: Cook meat; cool and drain off fat., Combine all other ingredients; add meat back to mixture and simmer for 45 minutes.

title: Enchilada Casserole
directions: Brown ground beef in a saucepan., Combine enchilada sauce and soup and warm., Put a layer of tortilla sauce, meat, onion and cheese., Repeat layers., Bake for 25 minutes at 350°., Serves 4.

title: Filete Steak Salteado
directions: In deep fryer or Dutch oven, heat vegetable oil to 350°., Fry potatoes in hot oil until brown, about 10 minutes; drain on paper towels., Cut meat into cubes., In large skillet, heat olive oil; brown meat on all sides., Add remaining ingredients except wine. Heat thoroughly; add wine just before serving., Serve over white or yellow rice.

title: Brownie Cake
directions: Sift together flour, sugar and salt., Set aside., Bring to boil the water and margarine., Stir liquid ingredients into flour mixture and add eggs, buttermilk, baking soda and vanilla., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes on cookie sheet.

title: Carrot Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°. Grease and flour a 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Split Seconds
directions: Heat oven to 350°., In a large bowl, beat butter and sugar until light and fluffy., Add vanilla and egg., Blend well. Lightly spoon flour into measuring cup and level off., Stir in flour and baking powder., Mix well. Divide dough int 4 equal parts., On lightly floured surface, shape each part into 12 x 3/4-inch roll., Place on ungreased cookie sheet., Using handle of wooden spoon or finger, make a depression about 1/2-inch wide and 1/4-inch deep lengthwise down center of each roll. Fill each roll with 2 tablespoons of jelly. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes until golden brown. Cool slightly. Cut diagonally into bars., Makes 4 dozen.

title: Manicotti
directions: Cook sausage links in Dutch oven until brown., Drain in paper toweling and remove fat from pan., Brown ground beef and onion well; stir in tomato puree, paste, sugar, pepper, 1 teaspoon basil, 1 teaspoon salt and 1 cup water., Simmer, covered, for 45 minutes. Cut sausage into bite-size pieces and add to mixture., Cook 15 minutes, stirring occasionally., In the meantime, cook manicotti as label directs; drain in colander., Preheat oven to 375°.

title: Red Beans And Rice
directions: Soak beans overnight. Cook rice and set aside. Drain off old water from beans and add fresh water. Add meat and cook until beans are tender. Add seasoning and serve over rice.

title: Pimiento Cheese Spread
directions: Heat milk. Add grated cheese and let melt., Add pimientos and mix well. This can be poured up in jars to cool before serving. Use as a sandwich spread, a dip or for stuffing celery.

title: Tortellini Salad(Great For A Crowd!)
directions: Add all ingredients., Toss and marinate at least 2 hours., Add avocado or mushrooms if you like.

title: Meat Loaf
directions: Heat in saucepan., Pour over meat loaf and serve.

title: Punch
directions: Be careful in your selection., Do not choose too young. When selected,, give, your, entire thoughts to preparation for domestic use., Some	wives insist on keeping them in a pickle. Others are constantly	getting, them, in hot water., This may make them sour, hard and sometimes bitter., Even poor varieties may be, made sweet,, tender, and, good by garnishing with patience, well sweetened, with love and seasoned with kisses. Wrap warm with, a steady, fire of domestic devotion and serve with peaches, and cream., Thus, prepared,, they will last for years.

title: Russian Tea Mix
directions: Mix above ingredients together and store in airtight container.

title: Sweetened Condensed Milk
directions: Combine all ingredients in blender container., Process until smooth., Store in refrigerator until ready to use., Yields about 1 1/4 cups, about the same as a 14 ounce can of commercial type milk.

title: German Potato Salad
directions: Boil red potatoes with skins on., Peel after cooked and set aside., Fry bacon until crisp., Drain on paper towel., Reserve 2 to 3 tablespoons drippings of bacon grease., Crumble the bacon. Saute onion in bacon grease until tender., Blend in flour slowly, then stir in vinegar and water., Cook until mixture boils and becomes thicker., Add sugar, salt and pepper; simmer 10 minutes.

title: Different Chicken Pie
directions: Put boned chicken in casserole., Put chopped celery over chicken., Pour melted oleo over chicken and celery., Mix flour and dry ingredients with the milk., Pour flour mixture over chicken. Mix cream of celery soup with 1/4 cup chicken stock., Pour over chicken., Bake at 425° for 50 minutes., Serve with green beans and corn.

title: Cottage Cheese Salad Ring
directions: Dissolve gelatin in hot water., Chill until partially set. Blend in mayonnaise., Fold in celery, green pepper and cottage cheese., Pour into a 4-cup ring mold., Chill until firm., Unmold on lettuce.

title: Turkey Parmesan
directions: Pound the turkey breast slices; set aside., Mix bread crumbs and Parmesan cheese; set aside., Combine eggs, salt and pepper. Coat turkey breast slices with bread crumb mixture, then dip into egg mixture and back into bread crumb mixture., Place coated turkey breast slices on wax paper., Let stand 20 to 30 minutes, turning several times., Heat oil in skillet over medium heat., Fry turkey breast slices in oil until golden brown on both sides., Add 1/4 cup hot water to pan., Cover and cook slowly about 30 minutes until tender., Arrange turkey breast slices in baking dish., Pour 2 spoons tomato sauce on each breast slice., Place a slice of Mozzarella cheese over sauce., Bake in 400° oven about 10 minutes until cheese is melted.

title: Pistachio Salad
directions: Mix all together and let stand overnight before serving.

title: Flavored Pretzels
directions: Mix all ingredients together. Enjoy.

title: Cranberry Salad
directions: Mix Jell-O according to package directions, then add remaining ingredients. Pour into Jell-O mold or bowl and chill until set.

title: Frozen Fruit Salad
directions: Soak gelatin in 1/2 cup cold water for five minutes.

title: Bread Pudding
directions: Soak bread in milk and water., Add sugar and eggs., Mix well. Add vanilla and raisins., Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle nutmeg on top., Pat pieces of margarine over the pudding. Bake at 350°.

title: Crevettes Scampi
directions: Shell and devein shrimp, leaving tail intact; arrange in single layer on bottom of broiler pan., Preheat broiler., In small saucepan, heat olive oil, garlic, parsley, oregano, salt and red pepper., Pour over shrimp; toss to coat., Broil 4 inches from source of heat for about 5 minutes., Sprinkle with lemon juice. Serves 6.

title: Pistachio Salad
directions: Combine dry pudding mix, pineapple and juice., Fold in marshmallows and nuts., Fold in Cool Whip., Refrigerate overnight.

title: Hot Cheese And Crab Dip
directions: Melt cheese and milk in medium saucepan or microwave, stirring to smooth consistency., Stir in crabmeat and wine., Heat through. Serve hot with crackers or party rye.

title: Surprise Sherbet
directions: Mix and put in ice cube tray., Freeze until firm and serve.

title: Piccalilli
directions: Slice tomatoes and onions thin., Mix with all other ingredients., Boil until tender, about 20 minutes., Pack into hot sterilized jars., Seal.

title: "Carolina Housewife" Wedding Cake Of 1850
directions: Add cloves to your taste.

title: Fresh Apple Cookies
directions: Place on ungreased baking sheet., Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Charlotte Russe
directions: Soften gelatin in 1/2 cup milk., Beat egg yolks and sugar until thick and lemon colored; stir in gelatin and scalded milk., Cook in top of a double boiler, stirring constantly, until thickened; cool. Stir in sherry and fold in whipped cream., Beat egg whites until stiff but not dry and fold into custard., Line a 3-quart bowl with ladyfingers; pour in filling and chill until set., Yields about 12 servings.

title: Apple Bread
directions: Peel apples and slice thinly., Add sugar and cinnamon; stir and let sit., Beat eggs until light and foamy., Add sugar and beat well until light., Add oil in 2 parts, beating well., Add vanilla. Sift flour, baking powder and salt., Add to egg and sugar mixture., Stir in orange juice.

title: Easy Lasagne
directions: Brown ground beef., Pour off grease., Add Ragu sauce to meat; mix well., Mix other ingredients except the noodles., Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan and layer meat sauce, noodles, mixture, repeat.

title: Spinach Dip
directions: Mix all ingredients together and let stand at least one hour before using so that flavors blend together., Best served by purchasing round loaf of bread of your choice, rye, sourdough, Italian, etc., Cut out center to form bowl., Place dip in bread bowl., Cut bread which was taken from center of loaf into cubes and use to dip along with cut up vegetables of your choice.

title: Great Vegetable Salad
directions: Mix oil, vinegar and sugar. Mix with vegetables. Marinate overnight.	Add lemon pepper and celery; salt to taste., Can use less oil. Add enough water to make 1/2 cup.

title: Yummy Potatoes
directions: Melt butter in saucepan. Add soup and heat through. Add soup to hash browns; stir in onions, sour cream and cheese., Mix well. Pour in 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle with crushed potato chips. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Bacon And Cheddar Dip
directions: Mix packet of dip and sour cream. Add cheese and bacon bits. Mix well. Chill 1 hour before serving.

title: Mini Cheese Cakes
directions: Mix cream cheese, sugar, eggs and vanilla., Grease nut tassie tins and flour with graham cracker crumbs., Fill 3/4 full with cream cheese mixture., Bake at 350° for approximately 15 minutes. Makes about 3 dozen., After cheese cakes cool, drop cherry or blueberry filling in center.

title: Cream Of Broccoli Soup
directions: Combine broccoli, margarine, onion, broth and the 3 different types of soups together., Cook on low and stir often until broccoli is tender, adding either milk to thin or cornstarch to thicken., Add cheese before serving.

title: Yam And Sweet Potato Dish
directions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees.

title: Mississippi Mud Cake
directions: Mix together and bake at 350° in an 8 x 12-inch pan (2-quart size) for 30 minutes., Spread 1 1/2 cups small marshmallows over warm cake until they melt., Pour chocolate sauce over and let stand 2 hours.

title: Banana Bread
directions: At medium speed on mixer beat oil and sugar; beat until light and fluffy., Add eggs and then dry ingredients, mixing well after each addition., Stir in bananas and nuts., Bake at 350° in greased loaf pan until done or 35 minutes., Let cool 20 minutes before turning onto cooling rack.

title: Supreme Chicken
directions: Bone and skin chicken., Stir rice, chicken soup, broth and mushrooms together and pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch casserole. Top with boned chicken and sprinkle with dry onion soup mix. Cover and bake 1 hour at 400°.

title: Orange Cherry Cobbler
directions: Combine pie filling, water, sugar, lemon juice and butter in saucepan and heat until boiling., Pour into an 8 1/4 x 1 3/4-inch round ovenware cake dish. Top hot cherry mixture with rolls, cut side up. Bake at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes or until rolls are done. Spread tops with the icing that comes in the Danish orange roll package. Good served warm., Makes 8 servings.

title: New Year'S Cookies
directions: Dissolve yeast and sugar in warm water; add warmed milk, margarine and cream., Add salt and beaten eggs, then flour and floured raisins., Let rise 30 minutes to 1 hour and fry in hot fat. Drop by tablespoons in hot fat., Drain on paper towels and glaze after they have cooled., Makes 5 dozen.

title: Company Potatoes
directions: Boil potatoes until tender., Cream margarine, sour cream and cream cheese., Add hot, drained potatoes and beat until smooth. Add salt and pepper to taste and them add onion., Put in a well greased two-quart baking dish., Sprinkle paprika on top and bake at 350 for 25 minutes.

title: Apple Chop Suey
directions: Mix first 5 ingredients and add next 4 ingredients., Using a 9 x 9-inch pan, bake in 350° oven for about 45 minutes., Top with Cool Whip., Serves 9.

title: Ham Loaf
directions: Mix ham, pork, bread, water and eggs together., Form into loaf., Mix brown sugar, cloves, mustard, vinegar and 3/4 cup water together and pour over the meat mixture., Bake at 400° for 1 1/2 hours with lid on., Bake at 300°, basting often until browned.

title: Fish And Cheese Chowder
directions: Cut fish in 1-inch cubes., Melt butter in large saucepan., Add onion, carrot and celery., Cook until onion is transparent., Blend in flour, salt and paprika., Cook 1 minute, stirring constantly. Gradually add chicken broth and milk., Cook, stirring constantly, until thickened., Add fish; simmer until fish flakes easily (5 minutes for fresh, 10 for frozen)., Add cheese; stir until melted. Serve hot., Yields 2 1/2 quarts.

title: Asparagus Casserole
directions: Drain asparagus, reserving 1/2 cup liquid., Combine the margarine, flour, salt, asparagus liquid, milk and cheese to make a cheese sauce.

title: Chili
directions: Smoke all meats, using oak and hickory., When meat is almost done, in a large pot, combine all the ingredients (except the beans) and add a cup of water., Simmer., When meat is done, cut stew beef into small pieces and break the beef, sausage and turkey up., Add to pot., Continue to simmer for an hour., Add beans and simmer for another hour.

title: Chocolate Cake
directions: Mix together flour and sugar., In pan boil water, cocoa and butter., Pour this mixture over flour and sugar., Add eggs, buttermilk and vanilla., Bake at 350 for 30 minutes in a 13 x 9 pan.

title: Taco Dip
directions: Stir and heat until hot and add 1 chopped onion., Serve with taco chips.

title: Blueberry Lush
directions: Mix the first 3 ingredients and let cool about 15 minutes. Add blueberries with syrup and pineapple., Let gel completely.

title: Blueberry Cheesecake
directions: Combine 2 1/2 cups blueberries and 1 tablespoon cornstarch in blender; blend until smooth., Cook puree over medium heat about 15 minutes, stirring constantly., Set aside to cool and reserve 1/2 cup for glaze.

title: Honey Glazed Chicken
directions: In a large skillet melt margarine; add honey, mustard, curry powder and salt. Mix well to blend. Place chicken in baking dish and pour honey mixture over the top. Turn chicken to coat on both sides. Bake uncovered at 350° for one hour; baste often.

title: Mom'S Egg Noodles
directions: Beat eggs, salt and baking powder together good., Then add flour to make a stiff dough., Flour linen table cloth and sprinkle with flour., Put dough on floured table cloth and knead until smooth., Roll out on cloth and let dry., When dry, fold in half, then in half again until a narrow roll., Then slice to desired thickness., Cook in roast or chicken broth.

title: Fresh Lemon Pie
directions: Cook the sugar, cornstarch and the water until thickened. Beat the egg yolks, adding 1/4 cup sugar, then pour some of the hot mixture into egg mixture and back into cooking pan to thicken more., Add the lemon juice., When thick enough for pie crust, add 1 tablespoon butter and 1/2 teaspoon of vanilla.

title: Refrigerator Pickles
directions: Layer cucumbers and onions in a large container (not metal). Mix remaining ingredients until sugar is dissolved., Pour over cucumbers., Let set in refrigerator 5 days before using.

title: Butter-Nut Crunch
directions: Butter a 15 x 10-inch cookie sheet and set aside., In a medium saucepan, combine sugar, salt, butter or margarine and water., Cook until mixture reaches soft crack stage or 270° on a candy thermometer., Stir in chopped walnuts., Pour onto prepared cookie sheet.

title: Tea Sparkler
directions: In a large pitcher combine all ingredients except soda., Chill at least 2 hours., Just before serving, add a splash of soda. Pour into ice filled glasses and garnish, if desired, with orange, lemon and lime slices., Makes 5 servings.

title: Texas Barbecue Brisket(6 Pound Brisket)
directions: Sprinkle lean side of brisket with 1/2 teaspoon liquid smoke. Rub in 1/2 teaspoon each of the salts., Place lean side down in large pan., Score fatty side., Rub in rest of liquid smoke and salts., Cover tightly., Refrigerate overnight., Before cooking, sprinkle each side with Worcestershire sauce, salt and pepper. Place fatty side up in roasting pan., Wrap in foil., Bake at 225° for 1 1/2 hours for each pound (9 hours for 6 pounds)., Last hour of cooking, uncover and pour over barbecue sauce., Leave uncovered.

title: French Roll Pizzas(Snack Or Meal)
directions: Mix all ingredients together and let sit to blend., Spread on sourdough bread halves., Bake in oven at 325° until cheese is melted and bread is crispy.

title: Fancy Franks
directions: In a small skillet or saucepan, combine first 4 ingredients. Add cocktail franks and pineapple chunks., Simmer together for 15 minutes., Serve warm with cocktail picks.

title: Grilled Corn
directions: Strip husks down to the end of the cob, but do not tear off. Remove silk., If desired, soak in salted ice water to which 1/2 cup milk has been added for about 20 minutes; drain well., Brush with softened butter and sprinkle with salt and pepper., Bring husks up around the corn., Wrap each ear securely in a double thickness of aluminum foil., Twist the ends well., Barbecue on briquets 10 minutes, turning once.

title: Blueberry Muffins
directions: Mix flour, sugar, salt and baking powder together in a bowl. Add egg, milk and oil., Mix, then add blueberries., Bake at 350° for 25 minutes., (I double the recipe.)

title: Hot Fudge Sauce
directions: Combine cocoa, sugar, flour and boiling water., Cook until thick, approximately 5 minutes., Remove from heat., Add a pinch of salt, butter and vanilla.

title: My Mother'S Punch
directions: Mix in large punch bowl and add ice and fruit, such as pineapple chunks, maraschino cherries or slices of oranges or lemons.

title: Punch Bowl Cake
directions: Bake cake according to directions on back of box., Cool completely and make pudding in a punch bowl., Shred cake mix to cover bottom., Layer pineapple, cool whip, cake, cherries, cool whip, cake (pour vanilla pudding over all ingredients) until you only have room left to top with cool whip., Sprinkle nuts on top.

title: Praline Cookies(Servings:  48)
directions: Put 1 layer whole graham crackers in jelly roll pan (approximately 24)., Boil and stir sugar and margarine for 2 minutes., Stir in pecans., Pour over crackers., Bake at 350° for 10 minutes., Cool in pan for 2 minutes., Finish cooling on rack and break into halves.

title: El Paso Burgers
directions: Place meat in a large bowl., Add onion, green pepper and taco mix., Combine thoroughly., Shape into 8 burgers., Place onto a well-greased oven broiling pan., Spread salsa on top., Bake at 400° until done., Place 1 slice of cheese on each burger and return to oven just long enough for it to melt., Serve on bun.

title: Jello Pineapple Cottage Cheese Salad
directions: Dissolve jello in boiling water., Drain pineapple and reserve juice., Add pineapple juice, lemon juice and sugar to jello. Stir., Chill until thick, but not firm., Fold in crushed pineapple and cottage cheese., Pour into bowl and chill until set., Unmold onto lettuce., Dot with mayonnaise.

title: Souped Up Chicken Soup
directions: Save broth from boiled chicken., Add carrots, potatoes, macaroni and onions to broth; cook until tender., You may need to add more water if too thick., Add chicken, tomatoes and spices. Cook 15 to 20 minutes and serve.

title: Chocolate Frosting
directions: Melt margarine;, add other ingredients., Place over heat, and bringing to boil., Boil 2 minutes., Remove from heat., Cool and whip.

title: Real Key Lime Pie
directions: Cut off the ends of the lime., Grind up fine and squeeze juice from pulp and use.

title: Holiday Pecans
directions: Melt oleo in large pan., Mix next 3 ingredients. Stir in pecans, then spread in glass dish., Bake at 400° for 20 minutes, stirring frequently. Turn onto paper towel and sprinkle with salt. Let season at least 1 day before serving.

title: Congealed Blueberry Salad
directions: Mix, jello in boiling water;, add blueberry pie filling and pineapple., Cover and refrigerate overnight.

title: Apple Crisp
directions: Arrange apples in well-greased baking dish., Blend remaining ingredients to form a coarse texture., Spread evenly over apples. Sprinkle water over mixture., Bake for 45 minutes at 350°.

title: Pepperoni Pizza Dip
directions: In a small mixing bowl, beat together the cream cheese, sour cream, oregano, garlic powder and red pepper., Spread evenly in 9 or 10-inch quiche pan or pie plate., Spread pizza sauce over the top., Sprinkle with pepperoni, green onions and green pepper. Bake in preheated 350° oven for 10 minutes., Top with cheese. Bake 5 minutes more, until cheese is melted and mixture is heated through.

title: Snickerdoodles
directions: Mix the first 3 ingredients well., Sift the dry ingredients and stir in., Roll into balls the size of small walnuts., Roll into sugar and cinnamon mixture., Place 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet., (These cookies puff up at first, then flatten out.), Bake at 400° for 8 to 10 minutes., Makes about 5 dozen cookies.

title: Cornbread Salad
directions: Chop vegetables fine and add to crumbled cornbread., Toss with 1/2 large bottle buttermilk dressing., Store in refrigerator. (Keeps well up to 1 week.)

title: Lemon Chess Pie
directions: Combine sugar, flour and meal in a large bowl., Toss lightly with a fork., Add remaining ingredients; beat with rotary or electric mixer until smooth and thoroughly blended., Pour into unbaked 9-inch pie shell and bake for 35 to 40 minutes at 350° or until top is golden brown.

title: Creamed Tuna On Patty Shells
directions: Melt margarine; add flour and pour in milk slowly until thickened., Season with salt and pepper and whisk in cream and egg yolk., Add tuna, mushrooms and peas and serve over patty shells. Garnish top with parsley.

title: Broccoli And Chicken Casserole
directions: Cook noodles according to package; drain., In baking dish, stir together (gently) the noodles, broccoli, chicken, onion and mushrooms., In a bowl, stir together the soup, milk, cheese, salt and pepper (reserve 1/2 cup, cheese)., Stir all into noodle mixture., Bake, covered, at 350° for 40 minutes., Sprinkle reserved cheese and paprika over all and return to oven for 10 minutes (or until cheese melts)., Contains 290 calories per serving and 11 grams fat.

title: Baked Beans
directions: Fry bacon and then saute chopped onion in bacon grease., Add beans, Ro-Tel and brown sugar., Bake at 350° in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish until bubbly, about 45 minutes., Makes 10 servings.

title: Onion Cornbread
directions: Preheat oven to 400°., Saute onion in margarine., Prepare cornbread mix according to package directions and pour into greased pie plate., Spread onion over top., Mix sour cream and cheese together; spread over top., Bake at 400° for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Quick Chicken Casserole
directions: Wipe chicken breasts with paper towels., Sprinkle each half with a portion of the salt, pepper and Accent., Place the pancake mix in a paper sack, then coat each piece of chicken with mix by shaking up and down vigorously., Heat the oil in a suitable skillet; brown each piece of chicken on both sides., Cook the rice according to directions., Stir the soup and half and half cream into the cooked rice., Put soup and rice mixture into a buttered casserole, then put chicken on top., Bake at 350° for 35 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Cabbage Casserole
directions: Cook cabbage for 8 minutes, boiling in water., Melt 1/2 cup margarine in casserole or 9 x 13-inch cake pan., Sprinkle and mix 1 tube crackers in margarine and flatten on bottom like a pie crust. Place cooked cabbage over cracker crumbs.

title: Scott'S Potato Salad
directions: Peel and slice boiled potatoes., Pour Italian dressing over potatoes and allow to sit 1 hour., Pour off excess dressing and add eggs, onion and spices., Add mayonnaise until desired consistency is obtained., Serve immediately or chilled.

title: Potatoes Baked In Cheese Sauce
directions: Melt butter in a saucepan., Add flour and stir until smooth. Add catsup, paprika and salt., Add milk gradually; then add grated cheese., Cut raw or cooked potatoes in thin slices., Place alternate layer of potatoes and pepper in a baking dish., Cover with sauce and repeat until all is used., Bake at 350° for 35 minutes., Serves 6.

title: Lemon Meringue Pie
directions: In 2 quart saucepan, stir together 1 cup sugar and cornstarch. Gradually stir in water, until smooth., Stir in egg yolks, stirring constantly., Bring to boil over medium heat., Boil 1 minute. Remove from heat., Stir in lemon rind, lemon juice, and margarine. Cool., Turn into pastry shell., In small bowl, with mixer at high speed, beat egg whites until foamy., Gradually beat in 1/3 cup sugar., Continue beating until stiff peaks form., Spread meringue around edge of filling first, then fill in center., Bake in 350° oven 15 to 20 minutes until brown., Cool., Serves 6 to 8 people.

title: Chocolate Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Mix the sugar, cocoa, margarine and milk together in a saucepan; bring to a boil., Boil for 1 minute, then remove from heat., Add peanut butter and stir until dissolved., Add flavoring. Next add oatmeal and beat mixture like fudge., Drop by teaspoon on wax paper and let set.

title: Elephant Stew
directions: Cut elephant into bite size pieces., This should take about 2 months., Add brown gravy and simmer., Add salt and pepper to taste., Heat whale oil to brown mushrooms, celery and onions., Mix all ingredients and cook over kerosene fire for 4 weeks at 465°. Yield:, 3,800 or more servings., If more guests are expected, 2 rabbits may be added, but do this only if necessary, as most people do not like to find hare in their stew.

title: Broccoli Bake
directions: Thaw broccoli in boiling water, then add remaining ingredients. Mix. Pour in casserole., Top with 1 stick melted oleo., Bake 1 hour at 350°.

title: Fudge
directions: Melt Velveeta and margarine., Mix in cocoa, sugar, vanilla and nuts (as many as you desire)., Mix well., Pat into 4 (13 x 9-inch) buttered pans., Cool., Cut into small pieces.

title: Holiday Apple Cider
directions: Bring the apple cider, cloves, allspice, cinnamon and sugar to a boil., Lower heat., Cover and simmer for 20 minutes. Strain punch and pour into heatproof bowl. Add orange slices., Makes 16 cups.

title: Walnut Bourbon Balls
directions: Mix all ingredients except granulated sugar. Roll into balls, a small melon scoop works well to measure, then roll in granulated sugar. Store in an airtight container. Makes about 48 balls.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Cook broccoli 5 minutes, then drain., Mix other ingredients and place in casserole., Top with cracker crumbs and dot with butter. Bake at 350° until brown and bubbly.

title: Bonnie'S Pound Cake
directions: Cream, butter, and, sugar., Add, flour alternately with eggs. Bake in loaf pans at 350° for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

title: Lamb Chops With Ratatouille And Couscous
directions: In a 4-quart flameproof casserole, heat oil over high heat. Add chops and brown on both sides, 2 or 3 at a time, a total of about 5 minutes., Remove to a dish and set aside.

title: Stromboli
directions: Roll dough into an oblong shape., Brush with olive oil and oregano., Place filling in the center., Fold long sides over and pinch to close., Close ends by rolling once and pinching., Grease pan with Pam. (Or for best results, eliminate Pam and bake on stoneware.), Bake at 350° for 20 minutes or until brown.

title: Pineapple Carrot Salad
directions: Heat the pineapple juice and water to boiling., Stir in the lemon Jell-O until dissolved., Cool to room temperature. Meanwhile, mix the cream cheese until light and fluffy., Heat milk and add to cheese., Mix until well blended., Then add carrots, pineapple and vinegar; put the Jell-O mixture into the cheese and mix well., Pour into container and chill.

title: Fruit Dip
directions: Mix together and refrigerate., Great for apples, grapes, strawberries, bananas, etc.

title: Famous Amos Chocolate Chip Cookies
directions: Beat softened margarine, brown and white sugars, vanilla, water and eggs in a large bowl with electric mixer until creamy and thoroughly blended., Preheat oven to moderate 375°., By hand, stir in flour, baking soda and salt until well mixed., Stir in chocolate pieces.

title: Coke Cake
directions: Heat Coca-Cola, butter and cocoa to boiling; mix rest of ingredients and add to mixture; batter will be thin with marshmallows floating. Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake in 350° oven for 35 minutes. Remove from oven and let cool.

title: Bread Dip
directions: Chop peppers, onion and ham., Mix everything together., Hollow out a round loaf of bread and put dip in loaf., Use the insides to dip with.

title: Lemon-Dijon Chicken Breasts
directions: Combine breadcrumbs and rind, stirring well., Combine lemon juice, mustard and lime juice; brush mixture over both sides of chicken., Dredge chicken in breadcrumb mixture., Place chicken in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish coated with cooking spray; sprinkle with any remaining breadcrumb mixture., Bake, uncovered, at 375° for 15 minutes., Turn chicken and bake an additional 15 minutes or until done., Garnish with lemon slices, if desired., Yield:, 6 servings (167 calories and 12 percent fat per serving).

title: Lasagna
directions: Brown ground beef with onion, garlic salt, salt and pepper. Place 3 lasagna noodles into boiling water., Don't overcook noodles or they will split., In bottom of 9 x 12-inch pan, put thin coating of spaghetti sauce., Put the noodles in bottom of pan and put 3 more in water., Put on top of noodles in layers: drained ground beef (cooked), Ricotta cheese, Mozzarella cheese, sprinkle of grated cheese, drizzle with spaghetti sauce, sprinkle of parsley flakes and sprinkle a few anise seed (if you like)., Do 2 more layers; use plenty of Mozzarella cheese and plenty of sauce., Put too much sauce will make the layers slide apart. Cover with foil; bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Spinach Roll-Ups
directions: Mix together., Heat tortillas as directed., Spread evenly on tortillas and roll up., Chill 3 hours before serving., Slice into 1-inch pieces.

title: Maple Nut Bars
directions: Cream oleo until soft; add powdered sugar gradually and beat until creamy., Add egg, maple syrup and soda., Mix in flour., Add nuts., Pour into an 8 x 8-inch greased pan., (I had to use a pan much smaller than this size.), Bake at 375° for 15 to 20 minutes. Cut into squares while warm and roll in powdered sugar., I put maple icing and walnuts on mine on top.

title: Honey Mustard Chicken
directions: Season chicken with soy sauce, then sprinkle seasoning salt. Cover well., Spread honey mustard on chicken and bake in glass baking dish with lid for 45 minutes at 375°, then add honey to chicken and cook for 35 more minutes.

title: Cocoa Mayo Cake
directions: Melt mayonnaise and sugar., Add part of sifted flour and dry ingredients, then the water., Mix well., Add remaining flour and vanilla., Mix well., Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Strawberry Pop Cake
directions: Bake cake as directed in a 9 x 13-inch pan., Dissolve gelatin in boiling water and add soda., While cake is still hot, poke holes in top with toothpicks., Slowly allow gelatin mixture to seep through holes., Refrigerate for 3 hours.

title: Old-Fashioned Rice Pudding
directions: Slightly beat eggs with sugar, salt and vanilla., Gradually add hot milk, to eggs; stir in rice., Pour into baking dish., Sprinkle with cinnamon and set dish in pan of hot water., Bake in 325° oven until set, about 40 minutes., Do not overbake.

title: Grape Pie
directions: Pop middle out of grape skins; save skins., Put pulp (middles) in saucepan and bring to a boil., Simmer 5 minutes., Put hot pulp through colander or food mill to remove seeds., Combine strained pulp with skins., Add sugar, flour and salt., Pour into unbaked crust., Dot with margarine., Add top crust with slits, lattice or circular cut outs on top of pie., Bake at 425° for 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Chocolate Delight
directions: Combine dry ingredients., Make center in mixture., Add vanilla, vinegar and oil., Gradually stir in water until well blended., Pour into 8-inch square greased pan., Bake at 375° for 25 to 30 minutes., Cool 10 minutes before cutting.

title: King Ranch Chicken
directions: Cut chicken into bite size pieces and mix all ingredients together, except tortillas, and spices to taste., Put a bit of the chicken grease from cooking the chicken in the bottom of a large casserole dish., Start with tortillas, then alternate chicken mixture, then tortillas., End up with the chicken mixture on top. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Key Lime Pie
directions: Mix together cream cheese and sugar; combine with sweetened condensed milk and lime juice., Add a few drops of green food coloring., Fold in topping., Pour into crust and chill at least 3 hours before serving.

title: Chocolate Brownies
directions: Place eggs and sugar in mixer., Put on slow., Add butter and melted chocolate., Scrape down. Remove and mix flour by hand; add vanilla and pecans., Put into greased sheet pan and bake at 350° until slightly firm to the hand, about 30 to 40 minutes., Makes 4 dozen.

title: Million Dollar Pound Cake
directions: Have eggs, butter and milk at room temperature., Combine sugar, a cup at a time, to the softened butter until light and fluffy., Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each., Sift flour four times and add to creamed mixture, 1/2 cup at a time, beating well after each., Stir in milk and flavorings., Pour in well-greased and floured tube pan., Bake at 300° for 1 hour and 40 minutes.

title: Dilly Casserole
directions: Dissolve yeast in 1/4 cup warm water., Heat cottage cheese to lukewarm., Combine cottage cheese, next 7 ingredients and yeast in large bowl; mix well., Add enough flour to make stiff dough., Let rise, covered, in warm place for 1 hour or until double in bulk. Stir dough down.

title: Ceilia'S Potato Salad
directions: Cook, peel and dice potatoes., Add diced celery, onion, parsley and dill., Add mayonnaise; mix., Then add lemon juice and salt and pepper to taste.

title: Spicy Tomato Juice
directions: Wash tomatoes., Remove cores and chop., Combine tomatoes, onions and celery and bring to a boil., Continue cooking and stirring for 20 minutes., Press through a food mill., Heat almost until boiling., Stir in other ingredients., Adjust seasonings to taste., Process in pints or quarts for 35 minutes., Makes 6 quarts.

title: Play Dough Recipe
directions: Do not double or halve this recipe., Measure flour and salt into a large bowl., Add only 1 cup of water to the dry ingredients., Mix thoroughly with your fingers, adding more water if necessary to make the dough the consistency of pie crust. Remove the dough from the bowl and knead for 4 or 5 minutes on wax paper., Store in tight container until used.

title: Dirt Cake
directions: Crush cookies., Mix oleo, powdered sugar and cream cheese until smooth; stir Cool Whip into mixture., Mix milk and instant pudding and vanilla as directed., Mix cheese mixture with pudding.

title: Deer Jerky
directions: Cut meat into strips., Combine ingredients to create a marinating sauce., Marinate meat for 12 to 24 hours in refrigerator., Hang strips of meat on toothpicks on oven rack. Cook at 150° with oven door cracked open 1-inch for 3 to 6 hours.

title: Hot Cheese Puffs
directions: Combine all ingredients, except bread; blend well., Cut bread into 1 1/2-inch rounds; spread with cheese mixture., Bake for 15 minutes at 350°., Yield:, 25 servings.

title: Lazy Daisy Oatmeal Cake
directions: Pour 1 1/4 cups boiling water over oats., Let set 20 minutes. Cream oleo, brown sugar, white sugar, vanilla and eggs., Then add oats; mix well., Pour into 9-inch square greased pan., Bake at 350° for 50 to 55 minutes., Do not remove from pan until frosting has been put on.

title: Cheese Sticks
