directions: Mix flour, baking powder, salt, pepper and cheese., Cut in butter and mix until smooth. Roll 1/3-inch thick. Cut 6 x 1/2-inch., Bake at 325° for 10 minutes., Makes 24.

title: Rockport Red Sauce
directions: Mix well and chill., May use more pepper sauce to taste.

title: Pineapple Cheese Ball
directions: Mix cream cheese with mixer until smooth. Gradually stir in drained pineapple, 1 cup nuts, onions, peppers and salt. Cover and chill overnight.

title: Rice Pudding
directions: Mix all ingredients together except raisins., Bake in glass dish at 325° for 1 1/2 hours., If desired, add raisins for the last half hour of baking.

title: Pineapple Icebox Cake
directions: Roll wafers into crumbs; put 1/2 in Pyrex dish., Cream butter and sugar; add 2 eggs., Put on top of crumbs. Whip cream and fold in pineapple and nuts., Pour over other., Top with other half of vanilla wafer crumbs., Refrigerate.

title: Refrigerator Cucumbers In The Cold
directions: Mix first 4 ingredients with water to cover., Let stand overnight or 12 hours., Rinse and drain., Put into jars (glass) the rinsed and drained cucumber mixture.

title: French Coconut Pie
directions: Mix all together., Pour into shell and bake for 35 minutes at 250°.

title: The Bungalow'S French Dressing
directions: Put all ingredients in a jar; shake well., Cover tightly and refrigerate.

title: Sour Cream Potatoes
directions: Thaw potatoes., Combine margarine, salt, pepper, onion, sour cream, soup and cheese., Blend together with potatoes., Pour into 3-quart casserole dish or 2 (1 1/2-quart) dishes., Mix crushed corn flakes and margarine together., Sprinkle over potato mixture. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Cottage Cheese Loaf
directions: Mix together and bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Brownies
directions: Mix all ingredients. Pour into ungreased 9 x 13 baking dish. Bake at 350° until set.

title: Shrimp Boats(Appetizer)
directions: Combine shrimp, eggs, celery salt, salt and pepper., Combine mayonnaise with cream., Fold into shrimp mixture., Spread shrimp mixture between bread slices., Cut into halves, diagonally. Fasten corners with wooden picks., Place on cookie sheet; broil 4-inches from source of heat for 10 to 15 minutes or until bread is toasted., Yield: 8 servings.

title: Irish Soda Bread
directions: In a mixing bowl, blend together the flour, sugar, baking powder, soda and salt. Cut in margarine until mixture resembles coarse meal. Add raisins, caraway seeds, egg and buttermilk. Stir until blended. Knead on floured board until smooth. Shape dough into 2 balls and place each in a greased 8-inch round cake pan. Flatten to fill pans. Cut a deep cross in the top of each loaf. Bake at 375° for about 40 minutes or until done. Slice and serve with butter. Yield: 2 loaves.

title: Squash Casserole
directions: Simmer squash, onion, salt and pepper until tender., Remove from heat., Add crackers, cream, margarine and beaten eggs., Pour into well buttered casserole dish., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or firm to touch., Cover with grated cheese and bake until cheese is melted and lightly browned.

title: Celery Sauce
directions: Put tomatoes, onions and peppers through food chopper. Combine with other ingredients; cook over low heat until thick. This takes about all day., Put in jars.

title: Corn Salad
directions: Mix and marinate overnight., Drain and serve on lettuce.

title: Ham And Onion Wrap-Ups
directions: Spread about 2 tablespoons of cream cheese onto each slice of ham., Place trimmed green onion (approximately 4 inches long) on cream cheese., Roll tightly., This is a great party snack!

title: Ha'Penny Snacks
directions: Let butter and cheese come to room temperature and mix thoroughly., Add remaining ingredients and blend., Shape into about 3 rolls, 1-inch in diameter., Wrap in wax paper and chill. Slice rolls into slices 1/4-inch thick., Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes or until slightly browned on edges., Keeps well in airtight container., Yields 6 dozen.

title: Green Bean Casserole
directions: In a casserole dish, arrange a layer of beans, layer of onion rings, layer of beans, layer of onions, layer of cracker crumbs and layer of cheese., Mix soup with water and salt; pour over beans, onions, etc., Bake at 325° for about 35 minutes.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Melt butter and bake chicken breasts in large casserole dish. Remove skin and bones; cut chicken in bite-size pieces., Combine butter, chicken and remaining ingredients in casserole dish., Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

title: Irish Creme
directions: Blend all ingredients together in large container., Put into bottles and store in refrigerator., Gets stronger as it ages., To serve, mix with half and half over ice.

title: Roasted Garlic Potatoes
directions: Spray large baking sheet with cooking spray., In small bowl combine corn oil and garlic., Arrange potato slices on baking sheet., Brush with corn oil mixture., Sprinkle with Parmesan and pepper., Bake at 400° for 30 minutes or until lightly browned and crisp., Makes 4 servings.

title: Pumpkin Pie Cake
directions: Mix first 5 ingredients and pour in 9 x 13-inch ungreased pan. Sprinkle cake mix over mixture., Scatter nuts over cake mix. Drizzle melted oleo over top., Bake in 350° oven for 1 hour. Serve warm with whipped cream.

title: Cool Fruit Pie
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Mix baking mix and 2 tablespoons sugar. Cut in margarine until mixture is crumbly., Press in bottom and up side of ungreased glass pie plate (10 x 1/2-inch)., Bake about 15 minutes or until lightly brown., Cool., Mix cream cheese, 1 cup sugar and vanilla., Beat whipping cream in chilled bowl until stiff., Fold whipped cream and marshmallows into cream cheese mixture., Spread over crust., Refrigerate any remaining pie., Makes 8 servings.

title: Russian Eggs
directions: Beat eggs and season to taste., Simmer pepper and onion rings until tender-crisp., Line well-oiled 9 x 12-inch pan with bread slices., Cover bread with meat and layer vegetables (except tomatoes) over meat., Pour eggs over all., Press down., Let stand overnight.

title: Poppy Seed Chicken
directions: Mix stewed and chopped chicken breasts, cream cheese, chicken soup and celery soup., Bake at 350° until bubbly (about 20 minutes)., Top with mixture of crushed Ritz crackers, melted butter and poppy seed., Bake until bubbly (about 10 minutes).

title: Cheese Wafer
directions: Combine butter, cheese and nuts. Mix well and add flour. Shape into log and cut into wafers. Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Refrigerator Pickles
directions: Slice cucumbers and onions. Layer cucumbers and onions., Boil vinegar, sugar, salt, mustard seed, celery seed and turmeric. Pour over cucumbers., When cool, refrigerate.

title: Spaghetti Sauce(Large Recipe)
directions: In a large pot, cook and stir sausage and onions until browned; drain the fat. Add other ingredients except pasta. Mix and bring to boil. Reduce heat; cover slightly and simmer for 2 hours. Stir often. (Sometimes I use a crock-pot.) Makes approximately 36 cups. Cook spaghetti as directed on package.

title: "No Brainer" Southwest Chicken Soup
directions: Put all ingredients together in large kettle and simmer about 30 minutes., Serve with crushed tortilla chips, grated cheese, sour cream, and avocado slices.

title: Mr. John'S Barbecue Sauce
directions: Blend all ingredients., Heat to a simmer and just keep warm.

title: Corned Beef In Rolls
directions: Mix ingredients together and toss., Fill 8 hot dog rolls with mixture., Wrap each in foil and heat on cookie sheet for 20 minutes at 250°., These are simple to make and may be wrapped in foil and frozen for later use.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Bring broccoli to a boil for approximately 5 minutes., Drain and set aside., Melt margarine; add chopped onion and saute in skillet., Add garlic cheese and cream of mushroom soup., Place broccoli in greased baking dish., When cheese and soup are melted, pour over broccoli., Top with crackers or bread crumbs and dot with butter., Bake at 350° for about 25 to 30 minutes., Do not cover while baking.

title: German Chocolate Cake
directions: Melt chocolate in boiling water., Cool., Cream butter and sugar until fluffy., Add yolks, 1 at a time, beating well after each., Blend in vanilla and chocolate., Sift flour with soda and salt; add alternately with buttermilk to chocolate mixture, beating after each addition until smooth., Fold in beaten whites. Pour into three 9-inch layer pans, lined on bottom with wax paper. Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Betty Croome'S Poppy Seed Chicken
directions: Mix ingredients and put in large casserole dish., Top with coarsely crumbled crackers, poppy seed and melted oleo., Bake for 35 minutes in 350° oven.

title: Frosted Orange Pie
directions: In a saucepan, combine sugar, flour and salt; gradually add water., Cook and stir over medium-high heat for 2-3 minutes or until thickened and bubbly., Remove from heat., Gradually stir 1/2 C. into egg yolks; return all to pan., Bring to a gentle boil; cook and stir for 2 minutes., Remove from the heat; stir in orange and lemon peel., Gently stir in juices., Pour into pastry shell. Cool on a wire rack for 1 hour., Chill at least 3 hours.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: *I use cooked chicken, boned and skinned.

title: Banana Energy Bars
directions: Cream margarine and sugar until light and fluffy., Beat in egg, salt and bananas., Stir in remaining ingredients.

title: Cheese-Garlic Biscuit
directions: Heat oven, to, 450°., Mix, Bisquick, milk and cheese to soft dough., Drop, by spoonful onto an ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes., Mix melted margarine and garlic powder and brush over biscuits while warm.

title: Pesto Bread
directions: Dissolve yeast with sugar in 1/4 cup water., Let set for 5 minutes to proof., In large bowl, mix 2 cups flour with yeast mixture together; add remaining water and flour as needed., Mix by hand or electric mixer with dough hook., Knead until smooth and elastic., Put in greased bowl to rise., When doubled in size, punch down and divide into 2 balls., Roll dough into rectangle (12 x 8)., Spread with pesto mixture, roll up and place on baking sheet that has been spread with corn meal., Let rise again., Bake at 375° until lightly browned and hollow sounding to touch., Let cool and feast.

title: Bacon Cheddar Muffins
directions: Spray muffin pan with Pam., In a large bowl, mix flour, cheese, sugar, baking powder and salt., Set aside., In a small bowl, mix egg, milk and oil., Add to flour mixture., Stir until moist., Batter will be lumpy., Fold in the crumbled bacon., Fill the muffin cups even with the top., Bake at 400° for 20 to 25 minutes or until muffins are golden., Serve warm.

title: Cream Puffs
directions: Combine butter, salt and water., Heat to boiling., Add flour to boiling mixture all at once., Beat vigorously until mixture leaves sides of saucepan and does not cling to spoon., Remove from heat. Cool slightly., Add unbeaten one egg at a time., Beat thoroughly after the addition of each egg until mixture is smooth., Drop by tablespoon into well oiled muffin tin or onto baking sheet 2-inches apart., Shape mixture into rounds and pile slightly in the center. Bake at 400° for 30 minutes., Lower heat to 350° for 10 minutes until firm and dry., Remove from oven., Cool., Cut a slit in the side of each with a sharp knife., Insert cream filling, sweetened whipped cream or fruit., Sprinkle with powdered sugar., Makes 12 average size puffs.

title: Favorite Muffins
directions: Heat oven to 400°., Grease bottoms and sides of 12 medium muffin tins., Beat egg; stir in milk and oil., Mix in remaining ingredients just until flour is moistened., Batter should be lumpy., Fill muffin cups, 2/3 full., Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown., Immediately remove from pan., If using self-rising flour, omit baking powder and salt.

title: Meatballs
directions: Mix ingredients together., Do not fry meatballs., Add to sauce with ribs or meat sauce.

title: Country Ham Butter
directions: Combine this and process in food processor until perfectly smooth., Chill. Serve on biscuits, buttered toast or crackers.

title: Apple Crisps
directions: Arrange apples in a buttered 8-inch square pan., Combine oats, sugar, flour and cinnamon., Cut butter into mixture until crumbly. Sprinkle this mixture evenly over apple slices., Bake at 350° for 40 minutes., Serve warm with vanilla ice cream., Yummy.

title: Batter For Fried Chicken
directions: Shake all ingredients in Ziploc bag., Batter chicken and fry. Refrigerate leftover batter in Ziploc bag for future use., This may remind you of the Colonel's chicken (just a little).

title: Glazed Raisin-Cinnamon Biscuits
directions: Mix all ingredients until dough forms, about 20 strokes., Turn into a floured board. Shape into a ball and knead 10 times., Roll to 1/2-inch thickness. Cut with 2 1/2-inch cutter., Bake on a greased cookie sheet at 450° for 8 to 10 minutes., Spread with Vanilla Glaze while warm (see Miscellaneous for Vanilla Glaze).

title: No Bake Cookies
directions: Boil sugar, milk, oleo and cocoa one minute., Must be a rolling, boil., Add, salt, vanilla, peanut butter and oatmeal. Mix well and drop by spoonfuls on wax paper and let set up.

title: Heavenly Hash
directions: Drain oranges and pineapple chunks., Mix all ingredients thoroughly and refrigerate overnight.

title: Chocolate Apple Spice Cake
directions: Cream butter with sugar; beat in eggs, then water., In separate bowl sift flour, cocoa, baking soda, cinnamon and nutmeg. Beat into creamed ingredients along with vanilla, chocolate morsels and apples., Turn into a greased and floured tube pan. Bake at 325° for 1 1/4 hours., Cool thoroughly before slicing. May be topped with whipped cream.

title: Best Ever Coleslaw
directions: Combine first 4 ingredients., In saucepan, bring vinegar, sugar and seasonings to a boil., Pour over cabbage mixture. Place in airtight bowl., Will keep in refrigerator 3 weeks.

title: Guacamole Dip
directions: Blend all ingredients together until smooth.

title: Broccoli And Rice Casserole
directions: Saute broccoli, onions and celery in butter., Mix all ingredients, except rice., Put rice in bottom of buttered casserole dish., Put mixture on top., Sprinkle paprika on top (for looks)., Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: 7-Up Cranberry Salad
directions: Drain pineapple and save juice., Add water to make 1 cup liquid., Heat to boiling and add jello to dissolve., Cool., Stir in 7-Up., Refrigerate to partially set., Mix in pineapple and cranberries., Pour into dish to congeal., Mix cream cheese and Cool Whip and spread on top., Sprinkle with pecan pieces.

title: Pecan Pie Cake
directions: Mix together 1 egg, melted butter and yellow cake mix (except 2/3 cup)., Pat into a greased 13 x 9-inch oblong pan., Bake for 15 to 20 minutes at 350° until brown., Mix rest of ingredients., Pour over baked crust., Bake 30 to 35 minutes., Take out before completely firm.

title: Potato Salad
directions: Cut up potatoes as you would for potato salad. Boil your potatoes, then drain. Let your potatoes cool 5 to 10 minutes. In a large deep serving dish, cover slightly the bottom with a layer of your cooked potatoes. Then spread a light thin layer of mayonnaise or sour cream or a half and half mixture of mayonnaise and sour cream mixture over the top of your potatoes. Then sprinkle with green peppers, Cheddar cheese and chopped ham. Sprinkle with salt and pepper.

title: Olive Cheese Balls
directions: Combine all ingredients (except olives)., Put 1 teaspoon around each olive., Be sure olive is covered., Cover with Saran Wrap and chill (minimum 1 1/2 hours)., Bake in 400° oven for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Best Ever Soup
directions: Brown meat and onion., Add other ingredients and simmer 1 1/2 hours, stirring about every 20 minutes.

title: Jalapeno Cornbread
directions: Mix all ingredients, except cheese slices (batter will be thin)., Pour half of batter in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan., Layer cheese slices on batter, then pour remaining batter on top., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Herbed Cream Cheese For Bagels
directions: Combine cream cheese, whipping cream and garlic in work bowl of food processor or blender., Process until smooth., Stir in chives, thyme and pepper., Refrigerate to blend flavors., Allow to stand at room temperature about 30 minutes prior to serving.

title: Sparkling Red Punch
directions: Dissolve sugar in 2 cups hot water., Dissolve jello in 1 cup hot water., Combine all ingredients and freeze., Thaw to slush stage., Pour in ginger ale when ready to serve.

title: Bootsie'S Spaghetti Casserole
directions: Saute chopped onion in small amount of oil., Add meat and cook until done., Add salt and pepper to taste., Add tomato soup, catsup and Worcestershire sauce., Stir and simmer., Boil spaghetti.

title: Slammin Jammin Fruit Dip
directions: Beat cream cheese well., Add marshmallow cream., Serve with fresh fruit.

title: Easy Chicken Pie
directions: Boil chicken and pull off bone., Chop chicken and layer in 9 x 13-inch pan., Pour chicken broth over chicken., Spread chicken soup (undiluted) over chicken and broth., Melt margarine and combine with flour and milk., Spread mixture on top of other layers and bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

title: Butter Muffins
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Grease 12 (3-inch) muffin pan cups. Cream the butter, shortening and sugar together., Beat in the eggs, salt and nutmeg., Stir in the flour alternately with the milk until the mixture is just combined., Fill the muffin cups full., Bake for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Spanish Rice
directions: Fry bacon ends., Saute onion and green pepper in 3 tablespoons of bacon fat in a large skillet until tender., Add all other ingredients., Cook slowly, covered, approximately 45 minutes. Sprinkle crumbled bacon ends on top and serve., Makes, 6 servings.

title: Mama'S Pound Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients by hand until moist., Beat on medium speed for 5 minutes., Scrape sides of bowl and beat 5 more minutes., Put in cold oven., Do not preheat!, Bake at 325° for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Magic Cookie Bars
directions: Pour melted butter onto the bottom of a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Sprinkle crumbs evenly over melted butter or margarine., Sprinkle chopped nuts evenly over crumbs., Scatter chocolate morsels over nuts., Sprinkle coconut evenly over chocolate morsels., Pour sweetened condensed milk evenly over coconut., Bake in a moderate (350°) oven for 25 minutes or until lightly browned on top., Cool in pan 15 minutes., Cut into bars.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Boil a fryer., Tear into bite size pieces., Place in a shallow baking dish., Combine soups and milk., Pour over chicken., Mix butter and broth; stir in stuffing., Spread over top of chicken. Bake 40 minutes at 350°.

title: Sauteed Shrimp And Mushrooms
directions: Slice mushrooms into 2 or 3 pieces each., Melt butter in a large skillet; add mushrooms., Cook on low heat or high simmer 30 minutes uncovered (until most of the water has cooked out)., Add garlic, salt and pepper., Stir and add shrimp., Cook covered 5 to 7 minutes, until shrimp are done., Stir occasionally., Serve over rice.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
directions: In heavy saucepan, over low heat, melt candy coating with sweetened condensed milk and salt., Remove from heat; stir in peanut butter, then peanuts and vanilla., Spread evenly into waxed paper-lined 8 or 9-inch square pan., Chill 2 hours., Turn fudge onto cutting board; peel off paper and cut into squares., Store loosely covered at room temperature.

title: Broccoli And Chicken Casserole
directions: Cook chicken 1/2 hour; skin and bone it., Cook broccoli as directed., Arrange broccoli in buttered 11 1/2 x 7 1/2-inch dish. Tear chicken in strips and place over broccoli. Mix soups with mayonnaise and spread over chicken., Sprinkle with cheese and then bread crumbs., Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

title: Apple Dip
directions: Put apples in 2 cups of water, 1 tablespoon of salt and 1 tablespoon of vinegar., Cover and when ready to serve, drain well. Blend cheese, brown sugar and vanilla., Spread in dish., Top with butterscotch topping and nuts., Serve with apples.

title: Italian Country Chicken(6 To 8 Servings)
directions: Heat, oil in large heavy skillet over medium heat., Add onion and garlic and cook until translucent, stirring occasionally, about 10 minutes., Add chicken and stir until cooked through, about 5 minutes., Mix in artichoke hearts (chopped slightly) with liquid, peppers (chopped into pieces) with liquid and olives and heat through., Season with salt and pepper., Pour over pasta and toss well., Serve, passing Parmesan separately.

title: Mrs. Tran'S Fried Rice
directions: Scramble eggs in butter and set aside., In wok or large frypan over medium heat, saute onion in oil until transparent., Add vegetables, and cook, stirring for 3 minutes., Add sugar, fish sauce and soy sauce and mix well., Add rice and cook about 5 minutes, stirring frequently until all food is hot., Chop up scrambled eggs; mix in and serve.

title: Dream Cookies
directions: Cream butter and sugar., Beat until fluffy., Add vanilla and then stir in flour, baking powder, salt and nuts., Mix until smooth., Form small balls., Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Press down with a fork., Bake in slow oven at 300° for 20 minutes or until light brown., Makes about 75.

title: Old Fashioned Cheese Potatoes
directions: In saucepan melt butter., Add flour, salt and pepper., Cook and stir until a thick paste forms., Gradually add milk., Cook and stir until mixture begins to thicken., Add cheese., Cook and stir until melted., Place potatoes in a greased 13 x 9-inch dish., Pour sauce over and bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Chicken Or Turkey Strudel
directions: In large bowl of electric mixer (or by hand), beat cheese and butter until smooth., Gradually add flour mixed with salt and herbs., When dough holds together, form into a ball, wrap in waxed paper and refrigerate overnight.

title: Carrot And Vegetable Stew
directions: Put all ingredients in a large pot and start cooking at high heat, then reduce heat to medium-high heat when it begins to boil. Cook, covered, until carrots are tender, but not too soft., Then serve over rice or plain.

title: Salt Substitute
directions: Mix in shaker container and use instead of salt.

title: Crock-Pot Beans
directions: Combine in crock-pot and cook for 5 to 6 hours., As mixture thickens, add catsup, as needed.

title: Bride'S Pink Punch
directions: Mix jello with hot water., Add Kool-Aid, sugar, water and juices., Chill., Just before serving, add chilled Sprite., In punch bowl, pour punch over sherbet.

title: Quick Cherry Dessert
directions: Butter Pyrex dish or sheet cake pan., Pour pie filling in pan with pineapple., Pour dry cake mix over fillings., Melt the margarine and pour over the cake mix., Sprinkle nuts over the top and bake for 45 minutes at 350° in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Picante Sauce
directions: Cook all ingredients for, 30, minutes,, stirring at all times. Put in jars and seal.

title: Cake That Won'T Last
directions: Mix by hand in large bowl., When well blended, pour into greased and floured angel food or Bundt pan., Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 20 minutes., Do not open door of oven first hour of baking time.

title: Chiffon Cake
directions: Mix flour, sugar, baking powder and salt., Make a well in middle., Add oil, egg yolks, water, orange and lemon extract; beat. In another bowl, beat egg whites with cream of tartar until whites form stiff peaks., Pour egg yolk mixture over beaten whites, folding until blended., (Do not stir)., Pour into pan, bake 55 minutes until light brown.

title: Hash Brown Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients. Grease baking dish. Place all ingredients in baking dish. (Optional: Sprinkle top with Parmesan cheese.) Cook at 350° for 55 minutes.

title: Coconut Cream Pie
directions: Mix flour and sugar. Pour in milk and stir. Add butter. Cook on low heat. Beat egg yolks. Pour in mixture. Stir while cooking and cook until almost done. Add vanilla and coconut to mixture. Remove from heat. Pour slightly thickened mixture into baked pie crust. Top with beaten egg whites and sugar. Sprinkle coconut on top. Bake for 10 minutes at 450°.

title: Apple Coffee Cake
directions: Mix eggs, brown sugar, vanilla and oil, then add cinnamon, flour, baking soda and salt., Add to apples and nut mixture., Bake 1 hour at 350°., Use a 9 x 13-inch glass Pyrex dish.

title: Bearnaise Sauce
directions: Put egg yolks with 1/3 of the butter in top of double boiler. Keep water in the bottom hot but not boiling., Stir eggs and butter constantly until butter melts adding more butter a little at a time and stirring each time until it melts., As soon as the mixture is thick remove from heat and stir in rest of ingredients. Serve at once.

title: Strawberry Cake
directions: Mix cake mix and Jell-O thoroughly; add oil and water., Blend well and add eggs, one at a time., Beat according to package (cake mix) directions., Fold in coconut, nuts and thawed, drained strawberries., Pour batter into tube (greased and floured) or 13 x 9-inch pan., Bake according to cake mix directions at 350° (maybe less).

title: Vegetable Dish(Diabetic Recipe)
directions: Mix all together and put in casserole or 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 1 hour at 350°.

title: Fried Cheese Balls
directions: Combine the cheese, flour, salt and cayenne pepper., Using your hands, gently stir in egg whites., Pat the mixture into small balls and roll them in cracker crumbs., Heat oil in skillet., When hot, put the balls in the pan without crowding them., Cover over medium-high heat, turning so all sides become golden brown., Drain on paper towels.

title: Easy Chicken In Wine
directions: Place chicken breasts in one layer in a shallow baking pan. Mix together all other ingredients., Pour sauce over chicken. Cover with foil. Refrigerate. Spoon sauce over chicken a couple of times.

title: Razorback Burgoo
directions: Combine first 4 ingredients in large Dutch oven., Bring to boil; cover and reduce heat., Simmer 2 hours or until meat is tender., Remove meat from broth; cool., Skin, bone and chop chicken., Skim off and discard fat from broth., Measure broth and return 3 quarts to Dutch oven., Add chopped meats and remaining ingredients., Bring to boil; reduce heat., Simmer, uncovered 4 hours, stirring frequently., Add additional broth or water if necessary., Remove red pepper., Double for after the game.

title: Easy Rice Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients., Bake at 350° until done.

title: Grandma Leones' Caramel Frosting
directions: Put brown sugar, milk and butter in saucepan and simmer slowly for about 3 minutes and cool., Add powdered sugar and stir until creamy.

title: Coconut Macaroons
directions: Mix together flour, sugar and salt., Beat till stiff egg whites., Fold in dry ingredients, vanilla and coconut., Drop on greased sheet., Bake at 325° for 20-25 mins., If doubled, will make approx. 40.

title: Chocolate Pie
directions: *If using large package, use a deep dish pie shell.

title: Chocolate Animal Crackers
directions: Melt the chocolate bits and shortening in a saucepan over low heat., Stir until smooth., Dip animal crackers into chocolate and lift with a fork., Place on waxed paper to harden.

title: Stu'S Fine Chili
directions: Fry ground beef with sliced onions; pour off excess oil (do not overcook)., Stir in chili mix., Stir in tomatoes, chop or cut tomatoes before adding., Add tomato paste (about 2/3 can)., Add jalapeno peppers (split into halves or quarters)., Add kidney beans juice and all., Add water to thin out (your choice as to density). Let simmer about 1 hour.

title: Salmon Patties
directions: Mix all ingredients well., Shape into patties., Cook at 325° on cookie sheet for 1/2 hour., Turn; cook 1/2 hour until brown.

title: Fruit Cocktail Cake
directions: Mix all at once., Pour in 10 x 14-inch greased pan., Bake 30 minutes at 375°.

title: Broccoli Salad
directions: Chop washed broccoli and drain on paper towels., Add onions. Crumble bacon., Reserve 1/4 cup and add to broccoli., Add Ranch dressing and mix well., Top with remaining bacon bits.

title: Bill'S Favorite Banana Pudding
directions: Mix pudding mix and milk., Add Cool Whip., Layer cookies, bananas, pudding and repeat.

title: White Bread(Quick Method)
directions: Scald milk., Add sugar and salt; cool to lukewarm., Dissolve yeast in lukewarm water and add to milk., Add half of flour and beat until smooth., Add melted shortening and remaining flour or enough to make easy handled dough., Knead quickly and lightly until smooth and elastic., Place dough in greased bowl, cover and set in a warm place., Let rise until double in bulk, divide into 4 equal portions and shape into loaves., Place in greased loaf pans. Bake in 425° oven for 15 minutes, then reduce heat to 350° for 30 minutes longer.

title: Walnut Broccoli
directions: Cook broccoli until barely tender., Drain and put in casserole dish., Melt the 1/2 cup butter and add the flour., Remove from heat and add bouillon., Gradually add milk., Return to heat and cook until smooth and boiling., Pour over broccoli., Heat the 3/4 cup water and 6 tablespoons butter., Add the stuffing and walnuts. Sprinkle over broccoli and bake at 400° for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Better Than Sex Cake
directions: Combine the first 3 ingredients., Place on bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes until lightly browned., Cool.

title: Italiano'S Spaghetti Sauce
directions: Simmer onion in oil., Add tomatoes, paste, sauce and water; simmer., Do not burn on bottom., Simmer 1 hour or more., Parboil sausages slowly to get some fat out, about 20 minutes., Drain and add sausages to spaghetti sauce., Heat for 30 minutes at a slow simmer., Serve with spaghetti.

title: Banana Pudding
directions: Mix and scald sugar and milk., Stir other ingredients into hot milk and cook until thickened and smooth., After mixture has cooled, add sliced bananas.

title: No-Mix Blackberry Cobbler
directions: Stir together berries and 1/2 cup sugar., Melt margarine in casserole dish., Mix flour, baking powder, salt and rest of sugar. Add milk and mix well., Pour batter into dish with margarine., Do not mix., Put berries and sugar over batter; do not mix., Bake 50 minutes in preheated 350° oven.

title: Raw Cauliflower Salad
directions: Trim and wash cauliflower and break into small flowerets. Combine all ingredients., Toss lightly and chill well.

title: Fried Scallops
directions: Combine half and half with Worcestershire powder., Dip scallops in milk mixture and roll in bread crumbs., Fry in hot oil for 3 to 5 minutes.

title: Mexican Chicken Casserole
directions: Boil chicken until tender., Remove skin and bones., Cut into bite sized pieces., Reserve 2 cups of cooking broth., Saute onion in butter until just heated thoroughly., Add to onion the chili peppers., Then add and heat chicken broth and soups., Stir until smooth and heated., Into large bowl, tear tortillas into bites sized pieces; stir in chicken pieces, soup mixture and 1 cup Cheddar cheese., Pour into baking dish and top with 1/2 cup Cheddar cheese and crushed nachos (if desired)., Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Chocolate Pound Cake
directions: Mix all together., Bake 1 hour and 20 minutes in large tube pan, greased and floured, at 350°.

title: Squash Dressing
directions: Mix all ingredients together and pour into a 2-quart casserole dish., Bake 35 to 40 minutes at 300°.

title: Mother'S Brownies
directions: Melt together the bitter chocolate with the stick of butter. Mix the eggs, sugar, flour, vanilla and coffee., Blend the mixture with the chocolate and butter., Sprinkle with chopped nuts or marshmallow bits, M&M's or other small edible bits., Bake about 20 minutes in a 350° oven in an 8 x 14-inch pan., Test with toothpick for slight moistness., Refrigerate immediately., (This keeps them moist.), Can be frozen.

title: Corn Tomato Chowder
directions: Cut bacon in small pieces and fry slowly to a golden brown in a large saucepan. Add onion and cook slowly without browning for 5 minutes. Add corn, potatoes and tomatoes in alternate layers. Sprinkle with salt, sugar and pepper, then add water., Cook slowly until potatoes are tender., Remove from heat and stir milk in slowly. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Strawberry Salad
directions: Dissolve jello in boiling water., Add strawberries and stir until thawed., Add bananas and nuts., Pour 1/2 mixture into long dish and put in refrigerator until firm., Combine pineapple and Cool Whip and spread on layer., Top with remaining mixture. Refrigerate until firm.

title: Cheese Balls
directions: Crumble Blue cheese and mix well with finely grated Cheddar cheese and cream cheese, chopped parsley and grated onion., Shape into a ball., Wrap and refrigerate until firm., Reshape ball and roll in dry roasted peanuts or pecans.

title: Best Ever Brownies
directions: Cream 1 stick of butter and 1 cup of sugar., Add eggs, flour, chocolate syrup and nuts; mix well., Pour into greased and floured pan and bake at 325 degrees for 30 minutes., Top with frosting when cool.

title: Fried Rice
directions: Fry bacon crisp in large skillet., Pour off drippings., Cover bottom of skillet with oil., Saute pepper and onion just until tender., Meanwhile, cook rice according to directions., Pour rice over onion and pepper., Add crumbled bacon and soy sauce., Stir slightly to mix., You can add cabbage, carrots, ham, chicken or hamburger meat.

title: Budget Cake
directions: Combine all ingredients in mixer and beat until mixed well, approximately 2 minutes., Pour into two 9-inch cake pans that have been greased and floured., Bake at 325° for 35 minutes. Cool before icing with cream cheese frosting.

title: Strawberry Butter
directions: Cream butter until light and fluffy, then gradually add oil, beating continuously., Beat in honey, strawberries and orange rind (if desired)., Store in a covered container in the refrigerator for up to one week., Serve on toast, muffins, biscuits or other warm homemade breads.

title: Pumpkin Loaves
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Grease two 9 x 5-inch loaf pans., Mix all dry ingredients thoroughly., Add remaining ingredients and mix just until blended., Turn batter into pans., Bake about 1 hour or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean., Clean in pans 10 minutes; remove from pans and cool completely.

title: Banana Bread
directions: Mash bananas until smooth and mush., Mix in order given., Pour into greased and floured loaf pan., Push batter to side (low in center)., Bake in moderate oven at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Crab-Filled Buns
directions: Combine crab meat, olives, cheese and onion., Add mixture of mayonnaise and lemon juice; add seasonings., Fill buttered buns with mixture; wrap each in foil., Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Fruit Jumblet Cookies
directions: Grind dates with a little flour to keep from sticking; walnuts help, too., Fold in egg whites, stiffly beaten, last., Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.

title: Indian Chicken Curry
directions: In a large saucepan, melt butter and saute onion, celery and apples for 5 minutes., Stir in curry and flour., Gradually stir in chicken broth, cream of coconut and half and half., Stir over moderate heat until sauce bubbles and thickens., Stir in chicken and season to taste with salt and pepper., Serve over rice.

title: Snow Ice Cream
directions: Whip cream to soft peaks; add sugar., Fold in half and half and vanilla., Add snow and beat., Cover and place in freezer.

title: Greek Roasted Chicken
directions: Place chicken on a rack in roasting pan., Season with salt and pepper and 1 1/2 teaspoons oregano., Arrange potatoes around chicken; sprinkle with salt, pepper and oregano., Pour butter and lemon juice over chicken and potatoes., Add chicken broth to pan bottom., Bake at 350° for 2 to 2 1/2 hours., Baste with juices while baking.

title: Old Fashioned Bread Pudding
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Combine sugar, cinnamon, allspice and ginger., Add scalded milk slowly to eggs; mix well., Add sugar-spice mixture and butter or margarine; stir until sugar dissolves., Combine bread cubes and raisins in buttered 1 1/2-quart casserole., Pour custard mixture over bread cubes. Place casserole in pan of water., Bake 1 hour or until a knife inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Chocolate Mocha Punch
directions: Heat 1 cup of the water to boiling; dissolve instant coffee in water., Stir in remaining water, dry milk, sugar and salt. Refrigerate until chilled 3 to 4 hours., Place softened ice cream in punch bowl., Pour chilled coffee mixture on ice cream., Swirl ice cream throughout coffee mixture., Beat whipping cream in chilled mixing bowl until very soft peaks from., Top chocolate mocha punch with mounds of whipped cream., Sprinkle nutmeg over the mounds of whipped cream.

title: Ice Cream Cake
directions: Melt 1 stick butter., Crush 1 package Oreos (save some out). Pour butter over cookies in bowl and mix., Press mixture into 9 x 13-inch pan., Slice carton of ice cream and layer over cookie dough., Pour 1 jar caramel ice cream topping over ice cream., Top with Cool Whip and garnish with leftover Oreos.

title: Vidalia Onion Casserole
directions: Saute onions in butter., Layer half of onions and butter in casserole dish., Cover with half of crackers and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese., Repeat layering., Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.

title: Frozen Fruit Salad No. 1
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Cover and freeze., Serve frozen., Keeps well in refrigerator.

title: Heloise'S Fudge
directions: Mix sugar and milk in a large, heavy saucepan., Slowly bring to rolling boil and boil for 8 minutes., Then move the saucepan off the heat and add the butter, chocolate chips and marshmallows. Mix only until the chips and the marshmallows are melted., Add the vanilla and nuts and blend., Spread the mixture in a large ungreased pan and let it cool.

title: Christmas Punch
directions: Combine aid, sugar, water and pineapple juice., Just before serving, add ginger ale., Pour the entire mixture over ice cream.

title: Chocolate Zucchini Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Melt chocolate., Grease and flour 2 large loaf pans., Sift the dry ingredients and set aside., Beat eggs; add sugar, oil and chocolate., Stir., Add the sifted dry ingredients and zucchini, then add the nuts., Pour into 2 large loaf pans., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Shepherd'S Pie
directions: Brown ground beef and drain grease off., Add Manwich and simmer about 15 minutes., While waiting for beef and sauce to simmer, make instant mashed potatoes., Add beef mixture into a casserole dish or pan., Add corn on top of beef mixture, then add instant potatoes on top of corn, then top with grated cheese.

title: Applesauce-Spice Cake
directions: Combine all ingredients in large mixer bowl. Blend well, then beat at medium speed of electric mixer for 4 minutes. Pour into greased and floured 8 x 4 inch loaf pans. Bake at 350 degrees for 50 to 55 minutes or until cake tester inserted in center comes out clean and cake begins to pull away from sides of pan. Do not underbake. Cool in pan 15 minutes. Remove from pan and finish cooling on racks.

title: Italian Beef
directions: Note:, If you desire to spice it up, add 1/4 cup pepper juice.

title: Cheese Cake
directions: Mix together and form in bottom and sides of pie pan, greased.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
directions: Mix all ingredients and bake at 350° for 90 minutes, or until potatoes are done.

title: Tea Cakes
directions: Cream the sugar, shortening, salt and nutmeg., Add eggs and ice water; work in flour., Roll out on floured board; cut in desired shape., Bake at 375° for 10 to 15 minutes., May be sprinkled with sugar while still warm, if desired.

title: Rice Pudding
directions: Mix all ingredients in medium-sized bowl., Pour into a lightly greased 1-quart casserole and bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Yield: 4 to 6 servings.

title: Pineapple Cottage Cheese
directions: Heat pineapple juice and lime jello., Put pineapple, cottage cheese and marshmallows in big bowl., Cool lime jello and pour over pineapple mixture., Add whipped cream., Sets quickly.

title: Nana'S Bean Soup
directions: Cook beans until mushy., Dice potatoes, carrots and onions. Add salt, pepper and tomato soup., Add small amount evaporated milk to thicken and cook until vegetables are cooked.

title: Beer Bread
directions: By hand, mix dry ingredients and blend into beer., Pour into well, greased loaf pan., Bake at 375° (350° if glass) for 1 hour. Serve warm.

title: Chess Bars
directions: Melt butter and let cool., Mix with cake mix and 1 egg., Press into 9 x 13-inch pan or Pyrex.

title: Fiesta Dip
directions: Mix all ingredients and spread into serving dish or 9 x 13-inch or larger pizza pan., Top with shredded lettuce, grated Cheddar cheese and chopped tomatoes., Chill for at least 1 hour. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Sparkling Cranberry Apple Punch
directions: Combine juices and coriander in large pitcher or punch bowl. Just before serving add club soda and stir., Garnish with orange slices and cranberries.

title: Banana Nut Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Put in 2 greased and floured cake pans., Bake at 375° for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Hot Pineapple Salad
directions: Mix together first 5 ingredients., Place in 9 x 13-inch pan. Top with finely crushed crackers and melted oleo., Bake at 375° until cheese melts and mixture is bubbly., Serve warm.

title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
directions: Beat butter lightly., Add part of sugar and mix until smooth. Add remaining sugar and beat until smooth and fluffy., Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition., Stir in flavoring., Add dry ingredients alternately with sour cream., Bake at 325° in greased and floured Bundt or tube pan for 1/2 hour. Reduce heat to 300° and cook 45 to 50 minutes or until cake is done., Cool cake 5 minutes before removing from pan.

title: Butterscotch Brownies
directions: Lightly oil a 9 x 13-inch baking pan., Stir together sugar, oil, margarine and eggs., Mix in nuts and vanilla., Stir together flour, baking soda and salt; add to sugar mixture., Pour into prepared pan., Bake in 350° oven about 25 to 35 minutes (until browned and knife comes out clean)., Cut into 32 pieces.

title: Peanut Brittle
directions: Cook sugar, Karo, water and salt to 234°., Add roasted peanuts., Cook to 260°., Then add butter., Cook to 300°., Last of all, add vanilla and soda., Stir rapidly; pour on tray until cool.

title: Spicy Cheese Dip
directions: Combine all ingredients in a blender and blend until smooth. Chill and serve with raw vegetables.

title: Moist Chocolate Chip Cookies
directions: Mix flour and baking soda. Cream butter, sugars, vanilla. Add eggs, gradually add flour mixture then stir in chips and nuts. Batter will be stiff. Drop onto ungreased cookie sheet and bake at 375 degrees for 8-10 minutes. For chocolate lovers, use Chocolate flavored instant pudding.

title: German Chocolate Icing
directions: Cook on medium heat in saucepan until thick., Pour on cake while hot, then place in oven broiler until brown, 2 to 3 minutes.

title: Potato And Cabbage Slaw
directions: Cut potatoes in 1/2-inch cubes., Cover with water; heat to boiling., Reduce heat and simmer 10 minutes until tender., Drain and cool., Slice cabbage., Toss potatoes, cabbage and remaining ingredients., Cover and refrigerate.

title: Spaghetti Sauce
directions: Brown onion in olive oil., Brown and drain hamburger., Add remaining ingredients and simmer for 1 hour.

title: Flowerpot Dirt Cake
directions: You will need an 8 x 10-inch flowerpot.

title: Corn Casserole
directions: Mix together and bake 1/2 hour.

title: Russian Tea
directions: Mix., Put 2 to 3 teaspoons in cup; add hot water.

title: Honey Mustard Dressing(Great Christmas Gift!)
directions: Combine all ingredients in a food processor or blender., Blend until creamy., Refrigerate, covered., Will keep for weeks. Yields 2 1/2 cups.

title: Layered Salad
directions: Mix together the mayonnaise and sugar in a small bowl and set aside., Layer the first 6 items in order listed, then spread mayonnaise mixture over top, sealing edges., Sprinkle cheese and bacon bits over the top., Refrigerate and let sit overnight.

title: Italian Tortellini Soup
directions: About 45 minutes before serving time, in a Dutch oven over medium heat in hot oil, cook onion, green pepper and garlic until tender, about 5 minutes., Add tomatoes and their liquid, wine, parsley, salt, basil and oregano., Reduce heat to low; cover and simmer for 15 minutes., Increase heat to medium., Add crab and clams; cook for 10 minutes, stirring constantly., Add fillet pieces and shrimp., Continue cooking for 5 more minutes or until fish flakes easily when tested with a fork and shrimp are tender. Serve immediately in soup bowls., Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Tortellini And Spinach Tomato Soup
directions: On top of stove, combine soup and consomme; bring to a boil. Add soy sauce., Pour in egg and stir constantly for 2 minutes, until egg separates into shreds., Pour and serve.

title: Korean Chicken
directions: Combine all ingredients, except chicken. Mix the night before; let sit out to allow sugar to dissolve. Needs to be at room temperature.

title: Candied Sweet Potatoes
directions: Peel potatoes; cut in slices 3/4-inch thick., Place in baking dish (single layer is best)., Mix sugar and flour; spread over potatoes., Heat water and margarine., Add vanilla., Pour over sugar and potatoes., Bake at 350° until potatoes are tender (about 20 to 30 minutes).

title: Blueberry Delight
directions: Mix together cream cheese, powdered sugar and Cool Whip. Spread over the baked crust., Top with blueberry pie filling.

title: Lemon-Zucchini Cookies
directions: Cream butter; gradually add 3/4 cup sugar, beating well at medium speed of an electric mixer., Add egg and lemon rind, beating well., Combine flour, baking powder and salt; stir well. Add to creamed mixture, mixing well., Stir in zucchini and walnuts., Drop dough by rounded teaspoonfuls onto greased cookie sheets., Bake at 350° for 10 minutes., Remove to wire racks. Combine confectioners sugar and lemon juice; stir well., Drizzle over warm cookies; let cool completely.

title: Mother'S Lemon Pie
directions: Beat eggs well, but not to the creamy stage., Add sugar; mix well., Add grated rind and juice of lemons., Mix well and last, add real cream; mix., Pour into unbaked pie shell and bake until golden brown at 350°.

title: Mexican Corn Bread
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Place in a lightly greased, large, heavy cast-iron skillet., Bake at 400° for 30 minutes or until browned.

title: Praline Brownies
directions: Prepare brownie mix according to directions, using 1 egg method., Put in pan., Mix other ingredients and sprinkle over top of brownie mix., Bake 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Surprise Fruit Salad
directions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl. Cover and chill. Store in refrigerator.

title: Lima Bean Casserole
directions: Brown onion and pepper in margarine., Cook limas until tender; drain., Add peppers, onions and celery soup., Place in a greased casserole dish and cover with bread crumbs and cheese. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

title: Biscuits
directions: Blend dry ingredients., Cut in shortening until coarse like peas., Make a well in the center., Pour in 1/2 cup of milk; toss or mix., Add egg with rest of milk., Mix lightly with a fork. Roll or pat to 1/2 or 3/4-inch., Bake at 400° for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Grandma Bella'S Cream Cheese Pound Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Cream the butter, cheese and sugar until fluffy., Add the eggs, one at a time, beating 3 minutes for each egg., Combine dry ingredients and beat in alternately with the milk and vanilla., Pour into greased and floured tube pan lined with waxed paper., Bake for 1 hour.

title: Weight Watchers Apple Cake
directions: Beat eggs until fluffy; put bread in blender, then add apples. Fold in eggs., Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Hunky Pory Cookies
directions: Cream sugar and shortening; add eggs and vanilla., Add dry ingredients., Chill in refrigerator at least 2 hours., Roll in balls the size of walnuts., Roll in mixture of 2 tablespoons cinnamon and 2 tablespoons sugar., Bake on an ungreased cookie sheet for 10 minutes.

title: Elephant Ears
directions: Dissolve yeast in lukewarm water., Add salt, sugar, water, shortening and egg., Mix well., Stir in flour, 1/2 cup at a time until smooth. Break off pieces the size of an egg., Roll out 1/4 inch thick on floured surface., Deep-fry in shortening., When brown and crisp, remove and dust with sugar and cinnamon., Recipe makes 20.

title: Stuffed Sea Shells
directions: Cook macaroni shells until done., Stuff with mixture of cottage cheese, Mozzarella cheese, Parmesan, eggs, spinach, salt and pepper., Cover with Prego sauce., Cook at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Easy Quick Microwave Chicken Cacciatore
directions: Arrange chicken parts (or 4 breasts) in 12 x 8-inch baking dish, bone side down, thicker portions toward edges of dish., Top with 1 cup sliced fresh mushrooms., Stir 1/2 teaspoon dried basil into 2 cups of pasta sauce (onion and garlic is great) and pour over chicken., Cover with waxed paper., Microwave High for 17 minutes or until fork can be inserted in chicken with ease and juices run clear, rearranging pieces once., Serve over cooked pasta., Serves 4.

title: Cornflake Chewies
directions: Mix corn syrup and sugar in saucepan., Bring to a full boil and then add peanut butter., Remove from heat then add vanilla and cornflakes., Stir well and drop by tablespoonful onto greased wax paper.

title: Miracle Pie Crust
directions: Mix together first 5 ingredients., In a cup, mix egg, vinegar and water., Add to flour mixture., Makes 5 to 7 crusts., Can be frozen.

title: Fruit Pizza
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Bring water to boil., Mix brownie mix, water, oil and egg in large bowl., Pour into greased and floured 12-inch pizza pan., Bake for 25 minutes., Beat cream cheese, sugar, remaining egg and vanilla in small bowl at medium speed until well blended., Pour over brownies., Bake for 15 minutes., Cool., Top with fruit; drizzle with chocolate.

title: Pepper Relish
directions: Grind peppers and onions., Pour boiling water over them and let stand 2 hours., Drain and add vinegar, salt, sugar and mustard seed., Cook until tender., Jar and seal.

title: Sausage Balls
directions: Mix all ingredients well., Pinch and roll mixture into small balls., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

title: Chinese Beef And Peppers
directions: Saute beef, onion and garlic in oil until meat browns., Add rest of ingredients except rice; bring to a boil., Stir in rice. Cover; let stand 5 minutes.

title: Poppy Seed Cake
directions: Mix all together for 2 minutes., Put in two loaf pans or one angel food cake pan., Grease the pans very well and dust with a mixture of cinnamon and sugar., Bake at 350° for approximately 40 to 50 minutes, depending on the size of the pans.

title: Butter Cookies
directions: Cream sugar and shortening., Add eggs and vanilla; mix well. Mix dry ingredients; add to egg and sugar mixture., Roll in balls and press with a fork., Bake at 375° to 400° until lightly browned.

title: Cucumber And Green Onion Dip
directions: Wash and dry cucumber and onions., Chop very fine., For each package of cream cheese you use, add cucumber and green onions.

title: Sun-Drop Cake
directions: Cream sugar, margarine and shortening in mixer bowl until light and fluffy., Add flour and eggs; beat well., Add flavorings; mix well., Stir in Sun-Drop., Pour into greased and floured tube pan. Bake at 325° for 1 1/4 hours., Cool in pan for several minutes. Invert onto serving plate., Spread frosting over cake., Yield:, 16 servings.

title: Strawberry Bread
directions: Defrost strawberries., Beat eggs in a bowl until fluffy., Add cooking oil, sugar and defrosted strawberries., Sift together flour, cinnamon, soda and salt into mixing bowl., Add strawberry mixture and mix until well blended., Stir in nuts., Pour into 2 greased and floured 9 1/2 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pans., Bake in a 350° oven for 1 hour and 10 minutes or until done, then turn out of pans and cool on racks., Makes 2 loaves.

title: Watergate Jello Salad
directions: In a large bowl, add pineapple (with juice) and pudding; mix well., Add fruit cocktail and marshmallows., Fold in Cool Whip. Put in a pretty glass bowl and top with coconut, chopped nuts and cherries.

title: Baked Beans
directions: Chop onion and bell pepper very fine and cook in small amount of water in frying pan (large)., Add brown sugar, ketchup, mustard, bacon and beans., Bring mixture to boil., Pour mixture in baking pan and cook in oven at 350° for 45 minutes to one hour.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Mix hot rice, Cheez Whiz and margarine together until cheese melts. Add rest of ingredients. Put into casserole dish. Bake 20 minutes at 350° until brown.

title: Bermuda Salad
directions: Combine first 5 ingredients in a jar; shake well., Combine cauliflower, onion and olives., Marinate in dressing for 1 hour.

title: Salmon Ball
directions: Combine all but nuts and parsley., Chill., Shape into ball and roll in nuts and parsley., Chill again.

title: Chick-A-Tini
directions: In small mixing bowl, blend together soup and milk; set aside. Cook rotini according to package instructions. In large mixing bowl, combine green peppers, onion, chicken, pimiento, cheese and cooked rotini. Pour on soup mixture and mix thoroughly. Pour into 9 x 13 greased casserole. Sprinkle with bread crumbs. Bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes. Serves 7 to 9.

title: Russian Pea Salad
directions: Thaw peas; add all other ingredients., Chill overnight. Serves 6.

title: Chunky Potato Soup
directions: Peel and dice potatoes and cook until tender., Drain., Melt butter in 3-quart pot., Add carrot and onion., Cover and cook until tender., Remove from heat., Add flour and milk., Add 1/2 potatoes., Mash remaining., Add to soup with seasonings and bouillon., Heat to steaming hot.

title: Poppy Seed Chicken
directions: Cook chicken and cut into bite size pieces., Place in bottom of a 3-quart casserole dish., Combine sour cream and chicken soup; pour over chicken., Crush crackers; put over chicken and sauce. Melt butter; put over crackers., Top with poppy seed until dark; refrigerate for 24 hours., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Cranberry Bean Soup
directions: Sort and soak beans with a pinch of baking soda over night. Next day bring to a boil. Rinse and cover with water and add ham or bacon, onion, salt and pepper to taste. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer, 1 1/2 to 2 hours or until tender. Add water as needed during cooking time.

title: Squash Supreme
directions: Mix the first 4 ingredients together., Spray a loaf pan or dish with Pam., Sprinkle a layer of Pepperidge Farm herb stuffing on the bottom of the pan., Add squash mixture, then cover with another layer of Pepperidge Farm herb stuffing., Dot the top of the casserole generously with butter., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

title: Taco Delight
directions: Brown beef and onion in skillet for 5 minutes., Add salsa, tomato sauce and bouillon cube; bring to a full boil., Stir in rice; cover and remove from heat., Let stand 5 minutes and fluff with a fork.

title: Million Dollar Pie
directions: Mix well and put into 2 graham cracker pie crusts., Put in refrigerator for 3 to 4 hours before serving., This is rich and delicious.

title: Hot Fudge Sauce(This Is A "Mom" Original)
directions: Mix cocoa, sugar and salt., Add butter and milk., Bring to a boil over medium to low heat; stir constantly., When sauce thickens, remove from heat., Cool 3 to 5 minutes., Serve warm or cold., Use over ice cream, cream puffs or eclairs.

title: Cornstarch Pudding
directions: Put canned milk in a quart jar and fill up with regular milk. Use a double boiler; heat until boiling., Beat eggs and add to milk., Add sugar and cornstarch., Boil until thick, then cool. Strain., Add vanilla.

title: Crisp Potato Skins
directions: Bake potatoes at 400° for 45 minutes or until tender. Cool, then cut into quarters lengthwise. Scoop out pulp, leaving 1/8-inch shell. Reserve pulp for use in other recipes. Increase oven temperature to 500°. Combine butter and soy sauce. Brush on both sides of skins. Place on a baking sheet and bake for 10 to 12 minutes or until crisp. Top with coarse salt, sour cream, chives and/or bacon bits. Yield: 6 servings.

title: Artichoke Pasta Salad
directions: Cook pasta as directed on the box., Drain; rinse with cold water and put in a large bowl., Add olives, artichoke hearts, celery, dressing and cheese., Season with salt and pepper., Toss together., Cover and let marinate in refrigerator overnight. Makes 8 servings.

title: Cookie Kisses
directions: Beat the margarine, sugar and vanilla until light and fluffy. Add flour and mix well., Chill the dough., Shape about 1 tablespoon of dough around each chocolate kiss., Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 375° for 12 minutes., The cookie should be set but not brown., Cool slightly, then roll in confectioners sugar.

title: Beef And Biscuit Skillet
directions: In a 10-inch skillet, brown meat with onion; drain off fat. Stir in gravy and 1/2 cup water., Add 1/2 teaspoon salt and frozen vegetables, breaking apart with fork., Bring to boiling., Cover; reduce heat., Simmer 10 minutes., Top with biscuits; simmer, covered, 15 minutes., Sprinkle biscuits with cheese; heat until cheese melts., Sprinkle with paprika, if desired., Serves 4.

title: Gooey Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Grease oblong pan., Mix egg, butter and cake mix together., Pat into pan., Pat flat; do not leave raised edges.

title: Southern Stew
directions: On rack in broiling pan broil steak for 5 minutes on each side; cut into 2- inch pieces and set aside.

title: Whipping Cream Cake
directions: Cream butter and sugar; add eggs, one at a time, and stir until mixed well., Add flour and stir until well blended., Add flavoring., Stir in whipping cream., Bake in a Bundt pan at 375° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Steak Sauce
directions: Combine all ingredients in a 3-quart saucepan. Bring to a boil over medium heat. Reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, for 30 minutes. Strain if desired. Cover and refrigerate.

title: Tuna Casserole
directions: Combine peas, tuna fish, corn, pimentos and cream of mushroom soup in casserole., Top with shoestring potatoes., Bake.

title: Dedication Chicken Spaghetti
directions: Reserve stock., Debone chicken and cut in bite size pieces. Cook spaghetti in reserved stock; drain to just below top of spaghetti., Saute onion, celery and bell pepper in margarine until tender., Add cheese to hot spaghetti; stir until melted., Add all other ingredients together and season with garlic salt., Stir together well., Bake in oblong dish or pan at 350° for 30 minutes. Sprinkle parsley flakes on top., Serves approximately 12 to 15 people.

title: Mom'S Tomato Soup Cake
directions: Mix baking soda and soup in a bowl; set aside. Cream sugar and Crisco. Add eggs and soup mix; mix well. Sift together dry ingredients; mix all together. Bake in 9 x 9 or 8 x 9 greased and floured pan at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Pineapple Cheese Ball
directions: Mix well and form into ball.

title: Star Cookies
directions: Mix all together and put in icebox overnight., When chilled, roll them and cut in star shape., Bake at 350°.

title: Goblin Cookies
directions: Mix first 6 ingredients together; stir in 1 cup of any dry cereal., Drop by teaspoonfuls onto a piece of waxed paper., Put a jelly bean in center of each and refrigerate until firm., Makes 12 cookies.

title: Mushroom Soup
directions: Mix well., Use more water if needed for thinning., Serve over Swedish meatballs.

title: Cheese Fish Bake
directions: Arrange fish in a greased 10 x 6 x 2-inch baking dish., Pour soup over fish., Sprinkle with pepper, cheese and paprika., Bake at 375° for 45 minutes or until lightly browned., Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: German Chocolate Cheesecake
directions: Press evenly into ungreased pan first 3 ingredients., Bake at 350° for 10 minutes., Beat cream cheese in 3-quart bowl., Add sugar and cocoa gradually., Beat in eggs, one at a time., Pour in vanilla., Pour into spring-form pan., Bake at 300° until center is firm, about 1 hour., Cover and refrigerate for 3 hours., Prepare topping., Spread over cake; loosen sides and remove.

title: German Chocolate Upside-Down Cake
directions: Layer the bottom of 9 x 13-inch cake pan with the pecans and coconut., Pan must be buttered., Mix cake mix as directed on box and pour over pecans and coconut in pan., Mix cream cheese, oleo and sugar together and pour over cake mix., Bake 40 to 50 minutes at 350°.

title: Potato Cheese Puffs
directions: Combine all ingredients except for oil; mix well., Pour about 2 inches of oil into frying pan; get oil hot but not smoking, or use Fry Daddy., Drop batter by tablespoons, 4 to 5 at a time, into hot oil., Fry 3 to 4 minutes or until golden brown., Serve immediately., Makes about 24 puffs.

title: Pumpkin Cake Roll
directions: Beat eggs on high speed for 5 minutes., Gradually beat in sugar., Stir in pumpkin and lemon juice., Stir together flour, salt, spices and baking powder., Add to pumpkin mixture., Spread into greased and floured cookie sheet., Top with nuts., Bake at 375° for 15 minutes., Turn out on towel sprinkled with powdered sugar., Roll towel and cake together., Cool for 1 hour.

title: Merry Cherry Chocolate Cake
directions: You will also need artificial holly leaves or other garnish.

title: Green Mountain Gingersnaps
directions: Cream shortening in bowl., Add sugar, molasses and egg., Mix thoroughly., Sift remaining ingredients together., Stir into creamed mixture., Roll into small balls; dip in additional sugar. Place 2-inches apart on greased cookie sheet., Bake at 375° (preheated) for 10 minutes., They will still be soft when you take them out., They firm as they cool., Makes about 5 dozen.

title: Salad Dressing For Green Vegetables
directions: Combine all ingredients and mix well., Use as a dressing for vegetables.

title: Buckeyes
directions: Add water to heavy skillet and immediately add brown sugar also., Stir continuously over medium heat., Bring mixture to a rapid boil until it reaches the soft ball stage (120° to 238° on a candy thermometer)., Take off heat., Stir in pecans until well coated., Sprinkle cinnamon., Keep stirring until they cool and dry.

title: Prune Spice Cake
directions: Cream the shortening and sugar., Add eggs., Sift flour, baking powder, salt and spice, then blend into creamed mixture alternately with liquids., Pour prunes into two 8-inch pans that have been greased and floured., Bake for 30 to 35 minutes at 350°. Cool completely; frost if desired.

title: Cream Cheese Coffeecake
directions: Cut cream cheese into 20 pieces., Mash biscuits into 3 1/2 inch circle., Place a piece of cream cheese on each biscuit., Mix cinnamon and sugar., Place 1 teaspoon of sugar mixture on each biscuit., Roll biscuits into balls., Melt butter and pour into Bundt pan., Then pour in 1/2 of the nuts into pan., Then pour 3/4 of what sugar mixture you have left into Bundt pan., Then put your 20 biscuit balls into the Bundt pan., Then pour what sugar mixture and nuts you have left over biscuits., Bake 35 minutes at 350°. Remove from oven., Turn onto plate., Let pan remain a few minutes before removing., Glaze while hot.

title: Chicken Rice Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients., Bake in covered casserole at 350° until hot and bubbly.

title: Chocolate Fudge
directions: Combine sugar, milk and margarine in pot; boil for 5 minutes, stirring constantly., Remove from heat; add remaining ingredients. Stir until chips and marshmallows are melted., Pour into a well buttered pan; let cool in refrigerator for 2 hours., Cut into 1 inch squares.

title: Blueberry Trifle With Lemon Curd
directions: Combine the yolks, lemon juice and sugar in the top of a double boiler., Cook over simmering water until sugar is dissolved., Add butter; continue to simmer until mixture thickens. Pour in a clean bowl., Chill.

title: Chocolate Syrup
directions: Combine cocoa, sugar and salt in medium saucepan. Stir in water and mix until smooth. Bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring constantly. Cook for 3 minutes. Remove from heat and add vanilla. Pour into container and refrigerate. Use to pour over ice cream or put 2 tablespoons of syrup in an 8-ounce glass of cold or hot milk.

title: Strawberry Pie
directions: Cook water, sugar and cornstarch until thick and clear, about 2 minutes., Add Jell-O (after removed from heat)., Pour over sliced berries in baked pie shell.

title: Monster Cookies
directions: Mix in order. Drop by ice cream dipper. Flatten with fork. Bake 12 minutes at 350°.

title: Mimaw'S Butterscotch Squares
directions: In large saucepan, melt butter., Remove from heat., Add brown sugar and mix well., Add remaining ingredients and mix well., Pour into 8-inch square greased pan. Bake 25 minutes at 350°.

title: Cheesy Green Beans
directions: Cook bacon until crisp., Drain bacon, reserving 1/4 cup drippings., Crumble bacon; reserve 2 tablespoons., Microwave beans as directed on package; drain well., Add mushrooms and onion to reserved 1/4 cup drippings in skillet., Cook and stir on medium-high heat 10 minutes; drain., Add bacon, hot cooked green beans and pepper; mix lightly., Spoon into 2-quart serving dish. Microwave process cheese spread as directed on label., Pour over green bean mixture., Sprinkle with reserved 2 tablespoons crumbled bacon., Makes 10 servings.

title: Coralie'S Blue Cheese Dip
directions: Put all ingredients in blender and mix until fluffy.

title: Raisin Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Drop by spoonful on cookie sheet., Bake at 375°.

title: Salad Dressing
directions: Cook all ingredients on low heat., Stir constantly to prevent sticking until thickened., Remove from stove., Add lump of butter. Cool; ready for use.

title: Nut Fingers
directions: Cream butter. Add sugar and other ingredients in order given. When thoroughly mixed, mold and shape into fingers about the size of pecans. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes or until lightly browned. Roll in powdered sugar when cool. Be sure to mix pecans in by hand. Makes about 7 dozen.

title: Cucumbers With Sesame Seeds
directions: Sprinkle salt over cucumbers and let stand about 15 minutes. Squeeze water from slices and combine with remaining ingredients. Chill.

title: Dean'S Perfect Divinity
directions: Bring to a boil and boil, covered, 2 minutes., Uncover and cook to a soft ball stage., While cooking, beat 2 egg whites until stiff, but not dry., Pour the syrup over the beaten egg whites slowly., Beat with electric mixer until thick, almost stands in peaks., Quickly add 2 cups pecans and 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla. Drop on wax paper.

title: Zucchini Bread
directions: Sift flour, baking soda, salt, baking powder and cinnamon. Combine eggs, oil, sugar, zucchini and vanilla in large mixing bowl., Beat until well mixed., Stir in flour mixture until smooth. Stir in raisins and nuts., Pour mixture into greased 13 x 9-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes or until center springs back., Cool on wire rack.

title: Banana Bread
directions: Cream the butter and sugar together. Add banana and egg., Sift dry ingredients together and add to mixture., Add vanilla and mix well., Pour into buttered loaf pan and bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Sweet And Sour Meatballs
directions: Mix ground beef, egg, seasonings and bread crumbs with 1/3 can of tomato sauce., Add more sauce and/or breadcrumbs until mixture is moist and well mixed., Place remaining tomato sauce in medium saucepan with sugar and lemon juice., Mix and place over medium-high heat.

title: Apple Cake
directions: Cut butter into dry ingredients., Add egg., Pat into bottom and sides of 8 x 8-inch or 9 x 9-inch pan., Peel, core and slice apples (quantity as necessary) and line up in pan.

title: Quick And Easy Pizza Burgers
directions: Brown hamburger; drain off fat., Add pepperoni and pizza sauce., Mix well and simmer 5 minutes., Add cheese just before serving., Spoon onto bun and enjoy.

title: Hot Stuff
directions: Grind together peppers, garlic and onion. Put in crock pan (not aluminum). Add salt and add just enough water to cover. Let set 2 hours and drain. Add oil, vinegar and water. Cook 30 minutes. Seal in hot jars. Makes 12 pints.

title: Rice Pilaf
directions: Melt butter and add chopped onion, oregano, salt and rice. Stir all the ingredients listed and simmer 10 minutes (can use iron skillet or Teflon)., Turn into large casserole and add beef consomme and water., Add drained mushrooms; bake, covered at 400° for 1 hour.

title: Pumpkin Stew
directions: Cook ingredients all together in a pot for 10 minutes., Then pour into a medium pumpkin which has been cleaned out., Replace the top., Put pumpkin in a sturdy baking pan and bake at 350° for approximately 45 minutes, until pumpkin turns brown., Remove the top and ladle out the stew.

title: Shrimp Pie
directions: Saute the shrimp with the butter and seasonings for 1 minute. Add the vermouth and boil for 1/2 minute., Strew shrimp in pie shell., Make custard with eggs and milk or cream., Pour in custard to within 1/8-inch of rim; sprinkle on cheese., Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 375° or until puffed and browned.

title: Eggs Belmar
directions: Add flour to 1/4 cup melted butter in saucepan., Stir until smooth; cook 1 minute and gradually add milk., Cook, stirring constantly, until thickened., Add salt and pepper and set aside. Saute bacon and next 3 ingredients in 3 tablespoons butter until vegetables are crisp-tender., Drain., Cook eggs in 1 tablespoon butter without stirring until beginning to set on bottom., Draw spatula across to form large curds., Continue until cooked, but moist., Stir in bacon mixture and white sauce., Place in greased 13 x 9-inch baking dish (glass)., Combine 2 tablespoons butter and bread crumbs to egg mixture., Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes., Make ahead up to 24 hours and refrigerate., Let stand at room temperature 30 minutes before baking., Leftovers reheat well.

title: Hush Puppies
directions: Mix dry ingredients., Add onion, egg and milk; mix well., Drop by spoonful into deep fry; fry until golden brown., Drain on paper towels.

title: Lemon Pie(Old Family Recipe)
directions: Mix flour and sugar together., Beat egg yolks., Mix all together and cook over boiling water until thick., Put in baked pie shell.

title: Blanche'S Peach (Cake) Cobbler
directions: Pour peaches and juice into, an 11 x 14-inch pan, which has been greased., Pour, dry, cake, mix, over, peaches., Melt margarine and pour over mixture., Bake, in 325° oven 1 hour or until brown on top.

title: Oatmeal Raisin Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., Cream shortening and sugar., Add spices and, dry, ingredients., Drop, by spoonful onto greased baking sheet., Bake for 8 to 10 minutes., Cool on rack., Store in refrigerator., Each cookie contains 55 calories.

title: Caramel Sheet Cake
directions: Mix according to directions on box., Prepare a 13 x 9-inch and a small square pan by greasing pans and sprinkling with powdered sugar., Bake according to box directions., Cool in pans and spread frosting on tops.

title: Banana Split Pudding
directions: To reserved pineapple liquid add enough water to make 1 1/2 cups., In large bowl combine Eagle Brand milk., Add pudding mix and beat well., Add pineapple., Chill 10 minutes., Fold in whipped cream., Spoon 1 1/2 cups pudding into 3 to 4-quart glass serving bowl., Top with 1/3 each of chocolate wafers, banana and pudding. Repeat layering twice, ending with pudding., Chill thoroughly.

title: Cream Cheese Pastry
directions: Cream first 4 ingredients together., Butter or Pam spray 9 x 13-inch pan., Layer 1 package rolls, filling, 1 package rolls and cinnamon-sugar topping., Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Granddad Bill'S T Cakes
directions: Mix all ingredients well and drop by teaspoonfuls on lightly greased cookie sheets., Bake at 300°.

title: Corn Fritters
directions: Sift flour, salt and baking powder into bowl., Beat eggs with milk; add melted Crisco and whole kernel corn and combine the two mixtures lightly., Drop from a teaspoon into deep Crisco heated to 365° (or when an inch cube of bread browns in 60 seconds)., Fry until brown and cooked in center (about 4 to 5 minutes)., Drain on absorbent paper.

title: Goldline Chili
directions: If you like it sweet, add a Hershey chocolate bar to taste.

title: Grammy'S Brownies
directions: Cream margarine and sugar., Add eggs and vanilla., Beat well. Add melted chocolate., Then add flour., Pour into four 8-inch pans., Bake at 325° for 35 minutes.

title: Baked Oatmeal
directions: Cook oats in water with salt for 5 minutes., Beat egg whites until stiff., Mix oats, egg yolks, melted butter, honey and raisins., Fold in egg whites., Pour into well-greased 8-inch pan and cook at 400° for 15 minutes or until set in the middle and light brown., Recipe may be doubled.

title: German Potato Salad
directions: Boil potatoes; skin and slice into pieces., Fry bacon; drain off all fat., Sprinkle flour over bacon; mix it up., Pour vinegar, sugar and water over bacon., Simmer until thick., Pour over potatoes; mix well., Serve warm.

title: Baked Beans
directions: Combine all except bacon., Pour into a greased 2 quart casserole dish., Bake uncovered at 350° for 55 minutes., Sprinkle top with crumbled bacon., Bake another 5 minutes., Serves 8.

title: One Bowl Holiday Fudge(Microwave)
directions: Microwave chocolate and milk in 1 1/2-quart microwavable bowl on High 2 minutes, stirring after 1 minute., Stir until chocolate is completely melted and smooth., Stir in vanilla, salt and nuts. Spread in greased 8 x 4-inch or 9 x 5-inch loaf pan., Refrigerate until firm, about 2 hours., Makes about 2 dozen pieces.

title: Old Fashioned Stickies
directions: Combine flour, baking soda, baking powder and salt., Cut in shortening., Mix well., Add milk., Mix well., Roll out thin. Spread softened margarine over dough., Sprinkle sugar over margarine., Roll up jelly roll fashion., Slice into 1-inch pieces. Place in pan and cook at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes or until brown.

title: Homemade Oreo Ice Cream
directions: Use only Grade A clean, uncracked eggs.

title: Baked Chicken Reuben
directions: Place chicken in a nonstick baking pan., Sprinkle with salt and pepper., Cover chicken with sauerkraut., Pour dressing evenly over all and top with Swiss cheese., Cover with foil and bake at 325° for about 1 hour or until fork can be inserted in chicken easily., Sprinkle with chopped parsley to serve., Makes 4 servings.

title: Sweet And Sour Cabbage(Rodkaal)
directions: Melt fat in pan., Add remaining ingredients in layers and cook until very tender., If too dry, add water., Garnish with apple slices.

title: Hot Salsa
directions: Simmer ingredients until vegetables are well cooked. Then can as you would tomatoes.

title: Red Beans And Rice
directions: Saute onion, bell pepper and sausage in a large skillet., Add beans and tomato sauce., Cook on low, until it thickens, for about 45 minutes., Serve with your favorite rice and cornbread, cooked according to package directions.

title: Cheese Grits
directions: Add grits slowly to boiling water and salt., Cook while stirring till thick., Remove from heat, add butter and cheese sliced in pieces and stir into grits., Cool slightly and add egg-milk mixture., Pour in casserole dish., Bake at 350° for 45 mins. to 1 hr. till firm.

title: Banana Split Ice Cream
directions: Mix all ingredients except chocolate milk., Add milk., Pour into 4-quart ice cream freezer bucket and freeze according to manufacturer's instructions., Let harden 1 hour before serving. Yields 1 gallon.

title: Pumpkin Bread
directions: Mix dry ingredients in a large bowl. Add rest of ingredients. Mix well with blender., Pour batter into two greased and lightly floured loaf pans. Bake 40 to 45 minutes at 350°., May bake muffins instead., Bake approximately 12 to 15 minutes. Raisins and nuts are optional.

title: Buttermilk Rolls
directions: Dissolve yeast in lukewarm water., Heat buttermilk to lukewarm., Add the salt, shortening and sugar to the buttermilk. Add the dissolved yeast, a cup of the flour with the soda and the egg., Beat vigorously., Beat and fold in the remaining flour until a soft dough., Fold lightly (about 5 minutes)., Place in a clean lightly greased bowl., Cover and let rise 45 minutes to 1 hour until double in bulk., Shape into desired rolls., Bake in a 350° to 375° oven for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Broccoli Rice Casserole
directions: Cook rice; drain., Cook broccoli and drain., Mix together. Add Velveeta cheese and soups., Put in greased casserole dish and top with shredded cheese., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Wassail
directions: Mix Burgundy, cider and spices to taste., Heat before serving. Float orange slices in wassail.

title: Macaroni Salad
directions: Combine eggs, celery, green pepper, pickles and chilled macaroni., Blend mayonnaise, buttermilk and mustard., Fold into macaroni mixture., Season with salt and pepper.

title: Chuck Wagon Western Bean Casserole
directions: Combine meat, onion and pepper in skillet and brown; drain off grease., Add other ingredients., Put in a covered 1 1/2-quart casserole dish., Bake at 350° for 40 minutes., This is a delicious meal with bread and a salad!, So easy!

title: Brittany'S Favorite Pickles
directions: Peel and thinly slice cucumbers., Slice onion into thin rings. Mix all ingredients., Store in airtight container in refrigerator for up to 24 hours., Stir occasionally.

title: Seafood Etouffee
directions: Saute butter, onion and celery until wilted., Add tomato sauce, soup and water., Cook 20 minutes., Add shrimp, crab meat and/or scallops., Cook an additional 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Imagination Cookies
directions: Mix first 4 ingredients and beat to soft peaks., Gradually add sugar and cocoa., Beat to stiff peaks., Make 10 big round cookie "shells" on a cookie sheet using the egg white mixture., Bake at 250° for 40 minutes., Cool., Spread 1 tablespoon Dream Whip on each cookie., Mix rest of Dream Whip with fudge and cream cheese. Spread 2 1/2 tablespoons of chocolate mixture on each cookie. Refrigerate.

title: Nancy'S Chili
directions: In frying pan, cook sausage well and drain off excess fat; set aside. Brown ground beef in frying pan and drain off excess fat; set aside. Brown onions in olive oil in large heavy pot. Add cooked sausage, ground beef and remainder of ingredients except green pepper. Stir well and simmer covered for 45 minutes. Add chopped green pepper and simmer 15 minutes longer.

title: Holiday Yam Bake
directions: Take 1 large ball field, half a dozen children, 2 or 3 small dogs, a pinch of brook and some pebbles., Mix the children and dogs well together; put them on the field, stirring constantly. Pour the brook over the pebbles, sprinkle the field with flowers, spread over all a deep blue sky and bake in the sun., When brown, set away to cool in the bath tub.

title: American Chop Suey
