directions: Saute onion in olive oil., Add hamburg and cook until done. Skim 3/4 of fat from pan., Add tomatoes., Mix together and add to drained macaroni.

title: Hearty Tuna Casserole
directions: Drain tuna., Cook noodles according to directions., Drain and rinse in hot water., Combine noodles with tuna, celery and onions. Blend in sour cream, mustard, mayonnaise, thyme and salt., Spoon half mixture into buttered casserole., Top with half zucchini. Repeat layers., Top with cheese., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Sprinkle with chopped tomato.

title: Deep Dish Peach Pie
directions: Combine peaches, lemon juice, almond extract, sugar and salt. Mix together thoroughly and let stand while rolling pastry.

title: Baked Corn
directions: Spray microwave dish with Pam., Combine all ingredients and stir to mix egg and flour into mixture., Microwave on High for 3 minutes., Remove and stir., Microwave on High again for 3 minutes. Ready to serve.

title: Rice Krispies Cookies
directions: Cream shortening and brown sugar first; then add white sugar and cream together., Add eggs and vanilla., Sift dry ingredients together and add to mixture., Add oats and coconut., Fold in Rice Krispies last, so as not to break them.

title: Dressing For Fresh Fruit
directions: Beat all above together at medium speed., Constantly continue beating while gradually adding 1/4 cup salad oil., Cover and chill., If it becomes too thick, let stand at room temperature. Use over fresh fruit and walnuts.

title: Easy Fruit Cobbler(Mrs. W. A. Broadway)
directions: Melt margarine in bottom of casserole dish., Mix flour, sugar and milk., Pour this mixture over margarine in dish and top with peaches., Bake at 350° until brown., You may substitute any fruit you wish to use and also add cinnamon or other spices.

title: Cottage Cheese Dip
directions: In a large bowl, mix garlic salt, green onion dip mix, Miracle Whip, seasoned salt, salt, pepper and milk., Add cottage cheese. Stir., Let set at least 12 hours., Serve with chips of your choice.

title: Molasses Apple Pan Dowdy
directions: Pare, core and slice apples in wedges into a buttered baking dish 8x13x2. Add water and cook in oven a few minutes until soft. In a saucepan mix molasses, sugar, cornstarch, mace and salt. Boil together thoroughly blended.

title: Sausage Balls
directions: Let sausage and cheese get to room temperature., Mix all ingredients well., Make into balls the size of a quarter., Bake at 375° for approximately 15 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Grandmother'S Cherry Cobbler
directions: Sift flour, baking powder and salt., Cream butter and 1/2 cup sugar until fluffy., Add dry ingredients alternately with milk and beating until smooth., Pour batter into greased baking dish and put fruit on top., Sprinkle 1/2 cup sugar on top., Pour on juice over all., Bake at 375° for 45 minutes.

title: Tomato Pie
directions: Mix Bisquick with enough milk to form a soft dough., Press dough into pie plate., Slice tomatoes and arrange on dough. Season with salt, pepper and garlic salt., Mix mayonnaise and cheese and spread over tomatoes., Bake at 350° for about 45 minutes.

title: Bean Soup
directions: Soak beans overnight., Drain and add fresh water, cook slowly with ham bone for 2 hours., Put in onions, potatoes, celery, tomato sauce, parsley and seasoning., Cook slowly until vegetables are soft., Remove ham bone., Trim off any meat and cut in small pieces to add to the soup.

title: Lemon Squares
directions: Combine 1 cup flour and 1/4 cup powdered sugar., Cut in butter with pastry blender until mixture resembles coarse meal., Press into a 9-inch square pan., Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.

title: Oven-Fried Chicken
directions: Cut chicken into serving pieces., Combine buttermilk and onion., Sift flour with salt, pepper, paprika and thyme., Melt the butter in a baking pan., Brush each piece of chicken with the buttermilk mixture, then sprinkle with the seasoned mix., Place pieces skin down in the baking pan., Bake in oven at 375° for 30 minutes., Turn each piece and bake 30 minutes longer or until very tender.

title: Mashed Potato Casserole(Serves 6 To 8)
directions: Cook and mash potatoes., Add sour cream, salt, pepper, margarine and milk., Beat until fluffy., Add dill weed or seed, chives and broccoli., Place in greased casserole and top with cheese., Bake at 400° for 20 to 30 minutes., Can be made a day or two ahead and refrigerated.

title: Marinated Mushrooms
directions: Mix all ingredients in a deep dish or jar so liquid will cover mushrooms., Chill overnight., Drain and serve.

title: Kahlua Cake
directions: Combine cake mix, pudding, sour cream, eggs, oil and Kahlua until well blended., Pour into greased Bundt pan., Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until done.

title: Tea Cakes
directions: Soften margarine. Add all other ingredients and let the dough sit in the freezer for about 30 minutes., Pinch off pieces of dough and dip into flour., Roll into a ball with hands and flatten out on a cookie sheet. Bake at 350° for about 10 minutes or until edges start turning brown.

title: Chicken Dijon
directions: Combine all ingredients except cream and allow to marinate for 1 to 2 hours., Preheat oven to 350°., Bake, basting occasionally, about 30 minutes or until chicken is done., Remove baking dish from the oven and place chicken on a warm platter., Skim off fat from the cooking juices and set the baking dish over medium heat., Add cream., Simmer 5 to 10 minutes., Spoon sauce over chicken and serve., Serves 4 to 6.

title: Bleu Cheese Dressing
directions: Combine sour cream, dry mustard, black pepper, salt, garlic powder and Worcestershire sauce., Mix at low speed for 2 minutes. Add mayonnaise and blend 1/2 minute at low speed, then 2 minutes at medium speed., Add crumbled Bleu cheese and beat at low speed for 3 minutes., Store in refrigerator for 24 hours before using.

title: Persimmon Pudding
directions: Melt margarine in 9 x 13 x 2-inch cake pan., Mix pulp, eggs and sugar together; alternate milk and dry ingredients., Pour melted margarine from pan into mixture., Mix well., Pour mixture into pan., Bake 1 hour at 300° to 325°., Top with Cool Whip.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
directions: Beat eggs;, add, sugar, oil and flour; add cinnamon and vanilla., Mix, apples and nuts; stir until mixed., Pour into a greased tube pan and bake 50 minutes at 375°.

title: Three Fruit Punch
directions: Blend 3 fruits in blender., Add ginger ale right before serving.

title: Fresh Peach Chiffon Pie
directions: Add sugar to peaches; let stand 30 minutes., Soften gelatin in cold water, dissolve in hot water and cool., Add peach mixture, lemon juice and salt., Chill until partially set., Fold in whipped cream., Pour into pie shell (graham cracker); chill thoroughly.

title: Banana Slush Punch
directions: Dissolve sugar in hot water., Add pineapple juice, orange juice, lemonade and blended bananas., Freeze mixture in 3 large containers., Take out of freezer 2 hours before serving., For each container of punch mixture, add 1 cold bottle ginger ale or lemon-lime soda, serve while slushy.

title: Salad Dressing
directions: Combine and beat well with rotary beater.

title: Corn Pudding
directions: Add corn to well beaten eggs., Add melted margarine and remainder of ingredients; mix thoroughly and pour into a greased 1 1/2-quart casserole., Bake in a moderate 350° oven until firm and brown, about 35 minutes.

title: Beriox
directions: Brown meat in a large skillet or Dutch oven., Chop onion and brown., Add salt, pepper and spice. Then add chopped cabbage and flour. Stir about 2 minutes

title: Pea Salad
directions: Mix all together., This is really good with turkey or ham.

title: Apricot Casserole
directions: Place apricots in baking dish, cut sides up., Crumble crackers over top., Sprinkle with sugars and drizzle butter over all., Heat at 350° for 20 minutes.

title: Apple Delight
directions: Blend sugar, flour, soda, salt and spices., Add oil and eggs. Stir in nuts and apple pie filling., Blend by hand., Bake for 1 hour at 350° in a Bundt pan.

title: Bill'S Fruit Dip
directions: Blend together., For more cheese taste, add more cheese. Serve with fruit.

title: Easy Oven Roast
directions: Place roast on heavy-duty aluminum foil; brush with steak sauce and sprinkle with onion soup mix., Spoon mushroom soup on top., Wrap loosely with foil., Place in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 2 hours.

title: Blueberry Salad
directions: Mix all of the ingredients. Let congeal.

title: Quick Pinwheel Coffee Cake
directions: Separate rolls and spread each with butter., Sprinkle mixture of sugar and cinnamon on rolls., Roll up as directed on can. Arrange in a circle on a lightly greased cookie sheet., Arrange remaining rolls on top., Bake 15 minutes at 375°., (Cover tips with foil so as to brown evenly.), Spoon jelly, preserves or relish in center of rolls, letting some run between rolls. Combine confectioners sugar and milk; drizzle mixture over the rolls., Serve warm.

title: Rave Reviews Coconut Cake
directions: Blend cake mix, pudding mix, water, eggs and oil in a large mixing bowl., Beat at medium speed of electric mixer for 4 minutes., Stir in coconut and nuts., Pour into 3 greased and floured 9-inch layer pans., Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

title: Vanilla Rice Pudding
directions: Gradually stir milk and egg into pudding mix in saucepan., Add rice and raisins., Stir over medium heat until mixture just comes to a boil., Cool 5 minutes, stirring twice., Pour into dessert dishes or serving bowl., Sprinkle with cinnamon and nutmeg., Place plastic wrap on surface while cooling.

title: Texas Cheese Dip
directions: Cook hamburger meat until brown. Drain well and set aside. Saute onion in butter. Dice cheese and add to mixture. Add rotel, hamburger meat and jal. Mix well and serve.

title: Miniature Hot Reuben Sandwiches
directions: Cut the corned beef and cheese into pieces to fit on the bread. Lightly butter 1 slice of bread; top with 2 slices of corned beef, 1 slice cheese, 1 teaspoon sauerkraut and 1/4 teaspoon mustard. Top with another slice of bread and bake in a preheated 400° oven for 10 minutes. Makes about 18 sandwiches.

title: Boiled Shrimp
directions: Wash shrimp; place in boiling salt water., Cover and return to a boil., Simmer 3 minutes and drain., Peel shrimp, removing veins. Refrigerate and serve with cocktail sauce as an appetizer, or use in any recipe that calls for cooked shrimp., Yields 1 1/2 pounds or about 4 cups, cooked.

title: Diabetic Salad Dressing(Diabetic Recipe)
directions: Mix low-fat yogurt and lemon juice or relish together., Add Equal to taste; mix well.

title: Snickerdoodles
directions: Mix shortening, 1 1/2 cups sugar and eggs., Blend in flour, tartar, soda and salt. Shape dough into 1 inch balls., Roll in mixture of 2 tablespoons of sugar and cinnamon., Place on ungreased baking sheet.

title: Grilled Garlic Toast Bruschetta
directions: Slice baguette in 1/4-inch slices., Combine all ingredients, mixing well., Using a flat knife, spread mixture thickly on slice baguette., Arrange on waxed paper covered tray (no spacing necessary; close together is fine)., Place in a 400° preheated oven for 8 minutes or until lightly browned., Allow to cool on the tray, then transfer to a plate., These are great the day before needed or the day you intent to serve them., If made the day before a double batch may be necessary., Family and friends may want to sample them before you make it to the table! Check after 5 minutes., Cooking times may vary depending upon your oven.

title: Sausage Corn Casserole
directions: Cook sausage; drain off fat., Combine sausage with remaining ingredients., Pour into greased 1 1/2-quart casserole., Place in pan of hot water., Bake at 350° for 1 hour, or until set.

title: Sour Cream Dip
directions: Mix ingredients together., Season to taste with salt and pepper., Chill overnight., Serve with raw vegetables.

title: Sunshine Bars
directions: Combine sugar, oil and sweet potatoes. Add eggs, water and vanilla; blend. Sift dry ingredients and add mix only until blended. Do not overmix. Pour into greased pan. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes. Cool and ice with powdered sugar.

title: Spiced Tea
directions: Mix together., Adjust mixture to your taste., To use, add 2 teaspoons of mixture to 6 ounces hot water.

title: Lasagna
directions: Brown ground beef, add next 6 ingredients., Simmer, uncovered, until thick, 30 to 45 minutes, stirring occasionally., Cook noodles, drain and rinse in hot water., Combine cottage cheese mixture (cottage cheese, parsley flakes, Parmesan cheese, beaten eggs and salt and pepper)., Place half noodles in a 13 x 9-inch baking dish., Spread half of cottage cheese mixture over noodles. Add half Mozzarella cheese and then half of the meat mixture. Repeat layers., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Sourdough Bread
directions: Add yeast to 1 cup warm water; combine and refrigerate 3 to 5 days (covered jar).

title: Ambrosia
directions: Sprinkle sliced bananas with lemon juice to prevent them from turning black., Combine oranges and mix walnuts, coconut and cherries; add sugar and mix gently., Serves 8 to 10.

title: Pecan Pie
directions: In large bowl, stir eggs, corn syrup, sugar, butter and vanilla until well blended., Stir in nuts., Pour into pie crust and bake at 350° for 50 to 55 minutes or until knife inserted halfway between center and edge comes out clean., Cool.

title: Chicken Yakitori(Skewered Grilled Chicken)
directions: You will need 20 to 30 fine metal or bamboo skewers, about 5-inches long.

title: Baked Chicken Salad
directions: Mix potato chips and cheese in bowl., Combine half the cheese mixture with next 9 ingredients, mixing well., Spoon into shallow 1 1/2-quart baking dish., Arrange egg slices on top., Sprinkle with remaining cheese mixture., Chill for several hours., Bake at 400° for 25 minutes or until heated through., Makes 8 to 9 servings.

title: Aunt Sylvia'S Mustard Sauce
directions: Whisk all ingredients together except butter., Heat butter and add mixture to pan., Simmer 5 to 10 minutes until thick., You can not substitute margarine as it will separate later., This sauce is great for any meats., If you want a good mustard barbecue sauce, add 1 to 2 tablespoons of Matouk's hot sauce after it cools down and mix in.

title: Pineapple Casserole
directions: Layer pineapple in a 2-quart casserole dish., Mix together the sugar and flour., Sprinkle on top of the pineapple., Layer the cheese and Ritz crackers., Top with melted butter. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Strawberry Bread
directions: Combine dry ingredients., Add eggs and oil., Add strawberries and pecans., Mix in lightly; do not beat., Spoon batter into loaf pans., Makes 3 medium loaves or 5 small ones., Bake at 350° for about 1 hour.

title: Meat Casserole
directions: Mix the onion, celery, green pepper and meat with mayonnaise. Beat eggs and milk together., Arrange bread in bottom of pan., Top with meat mixture and rest of bread., Let stand all night., Bake 20 minutes at 350°., Remove., Top with 1 1/2 cups cheese and 1 can cream of mushroom soup., Bake 1/2 hour.

title: Frosties(Rum Balls)
directions: Melt the chocolate chips., Combine the melted chips, corn syrup, coffee and rum flavoring., Add the wafers, nuts and 6 cups of powdered sugar to the chocolate mixture., Form into balls. Roll into remaining powdered sugar., Refrigerate.

title: Hungarian Pork Chops
directions: Sprinkle chops lightly with salt and pepper; flour on both sides., Brown in a heavy skillet; then arrange a layer of kraut, then a layer of potatoes with a layer of kraut on top., Sprinkle with paprika and brown sugar., Pour tomatoes over top., Cover and cook slowly on top of stove for 40 to 45 minutes or until chops are very tender.

title: Lemon Ice Cream
directions: Mix lemon juice, sugar and milnot together and fill freezer can with milk. Makes 6 quarts.

title: Corn Salad
directions: Stir all ingredients together, chill; serve.

title: Marinated Shrimp Kabobs
directions: Peel and devein shrimp; set aside., Drain pineapple chunks, reserving 1/4 cup juice., Set pineapple aside.

title: Raisin Tarts
directions: Cover raisins with water. Bring to a boil; drain., Stir in egg, brown sugar and salt., Mixture is ready to put into unbaked tart shells., Bake at 450° for 15 minutes (small tarts bake 10 minutes).

title: Pineapple Sheet Cake
directions: Mix cake mix with eggs., Add oil, milk and flour, then add pineapple., Bake at 350° for 35 minutes in a greased and floured sheet pan., Pour pineapple juice over cake while still hot.

title: Pecan Puffs
directions: Whip together pecans, cheese, steak sauce, bacon and mayonnaise until thoroughly blended., Spread on crackers., Broil 3 to 4 inches from heat until lightly puffed., Serve hot.

title: Pea-Peanut Salad
directions: Cook peas according to directions., Cool., Measure and add equal amount of peanuts., Mix thoroughly with sour cream and salad dressing., Chill before serving.

title: Shrimp Rangoon
directions: Combine shrimp, cream cheese, garlic powder and steak sauce. Put 1/2 teaspoon of mixture in center of each wrapper., Roll as directed on package., Deep fry until delicately browned., Serve with sweet-sour sauce.

title: Sourdough Pancakes
directions: *This is the sourdough starter.

title: Peanut Blossoms
directions: Cream sugars, butter or margarine and peanut butter. Beat in eggs, milk and vanilla. Sift together flour, soda and salt; stir into mixture. Shape into balls; roll in additional sugar. Place on ungreased cookie sheet; bake in 375 degree oven for 10-12 min. Immediately press a chocolate candy into each cookie. Makes 7 dozen.

title: Taco Soup With Black Beans
directions: Combine all ingredients except chips, shredded cheese and sour cream in slow cooker., Cover., Cook on low 4 - 6 hours or serve as soon as thoroughly heated., Garnish individual servings with chips, cheese and sour cream.

title: Waffles
directions: Add ingredients in order, saving egg whites to be added last.

title: Good Corn
directions: Slowly heat all ingredients until the cheese melts and it is hot.

title: Appetizer Oyster Crackers
directions: Combine Ranch salad dressing mix with dill weed and oil., Pour over crackers; stir to coat., Place in warm oven (250°) for 15 to 20 minutes., Stir gently halfway through baking., Serves 6.

title: Easy Broccoli Casserole
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Cook broccoli according to package and drain., Add cheese and 2 tablespoons margarine., Stir until melted., Add remaining margarine., Pour into casserole., Bake for 25 minutes., Top with cracker crumbs and bake 5 minutes longer.

title: Crunchy Chicken Salad
directions: Combine all ingredients; blend well., Chill., Serve on lettuce cups or use for sandwiches.

title: Sugar-Free No-Fat Poppy Seed Dressing
directions: Combine and mix well all ingredients., Store in a covered container in the refrigerator., Will keep 2 weeks.

title: Tater Tot Casserole
directions: Brown ground beef, onions and celery., Drain and pour into a mixing bowl., Add soup and mushrooms; mix well., Pour mixture into a 9 x 13-inch oblong baking pan., Add Tater Tots to the top., Bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Frosting
directions: Cream margarine., Blend in part of sugar., Add peanut butter. Cream well., Alternate remaining sugar and milk., Beat until of spreading consistency., Makes about 1 cup.

title: Olive Cheese Ball(Makes 3 Cups)
directions: Blend cheese and butter or oleo., Stir in olives and chives. Chill slightly for easier shaping., Form into ball on serving dish, after rolling in or patting on chopped nuts., May be trimmed with parsley., Serve with crackers.

title: Granny'S Homemade Fruit Cake
directions: Mix nuts, cracker crumbs and raisins together in a bowl., Heat milk with marshmallows until melted, stirring constantly., Pour mix over crumbs., Pour in square pan and cover with foil., Freeze 4 to 6 hours.

title: Fresh Fruit Bowl
directions: Over a bowl, peel and section oranges, reserving juice. Combine reserved juice, sugar or honey, lemon or lime peel, lemon or lime juice and ginger, cinnamon or nutmeg., In a large serving bowl place all the fruit except berries., Drizzle juice mixture over fruit., Cover; chill 2 to 24 hours.

title: Icebox Cookies
directions: Sift the sugar and cream it and butter together; beat eggs and add to creamed mixture., Sift all other ingredients together and add to first mixture., Knead with hands when mixture becomes too stiff for a spoon., Chill well and slice., Bake in moderate oven.

title: Sunday Glazed Carrots
directions: Steam carrots., Combine brown sugar and butter., Heat., Mix water and cornstarch until smooth., Heat until thickened., Stir into carrot mixture., Stir nuts into carrot mixture.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
directions: Cream shortening and sugars together., Add egg and vanilla and mix well., Put in the sifted flour, soda and salt., Mix well and add 1 package of chips., Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes., Makes 4 dozen.

title: Pineapple Salad
directions: Mix sugar and flour., Beat together eggs and juice, add to dry mixture and cook in double boiler until thick., Stir constantly. Cool.

title: Cranberry Salad
directions: Chop up cranberries., Put 1 cup sugar over them and let sit overnight. Next day add marshmallows, pineapple and nuts., Fold in whipped cream when ready to serve.

title: Fluff 'N Chip Treats
directions: In small bowl, stir marshmallow cream and peanut butter just until mixture is striped., Spread 1 tablespoon onto each cracker. Dip tops into mini morsels., Makes 20 treats.

title: Savory Potatoes
directions: Cover all ingredients in saucepan with barely enough water to cover top of vegetables., Cook 15 minutes until tender., Do not add more water, but watch to prevent scorching., When tender, mash with fork only., Add milk to make consistency that you like.

title: Oven Chicken
directions: Put together in bag and mix., Shake., Chicken should be coated. Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until done.

title: Banana Cream Pie
directions: In a saucepan, combine sugar, flour and salt., Stir in milk and mix well., Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly until the mixture thickens and comes to a boil., Boil for 2 minutes. Remove from heat., Stir a small amount into egg yolks., Return all to saucepan., Cook for 2 minutes, stirring constantly., Remove from heat., Add butter and vanilla., Cool slightly., Slice the bananas into pastry shell., Pour filling over., Cool., Before serving, garnish with whipped cream and bananas., Refrigerate any leftovers., Yield:, 6 to 8.

title: Homemade Chili
directions: Put in kettle browned hamburger meat (drained)., Add onion, beans and chili powder., Bring to boil., Add tomato juice., Add more if you need to., Add salt to taste and dash of pepper., Serve.

title: Homemade Ice Cream
directions: Beat egg whites until stiff. Beat egg yolks well., Add sugar and Eagle Brand milk, Milnot condensed milk and vanilla., Mix well., Add egg yolks and egg whites and mix well., Don't use chocolate syrup in mixture!, It won't freeze.

title: Dressing
directions: Mix all ingredients together. Then pour over 1-quart chicken broth., Bake at 350°.

title: Pineapple Casserole
directions: Half fill a tall glass with cranberry juice., Add a big scoop of vanilla ice cream and enough ginger ale to float the ice cream. This is a very good drink to serve at Christmastime.

title: Kidney Bean Soup
directions: Cook bacon until crisp and crumble., Reserve 2 tablespoons bacon drippings., In a 2-quart casserole dish, put bacon drippings, diced onion and crushed garlic., Cook in a microwave oven, covered, for about 3 minutes., Add 1/2 cup water and rest of ingredients, including liquid from beans., Mix until well blended., Cook, covered, for 10 to 12 minutes., Place 1/2 soup in a blender for 10 seconds and return to casserole dish., Repeat with other half of soup., If soup is too thick, add water to make it the desired consistency., Cook for another 3 minutes in microwave., Just before serving, stir in reserved bacon.

title: Marinated Roast Cookout
directions: Mix first 5 ingredients and pour over roast in glass dish., Let marinate for 6 to 8 hours at room temperature or overnight in refrigerator plus two hours at room temperature., Cook to desired doneness on outdoor grill, 1-1/2 hours for rare, 2 hours for medium or 2 -1/2 hours for well done., Serves 8-12.

title: Baked Corn
directions: Put all in blender and mix., Pour into a small greased casserole and bake at 350° for 1 hour until firm.

title: Yellow Cake
directions: Mix ingredients together except cinnamon., Pour 1/2 batter into Bundt pan., Sprinkle 2 tablespoons sugar and 1 teaspoon cinnamon over batter, then pour rest of batter in pan., Bake at 325° for 1 hour.

title: Marsha'S Chicken
directions: Layer chicken and broccoli in 9 x 13-inch pan., Slice cheese; spread over chicken and broccoli., Spread dressing over cheese; top with soup., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Stoecker'S Drum Rolls
directions: Combine 3 cups flour and yeast., Heat milk, sugar, shortening and salt until warm (115° to 120°)., Stir constantly until shortening almost melts., Add this to dry mixture., Add eggs. Beat at low speed with electric mixer for 1/2 minute, scraping bowl., Beat 3 minutes at high speed., Stir in by hand the remaining flour to make soft dough., Shape into ball; place in lightly greased bowl., Turn once to grease surface., Cover; let rest in a warm place until it doubles (1 1/2 to 2 hours)., Punch down; turn out on floured surface., Cover and let rest 10 minutes. Shape into desired rolls., Cover and let rise in warm place until doubled (30 to 45 minutes)., Bake on greased muffin pans in a 400° oven for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Cornish Hen Delight
directions: Preheat oven to 500° (to sear juices)., Meanwhile, lay hens in pan., Salt and pepper each hen; rub in good., After oven is hot, put hens in oven for 30 minutes or until crispy golden brown. Meanwhile on stovetop, saute onions and celery in butter., Put can of cream of chicken and 1 can of water; heat until creamy and set aside until 30 minutes are up, then pour mixture over hens and cook for about another 20 minutes or until hens are done., Serve over rice (can substitute chicken if you don't have Cornish hens).

title: Poached Fish With Sauce
directions: Bring water to boil., Place fish in water; bring to boil again., Turn burner off, cover pot and let fish stand for 15 to 20 minutes (1 pound=15 minutes, 2 pounds=20 minutes)., Toothpick goes through fish easily if done., Remove fish from water and place in platter., Garnish with finely chopped ginger, green onions and Chinese parsley., To prepare sauce, saute oils and garlic., Add shoyu, oyster sauce and mirin., Bring to a boil and pour over fish.

title: Braised Chuck Beef Pot Roast
directions: Sprinkle both sides of meat with garlic salt., Place in 3-quart (13 x 9-inch) glass baking dish., Cover with plastic wrap. Microwave on Simmer for 45 minutes., Turn meat over; re-cover and continue cooking on Simmer for 40 to 45 minutes or until fork-tender., Remove meat and slice meat approximately 1/4-inch thick., Dissolve onion soup mix in hot meat juices; place sliced meat in seasoned meat juice (add sliced onions on top of beef, if desired)., Cover with plastic wrap or glass cover., Microwave on Reheat for 8 to 10 minutes or until heated through., Let stand, covered, 5 minutes before serving., Serves about 8.

title: Rosy Pickled Eggs
directions: In a large bowl or jar, combine water, beet liquid and vinegar., Add sugar, pickling spice, salt, garlic and bay leaf; mix well., Add eggs and onions; cover and refrigerate several days before serving.

title: Chipped Beef Cheese Ball
directions: Combine 2/3 chipped beef with cream cheese, green onions, Worcestershire and milk., Mix well and roll into a ball and then in remaining beef., Refrigerate overnight.

title: Spaghetti Pie
directions: Cook and drain spaghetti., Stir in butter, grated cheese and eggs., Form mixture into a crust in buttered 10-inch pie plate (or use 8 x 8-inch square pan)., Spread cottage cheese over bottom of spaghetti crust., Brown beef; add onion and green pepper., Cook until vegetables are tender and meat is browned., Drain off excess fat., Stir in undrained tomatoes, tomato paste, sugar, oregano and garlic powder., Heat through., Turn meat mixture into spaghetti crust., Bake, uncovered, for 25 minutes., Sprinkle on Mozzarella cheese and bake until cheese melts.

title: Spicy Salt Substitute
directions: Mix the ingredients together very well and put in an airtight container., Store in a cool, dry place, away from the stove.

title: Creamed Asparagus
directions: Cook asparagus until tender (steam)., Add milk, flour and water; cook until thick., Add asparagus and diced hard-boiled eggs.

title: Mini Cheesecakes
directions: You will need 12 cupcake papers.

title: Fruit Salad
directions: Mix all together., Let set overnight in Frigidaire.

title: Apricot Brandy Pound Cake
directions: Cream margarine until light., Add the sugar in thirds., Cream again until light and fluffy., Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each one., Beat for another 3 minutes after the last egg is added. Sift flour, salt and soda together., Combine the sour cream and extracts., Add flour mixture and sour cream alternately to the batter., Blend well., Fold in apricot brandy. Bake in a well-greased and floured Bundt or tube cake pan at 375° for 70 minutes or until done.

title: Sugar-Free Doughnuts
directions: Cream shortening and margarine in bowl., Add mashed potatoes, potato water, sweetener and egg; beat well., Sprinkle with yeast. Stir in gently., Let stand, for 1 1/2 hours in warm place., Stir in flour gradually., Knead on floured surface until smooth., Let rise, covered, in warm place 5 to 6 hours or doubled in bulk. Roll out on floured surface 1/2-inch thick., Cut to desired size. Place on floured towel., Let rise in warm place 1 1/2 to 2 inches or until doubled in bulk., Deep fry in 375°, oil until light brown., Drain on paper towels., Yields 50 doughnuts.

title: Runzas
directions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees.

title: Rice Pudding
directions: Wash the rice about 3 times in cold water., Put the milk in the pan; add rice and cook long and slow (about 30 minutes)., Mix eggs, sugar and vanilla., Mix well., Add to rice and milk very slowly, mixing the milk mixture as you pour in the egg mixture. Bring to a boil again., Sprinkle with cinnamon and refrigerate.

title: Cream Cheese Pound Cake
directions: Preheat, oven, to, 325°., Grease, and, flour, tube pan. Blend together, oleo, and cream cheese; add sugar, blend until fluffy. Add, eggs, one at a time, blending well., Add vanilla. Blend in flour, and, salt., Pour batter into prepared pan and bake 1 hour and 15 minutes., Cool and dust with powdered sugar if desired.

title: Tortellini Alla Checca
directions: Cook tortellini according to package., In large saute pan, heat olive oil., Add tomatoes, garlic, lemon juice and basil. Saute gently for 5 minutes., Add cooked tortellini, butter, Parmesan cheese, salt and pepper., Gently toss., Serve.

title: Island Salsa
directions: Combine all ingredients., Serve on Hawaiian Lavash crackers or serve over grilled chicken., Can be made 3 hours ahead.

title: Broccoli Soup
directions: Cook broccoli according to package (do not add salt)., When finished cooking, add remaining ingredients., Reduce heat and simmer for 1 hour., Makes 7 cups.

title: Hash Brown Casserole
directions: Stir together soup, sour cream, hash browns, 1 bag of cheese, melted margarine and hot sauce (if desired)., Put in a 9 x 13-inch (or equal quantity) pan., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour, or until lightly browned on bottom and sides., Add more cheese on top for the last few minutes of baking time and bake till bubbly.

title: Pumpkin Sheet Cake
directions: In a mixing bowl, beat pumpkin, sugar and oil. Add eggs; mix well. Combine flour, baking soda, cinnamon and salt; add to pumpkin mixture and beat until well blended. Pour into greased 15 x 10 x 1-inch baking pan. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes or until cake tests done. Cool.

title: Coconut Caramel Pie
directions: Melt butter in large skillet; add coconut and chopped pecans. Cook until golden brown, stirring frequently., Set the mixture aside., Combine cream cheese and sweetened condensed milk; beat until smooth., Fold in whipped topping., Layer 1/2 of cream cheese mixture in each shell., Drizzle 1/4 of chocolate fudge topping on each pie., Sprinkle 1/4 of coconut mixture evenly over each pie, repeat layers with remaining ingredients., Cover and freeze until firm.

title: Hamburger Skillet Dish
directions: Brown rice in shortening in heavy skillet, stirring frequently., Add ground round, onion and celery; brown well., Add tomatoes and other ingredients., Cover and simmer until rice is tender, about 45 minutes.

title: Apple Squares
directions: Mix apples and sugar., Let stand 10 minutes., Sift flour, salt, soda and cinnamon together; set aside., Beat the egg; add oil and blend into apple mixture, then add flour all at once. Beat with wooden spoon until blended., Bake in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch well-greased pan at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes., Mix confectioners sugar and milk and drizzle over squares.

title: Marinated Chicken Wings
directions: Cut chicken wings in half., Discard the tip., In a bowl, mix orange juice, soy sauce and minced garlic., Add the chicken wings to the mixture and marinate at least one hour., It is better to do this the day before and marinate overnight., Place chicken wings on a cookie sheet and bake at 350° for about 30 to 45 minutes or until very brown., Let cool for about 15 minutes before serving.

title: Brownies
directions: Have ingredients at room temperature., Combine all ingredients in a bowl and mix at medium speed for 2 minutes., Spoon into a greased 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 20 to 22 minutes, or until it tests done., Cool and frost, if desired., Recipe can be doubled for a 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan.

title: Lemon Bars
directions: Cut margarine into flour and powdered sugar until crumbly. Pack into a 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.

title: Texas Sheet Cake
directions: In saucepan melt oleo or margarine., Add water and cocoa., Add flour, sugar, salt and soda., Then add eggs, vanilla and sour cream., Bake in a greased and floured 11 x 17-inch sheet pan for 20 minutes at 375°.

title: Oven French Fries(Dietetic)
directions: Slice potatoes in half and then slice each half into 8 thick crescent-shaped pieces., Chill sliced potatoes 10 minutes (or longer) in ice cold water to crisp them., Preheat oven to 475°. Drain potatoes well., Toss lightly with oil., Spray a baking pan with Pam., Arrange the slices in a single layer., Bake 25 minutes turning occasionally., Season and serve., Makes 4 (75 calorie) servings.

title: Pumpkin Cookies
directions: Bake in, 375° oven for 15 minutes or until done., Yields 3 1/2 dozen.

title: Pizza Sauce
directions: Simmer for 1 hour., Seal in pint jars.

title: Green Chile(Soup Or Smothering For Burritos, Chile Rellenos Or Enchiladas)
directions: Heat oil in large stockpot., Add pork, onion, garlic, salt and pepper., Saute until pork is browned., Drain juice from tomatoes into stockpot., Chop tomatoes and add to pork with chiles and 2 cups water., Stir well and simmer, covered, for 45 minutes., Whisk together flour and 1/3 cup water until smooth., Add to chile mixture and stir constantly until well blended and slightly thickened., Cover and simmer for 15 minutes., Serve with warm tortillas., Serves 6 to 8.

title: Quick Lime Pie
directions: Blend first 3 ingredients together in blender or food processor., Pour into large bowl and fold in Cool Whip., Add food coloring at this time., Pour into graham cracker crust. Refrigerate 1 hour before serving.

title: Picante Sauce
directions: Clean vegetables with a vegetable brush., It takes less time and they come out cleaner.

title: Meat Pie - Good For Holidays
directions: Simmer first 7 ingredients together until done., Place in crusts., Cover with lattice work crust or rolled top crust and be creative with designs on top., Bake 1 hour at 450°., Makes 4 pies.

title: Chicken Dressing
directions: Wash and cut up chicken., Boil chicken in large pot with plenty of water., Add onion, pepper, salt and butter., After chicken is done, use broth and pour over corn bread., Put all other ingredients with corn bread and mix well., Debone chicken and put pieces in with dressing., Pour mixture in a greased pan and bake at 350° about 30 minutes or until brown.

title: Southern Spoonbread
directions: Pour boiling water over meal., Let stand until cool., Add sugar, salt and beaten egg., Dissolve soda into buttermilk and add to batter; mix well., Add melted shortening; pour in greased deep dish or skillet., Bake at 400° for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Hop'N John And Rice
directions: Boil beans and thyme in 2 quarts of water until peas are tender., Dry onions and bacon until brown., Add to peas; add rice. Season with salt and pepper., Cover tightly over low heat about 3/4 hour.

title: Congealed Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Chill in refrigerator for a couple of hours.

title: Cherry Torte
directions: Combine ingredients in order given except use only 1/2 can cherries., Lastly, fold in last 1/2 of cherries., Bake 45 minutes at 350°.

title: Refrigerator Rolls
directions: Soften yeast in lukewarm water., Cream shortening, sugar and salt., Add boiling water and cool to lukewarm., Add well beaten eggs, yeast mixture and flour; mix well., Place in refrigerator at least 2 hours (overnight is best)., Make into rolls., Let rise 2 hours in warm place., Bake for 15 minutes at 425°.

title: Fudge Pie
directions: Mix sugar, cocoa and cornstarch in saucepan., Add butter, milk, eggs and vanilla; mix well., Pour into regular pie shell (not deep dish) and bake at 325° for 45 to 55 minutes.

title: Lynn'S Coconut Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Cream margarine and brown sugar., Add beaten eggs., Mix together flour, soda and baking powder., Add with coconut flakes and oatmeal to mixture., Add nuts (optional).

title: Toasted Mixed Nuts
directions: Place pecans, cashews and almonds in 1 1/2-quart micro-proof casserole., Sprinkle with seasoned salt., Cut butter into 8 pieces and arrange evenly on top of nuts., Cook, uncovered, on High for 5 to 6 minutes, stirring once or twice during cooking.

title: Rice Pudding
directions: Combine rice, milk, sugar and salt; cook until creamy (15 to 20 minutes)., Blend milk and egg and stir into rice mixture., Add raisins and cook 2 minutes., Add butter and vanilla; sprinkle with nutmeg or cinnamon (optional).

title: Tortilla Soup
directions: Cook chicken in 8 cups water 30 to 40 minutes., Set aside; cool and debone., Add tomatoes, bell pepper, onion and cilantro to chicken broth., Bring to boil; reduce heat and simmer 20 to 30 minutes, then cool to room temperature., Remove tomatoes, bell pepper, onion and cilantro from liquid and puree., Return pureed mixture and broth to heat., Bring to boil; reduce heat to simmer and add cooked rice, deboned chicken, cumin, salt and pepper; serve hot., Garnish with tortilla strips and guacamole.

title: Baked Beans
directions: Pick over beans; wash., Cover with 3 cups water and 1 tablespoon baking soda., Soak overnight or 8 hours; then add 2 cups water, mustard and next 6 ingredients., Cover and boil 20 minutes., Heat oven to 250°., Cut salt pork into small pieces and place in a bean pot or casserole dish., Cover with hot beans and their liquid., Sprinkle pepper on top., Cover and bake in a slow 250° oven or until tender., Add 3/4 water when 2/3 done, if necessary.

title: Cranberry Salad
directions: Cook sugar and water., Add cranberries., Simmer for 10 minutes., Dissolve Jell-O in hot water, then add cranberry mixture and pineapple and chill slightly., Fold in celery and nuts., Put in 5-cup mold or 9 x 9-inch square dish.

title: Pineapple Orange Salad
directions: Mix jello according to directions. Add pineapple and oranges (drain both)., Chill until set., Top with whipped cream., Sprinkle nuts on top.

title: Cheezy Garlic Biscuits
directions: Mix baking mix, milk and cheese until soft dough forms., Beat vigorously for 30 seconds., Drop dough by spoonfuls on ungreased sheet., Bake in a 450° oven for 8 to 10 minutes or until golden brown., Mix butter and garlic powder together., Brush over warm biscuits before serving., Makes 10 to 12.

title: Wisconsin Potato Cheese Soup
directions: In a large saucepan, melt butter over medium-high heat., Saute celery and onion until tender., Add potatoes and broth., Cover and simmer until potatoes are tender., In batches, puree potato mixture in a blender or food processor., Return to saucepan., Stir in milk and seasonings., Add the cheese and heat only until melted., Garnish with croutons and parsley., Makes 8 servings.

title: Gingerbread Man
directions: Thoroughly cream together butter or margarine and sugar., Add egg; beat until light and fluffy., Add orange peel and corn syrup; mix well., Sift together remaining ingredients; stir into creamed mixture., Chill dough thoroughly., On lightly floured surface, roll to 1/4-inch thickness., Cut with gingerbread man cookie cutter. Place 1 inch apart on ungreased cookie sheet., Bake in 375° oven for 8 to 10 minutes., Cool 1 minute; remove from pan., Cool on rack., Decorate gingerbread men with decorating icing and raisins, if desired., Makes 2 dozen.

title: Oatmeal Bread
directions: Stir, boiling, water,, rolled, oats, molasses, salt and butter together.	Let cool., Dissolve yeast with 1/4 cup warm water; stir, in oatmeal mixture., Add 2 cups of flour; beat 2 minutes at medium speed., Mix in rest of flour., Cover and let rise, about, 4 hours., With wooden spoon, beat batter about 75 strokes., Put in two, greased, bread, pans.	Let, rise, again. Bake at 350° for 40 to 50 minutes.

title: Hot Tamale Pie
directions: Brown meat; mix other ingredients together., Boil 15 minutes. Remove from fire and add 1 1/2 cups corn meal, slowly stirring. Salt to taste; pour in long casserole dish., Bake 1 hour in a 300° oven.

title: Company Chicken Hot Dish
directions: Dust chicken with flour, salt, pepper and paprika., Brown in butter. Grease pan with butter, large enough to lay chicken in single layer., Put celery on bottom of pan, then browned chicken. Mix soup, cream, onions, pimentos and cheese., Pour on top of chicken., Sprinkle bread crumbs, almonds and a little grated cheese on top. Bake 1 hour at 350° or until chicken is done. Serve with rice.

title: Teriyaki Burgers
directions: Mix all ingredients., Shape into burgers and fry or grill.

title: Broccoli Salad
directions: Combine the broccoli, bacon, walnuts (if desired), onion, salt and pepper to taste., Blend the mayonnaise, sugar and wine vinegar., Pour over the broccoli mixture. Stir until all pieces are coated.

title: Special K Candy
directions: Mix sugar and syrup in saucepan., Cook until sugar is dissolved., Add peanut butter; continue cooking until it melts. Add this to cereal., Mix in large bowl until cereal is coated. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto waxed paper., Let set until firm.

title: Cream Puffs(Yield:  6 Medium Puffs)
directions: In saucepan, melt butter in boiling water., Add flour and salt all at once; stir vigorously., Cook and stir until mixture forms a ball that doesn't separate., Remove from heat; cool slightly and add eggs, one at a time, beating with a spoon after each addition until smooth., Drop, by heaping tablespoonfuls 3 inches apart on lightly greased baking sheet., Bake at 450° for 15 minutes. Reduce heat to 325° and bake 10 minutes., Remove from oven; cut off tops., Turn oven off; return cream puffs to oven to dry 20 minutes., Cool on rack.

title: Hot (Soup)
directions: Slice a large onion and boil until tender in chicken broth; strain and throw away onion., Return to heat., Add one (more if needed) can of pureed tomatoes., Stir., To add a little color and taste, season with some black pepper and ground cayenne., Simmer. Pour into cup over a slice of lemon., Strips of corn tortillas dropped in are good.

title: Coleslaw
directions: Marinate cabbage, carrots, sugar and milk in refrigerator overnight., Drain well., Mix cabbage with mayonnaise, buttermilk or sour cream, Tabasco, onion and celery seed., Refrigerate 1 hour before serving., Serves 4.

title: Vanilla Ice Cream (1923)(Over 50 Years Old)
directions: Scald the fresh milk in a double boiler., Mix the 1/2 cup sugar, flour and salt., Sift., Moisten with the 3 tablespoons cold milk., Add 1 cup of the scalded milk and mix, then add to remaining hot milk., Cook 30 minutes.

title: Pasta With Primavera Sauce
directions: In a large skillet, saute broccoli, zucchini, red pepper and snow peas in butter until crisp-tender. Add half and half and black pepper., Cook briefly until slightly reduced. Serve over pasta. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese., Makes 4 servings.

title: Beef Pot Pie
directions: Mix roast beef and soup in pie pan, placing pie crust on top. Bake until golden brown.

title: Honey Blueberry Muffins
directions: Mix the milk, honey, blueberries, baking powder, egg and shortening. Combine flour and salt; add to the first ingredients. Stir just to moisten. Fill greased muffin pans 1/2 full. Bake at 400° for 12 to 15 minutes. Makes 12 to 15 muffins.

title: Microwave Zucchini Bake
directions: Slice squash in half., Sprinkle with salt, pepper and oleo. Cook in microwave until tender., Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Return to microwave and cook until cheese is hot.

title: Rhubarb Kuchen
directions: Mix and put into a greased and floured 8 x 12 pan. Pat on bottom of pan.

title: Chocolate Nut Caramel Bars(Snicker Bars)
directions: In microwave on High, melt chocolate morsels and shortening together., Stir until mixture is smooth., Pour 1/2 of the melted chocolate into an 8-inch foil lined square pan., Spread evenly. Refrigerate until firm (about 15 minutes).

title: Chicken Tetrazzini
directions: In a large pot, boil chicken until tender., Remove from broth and reserve broth., Debone chicken and put aside., To the broth add onion, celery, green pepper and oregano., Salt and pepper generously., Then add vermicelli., Stir constantly until vermicelli is done., Add deboned chicken.

title: Veal Paprika
directions: Mix salt, pepper and flour., Roll individual servings of veal cutlets in seasoned flour., Brown in hot oil in skillet rubbed with garlic., Add 1 cup hot water; cover and simmer 1 1/2 hours. Arrange meat on hot platter., Into gravy left in pan, stir 1 cup cream., Heat and pour over noodles., Sprinkle with paprika., Makes 6 servings.

title: Sugar Cookies
directions: Note:, Omit baking powder and salt if you use self-rising flour.

title: White Icing
directions: Cook sugar and water to soft-ball stage. Beat egg whites until stiff. Pour 1/2 sugar mixture over egg whites, beating constantly. Place remaining syrup back on heat. Bring to boil, then pour syrup over egg whites. Add cut up marshmallows to icing and beat until consistency to spread on cake.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Cook broccoli as directed on package., Drain., Combine soup, eggs, mayonnaise and cheese., Mix well., Add broccoli., Pour into buttered casserole and bake in 350° until set., Remove from oven. Cover with chips and bake until light brown., Makes 4 servings.

title: Skillet Dinner
directions: Drain beans, saving liquid (there should be 1 cup liquid). Mix together meat, milk, rolled oats and 1/2 teaspoon salt., Shape mixture into 16 balls and roll in flour., Melt shortening in a skillet and brown meatballs on all sides., Reduce heat and add onion; cook slowly until onion is lightly browned, about 5 minutes., Add liquid and remaining ingredients, except the beans. Cover and cook slowly for 10 minutes or until potatoes are tender. Add drained beans; cover and heat thoroughly.

title: Frosted Toffee Bars
directions: In medium bowl, combine oats, sugar and margarine; mix well. Spread in greased 9-inch square pan., Bake at 350° for 13 minutes or until light golden brown; cool., In small, heavy saucepan over low heat, melt chips., Spread over oat mixture; sprinkle with nuts., Refrigerate until chocolate is set., Cut into bars and store in tightly covered container in refrigerator., Makes 2 dozen bars.

title: Asian Beef Noodles
directions: Cook beef with oil to desired tenderness. Break noodles into 4 sections and cook (save beef seasoning/flavoring packet). Combine cooked noodles, steak sauce, carrot, onion and beef seasoning/flavoring packet. Cook until heated throughout. Add beef. Sprinkle with peanuts. Yield: 4 servings.

title: Marinade A La Greque
directions: Combine all ingredients in a large dish., Marinate beef, chicken or lamb., You may also use firm fleshed fish steaks.

title: Punch
directions: Dissolve Jell-O in 1 cup of boiling water., Then add remaining ingredients in punch bowl.

title: Banana Yellow Cake
directions: Make batter as directed, except stir 1/8 teaspoon soda into mix before adding liquid., Use only 3/4 cup water and add 1 cup mashed bananas (2 to 3 medium)., If desired, fold 1/3 cup finely chopped nuts into batter., Pour into prepared oblong or layer pans., Bake., If desired, fill and frost with sweetened whipped cream and sliced bananas.

title: Deviled Eggs
directions: Hard boil eggs, let cool and peel., Cut eggs in half, lengthwise and remove yolk., Mix yolk, Miracle Whip and olive juice with salt together until smooth., Place egg yolk back into eggs and garnish with one slice of green olives., Chill and enjoy.

title: Aliene'S Sugar Cookies
directions: Blend first 4 ingredients until light and creamy., Stir together, dry, ingredients., Gradually, add to creamed mixture and mix, well until blended., Form dough into balls., Flatten with glass dipped in sugar or drop by spoon and mash with fork dipped in water., This recipe may be cut down to one half.

title: Mint Cordial
directions: Pour all ingredients into a blender and blend until smooth. Store in an airtight container in refrigerator., Shake well before serving., Serve chilled., Makes about 4 cups liqueur.

title: Pineapple Delight
directions: Place drained pineapple in a dish., Mix flour and sugar together., Sprinkle over pineapple., Cover with a layer of shredded cheese., Top with melted butter and crumbled Ritz crackers., Bake at 350° until dish bubbles (about 40 minutes). Serve hot., Serves 8 to 10.

title: Beef And Beans Barbecue
directions: Brown ground chuck in skillet with chopped onions and drain. Then add other ingredients., Either simmer on top of stove or place in oven at 375° until all ingredients are bubbly., This will take 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Cheesie Potatoes
directions: Spray a glass baking dish with a nonstick spray. In microwave, melt cheese, butter and cheese. Put sliced potatoes in baking dish. Sprinkle dried onion over potatoes and salt and pepper to taste. Pour cheese mixture over potatoes. Bake at 350° until golden brown.

title: Kids Favorite Morning Spiced Tea
directions: Mix all ingredients in an airtight container., Use 1/3 cup (more or less to taste) per cup of hot water.

title: Crock-Pot Stew
directions: Open cans; dump contents into crock-pot., Add remaining ingredients., Stir until well mixed., Cook on low setting all day.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
directions: Combine prepared apples and sugar in large mixing bowl., Let stand 10 minutes., Sift flour and add soda, salt and spices; set aside., Blend oil and egg into apple/sugar mixture., Add dry ingredients, stirring just until blended., Stir in raisins and walnuts.

title: Curried Vegetable Medley
directions: In 10-inch skillet, over medium heat in hot oil, cook cauliflowerets, beans, mushrooms and carrots with garlic, curry and cumin until vegetables are tender-crisp, stirring often., In small bowl, stir together vegetable juice, cornstarch and pepper; gradually stir into skillet., Cook until mixture boils and thickens, stirring constantly., Sprinkle with almonds., Makes 4 cups or 8 servings.

title: Prepare Ahead Mashed Potatoes
directions: For "Mashies" that stay smooth, mash the potatoes with warm milk, butter and an egg yolk., Whip an egg white and fold it into the potatoes., Place in a buttered casserole and dot with more butter., Cover and refrigerate until ready to use.

title: Hearty Bean Stew
directions: In a Dutch oven combine undrained kidney and garbanzo beans, water, potatoes, carrots, onion, tomato paste, chili powder, salt, basil, garlic powder and pepper., Bring to a boil., Reduce heat; cover and simmer 30 minutes or until vegetables are tender., Top each serving with about 1/4 cup of the cheese cubes., Makes 8 servings.

title: Party Mix
directions: Melt butter in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan in oven., Remove and add seasoned salt and the Worcestershire sauce., Mix the cereal, pretzels and nuts in a large pan (oven broiler pan) and pour the butter and seasoning over it., Stir until all the cereal and pretzels are covered., Bake 1 hour at 250°, stirring every 15 minutes.

title: Batter For Deep Frying
directions: Mix ingredients together., Use for deep frying vegetables when camping., Use for onions, green pepper rings, zucchini slices, cauliflower, mushrooms and cheese as well as hot dogs.

title: Buttermilk Salad
directions: Heat pineapple and juice until hot; but not boiling. Remove from heat and add dry gelatin. Mix well. Stir in buttermilk and fold in Cool Whip. Place in 13 x 9 dish and refrigerate until set, congealed.

title: Pecan Thins
directions: Cream butter and sugar., Add flour., Add egg yolk and vanilla. Batter will be stiff., Spread as thin as possible on 2 cookie sheets., Lightly beat egg white., Spread on top and sprinkle with nuts., Press in with hand., Bake 1 hour at 275° or lower., Remove from oven and cut into squares immediately., Freeze well.

title: Kool-Aid Fizzy
directions: Combine all ingredients in a 2-quart pitcher., Mix well.

title: Buttermilk Pound Cake
directions: In large bowl, cream butter;, add sugar gradually, beating until light., Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each. Stir flour and soda., Add to creamed mixture alternately, with buttermilk, beginning and ending with flour., Blend in flavorings. Place batter in greased and floured 10 inch tube pan., Bake at 300 degrees for 45 to 50 minutes, or until done., Do not over bake.

title: Ruth'S Dill Dip
directions: Mix together and refrigerate overnight or for several hours.

title: Chicken Divan
directions: Cook broccoli in boiling, salted water until tender; drain. Arrange broccoli in greased 11 1/2 x 7 1/2-inch baking dish. Place cooked chicken on top., Combine soup, mayonnaise and lemon juice; pour over chicken., Sprinkle with cheese., Combine bread crumbs and butter., Sprinkle over top., Bake 30 to 40 minutes at 350° or until thoroughly heated., This dish can be prepared a day ahead and put in the refrigerator., It also freezes very well. Dish can also be made substituting asparagus for broccoli.

title: Quickie Brownies
directions: Stir all ingredients together;	spread into shallow 8 x 8-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Sweet Nutty Yam Bake
directions: Drain yams., Melt butter in bottom of baking dish., Put yams in bottom of baking dish., You can mash or cut up in small pieces. Sprinkle brown sugar on top along with cinnamon., Add pecans and marshmallows., Bake about 20 minutes., Don't let marshmallows burn.

title: Earthquake Cake
directions: Put nuts in bottom of greased 9 x 13-inch pan., Add coconut on top of nuts., Mix cake according to box directions and pour on top., Mix powdered sugar, cream cheese and margarine., Whip., Drop over top of cake mix., Swirl around in mixture., Bake according to box directions.

title: Stewed Chicken
directions: Cut up chicken; clean and wash., Put chicken in stewing pot with water., Keep enough water in pot to cover chicken., Salt and pepper to taste., Stew until almost tender.

title: Meat Loaf
directions: Mix everything together (except bread crumbs) in a bowl., Add bread crumbs slowly until mixture is consistency of cookie dough (sprinkle in more crumbs if needed)., Roll into a ball and pat ball into a glass dish (about 8 x 8-inch)., Make even thickness. Bake in oven about 1 hour.

title: Lemon Pound Cake
directions: Cream the margarine, Crisco and sugar until light and fluffy. Add eggs; beat well. Sift flour, measure and add baking powder; sift again. Add to the creamed mixture with milk. Add flavoring last and beat well. Pour into well-greased and floured pan., Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 10 minutes.

title: Onion Pizza Bread
directions: Preheat oven to 450°., Combine onion and garlic with an equal amount of water; set aside 10 minutes to soften., Fit dough into a greased 12-inch round pizza pan., Brush dough with 2 tablespoons of oil., Sprinkle dough with salt and reserved onion and garlic. Dribble remaining 2 tablespoons oil over top of dough., Bake until dough and onion is browned, 15 to 20 minutes., Cut into wedges.

title: Lithuanian Boiled Vyritos
directions: Bring water and ruta to boil., Add all ingredients except whiskey., Squeeze orange, lemon and lime into water., After it boils, let it simmer until the flavor is in the water., Add whiskey and bring to a boil., Remove immediately and let cool overnight. Pour in bottle.

title: Zucchini Chocolate Chip Cake
directions: Cream sugar, butter and oil together., Add eggs, vanilla and sour milk., Mix well., Mix together dry ingredients and add to creamed mixture., Beat well., Stir in zucchini., Pour batter into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch cake pan., Sprinkle top with chocolate chips., Bake at 350° for 40 to 50 minutes.

title: Bean Pot
directions: Do not drain beans., Fry hamburger, onions and bell pepper (green) until brown (drain)., Add beans and other ingredients. Cook in electric fry pan at 350° for 30 minutes or in slow cooker for 2 to 3 hours on low.

title: 5-Cup Salad
directions: Mix and refrigerate for several hours or overnight.

title: Chinese Spice Cookies
directions: Combine shortening and sugar., Add eggs, vanilla and milk. Add powdered ingredients., Mix well., Drop by teaspoon onto ungreased cookie sheet., Dip or sprinkle with sugar., Bake at 375° for 12 minutes., Makes 2 1/2 dozen.

title: Crawfish Puffs
directions: Sift together dry ingredients., Beat egg yolks, milk and vegetable oil until blended., Add to dry ingredients and beat until blended., Stir in crawfish, rice and green peppers., Beat egg whites until stiff, but not dry, then fold into batter., Add Tabasco sauce to taste., Drop batter by tablespoonfuls into deep, hot fat (375°)., Fry until golden, 3 to 4 minutes, turning once. Drain on paper towel and serve with cocktail sauce or tartar sauce. Makes 24 puffs.

title: Pound Cake
directions: Combine flour, sugar, oil, egg yolks, pineapple cinnamon and nutmeg in large bowl., Beat egg whites until stiff peaks form. Fold into batter., Fold in pecans., Pour into a 10-inch tube pan. Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 10 minutes, or until cake tests done. Let cool in pan.

title: Christmas Mix (Snack)
directions: Melt chocolate and oil in double boiler.

title: Butternut Squash
directions: Place squash, cut side up, in shallow roasting pan. Place 1 tablespoon butter in each half. Place seasonings on each half. Cover pan with aluminum foil and roast 1 1/2 hours at 350°. Remove herbs, spoon squash into a bowl and mash until very smooth. In a saucepan, add honey and remaining butter; add seasonings and warm through before serving.

title: Black-Eyed Peas And Spareribs
directions: Saute onion and garlic in oil in 4 or 5-quart pot or skillet. Add spareribs and brown., Sprinkle with paprika, add peas, water and wine., Cover and simmer 1 hour, until ribs are tender., Add tomatoes, green pepper, brown sugar, chili powder, salt and pepper., Cover and cook slowly for 30 to 45 minutes., Serves 4. Good over rice.

title: Frosted Cranberry Salad
directions: Drain pineapple., Reserve juice and make up to one cup with water., Heat to boiling; dissolve jello in hot liquid., Gently stir in ginger ale; chill until partially set., Mix pineapple and the cranberry sauce; fold into jello., Turn into 9 x 9 x 2-inch dish and chill until firm., Mix cream cheese and whipped topping; spread over jello and sprinkle nuts on top.

title: Punch Bowl Strawberry Cake
directions: Mix first 4 ingredients together., Crumble cake and put in large bowl., Stir half of mix in with cake., Mix strawberries and glaze together and put on top of cake., Put rest of Cool Whip mixture on top., Add whole strawberries on top and side of cake.

title: Hot Water Gingerbread
directions: Put molasses,, shortening, and	sugar, in, mixing bowl. Dissolve baking soda in boiling water and pour into bowl., Mix well and let cool.	Add, eggs, nuts and raisins., Mix and sift remaining ingredients., Add to mixture in bowl, mix well until smooth., Pour into 8 x 8 x 2-inch cake pan., Bake in 350° oven for about 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Lunch Meat Casserole
directions: Heat oven to 400°. Layer ingredients in casserole pan and bake until done.

title: Christmas Jewels
directions: Mix all ingredients, except coconut and food coloring., Shape in about 3 dozen small ovals., In two separate pint jars, put a few drops each of red and green food coloring., Add 1/2 teaspoon coconut to each jar., Cover and shake until coconut is tinted. Roll ovals in coconut., Chill.

title: Creamed Celery
directions: Cook celery in lightly salted water until tender; drain., Add water chestnuts, soup and pimento., Top with bread crumbs, almonds and melted butter., Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes., Serves 6 to 8.

title: "Hands-Off" Chicken
directions: Mix rice and soups together., Spray dish (long, flat 2-quart dish) with Pam and put soup and rice in the casserole dish., Place raw chicken on top of rice mixture., Then sprinkle onion soup mix over everything., Cover tightly with foil and bake at 350°.

title: Eggplant Casserole
directions: Soak eggplant in salt water for 30 minutes., Drain., Saute eggplant and onion in butter in frying pan until tender., Mix in cheese, bread and milk., Put in casserole dish., Bake 30 minutes in 350° oven.

title: Apple Salad
directions: Dice apples, cut grapes in half and slice bananas., Mix together; stir in marshmallows, walnuts, sugar, peanut butter and mayonnaise., Makes a delicious summer salad.

title: White Conch Chowder
directions: Pound and dice conch., Fry bacon, saute onions, add conch and all other ingredients except the milk., Simmer for one hour, add milk and heat.

title: Salmon Loaf
directions: Add all ingredients, except egg whites., Mix well., Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites., Bake in buttered mold in 350° oven for 1 hour.

title: Velveeta Fudge
directions: In saucepan over simmering water, beat cheese, butter and cocoa., Slowly add in sugar., Add vanilla., Cook 10 minutes over medium heat until thick., Put in buttered 9-inch pan for thick slices or put in 10 x 13-inch pan for thinner slices.

title: Heavenly Hash
directions: In a sauce pan, stir together half and half, margarine and cornstarch over medium heat until it starts to thicken, remove from heat., Add marshmallows and stir until dissolved., Add pineapple that has been drained and pecans., Pour into container with a lid and refrigerate over night., Before serving, stir in sour cream.

title: Cherry Tart
directions: Beat until stiff the egg whites and baking powder., Add sugar, crackers and nuts., Let set overnight. Butter 2 pie dishes or 9 x 13-inch oblong dish., Bake at 325° for 25 minutes.

title: Old Timey Potato Salad
directions: Take Irish potatoes., Peel and wash and chop small., Put a small amount of salt in the water you boil them in., Cook until real tender., Drain water off and break eggs in the hot potatoes. Mash real good, the hot potatoes will cook the eggs., Add onion (chopped fine), mayonnaise, sugar, vinegar, salt and black pepper. Stir all this up real good and taste to see if it's flavored to suit your taste.

title: Taco Dip
directions: Mix both together until smooth., On a small platter or something flat, break up lettuce small; chop tomatoes small and sprinkle shredded cheese on top., Dip Fritos chips into dip, then scoop up salad., Good!

title: Chicken Salad Casserole
directions: Mix together soup, onion, mayonnaise and lemon juice., Add chicken, rice, celery and eggs; toss lightly., Put mixture in 9 x 13-inch baking dish; top with bread crumbs., Bake for 40 minutes at 350°.

title: Italian Zucchini Pie
directions: Heat oven to 375°., Cook onion and zucchini in butter., Add seasonings., Blend eggs and cheese in large bowl., Stir in vegetables., Put teaspoon mustard in prepared pie shell., Pour in ingredients., Bake 20 minutes.

title: Creamy Pot Roast
directions: Boil roast in a large pot on top of stove until extremely tender., Pour the cream of mushroom soup over cut up roast. Salt, pepper and enjoy.

title: Hash Browns
directions: Heat butter, cream and salt., Put 1/2 hash browns in bottom of baking dish., Sprinkle with half of cheese., Top with remaining hash browns., Sprinkle with remaining cheese., Pour cream mixture over., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Peppermint Dessert
directions: Combine crumbs and butter and spread in bottom of, 9, x 13-inch ungreased pan., Melt chocolate and butter, (let cool). Add sugar, yolks, pecans and vanilla., Beat whites until stiff and fold, into above mixture., Pour over crumbs, and, freeze. Spread ice, cream over chocolate mixture.	Drizzle, chocolate sauce over mixture and freeze.

title: Cheese Rolls
directions: Combine dry ingredients in large mixer bowl., Heat milk and oil in saucepan over low heat until warm., Add 1 egg and warm liquid to flour mixture; beat 1/2 minute at low speed and 3 minutes at medium speed., By hand, gradually stir 2 cups flour, Cheddar cheese and 2 to 3 cups more flour until soft dough., Knead on floured surface until smooth and elastic., Cover and let rise until doubled in size., Punch down dough., Shape into rolls. Place in greased pan., Cover; let rise 15 to 20 minutes., Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Superb Sweet Potatoes
directions: Wash the unpeeled sweet potatoes., Cook in a large saucepan in the water with 1 teaspoon salt for about 20 minutes, until tender, but not mushy., Drain, peel and mash to a puree., This may be done in a food processor, blender or electric mixer., Add the remaining salt, butter, pepper and milk.

title: Boursin
directions: Combine cream cheese, sour cream and butter thoroughly., Add remaining ingredients., Chill., Serve with crackers.

title: Orange-Raisin Fruitcake
directions: Extract orange juice, then put orange pulp, rind, nuts and raisins through food chopper., Keep 1/4 cup of nut mixture for topping., Mix remainder with orange juice, sugar and shortening until light and fluffy., Add eggs. Mix., Add flour, soda, salt and buttermilk., Mix well and pour into a tube pan., Bake 45 minutes at 350°.

title: 10 Day Slaw
directions: Chop or shred cabbage., Add sliced onions and chopped green peppers., Pour white sugar over cabbage mixture and let stand while mixing dressing., Heat oil, vinegar, celery seed and salt to a rolling boil., Pour immediately over cabbage., Store in refrigerator., Keeps 10 days.

title: Spaghetti Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients in large bowl., Set over night or for several hours in the refrigerator., Eat cold.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
directions: Peel potatoes and slice medium thin., In saucepan, melt butter., Blend in flour and add milk., Stir until boiling., Add cheese, salt and pepper., Put sliced potatoes and onion in buttered baking dish., Pour cheese sauce over these and bake at 375°, uncovered, for 1 hour or until potatoes are done.

title: Champagne Punch
directions: Mix together in punch bowl the Sauterne, champagne and soda. Drop in strawberries., Makes 18 to 20 servings.

title: Squaw Corn
directions: Cut bacon across strip into 1/4-inch pieces. Chop onion and pepper about the same size. Fry bacon; drain. Discard half of the bacon fat., Add liquid from corn and chopped vegetables., Cook over medium-high heat until thick syrup forms on bottom of pan, stirring frequently. Add corn, bacon, pimento, salt, pepper and chiles. Stir to mix and continue cooking until corn is heated through., ("Great for company.")

title: Four Fruit Float
directions: Use fresh or frozen berries., Put all ingredients into blender container., Blend until smooth., Serves 4.

title: Yummy Potatoes
directions: Shred potatoes. Mix soup, sour cream, cheese, butter, salt and pepper. Mix all together in casserole dish. Top with crushed crackers mixed with butter. Bake in preheated oven at 350° for about 1 1/2 hours.

title: Triple Layer Mud Pie
directions: Pour chocolate and sweetened condensed milk into bowl; stir until smooth and pour into crust., Press nuts evenly onto chocolate in the crust and refrigerate 10 minutes., Pour milk into large bowl and add pudding mixes., Beat with wire whisk for 2 minutes or until smooth., Mixture will be thick., Spread 1 1/2 cups of the pudding over nuts and chocolate layer in crust. Immediately stir half of the whipped topping into remaining pudding., Spread over pudding in crust., Top with remaining whipped topping., Refrigerate 3 hours or until set.

title: Pepper Jelly
directions: Mix all but Certo., Boil for 1 minute., Add Certo and boil for 2 minutes., Put in clean jars and seal.

title: Golden Punch
directions: Mix well., Chill. Serve over ice. Serves 75.

title: Old-Timey Biscuits
directions: Sift flour and cut lard into mixture., Add sugar and buttermilk; mix well with hands., Roll out and place apart on baking sheet that has been greased with margarine., Bake at 450° for about 18 minutes, or until brown on the bottom, then broil tops until golden brown., Brush margarine over the tops while hot.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Mix butter, sugar, cocoa and milk., Boil hard for 1 minute. Remove from heat and add vanilla and oats., Drop by spoon on waxed paper.

title: Egg Custard
directions: Mix well and pour into unbaked pie crust., Slice 3/4 stick margarine on top., Bake in 425 degree oven for 30 minutes or till set.

title: Microwave Toasted Butter Pecans
directions: In a 1 1/2-quart casserole place pecan halves., Sprinkle with seasoned salt., Cut butter into 4 pieces and arrange evenly over top., Microwave at High 5 to 6 minutes. Mix to evenly distribute butter., Serve warm or cold.

title: Pecan Fudge Pie
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., In small saucepan, over low heat, melt chocolate pieces, stirring occasionally., In medium bowl, beat together next 5 ingredietns., Slowly add melted chocolate, stirring rapidly with wire whisk or spoon., Fold in pecans.

title: Pineapple Roast
directions: In electric skillet, brown roast on all sides in butter., Pour enough water to cover roast; simmer 2 to 3 hours., Add more water during simmering if necessary., Drain water (if any) and place potatoes in skillet with roast., Pour in pineapple juice., Cook until juice becomes thick-like sauce and potatoes are tender.

title: Carrot Casserole
directions: Cook carrots until just tender., Place carrots into buttered casserole., Sprinkle raw onions over carrots., Spread mayonnaise mixed with lemon juice over carrots and onions; pepper to taste. Add grated Cheddar cheese., Top with bread crumbs., Bake for 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Grandpa'S Goulash
directions: Cook hamburger and onions until brown; drain., Stir in tomatoes and juice, green peppers, water, mushrooms, salt, sugar, chili powder and macaroni., Heat to boiling; reduce heat and simmer about 30 minutes., If needed, add more water.

title: The Great Pumpkin Cookie
directions: Cream butter., Gradually add sugars., Beat until light and fluffy., Add egg and vanilla., Mix well., Add dry ingredients. Mix., Add pumpkin., Stir in chocolate chips.

title: Beef Stew(Caldereta Style)
directions: Cut beef into desired sizes., Marinate for an hour or two with: garlic, vinegar, soy sauce, peppercorn or powder, salt to taste, Pirim's sauce (squeeze of liquid from meat and fry with just enough oil until brown)., Then add a little water (enough to cook), sliced onion, pickles, olives, tomato sauce or paste, bay leaf, red pepper (sliced), the liquid off the meat and a little sugar., Cook until tender (pressure cooker only 15 minutes)., This is a Philippine food.

title: Broccoli Raisin Salad
directions: Rinse broccoli well and cut flowerets into bite-size pieces. Toss with raisins, onion and crisp bacon pieces., Combine cream cheese and remaining ingredients in blender., Pour over broccoli. Mix well., Serve well chilled.

title: Banana Cream Supreme
directions: Use only butter or margarine.

title: Cheesy Mostaccioli
directions: Mix Ragu sauce and Cheddar cheese soup with 2 cups of Mozzarella cheese in baking dish., Drain grease off ground beef. Mix ground beef in sauce., Add cooked noodles; mix well., Top with 2 cups of Mozzarella cheese., Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

title: Vanilla Wafers
directions: About 1 1/2 hours before serving or up to 1 week ahead: Preheat oven to 350°., In medium bowl with mixer at low speed, beat all ingredients until blended, occasionally scraping bowl with rubber spatula., Drop dough by 2 teaspoons about 2 inches apart, onto ungreased cookie sheets., Bake cookies 10 to 12 minutes until edges of cookies are browned., With pancake turner, remove cookies.

title: Annie'S Pound Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Spray Pam on a 10-inch tube pan., Have all ingredients at room temperature., Cream together the butter, shortening and sugar., Add extracts., Beat in eggs, one at a time, beating well after each., Sift flour with baking powder and salt; add to egg mixture alternately with milk., Blend well after each addition., Pour batter into prepared pan., Bake for 1 hour at 350°., Cool 15 minutes before turning gently onto plate.

title: Caramel, Coconut, Pecan Pie
directions: Bake and cool pie crusts., Toast chopped pecans and coconut. Mix Cool Whip, condensed milk and cream cheese., Put a layer of this mixture in bottom of crusts, then sprinkle in pecans and coconut., Next, drizzle caramel topping over all., Layer again, starting with cream cheese mixture and ending with caramel topping. Freeze., Take out about 30 minutes before serving.

title: Georgia Brown Bread
directions: Cut up dates and sprinkle soda over dates., Pour water over them., Let stand until cool.

title: Spinach Dip
directions: Thaw spinach and drain well (squeeze liquid out of spinach, if necessary)., Mix with other ingredients and refrigerate for several hours before serving.

title: Quick Cheeseburger Bake
directions: Heat oven to 400., Grease rectangular baking dish, 13x9x2 inches., Cook beef and onion in 10 inch skillet over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until beef is brown., Drain., Stir in soup, vegetables and milk., Remove from heat.

title: Polka Dot Pudding
directions: Combine water, fruit juice, Minute tapioca, sugar and salt in saucepan and mix well., Bring mixture quickly to a boil over direct heat., Stir all the time and remove from heat after boiling., Do not overcook., Will be thin., Put in pineapple and nuts., Stir occasionally until cool.

title: Cabbage Slaw
directions: Mix well and serve chilled., Yield:, 8 to 10 servings.

title: Microwave Peanut Butter Fudge
directions: In 2-quart casserole, add oleo, peanut butter and vanilla. Put in microwave on High power for 3 minutes., Remove from microwave and stir in sugar., Press in container., Let cool., Cut in squares.

title: Buttercream Frosting
directions: Put all in mixer bowl., Stir on slow to combine., Beat well.

title: Peanut Butter Round Up
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Combine shortening and sugar in mixing bowl., Beat until light and fluffy., Add eggs and beat until well blended in peanut butter., Sift together flour, salt and soda. Combine with peanut butter., Stir in oats., Roll dough to form small balls., Bake on ungreased cookie sheet., With fork, press cookie balls., If dough sticks to fork, dip in flour. Bake for about 12 minutes.

title: D-Gumdrop Fruit Cake
directions: Cut gumdrops into small pieces., Cream butter and sugar together., Add well beaten eggs., Add flour and applesauce alternately., Stir in baking soda and 1 teaspoon vanilla., Fold in nuts, raisins and gumdrops (chopped candied cherries and candied pineapple may be added for variety)., Bake slowly in about 250° oven approximately 3 hours., Will make 4 small loaves or one large tube pan., I use all orange slices, 2 pounds.

title: Chili Chicken
directions: In a large skillet, saute poultry in oil until no longer pink. Set aside., In same skillet, cook onion, peppers and garlic until tender. Drain. Stir in chili and tomatoes., Add rice and pepper sauce., Arrange chicken on top., Simmer 10 minutes., Top with shredded cheese., Serves 6.

title: Chicken Noodle Soup
directions: Combine chicken, water, broth, half of the celery, carrots, onions, green pepper, pepper and bay leaf; bring to a boil. Simmer 2 1/2 hours or until chicken is tender. Remove chicken. When cool enough to handle, remove meat from bones and cut up. Set chicken aside. Strain broth and skim fat. Return to kettle. Add salt and remaining ingredients. Simmer 10 to 12 minutes. Add noodles and chicken. Simmer 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Squash Casserole
directions: Saute onion in butter., Boil squash until tender., Melt soup and cheese into onions., Add squash, beaten egg and crumbled crackers., Salt and pepper to taste., Place mixture in casserole dish and bake at 350° uncovered until light brown on top.

title: Easy Chicken Pie
directions: Place chicken in a 13 x 9-inch greased baking dish., Mix soup and broth., Pour over chicken., Break eggs over this.

title: Seafood Platter
directions: Serve as they come from the can on the crackers.

title: Lemon Fluff
directions: Chill the evaporated milk, unopened, in refrigerator until icy cold.

title: Marinated Artichokes
directions: Mix all ingredients and allow to marinate for at least 2 hours., Serve with crackers., (Better if made 1 or 2 days ahead.)

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
directions: Slowly melt butter being careful not to burn., Add brown sugar while butter is still warm., If brown sugar is clumpy, place with butter in microwave until sugar softens., Add eggs and vanilla and beat until creamy and of a slightly lighter color., In separate bowl, mix dry ingredients together and add to mixture., Fold in chips., Place 2-inch balls on ungreased sheet and bake at 325° for about 12 to 15 minutes., Take out and cool for one minute.

title: Heavenly Onions
directions: Butter bread on both sides. Saut onions in 2 tablespoons butter. Butter 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Layer mushrooms, onions, cheese and bread. Mix soup, milk and soy sauce and pour over top. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Bake uncovered at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Company Goodies
directions: Mix first 3 ingredients and place in greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle nuts over mixture., Mix cream cheese and box confectioners sugar and spread over nuts., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes., When cool, cut in squares.

title: Dessert Pizza
directions: Slice cookie dough 1/4 inch thick., Arrange slices close together in pizza pan., Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes until light brown., Cool completely.

title: Carrot Salad
