directions: Slice carrots and cook in salted water only until barely tender., (Do not overcook.), Drain., Combine soup, sugar, vinegar and seasonings; blend well and slowly add salad oil while beating until well mixed., Add to vegetables and let set overnight in refrigerator.

title: Tuna Noodle Casserole
directions: Cook noodles according to directions on package., Drain., Stir in tuna, celery, mayonnaise, onion, green pepper and salt., In saucepan, combine soup and milk; heat through., Add cheese., Heat and stir until cheese melts., Add to noodle mixture., Turn into 2-quart casserole., Bake, uncovered, in a 425° oven for 20 minutes., Makes 6 servings.

title: Low-Fat Potato Salad
directions: Combine veggies in a large bowl., Mix together mayonnaise, mustard, milk, salt, pepper and celery seed., Mix until smooth. Pour over veggies and toss to coat., Chill (overnight is best.) The dressing should be a pale yellow color and slightly thin.

title: Cantaloupe Meringue Pie
directions: Bake pastry shell 9 to 11 minutes., Let cool., Beat 4 egg whites, at room temperature, and cream of tartar at high speed on mixer for 1 minute., Gradually add 1/2 cup sugar, 1 tablespoon at a time, beating until stiff peaks form, 2 to 4 minutes., Combine egg yolks, cantaloupe and next 6 ingredients in a heavy saucepan; stir well., Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until thick and bubbly., Remove from heat; stir in vanilla., Pour mixture into prepared pie shell., Spread meringue over hot filling, sealing to edge of pastry., Bake at 400° for 8 minutes, until browned., Let cool.

title: Laplands
directions: Grease muffin tin very thoroughly., Sift flour and salt together., Separate, eggs, and, beat, yolks, until, thick, and creamy., Whip the, cream, until, it, holds its shape., Now add flour and whipped cream to the egg yolks alternately beginning and ending with the flour., Whip egg whites until stiff., Dump egg batter on, top of whites and mix with your hands until all the white patches have disappeared., Work quickly., Spoon into muffin tin, filling half full., Bake in preheated oven at 375° for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Lay cooked chicken pieces in bottom of casserole dish., Spread mushroom soup over chicken., Heat 1 can cream of chicken soup with 1 can water or chicken broth., Add 1 package bread crumbs., Spread over top., Bake at 350° for about 35 minutes.

title: Salmon Pie
directions: Combine salmon, onions and butter; mix thoroughly., Add potatoes and mash., Stir in milk; whip until smooth., Spread mixture in prepared pastry shells; top with crust and crimp edges to seal., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes., Pie may be frozen., Yields 12 to 16 servings.

title: Angel Food Candy
directions: Boil until syrup reaches 300° on candy thermometer., Take from heat., Add 1 tablespoon soda., Pour on a buttered cookie sheet. When hard, break in pieces and dip.

title: Chipped Beef Appetizer
directions: Combine all ingredients., Bake 30 to 40 minutes at 350°. Serve with crackers.

title: Bacon, Cheese And Macaroni Bake
directions: Cook bacon until crisp., Cool and crumble., Cook macaroni according to directions., Combine macaroni, crumbled bacon and tomato sauce., Cut cheese up in pieces and mix in with other ingredients., Put in a 2-quart casserole dish sprayed with Pam and bake at 350° for about 30 minutes, until cheese is melted.

title: Corn Kalasky Soup
directions: Mix egg, sugar, 1/2 teaspoon salt and flour., Bring water and 1 cup, milk to a boil., Have batter ready., Drop into boiling mixture gently., Turn heat down., Dumplings go to bottom of pan (cover)., Add butter, corn and 1 cup milk., Cook until warmed through.

title: Old-Fashioned Gingerbread
directions: Preheat the oven to 350°. Beat butter at medium speed of an electric mixer until light and fluffy. Gradually add sugar, beating well. Add eggs and molasses, mixing well. Combine flour and next 4 ingredients. Add to butter mixture alternately with hot water, beginning and ending with flour mixture. Mix after each addition. Pour batter into a greased and floured 8-inch square pan. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Serve with whipped cream. Makes 9 servings.

title: Surprise Sandwiches
directions: Prepare the night before., Grease an 8 x 10-inch pan with butter or oleo., Place 6 slices of bread (crusts removed) in bottom of pan., Cover each slice with a slice of American cheese. Then spread each with prepared mustard and cover with any of the listed meats., Butter 6 more slices of bread and place on top, buttered side up.

title: Crab Bisque Soup
directions: Blend soups., Stir in milk and cream., Heat just to boiling. Add crab., Heat., Stir in wine just before serving., Serves 6 to 8.

title: Veal Parmigiana
directions: Pound cutlets until they reach 3 x 3-inch size., Dip meat into egg and milk mixture, then dip into 3/4 cup dry seasoned bread crumbs., Sprinkle freely with Parmesan cheese; allow to stand 15 minutes., Saute in butter or oil until crisp (2 to 4 minutes, each side)., Place in baking sheet, top with your favorite spaghetti sauce and Mozzarella cheese., Place in preheated oven until cheese melts., Serves 4 to 5.

title: Jim'S Mother'S Beet Pickles
directions: Cook beets., Peel and cut., Pour liquid over and bring to boil, then put in jars and seal.

title: Liver Pat
directions: Saut chicken livers and onions until done, but not browned. Cool slightly., Puree 1 cup at a time in blender., Stir in salt, dry mustard, pepper and butter., Refrigerate.

title: Half Moon Cookies
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes., Frost 1/2 chocolate and 1/2 white frosting.

title: Stew
directions: Put 2 to 3 cups hot water in large stew pan., Add potatoes, carrots and onions (all peeled and diced)., When halfway tender, add tomato sauce, corn, beef stew mix and hamburger meat., Add salt and pepper to taste., Cook on low heat until ready.

title: Dill Sweet Pickles
directions: Pour juice off pickles and discard. Rinse with cold water. Put in large bowl or crock and add remaining ingredients. Stir well until the sugar dissolves. Let stand for 4 days, stirring daily. Pack in sterilized jars or put them back in the gallon jar they came in and store in refrigerator.

title: Quick "N" Hearty Mushroom Soup
directions: Saute mushrooms in a little oil; set aside., Brown hamburger, draining off fat., Add tomatoes, mushroom mix, broth, water and seasonings., Bring to boil., Reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, for 5 minutes., Stir in rice and cover., Set aside for 5 minutes. Makes 9 cups.

title: Pineapple Casserole
directions: Drain pineapple and save juice., Put pineapple in a butter dish., Mix sugar and flour and sprinkle over pineapple and add 1 cup pineapple juice., Pour over., Put a cup of grated cheese., Melt 1 stick of butter and 2 tablespoons of brown sugar and stir up crushed crackers (Ritz)., Sprinkle over the ingredients., Bake 40 minutes at 325°.

title: White Buttermilk Sheet Cake
directions: Cream sugar and shortening., Add vanilla and then salt., Add egg whites one at a time, beating after each one., Beat in 2 tablespoons flour., Add 3/4 cup buttermilk with baking soda added. Add remaining flour and buttermilk alternately., Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes in 10 x 15-inch sheet cake pan that has been greased and floured., Cool and frost with buttercream frosting.

title: 5 Cup Fruit Salad
directions: Blend all ingredients; chill and serve.

title: Oven Barbecue Hamburgers
directions: Mix all ingredients and make medium size patties., Brown in small amount of cooking oil and set aside., Make the sauce.

title: Pound Cake
directions: Cream first 3 ingredients together., Add eggs, one at a time. Beat after each egg., Add cake flour, 1/2 cup at a time., Beat each time., Add lemon or almond extract., Bake at 325° for 1 hour in greased, floured Bundt pan.

title: Chicken And Sour Cream Enchiladas
directions: Cook and cube chicken., Mix together all ingredients, except cheese and tortillas., Put a little of the mixture in the bottom of pan (so they don't stick)., Put 2 tablespoons of mixture in tortilla and some of the cheese, roll and place in pan., After all are rolled up, spread rest of sauce and cheese on top., Bake for about 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Pistachio Microwave Cake
directions: Grease 9 x 9 x 2-inch or tube microwavable cake pan with solid shortening and line with waxed paper., Blend water, egg whites and oil., Stir in cake mix and pudding until well blended., Microwave on turntable 9 minutes., Let stand 5 minutes., Remove from microwave and cool until warm to touch., Turn out on cake plate and remove waxed paper., Frost with cream cheese frosting, if desired.

title: Texas Beans
directions: Brown ground beef; drain well., Combine everything together. Bake in a 9 x 13 inch baking dish at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: No Bake Chocolate Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Mix sugar and cocoa., Add milk and margarine., Bring to a boil for 2 1/2 to 3 minutes., Add vanilla and oatmeal., Remove from heat., Spoon out on wax paper., Let cool., Cookies will harden while cooling., Yield: 2, dozen.

title: Oatmeal Pecan Cookies
directions: Bring to a boil first 4 items., Boil 1 minute and remove from heat., Add remaining ingredients., Beat until well mixed., Drop by spoonfuls on wax paper., Let stand for 30 minutes.

title: Christmas Jubilee
directions: Whip the Dream Whip. Add sugar and cream cheese., Mix well. In deep dish, put 1 layer of ladyfingers., Spread with mixture. Cover with pie filling., Repeat in layers., Chill at least 3 hours. Serves 10 to 12.

title: Lasagna
directions: Brown ground beef in oil in a large skillet, stirring to crumble., Drain off pan dripping., Stir in tomatoes, tomato paste and seasonings into meat., Bring to a boil., Reduce heat and simmer 40 minutes, stirring occasionally.

title: Dishpan Cookies
directions: Cream together first 5 ingredients., Add flour, soda and salt to mixture., Fold in oats, then corn flakes., Bake at 350° for 7 to 8 minutes., Makes 100 (2 1/2-inch) cookies., "A dishpan full!"

title: Mexi-Corn Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients except cheese., Pour into lightly greased 9 x 13-inch dish., Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes., Sprinkle cheese on top and bake until melted.

title: Beef Stew
directions: Cut first 7, ingredients, into bite size pieces., Place meat and vegetables layered, in	a roaster or flat in a casserole with lid., Mix remaining ingredients together., Pour over vegetables and meat., Cover., Bake, at 250° for 4 hours undisturbed.

title: Chicken Broccoli Bake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Cook and drain broccoli., Place in bottom of greased, glass baking dish (13 x 9-inch)., Arrange cooked chicken on top., Mix together soup, mayonnaise, curry powder and lemon juice., Pour mixture over chicken and broccoli. Top with shredded cheese, bread crumbs and paprika., Bake 30 minutes or until bubbly.

title: No Fail Yeast Rolls
directions: Stir yeast, salt and sugar into flour., Heat milk until hot to touch., Add milk and oil to dry ingredients, beating until well blended, for about 5 minutes., Then with a spoon, add as much flour as needed., Turn out onto a floured surface and knead until smooth. Place into a greased or oiled bowl and cover with a towel., Let rise until double., Punch down and turn out onto a floured surface. Roll out; cut with a biscuit cutter., Put into oiled pan and let rise until double., Cook at 400° until brown.

title: Rotel Chicken Casserole
directions: Cook chicken until tender., Debone chicken and reserve 1 quart of chicken broth., Cook spaghetti in chicken broth until tender, do not drain., Saute bell pepper and onion in margarine., Add to spaghetti., Add other ingredients including chicken and cheese (cut cheese into small pieces)., Pour into 1 large or 2 small casserole dishes., Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes., This dish freezes well.

title: Lime Cookies
directions: Cream margarine and confectioners sugar. Add vanilla, lime juice and zest of limes. Combine flour, cornstarch and salt. Mix into butter mixture. Roll batter onto wax paper. Refrigerate. Slice and bake 12 to 15 minutes at 350°. Coat with confectioners sugar.

title: Strawberry Glaze Pie
directions: In a 9-inch pan place Bisquick and soft butter., Pour boiling water over this and stir with fork until soft-ball., Pat dough in pan over the edge.	Bake 8 to 10 minutes in 450° oven.

title: Sweet Potato Chips
directions: Peel and wash yams., Slice as thin as possible, the thinner, the better., Heat oil in a deep frying pan; let oil get very hot. Place chips in oil until golden brown., Place cooked chips on a paper towel., Salt to taste and serve.

title: Okra And Tomatoes
directions: Put fat in skillet. Add onions and tomatoes. Sprinkle with salt and pepper and sugar. Add okra and cover; simmer until okra is tender, about 5 minutes. Stir all together. Serve hot.

title: Perfect Every Time Beef Stew
directions: Put all ingredients in casserole and bake, covered, at 300° for 3 hours., One hour prior to finish, add the potatoes (cut in halves)., Serves 6.

title: Frying Dip And Coating For Seafood
directions: *For tenderizer trick add a 7 ounce can of beer to the dip.

title: Appetizer Pie
directions: Blend cheese and milk., Stir in dried beef, onion and pepper. Mix well., Add sour cream., Spoon into 8-inch pie plate., Sprinkle walnuts over top and bake at 350° for 15 minutes., Serve with crackers as a dip.

title: Cheezy Chicken
directions: Dip boneless chicken breasts in butter, then roll in cracker crumbs., Place in baking dish., Cover and bake at 350° for 1 to 1 1/4 hours.

title: Very Best Burrito
directions: Combine milk and pudding mix and blend 1 minute., Let stand 5 minutes., Fold in 2 cups of Cool Whip., Add about 1 1/2 cups of strawberries., In bowl combine sugar and cinnamon., Butter both sides of tortillas., Sprinkle one side with the sugar/cinnamon mixture., Put in 350° oven, sugar/cinnamon side up, only about 2 minutes until bubbly., Take out of oven and let stand 3 to 4 minutes., Fill shells with sugar side out., Top each with Cool Whip and add sliced strawberries.

title: Old-Fashioned Custard Pie
directions: Beat lightly; pour into 9-inch unbaked crust., Bake for about 40 minutes or until knife inserted into side of filling comes out clean., Center is soft, but will set later., Bake in 450° oven for 15 minutes, then at 350° to finish.

title: Rum Cake
directions: Cream shortening and sugar; add eggs, one at a time beating and mixing thoroughly., Sift flour, salt, soda and baking powder; add buttermilk and rum flavoring., Add vanilla., Pour into tube pan and bake at 325° for 1 hour or until done.

title: Harvest Soup
directions: Add all ingredients except tomatoes to boiling water., Cover and boil gently for 15 minutes., Break up large pieces of tomato and add to vegetable mixture., Continue cooking until vegetables are tender, about 20 minutes., Remove bay leaf and serve with grated Parmesan cheese., Makes 4 servings, 1 cup each.

title: Small Apple Crisp
directions: Lightly spray 8 x 8 pan; place apple in pan and sprinkle with lemon juice and water., Combine remaining ingredients and cover apples., Bake at 375° for 40 to 45 minutes or until apples are done and brown.

title: Barbecued Sweet Potatoes
directions: Wash and scrub potatoes., Cut slits in tops., Place each potato in a piece of aluminum foil, wrapping securely., Cook 6-inches from heat, tops down, for 20 minutes., Turn and pierce foil tops with a fork., Cook for 20 to 25 minutes or longer, until done., Cut foil open., Combine cloves and butter., Frizzle over tops., Let stand for 5 minutes before serving., Serves 6.

title: Two-Handed Cookies
directions: Beat eggs; add sugars, peanut butter, oleo, soda and vanilla. Mix well., Stir in remaining ingredients; mix thoroughly., Drop dough on ungreased cookie sheet., Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Spinach Casserole
directions: Spinach should be thawed and drained., Margarine should be melted., Mix ingredients together, except Ritz., Place in casserole dish., Top ingredients with crushed Ritz crackers., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Blintz Souffle
directions: Place blintzes (partially defrost) in baking dish., Blend remaining ingredients and pour over blintzes., Bake at 350° for about 45 minutes (mixture should be set)., Serves 6 to 8.

title: Red Cabbage - German Style(Sweet And Sour)
directions: Cut cabbage in half and slice thin., Place in a large kettle of boiling water for 10 minutes., Drain., Put cabbage back in pot and add all other ingredients., Pour the boiling water on last. Bring all to a boil and simmer for 2 to 3 hours., Be sure to use a close-fitting lid.

title: Zucchini Lasagne
directions: Cook zucchini in boiling salt water for 5 minutes., Cook beef and garlic, stir in spices and sauce., Mix Ricotta, egg and parsley., Place 1/2 zucchini in greased 8-inch square baking pan. Sprinkle with bread crumbs., Spread 1/2 of Ricotta, 1/2 of beef mixture and 1/2 of Mozzarella., Repeat., Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes., Yields 5 to 6 servings.

title: Pineapple Cream Cheese Pie
directions: Cream the cream cheese, sugar and vanilla., Add eggs, one at a time., Add drained pineapple, then add cherries and nuts; mix well., Pour into crust., Bake at 325° for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Mixed Fruit Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Let stand in refrigerator.

title: Hash Brown Casserole
directions: Mix in 9 x 13-inch pan and bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: German-Style New Potato Salad
directions: Peel strip around center of each potato., Cook potatoes in boiling water., Drain., Halve any large potatoes., In bowl, combine cooked potatoes, lettuce, curly endive, eggs, radishes and green onion.

title: Corn Casserole
directions: Mix all dry ingredients together; add eggs and butter., Add milk., Put in well-greased dish and bake at 350° until thick, about an hour.

title: Christmas Pumpkin Bread
directions: Combine oil, eggs, 1/2 cup water., Stir in the rest of ingredients and put in greased loaf pan., Bake at 250° for one hour.

title: Butterfinger Delight
directions: Melt margarine and mix with graham cracker crumbs., (Before mixing together, set aside 1/4 cup of crumbs.) Press in a 10 x 13-inch pan.

title: Pepper Steak
directions: Mix egg and milk; dip steak in and then in flour., Brown lightly in shortening., Add onions and green peppers to meat in shortening., Add water and soup; simmer for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Squash Casserole
directions: Cook squash in a little water and salt., Drain and mix with soup, onion and carrot., Grease a 9 x 12-inch casserole dish and put in all ingredients., Put 1/2 package of stuffing over top and bake 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Hot Deviled Potatoes
directions: Prepare potatoes according to package directions., Heat sour cream but do not boil., Add mustard, salt and sugar., Stir to blend and add to hot potatoes., Stir in onion., Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes., Serves 4.

title: Banana Split Cake
directions: Mix cake according to directions, with the exception of using milk instead of water., Bake in a 9 x 13-inch cake pan., Bring to a boil the pineapple and sugar., When cake is done, punch holes in it and pour pineapple mixture over cake., Let set long enough to cool., Mix pudding according to package directions with the exception of leaving out 1 cup of milk., Mix softened cream cheese and pudding with mixer., Spread over top of pineapple mixture on cake., Slice bananas over cake., Sprinkle with coconut, pecans and cherries.

title: Banberry Surprise
directions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water., Add strawberry soda pop and cool completely., Mix cake according to package directions (do not use cake mix with pudding in it)., Bake in 13 1/2 x 9 1/2 x 2 inch greased and floured pan., Let cool completely., After cake is cooled, using potato peeler, poke lots of holes all the way to the bottom., Pour gelatin and soda pop mixture over cake., Cover entire top of cake with thick sliced bananas.

title: Broccoli Salad
directions: Cut broccoli; do not cook., Mix in bacon, onion and cheese. Mix together mayo, sugar and vinegar and pour over broccoli. Chill., Serves 6 to 8.

title: Senate Bean Soup
directions: Heat beans and water to boiling; reduce heat., Boil uncovered for 2 minutes; remove from heat., Cover and let stand 1 hour, or cover beans with water and let soak overnight., Drain and add 10 cups fresh water., Add salt meat to beans and water., Heat to boiling; reduce heat., Cover and simmer about 2 hours or until beans are tender., Stir in remaining ingredients., Cover and simmer 1 hour., Makes 12 servings; contains 1 gram fat per serving.

title: Mother'S Cheese Cake
directions: Mix cream cheese, 1 cup sugar, eggs and 1 teaspoon vanilla. Bake at 375° for 20 minutes., Let cool 15 minutes., Mix sour cream, 2 tablespoons sugar and 1 teaspoon vanilla; pour over cake. Bake 3 to 5 minutes more at 475°.

title: Cheesy Potato Casserole
directions: Cook potatoes in boiling water 30 minutes or until tender. Drain; let cool to touch., Peel and cut into 1/4 inch strips; set aside., Combine 1/4 cup butter and next 5 ingredients in a large bowl; gently stir in potatoes and cheese., Spoon into a lightly greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish., Combine 3 tablespoons butter and stuffing mix; sprinkle over potato mixture., Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 25 minutes or until thoroughly heated., Yields 8 servings.

title: Homemade Ice Cream
directions: Line a Pyrex pie pan or round Corning Ware dish with large size tortilla round., Pour in a can of peaches, cherries, plums or blackberries, sweeten to taste., Tear the second tortilla round into pieces and stick down into fruit., Pat generously with butter., Cut strips from another tortilla and lay on top. Sprinkle with sugar and again pat generously with margarine., Bake at 375° for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Vidalia Onion Casserole
directions: Preheat, oven, to, 350°., Saute, onion rings in 1/4 cup butter., Combine, remaining, butter, with, cracker, crumbs. Reserve 1/4, of, crumb mixture for topping and layer remaining crumbs into, bottom, of greased 9 x 13-inch casserole., Spread sauteed onion rings over crumb layer and sprinkle with cheese, salt and paprika., Combine eggs and milk and pour over layers. Top with reserved crumb mixture and bake 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Nacho Cheese Chowder
directions: In a 2-quart microwave-safe casserole, crumble meat., Add the green pepper., Cook in microwave, covered, on High for 2 to 3 minutes until no pink remains in meat, stirring once or twice. Drain off the fat., Stir in nacho cheese soup, milk, corn, chopped tomato and minced onion., Cook, covered, on High for 7 to 10 minutes or until chowder is heated through, stirring once., Makes 3 main dish servings., Serve with corn chips.

title: Pineapple Fluff Pie
directions: Soak gelatine in cold water 5 minutes., Beat egg yolks with 1/4 cup sugar., Add pineapple, lemon juice and salt., Cook on low heat until consistency of custard., Add softened gelatine, stir and cool., Beat egg whites until white and foamy., Add remaining sugar gradually and continue beating until glossy and holds soft peaks. When mixture begins to thicken, fold in egg whites., Beat whipping cream and fold in., Pour into baked pie crust and refrigerate.

title: Pralines
directions: Cook all ingredients, except pecans and vanilla, to soft ball stage (240°).

title: Pineapple Crush Cake
directions: Cake:, Preheat oven to 350°., Grease and flour two 13 x 9 x 2-inch pans., Prepare cake as directed on package., Divide evenly in pans., Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes., Cool.

title: Easy Chicken Pie
directions: Preheat oven to 400°., Grease a shallow 2-quart baking dish. Stir together soup, chicken and vegetables in dish., Combine flour, milk and butter., Stir until smooth., Pour over mixture in dish., Bake 40 to 45 minutes or until brown.

title: Pecan Pie
directions: Mix ingredients and pour into pie shell., Bake until center is firm.

title: Hardee'S Biscuits
directions: Mix all ingredients together and roll out on floured board. Cut out and bake at 350° until light brown on greased cookie sheet, about 12 to 15 minutes., Makes 14 biscuits.

title: Willie'S Homemade Boiled Chicken And Rice
directions: Boil chicken thighs for 1 hour and 45 minutes., Stir in 2 cups rice., Cook, covered, for 20 minutes longer., Ready to serve.

title: Apricot Foldovers
directions: Add cut-up margarine to flour., Make well in flour; add egg yolks and sugar that's been mixed together., Mix with fingers; sprinkle with 2 tablespoons cold water., Continue to work with fingers., Make into a ball, wrap in wax paper and refrigerate until chilled., Preheat oven to 325°., Take dough out and divide into 2 balls; refrigerate one., Roll part of dough to about 1/8-inch thickness on slightly floured surface., Cut into 2 1/2-inch rounds., Put rounds on slightly greased cookie sheet., In center of each, put 1/2 teaspoon of apricot preserves and pinch around edge or use fork., Brush top with mixture of egg and milk. Sprinkle with nuts., Bake 18 to 20 minutes or until lightly brown. Remove from rack., Cool., Makes about 5 dozen.

title: Martha Washington Balls
directions: Mix sugar, butter, milk, vanilla and nuts., Roll into balls and chill., Drop in melted candy coating., Spoon onto wax paper.

title: R C'S Fudge
directions: Cook in 2-quart pan, stirring constantly, over medium heat until mixture comes to a full boil., Boil and stir 5 minutes. Take off heat; stir in 6 ounces chips, vanilla and nuts., Pour in greased pan.

title: Cream Cheese Cut-Out Cookies
directions: Blend well with spoon the oleo, cream cheese and sour cream. Gradually add sugar, continuing to beat until light., Add egg yolks (slightly beaten with vanilla)., Beat until light and fluffy., Add flour sifted with baking powder and salt and mix

title: Angel Biscuits
directions: Dissolve yeast and sugar in lukewarm water. Add the remaining ingredients. This will keep in refrigerator for 1 week. Dip out needed amount in flour; pinch off and place in greased skillet. Bake in 400° oven for 10 minutes.

title: Almond Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Mix flour, baking soda and salt., In a blender, grind 1/2 cup blanched almonds to a fine powder, add to flour mixture., Cream the sugar, shortening, almond extract, egg and water and add to dry mixture., Mix thoroughly., Form into 1-inch balls and place on an ungreased cookie sheet 2 inches apart. Press one of the remaining almonds into the center of each ball while flattening it slightly with fingers., Brush cookie with beaten egg., Bake 20 minutes or until light brown.

title: Chocolate Chip Angel Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Cream sugars, margarine and shortening. Beat in egg and vanilla., Gradually add flour, soda, cream of tartar and salt mixture., Stir in chocolate chips and nuts (optional)., Bake for 12 to 15 minutes or until firm to touch.

title: Baked Macaroni And Cheese
directions: Cook macaroni according to package directions and drain. Cut margarine and Velveeta into small pieces. Place in pan, still warm from cooking macaroni, and pour warm macaroni over cheese and margarine. Cheese and margarine should melt quickly. Then add 1/2 cup milk. Mix well. Place mixture in a casserole dish and place slices of American cheese on top. Bake at 350° for approximately 20 minutes.

title: 3-Day Brown-N-Bag Coconut Cake
directions: Mix sour cream, sugar and coconut together and keep in refrigerator 24 hours before making cake., Make cake according to directions on box., Make in 3 layers., Let cake layers get completely cool., Spread coconut mixture over layers., Slide cake into turkey-sized brown-n-bag, satin refrigerator bag and let stay for 3 days before serving.

title: Caramel Apple Pie
directions: Combine 10 caramel candies; cut each into 4 pieces., Add 1/3 cup flour., Add 3 cups (cut into 1/2-inch cubes) Jonathan or Rome apples, 2/3 cup caramel ice cream topping and 2 teaspoons lemon juice., Mix well., Bake at 375° on a preheated baking sheet for 40 to 45 minutes., Store at room temperature.

title: Diced Mcintosh Apple Cake
directions: Add sugar to diced apples and let stand for 10 minutes., Sift flour and spices., Blend oil and egg into apple mixture., Add flour mixture all at once., Beat with large spoon until well blended., Pour into a 9-inch well greased pan., Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

title: Cheese Biscuits
directions: Grate cheese., Mix all ingredients., Roll and pinch off marble size. Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes (do not overbake).

title: Homestyle Chicken And Biscuits
directions: In a 1 1/2-quart casserole, combine gravy and poultry seasoning., Stir in chicken and frozen vegetables., Bake at 400° for 15 minutes, or until mixture begins to bubble.

title: Carla'S Five Can Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients., Place in casserole dish., Bake at 375° for 1 hour.

title: Confetti Scalloped Potatoes
directions: In a skillet, melt butter over medium heat., Saute onions until tender., Stir in potatoes, soup and milk., Add cheese, green pepper, pimento and 1/2 cup of the cracker crumbs., Pour in shallow casserole dish., Top with remaining cracker crumbs., Bake at 375° for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Red Beans And Rice
directions: Sort and wash beans., Combine beans and water in large Dutch oven; bring to a boil., Cover; reduce heat to medium and cook 40 minutes., Add next 8 ingredients; cover., Reduce heat and simmer 2 hours, stirring occasionally., Mash most of beans against side of Dutch oven with back of a spoon; stir well., Cover and bring to a boil; reduce heat to medium-high and cook, uncovered an additional hour or until desired degree of doneness, stirring occasionally. Discard bay leaves., Serve over hot cooked rice.

title: Microwave Chicken Divan
directions: Pierce hole in broccoli package and cook 3 minutes in microwave oven., In a mixing bowl, mix soup, sour cream, lemon juice, garlic powder and soy sauce., Set aside., Put rice and broccoli in greased 2-quart casserole dish and add half of the soup mixture., Add chicken and remaining soup mixture. Top with Parmesan cheese and bread crumbs. Cover with plastic wrap. Cook 8 minutes. Turn dish 1/2 turn and cook 6 to 8 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Sugar Cookies
directions: Mix together., Add extra flour if needed., Roll out; cut into shapes., Bake for 7 minutes.

title: Barbecued Ribs
directions: Cook rack of ribs in Dutch oven or regular 350° oven for about 2 1/2 to 3 hours or until done., In a bowl, mix together remaining ingredients., Pour sauce over ribs and bake, uncovered, until brown, about 20 minutes., Keep basting ribs with sauce.

title: Onion Patties
directions: Mix together first six ingredients., Stir in enough cold water for thick batter., Mix in onion and drop by teaspoons into deep fat., Flatten patties slightly as you turn them., Fry to a golden brown.

title: Coconut Pie
directions: Beat eggs well., Add other ingredients., Stir until well blended., Pour into unbaked crust., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Creole Pork Chops
directions: Salt and pepper chops; brown well in skillet, then put in baking dish., Combine remaining ingredients and pour over chops. Bake, uncovered, at 325° for 1 1/2 hours, or until tender., Turn chops after an hour., Have a barbecued taste.

title: Baked Fish
directions: Bake in baking dish covered with foil at 350° for 25 minutes.

title: Beth'S Cheese And Bacon Quiche
directions: Preheat oven to 425°. Sprinkle bacon over bottom of pastry shell. Combine eggs, cream, salt, nutmeg and cayenne pepper in a bowl and beat until thoroughly mixed. Sprinkle cheese over bacon and ladle egg mixture over top. Bake 15 minutes at 425°, lower the heat to 350° and bake another 30 minutes.

title: Cranberry And Apple Salad
directions: Dissolve gelatin and salt in hot water., Break up cranberry sauce with fork., Add the gelatin mixture; chill until thickened. Fold in apples and nuts.

title: Crawfish Casserole
directions: Saute celery, bell pepper and onion in margarine., Combine with tomatoes and steam on low fire., Mix in soup., Cook rice according to directions., Mix rice with tomato-soup mixture., Add grated cheese and crawfish., Bake at 350° about 40 minutes or until bubbling., Don't stir., Enjoy with salad and French bread. Serves 8.

title: Miracle Whip-Up
directions: Brown and cook the ground beef., Add the salad dressing, spaghetti sauce, and cooked macaroni., Heat on medium heat., Top with grated Cheddar cheese., Serves 4 to 6.

title: Bean Dip
directions: Spread beans on serving platter. Mix sour cream with taco seasoning and spread over beans. Cover with shredded cheese and sprinkle with remaining ingredients.

title: Cheese-Pineapple Casserole
directions: Put pineapple in 2-quart casserole dish., Mix flour, sugar and cheese and cover pineapple., Cover this with cracker crumbs. Drizzle margarine over crumbs., Bake at 350° until bubbly, approximately 20 minutes., Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Blueberry Muffins
directions: You will need 2 regular size muffin pans.

title: Peppered Steak
directions: Cut steak in strips., Mix garlic, soy sauce, salt and 1/4 cup water., Add steak., Marinate steaks 1 hour (longer if possible) tossing occasionally., Drain steak., Save the marinade.

title: Lemon Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Mix cake mix according to directions on package and bake in 9 x 13-inch greased cake pan., Let cool thoroughly., Spread with pie filling, then frost with Cool Whip. Keep refrigerated until you serve it.

title: Watergate Salad
directions: Sprinkle pudding over pineapple., Add other ingredients and stir together.

title: Mom'S Special Party Cheese Balls
directions: Cut cheese in small pieces or grate and allow to come to room temperature., In mixing bowl, beat cheese and mayonnaise until smooth and creamy., Add onion, Worcestershire sauce, paprika and parsley., Continue to beat until thoroughly blended., Shape into 2 balls., Roll in nuts., May garnish with olives, cherries or parsley., Freezes well.

title: Peach Cobbler
directions: Cream margarine and sugar together., Sift together flour, baking powder and salt., Stir into margarine mixture with milk. Beat until smooth., Pour into greased baking dish., On top of the batter, place peach slices close together., Pour about 1/4 cup of peach juice over the peaches and batter., Bake 45 minutes at 350°. Serve with milk or ice cream.

title: Broccoli Corn Casserole
directions: Combine broccoli, corn and egg in a bowl; mix well., Place in a casserole., Top with bread crumbs., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes. Sprinkle cheese on top., Bake 15 minutes longer or until cheese is melted.

title: Spicy Hillbilly Rice
directions: In a large kettle (4 to 6-quart), place olive oil over heat (medium-low to medium). Add onion, celery, bell pepper, garlic, basil, salt and pepper. Cook until vegetables are tender-crisp. Stir frequently. Add uncooked rice and stir to blend well. Cook for about 2 minutes. Add tomato juice and chili powder. Stir to blend. Bring to a boil; reduce heat to low, cover and cook until all liquid is absorbed and rice is tender. Serve with shredded Cheddar cheese, if desired. Serves about 8.

title: Southwestern Potatoes
directions: Fry bacon until crisp; drain and crumble. Line 2 large baking sheets with foil.

title: Crumb Crust
directions: Combine crumbs and sugar., Mix in butter., Press firmly on bottom and sides of a 9-inch pie pan. For unbaked crumb crust, chill 1 hour before filling. For baked crumb crust, bake at 375° for 8 minutes. Cool thoroughly before filling., For ease in serving, dip pie pan in warm water for a few seconds, then cut and serve.

title: Kraut Relish
directions: Mix together and store in closed container in refrigerator. Delicious with vegetables.

title: Favorite Chicken
directions: Preheat oven to 325°. Combine cranberry sauce, dressing and soup mix in small mixing bowl and mix well. Spread half the cranberry mixture over bottom of 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Arrange chicken in single layer over prepared layer. Top with remaining cranberry mixture. Bake 30 to 45 minutes until chicken is cooked through. Serve over rice. Yield: 8 servings.

title: Japanese Fruit Pie
directions: Beat eggs and sugar together., Add oleo and mix., Add other ingredients., Add vinegar last., Pour into unbaked pie shell and bake at 300° for 45 minutes.

title: Aloha Slush
directions: Mix all of the ingredients and divide into 4 separate containers and freeze., When serving, add 1 quart of 7-up to each container.

title: The Best Summer Cake
directions: In a 13 x 9-inch pan, bake cake mix according to box direction. While slightly warm, poke holes in cake with a wooden spoon handle and press down flatten cake. Pour crushed pineapple, including juice and spread evenly. Prepare pudding according to box directions, but subtract 1 cup milk. Pour and spread evenly over pineapple. Top with Cool Whip and walnuts. Refrigerate 1 hour prior to serving.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
directions: Melt butter., Add peanut butter then confectioners sugar., Mix well., Put in greased pan (9 x 13-inch or smaller)., Sets up in 1 hour at room temperature.

title: Fresh Squash Casserole
directions: Preheat oven to 350°. Saute squash and onions with the margarine until tender. Drain. Add eggs, milk, salt and pepper. Spoon into a 9 x 13-inch casserole dish and top with cheese and crackers. Bake for 20 minutes.

title: Green Chili Pie
directions: Season meat and onion with salt, pepper and garlic., Cook until mixture is not pink., Drain meat., Place back in skillet. Add the Ro-Tel tomatoes, green chilies and chicken soup., Simmer 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Sour Cream Chicken
directions: Line bottom of baking dish with 6 slices of Armour dried beef. Top with boneless chicken breasts.

title: Tiger Butter(Candy)
directions: Melt vanilla and chocolate almond bark in separate bowls in microwave., Add peanut butter to almond bark and stir in good. Pour vanilla almond bark mixture in deep cookie sheet (pan must be completely dry)., Swirl in chocolate almond bark., Let set on counter., Do not refrigerate!, Cut and serve.

title: Polly'S Sour Cream Banana Nut Bread
directions: Mix first 6 ingredients in bowl, mixing well after each ingredient is added., In another bowl, sift together salt, soda, baking powder and flour., Add alternately with sour cream to first 6 ingredients., Fold in nuts., Bake in two large loaf pans at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Teenage Scramble
directions: Saute ground beef with onion in oil in skillet until ground beef is browned, stirring frequently., Add mushrooms and spinach, mixing well., Stir in eggs gradually., Cook until eggs are set, stirring constantly., Season with salt and pepper., Yields 6 servings.

title: Quick Fruit Crisp
directions: Pour pie filling into 8 x 8 x 2-inch square pan., Mix remaining ingredients with a fork., Sprinkle over fruit., Bake at 400° for about 20 minutes or until light brown.

title: Chicken Soup Mother Didn'T Make
directions: Boil chicken, including heart, gizzard and liver for about 45 minutes., Use enough water to just float the chicken., Remove pan from heat., Take chicken out and let it cool., Save the pot of water., When chicken is cool, pick the meat off the bones (don't start too early or you will invent words the dog won't stay around to hear)., Put chicken meat back into the pot of water., Add the complete soup starter, the vegetables for seasoning and the sliced carrots., Add any leftover veggies found in the fridge., Cover pot and simmer at least 2 hours., Serve with cornbread., It will fix what ails you!

title: My Favorite Fried Potatoes
directions: Fry onions, bacon and mushrooms together, turning frequently until bacon is sufficiently cooked (not crispy)., In a separate frypan, heat vegetable oil on medium-high temperature for 2 to 3 minutes., Season sliced potatoes with paprika, pepper and salt as listed in large bowl., Reduce temperature to low-medium; add sliced potatoes slowly to hot oil; turn potatoes frequently., Fry until light brown color is achieved., Combine all ingredients in one frypan and cook an extra 10 to 15 minutes and serve.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
directions: Cook chicken in seasoned water until tender; reserve broth. Debone. Cook potatoes, celery and carrots in broth until tender. Reserve 3 cups broth. Melt butter and flour; stir a few minutes. Add milk, 3 cups chicken broth, salt and pepper. Mix everything together, including peas. Pour in 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Shape crusts to fit and put them on top; make a few slits. Bake at 400° for 45 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Japanese Fried Rice
directions: Cook the rice following the instructions on the package. This should take about 20 minutes., Pour the rice into a large bowl to let it cool., Scramble the eggs in a small pan over medium heat., chop scrambled chunks of egg into small pea-sized bits with your spatula while cooking., When the rice is cooled, add the peas, carrots, eggs and onion to the bowl. Carefully toss all of the ingredients together. Melt the butter in a large skillet over medium/high heat., When the butter has completely melted, dump the rice mixture into the pan and add the soy sauce plus a dash of salt and pepper., Cook the rice mixture for 6 to 8 minutes, stirring often.

title: Stroganoff Style Pork Chops
directions: In a large skillet on medium heat brown pork in oil for 5 minutes., Remove; keep warm., In the drippings saute onion and mushrooms until tender, stir in water, mustard and salt; bring to boil., Return chops to pan; reduce heat, cover and simmer for 15 minutes, until chops are tender., Remove and keep warm., Combine flour and sour cream until smooth; add to skillet., Bring to a boil; cook and stir 1-2 minutes or until thicken., Serve pork chops and mushroom sauce with noodles.

title: Twice-Baked Italian Cookies
directions: In a bowl, mix sugar, butter, anise seed, liqueur, bourbon, almonds and eggs., Beat to blend. Stir together flour and baking powder. Add to butter mixture and blend thoroughly. Cover and refrigerate dough until firm, 2 to 3 hours.

title: No-Peek Chicken
directions: Grease 9 x 13-inch pan., Sprinkle rice on bottom., Layer chicken, skin side up on rice., Sprinkle onion soup mix over chicken., Mix water with both cans of soup and heat, then pour over chicken., Cover with foil and bake 2 hours at 325° to 350°.

title: Wilted Lettuce
directions: Fry bacon until crispy., Remove from skillet and set aside. Into bacon drippings stir, vinegar, water, sugar, salt, onion and egg., Heat to boiling, stirring constantly., Add lettuce to skillet and toss with hot dressing quickly., Remove to bowl., Crumble bacon on top.

title: Chocolate Chunk Bars
directions: Mix flour, baking soda and salt in medium bowl; set aside.

title: Chow Chow
directions: Grind vegetables and salt., Let stand for 2 hours, then drain. Boil vinegar and spices 5 minutes., Add vegetables and cook slowly 30 to 40 minutes., Seal in hot sterile jars.

title: Old-Fashioned Potato Bread
directions: Make potatoes for 2 servings, as label directs, using liquid, omitting butter and seasoning., Measure 1 cup., In large bowl, sprinkle yeast over water; stir until dissolved., Stir in sugar and salt until dissolved., Add 1 cup potatoes, butter and 3 1/2 cups flour., With electric mixer at medium speed, beat until smooth, 2 minutes., Gradually add 4 cups flour, mixing with hands until smooth and stiff enough to leave bowl., Add remaining 1/4 cup flour, if needed., Turn out onto lightly floured board., Knead until smooth, electric, small blisters appear on surface, 10 minutes., Place in greased large bowl; turn over., Cover with towel., Let rise in warm place (85°), until double, 1 hour., Turn out dough onto lightly floured pastry cloth or board., Divide in half., Roll out one-half into a 16 x 8-inch rectangle; roll up from one end., Press ends even, pinch to seal and tuck under loaf. Place, seam side down, in greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan., Brush surface lightly with some of the melted butter., Repeat with other half of dough., Let loaves rise in warm place, until tops are rounded, 1 hour., Set oven rack at lowest level., Preheat oven to 400°., Bake 30 to 40 minutes or until deep golden brown and loaves sound hollow when tapped., If crust becomes too brown, cover with brown paper., Turn out onto wire racks, brush tops with remaining butter., Cool., Makes 2 loaves.

title: Nutty Crispies(Easy Cookies)
directions: Line cookie sheet with sides with foil., Arrange separated crackers on foil, side by side., Sprinkle nuts over top of graham crackers., Bring butter and brown sugar to a boil in small saucepan and pour over crackers evenly., Bake 10 to 12 minutes in a 350° oven until bubbly., Remove from oven and let set a couple of minutes., Cut apart with knife while still warm and cool on wax paper., Makes about 3 dozen 1 1/2 x 3-inch cookies.

title: Bohemian Turkey Soup
directions: Make and brown small meatballs and drain well., In large stock pot put chicken broth, soup bone and cleaned giblets on medium flame approximately 1 hour., Remove soup one, skim off and add vegetables., After another hour, reduce flame., Add parsley, meatballs and noodles after 10 to 15 minutes, should be ready.

title: Cranapple Sherbet Punch
directions: Mix sugar and water until sugar is dissolved., Mix remainder and stir well., Chill., Just before serving, add 1/2 gallon pineapple sherbet., Makes 60 (1/2 cup) servings., Good for wedding and other receptions.

title: Low-Fat Vegetable Soup
directions: Stir onion, cabbage and celery in water., Simmer until tender. Add rest of the ingredients and simmer., Serve the next day. (One pound of ground turkey may be added.)

title: Five Bean Casserole
directions: Saute celery, green pepper and onion in sausage drippings until tender., In large roaster, combine all of the ingredients except bacon., Put bacon on top., Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Goulash
directions: Combine flour, salt, paprika, and mustard., Roll meat in flour mixture., Brown meat slowly in hot oil., Sprinkle remaining flour mixture over meat., Add remaining ingredients., Cover and simmer for 1 1/2 to 2 hours., Then remove vegetables and bay leaf. Pack meat into jars, leaving 1/2 inch headspace., Cover with sauce, 1 pint 1 hour, 1 quart 1 hour and 15 minutes at 10 pounds pressure.

title: Boiled Cookies
directions: Cook sugar, milk, margarine and cocoa in a deep saucepan. When it starts to boil, time it for 5 minutes., Remove from heat. Add peanut butter, if you desire., Add vanilla, oatmeal and peanut butter., Stir briskly until it loses its gloss., Spoon onto wax paper using a tablespoon.

title: Blueberry Muffins
directions: Heat oven to 400°., Grease bottom only of muffin tin or line with baking cups., Combine all ingredients except for blueberries. Mix well., Now add blueberries., Mix just until blended., Fill cups and bake 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Italian Cake With Chocolate Icing
directions: Beat egg whites at high speed with an electric mixer until stiff peak forms., Set aside., Beat butter and shortening until creamy; gradually add sugar beating well., Add egg yolks, 1 at a time, beating until blended after each addition., Combine flour, cocoa and baking soda; add to butter mixture alternately with buttermilk, beginning and ending with flour mixture., Beat at low speed until blended after each addition., Stir in coconut, chopped pecans and vanilla., Fold in egg whites., Pour batter into 3 greased and floured 8 inch cake pans., Bake at 325° for 25 to 30 minutes or until a wooden pick inserted in center comes our clean. Cool in pans 10 minutes., Remove cake layers to wire rack and cool completely.

title: Honey Glazed Carrots
directions: Use wooden spoon to stir up ingredients which are placed into a pot., Cook until tender.

title: Chicken Salad
directions: Combine all and add dressing as much as desired., There may be too much dressing for this recipe., Refrigerate overnight.

title: Dirt Cake
directions: Cream the butter, cream cheese and sugar., Mix milk and pudding; add to butter mixture and mix well., Add Cool Whip; mix again., Crush Oreos; use food processor., Take a new flowerpot and layer Oreos, then mixture, starting and ending with oreos., You can use gummy worms in the cake and place silk flowers on top.

title: Fried Peach Pies
directions: Combine flour, baking powder and 1 teaspoon of salt; cut in 1/3 cup butter with pastry blender until mixture is crumbly., Sprinkle cold milk (1 tablespoon at a time) evenly over surface., Stir with a fork until dry ingredients are moistened., Shape into a ball. Chill.

title: Snow Salad
directions: Drop marshmallows in boiling water, dissolve well., Add jello and cool., Add pineapple to cheese and mix well, then add to cooled gelatin mixture., Add whipped cream and nuts, pour into large pan, 8 x 14-inch, chill well and serve., May use a large jello mold.

title: Diabetic Chocolate Millionaires
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Add quick cooking oatmeal to desired consistency., Drop by teaspoon onto waxed paper., Place in freezer to harden., (This can be rolled into waxed paper and sliced after hardening.)

title: Poppy Seed Dressing
directions: Blend together all ingredients except oil., Turning blender on low speed, add oil very slowly in a steady stream., Stir in a few extra seeds., Chill until ready to serve.

title: White Bean Soup
directions: Soak beans overnight., Cook in chicken broth until soft., Chop onion, celery, cabbage and garlic., Cook in small amount of oil until soft., Add to beans., Add ham, salt and pepper to taste. Cook on low for 30 minutes.

title: Cheese Biscuits
directions: Melt margarine in an 8 x 8-inch pan., Place biscuits in pan. Cover with grated cheese., Bake in preheated oven according to package directions.

title: Marinated Shrimp And Artichokes
directions: Chill marinated artichokes and shrimp., Drain and quarter artichokes and combine with shrimp., Beat together the olive and vegetable oils, vinegar, mustard, chives, scallions, salt and pepper., Pour over the shrimp and artichokes., Refrigerate several hours., Serve with toothpicks.

title: Dirt Cake
directions: Crush Oreo cookies in food processor., Set aside.

title: Polly Smith'S Pistachio Salad
directions: Mix the pudding and pineapple., Add remaining ingredients and blend everything together., Refrigerate until cold.

title: Jello Cake
directions: You will need 2 (8-inch) pans and 1 straw or butter knife.

title: Texas Matador
directions: Cook the noodles according to package directions and drain. Brown meat with salt, sugar and pepper in a skillet., Add tomatoes, tomato sauce and garlic and cook for 10 minutes over low heat., Add the noodles, sour cream, cream cheese and green onions. Place in a casserole dish and cover with grated cheese., Bake at 350° for 35 minutes., Serves 8 people.

title: Diabetic Yogurt
directions: Completely, dissolve gelatin in boiling water.	Combine cold water, and	enough	ice, cubes, to measure 1 cup., Add to gelatin and, stir, until	slightly, thickened., Remove, any unmelted ice., Stir in yogurt and vanilla., Pour into individual dishes and chill until set, about 30 minutes.	Makes 2 1/2 cups of 5 servings.

title: Chicken Parmesan
directions: Preheat oven to, 400°., Dip chicken into eggs then into bread crumbs and arrange in a 9, by 13 inch baking dish., Bake uncovered for 20 minutes. Take out and pour pasta sauce over chicken and top with cheese., Bake 10 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink.

title: Taco Burgers
directions: Crush enough corn chips to make 1/3 cup., Mix ground beef, chips and seasoning mix., Shape into 6 patties., Set oven to broil. Broil patties 5 minutes; turn and broil for 3 minutes more. Crisscross cheese strips on each patty and sprinkle with paprika. Broil until cheese is puffed and golden.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Cook veggies and drain well., Add chicken, oleo, cheese, soup, salt and pepper., Bake 40 minutes at 350° (also good with ham instead of chicken and cream of mushroom soup instead of cream of chicken).

title: Seven Layer Cookies
directions: Melt butter or oleo in jelly roll pan., Sprinkle on graham cracker crumbs, nuts, chocolate chips, butterscotch chips and coconut., Pour evenly over top, Eagle Brand milk., Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes, or until coconut is brown.

title: Tostado Dip
directions: Layer refried beans mixed with taco mix., Layer sour cream with carton of avocado dip., Layer grated Cheddar cheese., Layer green onions and black olives., Refrigerate until chilled., Serve with taco chips.

title: Pork Chops And Rice
directions: Spread rice on bottom of oblong dish., Dissolve bouillon in water and pour over rice., Place pork chops on rice., Pour mushroom soup and water over chops., Sprinkle onion soup over all. Cover with foil and bake at 325° for 1 1/2 hours., Chicken can be substituted for chops.

title: Hedge Hogs
directions: Cook first 6 ingredients for 5 minutes., Stir in Rice Krispies. Roll in balls., Then roll balls in mixture of coconut and confectioners sugar., Makes about 24 balls.

title: Golden Potato Squares
directions: Saute onion in butter, add milk and bring to boil., Mix remaining ingredients., Bake in greased 9 x 13-inch dish., Save 1/2 cup cheese to sprinkle on top and bake 30 minutes more., Cut in squares to serve., Good with ham and cole slaw., May be refrigerated overnight before baking.

title: Frozen Pineapple Torte
directions: Beat egg yolks, salt and 1/2 cup sugar., Add pineapple syrup and lemon juice., Cook in double boiler, stirring constantly, until thick., Add pineapple., Cool.

title: Tater Tot Casserole
directions: In skillet, brown beef., Preheat oven to 350°., Place ground beef in bottom of glass dish, then pour soup over beef., Place Tater Tots on top of meat and soup., Bake for 30 to 40 minutes or until Tater Tots are brown.

title: Chopstick Tuna
directions: Mix together and bake 20 minutes at 375°., Inexpensive and very good for tuna.

title: Apple Cake
directions: Stir apples and sugar together and let stand until sugar is dissolved., Mix in remaining ingredients and bake at 375° for 40 minutes in an 8 x 8-inch pan.

title: Lemon Cookies
directions: Mix and drop from spoon on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350°. Garnish with pecan halves, if desired.

title: Sweet Potato Pie
directions: Combine all ingredients., Bake at 425° for 45 minutes., Makes 2 pies.

title: Low Cholesterol Pound Cake
directions: Cream margarine and sugar., Sift baking powder and flour together., Add to sugar mixture with milk., Fold in egg whites, vanilla and lemon flavoring., Bake at 325° for 1 1/4 hours.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Saute onions in butter., Add broccoli and cook until soft. Mix with remaining ingredients., Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Famous Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Beat together the shortening, sugars, egg, water and vanilla until creamy., Sift together flour, salt and soda; add to creamed mixture., Blend., Stir in oats., Drop by teaspoonfuls onto greased cookie sheets., Bake in preheated 350° oven for 12 to 15 minutes. Makes 5 dozen cookies.

title: Date Balls
directions: Cook over low heat first 4 ingredients for 10 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in 1 1/2 cups Rice Crispies., Add rest of Rice Crispies if needed., Prepare aluminum foil with part of coconut; spread over to put mixture on adding more coconut as needed.

title: Chess Pie
directions: Soften butter; don't melt., Cream softened butter with sugar; beat well., Add flour, corn meal and eggs., Pour in buttermilk and vanilla., Pour into pie shell., Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Custard Pie
directions: Beat eggs (slightly) and combine sugar, salt, nutmeg and vanilla slowly. Add milk. Mix well. Pour into 9-inch pie pan. Bake in hot oven at 450° for 10 minutes. Then in moderate oven at 325° for 25 minutes.

title: Sugar Cookies
directions: Cream butter, shortening and both sugars., Add eggs and beat well., Blend in flour and soda; mix in vanilla., Roll in small balls., Sprinkle with sugar and place on greased cookie sheet. Flatten with glass or refrigerate until firm (overnight) and roll out and cut with cutters., Color may be added., Best when soft (before refrigerating)., Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Artichoke, Potato And Bacon Salad With Fennel Flowers
directions: Wash and cook potatoes just until tender., Cut onion lengthways into quarters and cut thinly crosswise., Soak in cold water., Cut peppers into strips, 1/4 x 1-inch long., Cut artichokes in half., Slice artichokes crosswise in 1/4-inch slices.

title: Deep Pit(From The Oven)
directions: You will need freezer paper and string.

title: Hot Chicken, Shrimp Or Crab Salad
directions: Combine all ingredients except cheese and potato chips; put in casserole., Combine cheese and potato chips and sprinkle on top. Bake at 350 degrees until hot, 25 to 30 minutes., Serves 4 to 6.

title: Carrot Casserole
directions: Prepare herb stuffing as directed on package., Set aside. Melt 3 tablespoons butter. Add onion and saute until glassy., Add soup and cheese, stirring until heated through and cheese is melted. Season to taste with salt and pepper., Add the cooked carrots. Turn into greased casserole (2-quart). Cover with stuffing mix., Drizzle 1/3 cup melted butter over top., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes or until hot and bubbly. Serves 6.

title: Squash Casserole 1
directions: Mix all ingredients., If bacon drippings are cold, melt them first., Pour into ungreased dish., Bake at 350 for 45 to 60 minutes.

title: Brownies
directions: In a bowl, beat eggs and sugar until light and fluffy., In a double boiler, melt chocolate and butter over hot water., Add egg mixture to the chocolate mixture., Combine flour, baking powder and nuts in a bowl., Add to chocolate batter and stir until smooth., Put in a greased 8-inch square pan., Bake at 350° for about 30 minutes., Let cool and then cut into squares.

title: Rich Lemon Bars
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., In a medium bowl combine 1 1/2 cups flour and 1/2 cup confectioners sugar., Cut in margarine until crumbly., Press into bottom of lightly greased 13 x 9-inch baking pan., Bake 15 minutes., Meanwhile in a large bowl combine eggs, granulated sugar, baking powder, ReaLemon and remaining 3 tablespoons flour., Mix well., Pour over baked crust for 20 to 25 minutes, until lightly browned., Cool., Cut into bars., Sprinkle with additional confectioners sugar., Store, covered, in refrigerator.

title: Holiday Pecan Logs
directions: Butter an 8 inch square pan with 2 tsp. butter, set aside. Combine powdered sugar and dry milk, set aside., In a heavy saucepan combine 1/2 cup butter, sugar and corn syrup; cook and stir until it comes to a boil and sugar is dissolved., Stir in powdered sugar, about 1/3 at a time until blended., Remove from heat and stir in vanilla., Continue stirring until mixture thickens and mounds slightly when dropped from a spoon., Spread into prepared pan., Cool., Cut candy into four strips., Cut each strip in half., Shape each strip into a log shape., Wrap in waxed paper, twist the ends., Freeze or refrigerate until firm., In heavy saucepan or microwave melt caramels with milk., Stir often. Roll logs in caramel mixture then in pecans., Wrap in waxed paper. Store at room temperature in airtight containers., Cut into slices with serrated knife.

title: Cream Puff Dessert
directions: Cook water and oleo until oleo is melted, then stir in flour; beat well., Let cool, then add eggs, one at a time; beat well. Spread in cake dish and bake at 350° until golden brown (about 25 minutes).

title: Parmesan Chicken Breasts
directions: Heat oven to 400°., Spray 15 x 10 x 1-inch baking pan with no-stick cooking spray., Dip chicken in margarine and coat with combined remaining ingredients., Place in prepared pan., Bake 20-25 minutes or until tender., Makes 6 servings.

title: Strawberry Pudding
directions: Heat strawberries, sugar and Jell-O just enough to dissolve Jell-O; stirring constantly., Let cool., Mix pudding with milk as stated on package., Add sour cream to pudding., Fold in 3/4 of Cool Whip., Layer cake, pudding mix and strawberries in a large dish, repeating until all is used., Top with remaining Cool Whip. Refrigerate for several hours.

title: Orange-Pineapple Sherbet
directions: Mix well., Pour into ice cream freezer can., Freeze until firm.

title: Sage-Onion Potatoes
directions: Heat butter and oil in a large heavy skillet., Add the sliced potatoes; turn them to coat thoroughly in the butter and oil, then cook over medium heat for 20 minutes., Turn potatoes often so they cook evenly., Carefully add 1 cup boiling water to the potatoes in the pan., Add the scallions, sage, parsley and season with salt and pepper., Boil, uncovered, for 10 minutes, until water evaporates., If potatoes aren't done, add 1/3 cup boiling water and cook 5 minutes more., Serve at once., Serves 4; 315 calories per serving.

title: Cincinnati Chili
directions: Combine ground beef, onions and water in saucepan. Simmer until beef turns brown. Add tomatoes, vinegar and seasonings. Cover, simmer 3 hours, stirring occasionally. Fat will float. If time, chill chili and lift off fat layer; if not, spoon off fat.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Mix all ingredients, except cheese and chips. Put in a 13 x 9 casserole dish and top with cheese and chips. Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Caramel Corn
directions: Mix syrup, salt, vinegar, salt and pepper and butter in 2 quart pan., Stir constantly; bring to a boil over medium heat until mixture reaches the hard crack stage 290°., Add soda and mix well. Pour foamy mixture over corn.

title: Deer Stew
directions: Cut deer up into small pieces; boil for about 1 hour and a half on medium-high., Dice onion, potatoes and carrots; add to boiled meat after half hour cooking., Add all other ingredients and continue cooking for the other hour., Serves 3 to 6.

title: Seven Layer Cookie Bars
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., In 13 x 9-inch baking pan, melt butter in oven., Sprinkle crumbs over butter, then pour condensed milk evenly over crumbs., Top with remaining ingredients; press down firmly., Bake 25 to 30 minutes., Cool., Cut into bars., Store loosely.

title: Broccoli Salad
directions: Mix together dressing, vinegar and sugar., Pour over other ingredients., Recipe can easily be doubled.

title: Frozen Orange Dessert
directions: Combine the first 3 ingredients. Set aside 3/4 cup., Press remaining crumb mixture into an ungreased 13 x 9 x 2-inch dish. Set aside., Combine condensed milk and orange juice concentrate. Fold in whipped topping and oranges., Spoon mixture over crust and sprinkle with reserved crumb mixture. Cover and freeze until firm. Makes 12 servings.

title: Cranberry Salad
directions: Mix together and chill.

title: Eggplant Parmesan
directions: Saute onion and garlic in small amount of oil until golden brown., Stir in tomatoes and paste; simmer 30 minutes, stirring often., Stir in oregano and simmer 30 minutes more., Mix eggs and salt., Dip eggplant in eggs; then in bread crumbs., Fry in oil; drain on paper towels., Mix cheeses together., Pour 1 cup mixture in 13 x 9-inch baking dish., Top with 1/3 eggplant and 1/3 cheeses., Repeat until used up., Bake in a 350° oven for 45 minutes.

title: Fireside Coffee
directions: Combine all ingredients., Store in tightly sealed container. Use 2 to 3 heaping teaspoonfuls per cup of hot water.

title: Summer Sausage
directions: Mix and roll into two rolls., Wrap in Saran Wrap and refrigerate 24 hours., Remove from wrap and place on broiler pan; cook at 300° for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Chili -- Quick And Easy
directions: Brown sausage, ground beef, onion and pepper in large skillet. Drain off excess grease. Put mixture in a large pot; add chili powder, salt and pepper. Stir in tomatoes and beans. Bring to a boil; reduce heat to simmer for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Stuffed Ham
directions: Split rolls in half and brush with mixture of butter, poppy seed, mustard and Worcestershire sauce., Layer ham and cheese and bake at 350° for 30 minutes., Great for parties.

title: Tuna Ball
directions: Mix all ingredients, except pecans., Chill, then roll into ball., Roll ball in chopped pecans.

title: 7 Layer Salad
directions: Layer lettuce, onion, peas and eggs. Sprinkle with bacon., Ice top with mayonnaise., Sprinkle top with shredded cheese.

title: Rice-Con-Queso
directions: Spray a 1 1/2-quart casserole with cooking spray., Combine all ingredients and pour into casserole., Bake, uncovered, for 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Sweetened Condensed Milk
directions: Microwave 1 pound of frozen bacon at Medium-low for 4 to 6 minutes.

title: Wild Rice Soup
directions: Saute butter and onion until tender., Blend in flour. Gradually add chicken broth and cook until it thickens slightly. Stir in wild rice and salt., Simmer 5 minutes., Blend in half and half and sherry., Heat to serving temperature., Add meat and carrots at this time, if desired., Mushrooms, water chestnuts or chopped bacon may also be added at this time., Top with sliced almonds, if desired., Serves 4.

title: Black Forest Cheesecake
directions: Combine crumbs and margarine., Press onto bottom of 9-inch spring-form pan., Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.

title: Spinach Salad
directions: This makes a very large salad.

title: Our Favorite Chocolate No-Bake Cookies(Kids' Stuff)
directions: Form cake in a dragon cake mold with your favorite cake mix and bake., Get dry ice; place in small container at mouth of dragon., Decorate with green icing.

title: Pinakbet
directions: Combine all ingredients except eggplant, bitter-melon and okra., Bring to a boil., Lower heat and simmer, covered, until beef is tender., Add eggplant, bitter-melon and okra; cook for 15 minutes., If using canned bitter-melon, add last 3 minutes of cooking.

title: Lemon Pepper Catfish
directions: Wash fish and place in pan., Brush with melted butter and sprinkle with lemon pepper seasoning., Cover., Broil for 10 minutes, then turn catfish and repeat process, cooking for another 10 minutes or until fish flakes apart.

title: Diet Vegetable Soup
directions: Cut cabbage in small pieces., Add 2 cans mixed vegetables (Veg-All)., Add 2 cans chicken broth., Add 1 large can whole tomatoes., Add large can tomato juice., Salt to taste., You can add green beans, peas, carrots or any canned vegetables.

title: Orange Balls
directions: Cream margarine and sugar., Add frozen orange juice, vanilla wafers and nuts. Then roll balls in coconut and put in refrigerator.

title: Butterfinger Cake
directions: Prepare cake mix; let cool. Crush Butterfingers; set aside. Melt margarine in saucepan. Mix in sugar and mix well. Remove from heat. Stir in Cool Whip and mix well. Pinch 1/2 of cooled cake into punch bowl or trifle dish. Pour 1/2 of Cool Whip mixture over cake. Sprinkle layer with 1/2 crushed Butterfingers. Repeat layers and chill.

title: Sweet And Sour Sauce
directions: Combine all ingredients and heat., Serve with egg rolls.

title: Joseph'S Breakfast Drink
directions: Blend well. Makes 2 (8-ounce) servings.

title: Christmas Hard Candy
directions: To make this candy, you will first need a large slab of marble on which to pour the hot candy., Possibly a large cookie sheet would suffice, but I've always used marble., You will also need several pairs of scissors and at least 3 additional people to help cut the candy before it sets up.

title: Hearty Potato Soup
directions: In a, large kettle, cook potatoes, carrots and celery in water until tender, about 20 minutes., Drain, reserving liquid, and setting vegetables aside., In the same kettle, saute onion in butter until soft., Stir in flour, salt and pepper; gradually add milk, stirring constantly, until thickened., Gently stir in cooked vegetables., Add one cup or more of reserved cooking liquid until soup is desired consistency., Yield:, 8 to 10 servings.

title: Marsha'S Dessert
directions: Heat oleo, nuts and flour in 350° oven for 20 minutes., Press down and let cool., Mix powdered sugar, cream cheese and Cool Whip on top of cool crust., Mix puddings with milk and let thicken. Pour over cream cheese topping., Top with Cool Whip and a few pecans.

title: Chicken Saltimbocca
directions: Coat cutlets with mixture of flour, salt and pepper., Brown in butter and remove as cooked., Sprinkle 3 tablespoons flour into pan drippings., (You may have to add more butter to drippings.) Stir in wine, tomato sauce, chicken broth, lemon juice and salt and pepper to taste., Cook over low heat until sauce thickens.

title: Chicken Veronique
directions: Skin and bone chicken breasts lengthwise., Cut chicken into 1-inch pieces; set aside.

title: Low-Fat Herbal Hash Brown Potatoes
directions: Steam potatoes over steamer until sticky and not quite done, still hard., Include garlic, onion and herbs in steamer., Turn frequently., For serving 4, you may want to steam a batch of potatoes, set aside and steam the other half with herbs.

title: Quick Lime Icebox Pie
directions: Place Cool Whip in bowl and add lemon juice; mix., Stir in jello and sugar., Mix well., May add more sugar, if needed, for personal taste.

title: Italian Beef
directions: Remove string from around roast and discard., Place roast in roasting pan., Pour liquid from jar of peppers over roast., Remove stems from peppers and discard., Do not discard seeds., Chop peppers and sprinkle over roast., Place in warm oven (200°) before bedtime or in early A.M.

title: Mexican Casserole
directions: Brown meat and onions. Add your soups, milk, enchilada sauce and chopped green peppers to meat and simmer for about 10 minutes. In a greased (Pam spray) pan, add ingredients as below: Layer of meat mixture, layer of crumbled Doritos and layer of grated cheese, repeating layers until all material is used. Bake at 350° in oven for about 30 minutes or until cheese is melted. All or parts of the casserole can be frozen.

title: Diabetic'S Cake
directions: Combine applesauce, oil, egg and sugar substitute., Combine remaining ingredients and add them to applesauce mixture., Pour into a 9 x 5-inch loaf pan., Bake at 325° for 45 minutes or until it tests done.

title: Italian Casserole
directions: In a Dutch oven over medium heat, cook sausage, beef, onion and green pepper until meat is browned and vegetables are tender; drain., Add tomato sauce and paste, water and seasonings; bring to a boil., Reduce heat; cover and simmer for 15 minutes., Add corn and olives; cover and simmer for 5 minutes., Stir in noodles. Pour into two greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dishes; top with cheese., Cover and bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes or until heated through., Yield: 16 to 20 servings.

title: Oriental Omelet(From Joslin Diabetic Clinic)
directions: Combine chicken, bean sprouts, water chestnuts and soy sauce and mix well., Set aside., Mix eggs, water, green pepper, onion, salt and pepper with a fork., Heat butter or margarine in a 10-inch skillet., Pour in egg mixture., With spatula, draw cooked portions of egg toward center so that uncooked portions flow to bottom. Cook until bottom is set and lightly browned and top is creamy. Arrange chicken mixture on half of omelet., With spatula, fold other half over and turn out on serving platter., Yields 2 servings., Each serving equals 3 ounces of meat and 1 vegetable.

title: Date Bread
directions: Mix dates, butter, sugar and boiling water and add remaining ingredients., Bake at 325° for 45 minutes or until done.

title: Magic Apple Pie
directions: Combine sugar and egg., Sift together baking powder and flour, then add to sugar mixture., Toss together nuts and apple, then add to batter.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Cook broccoli and drain., Mix soup, 3/4 cup cheese, onions and ham together thoroughly., Now fold in broccoli., In separate bowl, melt butter and mix in cracker crumbs., Mix well., Take half of crust mixture and spread over bottom of baking dish., Pour in soup mixture., Take remaining crust and smooth over top., Sprinkle remaining cheese on top., Bake between 375° to 425° for approximately 30 minutes.

title: Angel Biscuits
directions: Dissolve yeast in lukewarm water; let stand 5 to 10 minutes. Combine sugar, flour and salt; cut in shortening., Pour 1 cup buttermilk on top of flour mixture; add yeast to buttermilk and mix slightly., Add other cup of buttermilk and mix well., Knead on floured board., Store in covered container in refrigerator., Will keep 1 week., Take amount needed; roll or cut biscuits., Dip in melted butter., Biscuits are lighter if dough is allowed to double in bulk before baking., Bake at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Corn Pudding
directions: Mix well and put in greased baking dish., Bake in oven at 325° for 1 hour.

title: Play Dough
directions: Combine all and cook over low heat, stirring constantly until thick., Turn out onto floured wooden surface., Knead like bread until no longer sticky., Add food coloring.

title: Easy Rocky Road Candy
directions: Melt chocolate chips over hot, not boiling, water, stirring until smooth., Spread about 1/3 of the melted chocolate in buttered 8-inch square pan., Cover with marshmallows mixed with walnuts., Pour over remaining chocolate, mixing slightly until marshmallows and walnuts are coated., Let set until firm., Cut in squares., Makes 1 2/3 pounds of candy.

title: Spinach Souffle
directions: Squeeze excess liquid from spinach., Place all ingredients in blender-blend till combined., Butter a souffle dish or 1 1/2 qt. baking dish., Sprinkle with 1 to 2 parmesan cheese - pour mixture in and bake at 375 degrees for 50 minutes or until puffed and golden.

title: Short Ribs
directions: Sprinkle salt and pepper on all sides of short ribs and put into Dutch oven or a 3-quart covered casserole dish., In a small saucepan, combine the tomato soup with the molasses, vinegar, liquid smoke and minced onion; bring to a boil and simmer for 5 minutes., Pour over short ribs; cover and bake in a 275° oven for 3 to 4 hours, or until very tender., Just before serving, spoon off any excess fat., (If you prepare this dish ahead, refrigerate it and then lift off the solidified fat before you reheat it.), Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Chili
directions: Cook all ingredients in skillet for 3 minutes except beans; add beans., Put in crock-pot and cook until ready or simmer for 25 to 30 minutes atop stove.

title: Cumber Kimshi(Variation Of Traditional Korean Cabbage Kimshi)
directions: Slice cucumbers very thinly and wilt with salt., Squeeze out water., Add spices., This keeps in the refrigerator for weeks., It gets hotter the longer it sets.

title: Apple Cake
directions: Mix ingredients in order given., Bake in 8 x 12-inch pan at 350°., Batter will be thick, depending on how juicy the apples are. If too thick to spread, add 1 or 2 tablespoons water., No other liquid is necessary.

title: Grandma'S Brownies
directions: Stir in a lots of love; mix and bake according to directions on box. Serve with lots of hugs and kisses.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
directions: Make cream sauce of butter, flour, salt, pepper, broth and milk., This will be thin., Add chicken and drained peas and carrots., Put in 9 x 13-inch baking dish., Make pie crust; roll thin and cut out like biscuits. Place on top of chicken mixture. Bake at 425° for 30 minutes.

title: Banana Pudding Cake
directions: Combine all 7 ingredients and mix well (Jell-O pudding mix last)., Bake 60 minutes at 350°.

title: Quiche Casserole
directions: Place bread evenly into a lightly greased 11 x 7 x 1 1/2-inch baking dish. Set aside. Stir garlic powder into quiche filling. Pour over bread. Bake at 400° for 20 minutes. Top with pepper rings and bake 5 additional minutes. Let casserole stand 5 minutes before serving.

title: Broccoli Cornbread
directions: Melt butter in a 9 x 13-inch pan., Mix all ingredients together into pan and bake at 400° for 45 minutes., Recipe may be doubled to serve 16.

title: Orange Glazed Carrots
directions: In a small saucepan, combine sugar, cornstarch, salt and ginger., Add orange juice., Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly., Cook 1 to 2 minutes more., Stir in butter and pour over hot carrots., Stir to coat.

title: Breakfast Pizza
directions: In a skillet cook sausage until well done, drain., Separate crescent rolls into 8-inch triangles., Place dough in 12-inch pizza pan, with points toward center., Press over bottom and sides to form crust., Spoon sausage over crust. Sprinkle with potatoes., Top with Cheddar cheese., In a bowl, stir eggs, milk and 1/8 teaspoon pepper., Carefully pour over mixture in crust. Sprinkle Parmesan cheese on top., Bake at 375° for about 25 minutes or until set., Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Snickerdoodles
directions: Mix shortening, sugar and eggs together thoroughly., Sift flour, cream of tartar, soda and salt together., Mix together.

title: French Cherry Delight
directions: Beat eggs until stiff., Add vanilla., Fold in sugar, crackers, baking powder and nuts., Spread in loaf pan (grease well)., Bake 325 degrees for 20 minutes (let completely cool).

title: Smothered Chicken
directions: Combine flour, salt, pepper and paprika. Coat chicken with flour mixture. Melt margarine in heavy skillet. Brown chicken on both sides. Remove from heat. Brown remaining flour mixture in margarine until golden brown, stirring constantly. Slowly stir in water to make gravy. Return chicken to skillet and add onions. Cover and cook on low heat until done, about 25 or 30 minutes.

title: Auntie'S Green Bean Salad
directions: Mix sugar, vinegar and oil., Pour over vegetables., Cover and place in refrigerator., This salad will keep for weeks and improves with age.

title: Angel Cookies
directions: Soak bread crumbs in condensed milk to which the extract and coloring have been added., Add nuts., Drop by spoonfuls onto greased cookie sheets., Top each with a nut half; bake at 350° for 12 minutes.

title: Watergate Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients together by hand., Decorate top with cherries and crushed cashews

title: Cousin Susie'S Perfect Fudge
directions: Combine chips and milk and microwave for 2 1/2 minutes., Stir and microwave 2 1/2 minutes more., Add vanilla and pecans., Pour into greased glass pan and refrigerate.

title: Macaroni Salad
directions: Cook macaroni; drain and cool., Add tomatoes, onion, peppers, cheese and pickle juice., Mix., Add remaining ingredients., Add celery seed and seasoned peppers to taste.

title: Chocolate Pie
directions: Mix sugar, cocoa and flour., Add eggs and milk, a little at a time, mixing well., Cook on medium heat, stirring until thick. Add butter and vanilla., Pour into baked pie shell.

title: 5 Day Sour Cream Cake
directions: Mix sugar, cream and coconut; refrigerate overnight., Bake cake as directed on package, except use 3 round pans., Remove from pans; freeze, then slice each layer in half., Remove filling from refrigerator to soften while slicing cakes., Spread filling on top of each layer, stacking them., Refrigerate for 5 days.

title: Chicken And Sausage Gumbo
directions: Place flour in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan., Bake at 400° for 15 minutes or until caramel colored, stirring flour every 5 minutes.
