Brown sausage in a Dutch oven or large skillet coated with cooking spray over medium heat., Drain and pat dry with paper towels., Wipe drippings from Dutch oven., Brown chicken; drain and pat dry., Wipe drippings from Dutch oven., Cook onion, green pepper and celery in Dutch oven (coated with cooking spray) until tender; sprinkle with browned flour., Gradually stir in water; bring to a boil., Add sausage (cut into 1/4-inch slices); add chicken, garlic, bay leaves, Worcestershire sauce, hot sauce, thyme, salt and green onions (optional)., Reduce heat and simmer mixture (uncovered) for 1 to 1 1/2 hours., Serve over rice.

title: Hash Brown Potato Casserole
directions: Combine potatoes and 1/4 cup butter, onions, soup, sour cream and cheese., Place in a buttered casserole., Mix remaining butter and crushed corn flakes and sprinkle over potatoes., Bake at 350° for 2 hours.

title: Banana Split Cake
directions: Mix together and press into the bottom of a 10 x 13-inch dish the graham cracker crumbs, 1 stick of butter and sugar.

title: Green Bean Relish
directions: Slice beans in thin slivers. Cook 5 minutes. Cool. Cut onions in thin slices. Add beans along with mixture of salad oil, lemon juice, salt, sugar, pepper and paprika. Chill in refrigerator several hours to develop flavor. Serve as salad or relish.

title: Chocolate Delite
directions: Make graham cracker crust in 9 x 9-inch dish by combining melted margarine and 2 tablespoons sugar. Refrigerate for 30 minutes, until set. Combine microwaved/soft cream cheese and powdered sugar; mix. Add 1/2 tub Cool Whip; mix. Place next to crust. Cover with chocolate pudding. Finish top off with whipped cream. Chill.

title: Coconut-Orange Dressing
directions: Combine all ingredients., Fold in whipped cream., Chill several hours., Makes 1 1/3 cups.

title: Dorito Dip
directions: Brown chopped onions, garlic and salt., Add drained tomatoes (puncture tomato in strainer to get out most of juice)., Add drained chile peppers., Cook until all moisture is absorbed, approximately 45 minutes over low heat, stirring occasionally. Add cheese., Stir constantly until melted., Serve warm with Dorito chips., Can be cut in half for small gathering.

title: Brownies
directions: Sift flour and salt., Cream butter., Blend in sugar and add eggs., Beat until smooth and fluffy., Add vanilla and stir in cocoa., Add flour alternately., Add nuts., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes in a buttered pan.

title: Beef Stroganoff
directions: Dredge meat with flour., Saute mushrooms and onion in a little oil until onion is clear., Add beef and brown., Add tamari and spices., Simmer 10 minutes.

title: Barbecue Meatballs
directions: Use a three or four pound boneless sirloin or rump roast. Boil on stove top until very tender., Cool and break up into small pieces., Take out all fatty pieces., Add enough catsup to moisten well and reheat., Serve on sandwich buns.

title: Chicken Crescent Casserole
directions: In a large saucepan, combine the first 8 ingredients. Cook over medium heat until hot and bubbly., Place in an 8 x 12-inch ungreased baking dish. Place the refrigerated dinner rolls over hot chicken mixture. Combine the cheese and melted margarine. Spread cheese mixture on rolls. Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes or until crust is golden brown.

title: Flaky Yellow Pastry
directions: Cut shortening into dry ingredients., Very gradually add egg/water mixture while gently mixing with fork., Don't overwork dough.

title: Layered Salad(Makes 10 To 12 Servings)
directions: Place lettuce and spinach in the bottom of a large salad bowl. Top with peas, water chestnuts, onion, crumbled bacon and two sliced hard-boiled eggs., Sprinkle with salt, then pepper as desired., Combine mayonnaise and sour cream, stirring well. Spread mayonnaise mixture over salad to seal tightly., Sprinkle with cheese, then sugar., Garnish with remaining 2 hard-boiled egg slices., Chill 8 hours or overnight.

title: Cornflake Cookies
directions: Beat egg whites, sugar and vanilla together until stiff., Add coconut and cornflakes., Mix until blended., Drop onto buttered cookie sheet by teaspoons., Bake at 250° until lightly brown.

title: Easy Asparagus Au Gratin
directions: Sauce:, Melt margarine in a saucepan., Stir in flour until well blended., Slowly stir in 2 cups milk., When sauce is smooth and hot, reduce heat and stir in cheese., Season with salt, pepper, Dijon mustard and Worcestershire sauce.

title: Veggie Burger
directions: Process vegetables in food processor until well chopped., Mix all with turkey., Form into burger and bake.

title: Chicken Primavera
directions: Brown chicken. Remove from skillet and blend soups and paprika., Add chicken and vegetables., Heat to boiling., Reduce heat to low. Cover and simmer for 20 minutes or until chicken and vegetables are tender. Serve over rice or noodles.

title: Hamburger Casserole
directions: Layer hamburger, carrots, onions and potatoes in 9 x 13-inch baking dish., Pour tomato soup over this and bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Coconut Cream Dessert
directions: Set out 1/2 gallon ice cream to soften., Roll crackers fine. Melt oleo and combine with crumbs, except a handful saved out for on top., Pat mixture on bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan., Beat together pudding and milk., Fold into the ice cream., Pour over crumb crust., Top with Cool Whip., Sprinkle with crumbs. Set in refrigerator for 8 hours., Cut in squares., Fast and easy.

title: Joan'S Dip
directions: Chop meat and onions (greens only) and mix with cream cheese, soup and sour cream., Serve with Ritz or Club crackers or with party rye bread.

title: Iris' Chicken
directions: Place chicken thighs in shallow casserole., Mix soup with 1/4 cup of water and pour over chicken., Cover with thin cheese slices, then place Stove Top stuffing on top., Bake at 325° to 350° for, 1 hour., Freezes beautifully., Nice served with asparagus or Chinese pea pods., Serves 8 to 12.

title: Pineapple Upside-Down Cake
directions: Drain pineapple, reserving 2 tablespoons juice., Combine brown sugar and butter in 13 x 9-inch pan., Arrange pineapple slices in pan, cutting slices, if necessary., Place a cherry half, cut side up, in center of each slice., Sprinkle with reserved juice and then nuts., Combine cake mix, Dream Whip, right from envelope, eggs and water in large mixer bowl., Blend, then beat at medium speed for 4 minutes., Carefully spoon over mixture in pan., Bake at 350° for 50 to 55 minutes or until top springs back when lightly pressed., Let stand in pan for 10 minutes and then invert onto serving plate., Let stand 1 minute, then remove pan., Serve warm or cold., May also be topped with Cool Whip.

title: Turtle Cookies
directions: Empty caramels in saucepan with 1/3 cup of milk., Melt, stirring constantly., Remove from heat., Combine cake mix, 1/3 cup milk, melted butter and nuts., Press two-thirds of cake mixture in greased and floured 9 x 13 x 2-inch baking dish., Bake in 350° oven for 10 minutes., Sprinkle chocolate chips over baked mixture. Spread caramel mixture over top of chips., Add remaining cake mix by spoonfuls on top of caramels., Bake an additional 20 to 25 minutes. Cut while warm., Makes 12 to 16 servings.

title: Nacho Pizza
directions: Cut tortillas in quarters, making 16 wedges., Place vegetables evenly on wedges on 2 baking sheets., Spoon sauce over vegetables and top with cheese., Bake at 350° for 15 minutes or until cheese starts to brown., Serves 10 to 12.

title: Hot Chocolate Mix
directions: Mix ingredients and place in airtight container., To serve, place 1/3 cup mix in cup and add 1 cup boiling water.

title: Hamburg Casserole With Cheesy Buttermilk Biscuits
directions: Fry hamburg, onion and peppers., Let cool., Cook potatoes and celery and add milk and flour; cook until creamy., Place layer of potatoes, then layer of hamburg, ending with potatoes on top., Mix biscuit mix (buttermilk kind)., Roll biscuit dough out flat and sprinkle with Cheddar cheese., Roll up like jelly roll and cut; place on top of potatoes., Bake at 450° for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Tamale Casserole
directions: Remove tamales from can, reserving liquid., Remove husks from tamales, cut tamales in half crosswise and place in a lightly greased 8-inch square baking dish., Spoon reserved liquid over tamales., Spread chili over tamales, and sprinkle with cheese. Top with corn chips., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until thoroughly heated., Serves 4.

title: French Onion Soup
directions: Saute onions in butter., Add beef broth., Cook and simmer. In soup bowls or crocks, place croutons, and sprinkle with parmesan cheese., Add soup and top with provolone cheese slices.

title: Chicken Budapest
directions: Soak raisins in mandarin juice., Melt butter, brown chicken breasts on both sides., Cook over low heat 15 to 20 minutes until chicken is done., Remove chicken from skillet, place on serving platter and keep warm., Pour off all but 3 tablespoons of pan drippings and stir in flour, paprika, salt and pepper, mix., Add half and half and cook over low heat until smooth and thick., Stir in raisin and mandarin juice mixture and heat through., Pour sauce over chicken., Serve over wild rice., Serves 6.

title: New England Clam Chowder
directions: In large saucepan, cook onion in margarine until tender., Add potatoes, salt, bacon bits, pepper and 1 cup water., Cover and simmer 30 minutes or until potatoes are tender., Stir in clams and milk., Heat., Do not boil., Makes 6 servings, about 130 calories each.

title: Jamaican Fruit Cake
directions: Presoak fruit in wine or rum., Combine fruits and nuts., Sift flour and mix 2 cups with fruit and nuts. Cream butter until soft and blend with sugar., Add eggs, singly beating well. Add jelly.

title: Greek Potatoes
directions: Place all ingredients in plastic Ziploc bag and shake to coat evenly., Place in shallow baking dish., Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours, stirring several times during baking., Cover with foil if it browns too fast.

title: Strawberry Cake
directions: Cut strawberries in half to use in cake (save other half for icing)., Mix all the ingredients., Pour into 2 layer cake pans; bake in 325° oven until done.

title: Mama'S Pineapple Salad
directions: Cook beaten egg yolks, pineapple juice, sugar and butter in double boiler until done., Thicken with flour., Pour this cooked custard over pineapple, apples and nuts and chill.

title: Oriental Dish
directions: Cut chicken breasts into strips., Marinate chicken strips in soy sauce, cherry wine and cornstarch for 20 minutes., Saute chicken in cooking oil until brown., Add onion, garlic and bell pepper with carrots., Cook until vegetables turn a bright color. Add broccoli slaw mix, sesame seed and ginger., Serve with white rice., Serves 4.

title: Camper'S Cocoa
directions: Mix thoroughly., Store in an airtight container., Stir in 1/2 to 3/4 cup dry mix into a mug of hot water.

title: Hash Brown Casserole(Low-Fat Version)
directions: Saute onion slightly in Pam-sprayed pan., Add flour, mustard, salt and pepper., Gradually add milk and broth, stirring constantly., Cook until thickened., Remove from heat and stir in sour cream., Combine with potatoes and top with cheese and corn flakes, if desired., Bake in 13 x 9-inch Pam-sprayed pan at 350° for 35 minutes.

title: Date Pudding
directions: Bake 45 minutes at 375°.

title: Hello Dollies
directions: Melt margarine in square cake pan., Add rest of ingredients in layer as listed., Bake at 325° until firm, 25 to 30 minutes., Cut in small pieces while still warm.

title: Chicken Tarragon
directions: Sprinkle chicken with seasoned salt, pepper and paprika., In skillet, over medium-high heat, in hot butter or margarine, cook chicken pieces until well browned., Sprinkle tarragon over chicken., Add onion and mushrooms to skillet., Reduce heat to low; cover and simmer 25 minutes or until tender., Skim fat from liquid., Makes 4 servings.

title: Beef Stroganoff
directions: Brown steak and saute with onions and mushrooms., Add rest of the ingredients and then add sour cream., Serve over buttered noodles with poppy seed.

title: Corn Pudding
directions: Combine the flour, sugar and baking powder., Stir in corn, eggs, pimentos, salt, pepper and milk., Pour in buttered 1 1/2-quart baking dish., Dot top with butter., Add decorative dashes of paprika., Bake, uncovered, 45 minutes at 350°.

title: Tasty Meat Loaf
directions: Combine all ingredients and make a loaf.

title: Buttermilk Pie
directions: Cream margarine and sugar., Add eggs, flour, buttermilk and vanilla., Pour in unbaked pie shell., Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: One Pot Pork Chop Supper
directions: In skillet, brown pork chops., Pour off fat., Add rest of ingredients., Cover; simmer 45 minutes or until tender.

title: Reuben Spread
directions: Mix well all ingredients together., Serve with rye crackers or rye cocktail bread.

title: No Crust Cheesecake
directions: Beat eggs well in glass bowl., Fold in sugar and softened cheese., Beat until smooth., Grease a 9-inch pie pan (glass) well with oleo., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes, filling will sink slightly to form its own crust., Let cool, then cover with your favorite topping (cherry pie filling, berry, etc.).

title: Taco Dip
directions: Spread ingredients on tray or platter by layers listed., Top with lots of cheese and arrange olives to look nice., Use taco chips to dip.

title: Long John Silver Fish Batter
directions: Blend beer, flour, butter, egg yolks and seasoning., Let stand for 10 minutes., Beat egg whites until stiff., Fold into batter., Dip cleaned and deveined shrimp or fish into batter. Deep fry at 375 for 5 to 7 minutes.

title: Nippy Carrots
directions: Use pancake mix and in the place of water in the recipe, use light colored pop (like 7-Up or ginger ale)., It will make the pancakes very light.

title: Tiny Cinnamon Rolls
directions: Unroll crescent roll dough and separate into 4 rectangles, pinch edges to seal., Stir together sugar, powdered sugar, and cinnamon., Sprinkle evenly over rectangles., Roll up, jelly roll fashion, starting with long side., Press edges to seal., Cut each log into 5 slices and place in lightly greased 8 in. round cake pan., Bake at 350 degrees for 12 minutes., Combine powdered sugar, milk and vanilla., Stirring until smooth., Drizzle over warm cinnamon rolls.

title: Chicken And Rice
directions: Measure raw rice into a 2 1/2-quart casserole dish. Mix dry onion soup mix, cream of chicken soup and 1 soup can of water. Arrange pieces of chicken on top (legs, thighs and breasts are good)., Sprinkle chicken generously with paprika., Bake in 350° oven, covered, for 1 1/2 hours., Then, if chicken is tender, let it brown, uncovered, for 15 more minutes., Watch that the rice mixture stays moist., You might want to add a little hot water. This is good baked in a 9 x 13-inch baking pan covered tightly with foil., The paprika gives the chicken color., Also, there is no salt added as the soups give plenty of flavoring.

title: Easy Chicken Pot Pie
directions: Combine all ingredients., Spoon into prepared pie crust. Cover with top crust., Crimp edges to seal., Slit top crust and brush with beaten egg, if desired., Bake at 375° for 40 minutes. Cool 10 minutes before cutting.

title: Harvest Bowl Salad
directions: Beat eggs slightly., Add sugar, salt and lemon juice; cook until thick in double boiler, stirring constantly., Cool., Whip the cream and fold into cooled egg mixture., Combine fruits, pecans and celery; fold into dressing., Serves 10.

title: Microwave Brownies
directions: Mix all ingredients and put in greased 8-inch square dish. Cook at full power for 6 to 7 minutes, rotating dish 1/2 turn after 3 minutes of cooking.

title: Blueberry Bread
directions: Mix ingredients well., Put in 2 greased loaf pans., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to one hour until toothpick inserted in middle comes out clean.

title: Sausage-Bread Stuffing
directions: In a large skillet, fry the sausage and bacon until crisp and brown., Remove sausage and cut into 1-inch pieces., Replace in skillet and add onion, celery, mushrooms, apples, parsley and herbs., Saute, stirring occasionally for 5 minutes., Stir in bread cubes and chicken broth., Season to taste with salt and pepper.

title: Vidalia Onion Casserole
directions: Saute onions in margarine until tender., Remove from skillet and place in a bowl., Add flour, salt and pepper., Mix well and while stirring, gradually add beef bouillon., Fry bread cubes or croutons in margarine in the skillet., Combine with onion mixture.

title: Strawberry Dream Pie Filling
directions: Mix strawberry halves, jello and yogurt. Add ice cream and mix well. Pour into a prepared light graham cracker pie crust. Place in freezer for at least 4 hours before serving. Let stand at room temperature, 30 minutes before serving. 8 servings per pie. Calories 212.7 and fat 3.05 grams.

title: Arlene'S Appetizer
directions: Cut off top of bread and take out insides., Mix all other ingredients in large bowl., Pour mixture inside bread shell. Replace top of bread and wrap in foil., Bake at 350° for 2 hours, stirring every 30 minutes.

title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Pie
directions: Mix ice cream and peanut butter on low speed. Pour into cookie pie crust. Freeze 3 hours. Top with 1 jar of ice cream fudge topping. Return to freezer. Serve with whipped topping on top of each slice.

title: Tangy Tuna Cocktail
directions: Lightly mix tuna, eggs, pickles and radishes., In a small bowl, blend mustard, lemon juice, vinegar, salt and cayenne. Gradually stir in salad oil with a fork until dressing is well blended., Mix dressing lightly with tuna mixture., If you wish, cover and chill for 30 minutes to 2 hours to blend flavors.

title: Rice Krispies Candy
directions: Mix syrup and sugar; bring to a boil., Remove from heat; stir in peanut butter and then stir in the Rice Krispies., Pour into a greased pan., Cut into squares when cool.

title: Knox Gelatin Squares
directions: Mix unflavored gelatin into cold water., Mix Jell-O into hot water., Then mix both together., Pour into Pam sprayed glass 9 x 12-inch pan., Set until firm.

title: Potato Stuffing
directions: Mix together very good., May use in any recipe calling for stuffing.

title: Homemade Ice Cream
directions: Stir ingredients by hand until mixed., Plug in freezer.

title: Pasta Con Presto
directions: Chop, 2, cloves, of, garlic, in, food processor., While processor, is still running add fresh Parmesan cheese, Italian parsley, pine nuts, fresh basil, salt and vegetable oil., When mixture is soft and pasty, spoon sauce over freshly cooked hot spaghetti and mix thoroughly., Add grated Parmesan as topping.

title: Brownies
directions: Melt margarine., Sift together flour, baking powder, salt and cocoa., Beat eggs, then add sugar., While beating, add vanilla and melted margarine., Stir in dry ingredients., Add pecans., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes in a 9 x 9-inch pan., Makes 12 bars.

title: Lemon Chiffon Pie(Makes 8 Or 9-Inch Pie)
directions: Cook in double boiler the egg yolks, sugar, grated rind and juice of lemon and dash of salt, stirring frequently until consistency of thick custard., Dissolve gelatin in water and add to hot custard., Mix well., Cool.

title: Fudge Pie
directions: Mix well and pour into uncooked pie shell., Bake at 325° for 35 to 40 minutes., If desired, cover top with chopped pecans before baking.

title: Chocolate Drop Cookies
directions: Cream shortening., Gradually add sugar, beating at low speed of electric mixer until light and fluffy., Add egg, chocolate and vanilla; beat well., Combine flour, soda and salt; add to creamed mixture alternately with milk, stirring well., Stir in pecans or walnuts., Drop dough by teaspoonfuls, about 1 1/2 inches apart, onto greased cookie sheets., Bake in a 350° oven for 12 minutes, or until done., Remove to wire racks., Frost with Chocolate-Coffee Frosting while still warm., Yields about 4 dozen cookies.

title: Strawberry Angel Squares
directions: Cut half of the angel food cake into 1-inch cubes., Pour boiling water on gelatin in a large bowl; stir until the gelatin is dissolved., Stir in reserved pineapple juice., Place cottage cheese in blender container., Cover and blend on medium speed, stopping blender frequently to scrape sides (about 15 seconds). Return mixture to large bowl., Stir in pineapple, strawberries and cake cubes., Pour into square baking dish (8 x 8 x 2-inches). Refrigerate until firm, at least 6 hours., Garnish with fresh strawberries, if desired.

title: Tea Cookies
directions: Mix softened butter with 1/2 cup sugar, vanilla, flour and baking soda., Mix in pecans and form balls, about the size of a round tablespoon., Bake at 350° for 15 minutes., Cool and roll in more powdered sugar.

title: Calico Beans
directions: Drain all beans., Cook meats and onion in skillet., Drain. Stir in catsup, mustard and vinegar., Combine remaining ingredients in 3-quart casserole, stir in meat, cover and bake at 350° for 40 minutes or until bubbly., Garnish with bacon if you wish., Serves 8.

title: Apricot Chicken
directions: Place chicken pieces in a 9 x 13-inch pan., Mix other ingredients and pour over chicken., Bake for 1 hour at 350°. Serves 4.

title: Taco Dip
directions: Layer ingredients in order listed., Refrigerate for 2 hours before serving., Serve with Tostitos.

title: Bubble Bread
directions: The night before serving:, Grease a Bundt or tube pan., Evenly place frozen rolls in bottom of pan; sprinkle with dry pudding mix., Next, sprinkle brown sugar and pecans over rolls, then pour melted margarine over the top., Place pan in cold oven overnight. As rolls thaw, bread will rise.

title: Apple Bread
directions: In bowl, combine flour, cinnamon, soda, powder and salt., Set aside., In large bowl, place oil, sugar, eggs, vanilla and apples. Stir flour mixture; add walnuts and mix., Divide mixture between two greased 8 x 4-inch bread pans., Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes or until bread tests done., Cool for 10 minutes on rack before removing from pans.

title: Chicken And Broccoli Casserole
directions: Heat oven to 350°. Cut up sausage into small pieces and cook. Melt cheese, add soup to cheese, stir until well blended., Cook broccoli. In a seperate bowl mix stuffing, sausage, celery and onions., Place cut up chicken in bottom of pan, then broccoli, then pour soup and cheese mixture on top. Top with stuffing mixture., Bake for 40 min. till cheese bubbles and stuffing browns.

title: Apple Dip
directions: Combine cream cheese, sugar and vanilla., Use for dipping apple slices, celery, crackers, etc.

title: Chicken Or Turkey Tetrazzina
directions: Combine and heat soup, water and cheese., Heat until cheese is melted, stirring occasionally., Add spaghetti, chicken, pepper and parsley., Heat through, stirring, or pour into baking dish and heat in microwave or oven until hot., Serves 4.

title: Spring Vegetable Dip
directions: Combine mixture together. Chill., Serve with fresh vegetables or chips.

title: Garlic Steak
directions: Dredge steak in flour; pound to 1/2-inch thickness., Cut steak into serving size pieces., Brown steaks in hot oil in a Dutch oven., Remove from skillet and set aside., Add onion to pan drippings; saute until tender., Return steak to Dutch oven; add remaining ingredients except noodles., Cover., Reduce heat and simmer 1 1/2 to 2 hours or until steak is tender., Serve over noodles.

title: Applesauce Nut Bread
directions: Sift flour, baking powder, salt, soda and cinnamon together. Stir in walnuts and raisins, tossing to coat well with flour mixture.

title: Strawberry Nut Salad
directions: Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water., Add strawberries, pineapple, bananas and nuts., Pour half into 2-quart mold., Chill until firm., Spread sour cream over.

title: Italian Cream Cake
directions: Cream margarine and shortening; add sugar and beat until smooth., Add egg yolks and beat well., Combine flour and soda. Add to cream mixture alternating with buttermilk., Stir in vanilla; add coconut and chopped nuts., Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites., Bake in a 3 (8-inch) pans, greased and floured., Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

title: Italian Chicken
directions: Beat egg and 1 tablespoon water., Roll chicken in mixture, then in bread crumbs., Brown chicken in shortening., Pour off fat. Stir in soup, water, onion and seasonings., Cover and cook for 45 minutes on low heat, stirring occasionally., Sprinkle with cheese and serve.

title: Queen Victoria'S Soup(Serves 8)
directions: Put the chicken in a large saucepan., Cover with the stock and parsley., Bring to a boil., Cover and simmer for 1 hour.

title: Curried Chicken Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients together and refrigerate.

title: Golden Pork Chops
directions: Brown pork chops in deep fat quickly., Pour off grease., Add soup, water, diced celery, pepper and onion., Salt and pepper to taste., Cook for 30 minutes with lid on pan., Cook on medium heat on top of stove.

title: Sweet And Sour Chicken
directions: Mix last 3 ingredients; pour over chicken., Bake at 350° for 1 to 1 1/2 hours, basting occasionally.

title: Sausage Balls
directions: Melt cheese in medium saucepan., Mix Bisquick and sausage thoroughly, then add melted cheese and mix., Form into small balls; bake until lightly browned in a 350° oven for approximately 20 to 30 minutes., Can be frozen before or after baking., (Good party recipe.)

title: Nothing Cake
directions: Beat eggs and brown sugar in mixer bowl until smooth., Add remaining ingredients; mix well., Pour into 3-quart glass cake pan., Bake at 325° for 35 minutes., Serve with vanilla ice cream and chocolate or butterscotch sauce.

title: Lesueur Pea Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients and chill on bed of lettuce.

title: Butterscotch Cookies
directions: Mix flour, soda, and sugar thoroughly. Add eggs and mix well. Add vanilla and flour mixture and mix well. Shape in round loaf. Wrap in waxed paper and chill over night. Cut in thin slices and bake in 350 oven.

title: "Trailblazer'S Chili"(Serves 10)
directions: In saucepan, heat olive oil., Add onions and cook until tender., Add meat and cook until done., Add chili powder, salt and pepper., Stir in tomatoes and beef broth., Bring to a boil, then lower heat., Simmer for 30 minutes., The chili will be very thick.

title: Barbecue Sauce
directions: Mix together equal parts of ingredients; keep refrigerated.

title: Corn Bread
directions: Mix dry goods in a medium bowl., Soften shortening in the baking pan or iron skillet in oven at 300°., Pour into the bowl with the dry goods., Turn oven to 425°., Add egg and milk., Stir. Pour into pan/skillet., Bake at 425° for 20 to 25 minutes until golden on top., (Clabber Girl recipe.)

title: Barbecue Burgers
directions: Mix together., Make patties and brown., Place patties in baking dish.

title: Company Potatoes
directions: Boil potatoes until done., Beat sour cream and cream cheese together., Add hot potatoes and beat until smooth., Add butter, chives, salt and pepper., Pour into a well-greased 2-quart casserole., Dot with butter and sprinkle with paprika., Bake 25 minutes at 350°., Can be made the day before., Serves 8 to 10.

title: Persimmon Pudding
directions: Mix pulp, eggs and sugar together., Add milk, then flour, cinnamon and nutmeg., Add butter., Bake for 1 hour at 300°.

title: Crock-Pot Pork Chops And Stuffing
directions: Prepare Stove Top stuffing by mixing all ingredients together. Place stuffing in bottom of crock-pot., Brown and season pork chops to taste., Place pork chops on top of stuffing., Cover and cook on low until meat is tender, 2 to 3 hours.

title: Blueberry Dump Cake
directions: Place blueberry pie filling in a 9 x 13-inch greased pan. Cover with pineapple., Pour on dry cake mix and sprinkle nuts on top., Melt butter and drizzle over all., Bake for 1 hour at 350°. Serve topped with whipped topping.

title: Shrimp Creole
directions: Cook and stir onion, celery, green pepper and garlic in oil until tender, not brown., Add tomatoes, tomato sauce and seasoning., Simmer, uncovered, 45 minutes., Cook over low heat. Mix cornstarch with 2 teaspoons water., Stir into sauce., Add shrimp., Cover and simmer until tender, about 5 minutes., Serve over rice., Makes 6 servings.

title: Cabbage Slaw
directions: In a bowl, combine cabbage, carrots and green pepper., Chill. Mix Miracle Whip, sugar, vinegar, Ranch dressing mix, celery seed and salt., Toss with vegetables.

title: Whiskey Slush
directions: Mix ingredients together., Freeze., Spoon 1/2 cup in glass and fill glass with Fresca, Squirt or Wink.

title: Caramel Corn
directions: Prepare popped corn., Combine next 4 ingredients., Bring to a boil; boil 5 minutes and stir occasionally., Remove and add soda. Stir and pour over corn., Put on greased cookie sheet., Bake at 250° for 1/2 hour., Store in tightly covered container.

title: Glazed Onions
directions: Peel onions; cut into even slices., Heat butter in large skillet., Add onions and toss for a few minutes until coated with butter., Do not brown., Add vinegar, brown sugar and curry powder. Stir to blend., Add parsley., Cook onions for about 5 minutes, covered, until almost tender-crisp., Remove cover and cook onions for 2 to 3 minutes, until glazed., Season with salt, black pepper and paprika., Add chili.

title: Homemade Salsa
directions: Finely chop the first 3 ingredients., Add the remaining ingredients., Better to make ahead and let marinate., May need to drain off some of the liquid that forms., Serve with Doritos chips., Delicious!

title: Marinated Sliced Pickles
directions: In a large bowl, marinate at room temperature for 24 to 30 hours., Mix occasionally during marinating., Then you can store in jars (whatever size you want)., If spices are in cheesecloth, throw them away., Refrigerate., Keeps for weeks.

title: Picklelets
directions: Beat the egg and sugar until thick and add with the milk to the sifted flour, salt and baking powder., Lastly, add the melted butter., Mix until smooth and cook in spoonfuls on a hot grease griddle or frying pan., Serve with butter, jam or sliced strawberries.

title: Lime Congealed Salad
directions: Dissolve, jello in 2 cups boiling water., Add pineapple (with juice)., When, cooled,, add cottage cheese, Eagle Brand and nuts. Stir. Congeal.

title: Carrot Cake
directions: Beat eggs, sugar, oil and sifted dry ingredients., Add carrots. Stir nuts in last., Bake in greased 9 x 13-inch pan at 325° for 1 hour.

title: Aunt Sandy'S No-Bake Cookies
directions: Cook first 4 ingredients together until they boil for 2 to 3 minutes., Remove from stove and add the other ingredients all at once., Mix together quickly., Drop by spoonfuls onto wax paper. Let harden., The secret to this recipe is to work quickly and time carefully.

title: Lemon Chess Pie
directions: Blend all ingredients together (don't beat) and pour into pie shell. Bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes., Makes 8 servings.

title: 7-Up Sauce
directions: Put all ingredients into Ziploc bag; shake to mix., Add 4 to 6 turkey tenderloins, cut into 2-inch strips., Marinate for at least 2 hours in refrigerator., Great on the grill.

title: Carrots And Walnuts
directions: Cook carrots with water until tender (5 minutes in microwave or 10 to 15 minutes in covered pan over medium heat)., Combine olive oil, nuts, lemon peel and seasoning salt in a bowl., Add carrots., Toss., Serve warm., Serves 4.

title: Bacon And Egg Bake
directions: Fry bacon until crisp., Drain fat, reserving 2 tablespoons. Saute onions in bacon fat., Stir in soup, milk, eggs, cheese and seasonings., Bake in an 8 x 8-inch dish for 20 minutes at 350°. Top with crumbled bacon and serve over muffin halves.

title: Drop Dumplings
directions: Combine until just moistened., Drop by spoonfuls onto bubbling stew, chicken and gravy, etc., Cover and simmer 12 minutes.

title: Tuna Casserole
directions: Cook noodles in enough water to cover them and cook until tender. Then add tuna, soup and milk. Pour into greased casserole dish. Melt 1/2 stick butter and crumble about 4 slices of bread; mix in the melted butter. Cover top of casserole with mixture. Bake at 400° until done.

title: Japanese Fried Chicken
directions: Blend all ingredients (except chicken)., Add chicken, soak for 20 minutes and deep fry.

title: Texas Rice
directions: In 3-quart casserole, combine the water, uncooked rice, soup mix and onion., Cover, cook on 100% power (High) for 4 to 5 minutes or until boiling., Let stand, covered, 5 minutes., Stir before serving., Garnish with parsley, if desired.

title: Jalapeno Cornbread
directions: Mix dry ingredients; add milk, oil, eggs and corn. Mix well. Add peppers and onions. Pour 1/2 mixture into greased 9 x 14-inch baking pan or 10-inch iron skillet. Sprinkle 1/2 of Cheddar cheese; add balance of mixture. Top with remainder of cheese. Bake in a 375° oven for 35 minutes or until done.

title: Cornbread Pot Pie
directions: Mix meat, peas, corn, cheese, 1 cup milk, onion and Worcestershire sauce., Pour into greased 12 x 8-inch baking dish or shallow 2-quart casserole., Bake at 375° for 15 minutes or until bubbly at edges., Mix well baking mix, cornmeal, sugar, salt, egg and 2/3 cup evaporated milk., Pour on hot mixture, leaving center uncovered., Spread to edges., Bake 25 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Hot Bacon Dressing
directions: Brown the Sizzlean on both sides and drain on paper towels. Stir together the dry ingredients., Stir in the egg, vinegar and water., Add the bacon., Cook slowly, stirring until thickened.

title: Monster Mash Potatoes
directions: Peel and quarter potatoes., Cook in boiling water until tender. Drain and mash., Add next 4 ingredients and beat at medium speed until smooth., Put in greased 1 1/2-quart baking dish., Sprinkle with paprika., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Peas And Peanut Salad
directions: Cook peas., Drain and cool., Mix sour cream, mayonnaise, sugar, dill seed, mustard, vinegar and salt until creamy smooth. (I add garlic powder, too.), Add peas; blend., Add peanuts., Best served that same day.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
directions: Put in large mixing bowl and mix as little as possible. The batter will be a, little chunky., Bake in tube pan in 350° oven for 1 hour and 10 minutes.

title: Chocolate Pecan Clusters
directions: Melt chocolate in double boiler or microwave., Stir in nuts; mix well., Drop by teaspoon onto waxed paper., Makes approximately 20 to 25 pieces.

title: Hot Italian Submarine Sandwiches
directions: Fill sandwich roll with ingredients., Add salt, pepper and about two tablespoons Italian salad dressing., Roll in aluminum foil and bake about 10 to 15 minutes at 350°.

title: Sauerkraut Chocolate Cake
directions: Cream eggs and butter in bowl until light and fluffy. Add eggs and vanilla. Mix well. Sift dry ingredients together. Add to creamed mixture alternately with 1 cup of water, beating well after each addition. Stir in sauerkraut. Pour into 2 greased and floured 8-inch pans. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Frost with favorite frosting.

title: Peanut Butter Icing
directions: Mix all ingredients together and mix until spreadable consistency.

title: Peanut Brittle
directions: Cook water, margarine, sugar and Karo until it will spin a fine thread in a glass of cold water., Add peanuts and cook until light brown (this takes a bit of time, you will start smelling the peanuts cook, then cook a bit longer).

title: Lemon Dessert
directions: Melt butter; mix crumbs in and press into 9 x 13-inch serving dish., Dissolve sugar in mixture of lemon juice and rind. Dissolve Jell-O in water and chill in refrigerator., Whip milk until thick; gradually add Jell-O, beating., Stir in lemon mixture., Put in crust and chill., Sprinkle graham cracker crumbs on top for garnish.

title: Seafood Newburg
directions: Remove lobster from shell., Cut meat in bite size chunks and reserve., Make sauce of butter, flour, salt, pepper, milk and evaporated milk., Cook one minute., Beat egg yolks and stir in sherry., Stir in 1 cup sauce into the egg yolk mixture and then add this to the rest of the sauce., Cook for one minute or until thickened, stirring constantly., Add lobster chunks, scallops and shrimp and heat., Serve over rice.

title: Carrot Cake
directions: Beat eggs well., Mix in remaining ingredients., Pour cake into greased round cake pans covered with wax paper., Cook at 325° for 45 minutes or until done.

title: Oven-Baked Apple-Pecan Pancake
directions: Heat oven to 450°., Mix pancake mix, eggs, water and 1 teaspoon sugar; mix well., In ovenproof skillet, saute apples in butter until tender., Remove skillet from heat and sprinkle with nuts. Pour batter evenly over apples., Mix remaining sugar and cinnamon. Sprinkle over batter., Cover skillet with lid or foil and bake 12 to 14 minutes or until pancake is puffed and sugar is melted.

title: One Dish Supper
directions: Fry turkey burger in large skillet., Bring tomatoes to boil in turkey (cooked)., Add dry rotini to boiling mixture., Cook about 7 or 8 minutes or until tender., Add remaining ingredients., Serve with green peas, tossed salad and garlic toast.

title: Down South Marshmallow Brownies
directions: Melt one stick butter and stir in all other ingredients except the marshmallows. Pour into a greased and floured 8 x 8 inch pan. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes. After baking, cover the brownies with miniature marshmallows. Put back into oven long enough to melt the marshmallows, but do not let them brown. Cover with icing.

title: Chicken Pasta Salad
directions: In large bowl, mix all ingredients., Toss with the Italian dressing which has been made according to package directions.

title: Famous Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Beat shortening, sugars, egg, water and vanilla together until creamy., Sift flour, salt and soda; add to cream mixture and blend well., Stir in oats; drop by teaspoonfuls onto greased cookie sheet., Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Chocolate Chip Pistachio Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees: Lightly grease cookie sheets.

title: Spiced Tea
directions: Bring to boiling first 3 ingredients and pour over tea bags. Steam 5 minutes and strain., Add the remaining ingredients and serve either hot or cold.

title: Tuna Or Salmon Dinner
directions: Prepare macaroni and cheese as directed., Mix all other ingredients and serve.

title: Orange Fruit Salad(Low-Fat)
directions: Mix together all ingredients, except jello. Then add jello last. Mix well and keep in refrigerator until firm.

title: Chocolate Chipper Champs
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Mix brown sugar, margarine, vanilla and eggs in a large bowl until well blended., Stir in remaining ingredients., Drop dough by rounded tablespoonfuls about 3-inches apart onto lightly greased cookie sheet., Press 3 or 4, additional candies in each cookie, if desired. Bake until light brown, 10 to 12 minutes. Cool slightly. Remove to wire rack., Makes about 2 1/2 dozen cookies.

title: "Buch'Ta"
directions: Warm milk, add yeast and sugar; let melt., Add the eggs, salt, margarine (melted) and oil., Add flour and knead dough approximately 20 minutes., Cover and refrigerate overnight.

title: Chicken With Spicy Fruit Sauce
directions: Combine first 4 ingredients in large non-aluminum skillet, bring to a boil., Add chicken and cover., Reduce heat and simmer 10 minutes or until chicken is done., Remove chicken from skillet and keep warm., Bring cooking liquid to a boil; cook 7 minutes or until reduced to 3/4 cup, stirring occasionally., Combine strawberry spread and cornstarch; stir into cooking liquid and cook 1 minute or until syrupy., Spoon 3 tablespoons sauce over each chicken breast, garnish with green onion strips., Yields 4 servings, 215 calories and 1.5 fat.

title: Coca-Cola Cake
directions: Sift sugar and flour together in bowl; set aside., In saucepan melt butter; add cocoa and Coca-Cola., Bring to a boil; boil one minute., Add to dry ingredients., Mix buttermilk and soda and add. Add eggs and vanilla; stir until smooth., Last, stir in marshmallows., Pour into greased pan (9 x 13-inch); bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Chocolate Pound Cake
directions: Cream oleo and shortening with sugar., Add eggs one at a time and blend well after each., Sift dry ingredients together and add alternately with milk., Add vanilla., Pour batter into greased and floured tube pan., Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 25 minutes.

title: Delicious Potatoes
directions: Melt cheese and oleo; mix in half and half, all in pan., Pour over potatoes and let stand for an hour., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Easy Garden Caesar Dip
directions: Combine ingredients in a food processor or blender and process until smooth. Serve the dip in a shallow bowl or small hollowed out bell pepper., Makes 1 1/4 cups.

title: Ranch House Casserole
directions: Melt shortening in skillet over medium heat., Place meat in skillet and scramble it., Let it cook until done but not brown. Add all other ingredients and turn heat to low; heat and let it simmer until hot.

title: Sausage Treats
directions: Mix all together well. Make into very small biscuits., Cook on cookie sheet., Bake about 10 minutes at 350°.

title: Chicken Soup With Matzo Balls
directions: Place chicken, water, onions, leek, celery, salt and pepper in 8 to 10-quart Dutch oven., Bring to boiling; reduce heat and simmer covered for 1 hour to 1 1/2 hours., Add carrots and parsnips; simmer covered for 30 more minutes., Remove chicken and refrigerate if you are not planning to use as main meal., Lift vegetables from broth with slotted spoon, then strain broth. Return vegetables to broth., Add parsley and dill if desired. Heat through and serve in bowls with Matzo Balls., Serves 15.

title: Fruit Salad
directions: In a large bowl, combine fruit, nuts and sour cream., Fold in cool whip and marshmallows., Refrigerate., Yields 10-12.

title: Finger Jello
directions: Put unflavored gelatin in cold water., Mix., Put flavored gelatin in large bowl and add boiling water., Add plain gelatin to flavored gelatin., Pour into an 8 x 8-inch pan., Refrigerate to set (20 minutes).

title: Pecan Pie
directions: Mix all ingredients well., Pour into pie shell., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to an hour.

title: Macaroni Pie
directions: Bring 6 cups water to boil., Add salt and macaroni; cook until tender., Grate cheese coarsely, then put in large baking dish, layering alternately with cooked macaroni., Beat eggs in milk; pour over this mixture., Take fork; mix well, down through pie. Bake at 400° or 450° until brown, about 20 minutes., Black pepper is optional.

title: Italian Love Cake
directions: Grease and flour 11 x 13-inch pan., Make cake according to box directions; pour into pan., Mix vanilla, sugar, eggs and cheese. Pour gently over cake mix., Do not blend.

title: Chile Rellenos Casserole
directions: Brown meat and onion together. Layer chiles, cheese, meat and chiles in a 9 x 13-inch pan., Mix together flour, salt, eggs, milk and hot pepper sauce., Pour over., Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes., Cool before cutting.

title: Fresh Strawberry Pie
directions: Mix sugar, flour and salt together., Add milk, beaten egg yolks and margarine., Cook until it bubbles good and gets thick. Let cool., Add 3 cups of sliced strawberries., Pour into baked pie shell., Top with Cool Whip.

title: Overnight Tuna Casserole
directions: Reserve 1/4 cup Cheddar cheese., Whisk soup and milk in 2-quart microwave-safe bowl until well blended., Stir in remaining ingredients, except reserved cheese., Cover and refrigerate at least 12 hours or overnight.

title: Barbecue Beef
directions: Fry hamburger and onion until red disappears., Add garlic, onion salt, chicken gumbo and catsup., Simmer for 2 hours., The longer it simmers, the tastier it gets.

title: Pineapple Cottage Cheese Salad
directions: Dissolve jello in boiling water., Mix other ingredients together., Add to cooled jello and chill.

title: Velvety Cocoa Frosting
directions: In large bowl with mixer at low speed, beat confectioners sugar, cocoa, butter, water, vanilla and egg yolk until smooth, occasionally scraping bowl with rubber spatula.

title: Cherry Christmas Cake
directions: Beat butter until softened and light., Add sugar and beat until fluffy., Add eggs, one at a time, and beat after each addition. Stir in almond flavor., Mix flour and salt together., Add to butter mixture alternately with milk (about 1/3 each time)., Fold in nuts and cherries., Bake in greased tube or Bundt pan at 325° for 1 1/4 hours.

title: Charlotte Russe(Basic Recipe)
directions: In a double boiler, beat the egg yolks and add 2 tablespoons sugar gradually while beating., Add salt and milk., Cook over hot water until mixture coats the spoon, stirring constantly., Soften gelatin in cold water; add to hot custard and stir until dissolved., Cool slightly., Beat egg whites stiff; fold in., Whip the cream; add remaining 3 tablespoons sugar and vanilla extract. Fold in., Line sherbet glasses or spring-form mold with the ladyfingers and fill with the custard., Chill until firm.

title: Minted Lime Mold Salad(Yield:  6 Servings)
directions: Heat 1 cup water and limeade concentrate to boiling., Pour over gelatin in large bowl., Stir until dissolved., Stir in 1/2 cup cold water, ginger ale and peppermint extract., Chill until partially set., Stir in pears and melon balls., Pour into 7 cup jello mold., Chill until firm., Unmold onto lettuce and garnish with extra cantaloupe balls and mint sprigs.

title: Chicken Spectacular
directions: Cook chicken., Chop when cooled., Add remaining ingredients. Bake in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch greased pan at 375° for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Apple Cake
directions: Beat the eggs and sugar together., Gradually add oil; add vanilla., Mix flour, soda, salt and cinnamon together., Gradually add flour mixture to first mixture (will be thick)., Fold in apples., Add 1 cup nuts or raisins., Bake in a 375° oven for 45 minutes., Use greased 9 x 13-inch sheet pan., Sprinkle with confectioners sugar.

title: Poppy Seed Orange Muffins
directions: Heat oven to 400°., Beat all ingredients at low speed, scraping bowl often, until all ingredients are moistened., Spoon batter into greased tin., Bake 17 to 22 minutes.

title: Delicious And Healthy Pancakes
directions: Preheat frypan or griddle., In medium bowl, combine dry ingredients., Add buttermilk and skim milk; stir just until combined., Fold in egg white gently; add olive or salad oil., Cook on hot griddle which has been sprayed with nonstick spray., These pancakes contain no cholesterol.

title: Spinach Dip For Fresh Vegetables
directions: Combine all ingredients and stir well., Stir before serving. Makes 1/2 cup.

title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
directions: Cream the butter, sugar and sour cream until light and fluffy. Add eggs, one at a time, beating after each one., Add flour and baking soda which have been sifted together., Add flavoring., Bake in greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan in 325° oven for 1 hour and 15 minutes or until cake tests done in center.

title: Sausage Roll-Ups Snacks
directions: Cut smokey links lengthwise halfway through., Insert long thin wedge of dill pickle (drained) in each cut., Spread triangle of dough of crescent roll as label directs., Lightly spread each triangle with cheese., Place smokey link, pickle side down, on wide end of triangle and roll up toward point., Repeat with each roll and link., Arrange rolls on ungreased cookie sheet. Brush with melted butter or margarine and bake at 350° for 10 minutes or until puffy and golden brown., Makes 8 servings.

title: Fudge Topping For Ice Cream
directions: Boil chocolate and milk until thick, about 3 minutes., Add sugar, butter and marshmallows., Add vanilla.

title: Japanese Fruitcake Pie(Makes 2)
directions: Mix, butter,, sugar and eggs together (after butter has cooled to, room temperature)., Mix thoroughly., Add remaining ingredients, and pour evenly into unbaked pie shells., Bake 30 to 40 minutes in a 350° oven.

title: Black Bean Dip
directions: Mash beans with fork., Stir in remaining ingredients until well blended, refrigerate., Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Gingersnap Crust
directions: Melt butter or margarine in a small saucepan., Remove from heat., Stir in gingersnaps and sugar., Press evenly into the bottom of an oiled, 9-inch spring-form pan and freeze until needed.

title: Pecan Pie
directions: Mix all ingredients and pour into pie shell., Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

title: Cheese Ball
directions: Mix cream cheese, onion and Worcestershire together., Form one ball and roll in chopped ham., Serve with crackers.

title: Heavenly Hash
directions: Stir jello into cottage cheese., Mix well., Add fruit., Fold in Cool Whip., Chill overnight., I sometimes use 3 ounce size fruit cocktail in place of oranges and pineapple.

title: Hamburger Corn Casserole
directions: Brown hamburger and onions., Mix in next 8 ingredients., Stir in 3 cups cooked noodles., Top with bread crumbs., Pour melted butter over bread crumbs., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

title: Buffalo Chip Cookies
directions: Cream together oil, shortening and sugars., Add eggs and vanilla., Sift in flour, baking soda and powder., Mix in oatmeal, Post Toasties, chocolate chips, pecans and coconut., Put 6 scoops on each cookie sheet with an ice cream scoop., Heat oven to 350°. Cook 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Turtle Cake
directions: Grease or spray Pam on large square pan or dish., Pour 1/2 cake mixture in pan and bake 15 minutes at 350°., Mix melted caramels, margarine and Eagle Brand milk., Pour over cake that's baked., Pour remaining cake batter over mixture., Sprinkle with nuts, if desired., Bake 20 minutes at 350°., Cool.

title: Butterscotch Pudding Cake
directions: Cook pudding as directed on box., Let cool., Add cake mix. Mix well., Pour into greased 9 X 13 pan., Add butterscotch morsels on top of cake., Sprinkle with nuts., Bake at 350 degrees for 35-40 minutes.

title: Parmesan Dip
directions: In a small bowl with fork or wire whisk, mix mayo, anchovy fillets, Parmesan cheese, lemon juice and black pepper.

title: Lemon-Butter Broiled Chicken
directions: Sprinkle chicken quarters on both sides with salt and pepper. Melt butter in small saucepan; add lemon juice, tarragon, chervil and vermouth; brush part over chicken., Place chicken, skin side down, on rack of broiler., Broil 6 inches from heat for 20 minutes, basting frequently., Turn; broil 15 to 20 minutes longer or until nicely browned, brushing with remaining lemon-butter., Makes 4 servings.

title: Roasted Salted Pecans
directions: Toss pecans in bowl with oil until well coated., Spread on cookie sheet; salt to taste., Cook at 400° for about 10 minutes. Check; should be a little brown., Remove from oven and cool., Pack into containers.

title: Chocolate Delight
directions: Prepare Duncan Hines angel food cake mix according to directions on box., Let cool., Break into bite size pieces., Line 13 x 9-inch pan with pieces., Prepare 1 package chocolate pudding mix according to directions., As it begins to boil, stir in 1 package chocolate bits., Cool slightly., Fold in 1 carton Cool Whip., Pour over angel food cake bits., Ice with 1 carton Cool Whip., Put pecan bits on top.

title: Asian Beef Stew
directions: Heat wok over high heat 1 minute., Drizzle 1 tablespoon oil into wok., Heat 30 seconds., Add 1/2 of beef and stir-fry about 5 minutes until brown., Repeat with remaining beef., Remove beef to bowl; set aside., Add 1 tablespoon oil to wok., On medium heat, add shallots., Cook 3 minutes., Remove to same bowl., Repeat same for onion and garlic., Return all beef and juices to wok; add water, sugar, salt, anise seed, cinnamon, pepper and bay leaves. Reduce heat; cover 1 1/4 hours until meat is done., Peel carrots and turnips; cut into 8 wedges., Add carrots, turnips, shallots and lemon peel to beef., Cook until tender, about 30 minutes, stirring occasionally., Remove bay leaf and lemon peel., Stir in tomato paste., Cook until sauce boils and thickens, then serve.

title: Vegetable Casserole
directions: Cook each separately until done. Season with salt. Drain well.

title: Andes Candies Cookies
directions: In small saucepan, combine margarine, sugar and water until sugar has dissolved., Add chocolate chips till partially melted. Remove from heat and stir until chips are totally dissolved and mixture is smooth., Let stand 10 minutes.

title: German Chocolate Upside-Down Cake
directions: Mix cake mix as directed., Grease and flour a 9 x 13-inch cake pan., Put pecans in bottom of cake pan; spread cake mix over pecans., Melt stick of margarine; mix with cream cheese and powdered sugar., Pour over cake mix., Bake at 300° for about 1 hour.

title: Chocolate Chip Pie
directions: Mix all ingredients., Pour into unbaked pie crust., Bake 30-40 minutes at 350 degrees., Serve with whipped topping or vanilla ice cream.

title: Oven Fried Potatoes
directions: Wash and scrub each potato; dry with a paper towel., Cut each potato into eight wedges; arrange peel side down in a shallow baking pan., Mix the rest of the ingredients and brush over potatoes., Bake at 375° for 45 minutes or until potatoes are golden and tender., Brush occasionally with mixture.

title: Rice Medley
directions: Add enough water to reserved vegetable liquid to measure 1 1/2 cups., Pour into 2-quart saucepan., Heat to boiling., Stir in peas, rice, butter, salt and carrot., Heat to boiling. Remove from heat., Cover and let stand until liquid is absorbed and rice is tender, about 10 minutes.

title: Pan Fried Liver
directions: You will need an iron frying, pan.

title: Thin Mint Girl Scout Cookie Dessert
directions: Mix pudding and 2 cups of milk until smooth., Add chocolate Cool Whip; set aside., Crumble 1 box of thin mints in bottom of an 8 x 8-inch dish., Pour in half of the pudding mixture., Top with vanilla Cool Whip., Continue to layer, saving 1/4 cup of cookie crumbs for top., I use a Tupperware container so I have the cover to store in the refrigerator overnight.

title: Cheese And Chicken Enchiladas
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Cook and stir onion in margarine in large skillet until tender., Stir in chicken, 1/4 cup picante sauce and cream cheese; cook until thoroughly heated., Stir in 1 cup cheese.

title: Glaze For Fresh Fruit Pie
directions: Mix and boil one minute., Pour over fresh strawberries or peaches in baked pie shell.

title: Potato Soup(Microwave)
directions: Combine potatoes, onions and water in a 2-quart microwave-safe dish. Cook, covered, on full power, 10 minutes or until potatoes are tender. Stir one time. Lightly mash potatoes. Stir in flour. Add milk, salt and pepper. Cover and cook on full power 5 minutes longer, stirring every minute or until soup boils and is thickened.

title: Miracle Brownies
directions: Mix all together and beat well., Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes in 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Beef Stroganoff
directions: Cut steak into bite size pieces; place in bowl., Salt and pepper to taste., Place in refrigerator for 2 hours., Brown flour with butter; gradually add beef consomme soup., Add mustard, sour cream and catsup., Bring to a boil., Set sauce to one side.

title: Sausage Swirls
directions: Sift dry ingredients together., Blend in vegetable oil., Add enough milk to make a stiff dough., Thinly roll out dough (1/4-inch thick) on a lightly floured board into two 10 x 18-inch rectangles., Spread on sausage; roll up lengthwise., Chill well and slice 1/4-inch thick., Bake in a preheated oven at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Better Than Anything Cake
directions: Bake yellow cake mix in 9 x 13-inch pan., Combine crushed pineapple and its juice and 1 cup sugar., Bring to boil for 5 minutes., Punch holes in cake and pour pineapple mixture over cake., Let cool., Prepare vanilla instant pudding., Pour over cool cake., Slice 3 bananas and layer over pudding., Spread with 8 once carton Cool Whip., Sprinkle with nuts and coconut., Keep in refrigerator.

title: Brunswick Stew
directions: Cut chicken as for frying, place with seasonings in a large kettle with enough cold water to cover., Bring slowly to a boil, simmer until meat comes off bones., Remove bones, cut chicken in fairly large 1/2-inch pieces., Return to pot; add onions, potatoes and butter beans., Cook until done; add tomatoes and corn, cut from cob., Cook slowly for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Cool Whip Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients together and chill.

title: Prune Bread
directions: Beat eggs, sugar, cooking oil and prune baby food well and add other ingredients., Grease and flour pans., Bake at 325° for 1 hour.

title: Chicken Italiano
directions: In a large skillet combine chicken and 1/3 cup Italian dressing., Saute until chicken starts to brown., Add vegetables and remaining dressing., Cover., Simmer 7 to 9 minutes until vegetables are crisp-tender, stirring frequently., Serve over pasta or mix pasta with vegetables., Sprinkle with cheese. Yields 5 servings.

title: Pumpkin Nut Bread
directions: Mix all together and put in muffin tins. Sprinkle pumpkin seed on top. Bake at 325° for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Conga Bar
directions: Melt margarine and add sugar., Stir and let cool., Add eggs (one by one), flour and vanilla., Stir., Add peanuts and chocolate chips., Stir again., Pour mix in greased rectangular pan., Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Swedish Apple Pie
directions: Fill a 9 x 9-inch or 9 x 13-inch pan full of apple slices. (Spray pan with vegetable spray first)., Sprinkle with 1 tablespoon of cinnamon and sugar.

title: Blueberry Muffins
directions: Mix flour, honey and salt together., Add milk gradually., Add beaten eggs and butter., Beat for 2 minutes., Add blueberries, sprinkled with flour.

title: 6 Layer Mexican Dip
directions: Layer ingredients in order.

title: Ms. Carly'S Broccoli And Chicken Casserole
directions: Spread cooked broccoli in 13 x 9-inch pan., Add chicken, salt and pepper lightly., Mix soup, mayonnaise and lemon juice and pour over chicken., Top with corn flakes and dot with butter., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Golden Glow Salad
directions: Prepare jello using pineapple juice for cold water., After thickened, add other ingredients.

title: Strawberry Pretzel Salad #2
directions: Mix together and pat into 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake 8 minutes in 400° oven., Set aside to cool.

title: Fruit Ice
directions: Mix above ingredients in blender., Serve in glasses and enjoy; it tastes like ice cream without the fat!

title: Chicken Rice Salad
directions: Combine French dressing, mayonnaise, salt and pepper to make dressing.

title: Anise Cookies
directions: Add salt to eggs and beat until thick; add sugar gradually. Continue beating until sugar is dissolved., Add anise and beat until thoroughly blended., Beat in flour to make a moderately stiff dough., Chill dough for several hours or overnight; roll into a rectangular sheet 1/4 to 1/2-inch thick on floured board., Cut cookies in 1 1/2-inch squares; place on greased baking sheet and chill, uncovered, for about 1 hour., Bake at 325° for 15 minutes. Cool and store in covered container., These can keep for weeks. Makes 60 cookies.

title: Simple Shortbread Cookies
directions: Mix all ingredients., Roll out on floured board (1/4 to 1/2-inch thick)., Cut into desired shapes and arrange on ungreased cookie sheet., Bake at 325° for 10 to 15 minutes., When cool, sprinkle with powdered sugar.

title: Punch Bowl Cake
directions: Bake cake according to package directions in 3 layers., In the bottom of the punch bowl, put the strawberry pie filling., Add a layer of cake., Mix pudding according to package directions and add drained pineapple., Spread on top of cake layer, then add second cake layer., Top this layer with cherry pie filling and add third layer of cake., Mix second box of pudding as directed and add 3 bananas, sliced., Spread on top of third cake layer., Top with Cool Whip., Garnish with pecans and cherries.

title: None Such Mincemeat Prize Cookies
directions: Cream together until fluffy the shortening and sugar., Add eggs; beat, until smooth., Stir together the flour, soda and salt. Add to first mixture., Stir crumbled mincemeat into dough., Drop onto greased cookie sheet 2 inches apart by rounded teaspoonfuls. Bake 8 to 10 minutes at 375° until lightly browned., Makes about 6 1/2 dozen., A tasty, mild, fruity cookie.

title: Reuben-Wich
directions: Dissolve yeast in warm water in large warm bowl., Add sugar, salt, margarine and 2 1/2 cups flour; beat until smooth., Stir in enough more flour to make soft dough., Knead 6 to 8 minutes., Place in greased bowl; turn to grease top., Cover; let rise until doubled, about 45 minutes., Punch dough down; divide in half., Roll half to 14 x 10-inch, spread half dressing down center third of dough length., Layer with half the beef, cheese and sauerkraut. Make cuts from filling to dough edges along sides of filling, 1 inch apart., Alternating sides, fold strips at an angle across filling; place on greased baking sheet., Repeat with remaining dough., Cover; let rise until doubled, about 45 minutes., Brush with egg, sprinkle with caraway seed., Bake at 400° about 25 minutes., Serve warm., Refrigerate leftovers; reheat to serve. Makes 2 loaves.

title: Cheesecake Factory Key Lime Cheesecake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Stir to coat well the ingredients. Keep it crumbly., Press crumbs on bottom and half way up sides of 8-inch spring-form pan., Bake 5 minutes.

title: Banana Cake
directions: Cream together sugar, butter or margarine and eggs; mix well. Sift flour and then measure out three cups; add soda and salt and sift again., Add flour mixture to butter mixture a little at a time letting your batter blend well between each addition., Add in bananas and nuts and mix well., Pour into well greased tube or Bundt pan and bake at 300° for 1 hour or until toothpick inserted in middle comes out clean.

title: Green Bean Casserole
directions: Layer ingredients in order in a 13 x 9-inch dish, except Ritz crackers and melted oleo., Roll Ritz crackers to crumbs; toss with stick of melted butter., Top with crumb mixture., Bake at 350° until bubbly and brown on top (20 to 30 minutes).

title: Quick And Easy Rice Jambalaya
directions: Heat oil in a large skillet on medium-high heat. Add sausage; cook and stir until lightly browned. Add chicken, onion, pepper, celery and garlic; cook and stir until chicken is cooked through. Stir in tomatoes, okra, tomato sauce and seasoning. Bring to boil. Stir in rice; cover. Remove from heat. Let stand 5 minutes or until liquid is absorbed. Stir.

title: Ruth'S Dressing
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Shake well., Serve over spinach salad.

title: Mexican Dip
directions: Put in small cake pan in layers:, Bean dip, guacamole (avocados mixed with the mayonnaise), sour cream mixed with taco seasoning, shredded cheese, tomatoes, olives, onions and shredded cheese. Serve with chips.

title: Irish Kisses
directions: Beat up the butter and all the other ingredients., Sift in enough flour to make a stiff dough., Drop a teaspoonful at a time on a baking sheet., Sprinkle with 4x sugar., Bake in hot oven.

title: Applesauce Cookies
directions: Cream shortening and sugar., Add egg and mix well., Add all ingredients and blend well., Drop with teaspoon on a greased cookie sheet., Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.

title: Easy Jello Salad
directions: * Do not add water.

title: Savory Upside-Down Pie
directions: Thaw pastry., Mix ground beef, salt, pepper and onion; bind with egg yolks., Wash and quarter mushrooms., Cover the bottom of an 8-inch loose bottomed cake pan with the bacon., Arrange the cheese, herbs and mushroom quarters on top., Cover the meat mixture, pressing it down firmly and smoothly on the top.

title: Never Fail Pie Crust
directions: Combine flour, baking powder and salt., Cut in shortening. Make a well in dry ingredients and add egg, vinegar and cold water., Prepare as for any pie crust.

title: Cheese Whiz
directions: Melt cheese and milk., Add mustard and vinegar., Put in container and refrigerate.

title: Cheese Ring
directions: Mix all together with hands and shape into a ring. Put strawberry jam or green pepper jam in center and serve with crackers of your choice.

title: Crock-Pot Mushroom Barley Soup
directions: Microwave meat first, or else put in crock-pot and cook until half done., Add barley and mushrooms, fill pot to within 1 inch of top with stock or water., Cook 3 to 4 hours until barley is done. Season to taste.

title: Oatmeal Cake
directions: Combine ingredients., Spread on cake while hot., Brown under broiler until coconut is brown.

title: Short'Nin Bread
directions: Combine sugar and flour., Add butter., Place on floured board; pat to thickness of 1/2-inch., Cut into shapes desired., Bake in a moderate oven (325° to 350°) for 25 minutes.

title: Neiman Marcus Cookies
directions: Cream the butter and both sugars., Add eggs and vanilla; mix together with the flour, oatmeal, salt, baking powder and soda. Add chocolate chips, Hershey Bar and nuts., Roll into balls and place two inches apart on a cookie sheet., Bake for 10 to 12 minutes at 375°. makes 55-60 cookies.

title: Strawberry Pie
directions: Cook water, sugar and cornstarch until clear., Add 3 tablespoons jello powder and red food coloring., Let cool., Place washed strawberries in baked pie shell., Cover with above mixture. Chill; serve with Cool Whip.

title: Pork Chops
directions: Put flour, salt and pepper in a bag., Put pork chops in and shake until flour covers chops., Put Crisco in frying pan., One at a time, put chops in pan., Cook on medium heat until done.

title: Very Berry Surprise
directions: Drain blueberries and pineapple (save juice)., Mix Jell-O with package directions (hot water only)., Add juice from berries and pineapple., Let jell., Add pineapple and blueberries to Jell-O. Mix remaining ingredients together., Top chilled Jell-O mixture and chill.

title: Corn Bread Mix
directions: Mix dry ingredients together and cut in shortening. Store in an airtight container., Take the amount that you think you need and add egg and water., Bake until golden brown.

title: Fiesta Meat Loaf
directions: *Add more bread crumbs to taste.

title: Watergate Salad(Club Member: Lee Higginbotham)
directions: Mix all the ingredients in order listed. Cool before serving.

title: Ice Cream Dessert
directions: Heat liquid to boil., Dissolve Jello and let cool slightly. By spoonful, add ice cream until all is in and melted., Chill for 10 to 15 minutes, stirring every 5 minutes and fold in fruit., Mix well., Chill till set.

title: Gingersnaps
directions: Combine the sugar with flour, salt, soda, cinnamon, ginger and cloves., Cut in shortening until mixture looks like crumbs. Stir in molasses and egg., Mix well., Shape dough into 1 inch balls - no bigger- and roll in sugar., Bake at 350° for 10 minutes., Remove from cookie sheet immediately because cookies firm quickly as they cool., Makes about 4 1/2 dozen cookies. These are good and easy to make.

title: Chocolate Sheet Cake
directions: Put oleo, cocoa and buttermilk in saucepan., Heat over low heat, do not boil; remove and stir in sugar, pecans and vanilla. Beat, then spread while cake is still hot and serve., Wonderful!

title: Sausage Rings
directions: Mix Bisquick and water well., Roll the dough mixture thin. Spread the sausage in a thin layer over the dough., Roll from each end toward the middle for 2 rolls., Cut down the middle and wrap in Handi-Wrap., Refrigerate overnight for easier slicing or freeze for several weeks., Slice 1/2 inch rings., Bake in 400° oven until slightly brown, around 20 minutes.

title: Texas Cake
directions: Mix flour and sugar., Bring shortening, water, margarine and cocoa to boil., Pour over flour and sugar mixture., Add buttermilk (sour cream can be substituted), eggs, vanilla, baking soda and salt., Mix thoroughly., Pour into 12 x 17-inch sheet pan., Bake at 400° for 20 minutes.

title: Triple Chocolate Bars
directions: Heat oven to 350°., In large pan, cook pudding with milk as directed on package., Blend dry cake mix thoroughly into hot pudding; beat one or two minutes., (You don't add eggs or other ingredients listed on cake mix.), Pour into greased, floured pan, 15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 1-inch., Sprinkle with nuts and chocolate bits. Bake 25 to 30 minutes at 350°., Cool and cut into bars.

title: Jumbo Pasta Shells
directions: Save 1 cup Mozzarella cheese for topping.

title: Angel Food Delight
directions: Melt chocolate chips in double boiler; add beaten egg yolk and cool., Add beaten egg whites, sugar and nuts., Fold in whipped cream., Put broken pieces of cake in bottom of pan., Pour cool mixture over the pieces of cake., Refrigerate until serving time.

title: Deviled Eggs
directions: Cook eggs; remove shells and cut each in half lengthwise. Remove yolks., Mix yolks with rest of ingredients., Fill each half white of egg with mixture.

title: Microwave Garlicy Potatoes
directions: Place potatoes in a 1 1/2-quart dish., Add remaining ingredients and stir to coat potatoes., Cover tightly with microwave plastic wrap., Cook on High for 10 minutes in a 600 to 700 watt oven or 15 minutes in a 400 to 500 watt oven, shaking dish to redistribute potatoes., Potatoes are done when the tip of a small knife easily pierces the potato in the center., Serves 4 as a side dish.

title: Sixty Minute Rolls
directions: Combine 1 1/2 cups flour with the sugar, salt and undissolved yeast., Combine milk, water and margarine in a saucepan., Warm over low heat to 115° to 120°., (Margarine does not have to be melted.), Remove from heat and gradually add flour mixture., Beat 2 minutes at medium speed, scraping sides of bowl occasionally. Add 1/2 cup flour., Beat on high for 2 minutes., Stir in additional flour to form soft dough., Turn out onto lightly floured board., Knead 5 minutes until smooth and elastic., Place in greased bowl., Turn over and grease top., Let rise 15 minutes. Turn out on a floured board., Divide dough in half and shape into rolls., Cover and let rest in a warm place for 15 minutes., Bake at 425° for 12 minutes or until done.

title: Coconut Pie
directions: Mix all ingredients together; pour into a pie shell., Bake at 375° for 30 to 40 minutes, or until golden brown and not runny.

title: Danish Sesame Bran Bread
directions: Combine boiling water and cornmeal., Combine 1 1/2 cups unbleached flour, 1 cup whole wheat flour, cereal, sesame seed, salt and yeast; blend well., Heat milk, oil, molasses and honey until very warm., Add warm liquid, cornmeal mixture and yogurt to flour mixture., Blend well., Stir in rest of whole wheat flour until stiff dough forms., Knead in 1 to 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour about 8 minutes., Place in greased bowl; cover loosely with plastic wrap and cloth towel., Let rise in warm place until light and doubled in size, 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

title: Dorothy'S Candy
directions: Melt chocolate very slowly in double boiler; add rest of ingredients., Spread on wax paper; chill., Break into pieces.

title: Ham And White Bean Soup
directions: Dice and saute celery, onion, carrots, zucchini, and ham in dutch oven with, olive oil and seasoning., Stir in tomatoes, chicken broth, spinach, 1 can beans (smashed), and 2 cups water. Heat to boil., Reduce heat and simmer 15 minutes., Add the rest of beans and sprinkle with parmesan cheese.

title: Frosted Coffee Bars
directions: Mix in order., Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch cake pan., Bake in a 350° oven. Frost with powdered sugar frosting, flavored with coffee.

title: Stir-Fried Beef And Vegetables
directions: Trim fat; slice meat into thin strips., Combine salad oil, sugar, cornstarch and pepper sauce and add meat strips., Cut vegetables up.

title: Crunchy Broccoli Salad
directions: Combine mayonnaise, vinegar and sugar to make dressing., Set aside.

title: Marinated Shrimp
directions: Combine shrimp, carrots, onions and peppers; set aside., Mix well soup, vinegar, salad oil, sugar and mustard., Pour over shrimp and vegetables., Mix lightly., Refrigerate overnight. Before serving, add cucumber slices., (You can also add orange or apple slices, dew melon cubes, etc.)., Serves 6.

title: Potatoes And Tomatoes With Fresh Coconut
directions: Peel potatoes, then dice into 3/4-inch pieces and put into bowl of cold water., Heat oil in heavy 3-quart pot over medium-high flame., When hot, add finely chopped garlic., Stir about 5 seconds before adding red pepper and cumin seed., Stir for another 3 seconds., Garlic should brown lightly, red pepper should darken and cumin seed should sizzle., Lower heat to medium., Add grated coconut and stir for 10 to 15 seconds.

title: Lemon Nut Cake
directions: Cream butter and sugar; sift baking powder and flour together and add to butter mixture, alternating with egg yolks. Add lemon extract, fruits and nuts; add stiffly beaten egg whites. Bake at 275° for 2 hours.

title: Frozen Cheese Salad
directions: Mix all together and freeze.

title: Pumpkin Pie
directions: Stir eggs into pumpkin., Blend salt, sugar and spices., Stir into pumpkin., Add milk and mix well., Pour into unbaked pie shell.

title: Chicken Acapulco
directions: In a 9 x 13-inch pan layer chicken., Melt margarine and add flour until smooth, add sour cream until it just bubbles., Add soup, chilies and onion salt., Blend well, pour over chicken., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes., Add cheese and bake until melted., Serve over rice.

title: Sour Cream Banana Bread
directions: Cream together butter and sugar; add eggs., Mix sour cream and soda in separate bowl and let stand until foamy., Add sour cream mixture to egg and sugar mixture and mix well., Pour into four greased and floured loaf pans (or 10 mini loaf pans 2/3 of the way full)., Bake 50 minutes at 350° or until toothpick comes out clean.

title: Cheeseburger Rice
directions: Brown meat and onion in a large skillet on medium-high heat. Drain., Stir in water, catsup and mustard; season with salt and pepper., Bring to a boil., Stir in rice; cover., Remove from heat. Let stand 5 minutes., Fluff with fork., Top with cheese; cover. Let stand until cheese melts., Makes 4.

title: Harvard Beets
directions: Cook, peel and slice fresh beets in a bowl and set aside., Mix sugar and cornstarch until blended before adding the vinegar. Stir all ingredients together and cook at hard boiling point for 1 to 2 minutes or until clear and slightly thickened. Add butter and pour this sauce over the beets., Serve warm., May be reheated, but do not boil., If there is extra sauce, it may be used later if stored in refrigerator., A small family would not use 3 cups of beets at one meal.

title: Vegetable Stew
directions: Soak, beans, in, broth., Cook down with garlic that has been minced., Add, onions,, celery, and carrots, all chopped. Add eggplant, peeled and chopped, and olive oil., Season with herbs. Cook on very low burner until done.

title: Favorite Pumpkin Pie
directions: Mix squash, nutmeg, cinnamon and sugar., Mix thoroughly., Add eggs and milk., Pour into pie shell., Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes or until done., (May need to cover edges of pie with foil to prevent overbrowning.)

title: Cauliflower Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients and chill.

title: Bulls Eye Breakfast
directions: Cut hole in bread with biscuit cutter., Spray cooking spray in frying pan., Place bread with hole in pan; cook on medium heat. Break egg into bowl, then pour into hole in bread., Cook until almost set; turn., Put circle cut from bread into pan while egg finishes cooking., Remove from pan and serve hot., Makes 1 serving.

title: Mandarin Chicken
directions: Prepare chicken by removing bones and steaming good size pieces (good idea to buy breasts and thighs)., Dip in tempura batter and fry in hot deep oil., Slice each piece in 1/2-inch to 1-inch slices., Arrange on a bed of shredded lettuce., Cover with sauce.

title: Cucumbers In Sour Cream
directions: Blend sour cream and dry mustard; set aside., Slice cucumber and place in shallow dish., Pour sour cream mix over all., Chill. Serve cold.

title: Bean Soup
directions: Cook all except vinegar and salt., Simmer 4 to 5 hours., Add vinegar and salt when beans are tender (last).

title: Spinach Dip
directions: Cook spinach according to directions on package and drain. Combine ingredients; mix well., Chill., Serve with assorted vegetable dippers., Makes 3 cups.

title: City Chicken
directions: You will also need sticks.

title: Trifle Pudding
directions: Mix and spread in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 340° for 10 minutes.

title: Pecan Pie
directions: Cream sugar and butter., Add remaining ingredients., Mix well. Pour mixture into unbaked pie shell., Bake at 325° until golden brown, about 1 hour.

title: Taco Salad
directions: Mix first 3 ingredients., Put in bottom of container and layer shredded lettuce, tomatoes and onions., Place cheese on top. Serve with nacho chips.

title: Spam And Macaroni
directions: Cook macaroni as directed., Drain and set aside., Cut Spam into small cubes., Set aside., In a pot big enough for all ingredients, melt margarine., Add Spam and cook it for a few minutes., Add macaroni and all-purpose seasoning and pepper. Serves 3 to 4 people.

title: Fried Squid(Calamari Fritti)
directions: Cut, squid, into, rings or 3-inch pieces., If tentacles are large,, cut, in half., Toss the squid in flour mixed with salt and, pepper;, coat, as, you, are, frying, to avoid flour getting soggy., In a skillet, heat enough oil to measure about 1, to, 1 1/2, inches, deep., When, the oil is hot, add squid. Lower, heat just, a, little, and, continue to fry squid until nicely, golden. Drain on paper towels., The squid should cook in, 2, to 3 minutes. Place fried squid on platter and garnish with lemon wedges. Makes 2 servings.

title: Peanut Butter Krispies
directions: In a large saucepan, mix together the corn syrup and sugar and heat slowly until it boils, stirring often., Remove from heat and stir in peanut butter until it melts., Then stir in Rice Krispies. Pour mixture into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan., When cool, melt chips and spread on top.

title: Hawaiian Teriyaki Steak
directions: Mix together soy sauce, sugar, ginger and garlic powder., Add meat strips and marinate overnight in refrigerator., Cook on barbecue grill on bamboo sticks after draining.

title: Cheese And Chile Dip
directions: Combine the first five ingredients in a bowl and beat at medium speed with mixer until smooth., If you use a food processor, use the knife blade., Drain the can of chiles., Gently stir in the last three ingredients., Chill well., If you wish, garnish with chile strip., Set out at room temperature before serving, about 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Rock Candy
directions: Combine first 3 ingredients., Cook over medium heat until mixture is dissolved., Cook over high heat for 15 to 20 minutes. Remove from heat and add desired flavoring or cinnamon oil., Add food coloring if desired., Pour into cookie sheet; allow to cool completely., Crack candy and roll into powdered sugar., Store in airtight container.

title: Buttermilk Coconut Pie
directions: Mix all ingredients well., Pour into a glass pie plate., Needs no crust., Bake at 325° until browns on top.

title: Creamy Sweet Potato Pie
directions: Cook sweet potatoes in boiling water until fork easily pierces potatoes., Cool slightly. Remove skins. Place cooked and peeled potatoes into a large mixing bowl., Mix with electric mixer until smooth. There should be 3 1/2 cups of mashed sweet potatoes.
