Stir in butter and sugar., Beat in eggs, one at a time., Mix in spices, salt and evaporated milk., Pour into unbaked pie crusts., Bake in a 425° oven for 20 minutes., Lower heat to 325° and bake 30 to 45 minutes longer or until knife inserted near center comes out clean., Cool before serving.

title: Bread Pudding With Lemon Sauce
directions: Butter square Corning baking dish. Put bread in dish., Mix scalding milk, butter, salt and sugar., Add eggs, vanilla, cinnamon and nutmeg, stir over bread., Set baking dish in some water in Pyrex pie plate., Bake at 325° for 50 minutes.

title: Monster Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Mix in dishpan in order given., Drop by large tablespoon or ice cream scoop and flatten., Place 6 to a cookie sheet., Recipe does not call for flour., Bake for 12 minutes., Do not overbake., Makes 77 large cookies.

title: Pumpkin Bread
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., In a bowl, combine oil, eggs, water and pumpkin., Mix well., In another bowl, sift together flour, salt, baking soda, nutmeg, cinnamon, cloves and sugar., Gradually add dry mixture to liquids and mix well., If you wish, stir in 1/2 cup nuts and/or raisins., Pour batter into a greased and floured 9 x 5-inch loaf pan., Bake for about 1 hour or until it springs back when lightly touched and sides of the loaf have pulled away from the pan.

title: Jello Salad
directions: Dissolve jello in 2 cups of boiling water., Add strawberries, pineapple and bananas., Stir well., Pour half (about 2 1/2 cups) in a greased pan., Let jell, about 30 minutes., Spread sour cream on top., Add the other half of strawberry mixture., Let jell.

title: Cheese Squares
directions: Mix like pie crust., Add egg yolk and yeast mixture., Divide into 2 parts and roll out on cookie sheet., Top with cream cheese mixture., Top with other crust., Bake at 350°.

title: Super Simple Supper Soup
directions: Bring all ingredients, except macaroni, to a boil., Add macaroni and simmer until tender., Serves lots.

title: Lemon Pudding
directions: In saucepan, blend sugar, cornstarch and salt., Add milk. Cook and stir over medium heat until thickened and bubbly., Cook and stir 2 minutes more., Remove from heat., Stir small amount of hot mixture into yolks or beaten egg., Return to hot mixture; cook and stir 2 minutes more., Remove from heat; blend in butter, vanilla, lemon juice and lemon peel., Pour into sherbet dishes; chill., Makes 4 to 5 servings.

title: Pot Roast (Beef Or Pork)
directions: I add 2 red peppers or 1 fresh jalapeno.

title: Hush Puppies
directions: Mix together., You may add a little more milk if needed., Drop by teaspoon into hot, boiling grease., Fry until golden brown. Drain on paper towels.

title: Frosty Cranberry Salad
directions: Combine cranberries and pineapple., Mix powdered sugar and sour cream together., Stir into fruit., Pour into shallow dish and freeze until firm., Remove from freezer and let sit a few minutes before serving.

title: Heavenly Lemon Dessert
directions: Mix flour and margarine like pie crust, add nuts and press into bottom of a 9 x 13 inch pan., Bake at 325° for 30 minutes; cool., Cream together the cream cheese and powdered sugar; fold in 1 c. Cool Whip then spread over crust., Mix the pudding mix using only 3 c. milk, and beat until stiff; spread over the cream cheese mixture., Top with the remaining Cool Whip and sprinkle with chopped walnuts., Chill well before serving.

title: Sweet-Sour Carrots(Serves 8 To 10)
directions: Peel carrots and cut into strips., Cook until just tender; drain., Add butter, sugar, vinegar and mint or dill., Cook until transparent., Serve hot or as a cold relish.

title: Texas Beef Stew(Serves 6)
directions: Cut steak in crosswise strips 1-inch wide., Mix water and vinegar with ketchup and other seasonings; pour over meat., Let stand several hours, turning meat occasionally., Lift meat from liquid, saving vinegar mixture., Place meat in pan, top with sliced onions and add 1/2 of the vinegar mixture., Cover, simmer gently over low heat for 1 1/2 to 2 hours, adding vinegar mixture as required to keep liquid about 1/2-inch deep in pan., Remove meat and onions to hot platter; strain liquid, then boil hard 3 to 4 minutes, pour over meat and serve while hot.

title: Poteau French Dressing
directions: This should be made just before serving., Rub the bottom of a small bowl with onion or garlic., Put in 1/2 teaspoon of salt, a dash of Tabasco sauce and a tablespoon of cold water (to dissolve salt)., Stir until salt is completely dissolved., Now gradually add, stirring constantly, 6 tablespoons of oil and 1 teaspoon of vinegar or lemon juice., Beat quickly until well mixed.

title: Cherry Supreme
directions: Mix butter, flour and chopped pecans., Press in a casserole dish., Bake for 15 minutes at 350°., Mix the cream cheese, sugar and Cool Whip., Spread on crust., Add pie filling., Eat!

title: Date Nut Bars
directions: Sift flour; add baking soda and salt. Sift again. Combine with brown sugar. Add melted shortening to beaten eggs and combine with dry ingredients. Add nuts and dates. Pour into greased 7 x 11 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes., Cut in bars while hot. Sprinkle or roll in powdered sugar.

title: Chocolate No Bake Cookies
directions: 1. Have all ingredients measured and ready., Line a baking sheet with waxed paper or foil; set aside.

title: Sweetheart Salad
directions: Dissolve gelatine in cold water, set aside., Add pineapple and sugar together in pot on stove., Bring to a boil., Add the gelatine mixture to the pineapple mixture., Stir until gelatine is dissolved., Add lemon and cherry juice, let cool., Mash cream cheese and chopped cherries., Add to pineapple mixture., Chill to slightly thickened., Add Cool Whip., Top with chopped walnuts and cherries, if desired., Mix with mixer in large bowl.

title: Banana Nut Bread
directions: Beat oil and sugar together., Add eggs and banana., Beat well. Add sifted dry ingredients, milk and vanilla., Mix well and stir in nuts., Pour into a 9 x 5 x 3-inch pan., Bake in a 350° preheated oven for 1 hour., Cool well and store overnight before cutting. Makes 1 loaf.

title: Hopel-Popel
directions: Place potatoes	in, a, medium bowl., Cover with boiling water. Let, stand, for, 8 minutes or until water is absorbed. Heat skillet, and add bacon., Cook and stir until bacon begins to crisp., Add, the, onion, and, mushrooms., Stir until barely tender., Add, parsley,, sprinkling	it, evenly, over the bacon mixture and, potatoes., Toss together lightly., Adjust heat to low., In a small mixing bowl, beat eggs with 1/4 cup of water. Add the, salt, and, pepper., Pour, over vegetables in skillet. Sprinkle with cheese., Cook, over low heat for 8 to 10 minutes or until eggs are set., Cover skillet for part of cooking time to help eggs, set on top., If desired, brown under broiler for 2 to 3 minutes.

title: Broccoli Soup
directions: Put water and bouillon cubes in pot; boil until cubes are melted., Add chopped broccoli, onion and celery (celery is a must)., Let boil until soft., Melt butter and add flour., Heat half and half in microwave, then add it to broccoli mixture., Add butter and flour mixture., Let simmer until it thickens., Add parsley and dash of black pepper., No salt is needed.

title: Huckleberry Muffins
directions: Combine oats and sour milk. Let stand., Combine all dry ingredients., Add egg and melted butter to oat mixture and mix well., Add dry ingredients and stir only until moistened., Fold in huckleberries., Fill muffin cups 3/4 full., Bake at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Hot Potato Salad
directions: Boil potatoes in skins. Peel and slice thin. Cook bacon until crisp, then cook onion in bacon fat. Mix in flour, sugar, salt and pepper. Stir water in gradually. Add vinegar gradually. Cook and stir until it boils for 1 minute. Pour over potatoes. Add the bacon. Cover and let stand until ready to serve.

title: Pumpkin Bread
directions: Add sugar to oil., Add eggs and pumpkin., Sift together dry ingredients., Then add water., Place in greased and floured pan. Add nuts, if desired., Bake at 350° for 1 hour., Makes 2 loaves.

title: Pineapple Pie
directions: Cream oleo and sugar. Mix 3 beaten eggs. Mix pineapple and 1 tsp. vanilla. Pour in unbaked pie shells. Bake 50 minutes at 350°.

title: Upside-Down German Chocolate Cake
directions: Grease and flour long cake pan., Sprinkle on bottom the pecans and coconut., Mix cake mix and pour in pan., Mix butter, cream cheese and powdered sugar and spoon on top of cake mix., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Raisin Bread
directions: Prepare sweet dough. Grease 9 x 5-inch loaf pan., Roll dough into 12 x 9-inch rectangle. Sprinkle raisins on dough. From short end, roll dough jelly roll fashion., Pinch seam to seal., Press ends to seal and tuck under., Place, seam side down, in pan. Cover and let rise until doubled, about 1 1/2 hours., Preheat oven to 350°., Bake 35 minutes or until loaf sounds hollow when tapped. Let cool on rack.

title: Oats 'N Pumpkin Pinwheels
directions: Beat 1 cup sugar and margarine until fluffy., Mix in egg whites., Stir in combined flour, oats and baking soda., On wax paper, press into 16 x 12-inch rectangle., Spread combined pumpkin, 1/2 cup sugar and spice over dough to 1/2 inch from edge. From narrow end, roll up dough., Sprinkle sesame seed around roll, pressing gently., Wrap in wax paper; freeze overnight or until firm.

title: Zero Salad Dressing
directions: Combine ingredients in a jar with tightly fitted top. Shake well and refrigerate. Shake well before use.

title: Mexican Green Peppers
directions: Cut off tops of green peppers; remove seed., Cook peppers 5 minutes in boiling water to cover (salt added)., Drain and set aside., Combine next 7 ingredients., Mix well., Fill peppers with meat mixture., Place in a 2-quart shallow casserole., Pour tomato sauce over and around the peppers., Bake at 375° for 45 to 50 minutes., Yields 6 servings.

title: Zucchini Casserole
directions: Grease 2-quart casserole., Layer sliced zucchini, sliced tomatoes, mushrooms and cheese., Repeat to fill dish., Top with bread crumbs., Bake, uncovered, for 20 to 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Fruit Punch
directions: Mix Jell-O and boiling water in large container., Add cold water and stir., Add sugar and stir., Add lemonade and stir., Add pineapple juice and stir thoroughly., Freeze in appropriate containers (large mouth plastic gallon jugs are good)., Let thaw until slushy before serving and add ginger ale.

title: Coca-Cola Salad
directions: Cream the cream cheese and nuts; set aside., Drain juice from cherries and pineapple; bring juice to a boil., Pour over jello to dissolve., Let cool; add Coke., Combine all ingredients and refrigerate.

title: Buttermilk Pie
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., In large bowl, mix eggs, sugar, butter, buttermilk, flour and vanilla until well blended., Pour into pie shell and bake until golden brown (approximately 50 minutes)., Let cool before slicing.

title: Party Ham Biscuits
directions: Combine first 5 ingredients in bowl; mix well., Cut rolls in half., Spread sauce over bottom half of roll., Sprinkle with ham and cheese., Cover with top half of roll., Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes., May be frozen and reheated.

title: B L T Salad Toss
directions: Combine tomatoes, celery, salad dressing, green pepper and onion; toss lightly., Chill., Add bacon; toss lightly., Spoon vegetable mixture over shredded lettuce., Garnish with additional cherry tomato halves and bacon curls.

title: Chicken Enchiladas
directions: Cook chicken until tender; allow to cool and cut into bite size pieces. Saute onion and green chilies in butter. Mix soup, milk and Velveeta cheese in large pan; heat until cheese melts. Add onions and green peppers. Stir until well combined. Add chicken and mix well. In a large baking dish, place a layer of tortillas, a layer of chicken mixture and a layer of grated cheese. Repeat layers until dish is filled. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Greek Pizza
directions: Fry chopped meat and drain. Add tomatoes. Saute eggplant in olive oil, then add to meat mixture. Grate cheese. Set aside. Line a 9 x 13-inch pan with crescent rolls. Spread meat mixture on dough. Top with cheese and season to taste., Bake at 375° for 25 minutes or until crust is golden.

title: Fresh Pickle Slices
directions: Combine cucumbers and onions., Mix remaining ingredients and then pour over cucumbers and onions., Stir gently to mix. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Drop Dumplings
directions: Sift dry ingredients together., Add melted butter and milk. Blend together., Batter should be moist and stiff., Drop by teaspoon into boiling liquid., Cover and cook 18 minutes., Yields 1 dozen dumplings.

title: Impossible Turkey Pie
directions: Heat oven to 400°., Lightly grease pie plate (10 1/2 x 1 1/2-inch)., Beat remaining ingredients after you sprinkle turkey, mushrooms, onions, salt and cheese in pie plate., Pour into pie plate., Bake until golden brown and knife inserted halfway between center and edge comes out clean, 30 to 35 minutes., Let stand 5 minutes before serving., Refrigerate any remaining pie.

title: Chicken Rice Dish
directions: Cook chicken; save broth., Remove chicken from bone and cut in chunks., Saute chicken and mushrooms in butter or oleo. Add the chicken broth, and	green, beans, and, bring this to a boil., Stir in Minute, rice, then remove from heat., Cover for a few minutes before serving.

title: Quick Apple Crisp
directions: Pour pie filling into greased baking dish., Sprinkle top with cinnamon sugar; put dry cake mix on top., Put pats of margarine on top., Bake in 350 degree oven for 25 minutes or until top is brown and bubbly., (Any flavor pie filling may be used.)

title: Hungarian Poppy Seed Nut Slices
directions: Cream butter and sugar; add egg., Beat 2 to 3 minutes; add nuts and poppy seed., Beat 1 minute., Stir in flour and salt. Refrigerate until dough is easily shaped into rolls., Make 2 rolls., Roll in sugar; wrap in waxed paper and refrigerate for 2 to 3 hours., Cut into 1/4-inch slices., Bake on ungreased pan at 325° for 20 minutes or until slightly brown., Store in closed tin.

title: Sesame Stir-Fry
directions: Heat oil in large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Stir-fry garlic and onion 2 minutes., Add broccoli, zucchini and mushrooms., Stir-fry 3 to 4 minutes or until crisp-tender., Add water chestnuts and tomatoes; heat through., Add Molly McButter; stir until melted in., Sprinkle with sesame seed, basil and pepper to taste., Makes 4 (2 cup) servings.

title: Grilled Salmon Fillets(Easy; See Marinade Variations)
directions: Make a marinade by mixing 2 tablespoons oil, ginger, cumin, coriander, salt and cayenne together in large shallow bowl. Add fish and marinate in the refrigerator for no more than 30 minutes. Meanwhile, build a single-level fire. Set grill rack in place. Cover grill with lid and, let rack heat up, about 5 minutes. Rub cooking grate with oil-dipped wad of paper towels.

title: Irish Whiskey Cake
directions: Make yellow cake according to directions, except substitute double strength coffee for water called for., Bake in two round layers., When layers are cool, split them in half., Sprinkle 1 tablespoon whiskey on each cut, except for rounded top., Spread Cool Whip on each cut surface and top., Stack layers., Refrigerate 8 hours (24 is better).

title: Salsa Fresca
directions: Gently stir together all ingredients in a small bowl until blended.

title: Easy Stroganoff
directions: Put beef, soups, onion, salt and pepper into a large pot. Simmer slowly for several hours., When the meat is tender, add sour cream and mushroom pieces., Bring to a boil and immediately serve over hot rice or noodles.

title: Nantucket Cranberry Pie
directions: Sprinkle 2 cups cranberries into buttered 10-inch pie plate. Combine 1/2 cup sugar and walnuts., Sprinkle over berries.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
directions: Blend first 4 ingredients until smooth., Fold in Cool Whip. Pour into crust.

title: Tapioca Jello Salad
directions: Cook the first 3 ingredients together until thick; let cool. Mix Dream Whip; add to cooled jello-pudding mixture, along with drained pineapple and oranges., Refrigerate.

title: Cheeseburger Logs
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Combine tomatoes and bread crumbs in a large bowl; let stand until liquid is absorbed., Lightly mix in ground beef, egg, mustard, salt and pepper., Divide mixture into quarters, then shape into a 5-inch loaf; make a ridge down middle of each with your finger., Place loaves on a rack in a shallow baking pan., Bake 30 minutes., Spoon cheese into hollows., Bake 10 minutes longer or until cheese melts and loaves are crusty brown. Yields 4 servings.

title: Swiss Steak
directions: Cut steak into 1-inch strips., Brown on both sides., Mix soup mix in 1 cup water., Pour over steak and simmer on top of stove for 1 1/2 hours or until tender on low to medium heat. Soup mix will thicken into gravy.

title: Chocolate Chippers
directions: Cream together butter, sugars, egg and vanilla., Add flour, chocolate chips and pecans., Bake at 375° about 10 minutes. (Dough does better if chilled.)

title: Easy Chicken Noodle Soup
directions: Heat water to boiling in 3-quart saucepan., Break block of noodles; reserve seasoning packet., Stir noodles, chicken, bok choy and carrot into water., Heat to boiling; reduce heat. Simmer, uncovered, 3 minutes, stirring occasionally., Stir in seasoning packet.

title: Mississippi Mud Cake
directions: Melt margarine with cocoa in saucepan., Remove from heat and stir into eggs, sugar, flour, salt, nuts and vanilla., Bake in greased 9 x 13-inch pan at 350° for 35 minutes. As soon as it is taken out of the oven, sprinkle miniature marshmallows or marshmallow cream on top.

title: Mixed Nut Crunch
directions: Preheat oven to 250°., In large roasting pan, spread the popped corn and the dry roasted nuts., In heavy saucepan, combine the sugar, butter and dark corn syrup., Cook until mixture boils. Boil for 5 minutes without stirring., Remove from heat., Stir in the vanilla and baking soda., Pour mixture over corn and nuts; stir to coat., Bake, uncovered, at 250° for 1 hour., Stir occasionally., Cool; break apart., Store in covered container.

title: Lemon Chicken
directions: Pound chicken breasts to 1/4-inch thickness between 2 pieces of waxed paper., Mix salt, pepper, paprika and flour in a plastic bag; add chicken, one piece at a time, and shake to coat., Place butter and oil in a saute pan or large skillet; heat over medium heat until bubbly., Add garlic and chicken; saute, turning, about 6 minutes or until chicken is brown and fork can be easily inserted., Drain on paper towels and keep warm., Drain all but 2 tablespoons of cooking fat from pan; add wine and deglaze pan, scraping up brown bits., Add lemon juice and heat 1 minute; return chicken to pan; add lemon slices and heat 2 minutes., Add capers and pimento., Sprinkle chives over all.

title: Chicken Broccoli Casserole
directions: Mix first 4 ingredients., Cook chicken and broccoli., Layer in baking dish. Pour mixture over chicken and broccoli., Top with bread crumbs and small pats of butter., Bake at 400° until top is brown and bubbly.

title: Million Dollar Pound Cake
directions: Bring all ingredients to room temperature., Cream the butter; add sugar and beat., Add eggs, one at a time, and beat., Add flour and milk., Bake at 300° for 1 hour and 40 minutes.

title: Roasted Red Peppers
directions: Place the peppers on a roasting tray and put in a 350° oven. Turn the peppers until cooked on all sides (about 1 hour)., When done, place the peppers in a paper bag., Wait a few minutes and then peel and slice the peppers into strips., Place in a bowl with fresh garlic and olive oil and let marinate.

title: Salmon Loaf # 1
directions: Mix all ingredients and pour into a buttered loaf pan., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until top is crispy., (Mixture will look sloppy.), Good cold, too.

title: Korean Salad
directions: Cook bacon; drain and crumble., In large salad bowl, mix spinach, sprouts, water chestnuts, eggs and bacon., In a jar, combine oil, sugar, catsup, vinegar, Worcestershire sauce and onion; shake well., Sprinkle dressing on salad and toss., Serve. Dressing refrigerates well and is good on any salad.

title: Chicken Broccoli
directions: Cook chicken (cut into pieces) in water with 1 teaspoon salt. Strain and debone., Use 2 cups broth to cook rice., Saute onion and broccoli in oleo., Mix all together and put in casserole., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until bubbly hot.

title: Okra Casserole
directions: Cook and crumble meat., Arrange in layers in casserole dish. Bake at 350° until vegetables are tender.

title: Banana-Nut Muffins
directions: Combine oat bran, brown sugar, walnuts and baking powder in bowl; mix well., Combine milk, bananas, egg whites and oil in small bowl; mix well., Stir into oat bran mixture just until moistened., Fill paper-lined muffin cups 2/3 full., Bake at 425° for 17 minutes or until brown., Yield: 12 servings.

title: Baked Chicken And Rice
directions: Cut chicken in serving pieces; set aside., Sprinkle washed rice in bottom of 13 x 9-inch baking pan., Pour 2 cups water over rice., Place chicken on top of rice., Place parsnips, cut in chunks, around chicken., Mix soup and milk., Pour over chicken. It will look very soupy., Bake, covered, with foil at 325° for 60 minutes., Uncover and bake 30 minutes longer.

title: Potatoes And Sausage Casserole
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Peel the potatoes (enough to fill a 13 x 9-inch casserole bowl) and slice as thin as possible., Grate the cheese., Brown the sausage., Alternate the layers of each, beginning with a layer of potato slices, then sausage and then cheese., Add the milk, salt and pepper., Bake in preheated 350° oven., You may have to cover with foil., For softer potatoes you may want to boil them for a few minutes before putting them in the casserole bowl.

title: Maryland Crab Cakes
directions: Pick through crabmeat to remove cartilage., Mix together all ingredients, except crabmeat, in medium bowl., Gently fold in crab., Shape into 8 crab cakes and place on lightly oiled cookie sheet., Sprinkle with paprika; place under preheated broiler until golden brown, about 7 minutes.

title: Green Bean Casserole
directions: Combine beans, milk, soup, pepper and 1/2 can of the French fried onions., Pour into 1 1/2-quart casserole dish., Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 30 minutes., Top with remaining onions and bake 5 minutes longer.

title: King Ranch Chicken
directions: Place chicken, sliced onion, 2 teaspoons salt and celery in a pot., Cover with water., Cook until tender., Bone and cut chicken into pieces., Reserve broth., Combine soup, broth, tomatoes and 1/2 teaspoon salt in pan and heat., Layer chicken, tortillas, cheese, chopped onion and heated sauce in a casserole dish. Repeat, ending with cheese., Bake at 250° for 20 minutes., Lower to 200° and bake for 40 more minutes., May be frozen.

title: Ron'S Biscuits
directions: Dump all in big bowl and mix really good., Sprinkle pastry cloth well with flour and roll dough out like a cross., Take left side; fold to center., Take right side; fold to center., Take bottom; fold up., Take top and fold down., Roll over slightly with rolling pin, then cut biscuits out with top of drinking glass.

title: Carrot-Raisin Salad(Makes 4 Servings)
directions: Mix shredded carrots with combined ingredients., Refrigerate before serving.

title: Striped Delight
directions: *Suggested Flavors:, Chocolate flavor pudding with graham cracker crumbs or butterscotch or lemon flavor pudding with gingersnap crumbs.

title: Microwave Fudge
directions: Microwave the first 4 ingredients on High 2 minutes. Stir. Add the vanilla and nuts., Stir., Pour into buttered dish., Cool on countertop., May be stored in refrigerator.

title: Broccoli Corn Bread
directions: Lightly cook broccoli., Chop into small pieces (not grated). Saute onion in butter until transparent., Combine all ingredients. Pour into lightly greased 9 x 13-inch Pyrex dish., Bake at 375° for 40 to 45 minutes, until golden brown., Cut into squares. Serves 12., It is oh so good!

title: Hummingbird Cake
directions: Mix flour, soda, salt, cinnamon, sugar, oil, eggs and undrained pineapple., Mix only by hand., Add bananas and nuts and mix again., Bake in a tube or Bundt pan that has been greased and floured., Bake in 350° oven for 1 hour and 5 minutes., Let cool in pan 1 hour before removing to serving plate.

title: Double Cheese Biscuits
directions: Heat oven to 450°., Lightly grease cookie sheet., Mix flour, mustard and red pepper., Cut in margarine with pastry blender until mixture resembles fine crumbs., Stir in Swiss cheese, buttermilk and egg until dough forms., Turn dough onto well-floured board; coat with flour., Knead lightly 10 times. Roll or pat dough 1/2-inch thick; cut with floured 2 1/2-inch biscuit cutter., Place on cookie sheet., Mix egg yolk and water; brush over biscuits., Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese., Bake 10 to 12 minutes or until golden., Serve warm., Makes 10 biscuits.

title: Potato Soup
directions: Peel and slice potatoes into large pot., Grate onion very fine and add to pot with celery seed, salt, margarine and water to completely cover potatoes., Cook until tender, adding water as necessary to maintain level of broth., Mash about half the potatoes and reduce rest to small pieces., Cut up cheese into hot potatoes and broth., Stir carefully until cheese has melted, then add milk., Simmer over low heat until desired consistency.

title: Chocolate Rum Souffle
directions: Soak macaroons in the rum., In a double boiler, melt chocolate with water and 6 tablespoons of sugar., Mix well., Remove the chocolate from heat and add the egg yolks one at a time., Let mixture cool., Beat egg whites, adding 1 tablespoon sugar to make them more dense., Fold into chocolate mixture gently., Line bottom and sides of an oiled 7 1/2 or 8-inch spring-form pan with split ladyfingers., Add half of the chocolate and then the layer of soaked macaroons., Add the remaining chocolate mixture., Top with remaining ladyfingers and cool for at least 6 hours or overnight in the refrigerator.

title: Chicken Salad
directions: Combine chicken and apple., Sprinkle with lemon juice and toss together., Mix celery with mayonnaise and add to chicken and apple mixture., Toss lightly., Chill., Serve on lettuce or eat as is. Makes 4 to 5 servings.

title: Grated Potato Casserole
directions: Place milk, eggs, salt, pepper, cheese, butter or margarine, onion and cubed potatoes in blender container., Blend on high speed, just until potatoes are grated., Pour into greased baking dish., Bake in 375° oven for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: My Favorite Tuna Fish Sandwich
directions: Put tuna in a medium mixing bowl., Add enough Miracle Whip to make it look creamy or to your taste., Cut up pickles and put them in (I like lots of pickles)., Stir it all up and put it on the bread or eat with crackers.

title: Texas Style Cornbread
directions: Grease large pan., Mix all ingredients., Cook 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Pie Crust(Low-Fat, Low Cholesterol)
directions: Sift into a bowl flour and salt., Mix oil and milk., Add all at once to the flour and stir until mixed,, Using the hands, form the mixture into a smooth ball., Roll the dough between 2 sheets of wax paper until it is a circle about 11-inches in diameter. Remove one sheet of wax paper., Turn the crust into a 9-inch pan. Remove wax paper., Bake in 400° oven for 12 minutes or until browned., If the crust is to be baked with a filling, follow the cooking directions for the filling., Double the recipe for a double crusted pie.

title: Swedish Meat Balls
directions: Mix meats together thoroughly., Soak bread in cream about 5 minutes., Cook onion in butter until tender., Mix meats, crumb mixture, onion, egg, parsley, salt, pepper, ginger and nutmeg until well combined., Shape into 1 1/2-inch balls., Brown meat balls in 2 tablespoons butter., Remove from skillet.

title: True Texas Baked Beans
directions: Mix all ingredients well., Put in a large baking dish sprayed with Pam., Cover top with crisp, crumbled bacon., Bake at 375° for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Mulligan Stew
directions: Mix together and cook over low fire for 1 hour or 1/2 hour.

title: Peaches And Cream Pie
directions: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease sides and bottom of a 10-inch deep-dish pie pan. In a medium mixing bowl, mix together flour, salt, baking powder and pudding mix. Mix in butter, egg and milk. Beat for 2 minutes. Pour mixture into pie pan. Arrange the peach slices on top of the pudding mixture. In a small mixing bowl, beat cream cheese until fluffy., Add 1/2 cup sugar and 3 tablespoons reserved peach syrup. Beat for 2 minutes. Spoon mixture over peaches to within 1-inch of pan edge.

title: Chocolate Pie
directions: Mix cornstarch with 1/2 cup milk., Combine chocolate, butter, remaining milk, sugar, salt and vanilla in a double boiler., Heat to the boiling point., Add cornstarch mixture and cook 8 minutes. Let cool and pour into a baked pie shell., To serve, top with whipped cream.

title: Spice Nut Cake
directions: In mixing bowl, combine flour, sugar, salt, baking powder, soda, cloves and cinnamon., Add shortening, brown sugar and buttermilk., Mix until all flour is moistened., Beat 2 minutes; add eggs., Beat 2 minutes more; stir in nuts., Place in 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes., Cool 10 minutes. Frost with Orange Butter Frosting.

title: Tuna Casserole
directions: Add noodles to boiling water., Boil according to instructions. Dice onion and saute in butter., Add soup, milk, tuna, salt and pepper to onion., Cook together for about 5 minutes; do not boil. Drain noodles., Add tuna mixture to noodles and stir until combined., Pour into casserole dish., Sprinkle top with Parmesan cheese., Bake at 350° for about 30 minutes until brown.

title: Vegetables Tossed In Olive Butter
directions: Mix vegetables and steam until tender., Transfer to a bowl. Toss with Olive Butter., Yields 6 servings.

title: Chocolate Delight
directions: Combine butter, flour and pecans., Mix well., Press into 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan., Bake at 375° for 15 minutes., Cool completely.

title: Light Strawberry Pie
directions: Mix sugar, eggs and strawberries., Bring to hard boil. Remove from stove and add Jello., Cool., Whip milk and add to mixture., Pour into crust., Chill., Add a few drops of red food coloring if desired.

title: Chocolate Lush
directions: Mix, flour, margarine and pecans., Press in bottom of a 9, x 13-inch, pan., Bake, for 30 minutes at 350°., Cool., Mix cream cheese,, powdered, sugar and 8-ounces Cool Whip; spread over crust., Mix chocolate pudding and milk., Spread over that layer. Top, with, another	8-ounces of Cool Whip and sprinkle chopped pecans on top; chill thoroughly.

title: Kraut Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients and chill before serving.

title: Ambrosia
directions: Drain pineapple and oranges (use juice as a beverage). Combine pineapple, oranges, banana, grapes, marshmallows, coconut and almonds. Fold in yogurt. Chill. Serves 4 to 6 people.

title: Individual Pizzas
directions: Cut one pita bread in half., Spread on ingredients (sauce, cheese, etc.)., Spray a cooking sheet with Pam., Bake at 400° for 8 to 9 minutes.

title: Spray And Wash
directions: Mix together and put into a spray bottle., Use for removing stains before washing clothes., Apply just before placing in wash. Be sure to always check for colorfastness on colored garments.

title: Vegetable Lasagna
directions: Cook lasagna noodles according to package directions., Drain. Steam carrots, broccoli, cauliflower and yellow squash until tender., Drain., To vegetables, add cream of celery soup., Season with Italian seasoning., In baking dish, build layers of noodles, vegetables and grated Mozzarella and Ricotta cheese., Top with grated Parmesan cheese., Bake in 350° oven until cheese is bubbly and brown.

title: Tostado Casserole
directions: Brown beef and drain., Add 1/2 cup tomato sauce and taco seasoning., Stir., Line bottom of 9 x 11 x 2-inch pan with 2 cups corn chips., Crush remaining chips and set aside., Spoon meat mixture over corn chips., Combine remaining tomato sauce with beans and spoon over meat mixture., Bake at 375° for 25 minutes. Sprinkle with cheese and crushed chips., Bake 5 more minutes.

title: Kayla'S Secret Muffins
directions: Cream butter and sugar until smooth., Add vanilla and eggs, one at a time., Add yogurt, mix at medium speed., Mix in flour, salt, soda and poppy seed., Put in muffin tins., Bake at 400° approximately 15 minutes or until golden brown., Makes 14 muffins.

title: Baked Chicken In Sour Cream
directions: Place chicken in greased flat 2-quart casserole dish., Mix soup, sour cream, broth, water chestnuts and almonds., Heat and pour over chicken., Top with cracker crumbs which have been tossed in oleo., Bake at 375° until crackers are browned.

title: Dump Cake
directions: Grease baking dish., Add crushed pineapple, pie filling, yellow cake mix and nuts in layers., Pour melted margarine over top., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Red Punch
directions: Mix together; add water., Makes 2 gallons.

title: Sausage Strata
directions: Put croutons in a greased 8 x 12-inch pan; top with cheese. Cook sausage in skillet until brown., Drain on paper towels. Place sausage over cheese.

title: Blonde Brownies
directions: Melt butter over low heat., Remove from heat and stir in brown sugar until well blended., Cool., Stir in egg., Sift together and stir in flour, baking powder and salt., Then stir in vanilla and walnuts., Spread in well-greased 8-inch square pan., Bake at 350° about 25 minutes., Do not overbake!, Cut into bars or squares while still warm.

title: Frosty Pineapple Punch
directions: Combine first 3 ingredients in a punch bowl., Just before serving, spoon sherbet into punch bowl by heaping tablespoonfuls; stir gently., Serve immediately., Yields 3 quarts.

title: White Drop Cookies
directions: Beat egg(s), add sugar and shortening and stir well., Add soda to your sour milk, then add to other ingredients., Add sifted flour, baking powder and salt, then add vanilla., Finally add chips and walnuts (optional) and stir together thoroughly., Drop on greased cookie sheet., Bake at 350° until golden brown.

title: Dill Pickles
directions: Select fresh even cucumbers., Wash and cut ends off., Place dill in jar and clove of garlic., (If you wish you can use hot peppers.), Pack in sterilized jars., Add 3 level teaspoons of salt in each jar., Boil 1 quart vinegar and 3 quarts water., Pour hot over pickles and seal., Put in cold packer, starting with cold water., When water comes to a boil, remove jars., Let stand 4 weeks before eating.

title: Taco Salad
directions: Brown ground beef., Add taco seasoning and water., Cook 15 minutes., Cool., In separate bowl, chop the lettuce, onion and tomatoes., Add ground beef., Refrigerate 1 hour., Before serving, add cheese, dressing and crushed Fritos.

title: Easy Refrigerator Roll Dough
directions: Dissolve yeast in warm water in a large bowl., Stir in sugar, shortening, beaten egg, salt and 3 cups of the flour., Beat until smooth., Stir in enough flour to make dough easy to handle., Place dough in greased bowl, then turn greased side up., Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours or until ready to use., Dough can be kept up to 4 days in refrigerator at 45° or below; keep covered.

title: Nuts Over Turkey
directions: Combine first seven ingredients., Spoon into 1 1/2-quart casserole., Top with almonds. Bake at, 350° for 20 minutes or until heated through., Makes 3 cups., Has 300 calories per 1/2 cup serving.

title: Country Butter
directions: Note:, Have oleo and cream cheese at room temperature (soft).

title: Pickled Beets
directions: Combine all ingredients in a saucepan and bring to a boil. Simmer for 5 minutes., Cool and enjoy., (When storing, keep cloves with beets in juice to keep flavor., Lasts forever!)

title: Continental Round Steaks
directions: About 1 1/2 hours before serving:, In large skillet over medium-high heat, cook bacon until light brown., Push bacon to one side of skillet.

title: H And J Pizza
directions: Mix yeast and water together. Set aside., Mix all the rest of the ingredients together., Combine both mixtures. Turn dough on floured board., Knead. Spread on greased pizza pan., Let stand 15 minutes. Spread spaghetti sauce on dough, then add cooked hamburger meat, mushrooms, cheese, onions, pepper or whatever you like. Preheat oven to 425°., Cook 15 to 20 minutes. Eat and enjoy.

title: Cucumber Salad
directions: Prepare salad 1 hour before using and refrigerate.

title: Garden Macaroni Salad
directions: Cook macaroni according to package directions. Drain and rinse with cold water. Add ham and remaining ingredients. Toss well. Chill at least 4 hours before serving.

title: Oreo Dirt Cake
directions: Mix cream cheese and powdered sugar and fold in Cool Whip. Mix milk and pudding., When thick, fold into Cool Whip mixture. Put 1/2 of crumbled Oreos in bowl; layer pudding mixture and top with layer of Oreo crumbs.

title: Potatoes Deluxe I
directions: Melt 1/2 cup margarine in baking dish in slow oven., Mix potatoes, onion, cheese, sour cream and soup and place in baking dish., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes., Mix corn flakes and 1/2 cup melted margarine., Put on top and bake 15 minutes longer., Serves 8 to 10.

title: Sweet And Sour Tofu And Vegies
directions: Dissolve cornstarch in 2 tablespoons of water; add 1/4 cup pineapple juice, 1/4 cup water, vinegar, honey, soy sauce, ginger, and pepper; set aside., Heat oil in a wok or large skillet on high heat., Add onion and stir until strong smell starts to go away. Add carrot and stir a little more., Add tofu and stir until lightly browned., Add green pepper and salt., Stir a minute more, then reduce heat to medium and cook, uncovered., Colorful, rich and juicy with a Chinese flavor., A meal in itself with rice or chow mein noodles.

title: Better Than Sex Cake
directions: Bake cake in 9 x 13 pan according to directions on box., When done, poke holes in cake., While cake is baking, combine pineapple and sugar and boil for 5 minutes., Pour over cake while hot., Let cake cool, then prepare instant pudding according to directions on box., Spread pudding over cake., Spread Cool Whip over pudding.

title: Apple Cheese Casserole
directions: Cream butter and sugar., Add cheese and flour., Place apples in a 2-quart dish., Spread batter over apples., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes until bubbly.

title: Italian Beef
directions: Cook the roast with the dried onion soup and Italian seasoning for 12 hours in crock-pot on low., Cool and slice or shred meat. Save drippings., To drippings, add the remaining ingredients. Simmer until ready to serve.

title: Monastery Lentil Soup
directions: Saute oil, onions and carrots for 5 minutes., Add all ingredients to one pot and cook for 45 minutes., Add sherry at end., Serve with Swiss cheese.

title: Fruit Pizza
directions: Mix and spread on greased and floured jelly roll pan., Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.

title: Saucy Asparagus
directions: In a 2-quart saucepan over medium heat, combine soup and milk. Heat to boiling, stirring often., Add asparagus., Cover; cook over low heat 10 minutes or until asparagus is tender, stirring occasionally., Serve with grated Parmesan cheese, if desired. Makes 8 servings., Preparation time: 10 minutes., Cook time:, 15 minutes.

title: Zombie
directions: Build in bucket glass with crushed ice., Float rum., Garnish with red cherry and orange slice.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Top with French fried onions last 10 minutes.

title: Yogurt Pound Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Cream the butter., Gradually add sugar, beating until mixture is light and fluffy. Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition. Combine flour, soda and salt. Add to creamed mixture, mixing well., Stir lemon rind, vanilla and yogurt into batter. Pour batter into, a greased and floured 10-inch Bundt pan. (I just spray with Pam, no flour.) Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until a wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean., Cool in pan 15 minutes; remove from pan and cool completely on a rack., Sprinkle cake with powdered sugar, if desired., Yields one 10-inch cake.

title: Cheesy Lasagna
directions: Saute beef and onion in a deep skillet., Pour off fat, then add tomatoes and tomato paste and simmer for 30 minutes., Add 2 beaten eggs to cottage cheese, salt and oregano., Place cooked noodles at the bottom of a 9 x 13-inch casserole dish, alternating the meat and egg and cottage cheese mixture., Cover with half of the Mozzarella cheese, then a layer of noodles and repeat., Cook in oven at 350° for 30 minutes., Let set about 15 minutes before serving.

title: Sauerkraut Salad
directions: Mix together and set aside while preparing dressing.

title: Vegetable Casserole
directions: Mix vegetables, water chestnuts, cream of chicken soup, onion, and mayonnaise (or sour cream) together. Place in a 9 X 13 glass baking dish. Melt butter and mix with crumbled Ritz crackers. Spread crackers over top of casserole. Bake at 350 for 25 minutes. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Holiday Salad
directions: Mix jello and cold water; set for a couple minutes and add 1/4 cup boiling water until dissolved., Add all ingredients., Chill!

title: Beef Stew
directions: Mix all ingredients in large casserole dish., Cover., Bake at 250° for 5 to 6 hours., Serve with cornbread.

title: Chicken Pie
directions: In fry pan cook chicken with olive oil., Add diced carrots and broccoli., Take a 9 inch pie pan and place a bottom crust., In bowl mix soup with 1/2 c. milk., In pie pan add your chicken, broccoli and carrots, potatoes., Pour soup over ingredients., Put top on pie., Preheat over 350°., Cook pie in oven until golden brown or approximately 1 hour.

title: Cheese Quiche
directions: About 1 1/4 hours before serving, prepare pie crust mix as label directs for 1 crust pie; use to line 9-inch pie plate. Preheat oven to 425°., In medium bowl, with wire whisk or fork, mix eggs, half and half, salt and pepper until well blended. Sprinkle shredded cheese in pie crust., Pour egg mixture over cheese., Bake quiche 15 minutes, turn oven control to 325° and bake for 35 minutes longer or until knife inserted in center of quiche comes out clean., Makes 6 main dish servings.

title: Favorite Baked Beans
directions: Cook bacon until crisp; drain and crumble, reserving drippings., Set bacon aside., Saute onion, catsup, brown sugar, Worcestershire sauce and mustard in a greased 1-quart casserole. Cover and bake at 350° for 45 minutes., Yield: 4 servings.

title: Baked Chicken Coating
directions: Brush chicken with oil and coat with this coating., Bake until done.

title: Peter Paul Mounds Cake
directions: Cream together sugar and shortening, beating in eggs, one at a time., Sift flours together; add milk and vanilla., Pour into 3 greased and floured 9-inch pans., Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Tostada Casserole
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., Brown beef and drain fat., Add 1/2 cup tomato sauce and the taco seasoning., Mix well., Line bottom of 2-quart flat casserole with 2 cups corn chips., Crush the remaining chips and set aside., Spoon meat mixture over corn chips in dish., Combine remaining tomato sauce and the refried beans. Spread over meat., Bake, covered, for 25 minutes., Sprinkle with shredded Cheddar cheese and crushed corn chips., Bake, uncovered, for 5 minutes more., Serves 5.

title: Broccoli Nut Casserole
directions: Cook broccoli., Drain. Add soup, mayonnaise and nuts., Mix well. Add eggs and onion., Pour into greased baking dish. Sprinkle with cheese and top with crumbs. Repeat., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Joyce'S Fruit Cookies
directions: Cream butter and brown sugar., Add eggs., Gradually add flour, soda, allspice and milk., Fold in candied fruit, nuts and raisins. Drop by teaspoon on greased cookie sheet and bake approximately 15 minutes at 350°., Makes 3 1/2 dozen.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
directions: Mix first 5 ingredients., Add salt and soda., Stir well., Add flour and chocolate chips., Bake at 325° for 8 minutes., Remove from oven when light brown.

title: Broccoli & Cauliflower Cheese Soup
directions: Dehead broccoli and cauliflower., Put in a 3-quart pot with enough water to cover vegetables., Cover and steam until done. Drain., Add 1 to 1-1/2 quarts of milk and 1/2 loaf of Velveeta cheese., Cover., Simmer 20 to 30 minutes or until cheese has melted.

title: Homestyle Pot Pie
directions: Line 9-inch pie plate with 1 crust; set aside. Combine remaining ingredients. Add salt and pepper to taste. Pour filling in pie crust. Top with second crust. Seal and crimp edges. Slit top of crust to vent and bake at 375° for 45 to 60 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Peanut Pie
directions: Beat eggs slightly; add sugar, syrup and butter and mix well. Add vanilla; add peanuts., Bake at 350° for about 45 to 50 minutes or until filling is firm and brown., Pie may be soft when shaken gently but will firm as it cools.

title: Hot Spiced Tea
directions: Bring to a boil., Turn heat down and simmer 15 to 30 minutes.

title: Polish Mistakes
directions: Fry sausage and hamburger together; drain grease off., Put in a bowl while warm; mix Cheez Whiz., Put on party rye bread (rye bread) and broil until bread is lightly brown and crisp., Watch close.

title: Spiced Apple Loaf
directions: Preheat the oven to 350°., Grease a 9 x 5-inch loaf pan., In a medium bowl, mix together flour, pumpkin pie spice, baking powder, baking soda and salt., In a large bowl, using a wooden spoon or an electric mixer set on medium speed, beat together butter and sugar until light and fluffy., Stir in the apples., Stir flour mixture into the apple mixture until the dry ingredients are just moistened., Spoon batter into the prepared pan., Bake until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean, about 1 hour. Transfer the pan to a wire rack to cool for 10 minutes., Turn the cake out onto the rack to cool completely.

title: Sauerkraut Casserole
directions: In a skillet, cook sausage and onion until sausage is brown and onion is tender, drain., Stir in apples, sauerkraut, water, brown sugar and caraway seeds., Transfer to a 2 1/2 qt. baking dish., Cover and bake at 350 degrees for one hour., Garnish with parsley, if desired., Make 6 to 8 servings.

title: Pecan Pie
directions: Combine sugar and syrup; mix well., Add eggs, butter, vanilla and nuts., Mix well and pour into uncooked pie crust., Bake for 10 minutes at 400°., Lower temperature to 300° and cook for 35 minutes longer.

title: Ri'S Easy Salisbury Steak
directions: Preheat oven to 400°., Mix all ingredients, except peas and gravy, and shape into 2 loaves., Spray a 9 x 13-inch pan with Pam. Place loaves in dish, lightly spray top with Pam to help brown nicely and bake at 400° for 1/2 hour., Add gravy and bake at 350° for 1/2 hour., Then add peas to gravy and steak., Bake for 15 minutes.

title: Buttermilk Custard Pie(My Mother'S Recipe)
directions: Beat egg yolks, butter and sugar., Add flour and buttermilk. Cook over low heat until thick, stirring constantly., Add extract. Pour into baked pie shell., Top with meringue and brown.

title: Bbq Rice
directions: Pour rice, in, a large baking dish., Add soup and mushrooms and, stir, to mix.	Place 1 stick of margarine in center of dish. Bake, in, preheated oven at 400° for approximately 1 hour.

title: Bread Pudding
directions: Mix all but bread cubes and raisins., Add bread cubes and raisins., Pour into well oiled baking dish., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Stuffed Shells Florentine
directions: Cook shells according to package directions., Pour marinara sauce into saucepan and heat., Spoon 1 cup of sauce into bottom of a large roasting pan or 1/2 cup sauce into each of two 2-quart baking pans., Reserve remaining sauce; keep warm.

title: Beef Stroganoff
directions: Combine the 1 tablespoon flour and the salt; coat meat., Melt 2 tablespoons butter in skillet; add meat and brown quickly on both sides., Add mushrooms, onion, and garlic; cook till crisp-tender, 3 or 4 minutes., Remove meat and mushrooms from pan. Add 2 tablespoons butter to pan drippings., Blend in the 3 tablespoons flour., Add tomato paste; stir in beef stock., Cook and stir till thickened and bubbly., Return browned meat and mushrooms to skillet., Stir in sour cream and wine; cook slowly until hot; do not boil., Serve over noodles. Serves 4 or 5.

title: Orange Raisin Bread
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Mix flour, sugar, baking powder and salt. Beat egg whites in small bowl; stir in milk, juice, oil and peel. Add to flour mixture., Stir until moistened., Stir in cereal. Pour into prepared pans., Bake 1 hour.

title: Potato Casserole
directions: Defrost hash browns and combine in a large bowl with melted butter, salt and pepper., Add onion, soup, sour cream and cheese. Blend ingredients thoroughly., Pour into buttered 3-quart casserole dish., Mix 1/4 cup melted butter with corn flakes. Sprinkle crumbs over casserole., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: French Pea Soup
directions: Wash peas and put in 6-quart pot., Add 6 cups water and 2 onions., Cook on low heat for 45 minutes., Add carrots and celery. Cook for an additional 30 minutes on low heat, continuing to be sure it remains boiling., Serves 4 to 6.

title: Casserole Sauce Mix
directions: Combine all ingredients and mix well., Store in an airtight container and keep in refrigerator., This recipe makes 3 cups mix (equivalent of nine 10 1/2 ounce cans of condensed cream soup).

title: Old-Time Tea Cakes
directions: Break eggs into mixing bowl., Add margarine, molasses, sugar, nutmeg and baking soda., Cream thoroughly., Work in flour. Transfer dough to a well floured board and knead until it is pliable., Roll out and cut with biscuit cutter., Bake at 400° until light brown., Yields 3 dozen tea cakes.

title: Hot Apple Cider
directions: Combine spices in a spice bag. Add to the other ingredients in a large pan on stove or use large coffeepot., Simmer.

title: Cocoa Delight Cake
directions: Combine dry ingredients in mixing bowl., Add Crisco and first amount of milk called for., Beat with mixer at medium speed for 2 minutes., Add eggs, rest of milk and vanilla., Beat 2 minutes. Spread batter in 2 well greased and floured 9 x 1 1/2-inch round layer cake pans., Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes until center springs back when touched lightly., Cook 10 to 20 minutes, then remove from pans.

title: Quick Caramel Frosting
directions: Melt butter in saucepan., Add brown sugar., Cook until blended and slightly thickened, stirring constantly., Cool slightly., Add cream., Beat until smooth., Add confectioners sugar gradually until right consistency to spread.

title: Party Casserole
directions: Brown beef and onion; add Ragu sauce and heat to boiling point. Beat cream cheese; add cottage cheese, sour cream and olives and mix., In a 3-quart casserole, layer 1/2 beef mixture, 1/2 noodles, cheese mixture, remaining noodles and top with remaining beef mixture., Bake.

title: Italian Meatball Soup
directions: Combine everything in a large saucepan; bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer 8 to 10 minutes or until pasta is tender.

title: Banana Nut Roll
directions: Lightly grease 15 x 10 x 1-inch baking pan. Line bottom with waxed paper; set aside.

title: Instant Lemon Pie
directions: Mix and pour into 2 graham cracker pie shells., Chill and serve.

title: Monkey Bread
directions: Put 5 pats of butter, brown sugar sprinkles and pecans in the bottom of pan. Quarter biscuits and roll in white sugar and cinnamon mixture., Melt butter and brown sugar over low heat., Add cinnamon., Pour over biscuits in pan., Bake at 400 degrees for 10 minutes; then 350 degrees of 20 minutes or until biscuits are done in center.

title: Venison Roast
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Put roast in roasting pan., Add water, tenderizer and cover., Cook for 1 hour., Peel potatoes and cut in half., Cut celery in half., Add remaining ingredients., Cover and return to oven for 1 more hour., At end of baking time, remove from oven., Place roast on platter and surround with veggies.

title: Cheese Krispies
directions: Sprinkle flour on cheese., Pour on butter., Add salt and red pepper., Add Rice Krispies., Knead by hand., Roll into marble sized balls and bake on ungreased sheet., Flatten with fork and bake at 300° for 30 minutes.

title: Pork Chop Casserole
directions: Melt 1/2 stick butter in frying pan., Salt and pepper pork chops., Brown pork chops in pan until braised on both sides but not until done., Remove from frypan and put aside., Melt rest of butter in frypan., Add rice and brown., Add consomme, onion soup and mushrooms., Bring to a slight boil., Pour into a 2 to 3-quart casserole dish., Top with pork chops., Cover with foil and bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Pimiento Cheese Spread
directions: Combine five ingredients in food processor; process until blended and cheese is fine as you want it., Add pimiento; process just to blend., Store in covered container in refrigerator., Makes 3 cups.

title: Irish Coffee
directions: Fill a stemmed glass with hot water, then empty glass., Refill with boiling water and empty again., Fill the glass more than half full with the coffee and sugar to taste., Stir and add whiskey. Spoon on whipped cream and drink hot coffee through cool cream.

title: Stuffed Mandarin Ham
directions: Prepare stuffing and let stand 2 minutes., Add oranges to stuffing., Place 1/4 stuffing in each ham slice., Roll ham and place each one, seam down, in a baking dish., Spoon remaining stuffing around ham slices., Spoon marmalade over all., Bake at 400° for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Quick Potato Salad
directions: Cut slightly cooked potatoes into 1 inch cubes., In large bowl combine potatoes, onions and salad dressing., Toss gently. Dust with paprika., Garnish with chives and bacon bits., Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Baked Potatoes And Onions
directions: Peel and cube potatoes., Put into shallow baking pan and mix oil into potatoes., Pour dry soup mix over potatoes and mix well. Bake in oven at 350° or until done.

title: Fruit Soup(Servings:  8)
directions: In food processor, blend strawberries until smooth; pour into saucepan., Add water, sugar, tapioca and salt; let stand 5 minutes., Bring to boil over medium heat, stirring constantly; remove from heat and add lemon juice., Chill; add orange sections just before serving.

title: Shrimp Creole
directions: In large pan, saute onions, bell pepper, shallots, celery and garlic in oil until tender., In small skillet, make roux of 1/4 cup oil and 1/4 cup flour and brown; add to onion mixture., Add to onion mixture the tomato sauce, tomato paste, water and all seasonings, except parsley and lemon juice., Simmer 45 minutes. Add shrimp, lemon juice and parsley., Simmer 15 to 20 minutes or until shrimp is done., Serve over rice., Serves 10.

title: Hot Artichoke Dip
directions: Mix all ingredients thoroughly and bake in greased casserole dish at 350° for 30 minutes., Serve with crackers.

title: Ice Cream Jello
directions: Add 4 cups of boiling water to powdered Jell-O., Stir with wooden spoon until completely dissolved., In place of cold water, slowly add partially softened vanilla ice cream to Jell-O mixture in pan., Stir until completely melted., Refrigerate in 10 x 13-inch pan until set (approximately 2 to 3 hours). Cut into squares., Serves 10 to 12.

title: Easy Hamburger Stroganoff
directions: Saute onion and garlic in butter over medium heat., Add meat and brown., Add flour, salt, pepper and mushrooms., Cook 5 minutes., Add soup and simmer uncovered 10 minutes., Stir in sour cream., Heat through., Sprinkle with parsley., Serve with noodles. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Parmesan Potatoes
directions: Pare potatoes and cut into squares., Combine flour, cheese, salt and pepper in bag., Soak potatoes in water., Then shake well in bag, coating well., Melt margarine in baking dish., Place potatoes in dish and bake at 375° for 1 hour., Turn once during baking.

title: Cheddar Garlic Biscuits
directions: Combine biscuit mix, milk and cheese in a large bowl., Mix until a soft dough forms., Drop by spoonfuls onto a baking sheet. Bake at 450° for 8 to 10 minutes or until lightly browned., Mix the butter and garlic powder in a small bowl., Brush the butter mixture over the warm biscuits.

title: Pumpkin Bars
directions: Mix all dry ingredients., Add beaten eggs, pumpkin and oil. Mix all together and bake at 350° for 25 minutes on a large cookie sheet.

title: Fast Rolls
directions: Beat well; cover and let rise 30 minutes., Stir and spoon into muffin cups., Let rise 30 minutes., Bake at 400° for about 20 minutes.

title: Passion-Orange Pudding Jello
directions: Dissolve orange, jello	in boiling water., Add passion-orange juice,, then add evaporated milk., Whip all ingredients together. Let stand for 1 hour in refrigerator.

title: Peanut Butter Bars
directions: Cream sugars and butter., Stir in oatmeal., Pat into 9 x 13-inch pan or cookie sheet., Bake at 350° for 12 minutes.

title: Red Rolled Enchiladas
directions: Fry tortillas in oil in a small frying pan until soft, approximately 2 to 3 seconds on each side. Set aside. Place 1 tablespoon of sauce on each and stack. Brown ground beef and drain the fat off. Add one can sauce and simmer together for about 5 minutes or until the beef and sauce are well mixed. Fill tortillas with beef, 4 ounces cheese and olives. Roll and place into a 9 x 13-inch glass pan. Pour remaining sauce over the top and sprinkle the rest of the cheese and olives on top. Bake at 250° for 10 to 20 minutes until cheese is melted. Makes 5 to 6 servings, depending on how many enchiladas you can make with this recipe. Also great to reheat. You may use Monterey Jack and can use more or less if you like cheesy enchiladas.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
directions: In a casserole dish place a layer of peeled, sliced potatoes. Spoon mushroom soup and cubed Spam., Another layer potatoes, soup and Spam., Fill up dish., Add salt and pepper (to taste)., Mix one can water into mushroom soup can; mix., Pour over potatoes, Spam and soup., Add more water, enough to fill casserole dish up to top layer of potatoes., Bake at 400° until potatoes are tender., Serve hot or cold.

title: Chicken Tetrazzini
directions: Cook spaghetti and celery in chicken broth to package directions., Drain, add green pepper, onion and diced chicken to spaghetti., Set aside., Prepare cheese sauce, milk, flour and margarine in medium sized saucepan., Cook until thick, stir constantly., Add grated cheese and mushroom soup., Mix cheese sauce into spaghetti mixture., Pour into large oblong baking dish., Top with margarine and cracker crumbs., Bake 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Gingerbread
directions: Mix dry ingredients., Blend in margarine, buttermilk, and molasses., Put in unbeaten eggs and mix., Beat by hand 20 strokes. Butter and flour a 9 x 9 x 5-inch glass pan, or 8 x 12-inch aluminum pan., Pour in mixture and bake at 340° to 350° heat for 45 minutes., The bigger the dish, the less heat.

title: Chocolate Sheet Cake
directions: In a saucepan melt butter, oil, cocoa and water and bring to a boil., Mix with flour and sugar in a large mixing bowl., Then add buttermilk, eggs, cinnamon and vanilla., Pour into a greased and floured sheet pan and bake at 400° for 25 minutes.

title: Special K Bars
directions: Bring to boil the white sugar and white syrup; add peanut butter and Special K cereal., Spread on buttered 11 x 16-inch cookie sheet., Melt the chocolate chips and butterscotch chips. Spread on top of mixture on sheet.

title: Chocolate Drops
directions: Mix sugar, butter and milk in a saucepan., Bring to a boil for 1 minute., Remove from heat and add oatmeal, cocoa, peanut butter and vanilla., Blend together; drop from teaspoon onto wax paper. Let set for 1 hour.

title: Deviled Eggs
directions: Eggs:, We usually do 12 to 18, depends on size of group you are feeding or the size of your deviled egg dish.

title: Linley'S Jello Salad
directions: Mix jello and water., Let cool and add cream cheese., Mash with a fork and stir together., Then add pineapple and Cool Whip. Last, add 7-Up slowly., Put into square Pyrex or plastic container., Refrigerate.

title: Black Forest Cake
directions: Prepare cake mix as directed on box., Pour into 13 x 9-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 40 minutes., Cool completely., Empty cherries into a baking dish., Bake for 10 minutes., Cool for about 20 minutes., Remove cake from pan, sitting right side up., Cut all sides off cake., Slice cake in half lengthwise., Remove top layer carefully, a spatula will help., Put bottom layer back in 13 x 9-inch pan., Spread cherries on bottom layer., Replace top layer and spread with Cool Whip., Sprinkle with nuts., Yields 10 to 12 servings.

title: Spaghetti Pizza
directions: Cook spaghetti and rinse in hot water., Add beaten eggs and butter; mix well., Brown hamburger and onions., Add Parmesan cheese and mushrooms., Layer in a 9 x 13-inch pan., Pour spaghetti sauce over meat and top with Parmesan cheese, Mozzarella cheese and pepperoni., Cover with foil and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Microwave Lasagne
directions: In large bowl, crumble beef., Heat in microwave 2 to 3 minutes on High until beef is browned, stirring once., Drain., Stir in sauce and water.

title: Salad Dressing
directions: Put all ingredients in a mixing bowl and mix for 5 minutes. Pour into a pint jar., Serve on garden salad.

title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
directions: Have butter and eggs at room temperature., Grease and flour a 10-inch tube pan., Preheat oven to 325°., Cream butter until soft; beat in sugar and beat until light and fluffy., Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition., Add flour and sour cream, alternately to creamed mixture, starting and ending with flour. Add flavoring and beat until smooth., Pour into pan and bake 1 1/2 hours until golden brown, top springs back when touched., Cool on wire rack before turning out.

title: Popcorn Balls
directions: Pop popcorn; put into a large pan., Mix sugar, syrup, water, vinegar and butter in saucepan; boil until it forms a firm ball in cold water., Pour over popped corn., Stir until all is covered. Use lots of butter or margarine on hands as you form balls., Makes 12 large popcorn balls.

title: Buttercream Easter Eggs
directions: Note:, Use 1/4 cup peanut butter in place of 1/4 cup margarine.

title: Mom'S Favorite Hot Artichoke Dip
directions: Chop artichokes to small pieces. Mix artichokes with rest of the ingredients., Place in decorative baking dish in preheated oven at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Five Hour Oven Stew
directions: Mix the last 3 ingredients and let stand while preparing vegetables.

title: Corn Casserole
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., Mix creamed corn, whole kernel corn, and melted oleo., Add Jiffy cornbread mix and sour cream., Beat egg and add to this mixture., Add softened Cheez Whiz., Mix well. Pour into greased baking dish and bake at 375° for 1 hour.

title: Sweet And Sour Meatballs
directions: Mix meat, eggs, crumbs, onion, parsley flakes and Worcestershire sauce together., Season to taste., Shape into meatballs and bake at 400° for 15 minutes., Drop into sauce and heat thoroughly., Mix cornstarch and sugar., Stir in reserved pineapple syrup, vinegar and soy sauce until smooth., Pour into skillet; cook over medium heat, stirring constantly until thick and boiling., Stir 1 minute., Add meatballs and pineapple bits; heat thoroughly.

title: Hash Brown Potato Casserole
directions: Combine all ingredients together and put in a 9 x 13-inch dish sprayed with Pam., Bake at 325° for 45 minutes.

title: Potato Pancakes
directions: Press the liquid from the grated potatoes and discard. Combine grated potatoes with the mashed potatoes, egg yolk, salt and pepper. Shape into desired size pancakes and fry until brown and crisp on both sides., The pancakes are often served with sauerbraten or other substantial meat dishes or as a luncheon dish together with applesauce.

title: Marinated Sirloin Roast
directions: Mix all ingredients and pour over roast., Turn roast over in sauce and cover all sides., Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight., Bake in slow oven at 325°.

title: Baking Powder Biscuits
directions: Sift dry ingredients together., Cut in shortening., Make a well in dry ingredients. Add milk., Roll out or pat down on a floured board and cut., Bake 10 to 12 minutes at 450°.

title: Jiffy Cinnamon Rolls
directions: In a large mixing bowl, combine 3 cups flour, cake mix, yeast, salt and warm water., Mix until smooth, add enough remaining flour to form a soft dough., Turn out onto a lightly floured surface. Knead until smooth, about 6 to 8 minutes., Roll dough into a 9 x 18-inch rectangle., Spread with butter and sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon., Roll dough jelly-roll style, starting with the long end., Slice the dough into 1-inch circles, place on greased cookie sheet., Cover and let rise in a warm place until doubled, about 15 minutes., Bake at 350° for 15 to 18 minutes., Frost, if desired. Makes about 18 rolls.

title: Ron'S Baked Corn Casserole
directions: In a small bowl, beat the eggs with melted margarine., In a larger bowl, combine the corn and sour cream., Stir in the butter and egg mixture., Add the corn muffin mix and mix well., Pour into a well-greased casserole or Pyrex baking dish (9 x 13-inch or smaller)., Bake at 350° for 1 hour (will be lightly browned on top)., Do not overbake.

title: Mom'S Oatmeal Cake
directions: Pour boiling water over oats; let stand while you cream shortening and sugar., Add eggs., Mix all together., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Italian Squash
directions: Place in pot and simmer until tender.

title: Stroganoff
directions: Fry steak in pan until tender., Mix soup, gravy and 1/2 of the sour cream in a pan; heat on low., Cook noodles in boiling water until done., When steak is cooked, add to the soup mixture., When noodles are done add to the rest of the ingredients., Mix well and let stand for a minute or two., The extra sour cream is for adding before storing leftovers or if it is not moist enough.

title: Codfish Cakes
directions: Soak codfish overnight., Drain off water., Run through meat grinder or chop in food processor with onion and garlic., When done mix together with eggs, flour and other ingredients., Drop by spoon into shortening or any cooking oil., Fry until golden brown.

title: French Fried Onions
directions: Peel onions. Slice 1/4-inch thick. Separate into rings., Dip into milk, then into combined flour and salt. Fry until light brown, a few rings at a time, in shallow frying pan., Drain on paper towel. Sprinkle with salt., Serve hot., Great with steak.

title: Thousand Island Salad Dressing
directions: Put mayonnaise, catsup and sugar into blender; blend 10 to 15 seconds., Add relish and blend for 2 to 3 seconds., Pour into jar or container and keep refrigerated.

title: Peanut Pie(From:  "Southern Living" Magazine)
directions: Combine cream cheese, confectioners sugar, peanut butter and milk in a large mixing bowl; beat at medium speed with an electric mixer until well blended., Fold in whipped topping; spoon into crust and sprinkle with peanuts., Chill 8 hours.

title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Bars
directions: Have ready a 13 x 9-inch baking pan., Mix confectioners sugar, cracker crumbs, peanut butter and butter in medium-size bowl until blended., Scrape into ungreased baking pan and press into an even layer., Spread melted chocolate over top., Refrigerate at least 2 hours until chocolate is firm., Let stand at room temperature 15 to 20 minutes before cutting with sharp knife into bars., Makes 36 bars at 173 calories per bar.

title: Banana-Nut Muffins
directions: Preheat oven to 400°., Grease a 12-cup muffin pan or use paper liners., Beat together softened margarine and sugar at medium speed until light and fluffy., Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition., Beat in bananas until smooth., Mix together flour, salt, baking powder and soda., Alternately stir in flour mixture and buttermilk into egg mixture until dry ingredients are just moistened., Stir in nuts and vanilla; do not overmix. Fill cups 2/3 full., Bake 15 to 18 minutes.

title: Betty Jane'S Onion Soup
directions: Saute onions in butter until tender. Add dash of Kitchen Bouquet. Add beef bouillon and water. Add sugar and Parmesan cheese. Simmer 1 hour. Add sherry. Put grated Black Diamond in bottom of crock (just enough to cover bottom). Pour hot soup over that and add toasted French bread in slices. Top with more grated Black Diamond cheese. Bake in 500° oven until cheese melts and is bubbly, almost brown.

title: Scottish Timesavers
directions: Measure all ingredients into large bowl., Mix at low speed of mixer until a dough forms., Using well floured rolling pin or well floured fingers, roll or pat out dough, half at a time on ungreased cookie sheet to a 12 x 8-inch rectangle., Cut into 2-inch squares. Do not separate., Sprinkle with sugar., Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes until golden brown., Immediately cut into squares along lines., Cool 2 minutes; remove from cookie sheets.

title: Summer Squash Casserole
directions: Cook sliced squash and chopped onion in boiling salted water for 5 minutes. Drain., Combine soup and sour cream., Stir in carrots., Fold in squash and onion. Combine stuffing mix with melted butter. Spread 1/2 stuffing mixture in bottom of a 12 x 8 x 2-inch dish. Spoon vegetable mixture on top. Sprinkle with remaining stuffing mixture. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Cocoa Apple Cake
directions: Cream together until fluffy eggs, sugar, margarine and water. Add all dry ingredients to the mixture and mix well., Fold in the nuts, chips, apples and vanilla., Mix until distributed evenly. Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan, bake in 325° oven for 60 to 70 minutes., Doesn't need frosting.

title: Pudding Cake
directions: Crush Ritz crackers and mix with melted margarine., Put the mixture in the bottom of pan., Reserve 1/2 cup of mixture.

title: Eggnog
directions: Separate yolks from whites of eggs., Beat egg yolks until fluffy and very light in color., Add 1 cup sugar., Add slowly, while beating the mixture constantly, the bourbon, rum and vodka. While still beating mixture, add the milk., Reserve 2 tablespoons sherry., Blend remainder of sherry with vanilla ice cream and beat into egg mixture., Whip cream until it forms soft peaks., Whip in 1/3 cup powdered sugar, folding into this the 2 tablespoons sherry., Set aside., Beat whites of six eggs until stiff. Sprinkle with nutmeg., Fold whipped cream into egg mixture and top with whites of eggs.

title: Peanut Butter Blossoms
directions: Mix first 5 ingredients in a bowl., Mix margarine, peanut butter and 2 sugars in another bowl., Add flour mixture to the other bowl., Mix well. Roll into small balls and roll in sugar. Bake at 375° for 8 minutes or until they start browning., Place a kiss in each and press down so the cookie cracks. Bake 2 to 5 minutes longer until brown.

title: Hot Artichoke Appetizer
directions: Mix mayo, cheese, parsley and hot pepper sauce in medium size bowl until well blended., Fold in artichokes., Spoon into ungreased 2 cup ovenproof serving dish., Sprinkle with garlic powder., Bake 20 minutes or until spread is hot and bubbly.

title: Pound Cake
directions: Cream the butter and sugar., Add eggs, one at a time, and flour alternately at slow speed., Stir in flavorings., Pour into a 10-inch greased and floured tube pan., Bake in a 300° oven for 2 hours or until cake pulls away from side of pan.

title: Mexican Casserole
directions: Cook rice in 3 cups water with salt for 20 minutes., While this is cooking, brown ground beef in skillet; drain and add taco seasoning and 2 cups water and simmer 10 minutes., Add beans. Spread rice in 9 x 13-inch pan; pour hamburger, bean mixture over rice., Spread tortilla chips over hamburger; spread cheese over tortilla chips., Bake in 400° oven for 10 minutes.

title: Eggplant Casserole
directions: Mix all together, except bread crumbs and cheese., Place in greased casserole., Sprinkle bread crumbs and cheese on top., Bake for about 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Cream Cheese Loaf Cake
directions: Sift together the flour, baking powder and salt., Cream the shortening and gradually add 1 1/2 cups of sugar, continuing to cream until light and fluffy., Beat in eggs, beating well., Add sifted dry ingredients, alternating with milk, beginning and ending with dry ingredients., Blend well after each addition., Cut cream cheese into 1/4-inch cubes and fold into batter along with orange peel., Turn batter into 2 greased and floured 9 x 5-inch loaf pans or 12 well-greased muffin tins., Bake at 375° for 50 to 55 minutes for loaves or 20 to 25 minutes for muffins or until golden brown.

title: Broccoli With Rice
directions: Cool rice; spread in flat casserole dish., Parboil broccoli; arrange on top of rice., Combine mushrooms, mayonnaise and seasonings., (For thinner sauce, add 1 cup milk.), Top rice with sauce mixture., Sprinkle almonds on top., Bake 20 minutes at 350° or until bubbly., Serve immediately.

title: Mayonnaise Cake
directions: Blend together in sifter:, flour, cocoa, sugar and soda. Blend in salad dressing and gradually add water to mixture., When mixed thoroughly, add vanilla., Cook 30 to 40 minutes at 350°.

title: Coconut Pineapple Pie
directions: Cream sugar, eggs and oleo., Add flour, meal, vanilla, coconut and pineapple., Pour into unbaked pie shell., Bake slow., Serve with whipped cream or Cool Whip.

title: Chocolate Pie
directions: Mix all together and cook until thick; pour into baked pie shell.

title: Fusilli And Chopped Meat
directions: Put small amount of oil in a large frypan., Cook green pepper and onion until tender., Remove from pan and put on the side., Cook chopped meat, then drain all fat., Return chopped meat, pepper and onion to frypan., Mix the 2 cans of tomato soup together., Pour into chopped meat and mix., Cook pasta., Drain., Return to pot. Add soup mixture and mix well.

title: Grandma Arp'S Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Mix well., Bake on ungreased cookie sheet 10-15 minutes at 350 degrees.

title: Honey Cereal Nibble
directions: To prepare syrup, put honey, sugar and butter in saucepan. Bring to a boil., Mix cereals and nuts in roasting pan; pour on syrup and toss., Bake at 275° for 45 minutes; stir once 1/2 way through., Remove from oven immediately and spread out on a cookie sheet or Reynolds Wrap in a thin layer to cool., Don't leave in pan or it will stick together., Store in airtight container.

title: Meat Crust Country Pie
directions: Combine beef, crackers, onion, green pepper, 1 1/2 teaspoons salt, seasoning to taste and 1/2 cup of tomato sauce., Mix well. Pat into bottom and up sides of a greased 9-inch pie plate.

title: Sausage Casserole
directions: Toss and brown sausage., Drain., Saute pepper, onion and celery in sausage pan., Drain., Boil water and add rice and dry soup mix., Cook until tender., Mix with first 4 ingredients., Bake in casserole dish for 15 minutes.

title: Boudain Dip
directions: Skin boudain and cut into slices. Microwave for 30 to 45 seconds to soften.

title: Chicken And Grape Salad
directions: Sprinkle chicken with lemon juice, salt and pepper to taste. Add remaining ingredients. Add more mayonnaise if necessary until chicken barely holds together. Chill before serving.

title: Texas Brag Cake
directions: Spray Pam in glass dish., Layer pineapple, pie filling or peach slices, cake mix, coconut and oleo., Bake 1 hour at 350°. Add pecans., Bake 15 minutes more., Cool before serving.

title: Rhubarb Crisp
directions: Mix together the sugar, salt, flour and rhubarb., Put into an ungreased 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan., Mix together the oats, cinnamon, oleo and brown sugar; sprinkle this mixture over rhubarb mixture. Bake at 350° until topping is browned and rhubarb is tender, about 35 to 45 minutes., Cool before serving, then top with Cool Whip.

title: Rice Casserole
directions: Use buttered flat 8 x 8-inch pan., Combine rice, sour cream, chilies, salsa, salt and pepper., Put a layer of rice combination and about 1/2 pound Jack cheese, shredded., Finish with rice, top with grated Cheddar cheese., Bake at 325° for 1/2 hour or 300° for 45 minutes., Can be combined the day before serving and held in refrigerator for baking.

title: Stir-Fried Green Beans
directions: In skillet, brown bacon until crisp., Break into small pieces. Add onion and stir until almost done., Add fresh green beans with 1/3 cup water., Turn to medium heat and cook, stirring constantly. Cook for 15 to 20 minutes. Add more water, if needed., Cover and turn heat to low., Simmer for 15 to 20 minutes longer. Add salt and pepper to taste., Serve.

title: Fresh Spinach Salad
directions: Wash well and thoroughly dry spinach., Tear leaves into bite-sized pieces and refrigerate., In a heavy skillet, fry the bacon until crisp., Drain on paper towel and crumble., Shake the oil, vinegar, wine, soy sauce, sugar, mustard, curry powder, salt and seasoned pepper together and pour over spinach., Add bacon and toss lightly., Top with chopped boiled eggs.

title: Pearls 'N Chocolate Cookies
directions: Preheat, oven, to 350°., In bowl, combine flour, cocoa, baking soda and salt; set aside., In bowl, beat butter, sugar, brown sugar, and vanilla extract until creamy., Add eggs, one at, a time,, beating, well, after, each., Gradually add flour mixture. Stir, in, Treasures., Drop by rounded tablespoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheets., Bake 9 to 10 minutes., Allow to stand, 2 minutes, before, removing, from, cookie sheets; cool completely. Makes about 2 1/2 dozen 3 inch cookies.

title: Jackie'S Broccoli Salad
directions: Wash and cut broccoli flowerets into bite-sized pieces., Add raisins, sunflower seeds and onions., Mix mayonnaise, sugar and vinegar., Pour over broccoli mixture., Mix lightly., Top with bacon bits., Serves 4 to 6.

title: Orange Fondant
directions: Microwave candy on Roast - a setting that allows sugar syrup to quickly boil and blend into a candy, yet needs little watching. Mix and cook ingredients in a buttered glass mixing bowl or 4-cup glass measure., Bowl or dish must be 2 or 3 times as large as the volume of the candy ingredients so candy syrup will not boil over. Cover candy during cooking when called for in the recipe., Use a glass plate or stretch plastic wrap tautly across the bowl or glass measure; pierce plastic wrap so steam escapes during cooking. There is no need to worry that candy will scorch because microwaves cook from all sides, not just the bottom., Candy syrups are usually stirred once during cooking so heat is equalized and candy cooks smooth., Do watch candy closely because a microwave oven cooks fast., When candy is removed from oven, it should register 236° on a candy thermometer., Do not put a candy thermometer into a microwave oven or it will be damaged.

title: Fast Fiesta Dip
directions: In medium bowl, combine sour cream, salsa and taco seasoning. Mix well., Serve with tortilla chips., Makes 3 cups.

title: Chicken Rolls
directions: Combine first 6 ingredients and form into log., Roll in chopped pecans and Parmesan cheese.

title: Cranberry Snap Punch
