directions: Combine all ingredients in large container, stirring well. Chill and then serve over crushed ice (2 quarts).

title: Green Bean Casserole
directions: Combine all ingredients, reserving 1/2 of onions., Pour into casserole., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes., Top with remaining onions and bake an additional 5 minutes.

title: Sweet-Sour Red Cabbage
directions: In a large bowl, mix well mayonnaise, chili sauce, relish, onion and salt., Add cabbage and raisins; toss to mix well. Makes 6 servings.

title: Sugar Cookies
directions: Mix dough., Chill 2 hours., Roll out and cut., Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.

title: Monkey Bread
directions: Cut each biscuit into 4 pieces., Place sugar and cinnamon in plastic bag., Add biscuit pieces a few at a time and shake to coat., Place pieces into a well-greased tube or Bundt pan until all are used., Sprinkle layers with pecans, raisins or coconut. Bring brown sugar and margarine to a boil in saucepan., Pour over top of biscuits., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes., Allow to cool 15 minutes before removing from pan., Turn top-side up to serve. Pieces can be picked apart.

title: Coca-Cola Cake
directions: Cake:, Combine flour and sugar in large bowl., Heat margarine, cocoa and Coca-Cola to boiling., Pour over flour and sugar; stir well., Add buttermilk, eggs, soda, vanilla and marshmallows., Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Mixed Vegetables Casserole
directions: Mix all together., Break 1/2 stick of Ritz crackers and melted margarine (1 stick) and put on top., Bake at 375° for 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Creamy Potato Soup
directions: In large saucepan, cook onions in3, tablespoons oil until tender., Add potatoes; cover with water., Cook covered 15 minutes or until potatoes are tender., Blend in soup, milk and salt., Heat but do not boil., Serve garnished with bacon and parsley., Makes 4 servings.

title: Four-Cup Salad
directions: Drain fruit., Add coconut and chill. Stir in sour cream just before serving.

title: Deep Dish Brownies
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Grease a square 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan., Blend butter, sugar and vanilla., Add eggs; beat with a spoon., Combine dry ingredients., Add to egg mixture., Stir in chips., Spread in pan., Bake 40 to 45 minutes (slightly less for chewy brownies) or until brownies pull away from the sides of the pan., Cool completely., Cut into squares., Yields 16 servings.

title: Helen'S Fried Rice
directions: Saute onions in oleo until brown., Add mushrooms and saute for 5 minutes., Add rice and saute another 5 minutes., Dissolve bouillon cubes in water; bring to a boil., Pour over rice mixture. Cover and shut off heat.

title: Pound Cake
directions: Put everything in bowl., Beat 20 minutes with electric mixer. Set oven at 350° and put cake in cold oven., Bake 1 hour., Do not open oven!, Bake in Bundt pan; do not grease or flour pan.

title: Corn Custard
directions: Double recipe if using large casserole, using 1 can of whole kernel corn and 1 can of cream-style corn.

title: Annie'S German Lentil Soup
directions: Wash lentils in cold water., Drain., Now add lentils to cold water., Saute bacon and onions until golden brown., Stir in tomato sauce or tomatoes, add bacon and onions, potatoes and rest of ingredients, adding more water as needed during cooking., Simmer 30 to 45 minutes; add parsley.

title: Spinach Casserole
directions: Cook spinach, according, to, package directions., Drain and cool it., Place, in a casserole dish., Blend in sour cream and onion soup mix., Bake in 300° oven for 20 minutes.	Do not cover. Serves 4.

title: Fried Do-Nut Holes
directions: Beats eggs; add shortening and sugar and beat well., Add remaining ingredients and stir in., Drop by spoonfuls into hot grease and fry until brown on all sides., Coat hot do-nut holes in cinnamon/sugar mixture., Dough can be made ahead and refrigerated.

title: Cinnamon Lemon Cake
directions: Mix cake mix, lemon pudding, cooking oil, water and eggs all together., Mix in a separate bowl the cinnamon and sugar. Set this aside., Grease a tube pan and sprinkle about 1/2 of the cinnamon and sugar mixture around in pan., Pour your cake mix in pan and then add the rest of the cinnamon and sugar mixture on top. Stir lightly and bake at 350° for about 1 hour.

title: Chili Dip
directions: Brown sausage and drain., Add cheese and chili to sausage. Heat until cheese has melted., Stir and serve hot., Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Yellow Split-Pea Soup With Kielbasa(My Favorite Winter Soup - A Meal In Itself)
directions: In a heavy kettle, cook the onion in the butter over moderately low heat, stirring until it is softened., Add the split-peas, the sliced carrot, the celery, the kielbasa, the bay leaf and 2 1/2 quarts water., Bring the liquid to a boil, skimming the froth and simmer the mixture, covered, stirring occasionally for 3 hours., Discard the bay leaf and transfer the kielbasa with a slotted spoon to a plate., In a blender, puree the mixture in batches., Transfer the puree to the kettle and thin it with hot water to the desired consistency., Cut the kielbasa into 1/4-inch thick slices., Quarter the slices and add them to the soup. Season the soup with salt and pepper., Makes about 9 cups before thinning, serving 6.

title: Libby'S Great Pumpkin Cookies
directions: Mix flour, oats, baking soda, cinnamon and salt in medium bowl. Beat butter, sugar, and brown sugar in large bowl until light and fluffy. Add pumpkin, eggs and vanilla. Mix well. Gradually, add flour mixture. Mix well. Stir in nuts and raisins. Drop dough onto greased baking sheet. Spread into 3 inch circle. repeat with remaining dough. Bake in preheated 350° oven for 14 to 16 minutes or until firm and lightly browned. Cool on baking sheets for two minutes. Remove to wire racks to cool completely.

title: Beaufort Stew
directions: Note:, May increase potatoes, corn or shrimp.

title: Peach Preserves
directions: Combine sugar and water and cook until sugar dissolves. Add peaches and cook rapidly until fruit becomes clear, stirring occasionally. Cover and let stand 12 to 18 hours in a cool place. Drain fruit and pack into hot Ball jars, leaving 1/4-inch headspace. Cook syrup rapidly 2 to 3 minutes or longer if too thin. Pour over fruit, leaving 1/4-inch headspace. Adjust caps. Process half pints and pints 20 minutes at 180° to 185° in hot water bath. Yield: About 6 half pints.

title: M&M Cookies
directions: Cream, butter;, gradually add sugar, beating well., Add eggs, peanut, butter,, vanilla, and corn syrup;, beating well. Add oats, soda and salt, stirring well., Stir in the remaining ingredients. (Dough will be stiff.)

title: Frozen Parfait
directions: Mix orange juice as directed., Add sugar and freeze until like slush., Mix all ingredients and pour into orange juice., Place in parfait glasses; freeze., Take out 15 to 20 minutes before serving.

title: Quesadillas
directions: Rub both sides of each tortilla lightly with oil; place on waxed paper or a paper plate. Microwave each tortilla on 100 %, (high) for 45 seconds. Sprinkle cheese on hot tortilla; fold tortilla in half. Microwave on 100 %, (high) for 35 seconds or until cheese melts. Repeat procedure for each tortilla and serve immediately.

title: Sesame Milk
directions: Bring sesame seed and water to a boil; simmer 10 minutes., Add remaining ingredients; blend until smooth., Chill and serve.

title: Ambrosia
directions: Dice oranges and apples. Add coconut and sugar., Mix well.

title: Vegetarian Tortilla Soup
directions: Heat oil over medium high heat in a large saucepan or Dutch oven., Add garlic and onion and cook until tender but not browned. Add tomatoes and cook for a few minutes more., Add the tofu cubes and stir gently until heated through, then add the corn, black beans, green chilies, vegetable broth, cilantro, cumin, salt, pepper and lime juice.

title: Christmas Salad
directions: Prepare lime jello according to package directions but reduce water by 1/2 cup and stir in pineapple., Pour into large dish or pan., Place in refrigerator until firm., Combine cottage cheese, lemon juice and sugar and mash with a fork or with mixer until smooth., Dissolve gelatin in 1/4 cup cold water., Blend into cottage cheese., Add nuts., Spread over lime jello., Prepare cherry jello according to package directions., Pour over filling. Chill until firm.

title: Pancake Syrup
directions: Simmer sugars and water for 10 minutes., Add extract., Doesn't need to be refrigerated but may crystallize., Reheat.

title: Cherry-Almond Balls
directions: Mix Karo light corn syrup, orange juice and almond extract. Add crushed vanilla wafers., Mold 1 teaspoon around a candied cherry., Roll in colored sprinkles. Store tightly covered.

title: French Toast
directions: Heat butter, sugar and syrup to boiling; boil 1 minute., Whisk together eggs, milk and cinnamon., Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan. Slice bread into 3/4-inch to 1-inch pieces; place in single layer over syrup., Pour egg mixture over bread., Cover and refrigerate overnight., Bake uncovered 35 to 40 minutes at 350°.

title: Sonya'S Pretzel Dessert
directions: Blend the sugar and butter., Add pretzels and press into a 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 10 minutes., Cool.

title: Cooked Onions With A Difference
directions: Peel onions., Cut off stem area and hollow out an area about the size of a thimble., Insert a beef bouillon cube in each onion and cover with about a 1/2 teaspoon of butter., You may have to push the cube in firmly., Wrap in aluminum foil and place on grill or in a low oven with mixture side up., Cook for about 1 hour or until the onion is tender., You won't believe how good this is! Serves 2.

title: Portuguese Soup
directions: Saute onion and garlic in oil just until transparent. Add sausage and brown lightly. Add beef stock and all other ingredients., Bring to a boil, stirring often. Reduce heat. Simmer for 45 minutes or more, stirring occasionally., Makes 1 gallon plus.

title: One More Chicken Dish
directions: Cook chicken; cool and dice., Reserve 1 cup broth., Mix soup, milk and broth., Cook until smooth., Fill each roll with 1 tablespoon chicken., Roll and seal edges., Place in 9 x 13-inch baking dish., Pour soup mix over., Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 30 minutes., Turkey can be used, also.

title: Gruyere Potatoes
directions: Place potatoes in a greased 10 x 6 x 2-inch baking dish. Combine next 5 ingredients and pour over potatoes. Bake, uncovered, at 400° for 40 minutes. Sprinkle with cheese., Bake an additional 5 minutes., Yields 4 to 6 servings.

title: Spinach Balls
directions: Combine all ingredients and mix well., Make small balls on lightly greased cookie sheet., Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: No Sugar Cookies
directions: Combine first three ingredients., Stir in remaining ingredients., Drop by tablespoon onto greased cookie sheet., bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Chocolate Chip Pudding Cookies
directions: Combine pudding mix and Bisquick| mix in a bowl., Cut in shortening until mixture resembles coarse meal., Add egg and milk; blend well., Stir in chips.

title: Macaroni Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients, except macaroni and egg, in large bowl. Add macaroni and egg., Mix lightly., Chill before serving.

title: Breakfast Pizza
directions: Cook sausage until browned; drain off fat., Separate crescent dough into 8 triangles., Place in ungreased pizza pan with points toward center., Press over bottom and up sides to form a crust. Seal perforations., Spoon sausage over crust., Sprinkle with potatoes., Top with cheddar cheese., In bowl beat together eggs, milk, salt and pepper., Pour into crust., Sprinkle Parmesan cheese over all., Bake in 375° oven for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Mexican Chicken
directions: Wash chicken well., Coat with flour., Cook in oil until brown., Remove., Put in remaining ingredients and mix., Return chicken to pan., Cover., Cook 30 to 40 minutes or until tender.

title: Buffalo Chips
directions: Brown ground beef and sausage., Stir in spices and cheese. Heat until cheese is melted., Put 1 Tbsp. meat mixture on thin slice of rye bread., Cut slices into 4 pieces each., Brown in oven for 15 minutes., Serve warm.

title: Cheese Ball
directions: Soften cream cheese and Blue cheese with milk and mix thoroughly., Add green pepper, pimento, garlic powder and salt. Mix well., Form into a ball., Roll cheese ball in finely ground nuts.

title: Kathy Powers Hudson'S Zucchini Loaf
directions: In a bowl stir together flour, baking powder, sugar, and 2 teaspoons salt., Cut in shortening until mixture resembles coarse crumbs., Store in an airtight container for up to 6 weeks at room temperature or for up to 6 months in the freezer., Use to make Easy Biscuits, Easy Muffins or Easy Pancakes.

title: Zucchini Bread
directions: Combine first five ingredients., Sift together into first mixture the flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt and spices. Stir to blend., Add nuts and raisins., Beat 4 minutes., Pour into greased loaf pans and bake 1 hour at 350°.

title: Green Bean And Corn Casserole
directions: First Layer:, Mix together green beans and corn., Put in 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Easy Breakfast Casserole
directions: Fry sausage and drain., Sprinkle into the bottom of a 9 by 13 inch pan., Add Italian bread, torn into pieces., Beat eggs with milk, salt, and pepper., Add vegetables if desired., Pour egg mixture over bread and sausage., Refrigerate over night., Bake at 350 degrees for approximately 40 minutes., Sprinkle with cheddar cheese and bake 5 minutes more.

title: Pound Cake(The Best Recipe I Have Ever Tried)
directions: Cream butter., Add confectioners sugar; add eggs and lemon extract., Add 1 confectioners sugar box of flour, filled lightly, vanilla and milk., Mix thoroughly by hand., Bake in tube pan for 1 hour at 325°.

title: Quick Nut Fudge
directions: Heat condensed milk on medium heat., Add chocolate chips, stir until melted., Add margarine and pecans pieces., Add peanut butter., Stir well and pour in greased 9 x 13-inch dish., Cool and cut in squares.

title: Poor Man'S Cake
directions: Boil raisins in water about 5 minutes., Let cool slightly. Add sugar., Add shortening to raisins., Next, add dry ingredients and mix., Bake in greased Bundt or tube pan at 400° for 35 or 40 minutes., If necessary, bake longer and reduce heat to 350°., Good luck., Enjoy!

title: Chicken Spaghetti
directions: Cook spaghetti in chicken broth after cooking fryers., Saute onion and peppers in margarine., Mix in chicken, peas, pimento, Ro-Tel tomatoes and cheese; cut into chunks., Heat until cheese melts., Stir in spaghetti and broth mixture., Pour into three 13 x 9 x 2-inch pans., Freeze 2 casseroles and bake the other one at 325° until hot and bubbly., Garnish with grated cheese.

title: Cheese Soup
directions: Boil water, bouillon cubes, potatoes, celery and onion for 20 minutes., Add California mix and boil 10 minutes., Add cream of chicken soup and Velveeta cheese., Stir until well mixed and cheese is melted.

title: Hot Sauce(Canned)
directions: Mix all in large crock., Bring to a boil slowly., Then simmer until as thick as you'd like., Set into clean jars (hot)., Seal in hot bath for 15 minutes, or until pressure cooked 10 minutes at 5 pounds.

title: Tiger'S Butter
directions: Mix thoroughly by hand the melted white summer coating and peanut butter in a small bowl., Add the melted light chocolate to that mixture and stir slightly., Pour into a wax paper lined pan (approximately 10-inch square) and use a table knife to stir pretty swirls of the dark and light mixtures to give a marbelized effect., Let set at room temperature until solid., Cut into squares and serve as you would fudge or roll into balls and use as centers in a bonbon mold.

title: Herbed Carrot Potato Salad
directions: Combine mayonnaise or salad dressing, sour cream, lemon juice, chives, Worcestershire, salt, dill weed, mustard and pepper until well combined., In a medium pan, heat small amount of water to boiling; add carrots and simmer, uncovered, for 2 minutes., Drain. Rinse with cold water; drain again., In a large bowl, gently toss together the sliced potatoes, sliced carrots, celery and olives. Add sour cream mixture., Gently toss to coat well., Cover and chill several hours.

title: Turtle Cake
directions: Make cake according to directions on box., Melt caramels, margarine and milk on low heat., Pour half the batter in a 9 x 13-inch greased pan., Bake 15 minutes at 350°., Pour melted caramel mixture over., Top with chocolate chips, nuts and coconut over., Pour remaining batter over., Bake 20 minutes more.

title: Quick Spanish Rice
directions: Brown the beef in a skillet; crumble., Drain off fat., Add remaining ingredients except rice, stir to mix well; bring to a boil., Add the instant rice; cover and remove from heat., Let stand for 5 minutes.

title: Potato And Burger Casserole
directions: Cook in iron skillet that can go in the oven., Brown beef and onion; drain off fat., Blend in 1/4 cup flour, ketchup, beef broth, 1/2 teaspoon salt and 1/4 teaspoon pepper., stir in mushroom soup and sour cream.

title: Burnt Sugar Cake
directions: Sift flour, measure and add baking powder and salt., Sift three times., Cream butter, add sugar gradually and cream until light. Add egg yolks and vanilla and beat., Add flour mixture alternately with water or milk., Add caramelized sugar., Fold in egg whites. Bake in two 9-inch layer cake pans in 350° oven 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients together well., Place mixture in a greased casserole dish., Sprinkle additional cracker crumbs on top of casserole., Bake at 325° for 1 hour.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
directions: Preheat oven to 350°. Grease 11 x 7-inch baking dish. Place potatoes in large saucepan; cover with water. Bring to a boil. Cook over medium heat 3 to 4 minutes; drain. Set aside. Heat butter in same saucepan over medium heat. Add onion; cook, stirring occasionally, 1 to 2 minutes or until onion is tender. Stir in flour, salt and pepper. Gradually stir in milk and water. Cook, stirring constantly, until mixture comes to a boil. Remove from heat. Arrange potatoes in prepared baking dish. Pour milk mixture over potatoes. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until potatoes are tender and cheese is light golden brown.

title: One Dish Chicken & Rice Bake
directions: In 2-quart shallow baking dish mix soup, water, rice and paprika., Place chicken on rice mixture., Sprinkle with additional paprika., Cover., Bake at 375° for 45 minutes., Serves 4., For creamier rice, increase water to 1 1/2 cups.

title: Cranberry Drops
directions: Heat oven to 375°., Cream butter and sugars together., Beat in milk, orange juice and egg., Stir together flour, baking powder, salt and soda; blend well with sugar mixture., Stir in nuts and cranberries., Drop by teaspoonfuls on greased cookie sheet., Bake 8 to 10 minutes., Makes 11 dozen cookies.

title: Peanut Brittle
directions: Mix all ingredients, except baking soda, in skillet., Cook 8 to 12 minutes on medium-low heat., Stir occasionally until golden brown., Remove and add baking soda., Stir fast and pour on aluminum foil.

title: Broccoli Rice Casserole
directions: Saute onion and celery in, margarine until transparent. Add Cheez, Whiz, and, broccoli and when, cheese, mixture, has melted, add rice, soup and milk., Mix well., Put, into, 1, 1/2 quart casserole and bake at 325° for 3/4 hour (covered for 1/2 hour, and uncovered for 15 minutes)., Stir, occasionally., Can use more broccoli or rice if you like.

title: Mexican Delight
directions: Brown ground beef., Chop onion and saute with ground beef., Add remaining ingredients and cook for 30 minutes or until rice is done., Serve over Fritos corn chips or tortillas., Top with fresh chopped onions, grated cheese, lettuce, diced avocado, ripe chopped olives, Ranch Style "white cream" dressing and sour cream, taco sauce, etc.

title: Kansas City Vanilla Ice Cream
directions: Mix cornstarch with 1/2, cup of milk until smooth., Add an additional 1 1/2 cups, of, milk, and, cook in double boiler until thick and, smooth,	beating, constantly, to avoid lumps. Blend sugar, eggs, salt and evaporated milk in electric mixer. Add hot cornstarch mixture and beat well., Add whipping cream, remaining milk and, vanilla.	Pour, into, gallon, electric, or hand-cranked type freezer., Pack, with ice and salt and freeze according to manufacturer's directions.	Makes 1 gallon.

title: Angel Bavarian Cake
directions: Mix pudding mix by directions on box., Let completely cool. Slice cake in thin slices and lay flat in 9 x 13-inch dish., Pour 1/2 pudding mix over cake., Top with half of Cool Whip., Add another layer of cake, then pudding, then rest of Cool Whip., Top with package of coconut., Chill before serving.

title: Mom'S Peanut Butter Fudge
directions: In heavy pan put sugar, milk and oleo, stir., Bring to boil. Boil 3 minutes., Turn off heat, stir and add rest of ingredients. When starts to set up pour on buttered platter.

title: Two Birds With One Stone
directions: Boil and mash the potatoes., Add the next 5 ingredients and beat well., Add the chives and dill., Add the cooked, drained spinach and beat well again., Put in a buttered 1 1/2-quart casserole and bake at 400° for about 20 minutes., Serves 6 to 8.

title: Pork Supreme
directions: Cut meat in thin, narrow strips., Season with salt and pepper. Brown in oil, using an ovenproof skillet., Add celery, green onions and peppers., Saute until tender., Stir in rice, broth and seasonings., Bring to a boil, cover and bake at 375° until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed., Fluff rice with a fork.

title: Hot Rolls
directions: Put yeast in warm water; add sugar., Let stand., Put salt and eggs in warm milk and shortening., Add yeast mixture., Stir well. Add flour to make stiff., Set in warm place; let rise, then make into loaves or rolls., Let rise and bake at 350° until golden brown.

title: Coconut Custard Pie
directions: Combine eggs, salt and sugar., Add milk and vanilla., Pour into pastry shell and sprinkle with nutmeg., Cover top with coconut., Bake in very hot oven (450°) for 10 minutes., Reduce temperature to 325° and bake for 30 to 40 minutes or until a knife inserted comes out clean.

title: Quick Buttermilk Rolls
directions: In mixing bowl, dissolve yeast in water., Add milk, half the flour, sugar and shortening., Beat with spoon until smooth and batter falls from spoon in sheets., Using your hands, mix in enough of the remaining flour until dough cleans the bowl., Turn out onto lightly floured board., Cover and let rest 10 to 15 minutes., Knead until smooth and blistered, about 10 minutes. Shape into crescents or any shape., Let rise 1 1/2 hours or until double in bulk., Bake at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Pistachio Dream Cheesecake
directions: Mix together first 4 ingredients and pat into 9 x 13-inch baking dish., Bake 10 minutes at 350°.

title: Kraut-Sausage Casserole
directions: Preheat oven to 350°. Place alternate layers of sauerkraut and beans in a buttered 8-quart casserole, ending with sauerkraut. Combine water and salt. Mix until dissolved. Add to casserole. Slice sausage roll. Place slices on top of sauerkraut. Bake 40 minutes. Remove from oven. Increase temperature to 400°. Arrange biscuits on top. Bake 10 to 15 minutes until browned.

title: Pull A Pound Soup
directions: Cut all vegetables fine., Cover with water., Bring to a boil and simmer 2 1/2 to 3 hours., Makes a big kettle.

title: Champagne Cake
directions: Combine cake mix, pudding mix, club soda, eggs and oil; beat with mixer, then stir in cherries, pineapple and nuts with spoon. Make 3 layers., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes or until done., For added color, use 1/2 jar red and 1/2 jar green cherries.

title: Cranberry Salad
directions: Combine first 6 ingredients in a large bowl., Fold in Cool Whip., Pour into a loaf pan or dish and freeze.

title: Raisin Pudding Cake
directions: Combine brown sugar, butter, vanilla and boiling water. Pour into, 8, x	8-inch	glass, pan., Pour, boiling water over raisins. Cover and let set while mixing batter.

title: Mozzarella In Carrozza(For 6 People)
directions: Cut bread in shape of a triangle., Place 1 slice of Mozzarella between 2 slices of bread., Cover them with flour, then dip in egg, then in bread crumbs., Meanwhile get oil ready and hot so you can fry the bread.

title: Buttercream Cookies
directions: Cut in butter, shortening and sugar, creaming well., Blend in almond extract and sifted flour, mixing well., Roll dough into balls, using 1 level tablespoon of dough for each cookie., Press and sprinkle with powdered sugar., Place on ungreased baking sheets., Bake in a 350° oven., Cook for 8 minutes.

title: Greta'S Taco Dip
directions: Mix taco seasoning mix, sour cream and salad dressing together and set aside.

title: Chess Cake
directions: Mix together cake mix, margarine and 1 egg., Press into greased 9 1/2 x 13-inch pan., Mix together powdered sugar, cream cheese and 3 eggs., Pour over first mixture., Bake at 300° for 60 minutes., Let cool; cut into squares.

title: Eszter Hazy(Austrian)
directions: Dust veal strips with flour, salt and pepper., Saute veal in 2 tablespoons butter, sauteeing quickly., Remove veal from pan., In skillet, heat remaining butter and add onion., Cook until lightly glazed., Add parsley and sprinkle 1 tablespoon of the flour; stir. Add cream and stock, cooking over low heat until sauce is smooth. Add meat and cook until tender., Stir in last two ingredients when skillet is removed from heat., Serves 8.

title: Apple Salad
directions: Drain pineapple; set juice aside., Mix pineapple, apples, pecans and cheese., Cook pineapple juice, sugar, flour and egg on medium heat, stirring constantly., Pour over salad.

title: Orsini'S Goulash Soup
directions: Saute onion, garlic and bay leaf in oil until soft and yellow. Add pork and beef; cook until brown., Add tomatoes, green pepper, potatoes, lemon juice and marjoram., Season with salt and pepper., Add bouillon and water to fill 5-quart saucepan nearly full., Stir in parsley., Cook 1 hour.

title: Drop Cookies
directions: Grease pans., Sift flour before measuring., Mix together dry ingredients., Mix together liquid ingredients., Add dry to liquid and mix thoroughly., Drop by teaspoonful on greased pan 2 inches apart., Bake in a hot oven (350°) for 10 to 15 minutes., Nuts, raisins or sprinkles can be added on top of cookie before baking.

title: Spiced Orange Gingerbread
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Combine all ingredients except orange marmalade and whipped cream., Beat at low speed 1 to 2 minutes. Pour into greased and floured 9-inch baking pan., Bake 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Festivities Poppy Seed Chicken
directions: Arrange chicken in the bottom of a casserole dish., Season to taste with salt and pepper., Stir together soup and water in saucepan over medium heat to remove lumps., Remove from heat and add sour cream., Stir in cheese and 1 1/2 tablespoons poppy seed. Pour over chicken strips., Mix together remaining poppy seed, melted butter and cracker crumbs., Sprinkle over chicken and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Sugar Cookies
directions: Mix all ingredients., Roll dough out (must add a lot of flour to make dry enough)., Cut cookies with cutters., Decorate., Bake in a 400° oven for 6 to 7 minutes, or until brown., (Also can be used with cookie press.), Yields approximately 2 1/2 dozen.

title: Potatoes, Cheddar And Ham Casserole
directions: Cook potatoes in saucepan. Cover with water and bring to boil. Remove from heat and drain. Transfer to a greased 2-quart baking dish. While potatoes come to a boil, make a white sauce by melting 3 tablespoons butter in saucepan. Stir in flour, salt and pepper. Cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until mixture begins to bubble. Remove from heat and slowly add milk, stirring constantly. Return to heat and bring to boil, stirring. When sauce is slightly thickened, add cheese and stir until cheese is melted. Pour cheese sauce over potatoes in baking dish. Add ham and mix gently so as not to break up potatoes. If desired, combine 1 cup dry breadcrumbs and 2 tablespoons melted butter in small bowl and sprinkle over casserole. Bake in preheated oven at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Fresh Pear Cake
directions: Combine sugar and oil., Add eggs, one at a time, mixing well. Stir in vanilla., Sift together dry ingredients; add to sugar-egg mixture, mixing well., Stir in pears and pecans., Batter will be stiff., Pour into a well-greased and floured tube pan., Bake in a preheated oven at 350° for about 1 hour or until done., Cool about 5 minutes and remove from pan., Freezes well.

title: Irene Enright'S Bailey'S Pie
directions: Following directions on Knox package, thoroughly dissolve gelatine., When slighlty cooled, combine with Irish cream and slowly add to heavy cream which has been whipped with sugar and extract until it is almost stiff., Don't add the liquor too soon, or it might not stiffen., When combined, pour into crumb crust. Garnish with sprinkles or nuts and extra whipped cream (so dietetic)., For quick setting, place in freezer for a few hours. Can be frozen a few weeks ahead of time and put into refrigerator a few hours before serving.

title: Fruit Cobbler
directions: Melt butter in pan, 9 x 14-inch., Pour batter mixture in melted butter in pan., Add fruit evenly., Do not stir, just shake pan a little., Put in 350° oven., Bake until brown, approximately 1 hour.

title: Chicken And Rice
directions: Select a deep, wide dish that will hold chicken without crowding and have only one layer., Melt oleo in dish; salt and pepper lightly., Roll chicken in oleo and arrange in dish. Sprinkle dry rice over chicken., Sprinkle soup mix over all., Add water slowly around and over all., Cover with foil or lid and bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours., At 45 minutes, lift chicken up and let rice fall under chicken.

title: Frosting For Hot Fudge Cake
directions: Cook all together until kinda thick.

title: Lemon Custard Cake
directions: Tear the cake into bite-sized pieces., Place in 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan., In mixing bowl, combine the pudding mix, milk and sour cream. Beat until thickened, about 2 minutes., Spread over the cake. Spoon pie filling on top., Chill until serving time., Makes 12 to 16 servings.

title: Pink Salad
directions: Mix all the ingredients together and chill.

title: Chocolate-Cherry Cake
directions: Mix gently by hand., Pour into 13 x 9-inch pan (greased and floured)., Bake at 350° for approximately 25 to 30 minutes., Frost with dark chocolate frosting.

title: Chicken Dressing
directions: Mix all ingredients in a large mixing bowl., Cover tightly and place in refrigerator overnight., Bake in a large pan in preheated oven at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes., You can add chopped chicken in dressing before baking.

title: Chinese Chicken Salad
directions: Mix chicken, onions and lettuce. Add sesame seeds, almonds and noodles.

title: Vegetable Bundles
directions: Remove husks from ears of corn., Spread corn generously with margarine and sprinkle with salt and pepper., Wrap each ear in heavy-duty foil, sealing and twisting foil around ends., Place on grill for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Chicken And Broccoli Casserole
directions: Boil chicken breasts until they are white and tender., While these are cooking, also cook broccoli by package directions., When done, debone chicken and cut into bite-size pieces., Spread broccoli in bottom of Pyrex dish., Layer with chicken., Mix soup, curry powder, mayonnaise and lemon juice together and pour over chicken., Sprinkle cheese on top., Crush crackers and mix with margarine and spread on top., Bake in preheated oven at 325° for 35 minutes.

title: Barry'S Deer Jerky
directions: Combine all ingredients together and marinate in the refrigerator for 6 to 10 hours., When ready to dry, remove slices and drain on paper towels; may pat dry., To dry, spread slices in single layer on oven racks., Place a pan under racks to catch drippings., Set temperature at 140° or lowest temperature on your stove., Open door slightly to allow air to circulate and moisture to escape., Drying will take 6 to 10 hours., Turn over after 4 hours., Jerky is done when meat is shriveled, dark, leathery and chewy.

title: 6-Cup Salad
directions: Pour pineapple over marshmallows and let stand until mushy. Mix all together and let set., Refrigerate in covered dish overnight., Very good with ham., You can also add maraschino cherries.

title: Quick Fruit Cobbler
directions: Melt oleo in 9 x 13-inch pan., Mix together flour, sugar, baking powder, milk and melted oleo., Spread in bottom of pan, then pour fruit over the top (the fruit needs to be cooked long enough to melt sugar and make syrup)., I use blackberries or rhubarb or peaches; use sugar to sweeten as needed., Bake at 350° until brown on top.

title: Sicilian Rice Balls
directions: Cook rice to tender., Drain and put aside., Fry onions to light brown., Add salami, then bread crumbs to absorb oil., When cool, mix all ingredients, including eggs, pine nuts and cheese, etc., Shape into meatball size or smaller., Fill dish with bread crumbs and roll balls to cover., Fry in deep oil or fry in pan to golden brown., Drain.

title: Cheezy Italian Macaroni Casserole(Serves 6)
directions: Use 1 1/2-quart buttered casserole., Preheat oven to 350°.

title: Easy Turkey Piccata
directions: Place turkey slices between two pieces of plastic wrap and pound with edge of heavy saucer until thin., Remove plastic and coat each side of turkey with flavored bread crumbs, pressing down firmly., Season each side with a sprinkle of flavored salt, garlic powder and black pepper., If time allows, refrigerated breaded slices for an hour to set bread crumbs., In large, heavy skillet, melt 3 tablespoons margarine and begin browning slices over medium-high heat until golden brown., Remove from skillet and keep warm., Add remaining margarine to skillet drippings and saute mushrooms until tender., Add lemon juice and wine or chicken broth and stir to loosen brown particles., Return turkey to skillet and top with lemon slices., Simmer gently 8 to 10 minutes until sauce thickens and turkey is tender., Makes 4 servings.

title: Oatmeal Toffee Cookies
directions: Heat oven to 375°. Lightly grease cookie sheet or use parchment paper. Beat butter, eggs, brown sugar and vanilla extract until well blended. Add flour, baking soda, cinnamon and salt. Beat until blended. Stir in oats and brickle with a spoon. Drop dough by rounded teaspoon about 2-inches apart onto prepared sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes or until edges are lightly browned. Cool 1 minute. Remove to wire rack. Makes about 4 dozen (large) cookies.

title: Macky'S Taco Dip
directions: Mix cream cheese and sour cream., Add taco mix., Put mixture in round dish., Layer with lettuce, tomatoes, cheese and olives. Pour salsa over all., Serve with nachos.

title: Spiced Apple Rings Or Lime Pickles(Takes 3 Days To Make)
directions: Scoop center out of cucumbers. Cut into 1/2-inch rings., Add lime and enough water to cover all the cukes., Let stand 24 hours in plastic container. Drain and rinse well., Cover with ice cubes. Let stand 3 hours., Drain well.

title: Dottie'S Olive Spread
directions: Chop olives and pecans finely or in a food processor., Mix in the mayo and softened cream cheese and pepper adding the olive juice to achieve spreading consistency., Refrigerate., Serve on crackers or as a sandwich filling.

title: Featherbed Rolls
directions: Add shortening to milk while milk is still hot., When milk has cooled, dissolve yeast in water and add to milk., Add sugar, salt, eggs and flour., Mix well and let stand in bowl for 20 minutes. Knead for a minute or two., Shape into rolls and let rise until doubled in size., Bake in hot oven, 425°, until golden brown, about 20 minutes., Brush with butter after removing from oven. Makes 3 dozen.

title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Pie
directions: Mix together peanut butter and sugar until they resemble pie crust mix., Gradually stir in Cool Whip; mix until smooth and creamy., Spread hot fudge sauce on bottom of chocolate pie crust. Top with Cool Whip mixture., Spread more hot fudge sauce on top of pie., Sprinkle with walnuts, if desired., Freeze for at least 3 hours before serving., Stays fresh in freezer.

title: Broccoli Salad
directions: Cook bacon until crispy, then crumble into small pieces., Cut broccoli into small pieces; mix all ingredients together., Chill and serve.

title: Mandarin Orange Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients and pour over crust., Cover and let set in refrigerator.

title: Chicken Rice Casserole
directions: Place bacon on bottom of 9 x 13-inch casserole., Sprinkle rice over bacon; add chicken, then salt and pepper., Dilute mushroom soup with milk; pour over chicken., Bake 1 1/2 hours at, 350°. Serves 6.

title: Lasagna Al Forno
directions: Brown beef or sausage, cut in small pieces, in oil in 3-quart saucepan; drain., Add spaghetti sauce and simmer 15 minutes, stirring occasionally., Cook lasagna; drain., (Separate lasagna and lay out flat on wax paper or aluminum foil to keep pieces from sticking together as they cool.) Spread about half cup meat sauce on bottom of 13 x 9-inch baking dish., Cover with layer of lasagna., Add some Mozzarella and Ricotta cheeses and cover with sauce., Repeat layers of lasagna, meat sauce and cheeses, ending with a layer of lasagna and sauce., Sprinkle with grated Parmesan cheese., Cover dish with aluminum foil., Bake at 375° for 30 minutes or until hot and bubbly., Remove foil and bake 5 minutes longer., Allow to stand about 10 minutes before cutting for easier handling.

title: Brownies
directions: Melt the butter and chocolate; cool., Beat eggs with wire whisk; add sugar, chocolate and vanilla., Mix well., Add flour and walnuts., Bake in small coffee cake pan at 325° for 25 to 30 minutes., Frost or cover with powdered sugar.

title: Cheesy Chicken And Rice
directions: Prepare a 9 x 13 inch greased baking dish., Mix 1/4 cup butter, flour, milk, bouillon, seasoned salt, garlic powder and pepper until smooth., Bring to a boil and cool until thickened., Reduce heat and add chicken, process cheese and sour cream., Stir until melted., Add cooked rice and pour into baking dish., Take 1/4 cup butter and crushed crackers and brown in skillet., Use this as the topping., Bake at 425 degrees for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Broccoli Rice Casserole
directions: Cook broccoli and rice separately., Place melted butter in bottom of 2-quart dish., Mix together cooked broccoli, rice, soup, onion, cheese and milk., Place on top of butter., Bake at 300° to 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Dollie'S Soup
directions: Simmer about 1 hour or longer., If you use broth that you have prepared yourself from turkey, put it in the refrigerator until fat has risen to top., Skim off fat and use only the broth.

title: Broccoli Supreme
directions: Cook broccoli as directed., Drain well., Combine soup, mayo, eggs and onion., Blend in cooked broccoli., Pour into buttered 13 x 9-inch baking dish., Sprinkle with cheese., Melt margarine., Add crumbs and mix well., Sprinkle over top of cheese., Bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Munching Peanut Brittle
directions: Microwave on High power., Mix sugar and syrup and microwave for 4 minutes., Add peanuts and microwave for 3 to 5 minutes until peanuts are light brown., Stir in vanilla and butter and microwave 1 to 2 minutes., Stir in baking soda until light and fluffy. Spread on greased cookie sheet to cool 1/2 to 1 hour., When cool, break into small pieces.

title: Mary Ball Fudge
directions: Mix sugar and milk together., Bring to a boil and boil exactly 9 minutes., Remove from heat., Stir in chocolate bits, butter and marshmallow cream. Stir until melted and mix well. Add vanilla and nuts. Yields about 5 pounds.

title: Wine Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Combine all ingredients in a large bowl., Beat with mixer 5 to 7 minutes., Bake 45 to 50 minutes. Sprinkle with confectioners sugar while still warm.

title: Ranger Cookies
directions: Cream the shortening and sugars together., Add the eggs and vanilla; mix until smooth., Sift flour, soda, baking powder and salt together; add to creamed mixture., Mix well, then add the oatmeal, rice cereal and coconut and mix well., Dough will be quite crumbly., Mold with hands into balls the size of a walnut. Place on a cookie sheet and press slightly., Bake in a 350° oven for 10 to 12 minutes., Yields 6 dozen.

title: Seven-Layer Salad
directions: Layer in dish as given, starting with the lettuce., Chill in refrigerator 6 to 8 hours., Do not stir.

title: Real Good Pie
directions: Mix ingredients and pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake for 45 minutes at 350°.

title: Easy Lasagna
directions: Brown meat; drain., Mix with sauce., Layer sauce, noodles (uncooked), sauce, cheeses, noodles, sauce, etc, sauce on top. Bake at 350° for 45 to 55 minutes.

title: Melt In Your Mouth Chicken Pie
directions: Place deboned chicken in 9 x 12-inch pan., Bring to boil chicken broth and soup., Pour over chicken; mix flour, buttermilk and melted margarine., Pour over first mixture., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes., Brown at 450° for 5 to 10 minutes., Serves 6.

title: Family Casserole
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., In a saucepan, combine beef, onion, garlic and 1/4 cup water; cook until onions are tender., Spread half of potatoes in a 3 quart casserole., Top with half of meat mixture, then carrots, then cheese, then remaining meat mixture. Mix soup with 1/2 soup can of water; pour over casserole and top with remaining potatoes., Bake, uncovered at 350° for approximately 1 hour., When potatoes are fork tender, combine biscuit mix with enough milk to make a thin consistency; pour over casserole., Bake 5 to 10 minutes longer or until dough is lightly browned., Yield: 6 servings.

title: Mousse(Chocolate Or Lemon)
directions: Mix flour, margarine and pecans together and press into a 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.

title: Quick Mix Chocolate Cake
directions: Mix all dry ingredients in bowl., Add last 5 ingredients., Mix well., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Reese'S Cups
directions: Mix and melt Hershey bar and peanut butter., Set jar of peanut butter in hot water to soften., Line cupcake pan with holders. Spoon in 1 tablespoon chocolate mix, then put one tablespoon of peanut butter., Top with 1 tablespoon chocolate., Refrigerate until it sets and becomes firm.

title: Dirt Cup
directions: You will need 8 to 10 (7 ounce) paper or plastic cups.

title: Aunt Osie'S Plum Cake
directions: Mix together in a large bowl., Pour in tube pan., Bake for 1 hour at 350°.

title: Golden Glow Salad
directions: Dissolve jello in boiling water and cool., Melt marshmallows in pineapple juice over low heat., Fold until smooth., Blend cheese, carrots and pineapple., When gelatin cools, blend together all ingredients., Pour into mold and chill several hours.

title: Lemonade-Watermelon Punch
directions: Select a melon about 20 inches long with a flat base., The day before serving, cut an 8-inch oval section making a sawtooth edge, out of the top of the melon., Remove cut portion and reserve. Using a long handled spoon, scoop out pulp; remove seeds., Place 1/4 of the pulp at a time in blender container or food processor bowl., Cover, blend or process until pureed., (Should have 12 cups.), Place melon shell on a large tray., Return puree to melon shell; stir in water, lemonade concentrate and grenadine., Replace cut out portion of melon., Refrigerate overnight., Before serving, remove cut portion of melon; pour in lemon-lime beverage to fill 3/4 full., Stir with an up-and-down motion., Ladle punch into cups.

title: Barbecued Rice Entree
directions: Combine all ingredients except almonds., Simmer about 20 minutes or until liquid is absorbed., Stir in almonds and serve. Serves 4.

title: Fried Rice
directions: Combine all ingredients in a wok., (You may use a large pot but is better to use a wok.), Stir ingredients to keep from sticking., Cook until warm throughout.

title: Molasses Cookies
directions: Mix shortening and sugar., Add eggs, then molasses; blend well., Sift dry ingredients together; add to first mixture. Combine thoroughly., Roll balls size of walnuts in white sugar. Bake at 375° for 12 minutes., Makes about 6 dozen cookies.

title: Artichoke Dip
directions: Chop artichoke hearts and mix with remaining ingredients. Bake in a small casserole dish at 300° for 30 minutes., Serve hot with Melba toast rounds.

title: Chicken Cordon Bleu
directions: Pound chicken fillets until thin., Lay out flat and sprinkle with parsley., Top each fillet with a slice of cheese, then a slice of ham., Roll up tightly., Brush each fillet with mayonnaise and then roll in the bread crumbs., Spray a baking pan or sheet with cooking spray., Arrange the chicken rolls, seam side down, in a single layer., Bake in a 400° oven about 30 minutes.

title: Dinner Pork Chops
directions: Wash and drain pork chops., Dip each chop in prepared mustard. Roll in flour, salt and pepper., Fry to a golden brown., Drain off fat., Using the cans of soup, spoon the rice on top of pork chops and pour the soup around chops., Cover and simmer until tender., If more rice is desired, cook the cup of rice and spoon on the chops., (Use an electric skillet.)

title: Merrimont Frankfurters
directions: Slice wieners in half lengthwise and place in dish, cut side down., Pour over barbecue sauce and bake in moderate oven (350°) for 15 minutes., Baste frequently.

title: Pizza Dough
directions: Sprinkle yeast in warm water; let stand until dissolved., Add sugar, oils and 2 1/2 cups of the flour, beating well., Gradually add the remaining 2 1/2 cups of flour to form a soft dough., Turn out onto a floured board and knead until smooth and elastic, adding flour as needed., May take 1/2 to 1 cup., Turn dough into greased bowl., Cover with plastic wrap., Let rise in warm place until doubled (2 to 3 hours)., Punch down and let rise again. Punch down and divide into 3 balls., Roll out dough, adding enough flour to make dough fit pizza pan., Fold under outer edges. Pierce holes in dough with fork., Do a "first bake" in a 400° to 450° oven for 5 to 7 minutes., Ready for your favorite pizza recipe., Makes three 13-inch pizzas.

title: Potato Soup
directions: In large pot, boil potatoes until they start to fall apart. Drain some of the water. Cook on low, constantly stirring, until thick. Add salt, pepper, butter and chives. Stir well. Add enough milk to make soup as thick as you like it. Continue to cook on low until hot.

title: Chicken And Rice Casserole
directions: Put all ingredients in a casserole dish and bake at 350° for 1 hour., Serves 4.

title: Layered Banana Pineapple Dessert
directions: Mix graham cracker crumbs, sugar and margarine in 13 x 9-inch pan., Press evenly onto bottom of pan., Arrange banana slices on crust.

title: Pumpkin Ice Cream Squares
directions: Mix crumbs, sugar and butter in bottom of 9-inch square pan. Combine pumpkin, sugar, salt and spices., Fold in ice cream., Pour over crumbs., Cover., Freeze., Cut into squares 20 minutes before serving.

title: Butter Nut Cheerios
directions: Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan with Crisco. Beat eggs until light. Beat in sugars, vanilla, butter and Crisco until creamy., In large bowl, combine flour with baking powder and salt., Add sugar mixture to flour., Mix on low and fold in pecans., Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

title: Easy Baked Chicken
directions: Grease an 8 x 8-inch baking dish., Pour in dry rice., Lay raw chicken on top of rice., Mix together mushroom soup, soup can of water and onion soup mix., Pour this over rice and chicken. Cover with foil., Bake at 350° for 2 hours., Yield:, 4 to 5 servings.

title: Layered Summer Salad
directions: In a salad bowl, layer the ingredients as follows: lettuce, 1/4 cup dressing, bacon, tomatoes, cheese, turkey or chicken and remaining 1/4 cup of dressing., Serve immediately or refrigerate overnight.

title: Baked Chicken Breasts
directions: Rinse chicken breasts in cold water and pat dry., In large bowl, combine sour cream, lemon juice, Worcestershire sauce, celery salt, paprika, salt, pepper and garlic; mix well., Add chicken to sour cream marinade, covering each piece well., Cover and refrigerate overnight.

title: Squash Supreme
directions: Put squash in a saucepan and bring to a boil. Drain well. Butter a 1 1/2 quart baking dish. Beginning with a sprinkle of cheese, alternate ingredients by layers. Save a little cheese for topping. Bake in oven at 350 degrees until contents bubble. Sprinkle remaining cheese over top. Brown and serve immediately.

title: Chocolate Pie
directions: Mix all together except vanilla in heavy saucepan., Cook over medium heat, as it thickens turn down. Add vanilla and set aside after it thickens., Let it cool then spoon into baked pie shell or you can pour in while it is warm.

title: Chicken Noodle Casserole
directions: Butter casserole dish., Mix soup, water and chicken with noodles., Sprinkle with bread crumbs., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes (covered).

title: Warm Springs Apples
directions: Put apples in baking dish., Sprinkle jello on top., Mix sugar, flour and margarine well., Put on top of apples., Bake 30 minutes until apples are done.

title: Oatmeal Cookies (3)
directions: Sift flour, salt, baking powder & soda. Cream brown sugar and shortening. Add eggs and vanilla. Beat well. Stir in dry ingredients and rolled oats. Chill dough. Form into balls and roll into powdered sugar until heavily coated. Bake in a moderate oven on greased cookie sheet at 375° for 8-10 minutes.

title: Pumpkin Muffins
directions: Beat egg slightly with fork., Stir in milk, pumpkin and butter., Measure flour; blend in dry ingredients., Fold in raisins., Fill cups 2/3 full., May sprinkle 1/4 teaspoon sugar over each muffin., Bake 18 to 20 minutes in a 400° oven.

title: Rice For A Crowd
directions: Bring to boil and boil 13 minutes., Rinse in cold water., Salt to taste., Place in large pan., Cover very tightly with foil. Place in low 150° to 200° oven until needed.

title: Vacuum Cleaner Cookies
directions: Combine margarine, dry cake mix and 1 of the eggs. Stir together until dry ingredients are moistened. Pat mixture over bottom of well-greased 10 x 15-inch jelly roll pan. Beat in remaining eggs and sugar. Stir in coconut and nuts. Spread evenly over margarine mixture. Bake at 325° for 40 to 50 minutes or until golden brown. Cool pan on wire rack to room temperature. Cut into bars. Makes 4 dozen.

title: Salary Cap
directions: Serve in chimney glass.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Mix milk and soup in a baking dish., Take chicken off bones. Put chicken over soup mixture., Mix dressing with broth and put over chicken or use Stove Top stuffing., Bake until bubbly, about 25 minutes at 350°., Use 2 1/2-quart casserole dish.

title: Meat Marinade(Chicken, Pork, Beef)
directions: Combine all ingredients., Marinate meat about 4 to 6 hours. Refrigerate for about 1 hour before grilling.

title: Rhubarb Pie
directions: Mix flour and sugar., Beat eggs., Add to flour mixture with milk., Add chopped rhubarb., Add to other mixture., Bake at 300° until brown and crusty on top., Yields 1 crust pie., Use big pie pan (do not use nonstick).

title: Fruit Jello Salad(Makes One Dish)
directions: Dissolve jello in 1 1/2 cups of hot water., Reserve 1/3 cup to mix with mayonnaise., Add canned pineapple and juice., Stir in cottage cheese., Mix the mayonnaise with 1/3 cup hot jello and add to the rest of mixture., Add nuts last., Set in refrigerator.

title: Aunt Kay'S Corn Casserole
directions: Mix all., Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Teriyaki Steak Sauce
directions: Mix well., Brush on uncooked meat and let stand for 1 hour. Barbecue and keep moist.

title: Potato Salad
directions: Cover potatoes with water; bring to boil., Lower flame and simmer until tender., Drain, peel and cut potatoes into bite size pieces., Mix onions, celery, eggs and sweet relish with mayonnaise and mustard., Stir in the potatoes., Add salt and pepper to taste. Cover bowl and refrigerate for 2 hours., Serves 4 persons.

title: Old-Fashioned Cream Pie
directions: Mix flour, sugar and salt; slowly add cream and vanilla., Pour into unbaked shell and sprinkle cinnamon on top., Bake at 425° for 10 minutes, then at 325° for 40 to 50 minutes.

title: Broken Glass Cake
directions: Dissolve each Jell-O in 1 1/2 cups hot water., Put in square pan., Dissolve gelatine in 1/4 cup cold water, then add hot pineapple juice and put in refrigerator and let cool., Add whipped cream, sugar and vanilla, then fold in cubes of Jell-O., Take half crust mixture and press in bottom of buttered pan., Put in filling and sprinkle remaining crust over top., Put in refrigerator to set for at least 6 hours., Better if left overnight., Allow Jell-O to set overnight, then cut into small squares., Set pan into hot water for 1 or 2 seconds., Jell-O will slide right out.

title: Mo-Jo Potatoes
directions: Preheat oven to 450°., Wash and brush potatoes., Cut into wedges., Mix the seasonings into the flour., Mix the egg with the milk., Dip potato wedges into milk., *Dust with seasoned flour. Place on a pastry sheet., Drizzle with oil., Bake in oven 20 to 25 minutes until browned and tender.

title: Pumpkin Bars
directions: In bowl, beat together eggs, sugar, oil and pumpkin until light and fluffy., Stir together the flour, baking powder, cinnamon, salt and soda., Add to pumpkin mixture; mix thoroughly. Spread batter in an ungreased 15 x 10 x 1-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes., Cool., Frost.

title: Grilled Marinated Beef(Korean)
directions: Cut meat into serving pieces; score on both sides., Place meat in shallow pan., Mix soy sauce, onions, garlic, sugar, oil, sherry and pepper., Pour over beef and let stand 1 hour at room temperature., Turn once; drain., Place meat over medium coals. Grill until desired doneness (allow 15 minutes for medium). Garnish with additional green onion, if desired., Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Baked Grits
directions: Cook grits as directed on box., Add ingredients as listed. Beat hard after each addition., Bake in a moderate 400° oven until firm and slightly brown (about 1 hour)., Serve at once., Good with barbecue.

title: Meringue
directions: Beat egg whites gradually adding sugar and cream of tartar, until stiff but not dry., Add vanilla and water and stir., Put on a cooled pie filling of your choice., Cook in preheated oven for approximately 10 minutes at 350°.

title: Shake 'N Bake Chicken
directions: Preheat oven to 400°., Wash chicken and pat dry., Drop in milk and coat with crumbs., Arrange in single layers in baking pan. Bake 45 minutes or until done.

title: Scalloped Cabbage
directions: Chop, and, cook, the, cabbage, just until crisp-tender; drain. To prepare cream sauce, melt margarine., Stir in flour until smooth and add, milk., Cook, over, medium, heat and stir until thick. Saute green pepper and onion in oil until tender. Place layer of cabbage, in, a, lightly, greased, baking, dish. Sprinkle with sauteed, onion,, pepper and grated cheese. Cover with cream sauce and bread crumbs., Bake about 10 minutes in a 350° oven.

title: Cauliflower Salad
directions: Mix mayonnaise and sugar; layer in large bowl first 4 ingredients., Mix in mayonnaise mixture, top with cheese., Chill for at least 1 hour before serving.

title: Rice Salad
directions: Mix, together; add enough French dressing to cover all. Serve on lettuce leaves if desired.

title: Raisin Sauce(Great On Baked Ham)
directions: Stir until thick and bubbly.

title: Prune Cake
directions: Mix all together and bake at 325° for 1 hour and 20 minutes.

title: French Dressing
directions: Combine all ingredients except sugar and water in a quart jar. Boil sugar and water 5 minutes., Add to other ingredients and shake well., Store in refrigerator., Makes 1 quart.

title: Purple Hull Pea Casserole
directions: In casserole dish, layer 2 cups peas, tomatoes, onion, bell peppers and salt and pepper to taste. REPEAT LAYERS. Sprinkle Parmesan cheese on top. Place 6 slices of bacon on top of cheese and bake until bacon is done and onions are tender. You may need to place under broiler to get bacon crispy.

title: King Ranch Chicken
directions: Mix chicken with all ingredients., Layer the chicken mixture, a layer of Dorito chips, a layer of Cheddar cheese and repeat. Add a little broth on top., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes., Use a 9 x 9-inch pan., You can prepare this recipe and place in the refrigerator to cook when you get home from work.

title: Deerburger Pie
directions: Brown meat, onions, salt and pepper; drain., Add beans and soup; mix well., Cover and simmer for 15 minutes., Peel potatoes and cook until tender; mash, using butter and milk., Pour meat mixture into casserole pan; drop spoonfuls of potatoes on top. Make sure to leave openings in the middle for steam to escape. Bake at 350° until potatoes start to brown.

title: Angel Pie
directions: Whip Eagle Brand milk and juice of 2 lemons., Fold in whipped cream with sugar added., Add pecans and fold in pineapple., Pour into 2 cooked pie shells (or 2 graham cracker crusts)., Chill.

title: Cheese Potatoes In Foil
directions: Slice potatoes into a large piece of foil., Sprinkle with salt and pepper., Crumble bacon over potatoes., Add onion and cheese. Dot with butter., Wrap loosely and seal well with double fold. Cook in 350° oven for about 1 hour or until done, turning occasionally., Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Cheesed Broccoli
directions: Cook broccoli according to package directions; drain., In saucepan, over low heat, combine mayonnaise, cheese and milk. Heat, stirring until cheese melts., Serve over broccoli., Serves 6 to 8.

title: Chewy Bars
directions: Mix the softened margarine and sugar well., Add the eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition., Gradually add the flour and stir in well., Add vanilla, chips and nuts.

title: Coupe De Luxe
directions: Combine fruit and juices with brandy., Marinate in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours., To serve, fill large stem glasses or goblets half full of fruit and marinade., Pour the champagne over the fruit at the table., Serves 6.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
directions: Mix in large mixing bowl, chicken, potatoes, cream of chicken & cream of celery. Place in 9 x 11 baking pan. Melt butter & combine with milk and flour. Pour over top. Bake at 350 for 1 hour.

title: Million Dollar Cake
directions: Mix ingredients in order given., Mix well after each., Grease and flour angel food cake pan., Spread in cake pan and bake for 1 hour and 15 minutes at 350° or when cake springs up when touched.

title: Shrimp Dip
directions: Have cheese at room temperature., Add onion mix and salad dressing to make smooth., Add pepper and beat with electric mixer. Stir in shrimp., Chill.

title: Oven-Fried Fish
directions: Heat oven to 500 degrees. Grease baking sheet. Combine milk and salt in a small pan or bowl and stir. Dip fish in milk and roll in crushed corn flakes. Place on baking sheet and bake for 20-25 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Red Cinnamon Popcorn
directions: Melt butter in medium saucepan; stir in sugar, corn syrup and cinnamon candy., Bring to boil; continue boiling, stirring constantly, until candy is dissolved completely., Boil without stirring for 3 minutes., Remove from heat; stir in soda. Gradually pour over popped corn, mixing well., Allow to cool completely., Break apart and store in tightly covered container. Makes about 4 quarts., (Spray popped corn container with Pam.)

title: Sausage-Cheese Balls
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Grease jelly roll pan, 15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 1-inch., Stir together all ingredients, using hands or spoon. Shape mixture into 1-inch balls., Place in pan., Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until brown., Immediately remove from pan., Serve warm with sauce for dipping., Makes 7 1/2 dozen., I like barbecue sauce.

title: Zucchini Soup
directions: Slice zucchini and cut into quarters., Cook in 2-quart pot in 1 cup of broth., Cook about 6 minutes or until crispy tender., Add 3 tablespoons chopped scallion greens one more minute., Drain broth back into remaining broth and set aside in small bowl., Peel rest of zucchini and chop., Chop rest of scallions and their tops. Simmer in butter until soft., Add broth., Add heaping tablespoonful of chopped pimento to reserved broth., Add remaining pimento to pot mixture., Cover and simmer 15 minutes., Put through blender; add salt and pepper to taste., Serve with croutons.

title: Dirt Pudding
directions: Crush Oreo cookies in 9 x 13 pan., Leave enough out to sprinkle top of dessert., Mix butter, cream cheese and powdered sugar well., May be a little lumpy.

title: Potato Casserole
directions: Mix potatoes, cheese, sour cream, and both cans of soup in large mixing bowl. When mixed evenly spread into large casserole dish., Top with cornflakes place into oven and bake at 350 degrees until cheese is bubbly., Let stand 10 minutes and enjoy.

title: Fudge
directions: Combine sugar, margarine and milk in a heavy saucepan; bring to a boil, stirring constantly., Boil 5 minutes over medium heat. Stir in chips until melted., Add Marshmallow Creme, nuts and vanilla., Beat until blended., Pour into a greased 13 x 9-inch pan., Cool at room temperature., Cut into squares., Makes about 3 pounds.

title: Lemon Ice Box Pie
directions: Mix Eagle Brand milk, egg yolks, and lemon., Pour into crust. Whip egg whites and a tablespoonful of sugar until fluffy. Spread on top of pie., Brown meringue.

title: Banana Pudding
directions: Mix together the pudding and milk, then add the sour cream and Cool Whip., Layer vanilla wafers, sliced bananas and filling until all the filling is used., Makes 1 (11 x 13-inch) pan full.

title: Cheese Ball
directions: Soften cream cheese. Add remaining ingredients and blend. Shape and chill. Serve with assorted crackers.

title: Chicken And Ham Lasagna
directions: Cook noodles per package directions and drain., In a saucepan, melt butter., Blend in flour, onion, garlic powder and 1/8 teaspoon pepper., Add chicken broth and milk., Cook and stir until bubbly. Stir in 1/2 cup grated cheese and mushrooms., In a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish layer half the noodles, all the asparagus, chicken, Mozzarella and 1/3 of the milk mixture., Top with ham, remaining noodles and remaining milk mixture., Sprinkle with remaining grated cheese., Bake at 350° for 35 minutes or until heated through., Let stand 10 minutes before serving., Serves 6 to 8 or 10 to 12 on buffet.

title: Easy Banana Pudding
directions: Put the wafers in a casserole dish; cut the bananas up on top, then spoon on the pudding., Repeat 2 or 3 times until you use it all up., Top with Cool Whip.

title: Chicken Divan
directions: Arrange the broccoli in a 2 qt. baking dish., Place the chicken over the top., In a separate bowl, combine soup and milk and pour over the broccoli and chicken., Sprinkle with the cheese, combine the butter and breadcrumbs and sprinkle over the top., Bake at 450°f. 230°c. gas mark 8 for 20-30 minutes or until bubbling.

title: Kosher Dill Green Tomato Pickles
directions: Follow directions on package but substitute sliced green tomatoes for the cucumbers., Process in hot water bath just long enough to seal and change color., They will become soft if processed too long.

title: Crock-Pot Spareribs
directions: Brown ribs in a pan for 15 minutes., Drain fat., Place ribs in crock-pot., Combine other ingredients and pour over ribs., Cook on medium for 4 to 5 hours.

title: Whole Wheat Rolls
directions: In a 2-cup container, dissolve yeast in 1/2 cup lukewarm water and 1/2 teaspoon sugar. Let stand 1 hour. Cream shortening and 1/2 cup sugar. Add 1 1/2 cups lukewarm water to shortening mixture; add egg and salt. Add part of the flour and mix well, then add the yeast mixture. Add remaining flour and mix well. May have to add extra flour if dough is sticky.

title: Texas Sheet Cake
directions: *If you don't have buttermilk, add some vinegar to milk.

title: War Time Cake
directions: In a saucepan, combine brown sugar, water, shortening, raisins, cinnamon, salt and cloves., Bring to a boil., Cool., Add flour and soda., Pour into loaf pan., Bake at 350° for one hour and 15 minutes., For a flat cake, use a greased 8-inch pan.

title: Homemade Salsa Recipe
directions: Mix everything together and use with Tostitos chips or garnish on your favorite Mexican dish., It's also very delicious on white chili.

title: Haystacks
directions: In top of double boiler over hot water, melt butterscotch morsels., Stir in salad oil., In large bowl, mix noodles, peanuts and butterscotch morsels., Mix thoroughly with a fork., Drop mixture onto wax paper by teaspoonful.

title: Harvard Beets
directions: Boil ingredients, except beets and onion for a few minutes, then add beets and onion., For better flavor, make a day ahead.

title: Taco Dip
directions: Have first 5 ingredients at room temperature., Mix cream cheese, sour cream, avocado dip, lemon juice and salt well so there are no lumps., Spread on a pizza pan or large plate., Refrigerate for a few hours., Layer in order on top of mixture:, lettuce, tomatoes, onion, green pepper, green onion, and Cheddar cheese. Serve with plain corn chips.

title: Salmon Log
directions: Mix first 6 ingredients well., Refrigerate for 3 hours., Form into 2 logs; roll in finely chopped pecans and sprinkle parsley over top., Serve with crackers.

title: Icing
directions: Beat well., If adding jello, do not add any water., Add any kind of jello for any color icing.

title: Chocolate Cake Icing
directions: Mix all ingredients in a pot., Bring to a boil., Boil until a few small drops form a little ball when dropped in a glass of cold water., Remove from heat., Ready for cake.

title: Shoo-Fly Pie
directions: Mix together to make crumbs.

title: No Sugar Apple Syrup
directions: Mix first three ingredients in saucepan., Heat and thicken with cornstarch until desired consistency., Serve over pancakes, waffles, French toast, etc.

title: Marinated Cheese Squares
directions: Cut cheeses into 1 inch squares about 1/2 inch thick., Cover with dressing and pimentos and marinate several hours or overnight. Serve in shallow serving dish with crackers.

title: Minestrone Soup
directions: Slice sausage crosswise, about 1/2-inch thick., Brown in oil in deep saucepan or Dutch oven., Add garlic, onion, carrots and basil., Cook for 5 minutes., Add zucchini, tomatoes with liquid, bouillon, cabbage, salt and pepper.

title: Date Pudding
directions: Combine dates, water, soda and butter; let cool., Beat the egg and sugar; add remaining ingredients., Mix all together., Bake in moderate oven (325°) for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Lemon Chicken
directions: Saute chicken, onion and garlic in butter until chicken is lightly browned, about 5 minutes., Stir in cornstarch and cook 1 minute., Add broth, carrot, lemon juice, rind and salt., Bring to a full boil., Stir in pea pods, parsley and rice., Cover and remove from heat; let stand 5 minutes., Fluff with a fork., Makes 4 servings.

title: Honey Date Nut Bread(1 Loaf)
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Blend ingredients in mixing bowl. Pour into prepared pan., Bake 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Pickled Eggs
directions: Place peeled eggs in bowl or jar., Mix vinegar, beet liquid, sugar, salt, onion and cloves., Pour over eggs., Cover and refrigerate at least 2 days., Slice eggs and serve on greens.

title: Lemonade Tea
directions: Mix all ingredients together in gallon container; fill to the top with water. Serve cold. Perfect on a hot day.

title: Tofu Casserole
directions: Cut tofu into quarters and boil in salted water for 20 minutes., Drain and crumble., Combine with the other ingredients and bake for 40 minutes at 350°.

title: Potato Soup With Sausage(Yields 6 Servings)
directions: In a heavy skillet, brown sausage over medium heat., Remove sausage and set aside., Drain all but 1 tablespoon of fat; saute celery, onion, thyme and salt., Cook until onion is tender., Stir in flour; cook 1 minute., Gradually add broth and water, stirring until the mixture comes to a boil., Add potatoes; cover and simmer for 25 minutes or until potatoes are tender., Allow soup to cool. Puree 2 cups in blender or food processor., Return to kettle., Add milk, beans and sausage; heat through., Garnish with parsely, if desired.

title: Pear Cake
directions: Mix eggs and sugar., Add oil., Stir in dry ingredients., Add pears., Bake in tube pan at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Carp-A-La-Shingle
directions: Clean, and, scale, carp., Melt	butter;, mix with wine. Place fish with butter/wine sauce into aluminum foil, wrapping tightly. (Salt, and	pepper	before	wrapping fish.) Place on redwood shingle, and, bake	at 350° for 1/2 hour., Then remove fish from oven., Throw away and eat shingle.	Serves all.

title: Sunday Favorite Roast
directions: Salt and pepper roast., Coat in flour., Heat cooking oil in skillet and lightly brown roast., Wash, peel and cut potatoes into quarters., Wash and scrape carrots and cut into approximately 1/8-inch slices., Remove roast after browning and place into a large baking dish., Arrange potatoes and carrots (and sliced onions, if desired) around the sides of roast., Sprinkle the soup mix onto roast., Brown a tablespoon of flour in the oil remaining in skillet after browning the roast., Pour 1/2 to 1 cup of water over browned flour to make gravy., Add salt and pepper., After the gravy has thickened, pour it over and around the roast in the baking dish., Place the dish into a very hot oven (425°) for about 15 minutes., Place a piece of aluminum foil very loosely over the dish., Reduce the heat to 300°., Cook for about 15 minutes per pound., (If you have a cooking timer on your oven, you can set it for the estimated cooking time and your lunch will cook while you are away at church.)

title: Rice Krispies Treats
directions: Melt margarine in a large saucepan over low heat., Add marshmallows and stir until completely melted., Remove from heat. Add peanut butter, if desired., Add Rice Krispies cereal., Stir until well coated., Using buttered spatula or waxed paper, press mixture evenly into buttered 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan., Cut into squares when cool.

title: Spinach Casserole
directions: Cook onions until soft., Add artichokes, spinach, soup, eggs and spices., Pour into greased casserole dish., Blend cream cheese, Parmesan cheese and milk., Pour over top of casserole. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Creamy Pasta With Mushrooms
directions: Prepare fettuccine as directed on package., Drain and set aside. Gradually add skim milk to fat-free mayonnaise and garlic in small saucepan., Heat thoroughly, stirring occasionally., Remove from heat; blend in Egg Beaters., Toss with fettuccine and mushrooms until well coated., Add Parmesan cheese and mix well.

title: Sourdough Bread
directions: Combine oil, water, sugar and Starter., Stir well and add flour., Place in greased bowl and turn to cover all surfaces with oil. Let rise in warm place. Bowl may be covered with towel or cookie sheet., Turn dough onto floured surface and knead several times. Shape into loaves or rounds., Place in greased pans., Let rise for at least 8 hours. Bake at 350° until brown, about 20 minutes for rounds, 30 minutes for loaves., May add 1 package of Italian seasoning mix for variety.

title: Betty Jane'S Barbecue Sauce
directions: Cut up onion and green pepper very fine., Cut fresh lemons; remove seeds., Squeeze juice; cut up rind., Place all ingredients in boiler., Combine all sauces and seasonings and cook slow for 25 minutes., Makes a delicious sauce for ribs, chicken, etc.

title: South Seas Pot Roast
directions: Place roast in deep pot or casserole., Mix sugar, ginger, soy sauce and soup., Pour over meat., Cut onions in thick slices. Place slices over meat., Cover tightly and bake at 300° for 4 hours and 30 minutes., Yields 6 servings.

title: Friendship Tea
directions: Combine and store in sealed jar., Use 1 heaping tablespoonful per cup of boiling water.

title: Mexican Cornbread
directions: Mix all ingredients together except cheese until all is mixed well., Pour mix in very hot oiled skillet., Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

title: Microwave Caramel Corn
directions: Spray 1 large bowl or brown paper bag with Pam., Place the sugar, butter, corn syrup and salt in a glass bowl; microwave on High until boiling, then cook for another 2 minutes., Add baking soda; stir well (mixture will become foamy)., Place popped corn in bowl or bag; pour syrup mixture over corn., Stir well with wooden spoon sprayed with Pam., Microwave for 1 1/2 minutes on High; stir., Repeat., Microwave for 30 seconds on High; stir., Pour out on cookie sheet., Spread out and allow to cool.

title: Baked Carrots
directions: Mix and pour into baking dish., Bake 30 minutes at 350°. Nutritious, quick and easy.

title: Fresh Lemonade
directions: Add ingredients and 8 ounces of water., Serves 1, me.

title: Red Velvet Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients together and blend on medium speed for 3 minutes., Pour into 3 cake pans that have been greased and floured., Bake 30 to 35 minutes., Cool and frost.

title: Green Noodle Casserole
directions: Saute pepper, celery and onion in oleo., Add cheese (cut into small pieces), soup, mushrooms, pimento and chicken., Cook noodles in broth where chicken was cooked., Add noodles to mixture and pour into casserole dish., Cook in 350° oven (covered) for 25 to 30 minutes., Remove cover and cook until brown, 5 minutes.

title: Creamy Fruit Salad
directions: Drain all canned fruits, reserving 2 cups mixed juices., Layer drained fruit, strawberries, cherries and bananas in bowl. Combine pudding mix with reserved juices in bowl, beating until thick., Pour over fruit., Do not toss., Chill for 2 hours before serving., Yields 15 servings.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Melt cheese with soup., Put broccoli in long, flat casserole. Pour cheese mixture over broccoli., Top with Pepperidge Farm dressing., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Cinnamon Rolls
directions: Scald milk and add shortening, sugar and salt., Dissolve yeast in warm water., Beat eggs in 1/2 cup cold water and add to scalded milk., Cool until just warm and mix with other ingredients., Add flour and beat until smooth, then add enough flour so dough can be kneaded to make it stiff., Set in warm place and let rise until dough is light., Divide dough into two equal parts and roll out into sheets., Smooth melted butter over each sheet., Mix 1/2 cup white sugar, 1/2 cup brown sugar and 1 teaspoon cinnamon and sprinkle over dough., Roll each sheet into a roll and cut., Put 1/2 cup melted butter in baking pan and sprinkle lightly with brown sugar., Put rolls in pan and let rise until light., Bake at 350° for 25 minutes., Yield:, 27 rolls.

title: K.K.'S Monkey Bread
directions: Cut biscuits into fourths., Fill a small baggie with sugar and 2 tsp. cinnamon., Shake biscuits in baggies., Place into bundt pan., Melt 1 1/2 sticks of oleo and add brown sugar, pecans and 1 tsp. cinnamon., Pour batter over biscuits., Bake at 350 degrees for 30-35 minutes., Cool 10 minutes and then empty pan.

title: Oatmeal Hermits
directions: Mix all together well., Bake at 375° for 10 minutes.

title: Chicken Tortillas(4 Servings)
directions: Cut chicken into large pieces., In bowl combine onion, soups, salsa and milk, blending well., In a 1 1/2-quart buttered casserole, layer half the tortillas, chicken, sauce and cheese. Sprinkle with green chilies., Repeat layers once more ending with cheese on top., Cover; refrigerate for 24 hours., Remove cover. Bake at 300° for 1 hour.

title: Ham Loaf
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Pack in a buttered loaf tin and bake 1 hour at 350° or moderate oven., Increase heat during last twenty minutes or so., Serve with sauteed pineapple slices.

title: Broccoli Puff
directions: Place broccoli in baking dish., Mix rest of ingredients and pour over broccoli., Then place topping mixture on top of broccoli and bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Mexican Casserole
directions: Brown ground beef and onion; drain., Season to taste., Combine beans, tomatoes and soup., Line a greased ovenproof dish (2-quart) with tortillas., Layer half of ground beef, soup mixture and cheese., Add another layer of tortillas, meat and soup mixture, ending with grated cheese., Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes or until heated through and cheese is melted.

title: Martha'S Pound Cake
directions: Cream Crisco and sugar until smooth., Add eggs, one at a time, beating after each addition., Combine salt and flour., Add to mixture., Beat well and stir in vanilla., Cook in a greased and floured tube pan for 1 hour and 10 minutes at 300° until brown.

title: Salmon Steaks With Dill Sauce
directions: Place salmon steaks in 10-inch skillet., Add enough water to cover., Top with onion, lemon slices and bay leaf; sprinkle with 1/4 teaspoon salt., Bring to a boil., Cover, reduce heat and simmer for 8 minutes, or until fish flakes easily when tested with a fork., Combine milk and flour in a saucepan, stirring well., Add mustard, dill seed, lemon rind, 1/4 teaspoon salt and pepper. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until thickened. Gradually stir about 1/4 of hot milk mixture into egg yolk; add to remaining hot milk mixture, stirring constantly., Cook 1 minute, stirring constantly., Add lemon juice, mixing well., Remove salmon steaks from skillet., Spoon sauce over salmon., Garnish with reserved lemon slices, if desired., Yields 4 servings.

title: Peanut Butter And Chocolate Kisses Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., In bowl, beat the butter, peanut butter, brown sugar, 1/4 cup granulated sugar, egg, vanilla and salt until fluffy., Add flour and baking soda; beat until thoroughly blended., Shape dough into 48 balls using a rounded teaspoonful for each., Roll balls into 3 tablespoons of granulated sugar., Place 2 inches apart on ungreased baking sheets., Bake 8 to 10 minutes or until golden., Immediately top each cookie with a candy kiss, carefully pressing down firmly., Remove cookies from baking sheets., Cool on racks., Makes 48 (1 3/4-inch) cookies.

title: Sweet And Light Bread
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Grease and flour loaf pan (9 x 5 x 3-inch)., Measure all of the ingredients into large mixing bowl. Beat on medium speed for 30 seconds., Pour into prepared pan. Bake 55 to 65 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean when inserted., Allow to cool.

title: Holiday Fruitcake
directions: Put package of mincemeat, broken, with 1/2 cup water and boil briskly for 1 minute. Cool. Combine the mincemeat, nuts, candied fruit, sweetened condensed milk and egg. Blend well. Stir in flour and baking soda; pour into a loaf pan that has been greased and floured. Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 30 minutes or until center comes back when lightly touched.

title: Moose Shoulder
directions: Cut meat into 1-inch cubes., Chop garlic., Brown meat in fat. Add garlic and cover with stock., Cover and simmer for 2 hours. Add cattails for the last 20 minutes of cooking.

title: Apple Muffins
directions: In a large bowl, stir together flour, sugar, baking powder, cinnamon, salt and baking soda. Set aside. In a small bowl, beat eggs, sour cream and butter. Add all at once to dry ingredients along with apples., Stir, just until moistened. Fill well-greased muffin tins 2/3 full., Bake at 375° for 15 minutes., Yields 24 muffins.

title: Pecan Crispies
