directions: Cream butter and sugars until light. Beat in egg and vanilla. Stir together dry ingredients. Blend into creamed mixture., Stir in nuts. Drop from teaspoon on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 375° about 10 minutes. Makes approximately 2 1/2 dozen.

title: Chocolate Cream Pie
directions: In medium bowl combine milk and Jell-O mix, beat until smooth, approximately 1 to 2 minutes., Fold in Cool Whip., Fold in chocolate cookies., Pour mix into pie crust., Add extra cookies, either whole or crushed, on top for garnish., Freeze for 3 hours before serving., A great treat children love!

title: Punch Bowl Cake
directions: Put 1 cake layer in bottom of a large punch bowl., Starting at top of ingredients, layer pudding, cherry pie filling, pineapple, fruit cocktail, coconut, pecans and Cool Whip; put 1 layer of each., Add other cake layer and start over., Put cherries on top of cake.

title: Oven French Toast
directions: Melt margarine in 9 x 13-inch baking pan in hot oven., Add brown sugar and cinnamon; mix well., Arrange bread slices in double layer in prepared baking pan., Beat eggs with milk., Pour over bread slices., Chill, tightly covered, in refrigerator overnight., Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 45 minutes., Serve with warm syrup and sprinkle of confectioners sugar.

title: Yorkshire Pudding
directions: Pour into an 11 x 7 x 1 1/2-inch baking dish and keep hot 1/4 cup roast beef drippings., Beat until thick and piled softly 2 eggs., Add to beaten eggs and beat with rotary beater until smooth milk, flour and salt., Pour mixture over hot meat drippings and bake at 400° for 30 to 40 minutes or until puffed and browned. Cut into squares and serve immediately with standing rib roast of beef.

title: Batter
directions: Sift dry ingredients together., Mix with water and egg., Use for onions or vegetables.

title: Maple Pralines
directions: Cook sugars, syrup, cream and salt over high heat until mixture forms a soft ball (235°) when dropped in water., Remove from heat. Add flavoring and pecans., Beat until creamy., Drop from spoon onto waxed paper.

title: Hot Dip
directions: Brown sausage and hamburger until crumbled; drain excess grease., In crock-pot, melt cheeses., Add meat, soup, tomatoes, green chilies and onions; mix well., Makes a large amount and can be frozen., Serve with chips., Serves many.

title: Apple Dumplings
directions: Make syrup of sugar, water, cinnamon and nutmeg; add butter. Quarter, peel and core apples., Sift flour, salt and baking powder, then cut in shortening., Add milk all at once and stir until flour is moistened., Roll 1/4-inch thick; cut in 5-inch squares., Put 4 pieces of apples on each., Sprinkle generously with additional sugar, cinnamon and nutmeg., Dot with butter and fold corners to center., Pinch edges together and place 1 inch apart in greased baking dish or pan., Pour syrup over dumplings and bake in moderate oven at 375° for 35 minutes., Serve hot with cream., (This is also great cold.)

title: Frosting Mix
directions: Beat cream cheese and sugar., Fold in Cool Whip., Spread over cool cake.

title: Shrimp Stuffed Eggplant
directions: Peel shrimp., Rinse in colander., Cook in just enough water to cover., Add 1/2 teaspoon salt and 1 tablespoon crab boil., Cook on high until water begins to simmer., Cover pot., Turn off heat and let stand 5 to 7 minutes., Remove shrimp from water., Save water. Peel eggplant and cut into chunks., Cook eggplant in shrimp water until soft enough to mash., In large skillet, heat olive oil. Saute onions, bell pepper and celery., When lightly brown and "limp," add garlic., Saute 2 more minutes., Remove skillet from heat., Mash eggplant until chunks are not intact., Add 1/2 teaspoon herb mix (oregano, basil, thyme, bay leaves, powdered). Add remaining salt and red pepper., Add sauteed vegetables., Cut shrimp into 1/3-inch long pieces., Add wine, beaten raw egg, Worcestershire and Tabasco sauce and mayonnaise., Mix thoroughly. Add bread crumbs., Mix well., Spread in 2-quart greased casserole. Top with grated Parmesan cheese and bake for 30 minutes in 325° oven., If mixture is too dry, add more mayonnaise or egg., If too moist, add more bread crumbs.

title: Coconut Jam Cake
directions: Cream butter, sugar and eggs together, then add all other ingredients., Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes., Makes 3 layers.

title: Flour Tortilla Roll-Ups
directions: Cream the cream cheese and add drained green chilies., Blend well with mixer., Spread out tortillas; divide and spread out cream cheese evenly over tortillas., Roll each one like a jelly roll. Wrap and refrigerate., When ready to serve, cut in thin slices.

title: Pennsylvania Dutch Chicken And Dumplings
directions: In large pot, boil chicken and keep stock., Bone and skin chicken., Place back in pot., Add vegetables., Salt and pepper. Boil until cooked., Reduce heat to simmer., Keep water level high. Add water to flour to make slightly sticky dough., Roll out 1/4-inch thick and cut 1 1/2-inch squares., Drop squares into water and let cook until dough is done., Drain water only as needed to keep from overflowing.

title: Cajun Squash
directions: Wash unpeeled squash., Slice thinly., Combine 1 teaspoon salt, dried green onion and 2 tablespoons butter in saucepan., Cook 15 minutes., Do not add water. Let cook in butter and its own juice. Makes about 3 1/2 cups.

title: Hawaiian Baked Beans
directions: Combine all ingredients in a casserole dish., Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 1 hour., Makes 6 servings.

title: Pecan Praline Crunch
directions: Heat oven to 250°., Spray 13 by 9 inch baking pan with non-stick cooking spray., Combine cereal and pecans in pan., In large bowl, microwavable, combine sugar, corn syrup and crisco. Microwave on high for 1 minute and 30 seconds., Stir and microwave again for 30 seconds or until boiling., Stir vanilla and baking soda into mixture., Pour over cereal mixture and stir to coat mixture evenly., Bake 1 hour, stirring every 20 minutes., Spread on baking sheet and cool completely., Break into pieces., Store in air tight container., Makes 9 cups.

title: Corn Pudding
directions: Mix together., Bake at 325° for 45 minutes in 13 x 9-inch pan. Stir from bottom three times while baking., When knife comes out clean, pudding is done.

title: Almond Bars
directions: Cream butter,, margarine and sugar thoroughly.	Add egg yolk; add flour,	salt, and, vanilla., Grease cookie sheet and spread dough with	fingers, dusted with flour., Beat egg white and brush over cookies., Sprinkle almonds over dough and press down with hand., Bake, at, 275°, for	45, minutes, or, lightly browned., Cut within, a, few minutes into desired portions., A 10 x 15-inch cookie sheet works well.

title: Yeast Rolls
directions: Soften yeast in water., Cut cutter into 3 cups flour; blend in eggs milk, sugar, salt and yeast., Gradually add remaining flour. Mix well after each addition., Cover and chill 2 to 3 hours. Divide in 4 parts; roll out to 10-inch circle., Brush with melted butter., Cut in pie shaped wedges., Start with wide edge and roll up., Place on greased baking sheet., Let rise until double., Bake at 375° for 15 to 18 minutes.

title: Goolash
directions: Brown ground beef and onions together., Add salt, tomato sauce, beans and water., Let simmer 45 minutes.

title: Raspberry Jam Strips
directions: Mix margarine, sugars, egg and vanilla., Stir in flour and baking powder., (If dough is soft, cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour.), Heat oven to 350°.

title: Meringue(Swiss)
directions: Beat egg whites., While beating, heat water, cornstarch and sugar on stove until it boils, then pour into egg whites slowly and add vanilla., Only needs browned, if desired.

title: Peanut Butter Cups
directions: Note:, Need 24 paper nut cups, 1 1/2 x 1 1/4-inches.

title: Chicken-Broccoli Casserole
directions: Stew chicken., Cool and bone., Steam broccoli until tender. Drain., Grease an 11 x 7-inch casserole. Place chicken on bottom and broccoli on top., Combine mayonnaise, soup, curry powder and lemon juice., Pour over broccoli., Sprinkle with a mixture of bread crumbs combined with butter., Bake in a 350° oven for 30 minutes., Yields 6 servings.

title: Chicken Roll-Ups
directions: Separate rolls. Sprinkle chicken over the triangles. Roll up, beginning at the large end. Place in a casserole dish. Mix the soup, cheese, milk and chicken broth and pour over rolls. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: New England Style Clam Chowder
directions: Cook potatoes, water and salt until tender., Cut bacon into small pieces and fry until almost cooked., Add onion and cook slowly until bacon is completely cooked., Combine all cooked ingredients in one pot and add milk and clams., Bring to a boil, however do not boil.

title: Bread Stuffing For Turkey
directions: Mix well; stuff bird and bake., Or, cook neck and back and put the stock over dressing and bake dressing in casserole at 325°. This stuffing can be used to stuff whitefish., Eliminate giblets.

title: Banana Pudding
directions: Mix the pudding mix with the milk., Add the sour cream and Cool Whip, mixing well., Layer pudding in 5-quart dish with bananas and the vanilla wafers., Refrigerate several hours before serving.

title: Pineapple Upside-Down Cake
directions: Melt butter and brown sugar in a large fryer., Beat eggs, sugar and vanilla until thick., Add scalded milk with butter., Mix thoroughly with egg mixture; pour over butter, sugar and fruit layer in fryer., Place over low heat and bake until done, about 35 minutes., During the last 5 minutes, tilt cover to aid in drying top of cake., Turn upside-down on a large plate., Serve plain or with whipped cream.

title: Ham And Cheese Party Rolls
directions: In medium bowl, combine mustard, onion, margarine and poppy seed., Do not separate rolls first., Split entire roll package horizontally and spread each side with mustard mixture., Cut ham and cheese into squares to fit individual rolls., Put one of each on each roll, then top with other half of roll package., Separate rolls and return to original aluminum pan., Cover with foil and heat at 325° for 20 to 25 minutes., Can be made ahead and frozen. Do not heat until ready to serve., Serves 8 to 10 persons.

title: Pie Of Any Flavor
directions: Bake pie shells and set aside., Place milk into a saucepan and place saucepan of milk into a larger pan of water and turn heat to medium., Add sugar, salt, Cook & Serve pudding mix, and egg yolks., Mix with just enough milk to pour and beat into hot milk., Stir until thick., Set into a pan of cold water and add butter and vanilla and beat well., When slightly cool, pour into pie shells., Take whites of eggs and add baking powder and beat until thick., Add sugar and vanilla and pour into pie shells spreading well and brown under broil.

title: Mexican Style Liver
directions: In large skillet, cook bacon until crisp., Drain, reserving 3 tablespoons drippings in skillet., Crumble bacon; set aside., Cook onion and garlic in drippings for about 5 minutes or until onion is tender, but not brown., Combine flour, chili powder and salt. Cut liver into thin strips; toss with flour mixture to coat., Add liver to onion in skillet; brown quickly on all sides., Stir in crumbled bacon, undrained tomatoes and whole kernel corn., Simmer, covered, until mixture is heated through., Serve with tortillas or over hot, cooked rice., Makes 6 servings.

title: Macaroni And Cheese
directions: Cook noodles., Drain and place in large casserole., Add margarine, cheese, milk and eggs., Mix well., Sprinkle another cup of grated cheese on top., Bake at 400° for 25 minutes.

title: German Potato Salad
directions: Peel and boil the chopped potatoes., Heat in skillet the first 4 ingredients until very hot., In bowl, put the chopped cabbage and the chopped potatoes., Pour the ingredients over it; mix well. Return to stove until all is hot., Serve at once.

title: Gooey Butter Cake
directions: Mix together yellow cake mix, 1 egg and 1/4 cup of butter. Put on bottom of 9 x 13-inch greased pan.

title: Puddles(Candy)
directions: Melt together the milk and Hershey bars. Take off stove and stir in pecans., Drop by teaspoonfuls on waxed paper., Let chill.

title: Tex-Mex Turkey Chili
directions: Combine onion, garlic and oil in a 2-quart glass bowl., Cover with plastic wrap., Microwave on High for 3 minutes or until onion is tender, stirring every minute., Add chili powder and the next 4 ingredients; stir well., Microwave, uncovered, on High 6 to 9 minutes, stirring every 3 minutes., Add the remaining ingredients. Microwave, uncovered, on High for 6 minutes until thoroughly heated.

title: Peasant Rye
directions: Mix all ingredients, except the bread., Chill mixture for 2 to 3 hours., Then cut top of bread off and pull bread out of inside of loaf to form a cavity., Fill cavity of bread with dip mixture before serving., Use bread cubes for dipping.

title: Low Calorie Apple Pie
directions: Combine brown Sugar Twin, flour, cinnamon, nutmeg and salt. Add apples and mix together., Place in pie shell and dot with 2 tablespoons butter., Bake for 50 minutes at 350°., Makes 8 servings at 231 calories per serving.

title: Chicken Soup
directions: Go to the store and buy a can of chicken soup., Put it in a small bowl, then microwave for 15 minutes., You can eat it with a spoon.

title: Pecan Pie
directions: Add melted butter into sugar and cream with a wooden beater. Add Karo syrup and beat in good with butter-sugar mix., Add salt and 3 eggs (one at a time), stirring well., Add 1/4 cup milk. Stir and then add 1 teaspoon vanilla; stir and add pecans.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
directions: Mix sugar and butter until creamy., Add eggs and peanut butter., Mix soda and flour in with the rest., Place small balls on cookie sheet., Press out with fork., Bake at 350° for 10 minutes, or until lightly browned.

title: The Best Chocolate Chip Cookies
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Mix shortening, butter, sugars, eggs and vanilla., Blend in remaining ingredients., (For a softer, rounder cookie, add 1/2 cup flour.), Drop onto an ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes, until light brown.

title: Plum Wine Mandarin Glaze
directions: Heat wine, mandarin syrup and corn syrup to a rolling boil. Add the lemon juice., Spread over cake or use as glaze for pork, ham or chicken.

title: Ginger Snaps
directions: Mix in order, roll into balls the size of a walnut. Roll in white sugar and bake at 350°. Cookie will flatten and crack.

title: Veal Veggie Loaf
directions: In the microwave:, Mix 1/2 of your spaghetti sauce with all your ingredients., Using a quiche pan (micro-safe) form a loaf in a circle, leaving the center empty., Pour the rest of spaghetti sauce over the top of the circular meat loaf., Cook on High for 12 minutes., Pour off drippings., Cook on High approximately 5 minutes more (depending on your microwave)., Serve with peas or another green vegetable in the center.

title: The Best Potato Salad
directions: Boil potatoes with their skins until tender (red potatoes are best)., Hard-boil 12 large eggs.

title: Five Hour Stew
directions: Cut chuck roast to chunks., Combine all ingredients in crock-pot; cook on high for 5 hours.

title: Filled Kolackys
directions: Soften the active dry yeast in warm water, compressed yeast in lukewarm water.

title: Pot Roast With Vegetables
directions: Wipe roast with paper towels., Place oil and butter in 5-quart Dutch oven or heavy kettle., Over medium heat, brown roast with sliced onion, turning roast with 2 wooden spoons until brown on all sides., Add seasonings to drippings and saute, stirring, 1/2 minute., Add beef broth; bring to a boil., Reduce to simmer and cook just below the boiling point, covered, 2 1/2 hours., Turn meat occasionally., Add vegetables and simmer, covered, for 30 minutes or until vegetables are tender.

title: Corn Pudding
directions: Beat eggs well., Add sugar, flour, margarine, corn and milk. Bake in greased casserole dish at 325° for 40 to 45 minutes, until golden brown.

title: Sour Cream Pumpkin Coffeecake
directions: Cream butter, 3/4 cup sugar and vanilla in mixer bowl., Add 3 eggs, beating well., Combine flour, baking powder and baking soda. Add dry ingredients to butter mixture alternately with sour cream., Combine pumpkin, beaten egg, 1/3 cup sugar and pie spice.

title: Brownies
directions: Mix and bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes., Mark and let cool., Makes about 24 (2-inch) servings.

title: Watergate Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients and refrigerate.

title: Joe C.'S Salad
directions: Mix cottage cheese and Cool Whip with dry jello., Add drained fruit., Quick, easy and a refreshing taste for any lunch or dinner.

title: Oven Roasted Chicken In Tomato Sauce
directions: Place chicken in baking pan., Combine all other ingredients and pour over chicken., Bake, uncovered, at 400° for about 45 minutes or until chicken is brown., Before serving, garnish with lemon slices, parsley or cooked green peas, if desired., Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Quick White Sauce
directions: Melt butter and flour; stir 3 to 4 minutes until blended. Slowly stir in milk., Cook and stir until thick and smooth.

title: Spiced Winter Punch
directions: Heat all together for 1 to 2 hours. Great at winter get togethers!

title: Easy Punch
directions: Pour pineapple juice in large container., Slowly add in cheerwine., Chill.

title: Cherry Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients and chill.

title: Magic Lemon Pie
directions: Blend together milk, lemon juice, lemon peel and yolks until thickened., Turn into pie shell.

title: Savory Pepper Steak
directions: Cut round steak into 1/2-inch strips., Coat with mixture of flour, salt and pepper., In a large skillet, brown strips in shortening.

title: Country Style Chicken Kiev
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., In heavy 2-quart saucepan, melt butter. Combine bread crumbs and next 4 ingredients., Dip chicken breast halves in melted butter; roll in bread crumb mixture., Place in ungreased 9-inch square baking dish., Bake in center of oven 50 minutes or until golden brown., Meanwhile, add diced onion to remaining melted butter (1/2 cup)., Saute onion; add wine and chopped parsley., Pour over golden brown chicken breasts., Return to oven 3 to 5 minutes more just to heat sauce., Serve with sauce spooned over breasts.

title: Spinach Salad(If You Like Spinach, You Will Love This Spinach Salad!)
directions: Wash spinach and break into small pieces in a large bowl., Add bacon, eggs and bean sprouts and lightly toss., Top with croutons and this dressing:

title: Mini Quiches
directions: On floured surface, roll half of pastry into a 12-inch circle. Cut 6 (4-inch) circles., Repeat with second pastry., Fit into 12 muffin pan cups., Fill each muffin cup with some shrimp, green onion, black olives and cheese., Beat remaining ingredients and pour over mixture in muffin cups., Bake in 400° oven for 15 to 20 minutes., Makes 12 appetizers.

title: Lemon Custard
directions: Put sugar and rind into food processor., Blend well., Add egg yolks, juice and cooled butter; blend., Warm on stove about 10 minutes., Do not boil., Put into puffed pastry.

title: Watergate Salad
directions: Mix; chill and serve.

title: Peach Fuzz
directions: In blender, combine peaches, orange juice, rum and lemonade concentrate., Blend until smooth. Gradually add ice, blending at low speed, until slush consistency. Serve immediately.

title: Honey Bun Cake
directions: Mix the first 4 ingredients and spread 1/2 batter in 9 x 13-inch greased pan. Mix together the brown sugar, pecans and cinnamon. Sprinkle 3/4 mixture over batter. Swirl with knife. Add remaining batter and top with remaining cinnamon sugar mixture. Bake at 350° for 40 minutes. Remove and drizzle with the confectioners sugar, vanilla and milk.

title: Seafood Nicolson
directions: 1. Put butter, leeks, onion, garlic, & red pepper into pan and saute., 2. Add 1/2 c. wine, parsley, lemon juice, salt, & pepper., Cook 2 minutes. Add cream., 3. Cook several minutes on simmer. Add scallops & broccoli, and cook for a few more minutes., 4. Just before serving add shrimp and cook till just pink.

title: Applesauce Cake
directions: Mix applesauce, sugar, butter and egg together and set aside. Combine flour, baking soda, salt, cinnamon and cloves together. Mix well and add raisins and nuts., Stir in applesauce mixture. Pour batter into well-greased tube pan and bake in preheated 350° oven for 50 minutes or until done., Makes 8 servings.

title: Tuna Cakes
directions: Combine all ingredients, except margarine and shape into 6 equal patties., In a 10-inch skillet, heat margarine until hot and bubbly., Add patties and cook over medium heat, turning once, until brown on both sides.

title: Marinated Beef Tenderloin
directions: Combine first 8 ingredients in a large shallow dish or zip-top freezer bag; add beef. Cover or seal and chill 8 hours, turning occasionally. Remove beef from marinade and place on rack in roasting pan. Discard marinade. Bake at 425° for 40 to 50 minutes or to desired degree of doneness. Cover loosely with foil and let tenderloin stand 10 minutes before slicing.

title: Pluck Cake
directions: You will need a Bundt or tube baking pan.

title: Oil And Vinegar Salad Dressing
directions: Put all ingredients in a pint jar; shake to mix well.

title: Strawberry Bread
directions: Mix sugar, oil and eggs together., Add strawberries and lemon juice., Sift together flour, soda, salt and spices., Gradually stir dry ingredients into strawberry mixture., Mix and add nuts, if desired., Pour into 2 greased loaf pans., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Texas Sheet Cake
directions: Sift flour, soda, salt and cinnamon; set aside., In saucepan, combine water, margarine, oil and cocoa; bring to a boil., Remove from heat., Add sugar; mix well., Add sifted ingredients, beating well., Add buttermilk, eggs and vanilla., Beat well., Spread in a greased and floured sheet cake pan (10 x 14 x 1-inch)., Bake at 400° for 20 minutes.

title: Pumpkin Bread(Makes 2 Loaves)
directions: Combine sugar and shortening; add eggs, water and pumpkin. Sift dry ingredients., Combine with first mixture., Add nuts, raisins and dates., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Original Pecan Pralines
directions: Combine sugar and water in a 2-quart saucepan., Heat to boiling, stirring constantly., Stir in pecans., Cook until mixture reaches soft ball stage, 235°., Remove from heat., Stir in butter. Drop by teaspoons onto waxed paper., Let stand until firm., Yields 1 1/2 dozen.

title: Blue Cheese Dressing
directions: Crumble Blue cheese with a fork and mix with mayonnaise, Worcestershire sauce, garlic powder, chives and pepper., Add sour cream and buttermilk., Let stand in refrigerator overnight., Add additional buttermilk to achieve preferred consistency., Will keep refrigerated 1 month.

title: Triple Fudge Cake
directions: Make pudding as directed., Add chocolate cake mix to hot pudding., Mix with heavy spoon., Spread mixture (will be thick) into 9 x 13-inch greased pan., Sprinkle chocolate chip pieces on top and then add walnuts on top., Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

title: Butterhorn Rolls
directions: Dissolve yeast in 1/2 cup warm water in a large bowl; let stand 5 minutes., Add remaining 1 cup of water and next 4 ingredients, stirring well., Add enough flour to make a soft dough., Turn dough out onto a floured surface and knead until smooth and elastic (about 4 minutes)., Place in a well-greased bowl, turning to grease top., Cover and let rise in a warm place (85°) free from drafts for 1 hour or until doubled in bulk., Punch dough down and divide into thirds., Roll each portion into a 10-inch circle on a floured surface; spread with 1 tablespoon butter., Cut each circle in 12 wedges., Roll up each wedge, beginning at wide end., Place on greased baking sheets point side down., Cover and let rise in a warm place free from drafts for 45 minutes or until doubled in bulk., Bake at 375° for 15 minutes or until browned., Yields 3 dozen.

title: Strawberry Pie
directions: Put all together., Bring to boil for 1 minute., Set off to cool., Bake two pie shells., After mixture cools, add 1 quart of strawberries and put into pie shells., Top with Cool Whip and refrigerate.

title: Soft Pretzels
directions: Dissolve yeast and sugar in water; let stand about 10 minutes. Add 2 cups of the flour, salt and oil; beat until smooth. Gradually stir in more flour (about 1/2 cup) to make a soft dough. Turn dough out onto a floured surface., Knead until smooth and elastic, adding more flour (up to 1/2 cup) if necessary to prevent dough from being too sticky., Place dough in a greased bowl. Cover; let raise in warm place until doubled, 45 minutes to 1 hour. Punch dough down; divide into 12 balls., Roll each out to form 18-inch rope., Twist into pretzel shape., Let rise, uncovered, 20 to 25 minutes., Brush lightly with egg white mixture and sprinkle with salt., Bake at 425° until well browned, 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Freezer Slaw
directions: Put the grated cabbage in a bowl and add salt., Let this stand for 1 hour., Then add the chopped carrot and green pepper., Set this mixture aside.

title: Easy Peanut Butter Pie
directions: Mix all ingredients with mixer, except chocolate pie crust. Put mixed ingredients in the chocolate pie crust., Freeze for 1 hour.

title: Cream Cheese Coffee Cake
directions: Line a 9 x 13-inch pan with foil. Unroll crescent rolls. Beat ingredients and spread on top of the bottom of the pan. Lay second can of rolls on top. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Emily'S Fudge Cake
directions: Grease and flour an 8 x 8-inch cake pan; set aside., Preheat oven to 350°., Mix ingredients together in large bowl until well blended., Put in pan; bake for 25 minutes, until done., When cool, frost with favorite chocolate frosting (butter frosting suggested).

title: Vegetable Casserole
directions: Cook broccoli and cauliflower lightly., Layer in greased casserole., Sprinkle celery over top., Mix soup and cheese., Pour over top of vegetables., Bake at 350° until heated thoroughly. Can top with Ritz cracker crumbs and sprinkle with melted margarine over top.

title: Mushroom Garlic Pork Chops
directions: In medium skillet over medium-high heat, heat oil. Add chops and cook 10 minutes or until browned. Set chops aside. Pour off fat. Add soups and water. Heat to a boil. Return chops to pan. Reduce heat to low. Cook 5 minutes or until chops are no longer pink.

title: California Tamale Casserole
directions: Brown meat, add minced garlic, onion and celery., Cook until onion is transparent., Add corn, salt, chili powder and tomatoes and boil slowly about 15 minutes., Slowly stir in olives. Put in a greased casserole dish, top with cheese. Bake at 350° about 45 minutes.

title: Pumpkin Custard Or Pie
directions: Bake at 425° for 15 minutes, then at 350° for 45 minutes. Test by inserting knife.

title: Pound Cake
directions: Cream margarine, sugar and cream cheese., Add eggs, one at a time; beat thoroughly., Add flour a little at a time; beat well. Add flavorings., Pour into greased and floured tube pan., Bake one hour at 350°., May be cooked 1 hour and 30 minutes.

title: Mandarin Orange Cake
directions: Mix ingredients 3 minutes. Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes. Let cake cool.

title: Caramel Apple Dip
directions: Mix brown sugar and butter in a small saucepan., Bring to a boil, stirring constantly., Add vanilla., Pour mixture over cream cheese and blend thoroughly., Use as a dip for sliced apples.

title: Angel Puffs
directions: Beat egg whites until very stiff., Add sugar gradually. Continue beating until very, very stiff., Add salt and vanilla. Drop by large heaping tablespoonful onto greased cookie sheet. Using back of spoon, make indentation to hold whipped cream., Bake in 250° (slow) oven about 1 hour.

title: Wacky Cake
directions: Preheat oven at 350°., Sift all dry ingredients into 8-inch square pan., Make 3 holes with spoon in dry ingredients., In one hole, put vanilla., In another, put vinegar and in last hole, melted butter., Pour lukewarm water over all., Stir, mixing well. Bake 30 minutes., Cool in pan; frost with chocolate frosting.

title: Date Nut Cookies
directions: Stir together the flours, wheat germ, cinnamon, salt and soda. Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy., Add vanilla and eggs; beat until smooth., Stir in flour mixture until well blended., Stir in dates and nuts., Drop by tablespoon onto greased baking sheet., Bake in preheated 375° oven for 12 to 15 minutes. Makes 4 dozen cookies., Very good!

title: Bacon Curry Coleslaw
directions: Combine raisins and lemon juice; heat gently until hot. Then set, aside until raisins are cool and plump., Meanwhile, finely shred the cabbage, dice onion, grate apple and cook and crumble bacon., Combine, apples,, raisins,, lemon, juice, and sugar;, add mayonnaise, and curry powder to apple mixture and blend., Just before, serving,, combine, cabbage, green onion, crumbled bacon, peanuts and mayonnaise.

title: Honey'S Cabbage Slaw
directions: Shred cabbage, celery, green pepper and onion., Mix together sugar, celery seed, salt, vinegar and mustard seed., Mix sauce before shredding cabbage and let stand after shredding all ingredients., Pour sauce over ingredients., Mix well and refrigerate overnight.

title: Low-Fat Brownies
directions: Combine box mix, yogurt and egg whites., Place in 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake for 22 to 24 minutes at 350°.

title: Crabmeat Spread
directions: Mix ingredients., Put into small casserole dish and bake at 325° for about 15 to 20 minutes. Top with slivered almonds. Serve with crackers.

title: Sweet 'N Sour Stew
directions: Brown meat after coating with flour, salt and pepper in hot oil., Add liquid to meat., Add chopped onion., Cover and cook 45 minutes., Add carrots., Cook until tender.

title: Fudge Brownies
directions: Combine butter and chocolates in a small saucepan and melt over medium heat., In a large mixing bowl, combine beaten eggs, sugar, baking powder, vanilla, flour, nuts and chocolate mixture., Stir to mix well.

title: German Chocolate Pie
directions: Mix egg yolks and milk over medium heat., Add melted and cooled German chocolate., Remove from heat., Add vanilla, 3/4 of coconut, nuts and softened butter., Cool and pour into baked crust.

title: Caramel Bars
directions: Melt caramels with 1/3 cup evaporated milk over low heat, stirring until smooth., Combine remaining milk with cake mix, melted margarine and mix well., Press half of cake mix into bottom of 9x13 greased pan., Bake at 350 for 6 minutes., Sprinkle one cup nuts, coconut and chocolate pieces over crust, pour caramel mixture on and top with teaspoons of remaining cake mix, pressing gently into caramel mix., Sprinkle with remaining nuts, pressing lightly into top., Bake at 350 for 20 minutes., Cool slightly, refrigerate (2 dozen).

title: Vivian'S Pumpkin Roll
directions: Mix all ingredients., Pour into a well-greased sheet cake pan. Bake at 375° for 20 minutes., Remove cake from pan onto a tea towel covered with powdered sugar., Roll up towel and cake together., Put in freezer for 30 minutes., While cake is cooling, make the filling.

title: Pretzel Salad
directions: Mix pretzel, sugar and butter., Pat on bottom of a 13 x 9-inch pan., Bake at 400° for 8 minutes., Mix cream cheese and sugar. Fold in Cool Whip., Spread on cooled crust., Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water., Add frozen berries. Mix until somewhat thick. Spread over cream cheese mix., Refrigerate.

title: Mandarin Orange Salad
directions: Crumble crackers and add sugar and melted margarine., Use half for crust and half for top., Mix orange juice, mashed oranges and Cool Whip., Pour over crust and top with other 1/2 of cracker crumbs.

title: Shrimp Casserole
directions: Place first 6 ingredients in an oblong glass baking dish and broil until vegetables are tender., In a saucepan, cook spaghetti and set aside., In another saucepan, combine Velveeta and milk over low heat until Velveeta melts and combines with milk to make a cheese sauce., Combine shrimp mixture, spaghetti and cheese sauce., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Chopstick Veal Bake
directions: Cut meat in 2 1/2-inch strips., Brown in hot oil., Add remaining ingredients except noodles., Turn into 2-quart casserole., Cover and bake at 350° for 1 1/4 hours., Stir occasionally., Last 5 minutes of baking, uncover and sprinkle with chow mein noodles., Serves 8.

title: Shrimp Casserole
directions: Cut large shrimp in half., Cook vegetables in butter or margarine until tender; blend in flour and salt., Combine soup and milk; add to vegetable mixture and cook until thick, stirring constantly., Add shrimp and pour into a well-greased 1-quart casserole., Combine melted butter or margarine and breadcrumbs; sprinkle over top of casserole., Bake at 400° about 10 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

title: Mushroom Medley
directions: Prepare each vegetable separately to obtain right texture., In saucepan, cook peas until nearly done., Cover and set aside., Slice onion thickly., Cut each slice into eight pie-shaped pieces., Cook in water until done, but still firm., Add margarine; cover and set aside., Wash mushrooms., Stand on end and cut into quarters., Boil hard until done., Strain mushrooms and add to onions., Add peas and enough juice that mixture can be simmered., Add salt., Simmer and taste., Serve hot.

title: Red Cabbage Relish
directions: Combine first 3 ingredients in mixing bowl., Sprinkle with salt., Let stand 1 hour., Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Chill at least 1 hour., Store, covered, in refrigerator.

title: Mexican Lasagna
directions: Brown hamburger; drain., Add spices and tomatoes., Heat. Cover bottom and sides of a 13 x 9-inch baking dish with tortillas., Pour beef mixture over tortillas., Place a layer of tortillas over meat mixture., Combine cottage cheese, Monterey Jack and egg together and pour over tortillas., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes., Sprinkle with Cheddar, lettuce, tomatoes, green onions and olives., Serves 10.

title: Texas Dip
directions: Brown meats and drain., Melt cheese in a microwave-proof dish. Combine all ingredients in crock-pot and mix well., Let crock-pot warm all ingredients and keep the crock-pot on low while serving. Stir occasionally to keep it from sticking to the bottom., Serve with lightly salted tortilla chips., Great for tailgating, parties or other social gathering., May not look very appetizing, but it tastes delicious.

title: Hamburger Noodle Casserole
directions: Brown hamburger meat with chopped onion. Add salt and pepper to mixture. Drain any excess fat drippings. Boil whole bag of egg noodles until tender. Drain. Mix meat mixture, noodles, cream of mushroom soup, cheese and whipping cream in a large bowl. Stir until all cheese is melted and all ingredients are blended well. Add salt and pepper to taste. Pour in a baking dish (greased). Top with bread crumbs. Bake at 375° until sides bubble, about 20 minutes.

title: Cream Cheese Spread
directions: Mix together all ingredients., Serve on crackers.

title: Pineapple Muffins
directions: Mix dry ingredients., Mix milk, 1 can pineapple with juice, egg whites and oil., Combine with dry ingredients and mix., Add second can of pineapple., Bake after lining muffin pans with paper baking cups at 425° for 17 minutes., Makes 12.

title: Korean Salad
directions: Break and take the spinach stems out., Rinse and drain bean sprouts., Slice water chestnuts., Chop eggs., Cook and break up bacon., Mix the spinach, bean sprouts, water chestnuts, eggs and bacon together.

title: Cheesy Zucchini Casserole
directions: Put all ingredients into greased casserole in 2 layers with the cheese on top., Cover., Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Chicken And Dressing
directions: Boil chicken and save broth., Debone chicken., Mix bread, eggs, onion, sage, broth and soup., After mixing, the dressing should be juicy, not thick., Add chicken to mixture., Cook until brown.

title: Oatmeal Bars
directions: Melt butter in a large saucepan and add oatmeal, sugar and vanilla., Press down in a pan and cook 12 to 15 minutes in a 350° oven.

title: Confetti Scalloped Potatoes
directions: In a skillet, melt butter over medium heat., Saute onion until tender., Stir in potatoes, soup and milk., Add cheese, green pepper, pimiento, pepper and 1/2 cup of the crumbs., Pour into a shallow casserole dish; top with remaining crumbs., Bake at 375° for 35 to 40 minutes., Yield: 6 to 8 servings.

title: Pineapple Au Gratin
directions: Mix together the pineapple chunks, Cheddar cheese, sugar and flour., Put in baking dish., Crumble Ritz crackers over this mixture., Pour melted margarine on top of crackers., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Irish Soda Bread
directions: Combine all ingredients except buttermilk, raisins and butter. Gradually stir in buttermilk and raisins; mix until dry ingredients are moistened., Knead until smooth, about 1 minute. Shape into a ball., Place on well-greased cookie sheet; flatten to form 7-inch circle., Cut cross in top 1/4-inch deep., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until golden brown., Brush with 1 tablespoon butter., Cool on wire rack., Makes 1 loaf.

title: Cheesecake Topped Brownies
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Prepare brownie mix as directed., Spread in well-greased 9 x 13-inch baking pan., In small mixing bowl, beat cheese, margarine and cornstarch until fluffy., Gradually beat in canned milk, egg and vanilla until smooth., Pour evenly over brownie batter., Bake 45 minutes or until top is lightly browned. Cool., Spread with frosting., Cut in bars., Store covered in refrigerator., Makes 40 brownies.

title: Pumpkin And Streusel Muffins
directions: Heat oven to 375°., Grease bottoms only of 12 muffin cups., In large bowl, combine all muffin ingredients; stir 50 to 75 strokes until dry particles are moistened, breaking up any lumps., Divide batter evenly among prepared muffin cups.

title: Strawberry Ice Cream Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Grease and flour two 9-inch round cake pans., Prepare, bake and cool cake following package directions. Place cake layer on cooling racks in jelly-roll pan., Freeze 2 hours or until cake layers are firm., Place cake layer on serving plate., Spread softened ice cream to edges., Place second layer on top of ice cream., Freeze assembled cake until ice cream is firm. Frost sides and top of cake with whipped topping., Garnish with fresh strawberries., Store in freezer until ready to serve.

title: No Bake Cookies
directions: Cook margarine, cocoa, sugar and milk until bubbles form around sides of pan; remove from heat., Add oats, peanut butter and vanilla., Drop on waxed paper and cool.

title: Strawberry Pretzel Salad
directions: Combine margarine, brown sugar and pretzels., Mix well and bake in lightly buttered 9 x 13-inch pan at 350° for 10 minutes. Dissolve gelatin in water., While hot, add to strawberries., Cool until mixture begins to set., Meanwhile, cream sugar and cream cheese and fold into Cool Whip., Spread cream cheese mixture over cooled crust., When gelatin begins to set, pour over top of cheese mixture., Refrigerate until firm.

title: Cheese Petit Fours
directions: Mix all ingredients except bread together., Cut crusts off bread, 3 slices at a time. Spread cheese mixture on sides and top of each petit four in 3 slices thick. Freeze on cookie sheet., Put in Baggies for storage., Bake, frozen, at 350° approximately 10 minutes. Before freezing, sprinkle on cayenne pepper and dill weed seed (optional).

title: Bourbon Franks
directions: In large saucepan, mix all ingredients, except franks., Cover and simmer at least 2 hours, stirring occasionally., (Can be made ahead to this point., Cover and refrigerate up to 24 hours. Reheat sauce until hot.), Add franks and simmer until heated through (about 5 to 10 minutes).

title: Chicken Gumbo Pork Chops
directions: Wash pork chops., Salt and pepper each side. Smear each side of chop with prepared mustard (about 1 teaspoon)., Dredge in flour., Brown in oil on each side in skillet., Empty contents of one can of soup over chops., Cook for 1 hour at 350°., All this may be done in electric skillet or you may place chops in covered baking dish and pour soup over them and bake in oven or microwave. Good accompaniments are rice and purple hull peas.

title: Chocolate Sheet Cake
directions: Sift together flour and sugar., Combine butter, cocoa and water and bring to a rapid boil., Pour over sugar and flour., Mix well., Add other ingredients and pour into greased 11 x 16-inch pan., Bake at 400° for 20 minutes.

title: Cabbage And Noodles
directions: Cook in large covered skillet with enough water to cook until tender., Cook noodles as directed on package., When cabbage is tender, add salt to taste and butter and drained noodles., Mix well., Turn heat to low and simmer until most of liquid is gone. I like 1 teaspoon sugar in mine.

title: Butter Cookies
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Mix all ingredients thoroughly., Roll 1/4-inch thick on lightly floured cloth covered board., Cut into 1 1/2-inch circles., Place circles on an ungreased baking sheet. Bake 10 to 12 minutes., Yields about 8 dozen cookies., After baking, you may "paint" the cookies different by using food coloring and tiny paint brushes.

title: Lentil Soup
directions: Cook ham hock until meat pulls apart., Remove meat from bone. Pour lentils into the ham stock., Refrigerate overnight., Dice onion and carrot; add to stock., Cook until lentils are tender.

title: Broccoli Salad
directions: Mix chopped broccoli, red onion, cheese and crumbled bacon in bowl.

title: Cream Tacos
directions: Brown hamburger in oil., Add Ro-tel tomatoes and evaporated milk., When boiling, add Velveeta cheese; stir until dissolved.

title: Slushy Punch
directions: Mix and freeze all ingredients., Take out about 3 hours before serving and pour in ginger ale.

title: Cherry Crunch
directions: Pour cherry filling in a 13 x 9-inch pan., Pour cake mix on top., Pour melted butter on top of those., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Houska Christmas Bread
directions: Dissolve, yeast, in lukewarm water., Scald milk and add butter,, sugar, and, salt., Cool, to, lukewarm., Add, to yeast mixture and well beaten eggs, 3 cups flour, raisins, cherries, almonds, and, pecans., Mix, well., Add about 2 1/2 cups flour. Place, on, lightly, floured, surface, and knead until dough is smooth., Place, in a warm bowl., Cover with towel and let rise for about, 1, 1/2, hours., Punch, down, dough and turn out on floured surface., Divide dough in half., Divide one half into 3, equal parts., Roll each piece into a strip about 15 inches long., Braid and, place on a baking sheet., Divide 2/3 of the remaining, dough into 3 equal parts and prepare braid like the first., Place, on top of first braid., Make a third braid from remaining, dough, and place, on top of second (center) braid. Brush with butter., Let rise until double in bulk., Beat 1 egg white, and, 1, tablespoon water; brush loaf., Bake at 350° for about 35 to 45 minutes, or until done.

title: Fudge Brownie Pie
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., Bake pie crust 10 minutes and remove. Reduce oven to 325°., Over low heat, melt chips with butter., In a large mixing bowl, beat chocolate mixture with remaining ingredients, except nuts, until smooth., Then add nuts., Pour into pie crust., Bake 35 to 40 minutes or until center is set., Cool. Serve with warm ice cream if desired.

title: Hot Cheese Ball
directions: Mix all ingredients., Place in small crock-pot until melted. Serve with crackers.

title: Pound Cake
directions: Cream Crisco, oleo and 1/2 cup sugar until light in color and fluffy, then gradually add the other sugar., Add room temperature eggs, one at a time., Beat after each addition., Add flour and milk alternately., I put the vanilla in the milk., Start in a cold oven., Bake for 1 1/2 hours at 325°.

title: Pineapple Angel Food Cake
directions: Fold crushed pineapple into the cake mix., Pour into ungreased 9 x 13-inch cake pan., Bake at 350° oven for 20 to 35 minutes., May be served with Cool Whip.

title: Get Well Chicken Meal Soup
directions: Sprinkle chicken lightly with salt and pepper and garlic salt as needed., Add celery., Cover chicken and celery with water. Boil until tender., Take off fire for 15 minutes., Put back on fire., Add 1/2 cup corn meal., Boil 4 or 5 minutes, stirring constantly.

title: Taco Casserole
directions: Saute and brown beef in frying pan, then stir in onion., Stir in tomato sauce, water and chili powder., Stir all together until well mixed., Cook for about ten minutes.

title: Swedish Pot Roast
directions: Mix salt, pepper and cinnamon., Rub spice mixture on both sides of roast., Brown roast in some oil in a roaster., Now mix the vinegar and brown sugar together and pour over the roast., Add onions and bay leaves and pot in oven. Bake for 3 - 4 hours at 350 degrees.

title: Brownie Fudge Nut Pie
directions: In a medium saucepan over low heat, stir condensed milk, margarine and cocoa until margarine melts and mixture is warm. Remove from heat., Stir in eggs, flour, vanilla and chopped nuts. Pour into prepared crust., Bake at 350° for 50 minutes or until center is firm., Serve warm or cold, topped with whipped cream, if desired.

title: Impossible Egg Pie
directions: Beat eggs., Add remaining ingredients and mix well., Grease two 9-inch pans or baking dish., Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes. Add one can coconut to make coconut pie.

title: Squash Dressing
directions: Chop onions and cook in oleo until transparent., Mash squash with fork., Combine onions and oleo with slightly beaten eggs. Add to soup, squash, bread crumbs, salt and pepper., Mix well. Pour into greased casserole dish., Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Strawberry Cake
directions: Cream jello and oleo., Beat in cake mix and juice., Mix remaining ingredients., Divide equally into 3 layers and bake for 45 minutes at 300°.

title: Mississippi Corn Salad
directions: Slice green onions and their tops., Stir together all ingredients in a large bowl., Cover and refrigerate 4 to 24 hours.

title: Country Style Chicken Casserole
directions: Cook noodles; drain., In a large skillet, melt butter, then blend in flour over medium heat., Gradually add broth, milk, pimentos, salt and pepper., Bring to boiling point, then simmer, stirring constantly, until sauce is thickened, about 5 minutes. Grease a 2 1/2-quart casserole., Combine noodles, chicken and sauce., Top with cheese., Bake for 20 minutes at 350°.

title: Cajun Fried Turkey(For A Crowd)
directions: Thaw turkey completely., Season outside of turkey by personal preference., Preheat oven to 500°., Put turkey in aluminum pan. Add 10 cups boiling water., Seal pan with heavy-duty Reynolds Wrap., Cook 12 to 14 pounds for 1 hour, or 20 pounds for 1 hour and 20 minutes., Turn oven off., Leave overnight., This is the crucial key., Do not open oven door at all!, (This actually steams turkey.)

title: Banana Coffee Bread
directions: Preheat oven to 400°., Combine bran, flour, baking soda, light salt, cinnamon, nutmeg and raisins in a bowl., Mix thoroughly. Beat brown sugar, molasses, oil, egg and milk in a bowl., Add wet ingredients to dry and stir until ingredients are moist., Fill muffin tins 2/3 full of batter., Bake for 15 to 18 minutes. Servings equal 1 starch and 1/2 fat.

title: Peruvian Potato Salad
directions: Simmer scrubbed potatoes in large pan with 1-inch of boiling, salted water for 25 to 30 minutes, until tender., Drain, cool and remove skins., In large saucepan over low heat, stir cream cheese and half and half until smooth., Add chopped chili peppers, lemon juice, turmeric, comino and salt., Simmer 1 minute, stirring occasionally.

title: Caramel Almond Torte
directions: In a small mixer bowl combine egg yolks, 1 cup sugar, the apple cider, baking powder and cinnamon., Beat with an electric mixer on medium speed for 3 minutes or until light and fluffy. Wash the beaters.

title: Southern Maryland Stuffed Ham
directions: Cut/tear up cleaned greens., Combine with cabbage, celery and red pepper., Place ham on clean cheese cloth., Make small slits all around the ham., Stuff the green mixture into the slits., Tie 1 package cheesecloth around the ham and place in a roaster that is half filled with water., Boil for at least 1 hour or until ham is done., Remove cheesecloth and serve.

title: Zucchini Casserole
directions: Amounts vary according to the size casserole needed.

title: Party Punch
directions: Simmer all ingredients for 10 minutes; strain and serve hot. Makes 6 cups punch.

title: Skillet Dinner
directions: Tear tortillas into bite-size pieces and brown in skillet in small amount of oil., Brown and cook the onion and green pepper until tender., Drain oil off all.

title: Rye Bread
directions: Mix the ingredients., Bake at 375° just to brown the top, then at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Boil chicken until done and separate., Mix one box stuffing package with chicken broth (or hot water) until moistened., Spread on bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan., Place chicken on top of stuffing until pourable., Pour on top of chicken., Mix second box of stuffing same as first., Spread on top., Broth from chicken may be poured on top to moisten, if needed., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Serve hot or warm., Serves 6 to 8 people.

title: Cauliflower Delight(Diet)
directions: Cook cauliflower in salted water for 6 to 7 minutes or until tender-crisp., Drain., Mix pickle liquid, sweetener, garlic and onion in a small bowl., Pour over cauliflower, pickles and radishes in bowl., Toss to marinate., Cover in refrigerator for 12 hours, stirring occasionally., Drain before serving.

title: Blackberry Wine Cake
directions: Mix together all ingredients on low speed until moistened. Mix on medium for 2 minutes., Pour into greased and floured Bundt pan and bake at 350° for 50 minutes.

title: Ham Casserole(Great For Christmas Brunch!)
directions: Sprinkle cracker crumbs in buttered casserole., On top of cracker crumbs, layer half of chopped eggs, 1/4 of sauces, half of ham and 1/4 of sauces., Repeat layers, topping with crumbs., Bake for 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Shoo-Fly Pie
directions: Bake at 375° for 10 minutes, then at 350° for 30 minutes. Makes 5 pies.

title: Ladson'S Potato Pone
directions: Mix all ingredients, and, cook on top of stove in heavy iron skillet, stirring, frequently., Must, cook	slowly on low heat. When almost done put in baking pan and bake at 350° for 20 minutes or until done.

title: Fudgsicles
directions: Mix as directed on pudding package., Pour into Tupperware Ice Tups or popsicle containers., Freeze., Yields 12 Fudgsicles.

title: Beef Roast Of Beef
directions: Put vegetables in bottom of crock-pot. Salt and pepper meat, then put in pot. Add liquid. Cover and cook on low 10 to 12 hours (high 5 to 6 hours)., Remove meat and vegetables with spatula and thicken for gravy, if desired.

title: No Roll Pie Crust
directions: Bring oil and water to a boil., Stir in flour., While mixture is still warm, put into 9-inch pie plate and proceed with filling; bake.

title: Jello Salad For Angels
directions: Tear cake and fill 13 x 9-inch pan with pieces., Mix all other ingredients and pour over cake pieces., Refrigerate until set, approximately 1 hour.

title: Barbecue Beef
directions: Put roast, onions and celery in a large pan with a little water., Cover and cook slowly until done (meat is falling apart). Don't let dry out., Or put in crock-pot or slow cooker and cook overnight., Drain off most of the juice because it is usually greasy., Cut meat into small pieces or pull apart., Add vinegar, sugar, Worcestershire sauce, mustard, water or wine, ketchup, lemon juice and salt and pepper to taste., Let cook until hot. Taste and you may wish to add additional ketchup, liquid or other seasonings.

title: Baked Pigs Trotters(Porco Al Forno)
directions: Boil pigs feet, in, water for 25 minutes., Preheat oven to 350°., Grease a large baking pan and place cooked pigs feet onto pan, bone, side, down., Sprinkle tomatoes and the rest of the ingredients on, top of pigs feet in the above order., Bake for 40 to, 50, minutes,, until skin looks browned and a little crispy. Serve immediately., Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Bread Pot Cheese Dip
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Slice off top of bread., Reserve top. Hollow out to 1/2-inch shell., Combine Cheddar, sour cream and cream cheese in bowl., Add ham, onion, chilies and Worcestershire sauce., Spoon cheese filling into bread shell; replace top of bread., Tightly wrap loaf in several layers of foil., Set on cookie sheet., Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 10 minutes., Stir filling before serving., Remaining bread can be made into croutons.

title: Salsa
directions: Put peppers, onion and garlic in blender with juice from tomatoes., Blend a few seconds to chop; add remaining ingredients. Blend a second or two to chop up tomatoes; stir., Serve with tortilla chips.

title: To Turn Cooper Green(Antique Look)
directions: Use 2 to 1 parts water with muratic acid., Sprinkle salt evenly over copper dipped in acid solution., Let dry.

title: Strawberry Pie
directions: Combine jello, cornstarch, water and sugar. Boil until clear and a little thick, then cool completely. Place strawberries in cool baked pie shell. Pour jello mixture over strawberries. Top with Cool Whip. Refrigerate.

title: Refrigerator Cukes
directions: Soak cukes in salt and ice for 2 hours., Drain well., Heat the remaining ingredients (except onions) for 5 minutes, then cool. Add onions and mix together., Put into refrigerator in quart or gallon jars or Tupperware.

title: Broccoli Salad(Serves 16)
directions: Toss first four ingredients when ready to serve., Add dressing last., Serve on bed of lettuce., Serves 16.

title: Tater Tot Casserole
directions: Brown meat and onion in skillet; drain., Put in bottom of casserole dish., Spread 1/2 of cheese on meat., Mix soups and Worcestershire in bowl and spread over cheese., Spread remaining cheese on top., Place Tater Tots on top., Microwave for 30 minutes, or bake in oven for 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Texas Potato Casserole
directions: Cover potato mixture with crumb mixture., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes (less time if potatoes are thawed).

title: Salad Dressing Cake(Heritage Recipe)
directions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees., Sift all dry ingredients together., Then add others, I use Crisco Oil in pan sparingly. (No flour.), Bake.

title: Canned Vinegar Beans
directions: Boil all ingredients, except beans, for 25 minutes. Fill jars with beans and pour vinegar mixture over beans., Scald.

title: Breakfast Casserole
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Combine ingredients and place in well-greased 6-cup casserole dish., Bake 45 minutes., Serve hot. Yield: 4 to 6 servings.

title: Impossible Chicken And Broccoli Pie Or Broccoli And Cheddar Pie
directions: Heat oven to, 400°., Grease, 10 x 1 1/2-inch pie plate. Rinse broccoli, under, running cold water to thaw; drain thoroughly. Mix broccoli,, 2, cups of the cheese, the chicken and onion in plate., Beat, milk, eggs, baking mix, salt and pepper until smooth, 15, seconds, in blender on high or 1 minute with hand beater., Pour, into, plate., Bake until knife inserted in center comes out, clean, 25 to 35 minutes., Top with remaining cheese. Bake just, until, cheese, is, melted,, 1 or 2 minutes longer. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Chocolate Pie
directions: Preheat oven and baking sheet to 400°., In a medium bowl, combine sugar, brown sugar, salt and cornstarch; mix well., In a heavy saucepan on medium heat, cook and stir sugar mixture and milk until mixture thickens and begins to boil., Gradually stir 1/4 of hot mixture into beaten egg yolks; add back to remaining hot mixture, stirring constantly., Stir in sour cream and butter; continue to cook until mixture thickens., Remove from heat., Stir in vanilla, mixing well., Stir in chocolate until blended., Pour mixture into pie crust., Refrigerate about 2 hours before serving. Serves 6.

title: Brandy Smash
directions: Bring to a boil for 1 minute, 9 cups of water and 2 cups of sugar., Take off stove and add 1 (12 ounce) can frozen orange juice and lemonade., Let cool., Add brandy., Stir and put in a gallon bucket; put in freezer., Let sit for 24 hours., Put 2/3 cup Smash in glass and add 7-Up to fill glass., Serve with a straw.

title: Andouille (Sausage) And Potatoes
directions: Heat bacon drippings in a large heavy saucepan over medium-high heat., Saute onions, bell pepper and parsley, stirring occasionally until onions are clear., Add wine, garlic, soy sauce and andouille (sausage); mix well., Add salt and soy sauce; stir. Add potatoes and stir., Cover, reduce heat to low and simmer, stirring occasionally until potatoes are tender, about 30 minutes.

title: Baked Macaroni And Cheese
directions: Boil macaroni., Melt butter in saucepan; take off heat and add flour., Blend well; add milk slowly until blended with flour mixture (no lumps)., Return to heat, stirring constantly until thickened., Heat oven to 250° for 8 to 10 minutes., Grate cheese mix all together in baking dish., Bake at 375° for 25 minutes.

title: Crazy Crust Apple Squares
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Grease 13 x 9-inch pan lightly., Spoon flour into measuring cup; level off., In large bowl, combine flour, 1/2 cup sugar, baking powder, salt and nutmeg., Mix well. Add milk and egg and blend well., Spread in greased pan., Sprinkle raisins, apples and pecans over batter.

title: Low-Fat Pork Lo Mein
directions: Slice pork thinly and shred into match-stick sized strips. Shred cabbage., Cut scallions into 1-inch sections., Heat oil until very hot in wok or heavy skillet., Add salt; then scallions. Stir-fry 45 seconds., Add pork., Stir-fry 2 to 3 minutes., Add cabbage and mushrooms., Stir-fry 2 minutes., Add spaghetti and soy sauce., Toss with rest of mixture., Cover and cook 5 minutes over medium heat., Serves 6 to 8. Contains 340 calories and 7 grams fat per serving.

title: Molly'S Seafood Crepes
directions: Use mixing method of your choice., Cook 45 to 60 seconds, preferably in crepe iron., Makes 14 to 16 crepes., Prepare crepe filling as follows.

title: Yeast Hot Rolls
directions: Preheat oven to 400°., Turn to 325°., Place rolls in oven., Mix yeast in water until dissolved., Mix salt with flour, then mix all together well., Make rolls on floured board., Let rise for 3 hours. Bake in a 325° oven., Heat oven to 400°; then turn down heat to 325° for 20 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Easy Cream Cheese Pie
directions: Mix together cream cheese and sugar., Blend in Cool Whip. Pour into pie shell and top with pie filling., Chill for about 1 hour.

title: Cocktail Wieners
directions: Mix ingredients in a saucepan over low heat., Slice 1 pound frankfurters diagonally into bite size pieces., Add to sauce and heat through., Serve hot.

title: Dip For Fruit
directions: Soften cream cheese., Add sugar and marshmallow cream., Stir well.

title: Sweet Cucumber Relish
directions: Remove pulp from cukes (do not peel unless ripe)., Grind with meat grinder (fine) the cukes, onions and peppers., Put in layers and sprinkle salt between each layer., Let stand overnight., Drain well in morning., Add remaining ingredients., Bring to a full rolling boil and boil 10 minutes., Pack in hot jars.

title: 6 Weeks Muffins
directions: In a large bowl, mix the first 5 ingredients together. In a small bowl, mix the next 3 ingredients together and add to dry mixture. Add nuts and raisins gently. Bake in paper cup in muffin tins. Bake at 400° for 20 minutes. Store leftover dough in tightly covered bowl in refrigerator.

title: Beef Stroganoff
directions: Brown cubed steak with chopped onion until onion is tender and meat is browned on all sides., Add water and simmer covered for 5 minutes., Stir in soup mix and sour cream, salt and pepper., Cook until thickened., Serve over egg noodles., Serves 4.

title: Pound Cake
directions: Cream oleo, Crisco and add sugar., Add one egg at a time., Add flour, salt and milk., Put in cold oven., Bake 1 hour and 45 minutes at 325°., Do not open oven until done., Bake in well-greased and floured tube pan.

title: Ice Cream Pie
directions: Melt ice cream or yogurt., Pour into pie shell., Refreeze and serve.

title: Butterscotch Cheese Crunchies
directions: Soften cream cheese., Preheat oven to 350°., Combine over hot (not boiling) water the butterscotch morsels and butter., Stir until morsels are melted and mixture is smooth., Transfer to large bowl., Stir in graham cracker crumbs and walnuts with a fork until mixture resembles fine crumbs., Reserve 2 cups for topping., Press remaining mixture into 15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 1-inch ungreased baking pan., Bake at 350° for 12 minutes.

title: Salad Dressing
directions: Mix all ingredients except oil and blend well., Add oil last.

title: Mini Cheesecakes
directions: Preheat oven to 300°., Combine crumbs, sugar and butter. Press equal portions onto bottoms of 24 lightly greased* or paper lined muffin cups., In large mixer bowl, beat cheese until fluffy. Gradually beat in Eagle Brand milk until smooth., Add eggs and vanilla; mix well., Spoon equal amounts of mixture (about 3 tablespoons) into prepared cups., Bake 20 minutes or until cakes spring back when lightly touched., Cool., Chill., Garnish as desired., Makes about 2 dozen.

title: Sweet Potato Biscuits
directions: Combine dry ingredients in a bowl, mixing well., Cut in butter until mixture looks like coarse crumbs., Combine sweet potatoes with buttermilk., Stir into dry ingredients., Makes a soft dough. Turn out onto a floured surface and knead 4 to 5 times or just enough to form a soft ball., Roll dough out and cut out biscuits. Place on lightly oiled baking sheet., Bake at 425° for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Deviled Eggs
directions: Boil eggs until well done., Slice eggs in half, placing egg yolks in a bowl., Use a fork to mix all of your ingredients., Use mayonnaise and mustard to your liking., After all ingredients are well mixed, add your paprika., You may now put your mixture in the eggs., Place toothpick in each egg, chill and serve.

title: Apple Or Peach Cobbler
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Melt oleo in a 9 x 13 x 2-inch cake pan. Heat water and sugar in saucepan until sugar melts., Mix flour and shortening until crumbly., Add milk and stir with fork., Turn out on floured board and knead until smooth., Roll dough out into oblong about 1/4-inch thick., Sprinkle with cinnamon., Add fruit on top., Roll up like jelly roll., Dampen edge with water to seal. Slice dough into 16 slices, 1/2 inch thick., Place in pan with melted butter., Pour water and sugar syrup carefully around rolls. This looks like too much liquid, but the crust will absorb it. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Monkey Cake
directions: Roll, biscuit, in sugar and cinnamon mixture., Put in a well greased tube or loaf pan., Cream together 1/4 cup margarine and 1 cup brown sugar., Pour over cake., Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Pat'S Cheese Cake
directions: Mix cream cheese, 1 1/3 cups sugar, eggs and 1 tablespoon vanilla., Pour into baking pan., Bake at 350° for 35 minutes., Set aside for 20 minutes; leave oven on., Mix sour cream, 6 tablespoons sugar and 2 tablespoons vanilla., Pour on top of cake and spread., Bake for 15 minutes.

title: Company Cheese Cake
directions: Mix the first 4 ingredients together and press into spring-form pan.

title: Holiday Fruitcake
directions: Break mincemeat into pieces in medium size saucepan., Add water; stir over medium heat until lumps are broken., Boil 1 minute; stir occasionally., Cool.

title: Carrot-Pineapple Loaves
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Grease and flour four baking pans.

title: Mom'S Deviled Crab
directions: Saute vegetables until soft in melted butter., Crumb the bread in a blender or processor., Mix all ingredients in a large bowl (use hands if necessary!)., Add mustard, Worcestershire sauce, lots of salt, pepper and celery salt (and a dash of Tabasco). Shape and place in crab shells., Bake in a 350° oven for 10 minutes, or until hot.

title: Old-Time Biscuit Pudding
directions: Soak biscuits in milk, making a thin batter., Add remainder of ingredients., Mix thoroughly., Bake at 400° until done.

title: Corn Pudding(Kentucky Style)
directions: Combine ingredients; pour into a 1 1/2-quart casserole., Set in a shallow pan filled to 1 inch with hot water., Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean., Let stand for 10 minutes at room temperature before serving., Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Pina Colada Dip
directions: Whisk all ingredients together, except the whipping cream. Cook in the top of a double boiler until boiling and thick, stirring constantly., Cool in a refrigerator until serving time. Just before serving, whip 1 cup of whipping cream until fluffy. Fold whipped cream into mixture and serve.

title: No Crust Pizza
directions: Fry beef and sausage together until done; drain., Cook and drain macaroni., Divide meat and macaroni equally into 2 (9 x 13-inch) pans., Add equal amounts of sauce; mix well., Top with pepperoni and cheese., Bake at 350° until bubbly., (Can also be frozen before baking.)

title: Golden Cheddar Broccoli Bake
directions: Melt 2 tablespoons margarine; stir in flour and salt., Add milk gradually, mixing until smooth., Cook until mixture boils, stirring constantly., Add cheese, stirring until melted., Mix in 1/4 cup corn flakes and corn., Arrange broccoli in a 7 1/2 x 11 3/4-inch baking dish., Pour cheese sauce over broccoli., Toss remaining 1/2 cup crumbs with 2 tablespoons melted margarine., Sprinkle crumb mixture over casserole., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes., Makes 8 servings.

title: Hash Brown Potatoes
directions: Mix ingredients together and put in greased 9 x 13-inch., Top with 1 cup crushed corn flakes mixed with 1/2 cup melted butter. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Tremendous Scalloped Potatoes
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Peel and slice the potatoes and add chopped onion., Simmer in a very small amount of water for 1 minute., Grate the cheese and combine with mushroom soup., Add no water., Alternate layers of sliced potatoes and cheese and soup mixture in greased casserole., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Joyce'S Dip
directions: In crock-pot or double boiler; put tomatoes in and cut up cheese and put in., Let cheese melt., Brown ground chuck or beef and onions; drain., Add to cheese and tomatoes mixture.

title: Chicken And Cabbage
directions: Cut the cabbage core off, then wash cabbage., Peel cabbage leaves so you can make layers.

title: Cream Filled Torte
directions: Whip cream with powdered sugar and flavoring., Arrange 9 graham crackers in a square on a plate., Spread with a thin layer of whipped cream and top with thinly sliced bananas., Repeat 4 times., Top with another layer of crackers., Frost sides and top with remaining cream., Coat sides with chopped nuts and put remaining on top., Chill about 3 hours and cut in squares., Is better if left overnight.

title: Monkey Bread
directions: Combine sugar and cinnamon. Cut biscuits into fourths; roll in cinnamon mixture before layering in Bundt or tube pan. Put remaining cinnamon mixture in 1-cup measuring cup; add enough sugar to make 1 cup. Add 1 teaspoon cinnamon. Melt margarine and mix with sugar mixture. Pour evenly over biscuit pieces in pan. Bake for 30 minutes at 350°. Remove from pan immediately. No need to cut bread, just pull apart.

title: Hungry Jack Casserole
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., Brown meat; drain., Stir in next 5 ingredients., Heat until bubbly., Pour into 2-quart casserole. Cut biscuits in half to form 20 half circles., Place cut side down around edge of casserole pan., Bake 25 to 30 minutes until biscuits are brown., Take out; top with cheese and return to oven until melted., Serves 4 to 6.

title: Baked Beans
directions: Saute bacon., Add hamburger and onion; drain fat., Add rest of ingredients., Bake until it bubbles (approximately 1 hour) at 350°., Freezes well before baking for later use.

title: Butterscotch Torte
directions: Beat egg yolks well, slowly adding sugar, then baking powder and vanilla., Mix well. Beat whites until stiff peaks, fold into yolk mix., Fold in crumbs and nuts., Pour into two 9 or 8-inch pans, greased and lined with wax paper., Bake at 325° for 30 to 35 minutes., Cool 10 minutes., Remove from pans and frost when cool.

title: Texas Sheet Cake
directions: Combine flour and sugar in large mixing bowl., In small saucepan, combine butter, cocoa and water., Bring to a boil and pour over flour and sugar; mix well., Add buttermilk with soda, cinnamon, vanilla and eggs., Mix well and pour into greased and floured 16 x 11-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

title: Orange Peach Jello Salad
directions: Cook until thick., Be sure and let cool and mix with one package of Dream Whip, prepared as directed., Fold into cool mixture and spread on jello.

title: Great Creamed Potatoes
directions: Pare potatoes., Boil until tender; drain., Beat softened cream cheese and sour cream until well blended., Add hot potatoes, gradually beating until light and fluffy., Season to taste with salt and pepper., Put in 2-quart casserole., Dot with butter. Bake at 325° for 25 minutes., Serves 6 to 8.

title: Southwestern Shrimp
directions: Peel and devein shrimp; cut in half., Heat oil in nonstick pan over medium-high heat. Saute onion, cilantro and jalapeno for 5 minutes.	Stir in tomato sauce. Add shrimp and stir until shrimp turns pink. Serve over white rice. Serves 2.

title: Puffed Pancake With Strawberries
directions: Mix eggs, milk, orange juice, sugar, flour and salt until blended (if using a mixer, batter may remain lumpy)., Preheat oven to 450°., Melt butter in a 13 x 9-inch baking dish in oven until it sizzles (don't let it brown)., Remove baking dish from oven and pour batter into it immediately., Bake in middle of oven for 20 minutes or until puffed and brown., Remove from oven, sprinkle with powdered sugar if desired., Pancake falls quickly so serve immediately with warm Strawberry Sauce and sour cream.

title: Party Pizzas
directions: Brown, meat and drain., Add seasoning., Mix with cheese until melted., Spread over rye bread., Broil slices on cookie sheet until golden brown.

title: Golden Glazed Chicken
directions: In shallow baking dish, arrange chicken and brush with butter. Bake at 400° for 45 minutes., Baste once with pan drippings. Combine remaining ingredients; spoon over chicken., Bake 15 minutes more, or until chicken is done.

title: Indian Black-Eyed Peas And Potatoes
directions: In skillet heat oil., Add mustard seed., Cover and cook until seed begins to pop., Remove from heat., Remove lid, stir in cumin. Add onion and garlic., Cook and stir until onion is tender but not brown., Stir in undrained black-eyed peas, potatoes, ginger, turmeric and red pepper., Bring to boil., Reduce heat, simmer for 15 minutes., Serves 4 to 5.

title: Spinach Dip
directions: Mix all ingredients, except bread., Cut out center of bread and spoon in dip., Slice fresh veggies and cut rest of bread into cubes., Dip and enjoy!, (Best if made the day before.)

title: Impossible Spinach Pie
directions: Heat oven to 375°., Grease pie plate., Mix spinach, cheese and onion in plate., Beat remaining ingredients until smooth. Pour into pie plate., Bake until a knife inserted in the center comes out clean., About 30 minutes., Cool 5 minutes.

title: Apple Walnut Ring Cake
directions: Cream butter and sugar until fluffy., Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition., Mix and sift flour, soda, salt and spices., Add gradually to butter, sugar and egg mixture., Mix well., Stir in vanilla, apples and walnuts., Batter will be stiff. Spoon into a greased and floured 10-inch tube pan and bake at 325° for 1 1/2 hours., Let cool in pan for 10 minutes, then remove to rack to cool., Dribble confectioners sugar icing on top and sides, if desired.

title: Chocolate Sunshine Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients together; blend well., Beat 3 minutes. Batter is very thin., Bake 30 minutes in 13 x 9-inch pan at 350°. Frost with your favorite white icing., Serves 20 slices.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
directions: Combine first 6 ingredients in a large bowl; toss., Combine mayonnaise, lemon juice, Worcestershire sauce and hot sauce; add to chicken mixture, mixing well., Spoon mixture into a 1 1/2-quart casserole coated with cooking spray.

title: Cream Cheese Pie
directions: Mix first 3 ingredients together., Put into a 9-inch pie pan and bake 10 minutes at 350°., Set aside., Cream together cream cheese, eggs, sugar and vanilla., Pour into crust and bake 20 minutes., Cool.

title: Strawberry Pie
directions: Cook water, sugar and cornstarch until thick., Add food coloring and gelatin.

title: Mama'S Homecooking Fried Muskrat
directions: First, trap muskrat., Then skin muskrat, then cut into 4 pieces., Once this is completed, dip into egg and milk, then roll into flour, cracker meal, salt and pepper.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Mix broccoli, mushroom soup, cheese, mayonnaise, egg and onion together in baking dish., Crumble cracker crumbs on top and bake in 350° oven for 30 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Festive Chicken Dip
directions: Place chicken in a small bowl. Sprinkle with 3 tablespoons lime juice, garlic, salt and pepper., Mix well., Set aside.

title: Fruit Yogurt Salad
directions: Cook liquids and cornstarch until thick, cool., Combine yogurt, sugar and vanilla and mix with cooled mixture., Stir in fruit and chill., Be creative and add different kinds of fruits.

title: Bread Machine Bread
directions: Add ingredients to the bread pan in the order listed, measuring carefully and using a knife to scrape off the excess. Bake as directed by the directions on the bread machine. Makes 1 1/2 lb. loaf., (You may also use the dough setting on your machine and when the dough is ready, form it into dinner rolls. Let them rise until doubled in size, then bake at 375° until brown.)

title: Chicken And Rice Casserole
directions: In a 2-quart casserole, add ingredients in order, starting with rice., Salt, pepper and flour chicken and dip each piece in liquid shortening., Put chicken into casserole mixture, cover and bake 2 hours at 350°.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
directions: Mix and put in an 11 x 13 baking dish. Top with 1 package of Pillsbury pie crust from the dairy section. I use a small biscuit cutter and lap it but it will still be vented. Bake at 350° to 375° about 45 minutes or until brown and bubbly.

title: Good Rich Yeast Rolls
directions: Dissolve yeast with 1 teaspoon sugar in lukewarm water., Sift flour with remaining sugar and salt; add eggs, milk, shortening and cooled yeast., Mix. Turn dough onto floured board and knead., Pinch off and roll into golf ball size balls; place in greased muffin pans., Let rise (covered with light cloth)., Bake at 350° until golden brown., Yields about 36 rolls.

title: Swedish Nut Cake
directions: Mix by hand., Pour in greased 9 x 12-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean., Have icing ready when the cake is done.

title: Pumpkin Bars(Microwave)
directions: Blend oil, eggs, sugar and pumpkin together in large mixing bowl., Measure flour, baking powder, soda, salt, cinnamon, ginger, cloves and nutmeg into 1-quart measure., Mix together lightly with fork., Stir into pumpkin mixture., Divide butter equally into two 8 x 8-inch glass pans., One at a time, cover with plastic wrap. Microwave 5 minutes and 30 seconds to 11 to 13 minutes on High, or until wooden toothpick inserted in center comes out clean., Let stand until thoroughly cooled., Top with Cream Cheese Frosting.

title: Manicotti Casserole
directions: Cook manicotti noodles as directed on package. Let cool. Stuff with grated cheeses. Place manicotti in dish; cover with spaghetti sauce. Bake at 350° until cheese melts and is hot.

title: Peanut Brittle
directions: Bring sugar, syrup and water to a boil., Add peanuts, stirring constantly., Cook until peanuts start popping., Remove from heat and add soda and stir quickly until well mixed., Pour in greased pan., Let cool and break into desired pieces.

title: Special Scalloped Potatoes
directions: Melt half of butter in large skillet; add potatoes and stir until coated., Mix other ingredients and pour into 9 x 13-inch casserole., Melt other half of butter and stir in corn flakes. Spread over top of potatoes and bake at 350° for 30 minutes., For a one dish meal, add chunks of chicken or ham.

title: Chili Sauce
directions: Combine tomatoes, onions, sweet and hot peppers, sugar and salt., Cook gently 45 minutes., Tie spices in a cheesecloth bag; add them to tomato mixture., Cook until very thick, about 45 minutes., As mixture thickens, stir often to prevent sticking. Add vinegar and cook slowly until thick as desired., Pour boiling hot into jars, leaving 1/8-inch space and seal., Yield:, 6 pints.

title: Oat Bran Muffins
directions: Add all ingredients together in a large bowl., Put in muffin pans., Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes., Makes 5 dozen.

title: Pumpkin Bread
directions: Sift together all dry ingredients., Add remaining ingredients. Mix till smooth., Pour into 3 loaf pans, greased and floured and bake at 350° for 1 hour or until toothpick comes out clean., Cool.

title: Vegetable Bars
directions: Spray a large cookie sheet or large pizza pan with Pam. Spread crescent rolls on sheet to make a crust., Bake 7 minutes at 350°., Cool., Mix together cream cheese, Ranch dressing and Miracle Whip., Spread on crust., Sprinkle vegetables on top of crust and cover with shredded cheese/cheeses., Chill., Cut into squares.

title: Dump Cake
directions: Spread pineapple into pan., Place cherries over pineapple. Dump cake mix evenly over filling., Sprinkle nuts over mixture. Bake 1 hour at 350°., Cool before serving.

title: Ann'S Cabbage Casserole
directions: Brown meat, celery, onion and salt., In a kettle, cook cabbage for 5 minutes., After it starts boiling, drain and add meat mixture., Then add rice and 1/2 of grated cheese., Put in casserole dish and top with remaining cheese., Bake at 350° for one hour., You may substitute bell pepper for celery and chicken soup for mushroom if you desire.

title: Cheese Ball
directions: Mix cream cheese, chicken and pineapple together well., Be sure to drain chicken and pineapple well., Roll in crushed pecans.

title: Cheesy Rice And Broccoli
directions: Bring broccoli and water to full boil in medium saucepan on medium-high heat. Stir in rice. Cover. Remove from heat. Let stand 5 minutes. Add Velveeta. Stir until Velveeta is melted.

title: Cream Of Corn And Crabmeat Soup
directions: In a large saucepot, add Wesson oil, corn, onion, celery and red pepper. Let saute until tender for 20 minutes.

title: Bonnymill Baked Eggs
directions: Beat eggs in large bowl., Add remaining ingredients., Beat well., Pour into an oiled 13 x 9-inch pan., Bake at 350° until mixture is set and top is golden, about 45 minutes., Yields 10 to 12 servings.

title: Pecan Crispies
directions: Set oven to 375°., Cream butter and sugars until light., Beat in egg and vanilla., Sift together dry ingredients; blend into creamed mixture., Stir in nuts and drop by teaspoon onto ungreased cookie sheet., Bake about 10 minutes., Cool slightly before removing from pan., Makes about 2 1/2 dozen.

title: Vegetable Medley
