directions: Scrub potatoes; peel onion and melt 2 tablespoons butter in glass baking dish., Slice potatoes and onion., Alternate layers of each onto melted butter., Top with 1 tablespoon butter., Sprinkle with salt and pepper., Cover with Saran Wrap and microwave 10 minutes (or until potatoes are tender.), This may also be fixed inside foil and placed on grill just prior to cooking hamburgers.

title: Taco Pizza
directions: Prepare pizza dough., Spread in round pizza pan., Place pizza dough in oven to rise about 5 to 10 minutes; dough should not be moist at this time., Layer the following items in this order: refried beans, hamburger (browned), Cheddar cheese and Mozzarella cheese., Put pizza in preheated 350° oven for 15 minutes or until hot and cheese has melted., Sprinkle shredded lettuce completely over pizza along with tomatoes and onions., Spoon picante sauce over all the pizza (sour cream optional)., Makes 2 to 4 servings.

title: Tomatoes Vinaigrette
directions: Arrange tomatoes on serving plate; set aside., Whisk together oil, vinegar, sugar and basil., Stir in onions., Season with salt and pepper., When ready to serve, pour dressing over tomatoes.

title: Chinese Spareribs
directions: Mix sauce all together and pour over spareribs., Roast ribs for 2 or 3 hours at 350°., Baste them while baking.

title: Pumpkin Cookies
directions: Cream together margarine and sugar., Beat in egg, vanilla and pumpkin., Mix well; add to margarine and sugar mixture., Mix dry ingredients and add all together., Drop by teaspoon onto a greased cookie sheet., Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes., Frost when cool if desired.

title: Strawberry Salad
directions: Mix gelatin and pineapple in saucepan., Bring almost to boil; let cool. Add buttermilk, whipped topping, strawberries and nuts. Spread in 9 x 13 pan. Let congeal in refrigerator.

title: Whole Wheat Bread
directions: In small mixing bowl, sprinkle yeast and 1 tablespoon honey into warm water., Let stand 5 to 10 minutes or until mixture becomes bubbly., In small saucepan, combine remaining honey with milk, butter and salt., Cook over low heat until butter melts. Remove from heat., Cool to lukewarm., Stir in yeast mixture. Combine wheat germ and whole wheat flour in a large mixing bowl. Add liquid mixture., Stir until smooth., Add enough flour to make a soft dough., Turn out onto a lightly floured surface., Knead until smooth and elastic, about 10 minutes., Place dough in a large lightly greased bowl., Turn dough over to bring greased side up. Cover with greased waxed paper and a towel., Let rise in warm place until doubled in bulk, about 1 hour.

title: Corn Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients and bake at 350° until bubbly.

title: Raspberry Poppy Seed Dressing
directions: Combine ingredients in a blender; blend for about 40 seconds or until dressing has a creamy pink appearance.

title: Pork Chops Hungarian
directions: Trim fat off chops., Brown chops in small amount of shortening in 8-inch pan., Drain fat., Combine onion, caraway, salt, paprika, dill weed, garlic powder and water., Add to pan; cover and cook over medium heat for 1 hour until chops are tender., Watch the juice!, It evaporates; add water every so often., Transfer chops to warm platter., Stir sour cream into juice in pan., Heat through., Do not boil!, Spoon over chops.

title: Monkey Bread
directions: Soften yeast in water. Heat milk and shortening together until melted, (don't, boil)., Measure, sugar, and salt into large bowl. Add, hot, milk, mixture., Stir until dissolved and cool until lukewarm., Add, 2, cups, of, flour to milk mixture. Mix for 1 minute, with, electric, mixer, or by hand.	Stir in softened yeast and eggs., Beat well and add more flour to make thick batter. Beat, thoroughly until smooth and elastic about 2 minutes. Cover and, let, rise, in	warm place until bubbly, about	1 hour., Stir down., Place, on, floured, board., Knead lightly and roll out, to not quite an inch thick and punch out with cookie cutter., Dip each, piece in 1 stick melted butter and drop in, Bundt, pan. Repeat, process layering in tiers in pan., Pour remaining, butter on top., Cover again and let rise 30 minutes. Bake at 375° for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Grandma E'S Molded Shrimp Salad
directions: Mix tomato juice, bay leaf, salt, cayenne pepper, chopped onion and celery (also chopped)., Put in saucepan and simmer 10 minutes., Soften gelatine in cold water and dissolve in hot tomato juice mixture., Add vinegar, remove bay leaf and cool.

title: Jennifer'S Colored Sugar
directions: You can save money by making your own colored sugar!, Put sugar in Ziploc bag., Add 3 or 4 drops of food coloring to bag and seal. Knead the bag until the sugar is uniformly colored., If the sugar is too light, add more food coloring., If the sugar is too dark, add more sugar., To make unusual colors, mix the food coloring in a spoon and stir with a toothpick before adding to the sugar., We use these sugars for decorating cookies, etc., Makes 2 1/2 cups.

title: Seafood Casserole
directions: Cook onions, celery and pepper in oil until they are clear. In baking dish, add milk and butter and spread on bottom., Add layer of noodles., Add layer of celery, onions and pepper., Add layer of English peas, then add soup., Add shrimp and crab meat. As you make these layers, at this point, add garlic, oregano, salt and pepper., Add a little of the sherry., Repeat layers until all ingredients are used., Cook in oven at 350° for 1 1/2 hours. Add buttered cracker crumbs just before taking the casserole out of the oven.

title: Great Aunt Elsie'S Cream Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., Cream together sugar, oleo and eggs. Add sour cream and vanilla., Stir well., Gradually add the remaining dry ingredients., On a well floured surface, roll out the cookie dough., Cut with cookie cutters in desired shapes. Bake for approximately 12 minutes or just until lightly brown on bottom., Cool and then frost and decorate.

title: Sour Cream Apple Pie
directions: Mix flour and sugar. Add vanilla, sour cream and egg. Beat until smooth. Stir in apples and salt. Pour into pie shell. Bake at 450° for 15 minutes. Reduce heat to 325°. Bake about 30 minutes longer. Remove from oven. Sprinkle with topping crumbs. Return to oven and bake 10 minutes.

title: Cranberry Fruit Tarts
directions: Thicken cranberries with cornstarch., Combine flour, shortening and milk., Roll out on floured surface., Cut with 4-inch cutter. Spoon 1 teaspoon of cranberries on each one., Go around each with milk to seal edges., Cover and seal with a fork to crimp., Lightly grease sheet to bake., Bake at 375° 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Chili Cheese
directions: *Can try Mexican varieties, according to taste.

title: French Dressing
directions: Heat cream until bubbles begin to form around edge., Remove from heat and add chocolate., Stir gently until mixture is smooth and shiny., Stir in brandy.

title: Mexican Casserole
directions: Brown ground beef, onion and green pepper. Drain. Mix soups, tomatoes, chili powder and 1/2 cup cheese. In a 9 x 13 baking dish, cover bottom with crushed Doritos. Pour ground beef on top of Doritos, then pour soup mixture on top of ground beef. Top with remaining cheese. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

title: Vegetable Casserole
directions: Drain green beans and corn, then put in oblong glass casserole dish., Then combine soup, sour cream, cheese and celery., Mix all together.

title: Orange Salad
directions: Bring pineapple and sugar to a boil, then cool., Mix Jell-O and water to cool pineapple., Chill in refrigerator., Fold in large Cool Whip., Chill and serve on lettuce or with any vegetable.

title: Party Tea
directions: Simmer tea, cloves and cinnamon sticks in 1 quart of water for about 15 minutes., Dissolve Jell-O in 2 cups of hot water, then add enough cold water to make 3/4 gallon., Add sugar, pineapple juice and lemon juice., Mix all together and serve hot or cold.

title: Magic Coconut Pie
directions: Put the ingredients in a blender; blend about 1 minute., Pour into well-greased and floured pie plate., Bake in a 350° oven for about 1 hour and 10 minutes., Glass pie plate works well.

title: Mushroom Ring Italienne
directions: Chop mushrooms and onion very fine., Saute onion and mushrooms in 2 tablespoons butter 5 minutes., Melt remaining 2 tablespoons of butter and mix in flour., Gradually pour in milk., Stir constantly., Combine with mushrooms., Cool., Add egg yolks., Mix well., Beat egg whites until stiff., Fold into mushroom mixture with parsley and Cappicola., Add seasonings., Pour into greased and floured ring mold., Place in pan of boiling water., Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

title: Refrigerator Bran Muffins
directions: Pour boiling water over 2 cups all-bran, let cool., Cream margarine, sugar, add eggs., Sift soda in flour., Add to cream mixture, buttermilk, also add the all-bran mixture and the remaining 4 cups all-bran., Stir until well blended; do not beat. Must refrigerate before using, fill well-greased muffin tins and bake at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes., Make only what you need as this batter will keep 4 to 6 weeks.

title: Cherry Cream Pie
directions: Bake pie shell., Beat pudding and pie filling, whipped topping mix, milk and almond extract in 2 1/2-quart bowl on low speed until blended., Beat on high speed until soft peaks form, about 3 minutes., Fold in cherries., Pour into pie shell., Refrigerate until firm, at least 2 hours., Top each serving with 1/2 cup reserved syrup., Makes 8 servings, 360 calories per serving.

title: Au Gratin Potato Casserole
directions: Cook, potatoes until partly done., Combine, soup,, milk and cheese., Alternate layers of potatoes and, soup mixture in a buttered, baking dish, adding salt and pepper, as, you, go. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes., Remove from oven, and, add onion rings, partially crumbled., Bake for 10 minutes more.

title: Zucchini Pickles
directions: Wash zucchini and cut in thin slices. Peel and cut onions in quarters, then slice very thin. Add to zucchini. Sprinkle salt over vegetables; add cold water, enough to cover. Let stand for 2 hours. Bring all ingredients to boiling point and heat for 5 minutes. Pack hot into hot jars, remove air bubbles. Adjust caps. Process for 15 minutes in a boiling watter bath. Makes about 4 half pints.

title: Fruit Punch
directions: Mix lemonade, orange, juice, pineapple juice and bananas together; divide into 3 parts., Put into freezer., When frozen, add 1 bottle of ginger ale, to each part., Can use all together at 1 time if desired.

title: Texas Sheet Cake
directions: Bring oleo, water and cocoa to a boil., Mix sugar, flour and salt., Add chocolate mixture to this., Add eggs, sour cream and soda., Pour into a greased cookie sheet., Bake 15 to 20 minutes at 350°.

title: Dried Beef Dip
directions: Mix all ingredients, except, butter, and nuts together. Pour in ovenproof baking, dish.	Saute 1 cup chopped pecans in 1/2 stick butter for 5	minutes., Put, on top of dip., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes or until hot., Serve with Ritz crackers or one of your choice.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
directions: Pile lightly in an 8 x 9-inch casserole., Sprinkle with 1/2 cup grated cheese and 1 cup crushed potato chips (or any kind of crumbs)., Bake at 425° for 20 minutes or until hot.

title: Cornmeal Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 400°., Grease baking sheet., Mix butter or margarine and sugar until creamy., Beat in eggs and flavoring. Mix flour, cornmeal, baking powder, nutmeg and salt thoroughly. Add to creamy mixture., Stir in raisins., Mix well.

title: Macaroni And Cheese
directions: Cook macaroni in boiling, salted water until tender., Melt butter in saucepan; stir in flour., Add milk and bring to a boil, stirring constantly., Add macaroni, salt, pepper, onion and mustard. Pour in greased dish., Sprinkle cheese on top. Dot with butter and cover with bread crumbs. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes until brown on top.

title: Seafoam Frosting
directions: Cook sugar and water until it spins a thread., Beat egg whites with cream of tartar., Pour syrup over egg whites; add vanilla and beat until it will stand in patties.

title: Western Fettuccini
directions: Cook peas as directed on package., Prepare noodles as directed on package., Drain well., Toss lightly with sour cream, grated cheese and salt., Add peas to noodle mixture and sprinkle more Parmesan cheese lightly on top., Serve immediately.

title: Omaha Potatoes
directions: Defrost potatoes., Combine all ingredients except cornflakes. Put them on top., Bake at 275° for 60 minutes, uncovered in 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.

title: Fresh Vegetable Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients in large bowl except sunflower seeds. Toss with dressing and store covered in refrigerator., Toss in sunflower seeds before serving.

title: Good Layer Cake
directions: Cream sugar and butter with Crisco and eggs, one at a time. Alternate flour and buttermilk; add vanilla., Bake at 350° until done.

title: Chocolate No-Bakes
directions: Bring first 4 ingredients to a boil over medium heat, stirring constantly., Boil for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally., Remove from heat, stir in peanut butter and vanilla., Stir in oatmeal. Drop by tablespoon onto waxed paper., Let cool.

title: Easy Bread
directions: Dissolve yeast in a bowl., Add oil, salt and sugar., Mix and add 2 cups flour., Stir well., Add 3rd cup of flour., Leave in bowl, cover and let rise until doubled., Pour out on floured board., Knead about 10 strokes., Put in greased pans; let rise again., Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Chocolate Walnut Sensations
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., Combine flour, soda and salt; set aside., In mixing bowl, beat brown sugar, butter and vanilla until creamy., Beat in egg., Gradually add flour., Stir in 1 1/3 cups chocolate chips (save 2/3 cups chocolate chips for top)., Spread into 9-inch square pan., Bake 23 to 25 minutes.

title: Gingered Chicken Stir-Fry
directions: Cut chicken., Drain oranges, reserving 1/4 cup syrup., Cook ginger in hot oil 30 seconds., Add chicken and stir-fry about 3 minutes., Add snow peas, reserved syrup and stir-fry sauce., Heat to boiling., Reduce heat, cover and cook 2 minutes., Top with orange sections., Serve over rice., Makes 2 servings, about 300 calories.

title: Virginia Baked Beans
directions: Fry bacon until crisp., Chop onion and garlic., Fry in 2 tablespoons of bacon fat until soft., Add vinegar, sugar and mustard., Simmer for 5 minutes., Mix the drained kidney beans and butter beans in a large baking dish with the baked beans., Crumble bacon and add, then mix in the onion and sugar mix., Bake in a 350° oven for 1 hour.

title: Lemon Coffee Cake
directions: Mix first 5 ingredients., Pour 1/2 of batter into a 10 x 12-inch greased baking dish., Mix sugar and cinnamon., Spread 1/2 over batter and 1/2 of nuts., Then add rest of batter, cinnamon and nuts., Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes., You can use any flavor cake mix and instant pudding you like.

title: Orange Punch
directions: In a gallon jug, dissolve acid in 1/4 can orange juice; add remaining juice and sugar., When dissolved, finish filling jar with water., Cover and let stand for 24 hours in refrigerator.

title: Lemon Squares
directions: Beat eggs with the salt, sugar and baking powder until very light and fluffy., Add the lemon juice and rind., Remove crust from oven., Pour lemon, mix over it., Return to oven and bake at 350° for 25 minutes., Cool and cut into squares.

title: Party Punch
directions: In a large punch bowl, pour sparkling wine or champagne over thawed strawberries., Allow mixture to stand at room temperature for 2 to 3 hours., Stir in the wine and lemonade and dilute with ginger ale and ice cubes as desired.

title: Golden Chicken Nuggets
directions: Preheat oven to 400°., Combine soup mix with bread crumbs. Dip chicken in bread crumb mixture, coating well., In lightly greased pan, put chicken, then drizzle with butter., Bake, turning once, 10 minutes or until chicken is done.

title: Championship Chicken Breasts
directions: Mix salad dressing, mustard and honey., Place chicken on grill or rack of broiler pan., Brush with half of the salad dressing mixture., Grill or broil 8 minutes., Turn; brush with remaining salad dressing mixture., Continue broiling or grilling 8 to 10 minutes or until tender., Makes 4 servings.

title: Chili
directions: Brown chuck and onions., Drain off grease., Add remaining ingredients., Cover and cook 30 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Jalapeno Cornbread
directions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl., Blend well., Pour into greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan., Bake in preheated 350° oven for 1 hour or until done.

title: Puffy Fried Bread
directions: Sift flour, measure, and sift again with salt, baking powder, and sugar. Cut in shortening, and add milk to make a soft dough just firm enough to roll. Cover bowl and let dough stand for 30 to 60 min. Roll 1\4 inch thick on lightly floured surface. Cut into diamond shaped pieces., Heat about 1 inch of oil in frying pan 370° to 380°. Add a few pieces at a time; turn at once, so they will puff evenly. Then turn back to brown on both sides. Drain on paper toweling. Serve with butter or honey. Makes 4 dozen.

title: Belvie'S Favorite Cake
directions: Combine eggs, sugar, oil and vanilla., Mix in dry ingredients, beating well., Then add pineapple, pecans and bananas., Bake at 350° about 30 minutes in 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Cold Bean Salad
directions: In large mixing bowl, combine first 5 ingredients., Combine remaining ingredients and store in refrigerator overnight.

title: Banana Pudding Supreme
directions: Cream the cheese until smooth., Stir in sweetened condensed milk and pudding mix; fold in half of the whipped topping., Layer pudding, cookies and bananas in dish; top with remaining topping. Chill.

title: Hershey'S Syrup Cake
directions: Cream margarine, sugar and eggs., Sift flour, baking powder and salt., Add to creamed mixture alternately with syrup., Bake 30 minutes in a 13 x 9-inch pan.

title: Old Fashioned Cornbread Dressing
directions: Combine cornmeal, baking powder, baking soda and salt in a large mixing bowl., Add 2 eggs, buttermilk and bacon drippings. Mix well., Place a well-greased 10-inch cast-iron skillet in oven at 450° for 4 to 5 minutes or until hot., Pour batter into skillet. Bake at 450° for 35 minutes or until lightly browned., Cool and crumble cornbread into large bowl.

title: Broccoli-Cheese Soup
directions: In heavy 4-quart kettle, melt 1 tablespoon oleo over medium heat., Add onion and garlic., Saute, stirring until onion is transparent and set aside.

title: Fruit Cake
directions: Place fruit and nuts in large mixing bowl., Sprinkle sugar over them., Mix well., Beat eggs, melted butter and flour together with flavoring., Pour over fruit and nuts., Mix well., Pour in tube pan. Bake for 2 hours at 350°.

title: 7-Up Salad
directions: Dissolve jello in boiling water., Add other ingredients and place in mold., Refrigerate.

title: Meat Loaf Layered
directions: Grease 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan., Combine beef, salt, pepper, onion and milk., Mix thoroughly., Prepare stuffing mix as directed on package., Fill pan with three layers of meat and two layers of stuffing, beginning and ending with meat., Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes., Makes six servings.

title: Pound Cake
directions: Separate eggs., Beat egg whites and set aside., Beat egg yolks., Add sugar and Crisco, then add milk, flour, baking powder, vanilla and lemon extract., Add beaten egg whites., Bake in preheated oven at 350° for 1 hour; last 15 minutes at 325°.

title: Rice Artichoke
directions: Cook the Rice-A-Roni as directed in large skillet., Add the green pepper, onions, celery and artichoke hearts to the skillet with the Rice-A-Roni., Mix the mayonnaise, lemon juice and dry mustard or curry powder., Mix this into the skillet and serve.

title: Soft And Easy Cheese Ball
directions: Set cheeses out until softened to room temperature and mix together., Add Worcestershire sauce., Chill for several hours. Form into ball and roll in chopped nuts., Cheese ball will be very soft., Keep cool.

title: Best Ever Brownies
directions: Mix cake mix, 1/3 cup evaporated milk and melted margarine. Add nuts., Press 1/2 of mixture into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake 10 minutes at 350°., Melt caramels and blend 1/3 cup evaporated milk into caramels., Pour over cake mix. Sprinkle chocolate chips over caramel., Crumble rest of cake mix on top., Bake another 20 minutes.

title: Hasty Hobo Soup
directions: Saute cabbage and onions in butter until slightly soft., Add drained beans, frozen vegetables, ham and rice., Cook over medium heat for 5 to 10 minutes, stirring to coat with butter.

title: Beefy Baked Beans
directions: Cook ground beef until brown, stirring to crumble meat., Drain well., Combine beef and next 6 ingredients; stir well., Spoon mixture into lightly greased baking dish., Arrange bacon on top of beans., Bake at 400° for 40 minutes.

title: Beef Stir-Fry With Mushrooms
directions: Partially freeze beef; cut on the bias into thin bite-size strips., For marinade, in a medium mixing bowl, stir together water, soy sauce, wine, cornstarch and molasses., Add beef, stirring to coat well., Cover and marinate at room temperature for 30 minutes or in the refrigerator for 2 hours, stirring occasionally., Drain well, reserving marinade., Set aside.

title: Baked Butternut Squash
directions: Skin & extract seeds, mash with a fork. Place all ingredients in a baking dish and bake at 350° for 1 hour or until baked solid and a knife inserted comes out clean.

title: Blueberry Buckle
directions: Mix thoroughly the sugar, butter and eggs., Stir in milk. Sift together flour, baking powder and salt., Add to the batter, stirring well., Toss the fresh blueberries in a little flour, then add them to the batter., Pour into greased and floured pan.

title: Tortellini Salad
directions: Cook and drain tortellini as per package directions., Set aside in a large bowl.

title: Baked Chop Suey
directions: Brown ground beef and onions; add salt and pepper., Add other ingredients and mix all together., Bake at 325° for 1 hour.

title: Upside-Down Cake
directions: Heavily grease bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan with butter or margarine., Sprinkle brown sugar over the bottom of the pan to cover the butter., Cover this with drained peaches or pineapple. Mix cake mix according to directions., Pour over fruit., Bake as directed or until done., Serve warm with sauce., Turn the piece upside down and put sauce over it.

title: Oriental Chicken Wings And Drummies
directions: Separate chicken wings at the joints, cut off wing tips and discard., Mix all ingredients well and pour over chicken wings and drummies in shallow dish., Cover and marinate in refrigerator overnight., Place wings on a cookie sheet., Bake at 375° for 30 minutes., Remove from oven and put in slow cooker on low until tender.

title: Chicken L'Orange
directions: Mix all ingredients together and pour over chicken in baking dish., Bake, covered, at 350° for 35 minutes; uncover and bake for an additional 20 minutes.

title: Buttermilk Pound Cake
directions: Have all ingredients at room temperature., Adjust oven racks to divide oven in thirds., Preheat oven to 325°., Spray a 5-cup loaf pan, Bundt or tube pan with nonstick cooking spray.

title: Peanut Butter Quickie
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Mix ingredients together and drop by spoonfuls onto greased cookie sheets., Press with a fork (sugar coated)., Bake for 10 minutes., Makes 1 dozen.

title: Fried Rice And Cabbage
directions: Fry rice, onions and pepper in small amount of shortening until it is brown, then add cabbage; cover it with water and add beef and salt to taste., Add tomato paste., Let simmer for about 30 to 35 minutes, then serve.

title: Nacho Dip
directions: Brown beef and onion together., Drain away any oil. Brown sausage and drain., Melt cheese, add in tomatoes and mix well., Add meats to cheese mixture., Mix well. Put all ingredients into a large crock-pot., Let simmer for 3 to 4 hours., Serve with nacho chips.

title: Chicken Parisenne
directions: Place, uncooked, skinned thighs in 13 x 9-inch Pyrex baking dish., Mix red wine vinegar, water, brown sugar and soup with wire whisk., Pour over chicken., Top with mushrooms., Bake at 350° for 1 hour., One half hour before serving,, mix in sour cream with a spoon., Serve with rice.

title: Quick Fudge Cake
directions: Mix as directed on box and pour into a nonstick 13 x 9-inch pan sprayed with Pam., Bake as directed.

title: King'S Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Cream together the butter, sugars and eggs., Add all other ingredients., Bake for 9 minutes at 375°., Take out before they look done.

title: Cauliflower Au Gratin
directions: Divide the cauliflower into sprigs., Soak in salt water for a while and rinse well., Boil up in slightly salted water., Make a white sauce with the butter, flour and milk, adding enough cauliflower water to make a soft, smooth dough., Allow to cool slightly and beat in the egg yolks one by one., Finally, fold in the stiffly beaten egg whites to which the corn flour has been added., Season to taste and line the bottom of a ovenproof dish with the gratin mixture., Add the cauliflower and pour over the remainder of the gratin mixture., Bake at 350° for about 1 hour testing with a knitting needle., Serve with cold or melted butter.

title: Chicken Tetrazzini
directions: Boil chicken in large pot; cook until it falls off bone. Cool; cut into pieces., Save 1 cup of broth., Cook spaghetti until tender., Cut Velveeta cheese into small cubes., Mix together the chicken, celery, cream of chicken soup, pimento, chicken broth, spaghetti and Velveeta in large bowl., Salt and pepper to taste. Put into a large, long casserole dish.

title: Potato Leek Soup
directions: In chicken stock, cook 2 cups potatoes, 2 whole carrots, celery, leek or onion and bay leaf., When cooked, remove bay leaf and carrots., In blender, puree the potatoes, celery and leeks with chicken stock. Return to pan.

title: Cheez Whiz Au Gratin Potatoes
directions: Bake 20 minutes at 375°., Last 5 minutes, sprinkle paprika on top.

title: Best-Ever Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients and beat for 1 minute by hand., Bake in greased, but not floured, 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan at 300° for 40 to 45 minutes., Let cool., Chop 1 large jar maraschino cherries (drained) and put on top of cake.

title: Snow Punch
directions: Beat together bananas, lemon juice and sugar., Pour into punch bowl., Add cream, 7-Up and sherbet., Sprinkle coconut on top.

title: Crab Salad
directions: After macaroni has been cooked and drained, add chopped vegetables and salad dressing., Mix and season for taste., Chill. (When I don't have fresh crabmeat, I use imitation crabmeat.)

title: Taco Meat Balls
directions: Mix and make into small balls., Cook in microwave for 3 minutes on High.

title: Raisin Bran Muffins
directions: Dissolve baking soda in buttermilk., Mix all ingredients together., Bake at 400° for 15 minutes., Store unused batter in airtight container., Do not stir when ready to spoon into muffin cups to bake., Can sprinkle with cinnamon-sugar or nuts before baking.

title: Green Wonder Salad
directions: Do not drain liquid from vegetables., Mix all and marinate overnight. Lasts weeks. Serves 12 to 16.

title: Cheese Balls
directions: Mix all ingredients, except 3/4 cup pecans., Mold into 2 small or 1 large ball. Roll in remaining pecans., Wrap in Glad Wrap and chill.

title: Quick Quiche
directions: Brown sausage with onions and mushrooms; drain well., Mix eggs, milk, salt and pepper; add sausage mixture., Pour into pie shells., Bake at 350° until knife comes out clean.

title: Spicy Oatmeal Raisin Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Grease baking sheets.

title: Pineapple Casserole
directions: Drain pineapple reserving 6 Tbsp juice. Mix pineapple, cheese, flour, sugar and juice. Stir well. Pour into dish. Sprinkle on topping.

title: Taco Pie
directions: Use a large glass pie dish or a 9 x 13-inch glass dish. Spread rolls to form crust., (Pam the pan first.), Brown meat and onion., Add taco seasoning and water., I bring to boil., Spread meat mixture over rolls., Spread sour cream over meat., Sprinkle cheese over sour cream., Top with crushed Doritos., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes., Serve with a salad.

title: Mama'S Lap Sugar Cookies
directions: Cream sugar, margarine and shortening together., Add eggs and cream., Sift flour and soda together., Add alternately with milk. Form into small balls the size of walnuts; flatten with fork. Bake for 10 minutes at 375°.

title: Cranberry And Orange Salad Mold
directions: Dissolve cherry gelatin in hot water., Add sugar and lemon juice., Soak gelatin in pineapple juice and dissolve over hot water., Add to cherry gelatin mixture., When gelatin begins to thicken, add other ingredients., Pour into molds.

title: Party Chicken
directions: Grease one large 8 x 12-inch casserole dish., Line with chipped beef., Wrap each chicken breast with a strip of bacon. Place on beef in casserole., Mix soup and sour cream and pour over chicken., Bake at 300° for 2 hours.

title: Cherry Chiffon Dessert
directions: Combine ingredients in large bowl, folding together until blended., Spoon into decorative serving bowl., Chill.

title: Tomatoes With Basil
directions: Arrange tomatoes on a platter., Sprinkle with minced garlic, salt, pepper, oregano, basil and cheese. Drizzle oil over all.

title: Fifty Dollar Cake
directions: Cream the butter and sugar., Add egg yolks and melted chocolate., Sift in flour and baking powder., Add milk and fold in egg whites. Add nuts and vanilla., Bake in a 350° oven. When done, cool and cover with Fifty Dollar Cake Icing.

title: Potato Soup
directions: Saute onion in butter., Mix hash browns and milk. Add to onion. Add remaining ingredients and cook slowly until potatoes are tender and cheese is melted.

title: Weight Watchers Quick Dinner Rolls
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Spoon into muffin pan sprayed with Pam., Bake at 400° for 15 minutes., Makes 6 to 8 muffins., A 1 ounce serving equals 1 Bread.

title: Coconut Bars(Candy)
directions: Melt oleo; add milk, sugar and coconut., Mix well., Chill until easy to handle and then form into small balls., Chill again until firm., Melt chocolate chips over warm water., Stir until smooth, then dip the bottom of each ball into the chocolate using a toothpick., Harden on waxed paper.

title: Tex-Mex Meatball Soup
directions: Chop onion., Cut zucchini into 1-inch pieces., Combine beef, chili powder, 1/2 teaspoon salt and 1/4 teaspoon pepper., Shape into 1-inch balls., In a Dutch oven, heat oil over medium heat. Add meatballs; brown well., Remove meatballs and reduce heat., Add onion and zucchini., Cover and cook 5 minutes., Stir in cumin, oregano, tomatoes with their juice, stock, hot pepper sauce, 1/4 teaspoon salt and 1/4 teaspoon pepper., Cover and simmer 15 minutes., Add meatballs; heat through., Sprinkle with fresh coriander.

title: Vegetable Bean Chili
directions: In a 4-quart kettle or Dutch oven, saute zucchini, green pepper, onion, carrots, celery and garlic in oil until tender. Stir in tomatoes, picante sauce, bouillon and cumin; bring to a boil. Reduce heat; simmer, uncovered, for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add beans and olives; heat through. Garnish with cheese and alfalfa sprouts, if desired. Yield: 9 servings (2 1/4 quarts).

title: Basic Meringue How-To
directions: Note:, A copper bowl is excellent for beating egg whites., The chemical reaction which occurs between copper and egg whites helps to stabilize mixture., Cream of tartar should be omitted when beating egg whites in copper bowl.

title: Pecan Pie
directions: Break 4 eggs in a bowl., Beat for several minutes with rotary eggbeater., Add brown sugar and syrup; stir well., Add pecan meats and several little pats of butter., Pour mixture into 2 pie crust shells., Sprinkle top with pecans., Bake slowly about 1 hour at 325° to 350°.

title: Quick Casserole
directions: Slice potatoes thin in a long baking dish., Add sliced onions and then sprinkle rice over this., Crumble beef over top of potatoes., Pour tomato soup over all in pan., Bake at 350° about one hour.

title: Icebox Cake
directions: Cream together sugar and butter. Add yolk of beaten egg. Add pecans and crushed pineapple. Put layer of mixture, then layer of vanilla wafers, etc. Serve with whipped cream and a cherry.

title: Dump Cake
directions: Spread cherry pie filling on bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan, then spread pineapple on top., Sprinkle on cake mix, then pour butter over top and sprinkle with coconut and nuts., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Porcupine Meatballs
directions: Wash rice., Combine meat, rice, salt, pepper and onion., Shape into small balls., Heat tomato soup and water in crock-pot., Brown meatballs., Add all to soup mixture; simmer for 1 hour.

title: Hot Apple Cider
directions: Pour 1/2 gallon apple cider into large pot., Add cinnamon sticks, cloves and orange juice., Simmer over low heat for 2 hours., Add more apple cider, as needed., Fifteen minutes before serving, garnish with orange and lemon slices.

title: Western Sour Cream Dressing
directions: Blend together all ingredients and chill., Makes 1 1/4 cups dressing.

title: Coconut Pie
directions: Mix flour and sugar well., Add egg yolks and milk., Cook over medium heat until thick, stirring frequently., When thick, add vanilla and coconut., Pour into cooked pie crust., Add meringue and brown.

title: Fresh Apple Squares
directions: Step 1:, Toss apples, sugar and spices together.

title: Pineapple Upside Down Cake
directions: Cream shortening and sugar, adding eggs one at a time. Beat in sifted flour, and pineapple syrup. Mix well. In a 9x13 pan melt butter, pour in brown sugar. Then pour in cake batter. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until done. You could place a cherry in the middle of the pineapple rings before baking.

title: Italian Cheese Pie
directions: Note:, Can top with any topping or sprinkle powdered sugar on top.

title: Punkie'S Chili
directions: Brown ground chuck., Rinse and drain., Add ingredients accordingly., Let boil then turn on simmer for 15 to 20 minutes. Use 1/4 cup green onion tops for garnish.

title: Donna Connor'S Pumpkin Bread
directions: Preheat oven to 350°. Grease 2 loaf pans.

title: Snowball Cake
directions: Dissolve unflavored gelatin in cold water., Stir in boiling water., Stir in pineapple and juice, lemon juice and salt., Chill until partially congealed.

title: Yummy Apple Pie
directions: Mix all ingredients., Pour into unbaked pie shell., Bake at 325° for 1 hour., Cool before slicing.

title: Rhubarb Cake Pudding
directions: Spread each ingredient into an oblong cake pan in order given. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Poulet
directions: Mix stuffing and margarine with water; set aside., Combine onion, celery, salt and mayonnaise., Mix well with stuffing mix.

title: Crisp Coconut Oaties
directions: Cream together butter, sugars, egg, vanilla and coconut extract., Combine all other ingredients and add to creamed mixture., Roll dough into balls., Place on greased cookie sheet, about 2 inches apart., Bake at 325° for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Chocolate Biscuits
directions: Combine dry ingredients; mix well. Add margarine and milk. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly until desired thickness. Stir in vanilla. Serve over hot biscuits.

title: Snickers Bar Cookies
directions: Cream together sugar, brown sugar and peanut butter., Add vanilla and eggs., Mix. Add baking powder, baking soda and flour. Mix well., Cut miniature Snickers in halves., Wrap around each bar half, forming a ball., Place on ungreased cookie sheet., Bake at 350° for 12 to 18 minutes.

title: Pineapple Cheese Ball
directions: Combine all ingredients, reserving 1 cup of pecans., Shape into a ball and roll in the reserved pecans.

title: Sloppy Joes
directions: Brown ground chuck and drain., Combine remaining ingredients and add to ground chuck., Simmer until hot.

title: Corn Bread
directions: Preheat oven to 400°: spray 8 inch square, 7x11, or 12 cup muffin tin with nonstick cooking spray., In a large bowl, combine the cornmeal, flour, sugar, baking powder, and the salt., In a small bowl, beat the buttermilk over the flour mixture; stir just until blended (do not overmix)., Transfer to the pan., Bake until golden brown and a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean, 20-25 minutes., Cool pan on a rack 10 minutes; serve warm. Makes 12 servings.

title: Turkey Casserole
directions: Blend flour and butter in a large pan., Add cream, soup, salt and water., Cook over low heat, stirring to thicken., Fold in remaining ingredients., Grease a 2-quart casserole., Top with bread crumbs., Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

title: Quick Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Spray cookie sheet with nonstick cooking spray., Mix all ingredients., If necessary press dough together. Drop dough by rounded teaspoonful 2 inches apart onto cookie sheet., Bake until tops are dry and edges are light brown, 8 to 10 minutes., Cool slightly; remove from cookie sheet., Cool completely., Store in airtight container.

title: Picnic Casserole
directions: Fry hamburger loosely in butter with onion; add remaining ingredients., Put in greased casserole dish., Bake slowly at 325° for 1 1/2 hours., (If uncovered a tasty crust forms.)

title: Baked Pineapple
directions: Drain pineapple, save juice., Put pineapple in baking dish. Combine flour, juice, sugar and cheese., Pour over pineapple. Combine cracker crumbs and margarine., Sprinkle over top., Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Louisiana Jambalaya
directions: Season meat generously., In a 4 to 5 quart heavy pot, heat oil., Brown meat on all sides and remove., Meat can be cut from bone or cut into smaller servings if desired.

title: Icebox Fruit Cake
directions: Heat milk and marshmallows and stir until melted., Pour over crumbled crackers and add other ingredients., Mix with hands as this is a stiff mixture., Line bowl or pan with wax paper and pack mixture in solid., Put in refrigerator and chill.

title: Microwave Diabetic Apple Cake
directions: Melt margarine in an 8-inch round microwave dish (glass preferable)., Set, aside., Mix, oil,, Equal and eggs together. In another bowl,, mix	remainder of the ingredients and add to egg mixture., Pour, into, dish	and stir or fold in the margarine. Microwave on, High	10, to	12 minutes, turning every 3 minutes.

title: Rice Casserole
directions: Cook rice by directions on package., Put in buttered casserole dish., Add other ingredients., Mix well., Bake 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Corn And Crab Bisque
directions: In a 2 gallon stockpot, melt butter over medium-high heat., Add corn, onions, celery, bell pepper and garlic., Saute five to ten minutes or until vegetables are wilted.

title: Mississippi Mud Cake
directions: Beat eggs with sugar; add remaining ingredients (except marshmallows) to eggs., Mix well and pour into greased and floured sheet cake pan., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes., While hot, cover with marshmallows., I return cake to oven until marshmallows lose their shape., Let cool.

title: Traditional Chex Party Mix
directions: Preheat oven to 250°., Heat margarine in large shallow roasting pan (about 15 x 10 x 2-inch) in oven until melted. Remove., Stir in seasoned salt and Worcestershire sauce., Add Chex cereal and nuts., Mix until all pieces are coated., Heat in oven for 1 hour., Stir every 15 minutes., Spread on absorbent paper to cool.

title: Holiday Cookies(Sugar Cookies)
directions: Mix all ingredients in mixing bowl with hands until smooth. Roll dough, one part at a time, 1/4-inch thick., Cut into desired shapes and place on cookie sheets., Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes., Let cool; decorate., Yields 3 to 4 dozen.

title: Chicken Olivia
directions: Mix all except oleo, corn flakes and almonds in large casserole dish., In frying pan, frizzle corn flakes and almonds in melted oleo for a few minutes., Spread over casserole., Bake in 350° oven for 30 minutes.

title: Nothing Cake
directions: Beat eggs slightly., Add remaining ingredients, mixing by hand., Batter is stiff., Spread into greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes., When cold, cut into squares., Don't get upset when the cake looks like it fell.

title: Banana Nut Bread
directions: Cream butter and shortening. Add dry ingredients. Add crushed bananas and nuts last. Bake in oiled loaf pan in 350° oven.

title: Squash Casserole
directions: Cook squash until tender., Drain and mash., Mix with other ingredients., Bake in oven at 350° for 20 minutes or until done or light brown.

title: Corn Pie
directions: Whip eggs thoroughly in bowl., Add sugar, flour, milk, margarine, salt and pepper., Stir in corn., Pour into buttered casserole., Set dish in pan of water about 2 inches deep., Bake at 350° for about 45 minutes or until knife blade comes out clean when tested., You also may use fresh or frozen corn.

title: Granny'S Chocolate Dessert
directions: Layer #1:, Mix flour, nuts and butter and make crust., Bake 20 minutes at 350°.

title: Grandma Wood'S Butter Sauce
directions: Mix all ingredients together and cook until thick., Serve warm over berry and fruit pies or dumplings., Yields approximately 2 1/2 cups.

title: Zucchini Bread
directions: Beat eggs, sugar and oil together., Add shredded zucchini. Add flour, soda, baking powder, cinnamon and nuts., Pour all into greased loaf pans., Bake 1 hour at 375°.

title: Chicken Pie
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., In large saucepan combine chicken, 1/2 cup of the milk, all the soup and sour cream., Bring to boil over medium heat., Remove from heat, spoon into ungreased 9 x 13-inch baking dish., In large bowl, beat remaining 3/4 cup milk, Bisquick, corn meal and butter., Pour over hot chicken, sprinkle top with cheese., Bake 25 to 30 minutes., Very fast and easy., Plus its good., Feeds about 4 to 5 people.

title: Easy Chicken Pie
directions: Preheat oven to 325°., Cook chicken in boiling, salted water to cover in saucepan until tender; drain., Cool and cut into bite size pieces., Place chicken in 9 x 12-inch baking dish., Pour mixture of soup and broth over chicken., Combine baking mix and milk in a bowl; mix well., Pour over chicken., Bake for 35 minutes., Drizzle melted butter over top., Bake for 10 minutes longer., This easy recipe can be prepared ahead and can be frozen., Yields 6 servings.

title: Peanut Bread
directions: Mix all ingredients in order given., Pour batter into greased 9 x 5-inch bread pan., Bake at 350° for 55 to 60 minutes., Test for doneness with toothpick., Cool on rack., Chill for easier slicing.

title: Frozen Salad
directions: Combine all ingredients except pineapple and oranges; mix well. Add pineapple and oranges and freeze.

title: Mary'S Goulash
directions: Cut beef into bite size cubes., Use a large iron frypan and melt oleo, then add meat, onions, paprika, salt and pepper. Brown until dark brown, stirring often. When meat is brown on all sides of cubes, add water and simmer about 35 minutes, covered with lid. Dissolve cornstarch in milk and add to mixture., Let simmer 10 minutes longer., Serve over rice, noodles or hot biscuits.

title: Chicken Liver Stroganoff
directions: Cook onions in butter until tender, not brown., Add chicken livers., Season with salt and pepper also paprika., Brown livers. Cover; cook over low heat for 10 minutes., Add sour cream; heat thoroughly., Serve over rice., Serve with Sue Tossed Salad in 1988 book, page 19.

title: Chicken Broccoli Crepes
directions: Beat eggs lightly in medium bowl., Add remaining ingredients and beat until smooth., Lightly grease crepe pan or 7 or 8-inch skillet and place over medium-high heat., Pour about 3 tablespoons of batter into pan., Tilt pan to spread batter evenly. When crepe is light brown and set, turn to brown other side. Remove and repeat to make 12 crepes.

title: Pink Lady Punch
directions: Mix cranberry and pineapple juice with sugar and chill., When ready to serve, add chilled ginger ale., Serves approximately 35.

title: Ham Potato Scallop
directions: Cut ham in bite-size pieces., Put half the potatoes in greased 2-quart casserole., Cover with ham pieces., Place remaining potatoes on top., Combine soup, milk, onion, green pepper and pepper; pour over potatoes., Dot with margarine., Bake at 350° for 1 hour; remove cover and bake 45 minutes longer or until potatoes are done., Makes 6 servings.

title: Apple Pie
directions: Make pastry for 2-crust pie; line pie plate with pastry., Fill with sliced apples. Mix sugar, flour and cinnamon; sprinkle over apples., Dot with shortening., Top with pastry., Seal edges and flute., Cover edge with aluminum foil, if desired., Bake at 425° for 50 minutes.

title: Watergate Salad
directions: Fold dry pudding mix into whipped topping., Add pineapple, juice, marshmallows and nuts., Refrigerate!

title: Squash Casserole
directions: Cut squash up and parboil until tender; drain., Add soup and onions to squash., Add several pats of margarine and salt and pepper to taste., Stir until mixed., Pour part of mixture in bottom of casserole dish., Spread crumbled Ritz crackers over mixture, then spread a layer of grated cheese., Repeat, finishing with cheese on top., Cover and bake at about 400° until bubbling through., Take cover off and let cook about 10 minutes more.

title: Cherry Angel Cream Cake
directions: Cut cake into 1/4-inch slices., Arrange half the slices on bottom of a 13 x 9-inch baking dish., In a large mixing bowl, combine milk, water and extract., Mix well. Add pudding mix and beat well., Chill 5 minutes. Fold in Cool Whip. Spread half the cream mixture over cake slices. Top evenly with 1 can cherry filling. Top with remaining cake slices, cream mixture and cherry filling. Chill 4 hours until set. Cut into squares to serve. Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., In small bowl, sift together flour, baking soda and salt., In large bowl, combine butter, sugars and vanilla extract., With wooden spoon, beat until creamy., Beat in eggs., Gradually add sifted dry ingredients., Mix well., Stir in chocolate chips and nuts., Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet., Bake in 375° oven for 8 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Honey Of A Chicken
directions: Place chicken in greased pan., Mix remaining ingredients and pour over chicken., Cover pan., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Sausage-Rice Casserole
directions: Cook rice as directed on package., Rinse and drain., Brown sausage; add onion, pepper and celery., Cook vegetables until tender., Add rice, mushrooms and soups., Pour in greased 3-quart casserole dish., Cover and bake for 1 hour at 325°.

title: Blueberry-Orange Bread
directions: Toss blueberries with 1 tablespoon flour and set aside. Combine remaining flour, 1/4 cup sugar, baking powder and salt in a bowl., Stir well and set aside., Combine egg, water, orange juice, margarine and 1 tablespoon orange rind., Add to dry ingredients, stirring well., Gently fold in berries.

title: Sugar-Free Orange-Pineapple Salad
directions: Boil water and add jello., Mix thoroughly., Add pineapple and mandarin oranges., Refrigerate until congealed.

title: Baked Hash Browns
directions: Mix 1/4 cup oleo, salt, onion, soup, sour cream and cheese. Blend well., Pour over hash browns and mix., Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan., Mix 1/4 cup oleo and cornflakes and pour over potato mixture. Bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: German Split Pea Soup
directions: Dice salt bacon and saute with onion., Pour all ingredients into a Dutch oven and cook for 6 hours., Serves 10.

title: Applesauce Bread
directions: Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy; beat in egg. Stir together flour, baking soda and spices., Gradually add to creamed mixture., Stir in applesauce, raisins and nuts., Pour into greased and floured 9 x 5-inch loaf pan., Bake at 350° for 1 hour. Cool in pan for 10 minutes; remove and cool on wire rack. Sprinkle with powdered sugar.

title: Golden Cornbread
directions: Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes., Makes a 9-inch square pan. Delicious with spaghetti or chili.

title: Chicken Dressing Casserole
directions: Boil meat, cut into chunks., (Save broth.), Mix stuffing, onions, margarine and put 1/2 in baking dish., Add meat chunks. Dilute cream of celery soup with can of chicken broth., Pour over chicken., Add another layer of each except this time use cream of chicken soup and broth.

title: Banquet Potatoes
directions: Thaw frozen hash browns until they can be broken apart and stirred., Combine first 4 ingredients and mix well., Turn into greased 9 x 13-inch pan., Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese., Bake 1 1/2 hours, uncovered, in 300° to 325° oven., Serves 12., May be made in advance and refrigerated until time to bake.

title: Millionaire Piesmakes 2 Pies
directions: Mix all ingredients well and pour into pie crusts., Let stand overnight.

title: Chocolate Pudding
directions: Put sugar and water in 2-quart pan., Cream shortening and sugar., Beat in egg., Sift dry ingredients together., Add alternately with milk., Add vanilla., Pour pudding batter into hot syrup, being careful not to mix with syrup., Cook, tightly covered, for 1 hour on medium heat., Do not take cover of kettle off while cooking pudding, or pudding will not cook right.

title: Seven-Layer Salad
directions: In a large bowl, layer the following:, lettuce, peas, celery, onion and mayonnaise., Cover mayonnaise with Parmesan cheese., Top with bacon., Cover and refrigerate approximately 8 hours prior to serving., Serves 8 to 10.

title: Cool Creamy Cucumber Salad
directions: Combine cucumbers, onion, pimento, chives and dill weed in medium size bowl., Add the salad dressing and toss.

title: Pumpkin Bread
directions: Mix all ingredients; beat well., Bake in a buttered loaf pan at 350° for 1 1/2 hours., Cool and slice.

title: Baked Ziti
directions: Brown sausage with garlic., Add Ragu sauce and tomato paste. Simmer for 2 to 3 hours., Cook 16 ounces ziti according to package instructions., In a large casserole dish, place a layer of ziti, then layer of sauce, followed by cheese., Repeat process ending with sauce., Bake, covered, for 45 minutes at 350°., Serve with Parmesan cheese.

title: Cheese Logs
directions: Mix well. Roll into 2 logs. Roll again in chopped pecans or parsley. Chill. Serve with assorted crackers.

title: Spinach Dip
directions: Thaw and squeeze spinach until dry., Combine remaining ingredients and blend well., Add spinach and blend., Chill 2 hours, covered.

title: Cheesecake
directions: Let cream cheese and eggs sit out and get room temperature. Mix cream cheese, eggs, sugar, flour, vanilla and heavy cream for 15 minutes., Mix graham crackers, sugar and oleo., Place graham cracker mixture in 10-inch spring-form pan., Pour cream cheese mixture over graham cracker crust., Bake at 500° for 12 minutes. Reduce to 250° for 45 minutes., Turn oven off (do not open oven) and leave in oven 6 hours., Cool., Remove from pan.

title: Deep Dark Chocolate Cake
directions: Heat oven to 350°. Grease and flour 2 (9-inch) baking pans in large bowl. Stir together sugar, flour, cocoa, baking powder, soda and salt. Add eggs, milk, oil and vanilla; beat on medium speed of electric mixer 2 minutes. Stir in boiling. (Batter will be thin.) Pour into prepared pans. Bake 30 to 35 minutes; cool 10 minutes. Frost with One Bowl Buttercream Frosting.

title: Bread And Butter Pickles
directions: Wash and slice cukes very thin., Slice in onions., Mix in salt. Add one quart very cold water, let stand 3 hours., Drain well and add pickling syrup of 5 cups of sugar, 1 1/2 teaspoons turmeric, 1/2 scant teaspoon cloves, 2 tablespoons mustard seed, 1 tablespoon celery seed, 4 cups vinegar, 1 cup water., Scald but do not boil. Seal in jars.

title: Hot Cinnamon Biscuits
directions: In an aluminum 9-inch or 10-inch pie pan melt butter, water, sugar and sprinkle of cinnamon over low heat., Open tube of biscuits and dip in mixture., Turn over and put on mixture., Bake at 400° for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Scallops With Tomatoes(Microwave)
directions: Pat scallops on paper toweling., Place in a microproof 1-quart casserole with onion, wine, tomato paste, tomatoes and cilantro. Toss together until well mixed. Cover with lid or vented plastic wrap and microwave on High 3 1/2 to 4 minutes or until scallops are opaque, stirring once., Sprinkle with pepper and Feta cheese. Toss together., Spoon over rice in deep bowls. Serves 2.

title: Cranberry Slush]
directions: Combine Jell-O and boiling water; let cool., Add the rest of the ingredients., Pour into freezer container and freeze.

title: Salt Rising Bread
directions: Peel and slice potatoes. Add remaining ingredients. Let stand overnight in a warm place. In the morning, when it has foam on top, remove the potatoes and discard. Add 1/4 teaspoon of soda and thicken with flour. Let rise. Add 1/2, gallon (8 cups) flour to make a sponge., Add risen mixture and let rise again. Make out into 4 loaves. Grease pans well. Bake in moderate 350° oven for 45 minutes or more.

title: Vegetable Enchiladas
directions: Simmer in covered saucepan the water, lentils and salt for 15 to 20 minutes., Drain, rinse and set aside., Stir-fry carrots and chili powder in hot oil for 2 minutes., Add zucchini; stir-fry for 2 to 3 minutes or until crisp-tender., Stir in lentils, half the undrained tomatoes and half of the cheese., Spoon vegetable mixture onto tortillas., Place, seam side down, in prepared baking dish., Cover with foil., Bake in 350° oven for 8 minutes., Remove foil., Bake for 7 to 12 minutes., Heat remaining tomatoes., Spoon over enchiladas., Top with cheese., Bake 1 minute.

title: Granny'S Beef Stroganoff
directions: Saute mushrooms and onions in 3 tablespoons butter until brown., Remove mushrooms, etc., Add 1 tablespoon of butter to pan. Brown meat. Dissolve bouillon cubes in water; pour over meat. Add tomato paste, mustard and salt. Cover and simmer 45 minutes until tender. Combine flour and water., Slowly stir into meat mixture. Cook, stirring constantly, until mixture comes to a boil., Reduce heat. Add mushrooms, onions and sour cream., Heat, but don't boil. Serve over rice.

title: Minestrone Soup
directions: Heat a large pot., Cook carrots, onion, celery and garlic in 1 cup stock until tender., Add remaining ingredients, except beans, macaroni, Tabasco and cheese., Cook until vegetables are tender. In blender or processor, process 1/2 cup garbanzo beans and 1/2 cup kidney beans until pureed., Set aside., Add remaining ingredients; simmer 10 minutes., Serve hot., Add cooked macaroni and sprinkle cheese on top.

title: Microwave Lasagna
directions: Mix tomato sauce, paste, oregano, basil, salt, garlic powder or clove garlic., Mix and spread in a 12 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish. Brown and drain ground chuck and mix with remaining sauce.

title: 7-Up Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients together and bake at 350° until done.

title: Oven-Fried Pecan Corn Meal Chicken
directions: Pound the chicken breast halves to an even thickness., Pour 1/2 cup of oil into a 9 x 13-inch baking dish and heat it in the hot oven for 10 minutes., Combine the remaining oil with the mustard, salt, pepper and paprika in a shallow bowl., Mix well., Combine the pecans and corn meal on a sheet of wax paper., Dip the chicken pieces in the seasoned oil and then in the nut mixture., Remove the pan from the oven and place the chicken pieces in the pan., Bake for 10 minutes, then turn with tongs and bake for an additional 15 minutes., Drain on paper towels and serve immediately., Serves 4 to 6.

title: Penny'S Baked Chicken
directions: Cut chicken breasts in half. Mix sour cream, lemon juice, and all seasonings. Coat chicken in the mixture. Refrigerate; allow to marinate for 8 hours or overnight. Roll chicken pieces in bread crumbs., Arrange in baking dish. Drizzle 1/4 c. melted butter over breasts. Bake 45 min. at 350° F. Drizzle another 1/2 c. melted butter over chicken and bake 15 min. longer.

title: Dutch Potato Filling
directions: Dissolve bouillon cubes in hot water., Place mashed potatoes in large bowl., Add slightly beaten eggs, bouillon cube mixture, onion, salt, pepper and parsley; blend well., Place in a 1-quart greased casserole., Bake, uncovered, in a 350° oven with chicken, or until browned on top.

title: Spinach Dip
directions: Mix together, making sure spinach is well drained., Let blend for at least 24 hours., You can hollow out round loaf and fill cavity with dip using bread as dippers.

title: Ham Roll-Ups
directions: Preheat oven to 400° (or as directed on package)., Spread out refrigerator roll into triangle shape., Spread with mustard., Top with ham, then cheese., Roll into crescent shape., Bake 12 to 15 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Greek Vinaigrette
directions: Combine ingredients in a jar with a screw-top lid., Shake well to mix., Store in refrigerator, covered, for up to two weeks.

title: Mexican Meat Filling
directions: In large skillet cook ground chuck, onion, garlic and cayenne over medium-high heat, stirring often until meat is no longer pink, about 5 minutes., Add chili powder, cumin and salt., Cook 1 minute., Add tomato sauce and cook, stirring often, until thickened, about 5 minutes.

title: Easy No Crust Pie
directions: Mix all ingredients together in a blender or electric mixer and pour in a 10-inch, buttered Pyrex pie pan., Bake for 1 hour at 325°., This will bake to a delicious crust and a toasted coconut top.

title: Quick Cobbler
directions: Melt margarine in large cake pan., Mix sugar, flour and milk together., Pour over melted margarine., Heat fruit, such as apples, peaches or strawberries; pour over batter and bake at 350° until brown.

title: Fruit Cheese Ball
directions: Roll in sliced almonds., Serve with Escort crackers.

title: Fried Ice Cream
directions: Dip ice cream in, egg,, then, roll, in crushed cookies. Repeat. Freeze at least 24 hours before frying. Deep fry for 1 minute.

title: Strawberry Freezer Jam
directions: Pour sugar over berries; stir., Let stand while you prepare the Sure-Jell., Boil Sure-Jell and water for 1 minute at rolling boil., Pour over berries and stir for 3 or 4 minutes., Put in jars and freeze.

title: Stuffed Jumbo Shells And Tofu
directions: Cook, drain and rinse shells., Combine remaining ingredients except spaghetti sauce and the extra Parmesan cheese., Spread 1/2 cup spaghetti sauce in bottom of shallow baking dish., Fill shells with tofu mix and place in single layer in baking dish., Top with remaining sauce and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese., Bake at 375° for 25 minutes or until hot and bubbly., Makes 6 servings. Calories 277.

title: Microwave Sugar Glazed Nuts
directions: Mix sugar and sour cream in large microwave bowl., Microwave on High a total of 7 minutes, 2 minutes and stir, 3 minutes and stir, 2 minutes and stir., Add vanilla and nuts., Mix well and spread onto waxed paper., Separate as mixture cools.

title: Fudge Brownie Pie
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., Bake pastry shell for 10 minutes. Remove from oven. Reduce oven temperature to 325°.

title: Buttermilk Pound Cake
directions: Cream shortening; add sugar gradually., Add eggs one at a time, beating each time., Add vanilla., Add soda to buttermilk. Add flour and milk alternately to other ingredients., Bake in tube pan at 325° for 1 1/2 hours., This cake can be frozen., It is good plain and/or frosted.

title: Dinner Salad
directions: Chop broccoli, cauliflower, lettuce and tomatoes. Place the vegetables in a large mixing bowl., Grate carrots and add to vegetable mixture., Stir in cheese and meat., If adding the hard-boiled eggs, slice them and mix into vegetables. Mix with Miracle Whip and refrigerate 1 hour., Serve with crackers or toast.

title: Fruit Pizza
directions: Press cookie dough in greased pizza pan., Bake and cool. Cream together the cream cheese and powdered sugar., Spread on crust., Layer fruits and top with cherry pie filling.

title: Baked Seafood Rice Salad
directions: Combine first 9 ingredients., Put in shallow 2 quart casserole and sprinkle with cheese., Bake at 350° for 25 minutes., Makes 6 servings.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
directions: Mix well and place in a greased casserole dish.

title: Lemon Pie
directions: Mix ingredients and pour into pie shell., Refrigerate.

title: German Chocolate Upside-Down Cake
directions: Mix together pecan pieces and coconut., Place in buttered 9 x 13-inch sheet cake pan. Mix box of German chocolate cake mix according to package directions., Spread over nut/coconut mixture.

title: Pineapple Chess Pie
directions: Mix all together and pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350° until done.

title: Cheese Ball
directions: Soften cream cheese and blend with remaining ingredients, except pecans., Chill., Roll in chopped pecans just before serving.

title: Cutout Cookies
directions: Combine shortening and butter., Add sugar, then beat in egg. Add salt, almond and vanilla extract., Last, add flour 1 cup at a time., Place cookies on ungreased cookie sheet and bake at 375° for 9 minutes or until edges brown.

title: Spaghetti Carbonara
directions: Finely chop Prosciutto and cook in 4 Tbsp. butter., Cook until crisp (can do ahead and reheat).

title: Pineapple Upside-Down Cake
directions: Melt 3 tablespoons butter in a 9-inch layer pan. Spread butter evenly. Sprinkle brown sugar over butter. Arrange fruits and nuts in sugar mixture., Mix 1/3 cup butter with granulated sugar until creamy. Add egg and vanilla. Beat well., Mix flour, baking powder and salt thoroughly. Add to creamy mixture alternately with pineapple liquid. Spread batter over fruit in pan., Bake at 350° for 35 minutes or until cake springs back with touched lightly. Cool a few minutes in the pan., Loosen cake from sides of pan and invert on serving plate.

title: German Potato Salad(Kartoffelsalat)
directions: *The amount of potatoes used for this tangy hot potato salad will determine the number of servings.

title: Peach Crumble Pie
directions: Line pie shell with plain pastry., Trim; let rest 10 minutes, then flute edge., Do not prick., Combine sugar, flour, salt and cinnamon., Add butter and work with fingertips until crumbly., Add 1/2 of this mixture to the peaches., Mix lightly and turn into pie shell., Sprinkle the rest of the crumbly mixture over top of peaches., Bake at 425° for 30 to 35 minutes or until peaches are cooked., Cool 2 or 3 hours on rack before cutting., Serves 5.

title: Teriyaki Steak Marinade
directions: Mix together., Pour over meat., Marinate several hours or overnight., Barbecue or broil meat.

title: Creamy Parmesan Dressing
directions: Combine all ingredients until smooth. Cover & Chill. Makes 1 1/4 cups.

title: Libby Danti'S Sauce With Sausage
directions: In a large pot, mix tomatoes, seasonings, wine and water. Stir and simmer 10 minutes., In skillet, fry sausage and remove from pan., Leave a small amount of oil in pan., Saute onions and mushrooms. When cool, cut sausage in slices. Add to skillet., Stir and simmer 5 minutes., Add to large pot. Bring to a boil., Lower heat and let simmer slowly, covered, 1 hour., Uncover and continue cooking for 1 to 1 1/2 hours at low heat., If sauce is too thick, add more water to your taste., Stir occasionally during cooking.

title: Apple Nut Cake
directions: Combine apples and sugar., Beat eggs with vanilla and oil and mix with apples., Sift flour, baking soda, cinnamon and salt. Combine with apple/egg mixture., Blend in nuts; spoon into an 11 x 14 x 2-inch pan and bake 1 hour at 350°.

title: Breakfast Pizza
directions: Grease a 9 x 13-inch sheet cake pan., Fry sausage, crumbled. Press biscuits into bottom of pan until covered., Sprinkle frozen hash brown potatoes over biscuits., Sprinkle sausage over hash browns., Beat eggs real well with a little milk., Pour eggs over mixture., Sprinkle Cheddar cheese over top., Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Aunt Fanny'S Baked Squash
directions: Wash and cut up squash., Boil until tender., Drain thoroughly, then mash., Add all ingredients, except 1/2 of the butter to squash., Melt remaining butter., Pour mixture into baking dish, then spread melted butter over top and sprinkle with crumbs., Bake in a 375° oven for approximately 1 hour or until brown on top.

title: Revival Goulash
directions: Saute onion and bell pepper in small amount of oil., Add ground beef; cook until brown. Add soup and cheese., Use 1/2 can of water to rinse can out., Add to drained cooked noodles., Pour into large baking dish., Bake at 350° until hot., Freezes well.

title: Chicken And Vegetable Rice Soup
directions: Put chicken broth in large pot with vegetable base., Simmer on low., Next, add all vegetables and cooked rice., Stir occasionally and cook, covered, for 1 hour or until vegetables are tender.

title: Wendy'S 3 Layer Quick Dip
directions: Soften cream cheese; spread in bottom of dish., Add salsa. Sprinkle cheese on top of salsa., Heat in microwave for 1 minute. Serve with tortilla chips., Enjoy!!

title: Chili-Mac Skillet
directions: Drain kidney beans., In a large skillet, cook meat and onion until meat is brown., Drain fat., Stir in beans, tomato sauce, undrained tomatoes, uncooked pasta, green chilies, chili powder, garlic salt and 1/4 cup water., Bring to boiling; reduce heat. Cover., Simmer 20 minutes, stirring often., Top with cheese. Cover., Heat 2 minutes or until cheese melts., Serves six.

title: One Pan Chicken And Gravy
directions: Mix all together the soups and pour over chicken in a 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until chicken is cooked. Any form or amount of chicken may be used.

title: Spiced Beef With Dumplings
directions: Trim excess fat from roast and melt the fat in a Dutch oven. Brown roast on all sides in the fat., Add 1/4 cup water and the remaining ingredients except biscuits, parsley and flour., Cover and simmer for 2 1/2 hours., Place biscuits on roast and sprinkle with parsley., Cover tightly and steam for 15 minutes., Remove roast and dumplings to platter., Add flour and 1/4 cup water to pan juices., Stir until thickened., Serve with roast.

title: Cousin Sallie'S Gingerbread
directions: Sift flour with baking soda, salt and spices., Combine shortening, sugar and molasses in mixing bowl and beat to blend. Add eggs; beat until thoroughly blended., Add dry ingredients, beat until smooth., All vinegar and milk, and stir until thoroughly blended., Pour into greased 9 x 9 inch pan., Bake at 350 degrees 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Slaw Dressing
directions: Mix sugar, flour, mustard, vinegar, sour cream and eggs together., Cook slightly., Stir constantly until dressing is creamy.

title: Rice Casserole
directions: Rinse and drain rice, sprinkle with salt and pepper., Pour 1 c. tomato juice over rice, then sprinkle with the onion, pepper, and celery (if wanted)., Then the meat, water, and 1 1/2 c. tomato juice., Cut the bacon in 1/2 and put on top., Cover and bake at 350°F for 1 hour., Uncover and bake for another 1/2 hour or until bacon is crisp.

title: Whole Wheat Bubble Loaf
directions: Generously grease one 2 qt. deep casserole dish or two 8 x 4 in. loaf pans., Lightly spoon flour into measuring cup; level off. In large bowl combine 1 c. bread flour, sugar, salt and yeast - blend well., In small sauce pan, heat milk and margarine until very warm (120 to 130 degrees)., Add warm liquid and egg to flour mixture., Blend at low speed until moistened; beat 3 minutes at med. speed., By hand, stir in whole wheat flour to form a stiff dough., On floured surface knead in 1 to 1 1/2 c. bread flour until dough is smooth and elastic about 10 minutes., Place in greased bowl; cover loosely with plastic wrap and cloth towel. Let rise in a warm place until light and doubled in size, about 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

title: London Broil
directions: Combine wine, soy sauce, garlic, ginger and parsley in baking dish., Marinate meat for 1 1/2 to 2 hours., Broil for 30 to 35 minutes at 550°, turning every 5 minutes., Baste with mixture at each turn.

title: Hot Dog Hash
directions: Combine potatoes and onion., Sprinkle on flour, salt and pepper., Add milk and hot dogs., Put in shallow baking dish., Dot with butter., Bake for 30 minutes at 425°., Top with cheese until melted.

title: Chocolate Heaven
directions: Combine flour, oleo and nuts and press in thin layer into 9 x 12-inch pan., Bake at 350° about 15 minutes., Let cool, then let chill in refrigerator., Combine softened cream cheese, powdered sugar and Cool Whip., Spread evenly over chilled crust and return to refrigerator., Mix instant pudding with milk and vanilla., Beat until thick and spread over cream cheese mixture., Chill., Top with remainder of Cool Whip., Will keep 4 to 5 days in refrigerator.

title: Party Sandwiches
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Add ham and Swiss cheese. Split rolls and fill with mixture., Wrap in foil and bake in 350° oven for 15 minutes., Makes 48 sandwiches.

title: Low-Fat Chocolate Fudge
directions: Boil cream, butter and sugar for 5 minutes (start time when bubbling)., Then add marshmallow cream and then add other ingredients., The strained prunes make this very creamy., Let set for 2 hours.

title: Chicken Enchiladas
directions: Dip each tortilla in hot grease just to soften., On each tortilla put some chicken, onion and cheese., Roll up and place in 9 x 13-inch pan which has been sprayed with nonstick spray., Mix the soup, milk and chilies and pour over the enchiladas., Top with additional onions and cheese., Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes or until hot.

title: Green Rice Casserole
directions: Place all ingredients in greased baking dish., Bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Sourdough Biscuits
directions: Dissolve yeast in warm water., Add sugar, oil and room temperature buttermilk., Stir together well (be sure oil is well blended when adding flour)., Add 4 cups flour and mix well., Then add 5 cups flour (more if needed), salt, baking powder and soda; mix well., Dough is ready to bake., Seal mixture in an airtight container and refrigerate!

title: Thai Ribbons
directions: Soak 30 (6-inch) bamboo skewers., Combine teriyaki sauce, ginger, oil, garlic and red pepper., Cut steak across grain into 1/4-inch thick slices., Place meat in plastic bag., Pour marinade over steak and marinate in bag up to 2 hours., Thread slices on bamboo skewers., Place on rack in broiler pan 3 to 4-inches from heat., Broil 2 minutes on each side., Sprinkle with sesame seed. (Can substitute chicken or pork.)

title: Fresh Vegetable Marinate
directions: Remove flowerets from broccoli, cut into bite-size pieces. Break cauliflower into flowerets., Combine broccoli and cauliflower with mushrooms, pepper and celery., Toss lightly. Combine remaining ingredients; mix well and pour over vegetables. Chill and serve.

title: Pickled Cukes
directions: Soak cukes in lime water overnight (cover)., Drain and wash 3 times in cold water., Soak 2 hours in salt water., Drain and wash 3 times in cold water., Dissolve alum in warm water., Add enough cold water to cover cukes., Add cukes and bring to a boil., Drain and wash 3 times in cold water., Mix sugar, vinegar and spices. Add cukes and bring to a boil, turn down heat and simmer 30 minutes., Pack in hot jars., Yield: 12 pints.

title: Peanut Butter Temptations
directions: Mix all ingredients, but peanut butter cups., Roll into balls. Place in greased T-cup tins., Bake 10 minutes at 375°. Take, out of oven; insert peanut butter cups immediately., Let cool.	Remove from tins.

title: Chocolate Caramel Pecan Fudge
directions: In a saucepan over low heat, melt chocolate chips with milk and salt., Remove from heat; stir in nuts, caramel topping and vanilla., Spread evenly in a foil-lined 8 or 9 inch pan., Chill 2 hours or until firm., Turn fudge onto cutting board; peel off foil and cut into squares., Makes about 2 pounds.

title: Shrimp Ball
directions: Mix and form into ball and chill.

title: Potato Onion Casserole
directions: In a 9X13 baking dish, layer onions, potatoes, Velveeta. Repeat onions and potatoes., Salt and pepper., Pour soup over all and top with grated cheese., (soup may be diluted with 1/3 cup milk.) Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours., Test potatoes for doneness.

title: Pull Apart Cake (Breakfast Or Brunch)
directions: Make night before., Cover with plastic wrap to allow dough to thaw and rise., Leave on counter overnight and bake in the morning., Grease Bundt or angel food cake pan., Sprinkle some of the pecans and all the granulated sugar in pan., Place frozen dough balls evenly on top of pecans and sugar., Sprinkle cinnamon and pudding evenly on top., Melt brown sugar and butter together and spoon over dough., (Do not pour over dough.), Add remaining pecans., Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes., Allow to set for 10 minutes before removing from pan., Flip rolls onto a serving dish.

title: Hamburger And Beans
directions: Brown hamburger., Sprinkle with garlic salt, chili powder, salt and pepper., Put beans in casserole dish., Sprinkle with brown sugar, Worcestershire and ketchup., Stir., Add hamburger and mix., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Italian Pot Roast
directions: In a 4 1/2-quart Dutch oven, brown roast., Drain off fat., Add water, bouillon, oregano, basil, bay leaves, garlic and 1/8 teaspoon pepper., Bring to a boil., Reduce heat., Simmer, covered, 25 to 30 minutes or until vegetables are done.

title: Chow Mein
directions: Brown beef., Add remaining ingredients and bring to a boil. Pour into casserole., Cover and bake at 375° for 1 hour.

title: Chocolatetown Pie
directions: Prepare pastry shell; set aside., Heat oven to 350°., In small mixer, bowl cream butter; add eggs and vanilla., Combine sugar and, flour;, add, to creamed mixture., Stir in chocolate chips and nuts; pour into unbaked pastry shell., Bake 45 to 50 minutes or, until, golden., Cool, about, 1, hour., Serve warm. Garnish with whipped cream.

title: Watergate Cake
directions: Mix all together with mixer and fold in 1/2 cup nuts, if desired., Bake at 350° for 40 minutes or until done.

title: Quick Beef Stroganoff
directions: Brown ground beef; drain., Cut up and add the cream cheese to the meat; stir until melted., Add the mushroom soup and 1 can of water to the mixture., (Use less water, if desired.), Heat through until well blended and hot., Serve over cooked noodles.

title: Divinity Candy
directions: Combine water and sugar., Boil to 265° (hard ball stage)., Beat egg whites stiff and gradually beat into boiling syrup., Whip until it begins to stiffen., Add vanilla and nuts., Drop on wax paper. Makes about 150 pieces.

title: Earthquake Cake
directions: Grease 13 x 9-inch cake pan with butter (very heavily). Sprinkle pecans and coconut in pan., Mix cake mix as usual., Add sugar, cream cheese, butter and vanilla to cake mix., Mix and pour in pan., Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes., Let cool.

title: Oven Apple Pancakes
directions: With whisk or beater, beat eggs, milk, salt and flour until smooth., Let the batter rest., Combine the sugar and cinnamon, and sprinkle over the apples; toss to mix., Generously butter two 9 inch pie pans, using about 2 Tbsp. for each pan., Divide apples evenly between the pans., Stir the batter and pour it over the apples, using 1 c. per pan., Bake at 375° 30-40 minutes, or until pancakes are fluffed, golden brown, and set., Serve hot in wedges topped with whipped cream.

title: Mexican Corn
directions: Combine all ingredients except cheese and chilies., Mix well. Pour 1/2 corn mixture into a greased long casserole dish. Sprinkle chilies over mixture., Top with 1/2 cheese., Repeat corn mixture and cheese., Bake, uncovered, at 350° until set, about 45 minutes., It thickens some as it cools.

title: French Coconut Pie
directions: Add sugar to butter and heat., Add eggs, one at a time., Add coconut, vinegar and vanilla., Stir well and put in unbaked pie shell., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Macaroni Salad(For Large Gathering)
directions: Cook macaroni., Drain and let cool. Cut cheese, tomatoes, cucumbers and bell peppers in little cubes., Mix this with cooled macaroni, relish and Miracle Whip to taste., (Original recipe did not list quantities or ingredients.)

title: Winter Vegetable Chowder
directions: In small bowl, cover tomatoes with boiling water; let stand 5 minutes., In large saucepan, over medium-high heat, bring broth and 1/2 cup water to boil., Add potatoes; return to boil., Cover and cook over low heat for 12 minutes, or just until tender., With slotted spoon, remove 1 cup potatoes; set aside., Transfer contents of saucepan to blender; puree until smooth., Pour mixture back into saucepan.

title: Swedish Apple Pie
directions: Place apples in a 10-inch pie plate., Sprinkle with the mixture of 1 tablespoon sugar and 1 teaspoon cinnamon., Melt the butter in a pot., Add the flour, sugar, egg and walnuts., Spoon over the apples., Bake at 350° for 50 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Beef Stroganoff
directions: Combine all ingredients except sour cream., Stir in sour cream just before serving., Serve over rice or noodles.

title: Spritz Cookies
directions: Heat oven to 400°., In large bowl, cream the powdered sugar, butter, vanilla and egg until light and fluffy., Stir in flour and salt; blend well., Fill cookie press; press dough into desired shapes onto ungreased cookie sheets., Bake for 5 to 7 minutes, or until lightly browned on edges., Immediately remove from cookie sheets., Makes approximately 5 dozen cookies.

title: Margaret'S Eclair Cake
directions: Mix pudding, Cool Whip and milk., Layer 9 x 13-inch pan with graham crackers, then with pudding mixture; alternate twice, ending with crackers., Pour chocolate sauce over all., Refrigerate.

title: Mom'S Pineapple Millionaire Pie
directions: Cream powdered sugar and oleo., Add eggs, salt and vanilla. Beat until light and fluffy., Spread mixture evenly into pie crusts., Then chill., Whip the cream until stiff., Blend in powdered sugar., Fold in pineapple and pecans., Spread over top of base mixture and chill thoroughly.

title: Cauliflower Patties
directions: Cook cauliflower; drain and mash., Add other ingredients; mix well., Let stand about 1 hour before cooking., Drop by tablespoons into hot oil and cook until golden brown on both sides., Can be frozen and then reheated as you need them.

title: Sausage Squares
directions: Combine the biscuit mix and 2 tablespoons of mayonnaise. Spread in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish., Brown sausage in skillet. Add onion and cook until tender; drain well., Spread sausage mixture over first layer., Combine egg, grated cheese and 2 tablespoons of mayonnaise., Spread over top of sausage mixture. Press lightly., Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes. Cook about 10 minutes before cutting into squares.

title: Alessa'S Cornbread Salad
directions: Combine salad dressing mix, sour cream and mayonnaise., Set aside., Place half of crumbled cornbread in a large bowl., Top with half of beans., In a medium bowl, combine tomatoes, pepper and onions; layer half of this mixture over beans., Layer half of cheese, bacon, corn and reserved salad dressing., Repeat layers, using remaining ingredients., Garnish as desired.

title: German Apple Pudding Cake
