directions: Mix apples and sugar together., Let stand until sugar is thoroughly dissolved., Add eggs and mix well., Sift dry ingredients together., Stir into apple mixture., Add nuts, raisins, and vanilla., Pour into 8 X 8 inch pan which is slightly oiled., Bake at 375° for 40 - 45 minutes., If preferred use unsweetened can sliced apples instead of fresh apples.

title: Good N Easy Crawfish Jambalaya
directions: Mix all ingredients well., Put in rice cooker., After cooker chimes, let jambalaya set on warm for 30 minutes before serving. May use shrimp instead of crawfish.

title: Banana Cream Supreme
directions: Crush crackers and combine with butter and sugar., Press in bottom and up sides of 9-inch spring-form pan., Combine whipped topping, pudding and sour cream., Pour half of filling over crust. Slice bananas and layer on top., Pour remaining filling over bananas, then sprinkle chopped pecans over top.

title: Pumpkin Pie
directions: Pour in 9-inch unbaked pie shell and bake for 20 minutes at 400°., Reduce to 350° and finish baking., When it doesn't wiggle in the center, it is done or when a knife inserted in the center comes out clean (about 20 to 25 minutes).

title: Copper Carrots
directions: Scrape carrots., Cut into 1/4-inch diagonal slices., Simmer carrots, green pepper and onion in small amount of water over low heat until carrots are tender; drain., Combine remaining ingredients and pour over vegetables., Refrigerate several days before serving.

title: Italian "S" Cookies
directions: Sift together flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt. Beat eggs., Add sugar, vanilla, lemon rind and shortening., Mix into bowl with flour to form a soft dough.

title: Ella Davis' Russian Tea Cakes
directions: Cream butter and 10x sugar., Add next 3 ingredients., Roll into balls., Bake at 400° for 14 to 17 minutes., Roll in 10x sugar while warm and again when cool.

title: Chicken Surprise
directions: Wrap each piece of chicken in a piece of bacon., Put each piece of chicken on 2 slices of dried beef in a casserole dish. Use one so the chicken fits snug in the dish., Mix 1 can cream of mushroom soup and 1 cup sour cream together and spread over chicken., Bake at 250 degrees for 5 hours uncovered.

title: Bourbon Pecan Chicken
directions: Whisk together mustard, sugar, bourbon, soy sauce and Worcestershire sauce., Set aside.

title: Cheezy Bacon Potatoes
directions: Boil potatoes and cut in small pieces; add margarine and milk., Mix until soupy., Add onions, green onions and parsley; mix., Add bacon, salt and pepper., Bake at 425 degrees for 20 to 30 minutes until perfect consistency., Melt cheese on top for last 5 to 10 minutes., Serves 25.

title: Georgetown Red Rice
directions: Cook bacon, remove from pan and crumble., Cook onions in bacon fat until tender, then add red tomatoes, rice, broth, catsup, seasonings and crumbled bacon., Cook on low heat until rice is done., Stir several times during cooking.

title: Tomato Soup
directions: Heat milk in one pan., Heat tomatoes, tomato soup, butter, flour (mix first in some of the tomatoes) and salt in another pan. When hot, add pinch of soda., When both milk and tomato mixture are hot, mix together.

title: 5 Flavor Pound Cake
directions: Cream butter, shortening and sugar until light and fluffy. Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each one., Combine flour and baking powder., Add to creamed mixture alternately with milk., Stir in flavorings., Bake at 325° for 1 1/2 hours in a 10-inch tube pan.

title: Lazy Cobbler
directions: Melt margarine in baking dish or pan., Mix flour, sugar and milk together., Pour over melted margarine., Add vanilla to sweetened fruit., Pour over batter., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Wassail(Kids Love It!)
directions: Cut orange into eighths, and pierce with whole cloves., Put all ingredients in a crock-pot., Cover., Cook one hour on high, then four hours on low., Makes 12 servings., Can be doubled for a six-quart crock-pot.

title: Cheese Fries
directions: Bake French fries as directed on package., Fry bacon; pinch into small pieces., When fries are baked, pour Ranch dressing on them, then add cheese and top with bacon pieces., Place back in oven until cheese is melted.

title: Fresh Corn And Tomatoes With Curry
directions: Shuck the corn., With knife, cut kernels off cobs., There should be about 2 1/2 cups., Core the tomatoes and cut into 1/2-inch cubes., Melt butter into skillet., Add the scallions and curry powder., Cook, stirring briefly, until wilted., Add the corn, tomatoes, salt and pepper., Stir and cook for 4 minutes over medium to high heat., Do not overcook., Serve hot., Sprinkle with coriander., Yields 4 servings.

title: Barbecued Beans
directions: Chop pepper, celery and onion., Cook until done, then add pork and beans, catsup and brown sugar.

title: Strawberry Punch
directions: Combine first 10 ingredients in punch bowl., Float sherbet in punch.

title: Life'S Recipe
directions: Mix these thoroughly and add tears of joy, sorrow and sympathy for others., Flavor with little gifts and kindly service. Fold in 4 cups of prayer and faith to lighten the other ingredients and raise the texture to a great height of Christian living., After pouring all this into your daily life, bake well with the heat of human kindness., Serve it with a smile.

title: Jello Salad
directions: Mix jello according to directions., Beat in cream cheese., Add pineapple after draining., Add nuts, if you want., Sprinkle marshmallow topping on top., Chill until firm., Any flavor of jello and fruit combination could be substituted.

title: Frijoles Ala Charra
directions: *Add more if desired.

title: Boiled Dressing
directions: Mix dry ingredients., Add vinegar, lemon juice, water, butter or oleo., Cook on low heat until thickened, stirring., Add beaten yolks and cook 1 minute., Remove from heat., Cool., Refrigerate.

title: Pumpkin Cake
directions: Cream sugar with shortening., Add three eggs, one at a time, beating between each addition., Add soda, salt, vanilla, cinnamon, nutmeg and pumpkin., Add flour and beat well., Cook in a greased and floured tube or Bundt pan for 1 hour at 350°.

title: Creamy Cherry Dessert
directions: Mix melted oleo and graham cracker crumbs in a bowl., Then press into 13 x 9 x 2-inch bowl or pan., Combine softened cream cheese (8 ounces and 3 ounces) milk and vanilla in a medium bowl. Beat until smooth., Spread the following in order over crust: cream cheese mixture, whipped topping and cherry pie filling. Chill several hours., Cut into squares to serve.

title: French Chicken
directions: Cover bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan with rice; add broth plus water if needed., Layer chicken over rice., Mix soup, sour cream and poppy seed., Pour over chicken., Top with crushed Ritz crackers., Pour melted butter over top., Bake at 325° for 1 hour.

title: Beach Party Punch
directions: Pour all ingredients into punch bowl with ice ring., Garnish with orange slices and cherries.

title: Scalloped Chicken
directions: Mix first 10 ingredients and put into a greased casserole dish. Cover with 1 can cream of mushroom soup., Bake at 325° for 1 hour, then sprinkle with grated cheese and return to oven for another 10 minutes.

title: Spinach Balls
directions: Cook spinach according to directions on package and drain well. Combine spinach with other ingredients and shape into bite size balls. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

title: Crab Nibbles
directions: Mix first 4 ingredients and microwave until cheese is melted. Spread mixture on muffin halves., Bake in 350° oven until slightly brown.

title: Great Grandma Lockerbie'S Scones
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Bake in skillet on top of stove, slowly, until done.

title: Ramen Noodle Cole Slaw
directions: Mix oil, sugar and chicken flavor packet in microwavable bowl for 1 minute in microwave. Add vinegar and stir well. Just before serving, mix first 4 ingredients together. Add Ramen noodles by breaking them up in mixture. Do not cook noodles. Pour the dressing mixture over and stir well. Serve immediately.

title: No Fail Pie Crust
directions: Mix in bowl., Roll out between 2 sheets wax paper., Makes 2 crusts.

title: Green Salad
directions: Mix Jell-O as directed on package. When it begins to set, add rest of the ingredients. Mix well. Let set. Serve on lettuce with mayonnaise and crackers.

title: Cinnamon Hard Candy
directions: Cook sugar, water, corn syrup and food coloring to very hard crack stage (300°)., Add oil of cinnamon; stir slightly to mix in oil., Pour onto well-greased cookie sheet, cool., Crack into pieces., Dust with powdered sugar.

title: Coconut Pie
directions: Melt butter with 1 cup of milk., Let sugar and remaining milk come to a boil, then add other ingredients and stir until thick.

title: Margaret'S Favorite Meat Loaf
directions: In a medium bowl, lightly mix ground meat, bread crumbs, onion, 1/2 (4 ounces) tomato sauce, egg, salt and pepper., Shape into loaf in shallow baking pan. Combine remaining tomato sauce with rest of the ingredients., Pour over loaf., Bake at 350° for 1 1/4 hours. Baste loaf several times., Makes 5 to 6 servings.

title: Butterscotch Cake
directions: Make pudding according to directions., Cool slightly., Pour into cake mix; add eggs and blend well., Pour into well-greased 9 x 13-inch cake pan., Sprinkle on butterscotch chips and nuts generously., Bake at 350° for 10 to 15 minutes or until done. This is a time saving recipe.

title: Re-Baked Stuffed Potatoes
directions: Scrub potatoes and grease with corn oil., Bake for 5 minutes in microwave or 20 minutes in 400° oven., Test with fork for tenderness., Wrap in foil and set aside.

title: Fried Cheese Ball
directions: Mix Cheddar cheese, flour, salt and cayenne pepper., Add egg whites., Shape into small balls and roll in fine cracker crumbs. Fry in deep oil at 375° until golden., Serve hot.

title: Velveeta Salsa Dip
directions: Stir Velveeta and salsa in saucepan over low heat until Velveeta is melted., Stir in cilantro., Serve hot with tortilla chips or vegetable dippers., Makes 3 cups.

title: Shrimp Spread - Blender
directions: Put onion, garlic, lemon rind, vinegar, ginger, salt and chili powder in blender jar and blend until finely chopped. Toss in shrimp a few at the time. Mix in sour cream until spreading consistency.

title: Scallops And Parsley Sauce
directions: Heat butter and oil in heavy, large skillet over medium-high heat until butter is melted., Add scallions and 1/2 cup parsley; cook 5 minutes, or until scallions are softened but not burned. Add wine; cook 2 minutes., Add scallops., Reduce heat to low; simmer, covered, for 4 to 5 minutes, or until scallops are opaque. Stir in remaining parsley; season to taste with salt and pepper. Pour over spaghetti; toss gently to mix., Serves 4 to 6.

title: Homemade Chocolate Ice Cream
directions: Combine all ingredients and put in freezer filling the rest of the way with milk to fill line.

title: Amish Bread Starter
directions: Stir every day for 7 days.

title: Sausage Jambalaya
directions: In a large skillet, heat the oil over medium-high heat and saute onion, bell pepper and parsley until onion is clear. Stirring, add the tomato sauce, garlic, mint and wine, then add rice, hot sauce, smoked sausage and enough water to cover the rice by about 1 inch., Cook until most of the water is gone., Reduce heat, cover and simmer for 1 hour; don't lift the lid until it has been simmering for 45 minutes., This makes a red jambalaya., Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Granola
directions: Mix first 4 ingredients., Add sweet rice syrup, ice water and olive oil and mix., Spread in deep, oblong baking dish, sprayed with Pam., Bake at 225° for 1 1/2 hours., Add pecans, walnuts and almonds., Mix and continue to bake 1/2 hour longer., Add raisins and chopped dates., Mix and cool., Store in Ziploc bags.

title: Oriental Rice Casserole
directions: Brown beef, celery and onions., Drain off excess fat., Mix in mushrooms, water chestnuts, bamboo shoots and soy sauce. Dissolve bouillon cubes in hot water; stir in mushroom soup., Add to beef mixture., Stir in rice., Place in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake, uncovered, for 1 hour at 350°., Serves 6 to 8., Delicious.

title: Meatballs(For Macaroni Sauce)
directions: Mix, ingredients, well	and, roll into small meatballs. Let 1/2, wedge of lard or some Crisco melt in frying pan., Put in meatballs, let brown on all sides and remove.

title: Creamy Cauliflower Soup
directions: Cook potatoes in broth., Chop celery and add., When potatoes are almost done, add cauliflower and cook until tender., The potatoes must be very well cooked, otherwise soup will be gluey.

title: Bread Pudding
directions: Put scalded milk in breadcrumbs., Add 4 egg yolks, sugar, butter and grated rind of lemon., Bake in 325° oven for 35 minutes., Beat egg whites into confectioners sugar until stiff. Spread over bread pudding to seal., Set into a 350° oven for 12 to 14 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Easy Potato Soup
directions: In a large pot, put potatoes and water. Bring to rolling boil. Add salt, pepper, celery salt and onion flakes., Simmer for 10 minutes, then add butter or margarine. Cook until potatoes are tender.

title: Rich Pecan Pie
directions: Heat oven to 375°., Combine syrup, margarine and sugar in saucepan., Bring to boil; boil gently 5 minutes, uncovered, stirring occasionally., Cool slightly., Place pecans in pie shell. Mix eggs, vanilla and salt in bowl., Gradually stir in cooled syrup mixture., Pour over pecans in pie shell., Bake 35 to 40 minutes or until knife inserted near center comes out clean., Cool on wire rack.

title: Cheddar Cheese Sauce
directions: In a saucepan melt margarine., Stir in flour and salt., Add milk. Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly., Cook and stir for one minute more., Add cheese, stir until melted., Makes 2 cups.

title: Unbaked Chocolate Oatmeal Drops
directions: Boil margarine, sugar and milk for 1 1/2 minutes., Pour over remaining ingredients in large bowl., Drop by teaspoonfuls on wax paper., Let cool, then refrigerate.

title: Dill Pickles
directions: Pack small firm cucumbers in jars., For each jar, add 1 button of garlic and 1 umbrella of dill or 1 tablespoon of whole dill seed., Boil water, vinegar and salt (not iodize) for 3 minutes. Pour over pickles while hot., (To make sure jars are sealed, can put in cold pack for few minutes.), Let stand for 4 to 6 weeks before use.

title: Shrimp Cheese Turnovers
directions: Cut butter and cream cheese into flour until mixture resembles coarse crumbs., Work with hands to form ball., Cover and chill 1 hour., On floured surface, roll half into 11-inch circle., Cut into rounds with 2-inch floured cutter., Spread each round with about 1/2 teaspoon of cheese spread., Top with a few shrimp., Fold in half and seal.

title: Special K Bars
directions: Put the cereal in a large bowl., Bring sugar, syrup and oleo to a boil; boil 1 minute., Remove from heat and add peanut butter; stir thoroughly and pour over flakes., Mix. Spread in greased 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Lemon Chicken
directions: Once the fat has been removed from the chicken, place the chicken in ovenware container., Season., Add lemon juice and the chicken broth., Garnish with paprika., Cover and cook in oven at 350° for about 40 minutes.

title: Sweet And Sour Cocktail Wieners
directions: Mix sauce and jelly in saucepan., Stir over medium heat until blended., Add wieners and heat thoroughly.

title: Candied Apple Pie
directions: Prepare pastry of 2-crust 9-inch pie., Fill bottom shell with apples., Combine next six ingredients., Pour over apples., Cover with top crust., Bake at 425° for 45 minutes or until crust is brown and apples are tender., Remove from oven.

title: Ugly Duckling Cake
directions: Combine cake mix, fruit cocktail with syrup, 1 cup of coconut and eggs in large mixer bowl., Blend, then beat at medium speed for 2 minutes., Pour into greased 13 x 9-inch pan., Sprinkle with brown sugar., Bake at 325° for 45 minutes or until cake springs back when lightly touched.

title: "Simply Delicious" Chicken Broccoli Lasagna(6 To 8 Servings)
directions: Will need a 13 x 9-inch pan sprayed with nonstick spray. Preheat oven to 350°.

title: Dilled Macaroni And Cheese Salad(Cold)
directions: Cook macaroni, omitting salt., Drain well; rinse in cold water., Combine the next 4 ingredients and the cooked macaroni.

title: Chocolate Filled Bonbons
directions: Cream Crisco, sugar, brown sugar, vanilla and egg in large bowl at medium speed of electric mixer.

title: Creamy Italian Dressing
directions: Mix all ingredients in a blender, except oil. After all is well blended, add oil very slowly. Blend until thick., Delicious.

title: Mil'S Dressing
directions: Bake for 1 hour at 350°., Double recipe for 4 or more people.

title: Graham Cracker Crust
directions: Measure by tablespoon, teaspoon or cup and mix well.

title: Sausage Balls
directions: Mix all together; roll into 1-inch balls., Place on cookie sheet., Bake for 20 minutes at 400°.

title: Shoo-Fly Cake
directions: Mix with hands, the first 5 ingredients., Remove 2 cups of crumbs and set aside., Mix remaining crumbs with boiling water, molasses and baking soda., Pour into ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle remaining crumbs on top., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Grape-Nuts Bread
directions: Soak the Grape-nuts in the buttermilk for 10 minutes., Combine other ingredients; beat well., Let stand for 10 to 15 minutes before putting in oven., Bake 40 minutes at 375° in loaf pan.

title: Dolly Parton'S Soup
directions: Cook cabbage, celery, onion and carrots until tender in the least, amount, of, water, possible., Then, add tomatoes or juice and bouillon cubes., Simmer until well done.

title: Easy Refrigerator Dough
directions: Measure water and yeast into bowl; stir to dissolve., Stir in sugar, salt, oil and eggs., Mix until dough is soft., Do not knead., Cover with damp cloth; place in refrigerator., Let set at least 2 hours., About 1 to 1 1/2 hours before baking, shape into rolls., Cover; let rise until doubled in size., Bake at 400° until done., This dough will keep in the fridge for about 5 days., Just keep the cloth covering it damp.

title: Golden Glazed Ham With Cherry Sauce
directions: Place ham, fat side up, on a rack in shallow pan., Heat in a 325° oven for time indicated on label., One-half hour before end of time, remove ham from oven and score fat in diamonds.

title: Cherry Swish
directions: Mix together Cool Whip, cream cheese, powdered sugar and vanilla., Pour 1/2 of mixture into each pie shell., Pour 1/2 pie filling on top of each mixture and swish around until white shows through, making swirls., Refrigerate for 1 hour before serving.

title: 30 Minute Chocolate Cake
directions: Mix flour and sugar., Put water, cocoa and oleo in pan and bring to boil; pour over flour and sugar., Mix well., Add eggs, buttermilk, soda and vanilla., Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 400° about 20 minutes until done., Frost while hot.

title: Maple Flavored Seven Minute Frosting
directions: Preheat oven to 325°., Grease (with extra amount of softened butter) and lightly flour a 10-inch tube pan., Set aside., Combine the butter and cream cheese in a large mixing bowl., Beat mixture with an electric mixer until well blended and creamy for 2 minutes., Gradually add sugar while continuing to beat on medium speed., Beat until the mixture is light and fluffy for 6 to 8 minutes., Add the eggs, one at a time, beating after the addition of each egg until it is thoroughly absorbed., Sift together the flour, salt and baking powder., Slowly add this combination to the egg mixture, blending well., Stir in the coconut flavoring and vanilla flavoring, then the flaked coconut., Beat well for 1 minute.

title: Oven Fries
directions: Cut potato into quarters lengthwise and dry with a paper towel., Coat all over with the oil., Sprinkle with salt, pepper and garlic powder., Place in a nonstick pan or a Pam sprayed pan and bake at 450° for 20 minutes or until done.

title: Egg Drop Soup
directions: In large saucepan, boil chicken broth and onions., String beaten egg while stirring., Add salt and pepper., Add cornstarch mixture to thicken., Continue to boil until thickened., Add corn, if desired., Serve in bowls., Serves 4 to 6.

title: Pea Salad
directions: Mix sugar, vinegar, oil, salt and pepper; heat until sugar dissolves., Let cool., Add peas, corn, celery, onion, green pepper and pimiento., Let chill overnight.

title: Peanut Butter No Bakes
directions: Mix oleo, sugar, milk and salt in saucepan., Boil 1 minute. Remove from heat., Stir in peanut butter, vanilla and oatmeal. Drop on waxed paper.

title: Marinade For Deer
directions: Mix in bowl; marinate the deer for 20 minutes to overnight.

title: Rum Balls
directions: Crush vanilla wafers and chop nuts., Combine with sugar and cocoa., Stir in corn syrup and rum., Wet hands and form mixture into balls (small)., Roll in chocolate sprinkles., Freeze on flat tray., When firm put into container.

title: Rich And Charlie'S Salad
directions: Marinate 3 hours., Add one large head of lettuce., Sprinkle on more Parmesan cheese.

title: Chocolate Bubble Biscuits
directions: In large bowl, combine flour, 1/4 cup sugar, baking powder and salt., Using pastry blender or 2 knives, cut in 1/3 cup butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs., Stir in chocolate chips. Add milk; stir until dough holds a shape., On floured board, knead dough lightly., Roll dough into 16 balls.

title: Apple Butter
directions: Cut apples into chunks, but do not peel., In a glass or stainless steel kettle, combine apples and cider., Cover and cook over medium-high heat until apples are very soft, about 30 minutes. Press through a food mill or fine sieve and return to the cleaned pot., Stir in sugar, cinnamon and nutmeg., Simmer over low heat, stirring occasionally, until very thick, about 2 hours., Cool to room temperature, then refrigerate or freeze.

title: Divinity
directions: Place sugar, syrup and water in saucepan over low heat. Stir until, sugar, is dissolved, then cook without stirring to 252° (a little, dropped, into, cold water forms a hard ball). Remove from heat, and, pour,, beating, constantly,, in a fine stream, into, 2 egg whites, stiffly beaten., Continue beating until mixture, holds its, shape, and, loses, its, gloss., Add vanilla and broken nuts., Drop quickly from tip of spoon onto wax paper or, spread in	greased, shallow, pan, and, cut into squares when firm.

title: Cranberry Bread
directions: Combine flour, sugar, baking soda, ginger and baking powder and sift together., Mix salt, egg, orange juice, butter and water together., Add the dry ingredients and mix well., Add the nuts and cranberries to the mixture., Pour into a well-greased loaf pan. Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 10 minutes or until the tester inserted in middle of loaf comes out dry.

title: Creamy Chocolate Squares
directions: Cream confectioners sugar and cream cheese in bowl until light and fluffy., Blend in chocolate and vanilla., Add walnuts; mix well., Pour into buttered 8-inch dish., Chill until firm., Cut into squares., Yield: 2 pounds.

title: Shrimp Provencale
directions: About 45 minutes before serving in a 12-inch skillet over medium heat in 2 tablespoons of oil, cook shrimp, stirring often about 3 minutes until shrimp turn pink; set aside., In same skillet, add 1 tablespoon of oil., Add mushrooms; cook until tender, about 3 minutes., Add tomatoes, lemon juice, salt and pepper., Cook 3 minutes more., Return shrimp to skillet., Heat through., Sprinkle with parsley., Serve with rice.

title: Chowder
directions: Cook hen , beef and bacon in 1/2 gallon of water for 2 hours. Then add onions, carrots, cabbage, green beans and tomatoes., Cook 1 1/2 hours., Then add potatoes, sugar, salt and pepper., Cook 1 1/2 hours., Then add corn and cook at least 15 minutes., Makes 2 1/2 to 3 gallons., It sticks very easily, so cook over low heat and stir often.

title: Cheese Salsa Dip
directions: Microwave cheese and picante sauce in a 1 1/2 quart microwavable bowl on High for 5 minutes or until cheese is melted, stirring after 3 minutes., Stir in cilantro., Serve hot with tortilla chips or vegetable dippers., Yield: 3 cups.

title: Potato Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes., Sprinkle on onions towards end., Makes 10 servings.

title: Strawberry Cake
directions: Mix ingredients, adding eggs one at a time., Bake in loaf pan at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Turkey Chili
directions: In a large skillet over medium-high heat, in hot salad oil, cook turkey, onion and garlic until all pan juices evaporate and turkey is well browned, stirring frequently., Stir in chili powder and cook 1 minute., Stir in tomatoes with their liquid, water, salt, sugar and crushed red pepper., Over high heat, heat to boiling., Reduce heat to low., Simmer uncovered 10 minutes to blend flavors., Gently stir in kidney beans and heat through.

title: Earthquake Cake
directions: Grease 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan with margarine., Put coconut and pecans in margarine covered pan., Mix cake mix as directions instruct., Pour cake mix over pecan mixture., Soften cream cheese and 1 stick of margarine., Mix the powdered sugar with enough milk to make a thin cake icing., Now mix cream cheese mixture and powdered sugar., Pour over cake mix., Now bake at 350° for about 45 minutes., Cake is done when cracks appear in cake.

title: Mushrooms And Steak
directions: Cut steak into 4 servings. Melt butter in skillet; add Worcestershire sauce, basil and tarragon., Place steaks in skillet. Cook 5 minutes on both sides., Remove to warmed platter., Cover with foil., Place mushrooms in skillet., Add wine, salt and pepper., Saute until mushrooms are cooked., In a small bowl, toss cheese with flour and stir in with mushrooms., Cook until cheese is melted., Pour over steaks., Great with potatoes (baked) and salad., This is so easy and great.

title: Pineapple Cake
directions: Mix eggs and sugar together., Beat until smooth., Add pineapple, juice and all and sprinkle salt and soda over top of pineapple., Add the flour and mix real good., Empty into greased baking dish and sprinkle brown sugar and nuts over top of cake. Bake at 350° for about 30 minutes., Serve plain or with whipped cream.

title: Apple Crisp
directions: In a bowl, combine oatmeal, flour, sugar and cinnamon., Mix in butter., Peel, core and slice apples in a greased 8-inch round pan., Sprinkle topping mixture on apples., Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Pepperoni Bread
directions: Slice pepperoni into cubes 1/8-inch thick., Shred Mozzarella. Preheat oven to 425°., Using a roller, apply flour on surface. Roll dough into a diamond shape; 6 x 6-inch wide, starting at the smallest point., Add pepperoni and Mozzarella (small portions at a time)., Roll over and continue adding, then rolling, pinching each end., After roll is completed spread egg white over roll with paper towel., Bake on cookie sheet, 15 minutes or until brown and bubbly.

title: Round Steak Bake
directions: Place steak on foil and sprinkle soup mix on steak. Place potatoes evenly over steak and pour mushrooms with liquid over potatoes and steak. Wrap foil tightly. Bake 350° for 1 1/2 hours. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Chinese Pepper Steak
directions: Slice steak in narrow strips., Brown steak in 2 tablespoons oil., Combine with garlic, salt, pepper, soy sauce and sugar for 6 to 8 hours in crock-pot on low., Turn to high and add vegetables. Dissolve 1 tablespoon cornstarch in 2 tablespoons cold water. Stir into pot., Cook on high 15 to 20 minutes or until thickened. Serve over noodles or rice.

title: Chicken Fajita Sandwiches
directions: Combine lime juice, garlic, cumin and red pepper seasoning in medium-size bowl., Add chicken., Refrigerate covered for 30 to 60 minutes.

title: Almond Potato Puffs
directions: Combine the water and butter in small saucepan and bring to boil over high heat., Remove from heat; add flour, all at once, and beat until smooth., Add egg, blending thoroughly., Let cool. Add potatoes to flour-egg mixture and blend well., Season to taste with salt, pepper and nutmeg., Flour hands lightly, shape mixture into tablespoon-size balls., Roll balls in chopped nuts., Pour oil into a deep fryer or large saucepan and heat to 375°., Fry balls in batches until golden, about 5 minutes., Drain on paper towels. Serve hot., Yield: 2 servings.

title: Cranberry Congealed Salad
directions: Heat pineapple juice and dissolve Jell-O., Stir well., Add cranberry sauce and mix well., Add pineapple and oranges., Mix well and pour into Jell-O mold., Chill.

title: Pork Chops And Kraut
directions: In, casserole, dish,, arrange, pork, chops, in a single layer. Salt and pepper to taste., Cover pork chops with layer of sauerkraut., Cover, casserole with aluminum foil., Bake in slow oven, 200°, for 3 to 4 hours or until chops are fork-tender.

title: Gingersnaps
directions: Cream the shortening., Add sugar, egg and molasses., Sift dry ingredients together and add to mixture., Chill at least 2 hours. (You may chill overnight or longer.), Roll in balls the size of a small walnut., Dip the tops of the balls in the 2 tablespoons sugar and 1/4 teaspoon cinnamon mixture and place about 3-inches apart on greased (sprayed) cookie sheets., Bake 10 to 12 minutes at 375°.

title: Butterscotch Crunch Squares(Frozen Dessert)
directions: Combine flour, oats, and sugar., Cut in butter until mix resembles coarse crumbs., Stir in nuts., Pat mix into 13 x 9 inch pan and bake in a 400 degree oven for 15 minutes., Stir while warm to crumble and then cool.

title: Strawberry Salad
directions: Place sliced strawberries in jello; congeal overnight., Mix Cool Whip, sour cream and pineapple., Spread over jello., Top with chopped pecans., Chill again until firm.

title: Blond Brownies
directions: Sift dry ingredients and add nuts. Melt butter and mix in brown sugar, egg, and vanilla. Add flour mixture to butter mixture and mix well. Spread in square baking pan and sprinkle chips on top. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes. Cut into squares.

title: Soda Cracker Candy
directions: Line cookie sheet with aluminum foil. Line aluminum foil with a single layer of crackers. In a saucepan combine margarine with brown sugar. Stir and let come to a low boil. Let mixture low boil for about 1-2 minutes. Pour mixture over the crackers. Quickly and carefully spread. Bake 5 minutes at 400 degrees. Sprinkle chocolate chips over baked mixture. Refrigerate. When very cool, break apart. Remove from foil.

title: Fruit Dip
directions: Mix Cool Whip and cream cheese together with mixer., Blend in brown sugar and Kahlua., Stir in peanuts and chill., Serve with fresh fruit: apple and pear wedges, strawberries or banana chunks.

title: Beef Stroganoff
directions: Brown round steak (cut into thin slices) in hot oil., Remove meat., Cook onion and mushrooms until golden., Stir remaining ingredients except sour cream., Return meat to pan., Simmer about 1 hour, or until tender., Gradually stir in sour cream., Heat to almost boiling., Serve over wild rice or noodles., Serves 6.

title: Spanish Sauce
directions: Simmer for 1/2 hour.

title: Cold Pizza
directions: Press crescent rolls on large baking sheet and bake according to directions., Cool., Spread rest of ingredients on cooled crust. Add shredded cheese, green pepper and onion., Refrigerate at least 1 hour before serving.

title: Donna'S Dessert
directions: Break angel food into pieces and place in bottom of 15 x 12-inch pan., Beat cream cheese and powdered sugar until smooth, then add Cool Whip., Make 3 packages Jell-O with 2 1/2 cups boiling water, adding frozen berries after Jell-O is dissolved.

title: "Sean'S Favorite" Cranberry Pie
directions: Grease a 9-inch pie plate., Layer with cranberries and apple. Sprinkle with brown sugar and nuts., Beat egg until thick; slowly add 1/2 cup of sugar, flour and melted butter until blended well. Pour egg mixture over cranberry mixture., Bake in a 350° oven for 45 minutes., Serve with vanilla ice cream or whipped cream.

title: Spinach Dip
directions: Mix together and chill several hours before serving. Excellent as stuffing in a loaf of pumpernickel bread.

title: Caramel Fudge Cake
directions: Prepare cake mix by package directions., Pour 2 cups batter into a greased 13 x 9-inch pan; bake 15 minutes., In a heavy saucepan, over low heat, melt caramels and margarine., Remove from heat., Add sweetened condensed milk., Mix well., Spread caramel over cake., Spread remaining batter over caramel mixture., Top with nuts., Bake 30 minutes or until cake springs back when lightly touched., Cool.

title: Crumb-Coated Chicken
directions: In small bowl beat together eggs, butter and salt., In shallow dish place crumbs., Coat chicken with crumbs, then egg mixture and crumbs again., In 2 qt. oblong glass baking dish arrange chicken with meatiest pieces to outside edges of dish., Cover with wax paper., Microwave:, 13 to 16 minutes., Power level:, high (10)

title: Potato Salad
directions: Cut up potatoes and boil., Add salt, pepper, vinegar and oil to warm potatoes., Let cool and add remaining ingredients.

title: Stew Beef With Gravy
directions: Roll stew beef in flour., Heat oil and brown stew beef., When well browned, place in saucepan and add Worcestershire sauce and Texas Pete., Cover with water., Cover and simmer until tender. Delicious served with mashed potatoes or rice.

title: Kraut Salad
directions: Bring sugar and vinegar to a boil., Set aside to cool., Mix vegetables with kraut., Pour liquid over mixture., Let set in refrigerator for 24 hours., Keeps a long time.

title: Marinated Mushrooms And Veggies
directions: In saucepan, combine vinegar, oil, onion, garlic, 1 teaspoon salt, sugar, basil, oregano and 1/4 teaspoon pepper., Bring to a boil; simmer, uncovered, 10 minutes., Combine remaining ingredients in a bowl., Pour hot marinade over veggies., Stir; chill several hours, stirring occasionally., Drain before serving., Serve in lettuce lined bowl., Makes 7 cups., Great Thanksgiving dish.

title: Fruit-Cookie Pizza
directions: Roll out cookie dough and place on a baking pan., Bake according to pkg directions., Set aside., Mix cream cheese and sugar together and spread over cookie, slice fruit and layer on top of cheese mixture., Garnish with pecans and cool whip.

title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
directions: Beat margarine until smooth., Add sugar and blend well., Add eggs, one at a time, blending well., Add vanilla., Sift flour and soda together., Slowly add flour until all ingredients are blended well., Add sour cream and blend., Pour in well-greased and floured tube pan., Bake at 325° for 30 minutes, then turn down to 300° and bake for 45 minutes., Let cool in pan for 30 minutes.

title: Quick Green Beans And Potatoes
directions: Empty beans into crock-pot., Add drained potatoes, onion and bacon., Cook on high for 30 minutes.

title: Salmon Loaf Deluxe
directions: Mix together and form a loaf., Bake 30 minutes in 325° oven.

title: 7 Cup Salad
directions: Mix all together, except sour cream and sugar., Now add sour cream and sugar., Mix well and chill.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
directions: Combine potatoes, sugar, eggs, milk, vanilla and butter., Add coconut and nuts., Pour into a buttered dish and bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes., Remove from oven., Cover sweet potato mixture with marshmallows., Put back in oven long enough to brown and melt marshmallows.

title: Ice Cream Sodas
directions: Place flavoring or fruit in a tall glass; add sugar.

title: Pecan Pumpkin Pie
directions: Combine eggs, sugar, corn syrup, pumpkin and vanilla., Mix well., Stir in pecans., Pour into pie shell., Bake in preheated 375° oven for 55 to 60 minutes., Cool and serve.

title: Cole Slaw
directions: Heat sugar, salt, oil and vinegar until mixture boils and turns clear (until sugar melts)., Pour over cabbage mixture; do not stir., Refrigerate for 1 hour before serving.

title: Gingersnaps
directions: Blend shortening and sugar, then add eggs and molasses., Mix flour, salt, soda and spices. Add to creamed mixture., Add raisins and chill 25 to 30 minutes. Roll into balls and dip top into sugar., Place on greased cookie sheet., Place 1 drop of water on top of sugar on each cookie. Bake at 375° for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Wilted Spinach Salad
directions: In 3-quart casserole snip bacon into 1 inch pieces., Cover with paper towel., Microwave at High (10) 2 to 3 minutes, until crisp., With slotted spoon, place bacon on paper towels to drain. To bacon drippings add vinegar, sugar, salt, pepper and tarragon. Microwave at High (10) 2 to 3 minutes, until mixture boils., Stir in celery and onion., Gradually add spinach to hot dressing, tossing to coat each piece., Add crumbled bacon, orange segments and cashews., Toss again lightly., Serve immediately., Total Microwave Cooking Time:, 4 to 6 minutes., Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Au Gratin Potatoes
directions: Cook, potatoes in skin and cool., Remove skin and shred coarsely., Mix, potatoes and cheese in greased 9 x 13-inch pan or large casserole., Cook onion in 1/4 cup butter until soft. Mix with, sour cream and celery soup., Pour over potatoes and mix well., Refrigerate overnight.

title: Pumpkin Bread
directions: Combine oil, eggs, water and pumpkin; sift together next six ingredients., Gradually beat into first mixture; stir in cherries and nuts.

title: Peanut Butter Balls
directions: Mix all ingredients except chocolate and paraffin until smooth. Shape into balls., Melt chocolate and paraffin over low heat. Cool slightly., Dip (toothpick works best) peanut butter balls into chocolate and paraffin., Place on waxed paper to harden.

title: Barbecue Sauce
directions: Mix and spread over cooked pork roast, ribs, chicken or whatever you wish to barbecue., Bake at 300° for 45 minutes.

title: Stripe-It-Rich-Cake
directions: Prepare cake mix as directed on package., Bake in 13 x 9-inch pan., Remove from oven., Poke holes once down through the cake to the pan with the round handle of a wooden spoon., Holes should be 1-inch apart., If you don't have wooden spoon, you may use a plastic drinking straw using a turning motion to make large holes.

title: Potato Casserole
directions: Boil potatoes 15 minutes and drain., Cool and cube., Chop onion., Cut up Velveeta cheese., Mix with mayonnaise and cubed potatoes., Spray baking dish with Pam., Spread mixture into baking dish., Sprinkle bacon bits on top., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Taco Dip Ambrosino
directions: Cream together with a fork cream cheese and cottage cheese until blended., Layer mixture in bottom of a glass pie plate or serving bowl/plate., Add layer of taco sauce, vegetables and Cheddar., Alternate layers until supplies are exhausted. Finish with Cheddar and garnish with parsley., Serve with taco chips to scoop.

title: Cranberry Salad
directions: Mix cranberries and sugar; this mixture should drain overnight in a colander in the refrigerator., Dispose of juice., Mix cranberry mixture with grapes and pecans., Beat 1/2 pint of whipping cream; add sugar to taste., Mix with cranberries., Makes a festive salad., Delicious when served with turkey.

title: Sugar Cookies
directions: Mix the oleo or butter and sugar together until creamy by hand or mixer., Add the eggs, cream of tartar, vanilla and soda., Mix until well blended., Add the flour, one cup at a time, blending well after each addition., Roll into small balls and press with bottom of glass dipped in sugar., Bake at 350° for about 15 minutes in a heavy pan or 10 minutes on a cookie sheet., Make sure the cookie sheets are cool and cleaned before putting more cookies on them. The dough may be chilled for awhile or overnight to make it easier to handle.

title: Spring Breakfast Strata
directions: In a large bowl, beat eggs; add milk, mustard, basil and salt. Gently stir in remaining ingredients until well mixed., Pour into a greased 13 x 9 x 2 inch baking dish., Cover and refrigerate 8 hours or over night., Remove from the refrigerator 30 minutes before baking., Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 1 hour or until knife inserted near the center comes out clean., Let stand 5 minutes before cutting.

title: Cole Slaw
directions: Combine cabbage, celery seed, pepper, sugar, vinegar, sour cream and mayonnaise in a large bowl., Mix well, chill.

title: Old Fashioned Potato Salad
directions: Cook potatoes until done and add salt while cooking. When tender, drain all water off of potatoes; add butter, mustard and mayonnaise. Mix with mixer on low speed. Add remaining chopped boiled eggs, diced onion and diced dill pickles. Stir together and really enjoy.

title: Russian Teacakes
directions: Mix butter, sugar and vanilla thoroughly., Measure flour by sifting., Blend flour and salt; stir into butter mixture. Mix in nuts. Chill at least 2 hours., Heat oven to 400°., Roll dough into 1-inch balls., Place on ungreased cookie sheet., Bake 10 to 12 minutes while still warm., Roll in powdered sugar., Cool and roll in sugar again., Makes 4 dozen.

title: Easy Chocolate Pie
directions: Melt the Hershey bar over low heat., Blend into Cool Whip. Pour mixture into the pie crust., Put in refrigerator and chill for 1 hour before serving.

title: Mackerel Potato Cakes
directions: Mix together all ingredients except fat., Put fat in pan and drop cakes in hot pan., Fry.

title: Creamy Shrimp Dip
directions: Cut shrimp into halves or fourths., Cover and refrigerate. Mix cream cheese, sour cream and lemon juice until smooth., Add onions and seasonings; mix well., Stir in shrimp and gradually add mayonnaise to give good dipping consistency., Cover and chill 2 or 3 hours before serving., Serve with crackers and sturdy chips.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: In large bowl, combine chicken, rice and celery., Add soup, mayonnaise, onions and water chestnuts., Put in a large uncovered casserole., Top with corn flakes that have been mixed with 1/2 stick melted margarine and almonds., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes. Serves 8 to 10., Can be frozen., Freeze unbaked., Bring to room temperature before baking.

title: Ashley'S Pecan Pie
directions: Beat eggs., Stir in all other ingredients., Pour into unbaked pie shell and bake in slow oven at 275° for about an hour.

title: Zucchini Bread(Julie'S Favorite)
directions: Beat eggs until, light	and, fluffy., Add, oil,, sugar, zucchini and vanilla., Mix	lightly,, but well., Add remaining ingredients, mix until blended., Add nuts.	Put in greased and floured loaf pans.	Makes 2., Bake 1 hour at 325°.

title: Caramel-Chocolate Squares
directions: Mix cake mix (dry), melted butter, nuts and 1/3 cup Pet milk. Stir by hand., Put 1/2 mixture into 9 x 13-inch pan; bake for 6 minutes at 350° (ungreased)., Combine caramel and 1/3 cup milk. Melt in double boiler., Sprinkle chocolate chips over baked mix. Pour melted caramel over chocolate chips., Pour remainder of cake dough over mix., Bake for 15 minutes.

title: Pie Crust Supreme
directions: Sift flour, baking powder and salt. Cut in shortening. Add water, vinegar and egg all at once to the dry ingredients., Mix. Roll as usual.

title: S'More Gorp
directions: In a large bag, mix the ingredients., Then shake well., This recipe gives you the same S'more flavor without the trouble of roasting the marshmallows and other things.

title: Toasted Pecans
directions: Measure pecans in a small bowl., Mix vinegar and sugar; pour over pecans and stir to coat thoroughly., Let stand 15 minutes, stirring every 5 minutes., Place pecans in a shallow baking dish and bake in a 300° oven for 10 minutes., Add melted butter to pecans, stir and allow to bake for another 5 minutes.

title: Coconut Pecan Balls
directions: Mix sugar, pecans, coconut., Add milk, margarine., Mix and roll into balls., Refrigerate to harden., Melt chocolate and wax in double boiler or on, very low heat., Dip each ball and place on waxed paper to cool.

title: Butter Rolls
directions: Use your favorite biscuit dough., Roll out like for jelly roll., Sprinkle with sugar., Cut butter up; put on top., Roll up in rolls; prick with fork., Put rolls in an 8 x 8-inch Pyrex bowl. Pour milk over rolls; milk should almost cover rolls., Bake in a 400° oven until brown., Makes about 3 rolls.

title: Peanut Butter And Chocolate Chip Cookies
directions: Heat oven to 375°., Mix shortening, sugar, butter, egg and vanilla in a bowl., Stir in flour, baking soda and salt., Add chocolate chips and peanut butter chips., Drop spoonfuls of dough onto ungreased cookie sheets., Bake about 10 to 13 minutes or until cookies are golden., Cool.

title: Strawberries(Using Dry Jello)
directions: Combine milk, coconut, one box of jello, almonds, sugar and vanilla., Mix well, then hand-shape to form strawberries., Roll berries in other box of jello to coat thoroughly., Set to dry. Pipe green icing on berries to form leaf and stems.

title: Bea'S Hot Olive Cheese Puffs
directions: Blend cheese and oleo., Add flour and paprika., Take 1 teaspoon of the mixture and wrap around an olive., Bake in 450° oven for 10 to 15 minutes., May be prepared early and frozen before baking.

title: Creamy Rice Pudding
directions: Combine the first 4 ingredients in a medium saucepan., Cover and cook over very low heat for about 30 minutes or until rice is tender and milk is absorbed., Stir mixture occasionally., Combine remaining ingredients in a small bowl., Gradually stir about 1/4 of hot rice mixture into egg mixture., Add remaining egg mixture to remaining rice., Cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until mixture comes to a boil., Remove from heat., Serve warm or cold with fruit or raisins.

title: No Bake Snow Drop Cookies
directions: Beat egg whites until foamy., Add sugar very gradually; beat until stiff., Fold in nuts and chocolate chips., Drop by teaspoons in mounds on baking sheet., Place in a 350° oven and turn oven off., Leave 3 hours to overnight.

title: Rhubarb Jam
directions: Cook rhubarb until tender, about 20 minutes., Add the jello and mix well (any flavor may be used)., Add sugar with rhubarb.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Mix first 4 ingredients in saucepan., Let boil for 1 1/2 minutes. Remove from heat and add next 5 ingredients., Mix thoroughly. Drop on wax paper., Let cool.

title: Chip Dip
directions: Cook hamburger and drain., Mix remaining ingredients., Cook until cheese melted., Serve with Doritos or other chips.

title: Sweet Onion Pie
directions: Saute onion in butter until soft., Mix flour with cold milk until there are no lumps., Add eggs, salt, pepper and cheese., Add onion and mix well., Pour into pie shell and bake for 40 minutes until brown, bake at 350 degrees.

title: Punch Bowl Cake
directions: Bake cake as directed in 2 layers., In punch bowl, crumble 1st layer of cake.

title: Cherry Tart
directions: Mix prepared cheese cake fillings and packages of cream cheese together and set aside., Take melted margarine and pour over both crusts., Put, one, half, of, the, margarine, on each crust., Put a cup of, pecans in the bottom of each crust, then divide the cheese cake, and, cream, cheese mixture between the two pies., Pour over the pecans., Pour cherry pie filling over each pie, then top with Cool Whip.	Chill and serve.

title: Soft Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Sift dry ingredients., Cream shortening, then add sugar and egg., Stir in one-half of the flour, then the milk and then the remaining flour., Stir in oats and raisins., Drop onto lightly greased cookie sheet and bake 10 minutes at 400°.

title: Zucchini Cheese Casserole
directions: Saute zucchini and chopped onion in oil., Whip cottage cheese with basil and oregano in blender. Place alternating layers of zucchini, cottage cheese and tomatoes in a 1 1/2-quart casserole dish., Top with Parmesan cheese., Bake at 350° uncovered for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Pork Chop Bake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., In a large skillet, brown chops., Drain on absorbent paper., In buttered, oblong baking dish, arrange chops, potatoes and mushrooms on top., In a small bowl, combine water and soup mix., Pour over other ingredients in baking dish.

title: Tater Tot Casserole
directions: Put tater tots in bottom of pan. Brown ground chuck, drain. Put over, tots. Pour soup in layers over ground chuck in any order. Spread cheese and put over soup. Bake at 350 degrees, until bubbly about 30 minutes.

title: Broccoli Salad
directions: Cut broccoli flowerets into smaller than bite-size pieces. Cut off tough outer layer of stalks and chop the tender part into small pieces., You need 8 cups of broccoli., (Do this the day before and store in plastic bag.), Saute bacon until crisp., Slice onion lengthwise., In large bowl, combine the broccoli, onion and raisins and bacon., In small bowl, mix together mayonnaise, sugar, vinegar and pepper., Combine dressing with the vegetables; refrigerate for at least 2 hours before serving., Top with sunflower seeds.

title: Quick Taco Salad
directions: Step 1:, In a large skillet, brown ground beef and onion. Drain., Remove from skillet., Set aside.

title: Oatmeal Pie
directions: Mix all ingredients together in bowl and pour into unbaked pie shell., Bake 30 to 40 minutes at 350°., Double recipe makes 3 pies.

title: Strawberry Cake
directions: Extract juice from strawberries., Combine dry ingredients for cake, then add others., Pour into greased pans., Bake at 350°.

title: Italian Delight(Large Portion)
directions: Take the cubed steak and set it into the pan (with Crisco) on medium-low., While steak is cooking, chop the veggies into fine pieces and place them in a bowl (with the cheese)., When the meat is done, put it in with the veggies., Put the whole jar of Ragu into the pan (simmer with a little bit of water).

title: Sugar Cookies
directions: Cream sugar and butter, add egg and vanilla. Mix thoroughly. Sift dry ingredients together and stir into first mixture. Refrigerate 2 to 3 hours., Preheat oven to 375°., Divide dough in half and roll out on lightly floured pastry sheet., Roll thin but thick enough to pick up the design in the cookie cutters., Dip cutter in flour before each cutting., Cut as many cookies from each rolling as possible., The least amount of working with the dough gives the best cookie., Place on lightly greased baking sheet., Bake for 7 to 8 minutes or until delicately golden.

title: Brownies
directions: Mix all ingredients and beat for 3 minutes., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Pickled Beets
directions: Dissolve all ingredients, except beets; bring to boil., Add diced or sliced beets until warm., Put in sterile bottles and seal., Cold pack 10 minutes.

title: Strawberry Pie
directions: Combine the sugar, cornstarch, jello, lemon juice and water. Cook until it becomes thick, stirring occasionally., Allow to cool., Put berries in pie shell; pour thickened mixture on top. Chill for at least 3 hours., Serve with whipped topping; garnish with halves or whole berries.

title: Asparagus Casserole
directions: In a 2-quart casserole dish, coarsely crumble crackers to cover bottom of dish., Layer asparagus over crackers; slice Velveeta cheese and layer over asparagus, then cover with about 1/2 can of mushroom soup., Alternate layers until all ingredients are used., End with a fine layer of cracker crumbs on top., For more moisture, you can add 1 or 2 tablespoons of the juice from the asparagus., Bake at 350° for about 30 minutes.

title: Ritz Cracker Dessert
directions: Beat egg, whites, stiff, and add sugar; then add baking powder, vanilla, pecans and crackers., Pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish., Bake, at 350° for 25 minutes., When cool prepare Dream Whip, as directed on box., Mix with cream cheese and pineapple, and, spread, over, dessert;, refrigerate., Will keep several days.

title: Lemon Chicken
directions: Blend all ingredients in bottom of an 8 x 12-inch baking dish. Add chicken. Cover and marinate in refrigerator for 8 to 10 hours. Turn at least once in marinade., Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 1 hour., Baste with pan juices and serve over rice.

title: Apricot-Blueberry Coffee Cake(A Favorite Of Family And Friends)
directions: Combine cake mix, pudding, eggs, oil and sour cream; beat well by hand; add blueberries and apricots., Combine sugar, cinnamon and nuts; set aside., Grease and flour a tube pan., Pour 1/2 of the cake mixture into pan., Sprinkle with 1/2 of the sugar-cinnamon mixture., Add the remaining cake mixture, then the remaining sugar-cinnamon mixture., Bake at 350° for about 1 hour. Yields 12 to 14 servings.

title: Crab Treats
directions: Combine cheese, milk, onion, Worcestershire, lemon juice and spices., Stir in crab., Halve English muffins with a fork., Cut halves into fourths and pile each wedge high with crab mixture. Place on baking sheet; dust with paprika and broil until lightly browned and bubbly., Makes about 40.

title: Japanese Fruit Pie
directions: Mix together first three ingredients, then add the coconut, pecans and raisins., Stir well, then add vinegar., Pour into unbaked pie shell., Bake 40 minutes at 300°.

title: Ham Sauce
directions: Blend cornstarch, mustard and salt into ham drippings., Add water, sugar and raisins., Cook and stir until clear and slightly thickened., Blend into vinegar and lemon juice., Makes 3 cups.

title: 24-Hour Salad
directions: Make 24 hours before serving., Use large casserole or large glass pan., Shred or tear lettuce into dish, approximately 1/3 full., Layer on top of the following (do not stir): green peas, green pepper, celery, red onion., Frost entire top with the following mixture:, mayonnaise, sour cream and sugar., Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese., Right before serving, sprinkle with bacon.

title: Glazed Waverly Crackers
directions: Line cookie sheet, 12 x 16-inch, with Waverly crackers and sprinkle about 1/2 cup pecans on top of crackers., Boil sugar and oleo for 2 minutes., Remove from heat and add vanilla., Pour over crackers., Bake at 350° for 10 minutes., Do not overbake., Remove crackers from cookie sheet while still hot.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
directions: In a mixing bowl, beat peanut butter, cream cheese and butter until smooth. Add sugar and milk; fold in whipped topping. Pour into the crust. Cover and freeze for at least 4 hours. Remove from the freezer just before serving. Garnish with peanuts and chocolate curls if desired. Yield: 6 servings.

title: Barbecue Sauce
directions: Mix together with a whisk., Brush on meats or poultry last 20 minutes of cooking or grilling.

title: Kim'S Corned Beef Hash
directions: Wash and peel potatoes, chop into wedges and place in microwave safe dish. Bake 15 to 20 minutes. Add butter to potatoes last few minutes in microwave. Cook bacon, remove from grease and brown onions. Add to potatoes along with corned beef, place on top and do not stir. Cook until done.

title: Play Dough
directions: Put in saucepan the flour, salt, cream of tartar and cooking oil. Add the boiling water. Cook until it sticks together and is doughy.

title: Cioppino
directions: Thaw fish if frozen., Cut fish into 1-inch pieces., In a large saucepan, cook green onion, onion and garlic in hot oil until tender., Add tomatoes, tomato sauce, wine, parsley, oregano, basil, salt and pepper., Bring to boiling, then reduce heat. Cover and simmer 20 minutes., Add fish, shrimp and undrained clams., Bring just to boiling, then reduce heat., Cover and simmer 5 to 7 minutes or until fish flakes easily with a fork., This stew is delicious on its own or over rice., Serve with salad and warm bread.

title: Orange Sherbet
directions: Mix all together real good, then pour in ice cream freezer. Freeze as you would ice cream.

title: Best-Ever Egg Nog
directions: Beat egg yolks and sugar in medium saucepan., Slowly beat in two (2) cups of the milk., Cook over medium heat, stirring frequently, until thermometer registers 150°F. or mixture coats the back of a metal spoon., Remove from heat;, strain into pitcher., Stir in remaining milk, Jim Beam Bourbon, vanilla and nutmeg., Cover and chill at least 8 hours or overnight., Sprinkle with additional nutmeg.

title: Crescent Roll Casserole
directions: Brown hamburger and onion; drain., Stir in seasoning and tomato sauce., Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan., Spread 1 can of rolls onto bottom of pan., Spread hamburger mixture on top of rolls. Sprinkle both kinds of cheese on top, then top with second can of rolls., Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

title: Eggplant Casserole
directions: Pare and slice eggplant. Cook in salted water until tender. Drain and mash., Add other ingredients except cheese slices. Place in a greased 1-quart casserole dish., Bake at 350° for 40 minutes. Arrange cheese slices on top and bake an additional 20 minutes., Yields 4 servings.

title: Gold Kist Pecan Pie
directions: Cream butter., Add sugar, creaming until light and fluffy. Add slightly beaten eggs and other ingredients., When all is blended, pour into unbaked pie shell., Bake on lower shelf of oven at 350° for 45 minutes., Makes two 9-inch pies.

title: Swiss Chicken
directions: Place chicken in a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish; sprinkle with garlic powder and pepper., Top each breast with cheese slice; set aside., Combine soup and milk, stirring until smooth., Pour over chicken., Sprinkle with stuffing mix and drizzle with butter., Bake chicken at 350° for 150 minutes or until chicken is done.

title: Grape-Nuts Pudding
directions: Soak cereal in warm milk for 10 minutes., Beat eggs with fork; add sugar to taste., Add salt, vanilla and cereal/milk mixture. Spoon into a buttered 5 cup casserole dish., If desired, sprinkle top with nutmeg., Set casserole into a pan partly filled with water., Bake at 350° for about 1 hour., Stir at least twice during the first 20 minutes of baking., Makes 4 to 6 servings., Serve warm or chilled., Store leftover pudding in refrigerator.

title: Mexican Salad
directions: Pinch lettuce in small pieces., Combine all other ingredients except Fritos., Add them just before serving.

title: Vegetable Casserole
directions: Place all, ingredients, in a 9 x 13-inch pan and cover. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Meat Loaf
directions: Mix all ingredients thoroughly., Spread in ungreased, 9 x 5, x 3-inch pan or casserole dish., Bake at 350° for 1 hour to 1 1/4 hours.

title: Dirt Cake
directions: Cream together margarine, cream cheese and sugar. Set aside. Mix together pudding and milk until smooth., Mix in whipped topping., Mix in cream cheese mixture., Alternate layers of the crushed cookies and pudding mixture, beginning and ending with cookies., Put in refrigerator or freeze until firm.

title: Millionaire Pie
directions: Mix all ingredients and pour into graham cracker crusts. Makes 2 or more pies!

title: Jello Salad
directions: Dissolve Jell-O in 1 cup boiling water., Fold in sour cream and pineapple., Pour into oiled mold., (Halved works well.)

title: Blueberry Delight
directions: Line bottom of 13 x 9-inch dish or pan with graham crackers. Mix pudding according to directions on box and spread over crackers., Spread Cool Whip over that and put in refrigerator until pudding sets., Top with blueberry pie filling.

title: Italian String Beans
directions: Cook beans until partially tender; drain and saute in olive oil, 1 clove garlic and oregano., Add salt and pepper., Cook until tender.

title: Hot And Sour Soup
directions: In a 5-quart pot, heat oil., Add chicken and saute until meat is not pink., Add water, mushrooms, cabbage, bamboo shoots and bouillon cubes., Bring to boil., Reduce heat and simmer 1/2 hour. In small bowl, dissolve cornstarch and stir with fork until smooth., Stir into soup., Add vinegar, soy sauce, salt and pepper. Stir soup until slightly thickened and enjoy., Unused soup can be frozen for a quick meal anytime.

title: Tuna Casserole
directions: Cook noodles according to package and drain., Combine tuna, soup, onion, vinegar, milk and Cheddar cheese in a bowl., Mix well. Stir in noodles. Spoon into 2-quart baking dish., Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Pie De Kahlua
directions: Dot shell with Kahlua and set aside., Slightly beat egg yolks in top of a double boiler., Add 1/2 cup sugar., Place over simmering water., Cook and stir until sugar is dissolved., Melt chocolate with 1/4 cup water in a small saucepan., Stir melted chocolate, mixture into egg yolks., Cook and stir until mixture begins to thicken., Soften gelatin in 1/4 cup cold water., Add to thickened chocolate mixture., Stir well and remove from heat., Add Kahlua., Place pan with mixture in a bowl of ice water to cool. In small bowl, beat cream with 2 tablespoons sugar until stiff. In another small bowl, beat egg whites until stiff., When chocolate mixture begins to thicken, fold in half of the whipped cream, then fold in stiffly beaten egg whites., Refrigerate remaining whipped cream., Turn chocolate mixture into pie shell, chill., Top pie with remaining whipped cream and almonds., Makes one 9 inch pie.

title: Green Rice
directions: Heat oven to 325°. Toss rice and spinach together. Add eggs, milk, Worcestershire sauce, salt and onion. Pour into 2-quart baking dish. Sprinkle butter and cheese over rice. Bake 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Chocolate Cherry Cheese Pie
directions: Let cream cheese stand at room temperature for 15 to 20 minutes to soften.

title: Good Green Beans
directions: Drain green beans., Mix all ingredients together in casserole dish and bake at 350° for about 20 to 30 minutes until bacon pieces are done.

title: Spaghetti And Meat Sauce
directions: In Dutch oven, cook beef, sausage, onion and garlic., Drain. Add next 7 ingredients., Simmer 30 minutes., Prepare spaghetti as package directs., Drain., Serve sauce over hot spaghetti., Pass the Parmesan cheese., Serves 6 to 8.

title: Microwave Fudge
directions: Place all ingredients, except walnuts, in a large bowl. Microwave at Medium (50% power) until chocolate chips are melted (about 3 to 5 minutes), stirring once or twice during cooking. Stir in nuts., Pour into well-greased (8 x 8-inch) square baking dish., Refrigerate until set (overnight if possible).

title: Cheesy Green Beans
directions: Brown the butter; add flour, then milk., Stir and cook until smooth., Add cheese and mushroom soup and stir until melted., Pour over beans., Heat.

title: Electric Frypan Swiss Steak
directions: On a breadboard, pound flour into both sides of steak; cut into serving pieces until flour is absorbed., Preheat frypan to 360°. Add fat and onions; saute until golden in color, about 3 minutes. Remove from fat., Change frypan setting to 400° and add a tablespoon of fat., Then brown steak on both sides, about 10 to 20 minutes., Sprinkle browned meat with salt and pepper; add the sauteed onions, garlic, celery, tomatoes and pepper slices., Cover and set frypan at 220°., Simmer until the meat is tender, about 1 1/2 hours., Sprinkle with parsley when serving.

title: Date Nut Roll
directions: Combine cheese, dates and 1/2 cup pecans., Cover and chill 30 minutes., Shape into a ball and roll in remaining pecans., Serve with apple wedges or gingersnaps., Makes 2 cups.

title: Aunt Lettie'S Pound Cake
directions: Separate eggs., Beat egg whites until stiff., Add 6 tablespoons of sugar gradually., Put in refrigerator., Cream butter and add remainder of sugar., Beat at low speed., Add 2 egg yolks at a time., Add milk and flour alternately., Add flavoring and fold in egg whites., Pour into greased steeple pan., Bake 1 3/4 hours in a 300° oven.

title: Sauerbraten Patties
directions: Soften bread in water., Add beef, onion, egg, salt and pepper and mix thoroughly., Form into patties., Brown on both sides in butter in heavy skillet., Mix remaining ingredients., Pour over meat., Cook, covered, on low heat for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Garlic Rosemary Chicken
directions: Wash chicken. Push garlic and rosemary under skin and in cavity. Cook in Brown N Bag, 1 1/4 to 1 1/2 hours at 375°.

title: Cheese Dip
directions: Cook until cheese is melted., Keep on warmer and serve with Doritos or other chips.

title: Chicken Pie
directions: Cut up chicken and put in casserole., Combine soup and broth and pour over chicken.

title: Microwave Pralines
directions: Stir whipping cream and sugar together well., Cook 7 minutes. Stir well, then cook 7 more minutes., Remove and add butter and pecans., Stir in 1 teaspoon vanilla (optional), then drop on wax paper.

title: Strawberry Bread
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Put in loaf pan and bake 1 hour at 350°.

title: Zucchini Bread
directions: Cream shortening, butter, sugar and eggs., Add remaining ingredients and mix well., Pour into a loaf pan, greased and lightly floured., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Savory Chicken Breasts
directions: Place chicken breast in shallow baking dish., Combine soup and milk., Pour over chicken., Sprinkle stuffing mix evenly over milk and soup mixture., Drizzle melted oleo over stuffing., Bake, covered, for 30 minutes at 350°., Remove cover and continue baking for 20 minutes or until golden brown and bubbly.

title: Raisin-Filled Apples
directions: Mix the first 4 ingredients., Peel off a strip around top of apples., Place apples in 10 x 6 x 2-inch baking dish; fill centers with nut mixture., Microcook, covered, until tender, 5 to 6 minutes; give dish a half turn twice., Let stand 15 minutes before serving., Serves 4.

title: Hamburger Hot Dish
directions: Fry hamburger and onion together until hamburger is brown and crumbly., Drain off excess fat., Mix all ingredients in casserole dish., Bake 1 to 1 1/2 hours until carrots are tender at 350°.

title: Orange Balls
directions: Mix wafers, powdered sugar and orange juice and roll in small balls., Then roll these in the coconut.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Mix sugar, flour, oats, cinnamon, salt and raisins., Add eggs and mix well., Add margarine., Mix soda and vinegar together and add to mixture., This dough will be stiff, but mix well., Drop by teaspoonfuls onto cookie sheet., Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes, depending on how crisp or soft you like them.

title: Butternut Squash
directions: Cut squash in half lengthwise and discard seeds., Slice into 1/2-inch slices crosswise and remove peel. Place in a 9 x 13-inch pan., Sprinkle with sugar., Heat orange juice in microwave dish. Dissolve candy in the orange juice., Pour over squash. Sprinkle with salt., Cover with foil and bake at 375° for 30 to 35 minutes. Place liquid from baking pan into small saucepan and boil until thick., Pour over squash. Yields 4 servings., Has 150 calories, fat free.

title: Champagne Salad(Frozen)
directions: Fold in fruit and nuts with mixture., Freeze in Pyrex dish. Cut into squares., Fills a 7 x 11-inch dish.

title: Chocolate Buttermilk Pound Cake
directions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees. Grease and flour a Bundt pan or tube pan. In large bowl, cream together the butter, shortening, and sugar., Add the eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition. In another bowl, combine the flour, baking soda, salt, and cocoa. Stir to mix., Add the flour mixture to the creamed mixture alternately with the buttermilk. Add vanilla and mix well. Stir in walnuts. Pour the batter into the prepared pan. Bake for about 1 hour 10 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean when inserted into center of cake. After the cake has cooled slightly in the pan, turn it out onto a cake plate.

title: Rhubarb Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients together and put in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Top with mixture of 1/4 cup sugar and 1 teaspoon cinnamon., Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Crisscross Peanut Butter Cookies
directions: Thoroughly cream shortening, sugar and vanilla., Add eggs and beat thoroughly., Stir in peanut butter., Sift dry ingredients. Stir into creamed mixture., Form into tiny balls., Place on ungreased cookie sheet., Press with back of fork to make crisscross., Dough may also be rolled and cut, if desired., Bake in moderated oven at 350° for 10 minutes., Makes 8 dozen.

title: Nacho Dip
directions: Brown and drain ground beef, sausage and onion on low heat; add other ingredients., Cook in a large pot., Serve with nacho chips., Keep warm in crock-pot.

title: Coffee Cake
directions: Mix sugar, oil, eggs and vanilla. Mix together flour, baking powder and salt. Mix dry ingredients into wet ingredients. Spread 1/2 batter into bottom of 9 x 13 greased baking pan. Spoon pie filling over batter. Drizzle remaining batter over pie filling. Before baking, sprinkle with 2 tablespoons white sugar and 1 teaspoon cinnamon, mixed together. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Ham Rolls
directions: Mix cream cheese, onion and Tabasco sauce., Spread on ham slices., Roll ham slices and refrigerate overnight., Slice in one-inch pinwheels after chilled thoroughly., Garnish with fresh parsley and serve.

title: Mexican Lasagna
directions: Cook meat and onion until brown; drain fat., Add taco seasoning mix to meat mixture., Add chilies., Cut tortillas into thirds., In a 9 x 13-inch pan, layer salsa, meat, cheese and tortillas in that order., End with layer of tortillas topped with cheese., Cover with foil and bake for 35 minutes at 350°.

title: Ladyfingers
directions: Mix all ingredients and roll in powdered sugar., Bake at 300° for 1 hour., Serves 5.

title: Mom'S Dandelion Wine
directions: Gather 1 peck dandelion heads., Do not collect from an area sprayed with pesticides or herbicides., Wash to remove bugs. Combine dandelion heads with boiling water in a large container. Let the flower heads steep for 24 hours., Strain the juice., To the juice, add sugar, yeast and fruit., The amount of fruit can vary, depending on the flavor you want., Set it in a warm, dark area to ferment., Do not stir., Keep mixture quiet for about 2 weeks., When the mixture reaches the desired potency, siphon off and filter through cheesecloth., Refrigerate., It's ready!

title: Southern Sweet Potato Pie
directions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour and sugar., Add potatoes, eggs, corn syrup, nutmeg, salt, butter and evaporated milk., Beat well., Pour into pastry shell., Bake at 350° for 55 to 60 minutes., Yields 8 servings.

title: Smoked Salmon Rolls
directions: Blend softened cheese with capers., Spread on salmon., Roll, jelly-roll fashion., Chill., Cut in 1/2-inch slices., Serve on cocktail picks.

title: Icebox Cookies
directions: Mix Crisco or oleo, powdered sweetener, milk, almond, vanilla and eggs together and add flour, baking powder and nuts., Make into logs and refrigerate overnight., Slice and bake at 350° until light brown., They do not brown like cookies with sugar., Can also add coconut and substitute unsweetened orange juice for the milk., Keep in refrigerator., (Thirteen calories per cookie.)

title: Pineapple Upside-Down Cake
directions: Prepare cake batter using first 8 ingredients., Melt 1/3 cup butter and brown sugar in cake pan (10 to 12-inch) or an iron skillet., Put the pineapple in the pan and place a cherry in the center of each pineapple slice if you wish., Then cover with cake batter., Bake at 375° for 35 minutes., Loosen cake from sides of pan and invert on large plate., Serve warm or cold, plain or with whipped cream.

title: Gone All Afternoon Stew
directions: Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes turning once.

title: Turkey Chili
directions: In large heavy pot, brown turkey; pour off any excess fat. Add onion, green pepper and garlic; cook 2 minutes, stirring occasionally., Add beans, water, tomatoes, tomato paste, chili powder, oregano, cumin and red pepper; cover., Simmer for 1 1/2 hours, stirring occasionally., Serve hot with crackers.

title: Quick Chili
directions: Brown beef and onion in skillet; drain off fat., Add soup, beans, green chilies, chili powder, salt and pepper; simmer for 30 minutes., Serve over rice or with crackers.

title: Crock Pot Pepper Roast
directions: Place about 5 or 6 peppers in bottom of pot., Put roast on top., Pour remaining peppers and the juice on top.	Cook on low all day while you are at work., You could also put on before bed and allow to cook all night., Refrigerate in the morning.

title: Swiss Steak
directions: Brown the steak., Mix the remaining ingredients and put on top of the steak., Bake.

title: Beatnik Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients well and bake at 325° for 30 minutes.

title: Broccoli Cornbread
directions: Mix all ingredients bake at 350° for 30-35 minutes in a 13 x 9-inch pan.

title: Chicken Parmesan
directions: Roll chicken in a mixture of flour, salt, pepper and garlic powder., Brown in oil., Place chicken in a 13 x 9-inch baking dish; sprinkle with Parmesan and then Mozzarella., Pour spaghetti sauce over chicken., Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 45 minutes. Serve with spaghetti or vermicelli., Serves 6 to 8.

title: Fresh Peach Ice Cream
directions: Dip into boiling water the peaches., Plunge peaches into cold water., Slip off skins. Cut in half., Discard pits., Press peaches through sieve or food mill into mixing bowl., Stir in 1 tablespoon lemon juice and the sugar., Let stand for 15 to 20 minutes. Combine the heavy cream, vanilla, almond extract and salt. Stir into peach mixture. Fill freezer container 2/3 full of mixture. Cover tightly. Set in freezer tub and freeze until firm.

title: Mountain Dew Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes., Cool in pans 10 minutes., Finish cooling before adding icing.

title: Sauce For Fresh Fruit
directions: Place beaten egg in top of double boiler and add sugar, flour and salt., Mix well., Add butter and pineapple juice., Cook over water until smooth and thickened., Cool, then add Dream Whip or whipping cream.

title: Eggplant Souffle
directions: Peel eggplant and cook in boiling water 7 to 10 minutes. Drain and season with dash of onion powder and dill., Mix remaining ingredients with 1/3 cup cracker crumbs and combine with eggplant., Put in 2-quart greased casserole., Sprinkle remaining cracker crumbs on top and dot with butter and dash of paprika. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until bubbly., Serves 4 to 6.

title: Famous Lemon Pie
directions: Mix cornstarch and lemon juice in pan., Separate 3 yolks from egg whites, set the whites aside., Add egg yolks to lemon mixture and stir, then add boiling water and cook until thick., Pour into pie shell., Beat egg whites and sugar until stiff peaks form for topping., Spread onto pie and bake at 325° for 15 minutes or until topping is golden brown.

title: Vanilla Wafer Cake
directions: Melt butter and beat eggs slightly.

title: Quick Cobbler
directions: Melt margarine in an 8-inch dish in a preheated 375° oven. Combine sugar, flour and milk., Stir into melted margarine., Top with cherries and mix thoroughly., Bake at 375° for 30 minutes.

title: Fiesta Onion Salsa
directions: Combine all ingredients; cover and chill at least 2 hours. Serve with vegetables, fish, chicken or tortilla chips., Yield: 2 cups.

title: Rudy'S Farm Holiday Dressing
directions: Brown sausage and drain., Cook onion and celery in oleo until tender., Mix remaining ingredients together; dump in sausage, onion, oleo and celery., Stuff a 14 to 20 pound bird or dressing may be baked in pan for 35 to 40 minutes at 350°., Feeds a hungry family!!

title: Pumpkin Pie Cake
directions: Mix cake mix, melted butter and 1 egg., Pour and press into lightly greased cake pan., Mix pumpkin, 2 eggs, sugar, salt, cinnamon, ginger, cloves and milk., Pour over crust mix., Mix remaining ingredients until crumbly; sprinkle over pumpkin mixture., Bake at 350° for 1 hour., Cool and serve with whipped topping.

title: Spatini Meatballs
directions: Mix together ground beef, Spatini, cold water and bread crumbs., Shape into meatballs., Place on cookie sheet., Bake in oven for 25 minutes at 350°.

title: 7 Layer Salad
directions: Layer in bowl as listed., Let sit 8 hours overnight in refrigerator.

title: North Rim Rolls(Grand Canyon)
directions: Mix milk, sugar, salt and shortening., Cool to lukewarm., Add eggs and yeast mixture., Stir in flour., Refrigerate overnight. Roll out dough., Cut or shape as desired., Let rise at least an hour., Bake 8 to 10 minutes at 350°.

title: Barbecue Meatball Bites
directions: Mix ground beef, bread crumbs, egg and poultry seasoning. Shape into about 2 dozen 1 1/2-inch balls. Brown balls slowly in a lightly oiled skillet over medium-high heat. Pour off excess fat.

title: Cherry Wink Cookies
directions: Sift together flour, baking powder, soda and salt., Blend butter and sugar; add eggs., Beat well., Stir in milk and vanilla. Add sifted dry ingredients together with nuts, dates and cut cherries., Mix well., Crush corn flakes into fine crumbs., Shape dough into balls using 1 level tablespoon dough each., Roll balls into crumbs., Place on greased cookie sheet., Top each with 1/4 cherry., Bake at 375° for about 12 minutes or until lightly brown. Yield:, 6 dozen 2-inch diameter cookies.

title: Applesauce Raisin Cookies
directions: Cream the butter and sugar., Stir in egg., Sift together the flour, soda, salt, cinnamon, cloves and nutmeg., Add to creamed mixture alternately with applesauce., Add oats and blend well. Stir in raisins and nuts., Drop by teaspoons onto well-greased cookie sheet., Bake at 375° for 15 minutes.

title: Sensational Celery
directions: Cook celery in boiling water for 5 minutes; drain., Drain water chestnuts; reserve liquid., Slice water chestnuts., Drain mushrooms and reserve liquid., Mix celery, water chestnuts, almonds and mushrooms., Melt butter in saucepan., Add flour and stir until smooth., Add reserved liquids, milk and broth; cook, stirring until thickened., Stir in celery mixture; pour into casserole., Top with crumbs; sprinkle with cheese., Bake in preheated 375° oven until bubbly and brown.

title: Imperial Cookies
directions: Cream margarine and sugar; add soda and vinegar, then vanilla and flour., Drop by teaspoon on ungreased cookie sheet and bake for about 15 minutes at 300°.

title: Hot Sauce
directions: Place tomatoes with juice in bowl, mash tomatoes to desired consistency., Place jalapenos, onion and garlic in food processor and chop., In skillet, over low heat, place vinegar, oil and jalapeno mixture until warm to touch (do not boil)., Sprinkle with salt several times., Add tomatoes, stir well., Place in jars and refrigerate.

title: Israeli Salad
directions: Dice each vegetable into extremely small pieces., Add oil, then squeeze in the juice of 1 to 2 lemons depending on your taste., Add the salt, then add lemon, oil and salt based on how much salad you need., The salad should be tart and refreshing.

title: Chicken Enchilada(Microwave)
directions: In 2-quart casserole, mix all the ingredients., Microwave on High for 11 to 13 minutes., Rotate dish 1/2 turn; cook 5 minutes.

title: Candy Strawberries
directions: Combine jello, pecans and coconut., Stir in milk and vanilla. Chill 1 hour., Shape into strawberries., Roll in red sugar., If you wish, tint sliced almonds with green food coloring and insert in tops of berries to form leaves., Makes 1 pound, 3 ounces. Very pretty to use among Christmas goodies.

title: Coconut Cake
directions: In a medium-size bowl, put 1/2 cup of coconut, then add 4 tablespoons sugar and 3/4 cup of warm milk. Stir well until mixed. Poke cake all over with fork and then pour the milk mixture all over cake, then allow to cool and frost with frosting made from Cool Whip, sour cream, 1/4 cup of confectioners sugar and 1/2 cup of coconut. Then top with remaining coconut. Chill until time to serve. Cake needs at least 3 hours to saturate, but overnight in fridge is best.

title: Mashed Potato Hot Dish
