directions: Brown hamburger and drain grease., Peel, cut and boil potatoes., Mash potatoes., Add butter and milk; set aside., Drain green beans., Combine tomato soup, green beans and browned hamburger in a greased baking dish., Layer mashed potatoes on top of hamburger mixture., Spread evenly., Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes., Let set 5 minutes and serve.

title: Spiced Mocha Mix
directions: In large bowl, combine all ingredients., Store in airtight container., Makes 2 1/2 cups mix (12 to 14 servings).

title: Swedish Pineapple Nut Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients together with mixer., Pour into ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Deer Roast
directions: You will also need one oven baking bag.

title: Sugarless Apple Pie
directions: Heat apple juice and cornstarch in saucepan until thickened. Remove from heat., Stir in butter and cinnamon., Pour over apples in large bowl and mix carefully., Pour into pie crust and cover with second pie crust., Bake in oven at 375° for 45 minutes.

title: Cheese And Veggie Crescents
directions: Combine spinach or broccoli, cheese spread, bread crumbs and bacon in a 1 1/2-quart saucepan., Cook over low heat, stirring occasionally, until cheese is melted., Unroll dough, and separate into 16 triangles., Cut each triangle in half lengthwise so you'll have 32 triangles., Spread each triangle with about 1 teaspoon of mixture., Roll up, starting at wide end., Place on greased cookie sheets., Bake at 375° for 11 to 13 minutes or until golden brown. Makes 32 appetizers.

title: Ice Cream Cookies
directions: Whip Crisco, sugar, eggs and vanilla together., Mix flour, soda, cream of tartar and pinch of salt., Combine and drop by spoonful on greased cookie sheet., Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Tamale Pie Casserole
directions: Butter casserole dish., Spread ingredients in layers (Chili, cheese, Fritos, onion, tamales, cheese then repeat.)

title: Grits Casserole 2
directions: Cook grits in boiling water for 15 minutes., Mix all ingredients together and place in greased casserole., Bake at 400° for 30 minutes., Delicious with ham.

title: Orange Lemonade
directions: In medium saucepan, combine sugar and water., Cook over medium heat until sugar is dissolved, stirring constantly., Cool., Finely shred enough orange and lemon peel to make 2 tablespoons., Set aside., Squeeze juice from the lemons and 1 1/2 cups orange juice. Add juices and peel to the cooled syrup., If desired, pour over mint sprig, cover and let stand 1 hour., Strain mixture; pour into jars and cover., Refrigerate., To serve, fill glasses or pitcher with ice cubes., Pour equal amounts of fruit syrup and water over ice., Stir to combine., If desired, garnish with lemon slices. Makes 6 cups fruit syrup or 12 (8 ounce) servings of orange-lemonade.

title: Baked Beans
directions: Brown ground beef; drain. Stir in all ingredients. Put in casserole dish. Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Christmas House Fragrance
directions: Mix and bring to boil., Keep simmering., (Crock-pot is great.)

title: Microwave Fudge
directions: Mix, sugar, and, cocoa	in microwave-proof bowl., Place stick of butter in center of dry mix., Pour milk over., Do not try to mix!

title: Tomato Parmesan Salad
directions: In a small bowl or jar with a tight-fitting lid, combine oil, vinegar, garlic, salt and pepper; set aside., In a large salad bowl, combine all remaining ingredients., Chill until ready to serve.

title: Frito Chili Pie
directions: Cook ground beef and onion; drain. Add tomato juice, beans and seasoning mix; set aside. Layer casserole dish with chips, chili, cheese, chips, chili, cheese until all ingredients are used. Cook at 350° for 20 minutes or until cheese has melted.

title: Frozen Slush
directions: Mix in order given; put in Tupperware dish., Put in freezer. Whenever you want a slush, scrape with ice cream scoop.

title: Fudge Cookie Cake
directions: Put flour, sugar and salt in large bowl, set aside., Bring to a boil oleo, water, oil and cocoa, pour over flour mixture and stir until well mixed., In a small bowl beat the eggs, buttermilk, soda and vanilla., Stir into mixture and beat well., Pour into greased and floured jelly roll pan (10 x 15-inch) and bake 20 to 25 minutes at 350°.

title: Easy Chili
directions: Brown ground beef in frypan or pot., Remove from heat., Drain excess fat., Add remaining ingredients., Mix well., Simmer for 1/2 hour.

title: Low-Fat Bran-Apple Muffins
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., Coat 12 (2 3/4 inch) muffin tin cups with vegetable cooking spray; set aside., In small bowl, combine buttermilk, bran and baking soda; set aside., In mixer bowl, cream sugar, prune puree; beat in egg whites and molasses., Stir in buttermilk mixture, flour, apple and salt., Blend thoroughly. Spoon batter into prepared muffin cups, dividing equally., Bake about 20 minutes until pick inserted into center comes out clean. Cool in pan for 15 minutes., Turn onto rack to cool completely.

title: Taco Dip
directions: Cream the cheese and sour cream and spread on a platter., Add the taco seasoning to taste., Chop and spread on the cream cheese mixture: onion, lettuce and tomato., Spread the Cheddar cheese over the top., Use real "nachos" or Tostitos with dip.

title: Baking Dish Cobbler
directions: Butter a 9 or 10-inch pie dish at least 1 1/2 inches deep. Place peaches in dish., Spread bread evenly over peaches., Mix melted butter, sugar, flour and egg together until well blended. Pour evenly over bread, making sure all bread is covered., Bake in a 350° oven for 30 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Fried Apple Pies
directions: Add water to apples and cook until done., Add sugar, salt and spices and simmer until jelled., Refrigerate until used.

title: Almond Bark Candy
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Turn off and place pan in oven with peanut butter and Candi-Quick., Mix the next 3 ingredients and drop by teaspoon on wax paper.

title: Braised Bratwurst With Spicy Mustard Sauce
directions: About 30 minutes before serving, with sharp knife, score sausages for even cooking., In 12-inch skillet, over medium heat, cook sausages in apple cider until cider evaporates and sausages are browned and heated, turning sausages occasionally.

title: Chess Cake
directions: Mix ingredients., Bake at 350° in oblong pan until cake falls (or about 45 minutes)., Cool and cut into squares.

title: Garden Green Salad
directions: Combine first 6 ingredients in a large bowl., Toss well. Combine lemon juice and remaining ingredients in a jar., Cover tightly and shake vigorously., Pour over lettuce mixture., Toss gently., Yields, 4 servings.

title: Sugar-Free Apple Pie
directions: Combine first 5 ingredients in saucepan., Bring to boil, stirring constantly., When thickened, add apples., Pour into unbaked pie shell., Dot with butter., Cover with top crust., Cut slits for escape of steam., Bake at 375° for about 50 minutes or until crust is brown and juice bubbles through slits.

title: Lemon Bars
directions: Mix flour, butter, powdered sugar and salt., Pat in 8 x 8-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes (don't brown)., Beat the eggs, sugar, flour and lemon juice for 3 minutes., Pour over hot crust and bake 20 to 25 minutes more., When cool, sprinkle with powdered sugar., Double the recipe for 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Relish
directions: Grind first 5 ingredients in blender. Add 1/2 cup salt. Let stand for 2 hours. Drain dry or squeeze out. Add vinegar, sugar, mustard seed and celery seed. Mix well; pack into jars and seal. Makes 10 pints.

title: Funny Cake
directions: Cook 1 cup sugar, cocoa and water for a few minutes, then let cool., In another bowl, mix remaining ingredients together., Pour first mixture into unbaked pie crust, then drop second mix by spoonfuls., Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Pecan Roll
directions: Place milk, sugar, and butter in iron skillet and cook over medium heat. Stir until mixture turns brown and gets thick and sugary. Add pecans and vanilla flavoring. Pour into well buttered plate. Cut into squares before it is completely cool.

title: Grape Finger Jello
directions: Soften gelatin in juice and cold water., Add the boiling water and stir until gelatin dissolves., Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan coated with nonstick vegetable spray., Refrigerate until firm. Cut into squares and serve.

title: Belgian Pie
directions: Dissolve yeast and 1-1/2 teaspoons sugar in warm water; set aside until bubbly., Beat 2 eggs, 2 tablespoons sugar and salt. Add cream and butter., Beat., Add yeast mixture and slowly blend in flour., Mix well and let stand for 10 minutes., Divide into 5 or 6 parts., Form into balls., Press into greased pans, forming a 1/2 inch ridge around outside of the pan., Let rise 15 minutes., Pour rice, prune, poppy seed, apple, cherry or any cake and pastry filling over the center., Top with Cheese topping., Bake at 350 degrees for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Cajun Cabbage
directions: Cook the bacon in iron skillet until crisp., Add the onion and peppers., Add the remaining ingredients., Simmer for 45 minutes.

title: Pumpkin Bread
directions: Mix all ingredients, except nuts, together with mixer until smooth., Add nuts., Pour into greased loaf pan., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes, or until done.

title: Oriental Grilled Chicken
directions: Cut chicken breasts in half., Mix remaining ingredients together in a shallow pan large enough to hold breasts in one layer., Place breasts in marinade, turning to coat and rubbing marinade into breasts., Marinate at least one hour and as long as overnight., Grill chicken over hot coals or under broiler., Strain marinade, bring it to a boil and serve it with chicken., Yield:, 4 servings., Carbohydrate 5 g, protein 21 g, fat 5 g, calories 186.

title: Pork Chops Au Gratin
directions: Brown the pork chops., Meanwhile, mix remaining ingredients and put into large casserole dish., Place browned pork chops on top., Cover and bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Soft Sour Cream Cookies
directions: Cream together sugar and shortening, add eggs and sour cream. Mix well. Add vanilla., Combine flour, baking powder and soda. Add to creamed mixture slowly. After well mixed, set overnight in refrigerator. Roll out on a floured surface., Cut into shapes. Bake at 350° for 8-10 minutes. Frost and decorate.

title: Play Dough
directions: Mix flour and cream of tartar in pan., Add water, food coloring and oil., Stir over medium heat 3 to 5 minutes., Don't worry if globby., Keep stirring until ball forms in center of pot. Take out and put on floured surface., Squish and punch a bit (kneading)., Keep in plastic bag or airtight container., Keep in refrigerator.

title: Mexican Fiesta Pie
directions: Heat oven to 400°., Lightly grease a 9-inch square pan or 1 1/2-quart shallow casserole dish., Layer half the corn chips, chili, onion and cheese in pan; repeat., Bake, uncovered, at 400° for 15 minutes or until hot., Garnish with lettuce, tomatoes and olives., Makes 4 servings.

title: Key Lime Pie
directions: Preheat oven to 325°., In large mixer bowl, beat egg yolks with Eagle Brand, ReaLime and food coloring (if desired)., Pour into prepared pastry shell., Bake for 30 minutes., Cool; chill. Top with whipped cream., Garnish as desired., (Refrigerate leftovers.)

title: "Cheaters" Mexican Bake
directions: Spray 9 x 13 baking pan with nonstick spray and line bottom with burritos, which have been cut into thirds. Mix chili and salsa together and pour over burritos. Sprinkle cheese on top and bake at 350° until hot and bubbly.

title: Pineapple Casserole
directions: Place pineapple chunks in bottom of glass 10 x 13-inch casserole dish., Mix sugar and flour together and sprinkle over pineapple., Then layer cheese and crushed crackers to form top layer., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until bubbly hot.

title: Dilly Beans
directions: Trim beans and pack in 4 pint canning jars. Add 1 garlic clove and 1/4 teaspoon cayenne and dill to each jar. Boil salt, water and vinegar. Pour into jars. Cover jars with canning lids. Process 10 minutes. These are great addition to a relish tray and good in Bloody Marys.

title: Irish Soda Bread
directions: Bake 35 minutes in cast-iron pot or medium cast-iron frypan at 350°.

title: Buttermilk Biscuits
directions: Mix thoroughly., Knead 10 times., Cut and bake at 450° for 12 minutes.

title: Green Rice
directions: Toss rice and spinach together., Add eggs, milk, worcestershire sauce and salt., Pour into ungreased casserole., Sprinkle butter and cheese over rice., Heat oven to 325°., Bake uncovered for 30 minutes.

title: Marinated Vegetables
directions: Mix all together green beans, peas, corn, celery, onion, pimentos and bell pepper and cover with Italian dressing, oil, vinegar and sugar.

title: Milky Way Cake
directions: Cream butter and sugar until mixture is light and fluffy., Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition., Add flour and baking soda alternately with milk, stirring until smooth., Add melted candy, mixing well., Stir in vanilla and nuts., Pour into greased 10-inch tube pan., Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 20 minutes. Cool a few minutes and remove.

title: Arame (Sea Vegetable) And Carrots
directions: *Arame is available at the Grainery and at Mellon Produce.

title: Mike'S Ice Cream
directions: Combine all., Leave plain or add whatever fruit desired. Freeze in ice cream freezer., Delicious!

title: Fresh Fruit Salad
directions: Cut up fruit., Mix it in a bowl., Mix 3 teaspoons of plain yogurt and 1 teaspoon of vanilla with fruit.

title: Chicken And Rice Casserole
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Mix bouillon and water., Sprinkle rice over bottom of a casserole dish., Chop onion, green pepper and place on top of rice., Place butter pats on top of green peppers and onion., Pour bouillon mixture over casserole., Put chicken on top of rice mixture., Pour the mushroom soup over the chicken. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes., Ovens can vary, so use your own judgement.

title: No Peek Stew
directions: Put raw meat in bottom of 9 x 13-inch baking pan., Place raw vegetables on top of meat., Combine salt, sugar, tapioca and pepper; sprinkle evenly over veggies., Pour juice evenly over top. Cover with heavy duty foil and crimp edges to seal tightly., Bake at 250 degrees for 5 hours and Don't Peek!

title: Cole Slaw, Frozen
directions: Shred cabbage; add salt and set for 1 hour., Mix sugar, vinegar, water, celery and mustard seed., Boil for 1 minute., Let cool., Add pepper and carrot to cabbage., Pour mixture over cabbage., Mix well., Put in containers and freeze., Will keep in refrigerator a week or more.

title: Quick Yellow Split Pea Soup
directions: Bring water with all ingredients to a boil., Reduce to medium-low., Simmer 30 minutes., Add rice or barley during last 10 to 20 minutes of cooking.

title: Blt Macaroni Salad
directions: Cook macaroni; drain and rinse in cold water. In a large bowl, combine the macaroni, green onions, tomato and celery. In a small bowl, combine mayonnaise, vinegar, salt and pepper. Pour over macaroni mixture and toss to coat. Cover and chill for at least 2 hours. Just before serving, add bacon. Yield: 12 servings.

title: Zucchini Muffins
directions: Beat eggs until light and foamy., Add oil, sugar, vanilla and zucchini., Into a separate bowl, sift the dry ingredients., Add dry ingredients to zucchini mixture, along with nuts., Pour into greased muffin tins or use muffin papers., Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes., Yield:, 2 dozen.

title: Ground Beef Basic Mix
directions: Melt margarine in 8-quart pan over low flame., Add ground beef; turn flame to medium and cook until red color disappears. Add onion, celery and green pepper; cook until beef is brown and vegetables are tender., Add soup, tomato sauce, salt and pepper; cover and simmer for 30 to 45 minutes, stirring occasionally. Cool and divide equally into 5 freezer containers., May be thawed and used in a variety of recipes.

title: Anise Oil Cookies
directions: Mix together butter and sugar., Add egg, wine, vanilla and anise oil., Sift flour, baking powder, salt and remaining ingredients and mix together., Put in refrigerator overnight. Take out and roll out with cookie cutters., Grease pan and bake at 350° for 3 minutes.

title: Valley Fresh Chicken Salad
directions: Combine all ingredients., Cover and chill before serving.

title: Stuffed Pork Chops
directions: Have butcher cut loin chops with a pocket for the stuffing. Brown onion in butter., Combine with bread crumbs, raisins, salt and seasoning., Stuff pockets with stuffing., Place in an 8-inch square baking pan., Bake at 350° for 2 hours.

title: Chicken-Rice Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients in casserole dish and bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Grandma'S Hamburger Casserole
directions: Brown, hamburger, meat, on, stove;, season as you wish. Layer the, hamburger,, potatoes and onions in casserole dish. Pour can of cream of mushroom soup over mixture., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Hot Sponge Cake
directions: Beat eggs; beat in sugar., Beat in flour., Melt butter in milk and pour over dry ingredients., Add vanilla., Bake in 10-inch square pan at 350° for 25 minutes., May frost or serve plain with fruit, such as strawberries.

title: Ozark Pudding
directions: Mix sugar, egg, flour, salt, baking powder and vanilla., Add apples and nuts and mix well., Bake in greased pie tin at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Vanilla Cookies
directions: Cream margarine and sugar., Add eggs and vanilla and beat until mixture is a light lemon color., Add flour and mix well. Form dough in 1-inch balls and place 2 inches apart on lightly oiled cookie sheet., Flatten with a fork., Bake in a preheated oven at 350° for 10 to 15 minutes or lightly browned.

title: Deviled Eggs
directions: Mix egg yolks and all other ingredients well., Spoon into egg whites and chill.

title: Sausage Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients thoroughly., Pack into a 2-quart casserole dish., Pour 1/2 cup of water over top., Cover and bake at 325° for 1 hour and 30 minutes.

title: Garlic Cheese Grits
directions: Cook grits in water and salt., Melt cheese and margarine together., Beat eggs., Finish cup with milk., Mix all ingredients together., Pour in large casserole., Bake in 350° oven for 45 minutes.

title: Cabbage Meat Loaf
directions: Mix ingredients together., Bake at 350° as you would for any meat loaf., Time depends on thickness of loaf., Drain juice off as it bakes., Cabbage will produce extra liquid.

title: Lemon Snowdrops
directions: In a mixing bowl, cream butter and sugar; add extract., Sift together flour and salt; add to creamed mixture and mix well. Roll level teaspoonfuls into balls., Place 1 inch apart on ungreased cookie sheets; flatten slightly., Bake at 350° for 8-10 minutes.

title: Delicious Bread Pudding #1
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Put bread crumbs in 1 1/2-quart baking dish., Blend in remaining ingredients and stir., Place baking dish in pan of hot water, about 1-inch deep, and bake for 45 to 50 minutes, until knife inserted comes out clean., Great for holidays!

title: Oriental Marinade
directions: Mix first 4 ingredients together and pour over uncooked fish or meat., Marinate in refrigerator at least 4 hours., Grill, broil, saute, stir-fry or bake as you desire., Grilling seems to bring out the best flavors., Marinade may be heated and thickened with cornstarch and served as a sauce.

title: Dirt
directions: Crush Oreos in a blender or food processor., Mix pudding with 3 cups ice water and set aside., Mix powdered sugar, cream cheese, Cool Whip and margarine together; then add pudding., Line a container with 1/2 of the Oreo cookie crumbs., Pour pudding mixture into crumb-lined container., Top with remaining cookie crumbs., Freeze overnight or at least 3 hours., Take out of the freezer 30 minutes before serving.

title: Cream Of Broccoli Soup
directions: Fry together butter and onion until brown., Add flour and stir., Add canned soup, milk and broccoli., Simmer 15 minutes or until broccoli is cooked., Add shredded Cheddar cheese and simmer 10 minutes.

title: Fruit Salad
directions: Drain peaches and pineapple. Mix all together. Garnish with cherries and pecans. Chill.

title: Meatballs
directions: Mix together., Form balls and drop into sauce; cook at least 30 minutes.

title: Cottage Cheese Spoon Bread
directions: Scald milk in saucepan., Add cornmeal and cook, stirring constantly until thick., Mix in sugar and salt., Mix small amount of hot cornmeal mixture with egg yolks; return to saucepan and mix thoroughly., Stir in butter and cottage cheese., Beat egg whites until stiff., Gradually fold in cornmeal mixture., Pour into baking dish and bake 35 minutes., Serve with melted butter.

title: Cream Of Potato Soup(Heart Smart)
directions: In medium saucepan over medium to high heat, melt margarine. Add onion and celery., Cook about 4 minutes or until soft, stirring frequently., Add potatoes, chicken broth, parsley, thyme, celery seed, salt and pepper., Bring to a boil., Reduce heat and cover., Simmer about 15 minutes or until potatoes are almost tender., Add milk., Simmer, uncovered, 5 minutes, stirring occasionally., In blender at medium speed, blend about 1/4 of the mixture at a time until smooth., Return to saucepan, heat about 1 minute., Makes 4 servings, about 1 cup each.

title: Fried Corn
directions: Fry bacon; set aside., Leave fat from bacon in skillet., Hold ear of corn perpendicular to cutting board., With sharp knife, slice downward, cutting off tip ends of kernels, then scrape milk out of remaining kernels., Heat bacon fat in skillet., Add scraped corn and kernel tips., Fry lightly for 3 minutes, stirring constantly., Add enough milk to make creamed corn consistency. Add butter., Cook another 5 minutes., Add salt and pepper to taste., Pour in serving dish and sprinkle crushed bacon over all. Serves 6.

title: Blackberry Cake
directions: Cream butter, sugar and eggs., Add flour alternately with milk., Add spices and cocoa., Fold in blackberries., Batter will be thick., Spoon batter into loaf pan., Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Crackle Snappers
directions: Melt chocolate morsels over hot, not boiling, water., Remove from heat and set aside., Combine shortening, 1/2 cup sugar and egg and beat until creamy., Blend in melted chocolate and corn syrup. Sift together flour, baking soda, cinnamon and salt and stir in gradually., Add nuts and mix well., Shape into balls using 1 level tablespoonful for each., Roll balls in about 1/4 cup sugar., Place 3 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet., Bake at 350° for 15 minutes., Yields 3 dozen 3-inch cookies.

title: Sausage Appetizers
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Drop onto baking sheet., Bake at 325° until golden brown.

title: Apple Or Peach Crisp
directions: Mix sugar, flour and egg., Will be dry and crumbly., Sprinkle over fruit., Melt 1 stick margarine., Pour over., Bake 30 minutes.

title: Orange Cookies
directions: Cream butter and sugar., Add eggs., Mix soda with sour cream and add to egg mixture., Add all dry ingredients and orange rind. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto cookie sheet., Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Chocolate Pizza
directions: Melt chocolate in microwave on High 3 minutes., Stir until all is melted., Stir in marshmallows, cereal and peanuts., Pour onto greased or Saran Wrap covered 12-inch pizza pan or smaller plates. Top with red cherries and 1 green for leaf., Sprinkle with coconut. Melt remaining white bark and shortening., Drizzle over coconut. Chill 15 minutes in freezer.

title: Pie Crust
directions: Put flour, sugar and milk in the middle of the pie pan., Add oil and mix., Makes a soft ball of dough., Press to bottom and sides of pan evenly.

title: Mother'S Rice Refrigerator Rolls
directions: Scald milk; stir in sugar, salt and shortening., Cool to lukewarm., Dissolve yeast in warm water., Add rice to milk, then add the yeast and eggs., Add about half of the flour and stir until mixed well., Add enough of remaining flour to make a very stiff dough., Stir until dough leaves the sides of bowl., Knead until smooth., Place dough in large greased bowl., Brush dough with melted shortening, cover and refrigerate for at least 12 hours. Remove from refrigerator 3 to 4 hours before baking., Shape, let rise and bake at 425° for 12 to 15 minutes for rolls., Can be made into loaves and baked at 350° for 30 minutes or until brown., Makes 2 loaves., Dough can be kept in refrigerator for 3 to 4 days.

title: Cinnamon Apple Jello
directions: Dissolve jello and candy in boiling water., When cool, stir in lemon juice, applesauce and salt., Pour into mold.

title: Chocolate Scotcheroos
directions: Combine sugar and syrup in a 3-quart saucepan., Cook over moderate heat, stirring frequently, until mixture begins to bubble., Remove from heat., Stir in peanut butter; mix well., Add Rice Krispies; stir until well blended., Press mixture into buttered 13 x 9-inch pan.

title: Trout Meuniere
directions: Roll trout in seasoned flour., Heat oil in frypan and add trout which should be gently cooked and browned on both sides. When thoroughly cooked, transfer trout to heated serving platter and keep hot.

title: Shrimp Dip
directions: Mix all ingredients together until smooth., Chill.

title: Diabetic Cookies
directions: Combine dates, raisins, apples and water., Bring to a boil for 3 minutes. Cool and add remaining ingredients. Chill dough., Drop by teaspoonfuls on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Chocolate Pie
directions: Mix well and cook over medium heat until thick., Pour into cooked pie shell., Add egg topping which consist of 3 egg whites, 1 Tbsp. sugar, and 1/4 tsp. vanilla flavoring whipped together. Place in oven on 325 degrees until topping browns.

title: White Bread
directions: Scald milk. Stir in sugar, salt and shortening. Cool to lukewarm., Pour warm water into bowl. Sprinkle yeast and dissolve. Add milk mixture. Stir half the flour into mixture, then add rest of flour and combine., Turn dough onto floured surface and knead. Put into greased bowl., Brush with melted shortening., Cover and let rise 1 hour and 20 minutes. Punch down. Divide into 2 equal parts., Knead., Place in loaf pan., Let rise 55 minutes., Bake at 400° for 50 minutes., Makes 2 loaves.

title: Gin Punch
directions: Pour over block of ice in a large punch bowl. Garnish with slices of orange and lemon.

title: White Trash
directions: Mix cereal, raisins and peanuts in a large container., Over low heat, melt margarine, peanut butter and chocolate morsels, stirring well., Remove from stove and cool; pour over cereal mixture and mix well., Place mixture in large paper bag; pour in confectioners sugar and shake until it is coated., Store in an airtight container., Enough for a crowd.

title: Sesame Loaf
directions: Saute onions and celery in 1/2 cup water until tender., Blend sunflower seeds and sesame seed., In bowl, mix together the oatmeal, blended seed, pecan meal, yeast, onion powder, garlic powder, Soy Supreme, bread crumbs, then add soy sauce, onions and celery., Add water; mix well., Bake in sprayed baking dish at 325° for 60 minutes until brown., Serve with Creamy Cashew Gravy.

title: Applesauce Nut Cookies
directions: Cream shortening and sugars., Add egg and mix thoroughly. Sift flour, cinnamon, salt, soda and baking powder together., Add to creamed mixture, blending well., Add applesauce, nuts, raisins and vanilla., Drop by teaspoon onto a cookie sheet about 1 1/2 inches apart., Bake in a hot oven (400°) for about 10 minutes or until brown.

title: Berry Whirl
directions: Combine the strawberries, pineapple, raspberries and limeade concentrate in a blender container or food processor. Process until smooth. Pour into 2 goblets. Serve immediately.

title: Banana Nut Bread
directions: Mix all ingredients thoroughly., Bake in greased and floured pans, about 1 hour, in 350° oven.

title: Orange-Clove Dried Tea Mix
directions: Dry peel in 200° oven., Store in airtight jar.

title: Mushroom-Chicken Cutlets
directions: Combine crumbs, Parmesan cheese, parsley flakes and garlic salt., Mix eggs and water together., Dip each chicken cutlet into egg mixture, then into crumb mixture., Heat oil in large skillet and brown cutlets on each side until golden brown., Remove to flat baking dish., Saute mushrooms briefly in same skillet; spoon over cutlets., Combine melted butter and lemon juice; pour over chicken and mushrooms., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes., Serves 4.

title: Pumpkin-Pecan Bread
directions: Combine flour, soda, salt, sugar, cinnamon, nutmeg and allspice in large mixing bowl., Make a deep well in center., Add pumpkin, eggs, oil, water, pecans and raisins., Mix just enough to moisten all ingredients.

title: Stanley Surprise
directions: Mix ingredients and spread on English muffins., Bake at 400° until bubbles appear, about 15 minutes.

title: Hush Puppies
directions: Mix dry ingredients., Add enough milk to make dough stiff enough to drop from a teaspoon into hot deep fat., Cook until brown and drain on paper towels.

title: Chicken Jambalaya
directions: Season chicken with salt and pepper., Brown in oil., Remove chicken and saute onions and garlic until soft., Add chicken and 20 cups of water., Bring to a boil and add salt, pepper and Tabasco., Add rice., Bring to a boil and reduce heat to a simmer. Stir twice while cooking., Cook until water is absorbed and chicken is tender., Yields 24 servings.

title: Uncooked, Fresh Peach Pie
directions: Combine peaches, sugar and lemon juice; let stand for 1 hour. Drain and measure 1 cup syrup., Add cornstarch to syrup and blend. Cook over low heat until thick., Add salt, butter and flavoring; cool., Put peaches in shell., Cover with sauce., Serve with whipping cream or ice cream.

title: Apple Casserole
directions: Combine cheese, flour, margarine and sugar., Mix until creamy. Drain apples and pour into baking dish., Spread cheese mixture over top., Pour canned milk over the top of this., Bake approximately 30 minutes at 350° or until well browned.

title: Baked Beans
directions: Mix together well. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Ricotta Cheese Cake
directions: Follow directions on cake box and pour into a 9 x 13-inch greased pan., Beat cheese, sugar, vanilla and eggs., Spread over cake batter., Bake at 350° for 1 hour., Cool., Sprinkle with powdered sugar and enjoy.

title: Lemon Chicken
directions: In a skillet, cook chicken, onion, carrot and garlic in butter until chicken is lightly browned, about 5 minutes.

title: Aunt Lena'S Chocolate Topping
directions: Mix cocoa, sugar and salt., Add hot water first before cream; cook for 10 minutes at boil., Remove from heat., Add butter and vanilla; beat with mixer until cool.

title: Asparagus Casserole
directions: Mix soup, milk, cheese and 1/2 the eggs together., Gently toss with asparagus., Top with remaining eggs and a little more cheese, crackers and a few pats of butter., Bake at 375° until hot and bubbly.

title: Hot Choco-Mallow Mix
directions: Combine dry ingredients in a bowl., Stir in marshmallows. Store in an airtight container with these serving instructions: Combine 1/4 cup mix and 6 ounces boiling water in a mug., Stir and serve.

title: Bagna Cauda(Northern Italian Antipasto)
directions: Heat butter or margarine and olive oil in saucepan., Add anchovy and garlic., Cook on low heat, stirring constantly (if using fillets, ensure they dissolve to a paste)., Transfer to a fondue pot over fondue burner.

title: Slim Jim Chili
directions: Brown meat and onion in Dutch oven; drain., Add remaining ingredients., Simmer, covered, 1 to 2 hours., Remove bay leaf. Serve hot., Freezes well., Can use crock-pot., Makes 8 (1 cup) servings with 156 calories each.

title: Molded White Bean Pate
directions: Place drained kidney beans in a medium bowl and mash thoroughly with a fork., Saute garlic in olive oil until lightly golden, about 30 seconds., Do not let it brown., Mix the garlic and the beans and all other ingredients except 1 tablespoon parsley.

title: Aunt Mary'S Fruit Punch
directions: Mix the first 5 ingredients real good., Then, add the recommended amount of water for each can of orange juice and mix well., After this, I usually put 1 quart of water and 1 cup of sugar and then stir and taste., I continue putting 1 quart of water and then some sugar (doesn't have to be a cup each time, maybe 1/2 cup) and taste each time until I get it to taste like I want it., Everyone has their own taste.

title: Pinwheel Date Cookies
directions: To prepare filling, cook brown sugar, water and dates for 5 minutes, then add nuts., Allow to cool., To prepare dough, cream butter and sugar., Add eggs, then salt and flour, mixing until dough like., Roll out dough and spread on the filling as for jelly rolls., Roll up, chill, slice and bake at 400° until done.

title: Fabulous Fruit Salad
directions: All fruits must be fresh, not canned or frozen., Prepare and slice all fruit into bite size pieces., Mix instant pudding mix powder (not prepared) with fruit and refrigerate overnight in sealed bowl., Before serving the next day, toss lightly, mixing thoroughly., The juice and pudding mix make a nice fruit pudding.

title: Newport Seafood Bake
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Make white sauce with margarine, flour, milk and seasonings., Add cheese, stirring until melted., Cook fish; skin, bone and cut in pieces., Add fish, shrimp, lobster and sherry to sauce., Pour into 2-quart casserole., Toss crumbs with margarine; sprinkle on top of casserole., Bake at 350° for 25 minutes., Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Millionaire Candy
directions: Place caramels and water in double boiler and stir to dissolve., Pur over pecans., Make in flat round balls., Put on buttered platter and refrigerate for several hours.

title: Cheesy Chicken Crescent Supper
directions: Combine chicken and 1/3 cheese soup., Roll up in crescent rolls., Heat remaining ingredients., Pour 1/2 of soup mixture on jelly roll pan., Arrange rolls on top of mixture and pour remaining soup mixture on triangles., Bake for 20 to 25 minutes at 375°.

title: Dream Bars
directions: Combine all ingredients with pastry blender or in food processor until crumbly., Pat into 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake at 375° for 10 minutes.

title: Pita Bread
directions: Mix ingredients together and add more flour if necessary., Make into 2 balls., Knead each ball, then divide into 12 smaller balls. Cover., Let rise about 30 to 40 minutes., Flatten balls to about 6 inches in diameter with rolling pin on a lightly floured board. Cover and let rise slightly., Flip the dough so that the bottom side of the bread dough is on the top side of baking sheets. Preheat oven as hot as it bakes., Place sheet on lowest rack., Bake about 2 to 4 minutes., Makes 24 pita breads.

title: Country Fair Corn Sticks
directions: Preheat oven to 400°., Grease well 14 corn stick molds., Place in oven while preparing batter., In large bowl, mix corn meal, flour, sugar, baking powder and salt., In small skillet, add oil and cook pepper and onions until tender., Remove skillet from heat., Stir in corn and milk, then egg until mixed; stir into dry ingredients until batter is just blended., Spoon batter into preheated molds., Bake 15 minutes or until done., Cool in molds on wire rack 5 minutes., Remove from molds.

title: Pork Chop Scallop
directions: Trim excess fat from chops., Grease 10-inch skillet with fat. Brown chops on both sides; season with salt and pepper., Remove chops from skillet., Empty potatoes and seasoned sauce packet into skillet., Stir in pimiento and amounts of milk and water called for on package., Heat to boiling, stirring occasionally., Reduce heat; place pork chops on top., Cover and simmer 30 to 35 minutes or until potatoes are tender.

title: Cornflake Cookies
directions: Mix sugar and syrup., Bring to a rapid boil., Remove from heat., Stir in peanut butter. Put cornflakes in a large bowl and pour syrup mixture over cornflakes., Stir until coated., Drop by teaspoonful onto waxed paper., Let cool.

title: Chocolate Pie
directions: Mix sugar, cornstarch, cocoa, salt, milk and egg yolks together., Cook in microwave until thick, about 8 minutes, on High., Add oleo and vanilla and beat until smooth., Put in cooked pie shell.

title: Spinach Casserole
directions: Thaw and drain spinach; set aside., Saute onion and garlic in butter., Add mushroom soup, salt, pepper, mushrooms, spinach and eggs., Place in buttered casserole dish., Top with bread crumbs and Parmesan cheese., Bake 20 to 30 minutes or until bubbly at 350°.

title: Sad Cake Squares
directions: Combine coconut, baking mix, brown sugar and nuts., Add eggs. Mix with spoon., Do not overmix!, Bake in greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan for 40 minutes at 325°., Cool., Cut into squares.

title: Tuna Cheese Wedges
directions: Drain and flake tuna., Add a few drops of Worcestershire sauce., Add all ingredients together and spread over 12 English muffins.

title: Scallops, Shrimp And Snow Peas
directions: Saute shrimp and scallops in small batches in a wok until done (shrimp first, then scallops; scallops take a few minutes to cook)., Set aside in dish, keeping warm., Put a bit more oil in wok., Quickly saute garlic, green onions and peppers, then add snow peas and continue sauteing., Saute until peas are bright green and are cooked, yet crunchy., Add scallops and shrimp., Add broth, soy sauce and spices., Thicken with a mixture of cornstarch and water (1/2 cup water and 1 tablespoon cornstarch)., Cook for about 7 minutes., Serve over rice.

title: Broccoli Soup
directions: Melt butter in heavy saucepan., Add onion and cook until transparent; do not brown., Wash and trim broccoli, peeling the stems., Add sliced broccoli, potatoes and broth to onion in pan. Bring to boil and season., Simmer, covered, until broccoli is tender, 20 to 30 minutes., Add parsley last 3 minutes., Drain broth from cooked vegetables and puree the broccoli mixture in blender., Combine with broth and refrigerate., When ready to serve, stir in the half and half., This soup may be served hot or cold.

title: Squash Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients well, using 1/2 cup grated cheese., Put in casserole dish., Put 1/2 cup grated cheese on top of casserole. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes at 400°.

title: Blueberry-Lemon Muffins
directions: Stir together flour, sugar, baking powder and 3/4 teaspoon salt., Combine egg, milk and oil., Add all at once to flour mixture., Stir until moistened., Fold in blueberries which have been mixed with 2 tablespoons sugar, the peel of 1 lemon and the juice of that lemon.

title: Bran Muffins
directions: Combine and let stand Bran Buds and boiling water., Cream sugar, margarine, eggs, then add buttermilk, flour sifted with baking soda, salt and All-Bran cereal., Add first mixture of bran buds and boiling water and combine with second mixture.

title: Cheesy Potatoes
directions: Peel, cut and boil potatoes until tender., Cook remaining ingredients slowly in double boiler until cheese melts., Pour cheese sauce over potatoes in greased 9 x 13-inch pan., Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese., Bake 45 minutes at 350°., For a spicier dish, use Mexican Velveeta.

title: Best Yet Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients by hand. Pour into a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan (greased only)., Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

title: Cherried Cranberries
directions: Put all ingredients and 1 cup water in heavy 4-quart pan. Bring to boil over medium heat., Cover and simmer gently for 15 minutes., Do not uncover during cooking or cooling., Store in jars in refrigerator.

title: Crawfish Etouffee
directions: Saute onions and sweet peppers in butter or margarine for 5 minutes., Add cream of mushroom soup., Add few tablespoons of water, if necessary., Add scallions, parsley, salt, pepper and paprika to taste., Add crawfish tails; cook 5 minutes or until done., Serve over white rice.

title: Italian Sausage And Bean Soup
directions: Cut sausage into 1/2-inch pieces; brown in large heavy saucepan over medium heat., Drain off all but 1 tablespoon fat. Stir in onions; cook 5 to 8 minutes, stirring occasionally, until soft, but not browned., Stir in garlic and celery; cook until soft, 5 to 8 minutes., Stir in cabbage, tomatoes, beans, chicken broth, thyme, basil, oregano and bay leaf., Cover and bring to a boil., Simmer 30 minutes., Discard bay leaf., Stir in almonds.

title: Sausage-Egg Bake
directions: Spread bread cubes in buttered 7 x 11-inch baking dish., Layer sausage and cheese over bread., Combine eggs and mustard with 1 generous cup of milk in a, bowl, beating well., Pour over sausage and cheese., Blend 1/4 cup of milk with soup until smooth., Pour over all., Bake at 325° for 30 to 35 minutes., Yields 6 servings, about 350 calories each.

title: Sweet And Sour Pork Chops
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., In large ovenproof skillet, brown chops in oil., Remove chops from skillet., Pour off fat., In skillet, combine ReaLemon and cornstarch., Mix well., Add sugar, onion, soy sauce and bouillon., Let bouillon dissolve., Add pork chops and carrots., Cover., Bake 1 hour or until tender., Add pineapple chunks., Cover and bake 10 minutes longer., Garnish with green pepper., Serve with rice if desired., Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Chocolate Pie
directions: Mix sugar, flour and cocoa and add enough milk to make it like a paste., Then add the egg yolks and beat well., Then add the balance of the milk and cook on top of the stove until thick., Add butter and vanilla., Pour into baked pie shell.

title: Golden Parmesan Potatoes
directions: Pare and quarter potatoes., Combine flour, cheese, salt and pepper in a bag., Moisten potatoes with water and shake a few at a time in the bag, coating potatoes well with cheese mixture., Melt butter in a 9 x 13-inch baking pan., Place potatoes in pan., Bake at 375 ° for about 1 hour, turning once during baking when golden brown.

title: Blueberry Muffins
directions: Preheat oven to 400°. Grease (12) muffin tin. Beat egg, then stir in milk and oil. Blend dry ingredients, then add the wet ingredients, stirring until moist. Add berries and fold in. Fill tins and bake for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: One Pot Dinner
directions: Brown beef; drain and put in cooker., Brown bacon and onion; drain., Add to cooker., Add remaining ingredients., Cook on low 4 to 6 hours.

title: Yummy Balls
directions: Mix all ingredients, except soup; shape into balls and place on a greased baking dish., Pour the soup, thinned with water over the Yummy Balls and bake for 1 hour at 375°.

title: Top Of The Stove Baked Beans
directions: Brown together ground beef with onion powder., Drain off excess grease., Mix together with all other ingredients., Stir and simmer until thick.

title: Butter Rum Cake
directions: Mix first 6 ingredients in a large bowl and beat until smooth. Pour into well-greased Bundt pan and bake at 350° for 45 minutes. Mix last 4 ingredients together in a saucepan and bring to a boil., Poke holes in cake while still in pan and hot., Pour glaze over cake and let set for 30 minutes., Remove from pan and serve.

title: Chicken-Rice Bake
directions: In bowl, stir together mushroom soup, milk, dry onion soup mix and undrained mushrooms., Reserve 1/2 cup of the soup mixture and set aside., Stir uncooked rice and thawed vegetables into remaining soup mixture.

title: Apple Candy Pie
directions: Put apples in baking dish (greased) and sprinkle with cinnamon and 1/2 cup brown sugar., Add water., Melt butter and add it to 1/2 cup brown sugar and flour., Mix well and put on top of apple mixture, patting it down firmly., Bake 3/4 hour to one hour in 350° oven., Serve with cream.

title: Quick Lunch Box Cake
directions: In large mixing bowl, combine all ingredients except chocolate and nuts., Blend at low speed until moistened; beat 2 minutes at medium speed, scraping bowl occasionally., Add chocolate and nuts and mix., Pour batter into greased and floured 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes or until cake springs back when touched lightly in center.

title: Chicken Taco Casserole
directions: Boil chicken breasts., (Skin, debone and tear into small pieces.), Mix chicken pieces, cream of chicken soup (not diluted), onions and peppers., Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan with corn oil. Layer chips, soup mixture and cheese until soup mixture is gone. Final layer of chips and sprinkle top with cheese., Cover with foil., Cook at 350° for 30 minutes., Remove foil; cook for 5 more minutes., Allow to cool for 10 minutes and serve.

title: Whole Wheat Muffins
directions: Mix all dry ingredients thoroughly (do not sift). Add shortening, unbeaten egg and sour milk., Beat only until smooth. Fill well oiled muffin tins 2/3 full. Bake in hot oven at 425° about 25 minutes.

title: Hard Candy
directions: Mix first 3 ingredients in a large saucepan., Stir over medium heat until sugar dissolves., Boil, without stirring, until temperature reaches 310° or until drops of syrup form hard, brittle threads in cold water., Remove from heat., After boiling has ceased, stir in flavoring and coloring., Pour onto lightly greased cookie sheet., Cool and break into pieces., Store in airtight containers.

title: Peanut Buster Dessert
directions: Mix together butter and pat 3/4 of the cookie crumbs in a 9 x 13-inch pan., Cover with 1/2 gallon of vanilla ice cream that has been softened., Put in freezer until firm., Before serving, cover with fudge topping (not syrup); sprinkle with peanuts and cover with Cool Whip., Use the 1/4 cup of Oreo cookies on top.

title: Peach Salad
directions: Bring pineapple, water and sugar to a boil; remove from heat. Add jellos., Chill until partially set., Whip slightly before adding other ingredients.

title: Blueberry Pie (Low-Fat)
directions: Place first 3 ingredients in a saucepan and bring to a good boil., Heat oven to 350°., Melt oleo in a Dutch oven., Mix together flour, sugar, baking powder, milk and vanilla and pour mixture over oleo., Using a cup, pour berries over the mixture. Bake at 350° until done, about 40 minutes.

title: Crescent Cheese Danish
directions: Grease 9 x 13-inch pan., Lay out 1 package of rolls in bottom of pan., Pinch seams together., Mix cream cheese, 1 egg and 1 yolk, sugar and vanilla., Mix well., Spoon over rolls., Take other package of rolls and spread on top., (I lay rolls out on waxed paper first so I can push out to right size.), Brush slightly whipped egg white on top., Sprinkle with 2 tablespoons of sugar. Bake at 350° for 35 minutes., Chill., Great for breakfast or as dessert.

title: Allison'S Peach Crisp
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Put peach slices in square casserole dish., In separate bowl, work together the sugar, flour, salt, cinnamon, nutmeg and margarine until crumbly., Add the lemon rind and mix., Sprinkle over top of fruit., Bake, uncovered, in a 350° oven until the peaches are tender and the top is browned., This takes about 20 to 30 minutes., Enjoy!, Serves 6 to 8 people.

title: Turkey Barbecue(40 Mini Sandwiches)
directions: Brown ground turkey in large skillet or saucepan; drain., Stir in remaining ingredients, except buns., Bring to a boil., Reduce heat to low., Simmer 15 to 20 minutes or until thickened., Serve in buns.

title: Belleville Gooey Bars
directions: Melt margarine in a 13 x 9-inch pan., Mix cake mix and 1 egg until crumbly., Press into bottom of pan., Mix the cream cheese, eggs, lemon juice and sugar (except for 1 tablespoon of the sugar) and pour onto cake., Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes. Sprinkle with reserved sugar and cool. Cut into squares.

title: Cheese Vegetable Soup
directions: Cook veggies to your liking., Saute onion in margarine. Blend in flour, salt and pepper., Stir in the milk., Gradually heat to boiling;, stir constantly. Reduce heat and add remaining ingredients (broth, cheese, mustard)., Heat thoroughly.

title: Oven-Fried Chicken
directions: Heat oven to 425°., In oven, melt shortening in baking pan (13 x 9 x 2-inch)., Measure flour, salt, paprika and pepper into paper or plastic bag., Shake 2 or 3 chicken pieces at a time in bag until thoroughly coated., Place skin side down in shortening. Bake, uncovered, 30 minutes., Turn chicken and bake until tender, 20 to 30 minutes longer.

title: Buckeyes
directions: Cream peanut, butter,, margarine, and vanilla together. Add powdered sugar and	mix, well., Form, into balls and chill until firm., Using a toothpick, quickly dip and swirl balls in Chocolate Dip, leaving a tan uncoated area around toothpick to resemble a buckeye., Place on waxed paper and chill.

title: Cassie'S Pecan Pie
directions: Beat all ingredients together, except pecans, for approximately 2 minutes., Add pecans., Pour into unbaked pie shell., Bake in a 375° oven for 35 minutes or until inserted knife comes out clean., Cool before cutting.

title: Eggplant Soup
directions: Steam onion and celery in hot oil and butter in tightly covered pot for about 10 minutes on low heat., Add eggplant and potatoes and steam 15 minutes., Stir in next 6 ingredients and bring to a boil., Lower heat and simmer 30 minutes., Cool for 10 minutes. Puree in blender., Add cayenne and cream., Serve hot or cold. Freezes well., Yields 1 1/2 to 2-quart., You may add green onion tops if you wish.

title: Hoppin' John
directions: In a large skillet, saute onion, celery and garlic in hot olive oil until onion is soft., Stir in remaining ingredients. Heat to a boil; reduce heat and cover tightly., Simmer 30 to 40 minutes or until liquid is absorbed., Makes about 6 servings.

title: Scalloped Tomatoes
directions: Mix all ingredients in proper sized buttered baking dish., Dot generously with butter., Bake, uncovered, slowly until bread browns a bit, at least 1 1/2 hours in 325° oven.

title: Snickers Pie Or Cake
directions: Cook cake as directed in a 9 x 13-inch pan., When cake gets done, take out of oven and poke holes all in the cake., Take your Smucker's caramel and condensed milk, already mixed together, and pour over cake., Take the Snickers bars, sliced thin (to melt) and put on top of cake., Top with Cool Whip, if desired., Very rich!

title: Dirt Cake
directions: Blend in large bowl the cream cheese, butter and powdered sugar until smooth., Mix pudding, milk and vanilla., Mix bowls together., Stir in whipped cream.

title: Chocolate Chip Bars
directions: Heat oven to 375°., Grease and flour baking pan (13 x 9 x 2-inch)., Mix sugars, margarine and vanilla., Beat in egg., Stir in flour, baking soda and salt., Mix in nuts and chocolate chips. Spread dough in pan., Bake until light brown, 12 to 14 minutes. Cool; cut into bars (about 2 x 1 1/2 inches)., Makes 3 dozen cookies.

title: Breakfast Pizza
directions: Roll crescent rolls out flat in bottom of ungreased 13 x 9-inch pan., Pour beaten eggs over dough., Spread fried sausage over eggs., Add hash browns (uncooked) over sausage., Sprinkle cheese over all., Bake in 350° oven for 15 to 20 minutes, or until cheese is melted and browned., Serves 6.

title: Pickled Peaches
directions: Place whole, peeled, peaches in lightly salted water to soak and prevent darkening,, no, more, than 20 minutes., Bring water and sugar to a, boil, in pot., Add pickling spice., Keep boiling. Drop peaches in hot liquid;, they will change color. Spoon peaches into hot, sterilized jars., Cover with syrup and seal., Try small pod of hot pepper in a few jars.

title: Peas And Rice
directions: Fry salt pork to get the fat., Add onion, tomato, salt, pepper and thyme., Stir all together and continue cooking., Add peas and 3 cups water., Let come to a boil and stir in rice., Cover and cook until rice is tender and water absorbed., Add another cup of water and cover to swell the rice., Add more water, if needed. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Raspberry Crisscross Cookies
directions: Sift dry ingredients; cut in shortening as for pie., Add eggs and milk., Keep 1/4 of dough out., Spread rest on 10 x 15-inch cake tin., Press dough well up along side of pan., Spread with jam. Sprinkle with nuts., Pinch off pieces of reserved dough with palms of hands and make 1/2-inch strips., Place on top for crisscross at 1 1/2 inches apart., Bake at 350° to 375° for 45 minutes., Let cool in pan., Cut with sharp knife in center of each strip so that each piece has dough around., Sprinkle with powdered sugar.

title: Tangy Fruit Salad
directions: In small bowl, combine reserved pineapple juice, pudding mix and Tang; set aside., In large bowl, combine all the fruit., Fold juice mixture into fruit., Refrigerate before serving.

title: Cornbread Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients in large bowl., Refrigerate overnight.

title: Holiday Cheese Ball
directions: Cream cheese in bowl. Add pineapple, green pepper, onion and seasoned salt. Add pecans (reserving some to roll ball into). Form into a ball and chill. Roll in nuts just before serving.

title: Pimento Cheese
directions: Heat in double boiler until melted, then mash up pimiento pepper real good., Remove from boiler and stir for a few minutes longer.

title: Microwave Fudge
directions: Blend powdered sugar and cocoa in microwave-safe mixing bowl. Merely place milk and margarine in bowl, but do not mix., Cook in microwave on High power for 2 minutes., Remove bowl from microwave and stir well., Add vanilla and nuts and stir until well blended and begins to thicken about 2 minutes or so.

title: Top Heavy Coconut Cake
directions: Make cake by box directions., Bake as directed., When has about 15 minutes left in oven, put sugar and pineapple in a saucepan; bring to a boil., Boil until sugar is dissolved., Poke holes in cake and pour mixture over entire cake., Place in refrigerator. Cool completely., Make pudding and pour over cake., Use 1/2 coconut and Cool Whip., Mix together., Put over cake., Then top with remainder of coconut., Then take your hand and push coconut into Cool Whip so it doesn't fall off cake.

title: Meat Balls
directions: Mix together all ingredients as you would for meat loaf., Form into small balls; brown in frying pan. Drain grease and place meat balls in a baking dish. Cover with jar of spaghetti sauce. Cover with foil. Bake at 400° for 40 minutes.

title: Bubble Up Pizza
directions: Preheat oven to 375°. Chop all ingredients, then add sauce mix. Cut biscuits in half, then in half again. Then mix with spaghetti sauce. Put in 13 x 9 pan sprayed with Pam. Bake at 375° for 23 to 28 minutes.

title: Perpetual Pot Of Fruit With Rum Or Brandy
directions: Bring water and sugar to a boil, stirring until sugar dissolves., Simmer 15 minutes., Cool., Add lemon juice and rum or brandy (or some of both)., Pour into a large container with cover. Add fruit to the syrup, making sure that the fruit is submerged. Refrigerate, replenishing as needed., Keeps beautifully.

title: Dutch Meat Loaf
directions: Mix together beef, onion, soup, egg, salt, pepper and crumbs. Put in a baking dish., Mix together soup, mustard, sugar, water and vinegar and pour over beef mixture., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Lemon Pie
directions: Bake in oven at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes in uncooked pie shell.

title: Carrot Dip
directions: Soften cream cheese., Beat all ingredients until smooth and even color., Sprinkle paprika or cut chives on top., Serve with carrots.

title: Pecan Pie
directions: Cream butter; slowly beat in sugar and salt. Add 1 egg at a time and beat briskly. Blend entire mixture. Pour into pastry lined pie pan for 8-inch pie. Bake at 450° for 10 minutes. Reduce heat to 350° and bake until custard sets, about 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Viennese Brownies
directions: In a bowl, combine softened cream cheese, sugar and 1 egg., Add almond extract; set aside., In small saucepan melt chocolate and butter together., Cool., Beat 2 eggs., Add sugar and chocolate mixture., Beat in sifted and combined flour, baking powder and salt., Pour half the chocolate mixture into a well-greased and floured square baking pan (8-inches)., Gently spread the cream cheese mixture., Top with remaining chocolate mixture., Bake in 350° oven 45 to 50 minutes, until cake tester inserted in center comes away clean., Cool in pan before cutting into rectangles or squares.

title: Pumpkin Spice Cake
directions: Mix together the dry ingredients. Add eggs, pumpkin and oil. Blend in nuts. Grease and flour 9-inch cake pans., Bake for 30 minutes at 350°., You may use a 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Texas Hash
directions: Brown meat, pepper and onion in large skillet., Add remaining ingredients and mix well., Bake at 375° for 45 minutes., Stir once or twice during baking.

title: Raspberry Mousse(Makes 8 To 10 Servings.)
directions: In small saucepan, combine 1 package undrained raspberries and cornstarch; cook and stir until thickened and clear., Chill thoroughly., In blender, combine remaining 1 package drained raspberries, Eagle Brand and ReaLemon brand; blend until smooth. Place in large bowl; stir in food coloring if desired., Fold in whipped cream., Spoon half the mousse mixture into dessert dishes; top with equal portions of raspberry sauce, then remaining mousse mixture., Chill thoroughly., Garnish as desired., Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Tomato Salad In A Bread Bowl
directions: Cut a thin slice off top of bread., Carefully cut out most of the inside of the bread, leaving a shell., Tear insides into large, irregular pieces., Toss lightly under broiler., Set aside.

title: Deep Dish Apple Dish
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., Lightly grease 8-inch glass baking dish., Place half of apples in dish; top with corn syrup., Add remaining apples, lemon juice, 1 teaspoon cinnamon and nutmeg. Combine 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon, sugar, salt, butter, flour and oatmeal., Mix well and press firmly over apples., Bake 50 minutes. Top with ice cream and serve.

title: Triple Layer Party Pie
directions: In medium bowl combine butterscotch pudding mix, 2/3 cup nonfat dry milk powder and 1 1/4 cups water., Mix well using a wire whisk. Pour into pie crust., In medium bowl combine chocolate pudding mix, remaining 2/3 cup nonfat dry milk and remaining 1 1/4 cups water. Mix well using wire whisk., Pour over butterscotch layer., Cover and chill in refrigerator until set, about one hour.

title: Green Bean Roll-Ups
directions: Drain juice from green beans and reserve., Cut bacon in half. In each slice of bacon, roll up 3 or 4 green beans., Secure bacon with toothpicks., Add part of green bean juice to the roll-ups after placing the roll-ups in a baking pan., Season with salt and pepper., Bake until bacon browns.

title: Peanut Blossom Cookies
directions: Cream sugars, butter and peanut butter in bowl with electric mixer., Beat in eggs, milk and vanilla., Sift together flour, soda and salt., Stir into egg batter., Shape into balls; roll in additional granulated sugar., Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes., Remove from oven and immediately press a chocolate kiss into each cookie., Cool on wire racks., Makes 7 dozen cookies.

title: Sugar Cookies
directions: Mix in order given and bake at 350° until lightly browned or until done.

title: Kraut Soup
directions: Boil pork chops and potatoes until cooked., Saute onion in pan and roll in flour., Add 1 large can of tomatoes and string kraut.

title: Gingersnap Cookies
directions: In large bowl, beat together sugar and shortening; add molasses., Mix well., Add beaten egg., Stir together all remaining ingredients., Mix into molasses mixture until thoroughly combined. Cover and chill at least 1 hour or overnight., Roll dough into 1-inch balls, then place balls into granulated, sugar., Place balls 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet., Bake at 375° for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Frog Eye Salad
directions: Combine sugar, flour and salt; gradually stir in egg and pineapple juice., Cook over moderate heat, stirring until thickened., Add lemon juice., Cool to room temperature., Bring water to boiling point with salt according to directions on acini de pepe box., Add oil and cook acini de pepe only until tender but firm., Drain and rinse well with cold water., Combine egg mixture with acini de pepe, mixing lightly., Refrigerate overnight in an airtight container., The next morning, add remaining ingredients. Mix lightly but thoroughly., Refrigerate in airtight container until well chilled., Salad may be refrigerated for a week, if desired.

title: Coca-Cola Ham Steak
directions: Cut each end of ham so ham steak won't curl., Pour the Coke over the ham in skillet. Cook over medium heat., Keep turning until Coke has vanished., Ham will be done. Serve with a slice of pineapple on top.

title: Key Lime Cake With Frosting
directions: Mix together all ingredients., Pour into a greased and floured 9x13-inch pan.

title: Children'S Edible Play Dough
directions: Combine all ingredients and mix well., If it gets too sticky, put in a little flour., Feeds six children.

title: Poppy Seed Bread
directions: Mix all ingredients well., Pour into greased and floured 3 loaf pans size 7 1/2 x 3 x 2-inch., Bake at 325° for 25 minutes or until toothpick inserted comes out clean., Very good served with fresh fruit.

title: Hot Chili Dip
directions: Mix together., Microwave on High until bubbling or bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Peanut Butter Balls
directions: Melt margarine., With a fork, blend in peanut butter., Slowly, adding sugar, mix together with hands., Roll into 2 or 3 long rolls., Pinch off enough for small balls., Place on wax paper or cookie sheet in freezer for 15 minutes.

title: Mandarin Salad
directions: Mix the sour cream, marshmallows and coconut., Use wooden spoon and stir in oranges and pineapple., Refrigerate overnight. Just before serving, add bananas., Serves 6.

title: Quesidillas(Kay-Sa-De-Ya)
directions: Soften cream cheese; then add olives and enough salsa to make mixture pink., Place 1 tortilla on plate (or server) and spread cheese mixture; repeat process ending with tortilla on top., Cut into small slices like pie., For garnish, fasten stuffed olive on each slice with toothpick.

title: Brownies
directions: Melt butter and chocolate in double boiler; cool., Beat eggs and salt until light and foamy., Gradually add sugar and vanilla and continue beating until well creamed., With a few strokes (mix manually), combine chocolate into egg/sugar mixture., Before mixture becomes uniformly colored, fold in flour., Again, before mixing is uniformly colored, gently stir in pecans or walnuts. Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan for 25 to 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Peanut Blossom Cookies
directions: Cream together shortening and peanut butter., Add sugars and mix well., Add egg, milk and vanilla., Add flour, baking soda and salt., Mix well.

title: Pecan Pie
directions: Mix all ingredients together and bake 10 minutes at 350°, then 40 minutes at 300°.

title: Cinnamon Chocolate Cake
directions: Mix the first 4 ingredients well and bring to a boil., Blend to the mixture the remaining ingredients., Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

title: Barbecued Steak
directions: Combine all ingredients, except round steak, in a saucepan; bring to a boil., Simmer gently for 5 minutes., Pound steak (break tissues)., Cut into serving pieces., Put in a large pan., Pour barbecued sauce over meat., Cover tightly and bake at 325° for 2 hours or until fork-tender.

title: Pea Salad
directions: Drain peas., Mix Miracle Whip with sugar; add vinegar (enough to make very tart)., Cut up eggs., Mix all ingredients together. Cover and cool.

title: Red-Skinned Mashed Potatoes
directions: Add salt and soybean oil to 1 quart water., Bring to a boil and add potatoes until fork-tender., Remove potatoes and add butter, heavy cream, pepper and sour cream., Mash., Serves 4.

title: Malaysian Beef
directions: Cut meat into 1/2-inch strips., Mix together ginger, chili powder, garlic and lemon rind., Dip meat into mixture and brown in butter., Combine sugar, jam, lemon juice, salt and 1 1/2 cups water., Add meat and simmer 30 minutes., Serve with rice.

title: Monkey Bread
directions: Combine milk, margarine, sugar and salt in microwave-safe bowl., Microwave on High until margarine melts., When lukewarm, add yeast., Stir in flour., Let rise 1 hour and 20 minutes., Roll into balls., Dip in melted butter., Place balls in baking pan. Let rise 45 minutes., Bake at 375° for 35 minutes., Cool in pan for 5 minutes.

title: Elephant Ears
directions: Stir flour, 2 tbsp. sugar, baking soda, and salt. Stir in milk and 3 tbsp. of melted butter. Mix until dough forms., Sprinkle surface lightly with flour. Knead dough 10 times., Roll dough, with rolling pin into a rectangle 9x5 inches., Brush with remaining melted butter. Sprinkle mixture of 3 tbsp. sugar and cinnamon. Roll dough up tightly, beginning at narrow end. Pinch end of dough to seal. Cut into 4 equal pieces. Place cut side up on greased cookie sheet. Pat into circle. Sprinkle with more sugar. Bake at 425° for 8 to 10 min. Remove from cookie sheet immediately. Let cool on wire rack.

title: Sweet Pickles
directions: Dissolve salt in 1 gallon boiling water and pour over cukes. Let stand 5 to 7 days., Rinse., Dissolve 2 tablespoons alum in 1 gallon boiling water., Let stand 24 hours., Rinse and split cukes (no matter how small); repeat 2 tablespoons alum in 1 gallon boiling water and let stand 24 hours., Rinse thoroughly., Prepare equal parts sugar and vinegar; bring to a boil., Pour over cukes. Let stand 24 hours., Pour off and add equal parts of sugar to vinegar solution., Bring to a boil and pour over cukes that have been packed in jars., Seal.

title: Strawberry Shake
directions: Combine skim milk, strawberries, orange juice and sugar substitute in container of an electric blender or food processor. Process until strawberries are pureed and mixture is frothy. Transfer mixture to a small pitcher., Stir in buttermilk., Pour into individual glasses and serve immediately., Diabetic Exchange: 1 skim milk., Each serving amount:, 1 cup., Calories:, 105.

title: Corn Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients together and bake 45 minutes at 350°.

title: Sweet Potato Souffle
directions: Mix all ingredients; pour into casserole.

title: Zesty Chicken Pot Pie
directions: Cook cream cheese and broth in large saucepan on low heat until cheese is melted, stirring frequently with wire whisk. Stir in chicken, vegetables and salad dressing mixes. Spoon into 9-inch pie plate. Cover with 1 pie crust; seal and flute edge. Cut several slits to permit steam to escape. Cut remaining pie crust into decorative shapes; arrange on crust. Place pie plate on cookie sheet. Bake at 425° for 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown. Makes 8 servings.

title: Salted Pumpkin Seeds
directions: Boil dry seeds for 5 minutes., Spray baking sheet with pam. spread seeds on baking sheet., Sprinkle with salt., Bake at 350 degrees until dry. Serve warm or cool.

title: Rock Road Cake Icing
directions: Melt butter over low heat in a small pan. Add cocoa, conf. sugar and milk. Stir and heat until everything is blended. Pour over cake (leave in pan) and spread.

title: Coca-Cola Cake
directions: Combine flour, sugar and cocoa in mixing bowl., Heat cola and oleo to boiling point., Pour over flour mixture., Add eggs, buttermilk, soda and vanilla., Mix well., Add marshmallows and stir with spoon until they are coated., Pour into greased pan., Bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Sweet And Sour Meatballs (Cocktail)
directions: Mix ground beef, bread crumbs, onions, milk, egg and next 3 ingredients., Make 1/2 to 1-inch size meatballs., Put shortening/oil in a skillet and cook until golden brown., Drain grease., In crock-pot preheat chili and jelly., After heated place meatballs in crock-pot., Let simmer approximately 1 1/2 to 2 hours on low., Makes approximately 5 dozen.

title: "Company" Bread
directions: Trim, crust, off top and sides of loaf of French bread. Cut X's across top., Place Swiss cheese, cut in small pieces, in, X's. In, pan, melt butter, mustard, onion, poppy seed and lemon juice until all is dissolved., Spoon over bread and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Pecan Pie
directions: Pour into two 8-inch pie shells or 1 large pie shell., Bake at 350° for about 50 minutes.

title: Box Honey Graham Crackers
directions: Break graham crackers into sections and line bottom of pan. Bring butter to boil 3 minutes, stirring constantly., Pour over crackers and add pecans., Bake at 350° for 12 minutes., Let cool.

title: Shepherd'S Pie
directions: First, brown hamburger., Drain the meat., Take 13 x 9-inch glass pan and butter both sides and bottom., Spread biscuits on both bottom and sides., Put meat on top of biscuits, then put vegetables on top of meat., Put a little bit of water on top. Bake in 325° oven for 15 minutes., Pull out and put potatoes and cheese on top., Put back in oven for 3 to 5 minutes or until cheese melts.

title: Chicken And Rice Bake
directions: Place rice on bottom of casserole dish. Place uncooked chicken on top of rice. Pour onion soup mix over chicken. Mix milk, soup and 1 soup can of water together. Pour over top of all. Bake at 325° for 1 to 2 hours.

title: Pumpkin Bread
directions: Sift first 5 ingredients together., Beat eggs; add sugar, oil and pumpkin., Mix dry ingredients gradually into liquid mixture. Pour into four (1 pound) coffee cans., Bake at 350°, for 1 hour. Remove while warm and wrap in foil.

title: Peachy Cobbler
directions: Arrange drained peaches in a square baking pan., Pour lemon juice and spread brown sugar over peaches., Sprinkle with cinnamon.

title: Chocolate Sheet Cake
directions: Mix flour, sugar and salt in a bowl; set aside., Bring the oleo, cocoa and water to a boil and add to the flour mixture., Mix together the remaining ingredients and add to the other mixture. Bake at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes, in a well-greased cookie sheet pan.

title: Mexican Cornbread
directions: Mix one cornbread mix according to directions on box and add 1/2 can corn., Put in bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan., Layer hamburger, picante sauce, cheese and the other cornbread mix, mixed according to directions, adding the other half of the corn. Bake at 400° until golden brown., Serve immediately.

title: Stuffed Tomatoes
directions: Cut olives into large pieces., Cut bacon into 1/4-inch strips and cook slowly until crisp., When bacon is half done, add onion and cook until soft., Drain off fat., Combine bacon and onion with eggs, celery and olives., Add mayonnaise., Mix., Stuff tomatoes and serve on lettuce.

title: Corn Pudding
directions: Mix corns with butter and sour cream., Add eggs and stir in muffin mix., Bake in a 9-inch pie pan for 35 to 40 minutes at 375° until golden brown.

title: Banana Pound Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees., Combine cake mix, pudding, eggs, oil, 3/4 cup water and bananas., Mix well., Pour into greased and lightly floured bundt pan., Bake for 1 hour. Meanwhile, combine sugar, margarine and 1/4 cup water in sauce pan., Bring to a boil, and remove from heat., When cake is done, immediately pour sauce slowly over cake, allowing time for it to be absorbed., Leave cake in pan for 20 minutes before removing.

title: Cheese And Vegetable Casserole
directions: Heat milk; pour over bread crumbs., Add pimento, parsley, onion, grated cheese and seasonings, then add eggs., Put the vegetables in a greased or oiled 1 1/2-quart casserole; pour milk and cheese mixture over them., Set in pan of warm water., Bake in moderate oven at 350° for 1 hour, or until firm., Serves 6.

title: Mexican Cornbread
directions: Brown meat and onion; drain excess fat and set aside., Combine cornbread mixes together according to directions on box. Additionally, add 1/3 cup milk and can of corn to the cornbread mixes., Using a nonstick spray, prepare a 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Pour a small amount of cornbread batter in pan to form a layer. Sprinkle meat mixture on top and then sprinkle grated cheese on top of the meat., Pour remaining cornbread mix on top of all and bake according to box directions.

title: Sour Cream Raisin Pie
directions: Mix cornstarch, sugar, salt and nutmeg; add egg yolks., Mix. Add sour cream, raisins, lemon juice and nuts., Cook until thick. Pour into baked pie shell., Spread meringue on top and brown.

title: Caf Viennese
directions: Process in blender on liquefies until well blended. Store in airtight container.

title: Savory Fried Chicken
directions: Rinse chicken and pat dry., In large bag, combine flour and seasonings., In shallow bowl, beat eggs and water., Place chicken a few pieces at a time in bag and shake to coat., Dip in eggs and shake in bag again., Fry chicken until done., Serves 4 to 6.

title: Orange Drink
directions: Blend all ingredients until creamy looking.

title: Fruited Coleslaw
directions: Combine cabbage, marshmallows, pineapple, apple, celery and enough salad dressing to moisten. Toss lightly and chill.

title: Corn Souffle
directions: Mix all ingredients in a bowl., Pour into a greased casserole and bake 30 minutes in a 350° oven or until lightly browned.

title: Squash Pickles
directions: Put vegetables and salt into ice water; let stand for 3 hours. Drain., Bring to, boil vinegar, sugar and spices.	Add squash, onions and peppers; boil, for, 3, minutes and put into jars and seal.

title: Limas In Casserole
directions: Mix ingredients together., Place in casserole and bake for 50 minutes at 350°.

title: Biscuit Topped Italian Casserole
directions: Heat oven to 375°., Grease 12 x 8-inch (2-quart) baking dish. In large skillet, brown ground beef and onion., Drain., Stir in water, pepper, tomato sauce, and tomato paste., Simmer for 15 minutes., Remove from heat., Stir in vegetables and 1 1/2 cups cheese., Spoon mixture into greased baking dish., Separate dough into 10 biscuits., Separate each biscuit into 2 layers., Place biscuits near outer edge of hot meat mixture, overlapping slightly., Sprinkle remaining cheese in center and around edge. Gently brush biscuits with margarine and sprinkle with oregano. Bake for 22 to 27 minutes or until biscuits are brown.

title: Chocolate-Almond Frosting
directions: Mix butter with coffee, salt and chocolate., Add rest of ingredients and beat thoroughly., Let stand for 5 minutes., Beat until creamy and frost tops and sides of cakes.

title: Rice And Broccoli Dish
directions: Saute chopped onion in melted margarine until tender., Add the mushroom soup., Cut up 1/3 of a small box of Velveeta or American cheese., Add to onion and soup mixture., Melt cheese with mixture. Add 2 cups cooked rice and 10 ounces of frozen broccoli (thawed and drained)., Pour in buttered casserole dish and top with cracker crumbs., Dot with butter., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Rhubarb Crunch
directions: Blend first 5 ingredients like pie dough. Put half in 8 inch square pan. Mix remaining ingredients. Spread on crumbs. Put remaining crumbs on top. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Drop Sugar Cookies
directions: Drop on greased sheet., Bake at 375°.

title: Salmon Loaf
directions: Mix all together and put in a greased loaf pan., Bake 1 1/4 hours at 350°.

title: "Miss" Jean'S Squash Casserole
directions: Combine melted butter with dressing mix., Sprinkle small amount in casserole dish., Save, enough, to cover top of casserole and combine the rest of crumbs with the other ingredients. Pour into casserole dish., Sprinkle the reserved crumbs on top. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until bubbly and brown.

title: Shrimp Gumbo
directions: Peel shrimp (uncooked) and devein., Make roux (dark) of flour and oil., Add shrimp to this for a few minutes, stirring constantly., Set aside.

title: Beef Stew
directions: Brown beef cubes in oil., Add water, salt and pepper for seasonings., Simmer slowly until meat is tender., Add vegetables and cook 30 minutes or until vegetables are done., Yield: 6 servings., Carbohydrate 7 g, protein 11 g, fat 12 g, calories 180. One serving = 1 1/2 meat medium fat exchange, 1 vegetable exchange, 1 fat exchange.

title: Baked Pineapple
directions: Cream together margarine and sugar, beat egg and add to mixture., Tear bread slices and add with pineapple to first mixture., Mix together., Place in 1 1/2 to 2-quart greased baking dish and bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Marinated Carrots
directions: Mix and pour over carrots., Refrigerate overnight.

title: Rachel'S Fruit Cake
directions: Chop nuts., Place all nuts, drained cherries and dates in a large bowl., Sift flour, baking powder, salt and sugar together. Coat the fruit and nuts with dry ingredients., Add vanilla to eggs and pour over coated fruit and nuts; mix well.

title: Sugar And Spice Pecans
directions: Mix sugar, cinnamon, nutmeg and salt together., Beat egg whites and water until it's meringue consistency., Add sugar mixture 1 tablespoon at a time., Beat to a stiff peak., Fold in pecan halves.

title: Earthquake Cake
directions: Mix coconut and pecans and press into a greased and floured 9 x 12-inch pan., Prepare cake mix as directed., Pour over coconut and pecan mixture., Melt butter and cream cheese., Add powdered sugar., Mix well and drop by tablespoons on top of cake batter. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour or when cracks form in center of cake., Do not overcook., No icing needed.

title: Surprise Muffins
directions: Sift flour., Beat eggs in 2 cup measuring cup with wire whisk. Whisk, in	milk and oil. Stir just until moistened. Do not beat. Fill, greased, and floured muffin pan 2/3 full. For Surprise Muffins, fill 1/2 full, then drop 1 teaspoon of jelly or preserves in center. Add more batter to make 2/3 full. Bake at 400° for 20 to 25 minutes., Makes 12 muffins.

title: Baked Applesauce
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Combine first four ingredients in a buttered casserole dish., Put butter on top of applesauce., Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Autumn Pudding
directions: Blend all ingredients together., Pour into a 13x9 inch pan. Top with topping mix.

title: Cranberry Salad
directions: Dissolve, jello in hot water., Add sugar and stir until dissolved., Add cool water., Set in refrigerator to cool until thick, (soft)., Add ground fruits, nuts and liquids., Mix then pour into mold and refrigerate.

title: Taco Salad
directions: Toss all ingredients together.

title: Sponge Cake Roll
directions: Let egg whites stand at room temperature for 30 minutes., Sift flour and salt and set aside., Coat a 15x10x1 baking pan with nonstick cooking spray., Line with wax paper and coat the paper with spray., In a mixing bowl, beat yolks until slightly thickened. Gradually add sugar and beating until thick and lemony colored. Add orange peel, lemon juice and vanilla., Add sifted flour mixture and mix well., Batter will be thick., In another bowl beat egg whites until soft peaks form., Fold into batter., Spread into prepared pan., Bake at 350 for 12-15 minutes or until cake springs back when lightly touched in center., Cool on wire rack 5 minutes. Turn onto a kitchen towel., Sprinkle with 1 Tbsp. powdered sugar. Gently pull wax paper off and roll cake up jelly roll style, starting with short side., Cool completely on wire rack., Unroll cake- spread marmalade evenly over cake within 1/2 inch of edges. Roll up again, seam side down., Sprinkle with remaining sugar. Wrap and place in refrigerator one hour., Servings 8 - 5 Points.

title: Coffee Cake
directions: Mix flour and brown sugar in a large mixing bowl., Cut in the Parkay and add the nuts. Mix in egg and soda. Press half of mixture in bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan., Sprinkle with cinnamon.

title: Vanilla Ice Cream
