directions: Mix all ingredients well., Pour into 1-gallon freezer., Finish filling with whole milk., Stir and freeze in ice cream freezer.

title: Chocolate Dream Bars
directions: Mix until crumbly., Press into 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 10 minutes or until golden brown and firm.

title: Fresh Tomato Soup
directions: Simmer tomatoes in large saucepan for 10 minutes., Remove from heat and add 1/4 cup butter, soda, 1 teaspoon salt and sugar., Let cool during preparation of next step., Melt the remaining 1/4 cup butter in large kettle., Add flour and 2 teaspoons salt., Add milk; heat and stir to boiling point., Combine the two mixtures and heat slowly., Add salt, if needed, and pepper to taste., Serve immediately.

title: Egg Custard Pie
directions: Mix all together., Pour into prepared crust., Sprinkle nutmeg on top., Bake at 350° for about 35 minutes.

title: Seafood Casserole
directions: Blend half and half and mayonnaise., Add remaining ingredients and mix well., Pour into greased casserole., Cover with 1/2 cup bread crumbs., Dot with butter, if desired., Bake at 350° approximately 30 minutes.

title: Low-Fat Chicken Spread
directions: Cook chicken in unsalted water to cover until tender., Remove from broth, reserving 2 tablespoons broth., Cool., Bone chicken; chop fine., Combine cheese and mayonnaise, beating until smooth. Add onion, pickle juice, celery, curry powder, salt, pepper, pimiento, hot sauce and garlic powder; mix well., Stir in chicken and broth., Serve on crackers or lettuce leaves., Each tablespoon contains about 22 calories.

title: Chicken Carrie
directions: Use a skillet or wok., Saute onion, green pepper, salt and pepper in chicken fat., Place potatoes on top of ingredients in skillet or wok, then chicken breasts on top of potatoes., Pour in broth., Cover and simmer gently, about 30 minutes., Do not stir.

title: Pineapple Salad
directions: Bring water, gelatine, sugar and pineapple to boil., Cook for five minutes., Remove from stove and while hot add cream cheese and cream., Stir until smooth., Add pecans., Pour into mold or decorative bowl., Chill until firm.

title: Dressing For Fresh Fruits
directions: In small bowl, combine all ingredients until smooth., Chill about 2 hours., Serve over fresh fruit salads., Yield: 1 1/4 cups.

title: Japanese Fruit Pie
directions: Melt margarine., Add chocolate chips., Keep over heat until melted., Add other ingredients., Pour into two unbaked pie shells. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Pumpkin Pie
directions: Combine cream cheese, sugar, vanilla and egg., Mix well. Spread on bottom of deep 9-inch unbaked pie shell., Combine canned or cooked pumpkin, sugar, cinnamon, ginger, nutmeg and salt., Mix well., Blend in beaten egg and evaporated milk., Carefully pour over cream cheese mixture., Bake at 350° for 65 to 70 minutes or until done., Cool., May be topped with Cool Whip or cream.

title: Southern Pecan Pie
directions: Refrigerate prepared pie shell., Preheat oven to 350°., In bowl, beat eggs well., Add sugar, syrup, flour, salt and vanilla. Combine well., Stir in butter and nuts., Pour into unbaked pie shell., Bake 60 minutes or until filling is set in center., May cover crimped pie crust edges with foil so edges don't overcook.

title: Pepper Steak
directions: Cube steak and brown in skillet with garlic and pepper and a little oil., Add soy sauce and water., Cover and cook 20 minutes. Add sliced bell peppers and onions., Cook 10 minutes., Add 1 teaspoon cornstarch and cold water to thicken., Serve over rice.

title: Red Hot Salad
directions: Dissolve red hots in hot water and add Jell-O.	Blend thoroughly and cool., Add applesauce., Pour in loaf pan and jell.

title: Apple Bars
directions: Sift flour, salt and baking soda together., Add brown sugar and rolled oats., Cut in margarine until crumbly., Spread half the mixture in a greased 7 x 11-inch baking dish.

title: Eggplant Parmesan
directions: Whisk together eggs and 3 tablespoons water until well blended., Combine bread, crumbs and 2 tablespoons Parmesan cheese. Dip the sliced eggplant into the egg mixture, then dredge in the bread crumb mixture. Cook the eggplant in 3 batches in 1 tablespoon hot olive oil (per batch) in a large skillet over medium heat 4 minutes on each side or until tender. Arrange 1/3 of eggplant in a single layer in a lightly greased 11 x 7 baking dish. Sprinkle with 1 tablespoon Parmesan cheese and 1/2 cup Mozzarella cheese. Repeat layers twice. Spoon 3 cups pasta sauce over top. Bake, covered, at 375° for 35 minutes. Uncover and sprinkle remaining 1 tablespoon Parmesan cheese and 1/2 cup Mozzarella cheese. Bake 10 more minutes or until cheese melts. Yield: 4 to 6 servings.

title: Pumpkin Cake Or Bread
directions: Mix eggs, oil, sugar together and add pumpkin., Mix well. Mix flour, soda, salt, cinnamon and baking powder together and add to wet ingredients., Fold in nuts or raisins., Bake in floured bundt pan or loaf pans for 1 hour at 350 degrees.

title: Green Bean And Radish Salad In Sour Cream Vinaigrette
directions: Bring plenty of lightly salted water to a boil., Add the beans and cook until just tender, about 6 or 7 minutes., Drain and run under cold water to stop further cooking., Transfer the beans to a serving bowl., Sprinkle with 1 tablespoon vinegar, sour cream and oil., Whisk the dressing until smooth., Season to taste with salt and pepper., Add the radishes, scallions and dressing to the beans. Toss the salad gently with 2 spoons., Let the salad marinate at room temperature for 2 hours before serving., Turn salad to lunch dish by adding smoked turkey, Swiss cheese or smoked ham, cut into julienne strips.

title: Potatoes With Caraway Seed
directions: Wash potatoes; do not peel., Halve them and dip cut side in caraway seed and salt., Place on greased baking sheet., Brush on melted butter and bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Chicken Fried Rice
directions: Cut, and, dice	chicken, breasts;, season with seasoned salt, pepper, and, Mrs. Dash., Cook slowly in slightly greased frying pan; do not brown meat., Simmer until done; may substitute chicken with, shrimp or beef., Set aside.	Chop and cook green onions, in slightly greased pan (drain any excess oil); set, aside. Scramble, eggs, with about 1 tablespoon of cooked green, onions; set, aside., Begin	frying cooked rice (do not boil rice too long) in butter.

title: Whipping Cream Potatoes
directions: Boil potatoes until tender but still firm. Drain and let cool. Peel and shred potatoes. In a buttered 2-quart casserole, place a layer of potatoes. Sprinkle with Lawry's salt and dot with butter. Repeat until all of potatoes have been used. Pour whipping cream on top. Bake at 375° for 45 minutes or until top is golden brown. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Turkey Chili
directions: Saute onions and garlic until onions are soft., Add turkey; brown., Add remaining ingredients; stir., Simmer over low heat for 1/2 to 2 hours., The longer this cooks, the better it gets!

title: Vegetable Dip
directions: All spices should be dehydrated., Mix together and refrigerate.

title: Baked Spaghetti
directions: Brown beef, onion and pepper and then drain., Add spaghetti sauce mix and remaining ingredients.

title: Popovers
directions: Put flour and salt in bowl., Add milk and eggs., Beat with a rotary beater for 3 minutes., Add melted butter and stir., Put in well-greased muffin tins (have tins hot)., Bake in hot oven at 350° for 40 minutes., Yield will be 12 muffins.

title: Frozen Lemon Crumb Dessert
directions: Mix flour, brown sugar, margarine and nuts until crumbly. Spread on cookie sheet lined with heavy-duty Reynolds Wrap., Bake in 350° oven for 13 to 15 minutes., Cool; break apart into crumbs. Line an 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2-inch loaf pan with heavy-duty aluminum foil, leaving a 1 1/2-inch collar around top., Spread 2/3 of crumb mixture in bottom., Beat egg yolks until thick and lemon color; blend in condensed milk., Add lemon juice and rind; stir until thickened., Beat egg whites until stiff peaks form., Fold into lemon mixture., Pour mixture into prepared pan; sprinkle remaining crumbs on top., Freeze until firm., When solid, cover with piece of foil the size of the top., Lift from pan and return to freezer. Slice in bars to serve.

title: Death By Chocolate
directions: Bake cake as directed, then cool., Mix pudding also as directed., Crumble cake into a plastic square dish (pretty good size)., Take half of your bowl of pudding and pour it over the cake., Add half of Cool Whip; stir lightly, then add half of sprinkles of Heath bars on top., Repeat process one more time so there's 2 layers., Refrigerate!

title: Orange Cashew Chicken
directions: Stir together orange juice, soy sauce and ginger root. Add chicken. Let stand 30 minutes at room temperature. Drain chicken. Reserve sauce. Saute chicken in olive oil. Stir together reserved sauce and cornstarch. Stir into pan and heat until thick and bubbly. Stir in orange sections and cashews.

title: Crab Cakes
directions: Mix the ingredients together., Make into individual crab cakes., Fry until golden brown.

title: Crab Dip
directions: Combine all ingredients, except almonds, and put in ovenproof dish., Top with almonds., Place in oven for 15 to 20 minutes at 375°., Serve with crackers or nachos.

title: Potato Chip Cookies
directions: Cream butter, sugar and vanilla, then add potato chips and nuts; mix well., Stir in flour., Form into balls and press flat with the bottom of a sugar-coated glass on a cookie sheet., Bake 12 minutes in a 350° oven.

title: Stuffed Hot Dogs
directions: Combine onion, carrots and hot shortening together; cook slowly for 5 minutes., Add bread cubes, milk, salt, sage and pepper; mix well.

title: Rice Casserole
directions: Layer ingredients in 8-inch square pan, starting with rice. Cover and bake at 325° for 1 hour.

title: Pecan Pie(Easy)
directions: Mix all ingredients well., Place in uncooked pie shell., Bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes., Pecans will rise to top.

title: Corn Casserole
directions: *I use 4 cups corn from my freezer.

title: Brown Rice
directions: Put the ingredients in a Corning Ware dish in the listed order. Do not stir., Dot 1/2 stick margarine on top., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Apple Cake
directions: Beat first 5 ingredients together until smooth., Add apple and nuts., Mix well., Pour in ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan and bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Speedy Charlie Chile
directions: Drain the first three ingredients., Mix all together and heat.

title: Best (And Easy!) Pound Cake
directions: Cream butter and sugar., Add eggs and flour., Beat for 10 minutes., Pour batter into greased and floured tube cake pan. Bake for 1 1/2 hours at 300° until golden brown and toothpick inserted comes out clean., Great with strawberries and whipped cream or for wedding cakes.

title: Apple Cake
directions: Beat the first 3 ingredients well, then beat in the baking soda, orange peel, salt and flour., Mix in the apples and walnuts. Bake at 350° in a greased and floured Bundt pan for 50 to 55 minutes. Cake is done when toothpick comes out clean., Invert onto rack after cooling for 10 minutes., Serve plain or iced.

title: Carol'S Pumpkin Bread
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Mix margarine and sugar thoroughly., Add eggs, pumpkin and water., Blend in flour, soda, salt, baking powder, cinnamon and cloves., Stir in nuts and raisins., Pour into a well-greased loaf pan, 9 x 5 x 3-inch., Bake 65 to 70 minutes until toothpick stuck into center comes out clean.

title: Lasagna
directions: Spray a 9 x 11-inch pan with Pam., Brown meat and drain., Add sauce and paste and all other ingredients except noodles and cheese., Cook until flavors blend.

title: Chopped Beef Spread
directions: Soften cream cheese; add finely chopped onions, beef, garlic and Worcestershire sauce., Chill; serve on crackers.

title: No Cook Fudge
directions: Melt oleo and cheese together in a large pan., Be very careful not to get too hot., Add sugar, cocoa, vanilla and nutmeats., Mix well, then spread in two 9 x 13-inch buttered pans., Let cool 30 minutes before cutting in squares., Makes about 7 pounds.

title: Boiled Tongue
directions: Scrub tongue well., Cover with boiling water and bring to a boil., Skim, cover and simmer until tender, 3 to 4 hours., Add 1/2 teaspoon salt per pound when partially cooked., Remove skin when tender., To 2 cups strained water in which tongue has been boiled, add the rest of the ingredients., Blend together to form sauce., Place tongue in roasting pan; pour over sauce., Cover and bake 30 minutes at 350°, turning often.

title: Robert Fraga'S Cuban Black Bean Soup
directions: Preparation Time:, Soak beans overnight, cook for 3 hours.

title: Bubbling Cheese Bread
directions: In medium bowl, combine the first 3 ingredients., Spread cheese mixture on cut side of each bread half., Sprinkle with Parmesan., Broil 4 inches from heat for 3 minutes, or until bubbly and lightly browned.

title: Time Out For Chicken Wings
directions: Combine dressing, soy sauce and ginger., Pour over chicken. Marinate in refrigerator several hours or overnight., Place wings on broiler pan., Broil 15 to 20 minutes, turning once., Brush occasionally with marinade., Makes 36 appetizers.

title: Potato Salad
directions: Cook the potatoes in their skins., Cool, peel and cut up in fine pieces., Cook the eggs and cool, peel and cut up., Chop up the peeled onion., Put all together., Sprinkle the salt, pepper and celery seed over them., Then mix the salad dressing, vinegar and sugar together., You may have to add more sugar and vinegar to make it taste real tart., Mix all together while potatoes and eggs are still warm.

title: St. Patrick'S Trader Vic Salad
directions: Mix all but lettuce and croutons., Toss with greens and top with croutons.

title: Frozen Cranberry Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients together and spoon into paper lined muffin cup and freeze., Remove from freezer a few minutes before serving. Makes 15 servings.

title: Party Pizza
directions: In a frying pan, brown ground beef., Drain off fat., Mix in Parmesan cheese, onion, oregano, tomato paste and Mozzarella cheese., Cut French bread in half lengthwise., Lay bread, cut side up, on a cookie sheet., Spread meat mixture evenly over top of bread halves., Bake at 350° for 25 minutes or until done.

title: Old Fashioned Mince Pie
directions: Heat oven to 425°., Mix mincemeat and apple., Pour into pastry lined pie pan., Cover with top crust which has slits in it., Seal and flute., Cover edge with 1 1/2-inch strip of aluminum foil to prevent excess browning., Bake 40 to 45 minutes or until crust is nicely browned., Serve slightly warm with whipped cream on top.

title: Cheese Ball
directions: Mix well; roll in pecans., Serve with crackers.

title: Herb Biscuits
directions: You will also need nonstick spray coating.

title: Cream Frosting
directions: Boil to desired thickness., Large bubbles will form.

title: Dietetic Date Cake
directions: Cream butter; add sweetener, vanilla and egg., Sift dry ingredients together., Add to mixture., Add applesauce, dates and nuts., Bake 1 hour at 350° in loaf pan.

title: Quick Uncooked Cookies
directions: Mix together sugar, milk, cocoa and butter; bring to a boil. Boil for 1 1/2 minutes., Remove from heat; then add quick cooking oatmeal, vanilla and pecans., Drop by teaspoonfuls onto wax paper.

title: Veal Cutlets
directions: Pound meat., Sprinkle with salt., Dip first in flour, then in eggs and then in bread crumbs., Fry in butter or oil until brown. Serve with lemon wedges.

title: Fruit Salad
directions: Cut up your favorite fruit into a bowl., Add chopped walnuts and shredded coconut, as desired.

title: Chicken Supreme
directions: Mix all ingredients in a glass 9 x 13-inch pan and refrigerate overnight., (If you use an aluminum pan, store ingredients in a glass bowl and transfer just before baking)., Sprinkle crushed potato chips over top and bake in 350° oven for 1 1/2 hours. Serves 12.

title: Hamburger Stroganoff
directions: Cook onion in butter until transparent., Add ground beef. Cook, stirring until beef is light brown., Add the flour, salt, pepper, mushrooms and soup., Cook for 5 minutes., Add the sour cream and simmer for 15 minutes longer., Serve over cooked rice or cooked egg noodles., Garnish with paprika., Makes 4 servings.

title: Seasoned Brussels Sprouts Parmesan
directions: In large saucepan, add brussels sprouts, salt and butter to 2 inches of water., Bring to boil, cover and cook until tender, about 15 to 20 minutes., Drain., Add salad crunches and parsley and sprinkle parmesan to cover sprouts., Serve warm., Serves 4 to 6.

title: Edible Rocket
directions: Peel the banana., Cut it in half crosswise., Cut the pineapple ring into quarters. Place a banana half on a plate., Place 2 pineapple quarters near the base of the banana., Spoon 1/4 cup of the cottage cheese around the bottom and eat!

title: Easter Lily
directions: Mix all together., Drop on greased cookie sheet (about 1 teaspoon), six on sheet., Bake at 350°, for 7 minutes., Pinch together while hot in the shape of a lily., Fill open end with Cool Whip and cherry.

title: Marinated Steak
directions: Mix together the wine, soy sauce and seasonings., Place the steak in a long glass baking dish and pour the marinade over the meat., Cover and chill at least 12 to 18 hours, turning the meat over once or twice., Preheat the broiler., Remove the steak from the marinade., Pat dry and broil 4-inches from the heat for about 5 minutes on each side., To serve, cut thin slices diagonally across the grain., Serve with rice.

title: 6 Weeks Bran Muffins
directions: Mix in very large bowl Raisin Bran, sugar, flour and salt. Add soda, cinnamon, beaten eggs, oil and 1 quart of buttermilk; mix well., Stir all the way to the bottom; refrigerate., Do not stir again., Fill muffin tins 2/3 full., Bake at 350° for 18 to 20 minutes., Keep in refrigerator for 6 weeks., Use just what you need each time., Makes 5 dozen.

title: Johnny Cake
directions: Heat water to a boil., In a large mixing bowl, combine cornmeal, sugar and salt., Add boiling water, stirring gradually into 3 ingredients., Batter should not be too thin., Add milk and butter., Using a small ladle, pour batter onto hot greased griddle forming cakes about 3 inches in diameter., Fry until browned on both sides., Serve with maple syrup., Serves 2 to 4.

title: Banana Cream Pie(No Bake)
directions: Mix pudding mix with cold milk at lowest speed of mixer for 3 minutes., Remove mixer., Fold in 1/2 cup whipped topping., Slice banana into pie crust., Pour in pudding., Chill 3 hours., Top with remaining whipped topping.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
directions: Mix well., Place mixture into one pie shell., Place the other pie shell on top., Brush top with butter., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Strawberry Cake
directions: Mix and blend well., Bake at 300° to 350° for 30 minutes or longer.

title: Pineapple Spoon Bread
directions: Grease 2-quart casserole. Mix sugar, flour and salt. Beat in eggs. Add pineapple. Pour in pan. Tear bread or croissants into pieces and spread over mixture., Pour melted butter over bread. Bake at 350° for approximately 1 hour or until it stops jiggling.

title: Gingerbread
directions: Heat oven to 325°., Grease and flour a baking pan 9 x 9 x 2-inches., Mix all ingredients except whipped cream or applesauce in a large mixer bowl., Blend 1/2 minute on low speed, scraping the bowl constantly., Beat 3 minutes on medium speed scraping occasionally., Pour into the pan., Bake 50 minutes., Serve warm with whipped cream or applesauce.

title: Caramel Apple Salad
directions: Mix apples and candy until well blended., Gently stir in whipped topping., Refrigerate 1 hour or until ready to serve. Garnish with apple slices and additional chopped candy bars, if desired.

title: Goulash
directions: Simmer all for 1/2 hour., Stir occasionally to prevent sticking to pan.

title: Vegetable Salad
directions: Drain corn, peas and beans., Then mix peppers, celery and pimientos with first mixture., Bring to boil the oil, vinegar, sugar, salt and pepper., Pour over vegetables; mix well., Chill and serve., Keeps for weeks.

title: Day Ahead Mashed Potatoes
directions: Mix all ingredients together while potatoes are warm., Put in casserole a day ahead., Warm in oven at 350° for 45 minutes. Especially good with ham.

title: Spinach Dip
directions: Combine preceding ingredients; chill., Serve with chopped vegetables or cut up dark pumpernickel bread.

title: Mmmmm Impossible Taco Pie
directions: Cook ground beef, onions and seasoning mix together until meat turns color; drain., Put in a greased 8 x 8-inch square pan. Spread beans on top of meat., Mix Bisquick, milk and eggs; pour over beans., Bake at 400° until brown., Sprinkle cheese on top and put back into oven until cheese is melted., Serve with remaining ingredients.

title: Corn Puddings
directions: Mix flour and sugar together., Stir in corn and all other ingredients., Pour into greased baking dish., Bake until thick, but not too dry (approximately 30 minutes at 350°).

title: Smoky Sausage Spread
directions: Cut up cooked sausage links in small, fine pieces; set aside. Combine cheese spread and Monterey Jack cheese; beat with mixer until well combined., Stir in sausage., Spread on bread, bagels or English muffins., Bake at 350° for 5 minutes.

title: Chicken Pilau
directions: Cook hen with celery, bay leaves, salt, pepper and enough water to cover., When the chicken is ready to fall from the bones, remove from broth; set aside.

title: Apple Pie Mix
directions: Sprinkle apples with sugar, cinnamon and nutmeg., Add vanilla and lemon juice., Cook slowly for about 25 minutes, stir occasionally.

title: Coconut Surprise
directions: Mix and bake cake (per directions) and let cool for about 15 minutes., Poke holes in top of cake., Mix together milk and cream of coconut., Pour mixture on top of cake., Put in refrigerator and let set., Sprinkle coconut and/or nuts on top.

title: Macaroni Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients together and refrigerate until time to serve.

title: A Fall Supper
directions: Brown slices of country ham in ample grease (I use Crisco). Remove ham., Brown flour very brown, put a lot of black pepper in pan and add tomato juice., Add water to desired consistency and simmer., Fry apples in a frying pan, adding sugar and bacon drippings until done (add a bit of salt)., Add a pan full of steaming hot biscuits that contain chunks of cheese in the center. Together with grits and lots of the tasty tomato gravy you will have a feast incomparable.

title: Cavsa From Peru
directions: Boil potatoes and mash well., Add lemon juice, oil, salt and hot pepper., Place a layer of mixture in bottom of serving dish. Saute onion and spread over potato mixture., May add other cooked, chopped fine vegetables., Cover with second layer of potatoes. Sprinkle with grated cheese (optional)., Garnish with olives, sliced hard-boiled eggs and serve on lettuce.

title: Turkey Stuffing
directions: Soak bread in water for 5 minutes., Cook onions, celery and sausage in butter for 10 minutes or until sausage is cooked. Combine with bread and add eggs, walnuts, salt, pepper, broth and giblets., Mix well.

title: Lattice Jam Bars
directions: Mix together the almonds and sugar., Blend in butter and flour., Mix well., Add egg yolks., Roll dough to 1/2-inch thick. Save half for cross bars., Spread on cookie sheet, then spread 1 pound apricot jam over dough., Make cross bars by rolling out dough and cutting into strips., Crisscross strips on top of jam to give lattice effect., Bake in a 350°, oven about 30 minutes, or until light brown., Great!

title: Dump Delight Cake
directions: Spread pie filling and pineapple in a 13 x 13 x 2-inch cake pan., Sprinkle dry cake mix over fruit (do not stir)., Top with nuts; add coconut., Pour melted butter over all and bake at 350° for 50 minutes., Great with ice cream., Serves 12 to 15.

title: Broiled Salmon With Herbed Lemon Butter
directions: Line broiler pan with foil and place salmon fillets on the well-greased rack., Combine remaining ingredients; baste salmon with mixture., Broil 4 inches from heat, allowing 10 minutes cooking time per inch of thickness measured at its thickest part or until salmon flakes easily when tested with a fork., Do not turn salmon., Baste several times during cooking., Makes 8 servings.

title: Caramel Popcorn
directions: Combine and melt over medium heat., Pour over popped corn. Bake at 250° in two 15 x 9-inch pans for 1 hour, stirring every 15 minutes and stirring after removed from oven until cooled., Keeps well in an airtight container or bag., Can halve recipe., Also can use the large bags of popped corn but omit salt if you do.

title: New Uncooked White Mystery Fruitcake
directions: Bake cake mix, following package directions., Cool., Crumble cake into very large bowl or pan., Add fruit to crumbled cake. Make Betty Crocker frosting mix, following package directions. Mix with cake and fruit., Pack tightly into foil-lined 10-inch tube pan or two 9 x 3-inch loaf pans., Cover cake with foil and chill in refrigerator at least 24 hours., Cake should be kept refrigerated., Slice with sharp knife.

title: Chicken Or Turkey Strata
directions: Place bread cubes in 12 x 18-inch nonstick pan., Combine chicken, onion, celery, chilies, mayonnaise, salt and pepper in medium bowl and spoon over bread., Tear tortillas into bite-sized pieces and place on top., Combine eggs, milk, cottage cheese and soup in a small bowl and pour over top., Cover and refrigerate overnight to allow flavors to blend., Preheat oven to 325° and bake 50 to 60 minutes or until the dish is firm and set., Remove from oven and let stand for 10 minutes before serving., Serves 8.

title: Texas Potatoes
directions: Mix all ingredients but last two., Place in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish., Top with crushed corn flakes and dot with butter. Bake uncovered at 350° for 45 minutes., Serves 8 to 10.

title: Lasagna Squares
directions: Grease square baking dish., Layer cottage cheese and Parmesan cheese in dish., Mix cooked beef, herbs, tomato paste and 1/2 cup Mozzarella; spoon evenly over top., Beat milk, eggs, Bisquick, salt and pepper with a wire whisk until smooth., Pour into dish., Bake until knife inserted in center comes out clean., Sprinkle with remaining cheese., Cool for 5 minutes., Serves 4 to 6.

title: Cafe Au Lait Mix
directions: Combine 4 tablespoons of mix with 2/3 cup of hot water.

title: Summer Squash Pasta
directions: Cut zucchini and squash into fourths lengthwise, then into 1/2-inch sections crosswise., Dice onion; mince garlic., Fry onion in enough oil to keep it from sticking., Add garlic when onion is soft., Then add squash., Cook on medium heat, stirring occasionally, until mixture collapses and becomes soft., Remove from heat and add cheese, the salt and pepper to taste (cheese is quite salty)., Serve over or mix into pasta adding more olive oil as needed., Serve with green salad if desired.

title: Corn Chowder
directions: Combine first 5 ingredients in a saucepan., Cook over medium heat until thoroughly heated, stirring occasionally., Sprinkle each serving with crumbled bacon and green onions., Makes 1-quart.

title: Applesauce-Raisin Cookies(Diabetic)
directions: Sift flour, soda, salt, nutmeg and cinnamon into a bowl., Add rolled oats and raisins., Mix applesauce, oil, egg, vanilla and sweetener together., Add to dry ingredients; mix just until moistened., Drop by teaspoonfuls onto a greased cookie sheet. Bake at 375° for 10 minutes, or until done., Yields 2 dozen cookies.

title: Cat'S Meow(Cold Fruit Candy)
directions: Put all dry ingredients through grinder 2 or 3 times., Knead well after adding butter, fruit juice and vanilla., Let stand several hours., Roll out to about 3/4-inch thick; cut into cubes or bars., Sprinkle liberally with powdered sugar; store in covered containers in refrigerator.

title: Scalloped Pineapple
directions: Butter a 2-quart casserole., Put 1 can of pineapple on bottom of dish., Mix cheeses together and sprinkle half of cheese mixture on top of pineapple., Mix flour and sugar and sprinkle on cheese. Follow with second can of pineapple and the remaining half of flour-sugar mixture, leaving remaining half of cheese mixture for top., Pour 1/2 cup pineapple juice over entire dish and dot with butter., Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes until bubbly and brown.

title: Cheese Rolls
directions: Mix together first four ingredients and form into logs., Roll logs in chopped beef until well covered., Can be prepared ahead of time and kept refrigerated several days., Serve with crackers.

title: Pizza Casserole
directions: Prepare egg noodles as directed; drain., Brown hamburger meat; drain., Combine all ingredients together., Place in greased 9 x 13-inch dish; sprinkle Mozzarella cheese on top., Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Chewy Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Combine Crisco, brown sugar, egg, milk and vanilla in large bowl., Beat at medium speed until well blended., Combine oats, flour, baking soda, salt and cinnamon., Mix into creamed mixture at a low speed., Stir in raisins., Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
directions: Mix all together; drop and bake at 350° to 375°., Makes lots.

title: Tortilla Pinwheels
directions: Mix all together., Spread over tortillas; roll up., Wrap tightly in plastic., Refrigerate overnight., Cut 1/2 to 3/4-inch and serve with salsa.

title: Creamy Vinaigrette Dressing
directions: Whisk together and refrigerate for 2 hours.

title: Coconut Flan
directions: Mix both milks, eggs and vanilla until well combined., Stir in the flaked coconut and pour the mixture into 6 individual custard cups or a larger flan mold., Place the cups or mold in a large baking pan and fill it with water to a depth of 1-inch. Bake in a preheated 350° oven for 30 to 35 minutes or until a knife inserted into the center comes out clean. A flan mold will take longer than individual cups. Allow to cool, then refrigerate at least 2 hours before serving.

title: Punch Bowl Cake
directions: Crumble half of cake in bottom of bowl. Layer half of pudding, pineapple and pie filling. Repeat with second layer. Add large Cool Whip on top. Nuts and coconut are optional. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Fried Fish
directions: Cut fillets in 4-inch portions., Season with salt and pepper. Mix nuts and cayenne., Dip fillets in egg and water mix; roll in flour., Fry in butter in skillet or microwave 5 minutes with nut mix sprinkled over fillets.

title: Fudge
directions: Melt butter. Add sugar and milk. Bring to a rolling boil, cook for 7 minutes, stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Add chocolate chips and marshmallows. Stir until dissolved. Pour into 2- 9 x 13 buttered pans. Cool. Cut into squares. Makes 5 lbs.

title: Baked Macaroni And Cheese
directions: In large Pyrex casserole, well greased, put 1 cup milk and 1 egg., Beat with fork until well blended., Add in layers cooked macaroni, grated cheese, dots of butter, salt and pepper., Sprinkle bread crumbs on top., Arrange sliced tomatoes., Bake at 350° for 25 to 35 minutes or until thoroughly heated through.

title: Green Bean Casserole (Quick And Easy)
directions: Mix green beans and cream of mushroom soup and top with onion rings., Place in microwave until steaming hot.

title: Beef Stew
directions: In a large non-stick pot, heat oil over medium-high heat. Add beef; saute until browned, about 6 minutes. Place on plate.

title: Hot Chicken Salad Casserole
directions: Combine all ingredients except potato chips and cheese; blend well together., Spoon into a lightly greased 3 quart shallow casserole., Top with cheese., Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes. Put sprinkling of potato chips over surface during last 10 minutes of baking.

title: Brown Rice
directions: Melt margarine., Add other ingredients and stir together. Pour into a glass casserole dish and bake at 375° for 1 hour.

title: Egg Custard
directions: Melt butter in a pie plate., Beat eggs with mixer (eggs only); then mix in sugar, flour, sweet milk, vanilla and butter., Bake at 350° about 30 minutes or until middle is done.

title: Chili-Cheese Rounds
directions: Heat oven to 400°., Mix beans, onion and pepper sauce; reserve., Mix baking mix and sour cream until soft dough forms; beat vigorously 20 strokes., Gently smooth dough into ball on floured cloth covered board., Knead 20 times., Roll dough 1/4 inch thick., Cut with floured 2-inch cutter., Place on ungreased cookie sheet., Press a deep indention about 1 1/2 inches in diameter in center of each round with floured hands., Fill each with generous teaspoon of bean mixture; spread within indention. Top each with chilies and cheese., Bake until light brown, 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Snicker Bar Salad
directions: Dice apples with peeling on., Slice bananas and the refrigerated candy bars into bite size pieces., Fold in Cool Whip.

title: Meat Loaf
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., In a large bowl, combine all ingredients., In a large baking pan, shape into a loaf., Bake 1 hour or until done., Makes about 8 servings.

title: Roasted Garlic
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Trim off each garlic head to expose the tops of the cloves., Place heads in shallow baking dish, such as a 9-inch pie plate., Drizzle garlic with oil and sprinkle with pepper, salt and thyme., Roast garlic for 30 minutes., Reduce heat to 250° and cook for 1 hour longer., Serve garlic with slices of crusty French bread, butter and goat cheese, such as Feta., Pop the cloves out of the skins and spread on bread., Yield:, 8 servings.

title: Chicken Loaf
directions: Saute onion and celery in margarine., Mix all ingredients well and bake in greased 8-inch casserole at 350° for 35 minutes.

title: Coffee Liqueur
directions: Mix in blender and drink.

title: Honey Cornbread
directions: Combine dry ingredients., Beat eggs, add cream, oil and honey., Stir into dry ingredients until just moistened., Pour into 9 inch square pan., Bake at 400 degrees for 20-25 minutes.

title: Spiced Coffee
directions: In saucepan, combine all ingredients except coffee., Heat to boiling., Strain., Pour liquid over coffee in heatproof container. Stir coffee until dissolved.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
directions: Preheat oven to 400°., Lightly grease a 2-quart casserole. Wash, pare and thinly slice potatoes; measure 8 cups., Cook potatoes and onions, covered in small amount of boiling water, with 2 teaspoon salt, for about 5 minutes or until slightly tender., Drain., Melt butter or margarine in saucepan; remove from heat., Stir in flour, pepper, paprika and remaining salt until smooth., Blend in milk., Cook, stirring, over medium heat to boiling point or until thickened and smooth., In prepared casserole, layer one-third of potatoes and onions; sprinkle with 1 tablespoon parsley., Top with one-third of the sauce., Repeat, then add remaining potatoes and top with remaining sauce., Bake, uncovered, for 35 minutes, or until top is browned and potatoes are tender when pierced with fork., Serves 6 to 8.

title: Lemon Squares
directions: Melt margarine with 2 cups flour and 1/2 cup powdered sugar. Put into 13 x 9-inch pan (greased) and press on bottom and sides to form crust., Bake 15 to 20 minutes., Beat eggs; add sugar, mixed with 1/4 cup flour and the lemon juice., Pour this over baked crust., Return to oven and bake 20 minutes longer., Remove from oven; sprinkle with powdered sugar while hot., Let cool before cutting.

title: Creamy Rice Pudding
directions: Combine rice, sugar, 6 cups milk and water., Bring to a boil. Cook 1 hour, covered, over low heat, stirring occasionally., Mix together the eggs, vanilla and 2 cups milk., Add to the heated rice mixture and heat an additional 10 minutes.

title: One Bowl Chocolate Fudge
directions: Microwave chocolate and milk in a large microwavable dish on High for 2 or 3 minutes, until chocolate is melted, stirring half way through heating time., Stir until chocolate is completely melted., Stir in vanilla and walnuts., Spread in a greased 8 x 8-inch pan., Refrigerate until firm., Cut into squares.

title: Easy Chicken Casserole
directions: In a large mixing bowl, mix all the ingredients together., If you are using broccoli, thaw it in the microwave and drain well before mixing it in., Place mixture in ungreased casserole bowl and bake, uncovered, at 350° for 1 hour., Remove and stir well during this cooking time., After it is done, let it stand for a few minutes.

title: Meat And Potato Cakes
directions: Mix ground beef with sauce, onion and salt., Shape into patties. Brown on each side., Put hot potatoes on each patty. Sprinkle with cheese and brown or until cheese melts.

title: Cake
directions: Mix the yellow cake mix, one of the eggs and the margarine together and press into the bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan., Beat for 3 minutes the other 2 eggs, cream cheese and sugar., Pour on top of the "crust.", Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Luck'S Chili Hot Beans
directions: In a 3-quart saucepan, cook beef and onions until beef is brown; drain., Stir in remaining ingredients., Heat to a boil over medium heat., Reduce heat; cover and simmer 30 minutes., Makes about 7 one cup servings.

title: One Step Lasagna
directions: Divide noodles into 3, for the 3 layers., Combine water with sauce in bowl., Cover bottom of 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan with 1 1/2 cups sauce., Arrange layer of uncooked noodles, slightly overlapping, on top of sauce., Spread 1/2 Ricotta and Mozzarella over noodles., Sprinkle with 2 tablespoons Parmesan., Add layer of sauce., Layer noodles with the remaining Ricotta and Mozzarella and 2 tablespoons Parmesan., Top with layer of noodles. Pour remaining sauce over, spreading evenly to cover edges of noodles. Sprinkle with 1/4 cup Parmesan., Cover tightly with heavy-duty foil., Set on cookie sheet., Bake at 350° for 1 hour., Let stand, covered, on rack for 10 minutes before cutting.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Position rack in center of oven and preheat oven to 350°. Line baking sheets with parchment paper or coat with nonstick cooking spray., In a large bowl, whisk together the sugar, applesauce, egg white, oil and vanilla until smooth., Stir in raisins., In a medium size bowl, stir together the oats, cake flour, whole wheat flour, baking soda, cinnamon and salt., Using a wooden spoon, stir the dry ingredients into the wet, mixing just until blended., Drop the dough by tablespoonfuls onto a prepared baking sheet, spacing cookies about 1 1/2 inches apart., Bake for about 15 minutes, or until lightly browned., Transfer cookies to a wire rack; let cool., Makes 3 dozen cookies.

title: Frankie Rouse'S 7-Minute Icing
directions: Place all ingredients except marshmallows and vanilla in top of double boiler over boiling water and beat with a rotary beater 7 minutes or until mixture holds a peak., Remove from heat., Add vanilla and marshmallows., Continue to beat until well blended and apply to cake.

title: Cheese Souffle
directions: Line sides and bottom of medium size casserole dish with bread dipped in melted butter or margarine., Mix other ingredients together and pour into bread-lined dish., Bake at 325° for 40 minutes or until firm.

title: Strawberry Jello Salad
directions: Dissolve Jell-O in hot water; add strawberries, bananas and nuts., Put 1/2 of mixture in glass bowl or mold and refrigerate until firm., Spread 1/2 of the sour cream on first mixture of Jell-O and pour remaining Jell-O mixture on top of sour cream. Chill again until firm., Spread the remaining sour cream on top. Better if made the day before.

title: Spaghetti Salad
directions: Boil spaghetti according to directions on package., Drain off hot water and rinse spaghetti in cold water 3 times., Add Zesty Italian dressing., Mix well., Add at least a half bottle of seasoning mix., Stir well., Cut up all vegetables and add them to spaghetti mixture., Store in refrigerator., Serve cold.

title: Easy Clams And Linguini
directions: Fry garlic and onion in oil until lightly browned., Add clams with only 1/2 juice, parsley and a little salt and pepper., Add wine; simmer for 15 to 20 minutes., Serve over cooked linguini.

title: Microwave Party Mints
directions: Combine sugar, corn syrup, milk and cream of tartar in a 2-quart glass measure., Cook on High for 6 minutes., Let stand 3 to 4 minutes, until slightly cooled., Beat vigorously until creamy. Add peppermint extract and food coloring., Drop by teaspoonfuls onto sheets of foil., Let stand until cool and firm., Store in airtight container., Makes about 36 mints.

title: Vegetable Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients except crackers and margarine., Place in a 2-quart buttered casserole dish., Mix crackers with margarine. Sprinkle on top of vegetables. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: American Meat Loaf
directions: Thoroughly combine all ingredients and shape into a loaf pan (8 x 4 x 1 1/2-inches)., Bake in 350° oven for 1 hour., Allow meat loaf to stand 5 minutes before slicing., Makes 6 servings.

title: Quiche Lorraine
directions: Heat oven to 425°., Prepare pastry for 9-inch crust., Sprinkle bacon, cheese and onion in pastry-lined pie pan., Blend remaining ingredients with mixer., Pour into pie pan., Bake 15 minutes. Reduce oven temperature to 300°., Bake pie 30 minutes longer or until knife inserted 1 inch from edge comes out clean., Let pie stand 10 minutes before cutting., Serve in wedges.

title: Torn Salad Dressing
directions: Put all the ingredients into blender. Can add roquefort or bleu cheese., Keeps well.

title: Fudge
directions: Combine, all ingredients, except nuts, in top of double boiler over medium heat.	Stir constantly until smooth., Then add nuts. Spread in 9 x 5-inch buttered pan.	Cool and cut in squares.

title: Chicken Rotel
directions: Cook spaghetti in 2-quart stock., If you do not have that much stock, add a little water., Drain., Add cubed cheese., Add mushrooms, onions (cooked in butter), bell pepper and chicken, Ro-Tel and Worcestershire., Fold in peas last., Salt and pepper to taste., Bake in 300° oven for 30 minutes., Serves approximately 8.

title: Blueberry Dessert
directions: Combine crumbs and melted butter; place in bottom of an 8-inch square pan., Combine cream cheese, powdered sugar and whipped cream., Pour in pan and spoon blueberry filling on top., Freeze for 2 hours before serving.

title: Cottage Herb Rolls
directions: Dissolve yeast in warm water., In large bowl, combine flour, sugar, oregano and salt., Mix well., Cut in cold margarine until mixture resembles coarse crumbs., Blend in cheese, egg and yeast. Turn out on well floured surface., Knead., Shape into ball., Place in well-greased bowl., Brush top with melted margarine; cover. Let rise until doubled., Punch down., Shape as desired., Brush with melted margarine; cover., Let rise again until nearly doubled., Bake at 375° for 12 to 15 minutes., Serve warm., Yield: 1 1/2 to 2 dozen.

title: Stuffed Mushroom Appetizers
directions: Drain crabmeat; press to remove excess fluid., Flake., Mix crabmeat, onions, cheese, seasonings and mayonnaise., Remove stems and scrape gills from mushrooms with a spoon to make deep cups. Heat oven to 325°., Stuff mushrooms generously with crab mixture. Place in ungreased shallow baking dish., Bake 5 minutes., Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese., Turn oven to broil., Broil until golden brown, about 15 minutes.

title: Apple Punch
directions: Combine juices in freezer container., Mix well., Freeze for 2 days., Place mixture in a punch bowl., Add ginger ale 1 hour before serving.

title: Chicken And Rice
directions: Preheat oven to 300°., Butter a 9 x 13-inch loaf pan., Mix rice and both soups and spread into loaf pan., Lay chicken parts on top of rice., Mix onion soup, water and lemon juice and pour over each piece of chicken., Cover with foil and bake at 300° for 3 hours., Serves 4 to 6.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
directions: Boil sugar and milk to soft ball stage, then add marshmallow, peanut butter and vanilla., Beat until smooth., Pour into 9-inch pan, let cool then cut.

title: Sue'S Shrimp Cocktail
directions: Mix all ingredients together very thoroughly and chill., Use salt and pepper to taste.

title: Gnocchi
directions: Beat egg before you mix in rest of ingredients., Flour hands and separate dough into 4 sections., Roll each section into snakes on a floured surface., Cut 1-inch pieces out of the snakes and, with thumb, press flat., Fast freeze (about 10 minutes) on a cookie sheet., When hard, cook in boiling water (salted) for 5 minutes after they rise to the top of the pot., Serve with spaghetti sauce.

title: Whole-Grain Soda Bread
directions: About 4 hours before serving or early in day, preheat oven to 350°., Grease cookie sheet., In large bowl, combine first 6 ingredients and 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour., With pastry blender or two knives used, scissor-fashion, cut in margarine or butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs., Stir in raisins and caraway seed., Stir in buttermilk just until flour is moistened (dough will be sticky).

title: Venison Stroganoff
directions: In large skillet, saute onion., (I like to add garlic, also.) Add venison and cook until browned., Add mushrooms and brown, then add soup and sour cream., Cover and simmer 30 to 60 minutes. Electric fry pan works good., Serve over hot noodles.

title: Cheesy Hamburger Casserole
directions: Cook macaroni until slightly tender., Drain., Set aside. Brown meat and onions in small skillet., Add tomatoes and simmer for 10 minutes., Oil a 1-quart casserole dish; spoon in 1/3 of meat mixture., Add cooked macaroni and then add remaining meat. Spread cheese soup over all (may be frozen uncooked)., Cover the casserole tightly; bake at 400° until bubbly., Makes 4 servings.

title: Hot Fudge Sauce
directions: Mix together and boil for several minutes., Can add a few marshmallows for a change; let them melt in sauce while hot.

title: Chocolate Chip S'More Cookie
directions: Microwave Directions:, Spread 1/2 teaspoon peanut butter on flat side of each cookie., Place marshmallow between peanut butter spread sides of cookies, making a sandwich on microwave-safe paper towel., Microwave on High for 6 to 8 seconds or until marshmallow is slightly softened., Squeeze cookie together slightly., Makes 1 cookie.

title: Cuban Black Bean Pie(Yields 24 Servings)
directions: Combine eggs, honey, cilantro, cumin, lime juice, lime zest, cayenne pepper and salt; reserve., Combine beans, rice and cheese; spread in pie shells., Top with reserved egg mixture.

title: Beer Bread
directions: Blend ingredients., Put in a greased bread pan., Bake for 45 minutes at 350°.

title: Sweet Pickle Chips
directions: Wash cucumbers; trim ends., Cut cucumbers into 1/4-inch slices., Combine cucumber slices, red pepper, onion and garlic in a, large, bowl;, add salt and stir well., Pack crushed ice over cucumbers;	cover, and, let stand 24 hours., Drain well. Rinse cucumber, mixture, several	times, in cold water; drain well. Remove, and discard garlic., Pack cucumber mixture into hot, sterilized jars, leaving 1/2 inch headspace.

title: Venison Ala Desjardins
directions: In heavy skillet brown salt pork in olive oil., Add vegetables and saute until slightly tender., Remove pork and vegetables, leaving fat in skillet., Add 1/4 cup pickle juice to skillet and brown meat., Baste meat with juice while browning., Sugar in juice will caramelize and glaze meat., Turn meat and baste with additional 1/4 cup of juice., Add more juice as needed., Juice will cook off as meat browns., Put all the remaining ingredients in a large covered roasting pan or kettle and cook in 325° oven for approximately 4 hours or cook, covered, on top of stove for 4 hours or until tender., Pour gravy over sliced meat to serve.

title: Black Bean Salad
directions: Soak beans overnight. Drain soaking liquid. Cook 1 hour. Rinse and chill beans., Mix all ingredients., Pour over with Italian dressing. Will keep several days.

title: Rice And Broccoli Casserole
directions: Cook rice and broccoli until tender. Do not salt anything. Saute onions and celery in butter. Combine all ingredients. Pour into 11 x 7 inch casserole dish. Let stand in refrigerator for 12 hours. Bake on 350° for 30 minutes. Serves 8.

title: Apple Nut Pudding
directions: Beat the egg until foamy., Add sugar and beat again., Sift together the flour, salt and baking powder and beat into the egg-sugar mixture.	Blend in the apples, nuts and vanilla.	Bake in a pie pan at 350° until the top is crisp, about 30 minutes., Serve with whipped cream or ice cream.

title: Baked Beans Supreme
directions: If using a low watt oven, first check the oven cavity to be sure it will hold a 3-quart microwave-safe casserole.

title: Ann Lander'S Meat Loaf
directions: Mix and place in loaf pan; add sauce and bake.

title: Candied Ham
directions: Place ham, with pineapple and brown sugar on top in 400° oven wrapped tightly in aluminum foil for about 1 1/2 hours.

title: Almond Butter Crunch
directions: Mix everything in a 10 inch skillet., Bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring constantly until the mixture turns golden brown (about 5 or 6 minutes)., Spread in a greased 8 or 9 inch round pan., Cool., Remove from pan and break into pieces.

title: Fresh Fruit Salad Dressing
directions: Mix juices and sugar; stir in beaten egg., Cook in double boiler for 5 minutes until spoon is coated., Good on fruits and melons.

title: Stuffed Sweet Peppers
directions: Mix ground beef, onion, 2/3 cup chopped pepper and cooked rice., Add crumbled bread and tomato juice; mix well., Take seeds out of the 8 sweet peppers and drop peppers in boiling water for 5 minutes; drain and fill with ground beef mixture., Put in a large pot with lid and pour ketchup over top of peppers., Add 1/2 cup of tomato juice to pot., Cover and cook 2 hours in oven at 350°. Uncover and cook 30, minutes.

title: Hot Spiced Tea
directions: Place water in a saucepan., Add cloves and cinnamon., Bring to a boil., Remove from heat., Add the tea at once; stir to distribute and immerse leaves., Cover and steep 5 minutes. Strain., While tea steeps, heat orange and lemon juices, with sugar added, to a boil., Stir into the hot tea and serve at once in teacups., Makes 7 or 8 servings.

title: Blueberry Syrup
directions: In saucepan combine sugar and cornstarch, and blend well. Add water, syrup, and lemon juice. Mix well. Add blueberries and cool, stirring constantly, until sauce comes to a boil and is thickened.

title: Stuffed Cornish Game Hens
directions: Prepare stuffing as directed on package., Do not stuff hens until ready to roast., Rinse hens with cold water., Pat dry., Rub neck and body cavities with salt and pepper., Lightly stuff cavities with prepared stuffing., Roast at 400° for 1 hour., Place any remaining stuffing in a small baking dish; bake at 400° for 15 minutes., (Meanwhile, heat orange juice and butter; baste hens frequently during the last 30 minutes of roasting.)

title: Beef And Potato Pie
directions: Heat oven to 450°., Oil a 2-quart casserole., Chop onion and garlic., Cook in oil the onion, then garlic, for 1 minute. Crumble beef in pan., Add salt, pepper, thyme and marjoram; cook until browned., Peel and thinly slice potatoes., Drain and chop tomatoes., Add tomatoes and bread crumbs to beef., Arrange 1/2 potatoes on bottom of pan, overlapping halfway up sides., Pack beef into pan., Cover with remaining potatoes., Bake until browned, for 30 to 35 minutes., Serves 4.

title: Cabbage Soup
directions: Combine all ingredients (except juice, potatoes and hamburger)., Simmer over medium, heat until tender; then discard bay leaf., Add juice, diced potatoes and partly fried hamburger. Cook until potatoes are soft.

title: Mexican Taco Dip
directions: Mix cream cheese, sour cream and taco seasoning all together. Shape into a mound on a plate., Spread salsa sauce over top. Sprinkle chopped ingredients over top., Sprinkle cheese over top last., Serve chilled with corn tortilla chips.

title: Mexican Salad
directions: Saute hamburger, pepper and onion together until meat is brown. Add seasonings and keep mixture warm., Melt cheese and Ro-Tel together., Keep warm., In individual salad bowls, layer Fritos, meat, lettuce and tomatoes., Cover with cheese sauce.

title: Artichoke Rice Salad
directions: Marinate artichoke hearts in vinegar and oil for 4 to 6 hours; drain and reserve liquid.

title: Baked Beans With Pineapple And Bacon
directions: Mix all ingredients, except bacon in 2-quart baking dish. Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes., Cook bacon crisp; blot on paper towel., Crumble up and add to bean mixture before serving., Very good.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Melt margarine., Add flour, cream cheese, salt, liquid, chicken, macaroni and pimiento., Mix well., Bake at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes, until slightly browned.

title: Blueberry Pie
directions: Mix first three ingredients and bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes., Cool., Mix cream cheese and powdered sugar together and set aside., Mix Dream Whip together by directions on box., Fold into cream mixture., Put in chilled crust and top with blueberry pie filling., (Can substitute strawberry or cherry pie filling.)

title: Old Fashioned Pot Roast With Egg Noodles
directions: Brown rump roast in oil in Dutch oven., Remove meat; drain off fat., Combine mushrooms, vegetables, garlic, 1 1/4 teaspoons salt, bouillon cubes, pepper, bay leaves, tomato paste and 2 cups water in Dutch oven; heat to boiling point., Add roast., Simmer, covered, for 4 hours.

title: Confetti Rice
directions: Melt butter in a skillet., Add rice, toss to coat with butter. Heat on low for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally., Place rice mixture in a 2-quart casserole bowl; add hot chicken broth., Cover and bake at 350° for 30 minutes., Stir in the remaining ingredients., Cook 5 additional minutes., Serves 4.

title: Surprise Cheese Puffs
directions: Blend cheese with butter; add flour, salt and paprika., Mix well., Pat olives dry on paper towel., Mold 1 teaspoon dough around each olive to cover., At this point you can refrigerate or freeze puffs for up to 10 days., They hold their shape better if frozen first., Bake puffs on lightly greased cookie sheet in a 400° oven until lightly golden brown, approximately 10 to 15 minutes., Serve hot.

title: Pasta Primevara
directions: Toss all vegetables in enough olive oil to coat; add herbs. Spread out onto 2 cookie sheets and roast in oven at 400° until well done and crispy, about 15-20 minutes, stirring vegetables at least once during baking.

title: French Coconut Pie
directions: Beat eggs and other ingredients., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Italian Torta
directions: Soak bread in hot milk., Set aside., Beat together eggs and sugar., Add to soaked bread/milk mixture., Add vanilla, raisins and grated apple., Add brandy last., Bake in well-greased pan at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Tasty Carrots
directions: Grate, carrots., Place	in, 8-inch Dutch oven.	Mix the rest of the ingredients and bake for 30 minutes.

title: Enchilada Bake
directions: Cook meat, mix in refried beans, taco seasoning mix until hot and blended. Mix enchilada sauce and soup together, warm., Put meat mixture in middle of tortilla, roll and place in greased baking dish. Pour sauce mixture over rolled tortillas, sprinkle with cheese and bake until bubbly.

title: Pickled Shrimp
directions: Place shrimp in boiling salted water; reduce heat and simmer for 3 to 5 minutes., Shrimp are done when they are pink and tender; drain and rinse with cold water, then chill.

title: Shortcut Manicotti
directions: Combine first 4 ingredients; mix well., Spoon into uncooked manicotti shells., Arrange in 10 x 6 x 2-inch baking dish. Combine picante sauce and 1/2 cup water; pour over manicotti.

title: Poached Catfish
directions: In medium sized microwave-safe dish, place fish., In cup, combine butter, wine, lemon juice, thyme, tarragon, paprika and salt and pepper to taste., Cover and microwave on High (100% power) 2 1/2 minutes or until fish flakes when tested with fork., Rotate dish one-quarter turn halfway through cooking time., To serve, garnish with parsley and lemon.

title: Blueberry Muffins
directions: Set oven at 350°., Mix together sugar, butter, egg and vanilla., Beat with mixer until creamy., Add baking powder to flour., Alternate flour and milk to mixture, beating with mixer until well mixed., Fold in drained blueberries., Spoon out into muffin tins., Bake for 30 to 35 minutes until golden brown.

title: Ice Cream
directions: Mix together the sugar, cornstarch, salt, eggs and enough milk to make a smooth paste; add to scalded milk., When it comes to a boil, boil for 2 minutes, stirring constantly., Add remaining milk, vanilla and Grape-Nuts., Can add Eagle Brand., Yields 8 quarts., Okay to use for 6 quarts, just don't add Eagle Brand.

title: Crunchy Pickle And Ham Appetizer
directions: Pat ham and pickle spears dry with paper towel. Spread 13 ham slices each with about 1 Tbsp. cream cheese. Top each with 1 pickle spear; roll up. Refrigerate 1 hour or overnight. Cut each pickle roll into 4 to 6 pieces to serve. Makes 62 to 78.

title: Lasagna
directions: Brown meat. Add all ingredients, except noodles and cheese. Season to taste., Simmer for at least 3 hours., Do not skim off too much fat, or lasagna will be dry., Cook noodles as directed on package, but add 1 tablespoon oil to prevent sticking., Place in pan as follows:, layer of noodles and layer of cheese., Repeat, ending with cheese., Bake at 350° for 1/2 hour.

title: Morgan'S Magnificient Obsession
directions: Preheat oven to 400°., Grease and flour a 13 x 9-inch baking pan., Combine sugar and flour; set aside., In a medium saucepan, melt butter or margarine with cocoa and water; bring to a boil. Pour mixture over sugar and flour., Mix well., Add buttermilk, eggs, cinnamon, baking soda and vanilla; mix until smooth., Pour into a greased and floured pan; bake 20 to 30 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Peanut Butter Ice Cream Pie
directions: Prepare crust., Cool., Press half of softened ice cream into crust., In small bowl, stir corn syrup and peanut butter until blended., Pour half of mixture over ice cream., Sprinkle with half of peanuts, repeating layering., Freeze until firm, about 5 hours. Let pie stand at room temperature for 5 minutes for easy cutting.

title: Squash Pie
directions: Mix squash, sugar, flour, nutmeg, vanilla and lemon extract together., Add beaten eggs., Add milk to squash., Stir until well blended., Pour into an unbaked pie shell., Bake for 10 minutes at 375°., Bake 40 to 50 minutes or longer.

title: Mrs. Yoppi'S Nut Roll
directions: Mix oleo with flour, like pie dough., Add egg yolks, sour cream and vanilla., Mix together and make 8 balls of dough., Put in refrigerator for 2 1/2 hours or overnight., Roll like pies in powdered sugar., Beat egg whites and 1/2 box powdered sugar together., Spread egg white mixture over dough; sprinkle with ground nuts., Cut with pizza cutter like pie in 8 pieces., Roll outside to center and put on greased cookie sheet., Bake for 18 to 20 minutes or until brown.

title: Applesauce Cake
directions: Cream the butter and sugar until light; add the applesauce, raisins, flour, spices, salt, soda and baking powder sifted together twice., Beat well and bake in a shallow well-greased pan in a moderate oven, 350° to 400°., Test with toothpick after 40 minutes.

title: America'S Pot Roast
directions: Trim all fat from roast, brown and drain., Combine 1/4 cup flour, salt and pepper., Coat meat with flour mixture., Place all vegetables except mushrooms in crock-pot and top with roast. Cover and cook on low setting for 10 to 12 hours., Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Peanut Butter Balls
directions: Melt butter and peanut butter, then add sugar and mix by hand. Roll out into balls., Set aside., Melt paraffin and chips., Dip balls into chocolate; put on waxed paper to cool.

title: Meatza Pie
directions: Place beef, garlic salt and stuffing in pie pan., Add milk and mix together with fork., Spread mixture evenly over bottom of pan with a rim around the edge., Spread tomato paste over meat. Sprinkle oregano and mushrooms over paste., Top with cheeses. Bake 20 minutes at 400°.

title: Cranberry Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients together (except drain and save pineapple juice)., Beat together pineapple juice, water and lemon juice. Then stir into Jell-O until dissolved., Chill until set.

title: Barbecue Baked Beans
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Place in a 350° oven for 1 hour.

title: Mexican Dip
directions: Mix sour cream and cream cheese., Spread on a cake plate. Pour picante sauce over and sprinkle cheeses on top.

title: Elk Or Deer Stew
directions: Cook meat, green peppers and onions in oil until browned., Add water, salt, black pepper, bouillon cube and bay leaf., Cover and simmer 2 1/2 to 3 hours until meat is tender., Add carrots, potatoes and celery., Simmer until vegetables are tender, approximately 30 minutes., Shake cold water and flour until completely mixed; add to stew., Bring to boil, stirring constantly until thickens like gravy.

title: Quick And Easy Lasagne
directions: Brown hamburger and drain., Mix with spaghetti sauce, drained mushrooms and water., Layer in 9 x 13-inch pan: meat sauce, uncooked lasagne noodles, cottage cheese, Mozzarella and Parmesan cheese, beginning and ending with meat sauce., Sprinkle top with Parmesan., Cover with heavy duty foil and seal tightly., Bake at 350° for 1 hour., Let stand 15 to 20 minutes before removing foil.

title: Cream Puffs
directions: Preheat oven to 450°., Combine water, butter and salt and bring to boil., Remove from heat and flour all at once., Stir vigorously until mixture leaves sides of pan and forms ball around spoon., (If ball does not form immediately, hold saucepan over low heat and beat briskly a few seconds.), Cool slightly., Add eggs, one at a time, and beat until smooth and glossy after each addition., Drop by teaspoonful onto greased baking sheet, leaving 2 inches between puffs., Bake 15 minutes., Reduce heat to 350° and bake until no bubbles of fat remain on surface and sides of puffs feel rigid, about 30 minutes., Cool., Cut a cap off puff and fill with Pastry Cream., Replace cap., Makes 10 large puffs.

title: Carrot-Dill Soup
directions: Bake the potato and sweet potato 1 hour until soft., Steam the carrots over boiling water until very tender (8 to 10 minutes).

title: Peanut Butter Cake
directions: Cake:, Mix all together and add 1 cup sour milk., If you have no sour milk, add 1 teaspoon vinegar., Add flour and soda., Bake 45 minutes at 350°.

title: Gobs
directions: Cream Crisco; add eggs. Add to flour mixture. Mix. Add sour milk. Last add water. Drop by tablespoon and bake 8 minutes at 350°. Cook flour and milk until thickened. Beat in Crisco with powdered sugar until fluffy; add cooled paste and vanilla. Beat until creamy and spread between 2 cookies.

title: Pound Cake 2
directions: Cream butter, sugar and Crisco., Add sour cream and blend., Add eggs, one at a time., Mix in vanilla., Sift flour, baking powder and salt., Add alternately with milk., Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 20 minutes in 10-inch tube pan.

title: Easy Lasagne
directions: Brown ground beef and spices in skillet; drain, then add spaghetti sauce and cottage cheese., While cooking meat mixture, cook noodles and drain.

title: Shirley'S Snack Crackers
directions: Put crackers in a large bowl., Pour on oil., In another bowl, mix together all dry ingredients., Mix all ingredients together and store in a container with a lid.

title: Easy Chicken Pie
directions: Remove chicken from bone and place in dish., Heat celery soup and broth and pour over chicken., Mix flour, milk and baking powder with margarine and pour over chicken., Bake at 425° for 30 minutes.

title: Basic Pudding Mix
directions: Mix all dry ingredients and store in Tupperware canister. Prepare as directed in individual recipes.

title: Hummus
directions: In small frying pan, toast sesame seed over low heat, shaking pan often, until golden brown (about 3 minutes)., Transfer seed to blender or food processor and add garbanzos, 2 tablespoons olive oil, lemon juice, garlic and 6 tablespoons reserved liquid. Whirl, adding more liquid if necessary, until hummus is smooth, but still thick., Season with salt and pepper., Place in shallow bowl., Drizzle with remaining 2 tablespoons oil., Makes 2 cups.

title: Chicken Strata(To Be Done The Day Before Serving.)
directions: Butter 2 slices of bread., Cut into 1/2-inch cubes and set aside., Cut remaining bread into 1-inch cubes., Place 1/2 of unbuttered cubes in bottom of pan., Combine chicken, vegetables, mayonnaise and seasoning., Spoon over bread cubes., Sprinkle remaining bread cubes over chicken., Combine eggs and milk and pour over all., Cover and chill overnight., Spoon soup over top and sprinkle buttered bread cubes over soup., Bake at 325° for 50 minutes or until set., Sprinkle cheese over top the last few minutes of baking.

title: Bran Muffins
directions: Stir together flour, sugar, salt and baking powder., In large mixing bowl, combine all-bran and milk., Let stand about 5 minutes., Add flour mixture and raisins., Stir only until combined., Spray 12 muffin pan cups with no-stick spray., Divide mixture into 12 cups., Bake at 400° for approximately 20 minutes. For reduced calories, use 2 tablespoons sugar instead of above amounts.

title: Fudgy Chocolate Brownies
directions: In small saucepan on low heat, melt butter and chocolate. Take off burner., Add sugar and mix., Add one egg at a time, mixing after each., Add all remaining ingredients and mix., Grease 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Tartar Sauce
directions: Mix all together and chill approximately 2 hours before serving.

title: Squash Casserole
directions: Cook squash and mash., Add eggs, milk and other ingredients to squash., Pour into buttered baking dish., Sprinkle cheese on top and bake., Bake 40 minutes at 375°.

title: Barbecue Sauce
directions: Chill and keep in refrigerator for a good long time.

title: Sausage Balls
directions: Combine Bisquick and water., Add sausage and cheese and roll into small, bite size balls., Bake 15 minutes at 350°.

title: Chicken And Rice In Green Vegetable Broth
directions: Remove and discard skin from chicken., In a large sauce pan, combine chicken broth, water, rice, thyme and pepper., Add chicken, cover and bring to a boil over high heat., Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 15 minutes., Shred cabbage and spinach., Remove chicken to a cutting board., Remove meat from bones and cut into bite size pieces., Return chicken to broth, add cabbage and spinach, bring to a boil over medium heat., Boil broth just until cabbage and chicken are wilted and heated through, 1 minute.

title: Chocolate Caramel Bars
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Beat eggs, sugars, dressing and vanilla at medium speed with electric mixer; add flour and baking soda. Set aside 1 cup of batter., Spread remaining batter into lightly greased 13 x 9-inch pan., Bake 12 to 15 minutes or until lightly browned., Cool 10 minutes.

title: Zesta Dessert
directions: Combine crackers with butter and press on bottom of 9 x 13-inch baking pan, reserving 1/4 cup for topping., Beat egg whites until stiff peaks form, then gradually add sugar, salt and vanilla., Spread egg white mixture over cracker crumbs., Bake in a 325° oven 10 to 15 minutes., Cool., Spread pie filling over top. Beat whipping cream until stiff., Add powdered sugar., Spread pie filling and refrigerate., Cut into squares to serve.

title: Wilma'S Salmon Cakes
directions: Mix salmon, onion, green pepper (if desired), basil, thyme, salt, pepper, egg, flour and cracker crumbs (if desired)., Form patties and roll in additional cracker crumbs., Fry in small amount of Crisco., Makes 5 to 6 patties.

title: Green Bean Casserole
directions: Combine beans (drained), milk, soup, pepper and 1/2 can French fried onions., Pour into a 1 1/2-quart casserole dish., Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 30 minutes., Top with remaining onions and bake 5 minutes longer., Makes 6 servings.

title: Holiday Cheese Ball
directions: Combine all ingredients, except nuts., Chill 3 hours., Shape into ball and roll in chopped nuts., Chill until firm.

title: Heavenly Hash Salad
directions: Drain, liquid from fruits., Combine all ingredients and refrigerate 3 to 4 hours before serving.

title: Peanut Brittle
directions: Cook sugar, Karo and water together in very heavy skillet or Dutch oven on top of stove until it spins threads., (Pick up spoon and let it run slowly out into hot syrup., Watch for threads.), Or if using candy thermometer, cook to hard crack stage., Add oleo and raw peanuts., When candy turns color of peanut hulls it is ready. Remove from heat and quickly add vanilla and soda., Stir and pour into greased cookie sheet., Spread as thin as possible using 2 greased forks pulling it to the edges of pan., Cool., Break into pieces.

title: Taco Salad
directions: Brown ground beef; drain., Chill enough so it does not wilt lettuce., Chop onion and tomatoes., Cut lettuce to salad size., In large bowl, combine lettuce, onion, tomatoes and taco mix., Add beef., Crunch up the Doritos and add to mixture., Pour dressing over salad just before serving.

title: Skillet Enchiladas
directions: In a 10-inch skillet, brown meat and onion; drain any excess fat (electric skillet at 350°)., Stir in soup, enchilada sauce, milk and chillies., Reduce heat to 220°., Cover and cook 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.

title: Fried Onion Rings
directions: Slice onions and separate into rings., Make batter of the beaten eggs and milk., Stir together flour and seasoning., Dip onions into flour and then in batter., Drop onion rings into oil and cook until golden., Serve hot.

title: Coconut Almond Pudding(Great!!!)
directions: Mix the ingredients together and brown in 325° oven until light brown; stir often.

title: Quiche
directions: Heat oven to 350°. Grease pie plate. Spread broccoli in pie plate. Beat sour cream, cottage cheese, butter, eggs and Bisquick until smooth. Pour into pie plate. Top with tomato. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake about 30 minutes until knife inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Brides Punch
directions: Chop ice cream and sherbet in punch bowl., Add juice., Stir. Add ginger ale last., Serves 25 people.

title: Coconut Balls(No Bake)
directions: Mix all ingredients together (except for powdered sugar). Blend well; roll into small balls., Roll in powdered sugar. Refrigerate.

title: Hot Dog Chili
directions: Combine cold ground beef and remaining ingredients and mix well in a heavy saucepan., Cook over medium heat until boils, stirring often. Cover and simmer 30 minutes.

title: Easy Garden Vegetable Pie
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Lightly grease pie plate., Heat salted water; add broccoli., Cover and heat to boiling., Cook until almost tender, about 5 minutes., Drain., Mix broccoli, onion, green pepper and cheese in pie plate., Beat remaining ingredients until smooth, 15 seconds in blender on high speed or 1 minute with hand mixer., Pour into pie plate., Bake until golden brown and knife comes out clean at 350° for 40 minutes., Let stand 5 minutes before cutting.

title: Apricot Roasted Pheasant
directions: Place pheasant on aluminum foil in roaster., Rub interior with butter, then salt, pepper and garlic., Cover bird with uncooked rice., Pour apricot juice and apricots over all., Wrap tightly in the foil., Bake in 325° oven until pheasant can be easily pierced with a fork., Serves 2 to 4.

title: Apple Bread
directions: Preheat oven to 325°., Spray 2 loaf pans with vegetable spray. In a large bowl, using an electric mixer, beat together sugar, oil and eggs., In a separate bowl, stir together dry ingredients. Add dry mixture to batter and mix just until blended., Stir vanilla, apples and pecans into batter., Pour batter into prepared loaf pans., Bake for 1 hour or until inserted knife comes out clean., Yield: 2 loaves.

title: Hawaiian Chicken
directions: Place chicken pieces in baking dish., Heat ingredients together in pan and pour over chicken., Bake 1 hour at 375°.

title: Yams Hawaiian Style
directions: Slice sweet potatoes into 1/2-inch thick pieces., Combine with pineapple, butter, sugar and cinnamon in 2-quart casserole., Place in microwave oven and cook on High 4 minutes., Stir., Sprinkle top with pecans and brown sugar., Continue cooking 2 to 4 minutes., If dish is not hot and topping melted after 2 minutes, give 1/4 turn before continuing to cook., Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Breakfast Stratta
directions: Preheat, oven, to, 350°., Cook ground sausage and drain off all, fat., Set, aside., Spray 9 x 13-inch baking pan with Pam. Line, bottom, of, pan, with bread.	Beat 8 eggs and pour over bread., Sprinkle dry mustard over eggs., Sprinkle ground sausage over, eggs., Sprinkle, Cheddar, cheese, over sausage. Sprinkle crushed corn flakes over cheese., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes covered with foil.	Remove foil and bake until brown, approximately 5 minutes.

title: Lasagna
directions: Brown meat, with, onions, salt and pepper., Drain., Add tomato paste and, sauce,, tomatoes, and garlic., Bring to boil and let simmer for 1 hour (the longer it simmers the better it is)., It may be, necessary, to, add a little water if sauce is too thick. Cook noodles (put a small amount of cooking oil in water to keep the noodles from sticking.) Drain.

title: Nacho Cheese Dip
directions: Cut cheese into cubes in a saucepan; add salsa to keep cheese from sticking., Brown hamburger; drain., Salt and pepper to taste. Add Tabasco sauce., Combine hamburger and cheese., Excellent dip for nachos or taco salad.

title: Holly Taters
directions: Wash potatoes (medium or large)., Cut into wedges., Drop into salted cold water for 1 hour., Drain, but do not dry., Put a couple of wedges in Shake 'n Bake bag., Repeat process until all potatoes are used., Place on greased cookie sheet., Salt potatoes and drizzle margarine over the top of potatoes., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Sausage Balls
directions: Mix together well and shape into balls., Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes or until lightly brown., These can be frozen and reheated as needed.

title: Barbecue Sauce
directions: Mix mustard and catsup together first to keep from lumping. Add rest and bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes.

title: Pumpkin Soup With Rivels
directions: Peel pumpkin and cut into small squares., Boil until soft. Do not drain water., Add milk until pumpkin is covered., Bring to a simmer., Add salt and pepper., Beat eggs with fork., Add flour slowly and keep mixing until it gets a little thick (like dumplings)., Drop this mixture into pumpkin 1/2 teaspoon at a time; let simmer 20 minutes., Serve.

title: Cinnamon Rolls
directions: Combine all ingredients., Let stand until double in size, about 1 hour., Knead down and let rise again., Roll out on floured board until 1/4-inch thick., Spread with oleo, cinnamon and brown sugar., Roll up like a jelly roll., Grease pan with oleo and sprinkle with brown sugar., Let raise until double in size., Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Sweet Potato Biscuits
directions: Peel and dice baked sweet potato., Combine flour, baking powder and salt., Cut shortening and potato into flour mixture. Add milk and sugar; stir until well mixed., Roll out on floured surface 1/2 to 3/4 inch thick., With knife, cut into squares and bake on greased baking sheet at 400° for 12 minutes., Makes 12 to 18 biscuits.

title: Basic White Sauce
directions: In small saucepan, whisk together broth, milk and flour. Insert clove into onion; add to broth mixture along with remaining ingredients., Bring to just below boiling over medium heat, stirring constantly., Lower heat to simmer and cook, stirring frequently, for 10 minutes., Remove onion and bay leaf with slotted spoon., Makes 1 cup.

title: Cheese Logs
directions: (Have, all, cheese at room temperature.) Add garlic and pecans to cheese mixture., Divide into logs about size as Ritz crackers. Mix, chili, powder,, red cayenne pepper and lots of paprika., Roll logs, in this mixture on waxed paper., Wrap in waxed, paper, and chill overnight., Slice and serve with Ritz crackers.

title: Microwave Fudge
directions: Pour all ingredients in a bowl., Melt 3 minutes in microwave. Stir., Pour in pan.

title: Bread Pudding And Brown Sugar Sauce
directions: Butter dish., Layer brown sugar on the bottom, then layer the bread cubes over sugar., Mix eggs, sugar, vanilla, milk and raisins; pour over bread, slowly., Put in pan of hot water., Bake at 375° until done, about 1 hour.

title: Chocolate Fudge
directions: Put Velveeta cheese, oleo and vanilla in a large pan on stove and melt together., Blend in the dry ingredients together in large bowl., After the dry ingredients are mixed, add the melted oleo and cheese mix with a spoon., When the mixture is fully combined, place it in a long pan (cookie sheet with wax paper on bottom) and pop it into the refrigerator., Cut into squares when it is firm and cold., Keep refrigerated., Makes 5 pounds., May be frozen for later use.

title: Spinach Parma
directions: Combine croutons and oleo; pat into quiche pan., Combine 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese and remaining ingredients; mix well., Spoon over crust., Bake at 350° for 35 minutes., Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese., Let stand 5 minutes.

title: Sherbet Jello Salad
directions: Dissolve Jello in water, add sherbet., Stir until melted. Let set until jelly like., Gently stir in Cool Whip., Let set until firm.

title: Pineapple Drop Cookies
directions: Cream together shortening and sugars., Add eggs and mix thoroughly., Add flour, soda and baking powder with pineapple and vanilla., Mix., Drop by teaspoon on ungreased cookie sheet., Bake 8 to 10 minutes at 350°.

title: Homemade Pizza
directions: Follow directions on package for bread dough except use cookie sheet., Spread dough on a greased sheet., Cook hamburger meat, sausage, onions and green peppers., Spread tomato sauce on bread dough; sprinkle with garlic salt, if desired., When meat mixture is about cooked, drain and spread over dough., Add mushrooms and pepperoni., Bake at 350° for about 1 hour.

title: Coconut Cream Pie
directions: Combine first 3 ingredients in a heavy saucepan. Combine milk and egg yolks gradually stir into sugar mixture. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until mixture thickens and boils. Boil 1 minute stirring constantly. Remove from heat, stir in 1/2 cup coconut, butter and vanilla. Pour into pie shell. Cover with meringue sealing edges and sprinkle 1/4 cup coconut on top of meringue and bake in 350 degree oven for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Amazing Coconut Pie
directions: Combine all ingredients except coconut in electric blender (can be mixed with electric mixer if you do not have blender) container. Cover and blend on low speed for 3 minutes., Pour into a greased 9-inch pie pan., Let stand about 5 minutes, then sprinkle coconut. Bake at 350° for 40 minutes or until a table knife comes out clean when inserted into middle of pie., Serve warm or cool with whipped cream or not., This pie makes its own crust., A great pie when you have unexpected guests.

title: Veggie Pie
