directions: Set oven to 400°., In saucepan, cook broccoli or cauliflower about 5 minutes; drain. Grease one 10-inch pie plate. Mix cooked vegetables, onion, green pepper and cheese on the pie plate. Beat Bisquick, eggs, salt and pepper until smooth. Pour into pie plate. Bake 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Buster Bar Dessert
directions: Combine the following, ingredients, and boil 8 minutes, stirring constantly:, powdered, sugar, evaporated milk, chocolate chips and 1/2 cup butter., Add vanilla and cool., Combine cookies and 1/2 cup melted	butter., Pat, into 9 x 13-inch pan and freeze until firm., Sprinkle, peanuts, over, cookie crust. Spread ice cream over	peanuts and cover with cooled chocolate mixture. Freeze until ready to serve., Serves 16.

title: Ruth Robuck'S Banana Split Dessert
directions: Mix and press in a 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Coconut Yule Trees
directions: Combine the first 5 ingredients; mix well., Drop by tablespoon onto a waxed paper-lined cookie sheet., Chill for 1 hour., Shape into trees.

title: Railroad Pie
directions: Brown beef and onion in skillet., Pour off excess fat; add the rest of ingredients., Bring to boil and simmer 15 minutes; turn into a large, greased casserole dish (1 1/2-quart).

title: Sweet Potato Pie
directions: Boil the potatoes in their jackets until done; peel and mash. Add butter, sugar and lemon extract., Combine the beaten egg and milk., Mix with the potatoes until blended., Pour into the pastry shell and bake at 375° for 1 hour.

title: Veg-All Casserole
directions: Take 1 cup of cracker crumbs and layer the bottom of the casserole dish., Then be sure you have drained your Veg-All, and put them as your next layer., Add your celery soup and pour milk over it., Put margarine and sprinkle salt and pepper over it. Cook for about 25 minutes in 400° oven., Remove, then spread with rest of cracker crumbs and cheese., Place back in oven for 5 to 7 minutes, or until cheese melts.

title: Zucchini "Crab" Cakes
directions: Mix first 6 ingredients together., Shape into cakes and roll in crushed cracker crumbs., Fry in hot oil until brown.

title: Black Forest Cake
directions: Bake the cake in 9-inch pans., Cool thoroughly and split each layer in half., Spread the cherry pie filling between the split layers., Now you have the original 2 layers with cherry filling in between., Reserve 1/2 cup pie filling to go on top of cake.

title: Corn Pudding
directions: Melt margarine in dish you are going to bake in., Beat eggs, sugar and cornstarch; add vanilla, milk and creamed corn., Pour into dish over butter., Bake at 375° for 45 to 60 minutes., Do not cover.

title: Remp Eyek
directions: Grind coriander, garlic and nuts., Mix all together into batter, adding 2 packages Spanish peanuts., Scoop batter with a hostess spoon and fry until brown.

title: Earthquake Cake
directions: Grease and flour 9 x 13-inch pan., Mix coconut and pecans. Place in bottom of pan., Mix cake mix according to package directions., Pour over coconut mixture., Mix margarine, cream cheese and powdered sugar., Pour over chocolate mixture., Bake in 350° oven for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Garden Linguine(I Usually Halve This Recipe.)
directions: Boil broth until reduced to half., Cook broccoli, carrots and beans in microwave until crisp tender., In large skillet, heat olive oil and saute onion, garlic, mushrooms, broccoli, pepper, carrots and asparagus until almost soft., Add reduced broth, milk, basil, oregano, parsley, salt and pepper., Simmer 10 minutes., If needed, thicken slightly with 1 tablespoon cornstarch mixed with 3 tablespoons cold water., Cook pasta and drain., Combine with vegetables., Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese., This cooks up quickly if the vegetables are cut ahead of time.

title: Sour Cream Cookies
directions: Mix, in order, first 8 ingredients., Chill 2 hours., Drop on greased sheet and sprinkle with cinnamon sugar., Bake 10 minutes at 400°.

title: Chili Con Queso Dip
directions: Cook hamburger; drain well., Put in crock-pot on low; mix in the rest of the ingredients., Cook until cheese melts and serve hot with nacho chips.

title: Strawberry Salad
directions: Dissolve Jell-O with boiling water., Add rest of ingredients. Place in refrigerator to set., Serve with Cool Whip.

title: Chicken 'N Dumplings
directions: Boil fryer until tender. Remove from broth and set aside to cool. Mix dry ingredients., Cut in shortening., Add beaten eggs and enough milk to make a stiff dough. Roll out really thin on heavily floured board., Cut into pieces (pizza cutter works great!)., Drop into rapidly boiling broth., Cover and simmer on very low heat for 5 to 10 minutes. Remove skin and bones from chicken and pull into bite size pieces., Add chicken to pot and season to taste with black pepper., I pour about a cup of sweet milk in pot just as it's finished cooking.

title: Mom'S Peanut Butter Fudge
directions: Mix sugar, cocoa, baking powder and milk together., Bring to boil until mixture forms a soft ball., Remove from heat and add peanut butter., Stir until mixture thickens, pour onto buttered plate.

title: Banana Bread
directions: Cream sugar and shortening., Add eggs and beat well., Combine flour, soda and salt together and add to mixture., Add bananas and nuts., Bake 1 hour in 300° oven.

title: Corn Casserole
directions: Mix together and bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Mexican Corn Bread
directions: Mix all the ingredients and pour into a greased pan. Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Sour Cream Cookies
directions: Mix ingredients together well, then drop by teaspoonfuls on cookie sheet and bake 10 to 12 minutes at 375°.

title: Strawberry Cream Squares
directions: Dissolve jello in boiling water., Add frozen strawberries; stir occasionally until thawed., Add pineapple and bananas and mix., Pour half of mixture into an 8-inch square pan., Chill until firm., Spread evenly with sour cream., Pour remaining jello mixture on top., Chill until firm., Cut into squares.

title: Barbecued Meat Patties
directions: Mix together all ingredients for patties., When milk is absorbed, shape mixture into 12 patties., Cook slowly for 10 minutes or until brown on both sides in a small amount of fat. Mix together all ingredients for Sauce., Add to the meat in skillet and cook slowly, turning in Sauce.

title: Coleslaw And Salad Dressing
directions: Combine all ingredients except mayonnaise. Beat well with mixer., Cook until thick. Remove pan from stove and add mayonnaise. Beat well and cool.

title: Dry Beef Dip
directions: Cut beef with scissors., Mix all together, then refrigerate.

title: Crumb Shell
directions: *For Crumbs:, Use crisp graham crackers, prepared dry cereal, zwieback, dried bread or cookies such as shortbreads, gingersnaps, chocolate wafers, etc., Roll with a rolling pin to fine crumbs.

title: Southern Blackberry Cobbler
directions: Place berries in 9 inch square baking dish., Combine sugar, cornstarch, and salt, mixing well.	Sprinkle mixture over berries. Dot with butter., Roll out pastry to fit dish., Place pastry over berries., Brush with milk, and sprinkle with sugar., Bake at 425° for 30 minutes., Makes 6-8 servings.

title: Broken Glass Cake
directions: Dissolve each flavor jello separately with 1 1/2 cups hot water., Pour in ice cube trays., Set until firm.

title: Roast Chicken Or Cornish Hens
directions: Preheat oven to 400°., Wash, chicken, or, hens, and pat dry. Mix all other ingredients and, stuff, chicken, or, hens. Place breast down in pan so juice will run downward from juicy birds. Roast, uncovered, for 1 3/4 to, 2 hours or until done. (Drumsticks will move up and down when ready.) Baste occasionally with drippings., Serves 4.

title: Quick Punch
directions: Mix all ingredients in punch bowl., Makes 25 to 30 punch cup servings.

title: Poppy Seed Dressing
directions: Blend all ingredients except oil. Drip in oil very slowly; blend well., Store in jar in refrigerator.

title: Alita Darby Arthur'S Classic Pecan Pie
directions: Stir together eggs, sugar, corn syrup, margarine and vanilla. Add pecans; mix., Pour into pastry shell., Bake for 50 to 60 minutes in 350° oven., Cool; serve with whipped cream or ice cream.

title: Artichoke Dip
directions: Mix together and heat in microwave for 8 minutes., Serve warm with crackers.

title: Tropical Fruit Cake
directions: Cut dates into thirds, add coconut, nuts and cherries, sprinkled with flour., Add milk and mix well., Butter loaf pan and dust with flour.

title: Gene'S Hop-N-John
directions: Brown ground beef and drain., Add the remaining ingredients. Add water to cover 1 inch above ingredients., Cook for 1 hour on low heat., Serves 15 to 20.

title: Classic Lobster Seafood Salad(4 Servings)
directions: Mix lobster, mayonnaise, celery and onion., Serve on bed of lettuce.

title: Apple Butter
directions: Make applesauce with apples., Add remaining ingredients., Mix all ingredients., Boil for 1 1/2 hours in the oven or until thick. Put in jars and seal.

title: No Peek Brisket
directions: Lay slices of rye bread in bottom of Dutch oven., Place brisket, with fat side down, on top of the bread in Dutch oven. Sprinkle garlic powder and pepper on brisket., Throw onion slices into pan., Pour beer over the meat., Spread the chile sauce over the meat., Cover Dutch oven.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Melt margarine; add to stuffing mix., Grease 9 x 13-inch casserole., Cut chicken into small pieces., Combine soup, broth and sour cream., Put 1/2 of stuffing mixture in casserole., Layer all of chicken on top and pour broth mixture over it., Top with remaining stuffing mixture., Bake at 350° for about 30 minutes or until bubbling hot.

title: Dirt
directions: Make pudding according to directions on box., Mix Cool Whip, then cookies., Chill.

title: Barbecued Lima Beans
directions: Mix all ingredients except onion., Put into skillet, top with onion and simmer for 10 minutes.

title: Microwave Divinity
directions: Mix together, sugar,, corn syrup, water and salt in a 1 1/2 quart casserole., Cook in microwave on Full power 20 to 22 minutes or	until, hard, ball, stage is reached., Stir once or twice during, cooking., While, syrup, cooks,, beat egg whites until stiff peaks form in a large mixing bowl., Gradually pour hot syrup over, egg	whites until beating at high speed until mixture, is thickened, and, candy, starts, to lose its gloss. Beating, may require about 12 minutes., Add vanilla and nuts. Drop by, teaspoon on, waxed	paper.	Candy, may be tinted for special occasions.

title: Homemilled Corn Meal Corn Bread
directions: Sift together all the dry ingredients., Add egg, buttermilk, and oil., Mix well and pour into hot iron skillet., Preheat oven to 400°., Bake 15 minutes., Flip in pan and brown.

title: Oatmeal Applesauce Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., In large bowl, combine flour, oats, baking soda, cinnamon and cloves; set aside., With mixer at low speed cream oil and sugar until light and fluffy; beat in egg whites and applesauce., Stir in dry ingredients until smooth. Spray baking sheet with vegetable spray; drop dough on cookie sheet., Bake 6 to 8 minutes or until brown., Makes 8 servings.

title: Cranberry-Raspberry Valentine Punch
directions: Wrap cinnamon, cloves and mint in cheesecloth or place in a cloth spice bag., Place bundled spices in cranberry-raspberry juice; simmer for 20 minutes., Remove spices and pour juice into a punch bowl., Cool., Add ginger ale, orange slices and fresh mint leaves for garnish.

title: Cookies Quick
directions: Any additional ingredients you wish such as chocolate chips, butterscotch chips, peanut butter chips, etc., depending on your choice of cake mix., (Yellow cake mix is excellent for adding other flavors to.)

title: Giant Burger
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Mix meat and salt; divide in half., Pat one half evenly in ungreased 8-inch pie pan., Mix cream cheese, mustard and horseradish; spread over meat., Shape remaining meat into 8-inch circle., Place on cheese mixture; pinch edges together to seal., Bake 45 minutes., Place onion rings around meat., Cut into wedges.

title: Sweet And Sour Pheasant
directions: Place pheasant breasts in a steamer and cover., Steam only until meat can be removed from bone (meat should be rare)., Cool to room temperature and cube.

title: Angel Kisses
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Beat egg whites until thick and foamy. Gradually add sugar and beat until stiff. Fold in salt, pecans, vanilla and chocolate chips., Drop by teaspoon onto cookie sheets covered with brown paper., Place in oven, close door and turn oven off., Leave in oven overnight.

title: Salmon Dip
directions: Blend the cream cheese, juice of salmon, mayonnaise, sour cream and onion salt well., Add salmon; blend well., Serve with vegetables, crackers or potato chips.

title: Savory Cheese Muffins
directions: Preheat oven to 425°., Grease 24 mini muffin cups., Stir together flour, cheese, mustard and chili powder in mixing bowl. Beat eggs in separate bowl; stir in milk and oil., Add liquid mixture to dry ingredients, stirring just until blended., Batter will be slightly lumpy., Spoon batter into prepared muffin cups, filling each 2/3 full., Bake for 13 to 15 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Broccoli Dip
directions: Drain mushrooms and save juice., Cook broccoli in mushroom juice., Drain broccoli and chop., Saute onion and garlic in oleo until clear., Put broccoli, garlic and mushroom soup into double boiler., When hot, add cheese and mushrooms and season to taste with Worcestershire sauce., Serve with Melba rounds.

title: Hamburger And Beans
directions: Brown hamburger and onion; drain off grease., Add remaining ingredients., Simmer 15 minutes.

title: The Trawler Crab Dip
directions: Mix all ingredients thoroughly.

title: Puppy Chow
directions: Melt oleo, chocolate chips and peanut butter in a medium saucepan over medium heat., Add cereal and stir until coated. Pour powdered sugar in Ziploc bag., Add about 1/4 cereal mixture to bag., Shake., Repeat until all cereal has been covered with sugar., Pour onto wax paper to cool., Makes a large batch.

title: Salad Dressing
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Stir until well blended., Store in refrigerator in covered container.

title: Yummy Fruit Dip
directions: Whip all ingredients with mixer., Store brands don't work as well.

title: Cheese Cake
directions: Mix cream cheese, sugar and vanilla together and set aside. Mix jello and water together and place in refrigerator and let jell slightly.

title: Easy Fruit Salad
directions: Combine strawberries and pie filling. Chill for several hours. Add bananas just before serving.

title: Orange Cooler
directions: Mix all ingredients and serve at once.

title: Banana Nut Cake
directions: Blend ingredients and beat 2 minutes., Bake 50 to 60 minutes at 350° in greased and floured 10-inch tube pan., Sprinkle with sifted confectioners sugar or glaze., May be baked in loaf pans for banana bread.

title: Pineapple Cake
directions: Blend together., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Squash Casserole
directions: Cook yellow squash in water., Drain water., Mix ingredients together and cook 30 minutes at 400°.

title: Finger Paint
directions: Mix dry starch with 1/2 cup water in a saucepan., Add 1 1/2 cups boiling water and stir rapidly., Add 3/4 cup powdered detergent and stir again until smooth., Add food coloring for desired color.

title: Diabetic Chocolate Chip Bars
directions: Combine first 4 ingredients., Beat 1 1/2 minutes at high speed of mixer., Add remaining ingredients, except chocolate chips. Chips are added last., Place in 8 x 8-inch ungreased pan and bake at 375° for 20 to 22 minutes.

title: Wash Day Cake
directions: Slice margarine sticks and distribute evenly over bottom of 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Pour dry cake mix over margarine., Pour peaches, including juice, over cake mix., Top with coconut., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes., Serve warm.

title: Apple Rolls
directions: Stir together apples, nuts and sugar., Let stand, stirring often until juicy, about 1 hour., Stir together flour, soda, salt and spices., Add apple mixture and stir well., Stir in butter and vanilla., Add eggs., Turn into two greased and floured one pound coffee cans., Tie 2-inch wide band of double foil around top., Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Onion Dip For Veggies Or Chips And Pretzels
directions: Boil bouillon cubes with water., Using an electric mixer, add cream cheese and onion., Should make a day ahead and refrigerate. Warm to almost room temperature before serving., Stir well and thin with a little milk if needed.

title: Buttermilk Biscuits
directions: Sift, flour,, baking, powder, salt and soda into mixing bowl. Stir in milk until all is wet; then add corn oil., Toss out on floured board., Sprinkle a little flour on dough., Then flatten out, and, cut, biscuits., Grease pan and turn biscuits over in grease and bake at 425°., Makes 14 large biscuits.

title: Chess Pie
directions: Mix sugar and cornmeal., Add oleo and cream., Add eggs, one at a time and beat thoroughly., Add remaining ingredients to mixture and beat., Pour in pie shell and place in oven., Cook at 400° for 10 minutes., Reduce to 325° and cook 30 minutes longer.

title: Grilled Cheese Sandwich
directions: Melt 1 tablespoon butter in a frying pan. Make sandwiches, using 2 slices of bread and 1 piece of cheese for each. Place sandwich in pan and fry until lightly brown; turn over and brown on other side. Fry on medium heat.

title: Caramel Brie With Fresh Fruit
directions: Place Brie on large serving plate., Melt butter and brown sugar in saucepan; add corn syrup and flour, stirring well. Bring to boil; reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes, stirring constantly., Remove from heat; cool to lukewarm., Gradually stir in milk., Pour caramel over Brie., Sprinkle with pecans., Combine lemon juice and water., Toss with fruit wedges., Drain., Arrange around fruit.

title: Breakfast Casserole
directions: Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan., Layer bread, meat, cheese and onion., Melt butter and pour over all., Beat eggs, seasonings and milk., Pour over., Chill in refrigerator overnight and bake 1 hour at 350°. Let stand 15 minutes before serving.

title: Lemon Dessert
directions: Mix together the flour, oleo and nuts., Press in a 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake 15 minutes at 350°., Cool.

title: Sour Cream Dressing For Cabbage Slaw
directions: Add all ingredients to sour cream.

title: Lime-Pineapple Salad
directions: Dissolve Jell-O in hot water., Chill., Add remaining ingredients and let set.

title: Boozy Bourbon Balls
directions: Melt chocolate in double boiler over hot, not boiling, water. Remove pan from fire and stir in sugar and corn syrup., Blend in bourbon., Combine crushed vanilla wafers and walnuts in bowl., Add chocolate mixture to it., Form into one-inch balls and roll in sugar., Let ripen in covered container for few days or longer. Then wrap and present to your friends., Makes about 4 1/2 dozen.

title: Breakfast Cocoa
directions: Mix cocoa, sugar and salt; add water and cook 3 minutes., Stir in milk; heat to boiling, but do not boil., Beat with rotary beater just before serving., Serves 6.

title: Coconut Candy
directions: Melt butter, let cool., Pour over sugar and grated orange peel., Add 1 tablespoon orange juice., Add milk, nuts and coconut; mix well., Set in freezer to cool.

title: Banana Milk Shake
directions: Blend ingredients in blender until smooth and foamy., Chill before serving., Makes 2 shakes.

title: Sweet-Sour Cabbage
directions: Shred cabbage and place in, a large pot with 3 tablespoons water and 1 can of stewed tomatoes., Cook until almost tender., In a separate pan, melt 1/4 stick margarine., Mix with 1 teaspoon salt, 2 tablespoons white vinegar and 1 tablespoon flour., Saute the diced onion in the mixture., Add this to the cabbage when the cabbage is almost tender., Heat until desired tenderness is reached., Add a teaspoon of sugar if needed.

title: Potato Casserole
directions: Cook potatoes in jackets and dice., Mix cream cheese and milk together., Add all ingredients together in 9 x 11-inch baking dish which has been greased with butter.

title: Baked Diet Chicken
directions: Line baking dish with foil., Arrange chicken in pan., Add rest of ingredients., Cover pan with foil and bake at 350° until well done.

title: Cherry Cheese Pie
directions: Mix sugar, vanilla and cream cheese together., Make a package of Dream Whip., Follow directions on Dream Whip., When you get this mixed up, combine Dream Whip, sugar, vanilla and cream cheese together., Bake pie crust at 350° for 10 minutes., Fill pie crust with mixture and top with cherries., Chill for 2 hours before serving.

title: Squash And Potato Casserole
directions: Mix all together., Bake at 350° until squash and potatoes are tender., Add cheese and melt.

title: Squash Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients and place in Pyrex dish., Mix an additional 1 to 1 1/2 cups stuffing with margarine., Crumble on top and bake for 1 hour at 325°.

title: Hamburger Baked Beans
directions: Mix all ingredients well in crock-pot and cook 8 hours or overnight.

title: Blueberry Bread
directions: Beat eggs and sugar until blended., Add milk and butter; mix well., Combine in separate bowl, 3 cups flour, baking powder and salt., Stir into egg mixture until moist., Mix blueberries with 2 teaspoons flour until coated., Fold into batter., Spoon into 2 small greased and floured loaf pans and bake at 350° for 55 minutes or until done.

title: Cinnamon Rings
directions: Combine 1 cup sugar and cinnamon to taste., Melt 1 stick of butter., Roll biscuits in butter, then in sugar mixture., Bake at 400° until done.

title: Banana Cake
directions: Cream oleo and sugar; add eggs, banana and water and mix well. Then add baking powder and baking soda., Mix in flour., Stir well after each addition., Grease 9 x 13-inch pan., Preheat oven to 350°., Bake for 1 hour.

title: Corn Salad
directions: Drain corn and mix all ingredients together. Vinegar, oil and a dash of sugar can be added for a tasteful salad.

title: Pepper Steak
directions: Brown beef in hot oil; add garlic and cook for 5 minutes., Add soy sauce, salt and water., Cook for 45 minutes., Add vegetables; cook 10 to 15 minutes longer., Stir cornstarch and tomato juice together; add to mixture., Cook, stirring constantly, until it thickens., Add tomatoes and cook 5 minutes more., Serve over hot fluffy rice., Serves 4.

title: Long John'S Batter
directions: Mix all but egg white., Beat egg white until stiff peaks form. Blend into batter., Dip fish or chicken and fry., Enjoy.

title: Everyday Easy Broccoli Bake
directions: Cook broccoli and drain., Combine soup, milk, soy sauce and pepper. In 10 x 6-inch baking dish, layer 1/2 of the broccoli, 1/2 the soup mixture and 1/2 can of the onions., Top with the remaining broccoli and soup mixture., Bake at 350° for 25 minutes. Top with remaining onions., Bake 5 minutes., May be microwaved, covered, 8 minutes., Turn half through., Top with onions., Return to microwave, uncovered, 1 minute.

title: Miracle Soup
directions: Cut vegetables into medium pieces, cover with water; let come to a boil., Your soup mix may be added at this time., After soup has boiled at least 10 minutes, lower heat and simmer until vegetables are soft., Can be eaten at any time that you feel hungry, as much as you wish, as often as you like, any time of the day., This soup will not add calories., The more you eat the more you will lose.

title: Microwave Ritz Pizza Snack
directions: Put sauce on cracker., Put on pepperoni., Sprinkle with cheese., Place in microwave until cheese melts (about 10 seconds).

title: Punch
directions: Pour all ingredients together.

title: Oven Baked Bourguignonne
directions: In a 2-quart casserole dish, toss beef with flour., Bake, uncovered, in a 400° oven for 20 minutes., Add carrots, tomatoes, beefy onion soup mix blended with reserved tomato liquid, wine and bay leaf., Bake, covered, for 1 1/2 hours, or until beef is tender., Add mushrooms., Bake, covered, an additional 10 minutes.

title: Cowboy Cookies
directions: Cream sugars and Crisco., Add eggs and beat well., Add vanilla and dry ingredients., Mix well., Shape into little balls., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

title: Steamed Fish
directions: Place fish and ginger in pot of boiling water (water should cover fish)., Turn flame off and cover with tight fitting lid. Let stand for 30 minutes or until done., Place fish on platter. Sprinkle with finely chopped green onion.

title: Pork Chops
directions: Brown pork chops., Add rest of the ingredients and simmer 45 minutes., Last 15 minutes, add frozen peas.

title: Spaghetti Sauce Seasoning Mix
directions: Place all the ingredients in a 1-pint jar., Cover tightly and shake well to mix., Store in a cool, dark, dry place for up to 2 months., Makes about 1 1/2 cups.

title: Baked Eggplant Parmigiana
directions: Dip sliced eggplant in eggs, then bread crumbs and fry until golden., Layer the slices with marinara sauce, then cheeses in rectangular baking dish.

title: Chicken Spectacular Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients, except bread crumbs., Pour into 3-quart greased casserole., Top with bread crumbs., Bake 30 minutes at 350°., To freeze, do not cook before freezing.

title: Yellow Squash Casserole
directions: Wash and slice squash; cook in salted water until tender., (Do not overcook.), Saute onion and garlic in butter and add to drained squash., Add 2/3 cup butter, sugar, salt and pepper to squash mixture., Mix well., Add milk, 2 eggs and cracker crumbs. Mix gently., Pour into buttered casserole dish., Dot top with remaining 1/3 cup butter and crushed crackers., Bake in a 350° oven for 40 minutes or until browned.

title: Black Forest Parfait
directions: In a mixing bowl, combine milk, yogurt and pudding mix., Stir until it is smooth and thick., Next, spoon a layer of pudding mixture into 4 clear glasses. Do the same with a layer of whipped cream. Repeat layering so you will have 4 levels. Chill 1 hour. Top with nuts and drained cherries.

title: Stuffed Peppers
directions: Melt butter in a skillet and brown onions and ground beef. Cut tops out of peppers and clean., Mix rice, ground beef mixture and spaghetti sauce and stuff into peppers., Top with cheese., Put some sauce in bottom of pan and place peppers in dish., Sprinkle 1/2 teaspoon of sugar in each pepper (optional)., Cover with foil and cook at 350°, for 30 minutes.

title: Company Beef Casserole
directions: Brown beef and onion together; add tomatoes, ketchup, steak sauce and parsley., Simmer for 30 minutes., Cook macaroni.

title: Seafood Salad
directions: Combine crabmeat and shrimp., Combine mayonnaise, French dressing, chili sauce, horseradish, onion, lemon juice, Worcestershire sauce and seasonings., Pour over crabmeat and shrimp., Cover and chill 2 to 3 hours., Serve on lettuce and garnish with tomato wedges.

title: Pumpkin Pie(Makes 2 Pies)
directions: Blend beaten eggs, canned pumpkin, sugar, salt, cloves, cinnamon, ginger and nutmeg., Slowly add condensed milk., Mix well., Pour into 2 unbaked pie shells., Bake at 400° for 15 minutes, then reduce temperature to 375° for about 45 minutes, or until you can cut center with a knife and none of the pie filling clings to it.

title: Pork Chop And Vegetable Skillet
directions: Fry, pork, chops, until, tender and brown., Place onion rings and, bell, pepper, over, cooked, chops., Put rice inside pepper. Pour tomatoes and celery (mixed) over this and season to taste with salt and pepper., Simmer approximately 1 hour in covered frypan on top of stove.

title: Saucepan Raisin Bars
directions: Mix, well., Pour, into	greased and floured 9 x 12-inch pan. Bake at 300° to 325°.

title: Stuffed Mushrooms
directions: Heat oven to broil., Remove mushroom stems; chop enough stems to make 1/4 cup., Saute mushroom caps in margarine 5 minutes., Mix soft cream cheese, Parmesan cheese and bread crumbs until well blended; stir in chopped stems., Fill mushroom caps., Broil until browned., Makes about 2 1/2 dozen.

title: Spinach Dip
directions: Mix together and let stand in refrigerator overnight.

title: Poor Man'S Soup
directions: Cook short ribs and stew meat together until done., Add onion, celery and seasoning., Cook until done., Add all precooked leftover veggies., Heat thoroughly., Serve with cornbread.

title: Casserole Cheese Bread
directions: Scald milk; add sugar, salt and margarine., Let cool. Dissolve yeast in water., Add milk and cheese and flour., Stir about 2 minutes until well blended., Cover; let rise until more than double., Stir down and beat vigorously for 1/2 minute., Turn in greased 1 1/2 quart casserole or two 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pans. Bake at 375° for 1 hour (no second rising).

title: Salmon Balls
directions: Let cream cheese set out for 1/2 hour., Mix all the ingredients together in a large bowl (with gloved hands) until well mixed., Roll salmon mixture in a ball, then roll in the walnuts., Keep refrigerated until ready to serve.

title: Easy Quiche
directions: Combine all ingredients., Bake at 425° for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Glorified Chicken
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., Meanwhile in an 8 x 12-inch baking dish, arrange chicken, skin side up. Drizzle with margarine. Bake 40 minutes. Spoon soup over chicken. Bake 20 minutes more or until chicken is tender and juices run clear., Transfer chicken to platter. Stir sauce., Spoon sauce over chicken. Garnish with parsley., Makes 4 servings.

title: Seven Decker Dinner
directions: Brown meat., Drain off fat., Arrange in layers cooked noodles, 1/2 of the cheese, onions, ground beef, green peppers and diced tomatoes., Mix together tomato juice, Worcestershire sauce, salt, garlic salt, herb seasoning and pepper., Pour over casserole. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes., During last 5 minutes, arrange remaining cheese over the casserole., Heat until cheese melts. Let stand 5 minutes before serving., Serves 6.

title: Biscuit Tortoni(My Version)
directions: Beat egg whites; slowly add sugar., Fold in Cool Whip, macaroons and sherry., Place cupcake papers in muffin tins., Put in mixture and freeze., Decorate., Serve with cookie.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Pick chicken off bones., Lay meat in the bottom of a 13 x 9-inch pan., Mix soup and milk., Pour over chicken., Melt oleo and mix with stuffing., Spread over casserole and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Broccoli Cornbread
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Spray a 9-inch square pan with nonstick spray., Pour batter in carefully., Bake in preheated 400° oven for 35 to 40 minutes. Can be frozen.

title: Potato-Bean Soup
directions: In large pot, cook and stir celery, carrots and garlic in hot margarine, over medium heat, for 4 minutes, or until tender. Carefully stir in broth, potatoes and dill., Heat to boiling, then reduce heat., Simmer, covered, for 20 to 25 minutes, or until potatoes are tender,, With back of large spoon, or masher, lightly mash about 1/2 of potatoes in the broth., Add drained beans to mixture.

title: Meatballs
directions: Mix all ingredients., Cover bowl and let stand in refrigerator a few hours., Form in balls., Brown in oil., Do not overcrowd. Place in crock-pot with your spaghetti sauce and cook on low for at least 8 hours and serve.

title: Mississippi Potatoes
directions: Toss together potatoes, mayonnaise, salt, pepper, cheese and onion., Place mixture in greased 9 x 13-inch pan., Sprinkle with crumbled, bacon and sliced olives. Bake at 325° for 1 hour.

title: Wet Burritos
directions: Brown meat., Add onion, tomato soup and Tabasco sauce., Simmer 1 1/2 hours., Chop lettuce., Mix enchilada sauce with tomato paste and water as package instructs., Heat up beans., Fold into shells the meat, beans and lettuce., Place in a 9 x 13-inch pan., Top with sauce and cheese., Bake at 375° for 10 minutes.

title: Shepherd'S Pie(Feeds About 6 People)
directions: Boil the chicken until tender; cut it into small pieces. Make the mashed potatoes any way you like; you can put garlic and cheese or whatever. After the chicken and the potatoes are done, layer it in a big pan: cream of celery, chicken breasts, green beans and mashed potatoes. Keep doing this until you run out of ingredients. Then sprinkle the fried onions and the shredded cheese and put it in the oven until the cheese is bubbling.

title: 10 Minute Peanut Brittle(Microwave)
directions: Stir together the salt, sugar and syrup in one-quart bowl. Microwave on High for 5 minutes., Stir in peanuts., Microwave on High for 2 minutes., Stir., Microwave 1 to 3 minutes longer, until it is light brown., Remove from microwave., Add butter, vanilla and soda., Stir until butter is all melted., Pour out on warm buttered cookie sheet to 1/4-inch thickness., Cool and eat.

title: Poppy Seed Dressing
directions: Mix first 4 ingredients in blender or electric mixer., Add oil slowly., Stir in poppy seeds., Serve over fresh fruit or finely shredded red cabbage and seedless fresh grapes.

title: Spring Punch
directions: Mix all ingredients together for delicious punch.

title: Chicken Ala King
directions: Combine and cook all day in slow cooker., Push bread with thumb and index finger into muffin tins and toast in oven at 450° about 10 minutes., Dip Chicken Ala King into bread cups on everyone's plate.

title: Sweet Trash
directions: Melt margarine, syrup and brown sugar until blended. Pour margarine mixture over cereal mixture. Place in large pan and bake 20 to 25 minutes at 325°, stirring 1/2 way through. Immediately spread mixture on wax paper covered cooling rack. Cool completely and store in airtight container.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
directions: Mix first 5 ingredients, in a pan on top of stove., Bring to a boil for 5 minutes and remove., Add marshmallow and peanut butter., Mix and chill.

title: Katie Gooch Wilmot'S Seafoam Candy
directions: Boil sugar until it forms a hard ball when dropped in cold water., Pour over stiffly beaten egg whites and beat until it cools and creams., Then drop on wax paper by spoon., Put halos of chopped nuts on top of the candy.

title: Creamed Chicken
directions: Cook celery, onion and green pepper in oil until tender. Blend flour into mixture., Stir in chicken broth and milk; cook to a smooth sauce, stirring constantly., Add chicken to sauce; season with salt., Heat mixture thoroughly., Serve on rice, toast or biscuits., Yields 4 servings.

title: Pain Persille(Parsley Bread)
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., Split the loaf of bread in half lengthwise., Melt the butter in saucepan and add the garlic, stirring., Stir in the parsley and salt and pepper to taste and remove from the heat., Spoon and brush one half of the bread with the mixture., Cover with the second side, sandwich fashion., Wrap the bread in a sheet of heavy-duty aluminum foil and bake 10 minutes or until piping hot.

title: Cheesy Potato Soup
directions: Cook potatoes, water, cubed chicken, onion, celery and grated carrots until done., Add cream of chicken soup and Velveeta cheese.

title: Peach Cobbler
directions: Peel, slice and sugar peaches until they make a liquid., Melt butter in a baking dish., Mix flour, baking powder, sugar, salt and milk in bowl., Pour batter in pan with melted butter., Spoon peaches over batter and bake for about 1 hour at 350°.

title: Praline Muffins
directions: Place paper liners in a muffin tin, if you use them; otherwise, butter the tin well., Fill them to 3/4 full and bake in a 350° oven for 25 minutes., Makes 1 dozen 2-inch muffins.

title: Scrambled Eggs, Spanish Style
directions: Slice green peppers; slice onion thinly., In 12-inch skillet over medium-high heat in tablespoon of hot olive or salad oil, cook green peppers, onion, garlic, dried thyme leaves and 1/2 teaspoon salt until vegetables are tender-crisp; add tomatoes and hot pepper sauce., Cook 2 to 3 minutes until tomatoes are softened., Spoon mixture onto warm large platter to keep warm.

title: Potato Soup
directions: Cook potatoes in water with chicken bouillon, onions, celery and carrot until tender., Do not drain., Mash with a potato masher., Add margarine, parsley, milk, salt and pepper., Heat thoroughly.

title: Sparkling Orange Eggnog
directions: In a large bowl, measure 3 cups of the orange juice, the lemon juice, eggs, sugar, cinnamon, ginger and cloves., Blend with beater., Stir in remaining orange juice., Cover and refrigerate. Just before serving pour eggnog mixture into punch bowl., Spoon ice cream into bowl; add ginger ale., Blend with beater., Sprinkle with nutmeg., Makes 30 servings.

title: Glazed Carrots
directions: You will need a 1 1/2-quart baking dish.

title: Chicken Nuggets
directions: Roll chicken pieces in flour, then in eggs and finally in bread crumbs, patting it on well., Using a frying pan, brown in olive oil until done., It doesn't take long and they are good!

title: Greek Bread
directions: Blend mayonnaise and oleo., Add other ingredients., Slice French bread in half-horizontally., Spread with mixture., Bake on a cookie sheet at 350 degrees for 20 minutes., Slice--serve hot.

title: Dill Pickles
directions: Pack eight quart jars with cucumbers., To each jar, add 3 teaspoons, dill, seed,, 1, clove garlic and 1 teaspoon lump alum.

title: Spicy Pickled Cabbage
directions: Trim cabbage., Cut heads into small wedges., Pack into jar, placing tomatoes and pepper about midway., Pour salt over cabbage and add water., Fill pint size freezer bag with water and weight mixture down., Make sure water covers cabbage., Cover jar with dish towel, held in place with a rubber band., Store in warm place 10 to 14 days., Can the same as kraut.

title: "Ladies Night Out" Jam Cake
directions: In large mixing bowl cream butter and sugar., Add eggs and beat until creamy.	Mix flour and soda., Add to creamed mixture and mix well., Add buttermilk, jam and allspice., Mix well., Stir in walnuts, raisins and coconut., Pour into lightly greased and floured 10-inch tube pan., Bake 1 hour in preheated 325° oven. Cool 15 minutes in pan., Loosen cake and invert onto cooling rack. Serves 12 to 16.

title: Poulet De Normandy
directions: Mix stuffing, chicken broth and butter together., Pat down in a 12 x 8-inch casserole., Add chicken mixed with onion, celery, mayonnaise and salt; mix 2 eggs with 1 1/2 cups milk., Pour over evenly., Cover with foil and marinate overnight., One hour before serving, spread 1 can of cream of mushroom soup over top., Bake at 350° for 40 minutes., Sprinkle with grated cheese., Put back in oven 10 minutes more.

title: Yeast Bread
directions: Scald, and measure the milk., Add the yeast cake, sugar and salt;, mix thoroughly., Add about 1/2 the flour, mix well. Add the, shortening, and, remaining, flour., Knead, the dough quickly and, lightly, until it is smooth and elastic., Grease lightly. Allow to rise in a warm place (80°) until doubled in bulk.	This will require about 2 hours., Punch down., Let rise about 45 minutes., Mold into loaves and let rise about 1 hour. Bake at 380° until done.

title: Sweet Potato Pie
directions: Beat eggs slightly; add sugar, salt, spices and milk., Add butter to mashed sweet potatoes., Blend with milk and egg mixture. Pour into unbaked pie shell and bake at 450° for 10 minutes. Reduce heat to 350°; bake for 30 to 40 minutes or until firm.

title: Snickerdoodles
directions: Mix together the first 3 ingredients., Add next 4 ingredients., Roll in balls the size of a walnut., If mixture seems too wet, add a little flour at a time until easily handled. Roll these in a mixture of sugar and cinnamon.

title: Italian Spaghetti
directions: Brown onions and garlic in small amount of olive oil., Add ground beef and cook until tender and meat is brown., Season with salt and pepper., Cook until sauce is thick or the longer you cook, the better.

title: Puerto Rico Chicken
directions: Put chicken in cooking oil and cook until brown., Add remaining ingredients and simmer 1 hour., Serve over rice.

title: Best Ever Pineapple Cake
directions: Mix flour, sugar, eggs, baking soda, vanilla and nuts., Add crushed pineapple., Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan for 35 to 45 minutes at 350°., "Happy eating".

title: Salsa Dip
directions: Combine all ingredients in 1 1/2-quart microwave safe bowl. Microwave on High 5 minutes, stopping after 3 minutes., Serve hot with tortilla chips or as a veggie dip., Makes 3 cups.

title: Pork Chop Marinade
directions: Combine marinade and place pork chops in a glass dish; add marinade., Cover and refrigerate overnight, turning occasionally. Grill or broil chops for 8 to 10 minutes; brush occasionally with reserved marinade.

title: Broccoli Corn Muffins
directions: Turn oven to 425°. Mix all ingredients in large bowl. Broccoli does not have to be cooked. Melt butter, then add other ingredients. Bake until golden brown (usually about what recipe calls for to make Jiffy mix muffins).

title: Ceviche
directions: Cut uncooked fish into small pieces., Add lime juice to cover fish; cover and refrigerate 3 to 4 hours, or until fish become opaque., Stir occasionally.

title: Creamy Chicken Broccoli Skillet
directions: Completely cook chicken in Miracle Whip about 8 minutes. Stir in broccoli and cheese., Heat until cheese is melted. Serve over hot cooked rice.

title: Zucchini Bread
directions: Beat eggs until light and frothy., Add oil, sugar, zucchini and vanilla.

title: Peach Cobbler
directions: Grease a 9 x 13 inch pan., Place peaches in bottom of pan and sprinkle with nutmeg., Sift together flour, sugar, baking powder and salt; set aside.

title: Cecil B. De Mille'S Baked Beans
directions: Fry bacon until crisp. Drain off most of the fat., Add onion to bacon and saute until onion is soft., Drain butter beans and kidney beans. Combine all in large 3 quart casserole., Bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour uncovered., Serves about 10.

title: Taco Casserole
directions: Cut tortillas into 1-inch pieces., Combine with meat, soup, salsa, milk and 1/2 cup cheese., Pour into 9 x 12 pan., Cover and bake 45 minutes at 400°., Uncover; sprinkle with remaining 1/2 cup cheese., Return to oven until cheese melts; serve.

title: Hearty Beef 'N Potato Casserole
directions: Place potatoes on bottom and up sides of 8 x 12-inch casserole., Bake, uncovered, at 400° for 10 minutes., Brown beef in large chunks; drain., Place beef, broccoli, 1/2 can of the onions and tomatoes in potato shell. Combine soup, milk, 1/2 cheese and seasonings., Pour over beef mixture., Bake, covered, at 400° for 20 minutes., Top with remaining cheese and onions., Bake, uncovered, for 2 to 3 minutes longer., Serves 6.

title: Pizza Cookie
directions: Preheat oven to, 350°., Grease a 12-inch pizza pan., In medium bowl with, electric mixer at medium speed, cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy., Beat in egg., Stir in flour and baking soda, until, well, blended., Spread dough into prepared pan., Bake 20 minutes or until lightly browned., Sprinkle marshmallows and candies, on, cookie, during, the, last 5 minutes of baking., Cool 10 minutes in pan on wire rack.

title: Cowboy Cookies
directions: Dough is crumbly., Drop by teaspoonfuls on greased cookie sheet., Bake 15 minutes in a 350° oven.

title: Peanut Butter Kiss Cookies
directions: Mix the sugars and shortening, peanut butter and margarine together., Stir in flour., Shape dough into balls., Roll in granulated sugar., Place on cookie sheet about 2 inches apart. Bake at 350° until edges are light brown, 8 to 10 minutes., As soon as they are removed from the oven, press a chocolate Kiss in center of each cookie.

title: Zucchini Bread
directions: Grate zucchini and combine with eggs, oil and vanilla., Mix all dry ingredients together., Combine all ingredients and put in two loaf pans., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Cherry Pineapple Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients together.

title: Lemon Delight
directions: First layer:, First 3 ingredients, blend together and press in 9x13 pan., Bake at 375 degrees for 15 minutes., Let cool.

title: Sally'S Pork Chop Casserole
directions: Saut the onion in butter or margarine. Brown pork chops on both sides in separate pan. Layer sauteed onions, browned pork chops and onions in a 9 x 13 baking dish. In a small bowl, blend chili sauce, flour, salt, pepper and ginger ale. Pour mixture over pork chop/onion mixture. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Avocado Salad
directions: Dissolve jello in hot water., Add tomato sauce and vinegar. When partially set, add avocados, onion and celery.

title: All American Corn Bread
directions: Scald cream (half and half) with butter., Add to thoroughly mixed dry ingredients., Bake for 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Beach Cake
directions: Mix cake mix, butter and 1 egg together and spread in greased 13 x 9-inch pan.

title: Sour Cream Cookies
directions: Bake in very hot oven (500°) for about 10 minutes., Turns out nice in kitchen range., Electric oven not so wise.

title: Party Salad
directions: Mix milk and Cool Whip; refrigerate for one hour., Add cherry pie filling and crushed pineapple., Mix well; add pecans and refrigerate until serving time.

title: Peach Salad
directions: Mix and chill at least 4 hours.

title: Mexican Cabbage
directions: Brown first four ingredients together in Dutch oven; drain. Add soup, Ro-Tel, tomatoes, cabbage, salt and pepper., Simmer 45 minutes., Serve with corn bread.

title: Rice Pudding
directions: Combine cooked rice, milk, sugar, salt and oleo., Cook over medium heat., Stir constantly until thick., Stir in vanilla., Add raisins, if desired., Yields enough for one person.

title: Air Buns
directions: Mix 1/2 cup warm water and 1 teaspoon sugar in a small bowl. Add dry yeast and let stand 15 minutes., In a large bowl, mix 3 1/2 cups warm water, 1/2 cup sugar, shortening, vinegar and salt., Mix well and let cool to lukewarm., Add flour., Knead until smooth and elastic., Let rise, then punch down and form into rolls., Bake at 375° for 30 minutes or until done., This is a large recipe and can be cut in half., A full recipe will make 5 to 6 dozen rolls., I usually make a large pan of rolls plus a pan of cinnamon rolls and some hamburger buns., It is also a good recipe for hamburger buns for family gatherings., The extra rolls freeze well.

title: Ham And Potato Casserole
directions: Layer potatoes, cheese and ham in casserole., Mix flour and milk; pour over potatoes., Add butter, salt and pepper., Bake at 375° for 1 1/2 hours (40 to 60 minutes in microwave) or until hot and bubbly.

title: Banana-Nut Bread Ii
directions: Preheat oven to 350°. Mix butter, sugar, and eggs together. Fold in dry ingredients that have been sifted together. Add mashed bananas and nuts. Bake in loaf pan 9 x 5-inch for 40 to 50 minutes. When done, cool 5 minutes in the pan. Then turn out on rack to cool.

title: Deli-Style Barbecued Beef
directions: In medium saucepan combine roast beef and barbecue sauce. Cook over medium heat 15 minutes to blend flavors, stirring occasionally., Serve in buns., Yields 8 sandwiches.

title: Spiked Cabbage
directions: Cut cabbage in 4 quarters; then slice each quarter into 1/2-inch slices., Cut up green pepper and onion., Add about 3/4 cup water, cover and cook on medium burner for 15 minutes., To be eaten alone, or along with a full meal, serving as a vegetable.

title: Yum Yum Salad
directions: Mix first 6 ingredients together., Add remaining ingredients and put the noodles right before serving.

title: Apricot Pinwheels
directions: Combine apricots and boiling water; allow to stand until most of the water is absorbed; drain., Sift flour and baking powder into bowl., Beat butter or margarine, brown sugar, sugar substitute and water until well blended., Add the flour mixture; blend with a fork until the dough forms a ball., Place the dough on wax paper; flatten slightly., Wrap in the wax paper; chill in the freezer 20 minutes.

title: Turnip Salad
directions: Boil turnips and peel; cut in slices., Add chopped onion, salt, oregano, vinegar and oil., Toss gently and top with sliced eggs.

title: April'S Blueberry Salad
directions: Boil 1 cup water and add 2 packages of jello, then add 1 cup cold water., Drain pineapple and mix with jello and add blueberry pie filling., Chill until jelled.

title: Impossible Quiche
directions: Place all ingredients, except cheese, meat and pepper, in blender and mix., Pour into 9-inch buttered pie pan., Sprinkle meat, cheese, green pepper or onion over top and push gently under surface with back of spoon., Bake 45 minutes at 350°., Cool for 10 minutes before cutting.

title: Candied Sweet Potatoes
directions: Preheat oven to 375° after cooking potatoes in jackets in boiling water in covered saucepan until they can barely by pierced with a fork; drain, cool and peel., Place in shallow baking dish, side by side.

title: Orange-Date Crescents
directions: Assemble blender., Put water, orange juice and dates in blender container., Cover and process at blend for 2 to 3 cycles. Cook mixture on low heat until thickened., Blend chopped nuts. Add to date mixture., Cool.

title: Beef Balls
directions: Combine all ingredients and chill overnight., Roll into balls. Place on serving tray., Sprinkle with paprika., Makes 2 dozen.

title: Spanish Chowder
directions: Brown hamburger in pan. Add beans, tomatoes, chopped pepper and onion. Cook 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Oatmeal Caramelitas
directions: *Note:, If using coconut, add to crumb mixture before pressing into pan.

title: The Obscene Chocolate Cake
directions: Do not preheat oven. Spray one 12-cup Bundt pan with vegetable cooking spray.

title: Creamy Peach Pudding
directions: Arrange fruit in the bottom of a shallow 1-quart serving dish. Place remaining ingredients in an electric blender., Cover and blend at medium speed, 10 seconds or until smooth and creamy., Pour sauce over fruit and stir gently to mix., Cover and refrigerate 3 hours or overnight., Makes 4 servings.

title: People'S Puppy Chow
directions: Melt first 4 ingredients until smooth., Add Rice Chex and mix gently until coated., Now put 2 cups of powdered sugar in a brown grocery bag and shake until coated., Leave in bag until cool.

title: Frosted Chicken Sandwiches
directions: Combine chicken, eggs, olives and mayonnaise., Fill sandwiches (3 slices to a sandwich).

title: Unstuffed Cabbage
directions: Place the cabbage in a greased 2 1/2-quart baking dish. In a skillet, cook beef and onion until done. Stir in rice, salt and pepper, if desired. Spoon over cabbage. Combine soup and water; pour over beef mixture. Cover and bake at 350° for 40 to 50 minutes or until rice and cabbage are tender. Uncover. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake 5 to 10 minutes longer or until cheese is melted. Makes 4 servings.

title: Chinese Winter Soup
directions: Saute celery and mushrooms in butter until crisp-tender but not browned., Add cabbage; saute for 3 minutes., Dissolve bouillon cubes in water; add to vegetables., Mix well., Add soy sauce, water chestnuts and chicken to mixture., Bring to a boil., Cook gently, uncovered, for 5 minutes., Makes 6 servings., Wonderful!

title: Pecan Crunch Cookies
directions: Cream together the margarine, sugar and vanilla., Add crushed potato chips and pecans., Stir in flour., Form small balls with 1 tablespoon of dough., Place on ungreased cookie sheet., Press balls with flat bottom of glass dipped in sugar., Bake in oven at 350° for 16 to 18 minutes, or until cookies are light brown.

title: Butterscotch Chews
directions: Beat eggs., Add all ingredients to beaten eggs and blend well. Spread in a well-greased and floured jelly roll pan., Bake at 325° for 25 to 30 minutes., They freeze well.

title: Good Biscuits(Yield: 1 Batch)
directions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Place biscuits 2-inches apart on an ungreased cookie sheet. Bake in preheated oven for 8 to 11 minutes or until golden brown. Place bacon in a large, deep skillet. Cook over medium-high heat until evenly brown. Drain and set aside.

title: Orange Buttermilk Salad
directions: In a saucepan, bring pineapple to a boil., Remove from heat; add gelatin and stir to dissolve., Add buttermilk and mix well. Cool to room temperature., Fold in whipped topping., Pour into an 11 x 7 x 2-inch dish., Refrigerate several hours or overnight. Cut into squares., Yields 12 servings.

title: Cabbage Casserole
directions: Cut cabbage into wedges; place in saltwater and cook until done. Cabbage should be firm, but tender. Drain well. In saucepan, combine margarine, flour, onion, bell pepper and milk; cook until thick. Remove from heat; add soup, pimento and cheese. Mix well. Combine cabbage with liquid mixture and pour into casserole dish. Bake at 375° until cheese is melted and casserole is bubbly.

title: Old Fashioned Beef Stew
directions: In oven, brown beef in margarine., Add Worcestershire sauce, bay leaves, garlic, paprika, ground cloves, 1 1/2 cups hot water and 1/2 teaspoon pepper., Cook, covered, for 1 1/4 hours; stir often., Remove bay leaves., Add vegetables; cook, covered for 30 to 45 minutes., Drain; reserve liquid., Skim fat., Add water to liquid to equal 1 1/4 cups., Return to oven., Combine cornstarch and 1/4 cup cold water; stir into hot liquid., Cook and stir until thickened., Stir in beef and vegetables., Heat through.

title: Stuff An Apple
directions: Core apple (not all the way through)., Peel 1/3 of the way down from stem end., Combine 1 tablespoon brown sugar and 1/2 teaspoon butter., Fill center of apple and sprinkle with cinnamon. Microwave 2 to 2 1/2 minutes on High.

title: Jan'S Chicken Stock
directions: Place all ingredients, except the chicken liver, into a large pan., Bring to a boil., Turn heat to simmer for 2 hours., Remove chicken, strain broth., This broth may be used for soup, stew or just eaten like it is., Will keep in refrigerator for 1 week.

title: Broiled Stuffed Mushrooms
directions: Rinse mushrooms and wipe gently with a paper towel to dry. Remove stems and chop finely., Saute stems in butter for 2-3 minutes., Add bread crumbs, nuts, garlic chives, basil and tarragon., Season with salt and pepper to taste.

title: Best Meat Loaf
directions: Mix all ingredients, except butter., Form into a loaf and place in roaster. Make holes with your finger here and there on top of loaf., Put margarine in holes., Put cover on roaster and bake at 400° for 45 minutes or at 250° for 3 hours., I usually double the recipe so we have some left for sandwiches.

title: Melting Moments Cookies
directions: Sift dry, ingredients together., Add soft margarine and vanilla., Beat, on	medium	speed of mixer until well blended. Chill in refrigerator 1 hour.

title: Artichokes Parmesan
directions: Mince artichokes very fine and blend with remaining ingredients., In a small baking dish, bake at 325° for 30 minutes or until slightly golden and bubbly around edges., Serve hot with assorted crackers., Especially good with Melba rounds.

title: Snails With Garlic
directions: Rinse snails with cool water and drain., Melt butter in frying pan and add, garlic., Saute, lightly, over, medium-high heat., Add snails and saute., Remove, from, heat, and, place 1 snail in each shell., Add the, rest, of the ingredients to pan and mix together. Stuff some, of the garlic mixture into each snail shell. Sprinkle with a little bread crumbs, if desired. Bake at 400° for 30 minutes, or, until, very, bubbly., Makes 2 servings., Serve with crusty Italian bread.

title: Artichoke Dip
directions: Chop artichokes and add remaining 2 ingredients., Heat in a 350° oven until bubbly and brown on edges., Let "sit" for 10 minutes before serving with crackers.

title: Posole(Yields 12 Servings)
directions: Boil Posole about 2 hours until it pops., Add pork, onion and garlic., Boil until meat is cooked, about 1 hour, on medium heat. Add chile and tomatoes and season with salt to taste., The tomatoes cut the "hotness" of the chile (acid neutralizes the base) and gives a tangy flavor., Chicken also makes good posole and is often used in place of pork.

title: Buckeyes
directions: Melt butter with peanut butter on low heat on stove top., Mix the powdered sugar in very thoroughly; you should have a doughy crumbled mixture., Then mix the Rice Krispies in with this mixture., Shape into balls or any shape you like., In a double boiler, melt the chocolate chips and enough wax for a creamy mixture., Dip the balls in the chocolate and cool on wax paper.

title: Lemon Jello Cake
directions: Put all ingredients in mixing bowl and mix with electric mixer until well blended., Pour into tube pan and bake for 1 hour at 325° (or bake until done).

title: Chicken Pie
directions: In long pan, spread chicken over entire bottom., Slice boiled eggs and place over top of chicken., Pour mushroom soup over top of this., In separate bowl, mix flour, sweet milk and margarine. Pour this mixture over chicken, eggs and cream of mushroom., Put black pepper on top., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Orange Punch
directions: Boil sugar and 2 quarts water. Add Kool-Aid, pineapple juice, orange and water and frozen lemonade., Add ginger ale before serving.

title: Applesauce Cake
directions: Sift together the flour, baking soda, cinnamon, nutmeg and cloves., Cream butter and sugar., Add applesauce; beat well., Add flour mixture in several additions., Beat gently., Fold in raisins., Turn into a greased and floured 8 x 8 x 2-inch cake pan. Bake in a preheated 350° oven for 45 minutes., Let stand on wire rack for 5 minutes., Turn out., Turn right side up., Good warm.

title: Potato Salad
directions: Wash and boil potatoes in skins until tender., Drain off water and allow to cool., Peel and dice potatoes to desired size., Peel and dice onion., (Dab eyes with dishcloth.) Wash and dice celery. Dice Velveeta into small pieces., (Eat a couple of pieces.), Place all ingredients into a large bowl and mix thoroughly., If too dry, add more mayonnaise., Transfer all to a nice clean bowl and garnish with paprika and green olives with tail lights., Serves from1 to 12, depending on appetite.

title: Tempting Shrimp Dip
directions: Combine butter, cream cheese, mayonnaise, garlic, pepper, worcestershire sauce, and lemon juice., Mix well., Stir in onion, celery, and shrimp., Chill well., Serves 8-10.

title: Honey Butter
directions: Place butter in a bowl; add honey a little at a time, stirring until syrupy looking., Great on fresh hot rolls.

title: Pumpkin Bread
directions: Cream the sugar and oil together., Add eggs and pumpkin; mix well., Sift together the dry ingredients., Add dry ingredients alternately with water., Pour into 2 well-greased and floured 9 x 5-inch loaf pans., Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours., Makes 2 loaves.

title: Delicious Potato Rolls
directions: Pour 1 1/3 cups hot potato water over shortening, sugar and salt., Allow to stand until lukewarm., Dissolve yeast in 1/4 cup lukewarm water., Add to first mixture., Then add eggs, mashed potatoes and flour.

title: Chicken Cacciatori
directions: *If you leave these items out, I suggest that you increase the tomatoes.

title: Lemon-Honey Carrots
directions: Mix butter and mustard in saucepan., Stir in honey, lemon peel and lemon juice., Heat. Pour over carrots. Sprinkle with parsley., Makes 4 servings.

title: Carrot Cake
directions: Mix Crisco oil and sugar., Add all other ingredients., Bake in the oven at 350°., Bake 3 layer pans for 30 minutes., Bake a 9 x 13-inch oblong pan for 40 minutes., Bake a Bundt pan for 45 minutes.

title: Cheesy Chicken Pie
directions: In a large bowl, combine soup, milk, spices, Worcestershire sauce, vegetables, cubed chicken and 1/2 can of onions., Place in a 10-inch pie pan that has been prepared with Pam., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes, then stir ingredients., Sprinkle with remaining onions and 1 cup of cheese., Bake for 10 minutes more or until cheese melts., Serves 4 to 6 people.

title: Forgotten Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Beat egg whites until stiff., Add vanilla, sugar and salt., Stir in pecans and chips., Drop by teaspoonfuls on ungreased cookie sheet lined with foil., Put in hot oven., Turn oven off., Leave in oven 3 hours or overnight.

title: Stuffed Cabbage
directions: Use outside leaves; separate and boil until done (about 8 leaves)., Cook rice until done., Put hamburger in pan and cook until brown; remove and add onion, chili powder, paprika and cooked rice., Put about 3 tablespoons of mixture into each cabbage leaf., Put into baking dish., Pour catsup over cabbage and cook until done.

title: Salmon Souffle
directions: Melt butter, add flour and milk and cook until thick., Add all ingredients above (egg yolks only)., Beat egg whites stiff, and gently fold into mixture., Pour into casserole dish and bake at 350° until a knife comes out clean, about 45 to 50 minutes., Serves 6 to 8.

title: Grandma'S Gingerbread
directions: Mix and pour in greased pan., Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Cheese Straws
directions: Run cheese through meat chopper., Mix all ingredients thoroughly and put in cookie press or roll thin and cut into narrow strips about 4-inches long and twist., Bake in oven at 350° for 25 minutes or until light brown., Makes about 100.

title: Zucchini Fritters
directions: Mix all ingredients well., Use nonstick skillet, well coated with spray., Heat skillet., Drop zucchini mixture by tablespoons into hot skillet., Brown on both sides.

title: Raw Apple Cake
directions: Combine all ingredients and mix well., Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Grandma'S Bubble Rolls
directions: Mix butter and brown sugar., Separate biscuits and dust with a cinnamon sugar mixture., Place on edge around bottom of greased bundt pan (36 in all)., Pour melted butter and brown sugar mixture over rolls., Bake at 350 degrees for 25 - 30 minutes., Turn out on large plate when done, so caramel will run over rolls.

title: Creamy Old-Fashioned Pralines
directions: Mix in pot with wooden spoon., Turn fire on medium., Cook for 7 to 8 minutes until soft ball forms in tap water., Remove from heat, add 1 tablespoon butter, 1/4 teaspoon vanilla and 1 1/2 cup pecans., Beat about 1 minute, until thick., Spoon out on greased waxed paper.

title: Cheese Meat Loaf
directions: Mix together., Pat out., Place 2 to 3 slices of cheese., Roll up., Place in pan., Baste with ketchup and brown sugar., Cover with foil., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Orange Pineapple Salad
directions: Mix jello according to package directions., Let set in refrigerator for about 30 minutes., Remove and mix all other ingredients with it., Return to refrigerator and let it set all night., When ready to serve, top with pineapple slices with a cherry in center.

title: Crispy Cocoa Bars
directions: Butter 9 x 13-inch pan., In a large saucepan over low heat, melt butter; stir in cocoa and marshmallows., Cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until marshmallows are melted and mixture is smooth and well blended., Continue cooking and stirring for one minute., Remove from heat; add cereal and stir until well coated. Press into buttered pan with a buttered spatula and let cool and then cut into 24 squares.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Cook broccoli as directed on package; drain., Add 1/2 stick butter and 1/2 pound Velveeta cheese., Stir until cheese dissolves. Put into greased casserole dish., Crush 1/4 pound Ritz crackers. Mix with 1/2 stick melted butter., Spread over top., Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Weight Watcher Stuffed Peppers
directions: Saute ground turkey, onion and celery in oil in nonstick frypans sprayed with Pam., Add cooked rice, spices, bouillon, V-8 and Worcestershire., Mix well., Spoon into pepper halves., Garnish with a tomato slice and 1 teaspoon grated cheese., Bake at 350°, covered, 1 hour., Four servings (2 halves each) equals 4 protein and 1 bread.

title: Fruit Leather
directions: Preheat oven to 140°., Prepare pan:, turn baking sheet over, bottom up., Cover bottom with plastic wrap., Secure wrap to sheet by taping down edges with masking tape., (This prevents the edges of wrap pulling up while fruit is drying.)

title: Classic Pecan Pie
directions: In large bowl, stir eggs, corn syrup, sugar, butter and vanilla until well blended., Stir in pecans., Pour into pie crust. Bake in preheated oven at 350°., Bake 50 to 55 minutes or until knife inserted halfway between center and edge comes out clean. Cool on wire rack., Makes 8 servings.

title: Harvard Beets
directions: Mix, sugar and cornstarch; add water and vinegar., Boil for 5 minutes., Drain, beets and add., Cook on low heat until beets are heated., Add, butter or margarine; season with salt and pepper.

title: Foolproof Dark Chocolate Fudge
directions: In a heavy saucepan, over low heat, melt chips with milk and salt., Spread evenly into foil-lined 8 or 9 inch square pan. Chill 2 hours or until firm., Turn fudge onto cutting board, peel off foil and cut into squares., Store loosely covered at room temperature.

title: Soda-Flavored Ice Cream
directions: Use any homemade ice cream machine (4 or 5 quart size)., Can be increased proportionally (1 quart soda to 1 can milk)., Fill ice cream bucket 4/5 full of mixture, allowing room for freezing expansion and proceed to chill or make ice cream according to machine directions.

title: Out-Of-This-World Pie
directions: In a saucepan, combine cherry pie filling with sugar, pineapple and juice, cornstarch and food coloring., Cook until thick., Remove from heat and add gelatin., Allow to cool., Add bananas and pecans. Pour into two baked pie shells., Top with whipped topping., Chill.

title: Meatball Casserole
directions: Roll the hamburger and onion together., Place in casserole dish, then sprinkle garlic salt all over top., Bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes, until done., Boil potatoes until tender., Turn burner on low and mash with a little milk until creamy., Add Cheez Whiz and mix well., Pour over top of the meatballs and bake for 10 more minutes.

title: Oatmeal Chocolate Chips Cake
directions: Pour water over oatmeal and let stand 10 minutes., Add sugar and margarine., Add eggs and mix well., Sift flour, soda, salt and cocoa., Add to mix., Add half package of chocolate chips., Put batter in pan or muffin pans., Sprinkle top of batter with remaining chips and chopped nuts., No frosting is needed., Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350°.

title: Zesty Grilled Ham
directions: In small saucepan bring brown sugar, horseradish and lemon juice to a boil., Brush over both sides of ham., Grill over medium-hot coals, turning once until heated through and well glazed, about 20 to 25 minutes., Yields 4 servings.

title: Skillet Corn
directions: Combine corn, salt, pepper, sugar, butter and water in a 10-inch skillet., Cover and simmer 15 minutes over medium heat, stirring occasionally., Combine flour and milk, blending until smooth., Stir into corn., Cook 5 minutes over low heat, stirring constantly.

title: Corned Beef Hash
directions: Melt margarine in large skillet., Stir in all ingredients, mixing together., Cook until browned and potatoes are tender., A little water may be added from time to time, if it starts to stick., Serves 4.

title: Pumpkin Pie
directions: Put everything in a blender and blend until smooth., It can be mixed until smooth with a mixer or by hand., Bake at 425° for 30 to 40 minutes until knife inserted in middle comes out clean.

title: Sugar-Free Apple Pie
directions: Combine ingredients., Bake at 400° for 15 minutes; reduce heat to 350° and bake until done.

title: Dirt Cake
directions: Crush cookies; set aside., Cream together cream cheese and butter and set aside., Blend pudding and milk., Fold in Cool Whip. Blend in cream cheese mixture., Layer the cake beginning with Oreo crumbs, then pudding mixture and ending with Oreo crumbs.

title: Pie Crust
directions: Mix flour, salt and shortening together until crumbly., Add hot water, mix thoroughly., Divide into thirds., Roll out on floured board., Place in pan, crimp edges., Makes 3 (10-inch) pie crusts., Bake at 350° for 15 minutes or until desired brown.

title: Hot Beef Dip
directions: Cut beef into small pieces., Combine beef and water into 4-cup glass measuring cup., Microwave on High for 3 minutes; drain., Mix in remaining ingredients., Insert microwave thermometer; microwave on Roast to 120°., Stir.

title: Cinnamon Rolls-Yeast Rolls
directions: Mix flour, sugar, salt and yeast., Heat milk, water and margarine., Gradually add to dry ingredients., Beat 2 minutes on medium speed., Add 1 egg and 1/2 cup flour., Beat on high speed for 2 minutes., Stir in 2 1/2 cups to 3 cups flour to make a soft dough., Knead until smooth and elastic., Place in greased bowl and grease top of dough., Cover and let rise until double., Punch down; turn onto floured board., Divide into two parts, 1/2 for rolls.

title: Shredded Barbecue Beef
directions: Mix ingredients all together well., Pour over raw roast. Cover with foil., Bake at 350° for 3 to 4 hours., Remove from roaster and shred with fork., Enjoy!

title: Baked Corn
directions: Combine all ingredients; mix well., Pour into buttered 2-quart casserole or 9 x 13-inch cake pan., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Tuna Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Chill and serve.

title: Sour Cream Doughnuts
directions: Put enough shortening into deep frying kettle to fry doughnuts. Sift flour, add salt, baking powder, soda and nutmeg., Beat eggs. Add sugar and beat., Add sour cream., Add to dry mixture., Remove 1/2 of dough to pastry cloth., Roll about 1/4-inch thick., Cut with doughnut cutter., Fry in hot shortening (370°)., Drain., Roll in powdered sugar or dip in doughnut glaze.

title: Brownie Pudding
directions: Mix first 9 ingredients together., Spread mixture in 8 x 8-inch pan., Mix remaining ingredients together and pour over brownie mixture., Bake at 350° for 40 minutes., Good either hot or cold.

title: Cherry Pie Filling Cake
directions: Combine cake mix, eggs and oil. Add cherry pie filling. Pour into sprayed 9 x 12-inch pan.

title: Sweet Potato, Crunchy Top Casserole
directions: Combine and mix all ingredients. Pour into baking dish.

title: Hot Cranberry Punch
directions: Combine all ingredients except the pineapple juice., Bring to a boil, stirring constantly., Add pineapple juice and return to a boil., Simmer 5 minutes., Makes 3 quarts.

title: Sandy'S Delight
directions: Wash and cut strawberries in fourths., Mix in fruit cocktail, then add strawberry jel., Mix well; chill., Top with whipped cream and serve.

title: Spice Pecans
directions: Beat egg and water until it foams., Stir in pecans., Mix sugar and spices., Sprinkle over pecans., Stir; cover all., Pour in pan. Bake at 300° for 30 to 35 minutes., Cool.

title: Chicken 'N' Biscuits
directions: In medium saucepan, saute onion and margarine., Stir in flour, salt and pepper., Whisk in 2 1/2 cups milk., Cook until slightly thickened., Add next four ingredients., Divide into 4 (8 ounce) baking dishes., Preheat oven to 450°., In medium bowl, combine remaining 3/4 cup milk, the biscuit mix and parsley., Drop 4 or 5 teaspoons of biscuit mixture on each baking dish., Bake about 15 minutes until mixture is bubbly and biscuits are browned.

title: Squash Casserole
directions: Combine squash (cut to bite size pieces), onion, salt and sugar., Simmer in 1 cup of water until tender., Drain well., Add eggs, oleo, flour, milk and cheese and mix well., Bake in greased casserole in a 350° oven for 30 minutes.

title: Death By Chocolate
directions: Bake cake per directions in a 13 x 9-inch pan., Cool., Poke holes in cake., Drizzle with Kahlua and refrigerate overnight. Prepare mousse per directions., Cut cake in small squares., Layer bottom of glass bowl with cake squares., Cover with a layer of mousse, then layer with Cool Whip and smashed Heath bars., Repeat layers, ending with Heath bars.

title: Pickled Eggs
directions: Combine juice from beets, vinegar and brown sugar; heat to boiling., Put beets in jar, then eggs., Pour hot juice over top. After cool, refrigerate.

title: Lemon Icebox
directions: Preheat oven to 325°., In large bowl, beat egg yolks, condensed milk and lemon juice., Pour into pie shell., Bake 30 minutes., Cool, then top with Cool Whip., Refrigerate.

title: Stuffed Bell Peppers
directions: Cut tops off and center out of peppers., Put peppers in boiling water; cook until tender., Saute meat and pepper tops with salt., Drain off excess oil., Mix well the meat, rice, 1/2 of liquid from tomatoes and soups., If you want it hotter, add rest of tomato juice., Place peppers in pan and stuff with mixture. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes, or until bubbling hot.

title: Fruit Pie
directions: Drain fruit and set aside., Melt butter in iron skillet., Pour in coconut and brown, add vanilla wafer crumbs., Remove from heat. Put aside 1/2 cup of mixtrue., Press immediately in 2 pie plates. Beat milk and lemon juice until peaked, add cool whip., Gently fold in fruit and walnuts., Top with crust mixture., Refrigerate overnight.

title: Blt Dip
directions: Let chill about 1 hour., Serve on crackers or cocktail rye.

title: Mexican Beef Casserole
directions: Cook ground beef, onion, green pepper and garlic together and drain., Add next 8 ingredients and simmer until slightly cooked. Add meat mixture to noodles and add grated cheese., Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and cover with foil., Bake 30 minutes at 375°.

title: Congealed Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients together; put in a jello mold or just a bowl., Refrigerate overnight.

title: Cream Cheese Pound Cake
directions: Cream together butter, cream cheese and sugar., Add and beat well the almond, vanilla and lemon flavor., Add eggs, one at a time., Stir in cake flour and mix well., Bake in tube pan at 325° for 1 1/2 hours (check after 1 hour)., Makes a large cake.

title: Baskin Robbins Cake
directions: Crust:, Mix flour, butter and pecans., Spread in a 9 x 13-inch pan and bake for 20 minutes at 350°., Cool.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Boil the chicken until done. Debone and place in a large bowl. Add both cans of soup and sour cream; mix well., Put in a casserole dish. Crumble up the entire sleeve of crackers and sprinkle on top of the chicken mixture., Melt 1 stick of margarine and pour over the top of the crackers., Bake in a 350° preheated oven until bubbly. Throw together your favorite green salad, add some rolls and you have a quick meal., Cream of celery or onion soup may be used as the soup.

title: Tea Cakes
directions: Combine butter, shortening and sugar, creaming until light and fluffy., Add vanilla., Work in flour and coconut gradually until well blended., Form into 2 rolls; chill in refrigerator overnight. Heat oven to 275°., Slice dough 1/4-inch thick., Slices may be cut in fancy shapes., Bake for 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Pumpkin Dream Pie
directions: Prepare Dream Whip as directed on package. Combine 1 cup prepared Dream Whip with pudding mix, pumpkin, 2/3 cup milk and spice., Beat slowly with eggbeater just until mixed., Pour into pie shell. Chill in refrigerator until set, about 2 hours. Top with remaining Dream Whip.

title: Shrimp Dip
directions: In a medium mixer bowl, beat cheese until fluffy., Gradually beat in ReaLemon., Stir in remaining ingredients except chips. Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Applesauce Cake(No Eggs)
directions: Cream oil and sugar., Add applesauce and flour which has been mixed with spices., Mix in raisins., Mix soda with hot water and add last., Pour batter into a 9 x 13-inch greased and floured pan. Sprinkle with granulated sugar, making a light coating., Bake at 350° for 35 minutes or until done., No frosting is needed., Best served warm.

title: Blue Cheese Stuffed Eggs
directions: Slice eggs in half lengthwise and carefully remove yolks. Position knife blade in food processor bowl., Add yolks, Blue cheese and remaining ingredients., Process until smooth, stopping once to scrape down sides., Spoon or pipe into egg whites.

title: Kente Cloth Cake
directions: Prepare cake according to directions on package and bake in a 13 x 9-inch cake pan., Cool cake 15 minutes in pan., Remove from pan and let cool completely on a rack., Wash and dry cake pan. Return cake back to pan, placing top up., Pierce cake with a large fork at 1/2-inch intervals.

title: Pear Marmalade
directions: Cook pears like salad pears, then mash them. Add jello and pineapple. Cook over low heat about 30 minutes, then put in jars.

title: Honey Graham Cake
directions: Crush crackers and mix with chopped cherries and pecans., Melt Parkay margarine and marshmallows together and pour over cracker mixture., Press well into a greased tube pan.

title: Beef Stroganoff
directions: Garlic salt and flour cubes; brown in 2 tablespoons oil. Drain fat; add next 5 ingredients., Simmer 2 hours., You may add more water and consomme., Cool and add sour cream and soup.

title: Banana Nut Cake
directions: Cream sugar and shortening; add eggs, bananas, pecans, buttermilk and vanilla., Sift dry ingredients., Gradually add to creamed mix., Beat well., Bake at 325° until done when tested.

title: Spanish Rice
directions: In bacon drippings, cook rice, onion and green pepper until onion is tender. Add bacon and other ingredients. Cover and simmer over low heat about 30 minutes or until rice is tender and liquid absorbed. Makes 5 to 6 servings.

title: Parmesan Potatoes
directions: Melt butter in a 9 x 13-inch pan., Mix flour and Parmesan cheese in a plastic bag., Shake a few potato cubes in bag at a time and put in buttered pan., Bake at 350° for 1/2 hour., With a spatula, turn over and bake another 1/2 hour., Leftover cheese may be put in freezer for next time.

title: Peanut Butter Cookie
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Spoon out on cookie sheet; mash with fork., Bake at 350° until lightly brown.

title: P T A Cookies
directions: Mix together syrup and sugar in a saucepan. Boil mixture for 1 minute. Remove from heat. Stir in peanut butter and vanilla until well blended. Add cereal. Mix until coated., Drop by spoonfuls on waxed paper. Let cool.

title: Creme Sherry Wine Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Mix cake mix, pudding, eggs, salad oil, sherry and walnuts or pecans., Grease and lightly flour Bundt pan. Pour in pan and bake at least 45 minutes.

title: Susie'S Chocolate Fudge Icing
directions: Mix, first, 3, ingredients, and, bring to boil, cooking until drops, from, spoon	and barely holds its shape., Remove from heat and add butter and dash of salt., Bake 3 thin layers of cake and ice with mixture, poking holes in bottom layers so the fudge will soak through.

title: Pecan Crescents
directions: Cream oleo, sugar and vanilla; add flour then nuts, mix well. Roll and shape into crescents., Place on ungreased cookie sheet and bake at 350° for 15 minutes., Remove and cool slightly., Put powdered sugar into a zip lock baggie., When the cookies are cooled a little add a few at a time to the powdered sugar and shake gently., Shake off any extra powdered sugar., Set on paper towels to finish cooling., This makes 4 dozen cookies.

title: A Berry Good Banana Smoothie
directions: Peel and slice bananas., Wash and cut off tops of strawberries., Put into blender with milk and yogurt and whirl away., Pour into cups and enjoy!

title: Molasses Cookie
directions: Combine sugar, oil and egg; beat well. Add molasses and beat. Combine flour and other ingredients. Stir into sugar mixture. Shape dough into 1-inch balls., Place 1-inch apart on cookie sheet and bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Ice Cream Fudge Dessert
directions: Mix crushed Oreos with melted butter., Spread in 9 x 13-inch pan., Freeze.

title: Low-Fat Oatmeal Raisin Cookies
