directions: Beat egg, brown sugar and oil until smooth., Beat in yogurt and vanilla., Add oats, flour, baking soda, cinnamon and salt. Beat until well mixed., Stir in raisins., Drop batter by rounded teaspoonfuls, about 2-inches apart on baking sheet lightly sprayed with vegetable oil spray., Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes or until cookies are lightly browned., Cool on wire rack., Each cookie contains 59 calories., Makes 48 cookies.

title: Hello Dollies
directions: In a large rectangular pan, melt the margarine., Sprinkle cracker crumbs, chocolate and butterscotch bits, coconut and nuts (in this order) over the melted margarine., Pour milk over all of this., Bake at 350° for 25 minutes., Cut into squares when cool.

title: Molded Candy
directions: Add water until until right consistency. Mix in mixer then knead. Roll in small ball, roll in regular sugar, put in mold, remove. Put on wax paper to dry overnight. 1 recipe makes 10 dozen.

title: A-Maze-Ing Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., In large bowl, mix corn, brown sugar and white sugar., Beat in eggs, one at a time., Add oil; beat until well mixed., Stir in raisins and pecans., Mix together dry ingredients; add to liquid., Stir until well blended., Pour into greased tube pan and bake for 45 minutes or until tests done. Can be used with or without frosting.

title: Chicken And Biscuits
directions: Preheat oven to 400°., Roll chicken in mixture of flour, salt, pepper and paprika., Melt margarine in 9 x 13-inch pan., Add chicken pieces, skin side down., Bake 40 minutes; then turn chicken., Combine soup and milk; pour over chicken., Place biscuits on top and bake 10 to 12 minutes or until biscuits are brown.

title: Bean And Bacon Soup
directions: In a 1-quart casserole, combine onion, celery, bell pepper, garlic and oil., Cover; vent top and microwave on High 3 minutes until softened., Stir halfway through cooking., Add remaining ingredients and stir., Cover and microwave on High 1 minute until thoroughly heated., Serves two 1-cup servings., Contains 164 calories, 6 gm fat and 496 mg sodium.

title: Chocolate Cherry Cake
directions: Mix together by hand., Grease, and, flour a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 40 minutes. Frost cake while warm.

title: Mexican Cornbread
directions: Mix everything together., Pour, into, well-greased pan. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Snickerdoodles
directions: Cream margarine and brown sugar., Add egg and milk alternately with flour and baking powder., Bake in muffin tin and sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon., Bake in hot oven.

title: Salmon Patties
directions: Mix all ingredients well, adding milk only if mixture is too dry., Fry in heated, buttered skillet until done., Sprinkle lightly with garlic salt on each side of patty while frying.

title: Great Northern Bean Stew
directions: In large saucepan or 4-quart Dutch oven, brown sausage and onions; drain., Stir in all remaining ingredients; bring to a boil., Reduce heat; cover and simmer 15 minutes., Makes 6 (1 cup) servings.

title: Potato Casserole
directions: Mix Velveeta, milk and butter in saucepan until melts., Pour over hash browns., Bake about 40 to 45 minutes at 350°., Makes 8 to 10 large portions., Quick and delicious recipe., Easy to make and great for large group casserole., Enjoy it!!!

title: Party Mix
directions: Melt candy coating in double boiler., Pour over remaining ingredients and mix well.

title: Chicken With White Wine
directions: Sprinkle chicken with salt, pepper and paprika., Coat well with flour., Brown in 1/4 cup butter., Remove chicken and add remaining butter., Brown mushrooms, scallions, celery and garlic. Return chicken to pan., Add wine and simmer slowly for 45 minutes or until tender.

title: Squash Balls
directions: Mix cooked squash, finely chopped onion, 1 egg, flour, and baking powder, salt, and pepper. Form small balls and roll in crushed corn flakes. Fry in deep oil until golden brown. Serve hot. Makes 6 to 8 servings. Very Good.

title: Crunch Bars
directions: Preheat oven to 400°., Line 10 x 15 x 1-inch pan with foil. Arrange saltines in pan., In saucepan melt butter and brown sugar. Heat to boiling; boil for 3 minutes., Pour evenly over crackers. Bake about 7 minutes., Remove from oven., Sprinkle chocolate chips evenly over top; spread evenly., Cool., Refrigerate 1 hour., Break into pieces., Store in refrigerator.

title: Nicaraguan Fried Rice
directions: Wash and drain rice., Set aside., In skillet, heat oil and saute onion, green pepper and carrot., Add 2 cups water and salt on medium heat until rice is done., Three minutes before, spread chopped tomato on top., When rice is done, top with lid.

title: Cranberry Cloud
directions: In processor, coarsely grind cranberries., Combine berries, marshmallows and sugar in large bowl; stir gently., Cover and chill at least 1 1/2 hours., Add apples, grapes and nuts; stir gently., Fold in cream or Cool Whip., Cover and chill 1 hour. Serve on lettuce.

title: Ham Cheese Ball
directions: Chop ham and crackers together in food processor., Mix together cream cheese, Miracle Whip and garlic powder., Add ham and cracker mixture to cream cheese mixture., Form into ball., Roll in nuts. Chill.

title: Elegant Butternut Squash Soup
directions: Halve the squash lengthwise; peel, seed and cut into chunks. Place in a soup pot with the broth. Simmer, partially covered, until tender, 20 to 25 minutes. Transfer the squash to a bowl with a slotted spoon; reserve broth. Melt the butter in the oil in a nonstick skillet over very low heat. Add the onion and cook, stirring, until wilted, about 15 minutes. Sprinkle with the mace and ginger. Cook, stirring, for 1 minute more. Add the cooked onion mixture and the brown sugar to the squash and stir well. Season with salt and pepper.

title: Crunchy Surprise Bars
directions: Mix sugar, butter, molasses, egg yolk and vanilla with a spoon., Stir in flour and 1 cup of chocolate bits., Press dough in an ungreased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan., Bake until golden brown, 25 to 30 minutes, at 350°.

title: Infallible Rice
directions: Saute onions in butter until transparent., Combine onions, rice and hot broth., Bring to boil; turn on low heat., Cover and cook for 25 minutes.

title: Robbie'S Favorite Graham Cracker Fruit Cake
directions: Mix nuts, cherries and crackers together., Pour juices into double boiler and melt marshmallows., Pour over mixture and pack back into cracker box.

title: Stuffed Tomatoes
directions: Wash tomatoes and scoop out pulp., Save caps., Sprinkle inside of tomatoes with salt substitute., Pan broil onions in a little oil until soft., Now mix onions, parsley, dill, raisins or currants, nuts, rice and more of olive oil., Fill tomatoes with remaining oil and the water., Weigh down the tomatoes with a heavy plate., Cover casserole., Let simmer for 30 minutes or until rice is done., Let cool., May be refrigerated., Serve cold., Serves 6.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
directions: Combine all ingredients in a mixing bowl and mix well. Put in two quart dish and cover with topping.

title: Poor Man'S Lobster
directions: Place water, salt, lemon juice, onion and celery in 4-quart pan., Bring to boil., Add fish., Bring to boil again for 3 minutes., Drain., Place fish on cookie sheet., Brush on melted margarine or butter and sprinkle paprika on top., Broil 2 to 3 minutes.

title: Low Calorie Chocolate Sauce
directions: Combine cocoa and sugar in a small saucepan., Stir in milk and water with wire whisk until smooth., Bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring constantly., Cook 1 minute, stirring constantly. Remove from heat; stir in vanilla., Serve warm over ice milk. Yield:, 1 cup (26 calories per tablespoon plus 100 calories per 1/2 cup ice milk).

title: Dump Cake
directions: Grease a 9 x 13-inch cake pan., Dump undrained pineapple into pan. Spread evenly. Dump in pie filling and spread evenly., Dump dry cake mix onto cherry layer. Spread evenly. Sprinkle nuts over cake mix. Put butter over top., Bake at 350° for 50 minutes. Very good with whipped cream.

title: Corn Oyster Scallop
directions: Combine oyster stew, corn, 1 1/4 cups crumbs, egg, salt, pepper and pimentos., Pour into a greased 2-quart casserole dish. Combine margarine and 1/2 cup crumbs; sprinkle around edge of corn mix., Bake at 350° for 1 hour, until knife inserted halfway comes out clean.

title: No Cook Recipe
directions: Load family (husband included) into family vehicle (van preferably for separating kids)., Drive to nearest location (can't stand kids for any longer) and release kids on the establishment (hopefully there's a playground)., When food is gone (whether in stomachs or on floor) leave to the relief of others sitting around you., Oh!, Don't forget your coupons!

title: Coconut Pies
directions: Beat eggs well. Mix remaining ingredients into beaten eggs. Pour into unbaked pie shells. Bake at 350° for 35 minutes. Makes 2 pies; one to eat and one to share.

title: French Onion Soup
directions: Peel and slice onions., In a skillet, saute onions in butter over low heat until soft and lightly brown., Sprinkle with flour; add water, stirring., Crumble bouillon cubes and add to pan., Add bouquet garni, salt and pepper., Bring to a boil., Cover; cook for about 20 minutes., Add white wine to soup., Transfer soup to individual ovenproof soup bowls or ovenproof large bowl., Place sliced bread on top., Sprinkle generously with grated cheese., Heat oven to 450° for about 10 minutes until cheese melts and turns golden brown.

title: Rice
directions: Fry bacon; add celery, onion, green pepper and tomato and saute., Add rice., Let brown with bacon and vegetables; add water or chicken broth., Cover; let come to boil, turn heat to low and simmer 20 minutes.

title: Pizza Batter Bread
directions: In a mixer bowl, combine 1 1/2 cups of flour, yeast, oregano and garlic powder., In a saucepan, heat water, oleo, sugar and salt just until warm, stirring to melt oleo., Add to dry ingredients in bowl., Beat 3 minutes at high speed., By hand, stir in pepperoni and enough remaining flour to make a moderately soft dough., Cover; let rise in warm place until doubled in bulk, 45 to 60 minutes., Stir dough down., Spread evenly in greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan., Let rise 30 more minutes., Bake at 375° for 35 to 40 minutes., Makes 2 loaves.

title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
directions: Cream butter and sugar thoroughly., Stir in egg yolks, one at a time., Add soda to flour., Add flour and sour cream alternately to creamed mixture., Beat egg whites stiff and fold in., Bake in large tube pan, greased and floured, at 300° for 1 1/2 to 2 hours or until a toothpick comes out clean., Leave in pan for 15 minutes.

title: Seven Minute Frosting
directions: Combine all ingredients except vanilla in top of double boiler., Beat one minute at high speed to blend; then place over boiling water and beat until mixture forms peaks when beater is raised, about 7 minutes., Remove from boiling water; add vanilla. Continue beating until thick enough to spread.

title: Fresh Strawberry Cake
directions: First Layer:, Pinch cake in bite size pieces., Mix with 1 1/2 small boxes of Cool Whip., Put in loaf pan.

title: Oreo Cookie Cake
directions: Crush Oreo cookies., Melt butter and mix with Oreos., Put aside 1/4 cup of mixture., Put the rest in 9 x 13-inch pan. Soften cream cheese., Mix with pudding and 3 cups milk., Put on top of Oreo mixture., Let set 2 hours in refrigerator., Put Cool Whip and 1/4 cup Oreo mixture on top.

title: New England Pumpkin Pie
directions: Thicken boiling milk with flour (mix flour with milk and cook until smooth)., Mix all other ingredients, except egg whites., When thoroughly mixed, add slightly beaten egg whites., Bake until brown on top; well done., Bake in 425° oven first 15 minutes, then 325° for 30 plus minutes.

title: Cherry Cheesecake
directions: Mix cream cheese, Cool Whip and confectioners sugar with electric mixer until well blended., Cut angel food cake in half horizontally to make 2 layers., Spread cream cheese mixture between layers, on sides and on top of the cake., Let it drizzle down the side., Top with cherry pie filling., Place cake, covered, in refrigerator overnight or several hours before serving.

title: Saucy Smokies
directions: Place Smokies in medium saucepan; combine with jelly and 1/2 bottle chili sauce., Simmer over low heat until jelly melts, stirring occasionally., When sauce is thickened, remove from heat and place in serving bowl.

title: 60-Minute Cheese Fondue Boat
directions: Set aside 1 cup of flour., Mix remaining flour, sugar, salt, garlic and yeast., Stir in water and margarine., Mix in enough reserved flour to make soft dough., Knead 4 minutes., Roll dough 18 x 8 inches., Spread mayonnaise down center third of length., Top with cheese and onions., Seal long edges over filling at 1 inch intervals; seal ends., Set on greased baking sheet., Cover., Place over large shallow pan of boiling water; let rise 15 minutes., Bake for 20 minutes or until done.

title: Cork And Cleaver Mud Pie
directions: Crush wafers into fine crumbs and mix thoroughly with melted margarine., Press into a 9-inch pie tin about halfway up the sides., Crust should be about 1/8-inch thick., Firm in freezer for 15 minutes., Whip softened ice cream until smooth., Fill pie shell so that top is mounded to 3-inches in the center and less than 1-inch on the edges., Place in freezer to harden., When ice cream is firm, spread topping to 1/8-inch thickness all over top and return to freezer to harden., Serve on a chilled plate., (Suggest you also chill server.), Top each slice with whipped cream and sliced, toasted almonds.

title: Chocolate Eclair
directions: Layer bottom of a 9 x 13-inch cake pan with graham crackers, then whip pudding as directed (less one cup milk)., Let stand for 1 minute, then add container of whipped cream to pudding., Put thin layer on crackers, then another layer of crackers and so on until you end up with a layer of crackers on top., Put frosting in microwave until runny and pour on top of mixture., Refrigerate about 3 hours.

title: Guacamole
directions: Mix together and serve.

title: Mina'S Old-Fashioned Cookies
directions: Beat sugar and shortening; add egg, milk and vanilla., Add dry ingredients., Bake 14 minutes at 350°., Drop by spoon on ungreased cookie sheet., Makes 4 dozen.

title: Popcorn Cake
directions: Melt together first 3 ingredients., Pour over popcorn, peanuts and M&M's., Mix well and pack into angel food pan (sprayed)., Pack well; also can be put into two bread pans.

title: Russian Cream Salad
directions: Double these ingredients for one jello mold.

title: Chewy Pecan Squares
directions: Grease and flour an 8-inch square pan., Stir together egg, brown sugar and vanilla. Quickly stir in flour, soda and salt. Add nuts., Spread in pan and bake at 350° for 18 to 20 minutes. Should be soft in center when removed from oven., Do not overbake. Leave in pan and cut into 2-inch squares., Makes 16 squares.

title: Quick Taco Bake
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Brown ground beef and onion; drain., Spoon into ungreased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish., Stir in seasoning mix (dry), tomato sauce and corn., Sprinkle with cheese., Stir remaining ingredients until blended., Pour over beef mixture. Bake 35 minutes or until light golden brown., Serve with sour cream, chopped tomato and shredded lettuce, if desired., Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Raisin Pie(From The Parsonage Kitchen)
directions: Combine raisins, sugar, flour, vinegar, butter and salt in boiling water., Roll pie dough and spread bottom crust with margarine; add raisin mixture., Wet edges of crust with water. Place top crust on top of filling and seal down good., Bake in hot oven at 425° for 15 minutes, then lower heat and bake until brown.

title: Chicken Or Turkey Casserole(Serves 12 To 15)
directions: Mix and put in 13 x 11-inch casserole., Refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350° for 1 hour., Put buttered crumbs on top of casserole the last 15 minutes.

title: Cranberry Relish
directions: Peel oranges; grind in blender., Add cranberries a few at a time until all are blended well., Add boiling water, sugar and Jell-O; stir until all is dissolved., Add cranberry mixture and nuts; stir., Refrigerate until thickened.

title: Crazy Cake
directions: Mix all dry ingredients together., Add all wet ingredients and mix well., (Mixture will look like pudding.), Bake in 8 x 8-inch pan at 350° for 25 minutes., Frost with Butter Frosting.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
directions: Spread	jam, on, the, bottom, only of pie crust and set aside. At, medium, speed, mix cheese and peanut butter., Beat in	sugar and vanilla., Blend in Cool Whip (or whipped cream) carefully. Refrigerate for 2 hours or overnight.

title: Mock Pink Champagne
directions: Early in day, mix sugar with water in saucepan and boil 5 minutes., Cool and add frozen juices., Refrigerate., At serving time, add ginger ale and grenadine syrup., Stir lightly., Makes 1 1/2 quarts or 10 servings.

title: Caramel Nut Pound Cake
directions: Cream butter, brown sugar and shortening. Gradually add white sugar and beat. Add eggs 1 at a time and beat. Combine baking powder, flour and salt. Add alternately with milk. Add vanilla and nuts. Blend well. Grease and flour pan. Bake at 325° for 1 1/2 hours. Let cool 15 minutes and take out of pan.

title: Squash Casserole
directions: Mix squash, soup, milk, onion, pepper and salt with 7 Ritz crackers, crumbled., Put in casserole., Top with another 7 crackers., Drizzle margarine over this and cover with, French fried onions., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Banana Bread
directions: Cream together butter, sugar and eggs., Add sour cream, flour, salt and baking soda., Mix well., Can also add walnuts or raisins to this recipe., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean.

title: Potato Leek Soup
directions: Use white part of leeks, clean and chop with garlic in blender or food processor., Saute in butter or margarine until leeks are softened., Add peeled, diced potatoes to leeks and garlic; mix to blend together., Add water to cover ingredients and cook until leeks and potatoes are tender., Add salt, pepper and dill., If you care to, you can add milk, sweet cream or evaporated milk.

title: Paul'S Favorite Sugar Cookies
directions: Mix margarine, powdered sugar, eggs, vanilla and almond extract until thoroughly mixed up., Add flour, soda and cream of tartar. Cover and chill overnight., Set oven to 375°., Divide dough., Roll each part of dough to about 3/16-inch thick on a floured cloth covered board., Cut into desired shapes; sprinkle with sugar., Put on baking sheet., Bake about 7 minutes or until they are light brown.

title: Chinese Chili
directions: Brown meat and onions., Add remaining ingredients., Cover and simmer 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

title: Colleen'S Ultra Fudgy Brownies
directions: Microwave halved chocolate squares and butter in a large glass bowl for 1 minute and 45 seconds or until butter is melted., Stir until chocolate is melted., Let this mixture cool.

title: Edith'S Pineapple Salad
directions: Add first 4 ingredients and refrigerate., Can also add a container of whipped cream.

title: Golden Glazed Chicken
directions: Preheat oven to 400°., In shallow baking dish (13 x 9 x 2-inch), arrange chicken (skin side up)., Brush with butter., Bake for 45 minutes., Baste once with pan drippings., Combine remaining ingredients; spoon over chicken., Bake 15 minutes more or until chicken is done., Garnish with parsley, if desired.

title: Tuts Toffee
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Line a cookie sheet with aluminum foil. Arrange crackers, 7 across and 5 down., Melt butter with brown sugar, mix and pour over saltines., Bake 15 to 20 minutes (will bubble and harden when removed)., Sprinkle warm toffee with chocolate chips and spread with a spatula when melted., Sprinkle with nuts., Chill until firm., Peel off foil and break into pieces.

title: Betty'S Pecan Pie
directions: Mix together eggs, syrup, salt, vanilla, sugar and butter. Stir in nuts and pour into pastry shell., Bake at 400° for 15 minutes, then reduce heat to 350° and continue baking for 30 to 35 minutes., Filling should appear slightly less set in the center.

title: Hush Puppies
directions: Mix dry ingredients., Add remaining ingredients., Drop by small spoonfuls into deep, hot fat., Puppies float when done.

title: Candy Cane Popcorn Balls
directions: Keep popped corn in 225° oven., Butter sides of saucepan. Combine sugar, syrup, vinegar, 1 1/2 cups water and 1/2 teaspoon salt., Cook until hard-ball stage (250° on candy thermometer). Stir in vanilla., Slowly pour over corn; stir just to mix well. Butter hands; shape mixture into balls around candy., Makes 15 to 20.

title: Mountain Dew Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients together. Place in a bundt pan. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Broccoli Bake
directions: In 1 1/2-quart casserole, combine soup, milk, soy sauce and pepper., Stir in broccoli and 1/2 can of onions., Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 25 minutes., Top with remaining onions. Bake 5 minutes more.

title: Prune Whip
directions: Crook prunes as package label directs., Drain prunes, reserving liquid., Remove 1/2 cup cooked prunes for later., Puree remaining prunes in blender or food mill with 1/2 cup of cooking liquid., Add lemon juice., Let cool., With mixer at high speed, beat egg whites with salt until frothy., Gradually beat in sugar, beat until stiff peaks form., Add puree of prunes 1/4 cup at a time, beating well., Beat at high speed, 2 minutes., Chop remaining prunes and fold into mixture, along with 1/4 cup cream, whipped., Turn into 6 or 8 sherbet dishes., Refrigerate., Garnish each with a little whipped cream, if desire or serve with custard sauce., Makes 6 or 8 servings.

title: Chicken And Rice Casserole
directions: Dice chicken and and with mix rice and mushroom soup., Top with cheese., Heat until the casserole reaches 140 degrees and cheese is melted.

title: Fruit Cocktail Frosting
directions: Add the oleo, sugar and evaporated milk and let this boil slowly for 10 minutes, stirring often, then add nuts, coconut and vanilla., Cook for a couple minutes., Let it sit for about 10 minutes, then put on a warm cake.

title: Fried Green Tomatoes
directions: Cut tomatoes into 1/2-inch slices., Mix flour, salt, pepper and seasoned salt in one bowl., Mix eggs and milk in another bowl. Dip tomato slices into egg mixture, then into flour., Repeat again, coating well., Fry in hot oil until golden brown; drain on paper towels., Arrange on platter and enjoy!

title: Homemade Condensed Milk
directions: Combine all ingredients in a blender and process until smooth. This will make the same amount of milk as a can of condensed milk.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Mix all together in a bowl. Put in 3-quart casserole dish. Cover with aluminum foil and bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Sausage-Cheese Balls
directions: Fry sausage in skillet, stirring until crumbly and browned. Combine sausage, cheese, pepper and biscuit mix., Add water and mix well., Form into small balls., Place on cookie sheet and bake at 375° about 20 minutes or until lightly browned., Serve hot or cold., May be frozen before baking.

title: Porcupine Balls
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Mix rice, 1/2 cup water, onion, salts, garlic powder and pepper., Shape into balls., Place in ungreased baking dish., Mix remaining ingredients and pour over meatballs. Cover with foil and bake 45 minutes., Uncover and bake 15 minutes more.

title: Camper'S Fare Skillet Spaghetti
directions: Brown hamburger., Add salt and pepper., Pour off fat., Add all other ingredients to hamburger in a skillet., Cook until thickened, stirring occasionally, about 45 minutes to 1 hour. Serves 4.

title: Reese'S Peanut Butter Cookies
directions: Spray mini-muffin pan with Pam., Press cookie dough into muffin pan., Bake until done.

title: Rolls
directions: Let yeast dissolve in 1/4 cup warm water., Mix flour and liquid to form soft dough., Knead gently on floured board., Form dough in 12 small balls and place in muffin pan., Brush with oleo. Let double in size., Bake at 400° for 10 to 15 minutes., Makes 12 muffins.

title: Parmesan Chicken
directions: Mix the first 5 ingredients together., Dip skinned chicken in melted butter., Roll in dry mixture., Bake in a tinfoil lined baking dish at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Dill Dip
directions: Mix thoroughly and refrigerate.

title: Strawberry Salad
directions: Combine strawberry jello with 1 1/2 cups boiling water; mix. Add strawberries and bananas., Add pineapple; mix and layer with sour cream.

title: Apple Crisp 2
directions: Slice peeled apples into, a 1-quart buttered baking dish. Sprinkle with spices and lemon juice., Work together sugar, flour and butter until crumbly., Spread over the apples., Bake, uncovered, for 45 minutes in a moderate oven (375°), or until apples are tender., If mixture becomes dry while cooking, add a small amount of water., Serve cold with whipped cream or hot with plain cream., Serves 6 to 8.

title: Eight Layer Salad
directions: Layer in 9 x 13-inch pan., Top with shredded cheese.

title: Cherry Cheesecake
directions: Roll graham crackers fine., Heat margarine until melted and add sugar and cracker crumbs., Spread in 8 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish and bake 8 minutes at 350°., Set aside and cool., Mix the cream cheese and powdered sugar until creamy., Spread over baked crust., Spread the Cool Whip over the top of cream cheese and sugar mixture., Spoon cherry or strawberry pie filling on top of Cool Whip., Chill for 24 hours before serving.

title: Quick Coffee Cake
directions: Prepare cake mix by directions on package in 2 pans., Bake at 350° for 35 minutes., Dribble melted butter over warm cake. Combine sugar, coffee and cinnamon and sprinkle over cake. Chopped nuts may be added if desired.

title: Best Mashed Potatoes
directions: Boil potatoes in water about 20 minutes until fork-tender. Drain well. Return to pot. In saucepan beat milk and butter over low heat until butter melts. Stir in salt and pepper. Add to potatoes and mash with potato masher or mixer until smooth.

title: Creamy Coleslaw
directions: Mix together and refrigerate., Reduce 1/3 to 1/4 for family.

title: Taco Roll
directions: Brown meat. Mix taco seasoning as directed on package. On a baking sheet, roll out crescent rolls. Add hamburger meat and raw onions. Top with crescent rolls. Cover with cheese. Bake at 350° until brown. Serve with tomatoes, cheese, etc.

title: Shrimp Jambalaya
directions: Melt margarine in large skillet over medium heat., Saute onion and pepper until onion is transparent., Add tomatoes, rice, seasonings and water., Cook 10 minutes over medium heat., Cut shrimp in half lengthwise; add to skillet; mix well., Cook covered, stirring occasionally, until liquid is absorbed, about 20 minutes. Serves 4.

title: Cherry Dream Pie
directions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees., In a medium bowl, beat egg yolks; stir in Eagle Brand milk and lemon juice., Pour into crust; bake 8 minutes., Cool. Chill 3 hours or overnight.

title: Copper Pennies
directions: Dice and cook carrots until tender., Combine all the rest of the ingredients; heat to near boiling., Drain the carrots and mix into the sauce; let cool.

title: Chicken Broccoli Casserole
directions: Cook chicken and slice., Cook broccoli., Heat soup, mayo and curry powder., Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan., Place broccoli on bottom., Place chicken on top and cover with soup mixture and sprinkle with grated cheese., Three cups cooked rice can also be used as the first layer., Bake in 350° oven for 45 to 60 minutes.

title: Snowballs
directions: In large bowl combine all ingredients except confectioners sugar., With hands, mix until thoroughly blended., Refrigerate dough 30 minutes., Meanwhile, preheat oven to 375°., Form dough into 1 1/4-inch balls. Place 1 inch apart on ungreased cookie sheet; bake 15 to 20 minutes or until set, but not brown., Let stand 1 minute., Remove to wire racks; cool partially., Roll in confectioners sugar while still warm; roll again., Makes about 20.

title: Tuna Burgers
directions: Mix all ingredients in medium bowl by hand. Take a small handful and form into patty., Fry on medium-high with oil just covering bottom of pan. Fry until lightly brown., Makes 6 burgers.

title: Cheese Fondue
directions: In large pot on stove, rub a clove of, garlic, and, discard. Bring wine to bubble (not quite boil), and gradually add cheese (already, cut, and	tossed	with, cornstarch), stirring constantly., When cheese is melted, add spices, and, pour, into fondue pot., If too stringy when eating, increase heat.

title: Waffles
directions: Combine all dry ingredients., Mix everything but egg whites together., Beat egg whites and fold into batter., Makes about 12 waffles.

title: Cherry Crisp
directions: Mix dry ingredients until crumbly., Pat half of mixture into an 8 x 8-inch pan., Spread pie filling over mixture., Cover with other half of crumb mixture., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Ann Mcgill Erck'S Sour Cream Coffee Cake
directions: Cream, sugar,, butter, and eggs until smooth., Add sour cream and, vanilla., Sift, flour,, salt and baking powder and add., Pour half this batter into greased and floured tube pan. Add half, of topping of cinnamon, brown sugar and pecans., Add remaining batter and remaining topping., Bake 1 hour at 350°. Let, stand until, cool, enough, to, handle, and, unmold cake. Freezes well.

title: Chicken Broccoli Bake
directions: Cook chicken., Cut in chunks and put in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan., Cook broccoli according to directions; layer., Add cheese. Mix 1/2 cup milk with celery soup., Pour on top., Mix dressing according to directions and spread on top., Bake 1 hour at 350°.

title: Quick Fruit Salad
directions: In a large bowl, prepare 1 package of Jell-O as directions indicate., Add drained pineapple., Sprinkle remaining package of Jell-O over mixture., Stir in cottage cheese and Cool Whip., Blend until smooth., Refrigerate until set in 11 3/4 x 7 1/2 x 1 3/4-inch pan.

title: Chicken Roll Ups
directions: Cook soup, milk and grated cheese until cheese is melted. Pour in casserole dish., In each crescent roll, put a strip of chicken and a strip of cheese., Roll up and place on top of soup mixture., Cook in 350 degree oven until rolls are brown.

title: Cheeseburger Pie
directions: Grease pie pan. Brown meat and onion; drain. Add salt and pepper; spread into pan. Beat milk, Bisquick and eggs. Pour over meat. Bake 25 minutes at 350°, then add tomato sauce and cheese over top. Bake until knife inserted comes out clean, about 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Barbecued Spareribs
directions: Cut spareribs into servings., Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Place in a roaster pan and cover with onions., Combine remaining ingredients and pour over meat., Cover and bake 1 1/2 hours at 350°., Baste occasionally turning ribs once or twice., Remove cover from roaster during the last 15 minutes of baking to brown spareribs.

title: Mile High Strawberry Pie
directions: Use a large mixing bowl., Beat egg whites until stiff peaks form., Add sugar and cream of tartar very slowly to stiffly beaten egg whites., Slowly add the nearly unfrozen berries and juice to the egg white peaks., Beat on high with mixer for 15 minutes., Put into pie shell of your choosing and freeze., Add sliced berries and whipped cream for garnish before serving.

title: Broken Glass Dessert
directions: Make graham cracker crust., (Save some crumbs to sprinkle on top.), Combine ingredients for dessert.

title: Snacks
directions: Mix well the day before going to use., Turn several times to mix good., You can add 1/4 cup grated cheese or use cheese crackers.

title: Shrimp And Shells
directions: Cook macaroni. Rinse and drain. Combine with remaining ingredients in large bowl. Gently stir in dressing. Cover and chill at least 2 hours before serving.

title: Potato Casserole
directions: Mix together and top with 1 cup corn flakes., Dot with margarine., Bake 1 hour at 350°., Serves 8 to 10.

title: Meat Loaf With Zesty Topping
directions: Pour milk over bread crumbs., Add ground beef, salt, pepper, carrot, onion and eggs., Mix thoroughly., Pack in a 9 x 5-inch loaf pan.

title: Congo Bars
directions: Cream sugar, shortening and eggs., Add baking powder, salt and flour., Stir in chips and nuts., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes in a 10 x 14-inch pan.

title: Blonde Brownies
directions: Sift dry ingredients; set aside., Cream together all other ingredients; mix well and add to flour mixture., Add chocolate chips and nuts (optional)., Bake in preheated 350° oven for 30 minutes.

title: Barbecue Bake
directions: Brown ground beef and onion; drain., Stir in chilies and barbecue sauce., Spoon into 10 x 6-inch baking dish.

title: Tang Pie
directions: Mix Tang with Eagle Brand milk., Make sure Tang is dissolved and add sour cream and Cool Whip; mix well., Put in graham cracker pie crust.	Chill 2 to 3 hours.

title: Artichoke Dip
directions: Bake in oven for 25 to 30 minutes., Serve hot with crackers.

title: Cornbread Salad
directions: Chop the onions, tomatoes, green peppers and pickles and mix with the cornbread and bacon., Add pickle juice and mayonnaise to taste for the dressing.

title: Crunchy Fudge Sandwiches
directions: In a large saucepan, melt butterscotch flavored morsels and peanut butter over very low heat, stirring constantly until smooth. Stir in cereal., Press half of the mixture in buttered 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan., Chill., Set remaining mixture aside., Melt over hot (not boiling) water the chocolate morsels, sugar, margarine and water, stirring constantly until smooth., Spread over chilled cereal mixture., Spread remaining cereal mixture evenly over top. Press in gently., Chill until firm (1 hour)., Yields 25 squares (1 1/2 x 1 1/2-inch).

title: Boiled Raisin Cake
directions: Boil together 3 minutes the first 8 ingredients., Cool., Sift together the remaining ingredients., Add to first part and bake. Can be used at holiday time for fruit cake., Improves with time. Can be made ahead to season.

title: Lemon Krispies Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Stir together dry cake mix, butter and eggs in a mixing bowl., Stir in cereal., Roll dough into 1 1/2 inch balls., Place 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet., bake 8 to 10 minutes until edges are brown., Cool on cookie sheet before moving to a cooling rack.

title: Wacky Cake
directions: Sift together in mixing bowl first 5 ingredients., Add next 4 and stir until smooth., Pour into an ungreased 8x8 square pan. Bake at 350° for 35 minutes., Use any glaze or icing but must be iced and served from pan., If quantity is doubled bake in 9x13 pan.

title: Vegetable Chicken Pot Pie
directions: Combine the first 6 ingredients., Spoon into prepared pie crust., Cover with top crust; crimp edges to seal., Slit top crust and brush with egg, if desired., Bake at 375° for 40 minutes. Cool 10 minutes.

title: Chocolate Pie(Lo-Cal)
directions: Make and set aside.

title: Key Lime Pie
directions: Mix the first 3 ingredients and pour into crust., Refrigerate several hours.

title: Christmas Brunch Sour Cream Coffee Cake
directions: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs and vanilla., Sift the dry ingredients together and add to the butter mixture alternately with the sour cream., Pour half the batter into a buttered tube pan.

title: Scalloped Corn
directions: Melt butter (2 tablespoons)., Add flour and seasonings., Cook over low heat until bubbly., Slowly stir in milk., Heat to boiling., Stir in corn and egg., Pour into casserole dish; sprinkle with crumbs and butter., Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Apple Cobbler
directions: Melt margarine in an 8 x 11-inch Pyrex pan in oven., Combine apples, water and 1 cup sugar in a saucepan., Cook 3 to 4 minutes. Pour apples in pan with margarine., Sprinkle with cinnamon and nutmeg., Mix flour, baking powder, milk and 1 cup sugar., Pour over apples., Sprinkle with brown sugar and bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Hamburger Surprise
directions: Brown meat, onions and bell peppers in skillet. Drain excess fat. Add rice and diced cooked potatoes. Simmer for 20 minutes.

title: Chocolate Walnut Crinkles(Croatian)
directions: Chop raisins and walnuts finely., Melt chocolate., Blend together butter, sugar and vanilla until fluffy., Stir in raisins, nuts and chocolate., Mix until well blended.

title: Breakfast Souffle
directions: Brown and drain sausage., Beat eggs with milk, mustard and salt., Cube bread and layer with sausage and cheese in a 9 x 13-inch baking pan., Pour egg mixture over layers; cover with foil and refrigerate overnight., Bake 45 minutes at 350° (20 minutes with foil on and 25 minutes with foil off)., Do not overbake.

title: Curried Celery And Apples
directions: In a skillet, saute celery and onion in butter until crisp-tender, about 5 minutes. Stir in apple. Cover and simmer for 3 minutes. Sprinkle with flour, curry powder, salt and pepper. Cook for 2 minutes, stirring occasionally. Serve immediately. Yield: 4 servings.

title: Old Fashioned Peanut Butter Pie(Heritage Recipe)
directions: Dissolve cornstarch in 1/2 c. cold water, add rest of ingredients., Cook until thick and pour into baked crust., Use egg whites for meringue., Makes 2 pies.

title: Wild Rice Soup
directions: Saute onions and celery in nonstick skillet sprayed with Pam. Combine flour with 1/2 cup of the broth in a small jar with a lid. Shake until there are no lumps., Add to kettle and slowly add rest of broth and milk., Stir over medium heat until thickened. Add cooked wild rice and chicken., Heat to serving temperature. Makes 6 (1 cup) servings.

title: Buffalo Potatoes
directions: Preheat oven to 450°., In 13 x 9-inch baking or roasting pan, blend onion soup mix, butter and pepper sauce., Add potatoes and turn to coat., Bake, stirring occasionally 45 minutes or until potatoes are crisp., Serve with dressing., Makes 4 servings.

title: Fruit Dip
directions: Mix together and refrigerate.

title: Almond Bark Candy
directions: Melt together over low heat or on 50% power in microwave the almond bark and peanut butter., In large bowl, mix peanuts, marshmallows and Rice Krispies., Pour melted mixture over and mix all together., Drop by teaspoonfuls onto waxed paper., Refrigerate to set., These freeze well.

title: Taco Salad
directions: Brown ground beef; drain., Add beans with liquid., Add salt and taco seasoning to taste., Simmer 10 minutes., Drain off all liquids and cool., Chill before serving., Gently toss the lettuce, tomatoes, dressing, cheese and chips together., Stir in meat and bean mixture.

title: Fried Dwaine-Feast Breakfast(Fried Potatoes, Fried Apples, Fried Saucy Grits, Fried Eggs)
directions: Fried Potatoes:, Fry potatoes, onion, bell pepper and garlic on medium heat in just enough oil to keep potatoes from sticking (3 to 4 tablespoons of oil): season with salt and pepper.

title: Cake Mix Cookies
directions: Mix together all ingredients until dough is formed; drop by spoonfuls on ungreased cookie sheet., Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Dump Cake
directions: Dump pineapple and pie filling in bottom of oblong pan., Mix and spread evenly over bottom., Sprinkle dry cake mix evenly over those., Pour melted margarine over cake mix., Sprinkle evenly with coconut and then pecans., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Spider Sandwiches
directions: With a 2 1/2-inch round cutter, cut a circle from each bread slice., Spread about 2 tablespoons of peanut butter on half of bread rounds; top with remaining bread rounds., Make 2 small indentations on top of sandwiches for "eyes"., Using peanut butter as glue, push one raisin into each indentation.

title: Dried Beef Casserole
directions: Into greased casserole, put soup and milk., Stir and add rest of ingredients; stir., Store, covered, 3 to 4 hours or overnight in refrigerator., Bake at 350° for 1 hour, uncovering the last 10 minutes to brown.

title: Butterscotch Oaties
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Combine butterscotch morsels and butter; melt over boiling water., Remove from heat., Mix boiling water with baking soda and add to butterscotch mixture., Gradually blend in the remaining ingredients., Drop by slightly rounded teaspoonfuls onto ungreased baking sheet., Bake at 350° for 10 minutes., Makes 5 dozen cookies.

title: Baked Fruit
directions: Mix first 4 ingredients in a large bowl. Pour into a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Place mandarin orange segments on top of mixed fruit, being careful not to break the segments. Pour mandarin orange liquid over all fruit. Cover with foil and bake for 1 hour at 350°.

title: Sweet Cucumber Pickles
directions: Mix the plain salt with enough water to cover cucumbers., Put a weight on cucumbers to keep under water. Stir every day for 15 days. Remove, wash and slice. Soak overnight in alum water to cover. Rinse 3 times., Cover with vinegar., Let set overnight. Remove cucumbers and throw away the vinegar., Layer cucumbers, sugar and spices in crock., Cover. In a few days enough syrup will be made to cover pickles., Put in jars. Do not have to be sealed.

title: Meat Loaf
directions: Mix everything with 1/2 of the tomato soup., Put in loaf pan. Pour rest of tomato soup on top., Sprinkle with Mozzarella cheese. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Strawberry Bread
directions: Thaw berries., Mix undrained berries, eggs and oil., Sift dry ingredients into strawberry mixture, reserving about 1/2 cup flour to sprinkle over nuts., Blend thoroughly., Add flour to nuts, coating well., Add to batter., Pour into 2 well-greased and floured 9 x 5-inch loaf pans., Bake at 350° for 1 hour., If top browns too quickly, cover with tent-shaped aluminum foil., Yield: 2 loaves.

title: Banana Bread
directions: Cream butter and sugar together. Beat eggs and combine with butter mix. Add bananas, beat well. Mix all dry ingredients together and combine to beaten mixture. Add nuts. Grease and flour two loaf pans. Divide mixture between loaf pans and bake at 350 degree for about 45 minutes or until lightly brown and done.

title: Monster Bars
directions: Mix in order given., Spread on greased cookie sheet pan., Makes 2 (10 1/2 x 15 1/2-inch) pans and 1 (8 x 8-inch) pan or something similar., Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.

title: Crazy Salsa Dip
directions: Melt Velveeta cheese in saucepan; add salsa., Melt together, then add green onion (chopped up)., Pour over soft tortillas or chips.

title: Swiss 'N Chicken Casserole
directions: Heat oven to 350°. Mix all ingredients except walnuts. Spoon into 2-quart casserole; sprinkle with walnuts. Bake 40 minutes or until thoroughly heated. Makes 6 servings.

title: Chocolate Balls
directions: Mix the first 6 ingredients., Roll into small uniform balls. Chill., Melt the paraffin and the chocolate chips in double boiler., Dip balls in this, kept warm., Chill, then refrigerate to keep for serving.

title: Strawberry Delight
directions: Break angel food cake in small pieces., Layer in pan., Dissolve jello in hot water., Allow to thicken slightly., Add berries to jello, pour over cake and chill., Mix instant pudding, then whip together with ice cream., Pour this over jello cake., Chill until firm, then cover with Cool Whip., Delicious!

title: Cucumber Dill Dip
directions: In medium bowl, beat cream cheese until smooth., Stir in mayonnaise, cucumbers, green onions, lemon juice, dill and hot pepper sauce., Cover and chill., Serve with fresh vegetables, crackers or chips.

title: Chicken-A-La-Can-Can
directions: Combine soup, water and chicken., Add dry rice and 1/2 can French fried onions., Stir to mix., Pour in buttered casserole. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes., Sprinkle remaining onions on top; bake 15 minutes more.

title: Baked Pineapple
directions: Combine juice, flour and sugar., Put in cheese and pineapple. Put mixture into casserole dish., Mix Ritz crackers and melted butter., Put on top., Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

title: Scalloped Corn
directions: Mix all ingredients. Pour into casserole dish, top with more cracker crumbs. Bake at 350° for about 45 minutes.

title: Zucchini Bread
directions: Grease loaf pans and line bottoms with waxed paper., Use 2 regular pans (9 5/8 x 5 1/2 x 2 3/4-inch) or 6 mini pans (5 1/2 x 3 x 2 1/4-inch).

title: Rhubarb Custard Pie
directions: Mix first 6 ingredients together and let stand until you mix and roll out single pie crust., Fill pie crust and bake 15 to 20 minutes at 425°; turn down temperature to 350° and continue to bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until knife comes out clean.

title: Christmas Holly Wreaths
directions: Melt marshmallows and oleo over low heat, add coloring and cornflakes., Using, tablespoon, put some mixture on it., Drop onto waxed paper and dip hands into water and shape into wreaths. Decorate with red hots., Makes about 24 wreaths.

title: My Mom'S Roast Beef
directions: Place meat in an 8 x 12-inch cake pan lined with foil paper (enough to be able to wrap meat after all ingredients have been put in)., Place on top of meat the onion, green pepper, bay leaves, garlic and mushrooms., Add tomato soup straight from the can on top of ingredients, then add ketchup., Wrap meat up with foil., Bake in oven at 350° for 2 1/2 to 3 hours.

title: Pineapple Delight
directions: Tear up angel food cake and lay in bottom of 9 x 13 pan., In large bowl, cream the cream cheese., Add pudding and milk and mix for 1 minute., Stir in drained pineapple., Pour mixture over cake and top with Cool Whip., Refrigerate for several hours or overnight.

title: Hot Spiced Tea
directions: In a saucepan, mix all ingredients together and bring to a boil., Reduce heat, cover and simmer for 15 minutes., Strain and serve., Yield: 8 servings, 77 calories.

title: Wonderful Banana Pudding
directions: Mix pudding as directed on box less 1/3 milk; set aside., Line 9 x 13-inch dish with vanilla wafers, side and bottom., Layer bananas, fold Cool Whip into pudding mixture., Pour over vanilla wafers and bananas., Crush about 1 c. wafers and sprinkle on top. Chill and serve.

title: Prune Cake
directions: Mix ingredients and bake at 375° for 45 to 50 minutes., Cake can be baked in Bundt pan or made as cupcakes.

title: Frozen Pink Salad
directions: Thoroughly mix cream cheese, mayonnaise and sugar together. Add marshmallows, pecans and fruit cocktail., Add desired amount of red food color to the whipped cream., Fold in colored whipped cream., Freeze in thin layer in serving dish., Cut into small squares before serving., Serve frozen or only partially thawed. (This was served on a restaurant buffet on Sundays.)

title: Fireman Hash Casserole
directions: In a large skillet cook ground beef until crumbly., Drain off fat., Add onions and green pepper., Cook until they are tender. Stir in tomatoes, rice, chili powder, salt and pepper., Mix well. Pour into a 2-quart casserole dish.

title: Mexican Salad
directions: Mix the first five ingredients together., Brown hamburger. Drain and mix with taco seasoning mix and 1/2 cup water., Simmer 5 minutes., Let cool, then add to salad.

title: Asparagus Salad
directions: Heat soup to boiling., Remove from heat and add Jell-O., Stir until dissolved., Add cream cheese and mix until well blended. Stir in remaining ingredients., Chill.

title: Creamed Spinach
directions: Beat eggs in large bowl., Add cottage cheese, grated Cheddar, butter, spinach, flour, salt and pepper., Pour into 2-quart buttered casserole., Bake on low, uncovered, for 1 hour at 350°. Yields 12 to 14 servings.

title: Elegant Chicken Breast
directions: Slightly cook bacon., Wrap one piece around each breast. Place in 13 x 9 x 2-inch dish., Mix butter and Worcestershire sauce., Pour over chicken; sprinkle mushrooms and scallions over top., Bake uncovered at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes, basting once or twice.

title: Gold Coast Cape Cod
directions: Fill a tall glass with ice., Put in vodka., Add cranberry juice to top., Squeeze in lime and stir., Serves 1.

title: Frozen Fruit Medley
directions: Drain apricots and pineapple, reserving 1 cup of the combined liquid., Combine the liquid with the apricots, pineapple and remaining ingredients., Spoon into cupcake papers put in muffin tins., Freeze until solid, then package cups in freezer bags. Remove from the freezer 20 minutes before serving to partially thaw., Makes 30 servings.

title: Slow-Cooked Tamale Casserole
directions: In a skillet, cook beef over medium heat until no longer pink; drain. In a bowl, combine the egg, milk and cornmeal until smooth. Add corn, tomatoes, olives, chili seasoning, seasoned salt and beef. Transfer to a greased slow cooker. Cover and cook on high for 3 hours and 45 minutes. Sprinkle with cheese; cover and cook 15 minutes longer or until cheese is melted. Yield: 6 servings.

title: Low-Fat Cucumber Salad
directions: Dissolve Jell-O in water; let slightly thicken., Add rest of ingredients., Store in refrigerator.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
directions: Boil the sweet potatoes until tender, about 30 minutes. Remove the skin, mash the pulp., Add the fruit juice and margarine and whip mixture until fluffy., Add the nutmeg, brown sugar substitute and cinnamon., Spray a baking dish with non-stick spray., Pour mixture into pan and bake for 25 to 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Veg-All Chicken Pie
directions: Combine first six ingredients., Spoon into prepared deep dish pie crust., Place second crust on top., Seal the edges of the crust., Bake at 375° for 40 minutes.

title: Salmon Cutlets
directions: Remove bones and skin from salmon; mash with fork., Add potatoes, salt, pepper and beaten egg., Mix well., Form into cutlets., Roll in crumbs., Heat oil and fry., Drain on absorbent paper.

title: Baked Rabbit
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Add seasonings to flour., Add rabbit. Heat oil., Add rabbit; brown on both sides., In casserole dish, add rabbit, mushrooms, milk, butter and onion., Cover with foil; cook for about 1 hour.

title: Chicken Spaghetti
directions: Remove chicken from bone., Cook spaghetti in chicken broth. Remove spaghetti from broth., Cook onions, pepper and celery until tender., Pour in tomatoes and cheese., Mix all ingredients together., Put in large casserole dish., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Icebox Cookies
directions: Cream sugars and margarine; add eggs and stir well., Stir in vanilla., Add all dry ingredients and mix well., Shape dough into 2 logs., Refrigerate overnight., Slice and bake at 325° for 12 minutes.

title: No-Peek Chicken Or Pork Chops
directions: Mix the soup, water and rice and put in a 9 X 13 pan. Put chicken or pork chops on top. Sprinkle with the onion soup mix. Bake at 350° for about 12 hours.

title: Vegetable Pizza
directions: Pat crescent rolls onto pizza pan or cookie sheet to look like pizza crust., Bake as directed on can., Cool.

title: Chicken Drummettes
directions: Combine all ingredients and pour over chicken., Soak for 5 to 6 hours or overnight., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes., Drain marinade and cook at 450° for 15 minutes.

title: Cheese Ball
directions: Toast the English muffins (the longer you toast them, the crunchier your pizza "crust" will be)., Add desired amount of pizza sauce to each muffin., Add toppings and cheese (keep in mind that some meats like sausage or beef should be cooked before you put them on your pizza)., Bake your mini-pizzas for 5 to 8 minutes at 350°, or until your cheese melts, or heat in the microwave. The time will vary based on the number of pizzas you are heating and the amount of topping on each pizza., Do not heat too long! They should be heated through when cheese is melted.

title: Asparagus Casserole
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Layer asparagus, peas and potatoes alternately in an 8 x 8-inch pan., Melt the margarine, milk and undiluted soup., Mix well and pour over top. Crumble saltines and sprinkle on top. Sprinkle with a little cheese., Bake at 350° until bubbly, about 45 minutes.

title: Broccoli Supreme Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients together and refrigerate for at least 1 hour before serving.

title: Mexican Corn Casserole
directions: In large bowl combine all ingredients., Saute onions in a skillet with a small amount of oil., Add onions to the rest of the ingredients and mix well., Pour mixture into a greased 13 x 9-inch pan or large casserole dish., Top with cheese., Bake in oven for 30 to 40 minutes or until firm at 350°.

title: Cranberry Salad
directions: In a saucepan, dissolve the gelatin in boiling water and stir in the orange rind and cranberry sauce. Refrigerate the mixture until it is thickened. Remove from the refrigerator and stir in the pineapple, celery and pecans. Pour the mixture into a lightly oiled 1 1/2-quart mold. Refrigerate the salad until it is firm. Unmold the salad on the lettuce leaves. Serves 10 to 12.

title: Pecan Pie
directions: Mix together., Pour into unbaked pie shell., Bake 1 hour in 350° oven.

title: Beatrice Stuffed Bell Peppers
directions: Boil the peppers in water until soft., Melt margarine in a large saucepan. Add onion, bell pepper, celery, garlic and parsley. Simmer until tender., Add ground meat to mixture., Cook ground meat until brown. Add shrimp and crab meat., Cook for 15 minutes. Add bread crumbs. Add salt and pepper to taste. Stuff cooled peppers. Sprinkle bread crumbs on top. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes. Serves 4. Contains 375 calories.

title: Mexican Beef Skillet
directions: Prepare macaroni as on package; drain., In large skillet, combine green pepper, garlic and beef; cook until beef is brown and vegetables tender., Drain., Stir in tomatoes, sauce, corn, olives and salt., Add macaroni; mix well., Stir in cheese., Serves 6 to 8.

title: Sesame Curry Sauce(Use To Brush Over Chicken, Meat Or Fish When Grilling.)
directions: Combine in a screw-top jar., Shake well., Brush over grilled items.

title: Mexican Chicken And Rice
directions: Heat oil in a large skillet on medium-high heat. Add chicken, onion and pepper. Cook and stir until chicken is cooked through. Add corn, broth and salsa. Bring to a boil., Stir in rice. Cover. Remove from heat. Let stand 5 minutes., Sprinkle with cheese. Cover., Let stand 2 minutes or until cheese melts., Makes 4 servings.

title: Cocoa Cola Cake
directions: Mix in large mixing bowl the sugar, flour and baking soda. Mix the butter, Coca Cola, and cocoa in a saucepan and bring to a full rolling boil., Add the hot mixture to the dry ingredients and stir., Add the buttermilk, eggs and marshmallows to the mixture. Mix all well., Pour into a greased 13 x 9 inch baking pan and bake for 30 - 35 minutes at 350°.

title: Poor Man Pie
directions: Brown hamburger meat., Season to taste - onions optional to brown with hamburger., Drain meat., Place back in skillet., Layer up with corn (either whole or cream) and green beans (drained). Top with mashed potatoes., Garnish with cheese on top., Bake approximately 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Dog Bone Treats
directions: Mix all ingredients in a large bowl until well blended., Roll the dough out on a floured board., Cut out treats with a dog bone shaped cookie cutter., Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes, or until dry.

title: Shanghai Chow Mein
directions: Saute chicken chunks in oil until firm., Stir in celery and cook 2 minutes., (Should be crispy.), Add vegetables, soup and soy sauce., Stir in onions., Heat through and serve over rice., Top with noodles.

title: Pecan Pie
directions: Dissolve Karo and sugar., Heat thoroughly until blended., Beat eggs; add butter, pecans and vanilla., Mix together with Karo and pour into unbaked pie shell., Bake in medium hot oven.

title: Chicken Rollatini
directions: Rinse and pat dry cutlets., Dip each cutlet in bread crumbs, shaking off excess., Put breaded cutlets on flat surface and place slice of Mozzarella cheese and slice of ham on each cutlet., Roll up cutlets and fasten each one with a toothpick.

title: Crawfish Etouffee
directions: Saute onions and celery in margarine until soft., Add everything, including fat which adds much of the flavor, except the crawfish tails and simmer for 10 minutes, sprinkling the flour over the contents of the pan., This is to give the sauce a little body and you can add more, if you like., Now, add the crawfish tails and water (2 cups or more, depending on the fact you may need to serve 2 or more additional persons); simmer for 15 minutes., Serve over cooked rice.

title: Holiday Cauliflower
directions: Bread cauliflower into medium sized flowerets; cook in boiling water until tender, about 10 minutes., Drain well; set aside., In saucepan, saute mushrooms in butter., Blend in flour gradually. Stir in milk., Cook, stirring constantly, over medium heat until thick., Stir in salt, cheese and pimento., Place 1/2 of cauliflower in buttered 2-quart casserole., Cover with 1/2 the sauce., Add remaining cauliflower and top with remaining sauce. Bake at 325° for 15 minutes.

title: Miracle Pie
directions: Put all ingredients in blender; mix, then pour into two 8-inch pie pans (greased and floured)., Bake at 350° for 60 minutes., A crust will form on bottom, pie filling in center and coconut on top.

title: Punch
directions: Combine all ingredients in punch bowl and serve., Yields 25 to 30 cups.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Cook broccoli according to package directions; drain them. Mix in all ingredients except stuffing and margarine., Pour into a 2-quart casserole dish., Top with stuffing and dot with margarine. Bake 45 minutes at 350°.

title: Apple Goodie
directions: Mix first 4 ingredients., Put in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Cover with remaining ingredients mixed together., Bake 45 minutes at 350°.

title: Pie Crust For Double Crust
directions: Mix flour and salt together in a bowl. Add the shortening and mix it into the flour and salt with a fork or your fingertips until the mixture has the texture of coarse crumbs. Mix in the water, a little at a time. Refrigerate to chill before rolling out the dough.

title: Corn Potato Bake
directions: Peel and cut potatoes for cooking., Cook until almost done. Transfer to casserole; add corn and salt and pepper to taste. Cover top with grated cheese., Bake until brown in a 350° oven.

title: Icing Or Fudge
directions: Cook first four ingredients over low heat until margarine melts., Bring to a hard boil., Boil for 1 minute., Take off burner and add 1 teaspoon of vanilla., Beat until almost thick., Add nuts (if desired) for fudge.

title: Spicy Molasses Cookies
directions: Combine flour, soda and spices., Beat butter, sugars, egg and molasses., Then add dry ingredients., Use a cookie press on cold ungreased cookie sheet., Bake at 400° for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Hot Creole Seafood Dip
directions: In a small skillet, melt butter over medium-high heat., Add bell pepper and green onions and saute 3 minutes., Set aside.

title: Salmon Corn Chowder
directions: In large saucepan, combine potatoes, onion, celery, broth, garlic and marjoram., Bring to boil; reduce heat and simmer, covered, about 10 minutes., Stir in milk and oleo., Combine flour and corn; stir into soup., Heat, but do not boil, until slightly thickened., Gently stir in salmon and heat through., Serves 6 to 8.

title: Mucho Nacho Salad
directions: Brown ground beef and cool., Chop lettuce, tomatoes and onion. Mix, then add shredded Cheddar cheese and creamy Ranch dressing. Sprinkle more cheese on top., Serve with nacho chips., May be crushed and added to each individual salad or served on the side. Use salsa to suit your taste., This makes a very large main salad.

title: Chess Pie
directions: Bake at 400° and then at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Lasagna
directions: Boil noodles and brown hamburger., Blend Ricotta cheese with seasonings and egg., In greased 9-inch square pan, alternate layers of noodles, sauce, Ricotta cheese mixture and Mozzarella cheese, ending with sauce., Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes., Let stand 15 minutes before serving.

title: Broccoli Supreme
directions: Cook broccoli until tender, 10 to 15 minutes; drain., Put in bottom of baking dish., Mix the next 7 ingredients., Place on top of broccoli., Melt butter and mix with bread crumbs; put on top of mixture., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Tea Cakes(Old Recipe)
directions: Beat sugar, Crisco and egg together. Add soda and baking powder to buttermilk and stir until it foams. Add to other mixture. Add vanilla and flour., Roll out and cut cookies., Bake in a, 400° oven.

title: Sausage Cheese Dip
directions: Brown sausage and ground meat., Drain and add melted cheese mixture., Heat in crock-pot.

title: Cheese Ball
directions: Mix all ingredients and mold into a ball; let set overnight. Can roll in chopped pecans.

title: Seafood Lasagna
directions: Cook lasagna noodles according to package directions; drain. Arrange 4 noodles in bottom of greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish., Cook onion in butter until tender; blend in cream cheese. Stir in cottage cheese, egg, basil, 1/2 teaspoon salt and 1/8 teaspoon pepper; spread half atop noodles., Combine soup, milk and wine., Stir in shrimp and crab; spread half over cottage cheese layer., Repeat layers., Sprinkle with Parmesan., Bake, uncovered, in a 350° oven for 45 minutes., Top with shredded sharp cheese. Bake 2 to 3 minutes more., Let stand 15 minutes before serving. Makes 12 servings., (Garnish with tomato, parsley and extra shrimp.)

title: Lo-Cal Strawberry Pie
directions: Spray pie pan with Pam., Make graham cracker crumbs and mix with margarine, cinnamon and 2 Equal., Press into pie pan., Bake 5 minutes at 350°., Mix water and cornstarch., Bring to boil (don't boil) and set aside., Into hot mixture, add Jell-O., When mixture cools, add 6 packages Equal., Put aside and cool 30 minutes., Add strawberries and pour into baked and cooled crust., Chill., Makes 4 servings., Each serving equals 1 fruit, 1 bread, 3/4 fat and 38 additional calories.

title: Suzy'S Key Lime Pie
directions: Mix milk until well blended with lime juice., Mix in Cool Whip (may add a few drops of green food color) and pour into pie shell. Chill in refrigerator until set.

title: Carrot Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Grease and flour a 10-inch Bundt pan. In a large bowl, mix flour, sugar, brown sugar, baking soda, cinnamon and salt., In a small bowl, beat eggs slightly; stir in orange juice, salad oil and vanilla., Stir egg mixture, carrots, raisins, nuts and apples into flour mixture just until flour is moistened., Pour batter into pan., Bake 50 to 55 minutes., Cool in pan 10 minutes; remove cake from pan and cool completely.

title: Green Pepper And Mushroom Chili
directions: In a large saucepan brown hamburger with onion, green pepper and garlic; drain., Add remaining ingredients and bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cover and simmer 30 minutes, stirring occasionally. Makes 8 servings.

title: Dip For Fresh Vegetables
directions: Mix sour cream or yogurt with salad dressing., Serve with veggies.

title: Fresh Green Beans And Vinaigrette
directions: Blend all ingredients together in covered container and shake well.

title: Wyoming Whopper Cookies
directions: Melt butter over low heat., Blend in sugar, eggs and peanut butter; mix until smooth., Add oats, soda, raisins and chocolate chips (mixture will be sticky)., Drop on greased baking sheet with large spoon., Flatten slightly., Bake at 350° for 15 minutes for large cookies., Remove to cooling rack., Yields 2 dozen cookies.

title: Jalapeno Cornbread
directions: Bake for about 30 to 45 minutes at 425°.

title: Fruit Cake Cookies
directions: Mix fruit in flour to coat., Add salt, coconut and pecans. Add Eagle Brand; mix well., Drop by spoonfuls on greased cookie sheet., Bake at 275° for 25 minutes., Cool completely., Store in airtight container about 5 days before serving., Makes 4 dozen.

title: Shrimp Creole
directions: Melt shortening. Blend in flour and brown, stirring constantly. Add water gradually and cook until thick, stirring constantly. Add remaining ingredients, except rice. Cover and simmer 20 minutes. Remove bay leaves. Serve over rice. Serves 6.

title: Chicken Green Enchiladas
directions: Mix shredded chicken and 1/2 cup green enchilada sauce in saucepan., Fry tortillas in vegetable oil until medium fry., Dip tortilla in green enchilada sauce., Scoop chicken; sprinkle cheese inside and roll tortilla., Repeat steps for each tortilla., Put enchiladas in tray and spread leftover enchilada sauce on top. Sprinkle cheese on top.

title: Cocoa Cream Pie
directions: Mix cocoa, cornstarch, sugar and salt., Slightly beat egg yolks., Add to mixture and milk., Cook until thick; stir constantly., Add flavoring., Pour into pie shell., Cover with meringue.

title: Honey Bars(Uncooked)
directions: Grind raisins and nuts., Mix with honey and press into sheet 1/2-inch thick., Cover and place weight on top for 24 hours., Cut into bars., Roll in white or colored coconut.

title: Shrimp Scampi
directions: Place shrimp in a single layer in a 15 x 10 x 1-inch jelly roll pan., Set aside., Combine next 8 ingredients., Pour over shrimp., Bake at 450° for 5 minutes or until shrimp is done.

title: Flag Salad
directions: Dissolve red raspberry Jell-O in 3 1/2 cups water., Chill until firm., Use 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Pierogi Casserole
directions: Make mashed potatoes with potatoes and part of milk., Save remaining milk for cheese sauce., Cook noodles 10 minutes; rinse with warm water and set aside., Cook margarine, milk, onion and cheese until melted., In 9 x 13-inch greased pan, add 1/2 of noodles., Spread in pan., Add not quite 1/2 of cheese sauce. Spread evenly., Add mashed potatoes on top of noodles and cheese. Add remaining noodles and cheese sauce., Bake at 350° until golden brown or 30 minutes.

title: Quick And Easy Potatoes Au Gratin
directions: Peel and cube potatoes., Place in a well-greased 1 1/2-quart casserole., Sprinkle with flour and pour milk to cover., Stir potatoes with a fork so that all are well coated with flour and milk., Sprinkle with salt and pepper., Cover with the grated cheese and dot with butter., Bake, covered, at 350° for 1 hour. Serves 4.

title: Dream Salad
directions: Sprinkle Jell-O over Cool Whip; mix well., Stir in remaining ingredients; chill.

title: Mayonnaise
directions: Mix egg, mustard, salt, sugar, cayenne, tarragon and dill in blender., Add slowly the oil., Blend again until thick.

title: Pumpkin Nut Roll
directions: Beat eggs and sugar 5 minutes., Mix together pumpkin and lemon juice and add to first mixture., Sift together flour, baking powder, cinnamon, ginger, nutmeg and salt and add., Spread evenly in a jelly roll pan which has been greased and floured. Line the pan with wax paper. Sprinkle walnuts over the batter. Bake at 375° for 10 to 15 minutes. Sprinkle a dish towel with powdered sugar.

title: Italian Lemon Chicken
directions: Preheat oven to 400°., Combine all ingredients except chicken. Lay chicken in a 13 x 9-inch baking pan., (Use 2 pans, if necessary.), Pour ingredient mixture over chicken., Add water, enough water to cover chicken., Bake in oven for 15 minutes at 400°., Turn oven down to 350° and bake for another 45 minutes.

title: Chicken And Scampi
directions: Boil chicken quickly., Separate into serving pieces or strips. Cover with spaghetti sauce mix (I use Giant's brand)., Add vegetables., Simmer on stove or in oven., Just before time to serve, add prepared shrimp (the amount and size you can afford that week)!, Cook 3 or 4 minutes., Serve on rice.

title: Caramel Candy
directions: Heat mixture in an iron pot until it starts to boil and lower flame to simmer., Heat sugar in iron pot until sugar melts. Cook the mixture in an aluminum pot until soft ball stage., Beat well. Add the nuts and pour into buttered platter.

title: Cajun Jambalaya
directions: Brown sausage in large, deep pot., Remove and add chicken. Cook chicken until done., Remove., Throw in vegetables and ham and cook until tender., Add spices., Add sausage and debone chicken. Stir thoroughly., Add water to cover., Bring to boil; turn down and cover., Cook about 20 minutes until rice is done., Stir occasionally to avoid sticking., Serve with salad and garlic bread., A Louisiana favorite!

title: Camel Droppings
directions: Mix together butter, cherries, nuts, coconut and powdered sugar., Form balls; chill., Melt paraffin and chocolate chips. Dip balls and chill.

title: Easy Egg Custard
directions: Mix well with whisk., Pour in custard cups., Bake at 325° until golden brown.

title: Cheese Vegetable Soup
directions: Cook carrots and onion in boiling water until tender., Stir in soup, milk, cheese and Worcestershire sauce., Stir over low heat until cheese melts., Garnish with parsley., Serves 6 to 8.

title: Lipton'S Party Puffs
directions: Preheat oven to 425°., Cut each biscuit into 4 sections., In saucepan, melt butter., Over very low heat, stir in Lipton Onion Soup Mix and biscuits; gently toss just until light golden., On a cookie sheet lined with brown paper, place biscuits;, bake 5 minutes., Serve hot., Makes 40 puffs., Variation:, Roll baked puffs in Parmesan cheese before serving.

title: Fluffy Stuffed Potatoes
directions: Bake potatoes, in, a 12-inch Dutch oven for 1 hour with 12 coals on top and 10 coals on bottom., Cut baked potatoes in half lengthwise., Scoop	out, potato and mash with milk, sour cream, margarine,	chives,, salt and pepper., Mound back into shells. Add, grated, cheese, on, top., Sprinkle with paprika. Place in Dutch oven., Bake 25 minutes with 14 coals on top and 12 coals on bottom.

title: Coco-Lopez Coconut Cake
directions: Cook cake by directions on package; use 13 x 9-inch pan. While still warm punch holes in cake and pour a can of Eagle Brand milk over cake, then cool and pour 1 cup Coco Lopez over cake. Spread on a large container of Cool Whip., Sprinkle coconut on top., Refrigerate.

title: Cold Cucumber Salad
directions: Mix vinegar, salt, celery seed and sugar until dissolved. Pour over rest and put in covered dish., Place in refrigerator. Wait 24 hours before eating., Good for a summer cook out.

title: Never Fail Chocolate Cake
directions: Blend well., Place in a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Place in oven. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Garlic And Cheese Biscuits
directions: Melt butter and mix into all ingredients., Stir and drop onto baking sheet., Bake at 400° until browned on top., If desired, brush on butter and sprinkle with parsley.

title: Fruit Dump Cake
directions: Mix fruit, tapioca and sugar; set aside., Combine the two cake mixes., Add oil, eggs and water and mix well by hand., Add fruit mixture and blend well., (Mixture will be thick and sticky.) Spoon into greased and floured pans (4 round or 2 rectangular) and spread evenly., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Breakfast Casserole
directions: Beat the eggs., Melt the Velveeta cheese and margarine together., Add to eggs and scramble., Brown and drain sausage. Saute onion and green pepper together slightly., Into a 9 x 13-inch pan, layer half of egg mixture, half of sausage, half of onion-green pepper mixture and 1 cup shredded cheese., (Do this procedure again, ending with shredded cheese.), Sprinkle with paprika., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes, covered., Remove cover and bake an additional 15 to 20 minutes, until set-up.

title: Butter Bean Casserole
directions: Mix the first 5 ingredients together., Combine crackers and butter, sprinkle over casserole., Bake at 350° for 20-25 minutes.

title: Bran 'N Beef Stroganoff
directions: In large bowl beat egg until foamy., Stir in milk, Bran Flakes, salt, pepper and paprika., Let stand 1 to 2 minutes., Add ground beef, mixing until combined., Form into 20 (1 1/2-inch) meatballs. Bake in 400° oven about 15 minutes; drain.

title: Orange Slush(Similar To Orange Julius)
directions: Blend the first 5 ingredients in blender., Add ice cubes 2 at a time., Beverage should be slushy., Makes 4 servings.

title: Tomato French Dressing
directions: Mix in electric blender., Makes about 1 1/2 cups.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Melt shortening; mix with oatmeal., Combine egg with sugar and add oatmeal mixture., Stir soda into milk., Add flour to first mixture alternately with milk., Add flavoring and cinnamon., Stir in floured nuts or raisins., Drop by teaspoonfuls onto greased cookie sheets., Bake in a 375° oven until lightly browned, about 15 minutes.

title: Nut Cake
directions: Blend eggs, butter, margarine, sugar and vanilla flavoring. Add flour. Blend in applesauce. Roll nuts in flour. Blend in nuts and coconut. Cook at 250° for 4 hours.

title: Salmon Loaf
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Grease loaf pan., Blend egg into salmon. Stir in remaining ingredients., Spoon into pan., Pat into shape. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until top is golden brown., Garnish with lemon wedges.

title: Ham Loaf
directions: Shape in loaf and bake at 300° for 1 1/2 hours.

title: 7-Up Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Prepare four 9-inch round cake pans. Mix all ingredients., Pour equally into the 4 cake pans., Bake for about 25 to 30 minutes or until tests done., While layers bake, prepare the filling., Cool layers after baking., Stack layers, spreading filling between and on top.

title: Rudolph Sandwiches
directions: Make a peanut butter and jelly sandwich., Cut it diagonally. Place 2 raisins on the wide side of the bread for eyes, a cherry on the tip of the triangle for the nose and pretzels for the antlers., (Use peanut butter to "glue" the trimmings.)

title: Creamy Corn Chowder
directions: In medium saucepot, saute bacon until lightly brown., Remove bacon and drain., Saute onion and red pepper., Cook 3 to 5 minutes, stirring often., Stir in flour., Gradually stir in milk, corn, Worcestershire sauce, salt and pepper., Bring just to boiling point over low heat; simmer one minute, stirring constantly., Sprinkle chowder with sauteed bacon pieces.

title: Eggplant Parmesan
directions: Peel your eggplant and slice about 1/4 inch thick., Lightly flour and fry in oil (not a lot)., Drain on paper towels and set aside.

title: Okra Fritters
directions: Combine all ingredients and stir well., Drop by tablespoon into hot oil., Turn once., Drain and serve at once.

title: Sloppy Joe
directions: Brown meat, celery and onion; drain fat., Add remaining ingredients and stir until well blended.

title: Texas Casserole
directions: Brown meat and onions. Add salt, pepper, herb sauce and sugar. Mix sour cream and cream cheese together. Place noodles first in casserole dish, the meat mixture then cream cheese mixture. Keep layering, top with American cheese slices. Bake at 375° for 45 minutes. This dish will make 2 medium-sized casseroles.

title: Taco Casserole
directions: Brown hamburger and drain., Mix taco seasoning, creamed corn and beans with juice into hamburger., Crumble chips in bottom of long casserole dish (any amount you like)., Pour meat mixture over chips and bake at 325° for 20 minutes., Sprinkle shredded cheese over top and heat until cheese melts., Serves 4 to 6 people.

title: Cheese Biscuits
directions: Combine all ingredients and roll 1/2 inch thick., Cut with 2 inch cutter., Bake at 450° for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Cottage Cheese Loaf
directions: Cook onion in oil until soft and golden., Stir all ingredients together., Pack tightly into a casserole, greased., Cover with foil., Bake at 350° for one hour., Uncover the last 15 minutes. Allow to stand for 15 minutes before serving., For a moister loaf, use less crumbs. You can also use more nuts., Walnuts work well.

title: Margie'S Brown Rounds
directions: Cream margarine, sugar and egg., Add remaining ingredients. Drop and bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Baked Chicken
directions: Place chicken legs and thighs in a shallow roasting pan or glass baking dish., Do not grease pan or baking dish beforehand. Sprinkle salt, pepper and paprika over the chicken in liberal doses., Bake in 325° oven for 1 1/2 hours until skin is crisp., Do not turn chicken while cooking., Serve on bed of watercress or as is.

title: Vidalia Onion Dip
directions: Combine all ingredients and spread in a 9 x 13 inch greased baking dish., Bake in a 325° oven for about 25 to 30 minutes or until slightly golden brown., Serve warm with Fritos, chips of choice, or crackers.

title: Basic Meat Loaf Microwave Special(Cooking Time 15 To 17 Minutes)
directions: Mix ground chuck thoroughly with onion, crumbs, egg, catsup, milk and seasonings., Mold into a rounded, flat loaf in 9-inch pie plate., Spread catsup evenly over top of loaf., Cover with waxed paper., Place loaf in microwave oven., Cook 15 to 17 minutes, giving dish 1/4 turn every 4 minutes., Let loaf stand at least 5 minutes before slicing., Yields 6 servings.

title: Baked Beans
directions: Add beans and brown sugar to onion cooked in bacon fat., Mix all and place slices of bacon on top., Bake at 325° for 1 hour (approximately).

title: Orange Or Lemon Sugar
directions: Put 1/2 cup of sugar and the peel into blender and process on high until peel is very finely grated., Empty into a bowl, add remaining sugar and mix well with a spoon., Sprinkle on hot buttered toast, pancakes or coffee cake, or use to flavor puddings and cookies., Yields 1 1/2 cups.

title: Strawberry Cake
directions: Mix first 5 ingredients together., In separate bowl, mix other 3 ingredients., Put 1/2 of second mixture in with first mixture. Keep 1/2 for icing., Bake cake per instructions on box.

title: Butterballs
directions: Cream butter and sugar., Add vanilla., Blend in flour and nuts until like pie crust, crumbly., Chill 1 hour., Roll in balls. Bake 15 minutes or until light brown at 325°., Roll in powdered sugar when cool.

title: Microwave Pralines
directions: Beat until creamy., Wrap in wax paper., Store in airtight container.

title: Rocky Road Candy
directions: In medium saucepan, slowly melt chocolate over low heat, stirring constantly., Remove from heat., Beat until smooth., Stir in marshmallows and nuts., Spread on buttered 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Chill and cut in squares.

title: Peach Cobbler No. 1
directions: Mix sugar, flour, milk, baking powder and salt together., Melt stick of margarine in a pan., Pour sugar and flour mixture in pan. Add peaches., Bake at 375° until mixture forms a cake and browns, approximately 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Garlic Cheese Bread
directions: Shake Molly McButter on bread., Add both cheeses and garlic powder., Broil until brown.

title: Blueberry Griddle Cakes
directions: Beat egg well., Add salt and milk., Stir baking powder with flour and stir in other mixture. Beat until smooth., Add blueberries. Drop from spoon and brown both sides., Serves 4.

title: Mom'S Hot Cake
directions: Cream shortening and sugar together., Add eggs and dry ingredients alternately with milk., Stir in vanilla., Bake at 350° until straw comes clean., Serve with a hot caramel sauce.

title: Chow Chow
directions: Cut up vegetables coarsely and put in large container., Put in pickling salt., Add 2 trays of ice cubes, mix through., Cover with cloth and let stand overnight in a very large canner (15 1/2-quart or larger)., In morning, make syrup of vinegar, sugar, turmeric and mustard., Cook down until mixed throughly., Mix flour in some syrup and then add to the syrup in pot (canner)., Cook until clear by boiling., Turn heat down., Fill a colander with vegetables and then add to syrup., Do this until all vegetables are in canner., Cook until it comes to a boil., Boil slowly for 5 minutes, no longer. Fill clean, sterilized jars and seal., Yields 16 to 20 pints.

title: Bread Sticks
