directions: In mixing bowl, combine flour and butter, stirring butter into flour and then add milk to desired consistency., Batter should not be thin but have a texture that will hold its shape when out on flour surface (wax paper).

title: Mrs. Field'S Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Cream the ingredients., Recipe can be divided in sections for making different kinds., Can add chocolate chips, grated chocolate, raisins, nuts, etc., Bake at 375° for 6 to 8 minutes.

title: Quick Peanut Butter Blossoms
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., In a medium size bowl, mix cake mix, water and peanut butter until blended., Roll dough into 1-inch balls., Put the sugar in a bowl and roll the dough balls in it until covered., Place dough balls on a cookie sheet about 1-inch apart., Bake for 10 to 12 minutes until cookie separates., Then place chocolate candy on center and press down until cookie separates around edges., Makes about 5 dozen cookies.

title: Rolled Sugar Cookies
directions: Mix ingredients together., Chill for 2 hours., Roll out, cut and bake at 350° until golden brown., Cool.

title: Albondigas(Meatball Soup)
directions: Put 1/2 of first 8 ingredients in a large bowl and other 1/2 of same ingredients in a large soup pot., To pot, add approximately 4 quarts of water and 1 heaping tablespoonful of flour., Boil.

title: Hot Crab Dip
directions: Melt butter and cream cheese in top of double boiler., Add remaining ingredients and mix well., Serve in a chafing dish. Serve with dip size Fritos or Wheat Thins.

title: Chicken And Rice Casserole
directions: Pour rice into buttered casserole dish; sprinkle with soup mix., Add water., Place chicken pieces on top., Pour soup over chicken., Cover and bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour., Serves 4.

title: "A B C" Sandwich
directions: In a bowl, combine cheese, apple, salad dressing and walnuts. Spread on 6 slices of bread and place 2 slices of bacon on each. Cover with egg slices., Top with tomatoes, if desired, and remaining slices of bread.

title: Strawberry-Lemonade Punch
directions: In punch bowl, combine lemonade, juice, strawberries and 3 cups cold water., Refrigerate.

title: Pepper Steak
directions: Trim fat from round steak on all edges; cut meat in lengthwise strips; coat meat in flour, salt and pepper mixture., Brown meat in oil., Add soup mix and 4 cups of water., Simmer for at least 1 hour; until meat is tender., Add extra water as needed., Add bell peppers cut into strips, cook until peppers turn color, about 15 to 20 minutes., Thicken with cornstarch and water., Serve over rice.

title: Easy Beef Stroganoff
directions: Add onions and mushrooms to ground beef., Then brown and drain., Add remaining ingredients., Stir and simmer for 10 minutes., Serve over noodles or split hamburger buns.

title: Clo'S Pound Cake
directions: In a large bowl, cream butter and sugar until fluffy., Add eggs, one at a time, alternately with flour until all are well mixed., Add salt., Pour into tube pan., Begin baking in cold oven. Bake at 350° for 1 1/4 hours.

title: Cleveland Chili
directions: Saute onion, garlic, green pepper, celery, salt and pepper in butter., When cooked, remove from pan into bowl., Brown meat. Drain fat., Add bowl of sauteed items to browned meat., Add tomatoes, chili beans and spices., Simmer on low for 1 hour. Serve over mashed potatoes (optional).

title: Chicken And Dressing
directions: Crumble both breads into a large pan; pour 2 to 3 cups broth over breads., Cook celery and onion in remaining broth until tender (oleo can be used instead)., Add this to bread, then sage and seasonings., Lastly, add eggs and sugar; gradually add soup and broth until desired consistency., Punch deboned chicken into dressing., Cover and bake at 350° for 45 minutes., Check after 30 minutes., Remove cover to brown.

title: Self-Crust Coconut Custard Pie
directions: Put ingredients into blender and blend about 20 seconds., Pour into 10-inch pie pan., Bake until golden brown in a 350° oven for about 30 minutes or until knife inserted in middle comes out clean., Crust forms at the bottom, custard in the middle and the coconut on top.

title: Zucchini Bread
directions: Combine first 5 ingredients together., Bet eggs, sugar, oil and vanilla until creamy., Add zucchini and stir in dry ingredients, just until moist., Bake in two 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pans at 350° for 1 hour., Can omit nuts., Freezes well.

title: Peachy Angel Food Dessert
directions: Tear cake into bite size pieces; set aside., Prepare whipped topping according to package directions; set aside., In a large mixing bowl, beat the cream cheese and confectioners sugar., Fold in whipped topping., Add cake pieces; stir gently to coat evenly. Spoon into a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan., Top with pie filling. Chill until ready to serve., Yields 12 servings.

title: Lydia'S Corn Chowder
directions: In a large saucepan combine potatoes, water, bouillon, red pepper and black pepper., Bring to boil, reduce heat., Cover and simmer about 10 minutes or until potatoes are just tender, stirring occasionally., Stir in 2 1/2 cups of the milk and corn.

title: Shrimp Dip
directions: Mix well., A delicious spread for crackers and party snacks.

title: Vegetable Beef Soup
directions: Brown ground chuck with onion and green pepper in large saucepan, stirring until ground beef is crumbly; drain., Add remaining ingredients; mix well., Simmer for 2 hours or to desired consistency., Chill overnight and reheat to improve flavor., Serve with corn bread., Yield:, 10 servings.

title: Strawberry Mousse
directions: Place cold water and gelatin in blender and let stand five minutes., Add hot water., Cover and blend on medium speed about one minute, or until white and foamy., Add brown sugar and lemon juice to gelatin mixture and blend until throughly combined., Add cream and eggs., Gradually add strawberries., Place in refrigerator until slightly thickened (15 minutes)., Pour into serving dishes and garnish with dollop of whipped cream and whole fresh strawberries.

title: Coconut Bread
directions: Cut bread into oblong shape 2 x 1-inch., Use a teaspoon and put the condensed milk on each side of the bread., Mix the coloring and banana flavoring with the coconut., Spread the coconut over the slices of bread., Place slices on a greased baking sheet., Bake at 250° for 20 to 25 minutes., Serve hot or cold.

title: Christmas Cutout Cookies
directions: Cream butter well; add white and brown sugar slowly and cream well., Beat eggs, cold water and vanilla., Mix and sift dry ingredients and add alternately with liquid ingredients to cream mixture., Chill at least 1/2 hour., (Can be wrapped in wax paper and left overnight.), Roll to desired thickness (about 1/8 or 1/4-inch) and bake for 12 to 15 minutes in a 350° oven., Frost with colored frosting or brush with slightly beaten egg white and sprinkle with colored sugars.

title: Zucchini Quiche
directions: Prepare sausage and peppers., Combine all the ingredients and mix together., Pour into oblong shallow pan and bake at 350° until firm., Serves 8.

title: Apple Cake
directions: In a bowl, cream the sugars and shortening. Add eggs, beating one in at a time., In second small bowl, add vanilla to the water and add to sugar mixture alternately with sifted dry ingredients. Stir in apples and nuts., Pour into a 9 x 13-inch greased and floured cake pan., Mix up caramel topping and spread on batter before baking. Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

title: Pretty Patio Salad
directions: Combine all ingredients and mix well.

title: Pretzel Pieces
directions: Break pretzels into bite size pieces., Then place pretzels in a large mixing bowl minus any crumbs which will soak up the dressing. Mix ingredients in a separate bowl and pour over the pretzels., Mix pretzels and ingredients well., After mixing, put pretzels in a pan, approximately 11 x 9 1/2-inch., Put in preheated oven at 350° for 5 minutes., Then take out., Pour back into mixing bowl and mix well again., Then place pretzels back in oven 5 more minutes. Remove and drain on paper towel.

title: Watergate Salad
directions: Drain pineapple and reserve juice., Place pudding mix in large bowl., Add about 4 tablespoons of the pineapple juice to make a soft paste., Mix well., Add drained pineapple, whipped topping, marshmallows and chopped nuts., Mix well until mixture is fluffy and increases in volume., Refrigerate until chilled.

title: Pam'S Meat Loaf
directions: Soak bread crumbs in milk; add meat, eggs, onion and seasonings., Mix well., Form in individual loaves; place in greased muffin pans., Cover with Piquant Sauce., Bake in a moderate 350° oven for 45 minutes., Makes 8 servings., Or form one loaf in 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2 1/2-inch pan., Spread with sauce; bake 1 hour.

title: Chili
directions: *Or whatever you want to use, as long as it is 18 ounces of "something."

title: 24-Karat Cake Or Cupcakes
directions: To make icing, beat butter or margarine with cream cheese in bowl of an electric mixer until very light and fluffy., Beat in powdered sugar, followed by vanilla, pecans and optional coconut. To frost the cake, spread a generous amount of filling between and over the top of the layers, leaving the sides of the cake unfrosted., Or use the icing to generously frost the top of the cupcakes.

title: Potato Casserole
directions: Mix soup, milk, sour cream and shredded cheese together and stir into the frozen potatoes., Bake in glass dish or 1 1/2-quart greased casserole., Bake at 350° for 1 hour, uncovered.

title: Coney Island Sauce
directions: Mix all together and simmer 15 minutes.

title: Apple Crisps
directions: Heat oven to 375°., Place apples into buttered pan., Mix remaining ingredients., Sprinkle over apples., Bake until brown.

title: Sausage And Potato Stew
directions: In a 3-quart saucepan, heat potatoes, salt and enough water to cover to boiling., Reduce heat and simmer 15 minutes or until potatoes are fork-tender., Drain., While potatoes are boiling, in a 12-inch skillet, heat butter., Cook onions until tender., Add sausage, tomatoes with liquid, paprika, caraway seed and 1/2 teaspoon salt., Heat to boiling., Reduce heat to low; cover and simmer 15 minutes., Stir in potatoes and serve.

title: Pistachio Pudding Dessert
directions: Mix all ingredients and press into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 10 to 15 minutes at 325°.

title: Sweet And Easy Corn Pudding
directions: Blend all ingredients., Conventional oven bake 45 minutes at 375°., In microwave oven, microwave on High 4 minutes, stir; 4 minutes more, stir; 4 minutes more., Should be like pudding.

title: Barbecued Shish Kabobs
directions: Cut the first 5 ingredients into strips or chunks., After cutting veggies and meat, saute chopped onion and garlic in oil. Stir in remaining ingredients; cook until slightly thickened. Thread meat and veggies on skewers., Brush with sauce., Place skewers on grill., Cook for approximately 10 minutes, or until done., Baste with remaining sauce while cooking.

title: Fruitcake
directions: (You can substitute other candied fruit.)

title: Hawaiian Baked Chicken
directions: Skin and wash chicken breasts., Pat dry., Place in a shallow pan., Mix pineapple juice, soy sauce, oil and ginger., Cover chicken with marinade and cover., Refrigerate for 8 hours; turn pieces over once., Preheat oven to 350°., Pour off marinade, reserving liquid., Bake chicken for 20 minutes; baste every 10 minutes., Turn chicken pieces over and bake for another 30 minutes., Continue to baste every 10 minutes, until chicken is done., Serves 4.

title: Nancy Luthy'S Festive Chowder
directions: Melt butter in saucepan., Stir in celery and chopped onion; cook until tender., Stir in flour, salt and pepper, if desired. Gradually add milk, stirring constantly., Add potatoes., Bring to boil; simmer 15 minutes, until potatoes are tender., Add bacon and Crab Delights., Heat 3 to 5 minutes more., Makes 4 servings.

title: Cafeteria Cookies
directions: Mix the first 4 ingredients., Bring to boil, stirring constantly., Simmer 10 minutes., Remove from heat and add peanut butter, oatmeal and vanilla., Stir., Drop on wax paper. Refrigerate 1/2 hour.

title: Garlic Bubble Bread
directions: Thaw and soften bread dough. Blend together melted butter, egg, garlic powder, parsley and salt. Cut off pieces of dough about size of small walnuts. Dip into butter mixture. Place pieces of dough into greased loaf pan until all dough is used. Cover. Let rise until double in size. Bake at 375° for 30 minutes. Brush with melted butter or margarine. Cool on wire rack. Makes 1 loaf.

title: Old Fashioned Jam Cake
directions: Cream butter and sugar; add jam., Beat eggs and add milk. Sift flour in., Add other ingredients., Bake at 325°.

title: Coconut Island Cookies
directions: In large mixer bowl combine chocolate, coffee, butter, brown sugar, egg, sour cream, flour, soda, salt and 1/3 cup coconut. Mix on lowest speed until a dough forms., Drop by rounded teaspoon onto greased cookie sheets 12 to 15 minutes., Frost warm. Sprinkle with remaining coconut.

title: Gay'S Pineapple Banana Slush Punch
directions: Dissolve sugar in water to make a light syrup., Mix syrup with next three ingredients and pour into small containers to freeze solid., Approximately 1 hour before serving, remove containers from freezer and place in punch bowl., Pour ginger ale over frozen ingredients., As mixture thaws, rake a fork over ice mixture to make slushy.

title: Chop Suey
directions: In a Dutch oven, bring water to a boil., After rinsing off sprouts, simmer for ten minutes., Bias cut celery and onions into semi-large pieces., Add to sprouts and simmer another five minutes., While you are cooking the vegetables, cut meat into whatever size pieces you desire.

title: Scalloped Tomatoes
directions: Stir all ingredients into well-beaten eggs., Pour into greased oven dish., Place dish in pan with some water., Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until custard is set., Serve hot.

title: Pecan Tarts
directions: Do not prebake pastry.

title: Meat Loaf
directions: Combine all ingredients. Mix well and put into baking dish. Bake at 350° for 50 minutes.

title: Oatmeal Chocolate Chip Cake
directions: Pour water over oatmeal; let stand 10 minutes., Add sugar and margarine; stir well., Add eggs., Sift and add dry ingredients. Add 6 ounces chocolate chips., Put in greased cake pan., Sprinkle on top 3/4 cup nuts and 6 ounces chocolate chips., Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

title: Breakfast Casserole
directions: Put stuffing mix in a greased, flat 3-quart casserole., Top with cheese, then sausage., Beat eggs, milk, soup and mustard together, then add mushrooms and pour over other ingredients in casserole., Refrigerate overnight., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Instant Love
directions: Take friendship and love and mix them with tenderness., Blend thoroughly with loyalty., Add hope and faith., Sprinkle with forgiveness., Serve daily with abundant laughter.

title: Hot Chicken Casserole
directions: Mix all together., Place in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan., Best if mixed the day before., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Chinese Pepper Steak
directions: Brown meat in a small amount of oil., Add chopped onions, water and salt., Cover and simmer until tender, about 20 minutes. Add green peppers and cook 5 minutes., Blend cornstarch with a little water and add to meat mixture., Cook, stirring, until thick., Just before serving, add tomatoes and soy sauce; heat. Serve over rice.

title: Fudge Pie
directions: Combine all ingredients; pour into an unbaked pie shell., Bake 30 minutes at 350°., Serve with a scoop of vanilla ice cream or whipped topping.

title: Beef And Squash Casserole
directions: Cook squash and onion in salted water, about 5 minutes., Drain well., Cook green pepper and meat until meat is no longer pink. Stir in rice., Blend eggs, soup, sour cream and seasonings; stirring into meat mixture., Fold in squash mixture., Turn into a greased 11 1/2 X 7 1/2 X 1 1/2 baking dish., Top with cheese. Sprinkle with paprika, if desired., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes or until hot and bubbly., Makes 8 servings.

title: Sweet-Sour Meatballs
directions: Mix ground beef, cracker crumbs, minced onion, egg, milk and ginger., Shape into meatballs; brown them on baking sheet in a 350° oven., Mix cornstarch and sugar., Stir in pineapple syrup, vinegar and soy sauce until smooth., Cook until thickened, stirring constantly., Put meatballs in casserole; add syrup mixture, pineapple and green pepper., Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Chinese Hamburg Casserole
directions: Do not salt anything., Brown hamburger in 2 to 3 tablespoons butter, add pepper., Remove meat from frypan, put in vegetables and cook until tender., Add 2 to 3 tablespoons of water to keep from burning., Cook rice, when done add soy sauce and canned soups., Add meat and rice mixture to vegetables., Mix ingredients well and put into covered dish and bake 30 to 40 minutes., A half cup water may be added, if needed., Can be frozen before baking.

title: Spanish Rice
directions: Bring to a boil in 2-quart saucepan in 1 1/4 quarts of water. Add ingredients., After 3 or 4 minutes, add rice; cut down heat and simmer for 10 minutes or until rice is cooked., Use bigger pan if needed.

title: Grammy'S Oatmeal Crispies Cookies
directions: Optional:, Add raisins or chocolate chips if you drop cookies.

title: Friendship Tea
directions: Mix all ingredients well., Seal in airtight container., When ready to use, put 3 or 4 teaspoons in cup., Fill with boiling water., This mix makes a lovely gift.

title: Wild Rice Rose(Serve With Lamb Or Chicken)
directions: Soak rice overnight; drain., Wash and drain., Mix with remaining ingredients., Place in buttered 2-quart casserole dish. Cover and bake for 1 hour at 350°., Serves 4 to 6.

title: Beer-Battered Bass
directions: Combine pancake mix, flour, baking powder and salt in bowl. Add egg and beer; mix until smooth., Dip fish in batter, coating well., Deep fry in hot oil until golden brown; drain., Yield:, 6 servings.

title: Apple Jello Salad
directions: In a saucepan, heat applesauce until it bubbles., Stir in Jell-O and cook until dissolved., Remove and cool, then stir in pop, orange juice and peel., Chill until partially set, then stir in apples and nuts., Chill until set firm.

title: Spicy Orange Chicken
directions: Combine flour, salt, pepper and garlic powder in a bag., Shake the chicken pieces individually until coated., Brown in the butter in a skillet over medium-high heat, pour off fat., In a bowl, combine remaining ingredients., Add to skillet and simmer, covered, 25 minutes or until chicken is tender., Serves 4.

title: Butter Cookies
directions: Combine all ingredients and mix with a mixer until dough forms and color lightens., Shape into small balls., Bake at 325° until just done, not brown., Roll in powdered sugar.

title: Monkey Bread
directions: Grease tube pan., Cut each biscuit into fourths., Shake in a bag with sugar and cinnamon., Put a layer of pecans (1 cup) and 1/2 biscuit mixture in pan and repeat this., Pour mixture of brown sugar and margarine over all of this., Bake at 350° for about 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Quick Fix Oyster Crackers
directions: Mix all ingredients. Garlic powder to taste. Make a day ahead.

title: Fruit Roll
directions: Mix all together, then fix into a roll; freeze., Slice when ready to serve.

title: Sausage Omelet
directions: Heat sausage in heavy 8-inch ovenproof skillet according to package directions., Remove sausage and keep warm., Saute the onion and green pepper in sausage skillet over medium-high until tender., Combine eggs and milk in bowl., Add the onion, green pepper and tomato., Melt the butter in the skillet over low heat. Add the egg and vegetable mixture and cook until eggs are almost set., Arrange the sausage on top of eggs., Place under the broiler and broil until center is firm and top is lightly browned., Cut into wedges and serve immediately.

title: Taco Salad
directions: Mix all but Fritos in large bowl., Chill, then make Meat Sauce:

title: Ritz Cracker Pie
directions: Mix together the Ritz crackers, chopped nuts and 1/2 cup sugar., Beat the egg whites, vanilla and 1/2 cup sugar., Fold cracker mixture into egg whites., Put in heavily greased pie plate., Bake for 30 minutes at 300°., Top with whipped cream or Cool Whip., Sprinkle with grated chocolate.

title: Butterscotch Surprise(Candy)
directions: Melt butterscotch chips and peanut butter in the top of a double boiler. Stir in nuts and shoestring potatoes. Drop by teaspoon onto waxed paper., Cool for several hours in the refrigerator., Yields 2 or 3 dozen.

title: Steaming Oyster Stew
directions: Heat milk and cream together until film shimmers over surface. Do not boil., In separate pan, precook oysters and drain., Add oysters (slice if you prefer) and butter to hot milk and cream mixture., Heat but do not boil for 5 minutes more., Add seasonings and serve at once., Serves 5 to 6.

title: Mazzetti
directions: Cook, beef,, onion, and, garlic., Add, soups and water; cook. Add 1 package wide noodles, uncooked., When noodles are done, place, 6, slices, of, cheese, cover and let stand until ready to eat., This is all cooked in one pot.

title: Grandmother Fowler'S Rolls
directions: Place warm water in a mixing bowl. Stir in yeast until dissolved. Add shortening, salt, sugar, egg and 1/2 of flour. Mix well with electric mixer. Mix in remainder of flour well with a spoon or dough hooks., Turn out into a well greased large mixing bowl. Grease top of dough (I spray it with Pam). Cover and let rise in a warm place until double.

title: Summer Ginger Ale Salad
directions: Dissolve jello in boiling water., Add lemonade concentrate and stir to dissolve., Add ginger ale., Chill until thick, but not set., Fold in remaining ingredients., Pour into 2 1/2-quart mold. Chill until firm., Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Roast And Potatoes
directions: Preheat oven to 400°., Place roast in medium roaster pan and cover with water., Add chopped onion, celery, salt and pepper. Cover and let cook 30 minutes. Turn oven down to 325°., Let cook slowly, approximately 4 hours. Check roast to be sure it is covered with water. After 4 to 4 1/2 hours, add potatoes and carrots., Cook about 1 1/2 hours or until potatoes are tender.

title: Orange Julius
directions: Combine all ingredients in blender with 1/2 cup water and enough ice cubes to fill container., Process until liquified.

title: Fruit Whip
directions: Prepare Jell-O as directed., Cut Jell-O into cubes and mix ingredients together., Cool.

title: Baked Squash From "Black-Eyed Pea Restaurant"
directions: Cut off tips of squash and cut in pieces., Boil until tender. Drain and mash., Add eggs, bread crumbs and butter., Then add sugar, salt, onion and pepper., Bake in greased casserole at 350° until top is lightly browned, about 45 minutes., Makes 10 servings.

title: Shortbread Salad
directions: Mix pudding and buttermilk., Add oranges (I drain 1 can), Cool Whip (I use 16 ounces) and shortbread cookies., Refrigerate.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
directions: Boil first three ingredients 3 minutes., Then add peanut butter and oats., Drop on wax paper.

title: Rolled Oats Cake
directions: Cook oats in water., Add butter., Let cool., Add sugars, coconut and eggs., Mix in dry ingredients., Pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake for 35 to 45, minutes, until light brown.

title: Pepper Steak
directions: Trim fat from meat and bones., Cut meat into 4-6 serving pieces., Grease large skillet, season meat on both sides with salt, brown meat thoroughly., Set meat to the side;, add onion; cook and stir until tender., Stir in broth, soy sauce and garlic. Cover; simmer for 10 minutes or until meat is tender., Add green peppers., Cover; simmer for 5 minutes.

title: Rolled Up Nut Cookies
directions: Dissolve yeast in milk., Mix all ingredients together and roll up to 90 balls., Cover and set it in the refrigerator overnight until next day., The next day, roll the balls on powdered sugar, but don't roll too thin., Put the filling in the center of the cookie; fold one side of the cookie and then overlap the other side on top., Slightly greased a cookie sheet using two cookie pans. Place 6 or 7 cookies across and 6 rolls down., Bake at 350° for 10 minutes., Use apricot or nut filling.

title: Crock-Pot Dessert
directions: Spray crockery with nonstick spray., Stir in peaches and pour into crock-pot., Cook on low for four to six hours.

title: Dieter'S Ambrosia
directions: Sprinkle gelatine over ginger ale., Heat until dissolved., Do not boil., Cool., Mix in other ingredients., Serves 10 (1/2 cup) servings.

title: Veal Marsala
directions: Season veal with salt and pepper, then dip in flour, vigorously shaking off the excess., In a heavy skillet, melt 2 tablespoons margarine with olive oil over moderate heat., When the foam subsides, add the veal, 3 or 4 at a time, and brown for about 3 minutes on each side., When done, transfer them to plate., Pour most of the fat out of the skillet, leaving only a thin film at the bottom., Add the Marsala and 1/4 cup of broth and boil briskly over high heat for 1 to 2 minutes., Scrape in any brown fragments clinging to pan., Return veal to pan; cover and simmer over low heat for 10 to 15 minutes, basting with pan juices until tender. Transfer veal to a heated platter., Add 1/4 cup broth to sauce in pan and boil briskly, scraping in brown bits., When sauce has reduced and is syrupy, taste it for seasoning and season as necessary., Remove the pan from the heat; stir in 2 tablespoons of softened margarine and pour the sauce over the veal.

title: Chicken Divon
directions: Cook broccoli and place in 9x13 baking dish., Debone chicken; place on top of broccoli., Mix mayonnaise, soup, lemon juice and spread on top of chicken., Brown bread crumbs., Sprinkle on top with cheese., Bake 350 degrees 30 minutes.

title: Soy-Flavored Chicken
directions: Skin chicken breasts (optional for low-fat)., Place into a baking dish the breasts., Add 1/3 cup water and place into a preheated oven at 325°., After 30 minutes, add soy sauce., Continue to cook for another 30 minutes, then add chopped pepper and sliced mushrooms., Continue to cook an additional 20 to 30 minutes., Turn breasts several times to allow the soy sauce to penetrate the meat. Brown lightly., Serve with wild, brown or white rice., A low-fat dish and low-salt.

title: Spicy Spanish Rice
directions: Brown beef., Add onion, green pepper, salt, brown sugar, chili powder, bay leaf and rest of the ingredients., Cook, covered, until rice and vegetables are done., Stir often., Serves 6 to 8.

title: Jodi'S Broccoli
directions: Cook broccoli according to box directions., Drain., Place broccoli in a casserole dish., Add the butter and Velveeta cheese. Crush crackers and spread over top., Dot extra butter on top of crackers., Place in a 350° oven for 20 to 30 minutes or until brown on top.

title: Orange Pecans
directions: Combine sugar and milk in saucepan., Add vinegar., Boil until it forms a soft ball in cold water., Pour mixture over pecan halves., Add grated rind of 2 oranges and stir until pecans are coated., Spread on foil to dry.

title: Chicken Baked In Soy Sauce
directions: Mix the onions, soy sauce and water and put into roasting pan. Put fryer in roaster, skin side down., Cook 40 minutes and turn; cook 40 minutes., Serve with Uncle Ben's seasoned long grain and wild rice., Serves 15.

title: Quick Kolacky
directions: Cream the margarine., Add cream cheese and beat until fluffy. Add flour., Chill 15 minutes., Roll out and cut into 2-inch rounds. Make depressions in center of rounds., Place 1 teaspoon of filling in the center., Bake at 400° for 15 minutes., Sprinkle with powdered sugar.

title: Hillbilly Slaw
directions: Shred cabbage., Cut carrot, cucumber, bell pepper and radishes in rings., Mix sugar, vinegar and oil and pour over vegetables. Toss and refrigerate several hours before serving., Salt to taste before serving.

title: Cream Cheese Muffins
directions: Combine all ingredients except honey in a large bowl., Beat at low speed of electric mixer., Fill baking cup lined muffin tins 1/2 full., Bake at 350° for 10 minutes. Drizzle with honey. Yields 18 muffins.

title: Sweet And Sour Green Beans
directions: Cut bacon into pieces and fry with onion., Drain off fat., Add vinegar, sugar, beans and salt and pepper to taste., Simmer 10 minutes., Serve hot.

title: Chicken And Vegetables Pot Pie
directions: Combine chicken, mixed vegetables and soups in bowl; mix well. Spoon into greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish., Spread topping evenly over chicken mixture., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour or until brown., Yield:, 8 servings.

title: Lasagna
directions: In skillet, saute onion., Add meat and cook until done. Mash garlic, with, salt., Add, to, meat	with pepper, oregano, parsley, tomatoes,	tomato	sauce, and 1 tablespoon Parmesan. Simmer, covered, 30 minutes.

title: Caesar'S Salad Dressing
directions: Mix all ingredients in a jar and shake well., Store in refrigerator.

title: Easy As 1-2-3 Microwave Brownies
directions: In a medium bowl, beat together butter, sugar, eggs and vanilla with an electric mixer on medium speed until light and fluffy, 1 to 2 minutes., Beat in cocoa., Add flour and beat until well blended., By hand, stir in pecans., Spread evenly in a wax paper-lined 8-inch square glass dish., Cook in a microwave oven on High for 3 minutes. Turn dish a quarter turn and cook 2 1/2 to 3 minutes longer., Let cool., Sift powdered sugar over top., Cut into 16 or 25 squares.

title: Oatmeal-Raisin Muffins
directions: Sift together flour, baking powder and salt., Cut in shortening until mixture is like coarse crumbs., Stir in rolled oats., Combine egg, milk and brown sugar; beat well., Stir into dry ingredients; add raisins., Spoon into paper baking cups in muffin pans., Combine granulated sugar and cinnamon; sprinkle over batter., Bake in a 425° oven for 15 to 20 minutes., Makes 12 muffins.

title: Apple Crisp
directions: Combined crushed frosted mini-wheats with flour, cinnamon, nutmeg and brown sugar., Mix well., Add margarine mixing until crumbly., Set aside for topping., Place apples in ungreased 9 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan., Sprinkle topping evenly over apples., Bake at 350° for 55 minutes or until apples are tender and topping is browned., Serve warm with ice cream.

title: Fruit Salad
directions: Drain juice from pineapple and fruit cocktail., Reserve to use with pudding., Combine juice and pudding in small saucepan; bring to a boil, stirring constantly., Mixture should thicken and become clear., Cool to room temperature., In large bowl, gently combine the pineapple chunks, oranges and fruit cocktail., Pour pudding mixture over fruit and toss to coat fruit., Refrigerate for 2 to 3 hours., When ready to serve, add bananas and gently combine. Serve immediately., Bananas may darken after a while.

title: Pineapple Rice Salad
directions: Cooked cup of rice is added to all other ingredients., Mix well., Serve.

title: Basil Tortellini Soup
directions: In a large saucepan, bring broth to a boil. Add tortellini; cook until tender, about 6 minutes. Stir in the beans, tomato and basil. Reduce heat; simmer, uncovered, for 5 minutes. Add the vinegar, salt and pepper. Serve with cheese.

title: Patsy'S Pecan Pie
directions: Beat egg whites until stiff., Add baking powder and sugar to egg whites., Add nuts and crackers., Mix together., Pour into greased pie pan., Bake at 325° for 20 to 30 minutes., Set and let cool, then put Cool Whip or whipped cream on top.

title: Company Chicken
directions: Preheat oven to 400°., Layer 13 x 9-inch baking pan with dried beef., Place chicken breasts on top., Cut bacon in smaller pieces, putting a small strip on each breast., Bake, uncovered, for 30 minutes., Mix soup and sour cream., Remove pan from oven and cover chicken well with soup mixture., Cover chicken and return to oven for 30 minutes more., (By covering chicken with tinfoil, your gravy will not cook away.), Remove and serve with rice or noodles.

title: Molasses Crinkles
directions: Mix shortening, sugar, egg and molasses very well., Either stir or sift flour before measuring., Blend all dry ingredients and stir into wet mixture and chill., Heat oven to 375°., Roll dough into 1 1/4-inch ball., Dip tops in granulated sugar., Place balls, sugar side up, 3-inches apart on greased baking sheet., Sprinkle each with 2 to 3 drops water., Bake 10 to 12 minutes or just until set, but not hard., Makes about 4 dozen.

title: Krum-Kaka
directions: Melt butter and cool., Beat eggs; add sugar and mix., Whip the cream., Add melted butter to eggs and sugar; add whipped cream. Add vanilla and flour., Use 1 scant teaspoon for each one on Krum-KaKa iron., Makes about 4 dozen.

title: Punch Bowl Cake
directions: Prepare cake mix as directed on package in 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Cool completely., Break cake into pieces., Prepare pudding mix as directed on package., In clear glass punch bowl, layer 1/2 of cake, 1/2 of pudding, 1/2 of cherry pie filling, 1/2 of pineapple and 1/2 of Cool Whip., Repeat layers, ending with Cool Whip. Garnish with maraschino cherries and nuts., Cover; refrigerate several hours before serving.

title: Corn Casserole
directions: Mix ingredients together and pour into a buttered 2-quart dish., Crush Ritz crackers over top and dot generously with butter., Bake at 400° for 35 minutes., Cover if crackers tend to burn.

title: Heart-Smart Wacky Cake
directions: In ungreased 8-inch cake pan, mix together flour, sugar, soda and cocoa., Make 3 wells in flour mixture., Put vinegar in one, vanilla in one and corn oil in 3rd., Pour water over all and mix with fork until entirely moist., Bake in 350° oven for 20 to 30 minutes until just done., Ice as desired.

title: Rhubarb Nut Loaf
directions: Stir together in order given., Pour into 2 loaf pans, well-greased.

title: Blueberry Banana Pie
directions: Bake pie crust and let cool., It is not necessary to bake graham cracker crust., Cover bottom of pie shell with banana slices., Whip cream cheese and combine with Cool Whip., Spoon over bananas in pie crust., Top with blueberries., Chill 2 to 3 hours before serving.

title: Three Layer Coconut Cake
directions: Cream margarine and Crisco until fluffy., Add sugar gradually. Cream for 10 minutes., Add eggs, one at a time., Add flour and milk alternately., Add vanilla; beat for 1 minute after last addition., Bake at 325° until brown., Cool; frost with White Cake Icing.

title: Enchilada Casserole
directions: Brown ground beef with onion; drain. Grease 8 x 13-inch baking dish. Place crushed Doritos in bottom. Pour ground beef and onion mixture over Doritos. Mix together the sauce and soup. Pour over mixture. Cover top with grated cheese., Bake at 350° for 25 minutes or until cheese is melted bubbly.

title: Tamale Pie
directions: Cook meat, diced onions and garlic., Mix all well in a casserole., Grate cheese over top and bake 55 minutes at 350°.

title: Butterscotch Cheesecake Bars
directions: Soften cream cheese., Preheat oven to 350° (325° for glass dish)., In medium saucepan, melt morsels and margarine., Stir in crumbs and nuts., Press 1/2 the mixture firmly into bottom of greased 13 x 9-inch baking pan., In large bowl, beat cheese until fluffy, then beat in sweetened condensed milk, vanilla and egg; mix well., Pour into prepared pan., Top with remaining crumb mixture. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes, or until toothpick inserted near center comes out clean., Cool to room temperature., Chill before cutting into bars., Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Frosted Cinnamon Rolls
directions: Combine 2 cups baking mix and milk in a bowl., Mix well., Beat vigorously for 30 seconds, adding enough remaining baking mix to make moderate dough. Knead 10 times on floured surface. Roll into 1/2-inch thick rectangle., Spread with butter., Mix sugar and cinnamon. Sprinkle over butter., Top with raisins and nuts. Roll as for jelly roll to enclose filling; cut into 1-inch slices. Place on baking sheet. Bake at 450° for 8 to 10 minutes or until golden brown. Blend confectioners sugar with a small amount of water., Drizzle over rolls. Cool for 5 minutes., Yields 1 dozen.

title: Chicken And Pasta Neapolitan
directions: In a large skillet over medium heat, heat oil., Add chicken, onion and garlic., Cook 5 minutes, stirring frequently or until chicken is no longer pink., Stir in tomato sauce, wine, sugar and seasonings., Heat to boiling., Reduce heat., Cook, covered, stirring occasionally for 20 minutes or until thickened.

title: Banana Bread(Low-Fat)
directions: Pour into 2 greased and floured loaf pans., Bake at 350° for about 1 hour.

title: Chicken Green Bean Casserole
directions: Melt butter., Add water and dressing., Put 1/2 dressing in casserole (8 1/2 x 10 x 1 1/2-inch)., Cook and drain beans., Layer on top of dressing., Add a layer of almonds, followed with split up chicken breast pieces., Cover with remaining dressing, then combine the soup and chicken broth; blend until smooth., Pour soup mixture over entire casserole., Bake, uncovered, for 30 minutes at 325°.

title: Penne All'Arrabbiata(Milano, Italy)
directions: Heat the oil and gently fry the chopped onion and garlic until softened., Add the chili pepper and fry gently for 1 minute., Add the tomatoes with their juice, sugar, salt and pepper to taste and cook on a high flame, uncovered, for about 20 minutes, stirring occasionally., When the sauce is reduced and thick, check the season., If you like a smoother sauce, you can pass the sauce through the medium disk of a food mill., I usually just chop up the tomatoes with a fork and leave the sauce a bit chunky., Add the chopped parsley just before serving., Cook the pasta following the directions on the packet very carefully to avoid overcooking.

title: Pam'S Barbecue Ribs
directions: Mix all dry ingredients together and roll ribs in this mixture until well coated., Place ribs in greased roaster pan with lid. Blend together tomato soup, vinegar and onion., Pour this over ribs., Bake in oven very slowly at 250° to 300° for 3 or 3 1/2 hours.

title: Fantasy Fudge
directions: Stir together sugar, margarine and milk., Bring to a full boil, stirring constantly., Remove from heat., Gradually stir in chocolate chips until melted., Add remaining ingredients., Pour into greased pans; cool at room temperature., Cut into squares.

title: Rolled Cheese Appetizers
directions: Mix filling together., Spread onto tortillas., Let refrigerate about 1 hour., Slice into pinwheels and serve., Great to make ahead and serve.

title: Diet Natural Food
directions: Mix together., Bake at 300° until lightly browned, stirring often.

title: Dried Beef Spread
directions: Mix and chill for at least an hour before serving with crackers.

title: Banana Nut Bread
directions: Cream the butter and sugar together., Beat eggs. Add the bananas., Sift the flour., Add the salt and sift together again, then add alternately with the banana mixture. Add the nuts., Add last the soda with a little warm water., Bake at 350° for 55 minutes in an angel food pan.

title: Sauerkraut Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients and enjoy.

title: Mexican Sausage
directions: Mix ingredients by hand., Let mixture set overnight in refrigerator., Make into patties and cook on slightly greased grill or frying pan.

title: Corn Bread Salad
directions: Cook corn bread to package directions. Cool. It's better if kept for 24 hours, then crumbled. Add all vegetables. Cool in refrigerator about 1 hour. Stir in Miracle Whip. Add cheese.

title: Oatmeal Apple Raisin Muffins
directions: Beat egg; stir in remaining ingredients, mixing just to moisten., Pour into 12 greased muffin cups until 3/4 full., Bake at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes., Serve cool or hot with butter.

title: Shrimp Salad
directions: Warm tomato soup; add gelatine to soften., Add other ingredients., Allow to set up in refrigerator.

title: Macaroni And Cheese
directions: Place Velveeta and 1 cup milk in thick boiler and melt., Add the Kraft package cheese powder., Beat egg and pour into cheese mixture and stir., Place boiled macaroni in Corning dish., Add cheese mixture over this., Cook in 350° oven for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Chicken Tetrazzini
directions: Cook bacon, crumble and set aside., In bacon fat, cook onion, pepper and mushrooms until tender., Stir in flour, chicken broth, cream and pimento., Simmer until sauce thickens., Add salt, pepper, bacon, chicken or turkey and cooked spaghetti., Pour into greased baking dish., Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Banana Split Cake
directions: Drain pineapple., Slice bananas and dip in lemon juice., Mix melted butter and graham cracker crumbs and press into 13X9 pan. In mixer, mix powdered sugar, butter and eggs for 15 minutes. Spread over crumbs., Cover with crushed pineapple., Cover pineapple with banana slices., Top with Cool Whip., Sprinkle with nuts and cherries., Chill overnight.

title: Bread And Butter Pickles
directions: Combine sugar, vinegar, mustard seed, celery seed and turmeric., Place in saucepan and bring to a boil., Mix onions and salt with cucumbers., Put these in jars and pour cooked spices over cucumbers., Follow directions on lids of canning jars to seal.

title: Health Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., In a bowl, sift together the flour, salt and baking soda., In a second bowl, place all the other ingredients., Add the flour mixture to bowl 2 and beat until well mixed., Batter will be lumpy., Place in tube pan and bake for 1 hour and 20 minutes., Do not open oven., When cooled, remove from pan and sprinkle with powdered sugar.

title: Chocolate Chip Zucchini Bread
directions: Cream sugar, oil and baking chocolate; add eggs and mix., Add remaining ingredients and mix., Spray 3 small loaf pans with Pam; pour batter in and fill halfway., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Beef Stroganoff
directions: Brown steak with green pepper and onion and cut into small bite-size pieces., Combine remaining ingredients., Pour over egg noodles or rice.

title: Turtle Brownies
directions: Prepare cake mix according to box instructions., Generously grease a 9 x 13-inch baking pan., Pour 1/2 of cake batter into the pan., Bake for 10 minutes at temperature recommended on box instructions., While cake is baking, melt caramels in saucepan with the can of milk., Remove cake from oven; pour caramel mixture over hot cake., Sprinkle chocolate chips on top of caramel., Pour remaining batter evenly over the top., Bake for 25 minutes, or until top layer is done., Let cool completely; cut into squares. Makes between 30 to 36 squares.

title: Macaroni Lunch
directions: Pan fry sausage into crumbled pieces and drain on paper towels., In a large boiler, bring to boil tomatoes, tomato sauce, water (add more or less water according to your liking), salt and pepper, oil and celery seed., Add sausage and macaroni., Stir well, turn off, place on lid and leave covered 5 minutes., Serve with crackers and salad or coleslaw.

title: Honey Bun Cake
directions: Mix and put half of mixture in 9 x 13-inch greased and floured pan., Mix brown sugar and cinnamon., Sprinkle 1/2 brown sugar mixture on batter and swirl in., Pour rest of batter in and use rest of brown sugar mixture., Bake at 325° for about 40 minutes.

title: Pecan Pie
directions: Melt butter; set aside to cool., Mix flour and sugar., Add milk and eggs., Stir in vanilla and vinegar., Add butter and nuts., Put in crust and bake at 300° for 1 hour.

title: Crispy Baked Onion Rings(Low-Fat)
directions: Cut each onion into 4 thick slices; separate into rings (reserve small rings for another use)., Set aside., Combine cereal and next 3 ingredients; divide in half and set aside., Beat egg substitute at high speed with an electric mixer until soft peaks form., Dip half of onion rings in egg substitute; dredge in half of crumb mixture., Place in a single layer on baking sheets coated with cooking spray., Repeat procedure with remaining onion rings, egg substitute and crumb mixture., Bake at 375° for 15 minutes, or until crisp., Serve warm.

title: Cranberry Salad
directions: Cook cranberries in water until they pop open., Pour in sugar, marshmallows and cherry jello., Stir until jello and sugar are dissolved., Refrigerate until mixture starts to set., Add the celery, apples and pecans., Pour in mold and chill.

title: Cousin Agnes' Bread Pudding
directions: Put sugar on bottom of double boiler insert., Add bread., Mix eggs, milk and vanilla., Pour over bread., Place insert over hot water., Cook until set 1 to 1 1/2 hours., Remove insert and let cool., When cool, place plate over top of pan and invert pudding. Serve warm or cold.

title: Mostaccioli With Bacon And Mushrooms
directions: In a medium skillet, cook bacon until crisp. Remove from fat and set aside., Add mushrooms to bacon fat. Cook until golden; drain and set aside., Prepare mostaccioli according to package directions. Drain., In same saucepan, combine half and half, butter, parsley flakes, salt, garlic and hot pepper sauce., Heat just until butter melts, stirring frequently. Combine bacon, mushrooms, hot mostaccioli, half and half mixture and Parmesan cheese. Toss to coat., Place on warm serving platter. Garnish with green onions., Serve immediately., Refrigerate leftovers., Makes 4 servings.

title: Meat Loaf With Tangy Sauce
directions: Mix all together well and spread into loaf pan., Spread tangy sauce over meat loaf and bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour.

title: Bohemian Pickles
directions: Put cucumbers in quart jars., Add garlic, dill weed and peppers., Mix all other ingredients., Fill jars with liquid. Store in cool dark place for 2 weeks.

title: Candied Kielbasa
directions: Cut kielbasa into 1/2-inch pieces. Cook in microwave for 5 minutes or until fully cooked. Mix all other ingredients together. Pour mixture over cooked kielbasa and mix together. Heat in microwave 5 more minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
directions: Whip cream cheese until soft and fluffy., Beat in peanut butter and sugar., Slowly add milk, blending thoroughly into mixture., Stir in whipped topping., Pour into prepared crust. Sprinkle with chopped peanuts, if desired., Freeze until firm and serve., For storage longer than 4 to 6 hours, wrap the pie well for freezing to prevent dehydration.

title: Breakfast Casserole
directions: Saute sausage., Drain., Beat eggs with milk, salt and mustard. Line 13 x 9-inch baking dish with bread., Top with sausage, then cheese., Pour egg mixture over all., Cover tightly., Refrigerate overnight., Bake, uncovered, at 325° for 35 to 45 minutes., Serve immediately.

title: Biscuits
directions: Combine first 3 ingredients in a large bowl; cut in shortening with a pastry blender until shortening is the size of peas., Add buttermilk and stir with a fork until dry ingredients are moistened., Turn dough out onto a heavily floured surface and knead lightly 4 or 5 times.

title: Cool Cake
directions: Bake cake as directed for about 25 to 30 minutes in a rectangular pan., Then remove from oven and punch holes all through the cake with a fork., Then pour the condensed milk on the cake, covering it completely., Let cool about 10 minutes., Then mix the rest of the ingredients together and spread over the cake and store in refrigerator.

title: Spam Salad
directions: Cube Spam into 1/2 to 3/4-inch cubes., Put into a pan., Add cooled, cubed potatoes., Add salt and pepper as desired., Add chopped onion., Mix well with sour cream., Before serving, add croutons (do not refrigerate with croutons, they will get mushy). Serve directly on plate or on lettuce leaf as garnish.

title: Microwave Rice
directions: Use 1 part rice to 2 parts water., Wash rice and drain., Add water and salt., Cover microwave dish or Pyrex dish with paper towel., Place in microwave and cook on High for 18 minutes., Let set for 4 to 5 minutes.

title: Hominy Bake
directions: Combine soup, peppers, celery seed, Worcestershire sauce and salt., Place over medium heat until mixture is heated thoroughly. Place hominy in greased baking dish; pour soup mixture over hominy; top with crumbs and almonds., Bake at 300° for 15 minutes., Yields: 12 servings.

title: Boursin Cheese
directions: Cream butter and cheese together., Mix in all spices., Serve at room temperature., Can be frozen.

title: Love Feast Pumpkin Bread(Makes 4 Loaves)
directions: Combine sugar, pumpkin and eggs in large bowl., Blend well. Add oil., Add remaining ingredients., Bake 1 hour or until toothpick inserted comes out clean., Grease baking pans well. Bake at 350°.

title: Two Cheese Fettuccine Primavera
directions: Saute onion and garlic in oil in medium saucepan., Blend in flour and seasonings., Gradually add milk., Cook, stirring constantly, until thickened., Toss hot pasta with sauce and remaining ingredients., Serve immediately., Serves 4.

title: Enchiladas
directions: Brown meat and onions; add seasonings., Dip each tortilla in warm oil., On each one, spoon 2 tablespoons sauce, a generous tablespoon of filling and a sprinkling of cheese; roll up and place together in large pan., Pour remaining sauce and cheese over top., Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Meatless Spaghetti Sauce
directions: In a 2-quart saucepan under medium heat, saute onion, garlic and crushed red pepper in margarine and olive oil until tender. Add basil, oregano and thyme., Pour in stewed tomatoes, roughly chopping up the individual tomatoes to desired consistency., Add tomato paste and mix thoroughly., Mix in the honey and turn down heat to low., Simmer, stirring frequently, for about 20 minutes. Serve with pasta of choice.

title: Salmon Salad
directions: Combine salmon, sour cream, artichokes, green onion, dill, Tabasco sauce, mustard and lemon juice in a blender., Process until firmly chopped., Add remaining ingredients., Process for 1/2 minute., Cover and refrigerate overnight before serving., Makes 4 servings.

title: Duffy'S Poppy Seed Cake
directions: Grease and flour a 10-inch tube or Bundt pan., Stir together the poppy seed and buttermilk; cover and refrigerate overnight. Sift together flour, baking powder, soda and salt., Cream the butter and sugar., Beat in eggs one at a time., Beat in vanilla and grated orange rind., Stir in flour mixture alternately with poppy seed mixture, mixing until just smooth each time., Turn half the batter in prepared pan; sprinkle with sugar, cinnamon mixture; add remaining batter., Bake in 350° oven for 1 hour or until inserted toothpick comes out clean., Place cake on wire rack to cool 10 minutes., Remove cake from pan to cool completely., The cake becomes moist when stored in a tightly covered container for several days.

title: Asparagus Supreme
directions: Blend ingredients together and add asparagus pieces last. Mix and pour into casserole dish.

title: Sugar Cookies
directions: Mix together and refrigerate. Form into walnut size balls and roll in sugar. Place on cookie sheet and press out with the bottom of a glass. Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Seasons Green Beans
directions: Cook beans as directed, then add all ingredients until done. Cook bacon; crumble on top of beans.

title: Ground Beef Casserole
directions: Brown ground beef; add salt and pepper., Add vegetables in layers without mixing., Last, sprinkle rice on top (do not stir). Simmer until done (about 30 to 40 minutes)., Mix before serving. Serves 6.

title: Sensational Double Layer Pumpkin Pie
directions: Mix cream cheese, 1 tablespoon milk and sugar in large bowl with wire whisk until smooth., Gently stir in whipped topping. Spread on bottom of crust., Pour 1 cup milk into bowl., Add pudding mix and beat with wire whisk until well blended, 1 to 2 minutes (mixture will be thick)., Stir in pumpkin and spices using wire whisk; mix well., Spread over cream cheese layer. Refrigerate at least 3 hours., Garnish with additional whipped topping and nuts, if desired., Makes 8 servings.

title: Italian Eggplant Casserole
directions: Cook eggplant and onions in water to cover 20 minutes., Drain and add remaining ingredients., Place in greased casserole and bake in moderate oven at 350° for 30 minutes or until brown. Serves 6.

title: Veal Piccata
directions: With meat mallet, pound cutlets to 1/8-inch thickness., On waxed paper, sprinkle 1/2 teaspoon of salt and 1/4 teaspoon of pepper., Add flour and coat cutlets., In a 12-inch skillet over medium-high heat in hot olive oil and butter, cook veal a few pieces at a time until lightly browned on both sides., Add more olive oil if necessary., Reduce heat to low., Into drippings in skillet, stir water, wine, bouillon and 1/2 teaspoon of salt, scraping to loosen brown bits., Return veal to skillet; cover and simmer 15 minutes until cutlets are tender., Cut 1 lemon and squeeze out juice., Thinly slice the other., Remove cutlets to platter; keep warm., Stir lemon juice in pan., Heat until boiling over high heat., Spoon over cutlets., Garnish with parsley. Serves 8.

title: Macaroni And Cheese
directions: Melt butter in microwave on High; stir in flour until smooth. Microwave 30 to 45, seconds until heated., Blend in milk smoothly. Microwave 4 1/2 to 5 1/2 minutes until thickened, stirring every minute., Stir in cheese until melted, 15 to 20 seconds., Mix in macaroni well., Microwave 5 to 6 minutes, stirring once.

title: Cream Of Broccoli Soup
directions: Cook broccoli according to package directions; drain., Mix soup with milk; stir constantly while heating., Don't boil., Add broccoli, pepper to taste, butter and herb., Heat to bubbly and serve.

title: Squash Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients, pour into greased casserole dish and bake 35-45 minutes at 350 degrees.

title: Sweet Chocolate Pound Cake
directions: Mix flour with sugar, salt, cream of tartar, soda and cinnamon., Cream butter until softened., Add flour mixture, milk and vanilla. Mix until all flour is moistened; then beat 2 minutes at medium speed of electric mixer, scraping bowl occasionally. Add eggs and chocolate., Beat 1 minute longer.

title: Hot Crabmeat Spread
directions: Combine crab, cream cheese and mayonnaise., Add lemon juice, curry powder, Worcestershire sauce and onion to taste., Put in 7 1/2 x 7 1/2 x 1 1/2-inch baking dish; top with cheese and bake at 400° for 30 minutes., Serve with crackers.

title: Blueberry Pie
directions: Combine eggs, sugar and cream cheese., Blend well., Put in pie crust and bake 20 minutes at 375°., Cool and add pie filling., Top with whipped cream., Chill thoroughly before serving.

title: Chocolate Eclair Cake
directions: Mix pudding and milk., Note recipe calls for less milk than package does., Fold in Cool Whip., Line dish with graham crackers. Cover with pudding mix. Finish with crackers on top.

title: Apple Crisp Pudding
directions: Butter casserole dish, add apples and pour water mixed with cinnamon over them., Mix together sugar, flour and butter until crumbly., Spread mixture over apples and bake 40 minutes at 350°.

title: Corn Pudding
directions: Mix first 3 ingredients., Add milk and corn., Mix again., Pour into a casserole baking dish about 2 inches deep., Pour melted butter on top., Bake at 325° for 1 hour.

title: Out-Of-This-World Rolls
directions: Soften yeast in 1/4 cup warm water., In large bowl, combine shortening, sugar, beaten eggs, 1 cup warm, water and salt., Stir in softened yeast and 2 1/2 cups flour., Beat until smooth and blended., Add remaining flour to make a soft dough and mix well. Cover and allow to rise, in a warm place until double in bulk. This takes about 1 hour., Punch down and place in refrigerator overnight., Divide dough in half and roll each portion into a rectangle 1/2-inch thick., Spread with softened butter., Roll each rectangle jelly roll style and cut into 1-inch slices., Place cut side down in greased muffin tins., Cover and let rise 2 hours. Bake at 400° for 15 minutes., Makes 2 dozen large rolls.

title: Banana Nut Bread
directions: Sift flour, baking powder, soda, dry milk, salt and sugar. Add pecans; mix well., Combine beaten eggs, butter, bananas and lemon juice., Add dry ingredients; mix only until flour is moistened., Divide into 6 well-greased loaf pans (3 1/2 x 8 x 2 1/2-inch)., Bake in a 325° oven for 40 to 45 minutes, or until done., Cool thoroughly., Wrap in foil; store overnight., Good for freezing.

title: Onion Roasted Potatoes
directions: Preheat oven to 450°., In a large plastic bag, mix all ingredients except parsley., Close bag and shake until potatoes are evenly coated., Empty potatoes in shallow pan., Bake, stirring occasionally, for 40 minutes or until potatoes are tender and golden brown., Garnish with parsley., Makes 8 servings.

title: Old Fashioned Pumpkin Pie
directions: Mix and pour into pastry., Bake at 375° for 45 minutes or until done.

title: Meringue(That Doesn'T Weep)
directions: Combine in a small saucepan, dry ingredients and water over medium heat, stirring constantly until thick and clear., Beat egg whites until stiff peaks form by gradually adding 4 tablespoons sugar, beating well., Slowly add cooled cooked cornstarch mixture, beating until stiff glossy peaks form., Spread meringue evenly to edge of pie crust to seal all around., Bake in 350° oven for 12 to 15 minutes or until meringue is golden.

title: Carrots Supreme
directions: Cook carrots in a small amount of water until just barely tender; drain., Combine remaining ingredients and pour over carrots., Refrigerate for several hours or overnight.

title: Cucumber Appetizers
directions: Combine Miracle Whip, cream cheese and Good Seasons mix. Spread on slices of cocktail rye bread., Top with a thin slice of cucumber. Sprinkle with dill weed.

title: Hamburger Soup
directions: Boil hamburger meat, potatoes and onion in water until tender. Add Spanish rice, tomatoes, salt and pepper., Cook for 20 minutes over medium heat.

title: Texas Sheet Cake
directions: Sift together first 4 ingredients., Bring to boil in saucepan margarine, shortening, cocoa and water., Remove from heat; add dry ingredients, then add buttermilk, vanilla, baking soda and eggs. Beat and pour into greased and floured large cookie sheet., Bake at 400° for 20 minutes., During last 5 minutes of baking time, make frosting as follows.

title: Ham And Cheesy Potatoes
directions: Slice potatoes and cube cheese. Mix soup and milk until creamy. Layer potatoes, cheese, ham and onion in a greased 9 x 13 inch pan. Pour half the soup over and repeat the layers. Dot with butter. Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until potatoes are tender.

title: Banana Brownie Pie
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., Bake pastry shell 10 minutes., Remove from oven., Reduce temperature to 325°., In small saucepan over low heat, melt chips with butter., In a large mixer bowl, beat chocolate mixture with milk, biscuit mix, eggs and vanilla until smooth., Stir in walnuts., Place bananas on bottom of pastry shell. Pour chocolate mixture over bananas., Bake 50 to 60 minutes or until center is set., Cool., Garnish as desired., Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Pickled Beets
directions: Bring beets to a slow boil; cook until tender and skins peel off easily., At this stage, you just boil the beets in water and then discard this water., Boil remaining ingredients together and add beets., Bring back to a boil., Pack and seal in jars.

title: Peaches N' Cheese Cream Pie
directions: Beat the first 7 ingredients 2 minutes. Pour into greased 10-inch pie pan. Drain the peaches and save juice., Lay peaches on top of batter. Beat the cream cheese, sugar and peach juice for 2 minutes., Spoon on top of peaches., Leave a 1-inch margin. Sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon. Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350°.

title: Wild Strawberry Preserves
directions: To a quart of strawberries, add sugar and water., Boil slowly for 15 minutes., Let stand overnight., Next morning, bring to a boil and pour into jars while hot.

title: Banana Pepper Pie
directions: Line an 8 x 8-inch pan with sliced banana peppers. (May use other peppers.), In a large bowl combine eggs, corn and cheese. Mix well., Pour over peppers in pan., Bake in a 300° oven for 45 minutes.

title: Spinach Dip
directions: Mix all ingredients and chill overnight.

title: Prune Cake
directions: Beat the first 4 ingredients well and set aside., Sift together the flour, cinnamon, nutmeg and allspice., Gradually add dry ingredients to egg mixture., Add prunes, vanilla and walnuts. Pour into greased and floured 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan., Bake at 300° for 1 hour., Glaze while hot.

title: Stuffed Mushrooms
directions: Remove caps from mushrooms and chop the stems., Cut up bacon and fry with mushroom stems., Add onion, pepper and bread crumbs. Stuff mushroom caps with first mixture., Place in buttered shallow baking dish., Salt, cover and refrigerate., Before baking, sprinkle with the Parmesan and basil., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

title: Longhorn Baked Eggs
directions: Grease 6 custard cups or other microwave-safe dishes; set aside., Place equal amounts of bacon and cheese in each cup., Break 1 egg into each cup., In small bowl, mix sour cream, milk and hot sauce until well blended., Spoon 3 tablespoons sour cream mixture around each egg., Gently break egg yolks with fork., Place egg cups in microwave and cover with paper towel., Cook 2 to 3 minutes on Medium power until eggs are set as desired., Garnish with chopped green onions or diced tomatoes.

title: Larry'S Hot Sausage
directions: Cut sausage into bun sized pieces., Cook for 15 minutes; drain., Slice onions and peppers into 1/2-inch strips., Mix whole tomatoes, Sweet 'N Low and tomato sauce with 1 1/2 cans of water. Cook for 15 minutes., Add vegetables and cook another 15 minutes. Add sausage and cook another 15 minutes., Serve with (soft) sausage buns., Makes about 20 sandwiches.

title: Rotini Casserole
directions: Brown ground beef, onion and green pepper; drain., Prepare rotini noodles according to package directions; drain., Mix all ingredients together except cheese., Spread in a 9 x 13-inch pan and cover with cheese., Bake in 350° oven until cheese is melted.

title: Jello Popsicles
directions: Mix, pour into molds and freeze.

title: Coney Island Sauce
directions: Saute ground beef, onion and garlic. Stir frequently until meat is no longer pink (do not brown)., Drain fat off. Add remaining ingredients and cook slowly, uncovered, stirring occasionally, for 2 to 3 hours until sauce thickens. Spoon over hot dogs. Top with chopped onions, if desired.

title: Trifle
directions: Mix pudding mix with milk., Let set until thick., Slice cake very thin., In an attractive bowl, layer the following:

title: No Roll Pie Crust
directions: Put all these ingredients in a bowl and stir together., Pat dough on sides and bottom of pie pan same as a graham cracker crust., Bake in 400° oven for about 7 to 10 minutes (not too brown).

title: Potato And Cabbage Casserole
directions: In large pan, heat butter and saute cabbage and onions until wilted., Place half of the cabbage, onions and potatoes in a 3-quart casserole., Sprinkle with 1 cup cheese., Put remaining cabbage, potato and onion on top., Melt 2 tablespoons butter in same pan cabbage was cooked in., Add 1/4 cup flour., Cook 1 minute., Add can of broth., Cook until thickened., Pour over top of cabbage., Sprinkle remaining cheese over top., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Pork Chops Sweet 'N Sour
directions: Mix first five ingredients. Melt shortening in skillet. Dredge pork chops in flour mixture and brown in hot fat, slowly.

title: Sugar Free Cake
directions: Cook raisins in water until dry., Let cool., Then mix all ingredients well by hand., Bake in lightly greased bundt pan or 9 x 13 x 2 inch pan for 55 - 60 minutes at 350.

title: My Deluxe Meatballs
directions: Mix first five ingredients well., Make into medium size balls. Place in a casserole dish., Mix remaining ingredients and pour over meatballs., Cover!, Bake for 45 minutes to 1 hour in a 375° oven.

title: Ginger Cookies
directions: Cream shortening., Add sugar gradually., Add egg and molasses. Add sifted flour, baking soda, salt and ginger., Roll into balls in sugar., Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Heavenly Fruit Dip
directions: Mix all ingredients, using electric mixer., Use apple wedges, orange slices, banana chunks, pineapple chunks, etc. to dip.

title: Sausage Beef Casserole
directions: Cook sausage; drain., Brown beef; drain., Cook onion and celery in meat fat until tender., Cook rice and drain., Mix all ingredients together except cheese and bake at 350° for 1 hour, adding cheese to top during last 15 minutes.

title: Rhubarb Strawberry Jam
directions: Mix the rhubarb and sugar together and let set overnight., In the morning, boil the mixture for 5 minutes, then add the Jell-O. Stir well., Put in jars to seal., Very good if you like rhubarb strawberry on your toast.

title: Fat-Free Carrot Muffins
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Spray muffin pan cups with grease., In medium bowl, combine flour, 1/2 cup sugar, cinnamon, salt, baking powder and ginger., In a large bowl with whisk or fork, mix carrots, yogurt, egg substitute, applesauce, raisins, brown sugar and vanilla until well blended., With spoon, stir together the 2 mixtures until moistened., Spoon batter into muffin pans., Bake 30 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean., Cool muffins in pans 10 minutes and remove., Sprinkle with powdered sugar., Makes 8 muffins.

title: Pork And Beans
directions: Mix all together and bake at 325° for 2 1/2 hours in a casserole dish, removing cover last 30 minutes.

title: Sausage Balls
directions: Mix and shape into small balls., Cook at 375° for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Aunt T'S String Pie
directions: Cook beef, onion and green pepper in a large skillet over medium high heat until meat is brown, stirring to separate meat. Drain fat., Stir in sauces; mix well., Combine spaghetti, Romano cheese, eggs and butter in large bow; mix well., Place in bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan., Spread Ricotta cheese over top., Pour sauce mixture over Ricotta cheese., Sprinkle Mozzarella cheese over top. Bake in pre-heated oven 350° until cheese melts, approximately 20 minutes.

title: Beef Jerky
directions: Combine sugar, seasoned salt and pepper; place mixture in a shaker., In a shallow pan, arrange layer of meat strips., Sprinkle with seasonings and cover with liquid smoke; repeat layers to use all ingredients., Marinate meat for 8 hours., Place aluminum foil on oven racks., Arrange meat strips on foil in single layer., Set oven temperature at lowest possible setting, leave oven door ajar and bake for 4 to 8 hours or until done to taste.

title: Sweet Potato Bread
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Grease a 4 1/2 x 6 1/2-inch loaf pan., Mix flour and sugar., Stir in pecans., Blend eggs, potatoes, milk and shortening., Add liquid mixture to flour mixture., Stir until blended., Pour into pan., Press pecan halves in top of batter. Bake 1 hour and 10 minutes., Cool 10 minutes before removing from pan.

title: Soppin Chocolate
directions: Mix and cook sugar, cocoa, flour and milk in saucepan until thick., Add vanilla and butter., Pour over hot biscuits.

title: Susan'S Salad
directions: Drain oranges and pineapple., Mix all ingredients except gelatin., Sprinkle dry gelatin over salad and toss lightly.

title: Angel Food Cake
directions: Break cake and press it in a sheet pan bottom., Bring juice and Jell-O to a boil, then add can of pineapple, cottage cheese and Dream Whip., Mix all up in a bowl and pour over cake., Keep in fridge., Really good if you are on a diet.

title: Chinese Fried Rice
directions: In heavy skillet or wok, saute onion in oil until transparent, but not browned., Add rice, water, bouillon cubes, salt and pepper., Bring to a vigorous boil., Cover and cook over low heat until all water is absorbed, about 25 minutes., Stir in eggs and green onions., Cook until eggs are set., Stir in soy sauce.

title: Spiced Tea
directions: Use 3 teaspoons per cup and fill with boiling water.

title: Granny Little'S Pound Cake(In Loving Memory)
directions: Cream margarine, Crisco and sugar., Add eggs, one at a time. Add flour (presifted with baking powder) alternately with flavoring., Bake at 325° to 350° for 1 hour.

title: Lemon Meringue Pie
directions: Mix until thick; pour into pie shell.

title: Shipwreck Stew
directions: In a skillet, brown ground beef with onion over medium heat. Drain fat., In a 3-quart casserole, combine beef mixture with all remaining ingredients., Cover and bake at 350° for about 2 hours or until rice and potatoes are tender.

title: Veggies With Horseradish Cream
directions: In large saucepan fitted with steam basket, bring 1/2 cup water to boil; place vegetables in basket and cook, covered, 4 minutes; remove saucepan from heat.

title: Hawaiian Chicken Salad
directions: Toss together all ingredients except almonds and lettuce leaves., Put almonds on top., Serve 6.

title: Cranberry Salad
directions: Mix first 5 ingredients., Sweeten this mixture to your taste. Mix cherry Jell-O according to box directions, but use pineapple juice instead of water., Let jell until syrupy, then add the cranberry relish., Let set at least 2 hours., Best when sets overnight.

title: Swiss Mushroom Chicken
directions: Flatten chicken to 1/4-inch thick. In a shallow bowl, lightly beat the egg. Combine cracker crumbs and salt in another shallow bowl. Dip chicken in egg, then in crumbs. Set aside. In a large ovenproof skillet, saute mushrooms in 1 tablespoon butter until tender. Remove and set aside. In same skillet, melt remaining butter. Add chicken; cook over medium heat 3 to 4 minutes. Top with ham, mushrooms and cheese. Broil until cheese is melted.

title: Chinese Marinated Vegetable Salad
directions: Combine vinegar, sugar, salt and pepper., Blend well., Combine remaining ingredients in a large bowl., Pour marinade over vegetables., Refrigerate at least 2 days before serving., Drain marinade from vegetables to serve., Yields 12 to 15 servings.

title: Hungarian Goulash
directions: Melt shortening in a large skillet., Add beef, onion and garlic., Cook and stir until meat is brown and onion is tender. Stir in catsup, mustard, Worcestershire sauce, sugar, salt, paprika and 1 1/2 cups water., Cover, simmer for 2 to 2 1/2 hours., Blend flour and 1/4 cup water; stir gradually into meat mixture., Heat to boiling, stirring constantly., Boil and stir one minute., Serve over buttered noodles., Yield:, 6 to 8 servings.

title: Special Tea
directions: Mix all ingredients thoroughly., Store and pack in jars or tin cans.

title: Squash Casserole
directions: Cook first three ingredients in a small amount of salted water and drain., Mix sour cream and soup with vegetables., Add butter to dressing., Layer dressing, then squash in buttered casserole dish and finish with dressing., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Hash Brown Casserole
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Mix all ingredients, except potatoes. Stir in potatoes., Pour into ungreased 8 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish or 2-quart casserole., Bake for 45 to 50 minutes, uncovered.

title: Company Shrimp Boil
directions: Fill a large pot with water to cover ingredients. Add shrimp and crab boil seasoning., When water comes to a boil, add sausage and corn. Boil 10 minutes., Add shrimp and boil 3 minutes., Drain and serve with butter for the corn and cocktail sauce for the shrimp., Cole slaw and favorite beverage completes the meal.

title: Orange-Date-Nut Cake
directions: Pour into greased and floured tube pan., Bake at 325° for 1 1/2 hours., While hot, punch many holes with ice pick., Pour glaze over cake., Let stand several hours before serving.

title: Crunch Bars
directions: Bring Karo syrup and white sugar to a boil., Add peanut butter., Mix well., Add Special K cereal., Mix well and put in a 9 x 13-inch pan., Melt in double boiler the chocolate chips and butterscotch chips., Pour over Special K mixture.

title: Cheese Ball
directions: Soften the cream cheese and mix with the shredded cheese. Drain the pimentos and chilies and mix in with the above ingredients., Put in a wreath mold for Christmas and decorate with sliced green olives and a bow., You can also use chopped walnuts.

title: Turnip Greens Casserole
directions: Blend all ingredients together except crumbs and cheese., Spoon into casserole, cover top with bread crumbs and cheese., Bake 1 hour at 350°., This dish multiplies well for a big crowd., Serves 6 to 8.

title: Japanese Fruit Pie
directions: Pour butter over sugar. Add eggs and vinegar., Mix well., Fold in remaining filling ingredients., Pour into pie shell and bake at 300° for 45 minutes or until done.

title: Golden Cream Soup
directions: In large saucepan, combine potatoes, water, celery, carrots, onion, parsley flakes, bouillon and seasonings; mix well., Cover; simmer for 15 to 20 minutes, or until vegetables are tender. Gradually add milk to flour, mixing until well blended., Add milk mixture to vegetables; cook until thickened., Add Velveeta; stir until melted., Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Fiesta Meat Loaf
directions: Saute onion, celery and green pepper in butter until tender. Stir in chili sauce., Combine 1/2 cup this mixture with ground beef, bread crumbs, egg, salt and pepper., Form into a loaf in shallow baking pan., Bake in 350° oven for 1 hour., Let stand 5 minutes before slicing., Serve remaining sauce, cold or hot, over meat loaf., Yields 6 servings.

title: Mexican Bean Salad
directions: Combine all ingredients except dressing, Fritos and cheese Add the French dressing. Allow a few hours to marinate in the dressing., Add cheese and Fritos before serving.

title: Chocolate Pound Cake
directions: Have all ingredients at room temperature., Cream shortening and butter., Add sugar and beat at medium speed for 5 minutes., Add egg yolks and beat until the yolks disappear., Stir flour, baking powder, salt and cocoa together., Add to creamed mixture alternately with buttermilk, beginning and ending with flour., Add vanilla., Fold in the beaten egg whites., Pour into a 10-inch tube pan that has been greased and floured., Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 15 minutes., Let cool in pan for 30 minutes., Remove from pan., May be iced with your favorite chocolate icing.

title: Pigs In Blankets
directions: Take each frank., Wrap 1/2 slice cheese around it., Take 1 piece bacon and wrap over the frank and cheese., Wrap 1 biscuit around frank., Continue until ingredients are used up., Place on cookie sheet and bake at 450° until golden brown., Serve hot.

title: Chewy Bars
directions: Heat butter in pan in 350° oven until melted., Sprinkle graham cracker crumbs evenly over butter., Press down with fork. Sprinkle chocolate chips and coconut over crumbs., Drizzle condensed milk evenly over top., Cover with marshmallows., Bake in 350° oven for 20 to 25 minutes., Refrigerate for one hour before cutting into bars.

title: Friendship Tea Mix
directions: Combine all ingredients., Store in tightly closed jar. Combine 1 tablespoon of mix and 1 cup of hot water in a mug; add sugar., Makes 2 1/2 cups of mix.

title: Cherry Nut Bread
directions: Combine all ingredients except cherries in a mixing bowl. Blend on low speed of electric mixer 15 seconds; increase to medium speed and blend 30 additional seconds., Stir in cherries. Pour batter into a greased and floured 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Bake at 350°, for 1 hour and 10 to 15 minutes, or until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean., Cool 10 minutes in pan; remove to wire rack and cool completely., Yields 1 loaf.

title: Hot Crab Triangles
directions: Preheat oven to 400°., Beat cheese until fluffy., Combine mustard with milk and add to cheese with salt, cayenne, crab meat, chives, and almonds., Mix well and spread generously on bread slices., Sprinkle lightly with paprika., Cut each slice in 4 triangles; put on a baking sheet and bake for 10 to 12 minutes, or until well browned.

title: Sweet Potato Pie
directions: Boil potatoes, peel and mash while hot., Add butter, beat eggs with half of sugar., Add to potatoes and butter mixture., Add milk and rest of sugar., Mix in spices (should be creamy)., Pour into pie shells, bake in oven at 350° for one hour or until custard is set and a toothpick comes out clean., Makes 2 (9-inch) pies.

title: One Step Pie Crust
directions: Mix together all ingredients., With hands, form dough to fit pie pan.

title: Crabmeat Au Gratin
directions: Cook butter and onion until tender., Add flour until mixed well., Add milk, salt and pepper and cook until thickens a little. Add sherry and crab meat.

title: Apple Crisp
directions: Spread sliced apples in 9 x 9-inch pan., Sprinkle with water, cinnamon and salt., Work remaining ingredients together until crumbly., Use pastry blender, fork or fingers., Spread over apples., Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

title: Pineapple Dessert Cake
directions: Follow directions on box for cake mix. Bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Cool. With electric mixer, beat cream cheese, milk and pudding until thick. Spread over cooled cake., Spread drained pineapple over creamed mixture. Top with Cool Whip., Sprinkle with some chopped nuts and coconut., Keep in refrigerator until served.

title: Round Steak
directions: Melt shortening in a skillet., Cut round steak in sections. Brown until done., Empty cans of mushroom soup and stir together. Let simmer for about 1 hour.

title: Barbecue Ribs
directions: Prepare ribs., Remove excess fat, wash and pat dry with paper towel., Place ribs in baking pan; sprinkle with salt and pepper. Cover with chopped onions and chopped celery., Sprinkle with Worcestershire sauce., Bake slowly in 325° oven until tender (approximately 1 1/2 hours)., Drain fat and pour 1/2 bottle or more barbecue sauce over ribs and return to oven for 1/2 hour, baste occasionally and remove from oven.

title: Pumpkin Crisp
directions: Combine and mix first 6 ingredients. Spread in 9 x 13 baking pan. Sprinkle 2/3 of spice cake mix on top. Sprinkle on top of cake mix the chopped walnuts. Drizzle butter over top. Bake for 50 minutes at 350°.

title: Poppy Seed Cake With Anise Hyssop
directions: Combine and set aside buttermilk, poppy seed, almond extract and anise hyssop flowers., Cream butter and sugar., Add egg yolks and beat., Sift together flour, soda, baking powder and salt. Alternately add with buttermilk mixture., Fold in beaten egg whites., Pour half the batter in a greased tube or bundt pan. Sprinkle half of the sugar-cinnamon mixture on batter and add the remaining batter and the remaining sugar mixture., Cut through batter with knife for marble effect., Bake 1 hour at 350°.

title: Ice Cream Party Punch
directions: Put pineapple juice, sherbet and ice cream in large mixing bowl and mix together., When ready to serve, add ginger ale. Makes 24 servings.

title: Corn Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients together except margarine. Melt oleo and pour into 9 x 12 casserole dish. Pour mixed ingredients over melted oleo. Do not stir. Bake 1 hour in 325° oven.

title: Peach Frostee
directions: In a blender, combine canned sliced peaches, dry milk powder, vanilla and cinnamon., Cover and blend until smooth., Add five ice cubes, one at a time with the motor running., Blend until smooth. Makes 4 servings., Calories per serving:, 115., Diabetic exchanges per serving:, milk 1, vegetable 0, fruit 1/2, bread 0, meat 0 and fat 0.

title: Bartley'S Pasta Salad
directions: Cook pasta in boiling water until just done and rinse in cold water., Add enough salad dressing to thoroughly coat the pasta. Add Parmesan cheese and vegetables., You may use any other vegetable you choose., Enjoy!, This makes enough for 10.
