title: German'S Sweet Chocolate Cake
directions: Melt chocolate in boiling water; cool., Sift flour, soda and salt., Cream butter and sugar well., Add egg yolks one at a time, beating after each., Blend in vanilla and melted chocolate., Add flour mixture alternately with buttermilk, beating after each addition., Fold in beaten egg whites., Pour into 3 (9-inch) greased and floured layer pans., Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes., Cool in pans 15 minutes., Remove and cool on rack.

title: Taco Salad
directions: Brown ground beef; drain and add seasoning mix., Let cool. Mix cream cheese and chip dip together., Spread creamed mix in a 9 x 13-inch pan., Layer with meat mixture, lettuce, tomato and cheese., Refrigerate., Serve with nacho chips.

title: Shrimp Chowder
directions: Cube potatoes and carrots., Add remaining vegetables., Simmer in water with salt and chicken bouillon for 20 minutes., Add cheese, allow to melt., Add milk and shrimp and Worcestershire. Simmer gently, stirring from bottom frequently., Do not boil. Thicken with cornstarch and water., Serve with salad and toasted French bread.

title: Sausage Egg Casserole
directions: Beat eggs., Cook sausage and onion., Drain grease., Mix all ingredients and bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes., When set in the middle it is ready to eat., Can be prepared the night before and cooked in the morning.

title: Quiche Lorraine
directions: Sprinkle bacon, cheese and onion in unbaked 9-inch pie shell. In a bowl, add the rest of the ingredients and mix well., Pour over the bacon and cheese mixture., Bake in a 400° oven for 15 minutes., Reduce temperature to 300° and bake 30 minutes longer or until knife inserted 1-inch from edge comes out clean., Let stand 10 minutes; cut into wedges and serve.

title: Dot'S Spaghetti Casserole
directions: Brown meat and onions., In another pan place tomato soup and 2 cans of water., Add chopped green pepper and olive juice., Boil for a few minutes., Add Worcestershire sauce., Cook and drain spaghetti or vermicelli., Put in large container., Add meat, sauce and cheese to spaghetti., Mix well., Put in 2 casseroles (13 x 9-inch). Spread can of undiluted mushroom soup on top of each., Decorate with sliced olives., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Vegetable Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients, adding beans last. Dot with butter., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: German Chocolate Pie
directions: Combine sugar, cornstarch, flour, cocoa and salt., Add eggs, butter and milk, then coconut, nuts and vanilla., Pour into unbaked pastry shell and bake at 400° for 35 to 40 minutes., Top should be crusty and firm., The center should become more firm as it cools.

title: Wonderful Meat Loaf
directions: Soak bread in milk., Add meat, eggs, onions, salt, pepper and soup., Mix thoroughly., Shape in 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan., Combine brown sugar, catsup, nutmeg and mustard; spread over meat loaf. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Corn Relish
directions: In a 6 to 8-quart saucepot, combine all ingredients., Bring to a boil over medium-high heat, stirring occasionally., Reduce heat to medium and cook 15 minutes, stirring occasionally., Remove bay leaf., Immediately fill hot pint or half pint jars with mixture, leaving 1/2-inch headspace., Carefully run a utensil down inside of jar to remove trapped air bubbles., Wipe jar tops and threads clean., Place hot lids on jars and screw bands on firmly. Process pints or half-pints in boiling water canner for 15 minutes., Makes 5 to 6 pints or 10 to 12 half pints.

title: Poor Man'S Filet Mignon
directions: Combine first 8 ingredients and 2 tablespoons barbecue sauce. Form into 12 thick patties., Wrap bacon slice around the sides of each patty and secure with a toothpick. Bake on a rack at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes or until done. Baste frequently with barbecue sauce the last 30 minutes. Serves 12.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Mix flour and soda., Combine butter, sugar and pudding mix in large bowl., Beat until smooth. Beat in eggs., Gradually add flour mixture., Stir in oats and raisins., Batter will be stiff., Drop by rounded teaspoon about 2 inches apart., Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Spaghetti Ala Carbonara*
directions: Mix cream, egg, Parmesan cheese and bacon together., Toss with cooked spaghetti., Sprinkle with salt, Parmesan cheese and plenty of freshly ground black pepper., Serve immediately!

title: Italian Chocolate Cookies(A Very Old Recipe)
directions: Make enough perked coffee to cover raisins., Pour over raisins and let cool.

title: Potluck Potatoes
directions: Place unpeeled potatoes in a large saucepan and cover with water., Cook just until tender, but firm., Drain and cut potatoes into 1-inch cubes., Place in an ungreased 2 1/2-quart baking dish. Add pimientos, onion, garlic and onion salt; toss gently. Sprinkle with cheese., Place bread cubes on top and pour melted margarine over all., Bake at 350°, uncovered, for 30 minutes or until bread is toasted., Makes 10 to 12 servings.

title: Stuffed Cherry Tomatoes
directions: In a mixing bowl, blend cream cheese, mayonnaise and salad dressing mix until smooth., Slice a thin slice off tops of tomatoes and carefully remove insides., Invert on paper towel to drain., Fill with cream cheese mixture., Yield: 12 to 16 servings.

title: Tutti-Frutti
directions: Do not drain fruit., Mix and chill first 6 ingredients., Just before serving, add bananas., Serve plain or with whipped topping.

title: Chilled Summer Squash Soup
directions: In a large saucepan, place all the squash., Add the onion, garlic, broth, salt and pepper., Bring to a boil, cover, reduce heat and simmer for 20 to 25 minutes or until the vegetables are very tender., Allow to cool slightly; puree in a food processor or blender with basil, parsley and lemon juice until smooth., Place in a container, cover and refrigerate for 6 hours or overnight., When ready to serve, add the buttermilk., Whisk until smooth and adjust the seasonings with salt and pepper., Serve chilled and garnished with chopped basil and parsley., Serves 6.

title: Golden Cheesy Potatoes
directions: Peel and quarter potatoes., Combine flour, cheese, salt and pepper in plastic bag., Moisten potatoes., Drop in bag and shake well., Melt margarine in 13 x 9-inch baking dish., Arrange potatoes in one layer., Bake at 425°., Turn once.

title: Instant Russian Tea
directions: Mix all ingredients together well and store in a tightly covered jar., Use 1-2 tsp. per cup of hot water.

title: Made-In-The-Shade Pork Chops
directions: In shaker jar, combine lemonade concentrate, soy sauce and seasonings., Shake ingredients vigorously to blend., Pour half of marinade into shallow pan and add chops in single layer., Pour remaining marinade over steaks; cover pan and place in refrigerator approximately 24 hours., Meat should be turned once or twice during refrigeration., Remove from refrigerator three or four hours before grilling., Grill over medium coals 40 to 45 minutes., Baste steaks occasionally with remaining marinade.

title: Wilted Lettuce Salad(Microwave)
directions: Cook, bacon, loosely covered with paper towel in microwave oven, for, 3, to 3 1/2 minutes or until crisp., Reserve 2 tablespoons, of drippings., Tear lettuce into small pieces and combine, with onion in salad bowl., Refrigerate until ready to serve., Combine, vinegar,, reserved, bacon, drippings,, sugar, water, salt,, mustard and pepper in 1 cup glass measuring cup. Cook uncovered, in, a, microwave for 1 minute or until mixture boils,, stirring, to, dissolve sugar., Pour over salad greens, tossing, to coat well., Garnish with crumbled bacon and radish slices., Serves 6.

title: Blueberry Delight
directions: Line a 9-inch square pan with whole graham crackers, breaking crackers if necessary., Prepare pudding as directed on package. Let stand 5 minutes, then blend in whipped topping., Spread 1/2 mixture over crackers., Add another layer of crackers; top with remaining pudding mixture and remaining crackers., Spread pie filling over top layer of crackers., Chill 3 hours., (Best if done a day ahead.)

title: Strawberries In The Snow
directions: Line bottom of bowl with 1/2 cake that has been broken into pieces., Mix together milk, cream cheese, and sugar., Mix in Cool Whip and beat with mixer until smooth., Pour 1/2 of the mixture over first layer of cake., Repeat layers., Pour pie filling on top.

title: Cinnamon Pound Cake
directions: Grease a 10-inch tube pan., Set aside., Preheat oven to 325°. In a large mixing bowl, cream butter and sugar until smooth., Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each., Combine flour, baking powder, 1/2 teaspoon soda, cocoa and cinnamon; add alternately with sour cream, beating after each addition., Stir in vanilla., Pour into prepared pan., Bake for 75 minutes, or until done., Cool in pan 10 minutes., Take off wire rack; cool completely.

title: Creamy Squash Casserole
directions: Wash squash. Slice in rounds, fairly thin. Salt, pepper and roll in flour., Have cooking oil medium-hot and fry until crisp and golden brown. Serve while hot.

title: Turkey Dressing
directions: Mix together., Add water until soupy., Stuff turkey., Put water in bottom of pan with turkey., Bake 3 hours; 45 minutes at 400° and the balance at 325°.

title: Oven Fried Potatoes
directions: Mix together oil, Parmesan cheese, salt, garlic powder, paprika and pepper., Dip potatoes in mixture., Bake at 375° for 45 minutes.

title: Veg-All Casserole
directions: Mix and add 1 roll Ritz crackers (crushed) on top., Dot with butter., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Granny'S Kitchen
directions: Dissolve yeast in warm water., Sift dry ingredients into a large bowl., Cut in shortening., Add buttermilk, then yeast mixture., Stir until thoroughly moistened., Turn out onto floured board and knead a minute or two., Roll out to 1/4-inch thickness and cut with a biscuit cutter., Place on greased baking sheet. Let rise for 30 minutes., Bake at 425° for 15 minutes or until brown., Brush tops with melted butter., Yield:, 60 (2-inch) biscuits.

title: Lima Bean Soup
directions: Soak dried beans overnight., Wash thoroughly and put in pot of boiling water., Add chopped onion and cubed potatoes., Add seasonings to taste., Bring to a boil, then cook on low until beans are done and soup is thick., Mash beans with wooden spoon while in the pot., Remove hot pepper., Add olive oil and sherry and simmer another 15 minutes., If sausage is added, omit olive oil and add sausage along with potatoes and onion, but boil sausage separately first to remove fat.

title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
directions: Set aside in bowl the nuts, cinnamon and sugar., Cream butter. Add white sugar., Add the eggs and beat fast., Measure flour, baking powder and salt., Grease and flour Bundt pan., Add dry ingredients to egg mixture alternately with sour cream and vanilla., Mix thoroughly., Put 1/2 batter in cake pan., Spread filling over the rest of batter., Bake at 325° for 45 minutes. Cool in pan on rack for 1/2 hour., Freezes nicely., Thaw covered. Better the older it gets.

title: Ed Mcmahon'S Turkey Dressing(Celebrity Recipe)
directions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl., Stuff into neck and body cavities of turkey., If preferred, bake in separate pan. Enough stuffing for a 16 pound turkey.

title: Corn Salad
directions: Combine vegetables, tossing lightly., Combine remaining ingredients; mix well., Pour over vegetables and toss lightly. Cover and chill overnight., Drain well before serving.

title: Veg-All Casserole
directions: Mix Veg-All, sour cream, mayonnaise and cheese., Place in casserole dish., Crush crackers and mix with melted butter. Spread on vegetable mixture and bake at 300° for 30 minutes.

title: Goulash
directions: Brown and crumble hamburger meat in large skillet., Chop up onion and bell pepper., Add to hamburger meat., Brown until soft. Add tomatoes and enough water to make gravy., Add seasonings. Cook on low heat 45 minutes., Add noodles., Cook 10 minutes or until noodles are done., Serve with corn bread and salad.

title: Creamy Dill Dip
directions: Mix together in blender or food processor until smooth.

title: Chicken Cacciatore
directions: Wash chicken, pat dry with paper towels., Heat oil and butter in 6-quart Dutch oven., Add chicken, a few pieces at a time, and brown well on all sides. Remove as browned., Return chicken to Dutch oven; add tomato sauce, tomatoes, wine, basil, oregano, garlic, parsley, salt and pepper., Simmer, covered for 45 to 50 minutes, or until chicken is tender., Combine flour with 3 tablespoons water; stir into sauce., Add mushrooms; cook 10 minutes longer or until sauce is thickened., Makes 6 servings.

title: Vegetable Casserole
directions: Gradually mix the ingredients, except cracker crumbs and melted margarine, together into a large bowl, then pour into a casserole bowl., Add the crushed crackers evenly on top, then spread the melted margarine evenly on top., Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Sauerkraut Salad
directions: Drain sauerkraut., Add remaining ingredients and toss lightly. Use only enough mayonnaise to moisten the mixture., Chill well about 1 to 5 hours before serving.

title: Banana Split Cake
directions: Spread crumbs into a 13 x 9-inch pan., Make pudding and pour over crumbs., Slice bananas over pudding., Cover with Cool Whip. Layer on strawberries and pineapple., Sprinkle on coconut.

title: Sausage And Salsa Skillet Dinner
directions: Cut sausage in half lengthwise, cut crosswise into 1/4-inch slices., In 10-inch skillet, combine rice, sausage, tomatoes, water, salsa and beans., Mix well, breaking tomatoes with large spoon., Bring to boil, reduce heat, cover and simmer 20 minutes. Remove from heat, let stand, covered, about 5 minutes., Makes 4 servings.

title: Roast Fresh Ham
directions: In a bowl, mix all ingredients together except ham., Remove rind from ham. Score fat with a knife., Rub mixture over ham. Wrap ham in foil or plastic and refrigerate overnight., Heat oven to 425°., Unwrap ham., Place in a 13 x 9-inch cake pan., Roast, uncovered, for 20 minutes., Reduce heat to 325°., Baste with drippings every 30 minutes for about 4 hours or until meat thermometer registers 160° internal temperature.

title: Hot German Potato Salad
directions: Cut bacon in 1-inch pieces and fry., Reserve 2 tablespoons bacon grease., Blend sugar, onion, flour and seasonings into grease in large frying pan. Gradually add water and vinegar. Boil 1 minute. Add potatoes and bacon. Cook 5 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Snickers Bar Dessert
directions: Mix vanilla pudding according to directions on package., Stir in Cool Whip., Add 2 chopped Snickers., Pour over crust., Sprinkle with chopped nuts., This makes 1 large 9-inch pie or 1 (9 x 13-inch) pan.

title: Egg Custard
directions: 1st Layer:, Mix 1 cup plain flour, 1 tablespoon sugar, 1 1/2 cups pecan pieces and 1 stick melted butter., Press in bottom of 12-inch rectangular Pyrex (or 10-inch round)., Bake for 10 minutes at 375° or until light brown., Chill or allow to cool completely.

title: Hearty Chicken Soup
directions: Boil chicken breasts until done and cool., Debone and chop into bite sized pieces., Save approximately 3 cups of water boiled in., Chop celery, carrots, onion and garlic into fine pieces.

title: Somen Noodle Salad
directions: Rinse lettuce., Drain well., Tear into small pieces., Clean and slice mushrooms., Rinse cucumber, green pepper, onion and tomatoes, sliced., Combine all ingredients in a salad bowl. Garnish with green onions.

title: Squash Souffle
directions: Chop squash and onion; cook until tender and drain well., Mix in all other ingredients and stir in saltines., Place in buttered casserole and bake at 325° for 25 minutes.

title: Scalloped Potatoes And Pork Chops
directions: Brown pork chops on each side; drain., Arrange potatoes in a 9 x 12-inch casserole, lightly coated with nonstick spray., Mix water, soup and sour cream in small bowl; pour over potatoes. Arrange pork chops on top., Season with salt and pepper., Bake, covered, at 375° for 1 1/4 hours.

title: Caesar Salad(Serves 6)
directions: Remove	crusts	from bread and spread butter lightly on each side., Place, in large skillet over moderate heat.	Add a little of	the, remaining	butter., Brown	bread on each side, drain on paper, towels, and	cube., Beat, eggs slightly., Add olive	oil, lemon juice, Parmesan cheese, mustard, pepper and garlic.	Beat until, blended., Toss, romaine,, dressing, and croutons.

title: Carrot Tuna Noodle Salad
directions: Mix carrots, celery and tuna together., Add mayonnaise., Just before serving, add noodles., Serves about 6.

title: Donuts
directions: Cut, small, hole in middle of biscuits., I use medicine bottle., Deep fry biscuits and the holes until brown., Roll in powdered sugar.

title: Starlight Mint Surprise Cookies
directions: Sift flour, baking soda and salt., In separate bowl, cream butter, sugar and brown sugar., Blend in eggs, water and vanilla. Add dry ingredients and mix thoroughly., Cover and refrigerate 2 hours., Put about 1 tablespoon of dough around each mint., Place on greased baking sheet, about 3 inches apart., Top with walnut half., Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Pork Tenderloin
directions: Mix marinade ingredients together and marinate meat overnight. Bake at 350° for 1 hour (uncovered).

title: Mama'S Fudge
directions: Boil until it forms a ball in cold water, then beat and pour into pan to set.

title: Hot! Hot! Dogs
directions: Mix together and simmer for one hour (covered)., Then add 2 cups of water., Cook one more hour., Serve hot., May be put in containers to freeze, if desired.

title: Food, Facts And Fancy Cream Of Potato-Vegetable Chicken Soup
directions: Dice bacon and place in heavy saucepan., Cook, but do not brown. Remove extra fat. Add diced onion and diced celery., Saute 2 to 3 minutes., Add potato, broth and bouillon., Cook until potato is almost (soft) tender., Add frozen carrots and peas, celery slices, mushroom slices, diced chicken, milk, chicken broth and herb blend.

title: Cheese Broccoli
directions: Melt butter. Add flour to make gravy. Add milk to thicken. Once thickened, add cheese. Arrange broccoli stems facing in the middle. Pour cheese sauce over the broccoli.

title: Eggplant Casserole
directions: Cut peeled eggplant into 1-inch cubes and soak in salt water in refrigerator 6 hours., Drain eggplant., Place in pan., Cover with water and simmer until soft., Soak cornbread in milk., Saute onions, green pepper and celery in butter until all are tender. Combine cooked eggplant, bread crumbs and sauteed vegetables., Add eggs, pimento and seasoning., Thoroughly blend and place in greased baking dish., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes, then top with grated cheese and return to oven until cheese melts.

title: Summer Salad
directions: Dissolve jello in hot water., Stir in marshmallows until almost dissolved., Add cream cheese., Fold in rest of ingredients and mix thoroughly., Put in an 8 x 8-inch Pyrex dish and refrigerate.

title: Popcorn Balls
directions: Stir jello, sugar and syrup all together., Bring to a full boil., Remove from heat and add the baking soda, stirring to mix. Pour over popcorn stirring so all corn is coated., Grease hands with butter and form into balls.

title: No Bake Cookies
directions: Mix and cook 1 minute for each batch, then stir in oatmeal mixture until thick., Drop onto wax paper., Makes 2 dozen.

title: Sausage Balls
directions: In large bowl, mix Bisquick, cheese and sausage meat; add salt and pepper., Mix well and roll in small ball., Place in refrigerator half a day or night., Cut bacon in three strips and wrap each ball with a strip of bacon., Lap ends and stick toothpick in to hold in place., Place on cookie sheet and bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Snickerdoodles
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., Mix together cinnamon and sugar in a small bowl., In a medium bowl, beat butter and sugar until light and fluffy., Beat in egg and vanilla until blended., Sift flour, baking soda, baking powder or salt over sugar mixture., Stir with wooden spoon to make a stiff dough., Shape dough into walnut-size balls., Roll in cinnamon/sugar mixture to coat., Place balls about 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet., Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes, or until lightly browned., Cool on wire racks.

title: Custard Pie
directions: Keep half of egg whites to put in last., Bake at 450° for 10 to 15 minutes, then to 375° to finish., For 2 pies.

title: Cool Veggie Pizza Or Mexican Siesta Pizza
directions: *For Mexican Siesta, add 2 tablespoons of sour cream and 2 tablespoons of taco mix., Omit mayo and dill.

title: Ben Grayson'S Barbecue Sauce
directions: Cook onions in butter until soft., Add other ingredients and simmer 15 minutes (preferably 30)., Makes about 2 1/2 cups and will be thick.

title: Chinese Barbecued Spareribs
directions: Place ribs on baking sheet. With sharp knife, cut meat between bones. Crush garlic and blend with other ingredients. Spoon sauce on both sides and into cuts. Bake in 400° oven for 20 minutes on each side. Serves 4.

title: Meal-In-A-Dish
directions: Combine all ingredients in covered pan or casserole dish or Dutch oven., Cook in 300° oven for 3 1/2 to 4 hours., If it gets too dry, add water to make right consistency., Serve over rice or noodles.

title: Chicken Spaghetti
directions: Bone chicken and chip up meat., Boil spaghetti in chicken broth., Cook vegetables in margarine until onions are transparent. Mix chicken, spaghetti and vegetables with mushroom soup., Cook around 40 minutes in a 300° oven.

title: German Chocolate Cake
directions: Melt chocolate in boiling water., Cool., Cream margarine and sugar until light and fluffy., Add egg yolks one at a time., Beat after each addition., Add chocolate, vanilla, buttermilk and flour to the egg mixture, beating slowly until smooth., Add the soda mixture and fold in the egg whites., Bake in layers or in a long, flat pan., Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Cabbage Casserole
directions: Cook cabbage, drain and place in 2-quart lightly greased casserole dish., Melt cheese in soup, pour over cabbage., Place corn bread crumbs on top., Bake at 350°, until hot and bubbly or brown.

title: Apple Crisp
directions: Peel, core and slice apples., Mix with cinnamon and sugar. Arrange in 9 x 13-inch dish., Melt oleo and add to remaining dry ingredients., Spoon over apple mixture., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes., Keep covered with foil and last 15 minutes, uncover to crisp up the topping.

title: Estofado
directions: In 10-inch skillet, brown beef cubes in hot oil., Stir in wine, undrained tomatoes, onion, green pepper, raisins, apricots, salt, pepper and garlic., In a cheesecloth bag, combine basil, thyme, tarragon and bay leaf., Add to meat mixture and simmer, covered, for 1 hour., Stir mushrooms and olives into stew. Simmer, covered, 30 minutes more., Discard herb bag., Blend cold water with flour; stir into stew., Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly., Serve over rice., Makes 6 servings.

title: Cinnamon Nuts
directions: Mix cinnamon into sugar; add cream and mix well., Cook on medium-low heat, stirring constantly; cook to 240°., Remove from heat., Add vanilla and nuts., Stir until syrup coats nuts., Spread on wax paper to cool., Break into pieces.

title: Pineapple Cheese Ball
directions: In medium bowl with fork, beat cream cheese until smooth. Gradually stir in crushed pineapple, 1 cup pecans, green pepper, onion and salt., Shape into a ball. Roll in remaining nuts., Wrap in plastic film or foil., Refrigerate until well chilled, overnight.

title: Fruit Cobbler
directions: Mix fruit, tapioca and sugar., Pour in ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan., Mix other ingredients and drop by spoonfuls on top of fruit. Bake 40 minutes at 350°.

title: Diet Refrigerator Pickles
directions: Put your sliced cucumbers or any cut up vegetables in mixture. Cover and store in refrigerator., Eat whenever hungry.

title: Salmon Cakes
directions: Combine ingredients., Refrigerate for 30 minutes., Form patties and coat with seafood breader., Pan-fry.

title: Johnny Marzette
directions: Brown meat in margarine., Mix all ingredients together., Put into a 14 x 9-inch roasting pan., Sprinkle top with 2 cups grated American cheese., Bake at 350° for 35 minutes., Serves 12.

title: Gloria'S Fried Pie Dough
directions: Sift dry ingredients together and cut in shortening., Add liquid ingredients and refrigerate., This can be stored several days and used as needed., For fried pies, I roll out a thin saucer-sized circle of dough., Fill with desired fruit and fold in half., Press edges with fork and fry in skillet with a little bit of shortening., This dough is very easy to work with and tastes great.

title: Papaya Seed Dressing
directions: Put vinegar and dry ingredients in blender with motor running. Add oil in steady stream., Add onion, then papaya seed and blend until seed looks coarsely ground., Chill for 1 hour., Good on fruit or green salads.

title: Egg Nog
directions: Beat eggs and sugar together., Beat in milk and vanilla. Serve very cold, sprinkled with nutmeg., Serve immediately., Makes 2 to 4 servings.

title: Cauliflower With Cheese
directions: Let cauliflower stand in salted water 20 to 30 minutes and rinse. Cover with water. Add the salt and garlic (if desired). Bring to a boil. Simmer 20 to 25 minutes or until tests done. Drain and place on serving dish. Top with Cheese Sauce and Buttered Bread Crumbs.

title: Vegetable Quiche
directions: Saute onions, zucchini and garlic in margarine or oil. Prebake 1 pie crust until slightly cooked., Mix together cheese, eggs, milk and dash of Tabasco sauce., Add sauteed vegetables to egg mixture., Pour into crust., Bake at about 350° until set, about 45 to 60 minutes., Sprinkle Parmesan cheese on top after it is baked.

title: Sausage Pepper Quiche
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., Grate cheeses; set aside., Cook sausages and drain., In a skillet, saute vegetables in the butter until soft., In a large bowl, combine and whisk half and half, milk, eggs and seasonings., In pie crusts, layer sausages, vegetable mixture and cheeses, two layers per pie., Pour milk over layers., Sprinkle with Parmesan and paprika., Bake 35 to 40 minutes or until brown; let sit 15 minutes before slicing to eat.

title: Leota'S Fudge
directions: Mix syrup, sugar, milk and chocolate., Stir over low heat until sugar dissolves., Increase heat until soft ball stage is reached. Add butter and put in cool water until mixture is lukewarm., Add vanilla and beat until candy stands alone., Add pecans and mix and turn into greased dish.

title: Raspberry Crumb Bars
directions: Position rack in the center of the oven and preheat to 375 degrees. Butter a 9 x 9 pan.

title: Lemonade Pie
directions: Whip together the lemonade and the Eagle Brand milk., Pour mixture into pie crust., Place in freezer., Pie is ready to eat when frozen.

title: Hot Chicken Salad Casserole
directions: Cook rice according to directions., Combine all ingredients and put in a buttered casserole dish., Top with crushed potato chips., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes., Serve hot.

title: Banana Cake
directions: Cream butter and sugar., Blend in eggs; add bananas and mix well., Combine flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt., Add to creamed mixture with buttermilk., Bake for 50 minutes at 350° in 9 x 13-inch pan., Serves 10 to 12.

title: Cocktail Wieners
directions: Brown onion and garlic in margarine., Add other ingredients except wieners., Simmer., Add wieners and cook 10 minutes.

title: Old Fashion "Peach" Cake
directions: Mix together cake mix, pie filling, eggs, vanilla and nuts. Pour into 9 x 13-inch greased pan., Mix together flour, sugar, butter and flavoring (will be crumbly)., Sprinkle over batter. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Corn Relish
directions: Combine, first	4 ingredients.	Mix sugar and remaining ingredients., Bring, to a boil; cover., Reduce heat and simmer 2 minutes., Pour, vinegar, mixture, over vegetables and toss. Cover and chill at least 2 hours.

title: Cheesy Potato Casserole
directions: Mix all together. Top with buttered bread crumbs., Bake at 325° for 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

title: Steak Marinade
directions: Blend in blender., Marinate meat overnight, then barbecue. Also good for chicken.

title: Slow Cooker Chicken
directions: Before you go to church Sunday morning, cut up and remove the skin from fryer; salt and flour lightly., Arrange in single layer in slow cooker., Slice onion; spread over chicken., Sprinkle over this the seasoning, thyme and celery, and parsley flakes., Place lid on cooker; turn on., Come home from church and eat!

title: Summer Punch
directions: In a large pitcher or punch bowl, combine all except sherbet. Stir until all juices are thawed and blended., Top with scoop of sherbet, if desired., Makes 18 (4 ounce) servings.

title: Tortoni Squares
directions: Combine almonds, oleo, crumbs and extract; mix well., Sprinkle 1/3 of crumbs over bottom of 8 1/2 x 11-inch pan that is lined with foil., Spoon half of ice cream over crumbs., Drizzle with preserves., Sprinkle with crumbs., Repeat layers., Store in freezer., Cut in squares and garnish with whipped cream, if desired.

title: Forgotten Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Beat egg whites until they begin to peak., Add sugar, salt and vanilla., Continue to beat until mixture is stiff., Fold in nuts and chips., Turn oven off., Spoon cookie mixture on cookie sheet (1 teaspoon)., Place in oven for 6 hours or overnight., Store in airtight container.

title: Zucchini-Potato Pancakes
directions: Heat oil in large skillet., In large bowl, combine zucchini, potatoes, eggs, cracker crumbs, salt, basil and pepper., Stir until well mixed., Drop by heaping tablespoonfuls into heated oil and cook until brown., Add more oil, if needed., Serve with grated Parmesan cheese., Makes about 18 medium pancakes.

title: Scalloped Chicken
directions: Boil chicken; cool and debone. Take bread and tear like you would for dressing. Mix seasoned salt, pepper, salt and onion with bread. Mix soups, broth and chicken. Add to bread crumbs and mix well. Put into two 9 x 13-inch pans. Bake 1 hour at 325°.

title: Wild Rice Soup
directions: Wash wild rice., Boil rice for 15 minutes and drain; set aside., Fry bacon until crisp., Remove bacon and discard all but 3 tablespoons bacon drippings., Saute celery, onion and green pepper in drippings, until onion is transparent., Put in a large kettle and add rice, broth, mushrooms, soup and diced bacon., Cook on low heat for 1 hour or more., Do not add salt.

title: Crepes
directions: Mix first 3 ingredients until smooth., Add flour and milk. Mix in slowly., Put on a small frying pan with Crisco, 1/4 cup crepe batter., Flip and fry both sides until golden brown.

title: Italian Cookie Anise Toast
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Grease and flour cookie sheet., Sift flour, baking powder and salt., Beat sugar and eggs for 5 minutes. Add anise and beat well., Add dry ingredients and mix at low speed., Make 3 separate long loaves on cookie sheet, 3-inches wide., Bake 15 minutes, until lightly baked., Remove from oven and cut into 1-inch cookies., Put back on cookie sheet, cut side down, and bake 10 more minutes., Makes 3 dozen.

title: Lyn'S Dip
directions: Heat jello, cream cheese, tomato soup and water until melted and blended well., Cool well., Add Miracle Whip, pecans, bell pepper and onion; chill overnight., Makes about 2-quarts of dip. Good for a large crowd and good with chips or vegetables.

title: Rhubarb Cake
directions: Put rhubarb in a 9 x 13-inch pan., Sprinkle Jell-O and sugar over rhubarb., Sprinkle package of dry cake mix over mixture., Mix butter and water together and drizzle over the top., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Best Yet Banana Bread
directions: Mix in order given and pour in loaf pan., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Waldorf Salad
directions: Combine apple, celery, nuts and mayonnaise., Toss and serve on crisp greens., Serves 4.

title: Corn Flake Chicken
directions: Combine first 4 ingredients in a shallow dish., Dip each chicken breast in milk., Roll in crumb mixture., Place chicken in a lightly greased 12 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish., Bake at 375° for 18 minutes or until done., Yields 6 servings.

title: Buttercream Frosting
directions: Cream 1/3 of the sugar with butter and salt in a large bowl. Blend extract, 2 tablespoons milk and remaining sugar into mixture., Gradually stir remaining milk into frosting until desired spreading consistency is reached.

title: Punch Bowl Party Dessert
directions: Bake cake in two round 8-inch cake pans according to package directions., Cool., Cut layers horizontally by pulling a string through., You will have 4 layers., Make pudding according to package directions., Cool., Mix 2 1/2 cups boiling water with 2 boxes of strawberry Jell-O, mixing until Jell-O dissolves., Chill until slightly thickened (like egg white)., Assemble in a punch bowl as follows:, First, layer of cake, 1/4 of the Jell-O, layer of Cool Whip and layer of pudding., Second layer of cake, Jell-O, Cool Whip and pudding., Third layer of cake, Jell-O, Cool Whip and pudding., Fourth layer of cake only, topped with thick layer of Cool Whip., Garnish with fresh sliced berries.

title: Poppy Seed Bread
directions: Mix all together., Put in 2 (5 x 9-inch) greased and floured pans., Bake at 350° for 40 to 50 minutes.

title: Rocky Mt. Apple Pie
directions: Mix flour and sugar., Spread 1/2 mixture evenly in bottom of pie pan., Line pan with quartered or halved apples, cut side up. Spread remaining sugar mixture on apples., Drizzle cream over apples., Sprinkle with cinnamon., Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350°.

title: Yummy Strawberry Pie
directions: Crush crackers fine, then combine with sugar and butter., Mix well., Press firmly in unbuttered 9-inch pie plate., Bake at 375° for 8 minutes., Place in refrigerator to cool., Mix milk and lemon juice by hand until thick., Add strawberries and part of the juice for color., Arrange in pie shell., Refrigerate until ready to serve., Top with Cool Whip.

title: Zucchini Bread
directions: Mix eggs, sugar and oil., Beat into the wet mixture flour, baking soda, salt, cinnamon, baking powder and vanilla., Add nuts, dates and zucchini to mixture.

title: Fruit Tray And Dip
directions: Mix together sour cream, jelly and coconut for dip mixture. Wash and cut fruit., Arrange on tray., Use decorative toothpicks to pick up fruit and dip in mixture.

title: Dill Dip
directions: Mix thoroughly. Store in refrigerator., Serve with vegetables.

title: Swedish Coffee Bread
directions: Beat together with enough cream to make it smooth.

title: Cheese-Stuffed Chicken Breasts
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., In small mixing bowl, combine green onions, parsley flakes, salt, pepper and garlic powder., Set aside., Place 1 piece of cheese in center of each chicken breast. Top with 1/4 of onion mixture., Starting at narrow edge, roll each breast tightly, tucking in sides to enclose cheese and onion mixture., Dredge with flour., In small bowl, combine bread crumbs and Parmesan cheese., Dip each rolled breast in beaten egg, then in crumb mixture to coat.

title: Hot Tuna Melts
directions: Mix ingredients in order using 8 to 12 hamburger rolls., Fill with mixture., Cover with tops., Seal each sandwich inside of foil and put on cookie sheet., Bake at 375° for 25 minutes., Serve hot.

title: Shrimp Dip
directions: Drain shrimp and rinse in cold water., Gradually blend milk and mayonnaise into cream cheese., Add seasonings and shrimp.

title: The Cake That Won'T Last
directions: Mash, bananas, in, mixing bowl., Add remaining ingredients. Stir until blended by hand., Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until done.

title: Bread Pudding
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., Beat egg and sugar., Add milk and vanilla., Sprinkle cinnamon on and beat., Set mixture aside. Break bread into bite size pieces in a bowl., Pour water over bread; make soggy., Squeeze water out of bread by handfuls., Put all bread in baking dish., Pour egg and milk mixture over it. Sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon., Bake at 375° for 1/2 hour to 45 minutes.

title: Squash Casserole
directions: Cook squash and onion for 10 minutes until soft and drain. Melt butter and place croutons in skillet., Place them on bottom of cake pan and save the other half for the top., Grate carrots, and mix with mushroom soup, chicken soup and King sour; mix them with squash., Grate cheese on top., Place Italian bread crumbs on top sparingly and bake 30 minutes at 350° or longer.

title: Lasagna
directions: Brown meats; drain., Saute garlic in oil., Add mushrooms, basil, oregano, tomatoes, paste, salt, pepper, sugar, 1 cup water and meat., Simmer about 45 minutes.

title: Broccoli Pasta
directions: Cut broccoli into flowerets., Peel and slice stems., Cook pasta., When pasta has about 13 minutes left to cook, heat olive oil and add garlic and red pepper., Stir one minute., Add broccoli., Mix well., Add salt and 1/2 cup water or defatted broth., Use less salt if using canned all chicken broth., Cover with a tight lid., Cook 8 minutes, stirring occasionally., Drain pasta and mix with broccoli and its liquid., Serve at once.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Mix and pour into a casserole dish and top with crushed Ritz crackers., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Garden Pizza
directions: Spread crescent rolls on cookie sheet and press together. Bake as directed on can until brown., Mix remaining ingredients except vegetables and spread over crust. Top with vegetables.

title: Country Pork Ribs
directions: Rub ribs with crushed garlic and sprinkle with salt and pepper. Place in roasting pan, rib side down,in 350° oven., While ribs are roasting, put dried fruit in saucepan, barely cover with water and simmer covered for 35 minutes., After ribs have cooked for 1 hour, add the fruit and its cooking liquid and continue roasting for an additional 30 minutes., Make glaze by combining unsweetened orange juice concentrate, onion flakes and mustard., Spread over ribs and roast another 15 minutes, basting frequently., If ribs don't appear nicely browned, bake a little longer until they have a pleasing color., Cut the ribs into serving size pieces and arrange along with the fruit on a platter., A green vegetable and salad will finish meal.

title: Pineapple Date Bread
directions: Combine egg, milk, shortening, pineapple, nuts and dates. Sift together dry ingredients. Add to first mixture and stir just to moisten. Grease baking pan. Bake at 350° for 55 minutes., A nice holiday bread.

title: Jello Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients together until well blended., Chill before serving.

title: Lazy Macaroons
directions: Beat the egg whites with a dash of vanilla until stiff. Slowly add sugar and fold in the coconut. Drop by a teaspoon onto a greased cookie sheet and bake about 20 minutes at 325°., Makes about 20.

title: Sicilian Meat Roll
directions: Combine eggs, breadcrumbs, tomato juice, parsley, oregano, salt, pepper and garlic., Stir in ground beef, mixing well with hands., On waxed paper, pat meat to a 12 x 10-inch rectangle. Arrange ham slices on top of meat, leaving a small margin around edge., Sprinkle shredded cheese over ham., Starting from short end, carefully roll up meat, using paper to lift; seal edges and ends., Bake in 350° oven for 1 1/4 hours., Place cheese wedges over top of roll., Return to oven for 5 minutes, or until cheese melts., Serve with watermelon pickle or sweet relish., Serves 6 to 8.

title: Chicken And Rice
directions: Grease baking dish and sprinkle bottom evenly with onion gravy mix., Spread rice evenly over the mix., Cut up chickens; salt and pepper., Place pieces on rice., Mix soup with 1 1/2 cans of water and pour over the chicken., Cover with heavy foil and bake for 2 1/2 hours at 300°., Uncover and bake 30 minutes longer.

title: White Chocolate Candy
directions: Melt, stirring constantly over low heat, the first three ingredients., Add Rice Krispies and peanuts., Drop by the teaspoon on waxed paper and enjoy.

title: Peach Cobbler
directions: Melt butter in a baking dish., Sift flour, salt and baking powder together., Mix with sugar; stir in milk., Pour batter over melted butter., Do not stir., Sweeten fruit to taste and pour over batter., Bake 1 hour at 350°., Enjoy.

title: Broccoli Salad
directions: Cut broccoli flowers in small pieces., Cook bacon and crumble. Mix mayonnaise, sugar and vinegar., Pour over all other ingredients., Mix well and refrigerate.

title: Broccoli And Cheese Casserole
directions: Cook rice (unsalted)., Melt butter., Mix all ingredients together. Cook at 350° for approximately 1 hour., May also be put in microwave for approximately 20 minutes.

title: Granny'S Chicken And Dumplings
directions: Mix dry ingredients together, then add shortening. Mix until it's a cornmeal type texture., Add egg and enough water to make it "a little wetter than pie crust dough." Roll out onto floured board and cut into squares., Drop into boiling chicken and broth. Add salt and black pepper to taste and thicken broth with more flour., Dumplings should be ready in 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Banana Split Brownie Pizza
directions: Preheat oven to 375°. Prepare brownie mix according to pkg. directions. Cut a circle of parchment paper (not wax paper) to fit the 15 inch large round stone. Pour brownie mix onto parchment paper. Spread into 14 inch circle. Bake 15-18 minutes or until brownie is set. Do no overbake. Cool completely. Mix cream cheese, drained pineapple and sugar, spread on brownie. Slice bananas and strawberries and arrange over the mixture. Sprinkle with chopped nuts and drizzle chocolate topping over. Refrigerate. Cut into 16 wedges.

title: Pinylata Or Sausage Rolls
directions: Mix flour with hot roll mix flour., Use yeast from mix plus extra yeast, dissolved in the warm water., Mix yeast water into flour and mix until dough comes away from side of bowl., Add maybe 1/2 cup flour more and knead 1 minute., Cover and let rise 1/2 hour., Roll 1/3 of dough to size of 10-inch pie shell., Spread 1/3 of cooked and drained sausage on top with some Mozzarella and Parmesan cheese, garlic powder and bread crumbs sprinkled on., Roll up like jelly roll., Cut into 3-inch pieces or smaller., Bake on an ungreased cookie sheet at 350° for about 30 minutes., Do 3 times.

title: Cathy'S Crab Brunch Casserole
directions: Drain crabmeat., Spread layer of croutons in buttered 9-inch square casserole., Sprinkle with crabmeat, then cheese., Layer 2 times, ending with cheese layer., Beat eggs; add milk and seasonings., Pour over casserole., Bake in oven preheated to 325° for 45 minutes to 1 hour., Check for doneness by inserting knife in center., Will come out clean when finished., Sprinkle bacon on top about 10 minutes before finished baking.

title: Cheesy Baked Mostaccioli
directions: Brown meat good; cut up vegetables., Add mushrooms, soup, onion, pepper and celery., Cook 45 minutes, then add cheese., Stir until melted., Add cooked noodles to the mixture., Put mixture in a large casserole dish and bake at 325° for 15 minutes.

title: Strawberry Punch Bowl Cake
directions: Mix strawberries with glaze; set aside., Break cake into bite size pieces., Fold together pudding, Cool Whip and condensed milk., Layer cake, pudding mixture and strawberries in a punch bowl until reaches top., You may garnish with fresh strawberries.

title: Vegetable Salad
directions: Mix salt, sugar and mayonnaise and pour over the vegetables. Sprinkle with cheese and crumbled bacon., Refrigerate overnight.

title: Chocolate Fudge Cake
directions: Cream, sugars, and margarine;, add eggs, one at a time, beating, well, after each., Measure cocoa in measuring cup and fill, to, the, 3/4 mark with boiling water., Stir to dissolve. Stir, into, creamed mixture., Mix soda with buttermilk and add to the, creamed, mixture alternately with flour, mixing well. Pour into, two greased and floured 9-inch cake pans., Bake in preheated 350° oven 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Creamed Chicken Breasts
directions: Arrange chicken in a greased 13 x 9-inch baking dish., Place cheese slices over chicken., Combine soup and wine., Stir., Spoon sauce evenly over chicken and cheese., Sprinkle with stuffing. Drizzle butter over crumbs., Bake at 350° for one hour.

title: Seven Layer Cookies
directions: Melt butter in a 9 x 13-inch pan., Spread graham crackers. Add butterscotch morsels, then chocolate morsels, then nuts and coconut., Then pour Eagle Brand milk over layers., Bake at 325° for 25 to 30 minutes., Let cool; cut into squares.

title: Mexican Cornbread
directions: Mix all but the last four ingredients in a large bowl and set aside., Brown hamburger meat and drain., Grease an iron skillet. Heat and sprinkle with a thin layer of raw corn meal, brown slightly., Pour 1/2 of the corn meal batter into the skillet; sprinkle with the meat, cheese, onion and chiles., Pour remaining batter on top., Bake in 9-inch skillet at 350° for 50 minutes.

title: Italian Rolls
directions: Bring 2 cups water to a boil., Pour over oil, sugar and salt. Cook, until, only, lukewarm., Dissolve, yeast in 1/3 c. warm water., Add, to, cooled mixture along with the eggs and 3 cups flour., Stir, until, smooth., Add, remaining 3 cups flour and blend in., Turn out onto a lightly floured board and knead lightly., Shape, into rolls and place on greased pans (I use 9 x 13-inch pans)., Let rise until doubled., Bake at 375° for 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Sugared Popcorn
directions: Combine sugar, butter and water in large, heavy pot. Bring to boiling over medium heat, stirring constantly. Continue to cook until the sugar is dissolved and the mixture becomes syrupy, 4 to 5 minutes. Remove pot from heat. Add the popcorn to the pot. Stir to coat popcorn evenly with sugar mixture. Turn coated popcorn out in thin layer onto sheet of wax paper or parchment paper. Let popcorn cool for about 10 minutes. Serve in a basket or for a festive touch, in individual paper cones.

title: Mock Black Forest Cake For Microwave Oven
directions: Grease or spray with Pam, a microwave Bundt cake pan. Sprinkle nuts and put cherries in bottom of pan., Put mixture in pan, only 1/2 full., Bake on High for 13 minutes.

title: Dump Cake
directions: Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan well., Dump, pie, filling, and pineapple with juice into it., Dump yellow cake mix on top and spread, it, around., Drizzle with butter, or, margarine., Dump nuts and some coconut on top. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Spanish Rice
directions: Fry onion and bell peppers in oil until tender., Cook over low to medium heat., Add tomatoes, water, onions, peppers, rice, salt and black pepper., Stir constantly until done., Serve with crumbled cornbread or cooked cabbage, if desired.

title: Healthy Supper
directions: Cook meat in large pot., Add rice, bouillon (dissolved in hot water) and seasoned salt and stir., Add cabbage, onions and carrots., Cover and cook slowly until cabbage cooks down and carrots are tender., Can be simmered for an hour and left unattended., Serve with soy sauce, if desired., Serves 4 to 6.

title: Mostaccioli
directions: Preheat oven to 350°. Brown hamburger. Cook noodles according to box directions. In large container, combine ingredients. Pour into 9 x 13 pan. Top with Parmesan cheese, if desired. Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

title: Potato Soup
directions: Cook potatoes, celery, onion and salt in 2 cups water, about 20 minutes., Stir in remaining ingredients., Lightly mash with potato masher and cook, stirring constantly, until soup is hot and thickened.

title: Corn And English Pea Salad
directions: Drain corn and peas., Stir in other ingredients until mixed well., Chill at least 12 hours.

title: Chilled Summer Soup
directions: Melt butter in saucepan., Add the lettuce, watercress and spring onions and fry for 8 minutes., Stir in all but 3 tablespoons of the chicken stock and simmer for 10 minutes or until vegetables are tender., Blend the flour to a paste with the remaining stock and stir into the soup., Add salt and pepper to taste and continue cooking until soup has thickened., Puree in an electric blender. Cool, then stir in cream., Sprinkle top with parsley., Serves 4 to 6.

title: Tempting Drop Sugar Cookies
directions: Have all ingredients at room temperature; sift together flour, soda and salt., Cream together margarine, shortening, sugar and vanilla., Add the egg; cream until mixture is fluffy. Stir in dry ingredients until mixture is smooth; blend in milk., Drop by teaspoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet; flatten the dough with the bottom of a glass which has been dipped in sugar., Bake at 400° for about 12 minutes., Makes 5 1/2 dozen 2-inch cookies.

title: Shredded Sweet Potatoes
directions: *May vary amounts as desired.

title: Chicken Pie
directions: Mix together chicken, broth, soup and vegetables., Spread into oblong baking dish., Mix flour, margarine and milk; spread over chicken., Bake at 375° for 45 minutes.

title: Pumpkin Bread
directions: Sift together the first 4 ingredients, then add next 5 ingredients., Combine water, oil and eggs., Mix together dry and wet mixtures well., Add raisins and/or pecans to taste., Bake at 350° for one hour in loaf pans.

title: Layered Salad
directions: Put sliced lettuce in bottom of bowl or container you are using (glass allows you to see the layers)., Put the other layers of vegetables you are using; try to vary colors for a nice look. The choice is yours, except that you need to finish with the peas on top., Mix the sour cream, mayonnaise and sugar in small bowl; spread over entire top of salad, on top of peas., Cover; refrigerate for at least 8 hours., To serve, go down to bottom of bowl with salad fork and spoon to get all the layers and dressing.

title: Nutty O'S
directions: A blessing be upon the COOK

title: Chocolate Pound Cake
directions: Cream together margarine, Crisco and sugar., Add eggs one at a time, beating well after each., Add vanilla., Sift together dry ingredients and add alternately with milk, until well blended. Pour into large greased tube pan or two loaf pans., Bake at 300° to 325° for 1 1/4 to 1 1/2 hours or until done.

title: Mexican Dip
directions: Combine the first 5 ingredients in mixing bowl., Beat at medium speed until smooth. Drain chilies. Gently stir in chilies, tomatoes and onion., Put in serving bowl and chill. Serve with taco chips or Triscuits., Makes 2 cups.

title: Ginger Bread
directions: Mix together sugar, shortening, molasses and water., Sift dry ingredients into mixture and blend well., Stir in eggs., Pour in greased 9 x 13 pan., Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Cheesecake Pie
directions: Beat cream cheese, sugar and vanilla until smooth., Fold in Cool Whip and some of the chopped fresh fruit., Spoon into crust. Chill., Arrange fresh fruit on top.

title: Banana Fudge Brownies
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Grease bottom of an 8-inch square pan. Melt in a 2-quart saucepan over low heat, stirring constantly, the butter and chocolate chips., Beat in the remaining ingredients; mix well., Spread in greased pan., Bake for about 30 minutes. Cool; cut into squares., Makes 14 or 16.

title: Crabmeat Casserole
directions: Arrange, cubes, on, bottom, of, dish.	Fold, crabmeat, mayonnaise,, onion, celery and green pepper together and spoon over cubed	bread.	Trim, 4 to 6 slices bread and arrange over crabmeat mixture., Beat, eggs, and milk together and pour over mixture., Chill, 8	hours or longer., Preheat oven to 325° and bake uncovered, for 15 minutes., Take out and spread soup over bread and, top, with cheese and paprika and cook for one hour, covered.

title: Sausage Casserole
directions: Brown sausage; pour off grease., Bring water to boil., Add soup; boil for 7 minutes., Add to sausage and vegetables., Pour into greased casserole pan; sprinkle sliced almonds on top., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Pancake Mix
directions: Sift flour and baking powder into bowl., Add milk, melted shortening and egg., Beat well. Pour onto sprayed pan., (For thinner pancakes, add more milk.), Makes 12 to 15 (5-inch) pancakes.

title: Bean Soup
directions: Saute together garlic, pepper, and onion., Add remaining ingredients., Add 1 or 2 cans water., Simmer until peppers are done.

title: Baked Beans With Ground Beef
directions: Saute onion, green pepper and celery., Brown ground beef., Mix beans, barbecue sauce, catsup and brown sugar., Add beef and sauteed vegetables., Mix everything together., Bake at 350° until bubbly.

title: Sweet And Sour Cocktail Meatballs
directions: Mix beef, bread crumbs, eggs, soup mix and Accent., Roll into bite size pieces., Arrange on cookie sheet., Bake at 350° for approximately 15 minutes.

title: Christmas Morning Rolls
directions: Arrange rolls in well-greased, fluted tube pan., Sprinkle pudding (dry) over rolls., Cook butter and remaining ingredients over low heat until sugar is dissolved and mixture bubbles., Pour over rolls., Cover tightly with foil., Let stand overnight on counter., Next morning, bake at 350° for 30 minutes., Let stand 5 minutes, then invert carefully onto serving dish.

title: Elephant Stew
directions: Cut elephant into small bite-size pieces., This will take about 2 months., Add enough brown gravy to cover., Cook over kerosene fire for about 4 weeks at 462°., This will serve 3,800 people., If more are expected, the 2 rabbits may be added, but do this only if necessary as most people do not like to find hare in their stew. Yield:, 3,800 servings.

title: Fresh Mint Jelly
directions: Wash mint, leaving stems intact., Crush or coarsely chop. Place in a large saucepan., Add sugar, water and vinegar., Over high heat, bring to a full rolling boil, stirring until sugar dissolves.

title: Blueberry Torte
directions: Combine graham cracker crumbs (save some for the top), sugar and melted margarine and press into a 13 x 9-inch pan., Soften cream cheese and beat until smooth., Add eggs, remaining 3/4 cup sugar and vanilla and cream well., Pour cream cheese mixture over crust and bake at 375° for 15 to 20 minutes., Cool., Spread pie filling over cream cheese mixture., Top with whipped cream and the rest of graham cracker crumbs., Chill overnight.

title: Lolita'S Deep Dish Apple Pie
directions: Mix sugar and apples., Arrange sliced apples into chilled shell 1/2-inch from edge; work toward center until shell is covered., Add salt, cinnamon, grated rind of lemon and lemon juice to apple mixture in pie shell., Pile remaining apples on top., Dot with butter., Cover with top crust and seal edges., Bake in preheated 450° oven for 10 minutes., Reduce heat to 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Delicious Frozen Strawberry Salad(Salad Or Dessert)
directions: Cream together Cool Whip, sugar and cream cheese., Fold remaining ingredients into mixture., Place in 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan and freeze or you may put in individual foil muffin cups and freeze. Enjoy., Serves 10.

title: Fresh Blueberry Cake
directions: Cream the butter and then add sugar a little at a time, creaming again., Add eggs and some flour, sifted with the salt and baking powder., Blend slowly, adding milk and the rest of the flour. Wash blueberries; dry with paper towel and dust with flour. Add to batter just before baking., Pour batter into greased and floured 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan., Sprinkle with cinnamon and sugar, nutmeg, cloves or whatever appeals to you., Bake at 325° for 45 minutes., Serve warm.

title: Popovers
directions: Sift flour; measure., Add salt and sift again., Beat eggs with rotary or electric beater until light and thick., Add flour and 1/3 cup of the milk; continue to beat slowly until all the flour is moistened, about 30 seconds., Gradually add remaining milk and melted shortening., Beat until free from lumps, 1 to 2 minutes. Fill greased muffin pan., Divide in 6 to 8 large popovers., Bake at 425° for 40 minutes.

title: Cheese Ball
directions: Mix all ingredients, well, except, for 1 cup of pecans. Shape into ball and roll in remaining pecans., Best if chilled a day or two ahead of serving time.

title: Pintos And Sausage
directions: Cook beans as directed on bag (I use more water, to give some juice), around 2 1/2 hours., Cut up sausage., Add to beans., Cook about 15 minutes more., Salt and pepper to taste., Great with cornbread and onions.

title: Earthquake Cake
directions: In 9 x 13-inch pan put nuts and coconut on bottom of pan and spread evenly., Mix cake mix as directed on box., Pour over nuts and coconut., Melt oleo and cream cheese in microwave or low heat in pan., When melted, mix in powdered sugar; should be pretty thick., Spoon all over cake mix; do not spread out., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes., You don't have to ice cake unless you want to.

title: Low-Fat Carrot Cake
directions: Mix the first eight ingredients., Heat to boil and then simmer 5 minutes., Cool to warm and add flour, soda and salt., Mix well. Bake in a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan 45 to 60 minutes at 325° or until done.

title: Holiday Salad
directions: Prepare gelatin as directed., When partly congealed, add other ingredients and mix well., Pour into mold and chill to firm.

title: Colorful Vegetable Salad
directions: Layer half of vegetables in a salad bowl., Repeat layers., Add salad dressing., Cover tightly and chill until ready to serve.

title: Oriental Brussels Sprouts
directions: Cook bacon until crisp., Remove from pan and drain on paper towel., Stir soy sauce into the bacon drippings., Add chestnuts, garlic and broth., Bring to a boil and add Brussels sprouts. Return to a boil; cover and reduce heat, cooking about 8 minutes or until sprouts are just tender., Combine cornstarch and water and add to the pan liquid., Cook, stirring, until thickened. Sprinkle reserved bacon over the top to serve., Serves 6 to 8.

title: Oatmeal Crunchies Cookies
directions: Sift together flour, sugar, baking powder, soda and salt., Add brown sugar, shortening, egg and vanilla; beat well., Stir in oats and nuts., Form dough into small balls., Dip tops in a little additional granulated sugar., Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes., Makes 3 1/2 dozen.

title: Scotch-A-Roos
directions: Bring syrup and sugar to a boil., Boil maybe 1 or 2 minutes, no longer or they will get too hard., Remove from heat., Add peanut butter and stir together., Add Rice Krispies., Put in bar pan, greased with butter or margarine.

title: Zucchini Appetizers
directions: Mix everything together and put into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake at 350° for about 25 to 35 minutes or until browned slightly., Let stand 2 or 3 minutes and cut into 1-inch squares. Serve warm as hors d'oeuvres.

title: Easy Casserole
directions: Fry meat until no longer pink., Add onion, green pepper and celery., Cook until tender., Drain off excess fat.

title: Chicken And Noodles
directions: In a large pot, cook chicken and spices in water for several hours, until done., The meat will start falling off the bone. Take chicken out, remove meat from bone and set aside.

title: Hinder Wings
directions: Mix together., Use only 2 larger sections of wings., Put wings in a shallow pan; pour sauce over., Baste and turn every 15 minutes so they get covered with sauce., Last 10 minutes, sprinkle with sesame seed., Drain on cake racks (spread newspaper underneath to catch drippings)., Can be eaten cold.

title: Breakfast Casserole
directions: Grease 13 x 9-inch baking dish., Tear up bread in dish, brown and drain sausage, spoon over bread and sprinkle on grated cheese. Beat eggs, milk, salt, pepper; pour mixture over sausage., Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes., Can prepare the night before. Serves 6.

title: Pineapple Cake
directions: Cream, the shortening and sugar until fluffy., Add eggs and vanilla., Combine dry ingredients., Add to creamed mixture alternately, with, milk., Stir thoroughly after each addition. Pour batter in two 9-inch greased and floured pans and bake at 350° for approximately 20 minutes.

title: Wanda'S Lasagna
directions: Boil noodles until done., Brown hamburger meat., In a large bowl, combine hamburger meat, Ragu sauce, sour cream, cottage cheese, salt and garlic powder.

title: Lemon-Lime Jello Salad
directions: Mix both packages of Jell-O in the hot water., Let cool., Add pineapple, milk, salad dressing, cheese and pecans., Pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan., Refrigerate until congealed., Cut in squares., If desired, top with fresh mint leaf and red and green cherries., Serve on lettuce leaf.

title: Marinated Carrots
directions: Cook carrots just until tender., Mix remaining ingredients in a pan., Bring to a boil and pour over cooked carrots. Refrigerate., Will keep up to 6 weeks in refrigerator., Sauce left after other ingredients have been eaten can be used over salads.

title: Twice Baked Potatoes
directions: Cut hot baked potatoes in half., Scoop out insides; reserve shells., In large bowl, with electric mixer, beat potatoes and spread until creamy., Gradually beat in milk; stir in onion, salt and pepper., Spoon mixture into reserved shells., Sprinkle with cheese., Arrange in baking dish., Bake at 375° for 20 to 25 minutes or until heated through., Sprinkle with paprika and serve.

title: Squash Casserole
directions: Boil squash and onion; drain. Mash., Add all ingredients together., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Chinese Chicken Casserole
directions: Mix all together and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: German Potato Salad
directions: Boil potatoes with skins on., Fry bacon until crisp; drain. Cook and stir onion in bacon drippings until tender and gold. Stir in flour, sugar, salt, celery seed and pepper., Cook over low heat., Stir until bubbly., Remove from heat., Stir in water and vinegar., Heat to boil; stir constantly., Boil and stir 1 minute. Crumble bacon., Dice potatoes., Carefully stir bacon and potatoes in hot mixture., Heat through., Stir to coat potatoes.

title: Coleslaw Superb
directions: Combine cabbage, onion, green pepper and sugar., In saucepan, combine 1 tablespoon sugar, salt, celery seed, dry mustard, water, vinegar and oil., Bring to a boil; pour over vegetables., Cool in refrigerator for 24 hours., Keeps for 3 weeks.

title: Delicious Meatballs And Gravy
directions: Chop onion; add garlic to oil in a large pot., Saute until soft (do not burn)., Strain tomatoes., Add this to the onions and garlic, plus puree, salt, black pepper, water and sugar., Cook this for 1 hour, low to medium heat.

title: Cranberry Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Grease cookie sheets.

title: Pasta
directions: For pasta, drop penne into kettle of boiling water; return to boil and boil gently for 8 to 10 minutes or until tender., Drain; toss with 1 tablespoon olive oil., Return to pan and keep warm. For sauce, saute garlic slowly in 3 tablespoons olive oil in skillet until softened, but not browned., Add olives, basil, red pepper and tomato sauce., Heat., Stir in cheeses and heat, stirring until chunks begin to melt., Pour over pasta., Pass additional grated Parmesan cheese to sprinkle over if desired. Makes 4 servings.

title: Cold Avocado And Tomato Soup(Gazpacho)
directions: Put all ingredients into a serving tureen, stir and chill well. To serve, spoon into individual soup bowls and top each with a slice of avocado and put an ice cube in each bowl.

title: Spaghetti Sauce
directions: Make meat balls., Cook meat balls in the tomato soup, 1 can water and 1/3 to 1/2 can Healthy Choice spaghetti sauce., Let simmer for a while, then add spaghetti that has already been cooked.

title: Strawberry Frozen Yogurt(Diabetic)
directions: In a large saucepan, soften gelatin in water for 2 minutes. Place over medium heat until gelatin is dissolved., Add evaporated milk, 1/2 cup of the fructose and salt to gelatin., Stir over medium heat until well blended, approximately 5 minutes., Remove from heat., Stir in yogurt and vanilla., Set aside.

title: Double Delicious Cookie Bars
directions: Preheat oven to 350° (325° for glass dish)., In a 13 x 9-inch pan, melt margarine in oven., Sprinkle crumbs evenly over margarine., Pour sweetened condensed milk evenly over crumbs., Top with chips; press down firmly., Bake for 25 to 30 minutes, or until lightly browned., Cool; cut into bars., Store, loosely covered, at room temperature., Makes 24 to 36 bars.

title: Apple Dip
directions: Mix together and slice apples to dip.

title: Spaghetti Pie
directions: Break spaghetti in half., Cook in boiling salted water until done; drain., While still warm, combine spaghetti with eggs and Parmesan., Pour into a well greased 10-inch pie plate and pat mixture up and around sides with a spoon.

title: Baked Eggs
directions: Layer in order in a small baking dish., Bake 10 to 12 minutes at 350°., Serves one.

title: Orange Delight Salad
directions: Dissolve Jell-O and sugar in hot water., Use the pineapple juice and enough cold water to make the 2 cups cold liquid., Add to Jell-O and let set until it starts to congeal., Add pineapple and marshmallows., Fold in whipped cream., Refrigerate a few hours before serving.

title: Teriyaki Steak Strips
directions: Combine all ingredients, (except flank steak).	Marinate flank steak overnight., Grill.

title: Orange-Kissed Pancakes
directions: Combine the flour, sugar, baking soda and salt in a medium bowl.

title: Fix Ahead Mashed Potatoes
directions: Boil potatoes in salted water., Drain and mash with the rest of the ingredients except for the melted butter., Spoon into a lightly greased 12 x 8 x 2-inch pan., Brush with melted butter and sprinkle with paprika.

title: Cheese Ring
directions: Combine first 5 ingredients and mix well. Add 3/4 cup pecans and mix. Shape into a ring and pat remaining pecans on top. Chill. (Put on platter or on sheet of wax paper.)

title: Collards And Cornbread
directions: Wash greens thoroughly (2 to 3 times) to remove sand., Take out and discard tough stems., Put ham hocks or ham chunks in pot., Add greens and fill half full with water., Let greens come to a boil, then turn fire down and simmer 2 1/2 to 3 hours or until seasoned and tender., Add salt according to taste when serving., Lift greens out of water into a flat bowl and cut into bite size pieces with a sharp knife., We like to sprinkle pepper sauce or vinegar on our plates.

title: Cracker Pudding
directions: Mix together the milk, crackers, coconut, salt and sugar; scald., Pour about a cup of this hot mixture over the egg yolks. Blend egg and hot milk together before returning to hot mixture. Cook until thick; add vanilla., Pour into baking dish and cover with meringue.

title: Fruit Cocktail
directions: Blend with ice and strain champagne flute. Garnish with strawberry.

title: Beef Stroganoff
directions: In large skillet, heat oil and cook beef and onion until meat is browned., Drain fat off, then add bouillon and Worcestershire sauce., Bring to boil, then reduce heat., Simmer, covered, for 1 hour., Add mushrooms with liquid., Combine sour cream and flour; blend into meat mixture., Continue cooking about 5 minutes or until thickened., Cook noodles to package directions., Drain; serve stroganoff over hot cooked noodles.

title: *Sweet And Sour Carrots
directions: Cook carrots in slightly salted water for 15 minutes., Add pepper and cook for 3 minutes more; drain., Drain pineapple and save juice., Add water to juice to make 1/3 cup., Combine sugar, cornstarch, salt, liquid, vinegar and soy sauce., Cook and stir until bubbly., Add vegetables and pineapple., Heat through. Serves 6.

title: Chinese Chicken And Broccoli
directions: Cut chicken into 2 x 1/2-inch strips., Toss chicken, cornstarch, salt and white pepper in glass or plastic bowl. Cover., Refrigerate for 20 minutes.

title: Skillet Cabbage
directions: Combine ingredients in large skillet., Cover and cook 3 minutes., Stir and cook 3 more minutes., Yields about 6 servings.

title: Ole Settlers Baked Beans
directions: Brown beef, bacon and onion, then add the rest of the ingredients and mix well., Pour all ingredients into a large baking dish and bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Paper Cup Salad
directions: Combine sour cream, lemon juice, sugar, salt, pineapple, bananas and coloring., Fold in nuts., Spoon into paper muffin cup liners in muffin tins and freeze., When frozen remove from tins. Put in plastic bags or airtight container and return to freezer. Will keep for several months., Take out of freezer for 15 minutes before serving., Peel off liners and serve on lettuce., Makes 12 to 14 servings.

title: No Bake Orange Coconut Balls
directions: Melt butter and pour over vanilla wafer crumbs and add remaining ingredients., Roll into balls and then roll in the coconut., Place on cookie sheet to let harden.

title: Pork Chop Cheese Pillows
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., In a small saucepan, melt butter. Saute onion and garlic clove until soft; set aside., Stab small holes in pork chops and sprinkle lightly with garlic powder and seasoned salt.

title: Navy Bean Soup
directions: Soak beans overnight., Boil ham bone, water, bay leaf, peppercorns and cloves., Add beans; boil 2 1/2 to 3 hours., Last half hour, add the rest of ingredients., Add salt and pepper to taste., Makes 6 cups.

title: Italian Squash Pie(Low-Fat)
directions: Cook vegetables in microwave or skillet sprayed with vegetable spray until tender., Add cheese to egg substitute., Add seasonings; mix well., Place pie crust in glass pie plate; spread mustard on bottom of crust., Add vegetables., Pour cheese and egg mixture over top., Bake at 375° for 18 to 20 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Easy Combination In A Pastry Shell
directions: Make the white sauce by melting butter in a large skillet. Take off the heat and add flour to make a paste., Add milk, return to heat and stir constantly until thick and smooth.

title: Amish Raisin Cream Pie
directions: Mix sugar and cornstarch., Add milk and 2 slightly beaten egg yolks., Cook until thick., Add salt, vanilla, oleo and cooled raisins., Pour into baked crust.

title: Spaghetti Pie
directions: Mix egg and Parmesan cheese together., Cook spaghetti and drain., Mix in 1 tablespoon butter, then mix into spaghetti with the egg and Parmesan cheese., Grease bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan with a little oil.

title: Hawaiian Delight Pie
directions: Mix all ingredients, put in pie shell and chill.

title: Meat Loaf With Sweet And Sour Sauce
directions: In a saucepan, mix tomato sauce with brown sugar, vinegar and mustard., Stir until sugar is dissolved., Combine egg, onion, crackers, meat, salt, pepper and 1/2 cup of the tomato sauce mixture., Mix lightly but thoroughly and shape into loaf., Put into baking dish and pour remainder of tomato sauce over mixture over it., Bake in 350° oven for 1 hour, basting occasionally. Note:, This recipe may be cut in half and it works fine.

title: No-Bake Peanut Nuggets
directions: Heat sugar and milk in saucepan to boiling., Boil for 3 minutes, stirring constantly., Remove from heat and add saltine crumbs, peanut butter and vanilla., Mix well so that peanut butter is melted., Add coconut and peanuts and stir until mixture is stiff., Drop by teaspoonfuls on wax paper to form mounds.

title: Chicken Pie
directions: Combine vegetables and chicken in 9 x 13-inch pan., Pour liquids over chicken and cover with crust.

title: Crisp Candy Bars
directions: Grease 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan., In saucepan, mix syrup and sugar, stirring, frequently, to boil over medium heat., Remove from heat. Stir, in peanut butter, then cereal and press into pan., Melt your chips and spread while hot.

title: Plains, Georgia Cheese Ring
directions: Mix cheese, onion, pecans and mayonnaise together., Mold mixture with a spoon or hands into a ring., Fill the center with strawberry preserves. Serve with Ritz crackers., Refrigerate.

title: Spinach Stuffed Eggs
directions: Remove shells., Cut eggs in half; remove yolks., Mix yolks with ingredients; beat until smooth, adding a little cream if necessary., Sprinkle red pepper for garnish.

title: Olive Nut Spread
directions: Mix well., May be kept a week or more in refrigerator.

title: Bread Stuffing For Turkey
directions: Cook onion in 2 tablespoons of butter until soft but not brown., Combine with the bread, seasonings and stock.

title: Lemony Torte Squares
directions: Cream butter and sugar., Add flour., Batter will be stiff. Pack in 9 x9-inch ungreased pan., Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.

title: Zucchini And Rice Casserole
directions: Saute onion in oil., Add zucchini, garlic, salt and pepper. Cook 5 minutes until zucchini is bright green., Beat eggs in a large bowl., Add cheese, parsley, rice and thyme., Add to zucchini mixture and place in a greased casserole., Sprinkle with 1/2 cup bread crumbs and drizzle with olive oil., Bake at 375° for 45 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
directions: Cook first 3 ingredients and stir constantly over medium heat in 9 x 13-inch pan., Bring to boil and cook for 5 minutes while stirring., Then add remaining ingredients.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Cook broccoli., Prepare stuffing mix according to box directions., In a 11 x 13-inch baking dish, layer all ingredients in order listed., Top with a little Cheddar cheese., Bake for 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Banana Nut Bread
directions: Mix all ingredients., Mash bananas and add last so that they will not turn dark., Bake at 300 degrees in a muffin tin or loaf pan.

title: Rice Casserole
directions: Grease baking dish., Mix uncooked rice, mushroom soup and dry onion soup together., Add water., Bake 1 hour at 350°., May need to add water.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Cook broccoli until tender according to package directions. Combine eggs, soup, cheese and mayonnaise., Fold in broccoli. Pour into casserole dish, cover with bread crumbs and dot with butter., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes., Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Monterey Beans And Cheese
directions: Fry the first 3 ingredients. Add the remaining ingredients. Cook, slowly, stirring until blended, about 5 minutes. Sprinkle 1/4 to 1/2 pound Cheddar cheese on top., Put lid on for 2 minutes or until cheese is melted. Serve on top of rice or mix with rice. Serve with carrots.

title: Rice Casserole
directions: Melt margarine in large casserole dish., Stir in rice, water and soup., Add green pepper, onion and pimentos, all chopped. Bake at 350°, covered, for 45 minutes.

title: Dilly Bread
directions: Drain cottage cheese in sieve., Dissolve yeast in water., Mix all ingredients well and let rise in same bowl until doubled. Work down with spoon and transfer to 2 oiled loaf pans., Let rise again., Bake 30 to 40 minutes in a 350° oven.

title: Benedict Spread
directions: Mash cream cheese with grated cucumber pulp., Add onion, salt and enough mayonnaise to make a smooth spread., Add small amount of green food coloring to make filling a very pale green., This is one of my favorites.

title: Chocolate Sheath Cake
directions: In a large bowl, sift flour and sugar together. Mix margarine, cocoa and water in a saucepan. Bring to a rapid boil. Pour over flour and sugar mixture and stir until well mixed. Add eggs, soda, cinnamon and vanilla. Mix well and pour into well-greased 11 x 16-inch pan. Bake at 400° for 25 minutes.

title: Berries 'N Bits Trifle
directions: In large bowl, combine Eagle Brand milk and water., Add pudding mix and beat well., Chill for 5 minutes., Fold in whipped cream. Spoon 2 cups pudding into 3-quart glass bowl., Top with 1/2 of each of the vanilla wafers, berries, little chocolate bits and remaining pudding., Repeat layers., Garnish with additional little bits, wafers and berries., Chill thoroughly., Refrigerate any leftovers. Serves 8 to 10., An elegant, delicious treat.

title: Sweet Relish
directions: Combine first 4 ingredients., Add salt., Let drain on a towel 2 hours., Then add remaining ingredients., Cook until done., Boil. Cook about 15 minutes., Put in jars and cool.

title: Crab Dip
directions: Mix all ingredients together and beat until cheese melts, approximately 20 minutes., Serve with your favorite cracker.

title: Plan Ahead Pinto Beans
directions: Note:, Sprouting the beans helps to remove some of the gas and also brings in extra nutrients.

title: Chocolate Crinkles
directions: Melt half of shortening and add cocoa., Set aside., Cream the rest of the shortening, sugar and vanilla., Beat in eggs, then cocoa mixture., Sift together dry ingredients and add alternately with milk., Chill 30 minutes., Drop by spoonful into powdered sugar and roll., Place on greased cookie sheets and bake at 350° for 15 minutes., Yield: 4 dozen cookies.

title: Meat Balls
directions: Mix all ingredients together to form dough. Roll into bite-size balls. Bake at 350° for 10 to 15 minutes. Makes about 30 balls. Serve hot. Freezes well also.

title: Salad Dressing Cake
directions: Mix dry ingredients., Mix water and salad dressing., Mix the two together gradually and beat., Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350°. May make 1 layer or a 2-layer cake.

title: 3 Layer Pie
directions: Mix first 4 ingredients until crumbly; put in 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake for 20 minutes at 350°.

title: Sawdust Salad
directions: Mix all these together and cool slightly. Pour in casserole dish with a small bag of miniature marshmallows. Let gel.

title: French Chocolate Pie
directions: Cream butter with sugar., Stir in chocolate., Add eggs, one at a time, beating 5 minutes after each addition at high speed., Fold in Cool Whip., Pour into a cooled 9-inch pie shell., Chill until firm, about 2 hours.

title: Cranberry Cherry Salad
directions: Drain cherries. Reserve juice. Set cherries aside. Add water to juice to measure 1 cup. Transfer to saucepan. Bring to a boil. Add cherry gelatin; stir until dissolved. Whisk in cranberry sauce until smooth. Add cherries; pour into an 11 x 7 pan. Refrigerate until firm.

title: Hamburger With Baked Beans
directions: Cut bacon strips in small pieces., Add onion and saute., Brown ground beef with the onion and bacon., Add remaining ingredients and pour into casserole or baking dish., Bake at 375° for 1/2 hour.

title: Quick Chicken Pot Pie
directions: Place one pie shell in bottom of casserole dish. Layer soups, vegetables and chicken. Place second pie shell on top and slit with knife several times. Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes until golden and bubbly.

title: Watergate Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients and top with cherries and crushed nuts. Chill.

title: Millionaire Pie - No Bake
directions: Mix first 4 ingredients and beat for 5 min., Pour into shell, mix next three ingredients and spread over first layer. Chill and serve.

title: Okra Gumbo
directions: Saute meat and drain on paper towel., Combine all ingredients in large stewpot., Cook until okra turns color.

title: Southern Sweet Tea
directions: Bring the 2 cups of water to a rolling boil. Drop the tea bags in the water and then the soda. Cook about 1 minute. Cover with lid and remove from heat or just turn the burner off. Let steep (sit) for about 15 minutes. Put sugar in a 2-quart pitcher and pour hot tea in and stir to dissolve. Add enough cold water to fill the pitcher. Add the lemon juice and serve over ice.

title: Shrimp-Corn Chowder Soup
directions: Cook onions with butter until tender., Add rest of the ingredients and heat to boiling., Put pat of butter or oleo in each bowl and fill with chowder., Sprinkle with parsley and paprika.

title: Chicken Pilaf
