directions: Mix rice, soup mix, soup, water and wine in 1 1/2-quart baking dish., Let stand 10 minutes., Put chicken parts on top. Brush with butter., Sprinkle with salt, pepper and paprika., Bake in 350° oven for 1 hour until chicken is done.

title: Sprite Sherbet Punch
directions: In a punch bowl add 2 1/2 qts. of softened sherbet. Add Sprite gently, DO NOT STIR. Add remaining 1/2 qt. sherbet by scoopfulls and float on punch. Serves approx. 30 people.

title: Apricot Almond Brie
directions: Remove top rind from cheese; place cheese on serving plate. In a small saucepan, combine preserves and liqueur., Heat until mixture is hot, but not boiling., Pour some of the sauce over cheese (save remainder for adding later, if desired)., Sprinkle almonds over top., Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Chicken And Tomato
directions: Place chicken in baking dish., Bake, covered, 15 minutes in oven preheated to 425°; drain., Combine tomatoes, cornstarch, oregano and pepper sauce., Cook, stirring constantly, until sauce is thickened., Pour heated sauce over chicken; top with cheese. Bake 5 minutes, uncovered., Garnish with parsley, if desired.

title: Briar Patch Bake
directions: Brown meat; stir in barbecue sauce and onion., Heat., Prepare macaroni dinner as directed on the package except use 1/2 cup milk. Layer half the dinner in a 10 x 6-inch baking dish., Cover with meat mixture., Top with remaining dinner., Cover and bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Hamburger Casserole
directions: Cook hamburger meat and onions until done in skillet., Cook macaroni and mix with hamburger., Put in a large casserole dish. Add diced up cheese (about 4 slices)., Add pimientos and tomato soup., Cover with more cheese slices and crumbled up bread on top of casserole., Bake until cheese melts and bread is brown.

title: Homemade Muenster Cheese
directions: Don't let new small potatoes go to waste., Scrape them or if you want to do a basketful or more, fill your washing machine with cold water and let it run to clean them., Pack them in jars; add water and 1 teaspoon salt to each quart., Cold pack 3 hours.

title: Rigatoni And Cheese Sauce
directions: Prepare rigatoni according to package directions. Melt margarine., Add flour and cook, stirring constantly for 2 minutes. Do not brown., Stir in milk, salt, pepper and cheese., Cook until smooth and thickened., Pour sauce over hot rigatoni and mix gently., Sprinkle peas on top and place in oven at 350° for 15 minutes.

title: Green Chili Fritters
directions: Mix salt, masa and flour into bowl. Add beaten egg, milk and shortening. Drop chili into batter, then drop chili in hot oil.

title: Best-Ever Corn Casserole
directions: Combine all ingredients and stir together., Bake in greased 8 x 8-inch dish in 350° oven for 45 minutes.

title: Sweet Potato Deluxe
directions: After, topping	has been added, bake in a 350° oven for 30 minutes., Potatoes	may be prepared several days ahead and refrigerated., Topping should not be added until you are ready to bake them.

title: Pistachio Jello Salad
directions: Mix all together and chill thoroughly before serving.

title: Egg Pudding
directions: Put cubed bread on bottom of greased 9 x 13-inch pan., Melt margarine and cheese in double boiler., Pour over bread., Beat eggs with fork and add milk and mix., Pour over mixture., Place in refrigerator overnight., Bake one hour at 300°.

title: Quick Cole Slaw
directions: Shred cabbage in bowl., Add pinch of celery seed or more, if desired., Add cole slaw dressing and stir., Chill and serve or serve immediately.

title: Sour Cream Yeast Rolls
directions: Soften yeast in water; let stand while combining sour cream, sugar and baking soda in large bowl., Add 2 cups biscuit mix, then yeast mixture., Mix well., Stir in 3 more cups biscuit mix., Turn dough onto board dusted with 1/2 cup biscuit mix; knead to form smooth ball., Shape dough into small rounds the size of a walnut. Place close together in buttered 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan., Let rise until doubled in bulk., Preheat oven to 375°., Bake rolls 15 minutes, or until done., Makes 72 bite size rolls.

title: Cabbage Slaw
directions: Cut cabbage, onions and green pepper very thin and sprinkle with salt., Bring to boil oil, vinegar and sugar., Let cool., Pour over vegetables., (Better if made one day in advance.)

title: Coconut Cake
directions: Preheat oven at 200°., Grease and flour tube cake pan., Mix ingredients and pour into pan., Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 20 minutes.

title: Cocoa Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Bring margarine, sugar, cocoa and milk to a boil for about 3 minutes., Add peanut butter and oats., Then drop on waxed paper and allow to cool.

title: Green Beans
directions: Wash and break beans into bite size pieces., Wash new potatoes., Cook in a large pot on top of stove until tender. Season to taste.

title: Zucchini-Carrot Bread
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Grease pans (three 5 1/2 x 9 1/2 x 3-inch if double)., In large bowl, beat eggs with oil., Stir in sugar, zucchini, carrots and vanilla., Mix flour, baking soda, baking powder, salt and cinnamon., Blend into egg and oil, etc. and add raisins., Bake 1 hour or until tested with toothpick. Remove from pan and cool.

title: Butterscotch Balls
directions: Soften butter (don't melt)., Mix powdered sugar, peanut butter, graham crackers, vanilla, coconut and butter in large bowl., Roll into 1-inch balls.

title: English Trifle
directions: Bake cake in oblong pan according to directions on box., This only uses half the cake (you can find someone baking on the same day and share)., Break 1/4 of the cake into large pieces and place in a 2-quart serving bowl., Pour half the thawed strawberries over the cake., Spread with half of prepared pudding., Repeat layers. Chill at least 8 hours., Right before serving, spread whipped topping on top and sprinkle with almonds., Spoon into dessert dishes to serve.

title: Quick Lemon Pie
directions: Mix well., Pour into a graham cracker pie crust and top with Cool Whip., Refrigerate for 1 hour.

title: Shrimp And Green Noodles
directions: Cook noodles as directed on package., Line a casserole with noodles and make into a nest., In a large frying pan, saute the shrimp in 1/2 cup clarified butter until pink and tender, about 5 minutes., Cover noodles with shrimp., Combine soup, sour cream, mayonnaise and chives; add mustard and sherry., Pour sauce over shrimp and sprinkle Cheddar cheese over all., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes, until, cheese has melted and bubbly., Serves 6.

title: Lemonade Pie
directions: Beat all ingredients until smooth., Pour into 2 graham cracker pie shells., Freeze until firm., Serve immediately.

title: Lasagna
directions: Fry onions and garlic in oil until soft, 5 to 10 minutes., Add hamburger and cook until brown., Mix in salt, pepper, rosemary and tomato paste., Gradually add hot water and simmer 30 minutes uncovered., In bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan, put a thin layer of sauce, then a layer of cooked noodles, layer of cottage cheese, layer of Mozzarella cheese, then repeat layers., Bake at 350° for 1 hour., Let cool 15 minutes before serving.

title: Refrigerator Cookies
directions: Blend Crisco with salt and sugars., Add eggs one at a time, mixing thoroughly., Add flour, baking soda and nuts to mixture. Shape into roll about 2 1/2 inches in diameter or 2 smaller rolls. Roll in wax paper and chill in refrigerator., When ready to bake, slice thinly and place on greased cookie sheet., Bake at 375° for 8 to 10 minutes, or when delicately brown.

title: Marinated Carrots
directions: Cook carrots until tender and cool., Mix remaining ingredients into carrots. Place in refrigerator and let set 12 hours or more. Yields 1/2 gallon or enough for 25 people.

title: Quaker Choc Oat-Chip Cookies
directions: Heat oven to 375°., Beat margarine and sugars until creamy. Add eggs, milk and vanilla; beat well., Add combined flour, baking soda and salt; mix well., Stir in oats, chocolate morsels and nuts; mix well., Drop by rounded measuring tablespoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet., Bake for 9 to 10 minutes for a chewy cookie or 12 to 13 minutes for a crisp cookie., Cool 1 minute on cookie sheet; remove to wire rack., Cool completely., Makes about 5 dozen.

title: Orange Salad
directions: Cook Jell-O, pudding and water until thick and clear., Chill. Add whipped Dream Whip and oranges.

title: Baby Ruth Cookies
directions: Sift together flour, soda and salt., Cream together margarine and sugar until light and fluffy., Beat in egg., Stir in Baby Ruth pieces and dry ingredients., Add vanilla and blend well. Chill dough for 30 minutes., Drop by 1/2 teaspoon onto greased baking sheet., Bake in oven at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes or until done., Remove from baking sheet onto wire racks to cool., To enhance flavoring, add caramel flavoring.

title: Icebox Fruit Cake
directions: Mix all together and shape into loaf pan., Decorate top with pecans and cherries, if wanted., Can use marshmallows.

title: Angel Biscuits
directions: Sift together first 5 ingredients., Cut in shortening., Add yeast mixture., Add to dry ingredients., Dough should be soft and pliable; work 5 minutes., Roll out; cut with biscuit cutter., Bake at 400° for 15 minutes or until golden brown., May refrigerate dough overnight.

title: Land And Sea Linguini
directions: Place water on stove for linguini; follow directions on package to cook the pasta., Place all ingredients, except mussels, into large pot and simmer for 1/2 hour., While the sausage and sauce are cooking, clean mussels according to package directions., Add to sauce and cook for another 15 to 20 minutes until mussel shells open., Serve over linguini., Serves about 8.

title: Erin'S Orange Salad
directions: Mix Jell-O with cottage cheese until well blended., Add fruit; be sure oranges and pineapple are drained well., Mix well and fold in Cool Whip., Makes a great low-cal, cool salad.

title: Louisiana Pie
directions: Pour pie filling in buttered deep-dish pie pan. Pour dry cake mix over pie filling. Slice butter evenly over cake mix. Bake at 350° until crust is brown (approximately 30 minutes). Stir mixture 1 time while baking. Good served with a scoop of vanilla ice cream.

title: Glazed Onion Rings
directions: Peel onions and cut into even thin slices. Heat margarine in large skillet. Add onions; toss until coated with margarine. Do not brown. Add vinegar, brown sugar and curry powder. Blend well. Add parsley. Cook 2 to 3 minutes until glazed. Season with salt, pepper and curry powder. Serve hot as a side dish or cook as an appetizer. Can be used in greens or potato salad.

title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Bonbons
directions: In large bowl, combine vanilla frosting, peanut butter and margarine until well blended., Stir in crumbs; mix well., Form into 1-inch balls., Chill 1 hour.

title: Pistachio Cake
directions: Beat first 6 ingredients together using only 1 package of pudding for 4 minutes at high speed., Place in 9 x 13-inch greased pan., Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes., Beat together 1 package of pudding and 1 cup milk., Beat heavy cream until peaks form. Mix with pudding mixture., Use this to ice cake when cake is cool. Store cake in refrigerator.

title: Day-Ahead Salad
directions: Tear lettuce in pieces., Cook and drain peas., Layer vegetables in a large salad bowl., Spread a layer of mayonnaise, sealing the lettuce., Make a second layer of vegetables., Seal with mayonnaise., Top with Parmesan cheese and then black olives. Cover tightly with Saran Wrap and refrigerate overnight., Toss before serving., Serves 6 to 8.

title: Whole Wheat Bread
directions: Combine whole wheat flour and yeast., Heat buttermilk, molasses, honey, salt and butter until warm., Add oats, whole wheat flour, yeast mixture and eggs., Bake at low speed for 3 minutes at medium.

title: Dried Beef Snax
directions: Spread, cream cheese on slice of dried beef., Put slice of pickle, on, top, and roll up., Chill, then slice into bite size pieces.

title: Cheese Log
directions: Note:, About 1 cup to 1 1/2 cups chopped pecans for outside coating.

title: Ada'S Carrot-Pineapple Jello Salad
directions: Dilute lemon jello in boiling water., Add cold water and pineapple juice., Let cool., Add the crushed pineapple and 1 cup shredded carrots., Chill until set.

title: Stew
directions: Fry bacon in a large stew pot., Remove bacon., Add stew meat and sear., Lower heat and add tomatoes, beef broth, water, celery, onion, garlic, Worcestershire sauce and chili powder., Cover and simmer 2 hours., Remove 1/4 cup broth from stew., Cool and mix with flour., Add flour mixture to stew., Season., Add carrots and potatoes and cook 30 minutes., Add corn and bacon., Cook another 5 minutes.

title: Baked Beans
directions: Saute onion in butter until tender., Put beans in a baking dish and add onions, mustard, brown sugar and bacon., Stir to mix. Bake at 350 degrees for approximately 1 hour until bubbly and set.

title: Electric 4-Alarm Chili
directions: In large, heavy pot, brown beef with onions, green pepper and garlic., Drain off fat., Add remaining ingredients, except kidney beans., Simmer, uncovered, at least 45 minutes, stirring occasionally., When thickened, stir in drained beans., Heat through and serve.

title: Parmesan Potatoes
directions: Cut potatoes into large pieces., Combine all ingredients, except butter; shake in a large bag., Melt butter in a 9 x 13-inch pan., Put potatoes in one layer., Bake at 375° for 1 hour. Turn once during baking.

title: Tammy'S Chicken Fingers
directions: Beat the eggs in a large bowl and add enough buttermilk to cover the chicken strips. Stir. Coat chicken strips and refrigerate overnight., Remove chicken strips from mixture and shake off excess., Dip in a mixture of flour, salt, pepper and the seasoned salt. Deep fry until chicken strips are golden brown and drain on a paper towel.

title: Scrambled Tots
directions: In a large frypan, put layer of Tater Tots to cover skillet. Cook Tater Tots until just about done., Mash Tater Tots flat with a spatula., Break open about 4 or 5 eggs over the top of Tater Tots., Mix eggs in with Tater Tots. Season to taste.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients together and pour into greased and floured tube pan or make three 9-inch layers. Bake for 1 hour at 325°.

title: Fresh Strawberry Pie
directions: Cook sugar, water, cornstarch and light corn syrup until thickened., After cooking immediately add jello and food coloring. Place fresh strawberries in a baked 9-inch pie shell., Pour the cooled glaze on top of strawberries., Serve with whipped cream.

title: Cheesy O'S
directions: Heat oven to 300°., Melt butter in baking pan., Stir in Parmesan cheese., Add cereal; mix well., Bake, uncovered, for 10 minutes.

title: Minestrone
directions: Put all ingredients into pot, except cabbage, zucchini and beans., Let cook 1 hour; add rest of ingredients., Let simmer another 1 1/2 hours., Serve with garlic bread and salad.

title: Inside-Out Ravioli
directions: Brown first 3 ingredients in large skillet., Cook spinach, using package directions., Drain, reserving liquid., Add water to make one cup., Add spinach liquid and next 5 ingredients to meat mixture; simmer 10 minutes.

title: Milk Chocolate Brownies
directions: Melt butter over low heat and remove from stove. Add 2 cups sugar. Beat well. Mix in eggs and vanilla; blend well. Sift together flour, cocoa and salt. Add to sugar mixture. Mix well. Stir in coconut. Spread into greased 9 x 13 baking pan.

title: Baked Rice Dressing
directions: Mix all in large bowl., Bake in covered 9 x 13-inch bowl at 350°, for 1 hour.

title: Dump Cake
directions: Put in a 9 x 13-inch cake just as listed., Sprinkle cake mix over the whole top., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Spaghetti Broccoli Au Gratin
directions: Cook spaghetti and drain., Cook onions in melted margarine until limp., Add thawed broccoli, salt, pepper and savory., Cook 5 minutes over low heat., Put spaghetti into greased 3-quart casserole., Cover with a layer of cheese slices., Pour in milk. Add a layer of broccoli, then cover with cheese slices., Bake 30 minutes in a 375° oven.

title: Banana Bread
directions: Cream Crisco and sugar well. Add eggs and beat. Sift dry ingredients together. Add this a little at a time while beating the egg mixture., Add bananas and nuts. Bake in greased, slightly floured loaf pan at 350° for about 1 hour or until toothpick comes out clean. Makes one loaf.

title: *No Crust Coconut Pie*
directions: Mix the first 4 ingredients., Add vanilla, then add milk and coconut., Grease two 9-inch pans., Bake at 350° for about 45 minutes.

title: Macaroni Cheese Salad With Dill Weed
directions: Cook macaroni according to package directions; drain., Turn, while still hot, into a bowl that contains butter and Parmesan cheese; toss to coat., Add celery, cheese, salad cubes, mayonnaise to moisten, salt, pepper, seasoned salt and mustard;, mix well and chill., Turn out on salad greens, and if desired, 2 cups of slivered ham or 1/4 cup of real bacon crumbs may be added to recipe., Serves 8 to 10.

title: Squash Balls
directions: Mix first 6 ingredients and form into small balls., Roll in cornflakes., Drop in hot grease and fry.

title: Hamburger Quiche(Serves 4)
directions: Brown ground chuck; add green pepper and onion., Cook until tender; drain off fat., Mix mayonnaise, milk, eggs and cornstarch until smooth., Add beef, cheese and salt., Stir until well blended., Pour into uncooked pastry shell and bake on cookie sheet at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes., It's ready when knife inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Easy Cheese Cake
directions: Whip the cream cheese., Stir in sour cream, then add sugar and vanilla; blend well., Put in graham cracker crust., Bake for 20 minutes at 375°.

title: Monkey Bread
directions: Put granulated sugar and cinnamon in bag., Shake biscuits (quartered) in bag., Layer biscuits in tube pan., Pour extra sugar/cinnamon mixture over biscuits in pan., In a saucepan, mix brown sugar and butter for 1 minute., Pour mixture over biscuits as you layer them in tube pan., Bake at 350° for 35 minutes., To serve, dump out of pan onto plate.

title: Pizzarino Green Beans
directions: Combine drained beans with remaining ingredients., Heat thoroughly, stirring gently.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
directions: Mix together the first 3 ingredients; let stand a while, preparing other ingredients., Add the flour, soda, salt, cinnamon, dates and nuts; mix., Add the oil and vanilla; mix well., Cook in tube pan or loaf pan at 325° for 1 hour and 20 minutes.

title: Cranberry-Raspberry Relish
directions: Mix all ingredients in a large bowl., May be refrigerated, covered, for 1 month., Makes 5 cups.

title: Berniece Thurn'S Pancake
directions: Beat egg whites until stiff; set aside., Mix together yolks and the rest of ingredients; fold in egg whites., Cook on hot griddle or heavy frying pan until bubbly on top; turn once., Cook until golden brown., Serve with hot syrup and butter.

title: Meatball Casserole
directions: Mix ingredients; form into small meatballs., Bake at 350° for 35 minutes uncovered in baking dish., Add tomatoes and peas. Return to oven for 15 to 20 minutes with cover on., Serve over rice or noodles.

title: Noodles Warsaw
directions: Chop cabbage into pieces., Brown sausage, season with chili powder., Drain sausage., Bring water to a boil and cook noodles for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Tootie Fruitie Salad
directions: In large mixing bowl, place peaches, pineapple and fruit cocktail if used with all juices; slice strawberries and add, to other fruit, then add pudding mixes. Do not prepare pudding, just dump in bowl with fruit and mix. Add bananas, sliced or chunk-sizes. Mix all together and refrigerate.

title: June'S Kidney Beans(Abington Grange Supper)
directions: Soak beans overnight., Place salt pork in the bottom of a bean pot, drain the beans and to pot with all other ingredients., Cover with hot water and bake at 325° for 5 or 6 hours., Add more water as needed and reduce temperature to 300° for last hour., Add more molasses, if desired., Fork test, done when beans are tender, but not mushy., Serves 10 hungry people.

title: Melanie'S Simple Sorbet
directions: Freeze unopened can of fruit for at, least 12 hours (longer is even better)., Dip frozen can in hot water a few seconds to loosen edges and make it easier to get out the contents., Cut the frozen fruit up into chunks and put into food processor., Add lemon juice, liqueur and cranberries. Pulse on/off for about 30 seconds., Serve immediately or can be scooped into small balls and stored in freezer until ready to serve., Makes 2 to 3 servings.

title: Egg And Sausage Casserole
directions: Mix all together., Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes (or longer, if needed).

title: Cabbage Casserole
directions: Cut cabbage into large chucks., Put in casserole., Brown ground chuck and onion; drain., Add tomato soup (not diluted). Put over cabbage., Cook in a 350° oven for 45 minutes to 1 hour. Stir in 1/2 hour.

title: Baked Beans
directions: Mix together beans, brown sugar, barbecue sauce and bacon. Saute onion and pepper; add to other mixture., Put in baking dish; bake 1 hour at 350°.

title: Marinated Salad
directions: Mix all together, refrigerate overnight, drain and serve.

title: Holiday Eggnog
directions: Beat eggs and add all ingredients, cooking constantly., Chill! Fold in egg whites and cream; fold in brandy and rum., Chill, then add vanilla.

title: Honey Drop Cookies
directions: Cream shortening and sugar; add eggs and beat well., Sift together dry ingredients and add to creamed mixture., Add vanilla and honey., Bake on greased cookie sheets at 350°.

title: French Salad Dressing
directions: Put all the ingredients in mixing bowl., Mix on low for 15 minutes.

title: White Enchiladas
directions: Crush Doritos., Mix together soup, sour cream, chilies, onion and chicken., In a 3-quart casserole, layer Doritos, soup mixture and cheese in that order., Make 2 layers., Bake 30 minutes at 350°., Serves 8 to 10.

title: Lazy Lasagna
directions: Brown meat in a large saucepan and drain., Add next 4 ingredients., Bring to boil and simmer for 10 minutes., In a small bowl, mix Ricotta cheese or cottage cheese, egg and Parmesan cheese., Put a little of the meat sauce in bottom of 13 x 9 baking dish and alternate layers as follows:, noodles, 1/3 meat sauce, half of cheese mixture., Repeat and then top with remaining meat sauce., Sprinkle Mozzarella cheese on top and cover with foil. Bake at 350° for one hour or until noodles are tender., Let stand 10 minutes before cutting.

title: Nanaimo Bars
directions: Prepare 9 x 13-inch pan with vegetable spray., Cook margarine, sugar, chocolate and vanilla in top of double boiler over simmering water until blended., Add egg; stir slowly., Cook 5 minutes; stir constantly., Add vanilla, cracker crumbs and pecans. Press into prepared pan., Chill 15 minutes., Cream margarine and Neufchatel cheese until fluffy., Add vanilla., Gradually add powdered sugar; beat until smooth., Add color; pour over cracker mixture., Refrigerate 30 minutes., Melt butter and chocolate chips in top of double boiler., Spread over cream filling., Refrigerate until firm., Cut into squares (36).

title: Apple Cake
directions: Mix well, pour into greased and floured tube pan and bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Easy Chicken Pie
directions: Place chicken in greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish., Mix soup and broth and pour over chicken., Place sliced boiled eggs over soup mixture., Mix flour, margarine and milk., Pour over chicken mixture., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour or until golden brown.

title: Spudnuts
directions: Dissolve yeast in 1/4 cup water., Mix potatoes and milk., Add flour salt, shortening and sugar., Add 3 more cups flour and knead., If needed, add 1 more cup flour., Let dough double itself, then roll out and cut with regular doughnut cutter., Let rise until twice their regular size., Cook in deep oil at 390°., Makes 4 dozen plus holes.

title: Broccoli And Cauliflower
directions: Cook according to directions; drain.

title: Meat Loaf
directions: Combine all ingredients thoroughly, except only add 1/2 cup of tomato ketchup at this time., Mix with hands., Pack firmly into ungreased baking dish., Bake in preheated oven at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes., At the last 15 minutes of baking time, take the meat loaf out and brush the other 1/2 cup of tomato ketchup over the top., Put back in oven for rest of baking time., Let stand 5 to 10 minutes before slicing., Makes 8 servings.

title: Chicken Parmesan
directions: Place chicken in baking dish., Bake, covered, for 15 minutes in a preheated 425° oven., Drain broth., Combine tomatoes, cornstarch, basil or oregano and optional pepper sauce., Cook, stirring constantly, until sauce thickens., Pour heated sauce over chicken., Top with cheese., Bake 5 minutes uncovered.

title: "Momma'S Chili"
directions: Cook in at least a 4-quart Dutch oven., Brown the ground chuck and chopped onion until the meat is thoroughly cooked., Add the salt and pepper for seasoning., Then add the remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil over low heat for 30 to 35 minutes., Stir often to avoid burning., No lid is necessary., Serve hot., Serves 4.

title: Sausage Balls
directions: Blend all ingredients., Shape into 1-teaspoon size balls., Put on ungreased cookie sheet., Bake at 325° for 15 to 20 minutes. Makes 4 to 6 dozen.

title: Strawberry-Banana Whip
directions: Combine all the ingredients in a blender and blend until smooth. Chill or serve immediately.

title: Salmon Croquettes
directions: Melt Crisco in small pan; blend in flour., Add milk., Cook and stir until very thick and smooth., Remove from heat., Pour into bowl and add onion, lemon juice and seasonings., Stir in salmon. Shape into balls., Roll in bread crumbs., Combine egg with water. Dip balls in mixture., Roll in bread crumbs., Deep fry until browned, about 3 minutes., Serve plain or with cream gravy with peas.

title: Meat Loaf
directions: Mix ground beef lightly with bread crumbs, egg, milk, onion, salt and pepper in a bowl., Pack mixture lightly in a 2-quart loaf dish., Cover with waxed paper., Cook in microwave 5 minutes at Medium-high., Top with catsup., Rotate dish 1/2 turn., Cook, covered, 15 minutes on High or until done., Remove from microwave. Cover with aluminum foil and let stand 5 minutes., Serves 6.

title: Ham And Cheese Quiche
directions: Mix sour cream, milk, Bisquick, eggs, pepper and salt together; stir in ham, cheese and chilies., Pour into deep pie plate., Cook until inserted knife comes out clean at 400° (40 minutes)., Let stand 5 to 10 minutes before cutting.

title: Pizza Dough
directions: Dissolve yeast in warm water., Stir in remaining ingredients; beat vigorously 20 strokes., Let rest about 5 minutes.

title: Southern Okra
directions: Cook okra in boiling salted water 10 minutes; drain., Brown onion and green pepper in salad oil., Add tomatoes and cook slowly for 5 minutes., Add okra and remaining ingredients., Cook over low heat until vegetables are just tender, stirring as little as possible., One cup canned tomatoes may be used in place of fresh tomatoes., Serves 4.

title: Simple Super Fudge
directions: Use a double boiler; heat chocolate chips until melted., Add can of condensed milk and vanilla., (Also peanut butter if desired.), Add nuts., Pour into a lightly buttered 8-inch or 9-inch square pan., Cool for 1 or more hours and then cut into squares.

title: Wet Chicken
directions: Wash and cut chicken., Lightly salt and pepper, then place in flour., Place shortening into frypan on medium heat., Brown chicken and then place into a large pot with a lid., After all chicken has been browned, pour remaining drippings over chicken and cover chicken with water., Bring to a boil and then simmer 1 hour. Remove chicken., It should have made its own gravy., Pour over rice or potatoes.

title: Stuffed Celery
directions: Wash, and, drain, celery., Cut into pieces three inches long. Fray, ends	if, you, want the celery to curl., Chill in cold water, overnight., Mix, and blend sour cream, mayonnaise and pecans., Drain the crisp celery sticks and fill with this mixture.

title: Dirty Rice
directions: Cook sausage and drain., Cut up celery, onion and bell pepper; add to sausage., Pour in chicken broth., Add uncooked rice., Mix well., Pour into lightly greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish., Cover and bake 1 hour at 350°., When cooked, fluff with fork.

title: Lime-Sweet Pickles
directions: Soak cucumbers in lime water for 24 hours., Rinse in clear water several times., Soak in clean water for 3 hours., Drain. Mix the cloves, vinegar, celery seed, salt and mixed spices; pour over pickles., Let stand overnight., Heat to boiling and put into jars.

title: Fresh Strawberry Pie
directions: Wash and hull berries; set aside., Mix sugar, cornstarch and Jell-O., Add water and syrup., Cook over medium until thickened. Mixture won't be real thick., Cool., When cool, pour over berries and toss lightly., Pour into baked 9-inch pie shell., Refrigerate until set, about 3 or 4 hours., Top with whipped cream or Cool Whip., Serves 6.

title: Custard Pie
directions: Combine sugar, flour and salt. Add beaten eggs and vanilla. Mix well. Slowly add scalded milk and stir until well blended. Pour into unbaked, deep, 9-inch pie shell. Bake 50 minutes at 325°.

title: Forget-Me-Not Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Beat eggs until foamy and white., Add salt., Continue to beat, gradually adding sugar until a stiff peak forms., Fold in morsels and pecans., Place on ungreased cookie sheet by the spoonful., Place in oven and turn oven off., Do not open door until the next morning., Yields 40 to 60 cookies.

title: Salmonettes Heloise
directions: Pour salmon juice into measuring cup and set aside., Put salmon in mixing bowl and 1 egg., Break up salmon and mix the egg real good., Fork in 1/2 cup flour., Mixture is thick., Add a little pepper, 1/4 salmon juice and add 1 teaspoon baking powder. Beat with a fork., It must foam., Pour into salmon mixture., Mix with fork., Scoop with small spoons into hot oil., Makes brown tidbits., Stick with toothpick and serve with dip or put a hot sauce over them.

title: German Cheese Soup
directions: Cook vegetables in one and one-half quarts of water until tender., Add other ingredients and cook until cheese is melted.

title: Hot Fudge Sauce
directions: Mix all ingredients, except vanilla, in saucepan and cook until it thickens., Add vanilla., This will get thicker as it cools.

title: Double Quick Rolls(Makes 1 Dozen Rolls)
directions: Mix flour, sugar, salt and yeast in a large bowl., Add water, shortening and egg., Beat until smooth., Cover and let rise in a warm place until double in bulk, about 30 minutes., Stir down batter by beating about 25 strokes., Spoon into 12 greased muffin tins., Let rise until batter rounds over tops of cups, about 20 to 30 minutes., Heat oven to 400°., Bake until golden brown (15 to 20 minutes).

title: Pumpkin Roll
directions: Beat eggs on high speed for 5 minutes, gradually adding the sugar., Stir in pumpkin and lemon juice., Mix together dry ingredients and add to pumpkin mixture., Spread onto jelly roll pan; bake at 375° for 15 minutes., Unroll onto toweling sprinkled with powdered sugar; spread filling mixture thick over roll., Roll up and allow to cool; slice.

title: Basic Turkey Meat Loaf
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Combine all ingredients; place in lightly greased 4 1/2 x 8 1/2 x 2 5/8-inch loaf pan or shape in loaf form and place into 1-quart greased baking dish., Bake for 45 to 60 minutes or until meat is no longer pink in center of loaf. Unmold on platter; top with sliced tomatoes and garnish with parsley, if desired.

title: Bisquick Butter Biscuits
directions: Cut cold butter into 1/4-inch pieces., Toss baking mix and butter with fork until coated., Add milk; stir just until milk is absorbed (do not overstir).

title: Microwave Sliced Baked Potatoes
directions: Peel potatoes if skin is tough or just rinse and pat dry., Cut potatoes into thin slices but not all the way through., Place potatoes in microwave dish., Sprinkle with melted butter and herbs., Microwave on High for 10 minutes; rearrange after 5 minutes., Let rest for 5 minutes., Sprinkle with grated cheese and Parmesan cheese., Microwave for 4 to 6 minutes until potatoes are soft and cheese melted., Sprinkle with salt.

title: Chocolate Coconut Drops
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Heat chocolate in 2-quart saucepan over low heat; stir frequently until melted., Remove from heat., Stir in coconut, walnuts and milk.

title: Stir-Fried Pork With Garlic
directions: In a bowl, combine pork, sherry, soy sauce, vinegar, cornstarch, ginger, sugar and chili paste., Toss to mix., Marinate 30 minutes.

title: Baked Pineapple(Side Dish For Ham)
directions: Mix all ingredients., Pour into a baking dish., Bake at 350° for 1 hour., Can be served with ham.

title: Ribbon Jello Salad
directions: Dissolve 1 package jello in 1 cup boiling water., Add 4 tablespoons cold water., Set aside 1/2 cup of mixture., Put in 1/3 cup sour cream., Pour remaining in a 9 x 12-inch glass pan., Set until firm, at least 1/2 hour., Pour on sour cream mixture; set 1/2 hour.

title: Banana Bread
directions: Cream the sugar and shortening. Add eggs and bananas. Sift flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt. Add to mixture., Bake at 325° for 45 minutes., Makes 2 loaves.

title: Tater Tot Casserole
directions: Brown hamburger., Put in bottom of an 11 x 14-inch baking dish., Cook celery and onion; drain peas., Spread celery, onion and peas over meat., Spread undiluted mushroom soup over all. Cover with Tater Tots., Bake in a 350° oven 3/4 to 1 hour.

title: Mandarin Pork Chops With Wild Rice
directions: In large skillet, heat 1 tablespoon oil and brown chops., Add water, long grain and wild rice with sauce (original recipe), reserved syrup and green onions., Bring to a boil., Reduce heat and simmer, stirring occasionally, 13 minutes or until pork is done., Stir in oranges; heat through.

title: Twinkie Cake
directions: Cut Twinkies in half., Fill 9 x 12-inch pan., Top with pineapple and bananas and the prepared pudding mix., Last, top with Cool Whip., Chill 30 minutes before serving.

title: Red Beans
directions: Add all ingredients together with enough water to cook until tender and of desired consistency.

title: Caramel Corn
directions: Prepare popcorn and add peanuts, if desired, or any kind of nuts you want., Cook sugar, butter, salt and Karo for 5 minutes. Take from stove and add baking soda., It will foam, then add vanilla., Pour over popcorn and mix well., Spread out onto 2 cookie sheets and bake in 250° oven for 1/2 hour., Stir after 15 minutes. Pour onto wax paper and spread apart., Cool and then it can be stored in plastic bags or an airtight container., It will last a while., Yield:, 8 quarts.

title: Peter Paul Mounds Cake
directions: Put all in mixer with cake mix and follow directions on box of cake mix.

title: Rice Krispies Raisin Cookies
directions: Combine flour, salt, baking powder and soda; set aside., In mixer bowl thoroughly combine sugar, brown sugar and margarine. Add eggs and vanilla; beat well., Add Rice Krispies and raisins, mixing until it combines., Drop cookies on greased cookie sheet and bake at 350° for about 16 minutes or until light golden brown.

title: Tex Mex Dip
directions: Layer on platter in this order:, Spread bean dip on a large, shallow serving platter., Peel, pit and mash avocados., Add lemon juice, salt and pepper., Mix well., Combine sour cream, mayonnaise and taco seasoning; mix in separate bowl., Layer avocado mixture over bean dip, then layer taco seasoning mixture over avocado layer., Top with green onions, tomatoes and sliced black olives, then sprinkle Cheddar cheese over top of dip mixture., Serve with large, round tortilla chips.

title: Strombolis
directions: Brown meat, pepper and onion in 2 tablespoons oil with garlic. Add tomatoes., Drain all liquid so mixture is very dry., Flatten out crescent rolls into 1 sheet, mush seams together so there are no holes., Place meat and vegetable mixture on one half and bring other side over., Press edges together., Cook 35 minutes at 350° until crust is golden brown., Serves 2 adults and 1 to 2 children. Repeat recipe to make more Strombolis as needed.

title: Sauerkraut And Spareribs
directions: Rinse kraut and put in roaster., Top kraut with onion slices and sprinkle with brown sugar., Add water so it is almost to the top of the kraut in the pan., Brown ribs in skillet and lay on top of kraut., Mix in a large measuring cup ketchup and Worcestershire sauce, and then fill the cup with water so the mixture measures a total of 1 cup., Mix and pour over ribs and kraut., Put in oven for 2 1/2 hours at 350°.

title: Lemon Bread
directions: Beat egg in large bowl until thickened., Add marmalade and butter until well blended., Sift together flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt., Combine buttermilk and lemon juice. Alternately add dry and liquid ingredients in thirds to egg mixture, stirring until well mixed., Fold in walnuts., Pour batter into greased loaf pan., Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes., Cool in pan 5 minutes., Invert onto wire rack.

title: Cherry Crumb Cake
directions: Sift flour, baking powder and salt., Mix with sugar., Cut in butter; add beaten egg and mix to make crumbs., Place 1/2 of crumbs in bottom of greased 13 x 9-inch pan., Distribute cherries evenly and top with remaining crumbs., Bake in moderate oven (350°) for 30 minutes., Serve with ice cream or other topping. Sprinkle crumbs lightly with cinnamon.

title: Garlic Buttered Green Beans
directions: Cook green beans in water, covered, until tender., Meanwhile, in a skillet saute mushrooms in butter until tender., Add onion powder and garlic powder., Drain beans., Add to skillet and toss. Season with salt and pepper., Yield:, 6 servings.

title: Mother'S Golden Potato Casserole
directions: Grate potatoes coarsely., Add other ingredients, except last 2, mix thoroughly., Press into casserole dish., Top with mixture of bread crumbs and butter., Bake at 300° for 1 hour.

title: Cottage Cheese And Apple Pancakes
directions: Beat egg whites until stiff. Combine all other ingredients in a medium size bowl and mix well. Fold in egg whites., Heat oil or melt butter in a skillet., When it is hot enough to sizzle a drop of batter on contact, add spoonfuls of batter., Fry on both sides until firm and lightly browned. Serve immediately. Serves 4.

title: Pumpkin Bread
directions: Sift together first 7 ingredients, all into a large mixing bowl., Add next 4 ingredients., Beat together until smooth., Add last 2 ingredients.

title: Easy Spaghetti
directions: Brown hamburger meat with onion and bell pepper., Drain grease., Add spaghetti and tomatoes., Simmer for 30 minutes.

title: Strawberry Congealed Salad
directions: Drain juice off strawberries and pineapple; add enough water to make 3 1/2 cups juice., Heat liquid and pour over Jell-O to dissolve., Stir well and jell slightly., Mash bananas and add strawberries, pineapple and pecans., Fold into Jell-O mixture and pour half of mixture into mold., Spread on sour cream., Add remaining half of mixture and chill.

title: Cherry Salad Supreme
directions: Dissolve raspberry Jell-O in 1 cup boiling water., Stir in pie filling., Turn into 9 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish., Chill until partially set., Dissolve lemon Jell-O in 1 cup boiling water. Beat together cream cheese and mayonnaise., Gradually add lemon Jell-O., Stir in undrained pineapple and whip 1/2 cup whipping cream., Fold into lemon mixture with one cup of tiny marshmallows. Spread on top of cherry layer., Top with nuts., Makes 12 servings.

title: Chicken Pineapple Salad
directions: Remove giblets and neck from chicken, then rinse chicken well under cold water., Place chicken, breast side down, in an 8-quart kettle., Add carrots, cut up celery, onion, 1 teaspoon salt, the bay leaf and 1 quart of water., Bring to boiling over high heat. Reduce heat; simmer, covered, for about 2 hours, or until chicken is tender., Let stand, uncovered, and frequently spoon broth over chicken for 1 hour, or until cool enough to handle., Remove meat from bones in as large of pieces as you can., Pull skin from chicken., Cut chicken into 1/2 to 1-inch chunks., Chill.

title: Potato Casserole
directions: Grease 13 x 9-inch pan and spread frozen potatoes in pan. Saute onion (chopped) in 1/4 cup margarine., Mix together onion, creamed soup, sour cream and shredded Cheddar cheese., Pour over potatoes., Mix together corn flake crumbs and 1/4 cup melted butter., Pour on top of casserole., Cover with foil., Bake 1 hour at 350°.

title: Hot Cross Buns(A Family Tradition On Good Friday)
directions: Combine sugar, salt, yeast and flour in large bowl., In 1-quart saucepan, over low heat, heat milk and butter until very warm (120° to 130°)., With mixer at low speed, beat liquid into dry ingredients until blended., Increase speed to medium; beat 2 minutes., Beat in egg and 1 cup flour to make a thick batter; continue beating 2 minutes, scraping bowl often., Stir in raisins and flour to make a soft dough.

title: Picante Sauce
directions: Put tomatoes, onions, bell peppers and jalapeno peppers through food grinder., Add seasonings and vinegar., Bring to a boil., Simmer about 1 hour, stirring often., Pour in pint jars and seal in hot water bath.

title: Sugar Cookies
directions: Beat egg; add sugar and salt. Mix baking powder in the flour. Mix soda in buttermilk. Then pour into egg and sugar. Add butter and stir until mixed well. Add all to flour. Mix well; add flour until stiff dough. Roll real thin and sprinkle with sugar. Cut and cook in moderate oven until brown through. Makes 150 cookies.

title: Seafoam Salad
directions: Make jello with 1 cup of water; let cool., Cream the cream cheese and add jello., Add pineapple and nuts., Fold in whipped cream., Refrigerate., (I use a ring mold.), Serves 10 to 12.

title: White Greek Cookies
directions: Cream butter well, then add sugar gradually., Add egg yolks and vanilla, continuing to mix., Fold in almonds and whiskey., Add flour and baking powder and mix by hand until dough is formed. Then make small shaped cookies (round balls, flat half moons). Bake at 350° for 20 minutes (almost light gold) on ungreased cookie sheet., Cool cookies before sifting confectioners sugar on top and bottom.

title: Sandwich Spread
directions: Cut Spam and cheese in pieces., Use food grinder with small attachments., Grind all and add enough Miracle Whip to moisten well., Let set in refrigerator for 24 hours.

title: Old-Fashioned Tea Cakes
directions: Sift flour in a large bowl., Make hole in center of flour and put in all ingredients in the hole., Work up as you would for biscuits., When all is mixed together, roll out on floured paper and cut., Bake at 350° until brown.

title: Ricotta Cheese Cake
directions: Follow directions on cake package mix., In a separate bowl, mix remainder of ingredients., Grease and flour a 13 x 9-inch baking pan., Pour cake mix into pan., Pour Ricotta mixture over the batter., Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes or 325° if oven is too hot., Let cool completely before cutting.

title: Cherry Tomato Salad
directions: Cook bacon until crisp., Drain and crumble., Combine bacon with tomatoes, cucumber and onions., Sprinkle with garlic salt, sweet basil and pepper., Mix well and chill., Combine vinegar and salad oil; shake well., Just before serving, pour over salad and toss., Serves 6 to 8.

title: Seedless Raisin Tarts
directions: Beat all ingredients together and fill unbaked tart shells. Sprinkle with grated cheese., Makes about 15., Bake at 350°.

title: Fruit Cake
directions: Melt butter and sugar; add eggs and flavoring., Sift flour, cinnamon and nutmeg and add a little at a time., Beat well; add nuts and fruit., Bake 2 1/2 hours at 275°., Take out of oven., Put cherries, pineapple and pecans on top., Cook 1/2 hour longer.

title: Orange Blossom Cream
directions: Dissolve sugar in orange juice., Whip evaporated milk until stiff., Combine with juice; mix well., Serve immediately.

title: Independent Dream Cake
directions: Gradually add orange juice to confectioners sugar, blending well., Makes 1/3 cup.

title: Vegetable Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients in a greased casserole dish., Top with Pepperidge Farm herb stuffing mix., Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Peanut Logs
directions: Mix, well peanut butter, Rice Krispies, oleo and sugar. Melt chocolate chips and wax., Roll by teaspoon size in hands. Keep your, fingers, wet, and, then, dip the logs in chocolate mixture. Put on wax paper.

title: Bread-N-Butter Pudding
directions: Butter glass baking dish., Cut buttered bread into triangles; mix fruit with sugar., Arrange buttered bread, fruit and sugar in layers in the dish., Beat the eggs with the milk, then pour egg and milk mixture over the bread-butter-fruit and allow this to soak in for 15 to 20 minutes., Then bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour or until custard is set and top is lightly browned.

title: Peanut Butter Bar Cookies
directions: Melt together corn syrup and white sugar., Remove from heat; stir in peanut butter until smooth., Add 7 cups cereal (corn flakes, Rice Krispies, Cheerios, etc.)., Mix well., Press into a 13 x 9-inch pan., Cool and cut into squares.

title: Pecan Dainties
directions: Mix butter, brown sugar and 1/2 cup confectioners sugar. Blend in flour and vanilla. Stir in nuts., Using about 1 teaspoon of dough, shape into crescents or balls., Place on ungreased baking sheets. Bake 10 to 12 minutes at 350° until lightly browned. Cool. Roll in confectioners sugar.

title: Mexican White Corn
directions: Melt the margarine and cream cheese over low heat., Leave all liquid on chilies for spicier flavor., Mix altogether., Bake for 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Carrots A L'Orange
directions: Mix cornstarch and sugar in small saucepan., Pour in orange juice and mix well., Heat, stirring until thickened., Stir in butter and ginger., Pour over cooked carrots.

title: Tomatoes With Mozzarella
directions: Layer slices of tomatoes and Mozzarella., Sprinkle with chopped fresh basil, salt and freshly ground pepper., Drizzle with extra virgin olive oil.

title: Eggplant Supreme
directions: Heat oven to 350°. Fry eggplant and drain on paper towels. Cook spinach according to directions and drain., Mix Ricotta cheese and spincah, don't beat, just blend., Spread evenly in pan. Layer eggplant on top., Either slice or grate Mozzarella cheese and layer over eggplant., Cover with sauce., Sprinkle grated cheese. Give it a blessing and throw it in preheated oven for 45 minutes until bubbly., Enjoy!

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Mix all together and bake in buttered casserole. Crumble Ritz crackers on top., Bake at 350° for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Mandarin And Pineapple Salad
directions: Drain juice and add to water to make 3 cups; boil., Add Jell-O, fruit and cinnamon., Let set, serves 8.

title: Pistachio Torte
directions: Mix nuts, sugar, flour and butter; press into 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes., Cool.

title: Chili Sauce
directions: Peel and cut tomatoes in 8 pieces., Put onions and peppers through grinder., Put all ingredients in large pot and cook until thick., Makes about 8 pints.

title: Cherries In Snow
directions: Soften cream cheese., Mix in powdered sugar, vanilla and milk. Gently fold in Cool Whip., In glass bowl, put some of the cake cubes., Drizzle some of the Cool Whip mixture over cake., Spoon pie filling over that., Add another layer of cake, Cool Whip and cherries., Keep making layers until all ingredients are used up, ending with cherries on top., Store in refrigerator or make ahead of time and freeze., This makes a lot!

title: Layered Spinach Salad
directions: Cook tortellini to desired doneness as directed on package. Drain; rinse with cold water., In large clear glass bowl with straight sides or 13 x 9-inch baking dish, layer cabbage, spinach, tortellini, tomatoes and green onions., Pour dressing evenly over top; sprinkle with bacon., Cover; refrigerate until serving time. Makes 8 (1/2-cup) servings.

title: Pasta
directions: Cook the pasta in boiling water (do not overcook); drain in colander., Pour warm pasta in bowl and pour Wish-Bone dressing over., Stir., Cool at room temperature., Meanwhile, dice green peppers and thinly slice onions., Cube the cheese into 1/4-inch cubes., Add all to pasta except cheese and parsley., They can be added just before serving., Serve on a lettuce leaf.

title: Lou'S Turkey Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients and place in dish., Cover with potato chips, crushed or uncrushed., Bake 20 minutes at 350°., Great for after the holiday meals.

title: Mediterranean Vegetable Pie(Yields 8 Servings)
directions: Preheat oven to 425°., Place eggplant between several thicknesses of paper towels., Sprinkle with a teaspoon of salt; weigh down with breadboard or several recipe books and let stand 30 minutes., Cut into 1/4-inch cubes., Heat 1/2 cup olive oil in a large Teflon skillet; add the eggplant and quickly toss to coat with oil., Cook, stirring constantly, until eggplant is tender, about 5 minutes., Remove to a large bowl., Pour remaining olive oil in the skillet, add onion, green pepper, zucchini and garlic., Cook until veggies are tender, but do not lose their shape, about 5 minutes., Reserve., Combine oregano, basil, 1/2 teaspoon salt and pepper in a small measuring cup.

title: Boston Brown Bread
directions: Heat raisins and water just until the mixture comes to a boil. Cool., Add soda and set aside., Mix sugar, oleo and eggs and beat until smooth., Add flour, salt, raisins and water., Beat until smooth., Bake in loaf pan at 350° until, when tested, the toothpick comes out clean.

title: Sauerkraut Salad
directions: In large bowl, mix first 6 ingredients., In a jar or small bowl, combine sugar and oil., Pour over vegetables and mix well. Cover and refrigerate for at least 8 hours.

title: Chinese Country Ribs
directions: Combine soy sauce, marmalade, catsup and garlic., Brush both sides of ribs., Place in crock-pot., Pour in remaining sauce. Cover and cook on low, 8 to 10 hours., Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Pecan Crisp Treats
directions: Melt margarine for 1 minute in microwave., Add sugar and microwave 2 more minutes., Add vanilla and nuts., Grease jelly roll cookie sheet., Carefully break each cracker into 4 pieces and place side by side in a single layer on cookie sheet., Drizzle pecan mixture over crackers., (Do 1 pan at a time.), Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes., Remove from pan while still warm.

title: Hamburger Pizza
directions: Prepare pizza dough according to package directions., Mix together tomato paste and tomato sauce., Add dash of oregano and dash of garlic salt. Spread sauce over unbaked pizza crust. Spread browned ground chuck over the sauce., Top with grated cheese., Bake on lowest rack for 10 minutes at 500° or, until golden brown., Makes 1 pizza.

title: Mother'S Cornbread Dressing
directions: Cook onion and celery in part of broth until tender, then puree., Crumble cornbread and toasted bread., Mix with rice, pureed onion mixture and enough broth to make a fairly soupy mixture., Heat bacon grease in shallow baking pan and add dressing mixture and bake at 400° until brown on top and crusty on edges.

title: Chicken Stir-Fry
directions: Cut skinned and boneless chicken breasts into bite-sized pieces., Mix slightly beaten egg white, 1 teaspoon cornstarch, soy sauce and fresh ground pepper in a plastic bag., Add chicken, tie bag and refrigerate for up to 1 hour, turning bag occasionally. Cut both peppers into thin strips., Slice onion very thin and separate into rings., Mix 1 tablespoon cornstarch, water, sugar and sesame oil., Heat wok until very hot, pour oil down sides of wok and rotate to oil all sides., Add onion, garlic and ginger. Stir-fry 1 to 2 minutes, until onion is light brown and softened. Add chicken and stir-fry until chicken pieces turn white., Add hoisin sauce and chili paste; stir for about 30 to 40 seconds. Stir in broth and heat to boiling., Add the green and red pepper strips; stir-fry for about 1 minute more., Add the cornstarch mixture and stir until thickened., If desired, sprinkle with roasted peanuts., Yield:, 4 servings., Carbohydrate 9 g, protein 23 g, fat 17 g, calories 284.

title: Persimmon Marmalade
directions: Cut, core and mash fruit., Add other ingredients and cook until thick. Pour into jars and process 10 minutes in boiling water bath., Makes 6 (1/2-pint) jars.

title: Pie
directions: Mix flour, sugar, salt together. Then add to egg yolk and milk mixture. stir into heated milk. Cook over medium heat until thick stirring constantly. Add butter, vanilla and coconut, banana or cocoa. Pour into baked 9 inch pie shell.

title: Crispy Chocolate Log
directions: Line a 15 x 10 x 2-inch jelly roll pan with waxed paper; grease the paper and set aside., In a large microwave-safe bowl, combine marshmallows, butter and peanut butter., Cover and microwave on High for 2 minutes; stir until well blended., Stir in cereal until well coated., Spread into prepared pan., In a microwave-safe bowl, combine chocolate and butterscotch chips. Microwave, uncovered, on High for 2 minutes., Stir; spread over cereal to within 1-inch of edges., Roll up jelly roll style, starting with a short side, peeling away waxed paper while rolling., Place, seam side down, on a serving plate., Refrigerate for 1 hour or until set., Cut into 1-inch slices., Makes 10 servings.

title: Oven Baked Halibut A La Orange
directions: Line a 12 x 8 x 2-inch shallow baking dish with foil., Lightly brush both sides of halibut steaks with oil., Arrange in dish. Sprinkle with orange peel and dill. Cover dish with foil and bake at 450°, allowing 10 to 12 minutes cooking time per inch of thickness measured at its thickest part or until halibut flakes when tested with a fork.

title: Pocket Sandwiches
directions: Take, 1, biscuit, and roll flat., Top with a filling of your choice., Take, another, biscuit, and, roll flat;, cover. Take a fork and crimp edges., Bake at 450° for 5 to 7 minutes or until done.

title: Shakertown Corn Pudding
directions: In a large bowl, blend butter, sugar, flour and salt., Add the eggs and beat well with a rotary beater or mixer on low., Stir in the corn and milk., (If using frozen corn, chop it up a little first to release the milky juices.)

title: Chicken Continental
directions: Saute chicken in oil., Sprinkle with salt; add vegetables and broth., Bring to full boil over medium heat., Separate vegetables with fork, stirring frequently., Reduce heat; cover and simmer 3 minutes., Combine sour cream, flour, and paprika., Stir into vegetables and heat gently.

title: Potato And Ham Chowder
directions: Potatoes may be red skinned or other thin skinned; cut in 1/2-inch chunks., Ham is fully cooked, smoked and cut in small chunks., Corn may be fresh, canned or frozen.

title: Three Bean Salad
directions: Combine beans; toss all together., Chill overnight., Before serving, toss to marinate beans and drain.

title: Ham Cheese Ball
directions: Put your cream cheese in a large bowl., Chop up your ham in a processor., Pour your ham in another bowl., Chop green onions in food processor., Mix together., Put about 5 or 6 handfuls of chopped ham in the cream cheese and onion mixture., Add Accent. Roll into 2 balls, then roll in ham that is left over., Serve with crackers.

title: Carrot Pineapple Bread
directions: Beat first 3 ingredients., Add next 3 ingredients; add remaining ingredients and blend., It's much easier to use Cusinart or blender for carrots., Lightly grease 2 loaf pans and bake at 325° for 1 hour.

title: Layered Taco Dip
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Brown ground beef; drain fat., Add taco seasoning per package directions and simmer approximately 5 minutes., Layer beef on bottom of 9 x 13-inch baking dish; top with refried beans; layer sour cream and salsa to taste and shredded cheese., Bake at 350° until cheese melts (approximately 10 minutes)., Garnish with diced lettuce, tomato, onion and black olives., Add salsa and serve with tortilla chips., Enjoy!

title: Heath Bars
directions: Line crackers on bottom of cookie sheet., Boil butter and brown sugar for 3 minutes., Pour sugar and butter mixture over crackers., Bake 4 minutes at 375°., Remove from oven and sprinkle chocolate chips on top., Let melt., Spread with butter knife., Put in refrigerator for about 10 minutes., Remove and cut into squares., Return to refrigerator., Sprinkle nuts on top, if you desire.

title: Sausage Snack Wraps
directions: Separate dough into 8 triangles., Cut each triangle lengthwise into thirds., Place sausages on shortest side of each triangle. Roll up from shortest side to the opposite point., Bake at 375° on ungreased cookie sheet for 12 to 15 minutes., May be prepared ahead and refrigerated up to 2 hours.

title: Hamburger Dip
directions: Melt cheese and stir in other ingredients., Simmer for a few minutes., Serve with plain tortilla chips.

title: Nannie'S Apple-Cranberry Casserole
directions: Mix ingredients and put in baking dish, then make topping.

title: Cheese Souffle
directions: Use a casserole dish with a cover., Spray dish with Pam. Alternate bread slices and cheese slices., (I also put mushrooms and chilies on top of cheese.), Pour melted butter over this. Beat eggs well., Add salt, pepper, mustard, milk, picante sauce, chilies and mushrooms., Pour this mixture over bread and cheese. Cover and refrigerate for 4 hours., (Can be made ahead and refrigerated for 2 days prior to baking.), Cook covered for 30 minutes at 350°., Uncover and bake an additional 30 minutes.

title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
directions: Heat oven to 325°., Grease and flour a 10-inch tube pan or 12 cup Bundt pan., In large mixer bowl, cream butter., Gradually add sugar, beat until light and fluffy., Add eggs, one at a time, and flavorings., Sift together flour, salt and soda., Add to creamed mixture alternately with sour cream., Pour batter into prepared pan and bake 1 hour and 15 minutes or until a wooden pick inserted in cake comes out clean., Cool about 15 minutes in pan.

title: Tomato Ketchup
directions: Wash vegetables; slice and remove seeds from peppers., Cook until celery is tender, then press through a fine sieve or pureeing device., Boil rapidly for about 30 minutes to evaporate some of the liquid., Add vinegar, sugar and spices., Cook, stirring occasionally, until mixture is thickened., Fill hot, sterilized jars and seal at once., This makes 3 to 4 pints of ketchup.

title: Cucumber Pickle Relish
directions: Mix by hand and put in jars., Makes 2 quarts., Cover with lids (not sealed) and tighten and then loosen a little., Pickles will work a little so it needs a little "working" space!, Refrigerate. Will keep up to a year.

title: Cowboy Soup
directions: Melt shortening in a large kettle., Add meat and onion., Brown slowly, stirring with a fork to break up meat., Add remaining ingredients., Mix well., Bring to a boil., Cover., Reduce heat. Simmer for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
directions: Combine all ingredients, except apples and pecans, mix well. Fold in fruit and nuts. Bake in well greased tube or bundt pan at 350 degrees for approximately 55 minutes., Cool in pan. May serve with whipped cream.

title: Wedding Punch
directions: Freeze pineapple juice. Take out 1 1/2 to 2 hours before serving time and partially thaw. Put in a large container and mash up. Add lemonade and orange juice, mixed with water as directed on cans. Add ginger ale. Stir and serve.

title: Jello Salad
directions: Mix all together and let set for about 1 hour.

title: Turkey Alfredo Casserole
directions: Cook pasta according to package directions., Drain and set aside., Run water over broccoli to thaw.

title: Meat, Potato, Egg Scramble
directions: Cook hash browns according to directions., Beat desired amount of eggs with 2 teaspoons water, then pour over potatoes., Cook eggs, turning 1 to 3 times., When eggs are done, put cheese on top., Cover pan to melt cheese., Cook in 12 x 14-inch skillet. Five eggs will serve 4 people, 4 to 6 ounce portions.

title: Cracked Wheat Cereal(Diabetic Approved)
directions: Toast cracked wheat and coconut by stirring constantly in a dry pan over medium heat for several minutes, until lightly browned., Place in a saucepan andd remaining ingredients., Bring to a boil., Reduce heat and simmer for 45 minutes., Sprinkle with chopped nut, if desired.

title: Barbecue Sauce
directions: Mix all ingredients in, a saucepan and simmer on low for about 20 to 30 minutes. Store in refrigerator.

title: Candied Sweet Potatoes
directions: Layer peeled and sliced potatoes in a 9-inch pan. Mix margarine, flour, brown sugar and water., Make a hot syrup and pour over potatoes., Bake at 400° for 45 minutes.

title: Brown Sugar Squares
directions: Mix thoroughly and bake 16 to 20 minutes at 375° in a 10 x 14-inch pan., When cool, cut into squares.

title: Tender Roast
directions: Spray pan with Pam., Slice onion in bottom of pan., Wash; salt and pepper the roast., Lay roast on onion in pan., Cover roast with the undiluted soup., Cover pan with aluminum foil., Cook in a 300° oven for 3 hours., This will make its own gravy.

title: Dill Pickles
directions: Wash cucumbers and pack in jars., To each quart jar add 1/2 bunch dill or more, 1 garlic button and 1 small onion., Let vinegar, water and salt come to a boil; pour over cucumbers. Seal.

title: Orange Supreme Tropical Delight Cake
directions: Cook cake as directed on box for making 2 (9-inch) round cakes.

title: Pear Butter
directions: Combine pears and water in a large Dutch oven., Cover and cook over medium-low heat 40 minutes or until pears are soft, stirring occasionally., Drain., Press pears through a sieve or food mill; measure 1 quart of puree., Combine 1 quart puree with remaining ingredients in a Dutch oven., Cook over medium heat, stirring frequently, 15 minutes or until mixture thickens., Remove from heat; skim off foam., Quickly pour hot pear mixture into hot sterilized jars, leaving 1/4-inch headspace; wipe jar rims., Cover at once with metal lids and screw on bands., Process in boiling water bath 10 minutes., Yield:, 2 pints.

title: Eisenhower Fudge
directions: Combine the first 4 ingredients for 6 minutes (sugar, salt, butter and evaporated milk). Bring to a boil. Keep at a rolling boil over medium heat. Do not stir. Have a metal or glass bowl ready with the chocolate chips, chocolate squares and Fluff. Pour boiling syrup over this and stir until chocolate is melted. Stir in vanilla and nuts. Pour into buttered 9 x 13 pan. Cool slightly, then place in refrigerator to chill and become firm. Cut into squares with sharp knife.

title: Chess Pie
directions: Mix oleo, sugar, flour and meal., Add beaten eggs, add other ingredients and pour into unbaked pie shell., Bake at 350 degrees until it does not shake.

title: Julienne Of Beets And Carrots Or Carrots And Parsnips
directions: Cook beets., Slip off skins and julienne., Julienne carrots or parsnips. Cook to desired tenderness., Melt butter and add to it a little orange juice.

title: Chocolate Meringue Pie
directions: Heat oven to 375°., Mix flour, sugar and cocoa., Add enough hot water to dry ingredients to wet it., Add egg yolks, milk, margarine (melted) and flavoring., Pour into uncooked pie crust and cook until firm, approximately 45 minutes.

title: Pepperoni Pinwheels
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., In small bowl, blend pepperoni, cheeses, oregano and egg., Roll apart crescent rolls into 8 rectangles (press perforations to seal)., Spread mixture on each rectangle, making sure to cover to the edges., Starting at shorter side, roll up and seal., Cut each roll into 6 pieces.

title: Finger Paint
directions: Add boiling water to the starch and boil until thick., Remove from heat and stir in the soap; add food coloring.

title: Tank'S Taco Grande(Mom Or Dad Will Help With Hard Parts.)
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Spray Pam on bottom and sides of 9 x 13 baking dish. Cook turkey or beef until no longer pink, breaking up chunks to small crumbs. Add taco mix and water (see mix directions). Remove from heat. Add 1 cup of salsa.

title: Baked Chicken Reuben
directions: Place skinned chicken breasts in 8-inch square baking dish that has been lightly oiled., Lightly salt and pepper., Place drained sauerkraut over chicken; top with cheese slices, one over each breast., Pour dressing evenly over the cheese., Cover with foil and bake in a 325° oven about 1 1/2 hours or until fork can be inserted in chicken with ease., Sprinkle with chopped parsley. Makes four servings., Baked potato skins can also be baked at the same time.

title: Layered Nacho Dip
directions: Combine first 2 ingredients in a 2 x 8 x 12-inch dish, mixing well., Layer with remaining ingredients in order listed., Serve with Tostitos.

title: Columbus Cooler Punch
directions: Mix all juices except 7-Up or ginger ale., Add just before serving.

title: Squash Carrot Casserole
directions: Cook squash according to directions on the package; drain. Sliver raw carrots on coarse side of grader., Mix squash, carrots, pimentos, sour cream and undiluted soup in saucepan., In separate bowl mix herb stuffing and margarine., Line baking dish with half of herb stuffing mixture., Pour in squash mixture and top with remaining half of herb stuffing mixture. Salt and pepper to taste. Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes., Yields 8 servings.

title: Baked Mostaccioli
directions: Brown ground beef, onion, green pepper and garlic; drain., Add undrained tomatoes, sauce, paste, undrained mushrooms, water and all spices., Bring to a boil; reduce heat., Cover and simmer for 30 minutes., Remove bay leaf and add cooked noodles.

title: Hearty Lentil Soup
directions: Wash lentils and let soak overnight; drain. Saute onions, celery and garlic in olive oil. Put soaked lentils in large pot and fill with 2 quarts water. Add sauteed vegetables, carrots, tomatoes (chopped very coarsely) along with all the puree, oregano, salt, pepper, parsley and bay leaf.

title: Oatmeal Walnut Raisin Cookies
directions: Cream margarine, sugar and eggs together until light and fluffy., Sift together flour, soda, baking powder, salt, cinnamon and nutmeg., Stir into creamed mixture., Stir in oats, raisins and walnuts., Drop from a tablespoon 2 inches apart on lightly greased cookie sheet., Bake at 400° for about 8 to 10 minutes., Cool slightly and remove from pan.

title: Cherry Confetti Cake
directions: Sift or mix together the flour, baking powder and salt., Cream the shortening and confectioners sugar., Blend in the almond extract and eggs., Measure milk and add alternately with dry ingredients to creamed mixture., (Begin and end with dry.), Fold in walnuts and cherries., Pour into well-greased and floured 10-inch tube pan., Cut gently through batter to break air bubbles. Bake at 350° for 60 to 65 minutes., Remove from oven and while still warm spread on top with butter and sprinkle with a mixture of cinnamon and sugar.

title: Cheese Crispies
directions: Combine seasonings with flour., Let margarine soften, mix in cheese and flour., If using an electric mixer, blend in flour on mixing speed., Mix the Rice Krispies in by hand., Place ball the size of marble on ungreased baking sheet and press with a fork (dipped in flour) to flatten., Bake at 350° for 10 to 15 minutes. Remove and let cool., Store in airtight container.

title: Sausage Balls
directions: Blend all together with hands until well blended., Roll into small balls., Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 350° for about 15 to 20 minutes or until done.

title: Curried Fruit
directions: Combine butter or margarine, sugar and curry powder., Bring to a boil., Drain the fruit and arrange in a 2-quart baking dish (about 10 x 6 x 1 1/2-inch)., Pour hot sauce over it. Garnish with cherries. Bake at 325° until it bubbles (about 30 to 40 minutes). Serve hot., Very good with poultry, ham and pork., Serves 8 to 10.

title: Microwaved Bread Pudding
directions: In a 2-cup casserole, slightly beat eggs., Add sugar and blend., Pour in milk and blend with salt and cinnamon., Add raisins and bread cubes., Dot with butter.

title: 12-Hour Cole Slaw
directions: Layer half of cabbage, onions and green pepper., Sprinkle half of sugar over vegetables., Repeat., Let stand while making dressing.

title: Harvard Beets
directions: Mix sugar and cornstarch; add vinegar and water from beets. Bring to a boil and simmer 5 minutes., Add beets and simmer 30 minutes., When ready to serve, bring to a boil and add butter. Serves 4.

title: Corn Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Bake at 350 degrees for one hour., Makes a large bowl.

title: Cranberry Fluff
directions: Grind cranberries in blender., Add marshmallows and sugar. Chill, covered, overnight., Add grapes, apples, walnuts and salt. Fold in chilled, whipped cream., Serves 8 to 10.

title: Three Bean Salad
directions: Drain beans and rinse with cold water several times., Let drain., Mix other ingredients in a large container., Pour in beans and mix., Let stand in the refrigerator 12 to 18 hours.

title: Tuna Dip
directions: Mix all ingredients together and sprinkle with paprika., Serve with Triscuits crackers or corn chips.

title: Pound Cake
directions: Mix sugar and butter., Add eggs one at a time., Add flour and milk, starting and ending with flour., Bake 1 hour and 15 minutes at 325°.

title: Summer Succotash
directions: Cook corn and lima beans in a small amount of boiling water for 12 minutes or until tender; drain and set aside., Cook bacon in a large skillet until crisp; remove bacon, reserving drippings in skillet., Crumble bacon and set aside., Saute chopped onion in bacon drippings until onion is tender; remove onion and set aside. Add flour to bacon drippings, stirring until smooth., Cook 1 minute, stirring constantly., Add tomatoes and rest of ingredients., Heat through.

title: Grasshopper Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., Combine first 4 ingredients and beat until stiff., Fold in remaining ingredients., Drop by teaspoonfuls on foil-covered cookie sheets., Turn oven off and leave cookies in oven overnight., Store in tins between wax paper., May be frozen.

title: Ann'S Beef Casserole
directions: Cook macaroni according to package directions., Drain and set aside.

title: Nut Cups
directions: Mix flour, margarine and cream cheese and refrigerate., Mix brown sugar, eggs, vanilla, salt and margarine., Cook over low heat., Watch closely as it burns easily., Add walnuts., Roll out dough 1/8-inch thick., Cut with a scalloped cookie cutter., Press into 1-inch muffin tin., Drop 1 teaspoon of filling into each cup about 3/4 full., They will swell., Bake at 325° for 20 to 25 minutes., Avoid overbrowning.

title: Ribbon Mold Salad
directions: Mix together 3 cups of hot water, pineapple juice and lemon Jell-O., Stir until dissolved., Pour mixture in pan and refrigerate to cool, but not set firm, about 1 hour., Mix together lime Jell-O and 1.5 quarts of hot water., Stir until dissolved., Pour lime Jell-O mixture into a 13 x 9-inch cake pan; chill until firmly set. Mix together strawberry Jell-O and 1.5 quarts of hot water., Stir until dissolved., Allow mixture to cool., In a small mixing bowl, cream the cream cheese., Add whipped cream., To this mixture, add the cooled lemon Jell-O mix and whip until blended thoroughly. Pour the lemon mixture on top of the set lime Jell-O., Refrigerate until firm., Pour strawberry Jell-O on top of the lemon mixture and let set again, until firm.

title: Fresh Tomato Sauce For Pasta Or Pizza Crust, Etc.
directions: Heat oil in a large skillet., Add onion and garlic., Saute 3 minutes., Add tomatoes and remaining ingredients., Stir well and bring to a boil., Reduce heat to medium-low and cook 10 minutes or until reduced to 4 cups., Keep in freezer for quick pasta dishes.

title: Chicken Nest
directions: Arrange pasta in skillet., Top with chicken (undrained), frozen peas, carrots and sliced onion., Pour on broth., Sprinkle with tarragon., Bring to boil., Reduce heat; cover and simmer 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Gail'S Quiche Lorraine
directions: Mix all ingredients and pour into pie crust., Cook in 375° oven for about 1 hour.

title: Mile A Minute Cupcakes(1942 Recipe)
directions: Thoroughly cream shortening and sugar., Add eggs; beat well. Add flour, sifted with salt, baking powder, soda and cocoa alternately with milk and vanilla., Add coffee; mix well., Fill greased cupcake pans 2/3 full., Bake at 375° for 20 minutes.

title: Pretzel Salad
directions: Melt margarine and stir in pretzels and sugar., Press gently into a 10 x 15-inch pan. Bake at 400° for 8 minutes (do not overbake). Cool.

title: Tammy'S Banana Pudding
directions: Mix pudding according to directions. Add eagle brand milk. Put in refrigerator for 5 to 10 minutes until set. While waiting for mixture to set, beat heavy whipping cream (use a mixer) until a soft peek. Fold in to pudding mixture. Start layering in a 2 qt. dish; putting pudding mixture first, then cookies and bananas. Refrigerate overnight so cookies get soft.

title: Mama'S Bread Pudding
directions: Scald milk with margarine., Add with all remaining ingredients to bread and stir lightly., Bake at 350° until firm.

title: Mississippi Mud Cake
directions: Cream sugar and oleo., Add eggs, one at a time., Sift flour, cocoa and salt., Add sugar., Add vanilla and nuts., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes., Remove from oven and spread with Marshmallow Creme while hot., Cool 30 minutes and ice.

title: Lemonade Stand Pie
directions: Beat lemonade concentrate in large bowl about 30 seconds. Gradually spoon in ice cream, blending well., Gently stir whipped topping until smooth., Freeze, if necessary, until mixture will mound., Spoon into crust., Freeze at least 4 hours or until firm. Let stand at room temperature or in refrigerator about 30 minutes or until pie can be easily cut., Garnish with strawberries., Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Chewy Chocolate Cookies
directions: Core the apples and peel them if you like., (We prefer the added texture of the peels, but peeled apples look more sophisticated.), Cut the apples crosswise into 1/4-inch thick slices., Melt about 2 tablespoons of the butter in a skillet and add a single layer of apple slices., Raise the heat and saute the slices, turning occasionally, until browned, about 5 minutes. With a slotted spoon, transfer apples to a bowl., Repeat with more butter and another batch of apples until all have been cooked.

title: Hamburger Stuffed Bread
directions: Cut off top of loaf of bread and hollow out, forming a crust shell., Tear enough bread for 2 cups; set aside., Brown beef and oil; add green pepper, Worcestershire sauce and cheese soup. Simmer 5 minutes., Stir in bread crumbs., Fill in bread crust. Place American cheese slices diagonally on top., Bake 5 to 10 minutes or until cheese melts.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Mix the cream of mushroom soup and milk together., Add all other ingredients., Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan., Cover and place in fridge overnight (12 hours)., Before baking, sprinkle buttered bread crumbs on top., Bake, uncovered, 1 1/2 hours at 350°. Grease the pan before adding ingredients.

title: Ruth'S Crab Pie
directions: Mix cream cheese with 1/2 tablespoon Worcestershire sauce and a little lemon juice., Spread in bottom of pie plate., Pick shells from large can of backfin crabmeat., Spread over cream cheese. Sprinkle with lemon juice., Mix Heinz chili sauce, 1 teaspoon Worcestershire, horseradish and lemon juice and pour over crab. Serve with Ritz crackers.

title: Hash Brown Casserole
directions: Mix ingredients in large bowl., Pour into a 10 x 14-inch pan. Top with cheese crackers and melted butter., Bake 45 minutes at 350°.

title: Fried Rice
directions: Cook rice as directed., Set aside to drain., Put veggies in skillet with small amount of oil., Stir fry., Add 3 tablespoons soy sauce., Add rice., Stir fry until hot., Ready to eat.

title: Frozen Passion
directions: Ice Cream Maker Method:, Mix and pour into ice cream freezer container., Freeze according to manufacturer's instructions., Store leftovers in freezer.

title: Rhubarb Pie
directions: Mix 1 cup of flour, baking powder and butter; add egg and milk., Mix., Press into greased pie pan., Arrange rhubarb in pie shell, Sprinkle with Jell-O.

title: Rolls With Gold Medal Flour
directions: Mix, all with flour., May have to add a little more flour but make a soft dough., Knead real good., Put in a greased bowl., Let rise until double in bulk, about, 1 hour., Work down and make into rolls., Makes 1 1/2 dozen.

title: Applesauce Jello Salad
directions: Add cup of boiling water to package of jello., Mix until dissolved., Add package of frozen berries; stir until thawed., Add the applesauce and stir well., Pour into a 9 x 9-inch pan., Chill in refrigerator until set., For the topping, fold in 1 cup of marshmallows into 1 cup of sour cream or Cool Whip and spread over the set jello.

title: Pasta Alfredo
directions: Heat butter and cream., Do not boil., Mound pasta in warm buttered bowl and pour on cream; sprinkle generously with cheese and toss thoroughly but lightly., Season to taste.

title: Lemon Meringue Pie
directions: In 2-quart saucepan stir together 1 cup sugar and cornstarch. Gradually stir in water until smooth., Stir in egg yolks. Stirring constantly, bring to boil over medium heat and boil one minute., Remove from heat., Stir in next 3 ingredients, cool. Turn into pastry shell., In small bowl with mixer at high speed beat egg whites until foamy., Gradually beat in 1/3 cup sugar; continue beating until stiff peaks form., Spread some meringue around edge of filling first, touching crust all around, then fill in center., Bake in 350° oven for 15 to 20 minutes or until lightly browned., Cool., Serves 6 to 8.

title: Cream Cheese Cookies
directions: Mix all together. Put in pan and bake at 350° until done.

title: Lasagna
directions: Two days before using, make sauce:, Brown onions in bottom of a large Dutch oven., Add meat and brown., Stir occasionally to break it up well., Add salt, pepper, lots of oregano, garlic powder, 3 cans of tomato paste and can of puree., Add 1 teaspoon of sugar., Cover., Simmer 2 to 3 hours, stirring every 30 minutes or so and taste to season., When done, put in a large airtight container., Store in refrigerator at least 24 hours before using.

title: Pumpkin Cookies
directions: Blend margarine, sugar and egg. Then add pumpkin and vanilla. Sift flour, cinnamon, baking powder, soda and salt. Add walnuts. Drop with spoon on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350° for almost 12 minutes.

title: Vegetable Soup
directions: Cook corn, tomatoes, carrots and butter beans., Mix all ingredients and heat good., Put in jars and seal., Cook in pressure canner at 10 pounds for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
directions: Cook chicken in water with onion., Remove chicken; drain and set onions aside., Chop chicken; salt and pepper to taste. Combine chicken, onion and mayonnaise to taste., Add celery, lemon juice, pimento, eggs and soup., Put into casserole dish., Top with almonds, potato chips and cheese., Bake at 350° until bubbly.

title: Cheese Grits
