directions: While grits are still hot, add cheeses and margarine., Allow to cool; add eggs and milk., Pour into baking dish., Bake at 325° for 30 to 45 minutes., This dish can be made ahead of time, frozen and reheated., Serves 6 to 8.

title: Egg Dumplings
directions: Sift and measure the flour., Cut the butter into the flour. Break the egg into a measuring cup, then add enough water to come up to the 3/4 cup line., Add to the flour; mix lightly with a fork. Drop by tablespoonfuls over boiling meat and broth or into well-greased steamer placed over boiling water., Cook for 15 to 20 minutes, or until dumplings are tender.

title: Fresh Apple Pound Cake
directions: Combine oil, sugar and eggs; beat at medium speed for 3 minutes., Combine dry ingredients and add to mixture., Fold in pecans and apples., Bake in greased and floured tube pan at 325° for 1 hour and 20 minutes, or until cake is done.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
directions: Dust apples, raisins and nuts with some of the flour; set aside., Blend oil, sugar and slightly beaten eggs; set aside. Sift together flour, salt and soda; add to egg mixture and add vanilla., Fold in coated apples, nuts and raisins; pour into a 10-inch greased tube pan., Bake in 350° oven for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Cheerios Nuggets
directions: Heat oven to 250°., Grease two 9 x 13-inch pan., Heat brown sugar, margarine, corn syrup and salt in a 2-quart saucepan over medium heat, stirring constantly until bubbly around edges., Cook, uncovered, stirring occasionally for 2 minutes longer., Remove from heat; stir in baking soda until foamy and light colored. Pour over cereal, peanuts and raisins in greased 4-quart bowl. Stir until mixture is coated., Spread evenly in pans., Bake 15 minutes., Stir., Let stand just until cool, about 10 minutes. Loosen mixture with metal spatula., Let stand until firm, about 30 minutes., Break into bite size pieces., Makes about 10 cups of snack.

title: Lime Salad Chiffon With Graham Crackers
directions: Make the crust with butter and cracker crumbs., Put into an 8-inch square pan., Chill.

title: Slushy Punch
directions: Mix jello and sugar with 3 cups boiling water., Stir until dissolved., Add remaining ingredients., Put in freezer., Stir after about 3 hours and every hour thereafter until it is slushy.

title: Harry Potter Punch
directions: Dissolve jello into boiling water. Add sugar and dissolve. Add cold water, pineapple juice and lemon juice. Pour into clean milk or apple juice jugs and chill well or start to freeze.

title: Cake That Won'T Last
directions: Beat eggs and mix with flour, salt, cinnamon, soda, vanilla, nuts, sugar, oil, bananas (not mashed) and pineapple., Do not beat., Stir until blended., Pour into greased and floured pan (9 x 13-inch)., Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

title: Toffee Candy
directions: Cook butter and sugar on medium heat, stirring frequently, until temperature reaches 290° on candy thermometer., Pour onto greased cookie sheet with sides., Spread out.

title: Oven Barbecue Sauce
directions: Mix the tomato soup, brown sugar and vinegar together well. Bake meat until it has about 20 minutes left. Pour the barbecue sauce on the meat and continue to bake uncovered until the meat is done. This is great on pork chops, some cuts of beef and a great way to dress up leftover meat.

title: St. Timothy'S Coffee Cake
directions: Cream together margarine and sugar., Sift together, flour, baking powder, salt and cinnamon., Add nuts and raisins to dry ingredients., Add eggs, sour cream and vanilla., Mix well., Bake in bundt pan at 350° for 1 hour., Sprinkle sugar and cinnamon mixture on top before baking., Sprinkle on bottom after baking.

title: Zucchini Bread
directions: Sift flour, spices, salt, baking powder, and soda together. Cream sugar and oil together while adding one egg at a time. Begin to add flour mixture, zucchini, apple sauce, pineapple, raisins, and nuts., Bake at 350 degrees for one hour., Makes three loaves. Really, really good!

title: Beef Enchiladas
directions: Brown meat, onion and garlic., Fill each tortilla with 2 tablespoons of mixture, 1 tablespoon of each cheese and top with onion., Roll and place in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan., Put remaining meat mixture over top with remaining cheese., Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Barbecue Shrimp
directions: Melt butter in a large sauce pan and add all ingredients, except shrimp. Cook over medium heat for approximately 5 minutes. Add shrimp and saute for 4 minutes on each side., Remove from heat and, ladle butter sauce over shrimp., Garnish, with fresh parsley and 3 slices of lemon., Serves two.

title: Green Bean Casserole
directions: Preheat oven to 400°., Take 1 can of beans; drain 1/2 water; put in casserole dish., Add cream of mushroom soup, then onions and cheese; mix well., Sprinkle extra cheese on top., Cook in oven for 30 minutes or until onions and green beans are tender.

title: Macaroni And Cheese
directions: In a saucepan, make a roux with flour and butter., Add mustard., Lower heat and add one-half of the milk, stirring so as not to scald., In a pot, cook pasta until it's half done., Saute onion and add to roux mixture along with cheeses and rest of milk.

title: Paintbrush Cookies
directions: Give each child 3 large marshmallows and toothpick., Instruct to insert toothpick and to align marshmallows., Decorate snowmen with raisins, fruit slices and cereal pieces., Eat as snack.

title: Hamburger Pie
directions: Slowly cook oil, onions, celery, salt and beef, stirring constantly., Add potatoes and tomatoes; stir well. Place in casserole dish. Place strips of pastry on top., Bake at 425° for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Hershey Bar Cake
directions: Cream margarine and sugar., Add eggs, one at a time., Blend well and add Hershey's syrup., Mix together flour, soda and salt. Melt Hershey bars; alternately add buttermilk, Hershey bars and vanilla., Bake in stem pan at 350° for one hour.

title: Baked Beans With Green Pepper And Carrots
directions: Wash beans, cover with water and cook until soft., Drain, not too dry., Add salt and bacon drippings., Mix in baking dish the beans, brown sugar, onions, green pepper and grated carrots., Add catsup., Bake in 325° oven for one hour or until as dry as desired.

title: Cabbage Goulash
directions: In a large kettle, brown sausage, beef and onion., Drain off any fat., Add remaining ingredients, except cabbage; mix well. Stir in cabbage and simmer, 15 to 20 minutes or until cabbage is tender., Serves 8.

title: Cherry Coke Salad
directions: Add sugar and water to cherries., Bring to a boil., Pour over jello and stir until dissolved., Place in refrigerator until cool. Remove and add Coke, pineapple and nuts., Refrigerate until set.

title: Hearty Vegetable Soup
directions: In 5-quart kettle on medium heat, heat oil., Add onion, celery and garlic; saute for 2 minutes or until tender., Stir in bouillon cubes, water and tomatoes with liquid, crushing tomatoes into little pieces., Over high heat, add carrots, cauliflowerets, lima beans, marjoram, thyme and pepper., Return to boiling, reduce heat and simmer uncovered for 15 minutes longer., Add parsley, if desired.

title: Party Style Hot Chicken
directions: Combine ingredients; put in greased casserole., Put in 1 cup potato chips on top., Cover chips with 1/2 cup grated cheese. Bake 10 to 15 minutes at 450°., Should be bubbly.

title: Corn Dogs
directions: Mix together until smooth. Dip hot dogs into mix and deep fry. Yields 8 to 10 corn dogs.

title: Unleavened Communion Bread
directions: Mix flour, Crisco, salt and sugar until like coarse cornmeal. Add cold water., Roll as for pie dough, approximately 1/8-inch thick onto an ungreased cookie sheet., Prick with a fork., Cut into bite size pieces (1/4-inch squares) with a knife before baking., Bake in 400° oven for 8 to 10 minutes or until very light brown.

title: Strawberry Pie
directions: Mix sugar,, water, and cornstarch together., Bring to a boil, stirring, constantly., Add	jello, and cool to lukewarm. Pour over berries in pie shell., Chill., When ready to serve, top with whipped cream.

title: French Onion Soup
directions: Fry onions gently, in, fat, until lightly browned., Add stock, and salt and pepper to taste., Simmer about 15 minutes.

title: Dipsy Devil Dip
directions: Combine all ingredients, except vegetables., Beat until creamy., Makes about 1 cup., Use as a vegetable dip.

title: Shirley'S Casserole
directions: Cook first 4 ingredients., Add all other ingredients and bake.

title: Tostadas
directions: Heat oil in small skillet., Fry corn tortillas, one at a time, in oil until crisp and hard., Brown ground beef., Add spices and stir., Drain meat., Add refried beans to meat and heat., Spread over corn tortillas., Add lettuce, tomatoes and cheese., Sour cream and salsa are optional., Enjoy!!, Quick, easy and inexpensive.

title: Pasta Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients together.

title: Chewy Chocolate Chip Cookies
directions: Cream together butter, shortening and sugars., Add vanilla and eggs., Sift flour, salt, soda and cocoa together., Add to creamed mixture; mix until blended., Add chocolate chips, coconut and nuts., Bake on greased cookie sheet until just set, about 6 to 8 minutes at 325° to 350°., Do not overbake., They will look a little raw until cool.

title: Chipped Chopped Ham Spread
directions: In a big bowl mix all ingredients together, except semi-hard rolls, and let stand overnight in refrigerator., Next day cut the rolls in half, on one side smear a little amount of butter and put on spread., Close the roll with the other half and mount in aluminum foil., Heat oven to 350°F and bake for 15 to 20 minutes. If you do not use up all the rolls at once, the rest mounted in aluminum foil can be stored in refrigerator for 2 days.

title: Christmas Salad
directions: Stir pudding in pineapple and juice., Mix in nuts, marshmallows and cherries. Fold in Cool Whip., Place in an 8 x 8-inch pan. Refrigerate until firm.

title: Vegetable Casserole
directions: Partially thaw vegetables (enough to break apart) and mix with onions, mushrooms and chestnuts., Place into greased 9 x 13-inch pan., Mix soup and Cheez Whiz., Heat just enough to be able to mix well., Pour over vegetables., Bake 1 hour and 15 minutes at 350°.

title: Beef Stroganoff
directions: Saute tips in butter; add flour and brown., Add hot beef stock and bring to a boil., Remove from heat., Reduce wine and vinegar to 1/2 and add to above.

title: Peanut Butter Balls
directions: Combine the first 4 ingredients and roll into 1-inch balls.

title: Cocktail Meat Balls
directions: Mix first 5 ingredients into balls., Brown in butter at 250° in electric frypan or regular pan on medium high heat., Melt catsup and currant jelly in frypan., Simmer meat balls and sauce together for 30 minutes.

title: Zucchini Carrot Cake
directions: Beat eggs and sugar until frothy., Gradually beat in oil; add dry ingredients., Beat at high speed 4 minutes., Add carrots, zucchini, nuts and currants or raisins., Pour in greased pan. Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

title: Fudge Oat Cake
directions: Pour water over oats and let stand 20 minutes., Mix remaining ingredients and add cooled oats., Bake in greased 9 x 13-inch greased and floured pan at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Candied Sweet Potatoes With Apricots
directions: Heat oven to 375 degrees., Cut sweet potatoes into thick slices., Arrange 1 layer in 10x6x2 greased baking dish., Cover with layer of apricots sprinkled with some brown sugar., Repeat layers., Combine butter,, reserved apricot liquid and orange rind. Pour over layers., Bake uncovered 45 minutes - basting once or twice with liquid from bottom of dish., Top with nuts during last 5 minutes.

title: Lucy Webb'S Barbecued Meat Loaf
directions: Mix ingredients together., Roll out between waxed paper sheets to a thickness of 1/4-inch., Remove top sheet., Sprinkle with 1 1/2 cups grated Cheddar cheese., Lift waxed paper and roll like a jelly roll., Turn ends in to keep cheese inside., Bake for 45 minutes at 350°., Top with sauce and bake 15 minutes more.

title: Crowd Chicken Casserole
directions: Combine first 6 ingredients; add 2 cups cheese., Mix mayonnaise and sour cream; add to chicken mixture and toss. Spoon into 2 greased 13 x 9-inch baking dishes., Sprinkle with chips., Top with remaining cheese., Bake, uncovered, at 350°, for 20 to 25 minutes or until hot., Serves 24.

title: Bread Machine Buttermilk Wheat Bread
directions: In bread machine pan, place all ingredients in order given. Select "white bread" setting., Bake according to bread machine directions., Makes 1 medium loaf (16 slices).

title: Vegetarian Spaghetti Sauce
directions: Crush garlic and chop onion and brown in oil., Add canned tomatoes and tomato sauce, mushrooms, salt, chopped squash (optional) and spices., Bring to boil; simmer for at least 2 hours., Good for weight watchers., Serve over spaghetti.

title: Sticky Chicken
directions: Place chicken in 9 x 13 x 2-inch glass baking dish. Melt butter; add honey, mustard, salt and curry powder. Pour over chicken and bake at 325° for 1 hour and 15 minutes. This is good, but all chicken is good.

title: Sweet Sour Green Beans
directions: Cook beans until crisp and tender (6 to 8 minutes). Drain. Plunge into ice water; drain., Set aside. Fry bacon until crisp; drain and crumble., Keep 2 tablespoons bacon drippings., Stir in flour. Cook until bubbly., Stir in water, vinegar and sugar. Heat to boiling and slightly thickened., Add beans and toss occasionally. Sprinkle with salt, pepper and bacon.

title: Green Chili Corn Bread
directions: Mix meal, eggs, oil and milk., Add other ingredients and stir. Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch casserole dish., Bake at 400° for 40 minutes., Bread is done when inserted knife comes out clean.

title: Quick Mix Pepperoni Batter Bread
directions: Set aside 1 cup flour., Mix together remaining ingredients, including yeast, in a large bowl., Stir in margarine and water into dry mixture., Mix in only enough flour to make very thick batter. Cover; let rest 10 minutes., Turn batter into greased 1 1/2-quart casserole., Cover., Let rise in warm draft-free place until double in size, about 35 to 40 minutes., Bake at 375° for 35 minutes. Check for doneness., Remove and cool on wire rack.

title: Spaghetti Casserole
directions: Saute onions, green pepper and celery in oil., Cook a few minutes., Brown meat in Dutch oven., Add onions, celery, green pepper, tomatoes, puree and seasonings., Simmer for about an hour. Add mushrooms last 15 minutes., Set off heat and add 1/2 grated cheese., Stir.

title: Broccoli Soup
directions: Saute onion in oleo until soft., Add water and bouillon cubes and dissolve., Add egg noodles and cook 3 minutes., Stir in broccoli, garlic and pepper., Cook broccoli until it thaws., Add 6 cups milk and cheese cut in cubes., Stir until cheese melts, then cook for 30 minutes on low heat., Do not boil., Serve with a salad and hot French bread., Makes a large pot of rich and delicious soup.

title: Chinese Barbecue Sauce
directions: Combine all ingredients., Good on spareribs or chicken.

title: Spiced Pecans
directions: In a bowl, beat egg white and water until frothy, not stiff. Add pecans and mix until nuts are covered., Mix sugar, salt and cinnamon in, a small bowl and pour over pecans. Stir well with wooden spoon until pecans are coated.

title: Chocolate Fondue
directions: Put chocolate pieces and milk in a bowl., Microwave, uncovered, on 100% power for 1 minute and 30 seconds., Stir., Add another 30 seconds if needed., Stir in almond extract., Makes 1 3/4 cups., Dip with bananas, strawberries, pound cake, pineapple or apples.

title: Escalloped Potatoes With Ham
directions: Boil potatoes with skin on., Peel and slice into baking dish. Add ham and mushroom soup., Bake in oven at 325° for 30 minutes. Quick and good!

title: Raisin Pie
directions: Mix sugar, cornstarch, cinnamon, nutmeg, water and raisins in a saucepan., Cook over medium heat, stirring until thick., Remove from heat., Stir in butter and lemon juice., Cool slightly., Pour into a pie shell., Cut other crust in criss-cross strips., Put on top., Brush melted butter on this and bake 20 minutes at 350°.

title: Broccoli Corn Bread
directions: Combine all ingredients and pour into a greased baking sheet. Bake in a 350° oven for 1/2 hour to 45 minutes or until brown. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Roast & Gravy
directions: Cook roast and spices until tender., Drain & slice., Add gravy and onion soup mix., Simmer 2 hours until done.

title: Coffee Cake(Easy)
directions: Put egg in measuring cup and add milk to make one cup., Mix all dry ingredients., Add shortening and mix with pastry blender (or two knives) until like cornmeal., Add egg and milk and put into greased pan., Sprinkle sugar, nuts or chocolate chips and cinnamon., Cut dough with knife like you would marble cake., Add some sugar on top with cinnamon.

title: Dorito Casserole
directions: Cook hamburger, salt and onion., Layer baking dish with Doritos., Put meat mixture on top of Doritos., Mix soups and Ro-Tel and pour mixture over meat., Bake at 350° until it bubbles. Remove from oven and top with grated cheese., Return to oven until cheese melts., Sprinkle with crumbled Doritos.

title: Scalloped Corn
directions: Mix together in a square baking dish and bake at 375° for 45 to 60 minutes.

title: Opossum Pie
directions: Wash opossum inside and out and salt., Heat lard in roasting pan., Stir-fry garlic, onions and ginger., Heat until starts to smoke., Shake flour over opossum and brown in lard for two minutes., Place opossum in roasting pan with paws crossed over chest, adding carrots, onions, potatoes and celery., Add stock and sherry and cook at 325° for 2 hours., Add peas., Recover and heat 8 more minutes., Best served with rice, turnip greens and corn bread., Serves 8 to 12 or whoever you can get to eat it!

title: Scrambled Egg Bake
directions: In a large mixing bowl with a wire whisk or fork, beat eggs until frothy., Stir in milk; mix well., Add cheese., Season with salt and pepper., Pour into buttered 2-quart baking dish., Bake in a preheated 350° oven for 30 minutes., Serves immediately.

title: Oatmeal Apple Cookies
directions: Cream Crisco, brown sugar, egg, milk and vanilla on medium speed., Combine flour, cinnamon, nutmeg, soda and salt., Beat into creamed mixture at low speed until well blended., Stir in oats. Drop rounded tablespoonfuls of dough on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 375° for 13 minutes., Cool 2 minutes on baking sheet. Remove to cooling rack., Makes 2 1/2 dozen cookies.

title: Peter Paul Mound Cake
directions: Cream butter and sugar., Add eggs., Sift flour, soda and cocoa and add alternately with buttermilk and flavoring., Bake in 4 nine-inch greased and floured cake pans at 325° for 20 minutes. Cool.

title: Piccalilli
directions: Chop tomatoes and onions., Sprinkle with salt; let stand for 24 hours and drain., Chop together peppers, and celery and add with sugar and vinegar to tomatoes and onions., Tie spices in a bag and add to the ingredients; cook slowly until ingredients are tender, about 2 or 3 hours., Remove the spice bag., Place piccalilli in sterilized jars and seal.

title: Stuffed Mushrooms
directions: Soften cream cheese in bowl. Core mushrooms after removing stems.

title: Quickie Barbecue
directions: Mix corned beef and whatever kind of barbecue sauce you like and heat., Serve on bun with cole slaw.

title: Marshmallow Cloud Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 400°., Keep marshmallows frozen until ready to use (they thaw quickly)., Combine flour, cocoa and soda., Set aside., Combine sugars; blend in butter., Add eggs and vanilla. Beat until light and fluffy., Add flour mixture and chocolate chips., Blend at low speed., Batter will be stiff., Gather 4 to 5 frozen marshmallows in your hand., Cover with heaping teaspoonful of dough., Wrap marshmallows in dough, making a 2 inch ball., Place on ungreased cookie sheet., Bake 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Corn And Sausage Soup
directions: Slice sausage and brown in heavy soup pot. Add onions and saute until tender. Stir in potatoes, water, salt, basil, pepper and parsley. Cover and simmer for 15 minutes. Stir in corn and milk. Heat to a boil, but do not boil. Serve with a tossed salad and crusty bread. Makes 8 bowls.

title: Judy'S Pecan Pie
directions: Mix ingredients., Pour into unbaked pie shells., Sprinkle more nuts on top., Bake at 350°, for 35 minutes., Makes 2 pies.

title: Spiced Apple Cider
directions: Pour brandy, and, cider into large coffee pot.	Combine remaining, ingredients, and, pour, into the percolator basket. Perk until done., Makes 9 to 10 cups of cider.

title: Creamy Orange Glaze
directions: Combine all ingredients in bowl; mix well., Pour over hot cake.

title: Crab Dip
directions: Heat soup to dissolve cream cheese in soup., Soften gelatin in 3/4 cup cold water, then add to soup and stir to dissolve, then cool., Add peppers, celery, onions and mayonnaise to soup mixture. Add crab meat., Spray mold with Pam.

title: Crazy Cake
directions: Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Pie
directions: Melt butter and chocolate., Stir in peanut butter and brown sugar., Cool slightly and then stir in 3/4 of Cool Whip., Pour into 9-inch baked pie shell., Spread remaining Cool Whip over pie.

title: White Chili
directions: Drain soaked beans., Put beans, chicken broth, garlic and half of the onions into a large soup pot., Bring to a boil; cover, lower heat and simmer until beans are soft, about 3 hours, adding more broth, if necessary.

title: Vodka Slushes
directions: Combine all ingredients and mix., Let set in freezer for at least 24 hours., Stir occasionally., Serve with 7-Up.

title: Soft Drop Sugar Cookies
directions: Cream sugar and margarine., Add eggs, milk and vanilla; mix well., Blend in flour, baking soda and baking powder., Drop by teaspoons onto cookie sheet., Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes. Frost or sprinkle with sugar just before you put in oven.

title: Chicken Roll-Ups(Old Recipe)
directions: Mix chicken with 1 1/4 cups cheese., Put mixture in center of each roll and "roll up"., Lay rolls in 9 x 13-inch pans., Heat soup, milk and 3/4 cup cheese until cheese melts., Pour over rolls. Bake at 350° for about 1/2 hour.

title: Sour Cream Muffins
directions: Mix all ingredients well., Bake at 400° in greased muffin pan until golden brown., Makes 12 muffins.

title: Crab Cakes Canton
directions: Combine crab meat, bread crumbs, garlic and ginger in bowl. Mix well., Add egg white and teriyaki sauce; mix well., Shape into patties, about 1/2-inch thick and 2-inch in diameter., Heat 1 teaspoon oil into large nonstick skillet over medium heat until hot., Add crab cakes to hot oil., Cook 2 minutes on each side or until golden brown.

title: Easy Bake Cheese Omelet
directions: Beat egg whites until stiff peaks form. Set aside., Slightly beat egg yolks., Add 1/2 cup of the Cheddar cheese soup., Mix well. Fold yolk mixture into white mixture., Spread in an ungreased 8 1/2-inch round baking dish. Bake at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes or until puffy and golden brown.

title: Sausage Balls
directions: Cut cheese into cubes; place in top of double boiler., Cook over hot water, stirring frequently until melted., Place sausage, Bisquick and cheese in large mixing bowl., Mix well., Shape into small balls., Place on cookie sheet., Bake in preheated oven at 350° for 15 minutes., May be frozen before baking., Place on cookie sheet to freeze until firm, then place in plastic bags or container, then freeze until needed.

title: Pasta Salad
directions: Cook pasta and drain well., Add dressing as needed to cook pasta., Add feta cheese, olives, and stir., Add parmesan and stir. Add tomatoes and broccoli., Chill and serve., Top with chopped fresh basil for presentation.

title: Minnesota Wild Rice Soup
directions: Brown beef., Add next nine ingredients and simmer 30 minutes. Add soup and water., Stir and simmer 30 minutes., Can be put in crock pot until ready to serve.

title: Damson Pie
directions: Put all together., Pour into unbaked pie shell., Bake at 350° about 45 minutes, until crust is pretty and brown and pie does not jiggle (firm)., Good with Cool Whip on top.

title: One Hour Rolls
directions: Dissolve yeast in warm water., Add buttermilk., Add dry ingredients and knead 5 minutes., Roll 1/4-inch., Cut and place on greased pan., Let rise 1 hour., Bake at 425° for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Cheesy Scalloped Cabbage
directions: Cook cabbage in small amount of water until tender; drain well., Melt butter over low heat; add flour and cook 1 minute, stirring constantly., Gradually add milk; cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until thick and bubbly., Stir in spices.

title: Bean Soup
directions: *Lawry's seasoning, Johnny's seasoning, garlic salt, Watkins soup and vegetable seasoning, flavor enhancer.

title: Mississippi Pound Cake
directions: Cream butter and shortening., Gradually add sugar., Blend in about 1/2 of the flour and all baking powder., Stir in milks and extracts., Then blend in remaining flour., Beat a short while until fluffy., Beat in eggs, one at a time., Grease and flour Bundt pan. Bake at 325° for 1 1/2 hours., Let sit in Bundt pan 10 minutes, then turn over on cake plate., When cool,, sprinkle powdered sugar lightly., Then add fresh fruit to the plate.

title: Strawberry Cheesecake
directions: Lightly spray 9 x 3-inch spring-form pan with vegetable cooking spray., Line bottom of pan with ladyfinger halves, split sides up., Cut 10 to 12 additional ladyfinger halves in half., Use to line side of pan, allowing cut ends to rest on ladyfingers in bottom of pan., Set aside on baking sheet.

title: Liver Pate
directions: Saute liver in butter., Mash and simmer., Add onion and spices., Simmer 2 more minutes., Whip until smooth., Serve with crackers.

title: Corned Beef Casserole
directions: Cook and drain macaroni; mix with all other ingredients. Season to taste., Bake at 350° until bubbly., Add ground cracker crumbs to top and butter dots for a brown top.

title: Baked Scallop Casserole
directions: Place rinsed scallops in a greased casserole dish. Pour milk over scallops and sprinkle with salt, pepper, and lemon juice. Bake at 350° for 10-12 minutes., Add Ritz crumbs to melted butter and mix well., When scallops are finished baking, remove from oven and spread crumb mixture evenly over scallops., Place under broiler just until golden brown.

title: Yum Yums
directions: Mix and pat in a 9 x 15-inch pan.

title: Mexican Casserole Corn Bread
directions: Mix first 6 ingredients. Brown ground meat. Melt cheese with Ro-Tel tomatoes. Layer 1/2 batter, then all of ground meat, all of cheese mixture and chopped onions. Top with remaining batter. Bake at 350° until brown.

title: Quick Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Combine sugar, milk, butter, cocoa and vanilla in pan., Bring to a boil for 1 minute., Add oatmeal and coconut., Using a tablespoon, drop mixture about an inch apart on wax paper., Let stand until the cookies have hardened.

title: Pineapple Stuffing
directions: Cream butter and sugar., Add bread, pineapple and oranges. In separate bowl, beat eggs and add to mixture., Bake at 350° for 50 minutes.

title: Fudge Brownies
directions: Combine flour, sugar, cocoa, baking powder, salt and nuts., Set aside; combine oil, eggs and vanilla and add to dry ingredients. Do not overmix., Spread in 9 x 13-inch baking pan., Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean., Yields about 24 brownies.

title: Old Fashioned Lentil Soup
directions: Combine all ingredients., Cover and simmer 1 hour or until lentils are tender (1/2 hour in pressure cooker)., Take out ham bone., Strip off bits of meat and return to soup., Remove bay leaf., Serve with 2 tablespoons vinegar on top., Croutons may also be served with soup., Serves 8.

title: Green Pepper Steak
directions: Cut beef across the grain into thin strips, 1/8-inch thick. Combine soy sauce, garlic and ginger., Add beef., Toss and set aside while preparing vegetables., Heat oil in large frying pan. Add beef and toss over high heat until browned. If beef is not tender, cover and simmer for 30 to 40 minutes over low heat., Turn heat up and add vegetables., Toss until vegetables are tender. Mix cornstarch with water., Add to pan., Stir and cook until thickened., Add tomatoes and heat through., Serve with cooked rice.

title: Texas Hash
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., In large skillet, cook and stir meat, onion and green pepper., Drain off fat., Stir in remaining ingredients., Heat thoroughly and pour into ungreased 2-quart casserole dish., Cover and bake 1 hour., Serve with salad for complete meal.

title: Chiffon Pie
directions: Mix eggs, sugar and pineapple juice until smooth; bring to a boil, stirring constantly., Add Jell-O, then let cool completely. Whip milk which has been refrigerated overnight., Add lemon juice. Fold cooled Jell-O mixture into whipped milk, blending well. Place mixture into 2 prepared crusts., Refrigerate and then serve.

title: Castle Hamburgers
directions: Mix and refrigerate for 2 hours., Make into patties and fry. Put holes in burgers to cook evenly.

title: Manest(Poor People'S Soup)
directions: Wash lettuce in salt water and rinse., Cut lettuce into 3-inch pieces., Place in large pot; cover with water., cut celery into 1-inch pieces and carrots into 1-inch pieces; add to endive., Add salt to taste., Cover and cook for 1 to 1 1/2 hours, until tender. Cover saucepan lightly with oil., Fry garlic lightly., Add tomato sauce., Add salt, pepper and oregano to taste., Simmer until it starts to thicken (10 to 15 minutes)., Add beans and simmer about 1/2 hour, until thickened., Drain vegetables, saving vegetable water., Add vegetables to bean sauce; slowly add water until thick, but soupy., Serve with Parmesan cheese.

title: Harvard Beets
directions: Drain liquid from beets into saucepan., Boil down to half. Shake together vinegar and flour., Stir into boiling mixture., Add sugar and salt; bring to boil., Add beets and butter; heat through.

title: Black Bean And Rice Soup
directions: Place beans with liquid in blender; blend until smooth., Pour into large saucepan., Stir in water, oregano and garlic powder and bring to boil., Stir in rice., Reduce heat; cover and simmer 5 minutes., Remove from heat., Let stand 5 minutes., Serve with chopped onions if desired.

title: Stewed Pears
directions: Pare and core pears., Place in cold water until ready to use. Make syrup., Add fruit, cored side down., Boil gently until soft. Add lemon juice before done.

title: Cocoa Fudge Brownies
directions: Heat shortening and cocoa in saucepan until melted., Stir in sugar and milk; bring to a boil., Add beaten eggs and all dry ingredients., Pour into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes., Wait 5 minutes before cutting into squares.

title: German Apple Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients together with spoon (no mixer)., Batter will be stiff., Spread into a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 45 to 60 minutes., Serve with whipped cream, ice cream or cream cheese frosting.

title: Cranberry Oatmeal Square
directions: Mix 2nd mixture well and put half into a 7 x 11-inch pan; press firmly., Pour in cranberry mixture and cool with remaining dry mixture., Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes., Cut into squares.

title: Pineapple Casserole
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Cream together the margarine and sugar. Add eggs, one at a time, beating well., Stir in crushed pineapple and bread cubes., Bake at 350° for 1/2 hour in a 9-inch square pan.

title: Pink Cloud
directions: Mix together and chill.

title: Cheese Fritters
directions: In a medium bowl, beat the cottage cheese and egg together. Stir in the half and half, flour, baking powder, salt, sugar and nutmeg. Mix until just combined. Fill a deep pot to the 2-inch mark with oil. Heat to 375°F (190°C). Drop batter by rounded tablespoonfuls into the hot oil. Fry until golden brown on all sides, about 3 to 4 minutes. Drain on paper towels and sprinkle with confectioners sugar. Serve hot!

title: Snack Bars
directions: In a very large bowl, combine the first five ingredients., In a saucepan over low heat, cook and stir marshmallows and butter until marshmallows are melted., Add honey and mix well., Pour over cereal mixture; mix well., Add chips, M&M's or raisins if desired. Pat two-thirds into a greased 15 x 10 x 1-inch pan and the remaining third into a 9-inch square pan., Cool., Yield:, 4 to 5 dozen.

title: Blueberry Streusel Cobbler
directions: In bowl, combine berries, sweetened condensed milk and rind. In large bowl, cut 3/4 cup margarine into 1 1/2 cups biscuit mix until crumbly., Add berry mixture., Spread in greased 9-inch square baking pan., In bowl, combine 1/2 cup biscuit mix and sugar; cut in 2 tablespoons margarine until crumbly., Add nuts. Sprinkle over cobbler., Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 10 minutes or until golden., Serve warm with ice cream and Blueberry Sauce.

title: Corn Casserole
directions: In a large bowl, mix all ingredients together., Pour into a well greased 9x13 inch pan., Bake for about 45 minutes., Serves 12.

title: Caramel Corn
directions: Mix brown sugar, margarine, corn syrup, water and salt., Bring to a steady boil., Boil for 5 minutes, stirring constantly., Remove from heat., Stir in baking soda., Stir until thoroughly mixed. (Syrup will be foamy.), Pour over popped popcorn., Mix gently. Bake for 1 hour at 225°, stirring every 15 minutes., Pour mix onto wax paper or on clean large tea towel separating corn gently. Cool.

title: Rice And Chicken Almondine
directions: Saute almonds and onion in butter for 10 minutes., Stir in flour., Add bouillon and cream, stirring until thickened., Add chicken and remaining ingredients., Pour into casserole., Bake at 375° for 30 minutes., Serves 6.

title: Grandma Brasch'S Molasses Cookies
directions: Dissolve baking soda in boiling water., Blend together sugar, shortening and egg., Add molasses; blend., Carefully add water. Mix in spices (according to your taste)., Gradually add in flour until a soft dough., Scoop tablespoon size balls and roll in sugar., Place on greased cookie sheet and flatten slightly., Bake at 400° for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Marbled Angel Food Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., Prepare cake according to package directions., Measure 4 cups of batter into separate bowl. Gradually, fold cocoa into batter until well blended, be careful not to deflate batter., Alternately pour vanilla and chocolate batters into ungreased tube pan., Cut through batter with knife to marble batter., Bake 30 to 35 minutes, do not underbake., Invert pan on heatproof funnel or bottle., Cool for 2 hours., Run knife along sides to loosen cake, place on platter., May be eaten plain or drizzled with chocolate glaze.

title: Caesar Salad
directions: Cut up or tear lettuce., Oil the bowl with oily dressing; toss lettuce with creamy dressing., Then add Parmesan cheese., Toss lettuce with oily dressing, then add Parmesan cheese., Add croutons just before serving., Add cucumber and tomato, if desired.

title: Cook Frosting
directions: Cook until thick the flour and milk., Cream the butter, granulated sugar and vanilla., Add both mixtures together and beat for 16 minutes., Frost cake and refrigerate.

title: Poppy Seed Muffins(Makes 1 Dozen)
directions: Combine all dry ingredients., Make a well in center., Add remaining ingredients., Stir until moist., Spoon into greased muffin pan, filling 1/2 full., Bake at 400° for 20 minutes.

title: Pecan Pie 3
directions: Cream the butter and sugar together thoroughly. Add the eggs, syrup and salt., Mix well., Add the vanilla and pecans., Pour into the pie pan lined with pastry. Bake 45 to 50 minutes at 350° until firm.

title: Buckaroo Beans
directions: Boil beans in 6 cups boiling water for 2 minutes., Let stand for 1 hour., Rinse twice., Add 3 1/2 cups fresh water and cook until tender., Add remaining ingredients and simmer for 1 1/2 hours uncovered., Serves 12.

title: Special French Toast
directions: Beat eggs and cream together., Add Triple Sec, granulated sugar, orange zest and cinnamon; whisk until well blended., Pour into shallow bowl.

title: Tapioca
directions: Soak tapioca overnight in water., Stir in 2 cups whipped topping and some nut meats., Let stand overnight in refrigerator.

title: Budget Shrimp Creole
directions: Saute first 4 ingredients in oleo., Remove from heat, stir in tomato sauce, water and seasonings., Simmer 10 minutes., Stir in shrimp., Heat to boiling., Cover and cook 15 minutes., Serve over hot rice., Serves 6.

title: Bean And Sausage Soup
directions: Pick through and rinse beans., Place in a 4 quart pot and cover with at least 2 inches of water., Bring to a boil for 2 to 3 minutes., Cover, and let stand in the refrigerator overnight. Drain and rinse beans., Place beans in crockpot with canned tomatoes, broth, wine, and vegetables., Cover and cook on low for 7 to 8 hours., In a skillet, cook the sausage over medium heat until done., Slice links into 1/2 inch pieces., Add meat to the crockpot and cook another 30 to 60 minutes., Makes 8 servings.

title: Grandma Straub'S Chili Sauce
directions: Grind peppers and onions., Mash tomatoes to chunky., Add all other ingredients to mix., Cook slowly until thickens, stirring occasionally to prevent burning, about 3 to 4 hours.

title: Cabbage Surprise
directions: Place all ingredients in large pot., Cover with water and bring to boil., Boil 10 minutes, then simmer until soft., Sprinkle with cheese.

title: Apple Cinnamon Baked French Toast
directions: Slice bread into 1-inch thick slices., Spray a 9 x 13-inch pan with oil and arrange bread slices tightly together., Mix eggs, milk, 1/2 cup sugar and vanilla., Pour half of mixture over bread. Arrange sliced apples on top and pour balance of egg mixture over top., Take remaining 1/2 cup of sugar and mix it with the cinnamon and nutmeg., Sprinkle over top., Bake at 350° for 1 hour., Let rest for 10 minutes before serving., Serve with hot syrup.

title: Taco Dip
directions: Brown beef; drain., Melt cheese in crock-pot; add sauce and meat and simmer for awhile., Serve with tortilla chips as dippers.

title: Quick Cabbage Casserole
directions: Slice cabbage, cook 10 minutes in salt water., Drain., Mix soup, milk, cabbage and cheese., Pour into casserole., Top with crumbs., Bake for 30 minutes in 350 degree oven.

title: Cherry Coke Salad
directions: Bring to boil the water and sugar., Add Jell-O and pie filling. Mix and bring to boil again, then cool slightly and add remaining 4 ingredients., Chill until firm.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
directions: In large mixing bowl, beat eggs and sugar., Add oil, salt and flour., Mix well., Add vanilla, cinnamon, baking soda, apples and nuts., Bake 1 hour or more at 350° to 375° in well greased tube pan.

title: Meatballs
directions: Mix meat, milk, egg, oatmeal, onion and salt., Form into balls., Make sauce out of remaining ingredients., Pour over meatballs., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes., Don't cover., Add pepper if desired.

title: Oyster Cracker Snack
directions: Mix dressing and oil; add seasonings., Pour over crackers., Put in warm oven, 15 to 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.

title: Texas-Style Beans And Rice
directions: Combine beans, tomatoes, picante sauce, beer and brown sugar in large saucepan., Simmer uncovered 20 minutes., Stir in rice and salt; heat through., Sprinkle with onion and cilantro.

title: White Cheese Dip
directions: Cube cheese and put in a saucepan. Over medium - low heat, add just enough milk to melt the cheese to the desired consistency, stirring constantly so cheese doesn't burn. Blend in finely chopped jalapenos to taste. Leftovers may be refrigerated and reheated on the stovetop by adding a little milk and stirring over medium - low heat.

title: Amaretto
directions: Bring brown sugar and water to a boil., Let syrup cool., Mix almond extract and vodka to syrup., Shake well., Let stand for 3 days.

title: Christmas Candy
directions: With hands thoroughly mix above ingredients., Shape into small balls., Place on wax paper and chill for at least 2 hours.

title: Vidalia Onion Seafood Casserole
directions: Saute onions, celery and green pepper in margarine., Add pimento, cream of celery soup, milk and cream cheese., Heat slowly until blended., Add rice and shrimp; mix well., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes., Place crushed crackers on top the last 10 minutes of baking., (Cover top of casserole with crumbs.)

title: Tamale Pie
directions: Brown ground meat; drain fat., Stir in tomato sauce, beans and seasoning., Prepare muffin mix according to the package directions., Spread muffin mix batter over chili mixture., Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes., Bake 5 minutes more or until cheese melts., Serves 6.

title: Grandma Stoddard'S Peanut Butter Fudge
directions: Stir sugar, oleo and milk together in pan., Boil to soft ball stage (about 5 minutes)., Remove from heat., Add peanut butter; stir well., Add vanilla., Pour into a greased pan., Allow 30 minutes to cool.

title: Potato Casserole
directions: Bake at 350° for 2 to 2 1/2 hours. Put crushed cornflakes on top after baking with dots of butter., Place back in oven for a few minutes.

title: Shoo-Fly Pie
directions: Mix until crumbs in a bowl.

title: Fruit Dip
directions: Mix together cream cheese and sugar in a bowl., Blend in vanilla and sour cream., Chill about 30 minutes.

title: Green Beans And Corn Casserole
directions: Grease a 2-quart casserole dish; combine butter and cracker crumbs and press one-half of mixture into the bottom of the casserole dish., Layer remaining ingredients in dish twice; top with remaining crumb mixture., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until it bubbles.

title: Salted Pecans
directions: Coat pecans with melted margarine; sprinkle with salt., Bake 20 minutes at 275°., Cool on paper towels.

title: Beef Cheese Log
directions: Soften cream cheese. In a large bowl, add mayo and Worcestershire sauce. Mix well. Add olives, parsley and onion. Chill until firm. On wax paper, shape into a 1 1/2-inch roll. Roll in dried beef. Garnish with parsley. Serve with crackers.

title: Microwave Lasagna
directions: Brown, beef;, stir, in tomatoes and tomato paste, salt, basil, oregano, garlic, powder, and water., Cover with lid and microwave 4, to, 5, minutes or until boiling., Combine cottage cheese, Parmesan cheese, egg and parsley., Mix well., Pour in 1 1/2 cups tomato beef sauce in 8 x 12-inch glass dish., Place 4, uncooked noodles, evenly, over, sauce., Top	with, 1/2 the cottage, cheese mix, spreading evenly., Sprinkle with 1/2 the Mozzarella, cheese. Spoon, 1, cup sauce over cheese., Place 4 more, noodles, on sauce,, top, with, even layers of remaining cottage, cheese, Mozzarella	cheese	and tomato sauce., Cover lightly, with plastic, wrap., Microwave, 15, minutes rotating dish., Microwave at	50%, power for 15 to 20 minutes or until noodles are tender. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese., Microwave uncovered 1, 1/2	to 2 minutes or until cheese is melted.	Let stand 10 minutes before cutting.

title: Party Fizz
directions: Pour the orange juice into a bowl, then the pineapple juice and club soda., Add the sherbet and mix everything with an egg beater., Pour the fizz into glasses.

title: Pot Roast
directions: Dredge roast in flour., Brown slowly on all sides in hot fat. Season generously with salt and pepper., Add onions., Mix remaining ingredients except mushrooms and add to roast., Cover and cook slowly at 300° for 2 1/2 hours., Then add mushrooms. Blend 2 tablespoons flour to thicken gravy.

title: Strawberry Pretzel Salad
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Combine margarine, brown sugar and pretzels., Mix well and pat into a lightly buttered 9 x 12-inch Pyrex baking pan., Bake at 350° for 10 minutes., Dissolve gelatin in boiling water., While hot, add strawberries., Cool until mixture begins to thicken.

title: Peanut Butter Health Bread
directions: In medium bowl, stir flour, oats, baking powder, and salt., In large bowl with mixer at medium speed, beat peanut butter and sugar until smooth., Beat in egg., Gradually add milk., With mixer on low, beat in dry ingredients until smooth., Stir in raisins.

title: Country Sausage
directions: Combine all ingredients except oil and pat mixture into 8 small cakes., Heat oil in large skillet and fry cakes about 20 minutes, turning until brown and crisp on both sides., Serves 4.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients., Bake 1 hour at 350° to 375°., The last 15 minutes of baking, add crushed potato chips on top.

title: Skillet Peanut Butter Fudge
directions: In an electric skillet, combine sugar, butter and milk., Set the heat control at 280°., Bring to full boil and boil for 5 minutes stirring constantly., Turn off heat., Add marshmallows, peanut butter and vanilla., Stir until melted., Cool., Cut into squares., Makes 2 pounds.

title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Pie
directions: Combine cocoa, flour, cornstarch, sugar and salt in a saucepan., Add egg yolks, butter and milk., Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until thickened., Add vanilla and peanut butter., Stir., Cool and pour into baked pie shell., Refrigerate until ready to serve., Within an hour of serving, spread whipped cream over top.

title: Gooey Buns
directions: Grind bologna and cheese. Add remaining ingredients and mix well., Butter 6 buns. Fill and wrap individually in tinfoil. Bake in a 325° oven for 25 minutes.

title: Asparagus Casserole
directions: Using your favorite casserole dish layer stuffing, asparagus and eggs and sprinkle with pepper and onion., Repeat until dish is full., Pour soup and asparagus liquid on top and spread., Bake at 350° until bubbles up.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
directions: Combine sweet potatoes, sugar, salt, eggs, margarine, milk and vanilla and pour into casserole dish., Combine brown sugar, flour, pecans and margarine in a medium bowl and sprinkle over potatoes mixture. Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Chocolate Fondue
directions: Combine cornstarch and water in a small saucepan., Add remaining ingredients; stir until smooth., Cook over medium heat until mixture boils, stirring constantly., Serve warm as a dip with fresh fruit., Serves 1 cup.

title: Wayne'S Hush Puppies(For Large Gatherings)
directions: Mix all ingredients well; drop by spoonfuls into hot oil. Submerge, if possible, until brown., Enjoy!

title: Sausage Balls
directions: Mix ingredients together., Knead, if necessary., Make into walnut size balls., Bake 15 to 20 minutes at 350° on ungreased cookie sheet.

title: Beginner'S Pie Crust
directions: Mix flour and salt together in bowl., Cut in shortening with fork until mixture looks like corn meal., Add water a little at a time., Let set a few minutes., Knead on floured surface and shape into pie shell.

title: Spinach Polenta Casserole
directions: Saute garlic in oil until crisp., Remove and add the spinach and salt and pepper to taste., Steam until limp., Remove from pan and squeeze dry when cool.

title: Rice Pudding
directions: Mix together 1 hour over low heat until thick., When thick, remove from heat., Add 4 scoops vanilla ice cream and vanilla extract., Stir., Sprinkle with cinnamon., Enjoy!

title: Cream Cheese Cookies
directions: Cream butter and cream cheese together., Slowly add sugar, beating until fluffy., Beat in egg yolk., Add flour and vanilla and mix well., Chill dough at least 1 hour., Shape into 1-inch balls and place on ungreased cookie sheet., Gently press a cherry half or pecan half into each cookie., Bake at 350° until bottom of cookies start to brown, 6 to 10 minutes., Do not overbake.

title: Caramel Frosting
directions: Place all ingredients in cooker., Bring to a boil; turn down. When it forms a soft ball in cold water, take off stove., Let cool, then mix with a mixer.

title: Church Windows Candies
directions: Melt margarine and chocolate chips., Let cool slightly., Add nuts and marshmallows., Spread coconut on wax paper., Divide mixture into four rolls., Roll in coconut., Wrap in wax paper. Place in refrigerator for 24 hours before slicing., Cut in 1/2-inch thick slices.

title: Corn Custard
directions: Combine first 4 ingredients., Stir in eggs., Scald milk and 2 tablespoons butter; add to corn mixture., Pour into a greased casserole and bake at 300° for 1 hour., Mix crumbs in 1 tablespoon butter and sprinkle on top., Bake until browned.

title: Ground Meat Casserole
directions: Cook macaroni until tender; add to other ingredients., Pour into baking dish and cook at 350° for 35 minutes., Remove from oven and top with grated cheese, if desired., Return to oven until cheese is melted.

title: Aunt Jo'S Peanut Butter Fudge
directions: Mix and boil sugar, brown sugar, salt and milk for 5 minutes. Remove from heat; add remaining ingredients and beat thoroughly. Immediately place in buttered 9 x 13-inch pan., Refrigerate until cool.

title: Rhubarb Bread
directions: Beat eggs, brown sugar, oil and vanilla until thick and foamy. Stir in rhubarb and nuts., Mix flour, baking powder, baking soda and spices., Add to the rhubarb mixture and stir until just blended.

title: Hungarian Rhapsody
directions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet., Over high heat, brown the cutlets briefly on both sides; do not overcook., Reserve browned cutlets on a warmed platter., In the same skillet over medium heat, saute chopped onion and garlic in the remaining olive oil until lightly browned, 6 to 8 minutes., Stir in paprika and cook 2 minutes longer., Blend in sour cream until just heated through., Do not allow the mixture to boil!, Season with salt and pepper., Remove from, heat., Spoon the sauce over the cutlets; serve with boiled rice.

title: Honey Bun Cake
directions: Heat the oven to 325°., Mix cake mix, oil, eggs and sour cream by hand., Pour 1/2 of batter in cake pan (greased and floured). Sprinkle with brown sugar and cinnamon., Pour remaining batter on top., Swirl., Bake for 40 minutes., Ice.

title: Zucchini Bread
directions: Heat oven to 325°., Generously grease bottoms only of 2 baking pans, 9 x 5 x 3-inches. Beat all ingredients on low speed, scraping bowl constantly for 1 minute., Beat on medium speed for 1 minute., Pour into pans., Bake until wooden toothpick inserted into center comes out clean, about 1 hour., Cool for 10 minutes. Remove from pans. Cool completely before slicing., Yields 2 loaves.

title: Fudge Pudding Cake
directions: Combine first 5 dry ingredients., Add milk, vanilla and butter and beat until smooth., Stir in the walnuts and spread the batter in a buttered 6 cup casserole., Over the batter, sprinkle the mixture of the brown sugar and cocoa., Over this, pour 1 1/2 cups boiling water., Bake in a 350° oven for 50 minutes., Do not attempt to turn out this cake., The bottom is full of fudge sauce., Serve warm with ice cream or whipped cream.

title: Christmas Punch(Ison Family Tradition)
directions: You will need a punch bowl, cups, potato masher and whisk.

title: Microwave Taco Chops
directions: Combine taco mix with cornflake crumbs., Dip one side of each chop into egg and then into crumb mixture., Reserve remaining egg and crumbs., Place crumb side up into 12 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish or large pie plate, placing meaty ends of chops toward outside of dish., Microwave uncovered on High for 5 minutes, turning dish 1/2 turn after 3 minutes., Turn chops over; top with remaining egg and crumbs., Dissolve bouillon cube in water on High for 30 seconds. Stir., Pour around (not over) chops., Cover with plastic wrap; microwave for 6 minutes on High, rotating dish once., Let stand covered for 5 minutes., Use pan drippings for gravy, if desired. Serves 4., Simply delicious!

title: Shoo-Fly Pie
directions: Beat all together with mixer., Makes one 9-inch pie., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Vegetarian Chili
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Bring to a boil., Simmer for 15 minutes.

title: Spiced Sesame Seed Crescents
directions: Sift together flour, baking powder, mace and salt. Gradually stir sugar into softened butter. Beat in egg. Add flour mixture gradually, mixing after each addition. Let dough stand 30 minutes at room temperature. With fingers, on waxed paper, shape a rounded teaspoonful of dough at a time into a roll 2-inches long. Taper ends. Roll in lightly toasted sesame seed. Place on an ungreased cookie sheet. Curve ends to form crescents. Bake in a 375° oven 18 to 20 minutes or until lightly browned around the bottom. Cool on wire rack.

title: Quick Fruit Pie
directions: Roll out biscuits., Fill with fruit and seal edges like fried pies., Place in single layer in casserole dish., Pour liquid mixture over pies., Sprinkle with cinnamon., Bake at 350° until done.

title: Disgustingly Rich Brownies
directions: You will also need measuring cups and spoons, a bowl, an 8 or 9-inch square baking pan and an oven., Preheat oven to 350°, then smear the inside of the pan with shortening.

title: Italian Chicken
directions: Soak chicken pieces in beaten eggs overnight., Roll chicken pieces in Italian bread crumbs and saute in butter., Arrange pieces in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish., Add to the drippings in your frying pan, 1 cup chicken broth and 1/2 cup dry white wine., Pour over chicken; top with mushrooms and grated Muenster cheese., Bake at 350° for 40 minutes (decrease oven temperature to 325° if using a glass baking dish).

title: Easy Pie Crust
directions: Put all ingredients in pie plate., Mix well and press into shape, partially covering rim of plate., Pinch dough into fluting for edge. Prick bottom and bake at 400° for 15 minutes.

title: Banana Burrito
directions: Lay tortilla on flat surface; spread evenly with peanut butter and raspberry spread., Sprinkle with coconut, if desired., Place banana on edge of tortilla; roll up to enclose., Wrap loosely in paper towel., Microwave on High for 35 seconds.

title: Ice Cream Pie
directions: Mix together ice cream and Cool Whip., Smooth in bowl., Freeze slightly until it mounds, then spoon into graham cracker crust. Freeze for 4 hours.

title: No Salt Herb Shaker
directions: Mix all ingredients., Pour into salt shaker and use instead of salt.

title: Microwave Fudge
directions: Mix sugar, cocoa, salt, milk and vanilla in a 1-quart glass dish., Cut butter in slices and put on top., Cook on High for 2 to 2 1/2 minutes., Stir until smooth., Add nuts., Pour into wax paper lined 8-inch square dish., Chill until firm., Cut into squares.

title: Football Popcorn
directions: Melt oleo in a saucepan., Stir in brown sugar., Simmer until syrup forms., Immediately pour over already popped popcorn., Stir well.

title: Breakfast Bake
directions: Brown sausage and drain., Combine all ingredients., Pour into two 9-inch pie shells., Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes., Ham can be substituted for sausage.

title: Plain Jane Cake
directions: Mix butter, Crisco and sugar together until smooth., Add eggs, one at a time, until they are mixed in well., Gradually add milk and flour., Bake at 325° for 1 hour and at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Croquettes
directions: Stir onion in melted butter until brown., Blend in dry ingredients., Add water and stir until thick., Add meat and cook 2 minutes., Break in egg., Stir until mixed., Chill., To mold, dip in cracker meal, seasoned beaten eggs, then cracker meal again. Chill., Roll in melted butter; cook on baking sheet at 350°, for one-half hour., Serve with tomato or mushroom sauce., Makes 6 regular size.

title: Nadine Krall'S Pork Chops And Rice
directions: Brown chops in frypan., Pour onion soup mix and enough water over chops to keep chops covered., Cook for 1/2 hour., Add Minute rice and simmer., For two people, use 1/2 cup rice.

title: Honey Buttermilk Rolls
directions: Place all ingredients into bread machine pan in the order listed. Use "dough" setting to make dough. Remove when dough setting is done. Use margarine to coat hands for easy removal and roll shaping.

title: Cherry Fruit Salad
directions: Blend Eagle Brand, Cool Whip, lemon juice, crushed pineapple, cherry jello and almond flavoring. Add bananas, cherry pie filling and pecans. Fold in. Chill.

title: Creamy Reception Punch
directions: Spoon vanilla ice cream by tablespoons into a large punch bowl. Add juices, stirring to muddle ice cream., Slowly pour in 7-Up or Sprite. Stir to mix.

title: Persimmon Pudding
directions: Bake for 30 minutes.

title: Pancakes
directions: Combine egg, milk and oil., Add sifted dry ingredients., Beat until smooth., Bake on ungreased griddle., Pour batter from 1/4 cup measuring cup., Makes 12 small cakes.

title: "Green Stuff" Salad
directions: Heat pear juice to boiling., Pour over jello and dissolve. While hot, pour jello over cream cheese., Mix well with mixer until blended., Place mixture in refrigerator or freezer until it starts to set., Add whipped cream with mixer until well blended. Add nuts and pears; pour into serving bowl., Chill until firm.

title: Fruit Salad
directions: Mix together in large bowl., May freeze if wanted.

title: Confectioners Sugar
directions: Whirl together in blender until fine.

title: Hot Cranberry Cider
directions: In large saucepan combine ingredients. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat; simmer uncovered 10 minutes., Remove spices., Serve warm.

title: Peppers 'N Potatoes
directions: In 12-inch nonstick skillet, heat margarine until bubbly; add bell peppers, onions and garlic., Saute until vegetables are softened., Stir in water, broth mix and pepper; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low., Add potatoes, cover and let simmer, stirring occasionally, until tender., (Add more water if necessary to prevent sticking.)

title: Monster Cookies
directions: Mix together in order given., Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes., Watch carefully, they brown quickly., You can make these any size you like.

title: Corn Salad With Mesquite Turkey Breast
directions: Toss together corn, celery, bell pepper, olives and cilantro in large bowl. Combine dressing and cumin in measuring cup and pour over corn mixture. Toss to coat. Line 4 plates with spinach leaves and place 1 cup corn salad in center of each plate. Fold 4 to 5 slices turkey into fourths and tuck around corn salad or cut turkey into strips and arrange strips around corn.

title: Jalapeno Dip
directions: This dip is put in layers; either on a glass plate or in a glass bowl.

title: Supreme Chicken Casserole
directions: Cook chicken until tender., Chop in bite-size pieces., Slice water chestnuts., Crush crackers., Sprinkle 1/2 crackers in bottom of baking dish., Mix chicken soup, water chestnuts, sour cream and onions together., Pour in baking dish., Top with remaining crumbs and sprinkle butter over crackers., Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Impossible Taco Pie
directions: Heat oven to 400°., Grease pie plate (10 x 1 1/2-inch)., Cook and stir beef and onions until brown; drain., Stir in seasoning mix; spread into plate., Top with chillies., Beat milk, baking mix and eggs until smooth, 15 seconds, in blender or 1 minute with mixer., Pour into plate., Bake 25 minutes., Top with sliced tomatoes and cheese, then bake until knife inserted in center comes out clean, 8 to 10 minutes or longer., Cool 5 minutes. Serve with sour cream, chopped tomatoes, shredded lettuce and Cheddar cheese.

title: Diabetic'S Fruit Salad
directions: Mix juice from pineapple, lemon juice and enough orange juice to make 1 cup., Add sweetener., Dissolve cornstarch in water and add to juice., Boil and stir until thick., Cool., Combine canned fruit and fresh fruit., Mix in fruit dressing; allow to stand to let flavors blend., Makes 1 cup dressing., Leftover will keep or double recipe.

title: Pineapple Shortcake
directions: Just dip canned biscuits in vegetable oil. Turn in granulated sugar and place on cookie sheet. Flatten each with bottom of glass dipped in sugar. Bake 10 minutes in preheated 425° oven, then on with the golden crushed pineapple and a topping of whipped cream. Garnish with a cherry.

title: Sausage Muffins
directions: Cook sausage and drain well., Mix flour, corn meal, egg, milk and oil., Add sausage., Place in greased muffin pan and bake at 425° for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Mustard Potato Salad
directions: Cool potatoes completely. To make mustard dressing, in a large serving bowl, combine white wine vinegar, Dijon mustard and salt. Whisk in olive oil until well blended., Add sliced red potatoes, scallions and roasted red peppers., Toss to coat well with mustard-oil dressing.

title: Caramel-Peanut Pie
directions: Place, 1, cup, sugar in heavy skillet; cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until sugar melts and forms a light brown syrup., Reduce heat to low;, gradually add boiling water in, a slow, stream,, stirring, constantly, with a wire whisk. Remove from heat.

title: Fresh Spinach Salad
directions: Wash spinach - mix all ingredients - Serve immediately.

title: Sad Cake
directions: Mix ingredients; beat well., Grease and flour 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake in 350° oven., Cake is done when it falls in middle., Bake 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Christmas Wreath
directions: Melt butter and marshmallows., Allow to melt gradually over low heat., Stir until creamy., Add food coloring; mix good., Add corn flakes., Drop by teaspoon on cookie sheet., Press hole in middle to form a wreath shape., Press cinnamon candy on to appear as berries., Allow to harden., Place layers of wax paper between layers of wreath.

title: Lace Cookies
directions: Mix dry ingredients., Pour melted butter over and stir., Add beaten egg and vanilla., Drop by 1/4 teaspoon onto aluminum foil on cookie sheet, leaving lots of room in between., Bake in a 350° oven for 8 minutes., Let cookies cool on foil before peeling off. Use new foil for each sheet of cookies., Makes 7 dozen.

title: Good Homemade Ice Cream
directions: Beat sugar, Pet milk and egg yolks until sugar is dissolved. Beat egg whites until stiff; fold in with vanilla., Pour in freezer., If not enough to fill to line, fill with milk., Any fruit you desire can be added to this.

title: Squash Casserole
directions: Cook squash in small amount of water until done and drain. Mix all ingredients together., Place in casserole dish., Sprinkle top with buttered crumbs., Bake 45 minutes or until set at 350°.

title: Homemade White Bread
directions: Heat 4 cups water to 110°; use 3/4 cup of the water and dissolve yeast and 3/4 teaspoon regular sugar., Stir in flour, Sweet 'N Low, salt, pepper and Crisco.

title: Black-Eyed Pea Dip
directions: Combine ingredients., Microwave until melted. Serve with corn chips.

title: Bacon-N-Eggs
directions: Cut hard-boiled eggs in half and remove yolks., Mix with mayonnaise, salt, pepper and crumbled bacon., Put mixture back into eggs and serve., Kids love them., Serve for breakfast with toast.

title: Sarah'S Lasagne
directions: In large heavy pan, lightly brown beef and onion in oil. Drain., Add tomatoes (put through blender), paste, water, parsley, salt, sugar, garlic powder, pepper and oregano., Simmer, uncovered, stirring occasionally for 30 minutes.

title: New England Blueberry Muffins
directions: Beat together the sugar and butter., Add eggs and milk., Add dry ingredients and beat for 1 minute., Fold in blueberries.

title: French Coconut Pie
directions: Mix all ingredients except the pie shell., Pour into shell and bake at 350° until set, 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Turkey Dressing
directions: Melt margarine in skillet., In margarine, saute chopped onion, chopped celery and leaves., Add salt, pepper, sage, thyme (may be omitted and recipe is still just as good) and poultry seasoning.

title: Celery Casserole
directions: Cook celery in small amount of salt water until tender, but crisp., Drain; add remaining ingredients except crumbs., Put in shallow 2-quart dish; sprinkle with bread crumbs., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Baked Fish
directions: Dip fish in dressing., Melt margarine in flat pan., Pour part off to be used later., Roll fish in cracker crumbs and put single layer in pan., Sprinkle with lemon juice and then chopped onion. Pour remaining margarine over fish., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes. (May be placed under broiler very briefly after baked for a crisper coating.)

title: Holiday Sweet Potato Surprise
directions: Cook the sweet potatoes in boiling water 20 to 25 minutes or until tender., Drain and cool., Peel the potatoes and mash. Combine mashed sweet potatoes, frosting, vanilla and cinnamon; mix well. Spoon into a greased 12 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish. Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 18 minutes., Sprinkle with marshmallows. Continue baking 5 minutes or until thoroughly heated., Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Carved Watermelon
directions: Mix all ingredients until sugar is dissolved.

title: Sauce For Ribs Or Burgers
directions: Combine all ingredients and bring to a boil., The sauce can then be sealed in a jar and stored in the refrigerator or used at once., Yield:, Enough sauce for three chickens, halved, or for 5 to 6 pounds of ribs.

title: Chicken And Biscuit Dinner
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Cut each biscuit into half., In saucepan, put chicken or turkey, gravy, beans, seasoning and pepper., Cook and stir until bubbly., This can be baked in a casserole or individual baking cups., Spoon into dishes and top with three biscuit pieces on each casserole., Bake 15 to 18 minutes until biscuits are golden., This is a fun recipe for kids to do.

title: Scotch Shortbread
directions: Sift flour, measure, add salt and sift again., Cream butter, gradually add confectioners sugar and beat until light., Combine dry ingredients and creamed mixture., Blend thoroughly., Put dough in 8 x 8-inch pan and bake at 325° for 25 to 30 minutes., Cut in squares before completely cool.

title: Strawberry Pie
directions: Mix together in saucepan., Cook and stir over medium heat until comes to boil., Pour in bowl; cool mixture by putting bowl in cold water with ice cubes in it., Stir while cooling until thickens. Add 1 1/2 cups whipped cream or Dream Whip., Mix well., Pour in 9-inch cold pie shell., Refrigerate about 2 hours before serving. Serve with more Cool Whip or strawberries.

title: Diabetic Maple Flavored Pancake Syrup
directions: In small saucepan, combine apple juice and cornstarch., Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly., Cook and stir 2 minutes more., Remove from heat and stir in butter, Equal, maple flavoring and vanilla., Serve over pancakes, waffles or French toast., Makes 1 cup.

title: Meatballs
directions: Mix grape jelly and chili sauce., Warm in microwave., Place meatballs in crock-pot., Pour jelly sauce mix over meatballs. Simmer on low for 1 hour or until heated through.

title: Rum Balls
directions: Sift cocoa and powdered sugar into bowl., Stir in liquor which has been combined with syrup; mix well., Add vanilla wafers and nuts; mix well., Form into 3/4-inch balls and roll in powdered sugar., Dry several hours., Freezes well., Yields 3 dozen.

title: Tea Tarts
directions: Soak yeast in water until dissolved., Mix dry ingredients and shortening as for pie crust., Combine everything as for pie crust. Combine everything just until blended and chill for several hours or overnight., Roll on sugared board 1/8 to 1/4-inch thick., Cut in squares., Put spoon of jam on center of square and fold three cornered., Press edges together., Place on pans and let raise 30 minutes., Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Corinne'S Famous Pea Salad
directions: Place 1/2 head of lettuce on bottom of bowl., Sprinkle with salt, pepper and sugar., Layer eggs atop lettuce in bowl., Add more salt., Layer as follows:, Peas, remaining lettuce, bacon and Swiss cheese., Spread mayonnaise over top, sealing to edge of bowl., Cover and chill 24 hours., Toss before serving.

title: Chicken Cordon Bleu
directions: Flatten chicken breasts; sprinkle with salt and pepper., Add ham and a slice of cheese to breast and fold over., Secure with long toothpicks., Coat with flour., In a large skillet, add 2 tablespoons butter., Cook about 4 minutes on each side., Melt remaining butter in skillet., Add mushrooms and onion; saute., Add water, chicken bouillon, parsley, and chives., Bring to a boil. Return chicken to sauce., Lower heat and simmer for 30 minutes. Bring sauce to boil again and stir in heavy cream., Cook on low heat until sauce thickens slightly., Pour sauce over chicken to serve., Serves 4.

title: Strawberry Surprise
directions: Cook cake according to directions on package., Bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan., Put glaze on top of cake (cooled)., Place cut strawberries on top and top with Cool Whip., Chill.

title: Hot Fruit Salad
directions: Cook, covered, for about 1 hour at 250° in a 2-quart casserole., May add ripened bananas., Serves 7 to 8.

title: Sunflower Seed Cookies
directions: Cream sugars, shortening and eggs. Add water and vanilla. Add remaining ingredients. Drop on cookie sheet. Bake at 350° for 10 to 15 minutes. Makes about 120.

title: Sausage-Peach Breakfast Bake
directions: Drain peaches and reserve liquid., Cut sausage links crosswise into bite-size pieces., Prepare pancake mix as usual, except use up to 1 c. of peach liquid as part of the mixture., Turn into a 9 x 13 baking dish and arrange peaches and sausage on top., Bake 350° for 30 minutes., Serve with syrup.

title: Spiders
directions: Melt chips and then add peanuts and chow mein noodles., Spoon onto wax paper., Chill.

title: Breakfast Pizza
directions: Cook sausage until brown; drain., Separate crescent dough into 8 triangles., Place in an ungreased 12-inch pizza pan with points toward the center., Press over bottom and up sides to form a crust; seal perforations., Spoon sausage over crust; sprinkle with potatoes., Top with Cheddar cheese., Beat eggs together with milk, salt and pepper., Pour into crust., Sprinkle Parmesan cheese over all., Bake at 375° for 25 to 30 minutes., Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Mrs. Fields Cookies
directions: *Put small amount into blender until it turns to powder. Measure first, then blend.

title: Texas Hash
directions: Cook ground beef in skillet., Add onions and green pepper; saute., Add other ingredients., Put in casserole dish., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Apple Kuchen
directions: Mix buttermilk baking mix, milk, sugar and eggs together and spread in a greased 9 x 13-inch baking pan., Arrange apple slices evenly over the top., Drizzle apples with melted butter., Stir sugar and cinnamon together and sprinkle over all., Drizzle with cream., Bake in preheated 350°, oven for 35 to 40 minutes. Wonderful served still warm., Scoop out with a large spoon to serve.

title: Baked Apples
directions: Wash and core apples., Pare apples 1/3 of the way down or slit the skin around the apple about halfway down., Place apples in baking dish., Put sugar and butter in center of each apple. Sprinkle with cinnamon., Pour water around apples to prevent sticking.

title: Josette'S Lasagna Roll-Ups
directions: Brown ground beef in skillet and set aside., Boil noodles until cooked and rinse with water.	Blend cheeses together and set aside., Add browned ground meat with sauce and seasoning in a pan and simmer., Spread cheeses onto noodle on one side., Roll noodles, curly side out., Cut in half., Do so with remainder of noodles., Pour sauce into baking dish and place noodles with non-curly side down into sauce., Cover and bake at 375° for 1 hour., Serve warm.

title: Anytime Dip
directions: Low-fat sour cream and mayonnaise may be used.

title: Instant Hot Chocolate Mix
directions: Mix well., Store in jar., Use 1/3 cup mixture to 1 cup boiling water., Delicious!!

title: Cornbread Dressing
directions: Crumble bread together in a pan and bake at 300° until dry and golden brown., Stir often., Once dry, add butter, eggs, baking powder, salt, pepper, celery and onion., Add sage to taste., Add hot broth and mix well., Bake in greased pan at 375° for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Hungarian Coffee Cake
directions: Crumble brown sugar, butter and flour together like pie dough. Reserve 1 cup for topping., Mix together by hand the beaten eggs and sour cream., Mix soda, salt and vanilla with flour mixture. Pour into 9 x 13-inch baking dish., Crumble on reserved topping. Bake at 350°, for 40 minutes., Check at 35 minutes.

title: Pudding Fruit Salad
directions: Drain juices from pineapple and mandarin oranges into large bowl., Add instant pudding and Tang., Stir until smooth., Add bananas, kiwi fruit, pineapple, oranges, grapes and strawberries. Mix well and chill., Will keep up to 2 weeks in refrigerator.

title: Yum Yum Salad
directions: Dissolve, jello, in water and cool until partially set. Fold in remaining ingredients., Pour into 5-cup mold and chill until firm., Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Tangy Meatballs
directions: Combine beef, salt, pepper, egg and cream., Shape into 1/4-inch balls., In skillet, brown meatballs in butter, turning carefully to avoid piercing., Combine remaining ingredients; add to brown meatballs., Cover; reduce temperature and simmer about 30 minutes., Serve warm., Makes about 4 or 5 dozen.

title: Easy Fruit Cobbler
directions: Melt butter in casserole dish in microwave. In separate container, mix together flour, baking powder, salt, sugar and milk. Pour this mixture over melted butter in casserole dish. Heat berries through. Pour over mixture. Bake at 350°.

title: Pasta With Chicken
directions: In large skillet, melt butter., Add chicken, onion and garlic; cook until chicken and onion are tender., Stir in spaghetti sauce. Reduce heat; simmer, covered, stirring frequently, 10 minutes. Meanwhile, cook pasta according to package directions; drain. Serve sauce over hot pasta; sprinkle with Parmesan cheese., Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Chocolate Pie
directions: Mix cocoa, sugar, flour, salt and milk in top of double boiler., Cook until mixture begins to thicken., Add a little of the mixture to egg yolks., Then add to mixture and cook about 3 minutes longer., Remove from heat., Add butter and vanilla., Pour into baked pie shell., Top with meringue.

title: Apple Crisp
directions: Heap sliced apples in pie plate; add lemon juice and sugar. Add cinnamon as desired., Crumble brown sugar, butter, flour and salt on top., Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

title: Hamburg Noodle Casserole
directions: Brown, ground beef., Cook noodles until not quite done; drain. Put, in, greased casserole., Put 1 layer hamburg and 1 layer noodles., Cover, with mushroom soup., Repeat layers and cover with, celery, soup., Bake in 350° oven until bubbly and lightly browned on top.

title: Carrot Cake
directions: Mix together oil and sugar., Add eggs., Sift dry ingredients. Blend into first mixture., Add carrots and nuts., Grease and flour 2 (10-inch) pans., Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes., When cool, ice with cream cheese frosting.

title: Grape Sunshine
directions: Using real ripe grapes, wash and remove stems., Place in large kettle with enough water to cover bottom of pan only. Kettle can be pretty full of grapes., Cook over medium heat until skins pop open., Run grapes, skins and seeds through a sieve, crushing grapes and skins as much as possible., Stir in 1 box of Sure-Jell with pulp in kettle., Bring to a full boil over high heat., Add sugar at once, bringing to a full boil again; stir constantly., Boil 1 minute, then remove from heat., Skim off foam. Put hot mixture in jars or glasses and top with melted paraffin.

title: Blonde Brownies
directions: Mix together all ingredients, except chocolate chips., Place chocolate chips on top before baking., Bake in cake pan for 20 minutes at 350°.

title: Passover Rolls Or Muffins
directions: Boil water and oil together., Add matzoh meal, sugar and salt. Mix off of the heat., Beat very well., Add eggs, 2 at a time, beating very well., Bake in muffin tin at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Pretzel Salad
directions: Dissolve Jell-Os in hot water., Mix together and when thickened, pour over mixture.

title: Pizzacato Pizza Casserole
directions: Prepare macaroni according to package directions., Drain and set aside., Take sausage out of casing and crumble., Brown and drain off grease., Stir in tomato puree, sauce, water, mushrooms and seasonings., Simmer 15 minutes., Add cooked macaroni and stir well., Put 1/3 of meat and macaroni mixture into a greased 3-quart casserole., Sprinkle with 1/3 Mozzarella cheese., Repeat with remaining 2/3., Bake 15 minutes at 350°., Serves 8 to 10.

title: Spicy Pecans
directions: Combine first 6 ingredients in deep Dutch oven pan. Cook until soft. (Boil at 232°.) Add pecans and stir until coated. Spread and separate with fork; cool completely. Store in tin box.

title: Breakfast Casserole
directions: Grease large casserole dish, 9 x 13-inch., Unroll crescent rolls., Lay out on bottom of dish., Press together., Cook sausage and drain., Pour over rolls., Beat eggs and add milk together. Pour over sausage., Mix grated cheese., Pour over top., Cook at 350° for 20 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Glazed Sweet Potato Pie
directions: Put butter or oleo in hot mashed potatoes; stir until butter is melted., Add sugar, slightly beaten egg and flavoring., Pour into unbaked 9-inch crust., Sprinkle 1/4 sugar over top of pie., Wait until sugar becomes moist, then put into oven., Bake at 350° until done and glaze has formed.

title: Applesauce Cake
directions: Cream butter and sugar; then mix with applesauce., Add sifted dry ingredients, raisins and nuts., Beat and pour into buttered, floured loaf pan., Bake slowly 1 1/4 hours at 325°., Serve with whipped cream.

title: Holiday Bourbon Slush
directions: Mix all ingredients (except Sprite) and freeze 2 days.

title: Italian Cookies
directions: Beat eggs well., Add sugar and beat., Add melted shortening and juice., Mix well., Add salt, baking powder, flour and mix until smooth and easy to handle., Make into different shapes. Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes., Decorate with colored sugar or frosting.

title: Barbecue
directions: Place meat in heavy kettle or skillet and cook slowly until meat changes color., Add onions and cook for 10 to 15 minutes. Add other ingredients, except soup., Simmer for about 1 hour., Add soup and cook a while longer., Salt to taste.

title: Apple Crisp
directions: Melt the butter; pour over the dry ingredients., Mix until crumbly., Spread over 1 can of apple pie filling., Bake until brown at 325°.

title: Pudding Bars
directions: Mix instant pudding according to directions. Add cake mix, then bag of chocolate chips. Mix well. Pour on cookie sheet (greased) and bake in 350° oven 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
directions: Pour sugar over chopped apples; let set 10 minutes., Mix eggs and shortening., Add dry ingredients, raisins and nuts., Stir in apple mixture., Batter is stiff., Bake in a greased 13 x 9-inch baking pan at 375° for 50 minutes., Needs no frosting., Cool before cutting.

title: Butterscotch Cream Cheese Bars
directions: In saucepan, melt morsels and margarine., Stir in crumbs and nuts., Press half of mixture firmly into the bottom of a greased 13 x 9-inch pan.

title: Long Island Iced Tea
directions: Mix together to make 1 serving. Multiply times 4 to make a pitcher.

title: Spaghetti Sauce
directions: Put tomato paste in large cooking pot., Add 5 cans warm water and bring to a boil., Add sugar, oregano, Lawry's salt, onion and Italian seasoning., Simmer for about 2 hours., Add mushrooms and browned hamburger during last half hour., Serve with pasta., Makes great lasagna too., Serves 4 to 6 people., Recipe can be doubled.
