title: April'S Beef Stew
directions: In a large saucepan, brown meat and drain well., Return meat to saucepan., Add onion, garlic and thyme., Stir in vegetable juice, bouillon and water., Bring to boiling; reduce heat., Cover; simmer 1 hour., Stir in potatoes, celery and carrots., Cover; simmer 30 minutes more.

title: Melba Sauce
directions: Put frozen raspberries into a quart glass measuring pitcher. Heat, uncovered, in microwave oven 1 minute on High., Stir to break berries apart. Cook, uncovered, 30 seconds on High or until berries are defrosted., Stir a mixture of sugar and cornstarch into raspberries, then stir in currant jelly. Cook in microwave oven 6 minutes on High until sauce thickens.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
directions: Mix powdered sugar and cheese, then mix in Cool Whip and peanut butter., Pour in graham cracker crust and chill for 1 hour.

title: Polo Star Candy
directions: Melt the almond bark and peanut butter. Remove from heat. Stir in peanuts, rice krispies and marshmallows. Stir until well coated and drop by teaspoon on waxed paper.

title: Honey Baked Chicken
directions: Place chicken, skin side down, in a baking dish., In a separate bowl, mix honey, mustard, lemon juice and salt., Spoon half of mixture over chicken., Cover and marinate overnight in refrigerator.

title: 7-Up Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients and congeal.

title: Oreo Cookie Cheesecake
directions: In a food processor, whirl 1/2 package of the cookies, including filling, until they form fine crumbs; mix in butter. Scoop crumbs into a 9-inch cheesecake pan with removable bottom and press crumbs evenly over bottom of pan and about 1/2-inch up sides. Chill crust to firm, about 20 minutes.

title: Macaroni And Cheese
directions: Boil macaroni in salted water 6 minutes. Drain and rinse well to remove starch., Set aside.

title: Blueberry Salad
directions: Dissolve jello	in, hot water.	Add pineapple and blueberries. Chill until firm.

title: Dee'S Strawberry Pudding Cake
directions: Crumble cake in baking pan., Put berries over cake., Let set in freezer while you mix pudding and milk., Pour mix over cake., Keep refrigerated until ready to serve., Top with Cool Whip.

title: Coconut Pecan Brownies
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Grease bottom only of 13 x 9-inch pan., In large bowl, combine brownie mix, water, oil and egg., Beat 50 strokes by hand., Add frosting and sour cream; mix well., Spread batter in greased pan., Sprinkle pecans and chocolate chips evenly over top., Bake at 350° for 42 to 52 minutes., Cool completely.

title: Snickerdoodles
directions: Combine caramels, 1/3 cup evaporated milk and 1/4 cup margarine in a double boiler until melted., Combine cake mix, 1/2 cup margarine, 1/3 cup evaporated milk and 1 cup walnuts., Spread half in a 9 x 13-inch pan and bake 6 minutes at 350°., Sprinkle with chocolate chips., Spread caramel mixture over the chips., Top with remaining cake mix., Bake 18 minutes at 350°., Do not bake longer!, Cut into bars.

title: Hot Maple Toddy
directions: In medium saucepan, combine all ingredients (except optional). Over low heat, simmer, uncovered, 10 minutes., Serve hot with butter and cinnamon sticks, if desired.

title: Poppy Seed Bread Or Muffins
directions: Beat all ingredients together in large mixing bowl for 2 minutes., Pour into 2 greased 9-inch loaf pans., Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes., Makes 15 slices per loaf., (Also, can use for muffins.), Contains less than 1 gram of fat per 1/2-inch slice.

title: Mauna Loa Muffins(Third Place Winner Of 1992 Mauna Loa Contest)
directions: Preheat oven to 400°., Spray muffin, tins, with cooking spray. In, large, bowl,	beat milk, oil and, egg., Blend, in remaining ingredients until flour is just, moistened., Fill in muffin cups 3/4 full;, sprinkle with sugar., Bake, until, tops are browned, for 15 to 18 minutes., Makes 10 to 12 muffins.

title: Eggless Spice Cake
directions: Sift all, ingredients., Place, in, bowl and add 1/2 cup melted shortening,, 2, cups water and 1 teaspoon vanilla., Mix well and bake, in, layers in a moderate oven for 30 minutes or until done.

title: Spicy Glazed Wieners
directions: Cut 3 thin gashes on each wiener., In medium saucepan over medium heat, cook remaining ingredients, stirring, until cranberry sauce melts and becomes smooth., Add wieners and heat through. Serve hot with cocktail picks., Makes 48 appetizers.

title: Chocolate Ice Cream (Frosty)
directions: Mix Eagle Brand milk and Cool Whip, then chocolate milk., Put into electric freezer., Makes 1 gallon.

title: Gumbo
directions: Get, a, large, pot, and, put, in the spareribs, beef and chicken, wings., Boil, spareribs, for, about 1/2 hour., Saute 1 pound, of boneless chuck beef and put in large pot., Saute pack of chicken, wings, and put in pot., Put in can of tomato puree and tomato, sauce., Add, diced, onions, salt, pepper, mustard, ketchup, sugar, Adobo seasoning and whole tomatoes., Simmer for 2 hours and then add 1 pound of deveined shrimp.

title: Creamy Baked Chicken
directions: Skin chicken breasts and arrange in baking dish., Place 1 piece of Swiss cheese in each piece of chicken., Stir together soup and wine or water., Spoon over chicken., Top with stuffing mix and drizzle melted butter over each piece of chicken., Bake, uncovered, for 55 minutes.

title: Green Bean Casserole
directions: In 1 1/2-quart casserole, combine soup, milk, soy sauce and pepper. Stir in beans and 1/2 can fried onions. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes. Stir, then top with remaining onions., Bake 5 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Watergate Salad
directions: *Save some nuts and cherries for top.

title: Fruit Dip
directions: Mix well and serve with fresh fruit.

title: Molded Lemon Dessert
directions: Make jello according to directions., When fairly thick, whip the milk., Add to jello (using large bowl)., Add sugar, lemon juice and vanilla., Put 1/2 of crumbs into a 9 x 13-inch pan., Add jello mixture., Put remainder of crumbs on top., Refrigerate overnight.

title: Pasta With Broccoli Di Rape And Sausage
directions: Remove the long stems and tough outer leaves from the Broccoli di Rape., Keep florets and small leaves, cut up, place in colander and wash several times., Pour oil into pan on medium heat., Lightly crush garlic, place in heated oil and allow to turn golden, then remove garlic if you wish., Remove casing from sausage, place meat in pan and cook thoroughly, breaking the pieces of meat apart as they continue to cook., If you still have not removed the garlic, do so now., Drain all but 1 tablespoon oil from pan; add Broccoli di Rape to pan and mix with cooked sausage., Keep mixing together, add your broth, mix and cook for approximately 5 minutes., Mix flour and butter together to form a roux and stir into your mixture., Cook approximately 5 minutes more until sauce thickens. Serve over pasta and add the grated Italian cheese of choice.

title: Sausage And Hamburger Casserole
directions: Brown hamburger and sausage. In a large casserole dish, slice potatoes and onion (in rings). Put cheese 1 cup on top of potatoes and onion. Layer browned meat on top of potatoes, onion and cheese. Then put a can of green beans, drained.

title: Bread Pudding
directions: Mix all ingredients., Put in baking dish., Bake until golden brown.

title: Three Layer Pie
directions: Combine ingredients and bake, in, a greased 9 x 13-inch pan for 30 minutes at 350°., Cool.

title: Million Dollar Cake
directions: Combine all ingredients., Bake at 300° for about 1 hour and 40 minutes.

title: Pineapple Whip Salad
directions: In large bowl, mix pineapple and sugar., In saucepan, bring water and gelatin to a boil., Pour over sugar and pineapple and stir., Refrigerate until slightly set., Add carrots, celery, cottage cheese, nuts, whipped topping and mayonnaise to pineapple mixture., Refrigerate until set.

title: Marinara Sauce
directions: Heat oil in a large saucepan over medium heat., Saute onion and green pepper until transparent., Add both cans of tomato, then remaining ingredients., Stir and simmer 30 minutes.

title: Healthy Sloppy Joes
directions: Brown sirloin with onion., Add other ingredients., Simmer 15 minutes or so., Serve open-faced on bread of choice.

title: Virgin Island Soup
directions: Simmer first 5 ingredients together 20 minutes., Add remaining ingredients., Simmer 30 more minutes.

title: Tortilla Pinwheels
directions: Drain chilies and olives., In mixing bowl, combine all ingredients except tortillas., Spread mixture onto tortillas and roll up jelly roll fashion., Cover with damp paper towel and plastic wrap to prevent drying out., Chill for several hours., To serve, slice tortillas into 1-inch segments., Serve with salsa for dipping.

title: Pie Crust
directions: Cut Crisco and flour together., Mix in salt., Gently mix in ice water with hands., Roll out for pie.

title: Florentine Lasagna Roll-Ups
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Cook lasagna noodles., Cool in large bowl of cold water; set aside., Saute onions in 2 tablespoons butter until tender.

title: Great Pheasant Or Partridge
directions: Do not thicken!, Pour over meat and bake for 2 hours on low. Serve with rice.

title: Coconut Pie
directions: Do not use electric mixer., Use hand wire whisk., Slightly beat egg yolks; stir in 1 cup milk., Then stir in remaining milk, sugar and coconut., Beat egg whites and stir in mixture., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until centers jell.

title: Shrimp And Cheese Strata
directions: Cut each slice of bread in half on the diagonal or cut into cubes., Dip in melted butter., Arrange half the bread slices or cubes in an unbuttered 8-inch baking dish., Sprinkle with half the cheese, onions, parsley and shrimp., Add remaining bread and repeat process., Beat eggs, salt, mustard, milk and sour cream together., Pour over casserole., Cover and chill overnight., Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes or until puffed and golden., Cut into squares and serve.

title: Apple Dumplings
directions: Combine sugar, water, cinnamon and nutmeg., Bring to a boil and add oleo., Sift together flour, baking powder and salt., Cut in shortening., Add milk, all at once., Stir until flour is moistened.

title: Green Beans Supreme
directions: Cook green beans; drain., Cook onion and parsley in butter until onion is tender., Blend in flour, lemon peel, 1/2 teaspoon salt and dash of pepper., Add milk, cook and stir until thickened and bubbly., Stir in sour cream and cooked beans; heat until just bubbly., Spoon into 1-quart casserole., Sprinkle with cheese., Melt the remaining butter; toss with bread crumbs and sprinkle over beans., Broil 4 to 5 inches from heat until cheese melts and crumbs brown, 1 to 2 minutes.

title: Corn Casserole
directions: Combine corn, eggs and salt., Alternate layers of corn mixture and crumbs in greased baking dish., Dot with butter on each layer. Pour in milk., Bake at 325° for 30 minutes., Serves 6 to 8.

title: Custard Pie
directions: Pour into pie plate (lined), then layer after mixing ingredients well together., Bake at 450° for 10 minutes to set the rim., Reduce heat to 325° and continue baking for thirty minutes or until custard is set., Sprinkle a little grated coconut on top when removed from the oven.

title: Rice-Broccoli Casserole
directions: Saute celery and onion in butter or margarine., Cook broccoli and drain., Mix all ingredients together and pour into greased 13 x 9-inch casserole dish., Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Nacho Dip
directions: Mix sauce and cream cheese, set aside., Put lettuce on platter and spread out., Spread cream cheese mix on top of lettuce., Layer tomatoes, peppers, onion and olives on top., Serve with nacho chips.

title: Italian Cream Cake
directions: Cream sugar and shortening; add egg yolks., Sift flour and soda together; add alternately with buttermilk., Add vanilla, coconut and chopped nuts., Fold in beaten egg whites., Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Cinnamon Chip Muffins
directions: Combine just until moistened., Spoon into muffin pan with liners., Bake at 400 degrees for 15-18 minutes or until done. Makes 12 muffins.

title: Aunt Minnie'S Eggs
directions: Cut bacon into small pieces (or crumble sausage into small pieces); fry., When meat is browned, add bell pepper and onion. Cook until onion starts to clear., Beat eggs with milk., Add egg mixture to meat and vegetables., Top with cheese and cover.

title: Monkey Bread
directions: Melt butter., Add sugar, nuts and cinnamon., Pour 1/2 of this over the biscuits., Do other 2 cans of biscuits same as first 2 cans., Pour remaining mixture over top.

title: Boston Brown Bread
directions: Put water and raisins in large pan; boil for 5 minutes (cool)., While still warm, add all other ingredients., Mix together well., Add nuts last., Grease cans fully to top., Half fill them., Bake, until well brown in 350° oven for 45 to 60 minutes., Cool for short time., While still warm, tip out of can on wax paper., (Use 3 or 4 No. 2 cans, vegetable or fruit.)

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients well except crumbs., Bake at 350° until bubbly.

title: Applesauce Cookies
directions: Cream butter and sugar together until mixture is light and fluffy., Add egg, raisins, nuts and applesauce and mix together thoroughly., Sift all the dry ingredients together 3 times., Add to the creamed mixture and blend thoroughly., Drop by spoonfuls on greased cookie sheet., Bake in moderate oven for 15 minutes.

title: Strawberry Bread
directions: Sift dry ingredients together in large mixing bowl; add pecans and mix., Make a well in the center., Mix the remaining ingredients., Pour into well., Stir enough to dampen all ingredients and then pour into two greased loaf pans., Bake in 350° oven for 1 hour.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
directions: In a bowl mix all ingredients together except the crumbs or chips and put into refrigerator for 8 to 24 hours before serving time., In a baking dish, a 1 1/2-quart greased casserole, put ingredients and top with crumbled chips or bread crumbs., Bake at 350° uncovered.

title: Carrot Casserole
directions: Mix carrots, onion, celery, sour cream and cheese., Pour into 1-quart baking dish., Melt oleo; add 1/2 cup cheese and Pepperidge Farm dressing., Mix and sprinkle over carrot mixture., Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes., Cover with foil, if topping is getting too brown.

title: Blond Brownies
directions: Cream butter and brown sugar., Add beaten egg and then dry ingredients., Add nuts and chocolate bits last., Bake in a square pan, 8 x 8-inch., Bake 25 minutes at 350°.

title: Lo-Cal Lemon Cheesecake Pie
directions: Preheat oven to 350°. In medium saucepan, melt margarine; remove from heat. Stir in graham cracker crumbs. Press in bottom and up sides of 9-inch pie pan. Bake for 4 to 5 minutes or until crust is lightly browned. Chill.

title: South Of The Border Salad
directions: Cook meats, onion and garlic until meat is browned and onion tender., Stir in flour, tomato sauce, undrained tomatoes, chilies and chili powder., Cook and stir until thickened.

title: Crockpot Chicken And Mushrooms
directions: Mix salt, pepper & paprika. Rub into surface of chicken, using it all. Place chicken in crockpot. Alternate layers of chicken, bouillion granules, mushrooms and onions. Pour chicken soup mixture over chicken. Do not stir. Cover & cook on high for 2 1/2 to 3 hours or on low 5-6 hours until chicken is tender.

title: Chicken Spaghetti
directions: Cook chicken until tender; remove from bones and cut into bite size pieces., Save broth., Fry bacon until crisp., Break into small pieces., Saute onions and celery in bacon fat., Add tomatoes, soup, drained olives, chicken and bacon., Cook spaghetti in broth and add to chicken mixture., Salt and pepper to taste; mix well., Cover with grated cheese., May use two 9 x 9-inch casseroles or one 3-quart casserole., Bake at 350° for 35 minutes or until thoroughly heated.

title: Cookie Cups
directions: You will need one 12-cup muffin tin.

title: Crawfish Stew
directions: Melt butter in a large heavy pot (iron preferred)., Blend flour and stir over medium-low heat until roux is dark brown., Add onions, celery and jalapeno pepper; cook until tender and crisp. Stir in water, tomatoes, crawfish and seasonings. Simmer over medium heat 15 minutes., Add okra, pepper and parsley., Simmer until tender-crisp, about 10 minutes., Stir in file powder., Ladle stew into soup bowls., Top each serving with 1/2 cup fluffy rice. Makes 6 servings.

title: Microwave Peanut Brittle
directions: Stir together syrup and sugar in a deep microwave-safe bowl. Cook 4 minutes on High., Stir in nuts., Cook 3 3/4 minutes on High., Add margarine and vanilla; stir., Cook 1 1/2 minutes., Add soda., Stir until light and foamy., Pour on lightly greased cookie sheet., Do not spread., Let cool., Break into pieces.

title: Fudge Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Boil until soft ball stage the cocoa, sugar, butter and milk. Remove from heat., Immediately stir in the vanilla, oats and nuts. Drop on waxed paper by spoonfuls; ready to eat when cool (about 15 minutes).

title: The Best Snickerdoodles
directions: Preheat oven to 400°., Mix together thoroughly the shortening, sugar and eggs., Sift together the next 4 ingredients and stir into creamed mixture., Chill dough.

title: "Excellent" Crock-Pot Mincemeat
directions: Mix together in crock-pot. Start out on high; then once simmering, turn to low for 5 to 6 hours.

title: Denise'S Prize Winning Chili
directions: Brown hamburg and onions., Add salt and pepper to taste., In a large pot, add hamburg mixture and all the other ingredients, except the kidney beans, and cook over low heat., Cook, uncovered, stirring occasionally for 3 to 4 hours.

title: Roasted Pecans
directions: Melt butter in, large, skillet., Add remaining ingredients, then pecans., Stir well., Arrange in a single layer on a baking sheet., Bake at 325° for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally until they are golden, brown., Remove, and drain on paper towels.

title: Peanut Butter Eggs
directions: Mix first 3 ingredients well, then add sugar., Shape into eggs or balls., Can be eaten plain or dip into melted chocolate.

title: Apple Nut Squares
directions: Combine eggs, sugar, oil and vanilla., Sift dry ingredients. Then add to egg mixture and mix well., Fold in apples and nuts. Bake at 325° for 1 hour in a slightly greased 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Squash Casserole
directions: Cook squash and onion in small amount of water. Drain and mash., Fold in butter, eggs, soup, salt and pepper., Place in buttered casserole dish and top with cracker crumbs and Parmesan cheese., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Teddy Bear Popcorn
directions: Prepare popcorn as package directs., In large bowl, combine cinnamon-sugar, cocoa and salt., Stir in popcorn, tossing to coat well., Stir in graham snacks and M&M's., Makes 11 cups.

title: Pasta Salad
directions: Mix prepared pasta and vegetables in a large bowl., Add dressing., Mix lightly., Refrigerate several hours., Stir and serve.

title: Pudding Cookies
directions: Mix all ingredients together and form into small balls. Flatten with hand on ungreased cookie sheets., Bake at 350° for 8 minutes., Makes 3 dozen.

title: Velveeta Fudge
directions: Melt together Velveeta cheese and oleo., Add cocoa, powdered sugar, cheese, oleo, vanilla and chopped nuts., Work together and spread on cookie sheet., Place in refrigerator to set up., Keep in cool place.

title: Squash Casserole #2
directions: Melt, butter, and mix in stuffing., Line part of casserole dish, with part of stuffing., Spoon in other ingredients (mixed together).	Cover with remainder of stuffing., Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

title: Apricot Nectar Cake
directions: Mix cake mix and Jell-O dry., Add remaining ingredients., Bake in greased 9 x 13-inch pan at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Alice'S No Bake Cookies
directions: Bring first 4 ingredients to rolling boil., Mix remaining ingredients., Pour boiled mixture over oatmeal mixture., Stir and drop by teaspoonfuls onto waxed paper., Let cool completely.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Bake at 400° for 30 minutes.

title: Chocolate Chip Pan Cookie
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., In large bowl mix margarine, sugars, vanilla and eggs with mixer., Gradually add flour until well blended., Stir in chips and nuts., Spread in greased 15 x 10 x 1-inch pan., Bake at 375° for 40 minutes., (Check after 30 minutes.), Cool, then cut into squares.

title: Banana Muffins
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., Mix all ingredients except flour. Gradually add flour, stirring lightly., Pour into muffin cup inserts in muffin pans., Bake 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown., Yield: 2 dozen muffins.

title: Scalloped Potatoes With Cheddar Cheese
directions: Empty soup into 2-quart casserole., Stir in milk gradually. Stir in remaining ingredients., Cover tightly and microwave on High 20 to 35 minutes, stirring every 10 minutes, until tender. Let stand covered for 5 minutes.

title: Scones(Recipe From Ireland, 100 Years Old)
directions: Mix all ingredients together with pastry blender., Drop by big spoon onto greased cookie sheet., Bake 20 minutes at 400°., Makes 6 to 8 scones., Serve warm with jam, jelly or honey., Quick, easy and good., They freeze well., Heat in microwave a few seconds.

title: Rice And Beef Porcupines
directions: Combine all ingredients, form into small balls., Brown lightly in oil., Drain off excess., Add tomato sauce and water., Cover tightly., Simmer for 45 to 50 minutes, until rice is done.

title: Bob'S Creamy Peanut Butter Fudge
directions: Combine sugar,, condensed milk and water., Stir over medium heat until sugar dissolves and mixture boils., Cook to 330° until soft ball forms in cold water.

title: Miniature Cheesecake(Makes 4 Dozen)
directions: Drop into inner circle of cooled cakes and bake 5 minutes only at 400°.

title: Seafood Pasta Salad
directions: Combine Miracle Whip, Italian dressing and cheese. Mix well. Add remaining ingredients. Mix lightly. Serve chilled.

title: Hacienda Hamburger
directions: Brown meat in oil in electric skillet or large frying pan. Add celery and onion; cover and cook slowly 10 minutes., Add tomato paste, water, noodles, cheese, olives, salt and pepper; stir to combine., Cook slowly until noodles are tender, about 30 minutes.

title: Stuffed Peppers
directions: Boil peppers until tender (firm, but tender), then drain. Brown hamburger, seasoned with chili and set aside., Saute onion and bread chunks in a small amount of leftover hamburger drippings., Add stewed tomatoes and hamburger, mixing thoroughly. Fill peppers with mixture., Nice served with jello on the side with a vegetable.

title: Bourbon N' Steak Barbecue
directions: Mix bourbon and soy sauce in flat roasting pan, preferably steel., Marinate steak for at least 5 hours, more if you have time., Barbecue as usual, seasoning steak as desired while cooking., Sauce may be stored in refrigerator and used again. Double ingredients if necessary as meat should almost be covered while marinating.

title: Chicken Wreath
directions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Mix all ingredients except crescent rolls. Arrange crescent rolls in a circle with the bases overlapping in the middle and the pointed ends outward. Put the mixture in the base part and fold the points inward. Bake about 25 to 30 minutes or until golden brown. You can substitute boiled, cut up chicken and slivered almonds for canned chicken and water chestnuts.

title: Chicken And Rice Casserole
directions: Mix together first 5 ingredients and put in buttered dish. Salt and pepper one side of chicken and put seasoning salt on the other side., Stand breast up in dish over rice and soup., Melt 1 stick of butter and pour over top of chicken., Bake for 2 hours at 275°.

title: Cauliflower Cheese Soup
directions: Combine first 4 ingredients in large saucepan., Bring to a boil., Simmer on reduce heat for 20 minutes or until tender., Melt butter in small pan., Add flour, salt and pepper; blend., Add milk, stirring until mixture boils., Add cheese and cook until cheese melts., Stir cheese sauce into vegetable mixture., Makes 1 1/2 quarts.

title: Rich Loaf Bread
directions: Sift flour before measuring., Scald milk., Add sugar, salt and shortening., Cool to lukewarm., Add yeast and beaten eggs., Add half of the flour and beat 3 minutes., Add rest of flour, half a cup at a time, and stir after each addition., Knead., Shape., Allow to rise until light and bake.

title: Wild Rice And Mushrooms
directions: Saute onion slowly in butter., Smooth in flour and brown., Add bouillon cube dissolved in boiling water and juice from can of mushrooms., Let simmer for about 5 minutes., Stir in mushrooms and cook until heated through., Serve over wild rice., Makes 4 servings.

title: Spinach Balls
directions: Cook spinach according to package., Drain well., Combine ingredients and mix., Shape into 3/4 inch balls., Place on lightly greased cookie sheet., Bake at 325° for 15 to 20 minutes., Yields: 11 dozen., Can be frozen before baked., Thaw slightly and bake for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Seven Minute Icing
directions: Put all ingredients, except vanilla, in top of boiler., Stir until well mixed., Place over simmering, but not boiling, water. Cook, beating constantly with electric mixer at high speed, for about 7 minutes, or until icing becomes stiff and glossy., Remove from heat and add vanilla., Stir until blended.

title: Chili Con Carne
directions: Heat oil in a 10-inch skillet., Add onion, green pepper and beef., Cook until brown, stirring occasionally., Add the next 6 ingredients., Cover and simmer about 1 hour, stirring occasionally., Add more water if mixture gets too thick., Combine garlic and salt, then add with kidney beans to the meat mixture and heat through., Yields 6 servings.

title: Chicken Wings
directions: Combine ketchup, soy sauce and brown sugar., Add chicken wings and mix well., Put in bowl and cover., Refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350° for about 1/2 hour., Lower to 325° and bake for 45 minutes.

title: Pumpkin Apple Muffins
directions: Combine first 5 ingredients and set aside., Mix eggs, pumpkin and oil., Stir into dry ingredients to moisten., Stir in apples and other fruit., Fill muffin pans 3/4 full., Grease pans or use paper holders., Sprinkle topping on each muffin., Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Easy Orange Balls(Unbaked)
directions: Crush vanilla wafers to fine crumbs., Add powdered sugar, butter, orange juice and nuts., Mix well with hands., Form into balls., Chill., Store in refrigerator., If desired, roll in coconut immediately after shaping.

title: Enchilada Pie
directions: Brown meat and onion in skillet. Drain off fat. Mix together soups, enchilada sauce and chilies. Add drained meat to this mixture. Grate and mix together Velveeta and Cheddar. In a deep casserole (9 x 12), alternate layers of 4 to 6 corn tortillas, 1/2 meat, mixture and 1/2 grated cheese. Repeat layers. Bake at 325° for 30 minutes or until cheese is melted. Serves about 8.

title: Apple Cake
directions: Put over batter; then put rest of batter on top of apple mixture., Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Ham And Pasta Salad
directions: Gently	toss ingredients together., Cover and refrigerate for at least 6 hours.

title: Chocolate Fudge Upside-Down Cake
directions: Cream 3/4 cup sugar with 2 tablespoons butter., Stir in milk. Sift flour, 2 tablespoons cocoa, baking powder and salt together. Add sifted ingredients to the creamed mixture and mix until smooth., Add chopped walnuts and spread in a buttered 9-inch pan. Mix well 1/2 cup sugar, brown sugar and 1/4 cup cocoa., Sprinkle over the batter., Pour boiling water over the top and bake in 350° oven for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Easy Spinach Casserole
directions: In a microwave oven, cook spinach (without water) covered for about 6 to 8 minutes, until spinach is hot., Remove from oven and drain well., Mix together sour cream and salad dressing mix and then stir into the spinach., Pour into greased casserole dish. Sprinkle Parmesan cheese and paprika on top., Return to microwave for 3 to 4 minutes or may be baked in a regular oven for 25 to 30 minutes at 325°., (I prefer the regular oven.)

title: Grandma'S Doughnuts
directions: Cream sugar with shortening., Add eggs, unbeaten., Add vanilla. Add sifted dry ingredients alternating with milk to which baking soda has been added., Roll on floured board., Cut and fry in hot, deep fat.

title: Open-Face Apple Pie
directions: Mix well., Place, into uncooked pie shell., Cook for 15 minutes on 325°., Turn oven to 350° and cook 30 minutes more.

title: Green Bean Casserole
directions: Combine all ingredients and mix well., Cook at 350° for 20 minutes.

title: Fluffy Banana Pudding
directions: Pour milk into blender., Add pudding mix., Blend in blender 1 to 2 minutes., Refrigerate 1 hour., Gently stir in whipped topping. Place wafers in bottom and sides of Pyrex dish., Put in pudding mixture., Add bananas and more vanilla wafers., Repeat in layers until reaches top., Last layer is cream mixture., Place in refrigerator until time to serve.

title: Quick And Easy Homemade Biscuits
directions: Combine all ingredients, form, a, ball	and knead until smooth., Pat out dough and cut out biscuits., Bake at 425° for 10 to 12 minutes or until, golden brown., Makes about 10 large biscuits or more smaller ones.

title: Pineapple Cookies
directions: Mix shortening, sugar, and, egg, well (will look sour). Blend flour, soda,, salt and nutmeg., Mix all together., Chill 1 hour or longer., Drop, by, rounded teaspoon approximately 2 inches apart on, lightly, greased, baking sheet., Bake 8 to 10 minutes at 400°. Makes approximately 5 dozen.

title: Hot Cheese Dip
directions: In a saucepan cook onion, garlic, and tarragon in margarine. Stir in cornstarch., Add milk all at once., Cook and stir till thickened and bubbly., Gradually add cheeses, stirring till melted., Serve with bread or chips., Makes 2 cups.

title: Strawberry Fluff
directions: Fix jello with hot water as instructed., Instead of cold water, use 1 pound frozen strawberries., Mix well., Then add 3/4 of Cool Whip and mix until firm; may need to put in freezer for a few minutes., When firm, take angel food and break into small pieces and work into jello mix., Take extra Cool Whip and cover top; also on top, cut fresh strawberries and mix a design on top.

title: Blueberry Pie
directions: Combine blueberries, sugar, cornstarch and water in saucepan and cook over medium heat, stirring until thick. Cool.

title: Pineapple Burgers
directions: Set oven at broil and/or 550°., Shape meat into 8 thin patties; sprinkle with salt., Place pineapple slice on each of 4 patties. Top with remaining patties and press edges together to seal., Place patties on rack in broiler pan., Broil with tops 4-inches from heat until brown, 3 to 5 minutes., Mix brown sugar, ketchup and mustard. Turn patties., Spoon mixture on patties and broil until desired doneness, 3 to 5 minutes., Makes 4 servings.

title: Curried Fruit
directions: The day before serving, drain and dry fruits on paper towels. Arrange fruit on shallow "bake and serve" dish., Sprinkle with brown sugar., Melt butter and add curry powder., Pour over fruit. Bake 1 hour at 325°., Refrigerate and reheat until bubbly hot when ready to serve., Cooking the casserole one day early allows curry flavor to penetrate fruits for best flavor., Serves 12.

title: Syrup Tea Cakes
directions: Roll 1/4 inch thick., Cut into whatever shape you choose. Place on greased cookie sheet and bake at 375° for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Sip And Cheer
directions: In a 2-quart non-metal container, combine bourbon, lemonade, beer and lemon juice., Refrigerate., Serve over ice and garnish with mint leaves and lemon slices, if desired., Makes 8 (1/2-cup) servings.

title: Cheesy Omelets
directions: Preheat skillet., Mix eggs, milk, salt and pepper., Pour mixture into skillet., When eggs are done, turn burner to simmer. Break cheese into 4ths and place on eggs., Serve after cheese melts.

title: Sloppy Tom
directions: In a large skillet that has been sprayed with Pam, cook turkey until brown., Combine all other ingredients and add to turkey. Simmer on low heat for 15 minutes.

title: Company Salad
directions: Mix Jell-O and hot water; cool., When partially set, add pineapple, marshmallows and bananas., Chill to set in a 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Cheesy Hash Brown Bake
directions: Mix all together and put into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan., Let stand overnight or a few hours to blend flavors., Bake in a preheated oven at 350° for 1 1/2 to 2 hours or until golden brown on top., Makes 12 servings.

title: Pound Cake
directions: Cream the butter., Add Crisco, milk and eggs; blend., Add flour, salt, baking powder and sugar; beat well with mixer 2 to 3 minutes., Pour into well-greased and floured cake pan., Bake at 325° for 1 hour, then at 275° for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Pasta Supreme
directions: Cook pasta as directed and cool., Chop up vegetables, any size you please., Mix pasta, vegetables, Italian dressing and Salad Supreme (1/2 to 3/4 jar) to taste.

title: Sour Milk Cookies
directions: Mix together and bake., Cookies are very good and moist.

title: Fruit Salad
directions: Mix and set in refrigerate or 3 hours or overnight.

title: Golden Smoothies
directions: Place the first four ingredients in a blender; cover and process until smooth., Pour into glasses; garnish with orange and cherries if desired.

title: Sausage Quiche
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., Fully cook sausage and drain well., Mix sausage, onions, cheese and flour., Beat eggs and milk; pour over the sausage mixture., Mix all well and pour into pie shell., Bake 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Squash Casserole
directions: Mix ingredients., Sprinkle cheese on top., Add cracker crumbs or bread crumbs on top of cheese., Bake at 400° until brown.

title: Mallow Fudge Squares
directions: Boil sugar, milk, oleo and chocolate to soft ball stage., Beat while cooling., Mix together marshmallows, graham crackers, nuts and vanilla., Add this to the chocolate mixture., Pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake 10 minutes at 350°., Check with toothpick.

title: Happiness Cookies(By:  Luerle Ruff)
directions: Mix thoroughly., Add tears of joy, sorrow and sympathy. Flavor with love and kindly service., Fold in 4 cups of prayer and faith., Blend well., Fold into daily life., Bake well in a warmth of human kindness, and serve with a smile anytime., It will satisfy the hunger of starved souls.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Mix broccoli, cheese and 1/4 cup butter together and place in a 2-quart casserole dish., Mix crackers and 1/4 cup butter, melted together, and sprinkle on broccoli mixture., Bake for 20 to 25 minutes at 350°., Serves 4 to 6.

title: Seven Layer Salad
directions: Layer the first 5 ingredients in order given., Top with mayonnaise, bacon and cheese., Garnish with tomato wedges and cucumber slices. Refrigerate at least 6 hours before serving.

title: Meat Loaf
directions: Mix all together and form a loaf., Place in pan and bake at 350° for 90 minutes.

title: Clam Dip
directions: Rub a mixing bowl with the garlic clove which has been cut in half., (I use garlic salt to taste instead of fresh garlic.) Place the cream cheese in a bowl and cream with a spoon until smooth and gradually add the remaining ingredients, blending well.

title: Chili For Charlie
directions: Brown beef in oil., Add onion and pepper., Saute until onion is transparent., Add remaining ingredients., Cover pan and bring to a quick boil., Lower heat and simmer slowly for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally., Freezes well.

title: Strawberry Pizza
directions: Arrange strawberries, cut in half on top of cream mixture. Top with glaze., Garnish with whipped cream, if desired.

title: Cheesy Mashed Potatoes
directions: Add water to unpeeled potatoes just to cover., Sprinkle with salt., Bring to boiling for 30 to 35 minutes., Drain., Peel and shred potatoes with a grater., In a large mixing bowl combine potatoes, cheese and butter; stir until butter is melted., Stir in sour cream, green onion, salt and the pepper., Transfer to a greased pan., Bake, uncovered, in a 325° oven for 45 minutes. Sprinkle with paprika., Makes 8 servings.

title: Tuna Salad
directions: Mix the first 6 ingredients together., Just before serving add the can of onions and stir.

title: Broccoli Chicken Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients together (except fried onions)., Place in 9 x 13-inch pan, which has been sprayed with Pam., Bake for 60 minutes, covered., Uncover and sprinkle with fried onions., Bake for additional 15 minutes.

title: Joy'S Salmon Spread
directions: Combine the cream cheese, lemon juice, horseradish and seasonings in bowl; mix well., Add salmon; mix well., Chill in refrigerator overnight.

title: Grandma'S Peach Crisp
directions: Arrange peaches in an 8 x 8-inch pan., In a small bowl, combine oats, sugar, flour and spices. Cut in butter until coarse crumbs form. Sprinkle over peaches. Bake at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes. Serve warm with cream or ice cream.

title: Southwest Stew
directions: Brown meat and onions. Add rest of ingredients. Bring to boil. Simmer 20 minutes., (May include 3 to 4 quartered potatoes.)

title: Quick Mexican Venison
directions: Brown venison; drain any grease., In a large stew pot, add all ingredients and bring to a boil., Reduce temperature to a simmer. Simmer for 30 minutes., Season to taste with garlic salt and black pepper.

title: Cherry Nut Icing For Banana Nut Cake
directions: Cook, the, sugar,, milk and Karo until soft ball stage. Add dates, cherries, pecans, butter and vanilla.

title: Sour Cream Raisin Pie
directions: Soak raisins in hot water for 10 minutes; drain., Mix the flour with sugar., Add beaten egg yolks., Cream together and add cream and raisins., Cook over low heat, stirring until thick. Cool and add vanilla., Pour into baked pie shell., Make meringue from egg whites and bake until nicely browned.

title: Rich Waffles
directions: Mix dry ingredients in mixer bowl., Add buttermilk, margarine and eggs., Mix well and beat at medium speed for 2 to 3 minutes. Bake in heated waffle iron.

title: Beef-And-Tater-Tot Casserole
directions: Brown beef and onions; dip off excess grease. Add soups and cook to bubble stage. Pour into greased casserole dish. Put Tater Tots on top. Bake at 375° for 45 minutes or until Tater Tots are brown.

title: Hot Fudge Pudding Cake
directions: Mix Bisquick, 1/2 cup sugar and 3 tablespoons cocoa in a greased 8-inch square baking dish., Stir in milk and vanilla until well blended., Sprinkle evenly with remaining 1/3 cup cocoa and 1/2 cup sugar., Pour water on top., Bake in a 350° oven for 40 minutes or until top is firm., Serve at once, topped with ice cream.

title: Cloud Biscuits
directions: Sift dry ingredients together., Cut in Crisco like coarse crumbs., Combine egg and milk., Add to flour mixture., Turn out on lightly floured board., Knead gently with heel of hand 20 strokes. Roll to 3/4-inch thickness., Cut and place on ungreased baking sheet., Bake in a 425° oven for 10 to 14 minutes or until light brown., Makes 2 dozen.

title: Hot Spiced Apple Cider
directions: Combine the ingredients in a large pot., Heat and simmer for 30 minutes., Be careful not to let mixture boil or the cider will become to heavily spiced., Pour into mugs and serve with cheese or popcorn.

title: Mike'S Pork Chop Casserole
directions: Brown pork in oil and set aside., Saute celery and onion in pork juices until limp.

title: Party Meatballs
directions: In a bowl, mix hamburger with onion soup mix., Form into meatballs and fry until done., While frying meatballs, put chili sauce and grape jelly in crock-pot with 1 onion and let cook. When meatballs are done, place in crock-pot and serve., Great for parties!

title: Spicy Zucchini Bars
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Grease 13 x 9 x 2-inch rectangular pan. Mix brown sugar, margarine, eggs and vanilla in large bowl., Stir in flour, baking soda, cinnamon, nutmeg and cloves., Stir in zucchini and raisins., Spread in pan., Bake 25 to 35 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean; cool., Frost with Cream Cheese Frosting., Cut into 2 x 1 1/2-inch bars. Refrigerate any remaining bars., Makes 32 bars.

title: Fortune Cookies
directions: In a bowl mix flour, sugar, cornstarch and salt., Add cooking oil and add white; stir until smooth., Add water and mix well. Make one cookie at a time., Pour 1 tablespoon of the batter on a greased skillet., Spread into a circle., Cook 4 minutes on one side and 1 minute on the other at low temperature., Working quickly, put a message in the cookie., Fold in half and in half again.

title: Snickerdoodles
directions: Cream sugar, margarine and eggs., Mix flour, powdered sugar and salt., Then mix slowly together., Roll into balls (size of walnuts)., Roll in mixture of sugar and cinnamon., Place 2 1/2-inches apart on ungreased sheet., Bake at 400° for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Baked Beans
directions: Mix all together and bake at 350° for 45 minutes., Add 1/2 cup water to beans and top with bacon strips before cooking.

title: Southwestern Gratin Eggs
directions: On the day before:, Drain yogurt through cheesecloth and refrigerate., Chop peppers and onions and refrigerate., Grate cheese and refrigerate., Use 9 x 13-inch casserole., Spray with Pam., Spread chopped bell peppers, onions and grated jalapeno cheese., In separate bowl, beat eggs, yogurt, milk, salt and pepper., Pour over peppers, onions and cheese mixture., Sprinkle the one cup grated Cheddar cheese over entire casserole., Bake at 350° for 40 minutes., Let cool ten minutes before serving. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Vienna Torte
directions: Beat egg yolks until lemon colored., Add sugar; beat well. Add flour, salt and vanilla., Beat egg whites until frothy., Add cream of tartar and beat until very stiff., Add egg yolk mixture to whites, folding carefully., Pour into large ungreased angel food pan., Bake 1 hour at 300°.

title: Kim'S Ham And Hash Brown Omelet
directions: Cook bacon until crisp; crumble., Cook ham; crumble., Add potatoes, onion and pepper to skillet and cook until brown and crisp., Blend eggs and milk; pour over potatoes., Top with cheese, bacon and ham., Cover and cook at low temperature for 10 minutes. Serve in 4 wedges.

title: Taco Pie
directions: Preheat oven to 400°., Grease dish., Brown together the beef and onion., Drain off grease., Stir in taco seasoning mix., Spread meat mixture in greased dish.

title: Jack Straws (Candy)
directions: Melt chocolate in double boiler., Add the remaining ingredients and mix very well., Drop by teaspoon on waxed paper. Allow to air dry., Store in an airtight container.

title: Reese Cookies
directions: Mix all top 4 ingredients together real good. Make into small balls and press 1 Kiss in each., Place on lightly greased cookie sheet., Bake 5 minutes in a 350° oven., Yields 3 dozen.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Fix 1 large or 2 small boxes of stuffing mix., Fix according to directions, but use a little less water so it's on the dry side. Boil and chunk up chicken (2 cups or so)., Mix with mayonnaise and a little salt., Layer 1/2 of dressing mix in 9 x 13-inch pan, spread chicken over it., Then put rest of dressing over this., Mix eggs plus 1 cup milk together, pour over top., Cover and refrigerate overnight., Set out 1 hour before baking., Mix cream of chicken soup with 1/2 cup milk, pour over top., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Enchiladas
directions: Brown ground meat; drain., Heat tortillas until soft, if you want to roll enchiladas., The fast way is to layer in a greased casserole dish, tortillas, meat, onions and cheese until used up. Finish with tortillas., Mix and heat remaining ingredients., Pour over casserole., Bake at 350° for about 30 minutes.

title: Apple Crisp
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., Grease an 8 x 8 x 2-inch baking pan. Arrange apples in pan., Mix remaining ingredients with fork. Sprinkle over apples., Bake until apples are tender and topping is golden brown., Serve with cream, Dream Whip or ice cream.

title: Beef Burgundy
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Combine first five ingredients in a Dutch oven or covered baking dish and bake 1 1/2 hours., Serve over cooked noodles.

title: Baked Beans
directions: Mix all together, adding enough ketchup to color., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Grandma'S Individual Ham Loaves
directions: Mix ground beef, ham, eggs, milk, mustard and corn flakes. Grease muffin tins and sprinkle brown sugar over bottom of muffin cups., Spread pineapple over brown sugar., Shape meat mixture into balls and place in muffin cups., This is great for entertaining. (This can be made in 10 x 15-inch pan.) Bake at 350° for 1 to 1 1/2 hours., Makes 15 individual loaves.

title: Baked Chicken
directions: Place rice on bottom of oblong pan., Arrange chicken parts on top of rice. Sprinkle onion soup mix over chicken., Spread mushroom soup over the soup mix., Pour in water and bake, covered, for 1 hour at 350°., Uncover and bake another 30 minutes.

title: Enchilada Casserole
directions: Crush Doritos and place in bottom of greased casserole. Prepare beef according to taco seasoning directions; place taco meat over crushed Doritos; combine soups and pour over meat., Top with cheese., Bake at 350° until bubbly.

title: Cauliflower Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients well and serve.

title: Corn Pudding
directions: Blend butter, sugar, flour and salt., Add eggs; beat well. Stir in corn and bake for 1 hour in 325° oven in a greased casserole dish.

title: Sauerkraut Relish
directions: Blend all ingredients together and refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Snicker Cake
directions: Mix cake mix according to directions on box., Pour half of batter into greased pan (no flour)., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

title: Caramel Corn
directions: Microwave last 3 ingredients until butter melts and then stir and put back in bowl for 2 minutes., Take out and add 1/2 teaspoon soda; stir.

title: Spinach Bread
directions: Cook spinach 7 minutes. Saute onions in butter and add cheese. Combine spinach with cheese mixture. Spread on French bread. Bake 5 to 10 minutes at 350°.

title: Beef Stroganoff
directions: Brown meat., Add salt, mustard, butter, onion, pepper and one cup of water., Pressure cook 10 to 12 minutes., Make thickening of 2 tablespoons of flour and water., Stir into cooked meat., Add mushrooms, simmer until thickened., Add sour cream., Serve over noodles or rice.

title: Mexican Dip
directions: Microwave Velveeta until smooth., Add the browned drained beef., Add tomatoes, drained., Keep warm and serve as dip with corn chips.

title: Summer Squash Casserole
directions: In saucepan, cook sliced squash and chopped onion in boiling salted water for 5 minutes., Drain., Combine soup and sour cream. Stir in shredded carrots., Fold in drained squash and onion. Combine stuffing mix and butter or margarine., Spread half of stuffing mixture in bottom of 12 x 7 1/2 x 2-inch baking dish. Spoon vegetable mixture atop., Sprinkle remaining stuffing over vegetables., Bake in 350° oven for 25 to 30 minutes or until heated through., Makes 6 servings.

title: Louisiana Whiskey Balls
directions: Crush vanilla wafers., Add the remaining ingredients., Mix well and form into balls., Roll in additional powdered sugar. Makes about 2 dozen small balls.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
directions: Combine all ingredients., Dice in apples and add nuts., Bake at 325° for 1 hour in Bundt pan or two 8 x 8-inch pans.

title: Five Cup Salad
directions: Mix together all ingredients and refrigerate.

title: Hickory Nut Cookies
directions: Cream butter and sugar in large mixing bowl until light., Add egg, mixing well., Stir in flour until well combined., Add remaining ingredients; mix well., Shape dough into 2 long rolls; wrap each roll in waxed paper., Chill several hours., Slice rolls into 1/4-inch slices and place on cookie sheet., Bake at 375° for 7 to 8 minutes.

title: Carrot Cake
directions: Cream sugar and oil., Beat eggs and add to sugar/oil with flour, salt, soda and cinnamon., Stir in carrots and nuts., Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan, at 300° for 45 minutes or in layer pans at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: French Onion Soup
directions: Melt butter in a 4-quart Dutch oven., Slowly cook onions in butter until lightly browned., Add bouillon cubes and water to onions., Cover and simmer 2 hours, stirring occasionally., Add Worcestershire sauce, salt and pepper to soup; stir., When serving soup, place a thin slice of French bread into the bottom of the bowl (must be able to go into the oven)., Ladle soup into bowls; top with layer of shredded cheese., Place under broiler until cheese melts., Serve at once.

title: Tuna Dip
directions: Set cream cheese out to get room temperature., Drain excess oil/water off tuna., Mix tuna and cream cheese together with a fork until tuna is blended well., Can be eaten chilled or as is. Great on crackers.

title: Corn Chowder
directions: Saute onion and celery in 1 stick oleo., Add water, potatoes, salt and pepper., Cook until tender., Add corn, soups and milk. Garnish with parsley., Do not dilute soups.

title: Bread And Butter Pickles
directions: Wash cucumbers and slice as thin as possible., Chop onions and peppers; combine with cucumbers and salt., Let stand 3 hours and drain., Combine vinegar, sugar and spices in a large preserving kettle; bring to a boil., Add drained cucumbers; heat thoroughly but do not boil., Pack while hot into sterilized jars and seal at once.

title: Beef Stew(18 Quarts)
directions: Put just enough oil in pan to brown meat., Add other ingredients and cook on medium heat until vegetables are done.

title: Country Style Omelette
directions: In large skillet, saute sausage until done; add onion and butter until soft. Add potatoes; saute until lightly browned. Beat eggs, salt, pepper and water; pour over sausage-potato mixture. Cook until eggs are set. Turn with spatula. Cook other side. Serves 4.

title: Mexican Chicken Wings
directions: Combine ingredients (first seven) and rub on chicken wings. Let stand for 15 minutes., Saute wings in oil and butter until lightly browned., Drain excess fat., Add garlic, jalapeno and beer and simmer until liquid has turned to a glaze.

title: Meat Loaf
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Bake in greased pan at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Frank'S Sausage And Peppers
directions: Remove stems and seeds from green peppers and cut into chunks. In ovenproof dish, saute green peppers in olive oil until soft (on top of stove)., Sprinkle with a little salt., Remove green peppers from dish; brown sausage in same dish., Add red wine and cover; bake for 40 minutes at 350°., Uncover, add sauteed green pepper and bake 30 more minutes., Serve in same dish.

title: Easy Pralines
directions: Mix the sugar, milk, butter and soda in saucepan., Cook to soft ball stage. The soda turns the sugar to caramel taste and color as it cooks., Remove from stove., Cool a few minutes. Add vanilla, then beat., Before mixture begins to stiffen, add nuts and spoon onto wax paper.

title: No Cook Peanut Butter Cups
directions: Melt margarine; add graham cracker crumbs, peanut butter and confectioners sugar., Mix and spread on greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Melt chocolate chips and spread on top of mixture., Set in refrigerator., Cut into squares when set.

title: Low Cholesterol Zesty Sausage Casserole
directions: Brown sausage and onion., Add remaining ingredients and bake in casserole at 350°., Serves 4., Sausage Casserole plus a salad makes a fine low cholesterol meal.

title: Porcupine Balls
directions: Combine the preceding and shape into balls., Place in roaster with 1 can tomato soup and 1 can tomato sauce well blended., Bake at 350° for 1 hour or longer.

title: Baked Squash
directions: Wash and, slice, 6, to	8, squash, and boil until done. Drain excess, water and add 1/2 stick margarine and mash., Mix egg, sugar and Pet milk., Pour into hot squash, stirring fast. Add salt and pepper to taste., Bake at 350° until firm (20 to 30 minutes). Sprinkle with grated cheese and melt.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
directions: Butter a baking dish (8 x 8-inch or 9 x 9-inch)., Mix all but cheese and chips in dish., Sprinkle cheese and potato chips on top., Bake in a 425° oven for 15 minutes.

title: Pronto Pizza Burgers
directions: In a bowl, mix beef, Parmesan cheese, onion, tomato paste, oregano, salt and pepper, just until combined., Toast the muffins in broiler until lightly browned., Divide meat mixture among muffins., Broil 4 inches from the heat for 8 to 10 minutes or until meat is cooked., Top with tomato and cheese slices., Return to broiler until cheese is melted., If desired, sprinkle with oregano., Serve immediately., Yields 4 servings.

title: Mexi Dip
directions: Brown hamburger and drain; stir in beans, tomato sauce, taco mix, onion, bell pepper, mustard and 1/4 to 1/2 teaspoon of chili powder., Heat to boiling, stirring constantly., Spread into ungreased pie plate., Spread sour cream on top of hamburger mixture., Sprinkle with 1/4 teaspoon chili powder, shredded cheese and chopped tomatoes., Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Cream Cheese Cookies
directions: Cream butter and cream cheese., Blend egg yolk and vanilla. Add cake mix 1/3 at a time., Cover., Chill for 30 minutes., Bake at 375°.

title: Garlic Green Beans
directions: Steam green beans for 15 minutes. In frypan, heat olive oil. Add garlic and green beans; dry beans until done. Salt and pepper to taste.

title: Chicken Ala Balsamic
directions: Fry breaded chicken in garlic and olive oil., After frying all chicken, saute and cover pan until chicken is fully cooked., Put aside sliced mushrooms, red peppers and sliced onion and simmer. Take a little olive oil and garlic; simmer mushrooms, red peppers and onions until cooked., When cooked, pour over chicken and then pour balsamic vinegar over entire food., Simmer until hot.

title: Fix Ahead Mashed Potatoes
directions: Place cooked potatoes in large bowl., Add butter, cream cheese, sour cream, milk, and salt., Mix until well blended. Spoon into 12, x 8, x 2 inch baking dish., Brush with melted butter. Sprinkle with paprika., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes just before serving time.

title: Oven Bag Chicken Supreme
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Combine all ingredients except chicken. Dust inside of large oven bag with flour and lay bag inside oblong baking pan., Arrange chicken, cavity side up, in a single layer in bag, spooning mixture evenly over top., Tie bag; pierce top with 2 to 3 small slits., Bake for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Easy Peanut Butter Cookies
directions: Combine eggs and sugar until blended; add peanut butter and mix well., Roll into balls (size of walnuts)., Place on greased cookie sheet., Flatten with fork., Bake 12 to 15 minutes in preheated oven at 325°., Yield:, 5 dozen cookies.

title: Venison Stew
directions: Mix together all ingredients in large stew pot, adding enough water to achieve desired consistency between, soup or thick stew. Simmer on low to medium-low for 3 or 4 hours., Makes a very mild, but tasty soup.

title: Strawberry Pretzel Salad
directions: Mix pretzels, 1/2 cup sugar and margarine., Bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan for 10 minutes at 350°., Mix cream cheese, 1 cup sugar and Cool Whip, and	spread over crumbs., Dissolve Jell-O in hot pineapple juice., Add strawberries and juice to Jell-O. Let set partially.	Spread	over, top of cream cheese mixture. Chill., Cut into squares.

title: Butter Nut Balls
directions: Blend shortening, butter, salt, sugar and vanilla., Add flour and nuts., Place in refrigerator for about 1 hour., Place balls of dough on slightly greased cookie sheet., Bake for 20 to 25 minutes at 325°., Sift on powdered sugar.

title: Cauliflower Casserole
directions: Cook cauliflower and drain; drain peas., Combine cauliflower, peas, cheese and sour cream., Pour into buttered casserole dish. Cover with Ritz crackers., Dot with butter., Bake 30 to 40 minutes at 350°.

title: Country Pork Ribs
directions: Place pork ribs (at room temperature) in roasting pan with a lid., Mix all the other ingredients together and spread over the ribs., Bake in preheated 400° oven until tender., Remove lid and bake 15 minutes longer to brown., This sauce is also good over beef short ribs, beef spareribs or brisket.

title: Strawberry Pizza
directions: Mix., Pat in an 8 x 11-inch pan., Bake at 325° for 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown., Cool.

title: Milk Chocolate Cake Icing
directions: Blend together., Beat on high until smooth.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Heat soup; add, cheese., Mix with cooked broccoli., Top with buttered bread crumbs., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

title: Butterscotch Graham Squares
directions: Preheat oven to 325°., Break each graham cracker in half. Place close together on a 17 1/4 x 11 x 1-inch nonstick cookie pan with side on it., Place butter and brown sugar in a glass measuring cup., Cover loosely with plastic wrap., Microwave on High for 1 minute or until butter is melted., Remove from microwave., Stir., Let cool at room temperature 2 minutes., Add pecans; mix well., Put a teaspoonful on each cracker., Bake 7 minutes., When cool, remove and store.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Cook broccoli for 5 minutes and drain., In large bowl, combine soup, mayonnaise, onion and cheese., Add eggs; mix well., Then add chopped broccoli., Pour into 9 x 13-inch sprayed baking dish. Sprinkle with crushed Ritz crackers (which have been sauteed in the melted margarine)., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Taco Dip I
directions: In a greased 9 x 13-inch pan, spread refried beans on bottom. Next spread cream cheese over beans., Brown ground beef; drain and add taco seasoning mix., Spread on cream cheese., Next, spread salsa and top with cheese., Bake 15 to 25 minutes at 350°., Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Hummus
directions: Place all ingredients in food processor., Process until well blended., Serve with pita chips, celery, and carrot sticks.

title: Diabetic Date Nut Cake
directions: Cream the butter, egg, sweetener and vanilla., Add applesauce; mix well., Sift dry ingredients together., Stir in dates and nuts. Add to first mixture., Mix by beating at medium speed for several minutes., Turn into buttered loaf pan., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Cranberry Meat Ball Sauce
directions: Mix together and pour over about 40 meat balls and simmer 10 to 15 minutes.

title: English Muffin Loaf
directions: Mix together yeast, flour, sugar, salt and soda., Warm to 120° milk and water., Mix milk and water into the dry ingredients., Add enough of 1 cup flour to make a stiff batter., Grease a loaf pan and sprinkle with corn meal., Put dough into pan., Let rise to double in size., Bake at 400° for 15 to 25 minutes (golden top).

title: Christmas Sugar Cookies
directions: Mix shortening, sugar and vanilla real good., Add 1 egg to sugar mixture., Beat until light and fluffy., Stir in 4 teaspoons milk., Mix flour and baking powder, then add to liquid mixture. Put in refrigerator for, 1 hour., Then roll out thin and cut into shapes., Bake 6 to 8 minutes at 375°., Frost and decorate.

title: Chicken Marengo
directions: Pierce sausages; simmer in water to cover for 15 minutes. Drain., Brown sausages in Pam sprayed pot., Remove and brown chicken pieces in pot., Spray again if needed., Remove meat and cook onions until tender, stirring frequently., Do not brown onions.

title: Chocolate Angel Food Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Follow directions on angel food mix package, stirring cocoa and coffee powder into dry mix., Beat 1 1/2 minutes, scraping bowl often., Bake 40 to 50 minutes in unoiled tube pan., Invert and cool thoroughly., Top with Berry Sauce. Makes 12 servings.

title: Dream Whip Salad
directions: Combine all ingredients together and place in covered container in the refrigerator for 3 or 4 hours before serving. This salad keeps well for several days., When mixing, if real thick, add some of the pineapple juice.

title: Oriental Chicken
directions: *Can omit m.s.g. if desired.

title: Oatmeal Casserole Breakfast
directions: Dot peaches with 2 tablespoons butter., Sprinkle lemon juice and cinnamon over peaches., Sift flour, salt and baking soda together and mix oats into mixture., Add brown sugar to margarine. Place peaches in bottom of 9 x 12-inch Pyrex baking dish. Combine flour-oats and margarine-sugar mixtures and spread over peaches., Bake at 375° for 45 minutes.

title: Fresh Salad Freeze
directions: Mash bananas with fork; blend in remaining ingredients., Stir well, pour into molds., Freeze until firm.

title: Double Decadence Chocolate Chip Brownies
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Lightly grease 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Beat sugar, margarine, eggs and vanilla until smooth., Add 1 cup chips, melted*; mix well., Add flour, oats, baking powder, remaining cup of chips and the nuts, mixing well., Spread into prepared pan., Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until brownies pull away from sides of pan., Cool completely., Sprinkle with powdered sugar, if desired., Cut into bars., Makes 2 dozen.

title: Sweet And Sour Chicken
directions: Combine Italian dressing, dry onion soup mix and apricot or guava preserves., Pour over chicken thighs which have been placed in a large shallow baking dish., Bake for 1 1/2 hours at 350° and baste occasionally with pan drippings., Serve hot with rice and sweet and sour sauce.

title: Squash Casserole
directions: Mash squash up., Add eggs, 1/2 cup crackers, 1/4 cup butter, milk, onions, cheese, salt and pepper., Mix well., Pour into casserole and top with 1/4 cup melted butter., Sprinkle 1/2 cup crackers on top., Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until brown around edges., You may garnish with cheese, if desired.

title: Sweet Potato Pone
directions: To grated sweet potatoes, add milk and other ingredients. Pour into large greased baking dish., Bake for 1 hour at 325°.

title: Sausage And Apple Stuffing
directions: Place bread cubes in a large bowl and set aside., In a medium size skillet over medium heat, saute sausage until well browned, about 10 minutes., Transfer sausage to paper towels to drain and discard drippings., In same skillet, melt butter., Add onion; saute until soft but not brown., Stir in stock, apples and raisins; bring to a boil., Pour over bread cubes and mix in sausage, salt and sage., (Makes approximately 10 cups)., Great for light or dark poultry dishes.

title: Red Velvet Cake
directions: Cream shortening and sugar., Add eggs, flavorings and salt. Make paste of cocoa and food coloring., Add to first mixture. Alternately add flour and buttermilk., Mix soda and vinegar in small bowl; add to batter., Blend., Bake at 350° in three 9 or 10-inch pans for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Cranberry-Orange Bread
directions: Combine egg, orange juice and salad oil., Combine dry ingredients plus cranberries and nuts., Stir juice mixture into dry mixture, stirring just until moistened., Bake in greased 9 1/2 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan at 350° for 50 minutes or until tests done. Remove from pan and cool.

title: Forgotten Chicken And Rice
directions: Put rice mixed with onion soup and mushrooms in 9 x 13-inch pan., Cut up chicken; salt and pepper the pieces and place on top of rice mixture., Mix cream of chicken or cream of mushroom soup with 2 1/2 cans water., Pour over chicken on rice., Bake 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

title: Cole Slaw
directions: In a large bowl, make layers of cabbage, green pepper and onion., Sprinkle 1 cup of sugar over top., In a saucepan, combine the remaining ingredients., Mix well., Bring mixture to a full boil, stirring constantly., Pour over slaw., Refrigerate at least 4 hours (best overnight)., Mix well., (Will keep for weeks.)

title: Sinful Salad
directions: Combine Jell-O and water; cool., Add bananas, pecans, strawberries and pineapple to Jell-O., Divide in half., Pour 1/2 into 12 x 8-inch pan., Refrigerate until set., Spread sour cream evenly over Jell-O., Pour remaining 1/2 Jell-O over sour cream. Cover; refrigerate until set or overnight.

title: Irish Potato Cake
directions: Cream butter and sugar., Add potatoes, extracts and spices. Mix well., Add milk., Combine flour, soda and cocoa., Add the creamed mixtures., Add well beaten eggs., Dredge nuts and raisins with 1/4 cup flour; add to batter., Pour into a greased 10-inch tube pan and bake at 300° for 2 hours.

title: Couple'S Club Delight
directions: Mix together nuts, flour and oleo; spread in 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes., Let cool.

title: Pink Lady Day Salad
directions: Drain pineapple; save juice., Add enough liquid to dissolve Jell-O., Mix Jell-O as directed., Place over medium heat, stir until marshmallows melt and cool for 10 minutes., Add remaining ingredients., Pour into mold and chill.

title: Cookie Clusters
directions: Melt 2 squares of white bark in a 200° oven for 20 minutes in a 12 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Remove from the oven when completely melted and add peanut butter., Mix., Combine granola and noodles to the mixture and coat well. Drop by tablespoon onto aluminum foil. Will harden when cooled., Makes 4 dozen.

title: Sweet Potato Puffs
directions: Mix all ingredients well., Shape into ball and roll into flour., Cook in hot oil (360°) until brown, about 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Pineapple-Coconut Cake(No Mixing)
directions: Spread pineapple in large baking dish., Sprinkle coconut over pineapple., Sprinkle brown sugar over coconut, then sprinkle cake mix (dry from box)., Slice butter thin and place over cake mix, making sure to cover completely., Bake at 300° for about 1 hour.

title: Nut Burgers
directions: Mix all ingredients well., Roll into meat balls., Roll in a little bread crumbs., Bake 30 minutes at 325° or can be fried., Can be used with spaghetti.

title: Easy Casserole
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Press ground beef into an 8-inch buttered dish., Pour over this the can of undiluted soup., Spread frozen vegetables over soup and cover with Tater Tots., Bake about 40 minutes.

title: Party Mix
directions: Melt butter and add all salts., Mix first 7 ingredients together, pour butter and salt mixture with Worcestershire sauce. Put in oven at 200° for 1 1/2 hours., Drain on paper towel.

title: "You Won'T Believe This" Cornbread Stuffing
directions: Put chicken broth in heavy saucepan., Bring to simmer., Pour corn meal into chicken broth slowly, stirring constantly until thick, about 10 minutes., Cover and set aside.

title: Quick Peach Cobbler
directions: Mix sugar, flour, milk and peaches together., Put into bowl. Slice 1 stick of butter over top., Bake at 375° until top rises and is golden brown.

title: Cheese Biscuits
directions: Cream margarine and cheese together., Add flour, paprika and salt., Work together into a roll and slice., Press sliced green olive into center of each circle., Bake at 350° for 10 minutes on greased cookie sheet.

title: Ranch Crackers
directions: Coat oyster crackers with vegetable oil., Mix dry ingredients and toss with crackers., Bake 5 to 10 minutes in a 475° oven.

title: Italian Cream Cake #2
directions: Cream Crisco and margarine., Add sugar and vanilla., Add egg yolks, one at a time., Sift flour and soda together; add to creamed mixture, alternating with milk., Add nuts and coconut. Beat egg whites until stiff; fold into the batter., Pour into 3 (9-inch) greased pans; bake for 25 minutes at 350°.

title: Chicken A La King
directions: Cook peppers in melted butter until tender., Remove peppers and add flour to butter; blend., Add warm milk and cook until thickened., Remove from heat and add well beaten yolks., Place over low flame and cook one minute, stirring constantly., Add lemon juice and salt; blend with ingredients.

title: Thousand Island Dressing
directions: Mix in blender. Store in icebox.

title: Frosted Blueberry Salad
directions: Dissolve jello in boiling water. Drain blueberries and pineapple., Measuring liquid, add enough water to make 1 cup and add to jello mixture. Chill until jello becomes jelly. Fold in blueberries and pineapple., Pour into long dish and chill until firm.

title: Easy Country Gravy
directions: Fry your sausage in a large skillet until brown. Add flour to sausage and in skillet and mix together. Brown flour and add milk. on medium high, stir mixture often to keep from burning. Add sage, salt and pepper. As gravy comes to a boil it will thicken. If it is too thick, add 1/4 cup of more milk. Reduce heat after bringing to a boil and cook for 5 minutes. This is excellent served over chicken fried steak, biscuits, or potatoes.

title: Chinese Beef-N-Rice
directions: In large skillet cook and stir rice in oil over medium heat until golden brown., Add salt, water, bouillon cubes and soy sauce. Cover tightly; simmer 20 minutes., Stir in onions, celery, green peppers and meat., Cover tightly; simmer 10 minutes or until liquid is absorbed and rice tender.

title: Chicken And Wild Rice Dressing
directions: Prepare wild rice according to directions on the box., Cut chicken in cubes; brown sausage, chicken and onion together. Drain the fat; mix all ingredients together., Bake 1 hour at 350° or until lightly browned.

title: Hot Chocolate
directions: Mix ingredients well., Add 2 heaping teaspoonfuls of this mix to cup of boiling water.

title: Lipton Cheese
directions: Blend all ingredients well. Cover and refrigerate., Hollow out a loaf of round rye or pumpernickel bread and put mixture in center. Cube the bread taken from the center and spread the cheese on it., Do not let the ingredients deter you from making this, as it is really good!

title: Fruit Salad
directions: Mix pineapple and apricots with juices., Add instant pudding and mix well., Add bananas and nuts., Chill.

title: Ranch Biscuits
directions: Mix yeast with warm water., Mix all other ingredients., Leave in refrigerator and use as needed.

title: Salmonettes Heloise
directions: Open can of salmon, pour the juice into a measuring cup and set aside., Dump the drained salmon in a mixing bowl., Drop in egg., Use a fork to break up salmon and mix the egg real good. When it is gummy, add flour., Stir in flour thoroughly with fork. Mixture will be real thick.

title: Butter Crisp Cookies
directions: Cream the margarine, sugar and vanilla. Beat in eggs. Add remaining ingredients and mix thoroughly. Shape in balls and place on ungreased cookie sheet., Flatten with bottom of glass dipped in sugar., Bake 6 to 8 minutes in a 375° oven.

title: Southern Peanut Butter Pie
directions: Whip cheese until light and fluffy., Beat in sugar and peanut butter., Slowly add milk, blending thoroughly., Fold in topping. Pour into pie shell., Sprinkle with chopped nuts., Freeze and serve frozen.

title: Corn Bread Or Mexican Corn Bread
directions: Mix the dry ingredients., Beat eggs. Add milk and stir into dry mixture., Add the Crisco and mix thoroughly., Pour into "hot" cast-iron skillet or corn bread stick pan with about 1 tablespoon oil. Bake in preheated oven at 450° or until golden brown.

title: Helen Green'S Green Chili Casserole
directions: Brown hamburger, onions and chilies., Add mushroom soup. Layer with chips, hamburger mixture and cheese in two layers. Bake until cheese melts in 350° oven.

title: Walnut Caramels
directions: In large, heavy saucepan, combine sugar, corn syrup, butter and half of the cream., Heat to boiling over medium heat, stirring constantly., Stir in remaining cream, nuts and vanilla., Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until mixture reaches a temperature of 244° on a candy thermometer (small amount dropped into very cold water will form a firm ball)., As mixture becomes thick, stir constantly., Immediately pour mixture evenly into a well buttered 8-inch square pan., Let stand until cool., Cut into 1-inch squares., Wrap individually in waxed paper or plastic wrap. Yields 64 candies (about 1 1/2 pounds).

title: Stuffed Mushrooms
directions: Remove stems of mushrooms and chop., Combine stems, cheese, butter and onion., Fill mushroom caps with mixture., Place on rack of broiler pan., Broil until filling is slightly crusty, 2 to 3 minutes.

title: Sangria For 32
directions: Cut lemons, limes and oranges in half. Squeeze by hand to remove some juice and mix with the wine., Add brandy, sugar and sliced fruit to the wine and let "mellow" for one day., Serve chilled with maraschino cherry and additional fruit slice.

title: Microwave Potatoes
directions: Slice potatoes medium thick., Layer in deep dish glass pie pan., Sprinkle with salt and pepper to taste., Dot with butter. Cover with plastic wrap., Microwave 25 minutes on High.

title: Fried Green Tomatoes
directions: Cut tomatoes into 1/4-inch slices., Combine cornmeal, flour, salt and pepper., Dip tomato slices into cornmeal mixture., Heat bacon drippings until melted., Add tomato slices; cook, turning once, until golden brown., Makes 4 servings.

title: Grandma Hanrahan'S Vanilla Icing
directions: In a small bowl, combine powdered sugar, milk, vanilla and a few drops of food coloring (if desired), stirring until smooth. The icing should be fluid but thick enough to form a line when drizzled from the tip of a spoon., If necessary, add a few drops of milk to thin or a little more sugar to thicken., Makes about 1/2 cup.

title: Pasta Primavera
directions: In a, large skillet, add olive oil and saute garlic and onions until, soft, about 2 1/2 minutes., Add carrots, broccoli, peppers, mushrooms, basil and crushed red pepper., Cook 5 minutes, stirring until broccoli and carrots are crisp-tender. Add, cream, Parmesan,, parsley,, salt, and pepper; cook until boiling., Pour over cooked linguine.

title: My Favorite Pasta-Garlic Clam Sauce
directions: Saute onion, green pepper and garlic in olive oil until translucent., (Add a little water and cover if necessary.) Add mushrooms and continue heating in covered saucepan for about 3 minutes., Add remaining ingredients, including all liquid from clams; heat until hot in covered saucepan., Serve with 1 cup spaghetti or linguine (2 ounces dry) per serving., Top with Parmesan cheese.

title: Strawberry Pineapple Cup
directions: Drain pineapple., Alternate layers of pineapple and strawberries; sprinkle each layer with sugar., Sprinkle mint over top; chill thoroughly., Serve in sherbet glass., Serves 6.

title: Cherry Cola Salad
directions: Add water to pie filling in saucepan., Bring to a boil and boil 3 minutes, stirring constantly., Remove from heat., Add gelatin and stir., Add pineapple, cola and nuts., Pour in mold and refrigerate.

title: Quick Potatoes Au Gratin
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Mix potatoes, cheese, soup, salad dressing, onion and pepper., Spoon into 12 x 8-inch baking dish., Sprinkle with combined crushed corn flakes and margarine., Bake 45 to 55 minutes or until thoroughly heated., Makes 6 servings.

title: Cheese Ball
directions: Mix cream cheese, ham, green onions, accent, onions and garlic together and form a ball. Roll in shredded cheddar cheese until completely covered. Reshape and wrap in plastic wrap to chill. Chill for about 2 hours before serving with your favorite crackers.

title: Broccoli-Rice Casserole
directions: Combine broccoli with onion and cook as directed on broccoli package; drain., Combine vegetables with margarine, rice, cheese spread and mushroom soup., Pour mixture into a greased shallow 2-quart casserole., Bake at 350° about 30 minutes.

title: Cookie Salad
directions: Crumble 3/4 package cookies into bite-size pieces; set aside. Combine pudding and buttermilk thoroughly. Fold in whipped topping and then add the mandarin oranges. Refrigerate until ready to serve., When ready to serve, mix in the crumbled cookie pieces and then place the remaining whole cookies on top for decoration.

title: Chicken Orleans
directions: Roll chicken in seasoned flour (flour, 1 teaspoon salt and pepper)., Brown in vegetable oil in heavy frypan; remove., Cook onion, garlic, celery and green pepper until they begin to brown, stirring occasionally., Stir in tomatoes, rice, Worcestershire sauce, remaining salt and water., Arrange browned chicken over the top., Cover tightly., Let simmer 20 to 30 minutes., Serves 6.

title: Swedish Heirloom Cookies
directions: Cream butter; add sugar gradually, then salt and nuts., Blend in flour and mix thoroughly., Add water and vanilla., Mix thoroughly with fork., Shape into balls or crescents., Bake in greased sheet., Flatten slightly., Bake at 325° for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Pineapple Cheese Ball
directions: Mix cream cheese until smooth.	Add green pepper, onion, pineapple and 1/4 cup chopped nuts., Mix well., Shape into a ball and roll in remaining nuts., Chill overnight.

title: Rosebud'S Biscuits
directions: Preheat oven to 450°., Make a well in flour, patting flour down lightly., Pour milk into the well., Add oil to milk., With hands, gradually add flour to make soft dough., Flour hands., Pinch off dough; roll between hands forming biscuits., Place biscuits on pan greased with oil., (I place biscuits touching.), Dab oil onto top of each biscuit., Bake at 450° for approximately 5 to 6 minutes or until done., Place on broil to slightly brown tops.

title: Apple Pasta Salad
directions: Thoroughly combine yogurt, pineapple, salt, spices, ginger and honey., Refrigerate., Cook pasta according to package directions, omitting salt., Rinse with cold water and drain thoroughly., Cool completely., In a large bowl, combine all ingredients including yogurt dressing., Chill thoroughly before serving., Makes 8 (1 cup) servings.

title: Red And Green Christmas Salad
directions: Place the spinach leaves in a large salad bowl and arrange the avocado slices in a circle around the edge of the salad., Place the pomegranate seeds in the center of the salad., Make the warm dressing., Pour 1 cup of the dressing over the salad at the table; toss and divide between salad plates., Makes 8 portions.

title: Amish Sugar Cookies
directions: Combine sugars, oleo and oil., Add eggs and beat well., Add the flour, soda, cream of tartar and vanilla., Make into balls and roll in sugar., Bake 10 to 12 minutes at 375°.

title: Beginner'S Blueberry Cobbler
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Melt butter and pour in baking dish. Mix flour, sugar and milk together., Fold in berries and pour over butter., Do not stir., Bake until golden brown.

title: No-Bake Butterscotch Haystacks
directions: Line cookie sheet with wax paper. Place butterscotch morsels, peanut butter morsels and shortening in medium microwave safe bowl. Microwave on high about one minute. Stir. If necessary, microwave an additional 15 seconds at a time, stirring after each heating, just until morsels are melted and mixture is smooth when stirred. Immediately, add chow mein noodles; stir to coat. Drop mixture by heaping teaspoonfuls onto prepared cookie sheet. Let stand until firm. If necessary, cover and refrigerate until firm. Store in refrigerator in tightly covered container. Yield: 2 doz.

title: Pizza Casserole
directions: In a skillet, brown beef and onion., Drain any fat., Add remaining ingredients. Spoon into a greased 2-quart casserole. Top with cheese and pepperoni., Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

title: Pork Chop Casserole
directions: Place pork chops in greased casserole dish, salt and pepper. Place potatoes on top of chops., Pour mushroom soup on top of potatoes., Cover with foil and bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: White Chili
