directions: About 1 1/2 hours before serving:, Preheat oven to 350°., In small saucepan over medium heat in hot salad oil, cook onion, garlic and cumin until onion is tender., In a 2 1/2-quart casserole, combine onion mixture with chicken, white kidney beans, garbanzo beans, corn, green chilies, bouillon and 1 1/2 cups of water., Cover casserole and bake 50 to 60 minutes, until chicken is tender.

title: Dole Cole Slaw Salad
directions: Mix first 5 ingredients together in a large bowl. Set aside. In small bowl mix seasoning from noodles, vinegar, oil and sugar. Mix all together and serve immediately.

title: Choc-Oat Chip Cookies
directions: Heat oven to 375°., Beat butter or margarine and sugar until creamy., Add eggs, milk and vanilla; beat well., Add flour, baking soda and salt., Mix well., Stir in oats, chocolate morsels and nuts., Mix well., Drop by rounded teaspoons onto ungreased cookie sheet., Bake 9 to 10 minutes for a chewy cookie or 12 to 13 minutes for a crisp cookie., Cool 1 minute on pan, then remove and cool completely., Makes 5 dozen.

title: Texas Hash
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Saute onions and green pepper in hot fat until yellow., Add ground beef and fry until mixture falls apart. Stir in remaining ingredients., Pour into greased 1 1/2-quart baking dish., Cover and bake 1 hour., Remove cover last 15 minutes., Serve hot., Makes 3 servings.

title: Chocolate Pound Cake
directions: Mix together., Fold in an 8 ounce container sour cream and a 6 ounce package chocolate chips., Bake in Bundt pan at 325° for 1 hour and 10 minutes., Cool completely and frost.

title: Strawberry Bread
directions: Mix oil, sugar and eggs; add strawberries. Combine and sift dry ingredients. Add dry ingredients gradually; mix well. Stir in nuts. Pour into 2 loaf pans. Bake at 350° for about 1 hour. Great with cream cheese.

title: Fish Patties
directions: Combine all ingredients except cheese in a bowl. Form into patties., Fry until crisp in hot olive oil., Top with a slice of cheese., Serve with mustard or salsa sauce. Also makes a great burger sandwich., Serve on a bun with lettuce, tomato and mayonnaise.

title: Rhubarb Crumb Pie
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., Combine rhubarb, egg, vanilla, 4 tablespoons flour and sugar together., Pour into unbaked pie shell., Blend 3/4 cup flour, brown sugar and margarine together until crumbly., Sprinkle over rhubarb mixture., Bake for 40 to 45 minutes at 375°.

title: Hawaiian Chicken
directions: Marinate chicken in soy sauce., Place chicken in baking dish. Sprinkle with brown sugar substitute., Pour remaining soy sauce over chicken., Bake covered for 1/2 hour at 350°., Uncover and add peppers and pineapple., Bake 1/2 hour longer., Serves two., Each serving exchanges 3 meats, 1 vegetable and 1 fruit.

title: Extra Rich Cake
directions: Grease and flour tube pan., Combine and bake at 325° for 55 to 60 minutes., You may use any flavor that you prefer, i.e. lemon cake mix and lemon pudding mix or white cake mix and vanilla pudding mix, etc.

title: Sweet-N-Sour Sauce
directions: Make paste of cornstarch and water., Combine with rest of ingredients; bring to a boil., Stir until thick.

title: Baked Chop Suey
directions: Brown beef, onion, salt and pepper. Put into baking dish; add celery, salt, soups and rice. Add water and soy sauce; stir all together and bake 1 hour, covered, and 1/2 hour more, uncovered, at 350°.

title: Country Hash
directions: Combine meats in one boiler., Cook until done., Cool for 15 to 20 minutes, then chop., Add vinegar, butter and onion., Reheat for 15 minutes., Serve over rice., Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Quick And Simple Meal
directions: Brown ground chuck and add chili powder, garlic powder and tomatoes., Cook macaroni as directed on package., Mix ground chuck and macaroni., Sprinkle cheese on top., Bake in a covered casserole dish at 325° for 20 minutes., Yields 4 to 6 servings. Can be frozen.

title: Scalloped Corn
directions: Spray a casserole dish with Pam., Add your corn and all of the ingredients in a bowl; mix well., Pour into casserole dish., Bake for 20 to 30 minutes in 350° oven., Serve hot.

title: Barbara'S Ham Loaf
directions: Combine and bake slowly in loaf pan.

title: L-H Dressing
directions: Combine all ingredients and mix in blender., Serve on greens and top with bacon.

title: Cornbread Muffins
directions: Mix all this together., Put in greased muffin pans and bake at 400° for 25 to 30 minutes., Makes approximately 12 muffins.

title: Ten-Minute Turkey Casserole
directions: Combine all ingredients in a saucepan., Cover and let simmer about 30 minutes., Makes 4 servings.

title: Strawberry Pie
directions: Put, strawberries in pie crust., Then mix sugar, water, cornstarch	and, jello., Pour over strawberries and bake., Put Cool Whip on top to serve.

title: Dorothy'S Rhubarb Pie
directions: Beat eggs., Add sugar and flour., Mix together with wooden spoon and stir in soft butter and salt., Pour this over rhubarb in unbaked shell., Bake at 450° for 10 minutes and then at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Kraft Macaroni And Hamburger
directions: Prepare macaroni and cheese as directed on package., Brown meat; drain., Add onion and green pepper., Cook until tender., Add soup., Add all together in casserole dish., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

title: Stollen
directions: Sprinkle the yeast over the warm water in a small bowl; add a pinch of sugar, stir to dissolve and let stand for 5 minutes.

title: Little Smokies
directions: Put in pot and let simmer for about 30 minutes.

title: Pimento Cheese Spread
directions: Mix with heavy-duty mixer until well blended., Refrigerate.

title: Barbecue Burgers
directions: Fry ground chuck, onion, celery and mushrooms in shortening. Add ketchup, tomatoes, water and seasoning., Cover, simmer 15 minutes., Add flour, cook until slightly thick., Serve over round buns.

title: Chocolate Pie
directions: Mix together sugar, cocoa, flour, cornstarch and salt in saucepan., Add milk; mix well., Cook, stirring constantly until mixture boils., Boil one minute., Add part of cooked mixture to beaten egg yolks, stirring to keep from lumping., Put all back into saucepan and cook one minute. Cool. Put in cooked pie crust., Top with meringue.

title: Old Fashioned Pound Cake
directions: Cream sugar, vanilla and shortening until fluffy., Add eggs alternately with flour., Beat until well blended., Pour into well-greased and floured 9 x 5 x 3 1/2-inch loaf pan., Bake at 325° for 1 1/2 hours or until center is done., Cool about 10 minutes on wire rack., Remove from pan and cool completely. (Lemon flavoring or other flavoring may be substituted.)

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Combine all ingredients except corn flakes., Press into casserole dish and top with corn flakes., Bake in preheated 350° oven for 30 to 45 minutes until bubbly hot., Enjoy!

title: Honey Apple Squares
directions: Step 1:, Spread peanut butter on a cracker.

title: Iced Tea Ala Mode
directions: Blend tea and ice cream until smooth and pour into a tall glass., Serves 3.

title: Road Runner Cake
directions: Melt oleo and add to one beaten egg and cake mix., Press into a pan.

title: Shrimp And Pepper Pasta
directions: Cook onion and garlic in oil in large skillet or wok until onion is tender, but not brown., Add shrimp and peppers; cook about 4 minutes or until shrimp is cooked through, stirring constantly., Add tomatoes, picante sauce, basil and oregano; heat through., Toss with linguine., Serve with additional picante sauce.

title: Sweet Potato Cake
directions: Sift dry ingredients and place in mixing bowl., Add cooking oil, vanilla and can of pineapple., Mix well., Add eggs, mixing well after each addition., Add grated sweet potatoes and pecans. Stir well., Pour in tube pan., Bake at 350° for about 1 1/4 hours. Test with toothpick.

title: Apple Nut Cake
directions: Mix all liquids together., Mix all dry ingredients together, then mix together., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes in 13 x 9-inch pan.

title: Low Fat Blueberry Coffee Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 325° F. Spray a 9 inch tube pan well with cooking spray and set aside. In a large bowl, mix together flour, baking powder, salt, malted milk powder and nutmeg then set aside. In a separate bowl, cream sugar together with butter and sour cream until light and fluffy. Add egg then egg whites, beating well after each addition. Stir in vanilla, and milk. Fold liquid mixture into flour mixture until just combined. Gently fold blueberries into batter. Pour batter into pan and gently even out top with spatula or spoon. Bake cake until well, browned on, top and long skewer inserted in thickest part of cake comes out clean, 50 minutes to 60 minutes. Let cake stand in pan for 5 minutes, loosen edges and invert onto a serving plate. Sprinkle warm cake with confectioners sugar. Serve cake warm or at room, temperature. Before serving refresh cake with a dusting of confectioners sugar if desired. Yield 16 servings, 176 calories.

title: Hungarian Goulash(Crock-Pot)
directions: Put steak cubes, onions and garlic in crock-pot., Stir in flour and mix to coat steak cubes., Add all remaining ingredients except sour cream., Stir well., Cover and cook on low for 7 to 10 hours., Add sour cream 30 minutes before serving and stir in thoroughly., "May cook on high for 5 to 6 hours, stirring occasionally.", Serve over hot buttered noodles.

title: Nipponese Eggplant
directions: Peel eggplant and cut into 1/2-inch to 3/4-inch cubes. Meanwhile, in a skillet, fry onions in butter., Add eggplant, soy sauce, water and brown sugar to onions., Cover and simmer for 20 minutes., Serves 3 to 4.

title: Creme Caramel
directions: Butter eight 6 ounce custard cups., In small skillet over medium heat, melt 1/2 cup sugar, stirring, until it is a light brown syrup., Pour syrup into buttered cups., Place cups in shallow baking pan for easy handling., Glass is best., Preheat oven to 300°., In large bowl with mixer at low speed, beat eggs, salt and 1/2 cup sugar until lemon colored., Gradually beat in milk and vanilla extract., Pour mixture into prepared cups; put hot water into pan to within 1-inch of top of cups; bake 1 hour until knife inserted in center comes out clean., Cool on wire racks., Refrigerate., When ready to serve, use knife to loosen custard from cups and invert onto dessert plates, letting syrup run down sides onto dish.

title: Cucumber Salad
directions: Mix all together and let congeal.

title: Corn Pudding
directions: Mix together., Bake at 350° for 40 minutes; 325° if using glass dish.

title: Crab Salad
directions: In a small, flat bottomed glass dish, place layer of onion, then a layer of crabmeat, then a layer of radish., Repeat step. In a medium bowl, whisk together the oil, vinegar, water, lime juice, salt and hot sauce., Pour over the last layer., Cover and let marinate in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours., Serve on a bed of lettuce with cracked pepper crackers.

title: Spice Pork Chop Bake
directions: Heat oven to 400°., Arrange pork chops in a single layer in a 3-quart baking dish., Bake chops for 20 minutes or until they begin to brown; spoon off fat., Combine remaining ingredients in bowl., Spoon mixture over chops and bake 15 minutes or until they are no longer pink., Stir sauce before serving.

title: Chili Chicken Dish
directions: In large skillet, saute poultry in oil until no longer pink; set aside., In same skillet, cook onion, peppers and garlic until tender., Drain., Stir in chili and stewed tomatoes., Add rice and pepper sauce., Arrange chicken on top of mixture., Simmer 10 minutes., Top with shredded cheese., Serves 6.

title: Apple Cream Cheese Coffee Cake
directions: Heat oven to 425°., Cut cream cheese and margarine into baking mix., Stir in milk., Turn dough onto surface dusted with baking mix; gently roll in baking mix to coat., Knead lightly 8 to 10 times., Roll into rectangle (12 x 8-inches); place on lightly greased cookie sheet., Spread Cream Cheese filling down center of rectangle., Make cut 2 1/2 inches long at inch intervals on 12 inch side of rectangle., Fold strips over filling, overlapping., Mix sugar and cinnamon; sprinkle over top., Bake, uncovered, until golden, 12 to 15 minutes., Cool 10 minutes., Carefully place on wire rack; cool completely., Spoon pie filling down center of coffee cake., Sprinkle with walnuts., Refrigerate any remaining coffee cake., Yields 4 to 6 servings.

title: Cinnamon Rolls
directions: Butter a 9 x 12-inch glass pan., Arrange rolls., Mix together pudding, brown sugar and nuts., Sprinkle over rolls., Pour margarine over all., Mix together 1/4 cup sugar and cinnamon. Sprinkle this over all., Let rise 8 to 10 hours or overnight., Bake in oven at 350° for 30 minutes., After top is golden brown (20 minutes), cover with foil and finish baking., Let set for 5 minutes and turn out onto serving tray.

title: Maritime Seafood Casserole
directions: Saute onion and celery in 3 tablespoons butter., In a large saucepan, melt 1/2 cup of butter., Blend in flour, salt and pepper. Gradually stir in milk., Cook, stirring constantly, until thickened., Remove from heat and add onion, celery and cheese. Stir until cheese is melted, then add seafoods., Pour into a large casserole or individual dishes., Bake in a preheated oven at 350° for about 30 minutes or until browned and bubbly., Serves 6 to 8.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
directions: Prepare apples; set aside and cover., Measure oil in large mixing bowl, add sugar and eggs and mix well at low speed until creamy smooth., Sift flour and measure., Then sift again with salt, soda and baking powder., Add flour mixture to creamed mixture in small amounts., Beat well after each addition., When batter becomes stiff, remove beater and finish mixing by hand. Fold in chopped nuts and apples last., Mix well., Spread evenly in a 9 x 13-inch pan lined with greased wax paper., Bake at 350°, for about 55 minutes to 1 hour., Turn out on cake rack to cool, or ice and serve from the pan.

title: Chicken Breast In Mushroom Sauce
directions: Sprinkle salt and pepper over chicken; place in baking dish. Bake in a 400° oven until brown (if desired)., Combine soup, mushroom pieces and milk; pour over chicken., Reduce temperature to 350°., Bake 45 minutes to 1 hour or until done., Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Rum Cake
directions: Cream Crisco and sugar; add eggs, one at a time., Sift flour alternately with milk and flavoring., Bake in Bundt pan at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Mexican Casserole
directions: In a large casserole dish, layer crushed chips., Mix one container sour cream, olives, cream of chicken soup, cream of mushroom soup and green chilies together; heat., Layer over chips. Layer in chicken and some cheese., Add sour cream, more olives and chilies., Top with cheese., Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes. Feeds 6 to 8.

title: Peanut Butter Candy
directions: Bring to a fast boil, then reduce heat to medium and cook about 20 minutes or until test for a hard ball., Add vanilla and peanut butter., Mix well., Pour into buttered dish with 1-inch sides., Let cool, then cut into squares.

title: Strawberry Fluff
directions: Combine flour, oleo, brown sugar and nuts; mix well., Spread on cookie sheet and bake 15 to 20 minutes at 350°, stirring occasionally., Cool, then crumble, reserving 1 cup., Spread remaining crumbs in a 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Blushing Bunny Sauce
directions: Put salt, pepper and flour with butter in double boiler., When melted, add cheese (which has been broken into small pieces) and stir until cheese melts., Then add tomato sauce and beaten egg; stir until smooth., Serve on toast.

title: Cheese Potatoes
directions: Combine all ingredients, except for last butter and corn flakes. Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours or until golden on top. Top with corn flakes and last butter during the last 1/2 hour of baking.

title: Cocoa Fudge Sauce
directions: Combine dry ingredients in saucepan., Add corn syrup and milk and blend thoroughly; bring to a boil., Boil for 5 minutes., Remove from heat; stir in butter and vanilla., Cool, without stirring, until pan feels warm to hand., Serve., Yields 1 1/2 cupfuls sauce. Very good!

title: Fluffy Frosting
directions: Mix egg whites, cream of tartar and sugar in small bowl with mixer at high speed, gradually until smooth and glossy., Gradually beat in corn syrup, vanilla and salt until stiff peaks form., If desired, beat in food coloring or 1 cup coconut.

title: Shawn'S Deer Steak
directions: Brown the venison in a skillet with 1/2 stick of margarine. When browned, add onion and green pepper., Continue cooking on medium heat., Season with salt, pepper and garlic salt., When onion is tender, add Worcestershire sauce., Top with one can of diced tomatoes., Cover and simmer until meat is tender.

title: Silly Putty
directions: Combine the ingredients in a small bowl., Try 1/4 cup of glue and 1/8 cup of starch; mix together., Allow to dry for 30 minutes to 1 hour before it will be workable., Store in airtight container., (This recipe may not work on a humid day.)

title: Monkey Bread
directions: Mix together first 5 ingredients in a heavy saucepan., Bring to a, boil., Let cool for 2 minutes., Take 4 cans of biscuits and cut each one into fourths., Roll in some sugar and place in a greased Bundt pan., Pour sauce over the top., Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes., Let cool., Turn over on plate and serve.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
directions: Mix all the ingredients as you do for a cake and mix well. Bake in preheated 325° oven for one hour and 30 minutes.

title: Finger Salad
directions: Press the rolls on a cookie sheet and bake according to the package directions., Mix the cream cheese, Miracle Whip and Hidden Valley Ranch together., Spread on cooled crescent rolls., Top with the vegetables., Top the vegetables with the Cheddar cheese and cut it into squares.

title: Cheese Ball
directions: Mix all ingredients., Shape into desired shape., Roll in finely chopped pecans.

title: Easy Oven Fried Chicken
directions: Combine crumbs, cheese, salt and pepper. Dip chicken in butter, then into crumbs, being careful to coat heavily. Place in baking dish. Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes uncovered. Do not turn chicken. (This can be refrigerated overnight before baking.)

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Place cooked broccoli in an ungreased Pyrex dish., Combine mushroom soup, mayonnaise, margarine, eggs and onion., Pour over broccoli., Sprinkle grated cheese over casserole and top with crushed crackers., Press cheese and crackers into casserole lightly., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes., Let stand 20 minutes before serving.

title: Kentucky Hot Brown Sandwiches
directions: Melt margarine in pan over low heat., Add flour, stirring until smooth., Cook 1 minute, stirring constantly., Gradually add milk and bouillon cubes., Cover over medium heat, stirring until thickened and bubbly., Set aside., Place toast in buttered 9 x 13-inch Pyrex dish., Top each with turkey and ham., Spoon white sauce over meat., Layer cheese, tomato and bacon over sauce., Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes., (Can use thinly sliced country ham or regular ham slices.)

title: Vegetable Dip
directions: Mix all together and chill for several hours., Serve with fresh vegetables.

title: Hershey Pie
directions: Melt candy bars., Add a large container of Cool Whip, unthawed., Pour into Oreo pie crust., Chill overnight in refrigerator.

title: Microwave Hot Dogs
directions: Place hot dog in bun., Carefully wrap single servings in separate paper towel., Smooth wrinkles in paper towel with hand or appropriate utensils as individual taste dictates., Place both items in microwave., Cook on High setting for approximately 40 to 60 seconds., See microwave for further details., When food is cooked to taste, remove hot dogs from microwave, unwrap from paper towel and add condiments.

title: Mexican Corn
directions: Combine all ingredients as given and bake in casserole for 40 minutes at 350°.

title: Cranberry Salad
directions: Grind cranberries and oranges and add sugar., Set aside for 1 hour., Mix Jell-O according to directions., Mix apples and nuts to cranberry mixture., Chill.

title: Tuna Melt Sandwiches
directions: In a medium bowl, combine celery, cheese, tuna, onion, mayo and salt; set aside., Spread butter over the cut side of buns. Spread tuna mixture on bun bottom; replace top., Wrap in foil. Bake at 350° for 15 minutes or until cheese is melted.

title: Lemon Bar
directions: Mix dry cake mix, margarine and egg together., Press mixture into bottom of 12 x 9-inch cake pan, then mix powdered sugar, 2 eggs, cream cheese, vanilla and lemon juice together until smooth. Spread second mixture evenly over the cake mixture., Bake at 325° for 45 minutes., You may want to sprinkle powdered sugar over top as it cools.

title: Harvard Beet Cake
directions: Mix flour, salt and baking soda together and set aside., In a bowl combine rest of ingredients except nuts and coconut and mix together., If beets are sliced, not diced, then cut them into smaller pieces., Beat mixture until well combined, about 3 minutes; add flour mixture and beat in, then stir in nuts and coconut. Batter will be reddish in color but will turn brown when baked. Spoon into greased and floured 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan and bake at 350° for 50 or 60 minutes, testing with a toothpick to see if it comes out clean., For a glass pan, reduce oven heat to 325°., Cool and cut into squares., Keeps well in covered container.

title: Lasagne
directions: BROWN: sausage, garlic and onion.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
directions: Blend all ingredients., Drop by teaspoon onto ungreased cookie sheet., Flatten each cookie with fork., Bake at 350° for about 15 minutes., Cool 1 to 2 minutes., Remove from sheet., Makes 3 dozen cookies.

title: Artichokes And Cheese
directions: Mix all together., Bake in glass dish at 350° until golden brown, about 10 to 15 minutes., Serve with tortilla chips - El Grande Chips.

title: Roast Pheasant
directions: Cut off necks of birds close to bodies, leaving neck skin on to help hold the stuffing., Remove pin feathers; singe if needed. Rinse inside and out in warm water; drain and pat dry.

title: Old Fashioned Molasses Cookies
directions: Cream together in a large bowl the sugar, lard or other shortening, molasses and eggs., Sift the flour, ginger and salt. Dissolve the baking soda in the coffee., Stir dry ingredients into molasses mixture, adding coffee alternately., Chill., Roll out dough to a thick layer, 1/2-inch or so., Cut with round cutter. Dip into sugar., Place on greased baking sheet, leaving room to spread., Bake at 375° for about 10 minutes but do not let brown as they will be too hard., They are a good big soft cookie which keep well. Cool on rack and enjoy with a glass of milk.

title: Chocolate Pound Cake
directions: Cream margarine and shortening., Gradually add sugar., Add eggs, one at a time., Sift flour, baking powder, salt and cocoa. Add milk and flour alternately., Add vanilla., Place in greased and floured tube pan., Bake 1 hour and 45 minutes in 325° oven.

title: Pickled Eggs
directions: Heat, peppers,, water, vinegar, salt and sugar to boiling. Add eggs and simmer for 5 minutes., Store in covered jar in refrigerator, for, one, week., Cut, in half and serve as an appetizer.

title: Texas Golden Chicken Breasts
directions: In a large, heavy skillet, heat butter and olive oil over low heat., In a separate bowl, combine flour, rosemary and cheese; mix well., Dampen chicken breasts., Roll in flour mixture, then eggs, then croutons., Cook in butter, 4 minutes per side., Serve with white sauce or milk gravy.

title: Dad'S Chili
directions: Fry meat in skillet until done; drain well., Put meat, chili powder, cayenne, salt and pepper in large pot., Fill with water. Boil 3 to 4 hours, adding water when needed., Add onions., Cook until tender., Add tomato sauce; stir well., Spoon off grease that is floating on top., Add a little cracker meal for grease you cannot remove., This helps thicken chili., Add 2 more teaspoons chili powder., Add salt and pepper to taste., Add beans., The longer the meat and chili powder boil, the better the chili taste.

title: Red Beans
directions: Soak beans overnight. Brown salt pork in shortening. Brown onions. Add flour, browning to form a roux., Add beans and enough water to cover well. Simmer 2 hours., Serve with rice. Serves 8.

title: Pecan Pie
directions: Mix well and pour into an unbaked pie shell and bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes., Cool and top with whipped topping or ice cream.

title: Beef Stew
directions: Combine flour and steak in plastic bag., Saute onion and garlic in hot oil in Dutch oven until tender., Add steak; cook over medium heat, stirring often until browned., Add remaining ingredients., Simmer 45 minutes.

title: Happy Holiday Recipe
directions: Mix well and share.

title: Cheese And Pasta In A Pot
directions: Cook ground beef in small amount of oil in large deep skillet until brown., Drain excess fat., Add onions, garlic, spaghetti sauce, stewed tomatoes and undrained mushrooms; mix well., Simmer 20 minutes., Cook macaroni, drain and rinse in cold water (as per package directions)., Pour half of shells into deep casserole. Cover with half of tomato-meat mixture and half of sour cream. Top with Provolone., Repeat layering and end with Mozzarella cheese., Cover casserole., Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes. Remove cover and bake until cheese melts and browns.

title: The "Day After" Punch
directions: In a large bowl, stir together the juices, the Curacao, the sugar and the cherries and let the mixture stand, covered and chilled, overnight., Stir in the brandy and champagne; serve over ice., Makes about 18 cups.

title: Chicken In Phyllo Dough
directions: Mix sauce. Use ingredients from mayonnaise to tarragon from list., Salt and pepper each chicken breast., Use two phyllo sheets per breast., Spread one sheet with melted butter., Spread another sheet with melted butter and lay it on top of first one. Coat a chicken breast with sauce and roll it up in the phyllo sheets, tucking the dough around chicken., Repeat with each chicken breast., Place each breast (tuck down) on baking sheet., Don't let them touch., Brush with melted butter and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese., Freeze or bake., If frozen, thaw completely before baking., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Sauce For Wieners
directions: Simmer first 4 ingredients 10 minutes., Add hot dogs., Simmer 5 minutes., Serve., Makes approximately 50., Honey wieners work better., You may add more wieners if you wish.

title: Hot Crab Dip
directions: Mix all ingredients except paprika with fork until well blended., Place in casserole dish and sprinkle with grated sharp cheese and paprika., Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes or until bubbly., Serve with crackers.

title: Peanut Butter Delight
directions: Blend flour and margarine., Add nuts., Press into a 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes., Cool.

title: Cool Cabbage Salad
directions: Mix together and serve., Makes a large bowl; good for a large party.

title: Chocolate Bonbons
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., In a medium saucepan, combine chocolate chips and margarine., Cook and stir over low heat until chips are melted and smooth., Add sweetened condensed milk; mix well., In a medium bowl, combine flour, nuts, chocolate mixture and vanilla. Mix well., Shape 1 tablespoon of dough around each candy kiss, covering completely., Place 1-inch apart on ungreased cookie sheet., Bake at 350° for 6 to 8 minutes., Do not overcook. Cookies will be soft and appear shiny but become firm as they cool.

title: Pasta Salad
directions: Cook rotini according to package directions. Drain. Rinse the pasta with cold water and drain. Combine pasta and remaining ingredients. Toss well. Serve immediately or chill until serving time.

title: Microwave Peanut Brittle
directions: Generously grease large baking sheet and set aside. Combine sugar and corn syrup in 2 quart glass measure bowl. Cook on high for 4 minutes. Stir in peanuts with wooden spoon and cook on high for 4 minutes. Stir in butter and vanilla and cook on high for 2 minutes. Add baking soda and stir until mixture is light and foamy. Pour on prepared baking sheet. Spread quickly to edges using back of wooden spoon. As candy cools stretch to a thin sheet using palms of hands. Cool completely before breaking into pieces. Store in airtight container.

title: Cheese Treats(Tom'S Grandmother'S)
directions: Mix flour with corn flakes., Add cayenne pepper., Grate into this sharp	cheese., Mix, well., Pour in melted butter or margarine (a little, more butter makes them easier to handle). Put in small balls on ungreased cookie sheet., Press down flat with fork, tines., Bake at 325° for 20 minutes.	Cut off oven and, let them, stay 10 minutes longer., Makes 2 cookie sheets full.

title: Macaroni And Cheese
directions: Cook macaroni in salted water and drain., Add egg yolks. Alternate layers of macaroni and cheese in greased baking dish. Place butter, flour, salt and pepper in double boiler; mix well. Add milk and cook until thickened., Pour over macaroni and cheese mixture., Fold in egg whites., Bake at 325° for 30 minutes.

title: Nestle Quik Icing
directions: Cream margarine and shortening., Add chocolate and sugar. Blend well, then add vanilla and milk.

title: Bootjie Bredie(Green Bean Stew)
directions: Trim fat from lamb., Cut lamb into 3/4-inch cubes., Heat oil in Dutch oven or large, heavy pan until hot., Cook and stir lamb in oil over medium heat until brown, about 10 minutes., Add water, garlic and 1 teaspoon of salt., Cover and simmer over low heat for 40 minutes.

title: Jeff'S New Potato Salad
directions: Combine all ingredients and adjust mayonnaise for desired creaminess., Serves 8.

title: Grandma'S Hot Chili
directions: Cook hamburger and onions., Drain grease., Mix tomatoes, sauce and paste into mixture., Drain beans and add and mix., Add salt and pepper, hot sauce and chili powder to taste., More will be hotter.

title: Sticky Rhubarb Muffins
directions: With pastry blender, mix 1/4 cup cold butter and the brown sugar., Add rhubarb and mix well., Spoon into bottom of 12 greased muffin cups., Cream remaining 1/3 cup butter, white sugar and egg. Sift flour, baking powder, salt and nutmeg., Add to creamed mixture alternately with milk, mixing just enough to blend., Spoon into muffin cups., Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Chocolate Gravy
directions: Mix ingredients together., Heat small skillet of milk on medium heat., Pour a little warm milk in mixture, then mix until smooth., Pour back into hot milk and stir until thick, but not too thick., Serve over hot biscuits.

title: Peanut Butter Balls
directions: Mix the 5 ingredients., Make into balls and drop into melted chocolate chips with little paraffin wax., Set on wax paper until dry.

title: Tex-Mex Dip
directions: Peel and pit avocados; mash with lemon juice, salt and pepper. Combine sour cream, mayonnaise and taco seasoning mix in bowl.

title: Noah'S Ark Clam Chowder
directions: Mix all ingredients together in a large pot; cover and bake at 200° for four hours or simmer for four hours., Stir every hour., If mixture becomes too thick, add the extra clam juice., This freezes well.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Cook noodles., Add to ingredients., Mix chopped chicken, mushroom soup, Durkee sauce, onion, pimiento, 1/2 cup grated cheese and chicken broth., Put in casserole dish and add rest of cheese on top., Bake at 350° until bubbly.

title: Low-Fat Banana Bread
directions: Mix everything well., Then add 2 cups flour., Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

title: Green Pea Casserole
directions: Preheat, oven, to, 350°., Cook	peas per package directions, unseasoned	and, drained., Set aside., Saute onion and celery in the 1/2 cup margarine., Add drained chestnuts, soup, flour	and peas., Mix	together, well and cook slightly., Add salt, and pepper, to	taste.	Melt, the, 1/4 cup margarine in skillet, and add, the, herb, dressing., Set, aside., Pour all (except the dressing) into a medium casserole dish and bake at 350° for 25 minutes or until bubbly and hot., Add dressing and brown slightly.

title: Orange Pineapple Dessert
directions: Stir graham cracker crumbs with sugar and melted oleo., Press into a 9 x 13-inch pan., Dissolve Jell-O in hot water., Mix cream cheese to soften, then add to Jell-O, a little at a time., Fold in crushed pineapple; do not drain., Add Cool Whip., Pour on graham cracker crust and refrigerate for at least 2 hours.

title: Peanut Butter Bonbons
directions: Combine all ingredients except chocolate in large bowl., Stir and knead until well blended., Chill 30 minutes., Roll into 1-inch balls., Chill balls on baking sheets until firm., Melt chocolate in glass measuring cup, stirring at least once., Dip each ball into melted chocolate., Chill until firm on wax paper., Store in refrigerator., Makes approximately 72 balls.

title: Quick Minestrone Soup
directions: Combine ingredients in a large pan; bring to a boil., Cover, reduce heat and simmer 10 minutes until pasta is done, stirring occasionally., Yields 9 servings., One cup per serving., Top with Parmesan cheese, grated.

title: Raggedy Ann Salad
directions: Place peach in center of salad plate., Position egg for head, celery sticks for arms and legs and lettuce for skirt., Add cheese for hair, cherry for mouth and raisins for eyes, nose, buttons and shoes., Yields 1 serving.

title: Chess Pie
directions: Mix all ingredients well., Place in deep dish pie shell., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Chicken Gumbo
directions: Put bread slices in bottom of casserole dish., Put chicken on top of bread., Mix eggs, broth, milk and salt., Pour this over bread and chicken. Put cheese slices on this, then soup on cheese. Brown bread crumbs in 1/4 cup of butter., Spread crumbs on top of casserole., Bake uncovered for 1 1/4 hours at 350°.

title: Pie Crust
directions: Melt oleo; mix with flour and sugar., Pat into pie plate. Bake at 375° for approximately 10 minutes or until brown.

title: Cheesy Spicy Spinach
directions: Cook spinach according to directions on package; drain well, reserving 1/2 cup spinach liquid., Set aside., In pan coated with nonstick cooking spray, melt margarine and saute onion until tender., Add flour; stir., Gradually add milk and spinach liquid to make sauce., Cook until mixture thickens., Add cheese and seasonings; cook until cheese is melted., Add spinach to pan, combining well., Yields 10 servings., A favorite of spinach lovers.

title: Pierogie Casserole
directions: Boil noodles and drain., (If using lasagne, lay flat until ready to use.)

title: Congo Bars
directions: Combine dry ingredients., Then add oil and other ingredients. Bake in a large square pan for 15 minutes at 350°.

title: Yum Yum Casserole
directions: Brown hamburger and add other ingredients., Bake 1 hour at 350°.

title: Frozen Cucumbers
directions: Prepare first 3 ingredients and refrigerate in covered container for 24 hours., Drain., Add sugar and vinegar; let stand in refrigerator again for 24 hours., Put in containers and freeze.

title: Crab Mushrooms
directions: Mix mayonnaise, cream cheese, lemon juice, chili sauce and crabmeat, all together and fill mushroom caps with mixture. Cook 1 to 2 minutes on High in your microwave., Watch carefully!

title: Han'S Sauerbraten
directions: Step 1:, In a large bowl, combine vinegar, wine, onions, celery, spices, salt and pepper., Wash meat with a damp cloth, put in marinade, cover and refrigerate for 3 days., Turn meat occasionally.

title: Hot Cheese Bubble
directions: Mix together and cook at 425° for 10 minutes, approximately. Serve with Wheat Thins., Serve hot.

title: Muffins
directions: Let all-bran cereal and boiling water set in bowl., Combine remaining ingredients., Bake in 400° oven for 20 minutes.

title: Playmate Pizzas
directions: Toast, muffins	or buns., Sprinkle with cheese., Spread tomato sauce on., Cut bacon or pepperoni to make 12 triangular eyes and 6 half, moon mouths., Arrange the eyes and mouths on muffins. Place, the mushrooms and/or olives to resemble hair. Place pizza faces, on, baking, sheet., Bake, at, 450° about 5 minutes or until hot., Makes 6 servings.

title: Oven Stew
directions: In a plastic bag, combine flour, salt, pepper and paprika. Add a few pieces of meat at a time and shake bag, coating well on all sides., Repeat until all meat has been floured.

title: Corn Bread Squares
directions: Heat oven to 400°., Grease 8 or 9-inch baking pan., Combine dry ingredients., Stir in milk, oil and egg, mixing just until dry ingredients are moistened., Pour batter into pan., Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown., Serve warm., Makes 9 servings.

title: Egg Rolls
directions: Mix all ingredients, except egg roll skins., Spoon 1 tablespoon onto egg roll skin; fold., May use drop of water to seal edges., Deep fat fry until brown on both sides., May also use mixture for won tons., Serve as a snack or as a side dish.

title: Cheese Biscuits
directions: Soften butter and cheese., Gradually add flour and paprika. Roll out and cut with cookie cutter or cookie gun., Bake at 325° for 15 minutes., Makes 4 dozen.

title: Cole Slaw
directions: Slice vegetables then mix all ingredients.

title: Coconut Cream Pound Cake
directions: Cream margarine and shortening; gradually add sugar and beat until light and fluffy., Add eggs, one at a time, beating well. Combine flour and baking powder; add to creamed mixture alternately with cream of coconut., (Begin and end with flour.) Stir in lemon rind and vanilla., Pour into greased and floured 10-inch Bundt pan., Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes., Cool in pan 10 to 15 minutes., Remove and cool completely on wire rack.

title: Lemon Meringue Pie
directions: Separate egg whites (keep aside for meringue)., Beat egg yolks well., Add other ingredients and mix well., Pour mixture into pie crust., For meringue, beat 2 egg whites until frothy., Add 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar and continue beating., Gradually add tablespoon of sugar as beating continues until mixture is stiff. Spread meringue over pie filling., (Be sure to seal edges around crust.) Bake at 350° for approximately 10 to 15 minutes or until meringue is light brown., Chill in refrigerator., Serves 8 people.

title: Homemade Picante Sauce
directions: Combine all ingredients, except for the peppers, and simmer together until onion is nearly done., Add peppers and continue simmering until all flavors are blended., Store in refrigerator.

title: Parmesan Chicken(Serves 8)
directions: Dip each breast in a combination of eggs and milk, then bread crumbs. Saute in a heavy frying pan in hot olive oil. Pour 1/2 spaghetti sauce into 15 x 10 pan. Top with sauteed chicken. In same skillet, saute the mushrooms. Spoon over the chicken along with any pan juices. Top each piece of chicken with a slice of Mozzarella and a slice of Swiss cheese, wrapping them slightly around meat. Pour remaining sauce over the chicken. Combine Parmesan cheese with leftover bread crumbs and sprinkle over top. Dish can be refrigerated, but bring to room temperature before baking. Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Caramel Turtles
directions: Melt caramels and cream in double boiler., Combine oat mixture without chocolate chips. Spread 1/2 mixture into 9 x 13-inch ungreased pan., Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.

title: Creamy Bleu Cheese Dressing
directions: Blend well. Chill overnight.

title: White Chocolate "Peanut Clusters"
directions: Melt white chocolate in double boiler., Add vanilla and stir - add peanuts and mix well., Drop on cookie sheet lined with wax paper., Let cool until firm., Store in cool place., Yield 2 - 3 dozen.

title: Easy Lunch Treat
directions: Bake fries., Pour heated chili over fries; top with cheese and bake until cheese melts.

title: Cheese Ball
directions: Mix cream cheese and mayonnaise; mix well., Add remaining ingredients, one at a time, stirring well after each ingredient except pecans., Refrigerate for several hours., Roll into ball and roll in pecans until fully covered.

title: French Onion Soup(Microwave)
directions: Melt the butter in a 2-quart casserole dish., Add onions and cook for ten minutes., Stir in beef bouillon, salt, flour and pepper., Cover and cook another 10 minutes., Spoon into individual bowls., Toast bread and add to soup., Cover with Mozzarella cheese. Heat on High for 1 minute and 15 seconds.

title: Divinity
directions: Stir sugar, corn syrup and water over low heat until sugar is dissolved., Cook, without stirring, to 260° on candy thermometer (or until small amount of mixture dropped into very cold water forms a hard ball).

title: Lemon Cookies
directions: Mix all ingredients well with a spoon., Roll into quarter-size balls., Roll into powdered sugar and bake at 350° for 15 minutes.

title: English Pea Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients, except cheese, oleo and Ritz crackers. Spread the cheese on top after putting the ingredients in a casserole dish., Melt oleo; crumble Ritz crackers (use your judgment as to how many)., Mix crumbs and oleo., Spread on top of cheese., Bake at 400° for 20 minutes.

title: Spinach Enchilada Casserole
directions: Brown meat with onion and garlic; drain., Add tomatoes with green chilies, tomato sauce, tomatoes, bell pepper, lime juice and salt., Simmer, uncovered, 15 minutes, stirring occasionally. Arrange 6 tortillas on bottom and up sides of lightly greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish, overlapping as necessary., Top with half the meat mixture., Arrange remaining tortillas, overlapping as necessary., Spread sour cream evenly over tortillas., Top with remaining meat mixture., Bake at 350° about 30 minutes or until hot and bubbly., Remove from oven; sprinkle with cheeses., Let stand 10 minutes; cut into squares to serve., Garnish with lettuce, if desired, and olives., Serve with picante sauce, if desired., Makes 8 servings.

title: No Bake Cookies
directions: Combine and boil sugar, butter and milk 1 minute., Stir in oatmeal, coconut, nuts and vanilla., Drop by spoonfuls onto waxed paper.

title: Sausage Balls
directions: Melt cheese in the top of a double boiler, stirring frequently., Combine cheese, sausage and biscuit mix; mix well. Shape into 1 inch balls., Place on ungreased cookie sheet., Bake at 350° for 15 minutes., Yield:, about 4 dozen.

title: Pepper Steak
directions: Fry beef in the butter and sprinkle with garlic powder., Cook, stirring slightly, until browned., Remove meat from pan. Add onion and green pepper., Saute about 2 minutes., Return meat to skillet along with tomatoes and bouillon cube., Simmer about 5 minutes. Blend together the next 5 ingredients., Stir into the meat mixture and simmer until tender, stirring once in awhile., Add drained mushrooms a few minutes before serving., Serve with hot rice and/or chow mein noodles.

title: Layered Lettuce Salad
directions: Tear lettuce into small pieces., Place in a 9 x 12-inch glass dish., Layer next 6 ingredients in order given., Add sugar to mayonnaise and spread over top as you would frosting., Top with grated cheese., Cover and refrigerate for at least 8 to 12 hours. Garnish with bacon bits and parsley.

title: Pineapple Cheese Ball
directions: Drain pineapple., Soften cream cheese and combine with other ingredients including 1/2 cup of nuts., Put into refrigerator for 1 1/2 hours., Take out and roll in remainder of nuts.

title: Old-Fashioned Meat Loaf
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Mix all ingredients., Place in loaf pan and bake for 1 hour.

title: Asparagus Casserole
directions: First place the buttered slices of toast on bottom of a Pyrex baking dish., Then add, one at a time, 1/2 asparagus, 1/2 English peas and 1/2 cream of mushroom soup., Repeat the steps as needed to fill up the baking dish., Bake at 350° until lightly browned. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Milk Shakes
directions: Spin all ingredients together in the blender or food processor., Serves 1.

title: Reese'S Candy(Club Member: Renee Evans)
directions: Mix first 4 ingredients together., Press out onto a 10 x 14-inch cookie pan., Melt chips and wax together and spread over crust., Refrigerate only 15 minutes., Take out and cut into candy squares., Return to refrigerator.

title: Reese'S Candy
directions: Combine ingredients and put in a greased 9 x 13-inch glass dish., Melt chips in microwave; pour on top of fudge mixture. Chill well several hours., Cut pieces at room temperature.

title: Pork Chop Casserole
directions: Grease a 9 x 15-inch pan., Layer onions, carrots and potatoes in pan., Salt and pepper to taste and dot with butter.

title: Apple Dumplings
directions: Make syrup and bring to a hard boil. Add 8 finely chopped apples. Roll dough as for pie crust. Cut into squares. Add a small amount of syrup in bottom of a pan. Peel and core apples. Wrap each apple in a square of dough., Place in pan., Pour half of the syrup over dumplings., Make sure that the top of the dough is secured around apple., Bake at 350° for 60 minutes or until done. Ten minutes before removing from oven, pour remaining syrup on top of dumplings.

title: Applesauce Raisin Spice Cake
directions: In a large bowl, mix all ingredients., Pour batter into greased Bundt pan or tube pan., Bake at 350° until toothpick comes out clean.

title: Derby'S Easy Chicken
directions: Heat oil in a large skillet. Season the chicken with salt and pepper., Brown on both sides in the heated oil. Remove chicken from pan and set aside. Add green pepper, onion and garlic to the skillet and cook, stirring frequently, until softened, about 5 minutes. Return chicken to pan. Cover and cook on medium-low for about 45 to 50 minutes, stirring often. Gently stir in frozen peas and cook for another 5 minutes. Serve with potatoes, rice or noodles. Makes 4 servings.

title: Hamburger Mac Skillet
directions: In a skillet, cook the beef, onion, green pepper and garlic over medium heat until meat is not pink. Drain. Add the tomato juice, macaroni, Worcestershire sauce, salt and pepper. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer for 20 minutes or until macaroni is tender. Makes 2 servings.

title: Chicken Nuggets
directions: Cut up chicken breasts into cubes., Add salt, pepper and seasoned salt into flour., Dip chicken into flour, then in milk and egg mix, then back in flour., Drop into hot grease, about 350°, until golden brown.

title: Turkey And Dressing
directions: In saucepan, combine celery, bell pepper and onions., Cook until tender and season lightly, if desired., In a large mixing bowl, combine crumbled cornbread and crumbled loaf bread., Add sauteed vegetables, boiled eggs and seasonings; toss well., You may also add Pepperidge herb dressing for taste., Now, add turkey broth and mix until desired consistency is reached., You may stuff turkey and arrange turkey around or just bake in pan until done. Use a 350° oven.

title: Baked Spinach Cheese Squares
directions: Thaw spinach. Blend all ingredients and put in an 11 x 7-inch buttered casserole., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes., Cut in squares to serve.

title: Pizza Hotdog
directions: Preheat oven to 350°. Split buns and hotdogs lengthwise. Place layer of cheese on buns., Add hotdog slices to buns., Top with sauce., Sprinkle with parmesan cheese., Place on broiler pan until cheese melts.

title: Fruit Punch Bar
directions: Beat first 3 ingredients on high., Add next 4 ingredients and beat on medium., Spread in a greased 13 x 10 x 2-inch pan., Top with coconut and nuts., Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Christmas Morning Casserole
directions: Grease an oblong pan., Layer sausage, bread and cheese in pan. Mix all other ingredients., Slowly pour mixture over layers., Place in refrigerator overnight., The next morning, bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Vegetable Casserole
directions: Cook vegetables per directions on package. Drain off excess water when done. While vegetables are cooking, heat butter, celery soup and cheese on low heat until cheese is melted. Add sauce mixture to drained vegetables and pour in casserole dish. Top with crushed Ritz crackers. Drizzle a small amount of melted butter over cracker crumbs. Bake in a 350° oven until crackers are lightly browned.

title: Fall Vegetable Skillet
directions: Place ingredients in a large skillet and cook over low heat, covered, for 25 to 35 minutes to desired tenderness of vegetables. Serve., Enjoy!, This reheats well for leftovers.

title: Garlic Roasting Chicken
directions: Rinse chicken and pat dry with paper towels., Stir butter (oleo) and garlic together in small bowl until well blended. Using your fingers, gently loosen skin on breast and smear about 2 teaspoons of oleo mixture under skin., Spread remaining mixture over outside of chicken., Add salt and pepper., Bake on rack in pan at 375° for approximately 65 minutes.

title: Low-Calorie Preserves
directions: Cook 3 to 4 minutes on high., Sprinkle 1 tsp. unflavored gelatin in cooked fruit, dissolve and cool.

title: Molasses Cookies
directions: Melt shortening then let cool., Ad sugar, molasses and egg. Mix well with mixer., Sift dry ingredients together; add to first mixture., Chill well., Form into balls and roll in sugar., Place on cookie sheet and bake at 350 degrees until they start to crack. About 6 - 8 minutes., Remove from oven., Leave on cookie sheets for a few minutes., Makes about 3 dozen.

title: One Hour Italian Casserole
directions: Brown ground turkey in skillet., Drain off excess fat., Add meat into spaghetti sauce and simmer over stove while preparing the rest of the recipe., Prepare pasta according to directions on box., Spray with nonstick oil; add pasta and pour meat sauce over. Arrange pepperoni on top., Sprinkle shredded cheese over the top. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes., Let sit 10 minutes and sprinkle with grated cheese., Makes 6 servings.

title: Angel Biscuits
directions: Mix dry ingredients thoroughly and blend into liquids., Mix in a large bowl and refrigerate., Use amount as needed to bake. Biscuits do not have to rise.

title: Artichoke Dip
directions: Cook in small baking dish at 350° for 20 minutes., Sprinkle with paprika before serving.

title: Easy Baked Alaska
directions: Bake cake mix in 2 layer pans, 8 x 1 1/2-inches, as directed on package., (Freeze one layer for future use.) Line 1 1/2-quart bowl with aluminum foil., Pack ice cream into bowl; freeze until firm., Cover baking sheet with aluminum foil., Place cake layer on baking sheet., Invert bowl with ice cream onto cake; remove bowl and foil., Freeze cake and ice cream until firm., Just before serving, heat oven to 500°., Prepare frosting mix as directed on package., Working quickly, completely cover cake and ice cream with frosting, carefully sealing it to foil on sheet., Bake 3 to 5 minutes or until light brown., Trim foil to edge of frosting; transfer cake to service plate., Serve immediately., Makes 12 servings.

title: Sunny Jim Peanut Butter Swirls
directions: Mix shortening, sugar, peanut butter, eggs and milk., Add flour, salt and soda., Melt chocolate chips., Divide dough and roll each out into oblong., Spread melted chocolate and roll. Refrigerate for 10 minutes., Slice and cook for 8 to 10 minutes in a 350° oven.

title: Frozen Punch
directions: Put punch in freezer., Put frozen slushy punch in punch bowl and add ginger ale or Sprite when ready to serve.

title: Angel Sweets
directions: Melt chocolate and butter in small saucepan over low heat. Remove and blend in egg., Stir in the rest except coconut., Shape in balls., Roll in coconut., Refrigerate on waxed baking sheet.

title: Turkey Pie
directions: *If making your own crust, add a dash of thyme or poultry seasoning to flour., If using prepared crust, just cut strips to fit whatever pan you use.

title: Violet Jelly
directions: Fill any size glass jar with violet blossoms., Cover with boiling water., Put lid on jar and let blossoms infuse for 24 hours., The next day, open the jar and strain the blue infusion, discarding the spent violets., Measure out 2 cups of the infusion and add the juice of 1 lemon and 1 package of Sure-Jell., Bring just to a boil and immediately add sugar., Bring back to a boil and boil hard for 1 minute., Pour into hot sterilized jars or glasses and seal.

title: Graham Cracker Cookie Bar
directions: Combine nuts, sugar and butter in saucepan and boil 2 minutes. In the meantime, break graham crackers where scored and place in bottom of a large jelly roll pan or cookie sheet that has been lined with aluminum foil., Placing crackers close together; pour mixture over crackers., Bake in a 350° oven for 10 minutes., Watch closely., Cool and remove from pan with spatula.

title: Zucchini Appetizers
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Grease oblong pan, 13 x 9 x 2-inch., Mix all ingredients., Spread in pan., Bake until golden brown, about 1/2 hour., Cut into pieces, about 2 x 1-inch.

title: Swedish Pancakes
directions: Add eggs to the milk., Add to flour, salt and sugar; beat until smooth., Add butter., Pour on hot griddle as thin as possible to make pancakes.

title: Pecan Pie
directions: Cream, butter;, add, sugar gradually and cream together until light, and fluffy., Add remaining ingredients and blend well. Pour, into pastry shell., Bake on lower shelf in moderate oven (375°) for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Broccoli And Cauliflower Salad
directions: Mix together in a bowl., Add dressing.

title: Brandy Cheese Ball
directions: Beat Blue cheese, cream cheese, garlic, parsley and brandy in a small bowl on low speed until smooth., Cover and refrigerate about 6 hours or until firm.

title: Favorite Casserole
directions: Brown ground beef and drain., Cook macaroni as directed and drain., Combine all ingredients in large casserole and bake at 350° for 45 minutes., Serve topped with Parmesan cheese.

title: Pineapple Lime Ring
directions: Dissolve jello in boiling water., Add cold water and juice. Gradually add jello to cream cheese, mixing well until blended. Chill until thickened but not set., Fold in marshmallow, pineapple and nuts., Pour in 6-cup ring mold., Chill until firm.

title: Carrot Souffle
directions: Soak crumbs in milk for, 10 minutes. Grease a 1-quart casserole., Combine crumbs, egg yolks, carrots, onion, cheese, salt and pepper., Beat egg whites until stiff, but not dry. Fold into carrot mixture., Bake in preheated 350° oven for 40 minutes or until set.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
directions: Combine potatoes and eggs., Melt butter; add sour cream and add to mixture., Pour mixture into casserole., Top with Ritz crackers., Heat thoroughly, approximately 45 minutes, at 350°.

title: Brunswick Stew
directions: Boil chicken and cut into small pieces., Add ground beef to chicken broth and boil a few minutes., Add vegetables and sauces. Cook about 4 hours.

title: Almond Crescents
directions: Blend together first 6 ingredients; add finely chopped nuts or mini chocolate chips., Shape into crescents and bake on ungreased cookie sheet 15 to 18 minutes until light golden brown., Sift powdered sugar over crescents while still warm., Makes about 4 dozen.

title: Lucille'S Mexican Casserole
directions: Brown meat and onion., Drain., Add beans, soup and tomatoes. Simmer for 5 or 10 minutes., Stir often., Place tortilla chips in large casserole dish., Pour meat mixture over chips., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes., Place cheese on top during last 5 minutes of baking.

title: Salsa Cheese Bake
directions: Cook garlic in oil 1 minute., Stir in next 6 ingredients. Heat to boiling constantly stirring., Reduce heat & simmer until thickened about 3 minutes., Cook & drain sausage, stir in 1 c. salsa mixture., In ungreased casserole dish layer 1/2 of cheese (sliced 1/4 inches) then sausage mixture., Top with 1/2 cheese. Bake uncovered at 400 degrees 8-10 minutes., Heat remaining salsa mixture & pour over cheese., Serve with chips.

title: Banana Bread
directions: Sift together, flour,, soda,, salt and cream of tartar. Set aside., Cream, together, shortening,, sugar and eggs; beat until fluffy., Add, flour mixture in small amounts alternately with bananas, to, egg, mixture., Beat, until smooth after each addition., Place, in, well-greased, loaf, pan and bake in 350° oven for about, 1, hour or until bread is done., Makes 1 loaf. (This Banana Bread has cake like texture and flavor and can be served as cake.), One, may, also add 1/4 cup chopped pecans to dough before baking., When Banana Bread is baked and hot, pour the glaze over it.

title: Vegetable-Cheese Bake
directions: In a saucepan, combine frozen vegetables and boiling water. Bring to boil again., Cover and simmer 5 minutes., Drain well. Melt the butter in a saucepan., Blend in flour., Cook 1 minute. Gradually stir in milk., Simmer, stirring until smooth and thickened., Add cheese and seasonings., Mix in vegetables, onions and pimentos., Spread into buttered 1-quart casserole., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until bubbly and browned.

title: Vegetable Marinade With Tangy Dressing
directions: Heat together vinegar, salt, pepper, sugar and oil until sugar is dissolved., Set aside to cool., Place vegetables in large bowl and pour dressing over vegetable mixture., Refrigerate overnight. Serves 6 to 8.

title: No Bake Pretzel Dessert
directions: Mix pretzels and cracker crumbs with Sweet 'N Low and melted margarine., Press into a 9 x 9-inch pan., Chill overnight.

title: Taco Dip
directions: Smooth the cream cheese over a dinner plate., Pour salsa over cream cheese., Spread black olives over salsa., Sprinkle cheese on top., Serve with Fritos or corn chips.

title: Roasted Chicken And Potatoes
directions: Oven should be preheated 10 minutes before using it to a temperature of 350°., Poke holes in chicken and season chicken in holes, inside cavity and outside with adobo, oregano and garlic. Soften butter stick in microwave and place half of it inside cavity and rub on all of the outside the other half of the softened butter., Place chicken, breast down, in a pan big enough to also hold potatoes later on., Place in oven and spread melted butter over chicken frequently., As soon as chicken is placed in oven, start to prepare potatoes., Chicken should cook in oven for 1 1/2 hours (set timer when chicken is placed in oven).

title: Cheese Puffs
directions: Separate biscuits; cut into thirds., Wrap dough around cheese cubes; seal well. Fry in hot oil for 2 to 3 minutes until golden brown. Yield: 30 puffs.

title: Butterscotch Cookies
directions: Mix all ingredients., Make four small rolls and wrap in wax paper., Place, in refrigerator., When ready to bake, slice and place on cookie sheet., Bake at 350° about seven minutes.

title: Barbecue Brisket
directions: Saturate both sides with liquid smoke., Sprinkle with meat tenderizer, celery salt, onion, salt, garlic salt and Worcestershire sauce according to personal taste., Marinate overnight in foil., Bake at 250° for 5 1/2 hours., Last 1/2 hour, uncover and cover with barbecue sauce.

title: County Fair Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Sift flour, baking soda, salt, cinnamon and nutmeg onto wax paper., Combine raisins and water in small saucepan; bring to boiling; remove from heat., Cover; cool to room temperature., Beat shortening and sugar well; beat in eggs and vanilla., Blend flour mixture into shortening mixture until smooth., Add cooled raisins and liquid and oats., Mix well., Cover bowl; chill at least 1 hour., Drop cookies from teaspoons onto lightly greased cookie sheets, about 2 inches apart., Bake in oven at 350° for 10 minutes or until evenly brown., Transfer at once to wire racks to cool. Store in container with tight fitting lid.

title: Linguine Al Pesto
directions: Method 1:, Drain 1 can of pinto beans., Mash., Cook in bacon grease or lard.

title: Toffee Cookies
directions: Break graham crackers into fourths and lay them down on a jelly roll pan evenly (should fill the pan). Then bring to a boil the butter and brown sugar on medium-high heat. Let boil 2 minutes.

title: Slime
directions: Place 1/2 cup of cornstarch in a small bowl., Gradually stir in 1/4 cup of water., If mixture is too dry, add more water., If too runny, add more cornstarch., Food coloring may be added, if desired., Slime will feel dry and solid to the touch, but if picked up, will dribble through your fingers., If hit, it will be solid, but if finger is placed in the bowl gently, it will be liquid., Have fun!

title: Chocolate Oatmeal Pie
directions: Preheat oven to 300°., Combine the first 7 ingredients listed in a mixing bowl., Pour the mixture into a pie shell., Bake at 300° for 45 minutes, or until done.

title: Peter Paul Mound Cake
directions: Cream Crisco; add sugar and beat until fluffy., Add whole eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition., Add vanilla to milk; sift flour together and add part of the flour mixture., Add milk and then remaining flour to batter., Beat until smooth and thoroughly mixed, but do not overbeat., Pour batter into 3 greased and lightly floured cake pans., Bake 25 to 30 minutes in preheated 350° oven.

title: Sunday Pot Roast
directions: Place roast in slow cooker and sprinkle with onion soup mix. In small bowl, combine soup and water until blended. Pour over roast. Cover and cook on low 7 to 9 hours.

title: Get Together Punch
directions: Day before:, Pour 1 can punch into 1 1/2-quart ring mold, freeze., Mix remaining punch, pineapple juice, lemonade and club soda in punch bowl., Just before serving, unmold frozen punch ring carefully., Place in bowl, garnish as desired., Makes approximately 2 quarts, 16 (4-ounce) servings.

title: Three Bean Salad
directions: Drain all beans., Mix sugar, oil, vinegar, salt and pepper. Add beans, green pepper and pimento to oil mixture., Chill., Make at least the night before.

title: Quick Cookies
directions: Mix cake mix, vegetable oil, and eggs., Add other ingredients of choice., Mix well, then drop tsp. of dough about 2 inches apart on an ungreased cookie sheet.

title: Zucchini Quiche
directions: Saute zucchini and onions until tender, about 10 minutes., Add spices., Combine eggs and vegetable mixture., Lay crescent rolls in quiche dish to form crust., Rub with mustard., Pour mixture over crust., Bake as you would crescent rolls.

title: Divinity Fudge
directions: Mix, sugar,, syrup and water together and cook, stirring occasionally, until, mixture, forms, a soft ball in cold water. Beat the, egg, whites, until, stiff, and pour the other mixture slowly, over, the egg whites, beating constantly while pouring. Beat until thick., Stir nuts in and drop by spoonfuls.

title: Zucchini Nut Bread
directions: Beat eggs; gradually add sugar and oil., Combine dry ingredients., Add to first mixture and alternate with zucchini. Stir in raisins, walnuts and vanilla., Use 2 greased and floured loaf pans., Bake at 350° for 55 minutes or until done.

title: Frosting
directions: In top of double boiler, combine egg whites and honey., Beat 1 minute with electric beater (hand or electric type), to combine ingredients., Cook over rapidly boiling water (water in bottom should not touch top of double boiler), beating constantly until soft peaks form when beater is slowly raised., Allow about 10 minutes for beating to get proper consistency., Remove from boiling water., Add vanilla; continue heating until frosting is thick enough to spread, about 4 minutes., Yields enough frosting for a 9-inch 2 layer cake.

title: Cinnamon Twist
directions: Mix and put on a board and roll to an oblong shape., Melt butter and spread over dough., Sprinkle brown sugar and cinnamon over half of the dough., Fold over other half and pat thin., Cut into 1/2 inch strips and twist. Let rise 1 hour and bake in 375 degrees till light brown, This makes 24 twist., May be frosted with powdered sugar frosting.

title: Zucchini Casserole
directions: Steam zucchini, onion and carrots for 5 minutes., Drain well. Combine soup and sour cream., Stir in zucchini mixture., Spread 1/2 of the stuffing mixture on bottom of greased casserole dish. Spoon in zucchini and top with remainder of stuffing., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Choco-Scotch Pound Cake
directions: Melt chocolate and butterscotch bits over hot water or in microwave., Cool., Cream shortening and sugar., Add eggs, vanilla and buttermilk., Sift dry ingredients and add to egg mixture and cooled chocolate mixture and stir well., Pour into greased and floured 10-inch tube pan., Bake at 300° for 1 1/2 to 2 hours. Cool on rack., Remove from pan., Dust with powdered sugar or glaze, if desired.

title: Cheese Ball
directions: Mix all ingredients, except pecans., Shape into 2 smaller balls or logs., Roll in pecans. Wrap in plastic wrap until ready to use.

title: Baked Cheese Spread
directions: Mix all together. Put in small casserole or souffle dish. Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes. Serve warm with Club crackers.

title: French Onion Soup
directions: Peel and cut onions into very thin slices., Cook onion slices in butter over very low heat., Add salt and pepper according to taste., Sprinkle in flour, stirring constantly to thicken butter/onion mixture., Slowly add beef broth and water, then bring to boil., Simmer with pan covered for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Noodles Romanoff
directions: Power Level:, High (100%) and Medium (50%)., Total Cooking Time: 23 to 29 minutes.

title: Strawberry Jello Cake
directions: Empty cake mix in a large mixing bowl., Add all other ingredients and beat 3 minutes., Grease and flour 2 round pans or 1 sheath cake pan. Bake at 350° until done (usually about 30 minutes).

title: Reese'S Peanut Butter Bars
directions: Mix together graham cracker crumbs and margarine., Press graham cracker mixture into cookie sheet or large cake pan., Mix together powdered sugar and peanut butter., Press peanut butter mixture on top of graham cracker layer evenly., Melt chocolate chips and pour on top., Let cool and cut into squares when firm.

title: Baked Fish Loaf
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Drain and flake fish., Add onion and capers to fish., In separate dish, combine mayonnaise, water, cream, salt, paprika and stir until smooth., Add 1/2 of this cream sauce to fish and mix well., Place fish mixture in buttered loaf pan or baking dish., Bake in 350° oven for 30 minutes., Use the remaining sauce, after the curry is mixed into it, to spread over the fish loaf slices., It can be cut into six slices while it is still hot and the sauce spooned over the slices., This is a good one for dieters.

title: Party Crunch Mix
directions: Heat oven to 250°., Combine both cereals and noodles in a 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan., Set aside., Combine the remaining ingredients in small bowl and pour over cereal mixture., Stir to cool evenly. Bake 1 hour, stirring every 20 minutes., Cool.

title: Marinated Brussels Sprouts
directions: Cook sprouts in 2-inches boiling, salted water for 4 to 6 minutes or until just tender; drain., Place in shallow bowl with celery and tomatoes., Pour on dressing; cover and chill at least 2 hours., Drain before serving., Spoon into lettuce-lined bowl. Makes 4 servings.

title: Icy Punch
directions: 1., Mix packages of jello with 3 cups hot water to dissolve and add 3 cups cold water., Set aside.

title: Barbecue Sauce
directions: Cook for 15 minutes slowly or until fairly thick., Serve hot on sausage rolls., This sauce may be made up and kept in a covered jar., Put in cool place.

title: Monkey Bread
directions: Cut biscuits in fourths., Mix sugar and cinnamon together. Place in plastic bag., Drop pieces of biscuits in the sugar mixture., Shake until well coated., Place coated biscuits in a well-greased angel food cake pan., Mix brown sugar and oleo in a saucepan and heat until mixture comes just to a boil., Pour mixture over biscuits., Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

title: Fluffy Fruit Salad
directions: Drain pineapple, reserving 1 c. juice in small saucepan., Set pineapple aside., To saucepan, add sugar, flour, eggs, orange juice, lemon juice and oil., Bring to a boil, stirring constantly. Boil 1 minute, remove from heat and chill., In salad bowl, combine pineapple, fruit cocktail, oranges and bananas., Fold in Cool Whip and chilled sauce., Chill several hours.

title: Barbecue Beef
directions: Cook beef until tender enough to mash easily., Add shredded beef to rest of ingredients., Cook down to proper consistency. Add 1 tablespoon A.1. sauce, if desired.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Cream margarine and sugar., Add eggs., Mix and stir in dry ingredients and raisins., Drop by spoon onto cookie sheet or roll into 4 logs., Chill and slice., Bake 9 to 10 minutes at 325° on greased pan., I steam the raisins for a few minutes.

title: Ritz Torte
directions: Beat egg whites stiff., Add sugar and vanilla., Beat well on high speed., With rolling pin, roll crackers together with baking powder on waxed paper., Stir into egg white mixture., Fold in chopped nuts., Spread into a 9-inch greased pie tin., Bake in a 350° oven for 20 to 25 minutes., When cool and before serving, top with whipped cream and shaved chocolate.

title: Lynn'S Lionel Cake
directions: Mix first 3 ingredients together and cool., Mix next 4 ingredients with beaters., Combine last 4 ingredients and add to mixture by hand., Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350° in a 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Pecan Pie
directions: Mix in order as listed., Pour into 2 unbaked pie shells., Bake at 325° for 45 minutes.

title: Lemon Sauce
directions: Combine and stir until thick., Cool and store in refrigerator. Great for pound cake and other desserts.

title: Fabulous Beef Fajitas
directions: In a large resealable plastic bag, combine 1/4 cup salad dressing and chili powder; add steak., Seal and turn to coat; refrigerate for 30 minutes., In a skillet, saute peppers and onion in remaining salad dressing until crisp and tender., Remove and keep warm.	Drain steak, discarding marinade in skillet, saute steak for 6-10 minutes or until no longer pink., Return vegetables to pan., Heat through and spoon meat and vegetables down center of tortillas; fold in sides., Yield:, 4-6 servings.

title: Cheddar Potatoes
directions: Mix together and put in 9 x 13-inch buttered pan., Mix together 1 1/2 cups corn flake crumbs and 1/2 cup melted margarine., Sprinkle over top and bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Home Baked Beans
directions: Wash beans; cover with water and soak overnight., Next morning, cook slowly until skins burst or until just tender. Drain, reserving liquid., Place half the beans in the bean pot or casserole., Bury part of pork in the beans and half of combined remaining ingredients., Add remaining beans and seasonings., Place remaining salt pork over top., Cover with bean liquid and bake in 250° to 300° oven between 6 to 8 hours., Serves 6 to 8 people.

title: Sweet Potato Pie
directions: Cook, peel and mash potatoes., Beat egg whites and set aside. Using an electric mixer, blend potatoes, egg yolks, sugar, nutmeg, allspice and margarine until smooth., Fold in egg whites., Pour in pie shell and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Baked Indian Pudding
directions: Heat oven to 325°., Butter a deep 2-quart casserole., Heat milk and sugar in a saucepan over low heat until tiny bubbles appear around edge of pan. Gradually stir in corn meal; cook, stirring constantly, until smooth and slightly thickened., Remove from heat., Stir in eggs, cinnamon, ginger, salt and molasses (syrup)., Stir together thoroughly., Pour into prepared casserole. Bake, uncovered, 1 to 1 1/2 hours., Serve hot as is, or with vanilla ice cream., Makes 6 servings.

title: Tomato Soup Cake
directions: Cream butter and sugar well., Sift flour; measure and resift 3 times with spices and salt., Alternately add dry ingredients with soda mixture., Pour into greased loaf or cake pan., Cook at 350° for 45 minutes., Top with cream icing.

title: Icebox Pickles
directions: Heat vinegar until salt and sugar dissolve., Cool and pour over cucumber slices, onions and spices., Refrigerate., Will be ready in seven days.

title: Chocolate Chip Cheesecake
directions: Preheat oven to 300°., Combine cookie crumbs and margarine; press firmly on bottom of 9-inch spring-form pan.

title: Fruit Cake Cookies
directions: Cream shortening and sugar; add eggs and vanilla and beat well. Mix flour with soda and cinnamon; add to creamed mixture and mix together. Cut up the candied fruits; add nut pieces and mix with the cookie dough. Spoon onto greased cookie sheets. Bake at 350° for 10 minutes. Makes about 4 to 5 dozen cookies.

title: Pepper Steak
directions: Thinly slice steak diagonally., Brown with onion in oil., Stir in gravy mix, water and soy sauce., Stir until thickened., Cover and simmer 30 minutes., Add bell peppers, cut in thin strips, and tomato, cut in wedges., Simmer 10 minutes., Serve over rice.

title: Creamy Cheesecake Pie
directions: Beat cream cheese., Add eggs, sugar, vanilla and lemon peel. Blend until fluffy., Pour this into unbaked crust., Bake until firm, 25 to 30 minutes at 350°., This is better after chilling for at least 8 hours., Top with strawberries; it's great.

title: Honey Cakes
directions: Mix first 5 ingredients; add remaining ingredients., Mix and pat out into a 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake 20 minutes at 350°.

title: Strawberry Pizza
directions: Mix together and press into pizza pan., Bake in 350° oven for 10 to 15 minutes., Let cool.

title: Basic Pasta(Noodle Dough)
directions: Put flour and salt in mixing bowl., Make a well in the center of the flour mixture and in it put the eggs and oil., Mix together with your fingers., Knead the dough until smooth, adding more flour or a few drops of water as necessary., Dough may also be made using a mixer with a dough hook or in a food processor.

title: Texan Pecan Pie
directions: Mix well., Put in 9-inch pastry., Cook for 1 hour at 325°.

title: Italian Artichoke Dip
directions: Drain artichokes and mix all ingredients; sprinkle with black pepper and bake in a quiche dish at 350° for 15 minutes., Serve with crackers.

title: Jonna'S Baked Quail
directions: Salt and pepper birds., Brown quail in oil., Place in Dutch oven., Saute onion, parsley and celery., Add broth and mushrooms and stir well., Pour over quail., Cover and bake at 350° for 1 hour or until tender.

title: Artichoke Hors D'Oeuvres
directions: Marinate drained artichoke bottoms in dressing overnight. Drain and place artichoke bottoms in baking dish. Fill each with thawed souffl., Dust with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 400° for 20 minutes.

title: Homemade Chicken Dumplings
directions: Boil chicken, onion, carrots and parsley until done., Add soup base enough to taste., Remove chicken to cool, then pick meat off bones.

title: Cheese Ball
directions: Mix all ingredients together and shape into a ball., Save some of the chopped dried beef to roll cheese ball in.

title: Blueberry Dumplings
directions: In saucepan bring blueberries, 1/2 cup sugar, dash of salt, lemon and water to a boil., Reduce to low heat., Sift together dry ingredients., Cut in butter, stir in milk and drop batter by spoonfuls on berries., Don't overlap., Cover., Cook 10 minutes.

title: Cheesy Ham Potato Casserole
directions: Saute onion in butter in a large saucepan until tender., Add flour and seasonings. Cook 1 minute, stirring constantly. Gradually add milk., Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly until thick., Add 1/2 cup cheese, stirring until cheese melts. Add ham and potatoes. Spoon into greased 2-quart shallow baking dish. Bake uncovered at 350° for 25 minutes. Sprinkle with remaining cheese.

title: Butterscotch Brownies
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Melt shortening., Remove from heat and blend in sugar., Cool., Stir in egg, then sifted dry ingredients. Add vanilla and nuts., Spread in greased 8-inch square pan., Bake 25 minutes., Do not overbake., Makes 16 (2-inch) squares.

title: Triple Cheese Dip
directions: Blend all ingredients thoroughly., Refrigerate 1/2 hour. Serve with corn diggers.

title: Creamy Sausage Stew
directions: Place potatoes in a 5-quart roasting pan., Add onions, peppers and sausage., Toss gently., Combine oil, basil, salt and pepper. Pour over the meat and vegetables; toss well., Cover and bake at 350° for 45 minutes; stir., Add the cream; cover and bake 30 to 40 minutes longer, or until potatoes are tender., Combine cornstarch and water; stir into stew., Place on stove top and bring to a boil, stirring constantly, until thickened.

title: Pilaf
directions: In saucepan, brown noodles in butter; stir often., Add remaining ingredients., Bring to a boil; stir., Cover; cook over low heat 20 to 25 minutes or until liquid is absorbed., Makes about, 2 cups.

title: Crunchy Fried Chicken
directions: Cut chicken up and remove skin. Mix flour salt and pepper in a paper bag. Put chicken in and coat well. Combine buttermilk and soda in a bowl, dip chicken in milk then reflour and fry.

title: Orange Muffins
directions: Cream margarine and sugar; add yogurt., Add dry ingredients and then raisins and nuts., Spray a muffin pan with Pam and fill cups., Bake at 350° for 18 to 20 minutes., Makes 12 large muffins.

title: Nutrasweet Homemade Ice Cream
directions: Mix first 4 ingredients well and then fill rest of freezer with skim milk.

title: Maple Apple Muffins
directions: Spray 12 muffin cups with vegetable spray., Combine first 5 ingredients., Mix well., Add milk, margarine, syrup and egg whites, mixing until just moist., Fold in apples., Fill muffin cups 3/4 full., Top with pecan halves., Bake 20 to 25 minutes at 400°., Cool slightly., Glaze.

title: Carbo Mexicana
directions: Combine all ingredients except salsa., Toss with salsa.

title: Eggnog
directions: Combine eggs, sweetened condensed milk, vanilla extract, rum extract and salt until thoroughly blended. Gradually beat in milk. Gently fold in whipped cream. Pour into serving cups or punch bowl. Sprinkle with nutmeg.

title: Baked Cranberry Sauce
directions: Wash and drain cranberries., In large bowl, combine sugar and cinnamon., Add cranberries and mix well., Spoon into a 9-inch square pan and cover with foil., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes., Add orange marmalade, lemon juice and walnuts to hot cranberry mixture, stirring well., Store in refrigerator.

title: Krunchy Krazy Korn
directions: Heat oven to 250°., Place popcorn in foil lined pan., In large saucepan, combine sugar, margarine and corn syrup., Bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring constantly., Simmer 2 minutes., Remove from heat and stir in soda and vanilla., Pour mixture evenly over popcorn; mix well., Bake at 250° for 30 minutes, stirring twice during baking time., Remove from pan immediately., Cool completely.

title: Rock Candy
directions: Mix it all up in a pot (don't stir)., Boil until it's 290° on the candy thermometer., Pour into a square pan thinly and let it cool until hard., After it cools, crack and eat., I hope you enjoy it.

title: Peach Bread
directions: Cream butter and sugar., Add eggs; beat well., Combine flour, baking powder, salt, soda and cinnamon., Add to creamed mixture. Stir in orange juice concentrate, vanilla and peaches.

title: Chicken Fanfare
directions: Remove skin from chicken., Pound between 2 pieces of waxed paper to 1/4-inch thick. Remove waxed paper., In a large bowl, combine stuffing ingredients, the mix, water, butter and raisins. Mix thoroughly., Place 1/3 cup stuffing mix on each chicken breast., Fold ends of chicken over the stuffing. Wrap chicken bundle with 3 slices of bacon., Combine topping ingredients of nuts, orange rind and sugar in pie plate. Roll chicken in nut mixture., Place on baking sheet.
