Sprinkle with remaining nut mixture. Bake in a 350° oven for 40 to 45 minutes., Makes 8 servings.

title: Chilled Potato Soup
directions: Stir potato flakes into hot water until smooth., Blend in butter and milk until well mixed., Add chicken stock base, Beau Monde and nutmeg, blending well., Stir in scallions., Turn into a 2-quart jar, cover tightly and chill overnight., Spoon into small soup cups to serve.

title: Blueberry Pineapple Cream
directions: You may use 2 cups fresh blueberries, 1/2 cup sugar and 1/2 cup water., Cook until thick and cool.

title: Mexican Breakfast
directions: Whisk sour cream, soup, green chilies, salsa, cumin and coriander together, in a mixing bowl., Saute sausage; drain on a paper, towel, and crumble., Melt butter in skillet; add eggs and cottage, cheese and blend., Add parsley and onion and cook lightly until, set., Add, 1, tablespoon, sauce mixture and the sausage. Remove from heat when set., Preheat oven to 325°.

title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
directions: Cream together margarine, Crisco and sugar., Add 5 eggs (one at	a time)., Add alternately dry and liquid ingredients. Add vanilla and lemon flavorings.

title: Cheese Chile Casserole Dish
directions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Cook pasta according to package and drain. Place ground beef, bell pepper and onion in large skillet. Cook and stir over medium heat 6-7 minutes or until beef is no longer pink, drain. Add taco seasoning and amount of water listed on package. Continue cooking according to package directions. Using any cookie cutter, cut shapes out of cheese; set aside. Chop remaining cheese. Combine chopped cheese, macaroni, seasoned meat mixture, chili beans, tomatoes, corn and salt; mix well. Spoon into baking pan. Bake for 30 minutes. Top with cheese shapes; continue baking 1-2 minutes longer or until cheese begins to melt.

title: Taco Roll-Ups
directions: Mix and spread on tortillas., Roll up tortilla and wrap in Saran Wrap overnight or at least 6 hours., Cut off in 3/4-inch slices., Serve with salsa sauce.

title: Grandma'S Cookies
directions: Cream together all but flour and nuts., Mix in flour and nuts. Form into logs about 1 1/2-inches in diamater; wrap in wax paper and freeze., Slice 1/4-inch thick., Cook at 350° for 7 to 10 minutes., Watch color carefully, after 7 minutes they go from white to burned., Remove from cookie sheet immediately.

title: Kyoto Stir-Fry(Serves 6.)
directions: Place thinly sliced beef into wok or large skillet; add cooking oil and brown over medium heat., Add all vegetables and stir constantly; cook until all vegetables are tender., Remove from heat., In small saucepan, combine cooking sherry and cornstarch over low heat., Stir until smooth., Stir in soy sauce and all spices., Add sauce to the meat and vegetable mixture over medium to high heat and simmer 5 minutes., Serve immediately.

title: Magic Biscuits
directions: Dissolve yeast in 1/2 cup warm water., Sift flour, soda, salt, baking powder and sugar together., Cut in shortening with blender or fork., Add yeast and milk to dry mixture., Mix to stiff dough. Knead; pinch off biscuits or roll out., Allow to rise for 10 minutes., Bake at 425°.

title: Cherry Delight
directions: Mix melted stick of margarine, graham cracker crumbs and the 2 tablespoons sugar together., Pat firmly in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 325° for 10 minutes. Cool.

title: Grandma Lewis' Stuffing
directions: Fry linguica and onion in small amount of oil., Add parsley.

title: Chewies
directions: Mix the first 3 ingredients well., Add remaining ingredients; mix until well blended., Bake in a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan for 45 minutes at 325°., Sprinkle top with powdered sugar while warm., When center sinks and pulls away from sides of pan, Chewies are done.

title: Mud Cake Chocolate Sheet
directions: Mix all dry ingredients and set aside., Bring all liquid to a boil in a small saucepan., Pour into dry ingredients and mix. Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan at 350°.

title: Zucchini Bread
directions: Mix together eggs, sugar, oil and vanilla. Sift together flour, soda, cinnamon, salt and baking powder. Add to the batter, mixing thoroughly. Pour into 2 greased and floured loaf pans. Bake in preheated 350° oven for, 1 hour. Wrap the warm bread in foil.

title: Dean'S Chocolate Fudge
directions: Cream margarine, sugar and milk in a 6-quart pan., Put on medium heat., Stir to full boil (soft ball, 230°)., Add marshmallow, bits and nuts., Stir., Pour into buttered pan.

title: Meat Loaf
directions: Combine all, ingredients and mix well.	Pack in greased loaf pan and bake at 375° for 1 hour.

title: Chicken And Cucumbers
directions: Bone chicken; remove skin and chop into half-inch pieces. Clean scallions; cut crosswise into quarter-inch pieces., Add to chicken., Add sugar, salt, soy sauce, wine, egg white and cornstarch to chicken., Marinate for 30 minutes., Peel cukes., Cut in half lengthwise; scoop out seeds., Sprinkle 1/2 teaspoon salt on cukes., Let sit for 15 to 20 minutes; drain., Cut into half-inch cubes., Smash garlic; chop into rice-size bits., Heat 1 tablespoon oil in wok., Stir-fry cukes for about 1 1/2 minutes; remove., Add 1 tablespoon water to chicken; stir well., Heat 1/4 cup oil and cook garlic for 15 seconds., Add chicken; cook for 1 minute., Add 2 tablespoons soy sauce and stir-fry for 15 to 20 seconds., Return cukes to pan., Stir-fry for 1 to 2 minutes.

title: Coquilles St. Jacques(This Is A Classic)
directions: Wash scallops and drain., In medium saucepan, cook and stir onion in butter until onion is tender., Add scallops, mushrooms, lemon juice, salt, marjoram, paprika and sherry; simmer, uncovered, exactly 2 minutes., Drain liquid from scallop mixture; set aside.

title: Purple Lady Salad
directions: Dissolve jello in boiling water and add the fruit., Mix well and chill until partially set. Fold in the whipped cream and chill until firm., A Bundt pan makes a pretty mold.

title: Cheese-Garlic Biscuits(Like The Ones From Red Lobster)
directions: Heat oven to 450°., Mix baking mix, milk and cheese until soft dough forms; beat vigorously for about 30 seconds., Drop dough by spoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet., Bake 8 to 10 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Peanut Butter Crackles
directions: In small bowl, combine flour, baking soda and salt., In large bowl, beat margarine and peanut butter until well blended., Beat in sugars until blended., Beat in egg and vanilla., Gradually beat in flour mixture until well mixed., Shape dough into 1-inch balls., Roll in granulated sugar., Place 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheets., Bake in preheated 375° oven for 10 minutes or until lightly browned., Remove from oven and quickly press star firmly into top of each cookie (cookies will crack around edges)., Remove to wire rack to cool completely.

title: Barbecue Pecans
directions: Combine first four ingredients., Stir in pecans and mix well. Spread pecans evenly in a shallow baking pan., Bake at 300° for 30 minutes, stirring frequently., Drain on paper towels., Sprinkle with salt, if desired., Yield: 4 cups.

title: Pumpkin Pie
directions: Mix filling ingredients in order., Pour into pie shell., Bake in a preheated 425° oven for 15 minutes; then reduce heat to 350° and continue baking for 45 minutes or until a knife blade comes out clean., Double this recipe for 2 pies.

title: Meat Loaf
directions: When thoroughly mixed, place into prepared pan., On top of mixture, add 1 tablespoon butter in small pats or 2 bacon slices cut in half., Bake around 1 hour or until brown., Serve hot or cold., Serves 4.

title: Beef Noodle
directions: Spread noodles in well- greased casserole., Top noodles with cottage cheese, sour cream, cream cheese and chives., Cover with remaining ingredients., Bake in preheated 350° oven for 45 minutes.

title: Coconut Pie
directions: Mix first eight ingredients and put in unbaked pie shell. Bake in 450° oven for 10 minutes, then reduce temperature to about 375° for 20 minutes.

title: Sausage Balls
directions: Mix sausage and cheese., Mix in Bisquick thoroughly., Make balls; roll them into bite-size balls., Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes., (Dough may be mixed and frozen ahead.)

title: Rich Dinner Rolls
directions: Scald milk., Stir in sugar, salt and margarine; cool to lukewarm., Sprinkle yeast into warm water., Add cooled milk mixture, eggs and 2 cups of flour; beat until smooth., Stir in enough remaining flour to make dough.

title: Bush'S Creamy Peanut Butter Pie
directions: Beat the egg yolks until creamy; set aside., Heat the milk in a double boiler to boiling., Combine the egg yolks, sugar, peanut butter, cornstarch and salt., Stir gradually into the milk and cook in the double boiler, stirring constantly until thick., Pour into the pie shell and refrigerate until chilled.

title: Hungarian Keiffels
directions: Crumble yeast in sour cream., Beat the egg yolks., Add cream, then mix with flour mixture., Knead ingredients to form a ball. Roll out in circles; fill with a nut filling., Bake 8 minutes in 350° oven., Brush with egg yolk and return to oven to bake 10 minutes more.

title: Chicken And Rice Casserole
directions: Chop up cooked chicken. Stir together with remaining ingredients. Spoon mixture evenly into 2 lightly greased 8-inch square baking dishes. Wrap one dish in heavy-duty foil and freeze. Bake remaining casserole at 350° for 55 minutes or until thoroughly heated. Yield: 4 servings per casserole.

title: Black Walnut Pie
directions: Cream butter, sugar and salt and mix well., Stir in walnuts. Pour into pie crust., Bake in 450° oven for 10 minutes, then lower temperature to 355° and bake until firm.

title: Minty Mallows
directions: Combine over hot (not boiling) water, sweetened milk and mint chocolate morsels., Stir until morsels are melted and mixture is smooth., In large bowl, combine marshmallows and nuts., Add chocolate mixture; mix well., Spread into foil-lined 9-inch square pan., Chill until firm, about 20 minutes.

title: Pineapple Tarts
directions: Drain pineapple from juice., Make a thick syrup of juice and 1 cup sugar., Roll out tart crust and spread thin layer of pineapple; sprinkle with dry sugar., Fold tart and fry slowly until golden brown., Place on platter and cover with pineapple syrup.

title: Orzo Salad
directions: Drain fruit and boil juice with sugar and egg., Pour over cooked orzo noodles., Let stand overnight., Next day, add fruit and Cool Whip., Very good.

title: Basil Tomato Tart
directions: Unfold pie crust according to package directions., Place in a 9-inch quiche dish or glass pie plate., Flute edge; press with the tines of a fork, if desired., Prebake according to package directions., Remove from oven., Sprinkle with 1/2 cup of the Mozzarella cheese., Cool on a wire rack.

title: Mint Julep
directions: Dissolve sugar in the bourbon., Crush mint against the inside of 10 ounce glass., Pack glass with crushed ice, add sweetened bourbon, stir, top with mint., Relax and enjoy.

title: Garlic Bread
directions: Cut bread in 1-inch slices almost down to the bottom crust, but not through it., Soften the butter and mix well with garlic. Spread between bread slices. Spread any remaining butter on top of the loaves., Bake in a 375° oven until brown and crisp (10 to 12 minutes). Serves 8.

title: Catalina Dressing Chicken
directions: Pour dressing over chicken; coat well., Cover., Refrigerate at least 30 minutes., Heat broiler (not necessary to heat gas broiler)., Place chicken on greased rack of broiler pan., Broil 5 to 7 inches from heat for 10 to 12 minutes, turning once.

title: Date Pudding
directions: Cut up dates., Dissolve soda in a little of the hot water, then pour all of hot water over dates., Add butter and stir well. Add sugar, flour, nuts and last, add egg, slightly beaten., Pour in greased tin and bake., This batter will be thin., Bake in a 350° oven for 35 minutes.

title: Marshmallow Waldorf Salad
directions: Place chopped apples in bowl; sprinkle with lemon juice., Add marshmallows, celery, walnuts and enough mayonnaise to moisten; toss lightly., Serve in lettuce cups; top with apple wedges.

title: Alice'S Butter Cake
directions: Cream sugar, oleo, and Crisco., Add eggs; beat well., Add flour, milk (3/4 cup milk and 1/4 cup water to make 1 cup) and flavoring; add nuts and cherries., Grease and flour tube pan. Start in cold oven., Turn temperature to 300°., Bake 1 hour and 45 minutes.

title: Punch Bowl Cake(Put In Punch Bowl)
directions: Mix up cake in sheet pan., After cake cools, cut in half. Crumble half of cake in bottom of punch bowl., Divide ingredients in half and layer over cake., Add second half of cake, crumbled. Repeat second half of ingredients., Top with last half of Cool Whip., Sprinkle with nuts or coconut and whole cherries if desired.

title: Peanut Butter Candy
directions: Melt white chocolate in double boiler over gently boiling water, stirring continually., When melted, add peanuts and peanut butter., Pour into pan and cool one hour., Cut into squares.

title: My Mom'S Strawberry Pie
directions: Boil together until thick 7-Up, sugar and cornstarch., Add Jell-O and boil 1 more minute., Let cool., Put sliced strawberries in crust and pour syrup mixture over strawberries.

title: Strawberry Bread
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Grease and flour two 9 x 5-inch loaf pans., In medium bowl, mix strawberries, eggs and oil., In large bowl, mix remaining ingredients., Add wet ingredients to dry ingredients and mix just until blended., Pour into pans., Bake 1 hour or until toothpick comes out clean.

title: Peanut Brittle
directions: Stir peanuts, sugar and salt; add syrup in 1 1/2 quart glass bowl., Microwave on High 7 to 8 minutes; stir well after 4 minutes. At end of 8 minutes, add butter and vanilla., Blend well., Return to microwave and cook on High 1 or 2 minutes more., Remove from oven and add baking soda., Stir until light and foamy., Pour immediately on greased cookie sheet., Cool 30 to 60 minutes., Break into pieces and store in airtight container.

title: Frosted Oatmeal Cake
directions: Combine butter, oats and boiling water in large mixing bowl. Let stand 20 minutes., Add brown sugar, white sugar and 2 unbeaten eggs., Mix well.

title: Lemon Pie
directions: Bake crust as directed; let cool., Mix together all ingredients, except sugar., Add sugar to suit taste., Pour into pie shell., Let set in refrigerator to thicken.

title: Reese'S Cookies
directions: Spray 3 tart muffin tins with Pam., Slice and quarter icebox cookies according to directions on package., Drop one-quarter chunk into each tart opening., Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes. While cookies are baking, peel the papers off the Reese's peanut butter cups., (Chill these before using.), As soon as the cookies are removed from oven, put a Reese's cup in each cookie., Leave in pan until cool and then place in freezer until chilled., Remove from pan., Keep refrigerated or in freezer until serving time.

title: Slush Punch
directions: Mix together., Freeze for three days., When ready to serve, thaw 3 hours then add 2 liters of 7-UP or Sprite.

title: Chow Mein Noodle Candy
directions: Melt butterscotch chips in bowl in microwave., Stir in noodles., Add peanuts., Drop by teaspoon on wax paper., Let stand until cool, about 20 minutes., Yields 4 dozen.

title: Potato Casserole
directions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees.

title: Veg-All Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients together except dressing mix and margarine., Pour into casserole dish., Sprinkle desired dressing mix over top of casserole., Melt margarine and dribble over top of casserole., Bake at 350° uncovered for about 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Broccoli Cornbread
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Mix first 5 ingredients in bowl; pour into melted buttered pan., Sprinkle Cheddar cheese to top., Bake 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Swordfish Steaks
directions: Clean steaks and place in shallow pan., Mix all other ingredients., Pour over steaks and refrigerate for 2 hours., Place steaks on greased (Pam) broiler pan., Cook 4 to 5 inches from heat for 8 minutes., Turn, baste and cook 5 minutes longer., Top with slivered almonds and thin lemon slices., Serves 4.

title: Mama'S Peanut Butter Cookies
directions: Mix sugars, vegetable oil, and peanut butter., Add eggs and vanilla., Sift in flour, salt and baking soda., Mix until well blended., Form into 1-inch balls., Press with thumb., Bake at 400° for 8 to 15 minutes., (All ovens are different)

title: Cabbage On The Grill
directions: Cut cabbage in 4 pieces., Wrap 1 bacon strip around each quarter or a pat of butter., Season and wrap in foil., Place on grill about 10 minutes., Turn over and cook about 10 minutes more.

title: Mom'S Double-Crispy Chicken
directions: Put crushed corn flakes cereal into shallow dish or pan., Set aside., In a small mixing bowl, beat egg and milk slightly., Add flour, salt and pepper., Mix until smooth.

title: Upside-Down Pizza
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., Brown ground beef and onion together in skillet., Drain fat., Add spaghetti sauce mix and tomato sauce. Simmer gently to let flavors combine for 10 minutes.

title: Cheese Biscuits
directions: Combine dry ingredients., Cut in butter and cheese., Add pimentos, milk; drop dough the size of an egg on greased cookie sheet., Bake at 375° for 10 to 15 minutes., Garlic powder can be used.

title: Shrimp Dip
directions: Mix cream cheese, sour cream, dressing and lemon juice well. Add shrimp., Chill for at least 1 hour., Serve on crackers.

title: Apple Pudding
directions: Mix and sift dry ingredients; add apples, eggs and melted butter., Stir until well blended., Bake in an 8-inch greased pan for 45 minutes at 350°.

title: Cottage Cheese Quiche
directions: In blender, combine cottage cheese, eggs, milk, paprika and salt., Line 10-inch pie shell with caraway seed and your favorite shredded cheese., Pour in cottage cheese mixture., Bake in 450° oven on lowest rack for 10 minutes., Reduce heat to 350° and bake 20 to 25 minutes longer or until done when knife inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Buttermilk Yeast Bread
directions: Combine 2, cups flour, the sugar, salt, baking soda and yeast in	large, bowl., Heat, buttermilk,, water and margarine until warm and add to the dry ingredients., Beat with electric mixer on medium speed for 2 minutes., Add 1 cup flour and beat on high speed, for	another, 2 minutes., Add 3 or more cups of flour to make, a, soft, dough., Knead about 5 minutes., Put in greased bowl; cover and let rise until double., Punch down and shape into 2 loaves., Cover and let rise., Bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Speedy Apple Crisp
directions: Spread apples in a 9 x 9-inch baking pan., Cut butter into remaining ingredients until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Sprinkle over apples., Bake at 375° for 30 to 35 minutes or until apples are tender and topping is golden., Serve warm., Yields 5 to 6 servings.

title: Chili Cheese Quiche(Appetizer)
directions: Beat eggs 4 to 5 minutes., Stir flour, salt and baking powder together., Add to eggs and mix well., Fold in Jack cheese, cottage cheese and chilies., Pour into greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan and bake in 350° oven for 40 minutes., Let stand 10 minutes before cutting., Can be served warm or cold.

title: Coconut Pie
directions: Beat sugar and eggs., Add 1/2 cup of buttermilk and 1 cup coconut., Melt 3/4 stick butter., Add flavoring last., Pour into pie crust., Bake at 350° for 35 minutes or until brown., Makes 1 pie.

title: Yellow Rice Casserole
directions: Cook rice following package directions., When done, stir in margarine and soup (do not add water to soup)., In casserole dish, layer rice, corn and cheese., Repeat, ending with cheese on top. Bake in 350° oven for 25 to 30 minutes or in microwave on High for 7 minutes and allow to stand for 10 to 15 minutes before serving.

title: Holiday Punch
directions: Combine juices and mix well., Pour over ice in punch bowl and add ginger ale., Garnish with maraschino cherries., Makes 25 punch cup servings.

title: Stir-Fried Broccoli With Mushrooms And Cashews
directions: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in wok or large skillet., Add broccoli, sugar and salt., Stir-fry for 3 minutes or until broccoli is tender/crisp., Add remaining oil, mushrooms, onions and nutmeg; stir-fry until added vegetables are tender-crisp, about 1 to 2 minutes., Sprinkle on cashews., Makes 6 servings.

title: Stuffed Green Peppers
directions: Saute onion; add ground beef and cook until color changes; drain off fat., Stir in 1/2 can tomato sauce and remaining ingredients and set aside., Cut green peppers in half lengthwise; remove core and seeds., Place peppers, hollow side up, in shallow casserole dish., Spoon beef mixture into pepper halves., Spoon remaining tomato sauce over peppers., Heat, covered loosely, with wax paper for 19 to 22 minutes or until peppers change color and become tender., Cover stuffed peppers with cheese (optional). Yields 6 servings.

title: Spinach Trenette Agata(Pasta)
directions: Cook pasta to al dente and drain., In large skillet, melt butter over medium-high heat and saute shrimp for 2 to 3 minutes or until shrimp are firm and opaque., Remove shrimp; set aside. Add tomatoes and mushrooms to skillet and saute for 5 minutes. Stir in brandy, basil, salt and pepper., Add cream and cook until sauce is reduced by 1/3, about 5 to 7 minutes., Stir in Parmesan. Reduce heat to low and add shrimp to sauce., Stir for 1 to 2 minutes to heat shrimp., In heated serving dish, pour sauce over warm pasta, toss gently and serve.

title: Easy Honey Barbecued Chicken
directions: Salt and pepper chicken pieces on all sides., Mix soy sauce, ketchup, mustard, wine and honey in an oblong dish., Add chicken and turn to coat well., Let stand at room temperature 2 hours, turning occasionally, or refrigerate overnight., Reserve marinade. Preheat grill, then turn to low and cook for 50 to 60 minutes with lid closed., Brush with marinade and turn chicken while it's cooking.

title: Tried And True Sugar Cookies
directions: Cream margarine and sugars., Add oil, eggs and vanilla; mix. Mix dry ingredients and stir into sugar mixture., Chill at least 2 hours., Place 1-inch balls on ungreased cookie sheet., Flatten with glass dipped in sugar., (I color my sugar with food coloring.), Bake at 350° for 9 to 12 minutes until bottom is golden brown.

title: Hearty Potato Soup
directions: In a large kettle, cook the potatoes, carrots and celery in water until tender (approximately 20 minutes)., Drain, reserving liquid., Set vegetables aside., In the same kettle, saute onion in butter until transparent., Stir in flour, salt and pepper. Gradually add milk, stirring constantly, until thickened., Gently stir in cooked vegetables., Add 1 cup or more of reserved liquid until soup is desired consistency.

title: Cottage Cheese Crumb Cake
directions: In large bowl, add the brown sugar, butter and flour. Mix as you would for pie dough. Take out 3/4 cup and set aside. To the large bowl, add the egg, cottage cheese, milk and baking soda. Beat on high speed. Stir in your favorite flavoring such as rum or vanilla. Pour into a 7 x 10 loaf pan and sprinkle the saved 3/4 cup of crumb mixture on top. Bake in a preheated oven at 350° for 35 minutes. Fast and easy.

title: Skillet Fish Italiano
directions: In large skillet, cook onion in margarine until tender., Add fish, lemon juice, oregano, zucchini and mushrooms; cover and simmer 10 minutes., Top with tomato and cheese; cover and simmer 2 minutes or until cheese melts., Serve immediately., Serves 4.

title: Cherries In The Snow
directions: Butter a 9 x 13-inch glass pan. Beat egg whites and cream of tartar, adding sugar a little at a time, until stiff peaks form. Add vanilla, nuts and crushed soda crackers. Mix well. Place into pan and bake at 350° for 30 minutes., Cool. Add Cool Whip making high peaks, and then add the cherries. Refrigerate any leftovers. Makes 8 large servings.

title: French-Style Green Beans
directions: Fry and drain bacon., Mix the chopped onions, bacon and A.1. sauce into the green beans., Heat 10 minutes.

title: Bogus Chocolate Chip Cookies
directions: Cream all ingredients except chocolate chips., Add chocolate chips., Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 375° for 6 minutes.

title: Fudge Pie
directions: Mix in order given., Pour in unbaked pie shell., Bake at 325° for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Walnut Tassies
directions: Cream the cream cheese, flour and margarine together., Shape into little balls., Press in very small muffin tins., Mix together brown sugar, egg, butter, salt, vanilla and nuts., Fill the crust with this mixture., Bake at 375° for 20 minutes., Makes 3 dozen.

title: Fruit Pizza
directions: Cut and arrange cookie dough on pizza pan, smoothing dough evenly over pan., Bake at 350° for 15 minutes., Sprinkle confectioners sugar over crust., Blend the cream cheese and whipped topping; spread over cooled cookie crust., Arrange fruit over cheese mixture., Sprinkle pecans over fruit., Pour Orange Sauce over top., Makes 10 to 12 servings.

title: Apple Cake
directions: Mix together flour, sugar and cinnamon. Mix together eggs, oil, vanilla and orange juice and add to flour mixture. Add remaining ingredients to mixture. Bake at 325° for 1 1/2 hours in a well-greased and floured tube pan. When cool, remove and punch holes with a drinking straw in top of cake. Pour Buttermilk Sauce over cake slowly.

title: Old-Fashioned Peanut Butter Cookies
directions: Mix first 4 ingredients; set aside., Beat margarine and peanut butter until smooth., Beat in sugars until blended, then eggs and vanilla., Add flour mixture., Shape into 1-inch balls., Place 2-inches apart on ungreased cookie sheets., Flatten slightly with fork., Bake at 350° for 12 minutes., Makes 6 dozen.

title: Cheddar Macaroni Salad
directions: Beat cheese together with, 1/4	cup, of the mayonnaise, minced onion, mustard and pepper sauce until well mixed., Cook macaroni according to package directions., Drain., Stir cheese mixture together with the, hot, macaroni., Let, cool., Combine all other ingredients., Stir together with macaroni mixture.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Cook chicken until real tender., Save the broth to prepare the dressing except for 1/2 cup., Pull all chicken meat from bone. Put 1 layer of dressing, then 2 chicken breasts and 1 can of soup. Repeat and sprinkle the top with dry mix., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Cheesy Potato Soup
directions: Peel potatoes and cut in cubes; slice celery and carrots., Chop onion and put all in cooking pot., Add water, parsley, bouillon, salt and pepper., Cook until vegetables are tender, about 30 minutes., Mix together milk and flour., Add to pot and cook until thick., Cut cheese into cubes and add to soup mixture., Cook until cheese melts.

title: Watergate Salad
directions: Combine all ingredients., Chill for at least 1 hour.

title: Hamburger Pan Meal
directions: Layer hamburger patties, potatoes and onions in a rectangular pan., Salt and pepper according to taste., Pour can of tomatoes over layers., Cover with foil., Bake in a 450° oven for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

title: Birds Nest Cookies
directions: Melt butterscotch pieces in microwave., Remove and add other ingredients., Drop by teaspoonfuls onto wax paper., Do not store in refrigerator.

title: Green Pepper Steak
directions: Cut steak in thin strips, combine with garlic and soy sauce. Heat oil in large frying pan and add beef and brown on high heat. Add vegetables and simmer for 30 minutes., Mix cornstarch and water, add to pan and stir until thickened., Makes 4 servings.

title: Raisin Or Currant Buns
directions: Sift flour once; measure. Add baking soda, salt and sugar; sift again. Cut in shortening. Add enough milk to make a stiff dough. Turn onto floured board. Knead slightly. Roll into a rectangle 1/4-inch thick. Spread with soft butter. Sprinkle with sugar, cinnamon and raisins or currants. Roll as for jelly roll. Cut in slices 3/4-inch thick. Place cut side down on baking sheet. Bake at 475° for 20 minutes. Makes 12 buns.

title: Percolator Punch
directions: Place in basket sugar, allspice, cloves and cinnamon sticks. Then perk.	If you have any leftover it can be put in the refrigerator and then reheated in the microwave.

title: Hoppin Black-Eyed Peas
directions: Saute onions in butter., Mix together with remaining ingredients and simmer until liquid is gone., Stir occasionally.

title: Butterscotch Cheesecake Squares
directions: Preheat oven to 350° (325° for glass dish)., In medium saucepan, melt morsels and margarine; stir in crumbs and nuts. Press half the mixture firmly onto bottom of greased 13 x 9-inch baking pan., In large mixer bowl, beat cheese until fluffy., Beat in Eagle Brand, egg and vanilla., Mix well., Pour into prepared pan., Top with remaining crumb mixture., Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until toothpick inserted near center comes out clean., Cool to room temperature., Chill before cutting into bars., Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Taco Bell Tacos
directions: Brown ground beef in skillet., Add 1 teaspoon salt, chili sauce and pepper., Simmer 5 to 10 minutes., Combine flour, cornmeal and 1 teaspoon salt in mixing bowl., Cut in shortening until particles are fine., Combine egg and water; sprinkle over flour mixture while stirring with fork until dough holds together., If dough is sticky, toss on well floured surface., Divide into 12 portions., Roll each portion on floured surface to a 6-inch circle., Fry in hot deep fat at 375° until golden brown, about 1 minute., Turn and brown other side., Remove from fat and immediately fill each with 1 to 2 tablespoons warm ground beef, cheese and lettuce., Fold in half. Makes 12 tacos.

title: Kelly'S Taco Pie
directions: Brown meat and onion., Add taco seasoning and cook according to directions., Spray a large casserole dish with Pam., Line dish with rolls and add about 1 cup crushed Doritos., Top with meat mixture., Spread sour cream and sprinkle cheese over all., Garnish with chips., Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

title: Fresh Vegetable Medley
directions: Arrange vegetables on largest round glass platter that will fit microwave., Place broccoli around edge; arrange cauliflower next to broccoli., Alternate squash, mushrooms and peppers toward center of dish., Combine melted butter, garlic salt and pepper and drizzle over vegetables., Cover with waxed paper and microwave 10 to 15 minutes., Vegetables should remain crisp, not mushy.

title: Pizza Crust
directions: Mix yeast and water; stir well., Mix flour, salt and sugar, then add oil., Stir in liquid; mix well., Let rise double., Spread on buttered cookie sheet and top with sauce and your favorite toppings., Bake at 425° for 20 to 30 minutes., Makes two.

title: Baked Sliced Potatoes
directions: Cut prepared potatoes into 1/4 inch slices., Place overlapping slices in oven-to-table 13 x 9-inch pan., Mix butter and oil. Brush slices with mixture., Pour remaining over potatoes. Sprinkle with garlic, salt and thyme., Bake at 400° for 25 to 30 minutes or until browned at edges., Serve immediately., Good served with broiled steaks or hamburgers, tossed green salad and crusty bread.

title: My Favorite Brownies
directions: Mix well the eggs, sugar and salt., Blend in vanilla., Add mixed flour and cocoa., Stir in melted margarine and pecans., Pour into 9 x 13-inch buttered pan., Bake for 30 minutes at 350°., Cool in pan., Cut into squares.

title: Herbed Shrimp And Feta Casserole
directions: Preheat oven to 350°. Coat bottom and sides of 8, x 12 inch baking dish with cooking spray. In separate bowl, blend eggs, milk, yogurt Feta and Swiss cheeses, parsley, basil, oregano and garlic. Spread half of pasta over bottom of baking dish. Cover with salsa. Add half of shrimp. Spread remaining pasta over shrimp. Pour and spread egg mixture over pasta. Add remaining shrimp and top with Mozzarella cheese. Bake 30 minutes. Remove from oven and let stand 10 minutes before serving.

title: Johnny Mozetta(Large Recipe; Feeds About 30 People)
directions: Fry onions, peppers and celery together., Fry meat and garlic together., Combine with first items in a large roaster., Add to preceeding mixture, all sauces, soup, olives and mushrooms., Let simmer 15 minutes., Add cooked noodles., Mix well., Cover with cheese., Bake 1 hour or until cheese browns., Can be made the day before and put into refrigerator., Uncover and reheat in a slow oven for about 2 hours.

title: St. John Banana Bread
directions: Cream, butter, and, sugar., Beat in eggs one at a time. Mix in	sifted dry ingredients., Beat in mashed bananas., Add nuts. Pour into greased and floured 9 x 5 x 3-inch pan., Bake at	350° for 50 to 60 minutes., While cake is still warm, pour melted butter, over top and sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon. Makes 1 loaf.

title: Homemade Turkey Soup
directions: Add all ingredients except egg noodles in large kettle., Add water to cover ingredients., Bring to boil., Turn down to simmer 1 hour, stirring occasionally., If using egg noodles, add and simmer another 20 minutes before serving.

title: Pretzel Jello
directions: Preheat oven to 400°., Mix pretzels, 3 tablespoons sugar and margarine and pat into a 13 x 9 cake pan. Bake 7 to 8 minutes until toasted. Set aside to cool.

title: Creamy Fudge
directions: Place chocolate in 1-quart casserole and melt 2 to 2 1/2 minutes on High power., Turn 1/4 turn halfway through., Add rest of ingredients., Pour into buttered container., Chill until firm. Makes 1 pound.

title: Enchilada Casserole
directions: Take 4 tablespoons shortening and melt in skillet., Then add chopped onions and 1 pound ground beef., Cook until meat loses red color., Then add 36 Dorito corn chips, 1 cup grated cheese, 1 can enchilada sauce, 2 cans tomato sauce and 1 tomato sauce can of water., Add salt and pepper to taste and 1 tablespoons comino spice., Pour into baking dish (8 x 12-inch), greased., Top all ingredients with grated cheese (1 cup) and 1 cup Frito corn chip crumbs., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes., Serves 6 to 8.

title: Turkey Tetrazzini
directions: Melt 3/4 cup of butter in a large saucepan., Remove from heat and stir in flour, salt and nutmeg., Gradually add 4 cups of milk and stock and bring to a boil, stirring constantly., Boil 2 minutes or until slightly thickened., In a small bowl, beat egg yolks with remaining milk; pour 2 tablespoons of hot mixture into yolks and then pour yolk mixture into saucepan, beating constantly until sauce is hot., Do not boil., Remove from heat and stir in sherry or wine.

title: Cream Of Carrot Soup (Creme Crecy)
directions: In a large saucepan, melt 2 tablespoons of butter., Add carrots and onion and cook slowly for 15 minutes., Add rice and 1 quart bouillon., Cook slowly for 45 minutes or until carrots are soft., Puree the soup in a blender a half cup at a time., Return to pan and add 2 cups more bouillon., Bring to a boil and add milk and 1 tablespoon of butter., Serves 4 to 5 big eaters.

title: Jellied Cranberry Relish
directions: Dissolve gelatin in hot water., Break frozen relish in chunks. Add to gelatin and stir until thawed., Add cold water and orange juice., Chill until partially set., Stir in celery and nuts., Pour into a 1 1/2-quart mold or individual molds and chill until firm. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Pinwheels
directions: Blend cream cheese, onion, horseradish and Worcestershire sauce until smooth and spreadable.

title: Fruit Dip
directions: Combine all ingredients, except rum., Place in blender and process 45 seconds., Chill overnight., Add rum before serving.

title: Pasta Sauce(Large Pot)
directions: Saute onion in small amount of oil., Add tomato paste., Stir for a minute., Add all other ingredients., Then add 4 cans of water, using tomato paste can for measure., Bring to boil., Simmer 3 hours, stirring often., Add 1/2 cup grated Italian cheese after cooking 1 hour., (Meatballs can be made and cooked in sauce.)

title: Chocolate Eclair Cake
directions: Mix pudding with milk., Fold in Cool Whip., Line bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan with graham crackers., Pour half of pudding mixture over., Line with another layer of graham crackers followed by the remaining pudding mixture., Top with another layer of graham crackers., Melt icing in microwave and pour over top of dessert. Chill and serve.

title: Farmhouse Pork And Apple Pie
directions: Cook bacon in an ovenproof 12-inch skillet until crisp. Remove to paper towel to drain., Saute onions until tender; remove and set aside.

title: Surprise Salad
directions: Mix dry jello into Cool Whip. Stir in cottage cheese, drained pineapple and chopped pecans. Cover with lid and refrigerate at least 4 hours.

title: Cheeseburger Macaroni
directions: In a large skillet, brown beef and onion; drain. Add tomatoes and water; bring to a boil. Stir in macaroni; bring to a boil. Reduce heat; cover and simmer for 10 minutes or until macaroni is done, stirring once. Stir in cheese. Yield: 4 servings.

title: Sugar Cookies
directions: Cut butter into flour, salt and soda until well mixed., Set aside., Beat eggs; add sugar and vanilla and mix well., Combine both mixtures, mixing well., Divide dough into 3 balls and chill for at least 15 minutes., Roll; cut into shapes and bake at 350° until lightly browned.

title: Pepperoni Pizza Dip
directions: This standard recipe has been in use in Ireland for many years.

title: Edible Dirt
directions: In blender, process cookies until they look like dirt., Combine cream cheese, margarine, sugar, Cool Whip and pudding with milk. Set aside., In a flower pot about 4 to 5-inches deep, start dessert by bottom layer of dirt, about 1/3 of total., Then pour 1/2 the pudding and cover with another 1/3 of dirt., Layer second half of pudding and top off with last of dirt., Place artificial flower in center., When serving, use plastic trowel.

title: Waldorf Whiz
directions: Beat cream cheese until smooth., Add other ingredients and mix well., Serve on Ritz crackers.

title: Broccoli Rice Whiz
directions: Cook rice in a large saucepan and drain., Saute onion, bell pepper and celery in margarine., Add onion, bell pepper and celery to the rice while still hot., Fold in Cheez Whiz, chicken soup and milk., Heat on low burner just until cheese and soup are well blended., Fold in chopped broccoli., Pour into a greased casserole and bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350°., Serves 12.

title: Ritzy-Chicken
directions: Melt butter., Dip chicken in butter, then roll in crushed crackers., Place in baking pan., Bake at 350°., Bake approximately 1 hour., Turn chicken after 30 minutes.

title: Cranberry Fluff
directions: Mix all ingredients and serve.

title: Apricot Nectar Molded Salad
directions: Heat apricot nectar to boiling; remove from heat., Add lemon gelatin, stirring to dissolve., Stir in crushed pineapple. Reserve 1/2 cup of this mixture., Divide remaining mixture in half., Pour 1/2 into 2-quart mold or 8 x 12-inch pan., Refrigerate until set.

title: Date Rolls
directions: Cook dates, butter, yolks, sugar and vanilla in heavy saucepan., Stir continuously until boils., Boil 5 minutes., Watch closely, will scorch., Remove from heat., Add vanilla wafers and nuts., Shape in rolls., Roll in coconut., Keep in refrigerator. Slice when ready to serve.

title: Mary Pat'S Fudge
directions: Put butter, chocolate and vanilla in large mixing bowl., Then put milk and sugar in a large pot., Put the pot on the stove and turn the stove onto medium-high., Bring the sugar and milk mixture to a boil for 6 minutes., You must stir this constantly or else it will burn., Next, take this off the stove and pour it into the chocolate, vanilla and butter bowl., Blend this on low power until everything has melted., Now pour this into a cake pan, cover and cool., Refrigerate.

title: Canned Green Beans
directions: Boil for 40 minutes. The beans need to be placed in a large pan covered with water. After your 40 minutes are, up, place in quart jars and seal.

title: Apple Dip
directions: Mix caramels and condensed milk, then mix with cream cheese, brown sugar and vanilla. Delicious!

title: Sister Mary'S Slaw
directions: Shred cabbage very fine., Brown almonds a little bit, either in oven or in a skillet., Chop green onions and break noodles into small pieces., Add to cabbage.

title: Swiss Chicken
directions: Place ingredients in order listed in a casserole dish and bake 50 minutes at 350°.

title: German Hot Potato Salad
directions: Cook potatoes in skin until tender., Cool, peel and thinly slice., Fry bacon until crisp., Add onion and cook one minute. Blend in flour, salt, sugar and pepper., Add vinegar and water. Cook 10 minutes, stirring well., Pour over sliced potatoes., Add celery seed and parsley., Toss gently., Serve, warm., Yields 6 portions., Great served with roast beef or baked ham.

title: Dove And Rice Casserole
directions: Clean doves and pat dry., Salt and pepper., Use an 8 to 12-quart covered cooking pot., Melt butter., Add doves to pot equally distributed on bottom., Cook slowly on low heat for 45 minutes., Turn doves once., Cover., Add chicken broth and water to total the amount of liquid needed to cook 3 boxes of rice., Do not cook rice before adding to doves., Bring broth and water to a boil with doves still in butter, broth and water., Add boxes of wild long-grain rice and spices without any more liquid., Cook doves and rice for 45 to 55 minutes, or until rice is tender., Gently fold in Chinese vegetables., Serves 6 to 8.

title: Sweet And Sour Turkey
directions: Place turkey in pot with 4 cups of water. Add onion, garlic, bay leaf, cloves, mustard, salt and peppercorns. Bring to a boil, reduce heat, cover and simmer for 2 hours. Remove turkey and strain broth. Return broth to pot; add cornstarch combined with sugar and vinegar. Cook, stirring constantly, until the sauce thickens. Add turkey and simmer for 15 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Low-Fat Banana Muffins
directions: Cream sugar, Sweet 'N Low and Butter Buds., Mix dry ingredients and add to creamed mixture., Add sour cream, bananas, vanilla and nuts., Mix gently., Pour into muffin tins., Bake at 375° for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Barbecue Cups
directions: Brown ground beef and onion in a large skillet. Drain and stir in barbecue sauce and brown sugar., Heat until very hot. Set aside., Separate biscuits and place each in an ungreased muffin cup., Press dough to cover bottom and sides of cup. Spoon mixture into cups. Sprinkle with grated cheese. Bake at 400° for 10 to 15 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Water Chestnut Salad
directions: Place first 5 ingredients in order in a big plastic bowl., Mix together mayonnaise and sugar and spread over the top of salad. Sprinkle Romano cheese on top., May use bacon bits and/or hard-boiled egg slices as garnishes., Refrigerate for 8 hours or more before serving., Toss just before serving.

title: Summer Sausage
directions: Mix all ingredients well., Keep covered 3 days, mixing every day., On fourth day, roll out in logs., Bake at 175° for 8 hours. Turn after 4 hours.

title: Hot Mulled Cider
directions: In a large saucepan, combine apple cider or juice, brown sugar and nutmeg.

title: Green Bean Casserole
directions: Mix milk with cream of mushroom soup., Add pepper and half can of dried onions., Bake at 325° for about 30 minutes., Sprinkle rest of dried onions on top and bake for about 10 minutes.

title: Dutch Carrots
directions: Fry bacon until crisp and remove from pan. Cook onion in drippings. Add carrots. Season with salt and pepper. Turn carrots into hot vegetable dish and garnish with bacon., Makes 6 servings.

title: Creamy Crab Chowder
directions: Defrost, drain and slice frozen crab., Partially fry bacon. Add onion, green pepper and garlic and saute lightly., Add potatoes, water and seasonings., Cover and simmer 15 to 20 minutes or until potatoes are tender., Add crab, corn, milk and evaporated milk., Heat slowly to simmer., Combine flour and soft butter. Stir into chowder and heat gently to thicken., Garnish with chopped parsley.

title: Chicken Etouffee
directions: Lightly season chicken with salt and pepper., Heat 1 tablespoon oil in heavy pot and saute chicken until brown., Remove chicken from pot., Add 1 tablespoon oil., Saute the onion, celery and sweet pepper; cook 15 minutes., Add 1/4 cup water; cook for another 15 minutes., Add chicken and 2 1/2 cups water; cook partially covered for about 1 hour., Sprinkle parsley., Turn off heat., Let stand tightly covered for 10 minutes., Serve over cooked rice., Serves 6.

title: Fudge Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Boil until smooth, about 2 1/2 to 3 minutes., Remove from heat., Stir in peanut butter, then stir in 2 1/2 to 3 cups of oatmeal., Drop on wax paper and cool.

title: Eclair Cake
directions: Grease bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan., Line bottom with graham crackers., Mix pudding with milk; blend 2 minutes, then blend in Cool Whip., Put 1/2 of mixture over graham crackers., Put second layer of graham crackers and then the remaining pudding mix over this., Cover with graham crackers., Refrigerate for 2 hours.

title: Microwave Hot Fudge Sauce
directions: Place all ingredients in a 1-quart glass measuring cup or serving pitcher., Microwave on Medium about 4 minutes or until mixture just starts to boil, stirring once during cooking time. Stir to combine ingredients to a smooth sauce., Serve warm over ice cream., Refrigerate leftover sauce and reheat in microwave on Medium as needed., Makes 1 1/2 cups sauce.

title: Veg-All Casserole
directions: Brown meat and season with salt and pepper., Drain., Add juice, macaroni, broth and dill weed., Cook until macaroni is done., Add sour cream., Fold into cooked macaroni mixture., Add 1 can French-fried onions.

title: Fruit Dip
directions: Mix well., Chill and serve with cut up fruit.

title: Roasted Broccoli
directions: Preheat oven to 500° (preheating is essential)., Separate broccoli into serving size spears., Wash and pat thoroughly. Place on a cookie sheet that has been sprayed with olive oil spray., (If you are not counting calories, use regular olive oil.), Spray spears lightly., Cook 10-12 minutes., Can put slices of Kraft Mexican cheese on top.

title: Sausage-Noodle Bake
directions: Combine first 7 ingredients, stirring well., Spoon into a lightly greased 1 1/2-quart casserole dish., Combine margarine and stuffing mix., Sprinkle over casserole., Bake at 350° for about 30 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Easy Orange Sherbet
directions: Combine soda, condensed milk and pineapple, mixing well., Pour into electric ice cream freezer., Ice and salt freezer., Plug in and wait for a great treat.

title: English Pea Casserole
directions: Put in layers, topping with Ritz crackers., Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

title: Deep-Dish Brownie
directions: Blend melted butter or margarine, sugar and vanilla in a mixing bowl., Add eggs and beat well with a spoon., Combine flour, cocoa, baking powder and salt., Gradually add to egg mixture until well blended., Spread in greased 8-inch square pan., Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes or until brownie begins to pull away from edges of pan., Cool and cut into squares.

title: Brown Bread
directions: Mix chopped dates, soda and boiling water and allow to cool. Add butter, sugar and unbeaten eggs (one at a time)., Mix date mixture with flour, salt, vanilla and nuts., Grease and flour 5 (No. 2) gold-lined cans., Fill half full., Bake at 350° until done, 45 minutes to 1 hour., Take bread out of cans when still warm.

title: Vegetable Casserole
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Use an ungreased 2-quart casserole dish., Cook broccoli and Brussels sprouts as directed on packages. After 5 minutes add cauliflower., Cook until tender., Drain well.

title: Banana Nut Bread
directions: Beat eggs., Add melted butter and sugar., Add mashed bananas. Mix together., Add flour and soda., Add nuts last., Pour into greased loaf pan., Bake for 1 hour at 300°.

title: Spaghetti Pie
directions: Cook the spaghetti; drain., Stir in butter, eggs and Parmesan cheese., Form spaghetti mixture into "crust" in buttered 10-inch pie pan. Cook ground beef and onion; drain., Stir in tomatoes, paste and spices., Heat., Fill "crust.", Bake, uncovered, in a 350° oven for 20 minutes., Sprinkle with Mozzarella cheese and bake for 10 more minutes. Even better the next day.

title: Pepper Steak
directions: Cut steak into thin strips., Sprinkle with meat tenderizer. Brown in oil in skillet., Cut green peppers into thin strips., Add onion, garlic, green peppers and celery to steak., Saute for about 2 minutes or until vegetables are partially tender., Combine cornstarch, beef stock and soy sauce; add to steak mixture., Cook, stirring, until liquid is slightly thickened and begins to simmer. Add salt and pepper., Serve immediately over rice.

title: Never Fail Icing
directions: In a small bowl, beat margarine and cream cheese., Add sugar till desired thickness., Mix well.

title: Sunny Banana Pie
directions: Slice bananas into crust. Gradually add 1/2 cup milk to softened cream cheese, mixing until well blended., Add pudding mix and rest of milk., Beat slowly 1 minute., Pour into crust and chill. Garnish with toasted coconut.

title: Strawberry Salad
directions: Mix ingredients together., Pour 1/2 into mold and chill until firm., Spread with sour cream., Top with remaining jello and chill overnight.

title: Cinnamon Sweet Pickles
directions: Peel and seed cucumbers (slice)., Soak cucumbers in one cup of lime per gallon of water for 24 hours., Mix 1 cup of vinegar, red food coloring, alum and enough water to cover cucumbers., Simmer for 2 hours., Pour off.

title: Rhabarber Kuchen(Rhubarb Cake)
directions: Combine butter, 1/2 cup sugar, eggs and salt., Gradually beat until frothy., Add lemon zest., Sift flour and baking powder; fold into egg mixture alternately with milk., Batter drops heavily from the spoon.

title: Sausage Swirls
directions: Sift dry ingredients. Blend in oil. Add enough milk to make a stiff dough., Roll thin on floured board into 10 x 18-inch rectangle., Spread uncooked sausage on top and roll lengthwise. Chill. Slice and bake at 350° for 15 minutes.

title: Omega Oyster Crackers
directions: Mix first 5 ingredients in bowl., In another bowl, place crackers., Pour mixture over crackers., Mix well & let sit for one hour.

title: Bean Salad
directions: Mix., Heat these 5 ingredients., Pour over the first 6 ingredients (bean mixture)., Stir., Refrigerate overnight., Heat and stir last 5 ingredients until sugar has dissolved but do not boil before pouring over beans.

title: Party Chicken
directions: Line bottom of baking dish with dried beef., Wrap each chicken breast with a slice of bacon and place on top of dried beef. Cover with a mixture of the soup and sour cream., Bake at 250° for 3 hours., No watching!

title: Pizza Crust
directions: Mix first 5 ingredients., Stir in 2 more cups flour., Knead until smooth and elastic, about 12 minutes., Let rise in warm place until more than double, 1 1/2 to 2 hours., Bake at 425°.

title: Vegetable Dip
directions: Combine all ingredients together and chill in refrigerator several hours before serving.

title: Barbecue Sauce(Servings:  4)
directions: Blend salad oil with vinegar in saucepan., Add rest of the ingredients., Bring to a boil and simmer 5 minutes.

title: No Eggs Chocolate Cake
directions: Combine all ingredients and mix well., Pour into a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Scotch Chocolate Cake
directions: Into large mixing bowl, put 2 cups sugar and 2 cups flour., In a saucepan put oleo, water and cocoa; bring to a boil., Pour over dry ingredients and mix well., Add eggs and buttermilk to which soda has been added., Add vanilla and mix well., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes in large pan (cookie sheet size)., Ice while cake is still hot.

title: Easy Peach Cobbler
directions: Mix milk, sugar, flour and butter., Place batter in deep baking dish., Pour canned peaches in center of batter., Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes or until done.

title: Date And Nut Loaf
directions: In a bowl, sprinkle the soda over the boiling water. Cool. Add the sugar and egg; beat well. Add the flour, baking powder, dates, vanilla, salt and walnuts., Pour in greased pan. Bake 1 1/4 hours at 350°.

title: Microwaveable Zesty Red Dip
directions: Place all ingredients in small microwavable bowl and mix well. Place same bowl in center of microwave oven., Heat on High (100% power) for 1 1/2 to 2 minutes or until warm, stirring dip halfway through heating time., Or heat in small saucepan over low heat until warm., Serve warm., Makes 1 1/2 cups.

title: Spritz Cookies
directions: Cream the butter with vanilla extract; gradually add the sugar until fluffy., Add the egg yolk and beat thoroughly., Sift the flour, baking powder and salt together and add to the creamed mixture in fourths., Mix until blended after each addition., Fill mixture into cookie press and form cookies onto ungreased cookie sheets., Bake at 350° for 12 minutes., Yield:, 5 dozen.

title: Tater Tot Casserole
directions: Combine hamburger meat, salt, pepper and onion; brown. Combine meat mixture with Tater Tots., Place in 2 medium sized baking dishes., Mix soups and milk., Pour half of this mixture over contents of each dish., Bake for 1 1/2 hours at 350°.

title: Fresh Broccoli Salad
directions: Mix ingredients together and chill 4 to 5 hours or overnight. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Taco Salad
directions: Brown hamburg and sprinkle with garlic salt while cooking. Drain good on paper towels., Mix all ingredients., Refrigerate.

title: Monkey Bread
directions: Cut each biscuit into four pieces; set aside., Mix the sugar and cinnamon., Roll pieces in mixture or put a portion of sugar mixture in a small clean paper bag and drop in a few pieces of biscuit., Shake to coat., Repeat until all pieces are coated.

title: Spinach Balls
directions: Mix and form into bite-sized balls., Bake on greased cookie sheet., Bake at 350° for between 10 and 20 minutes., May be frozen, then thawed 1 hour before cooking., If freezing, freeze separately then put together.

title: Fresh Peach Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Beat eggs and add sugar and oil, mixing well., Combine flour, salt and baking powder; add to egg mixture alternately with orange juice., Add vanilla extract., In a separate bowl, toss peaches with sugar and cinnamon., Pour 1/3 batter into a greased, lightly floured tube pan., Layer 1/2 peach mixture over it., Cover with 1/3 batter and the remaining peach mixture., Spread remaining batter over all., Bake one hour., Cool cake 10 minutes before turning out onto a wire rack., Sprinkle with confectioners sugar.

title: Herb Bread
directions: Mix first 6 ingredients in a bowl., Spread on one side of each bread slice., Wrap loaf in foil., Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes or until heated through., Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Mexican Corn And Chicken Tomatoes
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Cut top off tomatoes; scoop out pulp. Drain tomatoes upside-down on paper towels 10 minutes., Heat oil and saute onion, garlic and peppers for 5 to 10 minutes., Add corn, chicken, seasonings and sour cream., Heat through., Season to taste with salt and pepper., Spoon filling into tomatoes and sprinkle the tops with cheese., Bake 20 to 25 minutes., Serve at once.

title: Broccoli Salad
directions: Mix all together and let stand several hours in refrigerator.

title: Fat-Free Banana Surprise Muffins
directions: Spray 14 to 16 muffin cups with a nonfat cooking spray., In a medium-sized bowl combine flour oats, sugar, baking power, baking soda and cinnamon., In a large bowl whisk Egg Beaters., Stir in mashed bananas, milk and corn syrup., Add flour mixture; stir until blended., Spoon into muffin cups., Top each with about 1/2 teaspoon of jam each., Bake at 400° for 22 to 24 minutes., Cool 5 minutes in pan.

title: Hobo Stew
directions: Fry hamburger with onion and green pepper., Drain off the grease and set aside., Boil the potatoes, carrots and celery together until they are soft but not soggy., Drain off the water. In a large pot, put it all together, folding it in carefully, and then add tomatoes and gravy, stirring carefully., Season with salt and pepper., Keep on low heat for about 5 minutes, stirring occasionally., Serve over rice, mashed potatoes, noodles, toast or biscuits.

title: Hot Slaw
directions: Heat vinegar and sugar., Let cool., Chop up remaining ingredients., Add pepper, hot sauce and ketchup., Pour vinegar mixture over this and mix well.

title: Pork And Bean Bread
directions: Add raisins to boiling water and set aside., Mash beans with a fork in a large bowl until very smooth., Add sugar, eggs, oil and vanilla., Mix well., Sift together dry ingredients and fold in., Drain raisins and fold in with chopped nuts., Spoon batter into three greased and floured loaf pans., Bake in a 325° oven for 50 to 60 minutes or until a knife inserted in the center comes out clean.

title: Cabbage Casserole
directions: Brown hamburger and onion; drain., Cut cabbage and place in bottom of casserole dish., Pour cooked hamburger over cabbage. Mix tomatoes, salt and pepper together; pour over cabbage., Top with grated cheese., Bake at 325° to 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Cucumber Cinnamon Rings
directions: *Note:, You can quarter these instead of making rings.

title: Bittersweet Fudge Sauce
directions: Mix first 4 ingredients in a microwave-safe 1-quart glass measure. Gradually add milk and water, stirring with a wire whisk until blended. Microwave on High 3 1/2 minutes or until thick and bubbly, stopping to stir again after 2 minutes. Let stand 20 minutes, stirring several times with whisk. Serve warm or at room temperature. Great over vanilla frozen yogurt!

title: Broccoli And Rice Casserole
directions: Melt butter in greased casserole., Mix with rice. Add other ingredients together with rice and cut up ham, chicken or turkey. Bake at 350°, uncovered, for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Pickles In A Blanket
directions: Lay out a piece of dried beef., Coat with cream cheese., Wrap around pickle slice widthwise and stick a toothpick in center of pickle.

title: No Bake Cookies
directions: In saucepan, combine sugar, milk, margarine and cocoa., Heat to boiling, stirring constantly., Boil 2 minutes., Remove from heat., Stir in peanut butter, vanilla and oats until well blended. Drop onto wax paper., Cool until firm.

title: Mango Salad
directions: Use mango juice and water to make 3 cups liquid., Dissolve jello in heated liquid., Blend mangos and softened cream cheese. Add jello., Chill and serve.

title: Butter Pie
directions: Warm milk and eggs together on stove., Add sugar, vanilla, butter and spices, mix well and pour in pie dish.

title: Flank Steak
directions: Brush steak with soy sauce and sprinkle well with salt, freshly ground black pepper and dried thyme, crumbled., Let stand for an hour., Brush again with soy sauce and grill over brisk fire 3 or 4 minutes on each side for rare steaks., Carve with sharp knife in thin slices on the diagonal.

title: Oriental Cocktail Kabobs
directions: Cook sausages according to package directions and cut into thirds., Alternate pieces of pineapple, sausage, water chestnuts, green pepper and mushrooms on long toothpicks., Combine remaining ingredients; heat skillet., Add kabobs, cover and simmer 10 minutes., Remove from skillet; serve warm as a dinner or appetizer., Yields 40 to 50.

title: Potato Casserole
directions: Mix all together, except corn flakes and melted butter., Put in shallow casserole dish., Mix cornflakes and melted butter; spread on top of potato mixture., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour, until lightly browned., Makes a large amount and can be frozen.

title: Browned Butter Frosting
directions: Heat margarine in saucepan over medium heat until delicate brown., Remove from heat., Stir in powdered sugar., Stir in vanilla and milk., Beat until frosting is smooth and of spreading consistency.

title: Pumpkin Pie
directions: Beat eggs first., Add remaining ingredients., Bake in preheated oven at 425° for 15 minutes and then at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes., Makes 2 (9-inch) pies.

title: Smoked Shrimp
directions: You will also need a 1 gallon Ziploc bag.

title: Strawberry Pie
directions: Cook sugar, water and cornstarch until clear; cook slowly, then take off stove and add jello and strawberries., Put in baked pie crusts., Makes 2 pies.

title: Easy Marinated Carrots
directions: Scrape carrots and slice into 1/4-inch slices., Boil until cooked; add chopped onion and bell pepper last 10 minutes of cooking., Drain and toss with dressing., Chill., Serves 4., Goes well with grilled chicken, rice and bread.

title: Melting Moments
directions: In bowl, cream butter and sugar., Beat in egg yolk and vanilla., Sift together flour, cornstarch, salt and baking powder; stir in butter-sugar mixture., Shape into marble-size balls and turn in rolled oats to coat., Arrange cookies on greased jelly roll pan and bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes., Makes about 3 1/2 dozen cookies.

title: Ever Ready Cheese Log
directions: Combine, cheese with all of the ingredients., Form into rolls and wrap in waxed paper., Refrigerate until firm., Serve with crackers.

title: Snicker Cake
directions: Grease 9 x 13-inch cake pan., Mix cake mix according to package., Pour 1/2 the cake mix in pan and bake for 20 minutes at 350°.

title: Spectacular Chicken Casserole
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Prepare a 2-quart baking dish with Pam., Cook rice for 5 minutes less than package directions. Mix remaining ingredients with rice; sprinkle with paprika. Bake, uncovered, for 30 minutes., Makes 10 to 13 servings.

title: Red Velvet Cake
directions: Stir dry ingredients together., Add other ingredients in order and mix thoroughly., Bake in a layer cake pan at 350° for 25 minutes.

title: Bananas Foster
directions: Heat butter in skillet with sugar., Drop bananas in when sauce bubbles., Saute for 30 to 45 seconds., Add rum; mixture might flame., Add cinnamon and serve over vanilla ice cream.

title: Cucumber Spread
directions: Mix well and it's ready to spread.

title: Zucchini-Rice Casserole
directions: Heat oven to 425°., Grease a shallow 1 1/2 to 2-quart baking dish., In a large skillet, heat butter and oil., Add onion; cook until tender., Add garlic and zucchini; increase heat to medium-high and stir 5 minutes., Sprinkle with flour and stir 1 minute longer until flour is absorbed., Stir in half and half, rice, 3/4 cup cheese and the salt and pepper., Pour into prepared dish; sprinkle remaining 1/4 cup cheese over top., Bake, uncovered, 30 to 35 minutes until golden and bubbly., Remove from oven and let stand 10 to 20 minutes so custard has time to set before serving., Makes 12 servings.

title: Turtle Cake
directions: Combine cake mix and butter (preparing mix according to package directions)., Pour 1/2 of batter into a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 5 to 6 minutes or until cake puffs up and is still gooey., Unwrap caramels., Combine caramels and milk in top of double boiler and cook until caramels melt., Pour caramel mixture over baked top layer., Add nuts and chocolate chips over melted caramels., Pour remaining batter over all., Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes., Frost with whipped cream.

title: Crock-Pot Corn
directions: Place in crock-pot and cook overnight on low.

title: Chicken Noodle Soup
directions: Cook and stir celery and onion in melted butter in Dutch oven over medium-high heat until vegetables are tender., Meanwhile, heat water in medium saucepan over high heat to a simmer., Stir water, chicken, carrots, bouillon, basil, pepper and bay leaf into Dutch oven., Bring to a boil over high heat., Reduce heat to low. Cover and simmer 30 minutes., Remove bay leaf., Add noodles and parsley., Cook, covered, 10 to 15 minutes or until noodles are tender, stirring occasionally.

title: Italian Chicken
directions: Debone chicken breasts and cut in small pieces., Dip in beaten eggs, then roll in Italian bread crumbs., Let stand for 15 minutes., Brown in oil., Put in a large casserole dish., Cover with mushrooms, Mozzarella and Cheddar cheese., Before baking, pour the 1/2 can of chicken broth over., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Mexican Cornbread
directions: Mix first 7 ingredients together., Spread 1/2 mixture into a greased 8 x 11-inch casserole dish. Layer chilies evenly over mixture and sprinkle both cheeses over chilies., Cover with other half of mixture., Bake, uncovered, at 400° for 30 to 35 minutes. This recipe may be doubled.

title: Cinnamon Raisin Bread
directions: Sprinkle yeast over warm water., In separate bowl, combine sugar, salt, cinnamon and butter., Stir in mixed yeast., Beat in 1 1/2 cups flour., Add raisins., Stir in remaining flour; knead, sprinkling flour on hands, and work surface until dough no longer sticks., Knead about 10 minutes., Form into ball and place in a greased bowl, turning to grease., Cover and place in warm spot for 1 hour, until double in size., Punch down and shape into loaf. Place in greased bread pan., Cover; let rise 30 to 40 minutes. Bake at 400° for 30 to 35 minutes., Makes 1 loaf.

title: Grandma'S Icebox Cookies
directions: Mix all ingredients., Form into 2 rolls; wrap in wax paper and chill overnight or until needed., Slice to 1/4 to 1/2-inch each and place on pan., Bake at 350° until light brown.

title: Beef Porcupines
directions: Mix beef, rice, onion and seasonings., Form into small balls. Cook in hot oil in skillet turning frequently until light brown on all sides, but not crusty., Add tomato sauce and water., Mix well. Cover and simmer about 45 minutes.

title: Death By Chocolate
directions: Prepare cake mix by package directions., Bake in 2 layers., Mix pudding with milk by box directions., Layer in a punch bowl or trifle dish as follows:, One cake layer (crumbled), half of prepared pudding, four crumbled candy bars and half of Cool Whip. Repeat layers., Top with 9th crumbled candy bar., Refrigerate for two days prior to serving.

title: Cheese And Onion Bread
directions: Saute onion in butter until soft., Do not overcook., Remove from heat., Cool., Dissolve yeast in a large bowl., Add honey, beaten eggs and salt., Mix well., Add two cups of flour; beat well until sponge is smooth., Add onion and butter; mix., Add cheese. Mix in well., Stir in 1 1/2 cups flour and 1 cup whole wheat flour., Knead on floured board for five minutes or more., Return to greased bowl., Turn kneaded ball over in bowl to grease all surfaces., Cover., Let rise in warm place until double in size. Form into 2 loaves., Brush with glaze.

title: Chicken And Noodles
directions: Simmer chicken and save broth., Remove cooked chicken from the bone and cut into bite size pieces., Cook noodles in broth. Saut onion, mushrooms and celery in butter., Mix together milk, soup and Velveeta., Warm until cheese melts.

title: Mandarin Orange Pie
directions: Drain Mandarin oranges., Combine all ingredients and pour into pie shells.

title: Cucumber-Radish Salad
directions: In medium bowl, combine yogurt, corn oil, parsley, vinegar, mustard and salt., Add cucumbers, radishes and green onions. Toss to coat., Makes 4 servings.

title: Chicken Baba
directions: Clarify butter., Flatten chicken breasts between waxed paper. Brown chicken on both sides in butter over medium-high heat., Add mushrooms; cook about 10 minutes on medium heat., Add Marsala; cook about 5 minutes., Place Mozzarella on top., It will melt quickly and chicken is ready to serve., Goes well with steamed rice., Serves 4.

title: Orange And Tomato Soup
directions: In a large saucepan slowly saute onions, chopped potato and garlic in butter., Add tomatoes, orange juice, orange rind and broth., Simmer 30 minutes.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
directions: Mix chicken soup, chicken broth and peas and carrots., Pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan., Make a crust of Bisquick, margarine and milk., Pour over chicken mixture., Bake at 400° for 1 hour or until crust is brown.

title: Fried Apple Pie Crusts
directions: Mix ingredients together and set aside., Beat eggs and cream together., Cut shortening into dry ingredients., Add eggs and cream mixture to the flour and shortening. Cover and place overnight in refrigerator.

title: Drop Rolls
directions: Mix sugar and melted butter., Add beaten egg and dry yeast dissolved in the warm water., Add flour., Drop by spoonfuls in muffin tins., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

title: Spinach Dip
directions: Mix all ingredients, except loaf of bread, together in bowl. Cut center out of bread and spoon in dip., Slice celery, carrots, cucumbers, mushrooms, green peppers and any other fresh vegetables., Arrange around bread on tray., When vegetables are gone, cut bread into cubes and enjoy., This dip tastes best if made the day before it is to be used.

title: Laura'S Turkey Casserole
directions: Mix together., Place in casserole dish., Top with 1 package herb seasoned stuffing., Pour 1/2 cup broth over it., (Laura uses 2/3 to 3/4 of packaged stuffing.), Bake 30 minutes at 350°. Chicken can replace the turkey.

title: Cowboy Bean Soup
directions: Saute onions and bell peppers., Brown hamburger meat, add all other ingredients., Simmer 1 hour.

title: Spicy Shrimp Louisiana
directions: Cook shrimp about 3 minutes., Set aside., Combine spices*, set aside., Slowly add water to flour; mix into paste, set aside., Heat oil in wok or large skillet until hot., Stir in onion, pepper, celery, garlic and cook until soft., Mix in spices., Stir in broth and tomato paste., Stir in flour mixture., Cook until sauce thickens., Add shrimp, green onions., Stir until blended., Serve over rice.

title: Harvest Bread
directions: Combine sugar, shortening and eggs in mixer bowl., Beat until smooth., Add yams and orange juice concentrate; mix well., Mix flour, baking soda, cinnamon, nutmeg, allspice, cloves and salt together., Add to batter, 1/3 at a time, mixing well after each addition., Stir in pecans., Spoon into 4 greased and floured coffee cans., Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes or until loaves test done., Remove to wire rack to cool.

title: Angel Food Delight
directions: Prepare angel food cake in tube pan; let cool., Cut cake into 1/2-inch serving slices and arrange 1/2 of cake in an oblong pan. Mix together the Dream Whip, confectioners sugar and cream cheese until creamy., Spread filling on layer of cake, then put another layer of cake on filling., Cover with fruit pie filling., Chill.

title: Vegie Pizza
directions: Whip slowly with mixer until fluffy., Butter on slices of sourdough French bread., Toast under broiler.

title: Low Calorie Pizza
directions: Brown burger and drain off grease., Mix tomato paste, Italian seasoning, onion flakes and garlic salt to burger., Spread over the pita bread and sprinkle cheese over the top.

title: Boston Brown Bread
directions: You will need a 1 or 1 1/2-quart mold or 3 soup cans.

title: Steve'S Christmas Cider
directions: Heat all of apple juice in a large pot until all red hots are melted., Stir occasionally., Serve hot at Christmas parties. (Everytime I drink or make this I remember how A Tree Grows in Brooklyn and think of the wonderful fellowship our church has had together., Always hoping some things stay the same!)

title: Lemon Basil Pasta
directions: In a small bowl, combine butter, lemon juice and spices., Toss with pasta., Sprinkle with cheese and serve immediately.

title: Sour Cream Coffee Cake
directions: In small bowl, combine walnuts, cinnamon and 1/2 cup sugar; set aside., Preheat oven to 350°., Grease 9-inch tube pan with removable sides.

title: Three Meat Goulash
directions: Preheat oven to 325°., Heat butter in a deep pot that has a well fitting cover available that is oven proof., Saute onions in pot and butter until transparent., Add a third of the meat and stir on almost high heat for about 2 minutes., You are not trying to brown the meat, just change its surface from red to white., Add half the remaining meat to the meat in the pot and repeat process until all the meat is cooking in the pan and then stir and cook about 4 more minutes.

title: Oreo Ice Cream Torte
directions: Mix and press crushed cookies and melted butter into buttered 9 x 13-inch pan., Freeze until frozen., Spread softened ice cream over frozen crust and freeze again until frozen.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole(Club Member:  Neil H.)
directions: Mix ingredients together. Sprinkle on topping.

title: Veggie Mound
directions: The night before, spread cream cheese on ham., Roll up into logs., Refrigerate on large tray.

title: Sausage Bread
directions: Cut bread loaf in half; roll each half into a square., Sprinkle with garlic powder and pepper., In a frying pan, crumble up sausage and add chopped pepper and onions until done., Drain., Mix with 3/4 of the beaten eggs., Put 1/2 of sausage mixture in middle of each square of bread., Put grated Mozzarella cheese on top and fold bread up letter style., Brush sides of bread with egg mixture to seal edges., Baste top with butter and sprinkle with sesame seed. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until brown.

title: Pecan Pie Bars
directions: In a mixing bowl, combine flour and sugar., Cut in butter until mixture resembles coarse meal., Press firmly into a greased 13 x 9-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 15 minutes., In a bowl beat milk, egg, vanilla and salt., Stir in toffee chips and pecans; spread evenly over baked crust., Bake for another 20 to 25 minutes or until lightly browned., Cool, then refrigerate., When thoroughly chilled, cut into bars., Store in refrigerator., Makes 4 dozen.

title: Spicy Chili-Mac
directions: Combine carrots, onion and water in a large saucepan., Cook over medium heat, stirring until liquid has evaporated (about 10 minutes)., Add V-8, undrained tomatoes, beans, chili powder, garlic and parmesan cheese., Bring to a boil, add uncooked macaroni and cook for about 8-10 minutes or until macaroni is tender., If mixture is too thick, add additional V-8 juice or if it is too thin, boil until it is thicker., Ladle into bowls with yogurt and red pepper flakes on top., Toppings:, plain nonfat yogurt and/or crushed red pepper flakes.

title: Lasagna
directions: Prepare Creamette noodles according to package., Brown hamburger., Drain., Mix hamburger in sauce and mushrooms., Add salt, pepper and garlic to taste., Mix egg with cottage cheese. Layer in large greased pan:, noodles, hamburger mixture and cottage cheese (spread onto meat)., Spread Cheddar and Mozzarella cheese on top., Should have 2 layers.

title: Curried Butternut Squash Bisque(A Spicy First Course Soup)
directions: In a heavy soup pot, heat oil over medium heat., Add onions and garlic; saute for 2 to 3 minutes or until slightly softened., Stir in curry and cumin and cook for 1 minute., Add chicken stock, cider, rice and squash; bring to a boil., Reduce to low heat and cover, then simmer for 30 to 40 minutes, or until squash is tender. Pour mixture through a strainer set over a large bowl., Puree the solids in a food processor or blender until very smooth., Return the puree and liquid to the saucepan., (May be prepared to this point and stored, covered, in refrigerator for up to 2 days.), To serve, heat gently and season with salt and pepper., In small bowl, stir together yogurt and milk and add a tablespoon to each serving, drawing a knife through to make swirls., Serves 8.

title: Lasagna
directions: Brown beef and garlic in oil; add tomato sauce, tomatoes and seasonings., Simmer, covered for 15 minutes., Fill casserole with alternating layers of noodles, Mozzarella cheese, Ricotta cheese, meat sauce and Parmesan cheese, ending with sauce., Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese., Bake at 375° for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Broccoli Salad
directions: Cut broccoli in flowerets, discarding the thick stems. Toss together broccoli, green onions, bacon and sunflower seeds. Mix together remaining ingredients and stir into broccoli mixture. Refrigerate until serving.

title: Best Ever Banana Bread
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Mash bananas with potato masher; set aside., Cream shortening and sugar well., Add eggs and beat well. Sift flour with salt, baking powder and baking soda., Add flour mixture alternately with bananas to sugar mixture., Mix until well blended., Stir in walnuts., Pour batter into 1 large or 2 small well-greased loaf pans., Bake for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Garlic Rolls
directions: Thaw and soften dough., Blend melted butter, egg, garlic powder, parsley and salt., Cut off pieces of dough about the size of small walnuts., Dip into butter mixture., Place pieces of dough into greased pans until all dough is used., Cover; let rise until doubled in size., Bake at 375° for about 30 minutes., Brush with melted butter or margarine.

title: Crunchy Pea Salad
directions: Rinse peas in hot water and drain., Combine vegetables, nuts and bacon with sour cream., Mix dressing and mustard; pour over salad., Toss gently and chill., Can make the day ahead and refrigerate., Serves 6 to 8.

title: New England Clam Chowder
directions: Mix all ingredients., Heat over medium heat until piping hot, stirring occasionally (do not boil)., Serve with oyster crackers.

title: Baked Barbecue Steak
directions: Chop the steak into chunks about 1-inch., Place in bottom of casserole., Put in barbecue sauce, then carrots and onions., Bake in 350° oven for about 25 to 30 minutes or until done.

title: Baked Beans-Beef Style
directions: Saute onions in butter, add hamburg and brown., Drain off fat. In 2-quart casserole dish, add hamburg, salt, ketchup, mustard, vinegar and beans., Mix well and cover and bake at 400° for 30 minutes.

title: Shrimp Mousse
directions: Soak gelatine in water., Add to hot soup., Put in cheese, salad dressing, shrimp, salt and pepper., Beat until smooth., Cool., Add onion and celery., Pour into oiled mold., Serve with crackers.

title: Crescent Roll Treats
directions: Cut Milky Way in half and wrap with crescent roll., Bake according to crescent roll directions and roll in confectioners sugar.

title: Garlic Potato Casserole
directions: Boil potatoes in skins., Cool and shred coarsely., In greased casserole dish, alternate layers of potatoes, butter, cheese, onion, sour cream, salt, pepper and parsley., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Geri'S Crunchy Sweet Dills
directions: Drain juice from pickles, saving 2/3 cup., Put pickle juice, sugar, water, vinegar and spices in a large 3-quart saucepan and bring to a boil., Slice pickles in 1-inch slices and put back into jar., When vinegar mixture has cooled to lukewarm, pour over pickles., Replace lid and shake well., Put in refrigerator., Each day for 10 days, shake pickles to distribute spices., After the 10 day period you will have great pickles., These make a nice gift, especially for the holidays.

title: Potato Soup
directions: In saucepan, combine soup and milk., Cook as directed according to can., When soup is just about done cooking, add bacon pieces and chives., Stir until well blended., When soup is hot, add shredded cheese and stir until all the cheese has melted.

title: Apple Cake
directions: Beat the cooking oil, sugar, eggs and vanilla well., Add apples, then flour, soda, salt and pecans last., Bake in a loaf or tube pan for 1 hour at 300°.

title: Party Mints
directions: Soften cream cheese., Combine with sugar and peppermint extract in food processor, using steel blade., Batter will be very stiff., Divide batter and beat the desired color into each half.
