Pinch off enough dough to make marble size balls., Roll in your hand., Place balls in a single layer on a tray., Air day 30 minutes., Press each dough ball into a small mint mold. Immediately pop from mold and place in single layer to air dry overnight., Makes about 5 or 6 dozen., May be frozen, but will keep in refrigerator several weeks., May be chilled, but are better at room temperature.

title: Quick, Easy Baby Food Cake
directions: In large bowl, mix sugar with flour, cinnamon, cloves, salt and soda., In a separate bowl, mix eggs, vegetable oil and apricot and prune baby food., Mix all together with dry ingredients., Pam or grease tube pan and bake at 350° about 50 minutes or until light brown.

title: Cranberry Jello
directions: Grind the cranberries., Add the juices from oranges and lemon. Add sugar and let sit overnight in refrigerator., Next morning, mix jello with boiling water and let cool., Add the cranberry mixture and crushed pineapple to the jello., Chill.

title: Seafood Gumbo
directions: In a large pot over medium heat brown flour in oil until dark brown (not burned), stirring constantly., Add onions, peppers and celery and saute until tender., In a large bowl add tomatoes crushed up and water., Season to taste., Add to roux-vegetable mixture., Add consomme and okra and bring to a boil., Then reduce heat to simmer for 30 minutes., Add shrimp; bring back to a boil for 2 to 3 minutes., Reduce back to medium heat for 15 minutes. Then add crabmeat and simmer for 5 minutes, stirring gently., Turn off burner and cover with lid., Serve with rice.

title: Purple Cabbage Cole Slaw
directions: Shred cabbage., Chop onion., Mix., Top with 3/4 cup sugar. Boil vinegar, oil, 2 teaspoons sugar, mustard and celery seed. Cool., Pour over cabbage mixture. Stir., Refrigerate 6 hours. Keeps a long time in Tupperware.

title: Banana Pound Cake
directions: Mix first five ingredients well, then add bananas, mixing well., Pour into bundt pan and bake 1 hour at 350 degrees or until done., Take from oven and make glaze.

title: Carrot Crumb Cake
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Combine first 9 ingredients in large bowl, stirring well., Pour into greased and floured 8-inch square pan. Combine coconut, pecans, 1/4 cup baking mix, brown sugar and 2 tablespoons softened butter., Sprinkle over batter., Bake 30 to 35 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool 5 minutes., Combine powdered sugar and 2 to 3 teaspoons milk; drizzle over warm cake., Cool completely before serving.

title: Pasta And Beans
directions: Mix all ingredients together, except flour., Mix flour in slowly, maintaining a smooth consistency., Knead for 6 minutes.

title: Chow Chow
directions: Mix cabbage, green peppers and tomatoes with salt and let stand overnight; drain., Tie mixed whole spices in a cheesecloth bag and add to sugar and vinegar., Simmer for 20 minutes., Add all other ingredients and simmer until mixture is hot and well seasoned., Remove spice bag., Pack in hot canning jars and seal at once.

title: Delicious Sweet Rolls Or Doughnuts
directions: Add butter and sugar to milk., Add yeast, eggs, salt and flour; beat well., Let rise until double in bulk., Roll out to oblong shape., Spread with melted butter; sprinkle with brown sugar and cinnamon., Add raisins, if desired., Fold in half; cut into strips., Roll into rolls, twisting as you go., Let rise until very light., Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Ham N' Rice Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Place in greased casserole dish and cover., Bake for 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Lemon Chess Pie
directions: Mix all ingredients and pour into 9-inch pie crust., Bake 45 minutes at 375°.

title: Chili
directions: Cook ground beef until brown, drain. Put beans, tomato paste and 4 cans water., Add other ingredients., Cook for about an hour on low.

title: Oatmeal Muffins
directions: Beat egg slightly with fork., Add rest of ingredients and mix until combined., Put in greased muffin cups., Bake at 375° for 18 to 20 minutes., Makes 6.

title: Filled Star Cookies
directions: Cream shortening, sugar and vanilla extract., Beat in egg yolks and orange juice., Combine flour and salt; mix in 2 cups at a time until dough is soft., Add flour if needed., Wrap in waxed paper and refrigerate overnight., Roll out chilled dough to 1/4-inch thickness., Use a star cutter to cut out shapes., Use thimble to cut out 5/8-inch centers (these are the top cookies). Gather dough scraps and roll out to 1/4-inch thickness., Cut out stars and put onto ungreased cookie sheet., Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes., Cool and fill with jam., Sift confectioners sugar on top.

title: Layered Cabbage Casserole
directions: Cut cabbage into small wedges; cook in boiling salted water until tender., Drain., Place wedges in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish., Set aside., Melt butter in a small saucepan; stir in flour, salt and pepper., Gradually stir in milk; cook over medium heat until thickened, stirring constantly., Pour sauce over cabbage wedges., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

title: Simple Salad
directions: Mix Cool Whip and jello., Stir well., Mix in cottage cheese and oranges., Stir well., Chill before serving.

title: Black Walnut Pound Cake
directions: Cream together butter, Crisco, sugar and add eggs, one at a time., Beat after each., Add salt and flour., Beat again., Add water, cream and vanilla., Mix well., Then add walnuts., Pour in greased tube pan.

title: Simple Salisbury Steak
directions: In bowl, mix thoroughly 1/4 c. of the soup, beef, bread crumbs, egg and onion. Shape firmly into 6 patties. In skillet over medium high heat, cook patties, until browned on both sides. Remove patties and discard fat. Stir in remaining soup and mushrooms; return patties to skillet. Reduce heat to low. Cover; simmer 20 minutes or until done, turning patties occasionally.

title: Candy Apple Delight
directions: Combine whipped topping and pineapple in bowl., Peel, core and slice apples., Cut apple slices into quarters., Cut Snickers bars into small cubes., Chop peanuts., Fold in apples, candy bars and peanuts to whipped topping mixture., Yield: approximately 7 cups.

title: Herbed Bread Sticks
directions: Chop herbs., Add to dressing., Spread on bread that has been cut into shapes desired., Bake at 300° for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Yummie Bars
directions: Combine cake mix, eggs, oleo and peanut butter; stir until mix holds., Press 2/3 into ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan., Spread filling over dough., Crumble reserved dough over filling., Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes., Cut when cool., Makes 36., Test with toothpick for doneness.

title: Corn Pudding
directions: Blend all ingredients together., Pour into buttered casserole dish., Bake at 325° for about 45 minutes or until it starts to brown.

title: Overnight Chicken Casserole
directions: Place 1/2 the bread cubes on the bottom of a greased 9 x 13-inch glass baking dish., Layer meat and vegetables over top. Cover with rest of bread cubes., Beat together eggs, milk and mayonnaise., Pour over layered ingredients., Cover., Leave in refrigerator overnight., Bake at 325° for 15 minutes uncovered, then spread soup over top., Bake 45 minutes more., Sprinkle cheese over top and bake 15 minutes longer., Serves 12.

title: Ambrosia
directions: Drain pineapple and oranges., Combine pineapple, oranges, grapes, marshmallows, coconut and nuts., Mix sour cream and sugar. Stir into fruit mixture., Chill., Serves 6.

title: Hot Cheddar Dip
directions: Preheat oven to 400°., Mix grated cheese, grated onion and mayonnaise., Put in a small ovenproof dish (like a soup crock). Bake for about 20 minutes in a 400° oven., Serve with crackers while bubbly and hot.

title: Easy Sauerkraut Salad
directions: In a large bowl, combine the first four ingredients., Pour sugar over and mix well., Cover and refrigerate overnight., Serve chilled., Yield:, 8 to 10 servings.

title: Candied Sweet Potatoes
directions: *May substitute apples or pumpkin.

title: Mint Sauce For Lamb
directions: You will need a pan and spoon.

title: Chicken "N" Rice
directions: Grease bottom and sides of large baking dish with butter. Cover bottom of dish with 1 cup uncooked rice., Place several dabs of butter on rice., Salt and pepper fryer pieces and place on top of rice., Spoon 1 can cream of mushroom soup over chicken. Sprinkle onion soup mix on top., Add water to almost cover chicken, approximately 2 cups., Cover dish with aluminum foil and bake 3 hours at 250°.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Cook broccoli and drain., Combine mayonnaise, beaten eggs, salt, pepper, onions and soup and add to broccoli., Pour into baking dish and top with cheese; add melted butter to stuffing mix and put on top of cheese and bake for 45 minutes at 350°.

title: Italian Stuffed Zucchini
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., Line a baking sheet with foil., Trim end stem off each zucchini., Cut a thin slice along bottom of each zucchini so it sets straight., Trim top of length 1/2-inch, then hollow out each, leaving a 1/2-inch thick shell., Do not pierce., Dice the slices and pulp; add onion., Cook 10 minutes. Add garlic., Stuff each shell., Place on baking sheet., Cover with foil and bake for 20 minutes., Remove foil and bake for 25 to 30 minutes more.

title: Cherry Topped Icebox Cake
directions: Line a 13 x 9-inch pan with some of the graham crackers (break, if necessary)., Pour cold milk into bowl., Add pudding mix., With electric mixer at low speed, beat until well blended (1 to 2 minutes)., Let stand 5 minutes., Blend with Cool Whip., Spread half of the pudding mixture over crackers in pan., Add another layer of graham crackers., Top with remaining pudding mixture and remaining crackers., Top with pie filling., Chill 3 hours.

title: Potato Pancakes
directions: Grate 2 cups raw potatoes into 1/4 cup milk., Drain off milk; add egg and flour., Season with salt and pepper., Add minced onion., Drop by spoonfuls onto well greased pan., Brown on both sides.

title: Pineapple-Lime Float
directions: Combine pineapple juice, water and limeade concentrate. Divide pineapple mixture among 6 tall glasses., Spoon half of the lime sherbet into the glasses; stir gently., Carefully pour chilled ginger ale into each glass., Top with scoops of remaining lime sherbet., Garnish with mint leaves, if desired., Makes 6 servings.

title: Apricot Nut Cake
directions: Preheat oven, to 325°.	Soak dried apricots in the baby food apricots while you assemble other ingredients and grease a 10-inch tube, pan,, lining the bottom with wax paper cut to fit., Mix all, at once the sifted flour, sugar, eggs, oil and flavoring, beating, until, smooth., Add, apricots and pecans, mixing well. Bake, about 1 hour or until light brown and firm to touch.	Cool in pan before removing.

title: Grandpa'S Cookies
directions: Cream butter and sugar; add eggs., Sift remaining ingredients; add to creamed mixture., Refrigerate dough and roll 1/8-inch thick., Cut to desired shapes., Bake on greased sheet at 400° for 10 to 12 minutes., Yield: 2 1/2 to 3 dozen.

title: Strawberry Pretzel Squares
directions: Preheat oven to 350°. Mix crushed pretzels, 3 tablespoons sugar and butter. Press firmly into the bottom of a 13 x 9 baking pan. Bake for 10 minutes and cool. Beat cream cheese, 1/2 cup sugar and milk until smooth. Fold in Cool Whip gently, then spread over cooled crust and refrigerate. Boil water and pour strawberry gelatin in, stirring well for about 2 minutes. Stir in the cold water and refrigerate for about 1 1/2 hours or until thickened and gelatin is beginning to set. Stir in the strawberries and carefully spoon over cream cheese layer. Refrigerate at least 5 hours or until completely firm. Cut in squares to serve. Whipped topping may be added as a garnish.

title: Fudge
directions: Boil first three ingredients together for 7 minutes., Take off fire., Add chocolate chips, vanilla to taste, marshmallow cream and nuts., Pour and let set., Cut.

title: Simply Easy Chicken(It Really Is!)
directions: *Do not use fat-free or any of the diet dressings.

title: Summer Sausage
directions: Mix all the ingredients except meat until blended., Add meat, mixing well., Separate into 3 sausage rolls., If you want hotter sausage, you can roll the sausage in cracked black pepper., Roll the sausage in foil separately., Seal ends and put in refrigerator for 24 hours., Remove foil and bake on rack in pan at 350° for 1 hour., Makes three rolls., Freezes well.

title: Nana'S Pot Roast
directions: Brown meat with onion, a little butter, salt and pepper., Pour water to top of meat and simmer all day on low.

title: Oven-Barbecued Round Steak
directions: Cut the meat into 6 to 8 servings pieces., Heat oil in large skillet and brown meat over medium heat 15 to 20 minutes. Transfer the meat to an ungreased casserole.

title: Stuffed Celery
directions: Mix and press into cavity of celery sticks.

title: Seven-Up Cake
directions: Cream butter and sugar; add egg gradually., Mix salt with flour and add Seven-Up with flour., Use a large pan with hole in it. Bake 2 hours at 325°.

title: Apple Dumplins
directions: Mix all ingredients to make dough., Roll out dough, fill with apple, sugar, cinnamon and butter; freeze., When ready to use, thaw and make syrup., Pour over dumpling.

title: Cookies Cake
directions: Combine milk and egg., Add cake mix and chopped pecans., Pour into pan and top with chocolate chips and Bits 'O Brickle., Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes., Tastes better if you let set for 1 day.

title: Easy Skillet Supper
directions: Melt butter in frypan at low heat., Add macaroni; stir to coat thoroughly with butter., Add tomato juice; bring to rapid boil. Stir in beef and onion, salt and pepper., Cover; reduce heat to 250° and cook for 15 to 20 minutes., Remove cover and sprinkle with cheese., Serve with tossed salad.

title: Cherry Topped Cheesecake
directions: Preheat oven to 300°., Reserve 1 cup of dry cake mix., In a large mixing bowl combine remaining cake mix, 1 egg and oil (mixture will be crumbly)., Press crust mixture evenly into bottom and 3/4 way up the sides of a greased pan., In same bowl, blend cream cheese and sugar., Add 3 eggs and reserved cake mix; beat 1 minute at medium speed., At low speed slowly add milk and flavorings; mix until smooth., Pour into crust., Bake at 300° for 45 to 55 minutes, until center is firm.

title: Sloppy Joe
directions: Brown beef in skillet; drain off juice., Add barbecue sauce (enough to change color of beef from brown to reddish brown). Simmer 10 minutes on medium., Add Velveeta slices; stir frequently until melted., Serves 6 to 8.

title: Cheese Grits
directions: Cook grits until thick., While hot, add remaining ingredients and stir., Sprinkle with paprika., Bake 1 hour at 350° in a 9 x 13-inch pan., Yield:, 12 servings.

title: Strawberry Jello Pie
directions: Mix sugar and cornstarch well., Add water and salt until it thickens., Remove from heat and add strawberry jello and cool mixture really good., Add cut up strawberries and pour into 2 cooked pie shells., Chill for 2 hours., Top with Cool Whip.

title: Lemon Pie
directions: Separate eggs., Mix milk and egg yolks., Add lemon juice. Beat egg whites until light and fluffy., Add sugar 1 tablespoon at a time; beat until whites stand up in peaks., Fold into pie filling., Pour in crust., Sprinkle with graham cracker crumbs. Bake 10 minutes at 300°.

title: Cabbage Salad
directions: Pour sugar over vegetables and stir in.

title: Cocktail Meatballs
directions: Blend jelly, sauce and lemon juice and cook slowly., Season beef with salt, pepper, garlic and grated potato., Roll to the size of a quarter and drop in cooking sauce., Simmer for 1 hour., Makes about 70 meatballs.

title: Wassail(Hot Beverage)
directions: One teaspoon ground spices may be substituted for whole ones.

title: Gelatin Balls
directions: Mix all ingredients., Form into balls and roll in powdered sugar., Let stand until firm.

title: Great Fruit
directions: Combine lemon pudding and orange juice (as liquid) and mix well., Add all other ingredients.

title: Caramel Icing
directions: Melt butter until brown., Add brown sugar and cook, stirring, until sugar is melted., Pour in milk and stir., Cool., Add confectioners sugar and extract., Beat.

title: Popcorn Salad
directions: In bowl, combine the ingredients., Chill., Top with grated cheese and crumbled bacon, reserved from mixture., Rest should go into salad., Use within three hours.

title: Jennies Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Cream shortening., Add sugar gradually., Mix well., Add beaten eggs and vanilla., Stir in sifted flour, soda and oats., Form into small balls., Bake at 375° for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Boil chicken (when done, pull meat off bones), onions, celery, salt and pepper., (Reserve liquid.), Cook rice in 2 cups of liquid you reserved., Put rice in casserole dish., Pour English peas over rice., Mix remaining liquid with soup mixture., Put chicken on top of peas; pour soup mixture over that, then put a layer of cheese on top., Bake at 425° until hot.

title: Chocolate Fudge Pie
directions: Mix together sugar and cocoa., Stir in eggs., Add milk, vanilla, melted margarine, nuts; mixing well., Put in pie crust.

title: Hearty Sausage Stew
directions: *I use 2 beers., Makes it really good.

title: Fruit Dip
directions: Blend all ingredients together., Serve with fresh fruit.

title: Zesty Veggies
directions: Drain the mushrooms and reserve the liquid., Add enough water to liquid to make 1 cup., In large skillet, combine all ingredients., Bring to a boil, stirring occasionally., Simmer about 5 minutes., Cool and refrigerate in a tightly covered bowl for at least 24 hours.

title: Hamburger And Bean Casserole
directions: Brown beef; drain., Add other ingredients and cook until the mixture bubbles., Put mixture into casserole dish., Split biscuits, uncooked, in half and cover top of casserole., Put cheese on top of casserole and on top of biscuits., Bake at 375°, uncovered, for 25 to 30 minutes or until biscuits are brown.

title: Toasted Deviled Hamburgers
directions: This wil cover 8 slices of bread., Cut crust from bread. Toast on one side., Spread with hamburger on side not toasted. Return to broiler and let broil for eight or ten minutes., Serve hot.

title: Enchilada Pie
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Slice onions and bell peppers., Mince garlic., Drain tomatoes., Cook beef in a large frying pan until no longer pink., Remove with a slotted spoon., Add onions, bell peppers, garlic, 1/2 teaspoon salt and 1/4 teaspoon pepper., Cook until soft, about 15 minutes.

title: Easy Microwave Peanut Brittle
directions: Microwave in safe microwave casserole dish:, sugar and syrup. Cook 4 1/2 minutes., Add peanuts., Cook 3 minutes., Add butter and vanilla., Cook 2 minutes and 15 seconds., Add baking soda., Stir lightly., Pour onto buttered pizza pan or cookie sheet., Do not spread.

title: Vegetable Couscous
directions: Heat all ingredients except couscous and cheese to boiling in a 2-quart saucepan., Serve over couscous., Sprinkle with cheese. Makes 6 servings.

title: Sugar Cookies
directions: Cream the shortening and sugar thoroughly., Add sour cream, egg yolk and vanilla., Sift together dry ingredients., Add to cream, blending well., Chill and shape into balls, working with small portions at a time, keeping remaining dough chilled., Roll out 1/8-inch thick on lightly floured surface., Cut with floured 2 1/2-inch cutter., Sprinkle cut out with sugar., Bake on greased baking sheet in moderate oven at 375° about 15 minutes., Makes 6 dozen.

title: Steamed New Potatoes
directions: Wash potatoes and place them in a large steam pan. Fill the bottom pan with water (halfway to top). Put garlic and onion in the water. Bring to a boil. Place the steam pan with potatoes over the water pan. Cut the butter up and drop on top of potatoes. Salt and pepper to taste. Cover steam pan, reduce heat to a simmer and let steam for about 30 to 45 minutes. Check for doneness by pricking with a fork. Before you serve, sprinkle with parsley flakes, and more butter if desired.

title: Chocolate Turtle Cheesecake
directions: Place caramels and evaporated milk in a heavy saucepan. Heat over medium-low heat, stirring continually, until smooth, about 5 minutes. Stir in 1/2 cup chopped pecans, pour into pie crust. Combine cream cheese, sour cream and milk in a blender, process until smooth. Add pudding mix, process about 30 seconds longer. Pour pudding mixture over caramel layer, covering evenly, chill, loosely covered, until set, about 15 minutes. Drizzle fudge topping over pudding layer in a decorative pattern, Sprinkle top of cake with remaining pecans. Chill, loosely covered, until serving time.

title: Mexican Wedding Cakes
directions: In large mixing bowl, cream butter, confectioners sugar and vanilla until light and fluffy., Add flour, salt and pecans; mix well., Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours.

title: Peanut Brittle
directions: Cook sugar, Karo and water until threads or crackles in water. Add peanuts. Cook to 290° to 300°., Beat in the butter, vanilla and soda quickly. Spread on greased cookie sheet.

title: Lady Fingers
directions: Mix sour cream, 1 Cup margarine and enough flour to form soft dough, approximately 1/2 Cup.

title: Potato Sausage Casserole
directions: Combine all ingredients in crock-pot and cook on high for 6 to 8 hours.

title: Chicken And Broccoli Casserole
directions: Boil broccoli until nearly done; drain., Blend together soup, mayonnaise, lemon juice and curry powder., Put broccoli in buttered casserole., Then arrange chicken over., Pour sauce over top. Sprinkle with cheese, then bread crumbs., Bake 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Boston Brown Bread *
directions: Combine all ingredients and mix well., Spoon into three greased coffee cans or loaf pans., Let stand for one-half hour. Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Molly'S Chocolate Pie
directions: Mix sugar, flour and cocoa in saucepan., Beat egg yolks with milk., Gradually add water to dry ingredients; stir to blend. Stir some of the hot mixture into eggs, then mix all together. Cook until thick., Add vanilla and butter., Top with meringue.

title: Pizza Horns
directions: Thaw frozen bread in refrigerator overnight or at room temperature 2 to 3 hours., On lightly floured surface, roll out each loaf into a circle, about 10 inches in diameter., If dough is difficult to roll, pat or stretch dough with your hands until 1/4-inch thick., Brush surface with oil., With pizza cutter or sharp knife, cut each circle into 8 triangles or wedges. Generously spread surface with pizza sauce to which oregano and garlic powder are added., Leave about 1/4-inch margin on each side. Sprinkle with cheeses, green pepper and pepperoni., Roll up each triangle beginning from the wide end., Curve ends to form crescents., Place on lightly oiled baking sheets., Brush tops with egg white., Sprinkle with additional oregano or Parmesan cheese. Bake at 450° for about 15 minutes, or until crescents are golden brown.

title: Squash Casserole
directions: Cook squash and onion until tender, then mash together., Add margarine and eggs., Season to taste with salt and pepper; mix together., Place in casserole dish and top with buttered cracker crumbs., Bake at 350° for about 30 minutes or until brown.

title: Pumpkin Bread
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Grease and flour 4 1-pound coffee cans. Roll dates and nuts in flour. Combine all ingredients and mix well., Fill can 1/2 full. Bake 1 hour. Cool in can 10 to 15 minutes. Turn out on rack.

title: Sweetened Condensed Milk
directions: Place warm water in a bowl., Add the dry milk; mix well., Add sugar and mix until smooth.

title: Chewy Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Bake at 375° for 8 minutes., Do not grease cookie sheet for baking cookies., Very tender cookies after baking., Leave cookies on tray a minute or two before removing., Drop by teaspoonful on tray., Makes 60 cookies.

title: Red Molded Salad
directions: Combine cheese, celery, mayonnaise and nuts; let stand at room temperature., Dissolve gelatin in hot water; add applesauce and cinnamon., Pour half of mixture in pan; congeal., Spread layer of cream mixture; top with remaining gelatin mixture and congeal.

title: Trail Mix
directions: Mix sugar and syrup; bring to a boil., Remove from heat and add vanilla and peanut butter., Mix., Add corn flakes and drop by spoon onto waxed paper.

title: Zesta Cracker Candy
directions: Mix milk, and, sugar., Put in small pot., Come to rapid boil. Stir, constantly, for 3 minutes., Take off burner.	Add crackers, peanut butter and vanilla flavoring; mix well., Pour in small square pan or glass with margarine (grease it lightly)., Let cool and cut in squares.

title: Maple Syrup
directions: Combine in saucepan and bring to a boil., Serve hot or cold. Yields 1 1/2 cups.

title: Day Ahead Banana Pudding
directions: Mix together pudding, milk, Eagle Brand condensed milk, sour cream and Cool Whip., Pour over layered bananas and wafers. Continue this until all of the mixture is used., End with mixture. Garnish with wafers around your dish., Cool Whip as a topping is optional., Refrigerate overnight for best results.

title: Fudgies
directions: Boil first 4 ingredients for 5 minutes., Combine peanut butter with hot ingredients., Add oatmeal, stir well; add salt., Drop by spoonfuls on foil and allow to set for at least 30 minutes., (If it thickens too quickly, add small amounts of milk.)

title: Delicious Dip
directions: Combine all ingredients., Serve cold or heat slowly., Makes 1 1/2 cups.

title: Ditalini & Bean Soup
directions: In large pot, heat oil & saute ham, onion & garlic until tender., Add water, sauce, beans, parsley and pepper and bring to a boil., Reduce heat and simmer, covered, 10 minutes to blend flavors., Add pasta., Serve with grated Romano or Parmesan cheese.

title: Green Bean Casserole
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., In a large bowl, combine drained green beans, cream of mushroom soup, mushrooms, half a can of Durkee French fried onions and pepper to taste., Stir until all ingredients are combined., Put in a casserole dish and bake about 20 minutes, uncovered., Take out of oven and put remaining dried onions on top., Bake about 5 more minutes., Take out of oven and serve.

title: Angel Hair Pasta With Pimiento
directions: Drain pimiento, reserving 1 teaspoon juice; set pimiento and reserved juice aside., Break pasta into thirds; cook according to package directions, drain., Place pasta in a serving bowl., Add pimiento, reserved pimiento juice, cheese and remaining ingredients; toss well., Serve warm., Yield:, 4 servings.

title: Pretzel Jello Salad
directions: Beat together cream cheese and sugar, then add Cool Whip., Mix well and then spoon over crust., Mix jello with boiling water. Add strawberries with syrup., Let stand 10 minutes., Pour over cheese mixture and refrigerate., When set, garnish with nuts.

title: Sweet Potato Pie
directions: Mix all ingredients using electric mixer., Turn into unbaked pie shell., Bake at 450° for 10 minutes., Turn oven to 350° for 40 to 45 minutes more baking time.

title: Hot Crab Dip
directions: Blend all ingredients together. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

title: Apple Cake
directions: Mix ingredients well and bake for 1 hour or until done at 350°.

title: Vegetable-Lentil Chowder
directions: Combine lentils, water and salt in large saucepan., Cook, covered, over medium heat for 30 minutes., Cook onion and green pepper until tender., Combine all ingredients., Simmer, covered, for 30 minutes., Makes 6 large servings.

title: Million Dollar Pound Cake
directions: Combine sugar, butter and buttermilk., Beat until light and fluffy., Add eggs., Beat., Add flour, then almond flavoring., Pour into greased and floured tube pan., Bake at 300° for 1 hour and 40 minutes.

title: Cheese Cake
directions: Separate eggs., Beat egg whites., Cream the cream cheese and sugar; add egg yolks, sour cream, lemon juice and vanilla., Fold in egg whites., Add flour.

title: Spaghetti And Meat Balls
directions: Mix all ingredients and form small meat balls., Place in a pie plate and microwave on High until meat balls are almost fully cooked (about 6 to 7 minutes)., Rearrange once., Give dish 1/2 turn during cooking., Repeat procedure until all meat balls are cooked. Add to spaghetti sauce the last hour of simmering.

title: Old Fashion Jumbles
directions: Sift flour, baking powder and salt., Cream butter or Crisco with sugar, egg, milk and vanilla., Mix all ingredients together. Roll thin., Sprinkle with sugar., Place on slightly oiled sheet. Bake at 375° approximately 10 minutes.

title: Turnip Casserole
directions: Combine turnips, butter, sugar, salt, eggs, pepper and 3/4 cup of the bread crumbs; mix well., Pour into buttered casserole dish. Top with rest of bread crumbs mixed with 1 tablespoon of melted butter., Bake until brown, about 30 minutes, at 350°.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
directions: Microwave potatoes., Slice each potato lengthwise on the top. With a teaspoon, remove the center of potatoes to a bowl, leaving the potato shells intact., Add 2 tablespoons of butter, 2 tablespoons of sour cream, salt and pepper to the potatoes in the bowl. Mix until smooth., Divide the potato mixture evenly among the potato shells, mounding., Sprinkle with cheese, if desired. Microwave at High for 1, minute per potato., If more than 2 potatoes are microwaved at one time arrange in a circle.

title: Cream Cheese Delight
directions: Melt oleo., Add yellow cake mix and 2 eggs., Place in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish., Batter is stiff.

title: Broccoli Salad
directions: Mix first 5 ingredients., In small bowl, mix mayonnaise, vinegar and sugar until smooth., Add to salad, mixing well., Put salad in airtight container and place in refrigerator overnight.

title: Paper Mache
directions: Mix first 3 ingredients together in large bowl and allow to sit 24 hours., Then add water and flour., Mix thoroughly., Can form over balloon or use in molds.	Allow to air dry., Depending on the weather, sometimes takes 3 days., Sometimes use clear acrylic spray depending on the project., Enjoy!

title: Peanut Brittle
directions: Boil sugar, syrup and water to 240° or until it hardens in cold water., Add peanuts and butter; boil until peanuts are brown. Remove from heat., Add soda dissolved in vanilla., Stir well and pour on slab and spread.

title: Fried Cauliflower
directions: Wash cauliflower; cut in small pieces with stems., Boil in small amount of water until about half done and still somewhat crisp., Remove from heat; drain and cool just until it can be handled., Dip cauliflower pieces, one at a time, into mixture made of the egg and milk., Coat generously with flour to which desired amount of salt has been added., Fry in hot oil., (May use deep fryer or skillet with 1/2 inch of oil.), Brown lightly on both sides for approximately 5 minutes., Ready to eat as finger food!

title: Potato Soup
directions: Wash, peel and cube potatoes., Combine potatoes, water, bouillon, celery, carrot, onion, parsley and dash of salt and pepper., Boil and reduce heat to a simmer until tender., Add 3 1/2 cups milk, flour and butter; heat until hot and serve.

title: Peppery Hush Puppies
directions: Combine dry ingredients; add buttermilk, water, margarine and eggs. Mix well. Stir in onion and peppers. Carefully drop batter by teaspoon into hot oil (375°). Fry 3 to 5 minutes, turning once, until hush puppies are golden brown., Drain well on paper towels. Yields about 2 1/2 dozen.

title: Carrie Mae'S Chicken Pot Pie
directions: Stew chicken until tender., Remove bones and dice meat. Melt butter in skillet; stir, in, starch., Add broth and milk. Stir until thickened over medium heat., Place chicken, vegetables and peas in 12 x, 8, x 2-inch casserole dish., Cover with sauce. Sprinkle in salt, and, pepper;, mix., Cover, with latticed pie crust., Bake at 350° or until golden brown.

title: Artichoke And Shrimp Soup
directions: Melt butter; saute onion., Add flour and blend., Stir milk in slowly, stirring until smooth., Add broth and seasonings., Cook until slightly thickened on low heat., Add cheese, parsley and artichokes along with shrimp., Cook about 30-45 minutes., (If fresh cauliflower or broccoli are used, parboil until almost tender before adding to soup.)

title: Layered Ground Beef Casserole
directions: In 2-quart casserole, layer half the onion, celery and green pepper; season with salt and pepper., Top with beef; season with three-fourths teaspoon salt and 1/2 teaspoon pepper., Pour on tomato sauce., Top with remaining onion, celery and pepper. Arrange potatoes over top; spread with soup., Bake uncovered in preheated 350° oven for 1 to 1 1/2 to 2 hours or until potatoes are tender and top is lightly browned., Do not stir., Makes 6 servings.

title: Pork Chops With Herbs
directions: Brown chops in heavy skillet., In same skillet, saute onions until golden., Combine soup, milk, thyme, poultry seasoning, oregano, water and salt., Remove chops and onions to baking dish. Cover with remaining ingredients., Cook 1 1/2 hours in covered pan at 350°.

title: Fruit Cobbler
directions: Melt margarine in baking dish., Mix flour, sugar and buttermilk together in medium size bowl., Pour mixture over melted margarine. Pour fruit on top; do not stir.

title: Rice Pudding
directions: Cook rice until rice is very tender; cool slightly. Prepare pudding with milk. Mix together rice, pudding and Cool Whip., Add cinnamon to taste.

title: Potato Casserole
directions: Boil potatoes until done., Cool., Put in refrigerator overnight., Peel and grate potatoes., Put a layer of potatoes in a 9 x 13-inch pan., Add half of cheese., Sprinkle over cheese 1 teaspoon of onion., Add another layer of potatoes, cheese and onion., Pour the milk over the layers., Melt the butter and pour over the top., Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Blueberry Salad
directions: Mix jello with boiling water., Add fruit juice., Add blueberries and pineapple., Set in fridge overnight.

title: New England Clam Chowder
directions: Drain clams; reserve 1 cup liquid., Fry bacon in skillet until almost crisp., Add onion and celery., Saute until tender; drain. Combine bacon mixture, potatoes, clam liquid, salt, pepper and thyme in large saucepan., Simmer 10 minutes., Add milk and clams. Heat thoroughly., Do not boil., Top each serving with 1 teaspoon butter., Makes 6 servings.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Stew chicken, salt, pick off bones and set aside (save broth). Melt margarine and stir into dressing., In pan, put half of broth, dressing and half of chicken on dressing., Put mushroom soup (undiluted) on chicken., Then put another layer of broth and dressing, then chicken, then chicken mushroom soup on top of chicken (undiluted)., Put 3 tablespoons dressing on top., Bake 1 hour at 350°.

title: Fruit And Cabbage Salad
directions: Place all ingredients, except lettuce leaves, in a bowl and toss., Refrigerate until serving time., On individual salad plates, place a lettuce leaf and then fill with a portion of the salad; or serve in large bowl (no lettuce leaves needed)., Cabbage adds a crispy texture to the fruits in this simply prepared salad., Serves 6.

title: Pickled Beets
directions: Wash, beets and trim tops leaving 1/4-inch of tops., Do not break, the, skin., Boil until tender, peel beets and pour off juice., Do, not, reuse., In large pot mix vinegar, water, sugar and pickling spices., When sugar is dissolved, add beets and bring to a boil., Put beets in clean jars., Bring juice to a boil and fill jars., Seal while hot.

title: Cabbage And Tomato Skillet(Serves 4)
directions: Cook bacon in skillet (large) until crisp; remove bacon, reserving drippings in skillet., Crumble bacon; set aside., Add remaining ingredients in skillet; cook over medium heat, uncovered, for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally., Stir in bacon.

title: Nanny'S Gingersnaps
directions: Cream shortening and sugar., Add egg and remaining ingredients. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto a greased cookie sheet., Wet bottom of glass and flatten cookies., Bake at 350° for 10 or 15 minutes or less.

title: Mom'S Bread And Butter Pickles
directions: Combine cucumbers, onions and peppers., Cover with water and 1/3 cup salt; put several trays of ice cubes on top., Let stand 3 hours., Drain and add vinegar to cover cucumbers., Add rest of ingredients; bring to boiling point., Put in jars and seal.

title: Banana Pudding
directions: Combine flour, sugar and salt in heavy saucepan., Beat egg yolks; combine egg yolks and milk, mixing well., Stir into dry ingredients; cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until smooth and thickened., Remove from heat; stir in vanilla., Layer 1/3 of wafers in 3-quart baking dish., Slice bananas and layer over wafers., Pour 1/3 of custard over bananas., Repeat layers twice.

title: Texas Hash
directions: Saute onion and green pepper in oil., Add ground beef., Cook until browned., Add tomatoes, rice and chili powder., Bake at 350° for 1 hour, covered, in casserole and 15 minutes, uncovered.

title: Mexican Cornbread
directions: Heat oven to 400°., Grease a 9-inch square baking pan., Mix together first 5 ingredients., Set aside., Combine milk, sour cream, vegetable oil, egg, chilies, cheese and corn., Stir into dry ingredients., Spoon into prepared pan and bake 30 minutes. Serve warm., Serves 6.

title: Egg Nog(Serves 6)
directions: Mix eggs with sugar and salt., Add milk and vanilla. Serve cold in tall glasses with nutmeg sprinkled on top.

title: Curry Dip
directions: In a small bowl, combine all ingredients., Cover., Refrigerate for several hours., Serve with vegetable dippers. Makes 2 cups.

title: Nanie'S Banana Bread
directions: Cream the shortening, eggs, flour, soda, sugar, salt, then mashed bananas and chopped nuts., Grease loaf pan., Bake at 350° for 70 to 80 minutes.

title: Pigs In A Blanket
directions: You will need several toothpicks (broken in half).

title: Applesauce
directions: Peel apples, then slice. Put apples and water in pan and cook about 15 minutes or until tender. Use a potato masher to mash apples. Add sugar--about 1 1/2 c., to your own taste. Add cinnamon; heat for 5 minutes.

title: Bonbons Mound Candy
directions: Roll the first 6 ingredients into small balls., Combine the chocolate and paraffin together in a double boiler. Dip balls into the chocolate mixture and put chocolate balls on wax paper until hardened.

title: Chocolate Pound Cake
directions: Cream shortening, margarine and sugar. Mix until well blended. Beat in eggs; add flour with all dry ingredients alternately with milk. Add vanilla.

title: Whole-Wheat Irish Soda Bread
directions: Note:, Bake bread the same day you plan to serve it.

title: Play Dough
directions: Mix, and stir over low heat., Slowly continue to stir until it kneads like dough., The salt base allows mixture to crumble when dry, not gummy., Store in 20-ounce canister.

title: Herbed Summer Salad
directions: Note:, Can use more onion and cucumbers.

title: Seven Minute Frosting
directions: Combine egg whites, sugar, water and corn syrup in top of a double boiler, beating with rotary eggbeater until thoroughly mixed., Place over rapidly boiling water; beat constantly with rotary eggbeater and cook 7 minutes, or until frosting will stand in peaks., Remove from boiling water., Add vanilla; beat until thick enough to spread., Makes enough frosting to cover tops and sides of two 9-inch layers or 2 dozen cupcakes.

title: Cheese Balls
directions: Have all cheese at room temperature., Mix with remaining ingredients., Mix well and roll into balls, then roll in chopped pecans., Refrigerate.

title: Health Bread
directions: Put dates and raisins in a bowl with hot water; let set 5 minutes., Add remaining ingredients., Mix together and bake in a 350° oven for 35 to 40 minutes., Makes 2 small loaves. Delicious.

title: Mozzarella Meat Loaf
directions: Mix turkey, Egg Beaters, crumbs, milk (1 cup skimmed), Parmesan cheese, onion, salt and oregano., Shape into loaf and place in a greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan., Bake at 350° for 1 to 1 1/4 hours or until no pink remains; drain., Spoon pizza sauce over loaf and top with Mozzarella cheese slices., Return to oven for 10 minutes or until cheese is melted., Yield: 8 to 10 servings.

title: Strawberry Pretzel Salad
directions: Preheat oven to 400°., Melt oleo in 9 x 13-inch pan., Mix in crushed pretzels., Spread evenly in pan., Bake 10 minutes., Cool.

title: Chocolate Delight
directions: Blend the first 3 ingredients together. Spread into a 9 x 13-inch buttered dish., Bake at 350° for 15 minutes or until golden brown., Let cool.

title: Heavenly Hash Candy
directions: Mix the sugar, milk and corn syrup in heavy 2-quart saucepan. Cook, stirring constantly, over medium heat to a boil (mixture will be bubbling all over top). Boil and stir another 2 minutes more. Take off heat. Stir in the chocolate chips until completely melted. Cool about 15 minutes., Stir in the pecans and marshmallows. Drop by 2 teaspoons onto wax paper., Chill until firm or put in a buttered pan and cut into pieces.

title: Bean Ham Soup
directions: Remove 1 1/2 cups of beans and mash. Set aside.

title: Caramel Delight Pie
directions: In a skillet, brown pecans and coconut in butter; set aside. Blend cream cheese and condensed milk together., Add all of the Cool Whip., Divide into pie crusts., Top with the coconut-pecan mixture, then drizzle the caramel topping over the top., Keep refrigerated.

title: Breakfast Pizza
directions: Using a round pizza pan or a cookie sheet, lay crescent rolls out in pan and press edges together to form crust., Brown sausage and cook bacon., Crumble both on crust., Beat eggs; add salt and pepper to eggs to taste., Pour over meat and crust., Top with cheese., Bake at 350° until eggs are cooked in the middle.

title: Spaghetti Pie
directions: Cook and drain spaghetti., Stir butter into spaghetti., Stir in Parmesan cheese and eggs., Form mixture into a crust in a buttered 8-inch pie plate., Spread cottage cheese over bottom of crust., In skillet, cook ground beef, onion and green pepper until vegetables are tender and meat brown., Stir in undrained tomatoes, paste, sugar, oregano and garlic salt., Heat through., Turn into crust. Bake uncovered at 350° for 20 minutes., Sprinkle on cheese., Bake 5 minutes longer until cheese melts.

title: Coconut Refrigerator Cake
directions: Cake Mix:, Mix and bake according to directions., Bake in 2 layers., Let cool and split each layer, making 4 layers.

title: Chicken Supreme
directions: Cook chicken in water to cover with carrot, onion, celery seed and bay leaf., Reserve broth and cut chicken into bite-sized pieces., Sprinkle with lemon juice and curry powder., Bring 2 cups chicken broth to boil., Add rice and cook 20 minutes.

title: Blueberry Coffee Cake
directions: Heat oven to 350° and grease a 9 x 13 pan., Combine cake mix and butter until crumbly., Reserve 1 1/4 cups crumbs for topping. To remaining crumbs, add milk and eggs; beat 2 minutes on high. Pour into prepared pan., Spread berries on top., Sprinkle with crumbs., Bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Microwave Fruit Salad
directions: Combine pudding mix and 1 cup fruit juice., Microwave, uncovered, for 3 to 4 minutes, stirring every minute., Add pineapple and oranges., Refrigerate at least 1 hour., Add bananas when ready to serve., Decorate with maraschino cherries.

title: Zucchini With Meatballs
directions: Blend together broth and cornstarch., Stir into zucchini and tomato mixture., Pour over meatballs., Continue baking 10 to 20 minutes longer., Serve over cooked rice or noodles.

title: Lemon Fluff
directions: Mix gelatin, sugar and salt in top of double boiler., Add eggs and beat., Stir in undiluted lemonade and water., Cook this custard until it coats a spoon (about 5 minutes)., Cool.

title: French Onion Soup
directions: Cook minced onions and peppercorns in butter or margarine over medium heat, stirring frequently, until onions are light brown. Sprinkle onions with flour., Cook 1 minute, stirring constantly. Add beef broth, water and bay leaf., Bring to a boil., Reduce heat and simmer for 30 to 40 minutes., Discard bay leaf., Put soup in ovenproof soup tureen or large casserole., Place toast slices on top., Sprinkle with cheese., Place under broiler or in a 400° oven until cheese melts., Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Beef Stock
directions: Preheat oven to very hot, about 500°., Place bones in a single layer in a roasting pan., Break carrots and celery into large pieces; sprinkle among the bones, ditto with the onions., Roast for 30 to 45 minutes, until meat, bones and vegetables begin to brown, even turn a little., Dump these into a deep stock pot. Pour about a half inch of water into the roasting pan; dissolve any bits which have stuck to the bottom of the pan. Pour over bones., Add more water to several inches above bones., Bring to a boil; stir in tomato paste., Add parsley, thyme, peppercorns and garlic., Cook, barely simmering, for several hours, adding more hot water as necessary., Strain and boil slowly until reduced and flavor is intensified., Allow to cool; skim any fat from the top. Refrigerate, tightly covered, or freeze., Makes about 2 quarts.

title: Peanut Brittle
directions: Combine sugar, syrup, water and peanuts in a heavy pan., Bring to a rapid, rolling boil., Boil until a drop of water crystallizes or approximately 5 to 7 minutes, until golden brown., Add butter, vanilla and soda., (This will foam up.), Stir mixture then pour onto a buttered cookie sheet., Then break into pieces when cooled.

title: Broccoli-Cauliflower Casserole
directions: Arrange broccoli and cauliflower in 9 x 13-inch greased pan. Saute onion and margarine., Add cheese, soup and mushrooms. Simmer until cheese melts., Pour sauce over vegetables., Sprinkle with almonds and bread crumbs., Bake covered at 325° for 35 minutes.

title: Pumpkin Pie
directions: Mix pumpkin, and, dry ingredients thoroughly., Add eggs and milk., Pour, into 9-inch pie pan with unbaked crust., Bake in 425° oven for 45 minutes., Makes 1 (9-inch) pie.

title: Derby Fruit Dip(Especially Strawberries)
directions: Mix ingredients together and refrigerate overnight.

title: Sour Cream Coffee Cake
directions: Cream the margarine and sugar in a mixing bowl., Add eggs, sour cream and vanilla., Mix. Combine flour, baking powder, soda and salt. Add to creamed mixture. Beat until combined., Pour half of the mixture into greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Sprinkle with half of the topping mix. Add remaining batter and topping. Bake at 325° for 40 minutes or until done.

title: Taco Layered Dip
directions: Mix beans, seasoning mix and salsa together., Put in a large pan., This is the bottom layer. Top with sour cream, then avocado dip, then layer cheese and tomato on top., Let set in refrigerator for about 1 hour before serving., Serve with chips.

title: Laura'S Special Dip
directions: Mix dressing mix and sour cream together., Then use to dip chips, vegetables, etc.

title: Rabbit With Chestnut Puree
directions: Roast rabbits until fork-tender in a low, uncovered, pan in a slow 325° oven, seasoning only by brushing with melted butter.

title: Snowflake Square
directions: Cream shortening. Add sugar slowly while creaming mix., Sift flour, baking powder and salt., Combine milk and almond extract. Add flour and milk alternately to creamed mixture., Beat egg whites until stiff, but not dry. Fold in. Pour into 10-inch square shallow cake pan. Bake in moderate oven at 375° for 30 minutes. Cool., Frost as desired. Cut into squares.

title: Ham And Noodle Casserole
directions: Cook noodles in boiling salted water until tender., Drain off water, add ham, cheese, green pepper and cream of mushroom soup. Mix just enough to blend., Put in greased casserole dish and bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

title: Hunter'S Delight
directions: After meat is browned, add onions and peppers., Add a little water and simmer a few minutes; add rest of the ingredients and simmer until hot., Serves about 40 people.

title: Chicken And Tater Barbecue
directions: Saute first four ingredients just until tender, not brown. Add all but last 2 ingredients., Simmer for 15 minutes., Place chicken and potatoes in a roaster. Pour sauce over., Bake, uncovered, at 400° for 40 to 50 minutes or until done.

title: Corn Bread Cake
directions: Mix eggs, sugar and oil together. Add flour, vanilla and nuts. Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes in an oblong pan.

title: Pastry
directions: Pour boiling water over shortening., Stir well., Sift in dry ingredients and stir until nothing sticks to bowl., May be chilled in a large ball or divided into smaller ones., Wrap in foil before chilling., Keeps well in refrigerator., Roll to desired size for pie.

title: Aunt Mollie'S Salmon Loaf
directions: Mix all ingredients together (except parsley flakes)., Bake in greased loaf pan at 350° for 30 minutes., Use parsley to garnish top of casserole., Serves 2 "oink-oinks" or 3 normals.

title: Quick Meal
directions: Cook potatoes, onions and ground beef in skillet on medium heat until redness is gone from meat, stirring constantly, so potatoes and onions won't scorch., Add small amount of water, 1/2 cup., Season to taste.

title: Holiday Nuts
directions: Toast nuts at 325° for 15 minutes., Beat egg whites until stiff., Fold in sugar and salt., Slowly fold nuts into mixture and mix until coated.

title: Savory Spaghetti Sauce
directions: In a Dutch oven cook ground beef and onion until meat is browned and onion is tender., Drain., Add the next 8 ingredients. Bring to a boil., Reduce heat; cover and simmer for 1 hour, stirring occasionally., Remove the bay leaf., Serve over spaghetti., Yield:, 4 to 6 servings (about 1 quart).

title: Marinated Salad
directions: Boil until sugar is dissolved., Cool, then pour over vegetable mixture and refrigerate overnight.

title: Chili Rellenos Casserole
directions: Place chilies under broiler after washing; make a small slit in each pepper., Blister on all sides., Place in plastic bag for 15 minutes., Put in cold water; peel and seed., Cut Monterey cheese in strips and stuff chilies., Put in casserole dish; sprinkle with Cheddar., Beat egg, salt, milk and flour until smooth., Pour over and bake 35 to 45 minutes, until knife blade comes out clean.

title: Shrimp Mold
directions: Soften cream cheese to room temperature., Mix all ingredients together., Shape into round or square shape on waxed paper. Refrigerate for 3 to 4 hours., Place on serving dish and remove waxed paper., Serve with crackers.

title: Easy Potato Salad
directions: Boil potatoes. Cool and slice with skin on. Cut green onions and blend 2 vegetables with Ranch dressing. Top with Bac*Os and a little black pepper.

title: Artichoke Quiche
directions: Drain oil from artichoke hearts., Reserve hearts., Put oil into frying pan., Heat., Chop scallions and fry in oil until limp. Drain oil, reserve scallions.

title: Tuna Casserole
directions: Cook macaroni. Drain. Combine tuna, soup and milk. Fold in macaroni. Bake in 9 x 12 dish at 350° until mixture is bubbly. Sprinkle with cheese and brown. May substitute noodles for macaroni.

title: Spinach Bisque
directions: In 3 quart saucepan, saute onion in butter until tender. Stir in flour, salt and nutmeg until smooth., Gradually whisk in milk and water., Add cheese; cook and stir over medium heat until melted., Add spinach; cover and simmer for 4 to 5 minutes or until heated through., Serve with oyster crackers if desired., Yield: 5 to 6 servings.

title: Tater Tot Casserole
directions: Brown hamburger and onion., Drain., Place in 9 x 13-inch pan. Top with soup., Add Tater Tots., Freeze.

title: Beer Can Chicken
directions: Remove and discard the neck, giblets and any excess fat from the chicken. Rinse chicken well inside and out with cold water. Lightly brush or spray chicken with vegetable oil, then season inside and out with the rub mixture. Open the can of beer and pour out half. Set the half full can of beer on a flat surface and slide the chicken over the top so the can fits inside the cavity. Transfer the bird to the grill, keeping the can upright. Grill over indirect medium heat 1 1/4 to 1 1/2 hours or until the chicken juices run clear and the internal temperature reaches 170° in the breast and 180° in the thickest part of the thigh. Wearing barbecue mitts, carefully remove the chicken and beer can from the grill. Be careful not to spill the beer since it will be hot. Let the chicken set for about 10 minutes before lifting it from the can. Discard beer. Cut chicken into serving pieces. Serve warm. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Summer Squash Casserole
directions: Cook the squash and onion in boiling water for 5 minutes; drain., Combine the soup, sour cream and carrot., Fold in the squash and onion., Combine the stuffing mix and melted butter or margarine., Spread half of stuffing mixture in a 9 x 3-inch baking pan., Spoon vegetable mixture on top of stuffing., Sprinkle remaining crumbs over top., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes., Cut with spatula., Serves 10., Travels well., Equally good at room temperature.

title: Johnnycakes
directions: In large bowl, put flour, corn meal, baking powder and salt in bowl; set aside., Beat shortening, sugar and eggs; beat well., Add the milk, then the flour mixture., Drop a spoonful of batter onto the frying pan with a large spoon., Brown the cakes on both sides by turning them with the spatula.

title: Chocolate Sauerkraut Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Grease and lightly flour two 8-inch layer pans., Cream butter and sugar until fluffy., Beat in eggs, one at a time., Add vanilla., Sift flour, cocoa, baking powder, baking soda and salt., Add to creamed mixture alternating with water., Stir in sauerkraut., Bake in preheated pans at 350° for about 30 minutes or until cake tests done., Frost with your favorite icing.

title: Oven Steamed Rice
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., In 2-quart ungreased casserole dish with a tight fitting lid, mix rice, salt and pepper., Dot with butter., Pour boiling water over rice., Stir to melt butter. Bake, covered, 45 minutes (do not lift lid)., Add green onions. Mix lightly., To serve, fluff up rice lightly with fork., Serves 6.

title: Easy Soup
directions: Brown beef, then add remaining ingredients., Bring to a boil and simmer until done., Serves 6.

title: Corn Relish Salsa
directions: Mix all ingredients together. Cover and refrigerate at least a few hours before serving. Best served with Fritos Scoops.

title: Hamburg Dip
directions: Brown the first 3 ingredients and drain. Stir in the remaining ingredients except cheeses. Take off heat before adding cheeses. Stir until melted and well mixed. Serve with crackers.

title: Baked Beans
directions: Cut and brown bacon with onion and ground beef., Pour in casserole dish and bake at 375° for 30 minutes.

title: Saucepan Cookies
directions: Pour melted shortening over brown sugar and add remaining ingredients., Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes in a 17 x 12 x 2-inch pan., Let cool 10 minutes., Cut into squares and remove from pan when cold.

title: Glaze For Fresh Apple Cake
directions: Cook until thick enough to dribble over cake.

title: English Pea Salad
directions: Toss all ingredients together in medium bowl., Chill before serving.

title: Enchilada Casserole
directions: Crumble ground beef into 1 1/2-quart glass casserole; add onion and garlic., Microwave (High) 5 to 6 minutes or until set; stir once., Stir to break meat into small pieces; drain., Stir in tomato paste, water, green chilies, olives and salt., Cover with lid., Microwave (High) for 9 to 10 minutes or until flavors are blended and sauce is bubbly, stirring twice., Set aside.

title: Poppy Seed Chicken
directions: Salt chicken., Boil chicken until tender., Remove bones., Cut in chunks., Mix melted margarine, cracker crumbs and poppy seed. Pat 1/2 of mixture in 9 x 11-inch casserole dish., Layer chicken on top of crumb mixture.

title: Cherry Cheese Pie
directions: In a large mixing bowl, beat cheese until fluffy., Gradually beat in condensed milk until smooth., Stir in lemon juice and vanilla., Pour into prepared crust., Chill 3 hours or until set. Top with cherry pie filling., Ready to serve., Excellent with coffee., Makes one 9-inch pie.

title: Fresh Vegetable Bake
directions: Combine veggies and spoon into 4-quart casserole., In small saucepan, combine broth and herbs., Pour over vegetables., Cover and bake 40 minutes at 350°.

title: Squash Dressing
directions: Bring to a boil the squash, onion and water. Cover and simmer until tender., While this is cooking mix cornbread crumbs, cream of chicken soup, margarine and black pepper., Mix with squash mixture and bake in greased 1 1/2-quart casserole dish at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: French Cheeseburger
directions: Slice the bread lengthwise and hull out loaf (top and bottom). Brown hamburger and onions, then add catsup., Spoon into bottom part of the bread., Put a slice of cheese on top of meat., Place top of bread on sandwich, then roll in plastic wrap., Place in oven and bake at 350° for 25 minutes., Slice and serve with salad.

title: "The Best" Yeast Bread
directions: Have ingredients at room temperature., Heat milk to lukewarm. Add yeast, stirring to dissolve., Cream 1 stick butter, sugar and salt., Add milk and yeast to butter mixture., Beat eggs and add. Beat together., Add 1 1/2 cups flour, mixing well., Cover and let rise 1 hour., Add 1 1/2 cups flour and mix well., Refrigerate several hours or overnight., Drop by spoonfuls into greased Bundt or tube pan., Pour 1 stick melted butter over mix., Let rise 3 hours., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes., Slice to serve.

title: Autumn Soup
directions: Brown ground beef and onion., Combine all other ingredients in large pan., Bring to a boil., Let simmer for 45 minutes to an hour.

title: Bacon-Onion Cheese Balls
directions: Fry bacon; cool and crumble., Mix softened cream cheese, salad dressing, cheese, bacon bits and onion., When well mixed, form into ball and chill., Ball may be rolled in finely chopped walnuts or pecans or parsley flakes.

title: Mock Hollandaise Sauce
directions: Blend ingredients; refrigerate if desired., Heat over hot water before serving., Yields about 1 cup sauce.

title: Holiday Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Refrigerate overnight., If desired, add 2 cups of sliced bananas at serving time.

title: Pound Cake
directions: Beat sugar and shortening together., Then add eggs one at a time and beat., Add rest of ingredients and beat good., Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 10 minutes.

title: Veg-All Casserole
directions: Slice 1/2 stick butter over Veg-All, Cheez Whiz and salt and pepper., Crumble crackers and put over mixture., Add other 1/2 stick butter., Bake at 375° about 30 minutes.

title: Prime Rib Roast Beef
directions: Mix first 3 ingredients with 3 cups water., Put frozen roast in crock-pot., Pour liquid mixture over it., Put lid on and cook on low overnight., Serve., Cut in thin slices on Kaiser buns., Use juice to dip sandwich in.

title: Mom'S Million Dollar Fudge
directions: Combine sugar and milk; bring to full rolling boil., Boil and stir for 4 1/2 minutes., Break up chocolate and mix with other ingredients., Pour hot syrup over all ingredients and stir., Pour in buttered 9 x 13-inch pan and refrigerate.

title: Christmas Ruby Red Salad(Good Anytime)
directions: Mix and refrigerate for 24 hours.

title: Fruit Punch
directions: Mix Kool-Aid according to directions., Add pineapple juice. Chill and serve.

title: Mounds Bars
directions: Mix coconut, milk, sugar and butter together., Spread in a sheet cake or cookie pan., Put in freezer for 45 minutes to 1 hour., Remove; cut into bars., Melt chocolate chips and paraffin in double boiler., Dip bars into chocolate mixture (I dip them with a toothpick)., Place on wax paper to cool.

title: Barbecue Scalloped Potatoes
directions: Turn on oven and set at 350° (moderate)., Mix first 7 ingredients in a 2-quart bowl., Stir in potatoes until well mixed. Put mixture into a shallow 1 1/2-quart baking dish., Sprinkle 1/2 cup cheese and paprika over top., Bake near center of oven about 1 hour or until potatoes are tender.

title: Ranch Cookies
directions: Cream together shortening, brown sugar and eggs., Add remaining ingredients., Mix together and drop by tablespoons on greased cookie sheet (for smaller cookie, use teaspoon)., Bake at 375° for 12 minutes.

title: Campfire Macaroni
directions: Brown and drain meat; add onion., Cook until clear., Add remaining ingredients except beans and cheese., Cook until macaroni is tender., Add beans and cheese., Cook until heated through and serve warm.

title: Spaghetti Salad
directions: Dice tomatoes, green pepper, cheese and ham., Cook spaghetti; drain and cool with cold water., Toss together., Add Italian dressing.

title: Bonbons
directions: Mix first 3 ingredients well., Roll into small balls., Chill until firm., Dip in melted chocolate.

title: Banana Dream Pie
directions: Prepare Dream Whip with 1 cup of milk as directed on package, using a large mixer bowl., Add remaining milk and pudding mix. Blend, then beat at medium speed for 2 minutes, scraping bowl. Spoon into pie crust. Chill for 4 hours.

title: Frosted Graham Crackers
directions: Fill an 11 x 15-inch jelly roll pan with graham crackers., Boil 1 cup butter and 1 cup brown sugar for a few minutes., Add 1/2 cup ground nuts to mixture., Pour over graham crackers and spread evenly., Bake 8 to 10 minutes at 350°., Cut while warm.

title: Granola
directions: Preheat oven to 400°., Mix first 5 ingredients., Spread in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan., Bake for 30 to 40 minutes, turning and mixing every 10 to 15 minutes., Let cool slightly, then add raisins and any other dry fruit you like., Store in an airtight container.

title: Crab Cakes
directions: Clean crab meat and pick out all bones., Combine everything and roll in egg, then bread crumbs and fry in deep fat.

title: Hawaiian Cheese Spread
directions: Beat cream cheese at medium speed of electric mixer until fluffy; stir in remaining ingredients., Serve on crackers or bread., Yield:, 3 1/4 cups.

title: Pink Stuff
directions: Mix ingredients in a large bowl., Chill for 1 hour.

title: Zucchini Bread
directions: Beat eggs, sugar, oil and vanilla until thick; sift the remaining dry ingredients together. Fold in the dates or raisins and nuts; pour into 2 greased loaf pans., Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until wood pick comes out clean., Makes two loaves.

title: Special Potato Dish
directions: In a 9 x 13-inch pan, mix all ingredients together., Chill overnight., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Mexican Soup
directions: Cook ground meat until browned., Drain and add taco seasoning, stirring well. Add tomato sauce and chopped tomatoes., Stir in corn and simmer over low heat 30 to 45 minutes., Serve with crackers., Serves 6.

title: Old-Fashioned Tea Cakes
directions: Mix all ingredients well together., Use enough flour to make a soft dough., Roll out on floured bread board and cut with biscuit cutter., Place on greased cookie sheet., Bake at 350° until brown. Will be soft.

title: Mozzarella Munchies
directions: Mix the cheese, onion and Miracle Whip together and spread on party rye., Put under the boiler to slightly brown and bubbly. Serve.

title: Broccoli Bake
directions: Cook broccoli only until it separates., Drain., Mix remaining ingredients in greased casserole dish., Alternate first broccoli, then mixture., Repeat., Crush Ritz crackers over top., Dot with butter., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Cook broccoli according to package directions., Drain well. Pour broccoli back into pan., Add salt and pepper., Stir in cheese and 1/2 stick of margarine until melted., Pour into buttered casserole dish., Melt remaining margarine in pan and stir in crushed Ritz crackers, then spread over the broccoli., Bake at 350° for about 25 minutes.

title: Cherry Pie(Makes 10 Pies.)
directions: Combine sugar, tapioca, salt and almond flavor., Mix thoroughly with fruit and fruit juices before pouring into shells. Bake at 450° for 10 minutes, then at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Arkansas Beans
directions: Fry hamburger meat in large skillet., Drain off fat., Pour pork and beans in with hamburger meat, then barbecue sauce., Heat thoroughly.

title: Fried Rice
directions: Cook rice until tender in salted water., Mix all ingredients. Simmer on low heat for 15 minutes., Add 1/2 cup diced Cheddar cheese., Pour into flat bakeware., Top with cooking cheese., Brown cheese in hot oven., Serve.

title: Sauteed Zucchini
directions: Heat skillet., Put in oil., Heat and put in garlic, zucchini, salt and pepper. Cook few minutes until tender., Great taste.

title: Squash Bread
directions: Combine all ingredients; mix well and pour the mixture into a greased skillet. Bake at 400° for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Snowball Cookies
directions: Cream, oleo,, powdered sugar and vanilla together., Add flour, salt and nuts., Put in refrigerator to chill;, roll in balls. Bake, at 400° until done., While hot, roll in powdered sugar. Cool., Roll in plain sugar.

title: Barley With Ham
directions: Simmer ham in water until ham loosens from bone., Discard bone and fat., Add barley and onion., Cook until barley is tender, about 1 hour., Serves 2 as a main course.

title: Cranberry Salad
directions: Grind the cranberries and add sugar., Let set overnight in the refrigerator., Dissolve jello in 1 pint warm water and let set until it gets thick as honey., Add all cranberries, nuts, celery, marshmallows, apples and pineapple., Add one big cup of Cool Whip. Put in refrigerator for 2 to 3 hours.

title: N.D. Sugar Cookies
directions: Cream together all moist ingredients., Sift together and add all dry ingredients., Shape into small balls., Dip in sugar. Flatten with fork., Place on ungreased cookie sheet and bake 15 minutes or until very light brown., Bake at 350°.

title: Gingersnaps
directions: Cream shortening with sugar., Add beaten egg, then molasses, vinegar and cold water., Sift flour, soda and ginger and add to first mixture., Stir in as much of the flour as you can and knead in remainder., Roll out., Cut in desired shapes., Bake 10 to 12 minutes at 350°.

title: Dumplings
directions: Sift dry ingredients together., Cut in butter., Add milk to make a soft dough., Turn onto floured board and roll 1/2 inch thick., Cut into small squares., Drop into hot liquid., Cover closely and cook 20 minutes., Makes 12.

title: Fudge Icing
directions: Mix all ingredients excluding confectioners sugar and bring to a boil., Stir to prevent sticking., Remove from heat and add confectioners sugar., Add about 1/3 at a time, and use an electric mixer for beating., Add vanilla and continue mixing until mixture is of spreading consistency., Add chopped nuts if desired.

title: Cream Cheese Chocolate Chip Bars
directions: Grease a 9 x 13-inch cookie pan and preheat oven to 350°. Prepare Toll House cookie dough as directed on package of chocolate chips., Place 3/4 of dough on bottom of pan., Mix together cream cheese, sugar and beaten eggs., Pour over top of dough in pan. Glob on the rest of the dough., Bake for 30 minutes and touch to see if dough springs back., May need to bake for 40 minutes.

title: Soft Pretzels
directions: Mix hot water and yeast until dissolved., Stir warm water and brown sugar., Slowly add flour., Mix until smooth., Roll dough until smooth and 16-inches for each pretzel., Twist into shape.

title: Mango-Kiwi Salsa
directions: Dice fruit and vegetables. Add other ingredients and chill before serving. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Shrimp And Asparagus Casserole
directions: Blanch asparagus for three minutes in small saucepan., Melt butter and stir in flour., Cook, stirring, for one minute. Gradually add cream or half and half and milk., Cook until thick. Stir in white wine, cream or chicken broth., Season with salt and pepper., Stir in egg yolk, cheese and shrimp., Put in buttered casserole dish layered: one half asparagus, then one half shrimp. Repeat layer and top with buttered bread crumbs., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Fast Strawberry Mousse
directions: Chop walnuts and mix with sugar and spices., Grease an 11 x 16-inch pan with melted butter., Place 4 filo in pan, brushing each with melted butter., Sprinkle with thin layer of nut mixture. Cover with 3 filo, brushing each with melted butter., Continue this procedure until all filo and mixture is used., Finish with 4 filo on top, brushing each with butter., Cut into about 75 small squares (before baking)., Bake in slow oven (300°) for 1 hour or longer, until lightly brown., Remove from oven and cool., Pour warm syrup over pastry.

title: Strawberry Preserves
directions: Boil 10 minutes and remove from heat to cool dark place., Let stand 3 days, stirring 3 or 4 times each day. Can cold in sterilized jars., Seal., The berries remain whole and the juice is thick.

title: Baked Oatmeal
directions: Bake 30 minutes at 350° in 8 x 12-inch pan.

title: Lime Jello Salad
directions: In a 2 quart saucepan, add water, lime Jell-O and cream cheese. Heat on medium heat until cream cheese melts., After cheese melts, add marshmallows., Stir until dissolved., Then refrigerate until its almost firm., Then add pineapple juice, crushed pineapple and Cool Whip., Beat until mixture is smooth., Pour into bowl. Sprinkle chopped nuts on top., Refrigerate until firm.

title: Italian Cookies
directions: Mix flour, sugar, baking powder and salt., Work in butter until it disappears., Add eggs and vanilla and knead until soft and pliable., Pinch off piece of dough and roll into length of about 4 to 5-inches, twist and place on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Calico Beans
directions: Brown lamb and onion., Add beans, ketchup, brown sugar, vinegar and mustard in a large casserole., Top with bacon., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Biscuits For Your Dog
directions: Combine all ingredients., Mix well, roll out and cut with "bone" shaped cookie cutter., Bake at 300° until very hard., Fido will love these!

title: Cowboy'S Delight(Pineapple Dessert)
directions: Mix together the vanilla wafers and 1/4 cup melted butter and pack into an 8 x 8-inch dessert dish., Cream the powdered sugar and 1/2 cup butter., Add eggs and beat 10 minutes., Beat whipping cream until stiff (could use Cool Whip)., Add drained crushed pineapple and nuts (if desired)., Mix the sugar, butter and egg mixture., Top with pineapple mixture., Decorate with vanilla wafer crumbs, whipping cream, cherries and nuts., Refrigerate for 8 hours.

title: Chicken Fried Steaks
directions: Combine the first 3 ingredients; sprinkle on both sides of steaks., Combine egg and milk in a shallow bowl., Dip steaks in egg mixture, then dredge in cracker crumbs., Pour oil to depth of 1/2 inch into large, heavy skillet., Fry steaks in hot oil over medium heat until brown, turning once., Remove steaks; drain off drippings, reserving 3 tablespoons., In skillet, add flour, stirring until smooth., Cook 1 minute., Add broth and 1/2 cup milk; stir constantly until thick., Add Worcestershire sauce; stir., Serve gravy with steaks and cooked rice or mashed potatoes.

title: Mexican Cornbread With Ground Beef
directions: Combine cornmeal, milk, salt, bacon drippings, eggs, soda and corn in mixing bowl. Set aside. Saute ground beef in skillet. Drain on paper towels. Grease a large black iron skillet and heat. Sprinkle bottom with a thin layer of cornmeal and brown slightly. Pour half of the batter in hot skillet., Sprinkle cheese evenly over batter, then sprinkle on the meat, onion and peppers., Pour remaining batter on top. Bake at 350° for 45 to 60 minutes. Serves 8 to 10., Serve with a tossed green salad, iced tea and fruit dessert for a complete meal.

title: Barbecued Hamburger-Bean Casserole
directions: Cook hamburger with onion until brown, then drain., Stir in brown sugar, salt, barbecue sauce and pork and beans and heat through., Place in casserole., Separate biscuits and cut in half. Sprinkle with cheese, then arrange over hamburger mixture., Bake in preheated 425° oven until biscuits are brown.

title: Sarah Matt'S Onion Soup
directions: Place butter and one "plop" of oil in a large kettle., Cut up onions and saute in kettle., Add salt as desired and 1 spoon sugar for flavor and browning., When onions are soft and brown, sprinkle 2 spoonfuls (1 at a time) of flour and mix into onions., It will be pasty., Add meat and brown, about 30 minutes., Add 4 cans of broth and 4 cans of water., Add 3 to 4 bay leaves and a few sprinkles of red pepper., Bring mix to a boil., Cover and reduce heat to simmer for as long as you would like., Serve in bowls with torn pieces of bread and cheese, letting the cheese melt., Enjoy!

title: Special White Rolls
directions: Mix, 1 1/2 cups flour, salt, sugar, sour cream and milk in mixer, at, medium, speed until blended., Dissolve yeast in warm water, and add it along with the melted margarine to the flour mixture; beat until smooth., Remove from mixer and beat with spoon, gradually adding the remaining flour., If dough is too sticky, to, handle, add a little more flour and knead for several minutes., Place, dough in a large pan in a warm place and let rise until doubled in size.

title: Broccoli Salad
directions: In a large bowl, combine broccoli, cauliflower, bacon, onion, tomatoes and eggs; set aside., In another bowl, combine mayonnaise, sugar and vinegar., Mix until smooth., Just before serving, pour dressing over salad and toss., Yield: 6 to 8 servings.

title: Classic Potato Salad
directions: In a large bowl, stir together the first 5 ingredients until smooth., Add remaining ingredients., Toss to coat well., Cover. Refrigerate at least 2 hours to blend flavors., Makes about 5 cups.

title: Irish Champ
directions: Peel and slice potatoes., Just cover with salted water and boil until tender.

title: Banana Oatmeal Drops
directions: *Use less sugar if using sweetened coconut.

title: Tapioca Pudding
directions: Boil tapioca, water and salt for 1/2 hour., Two hours later, add jello and sugar., When cool, top with whipped cream and fruit. Mix in marshmallows.

title: Crumb Cake
directions: Beat eggs until light and frothy. Add sugar and beat., Mix baking powder and graham cracker crumbs. Then add to mixture., Add vanilla and then the nuts., Pour into 2 layer cake pans., Bake at 325° for about 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Chestnut And Cranberry Dressing
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Butter a 2 1/4-3 qt. baking dish., In a small saucepan over medium heat, warm stock until steam begins to rise, 3-5 minutes., Remove from heat, and add cranberries; set aside., In a large fry pan over medium heat, melt butter., Add onion, celery, and carrot; saute, stirring , until tender and translucent, 2-3 minutes., Using a slotted spoon, transfer to a bowl., In the same pan, saute sausage, stirring and crumbling with a fork, until lightly browned and cooked through, about 10 minutes. Transfer sausage to bowl with vegetables., In a large bowl, stir egg white slowly pouring in stock and cranberries., Add bread and stir until well blended., Let stand, stirring occasionally, until stock is absorbed, 6-8 minutes., Add vegetable-sausage mixture, chestnuts, sage, thyme, and parsley., Season with salt and pepper and stir to mix well., Transfer to prepared baking dish., Bake until brown and crispy, 45-50 minutes., Serves 10-12.

title: Sailboat Salad
directions: Wash lettuce leaves and stack on four salad plates., Cut the cantaloupe in half and scoop out the seeds., Cut each half into half., Place each piece in the "green sea" of lettuce., Cut the 2 slices of cheese in half diagonally (from corner to corner)., Use a toothpick and make a sail with the cheese and then "raise the sail" on each "boat".

title: Walt And Roberta'S Favorite Seven Layer Cookies Or Hello Dollys
directions: Melt butter in pan., Sprinkle cracker crumbs over melted butter, then spread crumbs with chocolate chips, then butterscotch chips., Sprinkle coconut over this, followed by the milk poured evenly over the coconut and add the chopped pecans on top., Bake for 30 minutes at 350°., Cool and cut in 1 1/2-inch squares., Use a 9 x 13-inch pan., Yields approximately 3 dozen.

title: Low-Fat Scalloped Potatoes
directions: Peel and slice potatoes; layer in baking dish with flour and salt and pepper., Cover with canned milk., Bake at 350° for 45 to 60 minutes.

title: Kathy'S Breakfast Casserole
directions: Salt and pepper lightly., Spray a 9 x 13-inch pan with Pam. Put bread, sausage and cheese into pan., Pour egg mixture (beat eggs, 2 1/4 cups milk and mustard) into pan., Refrigerate overnight.

title: Apple Crisp
directions: Blend flour, cinnamon and butter with pastry blender. Sprinkle over apples in a 2-quart baking dish., Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours., Serve with ice cream.

title: Cheese Cake
directions: For 9-inch pie pan, prepare Dream Whip as on package, using vanilla and cold milk., When topping peaks with blender, add cream cheese, slowly blending., Add sugar and blend., Pour into crust. Chill about 3 hours.

title: Zucchini Casserole
directions: Combine all ingredients. Bake at 250° for 45 minutes.

title: Banana Loaf
directions: Crush bananas in large bowl., Mix in all other ingredients. Pour into lightly greased loaf pan., Bake 1 hour at 350° or until knife comes out clean.

title: Quick Spanish Rice
directions: Brown hamburger in, 1 tablespoon fat., Add other ingredients. Cover and, simmer, for, 30	minutes., Add more tomato juice if it is too dry.

title: Lemon Cheese Pie
directions: Beat cheese until fluffy., Gradually beat in milk until smooth., Stir in lemon juice and vanilla., Pour into crust., Top with lemon topping. Chill 3 hours., Refrigerate.

title: Self Crust Egg Custard
directions: Mix flour and sugar., Add to well-beaten eggs., Add milk, evaporated milk, melted butter, salt and vanilla flavoring and mix well., Grease a 9-inch pie pan with butter; pour mixture in pan and sprinkle with nutmeg if desired., Bake at 325° for 40 minutes.

title: Chicken Appetizers
directions: Mix soup, dressing and preserves in bowl., Put chicken in a 13 x 9-inch loaf pan., Cover with mixture., Bake uncovered 45 minutes at 350°.

title: Chicken Rice Casserole
directions: Combine the first 5 ingredients together., After combined, place uncooked chicken on top of rice mixture., Spoon soup over the top of the chicken., Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours, or until rice is cooked.

title: Pineapple Casserole
directions: Place drained pineapple in baking dish., Mix flour with sugar and sprinkle over pineapple., Cover with cheese and top with crushed Ritz crackers., Cut margarine into small pieces and place on top of crackers., Bake at 325° until bubbly.

title: Main Dish Salad
directions: Make tossed salad., Cut up egg and cheese in salad or add cottage cheese to salad., Add dressing., Serves 1.

title: Herbed Halibut
directions: Mix bread crumbs, Parmesan cheese, green onions, parsley, basil and cloves in a bowl., Stir in melted margarine., Brush four 12-inch foil squares lightly with oil., Place 1 fish steak on each square., Drizzle with olive oil., Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Top with crumbs., Spoon wine around each steak., Seal foil securely., Place packets on baking sheet., Bake at 450° for 8 minutes or until fish flakes easily., Makes 4 servings.

title: Veggie Dip
