directions: Mix all ingredients and chill for 4 hours or overnight., Serve with assorted raw veggies.

title: Barbecue Country Style Spareribs
directions: Brown spareribs in heavy skillet., While ribs are browning, make a sauce from remaining ingredients., Cook all for 10 minutes. Pour over ribs and cook for 2 hours in a 375° oven., Remove; cover the last half hour to glaze them.

title: Sausage Balls
directions: Mix ingredients together; form into small balls., Bake in oven at 400° for about 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Fresh Coconut Cake
directions: Bake cake as directed on box., Let cool on wire racks.

title: Washington Favorite Senate Bean Soup
directions: Put beans in a large pot., Add the 2 or better quarts of water and soak overnight., Next day, drain the beans and add more water, more than cover., Add the ham bone to the beans and water, cover and simmer for 2 hours., Remove the ham bone from pot and chop the meat and return it to the pot., Then add onion, potato, celery and garlic., Season to taste with salt and pepper., Be sure there is enough water, cook for another hour.

title: Pumpkin Bread
directions: Add sugar to oil, then add eggs, pumpkin, spices (sifted together with flour), water and nuts., Bake one hour at 350°. Makes 1 large or two small loaves.

title: Black-Eyed Bean Salad
directions: Prepare rice and limas as labels direct. Drain black-eyed peas. Dice red pepper. In large bowl, mix peas, red pepper, parsley, lemon juice, oil, mustard, sugar and salt. Add rice and limas. Chill.

title: "Maybe Governor Of Texas" Chili
directions: *Favorite meat is to use, ground, moose,, if not available, use ground beef round., Venison, is, good to mix in with beef and also you can add ground, pork., You need a total of 6 pounds of meat with the sauteed onion.

title: Banana Cream Pie
directions: In mixing bowl, beat milk, sour cream and pudding mix until smooth., Place 1/3 sliced bananas into pastry shell., Top with 1/2 pudding mixture., Repeat layers., Arrange the remaining bananas on top., Cover with Cool Whip., Chill at least 2 hours.

title: Company Chicken
directions: Sprinkle chicken with salt., Spread rice on bottom of greased 3-quart casserole., Layer with mushrooms, then chicken., Mix undiluted soups with savory and dry soup mix., Pour over mixture in casserole., Pour broth around sides to moisten rice., Cover with foil., Bake at 350° about 1 1/2 hours., Serves 4 to 6.

title: Sassy Cinnamon Muffins
directions: Sift dry ingredients together., Combine egg, milk and oil. Add liquid ingredients to dry ingredients., Fill greased muffin pan 2/3 full., Bake at 400° for 20 to 25 minutes., Yields 12 muffins.

title: Hawaiian Chicken
directions: Coat chicken with flour and salt., Brown in oil for 10 minutes; remove from pan., Reserve 1/4 cup pan juice., In pan, stir honey, teriyaki sauce, chives, pepper and juice; heat to boiling., Boil for 30 seconds., Add pineapple; heat again., Pour sauce over chicken.

title: Meatball Porcupines
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Mix thoroughly meat, rice, 1/3 cup water, onion, salts, garlic powder and pepper., Shape into well rounded tablespoon sized meatballs; place in ungreased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan., Stir together remaining ingredients and pour over meatballs., Cover pan with foil and bake for 45 minutes., Remove foil and bake 15 minutes longer., Serve with pasta if desired.

title: Monkey Bread
directions: Mix sugar and cinnamon together., Tear small pieces of dough off, dip in melted butter, then in sugar mixture., Drop into Bundt cake pan., Let raise to within 1 inch of top of pan., Bake at 350° until brown.

title: Ranch And Cheddar Bread
directions: Spread each cut side with Ranch dressing. Add cheese and broil until lightly browned. Garnish with parsley.

title: Strawberry Cake
directions: Prepare cake mix as directed on box., Bake in 13 x 9-inch pan. When done, remove from oven and prick with fork., Prepare gelatin as on box, then pour over cake., Prepare pudding and spread over cake., Put glaze over pudding., Put Cool Whip on top., Slice strawberries and place on top.

title: Cinnamon Rolls "Ready In The Morning"
directions: At 4 p.m., boil first 4 ingredients together., Set in sink in water to cool., In a big bowl, dissolve the yeast in water., Stir in cooled mixture, 2 beaten eggs and enough flour to handle easily., Put in a greased bowl and let rise., At 9 to 10 p.m., punch down., Roll out in rectangle; spread with melted butter and sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon (3 tablespoons cinnamon, 1 cup sugar and 1 cup brown sugar)., Roll up and cut., Makes about 40 if cut about 1-inch.

title: Strawberry Angel Food Cake
directions: Prepare angel food cake according to directions., Just before baking, add red food coloring and stir into cake., Bake according to directions., Combine egg whites, sugar and strawberries in top of double boiler; beat with mixer to mix., Place over rapidly boiling water; beat constantly with mixer., Cook 7 minutes, or until mixture stands in peaks., Remove from boiling water; beat until cool., Fold in 2/3 cup strawberries., Spread over cake.

title: Garlic Pork Roast
directions: With a sharp knife, cut deep pockets between each rib on meaty side of roast., Combine green peppers, green onion, celery and garlic; stuff deeply into pockets., Season roast with salt and cayenne pepper., Insert meat thermometer., Place roast, rib side down, in a shallow roasting pan., Bake, uncovered, at 325° for 2 to 3 hours or until thermometer reads 170°., Let stand 15 minutes before carving.

title: Hershey Easy Pie
directions: Chop each peanut butter cup into 6 pieces, set aside. Microwave kisses in medium microwave safe bowl on high 1 minute or just until chocolate is melted when stirred, stir in 3 1/2 c. whipped topping until blended., Spread half of chocolate mixture into crust, sprinkle with peanut better cup pieces., Top with remaining chocolate mixture., Refrigerate 3 hours or until set.

title: Red Velvet Cocoa Cake
directions: Cream butter, sugar and vanilla in a large mixer bowl., Add eggs and food color; blend., Combine flour, cocoa and salt; add alternately with buttermilk to creamed mixture., Stir baking soda into vinegar; fold carefully into batter (do not beat)., Pour into 2 greased and floured 9-inch pans., Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes or until cake tester inserted in center comes out clean. Cool 10 minutes., Remove from pans.

title: Pound Cake
directions: Cream butter and sugar until light., Beat in egg yolks., Sift together dry ingredients and add to butter, sugar, egg mixture alternately with the milk and flavoring., Beat well., Carefully fold in egg whites., Bake in a tube pan or, in 2 loaf pans., Pans should be greased and floured., Bake in a 375° oven until done.

title: Snickers Cake
directions: Mix cake according to directions., Pour half, of batter into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 15 minutes. Melt caramels with milk and butter over low heat., Pour caramel mixture over baked cake., Sprinkle 1/2 of the nuts and all of chocolate chips over mixture., Pour remaining batter over this. Sprinkle with rest of the nuts and bake 20 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge(Small Batch, Can Be Doubled)
directions: Remove from heat and add 1/2 stick butter and 1 teaspoon vanilla., Let cool to 135°., Add peanut butter., Mix well., Pour into buttered dish., It should be getting stiff as you mix it up. It does not take long to set up.

title: Pecan Pie
directions: Beat sugar and Karo well., Add eggs, one at a time and beat well., Add butter, vanilla and pecans., Pour in a 9-inch unbaked pie shell and bake at 325° for 45 minutes or until done.

title: Pepper Steak
directions: Brown meat in 1 teaspoon oil., Add onions and garlic., Cook until tender., Add bouillon cube with 1 cup hot water, then add stewed tomatoes and green pepper., Cook 30 minutes, then add cornstarch and soya sauce., Cook 5 minutes longer., Serve over rice.

title: Chili Beans
directions: Put meat in shortening, then add chopped onion and garlic. Next, add the kidney beans, tomato soup and seasonings., Heat thoroughly., Just before serving, top with cheese and place under the broiler to melt cheese.

title: Macaroni Cheese Pie
directions: Cook macaroni until tender., Grate block cheese in bowl., Mix powdered cheese, milk and eggs together., Layer macaroni, then cheese alternately in casserole dish., Pour mixture on top., Salt and pepper to taste., Cook at 450° for 45 to 50 minutes until golden brown.

title: Sweet And Sour Cabbage
directions: Mix all together and cook over medium heat until tender., If cabbage seems to be quite moist, cut water by 1/2 cup.

title: Quick Lemon Pie
directions: Combine lemon juice and rind., Blend in condensed milk., Beat egg yolks slightly; blend into mixture., Pour into cooled pastry shell., Beat egg whites until foamy; add cream of tartar., Add sugar, one tablespoon at a time, beating well after each. Continue beating until very stiff peaks form., Pile lightly on pie filling., Brown in oven (350°) for 10 minutes., Serves 6.

title: Jollof Rice
directions: Brown beef in 12-inch skillet or Dutch oven., Drain., Add chicken, broth, mushrooms, rice, onion, green pepper, barbecue sauce and seasoning; bring to a boil., Reduce heat., Cover and simmer 30 minutes or until rice is tender., Add tomatoes; mix lightly.

title: Spanish Rice(Club Member: Kristi Mayfield)
directions: Cook rice in boiling salted water until tender. Fry 1/2 cup bacon until crisp. Add onion and green pepper; simmer until onion is soft and yellow. Add tomatoes, sugar, salt and pepper. Pour rice into strainer and rinse with hot running water. Add rice to onions, bacon and green pepper mixture. Mix well and pour into greased casserole dish., Bake about 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Praline Pumpkin Bars
directions: Mix flour, oatmeal, brown sugar and butter; pat into bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake at 350 degrees for 15 minutes.

title: Cranberry Slush
directions: In a large saucepan, cook the cranberries and 1 1/2 cups water over medium heat until the berries pop, about 15 minutes. Stir in raspberries. Transfer to a blender or food processor; cover and process until smooth. Strain and discard seeds, reserving juice. Pour the juice into a 2-quart freezer-proof container; set aside. In a small, saucepan, sprinkle gelatin over remaining water. Let stand for 1 minute. Stir in sugar., Cook and stir over medium heat until gelatin and sugar are dissolved. Add to berry juice. Stir in ginger ale; cover and freeze.

title: Ma Hettie'S Pound Cake
directions: Crem the butter, Crisco and sugar. Add eggs, one at a time. Alternately add 1 cup milk and flour mixture.

title: Shrimp Creole
directions: Heat oil over medium heat, add onion and cook until soft, about 6 minutes., Stir garlic and bell pepper and saute 2 minutes. Blend in flour; add tomato sauce and simmer for 5 minutes., Stir in water, thyme, parsley and shrimp., Simmer 30 minutes., Serve over rice.

title: Chicken Noodle Dumplings
directions: Boil chicken., Debone., Add 2 cans cream of chicken soup to broth., Add noodle dumplings., Cook until tender., Add salt and pepper to taste.

title: Open-Faced Chicken Sandwiches
directions: Combine chicken and celery., Mix salt, onion, mayonnaise and lemon juice. Mix into chicken., Split buns., Place, cut side down, on broiler rack., Brown lightly. Turn and butter cut side. Spread each with 1/4 cup chicken mixture. Toss cheese and corn chips together., Sprinkle over chicken., Broil 3-inches from heat until cheese is melted and slightly browned., Place on tray; garnish.

title: Sauteed Vegetable Medley
directions: The goal here is to create a variety of shapes, colors and tastes., It is not important to do it exactly as I do, but to find what you and your family like., I will describe how I do it.

title: Chicken Souffle
directions: Mix eggs, dry mustard, salt and milk., Layer bread, cheese and chicken in order listed., Pour liquid mixture over bread layers. Refrigerate overnight., In the morning, mix 1/3 to 1/2 cup melted butter with 2 1/2 cups corn flakes., Sprinkle over top., Bake 1 hour.

title: Turkey Goulash
directions: Combine turkey, seasonings, tomatoes, juice, green pepper, onion flakes, sweetener and mushrooms with liquid., Bring to a boil., Add macaroni and continue to boil, uncovered, until macaroni absorbs all of the juice and is tender, about 20 minutes. Divide evenly., Serves 4.

title: Lasagna
directions: Mix Ricotta, eggs, 1/2 cup Romano, salt, pepper and Accent until well combined.

title: Skillet Sausage And Sauerkraut
directions: Melt butter in heavy pan; add sliced meats., Cook 2 to 4 minutes, stirring until brown., Add broth and stir 30 seconds. Add remaining ingredients and toss lightly to mix., Cover and simmer over moderately low heat 10 minutes, until hot and flavors blend., Makes 3 to 4 servings., Contains 311 calories.

title: Icebox Cake
directions: Save the vanilla wafer box., Put all ingredients together and put in the box you saved; place in refrigerator., Cool for 24 hours., Tear box away and serve.

title: Stuffed French Bread
directions: Slice off top of loaf of bread and carve out center (keep). Brown and drain ground beef, sausage, onion and bell pepper. Combine egg, milk and bread (center)., Add to meat., Sprinkle grated Cheddar cheese on bottom of bread., Add meat mixture on top of cheese., Add cubes of Velveeta on top of meat., Put on top loaf. Brush with butter., Wrap in foil and bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Do not overbake., Take out of foil and slice.

title: Creamy Au Gratin Potatoes
directions: Preheat oven to 400°., Grease a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. In a saucepan, over medium heat, cook onion until tender., Stir in soup and cream cheese cubes., Cook, stirring constantly until smooth and hot.

title: Cabbage Casserole
directions: Cut cabbage in wedges or shred and cook in boiling water until tender., Drain and place in casserole dish., For sauce, melt butter in saucepan; blend in flour, salt and pepper., Cook over low heat; stir until smooth., Stir in milk; boil for 1 minute until thick., Spread sauce over cabbage., Bake at 375° for 20 minutes.

title: Hot Fudge Sundae Cake
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Measure flour, sugar, 2 tablespoons cocoa, the baking powder and salt into bowl., Blend in milk and shortening; stir in nuts., Pour into ungreased square 9 x 9 x 2-inch pan., Stir together brown sugar and 1/4 cup cocoa; sprinkle over batter., Pour hot water over batter.

title: Mexican Hash
directions: Cook and stir beef, onion, garlic and crushed red pepper in 10-inch skillet until beef is light brown. Drain. Add tomatoes, green pepper, raisins, salt, chili powder, cumin, cloves and cinnamon. Cover and simmer 10 minutes., In separate pan, cook and stir almonds over medium heat until golden, 2 to 3 minutes. Stir almonds and olives into beef mixture. Serve with rice.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Layer chicken in greased casserole dish., Place cheese over chicken breast., Spread soup and sour cream over cheese., Top with crumbs and butter., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes., Serve over noodles.

title: Schnitzel
directions: Beat each chop with meat beater until about 1/4-inch thick. Add Season-All., Beat eggs with fork on a flat plate., Put breadcrumbs on another plate., Put seasoned chops first in eggs to coat on both sides and then in breadcrumbs., Put breaded chops in medium hot grease in frying pan and brown both sides for 5 to 7 minutes, turning each chop only once., Enjoy.

title: Chef Tony Lasagna
directions: Cook lasagna according to package directions., Cook beef, garlic and onions in large saucepan for 10 minutes., Add next 3 ingredients; mix well and let simmer 15 minutes., In bowl, combine cottage cheese and eggs., Grease a 15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 2 1/2-inch baking pan., Arrange several alternate layers of cooked and drained lasagna, sliced cheese, meat sauce and cottage cheese mixture, beginning with lasagna and ending with meat sauce. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese., Bake at 350° for 45 to 55 minutes.

title: Rave Reviews Coconut Cake
directions: Blend cake mix, water, pudding mix, eggs and oil in large mixer bowl., Beat at medium speed of electric mixer 4 minutes. Stir in coconut and walnuts., Pour into 3 greased and floured 9-inch layer pans., Bake at 350° for 35 minutes., Cool in pan 15 minutes., Remove and cool on rack., Fill and frost with Coconut-Cream Cheese Frosting.

title: German Chocolate Pie
directions: Melt chocolate with butter over low heat, stirring until blended., Remove from heat; gradually blend in milk., Mix sugar, cornstarch and salt., Beat in eggs and vanilla., Gradually blend in chocolate mixture., Pour into pie shell., Combine coconut and nuts; sprinkle over filling., Bake at 375° for 45 minutes. Filling will be soft but will set while cooling., Cool at least 4 hours before cutting.

title: Best Homemade Chili
directions: In a large Dutch oven or soup kettle, brown beef with onions; drain. Stir in spices and tomato sauce. Simmer, uncovered, for 1 hour, stirring occasionally. Combine flour and vinegar. Stir into chili. Simmer another 15 minutes or until thickened.

title: Hot Dog And Potato Casserole
directions: Place layer of half potatoes and onions and half of the hot dogs over bottom of 2-quart baking dish., Drizzle half the margarine., Season with salt and pepper., Repeat, using remaining ingredients., Pour warm milk over casserole.

title: Easy Oven Lasagna
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., Brown ground beef and strain and return to pan., Add sauce and water, bring to a boil., Remove from heat. In 9 x 13-inch pan add meat sauce, noodles and cottage cheese. Repeat in layers, ending in layer of cheese., Bake 1 hour., Let stand 15 to 20 minutes before cutting., Makes 10 servings.

title: Mexican Chicken
directions: Mix the chiles, sour cream, cream of chicken soup and green onions., Coat tortillas in soup mixture., Place one layer in a 9 x 13-inch pan., Place chicken layer and cheese, then repeat layers. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Shortbread
directions: Cream butter, soda and sugar. Add as much flour as can be rolled in. Knead well. Cut in squares. Bake at 350 until done.

title: Sugar Cookies(Early 1900'S Recipe)
directions: Sift together all dry ingredients., Add liquids and mix well. Roll out dough 1/8 inch thick and cut in desired shape., Place on greased cookie sheet., Bake at 450° for 7 minutes., Makes about 3 dozen.

title: Quick Cobbler
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., Place margarine in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish., Heat in oven until melted.

title: Country Corn Pudding
directions: Combine all ingredients, except Cheddar cheese., Bake at 350° in casserole dish sprayed with Pam for approximately 45 minutes. Add the Cheddar cheese on top after half done.

title: Fruit Cocktail Cake
directions: Sift dry ingredients., Add all but brown sugar and nuts., Mix well., Pour in greased 9 x 13-inch pan., Sprinkle on top the brown sugar and nuts., Bake at 300° for 1 hour., Serve with whipped cream.

title: Ice Cream Sandwiches
directions: Bake Angel Loaves., Cool., Cut cake crosswise into 1/2-inch slices., Cut each slice in half and put together with matching slice of cherry-nut or vanilla ice cream., If desired, top with chocolate sauce., Makes 12 to 14 sandwiches., Use remaining loaf for another dessert.

title: Our Famous Chili
directions: Drain beans before adding to pot., Put all ingredients into a crock-pot., Cover and cook on low 10 to 12 hours or if using high, cook 6 to 8 hours.

title: Strawberry Dessert
directions: Mix the first 3 ingredients together with electric mixer. Blend into the Cool Whip., Pour into the graham cracker crusts. Top with chopped nuts., Makes 2 pies or 1 (9 x 13-inch) loaf.

title: Hamburger Chop Suey
directions: Brown beef and onion in skillet; add broth, soy sauce and sugar., Add vegetables; bring to a full boil, separating vegetables with fork, stirring frequently until sauce and cubes are blended., Cover and simmer 2 minutes., Bring to a boil again. Stir in rice and remove from heat; let stand for 5 minutes., Makes 4 servings.

title: Oven Caramel Corn
directions: Boil all ingredients, except corn and soda, for 5 minutes, mixing well and stirring., Remove from heat and add soda., Stir in quickly., Pour over popped corn., Mix well., Put in 2 large, flat pans and place in a 250° oven for 1 hour., Be sure to stir 2 or 3 times., Store in lightly closed container.

title: Fruit Cocktail Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients except coconut together., Grease 9 x 13-inch pan (or may use small cookie sheet that has deep sides). Sprinkle 1/2 cup coconut on bottom of pan., Then pour batter over the coconut., Bake at 350° for 50 minutes., Done when pick comes out clean., Cool, then frost with thin icing (drizzle on).

title: Chocolate Fudge(Microwave)
directions: Combine sugar, butter and evaporated milk in a 2 1/2-quart casserole., Microwave on High for 9 to 10 1/2 minutes., Add chocolate bits and marshmallow cream., Microwave on High for 30 seconds., Add chopped nuts and vanilla., Stir until chocolate pieces are melted., Pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch dish., Cool and cut into squares.

title: Bubble Recipe
directions: Combine, shake and let settle 4 hours., Have fun with bubble wand., Do not eat.

title: Strawberry Cake
directions: Mix thoroughly all the ingredients., Pour into prepared oblong cake pan., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Onion Shortcake
directions: Saute onion in margarine and cool. Add sour cream, salt, dill weed and half of cheese. Mix muffin mix with corn, egg and milk. Pour in 13 x 9-inch cake pan, then onion mixture, then top with last half of shredded cheese. Bake at 425° for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Ham Roll Ups
directions: Blend cheeses and margarine., Spread 1/4-inch on each slice of ham., Roll up; chill several hours or wrap and freeze.

title: E-Z Pizza
directions: Chop bell pepper and green onion together, sprinkle over sauce. Add sausage, pepperoni or hamburger., Top with cheese., Cook about 10 minutes or until cheese begins to brown.

title: Cucumber Sandwiches
directions: Grate together cucumber, carrots and onion., Drain the juice and save., Cream together the cream cheese and mayonnaise., Heat juice till hot, but not boiling, let it cool in cold water, add pkg. of knox gelation and stir together, let cool again until room temperature., Mix cucumber mix, and cream cheese mix into juice mixture., Stir well, and then beat mixture until it is fluffy and creamy., Refrigerate over night, salt to taste and spread onto frozen bread, trim off crust of bread and cut into finger sandwiches.

title: Currant Glazed Appetizer Franks
directions: Heat jelly and mustard together; stir occasionally, until blended., Add franks and heat., Serve with toothpicks., Use a fondue pan which keeps just the right heat but does not burn.

title: Franklin Pecan Cake
directions: Cream butter and sugar., Add beaten eggs., Sift flour, salt and baking powder., Add 3 cups of flour mixture., Pour last cup of flour over fruits and pecans., Add this to other ingredients., Add flavoring, mix well., Grease and flour a tube pan., Pour cake in pan., Bake in 300° oven for 3 hours.

title: Cheese Potatoes
directions: Cook the potatoes and grate or mash with a wire potato masher. Combine cheese and butter., Melt., Add sour cream, onion, salt and pepper. Fold in potatoes., Put into 2-quart casserole. Dot with butter., Bake 25 minutes at 350°., Yummy.

title: Fruit Bread
directions: Blend together the butter and sugar and beat., Mix flour, baking powder and soda and add to butter mixture., Add beaten egg and gradually add buttermilk., Fold in raisins., Pour into a greased and floured loaf pan and bake 1 hour at 350°.

title: Aunt Gin'S Pound Cake
directions: Cream together sugar, Crisco and butter and add eggs, one at a time., Sift flour, baking powder and salt., Add the creamed mixture to the flour mixture., Add milk and vanilla., Bake in a greased and floured tube pan at 325° for 1 hour and 20 minutes, depending on oven.

title: Russian Tea(Old Recipe)
directions: Mix all ingredients., Put 4 to 5 teaspoons in cup of hot water.

title: Cheesy Scalloped Potatoes
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., Spray 2-quart baking dish with nonstick cooking spray; set aside., In small saucepan over medium heat, melt butter., Stir in flour and salt until smooth., Gradually stir in milk., Bring to a boil, stirring frequently., Boil 2 minutes until thickened, stirring constantly., Add cheese and chives; stir until cheese is melted., Arrange potato slices in prepared baking dish. Spoon cheese-chive mixture over potato slices., Cover with aluminum foil and bake 45 minutes., Remove foil and bake 30 minutes more until potatoes are tender and top is golden brown., Garnish with fresh chives., Makes 4 servings.

title: Hot Gourmet Deer Chili
directions: Cube meat and, grind, with, hamburger plate of electric grinder., In a large, pot, heat olive oil and saute garlic for 1 minute., Add onion, and, ground, meat., Cook, until, meat is done. Add next 17, ingredients;, bring, to a boil., Cover and simmer 1 hour,, stirring occasionally., Slowly stir in cracker meal., Let simmer 10 more minutes, stirring frequently., Serve hot with crackers, Fritos or French-style garlic bread.

title: Jalapeno Corn Bread
directions: Preheat oven to 425°., Grease, two, 9, x 11-inch or 9 x 9-inch pans., Pour, the batter into the baking pans and spread evenly with a rubber scraper or spoon., Bake in the oven until the bread tests, done;, a, wooden, toothpick, or, metal skewer inserted in the center comes out clean., Remove bread from the oven., Let the pans, cool, somewhat, on, metal, racks, before cutting into serving pieces.

title: Grandma Mary Ann'S Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Cream shortenings and sugars., Mix in honey, eggs and vanilla. Stir in cinnamon, salt, flour, baking soda, oatmeal, nuts and raisins., Drop teaspoonfuls on greased cookie sheets., Bake 10 to 12 minutes at 375°.

title: Queen Elizabeth Cake
directions: Mix together sugar, shortening, egg and vanilla., Add flour, baking powder and soda., Next, add remaining ingredients., Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes or until cake tests done.

title: Orange Salad
directions: Place cottage cheese in a bowl., Sprinkle dry jello over it and mix., Drain mandarin oranges and add., Add nuts and mix with Cool Whip.

title: Shrimp Salad
directions: Cook pasta by package directions., Drain., Rinse with cold water to cool quickly; drain well., Combine cooled pasta \, celery and shrimp., Cover; chill., In a small bowl, combine remaining ingredients., Whip with wire whisk until creamy., Cover; chill. Serve salad on bed of lettuce with dressing drizzled over top or toss until blended.

title: Strawberry Dessert
directions: Mix pineapple and jello in bowl and heat in microwave for 4 minutes., In another bowl, mix buttermilk and Cool Whip., Combine with other ingredients and refrigerate.

title: Cottage Cheese Dessert
directions: Mix together, cottage cheese and dry jello., Beat., Add cool whip and mandarin oranges, pour in dish., Refrigerate for a couple of hours, then serve.

title: Cranberry-Strawberry Relish
directions: A day before serving, mix cranberries and strawberries. Refrigerate.

title: Spice Cake
directions: Cream butter and sugar., Add eggs and applesauce., Sift flour, soda and spices together and gradually add to cake mixture., Melt chocolate over hot water and add to cake for a lovely rich color. Makes 3 large 9-inch layers., Bake at 375° for 20 minutes., Ice.

title: Dieter'S Fluff
directions: Mix jello with cottage cheese., Add drained pineapple., Fold in Cool Whip., Any flavor jello can be used.

title: Parslied Potatoes
directions: Peel a strip of skin off of potatoes in the middle., Place potatoes in cold water., Heat large skillet over medium-high heat. Add oil., Saut onion and garlic for approximately 5 minutes. Add broth and 3/4 cup parsley; bring to a boil., Place potatoes (one layer) in skillet., Return to boil., Reduce heat., Simmer, covered, for 10 minutes or until potatoes are tender. Remove potatoes with slotted spoon to a serving bowl., Add pepper to skillet mixture; stir., Pour over potatoes., Sprinkle with remaining parsley.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Steam broccoli until tender., Put into casserole., Mix soup and sour cream., Pour over broccoli., Grate cheese and distribute evenly over broccoli., Bake at 300° until cheese has melted.

title: Spinach-Rice Casserole
directions: Cook for 40 minutes the brown rice and vegetable broth. Prepare the Cheddar cheese, parsley and fresh spinach while rice is cooking., After rice has cooked 30 minutes, preheat oven to 350°. Mix cooked rice with the Cheddar cheese mixture adding garlic powder, black pepper and eggs., Spoon mixture into greased casserole dish., Top with mixture of Parmesan cheese, melted butter and bread crumbs., Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

title: Lettie'S Peanut Butter Candy
directions: Combine first five ingredients and cook until it forms a soft ball., Add peanut butter., Grease cookie sheet., Pour., Cut in squares.

title: Pizza Casserole
directions: Brown hamburger; drain fat. Sprinkle Parmesan cheese in bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan. Mix beef, green pepper, salt and pepper. Add rest of ingredients, except Mozzarella cheese., Put in pan and sprinkle with Mozzarella cheese. Bake at 325° for 35 minutes, covered, and 15 minutes, uncovered., This can also be cooked in a crock-pot.

title: Garlic Pasta
directions: Chop the garlic and saute in the olive oil., Do not burn the garlic., Add the pinch of red pepper flakes to the olive oil and garlic., Pour the olive oil mixture over the cooked spaghetti. Add the cheese and parsley flakes and toss.

title: Orange Date Bread
directions: Cream butter and sugar., Stir in egg., Mix well., Combine dates, juice, rind, 1 teaspoon soda and hot water., Cool., Add to sugar and butter mixture., Combine flour, 1 teaspoon soda and salt., Add to first mixture., Stir in nuts., Pour into standard sized, oiled loaf pan., Bake 1 hour at 350°.

title: Shrimp Maska
directions: Heat olive oil in pan., Add shrimp and spices., Saute for 20 to 30 minutes., Add wine and simmer for 10 to 15 minutes., Serve hot with French bread.

title: Uncooked Fruit Cake
directions: Heat milk and melt marshmallows in double boiler., Mix crushed graham crackers, candy, raisins and nuts together., Add milk and marshmallow mixture; mix well., Put in a well buttered 9 x 12-inch pan.

title: Fruit Salad
directions: Mix jello and Cool Whip., Add cottage cheese; mix well., Add fruit of choice., Pour into mold or leave in bowl., Chill overnight., Garnish with fresh fruit.

title: Green Enchiladas
directions: Brown ground beef with salt and garlic., Drain well. Set aside., Make sauce: heat soup, milk and Velveeta until melted. Add green chiles, dip mix and pimentos., Add cheese and onions to meat., Mix well., Soften tortillas by dipping them, one at a time, in hot oil in shallow skillet. Drain. Fill with meat mixture. Roll and place in a greased 10 x 13 casserole dish., Pour cheese sauce over top., Cover and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Maryland She-Crab Soup
directions: Melt butter in pan., Add celery and onions., Saute until tender., Blend in flour and seasonings., Gradually add chicken broth, stirring constantly., Heat to boiling., Add cream and crabmeat., Season with nutmeg to taste., Do not boil!

title: Chicken Divan
directions: Steam chicken in a little water., Bone and cut chicken into small pieces., Cook and drain broccoli., Place broccoli in bottom of casserole sprayed with Pam., Layer chicken, then sauce made of soup, mayonnaise, lemon juice, black pepper and curry powder. Sprinkle with paprika., Top with grated cheese., Last, layer with stuffing mix combined with the melted margarine., Bake for 30 minutes at 350°., Makes 8 servings.

title: Rotini
directions: Brown and drain ground beef, onion, salt and pepper., Add Prego, tomato juice, oregano and sweet basil; simmer 20 minutes. Cook macaroni until tender and drain., Grate cheese., Layer in 2-quart casserole dish the meat sauce, macaroni, cheese, macaroni and meat sauce., Bake at 325° for 30 to 35 minutes., Add remaining cheese on top and bake until melted., Let stand 5 minutes before serving., Serves 4 to 6.

title: Microwave Cabbage Rolls Italian Style
directions: In 3-quart casserole, place cabbage and water., Cover and microwave on High for 7 to 9 minutes until leaves are pliable. While cabbage is cooking, mix together ground beef, egg, rice, onion and salt., Divide meat mixture into 8 equal portions., Place one portion on each partially cooked cabbage leaf and roll meat into leaf, securing with toothpick if necessary., Return to 3-quart casserole, placing rolls seam side down., Blend tomato sauce, sugar and oregano., Pour over cabbage rolls., Cover and microwave on High 15 to 17 minutes, rotating dish half turn and basting with sauce after 9 minutes.

title: Shrimp Dip
directions: Combine cream cheese with mayonnaise until smooth., Add remaining ingredients and chill., Serve with Toast Squares.

title: Ham Balls
directions: Combine all together., Shape into fairly large balls., Place in shallow dish and bake after pouring sauce over them at 325° for 2 hours.

title: 24-Hour Cucumber Pickles
directions: Cut cucumbers in thin slices and soak in lime water for 12 to 14 hours., Wash and soak in salt water for four hours., Bring to a boil in strong alum water., Pour off alum water and dip in hot boiling water., Combine spices (in a bag), sugar, vinegar and cucumbers and simmer for 25 minutes., Let cool., Pack in jars and seal., Makes 10 to 11 pints.

title: Easy Holiday Salad
directions: Make jello as usual, using 2 cups boiling water; stir until dissolved., Add frozen raspberries; stir until mixed., Stir in cranberry sauce., Pour half of mixture into dish., Chill until firm., Mix softened cream cheese with small amount of sour cream. Spread over jello mixture., Top with rest of jello mixture. Chill., Cut into squares.

title: Turkey Salad
directions: Cook turkey until tender, debone as soon as cool enough., Put in refrigerator to get cold., Chop all ingredients in food processor individually, removing to mixing bowl., Add all ingredients., Mix well., Refrigerate until ready to be served.

title: Macaroni And Tomatoes
directions: Cook macaroni according to package directions., Drain., Add stewed tomatoes and tomato juice., Add spices to taste., Simmer for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Frogmore Stew
directions: In large stockpot, add seasonings to water., Bring to a boil. Add sausage and boil, uncovered, 5 minutes., Add corn; count 5 minutes., Add shrimp; count 3 minutes., (Don't wait for liquid to return to a boil before timing corn and shrimp.), Drain immediately and serve., Serve with cocktail sauce, sweet and sour mustard or hot mustard., Serves 8.

title: Easy Fall Ratatouille Recipe
directions: Saute vegetables in sun-dried tomato dressing in large ovenproof skillet until tender., Add diced tomatoes, cook about 15 minutes, allowing some of the liquid to evaporate., Top with cheeses and bake in 350° oven for 15 minutes.

title: Squash Casserole
directions: Cook your squash for 12 minutes; drain. Mix sour cream, soup, onions, pimentos and water chestnuts; set aside. When squash is done, mix with sour cream mixture. Mix your dressing with 1 block butter/margarine, melted. Put one layer dressing on bottom of casserole dish; add squash mixture. Add remaining dressing to the top. Bake or put in microwave for 20 to 25 minutes at 325°.

title: Irish Potato Cakes
directions: Mix all together and form into little cakes., Fry in butter until brown., Serve hot with syrup or butter.

title: Granny'S Lazy Daisy Cake
directions: Beat first 4 ingredients together., Boil last 2 ingredients, add to egg mixture and mix well., Bake in a 350° oven until done.

title: Pushcart Palpetta(Spaghetti Sauce)
directions: Remove and chop the stems from mushrooms., Heat 3 tablespoons oil in large skillet; saute mushroom caps, round side down first, for 3 minutes., Turn and repeat., Brown sausages; discard fat. Heat 3 tablespoons oil; saute mushroom stems, green pepper, onion and celery until brown., Move to side; cook hamburg., Cut sausages into 1/2-inch slices; return to skillet., Add salt, oregano, basil, parsley, tomato sauce and dry red wine., Cover; simmer slowly for 45 minutes.

title: Super Seafood Supper
directions: Cook, celery,, green pepper and onion, in, butter, until partially cooked., Combine these with seafood and pimento.	Mix sour cream, light cream, lemon juice and, seasonings, in, small bowl., Combine 3/4 cup cream mixture, rice	and, drained mushrooms.	 Spread rice mixture evenly in well greased 15	x, 9 x 2-inch, baking, dish., Place seafood mixture on	top, of, rice mixture., Pour remaining 1/4 cup of cream mixture over seafood. Combine, bread, crumbs, with remaining, butter., Sprinkle, over casserole and bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350°., May be prepared a day, ahead	and, refrigerated., Allow, 30	minutes, additional cooking time if refrigerated.

title: Prune Cake
directions: Beat prunes, cake mix, cinnamon and nutmeg real hard., Bake for 40 minutes at 350°., While cake is hot, poke holes in cake layer. Mix buttermilk, sugar and melted margarine together; pour over the cake., Heat and stir until all sugar is melted., Bake in pan that the cake can stay in until all is eaten.

title: Missy Potatoes
directions: Combine first 7 ingredients., Spoon into lightly greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish., Sprinkle cracker crumbs over top., Bake at 350° for 40 minutes or until bubbly., Serves 10 to 12.

title: White Christmas Candy
directions: Melt chocolate over medium/low heat, stirring until smooth. Remove from the heat; stir in candy., Spread on parchment paper-lined cookie sheets.	Refrigerate for 8 to 10 minutes. Break into small pieces; store in airtight containers.

title: Yeast Biscuits
directions: Sift dry ingredients., Cut in shortening until fine., Heat milk, lukewarm only., Dissolve yeast in milk., Mix with dry ingredients and knead well. Roll out 1/4-inch thick., Cut in rounds or squares., (I prefer squares.), Brush with butter and top with another round or square and butter top., Let rise a few minutes before baking at 350°.

title: Pilaf Rice
directions: Saute onion in butter in large skillet until tender, but not brown, about 5 minutes., Add rice and saute for 3 minutes., Add bouillon, and salt., Bring to boil., Remove from heat., Cover and let stand for 5 minutes., Stir in almonds and parsley; fluff with a fork.

title: Bourbon Bread Pudding
directions: Cube bread; soak in milk., Add sugar, eggs, vanilla, chopped apple, raisins and margarine., Mix all together with hands., Put in buttered casserole., Bake at 350° for 1/2 hour, or until firm.

title: Cheddar Baked Potatoes
directions: In smal bowl, combine soup, paprika and pepper., In a greased 2-quart oblong baking dish, arrange potatoes in overlapping rows. Sprinkle with cheese., Spoon soup mixture over cheese., Cover with foil., Bake at 400° for 45 minutes., Uncover., Bake 10 minutes or until potatoes are fork-tender.

title: Cherry Coffee Cake
directions: Cream the sugar with the oil. Add eggs, one at a time, beating until well blended., Add flour sifted with the baking powder. Pour 1/2 into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan., Spread the cherry pie filling over the dough. Sprinkle lightly with sugar and cinnamon. Add remaining dough and sprinkle with more cinnamon and sugar. Bake at 325° for 50 minutes. Drizzle with powdered sugar glaze when still slightly warm.

title: Chicken Spaghetti
directions: Cook spaghetti and drain., Mix soup and chicken broth and heat. Mix all ingredients and put in greased casserole., Top with 1/3 of the cheese., Cover and bake for 30 minutes in 350° oven., Uncover and bake 15 minutes longer., Can freeze.

title: Oatmeal, Coconut And Chocolate Chip Cookies
directions: Cream margarine and sugar., Add eggs and vanilla; mix., Add the flour, a little at a time, mixing well., In 1 cup of the flour, mix the baking soda, baking powder and salt; add to dough. After mixing all the dry ingredients, add and mix the chocolate chips, pecans and coconut., Then add the oats., (The mixture may be so thick that you will have to mix by hand.), Bake at 400° on top shelf of oven., Bake until they are light, light brown., Take out and let cool 5 minutes on pan, then remove to rack to cool. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet.

title: Pecan Balls
directions: Mix well., Roll to size of walnut or smaller., Put on ungreased cookie sheet and bake at 275° for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Super Hash Brown Potato Casserole
directions: Mix hash brown potatoes, grated Cheddar cheese and chopped onion together., Mix sour cream, soup and melted margarine together., Combine potato mixture and soup mixture in large bowl. Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish., Sprinkle crushed corn flakes over the top., Bake at 350° for 1 hour., Everyone loves it.

title: N.Y.  Cheesecake
directions: Mix all ingredients in order given, beating well after each. Pour in well-greased 10-inch spring-form pan., Bake at 350° for 1 hour., Shut off oven., Leave in oven for 2 hours., (Total:, 3 hours; do not open oven door from start to end!!)

title: Spinach Salad
directions: Combine ingredients in a salad bowl., Pour dressing over and coat well to mix., Serve at once.

title: Carrot Cake
directions: Mix oil and sugar., Add one egg at a time., Sift dry ingredients together., Mix together, then add carrots and nuts. Blend with mixer., Pour in pan and bake (flour pans) at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes., Don't look until 30 minutes are up., Cool and frost; add nuts on top.

title: Eggless Milkless Butterless Cake
directions: Mix together and let come to a boil the first four ingredients., When cool add the rest of the ingredients., Mix well and pour into layer pans., Bake in moderately hot oven at 350 degrees until done., Put layers together with Powdered Sugar Icing., Can also be baked in a loaf pan.

title: Deep Dark Chocolate Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Grease and flour 13 x 9-inch pan., In large bowl, combine dry ingredients., Add eggs, milk, oil and vanilla; beat medium speed 2 minutes., Stir in boiling water (batter will be thin)., Pour in prepared pan., Bake 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Southern Fried Chicken
directions: Wash chicken; drain on paper towel., Season chicken with salt and pepper., Dip in egg mixture., Add spices to flour; coat chicken., Fry slowly in hot oil until browned on both sides (about 35 minutes), turning as needed.

title: Border Beans
directions: In a tall, narrow ware pot (Mexicans call it a jarrow), the beans nestle closely together and pack while cooking and it means the heat seeps gently through the jarrow as it should in cooking beans., In order that the beans pack right, you should use enough to almost fill the pot when they swell, never less than 2 pounds. Use Mexican pinto beans., Wash the beans; put them in the pot and fill the pot about half full of water., Never soak pinto beans., It causes them to be mushy., Using a medium flame, bring the water to a boil while stirring the beans to keep them from burning., When the water boils, turn the fire low so it can barely simmer., It is best if you see a bubbly oozing out now and then., Throughout the cooking, keep the water level barely covering the beans., It makes them pack., Be sure any water you add is boiling., After an hour of cooking, add several chunks of salt pork., Some people put a lid on the beans, but I do not., It chokes off those fine odors and sometimes it causes the juices to boil over., At the end of the second hour, cut the garlic fine (I use 6 pods)., At the end of another hour, add the oregano and chili pequins, mashed up (I use jalapeno peppers, 2 small ones, with seeds taken out)., Cook another hour., At the end of 4 hours of cooking, add salt, one level tablespoon per each pound of beans., Simmer 1 more hour.

title: Apple Pie
directions: Peel and slice apples., Melt butter., Add sugar and flour. Pour over apples., Sprinkle with cinnamon., Bake in oven at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Quick Tea Mix
directions: To use, add 1 teaspoon of spiced tea mixture per cup of boiling water., Package tea in small jars., Use a ribbon to tie a cinnamon stick (used to stir tea) to top of jar along with instructions on how to use mix.

title: King Casserole
directions: Place in baking dish layer of chicken and Doritos., Mix in chopped onion, soup and tomatoes together., Pour over chicken and Doritos., Sprinkle cheese on top., Bake 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Green Bean Supreme
directions: Drain green beans., Combine all ingredients in a 1-quart casserole., Bake 10 minutes in 400° oven.

title: Deviled Ham And Cheese Ball
directions: Combine all ingredients, except sunflower seeds or nuts. Refrigerate until firm enough to handle., Form into ball and roll in sunflower seeds or nuts., Refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Eggplant Moussaka
directions: Steam eggplants for 2 to 3 minutes., Saute onion, green pepper, garlic and celery in vegetable oil., Add tomatoes and cook briefly (5 to 10 minutes)., Add to mixture the cracked wheat cereal and simmer 20 minutes or so until cereal is cooked., (Add tomatoes or tomato sauce, if liquid evaporates).

title: Bloody Mary
directions: Shake with cracked ice., Strain into 6 ounce glass.

title: Mexican Cornbread
directions: Combine all ingredients., Pour into lightly greased pan and bake at 350° until done.

title: Low-Fat Chicken In Mushroom Gravy
directions: Remove all visible fat from chicken breasts., Place in casserole which has been sprayed with Pam., Top with condensed mushroom soup and add pepper to taste., Cover and bake at 350° for 1 hour or until tender., (No additional salt is needed., Can substitute Healthy Request condensed chicken soup if desired.)

title: Cream Cheese Brownies
directions: Cream together the 1/3 cup sugar and cream cheese., Add the 1 egg and mix., Set aside., Heat together the baking chocolate, butter and water until boiling., Remove from heat., Combine the 2 cups sugar and flour., Stir into chocolate mixture., Mix the 2 eggs, sour cream, salt and baking soda., Add to chocolate mixture. Pour chocolate batter into a greased and floured oblong cake pan. Spoon cream cheese mixture across top and cut in with a knife to create a marbling effect., Sprinkle top with the chocolate chips. Bake at 355° for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Na-Cho Ordinary Potatoes
directions: In square baking dish covered with plastic wrap, steam potatoes with 2 tablespoons water for 10 minutes on High in microwave, stirring halfway through., Toss with oleo and seasonings., Sprinkle with 1 1/4 cups cheese., Microwave for 2 minutes on High., Top with chips and remaining cheese., Cook for 2 minutes and 30 seconds on 50% power.

title: Crabmeat Quiche
directions: Combine mayonnaise, flour, milk and beaten eggs; stir until well blended., Then add remaining ingredients., Pour into the pie shell and bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Mix all the ingredients, except chicken, and put in a large oblong pan., Put cut up chicken pieces on top of soup mixture., Sprinkle 1/2 package of dry onion soup mix over all of the chicken., Sprinkle with paprika., Bake at 350° for 2 hours.

title: Spoon Bread
directions: Sift meal with salt and add boiling water., Add butter and stir until smooth., Add beaten eggs and milk., Sprinkle baking powder over top and stir quickly into batter., Pour into greased pan or pans and bake at 350° for 1 hour for large pan or 45 to 50 minutes for 2 pie pan or 1/2 recipe.

title: Oven Baked Chicken
directions: Place chicken in baking pan., Combine all other ingredients and pour over chicken., Add sliced mushrooms and Parmesan cheese. Bake at 325° to 350° for 1 hour., Serve with Rice-A-Roni pilaf rice.

title: Wanda'S Seven Layer Salad
directions: Layer the above ingredients in the order given or toss the ingredients all together.

title: Strawberry Salad
directions: Combine gelatin with 1 cup hot water., Add strawberries, crushed pineapple and bananas., Pour 1/2 of this mixture into a 1 1/2 to 2-quart mold., Refrigerate and let thicken., When set, cover with a layer of sour cream., Spread remaining gelatin mixture over the sour cream., Refrigerate., Unmold before serving. Serves 12., Exchanges:, 1 serving = 1 fruit, 1/2 fat., Calories: 1 serving = 83.

title: Meatball Appetizers
directions: Combine all ingredients., Mix well., Make into balls the size of meatballs., Cook on a broiler pan at 350° for 10 minutes., Makes about 30 meatballs.

title: Yeast Dough For Sweet Buns And Cherry Bread
directions: Mix together yeast, milk and flour., Let stand until spongy (20 to 30 minutes)., In a large bowl, put eggs, salt and sugar. Mix well, then add 4 cups flour., You'll have a very soft dough. Next, add your first mixture. Beat with a spoon. Add 1/2 cup melted butter. Work butter into the dough mixture until smooth. Knead on floured surface, adding 1 more cup flour until smooth and elastic. Dough is kneaded enough when it becomes shiny and has little air pockets or bubbles in the surface., Put dough in greased bowl and turn, leaving greased side up. Cover and let rise in warm place until double in size (approximately 1 1/2 hours). Punch down and make cinnamon buns or Cherry Bread.

title: Snowballs
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Heat oven to 350., Roll dough into balls and bake on a cookie sheet or 20 minutes., Roll in powdered sugar while hot and again when cold.

title: Philly Beef-A-Roni(In Honor Of "Adios")
directions: Brown ground beef in skillet., Add mushroom soup, tomato paste, garlic, salt, pepper and sugar; cook slowly 15 to 20 minutes., Cook macaroni until barely tender; drain., Set oven at 350°., Mix cream cheese with milk, sour cream and onion.

title: Strawberry Nut Bread
directions: Combine first five ingredients in large mixing bowl. Make a well in the center of mixture.

title: Peach Cobbler
directions: Place butter/margarine in baking dish, and melt in oven. Mix sugar, flour & milk. Add peaches to mixture. Pour over melted butter. Bake at 350 degrees until light brown on top. Best to eat while warm.

title: Trail Side Cookies
directions: Mix all ingredients and drop by spoonful on cookie sheet. Bake 15 minutes at 350°. Makes large batch of cookies.

title: Golden Medley Orange Candied Yams
directions: In saucepan, melt butter or margarine., Add almonds, brown sugar and orange juice; simmer, stirring occasionally, for 5 minutes., Add yams; sprinkle with salt., Simmer 10 to 15 minutes, spooning sauce over frequently., Garnish with orange sections. Makes about 8 to 10 servings.

title: Grandmothers Tea Cakes
directions: Sift dry ingredients then cut in shortening., Add eggs, milk, and vanilla., Roll out dough and cut as desired., Bake at 350 degrees for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Irish Soda Bread
directions: Mix first 5 ingredients; cut in butter with knife or pastry cutter., Add buttermilk, unbeaten egg and vanilla; also nutmeg and cinnamon., Pour into greased 9-inch cake pan (round)., Bake at 350° for 50 minutes.

title: Creamy Banana Pudding
directions: In a large bowl, combine sweetened condensed milk and water. Add pudding mix and beat well., Chill 5 minutes., Fold in whipping cream., Spoon 1 cup banana pudding mixture into 2 1/2-quart glass serving bowl., Top with 1/3 each of wafers, bananas and pudding., Repeat layers, ending with pudding., Chill. Garnish as desired., Refrigerate.

title: Pound Cake
directions: Mix ingredients in order given. Grease and flour an angel food cake pan or a bundt pan. Pour batter in pan and put in cold oven. Bake at 325 degrees for 1 hour and 40 minutes.

title: Wendy'S Chili
directions: In 1 tablespoon of oil, brown the ground round., Put the can of onion soup through a blender and add to beef., Add all the other ingredients., Heat 20 minutes on medium to blend flavors. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Spinach Quiche
directions: Melt butter in a large skillet., Saute onions over medium heat until soft, about 5 minutes., Add spinach and continue to cook, stirring often, until no liquid is left., Add salt, pepper and nutmeg., Stir well and allow to cool., Preheat oven to 375°., Beat eggs and cream together; gradually add to spinach mixture., Stir until smooth., Add cheese and combine., Pour mixture into pie shells., Place shells on cookie sheet and bake 30 to 35 minutes or until a knife inserted into pie comes out clean., Serve hot or room temperature.

title: Sour Cream Rhubarb Pie
directions: Place rhubarb in pastry shell., Blend together egg, sugar, salt, tapioca and sour cream., Pour over rhubarb and bake.

title: Minestrone Vegetable Soup
directions: In large saucepan, saute onions and celery until soft., Stir in broth and tomato sauce; bring to a boil., Add frozen vegetables, pasta, garlic powder and pepper., Simmer, uncovered, for 15 minutes., Add kidney beans and simmer 5 minutes longer.

title: Watergate Salad
directions: Mix pudding with 1/4 cup fruit juice., Mix rest of juice (not to exceed 3/4 to 1 cup) and add other ingredients., Let stand a few hours or overnight., Keeps well in fridge up to 10 days., Can be served on lettuce as a salad or as a dessert with a red cherry on top., Can be stretched by adding more marshmallows.

title: Coss Hot Cider
directions: Make in a 12-cup drip coffee maker glass pot or any 12-cup container., Mix together apple cider, apple juice, lemon juice, cinnamon and cloves., Serve hot., This can be heated in a microwave or on top of the stove., Keep hot on a drip coffee maker.

title: Cheesy Hash Browns
directions: Mix first 8 ingredients together. Place in 9 x 13-inch pan. Top with cheese and corn flakes. Bake 1 hour at 350°.

title: Gingerbread People
directions: Mix shortening, honey, egg and molasses., In another bowl, sift soda, salt, ginger, cinnamon, cloves and flour., Mix wet and dry ingredients to form dough. Roll 1/4-inch thick on floured surface., Cut with cookie cutter. Decorate with raisins, nuts, licorice and tiny candies. Bake at 375° for 10 minutes.

title: Butter Stickies(From Connie'S Biscuit Mix)
directions: Make the same way as biscuits, but roll the dough into an oblong shape., Spread top with melted margarine., Sprinkle with generous amounts of cinnamon, sugar and brown sugar., Roll jelly roll fashion and cut into 1/2-inch slices., Put in greased pan; adding 1 tablespoon water to bottom., Bake at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes; turn out onto plate.

title: Chicken Salad (For Two)
directions: In medium bowl, gently stir together chicken, apple, celery and raisins., In cup, stir together dressing and brown sugar; pour over chicken mixture., Toss gently to coat., Serve on lettuce leaves., Yields 1 1/2 cups or 2 servings.

title: Hamburger Casserole
directions: Brown beef and onion in butter; add tomato sauce, cottage cheese and sour cream., Put cooked noodles in greased casserole dish., Top with cheese mixture., Add meat, then sprinkle with paprika., Cover and heat in 350° oven about 30 minutes.

title: Angel Hair Pasta And Tomato Vinaigrette
directions: Cook pasta in boiling salted water until tender; drain. Combine tomatoes, garlic, basil, oil, vinegar and red pepper flakes in skillet., Season with salt and pepper., Cook until tomatoes are barely heated through and still firm, about 3 minutes., Pour over drained pasta., Makes 4 servings.

title: Mom'S Baked Beans Galore
directions: Mix ingredients., Bake at 375° for 20 to 30 minutes or cook in skillet; stir regularly for 20 minutes on low heat., Great for barbecues!

title: Granola
directions: Stir flours together., Toast in heavy frying pan (no oil is needed) until well browned. Do not burn., Place in large mixing bowl., Add wheat germ, coconut, sesame seed and sunflower seeds which have been toasted individually.

title: Pumpkin Cake
directions: Mix together in a large bowl eggs and sugar., Add salad oil, flour, soda, cinnamon, salt, pumpkin and vanilla., Put mixture into a 13 x 9 x 2-inch greased and floured pan and bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

title: Veal With Rosemary
directions: Cut the meat into cubes and lightly brown in hot oil, stirring frequently., Add the onions and cook until golden., Add tomatoes and seasonings., Cover and simmer about 25 minutes., Combine the flour and water and stir into the meat to thicken; stir., Continue cooking until the meat is tender and the gravy thickened., Serve over noodles or rice., Yield:, 4 servings.

title: Baked Beans
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Bake at 325° for 3 hours.

title: No Bake Coconut Cake
directions: Sprinkle gelatine over	cold water to soften., Cook egg yolks, sugar and, flour, until smooth., Add salt and gradually add milk. Cook, slowly, until coats spoon., Stir in gelatine. Refrigerate 1 hour, until, cool.	Beat, egg, whites;, fold, in cooled custard. Tear, cake	into, small, pieces., Use half to cover bottom of sheet, cake, pan., Pour, half, of custard over cake pieces. Sprinkle half of coconut over that., Put rest of cake, then rest of	custard,, then	coconut., Put Dream Whip, that has been, made by directions., (May substitute with Cool Whip.)

title: Mamaw'S Yeast Rolls
directions: Take sugar, salt and yeast, mix with flour; add the water. Mix until it gets like bread dough., Keep adding flour until it is thick enough to knead., Put in greased bowl and let rise until double., Roll out and cut into biscuits., Bake at 350° until golden brown; brush with butter.

title: Cinnamon Toast Cake
directions: Sift together flour, 1 cup sugar, baking powder and salt. Blend milk, shortening and vanilla., Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes on 11 x 17-inch baking sheet., Drizzle 1/2 cup melted butter over cake.

title: Two-Layer Cake
directions: Cream butter, Crisco and sugar until light and fluffy., Add eggs one at a time, beating well after each addition., Fold in flour alternately with milk., Add salt, lemon and vanilla., Bake in 2 greased and floured cake pans at 350° for 25 or 30 minutes.

title: Bread And Butter Pickles Or Peppers
directions: In large pan, cover cucumbers or peppers and onions with salt. Fill pan with water., Let stand for 2 hours., Bring cider vinegar, celery seed, mustard seed, powdered ginger, turmeric and sugar to a rolling boil., Add drained cucumbers and onions., Heat just to boiling and pack in hot, sterilized jars.

title: Sweet-Sour Red Cabbage
directions: In large frying pan, combine all ingredients; mix well. Cover; simmer 25 to 30 minutes or until cabbage is tender., Stir several times while cabbage mixture is cooking., Serves 6.

title: Smicker Cake
directions: Mix cake, put half of cake batter in pan and bake., While cake is baking, melt caramels with milk and butter., When cake is done, pour caramel, chocolate chips and pecans on top then pour other half of batter on top and bake until done.

title: K F C   Biscuits
directions: Mix together all ingredients., Shape into biscuits., Bake at 450° for 16 to 18 minutes., Makes 6 biscuits.

title: Carrot Cake 2
directions: Sift together flour, sugar, soda, salt and cinnamon, then add eggs, oil, carrots and nuts., Mix all together well., Pour into angel food cake pan., Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 20 minutes.

title: Quick Carrot Bars
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Grease and flour a 15 x 10-inch pan (jelly roll pan) or two 8 or 9-inch square pans., In a large bowl, blend oil, eggs and applesauce 1 minute on low speed., Add cake mix; blend until moistened. Beat 2 minutes at medium speed. Stir in raisins. Pour into prepared pan; spread evenly. Bake for 25 to 35 minutes. Cool completely., Frost with cream cheese frosting. Sprinkle with nuts., Makes 36 bars.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Cook broccoli as on package; drain well., Place in casserole dish., Combine soup, eggs, cheese, onion and mayonnaise., Pour over broccoli., Sprinkle with stuffing mix; dot with butter., Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Monkey Bread
directions: Cut biscuits into quarters., Combine in a bowl white sugar and cinnamon., Place biscuits in bowl and shake until covered., Place in tube or Bundt pan., Melt butter and brown sugar; pour over biscuits in pan., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Velvet Salad
directions: Drain pineapple and save juice., Boil Jell-O and pineapple juice for one minute., Let cool and mix all ingredients together; refrigerate.

title: Chicken Potato And Cheddar Bake
directions: Preheat oven to 425°., Spray a 13x9 baking dish., Place chicken in baking dish, sprinkle with salt and pepper., Spread broccoli and 1 1/2 c. cheese over chicken., Place potatoes on top; bake 30 minutes., Sprinkle with 1/2 c. of cheese; bake 5 minutes or until chicken is done.

title: Oatmeal Bread For Bread Machine
directions: Measure ingredients carefully., Place all ingredients in bread machine pan in the order recommended by the manufacturer., Select basic cycle., When cycle has been completed, remove loaf from pan and cool on wire rack.

title: Hot Dip Delight
directions: Brown and drain ground beef., Brown and add onions., Add chopped apple and tomatoes, jalapeno peppers, raisins, olives, cinnamon and cloves., Salt and pepper and add ketchup., Add almonds (optional).

title: Steamed Cabbage
directions: Cut up cabbage, then rinse in cold water., Drain and put in 5-quart pot., Add chopped onion, salt and pepper., Cover pot and let cook on medium-high until cabbage is tender., Stir often.

title: Luscious Lasagna(Low-Fat Without Meat)
directions: *Do not have to precook noodles.

title: Russian Dressing
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Use as a dressing for a salad.

title: Meat Loaf And Gravy
directions: Add ingredients as listed, then mix well and pat into two pans and bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Chocolate Cookies
directions: Melt chocolate in microwave or in double boiler., Cream shortening and sugar., Add egg and beat well., Add melted chocolate and vanilla and mix well., Stir in broken nutmeats., Add sifted dry ingredients alternately with sour milk., Shape into rolls on waxed paper; wrap., Chill thoroughly or overnight., Slice thin (1/4-inch or less)., Bake slices on greased cookie sheet in 400° oven for 10 minutes., Makes 4 dozen.

title: Light Rolls
directions: Dissolve yeast in 1/2 cup lukewarm water., Put sugar, shortening and salt in container you are making rolls in., Add 1 cup boiling water to mixture., Stir until dissolved., Add 1 cup cold water., Stir in yeast mixture., Beat egg and add to mixture. Add flour, 1 cup at a time, stirring., Cover and refrigerate.

title: Apple-Peanut Butter Dream
directions: Mix all ingredients and serve on lettuce leaves.

title: Toffee Bar Dip
directions: Crush Heath bars., Combine all ingredients together and mix., Graham crackers and apples are great to dip.

title: Salted Spiced Walnuts
directions: Wash chicken wings and pat dry., In a bowl combine the crumbled crackers or bread crumbs, herbs and Parmesan cheese. Add seasonings and mix well to blend., Melt butter., Dip chicken wings, first in melted butter, then into crumb coating., Arrange chicken wings in lightly oiled ovenproof baking dish., Bake chicken wings at 375° for about 30 minutes or until lightly brown and done., Chicken wings should be tender.

title: Cheese Cakes
directions: Blend together with electric beater., Spoon on vanilla wafer about 2/3 full in a cup cake paper., Bake 20 minutes at 350°.

title: Caramel Brownies
directions: Combine cake mix with butter, chopped pecans and 1/3 cup evaporated milk., Put a thin layer of mix in a 9 x 13-inch pan and bake at 325° for 10 minutes.

title: Jalapeno Cornbread
directions: Mix well all ingredients., Pour into greased and hot iron skillets., Bake at 325° to 350°., May be frozen for later use.

title: 4 Layer Coconut Dessert
directions: 1st Layer:, Melt margarine in 9 x 13-inch pan; dump in flour and coconut and spread mixture in bottom of pan., Bake for 15 minutes at 350°., Cool completely.

title: Teriyaki Marinade Sauce
directions: Mix all ingredients., Pour over meat and let stand at least 2 hours., Refrigerate.

title: Pickled Eggs
directions: Hard-boil the eggs., Put eggs in cold water., Keep changing the water to keep it cold., Shell the eggs., Put eggs in a container and place in the refrigerator next to the pickled beet liquid., Next day, cover eggs with the liquid., Put back in refrigerator for 3 or 4 days., Stir or shake occasionally so eggs color evenly., Serve cold.

title: Chicken A La King
directions: Melt butter in a heavy 2-quart saucepan; stir in flour, salt and pepper., Remove from heat; stir in chicken broth gradually. Add cream., Cook, stirring constantly, until thickened., Add chicken and pimento., Heat to serving temperature., Serve immediately over toast or in patty shells.

title: 7 Layer Cookies
directions: Melt butter in baking dish., Add one ingredient on top of each other., Bake 25 or 30 minutes at 325°., Let cool; cut in squares.

title: Crabmeat Casserole
directions: Combine ingredients and place in greased casserole dish., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes., Serves 4 to 6.

title: Peanut Butter Squares
directions: Mix above ingredients and press in cookie sheet with sides. Melt 1 stick butter with 12 ounces chocolate chips., Spread over mixture and chill for at least 4 hours, better if overnight.

title: Peanut Butter Swirl Candy
directions: Combine sugar, butter and milk; roll into a ball on waxed paper., Put small amount of powdered sugar on paper to keep from sticking., Roll out ball and spread with peanut butter., Roll out with fingers into a long roll and wrap in waxed paper., Put in refrigerator to harden., Cut into small pieces.

title: Pie Crust
directions: Cut shortening into flour and salt., Combine egg, water and vinegar., Pour liquid into flour mixture all at once., Blend with a spoon just until all is moistened., This is an easy crust to make., I roll the crust between wax paper and fold,, Put into pan. On the top crust I brush canned cream, then cut holes, sprinkle sugar on top and put little pieces of oleo on the holes., I like to mix in a large tupperwear container and shape into balls.

title: Cheesies Potatoes
directions: Melt margarine in pan., Quarter 6 potatoes., In a bag, shake potatoes, cheese and flour until potatoes are coated., Place in pan and bake until brown., Bake at 450° for 30 minutes in 10 x 12-inch pan.

title: Oyster Sauce Beef And Chinese Peas
directions: Combine beef, cornstarch, sugar, soy sauce, sherry, oyster sauce and 1 tablespoon of the oil., Marinate for 20 minutes., In a wok or skillet, heat remaining oil and brown garlic., Add meat and onion; stir-fry for 1 minute., Add peas and cook 1 more minute.

title: Baked Brie In Phyllo
directions: Wrap the Brie in thawed phyllo dough, brushing each sheet with butter and keeping unused phyllo covered with a damp cloth., Turn the cheese over after applying each sheet of phyllo for even distribution., Brush phyllo wrapped Brie with butter., Cover and refrigerate., Before serving, place the phyllo wrapped cheese in a shallow baking dish., Bake at 425° for 15 to 20 minutes or until golden., Let stand 10 minutes., Garnish with fresh dill and fruit. Serves 20 to 30.

title: Fudge Brownie Pie
directions: Heat, oven to 375°., Bake pie shell 10 minutes and remove. Lower temperature to 325°., In saucepan, melt chips with margarine over very low heat., In large bowl beat chocolate mixture with remaining ingredients except nuts until smooth., Stir in nuts and pour into pie shell., Bake 35 to 45 minutes or until center is set., Cool., Serve with ice cream, if desired., Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Honeyed French Green Beans
directions: Pour undrained green beans into a 1-quart casserole dish. Drizzle honey and Worcestershire sauce over beans. Place bacon strips on top. Bake at 350° until bacon is crisp, approximately 30 minutes. Serves 3 to 4.

title: Fruit And Nut Pies(Christmas Pie)
directions: Combine cherries and pineapple in a saucepan., Add sugar and flour., Cook until thickened., Sprinkle orange jello over mixture and stir until dissolved., Cool mixture slightly., Add bananas and pecans or walnuts., Pour into the pie shells., Refrigerate for several hours., Serve with whipped cream or Cool Whip.

title: Grandma'S Cranberry Sauce(Yields 20 Servings)
directions: First grind fresh cranberries (coarse grind)., Next slice seedless grapes in half., Then grind one of the oranges, rind and all (fine grind)., Next juice the other orange., Then add all the sugar to the fruit and juice mixture., Stir., Set aside., Place water in saucepan and bring to a boil., Add both boxes of jello and dissolve., Next add dissolved jello to fruit mixture., Now chop nuts and add to mixture., Place mixture in container that can later be sealed. Put in refrigerator until jelled., Now seal container., Will keep for weeks in refrigerator., Also makes nice jello mold.

title: Sausage And Rice Casserole
directions: Brown sausage and drain fat., Cook rice as directed on package., Add mushrooms and onions., Serve., Good warmed over with a little water added to moisten.

title: Lasagne
directions: Brown meat; add onions and cook until tender., Stir in tomatoes, tomato paste, water, garlic and seasonings; cover and simmer 30 minutes., In a 12 x 8-inch baking dish, layer noodles, meat sauce and cheeses; repeat layers., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Rice Pudding
directions: Cook ingredients over medium heat about 1 1/2 hours or until rice is done., Beat 2 eggs and 3/4 cup sugar together., Add this plus 1 teaspoon vanilla to rice mixture., Cook together., Add raisins and cinnamon as desired.

title: Cranberry Salad
directions: Prepare Jell-O according to directions, but cut down on cold water to 1 cup., Mix cranberry sauce and add to Jell-O., Add pineapple juice to Jell-O in place of water., Mix other ingredients and chill.

title: Fried Rice
directions: In large skillet, cook and stir onion and green pepper in oil until onion is tender., Stir in rice, water chestnuts, mushrooms and soy sauce., Cook over low heat 10 minutes, stirring frequently., Stir in beaten eggs., Cook and stir 2 to 3 minutes longer., Makes 4 to 5 servings (about 1/2 cup each).

title: Sweet Potato Souffle #2
directions: Combine all ingredients., Bake at 350° until firm.

title: Chop Suey Cookies
directions: Combine, the, oleo,, sugars,, eggs, and, vanilla; cream together., Mix the flour, baking soda, baking powder and salt. Add the remaining ingredients; mix all together., Drop mixture by spoonfuls, onto an ungreased cookie sheet.	Bake in a 350° oven for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Crullers
directions: Combine cream cheese and margarine, mixing until well greased. Add flour and salt; mix well., Shape dough into ball; chill 1 hour., On lightly floured surface, roll dough to 12 x 6-inch strips., Fry in deep hot oil, 375° for 1 to 2 minutes or golden brown., Drain on paper towels., Roll in sugar., Makes 2 dozen.

title: Lemon Icebox Pie
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Beat egg yolks; slowly stir in condensed milk., Mixing well, stir in lemon juice., Pour into graham cracker crust., Bake for 12 to 15 minutes., Remove and cool., Spread Cool Whip on cooled pie., Refrigerate for 3 hours before serving.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Place broccoli in baking dish., In a medium bowl, combine rice, soups, cheese, celery, onion, water chestnuts, egg and margarine., Pour over broccoli and add 1/4 cup crumbled Ritz crackers on top., Bake 30 minutes at 350° or until bubbly hot.

title: Vanilla Pudding
directions: Warm milk., Mix dry ingredients and pour into milk, stirring constantly over low heat., When thickened, remove from heat and add vanilla., Chill and serve.

title: Homemade Hot Cocoa
directions: In large mixing bowl, combine all ingredients; blend well. Store in a tightly covered container., Makes 3 3/4 cups mix (15 to 16 servings).

title: Creamy Ham And Cheese Salad
directions: Prepare dinner as directed on package., Add remaining ingredients; mix well., Chill., Add additional salad dressing before serving if desired., Yields 4 servings (you can add tuna instead of ham).

title: Rutabaga Magic
directions: Combine all ingredients except butter with water to cover in saucepan., Cook until tender; drain., Mash with butter and serve immediately.

title: Stuffed Chicken Breasts
directions: In a medium bowl, thoroughly combine cheese, eggs, bread crumbs, salt, pepper and nutmeg., Place about 1/4 cup cheese mixture in center of each flattened chicken breast., Roll up and secure with toothpicks.

title: Ground Beef And Noodle Casserole
directions: Brown beef, garlic salt, salt and pepper., Add tomato soup and then add sour cream and cream cheese., Mix and add noodles., Put in large casserole dish., Top with grated sharp cheese., Heat in moderate oven until bubbly.

title: Tangy Ham Dip
directions: Mix sour cream, deviled ham, chopped chives, horseradish and Worcestershire sauce in bowl., Blend well., Chill for 1 hour. Serve with potato or corn chips.

title: Lazy Housewife Pickles
directions: Mix well and refrigerate., Ready to eat in a few hours., Keeps well a long time, covered, in refrigerator.

title: Orange Slice Cookie
directions: Dice the pound of orange slices and sprinkle with 2 tablespoons of flour., Beat eggs until light and fluffy., Add brown sugar and flour and salt., Mix well and add chopped nuts. Turn batter into a greased and floured jelly roll pan or 9 x 15-inch pan., Bake at 340° for 35 minutes., Cut while still warm and sprinkle with powdered sugar.

title: Chow Mein Cookies
directions: Melt chocolate pieces in double boiler until it melts, add peanuts and stir in noodles., Mix until well covered., Drop by teaspoonfuls onto a waxed paper lined cookie sheet., Chill in refrigerator 15 to 30 minutes.

title: Tropical Fruit Sherbet
directions: Mix all ingredients in electric blender or food processor until smooth (make sure the, top is on the blender or food processor)., Pour into 1, gallon, ice cream freezer and freeze according to, manufacturer's, instructions., Serve immediately when ready., Makes 7 (1/2-cup) servings.

title: Hot Corn Salad
directions: In saucepan, melt margarine over medium heat; stir in green onion and carrot., Cook, stirring, 1 minute; stir in corn, vinegar, sugar and zucchini., Cover and cook 5 minutes, stirring often, until hot.

title: Dill Dip
directions: Mix the sour cream and 1 1/2 packages Hidden Valley dressing. Fill sour cream container half full with Miracle Whip., Add more, if desired., Chop dill and add more, if needed.

title: Play Dough
directions: Mix dry ingredients., Add liquids., Cook in medium size pot on medium heat until dough pulls away from sides of pot., Add flavoring for smell and cake coloring for color., Do not use Teflon.

title: Spaghetti Sauce
directions: Fry bacon until crisp in a wide 6-quart saucepot., Remove bacon and all but 2 tablespoons of fat., Save both bacon and extra fat., Add ground beef, breaking it up with a spoon and cook until brown, stirring occasionally., Stir in onion, green pepper and garlic and cook for 10 minutes., Add more bacon fat if needed. Mash plum tomatoes with a spoon., Stir the tomatoes and tomato paste, bacon, 1 cup of wine and 4 teaspoons each of oregano and basil; add all remaining ingredients into the sauce., Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, 3 hours, stirring occasionally., Taste after an hour of cooking and correct seasoning; herbs vary and so do personal notions of flavor., If you make the sauce early, cool and refrigerate it until an hour or two before dinner., Let it warm to room temperature before you reheat it., Ten or 15 minutes before serving, blend in 1 teaspoon each of oregano and basil and 1/2 cup of wine., Any leftover can be frozen for later use.

title: Spiced Tea
directions: Mix well., Place 2 to 3 teaspoons in cup., Add hot water; stir.

title: Twinky Cake
directions: Bake cake., Let cool., Beat other ingredients for 10 minutes. Slice your cake in layers., Spread filling on each layer and refrigerate.

title: Terry'S Chicken Tetrazzini
directions: Prepare Oodles of Noodles according to package., Let cook until almost all liquid is cooked out of pot., Add cream of mushroom soup to pot. Add can of chicken to pot., Stir all ingredients., Pour into a 9 x 13-inch casserole dish., Top with grated cheese., Bake at 350° until cheese is melted., Quick and delicious.

title: Bluebery Crunch
directions: Cut in 1/3 cup Butter. Sprinkle over the filling and bake for 350° for 40 minutes.

title: No Cook, No Can Cucumber Pickles
directions: Fill 1 gallon glass or plastic jug with sliced cucumbers. Dissolve salt in enough water to cover cucumbers., Let set for 3 days., Pour off water, rinse 3 times in cold water., Soak 24 hours with alum in water to cover., Pour off and rinse 3 times in cold water., Cover with white vinegar, let set for 7 days., Drain vinegar off and throw away., Rinse 1 time., Heat 1 cup vinegar and 3 cups sugar until sugar is dissolved., Cool and pour over cucumbers (will not cover pickles), add pickling spice and turmeric (put spice and turmeric in soft cloth tied up)., Let set for 24 hours.

title: Cheese Ball
directions: Combine softened cheeses and mix well with hands., Add green pepper, onion, Worcestershire sauce, lemon juice and salt., Mix well again with hands., Shape into ball., Roll in mixture of paprika and pecans., Chill.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
directions: In 3-quart oblong baking dish, combine soups, milk, thyme and pepper., Stir in vegetables and chicken., Bake at 400° for 15 minutes or until mixture begins to bubble., Meanwhile, cut each biscuit into quarters., Remove dish from oven; stir., Arrange biscuit pieces over hot chicken mixture., Bake 15 minutes or until biscuits are golden brown., Makes 5 servings.

title: Turtle Cake
directions: Mix cake mix according to directions., Pour 1/2 of batter into a 13 x 9-inch pan and bake until done, 20 minutes., Melt caramels in 1/2 cup Carnation milk, then pour over cake.

title: Orange Balls
directions: Mix crumbs, confectioners sugar and coconut., Add orange juice concentrate and mix well., Form into about 1-inch balls., Roll balls into confectioners sugar., Store in covered container overnight., Yields 3 dozen.

title: Broccoli And Rice Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Stuffed Acorn Squash
directions: Cut squash in half, remove seeds and bake cut-side down at 350° for 50 minutes., In skillet, cook pork, celery and onion until meat is no longer pink and vegetables are tender., Drain fat., Stir in salt, curry powder and cinnamon., Cook 1 minute more., Stir in applesauce and bread cubes., Place stuffing in squash halves; bake uncovered 20 minutes more., Makes 2 servings.

title: Mama'S Green Junk(Beulah Thomas)
directions: Mix all ingredients., Refrigerate., May garnish with cut up maraschino cherries for a festive look.

title: Polynesian Chicken
directions: Fry chicken pieces in oil until brown., Saute onions in same pan; add sherry (or other liquid)., Stir, scraping brown bits loose and blending into liquid to combine with chicken in pan., Add crushed pineapple and water or stock and braise 25 minutes., Add bean sprouts and bamboo shoots., Thicken with cornstarch., Serves 20.

title: Fresh Strawberry Pie
directions: Put, strawberries, in, pie, shell. Cook until clear the sugar, cornstarch, syrup, water and salt.	Cool slightly, then add, jello and, food	coloring., Pour over berries. Chill and serve with whipped topping.

title: Cabbage Casserole
