directions: Wash cabbage and chop fine, then chop onions., Heat ground beef and onions in skillet., Put half of cabbage in baking dish. Cover with beef and onions., Put remainder of cabbage on top. Pour undiluted tomato soup over mixture., Bake 1 hour or longer, covered with foil, at 325°.

title: Hamburger Goulash
directions: In skillet, saute onion in oil until tender., Add ground beef and sprinkle with garlic salt, salt and pepper., Brown; drain grease., Add pork and beans, tomato sauce and hot sauce., Simmer 15 to 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.

title: Pound Cake
directions: Blend the first 8 ingredients., Blend in small amounts the flour and milk., Bake in cold oven at 325° for 1 1/4 hours.

title: Glazed Pecans
directions: Heat nuts in oven at 250° for 15 minutes., Cook sugar, water, salt and spices to soft ball stage., Do not stir., Add vanilla. Stir in nuts until creamy and thoroughly coated., Pour on waxed paper., Separate nuts as they cool.

title: Zucchini Pie
directions: Mix all together; pour into unbaked pie shell and sprinkle with cinnamon and nutmeg., Bake at 350° until set, about 45 minutes.

title: Avocado Corn Quiche
directions: *Using your favorite pie crust recipe fit the dough into a 10-inch false-bottom quiche pan., Line with foil and fill with rice., Bake 10 minutes in a preheated 400° oven., Remove foil and rice and bake 5 minutes longer or until lightly colored.

title: Quiche
directions: Pour into deep dish Pet Ritz pie crust., Bake as directed on pie crust at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes or until firm in middle. Let set for a few minutes.

title: Monkey Bread
directions: Dissolve yeast in warm water., Mix shortening, sugar and salt in second bowl., Add boiling water and mix well., Add eggs; stir well., Add flour and yeast.

title: Meat Loaf
directions: Combine all ingredients thoroughly and pack firmly into loaf pan or pan of similar shape., Bake in preheated 350° oven for about 1 hour and 10 minutes., Let stand 5 minutes before slicing.

title: Sausage Breakfast Casserole
directions: Place bread in greased casserole., Brown sausage and drain grease., Sprinkle sausage over bread., Top with shredded cheese. Combine eggs, milk, salt and mustard with whip., Pour over cheese. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Sausage Delight Sauce
directions: Cook sausage until light brown and drain fat., Combine the rest of the ingredients and simmer on low for 30 minutes.

title: Wacky Cake
directions: Mix all dry ingredients right in 9 x 12-inch cake pan., Make 3 holes., Put vinegar into one hole, vanilla into second hole and liquid shortening into third hole. Pour one cup water over everything., Stir and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Valentine Cookies
directions: Cream butter or margarine and sugar., Add egg and vanilla and beat well., Sift flour, baking powder and salt; add to creamed mixture with milk to form a dough., Chill., Roll out to 1/2-inch thickness., Cut with heart shaped cookie cutter., Place half of the cookies on a lightly greased baking sheet; brush each with water., Cut smaller heart shaped centers from remaining cookies and place the heart frames on top of cookies., Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes., Cool; fill center heart space with cherry filling.

title: Lemon Snow Freeze
directions: Combine graham cracker crumbs with 2 tablespoons of the sugar and melted margarine., Press mixture on bottom and sides of lightly buttered refrigerator tray; chill., Beat egg yolks until thick., Combine, with, Eagle Brand milk., Add lemon rind and juice gradually,, stirring, until, thick., Stir, in 1 cup Baker's coconut., Beat egg whites until stiff., Gradually beat in rest, of sugar., Fold into lemon mixture., Pour into tray. Sprinkle, top with remaining coconut., Chill in freezer until firm, about, 4, to 6, hours., Garnish, with whipped cream, if desired.

title: Dill Salad Dressing
directions: Mix all ingredients and chill.

title: Yum Yum Ice Cream Or Ice Cream Delight
directions: Mix fruit in bowl and let stand until juices mix., Take one scoop of ice cream and pour or spoon fruit mixture on top., Add dash of Amaretto (almond flavored liquor).

title: 7-Up Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients in large mixing bowl., Mix 3 minutes; bake in two 9-inch buttered and floured cake pans for 20 to 25 minutes or until done., Cool., Frost and fill with Pineapple Coconut Cream Frosting.

title: Shipwreck Hot Dish
directions: Cook meat and onion with seasonings., Drain., Cook diced celery, carrots and potatoes., Reserve liquid., Combine all ingredients in a greased casserole., Bake in 350° oven for 1 hour.

title: Apple Dip
directions: Beat cream cheese, brown sugar and vanilla., Slice tart apples to dip.

title: Butterscotch Cheesecake Bars
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., In a medium saucepan or in the microwave, melt the chips and margarine., Stir in crumbs and nuts. Press 1/2 the mixture firmly onto bottom of greased 13 x 9-inch pan.

title: Cream Potato Casserole
directions: Cook, drain and mash potatoes just like cream potatoes., Add remaining ingredients and mix well., Pour in buttered baking dish and top with more butter and Parmesan cheese., Bake, uncovered, 35 minutes at 350°., Serves 6 to 8.

title: Quick And Easy No Bake Pineapple Sour Cream Pie(Very Lo-Cal And No Sugar Except In Crust)
directions: Combine all ingredients., Mix well with spoon or fork (not electric mixer) until thick., Pour into 1 Keebler ready crust (graham or cookie crust)., Top with lite Cool Whip., Refrigerate.

title: Banana Pound Cake
directions: Cream together crisco, margarine sugar and add eggs one at a time, beating well after each., Sift together flour, baking powder and salt., Mix together the bananas, milk, and vanilla, add alternately with flour mixture., Bake in greased and floured pan for 1 hour and 40 minutes at 350 degrees.

title: Cornbread Skillet Casserole
directions: Combine eggs, corn meal, corn, milk and oil in a bowl; set aside., Cook beef until browned; drain well and set aside., Pour 1/2 of corn meal mixture into a greased 1 1/2-inch cast-iron skillet., Spread evenly with beef., Top with cheese, onion and peppers., Pour on remaining batter., Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Butter Balls
directions: Cream Crisco and 1/2 cup of the sugar., Stir in flour, salt, vanilla and nuts., Mix well., Make into 1-inch balls., Place on cookie sheet, which has been rubbed with Crisco., Bake in oven, 375°, for 12 to 15 minutes., Roll in sifted confectioners sugar immediately after baking., Cookies may be re-rolled in sugar after cooling, if desired.

title: Fudge Brownies
directions: Melt butter and margarine., Add to the sugar, salt and cocoa and cream 4 minutes., Add eggs and vanilla two at a time., Mix in flour (do not overmix)., Add nuts., Spread evenly on greased cookie sheet., Brush lightly with milk or water., Bake 23 minutes at 350°.

title: Poncho Dreg'S Dip
directions: Brown ground beef., Salt and pepper to taste., Add chili to ground beef and heat., Put beef and chili mixture into casserole dish., Spread sour cream over mixture., Place 6 slices of Velveeta cheese on top of sour cream., Bake at 425° for 20 minutes., Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Baked Pineapple
directions: Beat eggs, sugar and flour., Add pineapple; mix well., Place in greased casserole., Sprinkle with nutmeg or cinnamon., Bake at 350° for 45 to 60 minutes.

title: Vanilla Sauce(For Baked Apples)
directions: Add all items, except vanilla., Boil until thick (3 minutes). Remove from heat and add vanilla.

title: Poor Man'S Chow Mein
directions: Brown beef, onions and celery (I usually begin beef in a small amount of water and after awhile, pour away drippings)., To the beef, add onions and celery; continue browning., Mix in casserole dish the soups, water, rice and soy sauce., Add the browned beef mixture and stir., Bake for 1 hour at 350°., Place topping of dry chow mein noodles on each serving.

title: Harriet'S Chicken Cantonese
directions: Heat oil in skillet or wok and saute chicken until brown. Blend rest of ingredients and add to skillet., Mix; cover and simmer for 25 minutes, stirring occasionally., Place chicken in platter and coat with sauce.

title: Orange Salad
directions: Mix Cool Whip and Jell-O., Add cottage cheese, pineapple and flavorings., Mix and chill.

title: Lemon Meringue Pie
directions: Mix in sauce pan., Stir in gradually., Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly until it thickens and boils., Boil 1 minute. Slowly stir at least 1/2 the hot mixture into 3 egg yolks, slightly beaten., Then blend into hot mixture in saucepan., Stir constantly., Remove from heat., Stir until smooth., Blend in 3 tablespoons butter, 1/4 cup lemon juice, 1 tablespoons grated lemon rind., Pour into baked pie shell., Cover with meringue. Bake at 400° (moderate hot oven) for 10 minutes.

title: Brown Bread
directions: In a large bowl, sift together dry ingredients., Add beaten egg and buttermilk and stir into a soft dough., With floured hands, knead dough lightly and quickly into a ball., Shape dough into approximately a 7-inch round and place in a 9-inch pie plate. Cut a deep cross into the dough., Bake in a preheated oven at 400° for 25 minutes and then lower the oven temperature to 350° for an additional 25 minutes., Test for doneness as above., Let bread sit for one hour before serving.

title: Instant Russian Tea
directions: Boil water; add tea, cover and let stand for 3 minutes. Strain; add sugar, salt, lemon juice and orange juice., Serve hot or cold.

title: Old Fashioned Chocolate Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Combine butter, sugar, eggs and vanilla in large mixer bowl., Beat on high speed for 3 minutes., In separate bowl, combine flour, cocoa, baking soda, baking powder and salt., Add alternately with water to creamed mixture., Blend just until combined., Pour into 2 greased and floured 9-inch layer pans or a 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes, or until cake tester inserted in center comes out clean., Cool for 10 minutes; remove from pans., Cool completely., Frost with your favorite frosting.

title: Easy Chicken Pie
directions: Cook chicken., Debone and cut into small pieces., Reserve 2 cups broth., Place chicken in 9 x 12-inch pan., In saucepan, mix broth and cream of chicken soup., Bring to boil., Pour over chicken., In a bowl, mix margarine, flour, pepper and buttermilk to form batter., Spoon over chicken., Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes or until brown.

title: Biscuit Casserole
directions: Brown meat and onion; drain., Add soup and ketchup., Pour into casserole dish., Top with biscuits., Bake at 325° for about 45 minutes, or until biscuits are done and lightly browned.

title: Meatballs
directions: Mix first 6 ingredients together and form into balls.

title: Creamy Lo-Cal Dressing
directions: Blend all ingredients with hand beater until very smooth. Store in covered jar in refrigerator., Makes 1 3/4 cups.

title: Taco Salad
directions: Brown ground beef and drain., Poke hole in bag of Doritos and crush the Doritos., Pour both into a large bowl and stir., Add diced tomatoes and lettuce., Stir again., Pour Catalina dressing in and stir until moistened., May need to add more dressing after it soaks in., Store in refrigerator.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Cook broccoli., Mix soup, mayonnaise, eggs, onion, salt and pepper., Add to drained broccoli., Pour into an 8 x 12-inch baking dish., Sprinkle cheese over mixture., Mix butter with stuffing. Sprinkle over mixture., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Seven Layer Dinner
directions: Put one layer of each ingredient, in order, in a large casserole dish., Bake, covered, in casserole at 375° for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

title: Microwave Pralines
directions: Combine first 6 ingredients in a 4-quart casserole, stirring well., Microwave at High 12 to 13 minutes, stirring every 4 minutes., Stir in soda., Microwave at High 1 to 1 1/2 minutes. Stir in vanilla., Beat with a wooden spoon just until mixture begins to thicken., Working rapidly, drop by tablespoons onto greased wax paper., Let stand until firm.

title: Coca-Cola Cherry Jello Salad
directions: Dissolve jello in boiling water., You may add Coca-Cola now or later., Add cherries and pecans., When at room temperature, place in refrigerator., After jelling, cut and place on lettuce leaf.

title: Hungry Jack Biscuit Barbecups
directions: Heat oven to 375°., Grease 10 muffin cups., Brown ground beef and drain., Stir in barbecue sauce, onion and brown sugar., Cook 3 minutes to blend., Stir constantly., Separate dough into 10 biscuits., Place 1 biscuit in each greased muffin cup., Press in bottom and up sides to rim., Spoon about 1/4 cup of meat mixture into each biscuit cup., Sprinkle with cheese., Bake at 375°, for 10 to 12 minutes, or until edges are brown., Cool 2 minutes. Remove from pan., Makes 10 servings.

title: Mexican Cornbread
directions: In a large bowl, mix all ingredients except cheese and peppers., Add grated cheese and jalapeno peppers., Pour into two 9 x 12-inch pans or one 12 x 18-inch pan. Bake at 375° for 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Vegetable Dip
directions: Mix softened cream cheese by hand with onion., Mix in mayonnaise., Add chili sauce slowly and mix a little at a time to blend into the cheese., Add Worcestershire sauce and mix.

title: Betty Roger'S Chicken Casserole
directions: Saute stuffing in butter until golden., Add 3/4 of buttered stuffing to bottom of greased 3 quart casserole dish., Place chicken in dish., Mix together soup, sour cream and mushrooms. Pour over chicken., Add remaining crumbs on top.

title: Squash Casserole
directions: Boil squash and onion., Combine with other ingredients., Put part of crumbs in mixture and save rest to sprinkle on top., Bake in moderate oven until done.

title: Chocolate Brownies
directions: Use a 9 x 13-inch pan to bake brownies., Mix eggs, butter and sugar., Ad flour, baking powder, salt and nuts., Melt chocolate and add to mixture., Pour in pan and bake at 350°, for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Salad Dressing Cake
directions: Sprinkle 1 teaspoon soda over the dates., Pour 1 cup of boiling water over the dates and soda., Let stand., Mix together salad dressing, sugar, vanilla, salt, flour and nut meats., Beat well., Add the date mixture., Pour into a 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until done.

title: 2 Minute Microwave Fudge
directions: In a casserole, stir sugar, cocoa, salt, milk and vanilla. (Mixture will be stiff.), Cut butter over top., Microwave on High for 2 minutes., Stir vigorously until smooth., Blend in nuts. Pour into waxed paper-lined loaf pan., Chill one hour., Cut into squares.

title: Carolina Gold Barbecue Sauce
directions: Put all ingredients into saucepan over medium heat, mixing well with whisk., Heat thoroughly, whisking frequently to prevent burning., This is great on pork, beef and chicken (see Carolina Gold Barbecue Recipe in the Meat & Main Dishes section)., If you're grilling the meat, don't put this on until the meat is cooked and ready to serve or it will burn.

title: Spicy Apple Nut Squares
directions: Mix first 4 ingredients by hand., Sift together flour, salt, baking powder and cinnamon., Add to mixture., Then add apples and walnuts and/or raisins., Mix thoroughly., Grease and flour 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan., Spread mixture well into pan., Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes or until done., While still warm, sprinkle with powdered sugar and cut into squares.

title: Lemon Whip
directions: Mix together and press in 9 x 13-inch pan the crackers, sugar and margarine., In bowl, mix 1 small can frozen lemonade, Cool Whip, lemon juice and milk., Beat with mixer and spread over crust., Store and serve from freezer.

title: Pistachio Salad
directions: In a bowl, combine pudding and whipped topping., Then add crushed pineapple and juice., Finally, stir in mini marshmallows. Refrigerate until firm.

title: Chicken Divan
directions: Cook broccoli until tender and drain., Arrange broccoli in a greased 11 x 7 x 4-inch baking dish., Place chicken on top. Combine soup, mayo, lemon juice and curry powder; pour over chicken., Sprinkle cheese over top., Combine crumbs and butter; sprinkle over all., Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes or until thoroughly heated., Serves 6.

title: Crab Soup
directions: Melt butter in top of double boiler; blend in flour until smooth., Gradually add milk, stirring constantly., Add crab meat and seasonings., Cook slowly over hot water for 20 minutes. Sprinkle with parsley or paprika., Serves 4 to 6.

title: Crunchy Pea Salad
directions: Combine all ingredients., Chill., Garnish with bacon just before serving.

title: Ham Crescents
directions: Heat oven to 375°., Unroll dough into 4 rectangles., Press seam smooth., Place one slice of ham; spread with mustard and sprinkle with cheese., Starting on short side, roll up; press to seal and roll in sesame seed., Repeat with other rectangles., Cut each roll into 5 slices (20 in all)., Spray cookie sheet with Pam. Place slices cut side down., Bake 15 to 20 minutes., Remove from pan immediately.

title: Apple Kuchen
directions: Heat oven to, 350°., Cut butter into dry cake mix until crumbly., Mix, in coconut.	Pat mixture lightly into ungreased oblong pan, 13 x 9 x 3-inches, building up slight edges., Bake for 10 minutes., Arrange apple slices on warm crust.

title: Texas Brownies
directions: In a large, mixing bowl, combine the flour and sugar., In a heavy saucepan, combine butter, shortening, coffee or water and cocoa., Stir and heat to boiling., Pour boiling mixture over the flour and sugar in the bowl., Add the buttermilk, eggs, baking soda and vanilla., Mix well using a wooden spoon or high speed of an electric mixer., Pour into a well-buttered 17 1/2 x 11-inch jelly roll pan., Bake at 400° for 20 minutes or until brownies test done in the center.

title: Macaroni Salad
directions: Cook macaroni and drain., Chop onions and pepper., Crush carrots., Mix., Add condensed milk, mayonnaise, vinegar and sugar; mix well., Let set 3 or 4 hours or overnight before serving.

title: Ambrosia Cream Cheese Mold
directions: Soften gelatin in water; let mixture stand 5 minutes., Drain pineapple and reserve juice., Add enough water to juice to make 1 cup., Pour juice into saucepan; heat to boiling., Add gelatin mixture; stir until dissolved., Remove from heat., Stir in sugar, lemon juice and cream cheese (a wire whisk helps to blend)., Chill until gelatin is partially set., Fold in pineapple chunks, orange, pecans and coconut., Spoon mixture into lightly greased 1-quart mold., Chill until firm., Unmold.

title: Rock Road Fudge
directions: In double boiler, mix and melt milk, butter and chocolate morsels., Remove from heat and add marshmallows and pecans., Pour into a 9 1/2 x 13-inch pan lined with wax paper., Chill 2 hours. Cut into squares.

title: Banana Pudding
directions: Put eggs in a boiler and beat well., Add sugar; mix well., Add milk., Cook slow until it gets to a boil, then add vanilla extract, then cornstarch (mixed in a little milk just to make a paste)., Add to the pudding., This will thicken and will be ready to finish. Cut the bananas, put in bowl and add 1 layer of wafers., Add some pudding mix., Continue until all is finished.

title: Shrimp With Vegetables
directions: In a 12-inch skillet, melt 2 tablespoons butter over medium-high heat., Add carrots, leeks, zucchini and mushrooms. Cook, stirring, 5 minutes., Reduce heat to low, cover and cook until carrots are crisp-tender, about 5 minutes longer., Remove vegetables to a plate and cover with foil to keep warm., Add remaining 2 tablespoons butter and oil to same skillet and heat unti hot over medium-high heat., Add shrimp and season with salt and pepper., Cook, stirring, 2 to 3 minutes, until shrimp turn pink and are loosely curled., Remove to a plate., Add wine and cream to skillet and boil over medium-high heat, stirring occasionally, about 5 minutes to reduce and thicken sauce slightly., Stir in Dijon and Pommery mustards, shrimp and vegetable mixture., Heat through, about 2 minutes., Garnish with snipped chives.

title: South Of Border Dip
directions: Cook and stir on low heat the cheese, tomato soup, taco seasoning and Ro-Tel., Add ground beef and rice., Put over chips.

title: Cheese Snacks
directions: Add red pepper to sifted flour., Work margarine and cheese together., Work in flour and Rice Krispies., Form into very small balls., Place on a cookie sheet., Press each ball flat with the tines of a fork that has been dipped in flour., Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes., Cool just slightly before removing from pan.

title: Easy And Fast No Cook Italian Pudding Squares
directions: Line bottom of 9 x 13-inch baking dish with cookies., Mix pudding as directed on package, adding 1 teaspoon anise for each package.

title: Pepper Steak
directions: Partially freeze steak., Slic across grain in 2 x 1/4-inch strips., Brown steak in oil in a skillet over medium-high heat for 4 to 6 minutes., Add beef broth and next 4 ingredients., Simmer 5 minutes or until vegetables are crisp-tender., Combine cornstarch, sugar and soy sauce, stirring well., Add to beef mixture., Bring to a boil for 1 minute, stirring constantly., Remove from heat, add tomato wedges and toss gently., Serve over hot cooked rice.

title: Millionaires
directions: Melt caramels with water and butter., Add pecans and vanilla. Drop by teaspoons onto buttered or Pam sprayed wax paper., Chill.

title: Strawberry Salad Dessert
directions: Dissolve Jell-O in 1 cup boiling water., Add 1 cup cold water. Add, thawed strawberries, diced bananas and pineapple. Pour 1/2 of mixture into mold or glass dish., Place in refrigerator, to gel., Leave the remaining mixture at room temperature., Whip cream., Beat, cheese, and sugar together, fold in whipped, cream. Beat, cheese, and, sugar, together,, fold, in whipped, cream. When, mixture, in, refrigerator, gels, spread cream, mixture over it., Chill. Carefully spoon on the remaining, half, of, fruit mixture., Return to refrigerator to chill and set.

title: Cherry Delectibles(May Be Prepared Ahead Of Time)
directions: Blend cheese and butter; work in flour until stiff dough is formed; chill overnight., Drain cherries, reserving 1/4 cup liquid., Combine cherries, reserved liquid and brandy; chill overnight.

title: Squash Casserole(Ernestine'S Favorite Recipe)
directions: Boil squash until tender; drain., Let stand for 8 minutes. Saute bell peppers and onions., Beat eggs separately in bowl. Save enough cheese to top casserole., Combine all ingredients with squash, mixing well., Pour into large casserole dish or large baking pan., Bake at 350° until done or brown.

title: Pauline'S Favorite Appetizer
directions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees., Unroll crescent rolls and press into a 10 X 15 inch pan., Seal perforations by rolling or pressing dough and push up the edges to form a crust., Bake 10 to 12 minutes or until light golden brown., Mix mayonnaise, sour cream and soup mix., Drain spinach, squeeze out all the water and add to mix., Drain artichokes and water chestnuts, chop and add., Mix in feta cheese and garlic., Spread spinach mixture evenly over crust. Grate Parmesan cheese over the top., Bake 10 - 12 minutes or until heated through., Remove from oven and cut into squares.

title: Chitterling Fritters(For Bill Colgan)
directions: Mix all ingredients with enough milk to give a pancake batter consistency., Drop by large spoonfuls into hot oil., Cook until browned., Bon Appetit, Bill.

title: Holiday Ham Balls
directions: Boiling fish is a favorite way, of preparing and serving fish in Denmark., Usually only large fish are cooked this way, but slices of large fish, such as salmon, pike, halibut or carp are also excellent., You should have a rack with 2 handles so the fish can be lifted out of the water without breaking it., You can tie a cloth around it before it cooks., Wash the fish well; sprinkle with salt and let stand a few minutes., Lay on rack or tie it in a cloth, then drop it in cold water to which has been added salt and 2 tablespoons vinegar; bring to quick boil, then simmer slowly until done., Test it with a toothpick for tenderness., Serve with lemon sauce and parsley potatoes.

title: Clam Sauce
directions: In a 2 cup measure, put drained clams and enough water to make two cups. Cook garlic in oil until lightly browned. Discard garlic. Add butter and clam juice. Heat to near boil. Add clams and heat through. Do not boil. Add salt to taste and 2 Tbsp. chopped parsley. Serve over spaghetti or noodles.

title: Chocolate Chess Pie
directions: Mix and put in unbaked pie shell., Bake 45 minutes at 325°.

title: Chocolate Crunch Brownies
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Combine sugar and butter in large mixing bowl. Beat at high speed until creamy, scraping bowl occasionally. Add eggs, beating until blended. Stir in flour, cocoa powder, vanilla and salt., Spoon into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake for 25 minutes or until edges pull from sides of pan. Cool in pan on wire rack. Spread with Marshmallow Creme. Combine chocolate chips and peanut butter in a 2-quart pan. Cook over low heat until blended, stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Stir in cereal. Spread over prepared layer. Chill, covered, until set. Cut into 36 bars. Store in refrigerator.

title: Peach Passion Salad
directions: Mix together water, boxes of Jell-O and box of vanilla pudding. Bring to a boil and remove from heat. Add marshmallows and stir until melted. Add peaches and juice. Pour into dish and chill.

title: Sand Tarts
directions: Cream together sugar and butter; add remaining ingredients. Roll in shape of a pecan. Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes. When cooled, roll in powdered sugar.

title: Upside-Down Pizza
directions: Cook turkey, celery, garlic powder, salt and pepper in 10-inch skillet., Pour into 13 x 9-inch pan., Top with vegetables., Pour tomato sauce over that., Cover with Mozzarella cheese, then cover with rolled out crescent rolls., Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes., Let stand 5 minutes, then serve.

title: Okra Gumbo
directions: In the early, 1900's,, the Labor Day celebration on the "green" was a, festive, affair on St. Helena Island., Visitors joined the crowd, of local islanders for a gala celebration at the picnic ground,, known, as the "bay or "green"., Tables and concession stands, set, up	by, individuals from Lady's Island and St., Helena, Island, featured delicacies such as red rice, Hoppin' John (or, peas, cooked with rice), fish, crab, shrimp, fried chicken and ham.

title: Broccoli Supreme
directions: In casserole dish, combine eggs, broccoli, soup, onion, salt and pepper., Mix melted butter and stuffing, then combine with other ingredients., Put in ungreased pan., Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes., Grated cheese can be put on top and melted.

title: Homemade Cheese Dip
directions: At room temperature, cream onion, cheese and canned cream together., Add more cream, if too thick., Serve with chips.

title: Almond Cake
directions: Grease pans well, then	flour.	Cream butter, margarine and Crisco; add sugar, then eggs., After, this	is well mixed, add baking powder, almond extract,, flour and then milk., Bake at 325°., Bake until golden, brown, (toothpick, inserted comes out clean).

title: Chicken Spaghetti
directions: Cook one fryer; bone 2nd cut into large pieces., Cook one small package spaghetti in chicken broth., Saute in 1/4 cup butter; green peppers, celery and onion., Add pimiento, soups, can milk., Mix all ingredients together and pour into 5-quart baking dish., Top with grated cheese., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Marinated Pork Chops
directions: Combine the first 6 ingredients in a small mixing bowl., Place chops in glass baking dish., Pour marinade over chops., Cover and place in refrigerator for several hours., Drain chops., Reserve marinade., Heat gas grill to medium setting., Cook with cover down for 7 1/2 minutes on each side., Baste with marinade., Enjoy!!

title: Mincemeat Cake
directions: If you want to frost cake before baking, whip one white of egg stiff., Add 1/2 cup brown sugar., Turn over cake and bake.

title: Vanilla Pudding
directions: Heat milk., Mix sugar, flour and egg yolks., Add from warm milk to make pourable., Pour into hot milk; keep stirred., Remove from heat., Add vanilla., Cool.

title: Butternut Balls
directions: Cream butter and sugar thoroughly., Stir in flour and salt. Add nuts; mix well., Form stiff dough into 1-inch balls., Place on ungreased cookie sheet., Bake for 15 minutes at 350°., Roll in powdered sugar while warm.

title: Peanut Butter And Walnut Fudge
directions: Mix sugar, cocoa, salt and 3/4 can of milk well., Cook over medium heat to boiling., Continue boiling until when by dropping in a small glass of cold water beads form in glass., Remove from heat., Stir in margarine, peanut butter and nuts., Stir and beat until mixture starts to thicken., Pour onto well buttered cookie sheet., Cut into squares when cool.

title: Meat Loaf
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Soak bread in water., Squeeze out excess water., Combine bread, ground beef, egg, seasonings, onion and 1/2 cup tomato sauce., Mix well with a fork., Shape into a loaf in a shallow pan., Combine remaining ingredients (1/2 cup tomato sauce, brown sugar, vinegar, mustard and water)., Pour mixture over meat loaf and bake 1 hour, basting occasionally.

title: Hamburger Casserole
directions: Brown beef and drain., Boil potatoes (sliced) and drain., Layer beef and potatoes., Mix soup with 1/2 can of water or milk, then pour over beef and potato layers., Top with cheese., Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes., Serves 4.

title: The 8-Minute Light 'N Fruity Pie
directions: Dissolve jello completely in boiling water; stirring about 3 minutes., Add ice cubes and stir until jello is thickened, about 2-3 minutes., Remove any unmelted ice., Using a wire whisk, blend in Cool Whip; then whip until smooth., Fold in fruit., Chill, if necessary, until mixture will mound up., Spoon into prepared pie crust., Chill 2 hours., Garnish, if desired.

title: Crab Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients in a bowl., Pour into a greased casserole dish., Sprinkle with slightly moist bread crumbs., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Sweet 'N' Sour Cabbage Casserole
directions: Cook the cabbage in 1 cup water and 1 teaspoon salt for 7 minutes., Remove from heat, drain well and place in a 1-quart casserole., Fry the chopped onion until crisp, remove from pan and set aside., Blend the flour and brown sugar into the bacon drippings in the pan., Stir in the beer and vinegar., Add pepper, 1/4 teaspoon salt and the onion; cook lightly until onion is limp., Return the chopped bacon to the mixture., Pour this sweet-sour mixture over the cabbage and cook about 10 minutes in a 350° oven., Makes 4 servings.

title: Macadamia Nut Brittle
directions: Lightly grease a 9 x 13-inch glass baking dish., Equally distribute Macadamia nuts over bottom of dish., Set aside.

title: South Of The Border Dip
directions: Cut cheese into cubes. Put in crock-pot., Add chili when cheese is starting to melt., Keep stirring., Serve with chips.

title: Cayenne Chicken
directions: Place chicken breasts in a large pan, sprinkle with seasonings of cayenne pepper and garlic powder., Cover with onion slices; bake at 400° until chicken is done., Spread picante sauce over chicken and over sauce the grated cheese., Return to oven just until cheese melts., Serve with nacho chips and salad.

title: Hamburger Junk
directions: Brown hamburger and onion. Season with garlic salt, oregano, salt, pepper and Parmesan cheese to taste. Add tomatoes, tomato paste and water., Let simmer., Put half of the sauce in bottom of a 9 x 13-inch dish, then half of the macaroni. Repeat layers. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and sharp cheese., Bake at 375° for 30 minutes.

title: Apple Pound Cake
directions: Cut 5 or 6 peeled apples into small pieces., Sprinkle with 5 teaspoons cinnamon (or to your taste) and set aside., In a large bowl mix ingredients (except apples) until smooth., Pour 1/2 cake mixture into a 10-inch greased and floured tube pan; add 1/2 apple mixture., Add remaining cake mixture to pan and top with remaining apple mixture., Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours., Cake will be golden brown when done., Remove from pan immediately and cool., Best served cool or cold.

title: Chili Sauce
directions: Boil all ingredients until thick, stirring often., Pour into quart jars and seal., Process in hot water bath for 5 minutes.

title: Jagerschnitzel(Veal In Brown Gravy And Mushrooms)
directions: Heat oil in large skillet over medium heat., Pound cutlets with a meat tenderizer to flatten them., Season cutlets with salt and pepper, dredge them in beaten eggs and then coat evenly with bread crumbs., Place cutlets into skillet and fry until golden brown (1-2 minutes in each side)., Remove the meat from the skillet and drain on paper towels., Keep the meat warm in the oven while you make the gravy.

title: Shrimp Mousse
directions: Heat soup; add cream cheese, stirring, until thoroughly blended., Soak gelatine in 1/4 cup cold water., Add to soup mixture., Blend in mayonnaise., Add remaining ingredients and stir until evenly mixed., Pour into oiled fish or any mold., Place in refrigerator to set., When ready to use, turn out on platter. Serve as spread on crackers or as a salad.

title: Cheese Grits Casserole
directions: Cook grits in boiling salted water., Meanwhile, melt 1 1/2 rolls of garlic cheese and 1 stick of margarine.

title: Pumpkin Waffles
directions: Sift together pumpkin, eggs, milk and butter., In a separate bowl, combine flour, baking powder, salt, sugar and nutmeg., Add dry ingredients to pumpkin mixture., Stir until thoroughly combined., Bake in waffle iron.

title: Moravian Mints
directions: Simmer granulated sugar and water together until syrup threads from spoon., Take from stove; add confectioners sugar, cream of tartar and peppermint., Beat until creamy and drop from spoon onto wax paper., For wintergreen flavor, use wintergreen extract and pink coloring, peppermint extract with green coloring and lemon extract with yellow coloring.

title: Passover Muffins
directions: Dissolve sugar and salt in boiling water., Add oil., Add matzo meal., Cool., Add eggs, one at a time., Beat thoroughly after adding each egg., Place in greased muffin pans., Bake at 450° until golden brown., Makes approximately 12 large muffins.

title: Summer Chicken
directions: Mix all the wet* ingredients with ginger and mix well., Cut vegetables and put them all in the marinating dish with the chicken and marinade., Place dish in the refrigerator for 2 to 3 hours. Mix the marinade every once in a while., Place vegetables and sauce in a tin pan or tin foil., Place it on the top rack or on the side of grill., Grill chicken until done., Serve with white or wheat rice., It's good.

title: Braised Cabbage, Kielbasa And Spuds
directions: Cut cabbage and potatoes in 1-inch chunks., Mix broth with mustard in a large saucepan., Add the cabbage and potatoes; bring to a boil., Reduce heat and cover; simmer 15 minutes., Add kielbasa; cover and cook 5 minutes or until hot., Serve with mustard., Serves 4.

title: Sugar Cookies
directions: Cream shortening, sugar and vanilla., Add egg and milk; beat until light and fluffy., Sift dry ingredients together and blend into creamed mixture., Divide dough in half., Cover and chill at least one hour., On lightly floured surface, roll to 1/8-inch thickness., Chill other half of dough until ready to use., Cut in desired shapes with cutters., Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 375° for 8 to 10 minutes., Cool slightly and remove., Makes 3 dozen.

title: Chicken Tortilla
directions: Boil 4 to 6 chicken breasts., Oil a casserole dish., Line with Doritos (regular flavor)., Put a layer of chicken that has been taken off the bone on top of the Doritos., Mix together cream of mushroom and cream of chicken soups with Ro-Tel tomatoes., Pour on top of chicken., Place a layer of Doritos on top and Cheddar cheese., Bake at 350° for about 45 minutes.

title: Monkey Bread
directions: Cut each biscuit into four pieces in 1/2 cup sugar and 1/2 tablespoon cinnamon mixture and drop into buttered Bundt pan., In saucepan bring to boil 1/2 cup sugar, white corn syrup, 1 tablespoon cinnamon, butter and nuts., Pour over biscuits and bake approximately 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Tasty Potato Salad
directions: Cook, peel and slice potatoes., Combine with celery, onions, green peppers, pimentos and seasoning., Add Dressing., Mix well and chill., Add additional dressing before serving.

title: Pat'S Chicken Enchiladas
directions: Place tomatoes, chili peppers, coriander and salt in blender; blend until smooth., Add sour cream and blend., Set aside., Mix chicken, cream cheese and onion, also salt to taste, if desired.

title: Vegetable Medley
directions: Cook and stir onion in oil, using 10-inch skillet, until tender., Add all ingredients except tomatoes., Cook and cover over low heat for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally., Add tomatoes. Cover and simmer until green pepper is tender, approximately 5 minutes.

title: Chili Con Queso Nacho Dip
directions: Cut Velveeta into cubes and put into crock-pot or microwave-safe bowl., Add Ro-Tel tomatoes or salsa., Melt together., Serve with nacho chips.

title: Barbecue Spareribs
directions: Follow directions on back of sparerib mix.

title: Strawberry Bread
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Pour into 2 greased and floured loaf pans., Bake at 325° for 1 hour or until done.

title: Apple Hill Cake
directions: Mix apples and sugar (let stand)., Mix eggs, oil and vanilla. Stir in apples and sugar., Sift flour, soda, salt and cinnamon. Add to mixture., Mix well, adding nuts., Pour into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake in a 350° oven for 1 hour.

title: Chicken And Wine(Makes 4 To 6 Servings)
directions: Place chicken skin side up in baking dish 11 1/2 x 7 1/2-inch. Combine remaining ingredients., Pour over chicken., Sprinkle generously with paprika., Bake at 350° for 1 to 1 1/4 hours.

title: Ribbon Salad
directions: Mix first 3 ingredients., Pour into greased Bundt pan., Place in refrigerator to jell., Mix lemon jello and 1 cup boiling water. Add marshmallows and cream cheese., Chill until slightly thickened., Blend mayonnaise, Cool Whip and pineapple., Chill until thick, then spoon over red jello., Mix lime jello, 2 cups boiling water and cold water or ice cubes., When thickened, gently pour over lemon mixture and jell.

title: Brunch Casserole
directions: Grease an 8 x 12-inch baking dish., Place bread as a liner in bottom of dish., Sprinkle with cheese, then sausage. Mix together eggs, milk, salt, mustard and pepper. Pour over sausage and cheese., Refrigerate overnight., Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes or until eggs are set. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Forgotten Short Ribs
directions: Salt and pepper ribs., Put in Dutch oven., In small pan combine remaining ingredients., Bring to a boil and simmer for 5 minutes., Pour over short ribs., Cover and bake at 275° for 4 hours or until tender., Spoon off excess fat prior to serving.

title: Dutch Cookies
directions: Cream butter/margarine. Add sugar and cinnamon; beat well. Add egg yolk; beat well. Sift and add flour. Mix well. Press dough evenly unto greased cookie sheets or 12, x 15-inch pan. Brush with slightly beaten egg white. Sprinkle with cinnamon sugar and pecans. Bake 30-35 minutes at 300°. Cut into squares while warm.

title: Black-Bottom Goodies
directions: Combine first 5 ingredients in a large bowl. Make a well in center of mixture. Combine water, oil, vinegar and vanilla. Add to dry ingredients, stirring well. Spoon batter into paper-lined miniature muffin pans, filling 2/3 full. Combine cream cheese and next 3 ingredients, stirring well. Stir in chocolate morsels. Spoon about 1 teaspoon cream cheese mixture over chocolate batter. Bake at 350° for 10 to 15 minutes. Yield: 5 dozen.

title: Beet Wine(5 Gallons)
directions: *Used in flower and root wines because natural yeast is absent in these crops and it helps to carry fermentation further.

title: Banana Popsicles
directions: Whiz for 3 minutes in blender., Put in bowl., Add remaining ingredients., Stir and chill., Cut a banana in half., Use a corn dog stick or fork., Roll banana in carob mixture., Then roll in coconut, peanuts, walnuts or anything else you desire., Place on tray covered with wax paper and freeze., Take out and let the kids or grown-ups have fun., Delicious treat and low-fat.

title: No Salt Bread
directions: Dissolve yeast in warm water., Add shortening, sugar and 1 1/2 cups flour., Beat 2 minutes at medium speed., Gradually add, by hand, rest of flour., Makes a soft batter., Let rise about 30 minutes., Punch down., Beat 25 strokes., Knead lightly., Spread in greased pan; let rise again., Bake at 375° for 1 hour., Makes 1 loaf.

title: Zucchini Slaw
directions: In large bowl, toss zuchini with carrot and green onions., In a small screw-top jar, combine remaining ingredients; cover and shake well., Pour over vegetable mixture and toss to combine. Cover and chill several hours or overnight.

title: Caramel Frosting
directions: Heat first 4 ingredients until dissolved., Bring to a rolling boil and cook for 1 minute., Set off heat and add vanilla., Beat until right consistency to spread., Spread on cooled cake layers.

title: Baked Corn
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Butter a 2-quart casserole dish., Beat egg whites until stiff; set aside., In casserole dish, beat egg yolks with cream., Stir in flour, sugar, salt and pepper., Add corn and butter and mix., Fold in egg whites., Pour into prepared pan and sprinkle top with paprika; bake for 45 to 60 minutes.

title: Cherry Delight Salad
directions: Fold all ingredients together.	Chill and serve.

title: Onion Pretzel Snacks
directions: Break pretzels into bite size pieces., Place in a 9 x 13-inch pan., Melt butter and add onion soup mix., Stir well., Pour over pretzels and mix well., Bake at 350° for 15 minutes, stirring every 5 minutes., Let cool completely., Store in tightly closed container.

title: Mock Lemon Pie
directions: Mix and cook together the first 5 ingredients., Add eggs and lemon extract; cook a little bit more., Cool and pour into baked pie crust., Beat egg whites; add 2 tablespoons sugar., Put on top and brown in hot oven.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
directions: Beat together cream cheese and sugar., Add peanut butter and beat in well., Fold in 2 cups Cool Whip and spoon into pie shell. Top to taste with more Cool Whip., Refrigerate several hours before serving., Makes one 9-inch pie.

title: Beer Bread
directions: Mix all ingredients and place in 2 greased 9 x 5-inch loaf pans., Start in cold oven., Bake 60 to 70 minutes., Butter top 15 to 20 minutes before done.

title: Mashed Potato Filling
directions: Saute in olive oil onion, celery, garlic and poultry seasoning., Mix with bread.

title: Too Easy Peach Cobbler
directions: Butter 8 x 8-inch pan., Slice peaches and put in the bottom of the pan., Cut bread into 5 finger slices and put on top of the peaches., Mix butter, flour, sugar and egg., Pour over bread. Sprinkle with a little cinnamon., Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

title: Six Week Muffins
directions: Mix together all dry ingredients., Add other ingredients, mix thoroughly and store in covered bowl in refrigerator., Do not mix second time., Fill muffin cups and bake at 400° for 20 minutes. May add any fruit variation., Will keep well in refrigerator for up to 6 weeks.

title: Lime Jello Salad
directions: Boil Jell-O, water and pineapple for 3 minutes., Add marshmallows, pecans, cottage cheese and whipped cream., Cool in icebox.

title: Cauliflower Au Gratin
directions: Break cauliflower into sections., Cook for 10 minutes in boiling water, which has been salted., Drain well., Combine cauliflower with 2 tablespoons margarine, onion, cheese, sour cream and salt., Spoon into a 1 1/2 quart casserole., Melt remaining margarine and toss with bread crumbs., Sprinkle over the cauliflower mixture., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until heated through., Yield:, 10 to 12 servings.

title: Oven-Buttered Corn Chunks
directions: Melt butter in a 9 x 13-inch pan., Sift flour, sugar, baking powder and salt into a bowl., Add milk and corn., Stir until soft dough is formed., Turn out on a well floured board or pastry cloth. Knead about 15 times., Roll out in a rectangle 1/2-inch thick., Cut into 1-inch strips and then into 24 pieces., Roll in the melted butter and arrange in the pan., Bake at 450° for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Taco Casserole
directions: Crush taco, chips, into 9 x 13-inch dish., Brown ground beef; season, with envelope taco seasoning., Add refried beans to beef; mix, well., Then add layer of meat and chips, then 1 layer thick of, shredded, cheees., Add, 1 layer of sour cream. Bake 15 minutes at, 350°., Leave set 5 minutes before eating. Add 1/2, head of chopped lettuce, chopped tomatoes and chopped black, olives., Add more, Cheddar, cheese, sprinkled, on top; serve.

title: Shrimp Newburg
directions: Melt butter in a large pot., Add onion and celery; saute about 10 minutes., Add peppers and shrimp; saute 15 minutes more until shrimp are done., Remove from heat., Add flour and sauce mixes; stir well to get out the lumps., Add 1 quart of milk., Return to low heat and bring to a simmer slowly, until it thickens., Add more milk; thin out if necessary., Add parsley at the end of cooking., Serve over rice.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Cook broccoli as directed on package., Place in casserole dish and cover with slices of Velveeta cheese., Melt butter and combine with crumbled Ritz crackers., Cover casserole and bake at 350° for approximately 30 minutes or until cheese is melted and crackers are browned.

title: Butterscotch Brownies
directions: Melt shortening in saucepan; add sugar and stir until dissolved., Cool 2 to 3 minutes., Add eggs, one at a time, beating after each., Sift flour with salt and baking powder., Add to first mixture., Add vanilla, water and nuts or coconut., Turn into greased 8 x 12-inch pan., Bake 30 to 35 minutes or less in a 350° oven.

title: County Kitchen Chicken Pie
directions: Cook chicken until tender., Remove meat from bones., Reserve broth; cut chicken into small pieces and place in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan., In a saucepan, mix and bring to a boil the reserved broth and soup., In another bowl, combine margarine, pepper, salt, flour and buttermilk., Mix thoroughly to form batter., Pour broth mixture over chicken., Spoon batter over top., Bake at 425° for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Pig Picking Cake
directions: Mix together., Bake in 3 layer cake pans at 325° for 15 to 20 minutes., Cool before icing.

title: Chinese Fried Rice
directions: Fry bacon. Remove from fat. Add onions and green pepper. Fry until slightly browned. Pour in soy sauce. Stir. Combine rice and meat. Add to onion mixture. Salt and pepper to taste. Heat. Add unbeaten egg and stir until blended well with rice. Crumble bacon over top.

title: Cordon Bleau
directions: Pound chicken., Season with salt., Place ham and cheese on each., Tuck in sides and roll, pressing to seal., Coat with flour. Lightly brown in butter; place in a baking dish., Stir mushrooms, water, wine and Heinz 57 sauce in butter in skillet., Heat and pour over chicken., Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until tender. Thicken sauce and serve with rice.

title: Nanaimo Bars
directions: Combine crumbs, coconut and nuts; reserve., Heat butter and 1/4 cup granulated sugar until butter is melted., Stir in cocoa; mixture should be smooth and sugar dissolved., Blend in egg and vanilla, mixing well., Combine mixture with crumb mixture., Turn into a lightly oiled (not greased) 8 x 8-inch pan., Press firmly to make a smooth surface., Place into freezer while preparing next layer., Blend the 1/4 cup soft butter, the powdered sugar and hot water until mixture is smooth and well combined., Spread over chocolate layer, smoothing top., Melt chocolate chips., Spread over top of cookie (sometimes it spreads easier if you add a little butter and milk.), Cover and chill., Cut into 16 bars (288 calories each!).

title: Squash Casserole
directions: Put squash in large casserole dish & mash., Add cheese leaving enough to cover later., Stir in crackers & minced onions. Add eggs & stir quickly to prevent them from cooking., Salt & pepper to taste., Cover with rest of cheddar cheese., Cook at 350 degrees for 20 minutes., Uncover and cook an additional 20 minutes or until slightly brown.

title: Tuna-Zucchini Frittata
directions: Melt 2 tablespoons butter in 8 or 9-inch skillet., Add mushrooms and cook until tender, 3 to 5 minutes., In large bowl, beat eggs with milk., Add mushrooms zucchini, tuna, salt, lemon juice and tarragon., Mix well., Melt remaining 1 tablespoon butter in skillet., Pour in tuna mixture., Cook over low heat to medium heat, without stirring, until frittata is set on bottom., Place under broiler and cook just until top is set, about 3 minutes. Serves 4.

title: Sunflower Dirt Cake
directions: Crush cookies, place half crumbs into a 9 x 13-inch pan., Mix cream cheese and margarine until smooth., Mix in powdered sugar. Fold in Cool Whip.

title: Sausage Balls
directions: Mix all ingredients together and roll into marble-size balls. Bake in 400° oven until brown, approximately 10 minutes.

title: Honey Whole Wheat Bread
directions: Combine water, honey and oil in saucepan and heat to lukewarm. Pour into a large mixing bowl and re-check temperature., Stir in the powdered milk, salt, yeast and 3 cups, whole wheat flour., Mix well. Add the rest of the whole wheat flour and enough unbleached flour to make a nice springy dough. Turn out onto a floured board and knead until smooth, about 10 to 15 minutes. Put dough into an oiled bowl, turning to coat all sides. Cover and let rise until double, about 60 minutes.

title: Fresh Strawberry Pie
directions: Line baked, cooled pie shell with 2 cups of large, uncooked berries, arrange hulled side down., Make a sauce of the other 2 cups of berries, cut up and cooked until thick with sweetening, water, cornstarch and salt, mixed together., Remove from heat. Add butter and stir well., Cool and pour over berries in the pastry shell., Spread with a thick coating of whipped cream or whipped topping., Serves 6.

title: Mushrooms With Crabmeat Stuffing
directions: Saute stems, onions and celery in butter until celery is tender., Pour into a large bowl., Add breadcrumbs, parsley, white crabmeat, garlic, salt & pepper., Mix well and add more melted butter if too dry., Lightly blanch mushroom caps., Drain and cool. Form small balls of stuffing and insert into each cap., (In forming balls, stuffing should not stick to your hands.), Lightly sprinkle with garlic., Bake at 350 degrees for 20 to 25 minutes or until golden., (Excess stuffing may be frozen or formed into crab patties and baked.)

title: Potato Casserole
directions: Mix cream of chicken and sour cream; set aside., Pour melted butter over potatoes; pour cream of chicken mixture over potatoes and mix well. Add rest of ingredients., Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

title: Pecan Pie
directions: Mix well and bake in unbaked crust in 375° oven for about 45 minutes or until done.

title: Black Walnut Pound Cake
directions: Cream butter, shortening and sugar, then add eggs, one at a time., Add rum and vanilla., Add alternately flour, baking powder and milk, then add nuts., Bake in a 350° oven about 80 minutes.

title: Beach Cake
directions: Mix first 4 ingredients in a bowl, then pat it out into a 9 x 12 inch pan, sprayed with Pam. Mix the next 3 ingredients and pour over crust. Preheat oven to 350°. Bake for 45 minutes. Cut into squares.

title: Honey Salad Dressing
directions: Place ingredients in a jar and shake., Refrigerate., Makes 2 1/2 cups.

title: Rainbow Punch
directions: Put ingredients in punch bowl and let stand for 15 minutes. Then pour 2-quarts ginger ale over sherbet and strawberries.

title: Rosemary Chicken And Mushrooms
directions: Cut chicken into 1 1/2-inch cubes., Spread lightly with mayonnaise and sprinkle with salt and lemon pepper., Arrange chicken cubes in shallow layer in nonstick skillet and brown quickly over high heat, turning once., Remove and set aside. Combine onions, wine, rosemary and mushrooms in skillet., Cook and stir over high heat until most of liquid evaporates and onions and mushrooms begin to brown., Return chicken to skillet and heat through., Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and serve over pasta.

title: Sue Siegel'S Stew
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Put into ovenproof casserole and cover tightly., Bake at 325° for 2 hours., Do not remove cover until ready to serve., Serve over noodles or rice.

title: Taco Lasagna
directions: Brown hamburger and stir in the seasoning. In large round casserole, layer meat, then cheese, then tortilla. Repeat until all is used. Put beans and sauce on top. Cover with more cheese. Bake in oven until bubbly and hot, for 20 to 30 minutes. Serve with sauce and sour cream.

title: Apricot Salad
directions: Bring pineapple and sugar to a full boil., Add jello., Stir until dissolved., Add cream cheese., Stir until dissolved., Add ice water and celery., Put into refrigerator until jello starts to mold., Whip evaporated milk and fold into jello mixture., Chill.

title: Hot Cherry Pudding
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., To Bisquick add sugar and the drained cherries., Stir in milk to make a stiff dough., Spread in greased 10 x 6 x 2-inch pan or 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan., Heat the juice from the cherries with water added to make 1 1/4 cups and the remaining cup of sugar., Also add 1/2 teaspoon almond extract and a few drops of red food coloring., Add butter and bring to a boil., Pour over the dough and bake for 30 minutes., Serve hot with vanilla ice cream.

title: Hungarian  Paprikas
directions: Saut onions in 2 Tbsp. shortening, drain., Add to the onions the red pepper and paprika, salt and water., Add cut up chicken and cook until tender about 2 hours.

title: Garden Vegetable Onion Dip
directions: Stir together sour cream, onion soup mix, garlic powder, and dill weed until well blended. Stir in grated carrots. Chill at least 1 hour before serving.

title: Roasted Potato Salad
directions: Bake small red potatoes., Fry bacon crisp, drain., Chop potatoes, bacon, eggs and onions., Add remaining ingredients. Mix well., May be served warm or cold.

title: Hamburger Baked Beans
directions: Brown hamburger and onions together., Drain excess fat., Mix all ingredients together with meat., Bake for 45 minutes at 350°. Can be cooked in crock-pot on high.

title: Zucchini Carrot Bread
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Grease and flour 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan or 2 1/2 x 3 1/2 x 2-inch loaf pan.

title: Mint Salad
directions: Melt jelly over low heat., Add salad dressing., Blend well. Stir in marshmallows, pears and pineapple., Fold in whipped cream. Pour into 8-inch square pan., Freeze until firm.

title: Leek, Potato And Sausage Soup
directions: In a dry, heavy saucepan, toast the cumin and caraway seeds over moderate heat, stirring for 2 or 3 minutes., Transfer to a plate., In the pan, cook the leeks in the butter, stirring occasionally for 5 minutes., Stir in the broth and the potatoes (cut into 1/2 inch cubes)., Bring the liquid to a boil., Simmer the mixture for 10 minutes or until the potatoes are tender., Stir in the toasted seeds, Kielbasa, cream, and salt and pepper to taste., Simmer the soup for 5 minutes., Just before serving, stir in the spinach., Serves 4.

title: Corn Fritters
directions: Measure water into large mixing bowl., Add yeast., Stir until dissolved., Stir in sugar, shortening, salt and egg., Add flour and beat until smooth., Cover., Let rise in warm place for 40 minutes., Stir down., Stir in corn.

title: Canjica(Corn Pudding)
directions: Cook the corn as you would dried beans or peas until tender (20 minutes in the pressure cooker is one way)., Don't use a lot of water., After the corn is done, add other ingredients., (You may need more milk, coconut and sugar, depending on how the corn comes out.), Before serving, sprinkle with cinnamon., The texture should be creamy, but lumpy and not too thick., Serve warm.

title: Chocolate Cheese Pie(In Microwave)
directions: Prepare and microwave crust as directed; set aside., Place cream cheese in medium mixing bowl; microwave at power level 5 for 1 1/2 to 2 minutes or until cream cheese softens., Add sugar, eggs and vanilla., Beat at low speed of electric mixer until blended; set aside., Place chocolate in small bowl., Microwave at power level 5 for 3 1/2 to 4 1/2 minutes or until chocolate can be stirred, stirring 1 or 2 times., Add to cream cheese mixture., Add sour cream; beat at low speed until smooth., Pour into prepared crust., Place on saucer in oven., Microwave at power level 5 for 12 to 15 minutes or until center is slightly set, rotating pie plate every 3 minutes., Let stand for 10 minutes., Chill for 6 hours or until set., Top, with cherry pie filling.

title: Sausage Roll
directions: Make dough with flour and margarine., Roll into a rectangle. Spread raw sausage over dough., Roll as for a jelly roll., Chill, slice and bake at 400° until sausage is done and dough is brown. Drain on paper towels.

title: Dump Cake
directions: Spread pineapple evenly over bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan (which has been greased)., Cover with pie filling., Sprinkle cake mix evenly over top., Sprinkle with nuts., Dot margarine evenly on top., Bake at 375° for 30 to 35 minutes or until brown.

title: Good Cookies
directions: Mix all ingredients except oats and chips. Stir in oats and chips. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 325° for 12 to 15 minutes., Makes 100 cookies.

title: Baked Ham Slice-Sauterne
directions: Place ham in a shallow baking pan., Mix sugar and cornstarch in a saucepan., Stir in water and margarine., Cook, stirring constantly, for 5 minutes.

title: Beef Stroganoff
directions: Melt butter in large skillet and saute chopped onion over medium heat., Add meat and saute 5 minutes or until browned., Add remaining ingredients except sour cream in order listed., Simmer 10 minutes., Stir in sour cream and cook just until heated through., Serve over mashed potatoes, rice or egg noodles.

title: Oranged Barbecued Wings
directions: Split chicken wings at each joint and discard tips; pat dry. Season wings with salt and pepper., Place wings on broiler pan. Bake at 400° for 25 to 30 minutes or until done., Combine barbecue sauce, orange juice, Worcestershire sauce, rind, cloves and garlic in saucepan. Heat to boiling; reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally., Brush sauce over wings., Yields 8 servings.

title: Vegetable Dip
directions: Cream together all ingredients. Chill in refrigerator overnight. Serve with fresh vegetables.

title: Easy Chicken And Rice
directions: Place rice in a buttered 13 x 9-inch Pyrex., Add soup and water; mix well., Place chicken on rice., Bake 3 hours at 250°.

title: Mixed-Up Hamburger
directions: Brown ground beef and drain., Place in 9 x 13-inch baking dish., Combine soups, water, onions and cheese., Cover with Tater Tots., Bake at 375° for 30 minutes.

title: Easy Italian Cream Cake
directions: Mix all together., Pour into 3 greased and floured 8-inch cake pans., Bake at 325° for 40 minutes., Cool.

title: Mexican Chicken Casserole
directions: Heat together cheese, soups, Ro-Tel and onions., After cheese melts, add broken chips and chicken., Pour into greased casserole. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: White Punch
directions: Mix all together in large punch bowl., Serves about 75 people.

title: Red And White Strawberry Salad
directions: Drain pineapple., Mix jello with water., Add partially thawed strawberries, stir well., Add bananas and pineapple., Place 1/2 of mixture in 9 x 12-inch pan., Put in refrigerator until firm. Put sour cream on top., Put the rest of the strawberries mixture and refrigerate until firm., Cut into square to serve., Dessert of salad.

title: Sherry Cake
directions: Combine cake mix, pudding mix and nutmeg in large bowl., Add all remaining ingredients., Mix at low speed until moistened, then beat at medium speed 3 minutes, or beat by hand 150 strokes per minute!, Turn batter into greased and floured 10-inch Bundt pan. Bake, below oven center, in moderate oven at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes, until cake tests done., Remove from oven and let stand in pan 10 to 15 minutes., Turn onto wire rack and glass, if desired.

title: Cheese Logs
directions: Grate and mix all cheese together., Add chili powder and garlic salt to taste., Roll in crushed nuts.

title: Cracker Jacks
directions: Boil the first 5 ingredients until it spins a thread. Then add soda and pour over one gallon popped corn.

title: Low-Fat Key Lime Pie
directions: Mix frozen limeade, milk and Cool Whip. Beat with mixer. Pour into pie shell and chill 2 to 4 hours before serving., Garnish with cut-up lime slices and stemmed cherries., Keep any leftovers in refrigerator.

title: Easy Fruit Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Refrigerate., Ready to serve when strawberries are thawed., Looks great when served in clear or crystal bowl.

title: Garlic Cheese Dip
directions: Combine, sour, cream,, salad, dressing	mix and parsley flakes in a small bowl;, chill several hours to blend flavors. Serve with crackers or crisp vegetable sticks.

title: Fruit Wake-Up
directions: Combine banana, pineapple and orange juice in bowl., Chill in refrigerator., Spoon into serving dishes., Top with toasted coconut.

title: Cappuccino Shake
directions: In a blender, combine milk, coffee crystals, sugar and extract., Blend until coffee is dissolved., Serve with a dash of cinnamon., For a hot drink, pour into a mug and heat in a microwave., Yield:, 1 serving.

title: Pineapple Zucchini Bread
directions: Beat eggs well, add sugar. Blend in oil and vanilla. Add zucchini. Add dry ingredients, then pineapple, raisins, nut, and coconut. Mix well. Pour into 2 well-greased loaf pans (don't fill too full). Bake 325° for 1 hour and 20 minutes.

title: Barbecued Chicken Wings
directions: Place wings in single layer on baking pan., Combine all ingredients in a sauce pan and bring to a simmer., Pour over wings and bake at 350° 1 hour., Pan may be covered for first 20 minutes of baking.

title: Fruitcake Cookies
directions: Chop cherries, pineapple, dates and pecans in a large pan. Add soda and salt to flour; add to fruit., Mix until fruit is well coated.

title: Banana Nut Loaf
directions: Hat oven to 350°., Grease an 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2 1/2-inch loaf pan., Mix together thoroughly sugar, shortening and eggs., Stir in buttermilk, mashed bananas and flour, then soda and fold in chopped nuts., Turn batter into prepared pan., Bake 50 to 60 minutes., Cool in pans for 10 minutes., Remove and cool completely.

title: Poor Man'S Stroganoff
directions: Saute onion and garlic in butter over medium heat., Add meat and brown., Add flour, salt, pepper and mushrooms., Cook about 5 minutes., Add soup and simmer, uncovered, about 10 minutes., Stir in sour cream., Heat through., Sprinkle with parsley., Serve with noodles., Serves 4 to 6.

title: Chocolate Chip Bars
directions: Heat oven to 350°., In medium bowl, combine flour and sugar. Cut in margarine until crumbly., Stir in 1/2 cup chips; press firmly on bottom of 13 x 9-inch baking pan., Bake 15 minutes.

title: Wendy'S Cheesy Potatoes
directions: Fully cook potatoes in skin in microwave., After cool, peel skins off and cut in pinwheels., In casserole dish, make a layer of potatoes., Put cheese strips on top of potatoes., Continue to make layers until you have used up the potatoes., Empty cream of chicken soup into separate bowl., Mix well with one soup can of milk, then pour over potatoes., Top with cheese strips., Add salt and pepper to taste., Place in oven uncovered at 400° for approximately 30 minutes or until cheese is completely melted throughout the casserole dish.

title: Hamburger Casserole
directions: In heavy skillet, brown beef and drain., Add onion, salt and pepper, then stir., Add sliced potatoes, soup and water., Cover and simmer until potatoes are done., Makes 4 servings.

title: Special Mashed Potatoes
directions: Make mashed potatoes., Add cream cheese, eggs, flour and minced onion., Put in baking dish., Top with French fried onion rings. Bake at 325° for 35 minutes.

title: Pasta With Artichokes
directions: Trim artichokes and prepare as for hearts, cutting in halves or quarters., Or, if using frozen artichokes, thaw and use as they come in the package., Saute onion in butter until translucent., Add garlic, wine, lemon juice and artichokes., Cover and cook over medium heat 1 to 2 minutes., Add heavy cream and cook, uncovered, 2 to 3 minutes longer until mixture thickens slightly., Add fresh fettuccine, cooked, chopped nuts and Parmesan cheese., Toss, then add salt and freshly ground pepper to taste., Serve with warm soup, sourdough French bread and Chardonnay wine for a Monterey Bay, California experience.

title: Fourth Of July Dip
directions: Spread beans in bottom of Pyrex dish., Top with sour cream and then pour melted cheese over sour cream., Top with sliced jalapenos., Serve with chips.

title: Almond Bark Candy
directions: Melt almond bark in 200° oven., Stir in peanut butter; add remaining ingredients., Drop by teaspoons on waxed paper., Cool until hardened.

title: Zucchini Bread
directions: Mix, first, five, ingredients, together., After this is well blended, add flour, cinnamon and nuts., Pour in 2 greased and floured, loaf, pans, or 1 (13 x 9-inch) cake pan., Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until brown.

title: Peanut Butter Bars
directions: Heat peanut butter and syrup over medium heat until warm and soft, stirring constantly., Mix in cereal until well coated., Press into greased pan and refrigerate until hard., Cut into 18 bars.

title: Hearty Chicken Pot Pie
directions: Combine broth, 1 c. water, carrots, and potatoes in a medium saucepan., Bring to a boil; reduce heat and simmer over low heat 10 minutes.

title: Pickled Okra
directions: Divide the okra evenly between 3 (1 pint) jars., Place one dried chile and one tsp. of dill into each jar., In a small saucepan, combine the water, vinegar and salt., Bring to a rolling boil., Pour over the ingredients in the jars, and seal in a hot water bath for 10 minutes., Refrigerate jars after opening.

title: Chicory(Cooked Greens)
directions: Clean and wash one head of chicory., Cut into manageable eating size., In a proper size pot, place 2 cups water, pinch of sugar, pepper, tomato sauce (for taste and color) and the press of 2 large cloves garlic., Add the cut greens to the pot containing the listed ingredients and cook, covered, at medium heat, until done (about 10 to 15 minutes)., Enjoy with toasted French or Italian bread.

title: Sauerkraut And Noodle Dough
directions: Place sauerkraut and water in 4-quart size saucepan., Begin heating.

title: Basic Crepes
directions: In mixer bowl, beat eggs lightly., Add melted margarine or butter and mix., Add remaining ingredients and beat until smooth. (Batter will be thin.), Pour scant 1/4 cup butter into lightly greased and heated 8-inch crepe pan or skillet., Tilt pan to coat bottom evenly with batter., Cook over medium heat until brown; turn crepe to brown second side., Cool pan slightly between crepes., Spoon filling onto center of crepe and roll.

title: Popcorn Balls
directions: Put all ingredients except milk in pan; bring to boil, stirring constantly, then add milk and bring to boil again., Boil until it forms a soft ball., Mix with popcorn and form balls.

title: Rice Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Bake in 325°, oven, covered, for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Broccoli-Cheese Potato Soup
directions: Peel and cube potatoes; add chopped onions., Cover with water. Cook together for 20 to 25 minutes., Add Ro-Tel tomatoes, cheese, broccoli, salt and pepper to taste., Simmer over low heat until cheese melts., Serve with Broccoli Cornbread.

title: Pineapple Almond Slaw
directions: Combine the first 6 ingredients in a small bowl; set aside. Combine cabbage and remaining ingredients in a large bowl., Add sour cream mixture., Toss well, cover and chill.

title: Parmesan Cheese Potatoes
directions: Heat oven to 375°., Place butter into a 9 x 13-inch cake pan and melt in oven., Mix Parmesan cheese, flour, salt and pepper in a bowl with a cover., Place potatoes into the mixture., Shake until well coated., Place in pan and sprinkle leftover mixture over the top., Bake, uncovered, for 1 hour.

title: Rhubarb Pudding Cake
directions: Combine together 1 cup sugar, flour, butter, baking powder and milk; pour into 9-inch square pan., Over this batter put rhubarb, 1 cup sugar and boiling water., Bake at 350° until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Oatmeal-Raisin Cookies
directions: Beat margarine at medium speed with an electric mixer. Gradually add sugars, beating well., Add egg substitute and vanilla; mix well., Combine flour and next 3 ingredients. Gradually add to margarine mixture, mixing well., Stir in raisins. Drop dough by 2 teaspoonfuls onto cookie sheet coated with cooking spray., Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes or until lightly brown., Remove to wire racks to cool., Yield:, 3 dozen cookies (60 calories per cookie), 1.5 g fat, 00 mg cholesterol.

title: Green Rice
directions: Saute onion and pepper in olive oil., In casserole dish, combine the rest of ingredients., Add the onions and pepper. Cover and bake at 375° for 35 to 45 minutes or until rice is done. Stir to mix the rice and vegetables.

title: Corn Pudding
directions: Beat eggs slightly., Add remaining ingredients, except cheese. Spoon into buttered casserole dish, sprinkle cheese over top. Bake at 350° for 35 minutes., Serves 5.

title: Jam Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients and pour into 3 layer pans and bake for 30 minutes in 350° oven., Let layers completely cool.

title: Pretzel Salad
directions: Mix pretzels, butter and 3 tablespoons sugar and press into large oblong cake pan. Bake 8 minutes at 400°. Cool completely. Beat cream cheese and 3/4 cup sugar until smooth; add Cool Whip and mix. Spread over pretzels. Seal edges and refrigerate until firm. Mix jello, 2 cups boiling water and berries. Let set up slightly, then pour over cream cheese mix and refrigerate. Keeps fine so you can make day ahead.

title: Fruit Salad
directions: Add most any kind of fruit except for blueberries., Combine and chill.

title: Layered Salad
directions: Layer in Tupperware bowl the lettuce, cauliflower and peas. Sprinkle Italian seasoning mix on top., Cover with mayonnaise and seal around edges., Sprinkle cheese and bacon crumbs on top. Cover and refrigerate.

title: Yogurt Cheese
directions: Line large sieve with double thickness of cheesecloth., Add yogurt., Set over bowl., Cover and put in refrigerator for 24 hours., Use with baked or mashed potatoes, as a spread or in dips.

title: Croque Monsieur
directions: Cut a slit in each bread slice to form a pocket., Spread 1 tsp honey mustard into each bread pocket., Divide ham and cheese evenly among bread pockets., Combine milk and egg whites in a shallow bowl, stirring with a whisk., Dip sandwiches, 1 at a time, in milk mixture, turning to coat., Heat a large nonstick skillet coated with cooking spray over medium high heat., Add 2 sandwiches; cook 3 minutes on each side or until golden brown. Repeat procedure with remaining sandwiches., Yield:, 4 servings.

title: Pineapple-Coconut Dessert
directions: Beat together egg yolks, sugar and salt. Add to milk that has been scalded and cooled. Cook over hot water in double boiler until custard coats spoon.

title: Sunday Morning Brunch
directions: Mix eggs, salt, 1 cup of milk, mustard and soup with remaining 2/3 cup milk., Layer bread, sausage, cheese, mushrooms and egg mixture in a rectangular cake pan., Leave in refrigerator overnight., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes., Serves 8 to 12.

title: Hot Broccoli Dip
directions: Cut slice from top of bread loaf; remove center, leaving 1-inch shell., Cut removed bread into bite size pieces., Saute celery and onion in margarine until tender., Add process cheese spread; stir over low heat until process cheese is melted., Stir in remaining ingredients; heat thoroughly, stirring constantly., Spoon into bread loaf., Serve with vegetable dippers and bread.

title: Hot Broccoli Dip
directions: Cook and drain broccoli (do not add salt)., Saute onions in margarine., Add soup, mushrooms, cheese and broccoli., Heat well and serve with large corn chips.

title: Potato Candy
directions: Mix potatoes and powdered sugar (will turn liquid) until it makes a ball like dough., Divide and roll out on powdered sugar. Spread peanut butter over and roll up jelly roll style., Repeat with remaining dough., Slice and eat.

title: Yulonda'S Homemade Sweet Spaghetti
directions: Cook spaghetti and drain., Brown hamburger and drain grease from meat., Stir in barbecue sauce and add water and sugar., Stir all together.

title: Easy Chocolate Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients thoroughly in a 9 x 13-inch rectangular cake pan., Bake at 375° for 40 minutes.

title: Cream Cheese Cake
directions: Cream together first 3 ingredients, then add the remaining ingredients., Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 10 minutes., Grease and flour pan.

title: Chicken Scala
directions: Flour chicken breasts and brown in oil. Drain fat from pan and add consomme to chicken; simmer 25 to 30 minutes., Add 1/2 to 1 cup sour cream to make a creamy sauce. Add several shakes of black pepper., Put chicken and sauce in baking dish. Sprinkle with cheese and brown under broiler.

title: Mock Lobster
directions: Thaw- have a large pan of water boiling with about 1 cup sugar (1/2 cup sugar/lb. fish).

title: Green Tomato Pickles
directions: You will also need 3 clean quart jars.

title: Fried Pies
directions: Roll out biscuits real thin and put fruit in side., Cut around edges., Fry in oil., Drain on paper towels.

title: Raspberry Brownies
directions: Melt chocolate., Cream margarine, eggs and sugar, then add chocolate., Stir in flour and walnuts., Pour into greased 8 x 8-inch pan., Drop jam by teaspoonfuls over surface of batter. Swirl with fork to mix into batter., Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

title: Buttermilk Pie
directions: Cream sugar and butter., Add flour and eggs; beat well., Pour into a 9-inch unbaked pie shell and bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes or until brown on top.

title: Ginger Cup
directions: Push the cloves into the oranges and let them stand an hour that the flavor may be extracted., Rub the sugar over the rind of the oranges and lemons, then add juice of these to the sugar., Add the spices and pineapple and let stand two hours., At the time of serving, put in the water and ginger ale and pour over the cracked ice.

title: Scripture Cake
directions: Mix and follow advice in Proverbs 23:14 for making a good boy. Put all in one pan., Bake for 3 hours in moderate oven.

title: Alabama Apples(Roll Tide!)
directions: Put butter in bottom of casserole; add sliced apples and sugar., Top with grated cheese., Bake at 375° for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Pizza Dough
directions: Dissolve yeast in measuring cup with warm water., Stir together flour and salt in large mixing bowl., Cut shortening into flour with pastry blender or two knives until mixture resembles coarse crumbs., Stir in dissolved yeast., Turn out onto lightly floured board or pastry cloth and knead just until smooth., Place dough in large greased bowl; turn once to grease top., Cover and let rise in warm draft-free area until doubled in size, about 1 hour., Punch dough down., Divide dough in half., On floured surface, roll each half into an 11-inch circle., Place rounds on greased 12-inch pizza pans., Make pizza as desired. Bake at 400°. Makes 2 pizzas.

title: Consomme Rice
directions: Mix all ingredients together and cover., Cook in oven at 350° for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

title: Cheese-Macaroni Salad
directions: Chill macaroni., Combine with celery, peas, carrots and green pepper., Season to taste., Moisten with mayonnaise., Mix lightly with two forks., Serve on any crisp salad greens., Garnish with cheese balls or diced stuffed olives., Yield: 6 servings.

title: Beef Goulash(Microwave)
directions: Place beef in a 3-quart microwave casserole., Peel tomatoes and remove cores., Cut tomatoes in chunks., Place in casserole with beef., Add onion, salt and pepper; stir., Cover and cook on Roast for 40 to 50 minutes or until beef is tender., Stir twice during cooking time., Stir sour cream into mixture and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.

title: Blueberry Cheesecake
directions: Mix ingredients until smooth., Pour into graham cracker crust. Top with blueberry pie filling., (May also be topped with cherry pie filling.)

title: Sausage Bake
directions: Braise sausage and drain grease off., Add flour to sausage and add all ingredients., Place in casserole dish.

title: Grandma'S Tea Cakes
directions: Cream the oleo, Crisco and sugar until smooth., Beat in eggs. Sift together the flour and soda; add to creamed mixture., Form into a ball., Roll out on floured board to the thickness you desire and cut out., Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes., Makes about 3 dozen, according to thickness.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
directions: Cream butter, beat in sugar and other ingredients., Add enough flour (about 1/2 cup) to make mixture stiff enough for drop cookies (on a greased sheet) with floured fork, crisscross., Bake at 350°. Makes 60.

title: Peanut Butter Candy
directions: Mix sugar, milk and butter in pan., Cook 5 or 6 minutes., Add peanut butter, Marshmallow Creme and vanilla., Pour in buttered cake pan or plate., Let cool!

title: Company French Toast
directions: Pour melted butter in a 13 x 9-inch pan and cover with brown sugar. Place a layer of bread (as close as possible) over butter; sprinkle cinnamon and raisins over and cover with another layer of bread. Combine and beat eggs, vanilla and milk; pour mixture over bread. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight.

title: Wild Rose Jelly
directions: Measure rose petals., Cover with water and bring to a boil. Boil 15 minutes., Strain through a jelly bag., Add strawberry juice and measure the liquid., If you do not have a quart, add enough water to make up the difference., Return to kettle., Stir in sugar and bring to a boil., Still, stirring, pour in pectin and boil 1 minute more., Pour into jelly glasses and seal with paraffin.

title: French Eggs
directions: Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan., Lay bread in 2 layers in pan. Cover each layer with grated cheese; sprinkle with bacon., Mix eggs, milk and salt together; pour over top., Let stand overnight in the refrigerator., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Williamsburg Chicken
directions: Mix all ingredients and place in a greased casserole., Top with crushed potato chips and bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Chocolate Baskets
directions: Crush shredded wheat biscuits until fine., Melt chocolate in double boiler until soft., Stir in peanut butter and add mixture to shredded wheat., Drop by tablespoons onto waxed paper., Shape into birds nest and place jelly beans in each one., Chill.

title: Nut Cake
directions: Cream butter and sugar in mixer bowl until light and fluffy.
