Add eggs 2 at a time, beating well after each addition., Add self-rising flour; mix well., Stir in vanilla., Combine pecans, walnuts and all-purpose flour in bowl; toss to coat., Fold into batter., Stir in apples., Pour into ungreased tube pan., Bake at 300° for 1 1/4 hours., Cool in pan for several minutes., Invert onto serving plate., Yield:, 16 servings.

title: Green Beans And New Potatoes
directions: Place beans, pork, onion, salt, sugar and water in Dutch oven. Cover and cook 1 hour. Add potatoes and cook 30 minutes longer or until tender.

title: Pineapple Cream Cheese Gelatin Mold
directions: Cook sugar and pineapple 5 minutes., Let cool., Dissolve gelatin in cold water., Add gelatin to sugar and pineapple and chill., Beat in separate bowls the cream cheese and Dream Whip. When pineapple is cold, beat in the cream cheese and the Dream Whip until well mixed., Add nuts., Place in mold and refrigerate.

title: Baked Potato Salad
directions: Combine all ingredients except cheese., Put in baking dish, sprinkle with cheese., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Red Velvet Cake
directions: Combine all ingredients and pour batter into two 9-inch cake pans., Bake at 350° for 25 minutes or until done.

title: Green Beans And Ground Beef
directions: Brown onion and garlic lightly in fat. Add beef and cook stirring with fork 3 minutes., Add soy sauce and 3 cups of water. Heat to boiling., Add beans and cook 10 minutes., Thicken with cornstarch blended with a little water., Cook slowly 10 minutes longer, stirring often., Serve on, hot rice., Makes 4 servings.

title: Zucchini Appetizers
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Grease oblong pan, 13 x 9 x 2-inches., Mix all ingredients; spread in pan., Bake until golden brown, about 25 minutes., Cut into 2 x 1-inch pieces., Makes 4 dozen appetizers.

title: Veg-All Casserole
directions: Mix, all, ingredients, together, except cracker crumbs. Put into buttered casserole and top with Ritz cracker crumbs. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes., Tasty!

title: Molly'S Pork Chops
directions: Mix soup and water and set aside., Place pork chops in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan., Slice onion and green pepper on top of each chop. Pour tomato soup over the top., Cover with tinfoil, vent foil. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Thyme-Lime Chicken
directions: In a small saucepan, over low heat, melt butter in olive oil; add lime juice, thyme, lime peel, garlic, salt and pepper., Place chicken on a greased broiler pan. Brush with sauce., Broil, basting frequently, 6 to 7-inches from the heat, for 15 to 20 minutes on each side or until the chicken juices run clear. Yields 4 to 6 servings.

title: Cranberry Slush
directions: Fix jello accordingly, add remaining ingredients and chill in freezer over night. Enjoy!

title: Chicken And Dumplings
directions: Mix flour, oil and enough water to mix dough well., Let set and rise about 2 hours or longer., Roll out thin; cut in strips. Break into small pieces, about 2-inches or shorter., Cook chicken; add bouillon to taste., Add salt if needed., Cook dumplings in broth; add chicken after they are cooked., Add a little yellow food coloring for color.

title: Easy Carrot Cake
directions: Combine first 5 ingredients and mix at medium speed for 3 minutes., Stir in next 2 ingredients., Bake in greased 9 x 13-inch pan at 350° for 35 minutes., When cool, spread with cream cheese frosting.

title: Piccalilli
directions: Chop the cabbage, tomatoes, peppers and onions., Mix with the salt and let stand overnight., Next morning, drain and press to remove all liquid possible., Boil vinegar, water, sugar and spices 5 minutes., Add the chopped vegetable mixture., Bring to a boil and pour into sterilized jars to within 1/2-inch of top., Put on cap., Screw band firmly tight., Process in boiling water bath 5 minutes., Yield:, 6 pints.

title: Gizzard Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients together in large casserole dish., Bake at 350° for 2 hours, stirring occasionally, or until gizzards are tender., Or use a crock-pot, reducing water to 1 cup and cooking on low for 9 hours.

title: Cabbage And Beef Soup
directions: In Dutch oven, brown beef., Add all remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer, covered, for 1 hour. Yield: 3 quarts.

title: Party Mix
directions: Melt butter in large pan and add Worcestershire sauce., Mix cereals and seasonings and add to pan., Bake at 350° for one hour, stirring every 15 minutes.

title: Cheesy Macaroni Bake
directions: Preheat oven to 450°., Spray a 6-cup shallow baking dish with nonstick cooking spray., Cut the Cheddar-flavor cheese and the Mozzarella into 1/4-inch cubes.

title: Monkey Bread
directions: Dissolve yeast and sugar in warm water, enough to dissolve it, for a few minutes., In mixing bowl, combine oil, brown sugar and salt and add milk., Stir until cool., Add egg., Add about 2 1/2 cups flour and mix well., Add flour until dough makes a soft mixture., Turn onto floured surface., Cover with greased foil and let rest 10 minutes; knead about 2 to 3 minutes., Put in greased bowl and cover with foil and cloth., Keep in refrigerator overnight; roll out dough to about 1/2-inch., Cut into squares and dip in melted butter and put in pan in layers., Let rise about 3 hours until double in size., Cook in oven at 400° for 30 to 35 minutes., Heat 1 stick margarine and pour over when it comes out of oven.

title: Lemon Cream Cheese Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 350°. Grease 2 baking dishes.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
directions: Combine broth, celery and onion; cook until tender., Combine chicken, broth mixture, mayonnaise, lemon juice, soup, eggs, 3/4 cup cracker crumbs, salt and pepper., Pour into casserole dish. Sprinkle remaining cracker crumbs on top., Bake at 325° for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Wacky Cake
directions: Combine first 4 ingredients in a bowl and mix well., Combine flour and next 4 ingredients and mix well; add to the first mixture and beat 1 minute., Pour into 9-inch baking pan coated with cooking spray., Bake at 350° for 25 minutes or until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Macaroni Pizza
directions: Brown ground beef and onion in skillet., Add tomato soup and cook 15 minutes until thickened., Stir frequently., Cook macaroni until tender., Add egg and milk to the macaroni., Spread macaroni mixture in greased jelly roll or cookie pan., Spread tomato beef mixture on top of macaroni., Place thin slices of cheese on top and bake at 350° for about 20 minutes.

title: Piggy Wraps
directions: Heat oven to 375°., Separate rolls into 8 triangles; cut each triangle lengthwise into thirds., Flatten a little or cut corn twists strips into 48 pieces to fit the sausages., Flatten a little., Bake until brown.

title: Zucchini Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Grease and flour 2 loaf pans or a 9 x 13-inch pan., Mix sugar, oil, eggs and vanilla., Add flour, baking soda, baking powder, salt and cinnamon., Lastly, add zucchini, raisins and nuts., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Golden Lamb'S Sauerkraut Balls
directions: Grind ham and pork together and saute until brown., Add flour, milk and dry mustard and cook until thick., Cook sauerkraut separately., Grind the sauerkraut and meat mixture together. Return to stove and cook until thick., Cool., Shape., Roll in flour., Dip in milk., Roll in cracker or bread crumbs., Fry in deep fat at 350° until brown.

title: Alexandra'S Favorite Drumsticks
directions: Heat oven to 425°., Mix flour, salt, paprika and pepper in bowl., Dip drumsticks, in margarine., Roll in flour mixture to coat., Arrange in ungreased square pan and bake, uncovered, until done, about 50 minutes.

title: Zucchini And Cheese Bake
directions: In a large skillet, put in a couple of tablespoons olive oil and saute garlic, onions, tomatoes and green pepper., Saute until pepper is tender and tomatoes are mushy., Set aside., Saute zucchini in some more olive oil., Cook until zucchini is 1/2 done, just tender., Heat oven to 350°., Mix vegetables together with zucchini and put in a large glass or Corning pie or quiche dish. Cover with 2 cups of cheese., Bake for 20 to 30 minutes, until cheese is melted and bubbly.

title: Cottage Cheese Salad
directions: Dissolve jello in water., Let cool., Add cottage cheese, well drained., Add mayonnaise and salt., Grind or grate vegetables and drain them well., Add to jello and cheese mixture., Let set several hours., Serve on lettuce.

title: Sticky Rolls
directions: Spray Bundt pan with Pam. Put frozen roll dough in the bottom of pan. Melt margarine. Add brown sugar and pudding. Stir and pour over frozen rolls. Let rise overnight. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Turn Bundt pan over onto a large platter and rolls will pop right out. Enjoy!

title: Copper Carrots Glaze
directions: Heat liquid to boiling., Let stand overnight.

title: Driskill Hotel'S Cheese Soup
directions: Saute carrots, celery and onion in butter., Add flour and cornstarch., Put vegetables in top half of double boiler., Add milk and chicken stock., Heat., Add soda and cheese., Stir until cheese has melted. Add seasonings., Serve hot, topped with paprika.

title: Easy Cream Pie
directions: Mix together dry ingredients. Gradually add milk and Milnot. Cook on very low heat until thick. Add butter., Pour in baked pie shell. Sprinkle with nutmeg., Makes 1 pie.

title: Cowboy Cake
directions: Rub flour, shortening, sugar and salt to fine crumbs, saving 1/2 cup crumbs to sprinkle on top. Add baking powder, soda, nutmeg, cinnamon, sour milk and eggs to batter. Mix well. Bake in a square cake pan. Sprinkle crumbs on top before baking. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Tasty Grilled Potatoes
directions: Mix salad dressing and seasonings in large bowl until well blended., Stir in potatoes and onions to coat., Divide potato mixture evenly among 3 large pieces of heavy-duty foil., Seal each and place on grill approximately 30 to 45 minutes until potatoes are tender., Makes 3 large servings.

title: White Mountain Frosting
directions: Mix in saucepan and keep covered first 3 minutes, then cook to 242° on thermometer., Beat 1/3 cup or 3 egg whites until stiff, while syrup is cooking., Pour syrup slowly over whites and add 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla.

title: Hash Brown Potatoes
directions: Mix all ingredients, except margarine, together., Put in 9 x 13-inch casserole dish., Pour melted margarine over top., Bake at 325° for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Tunnel Of Fudge
directions: Cream butter in large bowl at high speed., Add eggs, one at a time, beating well., Gradually add sugar., Beat until light and fluffy., By hand, stir in flour, frosting mix and nuts until well-blended.

title: Enchilada Casserole
directions: Brown and drain hamburger., Add 2 cans mild enchilada sauce and 1 can cream of mushroom soup to hamburger., Spoon a small amount of mixture into a 9 x 13-inch casserole pan., Layer 6 corn tortillas, 1/2 mixture, Cheddar cheese., Repeat this with shells with remainder of mixture and finish with cheese., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Donald'S Honey Chicken
directions: Season chicken. Bake or fry your chicken. Cover with honey and cook for 5 minutes.

title: Lettuce Salad Dressing
directions: Mix ingredients (not lettuce); mix well., Spread over lettuce.

title: Good Vegetable Salad
directions: Prepare marinade by stirring together salt, oil, sugar, water, vinegar and paprika., Pour marinade over other ingredients., Cover and refrigerate, overnight., Drain, 1 hour before serving.

title: Friendship Bread
directions: Do not use metal spoons or bowls for mixing.

title: Vegetable Dip
directions: Mix together and let stand overnight., Serve with carrots, cauliflower, bell pepper, radishes, celery and tiny green onions.

title: Sure-Jell Strawberry Jam
directions: Mix strawberries and sugar thoroughly; set aside 10 minutes. Stir Sure-Jell with water in pan., Bring to a boil, stirring constantly., Boil 1 minute., Remove from heat., Stir mixtures together until sugar is completely dissolved and no longer grainy. Pour into plastic containers., Cover., Let stand at room temperature 24 hours., Store in freezer.

title: Creamed Corn
directions: Mix all ingredients together and cook slowly about 30 minutes.

title: Royal Chocolate Sauce
directions: Combine cornstarch, cocoa, margarine, honey and water in a heavy saucepan, bring to a boil, stirring constantly., Remove from heat; add marshmallow creme and vanilla., Stir until blended. Serve warm over ice cream or as a dip for fresh fruit and cake cubes. Makes 2 cups.

title: Vinaigrette Dressing
directions: Combine oil, vinegar, onion, salt and pepper in screw-top jar or small bowl., Shake or whip with wire whisk until ingredients are well blended and of a thick and creamy consistency., Use as dressing for fish, salads, hot or cold vegetables and for marinating meats., Makes 1 cup dressing.

title: Carrot Cake
directions: Mix oil, sugar, and eggs together and then all other ingredients., Bake at 350 degrees in a 9 x 13 inch pan., Cook for about 35 to 40 minutes., The trick to a good carrot cake is to not overcook., Frost when cool.

title: Gooey Butter Cake
directions: Combine first 3 ingredients in a large mixing bowl, beat at medium speed until blended., Pour batter into a greased and floured 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan, set aside., Beat cream cheese until creamy., Gradually add sifted powdered sugar, beat well., Add eggs, one at a time, beating after each addition., Pour cream cheese mixture evenly over batter., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until golden., Let cool completely in pan or wire rack., Sprinkle with additional powdered sugar.

title: Marshmallow Fudge Bars
directions: Mix all ingredients, except marshmallows., Spread on a 10 x 15-inch greased cookie sheet., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes. Remove from oven; cover with marshmallows., Return to oven for 3 minutes, or until marshmallows are soft., Cool., Frost with your favorite chocolate frosting.

title: Carrot Casserole
directions: Cook well carrots; drain., Mash., Add salt and pepper, lots of butter, onion, green pepper and sharp cheese., Grease casserole dish., Mix all together., Top with 1/2 Pepperidge bread stuffing mix., Bake 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Hot Mulled Cider
directions: Pour juice into percolator., Put rest of ingredients into the basket of percolator., Perk as if making coffee., Recipe can be halved or doubled.

title: Chicken Relleno(Stuffed Chicken)
directions: Debone chicken where only skin, drumstick and wings are left. Ground chicken meat., Mix chicken meat and all ingredients, except boiled chicken and Vienna sausages., Spoon the mixture into the chicken skin., Spread it flat and alternately arrange quartered, boiled eggs and Vienna sausage., When done, spoon in the other half of the mixture., Close the skin with toothpick., Steam chicken for 3 hours., Serves 20 people.

title: Hush Puppies
directions: Mix all ingredients and drop by tablespoonfuls into hot oil. Fry until golden brown.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Cook broccoli until tender; drain off water., Mix in all the ingredients., Put in baking dish., Bake for 25 minutes at 325°, then take 1/2 a package Pepperidge Farm dressing and 2 tablespoons margarine, melted., Mix together., Pour over top and bake for 5 more minutes.

title: Lemon Meringue Pie
directions: Combine 1 cup sugar, flour, cornstarch and salt in double boiler; add boiling water, stirring constantly., Cover and cook 15 minutes., Beat egg yolks with 1/2 cup sugar and gradually pour hot mixture over this, while stirring., Return to double boiler and cook 5 minutes longer., Just before removing from heat, add lemon juice and rind., Mix well., Cool., Pour into pie shell., Top with meringue.

title: Juanita'S Cocktail Chicken Balls
directions: Combine ingredients in order listed except 3/4 cup pecans. Mix well., Shape into small balls and roll in chopped pecans. Keep refrigerated until serving time., These can also be frozen for later use., Try spearing a chicken ball and a pineapple chunk on an hors d'oeuvre pick.

title: Cream Cheese Peach Pie
directions: Beat crust ingredients 2 minutes., Pour into 10-inch pie pan.

title: Pork Chop Casserole
directions: Stir spices into rice on bottom of casserole., Top with browned pork chops., Add consomme Top chops with sliced onion, tomato and bell pepper., Bake covered 350° for 1 hour or until liquid is absorbed.

title: Pineapple Orange Salad
directions: Place pineapple in saucepan, bring to a boil, stirring constantly., Remove from heat, add gelatin, stirring until dissolved., Stir in buttermilk and nuts., Cool., Fold in Cool Whip. Pour in dish., Chill.

title: Persimmon Pudding
directions: Mix dry ingredients., Add all others., Pour into buttered pan. Bake at 350° until firm., Serve warm with whipped cream.

title: Strawberry Or Peach Pizza
directions: Grease a pizza pan., Press the cookie dough in the pan, put pecans on top and press them down into the dough., Bake 350 degrees for 10-15 minutes., Cool.

title: Norma'S Breakfast Casserole
directions: In a well-buttered, 9 x 13-inch casserole dish, beginning and ending with cheese, layer cheese and chiles., Mix eggs with salt, pepper and garlic powder to taste., Pour egg mixture over layered cheese and chiles.

title: Broccoli Corn Bread
directions: Mix together the ingredients and pour over oleo (melted) in pan., Bake at 350° for 25 minutes or until done.

title: Squirrel With Rice
directions: Dice salt pork; saute until brown., Add squirrel pieces; brown lightly., Add water., Simmer until tender., Add rice, catsup, onion and seasonings., Cook over low heat., Cook until rice is tender.

title: Lemon Chess Pie(A Dessert Of Early Virginia)
directions: Beat the eggs with a fork or wire whisk and gradually add the sugar., Add the lemon juice and rind; mix well., Slowly add all ingredients until completely blended., Pour into an 8-inch pie shell and bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes or until brown or until a knife inserted into the filling comes out clean.

title: Streusel Coffee Cake
directions: Stir together the 1 1/2 cups flour, granulated sugar, baking powder and salt., Combine egg, milk and oil., Add to flour mixture; mix well., Stir in raisins., Turn into greased 9 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan., Combine nuts, brown sugar, 1 Tbsp. flour, butter and cinnamon; sprinkle over batter., Bake at 375 for about 25 minutes.

title: Pound Cake
directions: Thoroughly cream the shortening and sugar; add eggs and vanilla and beat well., In separate bowl, sift together the flour, soda and salt., Add dry ingredients to creamed mixture alternately with buttermilk., Pour batter into loaf pan., Bake in a preheated 350° oven for 1 hour.

title: Apricot-Filled Pear Cake
directions: Drain pears., Save 1/2 cup juice., Blend pears in blender until smooth., In large bowl, combine cake mix, pureed pears, 1/2 cup pear juice and eggs at slow speed until smooth and moistened. Beat 2 minutes on high., Pour batter in a lightly greased and floured 13 x 9-inch pan., Grease a piece of wax paper and fit in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes. Cool in pan 10 minutes, remove from pan and cool completely. Slice cake in half, spread apricot jam over cut half., Replace top cake layer., Spread with topping., Chill well.

title: Jewish Apple Cake
directions: Mix in bowl pared and sliced apples, cinnamon and sugar., Mix in another bowl flour, baking powder, salt, oil, orange juice, sugar, eggs and vanilla., Beat until smooth., Pour 1/2 batter in ungreased Bundt pan., Spread 1/2 the apple mixture., Add remaining batter and top with remaining apple slices., Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours., Cool 15 minutes before removing.

title: Budapest Tea Bread
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Grease and flour a large Bundt pan and set aside., In a small bowl, combine brown sugar, cocoa, cinnamon, raisins and nuts., Set aside., In large mixing bowl, cream together margarine and sugar., Add vanilla and eggs, mixing to blend., In a separate bowl, sift together flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt., Add dry ingredients to the large mixing bowl., Mix well. Add sour cream and mix to blend., By hand, fold in brown sugar-nut mixture., Pour batter into prepared Bundt pan and bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes, until done.

title: Jam Cake
directions: Cream butter and sugar., Add eggs., Alternate with flour and milk., Add spices to flour., Bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Chicken Fillet Casserole
directions: Beat eggs well and dip chicken in them, then dip chicken in bread crumbs., Fry in oil and brown on both sides., Drain on paper towel., Put the chicken in a casserole dish., Dissolve bouillon in a cup of hot water and add reserved mushroom liquid; stir well. Pour over the layered chicken and add the mushrooms., Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes., At end of baking time, remove from oven and add enough slices of cheese to cover chicken., Return to oven and bake until cheese melts.

title: Cocktail Spread
directions: Mix the ingredients well., Then add mayonnaise, Worcestershire sauce and horseradish to taste and spreading consistency., Use any kind of crackers.

title: Chili Corn Muffins
directions: In mixing bowl, combine the flour, cornmeal, sugar, baking powder, chili powder and salt., Chop scallion., Beat milk, applesauce and egg until just combined and stir in scallion and corn., Stir flour mixture into milk mixture until just combined but still lumpy., Spoon into prepared muffin pans., Bake until edges start to brown., Bake at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes., They are great with chili and soups.

title: Spider Corn Bread
directions: Preheat oven to 425°., Melt shortening in frypan placed in oven., Beat egg; add 1 cup milk., Stir in cornmeal, flour, sugar, salt and baking powder., Turn into frypan with melted shortening. Pour over remaining milk., Do not stir., Bake 25 minutes at 425°.

title: Herman Cake
directions: Beat eggs, sugar and oil with mixer., Stir Herman, soda, salt, flour, baking powder, 1 teaspoon cinnamon, raisins and 1/2 cup nuts or walnut flavoring together with a spoon., Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan or two loaf pans.

title: Baked Brie With Crudites
directions: Melt 2 tablespoons unsalted butter in a heavy medium skillet over medium heat., Add onion and garlic; saute until onion is golden brown, about 10 minutes., Set aside., Place Brie and cream cheese (cut in large pieces) in a large microwave-safe bowl. Microwave on Medium just until melted, about 2 minutes., Whisk in onion mixture, sour cream, fresh lemon juice, brown sugar and Worcestershire sauce., Season to taste with salt and pepper.

title: Chicken Paprikas
directions: In a Dutch oven over low heat, cook onions in butter until soft but not brown., Add paprika and rub into onions with wooden spoon. Add chicken, meaty side down, and stock., Bring to a boil, then cover and gently simmer for 1 1/2 to 2 hours., Chicken should be very tender and onions mushy., Remove chicken to a platter and debone., Cut larger pieces into serving chunks, if you wish., Add 2 tablespoons of cooking liquid to cornstarch and mix well., Add this mixture to liquid in pot., Bring to a boil and stir until thickened., Reduce heat and stir in sour cream, heating just to simmer point., Add chicken, cover and simmer a few minutes until heated through., Holds well at low heat.

title: Shoo-Fly Cake
directions: Do not use mixer., Pour liquid into crumb mixture and mix with spoon., Pour into greased oblong pan., Place 1 cup crumbs on top and bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Peach Tart
directions: Preheat oven to 425°., Mix eggs, sugar, flour and cream., Pour the mixture over peach slices which have been arranged in the bottom of the pie shell., Dot the top of the tart with butter. Bake for 10 minutes at 425°; reduce heat to 350° and bake for 30 minutes more.

title: Meat And Cheese Tartlets
directions: Mix beef, seasoning mix and cold water. Shape in tartlet muffin pans, as mini-tartlet shell. Mix sour cream, taco sauce, olives and chips. Place one teaspoon of filling into each meat shell. Mound slightly. Sprinkle with Cheddar cheese. Bake 7 to 8 minutes at 425°. Remove from pan. Serve immediately or freeze and reheat at 375° for 10 to 15 minutes. Makes 30 tartlets.

title: Wondrous Brownie Pie
directions: Beat until smooth or blend in blender until smooth. Pour into greased pie plate then pour nuts over top., Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes until knife comes out clean.

title: Applesauce Diabetic Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Sift flour, cinnamon, nutmeg, cloves and baking soda., In a large bowl mix margarine, sweetener and egg., Mix in dry ingredients, alternating with applesauce., Fold in raisins, cereal and nuts; mix thoroughly., Drop onto greased cookie sheet by tablespoon., Lightly flatten with a fork dipped in milk., Bake for 7 to 8 minutes., Makes 36 cookies.

title: 14 Day Pickles
directions: Stir salt in water until salt is dissolved; pour over cucumbers., Let stand for one week; drain well., Add alum; soak 24 hours in the alum water; drain well., Split cucumbers; let them drain., Wash churn; dry it.

title: Spinach Madeline
directions: Cook spinach according to directions. Drain and reserve liquid., Melt butter or oleo in saucepan over low heat. Add flour and stir until well blended, but not brown. Add onion and cook until soft and clear., Add liquid slowly, stirring constantly, until smooth and thick. Continue stirring. Add seasoning and cheese which has been cut into small pieces., Stir until melted. Combine spinach. Pour into casserole and top with buttered bread crumbs., Bake at 350° until bubbly.

title: Chicken N' Rice
directions: Spread, rice on bottom of small roasting pan., Sprinkle mushrooms and pepper over rice., Lay chicken pieces over this. Dilute, mushroom, soup, and, onion soup with water., Pour over chicken., Bake covered at 350° for 2 hours.

title: Apple Glazed Carrots
directions: Melt butter in large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add carrots and saute until carrots begin to brown slightly, about 8 minutes., Add apple juice and honey and bring to boil., Reduce heat and simmer until carrots are tender and liquid is reduced to glaze, stirring occasionally, about 15 minutes., Season to taste with salt and pepper., Transfer to bowl., Sprinkle with green onion tops and serve., Makes 4 servings.

title: Orange Julius
directions: Mix for one minute in blender.

title: Barbecue Ribs
directions: Sprinkle ribs with salt, pepper and Schilling barbecue spice. Place ribs in broiler pan under broiler for 30 minutes to brown and remove excess fat., Slice ribs into serving pieces and put in crock-pot., Add onion and pour in barbecue sauce., Cover and cook on low 6 to 8 hours or on high for 3 to 4 hours.

title: Lemon Cake
directions: Mix together the cake mix, oil, eggs and lemon extract. Dissolve the jello in the hot water and add to the cake mix; mix well., Bake in a 350° oven for 35 to 45 minutes., While hot, prick with toothpick and pour on frosting.

title: Rum Duff
directions: Combine applesauce, sugar, rum, grated orange rind and gingersnaps., Stir until well mixed., Chill., Just before serving, fold in whipped cream and pile into sherbet dishes., If desired, top with additional cream and nuts.

title: Italian Style Bean Salad
directions: Rinse and drain green beans, chick peas, Northern beans and pinto beans., Add onion, bell pepper, red pepper, pimento, salt and pepper, garlic powder, basil and oregano., Heat and stir until dissolved the vinegar, sugar and vegetable oil., Mix together. Shake on wine vinegar and olive oil., Garnish with purple onion rings., Enjoy!

title: Double-Corn Muffins
directions: Preheat oven to 425°., Grease 12 muffin pan cups., In large bowl, combine flour, corn meal, sugar, baking powder, salt and red pepper., In medium bowl, whisk milk, butter and egg., Stir into dry ingredients just until combined., Stir in corn., Spoon into prepared pans., Bake 20 minutes., Unmold and serve warm., Makes 1 dozen.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Place broccoli in casserole., Cover with chicken., Spread mushroom soup, then cheese., Bake at 350° for 25 minutes or until cheese melts.

title: Cajun Hush Puppies
directions: Combine dry ingredients., Add buttermilk, water, oleo and egg. Mix well., Stir in onion and peppers., Carefully drop batter by teaspoonful into hot oil., Fry 3 to 5 minutes until golden brown, turning once., Yield:, 2 1/2 dozen.

title: 2 Step Chicken Broccoli Divan
directions: If using fresh broccoli, cut into spears., In a 9-inch pie plate or shallow casserole dish, arrange broccoli and top with chicken., Combine soup and milk; pour over chicken., Sprinkle with cheese., Combine butter and bread crumbs; sprinkle over cheese. Bake at 450° for 15 minutes, or microwave by covering with wax paper and cooking on High for 6 minutes, or until hot, rotating dish halfway through heating.

title: Pecan Delight
directions: To prepare pan, line 9 x 13-inch pan with wax paper.

title: Apple Cake
directions: Mix together oil, eggs, sugar and vanilla in a large bowl. Sift together the flour, salt and soda., Add oil mixture and blend well., Add chopped pecans and apples., Stir until well mixed. Preheat oven to 350°., Pour cake mixture into a large tube or Bundt pan and bake for 1 hour.

title: Strawberry Punch
directions: Mix sugar and Jell-O together., Add boiling water; mix well. Add pineapple and orange juice., Freeze in plastic 1 gallon container or 1 gallon Ziploc bag., When ready to serve, add ginger ale.

title: French Ice Coffee
directions: Mix coffee and sugar together and cool., Add half and half, milk and vanilla. Pour into Ziploc bags or milk cartons and freeze., Two hours before serving, remove from freezer., Serve with spoons at a slushy consistency.

title: Pinto Beans(German Style)
directions: Wash beans., Cover beans with plenty of water and bring to boil., Boil 2 minutes, set off burner, cover beans and let set for 1 hour., Drain off water and rinse beans., Cover with water and cook beans until tender., Add onion and all other ingredients. Simmer 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Meat Loaf
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., In large bowl, combine meat,, onion soup mix, eggs, tomato sauce, bread crumbs, water and chopped pepper., Shape into loaf and place in baking pan., Bake about 45 minutes or until done., Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Pasta Salad
directions: Cook pasta to desired state; drain., Dice green pepper and onion; add to pasta., Add cooked and drained sausage., Microwave pepperoni on a few paper towels for 2 to 3 minutes; pat oil off, then add to pasta., Add remaining ingredients; mix well. Refrigerate until chilled.

title: Hash Brown Potato Casserole
directions: Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan with margarine., Add hash brown potatoes (slightly thawed by rinsing with water in colander). Pour 1/4 cup melted butter over potatoes., Sprinkle with onions. Mix together soup, sour cream and milk., Pour over potatoes., Top with cheese., Melt 1/4 cup butter in saucepan and mix in bread cubes., Spoon over cheese., Bake, uncovered, at 375° for 1 hour.

title: Chocolate Eclair Cake
directions: Mix pudding according to package and cool., Mix pudding and Cool Whip until creamy., Layer graham crackers and pudding mixture, keep layering until graham crackers are on top., Top with icing and chill.

title: Crescents
directions: Beat butter at medium speed of an electric mixer until creamy., Add 1/2 cup powdered sugar; beat well., Combine flour and salt; gradually add flour mixture to butter mixture, beating at low speed just until blended after each addition., Stir in vanilla and pecans., Divide dough into fourths; cover and chill at least 2 hours., Work with 1 portion of dough at a time, storing remainder in refrigerator., Divide each portion into 12 equal pieces., Roll each piece into a 2 1/2 inch log; curve ends of each log to form a crescent., Place crescents 2 inches apart on lightly greased cookie sheets., Bake at 350° for 12 to 14 minutes or until very lightly browned., Cool on cookie sheets 1 minute., Carefully roll warm cookies in 1 1/2 cups powdered sugar; cool completely on a wire rack., Roll cooled cookies in remaining 1 cup powdered sugar. Store up to 1 week in an airtight container.

title: Mexican Cornbread
directions: Bake 45 minutes at 425° or until golden brown.

title: Crazy Chocolate Cake
directions: Combine all ingredients., Pour into greased and floured pan. Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Squash Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Pour into buttered casserole dish. Sprinkle 1/4 cup stuffing mix on top and dot with 1/2 stick margarine., Bake at 350° for 35 minutes, uncovered.

title: Golden Apple Pie
directions: Peel apples; core and slice thinly to measure 7 cups.

title: Dirt Cake
directions: Make pudding. Pour whipped cream (8 ounces) in pudding., Whip mixture., Put cream cheese in mixture., Mix mixture and whip.

title: The Best And Easiest Peanut Butter Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Mix all ingredients well., Roll into 1-inch balls and place on slightly greased cookie sheet., Press each ball with fork., Bake for 15 to 20 minutes or just until cookies start to turn brown.

title: Peanut Butter Crisscrosses
directions: Preheat, oven, to, 375°., Thoroughly, cream shortening, sugars and, vanilla., Add	eggs and beat well., Stir in peanut butter. Sift, dry, ingredients and stir into creamed mixture. Form	into tiny, balls, and, place on ungreased cookie sheet. Press with back of fork to make crisscross., Dough may also be rolled and cut, if desired., Bake 10 minutes.	Makes 8 dozen.

title: Chicken-Broccoli Casserole
directions: Place broccoli spears on bottom of 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Lay chicken pieces on top., Mix mayonnaise, lemon juice and soup together., Pour over chicken., Top with cheese., Bake at 350° for 40 minutes., May also top with potato chip crumbs or buttered bread crumbs.

title: Apricot Chicken
directions: Pound chicken breasts and put in baking dish., Puree apricots in blender and add lemon juice., Pour mixture evenly over chicken. Sprinkle with oregano and garlic powder., Heat Marsala and butter in saucepan until butter is melted., Pour over chicken., Place under broiler approximately 30 minutes until glaze is brown. Serve with rice or rice pilaf and green veggie., Serves 6.

title: Old-Fashioned Buttermilk Pound Cake
directions: Cream butter and shortening; gradually add sugar, beating well at medium speed of an electric mixer., Add eggs, one at a time, beating after each addition., Dissolve soda in buttermilk. Combine flour and salt; add to creamed mixture alternately with buttermilk, beginning and ending with flour mixture., Mix just until blended after each addition., Stir in flavorings., Pour batter into a greased and floured 10-inch tube pan., Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 5 to 10 minutes or until a wooden toothpick inserted in center comes out clean., Cool in pan 10 to 15 minutes. Remove from pan and let cool completely on a wire rack., Yield: one 10-inch cake.

title: Coca-Cola Salad
directions: Drain cherries and pineapple thoroughly., Heat juice in saucepan and add jello., Stir until dissolved., Pour into bowl and add Coke., Place in fridge until it begins to jell., Add halved cherries, pineapple, pecan pieces and cream cheese chunks., Combine and place back in fridge until firm.

title: Graham Cracker Shells
directions: Grind graham crackers and empty into plastic bowl., Add sugar and melted butter., Mix with both hands until well mixed and all the mixture is moist., Measure out 1 1/3 cups of mixture into each pie pan., Use fork to line side of pan with mixture., Spread remainder of mixture around bottom of pan and press down with bottom of flat glass., Bake at 350° for 6 minutes.

title: Quiche Lorraine
directions: Preheat oven to 400°. Warm pie crust in oven about 10 minutes while the oven heats., Shred cheese and place in mixing bowl. Crumble bacon into bits and add to bowl., Whip eggs with fork and add to mixture., Add milk, chives, salt and pepper to cheese mixture., Stir to mix thoroughly., Pour into crust., Sprinkle surface with nutmeg., Bake until knife inserted in center comes out clean, 30 to 35 minutes., Let cool 10 minutes before serving. Makes one (9-inch) pie.

title: Pork Chop And Rice Casserole (Or Chicken)
directions: Dredge meat in flour., Cook in a little shortening until brown. Put in 2-quart or larger baking dish., Brown pepper, celery and onion., Put in dish with meat., Add rice on top, then tomatoes. Bake in 350° oven until tender, about 45 minutes., Might have to add 1/2 cup water when gets dry.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
directions: In large bowl, mix oil, eggs and sugar., In separate bowl, sift dry ingredients., Add to mixture., Stir in apples and nuts. Spread into well-greased 13 x 9-inch pan., Distribute chips onto top of cake., Bake at 350° for 55 to 60 minutes., For best results, bake at least 2 to 3 days before serving.

title: Baked Beans
directions: Mix (except onion and bacon) and put in baking casserole. Slice onion and put on top., Put chopped bacon on top., Bake for 1 hour at 400° to cook bacon and onion., Reduce heat to 275° and bake, covered, for 2 to 3 hours more.

title: Blend Of The Bayou
directions: Melt cream cheese and butter., Saute shrimp, onion, pepper and celery in 2 tablespoons butter and add to first mixture., Add soup, mushrooms, seasonings, crab meat and rice., Mix well., Place in a 2-quart casserole dish and top with grated cheese and cracker crumbs., Bake for 20 to 30 minutes at 350°, or until bubbly. Serves 8 and leftovers freeze well.

title: Cider Stew
directions: To cut roast into 1-inch cubes, first trim excess fat from roast. Cut roast into 1-inch slices. Cut each slice in half lengthwise, then cut into 1-inch pieces.

title: Golden Coconut Balls
directions: Spread coconut in a large shallow pan., Bake at 350° for 7 to 8 minutes, until golden brown., Turn into a small pie pan. Cool.

title: Parmesan Baked Tomatoes
directions: Cube tomatoes into bite size pieces., Spread tomatoes evenly in a casserole dish., Season with salt, pepper and garlic salt. Sprinkle bread crumbs over tomatoes., Sprinkle cheese next., Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Homemade Oreo Ice Cream
directions: Coarsely crush Oreo cookies to equal one cup. In a large bowl, beat egg yolks, stir in condensed milk and vanilla. Fold in cookies and whipping cream. Pour into an aluminum foil lined 9 x 5 inch loaf pan or other 2 quart container. Cover, freeze 6 hours or until firm. Scoop ice cream from pan or peel off foil and slice. Store in freezer.

title: Blue Cheese Dressing
directions: Crush garlic with salt in small bowl., Add crumbled cheese, mayonnaise, lemon juice, Worcestershire sauce, mustard, paprika and pepper; stir until ingredients are well blended and dressing is smooth and creamy., Chill., Refrigerate in tightly covered container., Makes 1 1/2 cups dressing.

title: Oven-Fried Catfish
directions: Combine first 3 ingredients in a small bowl, stirring well; set aside. Combine mayonnaise, lemon juice and hot sauce, stirring well. Brush mayonnaise mixture evenly over both sides of fillets; dredge in cereal mixture. Place fillets in 9 x 13-inch glass cooking pan coated with cooking spray. Bake at 450° for 18 minutes or until fish flakes easily when tested with a fork. Serve with lemon wedges. Makes 8 servings.

title: Sour Cream Pumpkin Coffeecake
directions: Cream butter, 3/4 cup sugar and vanilla in mixer bowl., Add 3 eggs, beating well., Combine flour, baking powder and baking soda. Add dry ingredients to butter mixture alternately with sour cream., Combine pumpkin, beaten egg, 1/3 cup sugar and pie spice. Spoon half of batter into 13 x 9-inch baking dish., Spread to corners., Sprinkle half of Streusel over batter., Spread pumpkin mixture over Streusel., Carefully spread remaining batter over pumpkin mixture., Sprinkle remaining Streusel over top., Bake in slow oven at 325° for 50 to 60 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean.

title: Turkey Tetrazzini
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Saute onion and garlic in butter in a large saucepan., Add flour and seasonings and blend., Gradually add stock and cook until thickened., Stir in turkey, mushrooms and cheese., Fold in cooked spaghetti noodles., Turn into a 9 x 13-inch casserole dish; top with crumbs and bake 30 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Rice And Chicken Casserole
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Mix chicken soup and milk; reserve half of the mixture., Mix remaining soup, rice and 1/4 of the onion soup mix., Pour into ungreased baking dish., Place chicken breasts on top. Pour reserved soup mixture over chicken breasts., Sprinkle with remaining onion soup mix., Cover with aluminum foil and bake for 1 hour., Uncover and bake 15 minutes longer.

title: Favorite Peach Pie
directions: Peel and halve peaches., Lay face down in unbaked pie shell., Mix coffee cream, sugar, cinnamon and flour together., Pour over peaches., Bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes until lightly brown.

title: Cinnamon Christmas Ornaments
directions: Mix ingredients together., Will be a dense dough., Knead well and roll out to 1/8-inch dough., Cut with cookie cutters., Use a straw to cut out hole for ribbon., Lay on a flat surface to dry for up to 7 days, flipping to allow for even drying., Decorate with acrylic paints and glitter., String ribbon through straw hole.

title: Spinach Squares
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Cook spinach and drain well., Melt margarine in 9 x 13-inch pan., Mix ingredients in any order., Pour into pan., Bake at 350° for 35 minutes., Let stand for 45 minutes. Cut into squares., Makes a "hit" served cold at receptions. Serves approximately 35.

title: Cal'S Delicious Chili
directions: Fry meats, celery, garlic and onion., Add other ingredients. Salt and pepper to taste., Simmer for 1 hour, stirring occasionally.

title: Baked Macaroni And Cheese
directions: In saucepan, melt margarine; stir in flour and gradually add milk and some of the cheese to make cheese sauce., May need to use more flour before milk is added or more milk., Put cooked macaroni in baking dish; stir in cheese sauce mixture., Add more cheese to taste.

title: Famous Pretzels
directions: Dissolve yeast in milk or water., Add sugar, salt, margarine and flour., Mix all ingredients with a wooden spoon., Cover and let rise in warm place for 30 minutes., Form pretzels; brush with slightly beaten egg or a little egg white with a few drops of water., Sprinkle with coarse salt and bake at 425° for 15 to 25 minutes until golden brown.

title: Meat Balls
directions: Mix ground beef, eggs, evaporated milk, bread crumbs, onion, salt and pepper together well., Form balls., Brown meat balls in small amount of oil., Mix together hot water, bouillon cubes, mushroom soup and chicken soup and pour over browned meat balls. Bake in 300° oven for 2 1/2 hours.

title: Mexican Cheese Dish(Great! Xxx)
directions: Grate 10 ounces sharp Cheddar cheese into a 9 x 13-inch buttered Pyrex dish., Sprinkle 5 tablespoons of finely chopped jalapeno peppers on top., Grate 8 to 10 ounces Monterey Jack cheese on top of peppers., Press down., Pour 6 to 7 beaten eggs onto cheese., Bake 45 minutes at 325° or until set and golden. Cut into 1-inch squares.

title: Pretzel Salad
directions: Crust:, Melt butter or margarine., Mix with pretzels and 3 tablespoons sugar., Pat into 13 x 9-inch pan., Bake 8 minutes at 375°., Cool.

title: Easy Chocolate Pie
directions: Place pie crust into pyrex pie plate and cook as directed on package., Cool., Mix instant chocolate pudding as directed using 1 cup less milk for each box., When well blended, pour into cooled pie shell. When pie filling is set, spread Cool Whip on top of filling, shave Hershey bar into curls. Sprinkle chocolate curls on top of Cool Whip topping--then sprinkle walnuts on top also.

title: Hawaiian Chicken
directions: Simmer ingredients for 5 minutes., Pour over chicken pieces and bake for 1 hour at 350°.

title: Beef Stroganoff
directions: Combine flour, salt and pepper., Trim meat., Cut in strips 1 1/2 x 1-inch., Coat with flour., Melt butter in heavy skillet. Brown meat on all sides., Add onion and garlic., Dissolve bouillon cube in water., Add to meat., Add liquid from mushrooms, Worcestershire sauce and catsup., Cover., Simmer until meat is tender and sauce is thick (about 1 1/2 hours)., Add mushrooms. Just before serving, combine vinegar with evaporated milk and stir in., Heat, but do not boil., Serve over hot rice or noodles., Top with chopped parsley.

title: Cherry Delight
directions: Combine ingredients and put into a 9 x 13-inch cake pan.

title: Cherry Delight
directions: Pour cherry filling in bottom of casserole dish., Sprinkle cake mix on top., Pour melted butter next., Top with pecans., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: World'S Best Cookies
directions: Cream together butter and sugars, add egg and mix well., Add remaining ingredients one at a time except pecans., Mix until combined; stir in pecans., Form into balls the size of walnuts; place on ungreased cookie sheet and flatten with a fork., Bake at 325° for 10 to 12 minutes or until lightly brown; do not overcook. Allow to cool a few minutes before removing from pan., Yield: 6 dozen.

title: Cranberry Jello Mold
directions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water; add cold water and ice cubes., Cool until partially set., Stir in all remaining ingredients and pour into molds; chill until set., Makes 2 large jello molds.

title: Old Fashioned Egg Custard
directions: Mix all in top of double boiler. Cook until thick and pour into a baked pie shell.

title: Mexican Cheese Crackers
directions: Preheat oven to 250°., Place crackers in large shallow baking pan., In a small bowl, combine butter, taco seasoning mix, Worcestershire and salt., Pour butter mixture over crackers; stir well., Bake for 1 hour, stirring every 15 minutes., Pour onto waxed paper to cool., Store in airtight container., Yields 6 cups snack mix.

title: Peanut Butter Parfait
directions: Mix Oreo cookies and margarine., Press into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Spread ice cream on top of cookies., Sprinkle on peanuts and freeze for several hours., Melt chips and stir in sugar, margarine and evaporated milk., Bring to a boil., Boil for 10 minutes., Cool completely., Spread cooled fudge on peanuts and freeze.

title: Blender Banana Bread
directions: Put egg, butter, bananas, sugar and granola into blender. Whirl on low until smooth., Combine dry ingredients in a large bowl., Add blender mixture and stir until moistened., Turn into a greased loaf pan., Bake at 325° for 60 minutes., Yields one loaf.

title: Colwell'S Special Squash
directions: Cover squash and onion with water and butter and bring to boil., Cook approximately 5 minutes, until tender., Drain., Melt Velveeta cheese., Add salt and pepper to taste., Pour over squash. Makes 4 servings.

title: Best Ever Deer And Gravy
directions: Flour deer after salting and, peppering., Fry, in oil to brown., Meanwhile place a large, skillet, or, pot, on, another burner., Depending on amount you, cook,, put water in pot., For one package of deer to feed 4, use about 2 cups of water., When meat is browned, drop directly, into, water, that is simmering. Do not drain on paper., Continue, until, all, meat, is browned. Cook onions in oil until tender., Drain off most of oil., Brown small amount of flour and brown., Add, all, this to water., Add soup. Simmer, adding water if necessary.

title: Fruit Cocktail Cake
directions: Mix together., Pour into a greased floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 1 hour at 350°., Spread icing on hot cake.

title: Sausage Balls
directions: Put all ingredients in large bowl; mix well., Shape into small balls on ungreased cookie sheet., Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes., Serve warm.

title: Mother In Law Cake
directions: In, large, mixing, bowl, stir together dry ingredients. Make well, in, center;, drain pineapple, pressing out liquid. Reserve 1/3 cup syrup., Add remaining ingredients.	Beat with wooden spoon., Pour into 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan, greased. Sprinkle with walnuts and brown sugar., Bake in 350° oven for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Pea Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients together and serve cold., Keep refrigerated.

title: Punch
directions: Add water as directed on lemonade. Mix together and serve.

title: Hidden Valley Ranch Oyster Crackers
directions: Combine salad dressing mix, oil, dill weed and garlic., Pour over oyster crackers; stir to coat., Place in warm oven 15 to 20 minutes., Store in tight container.

title: Crispy Crunchy Brittle
directions: Place walnuts in 9-inch glass pie plate., Microwave at High 5 minutes, stirring halfway through until toasted; set aside., In 2-quart glass measuring cup with handle, combine sugar, corn syrup, water, butter and salt., Microwave at High 5 to 6 minutes, stirring well at least once until sugar dissolves., Microwave at High 4 1/2 to 7 minutes, stirring once after 2 minutes until mixture reaches 300°., Stir in baking soda; add toasted walnuts. Turn at once into buttered 15 x 10-inch jelly roll pan., Spread thin., Let stand until cooled., Break into pieces., Makes 1 1/2 pounds.

title: Best Ever Cookies
directions: Cream together the sugars and margarine., Combine with remaining ingredients and mix well., Roll in balls the size of a small walnut., Place 2 inches apart on greased cookie sheet. Press with the bottom of a glass, dipped in sugar., Sprinkle sugar generously on top of each cookie., Bake at 350° about 10 minutes. Makes 100 cookies.

title: Green Pepper Pineapple Salad
directions: Soak gelatin in the pineapple juice and dissolve over hot water., Add to pineapple and cream cheese mixture., Fill green peppers and set in refrigerator to harden., With a very sharp knife, cut the stuffed peppers crosswise into thin slices., Serve on lettuce with mayonnaise.

title: Chocolate Chip Kiss Cookies
directions: Remove foil from Kisses., In a large bowl, combine butter, sugars and vanilla. Beat well. Add flour; blend until smooth. Stir in chips. Mold scant tablespoon of dough around each Kiss, covering completely., Shape into ball and place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 10 to 12 minutes or until set., Cool., Remove from cookie sheet., Makes 6 to 7 dozen cookies., Drizzle topping over each cookie (optional).

title: Hobo Bread
directions: Mix; put in loaf pan., Bake for about 40 minutes at 300°. Serve warm.

title: Chocolate Chip Butter Cookies
directions: Cream together oleo and sugar. Add salt, vanilla and flour. Mix until blended. Mixture will be stiff. Stir in chocolate chips. Roll into balls (3/4 inch) and flatten with a fork. Bake at 350° about 12 to 13 minutes. Sprinkle with powdered sugar.

title: Creamy Honey Butter
directions: Beat butter until creamy and light. Add honey and orange extract and beat until fluffy. Taste at this point. If you like it sweeter, add a little more honey. Refrigerate.

title: Mayonnaise Biscuits
directions: Mix all together., Do not overmix., Drop in greased muffin tins., Bake at 450° until brown, approximately 20 minutes., An especially good recipe for weight watchers.

title: Thanksgiving Salad
directions: Dissolve, jello, in, one, cup, hot, water and pineapple juice. Melt, cranberry, sauce, in, saucepan on low heat until smooth and, mushy., Mix, with all other ingredients and chill until thickened, and then add diced apple., Spoon into 8-inch square dish,, sprayed with Pam or salad oil for easy removal. Chill until, firm., Cut, in squares and serve on lettuce with mayonnaise or Cool Whip., Serves 8.

title: Black Bean Lasagna
directions: Heat oven to 350°. Spray 9 x 13 inch baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. Mash beans; stir in tomatoes, onion, peppers, salsa, chili powder and cumin. In a small bowl, mix ricotta cheese, garlic powder and egg. Spread 1 cup tomato mixture over bottom of dish. Top with 1/2 of noodles, overlapping a bit. Top with half of the remaining tomato mixture. Spoon ricotta cheese mixture over top and spread. Top with 1/2 of shredded cheese. Top with remaining noodles. Top with remaining tomato mixture. Sprinkle remaining shredded cheese on top. Cover with spray-coated foil. Bake about 45 minutes. Let stand about 15 minutes before serving.

title: Banana Walnut Cake
directions: Cream sugar and butter together., Add remaining ingredients. Mix together thoroughly., Add egg whites which are beaten., Bake at 350° for 60 minutes.

title: Barbecue Meatballs
directions: Mix ingredients and form in balls; put in Pyrex pan close together.

title: Lemon Jello Salad
directions: In blender, mix Jell-O and water., Add juice, vinegar and milk., Add cream cheese, one piece at a time., Add carrots and pineapple., Pour in 2-quart mold and chill.

title: Strawberry Pretzel Salad
directions: Melt oleo, add brown sugar and pretzels., Spread in a 13 x 9 inch pan., Bake in 350 degree oven until bubbly (3-5 minutes). Combine cream cheese and white sugar, beat smooth., Add in 1/2 cool whip, mix., Spread over cooled pretzels., Dissolve jello in 1 1/2 c. boiling water, add strawberries., Mix well, cool., Pour over cream cheese layer and chill., Top with remaining cool whip.

title: White Monkey
directions: Melt margarine over low heat; stir in flour and cook for one minute., Slowly add milk; cook until thick, stirring constantly. Add cheese and stir until melted., Salt and pepper to taste. Serve over toast.

title: Flank Steak Fix-Up
directions: Rub steak with garlic; sprinkle with 1 teaspoon salt and the pepper., Cut meat crosswise into 4 to 6 serving pieces., In large skillet, cook bacon., Drain bacon; reserve 2 tablespoons drippings in skillet., Place slice of bacon on each piece of meat, roll up and secure with wooden picks., Coat rolls with flour., Brown rolls in the reserved bacon drippings over medium heat.

title: Party Salad
directions: Combine Cool Whip and milk in a large bowl., Refrigerate one hour., Add remaining ingredients and stir well., Then refrigerate overnight.

title: Cherry Dessert
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Keep in refrigerator., You can also freeze it., I usually do this., I divide it into 8 x 8-inch glass dishes.

title: Diabetic Persimmon Pudding
directions: Mix pulp, sweetener and egg., Add dry ingredients and a little of the milk., Blend well., Add rest of milk and butter., Bake 55 minutes at 325°.

title: Hot Fudge Sauce
directions: Chop chocolate coarsely., Combine with oleo or butter and boiling water in a large saucepan., Heat over low heat, stirring constantly, until chocolate is melted., Add sugar and corn syrup. Heat slowly to boiling, lower heat and simmer gently 8 minutes. Watch carefully but do not stir., Test for thickness on ice cube. Add vanilla., Refrigerate leftover sauce in screw top jar., Reheat in warm water (in jar) until soft enough to pour., Makes 2 1/2 cups.

title: Sloppy Joes
directions: In a skillet over medium-high heat, cook the beef until browned, stirring to separate meat. Spoon off fat. Stir in soup, water, Worcestershire sauce and pepper., Heat through,, stirring occasionally. Serve on buns., Makes 6 servings.

title: Homemade Ice Cream
directions: Mix all the ingredients in a large pot., Boil it on the stove until the mixture becomes thick and the egg yolks have evaporated and there is no lumps., Let this mixture cool for approximately 30 minutes., Put mixture into a ice cream maker until it freezes.

title: Hamburger Casserole
directions: Cook ground beef and then drain., Pour ground beef in pan (8 x 10-inch)., Stir tomato soup in with the ground beef., Pour green beans (drained) and then mashed potatoes until it covers the ground beef., Pour shredded cheese over it., Heat oven to 350° until cheese melts.

title: Old Fashioned Spice Cake
directions: Mix baking soda, cinnamon, nutmeg, cloves and olive spice in small bowl; set aside., Mix remaining ingredients in large bowl; pour in baking dish., Sprinkle cinnamon, baking soda, nutmeg, cloves and olive spice over top of cake., Bake at 350° until golden brown.

title: Tex-Mex Dip
directions: Peel and mash avocado in bowl with lemon juice and salt. Combine sour cream and mayonnaise with taco seasoning in another bowl., (I use 1/2 of the package of taco seasoning in the sour cream mixture and 1/2 in the refried beans.)

title: Zucchini Cake Squares
directions: Blend together., Cut like pie dough., Press 1/2 on bottom of lightly greased pan (cookie sheet)., Bake at 375° for 10 minutes (on bottom rack).

title: Polish Noodles And Cabbage
directions: Melt butter in a large skillet., Add onion and saute until soft., Add cabbage to skillet., Cook for 5 minutes., Stir in caraway seed, salt and pepper.

title: Zesty Grilled Pork Chops
directions: Combine the first five ingredients., Place chops in a glass baking dish and pour marinade over., Cover and refrigerate 3 to 6 hours or overnight., To cook, remove chops from marinade and grill or broil 4-inches from the heat to desired doneness. Brush occasionally with the marinade., Serves 6.

title: Cinnamon Buttermilk Biscuits
directions: Heat oven to 450 degrees., Lightly spoon flour into measuring cup; level off., In large bowl, combine flour, sugar, cinnamon and baking soda., Using pastry blender or fork, cut in shortening until mixture resembles course crumbs; stir in raisins., Stirring with fork, add buttermilk until mixture leaves sides of bowl and soft dough forms., Turn dough onto floured surface and knead lightly until no longer sticky., Roll out 1/2, inch thick and cut with floured 2 1/2 inch cutter., Place on ungreased cookie sheet with sides touching., Bake at 450 degrees for 10 to 15 minutes or until light golden brown., Cool 5 minutes on wire rack and frost. Serve immediately.

title: Savory Italian Rice Bake
directions: Prepare Rice-A-Roni mix as package directs., Remove sausage from casing and crumble., In 12-inch skillet, brown sausage and onion; drain, reserving 1 tablespoon drippings in skillet., Set aside., Add zucchini and garlic; saute over medium-high heat 1 minute., Cover, continue cooking over low heat about 2 minutes or until crisp-tender., Combine prepared Rice-A-Roni, sausage mixture, 1 1/2 cups spaghetti sauce and basil; spread into 9 x 13-inch baking dish., Sprinkle with 1 cup cheese., Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes, or until heated through., Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

title: Cherry Salad
directions: Heat 2 cups of water to boiling, pour over jello in a 9 x 13-inch cake pan., Mix in cherry pie filling and the crushed pineapple., Let this mixture jell.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Pick meat from chicken (no skin)., Mix all ingredients, then tear up the bread like for dressing., Stir all together., Add enough broth to make all real moist, a cup or more if needed. Pour in large casserole dish or pan and bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Beef Vegetable Stew
directions: Add meat, onion, celery and salt to 6 to 7 quarts boiling water., Boil on medium about one hour., Add potatoes, carrots, bouillon and hot pepper to taste., When beef is well done, add tomatoes. Simmer 30 minutes.

title: Tossed Fruit Salad
directions: To make dressing, combine sugar, vinegar and water in saucepan., Heat and stir just until sugar dissolves., Cool., Stir in celery salt, paprika and mustard., Add oil in slow stream, beating with electric mixer until thick., Cover and chill., Peel and section orange and grapefruit, reserving juices., Peel and slice banana., Brush with reserved citrus juices., Set aside., In large salad bowl, combine lettuce and escarole., Arrange orange, grapefruit, banana, avocado and grapes in circle atop lettuce. Pour on chilled dressing., Toss to coat fruit and vegetables. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: 7 Layer Salad
directions: Layer the first 5 ingredients., Sprinkle with sugar, cheese, salt and garlic powder., Just before serving, add bacon or bacon bits., Cover with plastic wrap., Can be made the day before needed.

title: Peach Salad
directions: Mix ingredients and serve.

title: Cabbage Soup
directions: Shred cabbage (food processor or hand grater) and put into pot with 2 quarts water or broth., Add the remaining ingredients after the cabbage shrinks down enough to make room for the rest., Boil on medium-low for a few hours., Yum!

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Melt butter in large skillet; add broccoli and onion., Cook until broccoli is thawed., Cut cheese into 1 square., Mix cheese, soup, milk and rice in large bowl., Add broccoli., Mix and bake in oven at 350° for about 30 minutes or until cheese is melted and rice is done.

title: Fey Family Fruit Cups
directions: Choose from the fruits, selecting, a, total, of, 6 to 7 cups of fruit., Mix, fruits, sugar lightly and coconut., Chill covered. Just before serving, pour liquor or juice over fruit for extra pick up., Serve in a beautiful bowl., Makes 10 to 12 servings.

title: Taco Salad
directions: Fry meat and drain., Add crunched chips and Tabasco; mix together., Mix other ingredients in bowl; let meat cool and mix with salad.

title: Molasses Pecan Cookies
directions: Cream together margarine, sugar, egg and molasses until mixture is smooth., Combine dry ingredients and add to creamed mixture; mix well., Stir in chopped pecans.

title: Scalloped Cabbage
directions: Cover the cabbage with 1-quart boiling water., Add the salt; boil 5 minutes, drain dry., In the melted oleo, add flour and stir well., Add milk and cook until thickens a little., Put cabbage in baking dish., Add cheese to sauce and stir until melted., Pour over the cabbage and cover with buttered crumbs., Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Almond Joy Cake
directions: Mix chocolate cake mix as directed on box., Bake in two 13 x 9-inch pans for 20 minutes at 350°., While cake is baking, mix in large bowl 1 cup Pet milk and 1 cup sugar., Bring to rapid boil and remove from heat., Add marshmallows; stir until melted., Add coconut., Pour over hot cakes; cover completely., In a saucepan heat to a rapid boil 1 1/2 cups sugar, 1/2 cup Pet milk and margarine., Remove from heat; add chocolate chips and stir until melted., Pour over cakes to completely cover., Sprinkle with toasted coconut if desired.

title: Noodles And Cabbage
directions: Cook cabbage and onion together until cabbage is almost done. Cook noodles; drain., Mix noodles with cabbage, onion and sour cream., Mix half of the cheese into mixture., Put in baking dish. Sprinkle with remaining cheese and then with bread crumbs., Bake for 45 minutes at 350°.

title: Chicken-N-Yogurt
directions: Dip chicken breasts in yogurt., Roll in mixture of bread crumbs and Parmesan cheese., Place in baking dish., Place tinfoil lightly over dish., Bake at 350° for approximately 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Bread And Butter Pickles
directions: Soak sliced cucumbers in lime water for 24 hours, stirring often., Rinse in cold water until cucumbers are lime free., Water will be clear., Combine cucumbers and onions in salted water., Let stand for 3 hours and then drain., In a large kettle, combine vinegar and remaining ingredients; bring to a boil., Add vegetables and heat to simmering., Avoid boiling the vegetables for this will make them soft., Pack while hot in sterilized jars and seal., Makes 3 quarts.

title: Oven-Baked French Toast
directions: Spray 9 x 13 inch baking dish., Cut bread into 1-inch-thick slices; arrange closely in single layer in prepared pan., In large bowl beat eggs, whisk in milk, 3 Tbsp. of sugar, vanilla and salt; pour over bread., Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour or over night., Preheat oven to 400 degrees., Sprinkle bread with cinnamon, if desired., Bake uncovered for 30 minutes or until golden brown. Remove from oven; sprinkle with powdered sugar., Slice strawberries place in bowl., Add lemon zest, juice, and remaining 1 Tbsp. sugar, mix lightly., Serve over warm French toast., Yields:, 8 servings.

title: Crock-Pot Macaroni
directions: Spray pot with Pam. Combine all ingredients. Stir once. Cook on low 3 1/2 to 4 hours.

title: Chocolate Cream Pie
directions: Combine cream cheese, sugar, and vanilla in small mixer bowl until blended. Add cocoa alternately with milk, beating until smooth. Fold in topping until combined. Spoon into pie shell and chill until firm or freeze.

title: Pudding Mix
directions: Store dry ingredients in airtight container., For pudding, combine 1 cup mix with milk in pan., Bring to a boil, stirring constantly., Stir in butter and vanilla., Yields 9 batches (4 servings per batch).

title: Pasta With Vegetables And Goat Cheese
directions: Combine broth, wine, shallots and black pepper in large saucepan., Bring to a boil, add broccoli, breaking florets apart. Add squash and mushrooms, reduce heat, cover and simmer 5 minutes. Add cream cheese, goat cheese and lemon juice, cook on low heat, stirring constantly until cheeses are melted., Set aside, keeping warm., Cook pasta according to package directions, drain., Place in large serving bowl, add vegetable/cheese mixture, toss gently. Garnish with red pepper strips., Serves 6 to 8.

title: Coq Au Vin
directions: Sprinkle chicken with salt, pepper and garlic., Dredge chicken in flour., Reserve remaining flour. Saute chicken in 3 tablespoons of butter to brown., Transfer to a 13 x 9-inch pan.

title: Banana Nut Bread
directions: Cream together butter and sugar., Combine dry ingredients and add to butter mixture; mix well., Add eggs, bananas and pecans. Add 1 tablespoon vanilla (optional)., Grease a loaf pan., Bake 30 minutes at 350°, then 30 minutes at 325°.

title: Margaritas
directions: Combine first 5 ingredients, in, a large pitcher., Fill pitcher with ice and, water., Serve immediately in salt-rimmed glasses.

title: Dillicious Pot Roast
directions: In heavy saucepan, cook bacon until crisp., Drain off all but 2 tablespoons bacon drippings from pan., Crumble bacon; set aside. Sprinkle both sides of beef with lemon pepper marinade., Brown beef in bacon drippings., Combine mushroom soup, dill pickle and Worcestershire sauce; pour over browned meat., Cover; simmer for about 2 1/2 hours, or until meat is tender., Remove to warm platter., Sprinkle with crumbled bacon., Skim fat from gravy; serve with roast.

title: Copper Pennies
directions: Cook carrots in small amount of water for 8 to 10 minutes, until tender., Drain well., Combine onions, green pepper and carrots in large bowl., Mix well., Mix remaining ingredients in second bowl., Pour over carrot mixture., Marinate 24 hours in refrigerator.

title: Popcorn Surprise Squares
directions: Melt oleo and marshmallows; add gumdrops, popcorn, M&M's and nutmeats., Press into a 9 x 12-inch cake pan., Cut into squares.

title: Easy Brunch Casserole
directions: Place croutons in greased 9 x 13-inch metal pan., Put grated cheese over croutons., Brown sausage and place on top of cheese. Beat eggs and mix with soup, mustard, milk and mushrooms., Pour over sausage., Bake, covered, with foil in 300°, oven for 1 1/2 hours., This recipe may be prepared the night before and refrigerated., Serves 10.

title: Scalloped Potatoes And Pork Chops
directions: Season pork chops and brown., Melt butter in saucepan., Add flour and mix well., Slowly add milk., Cook until thick, stirring constantly., Alternately place potatoes, onions, pork chops and cream sauce in greased casserole., Cover., Bake 1 1/2 hours at 350° for 1 hour., Uncover last 15 minutes., Serves 6.

title: Michigan White Chili
directions: *Bake 1/2 hour at 350°. Cool. Cut into bite size pieces.

title: Green Pea Salad
directions: Gently add all ingredients to peas., Refrigerate before serving.

title: Maple Nut Chiffon Cake
directions: Heat oven to 325°., Sift the first 5 ingredients together in a mixing bowl., Make a well; add Wesson oil, egg yolks, water and maple flavoring., Beat until smooth with spoon or mixer on medium speed., Add cream of tartar to egg whites in large mixing bowl. Beat until whites are very stiff, then pour egg yolk mixture gradually over beaten egg whites, gently folding with rubber scraper, just until blended., Pour into ungreased 10 x 14-inch tube pan., Bake at 325° for 55 minutes, then at 350° for 10 to 15 minutes., Turn pan upside down on bottle until cold.

title: Quick Peanut Butter Fudge
directions: Melt butter and peanut butter., Add vanilla., Stir in powdered sugar., Place in pan; let cool.

title: Cioppino
directions: About 45 minutes before serving, in 8-quart Dutch oven or saucepot over medium heat, in hot olive or salad oil, cook onion, green pepper and garlic until tender, about 5 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add tomatoes and their liquid, wine, parsley, salt, basil, pepper and bay leaf., Heat to boiling. Reduce heat to low. Cover and simmer 15 minutes.

title: Chicken Salad
directions: Mix salad dressing and ginger together. Add to other ingredients. Serve on lettuce with muffins., It's delicious.

title: Savory Pot Roast
directions: In a 6-quart saucepan, in hot oil, brown roast on all sides. Spoon off fat., Stir in mushroom soup, onion soup mix and 1 cup water., Reduce heat to low; cover and cook for 2 hours., Add vegetables., Cover; cook for 45 minutes, or until roast and vegetables are fork-tender., Remove roast and vegetables., Stir together flour and remaining 1/4 cup water until smooth. Gradually stir into soup mixture., Cook until mixture boils and thickens, stirring constantly., Garnish with fresh parsley, if desired., Makes 8 servings.

title: Shortbread
directions: Mix confectioners sugar and granulated sugar together., Heat oven to 325°., Cream butter and sugars together., Gradually add the rice and unbleached flour., Mix with hands until smooth; do not overmix., Press into baking pan or shortbread mold., Bake for 45 minutes., Cool on wire rack.

title: Polish Cheese Cake
directions: Mix crumbs with 1/2 cup sugar, cinnamon and melted butter. Reserve 3/4 cup of mixture for topping., Press remainder into a 9-inch spring-form pan or a 9 x 13-inch cake pan, lining bottom and sides.

title: Mom'S Bread And Butter Pickles
directions: Slice cucumbers, onions and peppers very thin., Salt overnight, covered with water., Drain, then cook with remaining ingredients., Let stand in hot vinegar for a few hours, then reheat and can.

title: Monster Cookies
directions: Mix first 7 ingredients., Add peanut butter (the kind with oil on top)., Mix again., Add M&M's and chocolate chips, mix well; then add uncooked oatmeal., Drop by teaspoon., Bake at 350° on greased cookie sheet.

title: Pastitso-Greek Lasagna
directions: Boil macaroni according to package directions., Melt 3/4 stick of butter until slightly burned., Put in macaroni; mix with some Romano cheese.

title: Lynn'S Meatballs
directions: Simmer for about (or at least) 1 hour., Making 1 day before is better.

title: Pepper Relish
directions: Wash peppers; remove tops., Finely grind peppers and onions; drain., In large saucepan, combine peppers and onions; cover with boiling water., Let stand 5 minutes; drain., To pepper mixture add sugar, vinegar, salt, dill seed and 1/2 cup water., Boil gently, uncovered, 5 minutes., Pack into hot half pint jars, leaving 1/2 inch headspace., Adjust lids., Process in boiling water bath 5 minutes., (Start timing when water returns to boiling.), Makes 10 half pints.

title: All-In-One Muffin
directions: Beat brown sugar, oil or applesauce, egg, milk and banana until well blended., Stir in flour, baking powder and salt all at once., Fold in cereal, dates and nuts., Spoon batter into paper-lined 4-inch muffin tins until 2/3 full., Bake 20 to 30 minutes at 375°., Serve warm or cold.

title: Holiday Dessert
directions: Dissolve jello in boiling water, turn heat to simmer, add marshmallows and dissolve., Add drained pineapple., Cool., Whip milk and cream cheese in large bowl, add cold jello mixture., mix well., Pour into greased mold and refrigerate., Top with whipped cream in mold pattern if desired.

title: "Bev'S Cocoa"
directions: Mix together cocoa and sugar., Add dash of salt and the water. Bring to boil., Stir in milk and vanilla., Remove from heat. Serves 8.

title: Cinnamon Chews
directions: Combine all ingredients but cereal and melt in top of double boiler., Add cereal, mixing quickly., Spread in buttered 8-inch square pan., Chill; cut in 1/2-inch squares., Dust with powdered sugar., Wrap individually in waxed paper.

title: French Onion Dip
directions: Mix well. Cover. Chill.

title: Western Hash
directions: Brown onions, bell pepper and beef in large skillet., Add tomatoes, basil, rice, salt and pepper., Cover and simmer for 25 minutes., Pour into casserole dish and cover with slices of American cheese., Heat in oven at 350° until cheese melts., Serve hot.

title: Chicken Spaghetti
directions: Cook spaghetti according to package directions., Drain. Combine all ingredients., Mix together and cook on low until cheese is thoroughly melted.

title: Ballistic Bubbles
directions: Mix all ingredients together and enjoy blowing billions of bubbles.

title: Lemon Berry Pie
directions: Beat cream cheese, 1 tablespoon milk and sugar in medium bowl using wire whisk until smooth., Stir in lemon peel and juice. Stir in 1 1/2 cups of the whipped topping., Spread evenly in bottom of crust., Press strawberry halves into cream cheese layer, reserving several for garnish, if desired.

title: Green Bean And Turkey Casserole
directions: Mix vegetable/seasoning packet from Stove top Dressing, with hot water, and margarine in large bowl until margarine is melted. Stir in stuffing crumbs just till moistened. Let stand 5 minutes. Mix turkey and green beans in 2 qt. casserole dish. Mix soup and milk in another bowl until smooth; pour over turkey mixture. Spoon stuffing evenly over top. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until thoroughly heated. Makes 6 servings. Easy and delicious!

title: Spiced Peaches
directions: Combine the vinegar, the juice from the peaches, sugar, cinnamon and cloves., Boil until reduced by about half., Remove the spices., Stick the cloves into the peach halves and pour the syrup over peaches., Let stand overnight in the refrigerator.

title: Red Velvet Frosting
directions: Cook water and cornstarch (stirring constantly until thick). Remove from heat and let stand until cold., Add sugar, vanilla and margarine., Beat with electric mixer until smooth., Spread on cool cake.

title: Champignons Bordelaise Mushrooms With A Bordelaise Garnish
directions: Rinse the, mushrooms, in cold water and drain well., If the mushrooms are large, slice them or cut them in half., In a heavy skillet, heat, the	oil., When, the, oil is hot, add the mushrooms and, salt and pepper to taste., Cook over high heat, shaking the skillet, and, stirring so that the mushrooms cook evenly until they, are quite brown and crisp., They should be almost mahogany colored., Pour, the mushrooms and cooking oil into strainer, or sieve to drain., To skillet, add the butter. When, melted,	add mushrooms.	Sprinkle, quickly, with, bread crumbs, shallots and parsley., Toss and serve., Serves 4.

title: Toffee Refrigerator Dessert
directions: Mix crackers and margarine., Press 2/3 cup of cracker mixture in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan., Prepare pudding with 2 cups milk; add softened ice cream and blend until smooth., Pour over crust. Put in the freezer until set., Remove and spread Cool Whip on the top., Sprinkle remaining cracker crumbs on top and crushed Butterfinger bars.

title: Tuna Crunch Casserole
directions: In 1-quart casserole, blend soup and milk., Stir in tuna, egg and peas., Bake uncovered at 350° for 25 minutes. Top with potato chips, etc. and bake 5 minutes longer., Makes 3 to 5 servings.

title: Picnic Cake(Very Rich)
directions: Mix dates in hot water., Set aside., Cream oleo and sugar. Add eggs; beat until fluffy., Sift flour, salt and soda., Add alternately with date mixture to egg mixture., Mix well each time. Stir in vanilla and 1/2 cup chocolate chips., Spread in greased 9 x 13-inch pan., Top with remaining chips and nuts., Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

title: Sunrise Cherry Pie
directions: Drain pineapple well, reserving two tablespoons syrup. Combine softened cream cheese, vanilla and reserved syrup, mixing until well blended., Stir in 1/4 cup pineapple and 1/2 cup pie filling., Gradually add sugar to cream, beating until soft peaks form., Fold into creamed cheese mixture., Pour into crust., Top with remaining pineapple and pie filling., Chill until firm.

title: Peanutty Chewy Bars
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., In bowl, stir together flour, sugar, cocoa, brown sugar, baking soda and salt., Cut in margarine until crumbly; add eggs., Mix well., Spread in greased 13 x 9-inch baking pan., Bake 8 minutes., Remove from oven., Top evenly with chips, then sweetened condensed milk and coconut., Return to oven; bake 20 minutes or until lightly brown., Remove from oven., Let cool., Cut into bars.

title: Meat Marinade
directions: Let chicken pieces or steak marinate in this mixture for 6 to 8 hours., Excellent on the grill.

title: Amazing Coconut Pie
directions: Combine milk, sugar, eggs, butter and vanilla in electric blender or mixer., Pour into 9-inch pie crust., Sprinkle coconut on top., Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Crescent Chicken Squares
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Blend cream cheese and margarine., Add chicken, salt, pepper, milk, chives and pimento., Separate crescent rolls into 4 rectangles; seal perforations., Spoon 1/2 cup mixture onto center of each rectangle., Pull 4 corners of dough up to center of mixture and seal., Brush tops with melted margarine; dip in crushed croutons., Bake on ungreased cookie sheet 20 to 25 minutes until golden brown., Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Pork In A Crock-Pot
directions: Place in crock-pot., Add dash of seasonings., Pour mixed soup and water over chops., Cover; let cook all day on low.

title: Tuna 'N Noodle Casserole
directions: Boil noodles according to package directions., Drain., Add drained tuna, soup, a little butter and some milk., Peas may be added if desired., Mix well., Bake in greased casserole at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Banana Drop Cookies
directions: Cream, sugar, and, shortening.	Beat in eggs., Dissolve soda in	sour milk; add alternately with the flour and baking powder that, has, been sifted together. Stir in vanilla, nuts and	mashed bananas., Drop, by, spoonfuls onto greased cookie sheet., Bake in 350° oven 10 to 15 minutes., Yield: 4 dozen.

title: Fresh Apple Bread
directions: Sift flour, soda, salt, cream, 1 cup sugar and shortening. Add eggs; mix well., Add apples, milk and vanilla., Mix well. Pour into greased loaf pan., Combine remaining sugar and cinnamon. Sprinkle over batter., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Moist Chewy Chocolate Cake
directions: Note:, Buttermilk can be replaced with 1/2 cup whole milk mixed with 1 tablespoon vinegar.

title: Super Nacho Casserole
directions: Mix first 3 ingredients and put into baking dish., Add the remaining ingredients in the order given., Bake in 400° oven for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Parker House Rolls
directions: Combine the milk, shortening, sugar and salt., Cool to lukewarm., Add yeast which has been dissolved in lukewarm water; add about 2/3 of the flour and beat thoroughly., Let rise until double; add remaining flour., Knead well., Let rise again until double., Roll dough 1/4 inch thick., Cut with a 3-inch biscuit cutter., Brush rounds with melted butter., Grease thoroughly center with dull edge of knife., Fold double, pinch edges together and place on well-greased pan, one inch apart., Allow to rise until double in size., Brush tops with melted butter., Bake in hot oven (425°) for 15 to 20 minutes., Makes 30 rolls.

title: Black Bean Soup
