directions: Soak the beans overnight; drain., Add the water., Add the cloves, bay leaf, garlic, celery, carrot and onion., Cook slowly for 3 hours., Mash beans., Add the beef broth., Combine the flour and melted butter; add to soup., Add the sherry wine to taste. Adjust seasoning., Serve with slice of lemon.

title: Cake Mix Cookies
directions: Mix dry cake mix, eggs and oil., Add raisins, nuts or coconut. Drop by teaspoon on ungreased cookie sheet 2 inches apart., Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Pecan Pie
directions: Mix beaten eggs, sugar and syrup. Add melted butter, vanilla and chopped pecans. Pour into uncooked pie crust. Bake for 20 to 35 minutes at 325°.

title: Banana Split Cake
directions: Mix cracker crumbs and 1 stick melted margarine., Press into 13 x 9-inch pan. In mixing bowl, cream eggs, 2 sticks margarine (melted), powdered sugar and vanilla., Beat with mixer 15 minutes, no less., Spread over crumbs., Slice bananas thin, and layer pineapple., Top with Cool Whip., Sprinkle with pecans and cherries., Cover and refrigerate overnight.

title: Hot Fudge For Cake
directions: Melt butter and chocolate chips together., Add powdered sugar. Pour a little milk at a time., Heat on stove., Will not get real thick until after it cools.

title: Southwestern Skillet Supper
directions: Heat oil in a 12-inch skillet over medium-high heat., Add beef and onion and cook until brown., Stir in chili powder and salt., Cook 1 minute longer., Add tomatoes, beans and corn., Cook over high heat until bubbling., Reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes., Prepare potatoes as directed on package., Stir in cheese and cilantro., Top mixture with 1/2 cup of potatoes and enjoy.

title: Green Tomato Relish
directions: Weigh 7 pounds pickles and put them in salt water that will float an egg., Let them stand 3 days, then 4th day change to clear water for 3 days, changing the water daily., Cut pickles in chunks, put them in weak vinegar., Add a teaspoon of alum to every quart of water to cover them, and let them stand a day., Make a syrup out of 3 parts water and 3 parts vinegar, 1 tablespoon each cinnamon, cloves and allspice, 1 teaspoon celery seed and 1 tablespoon mustard seed., Put all spices in a thin cloth and boil it in your syrup for a while., Then fill your cans and pour the syrup over them and seal cans.

title: Cabbage And Sausage
directions: Cut cabbage up like slaw. Set in bowl aside. Saute pan sausage. Drain grease from sausage. Add stewed tomatoes and let simmer for while. Add cabbage a little at a time. Then let all simmer until cabbage is cooked down. May add a cup or two of water if needed.

title: Pretzel Salad
directions: Spread crushed pretzels on bottom of 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Melt margarine or butter with 2 tablespoons sugar and pour over pretzels., Bake at 350° for 10 minutes., Cool.

title: Instant Russian Tea
directions: Mix all ingredients., Store tightly covered., To make tea, use about 2 teaspoons of mix per 1 cup hot water., This drink is great in cold weather.

title: Peel A Pound Soup
directions: May want to use tomato juice.

title: Chicken-In-A-Packet
directions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Cut four 20-inch long pieces of foil. Divide and layer tomatoes, onions, mushrooms, peppers and potatoes on each foil piece. Place chicken breast on top of vegetables. Mix Worcestershire sauce and pepper in a small bowl. Spoon over each breast. Top with 1 teaspoon margarine and 1 teaspoon honey. Seal packets by bringing opposite sides of foil together and fold over several times. Fold over the other two ends of foil tightly. Pierce top of foil twice with knife to vent. Arrange packets on baking sheet. Bake for about 35 minutes. Can be assembled ahead and refrigerated for up to two days. A great do-ahead main dish for a week-end bar-b-que. Can be grilled as well. Place foil side down about 4-6 inches from heat source for about 15 minutes. Serves four.

title: Pie Crust
directions: Mix all ingredients., Makes a sticky dough., Refrigerate one hour or overnight. Use a lot of flour to roll out., Makes four 9-inch pies.

title: Turkey Bacon Club Sandwich
directions: Cut each roll lengthwise into 2 halves., Spread mayonnaise on 1/2 of each roll., Place 3 slices of cooked turkey bacon over the mayonnaise., Place tomato slices and lettuce over the turkey bacon. Serve open-faced or as a closed sandwich., Enjoy!!

title: Best Ham Sandwiches
directions: Melt butter., Add rest of ingredients; stir., Brush top and bottom of bun., Stack with ham and cheese., Wrap in foil., Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Red Cake
directions: Mix vinegar and soda and set aside., Cream sugar and shortening; add eggs., Add a little food coloring to cocoa to make a paste., Add to creamed mixture with rest of coloring., Add flour and salt, alternating with milk., Add vanilla, then vinegar and soda., Beat well., Use 2 (8-inch) round pans (greased and floured)., Bake 30 minutes at 350°., When cooked, split to make 4 layers.

title: Batter Rolls
directions: Dissolve yeast in water., Melt butter., Mix all ingredients together., Leave in refrigerator for 2 hours., Fill muffin pan 1/2 full., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

title: Cranberry Salad
directions: Dissolve jello in boiling water and let cool. Add strawberries, pineapple, cranberry sauce and pecans. Put into a 12 x 8 x 2-inch pan or mold sprayed with cooking spray. Chill until firm.

title: Mexican Taco Salad
directions: Add salt and pepper to meat., Toss all ingredients together and serve., Leftovers taste good too, only not crunchy.

title: Soft Sugar Cookies
directions: Cream oleo, Crisco and sugar; add eggs and mix., Add buttermilk., Add vanilla, baking soda and salt; mix well., Stir in flour until mixed well., Heat oven to 350°., Drop mixture by using a tablespoon on a greased cookie sheet., Bake for 13 minutes. Makes 3 to 4 dozen cookies., May ice with lemon frosting.

title: Quick Microwaved Streuseled Apples
directions: Mix first 4 ingredients and place in 8-inch glass dish., Then mix last of ingredients until crumbly., Sprinkle crumb mixture over top of apples., Microwave on High for 12 minutes., Let stand 10 minutes before serving., Can serve with ice cream or whipped topping.

title: Just Delicious Cookie
directions: Mix ingredients in order given. Shape into balls on cookie sheet., Dip a fork or glass in sugar and flatten each cookie. Bake in 350° oven for 10 to 12 minutes., Makes 100 cookies.

title: Onion Pork Chops
directions: Place chops in 9 x 9-inch baking dish., Sprinkle onion soup mix over chops., Add 1/4 cup water and bake in 425° oven for 1 hour.

title: Broccoli Salad
directions: Mix ingredients and top with dressing.

title: Banana Freeze
directions: Combine sugar and water. Boil 3 minutes. Cool., Mash bananas. Add to fruit juices and stir in sugar syrup., Pour into containers and freeze. When ready to serve, thaw slightly., Pour carbonated beverage over mixture.

title: Stuffed Cabbage
directions: Parboil cabbage to loosen leaves., Mix meat, rice, onion, egg, salt and pepper., Roll balls in cabbage leaves., Place in pan and pour mixture of soup, sauce, vinegar and sugar over., Bake at 350° for about 1 hour.

title: Heavenly Hamburger
directions: Brown meat, garlic, salt and pepper in margarine., Drain and add tomato sauce and simmer 20 minutes., Cook noodles as directed on package; drain., Soften cream cheese and add to sour cream and onions., Combine meat mixture and noodles (or lasagna) and pour into a 9 x 13-inch casserole., Sprinkle with Cheddar cheese and bake at 350° for 20 minutes., Serves 8 or more.

title: Barbecued Meatballs
directions: To make meatballs:, Combine all ingredients (mixture will be soft)., Shape into walnut size meatballs., Place meatballs in a single layer on wax paper lined cookie sheets., Freeze until solid., Store frozen meatballs in freezer bags until ready to cook., Makes approximately 80 meatballs., These are good for something rather quick., Takes approximately 1 hour baking time.

title: Cough Syrup
directions: Boil all ingredients, except honey, for about 3 minutes. Strain through cloth to remove all seeds and lemon rind., Mix well with honey., Take one warm tablespoon at a time at 1/2 hour intervals.

title: Goulash
directions: In a skillet, brown beef in the vegetable oil., When browned, add the flour and stir until flour starts to brown., Add water and stir., Add the hot sauce, Worcestershire sauce, salt and pepper. Stir well., Bring to a boil., Now add the carrots, onions, peppers and tomatoes if desired., If the sauce seems too thin at this point, you can thicken it with a bit of rue which is flour that you have heated in just a slight bit of vegetable oil or you can add just a touch of cornstarch., Once the vegetables have been added, bring to a boil once again, then cover and simmer until vegetables are tender., The longer it simmers the better it will taste., It is great served over noodles or over rice.

title: Easy Cheese Potatoes
directions: Cook potatoes with skins on until just firm., Refrigerate overnight.

title: Sausage-Egg Casserole
directions: Beat eggs until lemon colored., Add bread, sausage, etc. Pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish., Sprinkle cheese on top., Refrigerate overnight., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Uncle Joe Allen'S Salad
directions: Combine all ingredients together in large bowl., This is a great salad and easy to make.

title: Barbecue Sauce For Meatballs
directions: Cook onion, celery and pepper., Add ketchup, sugar and vinegar., Warm, then add to meatballs.

title: Cream Cheese Dip
directions: Add onion, catsup and dressing into blender or food processor. Add softened cream cheese into mixture and blend until mixed. Refrigerate for a few hours.

title: Rosamarina Salad
directions: In saucepan, mix sugar and flour; whip eggs and add to juices. Cook until it thickens., Add the macaroni and all the fruit to 3/4 container Cool Whip., Cool 2 hour.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
directions: Cook potatoes in boiling water until tender (45 minutes to 1 hour)., Let cool, peel and mash., Add 1/2 cup sugar, eggs, vanilla, milk and 1/2 cup butter to potatoes., Beat at medium speed with electric mixer until smooth., Spoon into a greased 12 x 8 x 2-inch dish., Combine remaining ingredients and sprinkle over potatoes., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Heavenly Banana Pudding
directions: Beat cream cheese and milk together., Fix pudding by directions., Mix milk mixture to pudding., Make layer of bananas, wafers and pudding mixture or put pudding mixture on the bottom of 9 x 10-inch pan., Put bananas and wafers in, then to finish, put a layer of Cool Whip on top., Cool for 1 hour before serving.

title: Chili Rice
directions: Saute onion in oil in 2-quart boiler., Add rice, salt and chili powder., Pour in broth plus enough water to make 16 ounces liquid., Bring to, boil and then cover and simmer until rice is done.

title: Aunt Janet'S Hamburger Casserole
directions: Brown hamburger, onion and celery in skillet; drain fat., Pour hamburger into baking dish, 2 1/2-quart dish., Add 3 cups boiling water, rice and dry vegetable soup., Cook 1 hour at 350°.

title: Barbecue Meatballs
directions: Mix first 4 ingredients., Roll into balls., Put into 9 x 13-inch pan or baking dish., Mix other ingredients and pour over meatballs., Bake at 325° for 45 minutes or until juice is cooked up.

title: Happy Life Recipe
directions: Take Love and Loyalty, mix it thoroughly with Faith., Blend it with Tenderness, Kindness and Understanding., Add Friendship and Hope, sprinkle abundantly with Laughter., Bake it with sunshine.

title: Hot Olive Cheese Puffs
directions: Blend cheese with margarine., Stir flour with salt and paprika and mix well., Wrap 1 tablespoon of mix around each olive. Completely cover the olive., Freeze in a plastic bag., To serve, place frozen puffs on ungreased cookie sheet and bake in 400° oven for 10 to 15 minutes until golden., Olives will be quite hot. Serve on toothpicks.

title: Strawberry Cake
directions: Mix the first four ingredients together., Add the strawberries., Bake in 3 round cake pans at 350° for 25 minutes or until done., Cool before frosting.

title: Mixed Fruit Pies
directions: Mix, milk and lemon juice; add other ingredients., Pour in crusts., Chill for 4 hours.

title: Chicken And Sausage Jambalaya
directions: Saute onion, green pepper and celery in oil over low heat. Add garlic and parsley., Remove from pot., Brown chicken slowly in remaining oil., Add bouillon, vegetables, rice, salt, cayenne pepper, Worcestershire and water., Cook over low heat 1 hour., Add sausage., Add more water, if necessary, and correct salt.

title: Cherries In The Snow
directions: Cream the cream cheese with the sugar., Add milk and mix well., Combine with the thawed topping., Remove the brown crumbs from angel food cake., Break or cut the cake into small pieces. Mix cake with the creamed mixture., Combine cherry pie filling with almond flavoring., Swirl into cake mixture., Pour into a 9 x 13-inch dish or serve from a pretty crystal bowl.

title: Brownies #2
directions: Cream sugar and margarine., Add eggs one at a time., Add chocolate syrup, nuts and flour., Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Cream Cheese Bars
directions: Mix together cake mix, oleo, egg and vanilla., Put into a greased, and, floured 9 x 13-inch metal pan., Cream together cream cheese, powdered sugar, eggs, pecans and vanilla.	Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

title: Polk Salad
directions: Gather polk greens in spring of year., Look and wash well. Parboil greens; rinse., Boil again., Put 2 tablespoons of soda in water, rinse well., Squeeze out all the water you can., Put greens and cut up onion in skillet with fair amount of Crisco., Cook until onion is translucent., I like to scramble 3 or 4 eggs, then mix with cooked greens.

title: Hidden Valley Ranch Quiche
directions: Preheat oven to 400°., Sprinkle cheese in pie crust., Whisk eggs until frothy., Add other ingredients and mix., Pour over cheese., Bake at 15 minutes., Reduce heat to 350° and bake an additional 15 to 20 minutes or until center is set.

title: Lemon Lush
directions: Mix., Spread over mix., Top with remainder of Cool Whip before serving., Refrigerate.

title: Onion Mushroom Rice
directions: In a 2-quart saucepan over high heat, bring to boiling soup mix, rice and water., Reduce heat., Cover and simmer 25 minutes until tender, stirring occasionally., Stir in green onions, if used., Yields 4 servings.

title: Poppy Seed Cake
directions: Make cake as directed on box; add poppy seed to cake mix. Stir and bake as directed., Poke holes in cake and add in holes caramel syrup., Top with Cool Whip and crushed up candy bars.

title: Baneberry Tarts
directions: Combine butter and sugar. Mix in egg yolks, flour, and vanilla. Roll balls the size of marbles. Indent with your thumb and fill with a dab of jelly. Bake at 350 for 10 - 12 minutes.

title: Buttermilk Doughnuts
directions: Heat 3 to 4-inches of oil to 375° in deep fryer., Measure 1 1/2 cups flour and the remaining ingredients in a large bowl. Blend 1/2 minute on low speed, scraping bowl occasionally., Stir in remaining flour. Turn dough onto well floured surface. Roll around lightly to coat with flour., Gently roll dough 3/8-inch thick., Cut with floured doughnut cutter. With wide spatula, slide doughnuts into hot fryer. Turn doughnuts as they rise to surface. Fry 2 to 3 minutes or until golden brown. Carefully remove from oil., Drain., Serve plain, sugared or frosted. Makes 2 dozen.

title: Zucchini Squares
directions: Mix all together., Spread into a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish., Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes, until brown., Let cool, cut into squares.

title: Baked Creole Eggplant
directions: Parboil eggplant; drain., Saute onion, celery and shrimp in butter in skillet., Add tomato., Cook to desired consistency., Add salt, pepper, Tabasco sauce, Worcestershire sauce and bay leaf. Add eggplant., Spoon into 4 x 7-inch baking dish., Top with bread crumbs., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes., Yields 8 servings.

title: Dirty Rice
directions: Place chicken parts in large saucepan with water to cover. Cook over medium-high until tender., Remove from saucepan and dice meat, reserving cooking liquid., Fry sausage., Dice or chop., In 2 teaspoons of sausage fat, saute chopped onion, pepper and celery until almost tender; then add scallion., Cook few minutes more. Add ham, sausage, chopped chicken, butter and parsley to pan., Add the reserved liquid from cooking to chicken; season with salt and pepper., Simmer 15 minutes before blending into rice., Serves 4 to 5 people.

title: Ham And Cheese Quiche
directions: Combine eggs, half and half and cheese., Cook ham slice and cut into small cubes., Add to mixture., Add parsley and garlic powder. Mix well., Pour into pie crust., Bake at 375° for approximately 1 hour., When done, middle should be raised and browned lightly. Cover pie crust edge with foil to keep from overbrowning.

title: Instant Spice Tea
directions: Crush red hots to powder., Mix to all other ingredients., Keep in a closed container., Add 2 to 3 heaping teaspoonfuls to 1 cup boiling water.

title: Pumpkin Muffins
directions: Have all ingredients at room temperature., Cream butter, sugar and pumpkin until smooth., Add eggs., Blend well., Sift flour, baking powder and spices together and add alternately with milk to egg batter., Do not overmix., Fold in nuts and raisins., Sprinkle a little cinnamon sugar on top before baking., Bake in greased muffin tins at 375° for 25 minutes or until done., Do not open oven door while baking or muffins will have a tendency to fall. Equal amount of mashed sweet potatoes may be substituted for the pumpkin., May be frozen and reheated., Yield:, 2 dozen.

title: Fried Zucchini
directions: Slice zucchini., Roll in flour, then roll in milk/egg mixture. Roll in bread crumb/Bay seasoning mixture., Let set 1 hour before frying in canola oil.

title: Seven Layer Salad
directions: Layer ingredients, starting with lettuce and ending with bacon.

title: Mini Morsel Cookies
directions: In a medium bowl, combine flour, baking powder and salt., In a large bowl, combine 1 cup sugar and vegetable oil., Mix well. Beat in eggs and vanilla. Gradually stir in flour mixture. Stir in mini morsels (do not use whole bag, it will be more than you need). Shape into balls. Roll in remaining 1/4 cup sugar. Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes on ungreased cookie sheet.

title: Beef Stew - Oven Baked
directions: Put meat in roaster., Add onion soup mix; sprinkle on., Add potatoes, onions and carrots., Mix together cream of celery soup, water and catsup., Pour over stew., Bake, covered, for 2 to 3 hours.

title: Veggie Dip
directions: Combine ingredients; serve with veggies., Especially good with raw cauliflower.

title: Strawberry Cheese Salad
directions: Dissolve jello in water., Put in blender or food processor. Add cheese in 1-inch cubes., Blend until smooth., Stir in berries and nuts., Pour into mold., As jello begins to thicken, stir to distribute fruit and nuts evenly.

title: Fried Catfish
directions: Mix together flour, salt, pepper and other seasonings with corn meal., Fry in hot oil until brown.

title: Pralines
directions: Mix first 3 ingredients and bring them to a boil., Brown the 1/3 cup sugar; add to first mixture while cooking to soft ball stage., Drop on oil paper.

title: Rolls
directions: Add dry yeast to warm water., Add sugar and egg to yeast and water; add Crisco and flour., Mix until smooth., Turn into large bowl., Cover tightly., Refrigerate 12 hours., Take out and knead lightly., Pat out 1-inch thick and cut out., Place on buttered pan and butter top., Let rise at room temperature about 1 hour., Bake at 500° for 12 to 15 minutes until brown.

title: Apricot Bread
directions: Mix cream cheese, 1/3 cup sugar, 1 tablespoon flour and 1 egg with orange flavoring and rind and set aside., Cover apricots in warm water and soak for 30 minutes., Drain apricots and cut them in small pieces., Cream sugar and butter., Add egg., Add water and juice.

title: Chinese Pepper Steak
directions: Slice the meat diagonally against the grain into 1/8-inch strips., Heat a large nonstick or regular skillet (use 1 tablespoon of oil) and brown the steak quickly over high heat. Push aside.

title: Breakfast Casserole
directions: Fry sausage; drain and crumble into a greased 9 x 13-inch casserole dish. Sprinkle cheese over sausage. Mix well the remaining ingredients; pour over sausage mixture. Bake at 400° for 25 to 30 minutes, until set and browned on top. Cool 5 minutes before slicing.

title: Waldorf Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients in a large bowl; chill., Cover bowl with plastic wrap.

title: Orange Sour Cream Cookie Frosting
directions: Combine all ingredients, beating well until spreading consistency., Place 1/4 teaspoon frosting on each warm cookie.

title: Hot Island Splash
directions: Combine both ingredients; heat until boiling., Serve hot. Garnish with lemon slices.

title: Austria Viennese Noodles
directions: Cook noodles in boiling salt water until done., Drain well. Saute onions, green pepper and celery in 1/4 cup butter., Add to noodles with salt, pepper and parsley flakes; stir well., Blend in sour cream and lemon juice., Place in buttered casserole; top with crumbs, blended with remaining butter., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes., Makes 8 servings.

title: Hush Puppies
directions: Mix all ingredients., Drop by teaspoon into hot cooking oil. Cook until golden brown, about 3 minutes., Makes 24.

title: Jello-Sour Cream Dessert
directions: Make jello using boiling water, add strawberries, bananas, and crushed pineapple. Put half mixture into a 9 inch square pan, chill until firm. Spread with the sour cream and add the rest of the jello mixture. Chill till firm. Cut into square to serve.

title: Cream Puffs(With Cream Filling)
directions: Combine butter or margarine, salt and water. Heat to boiling. Sift flour and measure. Add to boiling mixture. Beat vigorously until mixture leaves sides of saucepan and does not cling to spoon.

title: Macaroni And Cheese Pie
directions: Cook macaroni as directed., Meanwhile, grate the cheese, set aside., Combine milk, eggs, salt and pepper, swish lightly until smooth.

title: Graham Cracker Cookies
directions: Butter 10 x 15 pan. Fill with graham crackers, broken apart. Bring to a boil butter and sugar and boil for 2 minutes. No more. Add pecans and pour over crackers. Bake at 325° for 10 to 12 minutes. Separate with fork and put on foil at once. Keep in Tupperware container in refrigerator. Keeps up to 2 to 3 weeks. Do not freeze.

title: Brownies
directions: Mix as for drop cookies., Bake in greased 9 x 13-inch pan for 30 minutes or until done. Frost with chocolate frosting.

title: Fancy Franks
directions: Slice each hot dog in half lengthwise., In small bowl, crumble onion rings., Reserve 2 tablespoons for topping., Combine potatoes, butter, crumbled onions, salt and pepper in shallow 1 1/2-quart casserole dish and blend well., Combine soup and milk in small bowl., Pour 3/4 soup mixture over potato mixture and blend. Arrange hot dogs, cut side down, on top of potatoes., Sprinkle with reserved crumbs., Pour remaining soup mixture over onions. Bake 25 minutes at 375°., Serves 4.

title: Milk Chocolate Fudge
directions: Combine butter, evaporated milk, sugar and salt in medium, heavy saucepan., Bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring constantly. Boil for 4 to 5 minutes, stirring constantly., Remove from heat.

title: Oriental Salad
directions: Tear lettuce into bite-sized pieces., Dice bacon and fry crisp., Remove bacon from pan and lightly brown almonds in the bacon fat., Drain on paper towels; blot excess fat away., Combine sugar, vinegar, lemon juice, paprika, celery seed, honey, onion, mustard and salt in saucepan., Heat until sugar is dissolved, stirring constantly., Cool slightly and pour into a jar with tight lid., Add oil and shake well., Combine lettuce, oranges, bacon and almonds in serving bowl., Pour warm dressing over salad just before serving.

title: Quick Trick Fudge
directions: Bring first 4 ingredients to a full boil., Boil 10 minutes, stirring constantly., Add vanilla and beat until thick.

title: Sante Fe Style Chicken Breasts
directions: Cut avocado into large dice., Combine with tomatoes, onion and cilantro., Sprinkle with 2 tablespoons lime juice., Add salt and pepper if desired., Toss gently., Refrigerate, covered, until ready to serve., Melt butter in a skillet and saute the garlic., Lightly brown chicken on each side, then remove to a plate., To drippings in skillet, add marmalade, chili powder, salt, pepper and remaining lime juice., Return chicken to skillet and coat with glaze., Simmer until cooked through., Serve with guacamole.

title: Fresh Vegetable Casserole
directions: Saute onions in butter until golden., Separate into rings, if desired., Add pepper rings and cook until tender., Combine ingredients in a 2-quart shallow casserole and toss lightly. Cover and bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours or until vegetables are tender, stirring once.

title: Dump Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients together, chill, and serve.

title: Potato Patties
directions: Add chopped onion to mashed potatoes., Form into patties. Brush with butter., Fry in butter greased frying pan until golden on each side.

title: Hamburger Casserole
directions: Brown meat and onion; drain and set aside., Mix soups, Ro-Tel and chili powder together., Place Doritos in a casserole dish. Put meat and onion on top of that., Pour mixture on top of meat. Top with grated cheese., Bake at 350° until bubbly and serve.

title: Chocolate Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Boil sugar, milk, cocoa and butter 4 to 5 minutes., Add vanilla, peanut butter and oatmeal., Drop off on waxed paper to cool.

title: Honey Butter Chicken
directions: Toss chicken in your favorite coating., Melt 1/2 cup butter in roasting pan., Roll chicken in butter., Arrange in pan skin side down., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes., Melt 1/4 cup butter with honey and lemon juice., Turn chicken skin side up and drizzle with honey mixture., Bake another 30 to 40 minutes, basting occasionally., Serve with steamed rice.

title: Biscotti Di Prato
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Place almonds in shallow pan and bake until golden brown (8 to 10 minutes)., Let cool., Reduce oven to 300°., In small bowl, whisk together the eggs, vanilla and extract. In mixing bowl, combine the flour, sugar, baking soda and salt. Add egg mixture and mix until blended, about 1 minute., Cut almonds in half and mix in., Divide dough in half., On greased and floured baking sheet, pat out dough into 2 logs, about 1/2-inch high, 1 1/2-inches wide and 12-inches long, spacing them about 2 inches apart., Bake at 300° for 40 to 50 minutes or until golden brown. Transfer to wire rack., Cool 5 minutes.

title: Ground Beef Ragout(With Pate Grand-Pere - Dumplings)
directions: Cook beef in margarine., Add onion, salt and pepper., Brown, stirring often., Add other ingredients, mix, cover, and let simmer., Prepare dumplings (pate grand-pere).

title: Apple Pork Chops
directions: Brown pork chops on both sides in hot fat., Place apple slices in greased baking dish., Sprinkle with butter or margarine. Top with browned chops, Cover. Bake in 400° oven for 1 hour and 30 minutes., Serves 3 to 4.

title: Queso Napolitano(Cream Cheese Flan)
directions: Heat sugar in skillet over medium-high heat until melted, clear and light brown, stirring occasionally., Spoon syrup over bottom and around sides of 1 1/2-quart baking dish., Set aside.

title: Pizza Hot Dish
directions: Brown ground beef; cook macaroni., Mix all but pizza sauce and mozzarella cheese together., Place in a 9 x 13 pan, pour pizza sauce over the top, then sprinkle the mozzarella cheese over the pizza sauce., Bake 350° for 30 minutes., Cover with foil until the last 10 minutes., A can of mushrooms can be added to the meat mixture if desired.

title: Tea Cakes
directions: Preheat oven to 400°., Mix margarine, sugar and vanilla., Add flour gradually and mix well., Chill dough., Form into 1-inch balls and place on ungreased baking sheet., Bake 10 to 12 minutes until set, not brown., Roll in confectioners sugar while warm.

title: Rosy Glow Punch
directions: Combine cranberry juice cocktail and concentrate., Stir well; chill., Just before serving, pour into a 4 quart punch bowl., Add scoops of sherbet., Slowly add ginger ale., Makes about 50 (1/2 cup or 4 ounce) servings.

title: Shells, Cheese And Tomato Macaroni
directions: Cook shells for 14 minutes; drain., Mix everything else together and add to drained shells., Pour into greased baking dish., Bake about 1 hour at 350°.

title: Coconut Eggnog
directions: Simmer first 4 ingredients., Mix 1 cup into eggs., Mix back into pan., Stir over low heat 5 minutes to thicken., Strain and chill., Add nutmeg, if desired.

title: Vegetable Soup
directions: Bring water to a boil., Add cubes, garlic powder and pepper. Next, add onion, celery, carrots and cabbage., Boil gently until vegetables are tender., Add tomatoes; boil gently until all is heated and serve.

title: Scalloped Potatoes Supreme
directions: In greased baking dish or 2-quart casserole, alternate layers of potatoes, peppers and onion., Combine remaining ingredients. Pour over., Cover; bake at 350° for 45 minutes., Uncover and bake 20 to 30 minutes longer or until potatoes are tender., Serves 8.

title: Cream Candy
directions: Cook in open kettle or heavy pan. Put sugar, salt and boiling water in pan; stir over low heat until dissolved. (Don't let boil at this time.) Add cream; stir only one time. When candy starts boiling, cut butter in slices and drop into candy. Cook until it says crack on the thermometer (290 degrees). Pour on buttered marble or dish. Pour 2 tsp. vanilla on candy. Pull candy when cool.

title: Slow Cooker Barbecue Pot Roast
directions: Brown meat in hot oil in skillet then transfer to slow cooker., Add sauce, green pepper, and onion. Cover and cook on high heat for 4 to 5 hours or until tender. Slice and serve with sauce.

title: Mixed Cut Green Bean Casserole
directions: Cook cauliflower in salted water according to package., Drain. Arrange in a buttered 1-quart casserole., Drain beans, reserving 1/2 cup liquid., Add drained beans to casserole., Melt butter in small saucepan., Stir in flour., Add reserved 1/2 cup liquid, milk, onion, salt and hot sauce., Cook and stir over medium-low heat until sauce thickens., Pour over vegetables in casserole. Garnish with pimento., Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Heavenly Hamburger
directions: Brown ground beef and onion in a skillet., Drain, then add cream of mushroom soup, tomato soup, salt, pepper and garlic salt. Simmer this for 20 minutes., Add cream cheese and sour cream; stir this together until cream cheese is melted and mix is well blended., Cook macaroni and drain., Layer macaroni and mixture in a casserole dish., Top with cheese., Bake for 20 minutes at 350°.

title: Brownies
directions: Cream margarine and sugar., Add eggs; beat., Add remaining ingredients except nutmeats., Beat thoroughly., Fold in nutmeats. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

title: Great Pumpkin Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Combine flour, oats, baking soda, cinnamon and salt; set aside., Cream butter; gradually add sugars, beating until light and fluffy., Add egg and vanilla; mix well. Alternate additions of dry ingredients and pumpkin, mixing well after each addition., Stir in morsels.

title: Fat Free T'S Easy Lasagna
directions: Brown and drain meat., Add spaghetti sauce, onions and green pepper., Add enough spaghetti sauce to make thinner than usual. Cook slowly until well blended., Combine grated Mozzarella cheese with cottage cheese and Egg Beaters., In a 9 x 13-inch pan spread a thin layer of the meat mixture, then the uncooked lasagna noodles., Top with meat mixture and a layer of cheese mixture. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese., Continue layering and end with Parmesan cheese topping., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Wontons(Appetizers)
directions: Brown meat and onion; drain fat., Add rest of ingredients, except wonton skins., Put mixture each skin., Fold in triangle. Wet edges with cold water to seal., Fry in 1-inch hot oil until golden brown, 30 to 60 seconds., Drain on paper towel., Freeze if you wish.

title: Mel'S Beer Cheese Soup
directions: In a large heavy Dutch oven, melt the butter. Mix in flour until smooth., Cook 5 minutes, stirring constantly, over medium heat., Blend in the hot chicken broth with wire whip., Add the cheese and stir until blended., Pour in whipping cream. Incorporate well., Add Worcestershire and beer., Cook over low heat, stirring until thick and smooth, 15 to 20 minutes., Serve with croutons, bits of ham, freeze dried chives or a sprinkling of parsley.

title: Cranberry Pie
directions: Preheat oven to 325°., Spread cranberries over 10-inch greased pie plate., Sprinkle with 1/2 cup sugar and nuts over cranberries. In bowl beat eggs well., Add remaining 1 cup sugar; beat until thoroughly mixed., Add flour and melted butter., Beat well., Pour batter over cranberries., Bake 1 hour at 325°.

title: Pineapple Coconut Pie
directions: Mix, together, all ingredients and pour into pie crusts. Bake at 375° for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Hamburger Noodle Casserole
directions: Brown meat and onion., Drain fat and run hot tap water over meat., Using a colander makes this easy., Combine meat mixture, soups and corn; heat thoroughly., Add noodles and it's ready to serve.

title: Spicy Eggplant Relish(Caponata)
directions: In a 12-inch skillet, heat 1/2 cup oil and add eggplant., Cook for 10 to 15 minutes., Remove with slotted spoon to a plate. Place the rest of the oil into the skillet and add the celery and onion; cook about 7 minutes., Add eggplant and the remaining ingredients, and simmer about 20 minutes, until eggplant is tender but holds its shape., (Stir gently now and then.), Can be kept covered in refrigerator for two weeks or stored in the freezer for one month., Bring to room temperature to serve.

title: Squash Casserole
directions: Mix ingredients in the order given, pour into an oiled 2 qt. casserole dish and bake at 350 degrees for 40 minutes., Top with the additional buttered crumbs and bake 20 minutes longer or until center is firm.

title: Friendship Salad
directions: Blend in understanding and good measure., Mix faith and sportsmanship in all pleasure., Add for seasoning a pinch of humor and wit., A few grains of kindness won't hurt a bit., Use confidence and courage, let none go to waste., Mix in a bowl with oil of love to taste., Serve as many as you can handle, but remember to serve yourself as well.

title: Apple Cinnamon Rice
directions: Combine juice and water in medium saucepan; bring to a boil. Add rice and cinnamon stick., Cover., Reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes or until liquid is absorbed., Yields 3 cups.

title: Strawberry Cream Pie
directions: In top of double boiler, blend together sugar, flour, salt and milk., Beat eggs and vanilla., Place over boiling water and stir until thick., Set aside until cold., Cover crust with a layer of sliced strawberries., Top with filling and refrigerate to chill. Spoon whipped cream around edge of filling., In center, put whole berries.

title: Spicy Oatmeal Cake
directions: Heat oven to 350°., In small saucepan, add water and 1 stick margarine; bring to boil., Add oatmeal; turn off with lid on., In large bowl, add sugars and eggs; mix., Add oatmeal mixture., Mix. Add flour, baking soda, spices and salt; mix., Put in dripping pan; bake at 350° for about 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Tassies
directions: Blend first four ingredients thoroughly., Divide into 24 equal parts and form into balls., Place a ball into each of 24 miniature muffin pans., Press thumb into each ball to make a shell., Beat with a fork the next 4 ingredients until blended., Place a few ground nuts in each shell and pour filling over each., Bake 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Party Spinach Dip(Low-Fat)
directions: Process cottage cheese in a blender until smooth., Press spinach between paper towels until almost dry., Put cottage cheese, spinach and remaining ingredients into a bowl., Blend well, folding ingredients together., Cover and refrigerate 3 hours., Yields 3 cups., Has 14 calories and a trace of fat per tablespoon.

title: Candy Store Cake
directions: Cream together sugar and butter. Blend in remaining ingredients., Pour batter into a buttered and floured angel food tube pan., Bake at 350° for 1 hour to 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Balls
directions: Mix together and chill for about an hour and roll into balls. Leave on a plate or cookie sheet in refrigerator for easy snacking.

title: Daiquiri Pie
directions: Place gelatine, pudding and sugar in saucepan; stir in 1/2 cup water and the eggs., Blend well. Add remaining water; stir over medium heat until mixture comes to full boil., Remove from heat and stir in rum., Chill thoroughly., Fold Cool Whip into chilled mixture and spoon into graham cracker or chocolate crust.

title: Baked Beans
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., Combine all ingredients and pour into baking dish., Cook for 15 minutes., Reduce heat to 250°; continue baking for 2 to 3 hours., Remove from oven long enough to sprinkle top with 6 strips of bacon cut in strips., Allow to cook 1 hour or until bacon curls and is crisp.

title: Pineapple Layered Salad
directions: Beat, egg, yolks; add 1 cup syrup from pineapple, sugar and flour., Cook until thick., Arrange in layers in bowl with a, layer of pineapple, a layer of marshmallows, grated cheese, then sauce. Repeat., Serve at room temperature., Serves 6.

title: Pimento Loaf
directions: Soak bread in milk; mix with other ingredients and cook 30 to 40 minutes at 350°., Serve hot.

title: Cauliflower Au Gratin
directions: Mix cheese, mayonnaise and mustard until melted., Pour over cooked cauliflower.

title: Hamburger Casserole
directions: Mix ingredients together and put tiny Tater Tots on top., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Heath Bar Cake
directions: Bake cake as usual following directions., Let cake cool., Poke holes in cooled cake, large enough for caramel to fill., After cake is cool, pour evaporated milk, then pour caramel into the holes., Cover cake with Cool Whip., Chop up Heath bars and sprinkle on top of cake., Refrigerate before serving.

title: Cheese Biscuits
directions: Mix Bisquick, milk and cheese. Drop by spoonful onto ungreased baking sheet. Bake at 400° for 15 minutes until golden brown.

title: Finger Jello
directions: Stir all ingredients together; pour in pan., When set, cut into squares or use cookie cutters.

title: Cry Babies (Cookies)
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Cream butter and sugar., Add molasses and egg., Beat until smooth., Stir together flour, baking soda and ginger., Add to creamed mixture alternately with milk., Drop by teaspoonful onto greased cookie sheet., Bake until lightly browned, about 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Green Bean Dish
directions: Combine all ingredients and mix well in casserole dish., Put grated cheese on top or you can use canned onions., Bake at 350° for about 20 minutes.

title: Cheese Cake Delight
directions: Roll the zwieback into fine crumbs and mix with the melted butter or margarine and 1/2 cup of the sugar., Pack all but 1/2 cup of this mixture on the bottom and sides of a well-greased 9-inch pan.

title: Chocolate Marshmallow Slices
directions: In medium saucepan, over low heat, melt chocolate chips and butter, stirring constantly, until blended., Remove from heat; cool 5 minutes., Stir in marshmallows and 1 cup nuts; do not melt marshmallows.

title: Microwave Caramel Corn
directions: Mix and place in microwave., Bring to a boil and boil 2 minutes on High., Add 1/2 teaspoon baking soda., Pour half popcorn in a brown paper bag and pour half the syrup over it., Add remaining popcorn and syrup.	Fold top of bag and shake well or gently stir with large, long handled spoon., Microwave 1 1/2 minutes on High. Take out and shake well., Cook another 1 1/2 minutes on High. Remove and shake well., Spread on cookie sheets to cool.

title: German Pfannkuchen
directions: Beat eggs., Add 1 cup milk and continue beating., Then add flour sifted with the salt, sugar and then rest of the milk., This will be a thin batter., Heat iron frying pan fairly hot with a tablespoon of melted butter in the bottom., Pour 2 or 3 tablespoons of the batter into the pan and roll it from side to side until bottom is covered., When top is set, dot with a teaspoon of butter and flip it over with a pancake turner to finish cooking., It is good served with butter and sugar rolled up and eaten with a fork. Applesauce, thick, is also good on these pancakes.

title: Lemon Chicken On Escarole
directions: Wash escarole thoroughly and boil down., Saute minced garlic in olive oil in frypan., Cut up cooked escarole some before simmering with garlic., (This can be done ahead of time.), Salt while cooking.

title: Wesley'S Biscuits
directions: Melt shortening in pan which biscuits will be baked., Leave enough melted shortening in the pan to turn the biscuits., Add remaining melted shortening with other ingredients and mix well.

title: Low-Fat Fusilli Fruit Salad
directions: Cook pasta according to package directions, omitting salt and fat., Drain; rinse with cold water and drain again., Drain pineapple, reserving 2 tablespoons juice., Combine pasta, pineapple chunks, cantaloupe and grapes in a medium bowl., Cover and chill., Combine yogurt and reserved 2 tablespoons pineapple juice in a small bowl, stirring well., Cover yogurt mixture and chill.

title: Ground Beef And Vegetable Soup
directions: Slowly brown ground beef with chopped onion and smashed garlic clove. Drain and put in large pan with soups, tomato paste, herbs, salt, pepper and 2 to 3 cups of water. Add more chopped onion and garlic. Slice cabbage thinly and add along with carrots and green pepper. Simmer for about 1/2 hour. Leave skin on potatoes, cut into quarters and add to soup along with macaroni; simmer for another 1/2 hour. You will need to add water once in awhile as the soup cooks.

title: Easy Garden Vegetable Pie
directions: Mix thawed and drained broccoli, onion, green peppers and cheese in a greased 10 inch pie plate., Beat remaining ingredients until smooth, about one minute with hand beater. Pour into pie plate., Bake until golden brown, about 35-40 minutes at 400°., Let stand 5 minutes before cutting.

title: Layered Pudding Dessert
directions: Spread half of the crushed wafers in the bottom of a greased 8 inch square pan. Prepare pudding mix according to package directions, spoon hot pudding over the wafers. Slice one banana; place over pudding. Top with remaining crumbs. Chill for one hour. Meanwhile, prepare gelatin according to package directions; chill for 30 minutes or until partially set. Pour over crumbs. Slice the remaining banana and place over gelatin. Spread whipped topping over all. Chill for at least 2 hours. Serves: 9.

title: Crab Au Gratin Dip
directions: Pick carefully through the crab for pieces of shell. Blend the cream cheese, mustard, Worcestershire sauce and mayo until smooth. Fold in the crab., Spread in a 9-inch Pyrex pie plate., Sprinkle lightly with paprika., Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes until browned and bubbly., Serve over crackers.

title: New Potatoes And Peas
directions: In a 4-quart saucepan, place potatoes., Add water to cover potatoes., Over high heat, heat to boiling., Reduce heat to medium., Cook 8 minutes or until potatoes are fork-tender., Drain in colander.

title: Vegetable Casserole
directions: Combine all ingredients, except crackers. Pour into baking dish. Crumble 1 roll of crackers and mix with 1/2 cup melted butter or margarine. Sprinkle generously on top of vegetables. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes until brown.

title: Potato Soup
directions: Mix hash browns, onion and margarine together, then add 2 cans water. Cook 20 minutes. Add remaining ingredients., Heat to simmer.

title: Chicken And Stuffing Casserole
directions: Place chicken breasts in oblong pan., Mix together soups and water., Heat., Pour over chicken., Top with cheese and stuffing mix., Bake at 325° for 45 minutes., Pat topping down into soup mixture., Bake 15 minutes more.

title: Twice-Baked Potatoes
directions: Scrub potatoes and dry., Pierce with a fork., Bake at 350° for 1 hour., Remove from oven., Cool to handle., Cut in half lengthwise; remove pulp to bowl carefully; keep skin whole., Mash pulp with cottage cheese, salt and pepper., Scoop mixture back into skins., Sprinkle with paprika and parsley and bake 20 minutes more.

title: Fig Bars
directions: Drain figs, reserving syrup. Mash figs well, adding in a little bit of the reserved syrup.

title: Caramel Corn
directions: In saucepan, combine brown sugar, corn syrup, butter, cream of tartar and salt., Bring to boil over medium heat, stirring constantly., Bring to hard ball stage, 260°., Remove from heat; stir in baking soda, stirring quickly., Pour over freshly popped corn in large pan., Bake 1 hour at 200°., Stir occasionally., Turn onto waxed paper and break apart.

title: Grammie'S Banana Bread
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Mix well by hand, you don't have to be afraid of overmixing., Pour into loaf pan and let set 1 minute. Bake at 350° for 60 to 75 minutes., Cool before cutting.

title: Ragu
directions: Saute onion, carrot and celery in olive oil for 15 to 20 minutes. Add meat, cook and crumble. Add white wine to mixture and continue to cook (with lid on loosely) for 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Add tomato sauce, salt to taste and basil. Lightly cover and cook for several hours more. Serve with pasta.

title: Swiss Mocha
directions: Stir ingredients together and place in blender until mixture is powdered., Place in an airtight container or a pretty jar. Yields 1 cup., Use 2 rounded teaspoons to 1 cup boiling water.

title: Cocktail Sauce For Shrimp
directions: Mix all ingredients., Serve with boiled shrimp.

title: Pronto Hominy
directions: Make cream sauce with the first 8 ingredients; when thick add cheese., Mix in well-drained hominy and undrained chilies., Pour into buttered casserole., Sprinkle with paprika., Bake, uncovered, 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Frozen Cherry Salad
directions: Let cream cheese stand to room temperature., Beat until fluffy and blend in sour cream, salt and sugar., Fold in fruit, nuts and marshmallows., Pour into loaf pan or jello mold., Freeze overnight or 6 hours.

title: Butterscotch Crispies
directions: Preheat oven to 350°. Sift flour, baking soda and salt onto waxed paper. Cream margarine and brown sugar with electric mixer at medium speed in large bowl until fluffy. Beat in eggs, 1 at a time, until fluffy. Stir in vanilla. Add flour mixture, 1/3 at a time, until well blended. Stir in rolled oats, rice cereal and walnuts. Drop by teaspoonfuls, about 1-inch apart, onto large cookie sheets, lightly sprayed with nonstick cooking spray. Bake 10 minutes or until cookies are firm and lightly golden. Remove to wire racks; cool.

title: Double Peanut Cookie Bars
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., In hot oven, melt margarine in 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan., Remove from oven., Stir in crumbs; spread evenly in bottom of pan., Pour sweetened condensed milk evenly over crumbs., Sprinkle with a layer of peanut butter flavored pieces, layer of chocolate pieces and then peanuts., Press peanuts gently into mixture., Bake 25 minutes or until edges are golden brown., Chill at least 1 hour before cutting bars., Makes 36 bars.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Combine all ingredients, blending well., Spoon into buttered casserole dish., Crush Ritz crackers and sprinkle on top to cover. Dot with butter, bake at 350° until bubbly.

title: Parmesan Vegetables
directions: In large bowl, break broccoli and cauliflower into bite size pieces., Combine with onion., In small bowl, combine sugar, cheese, salt, basil and mayonnaise., Mix well., Toss vegetables and dressing., Refrigerate overnight., Just before serving, add remaining ingredients., Toss lightly.

title: Sweet Potato And Banana Casserole
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., Peel potatoes; cut crosswise into 1-inch slices., Place in pot; cover with water and bring to a boil., Reduce heat slightly; cook for 15 to 20 minutes, or until tender., Drain., Peel bananas; cut in half once lengthwise and cut twice crosswise., Toss with lemon juice., Place cooked potatoes and bananas in a shallow roasting pan., Sprinkle with brown sugar, nutmeg and salt., Drizzle with rum and melted butter., Cover and bake for 30 minutes., Remove from oven and puree potatoes, bananas and liquid in a food processor until fairly smooth, leaving a bit of texture., Pour into an ovenproof casserole and cover with aluminum foil., Bake in a 350° oven for 15 to 20 minutes., Serves 10 to 12.

title: Mom'S Peach Pie
directions: Beat egg white until foamy; brush over bottom and side of pastry., In small bowl, combine flour and sugars; cut butter into mixture until it resembles fine crumbs., Sprinkle 2/3 of mixture in bottom of crust; top with peaches., Sprinkle with remaining crumb mixture., Bake at 375° for 40 to 45 minutes or until filling is bubbly and peaches are tender., Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Shrimp Dip
directions: Mix all ingredients, except shrimp, only using a sprinkle of cayenne pepper., Rinse shrimp in cold water and drain; fold into mixture of other ingredients.

title: Black Chocolate Cake
directions: Sift sugar, cocoa, flour and salt together., Add eggs, vanilla and margarine., Boil 2 cups water; remove from heat., Add 2 teaspoons baking soda., Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Giant Crisp Chocolate Chip Cookies
directions: Mix flour, baking soda and salt and set aside., Cream butter until fluffy and beat in sugar, egg and vanilla., Stir in remaining ingredients., Shape into 2-inch balls., Place 3 inches apart on an ungreased cookie sheet., Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes or until lightly brown., Let cookies remain on sheet until they are firm., Makes 21 (4-inch) cookies., (For softer cookies, add an additional 1/2 cup flour.)

title: Peanut Butter Cake
directions: Cook margarine, water, peanut butter and vegetable oil until it comes to a boil, then add flour, sugar, milk, eggs, vanilla and soda., Grease and flour pans., Bake on 18 x 13-inch cookie sheets. Makes 2., Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Swedish Meatballs
directions: Meatballs:, Mix hamburger, milk, soup mix and 1 tablespoon Worcestershire sauce together by hand., Form into meatballs and place on broiler pan., Broil 12 to 15 minutes (or until done).

title: Brownie Pudding Cake
directions: Stir together flour, 1/4 cup sugar, 1 tablespoon cocoa powder and baking powder., Add milk, oil and vanilla. Stir until smooth. Stir in nuts. Transfer batter to a 1-quart casserole. Combine the 1/3 cup sugar and remaining cocoa powder. Gradually stir in boiling water., Pour evenly over batter., Bake in a 350° oven about 30 minutes or until a toothpick inserted into the cake comes out clean. Serve warm., Makes 4 servings.

title: Italian Spaghetti Sauce
directions: Heat oil in heavy saucepan., Add onions and garlic; cook 5 minutes over medium heat until soft., Add other ingredients. Simmer 1 1/2 to 2 hours, uncovered, stirring occasionally.

title: Church Windows
directions: Melt margarine and chocolate drops and cool the mixture., Add the nuts and marshmallows., Mix and form 4 to 6 logs from the mixture., Roll in coconut on waxed paper or foil and put in freezer until firm, slice thin.

title: Cornbread Casserole
directions: Preheat oven to 425°., Butter a 9 x 13-inch baking dish., In skillet, saute onions and butter., Set aside., Mix eggs and milk until well blended., Add corn and meal mix., Spread butter into prepared pan., Spoon sauteed onions over top., Spread sour cream over onions., Sprinkle with cheese., Bake 35 minutes., Let stand at room temperature for 10 minutes., Serve warm.

title: Turkey Casserole(Great For Turkey Leftovers)
directions: Cube cooked turkey., Cook thin spaghetti according to directions., Make white sauce.

title: Low-Fat Cranberry-Apple Cobbler
directions: Place chopped apple in an 8-inch square pan coated with cooking spray., Combine cranberry sauce and orange juice, stirring well., Spoon cranberry sauce mixture evenly over apple., Combine oats, flour and brown sugar; cut in margarine with a pastry blender until mixture resembles coarse meal., Sprinkle oat mixture evenly over cranberry mixture., Coat oat mixture with cooking spray., Bake at 375° for 35 minutes or until apple is tender., Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

title: Mile High Biscuits
directions: Sift all ingredients together., Blend in shortening., Add milk and egg (one at a time)., Stir to mix., Turn out on floured board and knead., Roll out and cut biscuits., Bake at 375° until light brown.

title: Preserved Children
directions: Mix the children and dogs together., Sprinkle the field with flowers., Spread over all a deep blue sky and bake in sun., When brown, set away to cool in the bathtub.

title: Pineapple Delight
directions: Bottom:, Mix together flour, oleo and nuts., Pat firmly in bottom of pan and bake at 375° until slightly brown.

title: Caramel Peanut Butter Cake
directions: Blend margarine and peanut butter., Stir in brown sugar., Sift together flour, baking powder, salt and granulated sugar into mixture., Add 3/4 cup milk and vanilla extract., Mix until flour is dampened., Then beat two minutes on electric mixer or 300 strokes by hand., Add eggs and remaining milk., Mix, then beat one minute longer or 150 strokes by hand. Bake in moderate oven (375°) for 25 to 30 minutes before removing.

title: Overnight Salad
directions: In a shallow baking dish, layer the lettuce, celery, peppers, peas, eggs and onion. Mix mayonnaise, oil, sugar and Parmesan; smooth over salad. Distribute cheese and bacon over top. Cover and refrigerate overnight.

title: Vegetable Kabobs
directions: Pour boiling water over mushrooms and let stand 2 minutes; drain., On 4 skewers alternately thread mushrooms and zucchini. Combine Italian dressing and Worcestershire sauce., Grill kabobs over medium coals about 12 minutes turning and brushing often with salad dressing mixture., Thread cherry tomatoes on end of skewers and grill 5 to 10 minutes more until heated through, turning and brushing often with salad dressing mixture., Yield: 4 servings.

title: Mexican Hominy Casserole
directions: Drain hominy., Place in 2-quart casserole dish., Heat soup (undiluted)., Add Cheez Whiz and let melt., Pour over hominy. Sprinkle chips on top. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes, uncovered.

title: German-Style Red Cabbage
directions: Cut cabbage into 6 wedges, removing core; place in large saucepan., Add onion, sugar, salt, bay leaf and water., Bring to boil., Cover, reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes., Add vinegar and apple; cover and cook 3 to 4 minutes or until apple is tender.

title: Canadian Doughnuts
directions: In a large bowl, cream butter or margarine and sugar together until light. Add egg and milk. Stir until well blended. Sift flour a second time with baking powder, salt and nutmeg., Add enough of the flour mixture to the butter-sugar mixture to make a soft dough. Cover and refrigerate for 1/2 hour., Turn onto a lightly floured surface and roll into 1/3-inch thick and cut with doughnut cutter., In a deep skillet or deep fryer, heat vegetable oil or Crisco to 365°., Fry doughnuts until golden brown on both sides, do not crowd., Drain on absorbent paper and dust with powdered sugar or granulated sugar., Makes 2 dozen.

title: Texas Jambalaya
directions: Use a heavy pan with cover, heat oil and add uncooked rice. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until rice is browned. Add onion, bell peppers, garlic and ground beef., Cook and stir frequently until meat is brown., Add seasoning, soup and water. Cover tightly and cook over low heat, stirring occasionally, for about 40 minutes or until rice and meat are tender and liquid is absorbed., If needed, add more water during cooking.

title: Mandarin Orange Salad
directions: Mix cottage cheese, oranges and jello together in a large bowl., Stir until jello is completely mixed., Add Cool Whip and chill.

title: Rave Reviews Coconut Cake
directions: Blend cake mix, pudding mix, water, eggs and oil in bowl. Beat for 4 minutes., Stir in coconut and nuts., Pour into 3 greased and floured 9-inch layer pans., Bake at 350° for 35 minutes., Cool in pans 15 minutes., Remove and cool on rack.

title: Onion Puffs On French Rounds
directions: Cut small French rolls into slices and mound mixture of remaining ingredients onto each slice., Place under broiler until puffy and slightly browned.

title: Pepperoni Puffs
directions: Combine cheese, mushrooms, onions and mayonnaise., Spread about 2 teaspoons of the mixture on each toast round., Place pepperoni slice on top., Place on baking sheet., Broil 3 to 5 minutes until cheese melts., Serve immediately, or keep warm in 250° oven.

title: Brown Sugar Cookies
directions: Mix shortening, brown sugar and eggs., Stir in milk. Sift together and stir in dry ingredients. Chill at least one hour. Drop rounded teaspoonfuls about 2 inches apart on lightly greased baking sheet., Bake in preheated 400° oven for 8 to 10 minutes or until set., Makes about 6 dozen 2 1/2-inch cookies.

title: Mums Indian Relish
directions: Grind all of vegetables after washing., Measure all of the vegetables putting them in a stainless steel large kettle. Sprinkle 1 cup of non-iodized salt over the vegetables., Let stand overnight., Drain off all the juice on the vegetables., Add 2 quarts vinegar and bring to a, boil; cook until tender., Mix the sugar, turmeric, mustard and flour and make a thin paste with a small amount of water., Pour the paste over the ground vegetables. Mix well., Let stand 5 minutes and ladle into clean hot jars and seal. Makes 10-12 pints., Cover and let cool before storing in cool place.

title: Chicken Artichoke Casserole
directions: Sprinkle chicken with salt, pepper and paprika., In skillet, brown chicken in 4 tablespoons of the butter and transfer to a 2-quart casserole., Arrange artichoke hearts between chicken pieces.

title: Oven Spareribs
directions: Heat oven to 375°., Sprinkle ribs with lemon juice., Cook for 1/2 hour., While cooking, combine rest of ingredients., Bring to boil, then remove., Pour over ribs and bake 45 minutes to 1 hour (until tender).

title: Crab Meltaways
directions: Mix together first 6 ingredients and spread on muffin halves. Bake at 350° to 400° until golden brown. Better if baked on wire cookie rack placed in a lipped pan to catch excess margarine. May be frozen up to 3 months before baking.

title: Frankfurter Puffs
directions: Pour boiling water over 6 frankfurters., Cover; let stand 8 minutes., Slit each frank lengthwise., Spread with mustard. Combine 2 cups well-seasoned mashed potatoes, minced onion, chopped pimento and chopped parsley., Spread over split frank. Brown in broiler or oven., Makes 6 servings.

title: Broccoli Cornbread
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Bake at 350° until done.

title: 1900 Great-Grandmother Sarah Bright'S Laundry Soap
directions: Dissolve the lye well in 5 cups cold water., Melt the grease and strain through an old stocking into the lye, stirring all the time., Mix the kerosene, amonnia and Borax together and then add the oil of sassafras., Add the grease and mix well.

title: Favorite Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Cream shortening and sugars., Blend in eggs and vanilla., Sift flour, salt and soda., Fold into creamed mixture along with the oats, nuts and raisins., Roll into small balls and place on cookie sheet., Flatten with a fork., Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes or until golden., Yields approximately 10 dozen cookies.

title: Hot Chocolate
directions: Mix 1/3 cup with 1 cup hot water.

title: Mexican Lasagna
directions: Combine beef, beans, oregano, cumin and garlic powder., Place four of the uncooked lasagna noodles in the bottom of a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan., Spread half the beef mixture over the noodles., Top with 4 more noodles., Combine water and salsa sauce., Pour over all., Cover tightly with foil., Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours or until noodles are tender., Combine sour cream, onions and olives. Spoon over casserole., Top with cheese., Bake uncovered until cheese melts, about 5 minutes., Yields 12 servings.

title: Low Calorie Salad
directions: Mix Cool Whip and cottage cheese., Sprinkle orange jello over it and mix well., Mix pineapple with oranges and add 1/2 box of pudding., Mix with the mixture of Cool Whip and cottage cheese. Refrigerate at least 2 hours or overnight.

title: Cucumbers In Sour Cream
directions: In a large bowl, combine sour cream, minced chives, lemon juice, salt, pepper and hot sauce., Peel and thinly slice cucumbers., Add and mix well., Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes before serving.

title: Cranberry Salad
directions: Mix in large mixing bowl; add to cooled thickened jello., Pour in molds and let set.

title: Breakfast Casserole
directions: Layer the first 4 ingredients in order in buttered 9 x 13-inch pan., Beat remaining ingredients together and pour over bread in pan., Cover in refrigerator overnight., In the morning, make a topping of 2 cups crushed cornflakes and 1/2 cup melted butter. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Cherokee Dinner
directions: Brown meat and onion in olive oil., Stir in ingredients except olives and cheese., Bring to a boil; reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes, stirring occasionally., Spoon into baking dish; top with cheese., Broil until cheese is melted., Garnish with sliced olives., Serves 4 to 6.

title: Hot Crab Spread
directions: Beat together cheese and milk., Add onions and everything but almonds., Stir well., Put in 8 x 8-inch glass pan., Bake at 375° for 10 to 15 minutes., Top with toasted almonds., Serve with crackers., May be doubled.

title: Green Beans
directions: Brown bacon, add onion and simmer until tender., Drain 1 can of beans, add to bacon and onion., Then add second can with most of the liquid., Add mushroom soup and simmer until hot.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., Lightly spray cookie sheet with cooking spray., In a large bowl mix flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt., In a separate bowl whisk together shortening, applesauce, granulated sugar, egg and vanilla until shortening breaks into pea-sized pieces., Add flour mixture to applesauce mixture., Mix well., Fold in oats and raisins., Drop rounded teaspoonfuls onto a cookie sheet 2 inches apart., Bake 10 to 12 minutes., Remove from oven and cool on a cookie sheet for 5 minutes., Remove and put on cooling rack., Makes 36 cookies.

title: Million Dollar Pie
directions: Mix milk and lemon juice together., Add pineapple, Cool Whip and pecans., Pour into crust., Sprinkle coconut on top., Let chill.

title: Fruitcake
directions: Line angel food tube pan with heavy brown paper (a grocery sack will do). Spray with vegetable cooking spray.

title: Veggie Bars
directions: Unroll the crescent rolls and spread on a large greased cookie sheet., Pat them together into a single piece and bake 10 minutes at 350° so they are brown on top.

title: Fruit Cocktail Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients., Bake in greased 9 x 9-inch pan at 350° until top browns and sides pull away from pan., Serve hot or cold, with whipped cream or plain.

title: Potato Souffle
directions: Brown onion in butter., Add flour and then milk., Add egg yolks and sauce to potatoes; mix well, then fold in beaten egg whites., Bake in a greased dish in oven about 25 or 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Apple And Cheese Casserole
directions: Place apples in shallow casserole dish., Cream butter with sugar., Gradually work in cheese and flour., Spread over apples and bake at 350° about 30 minutes until top begins to brown.

title: Beef Cheese Ball
directions: Grate dried beef., Mix all ingredients together., Roll cheese ball in extra grated dried beef.

title: Mock Pound Cake
directions: Blend margarine and cream cheese., Add sugar, beat well until mixed., Add eggs 1 at a time, blending until smooth; add vanilla. Sift flour, salt and baking powder 3 times., Add flour alternately with milk., Mix smooth after each addition., Pour into greased and floured 10 x 4-inch tube pan., Bake at 350° about 1 hour and 10 minutes.

title: Big Mac Sauce
directions: Mix well and keep refrigerated in a covered container., Makes about 2 cups sauce., Spoon over piping hot hamburgers.

title: Shrimp Dip
directions: Melt together cream cheese and soup., (Do not add water to soup., Put in as is and melt with cheese over medium heat until smooth.), Mix gelatine with 3 tablespoonfuls of water., Add to soup mixture., Add soup mixture with the rest of the ingredients in a bowl., Refrigerate overnight (or at least a few hours).

title: Coconut Cake
directions: Make cake as directed., When done, blend together cream of coconut and Eagle Brand milk., While cake is still hot, poke holes in top and pour liquid over cake., Top with Cool Whip and coconut. Refrigerate.

title: Chicken With Pasta And Broccoli
directions: In a large skillet, heat the oil over medium heat., Saute the garlic for about 1 minute until golden, stirring constantly., Add the chicken strips and saute until white and almost completely cooked., Add the broccoli and saute until crisp-tender, then add the sun-dried tomatoes, red pepper flakes, salt and pepper., Add the wine, then the broth and butter and cook for about 3 to 5 minutes, or until heated through, stirring occasionally.

title: Artichoke Dip
directions: Drain artichoke hearts well., Chop artichokes in food processor until smooth., Add mayonnaise, cheese and garlic; mix well., Pour into small casserole; bake for 1/2 hour at 350°. Serve with Triscuits or Melba thins.

title: "Very Very Cake"
directions: Stir well and bake about 40 minutes in a 350° oven.

title: Pancakes
directions: Mix dry ingredients., Add milk to beaten eggs and combine. Mix the liquids with the flour mixture and blend., Stir in melted butter., Pour into pan sprayed with Pam., Turn when it browns around edges

title: Excellent Cheese Biscuits
directions: Mix baking mix, milk and cheese together and drop by tablespoonfuls onto a lightly greased cookie sheet., Bake for 8 to 10 minutes at 450°., Melt butter and add garlic powder., Brush over warm biscuits.

title: Sehr Gut Potato Salad
directions: Fry bacon until almost crisp., Add celery and fry until bacon is crisp., Stir in flour, sugar, salt and dill., Gradually stir in water and vinegar., Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until thickened., Add potatoes and peas; heat through., Garnish with egg quarters., May make ahead and refrigerate., Then bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Quick And Easy Dessert
directions: Bake angel food cake as directed., When cool, break cake in pieces and place in baking dish., Cream sugar, cream cheese, and condensed milk together., Fold in cool whip with electric mixer. Pour this mixture over cake pieces then add pie filling.

title: Red Velvet Cake
directions: Combine the cake mix, cocoa, sugar, oil and cake coloring. Add the eggs and buttermilk., Mix as any other cake mix in 3 thin layers., Cook the flour and milk to a thick pudding., Place in box to cool., Cream the oleo, Crisco, 1 cup sugar and vanilla. Beat in the pudding mixture and spread on cake. Sprinkle with coconut.

title: King'S Ranch Chicken
directions: Boil chicken until tender., Remove from bone and cut into bite size pieces., Grease 9 x 13-inch dish with margarine., Sprinkle crushed chips in dish., Add other ingredients in order listed. Cover with foil and bake at 350° for 20 minutes., Uncover and bake for 20 minutes more.

title: Cream Of Asparagus Soup
directions: Cook asparagus in water until tender., Whip asparagus in blender until smooth., Saute onions in margarine., Stir in flour and cook until bubbly., Add milk gradually, stirring until thickened., Stir in asparagus puree., Add chopped parsley and salt to taste., Do not boil.

title: Angel Rolls
directions: Let rise for 30 minutes and knead; cut out with biscuit cutter., Dip in melted butter; let rise., Bake at 450° until brown.

title: Easy Peanut Butter Candy
directions: Cook first three ingredients for 5 minutes until sugar has dissolved., Add marshmallow cream and peanut butter., Mix well. Place in buttered platter to cool.

title: Steak Butter
directions: Mix altogether and serve over cooked steak.

title: Sweet Dill Pickles
directions: Put some dill and garlic bud or sliced onions in bottom of jar and fill with unpeeled, sliced (not too thin) or make spears of cucumbers., Add rest of dill and more garlic or onion on top. Fill jars with liquid that has been heated to dissolve sugar. Seal and cold pack just until water begins to boil., Yields approximately 4 quarts.

title: Ham, Potato And Cheese Chowder
directions: Put potatoes, onion, water and oleo in covered dish and microwave 10 to 12 minutes, stir occasionally., In large bowl, combine milk, flour and pepper (shake flour and little milk to dissolve)., Microwave 6 to 7 minutes, stir often., Pour over potatoes., Add ham and cheese, microwave 2 to 3 minutes to melt cheese.

title: Banana Nut Bread
directions: Sift flour with soda and salt; cream butter., Gradually add sugar; mix well., Add eggs and bananas., Blend; add milk and lemon juice., Add flour mixture and nuts., Put in a bread pan and cook at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Pineapple Pudding
directions: Drain pineapple and set juice side., Mix flour and sugar., Add reserved juice, stirring well., Beat egg and add to mixture., Stir in pineapple., Pour into casserole dish., Top with bread cube. Pour melted oleo over top., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Banana Cake
directions: Mix ingredients as listed., Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350° in 9-inch pans.

title: Mom'S Baked Chicken And Prunes
directions: About 1 1/2 hours before serving or day ahead:, Preheat oven to 400°., In large open roasting pan, arrange chicken pieces, skin side up., Place carrots and prunes around chicken., In small bowl, mix brown sugar, lemon juice, white wine vinegar, salt, flour, oregano and pepper until blended., Pour over chicken., Bake 50 to 60 minutes, basting chicken frequently with liquid in pan, until chicken is fork-tender., Arrange chicken, carrots and prunes on large platter or in bowl., Skim fat from juice in roasting pan; pour pan juices over chicken mixture., Serve warm or cover and refrigerate to reheat later., Makes 8 main dish servings, about 335 calories per serving.

title: Salsa
directions: Mix all together and boil., Pour into hot canning jars, already cleaned and prepared., Seal jars.

title: Refrigerator Pickles
directions: Let first 4 ingredients stand 3 hours. Drain. Add sugar and vinegar; refrigerate.

title: Moravian Christmas Cookies
directions: Cream butter and shortening with sugar., Add molasses., Add soda to boiling water and add to creamed mixture., Sift flour with spices and salt., Add small amount at a time to creamed mixture and work in well., Work well with hands and knead dough well., Cover and store in a cold place overnight and longer if you don't want to bake all at one time., Roll to infinite thinness on board., (Board should be covered with cloth stretched tight and tacked on edges of board.), Flour board (cloth) evenly before rolling out cookies. Bake on a greased cookie sheet in 375° oven for a few minutes or just until they begin to brown.

title: Animals
directions: Place peanut butter, cream cheese and honey in mixing bowl. Stir until well blended., Trim crust from bread., Cut into animal shapes using cookie cutters., Spread peanut butter on half the bread animals., Top with a matching bread animal., May be covered and refrigerated until ready to serve.

title: Broccoli-Cauliflower Salad
directions: Place flower tips from broccoli and cauliflower in large bowl. Add cheese, bacon and onion., Stir up., In separate bowl, mix Miracle Whip, Green Goddess dressing, sugar and vinegar., Mix until smooth., Pour over vegetables., Stir until fully mixed and coated.

title: Dilled Butter
directions: Melt butter or margarine in a small saucepan over low heat. Stir in vinegar and dill seed., Good on green beans and whole kernel corn., Yield:, 1/4 cup.

title: Instant Spiced Tea Mix
directions: Mix all together and store in an airtight container., To make tea, use 2 teaspoons to cup of boiling water.

title: Toasted Sloppy Joe
directions: For the meat sauce (Sloppy Joe), saute garlic in the oil over medium heat in large skillet., As the garlic begins to brown, add the onion and saute until soft., Stir in the beef with a fork; continue stirring constantly to keep it loose as it browns.

title: Strawberry Frozen Pie
directions: Blend yogurt, sour cream and strawberries together., Pour into pie crust; freeze until solid.

title: Camper Stew
directions: Do not drain any of the ingredients., Just pour in crock-pot. Mix all of the ingredients together and cook on low for about 6 hours or let simmer on low on top of stove for 2 hours., Pepper, salt and add hot sauce to taste.

title: Zucchini Loaf
directions: Combine dry ingredients and set aside., In a large bowl, combine eggs, sugar, oil and vanilla., Beat well in mixer., Stir in squash., Add dry ingredients, stirring only until moistened. Optional nuts and/or raisins may be stirred in., Pour into greased and floured 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan., Bake at 350° for 50 minutes or until done., Test with toothpick., Let remain in pan 10 minutes, then remove to cool.

title: Fried Rice
directions: Melt butter in a skillet; add onion and rice., Brown, stirring continuously., Dissolve bouillon cubes in water., Combine all in a baking dish; add mushrooms, salt and pepper., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Three Fruit Punch
directions: Put first 3 ingredients in mixer; beat until smooth., Pour over crushed ice and add ginger ale., Makes 1 gallon.

title: Cranberry Salad
directions: Grind berries., Add sugar and let stand overnight., Dissolve Jell-O in 1 cup hot water., Add 1/2 cup cold water., Mix all together., Put in dish; let set in refrigerator overnight., Add 1/2 envelope gelatin.

title: Apricot Spread
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Chill., Serve on little pieces of bread.

title: Party Punch
directions: Mix well and serve cold or with ice cubes.

title: Taco Salad
directions: Mix together cream cheese and taco sauce with mixer., Onto 2 plates, spread lettuce, tomatoes and onions., Add taco dip on top of lettuce, tomatoes and onions., Spread 1 package of shredded Colby cheese over entire plate., Serve with taco chips or your choice of chip.

title: Cheese Crisps
directions: Preheat oven to 425°., In a large bowl with hand, knead all ingredients until blended.

title: Meat Loaf
directions: Mix first 8 ingredients and form into loaf., Combine Worcestershire sauce and catsup., Lightly score top and spread catsup over top., Roast in covered pan at 350° for 60 to 75 minutes.

title: Cucumber Dip
directions: Combine all ingredients, except cucumber, mixing until well blended., Stir in cucumber., Chill several hours or overnight. Serve with chips or as a vegetable dip., Yields 1 2/3 cups.

title: Corn Bread
directions: Mix meal, flour, egg, buttermilk and sugar. Pour over butter in Bundt pan. Bake at 425° for 35 to 40 minutes (until crisp and brown on top).

title: Sweet And Sour Beans
directions: Drain beans and bean sprouts; mix with onion and garlic., Mix salad oil, sugar and vinegar together and pour over beans., Let marinate for 24 hours in refrigerator.

title: Sand Tarts
directions: Cream, butter, and powdered sugar., Work flour, vanilla and nuts, into creamed mixture., Form into small crescents or balls. Bake on ungreased sheet in oven at 350° for 30 minutes or, until lightly browned., Roll tarts in powdered sugar while still warm.

title: Carrot Cake
directions: Cream together eggs and oil., Add dry ingredients., Blend in vanilla, butter extract, pineapple, carrots and pecans., Pour into greased and floured tube pan., Bake at 300° for 1 hour.

title: Carrot Casserole
directions: Puree together carrots, melted margarine and milk., Mix together sugar, eggs, flour, cinnamon, nutmeg and baking powder. Add pureed carrot mixture to rest of ingredients., Bake at 350° for 1/2 to 1 hour until crispy.

title: Stew
directions: Use a large covered casserole., Combine all ingredients into the casserole., Cover and bake 4 hours at 250 degrees., Do not brown meat beforehand., Optional - frozen peas., In crock pot may cook longer until potatoes and carrots are tender.

title: Cheese-Stuffed Squash
directions: Cook whole squash in boiling water until tender; drain., Cut in half lengthwise; scoop out pulp. Reserve pulp and shell., Mash pulp., Melt butter over low heat and blend in flour, 1/4 teaspoon salt and dash of pepper., Remove from heat., Stir in milk gradually., Return to heat. Cook, stirring constantly, until sauce is thick.

title: Bacon Tossed Brussel Sprouts
directions: Fill 6 quart Dutch oven with water. Add 1 Tbsp. salt. Bring water to a boil; add Brussels sprouts. Reduce heat to medium. Cook 12 minutes, until crisp and tender. Drain and rinse under cold water to stop cooking. In large non-stick pan, over medium heat, cook bacon for 5 minutes until slightly crisp. Pour off fat. Add onion to bacon in skillet and cook for 5 minutes or until tender. Add sprouts, remaining salt and pepper. Heat thoroughly. Add vinegar and butter, stirring to melt butter.

title: 20 Minute Chicken Parmesan
directions: Using palm of hand, flatten chicken to even thickness., Dip chicken into egg, then into crumbs to coat., In skillet over medium heat in hot margarine, brown chicken on both sides., Add sauce., Reduce heat., Cover and simmer 10 minutes., Sprinkle with cheeses., Cover and simmer 5 minutes or until cheese melts.

title: Stuffed Eggplant
directions: Parboil the eggplant whole., Let cool and cut in half lengthwise., Scoop inside out, leaving about 1/2-inch around side and bottom., Chop the pulp., Saute onion, butter, parsley flakes and garlic powder until wilted., Add shrimp and cook 3 minutes more., Add eggplant pulp and 3/4 cup bread crumbs and shrimp and ingredients., Cook on low heat until done, 5 to 10 minutes., Fill hull and sprinkle rest of bread crumbs on top., Add a strip of bacon on each one., Bake in oven until bacon is done and bread crumbs are toasted.

title: Pineapple Carrot Bread
directions: Combine flour, salt, soda and cinnamon; set aside., Combine eggs, sugar and oil in mixing bowl., Mix well., Stir in carrots and pineapple., Add dry ingredients and mix well., Pour batter into 2 greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pans., Bake at 325° for 1 hour or until done., Yields 2 loaves or makes 5 miniature loaves.

title: Hamburger Stroganoff
directions: Saute onion and garlic in butter over medium heat. Add meat and brown. Add flour, salt, pepper and mushrooms. Cook 5 minutes. Add soup and simmer, uncovered, 10 minutes. Stir in sour cream. Heat through., Serve with noodles or macaroni.

title: Herbed Lentils And Rice
