directions: Combine broth and lentils, onion, uncooked rice, wine and seasonings., Shred 1/2 ounce cheese and stir into ungreased 1 1/2-quart casserole dish and bake, covered, at 350° for 1 1/2 to 2 hours or until lentils and rice are done, stirring twice., Cut remaining cheese into strips and uncover casserole., Top with cheese strips., Bake an additional 2 to 3 minutes more until cheese melts., Makes 4 servings.

title: Sandy'S Spinach Salad
directions: Trim spinach; tear in small pieces and refrigerate., Sprinkle strawberries with 1 teaspoon of sugar or artificial sweetener and refrigerate.

title: Mother'S Jam Cake
directions: Cream butter and sugar., Add eggs one at a time and beat well., Put soda in buttermilk and sift together flour, cocoa and spices., Add alternately with buttermilk and soda, beginning and ending with dry ingredients., Then add jam and preserves, nuts and raisins., Pour into tube pan lined with greased brown paper., Bake 1 1/2 hours at 350°., Makes a large cake., I just grease and flour the pan., Top with Caramel Frosting.

title: Tomato Beef Stew
directions: Shake meat with seasoned flour in plastic bag., Brown meat in shortening in Dutch oven or stew pot., Add soup and water; cover. Simmer 1 1/2 hours., Add remaining ingredients., Cover., Cook 1 hour or until vegetables are tender., Stir occasionally to thicken., Uncover and cook to desired consistency., Serves 5.

title: Peachy-Cream Shake
directions: Put 1/4 cup milk and sliced peaches in blender., Blend until smooth., Add ice cream., Blend., Add 3/4 cup milk., Blend until mixture is combined., Sweeten with sugar, if desired., Pour into tall glasses., Garnish with peach slices, if desired., Serves 3 to 4.

title: Sweet-Potato Puff
directions: Peel potatoes and cut into pieces. Cover with water., Bring to a boil and boil 20 minutes or until tender. Drain potatoes and mash. Beat egg, cream, salt, sugar and spices together, then beat into mashed potatoes. Whip until fluffy., Heat oven to 350°. Butter a 1 1/2-quart baking dish., Pile whipped potatoes in baking dish., Press marshmallows lightly into potato mixture. Bake, uncovered, about 30 minutes or until marshmallows are melted and browned., Makes 6 servings.

title: Easy Vegetable Soup
directions: Boil the beef starting on high heat until it comes to a boil. Lower the heat to medium and cook the beef approximately 30 minutes. Add vegetables, stewed tomatoes and V-8 juice. Bring to a boil then lower heat to medium. Cook for approximately 30 minutes, then simmer on low heat until beef is tender but not overcooked. Salt and pepper to taste.

title: Breakfast Casserole(A Great Make-Ahead Dish)
directions: Cook sausage and drain. Mix sausage and eggs together. Put in a shallow baking dish. Pour soup over the top. top with cheese. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes. This can be made the night before and baked in the morning.

title: Lemon Squares
directions: Mix flour, sugar and butter until the size of small peas., Pat gently into a 9 x 12-inch pan., Bake crust in a 325° oven for 15 to 20 minutes until golden brown.

title: Oven-Baked Spaghetti Pie
directions: *I use my homemade spaghetti sauce with the spices.

title: Southern Fried Corn
directions: Cut kernels of corn off cobs with sharp knife., Scrape each ear with knife to remove all of corn and milk from each ear., Melt butter in heavy saucepan or heavy skillet., Add corn and 1 tablespoon of milk per ear (about 1 cup for 12 ears)., Simmer until tender., Season to taste with salt and pepper., (I use white pepper.)

title: Fruit Salad
directions: Drain fruit., Add the marshmallows and coconut., Add sour cream and mix thoroughly., Chill.

title: Cheese Dip
directions: Brown meats and drain., Melt cheese in microwave., Stir all ingredients together and heat in crock-pot. Serve with Fritos.

title: Mexican Chicken
directions: Place chicken pieces in greased casserole and pour taco sauce over chicken according to taste., Cover casserole and bake at 350° for 1 to 1 1/2 hours, uncovered., Sprinkle cheese over top of chicken and cover with broken tortilla chips., Bake, uncovered, until cheese is melted and chips are hot., Serves 4 to 6.

title: Pork Chops New Orleans
directions: Brown chops on both sides and place in buttered casserole. Arrange tomatoes, onion and green pepper on top of chops., Heat broth and wine together in separate pan; add thyme, sage, salt and pepper to broth after heating., Sprinkle raw rice over casserole and pour hot broth over all; mix (might add a little extra rice and broth)., Cover and bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour; be sure rice is thoroughly cooked., Liquid will be absorbed.

title: Meat Loaf And Potatoes
directions: Arrange evenly in greased 2-quart baking dish the potatoes, salt, pepper and some of the onions. Mix ground beef, milk, crackers or oats, catsup, rest of onions and some more salt and pepper. Spread evenly over potatoes. Bake in 350° oven 1 hour until potatoes are tender. Makes 4 servings.

title: Fruit Pizza
directions: You will need a 14-inch pizza pan (lined with foil).

title: Gold Coast Pork Chops
directions: In skillet, brown chips (use shortening, if necessary)., Pour off fat., Stir in soup, water, carrots, onion and sage. Cover and cook over low heat 15 minutes. Add green pepper and celery. Cook 15 minutes more until done. Stir occasionally. Serves 4.

title: Lasagna
directions: Brown beef in saucepan with oil, onion, garlic and parsley. Add tomato paste, 2 cups of water, salt and pepper and simmer 1 1/2 hours., Bring 5 quarts water to boil; add salt and lasagna (cut in half) and cook 20 minutes or until tender, stirring almost constantly to prevent sticking together., Drain., Arrange lasagna in casserole in layers, alternating with layers of sauce, Mozzarella and Ricotta until lasagna is all used and ending in like sequence, Ricotta last., Sprinkle with grated cheese., Bake in moderate oven (375°) about 20 minutes or until Mozzarella is melted and serve., Makes 6 large or 8 medium servings.

title: Taco Salad
directions: Prepare ground beef with seasonings, as on the package., Shred lettuce, dice tomato., Mix all ingredients together., Add chips in last.

title: Mini Cheesecakes
directions: Beat cream cheese until light and fluffy., Gradually add sugar, mixing well., Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each egg., Stir in vanilla., Place vanilla wafer in muffin paper and pan and fill with cream cheese mixture., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes. Chill overnight., Top with pie filling.

title: Squash-Potato-Onion Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients and place in baking dish., Bake for 1 1/2 hours at 350°., Stir about 3 times.

title: Chocolate Vinegar Cake
directions: Mix in order., Grease and flour a 13 1/2 x 9 1/2-inch cake pan., Pour mixture in and bake at 300° for about 1 hour until top springs back at touch.

title: Orange Slice Cake
directions: Cut nuts, dates and orange candy into small pieces., Add coconut., Melt butter and pour over nut mixture., In another bowl, mix eggs, sugar, flour, soda and milk., Pour over the nut mixture and mix well in a large bowl., Bake in tube pan 2 hours at 300°. Let cool in pan.

title: Pizza Casserole
directions: Brown hamburg with onion; drain. Salt and pepper., Put in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Add pizza and spaghetti sauces, 1/2 bag cheese and noodles., Mix together., Layer optional items on top. Cover with remaining cheese. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Walnut Cake
directions: Cream together Crisco, sugar and margarine., Add eggs, one at a time., Mix well., Add flour and milk alternately., Add vanilla. Mix all ingredients well., Bake in greased and floured tube pan for 1 hour and 30 minutes at 300°.

title: Bean And Sausage Casserole
directions: Brown the meats, onions and celery., Drain grease., Add soup, paste, mustard and brown sugar., Cook 15 minutes., Pour drained beans over mixture and stir well., Pour into a very large casserole dish., Bake 1 hour at 350°.

title: Ice Cream Salad
directions: Dissolve Jell-O in hot water. Add cream cheese and ice cream in small amounts and beat with mixer. Fold in pineapple. Garnish with coconut, nuts, etc.

title: Kelli'S Recipe For Dirt Pudding
directions: Mix pudding with milk; set aside. Blend Oreos until fine crumbs. Divide crumbs into two piles. Put on bottom dish or new flowerpot. Add cream cheese (softened) to pudding and Cool Whip. Mix. Pour over crumbs. Top with remaining crumbs. Top with fake flowers and worms.

title: Corn Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients., Pour into greased baking dish., Sprinkle cheese on top., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Irish Soda Bread
directions: Blend the flour, baking powder and baking soda with the butter., Add raisins, sugar and caraway seeds.

title: Crab Stuffed Mushrooms
directions: Remove stems from mushrooms and wash carefully., Save stems for another dish., Combine drained crab meat and grated sharp cheese., Add mayonnaise and mix well with a fork., Stuff this mixture into each mushroom cap., Sprinkle each with crushed crackers., Bake for 10 minutes in 350° oven., Then sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and run under the broiler until they bubble. Serves 8.

title: Never Fail Rolls
directions: Mix shortening, sugar, salt and boiling water., Add yeast to lukewarm water., When dissolved, add eggs and flour; combine all. Let rise 1 hour., Make into rolls and let rise, bake at 350°.

title: Garlic Grits
directions: Cook grits., Add shredded cheese, margarine and Worcestershire sauce., Add beaten eggs; mix., Bake 30 minutes in a 350° oven.

title: Judy'S Fudge Candy
directions: Combine first 3 ingredients., Cook and boil for 10 minutes. Combine next 5 ingredients with cooked ingredients., Add a pinch of salt and vanilla and mix., Pour into pan lined with wax paper and chill for 4 hours.

title: Mongolian Beef(Spicy)
directions: Deep fry beef in oil., In wok, stir-fry beef, red peppers and onion in sesame oil. Add approximately 2 tablespoons each of soy sauce, oyster sauce and wine sauce., (All can be found in any Asian grocery store.), Season with black pepper and pinch of sugar., Stir-fry quickly to blend flavors., Place crisp fried rice noodles on serving dish., Cover with beef mixture and serve.

title: Shrimp Etouffee
directions: Saute onion, celery and bell pepper in oleo., Add other ingredients, adding shrimp last., Cook until shrimp are done. Serve over rice., Adjust thickness by adding more flour or chicken broth, according to your taste., Use more shrimp, if desired.

title: Strudel
directions: Put fruit, sugar and salt in greased baking dish; dot with butter., Mix flour, sugar, baking powder and egg., Spread over top of fruit; cover with foil and bake at 375° for 20 minutes, or until fruit bubbles., Uncover; bake 25 minutes longer., Serve warm with topping, custard or ice cream.

title: Biscuit Pizza'S
directions: Leave biscuits out at room temperature while you are browning meat., Drain grease after browning hamburger meat., Add barbecue sauce or pizza sauce.

title: Hawaiian Sweet-Sour Ribs
directions: Fry ribs until brown and add soy sauce, sugar, vinegar and pineapple juice., Cover and simmer about 30 minutes on low heat. Add pineapple chunks and continue to cook on low heat for another 30 minutes or until meat is tender., If desired, thicken juice with cornstarch and serve.

title: Chicken Drummettes Teriyaki
directions: Cut large drummette sections from chicken wings and reserve rest for another use., Combine remaining ingredients in a large, glass dish or plastic bag., Add the drummettes and marinate. Refrigerate overnight.

title: My Mother'S Apricot-Cheese Salad
directions: Drain and chill fruit., Reserve juices., Dissolve Jell-O in hot water., Add 1 cup combined juices., Chill until slightly congealed., Fold in fruits and marshmallows., Pour in long baking dish and chill until firm., Spread with Cheese Topping.

title: Gingernut Cookies
directions: Melt butter in a pan and remove from heat; add sugar, syrup and beaten egg., Mix until well combined., Sift flour and ginger into bowl and pour in butter mixture., Mix until combined., Allow to cool a little., Roll teaspoons of mixture into balls., Place well apart on lightly greased cookie sheets., Bake in moderate oven for 12 to 15 minutes., Makes about 45.

title: Wheat Rolls
directions: Mix flours, and, salt, with, 2, tablespoons sugar., Mix yeast with water and remaining sugar., Stir in oil., Mix yeast mixture with flour., Cover and set for 1 hour at room temperature., Spray baking, pan., Form rolls and place in pan., Rise 1/2 hour., Cook at 375° for 15 to 20 minutes, until done.

title: Gourmet Stew
directions: Mix all ingredients together in a casserole dish. Cover and bake at 250° for about 3 to 4 hours. Serve with noodles, rice or mashed potatoes.

title: Lemon Jello Cake
directions: Mix cake mix and Jell-O., Add oil and water., Blend well., Add eggs one at a time., Bake at 375° for 30 to 40 minutes in 9 x 12-inch pan or tube pan.

title: German Chocolate Cake
directions: Melt chocolate in boiling water; cool., Sift flour, soda and salt., Add egg yolks, one at a time, beating after each., Blend in vanilla and melted chocolate., Add flour mixture alternately with buttermilk, beating after each addition., Fold in egg whites. Pour into three 9-inch layer pans, lined on bottom with waxed paper and greased., Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes or until cake springs back when lightly pressed in center., Cool in pans for 15 minutes., Remove and cool on rack., Spread coconut-pecan frosting between layers and on top and sides of cake.

title: Macadamia Nut Fudge
directions: Line an 8-inch square pan with foil., In a large saucepan over medium heat, combine sugar, salt, evaporated milk and butter, stirring constantly until mixture comes to a firm rolling boil. Boil 6 minutes, stirring frequently., Remove from heat., Stir in chips, unsweetened chocolate, marshmallows and vanilla., Blend until smooth., Stir in nuts., Pour into pan., Refrigerate for 2 hours., Remove from pan and peel off foil., Makes 2 pounds, 10 1/2 ounces candy., Contains a total of 5,950 calories; sorry!

title: Pudding Dessert(12 To 15 People)
directions: Beat the ingredients together and spread over cream cheese. Refrigerate until firm., One-half hour before serving, spread whipped cream over the top.

title: Breakfast Tacos(Eggs With Chile)
directions: Scramble the eggs with 1/4 cup of milk., Saute onions in bacon grease., Pour mixture into bacon grease in skillet., Add chopped bacon., In blender, mix jalapeno peppers with tomato sauce., Add 1 cup of water to this mixture; dump into scrambled eggs., Add salt and pepper to taste., Serve with tortillas., Serves at least 4 persons.

title: Baked Chicken Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Top with Cheddar cheese, if desired., Bake at 300° for approximately 30 minutes in a 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Down Home Pound Cake
directions: Separate, eggs., Whip, whites;, add 6 level tablespoons of sugar, and refrigerate until rest of cake is mixed., Cream butter and remaining sugar, beating until very light (this is important). Add, egg, yolks,, 2 at a time, beating well after each addition. Add flour and cream alternately, beating until mixture, is light. Add vanilla., Fold in egg whites., Bake in greased, and, floured tube pan at 300° for about 1 hour and 25 minutes or until done.

title: Japanese Fruit Pie
directions: Beat eggs well; add sugar, beating well., Add butter, beat well., Add raisins, coconut and peanuts., Pour into pie shell. Bake for 1 hour in oven at 350°.

title: Special Cheese Cake
directions: Soften, margarine, and blend with graham cracker crumbs. Spread evenly, on, bottom, and sides of 9-inch spring-form pan. Blend remaining, ingredients, one at a time and mix well., Pour into spring pan., Bake at 375° for 40 minutes., Leave oven door closed for 1, hour to let set and cool., Next open and cool, 30 minutes more.

title: Cukes
directions: Slice cucumbers and onions and cover with water; add salt. Let stand for 3 hours or more., Drain and rinse., Mix vinegar, sugar, water and celery., Pour over cukes and let stand overnight in the refrigerator., Can be frozen.

title: Punch For A Crowd
directions: Put Tang and sugar in a small container with lid and some of the water., Shake until Tang and sugar are completely dissolved, then combine with all other ingredients in a very large container. Slice orange very thin and float on top., Sugar can be omitted.

title: Light And Creamy Pumpkin Pie
directions: Combine pumpkin, milk, pudding mix and pie spice in a small bowl., Beat at low speed until blended, about 1 minute., Fold in 2 1/2 cups of Cool Whip., Spoon into crust., Refrigerate until firm, about 4 hours., Use remaining Cool Whip on top, if desired.

title: Porcupine Meatballs
directions: Combine meat, rice, egg, parsley, onion, salt, pepper and 1/4 cup soup; mix well., Shape into 20 small meatballs and place in large saucepan., Mix remaining soup, water and Worcestershire sauce., Pour over meatballs., Bring to boil; reduce heat., Cover and simmer 40 minutes, stirring often.

title: Lemon Rice
directions: Mix all ingredients together and refrigerate.

title: Coconut Balls
directions: Mix well all ingredients except paraffin and chocolate., Roll into balls and refrigerate overnight., Melt chocolate and paraffin. Dip balls and put on waxed paper until chocolate sets up.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Cook chicken breasts., Place chicken breasts in baking dish. Spread the soups over the chicken. Top with Pepperidge Farm stuffing mix., Bake about 30 minutes or until bubbling.

title: Shoestring Potato Salad
directions: Mix salad dressing and mustard well., Add to other ingredients (except potatoes) and mix well., Chill., Just before serving, add potatoes.

title: Hot Chicken Salad Casserole
directions: Mix ingredients and sprinkle stuffing on top., Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

title: Deluxe Refrigerator Rolls
directions: In large bowl, sprinkle yeast over warm water., Stir in butter, shortening, sugar and potatoes., Add cold water and salt; stir in flour., Use immediately, or store in refrigerator., Pat on table; cut into squares., Makes about 3 dozen., Place in pan, not touching., Let rise 1 hour, until double in size., Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Velvet Custard Pie
directions: Sprinkle cinnamon on top before you bake.

title: Easy Cake
directions: Light oil 13 x 9-inch pan., Spread pineapple in pan., Pour in cherry pie filling., Sprinkle cake mix; slice oleo and place on top., Top with nuts., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Casserole Burgers
directions: Mix beef, onion, egg, bread crumbs, salt, pepper and tomato sauce., Make into patties., Melt butter in pan., Add patties and green pepper strips., Brown slowly until done., Serve with rice or mashed potatoes.

title: Fruit Favorite
directions: Whip cream cheese in milk., Whip package of Dream Whip and add to cream cheese., Place in crust., Top with pie filling., Serve with whipped cream if desired.

title: Bean Dip
directions: Mix and top with sharp Cheddar cheese., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Cherry Yum Yum
directions: Mix together graham cracker crumbs and melted butter; spread half on bottom of pan and chill., Cream together cream cheese, sugar and Dream Whip., Beat until very stiff., Spread half of this mixture on crust., Next, spread cherry pie mix., Top with remaining cream cheese mixture and then sprinkle with remaining graham cracker crumbs.

title: Hot And Spicy Cranberry Dip
directions: In a saucepan, combine first 7 ingredients., Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer, covered, 5 minutes., Serve warm with pineapple, oranges and sausages.

title: Italian Slaw
directions: Chop cabbage and leave in bowl., Dice green peppers and onions., Add to chopped cabbage., Stir in sugar, salt, oil and vinegar., Let stand 30 minutes., Refrigerate for crispness., May keep in closed glass container up to 2 weeks in refrigerator.

title: Corn Chowder
directions: In large saucepan, cook bacon until crisp., Remove, crumble and set aside., Reserve 3 tablespoons bacon drippings in saucepan; discard remainder., Add onion slices to saucepan and cook until lightly brown., Add potatoes and water and cook until potatoes are tender., Add corn, milk, salt and pepper., Cook until it starts to boil., Serve with crackers., Serves 4 to 5.

title: Old Fashioned Carrot Cake
directions: *Mazola oil work best in recipe.

title: Tuna Casserole
directions: Mix together and heat in the oven for about 20 minutes. Sprinkle the chow mein noodles over the top and put back in the oven for an additional 10 minutes., Heat until noodles are crisp. Serves 3 to 4.

title: Crab Stuffed Manicotti
directions: Cook manicotti shells according to package directions., Drain the shells and set aside., Combine crabmeat, Ricotta cheese, mushrooms, onions, wine and lemon juice in a bowl, stirring until blended., Stuff the shells with the crabmeat mixture., Place the shells in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch casserole dish that has been sprayed with nonfat spray.

title: Cheese Pudding
directions: Remove crusts from bread., Butter each slice., Put together like sandwich., Cut into 1/2-inch cubes., Place half of cubes in a buttered baking dish., Cover with 1/2 pound grated Cheddar or Velveeta cheese., Then add remaining bread cubes, milk, beaten eggs, salt, dry mustard and onion., Pour over bread., Either store in refrigerator overnight or let stand for 2 hours before baking. If refrigerated, let stand at room temperature 30 minutes before putting in the oven., Set casserole in a pan of hot water for baking., Bake 1 hour at 350°., Before baking, test pudding., If too dry, add a bit more milk (usually not necessary)., Be sure the cheese will melt well., If in doubt, use Velveeta.

title: Tequila Slush
directions: Mix ingredients and freeze., Remove from freezer 30 minutes before serving and stir until slushy with a spoon., Can be refrozen and kept indefinitely.

title: Scalloped Pineapple
directions: Toss drained pineapple and cheese together., Combine sugar and flour and mix with pineapple juice; pour over pineapple and cheese mixture., Take 4 or 5 slices of white bread, cut in cubes and butter well with melted butter., Put bread mixture over pineapple. Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until brown.

title: Simple Strawberry Cake
directions: Combine butter or margarine and confectioners sugar; add strawberry juice until desired spreading consistency., Beat until creamy.

title: Savory Crescent Chicken
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Blend softened cream cheese and 4 tablespoons margarine., Add chicken and spices; mix well., Separate crescent rolls into triangles., Place chicken filling on a triangle and top with another crescent triangle., Twist., Brush with margarine and top with crushed croutons., Bake on cookie sheet and bake 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Spaghetti Casserole
directions: Spray a 9 x 13-inch pan with cooking spray., Cook spaghetti noodles and drain., Brown hamburger and add to spaghetti sauce. Layer spaghetti noodles in bottom of pan., Next, beat egg in milk and pour over noodles., Pour spaghetti sauce over noodles,, top with cheese, then arrange pepperoni slices on top of cheese., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Homemade Tomato Sauce
directions: Saute onion and garlic in oil until soft in a large saucepan; stir in tomatoes, tomato paste, basil, salt, sugar and water. Heat to bubbling; reduce heat., Simmer, uncovered, stirring frequently, 45 minutes or until sauce has thickened., Yield:, 5 cups.

title: Pecan Buns
directions: In a large bowl, blend egg, sugar and warm water., Stir in yeast until dissolved., Add roll mix gradually., Add extra flour and knead until dough is not sticky., Put in a warm place and let rise about one hour.

title: Tom'S Navy Bean Soup
directions: Wash and look through beans., Combine beans and water in large dutch oven, bring to boil, cover and remove from heat., Let stand for one hour., Add ham hocks, bring to boil, reduce heat, cover and simmer 3 hours., Remove meat from bone, chop into pieces and add back to soup., Stir in salt and pepper., Saute onion in butter and add to soup, stirring in well., Serve while hot with cornbread or crackers., Yields about 5 quarts.

title: Banana Cake
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Grease and flour cake pan., Cream sugar, shortening and eggs., Add mashed bananas and vanilla., Mix well. Add dry ingredients alternately with milk., Stir in nuts., Bake 40 to 50 minutes., Cool and frost with Caramel Icing (page 90).

title: Spaghetti Sauce
directions: Cook first 9 ingredients 2 hours or longer., Cook in crock-pot all day., Brown ground beef and onions., Cook spaghetti with oil. Do not mix ingredients., Serve with salad.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Line baking dish with a layer of chicken, then add a can of cream of chicken soup., Add another layer of chicken and then add a can of cream of mushroom soup and another layer of chicken., Fix stuffing according to package, then put on top of other ingredients and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: "Date Ball" Cookies
directions: Mix first 4 ingredients together and cook over low heat, stirring constantly until it boils hard., Cool slightly; add 1 teaspoon vanilla and Rice Krispies., You may substitute 1 cup nuts for 1 cup Rice Krispies., Cool., Form into balls (1 teaspoon each) and roll in coconut., (Good frozen.)

title: Banana Bread
directions: Combine all ingredients in order given., Mix well., Pour into loaf pan and bake at 350°., Bread is done when top springs back when touched.

title: Buffalo Chicken Wings
directions: Disjoint wings and wash., Deep fry in oil; drain., While wings are frying, mix all remaining ingredients and warm until butter is melted., After draining wings, toss them in the sauce until coated. Serve with carrot and celery strips and Blue cheese dip., Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Beignets From Togo
directions: Grind dry black-eyed peas into a flour., Mix this with chili pepper, minced onion and salt., Add small amount of water to make small rolls., Fry in hot oil.

title: Red Macaroni Sauce
directions: Put sauce in a crock-pot on low overnight or on top of stove for 4 to 5 hours., Stir often.

title: Amaretto Dip
directions: Mix together well and sprinkle with almonds, if desired. Serve with sliced apples, pineapple and strawberries.

title: Biscuits
directions: With fingers, crumble butter and enough flour (mix flour and salt first) to make a coarse, meal-like texture., Add enough milk to stick it all together., Turn onto floured surface, roll and cut. Bake at 400° for 10 to 12 minutes., Makes 8 to 10 biscuits.

title: Heavenly Hash
directions: Drain pineapple and fruit cocktail; save syrups (making a total of 1 cup)., Combine cornstarch and sugar., Then blend in beaten egg yolks and syrup blend., Mix well., Cook over medium heat, stir constantly until mixture comes to a boil and thickens. Remove from heat and cool at room temperature., Fold in whipped cream, walnuts, marshmallows, pineapple and fruit cocktail. Chill.

title: Tuna-Macaroni Salad
directions: Cook macaroni, drain and rinse with cold water., Combine macaroni, cheese, tuna, onion and celery in a large bowl., Stir together (use ziti macaroni)., Pour salad dressing, salt and pepper over macaroni mixture and mix thoroughly., Cover and chill at least 3 hours., Serves 5 to 8.

title: M&M Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., Combine first 3 ingredients in a small bowl. Cream butter with sugars. Add vanilla and eggs to creamed mixture. Then add dry ingredients and mix until well blended. Add M&M's and mix again., Drop by the teaspoon on an ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 8 to 11 minutes. Makes 5 dozen.

title: Pie Crust
directions: Mix together first three ingredients., In 1-cup measure, put the vinegar and egg; beat slightly., Fill cup with ice water. Pour over first mixture and blend to make a soft dough., Makes 4 double crusts.

title: Church Windows
directions: Melt chips and butter in saucepan on low temperature., Put marshmallows in large bowl and pour melted chocolate over them. Stir with fingers until marshmallows are completely covered. Shape marshmallow mixture into 2 logs on aluminum foil., Wrap and place in refrigerator for 2 hours., Slice into 1/4 to 1/2-inch cookies., Great for holiday guests.

title: Rocky Road Candy
directions: In a 2-quart saucepan, slowly melt chocolate over low heat, stirring constantly to avoid scorching., Remove from heat; beat until smooth., Stir in marshmallows., Spread in a buttered pan. Chill., Makes 2 pounds.

title: Bean Pot
directions: Cook ground beef, onions and bell peppers until light brown. Add mustard, sugar, vinegar and salt and pepper to taste., Add lima beans, kidney beans and pork and beans., Boil slowly for a few minutes., Simmer.

title: Oatmeal Crispies
directions: Cream shortening and sugars. Add beaten eggs and vanilla. Add flour, salt and soda or baking powder. Mix well. Add oatmeal and nuts or raisins or both. Roll in rolls about inches in diameter. Chill. Slice 1/4-inch tick. Bake on ungreased sheet 10 to 15 minutes at 325°.

title: Magic Potion(Halloween)
directions: Prepare Creepy Crawler Ice Ring., Pour boiling water over gelatin in heatproof bowl., Stir until gelatin dissolves., Stir in cold water., Add lemon-lime beverage and sugar; stir well (mixture will foam for several minutes)., Unmold ice ring by dipping bottom of mold briefly into hot water., Float ice ring in punch., Serve cups of punch garnished with gummy worms, if desired.

title: Nan'S Hershey Chocolate Cake
directions: Soften butter., Cream butter and sugar., Add eggs, one at a time., Add flour, syrup and vanilla., Bake in a well-greased 9 x 13-inch Pyrex dish for 30 to 35 minutes at 350°.

title: Six-Layer Casserole
directions: In a greased casserole, make a layer of each ingredient in the order listed., Season each layer., Bake for 2 hours at 350°. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Coconut Chews
directions: Combine sugar, syrup and cream in saucepan., Cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until sugar is dissolved., Continue cooking without stirring to soft ball stage., Remove from heat; fold in corn flakes, coconut and nuts., Press into buttered pan.

title: Scalloped Corn
directions: Put beaten eggs in medium size bowl. Add sour cream, whole corn and creamed corn. Mix well. Add muffin mix. Add melted butter & swiss cheese. Pour into greased 10 X 6 pan. Bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes.

title: Braised Cabbage
directions: In a large pot saut onions and bacon until tender., Add cabbage, water, salt and pepper., Cover and simmer until done., Mix cornstarch with water and add to cabbage., Cook until liquid is slightly thick.

title: Loaf Bread
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Grease and flour a loaf pan. Bake at 350° for about 10 or 12 minutes or until done.

title: Sourdough Culture
directions: Allow milk to stand in a warm place for 24 hours., Using a wooden spoon, stir in flour., Allow to stand in a warm place until it forms bubbles and becomes very sour., When ready, place in a large, loosely covered bowl and place in refrigerator., Never use metal bowls or utensils when working with sourdough.

title: Applesauce Cake
directions: Hand mix:, Melt butter and add sugar, then eggs and mix well. Mix flour and all other dry ingredients., Alternately add flour mixture and applesauce to butter, sugar and egg mixture., Add nuts, raisins and water last., Pour batter into a well greased and floured lg. tube pan or 3 sm. loaf pans., (It only takes the small ones about an hour to bake at the same temp.), Bake at 350 on middle rack., Do not open oven door any more than necessary., Check the large one after an hour, sticking a toothpick in to see if it is done., Cool in pan for 25 min. then remove to cake rack.

title: Ribbon Salad
directions: Dissolve the lime gelatin in 2 cups boiling water., Add 1 1/2 cups water., Pour into a 14 x 10 x 2-inch pan., Chill until set. Dissolve the lemon gelatin in 1 cup boiling water in top of double boiler., Add marshmallows and cream, cheese which has been cut into small pieces., Beat until well blended., Remove from heat and stir in pineapple and pineapple juice., Cool, then fold in whipped cream., Spoon over top of chilled lime gelatin., Chill until firm. Dissolve raspberry gelatin in 2 cups boiling water and 1 1/2 cups cold water, then pour over chilled lemon layer., Chill., Serves 12 to 15.

title: Mississippi Mud
directions: Combine walnuts, flour and butter until crumbly, Sprinkle into the bottom of an ungreased 13 x 9-inch pan., Bake for 20 minutes at 350 degrees., Cool., Mix 2 instant chocolate puddings with 2 c. milk., Spread over cream cheese layer., Mix 2 instant vanilla puddings with 2 c. milk., Spread over chocolate layer., Top with 1-12 oz., Cool whip, Sprinkle with chocolate jimmies.

title: Zucchini Bread
directions: Beat eggs until light and foamy, then add oil, sugar, zucchini and vanilla., Mix well., Add flour mixture slowly., Blend well. Makes 2 loaves., Bake at 325° for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Stuffed Cabbage
directions: Fry together onion, garlic, salt, pepper, hamburger and sausage., Combine meat mixture into rice., Put a large spoonful in each cabbage leaf that has been partly boiled., Fold leaf into square., Lay in pan., Pour tomato mixture over top and sprinkle caraway seed over top., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Punch Bowl Cake
directions: Drain cherries and pineapple. Mix cake per instructions on package. Add an extra egg. Bake in 13 x 9-inch pan. Let cool. Cut the cool cake into thirds. Crumble first third into punch bowl. Spread pineapple over the cake. Crumble the second third on top of pineapple; spread pie filling over this. Crumble last third over pie filling.

title: Shrimply Delicious
directions: Thaw shrimp, rinse and drain., Let cream cheese stand at room temperature for 1 hour or until softened., Put all three packages into a bowl., Add 3 jars of Fresh., Mix together until well blended., The cream cheese will be pink in color., Fold in shrimp. Serve with vegetables and grain crackers., Great for all occasions.

title: Sausage Balls
directions: Using your hands, mix ingredients well., Roll into 1-inch balls (or about the size of an English walnut)., Place on cookie sheet and cook at 325° for 25 to 30 minutes or at 400° for 10 minutes., Makes 4 to 5 dozen.

title: Dog Biscuits
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Combine wheat flour, powdered milk, salt and garlic powder., Cut in shortening or meat drippings until mixture resembles corn meal., Mix in egg and add enough ice water until mixture forms a dough., Roll out 1/2-inch thick and cut. Bake 25 to 30 minutes, until done.

title: Barbecue Sauce
directions: Melt margarine and onion and cook until clear., Add remaining ingredients., Cook in saucepan for 15 or 20 minutes., Pour on chicken (cut up) or wieners and bake in oven., Cook chicken in 300° oven for one and one half (1 1/2) hours., Cover loosely with foil.

title: Fried Chicken
directions: Mix flour, meal, salt and pepper in a dish., Melt shortening in an electric skillet., Roll chicken in batter and fry in electric skillet for 45 minutes at 350°.

title: Layered Spinach Salad
directions: In a greased 8x10 inch casserole, layer each ingredient as listed., Add a Tbsp. or so of mayonnaise to peas to keep them together., Refrigerate overnight., Cut into squares and serve.

title: Vegetarian Lasagna(Makes 8 Servings)
directions: Rinse the cooked noodles in cold water., Set them aside. Saute the onions and garlic in the olive oil until soft and transparent, but not browned., Stir in the tomato, oregano, basil, parsley and salt., Cook sauce about 1/2 hour, simmering it and stirring often until it has thickened., Stir in the sauteed mushrooms and cooked beans.

title: Pumpkin Pie
directions: Make pastry for a one-crust pie., Line pie pan., Place all ingredients into a bowl and beat together with a rotary beater. Pour into pastry-lined pie pan., Bake at 400° for 35 to 45 minutes just until a silver knife inserted 1-inch from the side of the filling comes out clean., The center may still look soft, but will set later.

title: Zucchini Nut Bread
directions: Mix all ingredients together, adding nuts last., Pour into 2 greased and floured loaf pans., Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Coconut Cream Pie
directions: Sprinkle 2/3 c. of coconut into bottom of crust, set aside. Spread remaining 2/3 c. coconut in even layer in shallow pan, toast at 350 degrees for 7 to 10 minutes or until lightly browned, stirring frequently, cool.

title: Cola Barbecued Chicken
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., Dust chicken with flour, shaking off excess., In a 10-inch skillet, heat oil over high heat., Add chicken and brown about 3 minutes on each side.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
directions: Beat eggs., Add oil and sugar., Mix dry ingredients together, then add the egg mixture with milk., Apples and nuts go in last. Blend well with electric mixer. Bake in tube pan at 325° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Mediterranean Shrimp Linguine
directions: Peel and devein shrimp but leave tails intact., Prepare linguini according to package directions., Drain., Keep warm., In a 12-inch skillet over medium-high heat, heat 2 tablespoons oil; add shrimp., Cook 4 minutes, stirring frequently, until shrimp are tender and just pink., Using a slotted spoon, transfer shrimp to a plate.

title: North Carolina Bishops Bread
directions: Combine eggs and sugar., Sift together flour, baking powder and salt., Add to egg mixture., Stir in dates, cherries, chocolate pieces and nuts., Bake in 325° oven for 1 1/4 hours., Let stand overnight before slicing.

title: Louise'S Cornbread
directions: Mix cornmeal, sugar, and oil., Add 3/4 boiling water., Mix well., Beat egg yolk and add to mixture along with the buttermilk. Whip egg white and fold in., Pour into muffin tins sprayed with Pam., Bake at 400° for 12-15 minutes.

title: Never Fail Icing
directions: Put all of the ingredients in top of double boiler., In bottom have water boiling., Beat with egg beater constantly for 7 minutes., Remove from heat and spread on cake.

title: Sesame Toffee Bars(Delicious)
directions: Toast sesame seed under broiler until brown., Cream butter and brown sugar., Add egg and vanilla; mix well., Sift flour with spices; add to creamed mixture and blend., Stir in nuts., Spread 1/4 inch thick in 13 x 15-inch greased pan., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes., Spread melted chocolate over while still hot., Sprinkle with sesame seed and cut while warm.

title: Fried Alligator Fingers
directions: Soak the fingers in buttermilk for several hours; drain and salt and pepper to taste., Heat about 1-inch of oil in frying pan. Shake the fingers in flour., Place in frypan in hot oil on medium heat for several minutes, turning until all sides are brown.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
directions: Combine oil and sugar blend., Add eggs one at a time., Add vanilla., Combine flour, soda, salt, cinnamon, nutmeg and sift. Add to previous mixture., Fold in apples, nuts and dates., Bake in 325° oven for 1 1/2 hours., Cool in pan for 15 minutes before you remove from pan.

title: Outrageous Chocolate Chip Cookies
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Beat sugars, margarine, peanut butter, vanilla and egg in bowl until creamy and well blended. Mix in flour, oats, baking soda and salt., Stir in chocolate chips.

title: Breakfast Pizza
directions: *Cheddar/Swiss/Monterey Jack (use alone or in combination).

title: Nut Muffins
directions: In a medium bowl combine brown sugar, pecans, flour and salt. Stir in eggs and vanilla just until blended., Batter will be lumpy., Spray the muffin cups with cooking spray or line them with paper cups., Fill cups about 2/3 full., Place muffin cups in cold oven., Set oven on 300° and bake for 25 minutes., Cool on a wire rack, run a knife round the edge of each muffin cup to loosen muffins., Transfer to a wire rack to cool.

title: Cream Of Broccoli Soup
directions: Melt butter, add onions and saute until light golden., Blend in flour, salt, pepper and stir constantly about 2 minutes., Gradually add broth, then broccoli and bring to boil., Stir frequently, cover and simmer until broccoli is tender., Puree in batches., Return to saucepan, add milk and bring to simmer., Ladle into bowl and sprinkle with grated cheese; run under preheated broiler until cheese is browned.

title: Pork Chops And Rice
directions: Salt and pepper pork chops. Flour and brown on both sides. Put rice in bottom of baking dish. Sprinkle onion soup mix on top of rice. Place pork chops on top of rice and onion mix. Pour water over all. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Chicken  Broccoli And Rice
directions: Add rice to boiling water; set aside., Melt butter and fry onion until soft., Add Cheez Whiz to onion and butter to soften. Add soup, milk, salt, pepper, rice and broccoli., Mix well., Add chicken; mix again., Place in 9 x 13-inch casserole., Sprinkle with buttered bread crumbs., Bake at 350°, covered, for 30 minutes., Uncover and bake 15 minutes longer., This freezes well. Mix ingredients and freeze., To use, thaw and add bread crumbs. Bake according to directions.

title: Smoked Sausage And Apple-Kraut
directions: Mix sauerkraut, apples and thyme in a Dutch oven., Put the smoked sausage on top., Poke the sausage several times with a fork., Pour the apple juice in the Dutch oven. Simmer in covered pan for 1/2 hour., If there is too much liquid, continue to simmer, uncovered, until the liquid is reduced.

title: Chicken Marinade
directions: Combine first 4 ingredients., Stir or mix well., Wash chicken pieces., Place chicken in large flat baking pan., Pour or spoon marinade over chicken and let it marinate several hours., Place in oven at 375° for 1 hour or until done., Make gravy with juices. Serve with rice, mixed vegetables and butternut squash baked.

title: Hard Cinnamon Candy
directions: Mix sugar, corn syrup and water in a large saucepan and stir over medium heat until the sugar dissolves., Boil without stirring, until the temperature reaches 310° or until drops of mixture form brittle threads in cold water., Remove from heat and allow to stand until all bubbles have simmered down., Stir in flavoring and coloring., Pour onto lightly greased cookie sheet. When cool enough to touch, break in pieces and coat with powdered sugar., Store in airtight container.

title: Fettuccine Alfredo
directions: Cook fettuccine according to directions on the package., Beat egg yolk lightly., Add cream., Melt margarine., Drain noodles. Add other ingredients and toss together.

title: Cheddar Baked Potato Slices
directions: In a small bowl, combine soup, pepper and paprika., In 2-quart oblong baking dish, greased, arrange potatoes in overlapping rows. Pour soup mixture over potatoes., Cover with foil and bake at 400° for 45 minutes., Turn over and bake 10 minutes longer until potatoes are tender., Serves 6.

title: Linguini In Clam Sauce
directions: Heat olive oil and butter in wok., Chop onions and garlic and saute., Add clam broth., Add wine and simmer for 10 to 15 minutes. Add the mushrooms, oregano, basil and pepper., Note:, Add seasonings according to your own personal preferance.

title: Chocolate Zucchini Cake
directions: 1. Combine sugar, magarine, and oil in large bowl and beat until fluffy., Add eggs, beating after each one. 2. Add vanilla and buttermilk and beat until smooth., Mix dry ingredients., Gradually add to first mixture beating until smooth. 3. Fold in zucchini, chocolate chips, and nuts., Pour into greased 9 x 13 pan. 4. Bake at 325° for 45 minutes to one hour or till cake tests done.

title: Cookie Cake
directions: Beat well., Bake in a cookie sheet for 15 to 20 minutes at 350°.

title: Wacky Cake
directions: Sift all the dry ingredients together into the pan you are going to bake the cake in., Make a well in dry ingredients and add wet ingredients., Add water slowly and mix thoroughly with a spoon., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes., Serve from pan., Use any frosting.

title: Hidden Valley Ranch Pinwheels
directions: Mix first 3 ingredients. Spread on tortillas. Drain vegetables and blot dry on paper towel. Sprinkle equal amounts of remaining ingredients on top of cream cheese. Roll tortillas tightly. Chill for at least 2 hours, then cut the rolls into 1-inch pieces. Discard ends. Serve with spirals facing up. Makes 3 dozen.

title: Cranapple Crunch
directions: Line a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish, which has been buttered, with the apples., Spread with cranberries., Mix oatmeal, flour, brown sugar and butter., Crumble over apples and cranberries., Bake at 300° until done.

title: Wacky Cake
directions: In ungreased 8-inch square pan, combine flour, cocoa, sugar, baking soda, baking powder and salt., Make 3 holes in mixture. Pour oil into one, vanilla into another and vinegar into the third., Add water and mix with fork until well blended., Bake in preheated 350° oven for 35 to 40 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Navy Bean Soup(Crock-Pot)
directions: Soak beans in water overnight., Combine all ingredients in cooker. Add water to cover. Cook on low 10 to 12 hours or on high 5 to 6 hours. Remove ham or pork from soup; cut into pieces and return to pot., Yields 8 to 10 servings.

title: Apple Cake
directions: Beat sugar, oil and eggs together., Mix remaining ingredients into sugar mixture., Pour into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake at 375° for 45 minutes., Sprinkle with powdered sugar.

title: Chocolate Eclair Cake(Serves 15 To 18)
directions: Bring water and butter to boil (melted). All at once, add flour and salt. Beat until mixture forms ball and leaves sides of saucepan. Cool slightly. Add eggs, one at a time. Beat after each one (it will be like play dough). Spread into lightly greased jelly roll pan. Bake at 400° for 35 minutes. Remove. Pierce bubbles with fork while hot. Cool completely.

title: Cherry Pie Delight
directions: Cream together the cream cheese, sugar and milk., Spread mixture over crust., Spread Cool Whip over top., Top with cherry pie filling.

title: Tortilla Chips
directions: Tear corn tortillas into small triangles., Spread them on cookie sheets and bake for 30 minutes at 325°., If you rub each tortilla first with a tiny bit of butter, 1/4 teaspoon to a side, the flavor steps up; cut the baking time down to 20 minutes.

title: Cottage Cheese Croquettes
directions: Saute onion until soft., Combine all other ingredients., Chill for 1 hour or overnight., Make croquettes., Place on oiled cookie sheet and bake at 350° until brown., Serve with gravy.

title: Upper Crust Chicken
directions: Trim crust from bread, reserving crust., Cut bread slices diagonally into quarters., Cut reserved crust into cubes., Combine bread cubes, chicken, celery and 1 3/4 cups cheese; mix well. Spoon into 11 3/4 x 7 1/2-inch baking dish., Arrange bread quarters over chicken mixture., Combine mayonnaise, egg and seasonings, mix well., Gradually add milk, mixing until blended. Pour over bread., Sprinkle with remaining cheese., Cover. Refrigerate several hours or overnight., Bake, uncovered, at 375° for 30 minutes., Garnish with celery leaves, if desired., Yields 8 servings.

title: Pan-Fried Potatoes And Zucchini
directions: Cut vegetables into chunks., Cook potatoes in oil over medium-high until some have browned., Add zucchini, salt and pepper., Cover; cook over medium-low until zucchini is done.

title: Christmas Cookies
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Mix together sugar, oleo, eggs, sour milk and vanilla., Add flour, soda, baking powder and salt., Stir well., Refrigerate for 1 to 2 hours., Roll out on floured board. Cut into Christmas shapes., Bake for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Sweet Potato-Pecan Puffs
directions: Whip sweet potatoes with margarine., Season to taste with spices., Form mixture into small balls., Cover each ball with pecans., Arrange on lightly greased baking dish., Bake at 400° for 10 minutes., Serve piping hot.

title: Fruit Cocktail Dessert Cake
directions: Place the egg in a bowl and beat., Add the fruit cocktail, then add dry ingredients (except brown sugar)., Mix well., Put in ungreased pan., Sprinkle with the brown sugar., Bake at 325° for 50 minutes., Broken pecans can be added on top of brown sugar before baking.

title: Hot Crab Dip
directions: Mash cream cheese with crabmeat., Mix in onion, milk, horseradish, salt, pepper, and artichoke hearts., Spread in 9 inch ungreased pie plate., Sprinkle with almonds and bake in 375 degree oven for about 15 minutes or until heated through., Serve with crackers, chips or raw vegetables., Makes 2 cups.

title: Mock Chopped Liver
directions: Saute the onion until brown., Blend all ingredients in food processor., Serve chilled with crackers.

title: Rocky Road Cake
directions: Sift together flour, sugar and salt., Add eggs and vanilla. Add walnuts., Fold in melted margarine., Pour into a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake 40 minutes at 350°., Remove from oven and immediately sprinkle with marshmallows.

title: Fruit Salad
directions: Do not drain liquid off fruit., Mix all ingredients together. Chill and serve.

title: Muffins
directions: Mix and sift dry ingredients. Add milk and eggs; mix well. Add oil; mix thoroughly. Fill buttered muffin tins 1/2 to 2/3 full. Bake in hot oven (400° to 425°) for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Frito Dressing
directions: Mix together., Put into baking dish., Bake in oven 25 minutes at 325° until brown.

title: Paella
directions: Debone pork., Cut up chicken and pork into mouth-sized pieces. Preheat a large skillet or paella pan with 1/4-inch coating of olive oil (medium flame)., Toss in chicken and pork; cook evenly. Chop onion into small pieces and add to meat., Cook with cover on for 20 to 30 minutes (low flame).

title: Krispy Cheese Crackers
directions: Mix cheese and margarine; add flour, salt and pepper, mix well., Shape into small balls., Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Flatten with fork., Bake at 375° about 10 minutes.

title: Ham Potato Patties
directions: Combine potatoes, onion and ham., Chill 1 hour., Shape mixture into patties., Combine milk and eggs. Dip patties into this mixture and then in crumbs., Fry in hot oil until golden brown.

title: Mexican Casserole
directions: Brown meat., Add peppers, soups and sauce., Let simmer., Put Doritoes on bottom of casserole dish., Put mixture on top of Doritos., Put cheese on top of that., Bake until cheese is melted.

title: Hash Brown Potato Casserole
directions: Place hash browns in a 9 x 13-inch pan., Melt butter and pour over potatoes., Add salt, pepper and onions., Mix soup and sour cream; pour over potatoes., Sprinkle with cheese., Top with crushed Ritz crackers (about 32) and 1/4 cup melted margarine. Bake at 350° for about 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Potato & Sausage Chowder
directions: Melt butter and cook onion until soft., Stir in flour., Add potatoes, milk, salt & pepper., Cook 25-30 minutes., Add cheese and kielbasa and cook another 2-3 minutes.

title: Banana Bread
directions: Combine all ingredients in a loaf pan., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or longer.

title: Icebox Rolls
directions: Sift flour 4 times., Pour boiling water over shortening, sugar and salt., When cooled, add 2 well beaten eggs and yeast., Last add the flour., Mix well; let rise until double., Knead and shape into rolls and let rise again., Bake at 375° until done.

title: Potato Stuff
directions: Place potatoes in a 9 x 13 pan. Pour melted margarine over potatoes and onions (1 stick margarine). Mix soup and sour cream. Pour over potatoes. Sprinkle Cheddar cheese over top to taste. Crush 1 stick of the Ritz crackers and mix with 1 stick of margarine. Spread mix over top. Bake 1 hour at 350°.

title: Chicken In Green Sauce-Guatemala(Jocon)
directions: Cook chicken in the water with 1 tsp. of salt in a covered pot, about 30 minutes, or until chicken is soft., Remove chicken and set aside., Save broth and soak tortillas in in it., Toast sesame seeds and squash seeds in a skillet until they lightly brown., In a food processor, grind the seeds. add the cilantro, green onions, hot chiles, tomatillos and 1 cup of the broth., Add the tortillas and process into a smooth paste., Brown the chicken in a lightly oiled pan for 5 minutes over medium heat., Add the paste mixture and the remaining broth, about 2 cups., Simmer over low heat for 15 minutes until the sauce is reduced to a thick, rich, green consistency. Serve over rice if desired., Makes 4-6 servings.

title: Sweet Potato Souffle
directions: Whip all ingredients together until smooth., Grease casserole with butter., Pour mixture into dish. Bake at 350° for 45 to 55 minutes.

title: Lemon Pudding Cake
directions: Mix together flour, sugar and salt., Stir in lemon rind, juice, well beaten egg yolks and milk., Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites., Pour into 1 1/2-quart casserole or 6 custard cups., Set in pan of water (1-inch deep)., Bake 45 to 50 minutes at 350°. Serve warm or cold., Good with whipped cream.

title: Kahlua Chocolate Cake
directions: Beat butter at medium speed of electric mixer; gradually add sugar, beat well., Add eggs, one at a time; beat well after each one., Add the Kahlua and chocolate; beat until blended., Combine flour, cream of tartar, soda and salt; add to the mixture in mixing bowl; alternate with the milk until all is used (begin and end with flour)., Mix well after each addition., Pour into 3 greased and floured 9-inch cake pans., Bake at 350° for 18 to 23 minutes or until cake tests done., Cool on wire racks for 10 minutes; remove from pan and cool., Stir 1/2 cup nuts into 1 cup of the frosting; spread between layers., Frost rest of cake. Sprinkle with reserved nuts.

title: Sweet Nut Braid
directions: Soften yeast in water., Combine 1/3 cup butter, sugar, salt and milk., Stir to melt butter., Cool to lukewarm., Stir in eggs and yeast., Gradually add flour to form stiff dough., Knead 5 to 8 minutes., Cover; let rise about 1 1/2 hours.

title: Cheese Meat Roll
directions: Combine beef, egg, crumbs, onion, 1/3 cup sauce, salt, oregano and pepper., Mix well and shape into flat rectangle, about 10 x 12 inches, on waxed paper., Sprinkle cheese over., Roll as for jelly roll; press ends to seal., Bake in shallow baking dish at 350° for 1 hour., Drain off excess fat., Pour remaining sauce over roll; bake an additional 15 minutes.

title: Husband'S Delight
directions: In a large skillet, brown beef with onion, then drain grease. Stir in soup, cream cheese and catsup., Transfer to a large casserole dish., Bake at 375° for 10 minutes., Top with biscuits and bake for an additional 10 to 20 minutes, until biscuits are golden brown.

title: Italian Anise Slices
directions: Sift together the flour, baking powder and salt., In a large mixing bowl, cream butter, sugar and anise flavoring; beat in eggs, one at a time., Add flour mixture and almonds., Turn out on a floured pastry cloth and knead gently until smooth., Divide dough in half., Shape each half into a roll about 1 1/2 inches in diameter., Place on lightly greased baking sheet., Bake in a preheated 350° oven until firm to the touch, about 30 to 35 minutes., Remove from oven and let cool slightly., While still warm., Cut rolls into crosswise slices about 1/2-inch thick., Place cut side down on cookie sheet., Return to oven and bake until toasted and dried out, about 10 to 20 minutes, longer if necessary. Turn once to toast and brown both sides., Cool completely., Store in a tightly covered tin box., Makes 3 to 3 1/2 dozen.

title: Chicken Fricasse
directions: Fry chicken in butter (use heavy skillet) for 5 minutes; add onion, garlic and tarragon sprigs., Sprinkle with flour, stirring to distribute flour evenly., Add water and carrots., Cover and cook for 20 minutes., Remove chicken and keep warm., Let the sauce cook down, stirring often, for about 5 minutes., Remove tarragon; add cream, salt and pepper., Simmer 3 minutes., Stir in chopped tarragon and serve with rice., Serves four.

title: Pat'S Hungarian Goulash
directions: Brown meat;, add, onions., Combine, first 4 ingredients and add., Combine next	3, ingredients	and add., Add 1 cup of the water., Cook 2, to	2 1/2 hours (until tender)., Mix flour with remaining water, and, add and let thicken.	I add carrots or green beans for variety.	Serves 4.

title: Broccoli Soup
directions: Saute onion in oleo; stir in soups, mixing well before adding other ingredients., Salt and pepper to taste.

title: Strawberries On A Cloud
directions: Mix sour cream, evaporated milk and 10x sugar together., Add thawed whipped topping., Tear angel food cake into small pieces and put into a large bowl., Add first mixture, stir together., Mix strawberries (sliced) and glaze., Put on top of cake mixture. Keep refrigerated.

title: Sauerbraten
directions: Rub meat with a cut surface of garlic, salt and pepper., Place in bowl., Heat vinegar, water, onion, bay leaves, peppercorns and sugar together, but do not boil., Pour hot mixture over meat; cover bowl and let stand in cool compartment of refrigerator 4 to 8 days, turning meat each day.

title: Deep Dark Chocolate Cake
directions: Combine ingredients., Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Veggie Sandwiches
directions: Unroll crescent rolls and press on a cookie sheet., Bake at 350° for 8 to 12 minutes., Gently press, if puffy., Cool completely.

title: Veg-All Chicken Pot Pie
directions: Combine all ingredients., Spoon into prepared pie crust. Cover with top crust; crimp edges to seal., Slit top., Bake at 375° for 40 minutes., Cool 10 to 15 minutes before serving.

title: Gourmet Potatoes
directions: Cook potatoes in skins., Let cool., Peel and shred coarsely. Over low heat, cook onion in butter., Add cheese and stir until almost melted. Remove from heat and blend in sour cream, salt and pepper., Fold in potatoes., Put in greased 2-quart casserole. Dot with butter and bacon., Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

title: Excellent Chicken Stir-Fry
directions: In wok, fry chicken breasts in Wesson oil., Sprinkle with garlic powder., Remove excess oil when done with paper towels., In separate pan, cook Knorr soup and bouillon cubes about 20 minutes. Thicken with cornstarch., Cut up vegetables and add with the soup to chicken in wok., Heat together while stirring., Enjoy.

title: Sticky Buns
directions: Layer cake pan with pecans., Mix sugar and cinnamon together. Roll biscuit in mixture., Pour over pecans in cake pan., In saucepan, mix butter, ice cream, granulated sugar and brown sugar. Mix until all is melted., Pour over biscuits., Bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes., Flip out on wax paper while still hot.

title: Calico Bean Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients well., Remove from dressing with slotted spoon and serve on lettuce leaves.

title: Macaroni And Cheese With Tomatoes
directions: Cook macaroni., Peel and chop onion., Preheat oven to 350°. Open can of stewed tomatoes., In mixing bowl, combine milk, cheese, stewed tomatoes and onion., Pour cooked macaroni into baking dish., Pour tomato cheese mixture over macaroni and stir. Bake in oven for 40 minutes.

title: Hearty Steak And Kidney Pie
directions: Cover kidneys with cold water., Add 1 teaspoon salt; let stand for 1 hour., Prepare pie crust mix according to package directions., Refrigerate until ready to use., Roll (beef) chuck strips in 1/4 cup flour on waxed paper, coating evenly; shake off excess flour., In large skillet, melt butter., Add strips of chuck and brown well on all sides., Brown only enough at one time to cover bottom of skillet., Takes about 25 minutes., Arrange around sides of 9 x 13-inch baking dish.

title: Christmas Salad
directions: Add sugar to lime Jell-O and mix by package directions., Add all to Jell-O., Let set until firm., Can be made several days ahead.

title: Helen'S Macaroni And Cheese
directions: Grate cheese in flat dish., Beat egg and pour over cheese. Add salt and pepper to taste., Add milk to cover cheese., Pour cooked macaroni into dish; stir., Bake 20 to 25 minutes at 350°.

title: Fudge Pie
directions: Beat sugar and oleo together., Add eggs; mix well., Add flour, chocolate and vanilla., Blend well., Pour into greased Pyrex (9-inch) pie plate., Bake 25 minutes at 325°., Serve warm with ice cream.

title: Strawberry Pie
directions: Cook crushed berries with the other 4 ingredients until thickened., Pour over the whole berries in a baked pie shell. Cool and serve with whipped cream.

title: Frosty Dessert
directions: Mix cream cheese with powdered sugar and 1 cup Cool Whip; stir until smooth., Spread on cooled crust., Mix pudding with milk. Spread on top of cream cheese., Spread Cool Whip on top of cream cheese., Sprinkle with whatever you have.

title: Cake Frosting
directions: Cream shortening., Add confectioners sugar; add egg whites and beat well., Add vanilla or other desired flavoring., Beat until smooth; spread on cake.

title: Butterscotch Banana Bread
directions: Sift together dry ingredients; set aside., Combine bananas, sugar, eggs and butter; blend well., Alternately blend in flour and milk., Stir in pecans and butterscotch morsels., Pour in greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan., Sprinkle 1/3 cup finely chopped pecan pieces on top., Bake at 350° about 1 hour., Cool 30 minutes. Makes 1 loaf.

title: Five Cup Salad
directions: Combine all ingredients and let stand overnight in refrigerator., Garnish with a few red maraschino cherries.

title: Pecan Pie
directions: Mix thoroughly all but nuts; then add them., Pour into unbaked pie shell., Bake 1 hour at 325°.

title: Red Cabbage(A Sweet And Sour Dish With Great Color)
directions: In a small saucepan, combine sugar, vinegar and cloves., Bring to a boil; reduce heat and simmer 6 minutes., Remove cloves., Add onion and water; simmer 5 more minutes., Place shredded cabbage in a large saucepan and pour hot vinegar solution over cabbage., Cook until cabbage is hot and crisp-tender (5 to 6 minutes).

title: Old-Fashioned Apple Fritters
directions: Combine egg and milk., Stir in sugar and salt., Sift and mix together the flour and baking powder.

title: Microwave Peanut Butter Fudge
directions: Place sugar, butter, cocoa and milk in 2 1/2 quart bowl and microwave for 10 minutes on medium-high setting (70%), stirring every 3 minutes., After cooked, add peanut butter and vanilla. Beat with electric mixer until smooth and partially set., Pour in a 9 x 9 buttered pan., Cool and cut into squares.

title: Dip For Raw Vegetables
directions: Mix all ingredients and use with assorted, raw vegetables.

title: Hash Browns
directions: Mix everything, except butter and corn flakes; place in baking dish., Top with corn flakes and butter., Bake in 350° oven for 45 minutes.

title: Corn To Can
directions: Cut raw corn off of cob and measure., Add water, sugar and salt., Stir well., Cook for 5 minutes., Cool., Put into freezer containers and freeze.

title: Easy Baked Beans
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Bake, uncovered, at 350° for about 1 hour., Serves 4 to 6 people.

title: Country Fried Chicken
directions: Blend milk and egg., Combine flour and seasoning in plastic bag., Shake chicken in seasoned flour., Dip chicken pieces in milk-egg mixture., Shake chicken a second time in seasoning mixture to coat thoroughly and evenly.

title: Tamale Pie
directions: Brown onion and ground beef., Add all other ingredients; sprinkle with cheese., Bake 40 or 45 minutes at 350°., Serve with tossed green salad and garlic bread., This is a big hit with men!

title: Ym Ym Chicken Casserole
directions: Boil and debone chicken breasts., Place in casserole dish. Undercook broccoli and layer on top of chicken., Melt together both soups, mushrooms, margarine and cheese., Pour over broccoli and chicken., Bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Salmon Log
directions: Remove skin and bones and flake salmon., Add other ingredients except pecans and parsley., Mix well and chill until easy to handle., On a sheet of waxed paper, mix pecans and parsley., Turn salmon mixture onto this and shape into a log., Serve with crackers.

title: New Year'S Omelet
directions: Scramble eggs in a bowl., Add ham and cheese., Mix., Add a dash of wine and spice to taste., Pour in a heated skillet., Flip when lightly golden brown.

title: Guey Cake
directions: Mix., Pour mixture on top of cake in pan., Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Slush Cake
directions: Mix together and press into 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake for 15 minutes at 350°.

title: Whole Wheat Rolls
directions: Combine in a large bowl 1 1/2 cups flour and yeast., Heat buttermilk, butter, sugar and salt until warm and butter is almost melted (120° to 130°)., Add to flour mixture along with eggs. Beat at medium speed for 3 minutes after blending with electric mixer., Stir in remaining flour with mixing spoon and as much flour as needed to form soft dough., Knead 6 to 8 minutes on floured surface., Let rise until double., Make into desired rolls. Makes 1 1/2 dozen cloverleaf rolls., Let dough again., Bake for 15 minutes at 375°.

title: Fried Rabbit
directions: Roll rabbit in mixture of flour, salt and pepper., Heat fat or oil, about 1/4 inch deep, in heavy frypan, large enough to hold the pieces without crowding., Use moderate temperature.

title: Roast Turkey With Wild Rice Stuffing
directions: Preheat oven to 325°. Remove giblets from turkey; set aside for gravy. Wash and dry turkey inside and out. Wash and drain wild rice. Cook and stir celery and onions in butter in a large sauce pan until tender, about 5 minutes. Stir in mushrooms and green pepper, cook and stir 3 minutes. Stir in rice, add 2 cans of chicken broth and remaining ingredients, except egg. Heat to boiling, reduce heat and cover. Simmer, stirring occasionally, until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed, one hour or more. Remove from heat and let stand covered about 20 minutes, stir in egg. Spoon stuffing into neck cavity, bring skin of neck back over and fasten with a poultry pin. Spoon stuffing into body cavity, do not pack. Most turkeys have a band of skin or metal to push legs through. Place turkey in roaster and roast according to package directions for pounds of turkey. Thermometer should register 195° if used. When turkey is done, remove from pan and use pan drippings to make gravy. Let stand 20 minutes before carving.

title: Date Nut Roll
directions: Mix sugar, milk and butter and cook until it forms a firm ball in cold water., Fold in the dates and bring to a boil., Remove from heat and beat thoroughly., Add vanilla and nuts and stir. Pour onto a damp tea towel and roll lengthwise., Let harden., Cut in 1/4 inch slices., Store in tightly covered container.

title: Western Stew
directions: Marinate meat in dressing for several hours or overnight in fridge., Remove from marinade and brown meat., Combine meat, marinade and water in a 2 1/2-quart casserole., Cover., Bake at 350° for 1 hour., Add vegetables and continue baking for 45 minutes., Place biscuits around edge of casserole; brush with margarine., Sprinkle with cheese and bake at 475° for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Seafood Fettuccine
directions: Cook fettuccine according to package directions; drain., Heat butter and garlic in skillet on medium heat until garlic is lightly browned., Add Crab Delights, half and half and pepper., Heat about 3 minutes or until mixture just begins to bubble, stirring occasionally., Add Parmesan cheese; stir for 1 minute., Remove from heat., Toss Crab Delight sauce with fettuccine., Serve immediately with additional Parmesan cheese, if desired., Makes four 1-cup servings.

title: Bean Salad
directions: Drain all vegetables before adding to liquid., Cut onion and bell pepper. Dice small., Mix vinegar, oil and sugar., Put in covered bowl and keep in refrigerator.

title: Italian Salad
directions: Combine the dressing, sugar, onion and Parmesan cheese in a large Ziploc bag; refrigerate and let marinate for 8 to 12 hours. Mix remaining ingredients and toss just before serving.

title: Chess Cake Squares
directions: Mix ingredients. Spread in well-greased 13 x 9 x 2 pan.

title: Egg Custard
directions: Mix all ingredients and pour in unbaked pie shell and bake at 350° until done.

title: Bible Cake
directions: Beat (third word in Proverbs 23:14)., Bake in loaf pans at 325° for 50 minutes.

title: Yankee Doodle Soup
directions: Brown ground beef and drain., Add all other ingredients. Bring to boil; reduce heat., Simmer 10 minutes., Serve with grated Parmesan cheese., Makes about 6 cups.

title: Pineapple Rhubarb Crisp
directions: Preheat oven to 350°. Combine 1 tablespoon margarine, 3 tablespoons flour, the brown sugar and nutmeg. Stir in water. Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until thickened. Add rhubarb and cook until tender. Remove from heat. Stir in pineapple and pour into ungreased, shallow 1 1/2-quart baking dish (12 x 7 x 2-inch works well). Combine 1/2 cup sugar, 3/4 cup flour and remaining margarine until mixture resembles coarse meal. Sprinkle over fruit mixture. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Serve warm. Makes 8 servings.

title: Strawberry Jello Mold
directions: Dissolve, jello in, 3, 1/2, cups, boiling, water., When completely dissolved,, add	strawberries,, pineapple and nuts. Place 1/2 of mixture into a mold, or, 9, x 13 x 2 1/2-inch pan and let set in refrigerator., Keep, the remaining half at room temperature., When first half is, set,, spread, 1 pint of sour cream., Carefully pour remaining mixture over sour cream., Let set until firm in refrigerator.

title: Red Velvet Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Dissolve soda in vinegar; set aside. Cream the shortening. Add sugar and beat well with electric mixer. Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition. Beat in soda mixture. Sift together flour, cocoa and salt. Combine buttermilk, vanilla and food coloring., Add dry ingredients to creamed mixture alternately with buttermilk mixture, beginning and ending with flour mixture. Bake 25 to 35 minutes. Cool in pans 10 minutes. Remove from pans. Cool on racks. Spread Custard Frosting between layers, top and sides. Sprinkle with coconut flakes, if desired.

title: Dean'S Squash Casserole
directions: After cooking squash, beat in bowl with Mixmaster., Add other ingredients, including bread crumbs., Place in shallow casserole; cover with more bread crumbs., Dot with butter; bake for about 45 minutes at 350°, until brown on top.

title: Arroz Con Pollo(Rice With Chicken)
directions: Separate breasts, wings, drumsticks and liver., Place remaining parts of chicken in saucepan with 3 cups water, peeled onion, saffron and 1 1/2 teaspoons salt., Boil 30 minutes; strain to make 2 1/2 cups.

title: Chicken Divan
directions: Boil 2 to 3 quarts water. Add chicken. Turn flame off and let chicken sit in water., Steam broccoli., Make Stove Top according to package directions., In a bowl, with a wire whisk, mix soup, broth and sour cream., Lay chicken in bottom of rectangular casserole dish and broccoli., Pour soup mixture over chicken and broccoli., Spoon stuffing to cover entire top of dish. Cover with foil and bake for 45 minutes at 325°.

title: Roasted Pecan Clusters
directions: Melt butter in a 15 x 10 x 1-inch jellyroll pan., Spread pecans evenly in pan., Bake at 300° for 30 minutes, stirring every 10 minutes.

title: Hash Brown Potatoes Casserole
directions: Heat until mixed and then pour over potatoes in baking dish.

title: Old Fashioned Christmas Cookies
directions: Combine flour, sugar, baking powder, soda and salt., Mix well. Add shortening and cut into flour mixture with a pastry blender. Break eggs in a cup and fill with milk to make 1 cup; add vanilla. Add to flour mixture and mix well., Chill if desired for easier handling., Roll out on pastry cloth and cut out cookies., Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes., Cool and decorate as desired.

title: Fruit Ice Cream
directions: Mix and pour into ice cream freezer., Freeze per instructions for freezer.

title: Doughnuts
directions: Beat the one egg; add sugar and beat until very light and white., Add the milk without stirring., Then sift 1 pint flour to which has been added the baking powder and salt and nutmeg., Beat this thoroughly; then add quickly enough flour to make a firm but soft dough., Roll out 1/2-inch thick; cut into rings.

title: Cherry Crunch
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Spread pie filling in bottom of a 9-inch square pan., Sprinkle with lemon juice., Combine dry cake mix, nuts and melted butter., (Mixture will be crumbly.), Sprinkle over pie filling., Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes, until golden brown., Serve with whipped cream or hot with coffee cream., Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Date Nut Bread
directions: Pour boiling water over dates and nuts., Let them stand until cool., Mix shortening and sugar., Add the eggs, without heating. Sift salt with flour., Now add soda to dates and nuts., Add alternately to the sugar mixture with flour., Lastly, stir in 2 to 3 cups cold water., Bake in two loaf pans at 350° for about 45 minutes.

title: Naomi Currey'S Mincemeat Cake
directions: Mix brown sugar, white sugar, Crisco and eggs in bowl., Add mincemeat and milk., Stir, then add soda, baking powder, flour, salt and spices., Bake at 350° for 1 hour., Test with toothpick.

title: Christmas Gelatin Layered Salad
directions: Layer 1:, Dissolve lime gelatin in hot water., Add pineapple and juice-water mixture to gelatin; stir well., Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan and place in refrigerator to congeal.

title: Baked Stuffed Fish
directions: You will need toothpicks or string.

title: Cream Caramel Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Cream butter and sugar until fluffy. Add eggs, one at a time., Sift flour, baking soda and salt together., Alternating, add flour and sour cream to butter mixture., Add vanilla.

title: Oven-Fried Chicken And Biscuits
directions: About, 1 1/4 hours before serving:, On waxed paper, mix potato flakes,, paprika,	salt, garlic powder, pepper and 1/4 cup grated, Parmesan, cheese., In, pie	plate, beat egg and 1 teaspoon water., Dip, chicken, pieces, into egg mixture, then coat with potato flake mixture.

title: Mexican Taco Salad
directions: Prepare rice according to directions on bag., Saute onions and ground beef., Add chili mix, canned tomatoes, salt and pepper to beef mixture., Add rice., Mix milk and cheddar cheese soup together and beat until creamy., Pour over meat mixture., Top with cubed fresh tomatoes, shredded lettuce, shredded cheese and Fritos.

title: Tortellini Soup
directions: Combine all ingredients except broccoli and tortellini. Bring to a boil and then turn to low and simmer for 30 minutes. At 15 minutes, add the broccoli and tortellini and continue to simmer for 15 minutes. Enjoy.

title: Stroganoff Casserole
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Cook macaroni according to directions. Drain., Combine ground beef, onion and seasonings., Shape into 16 meatballs., Brown the meatballs in oil, turning to brown all sides., Stir in soup., Cover and simmer 10 minutes., Remove from heat., Stir in sour cream, macaroni and sweet peas., Put in greased 2-quart casserole dish and bake 45 minutes. Makes 8 servings.

title: Bunker Hills
directions: Combine, Spam,	cheese, mayonnaise, relish and mustard. Pile on open-face buns.	Broil until cheese is bubbly.

title: Strawberry-Rhubarb Sauce
directions: In a 2-quart saucepan combine rhubarb, sugar, 2 tablespoons water and cardamon or cinnamon., Bring to boiling; reduce heat. Cover and simmer about 5 minutes or until fruit is tender., Stir together the 1 tablespoon water and cornstarch., Add to rhubarb mixture., Cook and stir over medium heat until thickened and bubbly., Cook and stir for 2 minutes more., Stir in strawberries. Serve warm over ice cream., Makes 2 cups.

title: Mexican Casserole
directions: Brown meat in skillet., Add onions., Mix soup, tomatoes and milk., Alternate, meat, and, tortillas., Pour soup mixture over meat and tortillas., Poke with knife so soup runs through meat. Bake 30 minutes at 400°., Top with cheese., Put back in oven for a few minutes for cheese to melt.

title: Cheesy Broccoli Bake
directions: In 1 1/2-quart casserole dish, combine soup and sour cream. Stir in broccoli, ham and rice., Mix well. In a cup, combine bread crumbs and butter. Sprinkle over casserole., Heat oven to 350°. Bake 30 to 35 minutes or until hot and bubbly. Serve.

title: B J'S Baked Ham Omelette
directions: Melt margarine in 9 x 13-inch Pyrex dish., Sift flour with baking powder; beat eggs and season lightly., Add 5 to 6 drops Tabasco sauce., Stir in flour, ham, cheese, cottage cheese and most of the melted margarine., Swirl rest of margarine around in dish to coat evenly., Pour in egg mixture., Bake at 400° for 15 minutes., Reduce heat to 350° and bake 10 to 15 minutes longer until puffed and golden brown., Cut into squares and serve.

title: Easy Scalloped Potatoes
directions: Combine milk and soup in a 2-quart, microwave-safe casserole dish., Stir in remaining ingredients., Cover and microwave on High for 10 minutes., Stir., Microwave another 12 minutes or until potatoes are tender., Serves 8.

title: Spinach Quiche
directions: Preheat oven to 425°., Prepare spinach according to package and drain well. Combine eggs, cheese, milk and onions. Add salt, celery salt, basil and garlic. Combine with spinach., Pour into unbaked pie crust. Top by overlapping sliced tomatoes and crumbled bacon strips., Cover edge of crust with tinfoil to prevent it from getting too brown., Bake at 425° for 15 minutes. Reduce heat to 350° and bake for 25 to 30 minutes., Let stand 10 minutes before cutting.

title: Spicy Vegetable Soup
directions: Combine beef and garlic in a Dutch oven., Cook over medium heat until browned, stirring to crumble meat., Drain meat in colander, pat with paper towel., Wipe pan drippings from skillet with paper towel., Return meat to Dutch oven, add tomato juice and next 9 ingredients., Bring to a boil., Cover, reduce heat., Simmer 40 minutes, stirring occasionally., Stir in mixed vegetables., Cover and cook 25 minutes., Yields 10 cups, 177 calories per cup.

title: Two-Flavor Fudge
directions: In saucepan, combine brown sugar, granulated sugar, evaporated milk and butter or margarine., Bring to full boil over moderate heat, stirring frequently., Boil for 15 minutes over moderate heat, stirring occasionally., Remove from heat., Add marshmallow cream, butterscotch chips and chocolate chips., Stir until chips are melted and mixture is smooth., Blend in nuts and vanilla. Pour into a greased 9 x 9-inch pan., Chill until firm., Makes about 2 1/2 pounds., Freezes well.

title: Southwestern Swiss Steak
directions: Cut meat into 3 or 4 portions. Mix flour and salt; dredge meat in flour mixture. Set aside remaining flour. Brown meat in small amount of hot oil, about 3 tablespoons. Place meat in shallow baking dish. Blend reserved flour mixture into drippings in skillet. Add tomatoes and green chilies, celery, carrot and onion. Cook, stirring constantly, until mixture boils. Pour over meat. Cover and bake in 350° oven for 1 hour or until meat is tender. Sprinkle cheese over meat.

title: French Oven Stew
directions: Heat, oven, to	300°., Mix all ingredients in a heavy 3 quart ovenproof, saucepot., Cover and bake, stirring 3 times, for, 3 hours, or, until, meat, is	tender and sauce thickens. Discard bay, leaves before serving or storing., Makes 8 servings., In, you like,, add, a, cup of frozen green peas or cut green beans 20 minutes before stew is done.

title: Chutney Chicken Spread
