directions: Process chicken in food processor for 5 seconds, using steel blade., Add cream cheese, chutney, curry, onion, mayonnaise and pepper., Process 5 to 10 seconds, until well blended., Place in an au gratin dish; spread with almonds., Bake at 350° for 15 minutes. Serve with large corn chips.

title: Dutch Apple Bread
directions: Sift flour. Add baking powder, salt and sugar. Sift again. Cut softened butter into dry ingredients as for pastry. Add beaten eggs and milk. Beat. Spread in 8 x 12 pan (greased). Press apple slices over top and sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon. Bake at 400° for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Banana Split Cake
directions: Mix oleo and graham crumbs. Put this in the bottom of 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan., Beat the eggs, oleo and 10x sugar for not less than 15 minutes., Spread on the graham crust and then cover with sliced bananas and crushed pineapple. Cover with Cool Whip. Sprinkle with chopped nuts and some cherries., Refrigerate for several hours before serving., Keep refrigerated.

title: Pot Roast
directions: In a 6-quart saucepan, put oil and heat., Brown roast on both sides., Spoon off fat., Stir in mushroom soup, onion soup mix and 1 cup water., Reduce heat to low., Cover; cook 2 hours., Add vegetables., Cook 45 minutes., Remove roast and vegetables., Stir in flour and 1/2 cup water., Gradually stir into pot., Cook until it boils and thickens.

title: Mum'S Rice Pudding
directions: Preheat oven to 425°., Cook rice and raisins together., Beat egg yolks and add sugar, pinch of salt, milk, nutmeg and cinnamon.

title: Pizza Casserole
directions: Preheat oven to 400°. Cook ground beef. Put in 8 inch baking dish. Top with sauce and cheese. Combine milk, bisquick and eggs. Beat until smooth. Pour over top. Bake 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Caramel Coconut Pie
directions: Brown coconut and pecans lightly in 1/4 cup margarine., Mix cream cheese and Eagle Brand milk until smooth., Fold in Cool Whip. Put 1/4 cream cheese mixture in each pie crust., Drizzle 1/4 jar caramel and 1/4 coconut mixture., Repeat layers., Freeze (better results if frozen overnight)., Thaw 5 to 10 minutes before serving.

title: Cran-Apple Bake
directions: Combine fruit and sugar in a 9 x 13 x 2-inch baking dish., Mix remaining ingredients and sprinkle over top., Bake at 350° for one hour or until brown and bubbly.

title: Caramel Apple Cheese Pie
directions: Beat cream cheese and sugar in mixing bowl until fluffy and well-blended., Spread on bottom of pie crust., In skillet, over medium heat, melt butter and add apples., Cook, stirring, until tender-crisp, about 5 minutes., Drain well on paper towels.

title: Christmas Cookies
directions: Drop on greased cookie sheet and bake at 300° for 30 minutes; 275° may be better., Makes 100 cookies.

title: Cranberry Relish
directions: Place cranberries, Quartered orange with peel, apple and sugar in food processor., Chop, until mixture reaches relish consistency., Refrigerate for at least 3 hours., Mix in walnuts and serve.

title: Maxine'S 2 Minute Microwave Fudge
directions: In a 1 1/2-quart bowl, stir sugar, cocoa, milk and vanilla together until partially blended., Place butter over top in center of bowl., Microwave on High for 2 minutes., Stir vigorously until smooth., (Don't worry if all the butter does not melt; it will as mixture is stirred.), Pour mixture into greased 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan., Chill in refrigerator 1 hour., Cut into squares., Makes about 36 squares.

title: Banana Shake(Yield: 3 Large Shakes)
directions: 1. Unpeel bananas and put in a blender.

title: Orange Julius
directions: Blend together in blender., Delicious, refreshing drink.

title: Baked Spareribs Aloha
directions: Cut ribs into serving pieces. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Place in shallow pan. Bake at 450° for 1/2 hour., Pour off excess fat., Reduce oven heat to 350°., Mix remaining ingredients., Pour over ribs. Bake for 1 1/2 hours, basting frequently. Makes 4 servings.

title: Linden Lea Banana Chip Muffins
directions: Combine sugar, margarine and eggs., Mix well., Stir in bananas, buttermilk and vanilla., Stir in remaining dry ingredients., Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Mexican Dip
directions: Heat in crock-pot until cheese is melted., Serve warm with tortilla chips.

title: Banana Bread
directions: Mix ingredients together and bake 1 hour at 350°.

title: Jo'S Quick Spanish Rice
directions: In a large pot, heat the vegetable oil until very hot., Stir in Sofrito and stir for 20 seconds., Add rice; stir until all ingredients are well mixed., Add black beans, water, salt, garlic powder, pepper and envelopes of Sazon; stir and bring to a boil. Add olives and/or Vienna sausages (optional)., Reduce heat to low. Cover and simmer for 20 to 25 minutes (until all water is absorbed)., Stir rice once with a large fork after 10 to 15 minutes., When rice is done, turn off heat and let stand for 5 minutes., Stir rice once again after 5 minutes and enjoy!

title: Potato Soup
directions: Peel and cube potatoes., Boil until soft., Drain, but do not throw water away., Mash potatoes and butter., Slowly add water (not too much) and heat, stirring all the time., Mix leek soup mix with water and add to potatoes., Heat and stir all the time., Keep stirring and add 1/2 the cream.

title: Cranberry Relish
directions: Combine cranberries,, orange, and, apricots and put 1/2 the mixture in	the, blender., Blend well., Add the other half of mixture, blend well. Add sugar, ginger, almonds and raisins to mixture., Refrigerate.

title: Peanut Brittle
directions: Combine sugar, syrup, water and peanuts., Measure into custard cup soda and salt., Cook together sugar, corn syrup, water and peanuts for 30 to 35 minutes after it begins to boil, until it is amber, a little deeper than straw color., Add soda and salt, mixed., Remove from heat., Beat until blended and pour onto heavy buttered aluminum tray., Pull edges to thin sheets; cut off pieces with kitchen shears., Cool and store tightly covered.

title: Tangy Tea Mix
directions: Mix all ingredients together in large bowl., Store in glass jars.

title: E-Z Scalloped Potatoes
directions: Use can from cream of mushroom soup to add the hot water and half and half to all ingredients., Stir together and put in casserole dish and bake at 400° for one hour.

title: Pepsi Barbecue Chicken
directions: Put chicken in pan., Put salt over chicken, then put Pepsi up to the top of chicken., Then cook 1 hour at 350°., Then cover with barbecue sauce.

title: Easy Chicken And Dumplings
directions: Boil chicken breasts in 1 quart water until tender., Remove, cool and cut up., Add cream of chicken soup to broth and bring to rolling boil.

title: Vanilla Wafer Pudding
directions: Pour half of the vanilla wafers into about a 1 1/2-quart bowl. Whip cream until stiff and fold in drained maraschino cherries (chopped) and drained crushed pineapple., Add chopped nuts., Layer the creamed mixture over the wafers; add the remaining vanilla wafers., Refrigerate overnight.

title: Vegetable Pizza
directions: *Broccoli, cauliflower, carrots, green pepper, celery, etc.

title: Pineapple Glazed Apple Pie
directions: In large saucepan, combine 1 1/4 cups of pineapple juice and sugar., Bring to a boil., Add apple wedges., Simmer, covered, 3 to 4 minutes or until apples are tender, but not soft., With slotted spoon, lift apples from liquid., Set apples aside to drain., Blend the remaining 1/4 cup pineapple juice slowly into cornstarch., Add to hot pineapple liquid in saucepan., Cook and stir until mixture thickens and bubbles., Cook 1 minute more., Remove from heat; stir in butter or margarine, vanilla and salt., Cover and cool 30 minutes, without stirring.

title: Cocktail Meat Balls
directions: Mix all of ingredients together and roll into 80 to 100 balls.

title: Chocolate Thing
directions: Melt butter in a 6 x 9-inch glass baking dish., Mix in flour and pecans., Press into pan to form crust.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Cook rice., In a large frying pan, heat oil; toss in broccoli and onion., Cook for 5 minutes., Add cream of chicken soup. Reduce heat., Stir in cheese, milk and salt; cook until bubbly. Place rice in bottom of 2-quart casserole and add broccoli sauce. Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Key Lime Pie (Or Lemon)
directions: Fold together milk and juice., Fold in Cool Whip., Pour into crust and cool for a few hours.

title: Angel Food Pie
directions: Put water, sugar and pineapple in top of double boiler and bring just to boiling point., Mix flour and cornstarch and add to pineapple mixture., Cook until it thickens., Remove from heat and add vanilla., When cool, fold in egg whites., Pour into 2 baked pie shells., Top with 1/2 pint whipped topping for each pie. Sprinkle with coconut., Let stand in refrigerator overnight.

title: Brown Sugar-Bourbon Glazed Ham
directions: Place unwrapped ham on rack in large roasting pan. Let stand at room temperature 2 hours.

title: Gelatin Easter Baskets
directions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water., Add cold water., Pour into individual ring molds or 6 ounce custard cups., Chill until firm, about 2 hours.

title: Red Raspberry Salad
directions: Dissolve jello in water (do not add cold water)., Add ingredients except sour cream., Stir well or until raspberries separate., Pour 1/2 mixture in 9 x 13-inch pan., Chill until firm enough to spread sour cream over top., Add remainder of jello mixture and chill until firm., This can be made with different flavors also., Example:, strawberry jello and fruit, orange jello and mandarin orange slices, etc., But raspberry is super!

title: Roux
directions: Mix the flour and oil in, a, heavy pot; stir constantly over a medium fire., As you, stir,, the, roux, browns, slowly. Don't cook the roux fast, because, as, it, reaches, the, done point, it will burn.	When the roux is a rich dark brown, turn fire, off while continuing to, stir, until, it, cools., Makes enough roux for stew with one hen or 2 pounds shrimp.

title: Nine Layer Vegetable Salad
directions: Layer vegetables in the order listed in a 10 x 10 x 2-inch casserole dish., Spread mayonnaise evenly over top., Sprinkle sugar, then Parmesan cheese, then Bac*Os bits over mayonnaise. Layer mushrooms evenly over top and then sliced eggs., Add croutons on top.

title: Midwestern Scalloped Corn And Sausage Casserole
directions: Brown sausage; drain off all fat except about 2 tablespoons. Add flour and stir until blended, then add milk and stir until mixture boils and thickens., Add corn, salt and pepper to mixture. Place into shallow casserole., Arrange thick slices of tomato over the top of sausage and corn mixture., Top with grated cheese. Place under broiler for 4 to 5 minutes, until tomatoes are cooked and cheese is melted., Yields 4 servings.

title: Lemon-Glazed Carrots
directions: In 1-quart microproof casserole, combine carrots and water. Cover., Cook on High (maximum power) 6 minutes., Stir in green peppers., Cover., Cook on High (maximum power) 12 to 15 minutes or until carrots are tender, stirring once during cooking time. Drain.

title: Striped Delight
directions: Combine first 3 ingredients and press firmly into 13 x 9-inch pan., Beat cream cheese, sugar and 2 tablespoons of milk until smooth., Fold in 1/2 of Cool Whip., Spread over crust., Prepare pudding using 3 1/2 cups milk., Spread over layer of cream cheese. Chill 2 hours., Spread remaining Cool Whip over pudding layer. Garnish with graham cracker crumbs or semi-sweet mini chocolate chips.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
directions: Blend Crisco, salt and sugars., Stir in eggs; add peanut butter and vanilla., Add dry ingredients to first mixture, blending well., Roll into small balls the size of a walnut. Place on greased baking sheet and mark with fork to form "X" on cookies., Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: No Bake Cheese Cake
directions: Beat cheese until smooth; gradually beat in sugar., Blend in sour cream and vanilla., Fold in Cool Whip, blending well., Spoon onto crust., Chill until set, at least 4 hours., Garnish with fresh strawberries, if desired.

title: Easy Corn Pudding
directions: Beat eggs; add butter, milk, sugar and flour all together. Add corn. Bake at 350° until firm, approximately 45 minutes or more. Sprinkle small jar chopped pimentos on top (option).

title: Apricot Cookies
directions: Cream the butter with sugar., Mix in egg yolks, then flour, then nuts., Use hands., Grease an 8-inch square pan., Put half of the dough in pan., Top with 2 tablespoons of apricot preserves. Put the rest of the dough on top of the apricot preserves., Spread remaining preserves on top., Bake at 325° for 1 hour.

title: Chicken Wings
directions: Lay chicken wings n large pan., Mix soup, dressing and 3/4 jar preserves and spoon over chicken., Cover with foil and bake for 1 hour., Uncover and continue baking for 1/2 hour or until browned at 350°.

title: Pork Chops With Scalloped Potatoes
directions: In a saucepan, melt butter. Stir in flour, salt and pepper. Add chicken broth; cook and stir until mixture boils. Cook for 1 minute. Remove from heat and set aside., In a skillet, brown chops in oil. Season more if desired., In a greased 9 x 13 x 2-inch baking dish, layer potatoes and onion. Pour broth mixture over. Place chops on top., Cover and bake 1 hour at 350°. Uncover and bake 30 minutes longer or until potatoes are tender. Sprinkle with parsley and paprika if desired.

title: Summer Squash Casserole
directions: Drain shredded zucchini and squash., Squeeze dry with paper towels., Set aside., Coat a medium skillet with vegetable spray. Place over medium-high heat until hot., Add onions and saute for 5 minutes or until tender., Combine squash, onions, shredded cheese and next four ingredients in large bowl., Stir well.

title: Party Potato Salad
directions: In large bowl, mix buttermilk, mayonnaise, horseradish, sugar, bouillon and dill., Stir in remaining ingredients., Cover and chill., Garnish., Refrigerate leftovers.

title: A-B-C Salad
directions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water and add fruit juice or cold water., Add fruit cocktail., Pour in a 9 x 13-inch dish and let set.

title: Tea Cakes
directions: Mix oleo and sugar; mix flour, salt and baking powder., Add 2 mixtures together and add vanilla., Add enough milk to make stiff dough., Roll out on floured sheet and cut like biscuits., Bake at 425° for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Breakfast Ham Ring(Yields 8 Servings)
directions: In a large bowl lightly beat 2 eggs., Add ham, sausage, bread crumbs, milk, parsley and horseradish and mix well., Press into a greased 6 cup ring mold., Bake at 350° for 1 1/4 hours., Toward end of baking time, prepare scrambled eggs with remaining eggs. Remove ring from oven and drain juices., Unmold onto serving platter., Fill center with scrambled eggs., Serve immediately.

title: Stuffed Spinach Shells
directions: Prepare shells and drain., Cool spinach and pour into large bowl., Add salt, pepper and cheese (Ricotta or cottage cheese). Mix fried beef and spaghetti sauce., Stuff cheese mixture into shells., Pour spaghetti sauce over shells., Use a 9 x 13-inch pan. Top with shredded cheese. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Mandarin Orange And Cashew Chicken
directions: Drain oranges, reserving 2 tablespoons syrup., Blend syrup with stir-fry sauce., Heat 2 tablespoons oil in wok or skillet (high heat)., Add chicken, cashews and garlic; stir-fry for 3 minutes., Remove from pan., Heat remaining oil in same pan., Add onion and snow peas., Stir-fry for 3 minutes and then add chicken, cashews and stir-fry sauce mixture., Cook and stir to coat all ingredients., Remove from heat and stir in oranges., Serve on rice.

title: Pumpkin Pie(Sugar-Free)
directions: Mix all ingredients until well blended., Pour into unbaked 8-inch pie shell., Bake 10 minutes at 450°. Then 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Cranberry Relish
directions: Grind cranberries and apple., Add the sugar., Stir and let stand overnight in the refrigerator., Add remaining ingredients and mix well.

title: Orange Nut Bread
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Sift together flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda and salt in a large bowl. Stir in nuts and orange peel., Mix egg, orange juice and salad oil in a small bowl., Add liquid mixture to dry mix and blend well., Pour into greased loaf pan. Bake at 350° for 55 minutes. Do not overbake. Cool in pan on rack for 10 minutes before removing from pan. Makes 1 loaf.

title: Ham And Onion Quiche
directions: Bake pie shells at 450° for 6 minutes.	Always prick bottom and sides of crusts with a	fork before baking., Remove shells from oven; reduce heat to 350°., Toss ham in 1 tablespoon flour, then sprinkle ham over bottom of pie shells., Sprinkle Cheddar cheese over ham., Beat remaining ingredients together and pour mixture into shells., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until knife inserted comes out clean.

title: Easy Lemon Pie(No Bake)
directions: In medium mixing bowl, blend cream cheese, lemonade and condensed milk until smooth., Add a few drops of food coloring. Blend well., Squeeze 1/2 lemon into mixture., Add Cool Whip and blend for a few minutes., Pour into pie crust., Chill 2 to 3 hours.

title: Shredded Carrot And Egg Salad
directions: In a medium bowl, combine carrot, onion, eggs and salt., Add salad dressing., Toss to combine., Refrigerate about 2 hours to allow flavors to blend., Yields 4 servings.

title: Cheese And Apple Spread
directions: Combine softened cream cheese and salad dressing, mixing well. Add cheese and apples; mix well., Chill., Serve with apple wedges, crackers and bread., Makes 1 2/3 cups.

title: Easy Rotini Salad
directions: Mix vinegar and sugar; slowly add oil., Add cooked rotini and green pepper.

title: Edna'S Cornbread
directions: Mix corn, eggs and sour cream together., Add meal., Bake at 400° for 20 minutes., Makes 16.

title: Potato Pudding
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Using a large bowl, beat eggs well. Add flour, salt, baking powder and butter to eggs and beat well until all is dissolved., Add potatoes and onions and mix well. Don't be afraid to use your hands!, Pour into brownie pan and bake for 1 hour., Enjoy!

title: Monster Chip Cookies
directions: In large mixing bowl, cream shortening, butter and sugar until light and fluffy (about 5 minutes)., Add eggs one at a time, beating each well., Add vanilla and lemon juice. Combine flour, oats, baking soda, salt and cinnamon., Add to creamed mixture. Mix well., Stir in chips and nuts., Drop by 1/4 c. three inches apart on lightly greased baking sheet., Bake at 350° for 14-16 minutes or until lightly browned and set in center., Cool two minutes before removing to wire rack.

title: Recipe For A Happy Marriage
directions: Take one child., Mix with generous pats of good humor and understanding., Blend in discipline as needed., Surround with music, love of nature, pets and friends., Bake in a warm, pleasant atmosphere., Use large amounts of patience., Do not be discouraged if at times objects do not seem to be turning out to your perfection., Continue basting., Before you realize it, your delight turns out even better than you had even hoped for., Release when properly aged.

title: Sugar Cookies
directions: Cream oleo, vegetable oil, sugar, powdered sugar, vanilla and eggs. Add flour, salt and soda. Roll a teaspoon of dough into a ball. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Press lightly with floured fork. Works best if dough is chilled. Bake at 375° for 12 minutes.

title: Cicoria Fina Agliata(Dandelion Sauteed With Garlic)
directions: Clean and wash greens, cut in half., Place in saucepan., Cook for 10 to 15 minutes or until tender., Remove and drain., Heat oil and garlic in frying pan., Place greens in pan., Stir with wooden spoon until slightly dry., Serve hot., Serves 6 to 8.

title: French Onion Soup
directions: Saute onions until golden in margarine., Add water; bring to boil., Add bouillon cubes and Worcestershire sauce., Simmer 1/2 hour, or until ready to eat., Add grated cheese just before putting in bowls., In individual bowls, add croutons., Put Mozzarella cheese over top in each bowl., Melt cheese in microwave or oven.

title: Buttermilk Chicken
directions: Melt 1 stick of butter in a flat casserole dish., Salt, pepper and flour chicken pieces., Place in dish and bake for 30 minutes at 350°., Turn over and bake for 15 minutes more., Mix cream of chicken soup with buttermilk and pour over chicken., Cover and bake for 15 minutes longer., Serve with rice.

title: Dill Dip
directions: Mix all ingredients together well. Serve over sliced cucumbers.

title: Jello Pie
directions: Mix first 3 ingredients well; let come to boil., Add jello. Mix and let cool., Chill milk., Beat until stiff and add all together., Pour in crust.

title: Beef Stroganoff
directions: Tenderize meat; brown steak quickly in 3 tablespoons oil., Add mushrooms, onion soup and water., Bring to boil., Mix sour cream and flour., Add to meat and simmer until sauce is thick.

title: Devil'S Food Sour Cream Cake
directions: Combine all ingredients; bake at 350° for about 30 minutes in 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Buttermilk Pancakes
directions: Beat all ingredients together with a spoon., Cook quickly on a hot griddle., Yields 12 to 15 pancakes.

title: Creole Black-Eyed Peas
directions: Sort and wash peas., Place in Dutch oven., Cover with water. Soak overnight., Drain peas., Add pork., Cover with water., Cover and cook 45 minutes., Add all other ingredients except sausage. Cover and cook, 1 1/2 hours., Stir occasionally., Add sausage. Cook, uncovered, over low heat 45 minutes., Serve over cooked rice., Serves 10.

title: Quick Vegetable Bread
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Butter an 8 x 5-inch loaf pan., Chop the spinach., Grate the carrot., Chop the scallion., In a large bowl, combine flour, 2 tablespoons Parmesan, sugar, baking powder, salt, thyme and nutmeg., In a separate bowl, combine the milk, oil and egg., Stir the milk mixture, chopped vegetables and pimento into the flour mixture until all ingredients are just moistened., Spoon batter into the prepared pan., Sprinkle with the remaining 2 tablespoons Parmesan., Bake until a toothpick stuck into the center comes out clean, 55 to 60 minutes., Cool 10 minutes. Remove from the pan; cool completely.

title: Cabbage Casserole
directions: Cook cabbage and onion until tender and drain water. Place cooked cabbage in casserole dish sprayed with Pam. In a bowl, mix soup, mayonnaise and salt and pepper. Pour over cabbage. In another bowl, mix crushed Ritz crackers, butter and cheese. Spread over cabbage and soup mixture. Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes or until golden brown. Do not overbake or cheese gets too brown.

title: Dried Beef Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients together and let stand in refrigerator overnight., Bake in 350° oven from 45 to 60 minutes., Serve hot. (If you use a dish that can be taken out of the refrigerator and put right in the oven, that will be the best.)

title: Chicken Pot Pie
directions: Combine the first 6 ingredients., Spoon into prepared pie crust., Cover with top crust; crimp edges to seal., Slit top crust; brush with egg, if desired., Bake at 375° for 40 minutes. Cool 10 minutes.

title: Shrimp Creole Microwave
directions: Place butter in 2 1/2-quart casserole., Heat full power 20 to 30 seconds or until melted., Stir in green pepper, onion and celery. Cook full power 6 to 8 minutes until vegetables are tender. Stir halfway through. Sprinkle vegetables with flour and stir to blend., Mix in tomatoes. Cook full power until heated, 4 to 6 minutes. Stir halfway through cooking time. Blend in remaining ingredients. Cook full power about 6 minutes, or until shrimp are fully cooked., Stir twice during time., Remove bay leaf.

title: Fruit Pizza
directions: Prepare cookie mix as directed on box., Spread in pizza pan and bake at 375°, for 12 minutes., Cool., Sprinkle with sugar before baking.

title: Chocolate Chunkies Cookies
directions: Combine flour, baking soda and salt., Beat butter and brown sugar in a large bowl at medium speed until creamy., Beat in egg until light and fluffy., Beat in melted chocolate and vanilla., At low speed, beat in flour mixture., Fold in nuts, chocolate and candies., Grease baking sheets., Drop dough by tablespoons, 2 inches apart on prepared pans., Bake in preheated 350° oven for 10 to 12 minutes., Cool cookies on rack., Makes 2 1/2 dozen.

title: Zucchini Pie
directions: Peel and dice zucchini., Mix zucchini, Bisquick and oil in bowl., Mix well., Then add eggs, one at a time., Add remaining ingredients and bake at 350° for 45 to 60 minutes.

title: Chocolate Covered Peanut Butter Balls
directions: Mix together and shape into balls., Dip into melted chocolate.

title: Linguine With Clam Sauce
directions: Saute onion in butter until tender., Add the juice from the clams, seasonings, condensed cream of mushroom soup and white wine., Simmer covered for 10 minutes.

title: S'More Cookie Bars
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Grease 8-inch square baking pan., In large mixing bowl, beat butter and sugar until light and fluffy., Add egg and vanilla; beat well., Stir together flour, crumbs, baking powder and salt., Add to the butter mixture and beat until well blended., Press 1/2 dough into pan., Arrange bars over dough, breaking as needed to fit., Spread with Marshmallow Creme. Scatter bits of remaining dough over Marshmallow Creme; carefully press to form a layer., Bake 30 to 35 minutes., Cool completely and cut.

title: Deep Dish Pie (Has No Bottom Crust)
directions: You will need 1 greased casserole dish.

title: Bread And Butter Pickles
directions: Cover pickles and onions with water and salt., Let soak for 3 hours., Drain., Mix together 10 cups water, turmeric, mustard seed, celery seed, vinegar and sugar and pour over pickles., Heat and put in jars and seal.

title: Chicken Enchiladas Casserole Style
directions: Place first 7 ingredients in saucepan; heat to boil., Reduce heat., Add sour cream (do not boil after adding)., Place a couple of spoonfuls in the bottom of 4-cup crock-pot., Layer tortillas, soup mixture and cheese., Cook on low for the afternoon., Let stand 10 minutes if there is too much liquid or cook a bit longer. Dinner is ready when lessons are finished., Serve with tossed green salad.

title: Turkey Keema
directions: Heat oil and fry onion until golden brown., Add ginger and garlic, fry for a few more minutes., Add ground turkey, tomatoes and all the spices; fry for a few more minutes., Add 2 to 3 cups water and cook until turkey is tender and gravy is thick.

title: Zucchini Bread(2 Loaves)
directions: Beat eggs until fluffy and slowly add remaining ingredients. Pour into 2 well-greased and floured loaf pans and bake in 325° oven for 60 minutes or until done., Invert and cool loaves on racks.

title: Play Clay
directions: Preheat oven to 300°., Mix all ingredients together in bowl. Work the mixture with your hands until it feels well mixed., Shape the dough into decorations like stars or snowmen or cut with cookie cutters., Be sure to make small hole in the top or push a paper clip into the dough.

title: Easy 1 Hour Rolls
directions: Heat milk to lukewarm., Add oil., Mix yeast and sugar into a small amount of warm water to dissolve yeast., Add to milk mixture and then dry ingredients. Roll out on floured board and knead well. Cut out biscuits and place in oiled pan., Let rise 45 minutes or until doubled in size., Bake at 400° for 20 minutes or until browned.

title: Cheddar Cheese Soup
directions: Combine first 5 ingredients in a covered pan and simmer until vegetables are tender, about 10 minutes., Add cheese, stirring over low heat until cheese is melted., Whisk in beer and stir until well blended.

title: Baked Bluefish Fillets With Creole Sauce
directions: Mix the first 5 ingredients together in a 2-quart pan and saute together for 10 minutes over medium heat., Add remaining ingredients, all but bluefish fillets and mix well over medium-low heat until vegetables are fully cooked, about 15 minutes., While this is cooking, bake bluefish fillets in a 400° oven until fully cooked, approximately 30 minutes., When fish is cooked, portion on plates and top with Creole sauce.

title: Pizza Bread
directions: Thaw frozen bread dough., Roll dough into 2 (14 x 8-inch) rectangles., Beat together eggs, Parmesan cheese and oregano. Spread egg mixture on dough, reserving 3 tablespoons., Top with cheese and melt., Roll up from long edge and pinch seams to seal. Place seam side down in greased pan., Brush top of loaves with remaining egg mixture., Bake 20 to 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Fortune Cookies
directions: Write fortunes on strips of paper., Mix sugar into egg whites and blend until fluffy., Melt butter and let cool until warm., Add flour, salt, vanilla and butter to the sugar mixture., Beat until the batter is smooth., Pour batter from a spoon to form circles on a well-greased cookie sheet., Bake at 375° about 8 minutes., Lay a message on each cookie; fold in thirds, then bend it gently in the center., If cookies get too hard to bend, return to oven for about 1 minute.

title: Corn Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients. Store in refrigerator., Keeps well for several days.

title: "Jiffy" Spoon Bread
directions: Scald milk. Beat eggs in a bowl until light and frothy. When milk is scalded, add corn muffin mix and beat. Then add eggs. Pour into casserole dish margarine which has been melted. Bake in 425° to 450° oven for 25 to 30 minutes. Leftovers are good with syrup for breakfast.

title: Double Layer Pumpkin Pie
directions: Mix cream cheese, 1 tablespoon milk and sugar in a large bowl with a wire whisk until smooth. Gently stir in Cool Whip. Spread on bottom of crust.

title: Escallop Corn
directions: Combine all ingredients., Bake in a greased, uncovered container, 45 minutes at 325°.

title: Oh-So Easy Bars
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Grease and flour the bottom only of a 9 x 13-inch pan., Reserve 1/4 cup of the M&M's., Mix remaining ingredients together., Spread in pan., Sprinkle with reserved candies., Bake about 30 minutes, until light golden brown; cool. Cut into bars., Makes about 3 dozen.

title: Lemon Chiffon Cake
directions: Separate eggs., In egg whites, add 1/2 tsp. cream of tartar and beat well until very stiff., In yolks, add flour, sugar, salt, baking powder, oil, extract, rind and water., Beat well until creamy., Fold into egg whites, do not beat., Pour into 10 inch tube pan., Do not grease., Bake at 325° for 50 minutes and 375° for 10 minutes more.

title: Pecan Pralines
directions: Combine sugar, buttermilk, soda, oleo and Karo., Cook over low heat until candy makes hard ball in cold water, about 45 to 55 minutes., Add pecans and vanilla., Start beating by hand until it gets thick and loses its sheen., Drop on wax paper and cool.

title: One Pan Dinner
directions: In electric frypan, brown pork chops and onion., Wash sweet potatoes and microwave 10 minutes on High.

title: Frankfurters And Sauerkraut
directions: Combine first 4 ingredients, and cook 1 to 1 1/2 hours, the longer the better., Add frankfurters and cook 30 minutes longer.

title: Cherries In The Snow
directions: Break up angel food cake into bite-size pieces., Place pieces in bottom of casserole dish., For ease in mixing allow cream cheese to soften out of refrigerator for a couple of hours., With wire whisk, blend together cream cheese, whipped topping and sugar until nearly smooth., Layer this mixture on top of cake pieces. Top dessert with one or both cans of pie filling depending on your liking., Because of layering, a deep dish is best., However, if using a shallow pan, at least 9 x 13-inch is recommended.

title: Manicotti(Jean Stapleton'S Recipe)
directions: Grease griddle lightly., Wipe away excess grease with paper towel., Put one teaspoonful batter on griddle., These do not need to brown., Do not turn., They are done when top appears dry.

title: Angel Food Cake And Strawberries
directions: Mix jello according to directions minus 1 cup of cold water. Refrigerate until partly set., Mix in Cool Whip and strawberries. Mix well., Add angel food cake and stir just until mixed. Refrigerate until set., This is better is it is made a day ahead of time.

title: Before Breakfast
directions: Fry sausage and, drain, off fat., Beat eggs., Add milk, salt and mustard., Layer in 9, x 13-inch baking dish or pan:, bread, sausage and cheese., Pour egg mixture over all., Put in cold oven. Set temperature at 350°., Bake 45 minutes.

title: Spanish Cabbage
directions: Fry bacon; break in pieces., Saute onion and green pepper. Chop cabbage., Add tomatoes, salt and pepper and vinegar., Put all in one pot and boil until cabbage is done.

title: Frozen Fruit Salad
directions: Dissolve jello and salt in boiling water., Drain pineapple, measuring syrup., Add water to make 1/2 cup if necessary., Stir into gelatin with lemon juice., Blend in mayonnaise., Chill until very thick., Fold fruits, nuts and Cool Whip into jello., Pour into 2 freezing trays or a 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan., Freeze until firm or at least 3 to 4 hours., To serve, cut in squares or slices., Makes about 8 servings.

title: Herbed Toast
directions: Preheat broiler., In small mixing bowl, combine margarine, basil and parsley; mix thoroughly., Onto each slice of bread, spread half of the margarine mixture; sprinkle half of the cheese on each slice of bread., On nonstick baking sheet, arrange bread slices, herb-side up, and broil until cheese is golden, about 1 minute.

title: 8 Layer Salad
directions: In a 9 x 13-inch pan, layer as follows:, 1/2 head shredded lettuce, bacon, eggs, peas, onion, mixed dressing, ham and Swiss cheese., Press down after each layer., The dressings will spread thickly over entire surface and top with ham and cheese., Cover with Glad Wrap and refrigerate at least 12 hours.

title: Cole Slaw Without Mayonnaise
directions: Grate or shred cabbage and soak in water for an hour Drain and rinse well and pat off water., Mix sour cream, sugar and cider vinegar well and pour over cabbage and mix well., If using caraway seeds, spin then in the blender long enough to release the oils and mix in the slaw.

title: Pineapple Cream Cheese Pie
directions: Blend 1/2 of the sugar with cornstarch. Add pineapple with juice. Cook, stirring constantly, until mixture is thick and clear. Cool. Blend cream cheese (softened at room temperature) with 1/2 cup sugar and salt. Add eggs, one at a time, stirring well after each egg is added. Blend in milk and vanilla. Spread the cooked pineapple mixture over the bottom of pastry shell. Pour in cream cheese mixture and sprinkle with pecans. Bake at 425° for 10 minutes. Reduce heat to 325° and bake 50 minutes. Cool before serving. Serves 7 or 8.

title: Chocolate Pie (No Cook)
directions: Combine sugar and butter., Beat in electric mixer at medium speed five minutes., Add chocolate and one egg; beat five minutes. Add other egg, vanilla and salt; beat five minutes., Fold in whipped cream., Spoon in baked pie shell and chill.

title: Sauerkraut Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients together and chill., This will keep covered in refrigerator for a week, a, month, or until all has been eaten.

title: Strawberry Pie
directions: Prepare your crust., Cook crushed strawberries., After cooked until clear, add 1 Knox gelatine dissolved in 2 tablespoons cold water., Add berries into baked pie shell.

title: Smothered Deer Tips
directions: Cut stew meat into small pieces and brown in cooking oil. Remove meat and saute onion and garlic in the oil., When onion is tender, put the meat back into oil with onion and garlic., Add flour and toss until blended., Salt and pepper to taste., Lower heat and slowly add water until sauce is not too thick., Add Kitchen Bouquet to darken and simmer on low flame until meat is tender, about 1 hour.

title: Banana Cream Cheese Pie
directions: In a large mixer bowl, beat cheese until fluffy., Gradually beat in sweetened condensed milk until smooth., Stir in ReaLemon and vanilla., Slice 2 bananas; dip in lemon juice., Drain and line crust., Pour over bananas; cover., Chill 3 hours or until set. Before serving, slice remaining bananas; dip in lemon juice, drain and garnish top of pie., Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Coconut Pie(Makes Its Own Crust)
directions: Mix eggs, sugar, flour, oleo, milk, coconut and vanilla., Pour into 10-inch pie pan., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Golden Chicken
directions: Place chicken parts in a single layer in large baking pan. Cover with soup, onion and Chablis wine., Cover dish., Bake at 350° for 1 hour., Serve with rice and vegetable.

title: Spaghetti Salad
directions: Mix well and refrigerate overnight., Serve cold!

title: Taco Salad
directions: Mix the first 4 ingredients together., When ready to eat, add dressing and mix, then add crushed Fritos.

title: Sour Cream Chocolate Cake
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Measure all ingredients into a large bowl. Mix 1/2 minute on low speed, scraping bowl constantly., Beat 3 minutes at high speed, scraping bowl occasionally., Pour into prepared pans., Bake 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Snickerdoodles
directions: In a mixing bowl beat margarine with an electric mixer on medium to high speed for 30 seconds., Add about half of the flour, the 1 cup sugar, the egg, vanilla, baking soda, and cream of tartar., Beat until thoroughly combined., Beat in remaining flour. Shape dough into 1-inch balls., Combine the 2 tablespoons sugar and the cinnamon., Roll balls in sugar cinnamon., Place 2 inches apart on an ungreased cookie sheet., Bake at 375° for 10 to 11 minutes or until edges are golden., Makes about 36.

title: Penne Pasta
directions: Cook pasta. In a skillet, combine all other ingredients and simmer. Drain pasta and combine with heated tomato mixture. Top with Parmesan cheese.

title: John'S Favorite Buffalo Wings
directions: Melt butter and mix with red hot sauce., Cook wings in oven at 325° for 1 hour., After hour is up, pour sauce mixture over wings. Turn oven up to 425° and cook for 1 more hour., Serve hot with Blue cheese salad dressing for dipping.

title: President Clinton'S Lemon Chess Pie
directions: In a large bowl, toss sugar, flour and cornmeal with a fork. Add remaining ingredients and mix well., Pour into pie shell and bake at 450° for 10 minutes. Reduce heat to 350° and bake for 30 minutes., Serve at room temperature or slightly chilled.

title: Crispy Oven Fried Chicken
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., Lightly spray cookie sheet with nonstick spray., Roll chicken pieces in flour to evenly cover all sides., Dip chicken in egg white and roll in cornflake crumbs. Place on prepared cookie sheet., Bake 20 - 30 minutes for boneless breast halves or 45 - 55 minutes for chicken pieces.

title: Hamburger And Rice Casserole
directions: Add garlic, onion flakes, basil flakes and mushrooms to olive oil; mix well., Add tomatoes and cook for 1/2 hour., Brown crumbled hamburger., Add eggs to cool rice., Add hamburger and rice mixture to the tomato mixture., Put in 2 or 3-quart casserole., Add salt, to taste (optional)., Bake at 325° for 45 minutes., Sprinkle top with Parmesan cheese before serving.

title: Sausage Rice Casserole
directions: Cook rice as directed on package., Chop onion, pepper and celery., Brown sausage and drain, then add vegetables., Cook until vegetables are limp., Add rice and soup and pour into greased 3-quart casserole dish., Cover and bake for 1 hour at 325°.

title: Alkali Bars
directions: Bring to a boil the raisins and water., Turn off heat., Stir in salad oil; cool to lukewarm., Stir in sugar and egg., Sift together flour and spices., Beat dry ingredients into raisin mixture., Stir in the walnuts., Pour into a greased baking pan. Bake at 375° for 20 minutes., Dust with powdered sugar while still warm.

title: Baked Hash Brown Potato Casserole
directions: Mix well first 6 ingredients and place in greased 9 x 13 baking dish. Sprinkle with paprika. Combine 1 1/2 sticks melted margarine and crackers and spread on top of potatoes. Bake at 350° for 1 hour. Cover loosely with foil during latter part of baking to prevent drying out. Serves 12-15.

title: Quail Our Favorite Way
directions: Shake salt over each quail, covering all parts., Put quail in sack with flour and shake well., Oil should be hot enough that it bubbles when quail are placed in it., Put quail in oil with breast side down., Turn when browned with total cooking time not over 10 minutes., Remove quail to drain on paper towel., Pour off oil into container, reserving enough oil and drippings to make gravy.

title: Oatmeal Fudge
directions: Bring sugar, cocoa, butter and milk to a boil., Boil for 2 minutes., Add vanilla and nuts., Stir in oatmeal., Drop by tablespoon onto well buttered wax paper., Cool.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Layer ingredients (in order listed) in greased 1 1/2-quart casserole. Cover; bake in a 350° oven for 30 minutes. Remove cover and bake 5 minutes or until cheese is melted. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Peach Almond Cream Tart
directions: Bake pie shell at 375° for 15 minutes., In bowl, combine condensed milk, sour cream, lemon and extract; mix well. Reserving 6 peach slices, spread remaining filling on bottom of pie shell., Top with sour cream mixture., Top with reserved peach slices and almonds., Bake 30 minutes at 375°., Cool., Refrigerate.

title: Hungry Jack'S Pancakes
directions: Break eggs into a bowl and beat with a fork., Add buttermilk and mix well., Add remaining ingredients and mix just long enough to blend well., Pour onto hot griddle and brown lightly on both sides.

title: Hamburger Soup
directions: In large saucepan or kettle having a lid, brown meat in oil. Add salt, spices and onion soup mix., Stir in boiling water, tomato sauce and soy sauce., Cook and simmer about 15 minutes.

title: Banana Pudding
directions: Blend 3/4 cup sugar, flour and salt in top of double boiler. Add milk slowly and cook until thick, stirring constantly., Cover and cook for 10 minutes., Beat egg yolks; combine with custard. Cook 2 minutes longer., Add vanilla.

title: Taco Dip
directions: Mix fried hamburger and seasoning., Put in bottom of baking dish., Heat refried beans and spread over top., Mix sour cream, chili dip and cheese., Spread over beans., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes., Heat Tostitos and serve.

title: Breakfast Egg Casserole
directions: Brown sausage and drain., Beat eggs and add milk., Add salt and mustard., Cube bread; stir into eggs., Add cheese and sausage. Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan for 45 minutes at 350°.

title: Crabmeat Dip
directions: Heat all ingredients in a double boiler., Serve warm with crackers.

title: Old Fashioned Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Simmer raisins and water in saucepan over low heat until raisins are plump, 20 to 30 minutes., Drain water into measuring cup., Add water to make 1/2 cup., Heat oven to 400°., Cream shortening, sugar, eggs and vanilla., Stir in raisin liquid. Blend flour, baking powder, soda, salt and spices., Stir in., Add rolled oats, nuts and raisins., Drop rounded teaspoonfuls 2-inches apart onto ungreased baking sheet., Bake 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Punch For A Bunch
directions: Mix and chill., Freeze some of the punch in a mold to keep cold., Do not add ice., The ice will melt and water down the punch.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
directions: Mix beaten eggs, syrup, sugar, peanut butter and vanilla together. Pour in unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes until crust is brown.

title: Fat-Free Fudge Brownies
directions: Combine flour, cocoa, sugar and salt., Stir to mix well., Stir in applesauce, egg whites and vanilla., Fold in nuts, if desired. Coat an 8-inch square pan with nonstick cooking spray., Spread batter evenly in pan and bake at 325° for 23 to 25 minutes or until the edges are firm and the center is almost set., Cool to room temperature., Cut into squares and serve., Yields 16 servings. Contains 80 calories and 4 grams fat.

title: Cheese Broccoli Soup
directions: In large saucepan, boil/steam broccoli in 1/2 cup water. Remove about 1/4 of the broccoli and set aside., Put remaining broccoli in blender and puree until smooth., In large saucepan over medium heat, combine flour, butter and 1 cup of water until creamy., Pour mixture from blender into flour mixture., Rinse blender with 1/2 water and cream or evaporated milk and pour in flour-broccoli., Stir and season with spices., Microwave Cheez Whiz and stir into soup., Chop broccoli that was set aside and add to soup., Heat thoroughly.

title: Chow Mein Casserole
directions: Lightly brown beef, onions and celery; add remaining ingredients and stir well., Pour into greased casserole dish. Bake for 1 1/2 hours in 350° oven.

title: Super Potato Casserole
directions: Mix together first 3 ingredients; add onions, salt, pepper and sour cream., Place in casserole., Dot with 2 tablespoons butter. Bake for 25 minutes at 350°.

title: Quick Chicken Casserole
directions: Mix broth and soup together., Heat until mixed well., Pour over chicken.

title: Steak House-Style Grilled Steak
directions: Mix seasonings and brown sugar., Brush steaks with oil. Sprinkle seasoning mixture over both sides; press into steaks. Place steaks on medium-hot grill., Grill 6 to 8 minutes on each side or until cooked to desired doneness.

title: Quick Cherry Dessert
directions: In large bowl, cream together oleo and sugar., Add eggs; beat until light and fluffy., Add almond extract., Stir in flour and baking powder., Mix until smooth., Butter a 13 x 9-inch cake pan. Pour batter in pan., Spoon pie filling with the cake mixture in different places., Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes, or until golden and cake tests done., Filling will sink into the cake while baking., Serve warm with sweetened whipping cream or Cool Whip.

title: Vietnamese Spring Rolls(Goi)
directions: *Or 1 pound large, cleaned and deveined shrimp or 8 ounces boiled breast of chicken, minced.

title: Mexican Dip
directions: Spread refried beans on serving dish., Then layer on green chiles., Mix taco seasoning mix with 1/2 of the jar of chunky salsa sauce., Layer this on serving dish., Add grated Cheddar cheese., Layer sour cream., Spread the chopped green scallions. Then sprinkle remainder of salsa sauce on top., Keep refrigerated. Can use corn chips or tostadas to scoop the dip up., Use 12 x 8 x 2-inch dish or round plate.

title: Pumpkin Bread
directions: Cream sugar and oil together., Add eggs and pumpkin; mix well. Sift together dry ingredients, add alternately with water to pumpkin mixture., Pour into 2 well-greased and floured 9 x 5-inch loaf pans., Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours or until tests done., Let stand 10 minutes., Remove from pan to cool.

title: Pineapple Sweet Potatoes
directions: Boil potatoes until tender (approximately 30 minutes)., Remove skins., Preheat oven to 425°., Lightly spray a 1-quart baking dish with vegetable spray., Mash potatoes., Add pineapple juice, oil and whip until fluffy., Add pineapple, cinnamon, nutmeg and allspice., Mix well., Place in baking dish., Spread molasses over the top., Dot with margarine., Bake, uncovered, for 15 minutes or until thoroughly heated.

title: Oreo Cookie Dessert
directions: Line bottom of dish with 1/2 crushed cookies., Then spread pudding., Then spread rest of crushed cookies., Spread Cool Whip and then nuts.

title: Chocolate Peppermint Pie
directions: Combine cocoa and sugar., Add to pudding mix and prepare as directed on package., Cool; add vanilla., Whip cream and fold into chocolate mixture., Pour into peppermint stick ice cream shells. Freeze.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
directions: Sift dry ingredients together., Add oil and vanilla., Beat until smooth., Beat eggs until foamy., Add sugar and blend together., Fold into batter., Add nuts and apples., Pour into greased tube pan., Bake 1 hour at 350°.

title: Brunch Casserole
directions: Brown pork sausage., Drain and crumble., Mix all other ingredients together., Put in greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Refrigerate overnight., Bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes until set and brown., Serve hot., Serves 6.

title: Crystal'S Crab Mold
directions: In large bowl, dissolve the gelatine in water., Heat soup and add to gelatine., Add rest of ingredients; mix and mold (i.e., Tupperware jello mold container)., Chill 6 hours., Unmold., Serve with crackers.

title: Fried Green Tomatoes
directions: In a bowl, whisk together buttermilk, 1 tablespoon flour, 1/2 teaspoon salt, 1/2 teaspoon pepper., Immerse tomato slices in mixture., In a heavy skillet, heat over moderate heat until candy thermometer registers 350°., While oil is heating, whisk together the remaining flour, salt and pepper., Dredge tomatoes (1 at a time) in seasoned flour, shaking off excess and fry in batches of 6 (do not crowd in skillet) until golden brown on both sides. Transfer slices to paper towel to drain., Sprinkle with salt.

title: Peg'S Shrimp Yummies
directions: Place cheese on dish., Pour 3/4 sauce over cheese., Place shrimp on top and add rest of sauce., Sprinkle with green onions. Place crackers around dish.

title: Zucchini-Stuffing Casserole
directions: Cook squash until tender, drain, mash lightly and drain again. Make stuffing according to directions., Layer 1/2 of stuffing on bottom of 9 x 12-inch casserole dish., Mix rest of ingredients together, layer and then top with remaining stuffing., Bake at 350° for 45 to 60 minutes.

title: Tater Tot Casserole
directions: Brown ground beef with onion, bell pepper and season to taste. Layer in dish with frozen vegetables and mushroom soup., Add a layer of Velveeta cheese. Top with a layer of Tater Tots and bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Lemon Pineapple Salad
directions: Melt marshmallows in milk over low heat; pour jello in, stirring until dissolved., Combine softened cream cheese and mayonnaise, mixing until well blended., Gradually add jello mixture, mixing until well blended., Stir in pineapple., Chill until slightly thickened., Fold in whipped cream., Pour into 2-quart mold; chill until firm., Unmold if you like., Makes 12 servings.

title: Chocolate Pudding Cake
directions: Mix brown sugar and cocoa in 13 x 9 pan., Stir in water until well blended. Snip marshmallows into quarters and scatter over mixture., Prepare cake batter and spoon over mixture., Top with nuts., Bake for 45-50 minutes at 350 degrees., Serve warm, topped with whipped cream or ice cream., Delicious!

title: Chuckwagon Stew
directions: Coat beef in mixture of flour, paprika, 1 teaspoon chili powder and salt., Brown in hot fat in large Dutch oven., Add onion and garlic; cooking until soft.

title: French Pastries
directions: Press 1 can of crescent rolls into a 13 x 9-inch pan, sealing perforations., Cream 1 cup sugar with cream cheese and vanilla. Spread this over dough., Top with remaining can of dough., Brush with egg yolk., Sprinkle with remaining 1/4 cup of sugar and pecans., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes., Best when served same day at room temperature.

title: Golden Ruhl Broccoli
directions: Cut off tips of broccoli only and steam or boil until almost done., Meanwhile, mix soup, eggs, onions, mayonnaise and cheese and put in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish.

title: Frozen Fruit Salad
directions: Cream sugar and cream cheese. Add strawberries and juice, pineapple and bananas, nuts, Cool Whip and lemon, juice., Put in a 9 x 13-inch pan or 24 muffin paper cups. Freeze.

title: Spaghetti-N-Meat
directions: Melt butter in skillet., Add bell pepper, onion, celery and ground chuck., Cook slow until done., Mix in spaghetti mix, Ragu sauce and tomato sauce., Simmer 20 minutes., Boil spaghetti. Rinse with cold water., Add to the meat sauce., Cook for 10 more minutes., Cover with cheese., Put lid on pot., Turn off heat. Serve with salad or cold slaw and garlic bread.

title: Ham And Egg Pasta
directions: Cook fettuccini to desired doneness as directed on package. Drain; rinse with hot water., Keep warm., In large skillet over medium-high heat, heat oil., Saute onions for 1 to 2 minutes or until crisp-tender., Reduce heat to medium., Stir in sour cream, milk, parsley, salt and pepper., Cook, stirring constantly, until hot., Do not boil., Stir in turkey ham, egg wedges and fettuccini; toss gently., Makes 4 (1 1/2 cup) servings.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
directions: Prepare apples., Put a little lemon juice over them; set aside and cover., Add sugar and, eggs, to, oil; mix well at low speed until creamy and, smooth., Sift, flour and measure., Sift again with salt, soda and, baking powder., Add flour mixture to creamed mixture a little at, a, time., Fold, in well after each addition; add vanilla., When, batter, is stiff, remove beaters and finish mixing by hand., Fold in apples and nuts., Bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan for 55 minutes to 1 hour at 350°.

title: Saucy Apple Swirl
directions: Grease and flour tube pan. Put 1/2 batter in pan. Mix sugar and cinnamon and sprinkle most over batter., Also, sprinkle most of nuts., Add rest of batter and sprinkle rest of nuts and sugar-cinnamon., Bake in 350° oven for 35 to 45 minutes, sometimes longer.

title: Unbaked Fruit Cake
directions: Crush vanilla wafers. Cut candied fruit into pieces., Leave nuts whole., Mix all ingredients except milk and marshmallows. Melt marshmallows in milk and mix with other ingredients., When mixed well, pack in angel food pan or 3 small loaf pans., When cool, remove from pan and wrap in wax paper at room temperature.

title: Apple Crisp
directions: Heat oven to 375° and grease an 8 x 8 x 2-inch baking pan. Place applesauce in the bottom of the pan., Mix remaining ingredients in mixing bowl and sprinkle on top of the applesauce. Bake until golden brown, 15 to 20 minutes and serve warm., Makes 6 servings.

title: Holiday Hermit Cookies
directions: Beat shortening and sugars together until creamy., Beat in eggs., Sift dry ingredients., Add to cream mixture along with buttermilk, beginning and ending with dry ingredients., Stir in the remaining ingredients., Drop by teaspoonfuls onto a lightly greased cookie sheet., Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Pinto Bean Pie
directions: Combine first 5 ingredients., Mix well; pour into pie shell. Bake at 350° until firm.

title: Cranberry Relish
directions: Prepare the cranberries and apples in a food processor or blender., Mix together the oranges, sugar and dry Jell-O, then combine all ingredients together., It is best to let the relish set a couple of days before you use it., The relish can also be frozen.

title: Seviche - Raw Fish, Mexican Style And Salsa(Actually The Lemon Juice Cooks The Fish, So It'S Not Really Raw.)
directions: *Vary the number of chilies according to your "heat tolerance" or just don't use them., I prefer at least 3.

title: Pumpkin Rolls
directions: Combine 2 cups flour and yeast., In saucepan, heat milk, shortening, sugar and salt until warm., Add to dry mixture., Add egg and pumpkin., Beat at low speed 1/2 minute., Beat 3 minutes on high., Stir in enough remaining flour to make soft dough.

title: Surprise Supper
directions: You will also need 4 (18 x 12-inch) pieces heavy aluminum foil.

title: Rhubarb Cream Pie
directions: Mix sugar and flour; add cream, egg, vanilla and nutmeg., Mix well with eggbeater or wire whisk., Put rhubarb in pie shell; pour cream mixture over rhubarb., Push the rhubarb pieces down so they will be well coated with the cream mixture., Flute edge of pie crust., Bake at 375° for 15 minutes., Reduce heat to 350° and continue baking 40 to 45 minutes or until done.

title: Communion Bread
directions: Mix dry ingredients thoroughly, sifting 3 times., Add cream and milk to make a medium dough ball., Divide into 4 equal parts and knead 25 to 30 minutes., When dough is smooth and free from bubbles, roll out with rolling pin onto metal baking sheets. Measure with ruler 1-inch (prick with fork) the width of cooking sheet, all the way across (1-inch prick, 1-inch prick)., Length is 1 1/2-inches, prick (1 1/2, 3, 4 1/2, 6, 7 1/2, 9, 10 1/2, 12, 13 1/2)., Bake in slow oven 12 to 15 minutes at 375° until light brown., Cut apart lengthwise with sharp knife.

title: Corn Casserole
directions: Mix both kinds of corn, sour cream, cheese, corn meal and butter together., Then add eggs (slightly beaten) and salt and pepper., Mix well., Bake in 1 1/2-quart casserole at 325° for about 40 minutes or until center is set., If desired, you may add a cup of cooked chicken.

title: Chocolate Fried Pies
directions: In a saucepan, combine granulated sugar, flour and cocoa powder., Stir in the 1/2 cup milk and butter., Stir until blended thoroughly., Bring to a boil, stirring constantly until it thickens. Remove from heat., Add vanilla., Let cool.

title: Onion Shortcake
directions: Saute onions in oleo until tender., Add sour cream, 1/2 cup of Cheddar cheese, dill weed and salt., In a separate bowl, mix corn bread mix, milk, egg, corn and hot sauce., Spread in a 9 x 13-inch greased pan., Top with onion mixture., Top this with 1 1/2 cups Cheddar cheese., Bake at 400° for 30 minutes., (Very good leftover!)

title: Yummy Casserole
directions: Fry mushrooms in butter pan about 10 minutes; do not brown. Fry medium onion in butter., Combine ham, cheese and mushroom mixture., Place cooked noodles in greased oblong casserole., Place ham and cheese mixture over noodles., Pour half and half over top. Cover and bake at 350° for about 40 minutes.

title: Egg Salad
directions: Cut cooked eggs into pieces. Stir in other ingredients. Refrigerate.

title: Oatmeal Molasses Cookies
directions: Into a medium mixing bowl, sift together flour, soda, cloves, ginger and sugar., Add margarine, egg and molasses., Beat until smooth and stir in oats., Drop by level tablespoon 2 inches apart onto ungreased cookie sheets., Bake in a 375° oven, until lightly browned; let stand a minute before removing from pan.

title: Shrimp Cocktail
directions: Mix all ingredients; chill overnight for best flavor.

title: Tropical Pork Chops
directions: Preheat oven to 325°., Place chops in shallow baking dish. Top with pineapple and orange juice., Bake for 1 hour, uncovered.

title: Spinach-Cheese Bake
directions: Combine first 6 ingredients; stir until blended., Spoon into a greased 12 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish., Bake at 350° for 25 minutes. Top with cheese and bake 5 minutes.

title: Taco Soup
directions: Saut celery, onion and garlic in vegetable oil until tender; add the taco seasoning and 1 cup water. Stir until mixed well. Add tomatoes and all beans with juice except pinto beans (rinse and add). Bring to a boil and simmer on low for 20 minutes. Remove from heat and allow to cool.

title: Ham & Cheese Omelet Rolls
directions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees., In a bowl combine cream cheese and milk, whisk until smooth., Add flour and salt, mix well., In a separate bowl gently whisk eggs then add cream cheese mixture, mix well., Pour in a long cookie sheet (parchment paper may be used). Bake for 30 to 33 minutes or until eggs are puffy and golden. Meanwhile, finely chop ham., Remove omelet from oven, immediately spread dijon mustard, and sprinkle 1/2 of cheese, ham and green onions., Sprinkle the rest of the cheese and roll up, (like a jelly roll)., Let stand 5 minutes allowing cheese to melt., Slice and serve.

title: Jessie'S Potato Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients except salt., Add salt last to taste. Store in sealed container in refrigerator for at least 1 hour prior to serving., Serves 10.

title: Applesauce-Raisin Cookies
directions: Cream the oil and sugar together., Add the egg and beat until light., Blend in the vanilla and applesauce., Stir the flours, baking powder, baking soda, cinnamon, cloves, oats and raisins into the creamed mixture., Blend well., Drop by teaspoonfuls onto a lightly oiled baking sheet., Bake in a 375° oven for 10 minutes. Cool on a wire rack., Makes 24 cookies.

title: Strawberry Salad
directions: Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water., Add strawberries and stir until thawed., Add sliced bananas, pecans and pineapple., Pour half of mixture into 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan and hold in refrigerator until firm., Jell remaining half only to thick pouring consistency., Spread sour cream on first mixture and pour remaining half on top., Place in refrigerator to jell entire mixture.

title: Pumpkin Bread
directions: Cream together butter, sugar, and eggs. Sift together all dry ingredients. Add dry ingredients and pumpkin to creamed mixture. Add pecans and vanilla. Mix well. Bake for 55 to 60 minutes in greased and floured 9 x 13 pan, at 350 degrees.

title: Green Bean Casserole
directions: Drain green beans; place in casserole dish., Warm soup and water in saucepan; pour over beans., Cook in oven 20 minutes. Top with onion rings., Cook 10 more minutes.

title: Germany Gurting Cucumber Salad
directions: Chill cream., Wash and slice cucumbers., Sprinkle with salt and sugar; add vinegar., Allow to stand 10 minutes., Add sweet cream and mix., Chill 15 minutes before serving.

title: Mandarin Orange Cake
directions: Combine ingredients and beat until smooth., Preheat oven to 350°., Bake in greased 8 x 8-inch pan for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Apricot Nectar Cake
directions: Pour into bowl the cake mix and jello., Add oil, nectar and well beaten eggs., Mix at low speed, then beat for 2 minutes at number 4 speed., Pour into greased and floured tube pan., Bake for 45 minutes at 350°., Cool in pan.

title: Chicken Divan
directions: Mix together soup, lemon juice and mayonnaise., Cook and drain broccoli., Place in bottom of casserole., Top broccoli with chicken, then pour soup mixture over all., Sprinkle top with cheese and crumbs., Bake 25 to 30 minutes in 350° oven.

title: Watergate Salad(Pistachio)
directions: Mix dry pudding and pineapple., Fold in Cool Whip, nuts and marshmallows., Fill 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Seven Layer Salad
directions: Layer lettuce and then onions in large bowl., Mix mayonnaise with sugar and stir in peas (drained)., Add cheese and top with bacon bits.

title: Rib Ticklin' Barbecue Sauce
directions: Mix all ingredients in saucepan and bring to a boil., Reduce heat and let simmer for 20 minutes., Brush sauce on meat the last 20 minutes of grilling.

title: Ratatouille
directions: Pour stewed tomatoes, water and spice in a large pot with garlic, pepper and crushed red pepper., When mixture comes to a boil, stir in onions, zucchini and yellow squash., Stew (boil) for 2 hours, stirring every 15 minutes., Serve in individual bowls; garnish with freshly grated cheese., Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Tuna Walnut Spread
directions: Serve with crackers (Ritz are best).

title: Pickled Eggs
directions: Hard-boil eggs and peel., Boil all ingredients, except eggs, in a saucepan., Simmer for several minutes., Cool until just warm and add shelled, boiled eggs., Keep refrigerated a day or so to blend spices.

title: Lemon Icebox Pie
directions: Mix milk and eggs., Add lemon juice., Pour into a prepared vanilla wafer pie crust., Chill.

title: Tacos In Pasta Shells
directions: Brown ground beef., Drain fat., On low heat, add cream cheese, salt and chili powder., Simmer 5 minutes., Cook pasta shells; drain., Toss in butter., Fill with beef mixture.

title: Chocolate Delight Dessert
directions: Mix together the first 3 ingredients in, 9 x 13 baking dish; spread out for crust. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes. Remove from oven and cool.

title: Crunchy Vegetable Cheese Ball
directions: Press shredded carrots between paper towels to remove excess moisture; set aside., In large bowl, combine cheeses and minced onion., Stir in shredded carrots and broccoli., Cover tightly. Refrigerate at least 2 hours., Shape mixture into a ball; wrap with plastic wrap., Makes one cheese ball.

title: Fruit Salad
directions: Mix all together and chill.

title: Shrimp And Rice
directions: Cook shrimp in boiling water with a little salt about 10 minutes and peel., Cook the rice in shrimp water., Saute onions and bell pepper (chopped) in margarine., Add rice and stir., Add Worcestershire sauce, salt and pepper to taste, then shrimp. Serve hot.

title: Lemon Herb Sauce
directions: Melt margarine in saucepan; remove from heat., Stir in lemon peel, flour, dill weed and salt., Blend in half and half; cook and stir over medium heat until mixture thickens and comes to a boil. Remove from heat., Blend a small amount of hot mixture with egg yolk; blend back into hot mixture., Stir well; cook for 1 minute longer., Serve over cooked vegetables.

title: Peach Dump Cake
directions: Pour sliced peaches into ungreased cake pan., Pour dry cake mix onto that., Cover with melted butter., Bake at 400° until cake does not jiggle when moved., To serve, top with Cool Whip.

title: Light Bread
directions: Dissolve yeast in warm water., Mix all ingredients together; as you do for biscuit dough., Put wax paper and then a towel over bowl., Let stand and rise for 1 1/2 hours., Knead dough until stiff, using 1/2 cup flour., Place in a greased loaf pan., Brush with melted butter and let rise for 2 hours., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Old Time Fudge
directions: Mix sugar, cocoa and salt in iron skillet., Add milk, oleo and Karo., Cook on high until when dropped in cold water the candy won't separate, makes a ball in bottom of cup of cold water., Take off heat; beat., Add vanilla and beat until it looks shiny., Pour in buttered platter., Can add pecans, peanut butter or coconut.

title: Broccoli And Cauliflower Salad
directions: Combine cauliflower, broccoli, onion and water chestnuts; toss well., Combine remaining ingredients, mixing well., Pour over vegetables and let stand in refrigerator overnight.

title: Chocolate Mousse
directions: Put chocolate chips, sugar, vanilla, egg and salt in blender. Heat milk to just boiling., Pour into blender., Blend 1 minute or until thoroughly blended., Pour into 6 individual serving cups. Chill and serve with whipped topping.

title: David'S Favorite Spiced Tea
directions: Mix all ingredients together and store in an airtight container until ready to use., Then add 3 to 4 heaping teaspoonfuls to a cup of hot water or 2 to 3 tablespoons to a glass of ice water and enjoy.

title: Cheese Soup
directions: Mix ingredients in crock-pot., Cook on high until melted, then on low for 2 to 3 hours.

title: Frozen Fruit Dessert
directions: Mix together well and freeze., Will keep 4 to 6 weeks.

title: Beef Enchiladas
directions: Brown the ground beef in a skillet and pour off excess fat. Add taco seasoning and water., Simmer until reduced., Place equal amounts of taco meat on each tortilla., Add some refried beans, if desired., Put some salsa in bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan., Roll up tortillas and place seam down in pan., Top with more salsa and the cheese., Put in oven at 300° for 20 minutes or microwave 6 to 8 minutes until cheese melts.

title: Watergate Salad
directions: Mix dry pudding mix, pineapple with juice, marshmallows and pecans. Add Cool Whip and refrigerate 1 to 2 hours before serving.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
directions: Mix the sugar, cocoa, vanilla, peanut butter and nuts together., Melt the butter or margarine., Add to mixture., Put into a 9 x 13-inch pan, lightly buttered., Refrigerate and cut.

title: Fruity Mermaid Kabobs
directions: For each kabob, thread a watermelon wedge, large at the bottom, onto a 6-inch narrow cocktail straw to make the tail of the mermaid., Next, thread a prune onto the straw, push gently next to the watermelon to tighten and look like a waist., Next, thread a cantaloupe ball for the face., Pull in a mound of alfalfa sprouts from the container and stretch the mound just enough to keep the sprouts bunched together., Shape the hair and insert onto straw letting hair drape around face.

title: Holiday Fruit Cookies
directions: Mix well shortening, brown sugar and eggs., Add buttermilk and stir in flour., It will be easier to work with if you chill dough overnight., Drop by teaspoon on baking sheet and bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes, or until done., Yields 7 dozen.

title: Cabbage Casserole
directions: Cook cabbage in, salt water until tender., Drain off all of water., Put cabbage in casserole dish.

title: Mushrooms With Garlic Butter
directions: Mince the garlic., Wash the mushrooms quickly, then trim and slice them., Melt the butter with the olive oil in a large frying pan over high heat., When the foam subsides, add the mushrooms, the minced garlic, 1/2 teaspoon of salt and 1/4 teaspoon of pepper., Cook, stirring occasionally, until mushrooms are browned and tender, about 5 minutes., Taste for seasoning and add salt and pepper if needed., Sprinkle with parsley before serving.

title: Apricot Nut Supreme Brownies
directions: Preheat, oven, to 350°., In small saucepan, melt chocolate and, margarine, over, low, heat., Stir, constantly until mixture becomes a curdling consistency; remove from heat., Add sugar, eggs and extract; stir quickly to blend.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Cook broccoli 5 minutes and drain., Combine other ingredients, except crackers to make sauce., Combine sauce with broccoli., Pour into casserole., Sprinkle top with cracker crumbs., Bake in 400° oven for about 30 minutes., This may be frozen or refrigerated before baking.

title: Microwave Peanut Brittle
directions: In a microwave-safe glass bowl mix first 3 ingredients together and cook on High for 7 to 9 minutes, until mixture bubbles and peanuts are brown., Quickly stir in margarine and vanilla., Cook on High for 2 to 3 minutes., Add baking soda, stirring quickly until mixture is foamy., Pour onto a greased cookie sheet., Let cool for 15 minutes, until firm., Break into pieces or cut., Makes 1 1/4 pounds.

title: Salad(Christmas Or Valentine'S Day)
directions: Bring water to a boil; add jello., Stir until dissolved., Add frozen berries; continue to stir until berries are thawed apart. Add applesauce., Stir until well mixed., Set in refrigerator until set.

title: Lisa'S Famous Breakfast Eggs Florentine
directions: Cover the bottom of shallow baking dish (10 x 6 x 2-inch) with spinach., Break eggs around outside edge of dish., Pierce egg yolks twice and egg whites several times with a toothpick., Mix soup, pepper and onion flakes., Pour around eggs., Cover spinach completely., Cover and cook on High for 7 to 8 minutes or until eggs are almost set., Sprinkle cheese., Let stand covered 5 minutes., Serves 6 people.

title: Fruit Punch
directions: Mix all ingredients, but ginger ale, the day before., Fill ice trays with mixture and put 1 cherry per cube (optional)., Freeze until ready to serve., Mix ginger ale and ice cubes in large punch bowl.

title: Meat Loaf
directions: Lightly mix and form into loaf.

title: Chicken Broccoli Vegetable Saute!
directions: In skillet over medium heat, in 1 tablespoon hot margarine, cook chicken 10 minutes or until browned on both sides., Remove chicken; keep warm., In same skillet, in remaining margarine, cook broccoli, carrots and mushrooms 5 minutes, stirring often., Stir in soup, milk and pepper., Heat to boiling., Return chicken to skillet., Reduce heat to low; simmer 5 minutes or until chicken is fork-tender.

title: Squash Casserole
directions: Combine squash and water., Cover and cook slowly 10 minutes; drain., In skillet saute onion and pepper in butter 3 minutes. Combine all ingredients., Spoon into casserole dish., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Hot Taco Dip
directions: Let cream cheese soften. Spread on bottom of dish. Spread 2 cans of green chilies, then chopped onion, then chili. Layer second set of green chilies. Cover with cheeses. Bake at 350 for approximately 30 minutes. Serve with chips.

title: Breakfast Pizza
directions: Cook, sausage, and drain., Separate rolls into 8 triangles. Place triangles onto pizza pan., Press to form sides of crust. Seal, perforations., Spoon sausage over dough., Sprinkle with hash browns and Cheddar cheese.

title: Meat Loaf(From Ann Landers)
directions: Mix together thoroughly., Put into loaf pan and cover with two strips of bacon., Pour one can (8 ounce) tomato sauce and bake at 350° about 1 hour.

title: Mary Ann Cake
directions: Cream sugar, and, shortening., Add, beaten eggs, cocoa, soda and salt., Gradually, sift	in, flour and sour milk., Add hot water and, banana flavoring; mix well., Bake at 350° until done. This cake is best when mixed by hand instead of using a mixer.

title: Basil Chicken With Rice
directions: In 3-quart saucepan over high heat, heat broth, tomatoes, garlic and basil to boiling., Add chicken, rice, peas and hot pepper sauce., Return to boiling; remove from heat., Cover., Let stand 5 minutes or until most of the liquid is absorbed., Fluff rice with fork before serving., Makes 4 servings.

title: Oven-Barbecued Beef Brisket
directions: Trim brisket well., Place in large deep roasting pan., Heat Worcestershire sauce, liquid smoke and margarine. Pour over brisket., Cover tightly with heavy-duty aluminum foil., Cook in oven at 250° for 1 hour per pound. (Or cook at 425° for 1/2 hour, then reduce heat and cook at 325° for 30 to 40 minutes per pound.) Meat is done when fork inserts easily., Cool for 30 minutes and cut with electric knife into thin slices.

title: Percolator Punch
directions: Place sugar and spices in basket of percolator., Place juice and water in lower part of coffee pot and allow to perk just like coffee.

title: Wild West Corn
directions: Melt cream cheese and milk, stirring constantly., Add remaining ingredients. Pour into buttered 1 1/2-quart casserole. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes, uncovered.

title: Dumplings
directions: Beat egg until smooth., Add milk and shortening., Mix thoroughly., Pour this in flour., Mix to a very smooth dough. Drop by spoonfuls into broth., Cover tightly and cook 10 to 14 minutes or until done, depending on size of dumplings.

title: Chicken Delight
directions: Combine first 5 ingredients and set aside., Saute celery and onions., Cook rice by directions, adding water chestnuts, celery and onions., Into a large buttered Corning casserole, put layer of rice, then layer of chicken mixture and then sprinkle with cheese. Alternate layers until all is used., A little Tabasco sauce can be added., Garnish with small pieces of chicken, cheese and paprika., Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

title: Spiced Nuts
directions: Mix sugar, cream of tartar and cinnamon., Pour in boiling water., Boil until soft ball stage., Remove from fire., Add vanilla and pecans., Stir until mixture sugars., Turn out on waxed paper and separate pecans.

title: Delicious Pecan Pie
directions: Combine oleo, sugar and syrup., Cook over low heat, stirring constantly until sugar is dissolved (do not boil)., Let cool slightly., Add to beaten eggs, vanilla, salt and pecans., Pour in unbaked pie crust., Bake in 325° oven for about 40 minutes or until brown.

title: Graham Cracker Crumb Crust
directions: Blend ingredients together; spread out in a 9-inch pan., If desired, bake at 375° for 8 minutes.

title: Easy Chocolate Chewy Brownies
directions: Combine first 6 ingredients in bowl., Mix at low speed until smooth., Combine baking soda and flour in sifter., Sift in dry ingredients., Pour into 13 x 9 baking dish and bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

title: Cheesy Scalloped Potatoes
directions: In a saucepan over medium heat, melt butter; blend in flour and add milk, all at once., Stir until thickened., Add grated cheese, salt and pepper., Continue to cook and stir until cheese is melted., Remove from heat and spread 1/2 of the cheese sauce on the bottom of a shallow 2 1/2-quart casserole dish., Place potatoes on top of cheese sauce, sprinkle with onions and bacon. Add remaining sauce over potatoes., Bake at 350° for 1 hour, until potatoes are tender.

title: Cheeseburger Pizza
directions: Preheat oven to 400°., Meanwhile, press biscuits into 12-inch round greased baking sheet or 12-inch pizza pan, pinching edges of biscuits together to seal., Bake 10 minutes.

title: Friendly Fungus-Marinated
directions: Gently boil the mushrooms for 1 minute, drain., The heat will help the marinade to absorb into the mushrooms., Serve hot or cold.

title: Beer Batter Bread
directions: Mix dry ingredients in bowl., Add beer and beat 60 strokes with spoon., Fill a lightly greased 9 x 5-inch loaf pan and drizzle top with melted butter., Bake at 375° for 45 to 50 minutes or golden and tests clean., Remove from pan and cool on rack.

title: Pork Chops In Apple Juice
directions: Brown, chops, in, a, 12-inch, Dutch, oven in margarine. Remove chops, and, saute apples and onion slices in drippings until tender., Set, aside, in, a	bowl., Return chops to Dutch oven. Add, apple juice, bouillon, sage and 1/2 teaspoon salt. Bring to a boil, cover and simmer for 15 minutes., Add apples and onions to	Dutch, oven, and, cook	for 5 minutes.	Remove chops, apples and, onions., Stir	in the half and half., Cook and stir, until sauce boils and thickens., Pour over chops and serve.

title: Roman Holiday
directions: Add to ground beef and salt and pepper:, celery, onion, green pepper and mushrooms., Simmer until soft., Cook spaghetti (broken in thirds) and add Cheddar cheese and tomato soup.

title: Marinated Vegetable Salad
directions: Mix and boil salt, vinegar, pepper, sugar, oil, and water. Cool mixture and pour over remaining ingredients premixed in a large bowl. Set for several hours in refrigerator.

title: Batter Dip For Frying
directions: "How many ways can you eat peanut butter., Let me count the ways."

title: Truthahn Brust In Zwiebelrahm Sosse(Turkey Breast In Onion Sauce)
directions: Set oven at 350°., Lay turkey slices in shallow baking dish (spray with nonstick coating)., Mix together whipping cream and soup mix; pour over turkey., Sprinkle with parsley., Cover and bake for 30 minutes., Remove cover and bake another 30 minutes. Makes 4 to 5 servings.

title: Snicker Salad
directions: Put the Cool Whip in a bowl., Next, core the apples, but leave the peeling on the apples., Dice the apples and put into the Cool Whip., Cut up the Snicker bars and slice the bananas., Combine all with the Cool Whip and mix together., Serve.

title: German Potato Pancakes
directions: Grate potatoes, add salt and egg and mix well., Drop by tablespoons in well-greased frying pan, spreading real thin., Fry slowly until browned on each side.

title: White Cake
directions: Sift flour, baking powder and salt together three times. Cream sugar and shortening; add milk, stiffly beaten egg whites and vanilla. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes., Frost with your favorite frosting.

title: Hot Artichoke Dip
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Mix all ingredients and spoon into 9-inch pie plate or shallow ovenproof dish., Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until lightly browned., Sprinkle with sliced green onions and chopped tomatoes, if desired., Serve with tortilla chips or crackers., Makes 2 cups., Preparation time:, 10 minutes., Cook time is 25 minutes.

title: Oriental Skewers
directions: Wash and cut chicken into 1-inch chunks., Also cut sirloin into chunks., Marinate chicken in teriyaki sauce for 1 hour., Marinate steak in Worcestershire sauce for 1 hour., Cut and wash peppers and onion into large chunks., Put peppers and meat on skewer alternating., Cook on grill until done., Serve over rice with extra sauces, sauteed mushrooms and pineapple chunks., Do not use the sauce that the meat marinated in., Use fresh sauces.

title: Christmas Crunch
directions: Boil syrup, butter, sugar and salt together for 5 minutes at medium-high., Remove from heat., Add vanilla and soda; return to heat and cook 2 more minutes., Pour over Rice Chex, almonds and coconut; mix well., Pour out onto greased cookie sheet (large). Cool, cut and eat.

title: Shrimp Dip
