directions: Blend together in blender, then chill.

title: Homemade Ice Cream
directions: Add milk to fill line on container., Freeze in electric or manual freezer until solid., Makes 1/2 gallon.

title: Chili Sauce
directions: Combine all ingredients in large 3 gallon pan; cook until mixture comes to rolling boil., Turn heat down until sauce is barely boiling and cook for 1 1/2 to 2 hours., Stir often, but sauce must be stirred constantly almost all of the last hour to keep from sticking., Store in 12 (1/2 pint) Mason jars.

title: Chocolate Covered Cherry Cookies
directions: In large bowl stir together flour, cocoa, salt, baking powder and soda., In mixer bowl beat together butter and sugar on low speed of electric mixer until fluffy., Add egg and vanilla; beat well., Gradually add dry ingredients to cream mixture; beat until well blended., Shape dough into 1-inch balls., Place on ungreased cookie sheet., Press down center of dough with thumb., Drain cherries and reserve juice., Place a cherry in center of each cookie., In saucepan, combine chocolate chips and condensed milk. Heat until chocolate is melted., Stir in 4 teaspoons of cherry juice., Spoon about 1 teaspoon frosting over each cherry, spreading to cover cherry., Bake at 350° about 10 minutes., Remove to wire rack and cool.

title: Broccoli And Walnut Stir-Fry
directions: In a large skillet or wok, heat the oil until quite hot., Add the walnuts and saute for 1 minute. Add the broccoli and cook over medium heat, tossing frequently, until tender and crisp, about 4 minutes. Add the soy sauce and cook 1 minute more. Serve immediately, garnished with red bell pepper.

title: Pumpkin Pie
directions: Mix sugar, cornstarch and spices together in lg bowl. Add milk, eggs, butter and molasses. Stir well. Add pumpkin and mix until all blended together. Pour into uncooked pie shell. Bake at 425 degrees for 20 minutes and decrease heat to 375 for 1 hour or until a toothpick comes out clean when stuck into middle of the pie.

title: Classic Green Bean Bake(Yields 6 Servings)
directions: In a 1 1/2-quart greased casserole, combine soup, milk, soya sauce and pepper., Add beans and 1/2 of the onion rings., Stir. Bake in a 350° oven for 25 minutes until hot and bubbly., Stir. Top with remaining onion rings., Bake 5 minutes more.

title: Zelma'S Never Fail Dumplings
directions: Beat eggs and shortening., Add dry ingredients and enough milk to make a stiff dough., Knead dough on floured surface., Roll out very thin, cut in strips and drop into boiling broth with a teaspoon of Accent seasoning. When dumplings are almost done, add a few drops yellow food coloring and 1 cup of cream.

title: Easy Grilled Chicken
directions: Layer chicken pieces in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish., Sprinkle salt, pepper, garlic and onion powder to your taste., Place in microwave oven and cook chicken until done (around 30 to 40 minutes depending on your oven)., Remove chicken and place on heated outdoor grill., Baste barbecue sauce over it and put lid down., It only has to stay on the grill for a few minutes to get the smoked flavor without all of the time and trouble of regular grilled chicken.

title: Rhubarb Sauce For Ice Cream
directions: Barely cover the ingredients in a saucepan., Cook over low heat until tender., Sauce will be kind of thick.

title: New England Baked Beans
directions: Cook dry beans in water until softened (1 1/2 to 2 hours). Drain and put into crock-pot., Add all remaining ingredients; mix well., Cover and cook on low 10 to 12 hours or high 4 to 6 hours.

title: Grandma Cocking'S Cornish Pasties
directions: Note: Ingredients listed are for each pastie.

title: Buttermilk Fudge
directions: Combine first 5 ingredients in a buttered Dutch oven., Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until mixture reaches soft ball stage or candy thermometer registers 243°; remove from heat. Cool to 180°., Stir in vanilla., Beat at high speed with an electric mixer until mixture thickens and begins to lose its gloss., Stir in pecans., Pour into a buttered 8-inch square pan or baking dish; cool., Yield:, 1 1/4 pounds.

title: Squash Casserole
directions: Combine soup, milk, and beaten eggs., Stir until well blended, add squash, 1 c of the cracker crumbs, and 1 c of cheese, stir until blended., Pour into a buttered 1 1/2 quart baking dish., Mix together the remaining cheese and cracker crumbs., Sprinkle over top., Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes., Serve 8.

title: Sunshine Salad
directions: Dissolve jello in water; add sour cream., Beat until smooth and frothy., Add pineapple and vegetables., Pour into bowl; let set., Also good with orange-pineapple jello.

title: Sandwich Or Cracker Spread
directions: Blend until consistency wanted., Make sandwiches or serve on crackers.

title: Cavatini
directions: Mix sausage, beef, pepper, onion, mushrooms and pepperoni in skillet and brown., Add sauce and sugar., Salt and pepper to taste.

title: Goulash
directions: Brown bacon in heavy 3-quart pot with a tight fitting lid. Remove bacon and brown onions in drippings until transparent. Remove pot from heat and add paprika, beef, salt, caraway, bacon and half green pepper and tomato., Return to heat and cover tightly., Simmer over low heat, stirring occasionally, and add small amounts of water as needed., Cook 1 1/2 to 2 hours until meat is tender., Add garlic, potatoes, the rest of peppers and tomatoes., Add enough water to completely cover meat and vegetables., Bring to a boil; simmer 30 minutes., Serve with very small bow tie egg noodles.

title: Chicken A L'Orange
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., Arrange quartered chicken pieces in a long, shallow baking dish., Bake in preheated oven for 30 minutes, turning pieces twice during cooking., In a small skillet, melt butter; stir in salt, pepper, paprika and tarragon; pour evenly over chicken pieces., Continue to bake for about 15 minutes, until chicken is tender and browned., While chicken bakes, prepare sauce.

title: Quick Rolls
directions: Dissolve yeast in sugar, salt and warm water solution., Add melted shortening and enough flour to make a medium stiff dough. Grease dough and cover and let rise until double in size., Make rolls; let rise again and bake in a 400° oven for 15 minutes.

title: Curry Vegetable Dip
directions: Blend well and chill before serving with cucumbers, carrots, cauliflower, celery, etc.

title: Turkish Delight
directions: Bring, orange juice to a boil.	Stir boiling juice into gelatin., Dissolve	completely., Pour, into, an 8 x 8-inch pan lightly sprayed, with, oil., Chill 3 hours or more. Slice into squares and coat with confectioners sugar, then serve.

title: Custard(Low-Fat, Low Cholesterol)
directions: Preheat oven to 325°. Mix Egg Beaters with sugar, vanilla and salt. Gradually add scalded milk and pour into ovenproof dish. Sprinkle with nutmeg and place dish in a warm-water bath. Bake in slow oven 1 hour or until set.

title: Russian Tea
directions: Boil lemon and orange rinds with cloves and cinnamon bark for 5 minutes., Strain; add juices, sugar and the tea., Serve piping hot. Makes 3 quarts.

title: Whiskey Slush
directions: Add the tea bags to the boiling water in a large glass bowl. Let cool. Stir in sugar and water. Add frozen orange juice and lemonade. Stir well. Finally, stir in whiskey. Freeze in a container with a lid. Serve in a glass with Sprite.

title: Momma'S String Bean Dish
directions: Drain green beans and chestnuts., Mix together the soup, sherry, oregano, salt and pepper., Toss in green beans and chestnuts., Bake at 350° for 25 minutes., Nice if topped with "canned" onion rings or slivered almonds.

title: Rhubarb Cake
directions: Cream sugar, shortening, eggs and milk., Add flour and spices; mix well., Stir in rhubarb., Pour into greased pan; add topping.

title: Glazed Carrots
directions: Peel carrots; cut in 1/4-inch thick diagonal slices., Cook in 1 1/2 cups water for 20 minutes or until tender., Drain., Melt butter or margarine; add brown sugar, brandy or cognac., Stir well., Add to carrots in saucepan., Bring to a boil., Cook 2 to 3 minutes longer.

title: Easy Cobbler Pie Topping
directions: Prepare fruit or berries and sugar to taste (can use fresh or canned)., Mix flour and sugar., Add beaten egg and mix until mixture is like coarse cornmeal., (I do this with my fingers; if preferred you can use a fork.), Sprinkle mixture over fruit or berry cobbler filling in a pie plate or glass long dish.

title: Green Bean Sauce
directions: Mix mayonnaise, vegetable oil, grated onion, Worcestershire, Tabasco sauce, dry mustard and eggs and serve over green beans.

title: Great Breakfast Casserole
directions: Layer bread, sausage and cheese in a buttered baking dish. Combine eggs, milk, salt and dry mustard; pour over the ingredients in the baking dish., Refrigerate overnight., Bake the next morning in a 350° oven for 1 hour., Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Quickie Frozen Dessert
directions: Layer large oblong Pyrex dish (10 x 14-inch) with ice cream sandwiches., Spread Cool Whip on top. Sprinkle candy bits on top. Cover and place in freezer., When ready to serve, remove from freezer., Let sit for 5 minutes., Cut into squares., Makes 12 to 15 generous servings.

title: Sweet Pastry Pockets
directions: Preheat oven to 400°., Cream brown sugar with cream cheese. Add 1/8 teaspoon salt and vanilla extract; beat well., Stir in coconut., Chill while preparing dough., Combine flour and 1/2 teaspoon salt., Cream butter with confectioners sugar and egg yolk., Blend in orange rind and dry ingredients; mix well., Add orange juice; mix until a stiff dough forms., Roll out, half at a time, on well floured surface to 1/8-inch thickness., Cut with floured 2 1/2 or 3-inch cutter., Place 1/2 teaspoon filling in center of each; moisten edge with water., Fold in half; seal edges., Place on ungreased cookie sheet., Repeat with remaining dough., Make 1/2-inch cut in top of each for escape of steam. Brush with slightly beaten egg white., Sprinkle with sugar., Bake at 400° for 8 to 10 minutes until light golden brown., Makes 36 cookies.

title: Broccoli-Cauliflower Mold(Easy)
directions: Peel and cook onions in salted boiling water until tender. Drain., Add butter and sprinkle with white sugar., Heat and toss onions over low heat until browned and glazed.

title: Corn And Rice Casserole
directions: Mix all together., Pour into casserole dish and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Heavenly Chicken Lasagna
directions: You can add more chopped cooked chicken. Melt butter in a skillet over medium-high heat. Add onion and saute 5 minutes or until tender. Stir in soup and next five ingredients. Reserve 1 cup sauce. Drain spinach well, pressing between layers of paper towels. Stir together spinach, cottage cheese and next three ingredients. Place three lasagna noodles in a lightly greased 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Layer with half each of sauce, spinach mixture and chicken. Sprinkle with 1 cup Cheddar cheese. Repeat procedure. Top with remaining 3 noodles and reserved 1 cup of sauce. Cover and chill up to one day ahead. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes. Sprinkle with remaining 1 cup cheese and bake 5 more minutes or until cheese is melted. Let stand 10 minutes before serving. Serves 8 to 10 people. Can use Contadina Light Alfredo Sauce found in the dairy section of the grocery.

title: Mom'S Meat Loaf
directions: Put everything in bowl. Mix together. Place in pan. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Mission Artichoke And Spinach Frittata
directions: Melt 1/4 cup or less margarine in 9 x 13-inch glass pan., Beat the eggs, then gradually mix in the remaining ingredients one at a time in order., Pour in the 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake at 325° for approximately 40 minutes.

title: California Chicken Soup
directions: In stock pot, combine all ingredients, except tortellini and broccoli., Bring to a boil; add tortellini., Reduce heat., Simmer, uncovered, for 25 minutes., Add broccoli., Simmer for 10 minutes. Remove bay leaves.

title: Sauerkraut Meatballs
directions: Mix first 8 ingredients; melt fat in skillet and brown meatballs., Mix sugar, water and vinegar., Spoon over meat. Simmer for 30 to 45 minutes., Serves 6.

title: Creamy Peanut Dessert
directions: In a bowl, combine cracker crumbs and peanuts., Stir in 1/4 cup butter and 2 tablespoons peanut butter; mix well., Set aside 1/2 cup for topping., Press the remaining crumb mixture into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan., Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes. Meanwhile, in a mixing bowl, beat cream cheese and 1/2 cup peanut butter until smooth., Beat in sugar and vanilla., Fold in Cool Whip; spoon over crust., Drizzle with chocolate; sprinkle with reserved crumb mixture., Cover and freeze for up to 3 months. Remove from the freezer 15 minutes before serving.

title: Pete'S Sauerkraut
directions: Mix all ingredients in saucepan., Cook on high heat for 2 minutes,, stirring	constantly., Cook, on medium heat for 7 minutes,, stirring often to keep from burning., Delicious over hot dogs.

title: Applesauce Cake With Lemon Glaze
directions: Combine flour, baking powder, salt, cinnamon and nutmeg; set aside., Cream shortening with sugar., Add eggs and applesauce. Gradually stir in flour mixture., Beat at medium speed of electric mixer for 2 minutes., Fold in raisins., Spoon batter into a nonstick 12-cup fluted pan., Bake at 350° for 55 to 60 minutes, or until wooden pick inserted into center of cake comes clean., Cool 10 minutes., Invert onto a wire rack for cooling. Drizzle sugar and lemon juice over cake., Makes 16 servings.

title: Cheese Spread
directions: Heat milk 3 minutes on roast., Cut cheese in pieces, then add to hot milk., Heat 5 minutes on 1/2 power until cheese is soft. Mix until smooth., Add beaten egg, butter and seeds., Beat until well mixed., Put in small containers and freeze., Just super on any crackers.

title: Chambord Brownies
directions: Mix together above ingredients and place in a greased 9 x 13-inch baking pan., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes., Allow to cool.

title: Mexican Lasagna
directions: Brown ground beef with taco seasoning., Layer the following in a 9 x 13-inch pan:, salsa, taco shells to cover pan, hamburger, salsa, refried beans, sour cream and Cheddar cheese., Bake at 350°, uncovered, for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Six-Week Refrigerator Bran Muffins
directions: In large bowl, add 2 cups bran, Crisco oil and raisins., Pour boiling water over the mixture and let stand., Mix remaining bran, sugar, eggs and buttermilk., Sift flour, soda and salt., Combine, cover and store in refrigerator., May use as desired.

title: Corn And Sausage Bake
directions: Brown breakfast sausage., Drain off grease., Mix all ingredients in casserole dish., Bake at 375° for 1 hour or until bubbling and brown.

title: Peanut Butter S'Mores(Microwave)
directions: For each s'more, spread 1 graham cracker square with peanut butter., Top with semi-sweet chocolate pieces and marshmallows. Cover with another graham cracker square.

title: Namak Paaray
directions: Mix together all ingredients and add small amounts of water, enough to make a smooth, binding dough., Divide dough into 3 parts., Set aside for 10-15 minutes.

title: Deviled Ham And Chive Balls
directions: Blend ham, pretzels, Worcestershire and pepper thoroughly and form 25 balls, using a rounded 1/2 teaspoon for each., Freeze on cookie sheet for 30 minutes.

title: Chicken Burritos
directions: In a large stock pot add 4 quarts of water and all of the ingredients except the tomatoes and bring to a boil for 40 minutes., Remove the chicken with a large spoon and remove the chicken bones and skin., Skim fat oils from the top of the broth, put the chicken meat back into the pot, add tomatoes and boil for 15 minutes., Serve on flour tortillas, with salsa or hot sauce, rice or beans optional., Serves 6 to 8.

title: Creme De Menthe Brownies
directions: Cream butter and sugar, then add remaining ingredients and mix well., Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan and bake at 350° for 30 minutes., Cool thoroughly.

title: Prize Winning Meat Loaf
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Combine all ingredients and mix lightly, but thoroughly., Press into an 8 x 4-inch loaf pan., Bake for 1 hour or until meat is no longer pink., Drain and let stand for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Mixed Vegetable Casserole
directions: Cook vegetables; drain., Line bottom of casserole with vegetables., Mix onions, cheese and mayonnaise and seal over vegetables., Mix melted oleo and crackers and put on top and bake until bubbly (not too fast).

title: Corn Dodgers(Hush Puppies)
directions: Mix all ingredients together, drop by rounded teaspoon into hot grease., Fry until golden, turning once.

title: Italian Squares
directions: Saute beef,, onions, and, garlic, until, meat loses red color. Add spinach,, rice and cheese; mix well., Mix milk and eggs, salt and, pepper, and, add, to, rice, mixture., Place in shallow casserole., Bake, at 350° for 30 minutes or until set. Meanwhile, blend, sauce, and, seasonings and simmer 5 minutes. Cut spinach meat mixture into squares., Top with tomato sauce and grated Italian cheese.

title: Carrot Cake
directions: Mix eggs, sugar and oil together., Add dry ingredients., Mix together. Add carrots and nuts. Bake at 300° for 35 to 45 minutes in a greased 10 x 13-inch pan or 3 layers.

title: Continental Frosting
directions: Cook milk and flour until thick; take off heat (cool)., Cream sugar and butter with mixer until fluffy, 4 to 5 minutes., Add flour and milk mixture., Beat another 4 to 5 minutes., Add vanilla. Keep cake cool after frosting (refrigerate)., Add crushed pieces of pineapple and flavoring if you want it (just a little)., Very good over chiffon cake, angel cake or any other kind of cake.

title: Cream Cheese Pie
directions: Lay out cream cheese overnight., Mix all ingredients with mixer., Pour in pie crust., Let stand in refrigerator all day or night., Put some flavor of pie filling over pie if desired (blueberry or strawberry).

title: Angel Biscuits
directions: Sift dry ingredients together., Add yeast to warm water and let dissolve., Mix milk, yeast and shortening with dry ingredients until slightly sticky., Form into rolls and place on ungreased baking pan., Bake at 450° for 12 to 15 minutes., Bake immediately or cover and store in refrigerator up to one week.

title: Sourdough Bread
directions: For whole wheat bread, use 3 cups whole-wheat flour and 3 cups bread flour.

title: French Chocolate Pie
directions: Cream butter and sugar., Stir in chocolate., Add eggs, one at a time, beating at high speed for 5 minutes after each egg., Fold in Cool Whip., Pour into cooled pie shell and chill until firm (about 2 hours) or freeze.

title: Pound Cake
directions: Cream shortening and butter; add sugar., Cream until smooth. Add eggs, one at a time., Add baking powder to flour., Add to mixture alternately with milk and flavoring., Bake in tube pan 1 hour and 15 minutes at 315°.

title: Ice Cream Cone Clowns
directions: You will also need construction paper and glue, paste or a stapler.

title: Peanut Butter Chocolate Chip Cookies
directions: Beat eggs, water, peanut butter and 1/2 of cake mix until light and fluffy., Stir in remaining cake mix and chocolate chips., Drop onto ungreased cookie sheet., Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Beef-Barley Vegetable Soup
directions: Place meat in kettle. Cover with cold water. Add seasoning. Heat slowly to boiling point. Cover and let simmer 2 1/2 to 3 hours or until meat is tender. Skim off fat., Remove meat and bone., Add barley and vegetables., Continue cooking for 45 minutes., Yields about 2 quarts.

title: Potato Casserole
directions: Press 1/2 uncooked ground beef into bottom of a 9 x 13-inch casserole pan., Layer top with potatoes, then layer with ground beef, then potatoes again., Mix water and soup well; pour over potatoes and meat., Cook at 375° for 1 hour., Serve hot.

title: Sparkling Catawba Punch
directions: Mix pineapple juice and lemonade., Add ginger ale and sparkling grape juice just before serving., Makes 125 (4 ounce) servings.

title: Creamy Pimento Cheese Spread
directions: Position knife blade in food processor bowl., Add first five ingredients., Process until smooth., Add pimento., Pulse 4 or 5 times.

title: Pineapple Scallopini
directions: Melt butter and break toast into pieces., Pour butter over toast., Drain pineapple (partially)., Mix remaining ingredients and pour over toast., Bake, covered, for 30 minutes., Great with ham.

title: Homemade Pop Sickles
directions: Mix cool-aide and sugar together. Pour into cubed ice tray. Put wax paper over tray. Cut holes in the middle of the cube, just big enough to fit a stick in. Put in freezer until well set. Take out of freezer; remove wax paper. Take as many out as you would like and enjoy. Put remainder in freezer.

title: Hash Brown Casserole
directions: Mix together first 5 ingredients. Add cheese on top. Put corn flakes over all and 1/2 stick melted butter over this., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Swiss Potato Pancakes
directions: Measure flour, sugar and salt into large bowl., Mix well with fork., Add shortening, mix with fork until crumbly., In small bowl beat together egg, water and vinegar (using fork to blend well). Combine dry ingredients with liquid., Divide dough into 5 equal portions and shape into round flattened patties, ready for rolling. Wrap each patty in plastic wrap, chill 1/2 hour before using., When ready to roll, lightly flour both sides of patty and roll out on lightly floured board., Makes 5 (9-inch) pie crusts or 20 tart shells., Can be frozen after shaping into round flattened patties.

title: Apple Cake
directions: Sift flour, sugar and baking powder together into a large bowl., Combine oil, orange juice, flavoring and eggs; add it to the dry ingredients, a little at a time., Mix until smooth (don't overmix)., Grease and flour a 10-inch tube pan., Pour half the batter into the pan., Spread half the apples evenly over the batter and sprinkle with half the cinnamon-sugar., Repeat with other half., Bake in a preheated 350° oven for 1 and 1/4 hours. Remove from oven, place on a rack and let stand about 10 minutes before removing from pan.

title: Baked Beans With Hamburger
directions: Brown and drain hamburger and onion., Mix all other ingredients., Bake at 325° for 1 hour.

title: Apple Squares
directions: Mix salt with flour; cut in shortening., Separate egg; save the white., Add yolk to 2/3 cup water and beat., Add to flour mixture., Mix into soft ball stage., Divide dough in half.

title: Zucchini Casserole
directions: Cook onion and zucchini in salt water for about 5 minutes, then drain well., Pour into well-greased casserole., Add Italian seasonings., Pour tomatoes over top of zucchini and onion., Bake at 350° for 1 hour., Remove from oven and sprinkle well with Parmesan cheese and return to oven until the cheese melts.

title: Low-Fat Soft Ginger Cookies
directions: Stir flour, salt, baking powder and spices together., Cream sugar, margarine and egg until light., Add prunes, buttermilk, molasses and vinegar and beat to combine., Dissolve soda in boiling water., Stir in flour mixture and soda water., Drop onto greased baking sheet and bake for 15 to 17 minutes at 350°., Makes 6 dozen.

title: Vegetable Dip In Rye Bread
directions: Mix all ingredients (except bread)., Cut top off bread (keep for lid)., Dig out center of bread (keep bread for dipping)., Fill bread with mixture., Replace top of bread., Triple wrap bread with foil and place in 350° oven for 1 1/2 hours (or until cheese is melted and mixture is hot all through)., Mix pieces of bread with 2 tablespoons of butter and place in oven for 10 minutes., Serve dip warm with raw vegetables, crackers, bread sticks, etc.

title: Uncooked Lemon Pie
directions: Mix and pour into a 9-inch graham cracker or vanilla wafer crust.

title: Slice And Bake Chocolate Chip Cookies
directions: Cream margarine and sugars., Beat in vanilla and eggs. Combine flour, salt and soda., Gradually stir in dry ingredients. Stir in chocolate chips and nuts.

title: Orange Chicken
directions: Arrange chicken in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish., Drizzle melted margarine over chicken; sprinkle with paprika., In small bowl, combine onion, salt, rosemary, pepper, orange juice, orange peel and cornstarch; mix well., Pour over chicken., Bake, uncovered, for 40 to 45 minutes, or until tender., Baste occasionally.

title: Ranch-Style Baked Lentils
directions: Rinse the lentils., In a heavy saucepan, bring lentils, salt and 4 cups water to a boil. Cover and simmer 20 minutes or until the water is absorbed and the lentils are tender. Meanwhile, brown beef in a skillet. Drain excess fat. Stir in soup mix, catsup, mustard, vinegar and remaining water. Gently stir in lentils. Spoon into a 2-quart casserole. Bake, covered, at 400° for 30 to 35 minutes. Yield: 4 to, 6 servings.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
directions: Chop apples and set aside., Measure oil into large bowl; add sugar, egg and vanilla., Beat until creamy., Sift flour, salt, soda and baking powder together., Add small amounts at a time to creamed mixture., Fold in pecans and apples., Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan for 55 to 60 minutes at 350°.

title: Parker'S Favorite Pecan Pie
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Beat eggs slightly, just until whites and yolks are mixed., Stir in sugar, then add corn syrup, melted butter, milk and vanilla., Stir the pecans into the egg/sugar mixture., Pour mixture into an unbaked pie crust.

title: Easy Chocolate Fudge
directions: In 2-quart saucepan, melt oleo., Do not get too hot., Add cocoa and milk; mix well., Stir in powdered sugar; bring to a bubbling boil stirring constantly., Cook 2 or 3 minutes more. Remove from heat; stir in vanilla and peanut butter., Stir until cooled slightly and begins to firm., Pour into greased (oleo) 8 x 8-inch dish., Cut into squares when cool.

title: Layered Salad
directions: Layer chopped lettuce, onions and bell peppers., Into mayonnaise, stir the 3 tablespoons sugar., Spread over lettuce, onions and peppers., Spread cheese and bacon bits over top of mayonnaise., Chill and serve., Other veggies such as green peas, broccoli or cauliflower may be layered in.

title: Banana Muffins
directions: Cream the butter and sugar together., Add egg, well beaten, and the mashed pulp of the bananas., Add dry ingredients alternately with milk., Mix well., Drop into greased tins and bake in a medium oven about 12 minutes., Makes 12 muffins.

title: Basic Stir-Fry
directions: In glass bowl, combine chicken, soy sauce and garlic powder; stir well and set aside., Heat 2 teaspoons oil in skillet or wok. Stir in all vegetables and stir-fry 3 to 5 minutes until onions are translucent., Remove to bowl., Heat remaining 2 teaspoons oil. Add chicken and stir-fry until chicken is cooked, about 5 minutes., Return vegetables to skillet or wok., Stir in cornstarch mixture and continue cooking until sauce thickens., Divide mixture evenly., Makes 4 servings.

title: Buttercream Mints
directions: Blend all ingredients with spoon, then hands. Line molds with fine sugar. Press in fondant. If no molds are available, roll into 1 inch or 1/2 inch balls, then flatten with fork or bottom of glass dipped in powdered sugar. May make ahead and freeze.

title: Mexican Casserole
directions: Brown hamburger., Mix in remaining ingredients., Place layer of hamburger mixture., Cover with grated colby of colby jack cheese and crushed tortilla chips., Pour remaining hamburger mixture, over first layer., Top with more grated cheese and crushed tortilla chips.

title: Turnip Salad(Southern Style)
directions: Pick a mess of salad from the garden, about 3 pounds. Wash to remove bugs, worms and dirt. Parboil in a pot of water after adding a pinch of soda. Drain. Put in pot and cover with water. Add olive oil and salt to taste. Cook on medium heat (2 hours) until tender. Drain and chop. Serve.

title: Cheese Cake
directions: Mix jello and boiling water; let cool (not gel)., Cream the cream cheese, sugar and lemon juice., Whip the chilled evaporated milk., Beat until peaks form., Add jello and cream cheese mixture to whipped milk., Pour into graham cracker pie crusts., Chill.

title: Western Bean Casserole
directions: Cook and drain excess bacon grease., Cook, drain and rinse ground beef., Add remaining ingredients and mix well., Pour into a casserole dish prepared with Pam., Bake in a preheated oven at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Striped Delight
directions: Combine graham cracker crumbs, 1/4 cup sugar and melted butter. Press firmly into bottom of a 13 x 9-inch pan., Beat cream cheese with 1/4 cup sugar and 2 tablespoons milk until smooth., Fold in 1/2 of the Cool Whip; spread over crust., Prepare pudding as directed on package using 3 1/2 cups milk., Pour over cream cheese layer., Chill several hours or overnight., Spread the remaining Cool Whip over the pudding., Top with Baker's coconut (as much as desired)., Makes 15 to 18 servings.

title: Scotch Crunchies
directions: On high heat, place tomatoes and jalapenos directly on stovetop until slightly roasted., Remove from heat., Peel and slice. Combine with avocados, garlic, onions, cilantro, garlic salt and pepper into a food processor., On low speed, blend ingredients until they appear blended into a lumpy texture, not creamy., (I prefer to hand mix in a mocahete, which adds just the right authentic flavor!), Serve with tortilla chips or as a topping on your favorite Mexican dish!, Muy Bueno!

title: Cheese Wafers
directions: Cream the cheese and margarine. Mix in flour. Stir in Rice Krispies. Drop by teaspoon on ungreased cookie sheet. Flatten with back of spoon. Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes. Store in airtight container.

title: Raspberry Punch
directions: Mix all juices., Blend and allow to stand several hours (overnight)., At serving time, pour into punch bowl and add sherbet, cut into small pieces., Serves 40.

title: Coconut Pie
directions: Cream butter and sugar., Add eggs one at a time., Mix well. Add milk and flour., Blend well., Add coconut. Pour into 9-inch pie pan, greased with butter., (This pie makes its own crust.), Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until it sets in the center., Let cool before cutting to serve.

title: Peanut Butter Chocolate Logs
directions: Mix the first 6 ingredients in a large bowl, then roll small logs and dip in the chocolate., (Melt the chocolate chips and wax in top of double boiler and keep stirring the chocolate while you are dipping the logs., Use toothpicks to dip with.)

title: Lasagna
directions: Cook noodles; drain. Mix cooked meat and spaghetti sauce together. Layer noodles at bottom of pan. Pour sauce over noodles, thick enough to cover. Spread cottage cheese over noodles, then layer the Mozzarella cheese. Repeat. Cook in oven for about 30 minutes or until cheese is done. Cook at 350° until done (about 20 minutes).

title: Cucumbers And Sour Cream
directions: Peel cucumbers; slice thin and chill., Mix other ingredients together., Toss all lightly., May be served on greens., Makes 4 servings.

title: Chocolate Delight
directions: Combine butter, flour and pecans., Press into a 9 x 13-inch pan and bake at 375° for 15 minutes., Cool., Combine cream cheese, confectioners sugar and 1 1/2 cups whipped topping., Spread over the cool crust and chill., Combine pudding mixes and milk., Beat 2 minutes with rotary mixer., Spread on top., Top with remaining whipped topping., Sprinkle with pecans and grated chocolate. Refrigerate.

title: Cherry Delight
directions: Mix flour, pecans and margarine., Pat in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish., Bake at 350° for approximately 20 minutes or until golden brown., Remove from oven and cool., Combine cream cheese and powdered sugar., Fold in Cool Whip and/or whipping cream as desired., Spread over cooled crust., Add one can cherry topping/filling., Top with whipping cream or Cool Whip as desired.

title: Low Calorie Instant Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Cream together brown sugar, sugar substitute, margarine and wheat germ., Sift together flour, baking soda, salt and cinnamon. Stir into creamed mixture and add remaining ingredients., Mix thoroughly., Drop by level teaspoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet., Bake at 350° for 12 minutes., Makes 68 small cookies, 37 calories per cookie.

title: Snickerdoodles
directions: In a mixing bowl beat margarine with an electric mixer on medium to high speed for 30 seconds., Add about half of the flour, the 1 cup sugar, the egg, vanilla, baking soda, and cream of tartar., Beat till thoroughly combined., Beat in remaining flour. Cover and chill 1 hour.

title: Blender Bearnaise
directions: Reduce vinegar together with tarragon until liquid is almost gone., In a blender, beat eggs and lemon juice until lemon colored. In the same pan as the vinegar and tarragon, melt the butter while hot., Slowly pour into the egg mixture while the blender is running., Add salt and pepper to taste., Enjoy.

title: On The Grill
directions: Remove silk from corn, but not the husks., Tie the husks closed., Wrap potatoes in foil., Some fresh herbs and margarine can be added to the foil package, if desired., Dip summer squash and eggplant slices in olive oil., Soak husks of corn in cold water for 10 minutes., Drain and cook for 30 minutes, turning. Cook potatoes 45 minutes and squash and eggplant for 20 minutes on coals that have burned 45 minutes.

title: Pina Colada Muffins
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Bake at 300° for 30 minutes. Makes 24 muffins.

title: Dutch Baby Pancakes
directions: You will need casserole dish, 2-quart size.

title: Red Velvet Cake
directions: Cream shortening, sugar and eggs., Make a paste with food coloring and cocoa and add mixture., Add salt and flour together. Add to creamed mixture, adding buttermilk a little at a time, alternately with soda and vinegar (do not beat hard), just blend. Bake 30 minutes at 350° in 2 (8-inch) round pans, greased and floured.

title: Apricot-Pineapple Molded Salad
directions: Mix Jell-O and let set until slightly thickened., Add crushed pineapple., Beat together cream cheese and Cool Whip., Fold Cool Whip mixture into the Jell-O., Pour into a shallow baking dish (8 or 9-inch square pan)., Let set in refrigerator until firm.

title: 15 Minute Linguine With Clam Sauce
directions: While pasta cooks, saute butter, onions and garlic., Add juice from clams and milk., Bring to boil and add thickener and clams. Before removing from heat, stir in parsley and remove; pour over pasta., Sprinkle with "Italian cheese"., Serve with a salad and bread.

title: Great Gerts
directions: Cream margarine and cheese., Add seasonings, flour and Rice Krispies., Pinch off small bits with your fingers and press flat with a fork dipped in cold water., The smaller these are the better they are., Bake on a cookie sheet for about 12 minutes at 350°.

title: Glorified (Heavenly) Rice
directions: Mix all ingredients., Chill very thoroughly before serving. Serves 6 to 8., If you choose to use Cool Whip, add just before serving instead of whipping cream.

title: Chocolate Oatmeal Drops
directions: Put the sugar, milk and butter in boiler; boil for 1 minute. Remove from heat., Add the cocoa, quick oats and nuts., Stir and mix in the vanilla and pinch of salt., Spoon out by drops on dish sprayed with Pam or greased with butter.

title: Squash Cookies
directions: Combine squash, sugar, oil and egg., Sift together flour, baking powder, cinnamon and salt., Add to squash mixture., Add soda, dissolved in milk., Add vanilla., Drop on greased baking sheet., Bake 10 to 12 minutes in 375° oven.

title: Chicken Dressing
directions: Mix all ingredients well., Pour into a well-greased pan. Bake one hour or until brown at 400°.

title: Oven Stew
directions: Cut stew meat into small pieces., Salt, pepper and roll in flour., Brown in skillet., Put stew meat, carrots, tomato sauce and cabbage in a long pan or Dutch oven., Cover and bake 2 to 3 hours or until tender-done at 300° to 350°.

title: Baked Spaghetti
directions: Combine spaghetti, eggs and Parmesan cheese., Place half of mixture in greased 8 x 8-inch baking dish., Add half of Mozzarella cheese., Repeat with remaining spaghetti and Mozzarella., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes., Cut into squares and serve with spaghetti sauce., Makes 4 servings.

title: Diabetic Orange Cookies
directions: Cream first three ingredients, then add the rest of the ingredients and form into 1-inch balls., Chill., Press a pecan half in the center., Bake at 350° for 12 minutes., Makes 5 dozen cookies.

title: Frozen Coleslaw
directions: Combine vegetables., Sprinkle with salt and let stand 1 hour. Drain, if water accumulates., Combine remaining ingredients in saucepan. Bring to a boil. Boil 1 minute., Cool., Pour over cabbage mixture. Stir well. Freeze in plastic bags or container. To serve, thaw in refrigerator.

title: Quiche Lorraine
directions: Prepare eggs and cream in blender., Put ham and Swiss cheese in pie shell., Pour egg mixture over it., Cook 45 minutes at 400°.

title: Frozen Strawberry Yummy
directions: Cut first 3 ingredients as for a crust., Add nuts., Spread out crumbs onto cookie sheet and bake at 375° for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally., Spread a little more than half of the crumbs into bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan.

title: "Jack'S" Crock-Pot Beans
directions: *Read Jack and the Bean Stalk.

title: Stuffed Peppers
directions: In mixing bowl, add meat, rice, garlic powder, chopped onion and 1/2 can of tomato sauce., Mix all together., Set aside., Cut tops off green peppers and hollow., Boil all peppers for 5 minutes, then fill each pepper with meat mixture in round, deep dish., Pour over leftover tomato sauce., Cook at 400° for 45 minutes., Pour juice over if desired.

title: Irish Soda Bread
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., Mix together first 5 ingredients., Cut in margarine., Add milk to make a soft dough., Knead lightly on floured board for 2 minutes., Shape into a round loaf., Place on greased cookie sheet, cut an `X' across the top., Bake for 25 minutes.

title: Meatballs
directions: Combine ingredients; form into balls., Brown., Add sauce. Simmer for 45 minutes.

title: Hamburger Casserole
directions: *Or whatever vegetables you want.

title: Favorite Meat Loaf
directions: Place all ingredients in a large mixing bowl and mix well. Shape into loaf and cover top of loaf generously with catsup. Bake at 325° for 1 hour., Can be baked on broiler pan rack so grease will not be absorbed into loaf., Makes 10 servings.

title: German Chocolate Cake Mix Cookies
directions: Heat oven to 350°., In large bowl, combine all ingredients. Blend well., Drop dough by rounded teaspoonfuls 2 inches apart onto ungreased cookie sheets., Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes or until set., Cool 1 minute; remove from cookie sheets., Makes 4 1/2 dozen cookies.

title: Chinese Vegetable Salad
directions: Mix and let stand overnight in refrigerator., Will keep for days.

title: Fried Sweet Potatoes
directions: Slice sweet potatoes., Cover an iron frying pan with just enough oil to cover bottom., Fry 1 layer of sweet potatoes at a time, turning to brown both sides, lightly., Lift onto platter and, if desired, sprinkle with cinnamon and sugar, or eat plain.

title: 4 To 6 Pound Brisket(Freezes Well)
directions: Trim all fat from brisket., Generously cover both sides of brisket with garlic salt, celery salt and onion salt. Pour all of hickory liquid smoke; place in 9 x 13-inch baking pan., Cover tightly with aluminum foil and put in refrigerator overnight.

title: Peppered Steak
directions: Flour, salt and pepper steak., Brown in frying pan in oil. Place bell pepper and onion over steak., Pour bouillon over steak and simmer for 1 hour.

title: Lasagne(Lite Cooking)
directions: Cook and stir onions and garlic in Crisco until tender., Add ground beef and drain if necessary., Add tomatoes and tomato paste, basil, oregano, sugar and pepper., Stir until well blended. Simmer 30 minutes., Combine cottage cheese, 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese and parsley; set aside., Cook noodles 7 minutes in unsalted boiling water., Drain., Heat oven to 350°., Layer all ingredients in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan., Top with sauce and Mozzarella cheese. Bake 45 minutes., Makes 12 servings.

title: Lipton Pepper Steak
directions: Cut meat into thin strips, 2-inches long., In a large skillet, heat shortening and brown meat trimmings., Stir in onion soup mix and *2 cups water., Cover and simmer 30 minutes (until meat is tender)., Stir in peppers and simmer, covered, 10 minutes., Blend cornstarch with 1/2 cup water., Stir into skillet mixture. Cook until thickened.

title: 1-2-3-4 Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees., Butter & flour a 10-inch tube pan., Sift flour, baking powder, & salt., In a cup stir milk & vanilla., In a large bowl mix butter and sugar until yellow and fluffy., Add 2 eggs and beat well., Repeat and add last 2 eggs. Beat well., With a wooden spoon stir in flour mixture., Add milk mixture., Spoon into pan., Bake 1 hour., Cool cake in pan 10 minutes., Turn onto cake plate and dust with confectioners sugar.

title: Goop
directions: Mix and shake., Put in covered container.

title: Potato Pancakes
directions: Mix well., Drop by spoonful into hot skillet., Fry until crisp.

title: Stuffed Cabbages
directions: Core and steam cabbage until leaves can be peeled off in whole pieces., In a large bowl, mix together meats, rice, onion, salt and pepper., Add water to meat/rice mixture until "sloppy" to the touch; more is better than not enough., Line bottom of roast pan with outer, torn cabbage leaves (reserve enough to cover casserole, also)., Pour 1/2 can of sauerkraut over leaves., Roll small amount of meat/rice mixture in individual cabbage leaves, starting from stem side and tucking in edges., Place rolls in layers on top of sauerkruat., Add remaining sauerkraut with juice, tomatoes, with juice and 1/2 can water., Top with remaining torn leaves which will burn while cooking and will be discarded. Cover and bake at 350° for 1 hour. Serve with mashed potatoes and crusty bread.

title: Cranberry Grape Ice Cream Soda
directions: In a blender container, process grape cranberry drink and 1 scoop ice cream until smooth., Pour into glass with remaining ice cream., Top with soda., Makes 1 serving.

title: Vegetable Soup(Heart Smart)
directions: In medium saucepan over medium-high heat in hot oil, cook onion and garlic about 3 minutes or until soft, stirring frequently., Add tomatoes in juice, chicken broth, carrots, celery, parsley, basil, salt and pepper and bring to a boil. Reduce heat; cover., Simmer about 20 minutes., Add lima beans and water; bring to a boil., Reduce heat., Cover., Simmer about 20 minutes or until beans are tender., Makes 6 servings, about 3/4 cup each.

title: Turtle Cookies
directions: Melt first two ingredients. Add remaining ingredients and mix together. Drop by teaspoonful on waffle iron and cook 1 minute. Frosting is enough for a double recipe of cookies.

title: Broccoli Cornbread
directions: Mix all ingredients together; batter will be thick., Spread into lightly greased 9 x 13 inch pan., Bake at 350° until knife comes out clean.

title: Healthy Banana-Nut Muffins
directions: Preheat oven to 400° (200°C)., Mix both flours with sugar and walnuts., Stir in baking powder, cinnamon and salt., Place mashed bananas in separate bowl., Add eggs, milk and oil and mix well. Add wet ingredients to dry, mixing just until moistened., Spoon into lightly greased muffin tins and bake 15 to 20 minutes, depending on size., Cool on wire racks., Serves 6 to 8.

title: Cherry Pound Cake
directions: Grease tube pan and dust with flour., Combine margarine and sugar., Add eggs, one at a time., Add flour, vanilla and salt; mix well., Fold in walnuts and halved maraschino cherries., Bake at 325° for 1 1/2 hours., Remove from pan after 10 minutes., Sprinkle with powdered sugar.

title: Holiday Punch
directions: Mix together jello and sugar., Add hot water., Mix together thoroughly until jello and sugar are totally dissolved., Add ReaLemon juice and pineapple juice; mix well.

title: Twice-Baked Sweet Potatoes
directions: Pierce potatoes with a fork. Bake at 375° for 40 to 60 minutes or until tender. Allow potatoes to cool to the touch. Cut them in half lengthwise; carefully scoop out pulp, leaving a 1/4-inch shell. Place pulp in a large bowl. Add orange juice. Melt 3 tablespoons butter; add to pulp and beat until smooth. Stuff the potato shells; place in an ungreased 15 x 10 x 1-inch baking pan.

title: Chicken Macaroni Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients in ungreased 1 1/2-quart casserole or 10 x 6 x 1 1/2-inch baking dish., Cover and cook at 350° until macaroni is tender, 55 to 60 minutes., Serves 4 to 6.

title: Macaroni Salad
directions: Combine and let set a couple of days before serving.

title: Strawberry Square Salad
directions: Dissolve gelatin and water together., Add pineapple juice. Place in the refrigerator until partially congealed., Fold in fruit and marshmallows., Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan., Place in refrigerator overnight to congeal., Serves 24.

title: Loaf Pound Cake
directions: In one bowl combine flour, sugar, baking powder and salt. Blend in butter, vanilla, egg yolks and milk., Beat vigorously for 3 minutes., Pour batter into a greased 9-inch loaf pan., Bake at 350° for 60 to 70 minutes., Yields one 9-inch cake.

title: Hawaiian Banana Nut Bread
directions: Mix together flour, soda, cinnamon, sugar, cloves, salt and nuts and set aside.

title: Spinach Souffle
directions: Thaw and squeeze out spinach., Mix with other ingredients. Put in greased casserole., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes (for, a 7 x 11-inch dish)., I use a 9 x 13-inch dish and bake a little less time.

title: Candied Or Stewed Apples
directions: Dissolve sugar in water in large saucepan., Prepare apples by cutting in half and removing cores., Place in saucepan and sprinkle with spices and butter., Cover and cook slowly and turn apples when about half done., Cook until juice begins to get syrupy.

title: Salisbury Meatballs
directions: Combine the ingredients., Cover with sauce., Bake for 1 hour at 350°.

title: Fresh Salsa
directions: In a large frying pan, cook all the chiles until black on each side, then cut chiles down the middle and remove all the seeds. Dice chiles real small., Put into a large saucepan., Chop onions and tomatoes real small., Put into pan with chiles., Add the Pace salsa to other ingredients in pan., Also, add tomato sauce, stewed tomatoes and 1 cup of water., Let simmer for about 1 hour., Make sure to add about 1 tablespoon of garlic salt., Make sure to mix all ingredients well before simmering., Makes about 6 pounds of salsa.

title: Easy Crust Chicken Pie
directions: Cook and debone fryer., Cut up chicken and place in a large baking dish., Mix soup and broth; heat until creamy., Add salt and pepper; pour over chicken., Mix flour, milk and melted margarine. Spoon over chicken., Bake at 450° until brown and bubbly, about 30 minutes.

title: Layered Salad
directions: Cut lettuce into bite size pieces and place in bottom of 13 x 9-inch dish., Mix celery, onion, pepper, carrots and water chestnuts together; spread evenly over lettuce., Spread Hellmann's mayonnaise over top of mixture., Make sure you use sufficient mayonnaise, because this will become your dressing when served. Sprinkle 3 tablespoons sugar over mayonnaise., Cover with plastic wrap; let stand overnight in refrigerator.

title: Curried Baked Fruit(Prepare The Day Before)
directions: Drain all fruit., Add sugar and curry to melted butter. Arrange fruit and nuts in layers in casserole; pour butter mixture over all and bake at 325° for 1 hour., Refrigerate overnight. Reheat at 350° before serving., Yields 10 to 12 servings.

title: Cream Cheese Cupcakes
directions: Mix cream cheese and sugar until creamy. Add eggs and vanilla. Put 1 vanilla wafer in each cupcake liner. Put 2 tablespoons of cream cheese mixture on top of vanilla wafer. Bake at 370° for 15 to 20 minutes. Let cool. Put 1 tablespoon of pie filling on top of each one.

title: Possum Stew
directions: Paw 'n the chillun' allus worked so hard a' catchin' little fish outta the creek that they just had to be cooked! ... but they iz sweet 'n gud eatin'., Scales, take insides out'n the haid off ... clean in cold watah ... salt 'n roll in 1/2 meal 'n 1/2 flour ... drop in hot fat 'n brown on both sides., To eat small bream ... furst pull fins off ... then start at the tail 'n ease meat up with a fork along backbone all the way up to whair the haid wuz ... hit'll cum off in one piece widout bones iffn you're careful.

title: Broccoli-Chicken-Stuffing Hot Dish
directions: Brown chicken in margarine., Salt and pepper to taste., Put veggies in 2-quart casserole dish., Microwave about 8 minutes, covered, turning once and stirring., Put about 1/2 package of stuffing mix on top of veggies., Mix soups and milk and pour 3/4 over stuffing., Add chicken and pour rest of soup over chicken. Bake 45 minutes to 1 hour at 375°.

title: Imperial Crab
directions: Combine ingredients. Toss lightly., Put in crab shells., Bake in a 350° oven until golden brown.

title: Pistachio Salad
directions: Put pineapple and juice in a large bowl; add pudding and mix well., Stir in marshmallows and fold in Cool Whip., Keep refrigerated., Makes 10 servings with 1 gram of fat per serving.

title: Sour Cream Lasagne
directions: Lightly brown beef and remove excess fat., Add tomato sauce, onions, salts and sugar., Simmer 10 minutes., Cream together sour cream and cream cheese., Line lightly oiled 13 x 9 x 2-inch dish with layer of cooked noodles., Add 1/2 of tomato mixture., Put cream cheese mixture on top and spread evenly into layer., Put another layer of noodles and top these with other half of tomato mixture., Put grated cheese on top., Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes., Serve hot.

title: Coffee-Toffee Torte
directions: Freeze, then crush Heath bars., Prepare angel food cake as directed on box., Bake in a 10-inch tube pan., Invert and cool. In saucepan, mix pudding and instant coffee, but using only 1 1/3 cups of milk for each package of pudding for a total of 2 2/3 cups of milk., Cook according to directions on box., Cool., When cool, beat until mixture is smooth., Fold in half of the whipped cream. Split cake into 3 layers., Spread half of the pudding-cream mixture between layers., Fold remaining whipped cream into pudding mixture and frost tops and sides of cake., Sprinkle top and sides of cake with crushed Heath bars., Chill until ready to serve.

title: *Baklava("Pita Dulci")
directions: Butter a 12 x 17 x 1-inch baking pan. Butter 8 to 10 sheets of phyllo for bottom crust., Sprinkle nuts (combined with sugar and cinnamon)., Sprinkle nuts on every sheet or every two sheets. Top with 8 sheets. Refrigerate., Cut into diamonds. Bake at 350° for 60 minutes. (After 40 minutes, lower oven to 325° for remaining 20 minutes.), Pour cooled syrup over hot Baklava.

title: Phillip'S Dump Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Grease 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan., Dump pineapple into pan; spread evenly., Dump cherry filling., Spread evenly., (Layer) dump dry cake mix onto cherry layer; spread evenly., Sprinkle nuts on top of dry cake mix., Put margarine over top., Bake at 350° for 48 to 53 minutes., Serve warm or cold. Makes 15 to 18 servings.

title: Watergate Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients with juice of pineapple, Cool Whip and pudding., Blend in pineapple, nuts and cherries., Refrigerate.

title: Hamburger Dip
directions: Brown hamburger and onion., Put chili and peppers in crock-pot., Add hamburger and onion, then add 1/2 box of cheese. Cook 1/2 hour., Stir, then add remaining cheese., Cook 1 to 2 hours in crock-pot., Enjoy!

title: Apple Pie Delight(Diabetic)
directions: Preheat oven to 425°., In a mixing bowl combine Equal Measure, flour, nutmeg, cinnamon and salt.	Add dry mixture to apples; toss gently to coat fruit.	Fill a pastry lined 9-inch pie plate with apple mixture., Dot with margarine., Cover with top crust, that has slits in it., Seal and flute edge.	Bake 15 minutes at 425° and turn oven down to 350° and bake an additional 30 minutes.

title: Roasted Pecan Halves
directions: Preheat oven to 300°., Spread pecans on large baking sheet. Melt butter and pour over pecan halves., Sprinkle with salt and bake 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Orange Nut Glazed Raisin Bread
directions: Scald milk, pour over salt, sugar and butter., Blend and cool to lukewarm., Sprinkle yeast on warm water, stir to dissolve., Add to milk mixture with 2 1/2 cups flour., Beat 2 minutes with electric mixer, then beat in eggs, orange peel, ginger, raisins and 1/2 cup flour., Then mix in enough remaining flour, a little at a time with spoon., Then use hands knead until smooth into a ball. Grease and let rise in warm place until doubled., Punch down., Let rise 15 minutes., Make into 2 loaves., Make 3 slashes in top., Let raise not more than double., Bake in moderate oven at 375° for 40 to 50 minutes., Cover with sheet of foil after 20 minutes if it browns too fast., Remove loaves from pan., Place on wire rack, spread Orange Glaze over them, then cool.

title: Fancy Green Beans
directions: Chop bacon in pieces,, fry in skillet.	Saute onion and pimiento in bacon grease;, add, the green beans, juice and all to mixture., Add garlic, salt	and, Nature's, Season to taste. Simmer.

title: Hominy Casserole
directions: Mix Cheez Whiz and hominy in casserole dish., Bake at 350° until cheese is melted., Stir well; then top with crumbled corn chips., Cook about 10 minutes., Serve while hot.

title: Mustard And Vinegar Pickles
directions: Mix all ingredients; make sure cucumbers are covered., Use a large container., Let set for 3 to 4 weeks.

title: Ham Rolls
directions: Soften cream cheese in microwave. Chop green onions and mix with cream cheese. Spread a layer over each slice of ham. Roll the ham up and slice into small sections. Place a toothpick in each one and refrigerate at least 2 hours until ready to eat.

title: Broccoli Salad
directions: Steam broccoli for 5 minutes (until bright green and still crisp)., Cool and chop into 1/2-inch pieces., Add onions, olives, Miracle Whip and dill seed., Refrigerate overnight (or for at least 8 hours); just before serving, add eggs or cheese and salt to taste., Stir well., Serves 8 to 10.

title: Never Fail Caramel Icing
directions: Melt butter in saucepan., Add brown sugar., Boil over low heat, stirring constantly., Stir in milk and bring to a boil again, stirring constantly., Remove from heat and cool to lukewarm., Gradually add powdered sugar until thick enough to spread.

title: Wild Turkey Salsa And Rice
directions: Cut up turkey in chunks and cook in a crock-pot with water on low for 4 hours or until tender., Saute oleo, garlic, onion and green peppers in a Dutch oven., Add all vegetables in a Dutch oven on top of stove and simmer for 30 minutes., Add cooked turkey and simmer for 15 minutes.

title: Sweet Sour Pork Chops
directions: Brown chops in shortening; drain excess fat., Sprinkle lightly with salt and pepper., Combine ketchup and remaining ingredients; pour over chops., Cover; simmer 45 minutes, basting occasionally, or until meat is tender., Skim off any fat from sauce., Makes 6 servings (1 cup sauce).

title: Pink Flamingo
directions: Soften cream cheese; beat until fluffy., Add milk, lemon juice, vanilla and red food coloring., Mix well., Pour into a vanilla wafer crust in a 9 x 13-inch dish., Slice bananas over the top., Spread whipped cream over the top., Chill and serve.

title: Curry-Glazed Chicken
directions: Place margarine in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish and heat in a 375° oven until melted., Stir in honey, mustard and curry powder. Add chicken, turning to coat., Bake, turning chicken over after 20 minutes., Bake an additional 20 to 25 minutes., Makes 4 servings. Contains 255 calories per serving.

title: Cherry Flip
directions: Mix together crackers and oleo and pat into a small oblong dish., Bake at 350° for 10 minutes., Cream together cream cheese, sugar and milk., Spread on top of cooled crust., Sprinkle nuts on cream cheese mixture., Spread Cool Whip atop nuts., Then spread pie filling atop the Cool Whip., Very good!

title: Crock-Pot Apple Butter
directions: Start cooking on high. Turn to low and simmer 24 hours., If too juicy, uncover last two hours of cooking time., Your house will smell delightful!, Yields 2 to 3 pints.

title: Orchard Pops
directions: In blender, combine all ingredients; blend until smooth., Pour about 1/3 cup into each of six 3-ounce paper cups., Cover with foil., Insert wooden stick through foil., Freeze, for 5 hours or until firm., Before serving, let pops stand 10 minutes at room temperature., Remove foil and peel off paper cups.

title: Cucumber Salad
directions: Peel cukes, slice or grate, also the onion., Sprinkle with salt and set aside for 1 hour., Squeeze a few at a time (discarding liquid)., Pour the vinegar, water, sugar, black pepper and green pepper and mix thoroughly. Add enough sour cream to make it a bit soupy. Sprinkle paprika on top before serving.

title: Old-Fashioned Raisin Bars
directions: Combine raisins and water in saucepan and bring to a boil. Remove from heat and stir in salad dressing. Cool to lukewarm. Stir in sugar and egg. Add dry ingredients and beat., Stir in nuts., Pour into greased baking sheet. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes. Dust with confectioners sugar.

title: Pumpkin Pecan Bread
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Sift together flour, soda, salt and cinnamon and nutmeg., Add sugar and stir to mix thoroughly., Make a well in center of dry ingredients and add all at once, the oil, eggs and water and pumpkin., Mix well and add nuts., Pour batter into 3 (8 x 4-inch) loaf pans., Fill only half full., Bake for 1 hour or until wooden toothpick comes out clean., One loaf equals 16 slices; each slice contains 85 calories.

title: Beef And Noodle Casserole
directions: In a large skillet, brown beef., Remove beef and drain fat. In the same skillet, melt butter over medium heat., Saute onion and pepper until tender., Add beef, Worcestershire sauce, noodles and soups; mix well., Spoon into a greased 3-quart casserole; top with shredded cheese., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes., Yields 8 servings.

title: Green Bean Casserole
directions: Drain and rinse beans., Let stand in ice water while making roux.

title: Lena'S 5 Pound Fudge
directions: Cook together until a firm ball., Beat until you can't beat anymore.

title: Baked Chicken
directions: Pour into, a, plastic bag; add 2 or 3 pieces of chicken at a time, shaking until well coated., Melt 1 stick of margarine., Turn over, to coat both sides.	Place in single layer. Bake at	400° for, 35, minutes., Turn and bake until finished browning, about 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Campfire Bean Dinner
directions: In large skillet, brown meat well., Stir in soup mix, beans, chili sauce and water., Simmer, uncovered, stirring occasionally for 20 minutes., Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Refrigerator Mashed Potatoes
directions: Cook, drain and mash potatoes., Add cheese, sour cream, salt, pepper and butter., Beat until smooth and fluffy., Refrigerate or bake for 30 minutes at 350°., Makes 8 cups.

title: Old Fashioned Light Bread
directions: In a large mixer bowl, combine 3 cups flour and yeast., In saucepan, heat milk, shortening, sugar and salt just until warm and shortening is almost melted; stir constantly. Add to flour mixture. Beat at low speed 1/2 minute, scraping sides of bowl. Beat 3 minutes at high speed. Gradually stir in as much flour as you can mix with a spoon., Turn out onto lightly floured surface. Knead in enough of the remaining flour to make a moderately stiff dough that is smooth and elastic. Shape into a ball., Place in a lightly greased bowl at least twice as, large as the ball of dough., Turn dough over once to grease surface. Cover with slightly damp cloth. Allow to rise in warm place until double in size (about 1 hour).

title: Merk'S Coffee Cake
directions: Cream shortening, sugar and vanilla thoroughly., Add eggs, singly, beating well after each addition., Sift flour, baking powder and soda together., Add to creamed mixture, alternating with sour cream, blending after each addition., Spread half of batter in 10-inch tube pan, that has been greased and lined on the bottom with waxed paper., Cream butter, brown sugar and cinnamon together., Add nuts; mix well., Dot batter in pan evenly with half of nut mixture., Cover with remaining batter. Dot with remaining mixture., Bake at 350°, about 50 minutes., Cool cake for 10 minutes., Remove from pan.

title: Texas Meatballs And Rice
directions: Mix ground beef, egg, chili powder, salt and pepper; shape into 1 1/2 to 2-inch balls., Place in 2-quart casserole., Microwave at High (100%) until meatballs are set and lose pink color, 4 to 7 minutes, rearranging meatballs after half the cooking time., Drain. Stir in remaining ingredients; cover., Microwave at High (100%) until mixture is bubbly and onion is tender, 4 to 7 minutes., If using an oven without a carousel, stir after half the cooking time. Let stand until rice is tender, 2 to 3 minutes., Makes 4 servings.

title: Paul Newman Chicken
directions: Clean chicken and marinate several hours in dressing., Preheat oven to 400°., Put bread crumbs in plastic bag and shake chicken generously in crumbs., Spray a 13 x 9 pan with Pam., Place chicken in pan., Cook for 1 hour, uncovered, turning once., If chicken appears to be cooking too fast, turn oven down to 350° for the last 15 or 20 minutes., This dish is great hot or cold.

title: Spicy Fruited Chicken
directions: Brown chicken in oil in skillet; pour off fat., Stir in remaining ingredients., Cover and simmer 45 minutes or until done, stirring occasionally., Garnish with orange slices.

title: Barbecue Sauce
directions: Mix all ingredients together except pickling spice., Pour pickling spice in a strainer and put in mixture., Cook on low heat for 3 hours., Remove strainer and discard spices., Refrigerate sauce.

title: Never Fail Fudge
directions: Combine first 5 ingredients., Stir over low heat until blended., Bring to a boil over moderate heat., Be careful not to mistake air bubbles for boiling., Boil slowly, stirring constantly for 5 minutes (soft ball stage)., Remove from heat., Stir in chips and vanilla until chips have melted., Turn into a buttered 9 x 9-inch pan., Let cool.

title: Cherry Winks
directions: Sift together, dry ingredients; set aside., Beat butter or margarine and sugar, until	light, and, fluffy;, add, eggs. Beat well., Stir in, milk, and, vanilla., Add flour; mix well. Stir in nuts, dates and chopped cherries., Shape tablespoon of dough into ball and, roll, in	Corn, Flakes., Place on greased cookie sheet and put a quartered cherry in the middle of each. Bake at 350° for 10 to 14 minutes.

title: Texas Hash
directions: Brown hamburger., Add pepper and ringed onions., Mix in chili powder, tomatoes and rice., Bake in covered dish at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
directions: Mix cream cheese and powdered sugar together; add peanut butter and milk and fold in Cool Whip., Pour into graham crust. Freeze until firm., Take from freezer a few minutes before serving.

title: Skyline Dip
directions: Microwave Skyline until completely defrosted., Spread cream cheese in the bottom of a medium size baking dish until covered. Pour defrosted Skyline over cream cheese., Sprinkle cheese and onions (optional) and serve warm with tortilla chips.

title: Oatmeal Crispies
directions: Cream together first 5 ingredients. Sift together flour, salt and baking soda., Add flour mixture to creamed mixture., Add oatmeal and mix well. Add desired nuts, raisins, chocolate chips or dried fruit. Bake until brown in a 350° oven.

title: Coconut Pound Cake
directions: Cream shortening and sugar together., Add eggs, one at a time. Beat well after each., Sift dry ingredients., Add alternately with the buttermilk, coconut flavoring and coconut., Bake in a greased and floured stem pan for 50 minutes to 1 hour at 350°.

title: Sex In A Pan
directions: Combine butter, flour and chopped pecans; press in bottom of 13x9x2 inch pan and bake at 350° for 25 minutes., Let totally cool., Mix powdered sugar and cream cheese; layer on crust. Spread 1 c. of cool whip on cream cheese., Combine 1 1/2 c. of milk with each pudding and layer on top of cream cheese., Top with 12 oz. of cool whip., Serve chilled.

title: "Newfie" Corn Soup
directions: In a 2-quart pot, melt butter., Add onion and cook until soft, but not brown., Add potatoes, 1/4 teaspoon salt and 1 cup water. Cook until potatoes are soft and water is evaporated., (Add more water, if necessary.), Add creamed corn and evaporated milk to desired consistency., Simmer 5 minutes over low heat., Add salt and pepper to taste., Serve with hot Italian bread or rolls and a salad.

title: Rhubarb And Strawberry Pie
directions: Mix sugar and flour., Add 3/4 of mixture to fruits., Put remaining and sugar mixture in unbaked pie shell., Add fruit., Dot with butter., Add top crust., Bake in 420° oven for 10 minutes. Reduce temperature to 350° and bake 35 minutes more.

title: Haystack Cookies
directions: Melt peanut butter and morsels and fold in potatoes and pecans., Spoon out on wax paper.

title: Green Bean Side Dish
directions: Steam beans with oil and dill weed to warm., Add margarine to taste., Serve piping hot., This vegetable is especially good with Italian foods., Yields 4 to 6 servings.

title: Indian Corn
directions: Cut bacon into small pieces; fry until crisp, drain, reserving 2 tablespoons fat., In reserved fat, saute green pepper and onion until tender., Add corn, salt and pepper; heat thoroughly over medium heat., Add cream; cook 1 minute, stirring., Stir in bacon. Serve immediately., Serves 4.

title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
directions: Mix butter and sugar, add egg yolks., Mix soda into sour cream., Add flour and sour cream alternately to butter/sugar mixture., Add vanilla and almond extract.

title: Mexican Meat Casserole
directions: Fry hamburger and onion together; pour off grease., Mix in enchilada sauce and mushroom soup; mix well., In casserole dish, layer Doritos, sprinkle with grated cheese. Place layer of meat mixture and layer of Doritos, and layer of meat mixture, sprinkle with cheese., Cook in hot oven for 10 minutes.

title: Chicken Cordon Bleu
directions: Melt margarine in large skillet., Add chicken and ham; cook and stir for 5 to 8 minutes until chicken is browned., Stir in soup, water, beans and mustard., Bring to boil., Stir in rice and cheese; cover., Remove from heat and let stand for 5 minutes until liquid is absorbed., Fluff with fork and serve., Serves 4.

title: Egg Noodles
directions: If eggs are small, use a little less flour; if eggs are large use a little more flour.

title: Harvest Apple Cake
directions: Grease and lightly flour a 9-inch tube pan., Sift together flour, baking soda, salt and cinnamon., Chop and peel apples., Set them aside., Stir together eggs and vanilla, then beat 2 minutes, until light., Gradually add oil, beating until thick., Gradually beat in sugar., Add dry ingredients, apples and nuts a little at a time; beat well after each addition., Beat 3 minutes at medium speed., Bake at 350° for 55 minutes., Use cream cheese frosting.

title: June'S Jiffy Peach Cobbler
directions: Melt butter in large pan., Mix batter of flour, sugar and juice., Pour over butter., Lay peaches over batter., Bake at 350° to 375° for 45 minutes.

title: French Onion Soup
directions: Cut onion into thin slices; saute in margarine., Add flour and pepper; cook for 10 minutes., Add stock and Worcestershire sauce until onion is tender.

title: Waffle Cookie
directions: Cream margarine., Add eggs, sugar and vanilla., Add flour, then chocolate chips., Heat up waffle iron., Put 2 to 4 small teaspoons of batter,, separately, in waffle iron, making 2 to 4 cookies., Close iron, then take out with fork., "Great!"

title: Grandmother'S Gingerbread
directions: Blend sugar, shortening and eggs., Stir in molasses., Combine dry ingredients alternately with buttermilk., Beat well., Pour into greased and floured pan (13 x 9 x 2-inch)., Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes until done.

title: Chili Cheese Squares
directions: Grate cheese and mix together. Beat eggs lightly. Add canned milk to eggs and blend with cheeses. In a 9 x 13 buttered pan, cover bottom with chopped green chilies. Pour cheese mixture over chilies. Bake at 350° for 40 minutes. Remove, cool. Cut in 1 inch squares.

title: Spaghetti(With Homemade Pastas Of Course!)
directions: In a large Dutch oven, lightly brown the meat in oil and garlic at medium-low heat., Slowly mix in water and tomato paste. Add onions, celery and bell peppers. Simmer, covered, 3 to 5 hours until meat is very tender. Check often and add water as needed, making certain there is about a quart of thin sauce when ready to add the pasta., Add salt, pepper and homemade pasta., Simmer, uncovered, 20 minutes to 1/2 hour, stirring often, until broth is absorbed., Stir in parsley. Serves 6.

title: Frozen Pea Salad - Layered
directions: Put all ingredients in large bowl in layers as listed., Spread over this 2 cups mayonnaise mixed with 3 tablespoons sugar (seal edges as you spread)., Cover with airtight seal (I use Tupperware).

title: Asparagus Roll-Ups
directions: Cook asparagus; drain., Trim crusts from bread., Flatten each piece with rolling pin., Mix softened butter with cheeses., Spread mixture on each piece of bread and top with a piece of asparagus. Roll and dip in butter., Cut into fourths and freeze., When ready to serve, bake 15 minutes at 400°., Makes 96.

title: German Apple Cake
directions: Sift together flour, baking soda, salt and cinnamon., Combine eggs, sugar, oil and vanilla., Add dry ingredients., Beat together., Add sliced apples and walnuts., Grease 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Dan'S Double Chocolate Chip Cookies
directions: Beat the butter and sugar together until light and fluffy. Beat in the eggs, one at a time. Beat in the brandy., Melt the chocolate in dish over hot water. Stir the melted chocolate and sour cream into the creamed mixture. Sift together the flour, cocoa, baking soda, baking powder and salt., Stir the dry ingredients gradually into the melted chocolate mixture to form a batter., Stir in the white chocolate chips and nuts. Drop the batter by tablespoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350° for 10 minutes., Makes about 5 dozen.

title: Pot Roast Meat Loaf
directions: Mix first 8 and shape into a loaf in center of a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan., Peel and slice potatoes, onions and carrots (sliced lengthwise)., Mix parsley flakes, salt and pepper., Place vegetables in layers around meat., Sprinkle each layer with part of salt mixture., Cover pan tightly with foil., Bake in 375° oven for 1 hour or until vegetables are tender., Uncover and bake 10 minutes more to brown meat., Serves 4.

title: Pizza Burgers
directions: Combine milk, ground beef, cracker meal, onion, garlic salt, and Parmesan cheese in a large bowl., Mix well., Split each bun and toast lightly., Divide meat mixture into 8 parts., Spread one part mixture evenly over top surface of each bun., Place on cookie sheet., Make a well in center of meat, using the back of a spoon. Combine tomato sauce and oregano., Spoon 2 teaspoons of mixture into each well., Bake at 425° for 20 minutes., Sprinkle 2 tablespoons cheese over each burger., Continue baking until cheese melts.

title: Pineapple And Coconut Pie
directions: Pour into two 9-inch pie shells., Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Anisette Sponges Cake
directions: Mix together rum and water., Layer one package of Sponges in a 10-inch spring-form pan., Pour half the water and rum mixture over sponges., Cook pudding according to directions., While hot, pour half over sponges.

title: Butter Balls
directions: Mix together all ingredients; chill., Roll into balls., Bake at 350° for 15 to 18 minutes., Roll in powdered sugar.

title: Debbie'S Cranberry Salad
directions: Mix Jell-O and hot water in large container; set aside., In food processor, grind cranberries and orange., Chop celery; mix together., Add lemon juice and sugar., Add nuts., Refrigerate until firm.

title: Easy French Bread
directions: Sift flour, sugar, salt and yeast in large mixing bowl., Add hot tap water and oil at one time., Stir until dough leaves sides of bowl., Turn out on floured surface and knead 10 minutes until smooth and elastic., Put in greased bowl., Turn cover and let rise until doubled., Turn out., Divide in half., Roll each half to 12 x 15-inch., Roll tightly from long side., Place on greased cookie sheet., Slash top 3 to 4 times diagonally., Let rise.

title: Bean And Vegetable Salad
directions: Cook frozen vegetables as directed; drain and cool., Add drained red beans., Add diced vegetables and mix., Sprinkle with salt and pepper and mix., Mix sugar, vinegar, flour and mustard in a small saucepan., Cook, stirring until clear., Cool and pour over vegetables.

title: Zucchini Stew
directions: Thaw sausage meat the night before., Brown in frying pan and drain any excess fat., Set meat aside., Peel zucchini and slice into 1/4-inch thick rounds., Peel and slice onions and garlic.

title: Teresa'S Cabbage Salad
directions: Saute almonds in butter; add poppy seed., Cool., Mix cabbage and noodles and almond mixture., Add dressing of oil, vinegar and sugar., Refrigerate an hour if possible.

title: Benedictine Spread
directions: Combine first 5 ingredients in a bowl; mix well., Add a drop of green food coloring; stir well., Spread mixture on bread slices., Serve as finger sandwiches.

title: Baked Grits
directions: Heat oven to 375°., Grease large baking dish with butter flavor Crisco., Melt butter flavor Crisco in large skillet., Add mushrooms., Saute until mushrooms give up their liquid, about 5 minutes., Place grits in large bowl., Mash if they are leftovers. Add mushrooms, eggs, evaporated milk, cheese, paprika and cayenne. Stir gently to mix., Pour into casserole., Bake at 375° for 25 to 30 minutes., Makes 8 servings.

title: Sweet Potato - Corn Chowder
directions: Saute onion, garlic and sweet potato in butter or margarine until onion is translucent., Add remaining ingredients except for corn and heavy cream., Cook over medium heat for 45 minutes., Add frozen corn and heavy cream., Cook 5 more minutes over medium heat., Adjust seasoning to taste.

title: Chocolate Chip Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients together in order given., Mix until smooth., (Will be thick.), Put into Bundt pan that has been sprayed with oil., Bake at 325° for 1 1/2 to 2 hours or until center is done., Let cool before cutting., Very moist and rich.

title: Pork Chops And Rice Casserole
directions: Flour pork chops and lightly brown in oil in a heavy skillet. Remove from skillet and drain., In a large casserole dish, stir together chicken and rice soup, water and instant rice., Add pork chops., Cook for 1 hour in a 375° oven.

title: Mary Bradshaw'S Bourbon Hot Dogs
directions: Cut hog dogs in bite size pieces., Put on cookie sheet in 350° oven just until cuts are sealed., Mix catsup, sugar, rosemary, oregano, basil and bourbon and bring to a boil., Add hot dogs. Best to do day before so flavor can set in.

title: Brandy'S Chicken
directions: Open Rice-A-Roni and sprinkle in baking dish., Put chicken breasts on top of rice., Mix seasoning packet in 3 cups of water in which you have dissolved the 2 chicken bouillon cubes., Add soup to water with seasoning and mix well., Pour over chicken and rice., Bake for 45 minutes to 1 hour., Cover when bake at 350°.

title: Hot Fudge Sauce
directions: Mix dry ingredients; add milk., Cook and stir., Add vanilla and margarine., Heat in microwave., Keep in refrigerator.

title: Diet Apple Pie
directions: Mix cornstarch and apple juice and bring to a boil., Mix cinnamon, nutmeg, oleo and apples and add to juice., Pour into an unbaked pie shell., Place top crust over and make several slits in top., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Arabic Chicken Fajitas(Very Low-Fat)
directions: Spray large wok with nonstick cooking spray; heat until very hot., Add chicken and cook it for 4 minutes., Remove from wok and keep it warm.

title: Broccoli-Cheese Soup
directions: Saute onions in butter., Cook broccoli cuts as per directions. Drain., Add cream of mushroom soup, 1 can evaporated milk, 2 cans regular milk and Cheez Whiz., Heat over medium-low flame, stirring regularly.

title: Holiday Cheese Ball
directions: Beat up cheese and mix all together (can be frozen).

title: Italian Chicken
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Shake flour in bag; place in 9 x 13 x 2-inch baking pan., Add spaghetti sauce to bag., Squeeze bag to blend ingredients., Add chicken and green peppers to bag., Turn bag to coat chicken with sauce., Arrange chicken in even layer. Close bag with provided tie; cut 6 half-inch slits in top of bag. Bake until tender, 35 to 40 minutes., Serve over hot pasta.

title: Egg Drop Soup
directions: Bring the chicken stock to boil., With a wire whisk, mix together egg whites, flour and water until smooth., Pour a thin stream into boiling chicken stock., Do not stir until egg mixture is cooked., Add the soy sauce and mix well., Ladle into consomme cups and top each serving with 1 teaspoon chopped chives or scallion tops., Makes 3 cups., Each 3/4 cup serving contains approximately 42 calories, 0 mg cholesterol and 167 mg sodium.

title: Salad Dressing Cake
directions: Pour batter in greased and floured tube pan. Bake at 350° for 25 or 30 minutes.

title: Fried Chicken
directions: Wash and, clean, chicken., Salt, and pepper chicken and soak in milk overnight in refrigerator.	Flour and deep fry in Crisco until done.

title: Cream Cheese And Pineapple Spread
directions: Beat cream cheese until smooth., Add crushed pineapple and mix well., Serve on Ritz crackers.

title: Pie Crust
directions: Cream butter and sugar., Add flour and nuts., Pat on bottom of pan and bake until brown in 350° oven for about 15 minutes., Cool.

title: Soupe 'A Loignon(Onion Soup)
directions: In heavy pot, melt butter., Add onions and cook slowly, stirring occasionally, until golden., Sprinkle on the flour and stir for a few minutes, seasoning with salt and pepper., Add broth and wine, stirring constantly., Bring to a boil., Lower the heat and let the soup simmer for 30 minutes, partly covered.

title: Hash Brown Cheese Bake
directions: Combine ingredients. Bake in a greased 9 x 13 pan for 40 to 45 minutes at 350°.

title: Pear Pie
directions: Combine first 6 ingredients in mixer bowl., Beat until smooth. Pour half of the mixture into pie shell., Arrange pears in pie shell., Pour remaining sour cream mixture over pears., Combine remaining ingredients in bowl and mix until crumbly., Sprinkle over pie., Preheat oven at 350°., Bake for 1 hour., Yields 6 servings. Pan size is 9-inch.

title: Fruit  Dip
directions: Gradually beat orange juice into Cool Whip until the mixture is creamy, but not thin., Add sugar to taste., Serve with fresh or canned fruits.

title: Kidney Bean Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients with enough mayonnaise to moisten.

title: Peach Cobbler
directions: Mix peaches and lemon filling together. Pour into buttered 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan. Add cake mix on top, then nuts and then butter. Bake at 325° for 40 to 50 minutes until brown. (Insert knife to be sure it is done.)

title: *Mary E'S French Dressing
directions: Blend all ingredients well., Shake well before using.

title: Vegetable Casserole
