directions: Mix ingredients together., Put cracker crumbs on top., Pour melted margarine over it., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Wild Rice Casserole
directions: Saute celery and onion in margarine until onion is transparent. Add the rest of the ingredients., Pour into large casserole dish and bake at 350° for 30 minutes., Serves 10 to 12.

title: Skillet Chicken And Rice
directions: Saute celery, onion and green pepper in small amount of oil or butter until tender. Add chicken, salt and poultry seasoning. Continue stirring until chicken is heated., Cook rice according to package using chicken broth instead of water. Add to sauteed ingredients and cook until dry and beginning to stick to skillet.

title: Cherry Yum-Yum
directions: Mix cream cheese, sugar and milk. Divide into 3 graham cracker pie crusts. Top each pie with 1 can cherry pie filling and Cool Whip. Chill thoroughly.

title: Fiesta Salad
directions: Separate onion slices into rings., Place in salad bowl with green pepper and tomato., Fry bacon until crisp; remove and drain. Pour off bacon drippings., Reserve 2 tablespoons in skillet. Stir vinegar, chili powder, salt and red pepper sauce into drippings; heat to boiling., Pour over vegetables and toss lightly., Crumble bacon; sprinkle on top., Serve with a slotted spoon., Makes 6 servings.

title: Delicious Drumsticks
directions: Heat oven to 425°., Mix flour, salt, paprika and pepper in a bowl., Dip chicken into butter., Roll in flour mixture to coat. Arrange in an ungreased square pan 8 x 8 x 2-inch., Bake uncovered until done, about 50 minutes.

title: Spinach Dip
directions: Unthaw spinach and mix all ingredients thoroughly., Take one round loaf of baked bread and hollow out the entire center leaving only shell., Pinch into bite size., Pour dip in bread shell and arrange bite size pieces around outer edge., (Dip pieces in dip mixture.)

title: Chocolate Pie
directions: Mix all dry ingredients together. Add beaten egg yolks, then add milk gradually. Place over medium heat; stir constantly until mixture thickens. Remove from heat, then add vanilla. Stir well. Place into baked pie shell.

title: Jam Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients and blend well., Bake at 325° until done. Makes 3 layers.

title: Pizza Casserole
directions: Set oven for 425°., Combine beef and onion in baking dish. Brown in oven and drain., Cook macaroni, then mix with spices, beef and onions., Add 1 1/2 cans tomato sauce, tomato paste and water., Mix in some of pepperoni., Top with cheese, pepperoni and remaining tomato sauce., Bake 20 minutes or until brown.

title: Venison Roast In Gravy
directions: Soak venison roast for 4 hours in mixture of baking soda, vinegar, salt and water., Rinse; soak in clear water 1 hour. Remove roast from water and pat dry., Remove as much fat as possible before cooking to eliminate any gamey flavor., Combine seasoned salt, garlic powder and pepper., Sprinkle on both sides of roast., Sprinkle with soy sauce., Place onion slices on top of roast and sprinkle with 2 tablespoons flour., Place thin slices of oleo on onion., Wrap roast twice in heavy-duty aluminum foil. Place in roasting pan., Add 1 quart water., Cover and bake at 350° for 4 to 5 hours., Add water, if necessary, to roasting pan but do not open foil., Remove roast from pan., Carefully open foil and measure liquid., Combine 1 1/2 tablespoons flour and 2 tablespoons water to each cup of liquid., Stir well., Stir into roast broth. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly until thickened., Serve gravy with roast.

title: Louisiana Gumbo
directions: Brown okra in bacon drippings until okra is no longer gooey, stirring constantly (use 2 packages frozen okra and don't give up) Add onion and pepper, chopped; saute., Add a lot of water and a little tomato sauce; let boil gently for at least 2 hours., Add seafood, parsley, green onion tips and seasonings; cook until seafood is completely done (about 30 minutes)., Turn off fire and add file., I use shrimp and 1 can of crabmeat; when I feel rich, I add oysters.

title: Date Nut Loaf
directions: Combine nuts and dates. Add boiling water and stir in soda. Combine egg, vanilla and cooking oil., Add date mixture. Combine sugar, cocoa, salt and flour. Add to date mixture and mix well. Pour into greased 9 x 5-inch loaf pan., Bake at 350° for 1 hour. Makes 1 loaf.

title: Annie'S Old Fashioned Fudge
directions: Mix sugar, flour, cocoa, milk and syrup over low heat until mixture forms a soft ball., Stir only until sugar is thoroughly dissolved., Remove from heat and add butter and vanilla., Let stand., Beat until thick and creamy.

title: Enchilada Casserole
directions: Brown hamburger., Mix in tomato paste, water, salsa and taco seasoning., Add more water if sauce is too thick., Spread small amount over bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan., Place a layer of tortillas over sauce, tearing in half to cover sides and corners., Layer remaining as follows:, cheese, tortillas, sauce and cheese., Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Greens With Hot Dressing
directions: Wash, drain and dry lettuce and greens., Add chopped green onions; set aside., Fry bacon in a large skillet until crisp; drain., Set aside skillet with the hot bacon fat still in it. Combine the vinegar, water, sugar, salt and pepper in a bowl. From the reserved skillet, pour off all but about 3 tablespoons of hot fat., Pour the vinegar mixture into the skillet., Place skillet over the hot coals; bring mixture to a boil., Remove from heat and pour over the lettuce and spinach greens.

title: Lemon Freeze Pie
directions: Cream the cream cheese., Add lemonade and evaporated milk. Blend in Cool Whip., Pour into graham cracker crust., Chill in refrigerator until firm., This is for 1 pie only; double ingredients for 2 pies.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Cook broccoli; drain., Add sour cream, soup and half of the shredded Cheddar., Put mixture into a 9 x 13-inch pan sprayed with cooking spray., Sprinkle remaining cheese and equal amount of stuffing on top., Cover with foil and bake at 350° for 45 minutes. Remove foil and cook for 15 minutes more.

title: Hamburger Casserole
directions: Brown ground beef, onion and green pepper., Add tomatoes, macaroni, ketchup and Worcestershire sauce., Simmer 15 minutes on low heat., Drain excess fat., Add mushroom soup, little at a time. Pour ingredients into large baking dish., Bake for 25 minutes. Sprinkle cheese on top to melt as the last thing., Makes 10 to 12 servings.

title: Broccoli Stir-Fry
directions: Put oil in pot, add garlic, onion, mushrooms and red peppers. Stir-fry for 2 minutes., Add florets and stir-fry 5 to 8 minutes, until tender., Add salt and lemon rind., Toss and serve., Serves 6.

title: Swedish Pancakes
directions: Mix ingredients together., Pour on hot griddle, spreading out thinly in a circle., Use thin spatula and loosen edges., Turn over when batter begins to bubble., Remove and serve., Spread with butter and sugar or jelly., They are like crepes.

title: Layered Salad
directions: Layer 1 layer of lettuce, onion, green pepper, celery, peas and another layer of lettuce on top., Mix mayonnaise, salt, pepper and cheese together., Spread on top of salad., Sprinkle Bac*Os on top of salad.

title: Cranberry Punch
directions: Chill all ingredients thoroughly., Mix juices together in punch bowl (or other serving container)., Add ginger ale just before serving to preserve effervescence.

title: Blender Pear Salad
directions: Drain juice from pears and boil 1 cup of juice to dissolve gelatin., Put remaining ingredients in blender, including gelatin. Blend; add nuts., Pour into serving dish and garnish with shredded cheese, chopped peanuts, sliced canned pears, etc. Chill.

title: Strawberry Pound Cake
directions: Blend well the cake mix, jello and flour., Add salad oil and eggs, one at a time, also well drained strawberries., Beat well. Bake 1 hour at 325°.

title: Creamy Joes
directions: Brown ground beef, drain off fat., Mix in a bowl canned milk and canned mushroom soup., Add to ground beef and simmer for 10 minutes., Serve on roll like Sloppy Joes.

title: Red Punch
directions: Dissolve Jell-O and sugar in boiling water., Then add cold water, lemonade, orange juice and pineapple juice., Mix all ingredients together., Just before serving, add ginger ale. Makes 1 gallon., Float fresh strawberries or make an ice ring.

title: Mexican Layer Dip
directions: Layer first four items., Decorate with green onions, chopped tomato and black olives., Finish with teaspoon of sour cream and avocado., Serve chilled with tortilla chips.

title: Baked Squash
directions: Saute onion in the butter., Mix with cooked and drained squash., Pour into an oiled baking dish., (May use Pam cooking spray.), Beat eggs well (may use Egg Beaters as a substitute). Add salt, pepper, sugar and then milk., Pour over squash and onion, then mix gently., Top with bread crumbs and melted butter. Bake 20 minutes in a 450° oven.

title: Pizza
directions: Preheat oven to 400°., Break up beef and cook until no longer pink., Stir in onion and cook until tender., Add sauce, mushrooms, water, olives, herbs and salt., Simmer about 10 minutes., Spoon into prepared pan., (Grease a 9 x 15 x 2-inch baking pan.) Top with slices of cheese., Place in preheated oven., In a large bowl, beat eggs, milk and oil with electric mixer until foamy., Beat in flour and salt until batter is smooth., Spoon batter over hot beef mixture, spreading to cover completely; sprinkle with grated cheese., Bake for 30 minutes or until golden brown., Serves 6.

title: Sal'S Pizza Burgers
directions: Brown beef, onion and spices together., Add tomato sauce and mushrooms., Let cool., Put on hamburger bun halves., Sprinkle cheese on top and bake at 400° for about 15 minutes or until cheese melts., Makes about 12 to 16 halves.

title: Easy Microwaved Baked Apple
directions: Core a firm, flavorful apple, such as Jonagold, Empire, Cortland or Redfree, but don't cut through the bottom of the apple., Peel a little of the skin from around the top of the apple., Put some butter and brown sugar in the hole, and microwave on High for 2 minutes.

title: Eggnog Kringla
directions: Sift powdered sugar and nutmeg., Mix dry ingredients in a large bowl., In another large bowl, beat butter until softened. Add flour mixture and egg nog alternately; mix well., Chill 4 hours or overnight., Preheat oven to 350° when ready., Roll golf ball-size balls of dough into long ropes on floured surface, then shape in figure 8's on a cookie sheet, pinching edges together. Bake 10 to 12 minutes or until light brown around edges., Cool on wire racks and dust with powdered sugar.

title: Oregano Rice
directions: Saute rice in margarine until light brown (rice)., Place in 3-quart casserole., Add remaining ingredients; cover., Bake at 350° for 1 hour or a little longer.

title: Butterscotch Dip For Apples
directions: Mix all of the ingredients in a very heavy boiler until smooth and well blended., This is a great dip and would be an excellent addition to any party.

title: Corn Dip
directions: Combine all of the ingredients. Chill and serve with tortilla chips.

title: Caramel Chews(Unbaked)
directions: Melt caramels in the water in double boiler., Remove from heat and stir in coconut, oats and nuts., Let stand 5 minutes., Shape into 2 (12-inch) rolls., Frosted with melted chips., Refrigerate. Cut into 1/4-inch slices.

title: Slow-Cooked Pepper Steak
directions: Cut beef into 3 x 1-inch strips; brown in oil in a skillet. Transfer to a slow cooker., Combine next 7 ingredients; pour over beef., Cover and cook on low for 5 to 6 hours or until meat is tender., Add tomatoes and green peppers; cook on low for 1 hour longer., Combine water and cornstarch to make a paste., Stir into liquid in slow cooker and cook on high until thickened., Serve over noodles or rice., Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Chocolate Cake
directions: Mix together and beat for 2 minutes., Bake at 350° for 1 hour. When it is done, it is very moist., Pour confectioners sugar over entire cake.

title: Party Salad
directions: Combine Cool Whip and milk., Refrigerate 1 hour., Add remaining ingredients and let set overnight.

title: Broccoli Cauliflower Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Chill before serving.

title: Seafood Cornbread Dressing
directions: Mix soup and chicken broth into a large pan., Add onion and green pepper., Mix and simmer until tender., Add butter, shrimp, crabmeat and all seasonings., Pour this mixture over crumbled cornbread and mix well., Bake at 350° until done., Makes 2 average size casseroles or 1 large.

title: Strawberry Butter
directions: Whip all ingredients together in blender., Place in a container. Refrigerate. Stays fresh for 3 to 4 weeks., Makes 2/3 cup., Excellent on toast or English muffins.

title: Hot Sausage Cheese Balls
directions: Mix sausage and cheese well with biscuit mix., Shape into balls about the size of a quarter., Pat partially flat., Place on cookie sheet and bake for approximately 15 to 20 minutes at 350°., Makes approximately 7 to 8 dozen.

title: Congealed Carrot Salad
directions: Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water., Drain pineapple and reserve juice; add water to juice to make 2 cups., Stir into Jell-O mixture., Chill until the consistency of unbeaten egg whites is reached., Stir in pineapple, carrots, cheese and pecans., Pour into a lightly oiled 6 cup mold., Cover and chill until firm. Unmold onto lettuce leaves, if desired., Yields 16 servings.

title: Apple Bean Bake
directions: Melt butter., Add cubed apples and cook until tender., Add brown and white sugar., Stir until melted., Stir in cinnamon, catsup and molasses., Add beans and mix well., Pour mixture into 2-quart casserole., Bake in 400° oven for about 1 hour.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
directions: Combine ingredients in shallow baking dish.

title: Pear And Jello Salad
directions: Use only half of juice from pears., Mix Jell-Os in hot water; use half of pear juice., Put all ingredients in the blender, mix completely., Pour in mold and chill until it gels.

title: Cajun 15 Bean Soup
directions: In a large pan or kettle, cover beans with water and add 2 tablespoons salt., Soak overnight., In the morning, bring to boil and then drain., Add 2-quarts water., Bring to boil., Simmer slowly 2 1/2 hours to 3 hours., May be cooked in crock-pot., In a skillet, saute onion, garlic and sausage until sausage is brown. Drain off excess grease; add contents to bean pot with stewed tomatoes, lemon juice and flavor package., Simmer for 10 minutes. Serves 12 to 14., Great as a leftover next day., Also freezes very well.

title: Peanut Patty
directions: Cook ingredients in a heavy skillet or pan over medium heat for 20 to 25 minutes., Add red food coloring., Turn off heat and add oleo and powdered sugar., Pour on a greased cookie sheet. When set, break into pieces.

title: Strawberry Pizza
directions: To make crust, mix all ingredients to form dough., Spread in pizza pan., Bake at 400° for 15 minutes.

title: Apple-Mint Whip
directions: Blend to slush consistency.

title: Pico De Gallo (Fresh Salsa)
directions: Do not peel tomatoes., Chop/dice all ingredients., Start with one serrano pepper and taste., If your desire for the fire is greater, then add more peppers., Enjoy with chips, vegetables, etc.

title: Millionaire Candy
directions: Boil sugar, milk and butter (rolling boil)., Take off heat and beat well., Add nuts, marshmallow cream, chips, vanilla and broken Hershey bar., Fold for a few minutes., Spoon out onto wax paper or pour into buttered dish.

title: Quiche
directions: Brown meat and drain. Saute onion and pepper in a small amount of fat. Mix meat, sauteed vegetables, cheese, mushrooms, flour, and put into piecrust. Mix remaining ingredients and pour over meat mixture. Bake at 350° for 45-55 minutes or until firm. May be frozen. Serves 4.

title: Creamy Carrot Nut Mold(Salad)
directions: Lightly oil a 2-quart mold with cooking oil., Pour boiling water over gelatin in bowl and stir until gelatin is completely dissolved., Gradually add gelatin mixture to sour cream, stirring until well blended., Stir until mixture begins to jell., Stir in pineapple, carrots and nuts., Turn into mold and chill until firm, about 4 hours., Unmold onto salad greens.

title: Powdered Sugar Angel Food Cake
directions: Beat egg whites and cream of tartar until stiff., Fold in 1 tablespoon at a time the granulated sugar., Sift together the powdered sugar, flour and salt., Fold into egg mixture., Add vanilla., Bake in tube pan at 375° for 45 minutes., Invert the cake while cooling.

title: Oven Caramel Popcorn
directions: Boil sugar, margarine, syrup and salt for 5 minutes (stir). Remove from heat and add soda and vanilla., Stir well over popped corn (add nuts if desired)., Spread on deep cookie sheet or shallow roaster., Place in 200° oven for 1 hour stirring at 15 minute intervals., Remove from oven, cool and store in tightly covered containers.

title: Oriental Salad
directions: Cut cabbage lengthwise and crosswise (slice thin)., Add onions and chill., Brown noodles in oleo., Add sunflower seeds and almonds., Saute until light brown; drain on paper towel., I do this ahead of time and store in plastic container.

title: Marshmallow Creme
directions: Soften gelatine in water over top of double boiler., Place over boiling water and stir gelatine until dissolved., Add sugar and stir until dissolved., Put corn syrup in large mixing bowl; pour hot gelatine mixture over the syrup and beat until thick (about 15 minutes)., Stir in 2 teaspoons vanilla., Store in 1-quart wide-mouth jars in refrigerator., Spoon out as needed.

title: Chocolate Fudge Cake
directions: Combine cream cheese, 1 egg and 1/4 cup sugar in a medium mixing bowl; beat on high with mixer until smooth., Gradually add 3 tablespoons milk, 2 tablespoons margarine, cornstarch and 1/2 teaspoon vanilla, beating well., Set aside.

title: Squash Casserole
directions: Melt butter in skillet; add stuffing., Stir until stuffing is coated., Place 1/2 dressing in casserole., Blend together all other ingredients., Put in baking dish and cover with balance of herb dressing., Bake at 350° for about 35 minutes.

title: Quebec Tourtiere
directions: Mix meat, onion and spices in a saucepan. Add boiling water. Simmer, uncovered, for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally. Skim off any fat. Preheat oven to 375°. Roll out half of the pastry and line 9-inch pie plate. Place filling in pie plate and cover with the remaining pastry. Prick with a fork. Bake at 375° for 30 minutes or until golden. Serve piping hot topped with homemade ketchup or chili sauce., Serves 4 to 6.

title: Layered Potato Salad
directions: Layer 1/2 potatoes in a large bowl., Sprinkle with 1/2 onion and 1/2 eggs., Drizzle with 1 tablespoon oil if desired., Blend cottage cheese and mayonnaise together and spread 1/2 over above layers; sprinkle with 1/2 the dry dressing mix and lemon pepper to taste., (Be generous with the lemon pepper.), Repeat layers., Let set overnight to develop flavors.

title: Catalina Beans
directions: Wrap several beans in a strip of bacon; repeat until all beans are used. Place in baking dish and cover with Catalina dressing. Bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Tuna Casserole
directions: Combine cream of mushroom soup and milk., Layer peas., Crumble potato chips and tuna., Repeat layers., Cover., Cook in microwave for 10 minutes.

title: Cake Mix Cookies
directions: Cream shortening until soft and fluffy., Add eggs and beat until blended (mixture may become lumpy)., Add cake mix and water and flavoring and mix well until blended and moist., Dough will be stiff., Add any desired additional ingredients., Drop by spoonfuls and flatten on greased cookie sheet (flattening is not required). Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Cherry Cranberry Shakes
directions: You will need chilled glasses..

title: Stuffed Mushrooms
directions: Preheat oven to 400°., In large skillet, brown sausage and drain, reserving 1 tablespoon of fat in skillet., Chop mushrooms and stems; add to the skillet with the onion and saute 5 minutes. Add all remaining ingredients and mix well., Mound lightly into reserved mushroom caps., Bake 12 minutes or until lightly brown. Makes 6 appetizer servings.

title: Holiday Salad
directions: Bring pineapple and sugar to a good boil., Remove from heat and add jello, stirring until dissolved., Cool in refrigerator 45 minutes., Fold in cottage cheese and Cool Whip., Refrigerate.

title: Neiman-Marcus Cookies
directions: Cream butter and both sugars, add eggs and vanilla., Mix together with flour, oatmeal, salt, baking powder and baking soda. Add chips, candy and nuts., Form into patties and place 2 inches apart on cookie sheet., Bake for 6 minutes at 375°., The dough is very stiff and the cookies don't spread very much., They also seem to get darker as they cool, so they are real easy to burn.

title: Pizza Cups
directions: Brown, and, drain beef; stir in tomato paste, onion and seasoning., Mixture, will, be thick., Cook over low heat for 5 minutes,, stirring, frequently., Place, biscuits, in, greased muffin, tins;, press to cover bottom and sides., Spoon 1/4 cup of mixture, into, each cup and sprinkle with cheese., Bake at 400° for 12 minutes or until golden brown., This will make 12 (I buy 2 cans, of biscuits)., Absolutely delicious and easy to make.

title: Puppy Chow
directions: Melt together margarine, peanut butter and chocolate chips over low heat, stirring constantly., Add Chex to mixture and mix well.

title: Potato Fudge Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Cream the butter and sugar, then add potatoes; beat well., Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition., Sift dry ingredients and add alternately with milk., Add melted chocolate and vanilla; beat well., Bake in 3 layers until sides of layers leave pan.

title: Infallible Rice
directions: Saute onion in butter until transparent., Combine onion, rice and hot broth; bring to a boil on top of the stove., Cover; place in a 325° oven for 20 minutes., Serve.

title: Sauteed Shrimp
directions: Melt butter in large baking pan., Add shrimp and lemon and herb seasoning sprinkled on top of shrimp., Bake at 450° about 45 minutes or until brown.

title: Brown Rice
directions: Saute 1 teaspoon margarine and chopped onions., Pour rice, soups, sauteed onions and margarine in casserole dish., Bake at 400° for 30 minutes.

title: Country Breakfast Pie
directions: Cook sausage until done; crumble, then drain., Mix cheese and sausage; sprinkle in pie shell., Lightly beat eggs., Combine remaining ingredients and add to egg mixture., Pour in shell and bake at 375° about 40 to 45 minutes., Cool 10 minutes., Serves 6 to 8.

title: Sweet 'N Sour Baked Beans
directions: Drain butter, lima and kidney beans; add pork and beans and set aside., Fry bacon; reserve drippings and drain bacon., In small skillet, add drippings, brown sugar, vinegar, salt, mustard and chopped onion., Cook until onion is transparent., Add to bean mixture; add crumbled bacon., Bake at 250° for 2 hours.

title: Chicken Spaghetti
directions: Boil chicken breasts until done. Allow them to cool and debone them. Cut into small pieces. Cook spaghetti in chicken broth according to the time on the package. When done, drain and add cheese. Stir it until it has melted completely. Saut chopped onions and bell peppers for about two minutes in 1/2 stick of margarine. Add this to spaghetti. Add chicken, pimentos, Ro-Tel tomatoes and English peas to spaghetti. Heat until hot, but do not cook.

title: Fruit Salad(Sugar-Free)
directions: Mix together., Drain and rinse mandarin oranges before putting in bowl.

title: Stuffed Celery
directions: Wash celery and cut into small pieces, about 2-inch strips. Combine raisins, olives, cream cheese and mayonnaise and stir until ingredients are mixed well., Fill celery pieces and chill.

title: Chicken Cashew
directions: Fresh mushrooms may be added.

title: Lemon-Poppy Seed Muffins
directions: Grease bottoms of or use paper baking, cups in regular muffin pan., Mix oil, milk, eggs and pudding mix with fork until blended. Stir in the poppy seeds., Divide evenly into 12 prepared muffin pan., Bake 25 to 30 minutes in preheated oven at 375°., Cool 10 minutes and drizzle with glaze.

title: Monmouth County Chicken Pot Pie
directions: Place chicken and ham in 2-quart casserole., Combine butter or margarine and flour; stir until smooth., Slowly stir in broth and cream., Cook (200°), stirring constantly until thickened., Add salt, pepper, onion, mushrooms and sherry., Pour over chicken and ham., Drop sweet potato biscuit dough by tablespoons around edge of hot mixture., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes., Serves 8.

title: Pumpkin Pie Squares
directions: Combine the first 6 ingredients., Pour into an 11 x 13-inch pan., Sprinkle dry cake mix over top., Slice butter over top of cake mix., Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes., Serve with whipped cream.

title: Chess Squares
directions: Mix one egg, margarine and dry cake mix., Mix together until crumbly., Press into the bottom of a 9x13 pan., Mix remaining eggs, sugar, cream cheese and vanilla until smooth., Pour on top of crumb crust., Bake at 325 degrees for 35 minutes or until you see a hint of light brown on top., Let sit until cool then cut into squares.

title: Ham And Swiss Cheese Biscuits
directions: Bake biscuits until light browning starts. Split biscuits and place ham and Swiss cheese in the middle. Replace tops., Place biscuits in a 13 x 9-inch glass (greased) dish., Melt margarine in saucepan., Combine remaining ingredients with the margarine. Spoon mixture over the biscuits., Cover and place in refrigerator overnight., Uncover and bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Sweet Potatoes In Apple Cups
directions: Boil sweet potatoes until tender., Peel and mash., Add butter, salt and sugar to potatoes and blend thoroughly., Scoop out inside of apples, leaving a margin of about 1/4-inch all around., Fill apples with mashed sweet potatoes., Place in a baking dish and bake in a moderate oven at 325° for about 15 minutes, until apples are cooked., Place marshmallows on top of potato mixture and return to oven to allow marshmallows to brown., Serves 4.

title: Chicken In Tarragon Sauce
directions: On hard surface, with meat mallet, flatten each chicken breast., In large frypan, place butter over medium high temperature., Add chicken and saute about 4 minutes on each side or until lightly browned and fork can easily be inserted., Remove chicken and keep warm., In same frypan, add mushrooms and saute about 2 minutes., Add cognac and carefully ignite by touching edge of pan with match flame., (Always use caution when flaming!) Allow flame to completely die out after several minutes., Add cream and cook over high heat until mixture reduces and thickens, coating back of spoon., Stir in cayenne, tarragon, dash of salt and lemon juice., Arrange chicken on a platter and pour sauce over to serve., Serves 4.

title: Italian Sausage Peppers
directions: Cut sausage into 1-inch pieces; saute in oil in large skillet until lightly browned., Remove from heat., Saute cut up peppers and onions until tender., Add sausage and other ingredients. Stir; cook 15 to 20 minutes on low heat., Serve over noodles, rice or rolls.

title: Salmon Patties
directions: Mix all the ingredients together., Roll into small balls. Flatten and deep fry in oil., Cook until brown.

title: Chicken And Broccoli
directions: Cook broccoli; drain. Spread it in a 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Mix chicken, soup, mayonnaise, mushrooms, curry powder and 1/2 cup Parmesan cheese in medium bowl. Spread chicken mixture over broccoli. Sprinkle 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese over top. Bake in preheated 350° oven for 40 minutes or until heated through. Makes 6 servings.

title: Cajun Chicken Casserole With Cornbread Crust
directions: Combine chicken, soup, celery, green pepper, onion and pimentos in a large bowl., Stir well., Pour into a 9 x 14-inch pan or individual casserole dishes., Combine cornbread mix, chicken stock and melted butter in a large bowl., Stir well., Sprinkle over casserole., Bake in a 350° oven until crust is golden and casserole is bubbly, for about 15 to 20 minutes., Yields 10 servings.

title: Fresh Tofu Loaf
directions: Beat eggs slightly., Add mushroom soup; beat and blend with milk and soy sauce., Mash tofu coarsely, and combine all ingredients; mix well., Bake in oiled loaf pan, set in a pan of hot water, at 350° about 45 minutes, or until a knife inserted in the center comes out clean., Let stand 10 minutes before unmolding.

title: Battle Bread
directions: Mix all together and put in a covered bowl in icebox., Let set for 1 hour., Grease bread pan., Put dough in pan., Cook about 20 minutes.

title: Double Batch Easy Baked Beans
directions: Brown meat and onion together., In crock-pot, add all ingredients., Bake at 300° for about 2 hours (low setting on crock-pot)., Can be baked in a large Corning Ware dish in oven.

title: Barb'S Pasta Salad
directions: To the cooked pasta add the Italian dressing and salad season mix., Mix well and refrigerator overnight., Just before serving add the green peppers and tomato.

title: Slaw Dip
directions: Mix with mustard or mayonnaise until smooth.

title: Rolled Round Steak, Jelly Roll
directions: You will need a 3 to 4-quart pot (Dutch oven) and 1 empty Coke bottle.

title: Pie Crust
directions: Combine flour, Crisco and salt., Cut shortening in flour until it is gravel size., Put vinegar, egg and water in another bowl and beat, then add to flour mixture., Flour your hands and form crust into a ball., Wrap in wax paper and refrigerate for 2 hours before rolling into pie crust.

title: Cajun-Style Chicken Nuggets
directions: In large bowl mix onion soup mix, bread crumbs, chili powder, cumin, thyme and pepper., Dip chicken in bread crumb mixture; coating well., In large skillet heat 1/2-inch oil and cook chicken over medium heat turning once until tender., Drain on paper towel. Serve warm and could be served with assorted mustards., Makes about 5 dozen.

title: Lemon Things
directions: Preheat, oven, to, 350°., Mix flour, margarine and powdered sugar in small, bowl., Press, evenly in bottom and about 5/8-inch up sides of square	pan,, 8 x 8 x 2-inches., If dough is sticky, flour, fingers., Bake, 20, minutes., Beat remaining ingredients in a medium, bowl, on medium speed until light and fluffy., Pour over hot, crust., Bake	about, 25 minutes., Let stand until cool and cut into small pieces.

title: Christmas Punch
directions: Dilute the lemonade according to directions on the can and pour into punch bowl., Stir in thawed strawberries., Just before serving add ginger ale and ice., Makes 1 1/2 gallons of punch.

title: German Chocolate Pound Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°. Grease a 12-cup Bundt pan. Mix cake mix, oil, water and eggs together with mixer on low speed until blended, about 1 minute. Scrape bowl and beat for 2 minutes, still on low speed. Add the container of frosting and continue beating on low speed for about 2 minutes. Pour into pan and bake until a cake tester inserted in cake comes out clean, 55 to 60 minutes. Cool cake in pan. Invert onto a plate and cool completely before slicing. No frosting is needed.

title: Ants On A Log
directions: Wash celery and cut into small pieces., Fill celery with cream cheese and add raisins., Children can assist with this activity.

title: Apple Butter
directions: Peel, core and chop apples., Cook apples slowly (do not add water)., Cook, in, crock-pot on low temperature for 7 to 8 hours. Makes about 3 pints.

title: Green Bean Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients together in casserole dish., Bake at 300° for 1 hour., Top with remaining Durkee onions., Broil until crisp and brown.

title: Hearty Sausage Casserole
directions: In a large skillet over medium-high heat, brown sausage; drain., Add onions, carrot and green pepper; cook until tender. Stir in flour until smooth., Gradually stir in milk; cook, stirring constantly, until mixture thickens and begins to boil. Stir in Worcestershire sauce and sage., In 3-quart baking dish, combine beans and sausage mixture., Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 30 minutes or until hot and bubbly., Serve hot with crackers. Makes 10 servings.

title: Amish Chocolate Cake
directions: Mix first 5 ingredients thoroughly and make a well in center. To well in flour mix and add remaining ingredients., Mix until no lumps remain., Pour in 9 x 13-inch pan., Doesn't need to be greased., Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes., Frost with Peanut Butter Frosting.

title: Saturday Night Casserole
directions: In a 2-quart casserole, combine onion and ground meat. Microwave 4 minutes on High (100%)., In a separate bowl, combine the remaining ingredients, mixing well., Add to meat and onion, stirring to blend., Cover and microwave 8 minutes on High (100%) or simmer on stove., Serves 6 to 8.

title: Sweet And Sour Meatballs
directions: Soak bread in milk., Combine with onion, meat, beaten egg, salt and pepper.

title: Corn Custard With Tomatoes
directions: Grate, corn, from, cobs into a bowl and measure correct amount., Beat, eggs, vigorously, and, stir, in onion, salt and cayenne., Heat, milk, until, a, film forms; skim and stir into corn mixture., Pour, into 6 buttered custard cups and place in a shallow, pan containing about 1 inch of boiling water., Bake in a preheated 325° oven for 50 to 60 minutes or until a knife inserted in center of custard comes out clean.

title: Cranberry Smoothie
directions: Combine half of all the ingredients in electric blender; process until smooth., Repeat with all the remaining ingredients. Combine mixtures., Pour into individual glasses., Makes about, 4 cups.

title: Homemade Butter
directions: Mix thoroughly with mixer until it turns to butter.

title: Jewish Coffee Cake
directions: Cream sugar, butter or oleo and eggs (one at a time)., Add flour, baking powder, soda, vanilla and sour cream or buttermilk. In small bowl, mix cinnamon, chopped nuts and sugar., Pour half of batter in cake pan; put half of topping onto cake, then add remaining cake batter and top with remaining topping., Bake in greased 13 x 9-inch pan in 350° oven for for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Upside-Down German Chocolate Cake
directions: Sprinkle nuts and coconut in bottom of a greased 13 x 9-inch pan., Mix cake mix according to package directions; pour over coconut., Cream margarine and cream cheese., Add powdered sugar. Drizzle by spoonfuls over cake mix., Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

title: Pumpkin Bread
directions: Grease 3 loaf pans. Preheat oven to 350°., Place all ingredients in bowl, except for nuts, and beat with electric beater until creamy., Add nuts and pour into greased loaf pans. Bake at 350° for 1 hour., Yields 3 loaves.

title: Lemon Chiffon Pie
directions: Blend ingredients together and pour into baked pie shell. Chill for 1 hour before serving.

title: Zucchini Dish
directions: Spread rolls on 9 x 13-inch pan., Saute onion and zucchini in oleo until soft., Pour over rolls., Pour eggs over zucchini and onions., Sprinkle cheese over all., Bake at 350° for 1/2 hour to 45 minutes., Cut in squares.

title: Company Rice
directions: Mix together all ingredients., Bake in covered 2-quart casserole dish 1 hour or until done., Serves 6.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
directions: Heat oven to 375°., Cream butter, brown sugar, milk and vanilla in large bowl., Blend until creamy., Blend in egg. Combine flour, salt and baking soda., Add to creamed mixture gradually., Stir in chocolate chips and nuts., Drop rounded tablespoonfuls of dough 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet.

title: Christmas Gingersnaps
directions: Sift flour, measure 7 cups and sift with soda, salt and spices., Sift 1/2 cup flour and set aside to use only if needed. Measure sugar, butter and molasses., Turn molasses into small pan and warm slightly; add brown sugar and stir until melted., Add butter, blending in well., Stir in eggs, one at a time., Batter is smooth., Add orange peel., Stir in dry ingredients., Gradually add sufficient flour to make a soft dough that can be kneaded., Knead until smooth., Keep tightly covered and refrigerate overnight. Roll out and cut in desired shapes., Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Rice Puffs
directions: Beat egg., Stir in poultry seasoning, salt and cheese; mix with rice., Refrigerate for at least 1 hour., Shape by rounded teaspoonfuls into 1-inch balls., Roll in bread crumbs., Heat 2 to 3 inches of oil., Fry rice balls until golden brown; drain., Makes about 15 rice balls.

title: Veal Shank, Milanese-Style(Ossobuco Ala Milanese)
directions: Melt 6 tablespoons of butter in a skillet large enough to hold the veal pieces without crowding., Roll the meat in the flour and put in the skillet over moderate heat to brown both sides., Add carrot, onion, celery, half the garlic, the marjoram and the piece of lemon peel, then season with salt and pepper.

title: Apple-Nut Kuchen
directions: Sift together flour, sugar, baking powder, salt and cinnamon. Mix one egg, 1/2 cup milk and 3 tablespoons oil; stir into flour mixture., Turn into well-oiled 9-inch pan.

title: Pepperoni Quiche Appetizer
directions: Mix all ingredients and pour in a greased pie plate (use a bigger pan and make thinner for an appetizer)., Bake at 400° for 35 minutes.

title: Brandied Sweet Potatoes
directions: One and one-fourth hours before serving, cook yams in boiling, salted water for 25 minutes or until tender., Drain and cool., In a 1-quart saucepan, mix cornstarch, nutmeg or cinnamon, salt and granulated sugar., Stir in water., Cook over low heat until sauce is clear., Stir in lemon juice and brandy., Heat oven to 375°. Peel potatoes; slice crosswise, 1/4 to 1/2-inch thick., Put into buttered shallow baking dish., Pour on sauce, then bake 30 minutes or until glazed, basting occasionally., When glazed, sprinkle with miniature marshmallows and broil until golden, if desired.

title: Salted Peanut Crisps
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., Mix shortening, brown sugar, eggs and vanilla., Measure flour by dipping method or by sifting., Blend together flour, soda and salt; stir in., Mix in peanuts., Drop rounded teaspoonfuls of dough about 2-inches apart on lightly greased sheet., Flatten with tumbler dipped in sugar., Bake 8 to 10 minutes., Makes 6 dozen (2-inch) cookies.

title: Chocolate Chip Banana Nut Bread
directions: Preheat oven to 325°., Grease 9 x 13-inch pan., In a medium bowl, stir flour, baking soda and salt., Set aside.

title: Layered Salad
directions: Using large glass or plastic bowl that has flared top, layer vegetables in order named; do not mix., Spread mayonnaise over top to seal., Sprinkle sugar, then cheese over this., Seal with covering of plastic wrap or tight fitting lid., Refrigerate 8 to 12 hours., When ready to serve, sprinkle top with crumbled fresh fried bacon or artificial bacon bits., Serves 10 to 12.

title: Crock-Pot Camp Stew
directions: Brown ground beef and drain well., Add to other ingredients in crock-pot., Stir well, cover and cook on low for 6 to 8 hours (high for 2 to 3 hours)., Serve with tossed salad and crusty French bread for a quick and easy meal.

title: Bacon And Chive Potato Salad
directions: Cook potatoes in boiling water for 14 minutes or until tender. Drain., Mix mayonnaise and mustard in a large bowl., Add potatoes, bacon and chives., Mix lightly., Refrigerate until serving (at least 1 to 2 hours)., Makes 6 servings.

title: Quick Cheeseburger Bake
directions: Heat oven to 400°., Generously grease 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish., Cook beef and onion in 10-inch skillet until beef is brown; drain., Stir in soup, vegetables and milk., Stir baking mix and water in baking dish until moistened; spread evenly., Spread beef mixture over batter., Sprinkle with cheese., Bake for 30 minutes. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Mounds Cake
directions: Blend filling together (cream cheese, butter, sugar, 1 egg, cornstarch, milk and vanilla)., Beat at high speed until smooth. Set aside.

title: Homemade Pimiento Cheese
directions: Mix the first 3 ingredients with mayonnaise., Add pimiento, salt and sugar.

title: Butterscotch Pudding Cake
directions: Blend cake mix, egg and 1/3 cup water in square pan, 8 x 8-inch., Sprinkle with brown sugar., Mix remaining ingredients and gradually pour over brown sugar., Bake until cake springs back, 35 to 40 minutes., Cool 10 minutes., Spoon into dessert dishes., Serve warm; whipped cream optional.

title: Coconut Cake And Icing
directions: Cream eggs, sugar and Crisco., Add milk, baking powder, flour, vanilla and coconut., Bake 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Mocha Walnut Brownies
directions: Heat the brown sugar and butter in a medium-size saucepan over medium-low heat until the butter has melted., Dissolve the coffee in the hot water and stir into the butter mixture., Let cool to room temperature., Preheat oven to 350°., Butter an 8 x 11-inch baking pan., When the butter mixture is cool, beat in the eggs and vanilla., Sift the flour, baking powder and salt together., Stir into the butter mixture with a wooden spoon., Stir in the walnuts and chocolate., Spread evenly in the pan with a rubber spatula. Bake 25 to 30 minutes until light brown., Cool and cut into bars. Frost and sprinkle with nuts, if desired., Makes 20 brownies.

title: 100% Frosting
directions: Boil the first 5 ingredients until clear., Pour over slightly beaten egg white; continue to beat until spreading consistency. Add vanilla.

title: Grits And Cheese Souffle
directions: Grease a 2-quart souffle dish., Preheat oven to 425°., Cook grits in milk and water according to package directions., Add salt., When grits are cooked, add pepper, nutmeg, Tabasco and all but 1/2 cup of cheese., Mix well and then allow to cool slightly. Add egg yolks., Beat egg whites stiff and add half of them to the grit mixture; beat well., Fold in remaining egg whites with a rubber spatula., Spoon into the souffle dish and sprinkle remaining cheese over the top., Bake 25 minutes.

title: Chocolate Ladyfinger Dessert
directions: Melt chocolate in a double boiler pan., Stir in instant coffee., Cool., Beat egg yolks and fold in chocolate mixture. Beat egg whites, fold in chocolate mixture. Beat whipping cream with salt and fold in mixture.

title: Carrot Cheese Log
directions: Mix together carrots, cream cheese, Parmesan cheese and fines herbes., Cover and chill for at least 1 hour or overnight.

title: Microwave Potatoes For 2
directions: Peel and chunk potatoes., You can also add chopped onion to taste., Put in small casserole with tight fitting lid., Don't add any water., Cook on high for 3 minutes., Add small pat of oleo., Stir well to coat the potatoes., Then add any of the seasonings and cook, covered, for 1 more minute or until tender.

title: Peanut Butter Bars
directions: Cream, together margarine, brown, and, white, sugar, and peanut butter., Then add rest of the ingredients., Bake, at, 350° for 20 to 25 minutes., Put 1 cup chocolate chips, over top and let melt., Frost with the following:, 1/2 cup 10x sugar, 1/4, cup peanut, butter, and 2 to 4 tablespoons milk.

title: Rotel Chicken
directions: Layer chicken, onion slices and Velveeta cheese in order listed in 11 x 14-inch baking dish. Sprinkle with 1/2 of chips. Pour mixture of tomatoes and soups over chips. Top with remaining chips. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes. (Does best if covered with foil during baking. Uncover last 10 minutes to brown top.) Makes 12 servings.

title: Lemon Chiffon Jello
directions: Pour the liquid from the pears into a saucepan with the 2 packages Jell-O., Heat just before it boils., Blend pears, cream cheese and Cool Whip in blender., Fold in Jell-O., Pour mixture into 9 x 13-inch Pyrex dish sprayed with Pam., Let set in refrigerator until firm., Cut into squares.

title: Fudge
directions: Combine cocoa, sugar, milk and vanilla in 3-quart saucepan. Stir until smooth., Cook on medium heat until soft ball stage (236°)., Cool and beat until loses its gloss., Add peanut butter and nuts. Pour onto buttered platter., Cool and cut.

title: Chicken Mushroom Pie
directions: Combine chicken, celery soup, mushrooms and liquid, celery, green pepper and steak sauce in a large skillet., Heat slowly, until bubbly hot, about 10 minutes.

title: Family Reunion Rolls(Makes 2 Dozen)
directions: Scald milk., Stir in sugar, salt and margarine; cool to lukewarm., Sprinkle yeast into warm water; stir until dissolved. Add lukewarm milk mixture., Add beaten eggs and 3 cups flour., Beat until smooth., Add and stir in remaining flour.

title: Green Chilli
directions: Saute pork steak; salt and pepper to taste., Brown hamburger; salt and pepper to taste., Put Ro-Tel and tomatoes in blender and blend about 30 seconds., Cut jalapenos into small pieces., Put all ingredients into large soup pot, add 1/2 jar of minced garlic and cook (simmer) for about 1 hour or so.

title: Baked Pork Chops(Makes 1 To 2 Servings)
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Wash chops and season on both sides. Beat together egg and milk., Dip chops in mixture, then coat on both sides with crushed cornflakes., Place in baking dish and bake at 350° about 45 minutes or until the meat is cooked through and the juices run clear., It is not necessary to turn chops during cooking., Serve in sandwich or with baked potato or other vegetable.

title: Lemon Oat Lacies(Cookies)
directions: Beat margarine and sugar until creamy., Add remaining ingredients, except powdered sugar; mix well., Cover., Chill 30 minutes.

title: Italian Cream Cake
directions: Cream together butter and oil., Add sugar and beat until mixture is smooth., Add egg yolks and beat well., Combine flour and soda and add to creamed mixture alternately with buttermilk. Stir in vanilla., Add coconut and nuts., Beat egg whites until stiff and fold into mixture., Pour batter into three greased and floured 8-inch pans., Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes., Cool and frost with Cream Cheese Frosting.

title: Roast Beef Po Boy
directions: Put roast in baking pan., Add onion, garlic and soup., Add bouillon cubes to water; pour over., Cover with foil; bake at 350°., May need to add more water., Slice roast; serve on French bread with gravy.

title: Waikiki Meatballs
directions: Mix thoroughly beef, crumbs, onion, egg, salt, ginger and milk. Shape mixture by tablespoon into balls., Melt shortening in large skillet; brown and cook meatballs., Remove meatballs., Pour fat from skillet., Mix cornstarch and sugar., Stir in reserved pineapple syrup, vinegar and soy sauce until smooth., Pour in skillet; cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until mixture boils and thickens., Boil 1 minute., Add meatballs and pineapple tidbits; heat thoroughly., Serve over bed of rice.

title: Chocolate Pie(Makes 2 Pies)
directions: Mix, sugar,, salt, and	cocoa.	Add, eggs and mix well. Stir in vanilla and milk., Add melted oleo, then coconut., One cup of nuts may be added, if desired., Pour into 2 unbaked pie shells. Bake at, 350° for 40 minutes or until firm., Cool and serve.

title: Mexican Fiesta
directions: Brown meat; drain., Add seasoning and water., Simmer for 5 to 10 minutes., Prepare rice., Melt cheese and Ro-Tel tomatoes; mix well., Combine meat, rice and cheese dip., Top with chips., Bake at 400° for 15 minutes.

title: Parmesan Chicken
directions: *Weight Watchers makes a fat-free Parmesan cheese.

title: Tex-Mex Salad
directions: Combine first 9 ingredients in bowl., Using a fork, gradually mix oil into lime juice in small bowl., Season with salt and pepper., Add to salad with mint and mix well., Line plates (or serving bowl) with lettuce leaves., Mound salad on lettuce.

title: Microwave Applesauce
directions: Place apples and water in 1 1/2-quart casserole dish., Cover and microwave on High until apples are tender., Stir in sugar and cinnamon., Cool.

title: Cranberry Salad
directions: Peel orange, remove white membrane., Chop rind and pulp fine. Chop or grind cranberries., Combine apples, oranges and cranberries and drain well, reserving the juice., Pour juice in measuring cup and add enough water to make two cups., Heat one cup juice and sugar in a small saucepan, stirring until sugar is dissolved., Pour over gelatin in bowl, stir until gelatin is dissolved., Stir in remaining juice and cool thoroughly., Add drained fruits, nuts and celery., Pour into mold and chill until firm., Unmold on lettuce greens with pink gelatin cubes and pink mayonnaise.

title: Jello Delight
directions: Dilute Jell-O in hot water and let set slightly., Add crushed pineapple; let set until firm., Mix Dream Whip according to package; add cream cheese., Whip together and put over set Jell-O. Cook until thick the eggs, sugar, flour and juices., Cool, then spread over Jell-O and cheese topping.

title: Spice Snakin' Cake(Microwave)
directions: Mix as directed on box, using only 3/4 cup water., Place in a 5 x 9-inch buttered glass dish or cut a piece of wax paper to fit bottom., Microwave on Medium for 6 minutes; rotate dish one time. Cook on High 3 minutes., Rotate dish one time., Makes 6 servings.

title: Christmas Plum Pudding
directions: Combine raisins, currants, nutmeats and 1/2 cup flour. Combine eggs, molasses, buttermilk, suet and fruit juice., Combine remaining flour, bread crumbs, soda, spice and salt., Pour into 1 1/2-quart mold., Cover mold; set in deep kettle., Add water to 1-inch below cover of mold., Cover and steam 2 hours.

title: Stuffed Orange French Toast
directions: Butter 1 side of each bread slice; lay 6 slices flat, buttered side down, in a lightly buttered 13 x 9-inch pan.

title: Hot Artichoke Dip
directions: Mix ingredients. Pour into greased casserole dish. Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Brown Sugar Macaroons
directions: Combine sugar, nuts and egg and mix., Using 1 rounded teaspoonful per cookie, shape into balls., Bake on lightly greased cookie sheet in a preheated 300° oven for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Breakfast Stuff(Stuff:  An Unspecified Material Substance Or Aggregate Of Matter.)
directions: Brown sausage and drain well., Mix Bisquick, milk and eggs. Spread mix in a 13 x 9-inch pan., Combine sour cream, poppy seed, salt and eggs., Spread this mix over the sausage., Sprinkle grated cheese on top., Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Homemade Chicken Soup(The Kind That Cures The Flu)
directions: Cook chicken in large stockpot; cool, debone and cut up into small pieces., Return to pot in which broth from chicken was cooked., If more broth is needed, you may use clear, canned broth. Add clean, cut up carrots and celery., Add onions which have been chopped and chopped fresh parsley tops and stems., Cook in broth until tender., You will need to salt and pepper to taste., May serve over cooked rice or noodles.

title: Pasta Nugget Salad
directions: Prepare pasta according to package directions; drain., In large bowl, combine pasta and remaining ingredients; toss to mix. Serve immediately or cover and chill., Stir gently before serving. Refrigerate leftovers., Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Congealed Waldorf Salad
directions: Bring 1 cup cider to a boil; add gelatin and stir until dissolved., Stir in remaining cider., Chill until consistency of unbeaten egg white., Fold in apple, celery and pecans., Pour into a 4-cup mold., Chill until set., Unmold on a lettuce lined plate and top with a dollop of mayonnaise.

title: Ground Meat & Rice
directions: Brown meat in butter., Add: soup, rice and water., Cover and cook for about 5 minutes or until rice is done.

title: Coconut Candy
directions: Mix all ingredients and form into 1-inch balls; chill., Dip into chocolate and place on wax paper to set.

title: Spinach Dip
directions: Mix all ingredients., Stir well, cover and refrigerate for 2 to 3 hours., Serve with vegetables or Snackwell pepper crackers.

title: Red Cake
directions: Cream shortening, sugar and eggs until smooth., Then combine food coloring, cocoa and salt to make a paste., Add this to shortening mixture., Then add flour, milk and vanilla; beat until smooth., Remove from mixer and fold in vinegar and soda., Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350°.

title: Pasta Primavera
directions: Cook spaghetti and drain., Cook broccoli according to package directions to tender-crisp., Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a large, heavy skillet over moderate heat., Stir in garlic, basil leaves, onions and parsley., Cook 1 to 2 minutes., Turn off heat and gently mix in with cooked broccoli.

title: Irene'S Cake
directions: In a casserole dish, place crumbled angel food cake in bottom and cover with crushed pineapple with juice., Prepare pudding mix according to package directions and pour over pineapple., Place sliced bananas over pudding; cover with Cool Whip., Let chill before serving.

title: Hearty Potato Soup
directions: In a large kettle, cook potatoes, carrots and celery in water with bouillon cubes until tender. Saute onions in butter until soft. Stir in flour and salt and pepper, gradually add sour cream, stirring constantly until desired consistency. If too thick, add plain milk., Yield: 2 1/2 quarts.

title: Homecoming Banana Pudding
directions: Mix pudding, milk, sour cream and half of Cool Whip., Layer crackers, bananas and pudding., Top with other half of Cool Whip.

title: "Kay Huddleston'S Broccoli Casserole"
directions: Saute onion in margarine., Mix soup and Cheez Whiz., Add cooked and well drained broccoli., Top with onion rings or cracker crumbs., Bake at 350° for about 45 minutes.

title: Chicken Corn Noodle Soup
directions: Cut up the chicken and cover with 3 quarts water., Add the salt and saffron and stew until tender., Remove chicken from stock and set aside the legs and breast for chicken salad., Take the rest of the meat from the bones and return meat to broth., Add the corn and noodles to soup., Season with pepper., Cook 15 minutes longer., Before serving, add parsley and chopped eggs.

title: Chocolate Chip Pie
directions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees., Beat eggs in a large bowl on high until foamy., Beat in flour, sugar and brown sugar., Beat in butter., Stir in chocolate chips and nuts., Pour into pie shell and bake for 55-60 minutes., Serve warm with ice cream or cool whip.

title: Never Fail Dumplings
directions: Boil a whole chicken in a Dutch oven pot with water., (Cover chicken over half way with water) after chicken is done, take out of broth to cool., Mix flour and shortening in together first. Then add all other ingredients., (I beat my egg in with the 5 tablespoons of chicken broth.) After mixing all ingredients, mixture should be a soft dough., Roll out dough very thin and let stand for about 10 minutes., Then cut into strips and drop into boiling broth., Simmer about 15 minutes, then add deboned chicken to dumplings.

title: Butterscotch Fudge Bar
directions: Preheat oven to 350°. Melt butter and chocolate in saucepan. Remove from heat and stir in sugar. Add eggs and vanilla. Stir in flour, baking powder and salt. Add morsels. Spread mixture in a 9-inch square pan. Bake 25 to 30 minutes. Cool and cut into squares. Store in airtight container.

title: Fruit Dip
directions: Mix, chill and serve with apples, grapes, bananas and other fruit of your choice.

title: Crunch Cake
directions: Mix sugar and shortening until light and creamy., Beat in eggs, one at a time., Add milk and flour alternately., Stir in flavorings., Start baking in cold oven at 275° in tube pan for 1 hour and 30 minutes.

title: Chicken Tetrazzini
directions: Cook spaghetti, saute green pepper and onions in butter., When tender, combine all other ingredients (except spaghetti) and bring to a simmer over low heat until well blended., Mix with spaghetti. Put into a 9 x 13-inch pan (greased)., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes. Spread with cheese and melt in oven., Garnish with parsley.

title: Spinach Dip
directions: Mix well., Refrigerating overnight makes it better.

title: Buttermilk Pie
directions: Cream butter, sugar, salt and flour together., Add beaten eggs, buttermilk and nutmeg., Pour into unbaked pie shell and bake at 375° for 45 minutes., Nutmeg may be sprinkled on top of pie, if desired.

title: Easy Lasagne
directions: In a large pan, brown ground beef; drain., Add tomato sauce, mushrooms and onion; bring to a boil., Reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes., Prepare noodles according to package directions.

title: Chocolate Eclair Cake(Prepare 24 Hours Ahead.)
directions: Prepare 24 hours ahead.

title: Copy Cat Cheese Biscuits(Similar To Those Served By A Popular Seafood Restaurant)
directions: Preheat oven to 450°., Mix baking mix, cheese and water., Drop by large spoonfuls onto greased baking sheet., Bake for 8 to 10 minutes., After baking, while hot, brush with melted butter, mixed with the parsley, garlic and Italian seasoning., Serve hot., Makes about 12 biscuits.

title: J.D.'S Texas Cheese Dip
directions: Heat soup to boiling., Reduce heat and melt in cheese., Add green chiles., Pour into bowl and let cool for one hour., Great for dipping fresh vegetables or tortilla chips., For hotter dip, use Velveeta jalapeno cheese.

title: Banana Cake
directions: Place the flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt in a bowl., In another bowl, cream the shortening and sugar until light and fluffy., Beat the eggs and add to the creamed mixture., Mash the bananas (3/4 cup banana pulp) and mix with the sour milk and vanilla., Add the banana mixture alternately with the dry ingredients., Mix well., Pour the batter into 2 greased 9-inch round layer pans or a 9 x 13-inch pan and bake 1/2 hour at 375° for the round pans and 40 minutes at 350° for the 9 x 13-inch oblong pan.

title: English Cheese Melts
directions: Cut English muffins in half., Set aside., In large bowl mix together olives, cheese, onions, mayonnaise and salt., Spread mixture evenly over 12 muffin halves., Place on baking sheet. Broil 3 to 4 minutes or until cheese is bubbly and melted., Cut in half before serving., Garnish with parsley sprigs.

title: Chocolate Eclair Cake
directions: You will need 1 (8 x 20 x 3-inch) pan with cover.

title: Candied Sweet Potatoes & Apples
directions: Cut sweet potatoes in half crosswise., Cook in boiling water to cover, for 10 minutes., Drain and cool., Cut crosswise into 1/2 inch slices.

title: Zucchini Brownies
directions: Mix together flour, sugar, cocoa, salt and baking soda. Combine shredded zucchini, vanilla and oil., Mix with dry ingredients., Add nuts., Spread into a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes., May frost or serve as is., Very good!

title: Carrot Ring With Peas
directions: Combine all ingredients, mixing well., Place in a greased 5 1/2 cup ring mold., Bake in preheated 350° oven for 45 minutes. Unmold and serve on platter with cooked peas in the center., This makes a very pretty vegetable to serve with chicken, fish or beef. You may make the ring and freeze., Reheat, fill with peas and serve immediately.

title: Crispix Squares
directions: Pack first four ingredients in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan., Add vanilla ice cream., Keep frozen until ready to serve.

title: Italian Fish Fillets
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Cut fish into serving size pieces. Arrange in greased baking dish., Sprinkle with parsley, basil, oregano and pepper., Top with spaghetti sauce, then sprinkle with cheese., Bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until fish flakes easily at the thickest part.

title: Wyoming Cowboy Cookies
directions: Cream the margarine and sugar together., Add eggs and vanilla. Add dry ingredients., Drop onto cookie sheet and bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes., Yields 8 dozen.

title: Carrot Cake
directions: Cream together eggs, sugar and oil., Sift together flour, baking soda, baking powder, and cinnamon., Add alternately with baby food., Bake at 350 degrees for 35 minutes., For icing, combine cream cheese, powdered sugar, vanilla and butter or oleo.

title: "Vinegar For Sushi"
directions: Combine, vinegar,, sugar and salt in saucepan, stirring until sugar, dissolves., Bring to a boil., (If you desire, add ajinomoto when, liquid, becomes clear.) You can make a larger "batch" at a time and keep it on hand, making it handy to make sushi,, inari, maze-gohan, California roll, etc., frequently. The "su", is, also very, good to make "sunomono" or for other salads.

title: Black Forest Pie
directions: Spread 1 cup whipped topping on bottom of pie crust., Combine milk and pudding mix. Blend with wire whisk or mixer for 1 minute. Fold in 1 1/2 cups whipped topping., Spread over whipped topping in crust. Spread remaining whipped topping over top, leaving a 1-inch border and forming a depression in center of the whipped topping., Spoon cherry pie filling in the center. Chill 3 hours.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Place dry beef in, bottom, of, dish., Wrap bacon around chicken., Spread soup over top of all., Cover with foil., Bake at 300° for 2 hours, then 350° for 1/2 hour, uncovered.

title: Twin Mountain Muffins
directions: Sift flour; measure and resift 3 times with baking powder and salt. Cream butter and shortening; blend in sugar gradually. Add beaten egg and beat until smooth and fluffy. Add flour mixture alternately with milk, beating well after each addition. Spoon into buttered muffin pans, filling about 2/3 full. Bake at 400° for 25 minutes. Makes 24 muffins.

title: Drop Sugar Cookies
directions: Sift together the flour, soda and salt., In separate bowl, cream together the butter, shortening, sugar and vanilla., Add egg to creamed mixture and beat until fluffy., Add dry ingredients plus milk to creamed mixture and stir until smooth., Drop by teaspoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet., Flatten with bottom of glass which has been dipped into sugar., Bake in a preheated 350° to 400° oven for about 12 minutes., Cool., Yields 5 1/2 dozen 2-inch cookies.

title: My Favorite Meat Ball Appetizer
directions: Mix ingredients together; roll into walnut size balls., Bake on cookie sheet at 350° until done (approximately 30 to 45 minutes)., Prepare the sauce while meat balls are baking.

title: Texas B.B.Q. Beef Sandwiches
directions: Over medium heat add butter, onion, green pepper, saute until tender, about 5 minutes., Add beef and saute 2 minutes., Add lemon juice, worcestershire sauce, ketchup, brown sugar, mustard, salt and hot pepper sauce to skillet, mix well.

title: Chocolate Cream Pie
directions: Combine dry ingredients., Add cold milk to egg yolk., Add this mixture to scalded milk (total 2 1/2 cups milk includes all)., Cook very slowly until thick and creamy., Add vanilla., Cool., Pour into unbaked cooled pie crust, 8 or 9-inch., Add meringue by beating 3 egg whites (room temperature) with 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar until foamy., Gradually add 3 tablespoons sugar and beat until stands in peaks., Put on pie., Brown in 350° oven 12 minutes., Cool out of draft.

title: Mock Scwarzwalder Kirsch
directions: Mix cake mix, cinnamon, almond extract and vanilla., Bake at 350° and let cool.

title: Brennan Potatoes
directions: Bake potato., Grill bacon until crisp., Drain, leaving 3 tablespoons grease., Add onion and saute slowly., Remove from heat., Cut shallow lengthwise strip from potatoes and scoop out inside and add to skillet., Add cheese, crumbled bacon, sour cream and seasonings., Mix and mash with spoon to blend., Return to low heat and heat through., Stuff into potatoes., Drizzle with melted butter and sprinkle with paprika., Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.

title: Cowboy Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., Lightly grease cookie sheets., Cream the butter with sugars in a large bowl until blended., Add egg and vanilla., Beat until fluffy., Combine flour, cocoa, baking powder and baking soda in a small bowl., Stir into creamed mixture with oats, chocolate chips, raisins and nuts., Drop dough by teaspoonfuls 2 inches apart onto prepared cookie sheets., Bake 10 to 12 minutes or until lightly browned around edges., Remove to wire racks to cool., Makes about 4 dozen cookies.

title: Pound Cake
directions: Let margarine get to room temperature., Add Crisco and sugar, beat well., Add eggs one at a time, beating 1 minute after each, alternately with milk., Add other ingredients., Bake at 350° until done.

title: Simple Party Punch
directions: In punch bowl place any flavor sherbet., "I prefer orange." Then slowly pour the ginger ale over and let soften. Stir and mix together until the sherbet is dissolved.

title: Orange Jello Salad
directions: Combine dry Jell-O with defrosted Cool Whip and cottage cheese., Drain liquids from oranges and pineapple; stir into Jell-O mixture., Reserve a small amount of oranges to decorate the top., Refrigerate and serve cold.

title: Taco Salad
directions: Cook beans for 15 minutes. Layer on tray and let cool. Mix taco mix and add cream cheese. Layer on top of beans. Chop pepper, tomato, onion and lettuce and layer in order. Serve with chips.

title: Grilled Fajitas
directions: Marinate the meat according to directions. Grill the vegetables until tender-crisp., Remove and keep warm., Grill meat until preferred doneness.

title: Broccoli 'N Rice Casserole
directions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Mix together soup, broccoli, rice, process cheese spread, half the onions and water. Spoon into 1 quart casserole dish. Bake 35 minutes. Top with remaining onions. Bake 5 minutes more.

title: Cabbage Casserole In A Rice Cooker
directions: Brown ground meat and sausage together., Drain oil when cooked., Mix all ingredients in a large bowl; then transfer into rice cooker., When cooked, leave in cooker for 10 minutes before serving.

title: Dutch Baked Beans
directions: Saute peppers and onions in small amount of oil., Blend all ingredients together., Pour into casserole., Bake at 350° for approximately 1 hour.

title: Mexicali Pie
directions: In skillet, brown frankfurters and cook onion in butter until tender., Add soup, beans and water., Bring to boil., Pour into 2-quart shallow baking dish (12 x 8 x 2-inch)., Combine corn muffin mix, milk and egg., Spoon around edge of baking dish., Bake in 400° oven for 20 minutes or until done., Makes about 5 1/2 cups.

title: Strawberry-Banana Smoothy
directions: In blender, process strawberries, yogurt, banana and juice until smooth., Immediately, pour into chilled, insulated drink container or make into popsicles., Refrigerate any remaining drink in covered container and serve later., Instruct your child to give the container several vigorous shakes before opening it.

title: Cheese And Chilies Roll
directions: Bring cheeses to room temperature., On a sheet of wax paper, roll out Velveeta., Divide the cream cheese into small portions and put on top of Velveeta., Roll again., Spread the green chilies over cheeses., Roll up as for a jelly roll., Divide into 2 rolls. Serve with crackers.

title: No Bake Cookies
directions: Combine first 4 ingredients, then bring to a boil., Remove from heat and add peanut butter, vanilla and oats., Stir well. Drop on wax paper.

title: Vegetable Dip
directions: Mix all ingredients well, then chill overnight., Serve with chips or raw vegetables.

title: Spanish Pork Chops
directions: Roll pork chops in flour and onion mixture., Brown pork chops in oiled skillet., Add whole tomatoes, salt and pepper., Cover with tomato sauce and simmer until tender.

title: Sizzlers
directions: Cook hamburger meat and onion until done; drain., Add chili powder, garlic powder, salt, pepper and red pepper., Cook for a few minutes., Add Cheez Whiz and cook until melted., Spread meat on flat tostada shells., Shred cabbage on top of meat (may want to sprinkle red pepper on if you like hot stuff)., Place another tostada shell on top of cabbage.

title: Caramel-Peach Crunch Dessert
directions: Preheat oven to 400°., In a bowl, combine flour, oats, sugar, cinnamon and salt., Add butter., Mix well.

title: Persimmon Date Nut Bread
directions: Cream butter., Add sugar and beat well., Add eggs, one at a time, beating after each addition., Dissolve soda in persimmon pulp., Mix into creamed ingredients., Combine flour, baking powder, salt, cinnamon, nutmeg and cloves., Stir into creamed mixture.

title: Cream Cheese Pound Cake
directions: Combine cream cheese and margarine., Add sugar, beating until light and fluffy., Add eggs slowly until well mixed., Gradually add flour., Then add vanilla., Pour into greased and floured tube pan., Bake at 325° for 1 hour or until done.

title: Fruited Pistachio Pudding
directions: In a large bowl, combine pudding mix, whipped topping and salad dressing; mix well. Fold in remaining ingredients. Leave in bowl. Serve immediately or chill.

title: Peanut Brittle
directions: Cook until soft ball stage the sugar, Karo and water., After soft ball stage, add peanuts., Cook until dark., Remove from burner., Add baking soda, vinegar and salt., Mix together and pour onto a buttered cookie sheet., Cool, then break apart.

title: One Bowl Banana Cake
directions: In large mixing bowl, add all ingredients and beat until mixed well., Pour into greased and floured pan., Bake at 350° for at least 40 minutes., Test with toothpick to see if done., Cool and frost with butter powdered sugar frosting.

title: Chewies
directions: Melt oleo; add sugar., Add eggs one at a time; add flour and vanilla., Spread thinly on greased 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake 20 minutes at 350°., Cut while hot.

title: Baked Cheesecake
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Combine crumb with next 3 ingredients. Reserve 3/4 cup with spoon., Press the rest to bottom and sides of 9-inch spring-form., Beat eggs light, slowly beat in 1 cup sugar. Add next 5 ingredients and beat with hand or beater until blended., Sieve., Stir in lemon rind., Pour into pan., Sprinkle with reserved crumbs., Bake at 350°, for 1 hour., Turn off heat, open oven door., Cool cake in oven for 1 hour., Don't fret, it will settle., Chill., Remove pan sides., Makes 10 to 12 servings.

title: Fruit Pops
directions: Put in all ingredients and blend until smooth., Put in Dixie cups or popsicle molds., Put plastic spoon or popsicle stick in middle and freeze until frozen.

title: Hot Chocolate Mix
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Put 1/3 cup mix in mug; add hot water to make 1 cup.

title: Egg Sausage Casserole
directions: Cut bread; add a little butter., Beat eggs with milk, salt and mustard., Layer bread, sausage and cheese., Pour egg mixture on top and refrigerate overnight., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Pizza Casserole
directions: Brown ground beef and onions; drain., Add tomatoes, tomato sauce and seasonings., Add the two cheeses., Let simmer while you cook and drain macaroni; add to other ingredients and let simmer 10 minutes., Pour into two oblong; greased baking dishes and cook at, 350° for 20 minutes., This can be frozen for use at a later date.

title: Chili Cheese Puff
directions: Mix all ingredients together and pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 40 to 50 minutes.

title: Kentucky Chess Pie
directions: Mix all ingredients., Pour into unbaked deep dish pie shell. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until solid.

title: Cream Of Corn Soup
directions: To Cream Soup Base, add corn, milk, onion, chervil, salt and bouillon cube., Heat to simmering, cooking long enough to dissolve bouillon cube., Serve garnished with parsley and paprika.

title: Bean Relish Bowl
directions: Combine all but lettuce and egg., Toss lightly, cover., Chill at least 1 hour., Just before serving, add lettuce and egg., Toss.

title: Divinity
directions: Combine sugar, corn syrup, water and salt., Cook to very hard ball stage (260°)., Slowly pour syrup in a thin stream over beaten egg whites, beating constantly., Beat until mixture holds shape (about 4 to 5 minutes)., Stir in vanilla., Drop by heaping tablespoonfuls on waxed paper, lifting and twirling spoon to form a peak., If divinity becomes too stiff for twirling, add a few drops hot water., Makes about 1 1/2 dozen.

title: Beef Casserole(From The Files Of Louella Scott Williams)
directions: Lightly brown the ground beef, onion and green pepper in oil, then add the soups, water, garlic and cooked spaghetti., Pour into a 9 x 13-inch baking dish and top with grated cheese., Bake 20 minutes at 350°.

title: Zucchini Pineapple Bread
directions: Beat eggs until fluffy., Add oil, sugar, vanilla and zucchini. Mix well., Add dry ingredients and mix well., Add raisins, pineapple and nuts., Blend.

title: Fried Eggplant Or Summer Squash
directions: Wash eggplant; pare and cut in 1/2-inch slices., Or wash squash and cut crosswise in slices., Dip slices in well seasoned flour., Saute slowly in butter for 10 to 15 minutes, or until crisp and browned, turning occasionally., Serve hot., Makes 6 servings.

title: Whitney'S Sweet Potato Pie
directions: Boil potatoes in jacket until done., Peel and mash., Add butter, sugar, vanilla, sprinkle of nutmeg & cinnamon., Combine the beaten eggs and milk., Mix with potatoes until well blended. Pour into pie shells., Bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour and 20 minutes.

title: Watergate Cake
directions: Mix first 5 ingredients for 2 minutes with electric mixer. Fold in nuts., Bake in greased tube pan 50 to 55 minutes at 350°. Cool before serving.

title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
directions: Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy., Add eggs, one at a time., Blend dry ingredients and 1/2 sour cream., Mix well all remaining sour cream., Beat well., Bake at 350° until done.

title: Pumpkin Cake(This Cake Is So Tasty It Doesn'T Need Frosting)
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Mix all ingredients together and beat well., Bake in tube or Bundt pan for 1 hour., May sprinkle with confectioners sugar, if desired.

title: Pecan Pie Muffins
directions: Mix first 3 ingredients together in large bowl. Make a well in center. In another bowl, mix eggs until foamy. Mix butter into eggs. Put egg mixture into dry ingredients. Mix well. Pour into foil cupcake liners. Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes. You must use foil cupcake liners.

title: Jello Cake
directions: Mix all together. Bake 1 hour at 325°.

title: Ham, Egg And Cheese Casserole
directions: Place ham, cheese and croutons in the bottom of a greased 9 x 13-inch pan., Mix remaining ingredients; pour this mixture over crouton mixture and refrigerate overnight.

title: Pot Pie
directions: Cook until barely tender carrots, potatoes and celery., Add dinner cuts, onions and a dash of salt., Add mushroom soup., Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan., Cover with pie crust., Bake at 400° for 30 minutes.

title: Chicken Breasts Diane(Reduced Fat)
directions: Cook chicken slowly in covered nonstick skillet on both sides. Add a little water if it wants to stick.

title: Coconut Cake
directions: Blend cake mix, pudding mix, water, eggs and oil in large mixer bowl; beat for 4 minutes., Stir in coconut and walnuts. Pour into 3 greased and floured 9-inch pans., Bake at 350° for 35 minutes., Cool in pans for 15 minutes., Remove and cool on racks.

title: Miniature Cheese Cakes
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., Line cupcake pans with paper liners. Place vanilla wafer in bottom of each liner., In small bowl beat next 5 items until light and fluffy., Fill liners 3/4 full with mixture., Bake 15 to 20 minutes or until set., Top each with spoonful of filling and 1 teaspoon nuts., Chill., Serves 24.

title: Slaw
directions: Cut up cabbage, onion and carrot., Mix., Add sugar and salad dressing., Mix.

title: Christian Cake
directions: Mix thoroughly., Add tears of joy, sorrow and sympathy for others., Flavor with little gifts of love and kindly service. Fold in 4 cups of faith and prayer to lighten other ingredients and raise texture of great heights of Christian living., Bake well at a high degree of human kindness and serve with a warm smile.

title: The Zucchini Bread
directions: This is so easy and so great to have on hand in the freezer. Toasts like a dream or serve with cream cheese.

title: Banana Split Cake
directions: Melt 1 stick butter, mix 1/2 cup powdered sugar and graham cracker crumbs., This makes first layer of cake., Press mixture into bottom of loaf pan.

title: Taco Dip
directions: Layer ingredients in order listed in a microwave-safe pan. Microwave on High for 5 minutes or bake in oven at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Old-Fashioned Fudge
directions: Mix sugar and cocoa., Add corn syrup and milk., Stir., Cook on medium heat, stirring often, until it reaches a soft ball stage (235° on a candy thermometer)., Add butter and vanilla., Let cool. Beat until it thickens and loses its shine., Pour into greased pan to harden., (Nuts may be added just before pouring into pan.)

title: Coca-Cola Cake
directions: Mix flour, sugar and salt in a bowl., Heat margarine, Coke and cocoa in pan to boiling., Pour over mixture. Add eggs, buttermilk, soda and vanilla. Stir in marshmallows., Batter will be thin; marshmallows will float., Cook in a 9 x 13-inch cake pan for 30 to 35 minutes at 350°., Frost cake while hot.

title: Beet Top Greens
directions: Beet greens may be prepared in the same ways that you prepare spinach or Swiss chard, but they must be young and small to be tasty., Try cooking the greens in boiling salted water for 5 to 8 minutes., Drain, chop and add the butter or margarine., Toss with a fork until butter is melted., Add the horseradish and lemon juice; mix well., Season with salt and pepper., Serves 4.

title: Peaches-N-Cream Pie
directions: Blend first seven ingredients for two minutes., Put into greased 9 or 10-inch pie plate., Arrange peach slices on top. Blend cream cheese, juice and 1/2 cup sugar together., Beat until creamy and place in center of peaches; spread out to about 1 inch from edge of pie plate., Sprinkle with cinnamon and sugar., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes., Can be served warm or cold.

title: Red Wine Vinegar Salad Dressing
directions: Place all ingredients in a blender and mix until smooth. Serve over various lettuce salads.

title: Waldorf Turkey Toss With Apple Dressing
directions: Combine applesauce, honey, vinegar, poppy seed, paprika and lemon peel. Gradually add oil, beating with electric mixer until slightly thickened.

title: Copper Pennies
directions: Cut carrots into round pieces and boil about 5 minutes. Combine carrots with rest of ingredients and refrigerate 24 hours before serving.

title: Glad'S Own Custard Pie(Ed'S Very Favorite)
directions: Beat eggs; add sugar., Scald milk and add to mixture., Add nutmeg; pour into unbaked crust., Bake at 350° until filling is firm., Top with meringue., Brown slightly.

title: Orange-Nut Muffins
directions: Sift dry ingredients into mixing bowl. Stir in orange rind and nuts. Beat eggs in small bowl. Add orange juice and oil., Mix well. Add to flour mixture., Mix until moistened., Fill greased tins 2/3 full. Bake at 425° for 18 to 20 minutes. Makes 18 muffins.

title: Dump Cake
directions: Melt, butter, in, oblong baking pan., Pour out and save for later., In	pan,, put, pie	filling on bottom and top with crushed pineapple	and, juice., Cover, this with the dry cake mix., Top off with reserved melted butter., Bake for 1 hour at 350°

title: Cheese Grits Casserole
directions: Prepare enough grits to serve 12., Mix all ingredients in grits while hot., Bake at 350°.

title: Oven Fried Chicken
directions: Combine all ingredients except milk and salad oil., Dip chicken in milk and coat with crumb mixture., Place in shallow roasting pan, skin side up (do not grease pan)., Bake at 375° for 30 minutes., Brush with salad oil; bake 30 more minutes, or until nicely browned and tender.

title: Breakfast Casserole
