directions: Preheat oven to 375°., Brown sausage meat; drain., Press one can crescent rolls in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch casserole dish., Top with sausage and cheese., Beat eggs; add salt and pepper., Pour eggs over sausage and cheese., Bake in a 375° oven for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Shrimp And Eggplant Casserole
directions: Saute, shrimp in oil, until, pink., Remove, shrimp, and saute onion, celery and bell, pepper., Add, rice to shrimp and eggplant mixture., Pour into, buttered 2 1/2 quart dish., Pour soup over top., Top with grated cheese and then buttered bread crumbs., Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

title: Dirt Cake
directions: You will need one 8-inch clay flowerpot.

title: Caramel Apple Coffee Cake
directions: Melt butter., Add brown sugar and corn syrup and blend., Pour mixture into bottom of 8 x 8-inch or 10-inch round pan., Sprinkle with chopped nuts., Peel and slice apple., Spread apple slices on top of nuts., Dip each refrigerated roll in sugar-cinnamon mixture (one side only)., Place sugar side down in the pan., After placing all rolls in pan, sprinkle remaining mixture over all., Bake in 375° oven and turn out onto a large plate or tray., Let sit for 30 seconds, then lift off and serve warm.

title: Ginger'S Chocolate Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Lightly grease cookie sheets., Combine first four ingredients and mix well with spoon., (Dough will be thick.), Add vanilla chips and nuts., Drop by teaspoon on cookie sheet. Bake 10 to 12 minutes., Let stand on cookie sheet 1 minute before removing to wire rack., Yields 2 dozen large or 4 dozen small cookies.

title: Boiled Cookies
directions: Cook sugar, milk, cocoa, and margarine for 1 1/2 minutes. Start timing when it has reached a full boil. Remove from heat; add oats, nuts, and vanilla. Then add peanut butter., Mix well then drop by teaspoon on waxed paper.

title: Chocolate Crunch Truffles
directions: In a medium saucepan over very low heat, melt chocolate, stirring constantly; remove from heat., Add butter, stirring until melted; stir in liqueur and orange peel, if desired., Transfer to a medium bowl; cover and refrigerate until mixture is fudge-like, about 30 minutes.

title: Mushroom Croustades
directions: Preheat oven to 400°., Cut a 3-inch round from each slice of bread., Brush inside of 2 miniature muffin tins generously with butter., Gently fit bread rounds into each mold to form a cup. Bake 10 minutes or until lightly browned., Cool.

title: Butterscotch Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Sift together flour, soda, salt and cinnamon; set aside. Cream shortening and sugars; add eggs and beat. Add flour mixture and oats. Drop onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 325° for 15 minutes.

title: Mexican Soup
directions: Simmer all ingredients and then add cheese., Stir until completely mixed., Serve with tortilla chips and quesadillas.

title: Cheesy Chicken And Rice Casserole
directions: Preheat oven to 350°. To cook chicken, you can either boil for 20 to 25 minutes or place in a microwave-safe dish; cover and cook for 5 to 6 minutes on High. Turn and cook another 2 to 3 minutes or until cooked through and no longer pink inside. Let cool. Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces. In a 9 x 13-inch baking dish, combine chicken, salt, pepper, rice and soup. Mix well. Top with cheese, then with bread cubes. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes or until bubbly and golden brown.

title: Clam Dip
directions: Combine all ingredients, except the bread., Use some of the reserved clam fluid to thin it., Cut the top off the bread., Break out the insides and set aside.

title: Poppy Seed Cake
directions: Mix cake mix, vanilla pudding, 1 cup water, 1/2 cup oil and the eggs together on medium speed until well blended., Fold in the poppy seed., Prepare Bundt or tube pan by greasing with butter and sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon., Bake at 350° for 50 minutes. Cool 15 minutes.

title: Baked Beans
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Put 4 to 6 slices of bacon on top and bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours or until juice cooks down.

title: Cheesy Potatoes
directions: Place potatoes in casserole dish., Mix soup and milk., Pour over potatoes., Sprinkle cheese on top., Bake at 350° until cheese melts and is bubbly.

title: Peanut Butter And Oat Cookies
directions: Bring first three ingredients to a boil. Take off heat and add peanut butter, vanilla and oats., Drop by spoonful onto wax paper.

title: Green Apple Cake
directions: Mix sugar and eggs., Beat., Mix all dry ingredients., Add to eggs and sugar mixture alternately with oil and coffee., Beat well. Add raisins, apples and nuts., Cook at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes., Let cool., Add Cream Cheese Icing.

title: Southern Peanut Pie
directions: Beat eggs until foamy., Add sugar, syrup, butter, salt and vanilla., Continue to beat until thoroughly blended., Stir in peanuts., Pour into unbaked pie shell., Bake in preheated 375° oven for 45 minutes., Serve warm or cold., May be topped with whipped cream or ice cream.

title: Jean'S Nine-Layer Casserole
directions: Butter a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish or pan., Line with bread slices., Sprinkle chicken over bread., In saucepan, saute the mushrooms in 2 tablespoons of butter., Using a slotted spoon, spoon mushrooms over chicken in baking dish., Combine water chestnuts and mayonnaise; spoon over mushrooms., Top with cheeses. Combine eggs and milk; pour over cheese layer., Cover and then chill for at least 3 hours or let stand overnight., Bake, uncovered, in a 350° oven for 1 1/4 hours., Combine melted butter and crumbs., Sprinkle over casserole and then bake 10 more minutes., Serves 10 to 12.

title: Pecan Pralines
directions: Mix sugar, milk and soda thoroughly and cook over medium heat until small amount tested in cold water forms small ball., Add butter and return to heat until butter has melted., Remove from heat; add vanilla and beat until mixture begins to thicken., Add pecans; mix thoroughly and drop in thin patties onto waxed paper or foil., Yields 20 to 24 pralines.

title: Corny Cornbread
directions: Blend eggs, margarine, sour cream and corn., Add salt and muffin mix., Pour into greased 9 x 12-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes., This is best when served hot.

title: Chili
directions: Simmer onion and drippings., Add beef and simmer until brown. Mix all other ingredients., Add beans last so they will not be mushy., Add all ingredients to meat and bring to a boil., Simmer 45 minutes.

title: Rice Krispies Treats
directions: Melt margarine in large saucepan over low heat., Add marshmallows and stir until completely melted., Remove from heat. Add Rice Krispies cereal., Stir until well coated., Using buttered spatula or waxed paper, press mixture evenly into buttered 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan., Cut into squares when cool., Yield:, 24 squares, 2 x 2-inches.

title: Waikiki Meatballs
directions: Mix meat, crumbs, onion, egg, salt, ginger and milk., Shape mixture by rounded tablespoonfuls into balls., Melt shortening in a large skillet., Brown and cook meatballs., Remove meatballs; keep warm., Pour fat from skillet.

title: Mock Coconut Cookies
directions: Mix all ingredients together in order given., Beat well. Chill dough 1 hour., Shape into small balls., Put on ungreased cookie sheet., Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes, until lightly browned., Do not overbake., Let cool on cookie sheet before removing.

title: Broccoli Salad
directions: In a large bowl, cut broccoli into bite-size pieces., Crumble bacon into broccoli and add chopped onion., In a small bowl, mix mayonnaise, vinegar and sugar., Stir well., Stir into broccoli gently until broccoli and bacon are well coated., Refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Coconut Pie
directions: Mix together ingredients. Pour into pie plate and bake 30 to 40 minutes at 350°. No crust is needed.

title: Congealed Cranberry Salad
directions: Dissolve jello in boiling water., Add remaining ingredients. Pour into container and chill until firm.

title: Never Know It'S Low-Fat Cake
directions: Prepare German chocolate cake mix as directed on package, substituting Egg Beaters and applesauce for eggs and oil., Bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan, sprayed with low-fat cooking spray, as directed., Pour condensed milk over hot cake (in pan)., Let cool. Spread caramel topping., Sprinkle Grape-Nuts., Top with Cool Whip. Refrigerate several hours or overnight., Delicious and guilt-free!

title: Chicken Enchiladas
directions: Use meat mixture to fill and roll about 12 to 15 flour tortillas., Place rolled tortillas in cooking dish.

title: Sopaipillas
directions: Combine dry ingredients in a bowl., Cut in shortening with a pastry blender until mealy., Add water, a tablespoon at a time, and toss with a fork to blend., Turn onto a lightly floured surface and knead until smooth., Roll out as thin as possible. Cut into 2 or 3-inch squares and fry in hot oil, 370°, until puffed and browned., Makes 20 to 30, depending on size., Serve warm with cinnamon sugar or syrup, if desired.

title: Cabbage Stir-Fry
directions: Heat oil in wok or large skillet until hot., Add cabbage, onion, pepper, garlic powder, sugar, salt and pepper., Stir-fry until cabbage is just tender and light green, about 3 minutes. Add water and cover; remove from heat., Let stand 3 to 5 minutes. Yields 4 to 6 servings.

title: Hawaiian Banana Nut Bread
directions: Combine first five ingredients., Stir in pecans., Combine remaining ingredients and add to flour mixture, stirring until dry ingredients are moistened., Spoon batter into 2 greased and floured 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 3-inch loaf pans., Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 10 minutes., Cool in pan 10 minutes and remove and leave on wire racks.

title: Dutch Rusk
directions: Mix first 4 ingredients, then add flour to thicken slightly. Add the next 3 ingredients and mix., Add flour until right for punching., Lard sides of pan., Knead a few minutes more., Let rise 2 times., Make into large 3-inch buns., Let raise., Bake at 350° and let cool., Slice each bun in 2 or 3 slices., Dry in low oven until crisp.

title: Microwave Sweet Potato Chips
directions: On a rack, arrange the sweet potato slices in a circle. Sprinkle with either salt, cinnamon-sugar mix or chili powder. Cook in microwave on High 4 to 5 minutes, until dry., Rotate rack halfway through cooking., Let stand 1 minute., Contains 40 calories; no fat.

title: Garden Salad
directions: Drain all canned vegetables. Mix oil, vinegar, sugar and pepper. Pour over vegetables and mix well. Best if refrigerated overnight.

title: Hot Milk Cake
directions: Boil together margarine or butter and milk., Cream together eggs and sugar with a pinch of salt., Beat well., Add flavoring. Add flour., Beat in warm milk., Bake at 375° for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Easy Vanilla Pudding
directions: Mix together sugar, flour, salt and milk; cook over medium heat to a boil., Separate eggs; beat yolks., Mix with small amount of pudding mix., Then add to entire mixture., Put back on fire and cook for one minute., Remove from heat., Add 1 stick of oleo and vanilla.

title: Chinese Chicken Salad
directions: Chop cabbage and green onions., Add almonds, sesame seed and cooked chicken breasts., Combine Top Ramen flavor packets, salt, pepper, sugar, vinegar and oil., Pour over salad and add crushed Top Ramen noodles.

title: Date Roll
directions: Melt margarine and marshmallows in pan over low heat., Chop dates and nuts., Add to margarine-marshmallow mixture., Spread about 1 cup graham cracker crumbs on wax paper., Shape mixture into long roll., Lay on graham crackers and roll up., Chill; slice thin.

title: Party Cheese Ball
directions: Let cream cheese soften at room temperature for about 1 hour. Using plastic gloves, mix cream cheese, ham or turkey (use as much as desired), green onions, red pepper and Worcestershire sauce; mix well and form into a ball. Roll in pecans until covered and store in refrigerator. Serve with your favorite crackers.

title: Frosty Orange Nog Without Ice Cream
directions: Place ingredients in blender and blend until smooth.

title: Yummy Hot Fudge Sauce
directions: Heat milk and sugar to rolling boil in 2-quart saucepan, stirring constantly., Boil and stir 1 minute., Add chocolate and salt., Stir until chocolate melts, then beat with rotary beater until smooth., Remove from heat and stir in butter and vanilla. Keeps well in jar in refrigerator (if the family doesn't find it).

title: Strawberry Salad
directions: Dissolve jello in water and stir in strawberries until thawed. Add a little water., Add bananas., Pour half of this mixture in a pan., Chill until firm., Spread evenly with the sour cream., Pour remaining jello on top., Chill until firm and cut in squares., Top with dollops of sour cream., Serves 6.

title: Meat Loaf
directions: Mix well and shape into loaf; cook in covered pan at 350° for 1 hour., Last 10 minutes, remove foil and let meat brown.

title: Spaghetti Fruit Salad
directions: In a saucepan, combine sugar, eggs, lemon juice and salt. Cook and stir over medium heat until temperature reaches 160° until mixture is thickened. Cool completely. Cook spaghetti according to package directions. Drain and rinse in cold water. Place in a large bowl. Drain pineapple, reserving juice. Pour juice over the spaghetti. Stir in apples. Toss gently. Drain. Stir in the egg mixture. Add pineapple. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Fold in whipped topping just before serving. Garnish with walnuts and cherries.

title: Rita'S Banana Crush(Punch)
directions: Dissolve sugar in water., Add juice and bananas (mashed or put in blender)., Put in 7-Up that's been chilled.

title: Baked Apple And Carrot Casserole(Low-Fat!)
directions: Place half of the sliced apples in a buttered casserole dish. Cover with half of the carrot slices., Combine dry ingredients; sprinkle half of the mix over carrots., Repeat the layers; pour orange juice over the top., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes., Serves 6.

title: Pumpkin Pie
directions: Preheat oven to 450°., Bake pie crust 7 minutes., Remove from oven., Reduce oven temperature to 325°., In medium bowl, combine milk, light brown sugar, cognac, light corn syrup, pumpkin pie spice and salt., Add canned pumpkin and beaten eggs., Blend well. Slowly pour pumpkin mixture into prepared pie shell., Bake in a 325° oven until filling is barely set in the center, about 40 minutes., Cool., Garnish with whipped cream, if desired., Makes 8 servings.

title: Cauliflower Chowder
directions: Wash cauliflower and, separate into flowerets; set aside., In a large saucepan, melt butter., Saute onion until soft and transparent., Stir in garlic., Saute briefly, being careful not to burn., Stir in rice and coat with butter., Add pepper to broth; bring to a boil., Lower heat to simmer., Leave uncovered and cook 20 minutes., Add cauliflower; cover., Simmer 5 to 10 minutes until cauliflower is just tender., Sprinkle with cheese and parsley. Serve hot from the pot., Serve in wide rimmed soup bowls., Add extra cheese, if desired., Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Favorite Christmas Candy
directions: Combine all ingredients in bowl., Mix well., Shape into 2 logs; wrap in foil., Store in refrigerator., Cut into slices. Yields 4 dozen.

title: Forgotten Cookies
directions: Beat whites until stiff., Add salt, sugar and vanilla., Fold in chocolate chips and nuts., Spoon onto cookie sheet covered with brown paper., Bake at 375° for 1 minute., Turn oven off., Leave in oven 1 hour or overnight., Do not open oven until finished.

title: No Sugar Apricot Cookies(Diabetic)
directions: Sift flour and salt., Put cream cheese and butter in a bowl and blend., Add sifted ingredients; blend and cover., Chill., Heat oven to 350°., Divide dough into small portions., Roll on floured board about 1/8 inch thick and 3 inches square., Place a scant tablespoonful of preserves in center of dough and fold 2 opposite corners to center., Pinch and seal., Place on ungreased cookie sheet 2 inches apart., Bake 20 minutes until edges are lightly browned.

title: Pineapple Dessert
directions: Save 1/3 for topping., Put in 9 x 12-inch pan and cook for 5 minutes at 350°., Chill.

title: Sarah Circle Christmas Shrimp Casserole
directions: Put 1/2 crumbs in casserole., Add shrimp, mushrooms and 1/2 cheese., Top with remainder of bread and cheese., Beat eggs slightly., Add seasonings and milk; mix., Pour over the casserole. Bake at 325° for 45 to 50 minutes., Makes 5 to 6 servings., (May be prepared ahead of time and refrigerated.)

title: Hawaiian-Style Chicken
directions: Combine flour, salt and pepper; dredge chicken pieces., Heat oil in large skillet; add chicken and brown well on both sides. Turn chicken skin side up and add water., Bring to a boil; cover and simmer 30 minutes., Place chicken on platter and keep warm. Add vegetables to skillet., Bring to a full boil over medium heat, separating vegetables with fork., Stir until sauce cubes are blended., Reduce heat; cover and simmer 3 minutes., Stir in catsup and serve over chicken., Makes 3 servings.

title: Angel Biscuits
directions: Dissolve yeast in warm water; let stand 5 minutes., Combine flour and next 4 ingredients; make a well in center of mixture. Add yeast mixture, oil and buttermilk; stir until dry ingredients are moistened., Turn dough out onto a lightly floured surface; roll to 1/2-inch thickness., Cut with a 2-inch biscuit cutter; place on ungreased baking sheets., Cover; let rise in a warm place (85°) free from drafts, 1 hour., Bake at 400° for 15 minutes or until lightly browned., Yields 24 (100 calories per biscuit).

title: Cowboy Potatoes
directions: Bake potatoes., Let cool., Peel and cube., In large skillet, fry bacon., Remove bacon and allow to cool, then crumble., Saute onions and peppers in bacon drippings., Add potatoes and stir, heating thoroughly., Add bacon last., Serve while hot.

title: Apple Cake
directions: Mix and pour into a tube pan and bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Peanut Velvet Frosting
directions: Heat butter over low heat until golden brown., Remove from heat., Beat in sugar, milk, vanilla and salt., Blend in Jif. Frosts one 9 x 13-inch cake.

title: Scandinavian Cucumbers
directions: Stir together sour cream, sugar, parsley, vinegar, onion and dill., Fold in cucumbers; cover and chill for 2 hours.

title: Coconut Bananas
directions: Cut bananas into 1-inch pieces., Place lemon juice, sour cream and coconut in separate bowls., Dip bananas in lemon juice., Roll in sour cream and then in coconut, making sure all sides are coated., Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate several hours or overnight., Makes about 24 pieces.

title: Never Fail Dumplings
directions: Mix all ingredients., Roll out; cut., Cook gently in boiling broth.

title: Quick Butter Cookies
directions: Mix oleo and other ingredients with a fork or fingers., Roll into balls about 1-inch., Place on cookie sheet and press with fork crisscross., Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.

title: Shrimp Sauce
directions: Cut onion, celery and carrots finely., Fry in oil until lightly brown., Add small amount of grated cheese, garlic and parsley., Add clean shrimp, tomatoes, tomato paste and 1/2 cup water., Cook until done., Use more water, if needed., Salt and pepper to taste., Serve over spaghetti.

title: A Popular Zucchini Bread
directions: Beat eggs until light and foamy., Add sugar, oil, zucchini and vanilla to eggs and mix lightly but well., Combine flour, salt, soda, baking powder and cinnamon, then add to the egg/zucchini mixture., Stir all until well blended, then add nuts and pour into two 9 x 5 x 3-inch greased loaf pans., Bake 1 hour in 350° oven. Remove pans from oven and cool on a rack.

title: Posh Squash Casserole
directions: Cook squash until tender., Drain well; beat eggs and add all ingredients to eggs., Pour into buttered baking dish and dot with butter or top with bread crumbs., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: New Version Apple Crisp
directions: Place apples in bottom of a 11 x 7-inch baking dish or pan. Sprinkle cinnamon and nutmeg over apples., Cover with slices of white loaf bread with crust removed., Mix sugar, margarine and egg., Pour over bread., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until brown.

title: Perfect Pie Crust
directions: Sift together flour, salt and baking soda. Cut in shortening until mixture looks like meal. Add buttermilk, mixing with a knife until dough cleans bowl of all flour. Chill.

title: Banana Fluff Cake
directions: Mix eggs, sugar and shortening together., Add vanilla, bananas, buttermilk and baking soda., Mix well., Add baking powder, flour, salt and nuts., Beat until fluffy., Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes in a 9 x 13-inch pan., Cool., Mix 1 package of banana instant pudding according to box directions., Spread over cake. Spread Cool Whip over this., Sprinkle with nuts.

title: Strawberry Rhubarb Salad
directions: Cook rhubarb in water for 8 to 10 minutes., Remove and add Jell-O, sugar and juice., Chill slightly., Fold in apple and nuts.

title: Microwave Peanut Brittle
directions: In a 1 1/2-quart casserole; stir together peanuts, sugar, syrup and salt., Cook 8 minutes on High in microwave oven, stirring well after 4 minutes., Stir margarine and vanilla. Microwave 2 minutes longer., Add baking soda and quickly stir until light and foamy., Immediately pour into lightly greased baking sheet., Spread out.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
directions: Combine sweet potatoes, sugar, eggs, vanilla, milk, margarine and marshmallow cream with electric mixer until smooth., Spoon into a greased 2-quart shallow dish., Combine brown sugar, flour, 1/3 cup margarine and pecans., Sprinkle over top of casserole. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Old Fashion Pound Cake
directions: Cream Crisco and sugar well. Beat in eggs. Add flour, vanilla and coconut. Bake at 350° until done.

title: Strawberry Cheesecake Pudding
directions: Slice all but 4 berries., Mix cream cheese, milk and confectioners sugar until smooth., In 4 goblets, layer half of sliced berries, then half of cheese mixture., Repeat., Garnish with whole berries., Shave the chocolate bar., Top each goblet with 1 ounce shaved chocolate.

title: Oreo Cookie Delight
directions: Layer in a 9 x13 inch pan., 1st layer, put crushed cookies in dish and pour melted butter on top., 2nd layer, mix cream cheese and powdered sugar; spread on top of cookies., 3rd layer, sliced strawberries., 4th layer, pineapple. 5th layer sliced bananas. Top with Cool whip.

title: Christmas Morning Breakfast Casserole
directions: Scramble eggs and set, aside., Fry bacon and set aside. Fry hash browns and set aside.

title: Microwave Peanut Brittle
directions: Stir peanuts, sugar, syrup and salt together in a deep bowl. Cook on High 4 minutes., Stir candy so all sugar is mixed and continue cooking on High for 3 more minutes., Add butter and vanilla to syrup, blending well., Cook on High 1 to 2 minutes., Add soda and stir well until light and foamy., Pour immediately onto lightly buttered surface., Spread, cool and break into pieces. Store in an airtight container., Can use roasted, salted peanuts. Omit salt and add peanuts after the first 4 minutes of cooking.

title: Frozen Cranberry Salad
directions: Drain pineapple thoroughly; reserve syrup., Add enough water to make 1 cup syrup., Combine with sugar and cranberries and bring to full boil., Remove from heat., Drain cranberries and reserve syrup. Combine drained cranberries, pineapple, banana, pears and lemon juice and chill., Melt butter and blend in cornstarch., Add cranberry syrup and stir over medium heat until it boils and thickens., Reduce heat and stir a little hot mixture into egg. Return to hot mixture, stirring constantly., Cook over low heat 3 minutes., Cool to lukewarm., Fold fruit, marshmallows and whipped cream into cool mixture., Freeze., Can be frozen in muffin tins and used as needed., Will thaw quickly for eating.

title: Barbecue Buns
directions: In a large bowl, thoroughly mix 2 cups flour, dry milk solids, sugar, salt and yeast., Add oleo., Gradually add tap water to dry ingredients and beat 2 minutes at medium speed of electric mixer, scraping bowl occasionally., Add 3/4 cup flour., Beat at high speed 2 minutes, scraping bowl occasionally., Stir in enough additional flour to make a stiff dough., Turn out onto lightly floured board; knead until smooth and elastic (8 to 10 minutes)., Place in greased bowl, turning to grease top., Cover; let rise in warm place, free from draft, until doubled in bulk, about 45 minutes.

title: Spinach Balls
directions: Drain spinach (squeeze dry) and combine with other ingredients., Put bowl in freezer until hard enough to roll., Roll out into 1-inch balls and put on cookie sheet in freezer., After frozen, they can be stored in bags., Cook at 350° for approximately 20 minutes (until golden brown).

title: Sherry'S Soft And Chewy Chocolate Chip Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., Sift together flour, baking soda and salt and set aside., Combine butter or shortening, sugar, brown sugar, vanilla and water., Beat until creamy., Beat in eggs., Add flour mixture; mix well., Stir in chocolate chips and nuts., Drop by well rounded teaspoonfuls on greased cookie sheet., Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Tasty Cake
directions: Mix all ingredient together and pour into a greased and floured jelly roll pan., Bake 15 minutes at 350°., Spread peanut butter immediately from the oven; cool in refrigerator., Melt chocolate chips in a double boiler., Spread over cooled cake. Cool in refrigerator.

title: Raspberry Jelly Without The Raspberries
directions: Wash the tomatoes and cut out blemishes. Cut tomatoes into quarters (leave skins on) and place in a blender (or equivalent); liquify. Place the tomato liquid in a saucepan; add sugar and boil 5 minutes. Add 1 package berry jello and mix well. Place in hot jars. Jars may be sealed with paraffin or rings. It is recommended that the finished product be either frozen or kept in the refrigerator. I use paraffin and rings and leave it at room temperature if the rings seal.

title: Sweet-N-Sour Meatballs
directions: Cook meatballs as directed (see recipe)., Mix brown sugar and cornstarch in skillet., Add meatballs; stir in pineapple (with syrup), vinegar and soy sauce., Heat to boiling, stirring occasionally., Reduce heat., Add meatballs., Cover; simmer, stirring occasionally, for 10 minutes., Stir in green pepper. Cover; simmer until crisp-tender, 5 minutes.

title: Raisin Cookies
directions: Boil raisins and water for 2 minutes., Cool and add soda to raisin mixture., Add remaining ingredients to raisin mixture., Drop on greased cookie sheet., Bake at 375° for 7 to 10 minutes.

title: Smothered Hamburger
directions: One egg and 1/2 cup bread crumbs can be added to stretch hamburger.

title: Cocoa Fudge
directions: Combine cocoa, sugar and salt in large saucepan., Add milk gradually., Mix thoroughly; bring to bubbly boil on high heat. Stir continuously., Reduce to medium heat; continue boiling, without stirring, until mixture reaches 232° or until a small amount of mixture forms a soft ball stage when dropped into cold water., Be sure bulb of thermometer is not resting on bottom of saucepan., Remove saucepan from heat., Add margarine and vanilla to mixture., Do not stir., Allow fudge to cool at room temperature until it reaches 110°., Add peanut butter., Nuts are optional. Beat by hand or with electric mixer until fudge thickens and it loses some of its gloss., Quickly pour and spread fudge in lightly buttered 8 x 8 x 2-inch glass dish., Cut into squares., Makes about 3 dozen squares.

title: Poppy Seed Dressing
directions: Mix sugar, mustard, salt and vinegar., Add oil slowly; beat constantly until thick (or use blender)., Add poppy seed and beat a few minutes longer., Delicious over fruit.

title: Seasoned Buttery Vegetables And Noodles
directions: Cook pasta according to package directions and drain. Meanwhile, in large saucepan, melt butter., Add broccoli, green pepper and mushrooms., Cook just until tender., Add hot pasta and remaining ingredients, heat thoroughly, stirring occasionally. Sprinkle with cheese, if desired., Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Broccoli And Ham Casserole
directions: Cook broccoli according to package directions., Drain., Chop into 1 1/2-inch pieces., Melt 1 1/2 tablespoons butter in a saucepan., Add flour and salt; cook 1 minute., Add milk., Cook, stirring constantly, until thickened., Place broccoli in a 1 1/2-quart buttered casserole., Combine remaining ingredients except the bread crumbs., Pour over broccoli., Pour white sauce over all., Combine 2 tablespoons melted butter with bread crumbs. Put crumbs on top., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes or until bubbly. Green beans or asparagus may be substituted for broccoli.

title: Alsatian Pork With Sauerkraut
directions: Cook bacon and onion in a skillet until bacon is crisp, stir constantly., Stir in sauerkraut and brown sugar, add potatoes and apples., In a cheese cloth bag tie peppercorns, juniper berries, cloves, parsley and bay leaves; add to sauerkraut., Add pork chops and smoked kielbasa pieces, pour chicken broth in, stir well., Heat to boiling, then reduce heat, cover and simmer until meat is done, potatoes are tender for about 45 minutes., When done remove spice bag., With a slotted spoon remove sauerkraut, potatoes and apples to a large platter., Arrange meat and kielbasa in the center of the platter., Serve with fresh sourdough bread.

title: Methodist Baked Beans
directions: Brown, ground, beef and onion;	drain good., Mix ground beef, onion,, sugar, and pork and beans.	Put in a long Pyrex dish., Put bacon, on top of beans and top with ketchup., Cook until bacon is cooked., Bake in oven at 400°.

title: Stir-Fry Lemon-Honey Pork
directions: Cut pork into thin strips., Dredge in the flour., Cook quickly but thoroughly in the hot oil., Remove meat from skillet., Add remaining ingredients to drippings and cook 2 minutes until crisp but tender., Stir pork strips in and serve.

title: Salad
directions: Cut ingredients and marinate overnight in Kraft Italian dressing.

title: Stuffed Green Peppers
directions: Put ground beef, rice and peppers in green peppers in 2 inches of water and cook covered for 1 hour.

title: Spoon Corn Bread
directions: Preheat oven to 450°., Combine corn meal, shortening and 2 cups of milk in a pan over medium heat., Bring mixture just to a boil, stirring constantly., Blend beaten eggs, salt and remaining milk., Add to corn meal mixture., Mix well., Stir in baking powder., Pour into greased 1 1/2 to 2-quart casserole., Bake 25 to 30 minutes., Serve hot with butter.

title: Mexican Chicken
directions: Spread chips in casserole dish., Place boned chicken on top of chips., Saute onion and pepper in butter until tender., Add all other ingredients except for the cheese., Mix well., Pour over chicken., Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes. Top with cheese the last few minutes.

title: Murlean'S Pretzel Salad
directions: Mix crushed pretzels, margarine and 3 tablespoons sugar and press into a 13 x 9-inch pan., Chill.

title: Summer Cake
directions: Bake cake as per directed in a large oblong pan., While hot, cover with crushed pineapple.

title: Beef Enchiladas
directions: Brown ground meat with chopped onions, chili powder, ground comino and salt., Drain., On the side, pour about 1/2 can Wolfe's chili into a bowl or Pyrex pie dish; add small amount of water (make it a little runny); stir and warm in a microwave., Dip flour or corn tortillas into warm chili; add a couple of spoons of meat, onions and cheese, then roll it up and place into an oblong pan. When all are rolled up, pour any remaining chili on top; add cheese and onions., Cook at 400° to 425° until cheese melts.

title: Fruit Rolls
directions: Crush wafers to fine crumbs., Add to nuts and chopped cherries., Mix well in milk., Pour coconut on waxed paper., Form rolls by rolling and shaping on coconut., Wrap in foil. Refrigerate.

title: Sausage Casserole
directions: Layer the sausage and cheese in order in the pie shell., Beat the eggs and milk together., Add to the pie shell., Sprinkle with sharp cheese., Bake for 35 minutes in a 350° oven.

title: Potato Salad
directions: Boil potatoes until tender., Cut into chunks., Add all ingredients; mix well., Chill at least 2 hours.

title: Easy Spareribs
directions: Place all ingredients in a heavy pan and cook 45 minutes (high heat)., Stir, every 10 minutes until all sauce is gone. Turn to low heat; fat becomes oil.

title: Zucchini, Carrot And Tomato Casserole
directions: Cook carrots in boiling water for 5 minutes., Drain., Combine carrots, zucchini and tomatoes in rectangular dish., In saucepan, stir cornstarch, milk, 1/2 cup cheese and butter until smooth and thick., Pour sauce over vegetables., Sprinkle with remaining cheese and almonds., Bake at 375° for 30 to 40 minutes., Serves 6.

title: Beef Casserole(Chinese Style)
directions: Cook beef until brown and crumbly., Turn into a 1 1/2-quart casserole., Arrange thawed peas over meat, then cover with celery. Mix together soup, cream, seasonings and onion., Pour over celery. Sprinkle with chips or flakes., Bake at 375° for 30 minutes or until hot and bubbly.

title: Chewy Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Sift flour, soda, salt and cinnamon together; set aside. Cream the sugar, shortening, molasses and eggs together., Add flour mixture; mix well., Stir in oats, nuts and raisins., Drop by teaspoonfuls onto greased cookie sheet., Bake at 400° for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Easy Apple Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Combine apples and sugar in mixing bowl., Let stand 10 minutes., Blend oil, vanilla and egg with the apples, then combine the dry ingredients and mix in well., Stir in the raisins., Pour into greased 8-inch square cake pan., Bake 35 to 40 minutes., Yields 9 servings.

title: Wassail
directions: Mix all ingredients., Place cloves and cinnamon in small cloth and tie., Drop in cloth bag of spices; heat to boiling and boil 10 minutes., Simmer 20 minutes., Heat before serving.

title: Party Mix
directions: In a small saucepan, melt margarine; stir in Worcestershire sauce and seasoned nuts, cereals and pretzels., Pour margarine, sauce over mixture., Mix lightly about every 20 minutes., Spread out on absorbent paper or heavy brown paper to cool., Keep crisp by storing in airtight container.

title: Scorcher
directions: In a large kettle, fry meat in oil until dark brown., Then add 1-quart of water. Cover and simmer two hours., Add remaining ingredients, except flour and cornmeal., Cook at gentle simmer for 30 minutes, removing bay leaves after 15 minutes., Make a paste of flour, cornmeal and water., Stir into mixture, cooking another five minutes at simmer while stirring often., Serve immediately with a fire extinguisher at your right elbow.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
directions: Mix oil, sugar, eggs, apples, nuts and vanilla., Combine dry ingredients and add to oil mixture., Put in greased and floured Bundt pan., Bake at 325° for, 1 hour or until done.

title: Zucchini Casserole
directions: Chunk squash., Par-boil, drain and mash., Leave skin on., Put in baking dish., Beat egg yolks lightly., Add all ingredients except egg whites., Beat egg whites until stiff., Fold into vegetable mixture., Bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour., Makes 8 servings.

title: Coke Salad
directions: Heat pineapple juice and cherry juice together., Mix Jell-O with juice., Cool thoroughly (this is very important)., Add Cokes, pineapple, nuts and cherries., Pour in molds or Pyrex pan and chill until firm.

title: Lemon Sponge Pie
directions: Mix in order given and our into unbaked pie crust. Bake in moderate oven 25 minutes., You may use an orange instead of lemon; it's very good.

title: Chi Chi'S Mild Salsa
directions: Cut up stewed tomatoes and combine in saucepan with onions, fresh tomato, salt and pepper. Bring just to a boil. Boil hard 1 minute and remove at once from heat. Put half of mixture through blender just to mince fine, but not to puree. Return to remaining half of mixture. Cool and refrigerate in tightly covered container to use within a few weeks. Freezes well to use within 6 months.

title: Curried Fruit
directions: Melt butter., Add sugar and curry powder., Drain fruit well. Arrange in a 1 1/2-quart casserole., Add butter mixture., Bake for 1 hour at 325°., Serves 12.

title: Stuffed Clams
directions: Mix together bread crumbs, celery, green pepper and onion. Add lemon juice and clam juice and mix well., Season with garlic salt, oregano and pepper and mix., Add this mixture to the chopped clams., Spoon into cleaned clam shells and top with bacon pieces. Bake at 350° until bacon is crisp., Serve with lemon wedges. Serves 8.

title: Mary'S Cheese Grits
directions: Cook grits., Add cheese, butter and garlic., Stir until blended., Beat 3 eggs in measuring cup., Add half and half to eggs to measure 1 3/4 cups total., Add to grits., Put in casserole. Top with cheese., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes., Serves 10.

title: Herbed Chicken Bake
directions: Prepare rice mix using package directions., Season chicken with salt and pepper in skillet., Brown slowly in butter., Spoon rice into 1 1/2-quart casserole., Top with chicken, skin side up., Add soup to skillet., Slowly add Sauterne, stirring until smooth., Add remaining ingredients., Bring to boil., Pour over chicken., Cover and bake at 350° for 25 minutes., Uncover and bake 15 to 20 minutes or until tender., Serves 6.

title: Zucchini Muffins
directions: Combine eggs, oil, vanilla and zucchini. Add and stir until moistened sugar, flour, cinnamon, soda, salt, baking powder and chopped nuts. Grease muffin tins. Fill 2/3 full. Bake in preheated 400° oven for 18 minutes.

title: Homemade Custard
directions: Combine all ingredients and cook over medium heat until it comes to a full boil., Pour into a 9x13 pan lined with vanilla wafers or crackers.

title: Chinese Icicles(Cookies)
directions: Using high speed of the electric mixer, cream butter, sugar and vanilla until soft and creamy., Sift together salt and flour; add gradually to butter mixture., Blend well on low speed., Add noodles, stirring in by hand., Chill until firm., Pinch off small pieces of dough and shape into fingers., Bake at 350° for 10 minutes., Cool; dust with powdered sugar., Yield:, 5 to 6 dozen icicles.

title: German Potato Salad
directions: Cook bacon until crisp; drain and reserve 1/4 cup fat from bacon., Cook onion in the fat until tender., Blend flour, sugar, salt and celery seed; add vinegar and 1 cup water and cook until thickened., Add bacon, potatoes and eggs.

title: Dump Cake
directions: Empty can of pineapple with juice in a 9 x 13-inch ungreased pan., Spread pie filling over pineapple., Sprinkle dry cake mix over pie filling., Sprinkle chopped nuts over cake mix. Generously dot with margarine., Never stir mixture., Bake at 350° for 45 to 60 minutes until top is brown.

title: Zucchini Parmesan(Can Substitute Eggplant For Zucchini)
directions: On wax paper, combine bread crumbs with oregano., Cut zucchini lengthwise., Brush with mayo; coat with crumb mixture., In 2 1/2-quart casserole dish, arrange zucchini, crumb side up., Cook, covered with wax paper on High for 12 to 15 minutes, until tender, rotating halfway through cooking time., In small bowl, cook spaghetti sauce on High for 1 to 3 minutes, until hot., Meanwhile sprinkle 1 1/2 cups Mozzarella cheese over zucchini., Spoon sauce over cheese; top with remaining Mozzarella cheese and Parmesan cheese., Cook on High for 2 to 4 minutes until cheese melts.

title: Green Cheese Cake
directions: Cream Cheese:, Mix above ingredients until smooth., Fold gently into whipped cream.

title: Squash Casserole
directions: Mix 1 stick of margarine (melted) with the first 5 ingredients., Mix half of dressing with rest of ingredients. Leave half of dressing to top the mixture., Bake for 25 minutes at 350°.

title: Hamburger And Potato Casserole
directions: Season meat with salt, brown in hot fat., Arrange alternate layers, onions, potatoes and meat in a 2-quart casserole., Pour soup over layers., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes. Sprinkle cheese over casserole about 10 minutes before it's done, if desired. Makes 6 servings.

title: Two-In-One Bake
directions: Cook cauliflower in 1-inch boiling salt water until tender-crisp; drain., Separate into flowerets., Start heating oven to 350°., Combine soup and milk in a 10 x 6 x 2-inch baking dish., Add cauliflowerets, ham, savory and 1/2 cup cheese. Sprinkle 1/2 cup cheese on top., Bake for 30 minutes., Serves 4.

title: Fresh Key Lime Pie
directions: Pie Shell:, Mix cracker crumbs, butter and sugar in bowl. Press into pie pan to form crust., Bake for 10 minutes at 350°; cool.

title: 3 Bean Salad
directions: Fry together bacon and hamburger; drain., Add 3 cans of beans and juice., Mix with onion, catsup, brown sugar, prepared mustard and vinegar., Mix together in casserole dish., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Sensational Beef Stroganoff
directions: Slice beef across the grain into very thin strips., In skillet over high heat in 1 tablespoon margarine, cook 1/2 of beef and 1/2 of onion until beef is no longer pink and onion is tender., Set aside and repeat with remaining margarine, beef and onion., Return meat mixture to skillet., Stir in soup and paprika., Heat through, stirring occasionally., Reduce heat to very low., Stir in sour cream., Gently heat through., Serve on hot noodles.

title: Pecan Tarts
directions: Boil together the brown sugar and hot water for 10 minutes. Cool and add the butter, flour, milk, salt and eggs., Cook all together in a double boiler until thick and smooth, stirring constantly., Cool and add 1 teaspoon vanilla extract and 1/2 cup pecan meats, chopped., Put 2 tablespoons of mixture in prepared (baked) tart shells., Garnish with 1/2 cup whipped cream, sweetened with 1 tablespoon of powdered sugar and put a whole pecan on top., Fills about 1 dozen shells., Delicious!

title: Sara'S Brownies
directions: Mix all together and bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan for 45 minutes at 325°.

title: Spaghetti Pizza Style
directions: Cook spaghetti and drain., Mix with egg and milk., Spread over bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan., Top with spaghetti sauce, grated cheese and pepperoni or other toppings., Bake at 350° for 1/2 hour.

title: Turkey Tetrazzini
directions: Cook noodles and drain., Combine soup, milk, water and cheese and heat to boiling, stirring., Combine first 8 ingredients in 9 x 13-inch baking dish., Top with bread crumbs, Parmesan and parsley. Bake at 375° for 30 minutes.

title: Microwave Fudge
directions: Microwave until butter melts; take out and stir fast!, Put into pan., Let cool, then cut.

title: Spoon Rolls
directions: Mix in order listed., Fill section of a greased muffin pan half full., Bake at 450°., Dough will keep in refrigerator for 5 days.

title: Tex-Mex Chicken Casserole
directions: Mix chicken broth, soups, chili powder, Ro-Tel, onions and bell pepper., Place half of the chicken in casserole dish., Pour half of the soup mixture on top., Crumble half of the Doritos on top. Layer again in this order., Top with grated cheese., Bake at 375° for 30 minutes., Serve topped with sour cream and black olives. Makes 1 large or 2 small casseroles.

title: Cottage Cheese And Sausage Biscuits
directions: Grease muffin pan and press biscuit half in pan cups up the side as far as you can., Divide sausage and place on dough., Mix cheese cottage cheese eggs and pepper; pour over sausage and dough., Bake 375° 15 to 20 minutes., Wipe muffin pan, grease and make the rest of the muffins.

title: Cantaloupe Rings
directions: Cut about 1 1/2 inches from tops of melons., Scoop out seeds. Wipe cavity with paper towels., Drain pineapple, reserving syrup. Add water to syrup to measure 1 1/4 cups., Heat syrup-water mixture to boiling., Pour over gelatin., Stir to dissolve., Cool to lukewarm., Stir in milk and pineapple., Chill to consistency of unbeaten egg whites., Spoon into cantaloupe cavities., (Depending on cavity size, there may be enough gelatin mixture to fill a third cantaloupe.), Chill in upright position at least 3 hours, or until firm., Slice into 1-inch rings to serve., Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Sour Cream Banana Pudding
directions: Mix the last 4 ingredients (except for 1/3 of the whipped topping)., Layer wafers, bananas and mixture., Top with remaining whipped topping., Keep refrigerated.

title: Oatmeal Drop Cookies
directions: Mix shortening with brown sugar cream., Add egg., Sift together soda, salt, flour, milk rolled oats., Finally add raisins, nuts, vanilla., Bake at 375 till golden brown.

title: Corn And Tomatoes
directions: Cook all ingredients together., On the farm, we used fresh corn and tomatoes., This was one of Claude's favorites.

title: Potato Soup
directions: Slice onion about 1/8-inch thick then chop slices finely., In a pan add about 2 tablespoons of butter and the onions., Saute until transparent., Add the chicken broth., Dice the potatoes and add to the broth., (The potatoes should double the volume of liquid in the pan.), Cook until potatoes are tender., While still on the heat, mash the potatoes., Cook a little longer and mash again., At this point you can add the sour cream and serve.

title: Punch Bowl Cake
directions: Bake cake according to package instructions., Mix jello with 2 cups boiling water., Add frozen strawberries to jello and break up. Add 1/4 cup cold water and stir., Jello has to be jelled until a little thick.

title: Popover Tacos
directions: Brown ground beef with onion in skillet, stirring until ground beef is crumbly; drain., Stir in taco seasoning mix, tomato sauce and water; mix well., Simmer for 10 minutes, stirring frequently.

title: Pineapple Nut Bread
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Grease 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2 1/2-inch loaf pan.

title: Taco Casserole
directions: Brown meat with salt, pepper and onion., Drain., Add taco mix and 2 cups water., Cook on medium heat until mixture is hot., Let simmer on very low heat, stirring occasionally, until mixture is thick., Add drained corn and olives (if desired); heat., Grate each kind of cheese separately., Spray baking dish with vegetable spray. Fill each separated shell with small amount of pepper, cheese and meat., Roll shells and lay in dish (side by side) and pour rest of meat sauce over rolled shells., Cover the tops of shells with grated cheese (Cracker Barrel)., Bake at 400° for 5 to 10 minutes or until cheese is melted.

title: Punch
directions: Mix, the, first, 5 ingredients together., Add sugar and water mixture., Freeze, in, quart containers., To serve add 1 quart of punch mix to 1 (2 liter) bottle of 7-Up., Do not use ginger ale.

title: Oriental Eggplant
directions: *This will not work with the round American type eggplants.

title: New Potato Dish
directions: Boil new potatoes until partly cooked., Remove from pan and cut potatoes into halves., Pour melted butter over potatoes in a baking dish and sprinkle with dry Italian dressing., Finish baking until done., Do not cover.

title: Pumpkin Cake
directions: Step 1:, Remove 1 cup cake mix and cut in 1/2 stick margarine with 1 teaspoon cinnamon., Set aside.

title: Pepper Jelly
directions: Blend peppers and vinegar., Add with sugar and boil over medium heat for 10 minutes., Remove from heat., Add pectin., Boil for 1 minute., Add food coloring; strain out pepper pieces, if desired. Can in 4 pint canning jars., Serve over cream cheese with crackers.

title: Twinkie Cake
directions: Split Twinkies long wise and lay in cake pan, filling up., Mix vanilla pudding and milk together and set aside., Mix cream cheese, sour cream and Cool Whip., Add to pudding and spread over Twinkies. Top with cherry pie filling.

title: Mill Road Acres Beer Bread
directions: Combine all ingredients., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes., Best when just baked.

title: Pizza Sandwich
directions: In a frypan with a small amount of melted margarine, grill 2 slices of sandwich bread on one side only of each slice., Then remove one slice from pan and set aside.

title: Corn Pudding
directions: Combine all ingredients in a blender and mix for 10 seconds at high speed., Pour into a greased 1-quart baking dish., Bake at 375° for 45 minutes.

title: Beef Nachos
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Brown ground beef; drain., Put into mixing bowl., Add salsa, chili powder, Miracle Whip and corn., Layer 1/2 meat in dish., Add 1/2 chips and cheese on top., Layer rest of ingredients.

title: Cherry Winks
directions: Measure and sift dry ingredients., Beat until light and fluffy the sugar, shortening, eggs, milk and vanilla., Blend in the dry ingredients., Add nuts, dates and cherries., Blend well and chill. Shape into small balls., Roll in crushed corn flakes., Place on greased baking sheet., Press 1/4 maraschino cherry in each., Bake in moderate oven (375°) for 10 minutes.

title: Pork Sausage Spread
directions: Brown and drain the sausage., Add remaining ingredients. Spread on party rye bread., Bake for 10 minutes at 350°.

title: 7-Up Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients and pour into 2 well-greased and floured cake pans., Frost with 7-Up frosting.

title: Daffodil Dip
directions: Cut the white of the egg up into the cream cheese and salad dressing., Keep the egg yolk separate and mix all the rest together., After that's done, smash the egg yolk and sprinkle on top., If you want a big dish, use 8 ounces cream cheese and 2 hard-boiled eggs.

title: Oil Pie Crust
directions: Mix flour, wheat germ and salt., Pour water and oil in all at once., Stir with a fork., Roll dough between sheets of waxed paper., Bake 15 minutes at 450° (prick with fork before baking).

title: Next Best Thing To Robert Redford Cake
directions: Mix together flour, nuts and butter and put in 13 x 9 x 2 pan. Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Broken Glass Cake
directions: Dissolve each (cherry, orange and lime) package jello in 1 1/2 cups hot water and place in long dishes., When jelled, cut into small squares., Dissolve 1 package plain gelatin in 1/4 cup cold water., Add to 1 cup hot pineapple juice., Chill to a syrup., Whip 1 pint whipped cream; add 1/2 cup sugar., Mix well the whipped cream, juice mixture and jello squares., Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan lined with crust.

title: Sour-Creamed Potatoes
directions: Mix ingredients together., Pour into casserole dish., Bake at 350° until hot.

title: My Best Fruit Cake
directions: Mix all together and let stand overnight before baking. Bake at 250° for, 3, 1/2, hours., Makes	5, pounds., This, was copied from an original recipe sheet of Mother Reeves.

title: Beef Burgundy
directions: Heat oven to 325°., Grease baking dish., Place beef in baking dish., Toss with gravy and flour., Set aside., Spray 12-inch skillet and cook mushrooms, celery, onion and garlic about 6 minutes or until tender, but crisp., Transfer to baking dish along with carrots, wine, beef broth, thyme, marjoram, salt and pepper. Bake, covered, about 1 hour and 15 minutes., Uncover to stir occasionally until beef is tender and vegetables are cooked through., Replace cover after each stirring., Makes 6 servings.

title: Tuna Burgers
directions: Mix all ingredients., Fill buns; wrap in tinfoil., Heat in preheated oven for 15 minutes.

title: Crab Dip
directions: Let cream cheese set out until it's room temperature., Mix crabmeat and cream cheese; shape into a ball., Pour cocktail sauce over it and refrigerate until you're ready to serve., Serve with crackers.

title: Fried Corn
directions: In a 12-inch skillet add 1/2 cup Crisco to get it to the melting stage., Add 1 or 2 bags of corn with your 2 teaspoons salt and pepper, frying to let the whole kernel corn get golden brown.

title: Creamy Raspberry Ring
directions: Combine gelatin and water and cook over medium heat until dissolved., Beat cream cheese, sugar and vanilla until smooth. Add milk and softened gelatin; beat until mixed., Refrigerate until slightly thickened, about 15 minutes., Stir in cream cheese mixture until smooth; fold in whipped cream., Pour into ungreased mold.

title: German Schnitzel
directions: First, flatten meat to tenderize and make larger., (This can be done by pounding meat with the flat side of meat cleaver or plate edge.), Season with salt, pepper and garlic powder and spread with mustard., Dip meat in egg on both sides and then dip in bread crumbs., Melt margarine in skillet at medium-high heat., When margarine is hot, add meat and fry until brown on both sides., If egg is left over, scramble and place on top of meat.

title: Calico Beans
directions: Mix all ingredients except bacon in casserole., Top with bacon slices and bake 1 hour at 350°.

title: Cookie Bars
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Combine crumbs, cocoa, sugar and margarine., Press firmly on bottom of 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Pour Eagle Brand evenly over crust., Top evenly with remaining ingredients in order listed., Press down firmly., Bake for 25 to 30 minutes, or until lightly browned., Cool; chill thoroughly, if desired., Cut into bars., Store, loosely covered, at room temperature.

title: Cheddar Cheese Bread
directions: Mix, dry, ingredients., Combine egg, milk and water and stir into, dry, ingredients, until they are moistened., Spoon batter into, a, greased loaf pan (9 x 5 x 3-inches)., Bake at 350°, for 55, to 60 minutes., Cool 10 minutes before removing from pan.

title: Buttermilk Jello
directions: Mix first 3 ingredients in saucepan and heat until jello is dissolved., Set off and cool., Beat in Cool Whip and pour in dish.

title: Old-Fashioned Rice Pudding
directions: Combine milk, rice, pudding mix, raisins and egg in saucepan. Stir over medium heat until mixture just comes to a boil., Cool 5 minutes, stirring twice., Pour into dessert dishes or serving bowl., Sprinkle with cinnamon and nutmeg., Serve warm., Makes 10 servings.

title: Broccoli Cheese Soup
directions: Grate American cheese and set aside., Chop onion and saute in butter., Cook frozen broccoli in water., Combine onion and broccoli using all liquid., Add bouillon cube and stir until dissolved., Add garlic powder, dash of pepper, half and half and grated American cheese., Heat until cheese is melted, stirring constantly.

title: Oven-Fried "Chicken" Chimichangas
directions: Grind or chop "chicken"; add cheese and green chilies, set aside., Wrap tortillas in damp paper towels; microwave at High 15 seconds or until hot., Brush both sides of tortillas, one at a time, with vegetable oil (keep remaining tortillas warm)., Place a scant 1/2 cup of "chicken" mixture just below center of each tortilla., Fold in left and right sides of tortilla to partially enclose filling., Fold up bottom edge of tortilla; fold into a rectangle and secure with a wooden pick., Repeat with remaining tortillas and "chicken" mixture., Place on a lightly greased baking sheet., Bake at 425° for 10 minutes or until crisp and lightly browned., Serve with shredded lettuce, salsa and sour cream. Yields 4 servings.

title: Spinach Bites And Lemon Mayonnaise
directions: Lightly grease baking sheets., In a small bowl, mix spinach, stuffing mix, cheese, eggs, margarine, onion and nutmeg., Shape into walnut size balls., Place on baking sheets., Cover and refrigerate at least 4 hours or until ready to bake.

title: Spinach Mix
directions: Combine all ingredients., Add olive oil to moisten to taste. Use as filling for spinach turnovers (in roll mix dough) or excellent as: pizza topping, dip for raw vegetables, to spread on French bread or crackers, to stuff boneless chicken breasts or to toss with hot pasta.

title: Blackfoot Potato Soup With Sausage
directions: Slice sausage into 1/4-inch thick; brown over medium heat in Dutch oven or heavy kettle., Remove sausage with slotted spoon and reserve., Drain away excess fat., Add celery, onion, thyme and salt., Cook until onion is tender., Stir in flour., Cook 1 minute.

title: Kool-Aid Modeling Dough
directions: Mix flour, salt, cream of tartar, Kool-Aid and water in medium saucepan., Stir in oil., Adult should stir the mixture over medium heat for 3 to 5 minutes until mixture forms a ball in the center of the pan., Remove to a floured surface and knead for 1 minute. Store in the refrigerator in an airtight container.

title: Corn Dogs(Makes 8)
directions: Mix corn meal, flour, milk, egg and oil., Beat with fork. Roll hot dogs in flour, then roll in batter., Deep fry in oil until brown.

title: Oatmeal Chocolate Chip Cookies
directions: Mix together and bake at 375° for 5 minutes only.

title: Snow Flakes
directions: Melt chips in microwave 1 1/2 to 2 minutes or until melted. Pour into dry ingredients; mix together., Pour onto wax paper and let cool., Chocolate chips may be used also.

title: Wintertime Corn Pudding
directions: Mix all ingredients and pour into buttered casserole dish; sprinkle paprika on top., Bake at 375° for 20 minutes.

title: Pretzel Salad (Or Dessert)
directions: Mix ingredients and pat into a 9 x 13-inch baking dish (bottom only)., Bake at 400° for 8 minutes; cool., Whip together 8 ounces cream cheese and 3/4 cup sugar., Fold cheese and sugar into 8 ounces Cool Whip., Spread over pretzel crust., Top with fruit (peaches, strawberries, bananas, nectarines, cantaloupe works well, placed close together)., Cover fruit with a partially set 6 ounces of Jell-O., Refrigerate., Serves 12.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
directions: In 3-quart oblong baking dish, mix soup, milk, thyme and pepper., Stir in vegetables., Bake at 400° for 15 minutes or until mixture begins to bubble., Meanwhile, cut each biscuit into quarters., Remove dish from oven., Stir., Arrange biscuits over hot chicken., Bake 15 minutes until golden brown.

title: Oyster Cracker Snack Mix
directions: Mix and blend first 4 ingredients and blend well., Pour over the two packages of oyster crackers., Mix well and place in air-tight container for storage.

title: Three Fruit Jam
directions: Combine fruit and lemon juice in 4-quart saucepan., Cook, stirring until it is almost tender., Stir in sugar, powdered pectin, butter and food coloring., Bring to a rolling boil, stirring constantly., Boil for 10 to 12 minutes., Remove from heat and skim off foam., Ladle into sterilized jars, leaving 1/2-inch space at top., Seal with paraffin., Makes 8 (6 ounce) glasses.

title: Banana Bread
directions: Cream sugar and shortening; add eggs., Sift flour; measure and sift with salt, baking powder and soda., Add to first mixture., Add remaining ingredients., Pour into greased 5 x 10 x 3-inch loaf pan. Bake in 350° oven for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Bacon Cheddar Grilled Sourdough Bread
directions: Heat grill., Cut loaf into 1-inch slices., Lightly spread one side of each slice of bread with margarine., Place, margarine side down, on ungreased cookie sheet., Sprinkle cheese, bacon and parsley evenly on bread slices., When ready to barbecue, place slices, margarine side down, directly on gas grill over medium-high heat or on charcoal grill 4 to 6-inches from coals., Cook 4 to 6 minutes or until bottom of bread is toasted and cheese is melted. Makes 8 servings.

title: Party Cucumber Spread
directions: Press shredded cucumber between paper towels to remove excess moisture., Beat cream cheese until fluffy., Stir in cucumber and other ingredients., Spread between party rye or wheat bread, or as a spread for open-faced sandwiches.

title: Date Nut Bread
directions: Pour boiling water over dates, soda, salt and butter., Cool. Add eggs to sugar and then add other ingredients., Combine the 2 mixtures., Bake at 350° in greased and floured loaf pan for 1 hour or until done.

title: Chocolate Town Special Cake
directions: Cream sugar and shortening., Add eggs and vanilla, beating well., Sift together salt, flour, soda and cocoa., Add to creamed mixture with buttermilk., Mix well., Add boiling water; mix., Bake at 350° for 35 minutes or until done.

title: Peach Alexander
directions: Mix in blender and serve., This will make 4 to 6 servings.

title: Chess Pie Bars
directions: Combine first 3 ingredients and mix well., Press into a 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake at 375° for 10 minutes., Combine the last ingredients and beat well., Pour over crust in pan., Bake in 375° oven 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown., Cool, then cut into squares., Makes about 2 dozen.

title: "Fried" Pie Crust
directions: Mix well with pastry cutter; divide into balls large enough for 4-inch fried pie.

title: Veggie Surprise
directions: Put eggs, milk, corn bread mix and onion soup (one package) into blender container., Mix until blended.

title: Fruit Dip
directions: Mix above ingredients., Eat with your favorite fruit!

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Cook broccoli according to package directions, then drain well. In saucepan, melt margarine., Add a few onion flakes, flour and water., Blend and let boil a bit., Add Cheez Whiz, broccoli and eggs., Mix gently., Turn into buttered 1 1/2-quart casserole., Dot with cracker crumbs and/or crumbled croutons and 2 tablespoons margarine., Bake at 325° for 30 minutes.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Combine vegetables, chicken and seasoning; mix well., Stir in mayo to moisten., Spread mixture in 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Sprinkle cheese on top., Bake 45 minutes at 350°.

title: Smashed Potatoes
directions: first smash the potatoes., Mix the potatoes and the flower and the water., cook it for 40 menets., Put the potatoes on a plat and then put butter on it.

title: Almond Brownies
directions: Melt chocolate; set aside., Cream margarine and sugar., Beat in eggs and blend in chocolate, vanilla and flour., Add 1/2 almonds and spread in 8-inch pan., Sprinkle remaining almonds and bake at 325° for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Crunch
directions: *I've used cornflakes, Chex and Kix.

title: Pistachio Salad
directions: Do not drain pineapple., Stir into pudding mix., Fold in Cool Whip and marshmallows., You may add more pecans, if desired.

title: Chocolate Milk Shake
directions: Place the chocolate sauce, milk and ice cream in a blender. Blend until it turns a chocolate milk color. Pour in a cup. Top with whipped cream and sprinkles. Place the piece of chocolate on top of the whipped cream.

title: Baked Plum Tomatoes With Linguini
directions: In a 13 x 9-inch glass Pyrex dish, pour a layer of olive oil. Cut up about 10 plum ripe tomatoes in halves., Sprinkle on top lots of fresh garlic, salt and pepper, basil or spice and oregano (optional)., Bake in 350° oven until the tomatoes get a little soft or to the consistency you like (approximately 35 minutes). It doesn't look like tomato sauce., Cook up linguini and add to the Pyrex dish that the tomatoes are in., Toss and serve.

title: Chicken In Sour Cream
directions: Put chicken in a baking dish., Mix other three ingredients and pour over chicken., Bake at 350° for 1/2 hour to 45 minutes.

title: Pressure Cooker Swiss Steak
directions: Have butcher run meat through tenderizer. Cut steak in eight pieces., Coat with flour., Brown in cooker (uncovered), with small amount of hot oil., When completely brown on both sides, add a little salt and pepper., Add 1 1/4 cups water for 4-quart cooker (1 1/2 cups for 6 to 8-quart cooker)., Set pressure control for 10 pounds (both sizes)., After control starts to jiggle, cook for 35 minutes., Adjust heat for control to jiggle 1 to 3 times a minute. Cool cooker normally 5 minutes and then place under cold running water to reduce pressure., Recipe makes its own gravy., Serve with mashed potatoes and vegetables.

title: Meatless Mexican Cornbread
directions: Mix all ingredients except bacon. Pour half of batter into a greased 9 x 13 inch glass dish. Crumble bacon and cheese on top of first layer. Cover with remaining half of batter. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Sausage Balls
directions: Mix with hands until crumbly., Form into small balls., Place on baking sheet., Bake at 325° for 25 minutes., Can be frozen before ready to bake., Serves 5 to 6 dozen.

title: Apple Crisp
directions: Peel and cut apples; arrange in an oblong baking dish., Mix remaining ingredients in bowl; sprinkle over apples., Bake in 375° oven for 30 minutes., Cool before serving., Serves 12.

title: Dill Dip
directions: Mix well and keep in refrigerator., Will keep up to a week.

title: Mushroom Veal
directions: Arrange veal in 12, x, 8-inch, baking, dish., Top, with sliced mushrooms., Cover, with, wax, paper., Microwave, at 50% (Medium) 7 to 10 minutes or until veal is tender and no longer pink; rearrange once,, leaving, mushrooms on top., Set aside. In small bowl, blend remaining ingredients., Increase power to High. Microwave 2 to, 4, minutes or until thickened, stirring with wire whip once, or, twice., Pour, sauce over veal;, cover with wax paper., Reduce power to 50% (Medium)., Microwave 2 to 4 minutes or until heated through.

title: Earthquake Dessert
directions: Cover a 9 x 13 x 3-inch cake pan with coconut., Next, sprinkle on nuts., Prepare cake mix according to box directions; spread over nuts and coconut, but don't mix together., Blend until smooth the cream cheese, oleo and powdered sugar., Carefully spread over cake batter., Bake at 350° for 1 hour., Will rise and fall and have craters like an earthquake!

title: Three Bean Salad
directions: Drain beans., Rinse the kidney beans and drain., Put in large bowl and pour dressing over all., Mix ingredients (last five) for dressing until sugar dissolves., Pour over beans mixture and let stand overnight in refrigerator stirring 3 or 4 times., Drain and serve.

title: Mickey Mouse Rice Pilaf
directions: Melt margarine in a large skillet and saute garlic, onion, celery and mushrooms until tender, not browned., Add rice and stir until each grain is coated., Add chicken broth, bay leaf, salt and pepper., Bring to a boil., Transfer to buttered 2-quart casserole. Cover and bake at 350° for 20 minutes or until rice is tender and all liquid absorbed., Remove bay leaf before serving.

title: Ham Loaf
directions: Combine all ingredients., Place pineapple rings on top., Pour a little juice over top., Cover., Bake at 325° for 2 hours.

title: Broccoli Soup
directions: Blend soup into 1 package broccoli (do this 3 times)., Mill all together; add lemon pepper., Refrigerate., To serve, heat mixture with half and half until hot.

title: Onion Casserole
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Line a 9 x 12-inch Pyrex with crushed saltine crackers. Place a layer of onions over crackers., Sprinkle with a layer of grated cheese., Repeat until onions and cheese are used.

title: Southwestern Salad
directions: Wash and drain lettuce., Break into small pieces in a large salad bowl., Add tomatoes which have been cut into small pieces. Add Ranch Style beans., Just before serving, add corn chips and Catalina dressing., Toss well and serve., For small servings, this recipe can be halved.

title: Red Velvet Cake
directions: *Add 1 tablespoon vinegar to milk and let stand 1 minute.

title: San Antonio Skillet Supper
directions: Cook sausage in half lengthwise., Cut crosswise into 1/4-inch slices., In a 10-inch skillet, combine rice, sausage and remaining ingredients except optional toppings., Mix well, breaking up tomatoes with large spoon., Bring to boil., Reduce heat., Cover and simmer 20 minutes., Remove from heat; let stand covered 5 minutes., Top as desired and serve with additional salsa or picante sauce., Makes 4 servings.

title: Bushel Of Chocolate Chip Cookies
directions: Mix well sugars, oil and margarine., Add eggs, vanilla, salt and soda; mix well., Add flour; mix well., Add oatmeal or cereal and chocolate chips., Blend well., Bake at 350° on ungreased cookie sheet for 10 minutes until light brown.

title: Heath Bar Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Mix first 5 ingredients., Set aside. Mix buttermilk, egg and vanilla together., Add to dry mix and mix well., Add nuts and broken Heath bars., Stir just enough to mix. Pour into 8 x 10-inch or 2 bread loaf pans (greased well or wax paper lined makes easier clean up)., If greased, also flour well. Bake 30 to 35 minutes., Turn out while warm (after cooling about 1/2 hour).

title: Millionaire Pie
directions: Mix ingredients well and put in baked cool pie shell or vanilla wafer crust., When ready to serve, top with Cool Whip or whipped cream.

title: No-Fuss Bar Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 350°. Grease 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Set aside. Combine crumbs, chips, coconut and walnuts in medium bowl. Stir to blend. Add milk. Stir with spoon until blended. Spread batter evenly into prepared pan. Bake 15 to 18 minutes or until edges are golden brown. Let pan stand on a wire rack until completely cooled. Cut into 2 1/4 x 2 1/4-inch bars. Store, tightly covered, at room temperature or freeze up to 3 months.

title: Amanda'S Punch
directions: Chill all juices first., In punch bowl with ice ring, add already mixed cranberry, pineapple and sugar., To this add ginger ale and serve.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Combine all ingredients and pour into a 9 x 13-inch casserole dish., Bake for 30 minutes.

title: Chicken Supreme
directions: Mix chicken, soup, mayonnaise and curry powder., Pour over broccoli in casserole dish., Mix cheese and bread crumbs; put over top., Bake at 350° until hot through and brown.

title: Homemade Ice Cream(1 Hour And 30 Minutes)
directions: In 3-quart saucepan, combine milk and whipping cream., Cook over low heat until warm (6 to 8 minutes)., In large mixer bowl, combine all remaining ingredients., Beat at medium speed, scraping bowl often, until smooth (2 to 3 minutes)., Gradually stir into milk mixture., Cool to room temperature., Pour into ice cream canister., Freeze in ice cream maker according to manufacturer's directions., Yield:, 3 quarts.

title: Pineapple Cheese Ball
directions: Mix cream cheese, pineapple, bell pepper, onion and seasoning salt (by hand) until well blended., Add 1 cup pecans and mix well. Shape into ball., Roll in 1/2 cup pecans and refrigerate.

title: Boursin Cheese Spread
directions: Mix all ingredients together until fluffy., Refrigerate at least 24 hours for flavors to blend., Soften at room temperature for 1 hour before serving.

title: Pizza Casserole
directions: Brown ground beef and sausage and drain well., Mix spaghetti sauce with meat., In a 9 x 13-inch pan, layer with noodles, sauce, cheese and pepperoni., Repeat with remaining ingredients, ending with cheese and pepperoni., Bake at 350° for approximately 25 minutes, until cheese is bubbly.

title: Dreamy Salad
directions: Heat milk and marshmallows in a double boiler until marshmallows are melted., Add lemon jello; stir until dissolved. Mix crushed pineapple with cream cheese with mixer., Add to jello mix., Add nuts., Cool., Fold in Cool Whip., Form in flat shallow dish and let set in refrigerator., Make red jello using drained pineapple juice for part of liquid., When beginning to set, pour over cold bottom layer.

title: Super Easy, Super Quick Supper
directions: Heat 1 tablespoon cooking oil (any variety) in large frying pan., Add onion and cook until clear., Add chicken and cook until thawed., Add broccoli and mushrooms and cook about 5 minutes until heated through., Add bean sprouts and water chestnuts., Mix stir-fry seasoning according to package directions and pour over stir-fry., Add soy sauce to taste., Be careful not to cook too long, bean sprouts will become soggy., Serve immediately over hot cooked rice.

title: Orange Gelatin Salad
directions: Mix together gelatin and hot water., Add orange juice concentrate; cool., Add orange slices and crushed pineapple., Let congeal.

title: Fiesta Chicken Bake
directions: Place chips on the bottom of a glass casserole dish., Scatter the chicken pieces on top of chips., Mix soups and chiles together and pour over all., Top with tomatoes; sprinkle cheese over top. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes., Garnish with sour cream and guacamole before serving.

title: Pound Cake (5 Flavor)
directions: Cream the Crisco and margarine, adding gradually the sugar. Add eggs, one at a time; beat well 1 1/2 minutes after each egg. Sift baking powder with flour; add alternately with milk and flavorings. Mix well. Bake in a large tube pan. Grease and flour pan. Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours or until done. Let cool in pan for 30 minutes.

title: Cabbage Casserole
directions: Cut cabbage into wedges., Cook in salted water until tender; drain., Mix soup and milk together and set aside., Grease casserole dish. Layer alternately the cabbage, soup and cheese. Top with bread crumbs., Dot with butter., Bake 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Apple Candy Delight
directions: Combine whipped topping and pineapple in 2-quart bowl. Mix apples, candy bars and peanuts into whipped topping mixture. Spread mixture into serving dish and grate chocolate onto mixture. Yields approximately 7 cups.

title: Continental Veal
directions: Measure soy sauce into large skillet and brown veal in oil with onions and garlic, about 15 minutes., Add 1 cup water, stock or tomato juice and the sugar, pepper and rosemary or marjoram. Add salt. Cover and cook until veal is tender., Approximately 1 hour and 15 minutes before cooked, add carrots, green peppers and mushrooms., Just before serving, stir in lemon rind., Add extra water, stock or tomato juice as necessary during cooking., Makes 4 servings.

title: Mini-Reuben Hors D'Oeuvres
directions: Layer bread slices on cookie sheet., Put a teaspoon of dressing, then a piece of corned beef, sauerkraut and top with a small piece of Swiss cheese., Put under broiler for 3 minutes.

title: Hash Brown Cheese Bake
directions: Combine all ingredients, stirring well; spoon into a greased 13x9x2 inch baking dish., Bake at 350 for 40 minutes., Yield:, 12 to 15 servings.

title: Harvest Meat Loaf
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Combine all ingredients in a bowl., Mix lightly with a fork., Shape into a loaf and bake in a greased 8-inch square pan for one hour.

title: Lemon Cake Pie
directions: Cream butter and sugar. Add lemon juice and beaten egg yolks; mix., Stir in flour and milk., Fold in egg whites that have been beaten stiff., Pour in unbaked pie shell and bake at 450° for first 10 minutes., Reduce heat to 325° and bake until set as custard, about 45 minutes.

title: Sugar Cookies
directions: Mix all together., Roll into acorn-size balls., Roll in sugar. Press with glass., Bake at 350° for 12 minutes.

title: Chicken Parmesan
directions: In shallow dish, blend water and egg., Set aside., In another shallow dish, or on a sheet of wax paper, mix bread crumbs, Parmesan cheese and paprika., Dip each chicken piece in egg, then in bread crumb mixture to coat.

title: Red Hot Salad
directions: Add red hots to water and bring to boil., Red hots should be dissolved., Pour over jello., Add applesauce and nuts., Let set in refrigerator.

title: Punch Bowl Cake
directions: Bake cake as directed in two 8-inch round cake pans., Place one layer in the bottom of a punch bowl., Add pineapple., Layer with bananas (sliced), 1 1/2 cans vanilla pudding and 1 layer Cool Whip., Add the other layer of cake., Layer with strawberries, 1 1/2 cans vanilla pudding and Cool Whip., Cover with maraschino cherries and nuts.

title: Pecan Dreams
directions: Cream sugar and oleo., Add vanilla., Mix in flour and pecans, then roll in small balls and place on cookie sheet., Bake at 325° for 8 to 10 minutes, then roll in powdered sugar twice.

title: Bacon Wraps
directions: Cut strips of bacon into 3 parts., Wrap each part around the center of a cracker., Place on a rack over a baking pan so that grease will drain away from crackers., Bake at 250 to 300 degrees until crisp., Store in airtight container.

title: Biscuit And Beef Casserole
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., Brown beef and drain. Stir in next 5 ingredients; heat until bubbly., Pour into 2-quart casserole. Cut biscuits in half to form 20 half circles., Place cut side down around edge of casserole. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 375° for 25 to 30 minutes or until biscuits are golden brown. Refrigerate leftovers. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Microwave Nachos Grande
directions: On large microwavable platter, start layering as follows: tortilla chips, Cheddar cheese, refried beans, hamburger, sour cream, tomatoes, green onions and black olives., After completing first layer of everything, begin with second layer in same order. When ingredients are gone, top with guacamole and jalapeno peppers., Entire platter can be heated in microwave., Serve immediately., Great party snack (but a little messy)!

title: Spoon Hot Rolls
directions: Mix warm water and yeast. Melt margarine., Add margarine, sugar, egg and flour to yeast., Mix well.

title: Secret Beef Stew(Serves 6)
directions: Place grapefruit juice in saucepan., Place over medium heat. Add stew meat and mix well., Add Worcestershire sauce, garlic, onion, bay leaves and seasonings; mix well., Reduce heat to low and simmer for 2 hours., Add vegetables., Bring to boil., Reduce heat and simmer for 20 to 25 minutes., Remove bay leaves.

title: Bran Muffins
directions: Pour boiling water over bran., Stir well and let cool., Mix all ingredients., This will keep in refrigerator 6-8 weeks., Bake 20 min. at 400 degrees in greased muffin pan.

title: Sauteed Calf'S Liver With Onions
directions: Heat 2 tablespoons oil in heavy skillet., Add onions and cook, stirring frequently, for 7 to 8 minutes., Stir in sage and cook 2 to 3 minutes longer or until onions are limp and slightly colored. Set skillet off heat.

title: Frosting
directions: Blend with mixer until smooth., Frost one layer., Can be used for Whoopie Pies.

title: Crock-Pot Barbecue
directions: Cook roast along with 2 diced onions and 2 cups water in crock-pot for 8 to 12 hours on low. Drain. Shred meat and add 1 diced onion and barbecue sauce. Cook 1 to 3 hours on medium.

title: Brunch Casserole
directions: Crumble sausage in medium skillet; cook over medium heat until brown, stirring occasionally., Drain well., Line bottom of buttered 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish with crescent rolls, firmly pressing perforations to seal., Sprinkle with sausage and cheese. Combine remaining ingredients; beat well and pour over sausage. Bake at 425° for 15 minutes or until set., Let stand 5 minutes. Cut into squares and serve immediately., Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Fancy Chicken Puff Pie
directions: In medium saucepan over medium heat, melt butter and saute shallots lightly. Stir in flour and cook for 3 minutes. Add broth and sherry., Heat to boiling, stirring constantly., Season to taste with salt, pepper and nutmeg., Reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes. Stir in ham, chicken, asparagus and cream., Pour chicken mixture into an ungreased 9-inch pie pan., Preheat oven to 425°. Cut an 8-inch circle from crust., Cut hearts out of extra dough with a cookie cutter, if desired., Place circle on a cookie sheet and moisten with cold water., Pierce with a fork and brush with egg., Decorate with hearts which are also brushed with egg., Bake crust and full pie plate for 10 minutes, reduce heat to 350° and bake another 10 to 15 minutes or until pastry is golden brown and filling is hot and set., With a spatula, place pastry over hot filling and serve., Makes 4 servings.

title: Tiramisu
directions: In top of double boiler, beat egg yolks and 1/4 cup sugar with mixer for 5 minutes., Set over simmering water; add Marsala and continue beating for 6 minutes., (Keep beater on high speed.)
