Remove, set aside and cool., In separate bowls, beat Mascarpone cheese (which is available in delis with imported cheeses) until smooth and whipping cream until it has soft peaks., Fold together Mascarpone, whipping cream, powdered sugar and vanilla., Mix together coffee and rum., Layer one package of ladyfingers in flat bottom casserole and brush with 1/3 of the coffee mixture., Spread 1/3 of the Mascarpone mixture on ladyfingers and top with 1/3 Marsala mixture., Repeat with remaining ladyfingers, making 3 layers., Sift cocoa powder evenly on top., Cover lightly and refrigerate 3 hours., Serves 10 to 12.

title: Praline Pound Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 325°., Grease and flour a 10-inch tube pan. Sprinkle 1/2 cup chopped pecans in pan., Set aside., Cream the butter or margarine and cream cheese., Add brown sugar and cream until light and fluffy (about 5 minutes)., Add eggs, one at a time, mixing well after each addition., Fold in flour just until combined., Do not overmix., Stir in vanilla and remaining 1 cup chopped pecans., Spoon batter into prepared pan and place on baking sheet in oven., Bake for 1 1/2 hours or until wooden toothpick inserted near center comes out clean., Cool in pan 10 minutes. Remove to rack to cool completely., Yields 16 servings.

title: Broccoli And Rice Casserole
directions: Saute onion and celery in oleo., Cook rice and broccoli according to package directions., Combine celery, onion, soup and cheese., Salt and pepper to taste., Stir in cooked rice., Add broccoli., Pour into a 3-quart dish., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Shrimp And Okra Gumbo
directions: In a large skillet, heat oil and brown okra until tender (about 10 minutes)., Add onions and tomatoes to mix., Cook until onions are translucent., Put all remaining ingredients in large pot along with mixture in skillet., Bring to boil, then simmer for about 45 minutes.

title: Zesty Squash
directions: Mix cut squash, Ro-Tel tomatoes (do not drain) and 1 1/2 to 2 cups water in a large pot. Stew on medium heat for about 20 minutes or until squash is tender., Preheat oven to 350°., In a baking dish, spoon in layer of squash mixture, dob with butter, sprinkle with handful of bread crumbs and layer of cheese. Continue layering until all mixture is used. Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Mandarin Orange Dessert
directions: Combine crackers, sugar and oleo., Spread 3/4 mixture in 9 x 13-inch pan., Mix Eagle Brand milk and orange juice., Fold in Cool Whip and oranges., Fold in Cool Whip and oranges., Spread in crust. Top with remaining cracker mixture., Refrigerate.

title: The Original Berlin Fair Clam Chowder
directions: Use a coarse grinder for all ingredients., Cook salt pork and onions just a little., Add about 2 or 3 cups or more water, then the potatoes., Cook until nearly done., Add clams and the juice, salt, pepper and a little sugar (about 1 teaspoon)., Simmer about 1 hour uncovered., This recipe can to me from my sister-in-law, Marion France.

title: Chicken Chip Bake
directions: Use 1/2 bag of chips mixed in with all the ingredients., Salt and pepper to taste., Put rest of chips over all., Sprinkle Cheddar cheese on top and bake at 400° for 20 minutes. (Put in cake pan or casserole.), You can use canned chicken or cook a whole one and use it.

title: Golden Sugar Cookies
directions: Sift flour, cream of tartar, soda and salt together. Put aside. Cream butter and flavoring together until butter is soft and smooth. Add sugar, gradually creaming until fluffy. Add egg yolks one at a time. Next, add dry ingredients to creamed mixture, beating until well-blended. Form dough into 1-inch balls and place about 2-inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350° for 10 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Corn Dogs
directions: Mix first 7 ingredients together to form batter., Roll or dip frankfurters in mixture and fry in deep fat.

title: Gouda Cheese
directions: Wrap Gouda with crescent roll and bake about 20 minutes. Either serve with crackers, pickles, pepperoni or summer sausage or serve with fresh fruit (apple slices, grapes, etc.).

title: Christmas Cookies
directions: Mix all ingredients; will be stiff (better to mix with hand). Bake at 350° on a well-greased cookie sheet about 8 minutes.

title: Baked Chicken Salad
directions: Saute celery and onion until tender., Mix all ingredients together., Place in a 1 1/2 qt. greased casserole., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes., Remove and sprinkle chinese noodles over top. Bake for an additional 15 minutes.

title: Bran Muffins
directions: Add boiling water to All-Bran; set aside., Mix sugar, oil and beaten eggs., Add buttermilk and flour mixed with soda and salt. Mix in over All-Bran, then fold in 40% Bran Flakes., Bake in greased muffin pan at 350° for 18 to 20 minutes., Mix keeps up to 6 weeks in refrigerator.

title: Cream Cheese Pound Cake
directions: Cream butter, margarine, cream cheese and sugar until thoroughly creamed. Add vanilla and salt; alternate eggs and flour. Beat until well blended. Bake in a lightly greased and floured tube pan at 300° for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Meat Ball Stew
directions: Chop onion fine., Combine ground meat, chopped onion and rice in a large bowl., Form into medium size meat balls and bake at 350° for 15 minutes.

title: Kielbasa Casserole
directions: Parboil kielbasa for a few minutes before slicing to remove some of the fat., Melt grape jelly in pan then add can of chili and slices of kielbasa., Simmer for about 30 minutes.

title: German Fruit Cake
directions: Cream together butter, sugar and eggs., Sift together flour and spices., Add flour mixture alternately with buttermilk to which the soda has been added., Fold in gently the preserves, vanilla and nuts., Pour into a greased and floured angel food cake pan., Bake for 1 1/2 hours or until done at 325°., Cool for 15 minutes after it is removed from oven.

title: Simple Salmon Cakes
directions: Drain salmon and flake into bowl; stir in onion, egg and bread crumbs., Mix., Form into 1/2 inch thick patties; fry in a little oil until crisp and golden on both sides., Turn only once while frying., Serve with lemon.

title: Zucchini Drop Cookies
directions: Beat well the zucchini, pulp, soda, sugar and shortening., Add egg and beat well., Sift flour and spices., Add dry ingredients with nuts and raisins., Drop by teaspoons onto greased cookie sheet., Bake at 375° for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Walnut Pie
directions: In a medium bowl, beat together eggs, corn syrup, sugar, butter, vanilla and salt., Arrange walnuts on bottom of pie shell. Carefully pour egg mixture over walnuts., Bake on bottom rack of preheated 400° oven until a knife inserted near the center comes out clean, about 30 to 35 minutes., Cool on wire rack. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Cardinal Punch
directions: Pour all juices into a large goblet half filled with ice cubes., Top with ginger ale., Decorate with slices or oranges and lemons.

title: Spinach Dip
directions: Mix together., Refrigerate overnight., Serve with crackers, bread cubes or raw vegetables.

title: Jerky
directions: Cut meat into strips 1/8-inch thick., Soak meat in mixture of ingredients for 6 hours. Dry in oven or on stovetop until crisp.

title: French Rice Casserole
directions: Combine soup and margarine; stir well., Drain mushrooms and water chestnuts, reserving liquid., Add enough water to reserved liquid to equal 1 1/3 cups., Add all ingredients and mix well. Pour into a lightly greased baking dish., Cover and bake in 350° oven for 1 hour.

title: Crab Topping For Crackers
directions: Mix all together., Let set for awhile to blend., Spread on crackers.

title: French Toast With Bananas 'N Brandy Coulis
directions: Slice baguettes diagonally into 3/4-inch thick slices. Mix buttermilk, milk, eggs, vanilla and cinnamon thoroughly. Soak slices in mixture for 10 minutes or so. Lightly spray griddle with nonstick vegetable coating. Over medium heat, cook slices on griddle until golden brown. Keep in warming oven (covered with a sheet of aluminum foil) at 200° until just ready to serve.

title: Easy Strawberry Jam
directions: Combine berries and 2 cups sugar in pan., Boil 5 minutes. Add remaining sugar and lemon juice., Boil 12 to 15 minutes longer., Remove from heat and stir until foam disappears., Let set overnight., Pour into sterilized jars and seal.

title: Taco Salad
directions: Brown hamburger and drain., Add taco sauce and simmer., Put lettuce, tomatoes, kidney beans, onions and cheese in a bowl., Add meat and French dressing., Mix., Add chips just before serving.

title: Pecan Balls
directions: Cream butter; gradually add sugar., Mix well; add flour mixed with pecans and vanilla., Shape into small balls., Bake at 350° about 15 minutes or until light brown., Cool, then roll in powdered sugar., Makes about 2 dozen.

title: Shrimp Toast
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Spread on bread., Cut diagonally., Put about 1 inch oil in frying pan and heat., Place bread with filled side down and fry 15 seconds., Turn and fry other side until golden brown., Drain on absorbent paper.

title: Southern Pound Cake
directions: Cream the butter and sugar well., Break the eggs, one at a time, in a small bowl., Combine all ingredients and beat for about 5 minutes. Grease a large pound cake pan and bake for 2 hours at 275°.

title: Grandma'S Ginger Cookies
directions: Cream together egg, sugar, shortening and molasses., Add rest of ingredients., Roll in small balls, then roll in sugar., Bake at 375° for about 10 minutes.

title: Honey Coconut Divinity
directions: Boil together sugar, honey and water until syrup spins a thread., Slowly pour syrup over stiffly beaten egg whites, beating continuously., Beat until mixture holds in shape., Blend in extract and coconut., Drop from teaspoon onto waxed paper or spread in a buttered 9-inch square pan; cool and cut into squares.

title: Excellent French Dressing
directions: Blend well in blender and keep in refrigerator.

title: Baked Pineapple
directions: Mix dry ingredients., Add to pineapple., Stir in eggs and butter., Mix., Sprinkle with cinnamon., Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

title: Toasted Cheese Rounds
directions: Mix all ingredients together well, except bread., Spread over entire slice of bread., Broil on cookie sheet until bubbly., Serve warm.

title: Buttery Toasted Rye Loaf
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Combine all ingredients, except bread; mix well., Slice loaf into 1/2-inch slices, cutting but not through bottom of loaf., Spread one side of each slice with margarine mixture., Wrap in foil; bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Nutty Pie
directions: Beat the egg whites until stiff, but not dry., Add the sugar gradually., Mix baking powder with graham cracker crumbs and fold into meringue mixture., Add vanilla and nuts., Bake for 25 minutes in a 350° oven in a greased Pyrex pie pan., Don't overbake., Cool. Pour small carton of Cool Whip over pie; refrigerate overnight.

title: Yogurt Pies
directions: Fold ingredients together and put in graham cracker crust., If your family doesn't like yogurt, they will like these., (These are great for diabetics or heart patients.)

title: Oven Beef Stew
directions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.

title: Diet Cookies
directions: Mix well., Shape into small balls., Place on greased cookie sheets 2-inches apart., Flatten with fork and sprinkle lightly with sugar., Bake 10 minutes at 350°., Only 7 calories each! Makes 15 cookies.

title: Sauteed Corn With Bacon
directions: Remove husks and silks from corn. Cut corn from cob, scraping cob to remove pulp; set aside. Cook bacon in a large skillet until crisp; remove bacon, reserving drippings. Crumble bacon and set aside. Saute corn in bacon drippings until golden brown. Add water to cover, salt, and pepper. Bring to a boil; reduce heat, cover and simmer 30 to 45 minutes. Stir in crumbled bacon.

title: Lemon Snowball
directions: Line a 12-cup bowl with 2 pieces of wax paper, one on top of the other., Let each piece extend over opposite edges of bowl so all edges are covered; paper will be wrinkled., Set bowl aside. In a large bowl, sprinkle gelatin over cold water., Let stand 5 minutes to soften., Add boiling water; stir until gelatin is dissolved., Stir in granulated sugar, salt, orange juice concentrate, lemon juice and peel., Refrigerate 45 minutes to 1 hour, stirring occasionally, until partially set and mixture mounds when dropped from a spoon., In a large bowl, whip 1 pint cream until it forms soft peaks., Fold gelatin mixture into whipped cream., Spoon a small amount of lemon mixture into bottom of prepared bowl., Scatter several pieces of angel food cake over lemon mixture., Continue alternating cake and lemon mixture until all is used., Cover with plastic wrap and foil., Refrigerate 1 to 2 days before serving., May also be frozen.

title: Grilled Turkey Burgers
directions: Combine first 8 ingredients., Shape into 4 patties., Coat grill rack with cooking spray, place on grill over medium-hot coals., Place patties on rack and cook 8 minutes on each side or until done., Serve on buns., Makes 4 servings.

title: Beef Kabobs
directions: In small bowl, whisk oil, garlic, rind and juice, vinegar, oregano, salt and pepper. Pour half into large storage bag; add beef. Seal; refrigerate 1 to 2 hours. Divide steak, peppers, onion and mushrooms into 6 equal portions. Thread each portion onto large metal skewers. Heat broiler. Place skewers on large broiler-pan rack. Brush with some of remaining marinade. Broil 5 minutes. Turn over; brush with remaining marinade. Broil 5 minutes. Serve with rice.

title: Shrimp Dip
directions: Mix mayo, cream cheese, and soup in small pan until warm., Add gelatin., Mold.

title: Bread Bowl
directions: Turn a baking bowl upside down and grease well., Press dough evenly covering the outside of the baking bowl., Bake according to package directions., Cool and carefully remove and invert on to a serving tray., Fill with dips, stews, etc., Bread bowl is edible.

title: Vanilla Wafers
directions: In a medium bowl, beat all ingredients at low speed until well blended. Drop dough by 2 teaspoons about 2-inches apart onto ungreased cookie sheets. Bake 10 to 12 minutes until edges are brown. Makes about 4 dozen cookies.

title: Uncooked Fruit Cake
directions: Chop and mix all ingredients together., Pack in pan with oil paper., Cover tightly., Store in cool place., Keeps good for several years in freezer., Store in cool place for 2 to 3 weeks before cutting.

title: Sweet Potato Balls(Unusually Delicious)
directions: Boil sweet potatoes until tender. Add sugar, butter and flavoring. Mix and place in refrigerator overnight.

title: Microwave Peanut Butter Fudge
directions: Place sugar, peanut butter and margarine in a glass bowl. Microwave 2 minutes on High. Stir a few times during the 2 minutes. Remove and stir in vanilla., Pour into a 9 x 9-inch buttered dish., Chill 30 minutes and cut in squares.

title: Lasagna
directions: Brown ground beef in oil in a large skillet, stirring to crumble., Drain off pan drippings., Stir tomatoes, tomato paste and seasonings into meat. Bring to boil., Reduce heat and simmer 40 minutes, stirring occasionally., Cook noodles according to package directions., Drain., Place half of noodles in lightly greased 12 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish, slightly overlapping lengthwise edges., Spoon 1/3 of meat mixture over noodles., Add 1/2 shredded Mozzarella cheese, cottage cheese and Parmesan cheese., Repeat layers and spoon on remaining meat mixture. Arrange Mozzarella slices on top., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Corn Casserole
directions: Saute onions in butter, then blend in salt and flour., Add sour cream until smooth., Bring to boil, add corn and cook until heated through., Add 1/2 bacon., Pour in greased dish and top with parsley and bacon., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Colo Spaghetti Salad
directions: Night Before:, Cook spaghetti and rinse under cold water. Refrigerate., Peel, deseed and chop cucumber., Chop green pepper and green onions., Deseed and chop tomatoes., Add spaghetti., Add salad dressing (all of it)., Add salad dressing now or just before.

title: Taco Salad
directions: Brown hamburger and drain. Add taco seasoning, cheese, and Ro-tel tomatoes. Stir together in skillet over low heat until cheese is melted, keep warm. In large bowl mix the salad mix, tomatoes, and Doritoes. When ready to serve, mix everything together and serve immediately to keep chips from getting soggy.

title: Gerry'S Chicken With Lime Butter
directions: Sprinkle chicken on both sides with salt and pepper., In a large frypan, place oil and heat to medium temperature., Add chicken and saute about 4 minutes, or until lightly browned., Turn chicken, cover and reduce heat to low., Cook 10 minutes or until fork can be inserted in chicken with ease., Remove chicken and keep warm; drain off oil and discard.

title: Quick-N-Easy Cherry Cobbler
directions: Combine fruit and 3/4 cup sugar., Let stand for 20 minutes. Melt margarine to pour over cobbler at the end., Sift together flour and sugar., Add milk., Stir briskly (lumps will remain). Pour butter over top., Top with fruit., Bake for 45 minutes in 350° oven.

title: Fresh Fruit Cobbler
directions: Arrange in square or round pan the cut fruit., Sprinkle with mixture of flour, sugar and cinnamon., Dot with butter or margarine., Sift together into bowl the flour, sugar, baking powder and salt., Add oil, milk and egg., Stir with fork until blended., Drop by spoonful over fruit., If desired, dough may be spread with spatula., Bake 25 to 30 minutes in preheated oven at 350°., Cook until bubbly and light brown., Serve warm.

title: Fillet Of Flounder
directions: Combine egg, milk, salt and pepper., Soak the fish in this mixture for 15 minutes., Dip each fillet in the bread crumbs. Melt butter in skillet., Add fillets and saute on both sides until brown.

title: Fettucini
directions: Let butter or margarine, eggs and cream stand at room temperature for 2 to 3 hours., Cook bacon in skillet until browned., Remove and drain on paper toweling., Beat together eggs and cream just until blended., Cook pasta until al dente (tender), about 15 minutes., Drain thoroughly; do not rinse., Toss pasta with butter., Pour egg mixture over and toss until pasta is well coated., Add bacon, cheese, pepper and parsley; toss to mix. Serves 6.

title: Romaine Strawberry Salad
directions: Tear lettuce; cut strawberries in fourths (if large, cut in sixths). Add cranberries; toss or layer in dish. Add nuts just before serving. Top with poppy seed dressing (page 37).

title: Mixed Vegetable Casserole
directions: Preheat oven to 350°. Mix and bake 15 to 20 minutes. Remove cover. Top with 1 stick oleo, melted, and add Progresso bread crumbs, Italian-style. Bake 15 to 20 minutes more and serve.

title: Salt Dough
directions: Mix with your hands, adding more flour if dough is sticky and more water if crumbly., Wet the surface to add bits of decorative dough to cut-outs., After shaping, bake at 200° until thoroughly dry (about 1 hour)., You may glaze with egg yolk/water for brown color., Varnish cooled ornament.

title: Chicken Gumbo
directions: Add tomatoes, celery, green pepper, onion, parsley and bouillon cubes to chicken broth., Simmer 24 minutes or until vegetables are tender., Add chicken and okra; cook for 6 minutes longer., Add rice and corn., Heat and serve., Makes 6 servings, 1 cup each; 155 calories per serving.

title: Fruit Pizza
directions: Press cookie dough onto a greased pizza pan., Cook as directed., Do not overcook., Let cool., Mix softened cream cheese with 3/4 of the container of Cool Whip., Spread onto dough., Cut up fruit onto pan., Spoon heated preserves onto pizza., Let chill in refrigerator 2 to 3 hours before serving.

title: Dilly Bread
directions: You will need an 8-inch round, 1 1/2 to 2-quart casserole.

title: Country Chicken Soup(8 Servings)
directions: Place all ingredients, except rice, in slow cooker in order listed., Cover; cook for 1 hour on high, then on low for 8 to 9 hours., One hour before serving, remove chicken and cook slightly. Remove meat from bones; return meat to slow cooker., Add rice; cover and cook for 1 hour on high.

title: Hush Puppies
directions: In a bowl, combine cornmeal, flour, sugar, baking powder, salt and baking soda., Add egg, milk and corn; stir just until mixed.

title: Mushroom Tomato Quiche
directions: Beat eggs and egg white until creamy., Add milk and cream. Sprinkle in salt and pepper., Stir in meats and cheese., Pour into an unbaked pie shell., Add mushrooms; layer tomatoes., Sprinkle with additional cheese, if desired., Bake for 10 minutes at 425°, then for 10 additional minutes at 350°., (You can also add 1/4 cup sauteed onions for more flavor.), Serves 8.

title: Secret Kiss Cookies
directions: Cream butter, sugar and vanilla in large bowl. Gradually add flour. Beat on low until well blended. Chill 1 hour.

title: Oyster Cracker Snack
directions: Mix oil and dry ingredients., Pour over oyster crackers; blend well. Dry on paper towels.

title: Mary Imus' Favorite Cake
directions: Blend dry ingredients., Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Pour into large rectangular pan or two 8-inch round layer pans. Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes., May add chopped walnuts and/or raisins., Sprinkle top with powdered sugar after baking or frost with light chocolate frosting., Stores well.

title: Corn Pudding
directions: Dissolve flour in the milk., Add salt, sugar and eggs. Combine with corn and mix well., Pour into lightly greased 9 x 13-inch Pyrex dish., Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes., When done, knife will come out clean.

title: Jessica'S Famous Meat Loaf
directions: Mix ingredients all together., Form into a loaf., Bake at 350° for 60 minutes.

title: Cheese Ball Or Log
directions: Have cream cheese at room temperature., Combine with all ingredients except nuts., Form into ball or log., Place in refrigerator and chill., Take out and roll ball or log in nuts. Wrap in waxed paper or foil and place in refrigerator until time to serve.

title: Sour Cream Coffee Cake
directions: In large bowl, cream butter and 2 cups sugar until fluffy. Add vanilla, then eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition., In separate bowl, combine flour, baking powder, soda and salt., Add sour cream to butter and egg mixture; mix well. Slowly stir in flour mixture until batter is smooth., Spoon 1/2 of batter into a greased 10-inch tube pan., Combine cinnamon, nuts and remaining sugar; sprinkle 1/2 over batter in pan., Spoon in remaining batter and top with cinnamon/nuts mixture., Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes until tested done., Cool 15 minutes before removing from pan., Makes 16 to 20 servings.

title: Pastel Cookies
directions: Mix together the shortening, margarine and sugar., Add gelatin, eggs and vanilla., Blend in dry ingredients., Roll into small balls; place on cookie sheet., Flatten with bottom of a glass that has been dipped in sugar., Make sure glass has a bottom design on it that goes on cookie when pressed., Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.

title: Cherry Cobbler Pie
directions: Line an 8-inch square pan with cherry pie filling., Mix margarine, 1/2 cup sugar, baking powder, flour, salt and milk. Pour 1 cup sugar and 1/2 cup water over the batter., Bake for 40 to 45 minutes at 400°.

title: Baked Pineapple Dessert
directions: Beat eggs., Add flour and sugar., Mix well., Add pineapple. Pour into greased casserole and cover with white bread (cubed). Pour melted butter or margarine over all., Bake 45 minutes to 1 hour at 350°., Delicious!

title: Pumpkin Cake
directions: Beat together with a fork and press into the bottom of greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Fluff (Weight Watchers)
directions: Mix together yogurt, Cool Whip and puddings., Fold in pineapple and oranges., Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Crunch Top Potatoes
directions: Peel and cut potatoes into 1/2-inch crosswise slices., Cook in boiling water until almost tender., Melt butter in shallow 9 x 13-inch pan., Add single layer of potatoes, turning once in butter., Mix remaining ingredients and sprinkle over potatoes. Bake 1/2 hour or until done and tops are crisp., Serve hot.

title: Meat Loaf
directions: Mix meats thoroughly with bread which has been soaked in the milk, seasonings and beaten eggs., Put in a well-greased loaf pan., Spread with ketchup or chili sauce., Bake at 375° for 45 minutes.

title: Spicy Creamy Grits
directions: Bring first 4 ingredients to a boil in a large sauce pan. Gradually stir in grits., Return to a boil., Cover, reduce heat, and simmer, stirring occasionally for 5 to 7 minutes until thickened. Add cheeses and hot sauce or red pepper, stirring until cheeses melt., Serve immediately.

title: Snickers Cheese Cake
directions: Combine crumbs and butter; press onto bottom and sides of 9-inch pie pan., Bake at 350° for 10 minutes., Can use ready made vanilla wafer crust.

title: "Dr. Ziment'S Prescription Garlic Chicken Soup For Colds And
directions: Peel garlic cloves and place with other ingredients in a medium-size saucepan., Heat to boiling, then reduce to simmer. Simmer for 30 minutes, breathing fumes during cooking., If desired, strain soup, discarding solid ingredients, or puree it after removing bay leaf., Divide the soup into 4 portions, each of which should be taken at the beginning of a meal, one to three times a day.

title: Kentucky Pound Cake
directions: Beat egg whites stiff., Combine all ingredients in large bowl (including egg whites and yolks)., Mix thoroughly., Use round deep pan., Start in cold oven; bake at 300° for 1 hour and 20 minutes.

title: Onion Shortbread
directions: Saute onion in butter., Stir in sour cream, dill weed, salt and half the Cheddar cheese (1/2 cup)., In a separate bowl combine corn, milk, dry muffin mix, egg and hot pepper sauce., Put corn mixture in a buttered 9 x 13-inch dish., Spread onion mixture over top., Top with remaining Cheddar cheese., Bake in a 425° oven for 30 to 40 minutes., Serves 8 to 10.

title: Pizza Casserole
directions: Brown hamburger., Layer in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan or large casserole dish with potatoes and onions., Combine soup, tomato sauce, milk and spices., Pour over potatoes and hamburger., Cover with foil or cover casserole and bake at 375° for 45 to 60 minutes., Remove cover., Place on top a few slices of Mozzarella cheese., Bake for 15 minutes, until browned., Keeps well in refrigerator., Reheat in oven or microwave.

title: Porcupine Balls
directions: Mix beef, rice, salt, pepper and onion together., Form into 1-inch balls., In large skillet, mix soup and water; bring to a boil., Add meatballs gently., Cover; simmer for 25 minutes, turning once.

title: Texas Pie
directions: Spread each ingredient in a large pan in the order that it's written., Bake about one hour at 350°.

title: Movie-Time Nachos
directions: Empty chips into large serving bowl; set aside., Over low heat in small saucepan, mix remaining ingredients., Add a little more milk or salsa to achieve desired consistency., Stir constantly until thoroughly heated., Allow to cool a few minutes before serving., Dip and enjoy!, Serves 2 to 4.

title: Cheesy Broccoli Casserole
directions: Steam broccoli and drain., Put half of it into a casserole dish., Beat 1 egg until light, add undiluted mushroom soup and mayonnaise; mix well., Pour 1/2 of this mixture over broccoli in the casserole and also half of the grated cheese., Repeat with layers of broccoli mixture and cheese., Melt 1/4 cup butter., Mix with crumbled crackers and sprinkle over entire casserole., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until bubbly., Recipe can be doubled.

title: Chicken Tortellini Soup
directions: In large saucepan, combine water, broth, soup, chicken, onion, garlic, basil and oregano., Bring to a boil; simmer uncovered 30 minutes., Add tortellini and vegetables., Simmer 10 minutes. Serve with cheese.

title: Buckeyes
directions: Beat together the peanut butter, sugar, vanilla and butter. Roll into small balls and chill them for about an hour., In top of double boiler set over hot water, melt chocolate and paraffin. Dip chilled balls into the mixture and place on wax paper to cool.

title: Stir-Fried Pork Tenderloin With Vegetables
directions: Cut broccoli into bite-size pieces., With knife held in slanting position, almost parallel to the cutting surface, cut tenderloin crosswise into 1/8-inch thick slices., In medium bowl, mix pork with next 5 ingredients.

title: Favorite Banana Nut Bread
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., In a large bowl, cream together milk, shortening and sugar., Add eggs and beat well.

title: Chocolate Pudding
directions: Mix dry ingredients together., Slowly add milk, while stirring., Cook over medium heat until it comes to a boil., Boil 1 minute and add oleo and vanilla.

title: Cream Of Broccoli
directions: In medium saucepan, bring 3 cups milk and broccoli to the boiling point, then simmer, stirring occasionally, for 5 minutes. Stir in Lipton chicken noodle soup mix and flour blended with remaining milk., Bring to the boiling point, then simmer 10 minutes or until soup is lightly thickened and broccoli is tender. Makes 4 servings.

title: Make-Ahead Fruit Salad
directions: Mix together and chill overnight.

title: Pecan Pie
directions: Mix together., Bake 45 minutes at 350°.

title: Buffet Potatoes
directions: Mix all the ingredients together, except butter and bread crumbs, and pour into a 13 x 9-inch pan., Sprinkle with bread crumbs and drizzle the butter over crumbs., Bake for 50 to 60 minutes at 350°.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Melt cheese and 1/2 stick margarine., Set aside., Drain broccoli and place in a 2-quart casserole dish., Cover with cheese/margarine mixture., Melt remaining 1/2 stick margarine and add to cracker crumbs., Sprinkle over cheese., Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

title: Mexican Pinwheels
directions: Blend together cream cheese, green onions, black olives, pimentos and jalapenos., Spread on 10 flour tortillas., Roll jelly roll., Sash wrap and chill., Slice., Serve with salsa.

title: Italian Cheese Sticks
directions: Bring butter and cheese to room temperature., Beat together the butter and cheese until well blended., Combine flour, oregano, salt and cayenne; add to cheese mixture, gradually., Add water; mix until well blended., Form dough into a ball., Roll out on floured surface to 1/4-inch thickness., Cut into 3 x 3/4-inch strips or cut into shapes with small cookie cutters., Bake on ungreased baking sheet in 400° oven for 8 to 10 minutes or until lightly browned., Serve warm or cold., Makes about 40.

title: Vichysquash
directions: Saute onion in butter until clear., Add broth and cut up squash; cook until tender., Puree squash when cool; season and add cream when cold., Sprinkle top with chives., Can be served hot or cold.

title: Company Chicken Casserole
directions: Line casserole dish with pieces of dried beef. Lay chicken breasts on top. Combine sour cream and undiluted soup. Spoon evenly over chicken. Bake, covered, for approximately 45 minutes. Check; if chicken is tender uncover and bake about 5 minutes more.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Boil chicken and debone., Cut in bite size pieces. Save 1 cup of broth. Cook noodles in remaining broth. Combine remaining ingredients and add chicken and noodles. Bake in casserole dish at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Horseradish Sauce Variation-2
directions: Blend the ingredients and run through food processor., Once combined-refrigerate.

title: Low Cholesterol Pie Dough
directions: Mix ingredients together., Roll between wax paper., Makes enough for a double crust pie or two pie shells.

title: Frozen Cranberry Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients together and freeze in an 8 x 8-inch pan. To serve, let stand about, 15 minutes and cut into squares., Serve on a bed of lettuce., Serves 9 to 12.

title: Sour Green Beans
directions: Fry bacon until crisp; drain and crumble., Saute onion in bacon fat until transparent., Drain beans, reserving liquid. Combine vinegar, sugar and bean liquid and pour over beans and onion in baking dish., Microwave or heat in medium oven, covered., Sprinkle bacon over beans prior to serving.

title: Diabetic Pie
directions: Mix; add ingredients and pour into crust., Top with Cool Whip (optional).

title: Waldorf Salad
directions: Combine all ingredients and add salad dressing (amount desired)., Refrigerate.

title: Tater Tot Casserole
directions: Press ground beef into 8-inch casserole and salt and pepper it., Spread soup and top with Tater Tots., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes., (This recipe can be doubled and bake in 9 x 13-inch pan.)

title: Stuffed Meat Loaf
directions: Combine 1 cup stuffing mix with the tomatoes, ground chuck, and egg, mixing well with your hands., Prepare remaining stuffing mix as directed on package, following directions as if you were using all the bread., Divide the meat mixture in half., Drop chunks of half of the meat into 8 x 8-inch pan., Top with the prepared stuffing and press down gently., Layer the rest of the meat mixture on top., Again in chunks., Bake at 350°, for 45 minutes to 1 hour, depending upon the amount of meat used., Makes 9 servings.

title: Candied Walnuts
directions: Combine brown sugar, sugar and sour cream in a small saucepan., Cook over medium heat until it boils., Cook, to the soft-ball stage (240° on candy thermometer)., Stir in salt and vanilla., Pour hot candy over walnuts in a mixing bowl., Mix until walnuts are evenly coated., Spoon out onto waxed paper., Separate nuts., Allow to cool and set.

title: Nevada Annie'S Chili
directions: Saute onion, green pepper, celery, garlic and jalapeno pepper. Add meat and cook until it loses its redness., Combine chili powder, cumin, garlic salt, Tabasco, salt and pepper with 8 ounces beer (the other 4 ounces is for the cook!)., Let stand 2 minutes. Add to meat along with the remaining ingredients., Simmer, covered, on low heat for 3 hours.

title: Roseanne'S Shipboard Stroganoff
directions: Heat the gravy., Add the canned roast beef., Just before serving, add the yogurt and mix., Serve immediately over cooked egg noodles.

title: Watermelon Rind Preserves
directions: Clean rind by removing red meat and green outer part of rind. Cut rind and lemon into small pieces., Mix fruit and sugar; let set overnight., Cook mixture for about 1 hour, until thickened. Remove mixture from heat., Add 1/2 cup pectin and enough food coloring to give an attractive color., Seal preserves in jars.

title: Triple Chocolate Cake
directions: Cook pudding as per directions., Add to cake mix and mix well. Batter will be shiny., Pour mixture into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan., Sprinkle chocolate bits on top of cake., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes., One-half cup of chopped nuts can also be sprinkled on top of bits before baking., This is a most cake that keeps fresh for days.

title: Broccoli Supreme
directions: Cook broccoli until tender; drain., Chop into small pieces. Combine soup, mayonnaise, egg, onion, salt and pepper., Add to the broccoli., Pour into casserole dish and cover with cheese and cracker crumbs., Dot with butter., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Teriyaki Beef Jerky
directions: Mix sauce well and pour over thin sliced beef., Let marinate at least 4 hours., Place strips on wire rack over cookie sheet. Bake at 150° for 11 to 12 hours., Blot excess grease., Store in container with a lid at room temperature.

title: Pistachio Salad
directions: Mix altogether in large bowl., Chill and serve.

title: Potato Cheese Fritters
directions: Mix first 5 ingredients well., Shape into balls., Dip in well beaten egg; roll in crumbs., Fry in deep fat until crispy.

title: Stir-Fry Fajitas
directions: In a large skillet, fry meat in salad oil until tender., Add garlic, onion and rest of ingredients., Cook until desired tenderness., Serve mixture on warm tortillas topped with salsa and sour cream to your taste.

title: Peter Paul Mounds Cake
directions: Bake cake as directed on package in three 9-inch layer cake pans., Boil sugar, milk, marshmallows and coconut until marshmallows melt., Cool., Put between layers., Use frosting on top and sides.

title: Cranberry Salad
directions: Make jello according to directions., Chill until slightly set. Chop cranberries, apples and oranges in food processor. Add sugar according to taste. Add nuts and mix with jello. Chill.

title: New Waldorf Salad
directions: In a large bowl, gently toss together pineapple, apple, celery, grapes, walnuts and kiwi., In a small bowl, stir together the mayonnaise, yogurt and honey., Fold gently into fruit mixture. Cover and chill for 2 hours., Makes 6 to 8 servings, each containing 210 calories and 2 grams saturated fat.

title: Mud Pie
directions: Mix crushed wafers and butter., Press into a 9-inch pie plate. Cover with softened ice cream., Top with hot fudge., Freeze for 10 minutes., Top with Cool Whip and almonds., Freeze any leftovers.

title: Good Lite Cake
directions: Put pears in mixer., Add 1/4 cup Crisco oil and cake mix. Beat, then add eggs, one at a time., Beat well., Bake in tube pan at 350° for approximately 1 hour.

title: Sausage-Rice Casserole
directions: Cook rice., Add chopped onion and pepper., Cook sausage until done., Add with remaining ingredients to rice mixture., Place in casserole and bake until bubbly at 350°.

title: All-In-One Chicken
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Wash potatoes, but do not peel them. Cut them into quarters., Wash the carrots and cut them into 2-inch chunks., Peel onions and cut into wedges.

title: Sweetened Condensed Milk
directions: Combine all ingredients in electric blender., Process until smooth., Store in refrigerator., This makes 1 1/2 cups., You may want to add a little more water as it makes a thick milk.

title: Red Velvet Cake
directions: Mix together all ingredients; place in layer pans that have been greased and floured., Bake for 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Dump Cake
directions: Spread pie filling in bottom of 9 x 11-inch pan., Pour crushed pineapple over filling., Sprinkle cake mix over fruit mixture. Pour melted butter over all., Bake in 350° oven until top is brown, about 1 hour., Serve warm with ice cream.

title: Hot Crab Meat Spread
directions: Blend well., Put in Pyrex casserole dish., Bake at 375° for 15 minutes., Serve hot with crackers or French bread.

title: Easy Pecan Pie
directions: Combine eggs, sugar, corn syrup and butter., Cook over low heat until butter melts., Remove from heat and add vanilla and pecans., Pour into pie shell., Bake at 325° for 30 minutes.

title: Oven French Fries
directions: Wash, peel and cut potatoes lengthwise into "French fries." Toss with oil in a large bowl., Spread in a single layer on baking sheet., Bake at 450° for 20 to 30 minutes, turning once. Salt before serving, if desired.

title: Poor Man'S Steak
directions: In a large bowl, combine water, cracker crumbs and salt., Add beef and mix well., Press into a 15 x 10 x 1-inch baking pan lined with waxed paper., Cover and refrigerate overnight. Cut the meat into 12 squares. Coat each square lightly with flour. Brown in oil in skillet, a few pieces at a time. Drain. Remove waxed paper from the baking pan., Spread the soup in bottom of pan. Place meat squares in a single layer over soup. Bake, uncovered, at 300° for 35 to 40 minutes., To serve, spoon some soup over each meat square., Yields 12 servings.

title: Chicken Pineapple Salad
directions: Combine chicken, celery, pineapple, salt, lemon juice and mayonnaise., Stir in salted almonds., Chill in refrigerator. Serve on lettuce or endive., Makes 6 servings.

title: Mexican Chicken Casserole
directions: Layer ingredients as listed in a 9 x 13-inch casserole dish. Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Strawberry Delight
directions: Combine flour, brown sugar, pecans and margarine., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes, stirring often., Let cool., Combine strawberries, sugar, lemon juice and egg whites; beat at high speed about 20 minutes or until fluffy., Fold whipped cream into strawberry mixture., Remove 1/3 of crumb mixture from pan., Pat remaining crumbs into smooth layer., Pour strawberry mixture over crumbs in pan and sprinkle reserved crumbs over top., Freeze. Yields 8 to 10 servings.

title: Eggplant Casserole
directions: Peel eggplant, slice and boil in water until tender (5 to 10 minutes)., Drain and mash., Saute meat and onion in skillet., Add meat mixture, eggs, bread crumbs, cheese and seasoning to eggplant., Mix well; pour into a 2-quart casserole., Bake at 300° for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Cranberry Tea
directions: Mix all ingredients., Serve hot or cold., Contains 160 calories per serving.

title: Cinnamon-Frosted Zucchini Bars
directions: Grease 13, x, 9, x, 2-inch, pan., In a small bowl, beat butter for, 30, seconds.	Add sugars; beat until fluffy.	Add eggs and vanilla; beat well., Stir in flour., Stir in zucchini, coconut and, nuts.	Spread	in, pan., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.	Cool completely in pan.	Drizzle with frosting; cut into bars.

title: Spinach Balls With Mustard Sauce
directions: Combine spinach, stuffing mix, cheese, butter, scallions, 3 eggs and nutmeg., Shape into 1-inch balls., Refrigerate or freeze until ready to use., Bake on greased baking sheet at 350° until golden brown, 10 to 15 minutes, if thawed, and 20 minutes, if frozen., Makes 70 balls.

title: Oyster Cracker Snack
directions: Heat oil; add all seasonings except lemon pepper. Drizzle over crackers; shake in lemon pepper., Let stand overnight in airtight container., Occasionally turn upside-down.

title: Granny Eudell'S Chewy Brownies
directions: Mix and pour in a 13 x 9-inch pan., Bake in a 350° oven for 35 to 40 minutes., Cut while still warm.

title: Barbecue Sauce
directions: Mix catsup and mustard., Add sugar and spices., Mix remaining ingredients., Bring to boil for 15 minutes., Bottle up., Makes a little over 8 pints.

title: Dave'S Potato Salad
directions: Boil potatoes in skins and cool., Peel potatoes and chop in large 1/2-inch chunks., Add 1/2 mayo and mix carefully or with clean hands, if desired., Add veggies and salt and pepper to taste., Add remaining mayo and mix carefully., Chill and serve.

title: Bacon Wrapped Chestnuts
directions: Cut bacon in half, and wrap each chestnut., Secure with a toothpick., Bake 1 hour at 350° in a 9 x 13-inch pan., Place chestnuts in an ovensafe dish, (but, the one you want to serve them in)., Mix ketchup, sugar, and, soy, sauce, and, pour over chestnuts., Make sure they're all coated., Bake at 350° for 25 to 35 minutes., Great crowd pleaser!

title: Chocolate Chip And Raisin Cookies
directions: Combine flour and baking powder in medium bowl and set aside. Blend sugars in a large bowl, using an electric mixer set at medium speed.

title: Strawberry Ice
directions: Place strawberries in blender., Cover and blend until smooth. Microwave marshmallows and milk in large mixing bowl on High for 1 to 2 minutes or until smooth when stirred, stirring after 1 minute. Gradually add strawberries to marshmallow mixture, beating until well blended., Blend in juice and peels.

title: Million Dollar Pie
directions: Mix all ingredients together and pour into graham cracker crust. Refrigerate.

title: Dirt Pudding
directions: Crush Oreo cookies., Mix pudding and milk and set aside., Mix cream cheese, margarine and powdered sugar. Fold Cool Whip into pudding mixture., Layer in an oblong dish alternating crumbs with pudding mixture.

title: Stuffed Mushrooms
directions: Wash and remove stems from mushrooms., Chop stems., Set aside. Cook sausage until done., Drain well on paper towel.

title: Impossible Coconut Pie
directions: Beat eggs; add sugar and milk, then flour., Mix all remaining ingredients., Pour into 9-inch pie pan., Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes., This makes filling and crust.

title: Old-Fashioned Buttercream Frosting
directions: In small saucepan, stir flour and milk smooth., Cook over low heat until thickened, stirring constantly., Remove from heat; let cool., In bowl, cream butter, Crisco, sugar and vanilla., Add milk/flour mixture to butter mixture and beat with electric mixer until smooth.

title: Salted Nut Roll
directions: Butter a 9 x 13-inch pan and sprinkle 1/2 of the jar of peanuts, on, bottom., Melt	margarine and peanut butter chips. Add Eagle, Brand milk and stir, then add marshmallows and stir until coated., Pour marshmallow mixture over peanuts and press down. Sprinkle, rest of nuts on top and press down., Cool and cut into small pieces.

title: Sweet Potato And Apple Scallop
directions: Place in a buttered baking dish by layers, half of the sweet potatoes, cover with half of the apples, sprinkle with half the sugar, dot with half of the butter and sprinkle with half of the salt., Repeat the layers., Bake in a 350° oven for 20 to 25 minutes, until apples are tender.

title: Almond Puffs
directions: Mix margarine and peanut butter., Add vanilla., Gradually add sugar, working in as much sugar as possible., Dough will be stiff. Make nickel size balls., Line up on wax paper placed on cookie sheet and place on level surface in freezer for 1 hour.

title: Tuna Casserole
directions: Mix., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Skillet Casserole
directions: Put oil in skillet., Add hamburger, onions and green pepper. Brown., Pour off excess grease. Add tomatoes., Simmer 1 hour. Add macaroni and cook another 20 minutes or until tender.

title: Ham Loaf
directions: Combine, ham, pork, ground beef, cracker crumbs, pepper, eggs and milk., Shape into 2 loaves and place in greased baking dish. Combine, brown, sugar,, mustard, and, vinegar; pour over loaves. Bake 1 hour at 350°.

title: Grami Hurd'S Larded Grouse
directions: Grouse are rather dry birds and need to be larded to be palatable., Clean and wash quickly under running water., Cover bird entirely with thin slices of bacon, tying them in place with a crossing of soft string or toothpicks., Place the birds in a roasting pan and baste them with enough boiling water to use again and again., Roast in an oven (350°) for 45 minutes, basting frequently.

title: Chocolate Chex Mix
directions: Combine all cereals, nuts and pretzels., Melt chocolate in microwave., Pour over mixture., Mix well., Dry on wax paper. Break into pieces and enjoy.

title: Chicken Cordon Bleu
directions: Roll up chicken cutlets with 1 slice ham and 1 piece Swiss cheese., Put in toothpicks to hold together., Flour and brown cutlets (optional)., Put cutlets in casserole with 1 can cream of mushroom or chicken soup, diluted with about 1/2 can any white wine., Cook in oven for about 1 hour.

title: Fiesta Casserole
directions: Brown and drain the ground chuck. Add onions and green pepper. Spray a casserole dish with Pam. Spread the beans in the bottom of the dish. Add the meat mixture and black olives. Pour the soup over top and cover with a layer of grated mozzarella cheese.

title: Brunswick Stew
directions: Cook ground beef and onions together on low heat until done. Drain off fat., Add all the ingredients together and cook until thick, stirring often., If too thick, add more broth., Make about 5 quarts., This freezes well.

title: Pineapple Upside-Down Cake(A Light Moist Cake With A Tangy Fruit Topping)
directions: Lightly butter a 13 x 9-inch baking pan or two 8-inch square pans., Prepare Brown Sugar Topping and set aside., Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Combine Quick Mix and sugar in a large bowl., Mix well., In a small bowl, combine milk, eggs and vanilla. Add half of milk mixture to dry ingredients., Beat 2 minutes until batter is smooth., Add remaining milk mixture and beat 2 to 3 more minutes., Pat Brown Sugar Topping evenly over bottom of pan. Spoon crushed pineapple smoothly over topping., Spread batter over pineapple., Bake 45 to 50 minutes, until center springs back when lightly touched., Cool in pan 10 minutes, then invert onto a serving plate., Serve warm with pineapple side up., Makes one large cake or two 8-inch cakes.

title: Danish Cucumbers
directions: Peel and slice cucumbers thin., Sprinkle with the salt., Let stand at least an hour or overnight., A plate should be placed on top of cucumbers and weighted down., Drain and rinse well., While they are draining, mix the vinegar, sugar, salt and pepper., Pour over the cucumbers and let them stand at least 2 hours., Serves 6.

title: Stuffed Cabbage Rolls
directions: Mix ground beef, rice, onion, salt and pepper well., Form into good size balls and wrap in cabbage leaves., Fasten with toothpicks., Place in large pot; cover with canned tomato soup. Simmer for 45 minutes to an hour., Shredded cabbage may be placed between layers of rolls to give more flavor to the sauce., Serves 4 to 6.

title: Easy Chocolate Cake(Needs No Frosting)
directions: Mix all., Bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes., Serve with whipped cream or ice cream on top.

title: Easy Chicken Divan
directions: Cook broccoli or peas according to package directions in salted water until tender., Drain., Arrange peas or broccoli in greased 12 x 7 1/2 x 2-inch baking dish., Layer chicken on top. Combine next 3 ingredients and pour over chicken., Sprinkle with cheese., Combine crumbs and butter., Sprinkle over all., Bake at 350° about 35 minutes or until heated., Trim with pimento strips, if desired., Serves 6 to 8.

title: Hot Pepper Jelly(Fat-Free)
directions: *Sweet or green peppers may also be used.

title: Sausage Brunch(Serves 8)
directions: Put croutons in bottom of 8 x 12-inch Pyrex pan, then put 2 cups cheese on top, then loose sausage., Beat eggs, mustard and milk., Pour over top and let sit overnight in refrigerator., In the morning, pour over top 1 can cream of mushroom soup, mixed with 1/2 cup milk., Sprinkle 1/2 cup of cheese over this., Bake 1 1/4 hours at 300°.

title: Jumbo Raisin Cookies
directions: Add water to raisins and boil 5 minutes; cool., Cream shortening and sugar., Add eggs and beat well., Add vanilla and cooled raisins., Sift together the flour, baking powder, soda, salt, cinnamon and nutmeg., Add to raisin mixture and blend well. Add chopped nuts., Chill., Drop by teaspoon on greased baking sheet., Bake in a 400° oven for 12 to 15 minutes., Makes 5 dozen cookies.

title: Bear Claws
directions: Melt candy wafers and Crisco together., Mix all other ingredients in a large bowl., Pour melted candy over cereal and cool well., Drop by tablespoon onto wax paper., When firm, store in airtight container.

title: Banana Cake
directions: Add sugar gradually to shortening., Beat in lemon flavoring, vanilla, eggs and bananas., Sift flour, soda and salt., Beat in dry ingredients., Bake at 350° in two 9-inch round pans or 9 x 12-inch pan., Test at 25 minutes.

title: Homemade Summer Sausage
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Roll into 2 rolls, then wrap meat in foil., Refrigerate for 24 hours., Punch holes in the bottom of the rolls with a fork., Place the rolls on a rack in a baking pan., Bake at 325° for 1 1/2 to 2 1/2 hours., Yum Yum!!!!

title: Broccoli Soup
directions: Pour all ingredients into crock-pot and mix., (If you microwave Cheez Whiz as on label, it pours nicely.), Cook 6 to 8 hours on slow.

title: Cherry-Pineapple Strudel
directions: Preheat oven to 400°., Grease a 13 x 9-inch cake pan with butter., Spread can of pineapple (do not drain) in greased cake pan., Spread cherry pie filling over pineapple., Sprinkle yellow cake mix over pineapple and cherries., Sprinkle pecans over cake mix., Cut butter in small pieces and put on top of cake mix and nuts., Bake for 1 hour., Be careful not to burn pecans., Serve hot or cool.

title: Chocolate Icing
directions: Combine sugar, margarine and milk in a saucepan and bring to a boil., Boil 1 minute exactly., Add chocolate chips., Stir and cool until right consistency to spread. Add chopped nuts if desired., Frost cake or cookies while warm.

title: Vegetable Stroganoff
directions: Blend cream and yogurt until smooth; set aside., Microwave vegetables in a microwave-safe bowl on High for 5 or 6 minutes until cooked through., Cook noodles until tender; drain., Keep vegetables and noodles warm by placing in a 200° oven in a covered dish., Saute onion and mushrooms in oil until onion turns translucent., Add garlic; cook for another 3 minutes., Stir in Worcestershire sauce., Add 1/4 teaspoon of salt and pepper or to taste, if desired., Reduce heat to low., When ready to serve, stir cream-yogurt mixture to make sauce; heat through., Toss vegetables with noodles., Place on serving platter., Spoon sauce over top. Garnish with mixture of garnish ingredients., Serves 6.

title: Cream Cheese Pound Cake
directions: Cream margarine, cream cheese and sugar., Add eggs one at a time., Add vanilla., Slowly add cake flour., Pour into greased and floured tube pan or Bundt pan., Do not preheat oven., Bake at 300° for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Chewy Turtle Cake
directions: Pour boiling water over chocolate and stir until melted. Cool. Beat sugar and margarine until fluffy., Beat in egg yolks. Beat in chocolate mixture and vanilla on low speed.

title: Irresistible Peanut Butter Cookies
directions: Heat oven to 375°., Combine the first 5 ingredients in large bowl., Beat at medium speed until blended., Add egg and beat until blended., Combine flour, salt and baking soda., Add to creamed mixture at low speed., Drop by heaping teaspoonful 2 inches apart onto ungreased baking sheet., Bake for 7 to 8 minutes or until brown., Cool 2 minutes before removing from sheet.

title: Cheaters Jam Cake
directions: Mix cake by directions on the box and add flour., Fold in jam, raisins and nuts., Do not beat or mix with mixer., Flour and grease three 9-inch cake pans., Spoon batter equally into pans. Bake at 375° for 35 minutes, depending on your oven.

title: Chicken Lasagna
directions: Heat soup and cream cheese together., Layer all ingredients and bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Chicken And Homemade Noodles
directions: Place chicken (without skin) in large kettle of water, along with celery and celery salt., Cook for approximately 1 hour. Remove chicken and strip meat from bone., Return meat to water and add noodles., Cook for half an hour.

title: Beefy Rice
directions: Saute onion and mushrooms in butter., Mix rice, soup, salt and pepper., Bake at 350° for 1 to 1 1/2 hours or until rice is tender., Serves 4.

title: Peanut Butter Chocolate Chip Cookies
directions: Mix all ingredients. Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Cheddary Scalloped Potatoes
directions: Cook onion in margarine until tender., Add remaining ingredients; heat until boiling., Cover; reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes., Makes 4 servings.

title: Shrimp Dip
directions: Break up shrimp and blend with all ingredients., Chill several hours or overnight.

title: Artichoke Dip
directions: Drain water from artichokes and chop., Combine all ingredients., Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes., Serve with crackers.

title: Shrimp And Artichoke Casserole
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., Butter an oblong baking dish., Melt 4 1/2 teaspoons of the butter; blend in flour., Add milk and cream; cook, stirring constantly, until thickened., Add salt and pepper to taste; set aside., In remaining 2 teaspoons of butter, saute mushrooms gently for about 5 minutes., Arrange artichokes in a single layer on the bottom of prepared baking dish., Scatter shrimp over artichokes., Cover shrimp with a layer of mushrooms., Stir sherry and Worcestershire sauce into cream sauce; pour over contents of baking dish., Sprinkle with cheese and paprika., Bake for 20 to 30 minutes, or until bubbly (or refrigerate several hours and bake for 45 minutes)., Serve with rice.

title: Chocolate Souffl
directions: Mix first 3 ingredients in a sauce pan., Gradually add milk, stirring constantly, and heat to boiling., Remove from heat. Gradually add the beaten egg yolks to this mixture, and then stir in the melted butter., Set aside., Beat the next three ingredients with an electric mixer until foamy., Gradually beat in sugar until meringue forms stiff and glossy peaks., Gently combine the two mixtures and carefully pour into a well greased 6 cup souffl dish. Bake on lowest oven rack at 350 degrees for 1 hour., Serve immediately with fat free cool whip.

title: Broccoli Cornbread
directions: Mix 1 cup cornmeal, 1 heaping tablespoonful of flour, a little baking powder, salt to taste and a little grease., Add enough hot water to make soft mix., Have griddle hot and pour batter onto hot griddle., Turn over with spatula when brown on bottom.

title: Best Ever Baked Beans
directions: Brown hamburger and onions until done and drain., Mix all ingredients and put into a casserole dish., Place in preheated 350° oven for 30 minutes.

title: Suncoast Ham
directions: Combine first 6 ingredients; bring to boil., Brush sauce liberally on ham., Grill about 20 minutes on each side.

title: Nutty Bars
directions: Melt margarine and mix with crackers., Press into 9x13 baking pan., Layer coconut, chocolate and butterscotch chips, and nuts in order., Spread milk evenly over mixture.

title: Monkey Bread
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Lightly grease 12-cup fluted tube pan., Mix sugar and cinnamon in plastic food storage bag., Separate dough into 30 biscuits., Cut into quarters., Shake in bag to coat. Arrange in pan., Mix brown sugar and margarine., Pour over biscuit pieces., Bake 28 to 32 minutes or until golden brown and no longer doughy in center., Cool in pan 10 minutes., Turn upside down onto serving plate., Pull apart to serve., Serve warm.

title: Roast Lamb
directions: Crush garlic with salt and pepper., Mix with oil; spread on lamb., Sprinkle with marjoram, thyme, rosemary and flour., Pour wine and 1 cup water into pan., Roast in a 325° oven for 2 1/2 hours, basting frequently., Serves 6.

title: Strawberry Pie (Low-Fat)
directions: Dissolve Jell-O in hot water., Add cornstarch and sugar and boil until thick., Let gel for a few minutes in the refrigerator. Add strawberries and pour into crust., Chill in the refrigerator. Serve with whipped topping, vanilla ice cream or yogurt.

title: Italian Meatballs
directions: Soak the bread pieces in the wine; set aside., Combine the Italian sausage, eggs, mint and bread., Form into 24 meatballs. Brown the meatballs over high heat in a skillet, lightly greased with olive oil., Finish cooking the meatballs in a marinara sauce. Serve over spaghetti or other pasta.

title: Sweet And Sour Sauce
directions: Mix together all ingredients in a heavy saucepan., Simmer until sugar melts and sauce has thickened a little., Serve with chicken or pork.

title: Oatmeal Yeast Bread
directions: Add oats, molasses, salt and oil to boiling water., Let cool. Dissolve yeast cakes, in, water., Add to first mixture. Mix in flour, sifted., Let, rise, in greased bowl until double in size. Shape into loaves or, rolls., Let, rise 1 hour., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes., Makes 2 loaves or 2 dozen rolls.

title: Cheese Sauce
directions: Melt margarine in a pan., Mix in flour and salt. Add milk slowly, stirring until smooth. Cook and stir until sauce thickens. Add mustard and cheese. Stir over low heat until cheese melts. Makes 2 2/3 cups sauce.

title: Tacos
directions: Brown chopped meat, stirring often., Add salt and pepper to taste., Drain off fat., Put ground meat in a bowl., Everyone puts their favorite things on their own tacos., Eat and enjoy.

title: Crab Dip
directions: Clean crab meat., Combine ingredients, except almonds., Mix well and put mixture into a small baking dish., Sprinkle almonds on top., Bake at 370° for 15 minutes.

title: Susan'S Meat Loaf
directions: Combine in large bowl all above ingredients., Pat into a loaf size pan., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Beef Roast Cooked In Crock-Pot
directions: Put roast in crock-pot., On top of roast, put can of soup and the envelope soup mix., Cook on low., You will have gravy to serve on rice or noodles., You can cook on low overnight.

title: Chocolate Square Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Sift together flour, soda and salt., Add sugars, shortening, egg and vanilla., Beat until smooth (about 2 minutes)., Stir in oats and nuts., Shape dough into a roll; wrap and chill thoroughly., Slice and put on ungreased cookie sheets., Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes., Remove from oven and immediately place small square of milk chocolate bar on each., Remove from sheets and press pecan or walnut half into chocolate square.

title: Frosted Molasses Creams
directions: Thoroughly cream shortening and sugar., Add eggs and molasses. Mix well., Add coffee, then sifted dry ingredients., Beat until smooth., Pour into greased pan (12 x 18-inch)., Bake in moderate oven (350°) for 25 minutes or until done., While still warm, frost with confectioners sugar and butter or confectioners sugar with a little spoon of milk., Cool and cut in squares.

title: Taco Pie
directions: Thaw shells 10 minutes before baking 10 minutes at 400°. Reduce heat to 350°., Brown beef; drain., Add seasonings and fix as package directs., Mix refried beans and half of salsa., Layer crust with half beef, bean mixture and cheese., Repeat layer. Bake 25 minutes., Put rest of salsa on top., After baking, add lettuce and tomato., Serve., (We use sour cream on ours, too.) Enjoy.

title: Summertime Salad
directions: Break cauliflower and broccoli in small pieces; dice onion. Crumble bacon., Mix together rest of ingredients, then add all together and stir well., Put in refrigerator for at least 1 hour before serving.

title: Never Fail Chocolate Frosting
directions: Combine sugar, cocoa, oleo and milk., Stir until sugar dissolves over medium heat., When mixture comes to a rapid boil, boil one minute., Remove form heat., Add vanilla., Cool and beat. Spread on thin cake layers.

title: A Love Cake For Mother
directions: Mix well and bake in hearty warm oven and serve to mother everyday., She ought to have it in big slices.

title: Low-Fat Autumn Medley Stew
directions: In a large soup kettle, simmer chicken breasts in the broth. Add the onion as the chicken simmers., When chicken is fully cooked, remove and set aside.

title: Chicken Pasta Stir-Fry
directions: In large skillet, heat oil., Add broccoli and carrots., Stir over medium heat until tender-crisp., Add next 5 ingredients; cook until chicken is done., Stir in pasta, onions and cheese; heat thoroughly.

title: Cherry Yum-Yum
directions: In a 9 x 13-inch glass dish, pour pie filling on bottom. Spread evenly., Sprinkle dry cake mix over pie filling., Melt butter and pour over cake mix., Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Pizza Muffins
directions: Put pizza sauce on half of English muffin., Sprinkle with shredded Mozzarella and bake until cheese is melted., Serve.

title: Strawberry Milk Punch
directions: Place strawberries and sugar in mixer bowl., Beat with electric mixer until well blended., Combine with milk and ice cream in punch bowl., Serves about 25.

title: Orange Pineapple Cake
directions: Beat eggs, oranges (with juice) and oil., Blend in cake mix. Grease 3 round cake pans., Divide cake mixture into pans., Bake at 350° for 25 minutes., Blend Cool Whip, pineapple and pudding together., Spread generous amount between layers and over cake. Refrigerate overnight before cutting., Keep refrigerated.

title: Honey Poppy Seed Dressing
directions: Mix all ingredients together in order given., Blend in blender or mixer until oil disappears., Yield: 2 cups.

title: Dumplings
directions: Mix well., Drop by small spoonfuls into hot soup., Cook 12 minutes.

title: Filled Sugar Cookies
directions: Prepare the filling using raisins, sugar, water and flour. Cook until thick., Set aside to cool.

title: Banana Split Cake
directions: Mix graham crackers and 1 stick melted butter., Beat for 5 minutes., Place in a 9 x 13-inch pan., Mix powdered sugar, eggs and 2 sticks melted butter., Spread on graham cracker crust.

title: Thousand Island Dressing
directions: Using a wire whisk, combine all ingredients in a small bowl. Refrigerate until well chilled., Serve over tossed green salad. Yields 2 cups., One tablespoon serving contains 54 calories and no cholesterol.

title: Zucchini Pancakes
directions: Coarsely grate zucchini., There should be 2 cups, lightly packed down., Beat egg., Add zucchini, Bisquick, salt and cheese; mix well., In a large skillet, fry tablespoons of mixture in a little butter until lightly browned., Keep warm in oven while frying rest of batter.

title: Primavera
directions: In a large skillet, saut garlic in oil., Add vegetables and basil and saut until almost tender., Add chicken broth and mushrooms., Bring to a boil, quickly reduce heat and cover. Simmer for 5 minutes., Mix well., Serve over pasta cooked al dente. Sprinkle with grated cheese., Serves 6.

title: Batter
directions: Beat ingredients until smooth., Cover onion, mushrooms, fish, etc., with batter and deep-fry for 2 to 3 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Chop Suey
directions: Cut pork in small pieces and place in small amount of oil on stove in large heavy pan with salt and pepper., Cook slow until juice is drawn out (do not brown)., Cover and cook about 40 minutes., Add celery and soy sauce; cook 20 minutes., Add onions and cook 10 minutes., Add mushrooms and cook another 10 minutes. Add cornstarch and bring to boil; add beans sprouts and water chestnuts., Cook slowly until juice is clear., Good.

title: Russian Borscht
directions: Make vegetable soup with first five ingredients, including beets (if using raw ones)., Add canned beets (if using canned) when soup is almost done., Add tomatoes and generous amount of dill weed (to your own taste of course)., Serve with dollop of sour cream or cottage cheese.

title: English Scones
directions: Rub the butter and flour until they resemble fine bread crumbs. Stir in the baking powder, sugar and sultanas., Add the milk to make a sticky dough and turn onto a floured surface., Knead gently, then roll flat (about 1-inch thick) and cut out circles., Place on floured baking tray., Brush with milk., Bake at 220°C for 10 to 20 minutes., Spread with butter and jam to taste.

title: Double Good Blueberry Pie
directions: Combine sugar, cornstarch and salt in saucepan., Add water and 2 cups of blueberries., Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until mixture is thickened and clear (mixture will be quite thick)., Remove from heat., Stir in butter and lemon juice. Cool., Place remaining 2 cups raw blueberries in pie shell., Top with cooked berry mixture., Chill., Serve garnished with whipped cream.

title: Strawberry Bread
directions: Combine flour, sugar, cinnamon, baking soda and salt in a large bowl., Add oil and eggs; mix well., Stir in strawberries, pineapple, raisins and pecans., Pour batter into 2 greased and floured loaf pans., Bake 1 hour and 15 minutes at 350°., Remove from pans; cool., Wrap loaves in foil tightly overnight to mellow.

title: Make Ahead Breakfast
directions: Cook sausage until brown or done; drain well., Spread bread cubes in 12 x 8 x 2-inch buttered baking dish., Top with sausage, then cheese., Combine eggs, milk, salt and mustard; beat well. Pour over cheese., Cover and refrigerate overnight., Bake at 350° for 50 minutes or until set.

title: Old Fashioned Vinegar Candy
directions: Melt butter in heavy pan; add sugar and vinegar., Stir until sugar dissolves; wash down sides of pan with pastry brush dipped in cold water., Boil mixture to brittle stage (256°); pull and cut into small pieces with scissors or knife., Arrange on buttered plate to cool.

title: Hot Sandwich Supreme
directions: In small saucepan blend soup, flour and onions and 3/4 cup Milnot., Cook over low heat until mixture comes to a boil (stir constantly to prevent scorching)., Remove from heat, stir in chicken and pimento., Spread in 8 x 8-inch or 9 x 9-inch pan. Chill until thick., Cut in 4 squares and place on each of 4 slices of bread, top with other bread., Cut in halves or quarters., Beat eggs and remaining Milnot together., Dip sandwiches in egg mixture, then in potato chips., Sprinkle with almonds., Place on greased cookie sheet, bake at 350° about 30 minutes.

title: Chicken Pie
directions: Place chicken in 9 x 13-inch baking dish., Cook diced potatoes and carrots until tender., Drain and add along with peas, covering the chicken pieces., Pour soup over all., Mix melted oleo, flour and milk together., Pour over soup and spread evenly., Bake at 350° for 40 minutes or until done.

title: Sausage Bake
directions: Cook sausage, red pepper, onion, sage, garlic powder, salt and pepper until done., Spoon mixture into greased 9-inch round baking dish.

title: Bouillabaisse
directions: Combine first 10 ingredients in large stock pot and cook over moderate heat until vegetables are softened., Add clam juice and water and bring to brisk boil., Add shellfish, monkfish and then squid., Cover and gently simmer until fish is cooked., Stir in Pernod and sprinkle with parsley just before serving.

title: Eggplant Casserole
directions: Cook eggplant;	mash., Mix, soup,, onion, egg, salt and pepper; add, to, eggplant.	Add, 1 cup of herb stuffing; toss. Pour into, casserole dish.	Sprinkle remaining stuffing on top and dot with butter., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Sour Cream Chicken Enchiladas
directions: Mix soup, sour cream, onion, Ro-Tel and 2 cups of cheese in large bowl. Dip tortillas in hot oil and drain on paper towels. Put 2 tablespoons of mixture on each tortilla and roll up. Place, seam side down, in a large baking dish. Cover enchiladas with the remaining mixture and top with remaining 2 cups of cheese. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Salmon Loaf
directions: Combine all; pour into greased pan., Bake at 350° for approximately 45 minutes., Serve with white egg sauce.

title: Shrimp Scampi
directions: Melt margarine and add garlic, salt, pepper, parsley, scallions and lemons., Grease a large shallow pan and place shrimp in single layer on bottom of pan., Pour butter mixture over shrimp., Place under broiler for 5 minutes, until pink., Remove. Serve on bed of rice., Can pour butter sauce over rice.

title: Pastor'S Delight
directions: Liberally spread cheese on Spam; frost like cake., Decorate with whole cloves., Give to pastor with our delight.

title: Golden Parmesan Potatoes
directions: Peel potatoes., Cut into large pieces., Combine flour, cheese, salt and pepper in a bag., Moisten potatoes with water and shake a few at a time in bag, coating pieces with cheese mixture., Melt butter in a 13 x 9-inch baking pan., Place potatoes in a layer in pan., Bake at 375° for about 1 hour, turning once during baking. When golden brown, sprinkle with parsley.

title: Carolyn'S Ice Cream
directions: Add sugar to beaten eggs; beat until stiff., Add remaining ingredients., Use a Number 2 can crushed pineapple (drained). This was a recipe of Carolyn T. High., Freeze in ice cream churn.

title: Spaghetti Bake Casserole
directions: Brown hamburger, butter, onion and green pepper., Cook spaghetti as directed; drain., Mix hamburger mixture, spaghetti, tomato soup and corn., Put in a 13 x 9-inch casserole dish., Cover liberally with cheese., Bake for 1 hour at 350°.

title: Pineapple Cottage Cheese Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients., Make day before so it will sit in refrigerator several hours.

title: Toll House Kookie Brittle
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., Combine butter, vanilla and salt in bowl and blend well., Gradually beat in sugar., Add flour, chocolate morsels and 3/4 cup walnuts., Mix well., Press evenly into an ungreased 15 x 10 x 1-inch pan., Sprinkle remaining 1/4 cup walnuts, over top and press in lightly., Bake at 375° for 25 minutes until golden brown., Cool., Break into irregular pieces. Can cut into bars when warm, if desired., Makes about 1 3/4 pounds.

title: Tiramisu
directions: In medium mixing bowl, beat cream cheese and sugar with electric mixer until well combined. Add milk and beat 2 to 3 minutes until light and fluffy.

title: Marinated Rabbit
directions: Cut rabbit into serving size pieces., Cover with marinade containing the ingredients and marinate overnight at room temperature., Save the marinade and brown the meat in a baking pan at 375° for about 30 minutes.

title: Stuffed Peppers
directions: Halve and clean out peppers., Mix all ingredients together well., Fill pepper shells with mixture., Put a little water in bottom of Pyrex dish., Cook on 350° for approximately 1 hour.

title: Double Lime Chiffon Salad
directions: Drain pineapple reserving juice., Dissolve gelatin in boiling water; add reserved juice., Cool until slightly thickened; beat until frothy., Fold in pineapple, cottage cheese, mayonnaise and nuts., Place in 13 x 9-inch pan or mold., Refrigerate until firm. Yield:, 12 servings.

title: Deep-Fried Turkey
directions: Fill the injector needle of a bulb baster with salad dressing and squirt under skin., Tie legs together with one end of a 30-inch string., Pour oil to depth of 5 to 6 inches into a deep pot of a propane cooker; heat to 325°., Carefully lower turkey into hot oil using string; fry 30 minutes or until meat thermometer inserted in turkey registers 185°., (Temperature of oil drops immediately after turkey is placed in it; oil may not reach 325° again.), Remove turkey from oil and cool slightly before slicing.

title: Fresh Tomato-Basil Sauce
directions: Prepare the first 2 ingredients; place together in bowl. Cover and refrigerate overnight.

title: Vidalia Onion Classic Casserole
directions: Saut sweet onions in butter until transparent. Add chicken broth, sherry and flour. Cook and stir. When slightly thickened, transfer to medium casserole. Top with bread crumbs and both cheeses., Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes or until lightly browned and bubbly.

title: Frozen Cranberry Salad
directions: Mix together and freeze.

title: Cranberry Crunch
directions: Grease 10-inch quiche or pie plate., Spread cranberries over bottom of dish., Sprinkle with 1 cup sugar and pecans., In small bowl at high speed, beat eggs until frothy., Add 1 cup sugar; beat well at low speed., Add flour, shortening and margarine., Pour batter over berries and nuts., Bake 1 hour or until golden at 325°.

title: Fruit Cocktail Bars
directions: Mix together fruit cocktail, vanilla, eggs and sugar., Add flour, soda, salt and brown sugar., Mix and pour into greased and floured cookie sheet., Bake 30 minutes at 325°.

title: East India Chicken(Serves 6)
directions: Combine flour, curry powder, salt and pepper in paper bag. Add chicken pieces and shake until lightly coated., Brown chicken in butter., Sprinkle onion, raisins and rice over chicken. Dissolve bouillon cubes in boiling water and add to chicken. Reduce heat., Cover and simmer 45 minutes or until chicken is tender.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
directions: In a large saucepan, combine margarine, milk and sugar over medium heat., Stirring constantly, bring to a boil., Continue stirring until mixture reaches the soft ball temperature on a candy thermometer or until a drop of the mixture in the water forms a ball., After reaching soft ball stage, remove mixture from heat and add vanilla, peanut butter and Marshmallow Creme., Stir until smooth., Pour into 9 x 13-inch greased glass dish., Let cool.

title: Macaroni Cheese Twist
directions: Cut up green, pepper, and, garlic;, fry, in, pan with 4 tablespoons oil until tender., Stir in tomato sauce and water. Simmer 10 minutes.	Add, cheese (cut in 1/2-inch cubes)., Stir into mixture., Serve over hot macaroni.

title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
directions: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs, 1 at a time, until you have all eggs beaten with sugar and butter. Add sour cream, 1/3 at a time, then 1 cup flour. Continue with the sour cream and flour. Add vanilla and lemon. Beat until smooth. Grease tube cake pan. Bake 1 1/2 hours at 325°.

title: Pineapple Cheese Salad
directions: Put eggs in pan., Drain pineapple and add to eggs. Beat together. Add sugar and flour to juice and cook until thick. Pour over pineapple, marshmallows and cheese in a bowl. Stir and chill.

title: Pull Apart Cheese Loaf
directions: Mix melted margarine/butter and garlic powder., Dip biscuits in this and put in a greased loaf pan so they are standing vertically (4 rows of 5 biscuits)., Mix green onion and grated cheese., Put about 1 teaspoon of mixture between each biscuit until it is gone. Pour any leftover melted butter/garlic mixture over the top., Bake 25 to 35 minutes or until golden brown in a 375° oven.

title: Angel Food Cherry Dessert
directions: Crumble angel food cake into bite size pieces., Prepare pudding according to directions, then mix whipped topping with pudding., Put cake pieces in a 9 x 13-inch pan and top with the pudding mixture., Chill., Top with cherry pie filling and chill again.

title: Jim'S Favorite Zesty Bell Pepper Slaw(This Recipe Can Be Prepared In 45 Minutes Or Less.)
directions: Coarsely chop cabbage, bell peppers and scallions. In a bowl, whisk together mayonnaise, yogurt, vinegar and cayenne. Add vegetables, basil and salt and pepper to taste; toss well. Chill slaw, covered, 20 minutes.

title: No Bake Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Boil sugar, milk and butter at a hard boil for one minute., Put into a bowl and add cocoa, peanut butter and vanilla., Last, add your oats and mix well., Spoon onto foil or wax paper until firm.

title: Mystery Artichoke Appetizer
directions: Blend all ingredients together thoroughly and pour into greased baking dish., Note:, Onion and artichoke may be chopped separately in food processor, pulsing carefully., Sprinkle with paprika and bake at 350° for 1/2 hour.

title: Pickled Onions
directions: Drop onions in boiling water., Boil 3 minutes., Drain., Place in cold water., Cut root end; squeeze stem end to remove onion skin., Combine 2 cups water and pickling salt; pour over onions. Let stand 12 hours., Drain; rinse thoroughly., Combine vinegar, sugar and pickling spices; bring to boiling., Pack onions into hot jars, leaving 1/2-inch headspace., Cover with pickling liquid, leaving 1/2-inch headspace., Adjust lids and process in boiling water bath (half-pints) for 10 minutes.

title: Honey Walnut Fruit Salad
directions: Blend honey and mayonnaise until smooth. Toss remaining ingredients with lemon juice. Stir in honey mixture. Refrigerate until ready to serve. Makes 7 cups.

title: Ann'S Salad
directions: Mix well and refrigerate overnight.

title: Golden Puffs
directions: Mix all ingredients together and drop by teaspoon into hot oil., Fry until golden brown on each side., Drain and shake in brown bag containing cinnamon and sugar or powdered sugar., Makes a great after school snack.

title: Brownies
directions: Mix sugar, oleo, eggs, vanilla and cocoa until smooth., Add flour and salt., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

title: Chocolate Peanuts Candy
directions: Melt chocolate chips on stove at low heat until completely melted., Add peanuts and Chinese noodles., Mix well., Drop by tablespoon into cupcake wrappers., Sprinkle with powdered sugar. Let chill in refrigerator until you're ready to serve.

title: Creole Muffins
directions: Sift flour, baking powder, salt, sugar and corn meal together. Combine eggs and milk and add to dry ingredients, stirring only enough to moisten., Add oil, butter, peppers, onion, pimiento and cheese., Combine, stirring only enough to moisten., Do not overstir., Place in greased muffin tins. Bake at 400° for 20 to 25 minutes., Makes 3 1/2 to 4 dozen.

title: Marbled Cheesecake Bars
