directions: Preheat oven to 300°., Combine crumbs, cocoa, sugar and margarine; press firmly on bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan., In large mixer bowl, beat cream cheese until fluffy; beat in condensed milk until smooth., Add eggs and vanilla; mix well.

title: Dr. Bird Cake
directions: Measure and mix dry ingredients in large mixing bowl., Add eggs, oil, pineapple with juice and bananas., Stir to blend; do not beat., Pour into 9-inch tube pan and bake at 350° for 1 hour and 20 minutes.

title: Cheesecake
directions: Put softened cheese and milk together and mix until smooth. Add lemon juice and vanilla and blend., Pour into 9 ounce pie shell., Chill for 3 hours.

title: Strawberry Pie
directions: Mix sugar, cornstarch and salt. Add water gradually, stirring until smooth. Bring to a boil, stirring constantly until thick. Reduce heat; cook 2 or 3 minutes longer, until clear and transparent. Remove from heat; add lemon juice and drop of red food coloring. Fold in sliced strawberries. Pour in baked and cooled pie shell. Top with Cool Whip; chill. Enjoy!

title: Beef Stroganoff
directions: Brown onions in oil and add paprika and stir well., Add meat. Cover and simmer a few minutes., Add rest of ingredients., Cover and simmer until done., Add more water or broth, if needed during cooking., Add sour cream, gradually., You may want to use less than the full 8 ounces., If mixture is too thin, you may want to thicken it a little.

title: Onion Cheese Dip
directions: In 2-quart saucepan, combine soup mix, tomatoes and cheese over medium heat., Heat to boiling, stirring often., Remove from heat. Stir in sour cream., Serve with tortilla chips or fresh vegetables for dipping., Makes 2 1/2 cups., Preparation time:, 5 minutes.

title: Scotch Raisin Bread
directions: Beat eggs until light., Add sugar gradually while beating; stir in milk and molasses., Beat well., Sift dry ingredients (except oatmeal and nuts) together.

title: Ham Roll
directions: Spread cream cheese on ham slices. Place pickles on cream cheese and roll up like a jelly roll. Cut into desired size.

title: Mint Surprise Cookies
directions: Sift flour, soda and salt; set aside., Cream butter and shortening., Add sugars gradually; mix well., Add eggs, water and vanilla; beat well., Blend in dry ingredients; mix well., Dough may be chilled.

title: Cheese Wedges
directions: In a bowl, mix flour, corn meal and chili powder., Add butter, milk and egg., Stir until just moistened., Press mixture into nine-inch square pan., Bake at 350° until mixture is lightly browned and begins to pull away from sides of pan (about 25 minutes)., Mix cheese, chilies and green onions; spread over hot mixture., Return to oven and bake until cheese melts (about 15 to 20 minutes)., Serve either hot or cold., Makes 12 pieces.

title: Hobo Beans
directions: Brown ground beef and onions., Drain., Drain juice from butter beans and kidney beans., Add the 4 beans and salt and pepper to taste., Add a pinch or two of chili powder and bring to boil. Then turn to low and let simmer.

title: Baked Round Steak
directions: Preheat oven to 350°; place round steak in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan., Spread cream of chicken soup over steak., Shake Lipton onion soup mix over other soup., Bake for 40 to 45 minutes., Serve over rice.

title: Peanut Butter Logs
directions: Cream margarine and peanut butter in mixing bowl until light. Add confectioners sugar gradually, beating until fluffy., Stir in cereal., Shape by level tablespoonfuls into logs., Roll in peanuts., Place on waxed paper., Melt chocolate chips and paraffin wax in double boiler over hot water, stirring., Drizzle over logs., Chill until serving., Makes 2 1/2 dozen.

title: Vegetable Casserole
directions: Mix Veg-All, corn, soup and sour cream together., Put mixture into a casserole dish., Sprinkle crushed crackers over casserole. Pour melted margarine over casserole., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Corn Bake
directions: Combine all ingredients in 9 x 13-inch baking dish, sprayed with Pam., Mix well., Bake at 400° for 45 minutes or until golden brown ontop.

title: Fruit Punch
directions: Mix orange juice as directed., Mix 1/2 of orange juice, 1/2 of, Ginger ale, and 1/2 gal. pineapple sherbet., Add rest of ingredients as needed., Will serve approximately 50 to 60 people.

title: Potato Chip Cookies
directions: Mix butter or margarine with sugar; add flour, crushed potato chips, vanilla and chopped (finely) pecans., Drop by teaspoon on oiled cookie sheet., Bake at 350° for 15 minutes or until light brown., Sprinkle with confectioners sugar while warm.

title: Shrimp Mousse(Appetizer For A Large Crowd.)
directions: Rinse shrimp well., Set aside., Dissolve gelatine in boiling water., Set aside., Bring tomato soup to a boil., Add cream cheese. Let it melt into soup., Add mayonnaise., Mix well., Add celery, onion, chives, parsley and shrimp., Stir well., Pour into prepared ring mold or fancy fish mold that has been sprayed with Pam vegetable oil., Place into refrigerator overnight., Unmold onto platter or tray that has been lined with lettuce leaves., Serve with crackers.

title: Rice Casserole
directions: Melt butter in skillet., Saute onion and broccoli until tender (about 20 minutes)., Combine rest of ingredients., Combine all ingredients., Pour into lightly greased loaf-baking dish., Bake about one hour at 350°., Serves about 20.

title: Mousse
directions: Stir well, but do not use electric mixer., For variety, add desired amount of one or more of the following ingredients: apples, nuts, raisins, dates, chocolate chips, cocoa or drained fruit cocktail, or up to 4 bananas (overripe)., Bake in a floured and greased Bundt pan at 350° for 40 to 50 minutes., Cool on a rack for about an hour., Turn over onto serving plate.

title: Rhubarb Crunch
directions: In a bowl, mix together 1 cup sugar, 2 tablespoons flour and diced rhubarb., Pour into an 8 or 9-inch baking dish and dot with butter.

title: Dilled Shrimp Dip
directions: Blend milk gradually into cream cheese., Stir in lemon juice, shrimp, Worcestershire sauce, garlic salt and dill., Cover; refrigerate at least 1 hour before serving., Serve with crackers.

title: Punch
directions: Combine all ingredients in large punch bowl.

title: Raisin Molasses Gems
directions: Beat shortening and 1 cup sugar until light and fluffy., Add molasses and egg; beat well., Combine flour, soda, cinnamon, cloves, ginger and salt., Add to molasses mixture; mix well., Stir in raisins., Cover., Refrigerate until chilled., Shape into 1-inch balls., Roll each in sugar., Place 2 inches apart on oiled cookie sheet., Bake in upper third of preheated 350° oven for 10 to 12 minutes., Makes 3 dozen.

title: Emergency Lasagna
directions: Brown ground chuck in a skillet; drain. Add spaghetti sauce and oregano; heat until warm. Put 8 ounces of sauce on bottom of a 13 x 9 x 2 or equal size pan. Layer uncooked lasagna, sauce, cottage cheese, Mozzarella and Parmesan cheese. Repeat layers until ingredients run out; end with cheeses. Bake at 350° for 40 to 50 minutes. Remove from oven and let stand 15 minutes before serving. Good with garlic bread and tossed salad.

title: Flank Steak
directions: Place steak flat in shallow baking dish., Mix all ingredients and pour over steak., Let stand all day, turning occasionally or refrigerate overnight., Barbecue 5 minutes on each side or broil 2 minutes on each side., Cut diagonally into thin strips.

title: Pumpkin Tea Bread
directions: Preheat oven to 350°. Position rack in center of oven. Generously butter a 9 x 5-inch metal loaf pan and set aside. Sift flour, baking soda, salt, cinnamon, ginger and nutmeg into a medium bowl or onto a large sheet of waxed paper spread on work surface. Set aside.

title: Banana Quick Bread
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Beat shortening until creamy and glossy., Gradually add sugar, beating until light and fluffy after each addition., Add eggs and beat until thick and pale lemon color., Sift dry ingredients; add alternately with bananas., Blend thoroughly after each addition.

title: Apple Crisp
directions: Sprinkle apples with cinnamon, salt and water., Rub together flour, sugar and butter., Drop mixture over apples., Bake in buttered 10 x 6 x 2-inch dish., Bake at 375° for 40 minutes. Yields 6 servings.

title: Vegetable Dip
directions: Mix together and bake 20 minutes at 350°., Stir again and serve., Serve with any vegetables.

title: Pizza Bake
directions: Boil spaghetti for 9 minutes; drain., Add milk and beaten eggs; mix well., Put into buttered 9 x 13-inch pan., Brown ground beef until crumbly; drain and place on top of spaghetti., Pour pizza sauce on top of ground beef., Layer onion slices, pepper slices, mushrooms and pepperoni., Sprinkle with Mozzarella cheese. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

title: Cereal Mix
directions: Provide each child with covered margarine tub., Have available various measuring cups and spoons., Instruct children to make a snack mixture by using various measuring tools., Encourage them to compare amounts measured.

title: Crunchy Snack Mix
directions: Combine pretzels, cereals and nuts in 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Cook and stir brown sugar, oleo and corn syrup in a medium saucepan over medium heat until mixture comes to a boil., Let the mixture boil without stirring for 4 minutes., Remove heat.

title: Hot Tamale Pie
directions: Brown ground beef and onions in skillet., Drain any grease and add tomatoes, corn and tomato paste., Put in bottom of 2-quart casserole dish.

title: Chicken With Artichoke Hearts
directions: Combine flour, salt, paprika and pepper., Roll chicken in flour mixture to coat very lightly, shaking off excess., Spoon 2 tablespoons oil from top of artichokes into skillet and heat. Place chicken in pan and saute, browning slowly over moderate heat. Turn to brown on all sides., Add onion when chicken is almost browned., Spoon off any excess fat., Add wine, heat to boiling, then cover., Simmer 10 to 15 minutes or until chicken is tender. Saute nuts in butter until lightly browned., Set aside., Add artichokes to chicken., Mix cornstarch with remaining marinade, then gently stir liquid into skillet., Simmer 1 minute, until slightly thickened., Remove chicken and artichokes to serving dish. Spoon liquid over chicken and sprinkle with toasted nuts.

title: Au Gratin Potatoes
directions: Add pepper and cheeses to hot white sauce; stir until cheese melts. Combine sauce and potatoes and pour into 2-quart casserole. Toss crumbs with margarine and sprinkle over potatoes. Bake at 350°, for 35 minutes., Garnish with chopped olives.

title: Apricot Jello Salad
directions: Bring first 3 ingredients to a boil; let cool., Whip Pet milk; add sugar, celery, apple and nuts., Add Jell-O mixture and refrigerate.

title: Lemon Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Mix all ingredients together., Pour into greased jelly roll pan., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes., Let set a minute.

title: Japanese Cookies
directions: Cream the sugar with the butter., Add the remaining ingredients., Shape into two rolls; chill until firm., Cut 1/4-inch thick and bake 30 minutes at 300°., Sprinkle with powdered sugar while warm.

title: Lorraine Priest'S Peanut Butter Bonbon
directions: Mix powdered sugar and cracker crumbs., Heat margarine and peanut butter over low heat until melted., Stir into crumb mixture. Press in ungreased baking pan 8 x 8 x 12-inch., Heat chocolate chips in small saucepan over low heat, stirring frequently until melted., Spread over crumb mixture., Refrigerate until firm, about 30 minutes., Cut into one inch squares (3 dozen candies) or shape into one inch balls and dip in mixture of chocolate chips and one tablespoon of shortening.

title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
directions: Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy., Add eggs, two at a time; beat well after each., Add flour and sour cream alternately, beginning and ending with flour., Add soda and extract last., Bake in greased and floured large tube pan for 1 1/4 hours at 325°.

title: Pecan Pie
directions: Mix syrup, sugar, salt, butter and vanilla., Add eggs; pour into 9 inch unbaked pie shell., Sprinkle with pecans., Bake at 350° for about 45 minutes.

title: Macaroni And Cheese
directions: Mix all ingredients and bake at 400 degrees until brown.

title: Corny Squares
directions: Mix sugar and syrup in boiler; boil for 1 minute., Add peanut butter and vanilla., Stir without heat until smooth., Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan., Mix cornflakes and peanut butter mix in pan., Cut squares when cool.

title: Shrimp Jambalaya
directions: Spray saucepan with nonstick cooking oil., Place onion over medium heat., Saute onion until clear., Add all ingredients, except shrimp., Stir well., Add shrimp; cover and cook on very low heat for 35 minutes., Uncover and toss rice., Cover again and cook very slowly until rice is done., Yields 2 servings.

title: Italian Meat Loaf
directions: Combine bread and milk in a small bowl., Beat egg in large bowl; add oregano, salt, pepper and garlic., Add beef and cheese; mix well., Bake at 350° for one hour.

title: Corn Bread Salad
directions: Cook 3 or 4 pieces of bacon until crisp., Crumble cool bread and crumble; add remaining ingredients., Toss lightly and moisten with Miracle Whip., Cheese is good in this., Mix all but bacon in with Miracle Whip, then pour over bread and bacon., Toss., Serves 6.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
directions: Cook chicken, debone and reserve broth., Cut chicken in approximately 1-inch pieces., Put in large pan the potatoes, carrots, onions, peas and celery; cook until tender., Add 1 to 2 cups of broth and mix with cornstarch., Mix vegetables and 3 cups of cooked chicken., Pour broth, etc., over all and put in large baking dish., With mixture hot and bubbling, put biscuits on top and bake at 400° for 15 to 25 minutes or until biscuits are done and browned.

title: Cornmeal Chicken Saute
directions: Pound chicken to 1/2-inch thickness., Place flour in plastic bag., Beat eggs in shallow bowl or pie plate., Combine cornmeal, cumin, salt and cayenne pepper in another pie plate., Place chicken, 2 pieces at a time, in bag with flour and shake to coat. Remove chicken and dip in egg., Roll in cornmeal mixture, pressing to coat., Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat., Add chicken and cook until brown and cooked through., Place on platter; top with sour cream and picante sauce.

title: Cherry Salad
directions: Bring to boil the sugar, orange juice, lemon juice and juice from the can of cherries. Remove from heat and add jello. Dissolve jello and then add cherries and nuts.

title: Fresh And Frosty Lemonade
directions: Combine lemon juice and sugar., Add water, stirring., Serve over ice in glasses and garnish with lemon slices.

title: Layered Macaroni Shrimp Salad
directions: In large salad bowl, layer greens, macaroni, 1 1/2 cups cheese, tomatoes, shrimp, peas and cabbage., Combine mayonnaise and Italian dressing., Pour over salad., Top with remaining cheese., Cover and refrigerate several hours.

title: Club Salad
directions: In a large bowl, combine the salad, chicken, tomatoes, and bacon. Drizzle with dressing and toss to coat. Serve immediately. Yield: 6 servings, ready in 15 minutes or less.

title: Thanksgiving Cranberry Salad
directions: Grind cranberries fine., Add pineapple and sugar., Stir well. Let stand in refrigerator overnight (covered)., Two hours before serving, whip cream., Add nuts., Place in a serving bowl and chill.

title: Sausage Cornbread Bake
directions: Preheat oven to 425°., Grease 10-inch skillet., Brown sausage and onion; drain well., Combine eggs, cornmeal, corn, milk and oil., Pour half of mixture into skillet., Sprinkle with sausage mixture and cheese., Pour remaining batter over top., Bake 30 to 40 minutes., Let cool 10 minutes before serving.

title: Chew Bread
directions: Melt butter in a saucepan., Pour in light brown sugar., Mix together., Add eggs, flour and flavoring., Add as many pecans as you like., Pour in a 9 x 13 pan and bake at 350° for about 20 minutes., When middle of bread falls, take out of oven., If you don't take out of oven when it falls, it won't be as moist.

title: Hot Apple Cider
directions: For a handy accent to the last coffee break of the day, do this:, Make your coffee as you usually do, but then add a quarter teaspoon of almond extract., Voila!

title: Sweet Potato Pie
directions: In a large mixing bowl, combine sweet potatoes, sugar, cinnamon, ginger, nutmeg and salt., Add eggs; with a fork, lightly beat eggs into sweet potato mixture., Add the evaporated milk; mix well., Place a pastry lined 9-inch pie plate on oven rack; pour in sweet potato mixture slowly., Cover edge of pie with foil., Bake in a 375° oven for 25 minutes., Remove foil., Bake for 25 to 30 minutes more or until a knife inserted off-center comes out clean. Cool on wire rack., Cover and chill to store., Serves 8.

title: Peach Cobbler
directions: Mix flour, 1 cup sugar and milk., Melt butter in a 2-quart baking dish., Pour batter over butter., Toss 2 cups of peaches with 1 cup sugar and pour over batter., Do not stir., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Coconut Cake
directions: Prepare cake as directions on box., After it cools, cut each layer in half, making 4 layers., Put sour cream in dish with lid. Add sugar and mix well., Cover with lid and chill for 3 hours. After 3 hours, add thawed coconut to mixture and stir well. Spread on each layer of cake and place in sealed cake plate in refrigerator for 24 hours.

title: Beef Stew
directions: Cook vegetables in broth and seasoning mix until tender. Remove from heat., Drop in cooked beef which you have removed all visible fat., Remove from heat and cover so meat will heat through.

title: Southern Gizzards
directions: Heat oil in iron skillet on medium-high heat., Dip gizzards in whipped eggs and roll in flour or pancake mix., Put as many as you can get in the skillet., Turn every 5 minutes for about 20 minutes or dark brown.

title: Zucchini Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients together and put into greased casserole. Bake 45 minutes to 1 hour at 350°.

title: Kentucky Pecan Pie
directions: Beat white syrup, sugar, salt, butter and vanilla. Add eggs and pecans. Pour into unbake pie shell. Sprinkle pecans over all. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Cream Sticks
directions: Put yeast in warm water; scald milk, then add your oleo in hot milk to melt., Put together when cool, then add yeast, well beaten eggs, vanilla and sugar., Add flour., Put in warm place until double in bulk., Roll out and cut in pieces, about 1/2 x 3 1/2-inches long., Let rise again., Fry in deep vegetable oil. Cut top of stick open and fill with filling., Ice with brown sugar frosting.

title: Pineapple Casserole
directions: Place pineapple in a Pyrex baking dish., Mix flour, sugar, pineapple juice (the 3 tablespoons) and margarine or butter., Pour over pineapple chunks., Top with cheese, then cracker crumbs. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

title: Chocolate Walnut Pie
directions: Melt together chocolate chips, evaporated milk and butter or margarine., Remove from heat and add flour, salt, sugar, eggs (mixed well) and walnuts.

title: Winona'S Mocha Torte
directions: Blend dry cake mix, cinnamon and clove in large mixing bowl. Prepare cake according to package directions., Divide batter into three 8-inch glass baking dishes., One at a time, microwave 4 minutes and 30 seconds to 5 minutes or until a wooden pick comes out clean., Let stand 5 minutes, then turn out immediately onto a cake rack.

title: Yeast Biscuits
directions: Dissolve yeast in warm water with 1 tablespoon sugar., Add shortening, salt, 1 tablespoon sugar and flour., Mix well., Pour out on floured board and knead a few times, then cut out and place in a pan., Grease top and let rise in a warm place until double in size, about 1/2 to 1 hour., Bake at 400° until brown., Makes about 1 1/2 dozen.

title: Baked Chili Cheesy Dip
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Mix all ingredients., Spoon into a 1-quart casserole dish., Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until thoroughly heated. Stir before serving., Serve hot with toasted bread slices or tortilla chips., Makes 4 cups.

title: Butterscotch-Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Cream shortening and sugars., Add beaten eggs and hot water; mix well., Add flour and soda., Add vanilla and oats; mix well. Add chips and nuts., Drop by teaspoon onto baking sheet., Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: All-Season Salad
directions: Combine cranberry sauce and lemon juice in bowl; mix well. Spoon in lightly oiled mold., Freeze until firm.

title: Carrot Cake
directions: Mix sugar, oil and eggs; add rest of ingredients and bake for 1 hour at 350°.

title: Martha Odom'S Cookies
directions: Cream sugar, margarine and Crisco., Add egg and beat well., Add vanilla with sifted flour to which soda and salt have been added. Pinch off pieces the size of walnuts and place one inch apart on cookie sheet; flatten with hand or glass which has been floured.

title: Polenta With Cheese
directions: Bring water to boil, add salt and sprinkle in cornmeal, stirring constantly., Cook over low heat for 40 minutes., Polenta is cooked when it begins to leave the sides of the saucepan., Add cheese and cook, stirring constantly, for 5 minutes.

title: Stuffed Green Peppers
directions: Wash peppers, cut a thin slice from stem end and remove seeds. Cover with boiling salted water and simmer 5 minutes., Drain.

title: Pink Snowstorm
directions: Combine punch, milk and ice cream in an electric blender. Blend until smooth and frothy., Pour into tall glasses., Makes 3 to 4 servings.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Mix first 4 ingredients well., Pour into a greased baking dish., Sprinkle some crackers over top., Sprinkle with paprika. Bake in 350° oven for 40 minutes.

title: Lasagne
directions: Brown meat in 3-quart saucepan; drain., Add sauce; simmer for 10 minutes., Cook lasagne according to package directions; drain. (Separate lasagne and lay out flat on wax paper or aluminum foil to keep pieces from sticking together as they cool.)

title: Forgotten Cookies
directions: Mix well and place heaping teaspoonful of mixture on cookie sheet., Preheat oven to 350°., Turn oven off and put in cookies for 2 hours or overnight., Store in airtight container.

title: Chicken Salad
directions: Mix chicken, almonds, pineapple and celery with enough Miracle Whip to make it hold together., Season to taste with salt, pepper and Greek seasoning.

title: Tuna Ball
directions: Mix with a fork all ingredients, except parsley flakes., Roll into ball and roll in parsley flakes., Chill and serve with crackers.

title: Scalloped Corn
directions: Combine corn, sugar, eggs, milk, pepper and 3/4 cup of cracker crumbs in casserole., Sprinkle remaining 1/4 cup of crumbs on top and dot with butter., Bake at 400° for 20 to 30 minutes., Yields 6 servings.

title: Fruit Kabobs
directions: Remove stems from strawberries. Cut bananas, pineapple, apples, cantaloupe and honeydew into chunks., Place fruits in a bowl. Add Fruit-Fresh and orange juice concentrate, stirring gently., Let stand for 1 hour or longer. Arrange fruits and marshmallows on skewers. Sprinkle each kabob with a small amount of sugar.

title: Calico Beans
directions: Fry hamburger, bacon and onion., Drain off fat., Add remaining ingredients., Bake in 350° oven for 1 hour.

title: Javanese Pork Sate
directions: Cut tenderloin(s) in half., Blend remaining ingredients together., Marinate pork in mixture for 10 minutes., Grill or broil for 10 to 12 minutes, turning when needed., Serve with hot cooked rice, if desired., Serves 4.

title: Oreo Spider Cookies
directions: Scrape filling out of Oreo cookies., Cut red licorice into thin strips (to look like spider legs)., Put frosting on an Oreo piece; drape red licorice over frosting so that the licorice hangs out both sides., (Use however many red strips you want for however many legs you want.), Put an Oreo piece on top to form cookie. Put little dots of frosting on top for eyes., Enjoy this fun treat!

title: Taco Salad
directions: Brown meat; drain., Add seasoning mix and simmer 15 to 20 minutes; set aside.

title: Quick And Sassy Spaghetti Sauce
directions: Brown ground steak in large skillet., Add garlic and onion. When tender, add all other seasonings., Continue to simmer for 1 minute; add tomato sauce, spaghetti sauce and water., Stir until meat is completely mixed with sauce; simmer for 20 minutes., Stir to keep from sticking. Serve sauce over pasta with garlic bread. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Hungarian Goulash
directions: Cut beef cubes in pieces about one-inch square or smaller. Cut up onions medium fine., Fry onions in oil until brown., Add paprika and stir., Add water, about 4 cups., Simmer until beef is nearly tender., Add potatoes (cubed pieces)., Cook until potatoes are done., Eat as is or pour over noodles or rice.

title: Bar-B-Q Sauce
directions: Pour water, vinegar, syrup and mustard into a large pan. Beat with a portable mixer until smooth. Add butter and bring to a boil, stirring constantly until butter melts., Lower heat and simmer for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally., Makes enough sauce for 5, - 3 1/2 to 4 lb. whole fryers split down the breast and cooked over a charcoal fire., Makes 1 gal. sauce.

title: Italian Spaghetti Sauce
directions: Brown meat real well; add onions and brown., Add all ingredients except sugar and herbs., Cook for 1 1/2 hours; add herbs and cook another 1 1/2 hours., Add sugar at very end., Serve over spaghetti and sprinkle with grated Parmesan cheese.

title: Bacon And Chicken Sandwiches
directions: Combine chicken, celery, onion, yogurt and pepper in small bowl., If desired, place lettuce leaf on bottom of each bun; place pineapple ring on lettuce., Top each with one third of the chicken mixture and bacon., Makes 3 servings.

title: Barbecue Sparerib Sauce
directions: Mix all sauce ingredients together and pour over ribs., Bake for 1 hour or until done.

title: Fruit Dip
directions: Cook pudding with milk and stir until thick., Cover; cool to room temperature and whisk., Fold in Cool Whip, Amaretto and brandy., Serve with any type of cut-up fresh fruit.

title: Cherry 'N Apple Dump Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Combine pie filling, apples and lemon juice., Pour into an 8 1/2 x 11 1/2-inch glass baking dish or a size larger., In medium bowl, cut margarine into cake mix until crumbly., Add pecans and sprinkle evenly over pie filling., Bake 40 to 45 minutes or until golden brown., Serve warm with ice cream or plain anytime.

title: Sausage Hors D'Oeuvres
directions: Crumble ground beef and sausage, fry and drain well., Add spices and Worcestershire sauce., Melt cheese with meat over low heat., Serve on party rye., (Place on cookie sheets and freeze. Reheat 8 to 10 minutes at 350°.), Serves 24.

title: Hawaiian Cake
directions: Combine., Stir with a spoon, putting into 3 greased and floured pans., Cook at 350° until done.

title: Easy Fudge
directions: Mix butter, milk and pudding mix together. Bring to a boil and boil for 1 minute, stirring continuously. Remove from heat and add confectioners sugar, vanilla and nuts. Pour into a buttered pan. Chill before cutting.

title: Brownies
directions: Sift flour and salt., Melt butter with cocoa., Put sugar, eggs and vanilla into a large bowl; beat for 2 minutes., Add butter and cocoa mixture; then add flour mixture., Mix well.

title: Tangy Dill Dip
directions: Blend all ingredients thoroughly. Refrigerate overnight. Serve with raw vegetables.

title: Chocolate Pie
directions: Mix together flour, sugar, and cocoa., Add egg yolks and milk., Cook over medium heat until thick., Remove from heat and add margarine and vanilla., Pour into baked pie crust., Top with meringue and brown.

title: Caramel Corn
directions: Spread popcorn out in a 17 x 12 x 2-inch baking pan; set aside., For caramel mixture, in a heavy saucepan, combine the brown sugar, margarine, corn syrup and the salt., Cook and stir over medium heat until mixture starts to boil., Continue cooking for 5 minutes., Remove caramel mixture from, heat; pour over popcorn., Toss quickly to coat., Bake the caramel-coated popcorn in a 300° oven for 15 minutes., Stir popcorn., Return to oven; bake 5 to 10 minutes more, or until well coated., Gently stir in the peanuts, if desired., Turn caramel popcorn out onto foil. Cool; break up into 1-inch pieces., Store in the Tupperware cereal storer., Makes about 10 cups.

title: Foolproof Pie Crust
directions: Put first 3 ingredients in a large bowl and mix well with a fork., Add shortening and mix with a fork until ingredients are crumbly., In a small bowl, beat together with a fork the water, vinegar and egg., Combine the two mixtures, stirring with a fork until the ingredients are moistened., Divide the dough into 5 parts and with hands shape each portion into a flat, round patty ready for rolling., Wrap each in plastic or waxed paper and chill at least 1/2 hour., Dough may be left in the refrigerator for up to 3 days or frozen, until ready to use.

title: Holiday Ham Balls
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Lightly grease a 15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 1-inch jelly roll pan., Mix all ingredients thoroughly., Shape mixture into 1-inch balls., Place about 2 inches apart in pan. Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until brown., Immediately remove from pan., Serve warm., Yields about 7 dozen appetizers.

title: Ginger Lemon Tea
directions: In a large saucepan, combine the water, sugar, ginger and lemon peel strips. Bring to boiling; reduce heat. Simmer, uncovered, for 10 minutes. Remove ginger and lemon strips with a slotted spoon and discard. Place tea bags in a tea pot. Immediately add simmering water mixture. Cover and let stand 3 to 5 minutes. Remove tea bags and discard. Serve immediately in mugs. If desired, garnish with lemon slices.

title: Cheese Rounds
directions: Combine flour, salt, pepper and paprika; stir well., Cut in butter until mixture looks like coarse meal., Add cheese; stir well., Roll dough to 1/3-inch thick on floured surface., Cut with a 1 3/4-inch biscuit cutter., Place on greased baking sheet., Bake at 450° for 15 minutes., Yields about 4 dozen.

title: Tater Tot Casserole
directions: Lightly brown ground beef and drain. Place browned meat in bottom of greased shallow 2-quart baking dish. Spread onion rings over top. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Spread soup over onion rings. Cover with Tater Tots. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until hot. Makes 6 servings.

title: Chocolate Pie
directions: Mix first 3 ingredients., Stir in milk., Add egg yolks and butter., Cook until thick., Pour into baked pie crust (add vanilla before you put in crust)., Top with egg whites, beaten until stiff.

title: Savory Turkey Casserole
directions: Heat oven to 375°. In large bowl, combine contents of seasoning packet, poultry seasoning and water; mix well., Add soup; blend well. Add potato slices, turkey, carrots, celery and onion, stirring until thoroughly combined. Spoon mixture into ungreased 2-quart casserole dish. Bake at 375° for 35 to 40 minutes or until potatoes are tender.

title: Oyster Cracker Munchies
directions: Mix and pour over crackers., Let sit several hours.

title: Cherry Torte
directions: *Blueberry may be substituted for cherry.

title: Asparagus Spears With Garlic Mustard
directions: In 10-inch skillet, place asparagus spears; add enough water to cover., Bring to a full boil., Cook over medium heat until asparagus is crisply tender (5 to 7 minutes)., Drain; return to skillet., Add remaining ingredients, pushing asparagus to side just until butter is melted., Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until heated through (5 to 7 minutes)., Makes 4 servings.

title: Corn Flake Candy
directions: Cook sugar and syrup until boils, then remove from heat., Add peanut butter., Stir peanut butter in sugar and syrup., Pour mixture over corn flakes., Press corn flakes and mixture into a sugar pan., Let cool, cut in squares and eat.

title: Deep Dish Brownies
directions: Grease an 8 x 8 x 2-inch square pan. Blend together butter, sugar and vanilla., Ad eggs. Beat well with spoon., Combine flour, cocoa, baking powder and salt. Gradually add to egg mixture, beating until well blended. Stir in chips., Spread into pan. Bake in a 350° oven for 40 to 45 minutes., Cool and cut into squares. Makes 16 brownies.

title: Meat Loaf
directions: Mix all together., Spread it evenly over bottom of 8 x 8-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

title: Velvety Homemade Pumpkin Pie
directions: Cook 1/2 fresh pumpkin in oven., Remove seeds to use later in a snack., Cook until soft., Scoop out and mash., Mix sugar and seasonings with mashed pumpkin., Add eggs, one at a time., Add evaporated milk., Place pumpkin pie mixture into unbaked homemade pie shell., Bake at 450° and cook for 10 minutes., Lower heat to 350° and bake for about another 40 minutes or until a knife inserted comes out clean.

title: Strawberry Delight
directions: Dissolve Jell-O in water; then add frozen strawberries and let thaw in Jell-O., Chill until partially set, then fold in whipped cream., Tear half the cake into small chunks and spread in bottom of square pan, 8 x 8-inch., Spread half the strawberry mixture over cake and repeat layer of cake crumbs, ending with strawberry mixture., Chill at least 3 hours.

title: Devil'S Food Cake
directions: Sift flour with sugar,, soda and salt., Stir shortening to soften., Add flour mixture, 1, cup, milk, and vanilla., Mix until flour is dampened., Beat 2, minutes, at, medium speed of electric mixer., Add eggs,, melted chocolate and remaining 1/3 cup milk. Beat 1 minute longer., Pour, into, two, greased and floured 9-inch layer pans., Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

title: Coconut Bread Pudding
directions: Line a well-buttered pan with white bread slices cut in quarters., Spread coconut on top of bread., Mix milk, sugar, eggs and vanilla with a spoon., Spoon enough to soak bread, then layer bread and milk until done., Dot top with margarine., Sprinkle with sugar, brown sugar, cinnamon, nuts, raisins and coconut., Bake at 350° until brown., This is a good way to use old biscuits, rolls and bread.

title: Japanese Fruit Cake
directions: Sift flour 3 times before measuring. Add baking powder and salt and sift again. Cream butter and sugar thoroughly. Add eggs one at a time, beating well after each addition. Add 1/3 flour and blend well. Add 1/2 milk and blend well. Add another 1/3 flour and blend, then the other 1/2 milk and finally, the last 1/3 flour and blend well. Pour 2/3 batter into 2 pans which have been lined with wax paper. To remaining 1/3 batter, add 3/4 teaspoon each cinnamon and allspice, 1/4 tsp. cloves and 1/4 pound of raisins, chopped fine. Pour into cake pan which has been lined with wax paper. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Chicken And Macaroni Casserole
directions: Boil chicken breast until tender., Remove from pot., Remove skin and bones., Shred or dice chicken., Strain broth and put in a clean pot., Save 1 cup broth., Cook macaroni in broth until tender., Cook carrots and celery until tender., Cook cauliflower and broccoli together.

title: Blueberry Muffins
directions: Combine flour, salt, baking powder and sugar., Add eggs, milk and oil., Add cinnamon and blueberries., Pour into greased muffin pans., Bake at 375° for 15 to 20 minutes., Makes 12 muffins.

title: Baked Beans
directions: Mix well., Bake in 350° oven until done.

title: Banana Ice Cream
directions: This is for a 5-quart maker.

title: Grilled Lemon Dill Fish
directions: Mix mayonnaise, lemon juice, dill and lemon peel., Place fish on greased grill over medium coals., Brush with 1/2 of the mayonnaise mixture., Grill 5 minutes, turn., Brush with remaining mayonnaise mixture., Grill an additional 5 to 8 minutes or until fish flakes easily with fork.

title: Cool Whip Salad
directions: Drain fruit and mix together.

title: Pam'S Stuffed Peppers(Serves 3)
directions: Cut stem ends from peppers; remove seeds and cut peppers in half., Cook peppers in a small amount of water; cover., Cook in microwave oven on High power for 2 to 3 minutes., Remove from microwave and water., Combine remaining ingredients., Mix well. Stuff peppers with mixture., Place in baking dish., Pour tomato sauce over mixture in peppers., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Fresh Strawberry Pie
directions: Wash and hull strawberries and pat dry., Place berries in medium size bowl., Add glaze and toss gently to coat., Arrange in baked pie shell., Refrigerate until thoroughly chilled., Serve with whipped cream, if desired.

title: Miracle Cake
directions: Mix flour, soda, cocoa and sugar., Add Miracle Whip, warm water and vanilla., Beat until smooth., Pour batter into greased and lightly floured 8-inch layer or 9 x 13-inch cake pan., Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes or until done., Frost with icing when cool., Also makes 18 cupcakes., Buttercream frosting is very good on this cake or use your favorite icing, also.

title: Pumpkin Bread
directions: Mix oil, sugar, pumpkin, eggs and vanilla well. Mix all ingredients together. Spray 3 (1 pound) coffee cans and pour mix equally in each can. Bake for approximately 1 hour or until toothpick comes out clean.

title: Apple Crisp
directions: Combine dry ingredients., Cut in margarine until mixture resembles coarse meal., Stir in nuts., Layer half the apples and dry mixture into an 8-inch square baking pan., Repeat layers. Bake at 350° until apples are tender, about 30 minutes.

title: Chess Cake
directions: Mix first 3 ingredients., Grease a 9 x 13-inch cake pan., Press into pan., Mix cream cheese, confectioners sugar and 3 eggs., Pour over mix in pan., Bake 45 minutes at 350° or until done.

title: Grilled Tomatoes With Oregano
directions: Preheat the broiler., Core the tomatoes and slice them in half., Grease a baking dish (large enough to hold the tomatoes) with 1 tablespoon of oil., Arrange the tomato halves in it, cut side up., Sprinkle each with about 1/2 teaspoon oregano and salt and pepper., Sprinkle about 1 teaspoon oil over each half., Broil for about 5 minutes.

title: Pineapple-Carrot Cake
directions: Mix dry ingredients together., Add oil and blend., Add eggs and mix., Add carrots, nuts and pineapple., Mix well., Bake 30 to 45 minutes at 350° in a 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Mounds Bars
directions: Cream butter and brown sugar., Add flour and press into 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.

title: Pineapple Mint Freeze
directions: Stir together first two ingredients, and let stand several hours or overnight., Add rest of ingredients and mix well., Pour in container and freeze (8 x 8-inch or 9 x 9-inch dish works well)., Serve frozen; if not all used, it refreezes well for next meal.

title: Pineapple Layer Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Grease and flour two 9 inch round cake pans., Prepare, bake and cool cake mix according to directions on box., Place one cake layer on serving plate., Spread with 1/2 of pineapple preserves., Spread about 4 oz. of Cool Whip on top. Place second cake layer on top., Frost top and sides of cake with remaining Cool Whip., Coat top of cake with remaining pineapple preserves., Garnish sides with shredded coconut., Refrigerate at least 1 hour before serving.

title: Shrimp Creole
directions: Cook shrimp according to directions but reserve 1 cup liquid. Fry bacon until crisp., Saute onions, peppers, celery, garlic and parsley in skillet until tender., (Do not add bacon at this time; drain and reserve until later.), Add tomato sauce, tomato paste, reserved shrimp liquid, red pepper, black pepper, salt, sugar and bay leaf to ingredients that are sauteed., Bring to boil., Reduce heat and simmer covered 30 minutes., Add shrimp and bacon (crumbled)., Bring to a boil; simmer 5 minutes., Serve over rice. Serves 4 to 5 adults.

title: Barbecue Ribs
directions: Brown ribs., Combine remaining ingredients in baking dish over ribs., Cover and bake 2 1/2 hours at 350°, basting 2 or 3 times during baking.

title: Sweet Jammies(Muffins)
directions: Heat oven to 375°., Grease muffin tins., Mix dry ingredients. Melt margarine., Off heat, stir in milk and yogurt., Beat in egg and vanilla. Add mixture to dry ingredients. Stir well., Spoon half of the batter into 12 muffin tins. Place 1 teaspoon of jam over batter in each cup and top with remaining batter. Bake 15 to 20 minutes until golden brown., Let stand 5 minutes before removing from tins. Sprinkle confectioners sugar over top.

title: Zucchini Bread
directions: Mix well the eggs, salad oil and sugar., Add the remaining ingredients., Grease and flour 2 loaf pans., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Smoky Salmon Spread
directions: Blend all ingredients until smooth. Makes approximately 1 cup.

title: Snowball Cake
directions: Soften gelatin in cold water; add boiling water and stir until dissolved., Add sugar, lemon juice and pineapple, including juice. Chill until partially firm., Whip 2 envelopes Dream Whip according to directions on box., Fold into gelatin mix., Cut or break cake in small pieces., Arrange alternate layers of cake and gelatin mixture in pan until all is used., Chill overnight., Next morning, prepare remaining 2 packages of Dream Whip., Spread over cake., Garnish with coconut and cherries., Refrigerate until just before serving.

title: Beef And Macaroni
directions: Cook macaroni and cheese as directed on box., Cook ground beef with onion; when done, drain grease., Mix in bowl of tomatoes and milk, then add macaroni and cheese., Mix well, then pour into dish and bake in oven at 350° for about 20 minutes., Remove and serve.

title: Broccoli Cornbread
directions: Mix all ingredients in a large casserole dish., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: French Onion Soup
directions: Preheat oven to 400°., Saute onions in 4 tablespoons butter until golden., Add stock and boil 10 minutes., Season to taste with salt and pepper., Put toast in one large casserole or small individual bowls., Add soup and top with Mozzarella or Muenster cheese., Bake until top is golden brown (5 to 10 minutes).

title: Five Cup Salad
directions: Drain oranges and pineapple., Mix all ingredients together and let set for several hours in the refrigerator to blend the flavors.

title: Crab Spread
directions: Chop onion and combine with garlic, cheese and milk, mix well. Spread cheese mixture over bottom of 8 inch pan. Coarsely chopped tomato and bell pepper. Finely snip parsley. Combine tomato, bell pepper, 2 T. parsley, lemon juice and salt. Sprinkle over cheese mixture. Top with crabmeat. Sprinkle with remaining parsley. Chill. Serve with crackers or fresh vegetables.

title: Zucchini Bread
directions: Mix in the order given and bake in 2 greased loaf pans for 50 to 60 minutes at 325°., When done, bread freezes very well.

title: Mango Fruit Parfait
directions: Put the mango and orange juice in a blender and puree until smooth., Slice 20 of the strawberries, leaving 4 whole., Line the bottom of 4 balloon wine glasses with the sliced strawberries. Pour a thin layer of the mango puree over each to cover.

title: Pecan Pie
directions: Beat, eggs;, add, other mixture., Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake in 325° oven for about 45 minutes.

title: Kahlua Pecan Pie
directions: Cream butter, sugar, vanilla and flour., Beat in eggs, one at a time., Stir in kahlua, corn syrup, evaporated milk and pecans; mix well., Bake at 400° for 10 minutes, then bake at 325° for about 40 minutes.

title: Banana Bread
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Grease and flour loaf pan. Sift flour, baking powder and salt together., Beat sugar, shortening and eggs for 3 minutes at medium speed on mixer., Add sifted dry ingredients alternately with bananas, beginning and ending with flour mixture., Blend well after each addition., Stir in nuts. Put in pan., Bake for 60 to 70 minutes.

title: Chili Relleo Casserole
directions: Butter bread. Trim crusts (optional). Place buttered side down in baking dish. Sprinkle grated cheeses over bread. Spread green chili over. Mix milk, eggs and spices. Cover and chill overnight. Bake, uncovered, for 50 to 60 minutes until top is brown at 325°. Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

title: Easy Taco Pie
directions: Crumble corn chips in bottom of pan and add refried beans, ground beef, salsa, black olives and last Monterey Jack cheese. Bake at 300° for approximately 30 minutes., After baked, top with sour cream.

title: Hamburger Casserole
directions: Saute onion and garlic in small amount of oil., Add hamburger; cook until browned well., Add chili powder, Mexicorn, tomatoes and tomato sauce., Cook in Dutch oven about 35 minutes with lid on. Cook shells until tender; drain., Add layers of shells, sauce and grated cheese and repeat until all is used., Good also with small can of mushrooms., Cook in 350° oven until cheese has melted well.

title: Elephant Stew
directions: Cut elephant in bite-size pieces., Boil for 4 weeks, add vegetables and seasonings., Simmer for 1 week., Will serve 1,000 people., If you have unexpected company, add the rabbit. Everybody likes a little hare in their stew.

title: Fruit Cocktail Cake
directions: Mix eggs, flour, sugar, soda and fruit cocktail in large bowl. Bake in 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan for 30 minutes at 350°., Leave in pan.

title: Fruited Pistachio Pudding
directions: In large bowl, combine pudding mix, whipped topping and salad dressing., Mix well., Fold in remaining ingredients., Leave in bowl or put in individual dishes., Chill., Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Favorite Buttermilk Pancakes
directions: In, bowl mix flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt and sugar., In another bowl, beat eggs about 1 minute on high speed until light and fluffy., Pour eggs over flour mixture., Pour in buttermilk., Add, butter., Fold, together, entire mixture until flour is just moistened., Bake pancakes on greased, hot griddle using about 1/4 cup of mixture to make a 4 to 5-inch pancake.

title: Squash Patties
directions: Combine the first 6 ingredients., Beat with electric mixer until smooth., Add remaining ingredients; stir well., Drop mixture by tablespoons into a hot, greased skillet., Cook until golden brown, turning once., Drain on paper towels., Yields about 2 dozen patties.

title: Ham, Cheese And Mushroom Calzones
directions: Combine mushrooms, onion, garlic and basil with half the broth in a 10 to 12-inch frying pan over medium-high heat., Stir often until vegetables are browned and begin to stick in pan, about 8 minutes. Add remaining broth. Stir to scrape browned bits from pan; cook until liquid evaporates., Stir in flour and ham., Remove from heat.

title: Banana Bread
directions: Cream shortening and sugar., Add separately beaten eggs., Add mashed bananas, flour, baking soda and salt to cream mixture. Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

title: Chicken In Wine(Serves 6)
directions: Place chicken pieces in flat baking dish., Combine flour and 1/4 cup sour cream., Blend until smooth; add remaining sour cream, salt, soup and wine., Pour over chicken., Sprinkle with almonds, pimientos and paprika., Bake at 325° about 1 1/2 hours or until chicken is tender.

title: Special Occasion Punch
directions: Mix together. Serve in bowl with an ice ring.

title: Hamburg Macaroni Soup
directions: Cook meat until brown, then drain., Chop onion, green pepper and mushrooms., Cook 5 minutes., Add seasonings., Add tomatoes and use cans for water (1 can tomatoes to 1 can of water)., Cook to boiling., Cook macaroni; drain., Add to mix., Enjoy.

title: Cherry Slush
directions: Bring first 2 ingredients to a boil; add jello., Stir until dissolved., Add almond extract and pineapple juice., Add 1 1/2 juice cans of water., Put this mixture into freezer and let freeze solid, 6 to 8 hours., Set out of freezer before serving., Put in large container or punch bowl, then add your choice of clear beverage., Serve partially thawed or slushy.

title: Curry Dip
directions: Mix well all ingredients., Great with raw vegetables.

title: Tomato Pie
directions: Bake pie shell at 425° for 5 minutes., Reduce heat to 400°. Place tomatoes sliced thick into crust., Add salt, pepper, basil and onion., Mix mayonnaise and cheese., Spread over top of pie. Bake for 35 minutes or until browned.

title: Stuffed Baked Orange With Yams
directions: Cook yam until tender, peel and beat smooth., Add margarine. Mix other dry ingredients together and set aside., Squeeze the juice from oranges., Cut oranges in half and set aside., Add dry ingredients to yams., Add milk and vanilla., Mix well., In each orange half stuff yam mix to top., Bake at 350° until light brown on top of yams.

title: Fried Spaghetti
directions: Boil 5-quart pan of water., Put in spaghetti and cook to desired consistency., While spaghetti is cooking, put in large skillet the hamburger meat and chopped onion., Brown and drain. Add Ragu spaghetti sauce and simmer for 15 minutes., Drain spaghetti and add to skillet., Fold over until sauce and spaghetti are mixed., Cover and simmer for 5 minutes., Serves 8.

title: Hidden Valley Ranch Spinach Dip
directions: Combine ingredients., Stir to blend., Chill for at least 1 hour., Serve in hollowed out round loaf of French bread; use hollowed out section to make bread cubes for dipping.

title: Taco Dip
directions: Mix first 3 ingredients and spread on bottom of pan or serving plate., Shred lettuce on top, then cut up black olives and sprinkle on lettuce., Sprinkle shredded cheese next., Sprinkle on green onions., Last, add chopped tomatoes., Over all of this, spread approximately 1/2 cup taco sauce., Serve with taco chips of choice.

title: Greek Salad
directions: Break lettuce into small pieces., Place in large bowl with remaining vegetables., Pour enough dressing to lightly coat each piece., Garnish with Feta cheese, olives and anchovies.

title: Carrot Cake
directions: In mixing bowl combine dry ingredients., Add eggs, oil, carrots and vanilla., Beat until combined., Stir in pineapple, coconut and nuts., Pour into greased and floured 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan., Bake 50 to 60 minutes., Cool and frost.

title: Cheese Puffs
directions: Cream margarine and cheese., Add cayenne pepper and Worcestershire sauce., Add flour., Mix well., Shape into 2 balls and wrap in waxed paper to let chill for one hour., Shape dough into marble-size balls., Place on ungreased cookie sheet and bake in preheated 350° oven for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Oatmeal Cookies (Recipe 1)
directions: Add oats, sugar, raisins, shortening, eggs and milk in order listed., Mix together flour, soda, cloves and cinnamon., Add first mixture to dry ingredients., Spread very thin on cookie sheets. Bake in 325° oven about 15 minutes., Cut in squares in cookie sheet while still warm., Makes 48 squares.

title: Broccoli Quiche
directions: Beat eggs well, then add broccoli., Add milk, then fold in mayonnaise., Add minced onion., Fold in the cheeses; mix all ingredients well., (If any of the optional ingredients are used, this recipe will make at least 2 quiches.), Pour ingredients into unbaked pie shell., Bake at 350° for approximately 40 minutes, or until set and beginning to brown on top., Make sure that the pie shell does not burn.

title: Popcorn Cake
directions: Melt the margarine and marshmallows and pour over the popcorn. Add the M&M's and peanuts., Mix well and quickly., Press into a pan sprayed with Pam. Let cool in refrigerator for easier slicing.

title: German Chocolate Cake
directions: Make up cake mix using the water and egg whites called for on the box., Melt chocolate and butter on low heat and add salt., Add chocolate mixture to cake batter., Gently fold in beaten egg whites., Bake in two greased and floured 9-inch cake pans at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Pineapple Drop Cookies
directions: Cream together sugars and Crisco., Beat in eggs and pineapple. Add dry ingredients to pineapple mixture., Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Hot Clam Dip
directions: Mix first 2 ingredients., Simmer 15 minutes., Mix next 7 ingredients., Simmer 10 minutes., Mix ingredients together., Top with breadcrumbs and cheeses., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes., Makes 2 cups.

title: Orange Julius
directions: Place, all ingredients in shaker or blender., Cover and shake or blend at high speed until ice cubes are nearly melted and mixture is thoroughly whipped., Pour in glass and serve.

title: Lemon Sponge Pie
directions: Cream butter. Add sugar and egg yolks. Beat well. Add milk. Add flour, salt, lemon juice, grated rind and milk. Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 325° for 40 to 45 minutes or at 450° for 10 minutes and at 325° for 30 to 35 minutes more.

title: Dirt
directions: You will also need 8 to 10 (7-ounce) plastic cups.

title: Alices Cheesy Veg Casserole
directions: Saute celery and onion in butter., Combine vegetables, chestnuts, mayo and cream of mushroom soup., Put in greased casserole, top with crushed crackers mixed with melted butter (about 2 Tbsp.), and top with cheese., Bake for 30 minutes until bubbly.

title: Crock-Pot Chilli And Beans
directions: Brown ground beef and drain., Combine all ingredients, including ground beef in crock-pot., Stir well., Cook on high for 4 hours, stirring occasionally., Serve with cornbread or crackers.

title: Grandma Hansen'S Icebox Cookies
directions: Combine ingredients as for cake., Make as stiff as bread dough. Set in cool place., Next morning, roll like a sausage, about size of half dollar., Cut about 1/4 inch thick., Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Oven Burgers
directions: Combine first 6 ingredients in medium saucepan. Simmer 15 minutes., Combine next 6 ingredients; mix well., Shape into 10 patties about 3/4 inch thick., Cook patties over medium heat in a large skillet until browned, turning once., Arrange patties in a 13 x 9-inch baking dish., Pour ketchup mixture over patties., Bake at 350° for 40 minutes., Serve on buns.

title: Crab Casserole
directions: Melt butter in saucepan., Add flour; stir until smooth and blend in milk., Add remaining ingredients., Mix well; put in greased casserole and sprinkle with buttered crumbs., Bake 30 minutes at 400°., Serves 6.

title: Old-Time German Potato Salad
directions: Cook potatoes; cool, peel and slice., Fry bacon until golden brown., Take bacon out of pan; add butter to bacon grease., Stir in flour until smooth., Mix vinegar and water together in a bowl, then slowly add to flour mixture., Add sugar, stirring all the time., Pour over potatoes with chopped onions and crumbled bacon. Stir gently until all mixed together., Serve.

title: Grandma Lucy'S Pecan Pie
directions: Combine. Put in unbaked shell. Top with whole pecans., Bake at 375° or until done.

title: Pound Cake
directions: Cream butter thoroughly; add sugar and cream together until light and fluffy., Add egg yolks, well beaten., Beat for several minutes., Add flour, a small amount at a time, beating well after each addition., Add flavoring and beat for several minutes., Fold in slightly beaten egg whites., Bake in paper-lined pan in a slow oven from 275° to 300° for 2 to 2 1/2 hours.

title: Coconut Caramel Pie
directions: Brown coconut and pecans in melted margarine. Set aside. Mix cream cheese and condensed milk until smooth. Fold in Cool Whip. Layer crust with cream cheese mixture, then coconut with pecans. Drizzle caramel topping on top and freeze.

title: Banana Bran Muffins
directions: Preheat oven to 400°., Spray 12 muffin pan cups with nonstick cooking spray., Mix first 3 ingredients., In separate bowl, blend egg, milk, margarine and sugar substitute., Stir in bran cereal. Let stand for 5 minutes., Mix mashed banana with honey until well mixed., Add to bran mixture., Stir in flour mixture just until well blended; do not overmix., Fill muffin cups 2/3 full., Bake for 18 to 20 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean., Let stand for 2 to 3 minutes., Remove to wire rack to cool.

title: Pound Cake
directions: Put 1/2 cup sugar in cake mix., Soften cream cheese with warm water., Put Mazola oil and butter in this and then add in cake mix., Put one egg at a time., Beat., Pour in greased and floured pan., Put in 350° oven for about 40 minutes.

title: Fruit Salad
directions: Drain all fruit., Mix pudding and Tang with fruit juices., Mix by directions on box., Mix fruit and fruit mixture., Refrigerate.

title: Golden Corn Muffins
directions: Combine dry ingredients. Add eggs, butter and milk, stirring until moistened. Spoon into greased muffin tins. Bake at 400° for 15 minutes. Makes 12 muffins.

title: Authentic Wassail
directions: Mix together and let simmer., The taste is delicious and the aroma is to die for!

title: Quick Bisque Tortoni(Kids' Recipe)
directions: Place 6 fluted paper baking cups into cupcake pan., Mix ice cream, whipped topping and 1/4 teaspoon almond extract., Spoon into paper cups.

title: Chicken Salad
directions: Combine all ingredients with enough mayonnaise to moisten or spread

title: Angel Strawberry Delight
directions: Mix strawberries and gel together., Cut cake into serving pieces and spread strawberry mixture on top.

title: Hello Dollies
directions: Put 1/2 cup butter in large Pyrex pan, melt and add 1 cup graham cracker crumbs., Mash in bottom of pan for crust., Sprinkle chocolate chips and butterscotch morsels on top of crust., Sprinkle 1 can coconut on top., Bake at 325° for 25 minutes.

title: Hearty Sausage And Rice
directions: Crumble sausage into 2-quart casserole., Add onion and green pepper., Cover., Microwave at High 4 1/2 to 7 1/2 minutes or until sausage is set and vegetables are tender, stirring once., Drain. Stir in remaining ingredients., Cover., Microwave at High 6 1/2 to 9 minutes or until heated through (140° to 150°), stirring once. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Speedy After School Pizza
directions: Place one tortilla on a microwave-safe plate., Spread spaghetti sauce evenly over tortilla., Add pepperoni., Cover with cheese., Put the pizza in the microwave., Cook until cheese is melted, approximately 1 minute on medium heat., Remove and cut into fourths. Serves one.

title: Strawberry Salad
directions: Combine pretzels, margarine and sugar and press mixture into 10 x 15-inch ungreased baking dish., Bake 10 minutes at 375°. Cool., Soften cream cheese and mix sugar in., Fold whipped topping into mixture., Spread over pretzels., Chill.

title: Strawberry Pie
directions: Mix first 3 ingredients in saucepan., Add boiling water and boil until mixture thickens and clears., Let cool., Add strawberry halves in pie shell., Pour cooled Jell-O mixture over strawberries and refrigerate until congealed, about 3 hours., Slice and top with Cool Whip, if desired.

title: Speedy Yellowtail Sauce
directions: Just mix in blender or shaker and serve over your favorite fish., Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: 7 Layer Salad
directions: Layer the washed lettuce (drained well and torn), chopped celery to cover lettuce and chopped sweet onions to cover celery. Mix the sour cream and sugar., Pour over onions., Mix the mayonnaise and vinegar., Pour over cream., Grate sharp cheese over top., Crumble the bacon over top., Chill 3 hours, uncovered.

title: Peanut Blossom Cookies
directions: Combine all ingredients (except Kisses) in large mixer bowl; blend well at low speed., Shape into balls, using a rounded teaspoonful for each., Roll balls in additional granulated sugar. Place on ungreased cookie sheets., Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes., Remove from oven., Top each cookie immediately with a candy Kiss, pressing down firmly so cookie cracks around the edge.

title: Pumpkin Cookies
directions: Beat sugar, pumpkin, oil and vanilla., Stir in dry ingredients., Blend in raisins and nuts., Drop onto oiled sheet. Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes., Makes 7 dozen.

title: Diet Chicken
directions: Combine mushrooms, tomatoes, pepper, onion, garlic, oregano, salt and pepper., Place chicken on top., Bring to boil., Reduce heat., Cover and simmer 25 minutes., Remove chicken., Combine cornstarch and water and stir in tomato mixture., Cook until thickened., Serve over rice.

title: Swiss Steak
directions: Mix together dry mustard, flour and salt., Pound mixture into the steak, covering both sides thoroughly., Brown on both sides in roasting pan., Cover meat with onions, carrots and tomatoes. Sprinkle Worcestershire sauce and brown sugar over all., Cover and bake in a 325° oven for 2 hours., Makes very tender steak.

title: Diet Cake
directions: Place all in bowl except flour and wheat germ., Pour 1 c boiling water over all and stir well., Add the flour and wheat germ and mix well., Bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes or until done.

title: Oatmeal Crispies
directions: Combine the brown sugar, white sugar and shortening. Add the well beaten eggs, dry ingredients, raisins and nuts., Roll in balls., Flatten with fork and bake for 12 minutes, until golden brown in a 350° oven.

title: Barbecue Boneless Pork Ribs
directions: Wash boneless ribs and place in Pyrex baking dish., Pour barbecue sauce over ribs., Cover with foil and bake in 350° oven for approximately 1 hour or until tender.

title: Cabbage And Sausage
directions: Fry sausage and set aside., Steam cabbage with small amount of water for about 5 minutes., Add sausage and small amount of sausage grease (1 tablespoon)., Add salt and pepper to taste. Simmer until cabbage is tender.

title: Brunswick Stew
directions: In kettle, cook vegetables until partly done., Drain., In a large kettle, melt butter. Stir in flour to make paste. Gradually add chicken broth, stirring constantly, as you add. Cook until thickened., Stir in vegetables., Blend in chicken, being careful not to overstir., Heat on low heat for 2 hours or until hot.

title: Squash Pickles
directions: Mix first 5 ingredients and let stand for 1 1/2 hours., Mix together vinegar, sugar, mustard seed and celery seed., Bring to a boil., Pour over squash mixture and bring to boil again., Pack in sterilized jars.

title: Dill Pickles
directions: Put dill on top and bottom of quart jar., Fill with cucumbers. Add the remaining ingredients., Fill rest of jar with cold water. Seal; put in a 250° oven until they turn yellow.

title: Cole Slaw
directions: Mix ingredients well., Add mayonnaise and toss until well blended.

title: Homemade Hot Fudge
directions: Bring to a boil and cook, for 8 minutes., Cool and store in refrigerator until ready to use.

title: Caramel Corn
directions: Cook brown sugar, margarine, corn syrup and salt over medium heat, stirring occasionally until bubbly around edges., Continue cooking 5 minutes; remove from heat., Stir in baking soda until foamy., Pour over popcorn., Toss until well coated., Do not use plastic pans, containers or utensils.

title: Cherry 'O Cream Cheese Pie
directions: In medium bowl, beat cheese until light and fluffy., Gradually add condensed milk and stir until well blended., Stir in lemon juice and vanilla., Turn into crust., Refrigerate 2 or 3 hours. Garnish with chilled pie filling before serving.

title: Hot Dog Sauce
directions: Cook 1 1/2 hours, then add 1 cup flour to water and add to other ingredients., Cook another 1/2 hour., Freeze or can.

title: Curried Baked Fish
directions: Combine dressing, wine, dill weed and curry., Spread on fish. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

title: 5-Bean Salad
directions: Pour all the beans in a large mixing bowl., Add sugar, vinegar and oil., Salt and pepper., Add sweet pepper rings last so as not to break up too much.

title: Working Person'S Roast
directions: Put roast in a large piece of heavy aluminum foil., Cut slits in meat and insert slivers of garlic., Cover roast with soup. Sprinkle Worcestershire sauce over meat., Sprinkle onion soup mix over meat., Add desired seasoning., Cover tightly with foil, leaving room around meat., Place in pan., Cook at 250° from 7:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. (meat is tender and juicy and gravy is made). Delicious!

title: Caramel Nut Popcorn Crunch
directions: Spread corn and nuts in large shallow pan and place in preheated 250° oven. Combine butter, sugar, syrup and salt in a saucepan. Cook over medium heat until sugar dissolves. Boil until 248° (firm-ball stage). Remove from heat. Stir in soda. Pour over corn and nuts. Stir gently to coat. Bake 45 minutes at 250°, stirring every 15 minutes.

title: Bubble Bread
directions: Cut dough into squares 1-inch size., Layer nuts, raisins, dough and dry mixture., Then pour 1/4 cup melted butter on, then repeat layers., Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Low Calorie Banana Pudding
directions: Beat first 2 ingredients for 2 to 3 minutes on low and set in refrigerator., Place graham crackers in a gallon size plastic Ziploc bag., Crush with rolling pin., Place about half of crumbs in bottom of container., Cover with 1 sliced banana., Then cover with pudding., Slice 1 more small banana over pudding., Sprinkle with about 1/2 to 3/4 cup of cracker crumbs., Very good and low calorie. Makes 6 servings.

title: Crustless Fudge Pie
directions: Melt butter and chocolate over low heat., Beat other ingredients into eggs and then add chocolate mixture., Blend thoroughly., Pour into a greased pie plate (9-inch) and bake 40 to 45 minutes in a preheated oven (350°)., Cool., Serve with whipped cream or vanilla ice cream., Serves 6 to 8.

title: Ham And Noodle Casserole
directions: Cook noodles in salted water for 8 minutes., Heat Crisco., Add ham and brown lightly., Sprinkle flour over ham; stir until coated. Add milk slowly and cook thick., Add salt, noodles and corn., Mix and pour in a 2-quart casserole dish.

title: Vegetable Soup
directions: Cook beef and 1 onion with 4 quarts of water for 2 hours. After cooked, skim off fat on beef., Then chop beef., Add all ingredients and simmer for 4 hours.

title: Chocolate Cheep Cake
directions: Mix together the flour, sugar, soda, salt and cocoa. Add remaining ingredients and beat for 2 minutes. Pour into a greased and floured 13 x 9 pan. Bake at 375° for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Quick Cobbler
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Let butter melt in a 9 x 12-inch pan while oven is heating., Mix dry ingredients and combine with milk to make a thin batter., Put batter into pan, then add your favorite fruit., Bake 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Chocolate Raspberry Truffle Brownies
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Melt chocolate chips with butter, cool slightly., In a large mixing bowl at medium speed, beat brown sugar and eggs until blended., Add chocolate mixture and dissolved coffee; beat well., Stir in flour and baking powder., Spread evenly in baking pan., Bake for 30 to 35 minutes or until a wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean; cool on a wire rack.

title: Tomato Relish
directions: Peel and chop tomatoes finely., Chop onions and peppers. Combine all ingredients., Cook until thick., Pour into scalded jars and seal at once.

title: Tuscan Pot Roast
directions: Brown beef on all sides in oil., Add wine and water to meat. Cover and simmer 2 1/2 to 3 hours until meat is fork-tender.

title: Sweet Potato Souffle
directions: Mix sugar, flour and pineapple, then add other ingredients. Put in baking dish.

title: Bamboo Pickles
directions: Boil together., Put into jars one clove garlic, hot pepper, a small amount of alum, dill weed or 1/2 tsp dill seed., Cook bamboo for 25 minutes., After it begins to boil cool in ice water, fill jars with bamboo., Pour hot vinegar into jars; seal., Boil five minutes in a hot water bath to seal.

title: Parmesan Chicken
directions: Melt margarine in microwave., Preheat oven to 350°., Dip chicken in margarine and then roll in Parmesan cheese., Bake in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish., Sprinkle with remaining cheese and margarine and bake 1 hour at 350°.

title: White Fudge
directions: Cook the first 5 ingredients to a soft ball stage., Let cool to lukewarm., Add the remaining ingredients; beat until smooth.

title: Betty'S Chocolate Pound Cake
directions: Cream oleo, shortening and sugar until light and fluffy., Beat in eggs, one at a time., Sift flour, baking powder and cocoa together 3 times., Add to creamed mixture alternately with milk and vanilla., Mix well, scraping sides of bowl often., Pour batter in large, oiled tube pan and bake at 300° for 1 hour and 30 minutes.

title: Magic Pumpkin Pie
directions: In large mixing bowl, blend together all ingredients., Turn mixture into pie shell., Bake in 375° oven until sharp bladed knife inserted near center comes out clean, 50 to 55 minutes. Cool., Refrigerate at least one hour.

title: Potato Soup
directions: Peel potatoes, onion and garlic., Cut into small pieces., Add salt and pepper., Combine 1 quart water; cook 30 minutes., Add minced parsley and milk; heat 5 minutes more.

title: Grandma'S Rolls
directions: Combine sugar, salt and oil., Add hot water and beat. Sprinkle yeast over and set., Mix in and add egg (use wire whip). Gradually add 3 cups flour (use wooden spoon)., Knead., Pour 1 tablespoon oil in bowl and cover dough., Set for 1 1/2 hours. Bake at 375° for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Bread Pudding
directions: Measure 2 cups bread cubes into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle raisins evenly over top., Add remaining bread., Mix liquid ingredients in order given with wire whisk., Pour over bread and soak well., Bake 35 to 45 minutes., Serve warm topped with warm vanilla pudding.

title: Buffet Turkey Ham With Raisin Sauce
directions: Spread out on cookie sheet or pizza pan and heat in 300° oven until heated through.

title: Pork Chops And Dressing
directions: Cook onion and green pepper until tender in soup., Mix all ingredients except chops, salt and pepper., Put in baking dish. Place pork chops on top., Sprinkle with salt and pepper., Cover; bake 45 minutes in 400° oven., Uncover; bake 15 minutes longer.

title: Garden Quiche
directions: Heat oil in large, heavy skillet., Stir in the eggplant, onion and garlic., Cook until soft, about 10 minutes., Stir in the zucchini, oregano, salt, pepper and tomatoes., Cook over medium heat until all liquid has evaporated, about 20 minutes., Stir often., Cool slightly., Beat eggs., Stir into vegetable mixture with half of the grated Mozzarella cheese., Spoon into a buttered 9-inch pie plate., Top with remaining Mozzarella and Parmesan cheese., Bake at 375° for 25 minutes until golden., Let rest for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.

title: Quick 'N Easy Casserole(My Favorite)
directions: Place vegetables in 1 1/2-quart baking dish., Bake at 350° for 7 minutes to partially thaw., Stir in rice, soup, chicken, milk, half the cheese and the onion., Then sprinkle with remaining cheese., Bake for 45 minutes or until hot and bubbly., Makes 5 cups or 3 servings., Can be prepared in skillet.

title: Can'T Get Enough Buffalo Chicken Wings
directions: Split wings and discard tips., Cut chicken wings in half at joint., Broil or grill wings 30 to 45 minutes, turning often until cooked or bake in 425° oven for 1 hour, turning halfway., In bowl combine cayenne pepper sauce, butter and herb with garlic soup mix to coat., If you can't take it hot, eliminate the pepper sauce. Makes 24 appetizers.

title: Mock Ambrosia
directions: Peel and coarsely grate apples., Add orange juice that has been thawed a little., Let apples start absorbing juice., Sprinkle in orange jello and stir., Add pineapple and stir., Add flavorings and cherries., Store in refrigerator.

title: Yummy Turkey Apple Salad
directions: Mix turkey, celery and apples together in a large bowl. Combine mayonnaise and yogurt; fold into turkey mixture., Season to taste with salt, pepper, nutmeg and cinnamon., Serve on crisp lettuce and garnish with grated cheese if desired.

title: Chicken Divan
directions: In 2-quart baking dish or 9-inch pie plate, arrange broccoli and chicken., In separate dish, combine soup and milk., Pour over broccoli and chicken., Sprinkle with cheese., Combine bread crumbs and margarine and put on top of cheese., Bake at 450° for 20 minutes until hot and bubbly., Serves 4., Prep:, 15 minutes., Cook time:, 20 minutes.

title: Spaghetti Salad
directions: Mix together and marinate overnight.

title: * Easy Potatoes And Ham *
directions: Make potatoes according to directions., Add other ingredients and bake 30 to 45 minutes in 350° oven., Serves 4.

title: Corn Casserole
directions: Mix first 5 ingredients in 13 x 9-inch pan., Cook at 350° for approximately 20 to 30 minutes., Before completely done, sprinkle with cheese and cook until melted.

title: Italian Chicken
directions: Remove skin from chicken; place chicken in a 9 x 13-inch baking pan., Pour sauce over chicken., Place 1 slice of cheese on each thigh., Bake in a 350° oven for 1 hour., Serve on a bed of pasta.

title: Graham Cracker Pudding
directions: Scald milk., Combine flour, brown sugar and salt., Add 2 cups of scalded milk to dry ingredients; mix well., Return to pan of scalded milk., Cook and stir until thick., Remove from stove., Add the beaten eggs, vanilla and chunk of butter., Mix until smooth. When cool, stir in graham cracker crumbs and whipped topping.

title: Hearty Baked Macaroni
directions: In small bowl, combine water, tomato puree, Italian seasoning and 1/2 of garlic powder., In another bowl, combine cottage cheese, onion powder and rest of garlic powder., Spray a 9 x 9 x 2-inch casserole dish with cooking spray., Spread 1/3 of tomato mix in dish., Layer 1/2 of macaroni, all of cheese mixture, and 1/3 of the tomato mix., Add rest of macaroni and cover with tomato mix., Cover and bake at 350° for an hour., Uncover and top with Mozzarella cheese., Bake, uncovered, until cheese melts.

title: Tuna Bean Salad
directions: Lightly mix all ingredients except nuts., Line serving bowl with salad greens., Fill with mixture., Top with chopped nuts. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Oatmeal Cake
directions: Pour boiling water over oats, let stand 20 minutes., Add margarine, brown and white sugars and mix well., Add beaten eggs and vanilla., Add dry ingredients to mixture., Place in greased and floured 13 x 9-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Cry Babies
directions: Combine ingredients in order given, adding flour last and very gradually. Drop on greased cookie sheets; bake at 350° for 10 minutes. Very old recipe, but very good.

title: Vegetable Dip
directions: Mix all the ingredients together., Serve with raw vegetables.

title: Potato-Leek Soup
directions: Cook vegetables in enough water to keep from sticking until tender., Add Accent while cooking., Serve hot with saltine or other crackers.

title: Strawberry Salad
directions: Dissolve 2 package jello in 2 cups boiling water., Add the frozen strawberries (juice and all)., Stir until thawed., Add 1 1/2 cups crushed pineapple, 2 large bananas (diced)., Pour 1/2 mixture into 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan., Chill until firm., Spoon 1 cup sour cream over mixture., Spreading in even layer., Pour remaining jello over., Chill., Firm when set.

title: Peanut Butter Candy
directions: Knead ingredients together in a large bowl until firm., If mixture is too runny, add more powdered sugar until firm., If mixture is crumbly, add more milk., Roll out on a cookie sheet; cut into squares, or use cookie cutters.

title: No Bake Cherry Cheese Pie
directions: In a medium bowl beat cheese until light and fluffy., Add the sweetened condensed milk and blend thoroughly., Stir in lemon juice and vanilla., Pour into crust., Chill 3 hours or until set. Top with the amount of desired topping of pie filling before serving., Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Spiced Tea Mix
directions: Mic the ingredients., Make 2 cups., Use 2 teaspoons per 1 cup hot water.

title: Peach-Berry Smoothie
directions: Combine all ingredients in blender container., Cover and blend 30 to 60 seconds or until smooth., Serve immediately., Makes 4 (1 cup) servings.

title: Meatball Chowder(Makes 6 To 7 Quarts)
directions: Mix first 7 ingredients together and form into meatballs the size of walnuts., Bake in the oven., Put into a large kettle all the other ingredients except the corn., Bring to a boil, reduce heat and cook on low-medium and simmer 30 minutes or until vegetables are tender., Stir on occasion., Add corn and heat 5 to 10 more minutes.

title: Super Bowl Casserole
directions: In Dutch oven, brown ground beef or sausage with onion., Drain grease., Pour in beans, corn, stewed tomatoes and one can Ro-Tel tomatoes., Take 20 flour tortillas, broken up, put half in 14 x 10-inch pan., Layer meat, cheeses, tortillas, meat and cheeses. Pour 1 can Ro-Tel tomatoes over top., Let sit for two hours, covered with foil., Bake at 350° for 1 hour, uncovered., Serves 10 to 12.

title: Poppy Seed Chicken Casserole
directions: Boil chicken breasts until done., Debone and cut in cubes. In a 9 x 13-inch dish, layer chicken on bottom., Mix soup and sour cream; pour over chicken.

title: Fried Green Plantains
directions: Peel plantains and cut diagonally to 1-inch thick pieces. Heat oil to about 350°, medium to high heat., Fry them for about 7 to 8 minutes, turning them occasionally., Remove them and squash them flat., Fry them again for another 3 or 4 minutes until they brown., Remove onto a plate with an absorbent paper towel., Serve with a little salt on top (optional)., Serve with rice and chicken.

title: Steak And Potato Casserole
directions: Brown steak on both sides., Cut in chunks., Put in casserole dish., Add rest of ingredients., Stir up., Cook at 350° to 400° for 1 hour or until steak is tender.

title: Granny Deturck'S Corn Fritters
directions: Combine first three ingredients., In a separate bowl, beat eggs and milk., Add oil., Combine with dry ingredients and stir just until all ingredients are mixed., Fold in corn.

title: Favorite Chocolate Brownies(Microwave)
directions: Microwave (High) butter in uncovered 1-quart dish 15 to 20 seconds or until softened., Blend in sugar., Add eggs, one at a time, beating after each., Blend in vanilla., Add flour, ice cream syrup and salt; mix well., Grease bottom only of 8-inch square dish., Spread batter in dish., Cover loosely with plastic wrap.

title: Black Olive Soup
directions: Blend all ingredients, except eggs and cream in blender on high speed for 1 minute., Transfer to saucepan, heat and add beaten eggs;, cook 2 to 3 minutes., Add cream., Serve hot or cold. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Fluffy Jello Salad
directions: In a small saucepan, mix pudding, jello and water. Bring to a boil. Pour in a bowl and refrigerate overnight. Add fruit cocktail and cool whip. Mix well.

title: Granny'S Strawberry Pie
directions: Mix flour, sugar and salt., Add egg yolks and butter. Gradually add milk., Pour into unbaked pie crust., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes until brown., Add strawberries on top and top with meringue and brown about 8 minutes.

title: 5 Pound Fudge
directions: Place first 5 ingredients in large bowl and set aside., Cook milk and sugar until rolling boil., Lower heat and cook for 12 minutes, stirring continuously., Pour over first mixture and stir until all ingredients are well blended., Pour into greased pan (large or two smaller)., Spread to thickness desired.

title: Peach Cake
directions: Cut butter into dry cake mix until mixture resembles coarse crumbs., Pat into greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan., Beat egg yolks separately; add sour cream and mix well., Set aside a few peach slices for garnish; cut remaining peaches into 1-inch pieces and stir into sour cream mixture., Spread over crust; sprinkle with cinnamon., Bake at 350 for 25 to 30 minutes or until edges begin to brown., Cool on wire rack; spread with topping; garnish with reserved peaches., Store in refrigerator.

title: Buster Bar Dessert
