directions: Cream butter., Add sugar., Add salt and flour (mixed)., Use hands; work well., Blend in vanilla and nuts., Chill 1 hour., Form into balls (1-inch)., Place 2 1/2 inches apart., Bake for 10 to 12 minutes in a 350° oven., (They do not brown or spread.), Roll in confectioners sugar., Cool; roll again., Yields 3 to 4 dozen.

title: Freezer Pickles
directions: Mix salt and water and pour over cucumber and onion; let stand 2 hours., Drain (don't rinse)., Mix sugar and white vinegar., Stir until all the sugar is dissolved., Pour over cucumber and onion. Pack in containers and put in freezer.

title: Squash Casserole
directions: Cook squash., Add sugar and butter., Pour in 2-quart casserole dish., Sprinkle bread crumbs., Melt cheese in white sauce., Pour over bread crumbs; dot with butter., Put in moderate oven until bubbly.

title: Louisiana Dirty Rice
directions: Cook rice separate., Cook all other ingredients together., Mix with rice and green onions., Salt and pepper as desired., Serve very hot.

title: Bread Basket Dip
directions: Combine all of the ingredients (except bread)., Put into hollowed out loaf of bread., (When you hollow out the bread, save the top of bread so that you can put it back on top of the filled loaf.), Wrap entire loaf of bread in aluminum foil and bake for 2 full hours at 300°., Serve with bread cubes, crackers or raw veggies., This is worth the effort.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
directions: Combine and cook sugar, milk, margarine and salt., When it starts cooking, cook for 5 minutes., Add marshmallow cream and peanut butter., Beat until glaze is gone., Pour onto a plate and let chill until you can cut it.

title: Butter Riches
directions: Cream the butter., Gradually add brown sugar and white sugar. Cream well., Add egg yolk and vanilla., Beat well., Blend in flour to form a stiff dough., Shape into small balls., Put on greased cookie sheets., Flatten to size of a 50 cent piece with the bottom of a glass dipped in sugar., Bake at 350° for 7 to 9 minutes, until golden brown., Cool and frost with Browned Butter Frosting.

title: Chocolate Cheese Ball
directions: Mix all ingredients together very well. Chill 2 hours. Crush 3 graham crackers. Shape mixture into ball and roll in cracker crumbs.

title: Turkey With Cornbread Dressing
directions: In a skillet, saute celery and onion in butter until tender. Place in large bowl with cornbread, crumbs, sage and poultry seasoning., Combine eggs, chicken broth and cornbread mixture, stirring gently to mix.

title: Salmon Spread
directions: Mix all of the ingredients together, except for the pecans or parsley., Shape and chill., Remove from the refrigerator and roll in pecans or parsley., Serve as desired.

title: Van Der Height'S
directions: Melt 1/2 cup margarine and mix with crushed chocolate wafer. Consistency should be slightly tacky and moist., Press into pan. Can use pie pan, cake pan or cupcake sized pan., Try to form a pie crust with the sides higher than the middle., Put in freezer to cool.

title: Upside-Down Pizza
directions: Brown hamburger., Add sauce., Spread mixture in 9 x 13-inch pan., Add sausage, mushrooms, green peppers and pepperoni., Top with Mozzarella cheese., In a bowl, mix eggs, milk, cooking oil, flour and salt., Beat well and pour evenly over cheese., Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese., Bake at 400° for 30 minutes or until crust is golden brown.

title: Corn Bread
directions: Mix corn meal, flour, baking powder, sugar and salt., Beat eggs; add milk and stir into corn meal mixture., Heat fat in a 9 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan in a preheated 425° oven until hot., Tilt pan to coat with fat, then pour off and stir excess fat into batter., Pour batter into pan and bake for 25 minutes or until bread pulls away from sides of pan., Cut into squares and serve hot with butter., Makes 9 servings.

title: Death By Chocolate 2
directions: Preheat oven according to brownie package directions., Bake brownies according to directions; let cool.

title: Healthy Vegetable Stew
directions: Arrange onion, potatoes, kidney beans, uncooked rice and celery in layers in order listed in a covered casserole sprayed with Pam., Preheat oven to 325°., Mix spices and tomato sauce well and pour over stew layers in casserole., Cover and simmer 1 1/4 hours or until potatoes are tender., Do not stir; but check occasionally to be sure it does not boil dry., Makes 4 servings.

title: Hash Brown Casserole
directions: Mix the ingredients and pour into a casserole dish., Cover with a thin layer of crushed cornflakes; drizzle with butter or margarine., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Baked Brie
directions: In a glass pie plate, melt butter and saute nuts; add the brown sugar., Do this in a microwave., It should only take a minute or so., All microwaves are different so use your own judgment., Then place the wheel or wedge of Brie in the plate and return to the microwave just until the cheese melts., Serve with Wheat Thins., Delicious!

title: Chocolate Kahlua Mousse
directions: Blend chips in blender until they are chopped fine., Add water for 10 seconds in blender., Add egg yolks, Kahlua, sugar and vanilla., Beat egg whites stiff, then fold into mix., Chill 3 hours.

title: Warm Mexican Dip
directions: Mix all ingredients together in a crock-pot until warm., Serve with chips.

title: No Bake Cookies
directions: In a saucepan, mix the milk, butter, cocoa and sugar., Bring to a boil for 1 minute., (If you boil longer than 1 minute, the cookies will be too hard.), Add the vanilla, oats and peanut butter., Spoon drop onto waxed paper, or leave in a buttered 9 x 13-inch dish and slice when cool.

title: Broccoli Chicken Soup
directions: Mix together chicken broth, chopped broccoli, chopped celery, chopped onion and salt and pepper to taste., Simmer together until vegetables are tender, about 15 minutes., Then add rice, Cheddar cheese soup and chicken meat., Fold in milk and Velveeta cheese. Simmer together on low heat about 30 minutes., Stir often.

title: Broccoli Corn Bread(Nutritional)
directions: Mix all ingredients together, except the corn bread mix., Add corn bread mix last and pour into greased pan or casserole; bake. Can be reheated.

title: Potato Topped Meat Loaf
directions: Measure 1/4 cup gravy from jar and combine with beef and next 5 ingredients., Form into a loaf (8 x 14 x 1 1/2-inch) in shallow baking pan., Bake in a 350° oven for 1 hour., Remove from oven and carefully drain fat.

title: Sweet Potato Pie
directions: Peel and slice potatoes; boil in salt water until tender, then drain., Blend potatoes, margarine, sugar, eggs and milk; process until smooth., Add vanilla., Divide filling between the unbaked pie shells., Bake at 325° for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Mississippi Mud Cake
directions: Combine first 5 ingredients, 3 sticks margarine, 1/3 cup cocoa and 1 teaspoon vanilla in large bowl, mixing well., Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch baking pan., Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes or until cake tests done., Spread marshmallow cream over hot cake; cool.

title: Fruit Pizza
directions: Spread cookie dough on round pizza pan., Cook and cool as package directs., Mix cream cheese and sugar., Spread mix on cooled cookie dough., Decorate with mixture of fresh fruit., Slice like pizza and enjoy.

title: Lentil Loaf
directions: Boil lentils until well done., Mix with other ingredients and bake in a shallow baking dish about 45 minutes at 350°.

title: Aunt Irma'S Unbaked Cookies
directions: In saucepan, melt first 4 ingredients., Let come to boil, remove from heat., Stir in oats, nuts and vanilla., Drop by tablespoon onto waxed paper., Cool.

title: Western Mac-N-Cheese
directions: Prepare mac-n-cheese dinner as directed on box. Brown beef, celery, green pepper and onion; cook until tender. Stir in tomato paste, corn, water, salt and pepper. Mix well. Add the mac-n-cheese dinner and mix again. Pour into a 2-quart casserole dish. Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Oatmeal Pudding
directions: Take the boiling water and stir in oats., Let stand for 20 minutes., Mix in the remaining ingredients., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes in long pan.

title: Cheesecake
directions: Mix ingredients in a blender for 7 minutes on medium., Bake in an 8 x 8-inch pan at 375° for 45 to 60 minutes.

title: Crispy Parmesan Chicken
directions: Combine cornflakes, salt, pepper and cheese; set aside., Wash and pat dry chicken pieces., Combine beaten egg and milk., Dip chicken pieces in egg mixture and roll in cornflakes mixture. Place in well-greased baking dish (can use Pam spray), skin side up., Bake for 1 hour at 350°., Do not cover or turn chicken while baking.

title: Tea Cakes(Sugar Cookies)
directions: Cream margarine and sugar., Add eggs and beat until fluffy. Stir together dry ingredients and add alternately with milk., If dough is sticky, add flour to handle., Cut out with cookie cutters. Place on ungreased baking sheets., Bake in moderate oven at 350° to 375° for 8 minutes., These are called sugar cookies now, but used to be called "Tea Cakes."

title: English Cake
directions: Heat oven to 325° (150°C). Beat all the ingredients together. Then, before putting it in the oven, you can put some raisins and walnuts on the face (top)., Bake for 45 minutes. After baking, spread some icing sugar (powdered sugar) on top of the cake.

title: Quick Microwave Broccoli
directions: Put broccoli and water into small microwave dish; sprinkle on salt and add margarine., Microwave on High for 4 1/2 minutes; turn dish 1/4 turn and microwave for additional 3 1/2 minutes., This serves two, depending on size of broccoli used., Increase time and water for more servings., You can establish this based on experimenting if you undercook slightly, then add more time to achieve your desired degree of doneness., This procedure cooks the vegetables to a good consistency and color without its becoming soggy.

title: Best Bean Dip Ever
directions: Mix beans, cream cheese, sour cream and taco seasoning., Put into 9 x 13-inch baking pan., Mix cheeses together and sprinkle on top of bean mixture., Bake at 350° until cheese bubbles.

title: Pecan Pie Bars
directions: Set aside 2/3 cup of cake mix., Combine remaining cake mix, butter and 1 egg., Mix with fork until crumbly., Press mixture into a greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish., Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes or until light golden brown.

title: Green Punch
directions: Dissolve jello in hot water. Add pineapple juice and sugar. Stir in ginger ale. Freeze until icy. Stir occasionally to keep mushy. Makes 1 gallon.

title: Zucchini Relish
directions: Do not peel zucchini., Scrape out seeds., Grind zucchini and onions; add salt and leave overnight., Refrigerate., Rinse and drain., Add vinegar, dry mustard, turmeric, cornstarch, celery seed, pepper and sugar., Mix ingredients well., Cook until clear, about 30 minutes, over medium heat, stirring to keep from sticking., Put in jars and seal., Makes about 6 pints.

title: Spicy Meat Loaf
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., In a large bowl, combine all ingredients., Place in a large baking dish., Shape into a loaf. Bake 1 hour or until done., Makes 8 servings.

title: Potato Dumplings
directions: Combine all ingredients; roll into balls., Drop into boiling salted water., Boil 3 minutes after dumplings come to surface of boiling water.

title: *Asparagus Vinaigrette
directions: Mix dry ingredients; stir in oil and vinegar., Blend well., Add mustard, chives, relish and eggs., Chill and serve over asparagus on lettuce.

title: Chicken With Colorful Rice
directions: In plastic bag mix together flour, salt and spices., Add chicken, shaking to coat., In large frying pan, heat oil and margarine., Add chicken and cook, turning for about 20 minutes. Add mushrooms and cook over medium heat for 3 minutes., Combine broth and wine; add to frying pan., Cover, reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes or until fork-tender., Remove chicken; keep warm., Pour off fat; return 1 tablespoon fat to pan., Stir hot rice into mushrooms and drippings., Add tomatoes and spinach to rice mixture; carefully toss until warm throughout (3 minutes). Transfer rice to platter and arrange chicken on rice.

title: Pizza Bread
directions: Grate cheese and onion. Chop pepper very fine. Add all ingredients together., Spread on rounds of French bread., Broil until cheese melts. Serve with chips and dill pickle.

title: Crispy Parmesan Potatoes
directions: Baking Temperature: 375°., Baking Time: 1 hour.

title: Fried Okra
directions: Pour oil into skillet and heat., Cut okra into thin, round slices., Crack an egg and mix into okra slices well., Sprinkle flour over okra and egg until well coated., Add to hot oil and fry until lightly browned., Drain on paper towels and salt to taste.

title: Salmon Loaf
directions: Mix all ingredients together and pour into 9 x 9-inch pan. Sprinkle with additional bread crumbs. Bake 45 to 50 minutes in 350° oven.

title: Party Pin Wheels
directions: Mix first 3 ingredients., Spread on tortillas., Sprinkle fixings on top., Roll up jelly roll style, wrap tightly., Chill 2 hours or over night., Cut off ends, slice accordingly, 3/4 inch slices.

title: Hermits
directions: Cream together sugar and butter., Add syrup, soda (dissolved in water) and eggs., Stir in sifted flour, cloves, allspice, cinnamon, raisins, nuts and salt., Drop in small pieces (top) on lightly greased cookie sheet., Bake slowly at 350° about 10 minutes.

title: Microwave Lasagna
directions: Place noodles in 2-quart baking dish, cover with water and sprinkle with salt., Cook, uncovered, 15 minutes., Remove and let noodles stand in water while preparing meat sauce.

title: Quick Cinnamon Nut Coffee Cake
directions: Melt margarine in small pan over low heat., Measure and mix sugar and cinnamon in small bowl., Remove margarine from heat. Dip biscuits, one at a time, in margarine., Then roll in cinnamon and sugar mixture., Place in tube pan overlapping biscuits in a circle., Sprinkle with nuts and remaining sugar and cinnamon. Bake at 450° for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
directions: Combine chicken soup, mayonnaise, water chestnuts and any desired vegetables., Place in baking dish., Mix cornmeal, Bisquick and milk; pour over chicken., Bake for 20 minutes at 350°., Add cheese to top; cook 10 more minutes.

title: Baked Spaghetti
directions: Brown ground beef with green pepper and onions in shortening. Add mushroom soup, tomato soup and soup can of water, also garlic clove., Heat., Blend in 1/2 cup Cheddar cheese., Add spaghetti. Pour into 3-quart casserole dish., Top with 1/2 cup sharp cheese. Bake 30 minutes or until bubbly at 350°.

title: Layered Salad
directions: Fry bacon; crumble and set aside., In a glass bowl (large) layer first the lettuce (torn into bite-size pieces), then the celery, green pepper, uncooked peas and onion., Mix together mayonnaise, oil, sugar and Parmesan cheese., Gently spread over layered ingredients., Sprinkle Parmesan and Cheddar cheese., Also crumble bacon., Garnish with croutons.

title: American Lasagna
directions: Brown beef and drain; add garlic in hot oil. Add tomato paste, tomatoes, seasonings. Cover and simmer 20 min. heat oven to 350°. In 13x9, baking dish, alternate layers of cooked noodles, swiss cheese, cottage cheese, and meat sauce. Bake 20 to 30 min. Serve with grated parmesan cheese. 6 to 8 servings.

title: Scrumpdiliicious Ice Cream
directions: Smash cookies and spread in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan., Layer nuts over cookies., Spread softened ice cream over cookies and nuts., Spread softened Cool Whip over ice cream., Dribble chocolate syrup over Cool Whip., Cover with aluminum foil and put in freezer until frozen hard., Eat and enjoy while your mouth salivates., This is one of those things you cannot put down with just one serving.

title: Pecan Pumpkin Pie
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Stir together 1 slightly beaten egg, pumpkin, 1/3 cup sugar and pumpkin pie spice., Spread over bottom of pie shell., Combine 2 beaten eggs, corn syrup, 1/2 cup sugar, butter and vanilla., Mix well and stir in pecans., Spoon over pumpkin mixture., Bake at 350° for 50 minutes or until filling is set.

title: Sausage And Cheese Stuffed Mushrooms
directions: Remove stems from mushrooms. Brush mushrooms with dressing and place on broiler pan for 5 minutes. Press sausage evenly into mushroom caps, using about 1/2 teaspoon sausage in each cap. Sprinkle evenly with cheese. Broil an additional 5 minutes or until cheese is melted. Serve hot. Makes 12 servings.

title: W-R Never Fail Pie Crust
directions: Cut shortening into flour and salt until mixture resembles fine crumbs., Combine egg, vinegar and water with a fork. Sprinkle over dry mixture and mix with a fork., Let stand 10 minutes., Roll out this recipe., Makes 2 (2-crust) pies.

title: Chocolate Sheet Cake
directions: Do not add liquid or oil to cake mix., Mix with spoon; put in greased 13 x 9-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes., Cool; prepare frosting.

title: Quickie Casserole
directions: Brown meat in 12-inch skillet. Drain. Add tomatoes, tomato sauce, 1 teaspoon salt and chili powder. Bring to a boil. Cover and cook over low heat for 30 minutes. Cook spaghetti. Add 1 teaspoon salt until tender. Drain., Place spaghetti in long casserole dish. Pour meat mixture over spaghetti. Cover with cheese.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
directions: Cook chicken; drain fat from broth., Remove chicken from bones., Cut meat into smaller pieces., In a large pot, heat broth almost to boiling point., Drop in layer of thinly sliced raw potatoes, then a layer of dough, then a layer of chicken. Continue layers until used, ending with dough., Add boiling water to broth, if necessary to cover ingredients., Cook, uncovered, until dough is cooked.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
directions: Combine mayonnaise and cream of chicken soup., Pour over other ingredients and combine well., Pour into greased casserole., Bake at 350° about 40 minutes., Serve with toast or biscuits.

title: Caramel Corn
directions: Combine butter, brown sugar, corn syrup and cream of tartar in saucepan., Boil 5 minutes., Remove from heat., Stir in soda., Pour over popcorn and mix well., Put on cookie sheet and bake at 250° for one hour., Stir every 15 minutes., Cool on wax paper.

title: Eggplant With Two Cheeses
directions: Mix flour and garlic salt., Coat eggplant., Cook in oil over medium heat, turning once, until golden brown., Pour 1/2 of tomato sauce into ungreased oblong 13 1/2 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish., Add eggplant., Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese., Add remaining tomato sauce., Sprinkle with oregano and Mozzarella cheese., Cook, uncovered, in 325° oven until hot and bubbly, about 25 minutes.

title: Hello Dolly Cookies
directions: Preheat oven, to, 350°, (325° for glass dish)., In 13 x 9-inch baking pan, melt butter., Sprinkle crumbs over butter. Pour sweetened condensed milk evenly over crumbs., Top evenly with remaining ingredients; press down gently., Bake 25 to 30 minutes or, until, lightly, browned., Cool, thoroughly before cutting. Store,, loosely covered, at room temperature., Makes 24 bars.

title: Beans Beverly
directions: In a large saucepot or Dutch oven, saute ground beef, bacon, onion and garlic., Add ketchup, dry mustard, all beans, vinegar, salt and pepper., Mix thoroughly., Pour mixture into a large beanpot or other type of casserole dish., Bake in a preheated 350° oven for about 1 hour or until thickened., Serves 10.

title: Spaghetti Sauce
directions: Simmer sauce about 2 hours after adding to drained hamburger.

title: Fruit Pizza
directions: *Usually only one of each of the larger fruits is needed and the amount of the smaller fruits will vary.

title: Chocolate Cake
directions: Put sugar, eggs and lard in bowl and beat together., Add cocoa and water; beat again., Add flour and soda and stir well., Add sour cream and mix well., Bake at 350°.

title: No-Peek Chicken
directions: Combine rice and soups., Pour into lightly greased 9 x 13-inch pan., Place cut-up chicken slices on top., Sprinkle onion soup mix over chicken., Seal with foil., Bake for 2 hours at 325°.

title: Garden Beef And Macaroni
directions: In saucepan, brown beef and cook onion until tender., Stir to separate meat; drain., Add remaining ingredients., Bring to boil. Reduce heat., Simmer 20 minutes or until done., Stir often., Makes 3 1/2 cups.

title: Carrot Cabbage Slaw
directions: Shred cabbage and carrots., Finely chop onion and celery., Mix together in a large bowl., In a separate bowl, mix remaining ingredients., Pour over shredded vegetables and refrigerate. Yields 10 servings., Serving Size:, 1/2 cup., Exchanges:, 1 vegetable.

title: Chocolate Eclair Cake
directions: Butter 9 x 13-inch pan., Line bottom of pan with crackers. Mix pudding with milk; beat 2 minutes., Stir in Cool Whip., Put 1/2 mixture over crackers., Layer crackers and rest of pudding. Final layer of crackers., Chill in refrigerator while making frosting.

title: Vegie Pie
directions: Spread out crescent rolls on large cookie sheet., Push dough up sides of pan slightly., Bake 7 to 8 minutes at 375° until golden brown., Cool., Blend cream cheese, mayonnaise and spices., Spread over rolls., Top with vegetables, then sprouts., If made in advance, add tomatoes just before serving.

title: Enchilada Casserole
directions: Brown ground beef., Drain well., Add soups, sauce, chilies and taco seasoning., Simmer., Place tortillas in bottom of large casserole dish., Add meat mixture and a small amount of grated cheese., Add another layer of tortillas and meat mixture., Cook in microwave 10 minutes., Add the rest of the cheese and microwave until the cheese is melted.

title: Cookie Salad
directions: Blend pudding and buttermilk together., Drain oranges and pineapple and add., Add Cool Whip and stir together., Crush 1/2 package of cookies and mix in., Save a few cookies for topping. Refrigerate.

title: Shrimp And Potato Casserole
directions: Saute shrimp, onion and parsley in butter until tender., Make instant potatoes according to directions on box., Mix all together; put in a casserole dish and top with cheese., Bake at 350 degrees until cheese melts.

title: Hot Asparagus Canapes
directions: Trim crust from bread and flatten with rolling pin slightly. Blend cheeses and egg to workable consistency, then spread on bread., Place an asparagus spear on each slice and roll each, securing each with a toothpick., Dip in melted butter so as to coat thoroughly., Place on a cookie sheet and freeze., Remove and slice into 3 equal sections., Bake at 400° for about 15 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Coca Cola Cake
directions: Place 1 stick butter, oil, 3 Tbsp. cocoa, 1 c. Coke, and 1 1/2 c. marshmallows in saucepan., Bring to a boil., Set aside to cool.

title: Chicken Veggie Stir-Fry
directions: Heat 2 tablespoons salad dressing in large skillet., Add chicken and garlic powder., Add veggies., Stir-fry until chicken is cooked., Reduce heat; stir in remaining dressing and soy sauce. Serve over hot cooked rice.

title: Broccoli Stuffing Casserole
directions: Prepare stuffing mix as directed on box., Layer as follows: broccoli, 1 can soup, stuffing mix, remaining can of soup., Top with cheddar cheese., Cover and bake at 350 degrees for 1/2 hour.

title: Pineapple Casserole
directions: Combine flour, sugar and 3 tablespoons of pineapple juice. Mix in pineapple and add cheese. Melt butter and pour over mixture. Sprinkle crushed Ritz crackers on top. Bake at 375° for 35 minutes.

title: Cherry Dream Whip Dessert
directions: Crumble mixture., Pat into 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake at 400° for 15 minutes. Cool until it can be handled with fingers., Re-crumble and put back in pan; pat in hard.

title: Hot Potato Salad
directions: Peel and dice potatoes., Set temperature control of electric skillet at 325°., Fry bacon until crisp and remove from frypan. Dip off all but 1 tablespoon bacon grease., Reduce heat., Simmer. Combine potatoes with onion, green pepper, sugar, salt, pepper, vinegar and water., Place in frypan., Cover and heat thoroughly. Sprinkle crumbled bacon and parsley over potatoes.

title: Pineapple Upside-Down Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Melt margarine in bottom of an 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan; remove from heat., Sprinkle brown sugar on bottom of pan., Arrange drained pineapple slices over sugar., Garnish with maraschino cherries and chopped nuts.

title: Meat-Za Pie
directions: Mix beef,, garlic, salt and milk in an 8-inch or 9-inch pie plate., Shape, into a crust with a fork., Put ketchup into the center, area, of, meat, crust., Layer mushrooms or 1/4 cup chopped green, pepper, if, you, prefer, on the ketchup., Break cheese into strips and crisscross over the mushrooms., Sprinkle with Parmesan, cheese and oregano., Bake in 400° oven for 20 minutes. Serve, with a salad and a green vegetable.	Quick and delicious supper!!

title: Cranberry Salad
directions: Soften gelatin with 2 tablespoons of cold water., Dissolve gelatin and jello with 1 1/2 cups of boiling water., Run raw cranberries and unpeeled, but seeded, apples through food chopper. Cut up nuts and orange., Mix sugar with pineapple and combine with ground cranberries, nuts and orange., Add to jello mixture and turn into mold.

title: Apple Butter Milkshake
directions: Combine all ingredients in a blender and blend until smooth. Yield:, 2 servings.

title: Chicken Ratatouille
directions: *You may substitute 1/2 teaspoon dried basil and 1/2 teaspoon oregano for Italian spices.

title: Cheese Roasts
directions: Mix flour, salt and pepper., Coat meat., Heat oil in skillet. Cook onion until tender., Add meat cubes., Cook until brown. Slowly add sour cream or milk and vinegar or lemon juice., Stir constantly.

title: Orange Rolls
directions: In large mixing bowl,, add the first 3 ingredients. Mix for 2 minutes with, dough head beater., Add next 4 ingredients and continue to, blend., Slowly, add, remaining, flour	until mixture is blended well and not sticky to the touch. Cover and let double in size., Punch, down, and	roll dough out long and narrow to 1/4 inch, in thickness., Spread thin layer of orange frosting over dough., Roll up, and, cut, in, 1 1/2 inch rolls. Place in greased pans. Let, rise, to, top, of pans and bake at 375° for 18 minutes or until golden brown., Makes 20 rolls.

title: Chicken Delight
directions: Boil and cut chicken into bite-size pieces., Mix soup and evaporated milk and set aside., Saute celery and onion in the butter and add stuffing., Spread half of stuffing mix in a 13 x 9-inch pan., Add all the chicken., Top that with half of the remaining stuffing., Pour all of soup mix over that. Top with remaining stuffing., Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Mint Tea
directions: Bring 4 cups water to boil., Add tea bags, sugar and mint. Remove from heat., Cover and steep 10 minutes., Add lemonade, orange juice concentrate and 4 cans water.

title: Broccoli And Mandarin Orange Salad
directions: Pour Marzetti's Wilde Raspberry dressing over the above mixture., (Dressing can be found in with packaged salads department.), Very good with pork or steak, and healthy, too!

title: Eclair Cake
directions: Butter a 9 x 13-inch pan., Line with graham crackers., Mix pudding and milk; beat for 2 minutes., Blend in Cool Whip., Pour 1/2 of mixture over graham crackers then lay another of graham crackers., Pour rest of mixture over graham crackers., Add another layer of crackers., Refrigerate for 2 hours; frost with chocolate icing.

title: Nancy Mccorkle'S Scotch Sausage Pie
directions: Chop finely the green pepper and onion and mix with the chopped parsley., Combine with pork sausage.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Cook broccoli and onion together (salted water), then drain. Cook rice in salted water for 15 minutes with lid on., Add soup and Cheez Whiz., Bake for 30 minutes covered at 350°.

title: Corned Beef Sandwich
directions: Mix the first 3 ingredients., Put on bread, bun or English muffin. Make sandwich and wrap in foil. Can be stored in refrigerator or frozen. Warm in oven at 350° for 1/2 hour or until warmed through. Can make open-face and add cheese., Put under broiler until cheese melts.

title: Stuffed Manicotti Pastas
directions: Brown ground chuck and onion; drain and cool., Place in mixing bowl with bread, crumbled, milk, egg, drained mushrooms, 1/2 cup Mozzarella cheese, garlic salt, salt, pepper and Italian seasoning to taste.

title: Quick And Easy Chicken Soup
directions: In large saucepan, bring chicken broth and water to a boil. Reduce heat., Stir in pasta., Simmer 8 to 12 minutes or until pasta is almost tender., Remove broccoli from pouch., Add to soup mixture., Cook 5 minutes or until broccoli is crisp-tender., Stir in chicken., Cook until thoroughly heated., Makes 4 (1 1/2-cup) servings.

title: Pudding Cookies
directions: Cream butter, sugar and pudding., Add eggs and vanilla., Stir in baking powder and flour., Mix in nuts and goodies., Bake at 350° for 8 to 9 minutes for drop cookies., Makes 4 to 5 dozen. "This also makes a great giant cookie."

title: Coca-Cola Cake
directions: Sift flour and sugar together into a bowl., Heat margarine, cocoa and Coke to boiling point., Add buttermilk, soda, eggs, vanilla, salt and marshmallows., Batter will be thin and marshmallows will rise to top.

title: Broccoli In Cheese Custard
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Butter a 1 1/2-quart baking dish, put the chopped broccoli into it, and sprinkle with the cheese., Beat the eggs lightly in a bowl and stir in the milk or cream, salt and pepper., Stir into the broccoli-cheese mixture., Put the baking dish in a shallow pan with hot water halfway up its sides., Bake for 45 to 60 minutes, or until the custard is set.

title: Hay Stacks
directions: In a double boiler, melt peanut butter and butterscotch chips. Mix in noodles and walnuts until coated well., Drop by teaspoon onto waxed paper., Put into refrigerator until set.

title: Rhubarb Custard Pie
directions: Beat eggs slightly., Add milk., Mix together sugar, flour, nutmeg and cinnamon., Stir into egg mixture., Add chopped rhubarb. Dot with butter., Bake at 400° for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Heath Bar Pie
directions: Crush Heath bars into small pieces and put in bottom of pie crust., Mix the, rest of the ingredients together and pour over Heath bars., Bake at 350° for 50 minutes.

title: "Ma'S" Fruit Salad
directions: Cook and cool pudding., Drain and chill pineapple., Remove seeds and chop cherries., Mix pineapple, cherries, marshmallows and nuts., Mix pudding, mayonnaise and whipping cream., Pour over fruits and nuts and mix well., Garnish with paprika., Can be made the day before needed.

title: Indian Bread
directions: Dissolve yeast in water., Mix flour, sugar and corn meal together., Add yeast and enough water to make a sticky dough., Drop by teaspoons into hot lard (deep fat fry)., Fry until crispy brown on both sides., Remove to a paper towel covered pan., Serve with butter and maple syrup or peanut butter or jelly., Also good with ham and eggs or tomato gravy., Lots of ways to serve them.

title: Hawaiian Cake
directions: Drain juice off pineapple; put cream cheese in a bowl., Beat until light and soft., Add Cool Whip and drained pineapple. Spread over cooled cake., Halved cherries may be put on top of topping or, if preferred, nuts or any other decoration.

title: Zesty Mozzarella Chicken
directions: In a shallow bowl, combine egg white and milk., In another bowl, combine the bread crumbs, Parmesan cheese and seasonings. Dip each chicken breast in the egg white mixture, then in the crumb mixture.

title: Split Pea Soup
directions: Heat water, peas and spices to boiling., Simmer for 1 1/2 to 2 1/2 hours until peas are soft., Add vegetables and simmer until tender (may need to add more water)., Add bouillon and jarred meat., Heat and serve.

title: Fudge
directions: Mix sugar, margarine and milk; boil to soft ball stage, then add chocolate chips, Marshmallow Whip and peanut butter., Beat until everything is melted and smooth., Pour into buttered sheet cake pan and cool.

title: Banana Bread
directions: Mix all ingredients together and bake in greased loaf pan at 300° for about 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Brazos River Casserole
directions: Cook noodles and drain. Brown meat and onion with pepper and garlic. Add soups and mix well., Pour in baking dish and top with cheese. Bake 25 minutes in a 350° oven.

title: Sugar Cookies
directions: Mix ingredients together and drop with teaspoon on cookie sheet. Bake at 350° until light brown.

title: Cheesecake
directions: Combine cracker crumbs, margarine and sugar; divide and press into two pie plates., Bake at 350 degrees for 5 minutes., Mix cream cheese, 3/4 cup sugar and eggs with beaters and pour into crusts., Bake 15 minutes at 350., Cool., Mix remaining ingredients and pour on cheesecakes. Sprinkle with cinnamon and almonds, if desired., Bake at 350 for 10 minutes. Chill for 24 hours.

title: Pineapple Pie
directions: Pour in pie crust and bake at 350° until done.

title: Brownies
directions: Cream butter and sugar., Add vanilla and eggs., Sift together, cocoa and flour., Add to creamed mixture and mix well., Add nuts. Spread into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake 20 to 25 minutes at 350°., Cool and cut into squares.

title: Coffee Cake
directions: Butter a Bundt pan heavily with soft butter., Separate each frozen roll into 3 pieces., Put into buttered pan., Pour melted butter over., Combine dry pudding mix, brown sugar, cinnamon and nuts., Sprinkle over dough., Leave pan out overnight, uncovered.

title: Crock-Pot Pizza
directions: Brown and drain hamburger., Cook and drain macaroni., Layer ingredients in crock-pot., Add your own choice of whatever extra ingredients you want (olives, green peppers, etc.)., Cook 3 hours on low.

title: Company Chicken
directions: Brown chicken, remove from pan., Place in baking dish., Mix cream of mushroom soup and white wine together and pour over chicken., Bake for 1 hour at 350°., Remove chicken., Add sour cream., Stir; heat for 10 minutes., Serve.

title: Diabetic Fruit Cookies
directions: Cream together margarine and sugar replacement., Add eggs; beat until fluffy., Combine flour, baking soda, salt and nutmeg in sifter., Add alternately with hot apple juice to creamed mixture. Fold in raisins and currants., Allow to rest 15 minutes.

title: Homa L'S Caramel Pecan Pie
directions: Put can of milk in pot with lid on and keep covered with water., Boil (barely bubbling) for 2 1/2 to 3 hours., Remove; add hot coffee and beat until smooth., Add pecans; put in pie shell and top with whipped cream.

title: Biscuits
directions: Heat oven to 450°., Combine flour, baking powder and salt., Cut shortening into mixture until it is fine crumbs., Stir in just enough milk so dough leaves side of bowl; round up into ball., Turn dough onto lightly floured surface., Knead lightly 10 times., Roll or pat dough 1/2-inch thick., Cut with floured 2-inch biscuit cutter., Place on ungreased cookie sheet about 1-inch apart for crusty sides., Bake 10 to 12 minutes or until golden brown., Makes about 16 biscuits.

title: Pepper Steak
directions: Cut round steak into strips and brown in butter., Add garlic and beef broth., Cover and simmer 30 minutes., Add green onion and green peppers., Cover and cook 5 minutes., Blend cornstarch, water and soy sauce., Stir into meat, mix and cook until thick (2 minutes)., Add tomatoes and stir gently., Serve over a bed of rice.

title: Tofu Fried Rice
directions: Saute garlic, and, green, onion, in water until tender. Stir in celery, and, cook 2 to 3 minutes., Stir in sprouts and red pepper and, cook 1 to 2 minutes., Stir in remaining ingredients and remove from heat., Serve hot with soy sauce.

title: Caramel Coffee Cake
directions: Spray Pam in angel food pan., Mix dry pudding mix and sugar together., Add 1/2 cup chopped nuts (optional) to the mix. Sprinkle in bottom of pan., Place frozen rolls on top of mix so entire bottom of pan is covered., Pour melted butter over all. Cover with a towel and allow to rise all night (not in the refrigerator)., Next morning, bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes. Allow to set for 10 minutes, then invert on plate., Delicious plain or with butter.

title: Oatmeal Refrigerator Cookies
directions: In large bowl, cream sugars and butter or margarine together until light and fluffy., Beat eggs, one at a time., Sift together flour, salt, baking soda and spices., Mix nuts and raisins into sifted flour mixture and add to creamed mixture., Add vanilla. Stir in oats., Mixture will be rather stiff., Make 2 rolls on waxed paper and roll up., Refrigerate overnight., Slice into thin slices and place on baking sheet., Bake in preheated 350° oven for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Mom'S Jelly Muffins
directions: Preheat oven to 400°., Add ingredients according to order of recipe., Spoon into greased muffin tins or paper liners., Place 1/2 teaspoon to 1 teaspoon of any kind of jelly or jam on top of each muffin, pressing into batter., Try to bring batter over the top of jelly to cover it up., Bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until brown.

title: Cranberry Sauce For Pork
directions: Saute chopped onion and butter., Add catsup, cranberries (check for sweetness before adding sugar), sugar, Worcestershire sauce and yellow mustard., Simmer and serve over pork.

title: Sour Cream Coffee Cake
directions: Mix nuts, cinnamon and sugar together and set aside., Cream butter and sugar., Add eggs; cream together., Add vanilla, sour cream and dry ingredients; mix., Pour 1/4 of batter into greased tube pan or loaf pan., Sprinkle 1/2 nut mixture over., Add the rest of the batter, then sprinkle the rest of the nut mixture over top. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Lemon Chess Pie
directions: Mix sugar, flour and corn meal., Add eggs and butter., Mix well., Add buttermilk and lemon juice., Mix well., Pour into unbaked 9-inch pie shell., Bake at 400° for 10 minutes, then reduce heat to 325° and bake 35 minutes., When begins to brown, cover with foil to prevent burning.

title: Leslie'S Salad
directions: Toss lettuce, celery, green onions and Mandarin oranges together. Melt 1/4 cup sugar, toss in 1/2 cup almonds and lay out on greased cutting board to cool. Chop and add to greens.

title: Date Balls
directions: Combine egg, sugar and dates., Cook on low heat until dates are melted., Remove; add vanilla., Pour over Rice Krispies and pecans; mix well., Form in small balls and roll in coconut., Makes 4 dozen.

title: Fluffy Key Lime Pie
directions: Combine pie filling mix, 1 cup of sugar and 1/4 cup of water in saucepan., Blend in egg yolks; add remaining water., Cook and stir over medium heat until mixture comes to a full boil., Remove from heat; stir in lime juice and rind., Beat egg white until foamy throughout., Gradually add 1/4 cup sugar and continue beating until mixture will form stiff, shiny peaks., Blend in pie filling mixture., Add enough food coloring to tint light green. pour onto crust., Chill until firm., Garnish with prepared whipped topping, lime slices or twists.

title: Chocolate Berry Chill
directions: Spread softened ice cream onto bottom of crust., Freeze until firm. Spread fudge sauce evenly over ice cream., Cover with Cool Whip., Freeze 4 hours or until firm., Let stand approximately 30 minutes before serving. Garnish with strawberries and fudge sauce. Preparation time:, 15 minutes., Makes 8 servings.

title: Artichoke Squares
directions: Drain artichokes, reserving marinade from one jar., Saute onion in marinade., Cut up artichokes., Beat eggs and add crumbs and seasonings., Stir in cheese, sauteed onion and artichokes. Turn into a greased 11 x 7-inch baking pan., Bake at 325° for 30 minutes., Cool slightly before cutting into squares., Makes 40 servings (I don't believe it!).

title: Pull Apart Cake Or Bubble Bread
directions: Cut each biscuit into quarters., Mix together 3/4 cup sugar and 3 teaspoons cinnamon., Roll biscuit pieces to coat., Layer in ungreased tube pan with nuts., Combine 3/4 cup oleo, 1 cup brown sugar and rum or milk., Bring to a boil., Pour over biscuits., Bake at 350° for 20 to 40 minutes., Cake will not slice, just pull apart., May also use frozen bread dough instead of biscuits.

title: Jam Cake
directions: Cream butter and sugar., Add eggs and beat until fluffy., Sift flour, salt and spices together., Dissolve soda in buttermilk. Add flour mixture and buttermilk alternately to the creamed mixture, beginning and ending with dry ingredients., Fold in the jam and pour into three 9-inch round pans that have been greased and lined with wax paper., Bake for 40 minutes in 325° oven., Ice with caramel icing.

title: Cold Slaw
directions: Shred cabbage in large bowl., Chop onion and pepper and put on top of cabbage; set aside., Heat to boiling the oil mixture, vinegar, sugar and salt., Pour over cabbage mixture., Let set overnight before stirring., Stir up and refrigerate., Will keep indefinitely.

title: Heavenly Delight Congealed Dessert
directions: Prepare jello., Allow it to partially congeal in refrigerator. Dice cherries except for a few for garnish., Mix cherries, pecans and pineapple in separate bowl., Mix cream cheese (room temperature) with water and then with fruit., Mix in jello and marshmallows.

title: Pineapple Chutney
directions: Mix all the ingredients together and cook until the mixture is thick., Add salt to taste., Cook pineapple in juice until the juice has reduced to very little, then add all the other ingredients., Cook until the mixture thickens., Keep chutney in a jar and use as needed.

title: Mexican Cornbread
directions: Brown ground beef and onion (salt to taste); drain., Mix together meal, buttermilk, oil, eggs, corn, soda and salt., Use a large glass baking dish or a large and medium-size iron skillet. Grease with shortening., Pour 1/2 of meal mixture into dish., Pour in ground beef., Chop peppers, then grate cheese., Sprinkle over meat., Add rest of meal mixture., Bake, uncovered, at 425° for 45 minutes., Best when served with pinto beans and cole slaw.

title: Lemon Mustard Chicken
directions: Heat oven to 375°., Place chicken in shallow baking pan., Melt margarine in saucepan., Stir in mustard, lemon juice and tarragon. Pour mixture over chicken., Bake 45 minutes or until cooked through., Spoon sauce from pan over chicken as needed.

title: Fish Cakes Oven Baked Or Fried
directions: Separate fish into small flakes., Cook onion in fat or oil until limp., Combine eggs, mashed potatoes, catsup and salt with fish and onion in a bowl., Portion mixture into cakes and roll in bread crumbs., Space in single layer on well oiled shallow pan and bake 8 to 10 minutes., If frying, use bacon fat until brown on both sides.

title: Cajun Shrimp
directions: Divide shrimp equally among 4 small au gratin dishes; set aside., In saucepan, heat butter or margarine with olive oil., Add remaining ingredients, except cheese., Cook 5 minutes over medium heat.

title: Lori'S Chicken Casserole
directions: Mix together sour cream, cream of chicken soup, cream of mushroom soup and chicken broth. Place chicken in 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Pour mixture over chicken. Mix cracker crumbs with butter and spread over casserole. Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes, until crackers are brown.

title: Snack Meat Balls
directions: Combine milk, 2 teaspoons Worcestershire sauce and soup mix; blend well., Let stand for 5 minutes. Add beef; mix well. Mixture will, be, moist., Shape, into balls using 1 tablespoon for each. Place on, rack in broiler pan., Broil 5 to 6 inches from heat for 10	to, 12	minutes., (Do not turn meat balls.) Combine, remaining ingredients, and, Worcestershire, sauce in saucepan., Cook, stirring until heated., Add meat balls.

title: Grandma Minnie'S Banana Bread
directions: Combine dry ingredients., Mix together melted butter, beaten eggs, milk and mashed bananas., Add to dry ingredients and mix just enough to combine., Pour into greased loaf pan and bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Mayonnaise Cake
directions: Sift together the flour, sugar, soda and cocoa., Add the remaining ingredients., Pour into greased and floured 13 x 9-inch pan., Bake at 350° until done, when toothpick inserted in center comes out clean., Cool and frost with your favorite chocolate fudge frosting.

title: Caramel Corn
directions: Bring, margarine, sugar, salt and corn syrup to a boil, stirring, constantly., Then, boil, without stirring for 5 minutes. Remove, from, heat;, add soda and vanilla and pour over popcorn. Mix, and, turn, into, 2, large buttered baking pans. Bake, at 250° for 1 hour, stirring every 15 minutes., (Optional:	peanuts, can be added and stirred in the last 30 minutes of baking.)

title: Hamburger Pie
directions: Brown hamburger meat., Heat lima beans or peas., Mix hamburger meat and lima beans or peas with one can of tomato soup., Add Worcestershire or A.1. steak sauce, dash of salt and pepper., Put mixed ingredients into pie shell; cover with a layer of Cheddar cheese (optional)., Cover with top pie crust and bake at 350° for about 30 to 35 minutes or until turns brown.

title: Icebox Biscuits
directions: Dissolve yeast in warm water., Add salt, sugar, eggs, margarine, then flour., Stir., Let stand in refrigerator overnight. Roll out on lightly floured board 1/4-inch thick and cut like pieces of pie., Roll from wide end to point., Set on greased cookie sheet and let stand about 3 hours before baking at 425° for about 15 minutes., Add more flour if dough is too thin., Unused dough keeps well until needed.

title: Nesselrood Pudding
directions: Whip enough whipping cream to make 1 cup., Sweeten with powdered sugar to suit your taste., Add vanilla., Beat eggs until foamy., Add sugar gradually and beat until stiff., Toast almonds. Put almonds, Grape-Nuts and 1 tablespoon cherry juice in large mixing bowl., Add whipped cream., Blend together., Fold in egg whites last., Pour all into desired serving bowl or flat pan and freeze.

title: Easy Home Baked Bread
directions: In large bowl combine water, yeast, sugar and salt.* Gradually add flour to form a stiff dough., Place in a greased bowl and cover., Let rise until double in size, 1 to 1 1/2 hours., Toss on floured board, divide in half, shape into 2 loaves., Grease pans and sprinkle with cornmeal., Place in the dough and let rise 45 to 60 minutes., Brush with beaten egg white all over the top, and sprinkle with sesame or poppy seed.

title: Bean Soup
directions: Heat beans and water to boiling in, Dutch oven., Boil, uncovered, 2 minutes. Remove from heat., Cover and let stand 1 hour.

title: Chipped Beef Balls
directions: Finely chop beef and mix together with cream cheese, horseradish and parsley., Form into bite size balls and roll in Parmesan cheese., Chill., Just before serving, spear each ball with a pretzel stick., Serves 8.

title: Ravioli And Sausage
directions: In 10-inch skillet over medium-high heat, cook sausage until browned and no longer pink, stirring to separate meat., Spoon off fat., Stir in spaghetti sauce., Heat to boiling., Add ravioli. Heat through, stirring occasionally., Sprinkle with cheese. Garnish with oregano if desired.

title: Sauerkraut Casserole
directions: Mix sour cream and onions., Spread in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan., Spread sauerkraut over top., Layer with corned beef; add Swiss cheese., Top with bread crumbs., Drizzle with butter., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Pound Cake
directions: Have all ingredients at room temperature before beginning. This is very important!

title: English Muffins
directions: In large, bowl,, combine, 1 1/4 cups flour, salt, sugar and yeast; mix well., Add the warm water and shortening., Beat 3 minutes, at, medium, speed on mixer., By hand, gradually add remaining flour, to make a firm dough., Knead on floured board until smooth, and, elastic, about 5 minutes., Place in greased bowl;, cover, and let rise until double., Punch down dough and roll out, on, lightly sprinkled cornmeal board., Cut into 3 or 4-inch, circles., Cover;, let, rise, until, dough,, about	30 minutes., Bake, on lightly oiled griddle or frypan at 325° for about 8 minutes on each side, until golden brown., Makes 12 to 14.

title: Broccoli Bread
directions: Combine all ingredients and mix well., Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake at 400° for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Baked Mashed Potatoes
directions: Boil the potatoes in the skins, then peel., Mash the potatoes with cream and seasonings., Place in the baking dish and brush with melted butter., Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese., Bake at 450° for 20 minutes.

title: Lasagna
directions: Cook noodles., Brown beef, then add sauce, onion and mushrooms., Mix eggs and cottage cheese together, then layer in 10 x 13-inch pan:, noodles, beef mixture, eggs, cottage cheese and Mozzarella cheese and repeat for three layers., Cook 1 hour at 350°.

title: Rosemary Abbott'S Syrian Shadai
directions: Combine ingredients and cook in large stewing pan until noodles are done., If desired, white breast of chicken can be substituted for stewing chicken., Correct the seasoning with salt and pepper.

title: Wilted Coleslaw
directions: In a small bowl, combine the cabbage, onion, celery seed and salt; set aside., In a skillet, cook bacon until crisp., Drain, reserving 1 tablespoon drippings., Crumble bacon over cabbage mixture., To the drippings, add sugar, vinegar and paprika; heat until sugar is dissolved., Pour over cabbage mixture and toss to coat., Serve immediately., Yield: 1 serving.

title: Key Lime Pie
directions: In large bowl mix milk (Eagle Brand), lime peel, juice and salt., Add yolks., Use mixer at high speed., Beat 1 or 2 minutes or until thick., Pour into crust., Chill at least 2 hours or until set.

title: Strawberry Pie
directions: Bake pie crust 15 minutes in 350° oven., Cool. Mix ingredients except strawberries., Slice strawberries in 1/4's and place in pie crust., Cook other ingredients until thick., Pour over strawberries; place pie in refrigerator to cool, then put Cool Whip on top of pie., Ready to serve.

title: Caramel Apple Dip
directions: Combine and serve with sliced apples., Or combine one 8 ounce cream cheese, 1/2 cup brown sugar, 1 teaspoon vanilla and 1/2 teaspoon Watkins caramel flavoring.

title: Chocolate Nut Upside-Down Cake
directions: Melt 4 tablespoons of butter in small saucepan; stir in brown sugar., Heat until bubbly., Stir in corn syrup and cream., Heat, stirring constantly, just to boiling., Add nuts., Pour into generously buttered 10-inch (12-cup) Bundt pan., Put aside.

title: Spinach Or Broccoli Bake
directions: Thaw spinach., Add cheese, soup, butter, onion and egg; mix well., Toss in stuffing (reserve 3/4 cup)., Place in greased 1-quart casserole., Top with remaining stuffing., Dot with butter. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Vegetable Casserole
directions: Steam vegetables and onion together; drain., Put cheese in and mix well., Put in baking dish., Mix butter and crackers together; spread on top., Bake until it starts to turn brown around edges at 350°.

title: Nacho Dip
directions: Fry beef and drain., Add remaining ingredients., Place in crock-pot and keep on low., Serve with chips.

title: Mashed Potato Candy
directions: Stir powdered sugar into potato, vanilla and salt mixture until dough resembles pie crust., Place between sheets of waxed paper and flatten until 1-inch thick., Spread with peanut butter. Cut into bite size candy., Store in covered container.

title: Snickerdoodles
directions: Sift together the flour, cream of tartar, soda and salt. Cream the shortening., Gradually beat in sugar and eggs., Stir in dry ingredients., Chill dough about 1 hour., Form balls the size of small walnuts., Roll in a mixture of 2 tablespoons of sugar and 2 teaspoons of cinnamon., Place about 2 inches apart on ungreased baking sheet., Bake in hot oven (400°) until lightly browned, but still soft, about 8 to 10 minutes., These cookies will puff at first, then flatten out with crinkled tops., Makes 5 dozen.

title: Golden Chicken Nuggets
directions: Melt margarine., Add chicken chunks to the margarine and coat well., In separate bowl, combine all dry ingredients., Add chicken to dry ingredients and coat well., Bake on greased/sprayed cookie sheet for 10 minutes at 400°.

title: Chili Con Queso
directions: Add all ingredients together in a microwavable bowl and heat in two minute increments until cheese is melted., Stir well and serve with tortilla chips.

title: Banana Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients and chill.

title: Chili Relleno Squares
directions: In a lightly greased 8-inch square pan, alternate layers of cheeses and chilies, starting and ending with cheese., Beat eggs, milk and flour until smooth., Pour egg mixture over cheese and bake at 375° for 30 minutes., Cut into small squares., Serve warm.

title: No Bake Cookies
directions: In saucepan bring butter, sugar, milk and vanilla to a boil for 2 minutes, stirring frequently., In large mixing bowl put oats and cocoa powder together., Pour butter, sugar, milk and vanilla over oats and stir until mixed well., Drop tablespoon size cookie dough onto wax paper, let cool., Enjoy!

title: Creamy Chicken Casserole
directions: Cook and chop chicken breasts., Reserve 1/2 cup of broth. Crush crackers and mix with butter., Put 1/2 cracker mixture in bottom of casserole dish., Mix all liquid ingredients with chicken and layer over crackers., Top with remaining crackers., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Easy Chicken Pot Pie
directions: Mix all ingredients in a casserole dish.

title: Country-Style Barbecued Ribs
directions: In large pot, cover ribs with water and bring to boil., Cover and simmer for 45-60 minutes or until tender., Drain., Cook onion in hot oil until tender and stir in garlic., Stir in remaining ingredients except ribs and simmer uncovered for 15 minutes stirring once or twice., Grill ribs over low coals about 45 minutes or until done, turning every 15 minutes and brushing with sauce., Serves 6.

title: Grandmother'S Oatmeal Bread
directions: Soften yeast; combine next 5 ingredients., Cool., Stir in 2 cups flour, beat., Add eggs and yeast, flour to make soft., Rest for 10 minutes; knead., Let rise until double in bulk., Divide in 1/2 or make into rolls., Bake at 370° for 35 minutes., I let it rise twice before I put it into pans, kneading it again.

title: Pasta Salad
directions: Mix cooked macaroni, chicken, onion, bell pepper and olives together., Combine Italian dressing, mayonnaise, salt and pepper in separate bowl., Pour over salad and mix well., Put in refrigerator to cool.

title: French Toast
directions: Beat egg until frothy., Add milk; beat well., Melt butter in skillet on low heat., Dip bread slices, one at a time, into egg mixture., Lift them into skillet with pancake turner., Brown on each side., Serve with confectioners sugar, maple syrup or cinnamon and sugar, if desired.

title: Tater Tot Casserole
directions: Brown ground beef; drain and place in 9 x 13-inch casserole dish., Chop onion and put over beef., Spread 1 can cream of chicken soup on top of beef and onions., Top with Tater Tots., Mix cream of celery soup with 1/2 can water; mix well and pour over Tater Tots.

title: Lasagne To Die For!!!!
directions: Brown sausage and hamburger; drain., Add undrained tomatoes, tomato paste, water, basil, garlic and 1 1/2 teaspoons salt. Simmer, covered, 15 minutes; stir occasionally.

title: Southwest Appetizer Cheesecake
directions: Place tortilla chips in large plastic bag; seal., Finely crush chips with mallet or rolling pin to measure 1 cup., Preheat oven to 325°., Combine crushed chips and butter; press onto bottom of 9-inch spring-form pan., Bake 15 minutes.

title: Pecan Pie Bars
directions: Set aside 2/3 of cake mix., In mixing bowl, combine remaining cake mix, butter and 1 egg., Mix until crumbly., Press mixture into a 13 x 9-inch greased pan., Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Tuna-Macaroni Casserole
directions: Prepare macaroni as directed on box., Strain., Mix in tuna, shrimp, crabmeat, onion, mayonnaise and seasonings., Mix mushroom soup with juice from tuna., Mix soup and place in greased casserole dish., Bake at 400° about 1/2 hour or until bread crumbs have browned.

title: Popcorn Cake
directions: Mix popped corn, gumdrops and, nuts in large pan., Melt oil and oleo and marshmallows., Pour over the first 3 ingredients, mix well by hand., Pack, tightly, in, greased, tube pan. Let set for 2 hours., Take out of pan.

title: Pickled Beets
directions: Boil beets until tender. Dip in cool water and pull off skins.

title: Coffee Cake
directions: Cream shortening, sugar and vanilla thoroughly., Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition., Sift flour, baking powder and soda together., Add to creamed mixture, alternately with sour cream, blending after each addition., Spread half the batter in a 10-inch tube pan (greased and floured)., Cream butter, brown sugar and cinnamon; add nuts., Mix well., Sprinkle 1/2 nut mixture evenly over the batter in pan., Cover with remaining batter., Sprinkle remaining nut mixture on top., Bake at 350° for 50 minutes.

title: Strawberry Surprise
directions: Prepare 1 box strawberry jello and refrigerate to jell., After it has jelled, spread 1/2 of the strawberries over the jello. Over strawberries, spread the sour cream., Spread the remaining strawberries over the sour cream., Prepare the second box of jello and pour over the already prepared mixture., Sprinkle the pecans over the jello and refrigerate until firm.

title: Cream Cheese Coconut Cake
directions: Blend cake mix, pudding mix, water, eggs and oil in a large bowl., Beat at medium speed for 4 minutes., Stir in coconut and pecans., Pour into 3 greased and floured 9-inch layer cake pans. Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

title: Baby Pearl Tapioca
directions: Combine and heat, to, boiling,, stirring all the while. Boil for 5 minutes., Pour, in, cans, and cold pack 20 minutes. Can add fruit cocktail and Cool Whip after opening.

title: Million Dollar Pie
directions: Mix together and add 1/2 cup lemon juice before pouring into graham cracker crust.

title: Baked Beans
directions: Brown bacon and onion but don't cook until crisp., Add other ingredients, mixing well., Bake at 375° for 45 minutes.

title: Hot Crab Dip
directions: Chunk up the cream cheese., Drain the crab., Dump it all in the crock-pot on high., Stir frequently until the cheese melts. Cover; turn to low and cook 4 to 5 hours.

title: Chicken Divan
directions: Arrange broccoli in greased baking dish., Place chicken on top., Combine next 4 ingredients., Pour over chicken., Sprinkle with cheese and bread crumbs and dot with butter., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Christmas Morning Egg Strata
directions: In a large baking dish, spray Pam all over., Put 6 slices of bread on the bottom., Cover bread with cooked sausage (drain off grease)., Next layer is Velveeta slices., In a large bowl, mix eggs, dry mustard, milk, salt and pepper., Pour over layers., Bake at 325° for 1 hour, uncovered.

title: Harvest Loaf
directions: Combine dry ingredients and mix well., Cream margarine; add sugar gradually., Blend eggs in creamed mixture and mix well., Add dry ingredients and pumpkin., Stir in morsels and walnuts., Bake at 350° for 65 to 75 minutes., Grease and flour loaf pan.

title: Nutty Tuna-Noodle Bake
directions: Cook noodles according to package directions; drain well. Meanwhile, in saucepan, melt the butter or margarine; stir in flour., Add the milk and soup all at once., Cook until mixture is thickened and bubbly., Remove the soup mixture from heat; stir in American cheese until melted., Stir in tuna, peas and carrots and pimiento into soup mixture., Fold in noodles., Turn the soup-tuna mixture into a 2-quart casserole., Sprinkle the chopped peanuts atop., Bake, uncovered, in a 350° oven for 30 to 35 minutes or until mixture is heated through., Makes 6 servings.

title: Macaroni 'N Cheese
directions: Melt margarine in saucepan over low heat., Add flour., Slowly add milk and cook until thickened., Add salt, pepper and cheeses. Continue cooking over low heat until cheeses melt., Add to 1 pound cooked, drained elbow macaroni., Place in buttered casserole dish. Mix plain bread crumbs with melted margarine and sprinkle over top., Bake at 350° until hot.

title: Vegetable Party Sandwich Spread
directions: Drain vegetables well., Beat cream cheese and lemon, juice until smooth., Stir in vegetables., Yields about 2 1/2 cups. Store covered in refrigerator.

title: Chocolate-Chocolate Chip Cake
directions: Mix cake mix, pudding, oil, eggs, vanilla, sour cream and butter., Divide batter in half., Add chocolate chips to one bowl and chocolate syrup swirled in the other., Pour bowl with chocolate syrup in bottom of greased and floured pound or bundt cake pan., Then pour bowl with chocolate chip batter on top., Bake at 325° for 1 hour.

title: Hillbilly Ice Cream
directions: Fold all ingredients together and freeze., Any flavor of fruit pie filling may be used.

title: Coconut Macaroons
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Grease a baking sheet., Mix the ingredients together with a fork., Drop by teaspoon lumps of mixture onto baking sheet., Bake for 10 minutes or until edges turn light brown., Remove from baking sheet with a spatula., Cool. Yield: 24., You may place a pecan half in the center of each macaroon before baking, if desired.

title: Apricot Sherbet
directions: Combine all ingredients in saucepan., Heat until gelatin is completely dissolved., Place in bowl and freeze until partially frozen., Whip apricot mixture with electric mixer., Return to freezer until set.

title: Chicken Scaloppini
directions: Slice chicken thin and flour., Saute in olive oil until golden brown., Season with garlic salt., Layer chicken and top with eggplant and mushrooms in a baking dish., In a pan, melt butter and add flour and onions., Stir in broth, Sauterne and parsley. Mix to a nice gravy., Pour over chicken and eggplant., Bake, covered, 30 minutes at 325°.

title: Quiche
directions: Mix eggs, milk, dressing and seasonings., Toss flour with cheese and add to liquid mix., Pour over any of the following ingredients in the pie pan:, Broccoli - crab - ham - chicken - shrimp - mushrooms - spinach.

title: Mama'S Creamy Mac-N-Cheese
directions: Bring 1 quart of water to a boil in a saucepan., When it begins boiling add 1 tbsp of butter., Add noodles and cook until tender., Drain most of water but leave some in the bottom of the pan., Add milk, cheese, and the other tbsp of butter, salt and pepper., Stir until cheese is thoroughly melted of low heat., Makes approx. 4 servings.

title: Lo-Cal, Fat-Free Chocolate Chip Cookies
directions: Beat egg whites until foamy., Add cream of tartar and vanilla. Add sugar gradually and beat until stiff and glossy., Fold in chocolate chips., Drop by teaspoon on foil lined cookie sheet. Bake 25 to 30 minutes in a 250° oven.

title: Bean And Eggplant Curry
directions: In a 12-inch skillet, heat olive oil., When hot, add onion and carrots; stir-fry for 5 minutes., Add turkey and stir-fry, breaking up turkey, until there is no more pink., Add tomato sauce, oregano, beans and season to taste with pepper., Stir-fry for another minute or so or until all ingredients are very hot. Stir in parsley and serve immediately.

title: Sour Cream And Chili Bake
directions: In skillet, brown the ground beef., Stir in beans, enchilada sauce, tomato sauce and 1 cup shredded cheese., Set aside 1 cup corn chips. Coarsely crush remaining chips., Stir them into meat mixture., Turn in a 1 1/2-quart casserole dish., Bake, covered, at 375° for 30 minutes., Spoon sour cream on casserole., Sprinkle 1/2 cup shredded cheese., Sprinkle reserved corn chips around edge of casserole., Bake, uncovered, for 2 to 3 minutes.

title: Spinach Salad
directions: Layer ingredients in order given., "Ice" with 1 cup Miracle Whip mixed with 1 cup mayonnaise., Top with shredded Swiss cheese. Toss together before serving.

title: Easy Ice Cream Pie
directions: Blend the ice cream and milk., Add the pudding. Beat 1 minute. Pour in a baked pie shell., Let stand in refrigerator for at least 1 hour.

title: Sausage Zucchini Boats
directions: Cook whole zucchini in salted boiling water until tender, 7 to 10 minutes., Cut in 1/2 lengthwise segments., Scoop squash from shells and mash., Cook sausage with onion., Drain off excess fat. Stir in mashed zucchini, reserving 2 tablespoons Parmesan cheese. Add remaining ingredients., Mix with a spoon into shells., Place shells in a shallow baking dish., Sprinkle with remainder of Parmesan cheese and dash of paprika., Bake in moderate oven at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Baked Zucchini
directions: Mix all the ingredients together. Bake in a greased loaf pan in a 350° oven for approximately 1 hour.

title: Sweet Potato Souffle
directions: Bake and peel potatoes (or boil with skins on) at 400° for 1 hour., Cool and peel potatoes. Mash pulp and stir in raisins, sugar, cinnamon and pineapple., Pour into baking pan and sprinkle with chopped pecans., Bake, covered, at 400° for 15 minutes.

title: Veggie Dip
directions: Blend all of the ingredients and serve with fresh veggies.

title: Scripture Cake
directions: *Note:, May not need all of flour; watch for consistency of cake batter.

title: Corn Bread Dressing(100 Years Old)
directions: Mix bread and biscuits in a large pan or bowl., Melt butter and lightly saute onion and celery., Add to crumb mixture., Add remaining ingredients and mix well., Bake in well-greased shallow pans in a 400° oven for 15 to 25 minutes.

title: Old-Fashioned Cherry Pudding
directions: Preheat oven to 325°., Melt butter in 9 x 9-inch pan., Mix sugar, flour, baking powder and milk into batter., Pour batter over melted butter in pan., Do not stir!, Spoon pie cherries, juice and all, over batter., Do not stir! Sprinkle 1/4 cup sugar over top., Bake for 60 minutes.

title: Bread Pudding
directions: Scald milk., Add bread and set aside., Beat eggs lightly and add seasonings, sugar and butter., Mix, then add vanilla and raisins., Mix with bread and milk mixture and pour in 2-quart buttered dish and bake in a pan of water at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Chocolate Pie
directions: Mix, sugar,, flour, and cocoa;	add just enough milk to moisten., Add, egg	yolks.	In double boiler or Teflon skillet place, milk, and bring to a boil., Gradually stir in chocolate mixture., Cook, until it thickens.	Just before taking up, add margarine and vanilla., Pour in cool, baked pie shell., Chill. Top with Cool Whip before serving.

title: Chalupah
directions: Cover all ingredients with water., Cook 6 hours, covered. Stir and add water as needed., Remove lid; cook 1 more hour., Meat will fall apart., Serve over tortilla chips., Add grated cheese, lettuce, tomato, onion and avocado., Looks like a giant tostada. Freezes well.

title: Mandarin Glazed Beets
directions: In large saucepan combine sugar, cornstarch, lemon juice and butter., Bring to boil over medium heat, stirring constantly until thickened., Stir in beets and oranges., Cook until hot., Serve. Also good cold.

title: Rice Krispies Candy
directions: In double boiler melt morsels and Crisco., Add Rice Krispies and raisins., Mix well., Drop by teaspoon on wax paper on cookie sheet., Refrigerate 1/2 hour., Can use small peanuts, cut pecans or walnuts or coconut in place of raisins.

title: Cherry Chocolate Cake
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Mix all ingredients in an ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan with fork, scraping corners until moist., Stir batter vigorously with fork for 1 minute., Scrape sides and smooth out. Bake 40 to 50 minutes., Dust with powdered sugar or a frosting of your choice.

title: Celery Seed Potatoes
directions: Peel and cut potatoes into bite size pieces., Cook in salted water., When boiling, add onion and garlic powder along with celery seed., Cook to desired doneness and then drain., Place into bowl and add 1/2 stick butter, pepper and parsley., Mix until coated.

title: Quick And Easy Vanilla Cookies
directions: Mix sugar, Crisco and egg together., Add vanilla, then add dry ingredients., Roll into balls (small)., Flatten., Bake at 350° for 10 minutes., Makes about 50 cookies.

title: Shrimp Scampi
directions: Heat butter, garlic and olive oil in a large skillet., Add shrimp and saute on both sides until done (about 5 minutes)., Pour off pan drippings into a small saucepan., Add the remaining ingredients., Cook over high heat 1 minute., Pour sauce over shrimp and serve with rice to absorb the juices.

title: Cheese And Sausage Appetizers
directions: Mix all ingredients well., Shape into small, marble-sized balls., Place on cookie sheet and bake in 350° oven about 15 to 20 minutes., Serve hot., Keep on hand in the freezer., Can be frozen, cooked or uncooked., Makes about 100 balls.

title: Corn Custard
directions: Saute onions, including tops, and bell pepper in butter., Add remaining ingredients and bake in a deep baking dish (10 x 7 1/2 x 3-inch) for 45 minutes to 1 hour at 350° or until center has cooked and knife comes out clean when inserted.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: In large casserole dish, spread even 1/2 Pepperidge Farm mix. Melt oleo in water., Pour over this, then mix chicken, onion, celery, mayonnaise, salt, pepper and spread over mix evenly., Beat eggs well in milk., Pour over chicken mixture., Cover casserole with foil and refrigerate overnight., Before cooking, remove casserole and let sit until room temperature., Pour 1 can mushroom soup over top spreading even, then top with balance of Pepperidge Farm., Bake 1 hour at 350°.

title: Green Beans 'N Cheese
directions: Bring beans to a boil and simmer 5 minutes., Drain well and mash slightly., Pour into shallow baking dish., Add soup, blending well., Top with cheese and bake at 350° until cheese melts, being careful not to scorch cheese.

title: Chicken Elegant
directions: Spread chipped beef on bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan., Wrap each chicken cutlet, with, one piece of bacon and place on top of beef. Mix, sour, cream, and, mushroom, soup together, then spread over chicken, and, beef., Refrigerate 24 hours., Bake, uncovered, at 275° for 3 hours.

title: Olive Spread
directions: Mash cheese with a fork. Add mayonnaise and stir until smooth. Add other ingredients and mix well. Refrigerate at least 12 hours. Mix will become firm as it cools.

title: Hamburger Stroganoff
directions: Saute onion in butter. Stir beef, garlic, flour, salt, pepper, paprika and mushrooms. Saute 5 minutes. Add soup. Simmer, uncovered, 10 minutes. Stir in sour cream.

title: Cranberry Salad
directions: Dissolve jello in hot water., Mix all together the day before serving., Put in refrigerator.

title: Fruit Fluff
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Put in a glass bowl and refrigerate overnight.

title: Plain Pound Cake
directions: Beat sugar, crisco, and margarine together; until smooth., Add eggs one at a time., Add flavoring any time., Add half milk, half flour, beat until smooth, the add rest of milk and flour., Beat on low speed, then turn on high., Beat until creamy., Cook at 300° for 1 1/2 hour., Don't forget to grease pan and flour pan.

title: Orange-Honey Cake
directions: Combine concentrate, honey and coffee., Beat eggs until light; add oil and sugar gradually., Beat. Sift dry ingredients together. Add egg mixture alternately with orange mixture., Mix until smooth., Pour into 2 greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pans., Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 10 minutes, or until done., Cool, remove from pans., Makes 2 loaf cakes., Best if let set for 2 days before serving.

title: Cabbage Burger Bake
directions: Quarter and shred cabbage., Spread half in buttered 12-cup baking dish., Saute bacon just until fat starts to cook out in frying pan., Stir onions and rice in drippings, in frying pan and cook over medium heat, stirring constantly until onion is soft and rice is lightly browned., Spoon over cabbage in baking dish., Cook ground beef and crumble over rice mixture., Sprinkle with salt and pepper., Top with remaining cabbage., Heat Ragu and water to boiling., Pour slowly over cabbage., Top with bacon., Cover and bake at 400°, for 1 hour.

title: Chris' Pecan Pie
directions: Beat egg whites until very stiff; add sugar gradually and baking powder., Beat until stiff., Fold in crackers, nuts and vanilla., Put in buttered pie pan; bake at 350° for 23 minutes. May be served with whipped cream.

title: Gingersnaps
directions: Cream margarine, sugar, molasses and egg together., Stir flour, salt, baking soda, cloves and ginger together., Add to creamed mixture., Mixture will be soft., Roll in little balls and roll in sugar., Place on lightly greased cookie sheet, 2-inches apart., Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.

title: Broccoli Casserole I
directions: Cook celery and onion with broccoli in 1/2 cup water for 7 or 8 minutes (or until tender)., Add rest of ingredients; mix and put in casserole dish., Bake for 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Chicken Waldorf Salad
directions: Blend mayo, sugar, mustard, salt and lemon juice., Add remaining ingredients., Toss gently to coat., Serve on bed of lettuce or serve as is.

title: Unkneaded Brown Bread
directions: Combine yeast, 1/2 cup warm water and sugar., Set in warm place for 10 minutes to dissolve yeast.

title: Baked Hostess Ham
directions: Lay ham on heavy foil and pour mixture over it. Stick 6 to 8 whole cloves in ham., Fold foil to seal., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes per pound. When done, punch holes in bottom of foil to let liquid drain out.

title: Fruit Salad(Good For Diabetics)
directions: Dissolve jello in boiling water., Add crushed pineapple and buttermilk., Chill overnight., Makes 8 servings.

title: Mashed Potato Patties
directions: Mix mashed potatoes and grated cheese., Season to taste with salt and pepper., Form the mixture into patties and brown in butter on both sides., Leftover mashed potatoes work just fine.

title: Green Bean Casserole
directions: Mix together in casserole dish., Sprinkle cheese and 1/4 cup onion rings on top., Bake at 325° for 30 minutes.

title: Party Cheese Ball
directions: Mix together chili powder and paprika., Allow cheese to soften., Mix well the cheeses, nuts and garlic powder., Roll into balls or rolls., Roll and completely cover in chili powder/paprika mix.

title: Crabmeat Spread
directions: Combine in small baking dish; bake in 375° oven for 15 minutes., Serve with crackers., Can sprinkle with paprika before baking., Can top with almond slivers.

title: Samoa Milkshake
directions: Mix ice cream and milk in a blender to make a milkshake. Place crushed Samoas on top of the milkshake., Makes one milkshake.

title: Apple Salad
directions: Drain juice from pineapple., Heat juice, butter, sugar and lemon juice to boil., Remove from heat and let cool., Add cornstarch and water., Stir until thick., Add Cool Whip and stir over pineapple chunks, apples, grapes and marshmallows.

title: Helen'S Tea Cakes
directions: Beat butter and sugar, then add eggs, then oil and vanilla. Sift dry ingredients together and add to mixture., Drop by teaspoons and bake at 325° for about 15 minutes.

title: Punch
directions: Mix Jell-O in boiling water. add sugar and mix thoroughly. Add cold water, lemonade, pineapple juice and extract. Freeze in plastic container. Thaw, but not completely and add ginger ale.

title: Cheesecake Pie
directions: Beat cream cheese, sugar and vanilla until smooth., Fold in Cool Whip., Spoon into crust., Chill until set (about 4 hours). Arrange fruit on top before serving.

title: Lentil Casserole
directions: Combine first 11 ingredients in a 1 1/2-quart casserole coated with vegetable cooking spray; stir well., Add broth; stir well. Cover and bake at 350° for 1 to 1 1/2 hours, or until lentils are tender., Yields 11 servings, about 134 calories per 1/2 cup serving.

title: Ful Medames(Lebanese; International)
directions: Toss together watermelon, onion, cilantro, jalapeno chiles, salt, garlic and lime juice in glass or pottery bowl. Let stand at room temperature 30 minutes, then serve immediately. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Drop Sugar Cookies
directions: Put eggs in small bowl and beat well., Set aside., Put milk in mixing cup or bowl., Add vinegar (to make sour milk)., Set aside.

title: Butterscotch Sauce
directions: Mix cornstarch and sugar with cold water., Add boiling water and cook until thickens, stirring constantly., Add butter., Serve over cupcakes, angel food cake, bread pudding or plain cake.

title: Banana Split Pie
directions: Mix crumbs with 1/2 cup melted margarine; spread in bottom of brownie pan to make crust., Cream 1 cup margarine; gradually add sugar., Add eggs, beating well., Spread over crust; cover with bananas., Sprinkle pineapple; spread with whipped cream., Garnish top with nuts and cherries., Chill thoroughly., Better if made 1 day prior to serving.

title: Cherry Crunch
directions: Sprinkle half of the cake mix on the bottom of a 13 x 9-inch pan., Pour cherry pie filling over the cake mix., Combine the rest of the cake mix with the pecans., Melt the butter and pour over the top., Bake at 350° for 35 minutes., Top should be a golden brown.

title: Date Buns
directions: Sift together flour, salt, sugar, soda and cream of tartar. In separate bowl beat eggs., Add melted butter and milk., Combine the liquid and dry ingredients with a few strokes., Add dates.

title: Fish
directions: Marinate fish overnight in beer and mustard., Mix salt and black pepper in corn meal, then bread fish in corn meal and fry. This recipe will serve 4 people.

title: Pork And Rice
directions: Brown pork chops., Combine rice, salt and broth., Pour into a 13 x 9-inch baking dish., Arrange pork chops on top of rice. Bake at 350° for one hour.

title: Mama'S Refrigerator Rolls
directions: In small bowl combine 1/4 cup water, 1 teaspoon sugar and yeast., In large mixing bowl mix together melted margarine, hot water, 1/2 cup sugar, salt and eggs., Mix together with whisk., Add yeast mixture., Stir in 4 cups flour and mix well., Stir in remaining flour and mix thoroughly, but do not knead., Put in large oiled container and refrigerate., When ready to bake, roll out dough 1/2-inch thick., Spread with melted margarine., Cut out with biscuit cutter., Let rise in warm place 1 hour., Bake 10 to 12 minutes at 400°., Dough will keep in refrigerator for several days.

title: Anise Biscuits
directions: Blend sugar and oil., Add eggs, flavoring, anise seed, flour and baking powder., Shape dough into four loaves., Bake on slightly greased cookie sheet., Bake 25 minutes at 350° until golden brown., Slice each loaf and bake to toast, about 7 minutes on each side.

title: Microwave Brittle
directions: In a 1 1/2-quart casserole dish, stir together sugar and syrup., Microwave at High for 4 minutes., Stir in peanuts. Microwave at High for 3 to 5 minutes, until light brown., Add butter and vanilla to syrup, blending well., Microwave at High for 1 to 2 minutes more., Peanuts will be lightly browned and syrup very hot!, Add soda and stir until light and foamy., Pour mixture onto lightly greased cookie sheet., Let cool., Break into small pieces and store in an airtight container., Makes about 1 pound.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients together (except cheese and chips)., Put them on top. Bake at 425° for 15 minutes.

title: Katie Mae'S Cold-Oven Pound Cake
