directions: Cream butter and Crisco; then gradually add sugar, creaming mixture well., Add eggs, one at a time, beating after each addition., Mix dry ingredients together and add these alternately with the milk to creamed mixture., Add flavorings., Place in a well greased tube pan which has also been floured., Put in a cold oven., Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 15 minutes., Do not open oven the first hour., Serves 21 or more.

title: Mississippi Pecan Pie
directions: Boil syrup and sugar together about 2 minutes., Pour slowly over eggs., Add butter, vanilla and nuts., Bake at 375°.

title: Buckeyes
directions: In a large mixing bowl, beat cheese until fluffy., Gradually beat in sweetened condensed milk until smooth., In heavy saucepan, over low heat, melt peanut butter chips; stir into cheese mixture. Add nuts., Chill 2 to 3 hours., Shape into 1-inch balls.

title: Dump Cake
directions: Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan., Dump in, in order, the cherries, undrained pineapple, dry cake mix and nuts., Smooth after each layer; do not mix., Place the butter pieces on top., Bake for 1 hour at 350°., Serve with ice cream.

title: Music Teacher Casserole
directions: Combine tuna or chicken, soups, vegetables and 2 cans of water., Mix and add noodles and cheese., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Glazed Sweet Potatoes
directions: In a large skillet, dissolve gelatin, brown sugar and salt in boiling water., Add butter and bring to boil, stirring constantly. Add potatoes; simmer about 15 minutes, basting frequently, until syrup thickens and potatoes are glazed., Serves 6 to 8.

title: Ham And Potato Casserole
directions: Alternate layers of ham and potatoes, onions and cheese in crock-pot., Salt and pepper to taste., Top with can of mushroom soup., Cook on low for 6 to 8 hours.

title: Baked Beans
directions: Mix all ingredients except bacon in baking dish., Put bacon on top., Bake at 350° for 1 hour., Let stand for 10 minutes before serving.

title: Monster Cookies
directions: Mix in large bowl, roaster or dishpan in order given., Drop by large spoon onto greased cookie sheet., Flatten dough., Bake at 350° for 12 minutes., Let cool several minutes before removing from pan.

title: Chicken Puffs
directions: Preheat oven to 400°. In a small saucepan over medium-low heat, melt butter in water. Add flour and salt, stirring until mixture forms a ball. Remove from heat and allow to cool slightly. Add eggs and beat vigorously until smooth. Stir in cheese. Drop dough by heaping teaspoonfuls onto a greased baking sheet. Bake for 20 minutes or until golden brown. Remove puffs from oven; cool and split. Combine remaining ingredients, adding more mayonnaise if needed to moisten. Fill each puff with a heaping teaspoonful of chicken mixture. Yield: approximately 2 dozen puffs.

title: Crispy Fried Chicken
directions: Beat eggs and milk together., Dip chicken in this., Mix all dry ingredients together in plastic bag, then put a few pieces at a time in bag and shake., Fry in hot grease until golden brown. Let drain on paper towels.

title: Peach Cobbler
directions: Pour peaches into large cake pan., Add sugar if needed., Mix Bisquick, sugar, milk, vanilla and egg until well blended., Pour over peaches., Dot with margarine and bake in 375° oven until browned on top.

title: Freezer Pickles
directions: Put salt in water, enough to cover vegetables., Let stand 2 hours; drain well., Mix vinegar, sugar and celery seed together and pour over drained cucumber mixture., Mix well., Place in freezer bags and freeze., Real good; easy to make.

title: Potato Soup
directions: Peel and dice potatoes., Peel and dice onion., Cook potatoes and onion in a large pot with enough water to cover potatoes well. Boil until potatoes are tender or until they begin to fall apart. Add bouillon cubes, pepper and oil., Stir in potato flakes until well mixed., Add chicken soup., Continue to stir until well mixed and smooth., Serve hot.

title: Microwave Peanut Brittle
directions: Combine sugar and syrup in 2-quart casserole., Microwave on High 5 minutes., Stir in peanuts., Microwave 3 to 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until peanuts and syrup are lightly browned., Stir in butter, vanilla and soda until foamy., Spread 1/4-inch thick on buttered cookie sheet., Makes 1 pound.

title: Vegetable Relish
directions: Add salt to the vegetable mixture and mix well., Let stand for 3 or 4 hours., Drain well., Add sugar, vinegar, water and spices to vegetables., Boil for 3 minutes., Pack in jars and seal.

title: Cole Slaw Dressing
directions: Put vinegar and butter in top of double boiler until butter is melted, then add other ingredients after they have been mixed together., Cook until thick or to your liking.

title: Apple Pie
directions: Combine sugar, flour, spices, salt and lemon juice., Add apples; toss to mix., Roll out pastry dough for crust and top., Cut vents in top piece., Line pie pan with pastry and cut off overhang. Fill with half the apples and dot with butter., Add remaining apples., Moisten rim with water., Adjust top crust., Leave about 1/2-inch pastry beyond edge., Fold in under lower pastry., Seal rim by pressing together and flute it., Brush with milk., Bake at 400° for 50 to 60 minutes or until apples test done with fork., For a single crust, use a 425° oven.

title: Cayenned Corn
directions: Melt the butter in a pan large enough to accommodate the corn; add the corn, the garlic, the cayenne and salt to taste., Cook for 3 to 5 minutes over medium heat and add cream., Cook additional 8 minutes or until heated through., Serves 4.

title: Broccoli Soup
directions: Saute green onions in butter until limp., Add broccoli., Saute another 5 minutes, stirring frequently., Then add remaining ingredients and simmer 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Potato Pancakes
directions: Beat egg, add milk and flour., Then mix with grated potatoes. Add onions and salt., Cook on griddle until well browned.

title: Corn Flake Candies
directions: Melt sugar and syrup on low heat until dissolved., Mix in peanut butter., Gently fold in corn flakes., Spoon onto waxed paper to cool.

title: Strawberry Pie
directions: Mix sugar, cornstarch and water., Cook sugar, cornstarch and water over medium heat in saucepan until clear., Remove from heat. Pour jello into mixture., Put in whole strawberry chopped into quarters; place in baked pie shell., Chill until firm., Serve with whipped cream.

title: Potato Refrigerator Rolls
directions: Soften yeast in water., Add mashed potatoes, shortening, sugar and salt., Cool; let stand in warm place until bubbly or about 2 hours., Add flour; beat well., Cover; chill., Shape dough (cold) into rolls., Let rise at room temperature about 3 hours., Bake 15 to 20 minutes in 425° oven., Makes about 4 dozen.

title: Potato Casserole
directions: Beat soup and milk together., Place a layer of potatoes in large casserole; sprinkle with onion, green pepper, salt and pepper., Repeat until all are used, then pour over this mixture the milk and soup., Cover and bake at 350° for about 1 hour or until potatoes are tender all through., Serves 8.

title: Mile-High Lime Pie
directions: In a bowl, combine the milk, sour cream, lime juice and food coloring, if desired. Fold in whipped topping. Pour into the crust. Refrigerate for at least 12 hours.

title: Old-Fashioned Gingersnaps
directions: Beat the butter in large bowl until light., Slowly add sugar. Beat in molasses, ginger, cinnamon, cloves, baking soda and salt. Add flour, 1/4 cup at a time., Mix thoroughly., Chill 4 hours. Heat oven to 325°., Divide cookie dough in half., Shape each half into 1 1/2-inch thick rolls., Cut dough crosswise with sharp knife into 1/2-inch thick slices., Place on lightly buttered baking sheet., Bake cookies until golden, about 8 minutes., Makes 5 dozen.

title: Breakfast Casserole
directions: Cook crumbled sausage and drain., Spread bread with butter. Place in greased casserole, butter side up., Sprinkle sausage over, then top with cheese., Combine remaining ingredients, beating well., Pour over bread and sausage., Chill 8 hours or overnight., Bake at 350° for 40 to 50 minutes.

title: Chocolate Mousse
directions: Combine chocolate and coffee until smooth., Add egg yolks and beat on high speed for 30 seconds., Beat egg whites until stiff. Gradually add sugar., Fold in chocolate mixture and blend until smooth., Chill 1 hour.

title: Fruit Cookie Pie
directions: In a medium bowl, beat together butter and sugars until light and creamy., Add egg and vanilla., Beat well.

title: Strawberry Parfait
directions: Mix water with Jell-O., Stir in frozen strawberries until thawed., Cut cake in small pieces; spread in large pan., Fold whipped cream, marshmallows and strawberry mixture together., Pour over cake., Sit in refrigerator for two hours.

title: Spaghetti Stew
directions: Place beef in crock-pot and brown on high for 1 hour. Break up meat. Add Italian sauce, water, chopped celery, chopped onions, tomatoes, soup and V-8., Cook spaghetti; drain and add., Cook on high for 1 hour, then on low for 2+ hours. To serve, top with grated Cheddar cheese.

title: Stuffed Mushrooms
directions: Remove stems from mushrooms., Wash and dry., Stuff with cream cheese., Bake at 400° for 10 minutes.

title: Cabbage Stew
directions: Brown ground round., Add onion, celery and green pepper., Cook until tender., Add remaining ingredients., Cook until cabbage is tender.

title: Beef, Potato Soup(Lucy'S Original)
directions: Combine all ingredients in a Dutch oven kettle., Bring to a boil., Reduce heat and simmer until potatoes and carrots are tender, then simmer some more., Delicious served with corn bread.

title: Clam Chowder
directions: Precook potatoes and onions., Mix all ingredients and simmer 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Sauerbraten
directions: Chop onions and garlic., Combine all ingredients in a heavy kettle and simmer with meat slowly about 3 hours., Remove meat; strain gravy and thicken with flour., Serve over noodles.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Saute onion and celery in butter until tender., Mix remaining ingredients and bake in casserole dish at 375° for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Monkey Bread
directions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.

title: Moma Goulash
directions: Brown ground beef in large skillet, add green beans, tomato soup and season with chili powder to your taste., Cook until thicken., Pour into 11 x 7 in baking dish., Arrange biscuits in a single layer over top., Bake at 350 degrees until biscuits are golden brown., Serve immediately.

title: White Cake With Raspberry Sauce
directions: Prepare and bake cake according to package directions, using a 13 x 9 inch baking pan. In a small bowl, beat cream cheese and confectioners sugar until smooth. Fold in whipped cream. Spread over cooled cake. Refrigerate until serving. Just before serving, combine strawberry glaze and water in a bowl; gently fold in raspberries. Serve over cake.

title: No Sugar Apple Pie(But Sweet As Pie)
directions: Peel and slice apples., Sprinkle with flour and spices., Blend in thawed undiluted juice., Put into bottom crust and dot with butter or for a deep dish pie, put apple mixture in a loaf pan and dot with butter., Put on top crust and cut air vents., Bake at 400° for 40 minutes.

title: Cheese Balls
directions: Mix cream cheese until smooth with electric mixer., Add grated cheese and dressing mix., Stir together until well blended., Shape into ball and roll in chopped pecans.

title: Corn Bread
directions: Mix dry ingredients, then the liquid., Mix well., Pour into 9 x 13-inch baking pan (flour lightly) and bake for 30 to 35 minutes at 350°.

title: Peanutty Ice Cream Balls
directions: Combine cereal and peanut butter., Scoop ice cream into balls, using No. 16 ice cream scoop or shape into 2 1/4-inch balls., Roll in cereal mixture., Place on wax paper and freeze until firm. Drizzle with hot fudge., Makes 8.

title: Sausage Balls
directions: Let sausage come to room temperature., Grate cheese and let come to room temperature., Mix sausage, cheese and Bisquick together., Roll into balls the size of walnuts., Place on cookie sheet and refrigerate or freeze., After frozen, put in a plastic bag., Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes., Keeps for 2 months. Yields approximately 53 balls.

title: Chicken Rice Casserole
directions: Cook rice in water until tender., Heat milk with soup., In a large bowl add soup, milk, Mozzarella cheese, rice and chicken. Cover with shredded Cheddar cheese., Bake until mixture bubbles. Bake 30 to 45 minutes at 350°., May be cooked in microwave until bubbly.

title: Cobbler
directions: Melt butter., Mix sugar, milk and flour., Pour mixture over butter., Add fruit., Bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Breakfast Oatmeal Muffins
directions: In a large bowl, combine flour, brown sugar, baking powder and baking soda., In another bowl, combine oil, eggs, oatmeal, raisins and vanilla., Add to dry ingredients and stir just until moistened (the batter will be thin)., Spoon into 12 greased muffin cups. Bake at 350° for 18 minutes or until the muffins test done., Makes 1 dozen.

title: Sherry Pie
directions: Line two pie pans with ladyfingers., Dissolve gelatin in cold water., Beat egg yolks, sugar, salt and sherry., Put in double boiler and cook until thick., Add to gelatin., Beat egg whites and the other 1/2 cup sugar until glossy., Fold into mixture., Pour into pie pans., Let cool., Top with whipped cream., Sprinkle chocolate shavings on top!

title: Stromboli
directions: Brown sausage and hamburger., Drain, then add salt, pepper, green pepper, garlic salt and onion., Cook for 30 minutes., Roll out bread., Spread some sauce., Add a layer of ham, sausage and hamburger mixture, layer of olives, layer of both cheeses, layer of salami and layer of pepperoni., Add another layer of sauce, then add a layer of ham., Close to make a loaf., Bake at 325° for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: "Dian'S" Casserole
directions: Fix macaroni and cheese as directed on the box except for the milk, leave it out., Fry the hamburger; drain the grease., Mix the can of tomato soup with the hamburger.

title: Peach Cobbler
directions: Stir together peaches, allspice, cinnamon, butter and sugar in a deep pan on stove top., Bring to a boil.

title: Pancakes
directions: Mix all dry ingredients together well., Add remaining ingredients., Beat well., Cook on hot griddle or skillet, greased, at 325°., Top with your favorite fruit, syrup or whipped cream.

title: London Broil Marinade
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Place meat in a Ziploc bag and marinate overnight, turning over to be sure both sides have been done. This is not only excellent for beef but also turkey London broil.

title: Fruit Smoothie
directions: Combine all ingredients and blend.

title: Peanut Butter Bars
directions: Cream, together, shortening,, sugars, and peanut butter until light and fluffy., Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition., Blend in vanilla., Sift together flour, baking powder, and salt (if desired)., Add to creamed mixture, mixing thoroughly., Stir, in, coconut., Spread, batter, in, a greased 13 x 9 x, 2-inch, baking pan., Bake in a 350° oven for 25 minutes. Cool in, pan, on, rack., If, desired, spread with confectioners sugar frosting., Sprinkle with peanuts. Cut into 3 x 1 1/2-inch bars., Makes 2 dozen.

title: Easy Chicken Divan
directions: Cook broccoli until tender and drain., Arrange in greased dish with stalks facing each other., Top with the chicken., Combine soup, mayonnaise, lemon juice and curry powder., Pour over chicken., Sprinkle with cheese., Combine bread crumbs and butter and pour over all., Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes., Serves 4 to 6.

title: Broccoli And Rice
directions: Cook broccoli according to package instructions., Cook rice according to directions on package., Heat soups., Place broccoli, rice and eggs in casserole., Pour heated soup mixture over casserole., Sprinkle 1 cup grated Cheddar cheese on top and bake at 350° until bubbly and hot and cheese has melted., Serves 3 to 6.

title: Sweet Potato Pie
directions: Mash the sweet potatoes; add beaten eggs, sugar, cream, cinnamon, salt, vanilla and melted butter., Mix well and pour into unbaked pie shell., Bake in hot oven at 450° for 10 minutes, then reduce heat to 350°., Cook about 35 minutes or until a knife will come out clean.

title: Famous Apple Cheese
directions: Simmer apples in boiling water until tender. Remove from water; drain and place a layer in a buttered casserole dish. Combine remaining ingredients and sprinkle over apples. Repeat layering until all ingredients are used. Bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Stone Jar Cookies
directions: Heat molasses., Remove from heat and add margarine and soda. Add flour, baking powder, salt and ginger gradually., Chill. Roll very thin on floured board., Bake at 350° for about 8 to 10 minutes., Don't overbake., Store in stone jar and they will become very soft.

title: Mom'S Banana Bread
directions: Mix all dry ingredients in large bowl., Mash bananas on large plate with fork; put in bowl., Add shortening, eggs, vanilla and nuts; mix well., Add dry ingredients and mix well., Grease and flour loaf pan., Bake at 325° for 50 minutes.

title: Fresh Blackberry Pie
directions: Prepare crust., Combine sugar, flour and salt., Add to berries., Toss to coat fruit., Fill 9-inch pie plate., Adjust top crust, seal and flute edges., Cover edge with foil., Bake at 375° for 20 minutes., Remove foil., Bake 25 to 30 minutes more, until golden., Cool.

title: Shredded Chicken Or Pork Sandwich
directions: Shred the chicken or pork into small pieces. Put chicken or pork in saucepan. Add barbecue sauce until meat is well coated. Simmer on low heat for 5 to 10 minutes. Pile it on your favorite sandwich roll or hamburger bun.

title: Honey Chicken Parmigiana
directions: Season chicken to taste with seasoning salt, black pepper and cumin., In a deep pan, saute garlic in oil., Add chicken to pan. Brown lightly.

title: Buckeyes
directions: In a large bowl, mix together with hands (let margarine soften) until smooth., Pinch off about 1 tablespoon size of dough; roll in the palm of hands to form a round ball., Place balls on a cookie sheet., When it is filled, put in refrigerator for 1 hour.

title: Tea Cakes
directions: Cream sugar and shortening together., Add vanilla., Add flour and eggs., (I mix in eggs with mixer and flour by hand.), Knead dough., Roll out and cut with biscuit cutter or something smaller. (Use lots of flour on counter, hands, rolling pin and dough itself.), Bake at 350° to 400° for 10 minutes.

title: Dried Apple Stack Cake(60 Years Old)
directions: Cream shortening, sugar and molasses; then add egg and buttermilk., Mix well., Stir in dry ingredients together with vinegar-soda mixture.

title: Smash Cake
directions: Mix 1st three ingredients by hand and "smash" into greased pan., Mix last 3 ingredients until smooth and pour over cake mixture., Bake at 350° until done.

title: Vanilla Pudding
directions: Mix all ingredients except vanilla and butter in saucepan and cook until thickened., Add vanilla and butter., Pour into serving dishes., Top with plastic wrap to prevent skin forming on top.

title: Scalloped Potatoes And Ham
directions: Layer potatoes, onion and ham (do not cut up) in a greased 8 x 12-inch baking dish., Blend together oleo, flour, salt and pepper. Cook for about 2 minutes, stirring constantly., Remove from heat., Add milk, stirring until smooth., Pour over potato mixture. Cover and bake at 350° for about 1 hour.

title: Parmesan Chicken
directions: Mix stuffing, cheese, salt and spice in a bowl., Melt butter in a pan., Dip chicken breast in butter, cover well, then roll in crumb mix., Do one chicken breast at a time., Place on greased baking pan, uncovered., Bake at 350° about 20 minutes, until crisp.

title: Chicken Divan
directions: Boil chicken until tender., Cool and break into bite-sized pieces., Place broccoli in baking dish., Cook in microwave about 5 minutes., Arrange chicken on top., Pour on melted oleo, then half of the grated cheese., Mix together sour cream and soup (will be thick)., Spoon over chicken and top with remaining cheese., Bake at 350° for about 45 minutes., Serve over rice.

title: Bourbon Cookies
directions: Mix together first 4 ingredients. Add rest of ingredients, stirring after each one is added. Drop by spoonful on greased cookie sheet. Bake about 15 minutes at 350°.

title: Suzannne'S Juicy Chicken
directions: For each serving of chicken breast, salt and pepper as desired, and oil with bit of margarine., Place piece on an individual sheet of heavy duty aluminum foil., Pour a little lemon juice, dash of Tabasco, dash of Worcestershire sauce, slice of onion and a small pat of margarine on each breast., Fold and seal each package tightly., Cook on a cookie sheet in a 400° oven for 1 hour., Can be cooked ahead.

title: Baked Lima Beans
directions: Soak beans overnight and rinse., Cover with cold water and bring to a boil., Boil 5 to 7 minutes., Use large casserole or bean pot., Place 1/2 onion in bottom., Put in beans, bacon (rolled and placed in the beans), then mix remaining ingredients to cover beans (add water if needed)., Place strips of bacon on top; cover with catsup and bake at least 2 hours at 300°., Add water if beans become dry., Can be baked longer.

title: Sour Cream Salmon Loaf
directions: Crush corn flakes., Drain off half liquid from salmon. Combine all ingredients., Place in a loaf pan., Bake at 350°., If firmer texture is desired, use less butter and add 1 more egg.

title: White Fruit Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients., Bake in 200 degree oven for 2 1/2 hours.

title: Coconut Almond Carrot Ring
directions: Mix flour, baking powder, salt and cinnamon., Beat sugar and oil at medium speed of electric mixer until well mixed., Stir in flour mixture., Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition., Stir in carrots, nuts, raisins and 2/3 cup of the coconut.

title: Broccoli Noodle Bake
directions: Melt margarine in large saucepan; saute onion, green pepper and celery., Put broccoli on top; cover and simmer until broccoli is thawed, cook spaghetti according to directions., In a bowl combine soup and milk., In a buttered 3-quart casserole dish layer spaghetti, vegetables, mushrooms, soup and 1 1/2 cups cheese. Sprinkle remaining cheese on top., Bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes or until hot and bubbling., Serves 10.

title: 7 Layer Salad
directions: Layer ingredients in 9 x 13-inch pan in the order listed.

title: Minty Lamb Burgers
directions: These are wonderful., If possible, grill over hot coals, but are delicious pan-fried also.

title: Meatballs Romanoff
directions: Melt 2 tablespoons butter in large skillet., Remove from heat. Blend in flour and sauce mix., Gradually stir in milk., Heat to boiling, stirring constantly., Boil and stir 1 minute., Add frozen meatballs; heat to boiling., Reduce heat; cover and simmer 10 minutes., While meatballs simmer, cook noodles., Stir parsley flakes and 2 tablespoons butter into noodles., Serve meatballs with sauce over noodles., Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Coconut Pie
directions: In a large bowl, place milk, sugar, coconut, eggs, flour, butter and vanilla., Stir until combined., Pour into pie shell. Bake at 350° for 50 minutes or until a knife inserted near the center comes out clean., Cool at room temperature., Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Lemon Cheese Pie
directions: Dissolve jello in 2 cups boiling water., Place in refrigerator until it starts to jell., Meanwhile, mix sugar and cream cheese. Whip chilled milk in a chilled bowl., Have Cool Whip ready., Beat jello; add everything to jello and mix well., Pour into pie shells. Chill before serving.

title: Easy Rice Pudding(Microwave)
directions: Combine all ingredients in a baking dish., Microwave 7 minutes or until boiling., Let stand 5 minutes., Add cinnamon if desired.

title: Dilled Carrots
directions: Melt butter in saucepan., Add all ingredients., Cover; simmer 12 to 15 minutes, until carrots are tender.

title: German Spice Bars(Lebkuchen)
directions: Heat honey and sugar slightly in a pan., Add butter., Add 2 cups flour and baking powder; beat well., Add nuts, citron, peels and spices., Add 1 1/2 to 2 more cups flour until you have a thick, pliable dough., Pat it 1/4 inch thick into pans (three 8 x 8-inch cake pans and one 9 x 9-inch cake pan)., Bake about 25 minutes. When cool, cut in squares and ice with Lemon Glaze., Make this ahead for Christmas., Keeps 6 months when in an airtight container!

title: Chicken Pizza Mexicana
directions: Gas grill. Sprinkle, cheese evenly over bread shell. Top with remaining ingredients. Cover and grill pizza 4 to 6-inches from medium heat 8 to 10 minutes or until crust is crisp and cheese is melted (if crust browns too quickly, place a piece of aluminum foil between crust and grill). Makes 4 servings.

title: Cucumber Surprise
directions: Prepare favorite chicken salad recipe for about 6 people. Place 1 1/2 teaspoons chicken salad (depending on size of cucumber slices) on the cucumber slice and top with a toasted pecan half. Makes 48.

title: Cherry Jello Salad
directions: Mix together and pour into 13 x 9-inch pan., Chill.

title: Cliff'S Healthy Waffles
directions: In a large mixing bowl, mix all dry ingredients together., In a separate bowl, mix buttermilk, oil and egg yolks and beat well. Slowly stir buttermilk mixture into dry ingredients until thoroughly mixed., Beat egg whites and fold into batter., Spoon dip batter into preheated waffle iron.

title: Easy Lemon Pie
directions: Mix lemonade with Eagle Brand and Cool Whip., Pour mixture into a graham cracker crust., Chill for at least 1 hour., (Makes enough for two small pies.)

title: Brownies 'N Cream
directions: Mix together cream cheese, vanilla and egg until creamy; set aside., Mix the brownie mix according to package directions, except using slightly less water and oil., Spread 3/4 cup of brownie mix in bottom of sprayed 9 x 13 pan., Spoon in filling and spread remaining brownie mix over top., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes., Don't overbake.

title: Butterscotch Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients in large bowl., Pour into 9 x 13-inch cake pan., Sprinkle top with additional chips, if desired., Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

title: Strawberry Dessert
directions: Step 1 - Strawberry Glaze:, Cook water, sugar and cornstarch until thick. Remove from heat and add lemon juice, food coloring and strawberries., Set aside.

title: Easy Cookies
directions: Mix and drop on lightly greased and floured cookie sheet. Bake 7 to 9 minutes at 375° to 400°.

title: Cactus Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients and chill in refrigerator.

title: Chess Pie
directions: Beat the eggs, then add sugar, vanilla, oleo and milk., Mix well., Pour into pie shell. Bake at 350° until center is firm.

title: Crab Delight Fettuccine
directions: Cook fettuccine according to package directions., Drain., Heat butter and garlic in skillet on medium until garlic is lightly brown., Add half and half, Crab Delight and pepper., Heat about 3 minutes or until mixture just begins to bubble, stirring occasionally., Add Parmesan cheese., Stir 1 minute longer., Remove from heat., Toss Crab Delight; save with fettuccine., Serve immediately with Parmesan cheese, if desired., Makes 4 servings.

title: Chism Special
directions: Heat oil in a heavy dutch oven; brown meat with onion, garlic and bell pepper until meat is well done., Add soup, catsup, chili powder and Worcestershire sauce., Stir in corn and olives., Add salt and pepper to taste., Cover and simmer on low for 1 hour., Add water as needed to keep sauce liquid or to desired level of thickness., Served over cooked pasta; sprinkle with cheese., Makes 6 servings.

title: Fig Strawberry Preserves
directions: Cook mashed figs and sugar for 10 to 15 minutes., Add gelatin and boil until it dissolves., Pour into hot sterilized pint jars and seal.

title: Christmas Jello With Eggnog
directions: Dissolve lemon jello in 1 cup boiling water., Add 1/4 cup cold water., Measure 3/4 cup of lemon jello and save., Add eggnog to rest of lemon jello and pour into mold., Drain juice from pears and add water to make 3/4 cup., Dissolve cherry jello in 1 cup boiling water., Add measured fruit juice and leftover lemon jello to cherry jello., Chill until thickened., When lemon jello is firm enough, arrange sliced pears over top., Then gently spoon thickened cherry jello and chill., Can border with whipping cream.

title: Barbecue Beef Brisket
directions: Marinate overnight the brisket in liquid smoke, garlic powder and onion salt., Sprinkle generously., Cover tightly with foil and refrigerate overnight.

title: Mint Layer Treat
directions: Mix well. Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan., Do not grease! Bake for 30 minutes at 350°., Cool., Test for doneness with toothpick.

title: Toffee Crunch Ice Cream Cake
directions: Chocolate or vanilla wafers or Oreos (crumbled) may be substituted for coconut macaroons.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
directions: Mix margarine and Crisco with electric mixer. Add sugar and eggs. Now add, rest of ingredients and finish mixing. Drop by teaspoonful on baking sheet. Bake at 350 degrees for about 8-10 minutes. Makes a large batch.

title: Coconut Cream Cake
directions: Bake pound cake mixture in thin round cake layers (3 to 6 layers)., After cool, soak layers slightly with sugar and water mixture., Beat whipped cream and put on layers., Grate fresh coconut and place on cake layers.

title: Fluffy Potato Casserole
directions: Put potatoes into large bowl of electric mixer., Add cream cheese, onion, eggs and flour., Beat at medium until light and fluffy., Salt and pepper as needed., Spoon into a 9-inch square baking dish., Sprinkle canned onions over top., Bake at 300° for 35 minutes., Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Cake
directions: Heat 2/3 cup cream in a large microwave safe bowl until steaming., Add chips; whisk until smooth., Slowly whisk in remaining cream., Chill in refrigerator for 15 minutes., Beat with mixer just until soft peak forms., Arrange 3 crackers side by side, long edges touching on serving plate., Spread evenly with 1/2 cup cream mixture., Repeat 4 more layers., Add one more layer of crackers and chill one hour., Chill remaining cream., Spread top and sides of cake with cream mixture., Chill 4 hours., Garnish with peanut butter chips.

title: Turtles
directions: Melt over boiling water., Add 2 to 16 ounces coarsely chopped nuts (English walnuts, pecans, peanuts)., Mix well., Drop onto buttered wax paper., Cool., Dip into melted chocolate.

title: Potatoes With Cream Cheese
directions: Cut slightly thawed hash browns into cubes and put in 2-quart casserole dish., Mix softened cream cheese and half and half in saucepan and place over low heat until well blended., Add spices and pour over potatoes., Sprinkle with paprika., Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Rum Slush
directions: Heat water and sugar until sugar dissolves., Add lemonade, orange juice and rum., Stir until juices are dissolved., Freeze in 9 x 13-inch Tupperware container., Spoon in glass and add 7-Up.

title: Pumpkin Bread
directions: Beat first 7 ingredients together., Add the remainder in order, one at a time., Grease 3 loaf pans., Fill 2/3 full and bake 1 hour at 350°.

title: Chicken Soppa
directions: Boil the fryer; remove meat from bones and save broth., Blend the soup, milk and broth., Dip tortillas in hot Crisco oil., Put a layer of tortillas in bottom of casserole dish., Sprinkle onion, grated cheese, chopped green chilies and chicken pieces over tortillas., Pour sauce over and repeat layers until all tortillas are gone., Bake at 350° until bubbly, about 20 to 30 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Hot Reuben Sandwich
directions: Cook sauerkraut and brown sugar with a little water for 30 minutes;, drain., Cut, bread in half horizontally.	Spread bottom half with corned beef (can be softened in microwave for 15 seconds, to make easier spreading)., Place sauerkraut over corned beef;, cover, with	slices	of cheese., Place on cookie sheet in a 350° oven until cheese melts., Cover with top half of bread; return to oven for 3 to 4 minutes.	Cut in wedges.

title: Ambrosia Salad(Kids Love It!)
directions: Mix well together., Save some coconut and oranges for top. Keep in refrigerator.

title: Jubilee Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Place in pattie shells or on shallow casserole., Top with bread crumbs., Bake uncovered at 350° for 30 minutes., Serves 4.

title: Rich Caramel Sauce
directions: Cook first 3 ingredients in a Dutch oven over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until butter melts; remove mixture from heat., Bring sugar, 1/2 cup water, and lemon juice to a boil in a Dutch oven over high heat, stirring occasionally., Reduce heat to medium-high, and boil, stirring occasionally, 8 minutes or until mixture begins to brown., Reduce heat to medium, and cook, stirring, 5 minutes or until mixture is caramel colored., Pour sugar mixture gradually into whipping cream mixture. Remove from heat; let stand 1 minute., Whisk until smooth., Cook over medium-low heat, stirring occasionally, until a candy thermometer registers 230° (thread stage); cool., Makes 2 1/2 cups sauce.

title: Million Dollar Pie
directions: Cream milk and lemon juice with mixer., Add coconut, pineapple and pecans., Fold in Cool Whip., Put in crust and refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Snowballs
directions: Cream butter; add flour and sugar., Cream together, then add nuts and vanilla., Roll into small balls, approximately 1-inch in diameter., Bake in moderate oven, 350°, for 15 to 20 minutes on an ungreased cookie sheet., Sift additional confectioners sugar on cookies after baking., Makes about 40 cookies.

title: Fettuccine With Tomato Basil Sauce
directions: Combine salt, pepper, garlic and extra virgin olive oil., Then add tomatoes and basil and mix well., Serve over hot fettuccine. Pass Parmesan cheese.

title: Pasta Salad
directions: Mix pesto, vinegar and dressing. Add to mixture of vegetables and pasta and toss. Chill before serving.

title: Blonde Brownies
directions: Combine flour, baking powder and salt., Add nuts and sugar. Beat in egg and vanilla., Melt shortening and add to mixture. Stir in chocolate bits., Bake in 350° oven for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Ann'S Pork Chops
directions: Sprinkle chops with salt, pepper and paprika and brown in oil; drain. Blend sauerkraut and onion. In baking dish, layer chops, sauerkraut, then sour cream on top. Bake at 300° for 1 hour.

title: Holiday Fruit Drops
directions: Mix shortening, sugar and eggs well., Stir in soured milk. Measure flour; sift., Blend dry ingredients; stir in., Stir in nuts, fruit and dates., Chill at least 1 hour., Heat oven to 400°. Drop rounded teaspoonfuls of dough 2 inches apart on lightly greased cookie sheet., Bake 8 to 10 minutes until almost no imprint remains when touched.

title: Quick Chicken Paprika
directions: In hot skillet, saute minced onion, chopped peppers, salt and paprika until onion is golden, approximately 5 to 8 minutes. Remove from heat., Stir in chicken soup; bring to boiling, stirring constantly., Stir in chicken; remove from heat., Stir in sour cream., Delicious served over rice, in pastry cups, on noodles or toast points.

title: Sour Cream Coconut Cake
directions: Mix sour cream, sugar, vanilla and coconut., Reserve enough coconut to put on top of cake, if desired, and refrigerate overnight., Mix and bake cake mix according to directions on box, making 2 layers., Slice the layers to make 4 and spread the filling between them.

title: Pineapple Cake
directions: Beat eggs and sugar in bowl until well blended., Add undrained pineapple; mix well., Add flour., Add 1 teaspoon vanilla; mix well., Stir in 1/2 cup nuts., Pour into a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes., Cool.

title: Easy Cheeseburger Casserole
directions: Place cooked meat and onions into Pam-sprayed 2-quart baking dish., Add catsup, Worcestershire sauce, mushrooms (if desired) and 2 tablespoons Bisquick., Stir well and set aside., Combine remaining Bisquick with enough water to form a soft dough., With fingertips dipped in Bisquick, press dough into bottom and up sides of casserole., Fill with meat mixture., Sprinkle on cheese. Bake in preheated 425° oven 20 minutes.

title: Cranberry Muffins
directions: Spray 12 muffin cups with cooking spray., Combine first 4 ingredients., In small bowl, blend egg, orange peel, juice and oil., Stir in flour mixture until moistened., Stir in cranberries and nuts., Spread in muffin cups., Sprinkle with sugar., Bake 18 to 22 minutes at 400°.

title: Hot Dog Bean Casserole
directions: Stir together in a 2-quart baking dish all ingredients., Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes., Serve hot., Makes 5 (3/4 cup) servings., Top with cheese if desired.

title: Jeff Davis Pie
directions: Mix sugar and flour and cream with butter., Beat until light and frothy., Add eggs., Pour into unbaked pastry-lined pan., Bake as for custard pie, about 40 minutes, starting with hot oven to set pastry, then reduce heat for remainder of baking time., Top with meringue when cool.

title: Gravy
directions: Add the flour to the drippings., Stir., Slowly add the water and stir until the gravy thickens., Add salt and pepper to taste.

title: Sauerkraut Salad
directions: Mix vinegar, oil and sugar., Bring to a boil and pour over top of tossed ingredients listed.

title: Tater Tot Casserole
directions: Mix together., Place in a 9 x 13-inch pan., Top with a layer of frozen Tater Tots., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Hot Garlic Pickles
directions: Drain all pickle juice from jar., Add remaining ingredients to jar and reseal., Place jar upright on kitchen counter the first day., Place upside-down the second day., Continue this for 5 days.

title: Tuna Casserole
directions: Cook noodles in salt water till nearly done., Drain water from noodles. Mix all but cracker crumbs and grated cheese in casserole dish., Top with crackers and cheese. Bake at 350 till lightly brown on top., Serve hot.

title: Tuna Macaroni Salad
directions: Mix drained tuna and green onions with mayonnaise., Add salt to taste., Add macaroni and sliced hard-boiled eggs and mix together., Pour into serving bowl., Save 1 sliced egg to decorate top of salad., Sprinkle with paprika.

title: Tuna Casserole
directions: Put layer of macaroni in bottom of casserole., Mix rest with tuna and vegetables., Put in dish and top with cracker crumbs. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Orange Pork Tenderloin
directions: Mix butter, thyme and cayenne pepper. Spread evenly over tenderloin., Place tenderloin in shallow roasting pan and pour 3/4 cup orange juice over meat., Roast in a 375° oven for 25 to 30 minutes to 155° to 160° on meat thermometer, basting occasionally. Remove meat to serving platter., Keep warm., Measure basting liquid into small saucepan, adding additional orange juice, if necessary, to make 3/4 cup., Quickly whisk in flour, sugar and butter. Cook and stir until mixture boils and thickens. Cut tenderloin in 1-inch slices and serve with sauce., Makes 4 servings.

title: Vegetable Soup
directions: Prepare vegetables and cut in cubes., Cook celery and onions slowly in oil for 10 minutes., Add remaining ingredients and boil until vegetables are soft, about 1 hour., Add more water, if needed.

title: Pork Roast
directions: Peel potatoes and cut in large cubes. Peel carrots; cut into 2-inch lengths and quarter lengthwise., Cut onion to form rings. Cut apple into wedges and remove core., Cook roast for 30 minutes on grill (medium heat), turning occasionally to brown on all sides. Place roast in roasting pan and place the rest of ingredients around roast., Cover and cook for 45 minutes at 350°; season to taste.

title: Spoon Bread
directions: Combine cornmeal and sugar in bowl; mix well., Stir in butter. Add water gradually, beating constantly until smooth., Stir in buttermilk and eggs; mix well., Pour into a 9 x 13-inch baking dish., Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes or until golden brown. Yield:, 12 servings.

title: Gismos
directions: Cut the tortillas into quarters., Press small chunks of beef on each of the tortillas., Cut small slices of pepper and press into the beef., Cut domino-shaped pieces of Swiss cheese to lay on top of each tortilla, but first shake salt on each. Preheat oven, to, 325°., Slide, in each pan after 20 minutes. Keep an eye on them to get them cooked just right.

title: Orange Pork Chops
directions: Dust chops with flour seasoned with salt and pepper., Brown chops in hot butter about 5 minutes on each side., Combine brown sugar, orange rind and juice; pour over chops., Cover; reduce heat and simmer for 40 minutes., Arrange orange slices on meat; simmer another 5 minutes., Transfer chops and slices to a heated platter. Add 2 tablespoons water to sauce in skillet; stir and heat well. Pour over meat.

title: Quick Skillet Dinner
directions: Cook sausage in a 12-inch skillet over medium heat for 2 minutes., Add onions and cook, stirring occasionally about 3 minutes., Add rice and mix well., Stir in remaining ingredients except pepper., Bring to a boil and reduce heat., Cover and simmer for 20 minutes., Stir in green pepper., Remove from heat and let stand 5 minutes before serving.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Mix dry ingredients., Add eggs, milk and butter., Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls on baking sheet., Bake 10 minutes at 375°. Makes 6 dozen.

title: Pickled Mushrooms
directions: Cut the stems off the mushrooms., Wash and place in a saucepan and cover them with water., Bring water to a boil and cook for 5 minutes. Drain immediately., Put mushrooms in a quart jar and add all the remaining ingredients., Refrigerate for several hours or longer, but remove garlic after 48 hours., Can be stored in refrigerator for weeks., Makes 36 or 5 cups.

title: Lemon Coconut Bars
directions: In a medium bowl, combine flour and confectioners sugar., Cut in margarine until crumbly., Press onto bottom of lightly greased 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.

title: Cottage Meat Loaf
directions: Combine beef, catsup, tomato juice, salt, pepper, red pepper, eggs, crumbs, onions and 2 teaspoons mustard in a large bowl., Mix well., Line a 9 x 5-inch loaf pan with foil., Press in the mixture.

title: Underwood Cherry Cobbler
directions: Crust:, Put Crisco in bowl; add 2 1/4 cups flour and mix well. Add 1/2 teaspoon salt and enough water to make ingredients cling together., Roll dough until very thin.

title: Chicken And Filling
directions: Mix chicken with remaining ingredients., Put in roasting pan or baking dish., Bake at 300° for 1 hour., Save rest of broth for gravy to serve on top., Very simple and good for company or home use.

title: Creole Red Bean Salad
directions: Drain and rinse beans., Mix all ingredients., Great with barbecue!

title: Sausage Balls
directions: Combine all ingredients; blend well., Shape into small balls, about 1 inch in diameter., Place on cookie sheet., Bake for 20 minutes in 350° oven., These can be frozen and kept on hand for breakfast or snacks., If frozen, bake for 20 minutes in 400° oven.

title: Date Nut Pudding
directions: Mix dates, soda and boiling water and let set until cold. Meanwhile, mix white sugar, egg, flour, walnuts, margarine and vanilla together and bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Cinnamon Rolls
directions: Let yeast dissolve., Then add shortening, sugar and egg beaten to this, water, and, flour, to stiffen rolls after they raise. Spread butter, sugar, cinnamon and nuts., Put into the pan., Let raise, then bake., Ice with powdered sugar., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Mom'S Cornflake Candy
directions: Melt chocolate over hot water., Add cornflakes and nuts; mix well., Drop by tablespoon on waxed paper., Let set overnight until firm., Do not set in refrigerator.

title: Cole Slaw
directions: Place cabbage in a bowl., Mix all other ingredients in a separate bowl and then pour over cabbage and toss., Garnish with sliced olives.

title: Corn Chowder
directions: Cook onions in butter until tender in Dutch oven; drain. Return onions to Dutch oven with potato, salt, marjoram, pepper and water., Bring to boiling; reduce heat and simmer just until potato is tender, about 15 minutes., Add cream-style corn, whole kernel corn and evaporated milk., Heat through., Makes 6 servings. I usually double the water and milk so it's a little more soupy.

title: Dirt Dessert
directions: Put Oreo cookies in blender to make them look like dirt., Set them aside., Cream the cream cheese and butter., Add pudding, sugar and milk, then fold in the Cool Whip., In a large container, put a line of the dirt, then the pudding until you reach the top with the dirt on top.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
directions: Mix oil and sugar. Add eggs and vanilla; mix. Then add dry ingredients and mix. Then add apples and nuts. This makes a very stiff batter. Pour into Bundt pan. Spray with Pam or Crisco. I sprinkle with sugar so the cake will not stick. Bake about 1 hour at 325°.

title: Cheese Fondue
directions: Combine onion soup mix, tomato juice and lemon juice in pan and heat., As the juice simmers, add small portions of cheese until melted., Place in fondue pot., Dip small sausage balls, small hamburger balls, diced hot dogs or diced French bread.

title: Spaghetti Pie
directions: Cook spaghetti according to directions., Drain (yields about 3 1/4 cups). Stir margarine or butter into hot spaghetti., Stir in well-beaten eggs and Parmesan cheese., Press spaghetti mixture into a buttered 10-inch plate, forming a crust.

title: Broccoli Soup
directions: Melt butter; add Bisquick., Stir until bubbly on medium heat, add milk., Stir until thick., Add cheese and cooked broccoli., Stir until blended.

title: Beef Roast And Gravy
directions: Heat oven to 400°., Place roast in baking pan with 2-inch sides., Season with pepper., Bake in oven for 30 to 40 minutes or until center is slightly pink., Meanwhile, saute onion in butter. Slice roast with electric knife into thin slices., Remove from pan., Add water to drippings., Stir in cornstarch or flour to thicken., Add salt and onion., Return meat to pan and continue cooking until gravy is hot and thickened slightly.

title: Rhubarb And Strawberry Jam
directions: Combine rhubarb (cut up) and sugar., Mix and let set overnight. In the morning, bring to a boil and boil 8 minutes, then add the package of Jell-O., Mix well and put in sterile jars and seal.

title: Springerle(German Christmas Cookies)
directions: With electric mixer, beat eggs until light., Gradually add sugar and continue beating on high speed for 15 minutes or until like soft meringue., Add anise oil., Sift together flour and soda; blend into egg mixture on low speed., Cover bowl tightly with waxed paper or foil and let stand about 15 minutes (for easier handling).

title: Betty'S Fruit Dip
directions: Mix together., (Will be pink.), Wonderful also as a dressing on fruit salad plates.

title: Lemon Danish
directions: Open crescent rolls and cut diagonally to form triangle shapes., Mix together all other ingredients and add the mixture to the middle of each triangle., Bring the three corners to the middle and pinch together., Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes. Mix together confectioners sugar, lemon extract and milk to make a glaze.

title: Squash Casserole
directions: Drain squash and mash with a fork., Use 1/2 as much bread crumbs as squash., Add remaining ingredients along with margarine last (melted)., Mix well and cook 20 to 25 minutes at 375°.

title: Peanut Clusters
directions: In a heavy, medium saucepan, melt confectioners coating and chocolate pieces over low heat, stirring constantly., Stir in peanuts or cashews.

title: Coconut Pie
directions: Mix flour with sugar., Add eggs and beat until well mixed (by hand)., Add butter (melted) and mix well., Add coconut., Add milk and mix well (warm milk for faster cooking)., Cook at 350° about 30 to 40 minutes., Test corner of pie with knife to check degree of doneness.

title: Spinach Casserole
directions: Cook spinach and drain., Melt oleo, saute onion and all spices, then add cheese to melt., Add milk., Mix in drained spinach., Put in casserole, dish and cover with bread crumbs. Bake at 350°, until hot and brown.

title: Banana Split Cake
directions: Mix graham crackers and 1 stick margarine and press in pan. Combine 1 stick margarine, sugar and egg., Slice bananas over crust., Add pineapple., Then pour mixture evenly over all. Lastly, Cool Whip., Decorate with cherries on top., Refrigerate until cold., Cut into squares.

title: Chicken Cordon Bleu
directions: Place whole breast on cutting board, rib side down., Cut in half., With a boning knife, trim the meat away from the breast bone, following contour of rib cage and pulling meat away as you cut., Repeat with the remaining breasts.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Combine all ingredients except bread crumbs., Bake in casserole dish., Top with bread crumbs., Bake 30 minutes t 375°.

title: Meat Loaf Meal
directions: Brown meat and onion., Add other ingredients and mix., Place in casserole and bake 1 hour at 350°.

title: Sweet Potato Crunch
directions: Mix well and spread in Pam sprayed 12 x 9-inch pan.

title: Rotel Chicken
directions: Boil chicken until tender., Remove from broth and set aside to cool., Cook spaghetti in chicken broth., When tender, partially drain, leaving enough broth to be slightly soupy., Add cheese, soup and Ro-Tel., Cook over very low heat, stirring constantly, until cheese is melted., Remove skin and bones from chicken. Break into bite size pieces., Stir into spaghetti., Add black pepper to taste.

title: Baked Broccoli
directions: Cook broccoli in small amount of water and drain, then cut up. Mix the soup with milk and heat until it boils., Stir in the pimiento and water chestnuts., Arrange broccoli in buttered shallow baking dish and pour soup mixture over broccoli. Sprinkle with bread crumbs and dot with butter., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

title: Mexican Manicotti
directions: Mix together the ground beef, beans, onion, oregano, 1 1/2 tablespoons of seasoning mix and 1 cup of cheese., With a small spoon or using fingers, press meat mixture into shells., Arrange in a 12 x 8-inch microwave-safe baking dish.

title: Party Mix
directions: Mix first 4 ingredients in bowl., In large bowl, cover the crackers with this mix., Add oil and toss., Bake 30 minutes at 225°., (If making 1/2 batch, use 1/3 cup oil.)

title: Corn Pudding
directions: Mix all together and pour into an 8 x 10-inch baking dish (sprayed with Pam)., Bake at 350° about 20 minutes until firm.

title: Cocoa Peanut Butter Chip Pie
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Sprinkle chips on bottom of crust., In medium saucepan over low heat, melt butter., Add cocoa, stir until smooth., Add sweetened condensed milk and water., Stir with whisk until well blended., Stir in egg and vanilla., Remove from heat. Pour into crust., Bake for 30 minutes or until edges are set (center will firm while cooling)., Cool slightly., Garnish with whipped topping (if desired)., Serve warm or at room temperature. Makes 8 servings.

title: Lemon Bisque
directions: Dissolve Jell-O in water., Add sugar, salt, lemon juice and rind., Put milk in freezer until ice crystals form., Beat milk until stiff and whip slightly congealed Jell-O into it., Spread crumbs in 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan., Pour mixture over crumbs, saving some crumbs to put on top., Chill 3 hours or longer., Serves 12 to 15 people.

title: Refrigerated Cabbage
directions: Shred cabbage, pepper and onion; chop celery., Mix all together., Store in refrigerator.

title: Chocolate Pie
directions: Boil separately sugar, water and cocoa, until cocoa is dissolved., Mix together milk, egg yolks and flour., Combine all and cook until mixture thickens.

title: Boy Scout "Brownsie" Taters
directions: Chill salad dressing., Shake well and cover bottom of large iron skillet with 1/8-inch of salad dressing., Heat., Add onions, fries, peppers and seasonings., Cover while cooking, stirring occasionally., When taters are done, remove from heat., Sprinkle cheese over and let melt.

title: Sunday Rolls
directions: In a large bowl, mix ingredients thoroughly. Cover and let stand 8 hours or overnight on counter., Next morning, turn out on floured board and knead lightly. Roll 1/2-inch thick and cut into rolls., Place on greased cookie sheet., Let rise 4 to 6 hours. Bake in a 400° oven for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Ice Cream Muffins
directions: Combine flour, egg, oil and ice cream in bowl., Beat until smooth., Stir in berries., Fill well-greased muffin cups 3/4 full. Bake at 425° for 20 to 25 minutes or until brown., Serves 6 to 8.

title: Cheese Bars
directions: Press 1 tube of rolls into a 9 x 13-inch ungreased pan., Mix cheese, sugar, egg and vanilla until smooth., Spread over rolls in pan and cover with 2nd tube of rolls., Top with 1/4 cup sugar and 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon., Mix together and sprinkle on top., Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Layered Salad
directions: Layer pinched up lettuce on bottom of 9 x 13-inch glass dish. Add layer of green peas., Slice onion and pepper into thin rings. Place layer of these on top of peas., Add layer of bacon bits and cheese., Just before serving, pour dressing on top in crisscross pattern.

title: Excellent Macaroni And Cheese
directions: Cook macaroni in boiling, salted water until tender; drain. Melt butter., Blend in flour., Add milk., Cook and stir until thick., Add salt, pepper, onion and cheese., Stir until cheese is melted., Mix sauce with macaroni., Turn into 1 1/2-quart casserole., Top with crushed crackers if desired., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until bubbly and browned.

title: Perfect Apple Dumplings
directions: To make sauce, combine sugar, water, cinnamon and nutmeg. Boil 5 minutes, add butter.

title: Zucchini Bake
directions: Combine zucchini, tomatoes, onion, cheese, seasoning and Bisquick., Spread in 13 x 9-inch pan., In blender, process eggs and oil., Pour over casserole., Top with extra cheese., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Potato Salad
directions: Mix all, ingredients; sprinkle paprika or salad seasoning on top., Serves approximately 20.

title: Pea Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients except peas with enough mayonnaise to mix well., Fold in peas gently., Chill and serve.

title: Chicken Fajitas
directions: In plastic bag, combine lemon juice, oil, garlic and bouillon; add chicken., Marinate in refrigerator 4 hours or overnight. Remove chicken from marinade., Grill of broil as desired, basting frequently with marinade., Slice chicken into strips., Place on tortillas., Top with garnishes and cheese., Fold tortillas., Serve immediately., Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Sweet Potato Cake
directions: Combine oil and sugar; beat until smooth., Add egg yolks and beat well., Add hot water, then dry ingredients, which have been sifted together., Stir in potatoes, nuts and vanilla; beat well. Beat egg whites until stiff and fold in mixture., Bake in 3 greased 8-inch layer pans at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes., Cool and frost.

title: Roux
directions: Combine oil and flour in heavy pot, preferably cast-iron. Cook mixture over low heat; stir constantly, until a rich caramel color is reached., When desired color is obtained, add chopped seasoning (onion, bell pepper and celery) in order to lower temperature and keep roux from burning., Continue to stir., Always add hot water or liquid to roux., Cold water will cause roux to curdle and flour and oil to separate.

title: Chocolate-Peanut Butter Cake
directions: For cake, preheat oven to 350°., In a large bowl, combine cake mix, pudding mix, eggs, water, peanut butter and oil., Using low speed of an electric mixer, beat until moistened., Increase speed of mixer to medium and beat 2 minutes longer., Stir in chocolate chips., Pour batter into 2 greased and floured 9-inch round cake pans., Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until cake begins to pull away from sides of pan and springs back when lightly pressed., Cool in pans 10 minutes; invert onto a wire rack to cool completely.

title: Punch
directions: Put softened sherbets in bowl and add rest of the ingredients. Stir.

title: Taco Soup
directions: Brown ground beef and onion; drain., Mix all together; let simmer., Serve with grated cheese and corn chips.

title: Strawberry Salad
directions: Mix cream cheese until it is very smooth. Dissolve jello in 1 cup boiling water., Pour in with cheese. Stir in remaining ingredients. Chill., Mold or use regular dessert dish and cut in squares.

title: Scrambled Eggs(Microwave)
directions: Melt butter in microproof bowl on High for 30 to 45 seconds. Add eggs, milk, salt and pepper; stir., Microwave on High 1 1/4 to 1 3/4 minutes, or until eggs start to set., Stir eggs after 1/2 time., Remove eggs while they are still soft and moist., Let stand 2 minutes., Eggs will firm up during standing time., If desired, add cheese.

title: Easy Apple Cake
directions: Beat the eggs with a spoon or fork., Add the sugar and oil. Sift the flour, baking powder, salt and cinnamon together., Add flour mixture to first mixture with vanilla., Fold in the apples and chopped walnuts., Bake at 350° for about 50 to 55 minutes in a 13-inch pan or two 8-inch square pans for 40 to 45 minutes., Use half the recipe in an 8-inch square pan.

title: Cranberry Salad
directions: Mix and let set overnight the first 5 ingredients., Use processor.

title: Tomato Soup Salad
directions: Heat undiluted soup until hot, but not boiling. Stir in lemon jello until dissolved. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Pour into mold and refrigerate.

title: Potato Pancakes
directions: Grate potatoes and put immediately in milk. Add the remaining ingredients. Mix and drop from tablespoon onto a greased frying pan. Cook until well browned and crisp on both sides. Serve hot.

title: Cranberry Fruit Pops
directions: In a blender container, process crushed pineapple until smooth; add cranberry apple drink and yogurt., Process until completely blended., Pour into 2 ice cube trays., Freeze about 1 hour until partially firm., Place wooden stick in center of each cube., Freeze until hard., Makes 28 pops.

title: Seafood Appetizers
directions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees., Thaw shrimp as directed on package., Drain well, pressing between paper towels to remove excess water., Cut shrimp into small pieces., Unroll dough onto ungreased cookie sheet., Press dough to form a 12 x 8 inch rectangle, firmly pressing any perforations in dough to seal., Top dough with the remaining ingredients in this order:, shrimp, imitation crab meat, seafood seasoning, garlic powder, cheese and parsley flakes., Bake for 15 to 20 minutes or until crust is golden brown., Cut into squares., Makes 24 appetizers.

title: Creamy Reception Punch
directions: Spoon orange sherbet by tablespoons into a large punch bowl. Stir in orange juice and lemon juice., Slowly pour in chilled lemon-lime carbonated beverage; stir gently to mix., Makes 36 ounces.

title: Beef Stew
directions: Brown meat in oil in skillet., Add other ingredients in Dutch oven., Bake in oven at 325° for 2 hours., (Can put in crock-pot for 4 to 5 hours.)

title: Grandbuddy'S Meat Loaf
directions: Combine all ingredients thoroughly and pack firmly into a meat loaf pan or bread loaf pan., Bake in a moderate oven (350°) for about 1 hour or until done., Serve hot with a tomato sauce. Serves 8.

title: Potato Salad
directions: Cook enough potatoes that when mashed makes about 2 1/2 quarts., Add margarine and enough milk to thin., Add mayonnaise, mustard, pickles, onion and eggs., Mix well., Top with egg slices. Serve hot or cold.

title: Cream Cheese Cherry Dessert
directions: To the crushed crackers, add the melted oleo, sugar and gelatine., Mix all together and put in a 9 x 13-inch pan., Pat down and chill.

title: Date Balls
directions: Cook margarine, sugar and dates over low heat, stirring constantly until melted., Remove from heat., Stir in 1 teaspoon vanilla flavoring., Add 2 cups Rice Krispies and 1 cup chopped nuts., Let cool., Roll into small balls in confectioners sugar. Makes approximately 3 dozen.

title: Strawberry Cake
directions: Mix well and bake at 350°., Bake in 3 layers or an oblong pan., Cool., Spread icing over cake.

title: Shrimp-Macaroni Salad
directions: Cut, large, shrimp, in, half, combine shrimp, macaroni, cauliflower,, celery, parsley and pickle., Combine mayonnaise, French, dressing,, lemon juice and seasonings; mix thoroughly. Add mayonnaise, mixture, to, shrimp mixture and toss lightly. Chill; serve on salad greens and garnish with egg slices.

title: Russian Teacakes
directions: Take 2 big rolls frozen cookie dough., Slice it thin., Put on cookie sheets by loving hands of all the G.A.'s touching the cookies., Bake at 350°, for 4 to 7 minutes., Cool and put in Baggies to give to a lonely person.

title: Creamy Corn
directions: Combine corn, cream cheese, and mushroom pieces in saucepan. Heat over low heat until creamy., Stir continually, will scorch easily.

title: Texas Pecan Cake
directions: Cream sugar, butter, egg yolks and lemon extract., Add flour and baking soda mixture., Mix well., Fold in fruit and nuts that have been dredged in flour., Beat egg whites until stiff and fold into batter.

title: Peanut Brittle
directions: Heat oven to 200°., Grease 2 cookie sheets. 15 1/2 x 12 inches, with butter; keep warm in oven (keeping the cookie sheets warm allows the candy to be spread 1/4 inch thick without it setting up)., Grease long metal spatula with butter; set aside.

title: Seafood Stuffed Mushrooms
directions: Wash and drain mushrooms., Hollow out and chop enough of the pieces to make 3 tablespoons., Cook pieces with onion, garlic and 1 teaspoon extra virgin olive oil., Stir in crab, shrimp, Prosciutto and cheese, along with catsup., Stuff into mushroom crowns; sprinkle with fine soft bread crumbs., Bake at 425° for 6 to 8 minutes.

title: Fettucini With Blue Cheese Sauce
directions: Cook fettucini in boiling salted water., While cooking pasta, prepare sauce., Melt butter and cheese over low heat., Gradually stir in cream, walnuts and wine., Bring to boil then whisk a bit of the sauce into the egg yolk., Return the mixture to the sauce and stir continuously over gentle heat until thickened, do not allow it to boil., Stir in the parsley and pour mixture over cooked and drained pasta., Serve immediately with crusty bread., Makes 2 to 4 servings.

title: Swedish Pan-Cake
directions: Beat eggs; add sugar., Beat together until well mixed., Add remaining ingredients., Pour in a 13 x 9-inch greased pan., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or more.

title: Potato Casserole
directions: Mix all together., Let stand overnight in refrigerator., Bake in 350° oven for one hour., Stir after 1/2 hour and take the lid off for the last half hour.

title: Laundry Spray
directions: Mix well and pour into used spray bottles., This will remove most stains and grease stains.

title: Chocolate Bourbon Balls
directions: Cream 1/4 cup softened butter. Gradually add the sugar alternately with the bourbon, beating until thick and smooth. Shape measuring 1/2 teaspoons of mixture in small balls using sugar on hands if necessary. Press a pecan half on each side of ball and chill. Melt chocolate with 1 1/2 teaspoon of butter in top of double boiler. Dip one end of each candy in the chocolate and put on cookie sheet covered with wax paper. Chill. Makes about 2 1/2 pounds.

title: Baked Macaroni And Cheese
directions: Cook macaroni and set aside. Mix cottage cheese and sour cream with a little under half the bag of cheese. Then combine mixture with macaroni. Spray a 13 x 9 pan with cooking spray and pour macaroni mixture into pan. Top with remaining cheese., Bake at 350° until cheese bubbles or turns golden brown, whichever is preferred. Enjoy!

title: One Bowl Brownies
directions: Microwave chocolate and butter in a large bowl on High 2 minutes or until melted. Stir until chocolate is completely melted. Stir sugar into chocolate. Mix in eggs and vanilla. Stir in flour and nuts. Spread into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan and bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Potato-Corn Chowder
directions: Cook green pepper and onion in a saucepan coated with vegetable spray over medium heat, stirring constantly 5 minutes or until tender., Stir in broth, chopped potato and pepper., Bring to a boil; reduce heat and simmer 5 to 7 minutes or until potatoes are tender., Combine cornstarch and milk, stirring until smooth. Gradually add to potato mixture, stirring constantly., Stir in corn., Boil over medium heat, stirring constantly., Serve immediately.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
directions: In a small bowl, combine flour, baking soda, salt and cinnamon., In a large bowl, cream margarine, granulated sugar, brown sugar, eggs and vanilla., Gradually beat in flour mixture. Stir in oats and butterscotch morsels and drop by rounded tablespoons onto ungreased cookie sheets., Bake in preheated 375° oven for 7 to 8 minutes for chewy cookies, 9 to 10 minutes for crispy cookie., Cool for 2 minutes and remove from baking sheets.

title: Slow Cooked Pork Chops
directions: Fry pork chops., Put in slow cooker or drain oil and leave in skillet., Add soup, water, green pepper and onion. Salt and pepper to taste., Cover and cook until pork chops are tender.

title: Caramel Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°. Combine the margarine, sugar, egg yolk, eggs, buttermilk, baking soda, flour and vanilla. Mix well. Pour into three greased layer pans. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Twice - Baked Potatoes
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Bake potatoes for 1 hour or until tender., Cut shallow, lengthwise slice from 1 side of potatoes and scoop out pulp, reserving shells., Combine pulp with butter, milk, chives, seasonings and half the cheese., Beat until light and fluffy., Spoon pulp into reserved shells., Sprinkle with remaining cheese., Bake for 20 minutes.

title: Italian Beef
directions: Cook meat with seasonings except salt and pepper in Dutch oven., Bring to a boil, then cook on low heat 3 to 4 hours until done., Add salt and pepper to taste during the last 30 minutes of cooking., Place sliced green peppers on top of beef and steam until tender., Remove meat from broth and cool., Slice beef thin and return to broth., Serve on Italian bread.

title: Tomato Aspic
directions: Dissolve gelatin in cold water., Combine and gradually heat other liquids., Pour in gelatin and stir., Let liquid cool., Oil mold., Sprinkle onions, celery and olives on bottom (chopped very fine)., Works great to chop vegetables in blender with some water added, then strain, pressing out water., Pour cooled mixture in mold., Chill until firm., (I mix vegetables right into liquid and pour in a bowl; works fine.), Excellent for the holidays or anytime., Serve a little dab of mayo on top., A real tradition in the Roseberry family!

title: French Onion Soup
directions: In heavy skillet, cook onions in heated butter until slightly browned., Sprinkle with flour and cook over low flame until golden, never allowing them to become dark brown., Add consomme and water. Bring to boil, stirring constantly with a wooden spoon, then simmer gently for 20 minutes., Spoon into casserole or individual bowls. Place slices of bread on top., Sprinkle generously with cheese. Add pepper., Sprinkle with melted butter., Brown quickly under broiler flame., Serves 4 to 6.

title: "No Cheese" Cheese Cake
directions: Press into pan (reserve 1/2 cup for top).

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Mix all ingredients, except cracker crumbs., Pour into square, well-buttered 1 1/2-quart casserole dish., Sprinkle crumbs on top., Cook for 30 minutes., Serves 6.

title: Overnight Coffee Cake
directions: Grease bottom of Bundt pan., Sprinkle half of nuts on bottom; arrange rolls on top of nuts., Combine margarine, sugar, cinnamon, pudding and nuts; pour over top., Let set in a cool oven overnight., The next morning, tuck rolls back inside pan and remove from oven., Preheat oven to 350°., Bake 20 to 25 minutes, then turn upside-down on plate.

title: Squash Casserole
directions: Brown beef and onion. Put in casserole dish, mix squash, cheese, crackers, eggs, tomatoes with beef and onion. Bake in oven at 350° for 30 min.

title: Pickled Okra
directions: Pack okra tightly in jars., Add a few hot peppers and a button of garlic to each pint., Bring to a boil the water, vinegar, salt and sugar., Pour over okra in jars and seal., Let age about 3 weeks.

title: Jumbo Raisin Cookies
directions: Add water to raisins and boil 5 minutes or until liquid decreases to 1/2 cup., Cool., Cream shortening, sugar, eggs and vanilla., Add other ingredients alternately to cream mixture. Drop by 2 heaping teaspoonfuls on greased cookie sheet., Bake 10 to 12 minutes at 400°., Makes 40 large cookies.

title: Ratatouille
directions: Salt eggplant and leave for 30 minutes to drain., Pat dry. Heat 6 tablespoons olive oil in a large heavy pan. Add eggplant. Brown on all sides. Remove. Drain on paper. Add more oil. Cook zucchini until moisture has evaporated., Remove. Drain. Cook peppers. Remove. Drain. Add onions., Cook until soft, not brown. Stir in tomatoes, garlic, sugar, parsley and thyme., Simmer for 30 minutes., Add the rest of the vegetables. After 5 minutes, remove from heat., Mix in basil. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Cheddar Cheese Popovers
directions: Combine first 5 ingredients; beat with an electric mixer just until smooth., Place a well-greased muffin pan in oven at 450° for 3 minutes or until a drop of water sizzles when dropped in pan. Remove pan from oven; pour 1 tablespoon of batter into each cup. Sprinkle each with 1 teaspoon cheese; fill each cup 3/4 full with remaining batter., Bake at 450° for 25 minutes.

title: Tuna Casserole
directions: Cook noodles., Pour in bowl., Mix in soup and tuna., Add cheese on top., Cook in oven until cheese is melted and warmed up.

title: "Tabooley" - Wheat Garden Salad
directions: Soak wheat in cold water for 45 minutes., Change water several times., Use sieve; press to squeeze dry., Chop parsley, mint leaves and tomatoes very fine., Add wheat, lemon juice, oil, salt and pepper., Mix well., Serve with fresh lettuce leaves or serve in pita bread., Serves 6.

title: Brandon'S Brownie Dessert
directions: Mix and bake brownies according to directions on box. Let cool. Mix up chocolate according to directions on box.

title: Poppy Seed Cake
directions: Grease and flour Bundt pan., Mix together cake mix, pudding, poppy seed, oil and water., Add eggs, one at a time., Mix well. Pour into prepared Bundt pan., Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Banana Clay
directions: Peel bananas and freeze them in an airtight container., Remove from freezer when frozen solid and blend in blender with a little water or orange juice.

title: Chocolate Chip Cheesecake
directions: Preheat oven to 300°., Combine cookie crumbs and butter., Press firmly into bottom of a 9-inch spring-form pan., In a large mixer bowl, beat cream cheese until fluffy., Gradually beat in sweetened condensed milk until smooth., Add eggs and vanilla., Mix well., In a small bowl, toss 1/2 cup chips with flour to coat; stir into cheese mixture., Pour into crust., Sprinkle remaining 1/2 cup chips evenly over top., Bake for 1 hour, or until it springs back when lightly touched.

title: Green Chili Cheese Dip
directions: Mix cheeses, garlic and green chilies together., Stir in nuts. This is really good on Club crackers., You may roll it into a ball and roll in nuts, if you wish.

title: Banana Pudding
directions: Mix milk and pudding until smooth. Beat. Fold in half container of Cool Whip. Line dish with wafers. Pour a layer of pudding, bananas and wafers, ending with pudding on top. Top with remaining Cool Whip. Sprinkle with wafer crumbs, if desired.

title: Heavenly Delight
directions: For crust, mix together flour, 1/2 cup chopped pecans and margarine., Bake at 350° until light brown., Mix cream cheese, confectioners sugar, half of the Cool Whip and 1/4 cup pecans. Pour over cooled crust., Mix instant pudding and milk., Pour over cream cheese mixture, then add rest of Cool Whip.

title: German Slaw
directions: Mix all ingredients., Cover tightly and keep in the refrigerator.

title: Passover Tsimmes Kugel *
directions: Combine all ingredients., Pour into a greased 1 1/2-quart casserole., Cover and bake at 350° for 40 minutes., Uncover and continue baking an additional 20 to 30 minutes., Serves 10 to 12 easily.

title: Fluffy Biscuits
directions: In a bowl, combine the flour, baking powder, sugar and salt. Cut in shortening until the mixture, resembles coarse crumbs. In a small bowl, beat egg and milk; stir into dry ingredients just until moistened. Turn onto a well floured surface; knead 20 times. Roll to 3/4-inch thickness; cut with a 2 1/2-inch biscuit cutter. Place on lightly greased baking sheet. Bake at 450° for 8 to 10 minutes or until golden brown. Serve warm; great with apple butter.

title: Sausage Balls
directions: Combine first four ingredients and mix thoroughly. Shape into balls about the size of a quarter., Brown on all sides in a dry skillet; drain on paper towels., Drain fat from skillet, then add remaining ingredients., Stir well., Return meatballs to sauce. Refrigerate until time to use., When ready to use, reheat, simmering for 20 minutes., Serve in a chafing dish with cocktail picks., Yields 36 balls., For a party of 50, triple recipe.

title: Bean Dip
directions: Mix all together in micro-safe dish and heat until cheese melts., Stir and serve with tortilla chips., Decorate top with chopped olives., Teens love it!

title: Calico Bean Casserole
directions: Brown ground beef and onions in large pan., Then add catsup, brown sugar, vinegar, salt and mustard; mix well., Then add beans. Bake at 350° for 40 minutes., Makes large casserole or several small ones., Freezes well., Thaw and reheat.

title: Marshmallow Treats
directions: Melt margarine in 5-quart saucepan., Add marshmallows and cook over low heat, stirring constantly until marshmallows are melted. Mixture should be syrupy., Remove from heat and add Rice Krispies. Stir until well coated., Press mixture firmly into greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan., Cut into squares when cool., Enjoy.

title: Rolled Chicken Breast
directions: Sprinkle chicken breast with tenderizer, garlic salt and seasoning salt., Fold chicken breast in half around slice of cheese and wrap with slice of bacon., Top with soup and bread crumbs., Cover with foil., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Sweet Pickled Beets
directions: Boil the beets until tender, about 2 hours., Remove them from heat and peel., Slice 1/4-inch slices., Put the vinegar, sugar and spice bag in a kettle and boil for a few minutes or until sugar is well dissolved., Add the beets to the syrup and bring it back to the boiling point., Remove from heat., Pack while hot in sterilized jars and seal., Makes about 8 or 9 pints.

title: Frozen Fruit Salad
directions: Pour lemon juice over crushed bananas and mix all., Pour into cups and put in freezer for 1 hour., Top with maraschino cherries. Freeze overnight., Makes 25 (5 ounce) cups or 35 (3 ounce) cups.

title: Red Velvet Cake
directions: Beat eggs; add sugar, cooking oil and vinegar., Sift flour and soda together., Add the remaining ingredients., Bake in a tube pan for 40 minutes at 350°., Test with a toothpick.

title: Cranberry-Apple Jello Salad
directions: Grind cranberries and apples and mix with sugar., Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water or juice., Add cold water and refrigerate until Jell-O thickens, then add fruit mix.

title: Peanut Butter Chews
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Drop by spoonfuls on wax paper.

title: My Grandmother'S Easter Soup(Traditional Sicilian)
directions: Put broth and water into a 10-cup saucepan over medium heat. Mix next 8 ingredients together and form into small meat balls (1-inch size) and drop into boiling liquid., Let simmer 3/4 hour.

title: Dump-It Dessert Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., In lightly greased 9 x 12 inch baking pan, spread pineapple and top with pie filling., Sprinkle dry cake mix over this., Slice margarine into 12 slices and dot over top. Cover all with coconut., bake for 1 hour or until golden., Serve with ice cream or whipped cream if desired.

title: Pecan Cream Cheese Pie
directions: In mixing, beat cream cheese until smooth. Add 1/2 c sugar, salt, 1 egg, and 1 tsp vanilla. Beat just to combine. Spread mixture on bottom of pastry. Sprinkle pecans over cream cheese mixture. Lightly beat 3 eggs. Add 3 tbsp sugar, syrup, melted butter, and 1 tsp vanilla. Place pie on a baking sheet on oven rack. Slowly and carefully pour syrup mixture over pecans. Cover edge of pie crust with foil. Bake at 375° for 20 min. Remove foil. Bake at 325° for 20 min. Bake at 325° for 15 to 20 min. more, till knife inserted in center comes out clean. Cool before serving. Refrigerate leftovers. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Pecan Crispies
directions: Cream shortening, butter, sugar and eggs., Beat well dry ingredients, add to creamed mixture and add nuts. Drop by tsp. about 2 inches apart. Bake at 350° for 12-15 minutes. Makes 5 dozen.

title: Pork Chop Casserole
directions: Season and brown, chops., Place, over rice in casserole dish. Place onion and, pepper, on top of each chop., Sprinkle with salt and pepper., Pour, consomme, over all., Bake for one hour at 325°.

title: Indian Punch
directions: Boil the sugar, lemon rinds and 1 quart water for 5 minutes. Cool, then add remaining ingredients, except ginger ale., Chill. When ready to serve, add ginger ale.

title: C.C.'S Macaroni And Cheese
directions: Cook macaroni as directed on package; drain., Pour in casserole dish., Sprinkle with salt and pepper.

title: Fettucini Alfredo(Lo-Fat)
directions: Melt margarine., Saute whole cloves until brown., Remove garlic., Mix sour cream, yogurt and Parmesan cheese and put in skillet with butter.

title: Gram Ingraham'S Dumplings(Ora B. Plumlee Ingraham)
directions: Roll out 1/4 inch thick; cut in squares. Drop squares in boiling broth; cover and cook. Take chicken out of broth and serve apart from dumplings.

title: Quick Cheeseburger Bake
directions: Heat oven to 400°., Generously grease a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Cook beef and onion in 10-inch skillet until beef is brown. Drain. Stir in soup, vegetables and milk., Stir baking mix and water in baking dish until moistened., Spread evenly. Spread beef mixture over batter. Sprinkle with cheese., Bake 30 minutes.

title: Vegetable Salad
directions: Drain the vegetables., Combine with onion, celery and pimentos., Pour dressing over vegetables.

title: Dutch Apple Cake
directions: Beat egg in mixer bowl until foamy., Add sugar; beat well. Add apples, pecans, flour, baking powder and vanilla; mix well. Pour into greased and floured 4 x 8-inch loaf pan., Bake at 300° for 35 minutes., Remove to wire rack to cool., Serve warm with whipped cream., Cake will rise to top of pan and fall, leaving a crusty top., Yield:, 12 servings.

title: Hamburger And French Fries
directions: First mix ground meat, pepper, salt, and water., Cook the meat in a pan on the stove for one hour., Put the meat on the buns.

title: Apricot Salad
