directions: Set jello using water and 1 cup juice., Add drained fruit before jello sets., Let set., Cook 1 cup juice, sugar, flour, egg and butter., Let cool., After it cools, mix 1 envelope Dream Whip according to directions on package., Carefully fold into cooked mixture., Spread on top of jello and fruit., Refrigerate.

title: Date Nut Bread(Made In Soup Cans)
directions: Put chopped dates in a saucepan and add cup of water., Bring to a boil., Set aside to cool., In another bowl, beat eggs., Add sugar and vanilla or rum and mix well., Then sift together flour, baking powder, salt and soda.

title: Pecan Pie
directions: Combine the ingredients and place into pie crust., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes., Makes two pies.

title: Chicken Souffle
directions: Line 9 x 13-inch buttered pan with bread; top with chicken. Add mushrooms, then water chestnuts, then cheese., Combine eggs, milk and salt and pour over chicken, etc., Mix soups, melted butter, mayonnaise and pimento and spread on top., Refrigerate overnight., Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours., Remove from oven and sprinkle crumbs on top., Bake 15 minutes longer at 325°.

title: Hash Brown Casserole
directions: Put hash browns in 9 x 13-inch baking dish and let thaw. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over hash browns., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Potato Chip Cookies
directions: Cream butter and sugar, blend in flour and vanilla, gently mix in chips., Preheat oven to 300°., Wrap dough by teaspoon on cookie sheet., Bake 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Easy Chocolate Cake
directions: Mix the flour, sugar, cocoa and soda., Add remaining ingredients., Pour into ungreased pan., Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

title: Shrimp Enchiladas
directions: Melt margarine and saute onion until tender., Add soup and heat., Add cream cheese and melt., Add half jar pimento., Fill tortillas with mixture and fold over., Pour rest of mixture and pimento over them., Top with other cheese., Heat in oven until hot and melted.

title: No-Bake Oaties
directions: Melt butter or margarine and stir in sugar., Add juice and rind., Heat, stirring until sugar dissolves., Stir in the oats and nuts., Chill mixture for an hour., Shape into balls., Roll balls in coconut flakes., Makes about 30.

title: Chocolate Pixies
directions: Sift together flour, baking powder and salt., Melt butter and chocolate squares., Cool slightly., Blend in sugar and one egg at a time and beat one minute., Add walnuts and dry ingredients., Mix well., Chill at least 30 minutes., Shape into balls using 1 teaspoon of dough for each., Roll in sugar., Place on greased baking sheet., Bake at 300° for 18 to 20 minutes.

title: Freeze It And Forget It Fruit Salad
directions: Combine syrup, egg, sugar, salt, flour and vinegar in saucepan., Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly until thickened., Cool., Add fruit to cooked mixture., Chill Carnation in refrigerator tray until soft ice crystals form around edges of tray (10 to 15 minutes.), Add lemon juice; whip very stiff (1 minute.), Fold into fruit mixture., Spoon into 6 cup mold., Freeze until firm about 5 to 6 hours.

title: Apricot Sweet Potatoes
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., Grease 1 to 1 1/2 quart casserole. Arrange potatoes in casserole., Mix sugar, cornstarch, salt, cinnamon and orange peel in heavy quart saucepan., Add apricot nectar and water., Cook on high until mixture comes to boil, stirring constantly., Remove from heat., Stir in apricots and margarine., Pour evenly over potatoes., Sprinkle with pecans., Bake at 375° for 25 minutes (uncovered).

title: Potato Casserole
directions: Mix potatoes, onion and bacon in casserole dish., Mix soup and milk; pour over potatoes., Cook in microwave for 10 minutes., Mix in Cheez Whiz., Cook 10 minutes longer or until potatoes are done.

title: Gooseberry Pudding
directions: Cream margarine and 1/3 cup sugar well., Add baking powder and flour, mix well., Add milk to creamed mixture., Spread in greased 8-inch pie pan., Top with berries., Sprinkle 1 cup sugar over berries, dot with margarine and pour boiling water over all., Bake 30 to 40 minutes at 375° until lightly brown.

title: Chocolate Pies
directions: Mix all ingredients together and cook until thick; pour into baked pie shells., Top with meringue., Bake until meringue is brown.

title: Toffee Bars
directions: Mix all ingredients except chocolate together., Spread by hand into a greased 10 x 15-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes., Do not overbake., While cookies are still warm, spread chocolate over them.

title: Zucchini Casserole
directions: Prepare spaghetti sauce mix according to directions., Add oregano and parsley., Melt butter in frying pan and add bread dressing., Toss until brown., Put zucchini in bottom of casserole. Spoon part of sauce over it., Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and bread crumbs., Top with Mozzarella and tomato slices., Add remainder of sauce and rest of bread; top with cheese., Bake 30 to 45 minutes in 375° oven.

title: Pie Crust
directions: This recipe makes 3 or 4 pie crusts., Dough may be frozen in a freezer bag for future use.

title: Meat Loaf
directions: Mix all ingredients, except tomato sauce and syrup., Bake in loaf pan for 15 minutes at 400°., Pour mixture of tomato sauce and syrup over meat loaf., Baste 2 to 3 times while cooking, next 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Cauliflower Onion Soup
directions: In large saucepan, saute onion in butter until soft., Stir in flour; cook over low heat, stirring, for 3 minutes., Remove pan from heat; add chicken broth, stirring, and add cauliflower and bring to boil., Simmer for 30 minutes., Puree in blender in 2 batches and return to saucepan., Add milk, cream, cayenne pepper, white pepper and salt to taste., Cook until hot and serve sprinkled with minced parsley., Serves four.

title: Biscuit Tortoni(An Italian Dessert)
directions: Soak crumbs in milk with powdered sugar and salt for 1/2 hour. Fold whipped cream and vanilla into softened macaroons., Fill paper baking cups in cupcake tins., Decorate with maraschino cherry bits., Freeze without stirring.

title: U. P. Skinny Dip
directions: Combine all ingredients and chill., Serve with raw vegetables.

title: Pasta Con Broccoli
directions: Cook shells and drain., Cook broccoli and drain., Saut mushrooms in butter., Mix all ingredients together and simmer over low heat., Add salt, pepper and garlic powder to taste.

title: Dry Mixture For Barbecue
directions: Mix and store in a glass jar., Keep lid on tight., This will keep for years.

title: Tuna Tempties
directions: Mix all ingredients; spread on buns., Wrap in foil and place in a shallow pan., Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes, until heated through and the cheese melts.

title: Banana Stars Cookies
directions: Mix the ingredients well in large bowl., Roll out and cut into star shapes., Bake at 350° for 9 to 10 minutes., Makes 2 to 3 dozen.

title: Microwave Fat-Free Risotto
directions: Place onions in an 11 x 8 1/2 x 2-inch (28 x 21.5 x 5-cm) dish. Cook, uncovered, at 100% for 2 minutes in a 650 to 700 watt oven. Stir in rice and cook, uncovered, for 1 minute or until rice is milky-white, but not browned.

title: Tomato Delight
directions: Mix ingredients well., Add 2 to 3 slices of tomatoes., Chill at least 4 hours and better if overnight.

title: Hawaiian Wedding Cake
directions: Mix cake mix according to instructions on box., Bake in 12 x 18-inch or 11 x 15-inch pan., When done, let cool completely before adding the rest of the topping.

title: One-Step Salmon Bake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Meanwhile, chop celery., Drain salmon. Break into large chunks., In a 1 1/2-quart casserole, combine celery, condensed soup, milk, frozen broccoli, lemon peel and 1/4 teaspoon pepper., Add salmon and uncooked noodles, then toss lightly until well mixed., Bake, covered, in a 350° oven about 50 minutes or until noodles are tender, stirring once after 25 minutes of cooking., Sprinkle salmon-noodle mixture with cheese., Bake, uncovered, about 5 minutes more until cheese is melted., Makes 4 servings., Contains 244 calories.

title: Louise'S Coffee Cake
directions: Mix the flour, sugar, baking powder and salt together, then work in the shortening., Take out 1 cup for topping., Add the cinnamon, brown, sugar, vanilla, buttermilk and soda., Stir all together., Pour into greased 13 x 9-inch pan., Sprinkle on the topping., Bake at 350° for 45 to 60 minutes.

title: Southern Deep Dish Pecan Pie
directions: Beat eggs with sugar and salt., Add Karo, butter and vanilla. Add pecan pieces., Pour into uncooked pie shell., Bake at 350° about 50 minutes or until knife comes out clean.

title: Best Hot Fudge
directions: Mix first 5 ingredients together in large glass measuring cup. Microwave on High until it comes to a boil, stirring every minute., Stir in vanilla and butter., Serve over vanilla ice cream.

title: Beef Roast Sunday Dinner
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Put roast on heavy-duty foil in baking dish. Sprinkle soup mix over roast. Pour mushrooms and liquid over roast., Seal foil over roast in pan. Put in preheated oven just before leaving for church., It can bake as long as 2 1/2 hours and be perfect., If you desire gravy, drain juices into a saucepan. Put 3 tablespoons flour in a small jar., Add 1 cup water and shake vigorously., Pour into heated juices. Cook until desired thickness., Add more water, if needed.

title: Tomato Catsup
directions: Select good firm ripe tomatoes; scald and strain through a coarse sieve to remove seed and skin., When cold, add to each gallon tomatoes the other ingredients; let simmer slowly for 3 hours., Seal in bottles or jars.

title: Tossed Artichoke Salad
directions: In a saucepan, combine oil, vinegar, 2 tablespoons of water, onion, sugar, garlic, 1/2 teaspoon salt, celery seed and dash of pepper., Bring to boiling., Add artichoke hearts., Cook until tender, 3 to 5 minutes., Cool., Stir in pimento., Chill.

title: Party Meat Balls
directions: Mix all ingredients., Roll into golf size balls., Cook for 12 to 15 minutes at 375°.

title: Shoo-Fly Pie
directions: Pour 3/4 cup hot water over soda in small bowl. Stir to dissolve. Beat in molasses and egg yolk, combining well., In medium bowl, combine flour, sugar, salt and spices, mixing well. Add butter., Using fingers, rub into flour mixture to make crumbs. Sprinkle 1/4 crumb mixture in bottom of pie shell. Top with 1/3 molasses mixture., Continue layering, ending with crumb mixture on top., Preheat oven to 350°. Bake pie for 35 minutes or until filling is firm to the touch when lightly pressed with fingertip. Serve pie warm with vanilla ice cream or whipped cream, if desired.

title: Chocolate Pound Cake
directions: Cream, sugar,, butter, and, Crisco., Add eggs, one at a time. Beat, well., Sift, together dry ingredients., Alternate dry ingredients with milk into mixture;, add vanilla., Grease and flour tube pan., Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 20 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
directions: In medium saucepan, melt butter; stir in brown sugar and milk. Bring to a boil; boil and stir 2 minutes., Remove from heat. Stir in peanut butter and vanilla., Mix in 10x sugar; beat until smooth., Spread into buttered 9-inch pan., Chill until firm., Cut into squares.

title: Uncle Bill'S Drop Cocoa Cookies
directions: Cream together margarine, sugar and vanilla. Blend flour and cocoa together and add to this mixture. Refrigerate 1 to 3 hours. Mold a scant tablespoon of dough around each chocolate drop. Shape into balls. Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes or until set. Cool. Roll in 10x sugar. Makes 4 1/2 dozen.

title: Irene'S Corn Bread
directions: Put water and margarine in a large pot; bring to boil., Beat eggs and sugar; stir in salt, milk and corn meal., Add to boiling water; stir and cook until thick., Pour into 9 x 9-inch baking dish or pan., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Summer Salad
directions: Mix dry jello with cottage cheese and Cool Whip., Add all fruit which has been well drained. Mix well and refrigerate for several hours.

title: Variety Torte
directions: Cream butter and oil with sugar until creamy., Add egg yolks and flavoring; mix well., Gradually add dry ingredients, alternating with milk., Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites; blend lightly., Pour into 3 greased and floured 9-inch pans., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes., Cool., Split layers for 6 pieces.

title: Raised Doughnuts
directions: Dissolve yeast in 1/3 cup lukewarm water., Scald milk and, when cool, add dissolved yeast and rest of ingredients., Let rise until double in bulk., Place on board; roll out and cut., Let doughnuts rise about 3/4 hour and fry in hot fat.

title: Easy Pecan Pie
directions: In large bowl stir first 5 ingredients until well blended. Stir in pecans., Pour into pie shell., Bake in 350° oven for 50 to 55 minutes., Cool.

title: Broccoli Raisin Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients together and serve chilled., Serves about 8 people.

title: Dill Pickle Appetizer
directions: Spread cheese on ham., Roll up on pickle., Chill about 1 hour. Slice.

title: Vegetable Casserole
directions: Cut carrots and zucchini julienne style and then cook them until they are tender., In a saucepan add the first eight ingredients and cook over medium heat until smooth and thick., Do not boil., Then mix vegetables and sauce in a casserole dish. Stir bread crumbs, cheese and margarine together and spread over the top., Bake for 15 minutes at 350° to warm and brown crumbs.

title: Broccoli And Rice
directions: Cook 3 to 4 hours on low in a crock-pot.

title: Steak Roll-Ups
directions: Place prepared stuffing on cubed steak and roll up., Place in pan and pour mushroom soup over steaks., Bake in 325° oven for 20 minutes.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
directions: Blend oil and sugar., Add eggs, one at a time, beating after each., Stir together dry ingredients and add to egg mixture., Stir in apples, pecans and vanilla., Pour into greased and floured 10-inch tube pan or Bundt pan., Bake at 350° for about 1 to 1 1/2 hours., Remove from pan when slightly cooled in tube pan at least 1 1/2 hours.

title: Breakfast Casserole
directions: Crumble sausage and fry; drain well., Spread bread with butter. Cut into cubes and cover bottom of 9 x 14-inch pan (sprayed with Pam)., (Frozen bread slices are easier to work with.), Sprinkle drained sausage over bread., Beat eggs well, then add evaporated milk and salt., (I use garlic salt.), Beat until fluffy then pour egg mixture over sausage and bread., Cover with grated cheese., (I also put some of cheese into egg mixture before pouring onto bread and sausage.), Refrigerate overnight (covered with foil)., Bake next morning for 35 to 40 minutes in 350° oven.

title: Spinach Noodles Italiano
directions: In 3-quart saucepan, cook the noodles according to package. Drain well., In same saucepan, melt butter., Stir in herbs and noodles., Cook over low heat until heated through, 3 to 5 minutes. Stir in Parmesan cheese.

title: Recipe For Friendship
directions: Mix ingredients together; toss in a little flair., Serve to everyone you know and topped with a tiny prayer.

title: Taco Bake
directions: Brown beef and onions about 10 minutes., Stir in tomato sauce, kidney beans, chili powder, salt and pepper., Break taco shells in 1/2 at fold., Arrange on bottom of 13 x 9-inch baking dish., Spoon meat mix over tacos and sprinkle with cheese., Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes or until hot., If desired, top with lettuce and tomatoes.

title: Ice Cream Dessert
directions: Put butter, Rice Krispies, pecans and coconut in bowl; mix well and put in oven for 10 minutes or until butter melts., Remove from oven; add sugar and mix well., Place layer of sugar mixture in bottom of dish, then place layer of soft ice cream over that, then another layer of sugar mixture, etc., with layer of sugar mixture being on top., Cover with foil and re-freeze ice cream. Take out of freezer 30 to 45 minutes before serving.

title: Ezio Pork Chops
directions: In a large frypan, put olive oil to cover pan., Heat pan first. Put fresh rosemary in first and then pork chops., Cook hot and then sprinkle wine to cool pan down., Move chops around so they don't stick., Repeat many times., Heat up., Cool down with wine., Turn over., Should be caramel color on chops., Cook until white inside. Serves 4 to 6. Temperature:, Medium-high., Cooking Time:, 35 minutes.

title: Helen'S Tortilla Soup
directions: Saute onion and garlic in oil., Add broths, tomato sauce, cumin, chili powder, jalapenos and Worcestershire. Bring to a boil, cover and simmer for 1 hour., Add chicken and tomatoes. Cook 15 minutes. Cut corn tortillas in narrow strips., Fry crisp. Place a few tortilla strips in the bottom of each bowl., Fill with hot soup., Top with more chips and shredded cheese., (Optional - squeeze fresh lime juice on top.) Avocado slices may be served with this soup.

title: Festive Green Bean Casserole
directions: In a skillet, saute the red pepper and onion in butter until tender., Add the soup, milk, worcestershire sauce and hot pepper sauce; stir until smooth., Stir in the green beans and water chestnuts., Transfer to an ungreased 1 1/2 qt. baking dish. Sprinkle with cheese., Bake, uncovered at 350° for 15 minutes or until heated through and cheese is melted.

title: Quick Shrimp Curry
directions: Cook onion, garlic and curry powder in butter until onion is tender., Stir in soup, milk, shrimp and peas., Cook over low heat for 5 minutes; stir frequently., Serve over rice., Serve with fruit salad.

title: Sue'S Meat Loaf
directions: Soften bread crumbs in milk., Combine remaining ingredients. Shape into a loaf., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Cream Cheese And Potted Meat Spread
directions: Place minced onion in a small amount of water for 5 minutes. Drain., Mix with cream cheese and potted meat., Chill., When ready to serve, spread on party rye or crackers.

title: Coconut Pound Cake
directions: Cream margarine and sugar., Add eggs, one at a time, and beat. Combine milk and flavoring., Add flour alternately with milk, beginning and ending with flour., Fold in coconut.

title: Brandied Roast Pork
directions: Place all ingredients, except pork loin, in a saucepan and bring to a low boil, stirring until sugar is melted and ingredients are blended. Use caution since this boils over easily. Let cool. Reserve 1/3 cup of the marinade and refrigerate. Marinate pork for no less than 4 hours; overnight works best.

title: Homemade Eagle Brand Milk
directions: Mix syrup, oleo and boiling water., Slowly add sugar and milk. Mix until well blended., Makes 1 1/4 cups.

title: Strawberry Banana Sodas
directions: Blend or process the bananas, strawberries and mineral water on medium speed until smooth., Pour into 2 chilled glasses.

title: Crazy Aunt Moo'S "I Married A Greek" Orzo Salad(Yield:  10-12 Servings)
directions: 1. Cook box of orzo, set aside.

title: Lemon Icebox Pie
directions: Whip together lemon juice and Eagle Brand milk., Whip cream and sugar., Add flavorings., Mix well with milk mixture., Pour into baked pie crust., Refrigerate., Very, very good.

title: Never Fail Chocolate Cake
directions: Put ingredients in bowl in order given., Mix well., Bake in a 9 x 9-inch pan at 350°.

title: Breakfast Pizza
directions: Brown sausage; drain off fat., Separate crescent rolls and place into ungreased 12-inch dish., Press together making bottom crust and sides., Spoon sausage over the crust., Sprinkle with potatoes., Top with cheese., Beat together eggs, milk, salt and pepper., Pour over crust., Sprinkle Parmesan cheese., Bake at 375° for 25 to 30 minutes., Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Play Dough
directions: Mix ingredients in a large skillet., Stir over medium-high heat until ingredients form a soft ball., Remove from skillet and knead the dough until pliable and has an even consistency., Store in an airtight container., Gallon size Ziploc bags work well; will keep for months.

title: Cream Puffs
directions: Heat water to boiling., Melt margarine in hot water., Add flour and salt all at once and stir until mixture leaves sides of pan. Remove from heat; add eggs one at a time, beating well after each. Drop by spoonfuls on a greased cooking sheet., Bake at 400° for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Russian Tea
directions: Place tea bags in water; brew 5 to 10 minutes., Remove tea bags., Add all other ingredients., Bring to a boil and let simmer for at least 15 minutes.

title: Butterfinger Bars
directions: Cream butter, sugar and brown sugar in a large mixing bowl. Add quick-cooking oats., Mix well; press into a 2-quart utility dish., Bake at 350° for 15 minutes until slightly firm to touch. Place chocolate morsels and peanut butter in a double boiler over boiling water., Stir until melted., Spread melted chocolate mixture over warm oat mixture., Cool., Cut into squares.

title: The Best Homemade Vanilla Ice Cream
directions: Pour all ingredients into an electric ice cream freezer., Add milk to fill line; freeze as usual., Fresh fruit may be pureed and added.

title: Old-Time Beef Stew
directions: In Dutch oven, thoroughly brown meat in 2 tablespoons hot shortening, turning often., Add 2 cups hot water and next 9 ingredients., Cover; simmer for 1 1/2 hours, stirring occasionally to keep from sticking., Remove bay leaves., Add vegetables., Cover and cook 30 to 45 minutes, or until vegetables are tender., Serves 6 to 8.

title: Garden Medley Spaghetti
directions: Cook spaghetti; drain., In medium skillet, heat margarine with garlic., Add carrots, zucchini and onions., Cook and stir until vegetables are tender.

title: Hot Sausage Cheese Puffs
directions: Brown sausage., Drain., Pour sausage in a large bowl., Cool completely., Add cheese, Bisquick and water., Mix well until blended., Roll into 1-inch balls or patties., Bake at 400° until puffed and golden brown., Bake about 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Taco Stacko
directions: Blend refried beans with taco mix., Spread in 9-inch pie plate., Mash avocados and combine with sour cream and lemon juice. Spread mixture over beans., Sprinkle with cheese, tomatoes, chilies, olives and green onions.

title: Best Icing
directions: Cream sugar, oleo, crisco., Add salt,, vanilla, milk and flour., Beat high speed 12 minutes.

title: Fish Stew For 25
directions: Peel and, cut, up the potatoes., Add water to cover and boil until tender., When, cooked,, mash potatoes with a potato masher. Cook bacon until, brown,, then, add onions., When the onions are brown, place, bacon,, onions, and potatoes in large pot (12 quart) and, combine, the, mixture., Add, tomato juice, tomatoes and ketchup and, bring to a boil., Add Worcestershire sauce, hot sauce, salt, and, pepper., Simmer, for, 30 minutes. Add fish and bring to, a rolling boil., Turn down the heat and let simmer.

title: Chocolate Nut Caramels
directions: Put sugar, corn syrup, 1 cup cream and butter together., Stir and cook to a vigorous boil., Gradually add the other cup of cream. Do not allow the mixture to stop boiling while cream is being added., Cook until thermometer reads 250°, stirring gently. Without a thermometer, cook to hard ball stage., Remove from fire; add chocolate, nuts and vanilla., Beat until chocolate is melted.

title: Apple Coffee Cake
directions: Heat oven to 400°., Grease round layer pan, 9 x 1 1/2-inches or square pan, 8 x 8 x 2-inches., Prepare topping., Mix baking mix, sugar, egg and water., Beat vigorously 30 seconds., Stir in apples., Spread batter in pan. Sprinkle with topping. Bake until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean, 20 to 25 minutes. Refrigerate any remaining coffee cake.

title: Dried Beef Spread
directions: May substitute dried venison for beef.

title: Snow Frosting
directions: Combine first five ingredients in top of double boiler., Beat 1 minute, then place over, boiling water and beat constantly for 4 minutes., Remove from boiling water, beat 1 minute more while you add vanilla., Spread on cake.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Steam broccoli stems for 10 minutes, then put in bottom of casserole., Fry sausage very little and pour off grease. Alternate broccoli tops, sausage, onion and cheese in casserole with soup., Put croutons on top and pour on butter., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Poppy Seed Cake
directions: Mix together., Put into a greased and floured Bundt or angel food pan and bake for 1 hour at 350°.

title: Lemon Pound Cake
directions: Sift flour and powder together in a bowl, set aside., Cream butter and shortening., Gradually add sugar while beating., Beat until light., Add eggs, one at a time, beating well., Beat until light and fluffy., Add vanilla and lemon, mix well., Add dry ingredients, alternately with milk., Mix well., Spoon batter into a greased tube pan., Place in cold oven., Turn on oven and bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours, or until done.

title: Pineapple Zucchini Bread
directions: Mix together eggs, sugar and oil., Add flour, cinnamon, baking soda, baking powder and vanilla., Mix., Stir in pineapple, zucchini and walnuts., Pour into greased loaf pans., Bake at 350° for, 1, hour., Makes, 3, small or 1 large and 1 small loaf.

title: Baked Beans With Meat
directions: *May substitute all ground beef.

title: Yogurt Pie
directions: Mix yogurt and Cool Whip., Place in pie crust and chill until firm.

title: Zucchini Patties
directions: Combine all ingredients, except oil and cheese, and mix well. Divide batter into 4 patties.

title: Almond Bars
directions: Mix ingredients (except egg white and almonds) together well. Pour in a 9 x 13-inch pan., Beat egg white., Pour over top., Place sliced almonds on top., Bake at 350° for 25 minutes., Cut into squares.

title: Kisses
directions: First beat egg whites until thick., Next add salt, sugar, cream of tartar and vanilla, then spoon out on greased cookie sheet., Bake at 325° for 15 to 25 minutes or until they start turning a little brown.

title: American Spaghetti
directions: Saute bacon, green pepper, onion and mushrooms 5 minutes., Add ground beef and cook until brown. Add salt and pepper to taste. Add tomatoes (break up)., Combine with spaghetti., Pour into large baking dish and bake 30 minutes at 350°., Top with cheese, if desired.

title: Brown Sugar Cake With Maple Flavor
directions: Cream butter and sugar, then add egg yolks one at a time and beat., Mix milk and buttermilk together., Take 1/3 cup out., Add soda to 1/3 cup of milk., Add flour and milk to mixture., Add flavorings., Fold in beaten egg whites., Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Cheese Ball
directions: Soften cheese; add onions and Worcestershire sauce., Work 1 package of beef into mixture., Roll into ball, then in other beef., Cool 4 hours. Serve with Wheat Thins or Triscuits crackers.

title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Dessert
directions: Mix 2 tablespoons milk into peanut butter in a large bowl. Gently stir in whipped topping., Pour 2 cups milk into a large bowl., Add the pudding mix., Beat with wire whisk 1 to 2 minutes or until well blended., Spoon whipped topping mixture and pudding alternately into glasses. Refrigerate 1 hour., Makes 6 servings.

title: Raisin Bran Muffins
directions: Combine Raisin Bran and milk., Let stand until mixture is moistened., Add egg and shortening., Beat well, then add flour, baking powder, salt and sugar, stirring only until combined., Fill greased muffin tins 2/3 full., Bake at 400° for 30 minutes.

title: Caramel Corn
directions: Melt, margarine;, add	sugar,	syrup, and, salt., Stir constantly until sugar is dissolved., Let boil over low heat 5 minutes; do not stir., Remove from heat;, add soda and flavoring. Stir real good;, this will be foamy., Pour over corn and mix real good., Bake, in, 250° oven for 1 hour, stirring every 15 minutes. Let cool and break apart.

title: Lime Spring Salad
directions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water., Mix cheese and pineapple together; then add all ingredients to gelatin mixture and congeal. Yields 10 servings.

title: Gelatin Pizza
directions: Pour gelatin into a bowl., Add water and stir until dissolved. Spray pizza pan and pour in gelatin mixture., Refrigerate about 3 hours.

title: Fresh Strawberry Pie
directions: Heat sugar, water and cornstarch until clear, stirring all the time. Add jello. Cool. Clean and halve strawberries., Fold into cooled jello mixture., Spoon into pie crust and refrigerate until set., Serve topped with Cool Whip.

title: Potato Supreme
directions: Combine all ingredients except butter and stuffing mix., In a large bowl, mix thoroughly and then spoon into a 13 x 9-inch casserole dish, lightly buttered., Combine stuffing mix and butter and sprinkle on top., Bake 1 hour at 350° or until bubbly and brown., May be made ahead and stored covered in refrigerator.

title: Tortilla Roll-Ups
directions: Fold together the sour cream, cream cheese, chilies, olives, onions and garlic powder., Smear on flour tortillas and roll into a log., Cover individually with foil and refrigerate overnight to set., Cut into pinwheels or 2-inch sections., For variation, layer tortillas and cut into wedges.

title: Mini Cheese Cakes
directions: Soften cream cheese to room temperature., Blend with 1/2 cup sugar until creamy., Add vanilla and eggs; blend well., Place vanilla cookie into paper muffin cup., Place into muffin pan. Spoon cream cheese mixture into cups., Bake for 25 minutes at 325°., Top with cherries, peaches or strawberries.

title: Brisket
directions: Brush liquid smoke on brisket and sprinkle with salt and pepper., Soak overnight in cold coffee and wine., Add onion and bay leaves., Bake in a covered roaster or roasting bag for 5 to 6 hours at 300°, fat side up., Remove fat after 4 hours and drizzle with barbecue sauce., Slice across grain and add more sauce, if desired. Keep in low oven (200° to 250°) until ready to serve.

title: Hush Puppies
directions: Add milk to onion mix to make 1/2 cup milk; mix., Heap onto tablespoon, forming into a ball., Drop into deep, hot fat and fry until golden brown.

title: Buttercream Frosting
directions: In a small mixing bowl, cream butter; add 1/3 of the sugar and beat well., Add egg, vanilla, salt and cream; beat until smooth. Gradually add remaining sugar, beating until smooth., If frosting is too thick, additional cream may be added.

title: Baked Macaroni And Cheese
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Combine flour with seasonings., Layer macaroni, cheese and flour mixture in alternate layers in a baking dish until all are used. Pour milk over all and top with crushed cracker crumbs, if desired. Bake about 45 minutes or until golden brown on top.

title: Fresh Peach Pound Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°. Mix all ingredients in order listed. Pour into lightly floured Bundt pan. Bake 1 hour. Remove from oven to rack. Cool completely.

title: Jello Salad
directions: In bottom of dish, put the lime jello, 1 cup hot water and 1 cup crushed pineapple., Let this set.

title: Oven Baked Potato Chip Chicken
directions: Wash chicken; remove skin and dip chicken in beaten egg. Place chicken in crushed potato chips and press both sides so chicken is evenly covered., Place chicken in pan after putting a little oil in pan., Bake at 350° for 1 hour., Makes 5 servings. Good with Easy Potato Bake.

title: Cornbread
directions: Preheat oven to 425°., Grease and sprinkle cornmeal in an 8-inch baking pan or skillet., Combine all ingredients in bowl, mixing well. Pour into pan or skillet and bake 25 to 30 minutes until golden brown.

title: Party Mix
directions: Mix the first 5 ingredients and place in a large roaster or foil turkey pan., Pour oleo and taco mix over mixture and bake in 250° oven for 45 to 55 minutes., Stir every 15 minutes., Cool and store in airtight containers.

title: Caramel Apple Dip
directions: Serve with apple slices.

title: Powerhouse Stew
directions: Use a heavy saucepan large enough to hold all ingredients. Brown beef in the pan., Drain., Add package of beefy-onion soup to one cup of hot water in a small saucepan, then add this to the beef., Add the tomato soup., Peel and dice potatoes and onions to suit., Add all vegetables, salt and pepper to suit., Cook until done.

title: Granola Bars
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Grease bottom of 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan., Melt butter in saucepan over low heat., Remove from heat. Stir in remaining ingredients (sugar, honey, egg, flour, soda, cinnamon, salt, oats, coconut and nuts)., This mixture will be thick., Press in prepared pan., Bake 20 minutes., Cool in pan. Cut into 32 bars.

title: Spaghetti Sauce
directions: Saute ground meat, onion, salt and pepper., Simmer with cover on., Cook until meat turns white., Add water and bring to boil. Add garlic powder, red pepper, paprika, Italian spice mix, chili blend, tomato sauce, cream of mushroom soup and cheese soup. Simmer for at least 30 minutes to 1 hour., Makes large amount. Can be divided and frozen.

title: Tuna Buns
directions: Combine all ingredients except buns., Spread mixture between buns., Wrap each in foil., Place on baking sheet., Heat at 250° to 300° for 30 minutes., Serve warm., Makes 10 servings.

title: Flour Tortillas
directions: Mix dry ingredients with shortening until it looks a coarse meal., Add warm water and knead dough well., Divide into 12 small balls., Roll into very thin circles., Cook on hot griddle until done on both sides.

title: Potato Salad
directions: Peel and cube cooked potatoes., Add chopped onion, pickles and egg whites., In a coffee mug, add egg yolks, pickles and juice (about 1/8 cup) and finish filling mug with mayonnaise (about 3/4 cup)., Pour to consistency over other ingredients.

title: Lasagne
directions: Brown meat with salt, pepper and onion; add tomato paste, water and spaghetti sauce mix and simmer 10 to 15 minutes., In a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan, alternate layers of meat sauce, Cheddar cheese, noodles and Mozzarella cheese until all ingredients have been used., Bake at 400° for 30 minutes., Cool 10 minutes before serving.

title: Herbed Yogurt Dressing
directions: Crush garlic and salt in a mortar and pestle or small bowl until a paste forms., Stir in remaining ingredients., Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour.

title: Lucille'S Rice Dressing ("Dirty Rice")
directions: Have cooked rice ready., Have onion, parsley, bell pepper, celery, green onions and garlic chopped and ready.

title: Chicken Salad
directions: Mix well and refrigerate.

title: Pretzel Salad
directions: Using a rolling pin, crush pretzels between waxed paper., Mix together pretzels, margarine and 3 tablespoons of sugar., Pat into a 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake for 8 minutes at 400°., Let cool completely.

title: Corn Bread Taco Bake
directions: Brown and strain meat., Stir in next 5 ingredients., Pour into an 8 x 12-inch baking dish., Prepare corn muffin mix according to package directions except add 1/2 can onions., Spoon around outer edges of casserole., Bake, uncovered, at 400° for 20 minutes., Top corn bread with Cheddar cheese and remaining onions., Bake for 2 to 3 minutes.

title: Velvety Chicken Pate
directions: In medium skillet, saute butter and chicken livers for 2 minutes., Add onion and apple and stir for 5 minutes until apple softens., Stir in brandy and cream., Transfer mixture to blender and blend 2 to 3 minutes or until smooth., Refrigerate this mixture for 1 hour.

title: Rice Pudding
directions: Boil the rice in the water for about 25 minutes until soft. Gradually add the cream and flavor with salt., This method makes a lighter pudding and it is less likely to burn on to the saucepan. Serve with a lump of butter, cinnamon and sugar.

title: Mexican Hamburgers
directions: In, skillet, mix, hamburger, onion, green pepper, salt, pepper,, chili powder and sugar., Let hamburger brown with all these ingredients., Add tomato ketchup and let simmer 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Mexican Dip
directions: Spread refried beans on serving dish, mix sour cream and taco mix., Spread on top of beans. Top with lettuce, tomatoes, cheese, and peppers.

title: Peaches And Cream Cheesecake
directions: Beat flour, baking powder, soda, pudding, butter and egg for 2 minutes at medium speed, then pour into 8-inch deep dish or 10 pie pan., Drain the can of peaches, saving juice., Put peaches on top of mixture in pan., Beat cream cheese, sugar and peach juice. Spoon onto the top of peaches within 1 of edge., Mix 1 Tbsp. sugar and cinnamon, sprinkle over cheese mixture., Bake 350° for 30-35 minutes until crust is golden brown - filling appears soft., Keep refrigerated.

title: Cucumber Snacks
directions: Combine cream cheese, mayonnaise and package of Good Seasons. Mix well and spread mixture on bread and top with a cucumber. Refrigerate a couple of hours before serving., Sprinkle with paprika.

title: Taco Salad
directions: Brown ground beef mix in seasoning package., Drain very well. Break up chips and toss all ingredients together., Pour dressing over salad and mix well., Serve immediately.

title: Pie Filling Jello
directions: Dissolve Jell-O in 2 cups boiling water., Add 1 cup cold water and pie filling., Mix well and pour into 9 x 13-inch pan., Chill until set., Spread Dream Whip over top of set Jell-O.

title: Frozen Cookie
directions: Sift together flour, soda, cream of tartar and salt., Cream brown sugar and butter; add eggs and vanilla., Add to flour mixture., Make an oblong loaf of this mixture; wrap it in wax paper and freeze., Then cut it thin and bake 10-12 minutes, until brown, at 350°.

title: Sweet Zucchini Pickles
directions: Wash cucumbers, any size., If they are solid, 2 gallons., Make a brine of 2 cups salt to 1 gallon water; boil and pour over cucumbers in a stone jar., Weigh down; let stand 7 days., Drain; wash and cut into chunks., For next 3 days, make a solution daily of 1 tablespoon powdered alum., Pour over cucumbers which have been drained and old liquid discarded., On 4th morning, heat 6 cups white vinegar, 5 cups sugar, 1/3 cup pickling spices and 1 tablespoon celery seed (may tie spices in a cloth)., Heat to boiling and pour over pickles., On 5th morning, drain liquid into a pan., Add 1 cup sugar., Reheat., Pour over pickles., On 6th morning, drain in pan., Add 1 cup sugar., Pack pickles into sterilized jars and fill to within 1/2-inch of top of jar with boiling liquid., Seal at once.

title: Mango Pickles
directions: Boil all ingredients, except mangoes., Add mangoes when mixture is cool., Store in jars and refrigerate.

title: Marinated Vegetables
directions: Drain vegetables; mix with celery and onions, add salt and pepper., Heat vinegar and sugar; pour over vegetables. Refrigerate until well chilled before eating.

title: Mom'S Chicken Dumplings
directions: Mix eggs, oil, salt and pepper together., Add flour and about 3/4 cup water., Work dough until you can roll it easily., Do not have it stiff., Roll as thin as possible., Cover with dishcloth and let sit overnight., Put chicken broth in a large pot., Let come to hard boil and begin to put in dough cut in small pieces, keeping dough covered., Boil until pastry is done., If broth gets too low, add water so pastry doesn't become dry., With a big spoon occasionally lift pastry from bottom to top.

title: Rice And Deviled Eggs With Tuna
directions: Cook green pepper and onion in butter until glossy., Combine soup and milk. To 3/4 of the soup mixture, add rice and tuna. Place in a casserole. Top with deviled eggs and refrigerate.

title: Peanut Butter Kisses
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Stir peanut butter, sugar, eggs and vanilla in a bowl until blended., It will be sticky., Roll into 1 1/4-inch balls., Then roll in sugar and place on cookie sheets about 1 1/2 inches apart., Bake 12 to 14 minutes until cookies look dry and tops are cracked., Remove from oven and immediately press chocolate kiss in center of each., Cool on cookie sheets.

title: Carrot Cake
directions: Mix dry ingredients; beat eggs and oil together., Beat in dry ingredients., Stir in carrots., Can bake in a Bundt pan at 350° for 1 hour or in a 9 x 13-inch pan for 45 minutes.

title: Corn Pudding
directions: Grease a 1 1/2-quart casserole dish., Drain corn., Put in casserole dish. Add rest of ingredients. Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until set. If you want a little more custard, add 2 extra eggs, slightly beaten, and 1 more cup of milk.

title: Pronto Dip
directions: Whiz the cheese in a Waring-type blender., After several seconds, add picante sauce, enough to both taste and color., Serve with corn chips or on lettuce (tomato optional) as a salad.

title: Onion Rings
directions: Mix flour, cornmeal, baking soda, pepper, garlic salt and egg. Slowly add milk to make a thick, smooth batter., Try not to make it too runny., Use less milk if you need to., Cut onions into rings., Prepare oil by heating to frying temperature., Dip onions into batter and put immediately into oil., If oil is hot, the rings will start frying immediately., Let the rings fry until golden brown., Remove and place on paper towel to drain., Serve with catsup or barbecue sauce., Serves 6 to 8.

title: Sourdough Bread
directions: Combine yeast, 1/2 cup warm water and sugar., Combine 2 cups warm water and flour., Stir all together and put in quart jar. Let stand 8 hours then refrigerate 3 to 8 days before using.

title: Crustless Pizza
directions: Heat oven to 400°., Beat egg in a medium-size bowl., Add beef, catsup, onion, Worcestershire, bread crumbs, pepper sauce, 1/2 teaspoon oregano, 1 teaspoon salt and 1/4 teaspoon pepper., Mix thoroughly with a fork., Pat meat evenly in a 12-inch pizza pan. Bake 7 minutes or longer until no longer pink., Spread marinara sauce over meat., Sprinkle with 1/2 teaspoon oregano, 1/4 teaspoon salt and 1/8 teaspoon pepper., Top with Mozzarella and Parmesan. Arrange green pepper, mushrooms and pepperoni on top of cheese. Bake 10 minutes or until cheese is melted., Broil 3 minutes until cheese is bubbly., Serve in wedges., Makes 4 servings.

title: Quicky Chicken(Serves 4 To 6)
directions: Variation:, Eliminate tomato sauce, use a little more oil to coat potatoes and add oregano and green pepper rings.

title: Date Nut Candy
directions: Mix sugar, margarine, milk and dates in saucepan; cook until thick or makes a ball in cold water., Beat until it begins to get thicker., Add pecans and beat some more., When it gets so thick you cannot beat it, put in a damp cloth and roll it up., Let set for at least 2 hours, then slice into pieces.

title: *Southern Sweet Potato Pie*
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., Cream the margarine and sugar., Add eggs and stir., Add sweet potatoes and mix well., Stir in milk, vanilla and salt, making sure all ingredients are thoroughly mixed., Pour into pie shell and bake 40 minutes., (If using a commercial frozen pie shell, use a 9-inch deep dish.)

title: Chinese Chews
directions: Beat together margarine, sugars and eggs until creamy., Then add salt and flour, coconut, chocolate chips and pecans., Pour in two 9-inch cake pans, greased and floured., Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes., Let cool and sprinkle with powdered sugar or leave plain.

title: Cranberry Baked Apples
directions: Cut each apple lengthwise in half and remove core., Arrange apple halves cut side up in 12 x 8-inch baking dish.

title: Wacky Cake
directions: Mix together:, sugar, flour, cocoa, salt and soda., Add vinegar, vanilla, salad oil and cold water., Bake in a 9 x 9-inch pan in a 350° oven for 25 minutes.

title: Top Of Stove Cookies
directions: Boil the sugar, butter, milk and peanut butter for 1 1/2 minutes., Remove from heat and add cocoa, vanilla and oats., Drop on waxed paper.

title: Turkey Casserole
directions: Toss cheese in flour., Combine 3/4 cup cheese, 1/2 c., almonds and remaining ingredients, except pastry., Mix well., Roll pastry into 15-inch square., Fit pastry into 11 3/4 x 7 1/2-inch baking dish., Trim 1-inch beyond edge., Fill with turkey mixture., Top with remaining cheese and almonds., Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 400°.

title: Diabetic Yam Pie
directions: Combine gelatin, sweetener, salt, cinnamon and nutmeg., Stir in milk, egg yolks and yams., Mix well., Cook 10 minutes. Chill. Beat egg whites until stiff., Stir in Sweet 'N Low., Fold into gelatin mixture., Pour into pie shell., Chill.

title: Stuffed Peppers
directions: Cut top from peppers; remove seeds., Brown meat in skillet; stir in garlic salt and salt., Add 1/2 cup of tomatoes and the cereal., Fill each pepper with 1/2 cup meat mixture., Place in a greased shallow baking dish., Pour on remaining tomatoes., Top with cheese., Bake at 375° for 25 minutes., Makes 4 servings.

title: Nachos
directions: Spread 1 teaspoon of refried beans on each tortilla chip., Top with 1 teaspoon of cheese and one olive slice., Place 8 in circle on paper plate., Heat on full power for 30 to 60 seconds, or until cheese is melted., Serve warm., Repeat with remaining chips.

title: Old Fashioned Potato Salad
directions: Place potatoes in a Dutch oven; cover with water and bring to a boil., Cook 8 minutes or until tender., Drain; place in large bowl. Add onion and next 4 ingredients; toss gently., Combine sour cream and next 5 ingredients; stir well., Pour over potato mixture; toss gently to coat., Cover and chill.

title: Kraut Slaw
directions: Mix all ingredients together and chill.

title: Potato And Chicken Salad
directions: Combine ingredients at last minute before serving.

title: 7 Layer Salad
directions: Layer ingredients in order listed:, lettuce, celery, pepper, onion and peas., Mix sugar and Miracle Whip together and spread over top layer., Then sprinkle cheese and bacon bits on top., Let salad marinate for 24 hours, if desired, or serve when prepared.

title: Broccoli Bread
directions: Mix all and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Enchiladas
directions: Mix all except cheese and tortillas., Fill tortillas., Put remainder of mixture on top., Sprinkle with cheese., Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes., Serves 6 to 8.

title: Cornbread
directions: Grease medium iron skillet and warm in oven as it preheats. Mix all ingredients together., Pour into hot pan., Bake, at 425° for about 25 minutes., If you run out of eggs, you may substitute a heaping tablespoon of mayonnaise.

title: S'Mores Pie
directions: In large bowl, stir ice cream with a spoon until smooth. Spoon into crust, pressing to compact and molding slightly in center., Wrap in plastic and freeze for at least 3 hours., When ready to serve, remove plastic wrap and smooth marshmallow cream over top of ice cream., Drizzle with fudge sauce and top with mini marshmallows.

title: Hot Cocoa Mix
directions: Mix and store., Use 3 teaspoons to 1 cup boiling water.

title: Hot Chocolate
directions: Mix all together., Add 1/4 cup mix to cup of hot water., May need to add more according to taste.

title: Hash Brown Casserole
directions: Mix together 1/2 cup margarine, salt, pepper, onion, soup, sour cream and cheese., Add thawed potatoes and blend., Pour into buttered 3-quart casserole., Mix 1/4 cup melted butter and corn flakes., Put on top of mixture., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Fudge Pudding Cake
directions: In a large mixing bowl, stir together flour, 1/2 cup sugar, cocoa, baking powder and salt., Add milk, oil and vanilla; stir until smooth., Stir in nuts., Turn into a ungreased 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan., Combine the 3/4 cup sugar and the 1/4 cup cocoa; gradually stir in boiling water., Pour liquid mixture evenly over batter in pan., Bake in a 350° oven about 30 minutes or until a wooden pick inserted in the center comes out clean., Serve warm or chilled. Sprinkle with sifted powdered sugar., Serves 8.

title: No-Fuss Lasagna
directions: Heat oven to 375°., Cook ground beef in preheated large skillet over medium heat until no longer pink., Pour off drippings., Add spaghetti sauce and tomatoes with liquid to skillet., Stir and set aside., Meanwhile, combine Ricotta, egg, Parmesan and basil., Spread 2 cups beef sauce over bottom of 11 x 7-inch baking dish., Arrange 3 lasagna noodles in single layer, pressing into sauce., Spoon cheese mixture on top of noodles. Sprinkle with 1 cup Mozzarella and top with 2 cups sauce., Arrange remaining noodles in a single layer, pressing lightly into sauce. Top with remaining sauce., Spread evenly., Bake at 375° for 45 minutes or until noodles are fork-tender., Sprinkle with remaining Mozzarella; tent lightly with foil., Let stand at least 15 minutes., Makes 8 servings.

title: Chicken Romano Casserole
directions: Cook noodles and drain., Cook chicken., Roll in bread crumbs. Place in casserole and add cooked noodles., Dice cream cheese. Mix in sauces and seasonings., Pour over noodles., Bake 35 to 40 minutes in a 350° oven.

title: Garlic Cheese Bread
directions: In a mixing bowl, combine first seven ingredients. Beat until well blended. Slice bread in one inch pieces. Spread on one side of each slice of bread and place on ungreased baking sheet. Broil 4 inches from heat for 3 minutes or until cheese is melted and lightly browned.

title: Pista Kulfi
directions: In a large capacity food processor or blender, combine all the ingredients except whipped topping., Blend thoroughly 1-2 minutes. Remove blades and pour into a large bowl., Gently fold in the whipped topping.

title: Dilly Bread
directions: Soften yeast in 1/4 cup warm water; let stand 10 minutes. Combine cottage cheese, oleo, salt, sugar and baking soda., Stir. Add onion, dill, egg and softened yeast., Beat well., Add flour gradually., Cover with wet cloth., Let raise in warm place until double in bulk., Stir dough down, knead and pinch into loaf pan proportions., Let rise 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Green Rice Casserole
directions: Combine ingredients and put cheese on top., Bake in greased, covered casserole for 30 minutes.

title: Quick Broccoli Casserole
directions: Mix and melt cheese into rice and can of soup in microwave. Serve.

title: Eden Isle Breast Of Chicken
directions: Pepper, but do not salt, chicken breasts., Wrap slice of bacon around each., Place a layer of dried beef in bottom of baking dish., Place bacon wrapped breasts in dish., Cover with mixture of chicken soup, sour cream and cream cheese., Cover with foil. Place in 325° oven for 2 hours., When tender, remove foil and let brown slightly., Serve on bed of rice.

title: Teriyaki Chicken
directions: Blend all ingredients in big pot., Add chicken and cook on medium heat until chicken is fully cooked; stir often., It takes about 45 minutes., Serve with rice and tossed salad.

title: Taco Salad
directions: Tear lettuce in bite-size pieces into a large bowl., Add browned, drained and cooled hamburger., Add beans, cheese and crumbled chips., Combine mayonnaise and taco sauce; add to salad. Mix well.

title: Grandma Gregory'S Goulash
directions: Brown ground beef and diced onions., When beef and onions are brown, add spaghetti sauce, tomato paste, and diced whole tomatoes. Drain all juice from tomato can., Prepare noodles per package instructions and drain noodles., Combine with sauce and enjoy!

title: Cold Cucumber Soup
directions: Peel cucumbers and cut in small pieces., Mix together yogurt and water until smooth., Add cucumbers, garlic, salt and mint. Place some ice cubes in a bowl and refrigerate a few hours., Stir well just before serving.

title: Zucchini Bread
directions: Beat together eggs, oil and sugar., Add grated zucchini., In a large bowl mix together flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt., Add zucchini mixture and blend., Add nuts, raisins and spices., Mix well., Pour into two greased loaf pans and bake at 325° for 1 hour.

title: Split Pea Soup
directions: Rinse peas and boil with water and ham hocks., Reduce heat to a slow boil; cover and cook 45 minutes., Add to pot, cut up vegetables and seasonings., Simmer for 2 hours., After 2 hours, remove ham hocks and set them aside., Place smoked sausage in soup and cook for 1/2 hour longer over low heat.

title: Lo-Fat Triple Layer Chocolate Silk Pie
directions: In large bowl, mix cream cheese, sugar and 1 tablespoon milk with wire whisk until smooth. Gently stir in 1 1/2 cups Cool Whip; spread in bottom of crust. In 2nd bowl, stir pudding mix into remaining milk and mix well. Immediately stir in whipped topping. Spread this over cream cheese mixture.

title: Stuffed Pork Chops
directions: Place chops in baking dish., Combine bread crumbs, onion, 1/2 water, margarine and poultry seasoning., Spoon onto each chop. Cover chops with gravy made with mushroom soup and 1/3 cup water. Bake 1 hour, uncovered, at 350°., Serves 4 to 6.

title: Company Chicken Casserole
directions: Cook skinned chicken in water until tender., Remove from broth and cut into chunks., Strain broth and measure., Add water to equal amount called for to cook rice., Cook rice according to directions. While rice is cooking, saute celery in small amount oleo until partially tender., When rice is done, combine rice, chicken, celery, water chestnuts, soups, mayonnaise and onion soup mix. Pour into large flat casserole (approximately 4 quarts)., Cover with stuffing mix., Drizzle with melted oleo., Bake at 325° for 20 minutes., Remove cover and bake 20 to 25 minutes longer until golden brown and heated through., Serves 10 to 12.

title: Chocolate Quick Cake
directions: Sift all dry ingredients into 8 or 9-inch cake tin or dish. Make three indentations in dry ingredients., In first indentation, put vanilla., In second indentation, put vinegar., In third indentation, put cooking oil., Pour cold water over whole thing and mix with a fork., Bake at 325° for approximately 40 minutes. Makes 1 small cake.

title: Fruit Dip
directions: Beat all ingredients., Dip in and enjoy!

title: Breanna'S Favorite Creamy Banana Pudding
directions: In large bowl, combine sweetened condensed milk and water. Add pudding mix, beat well., Chill 5 minutes., Fold in whipped cream., Spoon 1 cup pudding mixture into 2 1/2 qt. glass serving bowl., Top with 1/3 each of the wafers, bananas and pudding. Repeat layering twice, ending with pudding., Chill., Garnish as desired., Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Sweet Pickles
directions: Dissolve and pour over cucumbers (gallon glass jar); let stand for 2 weeks. Wash off brine water and cover with cold water. Add 2 tablespoons alum powder and let stand for 24 hours. Drain off alum water. Pour vinegar to cover and add 2 teaspoons pickling spices (tied in a bag) and leave for 24 hours. Drain off vinegar and throw away. Add 3 cups sugar for 3 mornings straight. These pickles do not have to be sealed. The whole process is done in the gallon glass jar.

title: Seven Minute Frosting
directions: Combine egg, whites,, sugar, salt, water and corn syrup in top of, double, boiler., Place over rapidly boiling water, beating constantly	at high speed of electric mixer., Beat for 7 minutes or until frosting will stand in peaks., Remove from boiling water; add vanilla and beat at high speed until thick enough to spread.

title: Apple Cinnamon Burritos
directions: In heavy skillet, melt butter; add sliced apples., Fry until tender., Add sugar and cinnamon to taste., Fry until caramelized but still juicy., Spoon onto warmed flour tortillas.

title: Sweet And Sour Stew
directions: Coat meat with flour, salt and pepper. Brown in bacon drippings. Combine water, sauces, brown sugar, vinegar and 1 teaspoon salt. Stir into browned meat. Add onion., Cover and cook over low heat about 45 minutes. Add carrots and cook 45 minutes longer or until tender. Can be cooked in Dutch oven in oven at 350°.

title: Michelle'S Favorite Punch
directions: Mix together Kool-Aid, sugar and water., Stir until sugar dissolves., Add pineapple juice. Chill., When ready to serve, add ginger ale., Pour in punch bowl over an ice ring.

title: Kidney Bean Loaf
directions: Mix all ingredients well., Pack into loaf pan and bake at 325° for 1 hour.

title: Cherry Torte
directions: Mix first 4 ingredients., Cut in oleo., Spread 2/3 of mixture in a 9 x 9-inch pan., Spread 1 can of pie filling on top. Sprinkle remaining ingredients on top of pie filling., Bake 30 minutes in a 375° oven., Top with vanilla ice cream or whipped topping.

title: Fresh Apple Pound Cake
directions: Combine oil, sugar and eggs., Beat at medium speed for 3 minutes., Add vanilla., Combine dry ingredients (flour, soda, salt and cinnamon)., Add to first mixture., Fold in chopped pecans and apples., Bake in greased tube pan at 325° for 1 hour and 20 minutes.

title: Pink Fluff Salad
directions: In large bowl, mix pie filling, drained pineapple and Eagle Brand. Fold in Cool Whip and nuts. Chill.

title: Party Punch
directions: Thaw frozen juices., Pour in orange juice, lemonade and apple juice., Stir while pouring in ginger ale., Scoop on sherbet. Serve immediately., Add more sherbet later as first scoops melt.

title: Cornbread Taco Bake
directions: Brown meat; drain., Add taco seasoning, water, corn, pepper and sauce., Pour in casserole dish., Mix package of muffin mix and pour over mixture., Bake uncovered for 20 minutes., Add cheese and bake for 5 more minutes.

title: Mexican "Maze-In" Bread
directions: Mix together the corn meal, salt and soda and blend., Stir in shortening, sour cream, corn and eggs and mix well., Add chiles and cheese; stir., Pour mixture into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan and bake at 375° for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Stuffed Cherry Tomatoes
directions: Thoroughly mix together the cream cheese, bacon, celery salt and onion salt., Cut off tops of cherry tomatoes and remove pulp. Stuff with cream cheese mixture., Sprinkle tops with parsley. Chill.

title: Blueberry Crunch
directions: Sprinkle sugar over berries., Pour cake mix over pineapple, blueberries and sugar., Melt and pour margarine over cake mix. Sprinkle chopped pecans over top., Bake in a 9 x 13-inch buttered dish or pan for 45 minutes at 350°.

title: Jello Cake
directions: Buy a circle cake., Put holes in cake with a knife., Pour jello over cake and put strawberries on cake.

title: Dill Dip
directions: Mix all ingredients together and chill., Serve with raw vegetables., Makes 1 1/2 cups.

title: Chruscik(Polish Pastry)
directions: Add salt to eggs and beat until thick and lemon colored., Add sugar, butter and rum; continue to beat., Fold in flour and knead until the dough blisters., Transfer to a well floured board and knead., Cut in half and roll very thin., Cut into strips, about 4-inches long., Slit each piece in center and pull one end through the slit., Fry in hot fat (Crisco) until lightly browned., Drain on absorbent paper and sprinkle with powdered sugar., With leftover egg whites, I recommend the following recipe:

title: Sliced Baked Potatoes
directions: Peel potatoes., Cut into thin slices, but not all the way through., Use handle of spoon to prevent knife from cutting all the way., Put potatoes in baking dish and fan slightly., Sprinkle with salt and drizzle with butter., Sprinkle with herbs., Bake at 425° for about 50 minutes., Remove from oven., Sprinkle with cheeses. Bake another 10 to 15 minutes until lightly browned, cheeses are melted and potatoes are soft inside., Check with fork.

title: Shish Kabobs(Method:  Stick)
directions: Marinate beef and vegetables for at least 2 hours., (Use a plastic Ziploc bag or plastic bowl with lid., Keep cold in cooler.), Alternate items on toasting stick., Cook over the coals until done.

title: Cake Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Combine cake mix, eggs and oil; stir until well blended., Mix in chocolate chips., Spoon onto cookie sheet., Bake for 9 to 12 minutes., Makes about 5 dozen.

title: Saucy Succotash
directions: Combine corn, beans, cheese and onion., Combine mayonnaise and Worcestershire sauce., Fold into corn mixture. Turn into 1-quart casserole., Melt butter; toss with crumbs., Sprinkle over casserole. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Spoon Bread
directions: Preheat oven 350°., Grease large shallow baking dish., Combine water and milk and heat to simmer., Add: Cornmeal, salt, sugar and butter., Stir over medium heat until the mixture is thickened (about 5 minutes)., Remove from heat.

title: Delicious Dove Casserole
directions: Cook whole doves in chicken consomme until tender., Remove breasts and dice meat., Measure 4 cups and set aside., Blend 3 tablespoons butter with flour and cream. Saute bread crumbs, green pepper, onion, parsley and sage in remaining 3 tablespoons butter. Mix the sauteed ingredients, flour mixture and dove meat., Place in skillet. Add salt, pepper and sherry., Let cook gently for 25 or 30 minutes.

title: Carrot Casserole
directions: Mix and bake 45 minutes at 350°.

title: Barbecue Beef
directions: Melt butter over medium-high heat., Brown hamburger, onion and green pepper., Add remaining ingredients and simmer uncovered for 15 minutes.

title: Shrimp Dip
directions: Mix and serve with Triscuits.

title: Venison Backstrap
directions: Shell a quart and one-half of chestnuts., Put them in hot water and boil until the skins are soft, then drain the water and remove the skins., Replace the chestnuts in water, and boil until soft. Take out a few at a time, and press through a colander while hot. Season the mashed chestnuts with two tablespoonfuls of butter, two teaspoonfuls of salt and one-quarter of a teaspoon of pepper.

title: Mother'S Lifetime Recipe
directions: A heaping cup of happiness,

title: New Fruit Salad Ambrosia
directions: Mix the gelatin with the cottage cheese., Add the pineapple, marshmallows and shredded coconut., Add the whipped topping and mix well., Refrigerate overnight before serving.

title: Sweet Potato Sombreros
directions: Mash drained sweet potatoes., Mix with beaten egg, margarine, salt, brown sugar and nutmeg., Arrange slices of pineapple in a lightly greased shallow baking pan., Mound the sweet potato mixture on each slice., Brush with additional margarine, if desired., Bake at 425° for about 15 minutes.

title: Roast Beef In Crock-Pot
directions: Trim fat from roast., Place into crock-pot., Add dry soup mix, mushroom soup, tomato soup and water., (I find it easier to mix the ingredients before pouring over roast.), Turn crock-pot on high until cooking well., Turn to low and let cook 10 to 12 hours, or until desired doneness.

title: Chicken Stir-Fry
directions: Cut all vegetables into chunks., In a deep frying pan or wok, add oil, chicken and vegetables., Cook on medium high for 5 minutes., Stir occasionally., Add oregano, salt, pepper and garlic powder and simmer for 10 minutes or until chicken is thoroughly cooked., Serve over white rice and enjoy!, Serves 5.

title: Pecan Pie
directions: Mix all ingredients except for margarine and nuts., Add nuts and margarine; mix all together., Put in pie shell and bake at 325° for 30 or 35 minutes on bottom rack., Cut heat off and leave for a little while.

title: Indoor S'Mores
directions: Measure cereal into large bowl., Butter 13 x 9 x 2-inch rectangular pan., Melt only 5 cups of marshmallows, corn syrup, magarine and chocolate chips in medium saucepan over low heat, stirring constantly; remove from heat., Stir in vanilla., Pour over cereal., Mix quickly until completely coated with chocolate. Stir in 1 cup of marshmallows., Make squares by pressing mixture down into buttered rectangular pan with buttered back of spoon. Refrigerate for 1 hour., Then cut into 2-inch squares., Yields 24 squares.

title: Stuffed Bread
directions: Slice top off of the French bread; scoop out and crumble the inside bread, leaving about 1/2 to 3/4-inch shell., Brown ground beef, onion and pepper., Add all of the remaining ingredients to the crumbled bread; stuff the shell., Top with sliced American cheese; replace top of loaf., Heat in oven for about 10 minutes.

title: Sweetheart Strawberry Shortcake
directions: Combine strawberries and 1 tablespoon sugar substitute; let stand 20 minutes., Stir in strawberry spread., Cover and chill. Combine 1/2 cup flour, 1 1/2 tablespoons sugar substitute, baking powder and salt; cut in margarine with a pastry blender until crumbly., Add milk; stir just until dry ingredients are moistened. Sprinkle remaining flour over work surface.

title: Party Dip
directions: Beat all ingredients with mixer until well blended., Put in refrigerator., Best if made the day before needed.

title: Ham Loaf
directions: Mix all ingredients; shape into loaf in 9 x 5 x 3-inch long pan., Bake at 350° for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

title: Eloise'S Chocolate Pie
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Mix all above ingredients (except pie shells of course)., Melt the butter; mix well., Pour into pie shells., Bake approximately 45 minutes and you have two delicious chocolate pies., You may serve with Cool Whip, if desired.

title: Vegetable Casserole
directions: Combine beans and corn. Mix rest of ingredients (except oleo and crackers) in with vegetables. Pour into greased casserole dish. Dot with oleo. Crumble crackers on top. Bake at 350 degrees for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Watercress Salad
directions: Trim off the tough ends of the watercress and discard., Rinse the leaves and tender stems., Drain well., Put mustard, vinegar, salt and pepper in salad bowl., Blend with wire whisk., Add oil, beating with whisk., Add watercress, chopped egg and onion., Toss and serve.

title: Spiced Tea
directions: Mix all ingredients together well., Store in airtight container., Enjoy!

title: Caramel Corn
directions: Remove kernels (unpopped corn) and place corn in 2 large baking pans.

title: Quick Cherry Cheese Pie Or Fruit Dip
directions: With an electric mixer, mix lemon juice, cream cheese and marshmallow cream together until smooth. Pour into already prepared graham cracker crust and top with chilled cherry pie filling. Refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Gnocchi Pi Ricotta(Cheese Dumplings)
directions: Mix flour and Ricotta cheese. Add egg. On a lightly floured board, roll out with palm of hand a small amount to form a rope. Cut into bite size pieces. (Add more flour as needed.) Cook in salted, boiling water until gnocchi rise to the top. Drain well and serve with favorite sauce.

title: Polish Kielbasa
directions: Boil kielbasa approximately 45 minutes., Remove and let cool. Slice into approximately 1/4 inch slices., Arrange on plate and refrigerate 2 hours., Serve right off plate., Great with ketchup, mustard or your choice of topping., Also great for sandwiches on Polish bread.

title: Easy Baked Chicken Kiev
directions: Place chicken breasts, one at a time, between 2 sheets of waxed paper., With flat side of mallet, gently pound breasts until each is about 1/4 inch thick; set aside., In a rimmed plate or pie pan, combine bread crumbs, Parmesan cheese, 1 teaspoon of oregano, garlic salt and pepper; set aside.

title: Snickers
directions: Peel and dice apples., Cut Snickers in small pieces. Mix all together with Cool Whip.

title: Shrimp Scampi
directions: Clean shrimp., May leave tail on., Melt butter/margarine in frying pan., Saute garlic and shallots until clear., Add everything except parsley and shrimp., Bubble one minute., Place shrimp on broiler pan., Pour half sauce over shrimp., Broil 5 inches from heat for 3 minutes., Turn over and pour remaining sauce on shrimp and broil additional 3 minutes., Turn out onto serving dish; garnish with parsley., Serve with white rice. Instead of broiling may also just add shrimp to frying pan with sauce and cook until shrimp are done.

title: Macaroni And Cheese
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., Prepare macaroni by package directions in medium saucepan., Melt butter; stir in flour, dry mustard and salt., Gradually stir in milk; cook and stir until mixture thickens slightly and bubbles., Remove from heat., Add 1 cup of shredded cheese and stir until melted., Add macaroni.

title: Pecan Pie
directions: Mix all ingredients, except pecans. Pour into unbaked pie crust. Arrange pecans on top of filling. Bake at 350° for 50 minutes. Cool and refrigerate.

title: Pita Chips(Great With Chili Or Stews Or Dips)
directions: Cut each pocket bread into sixths., Split each triangle and place rough side up on an ungreased cookie sheet., Bake at 350° for about 10 to 15 minutes, until crisp but not brown., Makes 6 servings.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
directions: Mix together chicken, soups, stock and vegetables. Add a little pepper and poultry seasoning to taste. Add 2 to 3 tablespoons melted butter; stir together. Pour in greased 9 x 13 baking dish.

title: Cranberry Casserole
directions: Place apples, sugar and cranberries in baking dish., Mix melted oleo, sugar, oatmeal and flour together and pour over apple mixture., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Venison Parmesana For Two
directions: Saute onion in margarine in skillet until tender., Dip steaks in milk; coat with a mixture of crumbs, salt and pepper., Brown quickly in the hot skillet from which the onions have been removed. Place in a baking dish., Add tomato sauce to skillet; heat for several minutes, stirring occasionally., Add mushrooms now and pour sauce over steaks., Bake, covered, at 350° for 30 minutes., Remove from oven and sprinkle with cheese., Let stand, covered, for a few minutes to melt the cheese., Great served with rice pilaf.

title: Chocolate Macaroons
directions: Combine all ingredients; blend well., Chill for 15 minutes. Form into 1-inch balls., Place 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet., Bake at 350° for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Cereal 'N Honey Snack Mix
directions: Melt honey, butter and brown sugar in pan., Mix dry ingredients together in large bowl., Pour honey mixture over dry ingredients and stir to coat., Bake in jelly roll pans for 25 minutes at 325°., Lay out on aluminum foil to cool., Store in closed container.

title: Pumpkin Crunch
directions: Mix first 6 ingredients together and put in a 9 x 13-inch pan., Sprinkle cake mix over top, then nuts., Melt oleo and drizzle over all., Bake at 350° for 55 minutes or until knife comes out clean.

title: Cheesy Carrots
directions: Melt 1 stick butter and cheese (separately) in microwave; drain carrots and add to cheese in 1-quart casserole., Crumble bread into the melted butter., Sprinkle bread over carrots., Bake at 350° until bubbly.

title: No Bake Chocolate Cookies(Aka:  Mississippi Mud Cookies)
directions: Put sugar, cocoa, milk and margarine in a saucepan., Bring to a boil., Stir well and boil 1 minute., Turn off heat and add vanilla., Stir in remaining ingredients., Drop by teaspoon on waxed paper., Allow to set., Makes 4 to 5 dozen cookies.

title: Fruit Tray
directions: Arrange lettuce on, large, tray., Arrange fruit so that no two colors are next to each other.

title: Three Cheese Roulade
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., Grease 15 x 10-inch jelly roll pan. Line with wax paper, grease again; set aside., Lightly grease a piece of foil 15 inches long; set aside.

title: Tangy Lemon Cake
directions: Heat oven to 325°., Grease and flour a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Put all ingredients in bowl and mix well for 2 to 3 minutes., Pour into pan; bake for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Chili Tortilla Casserole
directions: Brown meat., Add tomatoes, tomato sauce and chili sauce mix. Simmer 5 minutes., Stir in corn and olives., Cut tortillas in half or quarters according to bowl size., Layer tortillas and meat in casserole bowl, ending with tortillas., Sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 400° for 15 minutes., Garnish, after baking, with lettuce and avocados.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Mix together all ingredients., Pour into a 1-quart casserole. Bake 45 minutes at 350°.

title: Old-Fashioned Wassail
directions: Tie cloves and cinnamon in a cheesecloth bag., Place spice bag and remaining ingredients in a large kettle; stir well., Bring to a boil; reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, for 15 minutes., Remove the spice bag., Yield:, 1 1/2 gallons.

title: Butter Baked Chicken And Gravy
directions: Dip chicken pieces into 1/2 cup Pet milk., Roll pieces in flour, salt and pepper., Melt 1/4 cup butter in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan., Put chicken, skin side down., Bake, uncovered, near center of 425° oven for 30 minutes., Turn chicken over., Pour mixture of 1 can cream of chicken soup, 3/4 cup Pet milk and 1/4 cup water over chicken., Bake 30 minutes longer, or until drumstick is tender when pierced., Place chicken on serving dish., Stir gravy well and serve with chicken over mashed potatoes., Serves 6.

title: Unbelievable Cookies
directions: Drop on cookie sheet., Bake 10 minutes at 325°.

title: Carefree Casserole
directions: Combine chicken, soup, mushrooms and Cheddar cheese in a 2-quart casserole dish., Add rice, mixing well., Sprinkle with potato chips and Mozzarella cheese., Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes or until cheese melts.

title: Broken Glass Cake
directions: Dissolve each of the jello flavors in 1 cup boiling water and 1/2 cup cold water., Pour into 3 (8-inch) square pans and chill until firm., Blend pineapple juice, water and sugar; bring to a boil., Add lemon jello and stir until dissolved., Chill mixture until it's consistency of unbeaten egg white., Whip this mixture, then whip the cream, then whip together., Cut the 3 jello flavors in 1/2-inch cubes and fold through the lemon mixture., Refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
directions: Mix first 6 ingredients together., Stir in apples and nuts. Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 1 hour., This is a very moist cake; should be refrigerated if there are leftovers.

title: Daiquiri Jello Mold
directions: Dissolve jellos in boiling water and add thawed lemonade and limeade., Chill until partially set., Whip until foamy., Add Cool Whip and mix well., Stir in pineapple and pour into an 8 cup mold. Refrigerate.

title: English Walnut Pie
directions: Mix all ingredients, except whipped cream, and pour into pie shell., Bake at 375° for 50 to 55 minutes, until top is crackly brown and filling just quivers when you nudge the pie plate., Cool and garnish with whipped cream and nuts.

title: Banana Split Cake
directions: Mix margarine and graham crackers and pat into 13 x 9-inch pan., Make pudding according to package directions; cool slightly. When cool, spread over graham cracker crust., Add layer of banana slices, then layer of pineapple., Cover this with Cool Whip. Sprinkle chopped pecans and cut up maraschino cherries over the top., Refrigerate overnight., Cut into squares., Serves 12 to 15.

title: Baked Creamed Potatoes
directions: Peel, dice and boil potatoes until tender., Mash potatoes, then add margarine, cream cheese, sour cream, salt and pepper. Mix until smooth and well blended., Pour into a buttered 2-quart casserole dish and bake at 400° until lightly brown., Serve.

title: Crusty Top Pound Cake
directions: Combine first 4 ingredients., Beat for 10 minutes., Add vanilla and lemon, flavoring., Beat 2 minutes longer., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Microwave Texas Brownies
directions: In a large mixing bowl, combine flour and sugar., In a microsafe dish, combine butter, shortening, coffee or water and cocoa., Microwave at High power for 2 minutes or until just boiling., Pour boiling mixture over flour mixture., Stir to blend. Add buttermilk, eggs, baking soda and vanilla., Mix well., Pour mixture into a microsafe 9 x 11- inch baking dish., Microwave at Medium-high power for 18 minutes, turning dish every 4 to 5 minutes until brownies test done., They may still appear soft on the surface.

title: Christmas Almond Bark Drops
directions: Melt almond bark in double boiler on low heat., Do not let water boil hard while melting., Have cereals, peanuts and marshmallows in big bowl., Pour melted chocolate either white or dark, over cereals., Mix., Drop by spoonfuls on waxed paper., Set, cool and store.

title: Quick Dish
directions: Place ground beef in skillet., Season with garlic powder, salt, black pepper (use quite a bit of black pepper) and chopped onion., Cook until done., Drain and add soup., Simmer until heated thoroughly., Serve on noodles.

title: Mini Cheese Cakes
directions: Combine crumbs and butter; mixing well., Line muffin pans with paper liners., Spoon graham cracker mixture into each liner. Press into bottom., Beat cream cheese until light and fluffy. Gradually add sugar., Mix well., Add egg and vanilla, beating well., Spoon into liners., Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.

title: Chicken Roll-Ups
directions: Fill, crescent rolls with chicken and cheese., Mix soup and milk., Pour over rolls and bake at 375° until brown., You can use canned ham or turkey instead of chicken.

title: Sole Neptune
directions: Butter casserole dish., Place sole on bottom. Top with crab and shrimp., Then with tomato and garlic butter., Bake at 375° for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Chicken And Bean Casserole
directions: Mix together; use only enough broth to make moist. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until bubbling.

title: Hot Crab Dip
directions: Melt butter and saute onions., Add cheese and soup., After cheese has melted, add crabmeat, salt, pepper, and Tabasco sauce. Serve in chafing dish.

title: Quiche
directions: Prick pie shell with fork and bake 5 minutes at 450°., After filling, bake 45 minutes or until brown and puffy at 350°.

title: Brownie Pie
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Grease a 9 x 1 1/4-inch pie plate., Beat all ingredients except nuts until smooth for 2 minutes in blender on high, stopping blender occasionally to stir, or 2 minutes with hand beater., Pour into pie plate., Sprinkle with nuts., Bake until knife inserted in center comes out clean, 30 to 35 minutes. Cool 5 minutes., Serve with ice cream, if desired.

title: Mackenzie'S Mexican Surprise
directions: Brown ground beef and onion., Drain., In a 9 x 13-inch casserole dish, pour Doritos first, then layer beef and onion and beans., Pour Ro-Tel over mixture., Top with cheese., Bake, uncovered, at 350° until cheese is melted, about 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 325°., Grease a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan.

title: Red Devil'S Food Cake
directions: Cream butter; slowly add sugar., Cream thoroughly., Add well beaten eggs and soda, dissolved in a little hot water, and cocoa, mixed with a little hot water., Alternately add sour milk and flour., Mix to smooth batter., Add vanilla., Bake in moderate oven 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Quick Pecan Rolls
directions: Preheat oven to 400°., Grease a 9-inch cake pan with margarine.

title: Potato Salad
directions: Cook potatoes in skins until tender., Drain and peel., Cut potatoes into bite size pieces in a large bowl., While potatoes are still warm, sprinkle with vinegar., Add celery, eggs, pepper, onion, pickle, salt and pepper., Blend mayonnaise and mustard together., With 2 forks, gently toss all ingredients., Add more mayonnaise, if needed., Avoid mashing potatoes., Cover and chill.

title: Christmas Cookies
directions: Cream together butter, sugar and eggs. In separate bowl, combine flour, salt, baking powder and baking soda. Add flour mixture gradually to butter mixture. Mix well. Add vanilla and almond extracts.

title: Chicken Salad
directions: Simmer chickens with salt until tender., Bone and chop fine. Add remaining ingredients and mix well., Chill., Serve on a lettuce leaf with green stuffed olives and small whole dill pickles.

title: Boiled Cookies
directions: Melt butter., Add sugar, milk and cocoa., Stir together. Bring to a boil and boil for 3 minutes., Remove from heat., Mix in oatmeal and any optional ingredient.

title: Green Bean Casserole
directions: Heat beans, then drain., Combine milk, soup and pepper; pour over beans., Add 1/2 can onion rings., Pour into a large, flat casserole; bake at 350° for 40 minutes., Garnish with remaining onion rings; bake 10 minutes more., Serves 6.

title: Strawberry Upside-Down Cake
