directions: Melt 1/4 cup butter in 9-inch square pan., Mix 1/2 cup butter; add 1/2 cup sugar and beat until light., Add egg and beat well. Sift flour, baking powder and salt and add to first mixture with milk, beating until smooth., Carefully spread on berries., Bake in oven (375°) about 30 minutes., Let stand 10 minutes; turn out on serving dish., Serve at once with cream if desired.

title: Mock Steak With Gravy
directions: Mix ground beef, crackers, salt and water., Form into balls and refrigerate overnight., Next day, slice meat and brown in a skillet., Place slices in covered baking dish., Mix cream of mushroom soup, flour, steak sauce and second cup of water and pour over meat., Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours. Very good.

title: Kosher Dills
directions: Pack cucumbers in jars with 2 pods of hot pepper, 1 teaspoon garlic flakes and fresh dill or 2 teaspoons dill seed., Pour hot vinegar mixture over and seal jars.

title: Apple Cake
directions: Combine sugar, oil, eggs and vanilla; add diced apples. Sift together the dry ingredients and add., This makes a stiff batter. Bake at 350° for 60 minutes.

title: Dreamy Pumpkin Pie
directions: Mix milk and pudding until smooth. Add spice and pumpkin., Mix until blended. Fold in Cool Whip., Pour into baked pie shells. Refrigerate until served.

title: Chicken Kabobs
directions: Combine first 3 ingredients., Cut chicken into 1/2-inch chunks and place in marmalade for approximately 6 to 8 hours., Wrap each chicken chunk with 1/2 slice of bacon., Thread chicken, mushrooms and onions on shish-kabob skewers alternating chicken, mushrooms and onions., Cook 30 to 35 minutes, baste while cooking with leftover marmalade.

title: Cabbage Casserole
directions: Chop cabbage in bite size pieces., Put in a 9 x 13-inch baking pan., Saute beef and onions., Put over cabbage., Mix tomato sauce, water and rice., Pour over contents., Top with kraut., Bake 20 minutes uncovered., Cover with foil and bake 1 hour and 15 minutes at 350°.

title: Frozen Cranberry Salad
directions: Combine milk and lemon juice in a large bowl., Stir in cranberry sauce, pineapple and nuts; fold in whipped topping. Spread in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish., Freeze until firm., Remove from freezer 10 minutes before cutting., Return leftovers to freezer.

title: Old-Fashioned Gingerbread And Sauce
directions: Heat oven to 325°., Grease and flour square pan, 9 x 9 x 2-inch., Measure all ingredients into large mixing bowl., Blend 1/2 minute on low speed scraping bowl constantly., Beat 3 minutes on medium speed scraping bowl occasionally., Pour into pan., Bake for 50 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean.

title: Fruit Jam
directions: Put everything except the gelatin into a pan and cook over high heat for 3 to 4 minutes stirring every so often. Now sample a little to see if it needs more sweetener. Sprinkle the gelatin ever the mixture and stir until completely dissolved.

title: Hillbilly Goulash
directions: Brown beef and onions in skillet; drain., Add Worcestershire sauce., Stir in flour and mix beef well., In large pot, cook egg noodles and drain., Add to noodles, ground beef, mixed vegetables (drained) and 1 1/2 cups tomato juice.

title: Shrimp Scampi
directions: Combine all ingredients., Cover and refrigerate 4 to 6 hours. Stir occasionally., Broil shrimp and marinate 4 to 5 inches from heat in preheated oven for 7 minutes., Then shrimp and broil another 10 minutes., Serve shrimp with the marinade., Serves 4.

title: Apple Pie
directions: Mix sugar, water, salt, flour, butter and vanilla and cook until thick., Add 1 tablespoon vinegar., Cool., Add to apples (sliced thin)., Place in pie shell and bake at 425° for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Chicken Parmesan
directions: Dip chicken breasts in egg batter; add salt and pepper., Roll in bread crumbs., Fry lightly in oil., Place in a greased baking dish., Cover with spaghetti sauce and bake at 350° for 1 hour. Put Mozzarella cheese on chicken 5 minutes before it's done.

title: Easy Peach Cobbler
directions: Slice peaches into a greased 8-inch baking dish., Add lemon juice., Mix sugar, flour and egg and crumble over top of peaches. Pour margarine over top and bake at 375° for 30 to 35 minutes or until browned and bubbling.

title: Chocolate Pie
directions: Mix well all ingredients, except butter and pie shells and Cool Whip, in a saucepan., Add the butter last and cook over medium heat until thick, stirring constantly.

title: Turkey Escallopes With Plums
directions: Pound turkey if necessary between two sheets of waxed paper to uniform thickness., Place in a large bowl., Pour the apple juice, soy sauce, sherry, garlic and thyme over the turkey and mix gently., Cover and refrigerate overnight or for 3 to 4 hours. Remove turkey and reserve the marinade., Heat butter and oil in large skillet., Quickly brown turkey on both sides., (Be careful not to overcook.), Add the plums and reserved marinade., Cover and simmer gently 10 to 15 minutes., Garnish with fresh thyme and dusting of pepper and serve.

title: Hash Brown Potato Casserole
directions: Place thawed potatoes in large bowl., Mix soup, cheese, sour cream, onion, salt and pepper., Pour mix over potatoes., Toss until coated.

title: Taco Salad
directions: Brown meat well in a large skillet. Drain. Add green pepper, onion, salt and pepper. Brown a few more minutes., Add tomatoes. Place in a large bowl in this order: lettuce, tomatoes, corn chips, hot meat mixture and hot cheese mixture.

title: Lucille'S Jello
directions: Mix about ingredients and chill until set., Top with lite Cool Whip.

title: Uncle Hollie'S Sponge Candy
directions: Combine sugar, syrup and vinegar in 2-quart bowl., Cover with plastic wrap and microwave on High 3 minutes., Stir well. Microwave, uncovered, on High 4 to 10 minutes, until thickened (300°)., Test by dropping in cold water., Remove the threads; if they bend, cook more., It is done if it is very brittle., Quickly stir in soda and mix well.

title: Country-Fried Steak And Cream Gravy
directions: Pound steak to 1/4-inch; cut into serving-size pieces. Sprinkle with seasonings., Dredge in flour; dip in milk., Dredge in flour again., Brown coated steaks in hot oil., Remove and drain., Reserve 3 tablespoons pan drippings., Add 1/4 cup flour to drippings., Cook over medium heat until bubbly, stirring constantly., Stir in 1/2 teaspoon salt and 1/4 teaspoon pepper. Add 2 cups milk, slowly cook until thick, stirring constantly. Add steak to gravy; cover, reduce heat and simmer for 25 minutes. Remove cover and cook an additional 5 minutes.

title: Cowboy Cookies(Great Family Recipe, Many Cookies To A Batch)
directions: Sift flour, soda, salt and baking powder; set aside., Blend together margarine and sugars., Add eggs and beat until fluffy. Add dry ingredients and mix well., Add oatmeal, vanilla and chips., Drop by teaspoon on cookie sheet., Bake for 10 minutes at 350°.

title: Gale Cirocco'S Broccoli And Spaghetti Soup
directions: Saute onion and garlic in butter., Pour in chicken broth and broccoli., Heat over medium burner., Add milk and Cheez Whiz., Heat on low so the milk does not curdle., Cook spaghetti separately according to box directions., Drain and add to the soup.

title: Oatmeal Nut Bread(Makes 3 Loaves)
directions: Combine 2 cups flour, salt and undissolved yeast., Heat water, milk, molasses and margarine over low heat until liquids are 120° to 130°., Add to dry ingredients; beat 2 minutes at medium speed, scraping bowl occasionally., Add eggs, oatmeal and 1 cup flour. Beat at high speed 2 minutes., Stir enough flour to make a stiff dough., Turn into floured board, knead 8 to 10 minutes., Place in greased bowl; grease top., Cover and let rise until doubled, about 1 hour., Punch down; knead in pecans., Divide into 3 equal pieces; shape into loaves., Place in 3 greased 8 1/4 x 4 1/2 x 2 1/2-inch loaf pans., Cover and let rise until doubled, about 1 hour., Bake at 400° for 30 minutes., Remove from pans; cool on wire racks.

title: Hot Chicken Salad Casserole
directions: Combine chicken, celery and nuts., Add soup, mayonnaise and eggs, mixing well., Add most of potato chips, salt and pepper. Put in greased casserole., Sprinkle with remainder of chips., Bake at 450° for 12 to 15 minutes, covered.

title: Super Cole Slaw
directions: Mix all seasonings., Add cabbage and chill thoroughly. Garnish with sliced olives., Serves 4.

title: V-8 Meat Loaf
directions: Combine meat, vegetable juice and 1 well beaten egg., Add oatmeal and mix until really moist., Add remaining ingredients. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Chicken And Noodle Casserole #1
directions: Combine noodles, soup and milk., Add chicken, broken into small pieces., Put in casserole dish, cover and bake 15 to 20 minutes at 400°., Sprinkle with cheese during last 5 minutes of baking.

title: Lady Sarah'S Doughnuts(My Sweet Mother)
directions: Sift together flour, nutmeg, cinnamon, baking powder, salt and baking soda., Beat eggs until thick and lemon colored; gradually beat in sugar., Add melted shortening, milk and vinegar, then add flour mixture., Mix well., Chill for a time, then turn out on floured cloth.

title: Monster Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Mix in dishpan., Drop on greased cookie sheet and flatten., Bake at 350° for 12 minutes (do not overbake). Makes 300 to 400 cookies.

title: Ratatouille Supreme(Healthy, No Fat)
directions: In nonstick skillet, saute eggplant and zucchini for 8 minutes., (Putting the lid on the skillet and stirring often will prevent sticking.), Add peppers and onion and simmer, uncovered, for another 6 minutes. Add garlic and simmer 2 minutes., Add wine, tomatoes, herbs, salt, pepper and black olives., Cook, covered, for 30 minutes over low heat until eggplant is tender. Sprinkle with parsley and serve., (Also good served over pasta or rice.)

title: Pineapple Bake
directions: Slice 5 slices of bread., Melt the butter and cook the bread in the butter., Mix the rest of the ingredients and place in a casserole., Place the bread on top., Bake 45 minutes in 350° oven.

title: Ginger Bread Boys And Girls
directions: In a large mixing bowl, cream shortening and sugar until light fluffy., Beat in egg and molasses., Add flour, soda, salt and spices., Stir until a stiff dough is formed., Wrap dough and refrigerate for 3 hours.

title: Chewy Cake
directions: Melt margarine., Mix with sugar., Add eggs and flour; mix well., Add vanilla and nuts; mix., Pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch dish., Bake at 300° for 45 minutes., Sprinkle with powdered sugar.

title: Honey-Mustard-Lime Chicken
directions: Slice chicken breasts., Combine honey, lime juice and mustard. (I use a combination of Kosciusko and a stone-ground mustard.) Place chicken in a baking dish., Pour marinade over chicken, turning to coat., Let stand for 15 to 20 minutes, turning once.

title: Party Cheese Ball
directions: Drain pineapple well., Squeeze to remove all liquid., Blend softened cream cheese with pineapple., Add other ingredients and shape into ball., Refrigerate for 1 hour., Reshape and roll in additional cup of finely chopped pecans.

title: Pound Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients together in a large bowl well., Pour into a large Bundt cake pan., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Lemon Cheese Pie(Makes 9-Inch Pie)
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Prepare crust (if needed) and press into pan., Soften cream cheese in large bowl., Beat in 3/4 cup sugar. Add eggs one at a time, beating until smooth after each one., Beat in lemon peel and juice., Pour into crust., Bake 30 minutes or until center is firm., (Do not turn oven off.), Remove from oven. Allow to stand 5 minutes., During this time, combine sour cream, 1 tablespoon sugar and vanilla., Spread over top of pie., Sprinkle with nuts., Return to oven., Bake 2 minutes or until sour cream is set., Cool., Chill about 4 hours before serving.

title: Baby Food Cake
directions: Mix first 6 ingredients, then add nuts., Grease Bundt pan. Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Fruit Pizza
directions: Mix cake mix, brown sugar, pecans, margarine and eggs., Spread evenly on pizza pan and bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes., Cool. Mix container of whipped cream and softened cream cheese and spread over crust., Arrange fruit on top of filling in alternating rows of fruit., May use "Fruit Fresh" to keep fruit from turning. Chill to serve; slice like pizza.

title: Vegetable Medley
directions: Mix vegetables, water chestnuts and mayo., Pour into casserole. Top with cheese., Spread butter and crackers (mixed together) on top., Bake at 350° about 30 minutes.

title: Oven-Baked Pork Stew
directions: In a large skillet, brown meat in hot oil., Remove meat from skillet, reserving drippings., Stir flour into drippings., Stir in undrained tomatoes, garlic, bay leaf, sugar, bouillon granules, thyme, oregano, pepper sauce, 1/4 cup water and 1/2 teaspoon salt. Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly.

title: Fruit Dip
directions: Dissolve gelatin and 3/4 cup of water on medium heat until dissolved., Put in blender., Add cottage cheese until very smooth. Add cream cheese, yogurt and lemonade., Mix well for 2 minutes. Put in refrigerator for 3 hours., Eat with lots of fruit.

title: Taco Soup
directions: Brown beef in large heavy kettle; drain and add onions., Cook until onions are tender., Add remaining ingredients except cheese; simmer for 15 minutes., Ladle into bowls; top with the grated cheese. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Peanut Butter Cups
directions: Mix the finely crushed graham cracker crumbs with the powdered sugar., Add the peanut butter and melted margarine., Work with hands until smooth and soft., (If too crumbly, add a bit more margarine, but not much)., Press into a buttered 9 x 13-inch pan. Melt chocolate chips in a double boiler., Pour over mixture in pan., Refrigerate until set, about 15 minutes., Cut into squares.

title: Cabbage Pie
directions: Roll out pastry and line a 9 inch pie plate and refrigerate. Stir fry cabbage and sliced onion in butter until barely tender. Whiz cottage cheese and scallions in blender or food processor. stir into cabbage mixture along with tarragon., Salt and pepper to taste., Distribute half of cabbage in pie shell., Arrange sliced eggs on top, cover with rest of cabbage., Cover with top pastry, crimp edges., Cut 2 or 3 slashes in top and bake at 400 degrees for 15 minutes., Reduce temperature to 350 degrees and bake 20 to 25 more minutes., Crust should be lightly browned., Makes 6 servings.

title: Chocolate Pound Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 325°., Cream margarine, shortening and sugar. Add eggs, one at a time., Add sifted dry ingredients alternately with milk and vanilla., Pour into tube pan and bake for 1 hour and 25 minutes.

title: Fresh Blueberry Pie
directions: Bring berries (1 cup), 3/4 cup sugar and lemon rind to boil in saucepan., Combine remaining sugar (1/4 cup) and 1/4 cup water with cornstarch., Stir into boiling berries., Cook about 1 minute, until thickened., Cool to room temperature., Pour in other 4 cups berries, stir to coat., Pour in baked pie shell., Chill until completely set., Decorate with whipped cream or Cool Whip and a few berries.

title: Brisket
directions: Rub salt, pepper and celery salt into brisket., Lay brisket on heavy-duty foil, fat side up., Pour liquid smoke, Worcestershire sauce and lemon juice over brisket., Seal in foil and let marinate overnight., Bake for 10 hours at 225°.

title: Jarilyn'S Spiced Tea
directions: Bring 1 quart of water to a boil., Steep with 1 family size tea bag., While still hot, add sugar, cinnamon, orange juice and lemonade., Add an additional quart of either hot or cold water (more or less to taste).

title: Chicken Cacciatore
directions: Transfer chicken to plate; set aside., Add to skillet the oil, onion, salt, oregano and pepper., Brown until golden., Add chicken, tomatoes and wine or water., Bring to boil., Cover; reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes., Remove meat; keep warm., Boil sauce over high heat 3 minutes to thicken slightly., Spoon on top of chicken., Serve over rice.

title: Honey Glazed Ham
directions: Combine apple juice, allspice, cloves, ginger and cinnamon sticks., Bring to a boil., Reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes. Drizzle ham with 1/2 honey., Bake at 325° for 30 minutes., Drizzle with other 1/2 honey., Baste with apple juice mixture every 20 minutes until done.

title: Taters
directions: Melt butter in a 9 x 13-inch pan., Wash and wedge potatoes. Soak wedges in cold water for 1/2 hour., Mix together dry ingredients., Coat wedges with mixture., Place in pan on top of melted butter., Bake at 375° for 40 minutes, turning once after 20 minutes.

title: Corn Casserole
directions: Combine the first ingredient in a large bowl., Combine corn meal and all other ingredients; pour into cream-style corn., Place in an 11 x 1 1/2-inch baking dish., Bake at 350° until a knife inserted in middle comes out clean.

title: Blue Owl Restaurants Chicken Salad Pie
directions: Combine all ingredients except the cheese., Place in pie crust., Bake at 375 degrees for about 30 minutes., Top with cheddar cheese and bake an additional 10 - 15 minutes.

title: Navajo Fry Bread(For Navajo Tacos)
directions: Mix ingredients and let set for 1 hour., Take small amount of dough and knead into a ball., Roll out on a floured surface., Fry in hot oil., Top with chili, cheese, lettuce, tomato, onion, etc. Use leftover bread for dessert., It's great with honey on top.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., In a small bowl, combine flour, baking powder and salt; set aside., In large bowl, combine butter, sugar, brown sugar and vanilla., Beat at medium speed until creamy., Add egg, beat well., Turn mixer to low, gradually add flour mixture. Stir in morsels., Drop by spoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 375° for 7 to 9 minutes., Remove and cool completely. Makes 6 dozen 2 inch cookies.

title: Chocolate Mint Pie
directions: Heat chocolate and 2 tablespoons milk in saucepan over low heat., Beat sugar in cream cheese; add remaining milk, the chocolate mixture and peppermint and beat until smooth., Fold chocolate mixture into whipped topping., Spoon into crust and freeze.

title: Shrimp Scampi For Two
directions: Soak fish in buttermilk overnight or for 4 to 6 hours., Wash well, removing buttermilk., Drain on paper towels., Squeeze lemon juice over fish., Roll in mixture of cracker meal, flour and small amount of cornmeal if desired., Fry in heavy skillet (cast-iron) in enough Crisco plus 1 tablespoon butter to cover bottom of pan well.

title: Salad Dressing
directions: Pour boiling water over tomatoes, red peppers, green peppers and onion; let stand 5 minutes., Drain and add sugar, vinegar and canning salt., Mix and cook 15 minutes., Mix salad mustard with cornstarch and cook 15 minutes longer., Stir to keep from sticking., Remove from stove and add salad dressing., Stir thoroughly and put in pint jars; seal.

title: Sugar-Free Raisin Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Mix well and drop by level teaspoon on cookie sheet sprayed with Pam., Bake at 375° until golden brown, about 10 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
directions: Mix., Roll in a ball and put on pan., Cook at 350° for 12 to 14 minutes., Put a chocolate star on top.

title: Cranberry Salad
directions: Drain pineapple and reserve juice. Add water to juice to make 2 cups and heat to boiling point. Add Jell-O, pineapple and cranberry sauce; stir until cranberry sauce is completely melted. Stir in nuts and refrigerate until set.

title: Apricot Jello Salad
directions: Mix Jell-O as directed on box., After set, add pineapple and bananas., (Icing recipe follows.)

title: Mexican Fahitas
directions: Marinate steak in oil and vinegar overnight., Place a little oil in pan and saute over very high heat so meat sears., Add 2 tablespoons green peppers, salt, pepper and garlic., Cook until meat is done.

title: Blender Breakfast
directions: Put orange juice, sugar, dry milk, ice cubes and banana or strawberries in blender., Blend on high speed for 1 minute or until ice is chopped and mixture is smooth., Pour into individual glasses., Garnish with orange slices.

title: Broccoli-Cheese Soup
directions: Combine all ingredients and simmer for a few minutes. Add cheese to taste. Easy! Good!

title: Mama'S Goo-Ood Chili
directions: Cook ground chuck until brown; drain through strainer until all fat is gone., Finely crumble meat with hands, then put in 6-quart slow cooker., Add all remaining ingredients, then stir to mix thoroughly., Cook on high 2 hours, then simmer for 2 hours, then enjoy the best chili in world.

title: Open House Punch
directions: Mix all ingredients in large serving bowl, adding the 7-Up last., Add ice cubes or frozen ice ring., Serve and enjoy.

title: Candy Pizza
directions: Heat chocolate chips and condensed milk in microwave until melted., Pour over 1 cup Rice Krispies and stir to coat., Press on buttered pizza pan., Press into top the candied cherries and nuts. Drizzle melted almond bark across top or can use part of white frosting mixed with Eagle Brand.

title: Chicken Crunch
directions: Mix soup, milk, onion and parsley., Dip chicken in soup mixture and then roll in stuffing., Place in shallow baking dish. Pour butter over chicken., Bake at 350° for 1 hour, uncovered.

title: Chicken Tamale Pie
directions: Mix soup, beans, chilies, chili powder, onions and chicken in a saucepan and heat., Mix muffin mix as directed., Add 1/2 cup Cheddar cheese., Pour into casserole dish and pull up onto sides. Pour heated mixture within 1/4 inch of edge., Bake at 350° for 25 minutes., Garnish with cheese, onions and cherry tomatoes.

title: Russian Tea Mix
directions: Mix., Store in sealed jar and mix 1 to 2 tablespoons with hot water to make 1 cup.

title: Punch
directions: Mix together Kool Aid, water, sugar, frozen limeade and lemonade., Last just before serving add 7 up, ginger ale and orange sherbet.

title: Chocolate Chip Cake
directions: Mix cake mix, oil, pudding and eggs., Beat well after each egg is added., Add milk and grated chocolate and fold in chocolate chips., Bake in tube pan for 50 to 60 minutes at 350°.

title: Chicken And Rice
directions: Mix all ingredients in oblong pan, laying chicken on top. Bake at 350° for 1 hour., Turn heat to 200° until done, about 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

title: Green Chili Stew
directions: Ingredients may be increased or decreased according to taste. Go ahead!, Have it your way.

title: Chicken In Tomato Cream Sauce
directions: Sprinkle chicken with salt, pepper and nutmeg., Brown lightly in heated butter in large pan., As you turn chicken to brown second side, add onion and mushrooms around edges., Sprinkle chicken with parsley and basil., Pour in sherry., Bring to a boil and cover., Reduce heat and simmer until chicken is cooked (about 20 minutes). Transfer chicken to warm serving dish. Stir mustard into liquid in pan., Add tomatoes and cream. Bring to a boil, cook and stir until liquid is shiny, reduced and slightly thickened. Pour sauce over chicken and serve., Makes 4 servings.

title: Pumpkin Squares
directions: Mix all ingredients together in large bowl until smooth., Pour batter into baking dish., Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Cream Puffs(Diabetic)
directions: Combine water, shortening and salt., Bring to boil., Reduce to low and add flour; beat until smooth and ball clings., Remove from heat., Beat in eggs, one at a time., Beat until smooth., Drop by spoonfuls on ungreased baking sheet., Bake at 375° for 40 minutes or golden brown and almost dry., Makes 6 to 8.

title: Hot Ham Buns
directions: Mix butter, mustard, poppy seed and onion and spread on the surface of buns., Tuck a slice of ham and cheese in each bun. Arrange on a baking sheet and bake in 350° oven for 20 minutes until hot.

title: Peanut Butter Cups
directions: Cream margarine, vanilla and peanut butter together, adding powdered sugar until desired consistency is reached., Roll into 1-inch balls and place on wax paper lined cookie sheet., Melt chocolate chips and Crisco in top of double boiler; keep mixture in boiler over low heat and dip balls in chocolate., Place on wax paper to cool.

title: Baked Corn Custard
directions: Mix first 8 ingredients together and place in a shallow baking dish., Top with grated cheese., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Molasses Popcorn Balls
directions: In a 2 quart saucepan combine molasses, corn syrup and vinegar. Cook, stirring occasionally till a little mixture dropped into cold water forms a soft ball., Remove from heat, add 1 1/2 tablespoons margarine., Stir only long enough to mix., Pour over popcorn., Toss until coated., Quickly shape into 2 1/2-inch balls., Makes 10.

title: Stuffed Cherry Tomatoes
directions: Blend cream cheese, mayonnaise and salad dressing mix until smooth., Slice a thin slice off tops of tomatoes and carefully remove insides; invert on paper towel to drain., Fill with cream cheese mixture.

title: Cornbread Salad
directions: Mix together and let set overnight in refrigerator.

title: Asparagus Casserole
directions: Cut asparagus spears in pieces about 3/4 inch long and place in bottom of a casserole dish., Sprinkle with cheese and hard-boiled eggs., Cover with white sauce., Add another layer of asparagus, cheese, egg and pimento; cover with white sauce., Top with buttered bread crumbs or crumbled Ritz crackers., Bake in a moderate oven and cook until crumbs are crisp and brown, approximately 30 minutes.

title: Banana-Nut Bread
directions: Mash bananas (hands work best)., Add all other ingredients. Either grease and flour pans or spray with cooking spray., Bake in tube pan at 350° until done (45 minutes to 1 hour).

title: Potato Sausage Casserole
directions: Brown sausage; drain and set aside., Combine soup, milk, onion, salt and pepper., In a greased 2-quart casserole dish, layer half of the potatoes, half of the soup mixture and half of the sausage., Repeat ending with sausage., Cover and bake at 350° for 1 hour or until potatoes are tender., Sprinkle with cheese and return to oven, uncovered, for 2 minutes.

title: Four Layer Salad
directions: Make a bed of lettuce in the bowl., Place a layer of English peas on the lettuce, then a layer of chopped onion., Add sugar to mayonnaise and spread over onions., Top with package of shredded Cheddar cheese.

title: Mock Angel Food Cake
directions: Sift flour 5 times, then add sugar and salt., Beat egg whites with cream of tartar until about half stiff, then add baking powder., Beat until it stands in peaks., Now pour boiling water over flour and sugar and stir until well mixed., Add vanilla. Fold in egg whites until well blended., Bake in ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan in slow oven at 320°.

title: Minted Cucumber Salad
directions: Combine cucumber, onion, vinegar, sugar, salt and pepper. Toss well., Add yogurt and fresh mint., Stir well to combine. Refrigerate.

title: Peach Pear Jam
directions: Wash, peel, pit and grind or finely chop peaches, pears and cherries., Prepare jam according to directions on package of MCP Pectin for Peach Pear Jam.

title: No Bake Cookies
directions: In medium skillet, melt butter and add sugar, cocoa and milk. Bring to boil over medium heat. Stir in peanut butter until smooth. Return to boil. Remove from heat, add oatmeal uncooked. Stir until mixed well., Spoon onto wax paper and let cool.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Top with herb stuffing Pepperidge Farm. Add grated cheese on top.

title: Steamed Spinach
directions: Squeeze and dry spinach thoroughly., Melt butter and chop onion fine., Mix egg yolks with spinach and add all ingredients, except egg whites., Beat egg whites until stiff; fold into spinach.

title: Foiled Hobo Stew(Method:  Foil)
directions: Put meat for one serving on a large foil square., Add remaining ingredients., Seal foil with a double foil., Cook on hot coals for 45 to 60 minutes, turning occasionally.

title: Pound Cake
directions: Cream shortening and sugar until light and fluffy., Add eggs one at a time., Add dry ingredients alternately with milk., Add extracts., Bake in greased and floured tube pan at 325° (do not preheat oven) for 1 1/2 hours +.

title: Jello Cheese Cake
directions: Remove cream cheese from fridge., Put evaporated milk in freezer., Add 1 cup hot water to Jell-O., Place in fridge until syrupy., Whip., Add sugar and vanilla to cheese and beat., Whip evaporated milk until it peaks., Mix with cheese mixture., Add crushed pineapple, if desired., Press 1/2 of cracker mixture into a 9 x 13-inch Pyrex dish and let stand while preparing other ingredients., Sprinkle balance of crackers over top.

title: Hush Puppies
directions: In, large, bowl, mix, together	meal, flour, buttermilk, eggs, onion, sugar, garlic and paprika.	Bring 4 cups oil to a boil, in large, pot., Drop	by, teaspoonfuls, in hot oil until brown. Yield: 50 hush puppies.

title: Pizza Casserole
directions: Cook ground beef until browned, stirring to crumble., Drain. Spoon beef into an 8-inch baking dish., Top with pizza sauce and cheese., Combine biscuit mix, milk and eggs; beat until smooth. Pour mixture over casserole, covering evenly., Bake at 400° for 30 to 35 minutes., Yield:, 6 servings.

title: Melted Cheese Spread
directions: Cut up cheese., Add milk; put on medium heat until cheese is melted., Add egg and cornstarch; cook until thick., Cool., Makes a good sandwich on rye with slice of shave ham.

title: Hello Dolly Bars
directions: Melt butter in 9 x 9 x 2-inch pan., Sprinkle crumbs over butter., Add coconut, chocolate chips and nuts in layers., Pour milk over nuts., Do not stir., Bake in preheated oven at 325° for 30 minutes., Cool; cut into bars.

title: Rice And Beef Supper
directions: Mix all ingredients., Pour into a 2 1/2-quart greased, covered oven dish., Bake in a 350° oven for 1 1/2 hours or until rice is tender and liquid absorbed., Serves 4.

title: Rhubarb Crisp
directions: In an 8 x 8-inch pan, mix the first 5 ingredients., In bowl combine the next 4 ingredients., Sprinkle on top of rhubarb., Bake at 375° for 35 minutes.

title: Easy Vegetable Linguine
directions: Cook linguine as directed., Cook bacon until crisp., Drain, reserving 2 tablespoons fat., Saute onion and broccoli in fat. Crumble bacon., Combine all ingredients., Mix lightly., Serve with additional cheese., Can be served warm or cold., Makes 2 servings.

title: Split Pea Soup
directions: Rinse the dry green split peas., Pick out any stems or stones. Put peas, ham hock, onion, pepper and water in a pot., Cover and simmer 1 1/2 hours until ham hock is tender., Remove ham hock and cut meat from bone., Cut meat into small pieces., Return meat into soup., Heat to serving temperature.

title: Quiche Parmesana
directions: Place all ingredients (minus pie shell) in blender., Cover; blend at high speed at least 1 minute., Pour mixture into crust. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean., Let stand 10 minutes., Serves 6.

title: Easy Vegetable-Beef Soup
directions: Combine all ingredients., Simmer over low heat for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Dream Cake
directions: Bake cake mix as per recipe on box., While still hot, poke small holes with toothpick., Heat Jell-O up and pour over cake slowly to drain in cake., Chill completely in refrigerator until cold., Frost with whipped cream., Chill and serve.

title: Rice And Gravy
directions: Cook the rice, then meat and seasoning, then put gravy., Put the rice and gravy in the to 72 minits and it is radey.

title: Apple Cake
directions: Mix all together., Bake 1 hour to 1 1/2 hours at 350° in tube pan (Bundt pan is nice to cook this in).

title: Brownies
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Grease baking pan (9 x 13-inch)., Melt chocolate and shortening in large saucepan over low heat., Remove from heat., Mix in sugar, eggs and vanilla., Stir in remaining ingredients., Spread into pan., Bake 30 minutes or until brownies pull away from pan., Do not overbake., Cool., Cut into bars., If desired, before cutting, spread with chocolate frosting.

title: Artichoke Pie
directions: Mix basil, garlic and oil., Add tofu; blend., Mix in pine nuts., Pour into crust and top with artichoke hearts and bread crumbs., Drizzle oil on top., Bake at 375° for 25 minutes.

title: Coconut Pineapple Pie
directions: In a bowl, combine sugar and flour. Add the corn syrup, coconut, pineapple, eggs and vanilla; mix well., Pour into pastry shell. Drizzle with butter. Bake at 350° for 50 to 55 minutes or until a knife inserted near the center comes out clean. Cover loosely with foil if the top browns too quickly. Cool on a wire rack. Chill before cutting., Store in the refrigerator. Yield: 6 to 8 servings.

title: Egg-Cheese Dish(Breakfast - Brunch)
directions: Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan generously., Spread the bread cubes over bottom of pan., Sprinkle cheese cubes over bread., In bowl beat eggs., Add milk and seasonings., Mix well., Pour over cheese-bread in pan carefully., Cover with plastic or foil and place in fridge overnight., Next morning sprinkle bacon bits over mixture and bake 1 hour at 325°.

title: Peanut Butter Chocolate Bars
directions: Preheat oven to 325°., In blender, grind cookies up fine., Add melted butter and mix., Press into 8 x 8-inch pan., Bake 10 minutes., Cool to room temperature., Melt chocolate in microwave, stirring every 30 seconds., Pour half into pan over crust., Smooth and spread over entire crust., Keep remaining chocolate warm. Blend peanut butter and butter together., Slowly beat in confectioners sugar; add vanilla., Beat., Spread over chocolate layer., Pour remaining chocolate over peanut butter layer., Chill for 1 hour., Cut into bars and serve., Very rich!

title: Granny'S Rolls
directions: Mix ingredients well., Slowly add 9 to 10 cups flour until sticky dough forms., Turn out onto greased bowl and turn to cover top with grease., Let rise until doubled., Punch down and form rolls., Place in greased pan and let rise until double., Bake at 400° until brown., Brush margarine over tops of hot rolls.

title: Crab Meat Dip
directions: Mix, chill and serve.

title: Hot Chili Sauce
directions: Wash tomatoes and dip into boiling water long enough to loosen skins,, then remove skins and core. Cut up and place in colander to, drain., Save, drained, juice, and, put in 8 quart kettle, and boil, about 30 minutes. Add other ingredients and cook, moderately fast, stirring often until sauce thickens to desired consistency (about 2 1/2 hours). Store in pint or 1/2 pint jars., This, sauce may also be served as a cocktail sauce on shrimp or oysters.

title: Jalapeno Roll-Ups
directions: Combine all filling ingredients in mixing bowl. Mix well. On each tortilla, spread about 1/2 cup mixture. Roll up tightly (jelly roll fashion). Wrap in Saran Wrap. Refrigerate at least 2 hours. Cut each tortilla into 12 slices. Makes 48.

title: Banana Nut Bread
directions: Mix well together and put into a greased loaf pan; bake at 300° until brown.

title: Spinach Souffle
directions: Thaw spinach. Mix with ingredients; pour into baking dish and bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

title: Gingerbread Cookies(50 To 60 Cookies)
directions: Combine the sugar, ginger, nutmeg, cinnamon, salt and baking soda., Mix well., Add the melted margarine, evaporated milk and molasses., Add the extracts, if desired., Mix well., Add the flour, 1 cup at a time, stirring constantly., The dough should be stiff enough to handle without sticking to fingers., Knead the dough for a smoother texture., Add up to 1/2 cup additional flour, if necessary, to prevent sticking.

title: Crunchy Jungle Cookies
directions: Cream the butter and sugars thoroughly., Add the eggs and vanilla; blend., Add the dry ingredients to the creamed mixture. Form into small balls., Bake at 350° for 10 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Low-Fat Green Chili Casserole
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Open cans of green chilies and rinse in colander with water; set aside., Take egg whites and evaporated milk; whisk until just frothy., Spray ungreased 8 x 9-inch pan with Pam or other low saturated fat oil., Put a layer of chilies, then sprinkle mixture of 2 cheeses (I use quite a bit)., Then pour 1/3 of milk and egg white mixture., This mixture does not need to cover the layer., Repeat this layering (chilies, cheese and milk mixture) until you are at the top., Pour tomato sauce on top to cover., Bake until bubbly throughout, anywhere from 20 to 30 minutes., Take out., Serve with salad and bread.

title: Indian Salmon Croquettes
directions: In large bowl, drain and pulverize salmon., Add all ingredients; mixing thoroughly., Mixture should be moist and not too chunky., Pour top olive oil into heavy iron skillet and heat over medium heat., Shape croquettes to desired size, dust with flour on both sides and cook, turning them once until golden brown on both sides, about 4 to 5 minutes., Serve hot.

title: Microwave Chicken Casserole
directions: Place chicken in 2-quart glass casserole dish with salt and pepper., Cover with water and microwave, covered, on High for 40 minutes., Saute onion, peppers, mushrooms and garlic until onion is translucent., Drain chicken, reserving liquid.

title: Greek Salad
directions: Combine oil, vinegar and seasonings; mix thoroughly., Cut up lettuce, tomatoes, cucumbers, onions and pour dressing over all. Garnish with black olives and Feta cheese.

title: Tomato Sauce
directions: Cover bottom of pot with oil and brown 3 to 4 minced garlic cloves., Add tomato sauce and the remaining spices according to taste., Brown the meat and drain fat., Add the meat and let simmer 1 hour., Serves 3 to 4., Cook until desired thickness, the longer you cook it, the thicker it gets.

title: Blueberry Salad
directions: Mix Jell-O with 2 cups hot water until dissolved., Add 1/2 cup cold water., Add blueberry pie filling and crushed pineapple. Place in refrigerator until firm., Mix Cool Whip and cream cheese together., Spread on top of congealed salad.

title: Texas Hash
directions: Saute chopped onions and peppers until tender in shortening. Add ground meat and brown., Add tomatoes, rice and seasoning., Put in covered dish and bake at 375° for about 45 minutes., Serve.

title: Sinful Potatoes
directions: Thaw hash browns., Put soup, cheese, onion and sour cream in large mixing bowl; stir together., Add potatoes and salt and pepper to taste and mix again., Pour into 10 x 13-inch pan.

title: Baked Beans
directions: Put all of the ingredients in a roasting pan., Bake at a low heat (200° to 300°) for several hours, until done.

title: Pineapple Upside Down Cake
directions: Mix margarine and brown sugar in cast iron deep fry pan on the stove., Spread evenly in bottom of pan., Remove from stove and place pineapple rings on top of mixture, placing a cherry in the center of each pineapple ring., In a large bowl, place cake mix, eggs and pineapple juice., Mix well, mixture will thick, heavy and fluffy., Spread on top of pineapple in cast iron pan., Bake at 350 degrees for 25 to 30 minutes or until cake is golden brown and a toothpick stuck in the center comes out clean., Cool cake in pan for 5 minutes then turn over onto cake plate., Best served warm.

title: Striped Pudding Cake
directions: Prepare cake as directed, baking in 9 x 13-inch pan., Remove from oven., Poke holes at once down through the cake to the pan with round handle of wooden spoon., Holes should be about 1-inch apart.

title: Bob Hope'S Favorite Chicken Hash
directions: Cut chicken in fine strips, crumble bacon and combine with the onion, butter, lemon juice and seasonings., Saute until thoroughly heated in the butter, and shortly before serving add the sherry and sour cream., Do not allow to cook after adding the last two ingredients., Just heat through.

title: Lasagna
directions: Grate large chunk of Mozzarella and Romano cheese; set aside. Brown in skillet celery, onion and ground beef., Mix in saucepan tomatoes, tomato paste, sugar, vinegar, garlic powder, salt and pepper., Add meat mixture to sauce and simmer 3 hours., Cook lasagna noodles., Spread 1/3 sauce in large baking dish., Put layer of noodles over sauce., Sprinkle cheese over noodles. Repeat and top with grated cheese., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Sift flour and salt., Beat shortening, sugars, eggs and vanilla until fluffy., Stir in flour mixture, oats and nuts., Drop by teaspoon on cookie sheet., Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Ham And Broccoli Casserole
directions: Cook broccoli until tender; drain., Spread in ungreased baking dish (13 x 9 x 2-inch)., Layer ham and cheese over broccoli., Beat remaining ingredients until smooth., Pour over cheese., Bake, uncovered, for 1 hour at 350°.

title: Lula'S Fruit Cake
directions: Mix all together and bake, in, greased	tube, pan for 4 hours at 250°., Put a pan of, water over cake and one of water under cake.

title: Fruit Dip
directions: Mix together., Chill 24 hours for thick or 3 hours for creamy smooth.

title: Broccoli Chowder
directions: Wash broccoli and remove any leaves on coarse stems., Put broccoli in kettle and add half the stock or broth., Bring to boil, reduce heat and cover., Simmer for 7 minutes or until tender., Remove broccoli from stock with slotted spoon and chop coarsely., Add remaining stock, milk, ham, salt and pepper to the stock in kettle and stir well., Bring to boil over medium heat, stirring occasionally., Stir in cream, cheese, butter and broccoli and heat until cheese is melted., Do not boil., Makes 8 servings.

title: Lemon Bars
directions: Heat oven to 350 degrees., Mix flour, butter, and powdered sugar., Press evenly in bottom of ungreased square pan (8x8x2). Bake for 20 minutes., Beat remaining ingredients about 3 minutes on medium speed or until light and fluffy., Pour over hot crust. Bake about 25 minutes longer or just until no imprint remains when touched lightly in the center., Cool., Cut into 2 inch squares.

title: Hickory Smoked Chicken
directions: Place chicken on baking sheet., Brush with melted butter. Sprinkle with seasoning., Bake in oven for 30 minutes., While chicken is baking, melt butter in saucepan with garlic over low heat., Cook for a minute., Add tomato sauce and hickory seasoning. Simmer for 10 minutes., Remove chicken from oven; brush generously with sauce., Cook 15 minutes longer., Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Mexican Chicken Casserole
directions: Combine onions, green chiles, soup, sour cream, olives and 1/4 of each cheese. Set aside 1 1/2 cups of the combine mixture. Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan. Lay each tortilla flat and put in mixture., Roll up and put rolls in pan. Cover tortillas with the remaining mixture. Sprinkle remaining cheese over the tortillas. Refrigerate overnight., Bake in oven, uncovered, at 350° for 45 minutes. Enjoy.

title: Pumpkin Muffins
directions: Beat egg slightly with fork; stir in milk, pumpkin and margarine., Blend dry ingredients and stir in until flour mixture is moistened., Batter should be lumpy., Fold in raisins., Fill greased muffin cups or paper baking cups 2/3 full., Sprinkle 1/4 teaspoon sugar over each muffin., Bake at 400° for 18 to 20 minutes., Serve hot., Makes 1 dozen.

title: Better Than Sin Cake
directions: Bake cake according to directions on box., When cake is done, poke holes in first layer and spread 1/2 of the condensed milk on top and then 1/2 of the caramel, heat the hot fudge and put 1/2 of it on the first layer, repeat process on second layer., Add cool whip on top and cherries to garnish.

title: Monteray Carrot Cake
directions: Measure into sifter the flour, salt, cinnamon, baking soda and sugar., Sift into mixing bowl and add salad oil, eggs (one at a time) and vanilla., Beat until light. Stir in carrots., Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 375° for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Zucchini With Cheese
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Spray an 8 x 8 x 2-inch casserole dish with a nonfat cooking spray., With a stiff brush, scrub zucchini well., Cut crosswise into 1/4-inch slices., In a medium bowl, combine flour and 1/2 teaspoon lite salt, 1/2 teaspoon oregano and 1/8 teaspoon pepper., Toss zucchini slices in seasoned flour to coat them well., Slowly heat liquid Butter Buds in a nonstick skillet., Saute zucchini slices until golden brown, about 4 minutes on each side., Drain on paper towels., Cover bottom of baking dish with zucchini., Top with tomato slices.

title: My Mom'S Strawberry Bread
directions: In a medium bowl, combine the first 3 ingredients., In a large bowl, combine the remaining ingredients., Grease and flour 2 (9 x 5-inch) loaf pans., Set aside., Add strawberry mixture to dry ingredients and stir until blended., Pour into pans., Bake one hour or more at 350° until toothpick comes out clean., Contains 195 calories per 1/2-inch slice.

title: Peanut Butter Crunch Cake
directions: Mix the first 3 ingredients and reserve 2/3 cup for topping (add nuts; optional)., Add oil, water and eggs to remaining batter and beat., Sprinkle topping over batter and top with chocolate chips., Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes., Use a 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: No Egg Ice Cream
directions: Add 1/2 cup sugar to fresh peaches., Blend., Add 2 cups sugar, Pet milk and apricot nectar to peaches., Mix and pour in freezer. Fill 1 gallon ice cream freezer with milk and freeze.

title: Hamburger 'N Hot Dogs
directions: In a pot, cook hamburger with garlic; drain oil., Add soup mix, onions and celery to hamburger mixture., Simmer on low heat. Chop hot dogs into bite size., Add hot dogs and Ragu sauce to hamburger mixture; set on low heat to simmer., Serves 4 to 6.

title: Apple Dumplings
directions: Roll out biscuits; fill with apples., Pinch together., Bring to a boil the butter, sugar, cinnamon and 7-Up., Pour over Apple Dumplings., Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Quick Taco Salad
directions: In large skillet, brown ground beef and onion; drain., Remove from skillet; set aside., In same skillet, prepare Rice-A-Roni as package directs., Stir in meat mixture, salsa and chili powder; continue cooking over low heat 3 to 4 minutes or until heated through., Arrange lettuce on serving platter or bowl., Top with beef/rice mixture, tomato and cheese., Garnish or serve with tortilla chips.

title: Piroshki
directions: Remove pastry shells from package and let stand at room temperature to thaw 30 minutes.

title: Coke Roast
directions: Sprinkle roast with seasoned salt and sear in oil on all sides., Remove and blot off fat from roast., Place roast in a foil lined pan., Pour Coke and chili sauce over roast, then Worcestershire sauce., Cover loosely with foil and bake 3 hours at 325°., It will have a barbecued flavor and tastes good the next day, too.

title: Cheater'S Cheese Souffle
directions: Sprinkle the sliced chicken with 2 tablespoons flour (or put both into a bag and shake)., Heat oil in a frying pan over medium heat., Add the chicken and flour and saute until lightly browned (about 4 to 5 minutes)., Remove chicken from pan and keep warm. Combine garlic, ginger, vinegar, chicken stock, honey and soy sauce., Add to the same pan and bring to a boil; stir until thickened, fragrant and reduced by about half (about 5 minutes). Add chicken to the pan, stirring well., Sprinkle with scallions and heat through., Serve over steamed rice., Serves 4.

title: Rye Log
directions: Mix first 6 ingredients well, add corned beef., Let sit overnight in refrigerator, covered.

title: Dorothy'S New England Apple-Raisin Bread
directions: Blend flour, sugar, cocoa, soda, salt and spices in a large bowl., Stir together buttermilk, applesauce and butter., Combine above, stirring until just moistened., Fold in raisins and nuts and turn into greased and floured 6 1/2 C ring mold.

title: Lazy Man'S Chile
directions: Brown the meat with the diced onion and seasonings., Add tomato soup (do not dilute)., Add kidney beans (do not dilute). Let simmer 15 to 30 minutes.

title: Frozen Lemonade Pie
directions: Fold sweetened condensed milk and lemonade concentrate into whipped topping; spoon into crusts., Freeze until firm., Garnish, if desired.

title: Smooth Chocolate Dip
directions: Whisk ingredients in a small bowl., Makes about 3/4 cup of dip.

title: Corn Casserole
directions: Combine all ingredients; mixing well., Spread 1/2 of mixture in greased 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Cover with 1 can (4 or 5 oz.) green chilies, drained and 6 ounces shredded Cheddar cheese., Spread remaining batter over top. Bake in hot oven, 400° for 30 minutes or until browned., Makes 6 servings.

title: Easy Potato Soup
directions: Peel potatoes and cut them into small cubes with some large cubes., Put them and the soup, water and milk in a pan., Bring to a boil until potatoes are done., Season with celery seed and garlic while cooking.

title: Old-Fashion Herb Stuffing
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Place bread cubes on baking sheet; bake 10 minutes or until dry., Melt margarine in large saucepan over medium heat., Add onions, celery and carrot; cover and cook 10 minutes or until vegetables are tender., Add broth, thyme, sage, paprika and pepper; bring to a simmer., Stir in bread pieces; mix well., Remove pan from heat; set aside., Coat a 1-1/2 quart baking dish with nonstick cooking spray., Spoon stuffing into dish., Cover and bake 25 to 30 minutes or until heated through., Serves 4.

title: Escalloped Pineapple
directions: Mix eggs and sugar., Blend in milk, oleo, pineapple and bread crumbs., Pour into a well-greased casserole and bake in preheated oven for 45 minutes at 350°., Especially good served with baked ham instead of sweet potatoes.

title: Baked Custard
directions: Beat eggs slightly; add sugar (exact amount depends upon sweetness desired) and salt and stir until well mixed. Add scalded milk gradually, while stirring constantly. Add vanilla. Add nutmeg or cinnamon, if desired. Bake in 6 or 8 custard cups or 1 1/2-quart casserole. Place cups in a shallow pan containing warm water and bake in a moderate 325° oven 45 minutes for the cups and 50 to 60 minutes for casserole. Test by inserting a silver knife into center of the custard., If knife comes out clean, the custard is done.

title: Swiss Cheese Bread
directions: Trim crust from bread leaving bottom crust intact., Make diagonal cuts 1-inch apart in bread., Do not cut completely through bread into slices, but leave bottom crust intact.

title: Vegetable Potato Soup
directions: Cook first 3 ingredients in covered saucepan until tender. Mash until fluffy., Add milk; mix well., Cook remaining vegetables and salt in beef broth in covered saucepan until tender, about 15 minutes., Blend with potato mixture., Stir in black pepper and butter., Serve hot.

title: Sweet Potato Pie
directions: Combine first 3 ingredients in bowl and mix well., Add eggs 1 at a time, beating well after each addition., Stir in nutmeg, salt, milk and flavoring., Pour into pie shells., Bake at 425° for 20 minutes., Reduce temperature to 325°., Bake for 30 to 45 minutes or until pies are done.

title: Rice-A-Roni Salad
directions: Cook and cool Rice-A-Roni according to package directions. Drain liquid from marinated artichoke hearts and mix with mayonnaise., Add all ingredients and marinade to Rice-A-Roni. Garnish with artichoke hearts.

title: Corned Beef Salad
directions: Dissolve jello in hot water and cool., Mix all ingredients and chill in bowl., (A jello salad bowl is best.), Unmold salad and serve with crackers.

title: Brisket Marinate
directions: Mix together first four ingredients and put on brisket., Wrap with foil and put in refrigerator overnight., Mix Worcestershire sauce and season salt together., Pour over brisket., Rewrap and bake at 300° for 5 to 7 hours, or until tender.

title: Old Fashioned Ground Beef Soup
directions: Brown the ground chuck with onions, celery and bell pepper. Add remaining ingredients and cover with water until all vegetables are covered., Add stew mix and cook until vegetables are tender., Makes a large pot of soup that may be frozen indefinitely.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: In casserole dish, add layers of broccoli, onions, eggs and celery soup., Make a cream sauce of melted butter, flour and salt. Stir well., Add milk and cheese; blend until melted., Pour over other ingredients., Sprinkle with grated cheese or Ritz crackers. Bake at 350° until brown.

title: Barbecue Sauce
directions: Brown onion lightly in butter., Add chili sauce, water and sugar; simmer for 20 minutes., Add mustard, lemon juice, vinegar, Worcestershire, salt and garlic., Simmer until mixture is thick.

title: Rechele'S Red Beans And Rice
directions: In a large pan cook onions, green peppers and garlic in butter for about 3 minutes. Add beans, sausage, tomato sauce and worcestershire sauce, hot pepper sauce. Tabasco sauce and red pepper. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover and cook for 15 minutes. Boil rice. Serve mixture over rice.

title: Peanut Butter Balls
directions: Mix butter, sugar, peanut butter, and vanilla together. Roll into 1/2 inch balls; chill. Melt chocolate chips and dip peanut butter balls. Place on wax paper.

title: Blueberry-Oat Muffins
directions: Combine oats and sour milk in small bowl., In another bowl, combine flour, baking powder, soda, salt and brown sugar; stir well to blend., Add egg and melted margarine to oat mixture; stir well. Add oat mixture all at once to dry ingredients., Stir just until all ingredients are moistened., Gently fold in blueberries., Fill well-greased muffin cups 3/4 full., Bake at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes., Makes 12.

title: Date Skillet Cookies
directions: Cook first four ingredients for 15 minutes (medium heat) in an electric skillet., When cooked, stir in nuts, vanilla and Rice Krispies., Mix well., Let cool about 10 minutes., Roll in hand to make small balls and then roll in coconut., Put on waxed paper on cookie sheet.

title: Swiss Steak
directions: Fry steak in oil until brown., Place in roasting pan or crock-pot., Cover with remaining ingredients., Simmer at 350° for 2 hours or until tender.

title: Mango Chutney
directions: Peel and slice mangos., Salt and cover with water overnight. Strain and wash., Boil all ingredients (except sugar) until tender., Add sugar and simmer another 2 hours., Bottle and seal.

title: Macaroni And Cheese
directions: Add salt to water in large cooking pan., Bring water to a boil. Add macaroni., When water returns to boil, cook macaroni for 7 to 9 minutes., DO NOT OVERCOOK., Stir occasionally to prevent sticking. Drain in colander., Run hot water through macaroni to rinse well. Combine eggs, melted butter, milk, salt and pepper., Mix in cooked macaroni., Arrange macaroni mixture and grated cheese alternately in buttered casserole with top layer being cheese., Bake in a 325° oven for 45 to 50 minutes or until surface is golden brown and cheese is crusted., Serves 6 to 8.

title: "Sinful Pie"
directions: Mix crumbs, sugar and margarine in pie plate., Press evenly in bottom of pan., Arrange banana slices on crust., Beat cream cheese until smooth., Add milk and pudding mix., Beat until thickened. Spread over banana slices; put pineapple over this., Spread Cool Whip over pineapple., Refrigerate until ready to use.

title: Fried Squash
directions: Slice the squash into thin rounds. Dip in beaten egg then coat with the cornmeal. Fry in oil on medium heat on both sides. Drain on paper towel and salt lightly before serving.

title: Momma'S Corn Pudding
directions: Mix all ingredients; pour into buttered casserole dish., Top with several pats of butter and sprinkle with nutmeg and cinnamon. Bake at 350° for approximately 30 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Dirt Dessert
directions: You will need 1 new 8 x 10-inch flowerpot, silk flowers and candy gummy worms.

title: Sausage Balls
directions: Mix and make into soft balls. Bake at 350° for 5 minutes.

title: Vegetable Soup
directions: Put all ingredients except peas, beans and pasta in large pot. Bring to boiling; reduce heat and simmer 1 to 1 1/2 hours., Add peas, beans and pasta and cook an additional 1/2 hour or until all vegetables are tender., Add extra water during cooking if soup starts to get too thick.

title: Pepper Relish(Makes About 6 To 8 Pints)
directions: Grind and soak peppers and onions in boiling water for 15 minutes., Drain and add sugar, vinegar and salt., Bring to a boil and let simmer for 30 to 35 minutes., Seal at once., Delicious on sandwiches!

title: Goochies
directions: Line cookie sheet with tinfoil. Break crackers and place on foil., Sprinkle nuts over crackers., Boil margarine, butter and sugar for 3 minutes., Spoon over crackers., Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.

title: Golden Beef Quiche
directions: Lightly brown beef and onions., Drain off any grease., Put meat in crust., Mix undiluted soup and rest of ingredients., Pour over meat., Bake 35 to 45 minutes in 375° oven until knife inserted comes out clean.

title: Refrigerator Cookies
directions: Melt chips and peanut butter together until smooth., Add corn flakes and mix thoroughly., Drop by teaspoon on wax paper., Let harden.

title: Pixie Salad Dressing
directions: Combine ingredients until well blended.

title: Swedish Rice Pudding
directions: Cook rice according to pkg. directions.

title: Pecan Praline Ice Cream
directions: Place pecans in butter in a skillet and toast., In a separate bowl, mix all other ingredients., Mix in pecans., Pour mix into freezer, add milk to fill line., Follow ice cream manufacturers directions.

title: Corn Pudding
directions: Combine corn, milk, onions, egg, salt and pepper; mix well. Pour into pan, top with pimientos and green peppers., Stir just enough to mix., Dot top with butter and bake at 350° until done.

title: Cheesy Lasagne
directions: Melt margarine and stir in flour and salt., Cook, stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Stir in milk. Boil, stirring constantly, for 1 minute. Add Swiss cheese, Mozzarella cheese and Parmesan cheese. Cook and stir over low heat until cheeses are melted and mix remaining ingredients along with Parmesan cheese. Spread 1/4 of the cheese sauce mixture in ungreased dish. Top with 4 uncooked noodles., Spread 1 cup cottage cheese mixture over noodles. Repeat with 4 noodles, the remaining noodles and remaining cheese mixture., Sprinkle with 1/2 cup Parmesan cheese. Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes., Let stand 10 minutes before cutting.

title: Flora'S Pepper-Rice Rings And Pork Chops
directions: Heat fat., Brown chops on both sides., Place onion and pepper ring slices on each chop., Fill rings with rice., Pour (spoon) tomato juice over rice to moisten., Add seasoning., Reduce temperature (to about 240°)., Cook approximately 1 hour.

title: Southern Corn Bread
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Bake in a greased casserole dish at 350° for 50 to 55 minutes or until brown.

title: String Bean Casserole
directions: Fry bacon crisp; crumble., Saute onion in bacon drippings. Drain beans; put in casserole., Dilute soup with 1/2 can hot water., Add onion to soup and simmer 2 minutes., Pour soup and onion mixture over beans in casserole., Sprinkle bacon bits on top., Cover and bake for about 25 minutes in oven at 350°., Serves 8.

title: Corn Cheese Custard Pie
directions: Thaw pie shell for 1 minute., Mix ingredients until well blended., Pour into pie shell and bake 40 to 50 minutes at 350° until puffed and browned.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
directions: Blend soup, milk and pepper., In buttered 1 1/2-quart casserole dish, arrange alternately with potatoes, onion and sauce., Dot top with 1 tablespoon butter; sprinkle with paprika., Cover and bake at 375° for 1 hour., Uncover and bake 15 minutes more or until potatoes are done.

title: 1-2-3 Green Bean Casserole
directions: Put beans in greased casserole dish., Add soup over top and then put the onion rings on top., Bake at 325° for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Heavenly Lime Salad
directions: Dissolve gelatin in 2 cups boiling water., In a large mixing bowl, mash cream cheese., Add hot, gelatin mixture; stir until dissolved., Melt marshmallows in 1/4 cup boiling water., Add cold water and whipped cream., Beat mixture until smooth., Add pineapple and nuts., Pour into greased mold, large baking dish or individual molds.

title: Green Rice
directions: Mix together all ingredients, put into a buttered, casserole, cover and bake at 350°f. 180°c. gas mark 4 for 35-45 minutes.

title: Saucy Apple Swirl
directions: Blend sugar and cinnamon., Grease 10-inch Bundt or tube pan and dust with about 1 tablespoon of sugar-cinnamon mixture; save remainder for cake., Blend cake mix, applesauce and eggs until moistened., Beat as directed on package., Reserve 1 1/2 cups batter., Pour remaining batter into pan., Sprinkle with remaining sugar-cinnamon mixture; then top with reserved batter., Bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes or until done., Cool cake in pan, top side up, for 15 minutes., Then invert on serving plate.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
directions: Cream Crisco and sugars., Blend in egg and vanilla; mix well. Add combination of dry ingredients; mix well, then stir in chocolate morsels.

title: Punch Bowl Cake
directions: Bake chocolate cake as directed on the box and cool., Mix pudding as directions say on the box., Crush candy bars., Thaw Cool Whip.

title: Brunswick Stew
directions: Cook pork and chicken until very tender., Cut in small pieces. Mix all ingredients together and simmer 1 hour.

title: Zucchini Nut Bread
directions: Mix all ingredients., Place in loaf pans coated with vegetable cooking spray., Bake at 325° for 55 to 60 minutes., Makes 2 to 3 loaves, depending on size of pan.

title: Applesauce Fruit Cake
directions: Cream butter and sugar well; sift dry ingredients and add alternately with applesauce, mixing well., Add nuts and raisins, which have been rolled in flour., Bake in oven at 325° for 1 1/2 hours., I use a tube cake pan.

title: Barbecue Hash
directions: Cook all meat separately; only brown hamburger., Remove all fat and keep liquid., (Liquid will be used to thin hash as other ingredients may make it too thick.), Grind meat, tomatoes, potatoes and onions., Mix all ingredients. Bring to a boil, then cook very slowly until done, stirring constantly (wooden paddle good to use for stirring)., Mixture easy to stick and burn., Add liquid from cooked meats to thin as desired., Used over rice. Will freeze.

title: Banana-Chocolate Tea Bread
directions: Cream butter, gradually add sugar, beating until light and fluffy., Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition., Combine flour, cocoa, soda, salt and cinnamon; sift together., Stir flour mixture into egg mixture, blending well. Add vanilla., Stir in banana, sour cream, nuts and chocolate chips.

title: Oreo Dessert
directions: Set 1 cup Oreos grounded aside; mix melted butter and Oreos together., In 13 x 9-inch glass dish, press Oreos down., Slice ice cream long ways, 3/4-inch thick., Set in pan on top of Oreos 1 can of fudge on top of ice cream., Spread Cool Whip on top of fudge; sprinkle 1 cup Oreos on top Cool Whip., Cover with Saran Wrap. Put in freezer.

title: Batter White Bread
directions: In large mixing bowl sprinkle yeast into water; let stand a few minutes then stir until dissolved., Add 3 1/4 cups flour, sugar, salt and shortening., Blend at low speed, then beat 2 minutes at medium speed or beat by hand., Beat remaining flour in by hand. Cover and let rise until doubled, about 45 minutes., Stir batter, beating hard 1/2 minute., Spread in 2 greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pans., Let rise until doubled, about 20 minutes., Bake in moderate oven at 375° for 40 to 50 minutes.

title: Melissa'S Best Eggs
directions: Boil eggs 5 minutes., Shell eggs and wash with water., Cut eggs in half., Put egg yolks in dish and egg whites on plate., Mix egg yolks and Miracle Whip together., Spoon egg mixture into egg whites.

title: Marinated Chicken Breasts
directions: Soak chicken in mixture of remaining ingredients for several hours or overnight., Cook or grill.

title: Eggplant And Shrimp
directions: May use fresh peeled shrimp in place of canned shrimp.

title: Taco Salad
directions: Mix first 3 ingredients and refrigerate., Then mix next 3 ingredients., Toss these two parts together; at the last minute add chips and Russian dressing.

title: Rice Dressing
directions: Brown ground beef and sausage., Saute vegetables in butter until soft; do not brown., Mix veggies, rice, meat and all soups together., Bake in oven at 350° for 1 hour and 45 minutes.

title: Cream Cheese Corn
directions: Boil corn until tender., Drain., In small saucepan, melt butter, milk and cream cheese together., Blend until creamy., Add seasoned salt., Pour over corn and mix well.

title: Grandmother'S Chocolate Cake
directions: In a large mixing bowl, cream butter and sugars., Add eggs, milk and vanilla; beat well., Combine flour, cocoa, salt, baking powder and soda., Add to creamed mixture and mix well., Stir in water, mix until smooth., (Batter will be thin.), Pour into a greased and floured 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan., Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes or until cake tests done.

title: Cranberry Salad
directions: Grind rind of 1 orange., Grind oranges, apples and cranberries; mix., Add sugar., Prepare Jell-O according to directions, using 1/4 less water., Add Jell-O and nuts to the cranberry mixture; refrigerate until set., This freezes well and will keep almost indefinitely in the freezer., Serves 12.

title: Zucchini Bread
directions: Mix sugar, oil, eggs, vanilla and zucchini together., Add all other ingredients to wet mixture., Grease and flour loaf pans. Pour into loaf pans., Bake at 325° for about 1 hour.

title: Spiced Round
directions: When the hog heads have been cleaned and soaked in salt water for some days, put in a dinner pot and cook in plenty of water until very tender., Take out in another pot and with a fork, break up fine; put in some of the juices and one pint of sifted meal to a head or more if you like; return to the stove and boil a few minutes., Can use the whole head and jowl which makes it very nice., In this case, you take off all the grease that you can. Mold and fry in a hot skillet.

title: Peanut Blossoms
directions: Mix all together (except kisses)., Shape dough in balls; roll in sugar., Place on ungreased cookie sheet., Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes., When cooked, top each cookie with a candy kiss and press so cookie cracks around edges.

title: Pastichio(Baked Macaroni)
directions: Brown meat and onions slowly (will make its own grease)., When meat is browned, add garlic powder and tomato sauce, blending well., Cook macaroni just until tender., Drain and set aside., Mix eggs, margarine and milk together and set aside., Lightly butter 9 x 13-inch pan and put down a layer of macaroni, packing well., Add layer of cheese and a layer of meat., Repeat the three layers, ending with the rest of the pasta, meat and cheese., Pour egg mixture over top and, using a knife, make wide cuts in the pastichio so the egg mixture will run through pasta., Oh, so good! Bake at 350° for 1 hour., Let cool for 15 minutes before serving.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Prepare stuffing mix according to directions; set aside. Place chicken breasts in casserole., Sprinkle with salt and pepper., Place a slice of cheese on each chicken breast., Pour the undiluted chicken soup over the chicken., Place the prepared Stove Top stuffing on top., Bake, covered, at 375° for 40 minutes. Remove the lid, reduce the heat to 350° for 20 to 25 minutes more. Serves 4.

title: Fresh Salsa
directions: Mix all ingredients in a bowl and add salt and pepper to desired taste. If you desire a hot taste leave all seeds in peppers. If you desire a milder taste, cut peppers in half and take out all seeds.

title: Rum Cake
directions: Grease and flour regular tube pan or fluted tube pan., Combine cake mix, sugar, oil, eggs and sour cream., Blend with electric mixer at low speed until ingredients are moistened., Beat at medium speed 2 minutes., Stir in pecans., Pour half of batter into prepared pan., Combine cinnamon and brown sugar., Sprinkle over batter., Pour remaining batter into pan., Bake 45 minutes at 350° or until a toothpick comes out clean., Allow cake to cool 10 minutes., Meanwhile, prepare Rum Sauce, then pour over cake., Cool at least 1 1/2 hours before turning out of pan.

title: Yellow Cake With Cherries
directions: Mix together cream cheese and powdered sugar., Add prepared Dream Whip., Spread on top of prepared cake., Top cake with cherry pie filling., Enjoy!

title: Pasta With Sausage And Cream Sauce
directions: Melt butter in skillet; stir in sausage and fry until brown. Drain grease., Stir in cream, wine, 1 tablespoon parsley, nutmeg and 1/2 cup Parmesan., Simmer 3 to 4 minutes.

title: Handy Casserole
directions: Saute for 3 minutes the onion, margarine and green pepper. Brown beef, breaking up the meat as it cooks., Add salt, pepper and sugar., Stir in tomatoes, tomato sauce and water., Bring to a boil., Reduce heat; simmer 15 minutes.

title: Apricot Salad
directions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water., Cool slightly; set aside. Beat the cream cheese until smooth., Gradually add gelatin, beating well., Stir in pineapple and baby food., Fold in whipped topping., Pour mixture into a 12 x 8 x 2-inch dish., Cover; chill until firm., To serve, cut into squares and serve on lettuce. Serves 12.

title: Fabulous Ham And Cheese Souffle
directions: Grease 9 x 13-inch glass baking dish., Spread half the bread cubes evenly in dish., Add the ham and both cheeses, then cover with remaining bread cubes., Mix eggs, milk, onion, salt and mustard., Pour evenly over bread cubes and refrigerate overnight. Combine cornflakes and butter for topping., Bake at 375° for 40 minutes., Makes 10 servings.

title: Beignets(New Orleans Style Square Donuts)
directions: In large bowl, stir together 1 1/2 cups flour and yeast., In saucepan, heat milk, sugar, shortening and salt to 115° to 120°. Stir constantly., Add heated mixture to flour mixture; add egg. Beat with electric mixer on low 1/2 minute., Beat 3 minutes on high., Use spoon and stir in enough remaining flour to make a soft dough., Place dough in greased bowl, turn once to grease surface. Cover and refrigerate dough until chilled., (Chill overnight and fry for breakfast.)

title: Tex-Mex Dip
directions: Mash the avocados with the lemon juice and salt and pepper to taste., On a flat, 12-inch plate, layer and spread refried beans. Spread avocado mixture over beans., Mix the sour cream, mayonnaise and taco mix together; spread over avocado layer., Sprinkle with cheese, then olives, onions and tomato., Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Dump Cake
directions: Dump pineapple in pan., Then dump in pie filling., Then add cake, mix, and, oleo., Don't grease pan., Use a long cake pan. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: New Year'S Eve Scalloped Potatoes
directions: Mix all together and put chips on top., Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Richie'S Irish Grandmother'S Buttermilk Pancakes
directions: Mix dry ingredients., Stir in remaining ingredients until moistened., Turn pancakes when bubbles appear., Tis helpful to sift dry ingredients together., Tis better not to beat the egg., Tis best not to overstir the batter., Double the ingredients and you'll have batter good for 2 days!!

title: Poppy'S Favorite Cookies
directions: Mix cream cheese and butter until blended., Blend in yolk and vanilla., Add cake mix (dry), 1/3 at a time, mixing well after each addition., If mixer is used, add last 1/3 by hand., Cover and chill for at least 30 minutes., Heat oven to 375°., Drop by teaspoons onto ungreased baking sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes or until light brown., Cool slightly before removing from sheet.

title: Venison Soup For Crock-Pot
directions: Put everything into a 6-quart crock-pot. Fill with water to 1/2-inch of top. Cover. Cook on low 6 to 8 hours or until done. Adjust salt., Serve with hearty bread and a salad.

title: Wedding Punch
directions: Dissolve jello in boiling water., Add sugar, stir until dissolved., Add cold water., Prepare orange juice and lemonade according to package directions., Add pineapple juice., Add jello mixture., Pour into jars, cover and chill for 24 hours., Part of jello mixture may be poured into jello mold., Freeze for 24 hours. Place ice ring in punch bowl, add rest of punch.

title: South Of The Border Dip
directions: Soften cream cheese; beat it with a fork., Add salsa to taste. Use with taco chips or regular chips.

title: Polish Pork Casserole
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Boil noodles., Drain and rinse with cold water., Set aside., Brown pork and onion in pan over medium-high heat., Add 1 cup water., Cover and simmer for 30 minutes., Place cooked meat, onion and noodles into a casserole dish., Add drained kraut and stir in both cans of cream of chicken soup., Mix in bay leaves, parsley, red pepper, brown sugar, pepper and salt and top with paprika., Bake for 1 hour.

title: Mostaccioli
directions: Bring a 3-quart saucepan full of water to a boil., Add mostaccioli noodles and simmer until tender., Drain and set aside. Brown ground chuck in a skillet and drain off any grease., In a large saucepan, add tomato paste, water, sugar, salt, pepper, oregano and basil., Heat and simmer., Add browned meat mixture. Simmer the tomato-meat mixture for at least 1/2 hour., Next, add noodles and serve with Parmesan cheese and buttered garlic bread.

title: Cheese Ball
directions: Chop green onions using half of green tops., Cut beef fine or chop fine., Soften cream cheese and add onions, beef and accent. Put small amount of pecans in and keep the rest to roll cheese ball in., Mix thoroughly; then roll ball in remaining nuts. Refrigerate., Will make 2 small balls or 1 large ball.

title: Yummy Chocolate Cake
directions: Stir together flour, sugar, soda and salt., In saucepan, combine butter, water and cocoa., Cook, stirring constantly until it comes to a rolling boil., Add boiling mixture to dry ingredients and blend with electric mixer., Stir in buttermilk, eggs and vanilla., Pour into greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch or 17 x 10 x 1-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes., Leave in pan and while cake is very warm, pour warm icing over cake., Serve from pan.

title: Bird'S Nest(A Recipe From Belgium)
directions: Mix first 5 ingredients. Divide into 6 portions. Flatten and shape meat mixture around boiled eggs. Dip meat coated eggs into egg whites and bread crumbs. Deep-fry in hot oil until brown and crusty, about 3 to 5 minutes. Remove from oil and drain. Cut crosswise for 2 round nests. Spoon tomato sauce around nests. Makes 12 servings.

title: Sour Cream Cookies
directions: Combine and dip by spoon onto greased cookie sheet., Dip glass bottom in water, then sugar, and flatten cookies., Bake at 375° for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Smashing Mystery Dessert
directions: Mix and bake in a 13 x 12-inch pan at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes; do not overcook.

title: Grandma'S Cutout Cookies
directions: Mix and put in refrigerator., Next day, roll and cut out. Bake at 350° for around 8 minutes.

title: Black-Eyed Pea Delight
directions: Add black-eyed peas to onion., Cover and cook over low heat 8 to 10 minutes., Put bacon on top.

title: Light Cajun Chili
directions: Saute turkey sausage until lightly browned; spoon out the fat. Add kidney beans and tomatoes., Simmer covered for 1 hour., Can be served as is or over rice or pasta., Delicious!

title: Seafood Scampi
directions: Melt margarine in skillet on medium-high heat., Saute onion, green pepper and garlic 3 minutes., Add remaining ingredients. Stir 3 minutes., Add cooked fettucini; toss and heat through. Serves 4.

title: Pork Chops And Scalloped Potatoes
directions: Brown chops., Blend soup, sour cream, water and parsley., In casserole dish, put layers of potatoes, sauce mixture, salt and pepper., Top with chops., Cover and bake at 375° for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Steak Marinade For Barbecue
directions: Marinate meat all day or overnight, especially with a thicker cut of meat.

title: Orange Candy Cake
directions: Cream oleo, sugar and eggs, one at a time. Add flour, alternately with milk. Add candy, dates, nuts and coconut., Mix well. Mixture will be thick. Grease and flour tube pan., Bake 2 1/2 hours at 250°. While cake is still warm, add glaze while still in pan.

title: Peach Puff Pie
directions: Sift the flour, baking powder and salt together., Cream the butter and 1/2 cup of the sugar; add beaten eggs gradually and then the grated lemon rind., Add flour and milk alternately., Put peaches into the pastry shell; sprinkle the remaining 1/2 cup of sugar., Spread batter over the peaches and bake in a 375° oven for 20 minutes., Reduce the oven temperature to 350° and bake for an additional 20 minutes.

title: Pasta Salad
directions: In a colander, rinse cooked macaroni with cold water; drain well., In a large bowl, combine the pasta and salad dressing. Toss to coat., Add the cucumber, green pepper, onion and snipped parsley to the pasta mixture., Toss gently., Cover and chill for 4 to 24 hours., Before serving, stir in the cherry tomatoes., Makes 4 servings.

title: Fat-Free Chocolate Cake
directions: Sift dry ingredients into large bowl., Mix water, vinegar and vanilla., Make a "well" in dry ingredients., Add water mixture and applesauce all at once., Mix well., Grease 10 x 13-inch pan., Bake at 350°, for 35 to 45 minutes., Batter will be very thin.

title: Split Pea Soup
directions: Wash peas., Put in water to boil., Simmer 2 minutes., Remove from heat., Cover and let stand 1 hour., Add ham bone, vegetables, bay leaf and thyme., Heat to boiling., Reduce heat and simmer, covered, 2 1/2 to 3 hours or until peas are soft., Remove bone. Cut off meat and dice., Return meat to soup., Season to taste with pepper., Makes about 2 quarts.

title: Grandmother'S Large Raisin Cake
directions: Cream butter and sugar until lemon colored., Beat in eggs one at a time., Add vanilla., Sift together flour, salt and baking powder., Add to egg butter mixture., To the raisins, add the cup flour and be sure each one is coated., Put in large cake pan and cook about 3 hours between 250° and 275°.

title: Dump Cake
directions: Spray 6-inch deep oven safe pot or dish with Pam or spread margarine around dish., Layer cherry pie filling, coconut, pineapple, cake mix, pecan halves and cut up margarine over top. Bake on 350° approximately 1 hour.

title: Kidney Bean Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients; let sit overnight in the refrigerator to blend flavors.

title: Broccoli Raisin Salad
directions: Chop broccoli and onion., Fry bacon and drain, mix mayonnaise, sugar, vinegar and raisins., Combine all ingredients together and let set overnight.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients well and pour into 2 nine-inch pans., Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: 7 Layered Salad
directions: Tear the cleaned, crispy lettuce into bite-size pieces; place in glass bowl., Layer rest of the ingredients in order given., Add sugar to the mayonnaise and spread over the top as you would frosting., Top with grated cheese., Cover and refrigerate for 8 to 12 hours., At serving time, garnish with parsley and croutons. Diced ham may also be added, if desired.

title: Corn Dogs
directions: Mix, all, ingredients, and, dip boiled wieners into it. Drop into hot fat (deep) and fry until brown.

title: Sausage Casserole
directions: Fry sausage., Drain off fat., Mix onion, bell pepper and celery., Saute with sausage., Mix rice, soup mix and water.
