Bring to a boil., Cook over low heat for 30 minutes., Add sausage, onion, bell pepper and celery to rice and soup mix., Cover with plain toasted croutons., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes., Makes 2 casseroles., May use beef.

title: Cheese Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 300°., Combine graham cracker crumbs, margarine and 2 tablespoons of sugar., Pat into a 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Turkey Tetrazzini
directions: Cook spaghetti and drain., Combine gravy and next 6 ingredients., Add spaghetti and mix well., Pour into 1 1/2-quart baking dish., Sprinkle top with remaining 1/4 cup cheese and paprika., Bake at 375° for 35 minutes or until bubbly and lightly browned., Let stand 5 minutes before serving., Makes 4 servings.

title: Old-Fashioned Banana-Pineapple Cake
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Grease and flour 2 round 9-inch pans or 1 (13 x 9-inch) pan., Beat all ingredients in a large bowl on medium speed for 2 minutes., Scrape bowl occasionally., Pour into pans and bake 35 to 40 minutes or until wooden toothpick inserted comes out clean., Cool 10 minutes and remove from pans., Cool completely., Frost cake.

title: Yoo Hoo'S
directions: Mix all of the contents in a blender for about 30 seconds. Refrigerate until cool., Makes 2 drinks.

title: Sweet Potato Souffle
directions: Mix sweet potatoes, evaporated milk, sugar, eggs and margarine with electric mixer until smooth., Pour into oblong dish sprayed with Pam., Heat in 400° oven for about 15 minutes or until heated thoroughly.

title: Venison Roast With Wine Gravy
directions: Remove any white membrane surrounding roast., Place roast in a shallow dish., Combine wine, onion and seasonings; pour over roast. Cover and marinate 8 hours in refrigerator, turning meat occasionally.

title: Linguine Salad
directions: Cook linguine., Finely chop vegetables., Put 1/4 shaker of Salad Supreme into drained linguine., Add rest of shaker to Italian dressing and stir., Pour over linguine., Add vegetables and toss lightly., This is better if prepared the night before. Makes 12 to 15 servings.

title: Chicken Pie
directions: Boil onion., Cook chicken and cut into bite size pieces., Mix everything together in a 9 x 13-inch dish., Make biscuits and place on top of mixture (make biscuits very thin)., Bake at 475° until biscuits are done.

title: Special Rum Cake
directions: Before you start, check the rum to make sure the quality is good., Select a large measuring bowl, measuring cup, etc. and check the rum again., With an electric mixer, beat 1 cup butter in the fuffy bowl., Add 1 teaspoon sugar and beat., Meanwhile check the rum again., Add 3 large eggs, 2 cups fried druit and beat unitl very high., If druit sticks in beaters, pry out with a screwdriver. Taste the rum again., Add 3 cups baking powder, one pint of rum, one seaspoon of tada and one cup of pepper., Stir in 1/2 pint lemon juice and fold in the chopped buttermilk and strained nuts., Add one bablespoon of scrown sugar or whatever color you have., Check the rum again., Turn pan to 350 degrees, grease oven and pour the whole mess in., Sample rum while waiting.

title: Frozen Fruit Salad
directions: Let first 5 ingredients stand in the refrigerator for several hours., Then add 1 package of Dream Whip without vanilla, 1 cup chopped nuts and 3 cubed bananas., Fold all this together and put into paper cups placed in muffin tins., Place into freezer until firm, then you can place in Ziploc bags.

title: Nacho Cheese Dip
directions: Mix together chili and Cheez Whiz in crock-pot (small one works nice)., Stir occasionally., Serve with chips.

title: Chinese Spareribs
directions: Sprinkle ribs with garlic salt (optional)., Mix ingredients, coat, ribs on both sides and put in glass pan to marinate overnight., Fill, the bottom of a broiler pan with water, cover pan rack, with, aluminum, foil, and, put, ribs, on rack., Cover loosely with, foil,, bake at 350° for 1/2 hour per pound. Baste with sauce frequently., Towards end of cooking, remove covering foil.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Cook, spaghetti according to package directions., Drain and mix together with other ingredients. Reserve 1 cup cheese. Pour in	greased, casserole dish., Spread remaining cheese on top. Bake, at, 350°, for, about 30 minutes or until cheese is melted and lightly browned.

title: Puppy Chow
directions: Melt in microwave peanut butter, chocolate chips and one stick of margarine in a large bowl., Stir in the Rice Chex., Put into a paper bag and add little amounts of powdered sugar and shake until the Rice Chex are fully coated.

title: Instant Delite
directions: Mix flour and oleo until crumbly; press into bottom of a 13 x 9-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 15 minutes., Cool.

title: Hot 'N Spicy Mustard
directions: In a medium saucepan, slowly combine the vinegar and mustard, whisking to make a smooth mixture., Cover and refrigerate overnight., Add sugar and eggs; cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until mixture comes to a boil., Cook for about 30 seconds or a little more, until mixture coats a spoon., Remove from heat; pour into hot, sterilized jars., Cool., Cover and refrigerate., If this is stored for a long time, it may need stirring before using.

title: Pineapple Orange Congealed Salad
directions: Place pineapple in a saucepan; bring to a boil, stirring constantly., Remove from heat., Add gelatin, stirring until completely dissolved., Stir in buttermilk, coconut and pecans. Cool., Fold in whipped topping., Pour into a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan or dish., Chill until firm., Yields 15 servings.

title: Baked Lima Beans
directions: Cover limas with water and bring to a rapid boil., Stir in baking soda; water will turn green., Pour off; add fresh water. Parboil 3 times or until water boils clear., Add chopped onion, meat and pepper to taste., Do not salt until beans have cooked long enough to taste saltiness of meat., Cook until beans are tender, about 1 hour., Pour off excess stock and save for adding to leftover beans or soup., Lift tomatoes from juice in can, chop and add to beans., To about 2 quarts of cooked beans, add 2 tablespoons vinegar and 2 heaping tablespoonfuls brown sugar., Salt and season to taste., Pour into baking dish, cover with sliced ham or bacon, sprinkle with brown sugar and dot with butter., Bake 1 hour in moderate oven., Add tomato juice to excess bean stock for soup.

title: Black Bean Soup
directions: Wash beans; put in a large pot with the water or stock and 1 tablespoon oil., Cover tightly and bring to a boil, then reduce to a simmer for 2 1/2 hours or until beans are tender.

title: Chicken And Rice
directions: Dissolve bouillon cubes in boiling water., Pour into 20 x 14-inch oven cooking bag., Add rice, carrots, celery and onion. Place bag in baking pan., Evenly spread out rice mixture. Sprinkle chicken with marjoram, salt and pepper., Place on top of rice, close bag and make slit in top of bag., Bake at 350° for one hour.

title: Mora'S Good Caramel Candy
directions: Cook over low heat to 238° or soft ball stage., Pour in greased 8 x 8-inch pan; cut into squares when hard., A nicer alternative is to get the small brown candy cases from See's and plunk a spoonful into each one., This makes the candy easier to serve or to package for mailing.

title: Apple Dip
directions: Soften cheese; mix all together., Serve with thinly sliced apples.

title: No Cook Pumpkin Pie
directions: Beat together milk and pumpkin., When smooth, add vanilla pudding, pumpkin spice and cinnamon., Beat well., Fold in Cool Whip., Pour into graham cracker pie shell or regular pie shell that has already been baked and cooled.

title: Burnt Sugar Cake
directions: Grease and flour two 9-inch layer pans or 13 x 9-inch oblong pan (large tube pan works well also and is my choice).

title: Solid Chocolate Easter Eggs
directions: For each egg, prick hole in each end of egg, making it larger on the broader end., Bow out the egg., Carefully rinse out the inside of each egg., Place on wax papered cookie sheet and allow to dry in 200° oven for 1/2 hour., Melt chocolate chips (6 ounces will fill one large egg) over low heat., Place each egg in egg cup or tray., Fill with chocolate using a baby spoon and tiny funnel. It may look full and need to be gently tapped to settle chocolate down., Add more chocolate until it is genuinely full., Whip chocolate off shell and chill overnight., Decorate with paint, glitter or whatever you like., Covered with sequins is spectacular., These are a little bit of work but are a huge hit with the little ones.

title: Sweet Potato Bake
directions: Cook sweet potatoes to just tender, about 30 minutes., Drain, cool and peel., In large bowl, mash potatoes., Stir in oleo, sugar and raisins.

title: Steak(Crisp And Crusty)
directions: Put broiler pan 8 to 10-inches from heat and preheat broiler. In a shallow bowl, combine oil and mustard. Dip steaks into mixture, then into the onions, coating completely. Place steaks on a rimmed baking sheet and broil for 3 to 4 minutes on each side.

title: Texas Sheet Cake
directions: Bring first 4 ingredients to boil., Add flour and cocoa to mixture., Mix, eggs,, soda, sour cream and vanilla together and add to, mixture., Pour into 13 x 9-inch pan., Bake at 400° for 20 minutes.

title: Crock Pot Candy
directions: Put nuts in bottom of crock pot., Layer other ingredients. Cook on low 1 hour without stirring., After 1 hour stir well. Cook on low another hour., Add 2 tsp. vanilla., Drop on wax paper.

title: Watergate Salad(Serves 6 To 8)
directions: Fold dry pudding mix into the whipped topping., Use medium-size salad bowl., Add the drained pineapple., Add the miniature marshmallows., Mix well., Chill for 2 to 3 hours or overnight, if possible., Serve right away.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Break bread into pieces as if for stuffing unless you are using cubed plain stuffing pieces., Add soup, 1/2 stick melted margarine and eggs and blend well. Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan that has been greased., Sprinkle crushed potato chips and 1/2 stick margarine (or butter) over casserole. Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until set.

title: Impossible Pumpkin Pie
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Grease 10-inch pie plate., Beat all ingredients until smooth., Pour into plate., Bake until knife inserted in center comes out clean (50 to 55 minutes)., Garnish with whipped cream if desired.

title: Gravy-Baked Pork Steaks
directions: Sprinkle steaks with salt and pepper., Brown in shortening in large iron skillet; drain., Mix remaining ingredients., Pour around chops., Bake in 350° oven 45 minutes or until tender., Stir gravy., Makes 4 servings.

title: Crawfish Or Shrimp Fettuccine
directions: Saute onions, bell pepper and celery in margarine until tender., Add shrimp or crawfish., Cook 7 minutes., Add 2 cups of water., Bring to a boil., Add noodles; cook 7 minutes., Add seasoning to taste., Melt Velveeta and add the half and half to noodles.

title: Chicken Chow Mein Casserole
directions: Simmer celery, onions and chicken broth 15 to 20 minutes., Mix with chicken, soup and butter., Top with noodles and nuts., Bake 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Festive Date Balls
directions: Boil and stir margarine, sugar and dates for 3 minutes., Add Rice Krispies and pecans., Form into small balls and roll in powdered sugar.

title: Tuna Miniatures
directions: Preheat oven to 425°., Combine 1 cup of corn flake crumbs with milk., Mix in remaining ingredients., Form into 1-inch balls. Roll in remaining corn flake crumbs., Place on greased pan and bake 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Cinnamon Raisin Carrots
directions: Heat skillet and add butter or oil., Saute carrots for 10 minutes., Add juice, spices and raisins., Cover and simmer until carrots are tender and most of the juice is absorbed.

title: Peanut Brittle(Easy Microwave Recipe)
directions: In a 2-quart glass dish, combine peanuts, sugar, syrup and salt. Cover and microwave on High 4 minutes. Remove; stir. Replace cover and microwave again for 4 minutes. Add vanilla and margarine; cover and microwave for 2 minutes. Add sifted baking soda; stir swiftly and pour onto greased cookie sheet. Spread thinly; allow to cool. Break up and store in an airtight container.

title: Toffee
directions: Heat over medium heat the first 4 ingredients, stirring constantly., Cook until mixture turns amber colored and begins to emit a light smoke., (This usually takes between 10 or 15 minutes.)

title: Creamed Cabbage
directions: Cube or shred cabbage; add cubed ham, cream, flour and seasonings., Cook just until tender., You may add a little milk if more liquid is needed., Slow heat is the secret.

title: Brownies
directions: Melt chocolate and shortening over low-heat., Remove from heat, add sugar and blend., Add eggs and blend; add flour and salt and blend., Mix in nuts., Bake at 325° for 25 minutes in lightly greased pan.

title: Golden Harvest Soup
directions: In a large, heavy pan, cook onion and garlic with basil in butter until tender., Stir in golden mushroom soup and water., Add remaining ingredients., Bring to a boil., Reduce heat and cook ten minutes or until noodles are done.

title: Mock Baklava
directions: Line 2 cookie sheets with foil, place crackers on cookie sheet in single layer., Cover with layer of almonds., Heat oven to 300°., On stove: melt butter and sugar, bring to a boil., On low heat, cook for 3 minutes, stirring constantly., Use spoon to drizzle all over crackers., Bake in oven for 15 minutes., Be sure rack is set on on above center in oven., Cool on counter and cut, one at a time, carefully.

title: Mock Champagne
directions: Boil, sugar and water for 3 minutes and cool., Add rest of the, juices, and, chill., Just before serving, add chilled ginger ale., Makes 50 servings.

title: Fruit Cake
directions: Cream butter and sugar., Add beaten eggs, 3 cups flour, salt and, baking powder., Mix 1 cup flour with nuts and fruit. Mix with other ingredients., Bake 3 hours at 250°.

title: Pea Salad
directions: Combine first 4 ingredients., Pour Miracle Whip, sugar and vinegar over ingredients., Mix well., You may add additional Miracle Whip to suit your taste.

title: Vermont Country Dill Pickles
directions: Mix the ingredients and bring to a boil., Add fresh dill and 2 cloves garlic to each 1 quart pickle jar., Wash and drain pickling cucumbers and pack into jars., Pour boiling salt and vinegar solution over cukes and seal jars.

title: Cracker Dessert
directions: Beat egg whites until stiff,, adding sugar gradually., Beat in baking powder., Fold in crackers,, nuts and vanilla., Spread in greased 9 inch pie plate., Bake 40 minutes at 300°., When cool, top with peach slices and whipped cream.

title: Pizza Crust
directions: Mix together. Let rise. Spread on pizza pan, then put on your favorite toppings and bake.

title: Strawberry Pie
directions: Wash strawberries and drain., Place in crust., Pour prepared jello over strawberries., Chill in fridge., Serve with Cool Whip.

title: Shoe Peg Corn Casserole
directions: Mix well and pour into shallow casserole., Top with cheese and mixture of crumbs and butter., Sprinkle with almonds., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Christmas Cookies
directions: Cream the butter and sugar., Blend in the milk and vanilla. Stir in the flour, cherries and pecans., Form dough into two 8-inch rolls., Roll in flaked coconut, coating outside., Wrap in wax paper or plastic., Chill 2 hours., Cut into 1/4-inch thick slices., Bake at 375° for 12 minutes on ungreased sheet pan.

title: Hawaiian Coconut Pie
directions: Bring syrup and sugar to a boil in a small saucepan., Slowly pour over beaten eggs, beating constantly to blend., Add butter; stir until melted., Stir in salt, vanilla, lemon juice, cereal, coconut and milk., Pour into unbaked pie shell., Bake at 375° about 30 minutes or until top is set and lightly browned., Serve warm or cooled with or without whipped topping.

title: Easy Coffee Cake
directions: Spray Bundt pan well with Pam., Take rolls (thawed) and spread in pan., In layers, pour brown sugar, nuts, dry butterscotch pudding and melted butter over rolls., Cover with cloth and let sit out overnight., Bake the next morning for 35 minutes at 350°.

title: King Cake
directions: Put in large bowl; make a stiff mix of ingredients., Put a little oil on top., Cover; let rise overnight or until double in size., Punch down., Knead 50 times., Divide in half., Roll 1/2 as flat as you can., Spread softened cream cheese., Spread over entire area., Spread pie mix of your choice over cream mix., Fold over the sides of dough to cover pie mix., Let rise again., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes., Mix powdered sugar and small amount of milk., Spread over cake., Sprinkle toasted almonds over cake. Take remaining dough and make into rolls; let them touch each other., Rise until double., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

title: Vegetable Pizza Salad
directions: Spread crescent dough on a greased cookie sheet., Press to form crust., Bake 10 minutes at 350°.

title: Diabetic Apple Pie
directions: Pare apples and slice thin., Combine Sugar Twin, flour, spices and salt., Mix with apples., Line pie plate with pastry., Fill with apple mixture and dot with butter., Adjust top crust. Sprinkle with Sugar Twin., Bake at 400° for 50 minutes or until done.

title: Hildy'S P-Nut Brittle
directions: Mix sugar and Karo together; bring to boil over medium heat. Add peanuts when mixture reaches 270°., Continue to cook until 290°., Remove from heat., Add baking soda., Beat with wooden spoon until you reach a nice, warm, brown color., Turn out onto well-buttered cookie sheet., Let cool and break into pieces.

title: Pork Chop And Potato Bake
directions: Roll pork chops into flour; brown until golden., Cook potatoes until almost done., Put in bottom of baking dish., Mix sour cream and mushroom soup; thin with milk., Pour over potatoes.

title: Pancakes
directions: In medium bowl, mix dry ingredients., In small bowl mix eggs, oil and milk., Add to dry mixture and mix., (Batter should be lumpy.), For standard size pancakes use a 1/4 c measuring cup to pour out batter.

title: Eggplant Casserole
directions: Combine eggplant, Worcestershire sauce, salt, pepper and water. Cook on medium-high until cooked down and most of the water has evaporated., Mix butter with cracker crumbs., Spray casserole pan with Pam or lightly grease., Place 1/2-inch of cracker crumbs in baking dish. Add eggplant and crackers, leaving enough crackers for a top covering., Mix egg and milk and pour over top of casserole., Cover with foil and bake for 30 minutes. Remove foil and bake an additional 15 minutes or until golden brown.

title: No-Bake Cookies
directions: Mix milk, sugar, cocoa, and butter in saucepan., Bring to a boil and boil for two minutes., Remove from heat, add peanut butter and stir until mixed., Add vanilla and then oats., Drop by spoonfuls onto waxed paper., Cool.

title: Biscotti(Hard Almond Cookies)
directions: Cream together sugar and butter., Add eggs and vanilla., Add dry ingredients and mix until blended., Fold in almonds., Shape into a roll the same length as your cookie sheet., Flatten to 1/2 inch thick and 3 inches wide. Bake at 350° until browned., Cut into cookies at 1/2 inch intervals., Turn over and place back in oven to brown the other side.

title: Banana Nut Cake
directions: Cream sugar with shortening., Add eggs and beat well., Add pecans, soda and milk., Add flour, salt, vanilla and bananas., Mix well., Bake in loaf or layer pan at 350° about 35 minutes.

title: Eclair Cake
directions: Mix instant pudding with 3 cups milk; add Cool Whip., Layer pan with graham crackers., Spread 1/2 pudding mix over graham crackers., Layer graham crackers on top of mix., Spread remaining half of pudding on top of graham crackers., Layer graham crackers on top., Spread fudge frosting over top layer of graham crackers generously., Refrigerate several hours or overnight.

title: Seven Layer Salad
directions: Chop up 3 to 4 cups lettuce., Place in large bowl or oblong pan., Sprinkle with salt, pepper and approximately 1 teaspoon sugar., Layer with sliced hard-boiled eggs, salt and pepper. Sprinkle peas (I never use whole box)., Layer remaining lettuce. Top with bacon bits and then Cheddar cheese., Seal top of salad with mayonnaise., Decorate with scallions.

title: Dilly Beans
directions: Cook green string beans until still firm., Pack in jars., To each pint jar, add 1/4 scant teaspoon red pepper, 1 clove garlic and 1 head dill or 1/4 teaspoon dill seed., Heat vinegar, water and salt., Bring to a boil., Pour into jars., Seal.

title: Fudge Brownies
directions: Grease a 9 x 13-inch baking pan; set aside., Preheat oven to 375°., Combine chocolate chips and butter in a large saucepan. Melt over low heat, stirring constantly., Remove from heat. Combine eggs, salt and sugar; blend well., Add to chocolate mixture., Stir in flour, baking powder and vanilla until well blended., Stir in nuts, if desired., Pour into prepared pan., Bake for 25 minutes or until brownie begins to pull away from edge of pan., Let stand until cool., Cut into bars.

title: Russian Tea
directions: Combine all ingredients., Store in an airtight container., Use 2 to 3 teaspoons per cup of hot water.

title: Ambrosia Salad
directions: Combine fruits; sprinkle with lemon juice., Chill., Fold whipped cream into mayonnaise., Fold into fruit mixture., Serve on greens., Top with coconut.

title: Concentrated Tea Lemonade Base
directions: Combine lemon juice, peel and sugar, stirring until dissolved. Set aside., Pour boiling water over tea bags., Steep 15 minutes in a covered container; strain., Combine lemon juice and tea mixture., Cover tightly and refrigerate.

title: Noodle And Ham Dish
directions: Cook ham and potatoes until potatoes are almost done., Add noodles and cook for 12 to 15 minutes., Then add tomato juice and sauce and simmer until done.

title: Chili
directions: Heat 2 teaspoons olive oil in large skillet., Add meat, bell peppers, and onion., Cook over medium-high heat 5 minutes or until meat has browned., Add chili powder, cumin, and tomatoes., Cover and simmer 5 minutes., Stir in beans and heat through.

title: Surprise Peanut Butter Cookies
directions: Mix ingredients together very well until you can handle with your hands., Roll into little balls; press with fork dipped in flour., Bake about 10 minutes in 350° oven., These brown very fast on bottom, so watch them closely., Yes, these are all the ingredients.

title: Orange Sherbet Salad
directions: Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water; add sherbet and stir until blended., Add other ingredients., Fold in whipped cream last., Add 1 cup chopped nuts, if desired.

title: Simply Delicious Easy Brownies
directions: Grease a 9 x 13-inch baking pan., In a large bowl, combine ingredients in order given., Mix well and add 1 cup chopped nuts, if desired., Put in pan., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes., Check at 25 minutes, if you like brownies chewy., Frost, if desired.

title: Vegetable Souffle
directions: According to what vegetables you decide to use, blanch mixed vegetables for 3 minutes and cook squash in boiling water for 10 minutes., Drain well., In saucepan over heat, melt butter, then add flour and stir in milk., Cook until thickened., Remove from heat and set aside., Beat egg yolks until fairly stiff and add to sauce., Add seasonings and mix well., Add vegetables of choice. Beat egg whites until stiff and fold into mixture.

title: Barbecued Beef Ribs
directions: For 6:00 p.m. serving time:

title: Quick Peanut Blossoms
directions: Heat oven to 375°., Shape dough into 1-inch balls., Roll in sugar., Place 2 inches apart on an ungreased cookie sheet., Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Drop Biscuits
directions: Mix and drop by teaspoon into cupcake pans prepared with oil. Bake at 425° until light brown.

title: Chili - Wanda'S Way
directions: Soak and cook pinto beans until done, 3 to 4 hours., Brown chili grind or chuck (chili grind is better, or buy a roast and have them run it through the coarse grinder)., Brown until the red is gone., Drain fat., Saute onion and bell pepper and cook 5 minutes., Drain.

title: Italian Spaghetti Sauce
directions: *If you don't like your spaghetti hot, use a can of diced tomatoes instead of the Ro-Tel.

title: Crabmeat Appetizers
directions: Spread muffins with mixture., Set on cookie sheet and freeze. When frozen, wrap until ready to serve., Broil until bubbly., Cut into four pieces.

title: White Bean Chili
directions: Spray large nonstick skillet with cooking spray; heat over medium heat until hot., Add chicken; cook and stir until browned, breaking into pieces with fork., Remove chicken; drain fat from skillet., Add celery, onions and garlic to skillet; cook and stir over medium heat 5 to 7 minutes or until tender., Sprinkle with chili powder, cumin, allspice, cinnamon and pepper; cook and stir 1 minute., Return chicken to skillet., Stir in tomatoes with juice, beans and chicken broth; heat to a boil., Reduce heat to low and simmer, uncovered, 15 minutes.

title: Marinated Chicken Wings
directions: Marinate chicken wings anywhere from 6 to 24 hours., Remove from marinade and bake in a 350° oven for 60 minutes., You can also use marinade for pork or beef., Delicious!, Yield:, 24 wings.

title: Shrimp Creole
directions: Cook and clean shrimp., Saute veggies in butter and some water., Add tomatoes, tomato sauce, flour, sugar and spices., Add peas., Cook this all together for a few minutes, until it is well mixed, then simmer about 1/2 hour., If it seems to be getting too thin, add more flour., If it is getting too thick, add hot water. Add shrimp to mixture about 15 to 20 minutes before serving. Serve over cooked rice.

title: Skillet Beans
directions: Brown diced bacon in large skillet., Remove bits from drippings and reserve for garnish., Saute onion in bacon grease until tender., Add remaining ingredients and stir until mixture begins to boil., Reduce heat and simmer uncovered 30 minutes. Garnish with bacon before serving.

title: Barbie'S Shrimp Dip
directions: Mix together in a medium bowl all the ingredients except the cocktail sauce., Shape into a ball., Place in middle of a serving dish and cover with clear wrap., Refrigerate., To serve, pour the cocktail sauce over the ball and decorate dish with crackers.

title: Cocoa Kiss Cookies
directions: Beat butter, sugar and vanilla in large bowl until creamy. Stir together flour and cocoa; gradually add to butter mixture, beating until blended. Add pecans; beat until well blended. Refrigerate dough about 1 hour or until firm enough to handle.

title: Zucchini And Cheese Bake
directions: Trim ends of zucchini., Cook, covered, in boiling, salted water for 5 to 8 minutes., Drain and cut in half lengthwise. Scoop out centers; chop.

title: Sausage Egg Casserole
directions: In a 9 x 13 x 2-inch Pyrex, layer bread cubes, cheese, bread cubes and cheese., Top with sausage that has been fried, crumbled and drained.

title: Beef Stew
directions: Brown stew beef in oil about 5 minutes., Add water, salt, pepper, potatoes, turnip, carrots, celery, onion, bouquet sauce, bouillon cube and bay leaf., Cook over medium heat for about 1 1/2 hours or in oven at 350° for 1 1/2 hours., Mix flour and 1/2 cup water (cold)., Add to stew beef to thicken for gravy.

title: French Onion Soup
directions: Cover and cook onion in margarine in 3-quart saucepan over low heat, stirring occasionally, until tender, 20 to 30 minutes., Add beef broth, water, bay leaf, pepper and thyme., Heat to boiling and reduce heat., Cover and simmer 15 minutes., Set oven on broil and/or 550°., Place bread slices on cookie sheet., Broil with tops about 5 inches from heat until golden brown, about 1 minute. Turn; broil until golden brown., Place bread in 4 ovenproof bowls or individual casseroles., Add broth; top with Swiss cheese. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese., Place bowls on cookie sheet. Broil with cheese about 5 inches from heat just until cheese is melted and golden brown, 1 to 2 minutes., Serve with additional French bread if desired., Makes 4 servings.

title: Warm Broccoli And Cheese Dip
directions: Combine soup mix, sour cream, broccoli and 3/4 cup cheese. Pour into a 1 quart casserole dish., Top with remaining cheese. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Ritz Cracker Pie
directions: Bake pie shell., Mix sugar, water and cream of tartar, let come to boil., Drop in crackers; let boil 2 minutes., Put in pie shell. Put margarine and cinnamon on top., Bake in 350° oven and let brown.

title: Black Bean Dip
directions: Combine beans and garlic in food processor, using on-off motion until smooth (do not puree)., Transfer to bowl and stir in salsa., Serve with vegetable crudites or toasted tortilla pieces. Makes 4 servings, about 1/2 cup each.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Cook broccoli in boiling water for 5 minutes., Drain and place in baking dish., Combine soups; pour over broccoli., Sprinkle with cheese and stuffing., Pour melted butter over top., Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.

title: Henriette'S Easy French Bread
directions: Put 1 cup warm water in a large bowl., Sprinkle in 2 packages of yeast and 2 tablespoons of sugar. Let stand until yeast rises. Put remaining 1 1/2 cups of water in small pot and then add 3 tablespoons of butter, 1 level tablespoons salt and 4 tablespoons of sugar., Simmer until all ingredients are melted., Cool until lukewarm.

title: Banana Nut Bread
directions: Cream together shortening and sugar., Add eggs and beat well. Add flour to creamed mixture alternately with banana., Blend well. Stir in nuts., Pour into well-greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes, or until done., Remove from pan., Cool on rack.

title: Prime Rib And Au Jus
directions: Place whole ribeye on baking pan., Rub both sides heavily with chopped garlic., Cover both sides with black pepper, then lightly salt both sides., Bake with fat side up at 350° for 45 minutes, then lower temperature to 175° and cook for 4 hours for medium-rare, 6 hours for medium-medium well.

title: New Mexico Salsa
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Refrigerate overnight to blend flavors.

title: Toffee Squares
directions: Cream butter and brown sugar until light and fluffy., Add beaten egg yolk, vanilla and sifted flour., Spread on 12 x 17 1/2-inch cookie sheet and bake at 350°.

title: Polynesian Meatballs
directions: Combine all ingredients; shape into very small balls (scant teaspoonfuls)., Brown in shortening.

title: Chocolate Crunch Brownies
directions: In mixing bowl, cream butter, sugar and eggs., Stir in cocoa, flour, vanilla and salt., Spread into a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan., Bake at 350° for 25 minutes or until brownies test done., Cool., Spread marshmallow cream over top of cooled brownies., In small saucepan, melt peanut butter and chocolate chips over low heat, stirring constantly., Remove from heat; stir in the cocoa., Spread over marshmallow layer., Chill before cutting., Makes 3 dozen.

title: Asparagus Cheese-Rice
directions: Combine rice and cheese., Drain asparagus and reserve liquid. Add asparagus to rice and cheese., Blend together egg, mayonnaise, 3 tablespoons asparagus liquid and seasoned salt., Stir into rice mixture., Pour into a greased 1-quart casserole., Sprinkle paprika over the top., Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Beef With Dumplings
directions: Trim excess fat from roast., In Dutch oven or large skillet, slowly brown meat on all sides in hot shortening., Add next 7 ingredients., Cover., Cook slowly 2 1/2 hours or until meat is tender., Place biscuits on meat. Sprinkle with parsley., Cover tightly and steam 15 minutes or until "dumplings" are done. Remove meat (pot roast) and "dumplings" to warm platter. Make pot roast gravy if you want to., Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Fisherman'S Delight
directions: Thaw frozen fish., Clean and dry fish., Brush inside of fish with lemon juice and sprinkle with salt and pepper., Wrap each fish with bacon slices., Place fish in a hinged wire grill., Cook about 5 inches from moderate hot coals for 10 minutes., Turn and cook for 10 to 15 minutes longer or until bacon is crisp and fish flakes easily when tested with a fork., Serves 6.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Cook chicken until tender., Cool and cut into bite-size pieces. Take fat off the cooled broth, blend fat with flour, 1 teaspoon salt and pepper., Slowly add 2 cups broth and heavy cream, stirring constantly., Cook over low heat until thick., Combine cornbread crumbs, celery, 1 teaspoon salt, pepper to taste and butter. Arrange cut up chicken and dressing alternately in large casserole. Cover with sauce and bake 50 to 60 minutes at 350°.

title: Cheese Ball
directions: Mix together the cheese at room temperature., Roll in chopped parsley or paprika.

title: Chicken And Dumplings
directions: Put chicken in large pot and add about 1/2 gallon water; cook until tender., Remove chicken from broth and let cool; remove from bone., Reserve broth., Mix milk, Crisco and flour., If not thick enough, add a little more flour., Put broth on stove and add cans of chicken broth; bring to boil., Add chicken into broth., Drop dough a teaspoon at a time into broth and cook 10 minutes covered.

title: Cheese Ball
directions: Mix all ingredients. Shape into a ball. Serve with ritz crackers.

title: Snack Crackers
directions: Mix oil, dill, garlic salt and Ranch salad dressing., Pour over crackers., Mix well., Let stand for at least one hour. Store in plastic container.

title: Pink Ice
directions: Cream together the cream cheese and sugar., Stir in the strawberries, crushed pineapple and thawed topping; gently fold in bananas and walnuts., Spoon into a 9 x 13-inch pan and freeze. Let stand at room temperature for 1/2 hour before serving.

title: Seven-Up Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients together well., Bake at 375° in a loaf pan about 40 minutes, or until done.

title: Cream Of Broccoli Soup(Makes 7 Cups; Low In Cholesterol)
directions: Heat broth in large saucepan to boiling., Add broccoli, onion and garlic., Cover., Simmer for 7 to 10 minutes or until broccoli is tender., Remove from heat., Cool for 5 to 7 minutes., Puree vegetables and broth in blender or food processor until desired consistency., (Process in two or three batches if necessary.) Return to pan.

title: Cheery Cherry Vanilla Fudge(Microwave)
directions: In 2-quart glass measuring cup with handle, combine sugar, sour cream, corn syrup, butter and salt., Microwave at High for 5 minutes., Stir well until sugar dissolves., Microwave at High for 6 minutes or just until mixture reaches 236°., Let stand 15 minutes; do not stir., Add vanilla; beat until mixture starts to lose its gloss (about 6 minutes)., Stir in cherries and walnuts. Quickly pour into buttered 8 1/2 x 4 1/2-inch loaf pan., Cool and cut into squares., Makes about 1 1/2 pounds.

title: Black Magic Cake
directions: Combine flour, sugar, cocoa, soda, baking powder and salt in a large mixing bowl., Add eggs, coffee, buttermilk, oil and vanilla. Beat at medium speed for 2 minutes., (Batter will be thin.), Pour in greased and floured 13 x 9-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Potato Candy
directions: Boil potato in quarters., Smash 1 or 2 quarters on clean surface., Add sugar, a little at a time, mixing in with potato until you have a sugar/dough ball., Press ball out flat., Spread peanut butter., Roll into a roll., Refrigerate., (Use sugar like flour.), Enjoy.

title: Squash Casserole
directions: Cook squash and onion in salted water and drain. Add bread crumbs and cheese and put mixture in a baking dish. Add rest of the ingredients and bake at 375° until top starts to brown.

title: Easy Rolls
directions: Mix well and spoon into greased muffin tins., Bak at 350°.

title: Strawberry And Cream Squares
directions: Combine all ingredients, except sour cream, in a large bowl. Pour into an 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan until firm (overnight)., Spoon sour cream over top., Yields 12 servings.

title: Date Nut Cake
directions: Beat eggs, until, light., Flour dates with 1 cup flour. Beat sugar and eggs together., Add the 2 cups flour, then rest of ingredients., If, you, don't, use enough nuts, use 2 tablespoons shortening., Cook, at, 275° about 1 hour and 10 minutes if using 3 small pans., Cook longer if using large pan.

title: Steak And Oatmeal
directions: In a large skillet in a little oil, brown steak on one side. Remove steak., Mix oatmeal in oil that the steak was browned in. Add a little water, if needed. Spread oatmeal mixture on one side of steak., Put sliced onion on top of oatmeal., Fold over steak. Add more onions, Worcestershire, salt and pepper to taste on top. Put a small amount of water in pan., Cover and bake in 350° oven for 45 minutes.

title: Calico Bean Casserole
directions: Brown ground chuck and drain., Add remaining ingredients to ground chuck and place in casserole dish., Bake at 350° until bubbly, usually about 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Fudge Chewies
directions: Heat oven to 325°., In a medium bowl, combine eggs and sugar. Add chips and pecans., Drop with teaspoon onto greased cookie sheet., Bake 8 to 10 minutes., Cool before removing from cookie sheet., Makes 2 dozen chewies.

title: Peach Cobbler
directions: Mix the first 4 ingredients together until smooth., In an oblong glass pan (13 x 9-inch), cut margarine in chunks in bottom of pan., Pour in batter., Pour sliced peaches and juice evenly over batter., Bake at 325° for 45 minutes., Cool 20 to 30 minutes before serving.

title: Lo-Cal Pineapple Cake
directions: Cream together the sugar and eggs., Add pineapple., Add all dry ingredients., Stir well., Add vanilla., Pour into greased 13 x 9-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 35 minutes or until done.

title: Broccoli And Rice Casserole
directions: Saute onions and celery in oleo. Cook rice., Put in a large bowl. Add Cheez Whiz and soup., Mix well. Add broccoli., Pour in well-greased casserole and bake until broccoli is done, 30 to 45 minutes at 450°.

title: Microwave Peanut Brittle
directions: Grease baking sheet., Combine sugar, corn syrup and salt in 3-quart casserole., Stir in peanuts., Microwave on High, until light brown, for 8 to 10 minutes, stirring once., Stir in remaining ingredients until light and foamy., Spread on greased cookie sheet as thin as possible., Cool and break into pieces.

title: Laura'S Chocolate Pie
directions: Mix sugar and flour together., Stir until smooth., Add cocoa; blend well., Add all other ingredients and cook over low heat until thick., Pour into a baked pie shell., Top with meringue.

title: Clara'S Cookies
directions: Cream butter and sugars., Add eggs, vanilla and oatmeal., Mix dry ingredients (flour, salt and soda), then add to creamed mixture., Add nuts, raisins and chocolate chips., (These can be worked in by hand.), Drop by teaspoon onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350° for 7 to 10 minutes., Makes approximately 7 dozen.

title: Mother Baker'S Fruit Cake
directions: Cream butter and brown sugar well, adding well beaten eggs, flour and baking powder., Add fruit that has been mixed with a cup of the flour., Let pressure come to 5 open pet cock and cook one hour., Close and raise to 15.

title: Beef-Filled Squash
directions: Cut squash in half lengthwise; remove seeds., Bake, cut side down, in shallow pan at 350° for 45 minutes or until tender., Fry diced bacon., Add beef, onion, 1/2 teaspoon salt and dash of pepper., Cook until beef is browned., Pour off excess fat., Remove squash from shells (reserve shells)., In small mixing bowl, whip squash with 1/2 teaspoon salt; add milk as needed to make mixture fluffy., Combine with beef mixture., Return to squash shells., Top with crushed potato chips., Continue baking at 350° for 15 minutes., Makes 4 servings.

title: Cold Slaw
directions: Dip apples in 1/2 cup lemon juice to prevent browning., Mix dressing ingredients in separate bowl until blended and pour over veggies., Chill for several hours.

title: Graham Cracker Cake
directions: Cream margarine and sugar., Add the rest of the ingredients.

title: Gooey Butter Cake
directions: Mix the cake mix, 2 eggs and melted oleo together and press into 9 x 13 pan., Mix the cream cheese, 2 eggs, powdered sugar and vanilla together., Spread on top of cake mixture and bake at 350 degrees for 30 to 35 minutes until golden brown., Sprinkle with chopped nuts and reserved powdered sugar.

title: Easy Shrimp Creole
directions: In medium skillet, heat dressing and saute green pepper and onion., Stir in tomatoes with liquid and simmer, covered, 15 minutes., Add shrimp, red pepper and sugar., Simmer, covered, an additional 15 minutes or until shrimp turn pink., Serve over hot rice.

title: Blueberry Cake
directions: Combine margarine and sugars together., Add Egg Beaters and vanilla., Mix well.

title: Crock-Pot Spanish Rice
directions: Brown beef in skillet and drain off fat., Put all ingredients in crock-pot (3 1/2 or 4-quart model)., Stir thoroughly., Cover and cook on low 7 to 9 hours (high 3 hours).

title: Pizza Cups
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Brown sausage and drain. Stir in pizza sauce. Set aside. Line greased muffin pan with biscuits. Spoon sausage mixture into biscuits., Bake for 15 to 20 minutes or until brown. Add cheese on top and let it melt.

title: Fruit Punch
directions: Mix together., Cover and chill., Before serving add 1 quart carbonated water or ginger ale., Makes 10 servings.

title: Crescent 'N Sausage
directions: Heat oven to 375°., Separate crescent dough into 4 rectangles. Press perforations to seal., Brush each with margarine., Combine cheese and oregano; sprinkle over dough., Cut each rectangle crosswise to form 2 squares., Place a sausage link on each square; roll up., Cut each roll into 3 or 4 pieces., Secure each with a toothpick., Place, cut side down, on ungreased cookie sheet., Bake at 375° for 12 to 15 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Pineapple Cream Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients with spoon., Grease and flour 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Easy Lasagna
directions: Brown beef in skillet; drain fat., Add Ragu., Heat to boiling. Mix Ricotta, eggs, parsley, salt, pepper and some Parmesan cheese (save some to sprinkle on top)., Put meat sauce in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan., Put layer of noodles, 1 cup cheese mixture, meat sauce, noodles then cheese sauce., Spread remaining meat sauce on top and sprinkle the rest of Parmesan cheese., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Scalloped Eggplant
directions: Peel eggplant and dice in small cubes., Saute pepper and onion until tender., Add tomatoes, eggplant, salt and pepper; cook 15 minutes., Place in a casserole dish., Melt oleo in a skillet. Add bread crumbs and stir., Sprinkle bread crumbs over eggplant. Bake in a 350° oven for 15 minutes, or until eggplant is tender and crumbs are brown.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Boil chicken; remove bone when done., Put into casserole dish with sour cream, chicken soup and 1/2 stick butter., Stir together., Crumble the Ritz crackers on top., Add remaining butter., Bake for 35 minutes, or until golden brown, at 350°.

title: Creamy Cranberry Salad
directions: Chop cranberries; add sugar., Chill for 2 hours., Add marshmallows, pineapple and nuts., Whip cream and fold into cranberry mixture., Refrigerate or freeze., Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Sandwich Spread
directions: Grind the first 4 ingredients all together. Drain off juice. Add the salt; let set overnight. Add the water and cook 10 minutes on simmer. Drain well and rinse with water to remove salt. Mix the sugar, vinegar and mustard. Stir in vegetables and cook 12 minutes. Then mix the cornstarch with cold water. Add to vegetables and cook 3 to 5 minutes, stirring constantly. Remove from heat and let cool 10 minutes. Add the salad dressing. Stir well. Put in pint jars and seal. Hot water bath for 5 minutes.

title: Taco Casserole
directions: Cook ground beef in 10-inch skillet until brown., Drain., Stir in beans, tomato sauce, taco sauce, chili powder and garlic salt. Heat to boiling., Coarsely break chips and place in ungreased 2-quart casserole dish., Top with beef mixture, spread sour cream. Sprinkle onions, tomatoes and cheese., Cook, uncovered, in 350° oven until hot and bubbly, 20 to 30 minutes., Arrange additional tortilla chips around edge of casserole., Serve with shredded lettuce, chili peppers and taco sauce., Yields 6 servings.

title: Hot Chocolate Mix
directions: Mix thoroughly., Use 2 to 3 heaping teaspoonfuls per cup.

title: Shrimp Soup(Sopa De Camaron)
directions: Peel and devein shrimp; chop., Place shrimp, 1 cup of chicken broth and the Casera sauce in blender., Cover and blend on high speed until smooth., Heat shrimp mixture, the remaining broth, salt, saffron and pepper to boiling., Mix cornstarch and water; stir into shrimp mixture to thicken., Heat to boiling; cook and stir for 1 minute., Remove from heat., Stir in half and half. Garnish with parsley., Yields 5 cups.

title: Tortilla Appetizer Wedges
directions: In medium bowl, combine cream cheese and sour cream; mix well. Stir in chilies, onions and jalapenos., Season with salt and pepper., Spread tortilla with about 1/4 cup cream cheese mixture; top with another tortilla., Continue spreading and stacking tortillas until stack is 4 tortillas high., Top with another tortilla that has not been spread with cream cheese mixture. Make another stack with remaining 5 tortillas., Wrap tortilla stacks in plastic wrap., Refrigerate at least 1 hour., Cut each stack into 18 wedges., Arrange pinwheel fashion around cup of salsa, picante sauce or salsa verde., Makes 36 appetizer servings.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Boil chicken., Cut in bite-size pieces., Put in buttered dish., Mix soup and sour cream., Pour over chicken., Crush crackers and spread over chicken., Melt butter and spread over crackers., Bake 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Dinner Biscuits
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Spoon into small muffin tin. Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Low Calorie Yogurt Fluff
directions: Pour boiling water into blender container., Add gelatin; blend at low speed until dissolved, about 1 minute., Combine cold water and ice cubes to make 1 cup., Add to gelatin; stir until ice is almost melted, then blend in yogurt and vanilla., Chill in dessert glasses for 1 hour, or until set., Makes 5 servings., Each serving contains 35 calories.

title: Fantasy Fudge
directions: Mix sugar, butter and milk; bring to a boil., Stir constantly. Boil 5 minutes over medium heat., Stir constantly., Remove from heat; stir in chocolate pieces until melted., Add Marshmallow Creme, nuts and vanilla., Heat until well blended., Pour into greased 13 x 9-inch pan; cool and cut into squares.

title: Chocolate Fudge Candy
directions: (Optional:, Add 2 c. walnuts or pecans.)

title: Red Beans And Rice
directions: Cook beans for 1 hour over medium heat with salt, pepper and drippings., Add garlic, onion and pepper., Cook 1 hour and add sausage in 1/2-inch slices., Cook another hour., Serve over rice.

title: Crazy Beans
directions: Brown sausage., In crock-pot put sausage, beans, onion and green pepper., Mix together tomato soup, tomato paste and brown sugar., Pour into crock-pot and mix with beans., Use crock-pot on high for 1 hour, then low for 2 hours.

title: Squash Casserole
directions: Boil squash and onion together in salted water until tender. While squash is cooking, saute crushed crackers in 1/2 cup margarine until brown and crisp. Set aside. Make white sauce with 1/4 cup margarine, half and half and cornstarch. When white sauce is smooth, add Velveeta cheese cubes and heat until melted. Drain squash and place in an oblong casserole dish; pour cheese sauce over squash and top with the crackers. Bake for 25 minutes at 350°. Cover with foil for the first half of baking time to keep crackers from browning too much.

title: Cheese Ball
directions: Mix all the ingredients with enough Miracle Whip to hold together., Shape into a ball.

title: Zucchini Jam
directions: Cook zucchini 10 minutes until clear, using some of pineapple juice in the cooking., Then add 2 cups pineapple, lemon juice, sugar and box of Sure-Jell., Bring to rolling boil., Boil for 5 minutes; remove from heat, then add orange jello., Stir well; put into jars and seal.

title: Large Banana Pudding
directions: Mix milk and pudding together., Fold in sour cream and 1/2 of Cool Whip., Place layer of vanilla wafers in large dish., Then a layer of bananas, and a layer of pudding., Repeat., Top with remaining Cool Whip., Refrigerate., Will serve a lot.

title: Sopaipillas
directions: Sift flour, baking powder and salt together., Add milk., Knead the dough until it has a rubbery texture., Roll it out on a lightly floured surface until it is 1/2-inch thick., Cut into squares., Fry in oil until brown., They will puff up and cook quickly., Drain on paper towels., Dust with powdered sugar and serve with honey, if desired.

title: Holiday Cheese Ball
directions: Set aside walnuts., Using your hands, blend ingredients together., Shape into ball., Roll in chopped walnuts.

title: Hershey Bar Pie
directions: In double boiler, melt Hershey bars and marshmallows in the milk., Allow to cool., Add the whipped cream., Pour into crust and top with additional whipped cream., Chill about 4 hours.

title: Broiled Tomato With Cheese
directions: Mix the other ingredients in a small container and pour over the tomatoes., Broil the tomatoes 3 to 5 minutes or until cheese is slightly brown., Serve immediately.

title: Pumpkin Bread
directions: Mix sugar, oil, eggs, pumpkin and vanilla together., Set aside., Combine all dry ingredients and add to mix alternately with water., Add nuts., Grease and flour 3 loaf pans., Makes 3 loaves. Bake in electric oven at 325° for 1 to 1-1/2 hours or gas oven at 375°, test for doneness.

title: Maple Walnut Walkaways
directions: Soften yeast in warm water., Add flour and salt., Cut in butter and mix until blended., Roll 1/2 at a time into rectangle. Beat cream cheese, sugar, lemon and orange rind., Beat until fluffy., Spread 1/2 on each rectangle., Sprinkle walnuts., Roll as jelly roll., Place seam side down on greased cookie sheet., Slit lengthwise 3/4 of the way through., Bake at 375° for 20 to 25 minutes., Sprinkle with confectioners sugar., Slice at an angle. Makes 24 cookies.

title: Italian Avocado Dip
directions: Mix ingredients well and serve with veggies!

title: Hamburger And Tater Tots
directions: Brown meat and onion., Salt to taste., Add soup and 1/2 can water., Mix., Place in 2-quart casserole dish., Place Tater Tots on top of mixture., Bake 30 to 45 minutes at 375°., Makes 8 servings.

title: Clam Pie
directions: Cut clams up with sharp knife and fork., Peel and dice potatoes; combine with onions, pepper, Texas Pete, Worcestershire, oregano, parsley flakes, salt and black pepper in large saucepan. Cover with clam juice and water., Add mixed vegetables and boil slowly 1 hour., Dice salt pork and fry crisp., Add meat and grease to clam, mixture., Continue cooking., Mix pie crust and roll out. Using 13 x 9-inch pan, line sides with crust., Add clam mixture. Cover with strips of crust., Bake in 400° oven until crust is browned.

title: Panned Steak
directions: Pound round, steak, that has been well rolled in flour. Fry in oil, until, good, and, brown., Season, to	taste while frying. Pour, some	hot, water over the steak;, cover and let simmer for 2 hours., Pour, on a milk and flour gravy; cook 15 minutes longer. Serve.

title: Fruit Medley
directions: Mix well., Mix 1 package vanilla, reduced calorie, pudding "dry" with fruit (family size)., Stir well., Weight Watchers count as 1/2 cup equals 1 fruit and 5 optional calories.

title: 30 Minute Chili
directions: Brown the hamburger meat with diced onions and green pepper until meat is brown., Add can of mushroom soup and can of tomato soup (undiluted)., Add catsup, water, salt, pepper and chili powder., Simmer for 30 minutes., Add the whole can of drained kidney beans., Add juice from can as needed., Stir well., Serve with raw chopped onion., Add more chili powder to make hotter.

title: 5 Cup Salad
directions: Mix and refrigerate at least 2 hours before serving.

title: Dumplings For Stew
directions: Mix dry ingredients., Add liquid., Put on simmering stew., Cook 10 minutes, uncovered., Cook 10 minutes tightly covered.

title: Luscious Lemon Pie
directions: Combine sugar and cornstarch in saucepan., Add butter, lemon rind, lemon juice and egg yolks., Stir in milk and cook over medium heat, stirring until thick., Cool, then fold in sour cream. Spoon into baked shell., Cool at least 2 hours., Serve topped with whipped cream and chopped walnuts or pecans.

title: Rhubarb Pie
directions: Mix all ingredients and add the rhubarb., Bake between 2 crusts until done.

title: No-Mix Cherry Pineapple Nut Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°. Grease 9 x 13 baking pan. Spread pineapple with syrup in the pan. Spoon pie filling evenly over pineapple. Sprinkle dry cake mix evenly over mixture, then the chopped nuts over all. Slice the chilled margarine in thin slices and put evenly over the other ingredients. Bake 50 minutes or until golden. Serve warm.

title: Peanut Butter Balls
directions: Mix peanut butter, powdered sugar, margarine and graham crackers together., Roll into balls., Refrigerate., Melt together paraffin wax and chocolate chips., Dip balls with toothpicks in chocolate., Drop on wax paper to cool.

title: Ritz Cracker Pie
directions: Mix sugar with stiff egg whites. Add this mixture to crackers, pecans and vanilla. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes and cool. Mix Nestle Quik to Cool Whip and spread over cooled pie crust. Makes 1 pie.

title: Escarole And Beans
directions: Remove core from escarole and wash under cold water until completely cleaned., Discard discolored and tough outer leaves. Place in a large pot with salt., Cover with water and bring to a boil., Lower heat and boil gently 8 - 10 minutes., Drain., In same pot, heat oil and saute garlic 3 minutes., Add cannellini beans. Simmer 5 minutes. Add escarole and toss to mix., Salt and pepper to taste., Cook another 2 minutes and serve.

title: Veggie Dip
directions: Put all ingredients into a blender and blend well., Allow to stand, covered, in the refrigerator for 2 to 3 hours before serving., Makes about 2 1/4 cups., Great as a party dip with fresh veggies.

title: Eight Minute Cake
directions: Put everything in bowl at one time and cut the oleo into little pieces., Beat for 8 minutes., Grease and flour two (9-inch) pans., Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Saucy Shrimp
directions: Put all but the shrimp into a saucepan., Hold out the sherry until later., Over medium heat bring to a boil, then simmer for 10 to 15 minutes., Just before serving, add shrimp and sherry., Serve over rice.

title: Favorite Chocolate Cake With Sour Milk
directions: *May substitute milk, with 1 teaspoon baking soda dissolved in it.

title: Pecan - Cream Cheese Pie
directions: Beat cream cheese, 1 1/3 cups sugar, 1 egg, vanilla and salt until thick and creamy., Beat 3 eggs., Add 1/4 cup sugar, Karo syrup and 1 teaspoon vanilla., Spread cream cheese mixture in bottom of unbaked pie shell., Then sprinkle nuts on top of pie. Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Veal Scallopini
directions: Cut veal into serving pieces., Make sauce by combining salt, paprika, oil, lemon juice, garlic, mustard, nutmeg and sugar. Beat or shake in bottle to combine thoroughly., Lay veal flat in baking pan., Pour sauce over meat. Turn pieces to coat with sauce. Let stand 15 minutes. Remove garlic., Lift meat from sauce and dip in flour. Brown well in heated shortening in skillet. Add onion and green pepper. Combine chicken bouillon with remaining sauce and pour over meat., Cover and cook until tender, about 40 minutes. Add browned mushrooms and olives to meat and cook about 5 more minutes.

title: Baked Spinach
directions: Cook spinach according to directions on package and drain. Blend soup mix, sour cream and salt. Add to drained spinach. Place entire mixture into a 2-quart casserole., Bake at 325° for 20 minutes.

title: Sausage Squash Casserole
directions: Spray baking dish with Pam., Layer ingredients as listed, except for cheese., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes., Place cheese on top as soon as removed from oven.

title: Crab Stuffed Mushroom Strudels
directions: Preheat oven to 400°., Grease baking sheet., In bowl, mix crabmeat, onion, egg, celery and bread crumbs., Remove stems from mushrooms and finely chop., Add to crabmeat mixture., Fill each mushroom and place on baking sheet., Bake for 5 minutes to remove water from mushrooms.

title: Hamburger Pie
directions: Heat oven to 375°., Bake 30 minutes., Mix baking mix and water until soft dough forms (beat vigorously 20 strokes)., Gently smooth dough into ball on floured board; knead 5 times., Roll dough 2 inches larger than pie plate.

title: Pretzel Salad
directions: Mix pretzel crumbs, butter and 3 tablespoons of sugar., Pat into a 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake 10 minutes at 400°., Cool.

title: Seafood Salad
directions: Mix the first 4 ingredients., Mix in enough Italian dressing to hold the mixture together., Very good served with Club crackers.

title: Easy Pound Cake
directions: Prepare cake as directed on box., Mix pudding into cake batter. Pour into greased and floured pan., Bake at 350° until lightly brown., Let cake cool in pan for 10 minutes., Remove cake carefully from pan and enjoy.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Cook broccoli until done, drain., Add sour cream or yogurt and cream of celery soup., Add meat and onion mix., Place in 3-quart casserole dish., Cover with shredded cheese., Bake at 350°. Yields 4 servings.

title: Egg Custard
directions: Add sugar, salt and milk to beaten eggs; mix., Pour into unbaked pie shell., Sprinkle nutmeg over the mixture and bake at 400° for 10 minutes., Turn oven temperature down to 325° and bake until done.

title: Baked Chopped Broccoli
directions: In a buttered casserole dish, layer the first 4 ingredients top with a little stuffing., Add the water and dot with butter. Cover and bake at 350° for 45 minutes., Uncover the last 10 minutes to brown topping.

title: Gooey Cheesecake
directions: Mix well., Spread dough in bottom and 1/2-inch up sides of a greased 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Fried Apple Pies
directions: Sift together flour, baking powder and salt., Cut in shortening., Moisten dough with enough water to give it the right consistency for rolling., Roll dough out on lightly floured surface., Cut into 6-inch saucer size circles.

title: Macaroni Salad
directions: Mix together cooked macaroni, ham, Cheddar cheese, cooked frozen peas and salad dressing., Add salt and pepper to your taste., I also add a little prepared mustard., Mix well and refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Marinated Tomato Slices
directions: Place tomato slices in a shallow dish., Mix remaining ingredients and marinate tomatoes.

title: Mexican Corn Pudding
directions: Just mix and bake 1 hour at 350°.

title: Summer Squash Soup
directions: Saute the onions in the margarine until tender., Add the squash, chicken broth, white pepper, celery salt and tarragon and cook over low heat until tender., Remove from heat and stir in the milk., Process in blender until smooth., Serve hot or cold., Can be frozen.

title: Pumpkin Crisp
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Line bottom and sides of a 9 x 11-inch pan with waxed paper., Mix pumpkin, milk, sugar, cinnamon and eggs; pour into pan., Pour dry cake mix over mixture., Top with nuts and cooled margarine., Bake for 50 to 60 minutes., Invert on tray.

title: Three Bean Salad
directions: Combine sugar, vinegar, oil, salt and pepper., Mix with remaining ingredients., Cover and refrigerate overnight.

title: Hidden Valley Ranch Chicken Stir-Fry(Dinner In Ten Minutes Or Less)
directions: Heat 1 tablespoon vegetable oil in large skillet or wok., Add chicken, cut into thin strips., Stir in Hidden Valley original Ranch salad dressing., Mix to coat chicken., Add thawed vegetable medley and 2 tablespoons water., Stir-fry about 2 minutes., Makes 4 servings.

title: Jill'S Favorite Chicken Skillet
directions: Combine flour, salt, paprika, sage and pepper in a paper bag. Add chicken, a few pieces at a time, and shake to coat., Reserve excess flour mixture., In skillet, brown chicken on all sides in hot Crisco., Remove chicken. Stir reserved flour mixture and sugar into pan drippings. Add chicken broth., Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly., Stir in lemon juice, carrots, onion and parsley., Return chicken to skillet. Cover and cook until vegetables and chicken are tender, 40 to 50 minutes. Stir occasionally., Makes 4 servings.

title: Graham Cracker Pudding Cake
directions: Roll crackers., Add melted butter., Mix well and line the bottom of a 9 x 13-inch dish., Place in refrigerator using 1/2 graham cracker mixture., Prepare vanilla pudding as directed and put in pan., Let set until cool., Cover with remaining crumbs. Prepare chocolate pudding the same and put in dish., Set overnight., Add whipped cream just before serving., Cut in wedges.

title: Stolen Wine Cake
directions: Grease and flour tube pan., Pour pecans in bottom of tube pan. Pour batter over nuts., Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Baked Limas
directions: Combine all ingredients except beans and bacon, mixing well until sugar is dissolved., Gently stir in beans (with juice) and place in oblong baking dish., Layer bacon across top., Bake at 300° for 45 minutes., Remove from oven; turn bacon slices and spoon off grease., Return to oven and bake 45 minutes longer.

title: Strawberry Cake
directions: Bake in Bundt cake pan for approximately 40 minutes at 350°.

title: Gina Lloyd'S Chicken And Wild Rice Casserole
directions: Cook wild rice according to package directions., (Bread and Circus sells bulk wild rice, Roach Bros. carries 6 ounce packages in the specialty food section rather than with other rices.), I cook the rice in a 6-quart pot.

title: Oatmeal Cake
directions: Add 1 cup oats to 1 1/4 cups boiling water, stir, cover, remove from heat and let set.

title: Mexican Chocolate
directions: Put all ingredients into blender and puree., May substitute mint chocolate chips for plain chocolate chips.

title: Easy Stir-Fry
directions: Marinate meat in marinade and/or vinegar for about 1 hour. Preheat vegetable oil in wok or large pan on stove., Add meat and marinade to pan and quickly brown outside of meat, stirring so all sides brown., Cover and steam for about 3 minutes., Add vegetables; stir until coated with liquid., Cover and steam for 5 minutes or until vegetables are desired tenderness., Add brown sugar and soy sauce to taste., Serve over rice.

title: Jellied Strawberry Pie
directions: Cook together (water, sugar and cornstarch) until the mixture thickens., Add the dry gelatin powder and let the mixture cool. Pour over the strawberries in the pie shells and chill until firm. Top the pies with whipped cream or your favorite topping.

title: Oven Omelet
directions: Blend together eggs, sour cream and salt., Stir in cheese. Add ham if desired., Pour egg mixture into greased 1 1/2-quart baking dish., Drizzle butter over top., Bake at 350° for 18 to 20 minutes or until set.

title: Uncooked Fruit Cake
directions: Mix, all, together, and pack firmly in a loaf pan lined with foil., Let set in refrigerator three days before cutting.

title: Poppy Seed Sweet Bread
directions: Put all ingredients in large bowl and mix well with electric mixer., Grease and flour 2 loaf pans., Divide batter., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Marinated Chicken Wings
directions: Mix all ingredients together (except wings), then add chicken and let marinate 4 hours or more., Remove chicken from marinade and bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes.

title: #1 Grated Apple Jam Cake
directions: Cream, butter,	then, add sugar, eggs (beaten), buttermilk, blackberry	jam, and, grated apple., Mix well together, then, add all, remaining ingredients., This may be baked in a stem pan or long pan.

title: Rotini Salad
directions: In a bowl, blend together the oil, vinegar and Italian dressing., In a large bowl, combine other ingredients., Stir. Pour dressing over and stir., Chill., Keeps good in refrigerator. May add other vegetables such as onions, carrot slices, cauliflower, etc.

title: Cookie Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients except cookies., Chill., When ready to serve, add the cookies.

title: Banana Cake
directions: Bake cake according to directions in 4 layers., Add bananas and 3 tablespoons of Cool Whip with about 1/4 cup sugar., Frost between 3 layers with bananas., Frost top and sides with rest of Cool Whip.

title: B-B-Q Sauce
directions: Place the meat of your choice in the bottom of a pan., Mix dry ingredients and pour over meat., Then mix liquids and pour over meat and dry seasonings., Marinate at least two hours., This is better if you marinate your meat overnight or at least for several hours., Turn once when marinating. Now, grill!

title: Divinity(Divinity Is Not Really Hard To Make.)
directions: In a large saucepan, cook sugar, water and glucose until it threads (usually 20 minutes)., We use a candy thermometer., Add butter and peanuts and continue cooking, stirring constantly so peanuts won't stick to the pan., When the thermometer shows soft crack, immediately have someone bring in the cold marble and lay it on a large countertop., Use butter or cooking spray such as Pam, and grease marble, countertop and forks.

title: Chicken Breast With Sage And Nutmeg
directions: Trim any fat from chicken., Combine next 5 ingredients. Dredge chicken in flour mixture and set aside., Heat oil in large skillet over medium-high heat until hot., Add chicken and cook 7 to 8 minutes on each side until browned., Add vermouth and bell pepper; reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes or until chicken is tender., Transfer chicken to serving platter; spoon sauce over chicken and garnish with fresh sage leaves.

title: Diabetic Potato Soup
directions: Combine potatoes, onion, water and salt in saucepan., Cover and boil until potatoes are done, about 20 minutes., Then add milk and margarine and pepper., Heat for 5 minutes until hot., Then while this is heating make Rupples.

title: Tartar Sauce
directions: Mix well., Refrigerate until ready to use.

title: Banana-Nut Loaf
directions: Lightly grease a 9 x 5-inch loaf pan; set aside., Stir flour, baking powder, salt and baking soda in a mixing bowl., Stir thoroughly., Cream sugar and shortening until light and fluffy. Add eggs and orange peel; beat well., Mash banana in a bowl with a fork; stir in milk., Add flour mixture and banana mixture alternately to cream mixture., Beat until smooth after each addition., Fold in nuts., Pour batter in prepared pan., Bake in a 350° oven for 45 to 50 minutes., Turn out and cool on a wire rack.

title: Whole Cranberries In The Microwave
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Place in 8-inch square microwave dish, covered with plastic film, vented on one corner. Microwave on 50% power for 6 minutes., Stir., Microwave for additional 6 minutes., May be served warm or cold.

title: Onion-Beef Soup(Microwave)
directions: Combine onions and butter in 3-quart microproof casserole. Cover., Cook on High for 10 to 12 minutes or until onions are transparent, stirring once during cooking time., Stir in remaining ingredients, except cheese., Cook on High for 10 to 11 minutes or until hot., Serve in bowls with cheese sprinkled on top.

title: Susan'S Vegetable Toss
directions: Stir-fry zucchini and garlic in oil for 3 to 4 minutes until tender-crisp., Reduce to low heat., Add parsley, margarine and half and half., Cook until butter melts., Add cheeses, linguine and oregano., Serve.

title: Mock Hollandaise Sauce
directions: In a small saucepan, combine all ingredients., Cook and stir over low heat until hot., Serve with vegetables, poultry, fish or eggs., Makes 1/2 cup or 8 (1/2-tablespoon) servings.

title: Cranberry Nut Bread
directions: Mix all dry ingredients, including cranberries., Mix all wet ingredients., Combine all ingredients., Spray pan with Pam (meat loaf size pan)., Bake at 350°., Cool and then turn out.

title: Kraut Burgers
directions: Mix ingredients together., Put on grill., Serve with lettuce, tomato and onion., Great for summer or anytime cookout.

title: Sweet Potato Pie
directions: Heat oven to 425°., Mix eggs, potatoes, sugar, butter and spices in large bowl., Gradually beat in milk., Mix thoroughly. Stir in flour until well blended., Pour into pastry shell., Bake 20 minutes., Reduce oven temperature to 350°., Bake 30 to 35 minutes or until set and knife inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Cheerwine Punch
directions: Combine and serve very cold. Make ice ring or ice cubes with mixture to add to punch to keep it cold. Makes 30 small servings.

title: Jason'S Creation
directions: Brown meat and onion together., Stir in peas, corn and stewed tomatoes., Add a dash of lemon pepper, black pepper or cayenne to taste., When macaroni and cheese mix is ready, mix all together in a large skillet until heated through., Makes 5 to 6 servings.

title: Sausage Balls
directions: Mix cheese and Bisquick, then add sausage., Roll into small balls., Bake 15 to 20 minutes at 300° or until done.

title: Tortilla Soup
directions: In large pot, combine all, except cheese and chips., Bring to a boil using medium heat., (Can mash tomatoes, if desired.)

title: Easy Good Lasagna
directions: Rinse noodles under warm water until soft., Do not cook.

title: Blarney Stones
directions: Combine flour, baking powder and salt; set aside., In mixing bowl whip cream until soft and peaks form; gradually fold in sugar., Combine water and extract; add alternately with flour mixture, gently folding ingredients together after each addition just until combined., Fold in egg whites., Spread into greased and wax paper-lined 13 x 9-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes or until cake tests done and is lightly browned., Cool on a rack for 10 minutes., Remove from pan; cool completely., With fork, break cake into 1 1/4 to 1 1/2 inch pieces; set aside.

title: Chow Mein Chunkies
directions: Melt butterscotch coating., Add peanut butter; stir and melt. Stir in noodles and peanuts., Drop into large candy cups and let set at room temperature.

title: Best Banana Bread
directions: To make sour milk mix about 1/2 teaspoon white vinegar to the 1 tablespoon of milk and let stand until curdles., Cream shortening and sugar., Add beaten egg and salt., Add flour and bananas alternately., Dissolve soda in little tepid water and mix with the sour milk., Add to batter., Add vanilla and nuts., Bake in greased loaf pan very slowly at 250° for 1 hour and 25 minutes., Brown 10 minutes more if needed., Toothpick test and let stand overnight before use, having turned out to cool.

title: Dessert Brownies
directions: Melt cocoa and oleo in 1 1/2-quart saucepan., Add remaining ingredients., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: No Cook Frosting
directions: Mix together; put on cake and place under broiler a few minutes until brown., Do not have to put under broiler, can just leave as is.

title: Red Chicken Stew
directions: Cook chicken and shred into small pieces., Put all ingredients in crock-pot or large pot and cook for approximately 2 1/2 hours on low to medium heat., Serve over rice.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge Cake
directions: In a saucepan combine first 5 ingredients., Stir constantly over a low heat until mixture bubbles., Stir in sugar, flour and baking soda while mixture is hot., Beat until smooth, then stir in vanilla., Spread into a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake for 25 minutes at 350° until center is firm to the touch., Cool.

title: Spanish Cream(Serves 6)
directions: Sprinkle gelatin over milk., Let stand 5 minutes, then heat until dissolved., Separate eggs., Beat egg whites to peaks., Beat yolks in large bowl., Pour gelatin mixture into egg yolks (slowly), then pour back into pan and add sugar., Cook until custard coats spoon (8 to 12 minutes)., Add vanilla., Pour custard over egg whites and cool.

title: Caramel Fudge Cake
directions: Cream margarine and sugar., Gradually add other ingredients, adding pecans last., Lightly grease and flour 9x13 pan., Spread mixture evenly., Bake 30-35 minutes at 325°, or until toothpick inserted in middle comes out dry.

title: Brownies (Low Calorie)
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Place all ingredients in bowl; stir to blend well., Bake for 30 minutes in greased 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Yield: 16 two inch squares, 1 square = 95 calories.

title: Apple Salad
directions: Combine first 5 ingredients., Mix salad dressing, whipped topping and sugar., Pour over apple mixture and toss gently.

title: Vegetable Dip
directions: Combine all ingredients; stir well., Cover and chill 3 hours. Serve with fresh vegetables., Makes 2 cups.

title: Midnight Chocolate Cake
directions: Cream the sugar and shortening. Add cocoa, eggs and sour milk. Mix well. Add flour., Mix. Add boiling water with baking soda and vanilla. Beat., Go heavy on wet ingredients., Light on dry ingredients. Bake 45 to 55 minutes at 350° in long pan or 8-inch.

title: Dirt Pudding
directions: In serving bowl, layer the crushed Oreos., Mix pudding with milk until thick for second layer., Mix cheese, powdered sugar, oleo and Cool Whip for the third layer.

title: Poor Man'S Steak
directions: Mix the first 5 ingredients., Place mixture in loaf pan to chill thoroughly and cut into slices., Roll in flour and brown quickly in frying pan., Place fried slices in casserole., Mix mushroom soup and 1 can of water; pour over meat., Cover to bake. Bake 1 1/2 hours at 300°.

title: Lemon Daffodil Dessert
directions: Combine juice, sugar and condensed milk; add whipped cream. Tear cake into small pieces and place in casserole dish or individual compotes., Pour mixture over cake and blend together slightly., Chill 24 hours before serving., Pound cake can be used. Yield: 8 to 10 servings.

title: Broccoli Salad
directions: Cut broccoli in bite-size pieces., Chop green onions., Cut tomatoes in half., Mix all ingredients in medium-size bowl., Salt and pepper to taste., Coat with mayonnaise., Toss until well coated.

title: Cottage Cheese Pie
directions: Mix ingredients in blender., Pour into pie shells., Bake at 300° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Party Cones
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Prepare cake batter according to package directions; set aside., In saucepan over low heat, melt peanut butter chips with milk, stirring constantly, until blended., Add peanut butter mixture while warm to cake batter., Beat on medium speed of electric mixer until blended, about 2 minutes., Fill ice cream cone cup 2/3 to 3/4 full with batter., Place upright in regular muffin cups or 2 inches apart on a cookie sheet., Bake 30 to 35 minutes or until wooden pick inserted comes out clean., Cool completely., Frost as desired., Decorate with chocolate or colored sprinkles., Makes 24 cones.

title: Hamburger Casserole
directions: Brown ground beef., Cook noodles following box directions. While noodles are cooking, add pepper, onion and tomato soup to ground beef., Simmer about 15 minutes., When noodles are done, layer half of the noodles and half the ground beef., Mix: 1/2 tomato wedges and 1/2 cheese., Repeat with the remaining, ending with cheese on top., Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes, until cheese is melted.

title: Lima-Corn Bake
directions: Place 1/2 the lima beans in bottom of nonstick baking pan. Top with a layer of corn, then top the corn with 1/2 of the tomato slices, the onion and garlic., Top with another layer of lima beans and corn; end with tomato slices., Pour tomato juice over all., Cover and bake at 350° for 40 minutes., Serves 4 to 6.

title: Beef Stroganoff
directions: Brown beef, and, onion, then add all the other ingredients. Simmer for 1 hour.	Serve with a salad.

title: Vegetable Pie
directions: Brown bottom of pie shell slightly., Cook broccoli according to package directions., Saute mushrooms and onion in butter., Beat egg slightly and mix with broccoli, mushrooms and onion., Place mixture in cooked shell., Place cheese slices on broccoli mix., Mash yams or sweet potatoes with 1 tablespoon butter and water in can and place on top of cheese and broccoli., Cut top of pie crust in strips, lattice top., Bake at 350° until top crust is brown.

title: Crab Meat Dip Pizza
directions: Beat cheese until light and fluffy., Blend in remaining ingredients., Then chill.

title: Barbecued Chicken
directions: Mix oil, vinegar and seasonings., Simmer 3 to 4 minutes., (If you increase, don't add more salt or poultry seasonings, but simmer longer.), Marinade chicken overnight., Grill over low heat until done.

title: Unfried French Fries
directions: Preheat oven to 400°., Slice each potato length into 1/4-inch ovals, then slice each oval lengthwise into matchsticks., Coat a baking sheet with 3 sprays of vegetable oil., Combine egg whites and Cajun spice in a bowl., Add the matchstick potatoes and mix to coat., Pour the coated potatoes onto the prepared baking sheet and spread them out into single layer, leaving a little space between. Place the baking sheet on the bottom shelf of the oven., Bake for 40 to 45 minutes until the fries are crispy, turning them every 6 to 8 minutes with a spatula so that they brown evenly., Serve immediately.

title: Hamburger Casserole
directions: Brown hamburger and chop onion; drain., Put in 8 x 8-inch casserole dish., Add green beans and green pepper, if desired. Mix water and mushroom soup., Pour over mixture., Add a layer of cheese slices., Place tatoes on top., Bake at 400° for 30 minutes or until tatoes are done and cheese is melted.

title: Jello Cookies
directions: Mix shortening with sugar and Jello. Add eggs and vanilla. Stir together flour, baking powder and salt, add to Jello mixture. Add food coloring. The food coloring should match the flavor of the cookie: lime = green, lemon = yellow, cherry = red. Mix until well combined. The flavor of the Jello you use is the flavor of your cookies. Drop dough by teaspoonfuls on lightly greased cookie sheet. Press with the bottom of a glass that has been buttered and dipped in sugar. Bake at 400° for 6 to 8 minutes. Do not brown.

title: Barbecue Franks
directions: Cut franks in bite-size pieces (approximately 5 pieces for each frank).

title: Crunchy Sundae Topping
directions: Melt, oleo, in, heavy, saucepan., Stir, in brown sugar. Cook for 2 minutes., Remove from heat and add cornflakes, nuts and coconut., Toss until well mixed., Pour out on cookie sheet and cool thoroughly., Crumble and serve over ice cream.

title: Crisp Pickle Slices
directions: Bring the syrup of vinegar, sugar, salt, celery, mustard seed and turmeric to a boil., Boil 5 minutes., Pour over cucumber slices and seal., Cook 5 minutes in hot water bath.

title: Macaroni And Cheese Salad
directions: Cook macaroni (salt water that you cook macaroni in); drain well and cool., Combine vegetables and macaroni., In a small bowl, mix remaining ingredients well., Then add to macaroni and vegetable mixture., Stir until mixed well.

title: Pineapple Pie
directions: Combine milk and lemon juice; stir well., Fold in pineapple and topping., Spoon into pie shell and chill.

title: Aunt Betty'S Nephew'S Famous Spaghetti Sauce
