directions: Brown onion and garlic (cut up in 1/4-inch pieces)., Add ground meat and brown., Add sauce and paste with 1 to 1 1/2 cans water; add sugar, salt and pepper., Cook well and let simmer for two hours.

title: Jello Salad
directions: Dissolve jello in hot water., Add frozen berries and break apart., Break up angel food cake in jello mixture., Mix slightly. (Cake will absorb juice and jello.), Pour into a 13 x 9-inch pan and refrigerate., Serve in squares, topped with whipped cream.

title: Chili Con Queso
directions: Cut loaf of Velveeta into slices and put in a large bowl. Saute vegetables in 1/4 cup of oleo until tender., Add to cheese. Add 3/4 to 1 cup picante., Place bowl in microwave and heat, stirring occasionally until melted to a medium consistency., Serve with your favorite nacho chips.

title: Chinese Casserole
directions: Heat all ingredients in a Teflon skillet, uncovered., Stir gently until well heated., Makes dinner for one with a 4-ounce portion of limited vegetables (pea pods or bamboo shoots).

title: Rhubarb Cream Pie
directions: Blend sugar, flour, nutmeg and butter., Add beaten eggs; beat smooth., Pour over rhubarb in a 9-inch pastry-lined pie pan., Top with pastry cut in fancy shapes., Bake in hot oven (450°) for 10 minutes, then in moderate oven (350°) for about 30 minutes.

title: Cherry Dessert
directions: Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water, then add pie filling and crushed pineapple with juice., Cool Whip may be added, when set if desired.

title: Apple Dump Cake
directions: In a greased 9 x 13-inch pan, layer pineapple and top with apple pie filling., Sprinkle cake mix over apple filling., Slice margarine over dry cake mix., Sprinkle with nuts., Bake 1 hour at 325°.

title: Tasty Baked Fish
directions: Combine onion, mustard and water., Let stand 10 minutes., Wipe fish with damp cloth and arrange in baking dish., Sprinkle with salt., Combine mayonnaise, lemon juice, onion and mustard mixture and black pepper., Pour mixture over fish., Bake in preheated oven at 500° for 12 to 17 minutes or until done and lightly brown. Garnish with paprika., Serves 6.

title: Cheesecake
directions: Place ingredients in order given in a large mixing bowl., Beat with electric mixer; start on low speed, then move to medium and finish with about 10 minutes on high speed., Batter should be smooth and liquid., Grease and lightly flour a round baking pan 10 inches in diameter and 3 inches high., Pour batter into pan; bake for 1 hour in preheated 350° oven., Leave cake in oven, with door closed, for an additional hour after heat is turned off, then cool on rack., Refrigerate for storage., Makes 20 servings.

title: Creamy Split Pea Soup
directions: Lightly boil, first, 4, ingredients until peas are soft (45 minutes)., Cool, a little and remove bay leaf., Blend with remaining ingredients., Return, to pan and simmer until thick. Stir occasionally., Makes 1 quart.

title: Spanish Shells
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Cook and drain pasta shells. Brown and drain ground beef., Combine picante sauce, water, tomato sauce and taco seasoning., Chop chilies and grate cheese. Stir 1/2 cup sauce into ground beef along with chilies, 1/2 cup cheese and 1/2 can fried onions., Pour remaining sauce into bottom of 1 1/2-quart baking dish., Stuff cooked shells with ground mixture. Arrange shells in dish., Pour remaining sauce over shells., Bake, covered, at 350° for 25 minutes., Top with remaining cheese and fried onions., Bake, uncovered, for 5 minutes.

title: Wallace'S Tortilla Dogs
directions: Place Velveeta cheese spread and wiener on flour tortilla; roll up., Microwave on paper towel on High for 45 seconds, or until cheese is melted and wiener is hot., Serve with salsa. Makes 1 serving.

title: Bacon Wraps
directions: Cut off ends of bread and cut in half., Spread with soup directly out of can., Roll bread up like crescents., Cut bacon in half., Wrap a slice of bacon around each slice of bread., Secure with toothpick., Bake on foil lined cookie sheet at about 425° for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Pizza Noodle Casserole
directions: Mix ingredients together and simmer until blended, about 2 hours.

title: Sugarless Punch
directions: Thaw shrimp, if frozen.

title: Parmesan Potato Rounds
directions: Pour melted butter into jelly roll pan., Combine flour, cheese, salt and pepper in plastic bag., Drop in potato slices; shake to coat with flour mixture., Place in a single layer over the butter., Bake at 375° for about 30 minutes., Turn slices; sprinkle with Italian seasoning., Bake 30 minutes more, or until tender.

title: Eye Of Round Roast
directions: Line pan with foil., Put onion, halved, and 2 cloves of garlic in pan on each side of roast with 1 inch of water., Pile salt on top.

title: Pierre'S Noodles With Vegetables
directions: Bring water to a boil in a large saucepan and cook noodles. While noodles are cooking, melt the butter in a skillet., Add the mushrooms and zucchini., (It may be more convenient to use separate skillets for the mushrooms and zucchini.)

title: Squash Rolls
directions: If possible, check, temperature of warm water with thermometer., Sprinkle yeast over water in a large bowl; stir until dissolved., Stir in sugar and salt until dissolved., Add eggs, squash, 1/2 cup softened butter and 3 cups flour.

title: Italian Spaghetti
directions: Brown hamburger,, onion, garlic, beef bouillon, salt and pepper to, taste;, drain., Add, remaining ingredients;, heat to boiling; reduce heat., Cover and simmer, stirring occasionally, 1 hour., Serve over hot cooked spaghetti.

title: Green Bean Salad
directions: Mix together first nine ingredients and set aside., Mix together vinegar, sugar, salad oil, Italian dressing and pour over dry ingredients and stir., Refrigerate overnight before serving.

title: Broccoli And Sausage Quiche
directions: Separate 1 egg and beat until frothy., Brush pie shells with white, but do not saturate., Bake pie shells., Brown sausage and drain., Cook broccoli according to package and drain., Combine whipping cream, Velveeta and Cheddar cheese and microwave 3 to 4 minutes., Beat eggs and combine with cheese mixture.

title: Spanish Rice
directions: Combine all ingredients in a 1-quart casserole dish., Cover. Microwave 10 to 12 minutes on High or until water is absorbed. Fluff with fork.

title: Mexican Jalapeno Cornbread
directions: Mix eggs, cornmeal, milk, oil, soda, salt and corn., Place half of mixture in skillet or pan that has been sprayed with Pam. Top with ground beef, onions, grated cheese and jalapeno peppers. Put remaining cornbread mixture on top., Bake 50 to 60 minutes at 375°.

title: Spaghetti Pie
directions: Cook spaghetti according directions; drain., Should have approximately 3 cups of spaghetti., Add the Parmesan cheese and eggs., Pat spaghetti mixture into a buttered, 10-inch pie plate to make crust.

title: Broccoli And Corn Scallop
directions: Saute onion in 1 tablespoon of butter., Blend in flour. Gradually add milk., Stir constantly until thickened., Add cheese. Stir until melted., Stir in corn and 1/4 cup bread crumbs., Arrange broccoli in an 11 3/4 x 7 1/2-inch dish., Pour cheese sauce over broccoli., Toss remaining crumbs and butter over casserole., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes., Serves 8.

title: Chipped Beef Cheese Balls
directions: Let cheese set to reach room temperature., Beat cheese until creamy, add remaining ingredients., Roll into small balls., Serve with toothpick.

title: Hamburger And Cabbage Casserole
directions: Saute onion in butter., Add hamburger, salt and pepper, heating through but not browning., Spread half the shredded cabbage in a 2-quart baking dish., Cover with meat mixture., Top with remaining cabbage., Pour undiluted tomato soup over top; stir., Cover and bake 1 hour at 350°., Serves 6.

title: Zucchini Casserole
directions: Saute cabbage, peppers and onion together until transparent. Add oleo and zucchini., Saute until transparent.

title: Potato Cheese Soup
directions: In 4-quart pot, add chunked potatoes and onion. Cover with water and cook. Stir all other ingredients together in pot, warming slightly to blend well. Add to potatoes and onions and water. Heat slowly, stirring often. Add milk if it's too thick. Refrigerate leftovers (5 to 7 days).

title: Joe Ann'S Cup-A-Salad
directions: Bring to a boil sugar, water and pineapple., Remove from heat. Dissolve Jell-O into mixture., Chill until slightly thickened. Add cheese, milk and pecans., Stir well., Chill until set.

title: Coconut Caramel Pies
directions: Melt butter in a large skillet., Add coconut and chopped pecans., Cook until golden brown, stirring frequently., Set aside. Combine cream cheese and sweetened condensed milk., Beat until smooth., Fold in Cool Whip., Layer 1/4 of the cream cheese mixture in each shell., Drizzle 1/4 topping on each pie., Sprinkle 1/4 of the coconut mixture over each., Repeat layers., Freeze., Remove from freezer about 30 minutes before serving., Additional caramel sauce may be served with the pie., If making individual serving pies, will make approximately 36.

title: Kool Popsicles
directions: Mix Kool-Aid, jello, sugar and hot water until dissolved., Add the cold water and stir., Pour into ice cube trays and let freeze. Enjoy!

title: Strawberry Jello Punch
directions: Pour the boiling water over the Jell-O and sugar. When cool, add the pineapple juice., Let stand at least 24 hours in refrigerator., Add the ginger ale before serving.

title: Artichoke Dip
directions: *I put mine in the blender, but make sure to drain well.

title: Orange Pecan Pie
directions: Beat eggs in large bowl; stir in remaining ingredients except pastry shell., Pour into pastry shell., Bake in 400° oven for 15 minutes; reduce heat to 350° and continue to bake 35 to 45 minutes longer., Filling will be moist in center., Cool., This kitchen-tested recipe makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Mayonnaise Cake
directions: Mix together., Bake 25 minutes at 350°.

title: Cranberry Banana Bread
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Grease a 9 x 5-inch loaf pan., Beat sugar, butter and eggs in a large bowl until smooth., Stir in bananas and lemon juice., Mix flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt into bowl., Stir dry ingredients into creamed mixture. Fold berries and nuts., Pour into pan., Bake 50 to 60 minutes until toothpick is clean.

title: Cheese Ball
directions: Mix all ingredients and shape into a ball., Roll cheese ball into the reserved chopped beef., Wrap in plastic wrap and refrigerate.

title: Stuffed French Toast
directions: Beat together cream cheese and 1 teaspoon vanilla until soft and fluffy., Stir in nuts; set aside., Cut bread into 10 to 12 (1 1/2-inch) slices., Cut pocket in top of each., Fill with 1 1/2 tablespoons cheese mixture., Beat together eggs, whipped cream, 1/2 teaspoon vanilla and nutmeg., Dip bread slices into egg mixture. Cook until golden., Heat together orange juice and preserves; drizzle over toast when done.

title: Joanne'S Lo-Cal Ice Cream Dessert
directions: Boil 1 1/2 cups water., Dissolve with jello., Add 1 1/4 cups cold water., Mix with lite ice cream until dissolved., Refrigerate until jelled., Serve with lite Cool Whip and sliced banana., (Make your own treat; try a different flavor jello and fruit topping.)

title: Corn Hush Puppies
directions: I measure with regular tablespoon not measuring spoon.

title: Father'S Day Delight
directions: Combine Jell-O with 2 cups boiling water., Add undrained pineapple and let cool., Whip cream cheese., Add to Cool Whip; add sugar, then blend with Jell-O mixture., Pour into large pan., Add marshmallows and nuts., Let chill thoroughly.

title: Ranch Style Beans
directions: Brown beef; drain., Stir in remaining ingredients., Pour into 9 x 13-inch baking dish., Bake 35 to 40 minutes, uncovered, at 400°., Stir once during baking. This freezes well.

title: Red Velvet Cake
directions: Use 3 small or 2 large pans., Cream together margarine, eggs, sugar and red food coloring., Sift together cocoa, flour, salt and cinnamon., Have buttermilk and vanilla ready., Mix all ingredients, alternating 3 mixtures, until all are used and mixture is smooth and velvety., Stir in vinegar and soda., Pour into prepared pans., Bake at 350° for 25 minutes and test for doneness., Cake is bright red., Serves 24.

title: Cheese Ball
directions: Set aside a small amount of dried beef to roll the ball in, then mix all the remaining, ingredients together., Form into a ball and roll in saved dried beef.

title: Soft Molasses Cookies
directions: Mix together flour, soda, salt and spices., Beat shortening and sugar until creamy. Add molasses and egg., Add buttermilk, raisins and nut meats. Slowly add flour mixture., Drop by teaspoonfuls on a greased cookie sheet., Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.

title: Aunt Sally'S Olive Shells
directions: Blend together the cheese, butter, paprika and salt., Stir in flour., Chill dough for easier handling., Wrap a small piece of dough around each olive, sealing well., Place on ungreased baking sheet., Bake in 400° oven for 15 minutes or until lightly browned. Serve warm., Makes 24.

title: Chocolate Covered Peanuts
directions: Melt ingredients together, mixing well., Stir in a large jar of dry roasted peanuts., Stir well and drop by teaspoonfuls onto waxed paper.

title: Persimmon Pudding
directions: Bake in low oven for 2 hours., One-half hour before taking from oven, dissolve 1 tablespoon sugar in boiling water and pour over the pudding., Serves 8.

title: Dill Pickles
directions: Seal jars., Process 5 minutes in boiling water., Remove from water immediately after 5 minutes.

title: Easy Cheese Lasagna
directions: Heat oven to 375°., In 10-inch skillet, brown ground beef, onion and garlic and drain., Return beef mixture to skillet and stir in Ragu and water., In 13 x 9-inch baking dish, layer 1/3 sauce mixture, 1/2 of uncooked lasagna noodles, 1/2 of combined Ricotta or cottage cheese and 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese and parsley. Repeat these steps in layers, ending with sauce on top. (Everything will be 1/2, except sauce and it will be thirds in order to end up with enough to cover the top lightly.), (I add Monterey Jack cheese to mine, optional.), Cook for 1 hour tightly covered with aluminum foil., Let set 10 minutes before serving.

title: Chicken Continental
directions: Cook broccoli and set aside., Saute onion and celery in butter., Add soup and heat., Then add Cheez Whiz., Add cooked rice and salt and pepper to taste (and dash of Tabasco, if desired). Layer chicken, broccoli and rice mixture in casserole dish., Top with bread crumbs., Bake at 350° until hot, 30 to 40 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Caramel Pie
directions: Pour Marzetti caramel apple dip into chocolate or graham cracker crust., Cover with Cool Whip., Sprinkle with chopped nuts and miniature chocolate chips per taste or eye appeal., Freeze. Thaw about 5 minutes before serving.

title: Peach Delight
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Generously grease and flour 2 round pans. Drain peaches, reserving sauce., Add enough water to reserved sauce to measure 1 1/4 cups., Prepare cake mix as directed on package, except substitute sauce mixture for water., Pour batter into pans., Bake and cool as directed on package.

title: Ham And Swiss Cheese Finger Sandwiches
directions: *Deli ham and cheese work best for this recipe, but are not required., The ham should be sliced "sandwich thick."

title: Fudge Sauce
directions: Place first 3 ingredients in a double boiler. Cook over hot water until thick. Then add 1/2 to 1 cup of hot water to the cooked milk and chocolate. Add the butter and the vanilla. Serve hot or cold over ice cream or use as fillings for cakes. Makes 2 cups.

title: Yum-A-Setta(Amish)
directions: Brown hamburger with salt, pepper, brown sugar and onion., Add tomato soup., Cook egg noodles and drain., Add chicken soup. Layer hamburger mixture and noodle mixture in casserole dish with processed cheese between layers., Bake at 350° for 1/2 hour.

title: Summer Blt Spread
directions: Combine bacon, sour cream, mayonnaises and tomatoes in med. bowl. Stir until blended. Cover and refrigerate 1 hour to blend favors. Can be prepared up to 3 hours in advance., To serve spoon in small bowl or a hollowed out tomato. Place on lettuce leaves or serving plate surrounded by, Keebler Town House crackers. Serve with bacon and parsley over spread.

title: Beef Bourguignon
directions: Heat oil in a heavy saucepan and brown the beef cubes until deeply colored., Remove from pan and brown sliced onions until golden brown., Return beef cubes to pan and add beef bouillon and dry red wine., Simmer until beef cubes are almost tender., Add small onions and cook until tender., Add mushrooms and heat through; adjust seasonings., Mix cornstarch and water, add to beef stock and boil for one minute, or until sauce is thickened and clear., Serve with rice or noodles.

title: Six Layered Dinner
directions: Place potatoes in bottom of greased casserole., Add celery, beef, onions and peppers., Salt and pepper each layer., Pour tomatoes over mixture., Bake at 350° for 2 hours.

title: Strawberry Delight
directions: Dissolve Jell-O in 1 cup hot water., Add 1 cup cold water., Add strawberries, pineapple and bananas., Mix well., Pour half into container and chill until firm., Spread sour cream over Jell-O and add remaining Jell-O and chill.

title: Brunswick Stew
directions: Cook Boston butt in crock-pot for about 4 1/2 hours on high until tender., After it cooks, trim off fat., Cut in chunks and put in food grinder., Use 1 cup of stock and cut up potatoes, chopped onion and a little more water to cover potatoes., Cook until tender but not mushy., To this, add meat, tomatoes, corn, hot sauce, salt and pepper., Cover and simmer for a while.

title: Cup Custard
directions: Beat eggs; mix all together., Put in custard cups., Set cups in a 9 x 9-inch pan with 1 1/2-inches hot water in it., Bake in 350° oven for about an hour.

title: Banana Split Dessert
directions: Mix graham cracker crumbs and 1 stick melted butter., Press into bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan., Cream eggs, 2 sticks butter, powdered sugar and vanilla., Beat with mixer approximately 15 minutes., Spread over crumbs., Slice bananas over mixture., Cover with large container of Cool Whip., Sprinkle with chopped pecans. Decorate with cherry halves., Cover and chill overnight.

title: Summer Tomato Salad
directions: Slice tomato in thin wedges., Slice onion also in thin wedges, using as much or as little as you want. Add salt and pepper and toss lightly., Set in refrigerator for at least 1/2 hour., Pour dressing to taste just before serving.

title: Okra Fingers
directions: Wash okra, trim and drain., Place in shallow dish., Pour buttermilk over okra, set aside., Combine next 5 ingredients, mixing well., Remove okra from buttermilk and carefully roll in cornmeal mixture., Drop into hot oil (375°)., Fry 3 to 5 minutes, turning and browning on all sides., Drain on paper towels.

title: Homemade Sloppy Joes
directions: Brown hamburger, then drain grease off., Place back on heat and add other ingredients, continually stirring., May add ketchup and brown sugar to taste., Add chili powder to taste, also., Cook on low to medium heat for 30 minutes, then serve hot.

title: Jello Salad
directions: Add dry gelatin to cream cheese and combine., Add boiling water, celery and pineapple., Fold in whipped topping., Pour into square baking dish and refrigerate until cold and firm.

title: Quick Barbecue Chicken
directions: Put flour, salt and cut up chicken in brown sack., Close tightly and shake chicken pieces good., Fry in hot shortening or oil of your choice., When browned, remove to paper towel on platter., Mix remaining ingredients., Dip each piece of chicken into sauce while hot., Then place in roasting pan., Leave open. Bake for 20 minutes in 375° oven.

title: Squash Casserole
directions: Cook squash and drain., Melt 1/2 stick margarine in dish. Reserve 1/2 cup crumbs with the rest of margarine to sprinkle over the top of casserole., Mix all other ingredients in dish with margarine., Bake at 400° for 30 minutes.

title: Noodle Pudding
directions: Boil noodles in salt water until tender., Drain very dry., Put in large bowl., Melt butter in hot noodles., Add 9 beaten eggs. Add both cans of fruit with juice., Add vanilla, sugar, raisins and orange juice., Put 3 tablespoons butter in 2 (9 x 12-inch) baking pans., When butter is melted, in a 350° oven, divide the mixture between the 2 pans and bake 1 hour at 325° or until slightly brown., Can divide recipe in half.

title: Apple Snack Cake
directions: Cover diced apples with sugar., Let stand until liquid rises, stirring occasionally, until sugar dissolves., Blend together eggs and corn oil., Add to apple-sugar mixture., Sift together flour, allspice, cinnamon, nutmeg, salt and soda., Add raisins and pecans., Add flour mixture to apple mixture., Beat by hand as too much mixing makes it crumble., Pour into greased 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 50 to 55 minutes., After it comes out of the oven, poke holes in cake and pour the following sauce over top.

title: Wheat Germ Bread
directions: In large mixer bowl combine 1 1/2 cups flour, yeast, wheat germ and salt, mix well., Add water, molasses, shortening and egg. Beat 3 minutes at medium speed., By hand gradually stir in remaining flour to make a stiff batter., Cover., Let rise in warm place until light, about 45 minutes., Bake at 375° for 35 to 40 minutes until deep brown., Remove from pan, cool.

title: Myrtle'S Cheese Cake
directions: Line 10 x 13-inch pan with crust mixture, pressing firmly to bottom and sides.

title: White Merry Christmas Fudge
directions: Put sugar, milk and corn syrup into saucepan., Cook and stir over medium heat until mixture begins to boil., Clip a candy thermometer to side of pan., Cook for about 12 minutes or until mixture reaches 234°, soft ball stage., Remove from heat., Add butter and almond extract., Beat until fudge begins to thicken. Quickly stir in walnuts and cherries., Beat until fudge is no longer glossy., Score into squares while warm.

title: Cabbage Stew
directions: Brown hamburger; add other ingredients., Season to taste. Cook until cabbage is done.

title: Meat Loaf
directions: Mix all ingredients, except 1/3 cup catsup., Pack into loaf pan; spread catsup over loaf., Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Chile Cheese Squares
directions: Spread the chiles in the bottom of a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Cover with cheese., Combine eggs, cream and pepper and mix well. Pour over cheese.

title: Ranch Style Baked Beans
directions: In large skillet put oil and brown ground beef., Stir in soup mix, beans, catsup, water, mustard and vinegar., Simmer until ready to eat.

title: Coconut Cake
directions: Grease and flour 2 (9-inch) pans., Cream sugar and shortening. Add eggs, one at a time., Cream thoroughly., Add vanilla. Alternately add flour in 3 portions with milk in 2 portions; pour in pans., Bake 25 to 30 minutes at 350°., Allow to cool 10 minutes before removing from pans.

title: Brownies
directions: Melt butter in an 8-inch square pan., Mix together remaining ingredients in pan with melted butter., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes., Cool; cut into squares.

title: Coconut Pecan Frosting
directions: Combine milk, sugar, yolks, butter and vanilla., Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until thickened, about 10 minutes., Remove from heat., Add nuts and coconut., Beat until cool.

title: Fruit Cobbler
directions: Melt 1 stick margarine in 9 x 13-inch pan., Mix sugar, flour, baking powder, salt and milk., Pour into pan with butter or margarine., Pour fruit over top of batter., Do not stir!, Bake at 350` for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Elly'S Pound Cake
directions: Cream margarine, shortening and sugar until creamy., Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition., Add flour and salt alternately with milk and vanilla., Pour into greased and floured tube pan., Bake in 325° oven for 1 hour and 20 minutes. Do not preheat oven; start in cold oven.

title: Strawberry Trifle
directions: Cut cake into sections/slices small enough to fit shape of bowl., Slices should be normal size thickness.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
directions: Beat shortening and peanut butter and sugar together, then add eggs, one at a time., Add flour and vanilla., Roll into walnut size balls and flatten in crisscross pattern with floured fork. Place about 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet., Bake at 375° until light brown, 10 to 12 minutes., Immediately remove from cookie sheet; cool., Yields about 2 dozen cookies.

title: Chicken Tapae
directions: Sprinkle chicken with salt., Brown in butter in skillet. Remove chicken and butter into large baking dish., Mix apples with chicken., Sprinkle with sugar and nuts., Add cider; cover., Bake at 375° for 40 to 45 minutes., Serve with mound of steamed rice.

title: Chicken Divan
directions: Cook broccoli until almost tender., Put well drained broccoli in greased 2-quart baking dish., Bake 30 to 40 minutes at 350°.

title: Grandma'S Apple Dumplings
directions: Mix flour, salt, baking powder and shortening; mix in milk. Roll out dough in rectangle., Spread with apples and sprinkle with a little cinnamon and sugar., Roll up like jelly roll and slice about 1 1/4 inch thick., Place in 9 X 13 pan., Boil sugar, water, cinnamon and butter., Pour over dumplings., Bake at 375° for 30 to 35 minutes., Serve with whipped cream.

title: Coconut Pound Cake
directions: Cream granulated sugar and shortening. Add eggs one at a time, beating well after each. Sift flour, baking powder and salt together. Add the mixture alternately with buttermilk or sour milk. Add coconut extract and flaked coconut. Place in a greased and floured tube pan (a 2 piece pan works best). Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes. Remove from oven. While still hot, punch holes in cake and slowly pour the glaze over cake, allowing it to seep into holes and down sides and middle. Cool thoroughly before removing from pan. Cake will cut better if allowed to firm up overnight.

title: Cabbage Soup
directions: Combine all ingredients and simmer until done., More water can be added, if too thick.

title: Baked Onions
directions: In buttered casserole dish, place thinly sliced onions, potato chips and grated cheese., Do this in layers., Pour over mushroom soup and milk., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Zucchini Appetizers
directions: Mix all ingredients, except zucchini and eggs, together., Mix well., Then add zucchini and eggs., Pour into greased 9-inch square pan., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until top is golden brown., Cool and cut into squares.

title: Corn Pudding
directions: Mix ingredients., Pour into greased 13 x 9-inch dish., Bake 45 minutes to 1 hour at 350°.

title: Cheese Ball
directions: Mix and chill. Serve with crackers.

title: Lemon Squares
directions: Mix together and, put, into 9-inch square pan.	Bake in 350° oven for 25 minutes.

title: Candied Yams
directions: Slice potatoes; put in ovenware dish., Mix sugar, flour and salt; sprinkle over potatoes., Mix lemon juice and water; pour over top., Dot with butter., Bake at 400° for 45 minutes covered.

title: Cheese Beef Dip
directions: Brown the beef, onion and garlic., Drain the grease., Add cream cheese and melt into the meat mixture., Add the other ingredients., Serve warm in a crock-pot or fondue pot with corn chips.

title: Butter Pecan Pound Cake
directions: Grease pan., Sprinkle with powdered sugar., Sprinkle chopped pecans in bottom of pan., Combine cake mix, eggs, oil and water. Mix for 2 minutes until smooth., Add icing to batter; mix well and pour into pan on top of pecans., Bake at 350° for 55 minutes or until brown.

title: Chicken Pizzioli
directions: Mix all ingredients together, except chicken and cheese., Pour over top of chicken., Bake in a 350° oven for 40 minutes., Remove from oven; sprinkle cheese on top., Return to oven and bake until cheese melts.

title: Shoe Peg Corn Casserole
directions: Combine corn, onion, cheese, soups and sour cream., Place in a greased 8 1/4 x 4 1/4-inch or 9 x 5-inch casserole dish., Mix together crackers, almonds and melted margarine., Spread topping over vegetable mix., Bake at 350° for 35 minutes., May be made ahead and refrigerated.

title: Chicken And Tater Tots Casserole
directions: Broil skinless breast of chicken until done., When cooled, cube chicken into bite sizes., Layer Tater Tots in the bottom of a greased casserole dish and add cubed chicken., Mix soups and milk and pour oven chicken and Tater Tots., Sprinkle cheese over top. Bake for 20 minutes at 350°.

title: Kentucky Jam Cake
directions: In a large bowl, mix all ingredients (except pecans)., When batter is smooth and sugar is dissolved, add pecans., Bake in two 9x9 pans for 40 minutes at 350°., (I line the bottom of pans with wax paper and grease and flour sides.)

title: Spinach Quiche
directions: Cook spinach according to package directions., Drain well; squeeze out excess moisture., Chop into smaller pieces; set aside. Unroll dough., Press into greased 10-inch glass pie plate, covering bottom and sides., Sprinkle cheese and onion over crust. Beat eggs., Add milk, seasonings and reserved spinach., Pour into crust., Sprinkle with bacon, parsley and Parmesan cheese., Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes or until knife inserted near the center comes out clean., Let stand 5 minutes before serving., Yield:, 6 to 8 servings.

title: Hot Cabbage Slaw
directions: Heat last 6 ingredients and pour over cabbage and onions. Keeps for days.

title: Peanut Butter Bars
directions: Melt butter., Stir in peanut butter, graham crackers and powdered sugar., Pat in cookie sheet.

title: Corn Casserole
directions: Combine all ingredients in order given. Reserve cheese. Spoon into a 2-quart casserole dish. Top with shredded cheese. Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Chocolate Eclair
directions: Blend together pudding and milk., Mix Cool Whip with pudding. Pour on top of graham cookies., Add another layer of cookies. Last, add Pillsbury chocolate fudge icing on top., Let chill until you can keep the kids out of it.

title: Birds Nest
directions: Use round deep casserole and fill it half full with tart peeled and sliced apples; sprinkle with brown sugar and nutmeg or cinnamon or both., Dot with butter.

title: Mamie'S Lima Beans
directions: Pick beans and cover with cold water., Soak 1 to 2 hours. Pour off water and rinse beans., Add all ingredients., Cover beans with cold water and simmer until tender., Pour into baking dish. Bake at 375° until crusty on top., Enjoy!

title: The Unnamed Recipe
directions: In microwave, melt chocolate 1 1/2 minutes; then continue to melt in microwave 15 seconds at a time until completely melted. Stir between meltings., Mix peanuts and cereal together., Pour into melted chocolate., Drop by spoon on waxed paper to cool.

title: Chris' Dump Cake
directions: Spray oblong pan, with	nonstick spray., Put cherry and pineapple in pan, and, mix with each other., Sprinkle dry cake mix evenly over, this, mixture., Cut up margarine all over the top of this., Bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes until brown on top.

title: Egg Roll
directions: Place ingredients in springroll shells according to package diagram., Deep fry with temperature of 140° to 150°., Turn on both sides, ready when golden brown in color., Blot excess oil before serving.

title: Chocolate Chip Cheese Cake
directions: Beat all but cookie mix until fluffy with mixer., Grease and flour a 9 x 15-inch pan., Cut 1 roll cookie mix and spread on bottom of pan., Pour cream cheese mix on cookie crust., Slice other roll cookie mix and place on top of mix., Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Beef Or Deer Jerky
directions: Mix all ingredients and marinate overnight., Remove meat from juice and dehydrate., If you do not have a dehydrator, place in oven on 140° with oven door cracked open so meat will dry out without being cooked., If meat is thin enough, it should dry out overnight.

title: Chicken A La King(Low-Fat)
directions: Melt margarine in a large, nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add chicken and onion; cook, stirring constantly, 3 to 5 minutes, or until chicken is browned., Add mushrooms; cook 1 minute., Stir in flour and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly., Gradually add milk and next 4 ingredients., Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until mixture is thickened and bubbly., Cut each slice of toasted bread into 4 triangles., Serve chicken mixture with 4 toast triangles; sprinkle with paprika.

title: Banana Split Cake
directions: Crush graham crackers, 1 stick butter and sugar. Mix., Put in a square dish., Beat powdered sugar, egg and butter at medium speed for 15 minutes., Put on top of crumb mix., Slice bananas., Put on top. Put drained pineapple between bananas. Put Cool Whip onto that. Put nuts and cherries., Set overnight.

title: The Rattlesnake
directions: In pitcher, combine pineapple juice, tomato juice, sugar and hot pepper sauce; blend well., Pour over ice cubes in glass. Squeeze lime juice into each drink, if desired., Garnish with dried red pepper, ripe olive and lime peel., Makes 4 servings.

title: Chicken Mozzarella
directions: Marinate chicken in egg at least 1 hour., Roll in bread crumbs and brown in butter., Place in baking dish., Top with mushrooms, then cover with cheese; add chicken broth., Bake at 350°, covered, for 30 minutes. Remove cover and bake 30 to 40 minutes more.

title: Lemon Bundt Cake
directions: Make cake mix according to directions only at the part for water add 3/4 cup lemon juice and the rest water (this is what makes your cake moist)., Bake at 350° for 45 to 55 minutes., Place on round cake plate, cool.

title: Creamy Broccoli (Or Cauliflower) Bake
directions: Heat 1-inch salted water to boiling. Add broccoli (or cauliflower)., Cover and heat to boiling., Cook until stems are almost tender (10 to 12 minutes). Drain., Place broccoli (or cauliflower) in ungreased 1 1/2-quart round casserole dish.

title: Lemon Squares
directions: Mix oleo, powdered sugar, flour and salt together., Press in 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake 20 minutes at 350° oven., Beat eggs; add sugar, 6 tablespoons flour and lemon juice., Pour on baked crust. Bake 25 minutes at 350°., Sprinkle with powdered sugar., Cut into squares.

title: Potato Soup
directions: In Dutch oven, cook hamburger with garlic and seasoned salt until brown; drain., Add onion, celery and dill weed., Add water (just enough to cover ingredients)., Cover and simmer for at least 2 hours., Add water if needed., Add potatoes, along with more water, to cover ingredients., Cook until potatoes are tender (not mushy)., Add milk; stir and skim off fat., Great with French bread and butter.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
directions: Cream oil and sugar together., Add eggs and mix well., Add flour, soda, cinnamon, apples and pecans., Mix well., (Batter will be stiff, apples will add moisture when cooked.), Bake in preheated oven for 1 1/2 hours at 325° in a tube pan.

title: Top Secret Chili
directions: Brown beef in skillet; drain off fat. In a large pot, combine beef and other ingredients and bring to a simmer over very low heat. Cook, stirring often to prevent sticking. Cook 2 to 3 hours. Makes 12 servings.

title: Sand Tarts
directions: Combine all ingredients and chill for one hour., Bake at 300° for 20 to 30 minutes, but not browned., Roll immediately in powdered sugar.

title: Raspberry Dessert
directions: Melt oleo and mix with crumbs and brown sugar., Press into bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan to make bottom layer; let set.

title: Pasta And Ricotta Stuffed Red Peppers
directions: Chop the onion., Mince the garlic., Grate the Mozzarella and Parmesan., Cut tops off peppers., Remove the seeds and ribs., Cook peppers in a pot of boiling salted water just until soft, about 30 minutes., Heat oven to 350°.

title: Light Fruit Cake
directions: Cream butter and sugar., Add eggs one at a time., Add 2 1/2 cups flour (save 1/2 cup to flour fruit), vanilla flavoring, milk, raisins, 1 pound pineapple, cherries, mixed fruit, coconut and pecans., Add crushed pineapple last., Bake at 250° for approximately 3 to 3 1/2 hours.

title: Watergate Salad
directions: Mix pudding (dry) and pineapple together until well blended. Add Cool Whip to pudding mixture until well blended., Chill for 2 to 3 hours., Extra nuts or coconut can be added, if desired.

title: Golden Pound Cake
directions: Note:, Allow butter, eggs and milk to get room temperature.

title: Leftover Corn-Off-The-Cob
directions: Cut corn from cob and scrape cob; set aside., Melt butter in large skillet., Add chopped onion and cover. Stir once or twice until onion is translucent., Add corn and milk if corn is dry. Cover and heat through., Season to taste., Sprinkle with cheese if desired.

title: Piping Hot Venison Dip
directions: Spread refried beans in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan., Brown meat and remove from heat., Add taco mix, enchilada sauce and taco sauce., Mix well and pour over beans., Spread cheese on top., Heat in 400° oven 15 to 20 minutes or until bubbly., Spread sour cream over cheese and return to oven for 5 minutes., Use spoon to dip and serve with nacho chips.

title: Tamale Dip
directions: Cut up Velveeta cheese in small pieces,, Add Chili Con Carne, salsa and canned chilies., Unwrap and cut up the tamales in bite size., Mix all ingredients well and place in a deep dish and bake for 30 -35 minutes in a 350° oven., Serve with chips or crackers.

title: Fried Noodles
directions: Heat skillet; add oil. Mix all the rest of ingredients and dump into skillet. Pack down in skillet. Lower heat. Simmer 10 to 15 minutes. Turn when golden brown and cook other side. Invert onto plate. Garnish with parsley. Serve with broiled meat.

title: Easy Coffee Cake
directions: Mix together cake mix, eggs and fruit pie filling., Spread in 9 x 13-inch pan., Top with mixture of butter, flour and brown sugar., It should be crumbly., Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Blueberry Dump Cake
directions: Melt butter in a 9 x 13-inch pan., Sweeten blueberries to taste and place in melted butter., Cover with crushed pineapple (do not drain)., Pour cake mix on top of this mixture (do not stir)., Sprinkle with nuts., Bake at 350° for 40 minutes., Serve with ice cream or whipped topping.

title: Steak N' Mushroom Casserole
directions: Flour meat and season with salt and pepper., Brown in butter. Place meat in casserole dish. Cook onions until tender but not brown; add soup, milk and mushrooms., Heat to boiling., Pour over steak., Bake, covered, at 325° for 1 hour and 30 minutes or until tender.

title: Seafood Ball
directions: Mix cream cheese and crabmeat thoroughly., Shape into ball or log in serving dish., Chill until ready to serve. At serving time, pour cocktail sauce over seafood ball and sprinkle top with parsley flakes., Serve with Triscuits or crackers.

title: Polynesian Beef
directions: Brown beef in shortening on top of stove., Add remainder of ingredients. Simmer 1 hour until tender. Serve over or with cooked white rice.

title: Lime Jello Salad
directions: Dissolve Jell-O in 1 cup boiling water., Cool., Add evaporated milk., Chill until slightly set., Blend mayonnaise and softened cream cheese., Add to thickened Jell-O mixture., Drain pineapple and fruit cocktail., Add fruits to Jell-O mixture., Pour into mold., Does well in Tupperware mold.

title: Chicken Pillows
directions: Cut chicken breasts in one-inch pieces., Marinate in lemon juice, oil, oregano, salt and garlic., Unwrap phyllo dough; place on wax paper and keep covered to keep moist., Cut dough in half lengthwise forming 2 strips each 6-inches wide., Fold in half crosswise; brush with melted butter., Put two pieces of chicken at short end and roll; form a package., Brush with melted butter and bake at 400° for about 15 minutes.

title: Roasted Smoked Goose
directions: Cut snapping turtle meat into steaks (thick as possible) and batter down with hands., Saute in butter and season to taste. Serve with jelly or appropriate sauce.

title: Seafood File Gumbo
directions: In a medium sized pot, make a roux with flour and oil., Saute onions and celery on high for 3 minutes., Stir in water and seasoning and chicken., Cover and cook for 15 minutes., Add shrimp and crabs; reduce heat., Cook 25 minutes; add oysters, juice and sausage., Cook 10 minutes., Sprinkle with file.

title: Apple Cinnamon Cake
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Blend cake mix, pie filling and eggs in a large mixing bowl., Beat at medium speed for 2 minutes., Combine sugar and cinnamon., Spread half cake mixture in a greased 13 x 9-inch pan., Sprinkle with 1/2 sugar mixture., Repeat with remaining batter and sugar mixture., Bake for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: 100 Cookies
directions: Cream oleo, oil and sugars., Add beaten egg and vanilla., Add dry ingredients, oatmeal, Rice Krispies and coconut; mix well. Roll into balls from tablespoon., Flatten with glass dipped in sugar., Bake at 350° for 9 to 10 minutes on a greased cookie sheet.

title: Potato Filling
directions: Melt 1/4 pound butter in each of 2 skillets., In one, brown the bread cubes until crisp., In the other, stir-fry onions and celery until soft and translucent., Mash the potatoes, adding the milk, eggs, salt and parsley., Fold in the celery and onion mixture and the bread cubes carefully so the cubes remain whole. Pour into a large baking dish and bake at 350° for 1/2 hour.

title: Barbecue Sauce
directions: Simmer until thick, about 1/2 hour.

title: Honey Nut Spread
directions: Combine cream cheese and honey, mixing until well blended. Stir in nuts., Chill., Great for topping pumpkin muffins!

title: Pear Relish
directions: Mix in order given and bring to boil. Simmer 15 minutes. Pack into sterilized jars and seal at once.

title: Ruben Casserole
directions: Combine kraut, onion, parsley and seed in 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Top with 2 cups cheese and 2/3 cup dressing., Layer beef slices. Add rest of cheese and dressing., Toss bread cubes with margarine and spread on top., Bake in 375° oven for 35 minutes.

title: Kluskis
directions: In large bowl, tear bread into dime size pieces., Mix both turkey and hamburger with bread., Add all remaining ingredients except 1/2 cup Worcestershire and 1 stick margarine or butter. Make into patties., Melt butter or margarine in large frying pan; add 1/2 cup Worcestershire on medium to medium-low heat; fry slowly covered, approximately 10 to 15 minutes each side or until no longer red in middle.

title: Sausage Balls
directions: Let sausage and cheese stand at room temperature before making., Mix together with Bisquick and sauce., Form into small balls and place on ungreased pans and bake at 375° for 15 minutes. Cool and freeze., Reheat before serving.

title: Stollen
directions: Combine fruits and nuts in bowl and dredge with 1/4 cup flour. Heat milk in small saucepan (or in microwave bowl in microwave oven) until very warm, not hot., Pour into large bowl., Sprinkle yeast and the 1/2 teaspoon sugar into milk., Stir to dissolve; let stand until bubbly, about 10 minutes., Stir in remaining sugar, softened shortening, eggs, salt, cardamon, lemon rind, almond and rum flavorings and 3 cups of the flour., Beat until smooth., Stir in enough of the remaining flour to make a soft dough., Turn out onto a floured surface., Knead until smooth and elastic, about 15 minutes, using only as much additional flour as needed to keep dough from sticking.

title: Butterscotch Brownies
directions: Cook butter and sugar over low heat until bubbly., Cool and add eggs, one at a time, beating thoroughly., Add vanilla and cream, then sifted dry ingredients and coconut., Mix thoroughly., Nuts may be added., Spread in shallow pan (greased) and bake at 350° for about 25 minutes., While warm, cut in squares.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
directions: Beat butter, sugars, vanilla, water and eggs until light and fluffy., Mix flour with soda and salt; blend into butter mixture. Stir in nuts and chips., Drop 2 inches apart from teaspoon onto greased baking sheets or pour onto cookie sheet., Bake at 375° for 8 to 10 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Italian Shrimp
directions: In large shallow baking dish, add shrimp to all other ingredients., Bake at 450° for 5 minutes., Turn to broil for additional 5 minutes., Serve over rice.

title: Zucchini Casserole
directions: Cook zucchini and onion in boiling salted water for 5 minutes; drain well., Mix sour cream, soup, carrots, garlic and Tabasco sauce; set aside., Combine stuffing and melted margarine., Put half of this crumb mixture in 8 x 11-inch or 9 x 13-inch baking dish., Add the zucchini to the sour cream and soup mixture; pour over crumbs., Cover with remaining crumbs., Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Monkey Bread
directions: Combine milk, sugar, margarine and salt., Heat until margarine melts., Cool to 115°., Stir in yeast mix and flour., Cover and let rise., Roll out and cut into squares., Dip in margarine., Put in Bundt pan and let rise again., Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Pasta Primavera With Shrimp
directions: Cook fettucine in salted water to desired doneness., Drain and rinse with hot water., In large skillet melt margarine; saute onion and garlic until tender., Add shrimp and saute 2 to 3 minutes. Remove shrimp from skillet; keep warm., Add 2 tablespoons margarine and whipping cream to skillet; heat until margarine melts., Stir in cheese, salt and pepper., In large saucepan combine fettucine, broccoli, and cream mixture; cook until thoroughly heated., Place on warm serving platter; spoon shrimp over top., Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Black Bean Casserole
directions: Soak beans 4 to 8 hours, then cook by bringing to a boil. Simmer until done., Cook rice by instructions on bag., Cook beans with coriander, cumin and garlic., Place beans in a large casserole dish., Add rice, then chopped tomatoes with juice., Add cheese and olives., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Watergate Salad
directions: Mix unprepared pudding with pineapple., Then add Cool Whip and nuts., Fold in marshmallows.

title: Chinese Stir-Fry Lamb With Vegetables
directions: Marinate lamb in soy sauce, brandy, garlic and cornstarch for one hour or more., Heat a wok or large skillet., Add oil to thinly coat bottom of pan., Add salt and ginger., Cook until ginger begins to brown and dry up., Add lamb with marinade, all at once, and saute until lightly browned., Add onions and bouillon., Cover and cook until meat is as done as you like it (about 1 minute for rare)., Remove cover and add bean sprouts, snow peas, water chestnuts and cashews., Cook about one minute more, stirring constantly., Serve over cooked rice.

title: Texas Casserole
directions: Brown the meat, onions and garlic., Drain off excess fat., Add the 2 cans of soup and a small amount of water, bring to boil and let simmer while cooking the macaroni shells.

title: Peanut Butter Kisses
directions: Mix peanut butter, sugar and eggs., Roll dough into balls and place on cookie sheets., Bake at 375 for 8-12 minutes or until lightly brown., As soon as they come out of the oven firmly place a kiss in the center of each of the cookies., Cool., Store in airtight container.

title: Wayne'S Asparagus Casserole
directions: Melt butter in saucepan., Add flour, liquid from asparagus and cream of asparagus soup; heat until creamy., Combine milk and cornstarch; add this to mixture and cook until thickened., In casserole dish, layer with 1/2 of the English peas and 1/2 the asparagus, then covered with half of thickened sauce and repeat with remaining peas, asparagus and sauce., Top with grated cheese and bake at 350° until heated throughout and cheese is melted, about 15 to 20 minutes., Watch closely.

title: Peanut Butter Chiffon No-Bake Pie
directions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water., Cool to lukewarm., Whip cheese until soft and fluffy., Beat in sugar and peanut butter. Slowly add gelatin mixture., Fold in whipped topping., Pour into pie shell., Sprinkle with peanuts until firm., Refrigerate and leave 1 to 2 hours., I always do overnight as the longer, the better the flavor., Yields:, 6 to 8 servings.

title: Marinated Vegetables
directions: Blend these ingredients and pour over vegetables., Refrigerate and marinate 48 hours., (Shake or stir occasionally.), Keeps for several days.

title: No Bake Cheesecake
directions: Beat cheese until smooth; gradually beat in sugar., Blend in sour cream and vanilla., Fold in whipped topping., Blend well. Spoon into crust., Chill until set, at least 4 hours., Garnish with fresh strawberries.

title: Meat Loaf Supreme
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., In a large bowl, combine all ingredients., Mix well., In a large, shallow baking dish, shape into a loaf., Bake 1 hour.

title: Cheese Puffs
directions: Separate biscuits; cut each into thirds., Wrap dough around cheese cubes; seal well., Fry in hot fat 2 to 3 minutes until brown.

title: Chicken Enchiladas
directions: Cook tortillas in oil., Fill with chicken, onions and cheese.

title: Salad(Cranberry)
directions: For syrup, bring to boil the sugar and water; add cranberries and cook until they pop., Dissolve Jell-O with 2 cups boiling water., Add to Jell-O the cooked berries, pineapple and nuts., Put in refrigerator to jell.

title: Out Of This World Pie
directions: Cook first four ingredients until thickened., Then add last four items., Mix together gently., Pour into pie crust., Top with whipped cream., Makes 2 pies.

title: Cranberry Salad
directions: Mix Jell-O in water. Let it dissolve, then add all other ingredients. Mix well. Put in refrigerator and let it jell.

title: Onion Squares
directions: In a skillet, saute the onion in the butter., In a bowl, combine the muffin mix, egg, milk, corn and Tabasco to taste. Pour into a greased 8 x 8 inch pan., Add the sour cream, salt, dill weed and 1/2 c. cheese to the sauteed onions, and spread all over the batter., Sprinkle with the remaining cheese and bake at 425° for 25-30 minutes., Cut into squares and serve warm.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients (except coconut) well with mixer., Add coconut and mix with spoon., Pour into oven baking dish., Top with topping.

title: Green Bean Casserole
directions: Drain canned beans., Combine beans, mushroom soup, milk, bacon bits, salt and pepper., Turn mixture into a 1-quart casserole dish., Bake, uncovered, in a 350° oven for 35 minutes., Sprinkle with French fried onions., Continue baking about 5 minutes.

title: World'S Best Sugar Cookies
directions: Mix flour, baking soda, cream of tartar and salt together and set aside., Mix together sugars, margarine and almond extract. Stir in oil and eggs., Mix with electric mixer until well mixed. Add flour mixture one cup at a time., Use electric mixer until mixture becomes very thick, finish mixing with a wooden spoon. Chill dough., Roll chilled dough into walnut-sized balls., Place on cookie sheet., Press with fork or a tumbler dipped in sugar., Bake 10 to 12 minutes at 350°.

title: Red Snapper With Honey Mustard Sauce
directions: Rinse fish and pat dry., Place in a baking dish., Combine first 7 ingredients., Stir with a wire whisk until well blended., Pour mixture over fish, cover and marinate 30 minutes to an hour in refrigerator., Remove fish from marinade., Coat grill with vegetable spray and grill fish over hot coals or broil 6 minutes on each side or until fish flakes., Baste with extra marinade.

title: Sweet Rolls
directions: Spray Bundt pan with Pam., Sprinkle a few nuts in bottom of pan., Stand up biscuits in circle of pan., Mix Jell-O pudding mix, brown sugar and nuts., Sprinkle mix over and between biscuits. Pour the melted butter or oleo over top and bake at 350° for 30 or 35 minutes., Turn out onto plate and serve while warm.

title: Orange Julius
directions: Blend until smooth., Serves 4-6., Note:, Can use small pkg. of frozen strawberries and 1 banana instead of orange juice.

title: Mexican Dip
directions: Mash avocados., Add lemon juice, salt and pepper., In separate bowl, mix sour cream, mayonnaise and taco seasoning., Refrigerate both mixtures.

title: Seasoned Pecans
directions: Heat oven to 300°., Melt butter, salt and hot sauce., Add pecans., Stir to coat., Bake 20 minutes, stirring every 2 to 5 minutes., Sprinkle with the Worcestershire sauce.

title: Coconut Cake
directions: Stir shortening to soften., Gradually add 2 cups sugar and cream together until light and fluffy., Add extract., Sift 3 cups flour, baking powder and salt together 3 times; add to creamed mixture alternately with milk and water, a small amount each time. Beat after each addition until smooth., Fold in egg whites., Bake in 2 paper-lined 9 x 9 x 1 3/4-inch pans in moderate oven at 350° for about 30 minutes., Put layers together with the following filling.

title: Sausage Rolls Canadian
directions: Combine softened cream cheese or margarine, mixing until well blended., Add flour; mix well., Shape into ball; chill., Cut sausage links in half crosswise., Simmer in water 2 minutes; drain., Cool., Divide dough in half., On lightly floured surface, roll out each half to 12-inch square., Cut each square into 16 (3 x 3-inch) pieces., Spread each piece with mustard to within 1/2 inch of edge., Roll around sausage half; seal ends., Dip each roll in seed., Place seam-side down on ungreased cookie sheet., Bake at 375° for 20 to 25 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Zucchini Raisin Bread
directions: Beat eggs and sugar., Add oil and vanilla., Combine dry ingredients., Mix all together., Add squash., Bake in 3 loaf pans., Cook 55 minutes at 325°., Freezes well.

title: Mock Apple Dumplings
directions: Blend flour, baking powder, salt, sugar and shortening like pie crust., Add milk and mix thoroughly until forms a soft dough. On a floured surface, pat dough, then roll out to a rectangular shape with 1/4-inch to 1/2-inch thickness., Spread softened margarine over the dough., Sprinkle cinnamon, sugar, apples, and more cinnamon and sugar., Roll up like a jelly roll., Cut in 2-inch slices and place in 9 x 13-inch pan (sprayed)., Pour Syrup (recipe follows) over slices., Bake at 425° for 30 minutes or tops are golden brown and center is firm., Serve warm or cold.

title: Stir Crazy Chocolate Brownies
directions: Combine first five ingredients., Then add the liquids., Stir well., Pour into 9 x 9-inch pan., Sprinkle 1 tablespoon uncooked oatmeal over top of batter., Bake at 350° for 15 to 17 minutes for chewy brownies., Yields 16 pieces., Has 68 calories., Exchange:, 1 starch.

title: Apple Torte
directions: Mix all the ingredients together., Grease a 9-inch glass pie plate., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or more., Check for doneness. You can double this recipe.

title: Fruit Salad With Sauce
directions: Cook until mixture has some thickness; cool., Add all kinds of fruit (canned or fresh)., Also you can add nuts or coconut.

title: Red Velvet Cake
directions: Cream Crisco and sugar; add eggs., Sift dry ingredients 3 times., Add, dry, ingredients to creamed mixture alternately with buttermilk., Add, vanilla, and food coloring., Beat well. Fold in soda, dissolved, in, vinegar., Bake, in 3 greased and floured 9-inch, pans, at, 350° for 30 minutes., Cool and frost with White Frosting for Red Velvet Cake.

title: Cheese Ball
directions: Combine all ingredients together., Hold out 1 cup pecans. Mold ingredients into a ball and roll in the remaining cup of pecans., Refrigerate.

title: Turkey And Mushroom Croquettes
directions: Make thick sauce., Melt 4 tablespoons butter. Add 4 tablespoons flour. Add stock and milk., Bring to a boil., Cook until thick and smooth. Add seasonings and parsley., Let cool.

title: Monterey Spaghetti
directions: Cook spaghetti according to package directions., In a medium bowl, beat egg., Add sour cream, Parmesan cheese and garlic powder., Drain spaghetti., Add to egg mixture with cheese, spinach and half of onions., Pour into a greased 2-quart baking dish. Cover and bake at 350° for 30 minutes., Top with remaining onions. Return to oven for 5 minutes.

title: Hamburg Pie
directions: Boil potatoes until soft, then drain. In the meantime, brown beef and onion. Mix in beans and soup and add salt and pepper to taste. Spread meat mix in a Dutch oven. Mash potatoes and mix in milk, eggs, salt and pepper to taste. Spread mashed potatoes on top of meat mix, leaving edges open for bubbling. Bake at 350° for approximately 30 minutes until top browns.

title: Mexican Lasagna
directions: In a skillet, brown the ground beef and drain., Stir in 1/2 cup salsa., Spread 1/4 cup salsa in a glass baking dish., Top with 3 or 4 taco shells., Top with half of each:, beans, meat mixture, sour cream and cheese., Repeat layers; cover with foil., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes., Top with lettuce and remaining salsa., This dish will serve 6 to 8 people.

title: Whipped Yellow Turnips
directions: Cook potatoes and turnips in boiling salt water to cover in 3-quart covered saucepan over medium heat, about 20 minutes. Drain., Return to pan., Shake pan over low heat a few seconds to dry., Mash vegetables., Add remaining ingredients., Beat with fork until fluffy.

title: Pancakes
directions: Mix thoroughly and fry on a hot griddle.

title: Greek Salad
directions: Break lettuce in small pieces., Place in salad bowl with celery, onions, cucumbers, green pepper and tomato., Pour only enough dressing over vegetables to lightly coat each piece. Garnish with cubes of Feta cheese, anchovy fillets, Calamata olives and boiled shrimp (optional).

title: Mocha Devil'S Food Cake
directions: Stir 3 tablespoons powdered instant coffee into devil's food cake (dry mix) or use strong cold coffee in place of water., Mix and bake as directed., Cool. Frost with Mocha Butter Icing.

title: Dill Dip
directions: Mix all together., Refrigerate for 24 hours.

title: Baked Beans
directions: Cook hamburger, onion, celery and green pepper in bacon grease until brown. Drain hamburger (if needed)., Add other ingredients and cook 2 hours at 350°.

title: Eggfree Spice Cake
directions: Mix sugar and margarine well., Mix together dry ingredients and add., Mix until well blended., Put in a bread tin and bake in a preheated 300° oven for 1 hour.

title: Green Pepper Steak
directions: Cook beef and green peppers in electric skillet until done. Add both cans of soup, water and soy sauce. Stir until celery soup is thinned out. Simmer. Pour over rice.

title: Nut And Raisin Bread
directions: Heat skillet until almost smoking., Turn burner down to low. Mix 1 to 1 1/2 cups corn meal mix, milk and egg., May also add chopped onion and/or sour cream., Add water if needed to make batter thin like cake batter., Pour into hot skillet and place lid on., Then turn batter and let cook., Crack lid to let the steam out so cornbread will not be soggy., One bag of self-rising corn meal is used.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
directions: Thoroughly cream shortening, sugars, eggs and vanilla., Stir in peanut butter., Sift dry ingredients and stir into creamed mixture., Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls on ungreased cookie sheet. Press with back of floured fork to make crisscross., Bake at 350° for about 10 minutes., Makes about 5 dozen.

title: Crab Meat Casserole
directions: Blend butter with flour., Add tomato soup and sour cream., Cook spinach with onion according to package directions., Line baking dish with this mixture., Cover with raw rice, then crab meat and add sauce., Top with grated cheese., Bake at 350° until thoroughly hot and cheese melts, about 30 to 40 minutes., Season to taste. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Smothered Round Steak
directions: Clean and trim, excess fat from steak., Cut into 3-inch wide by, 5-inch, long, pieces., Salt and pepper the steak and dredge in, the flour., In a frypan, place the cooking oil and heat. Place, steak, in, frypan and cook, turning occasionally until done., Remove from the frypan and add remaining flour to the cooking oil;, stir until brown., Add water to make gravy a smooth texture., Add, onions., Return, the, steak., Cover and cook, for an, additional, 10, to, 15 minutes over a low fire. Serves 6 to 7.

title: Creamed Green Beans And Potatoes
directions: Melt butter., Fry onions in butter, then add flour., Stir and add milk., In separate pan, boil water and add bouillon cube., Add to first mixture., Cube potatoes and mix with green beans., Pour cream sauce over both.

title: Kraut Salad
directions: Bring to a boil the sugar, oil, vinegar and salt., Add remaining ingredients and let stand 12 to 24 hours in refrigerator., Will keep for days.

title: Bride'S Salad
directions: Dissolve gelatin in hot water., Chill until slightly thickened., Add remaining ingredients., Chill for several hours or until firm.

title: Mom'S Chocolate Pie
directions: Beat eggs and sugar well, then add cocoa and flour., Put in microwave until thoroughly heated., Bake pie crust with pie weights until brown., Pour filling into baked crust, filling will be very thick., For meringue: beat 1/2 cup sugar and 3 egg whites until stiff peaks form., Bake pie with meringue on top until browned.

title: Hamburg Casserole
directions: Cooking Time: 40 minutes., Servings: 4 to 6.

title: Squash Pickle Relish
directions: Cook all together until tender., Process for 5 minutes in water bath cooker.

title: Golden Top Stroganoff
directions: Heat oven to 375°., Grease 2-quart casserole., Cook noodles according to package directions., Brown meat and drain., Put into casserole and mix in 1/2 can of onions., Prepare gravy mix according to package directions, except increase water to 1 1/4 cups., When thickened, add 1/2 cup sour cream, mixing well., Drain noodles., Return to pan., Pour and stir in the gravy mixture. Spread this over the meat/onions in casserole., To remaining sour cream, add egg and seasoned salt, mixing well with a fork., Pour over noodles, making sure all are covered., Bake for 25 minutes, uncovered., Top with remaining onions and bake 5 minutes more. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Roast On The Grill
directions: Pierce chuck roast; cover with meat tenderizer and pepper well. Mix marinade of vegetable oil, ketchup, vinegar with garlic and a few shakes of Worcestershire sauce., Cover roast and marinate at least 12 hours., Grill and baste with marinade., Roast has better texture when room temperature before grilling.

title: German Pretzels
directions: Dissolve the yeast in the warm water., Add the table salt and sugar., Blend in the flour., Put on bread board and knead for 5 minutes or until smooth., Divide into 4 equal parts., Roll each part separately., Cut into 5 equal pieces., This will yield 20 small pieces, each of which will be rolled (like a rope) and formed into a pretzel., Place on lightly greased cookie sheets., Flip over; brush each pretzel with beaten egg and sprinkle with coarse salt., Let rise 20 minutes., Bake at 375° for 10 minutes or until lightly browned., Cool and place in airtight container and freeze. Thaw at room temperature and warm in oven., Serve plain or dip in cheese or mustard.

title: Hot Dog Chili
directions: Melt lard in heavy pot., Add hamburger, salt, pepper and chili powder., Chop onion fine and add., Stir in tomato juice., Let cook 1 hour or until thick as desired.

title: Grandmother'S Old Fashioned Pound Cake
directions: Cream butter, then sift sugar., Add to butter a little at time, until all is used., Then add egg yolks, beaten until light. Add flour gradually and last add beaten egg whites., Fold whites in lightly., Pour into a greased loaf pan or tube cake pan and bake 45 minutes in a moderate oven., Do not open oven door until cake has been in oven 40 minutes., A pan of water in bottom of stove helps.

title: Honey Baked Sweet Potatoes(Over 50 Years Old)
directions: Place potatoes in a baking dish., Combine butter and honey and pour over potatoes in a hot (400°) oven, 15 to 20 minutes, basting frequently.

title: Barbecued Baby Beef Ribs
directions: Wipe ribs with wet towel or with damp cloth., Place ribs in a single layer in a shallow roasting pan. Roast ribs at 450° for about 20 minutes, turning once.

title: Blueberry Pie
directions: Bake crusts with pecans on top; cool., Cream the cream cheese with 2 cups powdered sugar., Put a layer in each crust., Beat Dream Whip (2 envelopes) with cold milk., Put a layer in each crust., Divide pie filling on each pie., Garnish with remaining Dream Whip.

title: English Muffin Pizza
directions: On English muffin, spread chili sauce, add a slice of cheese, a slice of bacon and season with poultry seasoning., Broil in oven approximately 7 minutes.

title: Chicken Enchiladas
directions: Boil chicken and cut in bite size pieces. Chop onion and saute in butter in large skillet. Add green chilies, soup and water. Mix and simmer 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Gooey Butter Cake
directions: Mix cake mix, oleo and 1 egg together and press into pan (9 x 13-inch)., Cream together cream cheese, 2 eggs and powdered sugar. Pour over cake mix and bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Ranch Pretzels
directions: Heat oven to 250°., Break pretzels into pieces., Place in oven on cookie sheet for 20 minutes., While pretzels are baking, mix dressing, oil and dill weed., Remove pretzels and place into plastic bowl with lid; pour (well mixed) oil over pretzels, mix and shake., Place pretzels back on cookie sheet and bake 20 more minutes., Keep stored in plastic bowl.

title: Easy-As-Pie Pie
directions: In medium sized bowl, beat cream cheese until light and fluffy. Gradually add sweetened condensed milk and stir until well blended. Stir in lemon juice and vanilla. Turn into crust. Refrigerate (not freeze) 2 to 3 hours. Garnish with chilled cherry pie filling before serving.

title: One Egg Cake(From 1975 Edition)
directions: Stir ingredients until smooth., Bake at 375°., Good for strawberry shortcake.

title: Strawberry Pie
directions: Bring water, cornstarch, sugar and food coloring to a boil. Cook until thick and clear., Remove from stove and add Jell-O. Cool 10 minutes in freezer., Add strawberries and mix., Pour into pie shell., Chill in refrigerator, then top with Cool Whip.

title: Calico Salad
directions: Combine the first 7 ingredients., Make a dressing with the remaining ingredients., Pour over salad., Needs to set in refrigerator at least overnight., Will keep up to 6 weeks.

title: Shrimp Dip
directions: Mix cream cheese and Miracle Whip., Add other ingredients. Chill., Serve with crackers.

title: Hot Cheese Biscuits
directions: Mash cheese and crisco; cream well. Add flour and salt; Mix well. Roll into small balls; chill 1 hour. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 450° for 10 minutes. Balls will flatten as they cook.

title: Fudge
directions: Cook until thick when dropped in cold water., Beat all the time., Add the Marshmallow Fluff after removing from fire., Beat until thick., Pour over nuts.

title: Cherry Angel Food Cake
directions: Bake cake mix as directed on package., Cool., Beat whipping cream and powdered sugar in a chilled bowl until stiff., Fold in cherries, juice and nuts., Frost cake., Refrigerate.

title: Potato Casserole
directions: Blend cream cheese into hot potatoes., Beat and add eggs and chopped onion., Sprinkle with paprika., Bake at 400° for 30 minutes., Serves 12.

title: Beef Jerky
directions: Cut meat into 1/4-inch strips., Works better if meat is a little frozen., Mix ingredients., Marinate strips of meat overnight, mixing once or twice. Turn oven on to slowest temperature. Dry on oven rack for 3 or more hours or until meat is dark and cracks when it is bent., Remove and cool., Store in airtight container.

title: Beef Tenderloin With Peppercorns
directions: Cut tenderloin lengthwise to within 1/2 inch of opposite edge, leaving edge intact., Open tenderloin out flat., Place heavy-duty plastic wrap on tenderloin; pound meat to flatten., Remove wrap. Spread mustard; sprinkle sage, green peppercorns and 1/2 tablespoon each of black and white ground peppercorns., Fold tenderloin back over and tie with string at 3-inch intervals. Spread butter on top of tenderloin; sprinkle rest of peppercorns. Place on rack., Can bake at 425° for 30 to 45 minutes, or until meat thermometer inserted at thickest part of meat reads 140° for rare, 150° for medium or 160° for well done., Can also cook on gas grill., Serves 8.

title: Cowboy Cookies
directions: Cream butter and Crisco with sugars., Add eggs, one at a time. Add flour, soda and powder., Mix well., Add remaining ingredients., Mix., Bake at 350° for 10 minutes., (It's okay if they are light in color.), Grease cookie sheets first time only and drop in small/medium sized clusters.

title: Chicken And Dressing
directions: Cook the chicken until done., Pick the chicken off in pieces and layer in the bottom of a 9 x 11-inch pan., Prepare the stuffing by the directions on the box, then spread the stuffing over the chicken., Next, you will pour the soup over the stuffing (no water added)., Then bake for 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Mary Raper'S Lemonade Cookies
directions: Cream together the butter and sugar., Add eggs., Beat until light and fluffy., Sift together the flour and soda., Add alternately to creamed mixture with 1/2 cup of lemonade., Drop from teaspoon onto an ungreased cookie sheet., Bake at 400° for about 8 minutes or until lightly browned., Remove from baking sheet.

title: Cream Cheese Frosting
directions: Beat cream cheese, margarine, milk and vanilla in medium bowl with electric mixer on low speed until smooth. Gradually beat in powdered sugar on low speed, one cup at a time, until smooth. Frosts 1 (13 x 9-inch) cake generously or fills and frosts one 8 or 9-inch (2-layer) cake.

title: Pastry
directions: Add, boiling, water to, Crisco., Beat, until, water, is absorbed., Add flour and salt in, two cup, then one cup intervals. Blend well after, each, addition., The final cup should be added slowly, depending on, the humidity., You may not need a full cup. If you don't, use, it all immediately wrap in wax paper to refrigerate., Allow to come to room temperature after refrigeration.

title: Bananas Royale
directions: Stir topping, rum and cinnamon in 12-inch skillet., Quarter bananas by cutting in half lengthwise and crosswise., Cut again in half lengthwise to form 8 pieces per banana., Add bananas to topping mixture; heat thoroughly.

title: Corn Casserole
directions: Mix together and stir well., Pour into ovenproof dish. Sprinkle generously with Mexican style Velveeta on top., Cook at 350°, uncovered, for 30 minutes., Cover with foil and bake 30 minutes more.

title: Banana Punch Concentrate
directions: Mix well., Freeze in quarts., Use 1 quart slush with 2 quarts 7-Up.

title: Mama'S Lasagna
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Cook lasagna noodles and cool., Brown ground beef with garlic salt and pepper., Add mushrooms, onion and green pepper.

title: Barbecue Sauce
directions: Combine all ingredients in bowl., Mix well., Can use a blender.

title: Pumpkin Bread (Dave'S Favorite)
directions: Mix all together by hand or electric mixer (mixer is faster and more thorough)., Bake in loaf pans (greased), one pound coffee cans or other cans., Bake in preheated oven at 350° for 1 hour. Springs back to touch when done.

title: Fruit Cobbler
directions: Sprinkle cinnamon and nutmeg in batter., Melt butter and mix together the flour, sugar, baking pwd., salt and milk;, stir by hand until smooth., Pour batter over butter and dribble the fruit over the batter;, do not stir., Bake at 350° for 35 min. or until done.

title: Yorkshire Pudding
directions: Combine flour and salt., Add milk, eggs and oil., Whisk with a wire whip., Let, sit, for, about 2 hours while roast is cooking. Pour some of meat drippings into a 9 x 8-inch baking dish., Add batter and, cook, in, hot oven at 425° until batter rises in peaks about 30 minutes., Serve with roast beef.

title: Brownies
directions: Cream shortening, sugar and salt., Stir in the eggs., Mix altogether., Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Pork Chop And Potato Scallop
directions: Brown pork chops in skillet., Season with salt and pepper. Blend soup, sour cream, water and parsley.

title: Meat Loaf
directions: Fry sausage until done., Drain., Add other ingredients., Mix well., Shape into loaf and put in loaf pan or on baking sheet. Keep drained. Bake at 375° until done.

title: Ham Hocks And Turnip Greens
directions: Wash greens thoroughly, breaking off the tough stems., Place in pot with all other ingredients., Cover with boiling water and cook gently for 3 hours., When done, season to taste with salt and pepper., Drain.

title: Potluck Potatoes
directions: Combine first 7 ingredients., Pour into buttered 13 x 9-inch baking dish., Combine corn flakes (or Chex) with melted 1/4 cup butter; top casserole., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Calico Beans
directions: Brown ground beef with onion and drain., Cut bacon in small strips; brown and drain., Mix together and place in baking dish. Add remaining ingredients., Mix well., Bake 40 to 45 minutes. Makes 4 quarts., Does well in crock-pot.

title: Hawaiian Delight Cake
directions: Poke holes in cake., Pour crushed pineapple with juice over cake and spread evenly., Make pudding and spread over pineapple. Slice bananas and place over pudding mixture., Spread Cool Whip over bananas, and sprinkle with coconut.

title: Mother'S Cheese Loaf
directions: Shred cheese., Add crackers and pimento., Mix dry mustard, sugar and eggs., Add milk., Add vinegar very slowly., Cook over medium heat until thick., Add cheese mixture; stir well., Bake in cheese ring or baking dish at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Turkey 'N' Stuffing Pie(Microwave)
directions: In 9-inch round or fluted microwavable dish, place water and butter., Cook covered on High 3 minutes or until butter melts. Stir in stuffing crumbs and 1/2 can onions., Press stuffing mixture into dish as above., Reduce milk to 1/2 cup., In large microwave bowl, combine soup, milk, turkey and peas., Cook covered 8 minutes., Stir turkey mixture halfway through cooking time. Pour turkey mixture into stuffing shell., Cook uncovered 4 to 6 minutes., Rotate dish halfway through cooking time., Top with remaining onions; cook uncovered 1 minutes., Let stand 5 minutes.

title: Sweet Potato Biscuits
directions: Mix milk, potatoes and butter., Mix together flour, sugar, baking powder, salt and soda., Mix all together., Turn onto a floured board; knead 30 seconds., Roll 1/2-inch thick and cut with biscuit cutter., Bake in a 425° oven for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Jewish Apple Cake
directions: Mix cinnamon and 5 tablespoons sugar., Sprinkle apples with cinnamon/sugar mix., Set aside.

title: Strawberry Rhubarb Jam
directions: In a large kettle, combine strawberries, rhubarb, sugar and pineapple., Bring to a boil; reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes., Remove from the heat;, stir in gelatin until dissolved. Pour into jars or frozen containers, leaving 1/2-inch headspace. Top with lids; refrigerate or freeze.

title: Peanut Butter Play Dough(Play Dough You Can Eat.)
directions: Mix all ingredients until smooth., Let kids make critters of their choice out of the mixture., Decorate with peanuts, raisins, chocolate chips or coconut and eat.

title: Tears On Your Pillow Pie
directions: In a large bowl, beat together oleo, brown sugar, eggs, flour and milk., Pour into unbaked pie shell., Bake at 350° for 35 minutes., Turn off oven and leave pie in for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Crabmeat Quiche
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Bake pastry shell 5 minutes., Mix ingredients; pour into pastry shell., Bake 45 minutes., Let stand 10 to 12 minutes until firm before cutting into wedges., Serves 6 to 8.

title: Taverns
directions: Mix all ingredients except meat in pan and bring to boil., Add the hamburger meat., Crumble until well mixed with other ingredients., Boil 10 minutes, then simmer 20 minutes., Serve on hot toasted buns.

title: Ham Meat Loaf
directions: Mix together and form into a loaf., Place in a pan (loaf) and pour on can of Campbell's tomato soup over it., Bake 1 hour in oven at 375°.

title: Quick And Easy Pizza Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Place into a baking dish with cover., Top with Mozzarella cheese and bake 20 minutes at moderate heat., Serve hot.

title: Lemon Melts
directions: Mix dry ingredients., Cream butter and gradually add dry ingredients., Mix and chill 1 hour., Roll into balls and place on ungreased cookie sheet., Press with finger., Bake 12 to 15 minutes in a 350° oven.

title: Easy Chicken Pot Pie
directions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees., Mix soup, 1/4 c. milk, pepper, vegetables and chicken in 9 inch pie plate., Mix remaining milk, egg and baking mix., Pour over chicken mixture., Bake until golden brown.

title: Brownies
directions: Melt chocolate and margarine., Set aside., In large bowl with mixer, beat 4 eggs and 2 cups sugar., Add chocolate to margarine mixture and mix well., Gradually add flour., Add vanilla and 1 cup chocolate chips., Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes in a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.

title: Sicilian Cheese Ball
directions: Allow cheese to soften at room temperature., Blend all ingredients together until smooth (except nuts)., Chill for 2 hours., Shape into a ball and roll in chopped nuts., Refrigerate.

title: Stuffed Bread(Appetizer)
directions: Cook bacon until crisp., Drain., Reserve 2 tablespoons of drippings., Crumble bacon and set aside.

title: Apple Dumplings
directions: For syrup, mix water, sugar and cinnamon., Cook for 5 minutes (simmer), then add butter., While syrup is cooking, in a bowl put flour and shortening., Cut shortening into flour until it resembles coarse bread crumbs., Add milk all at once., Stir until moistened.

title: Peanut Butter Cornflake Candy
directions: Bring sugar and syrup to a boil., Turn off heat., Add peanut butter and beat until melted or smooth., Pour into cornflakes. Put in square pan., The cornflakes are not to be crushed., Use nonstick pan to mix in.

title: Spinach Casserole
directions: In an 8 x 8-inch pan, put your spinach or green beans on bottom, then pour the can of cream of mushroom soup over the top of the spinach or green beans., Sprinkle the top with the dried onions., Bake about 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Vanilla Cream Fraiche(Diabetic Recipe)
directions: In a small, chilled bowl, whip cream until almost stiff. Gently fold in the yogurt and vanilla., Chill in a covered container at least 2 hours to allow flavors to blend., Use as a topping for berries, other fruits and desserts.

title: Pasta Salad
directions: Cook and drain macaroni., Cool this and add the onion, pimientos, green pepper and cucumber.

title: Cranberry Salad
directions: Combine cranberries, marshmallows and sugar together., Chill overnight., Add apples, grapes, walnuts and salt., Add cream to mixture when ready to serve.

title: Party Nuts
directions: Melt margarine in jelly roll pan at 325°., Beat egg whites until stiff., Add sugar and salt; beat into meringue., Fold in nuts and spread over melted butter in pan., Bake at 325° for 30 to 35 minutes, turning with a spatula occasionally until all butter is absorbed., Cool., Store in airtight container.

title: Bill'S Buttermilk Coconut Pie
directions: Pour coconut into frozen pie shell., Melt butter and pour over coconut., Mix eggs, sugar, flour, buttermilk and vanilla; beat well., Pour over coconut in pie shell., Bake until brown.

title: Fruit Salad
