directions: Drain juice from fruit and measure 4 cups juice. Pour juice into pan. Add the dry jello, dry pudding mix and tapioca. Cook until thick. Let cool completely. Pour over fruit in large bowl. Will keep in refrigerator up to 3 weeks.

title: Cheese Potatoes
directions: Mix together in casserole dish., Keep enough cheese to top. Sprinkle with parsley and pepper., Bake at 350° for 45 to 60 minutes or until it bubbles up in the middle., If potatoes start to look dry, cover to finish baking.

title: Linguini With Fresh Clam Sauce
directions: Chop garlic and brown in skillet with olive oil., Shuck clams, reserving the juice., Chop clams and add to garlic and oil., Cook for 3 minutes., Add parsley and pepper; simmer for 5 minutes. Serve over freshly cooked linguini.

title: Happiness Cake
directions: Mix together thoroughly., Add tears of joy, sorrow and sympathy., Flavor with love and kindly service., Fold into daily life., Bake well with the warmth of human kindness and serve with a "smile" anytime.

title: Spanish Rice
directions: Brown rice in oil until golden brown., Add onion and garlic. Saute., Next add tomato sauce, water, salt and pepper., Bring to a boil, then lower to the lowest heat possible for 20 minutes. Turn off heat and keep covered for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Easy Banana Pudding
directions: Mix pudding and milk until it starts to thicken, then add the cream cheese and powdered sugar., Layer in dish:, wafers, bananas and filling., Top with Cool Whip.

title: Danish Kringle
directions: Mix butter and flour, then add cream., Roll out and cut in strips., Shape in figures of an 8., Brush with egg white and sprinkle with sugar., Bake at 350° for 10 minutes, checking often.

title: Key Lime Squares
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Combine butter/margarine, confectioners sugar, 2 cups flour and salt., Mix with a pastry blender or two knives until mixture is well blended., Pat evenly into a 15 x 10 x 1-inch jelly roll pan and bake 20 minutes., Beat eggs lightly. Stir in granulated sugar, 6 tablespoons flour, lime juice and rind. Mix well and spread over baked crust., Bake 25 minutes longer. Remove from oven and sift confectioners sugar over the top., Let cool and cut into squares.

title: Crock-Pot Baked Potatoes
directions: Like foil baked, but no oven heat!, Fill your crock-pot with washed and well-greased potatoes., Cook on low for 8 to 10 hours. This recipe is great when you are having a busy day!

title: Pineapple Upside-Down Cake
directions: Drain pineapple well., Melt butter in pan (9-inch round or 8 or 9-inch square)., Remove from heat and stir in brown sugar. Arrange pineapple and cherries in sugar mixture., Prepare crumb cake and pour over all in pan., Bake at 350° for 40 to 50 minutes until tests done.

title: Ham And Pineapple Skewers
directions: Fit the steel knife into the work bowl of a food processor. Combine flour, orange juice, mustard, baking powder, salt and pepper in a bowl., Process 10 seconds, until well mixed., Pour batter into a deep bowl., Cut bread and ham into 1/2 inch cubes. Place a cube of bread, a cube of pineapple and a cube of ham on wooden pick., Repeat to make 30 appetizers., Pour oil into a large deep skillet to the depth of 2 inches., Heat oil to 325°., Dip each appetizer into batter to coat completely., Carefully lower wooden picks into hot oil., Deep fry for about 5 minutes, until golden brown., Serve warm., Yield:, 30 appetizers., Carbohydrate 15 g, protein 3 g, fat 2 g, calories 82 g.

title: Chicken Diablo(Honey)
directions: Line baking pan with silver foil., Melt butter, honey and mustard., Stir in salt and curry powder., Brush on chicken before and during baking., Bake 1 to 1 1/4 hours at 350°.

title: Apple Butter Cookies
directions: Mix shortening and sugar until creamy., Add egg, cloves and apple butter., Sift in flour with baking powder, soda and cinnamon. Add raisins., Drop by teaspoon on cookie sheet., Bake in 350° oven for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Bars
directions: Combine sugar and graham cracker crumbs., Melt margarine and peanut butter in microwave., Mix both together., Press into 9 x 13-inch pan., Melt chocolate chips (2 minutes in microwave); stir for 90 seconds., Spread on crumb mixture., Refrigerate., Cut when cool., Easy and always a big hit!

title: Chicken Dijon(Low-Fat)
directions: Sprinkle chicken with salt, pepper and garlic powder., Mix mustard, yogurt and sour cream in a bowl., Dip chicken in mixture and cover with mixture., Place dipped chicken breasts in baking pan., Sprinkle with bread crumbs., Bake at 375° for 1 hour., Makes 4 servings.

title: Cole Slaw
directions: Chop cabbage fine., Add chopped green pepper, onion and shredded carrots.

title: Glorified Rice
directions: Whip cream until stiff., Add sugar, pineapple, vanilla and marshmallows (gently)., Add food coloring last., Chill very thoroughly before serving., Amount: 6 to 8 servings.

title: Finger Jello
directions: Stir Jell-o and gelatin together., Add boiling water., Pour into 9 x 13 pan and chill.

title: Cheesy Cherry Tomatoes
directions: Mash cheese and blend in sour cream, onion and pepper to taste. Cut a slice from top of tomatoes and scoop out centers., Fill tomato shells with cheese mixture., Makes 3 to 4 dozen.

title: Easy Chocolate Cake
directions: Sift sugar, flour, salt, cocoa and baking soda into ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan., Make a well in middle of ingredients and add combined vanilla, oil, cold water and vinegar., Stir until smooth with wire whisk., Bake 35 to 45 minutes at 350°., Cool, frost as desired.

title: Wacky Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°. Mix ingredients in a large bowl in the order given, adding water last. Stir only until moistened. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan sprayed with Pam., Bake for 30 minutes. Cool on rack., Serve with chilled peaches and whipped topping or ice cream.

title: Easy Potatoes
directions: Boil potatoes; cool and peel., Melt the margarine and quarter the potatoes., Put into shallow baking dish and pour the margarine over them., Turn each section of potato to coat with margarine well., Sprinkle with minced onion and seasoned salt., Top generously with Parmesan cheese and bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Kathy'S Strawberry Rhubarb Cake
directions: Grease 13 x 9 pan. Mix first 3 ingredients and set aside. Combine cake mixture and rhubarb mixture; pour into cake pan. Pour marshmallows on top. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Taco Salad
directions: Brown meat; add salt, pepper to taste and kidney beans. Simmer 15 minutes., Cool., Add rest of ingredients., Doritos and lettuce when serving.

title: Asparagus Soup
directions: Cut off top 1-inch of frozen asparagus and reserve., Chop up remaining asparagus stalks and place in blender., Add pint of half and half and blend on high for 1 minute., Put in saucepan, add tips of asparagus and bring to scald., Do not boil., Serve immediately with sprig of parsley and pinch of paprika.

title: Old Witch'S Magic Nut Cake
directions: In a, large, bowl, beat together eggs, pumpkin, oil and water. Add flour, sugar, baking soda, salt, nutmeg, cinnamon, raisins and, walnuts., Pour, the, batter, into, 3, buttered (1 pound) coffee cans., Place, in, oven at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes or until straw inserted in the cake comes out clean.

title: Spicy Oven Fries
directions: Wash potatoes; cut into wedges or 3/4-inch chunk slices. Drain., Place in a bowl; sprinkle with oil and toss lightly. Combine spices and cheese., In a separate bowl, put half of the potatoes in., Sprinkle half of the spice mixture over and toss lightly., After placing these potatoes in a single layer on a lightly oiled 10 x 15-inch pan, sprinkle spices over the remaining potatoes., Bake at 425° to 450° for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Betsy'S Salad Dressing
directions: Blend well in blender., Serve over fresh vegetable salad.

title: Large Shell Macaroni And Sausage
directions: In large skillet, brown sausage; drain off excess fat., Add bell pepper and onion; cook until tender., Stir in tomatoes and tomato sauce (cut up the tomatoes with fork)., Add sugar, salt and chili powder., Mix., Cover and simmer for 45 minutes., Cook large shell macaroni according to directions on package; drain thoroughly., Add cooked shell macaroni to sauce., Stir in sour cream; heat thoroughly., Pass the grated Parmesan cheese.

title: Kids Finger Paints
directions: Press a block of styrofoam into a small flowerpot., Poke a peppermint stick into the middle of the block., Pour enough uncooked rice or beans into the pot to completely cover the styrofoam., They'll keep the pot from tipping.

title: Two Bean Salad
directions: Mix and let stand for 1 hour or longer.

title: Crusty Scalloped Potatoes
directions: Add milk to soup., Heat to boiling., Add onion, cheese, salt and pepper., Arrange alternate layers of soup mixture and cooked potatoes in buttered casserole dish., Sprinkle corn flakes on top. Melted brown butter may be added to the top., Bake at 350°, for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Chicken Enchiladas
directions: Mix chicken, sour cream, enchilada sauce, green chiles and chicken broth in pan and heat., Fry tortillas until softened. Layer in shallow pan the sauce, tortillas and onion and top with cheese., Bake at 375° for 30 minutes.

title: Baked Pecans (Sweet)
directions: Put nuts in mixture and coat., Spread nuts on baking sheet and bake in 250° oven for 1 hour., Turn nuts every 15 minutes.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Simmer broccoli, onion and butter until soft., Add soup and cheese., Mix well., Add rice., Mix well., Bake at 350° until real hot and brown.

title: Holiday Wreaths
directions: Line two large cookie sheets with wax paper., In top of double boiler, combine marshmallows, butter or margarine, vanilla and food coloring., Heat over boiling water, stirring frequently, until marshmallows are melted., Gradually stir in cornflakes. Drop by rounded, greased teaspoonfuls onto lined cookie sheets. Shape into 2-inch wreaths., Decorate with red candies., Store between layers of wax paper in refrigerator., Makes about 2 1/2 dozen, about 60 calories each.

title: Tandy Kake
directions: Cream eggs, vanilla, sugar, oil and salt. Add flour, alternating with milk. Beat. Pour into greased cookie sheet at 350° for 25 minutes. Check by pressing center or when edges separate from sides of pan. While hot, spread with peanut butter. (In a large cookie sheet, you may need more than 3/4 cup of peanut butter to cover.) Allow to cool at room temperature until peanut butter is set. Melt the Hershey bars in the microwave. Caution against burning. Pour onto peanut butter topping and spread to cover.

title: Kip'S Strawberry Pie
directions: Mix cream cheese and confectioners sugar; add whipped topping and strawberries and mix well by hand., Put in crust and garnish with strawberries., Chill.

title: Baby Food Cake
directions: Mix well., Grease and flour tube pan., Bake 1 hour at 350°.

title: Layered Bean Dip
directions: Spread bean dip in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan., Mix lemon juice, avocado, garlic salt, sour cream, mayonnaise and taco seasoning together., Spread on top of bean dip., Layer tomatoes, onions and cheese dip., Top with black olives.

title: Lick-It Glue
directions: Mix gelatine and fruit juice in a small saucepan., Bring to a boil until gelatine is completely dissolved., Using a paintbrush, brush warm solution on one side of a sheet of paper., Dry overnight., Children may then color the uncoated side of the paper and cut it apart., Lick and stick, instant stamps!

title: Fresh Apple Cake
directions: Mix well the oil, sugar, vanilla and eggs., Then add flour, soda and apple pie spice., Mix well., Last, add apples and nuts. Mix well., Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until toothpick inserted comes out clean.

title: California Chicken
directions: Sprinkle onion soup mix over bottom of 17 x 13-inch buttered pan., Sprinkle rice evenly over soup mix., Place chicken on top of rice., Dilute mushroom soup with water and pour over chicken., Dot with butter., Bake uncovered at 325° for 1 1/2 hours., Serves 5 to 6.

title: Cheese Ball 2
directions: Mix ingredients thoroughly until smooth., Form into 2 balls and roll in chopped nuts., Chill 2 hours.

title: Poppy Seed Cake
directions: Mix water, oil and pudding mix. Beat in eggs, one at a time. Blend with cake mix and poppy seed., Place in a Bundt pan, greased and floured or sprayed with Pam., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes. Allow to cool in pan for 15 minutes.

title: Chocolate Chip Pound Cake
directions: Mix sugar, oil and water., Add cake mix, instant chocolate pudding, eggs, and sour cream., Mix well., Stir in chocolate chips., Pour into a greased and floured tube pan., Bake at 325° for 50 to 60 minutes., Cool in pan a few minutes and then turn out onto serving plate., Either sprinkle with powdered sugar or ice immediately while still hot with Chocolate Frosting.

title: Jiffy Potato Casserole
directions: Mix soups, milk, sour cream, seasonings and hash browns., Pour into a 9 x 13 x 2-inch baking dish., Sprinkle cheese on top., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Russian Tea
directions: Boil water, sugar, cloves and cinnamon for 5 minutes in 4 to 6 quart pot., Add remaining ingredients and bring to boil and let simmer for 30 minutes., Makes 1 gallon.

title: Magic Cookie Bars
directions: Pour melted butter onto the bottom of a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Sprinkle crumbs evenly over melted butter., Sprinkle nuts evenly over crumbs., Scatter chocolate pieces over nuts., Sprinkle coconut evenly over chocolate pieces., Pour sweetened condensed milk evenly over coconut., Bake at 350° for 25 minutes or until lightly browned on top., Cool in pan 15 minutes., Cut into bars. Makes about 2 dozen 1 1/2 x 3-inch bars.

title: Philly Fruit Pizza
directions: Cut cookie dough into 1/8-inch slices., Arrange cookie slices slightly overlapping on foil covered 14-inch pizza pan., Press edges to seal., Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes, or until golden brown., Cool and remove from foil onto serving plate., Combine cheese, sugar and vanilla, mixing well., Spread over crust; arrange fruit on cream cheese mixture., Glaze with marmalade and water; mix., Chill.

title: Kugel
directions: In 9 x 13-inch baking dish melt margarine., Boil noodles 5 minutes until still slightly firm., Mix remaining ingredients together and beat well., Mix together with noodles., Bake 45 minutes to 1 hour at 350° until bubbling., Cool until warm to touch., Sprinkle cinnamon and sugar on top., Serve warm or cold. Refrigerate leftovers., Great served warm with cream!

title: Enchilada Casserole
directions: Melt cheese, soup and tomatoes (Ro-Tel)., In oblong pan, layer tortillas, beef, onion and beans., Pour melted cheese mixture over entire casserole., Crumble Fritos on top., Bake at 350° until bubbly and brown on top, 1/2 hour to 45 minutes.

title: Cream Cheese Cookies
directions: Melt butter in large jelly roll pan. Pour into mixing bowl. Add cake mix and 1 egg. Mix and put in greased pan. Press out evenly in bottom of pan.

title: Golden Corn Bread
directions: Sift together in bowl the flour, sugar, baking powder and salt., Stir in corn meal., In a small bowl,, beat eggs, milk and shortening., Add all at once to corn meal mixture., Stir with fork until flour is just moistened., Even if batter is lumpy, do not stir anymore., Pour into well-greased 9 x 9 x 2-inch pan., Bake in a 425° oven for 20 to 25 minutes, or until done.

title: Artie'S Homemade Pasta Sauce
directions: Chop the onions, bell peppers, parsley, mushrooms and garlic. In a large pot over medium heat, heat the olive oil and saute onions and peppers until onions are clear., Add mushrooms, then garlic and parsley., Add ground beef and brown it off., Add tomato sauce, oregano and salt., Then add ketchup and lemon juice., Bring to slow boil and add wine., Bring to boil again, then reduce heat to simmer and cover and cook 2 or 3 hours., For pasta sauce, add meatballs and sausage during last hour of cooking.

title: World'S Easiest Macaroni And Cheese
directions: Melt butter in a 2-quart casserole dish., Add uncooked macaroni and stir until macaroni is coated., Mix in Cheddar cheese and pour milk over the mixture so that all macaroni is covered. Bake at 325° for 1 hour.

title: Linguine With Shrimp
directions: Peel and clean shrimp., Smash and dice garlic., Brown garlic in unsalted butter., Chop parsley., Slice mushrooms and stir in the warm unsalted butter., Add coarsely chopped shrimp., After shrimp turns pink, stir in parsley., Pour over hot linguine., Add Romano cheese, salt and pepper to taste.

title: "Grandma'S Best" Cookies
directions: In small bowl combine dry ingredients., In large bowl cream margarine and peanut butter; blend in both sugars, add egg and vanilla., Gradually beat in flour mixture., Shape into 1-inch balls., Roll in granulated sugar., Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 375° for 10 minutes or until lightly browned., Remove from oven, quickly press candy star into top of each cookie., Remove to wire rack to cool completely.

title: Chicken Tacos(Low-Fat)
directions: Add sugar, picante sauce and cumin to chicken breast pieces. Cook on low temperature for 3 minutes, stirring., Toast taco shells in oven until lightly browned., Fill shells with meat. Garnish each taco with lettuce, tomatoes and onions.

title: Frog Eye Salad
directions: Cook macaroni in 1 1/2 quarts water with, oil, and salt added. When tender, drain and cool., Cook, until, thick	the sugar, flour,, pineapple juice, eggs and, salt., Remove, from stove and add lemon juice., Cool., Drain the cans of pineapple and, save. Use juice for custard., Drain, mandarin, oranges. Add 1 large and 1 small container Cool Whip plus, 1, cup small marshmallows to cool custard., Add fruit;, stir, and refrigerate.	Add macaroni too., Makes about 20, servings., Keeps, in fridge about 1 week.

title: Shoney'S Strawberry Pie
directions: Boil for 3 minutes., Let cool., Cut up strawberries., Put in baked pie shell., Pour mixture over strawberries., Top with Cool Whip.

title: Fire Ant Poison
directions: Mix above ingredients well., Use a 2-gallon plastic bucket. Add 5 pounds white corn meal and mix thoroughly., Use 1/3 to 1/2 cup of this bait formula to each fire ant mound., This does not keep long., Try to use it all., Fire ant bait recipe was developed by Texas A & M.

title: Spicy Rabbit
directions: Combine first six ingredients in non-metal casserole., Marinate in refrigerator for 24 hours., Remove rabbit and dry with paper towels., Coat the rabbit with seasoned flour., Heat oil in large frypan over medium heat., Brown to taste, then return marinade to frypan., Simmer to tender., Add enough flour to thicken marinade. Serve.

title: Cream Cheese Cupcakes
directions: In large bowl, sift together flour, sugar, cocoa, baking soda and salt., Add oil, water, vinegar and vanilla; beat well., Fill cupcake liners half full., Make topping., Soften cream cheese. Cream in small bowl., Add egg, sugar and salt., Beat well., Stir in chocolate chips., Put about 1 tablespoon of topping on each cupcake., Use all of topping., Bake at 350° for about 30 minutes. Makes 18 cupcakes.

title: Sugar Cookies
directions: Mix together the flour, baking powder and salt., Cream together the butter and sugar, then beat in eggs, vanilla extract and milk., Stir in the flour mixture, then gradually add enough of the remaining flour to make the dough stiff enough to roll., Form the dough into balls., Chill at least 1 hour., Place the dough on floured surface; roll out 1/8 inch thick., Cut with cookie cutters and place on ungreased cookie sheets., Bake 8 to 10 minutes. Makes 4 dozen.

title: Mexican Dip
directions: Layer in 9 x, 13-inch pan bean dip, avocados mixed with garlic and Tabasco, sour cream, mayonnaise and taco seasoning (mixed), then, top, with, remaining, ingredients., Serve with chips.

title: Crispy Bread And Butter Pickles
directions: Do not peel cucumbers., Slice thin., Add onions, peppers, garlic and salt., Cover with ice., Mix thoroughly., Let stand 3 hours., Drain.

title: Cheese Wafers
directions: Let butter and grated cheese stand at room temperature for about an hour before mixing with remainder of ingredients into a stiff dough., You may use a cookie press or make small balls and flatten to form wafers., Bake for 10 to 12 minutes at 375°.

title: Happiness Recipe
directions: Sprinkle generously with kindness., Add plenty faith and mix well., Spread over a lifetime., Serve to everyone you meet.

title: Peanut Pretzel Bars
directions: Mix cereal and pretzel sticks., Spread in 10 x 15-inch pan that has been buttered., Put sugar, Karo syrup and peanut butter in pan., Bring to a full boil, stirring constantly., Stir in peanuts and vanilla., Pour over cereal; spread evenly and press down firmly., Melt chips together and frost., Chill and then cut into squares.

title: Strawberry Salad Cake
directions: Make both packages of vanilla pudding according to package directions., Let cool slightly., Wash and hull strawberries. Slice and allow to sit in a sugar mixture., Let Cool Whip thaw.

title: Berry Cobbler
directions: Toss together berries and 1/2 cup sugar; set aside., In another bowl combine 1 cup sugar, flour, baking powder and salt., Add milk. Mix just until batter is smooth., Melt butter; pour into a 2-quart baking dish., Spoon berries over melted butter., Pour batter over top., Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes., Serve with cream.

title: Chicken Tetrazzini
directions: Cook a 4 1/2 pound chicken in 3 cups hot, salted water., After chicken is cooked, cut it off the bones., Melt 3 tablespoons butter in saucepan., Add flour., Stir in 2 1/2 cups reserved broth and cook sauce, stirring until slightly thickened., Add cream and pour over prepared chicken., Refrigerate overnight or all day.

title: Dried Beef Cheese Ball
directions: Mix 2 packages of beef with the onion, cream cheese, Worcestershire sauce and Accent., Form into a ball., Roll in the remaining beef and refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Mushroom Turnovers
directions: Saute mushrooms in butter with the onion until limp., Add salt, pepper, nutmeg and lemon juice., Blend in flour until smooth and slightly thickened., Stir in sour cream and dill weed., Cool filling., Place small amount of filling (scant teaspoon) on one side of 2-inch pastry round., Fold over and crimp edges with fork tines., Bake 20 to 25 minutes in a 350°, oven., These freeze well before baking.

title: Blender Hot Sauce
directions: Blend tomatoes, garlic, peppers and salt., Add the onion and chop, but not fine., Add vinegar., Best to start with smaller amount of peppers and add to taste., Pour all in saucepan and simmer 15 minutes., Pour in sterile jars and seal., Give boiling water bath for 5 minutes., Refrigerate after opening.

title: Eggplant And Feta Salad
directions: Set the oven at 350°., Pile the eggplant, squash, zucchini, pepper and onion in a large roasting pan and sprinkle them with oil., Turn the vegetables in the oil so they are coated., Bake the vegetables, tossing them a couple of times during the cooking, for 40 minutes or until tender.

title: Chicken Saute With Cranberry Vinegar
directions: In oven proof skillet, heat oil and lightly brown all the chicken., Cover and bake in preheated 425° oven for 25 minutes. Place chicken on platter., Keep warm., Saute shallots in same pan. Deglaze pan with vinegar, whisk in cranberry jelly and butter. Serve over chicken.

title: Frozen Fruit Salad
directions: Mix together and freeze.

title: Zucchini Bread
directions: Beat eggs until light., Add oil, sugar, zucchini and vanilla. Mix lightly, but well. Sift together flour, baking powder, soda, salt, cinnamon and nutmeg. Add to egg mixture. Stir in nuts. Bake at 350° for 1 hour., Makes two 9 x 5 x 2-inch loaves.

title: B. L. T. Surprise Salad
directions: Combine potatoes, bacon, tomatoes, sandwich spread, celery and green onion., Mix lightly. Season to taste. Chill., Serve in lettuce lined bowl. Garnish with bacon.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
directions: Beat shortening, sugars, vanilla, water and eggs until light and fluffy., Mix flour with soda and salt; blend into shortening mixture., Stir in nuts and chips., Drop 2-inches apart onto ungreased baking sheet., Bake at 375° for 8 to 10 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Pineapple-Coconut Squares
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., In bowl, at medium speed, cream the butter with 1/4 cup sugar., Beat in flour to form a soft dough. Press dough evenly on bottom of casserole and 1/2 inch up sides. Bake until brown, about 15 minutes; let cool., Spread pineapple over crust., Add remaining 1/2 cup sugar to egg., Add melted butter, vanilla and coconut., Spread mixture over pineapple., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes or until brown., When cool, cut into squares.

title: 5 Cup Salad
directions: Mix and let stand several hours in refrigerator.

title: Vanilla Wafer Cake(Bars)
directions: With mixer, beat sugar. Add the margarine. Beat in one egg at a time., Add milk. Crumble and add wafers. Chop nuts and add to mixture. Add coconut. Bake 1 1/4 hours at 350°., Should brown lightly on top.

title: Pork And Pepper Goulash
directions: Cut pork into 3/4 to 1-inch cubes., Heat bacon in heavy skillet., Cook until crisp., Add onion., Saute for 2 minutes until onion is wilted., Add pork cubes to pan along with green and red peppers, tomato, paprika, garlic, caraway seed and salt., Cook, stirring over high heat for 5 minutes., Turn heat down to low; cover and simmer for 10 minutes., Meanwhile, stir cornstarch and broth together until smooth., Pour mixture into pan with meat and peppers., Heat to boiling; stir and cook until juices are thickened.

title: Broccoli And Cheese
directions: Boil broccoli in water until tender and crisp., Drain and put in greased casserole dish., Add 1/3 stick butter., Mix. Add 1/2 pound Velveeta and mix., Toss Ritz crackers with 1/3 stick melted butter., Sprinkle on broccoli., Bake 25 minutes at 350°.

title: Spicy Plantation Chicken
directions: Combine egg, buttermilk and 1 tablespoon of oil., Sift together the flour, curry powder, salt and pepper., Blend flour mixture into the buttermilk mixture; beat until smooth., Dip chicken pieces into batter; drain., Cook batter chicken in deep 350° oil for about 12 minutes or until chicken is done., Fried chicken recipe serves 4 to 6.

title: Kaga
directions: Preheat oven to 450°., Mix all except butter., Melt butter in the bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan while oven is preheating., Mix ingredients; pour over melted butter., Do not stir!, Bake 20 minutes., Don't look; let set 5 minutes to set.

title: Coconut Cream Pie
directions: Scald 1 1/2 cups milk in top of double boiler., Combine sugar, flour, salt and cornstarch., Stir in remaining milk and egg yolks., Stir this flour mixture into hot milk., Cook until thick., Remove from heat; add butter, vanilla and 3/4 cup coconut. Allow mixture to cool., Pour into pie shell; cover with remaining coconut and meringue., Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes, until meringue browns lightly.

title: Sunday Hot Rolls
directions: Dissolve yeast in the warm water., Then add the other ingredients, beating as you add., Gradually add flour until dough is soft and not too stiff., Let stand 6 hours or overnight., Knead for 5 minutes and divide in 4 parts., Roll out like pie crust; cut in 8 pieces., Roll big end to small end., Put in greased pan and let rise in warm place until after church on Sunday morning or 4 to 5 hours., Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes., Before baking, add a dot of butter to each roll.

title: Sweet Potato Cake
directions: Combine cooking oil and sugar., Add egg yolks; beat well., Add hot water, then dry ingredients., Stir in potatoes and nuts., Then fold in beaten egg whites., Put in 3 layers and bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Broccoli Salad
directions: Combine broccoli, celery, onion, bacon, raisins and mandarin oranges in salad bowl., Blend mayonnaise, vinegar and sugar in small bowl., Add to broccoli mixture; mix until coated., Top with almonds. Chill until serving time.

title: Homemade Sweetened Condensed Milk
directions: Put in blender., Process until smooth., Keeps sometime in fridge.

title: Baked Beef Roast
directions: Place roast in pan., Spread the celery soup over roast. Sprinkle onion soup over the roast., Spoon the water over the top and sides., Bake 3 to 4 hours at 350°., During the last hour of baking time, put potatoes and carrots around roast to bake.

title: Cucumber And Onion Salad
directions: Combine all ingredients and chill., This makes a lot., You can half the recipe if you like.

title: Squash Casserole
directions: Bring squash, pepper, onion and water to a boil in medium saucepan., Cook until slightly tender; drain., Add drained pimentos., Melt the butter in double boiler., Add flour and stir until well blended., Slowly add with squash mixture., Spread cracker crumbs and grated cheese on top., Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

title: Chocolate Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Boll sugar, cocoa, butter and vanilla for 2 minutes., Remove from heat., Stir in oats and peanut butter., Drop into waxed paper.

title: Dilly Beans
directions: Pack the beans into 4 pint jars., Add the salt, dill seed, garlic and red pepper to the beans in the jars., Bring the vinegar and water to a boil., Pour into jars and seal., Process 5 to 10 minutes.

title: Cube Steak Mushroom Gravy
directions: Brown cube steak on both sides, then put into a crock-pot. Then add the mushroom soup. Cook on high for 1 hour, then on low until meat is done. Great with biscuits, rice or cream potatoes.

title: Hash Brown Potatoes
directions: In medium saucepan over medium heat, cook potatoes in boiling, salted water until tender; drain., Over low heat, shake pan to dry potatoes., With a table knife, chop potatoes until almost mashed. Place potatoes in a heavily buttered 8-inch skillet., Pat down top evenly; dot with butter or margarine and sprinkle with salt and pepper., Cover; cook over low heat until bottom is browned., (Lift gently with spatula to check.), To serve, invert onto plate so browned side is up.

title: Pasta Salad
directions: Boil pasta. Drain. Do not, rinse. Add oil, lemon juice and seasonings. Mix well. Refrigerate 4 hours or overnight. Add mayonnaise, bell pepper, onion, celery, olives and pimientos. Mix well. Serves 12. Can do ahead.

title: Sausage Dressing
directions: Cook sausage., When done, remove sausage and add onions and celery in drippings and cook until done.

title: Hamburger Pie(Grandma Hazel)
directions: In a skillet, fry ground chuck and onion., Drain fat., Add tomato sauce and corn., Heat on low, just until heated thoroughly. Place in a 10-inch pie plate., Add mashed potatoes, then top with Cheddar cheese., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes., Remove from oven. Add French fried onions and return to oven for 10 minutes.

title: Dishpan Cookies
directions: Cream sugar, oil and eggs., Gradually add remaining ingredients., Drop by teaspoon on cookie sheet., Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Blueberry Cobbler
directions: Sprinkle 1/2 cup sugar over berries., Chop margarine up over berries., Mix flour, sugar, milk and vanilla well., Pour over berries., Do not stir., Bake at 350° for 35 or 40 minutes.

title: Great Grandmother'S Hoe-Downs(Sugar Cookies)
directions: Cream butter and sugar together., Add eggs, sour milk and lemon extract; beat after each addition., Sift soda, baking powder, nutmeg and flour together., Chill dough 30 minutes. Flour hands., Roll a portion of dough (small egg size)., Dip or roll in a bowl of sugar., Flatten with two fingers., Place 2 or 3 raisins in center., Bake until light brown.

title: Italian Cream Cake
directions: Cream 1 stick butter and shortening; add sugar and beat well. Add egg, one at a time, alternating with flour, soda and buttermilk., Add vanilla, coconut and 1 cup of pecans., Bake in 3 prepared 9-inch pans at 350° for 40 minutes.

title: Easy Monkey Bread
directions: Separate biscuits and cut each into quarters., In a small bowl, mix 1/2 cup sugar with cinnamon and nuts., Drop in cut biscuits and roll to cover.

title: Red Fruit Punch(Usa)
directions: Mix together sugar and juices., Cover and chill until flavors are well blended., Just before serving add the carbonated beverage or ginger ale., Serves 10.

title: Sour Cream Cornbread
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Mix and cook about 20 to 25 minutes in well-greased iron skillet (9-inch or larger).

title: Zucchini Bread
directions: Combine and mix well., Bake for 30 to 45 minutes in 375° oven. Makes 2 large or 3 small loaves.

title: Molded Cheese Salad
directions: Dissolve lime gelatin in hot water., Add pineapple juice and marshmallows., Whip until marshmallows are dissolved., Let cool until partially set., Then add pineapple, celery, nuts, cream cheese and whipped cream., Pour into mold and let set.

title: Nuts And Bolts
directions: In a quart Ziploc bag, pour the half and half, milk, sugar and vanilla. Seal bag. In a gallon Ziploc bag, add 2 tablespoons rock salt or ice cream salt. Fill bag full of ice. Place quart bag in gallon bag. Turn end over end until the ice cream sets; takes about 15 minutes. It will look like snow cream when ready.

title: Broccoli And Cheddar Soup
directions: In large saucepan, cook broccoli until soft; drain., In small pan, saute onion in margarine., Add cornstarch and slowly add broth and cream., Stir and cook until thickens., Add salt, nutmeg and broccoli., Just before serving, stir in cheese.

title: Carrot Casserole
directions: Cook carrots until done., Drain., Add the other ingredients and top with crushed potato chips., Bake at 300° for 1/2 hour.

title: Rice Krispies Delite(Fast And Easy)
directions: Bring Karo and sugar to a boil and remove from heat., Add peanut butter and stir., Pour mixture over Rice Krispies and mix thoroughly., Place in greased 11 x 14-inch pan., Pat down flat with wax paper., Melt chips together., Microwave 3 minutes., Stir and spread over Rice Krispies., Cool for 1 hour., Cut into squares.

title: Dirt Cake
directions: Mix instant pudding according to box., Add Cool Whip and cream cheese., Crush Oreos., Place layers of Oreos, pudding, Oreos and pudding mixture., Finish with cookies on top.

title: Cherry Salad
directions: Mix together first 4 ingredients., Fold in Cool Whip., Put in 8 x 12-inch Pyrex dish., Put nuts on top., Refrigerate overnight or longer., Cut in squares to serve., Do not cover in refrigerator., (I usually put this in a bowl.)

title: Creamy Chicken
directions: Place chicken breasts in Pam-sprayed pan., Put small pieces of chipped beef over chicken., Mix sour cream and mushroom soup and pour over chicken., Crumble bacon and sprinkle on top., Bake at 300° for 2 hours, uncovered.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Mix all ingredients together and bake for 35 minutes., As an option, top with cornflakes and drizzle with butter.

title: Pumpkin Bread
directions: Beat together well the first 5 ingredients., Sift together the dry ingredients., Add them to the liquid mixture., Stir in raisins, nuts and water., Bake at 350° for 65 to 75 minutes.

title: Party Beans
directions: In a large Dutch oven, brown beef over medium heat., Drain fat., Add onion and celery; cook until tender., Stir in soup, ketchup and tomato., Simmer 15 to 20 minutes., Spoon into a large kettle or roaster., Add all remaining ingredients; stir well. Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 1 hour., Serves 25.

title: Hot Peppers In Tomato Sauce
directions: Boil all ingredients except peppers for 10 minutes., Cut peppers in rings and put in sauce., Bring to a boil again., Pack in hot jars., Seal.

title: Poor Man'S Ambrosia
directions: Peel and grate apples., Add pineapple, orange juice, 1 can of water and flavoring to apples., Mix well., Let stand for several hours before serving., Keeps well in refrigerator several days. (May add a little sugar or Sweet 'N Low.)

title: Pumpkin Delight
directions: Take out 1 cup dry cake mix., Put aside., Combine remaining mix with 1 egg and the melted margarine., Press into 9 x 13-inch pan., Mix together the pumpkin, eggs, white and brown sugar, evaporated milk and cinnamon., Spread on cake dough.

title: Chicken And Rice Casserole
directions: Boil the chicken for about 20 minutes., Remove and cook the rice in 2 to 3 cups of chicken broth., Place the rice, soups and chicken into Pyrex dish; bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Lemon Whippersnaps Cookies
directions: Grease cookie sheet., Combine cake mix, Cool Whip and egg. Stir well., Drop by teaspoon into sugar., Coat., Place about 1 1/2 inches apart., Bake at 350° for 10 or 15 minutes., Do not overcook.

title: Cinnamon Nut Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350., Mix cake mix, 3/4 oil, 4 eggs, sugar, sour cream, and flavoring., In separate bowl mix 2 Tbsp. cake mix, brown sugar, and ground cinnamon., After mixing well, add pecans. In greased cake pan begin layering batter and cinnamon and mix beginning with cinnamon mix and ending with it also., Bake for 50 minutes at 350 or until cake is done., Mix powdered sugar and milk to make creamy topping., Drizzle over cake while it is still warm.

title: Philly 3-Step Cherry Cheesecake
directions: Mix cream cheese, sugar, vanilla and 2 eggs; pour into crust. Bake at 350° for 40 minutes or until center is almost set., Cool. Refrigerate at least 3 hours., Spread with one 21 ounce can of cherry pie filling., Makes 8 servings.

title: Mexican Dip
directions: Brown lean hamburger and sausage in large skillet., Drain off fat., Add Velveeta cheese, cut in cubes., Stir until cheese melts. Add soup and salsa sauce., Serve warm with your choice of corn chips.

title: Corn Chowder
directions: In large saucepan, using scissors, cut bacon into small pieces., Cook until crisp., Remove bacon from pan; drain all but 3 tablespoons grease from pan., Add onion and saute in bacon grease until tender and brown., Add remaining ingredients., Reduce heat and simmer until potatoes are tender., Serve with bacon sprinkled over soup.

title: Macaroni Casserole
directions: Combine all ingredients together and place in baking dish. Crumble Ritz crackers on top and bake 20 minutes at 375°.

title: Mexican Fruitcake
directions: Combine dry ingredients., Add pineapple and eggs., Mix with mixer about 2 minutes., Add pecans., Bake in 9 x 13-inch loaf pan greased and floured., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Aunt Susan'S Easy Barbecued Chicken
directions: Microwave chicken, covered with 1/2 bottle of sauce, for 20 minutes., Add rest of sauce and bake in regular oven at 350° until done.

title: Cheesy Potatoes(Microwave)
directions: If potatoes are nice, no need to peel., Slice potatoes and onions and layer in casserole., Sprinkle with a little salt, if desired., Dot top with butter., Mix hot water with bouillon and pour over top., Cover and microwave on High for 17 to 20 minutes, until potatoes are tender, stirring occasionally., Uncover, sprinkle with cheese and parsley., Recover, microwave 1 to 2 minutes longer.

title: Vegetable Pizza
directions: Press crescent rolls on cookie sheet and bake according to directions., Mix next 5 ingredients and spread over cooled crust. Top with veggies.

title: Appetizer Dip
directions: Cook chickpeas approximately 6 minutes in pan of water. Drain. Blend in blender the chickpeas, tahini, garlic, lemon juice and olive oil until smooth. Little water may be added to thin slightly.

title: Spinach Pie
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., Defrost spinach and squeeze dry., Chop. Place room temperature cheeses in a mixing bowl., Add spinach and stir until blended.

title: Sponge Gingerbread
directions: Cream butter and sugar., Add molasses and egg., Sift together ginger, cinnamon and flour., Blend into molasses mixture. Dissolve soda in boiling water., Add to mixture; batter will be runny., Bake in greased pan at 325° for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Holiday Cranberry Salad
directions: Dissolve cherry gelatin in boiling water., Mix in plain gelatin, which has been softened in a little cold water., Stir in sugar, lemon juice, ground cranberries and orange. Then stir in pineapple, celery, and pecans., Let congeal in refrigerator overnight.	Makes 12 servings.

title: Jello Salad
directions: Dissolve jello in hot water; add the rest of the ingredients and chill.

title: The Preacher'S Coming
directions: Make a graham cracker crust for a 9 x 13-inch pan., Melt chocolate with oleo over low heat; add sugar and mix well., Beat egg yolks and add to chocolate mixture., Stir well., Add vanilla and stir., Beat egg whites until very stiff; fold them into chocolate mixture., Add nuts, if desired., Pour chocolate mixture into crust; chill in freezer until firm to touch.

title: Crab Salad
directions: Combine all of the ingredients., Mix mayonnaise to desired taste., Chill before serving., (May serve on top of orange).

title: Spaghetti Sauce
directions: Cook the first 3 ingredients 2 to 3 hours., Add the oil, oregano, salt, basil and sugar. Cook 1 hour, then add the tomato paste., Bring to a hard boil. Remove from heat. Can or freeze. Makes 11 quarts.

title: Cut Glass Jello
directions: Prepare orange, grape and lime jello and let set. Combine 1 cup pineapple juice --finish the cup with water and add another 1/2 cup cold water and sugar., Heat until sugar is dissolved, then dissolve the strawberry jello., Let set until it is thick like syrup., Then add Cool Whip, crushed pineapple., Cut the 3 flavors of jello into cubes., Mix all together and put on a graham cracker crust., To make crust mix graham cracker crumbs and melted butter and put in large rectangular pan., Can use sugar free jello and lite cool whip for less calories.

title: Sour Cream Muffins
directions: Mix Bisquick and sour cream., Add melted margarine and mix well., Fill miniature greased muffin tins., Bake at 425° for 15 minutes.

title: Chinese Casserole
directions: Saute celery and onion a few minutes in oil., Combine with remaining ingredients., Pour into greased casserole dish., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes., Serves 6.

title: Blueberry Cheesecake
directions: Mix the first 4 ingredients; pat firmly in 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 375° for 15 minutes., Cool., Dissolve gelatin in hot water and cool., Mix cream cheese and sugar; cream well., Add gelatin mixture., Whip Dream Whip; fold into cream cheese mixture., Pour into cooled crust., Chill 1 or 2 hours., Pour the blueberry pie filling (chilled) over top., Set approximately 1 hour before serving.

title: Corn Bread Dressing
directions: Saute celery and onions in butter until tender., Add to cornbread and bread crumbs., Add chopped eggs; mix., Add seasonings and broth., Dressing should be extra moist., Bake in 375° oven until lightly browned on top.

title: Chewy Cake Squares
directions: Mix batter., Grease pan., Bake exactly 30 minutes at 350°. Remove from oven., Cover with wax paper for approximately 30 minutes before cutting.

title: French Fried Cauliflower
directions: Parboil the cauliflower 10 minutes. Cool and separate into flowerets. Dip each piece into eggs and crumbs, then in eggs and crumbs again. Fry until golden brown.

title: Lemon Jello Pound Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Grease tube pan generously and flour. Blend 3/4 cup water with lemon Jell-O., Empty cake mix into bowl and blend in prepared Jell-O., Afterward, add oil; mix thoroughly, adding eggs separately and blending well each time., Add flavorings; blend well., Remove cake from oven and invert on foil. Top with icing., Cover cake on foil until icing settles.

title: Hacienda Dip(Microwave)
directions: Mix cream cheese, salsa and salt until well blended., Put cheese mixture in microwave-safe bowl and microwave on High for 3 to 4 minutes or until heated, stirring every 2 minutes., Makes 2 cups., This is also good cold.

title: Stuffed Peppers
directions: Remove seeds and membrane from peppers and rinse., Cook peppers in boiling water to cover, about 5 minutes; drain., Cook ground beef and onions in 10-inch skillet; stir occasionally until beef is brown., Stir in rice, salt, garlic salt and 1 cup tomato sauce., Heat until hot., Stuff peppers with beef mixture and stand upright in baking dish, 8 x 8 x 2-inch., Cover and bake 45 minutes at 350°., (Before covering, pour remaining tomato sauce over stuffed peppers.), Uncover and bake 15 minutes longer., Sprinkle with cheese.

title: Sauerkraut Rice Spuds
directions: Cover potatoes with water., Add other ingredients., Cook until potatoes and rice are soft, about 50 minutes., Stir and mix well. Serve with gravy or margarine or bake at 375° for 45 minutes.

title: Hungarian Cauliflower Casserole
directions: Cook cauliflower in salted water until tender., Drain and place in a buttered baking dish., Cover with bread crumbs; season and pour sour cream over it., Bake at 350° until crumbs are slightly brown.

title: Fretta-Like Cornbread With Broccoli
directions: Mix, all, ingredients,, except, cornbread mix; add that gradually., Place, in, greased 9 x 12-inch pan and bake for 20 minutes at 400°., Easy and good and healthful!

title: Beefy Mushroom Party Spread
directions: Soften cream cheese. Chop olives, mushrooms and green onions (not the tops). Mix all together. Spread on crackers or party rye bread.

title: Sweet And Sour Carrot Salad(Serves 12)
directions: Cook carrots in boiling water until crisp-tender, about 5 minutes., Drain and cool., Combine carrots, onion and green pepper in large serving bowl., Combine soup, sugar, oil, vinegar, Worcestershire and salt., Pour over vegetables., Stir gently to combine., Cover., Refrigerate at least 24 hours to blend flavors.

title: Turkey-Carcass Soup
directions: Remove turkey from carcass and place in large Dutch oven; add remaining ingredients. Bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer for about 2 hours or until all vegetables are tender. Remove bay leaf. Very good!!

title: Chicken Pie
directions: Spread chicken in bottom of casserole dish., Mix water and chicken soup, then pour over chicken., Mix milk, flour and melted margarine., Pour over other ingredients., Bake at 350° until golden brown.

title: Ranch-Style Frijoles
directions: Soak beans in cold water overnight., Drain, wash and cover with about 2 inches of water., Add salt and boil over moderate heat for about 1 hour, adding water if needed., Add diced onion, diced garlic, pepper, cumin seed, chopped chilies, taco sauce and tomatoes., Cook over medium heat for an hour or longer, until beans are tender., For spicier beans, add 1 or 2 teaspoons of red chili powder.

title: Microwave Lasagna
directions: Combine Ricotta cheese, 12 ounces of Mozzarella cheese, egg and garlic powder., Mix well., Combine sauce and water in a separate, bowl., Spread 1/3 of sauce in bottom of a 12 x 8 x 2-inch, dish., Place 3 uncooked lasagna noodles on top., Cover with, 1/2, of the cheese mixture, 1/2 of the hamburger and 1/2 of the mushrooms and pepperoni.

title: Fruited Carrot Salad
directions: Combine all ingredients in a 2-quart bowl, tossing gently. Cover and refrigerate.

title: Bailey'S Irish Cream
directions: Mix all in blender., Pour into dark bottle and refrigerate.

title: Lobster-Stuffed Potatoes
directions: Scrub potatoes, rub skins with shortening, and prick with fork. Bake at 375° till done, 70 to 80 minutes., Cut slice from top of each., Scoop out insides; reserve shells., Mash potatoes., Add butter, salt, pepper and enough milk or cream to moisten., Beat till fluffy., Stir in lobster, 3/4 cup cheese, and onion., Pile filling into potato shells., Bake 20 to 25 minutes longer. Sprinkle remaining cheese over tops of potatoes; bake 3 minutes more.

title: German Chocolate Cake
directions: Bake cake according to directions on box.

title: Woody'S Brunswick Stew
directions: Put ground beef, pork and chicken into a large pot., Pour enough broth over the meat to cover., Put catsup and tomatoes; stir., Add Worcestershire, salt and pepper to taste., Add mashed potatoes and creamed corn., Heat, stir constantly, so it will not stick.

title: Brown Rice
directions: Melt butter; pour into baking pan sprayed with Pam., Dump the remaining ingredients in the baking pan., Mix together., Cook at 400° for 1 hour, uncovered., This makes a large casserole.

title: Hawaiian Marshmallow Pie
directions: Microwave marshmallows and the reserved 1/2 cup pineapple liquid in large bowl on High 2 to 2 1/2 minutes or until smooth when stirred., Refrigerate 30 minutes or until slightly thickened. Mix until well blended., Fold in pineapple and whipped topping. Pour into crust., Refrigerate several hours or overnight., Garnish with pineapple chunks and cherries.

title: Congo Squares
directions: Cream sugar and butter., Beat eggs into creamed mixture; add flour., Fold in nuts and chocolate bits., Bake in well-greased pan at 325° about 40 minutes.

title: Fruit Cocktail Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients with electric mixer., Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Lemon Cake
directions: Beat for 10 minutes., Grease and flour Bundt cake pan., Bake at 325° for 60 minutes.

title: Hamburger Casserole
directions: In 4-quart casserole dish, layer in order the potatoes, onion, corn, green beans and carrots., Mix soup with hamburger., Pour over top., Place in 350°, oven covered with lid., Bake for 1 hour. Top with grated Cheddar cheese the last few minutes so it will melt.

title: Mamma'S Cooked Salad Dressing
directions: Cook first 7 ingredients and add margarine., Shake in some pepper and celery seed., This makes 1 quart and will keep a long time.

title: Banana Bread
directions: Cream shortening and gradually add sugar until all sugar is dissolved., Add eggs, one at a time, beating after each addition. Mash bananas and add to the batter., Sift dry ingredients together and fold in (do not beat)., Fold in finely chopped pecans., Bake in greased loaf pan for 45 minutes at 350°.

title: Aspic
directions: Cool and mold., Finely chopped onions, pepper and celery may be added to mixture before molding.

title: Apple Muffins
directions: In a small bowl, mix flour, cinnamon, baking soda and salt; set aside., In large bowl, beat eggs well, then beat in oil, sugar and vanilla., Stir in flour mixture until well blended, then add apples and walnuts., Spoon into 2 1/2-inch muffin tins lined with paper muffin cups., Bake in preheated 350° oven for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: American Pierogi Casserole
directions: Saute onion in butter and, add, to, potatoes which have been boiled and drained., Mash, together., Butter large casserole dish and add 1/2 of, the, noodles., Spread, mashed potato mixture over noodles and top with, slices of cheese., Add rest of noodles and again top with cheese slices., Dot with butter; cover., Bake in 350° oven until cheese melts.

title: Apple Dip
directions: Mix all together., Chill 1 hour before serving with sliced apples.

title: Lemon Chicken
directions: Rinse chicken., Poke holes in the lemon with a fork., Insert it into the chicken., Sprinkle with paprika., Put in a roasting pan and cover with foil., Bake in oven for 1 hour at 350°., Remove foil and bake until just brown.

title: Crunchy Cheese Ball
directions: Cream cheese and mayonnaise., Add next 5 ingredients., Chill one hour., Form into a ball and roll in nuts.

title: Strawberry Delight
directions: Mix jello according to directions on the box., Allow to partially gel., Add strawberries and Cool Whip to broken up angel food cake., Return to refrigerator for 3 hours.

title: Oven Roasted Skinny "Fries"
directions: Preheat oven to 450°., Halve the potatoes lengthwise., Cut halves lengthwise into long wedges, about 1/3-inch wide., Spray potatoes with cooking spray., Place on cookie sheet, cut side down. Sprinkle with 1 1/2 teaspoons cheese and dust with paprika., Bake 15 minutes., Turn potato wedges., Sprinkle with remaining cheese and dust with additional paprika., Bake 15 minutes longer or until crisp and golden brown., Per serving:, 170 calories, 4 grams protein, 38 grams carbohydrates, 1 gram fat, 3% calories from fat, 1 mg. cholesterol, 41 mg. sodium.

title: Cashew Chicken
directions: Dip chicken in egg whites and cornstarch., Saute chicken., Add vegetables, sherry, soy sauce, hoisin, garlic and ginger., Add snow peas, cherry tomatoes, bok choy and cashews., Total cooking time is about 10 minutes., Yields 4 servings.

title: Chicken-Rice Casserole
directions: Coat 12 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish with cooking spray., Place uncooked rice in bottom of dish and top with chicken., Combine water, mushroom soup and onion soup mix, stirring to blend., Pour over chicken., Cover and bake at 325° for 1 1/2 hours or until chicken and rice are done.

title: Mock-Sou-Berag
directions: Boil noodles in salted water until tender., Drain and rinse with cold water. Divide cheese into 2 equal portions., Mix parsley into 1 portion of cheese. Place half of noodles in buttered baking dish., Add cheese with parsley. Top with remaining noodles. Sprinkle remaining cheese over top and dot with butter. Bake at 350° until cheese melts and top is browned., Cut into squares. Baking time is 55 minutes from cold oven start.

title: Salisbury Steak With Onion Gravy
directions: In a bowl, combine 1/3 cup soup with beef, crumbs, egg, salt and pepper., Shape into 6 oval patties., Brown patties in skillet. Gradually blend, remaining, soup, into, flour, until smooth., Add remaining, ingredients, to skillet., Stir.	Cover and cook over low heat for 20 minutes., Stir often.

title: Peach Cooler
directions: Put all ingredients, except ice cream, into blender container. Cover and process at liquefy until smooth., Stop blender, add ice cream, cover and process 1 cycle at blend.

title: Luscious Lemonade
directions: Combine sugar, lemon juice and water., Stir to dissolve sugar., Serve over ice., Garnish with lemon slices., Serves 6.

title: Banana Split Cake
directions: Mix first 3 ingredients and press into a 9 x 13-inch pan., Mix next 4 ingredients and spread over crust., Put a layer of bananas over that, then a layer of pineapple., Top with Cool Whip, cherries and nuts., Serve well chilled.

title: Jalapeno Corn Bread
directions: Mix ingredients., Grease pan and bake at 450° until done.

title: Light Fruitcake
directions: Combine 1/4 cup brandy, thawed orange juice concentrate and cranberries in a large bowl; cover and let stand 1 hour., Combine dates, pecans, orange rind, vanilla, eggs and pineapple., Add to cranberry, mixture; stir well., Combine flour, baking soda, salt, cinnamon, allspice and nutmeg., Add to fruit mixture; stir well., Spoon batter into a 6-cup Bundt pan coated with cooking spray., Bake at 325° for 45 minutes or until a wooden pick comes out clean., Cool cake 20 minutes., Remove from pan and cool completely on a wire rack.

title: Hot Fudge Sauce
directions: Melt chocolate chips over hot water., Add milk; heat until mixture is just warm., Serve over ice cream., Can be refrigerated and warmed again.

title: Oktoberfest Sauerkraut(Liz Cooked 60 Pounds For The '93 Oktoberfest)
directions: Combine all ingredients and add a little water., Simmer for 3 hours.

title: Strawberry Quick Bread
directions: Combine eggs, sugar, oil and strawberries., Beat well., Add flour, soda, salt and cinnamon., Grease and flour 2 loaf pans. Bake at 350° for 50 minutes or until bread tests done., Cool only slightly and remove from pans.

title: Pecan Pie
directions: Heat oven to 375°., Mix together sugars and flour., Beat thoroughly by hand eggs, milk, vanilla and butter.	Fold in nuts. Pour into pastry-lined pan., Bake 37 minutes or until done.

title: Delicious Million Dollar Pie
directions: Melt chocolate chips and butter over low heat; gently stir in Rice Krispies., Press into 9-inch pie dish., Beat together pudding and cold milk, then add Cool Whip and marshmallows., Pour into the pie shell and cool at least 2 hours.

title: Fried Shrimp
directions: Combine milk, egg and beer, beating well., Roll shrimp in flour, then in milk mixture, then in flour again., Fry in hot oil until brown., Drain on paper towels.

title: Lasagna
directions: Cook noodles until tender; drain., Pan-fry ground beef until brown and pieces separate; drain., Add Ragu sauce and mushrooms to browned ground beef., Heat until bubbling., Using 10 x 13-inch baking dish, place a single layer of noodles on bottom of dish. Cover noodles with layer of beef and sauce., Place cheese slices over beef and sauce, then sprinkle heavy with Parmesan cheese. Repeat each step again., Bake in preheated 350° oven 15 minutes.

title: Gourmet Potatoes
directions: Peel and shred cool potatoes coarsely., Melt butter over low heat., Add cheese and stir until melted slightly., Fold into potatoes with remaining ingredients., Turn into casserole dish. Sprinkle with paprika., Bake for about 25 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Veal Parmigiana
directions: Dip veal cutlets in beaten eggs and dredge in Italian bread crumbs., Bake coated cutlets in a well greased baking dish for 35 minutes at 350 degrees., Pour spaghetti sauce over cutlets, then sprinkle with cheeses., Bake for an additional 10 minutes., Serve hot.

title: Croutons
directions: Toss bread cubes with butter and seasonings., Spread in a single layer in shallow pan., Bake in 300° oven, stirring occasionally until crisp and light brown, about 30 to 45 minutes. After cooling, store in airtight container for use in soups and on green salads., Store in refrigerator or freezer for extended storage.

title: One Pot Supper
directions: In a large pot place cabbage on bottom and then potatoes., Add enough water to cook., Cook only until about half tender., Add sausage pieces., Cover and cook until tender., Add butter and salt and pepper to taste., Serve with cornbread.

title: Nutrition Bombs
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Mixture will be stiff., Shape into balls., Roll in sesame seed, coconut, chopped nuts, etc.

title: Dirt Cake
directions: Crush Oreos with filling and set aside., Cream together butter, cream cheese and powdered sugar., Set aside., Blend pudding and milk., Mix cream cheese mixture and pudding mixture together, then fold in Cool Whip., Layer crushed Oreos and filling., Very attractive in a trifle dish., Keep refrigerated.

title: Spinach Salad
directions: Clean the spinach and tear it into bite size pieces., Put in a salad bowl., Toss with onion, celery and eggs., Chill., Toss with dressing.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Chop onion and saute in butter. Cook rice and broccoli. Mix all together. Preheat oven to 350° and cook for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Tortellini Soup
directions: Bring broth to a boil., Add tortellini and cook to package directions (about 4 minutes)., Add spinach and cook 2 to 3 minutes., Serve immediately in heated bowls sprinkled with Parmesan cheese., Serve with crusty bread and butter., Serves 2 or 3 as a main course or 6 as an appetizer.

title: Chicken Spaghetti
directions: Brown pepper and onions in the oleo., In large boiler, first cook spaghetti in broth until about tender., Add all other ingredients., After all is cooked about 10 minutes, it can be baked in a casserole dish about 25 minutes in a 350° oven., If desired, freeze to use later.

title: Exotic Fruit Compote
directions: Drain all fruit. Arrange in alternate layers in large baking dish/casserole.

title: Fruit Fluff
directions: Mix Cool Whip, sour cream and gelatin with mixer., Fold in other ingredients., Pour into serving bowl., Chill until time to serve.

title: Peanut Butter Drops
directions: Combine all ingredients and mix well., Roll in, balls and place on waxed paper, to chill., Dip in chocolate chips and wax which have been melted together.

title: Apple Cheese Salad
directions: In medium bowl, combine lettuce, apple, cheese and sunflower seeds; toss gently., In small saucepan over medium heat, heat jelly and vinegar until melted, stirring frequently., Cook slightly. Pour over salad; toss to coat., Yields four 1-cup servings.

title: Squash Dressing
directions: Saute onion, celery and green pepper in a small amount of oil or butter., Mash squash and mix in saute vegetables., Add crumbled cornbread, can of cream of chicken soup and egg., Bake at 350° until firm and brown, about 35 minutes.

title: Tofu Cheesecake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Prepare crust by crushing granola in blender to make 1 1/4 cups of crumbs., Press into a 9-inch pie plate.

title: Cornflake Cookies
directions: Cook syrup and sugar until it begins to boil., Remove from heat and add peanut butter, then cornflakes., Drop on wax paper from spoon.

title: Chili
directions: Brown meat in cast-iron pot; drain well and return to stove. Add tomato sauce and 1 1/2 cups water; simmer., Add chili powder and all herbs., Mix well and allow to cook for about 10 minutes. Add salt and cayenne pepper to taste; allow to simmer until thick. Add sugar and cook for few minutes longer., Serves 10 to 12 people.

title: Zucchini Quiche
directions: Add all ingredients to beaten eggs., Bake in greased quiche pan or baking dish at 350° for 45 minutes., Cool and serve in small squares or serve warm as main dish.

title: Olive Hors D'Oeuvres
directions: Mix the margarine, flour and Mozzarella cheese as you would a pie crust., With your fingers, roll the dough around the stuffed olives., Bake at 400° on a cookie sheet for 15 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Forgotten Cookies
directions: Beat egg whites until foamy., Gradually add sugar., Beat until stiff., Add salt and vanilla., Mix well., Add pecans and nuts. Preheat oven to 350°., Drop by spoonfuls onto foil covered cookie sheet., Put in oven and immediately turn oven off., Leave cookies in closed oven overnight.

title: Our Lord'S Scripture Cake
directions: Note:, Look up the references in the Old Testament.

title: Scalloped Potatoes And Peas
directions: Set oven to 400°., Scrub potatoes and remove eyes or bad spots., Slice paper thin (a food processor does job quickly). Oil-rub a 1-quart baking dish or 2 (1/2-quart) dishes., Layer half the potatoes, onions, flour and salt in the dish., Cover with all the peas and top with layers of remaining onions, potatoes, flour and salt (in that order).

title: Tuna Fish Pie
directions: Melt butter, add pepper and onions, cook until soft., Add flour and stir until smooth., Add milk slowly, stirring constantly until thick and smooth., Boil 2 minutes, add remaining ingredients, pour into large baking dish, cover with rolls., Bake 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Gobble Gobble Meat Loaf
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., In a large bowl, mix all ingredients well., Spoon mixture into loaf pan., Cook for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

title: Sand Cookies
directions: Beat margarine and sugar for 5 minutes., Dissolve soda in vinegar and add to margarine mixture., Add vanilla; beat in flour. Add chocolate chips., Drop by teaspoonful onto ungreased cookie sheets., Bake at 275° for 30 minutes.

title: Quick Turtles
directions: Arrange pecans in clusters of 3 or 4 halves 2-inches apart on greased baking sheet., Top each cluster with 1 caramel, slightly flattened., Bake at 300° for 7 minutes or until caramels soften. Remove to waxed paper.

title: Brownie Mix
directions: In a large bowl, combine first five ingredients., With a pastry blender, cut in shortening until evenly distributed. Store in a large airtight container in cupboard., Keeps 10 to 12 weeks., Yield:, About 17 cups of mix.

title: Fruit Slush
directions: Dissolve sugar in hot water., Cool completely., Combine remaining ingredients; pour in sugar and water mixture., Place in freezer., Stir once an hour for the first 3 hours., Freeze 24 hours., Thaw at room temperature until slushy before serving.

title: Chili Mac And Beef
directions: Brown meat, onions and pepper salt., Stir in remaining ingredients., Taste and if necessary, add chili powder., Simmer about 20 minutes until macaroni is tender., Add more water, if not saucy., Cook 5 minutes longer.

title: So... Easy Crock-Pot Roast Beef
directions: Put roast in crock-pot. Sprinkle onion soup mix over roast (no water required). Cook 8 to 10 hours on medium heat. Add potatoes and veggies as you wish.

title: Sweetheart Salad
directions: Heat pineapple with sugar., Add gelatine which has been softened in the 1/4 cup cold water., Stir until dissolved., Add lemon juice and cherry juice and set aside to cool.

title: Favorite Soft White Frosting
directions: Mix flour and milk; heat slowly until it makes a thick paste. Cool in refrigerator., Combine remaining ingredients; beat until fluffy., Add flour paste and beat well.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
directions: Boil, together	ingredients, until, mixture, forms soft ball. Drop, a, little, dab, of mixture in cold water., Remove from fire and, add 3 tablespoons peanut butter., Mix until it begins to thicken., Pour into butter-greased pan, 9 x 13-inches., Let set until mixture is solid.

title: Upside Down German Chocolate Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Grease and flour 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Spread coconut evenly in bottom of pan., Sprinkle with pecans. Prepare cake mix following package directions for original recipe. Pour over coconut and pecans., Combine cream cheese and melted butter, beat until creamy., Add sugar; beat until smooth., Drop by spoonfuls evenly over cake batter., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until toothpick inserted 1/2 to bottom comes out clean., Cool completely., To serve, cut into pieces and turn upside-down on plates.

title: Plantation Pecan Pie
directions: Cream butter and gradually add sugar., Add syrup and evaporated milk., In a separate bowl, add salt to eggs and beat until light., Stir well into first mixture., Add vanilla and pecans., Use 1 cup nuts for halves, 1 1/2 cups if using broken pieces., Pour into pie shell. Bake in preheated oven at 400° for 10 minutes., Lower heat to 350° and bake for 35 to 40 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Six Layer Cookies
directions: In a 9 x 12-inch baking dish, melt margarine., Add remaining ingredients in order, sprinkling evenly., Do not press down., Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes., Cut in small bars when cooled., Do not overbake.

title: Orange Sour Cream Dip
directions: Combine orange juice and milk in blender., Add pudding and blend on low speed 2 minutes., Stir in sour cream., Chill 2 hours. Serve with fresh fruit.

title: "Cheese Potato Casserole"
directions: In a large casserole dish, mix potatoes, sour cream, onion soup mix and cheese., Also, add salt and pepper in a saucepan; melt butter., After it melts, crumble your Toasties in with your butter., When the Post Toasties are pretty well soaked in the butter, spread over the contents already in the dish., Bake at 350° for one hour or until cheese is brown.

title: Crock-Pot Chicken And Rice
directions: Mix in crock-pot the 3 cans of soup. Add rice., Place the chicken on top of mixture., Add the diced celery. Cook for 3 hours on high or 4 hours on low.

title: Toll House Pie
directions: Beat eggs until foamy; beat in flour and both sugars., Blend in butter., Stir in chips and nuts; pour in pie shell., Bake at 325° for 1 hour., Serve warm with cream or vanilla ice cream.

title: Mexican Casserole
directions: Mix beans and chopped chilies., Layer in small (4 x 8-inch) dish., Mix together and layer on top of beans sour cream, mayonnaise and taco mix., Mix together and add next layer of tomatoes, black olives and green onions., Top with grated cheese. Serve cold or heated.

title: Chinese Chicken Sandwiches
directions: Cook oil, flour, salt and mushrooms in skillet., Add drained liquid, plus enough water to make 1/2 cup liquid., Cook until thickened., Add lemon juice, soy sauce, chicken or turkey, celery and green pepper; cook for 15 minutes., Spoon onto split hamburger buns., Serve hot.

title: Chile Rellenos Dip
directions: Peel and chop tomatoes; add remaining ingredients., Add salt, pepper, Worcestershire and Tabasco sauces to taste., Chill and serve with Doritos.

title: Chicken Over Stuffing
directions: Cook chicken cutlets in chicken broth for about 20 to 30 minutes or less., Put them in a butter coated casserole dish., Put Stove Top stuffing on top of chicken., Mix cream of chicken soup with milk and pour over stuffing., Sprinkle with cheese., Bake until bubbly at 350°, about 40 minutes.

title: Raisin Drop Cookies
directions: In a small pan, boil the raisins in the water. Boil for 5 minutes., Cool., Stir in 1 teaspoon baking soda. Let stand.

title: Custard Sauce
directions: In a heavy 2-quart saucepan over low heat or double boiler over hot (not boiling) water, beat egg yolks, sugar and salt with wire whisk., Gradually stir in milk and cook, stirring constantly, until mixture thickens and coats the back of a spoon, about 25 minutes., Stir in vanilla., Serve sauce warm or cold over apple pie, fruitcake, cut up fruit or ice cream., Serves 12.

title: Broccoli-Onion Deluxe
directions: Cook broccoli according to package directions., Drain., Cook onions in boiling salted water until tender., If frozen onions are used, drain., In saucepan, melt 2 tablespoons butter., Blend in flour, salt and pepper., Add milk all at once., Cook, stirring, until thick and bubbly., Reduce heat and blend in cream cheese until smooth., Stir in vegetables., Place mixture in a 1 1/2-quart casserole and bake for 20 minutes at 350°., Melt remaining butter. Toss with bread crumbs and Parmesan cheese and sprinkle over casserole., Bake 20 minutes more.

title: Lady Baltimore Cake
directions: Cream shortening and sugar thoroughly., Add sifted dry ingredients alternatively with milk and water; beat smooth after each addition., Add extracts., Fold in egg whites., Bake in 2 waxed paper lined pans, 9 inch square layer pans in moderate over (350 degrees) for 30 minutes., Put layers together with 2/3 of the recipe for Seven Minute Frosting tinted a delicate pink.

title: Johnnycake(Northern Corn Bread)
directions: Combine all ingredients; mix (be careful not to overbeat) until well blended., When batter is smooth, pour into greased 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan., Bake at 425° for 20 to 25 minutes., Can be served warm.

title: Lemon Gooey Bars
directions: Mix cake mix, butter and 1 egg in a well greased and floured 9 inch x 13 inch pan., Combine cream cheese, 2 eggs and powdered sugar., Spread over cake mixture and bake 350° for 35 minutes.

title: One Pot Dinner
directions: Brown beef and onion together., Drain off fat and put into crock-pot., Brown bacon; drain off fat., Add bacon and remaining ingredients to crock-pot., Stir together well., Cover and cook on low for 4 to 9 hours.

title: Pineapple Sheet Cake
directions: In large mixing bowl, combine all ingredients., Mix until smooth., Pour into greased 15 x 10 x 1-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 35 minutes., Cool.

title: Party Fruit Punch
directions: Be careful to keep in a moderately warm atmosphere., Do not refrigerate., Do not overbake, boil or broil., Neither should you keep her in a stew., Women are tender and bruise easily so do not pinch or whip too hard., When she appears to wilt, take her out to dinner., Sprinkle with equal amounts of strength and kindness. Baste often with love and affection., Garnish occasionally with flowers as this improves the flavor over the years.

title: Hello Dolly Bars
directions: In 9 x 13-inch pan, melt 1 stick of butter., Add graham cracker crumbs, coconut, chocolate chips, butterscotch chips and condensed milk., Sprinkle with walnuts (chopped)., Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Apple Dip
directions: Mix until creamy and serve with sliced apples.

title: Crawfish Fettucini
directions: Saute onions, celery, bell pepper and garlic in butter., Cover pot; stir occasionally., Add flour., Cook 10 minutes and stir. Add parsley, green onions and crawfish., Cook 10 minutes., Stir. Add milk slowly, then add Velveeta cheese., Cook over low heat for 20 minutes., Season to taste., Serve over noodles and add Parmesan.

title: Barbecue Sauce
directions: Mix all ingredients in a gallon jar; then fill to top with Worcestershire sauce., Shake well.

title: Scripture Cake
directions: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs, one at a time. Mix salt, flour, baking powder and spices (such as cinnamon, nutmeg and allspice)., Mix honey with water and add alternately to first mixture with combined dry ingredients., Add raisins, figs and nuts., Pour into greased loaf pan or angel cake pan., Bake at 375° until done.

title: Quail Pie
directions: Cook quail until tender in enough water to cover them., Salt water to taste. Save liquid. Remove all meat from bones; place in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix 4 tablespoons flour in 1/2 cup cold water. Add flour paste gradually to cool quail broth, stirring constantly. Cook mixture until thickened; pour over quail meat in pan. Add the drained peas. Roll out pie crust to cover top of pan. Dot with butter. Bake at 375° until crust is golden brown.

title: Frozen Worm Cups
directions: Prepare pudding mixes according to package directions; let stand 5 minutes., Layer puddings in cups, sticking 1 or 2 gummy worms in each pudding so that they look like they are coming out of the dirt., Insert wooden stick in each pop and freeze about 4 hours., To serve, remove from cups and enjoy.

title: Poached Salmon
directions: Thaw salmon if frozen., In large skillet, combine water, lemon juice and pepper., Bring to a boil., Add salmon., Simmer, covered, for 7 to 10 minutes, until fish flakes easily., Remove salmon from liquid and serve., Serves 4.

title: Carrot Kugel
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., Beat the egg yolks with sugar until light., Add the grated carrot, shredded apple, wine, lemon juice, lemon peel and potato flour., Blend well., Beat the egg whites until stiff peaks form and fold them into the carrot mixture. Spoon into a well-greased 1 1/2 quart casserole., Bake 35 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Baked French Toast
directions: Grease 13 x 9-inch baking dish., Diagonally cut bread into 1-inch slices and place in baking dish., Set aside., In bowl, beat eggs, sugar and vanilla., Stir in milk until blended., Pour mixture over bread in baking dish, turning slices to coat well. Cover and refrigerate overnight., Heat oven to 375°., In bowl, combine flour, brown sugar and cinnamon., Cut in butter until mixture resembles small crumbs., Turn bread slices over in baking dish., Scatter blueberries over bread and sprinkle evenly with crumb mixture., Bake 40 minutes or until golden brown., Cut into squares., Top with strawberries., Makes 8 servings.

title: Blueberry Crunch
directions: Wash and drain blueberries., Melt butter or margarine., Add flour, sugar and baking soda., Mix well., Pat 3/4 of mixture into 9 x 13-inch glass dish, well-greased., Sprinkle with berries and top with rest of mixture, crumbled up., Bake 20 to 25 minutes at 425° or until edges are brown.

title: Fried Cornmeal
directions: Put hot cornmeal mush in a loaf pan; cut into slices., Put slices of mush in heated greased frying pan and fry both sides.

title: M&M Pie
directions: Mix sugar and flour. Add butter and stir. Add well beaten eggs and stir. Add M&M's, coconut, pecans and vanilla. Pour into pie shell. Bake at 350° for about 30 minutes. Do not overbake.

title: Spaghetti Pie
directions: Cook spaghetti noodles and drain., Stir butter into hot spaghetti., Stir in Parmesan cheese and eggs., Form into a "crust" in a 10-inch pie plate., Spread cottage cheese over spaghetti crust., In skillet, cook hamburger, onion and green pepper until vegies are tender and meat is browned., Drain., Stir undrained tomatoes, tomato paste, sugar, oregano and garlic salt., Heat through., Turn meat into "crust.", Bake, uncovered, 20 minutes in a 350° oven., Sprinkle with Mozzarella cheese., Bake until melted.

title: Batter Rolls
directions: Scald milk., Stir in sugar, salt and margarine., Add cold to lukewarm., Measure warm water into large bowl., Add yeast and stir until dissolved., Add lukewarm milk mixture, egg and 2 cups of flour; beat until smooth., Stir in remaining flour to make a soft dough., Cover and let rise in a warm place, free from drafts, until doubled in bulk (about 15 to 20 minutes)., Punch down and shape into rolls.

title: Thick Fruit Salad
directions: Drain the fruit and use the juice instead of milk to cook the pudding, using 4 1/2 cups of juice., Add orange juice if you don't have enough from the fruit., Cook until thick., Cool completely. Add all of the fruit, except the bananas, which you will add when you serve., Keep in refrigerator., This is enough for a 9 x 13-inch cake pan.

title: My Vegetable Sandwich(Ideal For Picnic)
directions: Use 1 cup of stir-fry vegetables., Heat until soft, then add flour, cornstarch or leftover cream potatoes (your choice)., Add chopped onion to vegetables., Salt and pepper., Serve as open-faced sandwich or closed sandwich using 2 slices of your favorite bread.

title: Cobbler
directions: Whisk together 1 cup sugar, flour, salt and baking powder. Add milk. Whisk. Melt 1 stick of butter in bottom of cake pan. Pour batter over butter. Pour fruit over batter. Sprinkle 1/2 cup sugar over fruit. Bake for 1 hour or until golden at 350°.

title: Spinach Dip
directions: Combine well and refrigerate., Serve with raw vegetables or bread chunks.

title: Asparagus Almond Casserole
directions: Combine asparagus with soup, eggs and almonds., Season with a little red pepper and paprika., Mix well., Place in buttered casserole., Spread cheese over top., Bake about 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Pineanna Nut Cake
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Grease and flour 3 round cake pans, 9 x 1 1/2-inches. Mix flour, sugar, baking soda, salt and cinnamon in large bowl., Add oil and eggs., Stir until all dry ingredients are moistened; do not beat., Stir in bananas, 1 cup pecans, the vanilla and pineapple., Divide batter evenly among pans., Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean., Cool 10 minutes; remove from pans., Cool completely on wire racks., Fill layer and frost side and top of cake with cream cheese frosting., Sprinkle 1/2 cup of pecans on top of cake., Cut cake using sharp knife., Refrigerate any remaining cake.

title: Applesauce Cupcakes
directions: Cream the butter and sugar., Add eggs, applesauce, flour and floured fruit., Bake in paper baking cups.

title: Lime Pickles
directions: Wash and cut cucumbers in 1/4-inch sliess., Soak in water and lime 8 to 10 hours., Wash several times to get lime out., Put cucumbers in solution made with rest of ingredients., Let stand 3 hours., Boil in same solution for 30 minutes., Put in clean hot jars and seal., Makes 7 or 8 quarts.

title: Sweet Potato Rolls
directions: Combine sweet potatoes and 3 tablespoons melted butter. Dissolve yeast in 1/2 cup warm water, then add to potato mixture. Add egg, salt and sugar; blend together., Sift flour and measure; add 4 cups alternately with 3/4 cup warm water to potato mixture. Turn onto well floured (using the other cup of flour) board and knead., Place in greased bowl, turning to grease top., Cover; let rise for 2 hours or double in bulk., Place on board; roll to desired thickness and cut in shapes desired., Place on greased cookie sheet; brush tops with butter and allow to rise for 1 hour. Bake at 425° for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Shoney'S Strawberry Pie
directions: Cook, sugar, cornstarch and 7-Up cola until thick., Add coloring;, cool., Fold, in strawberries and pour in pie shell. Refrigerate and garnish with whipped topping.

title: Favorite Cheesy Grill
directions: Top 1 bread slice with processed cheese and second slice of bread., Spread sandwich with margarine., Cook in skillet on medium heat until lightly browned on both sides., Makes 1 sandwich.
