title: Harvest Potatoes With Herbs
directions: Heat oven to 425°., In small bowl, combine seasonings., Place 2 tablespoons melted oleo in 10-inch nonstick skillet., Arrange a third of the potato slices in a circular pattern in skillet. Sprinkle with about 1/4 teaspoon seasonings, 4 teaspoons melted oleo and 2 tablespoons onion., Repeat layers twice., Cover tightly with foil; press layers down., Bake 20 minutes., Uncover; bake 20 minutes or until potatoes are tender., Remove from oven; press layers down with a spatula., Let stand 10 minutes., Invert onto serving platter to unmold potatoes.

title: Apple Surprise
directions: Place pie filling in a 9 x 13 inch cake pan., Sprinkle lemon juice over the pie filling with., Add one part of the cinnamon over the mixture., Cover filling with dry cake mix, do not stir. Sprinkle with the remaining cinnamon., Drizzle melted butter over the cake mix., Spread nuts over top of cake., Bake at 350 degrees for 30 to 40 minutes, until topping is bubbly.

title: Pizza Casserole
directions: Bring 8 cups of water to boil. Add pasta. Reduce heat. Cook in gently boiling water for 8-10 minutes or until tender. Drain. Return to pot. Cut pepperoni in half and add to pasta. Stir in pizza sauce and 3/4 cups mozzarella cheese. Transfer to a baking dish. Top with remaining mozzarella cheese. Bake at 400° for 15 minutes.

title: Sweet Potato Pound Cake
directions: Mix dry ingredients together in a large bowl., Add add oil, vanilla, and sweet potatoes and mix well., Add eggs, one at a time, mixing well each time., Pour into a greased and floured Bundt pan. Bake in oven at 350° for 1 hour., Cool.

title: Easy Coffee Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients., Put half in greased and floured 13 x 9-inch pan., Put half of the can of pie filling on batter, then add more batter, then rest of filling, layering it., Take a knife and cut through and swirl around., Bake at 375° for 45 minutes. Can drizzle frosting on it, but is delicious as it is.

title: Marinated Vegetables
directions: Mix the first six ingredients., Place cut up vegetables in 1 1/2-quart shallow baking dish., Pour sauce over vegetables and mix., Cover and refrigerate 6 hours or overnight.

title: Russian Tea
directions: Mix all ingredients in airtight container., Shake contents of container before mixing 3 heaping teaspoonfuls with boiling water in a mug., Stir thoroughly.

title: Frozen Dessert
directions: Divide cake into 3 sections., Break into pieces about large marshmallow size., Place in tube pan 1/3 of cake with dry orange jello., Place oranges on top, then spread 1/3 of ice cream over all., Mix 1/3 of cake pieces with dry lime jello, then add to pan. Cover with blueberries followed by 1/3 of ice cream., Mix last 1/3 of cake with dry strawberry jello and add to pan, followed by strawberries and last of ice cream., Freeze at least 3 days.

title: Pickled Mixed Vegetables
directions: Heat vinegar mixture to boiling point., Remove from heat and let cool., Prepare any combination of vegetables suggested above. Slice thin, peppers, carrots, garlic, half onions and cut in 1/4-inch strips., Separate cauliflower into small flowerets. Rinse beets., Drain mushrooms (4 quarts in a gallon jar)., Pour vinegar mixture over vegetables and keep refrigerated., Will keep several months.

title: Baked Ziti
directions: Prepare the meatballs by combining the beef, egg, bread crumbs and onion; mix well., Form into balls about 1 1/2-inches in diameter, rolling them around in your hands to make them round. Heat the olive oil in a skillet and brown the meatballs on all sides., Pour in the red wine and cook over low heat for about 10 minutes., Add the tomatoes (including juice) and basil; simmer for about 25 minutes.

title: Ham Casserole
directions: Drop by spoonfuls onto mixture., Bake at 375° for 45 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Sweet Potato Oven Fries
directions: Cut the sweet potatoes into wedges lengthwise. Spray them lightly with the cooking oil spray. Add the salt and pepper. Bake them at 450° until crispy on the outside and tender on the inside, about 25 minutes. Turn them halfway through the cooking time.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
directions: Slice potatoes and onions thin and place in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish., Mix mushroom soup with milk., Pour over potatoes and onion., Sprinkle cheese over top., Bake at 350° for about 45 minutes., Serves 6.

title: Banana Pudding
directions: Mix 3 1/2 cups milk with vanilla and banana instant pudding. Add box of sour cream and 3/4 of Cool Whip., Mix well., Layer in dish with vanilla wafers and bananas. Top with remaining Cool Whip., Chill and serve.

title: Crab Spread
directions: Beat cream cheese 1 to 2 minutes with electric mixer until creamy., Blend in remaining ingredients., Spread mixture in 9-inch pie plate., Sprinkle top with paprika., Bake, uncovered, at 375° for 20 minutes or until golden brown., Then spread or dip any of your favorites.

title: Applesauce Cake
directions: Cream margarine., Add sugar slowly; add eggs, one at a time. Sift spices, salt and flour., Add coffee and applesauce., Stir in raisins, nuts and coconut., Pour into a greased and floured tube pan., Bake at 350° for 1 hour 15 minutes.

title: Chicken Dressing Casserole
directions: In a 13 x 9-inch baking dish, combine soups; lay chicken on top of soup., Mix stuffing mixes with chicken broth until moist., Pour over chicken., Cover with foil and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Sunday Chicken And Rice
directions: Mix rice, soups and vegetables together. Season to taste. Pour into a 9 x 13 casserole. Wash chicken, dry and season. Melt margarine in skillet. Coat chicken on both sides. Put chicken on top of the rice. Pour a small amount of chicken broth or water around the edges of the casserole, about 1/4 cup. Bake at 275° for 2 1/2 hours, uncovered. Freezes well.

title: Chili Rellenos Bake
directions: Combine cheeses; spread half on bottom of 8 x 8-inch baking dish., Split open chiles., Place over cheese; top with remaining cheese., Gradually add milk to flour., Blend well; add eggs., Pour over casserole; cover and bake at 325° for 45 minutes., Cool 10 minutes; cut into squares.

title: Swiss Steak(Serving 200)
directions: Mix flour, 2 tablespoons salt, 1 tablespoon pepper and 2 tablespoons seasoned salt until well blended. Coat steaks with flour mixture. Brown lightly in hot oil., Transfer to steam table pans.

title: Spaghetti Bolog'Nase
directions: Saut mushrooms, carrot, onions and green pepper in oil. Add sausage and cook until sausage is done. Drain well. Add remaining ingredients. Simmer 40 minutes (or longer).

title: Apple Crisp
directions: Place apples in greased 6 x 10-inch baking dish., Mix flour, sugar, baking powder, salt and egg with fork until well mixed and crumbly., Place this mixture over top of sliced apples., Pour over all the melted butter., Sprinkle with cinnamon., The secret to this recipe is the egg in the crumb mixture., Be sure it's well mixed., Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: 7 Minute Microwave Bread And Butter Pickles
directions: Mix all the ingredients together and microwave on High for 7 minutes., Put in refrigerator to crisp and store.

title: Ground Beef Grand Style
directions: Brown ground beef with onions in skillet, stirring until ground beef is crumbly; drain., Combine cream cheese, soup, milk, catsup and salt in bowl; mix well., Add to ground beef; mix well. Spoon into 2-quart baking dish and bake at 375° for 10 minutes. Arrange biscuits around edge of casserole., Bake 15 to 20 minutes longer or until biscuits are golden brown., Makes 6 servings.

title: Asparagus Lasagne Bianco
directions: Cook noodles as directed on package., Drain and cut in half crosswise., In saucepan, cook garlic and thyme in butter., Blend in flour., Cook, stirring constantly, for 2 minutes., Stir in milk; cook until thickened., Season sauce with salt and pepper. In buttered 2-quart baking dish, layer 1/3 of noodles, sauce, cheese, ham and asparagus., Repeat layers twice., Cover and cook on high for 9 to 10 minutes.

title: Chocolate Cake
directions: Beat cake flour, cocoa, oil, buttermilk and 1 teaspoon vanilla in one bowl., Set aside, then beat 2 eggs until foamy., Gradually add sugar., Put both mixtures together., Pour in cake pans that have wax paper on bottom., Bake at 350° for 35 minutes or 40 minutes., Cool, then take cake out., Peel wax paper off., Use no-bake white icing on this cake.

title: Sweet And Sour Chicken
directions: Skin and bone chicken breasts., Mix next 3 ingredients., Lay chicken in greased baking tray., Pour mixture over and bake covered tray for 1 hour., Uncover and bake for an additional 15 minutes., Serves 4.

title: Hamburger Subs
directions: Brown hamburger. Add cheese, 1/2 stick of margarine and 1/2 package of dressing mix. Split the sub rolls across and scoop out the inside of the cut rolls. Cut the pieces of bread that were scooped out into small pieces and add this to the hamburger mixture. Stuff the rolls with the mixture and put on a baking pan. Melt the other 1/2 stick of margarine and add to the rest of the Ranch dressing mix. Pour this over the rolls and bake until light brown.

title: Vegetable Salad
directions: Mix in a large bowl; serve with dressing of your choice.

title: Carrot Salad(Serves 45 People)
directions: Put all, together, in, glass bowl., Mix well; chill and serve. This will serve 45 people.

title: Drop Sweet Potato Bread
directions: Cook potatoes until tender., Add flour and nutmeg together. Mash potatoes until smooth., Add milk and flour alternately., Add margarine; beat until smooth., Drop by tablespoonfuls on a greased cookie pan., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

title: Lasagne
directions: In a large skillet, cook sausage on medium to medium low. Add ground chuck., Add salt, pepper, onion powder, garlic powder, fennel seeds, sugar, basil and 1/8 c. parsley flakes., Keep turning the meat continuously., Turn range to low heat., Add cans of tomatoes and tomato paste., Let it come to a low boil (bubbles). Turn to simmer and cover with a lid., Let it cook for 1 1/2 to 2 hours., Check every 15 minutes.

title: Orange Pineapple Punch(Make 1 Day In Advance)
directions: In a 6-quart container, combine first 7 ingredients., Place punch in covered container and freeze., Remove to partially thaw. Break into chunks; add ginger ale and cherries., Stir until slushy., Makes 27 (6 ounce) servings.

title: Salsa
directions: Combine all ingredients in medium bowl.

title: Mason Jar Dressing
directions: Put all ingredients in quart jar and shake well., A clove of garlic kept in the jar adds to the flavor., Refrigerate.

title: "Dirt Cake"
directions: Mix 2 packages (regular size) vanilla instant pudding with 3 1/2 cups milk (set aside)., Cream the cream cheese, powdered sugar and butter together., Mix all mixtures together in "large" bowl with Cool Whip., Crush Oreos., Layer Oreos and mixture in a flowerpot, starting with Oreos and ending with Oreos on top for "dirt.", Stick artificial flowers in pot and serve with small dirt spade.

title: Pickled Garden Relish
directions: Combine the vinegar, oil and seasonings in a large saucepan, stirring to dissolve sugar., Add all other ingredients; toss to coat., Bring to a boil on high heat; reduce to low and simmer, covered, for 10 to 20 minutes, or until cauliflower is crunchy but cooked., Cool, then refrigerate a day before serving, stirring several times to marinate all ingredients equally., Drain just before serving., (Serve cold.)

title: Sherry Pound Cake
directions: Mix and beat together until smooth and creamy., Bake in Bundt pan in 350° oven for 45 minutes.

title: Fruit Flour Tortillas
directions: Place filling in tortillas., Roll up and place in baking dish, seam side down., Bring to boil the sugar, butter, water and flavoring., Pour boiling mixture over tortillas and soak for 40 minutes., Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Ghost Cookies
directions: Mix sugars, peanut butter, margarine, shortening and egg in a large bowl., Stir in flour, baking soda, baking powder and salt. Cover and refrigerate about 3 hours or until chilled.

title: Great Pork Chops
directions: Trim off any excess fat from chops., Beat eggs with a little milk and place in pie tin., Grind crumbs or crush fine., In 9 x 13-inch pan, sprinkle a light layer of garlic salt or powder., Dip chops in egg (both sides) and dip in crumbs (both sides); layer evenly over bottom of the pan., Top each chop with a tablespoon of undiluted soup., Add 1 cup milk around edges of pan., Cover with foil to seal., Bake for 1 1/2 hours at 325°.

title: Night Before Mashed Potatoes
directions: Boil and drain potatoes., Whip hot potatoes, adding cream cheese and sour cream., Whip until fluffy and smooth. Add salt and pepper to taste., Place into a buttered 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Dot generously with butter and sprinkle with seasoned salt. Cover with foil and refrigerate., Potatoes could be frozen at this stage and thawed before baking. Bake, covered with foil, 15 minutes at 325°., Uncover and continue baking for 20 minutes more.

title: Sweet Onion Corn Bread
directions: Cook onion in butter until tender and clear., Prepare mix according to package directions., Pour into greased 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan., Sprinkle with cooked onion., Mix sour cream and cheese; spoon over the top., Bake in hot (400°) oven for 25 minutes or until done., Let stand a few minutes before cutting.

title: Hamburger Soup
directions: Cook ground beef and onion over medium heat until browned. Drain on paper towels., Discard pan drippings., Add tomatoes, water, bouillon cubes, salt, pepper, bay leaf, celery and Worcestershire sauce., Bring to a boil., Cover and simmer 30 minutes., Add mixed vegetables, noodles and thyme., Bring to a boil., Simmer, uncovered, about 20 minutes, stirring occasionally. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Grandma Dyer'S Potato Salad
directions: Boil potatoes., Mash potatoes with milk and mayonnaise to taste., Add sweet pickles and chopped onion., Slice boiled eggs and put on top of potato salad., Salt, pepper and paprika to taste., Serve warm.

title: Pie Crust
directions: Mix together and roll out between 2 pieces of wax paper. Yield: 2 crusts.

title: Sausage Balls
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Roll into small balls., Place on cookie sheet., Bake at 400° for 15 minutes.

title: Italian Fried Cheese
directions: Dip cheese in eggs and coat with bread crumbs., Deep fry in 350° vegetable oil for 1 to 2 minutes or until brown.

title: Baked Fudge Pudding
directions: Put margarine and cocoa in saucepan and melt over low heat. Cool slightly., Add sugar, flour, eggs and vanilla., Beat with electric mixer until creamy., Add nuts; stir thoroughly., Pour mixture into a greased 8 x 10-inch baking dish., Bake 45 minutes at 325°.

title: Hawaiian Torte
directions: Combine the first 3 ingredients and press into an 8 x 10-inch pan.

title: Hawaiian Yum Yum
directions: Mix ingredients., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Mix ingredients., Prepare 1 box of wild rice according to directions and add to mixture., Mix well., Put in a 12 x 12-inch Corning Ware dish., Sprinkle with paprika and Parmesan cheese. Bake at 350° for 35 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Happy Apples
directions: Slice the apples. Spread peanut butter over., Make happy faces with raisins.

title: Chicken Cheese Ball
directions: Mix well., Roll into ball., Roll in chopped nuts. Chill and serve with crackers.

title: Potluck Vegetable Casserole
directions: Drain whole kernel corn, cooked cauliflower, cooked broccoli and mushrooms., Cut up large pieces of cauliflower., Combine cream-style corn, cheese and soup., Fold in drained vegetables. Turn into a 12 x 7 1/2 x 2-inch baking dish., Melt butter., Toss with crumbs., Sprinkle atop mixture., Bake uncovered in a 375° oven 30 to 35 minutes or until hot., Serves 12 to 15.

title: Quick Chicken Lunch
directions: Mix first 5 ingredients together in a 6 x 11-inch Pyrex. Layer mixture with Doritos on top., Cover with grated cheese and bake at 350° for 30 minutes., Serves 4 to 6.

title: West Virginia Cookies
directions: Combine eggs, sugar, pitted dates and margarine in skillet over low heat., Stir constantly, until mixture forms thick paste. Remove from heat., Add vanilla, Rice Krispies and nuts., Roll into balls and then into coconut., Makes 50 to 60 pieces.

title: Langostinos And Pear Salad(Yield: 4 Servings)
directions: 1., Shred 1 small head lettuce to make a good layer in bottom of a 9 x 11-inch dish.

title: Puppy Chow(Snack Food)
directions: Mix together cereal, nuts and raisins., Melt together chocolate chips, margarine and peanut butter., Add vanilla., Pour mixture over cereal and nuts., Mix well., Pour powdered sugar into large clean plastic garbage bag; pour mixture into bag and shake. Serves 2 to 3 teenagers!

title: Iowa Summer Sausage
directions: Mix together thoroughly all ingredients; chill overnight. Flour hands and shape mixture into roll; wrap in foil and place on cookie sheet., Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours., Refrigerate or can be frozen.

title: Poppy Seed Chicken Or Turkey Casserole
directions: Cut meat into bite-size pieces., Spread in a greased 8 x 8-inch casserole dish., Mix cream of chicken soup and sour cream together, spread on top of meat., Mix crackers, melted butter and poppy seed together and put on top of sour cream/soup mixture. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes., Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Baked Apple French Toast
directions: Preheat oven to 400°., Spray 9 x 13-inch pan with vegetable oil spray., Slice bread into 1 1/2-inch slices., Place bread tightly together in one layer in pan.

title: Rice With Beans And Cheese
directions: Preheat oven to 350°. Mix rice, beans, garlic, onion and chilies., Layer this mixture alternately in a greased casserole with Jack and Ricotta cheese, ending with rice mixture., Bake for 30 minutes., During last few minutes of baking, sprinkle grated Cheddar cheese over top., Serves 6 to 8.

title: Cranberry Freeze
directions: Place all ingredients in a blender and blend at low speed. Add more cranberry juice if necessary

title: Chicken Mandarin
directions: Wash and dry chicken pieces., Shake in a paper bag with flour to coat., In a skillet, heat oil and margarine., Add chicken and brown each piece., Drain mandarin oranges and set aside., Mix juice from the can with the lemon juice, orange juice, honey, soy sauce and ginger., Pour sauce over the chicken in skillet., Cover and simmer for 30 minutes or until tender., Add mandarin orange sections for 5 to 10 minutes before chicken is done., Serve with rice., Serves 4.

title: Instant Spiced Tea
directions: Mix all ingredients together thoroughly., To serve, stir in 2 teaspoons to 1 cup boiling water.

title: Crispy Chocolate Bars
directions: Combine, chocolate, and butterscotch morsels and peanut butter in	a, large, pan. Stir over low heat until smooth. Add Rice Krispies or corn flakes., Stir until well coated., Spread mixture into, a long baking dish. Chill until firm., Let stand at room temperature for 5 minutes before cutting into bars.

title: Cream Cheese Danish
directions: Grease 9 x 13 pan. Use 1 can of rolls on bottom. Don't separate or press into pan. Mix cheese, vanilla, sugar and egg yolk. Spread on rolls. Place second can of rolls on top. Bake at 325° for 30 minutes.

title: Potato Candy
directions: Boil medium potato, peel and mash., Put in with powdered sugar and cornstarch., Add vanilla., Mix well., Add enough milk to make it like dough., Put a little cornstarch on table and roll and spread lightly with peanut butter., Cut into pieces.

title: Crock-Pot Camp-Out Chili Dogs
directions: Combine all ingredients except cheese and rolls in a crock-pot., Stir well., Cover and cook on low for 5 to 10 hours (on high for 2 to 3 hours)., Add cheese just before serving and allow to melt slightly., Serve each frankfurter in a roll and spoon sauce over top., Makes 6 to 8 servings (about 2 quarts).

title: Oriental Roast Pork
directions: Combine all ingredients, except pork., Place meat in plastic bag big enough to hold it and place in bowl., Pour marinade in bag. Refrigerate at least 4 hours, overnight is fine., Occasionally move the bag around so marinade reaches all portions of the meat.

title: Hot Broccoli Dip
directions: Cut slice from top of bread loaf, remove center, leaving 1-inch shell., Cut removed bread into bite size pieces.

title: Sweetened Condensed Milk
directions: Mix water and sugar in blender; set aside., Add butter and milk., Blend at high speed until mixed well., Store in Tupperware.

title: Million Dollar Relish
directions: Ingredients are put through a food chopper and measured when chopped.

title: Cocktail Wieners
directions: Mix mustard and jelly in saucepan over low heat., Add cocktail wieners to sauce and heat through., Serve hot.

title: Dagwood Sandwiches
directions: Spread out bread on table., Spread mustard or Miracle Whip. Layer 1 slice of each on bread, putting lettuce, pickles and tomatoes in between the slices., Put top slice of bread on., Slice in half., Makes 6 sandwiches.

title: Gingerbread
directions: Add soda to molasses and let stand for a few minutes., Add milk, egg and butter., Add sifted dry ingredients., Mix well. Pour into 8-inch square greased pan., Bake at 325° for 35 to 40 minutes., Serve with cheese slices or whipped cream.

title: Halushki
directions: Mix all together, making a slightly thickened paste. Place mix on a dish and scrape off in about nickel-sized amounts into boiling water. Stir occasionally.

title: Fresh Apple Or Pear Cake
directions: Combine sugar, oil, vanilla, eggs, lemon juice and salt in a mixing bowl., Beat well., Mix, flour, and, soda;, add, to first mixture and beat, well, again., Add, apples, and pecans. Mix well. Grease and dust Bundt pan with flour., Bake at 325° for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Sour Milk Biscuits
directions: Mix dry ingredients together., Add Crisco., Mix until crumbly. Add milk., Mix., Place on a lightly floured board and knead lightly., Cut., Place on ungreased cookie sheet., Bake at 475° for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Cranberry Almond Biscotti
directions: In a small bowl, plump cranberries in apple juice., Drain and set aside., Preheat oven to 350°., Cover baking sheet with parchment or buttered wax paper; set aside., In food processor, grind 3/4 cup of the almonds to a fine powder., Scrape ground nuts into a large bowl., Add flour, sugar, cinnamon, baking powder, soda, remaining 3/4 cup whole almonds and cranberries., Mix to blend., Pour in honey and water., Mix until ingredients form a stiff dough., Divide dough into 2 parts., Roll each piece into a 12-inch log., Place dough logs on prepared sheet.

title: 3 Layer Lasagna
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Mix ground beef with bread crumbs., Roll into meatballs and brown in skillet., Brown sausage, too., Slice meatballs and sausage., Boil noodles about 15 to 20 minutes., Cover bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan with sauce., Layer noodles on top of sauce., Spread Ricotta cheese over noodles., Spread meatballs and sausage over cheese., Pour more sauce over meats., Put sliced Mozzarella cheese over sauce., Repeat process until pan is full. Top with noodles, Mozzarella cheese, then sauce., Bake 45 minutes. Let cool for 15 to 20 minutes., Serves 4 to 6.

title: Nut Caramels
directions: Blend sugar, corn syrup and salt with wooden spoon., Boil for at least 10 minutes, stirring well., Add butter., Slowly stir in evaporated milk and continue stirring., Do this at medium heat (it may bubble and pop, you may have to remove it from heat until you finish adding all the milk)., Stir constantly and cook until a firm ball forms in cold water, 245° on candy thermometer., Remove from heat., Add vanilla., Use electric mixer to beat for a couple of minutes., Add nuts and pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan., Cool completely., Cut into squares., Wrap individually., Yield:, 120 to 140 caramels, about 3 pounds.

title: Lentil Soup
directions: Mix all ingredients together; heat to boiling., Add one tablespoon butter; salt and pepper to taste., Serve hot.

title: Sourdough Bread Or Cinnamon Rolls
directions: Take 1 cup of starter from a friend., Add 1/2 cup sugar, potato flakes and 1 cup hot water., Leave out 8 to 12 hours., Take 1 cup of starter that has been out (put other back in refrigerator for 3 to 5 days)., Add 1/2 cup of sugar, vegetable oil, salt and 1 1/2 cups hot water., Mix and gradually add bread flour., Make dough; let rise 8 to 12 hours., Make into loaves or rolls., (Press flat and sprinkle with sugar, cinnamon and chips of butter., Roll up and cut.), Let rise 8 to 12 hours., Bake at 325° for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Banana Split Cake
directions: Mix crumbs and margarine together and form into crust in 9 x 13-inch pan., Mix sugar, margarine and eggs together for at least 15 minutes., Smooth mixture over crust., Cut bananas lengthwise and place on mixture., Drain pineapple and pour over bananas., Top with Cool Whip, nuts and cherries., Chill., When firm, cut into squares and serve.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Boil and drain broccoli; place in greased casserole dish. Blend soup with mayonnaise; add lemon juice and mix., Pour over broccoli., Top with grated cheese, then bread crumbs (or crushed potato chips)., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until thoroughly heated.

title: Chewy Fudge Brownies
directions: Blend ingredients well; batter will be stiff., Add pecan pieces., Bake 25 minutes at 350° in glass oblong dish greased on bottom with nonstick cooking spray or vegetable shortening., Do not overbake., Cool completely in pan on wire rack., Cut into squares., Cover tightly after cooling to keep.

title: Sunday Treat
directions: Mix vinegar, honey, cloves and cinnamon in saucepan., Heat to a simmer., Add peach halves; cool., Chill several hours or overnight; drain., Serve fruit with some of the liquid over it.

title: Ham And Broccoli
directions: Cook rice; drain., Cook broccoli., Pour rice in 9 x 13-inch dish., Layer broccoli on top of rice., Mix rest of ingredients except Parmesan cheese., Cover broccoli with mayonnaise mixture. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese., Bake 45 minutes in 350° oven.

title: Shoo-Fly Pie
directions: Preheat oven to 375°. Prepare crumb topping by combining flour, brown sugar and shortening in bowl until mixture resembles course meal. In another bowl, dissolve soda in boiling water. Add molasses and corn syrup; blend well. Pour into unbaked pie shell and sprinkle crumbs evenly over the top. Bake in the middle of the oven for 10 minutes. Reduce heat and continue to bake for 35 minutes or until filling is set. Do not overbake!

title: Sauerkraut Salad
directions: Drain sauerkraut and rinse in cold water., Drain again and add 1 cup sugar., Let set overnight., Add celery, pimiento, onion, wine vinegar, oil and green pepper., Mix and marinate 24 hours. Delicious salad; no sauerkraut taste, just good!

title: Creamy Macaroni And Cheese
directions: Cook macaroni as per box; drain., Combine with next 4 ingredients., Spoon into greased pan., Top with crushed crackers. Bake at 325° for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: 7 Layer Dip
directions: Mix sour cream and taco seasoning together; set aside. Layer in order: bean dip, guacamole, sour cream mixture, picante sauce, chopped tomatoes, and sliced black olives., Cover with cheddar cheese and top with jalapenos to taste., Refrigerate.

title: Potato Casserole
directions: Mix together potatoes, onion, soup, sour cream and butter. Top with corn flake crumbs and, if desired, pieces of butter here and there on top of corn flake crumbs., Bake in 350° oven for 1 hour.

title: Taco Dip
directions: Layer bean dip in bottom of a pie plate., Spread sour cream on top., Spread taco sauce on top., Sprinkle with cheese, tomato and onion., Serve with taco chips.

title: Corned Beef Casserole
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Butter a 9 x 13-inch casserole dish. Shred cabbage and place in bottom of dish., Peel and slice potatoes and put on top of cabbage., Slice onion and place a layer on top of potatoes., Crumble corned beef on top and pour soup over casserole., Salt and pepper to taste., Cover with foil., Bake for 1 hour.

title: Five Minute Fudge
directions: Combine Carnation with sugar in heavy saucepan., Heat to boiling., Cook 5 minutes, stirring constantly., Remove from heat; add remaining ingredients., Stir until marshmallows are melted. Pour into buttered 8-inch square pan.

title: Veggie Casserole
directions: *Such as broccoli, cauliflower, whole carrots and water chestnuts (a must).

title: Quick Cherry Cobbler
directions: Put cherry pie filling in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle cake mix on top., Put margarine slices on top of cake mix., Bake in 350° oven for 25 minutes.

title: Mandarin Orange Salad
directions: Dissolve jello in hot water., Melt sherbet in jello., Add drained fruit and nuts., Pour into 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan; chill until set., Garnish with whipped cream cheese.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Cook chicken and save broth for stuffing., Debone chicken. Cook chopped onion and celery in butter until tender., Mix 1/2 cup water with can chicken soup., Add onion and celery to soup mixture and heat., Mix stuffing according to recipe on package., Spread chicken on bottom of casserole or pan., Spread soup mixture over chicken., Cover chicken and soup with prepared stuffing., Bake about 1 hour at 325°.

title: Sausage Quiche
directions: Pierce pie shell., Beat egg yolk with water and brush shell. Bake at 400° for 15 minutes. Saute sausage and onion, then stir in flour. Beat eggs with milk., Set aside., Sprinkle half the cheese on shell., Top with sausage, then rest of cheese., Pour in egg mixture. Sprinkle with parsley. Bake at 375° for 25 to 30 minutes or until set.

title: Hummus
directions: Put all ingredients except salt and paprika in a blender or food processor and puree., Season with salt., Garnish with paprika., Serve with pita bread., Makes about 3 cups.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
directions: Mix ingredients., Put in a 9 x 13-inch casserole pan.

title: Ranger Cookies
directions: Mix shortening and sugar together., Add eggs and vanilla and beat well., Add flour, soda, baking powder and salt., Gradually add oatmeal., Mix in Wheaties or Total with your hands., (The batter becomes very dry.), Add coconut if you wish.

title: Chocolate Pie
directions: Mix flour, sugar, salt and cocoa in double boiler. Pour enough milk to mix., Add egg yolks., Stir in rest of milk and cook until mixture is thick., Remove from heat., Add butter and vanilla. Pour in pie shell. Top with meringue, if desired.

title: Turkey Tetrazzini
directions: Cook, rinse and drain pasta according to directions., Cook mushrooms and pepper in a small amount of boiling water in a large covered saucepan about 3 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Drain well., Stir together flour and 1/2 cup cold water in a small bowl., Stir into vegetable mixture in saucepan., Stir in milk and bouillon., Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly., Stir in the pasta, turkey or chicken and sherry or water., Spray a 2-quart square baking dish with nonstick spray coating., Pour the pasta mixture into the dish., Sprinkle with cheese., Bake, uncovered, in a 400° oven for about 10 minutes or until heated through., Makes 4 servings.

title: Pizza Hors D'Oeuvres
directions: Crumble sausage and brown with onion, bell pepper and celery. Add cheese., Spread on small slices of wheat bread., Bake until bubbly.

title: The World'S Best French Onion Soup
directions: Heat oven to 400°. On stove top, heat butter in a large saucepan over medium heat. Add onions and stir often until softened and golden brown, about 35 minutes. Increase heat to high and pour in 1/2 broth, stirring until most of the broth has evaporated and onions are browning again. Continue until you have used up 2 cups of the broth. Wrap bay leaf, parsley and thyme in cheesecloth. Add to soup; reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, 15 minutes. Season with Madeira and salt and pepper to taste. Toast bread in oven on a cookie sheet 5 minutes. Divide the soup among 8 ovenproof bowls. Sprinkle 2 tablespoons of cheese over each, then top with bread and 2 tablespoons more cheese. Place bowls on cookie sheet and bake until the cheese bubbles, 10 minutes. Makes 8 servings.

title: Country Or Cured Ham
directions: Use a 15 gallon pot.

title: Clam Chowder
directions: Cok on medium heat for 10 minutes.

title: Vienna Bread
directions: Combine lukewarm water, sugar and yeast in bowl., Let stand 15 minutes., Add salt and oil; mix., Gradually add flour., Mix well. Knead until smooth on floured board., Place in greased bowl and let rise until doubled., Punch down and let rise again., Cut into 3 pieces., Let rise again (15 minutes)., Shape into long loaves and place on greased cookie sheets sprinkled with cornmeal., Cover with towel and let rise in warm place until doubled., Bake for 50 to 60 minutes at 350°.

title: Chicken-Corn Soup
directions: Cover chicken with water and cook until tender., Remove from water; cool., Cut into bite-size pieces., Set aside.

title: Rice Salad From France
directions: Mix well in a large bowl., For the dressing, make an oil and vinegar dressing and add salt, pepper, about a teaspoon Dijon mustard, parsley and basil., Mix to taste and pour over salad. Serve chilled., This is authentic, straight from Paris!

title: Sour Cream Fruit Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Let set for at least 2 hours before serving.

title: Apple Crumb Cake
directions: Grease and flour Bundt pan., In large bowl, cream butter and 2 cups of sugar., When fluffy, add eggs., Stir dry ingredients in separate bowl., Beat flour mixture in cream mixture., Alternate with sour cream., Beat in vanilla. Stir apples and remaining sugar; fold in batter., Spoon 1/2 batter into pan.

title: Banana Bread
directions: Mix together, then add bananas. Bake at 350°.

title: Chocolate Candy Bar Pie(Serves 15 To 20; 9-Inch Pie)
directions: In microwave, heat candy bars, marshmallows and milk on High 3 to 4 minutes., Stir after 2 minutes., Chill 30 minutes until thickened., Stir occasionally., Whip whipping cream., Fold whipped cream into cooled chocolate mixture., Lightly pour into prepared crumb pie shell., Freeze until firm., Cut with wet knife.

title: Sugar-Free Strawberry Pie
directions: Mix jello, cornstarch, Sugar Twin, water and salt in saucepan. Bring to boil, stirring at all times., Cook until clear., Cool for about 5 minutes and pour over strawberries that have been arranged in baked pie crust., Refrigerate for about 3 hours. Serve with Cool Whip Lite.

title: Baptist Pie (Makes 2-9-Inch Pies)
directions: Mix all ingredients except crusts., Pour into 2 pie crusts and chill., Top with additional Cool Whip.

title: Best Cake Ever
directions: Mix all ingredients together, except chocolate chips and German chocolate; beat 2 minutes., Grate chocolate; mix into cake batter., Stir in chocolate chips., Bake at 350° for 1 hour in a greased and floured tube or Bundt pan.

title: Stuffed Mushrooms
directions: Remove stems from mushrooms; chop stems., Combine in 1-quart casserole, stems, onion and margarine., Microwave on High 2 minutes., Stir in bread crumbs, cheese and seasonings; mound in caps., Microwave 2 to 2 1/2 minutes., Rotate 2 times while cooking. Heat thoroughly.

title: German Delight
directions: Heat all but 3 squares chocolate with 1/4 cup milk over low heat., Beat in cream cheese and remaining milk., Gently stir in whipped topping until smooth., Spoon into crust., Freeze until firm., Remove from freezer., Let stand 30 minutes., Melt remaining chocolate, drizzle over pie.

title: Mexican Meat Loaf
directions: Mix ingredients together., Bake in greased loaf pan at 375° for 45 minutes.

title: Angel Amanda Biscuits
directions: Combine ingredients., Cut in shortening., Stir in yeast and buttermilk. Roll and cut., Bake at 450°., Will keep in refrigerator for 1 week.

title: Banana Bread
directions: Cream butter and sugar., Add beaten eggs; add bananas, milk, flour and nuts., Bake in loaf pan at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Chicken And Rice-A-Roni
directions: Prepare Rice-A-Roni as per box instructions., Place in a 9 x 12 or 9 x 13 baking dish., Lay chicken breasts on top of Rice-A-Roni., Season with salt, pepper and paprika., Cover and bake for 1 hour or until chicken is done in 350° oven., You may remove cover last 20 minutes or so.

title: Ham Roll-Ups
directions: Make your noodle dough., Roll it out., Make stuffing out of chopped meat, onions, salt, pepper, eggs, parsley and spinach. Cover half of noodle layer with stuffing, then put second half on it., Take wooden board and press quarters by using edge of board, but do softly so stuffing moves and forms pillows (each about 6 x 6 cm) and the two noodles layers meet and glue., Then separate pillows from one another with a knife and cook in a broth for 15 minutes., Serve it in broth or with potato salad and green salad.

title: Orange Coconut Balls
directions: Crush vanilla wafers to fine crumbs., Add sugar, margarine, orange juice and nuts., Mix well., Form into balls and roll each ball in flaked coconut., Yield: 6 dozen.

title: Aunt Fanny'S Cabin Baked Squash
directions: Wash and cut up squash. Boil until tender. Drain thoroughly. Then mash. Add all ingredients, except 1/2 of the margarine. Melt remaining margarine. Pour mixture in baking dish, then spread melted margarine over top and sprinkle with cracker meal or bread crumbs. Bake in 375° oven approximately 1 hour or until brown on top and set.

title: Angel Food Cookies
directions: Cream shortening and sugars., Add egg., Mix well., Sift together dry ingredients and add., Stir in flavoring and coconut. Shape into small balls; roll in sugar., Place 2 inches apart on a greased sheet., Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Rookie Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., Mix cake mix, eggs, water and shortening., Mix in pecans., Shape dough into balls the size of small walnuts., Roll balls in powdered sugar., Place on greased baking sheet., Bake 8 to 10 minutes., Makes 48 cookies.

title: Vegetable Casserole(Feeds 10 To 12 People)
directions: Cook vegetables., Heat soups., Layer vegetables in 9 x 13-inch greased pan., Pour soup over vegetables., Add chestnuts, then onion rings., Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

title: Stir-Fry Vegetables
directions: Heat oil about 1 minute., Add vegetables with wooden spoon. Stir constantly until food is only wilted, but still crunchy., The secret of good stir-fry is not to overcook.

title: Potato Salad
directions: Combine salad dressing, mustard, celery seed, salt and pepper. Mix well., Add potatoes, eggs, onion, celery and pickles., Mix lightly., Chill., Makes 6 servings.

title: Rosemary Pork Chops
directions: Trim fat from chops., Add oil to skillet., Add chops and brown well on both sides., Sprinkle with pepper., Add shallots, vermouth and rosemary., Over high heat, heat to boiling., Reduce heat to low; cover and simmer for 10 to 15 minutes., Serve with brown rice and carrots.

title: Devil'S Food Cake
directions: Bring to boil chocolate, Crisco and milk., When cool, add sugar, eggs, flour, baking soda and vanilla., Do not overmix. Bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Mandarin Orange Cake
directions: Mix together well, adding eggs, one at a time., Pour into three 8-inch cake pans (grease bottoms only)., Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes., Let cool on rack for at least 5 minutes.

title: Big Mac Special Sauce
directions: Blend all the ingredients with a fork., Keep tightly covered and refrigerated., Use within a month., Makes 2 cups.

title: Mom'S Italian Cinnamon Cookies(Pinwheels)
directions: Make a well in the flour and baking powder., Add eggs, liquid, vanilla and lemon extract., Beat with fork, bringing in the dry ingredients., Add more flour to obtain soft, firm consistency., Rest dough 10 minutes and roll out, using flour to prevent sticking., After rolling to about 1/4-inch, spread butter., Sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon lavishly., Roll up., Cut into 1/2-inch pieces., Lay flat on cookie pan and bake only until lightly golden.

title: Coffee-Caramel Ice Cream Pie
directions: Spread melted chocolate over bottom of crust. Freeze until set, about 5 minutes. Spoon ice cream into crust; smooth top. Freeze until very firm, about 4 hours. Can be prepared up to 4 days ahead.

title: Health Nut Spread
directions: Mix all and adjust to taste., Can add more or less of any item., Serve on crackers, bagels or English muffins.

title: Stuffed Burger Bundles
directions: Prepare stuffing according to package directions., Combine evaporated milk and meat; divide into 5 patties., On wax paper, pat each to 6-inch circle. Put 1/4 cup stuffing in center of each; draw meat over stuffing and seal., Place in 1 1/2-quart casserole., Combine remaining ingredients, pour over meat., Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 45 minutes., Makes 5 servings.

title: Broccoli And Rice Casserole
directions: Combine cooked rice and cooked broccoli with onion which has been sauteed in margarine., Add soup, water and Cheez Whiz., Cook in shallow baking dish at 350° for 20 minutes., Sprinkle grated Colby cheese on top and bake approximately 5 more minutes, until cheese is bubbly.

title: Clear Lemon Filling(Used Between Layers Of Cake.  Terrific!)
directions: Add gradually, stirring., Spread over or between layers.

title: Cream Of Squash Soup(A Wonderful Way To Use Up Yellow Squash. Serves 12.)
directions: Saute onions and garlic in butter until translucent. Add carrots, potatoes, squash and chicken stock and cook until vegetables are tender, about 45 minutes. Remove from heat. When cool enough to handle, puree in blender, about 1 cup at a time. Return to pot. Add cream and heat thoroughly. Add salt and cayenne if desired. At serving time, sprinkle a bowl with paprika. Can be served hot or cold. Can be doubled.

title: Pepper Dish
directions: Use electric fryer or frying pan., Fry cut-up green peppers until soft., Add onions; fry until soft., Add hamburger; cook until browned., Open tomato soup cans; do not add water., Add soup to pan mix and you have an easy one-dish meal.

title: Tex-Mex Chops
directions: In large skillet over medium-high heat, brown chops in oil on one side, about 2 minutes; turn chops and add salsa and chiles to skillet., Lower heat; cover and simmer gently for 8 to 10 minutes. Uncover; top each chop with one tablespoon of cheese., Cover and simmer just until cheese melts., Serves four.

title: Christmas Salad
directions: Mix sugar and cranberries well!, Set 4 hours; drain., Mix all ingredients., Serve!

title: Pineapple Dump
directions: Open both cans of pineapple and pour juice and pineapple in cake pan (9 x 13-inch)., Put dry cake mix on top of pineapple (do not combine)., Melt stick of margarine in saucepan and pour as mix as possible., Preheat oven at 450°. Bake until cake mix on top is brown (golden brown)., Approximate cost:, $5.00.

title: Fruit Cocktail Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Top with whipped cream or ice cream and serve., Double recipe for a 10 x 13 x 3-inch cake.

title: Hamburger Delight
directions: Brown beef with onion., Add garlic salt, salt, sugar, pepper and tomatoes., Simmer 15 minutes., Cook noodles., Drain and put in Pyrex dish., Add meat sauce with cream cheese and sour cream., Add grated cheese., Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

title: Sausage And Potato Bake
directions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees., Spray 13 x 9 inch baking pan with nonstick cooking spray., Combine potatoes, onions, carrots, oil and soup mix in large bowl., Stir until evenly coated.

title: Cinnamon Cookies
directions: Mix butter, sugar, eggs. Then add vanilla, cinnamon, and baking powder. Divide dough in half. Chill for 3 hours. Roll out and cut. Bake at 350° for 8 minutes.

title: Robert E. Lee Cookies
directions: Melt the butter; add molasses, sugar and eggs., Beat well. Sift together and add to the mixture the flour, soda, cinnamon, ginger and cloves., Freeze dough for several hours., Break off pieces of dough (heaping teaspoon-size) and roll into small balls. Roll balls in sugar., Place on an ungreased cookie sheet about 1 1/2 inches apart., Bake in a preheated 385° oven until firm and brown, about 8 to 10 minutes., Makes 10 dozen.

title: Lipton Soup Canapes
directions: Cut bread into thirds; remove crust., Melt, oleo, with soup. Dip bread on both sides in mixture., Bake at 375° approximately 10 to 15 minutes., Watch carefully.

title: Kristy'S Mexican Casserole
directions: Brown meat and onion until done., Line pan with chips (15 x 11-inch pan)., Add layer of meat mixture, cover with tomatoes and top with cheese., Bake at 350° until cheese melts.

title: Cookie Cutter Cookies
directions: Beat margarine and sugar until fluffy. Add eggs and extract. Beat in dry ingredients., Refrigerate at least 4 hours., Roll out and cut with cookie cutters. Bake at 350° for 6 to 8 minutes. Frost with orange flavored frosting., Better the second day.

title: Marshmallow Fudge
directions: Melt butter and chocolate squares over low heat until melted. Remove from heat., Beat flour, sugar, salt, vanilla and eggs with mixer., Stir in nuts and chocolate mix., Use 9 x 13-inch pan and bake at 350° for 15 minutes., Heat chocolate chips and milk until smooth., Remove baking pan from oven and arrange marshmallows on top., Bake 5 minutes., Remove and flatten., Drizzle melted chips over marshmallows., Cover and refrigerate 2 hours., Cut when cold. Keep in refrigerator.

title: Six-Can Casserole
directions: Combine all ingredients., Bake in a 2-quart casserole for 45 minutes to 1 hour at 350°.

title: Potato Salad
directions: Add all ingredients together except the milk and heat to boil (low heat) until thick., After mixture is cooled, add canned milk to mixture and stir until your liking of thickness.

title: Strawberry Pie
directions: Crush enough of the strawberries to get 1 cup., Add sugar and tapioca., Cook over medium heat until clear and thickened., Add butter, cool, stirring occasionally., Arrange remaining strawberries in pie shell. Pour berry mixture over strawberry halves., Let cool., Serve with whipped cream or ice cream.

title: Cheese Appetizer
directions: Heat all the ingredients and mix well., Spread on crackers or party rye bread.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
directions: Butter sides of heavy 2-quart saucepan. Combine sugar and milk in pan. Stir over medium heat until sugar dissolves and mixture boils. Cook to soft ball stage (234°). Remove from heat. Quickly add Creme, peanut butter, chocolate chips and vanilla. Stir just until blended. Pour into buttered 9 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Score 1 inch squares while warm. Cut when firm.

title: Roast Leg Of Lamb
directions: Heat oven to 325°., Wipe leg of lamb with all natural paper towels., Place fat side up in a roasting pan., Sprinkle with 1/4 teaspoon of salt., Roast, uncovered, until lamb reaches desired doneness, about 2 to 2 1/2 hours., Remove roast to serving platter., Slowly drizzle 1/4 cup of the Madeira over the lamb. Let stand 15 minutes before carving the roast.

title: Quick And Easy Skillet Supper
directions: Slice smoked sausage and brown in large skillet., Meanwhile, cut cabbage in chunks and steam., Boil noodles and melt margarine. Combine everything in skillet and cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, for a few minutes., Salt and pepper as desired.

title: Bread Pudding
directions: Break bread into small pieces., Melt butter and add all ingredients; stir well., Put into greased casserole dish and bake at 350° until brown, about 30 to 35 minutes., Placing pan in a large pan of water.

title: Potato Casserole
directions: Cook, cool, peel and grate (or chop) potatoes., Melt 1/4 cup butter and stir in onions; cook onions until tender., Add cream, soup and 1 cup of Cheddar cheese to butter and onions., Heat until warm., Mix potatoes and cream mixture., Place in 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Jiffy S'Mores
directions: Spread peanut butter on one cracker., Top with chocolate. Spread marshmallow cream on remaining cracker. Place crackers together.

title: Chicken Bake
directions: Combine all 3 soups, with onion, mushrooms, parsley and raw rice until well blended., Spray, a, 13, x, 9-inch pan with Pam. Place rice mixture, in, pan;, top, with chicken breasts. (Be sure to remove all, fat from chicken.) Cover with aluminum foil and bake at 350° for 2 hours.

title: Fresh Lemon Meringue Pie
directions: Mix sugar, cornstarch and salt., Use wire whisk., Blend in cold water, then lemon juice until smooth., Add beaten egg yolks. Blend thoroughly., Add butter and boiling water, stirring constantly., Bring to a boil until thickened., Pour into pie crust., Add meringue., Bake at 400° for 10 minutes.

title: Beef Stew In The Oven
directions: In a, 5-quart Dutch oven, layer stew beef and alternate vegetables, 1/3, stew,, 1/3 celery, 1/3 peas, salt and pepper. (Easy on the, salt,, the soup has a lot.) Repeat for 3 layers. Cover top with, mushroom soup and 1/2 can of water., Cover and bake for 5 hours in oven at 225°.

title: Jelly Roll
directions: Mix flour, baking powder and salt., Beat egg until thick., Add sugar (a tablespoon at a time)., Blend in vanilla., Mix to dry mixture., Spread batter in 15 x 10-inch jelly roll pan, greased and lined with wax paper., Bake 12 to 15 minutes at 400°., Turn warm cake on towel., Sprinkle with confectioners sugar., Trim edges off., Spread with jelly; roll up.

title: Millionaire Pie
directions: Mix all ingredients together, then pour into pie shell., Top with Cool Whip and chill for 2 hours, then serve.

title: Refrigerator Cake
directions: Place over heat and stir until marshmallows melt., Let cool and add orange juice and whipping cream., Pour this mixture over sliced angel food cake., (This will cover two medium-size cakes.) Place in refrigerator until firm (about an hour)., Put the evaporated milk in the freezer about 2 hours before you whip it. Shake it occasionally or until it is a frozen mush, and it will whip beautifully.

title: One-Skillet Breakfast
directions: Chop, bacon, into small pieces and fry in skillet until almost crisp;, drain excess grease., Add hash browns;, reduce heat, to medium-low., Continue cooking until browned, turning frequently with spatula.

title: Hot Chicken Or Turkey Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Put in 9 x 9-inch pan or casserole dish., Sprinkle crushed potato chips on top., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Potato Casserole
directions: Let potatoes thaw., Mix all ingredients together., Pour in large, baking, dish., Top with parsley., Bake at 325° for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Baked Broccoli Casserole
directions: Layer broccoli, soup, mushrooms and onion rings twice., Top with cheese and bread cubes., Bake for 30 minutes at 400°.

title: Wintry Day Bean Soup
directions: Rinse beans., Place in large kettle., Cover with water., Add salt and soak overnight., Drain., Add 2-quarts water and ham or sausage., Simmer for 2 1/2 to 3 hours., Add onion, garlic, chili powder, tomatoes and lemon juice., Simmer 45 minutes., Add salt and pepper, if desired., Makes 2-quarts.

title: Cookie Sheet Chocolate Cake
directions: Sift together sugar and flour., In saucepan, bring to a boil shortening, water and cocoa., Pour over flour mixture while hot. Add buttermilk, eggs, soda and vanilla., Bake in large cookie sheet with sides (greased and floured)., Bake in 400° oven for 20 minutes., While cake is baking, make frosting.

title: Martin'S Catfish
directions: Split whole catfish., Mix corn meal, black pepper, seasoning salt, garlic powder and paprika., Fill saucepan with corn meal mixture (1/2-inch thickness)., Butter catfish in mixture and cook in preheated oil at 375° (medium).

title: Bambinoes(Party Snack)
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., Place Ritz crackers in orderly fashion on cookie sheet., Put one slice pepperoni on top of each cracker and cover with Mozzarella cheese (about 6 to 7 shreds per cracker). Bake for 7 to 10 minutes or until cheese is melted on top., Enjoy!

title: Potato Casserole
directions: Cook potatoes in their jackets with bay leaf in boiling salt water until barely tender., Cool, peel and grate., Add butter to soup; stir until smooth., Blend in sour cream, salt, pepper, green onions and cheese., Pour over potatoes., Stir gently until blended., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Calico Beans
directions: Saute ground chuck, bacon and onion; drain., Mix with remaining ingredients and bake for 1 hour at 350°.

title: Twice Baked Potatoes
directions: Wash the potatoes; pat dry., Prick each potato with a fork in a few places., Bake potatoes on a rack at 400° for about 1 hour, or until potatoes are done., Cut a thin slice from top of each potato. Scoop out the pulp into a bowl., Mash the potato pulp with the hot milk or half and half until fluffy., Beat in the butter and the green onion., Add seasonings., Fry the bacon until crisp; crumble and add to potato mixture., Spoon potato mixture into shells. Sprinkle with both cheeses., Place potatoes on baking sheet., Bake at 375° until potatoes are piping hot and cheese is melted, about 15 minutes., Serve immediately., Makes 4 servings.

title: Herb Mayonnaise Vegetable Dip
directions: Combine all ingredients except sour cream., Mix well and fold in sour cream., Chill 3 to 4 hours.

title: 9-Day Old Slaw
directions: Mix together cabbage, green pepper, onion and 1 to 1 1/2 cups sugar., Set aside., Blend remaining ingredients and bring to a full boil over high heat, stirring constantly., Pour over cabbage mixture immediately., Let cool., Cover and store in the refrigerator., Keeps 9 days.

title: Easy Lemon Pound Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients together well., Pour into a greased and floured tube pan., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Heavenly Hash
directions: Dissolve jello in hot water; add sugar and stir in marshmallows while still hot., Add lemon juice., Let cool some. Add pineapple, cottage cheese, salt and nuts., Stir until well mixed., Add softened Cool Whip., Blend thoroughly., Pour into mold or bowl., Refrigerate.

title: Chicken A La King
directions: For sauce, in a saucepan, melt butter., Stir in flour, salt and pepper., Add milk, 1 cup water and chicken bouillon granules, all at once., Cook and stir over medium heat until thickened and bubbly., Cook and stir for 1 to 2 minutes more., Stir in chicken, mushroom stems and pieces (drained) and pimiento., Heat through. Serve spooned over toast, toasted English muffins or baked patty shells., Serves 4.

title: Carbonnades 'A La Flamande
directions: Cook bacon until brown., Put bacon in 3-quart casserole dish. In bacon grease, cook onions until tender and lightly brown. Place with bacon in dish., In grease, cook beef chunks until browned on all sides., Add salad oil if necessary., Put in dish.

title: Toffee Crunch
directions: Line cookie sheet with foil., Put a layer of saltines (1/4 pound) on sheet., Boil 2 sticks of butter with 1 cup of sugar for 3 minutes., Pour over crackers., Bake at 350° for 10 to 15 minutes until golden brown., Sprinkle a large package of milk chocolate chips on top., Spread when melted., Cut long way into strips. Chill., Finish cutting crossways.

title: One Step Brownies
directions: Put all of the ingredients into bowl and mix all together. Mix about 4 minutes or until smooth., Pour into 8 x 8-inch pan and bake at 350° for 20 minutes (greased pan).

title: Oven Barbecued Chicken
directions: Arrange chicken in a single layer in a shallow baking pan. Add the sauce mixture., Cover and bake 1 hour at 325°., Uncover and bake 45 minutes., Baste occasionally.

title: Macaroni Casserole
directions: Blend soup and milk., Combine all ingredients, using only half of cheese., Pour into a greased 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Sprinkle with remaining cheese., Bake 20 minutes at 400°.

title: Turkey Dressing
directions: Mix all ingredients well., Add enough broth to be moist., Bake at 375°, about 40 minutes, or until golden brown., More broth can be added while baking., Spoon over the top.

title: Walnut Butter Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 300°., Sift first 3 ingredients into a bowl. Add butter and mix well., Stir in walnuts., Drop on baking sheet and bake until light golden brown, about 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Dump Cake
directions: Put in greased and floured pan in order given., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Baked Beans
directions: Mix ingredients together., Bake at 375° for 1 hour.

title: Chicken Piccata(May Use Green Rice As Side Dish)
directions: Melt the butter in a large skillet; heat to medium high., Roll chicken breasts in flour., Cut each breast in half or smaller pieces., Brown chicken in butter for 5 minutes; turn chicken, then pour in lemon juice, cooking wine and garlic., Cover; let cook on medium heat for 5 minutes., Remove chicken and garnish with fresh parsley., Remaining butter makes a good sauce for chicken or rice.

title: Philly Apricot Cookies
directions: Mix sugar, margarine and cream cheese well., Add eggs, juice and peel., Add flour and baking powder., Chill several hours.

title: French Silk Pie
directions: Cream butter; add gradually sugar; mix well., Blend in chocolate; add vanilla., Add eggs, one at a time, beating 5 minutes after each addition., Turn into cooled, baked pie shell., Chill 1 to 2 hours before serving with whipped cream and walnuts.

title: Never Failing Biscuits
directions: Mix the water, yeast and sugar., Stir to dissolve; add the oil, buttermilk, soda and salt., Mix well., Add the flour one cup at a time, mixing well after each cup., Cover mixing bowl with a plate or foil and refrigerate overnight or a few hours., Each time you wish to use some, stir dough lightly; cut off the amount you want., Knead on floured board or wax paper., Cut off rolls and bake at 450° until brown, about 15 minutes.

title: Key Lime Pie
directions: Combine condensed milk, limeade concentrate and whipped topping in a bowl; mix well. Spoon into pie shell. Chill for 10 minutes or until serving time. May substitute lemonade concentrate for limeade concentrate, if desired. Makes 8 servings.

title: Chocolate Cake With Black Walnut Cream Filling
directions: Place sugar, milk, egg yolks, flour and butter in double boiler., Cook until custard forms., After custard cools, add nuts and vanilla., Spread between layers., Cover with chocolate frosting.

title: Easy Coconut Custard Pie
directions: Combine all ingredients in blender., Pour into a well-greased 9-inch pie plate., Sprinkle with coconut, as desired., Bake for 45 minutes in a 350° oven.

title: Meal-In-One
directions: Cook macaroni by package directions., Saute onions in butter. Cook ground beef., Combine all ingredients together except the Cheddar cheese in large greased dish., Sprinkle cheese over top. Bake at 350°, for 1 hour., Serves 4.

title: Turtle Cake
directions: In saucepan, over low heat, melt caramels with butter and milk., Mix cake according to directions., Pour half of batter into a greased and floured 13 x 9-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 15 minutes., Remove from oven; top with chocolate chips and pecans. Pour caramel mixture over the first layer after baking it., Pour second half of cake batter over top., Bake 20 minutes more., May frost, if desired., May be prepared a couple of days in advance.

title: Crescent Chicken Squares
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Blend cream cheese and 2 tablespoons melted butter until smooth. Add chicken, milk, salt, pepper and pimento., Mix well. Separate crescent dough into 4 rectangles. Firmly press perforations to seal., Spoon 1/2 cup meat mixture into center of each rectangle., Pull 4 corners of dough to top center of filling; twist slightly and seal edges., (May be frozen at this point.) Brush tops with 1 tablespoon butter. Sprinkle crouton crumbs., Bake on ungreased cookie sheet 20 to 25 minutes until brown., Makes 4 servings.

title: Toffee Squares
directions: Cream shortening and sugar., Add egg yolk and vanilla; blend together., Add flour, mix together again., Spread this mixture onto a cookie sheet by pinching pieces of dough and pressing dough to cover the cookie sheet, working with your fingers., Bake 15 minutes at 350° oven.

title: Crispy Critters
directions: Melt the chips, peanut butter and butter in the top of a double boiler., Remove from heat and stir in the Rice Krispies. You can either drop the mixture by teaspoons on waxed paper or spread in a greased 13 x 9-inch pan., Cut into bars when cool.

title: Blueberry Crunch
directions: Wash blueberries and sprinkle with sugar., Place blueberries and crushed pineapple in a large baking dish., Sprinkle cake mix over top of berries., Melt margarine and pour over cake mix., Top with chopped pecans., Bake at 350° for 35 minutes or until brown.

title: Sand Tarts
directions: Mix, all, ingredients, and roll into marble size balls. Bake at 325° for 20 minutes., Cool and roll in powdered sugar.

title: Broccoli Cheese Cornbread
directions: In large bowl, combine all ingredients and mix well., Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes., Should be golden brown.

title: Hamburger Chili Dip
directions: Mix into crock-pot, set on low., Cook about 1 hour until hot. Serve with chips., Serves 4 to 6.

title: Broccoli Cheese Soup
directions: Cook all except cheese and milk for 3 minutes., Add heated milk and cheese, cut in chunks., Stir until cheese melts (4 minutes)., Can be frozen., When reheating, thin with canned chicken broth.

title: Blue Cheese Dip
directions: Empty all of the ingredients into a mixing bowl., Mix it all together with an electric mixer., Chill in the refrigerator., You can put it on crackers or stuff celery with it.

title: Gooey Butter Coffee Cake
directions: Blend cake mix, 2 eggs and butter., Place in a large ungreased 13 x 9-inch pan., Mix cheese, vanilla, 2 eggs and powdered sugar (save 2 tablespoons). Pour mixture on top of the first layer. Bake at 325° for 15 minutes., Then sprinkle nuts and remaining powdered sugar., Bake an additional 25 minutes.

title: Onion Soup
directions: Melt butter in a 4-quart soup pot. Saute onions slowly for about 40 minutes or until brown. Add flour and mix well. Cover and steam about 5 minutes.

title: Jamay'S Biscuit Peach Cobbler
directions: Bake biscuits as directed on can., In a 3-quart pot, add peaches, sugar, butter, nutmeg, cloves, cinnamon, vanilla and lemon flavor., Cook until it starts to get thick., Break open your cooked biscuits and place the bottom part on a greased square pan. Pour your peach mixture over the biscuit bottom, then place the top part of the biscuit over the mixture., Let bake in hot oven for 15 minutes., Serve with ice cream or cheese, if desired. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Chocolate Hazelnut Truffle Log(Makes One Log)
directions: Melt over hot, not boiling, water, chocolate morsels; stir until smooth., Remove from heat but keep over hot water., Add butter, egg yolks and heavy cream; beat with a wire whisk or fork until smooth., Stir in hazelnut flavored liqueur., Transfer to a small bowl., Set bowl over larger bowl filled with ice cubes. Chill, stirring occasionally, until fudgelike in consistency yet smooth and creamy, about 30 minutes., Shape into 8-inch log., Roll in hazelnuts., Wrap in waxed paper., Chill until ready to serve.

title: Chicken Tetrazzini
directions: In a 2-quart saucepan, combine soup, water and cheese., Over low heat, heat until cheese is melted, stirring occasionally., Add spaghetti, chicken, pepper and parsley., Heat through, stirring occasionally., Serves 4.

title: Aunt Millie'S Cheese Cake
directions: Grease and flour spring-form pan., All ingredients must be at room temperature., Mix all ingredients in one large bowl., Mix well.

title: Icebox Cookies
directions: Mix, sugars, and Crisco together well., Add eggs., Beat thoroughly., Stir, in, nuts., Add flour, soda, salt and spices which have been sifted together., Blend well., Mixture will be very, stiff;, shape, into, about 2 1/2-inch rolls and place in refrigerator., When, ready to bake, slice and bake at 375° for about 8 minutes., Bake on greased cookie sheets., Remove while warm., Makes at least 5 dozen cookies.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Place the cut up chicken, dipped in melted butter, in 9 x 13-inch baking pan., Pour remaining ingredients over chicken. Sprinkle onion soup over the top., Cover with foil and bake 2 hours at 350°.

title: Barbecue Sauce
directions: Mix all ingredients, except cornstarch and water; mix., Bring to boil; simmer 15 minutes, then add cornstarch and water., Mix and simmer until desired thickness.

title: Broccoli And Rice Casserole
directions: Melt, oleo and saute celery and onion., Mix with cooked rice; add chicken,, mushroom, soup,, Cheez, Whiz, and drained broccoli. Bake at 350° in casserole dish for 30 minutes.

title: Mayme'S Cheese Dreams
directions: Toast lightly the 8 slices of bread., Precook bacon lightly. Place cheese, tomatoes and onion on bread., Broil approximately 2 minutes., Place cooked bacon on top of mixture and broil until cheese is melted., Serve with your favorite salad.

title: Sunny Pasta Salad
directions: Boil noodles as directed on package. Drain water. Slice peppers, onion (or chop), olives and pepperoni. Mix in with noodles. Pour whole bottle of dressing over mixture. Toss well. Chill and serve.

title: Chicken Stir-Fry
directions: Heat oil over high heat., Add dash of garlic salt., Cut chicken in strips; add to oil., Cook for 3 minutes., Add vegetables; stir-fry 3 more minutes., Reduce heat; stir in the remaining ingredients., Cook 1 to 2 minutes., Serve over rice.

title: California Granola
directions: Heat oven to 325°., In large bowl, combine all ingredients, except raisins and mix well., Spread onto ungreased 15 x 10-inch jelly roll pan., Bake 30 to 35 minutes or until golden brown, stirring occasionally., Stir in raisins., Spread onto ungreased cookie sheet or aluminum foil; cool., Store in tightly covered container in refrigerator., Serves as a snack or as cereal with milk., Makes about 8 cups.

title: Pudding Surprise Cake
directions: Leave baked cake in deep large 9 x 13 or size larger pan., Add mixed banana cream pudding., Layer with Cool Whip., Top with cherry or strawberry pie filling.

title: Pear Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Cream butter with brown sugar until smooth., Beat in remaining ingredients, except sugar, until combined., Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls onto lightly greased baking sheet., Sprinkle generously with sugar., Bake at 350° for 15 minutes, or until lightly browned., Makes 4 1/2 dozen.

title: Garbanzo Bean Soup
directions: Heat beans and tomatoes together in large cooker., Cook onion and hamburger together., Pour in with beans and tomatoes., Simmer for 4 hours.

title: Zucchini Relish(Canning)
directions: Combine zucchini, onion, green and red peppers., Sprinkle with salt and cover with cold water., Let stand 2 hours., Drain vegetables; press out liquid., Combine remaining ingredients, bring to a boil., Add vegetables, simmer 10 minutes., Pour hot into hot jars, leaving 1/4 inch headspace., Adjust caps., Process 10 minutes in boiling water bath., Makes 4 1/2 pints.

title: Cinnamon French Toast(Kindergarten Recipe)
directions: You break the eggs and mix in cinnamon with a fork real good. Add milk., Put a piece of bread in and then put it into a buttered pan., (Do all 4 pieces.), Flip it over, take it out., Put it on a plate and put syrup on top., Then you eat it.

title: Self-Filled Cupcakes
directions: Prepare cake mix as directed on box., Fill each greased cupcake cup 2/3 full., Cream together the cheese, salt, sugar and egg until light and fluffy., Stir in chocolate bits., Drop a tablespoon of this mixture on top of each cupcake., Bake in a 350° oven for 25 to 30 minutes., Cream mixture will be in the center of each cake., These may be frosted with chocolate icing, if desired.

title: Bake-A-Rice
directions: Cook sausage, then drain., Boil soup mix and rice for 7 minutes in water., Add vegetables; put in baking dish., Cover with water chestnuts, then bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Easy Rocky Road
directions: Butter 8-inch square pan., In large microwave-safe bowl, place chocolate chips, butter and shortening., Microwave at High (100%) for 1 to 1 1/2 minutes just until chocolate chips are melted and mixture is smooth when stirred., Add marshmallows and nuts., Blend well., Spread even in prepared pan., Cover and refrigerate until firm., Cut into 2-inch squares., Makes 16 squares.

title: Meatballs In Sauce
directions: Mix., Form into small balls (walnut size)., Bake in a 350° oven for 25 minutes., Turn as needed., Prepare sauce.

title: Potato Deluxe(Serves 8 To 10)
directions: Mix all together. Pour into oblong pan. Sprinkle with corn flakes, crumbled. Bake 1 hour or more at 375° until brown on top. Serve for breakfast, lunch or dinner with entree and salad.

title: Busy Day Casserole
directions: Brown ground beef and chopped onion in skillet., Drain grease. Add salt, pepper and chili powder., Simmer over low heat and add cream of mushroom and tomato soups., Simmer about 5 minutes and pour meat mixture over cooked macaroni., Sprinkle crushed cracker crumbs over the top and sprinkle heavily with grated Parmesan cheese., Bake at 450° for about 10 minutes or until ingredients are heated through and sauce bubbles., Serves 5.

title: Bul-Kogi(Korean Barbecue)
directions: Place in broiler pan, cover and let marinate at least 15 minutes or until ready to cook., Uncover and broil about 10 minutes., Serve over white rice.

title: Streusel Topped Fruit Pie
directions: Preheat oven to 400°., Pour pie filling into pie shell., In bowl combine flour and brown sugar., Cut in butter until mixture is crumbly; stir in nuts., Crumble this mixture over pie filling. Bake 40 to 45 minutes or until top is golden brown and filling is bubbly., Remove from oven and let cool.

title: Oriental Beef
directions: Fry ground beef, onions and mushrooms together and drain. Return the meat mixture to the skillet., Put green beans in a strainer and run water over them to separate., Stir the beans and rice into the beef mixture., Push the skillet mixture to the sides of the skillet., Break the egg into the center and scramble., Mix the meat mixture and scrambled egg together., Add soy sauce and stir-fry until the mixture is heated., Serve from the skillet.

title: Easy Skillet Chicken
directions: Beat egg and milk together., Mix flour, salt and pepper., Dip chicken into egg mixture; roll in flour mixture., Brown chicken well, in a mixture of oil and butter, in a heavy skillet., Pour off skillet drippings., Return chicken to skillet., Add 1/2 cup boiling water., Cover., Cook over low heat for 45 minutes or until chicken is tender.

title: Fried Chicken
directions: Cut chicken into serving pieces., Soak pieces in buttermilk overnight in refrigerator., Drain., The next day, dip in flour, salt and pepper., Fry as usual.

title: Barbecue Wieners
directions: Combine all ingredients in crock-pot., Let simmer as long as possible before serving.

title: Spicy Shrimp With Noodles
directions: Prepare pasta according to package directions, while cleaning the shrimp; drain. Melt butter in a medium skillet over low heat. Stir in olive oil and red pepper flakes and raise heat to medium-high. Add shrimp and saute until almost pink. Add Cajun seasoning and garlic powder; saute for 1 minute until fragrant. Add Italian seasoning and sherry; heat until simmering. Dissolve cornstarch in water; add to skillet. Continue to cook, stirring constantly, until thickened. If necessary add small amounts of additional sherry until desired consistency is reached. Top with Parmesan cheese. Serve hot over linguine.

title: Orange Yogurt Salad
directions: Pour water over gelatin; stir until dissolved., Stir in yogurt and orange segments., Pour into 4-cup mold., Chill until firm, at least 4 hours; unmold., Makes 8 servings, about 1/2 cup each.

title: Today'S Cornbread
directions: Mix together; beat until smooth., Bake at 450° until done.

title: Oatmeal Raisin Spice Cookies
directions: Combine cake mix, shortening, eggs and water in a large bowl; blend, thoroughly., Stir, in oats and raisins., Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls, onto, ungreased, cookie sheet., Bake at 375° for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Frozen Dessert
directions: Mix Cool Whip, sour cream and sugar; add all other ingredients., Freeze., Take out 1 hour before serving.

title: Chicken-Rice Casserole
directions: Put rice in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish and place chicken on top of it., Mix together the water and cream of mushroom soup., Pour over the chicken., Sprinkle with onion soup mix; cover with foil and bake at 350° for about an hour., Uncover and bake 30 minutes longer.

title: Texas Chili
directions: Mix the ingredients and soak the ribs in this mixture for 2 hours., Then bake in oven at 300° for 2 or 3 hours., Baste every now and then with the sauce., If the ribs are fatty, drop them in boiling water for about 5 minutes before marinating, then proceed as directed., Serves 6.

title: Dump Cake
directions: Butter bottom of 9 X 13 pan. Spread pie filling evenly over bottom of pan. Sprinkle cake mix evenly over top of filling. Sprinkle nuts and butter over top. Bake at 350° for 50 minutes. When completely cooled, spread with cool whip. Keep refrigerated.

title: White Christmas Cake
directions: In a large saucepan, bring margarine or butter and 3/4 cup water to boiling, stirring constantly., Remove from heat., Add baking bar; stir until melted., Stir in buttermilk, eggs and rum extract; set aside., Sir together 1/2 cup of the flour and the pecans; set aside., In an extra bowl, stir together remaining 3 cups flour, sugar, coconut, soda and powder., Stir in margarine mixture., Fold in coconut mixture., Stir in margarine mixture. Fold in pecan mixture.

title: Chicken Enchiladas
directions: Boil chicken, until tender; debone and cut into pieces., Mix chicken,, soup, green chilies, and sour cream together.

title: Garlic Bread
directions: Mix all ingredients with enough mayonnaise to hold together (not too much)., Spread evenly over bread or buns., Place under broiler until melted.

title: Pecan Cheese Bars
directions: Combine butter, sugar and corn syrup., Cook over low heat until sugar dissolves., Cool slightly., Add beaten eggs gradually., Add vanilla and salt., Mix well., Pour into pastry shell., Top with pecans., Bake at 325 degrees for 50 to 55 minutes.

title: Chicken Casserole #2
directions: Place drained peas on bottom of 9 x 12-inch casserole dish. Spread chicken over this., Make sauce of soup, mayonnaise and water., Pour over chicken., Sprinkle on almonds., Tear bread into small pieces and place on top., Drizzle melted margarine over bread., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Egg Nog
directions: Beat yolks and whites separately., Add 1/2 cup sugar to yolks while beating., Add 1/4 cup sugar to whites after beaten stiff. Mix yolks and whites, add milk, whipped cream, whiskey and rum. Let set for at least 2 hours., Stir before serving.

title: Three-Cheese Potato Souffle
directions: In a large bowl, combine the first nine ingredients. Beat egg yolks; stir into potato mixture. In a small mixing bowl, beat egg whites until stiff peaks form; gently fold into potato mixture. Transfer to a 2-qt. souffle dish coated with nonstick cooking spray. Bake, uncovered, at 375° for 40 - 45 minutes or until golden. Serve immediately.

title: Eggplant Appetizer
directions: Wash eggplant; cut into 1/2-inch cubes., In 1/2 cup hot oil in large skillet, saute eggplant until tender and golden brown. Remove eggplant and set aside., In 2 tablespoons hot oil in same skillet, saute onion and celery until tender, about 5 minutes. Return eggplant to skillet., Stir in tomato sauce; bring to boiling., Reduce heat and simmer, covered, for 15 minutes., Add vinegar, sugar, capers, salt, pepper and olives., Simmer, covered, and stirring occasionally, 20 minutes longer., Refrigerate eggplant mixture, covered, overnight.

title: Ranch Pudding
directions: Heat oven to 325°., Mix in saucepan 1 cup brown sugar, water and butter., Boil 5 minutes., Pour into 9-inch square pan., Mix in bowl 1 cup brown sugar, milk, Bisquick, raisins, nuts and vanilla. Spoon batter on top of mixture., It will sink into liquid and spread as it bakes., Bake 45 minutes., Serve warm, plain or with whipped cream., This recipe serves 9.

title: Jalapeno Fudge
directions: Heat oven to 400°., Put chilies evenly in greased 8-inch square pan., Sprinkle cheese over chilies., Pour eggs over cheese and bake until firm in center, about 30 to 40 minutes., Place on wire rack and cool 5 minutes., Cut into bite size pieces. Delicious served on crackers.

title: Cap'N Crunch Cookies
directions: Melt almond bark., Add all other ingredients., Drop on wax paper.

title: Chapatis
directions: This is a flat bread., Sift flour and salt, adding 2 tablespoons oil and 2/3 cup water., Stir to form a ball., Knead until smooth and elastic, about 3 minutes., Divide into 12 equal pieces and form into balls., Roll into circles 6 to 7-inches; keep covered., Heat a cast-iron skillet and cook in ungreased skillet 1 minute on each side., Stack and cover with towel., Serve immediately.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Mix all the ingredients together, except cornflakes., Pour into baking dish and top with crushed cornflakes., Melt 1/2 stick oleo and pour over slivered almonds on top., Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes., Delicious with cooked rice.

title: Pumpkin Pie Squares
directions: Mix until crumbly., Press into 9 x 13-inch ungreased pan. Bake 15 minutes at 350°.

title: Fudgemallow Candy
directions: Melt chocolate with peanut butter in saucepan over low heat, stirring until smooth., Fold in marshmallows., Pour into greased 9-inch square pan., Chill until firm., Cut into squares., Yields 2 dozen.

title: "Fast And Easy" Chicken Casserole
directions: Mix chicken and eggs together; put in bottom of casserole dish., Mix broth and soup together; pour over chicken., Mix flour, milk and melted margarine; pour over casserole., Do not mix., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Breakfast Casserole
directions: Mix eggs, milk, salt and mustard., Blend well., Pour in an 8 x 12-inch greased casserole., Add bread crumbs, sausage and cheese. Cover and refrigerate overnight., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Hobo Bread
directions: Combine raisins, water and baking soda., Let stand overnight (10 to 14 hours)., Add remaining ingredients., Mix by hand with spoon., Grease cans (not too large) and fill each can 1/2 full. Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 15 minutes., Let cool in cans, when cool, remove from cans., Wrap in plastic wrap or freeze., You may use soup cans or any other size you wish.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Mix all ingredients together well and spoon onto cookie sheet. Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Raisin Cinnamon Bars(I Use Dates Instead Of Raisins.)
directions: Cream butter and sugar., Sift dry ingredients together and stir into creamed mixture; add oats and 1 tablespoon water., Mix until crumbly., Firmly pat 1/2 mixture in a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan., Spread with date filling., Mix remaining crumbs and 1 tablespoon water., Spoon over filling., Pat smooth., Bake at 350° about 35 minutes., Cool; drizzle with Cinnamon Icing., Makes 2 1/2 dozen.

title: Corn Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients together in a casserole., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Pimento And Cheese
