directions: Grate cheese., Mix in other ingredients., (Black pepper, garlic and mayonnaise are used to your taste.)

title: Wilted Lettuce Dressing
directions: Mix all together., Pour over cut up leaf lettuce., Mix enough to coat lettuce.

title: Swedish Pound Cake
directions: Cream together oleo and sugar., Add eggs, beating well after each., Mix together the remaining ingredients and stir in., Bake in greased and floured Bundt pan for 1 hour at 325°.

title: Chicken Ala Can
directions: Make in large frying pan., Put soup, water and rice in pan. Simmer for 5 minutes., Add all ingredients except onion rings, and simmer 10 minutes., Heat onion rings in oven., Dish up chicken hot dish into serving bowl and put onion rings on top.

title: Vidalia Onion Casserole
directions: Saute onions with margarine in large skillet for 15 to 20 minutes on medium heat., Place half of onions in 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish., Top with half of crackers and half of Parmesan cheese., Repeat with remaining ingredients., Bake, uncovered, in a 325° oven for 30 minutes.

title: Beef And Vegetable Casserole
directions: Brown onions in 2 tablespoons oil., Add meat and seasoning. Heat until meat loses color., Put in casserole dish over green beans., Add tomato soup., Top with mashed potatoes., Bake 35 to 40 minutes at 375°.

title: Pumpkin Nut Bread
directions: Mix all ingredients; pour into 2 greased loaf pans., Bake at 350° for 1 hour., More spices can be added to taste., Pans should not be over 1/2 full.

title: Scalloped Corn
directions: Melt butter and beat eggs., Drain the whole kernel corn. Combine all ingredients together, adding the muffin mix last., Pour mixture into a greased 7 X 11-inch baking dish., Bake ate 375 degrees for 35-40 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Pasta-Bean Salad
directions: Cook the pasta (macaroni, twists or shells) and drain., In large bowl, stir together mayonnaise, parsley, cheese and lemon juice until blended., Add pasta, beans, peas and carrots; toss to coat well., Cover and refrigerate until well chilled.

title: Molded Spring Salad
directions: Dissolve jello in boiling water., Beat in salad dressing with mixer., Stir in cottage cheese and add salt., Chill until thick and syrupy., Fold in peas, radishes, green peppers and onion. Pour into lightly oiled mold., Chill until set.

title: Light Trifle
directions: Prepare instant pudding according to package directions., Fold in half the whipped topping while pudding is still soft.

title: Casserole Of Chicken And Dressing
directions: Spread 1/2 of bread cubes in greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix chicken, celery, onion and mayonnaise and spread over cubes. Cover with remaining cubes., Combine eggs and milk and pour over top., Let stand overnight, refrigerated., Mix soup and 1/2 can of milk and pour over top before baking., Cover and bake 1 hour at 350°., Sprinkle cheese over top for last 10 minutes of baking.

title: Pasta Salad
directions: Cook noodles per package directions., Rinse under cold water. Add remaining ingredients and toss gently.

title: Chicken Deluxe Casserole
directions: Mix stuffing and butter together., Press half of mixture in lightly greased 9 x 13-inch baker., Mix the remaining ingredients together and pour over stuffing., Sprinkle remaining stuffing on top., Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

title: Apple Fritters
directions: Mix and sift flour, baking powder and sugar., Add milk and well beaten egg., Mix well., Pare and core apples, cut in sections and dip each piece of apple in the butter., Fry in deep fat until brown., Drain on paper towels and sprinkle with powdered sugar.

title: Sour Cream Chocolate Cake
directions: Melt chocolate in water over double boiler until chocolate melts; cool., Sift flour, soda and salt; set aside., Beat egg yolks with sour cream, adding sugar gradually, and beat vigorously until thick., Add chocolate mixture and vanilla mixing well., Add flour, soda and salt to sour cream mixture., Beat until smooth. Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites., Bake in paper lined 13 x 9 1/2 x 2-inch pan at 350° for 45 minutes., Frost with chocolate butter cream frosting.

title: 1-2-3 Beer Bread
directions: Mix in beer 4 ounces at a time., Pour the batter into 3 well-greased 3 x 6-inch pans., Drizzle melted butter over the top. Bake for about 50 minutes at 350°., Good at barbecues.

title: 7-Up Salad
directions: Mix together and let congeal.

title: Jan Hagel Cookies
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Lightly grease jelly roll pan., Mix oleo, sugar and egg yolk., Blend in flour and cinnamon., Pat into pan. Beat egg white and water; brush over dough., Sprinkle with nuts. Bake 20 to 25 minutes, until lightly browned., Cut immediately into strips.

title: Peggy'S Carrot-Pineapple Cake
directions: Mix sugar and oil; add eggs and crushed pineapple., Beat well. Mix dry ingredients together and add to other mixture., Add carrots and pecans and beat well., Bake in three 9-inch greased and floured pans about 40 minutes at 350°.

title: Rhubarb Pie
directions: Wash and cut rhubarb into small 1-inch pieces., Beat egg; add lemon juice, sugar and flour., Mix together and pour over chopped rhubarb., Stir until well coated., Pour into unbaked 9-inch pie crust., Dot with oleo., Cover with top crust., Sprinkle with 1 teaspoon sugar and prick holes with fork., Bake at 425° for 10 minutes and then at 350° for 30 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Cabbage Supreme
directions: Boil shredded cabbage for 7 minutes. Grate the cheese., Make white sauce with the margarine, flour, milk and salt., Line buttered 13 x 9-inch baking dish with finely crushed potato chips. Add 1/2 of the cooked cabbage, 1/2 of the white sauce mix and sliced hard-boiled eggs., Spread 1/3 cup grated cheese over mixture. Repeat steps, ending with the remaining chips. Bake at 325° for 40 minutes.

title: Christmas Ornaments(Do Not Eat!)
directions: Mix first 3 ingredients together., Knead in bowl until thoroughly blended., Lightly spray dough board and rolling pin and roll mixture to 1/2 inch thick., If dough sticks, spray a sheet of waxed paper and place over mixture., Cut out with cookie cutters. Using a straw, punch a hole in each ornament where you will put the ribbon later., Lay out to dry for at least 2 days., Tie ribbon through holes and hang on tree.

title: Raspberry Nut Bread(Mmmmmm-Good)
directions: Cream together margarine and sugar., Add eggs and vanilla., Mix together the berries, sour cream and nuts., Add alternately the dry ingredients to the liquid ingredients., Grease and flour loaf pans. Bake at 350° for 50 minutes or until done., Makes 3 loaves.

title: Holiday Garlic Olives
directions: Drain olives; save liquid., In small saucepan, combine 1 cup olive liquid, chili powder, garlic, bay leaves, olive oil, pepper and onion., Heat to boiling., Reduce heat; simmer 5 minutes, uncovered., Stir in pimientos., Place olives in a large jar; pour seasoning mixture over., Cover., Refrigerate., Make at least 3 to 4 days prior to serving., Makes about 3 cups.

title: Glazed Meat Loaf
directions: In a large bowl, combine ground beef, bread crumbs, milk, egg, onion, 2 tablespoons tomato sauce, horseradish, salt and pepper. Mix well. Put in loaf pan. Combine remaining ingredients and spread over meat loaf. Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Hawaiian Pie
directions: Mix wafers and butter and spread in a 13 x 9-inch pan. Arrange sliced bananas over crust., Beat together milk and lemon juice until thick., Add sour cream., Pour over bananas., Mix together pineapple and Cool Whip and spread over sour cream mixture., Sprinkle with pecans, coconut and cherries., Refrigerate 24 hours.

title: Sweet And Sour Baked Beans
directions: Place onions in skillet; add sugar, mustard, garlic salt, salt and vinegar., Cook 20 minutes, covered., Add onion mixture to beans., Add bacon., Bake 1 hour at 350°., Serves 12., This fills a 3-quart casserole.

title: Corn Casserole
directions: If you have difficulty finding yellow rice, use white rice.

title: Cupid Cream Puffs
directions: In a medium saucepan, heat butter with water over high heat, stirring occasionally, until butter is melted and mixture is boiling. Add salt and flour all at once. Stir vigorously over low heat until mixture leaves sides of pan in a smooth compact ball. Remove from heat., Quickly add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition until smooth and shiny., Drop mixture by spoonful on ungreased cookie sheet, 3-inches apart, shaping each into a mound., Bake in a 400° oven 50 minutes., Cool on wire rack.

title: Hearty Stir-Fry
directions: Prepare spaghetti according to package directions; drain., In medium skillet, cook sausage until no longer pink., Drain, reserving 2 tablespoons drippings., Add cabbage, onion, apple and garlic., Stir-fry just until tender., Stir in next 4 ingredients. Add spaghetti., Cook and stir until hot., Remove from heat., Add cheeses; toss to mix., Arrange on warm serving platter., Garnish as desired., Serve immediately., Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Meatballs And Sauerkraut
directions: Mix together meat, egg, bread crumbs, salt and pepper., Shape into 1-inch balls., Simmer catsup, water and cookie crumbs for 5 minutes., Add brown sugar, salt and sauerkraut., Heat to boiling. Add meatballs; lower heat and simmer for 45 minutes., Serves 4 to 6.

title: Corn Pudding
directions: Melt butter, sugar and salt gradually and add milk until it starts to thicken., Beat eggs and then stir them in., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Chili Sauce
directions: Chop tomatoes, peppers and onions fine., Boil all together slowly, then add spices and sugar and boil 3 to 4 hours., Bottle and seal while hot.

title: Cucumber Casserole
directions: *You can use half ground beef and half sausage.

title: Summer Vegetable Tian(Serves 6 To 8)
directions: Blanch the broccoli in salted, boiling water for 3 minutes or until it is bright green., Refresh under cold water and allow to drain., Trim the tough stalks from the spinach and wash well, without draining the spinach., Put the spinach in a large pot and cook over low heat, covered, until wilted, about 4 to 5 minutes. Squeeze out the water and chop roughly., Set aside.

title: Brownies From Heaven
directions: In a mixing bowl, cream butter and sugar., Add eggs, one at a time,, beating well after each addition., Beat in vanilla. Combine flour and cocoa; add to creamed mixture just until combined., Stir in walnuts., Spread into an ungreased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Bake at 350° for 23-28 minutes or until a toothpick inserted near the center comes out clean., Cool on a wire rack.

title: Cherry Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 400°.

title: Chocolate Eclair Cake
directions: Butter a 13 x 9-inch Pyrex dish., Line with graham crackers (not crushed)., Mix together pudding and milk., Fold in Cool Whip. Pour half of this mixture over graham crackers., Place another layer of graham crackers over this and pour rest of the pudding mixture over crackers., Lay a third layer of graham crackers on top., Frost top layer with Fudge Frosting and let set all day or night in refrigerator.

title: Hoppin John Soup
directions: Fry sausage and drain., Drain 3 cans of peas; use juice and all of the other 3 cans., In a 6-quart pot, stir in peas, onions, salt, pepper, water and sausage., Bring to a boil and cook on medium for 45 minutes., Add cooked rice and simmer 20 minutes more., The soup will be thick, so stir frequently to keep from sticking.

title: Asparagus-Almond Casserole
directions: Heat oven to 375°. Grease 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Toast bread; crumble and mix with butter. Combine cheese and soup. Heat slightly to melt cheese. Add almonds. Place half the asparagus in prepared dish. Cover with slices of 1 egg and half of the soup mixture. Repeat layer. Sprinkle buttered bread crumbs over all. Bake until bubbly and browned, about 30 minutes.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Cook broccoli in boiling water just enough to separate., In bowl, combine soup, mayonnaise, beaten eggs, onion and salt and pepper to taste., Pour this into broccoli, mixing well., Sprinkle cheese on top., Melt margarine and mix into stuffing; sprinkle on top of broccoli mixture., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Strawberry Cream Pie
directions: Combine softened cheese, strawberries and sugar., Process until smooth., Fold in whipped cream and freeze in pie shell., Top with additional frozen or fresh strawberries to decorate.

title: Maw, Maw Rene'S Banana Pudding
directions: Combine cream cheese and 1/2 cup milk, beating on low speed until well blended., Add remaining milk and pudding mix., Beat on low speed 1 minute., Layer wafers, bananas and pudding mix until all used, ending with top layer of pudding., Cover with a layer of Dream Whip., Serves 8 to 10.

title: Panamanian Chicken
directions: Place chicken in shallow pan and pour other ingredients over chicken., Cook covered in oven at 375° for 1 hour.

title: Aunt Wanda Chicken
directions: Heat enough oil in a skillet to cover the bottom. Salt tenderloins. Dredge in flour. Lightly brown both sides in oil. Pour off some of the oil before next step. Generously sprinkle tenderloins with lemon pepper seasoning. Mix soup and 1/2 can of hot water and pour over tenderloins. Sprinkle with a little more lemon pepper seasoning. Cover and simmer for 20 to 25 minutes. Serve with rice or mashed potatoes.

title: Crunchy Romaine Toss
directions: Brown in skillet walnuts, Ramen noodles, butter, and almond slices., Set aside and cool. In a large salad bowl, combine broccoli, romaine lettuce, chopped green onions. Mix together oil, sugar or Splenda, vinegar, soy sauce, and salt and pepper to make dressing. To romaine mixture add nut mixture and toss., Pour dressing over salad mixture and toss.

title: Shoney'S Strawberry Pie
directions: Wash strawberries and sprinkle with salt and let drain., Bake pie shell and let cool., Cook 7-Up, sugar, cornstarch and food coloring until thick and clear., Cool., Add strawberries and pour into pie shell.

title: Chocolate Syrup Cake
directions: Cream together margarine and sugar., Add eggs, one at a time. Sift together flour, baking powder and salt., Add alternately with the syrup., Add vanilla., Mix well., Bake in a sheet cake pan which has been floured and greased at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Orange Angel Food Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., Prepare cake as directed on box. Combine water, orange juice and food coloring., Add grated orange peel; mix., Bake and cool as directed on box.

title: Lana'S Peasant Bread
directions: In a large bowl, combine water, yeast, sugar and salt., Stir until dissolved., Add flour (dough will be wet)., Place dough onto floured platter.

title: Light And Easy Lemon Chicken
directions: Place each chicken breast in the center of a 12-inch square piece of aluminum foil., Fold sides of foil up so the lemon juice won't run out., Halve the lemons and squeeze the juice of 1/2 lemon over each chicken breast, then sprinkle each with 1/4 teaspoon tarragon and black pepper., (I also add 1/2 to 1 teaspoon of wine, poured over each piece of chicken.), Fold foil together and seal well., Bake wrapped chicken in shallow baking dish at 350° for 45 minutes., Makes 4 servings.

title: Peasant Potatoes
directions: In a large skillet over medium heat, melt butter., Add onion and garlic., Cook and stir 5 minutes or until onion is transparent. Stir in oregano and sausage and cook about 5 minutes more., Stir in potatoes, salt and pepper until potatoes are well coated with butter., Place mixture in slow cooker., Cover and cook on High 3 to 4 hours or on low for 6 to 8 hours, stirring every hour if possible., During last 30 minutes of cooking, add cabbage and peppers., Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese before serving., Makes 6 side dish servings or 4 main dish servings.

title: Coconut One Step Pie
directions: Blend all ingredients well. Pour into greased pie tin., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes., Serves 8.

title: Texas Stew
directions: Brown, ground, beef in a large skillet., Drain., Mix in can of	tomato	sauce,	corn,, green, beans, new potatoes and spices. Let simmer on stove for 30 to 45 minutes., Serve with corn bread.

title: Scalloped Oysters
directions: Mix the crumbs, butter and seasonings., Sprinkle a layer of crumb mixture 1/2 inch thick in the bottom of a buttered baking dish., Cover with oysters., Add a little milk, then a layer of crumb mixture., Repeat until all the mixture has been used., Be sure a layer of crumbs is on top., Bake 35 minutes in a moderate oven.

title: Oatmeal Raisin Cookies
directions: Mix all and shape into 1-inch balls., Bake at 350° for 10 to 11 minutes on ungreased baking sheets., "Do not overcook.", Cool on wire rack., Makes 3 1/2 dozen.

title: Pineapple Cocktail Barbecue
directions: Drain pineapple and save syrup., Combine the syrup with the jelly or preserves, ketchup, cloves, cinnamon and salt., Heat to boiling.

title: Fruit Ice Cream
directions: Mix all ingredients in a large mixing bowl., Place in ice cream churn to freeze.

title: Banana Bread
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Grease a 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy., Add the eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition., Sift the dry ingredients and add to the cream mixture, mixing well., Fold in the mashed bananas, vanilla and walnuts., Pour into the prepared pan., Bake for 50 to 60 minutes or until a tester inserted in the center comes out clean., Cool in the pan for 2 minutes, then invert on a rack.

title: Blueberry Crunch
directions: Spread pineapple in a lightly buttered 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish; sprinkle with cake mix, blueberries and sugar. Drizzle with butter and top with pecans. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Microwave Curried Rice With Almonds
directions: Put onions and oil into 3-quart casserole. Cover tightly and microwave on High for 2 to 3 minutes. Wash rice briefly in a sieve under cold, running water; drain well., Add to onions in a casserole along with rest of ingredients, except almonds. Cover tightly, and microwave on High for 7 minutes; stir., Cover and microwave until liquid is almost absorbed, 8 to 10 minutes longer. Stir. Cover and let stand 10 minutes., Stir again and top with almonds.

title: Ice Cream Sandwich Dessert
directions: Unwrap ice cream sandwiches and place side by side in a 13 x 9 pan. Top with caramel topping, nuts and Cool Whip. Freeze until ready to serve. Cut into squares to serve.

title: Stuffed French Toast
directions: Combine first 4 ingredients in small bowl; spread on 1 slice of bread., Top with remaining bread to form a sandwich., In small bowl, beat egg with water., Transfer to small, shallow pan and soak sandwich, turning occasionally, for 10 minutes or until all egg is absorbed., Melt margarine in small skillet; add sandwich. Cook until bottom is golden brown; turn and brown other side., Top with strawberry spread and serve., Serves 1.

title: Uncooked Chili Sauce
directions: Bring vegetables, spices, sugar and vinegar to a boil and fill 10 pint jars., Seal., The liquid that you drain off can be put in tomato juice if making it the next day.

title: Porcupine Meatballs
directions: In a bowl, combine the first seven ingredients. Add beef and mix well. Shape into 1-1/2 inch balls. In a large skillet, brown meatballs in oil; drain. Combine tomato sauce, water, brown sugar and Worcestershire sauce; pour over meatballs. Reduce heat; cover and simmer for 1 hour.

title: Frosty Lemon Supreme(Healthful Eating)
directions: Line a 9-inch pie plate with 1/4 cup of the graham cracker crumbs., Beat egg whites, water and milk to stiff peaks., Add egg yolks, lemon zest and lemon juice; beat 1 minute, gradually adding sugar., Spoon into pie plate., Sprinkle remaining crumbs over top. Freeze at least 2 hours.

title: Doughboys
directions: Wrap cubes of ham and cheese in biscuits., Toast on grill. Serve with pickle relish.

title: Cheese Ball
directions: Leave cream cheese at room temperature. Mix with onions that are chopped real fine., Cut up corn beef with scissors and mix in. Add Accent and Worcestershire sauce., Roll ball in chopped pecans., Refrigerate.

title: Crescent Lasagna Rolls
directions: Brown ground beef and sausage, stirring until crumbly., Add onions, spices, tomato paste and garlic., Mix well., Cook for 10 to 15 minutes and cool., Combine egg, cottage cheese and Parmesan cheese in bowl and mix well., Press crescent rolls into two 3 x 10-inch rectangles., Layer ground beef mixture, egg and cheese mixture and Mozzarella cheese on rectangles., Roll each to enclose filling., Place on baking sheet., Brush with milk., Sprinkle with sesame seed., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes., Serves 4 to 6.

title: Corn Pudding(Serve As A Vegetable.)
directions: Mix sugar and cornstarch., Gradually add milk, stirring until smooth., Add eggs, corn, butter and salt., Mix well., Pour into greased 1-quart baking dish., Sprinkle with nutmeg., Place in pan of hot water., Bake at 300° for 1 3/4 hours.

title: Pineapple Upside Down Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.

title: Chinese Sauteed Fresh Vegetables
directions: *Choose any 1 vegetable or combine several., Vegetables should total 1 pound before cooking.

title: Herb-Roasted Potatoes
directions: Cut the vegetables into chunks., Heat oven to 400°., Mix all ingredients in shallow baking pan in a single layer., Bake for 45 minutes or until potatoes are tender and golden brown, stirring occasionally., Serves 4 to 6.

title: Vegetable Beef Soup
directions: Brown ground beef and onion in a large saucepan., Drain off fat., Add remaining ingredients., Bring to a boil and simmer, covered, for 30 minutes or until vegetables are tender., Yield: 4 servings.

title: Mexican Cornbread
directions: Cook hamburger, bell peppers and onion., Add cheese., Add to meal, corn, oil, milk and salt., Mix all together and bake at 400° for 20 to 25 minutes or until brown.

title: Griffin'S Grape Jelly Meatballs
directions: Mix ground beef, crumbs, onion, milk, egg, and next four seasonings;, Gently shape into 1-inch balls, melt shortening in large skillet., Brown meatballs., Remove meatballs from skillet, drain fat., Heat chili sauce & jelly in skillet until jelly is melted, stirring constantly,, Add meatballs & stir until coated. Simmer 30 mins., Serve hot in chafing dish., Makes 5 dozen.

title: Taco Bake
directions: Cook ground beef with onions until browned and drain well. Spoon into a 13 x 9-inch ungreased baking dish., Into this stir taco seasoning, drained corn and tomato sauce., Spread evenly in dish., Sprinkle 1 cup shredded cheese on top., Mix Bisquick, milk and eggs until well blended., Pour over beef mixture., Bake at 375° for 35 minutes., Serve with lettuce, tomato, salsa and sour cream.

title: Blender Hollandaise Sauce
directions: Heat butter until bubbly., Place egg yolks, lemon juice and salt in blender., Blend at low speed., Uncover., Pour hot butter in., Continue to blend., Makes 1/3 cup.

title: Spanish Stew
directions: *The more celery, peppers and onions the better.

title: Peanut Butter Candy
directions: Mix sugar and syrup and bring to a boil., Remove from heat and add peanut butter mix., Add cornflakes and stir until all are coated with syrup mixture., Drop by teaspoon into wax paper., Cool and serve.

title: Orange Slice Cake
directions: Cream butter and sugar; add eggs, one at a time., Dissolve soda in milk; add flour alternately with buttermilk to creamed mixture., Roll nuts, candy and dates in extra flour, then add coconut., Add to cake batter., Bake in tube pan at 250° for 2 1/2 hours., Mix 2 cups white sugar, and 1 cup orange juice; pour on cake while hot., Store cake in pan overnight., Can also bake in loaf pans.

title: Neiman-Marcus Bars
directions: Mix 1 egg with box of cake mix and 1/4 cup butter (melted). Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan., Press mixture into the bottom., Mix 2 eggs, powdered sugar and cream cheese., Pour on top of other mixture., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Squash Casserole
directions: Drain squash and combine all other ingredients., Set aside enough stuffing or topping., Bake in casserole dish 20 to 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Forgotten Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Butter two large cookie sheets., Beat egg whites and cream of tartar until soft peaks form., Add sugar, 2 tablespoons at a time, beating constantly until stiff and glossy., Fold in vanilla, nuts and chocolate chips., Drop by rounded spoonfuls onto a buttered cookie sheet., Put in preheated oven, then turn oven off., Leave in oven for several hours or overnight until crisp.

title: Richs Celery Chicken Casserole
directions: Sprinkle tenderloins with salt and pepper., Brown in skillet in butter about 5 minutes per side., Remove., Cook onion and celery in same skillet until tender; add more butter if needed. Remove., Add flour and 1 Tbsp. butter to skillet., Stir over medium heat until paste forms., Add chicken broth to skillet. Bring to boil, stirring constantly., Stir in celery and onion. Layer rice in casserole., Layer chicken pieces over rice., Pour thickened celery broth over meat., Cover and bake for 1 hour in 350° oven.

title: Blueberry Dump Cake
directions: Spread pineapple in ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan. Spread blueberry mix over pineapple., Spread dry cake mix over blueberries. Cut margarine into pats and lay on cake mix. Sprinkle nuts on top of margarine., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. May top with whipping cream.

title: Orange Candy Cake
directions: Use some extra flour to coat candy and nuts.

title: Hot Slaw
directions: Put cabbage and onions in large bowl., Heat remaining ingredients in saucepan, bringing to a boil., Pour over cabbage and onions; toss., Refrigerate overnight.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Cook chicken and have noodles cooked and drained., Melt butter. Blend in flour and seasonings., Add broth., Cook, stirring until thickened., Stir in mushroom soup, chicken and stuffing mix., Add cooked noodles and mix., Bake at 350° about 20 minutes or until bubbles.

title: Easy Brown Sugar Pie
directions: Spread brown sugar in pie crust; sprinkle with flour., Pour milk over it., Dot with margarine., Do not stir., Sprinkle pie with cinnamon or allspice., Bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes until set.

title: Cream Cheese Danish
directions: Press 1 package rolls in 9 x 13 greased pan. Beat cream cheese, 1 cup powdered sugar and flavoring until smooth. Smooth cream cheese mixture over rolls. Cover with the other package of rolls. Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Sandwich For A Crowd
directions: Combine cream cheese, Cheddar, onion, mayonnaise and Worcestershire sauce., Spread on bread that has been cut lengthwise., Add ham and roast beef slices.

title: Beef Vegetable Soup
directions: Mix all ingredients in a large stockpot., Cook at high temperature for half an hour; then simmer for an additional hour.

title: Pork Chops With Tomato Sauce
directions: Brown chops in little portion of bacon drippings., On top of each chop, place 1 small onion (sliced) and 1 lemon (sliced) and salt and pepper., Mix and pour over chops: tomato soup and water. Cover and simmer for 45 minutes., Serve over rice.

title: Banana Bread
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Spray a loaf pan with nonstick cooking spray., Combine flour, baking powder, baking soda and cinnamon and set aside., In a larger bowl, whisk together applesauce, sugar, egg whites, banana and vanilla., Add flour mixture all at once and stir gently to blend., Pour batter into prepared pan and bake 50 to 60 minutes or until knife inserted comes out clean., Cool bread completely.

title: Nut Bread
directions: Combine all ingredients., Let stand for 20 minutes in greased loaf pan., Bake 1 hour at 350°.

title: Morning Glory Muffins
directions: In bowl, beat eggs, oil and vanilla., Set aside., In another bowl, mix flour, sugar, salt and cinnamon., Stir in carrots, raisins, nuts, coconut and apple., Combine well, then add wet ingredients from other bowl., Stir just until combined., Spoon into well-greased muffin tins, filling to top for large breakfast muffins., Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Orange Butter
directions: In small bowl, beat butter, orange peel and orange juice until well blended. Refrigerate to chill.

title: Chocolate Chip Date Cake
directions: Pour boiling water over dates and 1 teaspoon baking soda; let cool., Cream shortening and sugar., Add beaten eggs, then add cooled mixture., Sift together the flour and 1/4 teaspoon soda; add to creamed mixture., Mix well., Pour into a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan that has been greased and floured., Mix the last 3 ingredients; spread on top of cake., Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Seafood Pasta Salad
directions: Cook pasta until tender., Drain., Shake together vinegar, olive oil, salt, pepper and Parmesan cheese., Mix together remaining ingredients; add pasta and pour dressing over, tossing to coat., Chill.

title: Blueberry Delight(Microwave)
directions: Mix together pie filling and almond flavoring in microwave-safe dish., Cook on High 3 to 4 minutes until bubbly. Sprinkle on top of sauce, the cake mix, then slice butter or margarine on top., Combine pecans, cinnamon and nutmeg. Sprinkle over sliced butter. Cook on High 12 to 13 minutes or until cake is firm.

title: Hamburger Baked Beans
directions: Brown together, onions, pepper and celery., Pour off grease. Add remaining ingredients and bake in casserole 1 hour at 350° or until thick.

title: Stromboli
directions: Thaw bread dough or mix box dough for pizza crust., Spread on greased cookie sheet (like for a pizza)., Mix next 7 ingredients and spread on dough., Cover with toppings you want; roll like a jelly roll., Place seam side down and brush with egg white., Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Coffee Cake
directions: Cream shortening and sugars in a large mixing bowl., Add flour and crumble together., Set aside 1 cup of this mixture., Mix eggs, salt, soda and yogurt together in small mixing bowl., Add this to the sugar mixture and combine (seems better if not completely smooth) and pour into a greased and floured 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan. Bake about 40 minutes at 350°.

title: Chocolate Cinnamon Cake
directions: Sift in large mixing bowl the flour and sugar., In a saucepan, put cocoa, cold water, oleo and shortening., Bring to a boil. Pour over flour and sugar; add eggs, buttermilk, soda, cinnamon and vanilla., Bake in large 11 x 17-inch pan at 350° for 20 minutes or less.

title: Marinated Orange And Onion Salad
directions: Combine orange and onion in a large shallow dish., Pour vinegar over mixture and toss., Sprinkle with parsley., Cover and refrigerate 4 hours; stir occasionally., Toss gently., Serve over mixed greens using slotted spoon., Makes 3 servings.

title: Polish Sausage And Noodles
directions: Cook noodles per directions and set aside., Melt butter and saute onion and sausage 8 to 10 minutes., Add cabbage and saute 5 minutes. Stir in caraway seed, salt and pepper., Stir in noodles and sour cream., Heat through 5 to 10 minutes.

title: Sweet And Sour Steak
directions: Brown steak on both sides in oil in frying pan., Combine salt, pepper, dry mustard, minced onion, water and vinegar and pour over steak., Cover tightly and cook about 1 1/2 hours over low heat. Drain orange sections and pineapple chunks, reserving 3 tablespoons liquid and blend in brown sugar and cornstarch., Put steak on platter to keep warm., Put fruit and sugar mixture in pan with drippings and cook 2 or 3 minutes., Pour over meat and serve.

title: Apricot Bread
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Grease a loaf pan., Soak apricots in warm water for 30 minutes., Cream butter, sugar and eggs well. Stir in orange juice., Combine dry ingredients and add to egg mixture., Drain apricots well., Add with nuts to batter., Bake approximately 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Marinara Sauce
directions: Tips:, Use more carrots (makes sweeter) or garlic or oregano if you like more herbs; whatever you desire, it's always good.

title: Ham And Rice Chantilly
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Use a 2-quart casserole dish, greased. Combine ham, rice, peas, 1/2 cup cheese, salt, pepper and cayenne. Spoon into casserole dish., Add remaining cheese to the whipped cream., Spread over top of rice mixture., Bake uncovered for 30 minutes.

title: Cream Cheese Frosting
directions: Cream butter and cream cheese., Gradually add powdered sugar; beat until light and fluffy., Stir in vanilla and 1/2 c. pecans or sprinkle pecans on top of cake., Yield:, enough for one 3 layer cake.

title: Easy Tomato Soup(Yields 3 Servings)
directions: Heat tomato juice. Add spices. Do not bring to a boil, but simmer gently. Serve with thin slice of lemon to garnish each serving.

title: Old Fashioned Tea Cakes
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Form into a ball and roll on floured board. Cut with cutter dipped into flour., Bake on greased cookie sheet in a moderate oven until brown.

title: Cheese Ball
directions: Mix first four ingredients with electric mixer., Shape into ball and then roll in pecans.

title: Mustard Sauce
directions: Mix sugar and flour., Add vinegar and mustard., Cook in double boiler until thick., Add butter.

title: Apple Cranberry Pie
directions: In saucepan, combine the cranberries, sugar, tapioca, water and orange peel., Bring to boil, stirring occasionally., Remove from heat and stir in apples., Cool., Pour into unbaked pastry shell that has been coated with 1/4 cup flour and 1/4 cup sugar mixed together., Top with uncooked pastry or lattice strips of pastry., If using a full top crust, cut a few slits in top crust. Slice a few slices of margarine and place on top and sprinkle sugar over top., Bake at 375° for about 50 minutes.

title: Cranberry Apple Salad
directions: Heat 1 1/2 cups water to, boiling., Add cranberries and simmer for 10 minutes., Add sugar, gelatin soaked in the other 1/2 cup of water, nuts and apples., Pour, into mold., Place in circle on bed of crisp lettuce and, fill	center	with cottage cheese seasoned with salt and paprika., Serves 6.

title: Shrimp Scampi
directions: Saute garlic and onion in oil; add shrimp., Sprinkle with lemon juice; add mushrooms, wine and salt., Cook until shrimp turn pink (about 4 minutes)., Serve over rice or pasta., Add green salad and crusty French bread for a flavorful menu.

title: Eggplant And Mozzarella
directions: Saute the eggplant (cubed) with minced garlic in olive oil. Stir in the tomatoes and simmer for 10 minutes., Toss with basil, cubed Mozzarella and rigatoni.

title: Orange Fluff
directions: Combine Jell-O, orange juice, water and pineapple; let congeal., Beat lemon pudding and milk until smooth; whip cream until firm., Fold in pudding and whipped cream., Spread over congealed Jell-O mixture.

title: Hot Cheese Dip
directions: Dice hot peppers and onion., Add milk until right consistency. Mix in blender.

title: Old Fashioned Sweet Potato Pie
directions: Combine and mix ingredients., Pour in a pie shell and bake at 400° for about 45 minutes.

title: Karo Pecan Pie
directions: Combine all ingredients and place in pie shell., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Swiss Baked Chicken
directions: Arrange chicken in lightly oiled 13 x 9 x 1-inch baking dish. Top with cheese slices., Combine soup and water; stir well., Spoon sauce evenly over chicken; sprinkle crumbs on top., Dot with butter or margarine., Bake at 350° for 45 to 60 minutes.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Cook broccoli as directed on package., Saute onions and celery in oleo., Mix all ingredients., Sprinkle bread crumbs on top. Bake 20 minutes at 350°.

title: Hush Puppies
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Drop by spoonfuls in hot cooking oil., Will float when done., Put on paper towels to drain.

title: Cheddary Scalloped Potatoes
directions: In a skillet over medium heat in hot margarine, cook onion until tender. Add remaining ingredients, except parsley. Heat to boiling. Reduce heat to low. Cover; simmer 5 minutes or until hot and bubbly. Garnish with parsley. Makes 4 servings.

title: Chocolate Fudge Pie
directions: Melt margarine and cocoa together. Stir together., Let it cool for a few minutes. Add sugar., Add eggs all at one time., Beat with a mixer. Add milk and vanilla. Beat until well blended., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: New England Clam Chowder
directions: Fry bacon until crisp; drain and reserve 1 to 2 tablespoons fat., Add onion, celery and carrots to fat in kettle., Saute until onion is soft and transparent., Stir in flour and cook 1 minute. Stir in clam juice., Add bacon, potatoes and bay leaf., Cover and simmer 20 minutes until potatoes are tender., Add half and half and clams and salt and pepper to taste., Cook until heated through.

title: Cauliflower Lettuce Salad
directions: Mix dressing, cheese, sugar and onion in large bowl., Add remaining ingredients; mix lightly., Refrigerate., Makes 8 servings.

title: Easy Chicken And Rice Casserole
directions: Put rice in 9 x 13-inch pan., Mix all liquids together., Pour 1/2 of liquids over rice and mix well., Place chicken, uncovered, on top of rice., Cover with remaining liquids., Sprinkle cheese and almonds on top., Bake at 350°, uncovered, for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Peach Cobbler
directions: Mix flour, sugar and milk., Spray pan., Pour in pan., Pour the peaches over dough., Pour juice over the whole thing., Sprinkle a little cinnamon if you want to., Bake 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Italian Meatballs In Spaghetti Sauce
directions: Pour water over bread crumbs, then mix all ingredients together., Form into 1 1/2-inch meatballs., Heat a little oil in a skillet; brown meatballs, a dozen or so at a time., Place them in spaghetti sauce after draining off grease.

title: Pineapple Kielbasa
directions: Cut kielbasa into bite size pieces., Combine chili sauce, brown sugar, pineapple and juice., Pour into a casserole dish. Bake at 250° for 45 minutes.

title: Frozen Salad
directions: Mix pie filling, pineapple, condensed milk, banana and lemon juice well., Fold in container of Cool Whip., Pour into oblong pan and cover., Put in freezer., Take out about 10 minutes before serving.

title: Harvard Beets
directions: Melt butter in top of double boiler., Add dry ingredients; stir until smooth., Add liquids slowly; cook until thick and smooth. Add cooked beets; let set over low heat for at least 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
directions: Mix flour, salt and baking soda., Set aside., Mix fat and peanut butter., Add both kinds of sugar., Mix well., Add eggs and beat well., Stir flour mixture into peanut butter mixture., Drop dough from a teaspoon on baking pan., Flatten with a fork., Bake at 375° (moderate oven) for 10 to 15 minutes until lightly browned., Makes 4 to 5 dozen cookies.

title: Tuna Casserole
directions: Preheat oven to 325°., Boil noodles until firm but done. Drain., In casserole dish, combine soups and tuna., Add drained noodles., Top with grated cheese., Bake for 20 minutes or until done.

title: German Potato Salad
directions: Boil potatoes until tender., Mix sour cream, dry onion soup mix, mushroom soup, lemon juice, and mustard., Heat sauerkraut in drippings from cooked sausage., In baking dish alternate layers of potatoes, cream mixture, and sauerkraut., Put bread crumbs on top. Bake at 350°F. for 20 to 25 minutes or until bubbly and light brown on top.

title: Garden Vegetable Quiche
directions: Combine flour, 1/2 cup butter and softened cream cheese in a medium bowl, stirring until blended., Shape into a ball., Cover and chill 30 minutes., Saute mushrooms, pepper, zucchini, onion, carrot and garlic in 2 tablespoons margarine until vegetables are crisp-tender., Remove from heat; stir in paprika, salt and pepper. Set aside., Pass chilled pastry evenly on bottom and sides of 10-inch pie plate., Sprinkle cheese over bottom of shell., Spoon sauteed vegetables evenly over cheese., Combine eggs and milk in a medium bowl; beat with a wire whisk., Pour egg mixture over vegetables., Saute chopped onion in 1 tablespoon margarine until tender; drain and sprinkle over quiche., Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes or until set and lightly browned., Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

title: Corn Bread Pudding
directions: Butter 1 1/2-quart casserole., Mix all ingredients, one at a time., Bake, uncovered, for approximately 60 minutes at 350°, until set, brown and crusty.

title: Oreo Dessert
directions: Crush Oreo cookies, reserving 1 cup., Mix with margarine and put in 9 x 13-inch pan., Cream the cream cheese with confectioners sugar., Fold in Cool Whip., Spread cream cheese mixture on crumbs. Spread cooled pudding on top., Sprinkle cookie crumbs over all.

title: Play Dough
directions: Measure dry ingredients in mixing bowl., Add oil, water and coloring., Mix well, knead until smooth., Stores well in airtight bowls or bags.

title: Corn Dodgers
directions: Fry in patties dropped by spoonfuls into a small amount of cooking oil., Serve hot.

title: Noreen'S Fudge
directions: Cook sugar, marshmallows, salt, milk and butter over medium heat., Boil for 8 minutes., Take off heat., Add chocolate chips, vanilla and nuts., Makes 3 pounds.

title: Cornbread Salad
directions: Mix the above ingredients in a large bowl, add enough mayonnaise to hold ingredients together., Chill at least one hour and can be chilled overnight., Sprinkle with paprika and sliced hard boiled eggs before serving.

title: Zucchini Nut Bread
directions: Sift together dry ingredients, except sugar., Combine eggs, vegetable oil, sugar, zucchini and extracts in a separate bowl and beat well., Stir flour mixture into wet ingredients; mix until smooth., Add raisins, nuts and chopped dates last and stir., Pour into 9 x 5-inch loaf pans or muffin tins., Bake at 350° for about 45 minutes for loaves and 20 minutes for muffins.

title: Stuffed Cabbage(Total Cooking Time:  36 Minutes)
directions: Remove core and blemished leaves of cabbage., Place cabbage in 3-quart microproof casserole., Add water., Cover with plastic wrap and cook on High (Maximum power) 6 minutes., Cool cabbage slightly and separate leaves., Combine ground beef, pork, rice, egg, thyme, parsley, garlic, salt and pepper; stir thoroughly., Divide mixture among 6 to 8 large cabbage leaves., Wrap leaves tightly around mixture., Line bottom of 3-quart microproof casserole with some leftover cabbage leaves., Place cabbage rolls on top of loose leaves., Cover with remaining cabbage leaves., Dot with butter and pour tomato sauce over top., Cook, covered, on 80 (Reheat) about 30 minutes., Baste after 15 minutes and cook until rolls are fork-tender., Remove and let stand, covered, 5 minutes., Discard top loose cabbage leaves before serving., Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Gooey Butter Cake
directions: Mix together margarine, cake mix and 1 egg., Press into a 9 x 13-inch pan or 2 smaller pans, greased and floured., Mix powdered sugar, cream cheese and 2 eggs; pour over the top of cake mixture. Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes., Sprinkle some powdered sugar on top, if desired.

title: Oriental Chicken(By Pam Gabriel)
directions: Cut chicken into bite-size pieces in a frying pan, cook chicken with the lemon juice and water., When the chicken is done, add the 2 packages of dressing mix and simmer for at least 5 minutes., Cook rice as directed., Serve the chicken mixture over rice.

title: Sauerkraut Salad
directions: Mix thoroughly sauerkraut, bean sprouts, celery, diced pepper, chopped onion and celery seed., Blend together sugar, salad oil and vinegar., It is best when this mixture is heated and then left to cool., When cool, pour mixture over vegetables., It's better after it stands a few days., Keep in the refrigerator.

title: Creamed Chicken
directions: Brown chicken in a little oil., Put in casserole dish., Blend soup with milk and add pepper., Pour over chicken., Sprinkle with paprika (optional) on top., Bake at 400°, covered, for 45 minutes to 1 hour., Check after 45 minutes for doneness., Serve with rice or noodles.

title: Liver Sausage Appetizer Ball
directions: Mash liverwurst to make smooth., Blend in all of rest of ingredients, except add only 1/3 of the cream cheese., Pack into a 2-cup mixing bowl lined with foil or plastic wrap., Chill several hours until firm., Turn out and frost with remaining cheese. Chill well., Serve with crackers.

title: Snack Crackers
directions: Put crackers in brown paper bag., Sprinkle all dry ingredients onto crackers., Shake well. Pour oil onto crackers and shake again., Let bag set in sink 1 hour before storing in Tupperware. Sack will absorb excess oil.

title: Sherry Wine Cake
directions: Combine all ingredients., Mix with electric beater about 5 minutes at medium speed., Pour the batter into a greased bundt pan or angel food cake pan., Bake at 350° about 45 minutes or until done., Cool about 25 minutes before turning onto a rack., Sprinkle with powdered sugar.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
directions: Cook sugar and milk, stirring until mixture makes soft ball in cold water., Add marshmallows and peanut butter, stirring until all is dissolved and begins to thicken., Pour in buttered dish or pan. Slice when cold.

title: Pumpkin Roll
directions: Combine eggs and sugar; beat well., Add pumpkin and lemon juice; mix until blended., In a separate bowl, combine flour, baking powder, spices and salt., Add to egg mixture., Mix well.

title: Poor Man'S Pecan Pie
directions: Mix first 3 ingredients together and heat until dissolved. Add rest of ingredients and mix together., Pour into unbaked pie shell., Bake for 1 hour at 350°.

title: Sugar Coated Pecans
directions: Cook as a syrup the sugar, orange juice, rind and salt to soft ball stage., Stir well, then add nuts., Stir until creamy., Lift out pecans, one at a time, placing them on wax paper until dry.

title: French Onion Soup
directions: Cook onions slowly with butter and oil in heavy covered 4-quart saucepan for 15 minutes., Stir in salt and sugar., Cook, uncovered, over moderate heat, 35 to 40 minutes, stirring often until onions are a deep golden brown., Sprinkle with flour; stir 3 minutes., Remove from heat; add boiling bouillon and water to onion mixture., Blend well., Add wine and seasonings., Simmer partially covered, 35 minutes., While soup is simmering, place 1 layer of French bread slices on cookie sheet and bake at 325° for 30 minutes or until they are dried and golden brown.

title: Out Of This World Rolls
directions: Dissolve yeast in warm water., Let stand 10 minutes., Combine dissolved yeast, eggs, 2 1/2 cups flour, shortening, sugar and salt in a large mixer bowl., Beat until smooth at medium speed, scraping sides of bowl for 2 minutes., With wooden spoon, stir in remaining flour to make soft dough., Cover., Let rise until double in bulk, about 1 hour., Punch down., Refrigerate overnight.

title: Puppy Chow
directions: Melt the oleo, butterscotch chips and peanut butter together in microwave for 4 minutes., Pour over the Rice Chex; mix well. Put Chex mix in paper grocery bag with the powdered sugar., Fold top over and shake., Coat all well., Pour out and let dry on cookie sheet.

title: Butter Rolls
directions: Roll dough very thin., Spread butter and sugar over dough. Roll up into a roll., Cut into small rolls., Place in pan., Mix milk, sugar and vanilla; pour over rolls., Bake at 375° about 30 minutes, or until done.

title: Chocolate Ice Cream Pie
directions: In a bowl, whisk melted ice cream and pudding mix for 2 minutes. Pour into crusts. Freeze until firm. Pies may be frozen up to 2 months. Remove from the freezer 10 minutes before serving. Garnish with whipped topping, if desired. Yields 2 pies, 6 to 8 servings each.

title: Macaroni Salad
directions: Cook macaroni in salted water; rinse and drain., Add macaroni to a bowl containing salad oil and vinegar., Mix together, then add remaining ingredients., Chill.

title: Lace Cookies
directions: Mix dry ingredients together., Pour over melted butter., Add egg and vanilla., Drop by 1/4 teaspoon onto cookie sheet covered with aluminum foil, dull side up., Place fairly far apart as mixture will run., Bake at 350° for about 8 minutes, or until well browned on edges., Cool; remove with fingers from foil.

title: Sausage Rice Casserole
directions: Brown sausage; drain. Bring water to boil; add rice and Lipton onion soup mix. Boil 7 minutes. Add celery, green pepper, sliced water chestnuts and browned sausage. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: South Of The Border Casserole
directions: Mix milk, soup, salsa and onions., Chop tortilla into pieces. Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan., Layer ingredients and top with cheese. Bake 1 1/2 hours at 350°.

title: Carrots And Cheese
directions: Cook carrots and drain., Melt the butter and cheese together, then mix with the carrots., Place in 9 x 13-inch pan., Melt butter and mix with the crackers., Sprinkle over the carrots and cheese. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes (until cracker mixture is brown).

title: Chile Con Queso Dip
directions: Saute the onion (chopped fine)., Add the tomatoes and green chilies. Cook until most of the liquid is gone., Add and heat the milk. Add the Velveeta (cubed) and heat until melted., Mix well and serve.

title: Lemon Meringue Pie(Makes One 9-Inch Pie)
directions: In a saucepan mix the sugar and cornstarch very well. Gradually stir in water., Cook over medium heat and stir constantly until mixture gets thick., Boil 1 minute., Stir a little of this hot mixture very slowly into the egg yolks., Then blend this mix into the hot mix in saucepan., Return to heat and boil about 1 minute more, stirring constantly until smooth and thick., Blend in butter., Stir to melt and then add lemon juice and stir well., Pour into baked shell., Cover with meringue., Be sure to seal meringue to crust so it doesn't shrink., Bake in a 400° oven for 8 to 10 minutes or until light golden brown.

title: Wasetti
directions: Cook noodles as directed, then drain., Brown ground beef; add soups and Velveeta., Mix well., Add noodles., Put into casserole dish., Sprinkle Cheddar on top., Bake at 350° until hot through, 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Pumpkin Cake
directions: Beat all ingredients together., Bake at 350° in 9 x 12-inch pan for 35 minutes.

title: New Potatoes
directions: Scrape the peel off of the potatoes., Wash well., Cover with cold water; cover and bring to a boil., Cook until fork tender, approximately 15 minutes after they come to a boil., Add bacon drippings and butter and stir., Mix cornstarch with 1 cup of half and half and add to the potatoes stirring well., Add the rest of the half and half, salt and pepper., Stir frequently to keep from sticking and scorching., Cook until smooth and it thickens. Garnish with chopped green onions and crispy fried bacon.

title: Raisin Sauce For Ham
directions: In a saucepan, combine brown sugar, cornstarch and mustard. Stir in water, raisins, vinegar, lemon juice and peel until blended., Bring to a boil; cook and stir for 2 minutes or until thickened., Stir in butter until melted., Serve warm over sliced ham., Yield: 2 cups.

title: Eggplant Parmesan
directions: Cut ends of eggplant; peel skin with potato peeler., Slice into 1/4 or 1/8-inch slices., Scramble 3 eggs in a bowl., Pour bread crumbs in another bowl., Dip eggplant in egg, then in bread crumbs., Fry in olive oil to lightly brown on both sides., Cover bottom of baking pan with tomato sauce., Place a layer of eggplant, overlapping edges in pan., Cover lightly with sauce; spread evenly., Cut or break American cheese into squares, 1 for each serving, and place over eggplant., Put an even coating of Kraft Parmesan over it., Do another overlapping layer of eggplant, sauce, American cheese and Parmesan., Put sauce on each piece of American cheese so it won't burn., Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: 3 Bean Salad
directions: Drain kidney beans thoroughly., Pour off liquid from wax and green beans., Empty beans into a large bowl., Add onions. Dissolve sugar in vinegar and add salt, pepper and Crisco oil to beans., Stir gently to blend., Marinate overnight in the refrigerator., Serve beans, thoroughly drained, on lettuce.

title: Sausage Soup
directions: Brown sausage., Add remaining ingredients, except kidney beans, and simmer until vegetables are tender., Add kidney beans and simmer 5 minutes more., Then enjoy!

title: Apple Cake
directions: Sift flour, salt and soda together. Add lemon juice to apples. Mix oil, sugar and eggs together; add dry ingredients alternately with apples. Add nuts and vanilla., Pour into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 1 hour at 350°. Leave in pan and cover with glaze.

title: Low Carb Mashed "Potatoes"
directions: Steam or microwave the cauliflower until soft. Puree in food processor adding the butter and half & half to taste. Season with salt and pepper., This has 5 grams carbohydrates.

title: Old Time Cinnamon Jumbles
directions: Mix shortening, sugar and egg thoroughly., Stir in buttermilk and vanilla. Sift dry ingredients together and stir., Chill dough.

title: Chafing Dish Meatballs
directions: Mix meat and next 8 ingredients., Shape into 1-inch balls. Melt shortening in skillet., Brown meatballs., Remove from skillet and drain., Heat chili sauce and jelly in skillet until jelly is melted, stirring constantly., Add meatballs and stir until coated. Simmer 30 minutes., Serve hot in chafing dish.

title: Home Baked Communion Bread
directions: Mix as for pie crust., Divide into 3 parts., Roll out and score into small squares., Bake on thin cookie sheet for 30 minutes at 325°., Serves 200.

title: Impossible Tamale Pie
directions: Grease 10 x 1 1/2-inch pie plate., Cook and stir ground beef in skillet until brown; drain., Stir in onion and seasoning mix. Spread in plate., Sprinkle with tomatoes and corn., Beat eggs, milk, baking mix and cornmeal until smooth., Pour into pie plate. Bake at 400° for 30 to 35 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean., Cool 5 minutes., Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Farmer'S Doughnuts
directions: Grease and flour 12 muffin tins., Preheat oven to 350°., Cream shortening, sugar and egg., Sift flour, baking powder, salt and nutmeg., Add to creamed mixture alternately with applesauce or milk., Fill muffin cups 2/3 full., Bake 30 minutes or until done.

title: Chocolate Zucchini Bread
directions: In one bowl, mix together flour, baking powder, salt, cinnamon and baking soda., In another bowl, mix together oil, eggs, sugar, vanilla and chocolate chips., Add flour mixture to bowl and mix all ingredients well., Divide batter in well greased and floured loaf pans (9 x 5 x 3-inch)., Bake in a 350° oven for 60 minutes. Pick test; cool in pan 10 minutes., Cool on wire rack.

title: Oven Baked Or Crock Pot Stew
directions: Cut vegetables in large pieces., Combine all ingredients in large pot or crock pot., Cover and bake for five to six hours at 275° in pot; or low in crock pot.

title: Chicken Pie
directions: Mix all but biscuits and place in baking dish., Top with flaky biscuits and bake at 350° until done.

title: Cream Cheese Cookies
directions: Cream butter and cheese., Add flour, nuts and flavoring., Make into 2 rolls., Chill overnight., Cut into 1/4-inch slices or make into small balls and press down on cookie sheet with fork., Bake at 350° until slightly brown.

title: No Brown Meatballs
directions: Bring to a boil ginger ale and catsup., Pack and roll meat mixture into firm balls., Add to boiling mixture., Cook about 3 hours., Chill and remove fat from top; reheat., This makes a good dish to freeze or prepare ahead., Serve with noodles or pasta.

title: Healthful Brownies
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Combine first six ingredients., In medium bowl, combine next four ingredients., Combine the two mixtures., Spray pan with non-stick spray., Spread batter in pan. Bake 25 minutes., Cool and cut into 16 bars., Calories per serving:, 68.

title: Sea Reef Salad
directions: Drain and flake salmon., Mix salmon, eggs, olives and almonds. Soak gelatin in cold water for 5 minutes., Dissolve over hot water., Add mayonnaise, sour cream, onion, salt and lemon juice. Mix and combine with salmon mixture., Mold and place in refrigerator until congealed., Remove from mold., Garnish with parsley., Serve.

title: Shrimp Mold
directions: Heat soup to lukewarm., Stir in water., Slowly sprinkle gelatine into mixture., Add onion, mayonnaise and shrimp., Fold in soft cream cheese., Pour into mold., Chill overnight., Serve with crackers.

title: Simple Cheese Tarts
directions: Use cupcake liners as needed.

title: Southwest Green Beans
directions: Drain green beans, leaving a little water in each can. Saute onion in bacon drippings. Add chili sauce, beans and bacon. Chill overnight. Heat to serve about 20 minutes at 350°.

title: Apricot Cookies
directions: Mix half the recipe at a time., Mix together well all the ingredients., Roll into 4-inch balls, then refrigerate 2 to 3 hours or put in freezer for 1/2 or 1 hour, then take out of refrigerator or freezer., Take 1 ball out of refrigerator at a time, then roll out ball on board with flour or powdered sugar and cut with diamond cookie cutter and fill with 1 teaspoon apricot mixture with ground walnuts in center, then bring two corners together and seal., Put 1/2 toothpick in cookie to hold together. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 425° for 10 minutes or until lightly golden brown., Sprinkle with powdered sugar when cool.

title: Macaroni And Cheese Deluxe
directions: Cook macaroni as package described; rinse and set aside. Mix well cottage cheese, sour cream, eggs and sharp cheese (save 2 cups for topping). Add macaroni and stir well. Pour into lightly greased (Pam) 2-quart casserole. Top with shredded cheese and a dash of paprika. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Spinach Lasagne
directions: Saute onions, green peppers and garlic in oil until golden, stirring often., Stir in tomatoes, tomato paste, parsley, oregano and bay leaf., Simmer, uncovered, for 20 minutes., Cook noodles according to package directions and drain., Combine spinach, Ricotta, egg, 1/4 cup of Parmesan cheese, salt and pepper.

title: German Chocolate Pie
directions: Sprinkle coconut and nuts in 3 pie shells., Mix other ingredients with melted margarine., Do not boil., Pour into shells and bake at 325° for 45 minutes., I cover edges of pie shells with foil.

title: Chocolate Mayonnaise Cake
directions: Makes 2 standard size layers., Mix all dry ingredients., Add mayonnaise, water and vanilla., Mix thoroughly., Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350°.

title: Squash Casserole
directions: Steam the squash, zucchini and lemon., Cook them, but still firm., In a saucepan, heat just to boiling the cream of mushroom soup, bouillon cube and sour cream. Add the grated carrot. Drain the vegetables well and add them to the sauce., Prepare the stuffing., Cover bottom of a casserole dish with 1/2 of the stuffing. Add vegetable/sauce mixture, then top with remaining stuffing., Bake at 300° for about 1/2 hour.

title: Sausage Cheese Balls
directions: Shred cheese and combine with sausage and Bisquick., Shape into small balls and place on cookie sheet or shape into balls., Freeze. Then bake at 350° for 20 minutes., Make balls small since they get larger when cooked., Yields 100 balls.

title: Summer Garden Medley
directions: In a large nonstick skillet, saut the zucchini, corn, green pepper, leek and seasoned salt in oil until vegetables are tender. Add tomatoes; heat through. Yield: 4 servings.

title: Sauerkraut
directions: Place shredded cabbage in sterile jars., Use 1 teaspoon salt per quart and 1/2 teaspoon salt per pint., Cover with hot water and place lids on tight., Store in a cool, dark place for one month before tasting.

title: Company Cabbage
directions: In large saucepan, heat bouillon in 1/4 cup water until dissolved., Add cabbage, carrots, onion, 1/2 teaspoon salt and dash of pepper; toss to mix., Cook, covered, 5 to 10 minutes or until tender., Combine butter, mustard and pecans and pour over vegetables; toss to mix., Sprinkle with paprika., Serves 6 to 8.

title: Saucepan Scratchies
directions: Mix everything in kettle you melt the butter or margarine in. Add oil to melted butter., Add sugar, then eggs one at a time, beating well after each addition., Add vanilla, flour, baking powder and nuts, coconut or chocolate chips., Put in a 9 x 13-inch greased and floured pan., Bake at 350° about 25 minutes., Do not overbake., Watch very closely.

title: Just Like Grandma'S Bread Pudding
directions: About 2 hours before serving, preheat oven to 325°., In a medium saucepan over medium heat, heat milk until tiny bubbles form around the edges.

title: Coconut Prize Cake
directions: Blend all ingredients in a large bowl, then beat at medium speed for 2 minutes., Bake in a greased and floured tube pan at 350° for 45 to 55 minutes or until cake springs back when touched lightly., Cool for 15 minutes right side up., Remove from pan.

title: Deviled Ham Dip
directions: Combine all ingredients., Serve with snack crackers., Makes 1 2/3 cups.

title: Vermicelli With Spinach And Pasta Sauce
directions: Cook spinach in olive oil over medium heat about 10 minutes, stirring constantly., Add salt, pepper, Ricotta and skim milk. Cook over low heat until mixture is heated through., Do not allow to boil., Simmer pasta in sauce in a small pan; heat through. Cook vermicelli according to package; drain.

title: Scalloped Ham And Potatoes
directions: Melt butter and stir in milk and flour., Layer 1/2 the ham, then potatoes and onion., Season with pepper., Top with the remaining ham., Pour on the flour sauce., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Panhandle Egg Pie
directions: Variations:, Ham, onions, green peppers and/or Cheddar cheese may be added.

title: Creamy Tuna Twist
directions: In large bowl stir together first three ingredients until smooth., Add remaining ingredients; toss to coat well., Chill.

title: Easy Barbecue Sauce
directions: Mix together in saucepan and bring to boil., Use sauce on ribs, chicken, etc.

title: Coffee Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients together.

title: Creamed Tuna On Biscuits
directions: Saute onions in margarine until limp but not brown., Add tuna, green beans and mushroom soup., Stir until well blended and simmer for a few minutes., If too thick, add a little milk or water. Bake biscuits according to printed directions., Serve creamed tuna over biscuits., Toast may also be used instead of biscuits., This makes a good evening meal as it is light.

title: No-Egg Homemade Ice Cream
directions: Beat sugar, sour cream, condensed milk and vanilla well., Add 2% milk and fruit. Pour in freezer and freeze.

title: Buttermilk Pie
directions: Mix softened butter, sugar, flour and beaten eggs well. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes. Best when served room temperature.

title: Hot Water Sponge Cake
directions: Beat eggs and sugar well., Add flour and baking powder., Beat. Add hot water., Put in two 8-inch cake pans., Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Fudge Cake
directions: Melt margarine in saucepan., Mix in other ingredients., Pour into a greased pan., Place in cold oven., Bake at 250° for 30 minutes, or until there is a little crust on top., Great used as brownies.

title: Texas Sheet Cake
directions: Sift flour, brown sugar, salt and soda., Bring to a boil the butter, cocoa and water., While still hot, add to flour mixture. Add eggs, vanilla and milk., Pour into sheet pan that has been lined with tinfoil and that has been greased., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes, no longer., Frost with Texas Sheet Cake Frosting.

title: Stuffed Baked Tomatoes
directions: Cut thin slice from top of tomatoes and scoop pulp out with large spoon., Mix pulp with remaining ingredients and let stand. Place tomatoes carefully in 8-inch greased baking dish., Fill carefully with mixture., Top with bread crumbs and butter or grated cheese., Bake at 375° for 30 minutes.

title: One Pan Meal
directions: Brown meat; add soup, potatoes and onion., Simmer until potatoes are tender., Serves 4 to 6.

title: Green Tomato Relish
directions: Cook until it turns white and seal relish up in a jar., This does not take long to prepare.

title: Apple Nut Muffins
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Pour into greased muffin tins. Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes., Makes 4 1/2 dozen, using small muffin tins.

title: Easy Fruit Salad
directions: Mix together and refrigerate.

title: Reese'S Peanut Butter Balls
directions: Mix sugar, margarine and peanut butter with hand., Roll mixture into balls on waxed paper., Melt chocolate and paraffin in top of double boiler., Dip balls in chocolate mixture with toothpick., Place on wax paper.

title: Russian Tea
directions: Mix tea, pineapple juice, lemon juice and orange juice. Boil cinnamon sticks in cup of water for 10 minutes. Add to tea mixture. Heat and serve.

title: Pear Bread
directions: Combine flour, cinnamon, and pecans in a large bowl., In a separate dish, combine oil, eggs, sugar, pears, and vanilla., Add to dry ingredients, stirring just until moistened., Spoon mixture into two greased loaf pans., Bake at 325 degrees for 1 hour and 15 minutes., Cool in pan for 10 minutes.

title: Chinese Egg-Drop Soup
directions: Put chicken broth in saucepan., Bring to a boil., Immediately reduce heat to simmer., Dissolve cornstarch in water; add to chicken broth, stirring until slightly thickened., Add onion and stir., Add egg very slowly, stirring to break it up., Serve immediately.

title: Snow Cream
directions: Mix egg, sugar, vanilla and milk., Pour mixture over snow. Stir quickly before snow melts., Add more sugar and vanilla, if needed.

title: Pork Chops And Brown Rice
directions: Mix all ingredients in large dish, except pork chops., Lightly brown the chops and place on rice mixture., Cover and bake for 1 hour at 350°.

title: Paella(Low-Fat)
directions: Heat oil in Dutch oven over medium-high heat until hot., Add chicken and stir until browned., Add rice, onion and garlic. Cook, stirring, until onion is tender and rice is lightly browned. Add broth, tomatoes, tomato liquid, paprika, ground red pepper and saffron., Bring to a boil over high heat; stir., Reduce heat to low., Cover and simmer 10 minutes., Add shrimp, pepper strips and peas., Cover and simmer 10 minutes or until rice is tender, liquid is absorbed and shrimp are opaque.

title: Orange Julius
directions: Put all ingredients in blender and blenderize., If you have an ice crusher, you can do the ice in it and then scoop out the ice and pour orange mixture over it in your glass.

title: Bunuelos De Planto(Banana Fritters)
directions: To prepare the batter, sift 1/2 cup of the flour and the salt into a deep mixing bowl., Stir in the beaten egg and butter and then the milk and continue to stir until the batter is smooth., Do not beat or overstir., For the best results, set the batter aside at room temperature and let it rest for an hour or so, although it may be used at once if it must., In either case, the egg white should be beaten with a whisk or rotary beater until stiff and then folded into the batter just before using it.

title: Banana Bread
directions: Mix in order given. Bake in slow oven at 320° for 1 hour.

title: Lime Jell-O Punch
directions: Dissolve jello as directed on package, add sugar while jello is hot. Add pineapple juice and frozen lemonade diluted to make 1 quart. Add limeade diluted as directed. Add ginger ale immediately before serving.

title: Pea Salad
directions: Drain peas well., In medium mixing bowl, mix all listed ingredients., Season to taste., Cover and set in refrigerator to chill., Serves 4 persons.

title: Corn-Noodle Casserole
directions: Mix together., Put in casserole and pour 1/4 cup melted butter over this., Bake 1 hour in a 350° oven., Serve.

title: Spice Cookies
directions: Cream sugar and shortening., Add coffee and egg., Stir in dry ingredients and raisins., Chill 1 hour., Bake in 13 x 9-inch pan until done in center., Cut into bars and glaze with powdered sugar glaze.

title: Peach Macaroon Ice Cream
directions: Whip whipping cream., In a large bowl, combine sweetened condensed milk, crumbs, peaches and extract., Fold in whipped cream., Pour into a 9 x 5-inch loaf pan., Cover., Freeze 6 hours or until firm.

title: The World'S Greatest Mushroom Soup
directions: Slice mushroom caps thinly., Chop mushroom stalks finely. Soften chopped onions in butter with the chopped mushroom stalks. Add flour and cook for 1 to 2 minutes., Gradually add the chicken stock and bring to a boil., Then add the sliced mushroom caps, bay leaf, tarragon and Worcestershire sauce., Add salt and pepper to taste and simmer from 15 to 20 minutes., Remove bay leaf and adjust seasonings., Serve, garnished with a few slices of mushrooms and chopped parsley.

title: Snack Crackers
directions: Place crackers in a large bowl., Pour oil over crackers and mix., Add dressing mix and stir., Place mixture on a large cookie sheet and heat in a 350° oven for 10 minutes., Store in an airtight container.

title: Cranberry Salad
directions: Grind the cranberries., Add the sugar and pineapple., Let stand in refrigerator overnight., When ready to serve, mix in the marshmallows, nuts and Cool Whip.

title: Shrimp Dip
directions: Mash cheese until creamy., Blend remaining ingredients except celery and onion., Fold in vegetables and combine with cheese. Mix well., Refrigerate., Use with crackers or raw vegetables.

title: Corn Relish
directions: Bring to boil, pour over beets and boil 10 minutes., Pack into sterilized jars and seal., No salt., Makes 12 pints.

title: Rich Peanut Butter Bars
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Grease and flour a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Melt butter and peanut butter in a bowl over hot water., Add remaining ingredients., Stir until blended., Bake in a 350° oven for 20 to 25 minutes., Cool and cut into squares., Yields about 2 dozen squares.

title: Endive-Watercress Salad
directions: Combine first 5 ingredients in a jar; cover tightly and shake vigorously., Rinse endive lightly; pat dry and trim ends., Arrange on salad plates; top with watercress., Drizzle dressing over top and sprinkle with toasted walnuts.

title: Savory Short Ribs
directions: For Crock-Pot:, Arrange ribs in shallow microwave dish., Salt, pepper and rosemary each rib., Cook on High for 5 minutes., Drain fat., Add ribs, carrots, celery and wine to crock-pot., Stir together butter, flour, chicken broth, beef broth and bouillon until smooth., Add to the ribs in crock-pot and cook on high for 6 hours.

title: Rolls
directions: Dissolve yeast in water; add melted butter, egg and sugar with mixture., Add flour., Store in airtight container and refrigerate. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

title: Tuna Fish Casserole
directions: Melt margarine and stir in 1/2 of the crackers., Add the other ingredients., Mix., Pour into a Pyrex or other glass dish; top with remaining 1/2 cup crackers., Bake, uncovered, for 15 minutes at 400°.

title: Escalloped Corn
directions: Combine all ingredients and pour into medium size casserole dish., Dot top with cracker crumbs and butter., Bake at 325° for 45 to 55 minutes., Serves 4 to 6.

title: Whole Wheat Lasagna
directions: Brown beef and onion in large saucepan; drain grease., Salt and pepper to taste and add all spices (sugar, garlic powder and Italian seasoning)., Add tomato wedges, tomato paste and 1 can water., Simmer 30 minutes., Boil noodles according to box; don't over boil., Drain., Make layers starting with 1 thin layer of sauce, 4 noodles laid lengthwise, layer of sauce, layer of cottage cheese, layer of Mozzarella cheese, noodles, sauce, cottage cheese, Mozzarella, sauce, noodles, sauce, cottage cheese, Mozzarella and last 2 or 3 tablespoons Parmesan., Bake at 350° until cheese really bubbles, about 45 minutes to 1 hour., Serve with tossed salad and garlic bread!

title: Christmas Corn Bread
directions: Sift everything together, except meal., Stir in meal., Then add remaining ingredients., Beat 1 minute. Bake in greased pan 20 minutes at 425°.

title: Steak And Rice
directions: Cut steak into thin strips., In a large skillet (ovenproof if desired), brown meat in oil, using high heat., Add onions; saute until tender-crisp., Blend soup, water and garlic salt; pour over steak., Reduce heat; cover and simmer for 1 hour, or until steak is tender., Or, cover and bake at 350°., Serve over beds of fluffy rice., Makes 6 servings.

title: Swedish Meatballs
directions: Mix together and make into meatballs., Fry.

title: Pineapple Nut Bread
directions: Sift flour, sugar, baking powder and salt in a bowl. Add raisins, and walnuts. Combine egg, vanilla and melted shortening. Dissolve soda in pineapple and add., Stir just enough to mix well. Pour into greased loaf pan and bake 1 hour or until done at 350°. Wrap in foil for freezing.

title: Kiwi Mousse
directions: Briefly puree 8 ounces kiwi and pour into bowl., Whip cream into soft peaks., Whisk egg whites until stiff; sprinkle with sugar toward end and beat to incorporate sugar., Stir melted gelatin into puree., Fold in whipped cream, then egg whites., Pour half the mousse into a round 8 x 3-inch mold., Refrigerate 15 minutes., Pour tea over cake and let absorb., Put cake in mold in 1 piece., Add remaining mousse., Freeze 4 hours., Garnish mousse with kiwi.

title: Double Chocolate Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Heat oven to 375°., Beat eggs, shortening and half of the cake mix (dry) until smooth., Stir in remaining cake mix, oats and chocolate pieces., Drop dough by teaspoonfuls, about 2 inches apart, onto ungreased baking sheet., Bake for 10 to 12 minutes. Cool slightly before removing from baking sheet., Makes about 5 dozen.

title: Squaw Corn
directions: Dice the bacon and fry., Drain bacon and cook onion in grease. Beat egg; add salt, onion, bacon and corn., Pour into a greased baking dish., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Deviled Eggs
directions: Peel eggs, slice lengthwise, remove cooked yolks., Put other ingredients in bowl with yolks and mix with mixer until well blended, not lumpy., Put filling mixture into egg whites and sprinkle with paprika.

title: Mom'S Sugar Cookies
directions: Cream butter and sugar., Beat, in eggs, milk and vanilla. Sift dry ingredients and, add, to, wet., Blend, well, and chill. Roll out 1/4-inch, cut out and bake at 375° for 5 to 7 minutes. Makes 8 dozen small cookies.

title: Batter Bread
directions: Measure water into a large mixing bowl., Sprinkle in yeast and stir until dissolved., Add margarine, sugar, salt and 2 cups flour. Beat for 2 minutes with electric mixer (medium speed)., Blend in remaining flour., Cover; let rise until double., Stir down and spread in greased loaf pan., Let rise until double., Bake at 375° for 45 minutes or until loaf sounds hollow., Makes 1 loaf.

title: Carolina Beans
directions: Cook ground chuck with onion and pepper and drain., Mix all other ingredients., Bake in a 2 1/2-quart baking dish at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Tropical Chicken Salad
directions: Place chicken and celery in a large bowl., Combine mayonnaise and curry powder., Add to chicken mixture and mix well., Cover and chill for at least 30 minutes., Before serving, add the pineapple, bananas, oranges and coconut., Toss gently., Serve on salad greens, if desired., Sprinkle with nuts., Yields 4 to 6 servings.

title: Marinated Chicken Wings
directions: Cut tips off wings and section pieces., Combine margarine, soy sauce and other ingredients until melted., Sprinkle wings lightly with garlic salt., Pour mixture over wings and marinate 4 hours or overnight., Remove from marinating sauce and bake at 350° until done.

title: Easy Bake Chicken
directions: Spray 9 x 13-inch baking dish with nonstick spray., Place boneless chicken in baking dish., Spread cream of chicken soup over chicken., Spread prepared Stove Top stuffing over soup. Bake for 35 to 45 minutes at 375°.

title: Wild Rice And Mushroom Frittata
directions: In small bowl, rinse rice in several changes of cold water; drain in strainer; set aside., In 1 quart saucepan, combine rice, water and 1/2 teaspoon salt., Heat to boiling over high heat; cover and reduce heat to low., Cook rice until tender, about 40 minutes., Drain well., Heat oven to 350°., In 9-inch skillet with heat proof handle, heat oil over medium heat., Add onion, garlic and mushrooms., Cook, stirring, until vegetables brown and most of the liquid evaporates, about 5 minutes.

title: Microwave Lasagna
directions: Mix first four ingredients., Layer in 9 x 13-inch casserole: thin layer of sauce, 3 raw noodles, all of raw ground beef, 1/2 Jack cheese, 1/3 sauce, 3 noodles, spread all Ricotta cheese, rest of Jack cheese, 1/2 remaining sauce, 3 noodles and rest of sauce. Cover loosely., Cook on 1/2 power (5) 10 minutes, turn 1/4., Cook 1/2 power 10 minutes., Let stand 5 minutes., Turn 1/4, cook on High (10) 7 minutes., Add cheese (Mozzarella and Parmesan)., Let stand 15 minutes before serving.

title: Calico Cheese Soup
directions: Saute garlic and onion in margarine over low heat until tender., Add chicken broth, carrots and celery; cook until just tender-crisp., Blend flour into milk; add to chicken broth and cook, stirring, until slightly thickened., Stir in cheese., Add salt and Tabasco to taste., Serves 4.

title: Crock-Pot Corn
directions: Cook 4 hours on low.

title: Cranberry Jello Salad
directions: Make 2 packages Jell-O, using only 3 cups of water instead of the usual four (I use the pineapple juice which was drained from the crushed pineapple and the rest water making up the 3 cups water, 1 boiling and 2 cold.), Allow Jell-O to begin to jell; add the other ingredients., Chill until Jell-O is completely firm and set.

title: Barkley'S Garlic Butter
directions: Moosh together at room temperature.

title: Indian Chicken Curry
directions: Melt butter; add onion and garlic and cook until tender., Add remaining ingredients (except cooked chicken)., Cover and simmer 30 minutes., Add chicken; cover and heat., Serve over hot rice.

title: Dreamsicle Cake
directions: Prepare cake mix according to directions on box., Bake in two 9-inch round cake pans., When layers are cool, cut each in half, making a total of four layers.

title: Hummingbird Cake
directions: Combine first 5 ingredients in a large mixing bowl., Add eggs and oil, stirring until dry ingredients are moistened., Do not beat., Stir in vanilla, pineapple, pecans and bananas., Spoon batter into greased and floured 9-inch round cake pans., Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool pans for 10 minutes., Remove and cool completely., Spread frosting between layers, on top and sides. Sprinkle pecans on top.

title: Pizza Sauce
directions: Cook garlic, peppers, and onions in vegetable oil until soft, then add tomato, paste,, oregano, basil, sugar and salt. Simmer all together until, it, comes, to, a, boil., Bottle and seal.

title: Hot Cocoa Mix
directions: Combine., Add 1/3 to 1/2 cup per mug of boiling water.

title: Lemon Or Lime Shimmer
directions: In small bowl sprinkle gelatin over cold water; let stand 1 minute to soften., Add boiling water and stir to dissolve., Stir in remaining ingredients., Pour into 2-cup mold or individual dishes., Chill until set., Makes 4 servings.

title: Bubble Bread
directions: Crumble yeast into water., Place milk, sugar, salt and egg in mixing bowl., Blend., Add 2 cups flour and beat until bubbles form on surface., Add melted shortening and about half remaining flour.
