Mix in additional flour to form soft dough., Turn dough out onto a floured board and knead dough until it is smooth, so it is elastic and can be easily handled., Press dough into a lightly greased bowl; turn dough over so greased side is up., Cover and allow to rise to double in bulk., Knead down and divide into 18 portions. Shape into balls; lightly butter and coat with sugar-cinnamon mixture (1 cup sugar and 1 teaspoon cinnamon).

title: No Peeky Chicken
directions: Put rice, milk, soups and Kitchen Bouquet in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Stir., Place chicken pieces on top. Sprinkle with dry onion mix. Cover tightly with foil. Bake in a 300° oven for 2 hours. "Don't peek."

title: Not Just Potatoes
directions: Wash potatoes., Cut lengthwise wedge across top of potatoes, 1-inch wide and 1-inch deep., Remove wedge., Place bacon and green onions in corner of wedge., Add butter., Replace wedge and wrap in foil., Bake at 400° for 1 hour or until potato is done.

title: Chicken Enchiladas
directions: Mix soups, onions and green chilies with a dash of salt. Layer the pan with tortillas dipped in oil., Layer that with chicken., Pour 1/2 soup mixture, then top with cheese., Repeat. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until cheese is melted.

title: Baba Ghanouj(Eggplant Puree)
directions: Place eggplant in a baking pan and bake in oven at 375° for about 30 minutes., Remove eggplant and let cool; split open and scoop out pulp; set aside.

title: Pizza Hot Dish
directions: Brown hamburger, onion, green pepper, salt and pepper, oregano and mushrooms., Cook noodles as directed on package., Combine hamburger mixture and drained egg noodles with remainder of ingredients., Put Mozzarella cheese on top., Bake, covered, at 350° for 45 minutes and uncovered 13 minutes more., Serves 10 to 12 people.

title: Pecan Pie
directions: Beat eggs slightly., Then add corn syrup, sugar, margarine and vanilla and mix well., Add pecans., Preheat oven to 350°., Pour into pie crust., Bake on cookie sheet for 50 to 55 minutes.

title: Jamie'S Onion Ring Batter
directions: Mix dry ingredients together., Beat in egg, then add buttermilk until batter is proper consistency., Slice onions thick and dip in batter., Fry in peanut oil until light brown.

title: Blueberry Pound Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 325°. Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs and beat until light and fluffy. Add vanilla. Sift 2 cups flour, salt and baking powder together. Add sifted ingredients to creamed mixture, stirring thoroughly. Dredge berries in remaining flour. Fold berry mixture gently into creamed mixture. Pour mixture in tube pan that has been greased and coated with sugar. Bake for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Chicken Salad Casserole
directions: Saute onion and celery in butter., Mix all ingredients., Cover with 2 cups potato chips or 1/2 package sliced almonds., Bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan at 375° for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Beef Stroganoff
directions: Cut beef into strips., Heat 2 tablespoons of margarine in skillet., Add mushrooms, onions and garlic., Cover and simmer until onions are tender., Remove from skillet.

title: Quiche Lorraine
directions: Cut bacon in 1-inch pieces; cook until crisp., Drain on absorbent paper., Spread on bottom of pie shell., Beat eggs, cream and seasonings just enough to blend., Stir in cheese; pour into pie shell., Bake at 375° for about 35 minutes or until pie shell is golden brown and filling is firm., Serves 4 as an entree, 8 to 12 as an appetizer.

title: No Bake Brownies
directions: Melt chocolate chips and 1 cup canned milk in heavy saucepan, stirring constantly., Remove from heat., In another bowl mix wafer crumbs, marshmallows, pecans, powdered sugar and salt., Reserve 1/2 cup chocolate mixture for glaze., Stir remaining chocolate mixture into crumb mixture and mix well., Press into greased pan (9-inches)., Stir remaining canned milk into the reserved chocolate mixture until smooth and spread over mixture in pan., Chill until glaze is set, then cut into 36 squares.

title: Molasses Crinkles
directions: Mix together the first 4 ingredients., Sift together and stir in the remaining ingredients., Chill dough., (You can make the day before or longer and freeze dough.), Take out of refrigerator; cut in thin slices., Cut each slice into 4 sections., Roll each section into balls the size of marbles or walnuts., Dip tops of balls in sugar., Place balls, sugared side up, 3 inches apart on greased baking sheet., Touch each cookie with your finger dipped in water to dampen sugar., Bake at 375° for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Vegetable Lasagna
directions: Heat oil in Dutch oven; add zucchini, onion, green pepper, carrot, celery and garlic., Saute 15 minutes over medium heat. Stir in next 9 ingredients; bring to a boil., Cover; reduce heat and simmer 30 minutes., Uncover and simmer another 45 minutes until sauce is thickened, stirring occasionally., Combine water and salt; bring to a boil., Add lasagna noodles and boil uncovered for 12 to 15 minutes or until just tender., Drain., Spread 1/4 of the sauce in lightly greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish., Top with three noodles and one-quarter of cheeses., Repeat until remaining ingredients are used., Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes., Let stand five minutes before serving., Serves 8.

title: Coconut Bread
directions: Combine flour, baking powder and salt; set aside., In large bowl combine sugar, oil, eggs and extract., Add dry ingredients alternately with buttermilk; stir just until moistened., Fold in coconut and walnuts., Pour into 2 greased and floured 8 1/2 by 4 1/2 inch loaf pans., Bake at 325° for 1 hour or until bread tests done., Cool 10 minutes in pans before removing to a wire rack to cool completely.

title: Crab Meat Spread
directions: Combine soup, cheese and onion in pan., Heat until cheese melts, stirring., Blend in mayonnaise., Remove from heat., In small saucepan, sprinkle gelatin over water., Over low heat, stir until dissolved., Stir into soup mixture., Add crab meat and celery., Pour mixture into a 6-cup mold that has been greased with mayonnaise., Refrigerate until firm., Serve as spread with crackers.

title: Jewish Coffee Cake
directions: Beat cake mix, vanilla pudding, oil, sour cream, eggs and vanilla with mixer for 2 minutes., Combine nuts, sugar and cinnamon together., Grease and flour tube pan., Layer cake mix and nuts three times., Top with nuts., Bake at 350° for 50 to 55 minutes.

title: Old Fashion Biscuit Pudding
directions: Mix together all ingredients, except biscuits and cinnamon, in saucepan., Warm, then add crumbled biscuits; stir well., Pour into baking dish; sprinkle top with cinnamon., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes, or until it checks done when toothpick is inserted.

title: Lemon Meringue Pie
directions: Bake pie shell., Heat oven to 400°., In saucepan, blend sugar and cornstarch., Combine egg yolks and water; stir gradually into sugar mixture., Cook, stirring constantly over medium heat until mixture thickens and boils., Boil and stir 1 minute., Remove from heat; stir in butter, lemon peel and juice and food coloring. Immediately pour into baked pie shell., Heap meringue on hot pie filling; spread over filling carefully, sealing the meringue onto edge of crust to prevent shrinking or weeping., Bake about 10 minutes or until delicately browned., Cool pie away from draft.

title: Easy Beef Pie
directions: Mix and put into 9-inch deep dish pie crust.

title: Mustard Beets
directions: Bring to a boil all ingredients, except beets, until sugar is dissolved (use wire whisk to mix in mustard)., Add beets., (I sometimes put in slices of sweet onion too.), Simmer, uncovered, 5 minutes., Cool and put in jars and refrigerate.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
directions: Cream oleo and peanut butter., Add both brown and white sugars., Cream until light and creamy., Add unbeaten egg and beat well., Add flour which has been sifted with soda., Add vanilla and 1 cup chopped nuts, if desired., Roll 1/2 teaspoon in hand to form small ball., Place 2 inches apart on cookie sheet., Press flat with fork., Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.

title: Merry Berry Heaven
directions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water., Add cranberry sauce and rind., Add juice., Chill until thickened., Fold in Cool Whip topping., Chill again until mixture will mound., Pour in pie shell., Chill until firm (about 3 hours)., Garnish with cranberries, if desired.

title: Banana Bread
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Sift together flour, baking powder and salt., In a different bowl, blend the oil (or shortening) and sugar until creamy., Add the egg and bananas to the sugar mixture; mix well., Add the flour to the sugar mixture slowly, in three parts., Pour mixture into a greased 8 1/2 x 4 1/2-inch loaf pan. Bake for 45 minutes, or until you can insert a toothpick in the bread and it comes out dry., Cool before slicing.

title: Skillet Beef And Corn
directions: In skillet, brown meat, onion and thyme in oil., Season with pepper, if desired., Stir in wine; bring to boil., Simmer, uncovered, over medium heat, about 7 minutes or until liquid is gone., Add tomatoes; reduce heat., Cover and cook 15 minutes or until meat is tender., Uncover and cook 5 minutes more., Add corn and rice; heat through., Garnish with sliced green onions, if desired., Makes 4 servings.

title: Sour Cream Cornbread
directions: Spray pan with Pam!!!, Mix all ingredients until well blended. Pour into pan, bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Raisin Bread
directions: Sift together dry ingredients., Add the milk, eggs and raisins. Pour into 3 greased bread pans and let stand 15 minutes., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Hospitality Punch
directions: Mix all in punch bowl, except 7-Up., Add this just before serving., Add ice float and slice citrus slices.

title: Crumb Cake
directions: Combine sugar, flour and salt., Cut in butter until mixture resembles coarse meal., Remove 1 cup of mixture and combine with cinnamon and nuts; set aside., To remaining crumb mixture, add milk and baking powder., Spread into greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Sprinkle the reserved crumbs over batter., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes., Cut into squares., Garnish with whipped topping and a pecan half, if desired.

title: Pasta Salad
directions: Mix together and refrigerate.

title: Bread Pudding
directions: Beat eggs., Add 3/4 cup sugar., Add milk, salt, 1 teaspoon vanilla and 1 tablespoon butter., Pour over bread., Mix well. Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Cheeseburger Turnovers
directions: Brown meat in skillet., Add salt and pepper (about 1/2 teaspoon salt and 2 shakes of pepper)., Roll each biscuit very thin and sprinkle a generous tablespoon of meat on biscuits., Add a half slice of cheese., Fold biscuit over meat and press around edges with a fork., Bake at 400° on cookie sheet until brown.

title: Delicious Fruit Cake
directions: Pour 1/4 cup brandy over raisins and currants; let soak while you chop and slice other fruits and nuts., Mix all fruit and dredge with 3 cups flour., Sift rest of flour with soda, baking powder and spices., Cream butter; add sugar and cream until light and fluffy. Add well beaten egg yolks, molasses, figs and strawberries and blend., Add fruits and nuts., Fold in dry ingredients., Beat egg whites until stiff., Add to batter., Turn into pans (lined with wax paper)., Fill pans 3/4 full., Bake at 250° for about 3 hours for 2 pound cake and 4 hours for 5 pound cake., Brush tops and sides with Brown Sugar Glaze.

title: Corn Pudding
directions: Beat eggs well., Add milk, flour, sugar, melted margarine and dash of salt and pour into baking dish., Sprinkle nutmeg over top and bake at 300° until done., Will turn golden brown.

title: Chili Con Queso
directions: In food processor, chop fine the onion, peppers and chiles. Melt butter and saute the chopped vegetables., Add Velveeta and the Monterey Jack cheese, shredded., Add milk to thin., Cook on stove or in microwave.

title: Crab Melt Aways
directions: Mix first 6 ingredients and spread on muffin halves., Cut in quarters and freeze., When ready to serve, place under broiler until browned.

title: Mexican Chip Dip
directions: Brown sausage and ground beef; drain., Combine all ingredients and put in crock-pot to keep warm., Use as a hearty appetizer or party snack with corn chips or tortilla chips.

title: Buttermilk Biscuits
directions: Put flour in a mixing bowl; cut butter in with a pastry cutter until crumbly. Add buttermilk and stir just until dry ingredients are moistened. Turn dough out onto a lightly floured surface; knead a few times. Pat or roll dough out to 1/2 or 3/4-inch thickness. Cut out with a 2 1/2-inch round cutter. Place on a lightly greased baking sheet; bake in a 425° oven for 12 to 14 minutes. Brush tops with a little melted butter.

title: Punch Bowl Cake
directions: Will also need 1 punch bowl.

title: Cornbread
directions: Bake about 30 to 40 minutes at 375°.

title: Rice Pudding
directions: Mix well., Pour into butter-greased 1 1/2-quart baking dish. Set dish in a shallow pan holding 1-inch of hot water., Bake 45 minutes at 350°.

title: Fried Yam Sticks
directions: On baking sheet, bake yam at 400° until just tender, 35 to 40 minutes (do not overbake); let yam cool, then peel and discard skin., Cut potato into 2 x 1/4-inch sticks.

title: Cherry Salad
directions: Bring to a boil sour cherries and sugar., While hot add jello, pineapple, orange juice and pecans., Pour into large mold. Refrigerate until set and unmold.

title: Quick Cottage Cheese Fruit Salad
directions: Mix jello powder with cottage cheese. Stir in Cool Whip., Add drained fruit and chill for 1 hour. Serve.

title: Golden Angel Food Cake
directions: Beat egg whites until foamy, add cream of tartar, beat until stiff, but not dry. Add sugar, a little at a time and beat. Fold in flour. Beat egg yolks until very light and fluffy. Fold in egg white mixture. Add vanilla. Pour into angel food pan. Bake in 325° oven for 1 hour or until done.

title: Christmas Salad
directions: Prepare lime Jell-O., Fold in crushed pineapple., Chill in an 8-inch pan., Add mayonnaise and chopped nuts to cream cheese mixture., Spread over Jell-O and chill., Prepare red Jell-O., When it begins to set, pour over cheese layer., Let salad completely set before turning out on plate.

title: Impossible Pie
directions: In blender, mix first 7 ingredients in order listed., Pour into lightly greased 9-inch pie pan., Sprinkle nutmeg on top., Bake in 350° oven 40 to 45 minutes or until knife test done., The finished result will be pie crust, coconut custard filling and shredded coconut topping.

title: Cheese Potatoes
directions: Cook 8 potatoes with skins on., When done, let cool completely. Peel potatoes and cube., Put in crock-pot., Add the rest of ingredients., Cook on high for 1 hour., Stir occasionally., Turn to low., Serve.

title: Coconut Cake
directions: Blend cake mix, pudding mix, water, eggs and oil in large mixing bowl., Beat 4 minutes., Stir in coconut and walnuts., Pour into 3 greased and floured 9-inch layer pans., Bake at 350° for 35 minutes., Cool 15 minutes, then fill and top with Coconut Cream Cheese Frosting.

title: Green Bean Casserole
directions: Cook frozen beans according to directions., Drain mushrooms, chestnuts and bean sprouts thoroughly., Mix beans with remaining ingredients except cheese., Turn into casserole., Top with cheese. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

title: Heavenly Hash
directions: Pour pineapple over marshmallows., Add mandarin oranges and coconut., Add nuts and sour cream; mix well., Refrigerate.

title: Hash Brown Quiche
directions: Press potatoes into greased quiche dish to form crust. Pour butter over potatoes. Bake at 425° for 25 minutes. Fill crust with cheese and meat. Combine milk and eggs. Beat well and pour over cheese and meat. Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes or until knife tip inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Creamy Tuna Dip
directions: Soften cream cheese., Take other ingredients and mix together with cream cheese., Serve with crackers or tortilla chips.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
directions: Mix together the margarine, cocoa, milk and sugar., Let come to a boil., Boil for 1 minute, then add peanut butter, oatmeal and vanilla., Mix well and drop on wax paper.

title: Oatmeal Spice Cookies
directions: Pour cake mix and oats into bowl; mix., Add eggs, oil and nuts; stir until dry mixture is completely moist., Drop by teaspoonfuls on a cookie sheet treated with oil or cooking spray. Bake at 350° for 10 to 15 minutes., Do not overcook., For moist cookies, place warm cookies in a sealed container., For crisp cookies, cool first and then place in container., Makes about 4 dozen.

title: Pull Candy
directions: Put ingredients in cooker. Boil to 240°. Add butter. Boil to 260°. Pour on buttered marble slab. Pull.

title: Cheese Balls
directions: Combine cream cheese, 1 cup pecans and remaining ingredients until thoroughly blended., Shape in a ball and roll remaining pecans., Serve with crackers.

title: Asparagus Casserole
directions: Place asparagus in casserole dish. Pour on soup. Sprinkle with crackers, add cheese on top.

title: Vanilla Wafer Cake
directions: Cream sugar and margarine., Add eggs, one at a time, beating after each one., Add wafer crumbs, nuts and coconut., Pour into greased and floured tube or Bundt pan., Bake at 350° for about 1 1/2 hours or until done.

title: Baked Chinese Dish
directions: Brown onion, celery, ground beef and soy sauce together., Add soups, water, Worcestershire sauce and stir until smooth over medium heat., Add rice; mix well., Pour in baking dish., Bake at 350° for 1 hour., Put chow mein noodles on top; bake 10 minutes longer with cover off.

title: Louisiana Cornbread Salad
directions: In a 2-quart casserole or larger, layer the ingredients twice in this order:, cornbread, beans, vegetables and bacon., Top with cheese., Mix sour cream and salsa together and spread over entire top of dish so no air holes are showing., Cover and chill 2 to 3 hours.

title: Tropical Ambrosia
directions: Dump Cool Whip in a large mixing bowl with a lid., Drain pineapple and oranges., Mix into Cool Whip., Add nuts and mix. Add marshmallows and coconut if desired and mix., Chill.

title: Layered Vegetable Vinaigrette(Serves 8. Preparation :20.  Stand 1:00.  Total 1:20.)
directions: Mix dressing (first 4 ingredients) in a jar. Shake well. Scrub or peel carrots and slice into rounds. Steam green beans for 5 minutes; drain. Slice tomatoes, cucumbers and mushrooms into slices. Layer vegetables in a serving dish and top with dressing. Refrigerate 1 hour or more before serving.

title: "Easy" New Potatoes
directions: Cube well washed and unpeeled potatoes (about size of a quarter); enough potatoes to cover a cookie sheet in a single layer., Coat quartered potatoes with oil, then coat them with the onion soup mix., Spray cookie sheet with Pam and spread potatoes on it., Bake at 400° for 1 hour, uncovered.

title: Green Gook
directions: Break up cake into small pieces in a 9 x 13-inch dish., Mix together pudding and milk until thickened and thoroughly blended. Add Cool Whip., Mix well., Pour over cake., Stir lightly. Refrigerate.

title: Kids Stuff
directions: Brown ground beef., Cook elbow noodles until slightly tender; drain., Add tomato soup, cream-style corn and beef to noodles. Pour into greased baking dish., Top with cheese., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Carrot Salad
directions: Grate enough carrots to fill the next to large mixing bowl. Mix with onion, raisins, drained pineapple and mayonnaise., Mix well., Refrigerate overnight before serving.

title: Stew
directions: Mix all ingredients together and cook over medium heat for 2 hours.

title: No-Bake Peanut Oat Cookies
directions: In a medium saucepan, mix sugar and cocoa., Add milk and butter., Put over medium heat and bring to a boil; boil 1 minute. Remove from heat., Stir in peanut butter and oats.

title: Jam Cake
directions: Cream margarine and sugar; add eggs., Mix well., Add remaining ingredients and mix., Pour into 3 greased cake pans., Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes or until done., Spread filling on first 2 layers and Caramel Frosting on top of third layer and sides., Top with pecan halves.

title: Mei Ling'S Hawaiian Chicken
directions: Combine sauce, juice, sugar, oil, flour and salt; mix well. Pour into skillet., Cook, stirring, until mixture comes to a boil and thickens slightly., Add chicken, pineapple, water chestnuts and ginger., Cover; simmer for 10 minutes., Serve over rice. Sprinkle with nuts., Serves 6 to 8.

title: New Orleans Pralines
directions: Combine all ingredients; mix well., Press firmly into well-greased 15 1/2 x 10 1/2-inch jelly roll pan., Bake in preheated very hot oven (450°) for about 10 to 12 minutes or until golden brown., (Mixture will be golden brown and bubbly.), Cool thoroughly., Cut into bars., Makes 15 1/2 x 10 1/2-inch pan of bars.

title: Chicken Parmigiana
directions: Place each chicken breast on a sheet of waxed paper., Flatten to 1/4-inch thickness, using a meat mallet or rolling pin. Combine eggs, salt and pepper. Dip chicken breasts into egg mixture and roll each in bread crumbs., Brown chicken in hot oil in a large skillet., Drain on paper towels., Place chicken in a lightly greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Drain oil from skillet. Combine tomato sauce, basil and garlic powder in skillet. Bring to a boil and simmer 10 minutes or until thickened., Stir in butter. Pour mixture over chicken., Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese., Cover and bake at 350° for 30 minutes., Uncover and arrange Mozzarella cheese slices on top. Bake 10 additional minutes., Yields 6 servings.

title: Punch Bowl Cake
directions: Layer the bottom of a large bowl with the pieces of angel cake., Mix sour cream, Cool Whip and powdered sugar to form cream mixture and pour on top of cake pieces.

title: Corn Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients in casserole. Dot with margarine on top. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Green Beans, New Potatoes And Bacon
directions: Put everything in a pan with water and cook for several hours, until done.

title: Golden Oven Fried Chicken
directions: Combine crumbs, cheese, parsley and seasonings., Melt oleo with garlic in shallow dish. Dip chicken in butter and then in crumbs., Place in baking dish. Bake at 400° for 1 hour or until tender., Don't turn. Baste with pan drippings.

title: Cheese Bread
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Grease the bottom of a loaf pan (about 9 x 5 x 3-inch) with oil or shortening., Place egg and milk in a medium size bowl and beat until blended., Add the other ingredients., Stir to blend and beat vigorously for 1 minute. Pour batter into prepared baking pan., Sprinkle with poppy seed. Bake for 50 to 60 minutes or until top of loaf springs back when touched with your fingers., Place on a rack to cool for 5 to 10 minutes before removing from pan., Slice and serve warm., Leftover bread is extra good sliced and toasted.

title: Kung Pao Chicken
directions: Cut chicken breasts into 1-inch squares; marinate chicken in 1 tablespoon soy sauce and 1 1/2 tablespoons cornstarch, mixed. Quickly stir-fry chicken in hot vegetable oil., Drain and remove chicken from heat., Mix in a separate bowl 2 tablespoons soy sauce, cooking wine, sugar, Chinese brown vinegar, 1 teaspoon cornstarch, sesame oil, salt and hot pepper sauce; set aside., Stir-fry minced ginger in remaining oil., Add chicken and the sauce; set aside until thickened and thoroughly heated., Remove from heat; mix in peanuts.

title: Candied Pecans
directions: Melt butter in cookie sheet., Mix remaining ingredients., Pour into buttered pan., Bake at 275° for 30 to 45 minutes, stirring every 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Hot Spiced Punch
directions: Combine sugar, 1 cup water, salt and spices in large pan. Heat to boiling., Reduce heat and simmer., Combine cranberry sauce and 3 1/2 cups water in blender., Gradually add cranberry mixture and cider to sugar syrup., Heat to just below simmering and serve.

title: Party Mix
directions: Bake in large roaster at 250° for 2 hours., Stir well every 1/2 hour.

title: Tomatoes With Honey And Black Pepper
directions: To make this salad, peel a large tomato, cut it into slices and spread each slice with honey., Sprinkle the slices with salt and pepper, then reassemble the tomato., Brush with more honey and give a sprinkle with salt and pepper., Refrigerate for 20 minutes. Serve cool.

title: Creamy Frozen Fruit Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients together and freeze.

title: Creamy Fruit Dip
directions: Combine all ingredients, except fruit; mix until well blended. Refrigerate, covered, 1 to 2 hours to allow flavors to blend. Serve with fresh fruit "dippers.", Will keep, covered, in refrigerator up to 5 days., Makes 1 1/2 cups.

title: Buttermilk Coconut Pie
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Pour into pie shell., Bake at 325° for 45 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Squash Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients together in casserole dish., Put several pats of butter on top., Bake, uncovered, at 350° for about 45 minutes.

title: Tree Bark
directions: Line large cookie sheet with tinfoil., Arrange saltines to cover tray., Combine butter and brown sugar. Pour over crackers and bake at 400° for seven minutes., Remove and pour one cup chocolate chips over., Spread until melted., Chill 2 to 3 hours. Lift and break into pieces.

title: Cinnamon French Toast
directions: Mix eggs, salt, milk and cinnamon., Dip bread in egg mixture. Brown both sides on lightly greased griddle.

title: Venison Pot Roast
directions: The day before cooking, season venison thoroughly with salt and pepper. Stuff meat with garlic and refrigerate overnight. Brown venison in hot oil. Remove roast. Add flour and water, stirring constantly, to make a light brown roux. Add tomato paste and cook for 1 minute. Add onion and return to Dutch oven. Cover; cook slowly for 5 hours or until tender.

title: My Favorite Apple Pie
directions: Mix dry ingredients in a large bowl., Add apples, mix well. Line a 10 or 12-inch baking dish with pastry, add apple mixture. Pour apple juice around edge (not on apples)., Cover with top pastry, sealing edges., Cut slits in top., Brush with margarine, sprinkle with white sugar., Bake at 425° for 40 minutes or until juice bubbles through slits., This is a deep-dish pie., Pan must be at least two inches deep.

title: Zucchini Fruit Loaves
directions: Beat first 4 ingredients together until thick and foamy., Add zucchini and fruit and stir., Sift together next 6 dry ingredients; combine with last two (nuts and raisins) and add to first mixture.

title: Pineapple Jello Salad
directions: Prepare lemon jello as per directions on box., Refrigerate until partially gelled., With electric mixer, mix in cream cheese until smooth., Stir in pineapple and pecans., Refrigerate until gelled.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
directions: Put all ingredients in mixer and beat until fluffy., Pour in a greased casserole.

title: Pretzel Salad
directions: 1st Layer:, Add melted butter to pretzels and sugar; mix well and bake for 6 minutes., Let cool while preparing 2nd layer.

title: Beefed-Up Chicken Breasts
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Place dried beef slices evenly around chicken breasts., Tuck edges of beef under chicken. Place in 8-inch square baking dish. Combine soup and sour cream., Pour over chicken. Bake at 350°, covered, for 45 minutes., Remove cover and sprinkle with almonds. Continue baking at 350° for 15 minutes. Makes 4 servings.

title: Strawberry Meringue Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 200°., Line 2 baking sheets with parchment paper., Combine egg whites and salt in a large bowl., Beat with an electric mixer on a medium-high speed until soft peaks form, 1 to 2 minutes., Increase speed to high., Add sugar gradually in a slow steady stream, beating until stiff, shiny peaks form, 2 to 4 minutes., Add strawberry flavoring and food coloring; mix until just combined., Spoon meringue mixture into pastry bag fitted with star tip., Pipe meringue into 2-inch mounds on prepared baking sheets., Bake until cookies are dry and crisp, about 1 hour and 35 minutes., Turn off oven; let cookies stand in oven with door closed for 5 minutes., Remove from oven; cool 3 minutes., Remove from parchment paper; place on wire rack to cool completely.

title: Sweet Roll Dough
directions: In mixing bowl dissolve yeast in water. Stir in milk, sugar and salt., Add eggs, shortening and half the flour. Stir with spoon. Add the rest of flour. Turn unto floured board. Knead until smooth, about 5 minutes., Round-up in greased bowl. Cover with damp cloth. Let rise until double, about 1 1/2 hours in warm place. Punch down. Shape into rolls or coffee cake. Let rise until double, about 30 minutes.

title: Apple Nut Bread
directions: Mix the first 5 ingredients with an electric mixer, then add the remaining ingredients and mix well., Put mixture into greased and powdered sugared pans., Bake for 60 to 90 minutes at 350°. Fill loaf pans half full.

title: Salad Dressing For Spinach Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients, except oil, then add oil slowly until mixed well.

title: Banana Split Cake
directions: Pat graham cracker crumbs, melted margarine and 1 tablespoon sugar in a 9 x 13-inch pan., Beat 1 egg, soft margarine, salt and confectioners sugar for 10 minutes until very creamy; pour over graham cracker crumbs., Slice 4 to 5 bananas over mixture., Drain crushed pineapple; spread over bananas., Add cut up strawberries over bananas and pineapple., Spread Cool Whip over fruit. Sprinkle with chopped nuts., Chill overnight.

title: Cream Cheese Ball
directions: Mix and roll in 1/2 cup nuts., Chill., Serve on Ritz crackers.

title: Vegetables Mexicali
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Heat oil in a large skillet., Add zucchini, onion and green pepper and saute for 5 minutes., Add eggs and stir until barely set., Remove skillet from heat; stir in chilies, salt, black pepper and cumin., In a small bowl, blend flour and sour cream., Arrange 1/2 of tortilla wedges in a shallow 2-quart casserole or 8-inch square baking dish., Add 1/2 of vegetable mixture, then 1/2 of sour cream mixture., Top with 1/2 of the cheese., Repeat layers ending with cheese., Bake uncovered for 30 minutes or until bubbly., Let stand for 5 to 10 minutes before serving.

title: Dean'S Hot Dog Chili
directions: Peel and chop onions. In large pot, cover onions with water and boil until onions are soft and mushy. Mix in ground beef, stirring to separate. Add more water, if necessary. Heat until meat is gray. Add tomatoes, mashing with spoon; then add salt, pepper and chili powder. Cook over low heat until thick, stirring often. Skim off excess fat.

title: Cocktail Bread With Cucumber
directions: Mix the first 3 ingredients together. Spread on slices of rye cocktail bread. Top with a slice of cucumber. Sprinkle with dill weed.

title: Misericordia Crabcakes
directions: Melt butter and shortening in top of double boiler., Add onion; let simmer over direct heat about 15 minutes or until onion is very tender, but do not brown or burn it., Take pan from heat; let cool a moment, then stir in flour., Be careful the butter mixture is not too hot or the flour will get lumpy., Stir milk in gradually, making smooth., Add and stir seasonings., Place over boiling water and stir constantly until sauce is thickened and well blended. Pour this thick sauce over the picked over crab meat., Mix well and refrigerate overnight., Shape the chilled mixture into patties about 1 inch thick., Roll them in the fine breadcrumbs to coat all over and lower them carefully into hot fat deep enough to cover them completely and fry to a deep golden brown., Lift out with slotted pancake lifter and let them drain a moment on absorbent paper., Serve piping hot.

title: Irish Soda Bread
directions: Place rack in middle of oven and preheat to 350°.

title: Jumbo Oat Cookies
directions: Beat sugar, butter or margarine and corn syrup until fluffy. Add egg whites and extract; mix well., Gradually add combined remaining ingredients; mix well., Drop 1/4 cup measure, about 2-inches apart onto ungreased cookie sheet., Press into 3-inch circles., Bake 14 to 16 minutes or until light golden brown., Cool 1 minute; remove to aluminum foil., Store lightly covered., Makes 1 dozen.

title: Salsa Verde
directions: Peel, core and chop tomatoes. Chop peppers., Mix all together. Add salt and black pepper to taste., Bring just to a boil., Ladle into hot pint jars. Add 1 teaspoon lemon juice and/or vinegar to each jar., Adjust lids.

title: Red Velvet Cake
directions: Cream together shortening and sugar; add eggs, food coloring, vanilla and lemon flavoring., Sift together flour, soda and cocoa. Add the vinegar to the buttermilk., Alternating, add the flour mixture and the buttermilk to the creamed mixture., Bake at 350° until toothpick comes out clean (15 to 20 minutes)., Use 3 greased and floured 8-inch round cake pans or one 9 x 13-inch cake pan.

title: Chinese Chews Cookie
directions: Mix together butter, brown sugar, eggs, nuts and dates.

title: Tomato-Topped Chicken And Stuffing
directions: Crush 1/2 cup stuffing., In small bowl, combine crushed stuffing and margarine., Set aside., In a 3-quart saucepan over high heat, heat water to boiling., Remove from heat; add remaining stuffing., Toss to mix well.

title: Chicken Enchilada
directions: Saute onion and garlic., Add tomatoes, chicken and bouillon, simmer 15 minutes., Add Cheddar cheese., Spoon into tortillas, roll up and place in 9 x 13-inch baking dish., Sprinkle with Swiss cheese and bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

title: Curried Chicken Salad
directions: Combine mayonnaise,, curry, powder, soy sauce and lemon juice. Add to chicken mixture., Chill and serve.

title: Cowboy Soup
directions: Brown ground beef and onions. Mix with all other ingredients in large pot and cook 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Punch
directions: Mix together., Put in punch bowl., Add the sherbet at that time.

title: Potato Refrigerator Rolls
directions: Dissolve yeast in lukewarm water., Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs., Add mashed potatoes, sour cream and yeast mixture., Add flour and salt; knead well., Brush with melted butter., Cover and refrigerate overnight., Shape in desired form and place on greased pan., Let rise for 1 hour or more., Bake in preheated 375° oven about 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Oyster Crackers
directions: Blend all ingredients except crackers. Mix well. Pour over crackers to coat them. Put crackers on a cookie sheet. Place in warm oven for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Cheese Chicken Casserole
directions: Saute celery and onion in butter until tender., Cook noodles and chicken., Chop the chicken., Combine onion, celery, water, soup, noodles and chicken., Mix well., Add 1/2 cup cheese., Mix well., Pour into greased dish and top with remaining cheese., Cook at 350° for 45 to 60 minutes.

title: Cinnamon And Raisin Bread(Bread Machine)
directions: Add ingredients to the bread pan in the order that they are listed except the raisins., Select setting to Basic., Change crust color or leave it at medium., Press Start/Stop to begin., Add the raisins when beeping sounds during kneading., Display will read 2:20., When display read 0:00, press Start/Stop for 3 seconds to cancel., Use oven mitts to handle hot bread pan.

title: One-Step Lasagna
directions: Brown meat and drain., Combine beef and spaghetti sauce. Spread 1/3 of mixture in lightly greased 12 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish., Arrange 4 lasagna noodles on sauce., Layer 1 cup cottage cheese and 1 cup Mozzarella cheese over noodles., Spoon 1/2 of remaining sauce over cheese., Top with 4 noodles, 1 cup cottage cheese, 1 cup Mozzarella cheese and remaining sauce., Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and 1 cup Mozzarella cheese., Bake in 350° oven for 45 minutes.

title: Circuit Preacher Scripture Cake
directions: Follow the directions of Solomon for bringing up a child (Proverbs 23:14)., Bake in a tube pan at 325° for about 1 hour or longer if necessary., Cool on a rack., Slices best after a few hours.

title: Cheeseburger Pie(Weight Watchers Recipe)
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., Brown turkey, onion and green pepper in skillet., Add tomato sauce, chili powder and garlic powder. Simmer 8 to 10 minutes., Add cooked macaroni and 3 ounces of cheese., Stir until cheese melts., Pour into an 8 x 8-inch casserole dish that has been sprayed with a nonstick spray. Sprinkle remaining 1 ounce of cheese on top., Bake 30 minutes. Remove and let set 10 to 15 minutes before cutting.

title: Potato Soup
directions: Cook first 8 ingredients until tender., Add milk mixed with flour., Add chicken bouillon cube., Last, add cubed Velveeta cheese., Stir until cheese is melted.

title: Molasses Cookies
directions: Mix cloves, ginger and cinnamon together in small container. Mix all ingredients, including spices, together. Chill one hour. Shape into balls and roll in sugar. Cookies will flatten in baking., Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: No Bake Cookies
directions: Stir sugar, milk, butter and cocoa together., Bring to a boil. Boil for 1 minute., Remove from stove, add oats, peanut butter, nuts and vanilla., Stir well., Drop by teaspoon onto wax paper.

title: Cobbler Dough
directions: Stir with a fork until blended., Drop by spoonfuls over fruit. Bake in an 8-inch pan for 25 to, 30 minutes in a 350° oven.

title: Peanut Butter Eggs(Easter Candy)
directions: Mix well the powdered sugar, peanut butter, margarine, and vanilla., Form into balls or patties or form mixture into egg shapes; dip in chocolate for Easter.

title: Eggplant And Yogurt
directions: Fry eggplant until they are golden brown., Add salt, pepper and water to yogurt., Take eggplant out of the oil and put cumin seed in the oil until brown., Put half of the cumin in yogurt.

title: Date Pudding
directions: Put the hot water and soda over the dates and let stand while you mix up the rest, then put all together., Cook 1 cup brown sugar and 1 1/2 cups boiling water until sugar dissolves., Pour over pudding batter before baking., Bake in 350° oven for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Peanut Crisp Bars
directions: Combine sugar, Karo and salt. Cook and stir until sugar is dissolved. Blend in peanut butter. Stir in cereal., Pat evenly in a foil lined pan., In small pan, melt oleo and brown sugar. Remove from fire. Add milk and vanilla. Beat in powdered sugar until smooth. Remove cookie mixture from pan., Peel off foil and spread top with icing., Chill and cut in small bars.

title: Zucchini Jelly
directions: Boil grated zucchini and sugar for 6 minutes; add lemon juice, pineapple and Pen-Jell., Boil 6 minutes more., Put in sterilized jelly jars., Melt paraffin and pour on top to seal.

title: Orange Delight
directions: Mix dry Jell-O with pineapple and add cottage cheese, Cool Whip and marshmallows. Mix well.

title: Frozen Coconut Pie
directions: Mix well with mixer until soft and creamy., Pour half of mixture into each pie crust., Sprinkle coconut mixture over Cool Whip mixture., Drizzle half caramel topping over coconut mixture. Layer; repeat each mixture again., Finish with caramel topping. Wrap well and put in freezer overnight., Keeps well for 3 months in freezer.

title: Wieners In A Pot
directions: Place dogs in pot, cover with water., Place on stove and bring to boil., When wieners are hot take out of pot and put into buns.

title: Old-Fashioned Peanut Butter Cookies
directions: Mix flour, salt and soda., Set aside., Mix fat and peanut butter., Add both kinds sugar., Mix well., Add eggs and mix well. Stir flour mixture into peanut butter mix., Drop by teaspoonfuls on cookie sheet., Flatten with fork., Bake at 375° for 10 minutes or until lightly brown., Makes 4 to 5 dozen cookies.

title: Spoon Rolls
directions: Melt the margarine in a 10-cup refrigerator container, using the microwave oven., Takes about 1 minute on High., Add everything else but the flour., Beat., Add the flour and mix well. Refrigerate until you are ready to bake muffins., May bake immediately or wait 2 to 3 days.

title: Broccoli Corn Bread
directions: Cook and drain broccoli., Mix remaining ingredients with broccoli and put into a well greased pan., Bake at 350° until brown.

title: No Bake French Cream Cake
directions: Place 1 cup crumbs in ungreased 8 inch square pan. Thoroughly cream butter and sugar., Add eggs and beat well. Spread carefully over crumbs., Combine cream, nuts and pineapple. Spread over creamed mixture, then sprinkle with remaining crumbs. Let stand 18 to 24 hours in refrigerator., Cut into squares and serve., May top with a scoop of vanilla ice cream., Serves 12 - 16.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Stew, chicken.	Do, not, salt.	Pick, off bones and put aside. Save, broth., Melt, margarine, and stir into dressing. In	a greased, dish, (9, x, 13-inch), put a layer of dressing crumbs, a layer of chicken, then a layer of mushroom or celery soup (diluted with 1 can of broth)., Again, layer the crumbs, chicken and, can of cream of chicken soup (diluted with 1 can of broth). Top with crumbs and bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour (or until brown)., Use no salt at all.

title: Cheese Ball
directions: Mix sauce, Accent, cheese and 1 package beef., Cover and set 24 hours., Wrap ball with remaining beef and serve.

title: Oven Caramel Corn
directions: Preheat oven to 250°., Put popped popcorn and peanuts in a big roaster or pan., Put brown sugar, white syrup and oleo in saucepan and bring to a boil., Boil 5 minutes., Add soda and immediately pour over popcorn and peanuts., Put in oven and toss every 15 minutes for 1 hour., Spread on wax paper to cool.

title: Fruited Chicken And Rice Skillet
directions: Heat oil in skillet over medium-high heat. Add chicken., Cook and stir 3 minutes. Drain; reduce heat to medium., Stir in combined dressing, juice and sugar. Add rice and green pepper. Bring to a boil. Remove from heat. Add oranges and pineapple., Let stand, covered, 5 minutes., I also add pea pods., Preparation time:, 10 minutes., Cooking time:, 10 minutes plus standing. Makes 4 servings.

title: Mickey Mouse Salad
directions: Wash off the lettuce and place on plate., Lay a pear half on the lettuce., Cut cherries in half, then place on the end of the pear for a mouth., Use two raisins for eyes and two pecans for his ears to make a Mickey Mouse face.

title: Pot Roast
directions: Place roast in large crockpot., Add all other ingredients. Cook on low 8 hours.

title: Sausage Balls
directions: Roll into balls and bake at 325° for 12 minutes.

title: French Apple Cream Pie
directions: Put crust in pie pan and fill with apples., Sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon., Mix egg, sugar, lemon juice, cream cheese and sour cream., Mix until smooth., Pour over sugar and cinnamon apples. Put crust on top and bake in a 425° oven for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Broccoli Cornbread
directions: Mix all ingredients., Cook 40-45 minutes at 400 degrees.

title: Marshmallow Fudge
directions: Cook 1st four ingredients; stir over medium heat until mixture boils and is bubbling over top. Stir 5 minutes. Remove from heat and add vanilla flavoring and chocolate bits. Stir until melted. Stir in nuts. Spread in buttered pan. Cool thoroughly.

title: Potato Dumplings
directions: Mix first 3 ingredients., Put bread in the middle of a ball formed around the piece of bread., Place in boiling water., Simmer for 20 minutes., Serve with roast beef, roast pork, etc.

title: Microwave Fudge
directions: Melt first three ingredients for 2 to 4 minutes on High. Stir., Pour into greased 8 x 8-inch pan., Refrigerate until soft.

title: French Onion Soup
directions: Melt butter in large skillet., Add onions and cook slowly until soft., Add sugar and salt. Stir and cook one minute., Boil water and melt bouillon cubes., Place all ingredients in crock-pot., Add brandy or cooking sherry., Cook and cover on low 4 to 6 hours. Spoon into soup crocks. Top each crock with toasted French bread., Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese., Makes 4 servings. Recipe may be doubled.

title: Best Yet Pineapple Cake
directions: Blend together butter, cream cheese, sour cream and sugar. Add undrained pineapple and coconut; blend., Sprinkle with dry pudding mix as it comes in the package., Fold in whipped topping. Use to fill and frost layers of yellow cake.

title: Diabetic Fruit Cake
directions: Mix first 4 ingredients; set aside., Combine remaining ingredients and add to applesauce mixture., Dough will be thick. Pour into well-greased loaf pans and bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Spaghetti Salad
directions: Cook vermicelli al dente. Combine all ingredients., Mix well so that everything is coated. Chill before serving.

title: Breakfast Casserole
directions: Beat eggs and milk together., Combine dry mustard, salt and pepper., Add to egg and milk mixture., Line bottom of a 13 x 9-inch dish with bread., Cover with sausage., Pour egg mixture over sausage., Top with grated cheese., Refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes., Can freeze up to 6 weeks.

title: Sweet And Sour Venison Stew
directions: Brown the venison cubes in the oil in a heavy skillet., Add the rest of the ingredients (except parsley) and cover., Simmer for 2 1/2 hours., Add water during simmering, if needed., Thicken with instant flour and serve over hot, buttered noodles.

title: Scalloped Pineapple
directions: Mix all ingredients and bake in greased baking dish for 45 minutes at 350°., Serve warm (leftovers are also good cold).

title: Twinkie Cake
directions: Slice Twinkies in half and place cream side up in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan., Slice bananas on top of Twinkies., Prepare pudding as per directions and combine with well drained pineapple., Pour this over bananas., Next, smooth Cool Whip over top and sprinkle on nuts., Keep refrigerated.

title: Chocolate Mousse
directions: Line spring pan with Lady Fingers., Melt chocolate in top of double boiler; beat in egg yolks, one at a time., Beat whites until frothy; add sugar to beaten whites., In bowl, blend 1/4 of white with chocolate mixture., Fold in remaining whites., Fold in Cool Whip and vanilla., Refrigerate for 2 hours.

title: Grilled Chicken Breasts Oriental
directions: Combine all ingredients and set aside for 15 minutes., Heat grill, charcoal grill or broiler., Place breasts on hot grill, cooking on each side until done, about 5 to 10 minutes on each side, depending on size of breasts.

title: Pecan Fingers
directions: Heat, oven to 350°., Cream shortening and confectioners sugar. Blend, in, flour., Press evenly in bottom of ungreased pan, 13, x 9, x, 2-inches., Bake, for, 12 to 15 minutes., Mix remaining ingredients., Spread over hot, baked layer and bake 20 minutes longer., Cool and cut into bars.

title: Lemon Angel Food Cake
directions: Use the whole egg and prepare pudding as directed on box., Tear angel food cakes in 1-inch pieces., Alternate with pudding (layer cakes, then layer pudding) in cake pan., Put in refrigerator for several hours., Invert cake in plate after chilling and ice with Cool Whip.

title: Red Beans And Rice
directions: Place beans in a Dutch oven with water., Bring to a boil; simmer 2 minutes., Remove from heat., Cover and let stand 1 hour. Drain and rinse beans., Return to Dutch oven with broth, garlic and bay leaves; bring to a boil., Reduce heat; cover and simmer 1 1/4 hours., Stir in all remaining ingredients., Cover and simmer for 1 hour or until beans and vegetables are tender and gravy is thick., Remove bay leaves., Serve over rice., Makes 12 servings.

title: Strawberry Pretzel Salad
directions: First Layer:, Crush pretzels, add sugar and margarine., Mix. Spread in 11 x 14-inch Pyrex., Bake in 400° oven for 10 minutes. Cool.

title: Fresh Coconut Cake(16 Servings)
directions: Sift flour, baking powder and salt together., Grease and lightly flour three 9-inch cake pans., In a large mixing bowl, cream butter and sugar, using an electric mixer if possible., Add eggs, one at a time, mixing well after each addition., The mixture should be smooth and creamy., Using a spoon, add one-third of the milk., Repeat until flour and milk are incorporated., It is important that ingredients be folded in; batter should not be beaten after flour has been introduced., Stir in vanilla. Distribute batter evenly among three cake pans and bake in a preheated 350° oven for about 30 minutes, or until layers are golden brown and spring back when gently pressed in the middle. Cool for about 5 minutes and turn layers out of pans.

title: 7-Up Lemon Pound Cake
directions: Cream sugar and shortening together and beat until light and fluffy., Add eggs, one at a time and beat well., Add flour alternately with lemon extract and 7-Up., Pour batter into well-greased and floured tube or Bundt pan., Bake at 325° for 1 to 1 1/4 hours., When thoroughly cool, sift powdered sugar over cake. This cake freezes well and stays moist., Serves 16.

title: Vegetable Pie
directions: Line a 10-inch pie plate with crusts., Defrost vegetables, but do not cook., Mix milk with soup. Stir vegetables into soup. Pour mixture into crust. Cover with sliced cheese., Cover with top crust., Vent., Bake at 375° for 45 minutes.

title: Apple Cake
directions: Mix last 3 ingredients in bowl and set aside., Beat remaining ingredients together until smooth., Grease tube pan. Put layer of batter, layer of apples several times, ending up with apples on top., Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 to 2 hours., Serves 15 people.

title: Pan Toasted Fish
directions: Place fish in shallow baking dish and cover with milk. Refrigerate 1 hour., Drain and pat dry., Combine egg white and lemon juice in a separate shallow dish and set aside., Combine oat bran, paprika and black pepper., Dip fillets in egg mixture then oat mixture., Saut in oil in nonstick skillet 3 minutes on each side or until evenly browned., Serves 4.

title: Ginger-Marinated Chicken Wings
directions: Arrange wings evenly in the bottom of a shallow dish., Combine soy sauce, honey, arrowroot, vinegar, ginger and garlic in a bowl. Pour marinade evenly over top., Cover and chill up to 4 hours. Remove wings from marinade., Arrange on broiler pan., Cook, turning and basting with the marinade several times for 15 to 20 minutes, or until done to your liking.

title: Pecan Pie
directions: Line a 9-inch pan with pastry 1/8 inch thick., Combine ingredients, adding pecans last., Pour into pastry shell., Bake in hot oven (400°) for 15 minutes, then reduce heat to 300° and bake for 30 to 35 minutes longer or until a silver knife inserted in center of filling comes out clear.

title: Cold Chicken Curry
directions: Cook rice; refrigerate until cool., Toss rice, cauliflower and French dressing; cover and refrigerate for 2 hours., In a large bowl, combine the mayonnaise, curry powder, salt and pepper., Stir in milk., Add chicken and toss., Refrigerate for 2 hours., In a large bowl, mix the rice and chicken., Add green pepper, celery and onion., Turn on platter lined with romaine leaves., Top with almonds.

title: Sausage Soup
directions: Brown and drain sausage and onions., Combine all ingredients in large pot and simmer 20 minutes, stirring occasionally., May be thinned with more broth or water., May be frozen.

title: Shepards Pie
directions: Brown ground beef., Add onions., Cook until onion softens., Add tomato soup and beans., In a bowl put mashed potatoes plus eggs (beaten with a fork) and grated cheese.

title: Pumpkin Cake
directions: Beat eggs with sugar until light and well blended., Beat in oil., Sift dry ingredients together; beat into egg mixture., Add pumpkin and mix well., Pour into well-greased and floured 9-inch tube pan., Bake at 350° for 55 minutes or until cake tests done. Let stand in pan 10 minutes., Turn onto rack to cool., Serve with whipped cream or ice with cream cheese icing.

title: Easy Spicy-Sweet Chicken
directions: Pound chicken to 1/2-inch thickness; sprinkle with salt to taste., Cook chicken in oil in 10-inch skillet over medium heat cooked through, about 5 minutes on each side., Remove from skillet and reserve., Increase heat to medium-high., Add picante sauce, marmalade and peas to skillet; mix well., Cook and stir 3 minutes or until sauce has thickened., Return chicken to skillet; spoon sauce over chicken and heat through, about 1 minute., Serve with additional picante sauce, if desired., Makes 4 servings.

title: Easy Sticky Cinnamon Rolls
directions: Thaw bread dough at room temperature (1 1/2 to 2 hours). Grease 13 x 9 x 2-inch cake pan., Tear off bread dough in two-inch balls., Place in greased pan., Melt butter and add remaining ingredients., Pour over balls., Let rise 2 hours at room temperature., Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes., Serve warm.

title: Dorothy'S Muffins
directions: Heat oven to 400°., Grease bottoms only of muffin tins or use paper liners., Beat egg, melted margarine and milk., Combine dry ingredients and add to egg mixture., Stir until flour is moistened., Stir in marmalade, mixing well., Divide equally into 12 prepared muffin tin cups., Bake for 18 to 20 minutes., Remove from pan immediately.

title: Squash Casserole
directions: Cook, squash and onions until tender., Drain well., Add butter and mix well., Fold in remaining ingredients., Place in buttered casserole and top with layer of cracker crumbs., Bake for 30 minutes in 350° oven.

title: Easy Lasagna Ii
directions: Grease a 9 x 13 x 2-inch baking pan., Combine meat and spaghetti sauce., Mix eggs into cottage cheese., Spread a thin layer of sauce in pan., Add a layer of the uncooked lasagne noodles, a layer of the cottage cheese mixture, a layer of cut up Mozzarella and a generous layer of sauce., Repeat layers, ending with the sauce., Cover tightly with heavy-duty foil and bake at 375° for 1 hour., Let stand, covered, outside of oven for 12 to 20 minutes before serving., Sprinkle with Parmesan before serving.

title: Creamy Baked Chicken Breast
directions: Arrange chicken in lightly greased 13 x 9 1/2-inch baking dish., Top with cheese., Combine soup and wine; stir well., Spoon evenly over chicken., Drizzle butter over crumbs., Bake at 350° for 45 to 55 minutes., Serve over rice.

title: Rocky Road Candy
directions: In heavy saucepan, over low heat, melt morsels with Eagle Brand milk and margarine., Remove from heat., In a large bowl, combine nuts and marshmallows; stir in chocolate mixture., Spread in wax paper lined 13 x 9-inch pan., Chill for 2 hours or until firm., Remove from pan; peel off paper and cut into squares. Store loosely covered at room temperature.

title: Four Fruit Compote
directions: Drain pineapple, reserving 3/4 cup juice., In a saucepan, combine sugar and cornstarch., Add pineapple juice, orange juice and lemon juice., Cook and stir over medium heat until thickened and bubbly; cook and stir 1 minute longer., Remove from the heat and set aside., In a bowl, combine fruit., Pour warm sauce over the fruit., Stir gently to coat., Cover and refrigerate., Yields 12 to 16 servings.

title: Chili Dip (A Hit)(Quick And Easy)
directions: Use microwave or conventional oven., Put Hormel chili in bowl. Cut Velveeta in small chunks., Place in chili., Drain chilies and mix with chili and cheese., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes or microwave until cheese is melted., Stir frequently., Dip with nacho chips.

title: Bran Muffins
directions: Mix first 3 ingredients together., Then add buttermilk, raisins, dates and nuts., Cream the rest of ingredients together. Mix together all ingredients in large bowl., Makes about a gallon. Cook in a 375° oven for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
directions: In a large heavy pan, place sugar, oleo and milk., Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until ingredients melt. Continue cooking to soft ball stage, 235° on candy thermometer. Remove from heat., Quickly stir in marshmallow cream and peanut butter., Pour into two 8 x 8 x 2-inch pans (buttered)., Cut into squares when cold., You may add nuts or use crunchy peanut butter.

title: Microwavable Rice Krispies Treats
directions: Put butter into glass, microwavable tray., Microwave for 30 seconds., Add marshmallows into tray; microwave 2 to 3 minutes. Add Rice Krispies cereal evenly., Mix evenly., Set to cool for 10 minutes., Cut into squares and enjoy.

title: Magic Meat Loaf
directions: Mix all ingredients, except potatoes, in large bowl., Shape into a loaf., Place in crock-pot., Place potatoes at the sides of loaf., (If potatoes are peeled, wrap in foil to keep from darkening.), Cover and cook on low for 8 to 10 hours, on high for 4 to 5 hours.

title: Applesauce Cookies
directions: Mix together shortening, brown sugar and egg., Stir in applesauce., Sift flour, baking soda, salt and spices and mix well together., Add nuts and raisins., Drop by teaspoonfuls on greased cookie sheet., Bake until golden brown in a 375° oven for about 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Fresh And Creamy Potato Salad
directions: Combine potatoes, celery, green peppers, onion and salt; mix lightly., Combine cream cheese, sour cream and milk, mixing until well blended., Add to potato mixture; mix lightly., Chill., Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Chicken Fried Round Steak
directions: Pound steak thoroughly., Cut in serving pieces., Blend egg and milk., Dip meat in egg mixture, then in crumbs., Slowly brown meat in hot oil (iron skillet works well), turning once., Season with salt and pepper; cover., Cook over low heat for 30 to 45 minutes or until tender., Serves 4 to 6.

title: Poor Man'S Cake
directions: Mix flour, pineapple, 1 1/2 cups sugar and soda., Pour in ungreased pan., Cut butter into pats and place on top., Bake 35 minutes at 350°., Mix together 3/4 cup sugar, butter, cream and nuts., Cook slow until thickened., Pour over cake when cake is done.

title: Cranberry Salad
directions: Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water; add cranberries, then add pineapple, sugar, nuts and oranges., Jellied cranberry sauce also can be used instead of whole cranberries., Put into glass dish or mold.

title: Chicken And Ham Party Salads
directions: Put chicken through meat grinder (hand operated). Mix with other ingredients in a bowl.

title: Pizza Omelet(Serves 2)
directions: Allow 3 eggs for 2 servings., For each egg, add 1 tablespoon evaporated milk, 1/8 teaspoon salt and pepper., Beat eggs slightly; beat in milk and seasonings., Heat 1 tablespoon butter in heavy skillet and add eggs and cook slowly.

title: Sour Cream Raisin Pie
directions: Blend all together except 1 teaspoon soda., Cook until thick in double boiler; add soda., Pour puffed up filling in pie shell. Cover with meringue made from the 3 egg whites., Put in oven to brown.

title: "New Moon" Tea Cakes
directions: Cream the butter and sugar well. Add egg yolks and beat well, about 5 minutes. Sift flour, salt and baking powder together and add in 3 parts to creamed mixture, blending it well. Add vanilla. Clean beaters and beat egg whites in another bowl until stiff, but not dry., Pour on top of the batter and with spatula or rubber scraper, fold in gently., Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan. Dust with flour., Pour in batter and spread to corners., Sprinkle with walnuts and bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes., Lightly dust with powdered sugar while warm. Cool and cut with a serrated round cookie cutter so you will have half moon shaped little cakes.

title: Chicken Breasts In Sour Cream
directions: Mix flour and sour cream., Add cream of mushroom soup and white wine., Mix in pepper and garlic salt., Place chicken breasts into baking dish., Add mixture onto top., Bake, covered, at 350° for 90 minutes., If desired, you can then turn onto broil until top is slightly brown., Served with brown rice is good.

title: Cinnamon Toast
directions: Heat the oven., Butter 2 pieces of bread., Place cinnamon on bread., Butter the bread., Cook for about 5 minutes.

title: Coconut Pumpkin Chiffon Pie
directions: Dissolve gelatine in 1/4 cup water., Cook next nine ingredients in double boiler or in a microwave until slightly thick (12 to 15 minutes)., Remove from heat and stir in the gelatine; cool.

title: Oriental Steak Broil
directions: In a 1-quart saucepan, combine the lemon juice, oil, garlic, soy sauce, salt, pepper and aniseed., Bring to a boil over high heat and stir about 30 seconds or until the salt dissolves., Put the steak into a 9 x 9 x 2-inch non-aluminum baking dish and pierce all over with a fork., Pour the hot marinade over the steak, turn the steak over in the marinade to coat it well and marinate at room temperature for 30 minutes (or longer if you have time), turning once., Preheat the broiler., Place the steak on the rack of the broiler pan about 2 or 3 inches from the heat., Broil for 5 to 7 minutes per side for medium., Cut the steak on the diagonal into 1/2-inch slices., Makes 4 servings, 340 calories per serving.

title: Lemon Lush
directions: Mix margarine and flour together and press in a 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes., Let cool.

title: Berry Banana Smoothie
directions: Combine ingredients in a blender; cover and blend until smooth. Makes 2 (8 ounce) servings.

title: Skillet Candied Sweet Potatoes(Serves 6)
directions: Melt butter in a skillet., Stir in brown sugar, water and salt., Add sliced potatoes., Cook, uncovered, over medium heat 10 to 15 minutes or until glazed, basting and turning gently 2 or 3 times.

title: Cherry-Chocolate Cups
directions: Cream together sugar and butter., Beat in egg and vanilla. Stir together flour, baking powder and salt., Stir into creamed mixture; mix well., Divide dough in half., To one half add nuts and chocolate., Press a rounded teaspoonful of chocolate mixture into the bottom and up sides of ungreased 1 3/4-inch muffin cups., Place a cherry half in the center of each cup., Top with a rounded teaspoonful of the remaining white dough and another cherry half. Bake at 375° for 15 to 20 minutes., Makes 32.

title: Walnut Cheese Patties
directions: Mix together and form into patties., Fry in small amount of oil (not too hot of pan) until golden brown., Cover with mushroom or onion gravy., Also can be used with tomato sauce., These patties can be made up ahead and frozen until ready to use.

title: Wall Cleaner
directions: Mix together., Good to wash walls., This does a good job for pennies.

title: German Chocolate Upside-Down Cake
directions: Spray pan with Pam., Sprinkle coconut and chopped nuts in bottom of pan., Mix together cake mix., Spread over coconut and nuts., Mix together confectioners sugar, melted butter and softened cream cheese., Spread over cake mix., Bake at 350° for 40 to 50 minutes.

title: Swedish Meatballs
directions: Mix beef, onion, egg, parsley and crumbs., Form into balls and brown., Pour off drippings., Stir in soup, water and pickles. Cover; cook over low heat for 20 minutes., Delicious with any meal.

title: Scrumptious Minted Brownies
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Grease bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan. Combine brownie mix, egg, water and oil in a large bowl., Stir with spoon until well blended, about 50 strokes., Spread in prepared pan., Bake for 25 minutes or until set., Place 30 wafers evenly over hot brownies., Let stand for 1 minute to melt., Spread candy wafers to frost brownies., Score frosting into 36 bars by running tip of knife through melted candy., Do not cut through brownies. Cut remaining 18 candy wafers in half lengthwise; place halves on each scored bar., Cool completely., Cut into bars.

title: Tuna Vegetable Souffle
directions: Combine first 5 ingredients in large bowl., Prepare 4 servings of potatoes, omitting butter., Fold in mayonnaise., Add egg yolks, one at a time; beat until fluffy., Stir into vegetable mixture., Beat egg whites until stiff and fold in., Pour into greased 1/2-quart casserole., Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until knife inserted in center comes out clean., Makes 6 servings.

title: Bacon-Wrapped Mushroom Caps
directions: Cut the bacon strips in half and wrap each strip around the perimeter of each mushroom cap to create a small cuff., Fasten the back with a toothpick., Broil mushrooms 5 minutes or until the back becomes slightly crisp, drain., Mix the cheese with onion and bread crumbs., Place a small mound of mixture inside each mushroom cap within the bacon cuff., Broil 3 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Eye Of Round Roast
directions: Marinate night before., Bring to room temperature., Preheat oven to 500° and cook 6 minutes per pound., Turn oven off and leave for 2 hours without opening door.

title: Large Cheesecake
directions: Crush graham crackers and mix well with melted butter., Mix eggs, sugar, vanilla and cream cheese. Beat well., Put crackers in spring-form pan and pour in cheese mixture., Bake at 375° for 30 to 35 minutes. Remove from oven and cool 10 minutes., Increase oven to 475°.

title: Fruit Salad
directions: Put fruit in large bowl with fruit cocktail juice., Pour pudding over fruit and mix.

title: Deep Fried Pickles
directions: In a large bowl, combine 2 eggs, 1/4 c. of the flour, buttermilk, Worcestershire sauce, hot sauce, cayenne pepper, seasoning salt and garlic powder., In a separate mixing bowl, combine cornmeal, 2 c. flour, salt and 3/4 tsp. black pepper. Preheat oil in a deep fryer or pot to 365°., Dip drained pickles into milk mixture and then dredge them in the flour mixture., Deep fry until golden brown., Makes 4 servings.

title: Cranberry Salad
directions: Bring cranberries and water to a boil., Simmer on low heat for 10 minutes., Allow to cool. add sugar and jello., Mix well. Add the apple, pineapple and nuts,, mix well. Pour into mold and refrigerate until set or overnight.

title: Spicy Cole Slaw
directions: Combine first 4 ingredients in small pan and bring to a boil; reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes., Cool., Pour the cooled mixture over the prepared vegetables and toss lightly., Cover and chill several hours or overnight to blend flavors., Makes 10 to 12 servings.

title: Sweet Potato Biscuits
directions: Sift flour, salt, soda and sugar together. Cut in shortening. Add sweet potatoes. Stir in buttermilk. May need more to make stiff dough. Turn onto floured board and knead lightly. Roll out and cut into biscuits. Bake at 450° until golden brown.

title: Twister Pie
directions: Combine Tropicana Twister, Cool Whip and condensed milk., Beat thoroughly., Pour into pie crust and chill., Serves 6.

title: Mexican Wedding Cookies
directions: Mix together, press and roll into small balls., Then flatten. Bake at 350° until lightly brown., Let cool slightly., Cover in sugar and cinnamon.

title: Sand Tarts
directions: Add enough flour to the ingredients to make a moderately stiff dough., Make into a long roll., Wrap in waxed paper and chill overnight in refrigerator., Cut off small portions and roll thin. After cutting, brush each cookie with unbeaten egg white., Sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon., Trim with candy or nuts., For other holidays, trim with colored sugar, sprinkles, etc., They keep well.

title: Cheese Wafers
directions: Finely grate cheese., Mix with oleo, flour and pepper., Place small balls (about size of a quarter) on ungreased cookie sheet. Pat flat with back of fork., Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes. Remove from pan while still hot.

title: Spaghetti Pie
directions: Butter 10-inch pie plate., In a saucepan melt 3 tablespoons of butter; add onion and green pepper., Saute until tender., Stir in meat; brown., Drain excess fat., Stir in spaghetti sauce., Add 2 tablespoons butter to cooked spaghetti.

title: Coconut Shortbread
directions: Cream the sugar and butter together, then stir in remaining ingredients., Wrap in waxed paper and chill., to bake, slice in 1/4 inch slices and put on cookie sheet., Bake at 300° for 15-20 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
directions: Thoroughly cream butters, sugars, egg and vanilla., Sift together dry ingredients; add to creamed mixture., Shape into 1-inch balls., Roll in granulated sugar., Place about 2-inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet., Crisscross with fork tines. Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes., Cool slightly.

title: Applesauce Jello
directions: Melt red hots and sugar into the water., Add jello and applesauce., Pour into mold., Chill several hours.

title: Clam Chowder
directions: Combine first 4 ingredients. Season to taste with lemon juice. Simmer until shrimp are tender.

title: Fruit Salad Dressing
directions: In a double boiler, mix sugar, cornstarch and salt., Add lemon juice, orange juice and pineapple juice., Cook over warm water for 20 minutes, stirring constantly., Beat eggs and slowly add to cooked mixture., (It is best to add a little cooked mixture to the eggs and blend well, then return to double boiler.), Cook, stirring, 5 minutes more., Cool and blend with cream cheese.

title: Dad'S Favorite Cheese Ball
directions: Soften the cream cheese., Mix in Worcestershire sauce, garlic powder and Accent to taste., Chop green tops of onions and dried beef., Reserve about 1/3 of the chopped dried beef., Add remaining beef and about an equal portion of green onion tops to cream cheese mixture., Shape mixture into a ball, then roll in reserved beef., Serve with crackers (Sociables, Dad's favorite) or vegetables.

title: Chocolate Cookies
directions: Heat chocolate chips, condensed milk and margarine until melted, then add flour, vanilla and salt., Mix thoroughly., Drop by teaspoon on greased cookie sheet., Bake at 350° for 7 minutes.

title: Salmon Loaf
directions: Flake salmon; add beaten eggs., Add remaining ingredients; mix and put into greased loaf pan., Bake in moderate oven at 350° for 40 minutes., Serves 4.

title: Peanut Butter Surprise Cake
directions: Coarsely chop the peanut butter cups into random pieces; spread in a metal pan and freeze solid. Heat oven to 350°. Grease and flour a 9, x 13-inch pan.

title: Overnight Tuna Casserole(Microwave)
directions: Whisk soup and milk in, a 2-quart microwave-safe bowl until well blended., Stir in remaining ingredients except 1/4 cup cheese., Cover and refrigerate at least 12 hours or overnight. Cover with lid or vented plastic wrap., Microwave on High 15 to 17 minutes, until bubbly., Sprinkle with reserved cheese., Let stand uncovered 5 to 7 minutes until cheese melts.

title: Orange Roughy De Jonghe
directions: Preheat oven to 400°., Place fillets in a shallow, buttered baking dish (about 7 x 10-inch)., Pour sherry over fillets. Combine mayonnaise, garlic, parsley and bread crumbs., Spread evenly over fillets., Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese., Bake for 15 to 20 minutes or until fork-tender.

title: Hamburger Casserole
directions: Brown	hamburger, and	onions	in, frying, pan., Drain grease., Salt and pepper hamburger., Place Tater Tots over the bottom of the casserole dish., Put hamburger over top of Tater Tots., Place, remaining Tater Tots over top., Spoon soups over the top of, the Tater Tots., Bake in oven for 30 to 45 minutes on 325°.

title: Dirt Pudding
directions: Mix first four ingredients together., Mix pudding and milk, then add to first mixture., Crush package of Oreos, centers included; half goes on bottom, half goes on top., Chill at least 24 hours before serving.

title: Gumbo Style Okra
directions: Saut chopped onion in melted butter until onions are clear. Stir in remaining ingredients and cook over low heat until okra is tender., Season with salt and pepper to suit your taste.

title: Cherry Cream Cheese Pie
directions: Combine softened cream cheese and condensed milk in mixing bowl., Mix thoroughly., Add lemon juice and vanilla; mix., Pour into pie crust., Chill for 1 hour., Pour on pie filling and chill before serving.

title: Coconut Cake
directions: Bake cake as directed 13 x 9-inch pan., Pierce cake with fork while hot and pour Eagle Brand over cake., Set., Pour Coco Lopez and let set again., Cool., Put on Cool Whip; sprinkle with coconut., Serve cold.

title: Veggie Mix
directions: Mix sugar, oil, vinegar, salt, pepper and water together and boil until sugar has melted; let cool to warm stage.

title: Frozen Lemon Squares
directions: Combine margarine, crumbs and sugar; press onto 8-inch square pan., In bowl beat egg yolks., Stir in condensed milk and lemon juice., Add yellow food coloring if desired., Pour into crust. Top with whipped cream or topping and freeze., Keep cool.

title: Bruschetta
directions: Mix first 4 ingredients in a small bowl., Let stand so tomatoes release their juices., Brush both sides of bread with olive oil., Broil 4 to 5 inches from heat source on both sides until lightly browned., Place bread on serving plates and spoon topping over slices., Serve immediately.

title: Small Party Meatballs
directions: Combine, all, ingredients., When thoroughly mixed shape into small, balls., I, use, a, teaspoon, to get uniform size. Place, in baking dish and bake 1 1/2 hours at 350°., Serve in barbecue sauce or sweet and sour sauce.

title: Shrimp Creole
directions: Heat oil., Saute next 4 ingredients until tender., Add tomatoes and brown., Stir in paprika, cayenne, salt and water. Add a bay leaf and simmer for 15 minutes., Add shrimp and continue simmering for 10 to 12 minutes., Thicken sauce with cornstarch mixed with a little cold water., Serve with rice., Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Yummy Breakfast Roll
directions: Place 1 can of rolls in bottom of a 9 x 13 pan. Mix 1 cup sugar, cream cheese and vanilla together. Spread over rolls. Spread 2nd can of rolls over cream cheese. Melt butter; mix with 1/4 cup sugar and cinnamon. Pour over rolls. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until brown.

title: Tortillas (Flour)
directions: Sift, flour, and salt together and work shortening into it with hands and fingertips, then add water until dough forms into firm ball., Knead well and form into small balls the size of golf balls., Let, stand for about 15 minutes and then roll into thin pancake, size of 7 to 8 inches., Cook on moderately hot griddle or skillet (ungreased) for 2 minutes on one side; turn over, and cook, 1 minute on the other side., Serve while hot., (These, can be, placed, in foil and reheated in oven at 350°, for approximately 10 minutes.) Serve with butter spread on them or fill with cooked refried beans, cheese, etc.

title: Spinach Balls
directions: Cook spinach; drain, squeezing out liquid., Add remaining liquids; mix well., Chill 2 hours or more in refrigerator, then roll into 1-inch balls., Place on cookie sheet (can line sheet with heavy Reynolds Wrap for easy cleaning)., Bake at 300° for 20 minutes, shaking the pan for even cooking.

title: Sugar 'N Spice Cookies
directions: Cream shortening, sugar and egg., Mix in molasses., Mix in spices., Add flour and mix well., Form into balls and roll in granulated sugar., Bake 10 to 12 minutes at 375°.

title: Corn-Crisped Pork Chops
directions: Combine corn flake crumbs, Accent, salt and pepper., Dip chops in evaporated milk, then roll them in crumb mixture., Place in shallow baking pan, greased and lined with aluminum foil., Bake at 350° about 45 minutes or until meat is tender when pierced with a fork.

title: Bread Dressing
directions: Saute onion, celery and seasonings in margarine., Add broth. Add broth to bread crumbs until moistened., Bake at 425° for 1 hour.

title: Banana Split Cake
directions: Add 1 stick of the butter, melted, to the crushed graham crackers to form a thin layer crust.

title: Mock Lasagna
directions: In a baking pan spread 1 can ravioli., In small bowl combine egg, cottage cheese, Parmesan cheese and parsley., Spoon over ravioli., Top with half the cheese slices., Spoon remaining ravioli over cheese layer., Bake uncovered in a 375° oven for 25 minutes., Top with remaining cheese slices., Bake until cheese melts., Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

title: Tuna Puffs
directions: Early in the day:, Combine eggs, crumbs, salt, mustard, onions, milk and tuna., Pour into 6 individual casseroles or 8 custard cups., Refrigerate.

title: Beet Pickles
directions: Cut tops off beets; cook until tender., Peel and cut beets in size wanted., Boil vinegar and sugar together., Add cooked beets; bring to boil., Pack in hot jars; finish filling jar with syrup. Seal; put jars in a 250° oven for 10 minutes.

title: Starlight Mint Surprise Cookies
directions: Cream together the margarine, sugar and brown sugar., Add eggs, water and vanilla., Beat well and add flour, salt and baking soda., Chill dough., To 1 tablespoon of dough enclose a chocolate star and roll into a ball., Bake on a greased cookie sheet at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes., Yield: 4 1/2 dozen.

title: French Dressing
directions: Use equal amounts., Combine and mix well.

title: Jello Ice Cream
directions: Combine and mix jello, sugar and hot water; add gelatin and ice cream., Pour into 8 x 8-inch pan and refrigerate., It layers by itself., Cut into desired pieces and serve.

title: Civil War Pound Cake
directions: Dissolve soda (the size of a pea) in 1 tablespoon of cold water., Beat eggs separately and very well., Mix whites last., Fold in carefully., Bake about one hour or until tested with a straw that comes out clean.

title: German Red Cabbage
directions: Remove cabbage core; shred cabbage., Add onion, sugar, salt, bay leaf and water., Bring to a boil, then simmer 20 minutes., Add vinegar and apple., Cook additional 3 or 4 minutes., Sprinkle with bacon bits.

title: Baked Chicken Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Pour into lightly greased baking dish., Bake at 400° until bubbly, usually about 20 minutes.

title: Mushroom Casserole
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Saute onion in butter; drain mushrooms, reserving 3/4 cup of liquid., Combine eggs, cream, mushrooms and liquid, spices and saltines; add onion and cheese and mix well. Pour into a greased 1 1/2-quart casserole., Bake covered for 30 minutes., Remove cover and continue baking for 30 minutes more.

title: Ugly Dip
directions: Fry sausage, then drain well., Put both packages of cream cheese and 1 jar of salsa in microwave for about 7 to 10 minutes or until cream cheese begins to melt.	Mix sausage with cream cheese mixture., Can be served warm or cold with salsa, chips or toast.

title: Whole Wheat Sandwiches With Olive Filling
directions: Chop almonds until fine; combine with other ingredients., Trim crust from bread., Spread one slice with filling., Top with another slice of bread; cut into finger sandwiches., Yields 32 sandwiches.

title: Instant Rice Pudding
directions: Combine rice, 2 cups milk, salt, cinnamon, sugar, nutmeg and raisins., Bring to a rolling boil, stirring constantly., Reduce heat; boil slowly for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally., Mix eggs with remaining milk., Slowly add to hot mixture, stirring constantly., Cook over medium heat until thickened., Add vanilla. Let cool., Makes 6 servings.

title: Classic Green Bean Casserole
directions: In 9 x 13-inch baking dish, combine soup, milk, soy sauce and pepper., Stir in green beans and half the onions., Bake at 350° for 25 minutes or until hot., Stir., Top with remaining onions. Bake 5 more minutes., Makes 10 servings.

title: German Style Pork Chops
directions: Mix flour, salt, pepper and bread pork chops, then saute in skillet with butter to slightly brown both sides (1 to 2 minutes). In large pot, add water, soup mix, onion and beer., Bring to simmer., Then add breaded pork chops., Simmer on low for 45 minutes to 1 hour., Thicken with flour or cornstarch and serve over rice or noodles.

title: Grannie'S Peanut Butter Cookies
