directions: Melt butter., Beat together with sugars, vanilla, peanut butter and eggs., In a separate bowl, combine the flour, bran, oats and baking soda., Stir mixture into butter mixture., Drop by teaspoons onto ungreased cookie sheet., Bake at 350° for 15 to 18 minutes., Cool.

title: Diabetic Snow Pudding
directions: Soak gelatin in cold water. Combine lemon juice, rind and boiling water. Bring to boiling point and remove from heat. Add softened gelatin and artificial sweetener. Mix until well dissolved. Chill until consistency of unbeaten egg whites. Add unbeaten egg whites and extracts. Beat until fluffy and holds shape. Chill until firm

title: Chocolate Chip Muffins
directions: Sift together flour, brown sugar, baking powder and salt. Add chocolate chips and nuts; toss to coat. Mix egg and oil mixture into dry mix, stirring lightly and quickly, just to mix. Grease bottoms only of muffin tin or use paper baking cups. Fill each cup 2/3 full. Bake at 425° for 20 minutes, until light brown.

title: Company Chicken
directions: Melt margarine., With knife, spread sour cream on chicken pieces and roll in crumbs; gently roll chicken in melted margarine (I melt it in a 13 x 9-inch pan) and place in same., Bake at 350° for 1 hour to 1 hour and 25 minutes.

title: Chicken Tinola(Chicken Papaya)
directions: In saucepan, cook chicken with salt, bagoong or patis and ginger for 20 minutes or until fat collects at bottom of pan. Stir occasionally., Add water, cover and cook for about 2 1/2 hours or until chicken is tender., Add papaya cubes and cook for another 10 to 15 minutes., Serves 6.

title: Chicken Tostada Salad
directions: In small jar, mix vinegar, honey, cumin, salt and pepper. Shake well., Slice chicken into 1/2-inch strips and toss with garlic salt., Cook and drain corn., Add to chicken., Stir, cover and chill 1/2 hour., Add tomatoes, beans, onions and lettuce. Toss., Pour dressing over salad and toss., At serving time, add cheese and Tostitos and toss gently., Garnish with salsa and sour cream.

title: Taco Salad
directions: Brown ground beef and drain., Add taco seasoning mix according to instructions., Let cool., In a large bowl, mix meat, cheese, onion and tomatoes., Right before you serve it, add lettuce and crunched Doritos., Pour dressing over and mix.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Blend first 4 ingredients., Stir in chicken and vegetables. Spread into casserole dish., Sprinkle with cheese., Mix cornflakes, butter and parsley together, then spread it over casserole mixture., Bake at 350° for about 45 minutes.

title: Sensational Fish
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Place fish in nonstick baking pan; divide remaining ingredients equally on top of each fillet., Bake until fish flakes easily when tested with fork, about 15 minutes. Makes 2 servings.

title: Pineapple Casserole
directions: Put pineapple in flat dish., Mix flour, sugar and cheese and spread over pineapple., Sprinkle crackers over this, then pour melted margarine over all., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Pork Chops And Stuffing
directions: Brown chops in oil., Place in 12 x 8 x 2-inch glass baking dish., Lightly mix bread cubes, onion, butter, 1/4 cup water and poultry seasoning., Place a mound of stuffing on each chop., Blend soup and 1/3 cup water., Pour over stuffing and chops., Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until tender., Yields 4 servings.

title: Preacher'S Coming
directions: Put crushed wafers in ungreased 9 x 13 pan. Melt chocolate in 2/3 cup oleo. Stir in yogurt and 2 beaten egg yolks. Add nuts and vanilla. Fold in egg whites that have been stiffly beaten. Pour over crumbs and chill until firm. Top with 1/2 gallon vanilla ice cream that has been softened. Sprinkle with 1/3 cup nuts. Drizzle with Chocolate Fudge Sauce (follows). Cover and freeze. Cut into squares and serve.

title: Chocolate Brownie Pies
directions: Melt chips with butter, then add other ingredients., Mix well. Pour into 2 unbaked pie shells., Cook in oven at 375° for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Jello Cake
directions: Mix the cake mix, jello, vanilla, water, oil and eggs well. Pour mixture into a 10-inch tube pan that has been lined with wax paper., Bake at 350° for 50 to 55 minutes., Cool 15 minutes in the pan., Mix together the powdered sugar and lemon juice. Drizzle over the cake while it is still warm.

title: None Such Prize Cookies(Makes 48 Cookies, 3-Inches In Diameter)
directions: Sift together flour, salt and baking soda. Cream shortening; add sugar gradually., Cream smooth., Add mincemeat, broken into small pieces., Add flour and mix well., Drop by teaspoonfuls, 2-inches apart, on greased baking sheet., Bake at 400° for about 12 minutes.

title: Orange Mushroom Salad
directions: Toss lettuce, orange slices, mushrooms and onions with dressing until well coated., Serve on lettuce leaves., Top with raisins, if desired.

title: Chocolate Pudding Cake
directions: Cook pudding as directed., After coming to a boil, pour cake mix in pudding pan and stir., Batter will be a little lumpy., Pour in greased pan., Sprinkle chips and nuts on top., Bake for 20 to 25 minutes at 350°.

title: Sweet Potato Pie
directions: Beat eggs slightly and add sugar, salt and spices. Add butter to pulp and add pulp to liquid. Add milk and beat. Pour into pastry-lined pie plate and bake at 450° for 10 minutes. Reduce heat to 300° and bake for 30 to 40 minutes, until filling is firm.

title: Tomato Bisque And Macaroni
directions: Cook macaroni; drain., Add large can of tomatoes., Heat until real hot (not boiling)., Add 1/2 teaspoon of baking soda., Stir well., Add milk until desired amount, about 1 quart., Salt to taste.

title: Cheese Ball
directions: Mix together; shape into ball or log., Roll in chopped walnuts.

title: Pumpkin Cake Roll
directions: Beat eggs on high speed for 5 minutes., Gradually beat in granulated sugar., Stir in pumpkin and lemon juice., Stir dry ingredients together and fold into pumpkin mixture., Spread on greased and floured 10 x, 15 x 1-inch cookie sheet., Top with chopped nuts., Bake at 375° for 20 minutes or until done when tested., Turn out on dish towel sprinkled with powdered sugar. Roll towel and cake together., Cool., Unroll.

title: Cottage Cheese Dessert(Or Salad)
directions: Mix together well. Refrigerate. Will be ready to serve within an hour.

title: Strawberry Salad
directions: Combine jello, water, pineapple and berries., When it begins to thicken, add bananas., When it begins to get firm, combine the cream cheese, Cool Whip or sour cream and sugar., Pour into large container half of jello mixture., Add the cream cheese mixture, then the rest of the jello., Spread the cream cheese with a spatula.

title: Corn Pudding
directions: Sprinkle flour in eggs and beat thoroughly., Beat milk in with flour mixture., Beat everything together and pour into a greased casserole dish., Bake at 350° for 1 hour., Corn pudding should be kind of firm; test with knife., Should be like a custard.

title: Italian "Hot Bath"
directions: Heat oil and butter in microwave on Full power for 3 minutes. Mix garlic and anchovy into a paste., Add to oil and butter mixture and microwave on Full power for 3 minutes.

title: Ronald Reagan'S Favorite Macaroni And Cheese
directions: Boil macaroni in water until tender and drain thoroughly. Stir in beaten egg., Mix mustard and salt with 1 tablespoon hot water and add to milk., Add cheese, leaving enough to sprinkle on top., Pour into buttered casserole., Add milk; sprinkle with cheese., Bake at 350° for about 45 minutes or until custard is set and top is crusty.

title: Crustless Coconut Pie
directions: Beat eggs., Add sugar, flour, milk, coconut, butter and vanilla., Pour into large greased dish., Bake 30 to 40 minutes at 375° (glass dish 350°).

title: Lite Crab Dip
directions: Combine yogurt, mayonnaise, cream cheese and seasonings., Mix well. Then stir in cheese and crab., Cover and chill for 2 hours. Sprinkle with paprika. Serve with crackers.

title: Chocolate Kahlua Cake
directions: Combine cake mix, pudding mix, sour cream, eggs, oil and Kahlua., Mix until well blended., Stir in chocolate chips., Pour into well greased Bundt or other pans., Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until tests done.

title: English Teaballs
directions: Cream butter and confectioners sugar., Add dry ingredients. Work with hands to mix., Add nuts., Chill., form into balls. Place on lightly greased pan and bake at 400° for 10 minutes. While warm, roll in confectioners sugar., When cold, roll again in confectioners sugar., Yields 50 cookies.

title: Season'S Greeting Punch
directions: Combine all ingredients, chill and serve.

title: Baked Ratatouille
directions: Layer all ingredients in 6-quart casserole, pressing down to make firm., Drizzle olive oil over top layer., Cover and bake in 350° oven for 3 hours with some of the liquids., Uncover during last hour if soupy., Mix gently and salt to taste., Garnish with parsley and tomato slices.

title: Ham And Swiss Pinwheels
directions: Sprinkle flour over work surface., Turn dough out onto floured surface and roll into a 12-inch square., Combine mustard and honey in small bowl and brush over dough., Sprinkle evenly with cheese. Top with ham slices., Roll up jelly roll fashion, pinching seam to seal (don't seal ends)., Cut roll into 16 slices., Place slices, cut side down, on a baking sheet coated with cooking spray., Cover and let rise in a warm place (85°) for 45 minutes., Bake at 350° for 15 to 18 minutes, or until golden., Serve immediately., Yields 16.

title: Sparkling Pink Punch
directions: Mix together lemonade, orange juice and water; chill., Add ginger ale just before serving., Garnish with orange slices. Serves 25 to 30.

title: Catfish Creole
directions: Melt butter in wide frying pan over medium heat. Add onion, celery, green pepper and garlic. Cook until soft, about 7 minutes. Add tomatoes and their liquid (break up tomatoes with a spoon), lemon slices, Worcestershire sauce, paprika, bay leaf, salt, thyme and liquid hot sauce., Cook, stirring occasionally, for about 15 minutes or until sauce is slightly thickened., Press fish pieces down into sauce., Cover pan and simmer until fish flakes. Serve over hot cooked rice.

title: Dill Pickles
directions: Wash cucumbers thoroughly; cut in half lengthwise., Combine salt, vinegar and water., Heat to boiling., Pack cucumbers into clean, hot jars., Add 2 tablespoons dill seed and 3 peppercorns to each jar., Fill with boiling pickling syrup to within 1/2-inch from top of jar., Immediately seal and process in boiling water 10 minutes.

title: Swinging Salad
directions: Dissolve jello in boiling water., Add cream cheese and beat until cheese melts., Fold in prepared Dream Whip, nuts, marshmallows and salad dressing., Pour in large mold and chill until firm.

title: Raisin Squares
directions: Cook raisins in 1 cup of water. Set aside., Mix dry ingredients and add egg and margarine., Fold in raisins and water into this mixture., Bake at 350 degrees for 25 minutes or until done., Sprinkle powdered sugar on top.

title: Seafoam Frosting
directions: Mix well with spoon, then put in double boiler and beat until it holds peaks.

title: Chicken-Rice Casserole
directions: Mix rice, soups and water in bottom of 2-quart casserole., Dip chicken breasts in melted margarine, then lay on top of the rice. Bake at 350° for about 1 hour covered., Uncover and bake 15 more minutes or until chicken is brown., Sprinkle with paprika before baking to help chicken brown.

title: Meat Loaf
directions: Mix all ingredients together in order., Bake 1 1/2 hours. Bake at 350°.

title: Fruit Punch
directions: In a punch bowl, combine pineapple and apple juices., Puree undrained strawberries in blender; stir pureed strawberries into pineapple juice mix., Pour in ginger ale., Garnish with strawberry slices, lime slices and fresh mint.

title: Frozen Chocolate Dessert
directions: Combine first 3 ingredients in top of double boiler; bring water to a boil., Reduce heat to low; cook until chocolate and marshmallows are melted., Remove and set aside to cool., Combine butter and coconut in a saucepan over medium heat., Cook, stirring often, until coconut is lightly browned., Remove from heat and stir in graham cracker crumbs., Press 3/4 of crumb mixture into a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan., Cut ice cream crosswise into 1/2-inch thick slices., Arrange half of slices over crust. Pour 1/2 of chocolate mixture over ice cream; then repeat layers., Combine remaining mixture and pecans over top., Cover and freeze until firm., Yields 15 servings.

title: Congo Squares
directions: Cream together margarine and brown sugar., Add eggs and mix well., Sift together and add flour, baking powder and salt., Add chocolate chips, vanilla and nuts., Spread on greased cookie sheet and bake about 20 minutes at 375°., Cut into squares when cool.

title: Spaghetti With Zucchini Sauce*
directions: Wash, but do not peel zucchini., Trim ends and slice lengthwise into quarters and then into 1/2-inch slices., Heat oil and 2 tablespoons margarine., Add garlic and zucchini., Cook until zucchini is golden brown; drain on paper towels., Discard garlic. Season zucchini with salt and pepper., Boil spaghetti and drain. Place in warmed serving bowl with remaining 2 tablespoons margarine, Ricotta cheese and generous amount of grated cheese. Salt and pepper to taste., Toss well and serve with zucchini slices on top.

title: Elephant Stew
directions: Cut elephant in bite size pieces., This should take about 2 months., Add enough brown gravy to cover., Cook at 475° for 4 weeks., This will serve 3800 people., If more are expected, add the two rabbits., Only do this if needed, as most people don't like hare in their stew.

title: Pepperoni Bread
directions: Thaw frozen bread dough in refrigerator overnight., Roll or pat thawed bread into a rectangle., Slightly beat egg; spread some on dough layer., Add pepperoni on top of egg., Sprinkle with cheese., Roll up like jelly roll style., Connect ends or seal ends., Brush with remaining egg., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Good served warm or cold., Snack or meal.

title: Creamy Lemon Meringue Pie
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., In medium bowl, beat egg yolks; stir in sweetened condensed milk, lemon juice and pulp., Pour into crust.

title: Hamburger Soup
directions: Cook ground beef and onions together, browning the meat a little., Add vegetables and water., Bring to a boil and sprinkle the rice over and bring to rolling boil; cover and let simmer for 1 hour., Should be cooked in a 6-quart kettle., Will serve 6 to 8 people., Can be served with shredded cheese on top., This is a good-for-you, low-fat meal.

title: Carameled Nuts
directions: Combine sugar, salt, cinnamon and milk., Cook, stirring constantly, until a soft ball forms when in cold water., Remove from heat and add vanilla and 2 to 3 cups English walnuts or pecans., Spread out and cool.

title: Sharon'S Toffee
directions: Soft boil until golden brown., (Can add nuts and pecans.) Use heavy pan.

title: Pretzel Salad
directions: Mix first 3 ingredients together and pat into a 9 x 13 pan. Bake at 400° 5 to 7 minutes. Cool 1 hour.

title: Seven Up Salad
directions: Combine jello with hot water., Add cream cheese and beat with beater until fairly smooth., Add rest of ingredients and beat. Chill until solid.

title: George Washington'S Cherry Tree Cake(Make This In Honor Of His Birthday Or Someone Else'S!)
directions: Cream sugar and oil; add eggs and vanilla., Sift flour, baking soda and cinnamon and add to first mixture., Stir in pie filling and chocolate chips., Pour in two greased and floured cake pans or a 13 x 9-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes., You can frost if you like., A rich and moist cake.

title: Three Cheese And Chicken Bake
directions: Saute the green pepper and onion in butter. Stir in soup, milk, mushrooms, pimento and basil., Place half the noodles in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Cover with 1/2 each mushroom sauce, cottage cheese, chicken and cheeses., Repeat., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes., Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
directions: Mix first 6 ingredients. Add the remaining ingredients and mix well. Cover and refrigerate for 3 hours., Heat oven to 375°. Shape dough into 1 1/4-inch balls., Place about 3-inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet., Flatten with fork dipped in flour., Bake 9 to 10 minutes or until golden brown., Cool 2 minutes. Remove from cookie sheet. Makes about 3 dozen. Contains 80 calories per cookie.

title: Spiced Pecan Halves
directions: Beat, egg white and cold water until frothy., Add pecan halves and, stir to coat evenly., Mix sugar, salt and cinnamon in a large bowl., Add coated nuts and stir to coat thoroughly with sugar, mixture., Place on buttered cookie sheet and bake at 225° for 1 hour., Stir every 15 minutes.

title: Beef Cabbage Soup
directions: Brown ground beef in 1 tablespoon oil., Add cabbage, celery and onion in skillet., Transfer to 5-quart stock pot., Add remaining ingredients, plus 1 cup water, if needed., Stir and simmer for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Fruit Soup
directions: Soak the dried fruits in the fruit juice for 2 hours or longer; add 2 teaspoons honey., Bring mixture to a boil; add cornstarch and stir until mixture begins to thicken., Add cinnamon; chill or serve warm.

title: Hot Rib Sauce
directions: If, you use pork or have much grease, from cooked meat, use a tablespoon of lemon juice also.

title: Mottogany Wings
directions: Bake wings at 350° for 20 minutes., Drain any liquid from pan. Combine soy sauce and brown sugar., Pour over drained wings. Continue baking for 35 to 40 minutes, until wings are glazed. Serve hot by keeping in a crock-pot or warmer.

title: Scallop Casserole
directions: Melt 1 stick of butter in a skillet., Add scallops and spices; cook over low heat 8 to 10 minutes., Blend in the flour; add warmed cream., Cook 2 to 3 minutes or until it comes to a boil., Remove and pour into a 2-quart casserole dish., Melt remaining butter in small saucepan; add crumbled crackers and stir., Sprinkle cracker mixture over the top of casserole., Bake, covered, at 425° for 10 minutes., Uncover; bake an additional 5 minutes., Let cool for a few minutes before serving.

title: Honey Lemon Chicken
directions: Combine first five ingredients in shallow baking dish., Stir until well blended., Place chicken in marinade., Turn to coat. Refrigerate 30 minutes., Turn once., Heat broiler or prepare grill 3 to 5 minutes per side., Makes 6 servings.

title: Baptist Chicken
directions: Boil chicken until tender (leave skin on)., Debone and set aside., Butter baking dish., Prepare Stove Top as directed on package., Layer in bottom of pan., Put chicken on top of stuffing. Mix cream of chicken soup with chicken broth., Pour over layers. Bake, covered, for 20 minutes at 350°., Serve hot.

title: Floreeta'S Angel Biscuits
directions: Dissolve yeast in 1/3 cup lukewarm water., Mix dry ingredients., Cut into shortening., Add buttermilk and yeast to dry ingredients (batter will not be stiff)., Let stand at room temperature about 20 minutes., At this point, batter may be refrigerated for several days.

title: Neiman-Marcus Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., Cream butter., Add sugars and cream. Add eggs and vinegar; mix well., In separate bowl, combine flour, oats, salt, baking powder and baking soda., Add a little at a time to creamed mixture until well blended., Add chocolate chips, candy bar and nuts., Roll into balls.

title: Layered Taco Dip
directions: Use large flat serving dish. Spread bean dip on dish. Mash together avocados with lemon juice and spread on beans. Mix together sour cream, mayonnaise and seasoning. Spread on avocado layer. Top with chopped vegetables and cover with cheese. Serve with corn chips.

title: Baked Shoestring Potatoes
directions: Cut a 24-inch length of heavy-duty aluminum foil. Cut potatoes in thin lengthwise strips as for French fries and place just off center on foil. Dot with butter. Sprinkle with salt, pepper, cheese and parsley., Pull edges of foil upward, then pour cream over the potatoes., Fold foil., Place on shallow pan and bake in very hot oven at 450° about 45 minutes to 1 hour or until done. Fold back edges of foil and sprinkle potatoes with extra chopped parsley, if desired., Makes 4 servings.

title: No Bake Cookies
directions: Mix sugar, cocoa, butter and milk in a pan on stove., Let come to a boil and let boil for 1 1/2 to 2 minutes, then put in vanilla flavoring., Add peanut butter and then you add your oatmeal, a little at a time., Mix well., Drop by spoonfuls on waxed paper. Cool and enjoy!!

title: Lemon Tarts
directions: Mix all the ingredients (except pie shells and coconut), adding lemon juice last., Bake pie shells; cool., Put in cooled pie shells and sprinkle with coconut.

title: Chicken A La King
directions: Heat butter until hot; add onion and mushrooms., Saute until light brown., Sprinkle flour over onions and mushrooms; stir quickly., Add milk gradually; stir constantly and bring to boil. Reduce heat; let simmer until mixture thickens., Stir in remaining ingredients and cook until thoroughly heated., Serve on toast.

title: Broccoli Soup
directions: Place vegetables and broth in saucepan., Bring to boil, reduce heat, cover and cook until vegetables are tender, about 8 minutes. Mix milk, cornstarch, salt, pepper and thyme; add to cooked vegetables., Cook, stirring constantly, until soup is slightly thick and mixture just begins to boil., Remove from heat., Add cheese and stir until melted., Makes 4 servings, 1 cup each.

title: Milky Way Cake
directions: Melt Milky Ways and add one stick margarine., Set aside. Cream one stick margarine with sugar., Add eggs one at a time. Add flour and buttermilk to which soda and vanilla have been added and chopped nuts., Bake in tube or oblong pan 1 hour at 300°.

title: Honey Wheat Bread
directions: Heat milk, butter, cottage cheese and honey until butter melts., Dissolve yeast in warm water., Mix whole wheat flour, sugar and salt., Beat the eggs and add to liquid ingredients., Add this to dry ingredients and mix well., Add enough white flour to form a ball (2 to 3 cups)., Knead 10 minutes. Let rise in a greased bowl., Punch down and divide in 2 or 3 parts., Cover and let rest for 10 minutes., Form into loaves and let rise., Bake at 375° for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Mexican Bean Dip
directions: Mix taco seasoning into refried beans., Spread into small casserole dish., Spoon sour cream on top of and sprinkle with cheese., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or microwave on High for 5 to 8 minutes.

title: Chocolate Cake
directions: Cream margarine, eggs, sugar and vanilla until fluffy. Add sour milk, flour and cocoa. Beat. Add hot water and soda. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Whole Wheat Pound Cake
directions: Cream butter and Crisco., Add sugar and cream together. Add eggs,, one, at, a time, and beat., In a separate bowl sift together whole wheat flour, all-purpose flour and salt; add to sugar, mixture., Add vanilla and milk., Mix well and pour into greased and, floured tube pan., Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 15 minutes or until toothpick inserted comes out clean.

title: Tandoori Chicken
directions: Skin chicken., Slash chicken flesh., Combine ingredients in bowl., Add chicken, turning to coat., Cover and refrigerate several hours or overnight, turning occasionally., Let chicken stand 1 hour at room temperature before cooking., Preheat oven to 450°., Arrange in shallow baking pan., Bake 15 minutes; turn and coat with marinade., Bake until chicken is fork-tender.

title: Tasty Tidbits
directions: Melt margarine., Add seasoning., Mix well., Add cereal, nuts and pretzels., Toss to mix., Bake 250° 1 hour. Stir often cool and store in airtight jars.

title: Peach Cobbler
directions: Melt oleo in pan., Mix 1 cup sugar, flour, baking powder and milk., Pour into pan on top of melted oleo., Add peaches on top of this., Add remaining sugar over this., Bake for 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Dill Dip
directions: Mix all ingredients together thoroughly., Chill overnight. Serve with fresh chilled vegetables.

title: Macaroni Salad
directions: Prepare macaroni as directed on the box., Drain and rinse with cold water., Mix remaining ingredients and toss together until the macaroni is well coated.

title: Hot Chocolate
directions: Mix all dry ingredients., Use 1/3 cup mix to 1 cup hot water. Makes 125 cups., Stores very well in a tight container.

title: Crazy Cake
directions: Add all ingredients in 8 x 8-inch square pan., Mix with fork. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Pineapple Raspberry Punch
directions: Pour pineapple juice and ginger ale over vanilla ice cream and raspberry sherbet until melted and blended., Makes 24 (4-ounce) servings.

title: Baked Apricot Casserole
directions: Butter a shallow casserole., Melt butter in saucepan., Add juice of 1 to 1 1/2 cans of apricot juice, flour and brown sugar. Stir until thickened., Arrange apricots in dish., Pour sauce over fruit., Crumble crackers on top., Bake at 350° until bubbly (approximately 25 to 30 minutes).

title: Fettucine With Ham And Peas
directions: Saute the garlic in 1 tablespoon oleo. Stir in ham and peas. Saute 3 to 5 minutes. Remove from heat, cover and keep warm., Cook the fettucine, omitting the salt. Drain well and place in a large serving bowl., Add 1/2 cup oleo., Stir until melted., Add cheese and sour cream. Stir gently., Fold in ham mixture and pepper. Toss gently. Serve immediately., Serves 6.

title: Fluffy Coconut Pudding
directions: Soften gelatin in cold water., Add boiling water and stir until dissolved., Cool to room temperature., Beat egg whites with salt until frothy., Add sugar, 1 tablespoon at a time, and beat well after each addition., Continue beating until mixture holds a peak when beater is lifted., Slowly beat gelatin., Add vanilla to whipped cream., Mix and fold into egg whites., Fold in coconut. Cover and chill at least 4 hours., Garnish with Mandarin oranges and serve.

title: Potato Soup
directions: In a pot, add potatoes and onion to boiling water., Cover; cook 15 to 20 minutes, until potatoes are tender., Blend in milks, butter and seasonings., Cook until heated.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
directions: Cream the 2 sugars, shortening, eggs and vanilla., Add flour and baking soda, salt and water., Mix well., Add chocolate chips. One cup of chopped nuts may be added, if desired., Drop by 1 round teaspoon onto an ungreased cookie sheet., Bake at 350° for 10 minutes., Serves 36.

title: Traveling Taco Dip
directions: Spread beans over bottom of 10-inch glass pie plate., Layer remaining ingredients in the order listed., Serve with tortilla chips., Makes 8 servings., Preparation time:, 10 minutes.

title: Raw Apple Cake
directions: Sift flour., Measure and add sugar, soda, salt and cinnamon. Sift again., Work the shortening into this mixture as for pastry. Stir in chopped nuts and raisins that have been dusted with flour. Add ground apples and stir only enough to blend ingredients together., Pour into a greased 4 x 8 x 3 1/2-inch loaf pan., Bake at 325° for 1 hour., Yield:, one loaf.

title: Sausage Pie
directions: Set oven to 375°., Mix all together and fill pie shell., Bake 1 1/4 hour.

title: Cream Puff Pastry
directions: Combine water and butter in saucepan., Bring to boil., Add flour and salt to butter mixture., Stir vigorously until mixture leaves sides of pan and forms a ball., Let cool 4 to 5 minutes. Add eggs one at a time, beating with wooden spoon after each addition., Spoon dough into mound on baking sheet and bake as directed., Cut tops off and pull out soft dough inside., Fill with cream filling.

title: Indulgence Chocolate Mousse
directions: Heat the milk and chocolate over low heat. Stir until melted. Remove from heat. Beat yolks and vanilla together, then add the chocolate mixture. Return to heat and stir until thick. Beat the egg whites to stiff peaks and fold gently into the chocolate mixture. Divide into cups and refrigerate until firm., This is only 129 calories per serving.

title: Pecan Pie
directions: Mix together and pour into unbaked 9-inch pie shell. Bake at 375° for 40 to 50 minutes.

title: Rolled Buttermilk Dumplings
directions: Sift flour with baking powder, soda and salt., Add buttermilk and mix lightly with a fork., Turn out on a floured board or pastry cloth., Knead lightly 4 or 5 times., Roll or pat out to 1/4-inch thick; cut into rectangles 1 x 3-inch with a floured knife., Drop into boiling stew., Cover and boil gently 10 to 12 minutes., Do not uncover while cooking.

title: Coolest Banana Pudding
directions: Mix pudding and milk in a large bowl. Stir in whipped topping, sour cream and mayonnaise., Layer 1/3 each of the wafers, pudding mixture, bananas and berries in serving bowl. Repeat layers twice. Refrigerate 2 hours or overnight., Makes 12 servings.

title: Homemade Coconut Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Melt butter and pour into ingredients., Bake at 350°.

title: Swedish Meatballs
directions: Mix all ingredients together thoroughly., Form into small balls and place on lightly greased baking sheet., Bake 20 to 25 minutes at 350°., Serve in brown gravy.

title: Best Ever Fudge
directions: Melt butter with the cheese., Sift together cocoa and powdered sugar and add to cheese mixture, then add vanilla and nuts to taste., Spread in a 9 x 13-inch pan., Cool and slice., Very creamy.

title: Vegetable Bars
directions: Spread rolls out and blend seams together in a large rectangle cake pan., Bake 10 minutes or less., (Check at 8 minutes according to package directions.), Blend cream cheese, mayonnaise and salad dressing together and spread on top of baked crust., Garnish with chopped fresh broccoli, cauliflower, tomato, peppers, onion (whatever you like, or is in season)., Sprinkle Cheddar cheese over this., Cut into bars., Will keep several days in refrigerator.

title: Ole Fashioned Beet Pickles
directions: Wash fresh beets and leave an inch of the top stems so the juice will not cook out so much., I sort the beets according to size and this eliminates overcooking of small beets., Save a few cups of the red water the beets were cooked in., Beets are tender when tested with a fork., Drain off the hot water and cover with cold water until cool enough to handle., Peel beets and cut off the stems., Leave small ones whole, but large beets still need to be quartered.

title: Candy Cane Cookies
directions: Heat oven to 375°., Mix thoroughly the first 6 ingredients. Blend in flour and salt., Divide dough in half; blend food coloring into 1/2., Shape 1 teaspoon dough from each 1/2 into 4-inch rope. Roll back and forth on lightly floured board., Place ropes, side by side., Press together lightly and twist., Place on ungreased baking sheet; curve top of cookie to form a cane., Bake about 9 minutes, until set and very light brown., Makes about 2 to 4 dozen cookies, depending on size of canes.

title: Gumdrop Cookies
directions: Cream margarine., Add sugars, eggs and vanilla., Beat well. Add dry ingredients and mix well., Drop onto ungreased cookie sheets., Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes., Enjoy!

title: Cherry Winks
directions: Sift flour, baking powder, salt and soda together; set aside. Cream butter and sugar in separate bowl., Add eggs to creamed mixture, one at a time., Add milk and flour mixture., Mix well. Fold in nuts, dates and cherries.

title: Caramel Pull-A-Parts
directions: In Bundt, pan, or angel food cake pan, sprinkle nuts on bottom., Place, frozen, dough, balls, side	by, side in single layer., Melt, margarine, or, butter;, mix in pudding and brown sugar., Cook, until, sugar	dissolves., Remove from heat; pour over dough	balls, evenly.	Cover with waxed paper and a towel overnight.	Next, morning,	bake, at, 350° for 35 minutes.	To keep rolls	from, burning on top or becoming too crusty, place foil on top, for the first 25 minutes, then remove and bake 10 minutes more., Turn out on platter while still hot and serve.

title: Gloria'S Lemon Squares
directions: Mix first 3 ingredients and press into 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Bake 20 minutes at 350°.

title: Confirmation Auction Cavatini
directions: Brown sausage in skillet. Cook noodles separately until tender. Drain noodles. Mix sausage, noodles and spaghetti sauce in a casserole dish. Sprinkle cheese on top and bake until melted.

title: White Christmas Candy
directions: Melt chocolate over medium-low heat, stirring until smooth. Remove from heat. Stir in peppermint crunch., Spread on parchment paper lined cookie sheets., Chill in refrigerator 8 to 10 minutes. Break into small pieces., Store in airtight containers., Makes 2 1/2 pounds of candy.

title: Onion Butter
directions: Blend Lipton onion soup mix thoroughly with softened butter. Makes about 1 1/4 cups. Store, covered, in refrigerator.

title: Mandarin Orange Salad
directions: Dissolve jello in boiling water., Add enough cold water to reserved liquid to make 1 3/4 cups., Add to jello; chill until slightly thickened., Add oranges., Pour into a 1 1/2-quart ring mold., Chill until firm.

title: Kahlua
directions: Mix sugar, water and instant coffee well., Simmer for one hour. Cool slightly., Add vodka and vanilla., Stir well., Pour into dark bottles and cap., Keep in cool dark place., Delicious., May use the same day made., Best when allowed to mellow for few weeks., Need 2 to 3 bottles.

title: Honey 'N Spice Barbecue Chicken
directions: Combine Heinz 57 sauce and honey., Place chicken pieces on broiler or grill; brush with melted butter., Broil or grill until chicken is tender, turning and basting frequently with sauce. Makes 4 to 5 servings.

title: Coconut Crunch
directions: Spray 13 x 9-inch baking sheet with Pam; set aside., Pour entire contents of Eagle Brand milk into a shallow dish., Cut slices of loaf bread in half and dip into Eagle Brand milk., Place on the baking sheet and sprinkle each slice with coconut., Place on lower rack and broil until coconut is lightly toasted., Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Oatmeal Cake
directions: Place in mixing bowl the water, oats and margarine., Cover and let stand 20 minutes., Add other ingredients., Mix well and bake in a pan at 350° for 35 minutes.

title: Sweet Onion Corn Bake
directions: In a large skillet, saute onions in butter until tender. In a small bowl, combine the sour cream, milk, dill and salt until blended. Stir in 1 cup of cheese. Stir into the onion mixture; remove from the heat and set aside.

title: Salmon Steaks With Herbed Lemon Butter
directions: Combine all ingredients but salmon, oil and lemon., On wax paper, shape mixture into 1 x 7-inch roll. Wrap and chill., Brush salmon with oil. Barbecue, grill or broil 4-inches from heat 4 to 6 minutes on each side or until fish flakes when tested with a fork., To serve, top salmon with 1 teaspoon each of the margarine and garnish with lemon wedges and parsley., Makes 4 to 6 servings. Equals:, 4 protein exchanges, 1/2 fat exchange plus herbed margarine (1 teaspoon = 1/2 fat).

title: Potato Casserole
directions: 1., Rub each beet with olive oil for added flavor.

title: Wanna'S Peanut Butter Fudge
directions: Combine sugar and milk; boil until soft ball stage., Remove from heat., Add peanut butter, vanilla and oleo., Beat until mixture begins to thicken., Pour into a buttered dish; cut when cooled., This is my secret recipe., It's yummy!

title: Corned Beef Dip
directions: Combine all ingredients well and refrigerate overnight before serving.

title: Football Stew
directions: Mix all ingredients and pour into casserole dish., Bake at 250° for about 6 hours., Yields 4 servings.

title: Quick Banana Pudding
directions: Mix first 3 ingredients until smooth and thickened., Fold in Cool Whip thoroughly., Layer wafers, bananas and pudding.

title: French Dressing
directions: Beat well to blend.

title: Broccoli Soup
directions: In a 3-quart saucepan, cook onion in butter until onion is tender., Stir in salt, flour and pepper., Add milk all at once; stir until thick and bubbly., Stir in broccoli and cheese; cook until cheese is melted., Cook broccoli until tender before adding to mixture.

title: Favas
directions: Saute onion in oil., Add water and 1/4 cup ketchup., Stir and simmer, then add more water if needed., Add pepper, parsley, nutmeg and cinnamon., Cook for 5 minutes., Add another 1/4 cup ketchup and favas with juice., Simmer about 5 more minutes. Enjoy!

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients and pour into baking dish. Set aside.

title: Chicken Enchiladas
directions: Mix the first 4 ingredients together and spoon into tortillas; roll up., Place in a 9 x 13-inch glass pan (use about half of mixture)., Spread remaining mixture over all tortillas., Sprinkle cheeses over top and bake at 350° until bubbly and cheeses melt.

title: Bachelor'S Roast
directions: Rub roast with salt, pepper and garlic salt., Sear roast on all sides in oil., Remove from pan; drain off excess fat and place in foil lined pan., Pour Coke and catsup over roast., Cover loosely with foil and bake 3 hours at 325°., This is good chopped up and mixed with sauce for barbecue sandwiches.

title: Baked Beans With Hamburger
directions: Saute onion and pepper in a little oil on low heat., Increase heat and add hamburger., Mix vinegar, catsup and Worcestershire sauce., After hamburger is browned, add this mixture and onion to it and boil., Add beans., Put in a casserole dish and bake 20 minutes at 300°.

title: Vegetable Pizza(Lo-Fat)
directions: Several hours ahead:, Combine softened cream cheese and mayonnaise in a medium-size bowl; stir until smooth., Add the dressing mix; blend well., Cover and refrigerate 4 hours or overnight.

title: Hearty Cheese Ball
directions: Mix with hand forming a ball., If it comes too soft, refrigerate 1 hour., Roll lightly in walnut mixture., Refrigerate 1 to 2 hours., Serve with Wheat Thins.

title: Funnel Cakes
directions: In a deep bowl, stir together flour, sugar, baking powder and salt., Mix eggs and milk together and pour into dry ingredients. Stir with a whisk until batter is smooth., Pour shortening into a heavy skillet to the depth of 1/2 to 2 inches., Heat until hot, but not smoking., Hold a funnel with a 1/2-inch opening in your hand and keep one finger over funnel end., Hold funnel over hot oil; remove finger from spout., Using a slow, swirling motion, dribble batter into center of pan., Let brown on both sides. Sprinkle with powdered sugar.

title: Food For Fido(For The Dog Lover)
directions: Mix well and watch tails wag.

title: Freezer Chips
directions: Slice all vegetables thinly., Leave skin on cukes., Combine all ingredients., Refrigerate and stir each day for 5 days. Freeze with liquid for storing.

title: Rice Consomme
directions: Saute onion in butter., Add rice and mushrooms; simmer for 20 minutes., Add consomme, water and oregano; stir until well blended., Bake at 325° to 350° for 1 hour (covered).

title: Easy Summer Lemon Pie
directions: Mix Eagle Brand milk and lemonade., Fold in Cool Whip until smooth and well blended., (Makes two 8-inch pies.) Freeze for about 1 hour before serving., Store in freezer, well covered.

title: Creepy Jigglers
directions: Stir boiling water into gelatins in large bowl 3 minutes or until completely dissolved., Pour into 13 x 9-inch pan. Refrigerate at least 3 hours or until firm., Dip bottom of pan in warm water about 15 seconds., Cut into Halloween shapes with cookie cutters all the way through gelatin., Lift from pan., Makes 24 pieces.

title: Dirt Cake
directions: Crush cookies finely., Mix cream cheese, sugar and Cool Whip. Mix milk and instant pudding., Combine cheese mix and pudding. Layer flowerpot alternately, ending with cookies on top., Place worms around on top and stick down in the mix., Add a silk flower in the middle, giving the effect of a pot plant.

title: Pear Salad
directions: Heat 1 cup pear juice to boiling; mix with Jell-O. Refrigerate and let set until jelled around edges., Blend cream cheese, salad dressing and mashed pears., Prepare Dream Whip as directed., Fold into cream cheese mixture, then fold in Jell-O. Pour into mold and refrigerate.

title: Banana Split(Sugar-Free Torte)
directions: Crush graham crackers. Add melted margarine and mix., Put in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Slice bananas on top. Cook pudding according to directions. Stir in pineapple., Pour over bananas. Spread 2 cups Cool Whip on top. Refrigerate. Top with strawberries.

title: Rabbit Baked In Mustard, Garlic And Cream
directions: Coat rabbit pieces with mustard., Mix minced garlic, pastry and tarragon with a little salt and sprinkle half over the rabbit. Combine the vinegar and broth and pour into a large baking dish. Sprinkle the remaining garlic, minced parsley and tarragon over, then put the rabbit pieces on top.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
directions: Mix the potatoes, granulated sugar, milk, eggs and 1/2 cup butter together and place in a greased casserole. Combine the remaining ingredients together and pour on top of potato mixture. Bake for 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Yummy Stuff
directions: Cook pasta in water seasoned with bouillon; drain., Return to pan; add cheese slice., Cover, let cheese melt., Mix in meat and vegetables., Serve with catsup.

title: Melt-Away Pancakes
directions: Beat egg yolks well; combine with sour cream. Sift dry ingredients together; stir into egg yolk mixture. Beat egg whites until stiff; fold in. Drop by large spoonfuls onto hot griddle until tops are bubbly; turn and brown on other side. Makes 10 pancakes.

title: Daddy'S Grilled Chicken
directions: The night before, prepare chicken as follows:, Spray chicken with Pam., Then coat chicken with seasoning salt completely., Do not add salt or pepper., Place chicken in a large bowl or platter and cover tightly with foil. Chill overnight.

title: Chinese Torture
directions: Combine candied ginger, walnuts, syrup, crumbs and melted chocolate., Form 1-inch balls., Mix cocoa and sugar., Coat each ball completely with this mixture., Wrap and store in refrigerator.

title: Meringue Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 325°. Sift flour, baking powder and salt. Beat egg whites to soft peaks. Gradually beat in 1 cup sugar. Beat until stiff. Fold in 1 teaspoon vanilla. Set aside.

title: Baked Spaghetti
directions: Break spaghetti into 3-inch lengths. Cook in a large amount of boiling water; drain., In Dutch oven or kettle, cook meat, onion and green pepper until meat is browned., Sprinkle with salt. Gradually stir in soups, milk and 2 cups of the cheese., Divide spaghetti evenly between two 9 x 13 x 2-inch baking dishes., Into each pan, stir half the soup-meat mixture., Sprinkle 1 cup cheese atop each dish or use 1 large baking dish., Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 1 hour or until hot through.

title: Reuben Sandwich
directions: Butter bread lightly., Arrange corned beef on 4 slices of bread., Add sauerkraut., One tablespoon salad dressing., One slice swiss cheese., Brown on grill on one side., Butter other slice of bread and flip and brown on other side., When cheese is melted. Serve.

title: Southwestern Grilled Cheese Sandwiches
directions: Spread 1 side of half the bread slices to taste with chipotles, if using., Arrange half the cheese slices evenly on top of chipotles., Scatter green chilies on top, then add remaining cheese and bread.

title: Boiled Custard
directions: Combine eggs, sugar and salt., Add milk, vanilla and nutmeg. Dot with butter., Pour in pan, place in oven and bake 30 minutes or until set.

title: Rich Cocoa Fudge
directions: Butter an 8 or 9-inch square pan with foil; set aside., In heavy 4-quart saucepan, stir together the sugar, cocoa and salt. Stir in milk., Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until mixture comes to full rolling boil., Boil, without stirring, to 234° or until syrup forms soft ball stage., Remove from heat., Add butter and vanilla., Do not stir., Cool at room temperature to 110° (lukewarm)., Beat with wooden spoon until fudge loses its gloss., Spread in pan., Cool; cut into squares.

title: Harvard Beets
directions: Mix sugar and cornstarch. Slowly add and stir in beet juice and vinegar. Cook over medium heat until mixture thickens and clears., Add drained beets. Stir to mix., Let stand 2 minutes to heat the beets through.

title: Pumpkin Bread
directions: Cream the eggs, sugar, oil and pumpkin together., Sift the other ingredients together and add alternately with water to creamed mixture., Pour into 3 well-greased loaf pans., Bake at 350° for one hour.

title: Soft Shapes
directions: Blend first 4 ingredients., Mix in sugar and knead until blended., Divide mixture in half and color one red and green. Shape mixture into 1-inch balls and press nut half into center of each., Store in airtight container.

title: Stuffed Mushrooms
directions: Saute the sausage and mushroom stems, garlic and parsley. Drain well., Add cheese., Stuff the mushroom caps., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

title: Eggplant Parmesan
directions: Peel and slice eggplant very thin., Dip in egg and Italian bread crumbs., Fry in olive oil and drain., Make a sauce with tomato sauce, Romano cheese, salt and pepper, basil, oregano, onion, garlic, Parmesan cheese and mushrooms., In casserole dish, alternate sauce, eggplant, and Mozzarella cheese (like a lasagna). Bake at 350° for approximately 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Shera Jello Mold
directions: Mix gelatin with water until dissolved., Chill until thick but not completely set., Whip until frosty and light., Add sour cream and mix well. Chill.

title: Corn Casserole
directions: Combine all ingredients in large bowl., Pour into baking dish. Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.

title: Potato Salad For 100
directions: Cover potatoes with water; bring to a boil., Add 1/4 cup salt. Cover and cook until tender., Drain well; cool slightly., Combine onions, oil, salt and pepper., Add to potatoes., Combine celery, eggs, relish, pimientos, salad dressing and mustard to potato mixture., Mix lightly but thoroughly to coat potatoes.

title: Window Washing Solution
directions: *BLKLIN sweatshirt., Cut off the hood with the strings still attached and tie it onto a mop., Use it to dust ceilings and walls., The hood can be washed and used over and over again.

title: Hunter'S Stew
directions: Cut elephant into bite size pieces., Add the brown gravy and bake at 465° for about 4 weeks., Salt and pepper to taste., This will serve 3,800 people., If more are expected, the rabbits may be added, but do this only if necessary, as most people do not like to find "hare" in their stew.

title: Mom'S Dumplings For Chicken And Dumplings
directions: Sift together flour, salt and baking powder., Cut in Crisco shortening., Stir in just enough milk to make a real thick, sticky dough., Roll out pretty thin on a floured surface., Cut into squares., Drop into boiling broth., (Scatter your droppings so they don't all goo up., You can judge this by dropping according to where the boiling bubbles are.), Cook about 20 minutes., DO NOT STIR TOO MUCH (just enough to keep the dumplings from sticking to the bottom, otherwise you will break up the dumplings)., Thicken broth with a mixture of flour and milk to desired consistency.

title: Rum Balls
directions: Combine vanilla wafer crumbs, sugar, cocoa and pecans., Mix well., Combine Karo syrup and rum and pour over crumb mixture. Mix well., Shape into balls and roll in coconut., Store in covered container in refrigerator.

title: Dirt Cups(Great For Kids)
directions: You will need 8 to 10 (7 ounce) plastic cups., Suggested decorations: gummy worms and frogs, candy flowers, chopped nuts.

title: Creamed Chicken
directions: Pour undiluted soup in pan., Combine other ingredients. Cover; heat and serve piping hot on toast.

title: Crunchy Graham Crackers
directions: Place crackers on foil covered cookie sheet., Melt butter, margarine and sugar., Bring to boil., Boil 3 minutes., Pour mixture over crackers and sprinkle with pecans., Bake at 350° for 10 minutes., Cool., Break apart.

title: Jim'S Favorite Chocolate Pie
directions: Combine sugar, flour, cocoa, egg yolks, milk, margarine and vanilla., Cook in double boiler until thick., Pour into pie shell. Top with stiffly beaten egg whites, sweetened to taste., Add cream of tartar to thicken., Bake at 350° until brown.

title: Microwave Fudge
directions: Mix together first 4 ingredients., Cook on High for 2 minutes. Stir in nuts and vanilla., Pour into greased pan., Refrigerate 1 hour.

title: Gooey Butter Cake
directions: Mix together by hand the cake mix, 2 eggs and melted butter. Pat into a well-greased and floured 9 x 12-inch pan., Set aside, then mix 2 eggs, 1 box powdered sugar and cream cheese until well blended., Pour over cake mixture., Preheat oven to 350°., Bake for 45 to 55 minutes at 350°., Remove from oven, let cool and sprinkle with 1/4 cup powdered sugar.

title: Nadine'S Favorite Icebox Salad
directions: Combine, the, sugar, and, pineapple;, bring, to a boil. Dissolve, gelatin, in water., Add sugar and pineapple mixture. Put in	refrigerator, until it begins to set, then add cheese, pecans and whipped cream.	Return to refrigerator until ready to serve.

title: Cherry Cheese Cake
directions: Beat cream cheese until fluffy., Gradually beat in condensed milk until smooth., Stir in lemon and vanilla., Pour into crust. Chill 3 hours., Top with your desired amount of pie filling.

title: Dieter'S Swiss Mocha
directions: Blend in blender., Use heaping teaspoonfuls per cup boiling water.

title: Special Pumpkin Soup
directions: Dry bread crumbs in oven at 300° for 15 minutes., Cut a lid in pumpkin., Remove seeds and fibrous insides; discard., Rub inside of pumpkin with mixture of 1 tablespoon butter and 1/2 teaspoon salt., Cook onions in 6 tablespoons butter for 10 minutes., Stir in bread crumbs; continue stirring and cook for 10 minutes longer. Stir in 1/2 teaspoon salt, other seasonings and cheese., Put crumbs and cheese in pumpkin., Fill pumpkin with enough chicken broth to fill within 1/2-inch of top., Put pumpkin lid on.

title: Chicken Stew With Parsley Dumplings
directions: Heat chicken, 4 cups of water, onion, bouillon and pepper to boiling in Dutch oven and reduce heat., Simmer, uncovered, 30 minutes., Add carrots and simmer 10 minutes., Mix flour and 1/2 cup water. Stir flour mixture and celery into chicken. Cook, stirring constantly, until thickened., Combine Bisquick, milk and parsley., Drop by spoonfuls onto boiling stew. Cook, uncovered, over low heat 10 minutes., Cover and cook an additional 10 minutes. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Bacon Appetizers
directions: Cut bacon in 4ths and wrap each piece around a water chestnut. Fasten with toothpick., Bake on rack at 400° for about 10 minutes or until bacon is crisp., Pour off grease; put roll-ups into baking dish., Mix catsup and sugar; pour over rolls and return to oven for about 10 more minutes., Makes about 50 and may be served hot or cold.

title: Cinnamon Rolls
directions: Divide dough and roll out on floured table until 1/4 inch in depth., Spread with melted butter, Land of Lakes is best, and sprinkle brown sugar and cinnamon to cover., Roll dough up and cut into 3/4 inch slices or larger if desired., Place on a buttered pan, butter tops and let rise until doubled., Bake at 400 degrees for 10 minutes, or golden brown., Take out immediately and invert on another pan.

title: Creamed Tomatoes
directions: Mash tomatoes in a pan., Add flour, milk and sugar., Salt and pepper to taste., Heat until thick and creamy., Serve over biscuits.

title: Oatmeal Pie
directions: Combine ingredients; pour into unbaked pie shell., Bake for 30 minutes at 375°.

title: Sweet Cinnamon Bread
directions: Mix first 8 ingredients together., Beat 3 minutes at medium speed., Grease and flour the bottom only of a 9 x 3-inch loaf pan. Pour batter into pan.

title: Eclair Dessert
directions: Mix pudding and milk. Stir in Cool Whip., In a 9 x 13-inch pan, layer graham crackers, 1/2 pudding mixture, layer of graham crackers, other 1/2 of pudding mixture and graham crackers. Spread the chocolate fudge icing over top layer of graham crackers., Cover and refrigerate overnight.

title: Turkey Scalloppine
directions: Skin turkey, slice meat across grain, as thin as possible. Salt and pepper slices, coat with flour., Heat oil and butter in large skillet., Lightly brown slices, a few at a time, pour off fat, return meat to skillet., Add Marsala, thyme and oregano; cook until almost dry, turning slices gently as they cook (about 10 minutes)., Saute mushrooms in 2 tablespoons butter, add to turkey. Add beef broth., Cook turkey over gentle heat until almost dry. Beat egg yolk with cream, remove skillet from heat., Pour cream mixture over turkey slices, turn gently to glaze., Makes 6 servings.

title: Scallop Kabobs
directions: Set oven control at broil and/or 550°., Broil kabobs 3 inches from heat 5 to 8 minutes, turning once and basting with butter.

title: Candle Stick Salad(For Holiday Dinner Party)
directions: *Note:, The number 8 is variable, depending on how many you're having for dinner.

title: Jello Salad
directions: Mix the jello and the hot water together., Add the remaining ingredients., Let stand until well congealed in refrigerator. This is very good and it is very filling.

title: Corned Beef Hash
directions: Mix all ingredients together and pour into a greased casserole dish., Mixture will be sloppy., Bake in a 350° oven for 1 hour or until firm and crusty., Serves 4.

title: Pumpkin Bread
directions: Beat together sugar, oil and eggs., Add pumpkin and mix well. Sift together flour, baking powder, cloves, salt, baking soda, nutmeg, allspice and cinnamon; mix with first 4 ingredients., Then add walnuts and raisins., Bake in 4 loaf pans at 350° for 1 hour (metal pans, 50 minutes).

title: Bill'S Quiche
directions: Pour into crust and bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes., Let set 10 minutes before serving.

title: Sausage Quiche
directions: Brown sausage in skillet; drain., Cut into small pieces., Add onion to skillet and cook until soft., Combine onion with sausage and sprinkle over bottom of pastry shell., Sprinkle on cheese. Combine egg, salt, light cream and milk., Beat slightly., Pour over ingredients in pastry shell., Bake in preheated 375° oven for 40 to 45 minutes., Serves 6.

title: Beef Stroganoff
directions: Brown steak, salt and pepper, then add onions and mushrooms. Cook 5 minutes. Add broth and simmer for 45 to 60 minutes or until tender. Blend sour cream and 2 tablespoons flour together. Stir in broth. Cook and stir constantly until thickened and serve over rice or noodles.

title: Mother'S Pecan Pie
directions: Turn oven on to 400°., Put pie into oven, then turn down to 350°., Place a sheet of foil on top, then bake until center is firm.

title: Dandy Candy
directions: Combine peanut butter, milk powder, honey and vanilla in mixing bowl., Next, mix ingredients with spoon.

title: Easy Refrigerator Rolls
directions: Dissolve yeast in warm water, stir in sugar, salt, shortening and egg. Mix flour in until dough is easy to handle. No kneading necessary. Grease top of dough and put in refrigerator before using. Shape about 2 hours before serving. Bake at 400 degrees for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Kosher Dill Pickles
directions: For brine, bring first 3 ingredients to boil., In cold water, wash about 30 (4-inch) pickling cucumbers., Pack in quart jars. Add spices to each quart jar., Pour hot brine over cucumbers to within 1/2-inch of top., Immediately adjust covers., Process 20 minutes in boiling water bath., Makes about 6 quarts.

title: Peach Crisp
directions: Place peach slices in an 8 x 8-inch square pan., Cream the butter and 3/4 cup sugar. Combine flour, baking powder and salt. Add to creamed mixture alternately with milk., Spoon mixture over fruit. Sift together 1 cup sugar, cornstarch and nutmeg., Sprinkle over batter., Pour water over top., Bake at 350° for 60 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

title: Peter Pan Cookies
directions: Combine margarine, salt and peanut butter; mix well., Add sugars gradually and cream., Add eggs and milk; mix well., Add flour and soda., Drop from teaspoon on greased cookie sheet., Press top lightly with fork to flatten slightly., Bake at 325° for 15 to 20 minutes., Yield:, 5 dozen.

title: Sour Cream Coconut Frosting Filling For Layers
directions: Mix sugar, sour cream and coconut. Let stand while making layers., Put between cake layers and refrigerate or mix together overnight. Put between layers next day.

title: Batter Rolls
directions: Scald milk; stir, in, sugar,, salt, and, oleo.	Cool to lukewarm. Measure warm, water into large bowl., Crumble yeast; stir until dissolved., Add lukewarm milk mixture, egg (beaten) and 2 cups flour., Beat until smooth; stir in enough remaining flour to make a soft, dough., Cover and let rise in warm place until double in bulk,, about 30 minutes.	Punch down and shape into 2 dozen rolls., Place, on, greased, baking, cake, pans or muffin cups., Cover., Let	rise in warm place until doubled in bulk, about 30 minutes., Bake, in, hot, oven, at 400° about 15 minutes or so.

title: Cranberry Salad Squares
directions: Dissolve jello in hot water., Stir in whole cranberry sauce and ginger ale., Pour into an 8 x 8-inch pan., Chill until firm. Cut into squares., Place on lettuce leaf; garnish with sour cream, mixed with a dash of cinnamon.

title: Sugar And Spice Pecans
directions: Boil, all, ingredients	(except, pecans) to a soft ball stage (230°)., Let, cool	a few minutes and stir until mixture begins to look, creamy, then add pecan halves., Mix well with wooden spoon. When, hard,, turn	out on an oiled sheet or wax paper and break apart.

title: Irish Potatoes
directions: In medium size mixing bowl mash the hot pulp of baked potato with a fork., Add the sugar and blend well., (If the pulp is not hot enough to melt sugar, place bowl in larger bowl with hot water.), Add vanilla and coconut; work into mixture thoroughly. Form dough into small rounds and roll each one in cinnamon lightly.

title: Southwest Beans
directions: Brown beef and onion in oil., Stir in flour and add seasonings., Add tomato sauce and 2 cups of the liquid the beans were cooked in., Simmer about 45 minutes., Add beans and simmer until flavors blend.

title: One-Step Microwave Lasagna
directions: Crumble beef into a microwave safe colander; place colander in a 9-inch pie plate., Cover with wax paper; microwave at High 5 to 6 minutes or until meat is no longer pink, stirring after 3 minutes., Combine beef, sauce, water and wine., Spread 1/3 of mixture in a lightly greased 12 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish., Arrange 4 lasagna noodles on sauce., Layer 1 cup cottage cheese and 1 cup Mozzarella cheese over noodles., Spoon 1/2 of remaining sauce over cheese., Repeat process again., Sprinkle with Parmesan., Cover with plastic wrap, folding back one corner for steam to escape. Microwave at Medium 32 to 35 minutes, give dish half-turn after 15 minutes., Uncover and sprinkle with remaining Mozzarella cheese and microwave for 2 minutes., Yields 6 large servings.

title: Saucy Cocktail Meatballs
directions: Mix beef, crumbs, egg and salt; shape into 50 meatballs. Place in a shallow baking pan (13 x 9 x 2-inch)., Bake until browned; turn once., Spoon off fat.

title: Old-Fashioned Chocolate Cake
directions: Have all ingredients at room temperature., Cream margarine and sugar; add eggs, 1 at a time., Add Wesson oil, then gradually add flour and buttermilk, alternating flour with milk.

title: Homemade Rolls
directions: Dissolve yeast in water. Melt oleo in milk and cool. Beat eggs and add to yeast, then add milk and oleo. Add dry ingredients gradually and place in greased bowl. Cover tightly and refrigerate. When ready to cook, pinch off in biscuit size pieces. Pat out and put on greased pan., Cook at 350° to 400° for 15 to 20 minutes., Will keep in icebox for 4 to 5 days. Do not wait for them to raise.

title: Quick Cobbler Crust
directions: Combine flour, sugar and milk., Add butter and egg., Mix well! Pour over top of desired fruit that has been placed in baking pan., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Lasagna
directions: Brown hamburger., Drain fat., Add Prego and simmer., Cook noodles as directed., Layer noodles, sauce and cheese., Finish with cheese., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Chilled Spaghetti Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients together in a large bowl., Chill 2 to 3 hours., Serves 6.

title: Greek Cabbage Soup
directions: Saute, the, onion in the oil 5 minutes., Add the water; bring to, a, boil., Mix, in, the, tomatoes, cabbage, salt and pepper. Bring, to, a, boil again and cook over low heat 1 1/4 hours, or until cabbage is tender., Taste for seasoning., Stir in, the parsley., Serve with sauteed bread., Beef bone or ham bone, or chunks, may be added for richer taste., Also soup is very, good if served with melted Gruyere or Mozzarella cheese on top with toasted croutons.

title: Quick Cherry Dessert
directions: Cream butter and sugar; add eggs and beat until light and fluffy., Add almond extract., Stir in flour and baking powder. Mix until smooth., Turn mixture into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Spoon pie filling onto batter in 16 spots., Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes or until golden and cake tests done., Filling will sink into cake while baking., Blueberry filling may be used.

title: Cheesy Squash Custard Casserole
directions: Heat oil and butter in large skillet., Add squash, onion and garlic and saute until vegetables are crisp-tender., Combine beaten eggs, cheeses, dill, salt and pepper., Transfer vegetables to buttered 8-inch square baking dish., Pour egg mixture over., Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes or until set., Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Cereal Cookies
directions: Cream together margarine or shortening and sugars., Add eggs. Mix in dry ingredients, then cereals and chocolate chips or raisins. Drop by teaspoon on greased cookie sheet., Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Casserole Of Chicken
directions: Blend mayonnaise and water., Add remaining ingredients except noodles and eggs., Pour into casserole dish and bake at 350° for 20 minutes., Garnish with sliced eggs and Chinese noodles.

title: Wild Rice And Prawn Salad(Serves 8)
directions: Make rice according to directions; set aside.

title: Fried Okra
directions: Season okra with salt and cayenne pepper to taste., Combine flour and cornmeal and season with more salt and cayenne pepper. Dip okra into egg batter and then into flour and cornmeal mixture.

title: Cranberry Salad
directions: Grind the cranberries and let stand overnight., Add sugar. Before serving, add celery, marshmallows and pecans and mix., Fold in the whipping cream and serve.

title: Ice Cream Sundae Dessert
directions: Crush cookies between 2 layers of wax paper to about 1/4 inch size., Mix with melted margarine. Put in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan., Chill., Slice ice cream and spread over the cookie crust. Freeze hard.

title: Sausage Cornbread Bake
directions: Preheat oven to 425°., Brown sausage with onion and drain. Combine meal, eggs, corn, milk and oil., Pour half of mixture into large iron skillet or greased oblong pan., Sprinkle sausage mixture and cheese over batter., Pour remaining batter on top., Bake 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Holiday Orange-Blueberry Bread
directions: Sift dry ingredients together., Beat eggs., Add butter, orange juice, milk and orange rind., Mix well., Pour liquid mixture into dry ingredients and stir only until well moistened., Carefully fold in nuts and blueberries., Pour into 5 x 9-inch buttered and floured loaf pan., Bake at 350° approximately 60 minutes or until toothpick stuck in center comes out clean., Let set 10 minutes before removing from pan., Cool on rack., Wrap and refrigerate overnight before slicing.

title: Chicken-Fried Round Steak
directions: Pound the steak thoroughly and cut into serving pieces., Mix eggs and milk., Dip meat into egg mixture, then into cracker crumbs., Handle carefully so all the coating stays on the meat. Heat the fat in a large skillet., Brown meat on both sides in the hot fat., Cover tightly and cook over very low heat for 45 to 60 minutes.

title: Beef Macaroni Skillet
directions: Brown beef and onion in 12-inch skillet., Add tomato juice, Worcestershire sauce, vinegar, salt, pepper, mustard and macaroni. Bring to a boil., Reduce heat., Cover and simmer 20 minutes or until macaroni is tender., Stir occasionally during cooking.

title: Broccoli And Rice Casserole
directions: Butter sides and bottom of glass baking dish., Combine all ingredients in baking dish., Bake, covered, in a 350° oven for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Minestrone Soup With Ground Beef
directions: In a 5-quart Dutch oven or saucepot over high heat, cook ground beef, onion, celery and cabbage, stirring carefully so that meat stays in chunks, until all pan juices evaporate and meat and vegetables are lightly browned (about 10 minutes)., Add tomatoes, garbanzo beans and corn with all their liquid, zucchini, macaroni, bouillon, basil leaves and water., Over high heat, heat to boiling, stirring to break up tomatoes., Reduce heat to low, cover and simmer 8 to 10 minutes, until macaroni and vegetables are tender.

title: Sauteed Zucchini With Raisins
directions: Cut zucchini in half lengthwise and cut into slices about 1/2-inch thick., In a large frying pan, heat 1 tablespoon of the oil and 1 tablespoon of butter over medium-high heat., Add half the zucchini and brown on both sides., Add the remaining oil and butter; saute the rest of the zucchini., Remove with slotted spoon.

title: Meal-In-One Soup
directions: Cut meat into small pieces., Add onion, celery, salt, pepper and a little water., Cook until tender., Take meat out of liquid and let cool., Remove any bones., To the liquid, add vegetables, barley, tomato paste and tomato sauce., Put meat back into liquid and cook on simmer until vegetables and barley are tender., Add water as needed., Cook and drain macaroni noodles and add to soup while simmering.

title: Bev'S Lemon Ice Cream Pie
directions: Mix together with mixer until fluffy., Pour into graham cracker pie crust and freeze.

title: Blueberry Pie
directions: Put water, and, gelatin in saucepan., Place over direct heat and stir, until dissolved or mixture is clear., In medium size bowl, combine, condensed, milk, and lemon juice., Stir in gelatin mixture., Fold, in, sour, cream., Mix in 1 1/4 cups of the pie filling., Turn, into crust., Refrigerate 2 to 3 hours. Garnish pie top with remaining chilled pie filling.

title: Green Bean Casserole
directions: Mix soup, milk, soy sauce and pepper in casserole dish., Stir in green beans and 1/2 can of French fried onions., Cook at 350° for 25 minutes., Stir and add the rest of onions on top., Cook 5 more minutes.

title: Microwave Fudge
directions: Mix sugar and cocoa in large bowl., Add milk and margarine. Do not stir., Microwave for 2 minutes., Stir just until creamy. Add vanilla and chopped nuts., Stir until blended., Pour into greased 9-inch square pan., Refrigerate for 1 hour., Cut into squares.

title: Super Dooper Chocolate Chip Cookies
directions: Cream the margarine, oil, both sugars, egg and vanilla together. Add all dry ingredients to oil/sugar mixture., Mix well. Drop from teaspoon 2-inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes. Do not overbake!, Remove immediately from cookie sheet.

title: Basic Chicken Bog
directions: Discard liver, gizzard and innards if desired., Boil chicken in a large covered pot until done, about 1 1/2 hours, with a sprinkling of celery salt and/or garlic powder if you like., Pour off chicken liquid (broth) and measure., Cool chicken slightly; strip of bones and skin., Measure 1 part rice for 2 parts broth, i.e., if you have 4 cups of broth, measure 2 cups rice., Cut up sausage into 1/2-inch chunks., Replace chicken, rice, broth and sausage into pot and cover., Bring everything to a boil, then reduce heat to low., Don't lift lid for 30 minutes at least, then check to see if rice is done., If not, continue simmering until rice is done., Ask anyone for other variations!

title: Punch - No Ice Needed
directions: Dissolve gelatin and sugar in 1/2 gallon of boiling water. Cool., Add lemon juice, pineapple juice and 2 gallons of water. Freeze overnight., Add ginger ale just before serving.

title: Christmas Wreath
directions: Melt oleo and marshmallows together; when hot, add green food coloring., Pour over corn flakes., Mix well., Spoon into a plate in a wreath design and decorate with red hots., (Can put a candle in center.)

title: Sopaipillas
directions: Combine or mix tortilla flour with warm water., Slowly swift until it becomes a dough (not too sticky)., Make round balls, then roll out into any shape no bigger than the size of an interior coffee cup., Preheat pan with vegetable oil, low to medium heat. Lay dough inside pan., Cook until one side is brown, then flip over and cook the other side until brown., Combine sugar and cinnamon on another plate; mix with fork., When tortilla is cooked, place on top of sugar and cinnamon., Sprinkle both sides of tortilla well; remove., Ready to eat.

title: Crawfish Etouffee
directions: Melt oleo., Cook celery, onions and bell pepper slowly for 40 minutes or until done., Add seasoned crawfish tails and cook slowly for 40 minutes., Add parsley with crawfish tails., Add green onions during the last 10 minutes., Add cornstarch to thicken just before adding green onions., Add lemon juice., Let set for a few minutes. Serve over cooked rice., May use shrimp.

title: Peanut Butter Delight
directions: Place margarine, sugar, milk and cocoa in a saucepan and bring to a hard boil., Remove from heat and add oatmeal, peanut butter, vanilla, salt and flour., Stir until well blended., Press in pan smoothly., Let cool., Cut into squares., You may add chopped peanuts, if desired.

title: Beer Cheese Soup
directions: Sweat the onion in butter until tender., Add the garlic and sweat briefly., Add the flour, making a roux, stirring constantly for 5 minutes, until it's golden., Add the beer and let simmer for 1/2 hour., Add the cheese and let it melt in., Add the cream and let the soup continue to warm, just to a simmer., Do not let it boil., Add the julienne peppers., Add the dry mustard, Tabasco and Worcestershire sauce to taste., Add salt and white pepper to taste., Makes 8 servings.

title: Apple Honey Refresher
directions: Combine all ingredients., Pour into ice filled glasses. Serves 6.

title: Creole Grillades
directions: Cut meat in bite-size pieces., Brown in butter., Season with salt, pepper and Accent., Remove.

title: Homemade Italian Spaghetti(Special Seasoning)
directions: Combine first 6 ingredients in food processor., Freeze fatback prior to grinding., After all ingredients are ground up, add a dash of allspice and basil leaves., Makes about 6 quarts.

title: Oven Pancake
directions: Preheat oven to 450° for metal 9 x 13 x 2 baking pan (reduce heat 25° for glass pan). Melt butter in pan in oven until butter is bubbling. Mix remaining ingredients together and pour into hot butter. Bake 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown. Serve immediately with syrup, jam, powdered sugar, etc. for breakfast.

title: Butterscotch Fingers
directions: Preheat oven to 325°., Grease a 9-inch square pan on sides and bottom., Melt margarine., Mix with other ingredients., Bake for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Oatmeal Bread
directions: Pour boiling water over oats, sugar and salt., Let stand until lukewarm., Dissolve yeast in 1/4 cup warm water and add to oats mixture., Beat in flour; knead until smooth., Let double in bulk. Shape in 2 loaves and place in greased pans., Let double again. Bake at 350° for 45 to 60 minutes., Brush tops with butter or margarine.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Beat together shortening, sugar, eggs, water and vanilla until creamy., Combine flour, salt and soda., Add to mixture., Add raisins and oats., Mix well., Drop by spoonful onto ungreased cookie sheets., Bake 12 to 15 minutes., Makes 5 dozen. 15 minutes.

title: Broccoli Salad
directions: Chop broccoli and onion., Place in large bowl., Add shredded cheese, bacon bits, salad dressing, sugar and vinegar., Stir together., Cover and refrigerate overnight., Serves 8 to 10.

title: Refrigerator Pickles
directions: Mix cucumbers, onions and green pepper., Pour salt on top; let sit 1 hour., Rinse well., Mix remaining ingredients; pour over cucumbers., Place in jars or large bowl; store in refrigerator.

title: Banana Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Cream sugar and shortening with mixer. Add egg. Cream again. Mash bananas and add. Cream. Mix slowly while adding oatmeal. Combine flour, salt, soda, cinnamon and nutmeg. Fold into creamed ingredients. Add pecans. Spoon onto greased cookie sheet and bake at 400° for 12 to 14 minutes or until golden brown. Cool completely. Store in tight container to keep moist.

title: Yellow Bread
directions: Beat all ingredients, except 1/2 cup sugar and 2 teaspoons cinnamon, for 8 minutes at high speed., Mix 1/2 cup sugar and the cinnamon., Layer batter and sugar-cinnamon mixture in 2 greased loaf pans., Bake for 40 minutes at 350°.

title: Layered Bean Dip
directions: Mix together refried beans, green chilies and taco seasoning mix., Spread on a 12 inch round platter. Blend avocados, lemon juice and 1/2 c. taco sauce until smooth. Spread on top of bean mixture., Spread sour cream on top of avocado mixture., Top with shredded lettuce, cheese, taco sauce and olive slices., Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Homemade Play Dough
directions: Cook flour, salt, cream of tartar and oil over medium heat until it thickens., Add food coloring and knead when cool., Store in an airtight container.

title: Chili
directions: Brown the ground beef with diced onion., Drain off fat., Put all ingredients in pot., Bring to a boil and then simmer 1 hour.

title: Seven Layer Salad
directions: Place ingredients in a large bowl in the order listed. Mix mayonnaise and sugar thoroughly and place on top of pea layer. Spread it on like frosting. Sprinkle the cheese on top. Cover and refrigerate overnight.

title: Buttermilk Fruit Salad
directions: Mix buttermilk and pudding mix until smooth., Add fruit and fold in Cool Whip., Makes a huge salad., Half of recipe is enough for a family.

title: Marinated Fish Kabobs
directions: Thaw fish if frozen., Cut fish into 1-inch pieces., To make marinade:, combine oil, soy sauce, scallions, garlic, brown sugar, dried mustard and black pepper., Place fish pieces in marinade. Cover and let stand at room temperature for 1 hour.

title: Big Soft Ginger Cookies
directions: Combine flour, soda, salt and spices., Set aside., In large mixing bowl, beat margarine with electric mixer on low speed to soften., Gradually add 1 cup sugar, beating until fluffy., Add egg and molasses, beating well., Stir in dry ingredients.

title: Grilled Chicken Breast
directions: Marinate chicken in other ingredients in Ziploc bag for several hours., Grill 7 minutes on each side over medium heat.

title: Beer Batter Chicken
directions: In bowl with fork, mix first 3 ingredients., In another bowl, beat together beer, egg and 2 teaspoons salad oil; stir liquid into flour mixture., Coat half of chicken pieces with batter.

title: Chicken Supreme
directions: Cook chicken in water with celery, onion and salt until chicken is tender., Remove chicken from bone and line 13 x 9-inch pan with chunks of chicken., Mix together both soups and milk and pour over chicken., Next, mix the stuffing with enough chicken broth to moisten, then spread over top of soup and chicken., Cover with foil and bake at 350° for 1 hour., Serves 8.

title: Chocolate Pie
directions: Bake pie shell., I use the ones in the boxes and bake as directed (let cool)., Mix together cocoa, flour, sugar and eggs. Add 1 cup milk slowly until mixture is smooth.

title: Blueberry Buckle
directions: Stir together first 3 ingredients., In mixer, combine 1/2 cup butter and 1/2 cup sugar., Mix until fluffy., Add egg and beat until smooth., Combine milk and vanilla; add alternately with dry ingredients to mixture at low speed., Pour batter into greased and floured 1 1/2-quart oval baking dish., Spoon berries over batter. Combine 1/4 cup sugar, 1/4 cup flour and cinnamon; cut in butter. Sprinkle over berries., Bake at 375° for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Sift together flour, baking powder, salt and cinnamon., Add sugar to eggs; mix well., Add butter, stirring until blended., Add flour mixture alternately with milk, mixing until blended after each addition., Stir in oats, nuts and raisins., Let batter stand for 5 minutes.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Fold all ingredients together and place in baking dish., Cover with 2 cups crushed potato chips., Bake at 450° for about 20 minutes or 375° for 30 minutes until hot.

title: German Potato Salad
directions: In, 1, quart casserole, heat bacon until crisp., Remove bacon; crumble; set aside., Add onion to bacon drippings; heat until onions are transparent., Stir in flour, sugar, salt and celery and, heat;	stir, in, water, and, vinegar.	Cook until mixture boils., Add, potatoes, and	bacon, stirring gently to coat with sauce., Makes 4 servings.

title: Stouthearted Bean Salad
directions: Drain Trappey's beans; coarsely chop onion and jalapeno peppers., Combine all ingredients and refrigerate., Add salt and pepper to taste., Alter olive oil and vinegar to taste.

title: Date Nut Bread
directions: Cut up dates in a bowl; sprinkle soda over them., Pour boiling water over all and let cool., Mix sugar, eggs and butter together and drain dates liquid into batter., Add flour and then dates and nuts last., Makes 2 loaves., Put into greased pans., Bake at 325° for 1 hour.

title: Pumpkin Bars
directions: Combine first 6 ingredients., Add oil, pumpkin and eggs., Beat 1 minute at medium speed in mixer., Put batter in a 15 x 10 x 2-inch pan or 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes. Let cool completely.

title: Vic'S Cheese Potato Soup
directions: Cook chopped celery, onion and carrot in broth and water for 20 minutes., Add potatoes and cook another 15 to 20 minutes (medium heat)., Stir in cream of chicken soup and add Velveeta last., Stir to dissolve., Soup is ready to serve when all of the cheese has dissolved., Salt and pepper to taste and garnish soup with crumbled bacon.

title: Pork Chop Casserole
directions: Brown chops in oil., Then place in a baking dish or oblong pan., Cover with potato slices and onion., Spoon soups over the top and spread to cover potatoes., Put foil or lid on., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Fruit Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients well and chill overnight.

title: Microwave Caramel Corn
directions: Divide popped corn between two 4-quart glass bowls., Combine brown sugar, butter, syrup and salt in a 2-quart bowl., Microwave on High for 3 to 3 1/2 minutes or until mixture boils, stirring once., Microwave at 30% power for 4 minutes., Stir in soda., Pour half of the syrup evenly over each bowl., Sprinkle 1 cup of peanuts over each bowl., Stir until it lightly coats corn. Microwave at 50% power, one bowl at a time, for 6 to 7 minutes, stirring twice.

title: French Carrots
directions: Steam or microwave carrots until tender., In a small pan, heat butter, honey, Cointreau, orange zest and parsley., Heat until blended., Add salt and pepper to taste., Arrange carrots on serving dish., Pour warm sauce over carrots., Serve at once.

title: Creamy Hash Browns
