directions: Mix sour cream and soups together., Put frozen hash browns in a 9 x 12-inch cake pan., Mix in soups and sprinkle with cheese. Sprinkle with crushed cornflakes (if desired)., Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Taco Salad
directions: Pull lettuce apart, rinse and drain beans., Add grated cheese and sliced onion and toss well., Add crushed Doritos, tomatoes and salad dressing at the last minute to avoid a soggy salad.

title: Pineapple On Ice
directions: Blend all ingredients in blender.

title: Corn Pudding(Vegetables)
directions: Melt margarine and cream cheese together., Stir in corn. Simmer on low for 45 minutes to 1 hour., Stir frequently to avoid sticking.

title: Fruit Salad #3
directions: Toss all ingredients together and serve in lettuce cups.

title: Black Forest Pie
directions: In saucepan, over medium-low heat, melt chocolate with sweetened condensed milk., Remove from heat., Stir in extract.

title: Simple Salad
directions: In large bowl, combine all ingredients; mix well., Cover. Refrigerate at least 2 hours before serving.

title: Pickled Beets
directions: Place all ingredients into a pot., Bring to a rapid boil. Remove from heat and allow to cool., Refrigerate.

title: Baked Chicken Parmesan
directions: Pour vegetable oil into baking dish., Add minced garlic and paprika., Dip chicken breasts into mixture and coat evenly on both sides., Place chicken in baking dish and bake at 350° for 20 minutes., Remove and drain excess oil., Put cheese over top of chicken and return to oven for 3 to 4 minutes or until cheeses are melted., Pour spaghetti sauce over chicken breasts and bake 2 to 3 minutes.

title: Artichoke Dip
directions: Dice artichokes very fine., Mix mayonnaise and cheese with artichokes thoroughly., Put in small casserole and bake at 350° until brown and bubbly., Serve with Ritz or Town House crackers.

title: Everyday Meat Loaf
directions: Mix well and bake at 350° for 1 hour., Can also be baked in microwave oven.

title: Carrot Cake
directions: Mix and sift dry ingredients in large bowl., Add oil and blend., Add eggs and beat well., Add grated carrots; stir and beat well., Bake in two 9-inch round cake pans at 350° for 35 minutes.

title: Tuna Casserole
directions: Cook noodles. Drain. Add butter. Combine all other ingredients. Bake in greased casserole pan at 400° for 25 minutes.

title: Sweet Potato Souffle
directions: Mix all ingredients together and beat with mixer., Pour into a casserole dish.

title: Cracker Candy
directions: Crush crackers; boil sugar and mix exactly 4 minutes., Remove from heat immediately and quickly stir in crackers and peanut butter., Drop by spoonfuls on wax paper., Allow to cool and enjoy.

title: Herbed Yogurt Cheese
directions: Line 6-inch strainer with coffee filter or double thickness of cheesecloth., Place strainer over bowl.

title: Blueberry Cheese Pie
directions: Add Eagle Brand milk and lemon juice to softened cream cheese. Pour 1/2 blueberry pie filling in a graham cracker crust., Fold in Cool Whip., Pour over pie mix., Add Cool Whip, milk and lemon juice., Then put the rest of the pie filling on top., Let cool several hours.

title: Sour Cream Chicken Enchiladas
directions: Combine the first 5 ingredients in a saucepan and cook until heated through, approximately 10 to 15 minutes., Add sour cream and blend.

title: Best Ever Fried Eggplant
directions: Peel eggplant and cut in 1/2-inch slices., Combine first 3 ingredients., Separately, combine next 3 ingredients., Coat each slice eggplant in mayonnaise mixture, then in crumb mixture., Place in single layers on cookie sheet and bake at 425° for 15 to 17 minutes or until brown., Serve hot., Makes 4 servings.

title: Pumpkin Bars
directions: Preheat oven to 300°., Sift together flour, baking soda, ginger, allspice and cinnamon., Set aside., In a large bowl, cream butter or margarine., Gradually add sugar and beat until light and fluffy., Add egg and pumpkin., Beat well., Add dry ingredients. Mix until blended., Add nuts., Mix well., Spread batter evenly in well-greased 15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 1-inch jelly roll pan., Bake 15 to 18 minutes.

title: Pumpkin Bread
directions: Sift flour with salt, baking powder, soda, cloves, cinnamon and nutmeg and set aside., In a large bowl, beat sugar with butter until blended., Add eggs, one at a time, beating., Mix well after each egg., Continue to beat mix until light and fluffy., Beat in pumpkin with mixer at low speed; gradually add flour mixture until well blended., Divide batter into 2 greased and floured 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pans., Bake in a 325° oven for 1 hour and 15 minutes. Let cool in pans for 10 minutes., Turn onto wire rack to cool completely., Makes 2 loaves.

title: Strawberry Pie
directions: Cook sugar, water and cornstarch until thick., Add Jell-O and pour over strawberries in baked pie shell., Chill in refrigerator.

title: Forgotten Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Beat egg whites until foamy. Add sugar slowly and continue beating until mixture is very stiff. Gently add nuts and chips with spoon. Drop by tablespoon on a cookie sheet covered in foil (greased with a little Crisco)., Place in oven and turn heat off., Leave cookies in oven overnight or several hours. This recipe doubles well.

title: Broccoli Onion Casserole
directions: Place broccoli and water in casserole dish., Microwave on High for 10 minutes; drain., Stir to break up., Stir in onions and soup., Top with cracker crumbs; microwave on High for 7 minutes. Sprinkle with cheese., Microwave for 1 minute on High until cheese is melted.

title: Caramel Cinnamon Sheet Cake
directions: Mix flour, sugar, cinnamon and nuts in a bowl., In a saucepan, mix oleo, oil and water and bring to a boil., Pour over the dry ingredients., Add sour milk, soda, eggs, vanilla and salt and beat well., Pour into greased and floured cookie sheet pan., Bake at 400° for 20 minutes., Ten minutes before cake is done, make frosting.

title: Polske Paczki(Polish Donuts)
directions: Dissolve yeast in lukewarm milk; add 2 cups flour., Let stand in warm place about 1/2 hour., Then beat eggs, sugar, vanilla, grated rind and scant teaspoon salt., Beat until light., Add this to sponge., Melt butter and add this to sponge., Add 5 cups of flour., Cover and allow to rise for about 1 hour or until double in bulk., When light, turn on board and pat with hands until dough is 1/2-inch thick., Cut and let rise again until light., Cook in deep oil.

title: Hamburger Soup
directions: Cook 1st. 8 ingredients in large kettle., While they are cooking, brown ground beef and onion., After browning, add to rest of ingredients., Cook till done, about 20 minutes., Could also be put in slow cooker and cook for 6 - 8 hours., Optional:, Add cabbage.

title: Tangy Fruit Salad
directions: Drain and save liquid of fruit cocktail and pineapple., Add 1 cup of this liquid to the pudding and Tang., Mix all ingredients together., Apples or maraschino cherries may be added for color.

title: Orange Julius
directions: Put all ingredients into blender and blend on mix for 1 minute.

title: Chocolate Icing
directions: Bring to a boil; add 2 cups powdered sugar and 1 teaspoon vanilla.

title: Hot Broccoli Dip(Microwave)
directions: Remove outer wrap of frozen broccoli and microwave on High for 10 to 12 minutes., Microwave onions and celery in butter until tender., Add soup and cheese., Microwave 4 to 5 minutes or until cheese melts., Stir twice during cooking., Add remaining ingredients., Mix and microwave until heated through., Serve hot with corn chips or fresh vegetables.

title: Roast Chicken And Potatoes
directions: Mix tomato sauce in small amount of water in a bowl., Coat potatoes with sauce and place in roaster., Sprinkle garlic, bouillon and dabs of butter on top of potatoes., Do the same with chicken., Cover chicken with remaining sauce., Bake 1 1/2 hours, covered, at 350°.

title: Chess Bars
directions: Mix together cake mix, egg and margarine., Put in the bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan., Mix cream cheese, eggs, powdered sugar and vanilla., Pour over first mixture., Bake at 350° until brown on top.

title: Sally'S Blubber Burner
directions: One glass before each meal., Good for dieting!

title: Bean Casserole
directions: Mix soup and beans., Sprinkle onion rings on top., Heat thoroughly in 400° oven.

title: Corn Casserole
directions: Saute 1 onion and green pepper in margarine., Slightly beat eggs and mix with Jiffy corn mix and corn; add onion and pepper. Pour into casserole dish., Mix sour cream and cheese; pour over top and bake at 400° for 30 minutes.

title: Gram'S Nutmeg Sauce(To Serve Over Fig Or Plum Pudding)
directions: Mix sugar, cornstarch and salt in saucepan., Add boiling water gradually., Cook 3 to 4 minutes until thick., Remove from burner and add butter and nutmeg., Serve over fig or plum pudding.

title: Michael'S Marvelous Chicken
directions: Bring 2 cups water to a boil., Add shrimp and cook 3 to 5 minutes., Drain well; rinse with cold water., Peel and devein shrimp., Combine whipped butter and next 3 ingredients; add shrimp., Add salt, basil, poultry seasoning, garlic and lemon juice; mix well.

title: Beef Stroganoff - Quick And Easy
directions: Cut beef in 1-inch strips., Brown in hot shortening., Add chopped onion and garlic., Lightly season beef., Stir in soup and mushroom pieces., Add ketchup, Worcestershire sauce and sour cream. Heat, but do not boil., Serve over noodles.

title: Best Bread And Butter Pickles
directions: Gently stir salt into thinly sliced cucumbers. Cover with ice cubes; let stand 2 to 3 hours., Add more ice if it melts. Drain. Add onions. Combine remaining ingredients and bring to a boil. Boil for 10 minutes., Pack at once in hot sterilized jars. Process in boiling water bath for 30 minutes. Remove jars from canner. Makes 8 pints.

title: Chicken Cacciatore
directions: Put onion, green pepper and butter in 3-quart microwave casserole., Cover and cook on High (max power) for 6 to 8 minutes until onion is translucent., Add juice from stewed tomatoes and flour; stir until smooth., Stir in rest of the stewed tomatoes. Cover and cook on High for 5 minutes., Add chicken, covering with sauce., Cover and cook on Simmer (or 50%) for 25 to 30 minutes or until chicken is tender., Stir halfway through cooking time. Allow to stand, covered, 5 minutes before serving with hot rice or pasta.

title: Chili
directions: Brown ground beef with onion and drain., In large pot, combine all ingredients and bring to a boil., Boil, covered, for 40 minutes., Uncover for the last 10 minutes., Skim off grease.

title: Sunny Fruit Salad
directions: Combine first 4 ingredients in a medium bowl., Add fruit and toss gently., Serve on lettuce leaves.

title: Lemon Dessert
directions: Step 1:, Mix together flour, pecans and butter like a pie crust., Press in bottom of a 7 x 11-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 15 minutes., Cool.

title: Margaritas
directions: Blend in blender and serve in salted glasses.

title: Milky Way Cake
directions: Melt candy with 1 stick of butter in top of double boiler. Set aside to cool., Cream 1 stick butter with sugar., Add eggs, one at a time., Add flour,, nuts and buttermilk to which soda has been added., Add vanilla., Fold in Milky Way mixture., Bake in a greased and floured tube pan at 300°.

title: Gorp(Trail Mix)
directions: Mix together., Place in sealed plastic bag or other airtight container.

title: S'Mores Pudding Dessert
directions: Oil or butter, a, 1, 1/2, quart glass baking dish; then line bottom of, dish, with 1/3 of the whole size graham crackers., Cook pudding, mix, with	the, milk, using a little extra milk if needed, as directed on package., Pudding should not be too thick. Cool pudding not more than 5 minutes.

title: Roast With Pepperoncini
directions: Pour pepper juice into roaster. Cut tops off peppers. Add water or wine to jar and add. Cook at 350° all day. Will fall apart with fork.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
directions: Slice potatoes and place in greased casserole., Sprinkle with salt and pepper., Combine chicken soup and evaporated milk., Dot with margarine., Bake 1 hour and 15 minutes at 325°., Serves 4.

title: New England Clam Chowder
directions: Heat clams with liquid., Dice potato, onion and green pepper. Drain clams but keep liquid., Put clam liquid, potato, onion and pepper into a saucepan and cook on low heat until tender., Add milk, if necessary.

title: Chicken Oriental
directions: Combine chicken soup, mayonnaise, celery, rice, onion, salt and water chestnuts., Place in a buttered 9 x 13-inch dish., Melt margarine; add sliced almonds and corn flakes., Sprinkle on top of casserole., Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

title: Nut Cookies
directions: Cream butter and sugar., Add egg, then flour (sifted), then the nut meats (cut fine)., Drop onto greased cookie sheet with teaspoon., Bake in moderate oven (350°); cook quickly., Yields 50 cookies.

title: Strawberry Cake
directions: Dissolve strawberry jello with 1/2 cup hot water., Then mix cake mix, oil, eggs, jello and strawberries in order with an electric mixer., Bake in 3 medium cake pans (put wax paper in bottom of pans) at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes., If possible, make cake few days before using and refrigerate.

title: Oven-Baked Barbecue Spareribs
directions: Add garlic, ketchup, soy sauce and honey to chicken bouillon. Stir until well blended., Pour into shallow baking dish., Lay spareribs in the marinade sauce and let sit in refrigerator, turning occasionally, overnight or 8 hours at least in sauce. Bake at 375° in oven for 1 1/2 hours, turning for even browning in the pan with the sauce., Serves 4., Delicious and easy.

title: Get Together Punch
directions: Day before serving, pour 1 can punch into a 1 1/2-quart ring mold., Freeze., Mix remaining punch, pineapple juice, lemonade and club soda into a punch bowl.

title: Overnight Tossed Salad
directions: Tear lettuce and spinach into bite size pieces in very large bowl., Add onion, tomatoes, peas and bacon; toss gently., Combine mayonnaise, sour cream, lemon juice, oregano, basil, salt and pepper., Mix well., Spread dressing over greens; be sure to "frost" entire surface., Do not mix in!, Cover with plastic wrap. Refrigerate overnight., To serve:, Toss dressing with greens. Serves 8.

title: Dump Cake
directions: Grease 9 x 13-inch pan; spread pineapple evenly., Cover with cherries., Sprinkle cake mix over fruit., Sprinkle melted butter over cake mix., Add nuts if wanted., Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Seven Layer Salad
directions: Layer first 7 ingredients and place in refrigerator 6 hours or overnight., Just before serving, toss and sprinkle bacon and cheese on top.

title: Zucchini Bread
directions: Mix all ingredients and place in greased and floured pans. Bake 1 hour at 350°., Makes 2 loaves.

title: Walnut Graham Cracker Cookie Bars
directions: Line a jelly roll pan or cookie sheet with whole graham crackers; set aside., On top of stove in a pan, combine brown sugar, margarine and walnuts., Heat until all melted together. Pour over all graham crackers and spread evenly., Bake at 350° for 10 minutes., Cool slightly and cut into squares.

title: 24 Hour Salad
directions: Layer salad with the first 4 ingredients., For top of salad, mix the next 3 ingredients., Sprinkle 2 tablespoons dried salad seasoning (McCormick Salad Supreme).

title: Tom'S Tea
directions: Place tea bags in a small saucepan with water., Bring to a boil., Boil 3 minutes., Remove from stove and set aside to cool.

title: Homemade White Bread
directions: Soften yeast in warm water with 1 teaspoon of sugar for 5 minutes in one bowl., Put scalded milk, sugar and salt in another bowl and cool; add 4 cups flour., Mix until smooth., Add yeast mixture to this., Add more flour to form dough., Cover with towel; let rise., When it doubles, punch down., Let rise again., Separate into pans; let rise again., Bake at 400° for 45 minutes.

title: Chicken Enchilada
directions: Cook chicken; shred it and keep broth., Fry tortilla shells in a dash of oil until lightly browned., Add cheese, mushrooms, chicken and onion to shell and roll up., Mix chicken soup and chicken broth and pour on top of tortillas., Top with cheese and bake in warm oven until melted.

title: Surprise Casserole
directions: Layer in order given., After baking 1 hour in a covered casserole, uncover, and add 7 or 8 slices of American cheese and return to heat just to melt cheese.

title: Soup
directions: Cook all the ingredients on low heat until vegetables are tender.

title: Skipper'S Ceiling Pancakes
directions: Combine all ingredients and grill on lightly oiled hot skillet or griddle., If the pancakes are flipped too high, they will stick to the ceiling.

title: Mustard 'N Herb Sauce
directions: Use blender to mix egg and champagne mustard with blender on high speed., Add oil in a thin stream until mixture thickens. Turn off blender and add parsley and lemon dill., Blend again until sauce is pale green., Makes about 1 1/2 cups of sauce.

title: Busy Women'S Dream
directions: Cook ground chuck; crumble in bottom of a 10 x 10-inch dish. Add can of soup., Place the Tater Tots on top., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Veg-All Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients except crackers and butter., Pour in baking dish., Crush one roll of Ritz; sprinkle over mixture., Pour one stick melted margarine over it., Bake 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Potato Casserole
directions: Bake at 350° for 1 hour., Serves 12 to 16.

title: Fruity Spring Trifle
directions: Break cookies coarsely into 2 1/2-quart clear glass serving bowl., Sprinkle with orange juice., Top with layers of sliced fruit., Prepare pudding with 3 cups of milk., Refrigerate until pudding begins to thicken., Add chocolate; stir with wire whisk. Gently stir in whipped topping., Spoon over fruit; top with remaining whipped topping., Refrigerate for 30 minutes or overnight.

title: Shepherd'S Pie
directions: Boil vegetables in 1/2 cup water until tender., Drain and add beef and gravy., Pour into casserole dish., Beat egg whites with salt until stiff., Beat flakes, sour cream and milk., Fold in egg whites., Spread over beef mixture., Sprinkle cheese and paprika over top., Bake at 400° for 25 minutes.

title: Fresh Strawberry Pie
directions: Mix a tablespoon of cornstarch with 1 cup sugar., Mix with 1/4 cup cold water and stir gradually into 3/4 cup hot water., Bring to a boil and cook until clear and thick., Stir 3 tablespoons of strawberry Jell-O into hot filling., Stir until dissolved., Let cool., Gently fold fresh whole strawberries into cooled mixture. Pat into baked pie shell., Place into refrigerator to set., Top with Cool Whip.

title: Cranberry Mold
directions: Combine orange and pineapple juices with enough water to make 1 1/4 cups., Dissolve jello in 1 cup boiling water., Add orange rind and other juices., Crush cranberry sauce with a fork., Add to juices and pineapple., Chill until slightly thickened., Add orange sections and nuts., Pour into mold and chill.

title: Oven Swiss Steak
directions: Cut meat into 4 portions., Mix flour and salt., Pound into meat., Set aside remaining flour., Brown meat in small amount of hot shortening and place in shallow baking dish., Blend remaining flour with drippings in skillet., Add remaining ingredients, except cheese.

title: Lemon Cake Squares
directions: Mix the cake mix, 1 egg, pecans and butter together., Beat by hand until well blended., Spread this mixture in the bottom of a greased 9 x 13-inch pan., Use your hands to spread this mixture evenly over the bottom of pan.

title: Breakfast Pizza
directions: Brown sausage and drain., Separate crescent dough and place in ungreased 12-inch pizza pan., Press over bottom and up sides to form a crust; seal perforations., Spoon sausage over crust. Sprinkle with potatoes., Top with Cheddar cheese.

title: Libby'S Green Bean Casserole
directions: Combine the soup, water and green beans in greased casserole dish., Sprinkle top with cheese and dressing mix., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Peanut Brittle
directions: Microwave the sugar and karo 4 minutes on high in covered microwave-safe dish., Add nuts., 4 minutes more on high., Add butter and vanilla., Microwave 2 minutes on high., Add 1 tsp soda and stir briskly., Pour and spread onto cookie sheet.

title: Beef Stew
directions: Roll stew meat in flour and brown in small amount of shortening., Combine all ingredients in large covered pot., Make sure there is enough liquid to cover all ingredients., Add water or more V-8 if necessary., Bake at 275° for 5 hours., Do not peek.

title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
directions: Cream butter and sugar., Beat in eggs one at a time., Slowly add flour mixture, then vanilla., Add sour cream last., Cook at 325° in tube pan, about 1 1/4 hours.

title: Flavor-Favorite Bar Cookies
directions: Combine oleo and sugar., Blend in egg and vanilla., Add flour; mix well., Spread into ungreased 15 x 10-inch cookie sheet or jelly roll pan., Sprinkle with chocolate chips and nuts; press lightly into batter., Bake at 300° for 35 to 40 minutes until edges are lightly brown., Cool; cut into squares or bars.

title: Pecan Sandies
directions: Cream together first 4 ingredients., Mix well., Add flour and pecans., Chill 2 to 3 hours., Shape into balls or fingers., Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 350° for 20 minutes., Cool slightly, then roll into powdered sugar.

title: Whoopie Pies(Homemade Moon Pies)
directions: Add all ingredients together., Beat well and drop by teaspoonful on a lightly greased cookie sheet., Bake for 10 minutes in oven at 375°.

title: Orange Creme Salad
directions: Combine cream cheese and sugar, beating until light and fluffy. Gradually add milk, beating until blended., Dissolve gelatin in boiling water; let cool 5 minutes., Gradually add to cream cheese mixture, beating until blended., Stir in rind and juice., Pour into a lightly oiled 4-cup mold., Chill until firm.

title: Ruth'S Cookies
directions: Combine water, eggs, margarine, peanut butter and half of cake mix until smooth., Mix in rest of cake mix and chocolate chips. Drop by teaspoons on ungreased cookie sheet., Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Vegetable Salad
directions: Cut up vegetables and cover with Equal, vinegar and water mixture., You may add other vegetables.

title: Cheesy Potatoes
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Bake in preheated oven at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: No Bake Cookies
directions: Bring first four ingredients to full boil and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly., Remove from heat and add next 3 ingredients., Mix well., Drop by teaspoons on wax paper and let cool.

title: Holiday Sweet Potatoes
directions: Steam yams until almost done; cool and peel., Cut lengthwise and place in flat pan., Put remaining ingredients in saucepan; cook for 10 minutes, stirring constantly., Pour sauce over yams. Bake at 325° for 40 minutes.

title: Squash Casserole
directions: Combine onion, milk, cheese, soup, crackers, butter, salt and pepper to taste., Alternate layers of the cooked squash and sauce mixture in a buttered casserole dish., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Cranberry Fluff
directions: Combine cranberries, marshmallows and sugar., Let set overnight., Add apples, grapes, pecans and salt., Fold together with whipped cream., Chill.

title: Chicken And Rice(Low-Fat)
directions: Cut up tomatoes into large chunks., Cut up pepper into strips. Cut up onions into rings., Dissolve chicken bouillon with 1 cup water., Combine ingredients and simmer until tomatoes dissolve. Add salt, pepper and garlic powder., Cut up chicken in strips and add., Simmer another 1/2 hour., Cook rice and add (or) serve it over the rice.

title: Mom'S Goulash
directions: In a frying pan, saute in butter or oleo the onions, pepper and celery., Add meat; cook until done and drain off fat., Add beans, tomato juice, macaroni, salt and pepper to taste., Serve hot as is or over corn bread.

title: Hot Mulled Cider
directions: Combine all ingredients except cinnamon sticks in pan., Simmer 8 to 10 minutes., Pour into six mugs., Add cinnamon stick to each mug for stirring.

title: Rye Bread Dip(Appetizer)
directions: Take an oval rye bread loaf and hollow out center after cutting off a top portion., Break up center pieces into bite-sized pieces of bread., May break up top portion also., Bread now looks like a "bowl.", Mix dip ingredients and fill rye "bowl" just before serving., Use broken rye bread pieces as dippers.

title: Chicken Cacciatore
directions: *Immerse in boiling water to peel, then squeeze out seeds and chop.

title: Yummy Brisket
directions: Trim fat on brisket., Line cake pan with aluminum foil, 6 inches extra on each side., Put brisket on foil., Rub Worcestershire sauce on brisket generously so there is some on the pan., Rub with garlic powder and pepper., Top with soup mix., Top with another sheet of foil and seal well with bottom sheet., Bake at 250° for 3 to 3 1/2 hours., Slice into thin pieces.

title: Meat Cheese Ball
directions: Cream softened cheese and mayonnaise., Add onion, horseradish and hot sauce., Take 3/4 cup of pecans and all of meat., Add to mixture., Sprinkle remainder of nuts and parsley over ball., Let set in refrigerator for several hours.

title: Deviled Ham Spread
directions: Mix all together; spread on Triscuits or any cracker of your choice.

title: Lemon Salad
directions: Dissolve the jello in the hot water and cold water. Add the remaining ingredients. Pour into 9 x 13 dish and chill until set.

title: Chicken A La Can
directions: Combine soups, water and chicken., Add rice; quickly boil. Cover; reduce heat and simmer 7 minutes., Top with French fried onions.

title: Dried Beef Dip
directions: Cook and stir until it bubbles., Serve hot or cold.

title: Benny'S Pasta E Fagioli
directions: Add bouillon granules to 1 cup water and set aside to dissolve., Heat oil in large soup pot over medium-high heat. Saute beef, stirring to break up slightly, until beef loses pink color. Add 2 cups of water, onion, carrots and celery and simmer 10 minutes., Stir bouillon mixture, oregano, black pepper, parsley, Tabasco and Ragu into, pot., Simmer 10 minutes., Add, 2 cups of water (or enough to reach desired consistency) stir and simmer about 40 minutes (until carrots and celery are done). Cook, drain, and rinse pasta while soup simmers., Stir in beans and pasta just before serving., Makes about 12 large servings., Change flavor by changing type of spaghetti sauce used.

title: Grandma'S Gingersnaps
directions: In large mixing bowl, cream shortening and sugar., Beat in egg and molasses., Combine flour, soda, spices and salt., Gradually add to creamed mixture., Roll teaspoonfuls of dough into balls., Dip one side of each ball in sugar; place with sugar side up on greased baking sheet., Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes or until lightly brown and crinkly., Makes 3 to 4 dozen.

title: Broccoli Dip
directions: Cook broccoli until tender and drain., Add all ingredients including broccoli into blender and blend., Chill 1 to 2 hours.

title: Chocolate Sauce
directions: Combine ingredients and cook until thickened., Add 2 tablespoons butter and vanilla and stir.

title: Sauerkraut Salad
directions: Combine all ingredients and mix well., Refrigerate overnight.

title: Pound Cake
directions: Cream Crisco and sugar; beat eggs in one at a time., Sift flour, salt and baking powder (I sift mine 3 times)., Add flour and milk alternately., Pour into tube pan., Bake in preheated 325° oven for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Chocolate Banana Cake
directions: Prepare ingredients in order given, beating 3 minutes., Pour into a 13 x 9-inch pan., Bake for 30 minutes, until done.

title: Pumpkin Bread
directions: Blend first 5 ingredients., Add the rest; beat 1 minute., Pour into greased loaf pan., Bake at 350° for 60 to 65 minutes.

title: Key Lemon Pie
directions: Mix together first 3 ingredients., Add remaining ingredients. Mix good., Do not beat; milk may look curdled., Just mix a little more., Pour into an 8-inch unbaked pie shell., Bake at 375° for 15 minutes., Reduce heat to 350° for 20 minutes.

title: Pig Pickin' Cake
directions: Combine and divide into 2 greased and floured 9-inch cake pans. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes., Let cool.

title: Corn Fritters(From 1975 Edition)
directions: Beat egg yolks; add to corn, then add salt, sugar and flour. Add butter., Beat egg whites until stiff and add last., Fry on hot griddle., When golden brown, turn over on other side.

title: Honey Butter
directions: Mix until creamy., Refrigerate in covered jar.

title: Quick Barbecue Chicken
directions: Place chicken in foil lined pan., Season chicken and place onion slices over chicken., Mix catsup and Coca-Cola together; pour over chicken., Bake until tender at 350° for about 1 hour. Yields 4 servings.

title: Trifle Cake
directions: Bake a devil's food cake., Completely cool and cut into strips., Mix up chocolate pudding., Using a large bowl, put layer of cake strips in bottom of bowl., Cover cake strips with chocolate syrup., Next, put a layer of chocolate pudding, then a layer of nuts and a layer of Cool Whip., Start completely over, ending with Cool Whip., Swirl top with chocolate syrup, chopped nuts and top with cherries.

title: Cavatina
directions: Brown ground beef and sausage., Drain., Add mushrooms and spaghetti sauce., Cook pasta and drain., In a greased 9 x 13-inch pan layer 1/2 of pasta, 1/2 of pepperoni, 1/2 of cheese and 1/2 of meat mixture., Repeat. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Blueberry Dump Cake
directions: Strain pineapple (save juice)., Take juice from pineapple, add the butter and heat until butter is melted., In bottom of long baking dish spread blueberries and pineapple., Then sprinkle cake mix on top., Pour juice and butter and last, sprinkle with nuts. Bake at 350° for about 30 minutes.

title: Cheese Straws
directions: Preheat oven to 400°., Use a cookie sheet., Thoroughly combine all ingredients., Put through cookie press with star tip onto cookie sheet. Bake for 10 minutes. Store cooled straws in airtight container., Makes about 90.

title: Texas Chili Beef
directions: Heat the oil in a large heavy bottomed skillet, add the onions, red pepper and garlic, if using, and cook gently for 5 minutes, until the onion and pepper are soft., Add the beef, turn the heat to high and cook until the meat is evenly browned, stirring with a wooden spoon to remove lumps., Remove from the heat and stir in the flour, chili powder, cumin and oregano., Add the tomato paste, the tomatoes with their juice and the beef broth., Return to the heat and bring to a boil, stirring., Season with salt, if desired, but not with pepper (chili powder flavors the dish)., Cover the pan and simmer for approximately 40 minutes., Stir in the cannellini beans and simmer for a further 5 minutes to heat through., Turn into a warmed serving dish and serve at once., Serves 4.

title: Frozen Fruit Salad
directions: Mix together well the sugar and cream cheese., Stir in Cool Whip and add the bananas, strawberries and pineapple., Freeze. Will keep in freezer for 3 months.

title: Fresh Cabbage Relish
directions: Shred cabbage and, sprinkle, with, 2, teaspoons salt in glass bowl., Let	set several hours or overnight., Drain well. Coarsely grate carrot., Cut	onion, into, thin slices., Add to cabbage. Add celery seed and mustard seed to cabbage. Bring to a boil the vinegar,, water, and sugar. Boil 1 minute. Cool and pour over vegetables	and, spices., Cover, and chill 24 hours. Will keep several weeks in refrigerator.

title: Pecan Wonder Coffee Cake
directions: *Sour cream or sour milk may be used instead.

title: Macaroons(Diabetic)
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Beat egg whites stiff but not dry; fold in sweetener., Add cornflakes, coconut, nuts and almond extract. Drop from teaspoon onto greased baking sheet; bake about 12 minutes., Remove at once from baking sheet.

title: Sweet Potato Nut Bread
directions: Cream butter, shortening and sugar., Add eggs, one at a time, mixing well after each addition., Blend in sweet potatoes., Sift together dry ingredients; add nuts., Stir into creamed mixture alternately with cold coffee., Pour batter into 2 greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pans and 8 greased muffin pan cups., Bake in moderate oven (375°) for 1 hour for loaves and 25 minutes for muffins, or until they test done in center., Cool 10 minutes; remove from pan and cool completely., Makes 2 loaves, plus 8 muffins.

title: Oatmeal Bake
directions: Cream well butter, white sugar and brown sugar., Pour 1 1/4 cups boiling water over 1 cup oatmeal., Add 1 whole egg, 2 egg whites (save yolks) and 1 teaspoon vanilla., Sift together 1 1/2 cups flour, 1 teaspoon soda, 1 teaspoon cinnamon and 1/4 teaspoon salt., Combine creamed mixture and oatmeal; gradually add dry mixture., Bake 30 minutes at 350°., When taken from oven, cover with following topping.

title: Dream Pie
directions: Beat whipped topping mix, 1 cup milk and vanilla in a large bowl., Add remaining 1 3/4 cups milk and pudding mixes., Blend on low speed., Beat on high speed 2 minutes., Spoon into pie shell. Refrigerate at least 4 hours., Store leftovers in refrigerator.

title: Classic Pecan Pie
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Beat eggs slightly in bowl., Add sugar, margarine and vanilla., Mix in pecans., Set pie shell on heavy-duty baking sheet., Pour filling into pie shell., Bake in 350° oven 45 to 50 minutes, until knife inserted midway between center and rim tests clean., Cool on rack to room temperature.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients together, except last 3., In a separate pan, melt butter., Add corn flakes and almonds., Spoon over mixture., Bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes., Serves 8.

title: Tired Mama Cake
directions: Put cherries and pineapple (juice and all) in cake pan (9 x 13-inch) and mix together., Sprinkle cake mix over fruit. Sprinkle chopped nuts over cake mix., Cut up margarine over top. Bake at 350° for 55 to 60 minutes.

title: Excellent Oatmeal Raisin Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Grease cookie sheets., In a large bowl, cream together the shortening and sugar until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time, beating well with each addition, then stir in the vanilla and sour cream., Combine the flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt and cinnamon., Gradually stir into the creamed mix., Finally, stir in the rolled oats, and your choice of additions., Bake for 12 to 15 minutes., Then let cool for 5 minutes.

title: Cranberry Fruit Mold
directions: Dissolve jello in hot water., Mash cranberry sauce and add to jello., Stir until smooth and add 1 cup cold water., Chill until thickened., Fold in apples and oranges., Pour into a 6 cup mold and chill until set.

title: Grandma'S Molasses Cookies
directions: Melt Crisco shortening in 4-quart saucepan over low heat. Remove and let cool., Add sugar, molasses and egg to cooled shortening; beat well., Sift together flour, soda, ginger, cloves, cinnamon and salt., Add to first mixture., Mix well., Chill 2 hours., Form into 1-inch balls and roll in sugar., Place on a greased cookie sheet 2 inches apart., Bake at 375° for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Barbecued Franks
directions: In skillet, brown ground beef and hot dogs in margarine., Add green pepper and onion., Stir in remaining ingredients., Cover; cook over low heat for 20 minutes., Stir., Serve in hot dog buns and spoon sauce over.

title: Lemon Bars
directions: Mix the first 3 ingredients like pie crust., Pat into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

title: Fettuccine Alfredo
directions: Gradually add fettuccine and salt to rapidly boiling water so water continues to boil., Cook, uncovered, stirring occasionally until tender., Drain., Pour back into heated pan., Gradually, but quickly, stir in butter, half and half and cheese, tossing quickly so butter will melt., Sprinkle with pepper and serve at once. Yields 6 servings.

title: Fruit Dip
directions: Combine with mixer and chill until ready to serve. Great with any fruit.

title: Jello Salad
directions: Cream together Jell-O and cream cheese., Add boiling water and mash with fork., Add pineapple, Cool Whip and nuts., Put in 9 x 12-inch pan., Chill and serve.

title: Quick Cobbler
directions: Mix sugar, milk, flour, nutmeg, cinnamon and baking powder together, then melt butter in a deep baking dish., Pour the first mixture over butter., Add fruit., Bake at 350° until crust rises and browns, about 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Barbecued Chicken
directions: Mix ingredients together; shake well., Baste chicken., Place over rack on bottom position., Broil chicken pieces., Baste with sauce., Cook about 1 hour, turn after 1/2 hour.

title: Gooey Cake(Serve As A Brownie)
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Mix cake mix, butter and egg., Batter will be stiff., Take spatula and pat into 9 x 13-inch greased and floured pan., Set aside., Mix powdered sugar, eggs and cream cheese with mixer for 5 minutes until good., Pour over top of cake mix., Bake for 30 to 35 minutes., Take remaining powdered sugar and sprinkle over the top when cake is done., Let cool and serve. Caution: Overeating this stuff will cause severe stomach ache, it's very rich!, I know!

title: Pumpkin Cookies
directions: Mix first 10 ingredients together., Add chocolate chips and nuts., Bake., Yields 6 dozen.

title: Chili Burger(Quick And Easy)
directions: With the ground beef, prepare as many patties as needed. Place on baking sheet., Sprinkle Worcestershire sauce to taste and broil in oven until done., Heat chili mixed with chopped onions. Remove cooked patties and place on bun., Pour chili and onion mixture on top of patties. Add cheese and onions., Top with top of the bun.

title: Lemon Torte
directions: In medium saucepan, combine egg yolks, lemon peel, lemon juice, salt and 1/4 cup sugar., Mix thoroughly and cook over medium heat until mixture just bubbles., Stir constantly or it will scorch. Cool., Beat egg whites until frothy., Gradually add 1/4 cup sugar and beat until mixture forms stiff peaks., Whip whipping cream. Fold in lemon mixture and egg whites; mix well., Cover the bottom of 8-inch square Pyrex dish with crushed graham cracker crumbs. Pour lemon mixture over crumbs., Sprinkle some crumbs on top and freeze at least 4 hours.

title: Seashore Shells
directions: Bake patty shells as directed on package., Meanwhile, combine and heat soups (undiluted)., Add fish and peas., Warm until just heated through., Spoon into shells., Serves 4 to 6.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
directions: Blend pudding, peanut butter, milk and Cool Whip together and pour in graham cracker shell., Keep in refrigerator.

title: Pecan Date (Cracker) Pie
directions: Blend first 3 ingredients; add chopped pecans and dates., Beat 3 egg whites and blend gently with mixture., Add almond flavoring. Bake in greased pie dish at 375° for 20 minutes.

title: Life Recipe
directions: Mix these thoughts and tears of joy and sorrow., Add sympathy for others., Fold in four cups of prayer and faith to lighten other ingredients and raise texture to great heights of Christian living., After pouring all this into your daily life, bake well with the heat of human kindness and serve with a smile.

title: Taco Bake
directions: Brown ground beef, onion and garlic; drain off fat and add tomato sauce, water, olives, flour, vinegar and chili powder. Simmer for 10 minutes.

title: Chicken Wings Buffalo Style
directions: Place wings on a cookie sheet., Melt butter with sauce., Pour over wings., Bake for 45 minutes.

title: Green Rice Casserole
directions: Cook spinach; drain well., Mix all ingredients together and pour into large greased casserole., (Add milk after hot ingredients are melted.), Bake in a 350° oven for 1 hour., Serves 8 to 10.

title: Hot Water Chocolate Cake
directions: Cream sugar, cocoa and shortening., Add hot water and stir until melted., Add sifted dry ingredients and blend; then add milk and vanilla., Bake in 350° oven for 30 to 35 minutes., Let cool and then frost and serve.

title: 14-Day Sweet Pickles
directions: Wash cucumbers., Cut a 1/16-inch slice off blossom end and discard., Leave 1/4-inch of the stem attached., Place whole cucumbers in suitable 1-gallon container., Combine 1/4 cup salt with 2 quarts water; bring to a boil., Pour over cucumbers., Add suitable cover and weight., Place a clean towel over container. Store at about 70°., On the third day, drain salt water and discard., Rinse cucumbers and re-scald container; cover and weight. Return cucumbers to container., Add 1/4 cup salt to 2 quarts fresh water and boil., Pour over cucumbers., Replace cover and weight; recover with a clean towel., On the fifth day, drain salt water and discard., Rinse., Makes 5 to 9 pints.

title: Chicken Dorito
directions: Cook chicken until tender., Cool and debone., Cut chicken into bite size pieces., Saute onion until tender., Combine chicken, soup, tomatoes and onion., Layer Doritos, chicken mixture and cheese., Bake in moderate oven until cheese is melted and the dish is thoroughly heated.

title: Kugali
directions: Fry bacon until it starts to brown., Add chopped onion., Fry until onion browns; set aside., Do not drain grease., Add this to potato mixture., Grate potatoes into cold water., Stir well. Drain., Add eggs, milk, salt, pepper and Accent., Stir well., Add bacon and onion., Bake at 350° until brown., Cover with aluminum foil and bake at 325° for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Low Sodium Pickles
directions: Wash cucumbers., Pack into sterilized jars., Place 1/2 clove garlic and 1 head dill in each jar., Heat vinegar, water, and salt substitute in saucepan, until boiling., Cover cucumbers with hot liquid, leaving 1/2 inch head space., Adjust lids., Process 15 minutes in boiling water bath., Allow 5 days to ripen.

title: Squash Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients in a large bowl, except for stuffing. Sprinkle stuffing in bottom of a greased 2 quart casserole dish. Pour mixture over stuffing., Sprinkle one cup of stuffing on top. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes or until bubbly., Serves 6 to 8 people.

title: Shepherd'S Pie(A Meal In One Dish)
directions: Brown ground beef., Add onion and cook until tender., Stir in tomato sauce and heat until bubbly., Put in bottom of a casserole dish., Put green beans (or corn) on top of meat., Put prepared instant potatoes on top of green beans (or corn)., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Shrimp Fettuccine
directions: Cook fettuccine as directed; set aside., In a large pot, melt butter and saute onion and bell peppers for 15 minutes., Add garlic, crab and shrimp and cook for 10 minutes., Stir in cream and then cheese, stirring gently until cheese is melted., Stir in fettuccine., When thoroughly mixed, pour into a 9 x 13-inch dish. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese., Cover with foil., Bake at 350° for about 20 minutes., Add salt and pepper to taste.

title: Old-Fashioned Apple Pie
directions: Combine sugar, flour cinnamon, nutmeg, and salt., Mix lightly through apples (sliced 1/4 inch thick)., Heap in pastry-lined 9-inch pie pan., Dot with butter., Adjust top crust and flute edges; cut vents. bake in hot oven (425 degrees) 50 to 60 minutes, or until crust is browned and apples are tender.

title: Carrot Cookies
directions: Pour boiling water over raisins and soak 5 minutes; drain. Combine sugar, shortening, egg and lemon extract in mixing bowl; beat well., Stir in carrots and drained raisins., Sift together flour, baking powder and salt; add to first mixture and blend well. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto greased baking sheet., Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes., Makes 3 dozen.

title: Cold Oven Pound Cake
directions: Cream shortenings; gradually add sugar and cream well., Beat eggs in one at a time., Add flavoring., Mix in milk and flour (with salt) at 3 different times., Mix well., Put in greased and floured tube pan and place in cold oven., Bake at 300° 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Apricot Salad
directions: Mix first 3 ingredients well and chill until wobbley., Add marshmallows, pineapple and bananas., Mix with slightly chilled jello and let chill until firm., Mix together pineapple juice, sugar, egg and flour., Cook and stir until thick., Cool., Mix cream cheese and Dream Whip., Put into cooked and cooled mixture with coconut or nuts., Makes enough for two 8-inch or 9-inch pans.

title: Apple-Orange Marmalade
directions: Peel oranges, remove white membrane; boil rinds until tender in water to cover., Let cool, then grind and chop fine., Divide peeled oranges in sections, combine with apples; add water to barely cover., Cook over low heat one-half hour., Add sugar and orange rind., Boil until thick., Pour into sterilized jelly glasses., When cool, seal with paraffin., Makes 10 or more glasses.

title: Homemade Noodles
directions: Mix eggs, milk and salt together. Add baking powder to flour and mix into first ingredients. If not stiff enough to make a stiff dough, add more flour gradually. Roll very thin. It may creep. Cover rolled pieces with flour and roll up. Cut into thin strips. May be cooked immediately or dried and stored. Noodles will be done when edges are not sharp.

title: Fruit Cake Cookies
directions: Cream oleo and sugar., Add eggs., Add dry ingredients., Add chopped fruits and nuts., Bake at 325° on greased and floured cookie sheet., (Drop dough with a tablespoon.) Remove from oven when desired brownness is, reached, about 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Rosemary Honey
directions: Bruise fresh leaves slightly and place in layers on the bottom of a small saucepan., Pour room temperature honey into the pan and cook over low heat., Stir the mixture just until the honey is warm, about 2 minutes., High heat will damage the honey.

title: Coconut Cake
directions: Combine and bake at 350° till done., Cool.

title: Lemon Luscious
directions: Soften butter and mix with flour and spread in square baking pan., Then, sprinkle pecans over the top of that., Bake at 350° for 15 minutes, then cool., Then mix cream cheese, powdered sugar and Cool Whip., Spread on cooled crust., Chill in refrigerator. Mix pudding and milk and spread over the top of the cheese mixture., Top with Cool Whip and sprinkle pecans on top, if desired.

title: Lemon Chess Pie
directions: Mix first 4 ingredients., Pour into 2 baked 9-inch pie shells. Top with nuts., Refrigerate.

title: Vanilla Ice Cream
directions: Beat eggs., Add sugar., Mix well., Mix in can milk and vanilla., Fill freezer with milk to 3/4 full., Freeze.

title: Corn Pudding
directions: Mix sugar and cornstarch., Add and mix remaining ingredients. Pour into a greased 1-quart casserole., Sprinkle with nutmeg. Place casserole in pan of water and bake of 300° for 1 hour and 45 minutes.

title: Blueberry Muffins
directions: In a bowl, mix together the flours, sugar, salt, milk powder and baking powder., Cut in shortening with a pastry blender until well mixed., Mix water and egg whites to blend, but do not beat. Add to dry mixture, stirring just to blend., Mixture will be lumpy., Fold in blueberries., Spoon into paper-lined muffin tins. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes until nicely browned., Makes 12 muffins.

title: Apple Cake
directions: Add sugar to beaten eggs., Continue beating until thick., Set aside.

title: Broccoli-And-Chicken Soup
directions: Bring water to a boil in a large saucepan., Add broccoli. Cover, reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes, or until broccoli is tender., Stir in soup and milk., Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until thoroughly heated., Stir in pepper., Pour into serving bowls., Top each serving with 2 tablespoons Parmesan cheese., Yields 1 quart.

title: Chili Con Carne
directions: Chop onion; brown in butter., Add beef., Let brown well and add tomatoes (put through sieve), peppers and garlic., Add beans which have been cooked for 1 hour., Simmer about 6 hours.

title: Egg Rolls
directions: Heat through until thick., Add pepper and garlic salt to taste., Cool completely before wrapping mixture in egg roll skins and seal rolls with egg yolk., Deep-fry in wok.

title: Marinated Carrots
directions: Add 1 large onion thinly sliced., Cook carrots not too soft; drain., Marinate overnight., Can be served cold but best when hot.

title: Molded Vegetable Salad
directions: Dissolve gelatin and salt in hot water; add cold water, vinegar, onion and pepper., Chill until slightly thickened. Combine vegetables and fold into gelatin mixture., Chill until firm., To fill a 9 x 13 dish, double this recipe.

title: Orange Pineapple Ice Cream
directions: Mix all together., Freeze in ice cream freezer.

title: Green Bean Casserole(Prep Time:  10 Minutes; Cook Time:  30 Minutes)
directions: In 1 1/2-quart casserole, combine soup, milk, soy sauce and pepper., Stir in beans and 1/2 can of onions., Bake at 350° for 25 minutes or until hot and bubbling; stir., Top with remaining onions., Bake 5 minutes or until onions are golden brown., Serves 6.

title: Tamale Pie
directions: Brown the onion, beef, salt and pepper, chili powder and tomatoes; set aside., Cook the water, 1 teaspoon salt and corn meal on the stove, stirring constantly until thickens., Pour the corn meal mush into baking dish; pour meat mixture over that. Bake at 350° for 1 hour., Top with shredded cheese.

title: Banana Pudding
directions: Combine sugar, salt and cornstarch in the top of a double boiler., In another bowl, beat egg yolks with 1/2 cup of the milk. When well mixed, add remaining 1 1/2 cups of milk and mix well. Add milk and egg mixture to sugar mixture., Before starting to cook the pudding, layer your wafers and sliced bananas in a 2-quart casserole.

title: Souper Burgers
directions: Brown beef and saute onion in oil until tender., Stir to separate beef., Pour off grease., Add soup and seasonings and cook 5 minutes., Serve on buns.

title: Gourmet Hominy Bake
directions: Drain and rinse the hominy., Generously butter a 3-quart casserole., Layer the ingredients in this order: hominy, green chilies, salt, pepper, sour cream, butter., Repeat the layers ending with a layer of hominy., Dot the top with butter and pour cream over all., Sprinkle with cheese., Bake 15 to 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Swiss Chocolate Squares
directions: Combine water, butter and chocolate in saucepan; bring to a boil., Remove from heat., Stir in combined flour and sugar., Add eggs, sour cream, soda and salt; mix well., Pour into greased jelly roll pan., Bake at 375° for 20 to 25 minutes., Frost while warm with milk chocolate frosting.

title: Toll House Pie
directions: Preheat oven to 325°., In large bowl, beat eggs until foamy. Beat in flour, sugar and brown sugar until well blended., Blend in melted butter., Stir in Nestle Toll House semi-sweet chocolate morsels and walnuts., Pour into pie shell., Serve with ice cream or whipped cream., Bake at 325° for 1 hour.

title: Chicken Pasta Alfredo
directions: Cook pasta as directed on package; drain., In same saucepan, heat Alfredo sauce over medium heat, stirring frequently., Stir in cooked pasta, chicken and peas., Cook 5 minutes more., Makes 4 servings.

title: Never Fail Pastry
directions: In large bowl with fork, beat butter and sugar until creamy, then blend this mixture with soft shortening., Combine flour and salt with fork; blend with butter mixture., Gradually stir in water until mixture cleans sides of bowl., On lightly floured surface, knead dough until just well mixed., Chill., Divide into thirds and roll out crusts., Bake at 450° for 13 to 15 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Easy Popcorn Balls
directions: Combine corn syrup and sugar and bring to a boil., Remove from heat., Stir in powdered jello until dissolved., Pour over popped corn, one quart at a time., Shape into balls and place on Saran Wrap to cool and dry, then wrap individually.

title: Crustless Crab Quiche
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., In medium skillet saute mushrooms in butter., Remove and drain well., In blender or food processor (metal blade), blend eggs, sour cream, cottage cheese, Parmesan cheese, flour, onion powder, salt and Tabasco sauce., Pour mixture in large bowl., Stir in sauteed mushrooms, Jack cheese and crab meat., Pour into 9 or 10-inch quiche pan., Bake 45 minutes or until knife inserted comes out clean., Quiche should be brown (golden) and puffed., Let stand 5 minutes before serving., Cut in wedges., Serves 8.

title: Apple And Cinnamon Crescent Rolls
directions: Peel, core and cut apples into eight or ten pieces each., (Use one apple per crescent roll.), Put the eight or ten pieces of cut apple on the crescent roll and roll it up., Place them in a deep baking dish., Mix 1 cup water and 1 cup sugar., Pour the mixture over the crescent rolls., Put a little butter on each one and sprinkle cinnamon over the rolls., Bake in preheated oven (350°) for 20 or 25 minutes.

title: Broiled Squash
directions: Place squash in a saucepan; add water to cover and bring to a boil., Cover, reduce heat and simmer 6 minutes or until tender but still firm., Drain., Cut squash in half lengthwise, leaving stems intact., Remove pulp, leaving 1/4-inch thick shells., Mash pulp; add chilies and next 5 ingredients., Stir well., Spoon mixture into shells., Sprinkle with breadcrumbs., Arrange squash on a rack in a roasting pan coated with vegetable cooking spray., Broil 5 1/2-inches from heat for 8 minutes or until browned., Serves 4.

title: Bread Pie
directions: Fill pie crust with crumbled bread., Cover bread with sugar. Fill with milk., Dot with little chunks of butter and cover with cinnamon., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Strawberry Shortcake
directions: Sift together the flour, baking powder, sugar, salt and shortening., Mix thoroughly with fork., Add milk to beaten egg and add slowly to make soft dough., Drop by tablespoon on greased cookie sheet for individual shortcakes or put in a 9-inch round cake pan., Bake in hot oven (400° to 425°) for 10 to 12 minutes for individual, longer for cake pan., Serve with fresh sweetened strawberries.

title: Ellie'S Divinity
directions: Cook water, sugar and syrup until it reaches soft boil stage. Add 1/2 of the syrup mixture to stiffly beaten egg whites., Cook other half of syrup to crack stage when dropped into cold water. Add this to egg whites, beating all the time., Add vanilla and nuts., Stir with a large spoon until it loses its gloss., Pour into buttered pan.

title: Fruit Cake Cookies
directions: Chop dates, cherries, pineapple and pecans., Dredge in a mixture of the next 5 ingredients., Cream sugar and shortening or butter., Beat in eggs, one at a time., Add vanilla., Add baking soda with warm water., Add this to the mixture with fruit and flour mixture., Stir well., Drop by teaspoons on cookie sheet and bake at 375° until done.

title: Wheat Germ Cookies(Sugarless)
directions: Heat water and dates together until mushy., Cream oil and dates., Add other ingredients in order given., Beat thoroughly. Add nuts or raisins., Bake on lightly oiled cookie sheet at 350° for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Fruit Salad
directions: Drain syrup from fruit cocktail; add enough water to make 1 1/2 cups liquid., Heat to boiling; add gelatin., Dissolve and let cool. Stir in fruit., Blend cream cheese, mayonnaise and lemon juice and add nuts., Pour half of the gelatin mixture into fruit mold and let set., Spread cream cheese mixture over first layer and pour in remainder of gelatin., Return to refrigerator until firm., Serve on lettuce.

title: Potato Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients except cornflakes and margarine., Pour into a greased casserole dish., Top with crumbled cornflakes and margarine., Bake 1 hour at 300°.

title: Maw-Maw'S Frozen Fruit Salad
directions: Cream together cheese and sugar., Add fruit and nuts., Fold in Cool Whip., Put in large rectangular pan and freeze.

title: Ella Eld'S....Finnish Bread
directions: Dissolve yeast and salt in warm water using a large mixing bowl., Add whole wheat flour; stir and add the 6 cups white flour. Knead thoroughly right in the bowl., Cover and let rise for 2 hours., Make dough into 3 round flat loaves about 1-inch thick (use a rolling pin)., Lay on a cloth to rise for 35 to 40 minutes. Cover with a cloth., Test dough by pressing lightly with finger. If the impression stays, it is ready to bake., If not, let dough rise a little longer.

title: Microwave Crunchy Caramel Corn
directions: In large microwave bowl, combine popcorn, cereal and nuts., In 4-cup microwave bowl, combine brown sugar, margarine, syrup and salt; microwave on High for 1 1/2 minutes., Stir, microwave on High for 45 seconds to 2 minutes, or until mixture comes to rolling boil., Stir in vanilla and baking soda (mixture will become foamy). Pour over popcorn mixture and toss to coat., Spread 1/2 of mixture in ungreased 12 x 8-inch pan., Microwave on High for 2 to 3 minutes or until popcorn is evenly coated, stirring every minute., Spread on foil to cool., Using same dish, repeat with remaining popcorn mixture., Allow to dry for 2 hours., Store tightly in covered container.

title: Peaches & Cream
directions: In bowl, combine flour, milk, 1/2 c. sugar, baking powder, vanilla, egg, and cook and serve pudding together., Mix well and pour into a 10-inch deep dish pie pan or 8x8-inch square sprayed with non-stick spray., Place peaches over the batter., In a small bowl, beat well: cream cheese, peach juice, and 1/2 c. sugar. Drop by large spoonfuls over the peaches as evenly as possible. Spread out over the peaches as evenly as possible, keeping at least 1 inch from the sides., In small bowl mix together 1 Tbsp. sugar and cinnamon., Sprinkle over the top., Bake at 350° for 35-40 minutes.

title: Polka Dots
directions: Combine first three ingredients, stirring well., Stir in morsels., Drop dough by rounded teaspoonfuls about 2 inches apart onto greased cookie sheets.

title: Beef And Rice Espagnole
directions: In skillet cook meat and onions until meat is browned., Drain off fat., Stir in tomato sauce, uncooked rice, water, olives, chili peppers, garlic salt, pepper and hot pepper., Bring to boil., Turn into a 1 1/2-quart casserole dish., Cover and bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes or until rice is tender., Add cheese cubes, stirring just until cheese is distributed., Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

title: Corn Casserole
directions: Mix and place ingredients in 8 x 8-inch pan and bake at 375° for 30 minutes.

title: Zucchini Bread
directions: Combine dry ingredients., Beat eggs lightly; add with sugar, oil and vanilla and add to dry ingredients., Bake 1 hour at 350°.

title: Knock Your Socks Off Carrot Soup
directions: Saute the chopped carrots and onion over medium heat in butter for 5 minutes, stirring frequently., Add the stock or bouillon and rice and bring to a boil., Cover the pot and simmer for 25 minutes or until the carrots and rice are tender., Put soup into blender jar and puree on low speed for a minute., Then turn to high speed until the soup is really smooth., (If the soup is too thick for pureeing, add a little extra stock.)

title: Layered Salad
directions: Layer in a large glass bowl in order given., Cover and refrigerate overnight or several hours.

title: Red Velvet Cake
directions: Beat egg., Add sugar, and then Wesson oil and vinegar., Sift flour and soda together., Add to mixture., Add buttermilk slowly. Add vanilla and cake coloring., Bake in 3 greased and floured 9 inch pans for 30 minutes at 350.

title: Sunday Dinner Roast
directions: You will also need heavy-duty aluminum foil.

title: Peach Glazed Carrots
directions: Arrange carrots in casserole dish., Combine preserves and butter; spoon over carrots., Heat in oven at 350° for 15 minutes, until hot., Serves 10.

title: Brownies
directions: Melt the chocolate and oil together., Beat in the sugar and eggs., Stir in the flour, baking powder, salt and nuts., Bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Christmas Punch
directions: Dissolve gelatin according to directions on box., Add sugar while hot., Add remaining ingredients and chill.

title: Cheesy Chowder
directions: Cook veggies in butter or margarine until tender., Add chicken broth, soup and pepper., Cover and simmer 30 minutes., Blend milk and flour; stir into chowder., Add cheese and parsley., Heat through until cheese melts and chowder thickens.

title: Chicken Stuffing Casserole
directions: Place chicken breasts in bottom of casserole dish., Place one slice of cheese on top of each breast, or sprinkle with shredded cheese., Pour soup and wine over top of chicken., Combine stuffing mix and margarine., Sprinkle on top., Bake 350 degrees for 55 - 60 minutes.

title: Mexican Salad
directions: Mix these ingredients together and pour dressing on just before you serve.

title: Sourdough Bread
directions: Evening:, Place starter in a large bowl and add these ingredients., Make into stiff batter., Rub with oil., Cover with plastic wrap and leave on counter overnight to rise until doubled.

title: Seafood Cocktail
directions: Divide seafood among 8 cocktail glasses, saving 8 shrimp for garnish., Serve Guacamole Sauce over seafood., Garnish with shrimp.

title: Breakfast Casserole
directions: Brown meat in pan., Crumble up and drain off fat., Chop or tear bread into small pieces., Grate cheese., Beat eggs; add milk and salt., Spray 9 x 12-inch pan with Pam., Combine meat, bread, cheese and egg mixture in large bowl., Pour into pan., Refrigerate overnight., Bake at 350° for 1 hour., Makes 12 servings.

title: Black Cake(This Cake Will Keep Up To A Year.)
directions: Preheat oven to 250°. Take 1/2 cup of flour and dredge raisins and currants in it; set aside. Cream butter and sugar thoroughly. Beat eggs until light. Sift remaining flour with mace, cloves and nutmeg. Add flour alternately to batter with beaten eggs. Stir in brandy and fruit. Pour into baking pan. Bake in 250° oven for 2 or more hours. Makes 36 servings. Preparation time: 2:50.

title: Sausage Dip
directions: Brown meat, adding onion, chili powder and garlic salt to taste., Drain off grease., Add meat and soup to crock-pot to heat through., Add milk, using 1 soup can., When heated, serve with white tortilla chips.

title: Fruitcake
directions: Combine eggs, mincemeat, condensed milk, fruit and nuts., Fold in dry ingredients., Bake slowly in a tube pan (250° or 300°), for 2 hours.

title: Deep Apple Pie
directions: Heat oven to 425°., Stir together sugar, flour, nutmeg, cinnamon and salt., Mix with apples., Put in ungreased baking dish., Dot with butter., Put pie crust over fruit., Put slits in crust. Bake 1 hour.

title: Elephant Stew, Texas Style
directions: Skin and dress elephant; cut in bite size cubes., Peel vegetables and cut into cubes., Put rabbits in; cut in half., Put in large pot; simmer gently for 24 hours.

title: Cajun String Beans
directions: Place neck bones in bottom of soup pot., Add potatoes, salt, onions, parsley, garlic and Worcestershire sauce., Place string beans on top., Add water to cover ingredients., Cover and cook slowly until done.

title: Eggplant-Oyster Casserole
directions: Peel eggplant and cut into 1-inch cubes., Boil in salted water 10 minutes or until soft. Drain and mash., Mix with eggs, salt, pepper, milk, melted oleo and 3/4 cup cracker crumbs., Add oysters and pour into greased baking casserole. Cover with remaining cracker crumbs. Dot with oleo and bake at 350° until brown.

title: Pineapple-Cheese Casserole
directions: Mix sugar, flour and pineapple juice drained from can., In greased medium glass casserole, put half of cheese, layer of pineapple and top with rest of cheese., Pour juice mixture over all., Bake at 250° for 1 hour until brown on top.

title: Aunt Patsy'S Bell Peppers(Microwave)
directions: Cut bell pepper in half, seed & clean., Mix all ingredients together and stuff bell peppers., Place in microwave glass dish 2-inches deep., Cover with wax paper and cook 19-20 minutes. Uncover, spread ketchup on top of peppers, return to microwave and cook uncovered for 2-5 minutes., Serves 6.

title: Country Butter Pound Cake
directions: Cream butter and sugar until fluffy., Add eggs, one at a time, alternating with flour., Add vanilla., Bake in a tube pan that has been greased and floured at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Sugar English Walnuts
directions: Combine and cook first 4 ingredients until it has a sugary look or makes a small soft ball when dropped in cold water., Add vanilla flavoring; stir in nuts to coat., Spread on wax paper to cool., Store in airtight container.

title: Baked Celery Casserole
directions: Cook celery 8 minutes in salted water., Drain., Mix celery, chestnuts, pimento and soup., Place in a buttered 2-quart casserole., Melt butter., Pour over bread crumbs., Add almonds. Sprinkle over casserole., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Scalloped Corn
directions: Beat egg in a butter casserole dish., Heat corn and milk, then gradually stir into beaten egg., Add salt, bread crumbs and cheese., Mix thoroughly., Place directly on the rack of a moderately low (325°) oven and bake uncovered for 30 minutes or until custard test done.

title: Dry Sugar Pickles
directions: First Day:, Let cucumbers and salt set in 1 gallon boiling water for 24 hours.

title: Rice For Weenies
directions: Start with your hot rice (with that onion already cooked in it, remember?)., Then add your cheese to the rice so it melts and coats the rice., Does it look like a golden field?, Well, then you're ready to add the cauliflower and the weenies and serve this nice and hot., If you have a bear sitting at the table while you eat this, the calorie count is cut in half., But don't expect to have no calories just because you invited two bears., And you can't subtract calories just because you have three bears there., Get the drift of this yet?

title: Stuffed Flounder
directions: Simmer peppers, onions, celery and garlic in butter. Let cool a little and mix together with bread crumbs, eggs, pepper and parsley. Add crabmeat and mix in. Put 2 to 3 tablespoons stuffing in center of each fillet. Place a pat of butter on stuffing and sprinkle over with lemon juice. Lap ends of fillet over stuffing and secure with toothpick; sprinkle with paprika. Put in greased baking dish and bake at 325° for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Corn Casserole
directions: Mix corn, margarine, eggs and cornbread mix together., Add sour cream., Stir., Pour into a greased casserole dish., Bake 1 hour at 350°. (May need to cover last 10 minutes of baking if top is getting too brown.)

title: Broccoli With Rigatoni Pasta
directions: Gently brown garlic in oil and butter., Be careful not to burn garlic or it will taste bitter., Add broccoli and stir as you heat pan., Add chicken broth; cover and simmer until broccoli is just al dente (still a little firm)., Cook rigatoni pasta until al dente; drain., Add half the fresh basil and mix together with the broccoli., Top with parsley, pepper, cheese and basil.

title: Needhams(Candy)
directions: Prepare and cook potatoes to make 3/4 cup., Drain., Add salt and mash., Melt oleo; add potatoes, coconut and sugar and mix well. Turn into a buttered jelly roll pan., Spread evenly., Refrigerate and allow to harden., Cut into squares and dip in coating.

title: Instant Fruit Salad
directions: Mix all together 24 hours ahead., About 1 hour before serving, add 5 bananas, quartered., Wonderful.

title: Lemon Pound Cake
directions: Combine all ingredients; mix thoroughly., Bake in tube pan at 325° for 1 hour.

title: Salsa
directions: Mix and cook for 45 minutes., Can like tomatoes, using hot bath.

title: Peanut Butter Eggs
directions: Mix butter and milk; add peanut butter,, flour and powdered sugar., Shape into small eggs., Lay on wax paper overnight.

title: Pot Roast
directions: Put roast in roasting pan., Cover with water., Add brown gravy mix; stir until dissolved., Add whole onion., Bake in oven for 3 hours at 350°., Remove from oven., Add vegetables; bake 45 minutes to 1 hour more.

title: Hamburger Casserole
directions: In a 3-quart pan, make scalloped potatoes., Leave out butter (hamburger takes place)., Fry hamburger and strain., Add to potatoes., Strain peas and add to potato and hamburger., Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Balls
directions: Mix first 5 ingredients together., Make into balls., Melt paraffin wax and chocolate bits., Dip balls in this and lay out on wax paper to dry.

title: Salmon Pickle Loaf(Diabetic Recipe)
directions: Combine ingredients., Pack into greased loaf pan., Bake at 350° for 1 hour., Let stand 10 minutes before unmolding. Servings: 8., Calories: 1 serving, 221., Exchange per serving: 1 bread, 2 1/2 low-fat meat.

title: Spaghetti Chicken
directions: Boil chicken and take off bone., Cook spaghetti in broth., Salt and pepper to taste., Brown green pepper and onion in oleo., Add cream of celery soup and mushroom soup., Mix well., Pour in casserole dish., Cover with cheese., Cook at 350° for 50 minutes.

title: Roasted Potatoes
directions: Preheat oven to 350° to 400°., Wash and scrub potatoes good. Dice potatoes in cubes with skins on., Put potatoes in large pot of water., Boil potatoes 10 to 12 minutes., Drain potatoes., Heat butter in a shallow pan that will allow them to be in one layer. When butter is hot, roll potatoes in butter until they are covered completely., Add salt and pepper., Place them in a 350° to 400° oven., Cook for about 1 1/2 hours, turning occasionally so they will brown evenly., (You may use a little vegetable oil when butter cooks out of potatoes.)

title: Date Nut Roll
directions: Use just enough canned milk to be able to form graham crackers into dough., Add dates, nuts and Marshmallow Creme., Mold into 1 large roll or several small ones.

title: Mozzarella Loaf
directions: Preheat oven to 400°., Cut Italian bread crosswise into 1-inch slices., Do not cut through bottom crust., Cut Mozzarella cheese into 1/4-inch slices., Place cheese slices and olives between bread slices., Then place the bread on a cookie sheet and bake for 15 minutes or until cheese is melted and the bread is hot. Sprinkle loaf with oregano., With a knife divide loaf into slices. Serve hot.

title: Turnip Casserole
directions: Cook turnips and onion in saucepan in a little water until tender., Drain and mash., Add next four ingredients to turnips and mix well., Spoon mixture into lightly greased 2-quart casserole. Sprinkle with cracker crumbs and cheese., Bake 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Vegetable Beef Soup
directions: Place chuck roast in a crock-pot., Cover with water., Add soup mix and tomato juice., Let cook all day or night., Remove meat from broth and cool., Remove any fat from top of broth., Place broth in roaster or large soup pot., Add barley, carrots, celery and beef broth., Simmer slowly until carrots are slightly tender. Add lima beans, corn and green beans., Let cook a while and add cabbage, cut fine., When that is tender, add peas., Then add the meat that has been trimmed of any fat and cut into small pieces. Simmer.

title: 7 Pounds Wings
directions: *Use if you want them a little spicy.

title: Cajun (15) Bean Soup
directions: Wash beans and rinse., Simmer beans in 2-quarts water, about 2 1/2 to 3 hours., Saute onion., Add onion, tomatoes, lemon juice and flavor packet to beans., Simmer another 30 minutes., Add sliced sausage the last 10 minutes of simmering., Serve with crusty pumpernickel bread.

title: Sand Tarts
directions: Cream butter and sugar., Sift flour, baking powder and salt. Gradually add flour mixture to creamed butter., Add vanilla and nuts., Drop in 1-inch balls on a greased cookie sheet and then mash slightly flat., Bake at 375° until brown., If desired, roll in powdered sugar., Makes 5 dozen cookies.

title: Shepherd'S Pie
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., In skillet, saute beef and onions until meat is fully cooked., Drain fat., Stir in tomato sauce and other seasonings., Spoon into 1 1/2-quart shallow baking dish., Spread mashed potatoes on top., Sprinkle with cheese., Bake 30 to 35 minutes, uncovered, or until cheese is melted and casserole is bubbly., Makes 4 to 5 servings.

title: Apple Butter
directions: Wash and cook apples until tender, then run in blender until smooth., Put in saucepan; cook with cider vinegar, sugar and spices on low heat about 1 1/2 hours, stirring occasionally., Pour at once into jars and seal., Process 10 minutes in boiling water bath at simmering temperature.

title: Rocky Road Squares
directions: In top of double boiler, over boiling water, melt morsels with sweetened condensed milk and butter., Remove from heat., In large bowl, combine nuts and marshmallows; fold in chocolate mixture. Spread on wax paper-lined 13 x 9-inch pan., Chill 2 hours until firm., Remove from pan; peel off wax paper and cut into squares. Cover and store at room temperature.

title: Unusual Meatballs
directions: Mix all together except soups., Make into 12 large balls or more small ones if preferred., Place in 9 x 13-inch pan or any baking dish., Mix soups together and pour over., Cover with foil or glass top of baking dish., Bake 1 hour at 350°., This can be made the night before and put in the refrigerator., Can be served with rice or potatoes.

title: Easy Breakfast Casserole
directions: Cook, crumble and drain sausage., Layer ingredients in order listed in 9 x 13 glass baking dish., Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes until firm., Serves 10 to 12.

title: Chocolate Buttercream Frosting
directions: Combine cocoa and sugar in a bowl., Cream butter with 1/2 cup cocoa mixture in small bowl., Add remaining mixture alternately with milk, beating to spreading consistency., Blend in vanilla.

title: Spaghetti Salad
directions: Cook spaghetti according to package directions., Drain and rinse., Add chopped vegetables., Pour Italian dressing and Salad Supreme over vegetable-spaghetti mixture., Toss before serving.

title: Refrigerator Rolls
directions: Dissolve yeast in warm water., Melt Crisco in boiling water. Add sugar and salt., Cool to lukewarm., Add eggs, yeast mixture and flour., Batter will not be stiff., Cover with greased waxed paper and refrigerate.

title: Jalapeno Cocktail
directions: In covered blender, combine ingredients and blend until smooth. Pour over ice into four 10-ounce glasses., Garnish with sour cream., Yields 4 cups or 6 servings.

title: Pie Crust
directions: Chill 1/2 hour, then roll out and bake at 425° for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Party Meatballs
directions: In a large mixing bowl, combine ground beef, eggs, bread crumbs, water and garlic salt., Season with salt and pepper., Mix well., Shape beef mixture into 1-inch balls.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Mix soup and cheese together., Layer all ingredients after cooking and draining the broccoli in a baking dish., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Sister Ann'S Braised Venison
directions: Salt each steak; dredge in flour and beat with a mallet or edge of saucer. Saute onions in the fat, then remove onions and reserve. Brown steaks well in fat on each side over medium heat. Be careful not to overcook it., Serve with onions on top., Make gravy with the drippings and 3 tablespoons flour. Serve in a separate bowl or return steaks and onions to gravy pan and simmer 10 to 15 minutes., Serve with rice or hot biscuits or mashed potatoes.

title: Oven Fried Chicken
directions: Shake chicken in bag with flour, salt and pepper., Melt butter and dip floured chicken pieces into butter., Roll chicken in potato chips., Place in foil-lined pan; cover with foil., Bake at 400° for approximately 1 hour., Just before removing from oven, remove foil and brown.

title: Broccoli Continental
directions: Arrange broccoli in a shallow baking dish., Arrange mushroom slices over this, then arrange olives, then pimento strips. Sprinkle lightly with oregano and garlic powder or garlic salt.

title: Microwave Peanut Brittle
directions: Stir together peanuts, sugar, syrup and salt in a large microwavable mixing bowl., Cook 4 minutes on High power., Stir and cook 4 more minutes on High. Stir in butter and vanilla., Cook 2 more minutes on High., Add baking soda and quickly stir until light and foamy., Immediately pour onto lightly greased cookie sheet and spread very thin., When cool, break into smaller pieces. Store in an airtight container., Makes 1 pound.

title: Praline Grahams
directions: Separate each graham cracker into 4 sections. Arrange in a jelly roll pan with edges touching. Melt margarine in a saucepan; stir in sugar and pecans. Bring to a boil, cooking 3 minutes, stirring frequently. Spread mixture over graham crackers. Bake at 300° for 12 minutes. Let cool and break apart. Makes 3 1/2 dozen.

title: Old Style Pound Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 325°., Grease bottom of loaf pan and lightly flour., Mix flour, baking powder and salt., Beat in eggs, one at a time., Gradually add sugar, beating all the time., Add to flour mixture, then add lemon juice., Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Marla'S Butter Pecan Carrots
directions: Peel carrots and cut into 1 1/2-inch pieces., Boil until tender (20 minutes)., Remove from heat, drain and add butter. Stir to coat all carrots., Add maple syrup and put mixture in a baking dish., Add pecans and cover., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Stir to coat., Sprinkle with parsley.

title: *Minute-Boil Fudge Frosting
directions: Place chocolate, sugar, milk, Spry, butter, corn syrup and salt in a saucepan., Bring slowly to a full, rolling boil, stirring constantly., Boil briskly for 1 minute., (On a rainy day or very humid day, boil mixture for 30 seconds more.), Cool to lukewarm. Add vanilla and beat until thick enough to spread.

title: Quick Lunch
directions: Split top of wieners lengthwise, fill with grated cheese, sprinkle crushed peanuts on top., Stick under broiler until sizzles.

title: Sweet & Sour Meatballs
directions: Mix jelly and chili sauce in a large pan., Roll meat into small bite size balls., Brown in skillet., Add meat to sauce and cook about an hour., (Crock pot works well.), Use toothpicks to serve for a party or serve over rice as a meal.

title: Butterfinger Dessert
directions: Combine all crackers and margarine; mix and put 2/3 of the mix in a 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Shrimp And Crab Casserole
directions: Saute vegetables until tender., Add soup, cheese, pimento, salt and pepper., Stir in crab meat and shrimp., Add Ritz crackers., Bake at 350° until brown, about 20 to 25 minutes., Dot with butter before baking.

title: Calico Beans
directions: Brown hamburg, onions and bacon., Mix in sauce and beans. Cook in crock-pot.

title: Peanut Butter Roll Candy
directions: Boil sugar and water until it spins a thread., Do not stir. Add egg whites and vanilla to thick syrup., Beat by hand until stiff. Roll out on powdered sugar board and spread with peanut butter about 1/2-inch thick all over., Roll like jelly roll. Slice and eat.

title: Crunchy Cheese Potatoes
directions: Combine the sour cream, milk, chives, salt and pepper., Add potatoes; mix., Spread in a 15 x 10-inch baking pan., Combine cheese and corn flakes; sprinkle over potatoes., Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes., Sprinkle with chives, if desired.

title: Festive Freezer Coffee Cake
directions: Grease a 9 x 9-inch metal pan., Prepare topping:, Mix brown sugar, walnuts, cinnamon and 2 tablespoons butter or margarine; set aside.

title: Chicken Broccoli Casserole
directions: Combine soup, mayonnaise, lemon juice and melted butter until smooth., Place broccoli in casserole dish., Add chicken and pour sauce on top., Sprinkle with bread crumbs., Bake at 375° for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Chicken 'N Biscuits
