directions: In greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish, combine chicken, broccoli and 1 cup cheese., Blend soup and 3/4 cup milk; pour over casserole., Bake, uncovered, 15 to 20 minutes or until biscuits are golden brown., Top with remaining cheese and onions and bake 2 to 3 minutes.

title: Gems(Christmas Springerla)
directions: Stir eggs and sugar; add sifted flour till stiff., Roll out about 1/8 or 1/4 inch thick., Cut with roller cutter., Let stand overnight., Sprinkle anise on top., Bake at 325° until light yellow.

title: Broccoli-Cheese Casserole
directions: Cook broccoli until dry., Combine with cottage cheese., Add eggs., Add flour., Add margarine., Stir well after each ingredient. Place in glass casserole., Spread cheese on top., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Buttermilk Pound Cake
directions: Cream the sugar and shortening. Add eggs, one at a time. Combine flour, soda and salt. Add alternately with the buttermilk. Add flavoring. Bake 1 1/2 hours at 325°.

title: Mike'S Brownies
directions: Measure all ingredients into one bowl., Mix with mixer on low speed about 5 minutes., Batter will be thick., Spread in a well-greased 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan., Bake 15 to 20 minutes at 350°.

title: Cocktail Meat Balls
directions: Mix all ingredients together except the last 3., Shape into 1-inch balls., Melt shortening in skillet; brown., Remove from skillet and drain., Heat chili sauce and jelly in a skillet., Stir until jelly is melted., Add meat balls., Stir until thoroughly coated and simmer, uncovered, for 30 minutes., Makes 5 dozen.

title: Hot Slaw
directions: Mix all ingredients and let set overnight., Will keep for up to 10 days., Also the longer it sits the hotter it will be. Excellent with pinto beans and cornbread.

title: Italian Cream Pound Cake
directions: Cream together sugar, margarine and shortening., Add egg yolks, one at a time, beating after each one., Mix together soda and buttermilk; add alternately with flour to first mixture., Add nuts, coconut and vanilla., Beat egg whites until stiff and fold into mixture.

title: Kraut Salad
directions: Boil and let cool the sugar and vinegar., Pour over mixture and let set 24 hours., This will keep for several days when refrigerated.

title: Creamy Wafers
directions: Blend shortening and sugar thoroughly., Add eggs, beating until smooth., Sift flour with salt; add to mixture, beating vigorously., Add flavoring., Drop from spoon onto lightly greased cookie sheet, about 3 to 4 inches apart., Place nut in center of each cookie., Bake in a 350° oven for 10 minutes.

title: Lina'S Frosted Braunschweiger
directions: Mix together thoroughly, braunschweiger, ketchup and mayonnaise., Form into loaf with damp hands as it will stick. Chill for 1 hour., Frost with softened cream cheese (Philadelphia)., Cream cheese should be frosting consistency; thin with mayonnaise., Serve with any type cracker., Makes 20 (1 ounce) servings., Very good to serve for weddings., Enjoy!

title: Grandmother Skupin'S Molasses Cookies
directions: Cream shortening and sugar., Add molasses and eggs., Beat well., Sift all dry ingredients together (flour, soda, salt, cinnamon and ginger)., Add dry ingredients to mixture and mix well., Drop by teaspoonfuls about 1-inch apart on greased cookie sheet., Bake 10 to 12 minutes at 350°., Makes about 4 dozen.

title: Quickie Trifle
directions: Cut each jelly roll in 3 pieces., Line sides and bottom of casserole with jelly roll., Pour half vanilla pudding over., Put rest of jelly rolls on top., Cover with remaining vanilla pudding. Top with Cool Whip., At Christmastime, it's god to substitute egg nog for milk.

title: Corn And Dumplings
directions: Mix well in glass baking dish all the ingredients., Dot with 1/2 stick butter., Bake at 350° until, set or it barely shakes in middle.

title: Fruitful Muffins
directions: Combine oats, flour, baking powder and cinnamon., Combine remaining ingredients and add to dry mixture., Stir until moistened., Fill paper-lined cups 3/4 full., Bake at 400° for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Gazpacho(Cold Vegetable Soup)
directions: Combine all ingredients in food processor., Puree thoroughly. Cover., Chill overnight., Serve with croutons., Serves 6.

title: Apricot Salad
directions: Cream jello and cream cheese and set aside., Bring pineapple and sugar to a boil, then add cream cheese and jello., Mix until dissolved., Add cold water and put in refrigerator until thickened around edges., Add Cool Whip and celery and refrigerate until solid.

title: Peppermint Delight
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Put in 9 x 13-inch pan that has been lined with crushed vanilla wafers., Sprinkle vanilla wafers on top., Let stand in refrigerator overnight.

title: Mrs. C'S Wine Bread(Fruitcake)
directions: Cream shortening and eggs; add grape juice., Beat 3 minutes. Add rest of ingredients., Divide into 3 greased pans and bake 1 1/2 hours at 300°., Pour Mogan David grape wine over breads when removed from pans., Cool and wrap in wax paper and then in foil. Store them in a tightly sealed can., If they get dry, coat with more wine.

title: Mexican Corn Bread
directions: Mix all ingredients in large bowl., Pour into greased pan and bake at 400° until brown!

title: Santa Fe Chicken
directions: Cut chicken into thin strips., Sprinkle with paprika, salt and pepper., Heat olive oil or butter in 10-inch skillet over medium-high heat., Add chicken to oil and cook for 2 minutes., Add chopped onion, green pepper and garlic to skillet., Cook until tender, about 4 minutes, stirring frequently.

title: Ham And Red-Eye Gravy
directions: Fry ham slowly, being careful not to overcook. Remove from pan. Make gravy in the pan ham was fried in. Pour a small amount of coffee or cream right from the pot. Add a little water and bring to a boil.

title: Seafood Casserole
directions: Toss all ingredients lightly except crumbs., Place in buttered casserole; sprinkle crumbs on top., Bake 30 minutes at 350°. (Freezes well.)

title: Cranberry Scones
directions: Combine flours, sugar, baking powder, salt and spices., Add butter, cut in with pastry blender until coarsely mixed., Make a well., Add cream, milk and lemon zest., Stir., Add cranberries; stir until dough coheres., Shape into ball., Place in center of greased baking sheet., Pat into a 9-inch disk., Score deeply into 8 wedges., Brush top with 1 tablespoon of cream and sprinkle with sugar., Bake at 425° for 25 minutes., Cut apart at score marks and serve hot.

title: Raisin Pudding
directions: Stir together bread pieces, white sugar, egg, 1 tablespoon flour and milk. Bake in oven until dry.

title: Orange Brunch Pancakes
directions: Stir together biscuit mix, oats, sugars and peel., Beat together eggs, milk, juice and vanilla with rotary beater; add to flour mixture., Stir until blended; let stand 5 minutes., For each pancake, pour about 1/4 cup batter onto hot, lightly greased griddle., Cook over medium-low heat for about 3 minutes until golden brown, turning once.

title: Vegetable Pie(Quiche)
directions: Grease pie plate., Cook vegetables until tender., Drain thoroughly., Mix them together with cheese and pour in plate., Mix rest of the ingredients and pour over the vegetables., Serve hot or cold.

title: Apple Pie Cake
directions: Cream margarine; add sugar and egg., Combine dry ingredients and add to margarine mixture., Stir in water, vanilla and chopped apples., Spoon into greased pie plate., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until done.

title: Squash Casserole
directions: Combine squash, water and salt and cook until just barely tender., Drain and set aside., Saute onions and peppers in margarine until crisp-tender (about 3 minutes)., Combine vegetables, egg and next 5 ingredients., Spoon into greased casserole or 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Green Tomato Mincemeat For Pie Filling(Low Calorie!)
directions: Chop tomatoes fine., Sprinkle 1 tablespoon salt over them and let stand 1/2 hour., Drain., Add chopped apples and raisins., Cook until done., (Tomatoes, apples and raisins may be ground in a meat grinder or chopped in a blender.) Add vinegar, cinnamon, cloves and sugar before cooking.

title: Perfect Pound Cake
directions: Add sugar to butter gradually and cream together., Add eggs, one at a time, then add cream., Add flour gradually, then add vanilla., Pour into a well-greased and floured tube pan., Drop pan to remove any bubbles., Bake at 350° for 1 hour until brown and springy., Freezes well.

title: Lyndon B. Johnson'S Sweet Potatoes
directions: Drain potatoes very well and mash., Add sugar, eggs, milk, 1/2 cup butter, coconut, vanilla and nutmeg., Pour into a greased 9 x 12-inch casserole., Combine brown sugar, flour, remaining 1/2 cup butter and nuts., Sprinkle over mixture., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Broccoli Rice Casserole
directions: Melt margarine in saucepan. Add onion and saute. Add broccoli with 1/3 cup water., Cover and slowly bring to a simmer. Continue simmering until broccoli is thawed. Add soup and Cheez Whiz and simmer again., Add rice; stir and pour into buttered baking dish. Bake at 325° approximately 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Carrots
directions: Mix all together., Bake in greased casserole at 350° for 15 minutes., Remove from oven and add bread crumbs and slivered pecans., Return to oven for 15 minutes more to brown crumbs. Serve at once from the oven.

title: Cabbage Casserole
directions: Cut up cabbage and boil until tender. Fry ground pork until brown; add seasonings, Ro-Tel tomatoes and cabbage., Cook for about 45 minutes., Add salt and black pepper to taste., Add 1/2 cup bread crumbs to mixture. Cook about 2 to 3 minutes., Pour into baking dish and sprinkle remaining crumbs on top., Bake at 350° until bread crumbs are brown.

title: Mary'S Peanut Butter Cookies
directions: Spoon dough onto cookie sheet and bake at 300° for about 10 minutes.

title: Five Minute Fudge
directions: Place chocolate chips, condensed milk and butter in a large microwave-safe bowl. Microwave at Medium (50%) until chocolate chips are melted, about 5 minutes, stirring twice during cooking. Remove from microwave., Stir in flavoring and nuts. Pour into a "Pam" sprayed 8 x 8-inch baking dish., Refrigerate until set., (If you don't eat it all the first day, refrigerate any leftovers.)

title: Vidalia Onion Dip
directions: Mix all ingredients; put in a shallow dish., Bake at 325° for 20 minutes., Serve with crackers., Delicious!, Serves 10 to 12.

title: Artichoke Salad
directions: Cook artichoke hearts as directed on package., Rinse with cold water and cut each heart in half., Chill., Prepare remaining ingredients, keeping each separate., Lightly toss together lettuce, half of the cauliflower, half the tomato and all the chives in a large salad bowl., Arrange remaining ingredients in vertical rows over top of salad.

title: Potato Soup
directions: Dice vegetables., Cover with chicken stock., Add seasonings. Simmer until vegetables are soft., Spoon vegetables into a blender and puree., Return to chicken broth; add 1 can Cheddar cheese soup, undiluted., Stir until smooth., Adjust seasonings to taste; bring to boil., Sprinkle each serving with a little shredded Cheddar cheese and paprika., Serves 6 to 8.

title: Liverwurst Pinwheels
directions: Combine liver spread, chopped pickle, mustard and margarine. Trim crust from bread., Cut into 9 long slices; spread with oleo and 2 tablespoons mixture., Place gherkin strip across narrow end of each slice and roll up like jelly roll., Wrap tightly in damp linen towel., Chill 2 hours., Slice each strip into 8 pieces.

title: Gazpacho(Cold Spanish Soup)
directions: Combine onion soup and juice., Mix seasonings well and add to juice., Mix all liquids and add. Add vegetables or serve on the side., Chill soup at least 4 to 8 hours.

title: Fruit Salad
directions: Mix Jell-O with water., Add 7-Up., Soften cream cheese., Beat in pineapple, vanilla and sugar., Mix Jell-O with cheese mixture and nuts., Add desired amount of food coloring to give light green color., Pour in 8 oiled Jell-O molds or in an 8 x 8-inch pan.

title: Summer Corn Salad
directions: Remove kernels with paring knife and place in large bowl. Add tomato, onion and green pepper. Toss to combine. Add lime juice and olive oil. Snip cilantro and add to mixture. Season with salt and pepper. Serve.

title: Yum Yum Dip
directions: Combine all ingredients in large bowl., Mix well., Chill for 1 hour.

title: Salisbury Skillet Supreme
directions: In a large bowl, mix together the beef, rice, onion, egg, salt and pepper., Shape into 6 patties., Brown patties on both sides in oil., Drain vegetables, reserving liquid., Combine 1/2 cup of liquid and gravy., Stir in gravy and drained vegetables and thyme. Pour over browned patties., Cover and simmer 15 minutes.

title: Six Layer Dinner
directions: In order given, layer ingredients in greased 2-quart baking dish., Season each layer with salt and pepper., Bake, covered, at 350° for 1 hour., Makes 6 servings.

title: Cole Slaw
directions: Shred cabbage., Add other ingredients and mix.

title: Deb'S Dump Cake
directions: Layer pineapple, nuts, cherry filling and coconut. Sprinkle dry cake mix on top. Drizzle melted margarine over cake mix. Bake at 350° until lightly browned.

title: Mexican Cornbread
directions: Mix and bake at 475° about 15 to 20 minutes until brown.

title: Fruited Pot Roast
directions: In Dutch oven brown meat on both sides in hot oil., Remove from heat; add onion, carrots, wine, garlic, salt and pepper., Cover and simmer for 1 3/4 to 2 hours or until meat is tender., Meanwhile, pour 1 1/2 cups hot water over prunes and apricots., Let stand while roast is cooking., Drain, reserving liquid., Place fruit atop meat., Cover and cook 30 to 40 minutes more or until meat is tender., Remove meat and fruit to warm platter., Pour pan juices into measuring cup; skim off fat., Add reserved fruit liquid to pan juices to make 1 1/2 cups., Return to Dutch oven; blend together flour and 1/2 cup cold water., Stir into juices., Cook and stir until gravy is thickened and bubbly., Spoon some gravy over roast; pass remaining gravy around.

title: Barbecued Pork Chops
directions: Place pork chops in roaster., Combine remaining ingredients. Pour over chops., Cover., Bake at 300° or until meat is tender and gravy thick.

title: Enchilada Casserole
directions: Combine meat, green pepper, onion, chili powder and oregano; cook until meat is browned., Drain off excess fat., Remove from heat and add soup, water, enchilada sauce and garlic salt, combining well., In a greased 9 x 12 x 3-inch casserole dish, place a layer of tortillas, then meat mixture and the cheese. Layer any remaining ingredients, ending with the meat mixture on top., Refrigerate casserole for 24 hours or, if desired, freeze. To serve, bake at 350° for 45 minutes (longer if frozen)., Serves 10.

title: 20 Minute Apple Butter
directions: Combine all ingredients in saucepan and cook until candy is dissolved and mix is thick, about 20 to 25 minutes., Pour into hot jars and seal.

title: Layered Salad
directions: Layer in a 9 x 13-inch dish as listed., Use the mayonnaise to seal in the vegetables., Cover and chill 8 hours., Add the bacon bits after chilling.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Crush Ritz crackers and spread in bottom of casserole dish. Melt butter and drizzle over crackers, mixing well., Mix chicken broth, sour cream and cream of chicken soup together; boil, stirring until smooth., Add cut up chicken to sour cream mixture and pour over Ritz crackers., Bake at 350° until sides are bubbly.

title: Chicken Dijon In Pastry Shells
directions: Prepare pastry shells as directed on package., In a skillet over medium-high heat, melt margarine and cook half of chicken until browned; stir often., Remove and cook remaining chicken. Reduce heat to medium-low, add 1 tablespoon margarine, cook broccoli and mushrooms until tender and liquid has evaporated, stir often., Stir in soup, milk and mustard., Heat to boiling. Return chicken to skillet., Heat through, stirring occasionally. Spoon over pastry shells., Serves 6.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Cook chicken until done. Tear into small pieces and line the bottom of a 1 1/2-quart casserole dish., Mix chicken soup with milk., Pour over chicken. Put stuffing on top of soup mixture. Melt 1/2 stick of margarine and mix with 2/3 cup chicken broth. Pour over stuffing., Bake for approximately 20 to 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Lo-Fat Chicken Salad
directions: Boil boneless, skinless chicken breast in water., Cook until tender., Chop into bite size pieces and mix together with the other ingredients., Add salad dressing as you desire., Serves 12.

title: Alphabet Cupcakes
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., Sift all but C, F and K together in a mixing bowl., Add F and K; stir thoroughly with spoon., Add C and mix., Place heaping tablespoon in well-greased muffin pans., Bake 15 minutes.

title: Hot Chicken Sandwiches
directions: Mix chicken, soups, and bread crumbs to consistency for sandwiches., Bake at 350° until hot.

title: Punch Bowl Cake
directions: Bake cake according to directions on box., Cool., Crumble 1 cake layer in large serving bowl., Make pudding using the 3 cups milk., Pour 1/2 pudding mixture over cake.	Spread 1/2 of pie filling over pudding., Next spread 1/2 of pineapple, 1/2 of Cool Whip and 1 package of coconut., Repeat all layers.

title: Zucchini Stick Salad
directions: Slice zucchini and peppers into thin strips., Heat oil in frying pan; stir in zucchini and peppers to coat evenly., Cover and cook about 10 minutes, stirring occasionally until tender-crisp when pierced., Do not overcook., Remove from heat and stir in olives and green onions, 1 teaspoon garlic salt and pepper., Turn into bowl.

title: Chocolate "Philly" Fudge
directions: Gradually add sugar to cream cheese, mixing well., Stir in remaining ingredients., Spread into greased 8-inch square pan. Chill overnight., Makes 1 3/4 pounds.

title: Quick Peach Cobbler
directions: Place margarine in baking dish; melt in oven., Heat peaches, 1/2 cup sugar and water in saucepan until sugar is dissolved, then bring to a boil., Combine flour, baking powder, salt, remaining 1/2 cup sugar and milk in mixing bowl; stir until smooth., Remove baking dish from oven; add batter, then peach mixture., Bake at 375° for 20 to 30 minutes., Crust will rise to top and brown.

title: Souper Rice Supper
directions: In a large saucepan mix contents of soup can with equal amount of water., Bring to a boil., Fill can with Minute rice and add to boiling soup., Stir in 1 1/2 cups cooked vegetables (broccoli, peas or green beans), 4 slices American cheese and 1 1/2 cup cooked meat or fish., Stir, cover and remove from heat., Let stand 10 minutes for rice to cook.

title: Oriole Nectar
directions: Microwave 2 to 3 minutes to melt sugar., Fill with water to 1 quart., Add 4 to 5 drops red food coloring., Cool, store in refrigerator.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
directions: Boil sugar and milk for 3 minutes; remove from heat., Add peanut butter, vanilla and cracker crumbs., Beat until smooth.

title: Chinese Egg Drop Soup
directions: Beat the egg with a fork., Bring the broth to a simmering point., Remove from heat and slowly drizzle in the beaten egg, stirring slowly., The egg should become stringy-looking rather than making the soup appear milky., Garnish with parsley., Serve hot.

title: Peaches And Cream Pie
directions: Combine all ingredients except peaches., Mix at medium speed for 2 minutes., Pour into well-greased deep dish pie plate., Pour drained peaches over mixture.

title: Condensed Milk Pound Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 300°., Grease and flour tube pan., Beat together oil and sugar., Add eggs, one at a time, beating until well mixed., Add vanilla., Add flour and milk alternately, mixing well after each addition., Bake for 1 hour and 15 minutes., Cool for 15 minutes before removing from pan.

title: White Sauce
directions: Blend in blender until smooth., Mix thoroughly all ingredients and serve., May be used to make mock turkey, stuffing, etc.

title: Apple Strudel
directions: Thaw puff pastry for 20 minutes., Combine apples, raisins, cinnamon, sugar, nuts and crumbs., Unfold and roll out each pastry square to 13 x 10-inch rectangle., Place half the apple mixture along center line of pastry (lengthwise)., Brush edges with beaten egg yolks., Fold dough over filling, pressing edges together to seal., Place seam-side down on greased rimmed baking sheet. Repeat with remaining pastry., Brush tops with egg yolks.

title: Tamale Pie
directions: Mix corn meal with cold water in bowl., Add to boiling water in saucepan., Cook for 15 minutes, stirring frequently., Add salt and margarine; mix well., Remove from heat., Cool., Press into baking dish.

title: Potato Soup
directions: Brown beef or sausage. Stir in seasoning blend. Cook for 5 minutes. Add broth, soup and potatoes. Simmer for 30 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Asopado Puertorrigueno(Soup)
directions: Put everything together in a pot except the rice., After it has boiled abut 45 minutes, add rice., Boil until it gets thick. Add some water, if needed., Also taste for salt., Serves 2 or 3 people.

title: Blond Brownies
directions: Heat oven to 375°., Place butter in a 9 x 13-inch pan and melt in oven., Put brown sugar in large mixing bowl and pour the melted butter over it., Cream butter and sugar; beat in eggs., Mix in flour, baking powder, vanilla, pecans and chocolate chips., Pour batter into already buttered pan., Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until brownies just begin to pull away from sides of pan., When cool, cut in squares.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Saute celery and onion in butter until slightly brown and clear., Add rice and 1 package of broccoli, prepared according to package directions., Add cream of chicken soup and a small jar of Cheez Whiz., Mix well., Sprinkle bread crumbles on top., Cook at low heat for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Macaroni And Chicken Casserole
directions: Cook and drain macaroni., Mix together cream of mushroom soup, cream of chicken soup and milk until hot, then add seasonings and butter., Mix together with macaroni and chicken., Place in greased casserole., Top with grated cheese., Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

title: Turtle Cookies
directions: Mix brown sugar, margarine, water and vanilla., Stir in flour and salt until dough holds together (if dough is dry, stir in 1 to 2 teaspoons of water). Cut caramels into fourths., Shape dough by teaspoonfuls around caramel pieces., Press dough into center of each pecan half., Bake until done, 12 to 15 minutes., Cool.

title: Chocolate, Coconut Cake
directions: Prepare cake mix as directed on package., Chop 2 squares of the chocolate into cake mix., Bake cake in 4 layers.

title: Pig In Blanket
directions: Cut biscuits in half., Wrap around sausage; bake at 450° about 10 minutes or until brown.

title: Frozen Strawberry Pie
directions: In a large bowl, combine Cool Whip, milk, lemon juice and strawberries. Mix thoroughly. Put in pie shells and freeze. Remove from freezer 1 hour before serving. Garnish with fresh strawberries.

title: Quick Tuna Casserole
directions: Combine soup and milk in casserole dish. Add tuna, 1 cup potato chips and peas; blend. Sprinkle remaining chips on top. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

title: Vanilla Custard
directions: In a small, heavy saucepan, whisk milk and cornstarch until blended., Whisk in eggs, sugar, salt and vanilla., Cook over medium low heat, whisking constantly, until mixture thickens and you can see the bottom when whisking., Cool., Makes enough to fill a 9 inch pan.

title: Oven Dried Jerky
directions: Trim semi-frozen meat and slice 1/8 to 1/4-inch thick strips. In bowl, combine all ingredients except meat., Stir until dissolved., Add meat; coat thoroughly., Let stand 1 hour or refrigerate overnight., Meat will absorb liquid., Remove excess liquid., Arrange strips close together on oven or cake racks in shallow pans., Dry meat on lowest temperature (150° to 200°) until it turns brown and feels hard (4 to 7 hours)., Pat off beads of oil., Cool and store in airtight bags or jars., Keeps indefinitely., Makes 1/2 pound., Can also be dried on top of wood stove on racks and pans., Turn strips often though., Very economical.

title: Apple-Peachie Sauce
directions: Prepare apples, core and chop up., Cut up peaches., Add dates. Blend slow in blender until smooth., Very good!

title: Swiss Steak
directions: Combine flour, salt and pepper and pound into steak., In large skillet, brown steak in hot oil on both sides., Add chopped vegetables, tomatoes or soup mixture., Cover and cook over low heat for 1 1/2 hours or until tender., Serve over mashed potatoes or rice or egg noodles.

title: Baked Ziti
directions: Saute the onion in the oil in a medium size saucepan until tender., Add the tomato paste, tomato sauce, water, oregano, basil, salt and pepper. Simmer, covered, for 10 minutes. Preheat the oven to 375°. Coat the inside of a 1 1/2-quart casserole with nonstick cooking spray. Combine the Ricotta and half of the Mozzarella in a large bowl. Add the cooked ziti and half of the tomato sauce., Stir gently to mix. Turn into the prepared casserole., Add the remaining tomato sauce. Sprinkle with the remaining Mozzarella cheese., Bake in the preheated oven for 25 to 30 minutes or until the cheese is melted and browned.

title: Eggplant Stuffed Artichokes
directions: Wash eggplant and saute in oil with onions, tomato and garlic. Steam artichokes until done., Stuff with eggplant mixture and serve hot.

title: E-Z Micro Banana Pudding
directions: Mix sugar and flour in large microwave bowl; gradually add milk (evaporated milk can be used)., Stir in eggs real well. Microwave 3 minutes., Stir., Cook in microwave 2 additional minutes., Stir., Cook until creamy or until desired thickness. Crumble vanilla wafers into pudding and add sliced bananas., Top with whole vanilla wafers., (One bowl only to wash.), Enough for two and company, too.

title: San Francisco French Toast
directions: Combine eggs vanilla extract, sugar and, orange juice, Mix well., Heat oil in skillet., Dip bread slices into egg mixture. Fry in oil until lightly browned on each side., Serve with syrup, powdered sugar and apple butter.

title: Cherry Salad
directions: Beat Eagle Brand milk and Cool Whip together, then add crushed pineapple, nuts and pie filling., Pour into serving dish, refrigerate to season.

title: Pepperoni Bread
directions: Let bread thaw and rise, as per the package instructions. Roll as flat as possible., Top with butter, cheese and pepperoni. Roll up like a jelly roll., Spread egg over top and seal., Bake on foiled cookie sheet at 350° for 25 minutes.

title: Chicken And Sausage Jambalaya
directions: Cook chicken in oil in a Dutch oven until chicken is golden brown; remove chicken., Drain, reserving 2 tablespoons drippings in Dutch oven., Saute onion and next 3 ingredients in drippings. Add water, rice, salt, peppers, chicken and sausage; bring to a boil., Cover; reduce heat and let simmer until chicken is done and rice is tender and water is absorbed., Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

title: Hamburger Corn Casserole
directions: Cook noodles. Lightly brown hamburger and onion; stir in noodles. Pour into casserole. Mix 1 cup bread crumbs with 3 tablespoons butter. Sprinkle on top. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Orange Pound Cake(Diabetic)
directions: Coat bottom of 9 x 5-inch loaf pan with vegetable cooking spray. Dust pan with 1 teaspoon flour., Set aside.

title: Mexican Dip
directions: Layer in a shallow Pyrex dish in order. Put in microwave for 5 minutes (longer for some microwaves). Serve with chips.

title: Fork-Tender Swiss Steak
directions: Season the steak and place it on a well floured cutting board. Cover the	steak, with, flour and pound it with a meat hammer. Continue, to turn, flour and pound the meat until all the flour is taken, up by the steak.

title: Oreo Cheesecake
directions: In food processor or blender, whirl 1/2 package of cookies, including fillings, until fine crumbs form., (Or place cookies in paper or plastic bag and crush by rolling with rolling pin.), Mix in butter.

title: Apple Salad
directions: Peel, core and chop apples into bite size pieces (sprinkle with lemon juice so they won't turn brown)., Add celery, raisins, cherries and 3/4 cup pecans., Mix well., Add 1 tablespoon sugar to mayonnaise and beat until smooth., Pour over mixture and toss. (You might have to use more or less mayonnaise.), Place mixture in serving dish and sprinkle the top with celery seed and the remainder of the pecans.

title: Party Spritzer
directions: Pour juice and mineral water over ice in a glass., Garnish with fruit as desired., Makes 1 serving.

title: Cheesy Meat Loaf
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Combine all ingredients except cheese. Make 1/2 loaf., Lay cheese on top of meat., Top with remainder of meat and cheese., Bake for 1 hour.

title: Spiced Tea
directions: Mix all ingredients together and store in airtight container. Add 2 teaspoons of spiced tea mix to 1 cup hot water for a delicious hot drink.

title: Glazed Ham Steaks
directions: Combine honey, mustard and lemon juice in mixing bowl; beat thoroughly., Grill ham steaks slowly over charcoal or cook under broiler. Brush frequently with honey sauce until brown and glazed on both sides.

title: Mexican Stuffed Shells
directions: Brown ground beef and drain., Combine picante sauce, water and tomato sauce., Stir 1/2 cup ground beef along with chilies, 1/2 cheese, 1/2 cup French fried onions and mix well. Pour 1/2 of remaining sauce mixture in bottom of a 10-inch round or 8 x 12-inch baking dish.

title: French-Style Green Beans
directions: Rinse beans well, trim stem ends and cut beans lengthwise (French-style)., Melt butter or margarine in medium-size skillet over medium heat; stir in chicken broth., Add beans; bring liquid to boil., Reduce heat and cook (covered) about 18 minutes., Add bell pepper, parsley, salt and pepper., Cook, uncovered, an additional 5 minutes., Makes 4 servings.

title: Easy Sweet Rolls
directions: Preheat oven to 425°., Lightly grease 9-inch round cake pan. Prepare basic biscuits, rolling dough into a rectangle, about 1/4-inch thick., Brush with butter., Combine sugar and cinnamon. Sprinkle evenly over dough., Roll up jelly roll fashion, beginning with long side., Slice into 1/2-inch slices., Bake 18 to 20 minutes., Makes 16 to 18 rolls.

title: Pan-Fried Squash
directions: Cook bacon until crisp., Add sliced squash and water., Cook, covered on low until done., Scorching slightly adds to taste!, Salt and pepper to taste.

title: Linda'S Cheese Straws
directions: Cut shortening into dry ingredients., Add water and mix as for, pie, crust., Place, dough, into cookie press and form dough in long lines on cookie sheet., Cut into desired lengths with sharp, knife;, separate slightly., Bake at 400° for 5 to 10 minutes (until lightly browned)., Cool and serve.

title: Chicken Mandalay
directions: Shake first 3 ingredients in bag with chicken until coated. Saute in oil until golden brown., Mix remaining ingredients in bowl and add to chicken., Simmer until chicken is cooked., Serve with rice.

title: Frozen Salad
directions: Cube 3 to, 4, bananas,	sprinkle with lemon juice., Add Eagle Brand milk, Cool Whip, cherry pie filling and nuts., Mix and freeze.

title: Cherry Batter Pie
directions: Melt butter in a 13 x 9-inch pan., Spread hot cherries on bottom., Pour batter over cherries., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Chili Rellenos Casserole
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Spray a 13 x 9-inch pan with nonstick coating., Spread chilies in bottom of dish., Cover chilies with cheese., Mix remaining ingredients in blender until well blended. Pour mixture over chilies and cheese., Bake 45 minutes in a 350° oven., Serves 6 to 8., Also good cold, cut into 1-inch squares for hors d'oeuvres.

title: Frozen Cranberry Salad Or Dessert
directions: Cream the cream cheese with sugar and mayonnaise., Add pineapple (drained) and cranberry sauce., Use mixer to mix well. Add Cool Whip., Put into cupcake liners and freeze., Or can be frozen in any dish desired., Thaw slightly before serving., A good way to store in freezer is to let mixture freeze and put into Ziploc bags.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies I
directions: Beat Crisco and sugars in a large mixing bowl., Add eggs and vanilla, mixing well., Add flour, salt and soda., Mix well., Fold in chocolate chips., Drop by teaspoonfuls on cookie sheet and bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Mega-Fudge Brownies
directions: Preheat oven to 325°., Butter and flour a 9 x 13-inch baking pan., Place sugar, butter and water in a heavy saucepan and bring just to a boil; remove from heat., Add chocolate chips and stir until smooth; blend in vanilla., Transfer to a large mixing bowl and beat in the eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition.

title: Carrot Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients. Bake 350 degrees till done. When cool top with frosting:

title: Shrimp With Feta Cheese
directions: Simmer tomatoes in a large skillet for 10 to 15 minutes or until tomato liquid is reduced by about half., Add shrimp; simmer just until they begin to turn pink; sprinkle with cheese., Cover skillet; simmer about 5 minutes longer or until shrimp are cooked and cheese is hot., Spoon rice onto a large serving platter; top with shrimp mixture., Sprinkle with parsley.

title: Grilled Lemon Chicken
directions: In a small saucepan, combine butter, lemon juice, water, soy sauce, paprika, honey, mustard, garlic, salt and cayenne pepper. Heat until butter melts, stirring well., Grill chicken over medium coals about 15 minutes per side or until chicken is done, brushing frequently with sauce., Makes 4 servings.

title: Blueberry Pudding Cake
directions: Put blueberries in bottom of 8 x 8-inch pan., Mix flour, baking powder, salt, melted shortening, 1/2 cup sugar and milk. Spread over berries., Mix 1/2 cup sugar, cornstarch and water. Pour over mix., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes., Serve warm or cold with whipped topping.

title: Yam Patties
directions: Place patties in a 9 x 13-inch pan., Heat the water, white sugar and brown sugar., Heat until sugar is melted good; pour over patties., Dot with butter and sprinkle with cinnamon., Bake at 350° until syrup is thick and they are bubbly.

title: Chocolate Chip Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients and bake in greased and floured Bundt pan at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Pork Tenderloin With Sherry And Cream Gravy
directions: Tie 2 pieces of tenderloin together in 3 or 4 places., Season with Worcestershire sauce, poultry seasoning and garlic powder. Place in baking pan (use meat thermometer)., Cook at 350° until thermometer reads 180°., (Well done pork reading on thermometer.) Remove from pan when done., Let rest 10 minutes., Slice and put on serving platter.

title: Raisin And Nut Bran Muffins
directions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees., Grease a 2 inch muffin tin. Combine bran and milk in a bowl and let sit for 5 minutes., Then mash with the back of spoon., Sift together the flour and sugar and add to bran., Add the beaten egg and the melted butter and stir until well blended, Do not beat., Stir in the nuts and raisins. Divide batter amount the muffin cups., Bake 15 to 20 minutes. Makes 12 muffins.

title: Sweet Cherry Mold(A Christmas Special)
directions: Put jello in bowl; add hot water and stir until jello is dissolved., Add cold water., Drain cherries and pineapple and add juice of both to jello.

title: Self-Rising Flour
directions: Mix all ingredients together. Store in tightly covered can or jar and use soon., Use in any recipe calling for self-rising flour., Yields approximately 1 pound.

title: Hot Pineapple Casserole
directions: Drain pineapple (save juice)., Combine flour, sugar and juice; mix., Add cheese and pineapple., Place in 2-quart casserole dish. Combine margarine and cracker crumbs and sprinkle over mixture. Bake at 350° for 20 to 35 minutes.

title: Broccoli Piquant
directions: Cook broccoli according to package directions., Meanwhile, cook bacon and garlic until bacon is crisp., Add vinegar; heat. Brown bread crumbs in butter., Pour sauce over hot broccoli and sprinkle with crumbs., Makes 3 servings.

title: Macaroni 'N Cheese
directions: Cook macaroni in boiling salted water; drain and rinse. Combine the mushroom soup, milk, onion and seasoning., Alternate layers of macaroni, soup and cheese in greased 1 1/2-quart baking dish., Bake in moderate oven at 350° about 45 minutes.

title: Fresh Fruit Salad With Creamy Orange Dressing
directions: Sprinkle apple chunks with the lemon juice to keep them from discoloring., Place all the fruit in a large bowl., Spinach bowl works well.

title: Monday Night Roast Dish
directions: Combine all ingredients except cheese., Bake at 350° for 35 minutes., Sprinkle cheese on top., Bake for 10 more minutes.

title: Refried Bean Dip
directions: Mix all ingredients in a 2-quart baking dish., Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 45 minutes., Serve with Fritos corn chips or tortilla chips.

title: Deviled Hamburgers
directions: Mix all, together, and	spread	with, fork, on	half of hamburger bun., Broil about 4-inches from flame about 12 to 20 minutes.

title: Chicken Tortilla Casserole
directions: Wrap chicken breast individually in foil and bake for 1 hour in a 400° oven., When removed from oven, save broth which has cooked out of chicken., Bone and cut up chicken meat; set aside. In a mixing bowl, combine soups, milk, onion, salsa and half of the chicken stock; blend well., Pour rest of chicken stock into a well-greased, large, shallow baking dish., Begin with a layer of the tortilla pieces., Sprinkle some of the chopped chicken meat. Pour some of the soup mix on top of chicken and then sprinkle with half of the grated cheese., Repeat layering process, ending with soup mix., Top with cheese., Bake 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Carrot-Sweet Potato Casserole
directions: Note:, Very good to serve with baked ham., All measurements are approximate.

title: Never Fail Pie Crust
directions: Mix flour and lard together. Set aside. Mix salt, vinegar, egg and cold water together. Add to flour mixture. Roll out the way you like it, thick or thin, and put in pie pan.

title: Quickie Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients together, except potato chips., Put in a casserole dish., Top with crushed potato chips., Bake for 1 hour at 350°.

title: Impossible Buttermilk Pie
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Grease 9-inch pie plate., Mix all ingredients until smooth 1 minute in blender or 2 minutes with a mixer., Pour into pie plate., Bake for 30 minutes., Cool and serve.

title: Fruit Delight
directions: Cut pears into bite size pieces., Mix dry pudding mix into juice., Pour juice mix over pears into large bowl with cover. Stir and place in the fridge.

title: Dirt Dessert
directions: Crush cookies until fine., Mix together margarine, cream cheese and powdered sugar., Mix pudding with milk and vanilla in a separate bowl., To the cream cheese mixture, add 12 ounce bowl of Cool Whip, then mix pudding into cream cheese and Cool Whip mixture., Layer cookies, then pudding, cream cheese mixture, ending with crushed cookies., Arrange in a 9 x 13-inch pan or you can also use individual flowerpots.

title: Shrimp Dip
directions: Soften cream cheese and mix all ingredients together., Chill and serve with chips and crackers.

title: Pineapple Casserole
directions: Cream oleo and sugar., Beat in eggs, one at a time., Stir in pineapple., Fold in bread cubes., Turn into greased 1 1/2-quart casserole., Bake uncovered at 350° for 1 hour., Great with ham or chicken.

title: Black-Eyed Pea Salad 1
directions: Mix together and refrigerate overnight.

title: Carrot-Orange Nut Bread
directions: Stir, together, flour,, baking, powder,, soda, salt and spices., Set, aside., Combine, grated orange peel and carrots. In large, bowl, cream, butter., Gradually, beat in brown sugar until fluffy., Beat, in eggs, one at a time., Alternately stir in flour mixture and carrot mixture until well blended., Stir in walnuts. Turn, into greased loaf pan., Bake at 325° for 50 to 60 minutes or until pick inserted comes out clean., Cool in pan 5 minutes., Turn out to cool completely.

title: Salmon Mousse
directions: Bone and flake salmon, draining off liquid and adding water to make 1/2 cup. Soften gelatin in liquid and warm until thoroughly dissolved. Add to mayonnaise, chili sauce, lemon juice, Worcestershire sauce, dill and pepper. Mix well. Add lox, cooked eggs, onions and olives; pour into a 6-cup mold. Chill until firm. Garnish with olives, parsley and pimentos. May halve recipe.

title: Pizza Casserole
directions: Brown meat and onion., Layer in dish hamburger, cheese, pepperoni, cheese and so forth, ending with biscuit mix on top. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Corn Casserole
directions: Thoroughly mix all ingredients except margarine and crackers. Place the vegetable mixture in a 9 X 13 casserole dish., Melt margarine and mix with crushed crackers., Spread evenly over the vegetable mixture., Bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes., Serves 12 to 15.

title: Chili(D'Alessandro'S)
directions: Saute onion in butter., Add beef and brown lightly; drain off fat., Add the rest of ingredients except kidney beans, tomato juice and chili powder., Simmer 30 minutes., Cool slightly., Add remaining 3 ingredients and simmer 1 hour., Serves 10 to 12.

title: Mildred'S Meat Loaf
directions: Mix first seven ingredients well., Shape into a loaf., Mix the remaining ingredients and pour over meat loaf., Bake, covered, for 1 1/2 hours and, uncovered for 1/2 hour at 350°.

title: Pasta E Fagioli
directions: Brown meat in skillet with salt sense and 1/2 teaspoon black pepper., Simmer, covered, with 1 cup water until tender., Salt and pepper from amounts given., In a large pot, heat olive oil over medium heat., Add onions, garlic, celery and carrots., Cook, stirring frequently, until onions are transparent., Add ground meat and remaining ingredients, except macaroni., Simmer, uncovered, for 30 minutes., Add macaroni; simmer 2 minutes., If mixture is too thick, add more chicken stock or water., Serve with bread sticks., Top with grated Parmesan cheese.

title: Fern'S Dinner Rolls
directions: Mix yeast and 1 heaping teaspoon to dissolve in 1/2 cup warm water; set aside., Mix together hot water, salt, sugar and shortening, then add eggs; stir., Add 4 cups flour; stir together, then add yeast mixture., Mix., Add 4 cups flour and stir thoroughly., Let rise and then shape into rolls., Drop into greased and floured pans., Bake at 425° for 15 to 20 minutes. Makes 2 dozen rolls.

title: Chilled Cucumber Soup
directions: Blend on high speed in blender, chopped cucumber and chicken broth 2 minutes., Add sour cream., Continue to blend 2 more minutes at high speed., Chill before serving.

title: Deep Dish Chocolate-Pecan Pie
directions: Combine first 5 ingredients., Mix eggs, milk and vanilla and add to dry mixture., Stir in pecans., Pour into prepared pie crust; bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Tuna Noodle Casserole
directions: Mix; put into large casserole., Top with crushed potato chips. Microwave 9 minutes on High, uncovered.

title: Healthy Lasagne
directions: In saucepan, cook turkey., Add garlic powder, oregano and basil., When cooked, add Italian sauce., In bowl, mix the cottage cheese, egg whites, pepper and parsley flakes., Layer 3 noodles (uncooked) in bottom of 13 x 9-inch dish, then the meat sauce, cottage cheese mixture and evenly sprinkle Mozzarella., Repeat. Bake at 375° for about 35 to 40 minutes., Add some water (1/4 to 1/2 cup) during baking if too dry., Let stand 10 to 15 minutes. Serve.

title: White Clam Sauce
directions: Saute the minced garlic in the olive oil on low heat for 1 to 2 minutes., Do not let garlic brown., Add clam juice (which you get from draining the chopped clams), and the white wine., Bring to a boil; add parsley and chopped clams., Cook for 2 minutes, then add to well-drained linguini which you cook according to package.

title: Hawaiian Baked Beans
directions: Combine all ingredients and mix well., Divide into two or more greased baking dishes., Cover tightly and bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours., Uncover and continue baking 20 to 30 minutes more., Yields 80 to 100 servings.

title: Chili Rellenos Casserole
directions: Rinse chilies; slit open and remove all seeds., In a 13 x 9-inch baking dish, alternate chilies with cheeses to make 2 or 3 layers., In separate bowl, beat egg whites until stiff., In another bowl, beat yolks until foamy., Beat in evaporated milk, flour, sugar and salt., Fold egg whites into yolk mixture., Pour over chilies and cheese., Bake at 325° for 25 minutes., Arrange tomato chunks on top., Return to oven and bake 25 minutes longer., Serve warm.

title: Donna'S Goulash
directions: Brown meat and onions together with garlic., When all browned, add beans and catsup., Simmer for 20 minutes.

title: Zucchini Nut Loaf
directions: In a mixing bowl stir together flour, cinnamon, baking soda, salt, nutmeg and baking powder; set aside.

title: Low Fat Chocolate Cake
directions: Spray a 9-inch cake pan with cooking spray and set aside. Stir first 5 ingredients together. Stir in remaining ingredients until thoroughly blended. Pour into pan and bake 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Oyster Dressing
directions: Break stuffing bread into small pieces and let stand., Simmer vegetables in margarine until tender., Add oysters and simmer 5 more minutes.

title: Buttermilk Pie
directions: Beat egg yolks and sugar together., Add oleo, flour, buttermilk and vanilla., Mix well., Pour in pie shell and bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Old-Fashioned Cocoa Cake
directions: Cream butter or margarine, sugar and eggs until fluffy., Beat on high speed of mixer 3 minutes., Reduce speed to low., Combine flour, cocoa, baking powder and salt., Add alternately with milk to creamed mixture., Blend in crushed candy., Pour into 2 greased and cocoa dusted 9-inch cake pans., Bake at 350° for 35 minutes. Cool 10 minutes., Remove from pans., Frost with frosting of your choice.

title: Paneton
directions: Place the yeast in 3/4 cup warm milk; let rest 3 to 4 hours. Beat the egg whites with the sugar, until it forms peaks., Add the pisco and the orange extract; set aside., Add the yeast into a big bowl., Add the rest of the warm milk, the melted butter, the egg yolks, the grated rind and the anise., Slowly add 3/4 of the flour and the egg white mixture., Beat until smooth., Set aside in a warm space until the next day.

title: Banana Nut Cake
directions: Sift together flour, sugar, baking powder and salt, then add shortening, 1/3 cup buttermilk and bananas., Beat vigorously for 2 minutes., Add 1/3 cup buttermilk and nuts; beat 2 more minutes and then fold in nuts., Pour batter into prepared pans., Bake in 350° oven for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Potato Salad
directions: Sprinkle potatoes with sugar and vinegar., Add onion, celery, pickles, seasoning and mayonnaise., Toss to blend., Fold in egg slices., Chill; add egg slices on top.

title: Vegetable And Ham Casserole
directions: Layer half of potatoes, onion, carrots and ham in a 2-quart baking dish., Combine soup, milk and pepper to make sauce., Pour half of sauce over vegetables and ham., Add remaining ingredients (vegetables and ham)., Top with remaining sauce., Cover with foil and bake for 1 hour at 375°., Remove cover and sprinkle with cheese., Bake another 10 minutes., Serves 6.

title: Simple Salsa
directions: Chop all ingredients., Mix together well and refrigerate for one hour before serving., Serve with white corn tortilla chips. Hot and delicious!

title: Stuffed Meat Loaf
directions: Cook Stove Top stuffing as directed on the box., Take hamburg; roll out on a flat surface about 1-inch thick., Take cooked ham; put slices to cover all hamburg., Take stuffing; put into a line towards the center., Even it all out., Roll into a meat loaf; cook in oven at 350° for about 2 hours., Enjoy!, Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Old-Fashioned Chocolate Cake
directions: Combine butter, sugar, eggs and vanilla in a large bowl., Beat at high speed for 3 minutes., Blend dry ingredients in separate bowl., Add with water to the creamed mixture., Pour into two greased and floured 9-inch layer pans., Bake at 350° until cake tester is clean and dry., Cool for 10 minutes, then frost with a buttercream frosting., Serves 10 to 12.

title: Ham Casserole
directions: Brown ham slices in hot oil., In a deep casserole dish or pan, place half the potatoes, carrots, onions, seasonings, cheese and margarine., Place ham slices on top of vegetables., Pour 1/2 the soup and milk mixture over this., Add the rest of the vegetables, margarine and spices., Sprinkle on cheese and add ham slices on top., Pour remaining soup mixture over top and bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours or until vegetables are tender.

title: Dream Balls
directions: Cook sugar, egg yolks, butter, dates, nuts and marshmallow cream 10 to 15 minutes on low heat until mixed., Add crisped rice cereal and vanilla., Form into balls., Roll in coconut.

title: Rice Pudding
directions: Scald milk and cool., Beat eggs until frothy., Add sugar, spices and milk., Mix., Add cooked rice., If to be served with fruit, cook it plain, otherwise may add raisins, dates or a small can of drained fruit.

title: Red Velvet Cake
directions: Mix oil, sugar and eggs, then sift dry ingredients and add other liquids., Bake in cold oven at 325° for 30 minutes., Makes 2 layers.

title: Chicken And Dressing Casserole
directions: Invite all friends and family that you know., Fish slow for 50., Mix up hush puppies from Martha White Hush Puppy mix., Get Mutt and Chris to fry 3 or 4 gallons of crappie fillet., Have everyone bring a dish of anything.

title: Ai'S Huli Huli Chicken
directions: Salt chicken several hours prior to cooking., Add all ingredients (except oil) and let stand 15 minutes., Add oil., Mix well and baste chicken as it cooks over coals.

title: Hungarian Mushroom Soup
directions: Saute onions in 2 Tbsp butter., Salt lightly., A few minutes later add mushrooms, 1 tsp dill, 1/2 c stock or water, tamari and paprika., Cover and simmer 15 minutes., Melt remaining butter in a large saucepan., Whisk in flour and cook, whisking a few minutes. Add milk., Cook, stirring frequently, over low heat, about 10 minutes - until thick., Stir in mushroom mixture and remaining stock., Cover and simmer about 10 - 15 minutes., Just before serving add salt to taste, freshly ground black pepper, 2 teaspoons lemon juice, 1/2 c sour cream and if desired, extra dill. Serve garnished with 1/4 c fresh parsley., Takes approximately 1 hour to prepare and makes 4 rich servings.

title: Poppy Seed Chicken Casserole
directions: Boil chicken and shred. Mix chicken, sour cream and cream of chicken soup. Mix together and add poppy seeds. Mix. Crush crackers and pour over chicken mixture in a casserole dish. Melt butter and pour over crackers. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Taco Soup
directions: Brown ground beef and onion., Add tomato sauce, water, tomatoes, kidney beans, green chilies, corn, beans and taco seasoning.

title: Mrs. Fields Cookies
directions: *Put a small amount of oatmeal into blender until it turns to powder., Measure first.

title: Easy Candy
directions: Put first 3 ingredients in microwave-safe bowl., Microwave 45 to 60 seconds or until melted (shiny)., Stir until well blended. Stir in nuts., (You can use any nuts.), Drop by teaspoons onto a wax paper-lined cookie sheet., Place cookie sheet in refrigerator for about an hour., Remove candy and place in Tupperware or tin with wax paper between layers., Keep in refrigerator., Delicious!

title: Mexican Chicken
directions: Layer crushed chips in 9 x 13-inch pan., Spread diced chicken over chips., Sprinkle onion and pepper., Mix soup, undiluted, and spread., Pour Ro-Tel over top., Bake 25 minutes., Last 10 minutes, cover with Monterey Jack or Cheddar cheese.

title: Rotel Chicken Casserole
directions: Boil chicken and save at least 1 1/2-quarts broth., If not enough broth, use 1 can of chicken broth with water to make 1 1/2-quarts., Saute onion, bell pepper and celery in butter.

title: Bims Candy
directions: Mix sugar, syrup and peanut butter., Add cereal and shape mixture into balls., Roll in confectioners sugar or coconut.

title: Apple Crisp
directions: Place peeled, sliced apples in a 9 x 13-inch pan., Pour water over the apples., Mix sugars, flour and margarine as for pie crust., Spread, on	top, of apples., Bake until apples are done. Serve with ice cream or whipped cream.

title: Pretzel Salad
directions: Mix together and press in bottom of a greased pan., Next mix cream cheese and sugar., Cream together., Stir in Cool Whip (sometimes you use more).

title: Italian Spaghetti Pie
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Grease 10-inch pie pan or 9-inch square pan., Cook spaghetti to desired tenderness; drain and set aside. Brown the beef with celery; drain., Stir in spaghetti sauce and mushrooms; simmer 15 minutes., Combine spaghetti, eggs, Parmesan cheese and garlic salt; toss., Place mixture in the prepared pan. Press evenly over bottom and up sides, forming a crust., Pour meat mixture over spaghetti., Sprinkle remaining Parmesan cheese.

title: Stuffed Burger Bundles
directions: Prepare stuffing according to package., Combine milk and meat. Make patties and pat to 6-inch circle., Top with stuffing., Draw meat up and over to cover stuffing., Place in casserole and pour remaining ingredients (combined) over all., Bake uncovered at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: New Potatoes With Black Peppercorn Butter
directions: Combine broth and peppercorns in a small sauce pan., Cover and simmer until reduced to 1/4 cup., Add Brandy and simmer until reduced to about 3 Tbsp., Cool., Blend peppercorns, butter, lemon juice, shallots and Thyme in processor until peppercorns are finely chopped., Cook potatoes until tender, and quarter., Place in a large bowl., Add green onions and 1/4 c. peppercorn butter. Reserve remaining butter for another use., Toss gently., Season with salt.

title: Cherry Cobbler Ice Cream
directions: Prepare Cobbler Topping., In large mixer bowl, beat together eggs and sugar., Add cream, pudding mix, vanilla and salt; beat well., Mix in pie filling., Pour into 4 to 5-quart ice cream freezer., Add milk., Freeze according to manufacturer's directions., Remove dasher., Add Cobbler Topping and stir until well mixed., Ripen ice cream., Makes 4 quarts.

title: Hens In A Basket
directions: Make stuffing on stove according to directions., Set aside.

title: Pumpkin Cookies
directions: Combine pumpkin, sugar, oil and egg., In another bowl, stir together flour, baking powder, cinnamon and salt., To dry ingredients, add pumpkin mixture along with 1 teaspoon soda dissolved in 1 teaspoon milk., Mix well. Stir in chocolate chips and vanilla. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto lightly greased cookie sheet., Bake in a 375° oven for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Lemonade Pie
directions: Mix milk and lemonade; fold in Cool Whip. Pour into pie crust. Top with additional Cool Whip. Refrigerate before serving.

title: Crab Swiss Bites(Appetizers)
directions: Separate crescent rolls into three layers., Place on ungreased baking sheet., Mix crab mixture together and spoon onto layer of crescent rolls., Bake 10 minutes in 400° oven., Makes 36 appetizers.

title: Easy Baking Powder Substitute
directions: Sift ingredients and store in airtight container., Use the same as purchased baking powder.

title: Chicken Turnovers
directions: Cook onion and celery in butter until tender., Stir in flour, gravy or cream, salt and chicken., Roll out dough on lightly floured surface to about 1/8-inch thickness., Cut dough into 4-inch squares., Spoon chicken mixture onto 1/2 of each square and fold over to make triangles., Press edges of dough together to seal., Stick top with fork to let steam escape., Bake in greased pan at 425° about 30 minutes until browned.

title: Fudge Sauce Supreme
directions: Melt butter and chocolate; blend in cocoa and sugar., Stir in cream., Bring to a rolling boil for 10 seconds., Makes 12 ounces.

title: Poppy Seed Muffins
directions: Combine flours, sugar, poppy seed and baking soda; stir., Add yogurt, egg white, vanilla and nuts., Pour in muffin cups sprayed with nonstick cooking spray., Bake at 350° for 16 minutes.

title: Sauerkraut Hot Dish
directions: Fry sausage with onion., Put into casserole dish., Drain sauerkraut and put on top of sausage., Make mashed potatoes and, while whipping potatoes, add grated Cheddar cheese., Put on top of sauerkraut; sprinkle grated cheese on top., Bake for about 30 minutes at 375°., Enjoy.

title: Hamburger Gravy
directions: Brown meat and drain., Mix soup mix in water and pour over meat., Mix well and let simmer for about 30 minutes., Serve over noodles, rice or creamed potatoes.

title: Coconut Cream Pie #2
directions: Mix all dry ingredients first., Add liquid ingredients., Cook on top of stove until mixture becomes firm., Pour into pie shells already browned., Save egg whites for icing to go on top of pies. This recipe makes 2 pies.

title: Tuna Casserole
directions: Whip soup and milk in a 2-quart bowl., Stir in remaining ingredients except 1/4 cup cheese., Cover with lid or vented plastic, wrap and refrigerate 12 hours or overnight., Microwave on High for 15 to 17 minutes., Sprinkle reserved cheese on top. Let stand 5 minutes or until cheese melts., Serves 4.

title: Microwave Party Potatoes
directions: Place potatoes and water in 3-quart casserole., Cook, covered, on power 20 to 25 minutes, or until potatoes are tender., Stir halfway through cooking., Drain., Beat together cream cheese, onion dip, salt, pepper and garlic salt in large mixing bowl until well blended., Add hot potatoes one at a time, beating until light and fluffy., Spoon potatoes in 2-quart casserole., Dot with margarine as desired., Heat, covered, on full power 4 to 6 minutes or until heated through., Sprinkle with paprika as desired before serving.

title: Homemade Chili
directions: Brown hamburger meat with onions; pour off drippings. Add tomato sauce; rinse can with water (1/2 cup more or less)., Use this water. Add chili powder, butter, vinegar and sugar. Simmer 15 minutes, then add beans and simmer 10 to 15 minutes more. Salt to your taste.

title: Crunchy Chicken Cheese Bake
directions: Place chicken in an oblong dish., Top with cheese., Stir soup according to directions., Spread over cheese., Combine butter and stuffing., Sprinkle on top of soup., Bake at 400° for 25 minutes or until chicken is done., Serve over rice., Garnish with oregano.

title: Nana B'S Ham Sauce
directions: Beat egg in a saucepan., Add vinegar, salt, pepper and mustard., Cook slowly over low heat, stirring constantly (don't curdle)., Add currant jelly and catsup., Heat., Serve on ham. (This is a tangy, delicious sauce.)

title: Seven-Layer Cookies
directions: Melt butter in 9 x 12 x 2-inch brownie pan., Spread crumbs over it., Sprinkle coconut over that., Sprinkle chocolate morsels over that., Sprinkle peanut butter morsels over that., Pour canned sweetened condensed milk over that., Top with nuts., Bake in 350° oven for 25 to 30 minutes., Cut into squares while still warm.

title: Cherry Delight Salad
directions: Thaw Cool Whip., Put in large bowl add all other ingredients and mix well., Pour into 9 x 13-inch dish and freeze., Remove from freezer and partially thaw before serving., Can be used as a salad with meal or as a light dessert.

title: Stuffed Mushrooms
directions: Use large mushrooms., Wipe clean with paper towel., Never wash or peel., Break stems off and cut them up., Saute chopped onion and celery until tender in butter., Add chopped mushroom stems when onion and celery mix is partially done., Saute until golden. Use plenty of butter., Add Italian seasoned bread crumbs and mix. Stuff raw mushroom caps and cook or freeze., Don't cook before freezing.

title: Barbecue
directions: In Dutch oven, saute onions and garlic until golden., Add brown sugar and cook until caramelized., Add other ingredients and simmer 15 minutes., Add meat., Bake, covered, for 5 or 6 hours at 325°., Uncover last half hour., Remove from oven and shred meat with 2 forks and return to sauce., Can be frozen.

title: Sourdough Dip
directions: Mix all ingredients except bread., Slice off top 1/4 of bread and hollow out carefully., Make sure there are no weak points. Fill shell with mixture., Put bread top back on., Wrap in foil and bake at 300° for 1 1/2 hours or at 350° for 1 hour., Bread from the top and inside are used as dippers., (You will need additional bread.)

title: Burnt Sugar Cookies
directions: Mix ingredients in order given., Bake for 10 minutes at 375°.

title: Mr. Z'S Hot Shrimp
directions: Shell, and,, if necessary, devein shrimp., Slice garlic and ginger, into, thin	slices;, add to butter in frying pan. Cook, on medium, heat., Add, peppers and, lastly, the shrimp. Cook only until shrimp turns red; do not overcook.

title: Grandma Hebel'S Stacked Salad
directions: Break large head of lettuce into bite size pieces., Put in, a large bowl., Add celery, onion, green pepper and peas., Salt lightly., Spread with one pint Thousand Island dressing., Be sure to cover all ingredients well., Sprinkle with sugar., Add cheese. Add bacon., Cover with aluminum foil and refrigerate for at least 8 hours.

title: Cornbread Squares
directions: In a mixing bowl, combine flour, cornmeal, sugar, baking powder and salt., Add eggs, milk and oil., Blend just until moistened., Spoon into a greased baking pan (8 or 9-inch square). Bake at 400° for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: White Trash
directions: In a large pot on very low heat, melt margarine, peanut butter and chocolate chips., Pour in cereal and with a large spoon, blend until cereal is coated., In a plastic bag, dump powdered sugar, then add coated cereal and shake until coated., Enjoy.

title: Cherry Pie
directions: Melt the margarine in the baking dish., Mix flour, sugar, milk and eggs., Pour mixed mixture in the baking dish., Do not stir. Pour can of cherries in the middle of mixture., Do not stir., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes., Let cool before serving.

title: Cherry Crunch
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Spread pie filling in bottom of 9-inch square pan., Sprinkle with lemon juice., Combine dry cake mix, nuts and melted butter., Mixture should be crumbly., Sprinkle over pie filling., Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes, until golden brown., Serve with ice cream, whipped cream or serve warm with coffee cream.

title: Beef Stew
directions: Coat meat with the flour, salt and pepper., Melt shortening in a Dutch oven or large pot., Brown meat thoroughly in the hot shortening., Add envelope of soup mix and the water., Heat to boiling, then reduce heat, cover and simmer 2 hours., Stir in carrots, green pepper, onion, celery, bouillon cubes (2) and bay leaf., Simmer 15 more minutes., Add potatoes and simmer another 20 to 30 minutes., Add frozen vegetables., Stir well and simmer about 5 more minutes or turn off heat and let set about 10 minutes, until vegetables are tender., If you prefer thicker stew combine 1 cup cold water with 3 tablespoons flour; stir in stew and heat to boiling., Boil and stir 1 minute., Remove bay leaf.

title: Pineapple Casserole
directions: Melt oleo; pour over the bread., Beat eggs; add sugar and pineapple., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes., Good with ham.

title: Shoepeg Corn Casserole
directions: Drain beans and corn., Mix all ingredients together, except crackers and margarine., Pour into greased casserole., Crush crackers and toss with melted margarine., Top casserole with crackers and margarine mix., Bake 40 minutes at 350°.

title: Vegetable Dip Or Baked Potato Topping
directions: Mix well and refrigerate for at least one hour., Great dip for raw vegetable plate or topping for baked potatoes.

title: Garlic Toast For Pasta Dishes
directions: Spread English muffins with butter or margarine., Sprinkle with garlic salt., Top generously with Parmesan cheese and sprinkle on some dried oregano., Place under broiler flame until browned., These can also be cut into fours before being put under broiler and served as party tidbits.

title: Million Dollar Pie
directions: Mix all together and fold in Cool Whip., Spoon into graham cracker crusts., Chill until firm., Makes 2 pies.

title: Turtle Cake #1
directions: Mix cake mix as on package; pour 1/2 of batter in 13 x 9-inch greased and floured pan., Bake for 15 minutes at 350°.

title: Saucy Sirloin Surprise
directions: Trim fat from meat., Cut into 1-inch cubes., In skillet, brown meat in shortening., Pour off fat., Add remaining ingredients, except beans., Cover; cook over low heat 1 hour., Stir now and then., Remove bay leaf., Chill overnight.

title: Fudge Squares
directions: Melt together chocolate and butter., Add eggs and sugar; beat well., Add milk, flour, nuts and salt., Pour into well-greased and floured pan and bake 45 minutes in 350° oven., Turn out on waxed paper and do not disturb until cold., Cut and roll in powdered sugar.

title: Quiche
directions: Preheat oven to 450°., Prick and bake pastry 5 minutes., Use quiche pan or standard pie plate., Cook bacon crisp., Remove from skillet., Pour off all but 1 teaspoon of fat., Cook onion in fat. Crumble bacon over crust with onion and cheese.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Mix soups, milk, mushrooms and pimento., Fold in cooked chicken; let stand about 12 hours., Add noodles; place in buttered casserole and sprinkle with almonds., No salt is needed., Bake for 1 hour at 350°., Makes 12 servings.

title: Our Best Brownies(A Delightful, Chewy Treat)
directions: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C)., Grease and flour an 8-inch square pan., In a medium bowl, combine eggs, vanilla and Brownie Mix., Beat until smooth., Stir in nuts. Pour into prepared pan. Bake 30 to 35 minutes, until edges separate from pan., Cool., Cut into 2-inch bars., Sprinkle or frost with Brownie Topper of your choice., Makes 16 brownies.

title: Buttermilk Pie
directions: Combine sugar and flour; blend in margarine (melted)., Add egg yolks, milk and water and cook until nice and thick., Pour into pie shell.

title: Zucchini Cheesy Onion Corn Bread
directions: In a mixing bowl, sift together the flour, baking powder and salt., Mix in the corn meal and sugar., Add, mixing only until dry ingredients are moistened, the oil, eggs, milk, zucchini, cheese and onion.

title: Small Fruit Cakes
directions: Mix all ingredients together., In small baking paper cups, drop heaping teaspoonful in cups., Place cups on baking sheet and bake 10 to 12 minutes at 350°.

title: Mimi'S Cobbler
directions: Melt butter in dish while mixing flour, sugar and milk. Pour into hot butter. Add fruit. Bake at 400° for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Peas And Cheese
directions: Mix the mayonnaise, sugar and pickle juice., Toss all together and serve.

title: Venetian Pasta Rolls
directions: Crumble sausage in skillet., Brown and drain., Add onion; cook until tender., Stir in 1/2 cup sauce and 1/3 cup Parmesan cheese. Cover each half of noodle with approximately 1/3 cup sausage mixture; roll up, starting at narrow end., Place seam side down in an 8 x 12-inch baking dish., Spoon remaining sauce over noodles; top with Mozzarella cheese., Sprinkle with remaining Parmesan cheese., Cover and bake at 350° for 30 minutes., Serve with additional Parmesan cheese, if desired., Serves 8.

title: Boiled Frosting
directions: Combine sugar, water, syrup and salt in saucepan., Stir., Boil slowly without stirring until mixture will spin a long thread when a little is dropped from spoon; hold spoon high above saucepan (238° to 242°)., In mixing bowl, beat whites until stiff, about 2 1/2 minutes., Pour hot syrup slowly over egg whites while beating. Continue beating until mixture is fluffy and will hold its shape. Add vanilla., Blend., Spread on cake.

title: Candied Carrots And Grapes
directions: Melt butter; blend in cornstarch., Add honey, lemon juice and cinnamon., Cook, stirring constantly, until mixture boils., Add glaze to sliced carrots and grapes., Stir to mix.

title: Frozen Sherry Punch
directions: Combine all ingredients thoroughly in a large bowl or pot. Transfer to five 1-quart freezer containers; freeze for at least 24 hours., The mixture will be slushy., To serve, spoon into wine glasses., Yields 1 1/4 gallons.

title: Lasagna
directions: Brown onion and green pepper in 1 tablespoon cooking oil., Add ground beef., Cook until beef is done., Drain well., Put back on heat; add Ragu, mushrooms and sauce mix., Simmer at least 1 hour or longer., Layer cottage cheese and lasagna (cooked until soft) in casserole dish until 1/2 inch from top., Top with Mozzarella cheese., Cook for 30 minutes at 400°.

title: Jewish Coffee Cake
directions: Grease and flour bundt pan., Melt 2 Tbsp. butter and pour into bottom of bundt pan.

title: Grandma Fay'S Cake Donuts(1898-1974)
directions: Mix first four ingredients., Sift flour and add baking soda and baking powder., Mix into other ingredients and add vanilla and nutmeg., Refrigerate dough overnight.

title: Tangle Britches(An Old York County, Pa Recipe)
directions: Cream together the butter and sugar., Add eggs, beating well. Sift in the cinnamon and enough flour to make a stiff dough., Roll out the dough very thin on a floured board to about 1/8 inch thick., Cut into rectangular pieces (3 x 5-inch)., Make 5 cups lengthwise in the dough 1/2 inch apart and 4 1/2 inches long so that the rectangle remains on one piece., Fry in hot, deep fat (360°) for 2 minutes or until they bob up to the top of the hot grease., When dropping them into the fryer, pick up the first, third and fifth strips and pull them upward., Let the second, fourth and sixth sag downward so that in frying, they get all tangled or as the Dutch say, "all through each other." Dust with powdered sugar or dribble molasses over them and eat hot.

title: Ground Beef Stroganoff
directions: Combine, ground, beef,, onion,, garlic and pepper; cook until meat, loses, its, redness., Stir in soup, mushrooms and salt; stir, well and cook until bubbling., Stir in sour cream and heat. Serve over noodles or rice.

title: Stove Top Sweet Potatoes
directions: Peel sweet potatoes or yams. Cut into thick slices., Rinse in cold water., Cover sweet potatoes or yams with water (use small amount of water as potatoes already have water in them). Bring to a boil (30 minutes). Add all the ingredients except for the marshmallows and butter., When potatoes are done, sprinkle with marshmallows and butter and heat until marshmallows and butter are melted slightly.

title: Drop Doughnuts
directions: Mix together and drop by spoonful into hot grease., Remove when done.

title: Quickie Fudge
directions: Blend powdered sugar and cocoa., Put in sifter, then into mixing bowl suitable for microwave oven., Add milk and butter; do not stir. Cook 2 minutes on High in microwave., Stir ingredients to blend., Add vanilla and nuts. Mix well., Pour into buttered dish., Freeze 20 minutes or chill in refrigerator for 1 hour.

title: Polish Angel Wings "Chrust"
directions: Whip all ingredients, except for vegetable oil, flour and powdered sugar., Slowly add flour until the batter is satiny. Roll out on a well floured board (the thinner the better)., Cut into long strips, then cut strips into 4 to 5-inch strips., Slit these strips in the center and pull one end through to make a bow tie., Deep fry these, about 6 to 8 at a time., When golden, remove from hot oil., Sprinkle with powdered sugar., Enjoy!!

title: Punch Bowl Cake
directions: Put a layer of cake squares into bowl., Put a layer of cherries, layer of French vanilla pudding and a layer of pineapple., Keep alternating the layers until all ingredients are used., Top with Cool Whip., Sprinkle with pecans., Refrigerate.

title: Mincemeat Mini Loaves
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Grease 4 to 6 mini loaf pans., In large bowl, combine flour, sugar, baking powder and salt., With pastry blender or two knives scissor fashion, cut in shortening until mixture resembles fine crumbs.

title: Party Potatoes
directions: Let hash browns thaw completely., Mix in order given., Bake at 350° for 1 hour, uncovered, in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.

title: Banana Bread
directions: Cream together the sugar and margarine until well blended. Add the eggs and beat well. Add the remaining ingredients and mix until blended., Pour into a greased loaf pan and bake in a 375° oven for 1 hour.

title: Strawberry Cake
directions: Place all ingredients in mixer; beat 4 minutes., Pour into 3 pans (8 or 9-inch)., Bake at 350° for about 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Crab Au Gratin
directions: Pick through crab to remove shell., Put it in a 2-quart casserole dish and set aside., Saute onion in butter., Remove from heat and add flour., Set back on heat and add milk immediately. Stir constantly until mixture thickens and comes to a boil., Add shredded cheese and stir quickly until it melts., Remove from heat., Salt and pepper to taste., Gently mix it with crabmeat in the casserole dish., (Top with buttered bread crumbs.), Bake at 325° for 30 to 45 minutes or until hot and bubbly., Can sprinkle with paprika before baking.

title: Zippy Beef Olive Spread
directions: Soften onion in sherry or water., Add to cream cheese and mayonnaise., Mix well., Chop finely the smoked beef and olives. Add to cream cheese mixture., Mix well., Form into ball or log. Chill., Serve with crackers.

title: Teriyaki Chicken
directions: Mix sugar, soy sauce, lemon juice, garlic and ginger until smooth., Pour over chicken and marinate several hours or overnight.

title: Potato Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Pour into lightly greased casserole dish., Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 50 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Mary Ann'S Chili
directions: Brown meat and chopped onion; drain., Place meat mixture and the rest of ingredients in a large kettle or Dutch oven., Simmer for 1 hour., Stir occasionally.

title: Corn Pudding
directions: Mix milk and egg together; pour ingredients together., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Tuna, Chicken Or Turkey Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Put in a, 9 x 13-inch pan. Refrigerate overnight., Sprinkle 1 cup buttered bread crumbs on top before baking., Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours., Let stand 5 to 10 minutes before serving.

title: "Wednesday'S" Frosty Look-Alike
directions: Put all ingredients into a blender., Whip it up and there you have an imitation of the brand name prepared item.

title: Nannie'S Eggplant Parmesan
directions: Saute chopped onion and garlic in vegetable oil., Add chopped tomatoes and tomato sauce., Add salt, basil, oregano and sugar. Bring to a boil., Simmer for 30 minutes.

title: Chicken Pea Pod Salad Oriental
directions: In a large bowl, combine first 5 ingredients., In small bowl, combine remaining ingredients, except lettuce., Pour over chicken mixture; mix well., Cover and chill at least 3 hours., Line serving bowl with lettuce leaves; spoon salad over lettuce., Makes 4 servings., Each serving provides:, 1 bread exchange, 4 vegetable exchange, 2 fat exchange, 3 calories optional exchange and 3 protein exchanges.

title: Quick And Easy Potato Soup
directions: Saute garlic and onions in olive oil in a 4-quart kettle., Add hot water, potatoes and salt to desired flavor., Cook for 15 minutes or until potatoes are tender., You may reduce the water to 6 cups and add 2 cups of milk after potatoes are done if you use dairy products., Serve hot with crackers and/or bread and butter.

title: Apple Nut Cake
directions: Mix sugar and oil well., Add eggs one at a time; add vanilla, then chopped apples., Sift together flour, baking powder, soda, cinnamon and salt., Last add chopped nuts., Bake in angel food pan 45 minutes to 1 hour at 350°.

title: Mock Margarita
directions: Use a 4-quart nonmetal container., Mix lemonade and lime concentrate, powdered sugar and egg whites with a whip., Add crushed ice and club soda., Serve in salt rimmed glasses.

title: Hot Bologna Sandwich
directions: Skillet fry the bologna in butter on one side., Turn over and as second side fries, place a slice of cheese on it., Serve on bread with some mayonnaise.

title: Corn Fritters
directions: Add to the eggs the salt and melted butter, then add the milk and flour, sifted with baking powder., Stir in the well beaten corn., Fry in small spoonfuls in plenty of hot lard.

title: Scripture Cake
directions: Cream butter and sugar thoroughly., Add well beaten egg yolks and beat well., Add honey; mix., Sift in dry ingredients., Add alternately with milk to the butter mixture., Beat until smooth. Add chopped nuts and fruit., Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites. Pour into a greased paper lined 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 1 hour 15 minutes.

title: Poly Whipped Topping(Low-Fat)
directions: Chill a small mixing bowl., Soften gelatin with 2 teaspoons cold water, then add the boiling water, stirring, until gelatin is completely dissolved., Cool until tepid., Place ice water and nonfat dry milk in the chilled mixing bowl., Beat at high speed until the mixture forms stiff peaks., Add the sugar, still beating, then the oil and the gelatin., Place in freezer for about 15 minutes, then transfer to the refrigerator until ready for use. Stir before using to retain a creamy mixture., Yield: 2 cups.

title: Chocolate Pie
directions: Cook ingredients until thick., Pour into baked pie shell., Use egg whites for meringue; put on pie.

title: Easy Cream Cheese Fruit Bars
directions: Preheat oven to 325°., To prepare crust:, In a medium saucepan, place 1/4 cup sugar and butter., Heat until butter is melted, stirring occasionally., Stir in graham cracker crumbs. Press mixture evenly over the bottom of a 13 x 9-inch baking pan. In a large bowl with an electric mixer, beat cream cheese until smooth., Gradually beat in remaining 3/4 cup sugar., Beat in eggs, one at a time., Add vanilla., Blend well., Spoon blueberry filling evenly over crust., Carefully pour cream cheese mixture over blueberries., Bake just until set, 45 to 50 minutes., Cool. Chill until cold, about 2 hours or longer., Cut into squares.

title: Cheesy Potato Bake
directions: May substitute regular hash browns for hash browns O'Brien with onions and peppers., This would eliminate the oleo and onion. May also use Fiesta Cheddar cheese soup with peppers, instead of the regular Cheddar cheese soup.

title: Pineapple Sauce
directions: In a saucepan, combine pineapple and cornstarch. Stir. Add honey, soy sauce and cider vinegar., Heat ingredients for 5 minutes until thickened., This sauce is poured over sliced ham when it is served., Do not pour over ham when it is baking.

title: Punch
directions: Combine all ingredients and chill.

title: Mocha Bundt Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Grease and flour Bundt cake pan, shaking out excess., Combine first 7 ingredients in large bowl and beat thoroughly., Pour into pan., Bake until tester inserted in center comes out clean, about 50 to 60 minutes., Let cool 5 minutes in pan, then invert onto rack.

title: Rice With Black Beans(20 Minutes)
directions: Heat oil in large skillet., Add onion and garlic, cook and stir until tender but not browned., Stir in beans, tomatoes, water and oregano., Bring to boil., Stir in rice., Return to boil. Reduce heat to low; cover and simmer for 5 minutes., Remove from heat., Let stand for 5 minutes., Makes 4 servings., Recipe can be doubled.
