title: Baked Bananas
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., In small saucepan, combine sugar, butter, water, salt and lemon juice., Bring to a boil; cook briefly until syrupy., Add zest., Lightly smear a Pyrex (not aluminum) baking dish with butter (it's best to choose a dish you plan to serve it in, because transferring baked bananas is a tricky job). Split bananas in half lengthwise and place in dish so that they are cut side down and not overlapping., Immediately cover bananas with syrup and pop in oven., Bake for a total of 30 minutes., After 10 minutes, baste them with syrup., Repeat 10 minutes later.

title: 1 - 2 - 3 Chocolate Sauce
directions: Mix and bring to a boil, stirring constantly., Let it boil 1 minute, then add 1 teaspoon vanilla., Mix well for 1 minute. Serve warm.

title: Cocktail Meatballs
directions: Mix all ingredients except chili sauce and grape jelly., Roll into small balls and brown in a skillet., In a large pot (or crock pot), combine chili sauce and grape jelly., Add meatballs, and simmer until ready to serve., Serve with toothpicks.

title: Goofy Bars
directions: Mix for 5 minutes with mixer., Pour in pan., Bake at 325° for 35 to 40 minutes., Sprinkle with powdered sugar when done., Cut into squares.

title: Baked Rice
directions: Put all ingredients into a baking dish., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Hamburger Pie(Shepherd'S Pie)
directions: Run cold water over vegetables to separate., Cook meat and onions until meat is brown; drain. Stir vegetables and 1/4 cup water into meat. Cook, covered, 5 to 10 minutes. Stir in soup and 1/4 teaspoon pepper. Put mixture in 1 1/2-quart casserole. Prepare potatoes according to package directions., Put over top of meat mixture., Bake at 375° for 25 to 30 minutes., Sprinkle cheese over top the last 5 minutes of baking. Serves 4.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Mix sugar, butter, cocoa and milk together., Bring to a boil. Remove from heat and add peanut butter, vanilla and oatmeal. Drop by spoonfuls on tin foil or wax paper., Leave until cooled.

title: Country Cornbread
directions: Heat oil in a seasoned cast-iron skillet at 350°., Mix the remaining ingredients together., Remove the hot oil from the oven and add oil to the mix., Pour mixture into hot skillet and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Cauliflower And Broccoli Medley
directions: Cut cauliflower and broccoli into bite size pieces., Mix in large bowl., Mix dressing well., Pour over vegetables; toss gently., Chill before serving., Place onion rings on top.

title: Herb Bread Sticks
directions: Melt oleo., Add garlic salt,, basil and parsley., Preheat oven to 300°., Cut buns into quarters, then half the quarters., Brush with oleo mixture on cut side., Place on cookie sheet and bake until crisp and lightly browned, about 30 minutes., Store in tightly closed container., Enjoy!

title: Fresh Italian Pasta Salad
directions: Place garlic, basil, tomatoes, olive oil and Parmesan cheese together in large bowl., Cook pasta according to directions and drain well., While still hot, toss pasta with other ingredients. Cover and cool., Best when eaten warm.

title: Cracker Tarts
directions: Mix the crumbs and baking powder; set aside. Beat the egg whites until stiff, then gradually add the sugar. Fold in the cracker crumbs. Add the vanilla and nuts. Place in paper muffin cups and bake until very light brown at 325°., Be very careful not to overbake. Top with whipped cream and cherries.

title: Fondue
directions: Melt cream cheese in double boiler., Add milk; stir until smooth., Add garlic, salt and Parmesan cheese., Stir again. Serve with dry French bread., Cut into squares or strips.

title: Potato-Cheese Soup
directions: Saute onion in small amount of oleo., Add chicken broth and potatoes., When potatoes are done add Velveeta, salt, pepper and sugar (1 teaspoon)., Thin with milk if desired.

title: Velvet Chocolate Frosting
directions: Combine sugar and cornstarch in saucepan. Blend in butter and boiling water., Add chocolate. Cook, stirring constantly, until chocolate melts and mixture becomes thick and smooth. Remove from heat. Blend in 1/2 tsp. vanilla., Cool to lukewarm. Frosts 1 eight or nine inch layer cake.

title: Old-Fashioned Lemonade
directions: Combine sugar and 1 cup water in a pan., Heat, stirring constantly until sugar is dissolved., Bring to a full boil. Remove from heat and cool.	Add lemon juice and 4 cups water. Refrigerate.

title: Broccoli
directions: Cook broccoli and drain., Melt 1/2 margarine; add to 1/2 pound cheese and mix with broccoli., Put into buttered casserole., Crush crackers; mix with remaining margarine and sprinkle over broccoli. Bake at 325° for 30 minutes.

title: Pistachio Salad
directions: Mix pudding and pineapple; add remaining ingredients., Chill before serving.

title: Banana Bread
directions: Cream shortening and sugar., Add vanilla and beaten eggs. Sift together dry ingredients., Add alternately with milk., Mix well, adding bananas and nuts., Bake in 2 loaf pans in 350° oven for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Barbecue Beef Sandwiches
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Shake flour in oven bag and place in large baking pan., Add barbecue sauce and chili powder and squeeze bag to blend., Add onion and beef; turn bag to coat., Tie off bag and bake for 45 minutes., Divide mixture evenly onto rolls.

title: Cocktail Hot Dogs
directions: Mix together ingredients and cover with barbecue sauce., Cook in crock-pot for 5 to 6 hours.

title: Pudding Poke Cake
directions: Prepare and bake cake mix as directed on package for 13 x 9-inch cake., Remove from oven., Poke holes at once down through cake to pan with round handle of wooden spoon., Holes should be at 1 inch spaces., After holes are made, combine pudding mix with sugar in large bowl., Gradually stir in milk., Beat with electric mixer at low speed for not more than 1 minute., Quickly pour half of thin pudding over warm cake and into holes., Let rest of pudding sit for 1 minute, then spoon and swirl over cake., Chill in refrigerator.

title: Mexican Corn Bread
directions: Mix all ingredients except for cheese., Pour half of mixture in hot skillet., Sprinkle half of cheese on top., Pour rest of mixture on top of cheese., Top with remaining cheese., Bake at 375° until brown.

title: Tarts
directions: Mix first 3 ingredients together., Roll out thin., Cut in 2 or 3-inch squares., Put 1/4 to 1/2 teaspoon of raspberry, strawberry or apricot jam on each., Fold over to make triangles., Seal edges. Or use a donut cutter and cut circles for bases and circles with holes to go on top., Seal edges and put jam in centers., This method makes very attractive cookies., Be sure to seal the two layers together and use only 1/2 teaspoon of jam on each cookie or the jam will "boil over.", Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 375° for 10 to 15 minutes or until lightly browned., Remove and put on brown paper to absorb oil., Yields 3 1/2 dozen.

title: Flat Bread
directions: Dissolve yeast in the warm water., Stir in 5 cups of flour, then stir in the rest, little by little, adding only enough to make a dough., Turn out on floured board and knead until dough is smooth and elastic and doesn't stick to your hands., Pat into a ball., Pour 1/2 teaspoon of oil into palm of your hand and roll dough ball around until it is coated., Put in bowl; cover with towel and let rise until doubled, 30 to 40 minutes., Punch down and divide into two portions., With your hands, flatten out each portion to a plate-size round., Brush rest of oil on top of rounds., Sprinkle one with sesame seed and the other with Italian seasoning., Put on baking sheets; cover with bowls and let rise until doubled, about 30 minutes., Bake in preheated 400° oven for 20 to 30 minutes until golden on top.

title: Popovers
directions: Grease 6 Pyrex muffin cups; place them on a cookie sheet and preheat them for 10 to 15 minutes in 425° oven., Combine all ingredients., Pour the batter in the heated cups., Bake for 35 to 40 minutes., Do not open oven during baking as it causes shrinkage.

title: Sausage Brunch Braid
directions: In a skillet over medium heat, cook sausage, onion, celery, green pepper and garlic until meat is no, longer pink and vegetables are tender; drain. Add cream cheese, green onion and parsley. Cook and stir over low heat until cheese is melted. Set aside.

title: Party Punch
directions: Chill all ingredients., Combine each one finishing with ginger ale., Makes 2 1/2 quarts.

title: Creamy Broccoli Casserole
directions: Place cooked broccoli in a 9 x 13-inch dish., Melt the cream cheese, soup and margarine in microwave., Stir to blend., Pour mixture over cooked broccoli., Top with cheese slices., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes, or until thoroughly heated.

title: European Style Meat Loaf
directions: Mix all ingredients thoroughly in bowl., Bake at 375 degrees for 1 hour in loaf pan covered with foil., Uncover and bake for 10 more minutes to brown top.

title: Cereal Muffins
directions: Pour milk over cereal., Set 3 minutes to soak., Stir and add egg and oil., Mix in rest of dry mixture., Bake in muffin pans., I like to add frozen blueberries., Real good.

title: Cranberry-Apple Salad
directions: Dissolve Jell-O., Add cranberries, apples, sugar and nuts., Add celery and crushed pineapple, if desired., Pour into individual cups, decorative mold or 9 x 9-inch pan., Let set.

title: Low Cholesterol "Chicken"
directions: Place crushed Rice Krispies cereal and seasonings in large plastic food bag., Shake to blend well., Brush chicken on all sides with mayonnaise., Place one piece at a time in bag; shake to coat well., Place on rack in broiler pan., Bake at 425° for 40 to 45 minutes or until golden brown and tender., Serves 4 to 6.

title: Eskimo Cookies
directions: Mix butter, sugar, vanilla wafers and cocoa., Mix well., Add oats and mix., Put in refrigerator overnight., Roll in 36 balls and roll them in powdered sugar., Store in fridge.

title: Shrimp Linguine
directions: In large skillet, combine shrimp, wine, lemon juice and lime juice., Bring to a boil., Reduce heat; simmer, covered, 3 minutes. Add remaining ingredients, except linguine., Cook, stirring constantly, just until snow peas are tender and shrimp is opaque, about 5 minutes., Prepare linguine as package directs., Remove bay leaf from shrimp mixture., Combine shrimp mixture and hot cooked linguine; toss to coat., Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Twin Layered Lasagna
directions: Brown beef and drain., Add tomato paste and sugar., Mix eggs, Parmesan cheese, parsley flakes and pepper., In 13 x 9-inch pan, layer beef mixture, noodles, cottage cheese and Mozzarella cheese. Repeat layers., Cook for 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Spinach And Orange Salad
directions: Toss the oranges and spinach., Add desired rice vinegar and olive oil., Sprinkle with chopped walnuts.

title: Zucchini Relish
directions: Put the first 4 ingredients into a container and cover with 1/4 cup salt., Let stand overnight., Thoroughly drain next day.

title: Forgotten Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 400°., Whip egg whites while gradually adding sugar until stiff peaks form., Fold in vanilla., Stir in chips and nuts., Drop by spoonfuls onto parchment lined baking sheets., Put into oven and IMMEDIATELY TURN OFF OVEN., Leave overnight or at least 8 hours in turned off oven., Do not open oven door during this time.

title: Oreo Delight
directions: Crush cookies; add melted margarine., Mix well., Grease a 9 x 13 pan and line with cookie mixture., Soften ice cream at room temperature and spread on top of cookies., Melt 1/4 cup margarine and unsweetened chocolate., Add sugar and evaporated milk., Cook and stir for 10 minutes until slightly thickened., Drizzle over ice cream., Freeze overnight., Serves 12.

title: Sour Cream Apple Squares
directions: In a mixing bowl, combine flour, brown sugar and butter. Blend at low speed until crumbly., Stir in nuts., Press about 2 3/4 cups into the bottom of an ungreased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan.

title: Chewy Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Heat oven to 375°. Grease baking sheets with butter flavor Crisco. Place sheets of foil on countertop for cooling cookies. Combine butter flavor Crisco, brown sugar, egg, milk and vanilla in large bowl. Beat at medium speed of electric mixer until well blended. Combine oats, flour, baking soda, salt and cinnamon. Mix into creamed mixture at low speed just until blended. Stir in raisins and nuts. Drop rounded tablespoonfuls of dough 2-inches apart onto baking sheet. Bake 1 baking sheet at a time at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes or until lightly browned. Cool 2 minutes on baking sheet. Remove cookies to foil to cool completely. MAKES ABOUT 2 1/2 DOZEN COOKIES.

title: Spanish Style Rice
directions: Combine tomato sauce, water, onion, green pepper, butter, salt, sugar, mustard and pepper in saucepan., Cover and bring to a full boil., Stir in rice., Remove from heat; cover and let stand 5 minutes., Stir with a fork., Makes 3 1/2 cups or 4 servings.

title: Buttermilk Pound Cake
directions: Cream sugar and Crisco. Add milk and flour alternately. Add soda; mix well. Add eggs (one at a time). Add flavoring. Grease and flour tube pan. Bake 1 hour in 350° oven (in a cold oven).

title: Lamb Meatballs
directions: Mix, form into small meatballs and place in casserole dish.

title: Broccoli Salad
directions: Cut broccoli into bite size pieces., In salad bowl, mix broccoli, onion, cheeses and bacon., Mix mayo, sugar and vinegar and add to broccoli mixture., Toss well.

title: Pasta And Veggie Salad
directions: In a large bowl, combine all ingredients, except tomato and avocado., Cover and refrigerate at least 3 hours., Just before serving, stir in tomato and avocado., Has 120 calories.

title: Strawberry Bread
directions: Mix dry ingredients together, then stir in eggs, oil and strawberries., Grease 2 loaf pans., Bake, 1 hour at 325°.

title: Cream Cheese Pasta
directions: Cook pasta as directed by package., Cook vegetables as directed by package., Drain pasta and vegetables; mix all ingredients while pasta and vegetables are still warm., Serve immediately or chill.

title: Low-Fat Banana Shake
directions: Combine all ingredients in a blender and blend until smooth. Makes a great healthful treat with virtually no fat., Add any fruits to make different combinations.

title: Spinach And Strawberry Salad
directions: Combine all ingredients except the spinach and strawberries. Toss with the spinach and strawberries just before serving.

title: Poppy Seed Bread
directions: Mix all ingredients in bowl., Pour into 2 greased loaf pans. Bake for 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Easy Enchiladas
directions: Brown and crumble meat., In a large mixing bowl, combine 2 cans of enchilada sauce, tomato soup and 1 tomato soup can of water; mix well., Lay one side of tortilla in sauce and then drop meat and cheese on that side., Roll it up and put, seam side down, in a rectangular 13 x 9-inch pan that has been greased., When pan is full, pour remaining sauce over enchiladas., For more sauce, use other can., Sprinkle with cheese., Cover pan with foil; cook at 350° for about 1 hour.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
directions: Mix dry ingredients., Add oil, eggs, water, apples and nuts. Bake 1 hour at 325° in greased and floured pan.

title: Garlic-Cheese Biscuits
directions: Blend together butter, garlic powder, minced onion and set aside.

title: Pumpkin Bread
directions: Combine pumpkin, sugar, oil and egg in a large mixing bowl. Beat well., Combine remaining ingredients except walnuts., Add to pumpkin mixture, mixing well., Stir in walnuts., Spoon into a 9 1/4 x 5 1/4 x 2 3/4-inch loaf pan., Bake at 350° for 1 hour. Yields 1 loaf.

title: Gourmet Potatoes
directions: Cook potatoes in skins., Cool, peel and shred coarsely., In saucepan, melt butter over low heat., Add cheese and stir until almost melted., Remove from heat and blend in sour cream, salt and pepper., Mix with shredded potatoes., Bake in a 2-quart casserole and sprinkle with paprika for color., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until heated through., Best if made day before and stored in refrigerator until ready to bake.

title: Easy Personal Pizzas
directions: Spray cookie sheet with cooking spray., Preheat oven to 425°. Using a rolling pin, roll each biscuit to 1/4-inch thickness. Place on cookie sheet., Put a tablespoon of sauce on each biscuit. Add desired toppings and sprinkle cheese over all., Bake 8 to 10 minutes or until crust is brown.

title: Veggie Pizza
directions: Press crescent rolls into 15x10x1 inch baking sheet., Bake at 350 degrees for 12 - 15 min., Cool before adding topping., Combine cream cheese and next 3 ingredients, spread over cooled crust, top with chopped veggies., Sprinkle top with salad supreme (Mrs. Dash).

title: Spinish
directions: Combine spinach, cream, Ricotta and salt and pepper to taste. Heat over medium heat in saucepan., Pour over cooked pasta and sprinkle with pine nuts.

title: Tuna Patties
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Add just enough soup to make moist., Form patties and roll in bread crumbs., Spray Pam on both sides., Bake until brown., You may also brown these in a skillet on top of the stove., Just spray Pam in skillet as directed.

title: Seafood Casserole
directions: Blend soup with milk until smooth., Add into mixture red pepper, Worcestershire sauce, seafood seasoning, black pepper, salt and parsley., Stir mixture well., Fold in shrimp and crab meat., Keep lumps as whole as possible., Pour into a greased casserole., Sprinkle with bread crumbs and dot with butter or margarine., (I use "Shedd's Country Crock."), Bake in 375° oven for 35 minutes., Serves 6 to 8.

title: Chocolate Chip Bars
directions: In mixer, put sugar, shortening, 2 eggs and vanilla., Beat well., Add alternately milk and flour along with salt and baking powder., Add chips and nuts., Put in 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan at 350° for 30 minutes., Cool; top with powdered sugar.

title: Pineapple Cake
directions: Put all ingredients in a bowl and stir well; do not use mixer. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan and bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes., Cool and ice with buttercream frosting.

title: Impossible Coconut Pie
directions: Combine all the ingredients., With use of a blender, hand beater or electric mixer, blend ingredients., Grease a 9-inch pie plate., Pour ingredients in pie plate., Bake in oven at 350° for 50 to 55 minutes.

title: Meal In A Dish
directions: Brown beef in hot shortening in skillet., Stir in onions, beans, salt, pepper, tomatoes and mustard., Boil for 3 minutes. Stir often.

title: Meat Loaf And Gravy
directions: Place heavy-duty aluminum foil in baking pan, 9 x 9 x 2-inches., Mix meat and onion soup mix; turn onto foil and shape into loaf., Spread mushroom soup on loaf., Fold foil loosely over meat., Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 20 minutes.

title: Cool Orange Drink
directions: Combine and blend for 30 seconds.

title: Chicken Delish
directions: In electric skillet, brown chicken in oil., Add remaining ingredients, cover and simmer 1 hour., Serve over rice, noodles or mashed potatoes.

title: Chicken Livers With Mushrooms
directions: Fry bacon in pressure cooker; remove., Saute liver., Pour off excess drippings., Add remaining ingredients., Close cover securely., Place regulator on vent pipe., Cook 5 minutes and cool pressure cooker at once., Crumble bacon and sprinkle over liver. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Mom'S Apple Pie Bars
directions: Mix 2 1/2 cups flour, shortening and salt like pie crust., Put egg yolk into measuring cup and fill with milk to measure 2/3 cup. (Save whites for later.), Mix with flour mixture., Slice apples. Blend sugar, cinnamon, tapioca and 2 tablespoons flour., Mix all together., Divide dough in half., Pat 1/2 of mixture in bottom of cookie sheet., Arrange apples on crust., Sprinkle sugar mixture over apples., Put on other half of dough for top crust.

title: Microwaved Peanut Patties
directions: Combine sugar, syrup and water in 2-quart microwave-safe dish. Microwave on Full power 3 1/2 minutes., Stir in peanuts and continue to microwave on Full power for 9 minutes, stirring after 5 minutes., Stir in butter, vanilla and food coloring., Beat hard with wooden spoon 2 minutes until creamy., Pour into greased miniature muffin pans., Makes about 24 to 30 patties.

title: Mexican Casserole
directions: Brown and drain ground meat, onion and pepper., Then add soups, tomatoes and milk., Sprinkle with garlic powder, salt and chili powder., Cut the corn tortillas into bite size pieces., Add to mixture and mix well., Pour into 2 or more baking dishes; top with grated cheese., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Cornmeal Cookies
directions: In bowl mix all ingredients, one at a time., Preheat oven to 350°., Bake on greased cookie sheet 10 to 12 minutes or until bottoms of cookies are brown.

title: Mediterranean Steak
directions: Pressure cook, round, steak with water approximately 15 minutes; set aside.

title: Salisbury Steak
directions: Combine first 9 ingredients; mix well., By 1/4 cupfuls, shape into balls or patties., Heat soup, milk and garlic salt., Pour over patties., Bake at 350° for 45 to 60 minutes., During last 10 minutes, add mushrooms.

title: Strawberry Pudding
directions: Heat strawberries, sugar and jello and cool., Mix milk, vanilla pudding, sour cream and Cool Whip (reserve half for top). Line your bowl with vanilla wafers, then alternate strawberry mixture and wafers., Then top with jello mixture while still runny., Chill., Top with remaining Cool Whip.

title: Marinade For Beef Roast
directions: Go to a pizza store., Buy 3 large pizzas., Bring home, cut and serve.

title: Apple, Cinnamon, Raisin Mini-Muffins
directions: In small bowl stir together flour, oats, sugar, baking powder and cinnamon., In another bowl beat to blend egg, juice, oil, apple and raisins., Add dry ingredients; stir just until moistened., Spoon batter equally into 24 greased tiny muffin pans (1 1/2-inch diameter)., Bake at 400° until well browned, 20 to 25 minutes., Remove from pans; serve warm or cool., If made ahead, package cool muffins in an airtight container and hold at room temperature up until next day., Freeze to store longer.

title: Cheese Grits
directions: Cook grits according to directions on container., Add butter, eggs and cheese., Pour into oblong 8 x 10-inch Pyrex dish., Bake at 350° for 40 minutes or until lightly browned., Serves about six. Can be made day ahead before baking.

title: Spaghetti With Meat Sauce
directions: Bring water to rapid boil., Add salt and spaghetti., Cook, uncovered, about 15 minutes or until done., Drain., Saute onion in oil or butter until brown., Add ground beef and cook until brown. Stir in spaghetti sauce., Serve over cooked spaghetti.

title: Macaroni And Tomatoes
directions: Cook the bacon and onion in skillet until done. Set aside. Cook the macaroni until done; drain. Add bacon and onion to macaroni. Add water and tomatoes. Cook for 30 minutes. May add more water. Salt and pepper to taste.

title: Poppy Seed Cake
directions: Mix together the cake mix, sugar, oil and water., Then beat in the eggs, one at a time., Add the sour cream last and then fold in the poppy seed. Bake in a greased and floured tube pan at 350° for 50 minutes., Glaze while warm with a powdered sugar icing.

title: Chicken Enchiladas
directions: Butter casserole and line with tortillas., Make sauce., Saute one medium chopped onion and 1 can green chilies (seeds removed). Add soup, broth, Carnation milk and chicken., Top with grated cheese., Bake 45 minutes at 350°.

title: Marge'S Apple Puffed Pancake
directions: Preheat oven to 425°., In blender or large bowl, mix eggs, milk, flour, granulated sugar, vanilla, salt and cinnamon until blended., If using a mixer, batter will be lumpy., Melt oleo in a 12-inch fluted quiche pan or 13 x 9-inch baking dish., Add apple slices., Return to oven until oleo is melted and sizzles., Do not brown., Remove from oven and immediately pour batter over apples. Sprinkle with brown sugar., Bake 20 minutes until puffed and brown. Serve with maple syrup., This is a nice brunch recipe., Serves 6 to 8.

title: Meat Loaf
directions: Mix all ingredients well and put into a large baking dish. Make sure it is tall enough so the juice will not overflow. Spread 1/2 cup tomato soup over top of loaf., Cover with foil and cook in oven at 375° for 1 1/2 hours., Cook last 15 minutes uncovered to brown.

title: Holiday Punch
directions: Several hours ahead, mix together the fruit juices, salt and water., Place in covered container in refrigerator to chill., At serving time, combine mixture with ginger ale., Stir in food coloring, if desired., Serve over a block of ice in punch bowl. Makes 25 generous servings.

title: Zucchini Bread
directions: Grease bottom only of 2 loaf pans., Cream margarine and brown sugar., Add eggs, zucchini, water and vanilla., Sift together flour, soda, salt, baking powder, cinnamon and cloves., Add dry ingredients to creamed mixture., Stir in nuts/raisins., Pour into greased pans., Bake at 350° for about 60 minutes (until toothpick comes out clean)., Cool slightly before removing from pans.

title: Double Layer Pumpkin Pie
directions: Mix cream cheese, 1 tablespoon milk and sugar in large bowl until smooth., Gently stir in Cool Whip., Then spread on bottom of pie crust., Pour 1 cup milk into bowl., Add pudding mix. Beat until well blended, 1 to 2 minutes., (Mixture will be thick.) Stir in pumpkin and spices., Mix well. Spread over cream cheese layer., Refrigerate at least 3 hours., Garnish with additional Cool Whip topping and nuts, if desired., Makes 8 servings.

title: Chicken Salad
directions: Simmer chicken 40 to 45 minutes or until tender., Cool; remove chicken from bones and dice., Combine all ingredients in a bowl. Refrigerate until well chilled., Makes 8 servings.

title: Double Chocolate Cookies
directions: Blend cake mix, oil and eggs., Stir in chocolate chips., Drop from a teaspoon on ungreased cookie sheet., Bake 12 to 15 minutes in a 350° oven., Makes 4 to 5 dozen.

title: Apple Pie
directions: Bring water, sugar and apples to a boil., Cook several minutes until apples are soft but not mushy., Dissolve cornstarch in 1 cup water., Stir into apple mixture., Cook until thickened., Remove from heat., Stir in allspice, lemon juice, cinnamon, vanilla and margarine., Pour mixture into unbaked pie crust., Bake at 425° for 15 minutes, then at 350° for 35 minutes, or until browned., Put tinfoil on edges to keep from browning.

title: Pot-Roasted Pork
directions: Rub pork with salt and pepper., Make tiny slits in meat. Insert garlic., Put in broiler 15 minutes., Place onions in bottom of crock-pot., Add pork and remaining ingredients., Cook on low for 10 hours.

title: Chocolate Pie
directions: Mix cocoa, sugar and flour., Add egg yolks, milk and butter or margarine., Let cook until mixture thickens., Pour into cooked pie shell and top with meringue.

title: Fuzzy Navel Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Chop peaches., Combine peaches, Schnapps, sugar and orange juice in a covered glass container and let set for 24 hours., Mix cake mix, pudding mix, eggs and oil with 1 cup of chopped peaches from preceding mixture., Add 1/2 cup liquid from preceding mixture., Mix., Add chopped pecans., Mix. Pour mixture in greased Bundt cake pan., Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

title: Date Cake Squares
directions: Combine dates, prunes, raisins and water; heat to boiling. Reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, until tender and water is absorbed, about 10 minutes. Remove from heat. Add margarine and cool. Mix eggs until stiff. Spread in a greased 11 x 7 x 2 pan. Bake at 350° until cake springs back when touched lightly, about 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
directions: Spread hash browns in a 9 x 13-inch pan., Heat the remaining ingredients and pour over the potatoes., Bake at 350° about 1 hour.

title: Spinach Dip
directions: Thaw spinach and drain completely., Dice water chestnuts and green onions., Combine all ingredients thoroughly., Chill approximately 1 hour before serving.

title: Grilled Tuna
directions: Combine oil, teriyaki sauce, lime juice, ginger, garlic powder and pepper., Place tuna in a shallow dish., Add marinade., Cover and refrigerate 2 hours to 1 day., Grill tuna over medium hot coals about 5 minutes on each side., Serve on a bed of leaf lettuce., Garnish with lime slices and cherry tomatoes., Serves 8.

title: Fried Chicken Livers
directions: Clean liver and, roll in flour, salt, pepper and garlic mixture., In a frypan place the cooking oil and heat hot., Fry livers until crisp and brown., Serves 6 to 8.

title: Quick And Easy Ham Rolls
directions: Cut off green part of the onion., Spread softened cream cheese on ham slice., Place green onion longways on ham slice, at one edge., Roll and place toothpicks along edge., Repeat., Refrigerate until cream cheese hardens., Slice about 1-inch thick, leaving a toothpick in each slice., Enjoy.

title: Pepper Bread
directions: Dissolve yeast and sugar in water and set aside., Mix in 2 tablespoons coarse black pepper and 2 tablespoons dried chopped onion., Beat together eggs, cottage cheese and butter and microwave 1 to 2 minutes until warm., Combine yeast mixture with the cheese mixture., Add dry ingredients and mix well., Dough will be stiff! Knead to form ball on table., Cover with a large bowl and let rise until doubled., Beat down and let rise again., Form loaves on cornmeal dusted cookie sheets; let rise again., Just before putting bread in oven, mix 1 egg with 1 tablespoon water and brush on loaves., Bake at 350° for 40 to 50 minutes., Cool on wire rack.

title: Christmas Chicken
directions: Rinse chicken in cold water., Pat dry., Combine garlic (minced), sour cream, lemon juice, salts, paprika and pepper sauce., Coat chicken with mixture, place in a covered bowl overnight in refrigerator.

title: Mashed 3 Potatoes With Scallions(Excellent For Holidays)
directions: Place potatoes, half the scallions, 1 tablespoon salt and enough water to cover the potatoes., Boil until soft., Drain, reserving 1/2 cup cooking liquid., Mash the potatoes; stir in reserved cooking liquid, cream, butter, all but 2 teaspoons of the remaining scallions, 1/2 teaspoon salt, pepper and nutmeg. Transfer to warmed serving dish., Sprinkle with remaining scallions and serve hot.

title: Dutch Apple Pie
directions: Put apple slices in unbaked pie shell., Mix remaining ingredients together and pour over apple slices., Dot with butter. Bake at 350° until knife inserted comes out clean from center.

title: Egg And Bacon Spread
directions: Fry bacon., Hard boil eggs., Let grease drain from bacon while peeling shells from eggs., Crush eggs up in medium mixing bowl. Crumble bacon in with eggs., Add 2 tablespoons of mayonnaise., Mix together well., Spread on wheat bread topped with sliced tomato and enjoy.

title: Apple Cobbler
directions: Put apple in casserole dish. Put bread strips on top of apples. Mix sugar, egg, self-rising flour and softened margarine together., Pour mixture on top of bread strips., Bake at 350° until crust is brown. Let it cool before serving. May top cobbler with ice cream before serving.

title: Crunchy Baked Chicken
directions: Place butter in a 2-quart glass baking dish. Microwave at 70% power 1 1/2 to 2 minutes, until melted., Combine salt and pepper with cornflake crumbs., Roll chicken in the melted butter, then in the seasoned crumbs., Place the chicken pieces, skin side up with the thick edges toward the outside of the dish. Microwave, uncovered, 6 to 7 minutes per pound., Turn the dish halfway through the cooking time., Let stand 3 minutes before serving.

title: Apple Dumplings
directions: Put quarter of apple in each roll. Gently pull dough over apple quarter. Crimp edges so there are no holes. Place in Corning Ware dish. Sprinkle with cinnamon. Bring sugar, water and margarine to boil. Pour over apples. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Place chicken pieces in 9 x 12-inch dish., Mix soups and milk together and pour over chicken., Spread dressing over chicken mixture., Gradually pour broth over dressing until moistened. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Foam Green Salad
directions: Use standard recipe for mixing Jell-O., Put in refrigerator until it begins to jell., Mix nuts, cheese, pineapple and whipped cream together., Add Jell-O mixture., Pour in mold and serve when firm.

title: Zucchini Bread
directions: Mix all the ingredients and bake in a 350° oven for 45 minutes., Makes 2 loaves.

title: Apple Pecan Dessert
directions: Mix pie filling, water and nutmeg., Pour into greased 10 x 6 x 2-inch pan., Sprinkle with pecans., Top with biscuits., Bake at 375° for 30 minutes., Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Eggplant Au Gratin
directions: Trim ends from eggplant and slice in 1/2-inch rounds. Sprinkle slices with salt and pepper and roll in flour., Heat oil (1/2-inch deep) in large skillet and fry eggplant slices until golden brown on both sides., Line bottom and sides of a 1 1/2 quart casserole with eggplant slices.

title: Pineapple Cheese Ball
directions: Mix together all ingredients, saving 1/2 of the pecans., Set pecans aside. Shape mixture into ball. Roll ball in remaining pecans. Serve with crackers.

title: Muesli
directions: Combine oatmeal, wheat germ, orange rind, raisins and nuts. Shred 1 apple and chop 1 apple., Slice banana., Drizzle with honey and apple juice., Mix altogether., Serve with milk., Makes 4 servings.

title: Oven Roasted Ribs
directions: Saute onion in butter., Add all other ingredients., Simmer 20 minutes, stirring occasionally., Can be refrigerated up to 2 weeks., Preheat oven to 450°., Salt and pepper ribs; place on rack and pour 3 cups water in pan., Bake 30 minutes., Pour out water; reduce heat to 300°., Brush ribs with Vera's Barbecue Sauce., Bake 25 minutes., Turn; baste with sauce and bake 20 minutes., Broil a few minutes on each side before serving.

title: Seven In One Casserole
directions: Arrange layers in order., Pour tomato soup over layer of ground chuck and top with Pepperidge Farm herbal dressing mix and press down into soup., (You can substitute bread crumbs for the Pepperidge Farm dressing.), The last 5 minutes of cooking you can top with grated cheese., This may be made to serve as many as you want., Bake for 1 hour at 350°.

title: After Dinner Mints
directions: Combine egg white, cream, vanilla, oil flavoring and coloring. Stir well., Add sugar, all at once, mixing thoroughly., Add more cream, if needed., Add butter and more sugar if necessary to make mixture the consistency needed to roll into firm small balls. Arrange balls on waxed paper., Press each ball with tines of fork dipped into additional powdered sugar., Let stand overnight to form crust., Put mints into tins with waxed paper between each layer. Mints may be frozen and kept for several months.

title: Simon And Garfunkel Chicken
directions: Turn the chicken breasts, smooth side down and sprinkle with salt and pepper., Dot each breast with 1 teaspoon margarine., Lay a slice of Mozzarella cheese on top of each chicken piece., Roll up jelly roll fashion, long edge to long edge., Secure well with wooden toothpicks., Melt the remaining margarine; add parsley, sage, rosemary and thyme., Roll the chicken rolls in the flour, then in egg, then in crumbs., Place in baking dish., Pour melted margarine and spices over chicken., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Baked Lasagna
directions: In large skillet, saute ground beef., Drain excess fat., Add spaghetti sauce, onion salt and garlic., Simmer 20 minutes., Cook lasagna according to package.

title: Potato Salad
directions: Cook potatoes in small diced pieces for about an hour., Drain while hot., Put in mayonnaise and salt., Let cool, then mix other ingredients., Serves 10 to 12 people.

title: Recipe For Raising Our Children
directions: Mix all ingredients; add a pound of persistency and one cup of love and whip until right consistency., These recipes are given by our Creator.

title: Fresh Creamed Corn
directions: Cut corn off cob., Then with the knife blade, scrape juice from each cob., Place in a saucepan and cook for about an hour or until corn is tender., Add a little more water or Carnation milk if necessary., When tender, add enough water to make it fairly juicy., Mix in a cup 2 tablespoons flour and water to make a thin flour paste., Add this to corn to thicken mixture., Continue simmering until done.

title: Texas Hot Dog Sauce
directions: Simmer 3 hours, then add 3/4 stick of oleo and simmer another 1/2 hour.

title: English Pea Salad
directions: Drain English peas and Shoe Peg corn., Put both in a covered bowl overnight., Add onion, radishes, celery and pecans., Stir the mixture gently until combined., Add mayonnaise., Stir until well coated., Chill.

title: 7-Up Cake
directions: Mix cake mix and Wesson oil., Add eggs, one at a time., Beat well after each., Add 7-Up., Bake in four layers at 350°.

title: Broccoli And Cheese
directions: Mix 1 stick of butter, Velveeta cheese and broccoli together. Mix the other stick of butter and crushed crackers., Put broccoli mixture in casserole pan., Crumble cracker mix on top of broccoli casserole., Bake at 300° for about 30 minutes.

title: Chow-Chow Relish
directions: Combine chopped vegetables; sprinkles with salt. Let stand 4 to 6 hours in a cool place. Drain well.

title: Quick Lasagne
directions: Mix together eggs, cottage cheese, Mozzarella, spinach and spices., Grease a 13 x 9-inch pan., Spread sauce thickly over bottom of pan., Add layer of uncooked noodles (don't overlap), then top with cheese mixture., Continue layering noodles, cheese mix and sauce., Finish with sauce., Bake, covered, for 1 hour at 350°.

title: Taco Salad
directions: Combine lettuce, onion, and tomatoes. Brown beef in pan, drain, and let cool slightly. Add beef, cheese, and nacho chips to veggies. Pour on dressing. Toss and serve.

title: Lemon Lush
directions: Combine first 4 ingredients and pat into 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 15 minutes at 350°., Cool.

title: Broccoli Cornbread
directions: Mix all ingredients together and bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes in 9-inch greased pan.

title: Texas Hot Cocoa Cake
directions: Bring to a boil first 3 ingredients., Sift in large bowl, sugar, flour and cocoa., Pour liquid mixture over flour mixture and beat until smooth., Add remaining ingredients., Pour in large oblong pan and bake 25 minutes at 400°.

title: Cheese Pie
directions: Mix all ingredients together, except tortilla chips. Put in pie plate., Bake at 325° for 1/2 hour or until melted., (You can melt it in the microwave on Medium heat.), Use it as a dip for the tortilla chips.

title: Mocha Brownies
directions: Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy., Beat in vanilla., Add beaten eggs in thirds, beating well after each addition., Blend chocolate and instant coffee powder together. Add to creamed mixture., Add sifted dry ingredients in thirds, mixing well after each addition., Stir in walnuts., Turn batter into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 40 minutes. Cool., Sprinkle with confectioners sugar., Cut into squares.

title: Spice Cake
directions: Combine all ingredients., Mix well., Pour into 3 greased and floured cake pans., Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Gloria'S Sopaipillas(Fried Indian Bread)
directions: Combine dry ingredients in a medium size mixing bowl and cut in shortening., Make a well in center of dry ingredients., Add water to dry ingredients and work into a dough., Knead dough until smooth; cover and set aside for 20 minutes., Heat 2 inches of shortening in a heavy pan at medium-high heat (425°)., Roll dough to a 1/8-inch thickness on a lightly floured board., Cut dough into 4-inch squares and fry until golden on both sides, turning once., Drain Sopaipillas on absorbent towels.

title: Jamie'S P.B.J. Cookies
directions: Cream together margarine, shortening and sugar until very fluffy., Add eggs, one at a time, still creaming, then vanilla and peanut butter., Stir in salt, baking powder and soda., Add enough flour, stirring, to make a soft dough.

title: Cheese Ball
directions: Soften cream cheese., Carefully stir in drained pineapple, 1 cup pecans, green pepper, onion and salt., Chill well., Form into a ball and roll in remaining cup of pecans., Wrap in aluminum foil and let set overnight., (This is so that the onion and bell pepper taste will not be too strong.)

title: Broccoli-Corn Bake
directions: Combine corn, broccoli, egg, 1/2 cup cracker crumbs, onion, 2 tablespoons melted butter or margarine, salt and pepper., Turn into 1-quart casserole., Combine 1/4 cup cracker crumbs and remaining butter; sprinkle over vegetable mixture., Bake, uncovered, in 350° oven for 35 to 40 minutes., Makes 6 servings.

title: Italian Spinach
directions: Saute garlic and onion in olive oil until onion is clear. Mix in spinach. Cook on medium heat until tender., Spinach will cook down a considerable amount., Add drained tomato and drained mushrooms., Simmer until heated through., Serves 2 - 4.

title: Applesauce Cupcakes
directions: Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy in large mixing bowl., Add eggs and beat well., Sift dry ingredients together and add to mixture alternately with applesauce., Add vanilla and mix well.

title: Instant Hot Chocolate Mix
directions: Mix all ingredients together in a very large bowl., I have never added the cloves to the mix, but I love the cinnamon in it.

title: Chicken And Rice Casserole
directions: Combine rice, soup mix, chicken soup and water. Pour into a 9 x 13 baking dish. Place chicken on top of rice mixture. Melt butter and drizzle over chicken. Cover and bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours or until tender. If using glass pan, bake at 325°.

title: Paula'S Chili And Beans
directions: Mix all ingredients and bake for 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Monkey-Faced Cookies
directions: Heat oven to 375°., Mix brown sugar, shortening, molasses, milk and vinegar., Stir in flour, ginger and cinnamon., Drop by rounded teaspoonful about 2 inches apart onto a cookie sheet. Press 3 raisins in each cookie for eyes and mouth., Bake until set, 11 to 12 minutes.

title: Green Grape Salad
directions: Slice bananas., Mix green grapes., Add salty peanuts and mix with salad dressing., Serve on lettuce leaf.

title: Scalloped Corn
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Butter dish and bake for 1 hour at 350°.

title: French Garlic-Herb Cheese Spread
directions: Blend the first 3 ingredients., Mix in seasonings., Chill for 3 hours or overnight., Serve with bite-size raw vegetables or crackers.

title: Microwave Cherry Crunch
directions: Pour pie filling in oblong Pyrex baking dish., Sprinkle cake mix over pie filling., Pat mix into cherries., Sprinkle brown sugar and a little cinnamon over that., Dot with margarine and sprinkle nuts on top., Cover with wax paper and microwave on High for 14 minutes.

title: Taco Dip
directions: Spread bean dip over large plate., Combine mayonnaise, sour cream and taco mix., Spread over bean dip., Layer next 4 ingredients as listed., Let chill for at least 1 hour., Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Smoked Turkey
directions: Working from the front, lift the skin from the turkey breast and slide 2 strips of bacon beneath it on each side. Secure the loosened skin with toothpicks. Place the onion and apple inside the body cavity. Cook about 4 hours in a smoker, using damp hickory, apple, pecan or cherry wood to provide smoke and flavor. Check for doneness every 30 minutes, beginning at 2 1/2 hours, by pricking deeply with a cooking fork. When juice running from the hole is clear, not pink, the bird should be done. (Depending on the bird's size and the smoker's temperature, cooking time will vary considerably.) Keep the fire low and smoky, so the turkey cooks and throughout without drying too much on the outside. A small pan of water placed inside the smoker helps keep the bird moist.

title: Vegetable Sauce
directions: Put first 8 ingredients in a large pot and stir., Let sit on stove 3 minutes. Add celery (sliced), then add last ingredients. (You need not add anchovies.)

title: Sweet Potato Pie
directions: Boil sweet potatoes in jackets., Skin sweet potatoes., Mash the potatoes., Add butter and sugar., Mix well., Add eggs one at a time., Mix., Add spices, flavoring and milk., Pour into unbaked pie crust., Bake at 350° until firm, about 1 hour.

title: Party Potatoes
directions: In a large bowl, combine potatoes, sour cream, cream cheese, chives and garlic powder., Turn into greased 2-quart casserole. Combine bread crumbs with butter; sprinkle over potatoes., Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes., Top with cheese., Serve immediately.

title: Honey Drop Cookies
directions: Cream together butter, sugar and honey., Add egg; mix well. Sift together dry ingredients., Add raisins and nuts., Mix well and add to first mixture along with water, to form soft dough. Drop from spoon onto greased cookie sheet., Bake at 375°, 10 to 15 minutes., Makes about 4 dozen cookies.

title: Easy Cheesecake
directions: Combine the first 6 ingredients and beat until fine, then pour into 3 pie crusts. Add fruit topping to each pie. Chill for 3 hours.

title: Ripe Tomato Jam
directions: Boil tomatoes with sugar for 10 minutes., Add lemon and gelatin., Boil 10 minutes longer., Seal in sterilized jars.

title: Beef Enchiladas
directions: Cook beef and drain well soften tortillas fill with beef, cheese, and onion., Roll and, place in baking dish., After all are placed in dish, pour over the enchilada sauce., Sprinkle remaining onion and lots of cheese., Bake at 350 degrees for about 15 minutes or until are very hot and cheese is melted.

title: Blueberry Cake
directions: Cream the shortening, eggs and sugar until well blended., Add the dry ingredients alternately with the milk., Blend in the blueberries., Pour into a greased and floured loaf pan. Bake for 30 to 40 minutes at 350°.

title: Can'T Believe It Dessert
directions: Pour pie mix in ungreased 13 x 9-inch cake pan., Sift dry cake mix over top of pie mix., Sprinkle 1/2 cup melted butter on top. Bake at 350° for 1 hour., Serve with whipped cream or ice cream.

title: Carob-Date Syrup
directions: Blend until smooth., Pour into container and add 1 cup of water., (Use this to rinse out the blender.), Stir well., Use 5 tablespoons syrup to one cup water to make a delicious hot or cold drink., Mix 1/2 cup rice milk with 1/2 cup water and add 4 tablespoons carob syrup., Blend until smooth., Also may use as a hot syrup., Delicious on bananas with chopped nuts sprinkled on top.

title: Hot Sausage Appetizers
directions: Combine all ingredients in large bowl., Shape into 1-inch balls and place on ungreased cookie sheet., Bake at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Skillet Cooker (Date)
directions: Cook in iron skillet.

title: Meat And Rice
directions: Cook meat and onion until almost done., Add soups, rice and salt to taste., Put in baking dish and cook 20 minutes, uncovered. Put lid on and cook 20 minutes longer in a 350° oven.

title: Broccoli Chicken Casserole
directions: Cook broccoli., Arrange in greased casserole., Place chicken on broccoli., Combine mayonnaise, soup, lemon juice and curry. Pour over chicken., Sprinkle with cheese., Mix crumbs and butter. Sprinkle over cheese., Bake 30 minutes at 350°., Serves 6.

title: Microwave Peanut Patties
directions: Combine sugar, water, salt and syrup in a 2-quart glass measuring bowl., Bring to a boil in microwave (approximately 5 minutes)., Stir and add peanuts., Return to microwave and cook approximately, 7, to 8 minutes or to soft ball stage (234°) is reached., Remove; add butter, vanilla and food coloring., Cool and beat until creamy.	Drop in buttered muffin cups.

title: No Crust Coconut Pie
directions: Mix ingredients., Bake at 300° for 20 or 25 minutes., Makes 1 large or 2 small pies.

title: English Toffee
directions: Melt butter over low heat., Add sugar., Turn burner up to medium-high., Stir constantly., Will go through several (3 to 4) consistency changes until light brown and smooth., Pour onto cookie sheet and spread out., Rub and place squares of chocolate to melt., Sprinkle with nuts., Let stand in cool room until chocolate settles., Break into pieces and serve., Great holiday candy!

title: Boot Scootin' Spinach
directions: Precook spinach as directed on package., Drain; then add butter., Add half and half and salsa., Cook until bubbling hot in a large frying pan., Add half and half as needed for consistency. Add crumbled Feta cheese., Let cook down to desired consistency (not too soupy)., You may add a touch of garlic, if desired.

title: No Bake Banana Split Dessert
directions: Mix graham cracker crumbs and 1 1/2 sticks margarine; press into 9 x 13-inch pan., Beat 20 minutes by hand (or 10 minutes with mixer) the confectioners sugar, 2 sticks margarine, eggs and vanilla until light and fluffy., Spread over graham cracker crust. Add crushed pineapple and sliced bananas over pineapple., Top with whipped topping; decorate with nuts, cherries or strawberries.

title: Chicken Almond Casserole
directions: Broil the breasts until almost done and remove skin (about 10 minutes)., Put in a casserole dish., Mix soup, lemon juice, mayonnaise and onions; pour over breasts., Garnish with crushed potato chips and almonds., Bake at 350°, for 30 minutes or until brown and bubbly., Serve over rice.

title: Oriental Chicken And Noodles
directions: In small bowl dissolve reserved seasoning packets from noodles in the warm water., Add soy sauce and cornstarch; stir until smooth., Set aside., Cook noodles according to package directions., Drain off most of the liquid; set aside., In 10 inch skillet or wok over medium-high heat, in 1 T. hot oil, stir fry chicken until browned., Add vegetables, and garlic and cool until vegetables are tender-crisp., Add reserved cornstarch mixture. Cook until mixture boils and thickens, stirring constantly., Add desired amount of cashews just before removing from heat., Serve over noodles., May use additional soy sauce over top if desired.

title: Ladyfingers
directions: Cream the butter with mixer., Add other ingredients and blend well., Pinch out narrow strips of dough about 3 inches long for each and place on ungreased baking sheet 1/4 inch apart., Bake 15 minutes at 325°., May not appear brown when ready., While warm, roll in extra confectioners sugar to coat entirely.

title: Chop Suey
directions: Brown meat. Add celery, onion, bean sprouts, mushrooms, soy sauce and water. Bring to a boil, then simmer about 3 hours. Before serving, thicken with cornstarch and water., Serve over Minute rice or noodles.

title: Granny Dean'S Famous Fudge
directions: Combine dry ingredients in saucepan., Mix well., Gradually add milk, while stirring, being sure to keep mixture smooth., Bring to a bubbly boil on medium heat, stirring constantly., Stir bottom of pot as well to avoid sticking., Bring to a full rolling boil for several minutes, until mixture reaches "soft ball" stage. Remove from heat., Add butter and vanilla., Don't stir., Cool at room temperature until it loses its gloss., Beat with rotary beaters for about 5 minutes, until thickening begins., Pour into buttered 9 x 13-inch flat pan., Cool in fridge (or on the porch in the winter)., Cut into 2-inch squares.

title: Oranges In Liqueur
directions: Boil the zest from one orange (zest is the peel without the bitter white portion) for 5 minutes., Drain and dry., Melt butter. Add sugar and liqueur., When sugar is dissolved, add the orange zest and the juice., Simmer until medium thickness., Peel and slice remaining oranges 1/3-inch thick., Place overlapped oranges on a serving platter., Sprinkle walnuts over top., Pour sauce over the orange slices and serve.

title: Island Style Chicken
directions: Drain pineapple chunks, reserving syrup., In skillet, brown chicken in shortening., Pour off fat., Add reserved syrup, broth, vinegar, sugar, soy sauce and garlic., Cover., Cook over low heat 40 minutes., Add green pepper and pineapple chunks., Cook 5 minutes more or until done., Stir occasionally., Combine cornstarch and water., Gradually stir into sauce., Cook, stirring until thickened. Serve over cooked parsleyed rice., Makes 4 servings.

title: Red Cabbage And Kidney Beans
directions: In a large skillet, cook onion in butter 3 or 4 minutes., Add shredded cabbage., Sprinkle with brown sugar, salt and pepper. Add wine and vinegar., Add beans; cover and cook slowly 30 or 40 minutes., Add more wine or water if needed., Serve with pork chops.

title: Pepper Steak
directions: Mix first 6 ingredients., Marinate meat in mixture., Saute green peppers (3 to 5 minutes)., Stir in meat and cook over medium high heat for approximately 5 minutes., Stir in tomatoes., Simmer for approximately 3 minutes.

title: Enchilada Casserole
directions: Melt cheese in evaporated milk and soup., Brown ground beef. Add onion, garlic, salt and green chilies., Cook until onion is tender., Fry tortillas until soft., Layer ingredients in a greased 2-quart casserole dish, starting with tortillas, then meat mixture., Repeat., Pour cheese sauce over the top., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Lite Cream Of Broccoli Soup
directions: Combine the first 8 ingredients., Boil for 1 minute, stirring. Add broccoli and next 3 ingredients., Cook until cheese melts and well heated., Garnish bowls of soup with 1/2 teaspoon shredded cheese., Makes 4 servings.

title: Punch Bowl Cake
directions: Bake layer cake according to directions, making 2 layers., Let cool., Prepare vanilla instant pudding mix according to directions using cold milk., Crumble one layer of the cake in the bottom of a large punch bowl or trifle bowl., Spread with 1/2 can pineapple evenly over cake., Next, spread 1/2 pudding evenly over pineapple. Next, spread 1/2 strawberries over pudding., Next, sprinkle 1/2 chopped nuts over the strawberries., Next, spread 1/2 coconut over the nuts., Add one container of Cool Whip.

title: Banana Nut Bread
directions: Measure and sift together flour, soda and salt., Cream margarine/butter and sugar; add eggs and vanilla., Stir until thoroughly mixed., Stir in mashed bananas., Fold in dry ingredients and nuts., Place in well-greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan or 8-inch square cake pan., Bake at 325° for 55 to 60 minutes.

title: Tess' Salad
directions: At least one hour ahead, peel and section the oranges., Using a serrated knife, cut off the polar ends of the peel, then slice the peel off the sides., If the orange is a "ready to eat" naval type, it will section easily by hand., If not, use that same serrated knife to cut sections by going in one side of the membrane and out the other, releasing each orange section and leaving behind its lining., Squeeze all excess juice from the remaining membrane into the bowl of orange tidbits., Discard the membrane., Pick out seeds, if necessary., Drizzle honey and sprinkle cinnamon over the oranges-au-jus., When you are done drizzling and sprinkling, cover the bowl and let it stand at room temperature at least one hour.

title: Coffee Sponge Cake
directions: Dissolve coffee in 1 cup boiling water., Separate the eggs. Beat yolks., Add 1 1/2 cups sugar., To this, add alternately the dry ingredients and coffee. Beat whites until stiff., Add cream of tartar., Fold into batter the vanilla., Bake in ungreased pan (angel food is best) at 350° for 60 to 70 minutes.

title: Family Favorite Chip Dip
directions: Have cheeses at room temperature.

title: Melt-In-Your-Mouth Sugar Cookies
directions: Mix together., Roll in balls and dip in sugar., Flatten slightly with bottom of glass dipped in sugar., Bake at 350° until set.

title: Old-Fashion Chocolate Pie
directions: Put sugar in boiler., Separate egg whites and yolks., Put yolks in sugar., Put in 1/4 cup of water and mix., Add flour, cocoa and milk., Cook until thick., Take off heat and add butter and vanilla., Pour in baked pie shell.

title: Italian Green Beans
directions: Combine chicken bouillon, olive oil and diced tomatoes., Bring to boil., Add beans, salt, pepper and oregano., Cover and simmer 30 minutes., Remove cover and continue to cook over low heat until excess moisture has evaporated and beans are tender.

title: Cabbage Casserole
directions: Cook, onions, and, peppers until brown in skillet., Add meat and, brown (drain grease)., Add salt and black pepper to taste. In, long baking dish, chop cabbage., When meat mixture is brown, add rice., Stir well., Pour meat mixture evenly over cabbage. Cover, with, foil., Bake, 1, hour at 350°., Top with cheese and let melt before serving.

title: Fried Okra
directions: Thaw frozen okra and season with salt and pepper., Coat okra with meal., Drop into, hot oil., Cook until tender and brown.

title: Apple-Noodle Bake
directions: Mix apples, sugar, cinnamon and nutmeg together in a large bowl., In a second bowl, mix the cheese, eggs, sugar, honey and vanilla., Fold the noodles into the cheese mixture and put half of it in a buttered 2-quart casserole dish., Spread the apple mixture on top and cover with the rest of the cheese mixture., Dot with a tablespoon of butter., Bake at 350° for 50 minutes., Serve warm or cold.

title: 1930 Yeast Doughnuts
directions: Heat milk slightly and dissolve yeast., Add 1 1/4 cups flour and beat until smooth., Cover and let rise in warm place until it doubles, about 2 hours., Cream Crisco, salt and sugar together. Add egg and blend., Stir this mixture into yeast sponge., Add remaining flour and mix thoroughly., Rub top with Crisco and let rise again until almost double., Roll 1/4-inch thick and cut with floured doughnut cutter., Allow to rise about 45 minutes., Then fry in deep kettle with Crisco heated until an inch cube of bread browns (about 60 seconds)., Fry doughnuts 2 to 3 minutes until brown., Drain and glaze with confectioners sugar and hot water combined until it becomes a thin frosting., When you make these wonderful doughnuts, you will have a smile on your lips and a smile in your stomach.

title: Rice Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients in a 2-quart casserole dish. Bake 1 hour, covered, at 350°. Check to see if rice is cooked.

title: Chocolate Covered Pecan Caramels
directions: Melt margarine in heavy saucepan., Add brown sugar, condensed milk and corn syrup, then blend well., Cook over medium heat for 15 to 20 minutes, or to 248° on candy thermometer (firm ball stage) while stirring with wooden spoon., Remove from heat., Add pecans and vanilla., Stir and pour into buttered foil lined 8 x 8-inch pan., Let stand until firm., Lift foil from pan; cut into 3/4-inch squares with buttered knife., In double boiler, melt chocolate chips and paraffin over boiling water., Dip squares, one at a time, into chocolate mixture and place on waxed paper., Let stand until cool, then wrap in plastic wrap., Store in refrigerator or freezer., Yields 100 pieces.

title: Chicken Wings
directions: Marinade chicken overnight., Bake 1 hour at 350°., Can be used on a whole cut up chicken.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
directions: Mix oil, sugar and eggs until creamy., Sift dry ingredients together., Add small amounts of dry mixture to creamy mixture. Beat until smooth., Add vanilla., Fold in apples and pecans., (Do not use mixer.), Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour in greased and floured pan.

title: Front Porch Lemonade
directions: Combine sugar and boiling water, stirring until sugar dissolves., Add lemon juice and cold water. Mix well., Chill and serve over ice. Garnish if desired., Yields 7 1/4 cup.

title: Sour Cream Raisin Pie
directions: Boil the raisins in the water for 5 minutes. Drain good. Mix together the sugar, cornstarch and cinnamon. Add the half and half, egg yolks and raisins. Boil until thick. Keep stirring. Put in baked pie shell.

title: Pumpkin Vegetable Soup
directions: In a 3-quart container, melt margarine and saute onion., Add chicken broth and heat to boiling., Add potatoes, beans, corn, carrots, celery and peas; cover and cook until tender., Mix together pumpkin, salt, nutmeg and white pepper., Heat until boiling; reduce to low heat and cook 15 minutes., (Mix this pumpkin mixture with the vegetable mixture, then heat as directed.), Stir in cream.

title: Barbecue Turkey
directions: Use pressure cooker for ingredients and cook 20 to 25 minutes. Cut turkey in half and brown each side on grill for 30 to 45 minutes., Place turkey in broiler pan and pour sauce over turkey. Cover and cook on grill for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

title: Pizza Casserole
directions: Brown hamburger and onion and drain., Cook macaroni in water and drain., Prepare spaghetti sauce, mix according to instructions on back with hamburger and onion., Mix in Cheddar cheese and macaroni., Put in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Sprinkle Mozzarella cheese on top and baked at 350° for 30 minutes or until hot and cheese is melted.

title: Homemade Hot Dog Chili
directions: Cover hamburger in cold water with onion. Cook until done. Add remaining ingredients. Cook until thick.

title: Pa'S Chicken Pie
directions: Melt margarine in casserole. Place chicken in margarine. Spread Veg-All over chicken. Mix chicken broth and cream of chicken soup and pour over mixture, then mix milk and Bisquick together (batter will be thin). Pour on top of casserole. Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

title: Ooey Gooey Butter Cake
directions: Combine cake mix, margarine and 4 eggs., Turn into very large (10 x 16 1/2 x 2-inch) greased pan., Mix together sugar, cream cheese and 2 eggs; beat well., Pour over cake batter., Sprinkle with black walnuts., Bake 45 to 55 minutes in preheated 350° oven. Looks ugly but tastes great!

title: Mam-Maw'S Old Fashioned Sauerkraut
directions: You will need churn or large glass jar.

title: Mexican Deviled Eggs
directions: Cut eggs in half length wise. Remove yolk-place in bowl. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Fill eggs and enjoy.

title: Spicy Sausage Cheese Dip
directions: Brown and drain sausage and hamburger., Combine all ingredients in crock-pot and cook on high until cheese melts. Stir frequently., Reduce heat and serve from crock-pot with corn chips or tortilla chips.

title: Meat Loaf
directions: Mix well., Bake in ungreased loaf pan for 1 hour and 15 minutes at 350°., Let stand 5 minutes before removing from pan.

title: Death By Chocolate
directions: Slice baked cake through middle and break into small pieces. Put one half in large bowl or pan., Spread 1/2 chocolate pudding over cake., Add 1/2 chocolate bar pieces and 1/2 Cool Whip., Repeat layers., An additional candy bar may be used to decorate top., Keep refrigerated.

title: Fruit Cookies
directions: Cream butter and sifted sugar., Add eggs, one at a time., Add vanilla, milk and preserves., Sift flour and soda together and add to butter mixture., Have all fruits and nuts cut up into small pieces., Roll in extra flour; shake off as much flour as possible. Add to batter., Mix with hands until all fruits are well covered. Drop on greased pan., Bake in slow 350° oven for about 18 minutes.

title: Tuna Pasta Bake
directions: In small saucepan over medium-high heat, heat oil., Add onion and garlic and cook, stirring occasionally, about 3 minutes., Add tomato sauce and oregano; bring to a boil., Reduce heat, cover and simmer, stirring occasionally about 15 minutes.

title: Homemade Bread
directions: Heat and melt shortening., Add sugar, salt and milk., Cool. Add yeast that has been dissolved in 1/2 c. warm water to cooled mixture., Add flour, and beaten eggs alternately, beating well after each addition., Place dough in greased bowl to rise until doubled., Cover with cloth., When rising is complete, punch down and put dough in 4 greased loaf pans., Let rise, then bake at 350° until brown., Takes about 35-40 minutes., Butter crust when done.

title: Yeast Biscuits
directions: Place water, sugar and yeast in small bowl and set aside., Add all the rest in a large bowl, then add items in small bowl., Mix all together and set in fridge for 15 to 20 minutes., Bake what you want now and leave rest in fridge; will stay good for a week., Bake at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Prize Winning Meat Loaf
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Combine and mix well all ingredients. Press firmly into ungreased loaf pan (2 if needed)., Bake at 375° about 1 hour., Remove from oven and let stand 5 minutes before slicing.

title: Apple Butter
directions: Core and quarter unpeeled apples; cook in large heavy saucepan until soft, about 30 minutes., Press through food mill.

title: Wild Rice Bread
directions: Dissolve yeast in warm water., Heat milk to lukewarm; add honey., Stir to dissolve., Add to ingredients., Stir in dry milk and oil., Stir in flour and cooked rice., Pour dough onto floured surface; knead in flour (dough is slightly sticky because of rice)., Place in greased bowl., Cover., Let rise in warm place until double., Turn out on lightly floured surface., Knead well. Place in 2 loaf pans., Let rise until double., Turn out on lightly floured surface., Knead well., Place in 2 loaf pans., Let rise until double., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes until lightly brown. Brush with butter while still warm., This dough does not raise very fast.

title: Italian Spaghetti Sauce
directions: In large pot, combine onion, garlic and olive oil., Saute, but don't brown., Add remaining ingredients., Simmer 3 hours., Add meatballs the last hour., Serve with freshly grated Italian cheese.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Mix broccoli, mushroom soup, Miracle Whip or mayo, egg, onion and sharp or Cheddar cheese together and put in buttered 2-quart casserole dish., Melt oleo and toss in Pepperidge Farm stuffing. Place stuffing on casserole., Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350°.

title: Sweet-And-Sour Spareribs
directions: Place ribs on a rack in large shallow roasting pan., Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 1 1/2 hours., Meanwhile, combine sugars and cornstarch in medium saucepan., Stir in catsup, vinegar and water; bring to boil., Cook and stir until thickened and clear., Remove ribs and rack from pan; discard fat., Place ribs back in roasting pan., Pour about 1 1/2 cups of the sauce over ribs., Bake 30 minutes longer., Cut ribs into serving size pieces., Brush with remaining sauce., Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Italian Potato Salad
directions: Boil potatoes, eggs and onion., Fry bacon and crumble., Mix altogether using equal amounts of sour cream and creamy Italian dressing., Salt and pepper to taste.

title: Peanut Butter Pound Cake
directions: Mix together margarine, sugars and peanut butter., Add eggs, one at a time., Sift flour, baking powder, salt and soda., Add to mixture; beat well., Add milk and vanilla., Bake in tube pan at 350° for 1 hour., Cool., Frost with Peanut Butter Frosting.

title: Chuck Wagon Chili Soup
directions: Saute beef in a 5-quart pot over medium heat 4 minutes or until brown., Discard fat., Saute onions and garlic in pot 4 minutes or until soft., Stir in chili powder and cumin, then squash, broth and 1 extra cup water., Cover and gently boil 15 minutes until squash is almost tender., Add tomatoes and beans; bring to a boil., Reduce heat; cover and simmer 15 minutes to develop flavors., Serve with shredded Cheddar cheese and sliced scallions.

title: Oreo Cookie Dessert
directions: First Layer:, Crush cookies; save out about 3/4 cup to sprinkle on top layer., Melt margarine; add to cookies, then press into a 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Creole Green Beans
directions: Cook green beans in salted water until tender., Reserve liquid.

title: Shirley Cumming'S Cabbage Soup
directions: Saute garlic,, bacon and cut up cabbage strips in olive oil for, 2, minutes in frying pan., Then add chicken broth and pepper; simmer for 15 minutes., Add noodles and simmer for 15 more minutes., Serve with corn bread or muffins.

title: Sour Cream Cake
directions: Bake 1 hour at 350°.

title: Lemon Sponge Pie
directions: In mixer, cream butter and sugar until fluffy., Beat in egg yolks, flour, salt, milk and lemon juice., In bowl, beat egg whites until fluffy, then add to mixture., Bake 15 minutes at 375° then 45 minutes at 300° until lightly golden.

title: Pressed Fruit Cake
directions: Mix Pet milk and marshmallows together and melt, stirring constantly., Add nuts, fruit and crumbs., Mix well and press in pan or dish and store in refrigerator.

title: Never Fail Meringue
directions: Combine 2 teaspoons sugar and 1 tablespoon cornstarch in saucepan., Add 1/2 cup water., Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly until thick and clear., Cool., Beat egg whites with salt and vanilla until soft peaks form., Add 4 tablespoons sugar after adding cornstarch mixture., Beat until it stands in stiff peaks., Spread on pie., Bake for 10 minutes at 350°.

title: Uncooked Fudge
directions: Melt chocolate and then add butter, milk and vanilla., Add confectioners sugar and nuts or coconut., Mix well and pour into a buttered, square pan.

title: Chicken And Wild Rice Casserole
directions: Boil and debone chicken to bite-size pieces., Set aside. Prepare rice as directed., Set aside., Saute onion in butter or margarine until soft; blend in flour, soup and milk and add mushrooms.

title: Puppy Chow
directions: Combine chips, butter and peanut butter., Melt in large saucepan, stirring until all ingredients are melted., Take pan off stove and add cereal., Mix until all cereal is coated with chocolate mixture., Put 1 cup of powdered sugar in brown paper bag., Add cereal and shake until mixture is powdered with the sugar.

title: Microwave Meat Loaf
directions: Combine all ingredients., Shape into loaf or ring mold., Cover with wax paper., Microwave at Medium for 15 to 16 minutes., Let stand 5 minutes.

title: Hush Puppies
directions: Blend eggs, milk, onion and peppers in a blender. Add to dry ingredients. Fry in deep fat., They will turn over by themselves when 1 side is done.

title: Tuna Hot Snack
directions: Flake tuna and add salad dressing, mustard, Worcestershire sauce and horseradish., Fill croustades or shells; top with grated Parmesan cheese., Bake in moderate oven until brown., Serves 6.

title: Turkey Cabbage Patties
directions: Mix all ingredients together, make into 6 patties and fry until done., Can also be microwaved, power High for 5 minutes. Rearrange patties and cook 5 more minutes at power 7 or until done.

title: Cherry Pie Supreme
directions: In saucepan, combine sugar, cornstarch, and salt., Gradually add cherry juice, stirring until thick and clear., Add butter and extract., Cool., Line 9 inch pie plate with pastry., Add cherries to cool cornstarch mixture., Pour into pastry lined pie plate. Top with crust., Crimp edges high., Fold strip of aluminum foil around edge of pie., Bake in oven (425°) about 40 minutes., Remove foil 10 minutes before end of baking., I roll the crust between 2 sheets of wax paper., I fold it and put it in the pan, on the top crust I spread canned milk on top crust, then cut holes and put bits of oleo in the holes., Then sprinkle sugar on top of crust.

title: 7-Up Pound Cake
directions: Cream oleo and sugar for 20 minutes., Put in 1 egg at a time, beating after each egg., Add 7-Up., Pour into well-greased and floured tube pan and bake 1 1/4 hours at 325°., God bless!

title: J.D.'S Party Mix
directions: Preheat oven to 250°., Melt butter in a large oven pan., Add remaining ingredients and mix thoroughly., Bake at 250° for 1 hour, stirring occasionally., Store in an airtight container.

title: Chocolate Macaroons
directions: Combine in double boiler the oil, chocolate and sugar., Beat in eggs one at a time., Add vanilla and flour., Chill., Drop into sugar and shape., Bake on wax paper in moderate oven (375°) for 12 to 15 minutes., Makes 6 dozen.

title: Honey Bars
directions: Mix honey and eggs together., Add baking powder and flour sifted together, then add chopped nuts, dates and flavoring., Bake at 350° on cookie sheet for 15 to 20 minutes., Mixture should be 1/4 inch deep., Cut in strips (1/2 x 3-inch)., Roll in powdered sugar before serving., Yields 60 to 72.

title: 5 Cup Salad(Very Good)
directions: Mix together and serve., Drain fruit., This is very good., I used a whole can (large) or crushed drained pineapple and small can of mandarin oranges., My grandchildren loved it.

title: Beer Bread
directions: Mix ingredients together., Pour into greased loaf pan., Bake at 350° for 1 hour., Brush top with melted butter.

title: 3 Soup Casserole
directions: Mix all the ingredients. Place mixture in a casserole dish. Top with grated cheese. Cook at 375 until cheese in melted well.

title: Stuffed Mushrooms(First Course For Two)
directions: *Use light variety bread.

title: Taffy Apple Pizza
directions: Spread and flatten 1 package of refrigerated peanut butter cookie dough in a pizza pan., Bake according to directions., If it bakes over the edge of the pan, trim some away., Cook completely.

title: Biscuits
directions: Mix and sift dry ingredients., Add Miracle Whip and mix., Add milk, all at once, and stir., Turn out on floured board and knead 5 or 6 times., Roll to 1/2 or 3/4-inch thick., Cut with biscuit cutter., Bake at 350° until done.

title: Vegetable Beef Soup
directions: Saute beef and onions in margarine in large saucepan until meat is browned., Add tomatoes, water, celery, bouillon cubes, bay leaf, Worcestershire sauce, salt and pepper., Bring to a boil; cover and simmer 30 minutes., Add mixed vegetables, noodles and thyme., Bring to a boil; cover and simmer 15 minutes., Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Jellied Pineapple Salad
directions: Marinate marshmallows in pineapple with juice., Add whipped cream and cheese., Moisten gelatine in cold water and dissolve in 1/4 cup hot water., Add to mixture, then add pecans., Pour into mold., Sprinkle some grated cheese on top and chill overnight.

title: Old Fashioned Spice Cake
directions: Have all ingredients at room temperature., Soften butter in a bowl., Add spices and salt., Mix well. Add sugar., Mix well., Beat 5 of the eggs, one at a time. Stir in flour and the last remaining egg. Grease only the bottom of a 9-inch tube cake pan and flour lightly., Place in a cold oven., Bake at 300° for 1 1/2 hours or until well done., Cool at least 20 minutes before turning out.

title: Smoked Sausage Oriental
directions: Saute green pepper, onion and sausage in butter for 5 minutes. Combine cornstarch, ginger, vinegar, soy sauce and preserves. Stir into sausage mixture., Cook over low heat until sauce thickens., Mix in pineapple chunks and heat., Serve over chow mein noodles or rice.

title: "Papa" Pound Cake
directions: Sift flour, baking powder, cocoa and salt., Beat Crisco and sugar good., Add eggs, one at a time, and beat well., Add milk and dry ingredients alternately and beat well after each addition. Add vanilla., Bake in tube cake pan at 325° for 1 or 1 1/2 hours.

title: Brown Bread
directions: Mix first 5 ingredients., Let stand 5 minutes., Add the rest; mix until flour is dampened., Fill oiled cans a little more than half full., Place in cold oven., Bake at 325°., Bake about 40 minutes., Let set a little before you loosen them., Run a serrated knife around the sides and they will slowly slide out., Makes 7 cans., Tastes better the longer it sets., Can use more nuts, prunes and raisins.

title: Chinese Noodle Casserole
directions: Combine all ingredients in a large casserole dish; mix well. Bake, uncovered, for 40 to 45 minutes in a 350° oven.

title: Sweet And Sassy Sauce
directions: In a medium-size saucepan melt butter or margarine and saute onions., Combine all the other ingredients and let it simmer until your ribs are ready.

title: Potato Wedges
directions: Cut potatoes into wedges; cook until tender., Drain., Layer baking dish with potato wedges, slice butter and place on top of potatoes., Add salt, pepper and garlic salt (may use seasoned salt as well)., Place in oven on broil until golden brown.

title: Enchilada Casserole
directions: Mix onion, Ro-Tel tomatoes, green chilies and soup in blender. Brown ground beef and drain., Break 6 tortillas in pieces and spread in bottom of 9 x 12-inch pan., Put half of the ground beef, half of the sauce and half of the cheese over the tortillas. Place other 6 tortillas on top of the cheese (do not break up these tortillas)., Put rest of meat, sauce and cheese over the tortillas., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Golden Glow Salad
directions: Dissolve jello in boiling water., Add pineapple juice, lemon juice, crushed pineapple, grated carrots and celery., Pour into molds and chill until firm.

title: Bleu Cheese Roll-Ups
directions: Mix, all, ingredients, together., Make into 1-inch meat balls. Cut, bacon, slices, in half and wrap each slice around meat ball., Hold, together with toothpick., Bake in 400° oven for 30 minutes, or until bacon is crisp., Remove toothpick and serve hot.

title: Woodchuck Patties
directions: Remove all fat from the meat and grind with a meat grinder. Mix the ground meat with bread crumbs, egg, parsley, green onions, green pepper, garlic powder and basil., Salt and pepper to taste and shape into patties.

title: Seven Seas Casserole
directions: Mix water with soup, onion, salt, lemon juice and dash of pepper in saucepan., Bring to boil over medium heat, stirring occasionally., Pour about 1/2 of soup mixture into greased 1 1/2-quart casserole, then in layers add rice (right from box), partially thawed frozen peas and tuna., Add rest of soup. Sprinkle with cheese and dash of paprika., Cover and bake in a 375° oven for 15 to 20 minutes., After 10 minutes, cut through with knife.

title: Strawberry Cake
directions: Soften oleo and gradually add powdered sugar, then the frozen, thawed strawberries. Be careful not to add too much berries; it may not take the full 1/2 cup. Blend and spread between layers, sides and top of cake.

title: Coca-Cola Salad
directions: Mix sugar, water and cherry juice together., Bring to a boil. Add Jell-O and mashed cherries., Let stand 5 minutes; add pineapple and nuts, then Coke last., Chill and serve.

title: German Potatoes
directions: Peel potatoes, slice or cut into 1/2-inch pieces and boil in salted water just until tender., (Be careful not to overcook or the potatoes will become mush.), Meanwhile cut bacon into small pieces. Cut onion into small pieces or green onions into thin slices., Mix together vinegar, water, sugar, pepper and salt., Fry bacon in skillet until crisp, then scoop bacon out of skillet into vinegar mixture, leaving drippings in skillet., Saute onion in drippings. Add flour to onion in skillet and stir until smooth and thickened. Drain potatoes (when tender) and pour into skillet., Add bacon/vinegar mixture and stir gently to mix evenly.

title: Chocolate Fudge
directions: In heavy saucepan, mix all ingredients except pecans., Stir thoroughly and cook to 238°., Stir often., Cool to 170° and add pecans., Stir until thick., Pour onto a buttered platter and cut into squares.

title: Fish Chowder
directions: Melt butter in saucepan; mix in celery and onion., Arrange fish fillets on top., Cover and simmer until fish is done, about 20 minutes for frozen fish, 10 minutes for fresh., Break up the fish with a spoon into bite size chunks., Add remaining ingredients and simmer gently for 30 minutes.

title: Grilled Red Potatoes
directions: Slice garlic cloves., Mix with olive oil., Set aside for at least 4 hours., Wash potatoes., Cut into quarters., Place into microwavesafe covered dish., Add water., Cook 10 to 15 minutes on High in microwave or until tender., Drain water., Place on grill; brush with olive oil mix., Turn occasionally until slightly crisp. Serve immediately.
