title: Skillet Herbed Chicken
directions: Loosen skin of chicken with fingers, working from breast side. Cut off wing tips., Blend butter with lemon peels, salt and herbs. Spread on the meat under the skin and skewer wing to breast. Heat a 9-inch skillet over moderate heat and place chicken, skin side down, in, the dry pan., Cover and cook over medium heat 25 minutes or until chicken is nicely browned and tender.

title: Carrot Bran Muffins
directions: Combine bran flakes, milk and carrots; let stand 5 minutes. Add remaining ingredients, stirring until particles are moistened. Line each muffin tin with two paper liners; fill half full., Bake in 400° oven for 20 minutes.

title: Cranberry Salad
directions: Put cranberries and oranges, including rind, through grinder. Add celery, nuts and sugar., Make Jell-O using only 1 1/2 cups water., Add other ingredients., Place in refrigerator until thick. Serve with whip cream.

title: Dirt Dessert
directions: Crush Oreos in food processor., Beat together cream cheese and margarine., Mix pudding and milk., Blend the two mixtures., Add Cool Whip., Layer cookies and pudding mixture in a bowl., (For children's parties, fill clear, plastic cups and garnish with gummy worms.), Refrigerate for one hour.

title: Texas Hash
directions: Slowly cook meat, onion, celery and bell pepper until celery and onion are tender., Add uncooked rice and tomatoes., Add salt and pepper to taste., Simmer about 45 minutes.

title: Banana Pudding
directions: Mix first 4 ingredients., Heat until thickened., Add to beaten egg yolks., Bring to a boil., Thicken and remove from heat and add vanilla flavoring., Pour this over banana and vanilla wafers which have been layered., Top with meringue and brown lightly.

title: Beef Brisket Pot Roast
directions: Heat large heavy pot., Add meat., Brown on all sides without oil., Pour off any fat., Sprinkle onion around meat., Cover tightly., Cook over low heat for 1 hour., Remove from heat., Keep covered and let meat cool to lukewarm., When cool, slice across grain for serving., Return meat to pot., Sprinkle with salt and pepper., Cover and simmer 1 to 2 hours longer or until tender, turning slices once.

title: Sweet Pickle Recipe
directions: Put cucumbers in stone	jar or glass., Pour over them 1 gallon boiling water with	1 teacup salt dissolved., Let stand 8 days. On the 8th	day,, drain off water and wash good. Then pour	over gallon boiling water and let stand 24 hours., Ninth day,, pour over, a, gallon, boiling, water, with 1 tablespoon powdered, alum; let stand 24 hours., Tenth day, drain and pour over, 1 gallon boiling water and let stand 24 hours., Eleventh day, drain and pour over boiling syrup.

title: Cranberry Bars
directions: Combine flour, oats, brown sugar, lemon rind and soda in mixer bowl; mix well., Stir in margarine., Reserve 1 cup flour mixture. Press remaining flour mixture into 9 x 13-inch baking pan., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes., Spread cranberry sauce over baked layer. Sprinkle with, mixture of reserved flour mixture and pecans., Bake for 25 to 30 minutes longer or until golden brown., Cool. Cut into bars., May be frozen up to 12 months.

title: Oriental Chicken
directions: Cut chicken into 1/4-inch strips, cutting across the grain. Heat oil and add chicken until they go white (about 3 minutes). Add green pepper, onion, celery, water chestnuts, broth, salt and ginger., Cover and cook about 6 minutes., Mix soy sauce with cornstarch., Add to skillet with bean sprouts., Turn heat down and simmer few minutes., Serve over hot rice., Serves 4.

title: Mandarin Dessert
directions: Drain oranges; save juice., Add enough water to make 1 cup. Dissolve jello in 2 cups boiling water., Add sherbet and stir until melted., Chill until thickened., Then add orange sections and chill until you are ready to serve, about 2 hours.

title: Bean Soup
directions: Wash and drain beans; cover with water., Add salt; soak overnight., In morning drain beans and add 2 quarts water and ham hock with ham shreds., Bring to a boil., Cover and simmer 3 hours. Cut ham off bone; return meat to pot., Add remaining ingredients and simmer 30 minutes more., Enjoy!!

title: Pig Eat'In Cake
directions: Put cake, mix,	eggs,, oil and oranges in bowl and mix. Bake at 350° until done.

title: Chocolate Town Chip Cookies
directions: Cream shortening, sugars and vanilla until light and fluffy. Add eggs and beat well., Add flour to mixture., Stir in chocolate chips., Drop by teaspoonfuls onto a baking sheet., Bake at 375° for 8 to 10 minutes., Makes 2 dozen.

title: Gumdrop Cookies
directions: Mix together and drop by rounded spoonfuls., Bake at 350° until golden brown.

title: Sausage-Bean Stuffing Supreme
directions: Combine 4 cups water, beans and chicken bouillon cubes., Bring to boiling and boil gently for 2 minutes., Remove from heat; cover and let stand for 1 hour., Add sausage, tomato, onion, celery, parsley, garlic, thyme, bay leaf and salt., Return to boiling. Cover and simmer for 1 hour., Stir in wine., Boil gently, uncovered, for 30 minutes more or until liquid is absorbed. Makes 4 cups stuffing, enough for a 5 to 6 pound duckling.

title: Zucchini Chocolate Cake
directions: Cream the margarine, oil and sugar., Add eggs, vanilla and sour milk; beat well., Stir in zucchini., Add dry ingredients. Pour into a greased and floured pan, 9 x 13-inch size., Sprinkle with chocolate chips on top., Bake at 325° for 45 minutes.

title: Rolls
directions: Add sugar and shortening to boiling water., Cool in mixing bowl., Add yeast that has been mixed with lukewarm water., Add cold water, eggs and salt., Add flour 2 cups at a time., Place dough in bowl and rub with vegetable oil., Refrigerate overnight.

title: Cheese Cut Outs
directions: Mix butter and cheese, then add soup mix and flour., Blend and shape into ball and chill., Roll out on floured board., Cut into desired shapes., Bake at 375° for 10 minutes., Makes about 5 dozen., (If difficult to roll out, add more flour.)

title: Cheer-Up Chicken Soup
directions: In 3-quart saucepan, combine water and broth; bring to a boil. Meanwhile, cut chicken into 1/2-inch chunks., Add to liquid with carrots, celery and potatoes., Simmer for 10 minutes., Add mushrooms, onions and thyme., Simmer for 15 to 20 minutes., Add salt and pepper., Serves 4 to 6.

title: Cucumber Mousse
directions: Peel and coarsely grate cucumbers., Wrap in a paper towel and squeeze gently to completely remove juice., Dissolve gelatin and salt in boiling water., Add cold water and vinegar. Fold in sour cream and chill mixture until thickened., Fold in cucumbers, onion and pepper., Pour into greased mold and chill until firm. Serves 6.

title: One Pan Banana Bread
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Grease loaf pans., Stir ingredients in pan until moist., Beat 1 minute., Bake 55 to 65 minutes., Cool 10 minutes before cutting., Makes 2 loaves.

title: Black Forest Cake
directions: Prepare cake mix as directed on package., Bake batter in 2 greased and floured 9-inch pans., Remove cake layers from pans and cool on rack., Place 1 cooled layer on serving plate., Spread half can of cherries on first layer., Top with second layer., Combine sugar, vanilla, orange rind, and cream., Whip cream mixture until cream holds its shape., Spread on second layer and sides., Spread half of cherries on top of whipped cream., Sprinkle with chocolate shavings., Chill until ready to serve.

title: Pecan Pie
directions: Mix together in order listed., Pour into unbaked pie crust. Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes or until center is firm.

title: Puppy Chow
directions: Melt butter, peanut butter and chocolate chips in large pan over low heat. After completely melted, pour box of cereal into pan and coat each piece. Be careful not to break up cereal. After coated, pour box of powdered sugar into trash bag, then pour cereal over it and shake bag until cereal is coated.

title: Molded Shrimp Loaf
directions: Dissolve gelatin in cold water., Bring tomato soup to a boil in saucepan., Add gelatin and allow to cool., When cool, add cream cheese., Stir in all other ingredients., Pour into an oiled 9 x 5-inch loaf pan; cover and chill for 2 to 4 hours or until set. To serve, unmold on large platter., Garnish with lettuce and lemon and lime slices.

title: Lemonade Pie
directions: Mix the lemonade and Eagle Brand milk., Fold in the whipped cream., Put in graham cracker crust., Cool in refrigerator for 3 hours.

title: Apple Crisp Pie
directions: Place apples in pie shell, then sprinkle with the sugar., Mix together the flour, oleo, nutmeg and brown sugar and sprinkle over the top of the apples., Bake at about 375° until apples are tender.

title: Lime Jello Salad
directions: Dissolve 1 package lime jello with 1 1/2 cups boiling water. Blend cream cheese to jello., Add remaining ingredients. Refrigerate.

title: Graham Cracker Cake
directions: Cream shortening and sugar., Add eggs., Pour milk over crackers., When soft, add to mixture., Add remaining ingredients. Bake in 2 layers at 375° for 25 minutes., Put together with whipped cream or topping.

title: Chocolate Snack Cake(Without Eggs)
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Mix first 5 ingredients (dry) in bowl with fork; stir in rest., Pour into ungreased 8 x 8-inch pan. Bake 35 to 40 minutes., Cake can be mixed in pan., Recipe can be doubled and made in 13 x 9-inch pan, but should be mixed with mixer.

title: Wine Cake
directions: Mix and beat ingredients 5 minutes., Bake in 350° oven for 40 to 45 minutes in well-greased Bundt pan., Can be made 2 days in advance., Frost or glaze as preferred.

title: Honey Cookies
directions: Cream shortening and sugar, then eggs., Add honey, sour milk and vanilla., Beat well and add dry ingredients., Chill and form into balls., Roll in sugar., Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Mushrooms A La Grecque
directions: Place tomatoes in a 1 1/2 to 2-quart casserole and add wine. Cook over low heat 20 to 25 minutes., Strain and discard liquid. Add the mushrooms (wash them first!), pepper, bay leaf and olive oil to tomato pulp., Cook 30 minutes over low heat., Correct seasoning with salt and pepper., Serve cold., Serves 4.

title: Pronto Pups
directions: Mix dry ingredients together., Add egg and milk and beat until smooth., Dip franks in batter and fry until brown., Drain on paper towels., If batter is too thick add some more milk.

title: Cranberry Cooler
directions: Dissolve raspberry sherbet in cranberry juice until slushy. Add the 7-Up., Serves about 30.

title: Creative Noodle Pudding
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Cook entire package of noodles., Let sit in water for 1 hour or overnight., Separate eggs., Beat egg yolks, sugar and vanilla until thick and lemon colored., Beat egg whites until stiff., Mix yolk mixture with drained noodles., Add any optional ingredients.

title: Sherrie Broccoli Casserole
directions: Cook, broccoli, 30 minutes., Drain water., Mix together cheese, egg, soup, mayonnaise and mushrooms., Pour over cooked broccoli and stir well., Cover with cracker crumbs and drizzle butter on top.

title: Beef Stroganoff
directions: Mix all ingredients except mushrooms and sour cream., Bake at 350° until meat is tender., Add mushrooms and juice before serving., Add sour cream., Serve over rice or noodles.

title: Chocolate Fudge Deluxe
directions: In a 3 1/2-quart saucepan, mix sugar with dry gelatin., Add milk, corn syrup, chocolate and butter., Cook over medium heat, stirring frequently, to 238° on thermometer., Remove from heat; pour into a large mixing bowl., Stir in vanilla., Cool about 25 minutes or to 110°., Beat with wooden spoon until candy thickens. Stir in walnuts., Spread into prepared pan., Let cool., Cut in squares., Makes about 2 1/2 pounds.

title: Pepper Steak
directions: Trim excess fat from steak and discard., Press peppercorns into both sides of steak with heel of hand., Melt butter in pan large enough to hold steak., When butter is sizzling, brown steak on one side, turn and brown second side., Reduce heat and finish cooking steak., (To test, make a small slash with a sharp knife to see if steak is as done as you want it to be.), Season with salt to taste., Obviously, makes one serving.

title: Chocolate Carmelita Bars
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Grease a 13 x 9-inch baking pan., Combine first seven ingredients; mix well., Reserve one cup; press remaining on bottom of prepared pan., Bake 10 to 12 minutes or until light brown; cool 10 minutes., Top with nuts and chocolate pieces.

title: Angel Food Delight
directions: Mix chocolate pudding mix, according to instructions on the box., In, a, 13 x 9 x 2-inch glass dish, tear up the angel food cake, into	small, (bite, size) pieces., Spoon on pudding mixture and top with Cool Whip.

title: Chicken Taco Rice
directions: Cook and stir chicken in hot oil until lightly browned., Add broth, tomato sauce and seasoning mix., Bring to a boil., Stir in rice., Cover and simmer 5 minutes., Add corn and red pepper., Bring to a full boil., Stir in rice., Cover., Remove from heat., Let stand 5 minutes., Fluff with a fork., Serve with cheese sprinkled over it, tortilla chips and sour cream, if desired.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
directions: Beat eggs, sugar, soda and salt., Add oil and mix., Add flour and vanilla., Mix all together., Add apples and pecans., Bake in 350° oven for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Chess Pie
directions: Pour into unbaked pastry shell., Bake slowly for 40 minutes.

title: Lemon Bars
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Grease and flour a baking pan., In a bowl beat butter until creamy., Beat in 1/2 cup confectioners sugar and then work in 2 cups flour to make a smooth dough., Press dough in an even layer in the prepared pan., Bake 15 minutes until slightly puffed., Next, beat eggs in a bowl with a wire whisk., Beat in granulated sugar, lemon peel and juice., Sift remaining 1/4 cup flour over egg mixture and stir in., Prick top of crust with a fork about an inch away from each other all over., Pour egg mixture over crust and bake 30 minutes until egg mixture is set. Remove from oven., Cool and sprinkle top with 1 1/2 tablespoons confectioners sugar.

title: Tomato Aspic
directions: Heat juice and dissolve jello., Add water and cool until slightly thickened., Stir in celery, onion and horseradish., Add sliced stuffed olives and shrimp if you like variation., Pour into ring mold or individual molds.

title: Chocolate Drink
directions: Combine all ingredients in a container with a lid. Shake until dry milk is dissolved. Drink immediately or chill in refrigerator.

title: Peanut Brittle
directions: Bring the first 5 ingredients to a boil and add the peanuts. Stir constantly until peanuts are golden brown., Remove from stove and add the soda., Stir until foaming almost stops., Pour on greased sheet pan., Use heavy pan, use wooden spoon and make on a clear, cool day.

title: Merry Cherry Salad
directions: Drain fruits and reserve juice., Dissolve gelatin in hot water and add fruit juice., Chill until partially congealed., Blend cream cheese with lemon juice, salt and mayonnaise., Fold in whipped cream., Beat chilled gelatin until light and fluffy., Fold into cream cheese mixture and fruits., Pour into chilled buttered pan., Freeze until firm., Remove from freezer., Let warm enough to cut into squares., Serve on lettuce leaf., Garnish with maraschino cherries or coconut.

title: Rice Balls
directions: Drain rice on cloth., Add eggs, salt, pepper and parsley. Chill., Fry in deep oil until light brown.

title: Western Style Stir-Fry
directions: Heat oil in large skillet over medium heat., Add beef; cook until no longer pink., Add remaining ingredients; stir to combine. Cover; reduce heat., Simmer 6 to 8 minutes or until veggies are crisp-tender., Makes 4 servings.

title: Spicy Oven Fries
directions: Cut potatoes in quarters lengthwise., Mix with olive oil. Sprinkle with pepper, salt, garlic powder and cayenne pepper. Bake at 450° for 20 minutes.

title: Martha Washington Chocolates
directions: Mix all ingredients together and roll into 1-inch balls. Chill for 30 minutes., Melt chocolate chips with paraffin. Using toothpicks, dip chilled balls into chocolate.

title: Bread And Butter Pickles
directions: Scrub fresh, crisp cucumbers., Wash but don't peel., Slice cucumbers crosswise and mix with onions and green peppers., Mix the salt with the vegetables and bury 1-quart cracked ice in mixture. Cover with a heavy lid., Let stand 3 hours., Drain and prepare the following:, Blend sugar, turmeric and cloves together., Add mustard and celery seed and vinegar., If the vinegar is too strong, substitute 1 cup of water for 1 cup vinegar., Pour this mixture over the vegetables in a large pan; heat to scalding, stirring occasionally but do not boil., Seal in hot, sterilized jars., Let stand about 3 to 4 weeks before using.

title: Garden Vegetables With Pasta
directions: Cook pasta according to package directions, adding broccoli to water last 2 minutes of cooking time; drain well., Add process cheese spread and milk to pasta mixture in saucepan., Cook over low heat, stirring, until process cheese melts., Stir in remaining ingredients., Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Mama'S Tea Cakes
directions: Mix the above ingredients except flour; sift in enough flour to make a stiff dough. Roll out and cut with a cookie cutter. Bake in a moderate oven until golden brown.

title: Sugar Free Dream Sicle Fluff
directions: Dissolve jello in 2 cups boiling water., Add ice (to make 2 cups)., Stir until melted., Let set 5 minutes., Add pudding and oranges and mix with mixer., Add cool whip and mix with mixer. Refrigerate., Tastes great and it's quick!

title: Chocolate Gravy
directions: Mix all together in a sauce pan. Cook on medium high until it thickens, stirring often.

title: Ham 'N' Cheese Balls
directions: Combine all ingredients., Form a ball and chill., Serve on crackers.

title: Red Beans And Rice
directions: Soak beans overnight., Put drained beans and ham hock in large soup kettle., Add water and salt; bring to boil., Cook slowly for 45 minutes; add other ingredients., Cook 2 hours or until beans are tender and liquid thick., Serve over steamed rice., Makes 12 servings.

title: Sloppy Joes
directions: Brown beef and onion; drain off fat., Add the rest of the ingredients., Simmer 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Beer Bread
directions: Sift together flour and sugar and add beer., Mix well., Pour into buttered 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan., Bake at 375° for 45 minutes., Melt 1/2 stick oleo., Pour over top and return to oven for 15 minutes.

title: Molasses Yeast Rolls
directions: Pour boiling water over rolled oats, molasses, shortening and salt., Cool to lukewarm., Dissolve yeast in warm water., Add yeast, eggs and 3 cups flour to oat mixture., Beat until smooth., Stir in enough of the remaining flour to form a soft dough., Knead until smooth and elastic, about 5 minutes., Place in greased bowl and cover., Let rise until double in size, about 1 hour., Punch down. Shape into rolls and place in shallow pan., Cover loosely., Rise until doubled in size, 30 to 40 minutes., Bake in a 350° oven for 20 to 25 minutes., Brush with melted butter., Makes 3 dozen rolls. Enjoy!

title: Squash Dressing
directions: Cook squash and onion in enough water for simmering (about 1 1/2 cups) until tender., Drain, reserving 1 cup liquid., Return 1 cup liquid to squash., Mix all ingredients., Place in 2-quart buttered casserole dish., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until light golden brown., Yield: 6 to 8 servings.

title: Potato Soup
directions: Prepare potatoes, onions and celery., Place in saucepan, add water, salt and pepper., Cover and turn to high heat., Bring to rolling boil, switch to simmer and cook for 20 minutes., Then add milk and bring almost to a boil, again using high heat., While this is heating, measure flour into bowl and add egg., Stir with a fork until thoroughly mixed., Stir in egg, flour mixture and butter., Switch to simmer for at least 15 minutes.

title: Wagon Wheel Vegetable Platter
directions: Begin your platter with a bed of lettuce on a round platter. Add thick slices of tomatoes and thin slices of onion around edge of platter., Place pieces of avocado on tomatoes., Make spokes with raw cucumber sticks or celery sticks., Fill center of dish with radish roses and carrot curls.

title: Fruit Cake
directions: Cream butter and sugar real good., Add eggs and flour alternately, adding flour first and last., Cut fruit and nuts fine and mix with a little flour., (This keeps all the fruit from going to the bottom of cake.), Add vanilla., Mix nuts and fruit with batter.

title: Strawberry Sherbet
directions: Rinse, drain and hull berries., Add sugar and mash., Stir in buttermilk., Pour into refrigerator trays; freeze 2 to 3 hours. Remove from trays; break into chunks., Beat with electric beater until smooth., Refreeze until firm.

title: Apple Cake
directions: Bake in tube pan at 350° for 45 to 55 minutes.

title: Texas Pie
directions: Beat the first 7 ingredients together until blended., Stir in coconut and pineapple., Pour into pie crust., Bake for 5 minutes at 425°., Reduce oven temperature to 325°; bake for about 1 hour longer.

title: Lemon Herb Chicken With Hollandaise Sauce
directions: Dip chicken breasts in bread crumbs., Place the fillets on microwavable dish and cover with a domed, microwavable cover., Cook fillet on High for 4 minutes., Rotate dish 1/4 turn and continue cooking on High for 4 additional minutes., Add 1/8 cup of water to the frozen broccoli in microwavable dish and cover., Microwave broccoli for 3 minutes on High., Separate the broccoli and microwave for 3 additional minutes on High., Divide broccoli and place each portion with a chicken breast., Pour Hollandaise Sauce equally over both portions and serve.

title: Potatoes Romanoff
directions: Boil potatoes in skins just until tender., Chill in refrigerator., When chilled, grate potatoes., Mix sour cream, cream cheese, milk, margarine, 3/4 cup grated cheese, salt, pepper, onion and grated potatoes., Put in 9 x 12-inch baking dish., Sprinkle with 3/4 cup grated cheese., Bake at 350° for 40 to 50 minutes.

title: Hot Broccoli Dip
directions: Saute onion and celery in butter., Add flour, then cheese (cut up cheese into chunks, so it will melt quickly)., Then add mushrooms and soup., Cook broccoli according to directions on package., Drain., Add to mixture., Heat the dip well, then pour into chafing dish and keep hot., Serve with Fritos.

title: Speedy Little Devils
directions: Mix melted butter with dry cake mix; set aside 1 1/2 cups. Press rest into 9 x 13-inch pan., Spread mixed Marshmallow Creme and peanut butter on top., Crumble rest of cake mix on top., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes., Let cool and cut.

title: Jimmy Dean'S Calico Beans
directions: Brown sausage, hamburger, onion and celery., Drain off fat. Add remaining ingredients., Cook in crock-pot on high for 4 to 5 hours.

title: Clara'S Nesselrode Pie
directions: In a small bowl, soak the gelatin in the cold water for about 5 minutes., In a separate bowl, beat the egg yolks., Add 1/4 cup of sugar and cream.

title: Flying Saucer Cookies
directions: Mix the first 3 ingredients, then add the next 2., Mix and add the next 4 ingredients and stir in the last 4 ingredients., Drop by spoonfuls on cookie sheet., Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes. Makes 5 dozen.

title: Chicken And Broccoli
directions: Mix soup, mayo, milk and lemon juice., Heat and stir., Place in 9 x 13-inch pan, broccoli on bottom, some sauce, cut up chicken, remainder of sauce, grated cheese, bread crumbs on top. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Andy'S Country Pie
directions: Melt butter., Add chips and melt., Add remaining ingredients. Mix., Pour into two unbaked pie shells., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Mexican Cornbread
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Stir well., Bake in greased muffin pans or a 9 x 13-inch pan at 350° until done.

title: Zucchini Relish
directions: Cut up vegetables; grind in food chopper, using coarse blade. Add salt., Cover; refrigerate overnight., Rinse in cold water. Drain well.

title: Baking Powder Biscuits
directions: Heat oven to 450°., Cut shortening into flour, baking powder and salt with pastry blender until mixture resembles fine crumbs. Stir in just enough milk so dough leaves side of bowl and rounds up into a ball., Turn dough onto lightly floured surface., Knead lightly 10 times., Roll 1/2-inch thick., Cut with floured 2-inch biscuit cutter., Place on ungreased cookie sheet about 1 inch apart for crusty sides, touching for soft sides., Bake until golden brown, 10 to 12 minutes., Immediately remove from cookie sheet., Makes about 1 dozen biscuits.

title: Strawberry-Banana Freeze
directions: Reserve 4 berries for garnish., Puree other berries and banana in blender., Add jam and milk., Blend., Freeze.

title: Chocolate Sour Cream Pound Cake
directions: Cream butter, gradually adding sugar., Beat eggs in creamed mixture, one at a time., Combine flour, cocoa, soda and salt., Add alternately the dry ingredients and sour cream to creamed mixture, mixing well after each addition., Add boiling water and vanilla. Mix well., Bake in a greased and floured 10-inch tube pan at 325° for 1 hour and 20 minutes., Check after 70 minutes with toothpick, ovens may vary., Do not overbake., Cool for 15 minutes.

title: Pink Wedding Punch
directions: Mix lemonade and ice water., Add pineapple juice and Hawaiian Punch., Stir thoroughly., Add 7-Up., Scoop sherbet into punch bowl., Pour punch over sherbet very slowly., Punch will be very frothy., Serves 100 four ounce servings.

title: Mom'S Peanut Butter Cookies
directions: Mix, eggs, oil and water., Blend in cake mix and peanut butter., Drop, by, teaspoonfuls on greased cookie sheet., Mash down with spoon., Bake at 350° for 15 or 20 minutes.

title: Never Fail Pie Crust
directions: Cut shortening into flour, baking powder and salt., Add egg and water and mix., Shape into balls and freeze or roll out and use., Makes about 7 crusts., You may re-roll or re-shape; dough doesn't get tough!

title: Cream Of Carrot Soup With Homemade Croutons
directions: Melt butter in a pan and saute the onions, potatoes and carrots for ten minutes on med low heat., Add stock and sugar and bring slowly to a boil., Simmer for 30 minutes., In a food processor, puree soup., Return to pan and add half and half. Season with salt and pepper and serve.

title: Pecan Pie
directions: Mix all ingredients together and pour into a 9-inch unbaked pie shell and bake for 1 hour at 300°.

title: Taco Soup
directions: *Ground chicken or turkey may be used or 4 chicken breasts which have been boiled, deboned and cut up may be used.

title: Chicken Pie
directions: Cook all ingredients, thicken to consistency you desire., Top with biscuits.

title: Pimento Cheese Salad Ball
directions: Mix all until well blended. Roll in nuts and chill.

title: "Muddy Buddies"
directions: Melt butter, chips and peanut butter in microwave for about 2 minutes., Stir in vanilla until smooth., Pour mixture over cereal. Put powdered sugar in a bag., Shake Chex and sugar until well coated., Spread onto wax paper to dry.

title: Cabbage Rolls Or Pigs In The Blanket
directions: Cook cabbage 25 to 30 minutes., Peel leaves. Combine hamburger, rice, onion soup mix, onion, egg and 1/2 can tomato soup., Roll meat mixture up in cabbage leaves., Secure with toothpicks., Place cabbage rolls in a large pan and cover with remainder of tomato sauce and soup. Bake 1 hour at 375°.

title: Crock-Pot Macaroni # 1
directions: Cook macaroni according to directions on box., Drain and put into crock-pot., Add other ingredients in this order: oil, milk, butter, eggs and pepper., Top with the grated cheese and cook for 4 hours on low., Turn off after 4 hours.

title: Pasta Salad
directions: Cook pasta according to directions., Drain; rinse with cold water., Chop onion, cucumbers and tomatoes., Combine ingredients for dressing., Pour over pasta, onion and cucumbers., Add tomatoes last., Refrigerate for several hours, overnight, if possible. Will serve at least 12.

title: Cabbage-Beef Casserole
directions: Brown ground beef with onions., Drain off grease., In mixing bowl, combine cabbage, carrots, salt and pepper., Add ground beef mixture to this and toss to mix well., Pour uncooked rice into a 3-quart casserole., Pour cabbage and ground beef mixture over rice., Pour beef broth and water over mixture., Cover casserole and bake 1 hour at 350°.

title: Cucumber Delight Pickles
directions: Combine vinegar, water, sugar and salt., Bring to a boil and set aside to cool., Wash, peel and slice cucumbers rather thick. Place onion and garlic in jars., Add cucumbers, filling jar to top. Fill jar with vinegar mixture; seal., Refrigerate for 3 days before serving., (Liquid makes about 3 quarts.)

title: Meowser'S Pickled Brussels
directions: Wash and trim sprouts., Thoroughly wash four 1-pint canning jars and lids., In each jar, place 1 garlic clove, 1 teaspoon dill seed, 1 teaspoon peppercorns and then fill with Brussels sprouts.

title: Chocolate Pie
directions: Microwave chocolate squares and 2 tablespoons of milk until almost melted, stirring 1/2 way through., Stir until completely melted., Beat in cream cheese, milk and sugar until well mixed. Refrigerate 10 minutes., Stir in whipped topping until smooth. Put mix in pie crust., Freeze until firm (3 to 4 hours)., Garnish with chocolate curls or shavings.

title: Fruit Kabobs
directions: You will need wooden skewers., Choose five of the fruits (grapes are a must) and cut into bite-sized pieces., Put a piece of each fruit on a wooden skewer, alternating with grapes., A strawberry on top always adds color., Refrigerate until serving time.

title: Yummy Butterscotch Brownies
directions: Preheat oven to 375°. Butter 9-inch square pan. Mix all ingredients together, combining them well. Spread mixture in pan and bake 35 to 40 minutes or until dry on top and almost firm to touch. Cool for 10 to 15 minutes. Cut into 2-inch squares.

title: Working Man'S Breakfast
directions: Fry bacon until crisp; drain and set aside., Brown onion in the bacon drippings., Add bread, cheese and potato., Crumble bacon and add to mixture., Beat eggs; pour into mixture., Season to taste and cook until set, stirring occasionally.

title: Caramel Oatmeal Chewies
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Grease 13 x 9-inch pan., Combine oats, flour, brown sugar, soda and salt; mix well., Stir in margarine. Reserve 1 cup and press remaining onto bottom of pan., Bake 10 to 12 minutes or until light brown; cool 10 minutes., Top with chocolate pieces.

title: Deanna'S Apple Crisp
directions: Wash, peel, core and slice apples., Sprinkle lightly with hot water and a few drops lemon juice., Also a few tablespoons of sugar, salt and cinnamon., Arrange apple mixture in bottom of large greased baking pan., In mixing bowl, add melted butter; keep adding remaining sugar and flour to form crumbly mixture, working with a fork., Sprinkle butter-flour mixture evenly over sliced apples., A few chopped walnuts, pecans or wheat germ give an added crunch to topping., Bake in preheated 375° oven for 35 minutes or until apples are tender and crumb topping is golden brown., Serve warm with whipped cream or softened vanilla ice cream.

title: Seafood Casserole
directions: Cook shrimp according to package directions., Thaw crab meat. Cook rice according to package directions using seasoning in package., Mix all ingredients except bread crumbs., Pour into a 1 1/2-quart greased casserole., Top with buttered bread crumbs. Bake, uncovered, in a 350° oven for 20 to 30 minutes., Serves 6.

title: Holiday Cranberry Muffins(Heartwarming Christmas 1991)
directions: Let cranberries stand overnight in 1/2 cup sugar., Combine dry ingredients., Add liquid ingredients all at once., Stir until moistened., Add cranberries and stir., Fill greased muffin pans 2/3 full., Bake for 20 minutes at 400°., Yields 18.

title: Pierogi Casserole
directions: Assemble 3 lasagna strips into a buttered 9x12 inch baking dish., Mix cheese into hot mashed potatoes., Add 1/2 potato-cheese mixture., Layer 3 more lasagna noodles and repeat with potato and cheese mixture., Saute oleo and onions until golden., Pour over casserole., Bake 20 minutes a 350 degrees uncovered.

title: Banana Split Cake
directions: Combine ingredients and press into a 13 x 9-inch pan.

title: Fresh Apple Pie(Large Recipe)
directions: Arrange apples in 8 deep pie pans that have been lined with pastry., Mix the following and sprinkle over the apples: sugar, flour, nutmeg and butter., Cover with pastry., Brush top with milk., Bake approximately 15 minutes at 425°, then 30 minutes at 350° or until apples are done., Yield:, 8 (8-inch) pies.

title: Taco Snack Mix
directions: Combine all ingredients except margarine in a large bowl, tossing to coat well with seasoning., Drizzle with melted margarine and toss to coat well., Store in an airtight container. Makes an excellent anytime snack.

title: Spaghetti Sauce
directions: Brown beef and onions in a large skillet., Drain fat., Stir in remaining ingredients., Cover and simmer 20 to 30 minutes or until slightly thickened., Makes about 4 1/2 cups.

title: Baked Chicken And Rice
directions: Place rice in bottom of flat baking pan., Lay washed chicken breasts on top of rice; sprinkle lemon pepper and salt on chicken and rice mixture., Place onion slices on top of mixture and pour the water over rice., Bake uncovered at 275° for 3 hours.

title: Noodles Alfredo
directions: Cook noodles according to package directions., Drain well and return to the pan., Add remaining ingredients, tossing lightly to coat the noodles., Good with veal and poultry., Serves 4.

title: San Francisco Chops
directions: Trim pork chops., In a microsafe dish, combine the oil and garlic., Spread evenly in dish., Microwave at High power for 1 minute., Combine sherry, soy sauce, brown sugar and pepper in bowl. Add pork chops to dish, turning to coat., Pour sauce over chops. Cover with wax paper., Microwave at High power for 4 minutes, turning chops and dish once after 2 minutes., Keep covered. Microwave at Medium power for 12 to 15 minutes, until no pink remains., Remove chops to serving dish., Dissolve cornstarch in water., Stir into pan juices., Microwave at High power for 1 to 2 minutes, until thick., Pour sauce over chops and serve.

title: Salad Dressing
directions: Combine first three ingredients and heat until sugar is dissolved., Do not boil., Remove and add the remaining ingredients. Mix thoroughly., Bottle to store.

title: Black Bean Tortilla Pinwheels
directions: Beat cream cheese and sour cream in bowl until blended., Stir in Monterey Jack cheese, olives, onion, salt and garlic powder. Cover and refrigerate 2 hours., Place beans in food processor or blender; process until smooth., Spread each tortilla with a thin layer of beans., Spread thin layer of cream cheese mixture over beans., Roll up tortillas lightly., Wrap in plastic wrap. Refrigerate until chilled., Cut 3/4-inch slices and serve with salsa.

title: Cream Cheese Pound Cake
directions: Cream together cream cheese, sugar and butter; add eggs, one at a time., Mix well., Add flour last and one package of Dream Whip., Bake at 325° for 1 hour.

title: Veal Parmigiana
directions: Melt butter in 13 x 9-inch pan. Blend salt, pepper, crumbs and Parmesan cheese., Dip meat in eggs and then in crumbs twice. Place meat in buttered pan., Cook 20 minutes in 400° oven; turn and bake 20 minutes on the other side.

title: Strawberry Supreme Cake
directions: Mix first 5 ingredients, then add strawberries., Bake in greased and floured pan per directions on box.

title: Potatoes Romanoff
directions: Spray a 1-quart casserole dish with nonstick coating., Mix all ingredients in a mixing bowl except potatoes., Gently stir in potatoes., Spoon onto prepared baking dish., Heat oven to 350°. Bake casserole 45 minutes or until slightly puffed and top is lightly browned.

title: California Tamale Pie
directions: In skillet or slow cooking pot with browning unit, cook meat until crumbly., Drain., In large bowl, mix cornmeal, milk and egg. Add meat, dry chili seasoning mix, seasoned salt, tomatoes, corn and olives., Put in slow cooker or crock-pot and cook on high for 3 to 4 hours., Sprinkle with cheese., Cover and cook for another 5 minutes., Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Meal In A Bowl Soup
directions: In a large saucepan or Dutch oven, cook ground beef or ground pork and onion until meat is browned or onion is tender., Drain off fat., Stir in beef broth, water, peas, potatoes, mushrooms, carrots, sage, basil, salt and pepper., Bring to boiling; reduce heat., Cover and simmer about 15 minutes, stirring occasionally. Serves 6.

title: Monster Cookies
directions: Melt margarine and cream with sugars., Add eggs and vanilla, which have been beaten together., Then beat in the dry ingredients with the mixture., Add rest of the ingredients by hand., Bake 12 to 15 minutes at 350°., Use an ice cream scoop or tablespoon to drop dough onto the cookie sheet.

title: Jalapeno Cornbread
directions: Beat Egg Beaters and add remaining ingredients. Pour into a large cast-iron skillet already sprayed with cooking spray., Bake 50 to 60 minutes at 350°.

title: Molasses Cookies
directions: Cream butter and sugar together. Add egg, molasses, ginger and cinnamon. Sift the flour, baking soda and salt., Add sifted dry ingredients to the creamed mixture alternately with the cold water. Drop by spoonful (large) onto greased baking sheet and bake 8 to 10 minutes in moderate hot 375° oven.

title: Peach Cobbler
directions: Melt butter in a casserole dish. Pour in peaches and sprinkle cinnamon on peaches. Mix all other ingredients and pour on top of peaches. Bake for 1 hour at 350 degrees.

title: Calico Bean Casserole #2
directions: Cook bacon, hamburger and onions in frypan. Add vinegar, brown sugar and mustard. Simmer for 15 minutes. Stir in the beans. Put meat mixture in bean pot or 1 1/2-quart casserole. Bake 1 hour at 350° or slow cooker on low for 4 hours.

title: Graham Cracker Dream Bars
directions: Mix sugar, margarine, milk and egg., Cook until it comes to boil., Remove from heat., Add coconut, nuts and graham cracker crumbs., Line 9 x 13-inch pan with whole graham crackers., On top of graham crackers, spread filling on graham crackers., Put another layer of graham crackers on top of filling.

title: Shrimp Creole
directions: Saute vegetables in butter., Add other ingredients, except shrimp and lemon; simmer 2 hours., Add shrimp during the last 30 minutes and put in whole lemon the last 10 minutes., Serve with rice and lemon juice., Serves 6.

title: Sue'S Rosh Hashana Chicken
directions: Place chicken in large Ziploc bag(s) with lemon juice. Marinate overnight, turning bags occasionally. Next day, pat dry chicken with paper towels. Dredge in seasoned flour. Fry in oil until golden. Drain on paper towel.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
directions: Put sugar and milk in sauce pan and stir until not grainy. Then boil until it forms a soft ball when dropped into ice water. Let cool 15 to 20 minutes., Then add vanilla and peanut butter. Beat well., Spread into 9 x 9 inch pan.

title: Potato Wedges
directions: Place potatoes in large bowl. Add cold water. Let stand 30 minutes. Dry potatoes. Spray pan with nonstick spray. Place potatoes in pan. Spray potatoes with nonstick spray., Sprinkle with pepper and salt. Bake for 20 minutes at 425°. Using spatula, turn potatoes. Sprinkle with garlic. Bake until golden potatoes.

title: Great Caesar'S Roast
directions: Partially crush one cup Caesar Croutons., Add one Tbsp. each chopped chives and parmesan cheese and two Tbsp. melted butter. Cut three medium tomatoes in half (cross-wise)., Season with salt and pepper., Top with croutons mixture., Broil until brown., Serve with roast.

title: Breakfast Pie
directions: Combine first 5 ingredients and set aside., Combine Bisquick and onions., Combine 2 beaten eggs and milk, then add to Bisquick mixture., Stir only until the mixture is moistened.

title: Rice Pudding(Rizogalo)
directions: Heat milk and water in saucepan., Add rice; stir., Add sugar, salt and butter and stir, then let simmer for 50 minutes., Beat 2 eggs in separate bowl and slowly add hot mixture., Beat constantly., Add vanilla and stir gently., Ladle into dessert dishes and sprinkle with cinnamon., Refrigerate., Serves 8.

title: Szechuan Steak
directions: Mix all the ingredients except steak in a 10 x 13-inch dish. Score steak on both sides., Marinate for several hours., Grill.

title: Chicken Parmesan(Aunt Sue'S Recipe)
directions: Dip chicken in eggs. Roll in bread crumbs. Brown in olive oil and garlic (both sides). Grease casserole., On bottom, layer spaghetti sauce, chicken, Mozzarella cheese, garlic, oregano and Parmesan., Layer more spaghetti sauce and top with more Parmesan.

title: Peanut Butter Chocolate Centered Cookies
directions: Mix first six ingredients together until fluffy., Separately mix the flour, soda, baking powder and salt., Then add these to the first six ingredients., Mix well., Roll into 1 inch balls and roll each ball in sugar., Place about 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheets., Bake in preheated 350° oven for 10 - 11 minutes, remove quickly from oven., Place one chocolate candy kiss into the center of each cookie pointed side down., Bake for exactly one minute longer., Remove from oven and immediately spread chocolate over each cookie., You may want to leave the cookie as is or you may place a butterscotch chip in each one., Freezes well., Makes 6 - 7 dozen cookies.

title: Rum Sauce
directions: Cream the butter. Add sugar gradually, then rum flavoring very slowly. Add well beaten egg yolks and milk or cream. Cook over hot water until it thickens as a custard. Pour onto beaten egg whites. It is delicious on bread pudding.

title: Fresh Corn Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Put into a casserole dish., Put casserole dish in a pan of water and bake 1 1/2 hours at 325°.

title: Mozzarella Casserole
directions: Brown meat with onion and garlic., Drain off any excess grease., Combine with remaining ingredients (except Mozzarella) and place in 3-quart casserole dish. Top with Mozzarella and bake 40 minutes at 350°.

title: Greek Salad
directions: Peel and cube potatoes., Add garlic and cook until done, but still firm., Drain., Add chopped onion., Cool to warm., Add mayonnaise, sour cream, vinegar, salt and pepper to taste and mix well.

title: Blender Chocolate Fudge Pie
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Put first 6 ingredients in blender and mix well., Pour into pie shells and bake for 35 to 40 minutes. Remove from oven while center is still shaky.

title: Oven French Fries
directions: Preheat oven to 475°., Scrub potatoes, cut into long strips about 1/2-inch wide., Dry strips thoroughly on paper towels., Toss in a bowl with oil as if making a salad., Toss with optional spices., Spread potatoes in a single layer on a cookie sheet and place in preheated oven for 35 minutes., Turn strips periodically to brown on all sides., If a crispier, browner potato is desired, run under broiler for a minute or two., Sprinkle with salt. Yield: 6 servings, 80 calories per serving., This is a low cholesterol, reduced fat recipe.

title: Aloha Sandwich Spread
directions: Soften cream cheese with milk., Drain pineapple and mix with cheese., Add remaining ingredients and mix well., Serve on rounds of nut bread or Ritz crackers., Makes 12 servings.

title: Hot Chocolate Mix
directions: Mix all ingredients and put in a jar to store., To make hot chocolate, mix 4 tablespoons with 1 cup of boiling water.

title: Lemon Squares
directions: Bake 20 minutes longer at 350°., Sprinkle with powdered sugar. Cut in squares.

title: Broccoli Salad
directions: Mix sugar, oil, vinegar, water, and flavor packets., Set aside., Crush dry noodles., Mix noodles with almonds, sunflower seeds, onions, and slaw., Drizzle with dressing and toss.

title: Pita Points
directions: Cut pita bread into 8 pie-shaped pieces (like pizza)., Split sections open and pull apart., Drizzle olive oil on "rough" side of bread., Sprinkle with seasonings as desired., Bake on ungreased baking sheet at 350° for approximately 10 to 12 minutes until golden brown.

title: Caramel Corn
directions: Combine sugar, butter, syrup and vanilla., Bring to boil over medium heat., Remove and stir for 10 minutes., (Turns to light caramel color.), Mix together.

title: Six Week Bran Muffins
directions: In large bowl mix cereal, sugar, flour, soda, salt and cinnamon., Add eggs, oil and buttermilk., Mix well., Store in jars in refrigerator., Grease tins and fill 2/3 full., Bake at 400° for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Monte Cristo
directions: Cut 3 slices of Italian bread., Place 3 ounces of ham and 1 slice of Swiss cheese on first piece., Top with another slice of bread, 3 ounces turkey and 1 slice American cheese., Top with remaining slice of bread., Dip sandwich into egg wash and grill like French toast., Microwave or bake until hot through.

title: Pigs In A Blanket
directions: Wrap each roll or biscuit around a sausage link., Follow baking instructions on can to brown., Makes 10 servings.

title: Apple Crisp
directions: Preheat the oven to 350°., Butter a 1/2-quart baking dish. Spread the apples in it and sprinkle 1/3 cup water on top., Combine the flour, sugar, cinnamon and salt in a bowl and rub in the butter with your fingers until it resembles coarse crumbs., Spread evenly over the apples., Bake for about 30 minutes or until the crust is browned., Serve with heavy cream or whipped cream.

title: Milk Chocolate Rice Krispies
directions: Heat milk chocolate chips, oleo and syrup., Add vanilla and powdered sugar and mix., Add Rice Krispies., Spread in a 9 x 13-inch pan., Set in refrigerator., Cut into small squares to serve., (May melt chocolate chips in microwave or double boiler.)

title: Chicken Livers
directions: Wrap rinsed chicken livers with strips of uncooked bacon. Place on cookie sheet., Baste with butter and Worcestershire sauce mixture., Broil in oven, turning once.

title: Deviled Eggs
directions: Put eggs in pot and cover with water; heat just until the water boils. Remove pot from heat and cover. Let stand 15 to 18 minutes; remove shells from eggs. Cut eggs in half and remove yolks. Put the yolks in a small bowl and mash with fork. Add rest of ingredients and mix. Fill the egg whites with mixture, heaping it up slightly. Hint: Set pot in sink and run cold water over them to cool eggs down quickly. This makes them easier to peel.

title: Scalloped Corn Supreme
directions: Heat milk and corn gradually., Stir in egg., Add next four ingredients and dash of pepper., Mix well., Pour into greased 8-inch round baking dish., Top with buttered crumbs., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes., Serves 6.

title: Vegetable Oil Pie Pastry
directions: Combine flour and salt in a medium bowl., Mix oil and milk together with a fork., Add to flour and mix with hands until just mixed., Add a little cold water if more liquid is needed., Split dough into two balls., Chill 10 minutes., On a dry floured counter, press dough into a flat circle with hands.

title: Hermits
directions: Heat oven to 375°., Mix brown sugar, shortening, margarine, coffee, egg, baking soda, salt, cinnamon and nutmeg., Stir in remaining ingredients., Drop dough by rounded teaspoonful about 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet., Bake 8 to 10 minutes or until almost no indentation remains when touched., Cool., Makes about 4 dozen cookies.

title: Strawberry Cream Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients except sour cream., Put half in a bowl and let it begin to jell., Then cover with sour cream., Pour on the other half which you have not chilled., Put in refrigerator to congeal.

title: Minestrone Soup Casserole
directions: Brown and drain meat., Then dump together and season to taste: a little Tabasco, chile powder and garlic., Great on a cold day. Serve with corn bread.

title: Creamy Banana Pudding
directions: In large mixing bowl, combine Eagle Brand milk and water., Add pudding mix; beat until well mixed., Chill for 5 minutes., Fold in whipped cream., Spoon 1 cup pudding mixture into 2 1/2-quart round glass serving bowl., Top with 1/3 each of vanilla wafers, bananas and pudding mixture., Chill thoroughly., Garnish as desired. Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Sour Cream Coconut Cake
directions: Mix sugar, frozen coconut and sour cream until blended., Place in a covered container and refrigerate overnight., The next day, prepare cake mix as directed on box., Bake in layers., When cool, split layers into 4 layers., There should be enough topping to cover all four layers., Cover entire cake and refrigerate for another day or two., The longer this cake is refrigerated, the better it becomes.

title: Fried Rice
directions: Chop celery, carrots and onion., In large saucepan, break eggs in peanut oil., In separate corners of pan, place celery, carrots and onion., With spatula, chop egg up and flip as it cooks and stir other vegetables., Add rice and soy sauce and mix all together, stirring and flipping until rice is brown., Serves 4 to 6.

title: Fudge Ribbon Cake
directions: Make cake according to directions., Pour into greased and floured 13 x 9-inch pan., In bowl, mix cream cheese, sour cream and sugar., Add eggs one at a time, then add vanilla and flour., Mix until smooth and pour over chocolate batter., Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until done.

title: Good Baked Beans
directions: Brown hamburger or sausage, whichever you choose., Drain. Add pork and beans and onion; simmer 10 minutes., Good over cooked rice or mashed potatoes or biscuits.

title: Oatmeal Banana Bread
directions: Combine bananas, oats and milk in bowl; set aside., Cream butter or oleo and sugar until light and fluffy., Add eggs one at a time, beating after each addition., Combine dry ingredients, adding alternately with banana mixture to creamed mixture., Spoon into two greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pans., Bake in preheated 350° oven for 1 hour., Remove from pans; cool on wire rack., Yields 2 loaves., Can be frozen up to 3 months.

title: Louisiana Yam Corn Bread
directions: Sift flour with cornmeal, baking powder, salt and sugar; set aside., Combine eggs, milk and oil in a large bowl., Beat until smooth., Add yams and beat until blended., Add flour mixture, stirring only until flour mixture is moistened., Spoon into 2 greased 8-inch square pans., Bake at 425° for 35 to 40 minutes or until breads test done., Cut into squares., Serve warm with butter.

title: Punch Recipe(Club Member: John Waters)
directions: Mix first 3 ingredients. The ginger ale is to be added just before serving. Sherbet can be added if desired.

title: Tortellini In Garlic Basil Sauce
directions: Saute garlic in olive oil., Add basil and oregano; stir frequently and do not overcook., Add butter; let melt., Continue to stir., Meanwhile, water should be brought to a boil., Add tortellini., Cool and toss.

title: Sweet And Sour Pork
directions: Heat oil in skillet; brown meat; set aside., Drain pineapple and combine the juice with the water, vinegar, brown sugar, cornstarch and soy sauce., Mix well., Cook sauce in the skillet until clear and slightly thickened., Add meat and cook over low heat for about 55 minutes., Add green pepper, onion slices and pineapple chunks and simmer about 5 more minutes., Serve over steamed rice.

title: Skillet Fried Corn
directions: Place bacon slices in skillet and cook until crisp; remove from skillet to cool., For fresh corn, cut off cob (it is better cut off cream style)., Mix corn, salt and sugar; pour, into bacon drippings in skillet., Crumble bacon strips into corn., Add 1/2 cup water., Cook 15 to 20 minutes over low heat., Stir often.

title: So-O Good Butterscotch Pie
directions: Combine brown sugar and flour., Add egg yolks and water and beat with, electric, mixer, until creamy and smooth., Heat the can of, milk, until, hot and add the creamy mixture., Cook until thickened; stir constantly., When thickened, remove from heat. Add butter and vanilla., Pour into an 8-inch pie shell. Top with meringue.

title: Creamed Chicken
directions: Cook the chicken in enough water to cover until tender., Pick off bone, return chicken to broth., Bring to a boil., Thicken with flour mixture., This amount depends on the thickness you want. Cook and stir well., A few drops of yellow food coloring adds color., Serve over biscuits or mashed potatoes.

title: Fruity Cereal Squares
directions: Butter baking pan or dish (9 x 9 x 2-inches)., In large saucepan, heat gelatin (dry), corn syrup and butter to boiling over medium heat, stirring constantly., Remove from heat; stir in cereal until evenly coated., Pat mixture evenly in pan with buttered back of spoon., Cover, chill until set, about 30 minutes. Cut into 1 1/2-inch squares., Stores at room temperature., Makes 3 dozen squares.

title: Barbecues
directions: Mix all together and heat thoroughly.

title: Blueberry Dump Cake
directions: In a 9 x 13-inch pan, spread the can of blueberry pie filling followed by the can of crushed pineapple., Sprinkle the box of yellow cake mix over top (don't mix)., Pour the butter over the cake mix and sprinkle with chopped pecans if desired., Bake at 325° for 1 hour.

title: Butterfinger Bars
directions: Mix brown sugar, sugar, oats and butter., Pat in buttered 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes., Melt chocolate chips., Add peanut butter., Spread over cooled bars., Refrigerate.

title: Rigatoni With Meat Sauce
directions: In large saucepan heat oil. Saute onion, garlic, carrot and celery until golden brown. Add parsley, oregano, basil and meat. Stir and cook until meat is brown. Add wine and let evaporate quickly. Add tomatoes, salt and pepper; simmer about 1/2 hour. Prepare rigatoni as package directs. Drain. Pour in warm bowl. Add sauce and parmesan cheese. Toss to mix.

title: French Toast With Brandied Lemon Butter
directions: In a shallow dish, beat eggs, sugar, salt, milk and vanilla. Soak bread in mixture., Heat butter over medium-high heat and cook each slice until lightly browned on each side., Serve with maple syrup or Brandied Lemon Butter and lemon slices., Sprinkle with powdered sugar., Serves 6.

title: Okra Corn Tomato Medley
directions: Saute onion in bacon drippings until tender., Add okra and cook 5 minutes, stirring occasionally., Add remaining ingredients, stirring well., Cover and simmer 15 to 20 minutes or until corn is tender., Yields 6 servings.

title: Carrot Souffle
directions: Peel fresh carrots and cut into chunks or use frozen carrots. Boil carrots until extra soft. Drain very well. While carrots are warm, add sugar, baking powder and vanilla. Whip with mixer until smooth. Add flour and butter. Mix well. Whip eggs and add to carrot mixture. Pour mixture into a 9 x 13-inch buttered baking dish. Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until top is lightly brown. Add powdered sugar to top and serve.

title: No-Knead-No-Fault Whole Wheat Bread
directions: Place the whole wheat flour in a large mixing bowl and set in the oven at the lowest temperature for 20 minutes., While the flour is warming, dissolve the yeast in 1 cup warm water., Add the honey to the mixture and set it aside., Then dissolve the molasses in 1 cup water., Set aside while the flour is being warmed., This short time period will give the yeast mixture time to work before you combine it with flour.

title: Chicken Vegetable Fettucini
directions: Put vegetables in 9 x 12-inch casserole dish in microwave with 1 tablespoon water., Cook until tender, then set aside to drain. Debone chicken breasts; cube and season to taste., Brown in oleo. Remove chicken when brown, leaving remaining oleo., Saute onions. When ready, add cheese., When melted slowly, add milk and stir. Then add vegetables., Stir until well coated with cheese., Add noodles and chicken; stir gently again., Put in same 9 x 12-inch dish and top with bread crumbs., Bake in 350° oven for 20 to 30 minutes., Serves 6 to 8 people.

title: Feather Cake(From Cookbook Given To Flora A. P. Engle, Christmas 1902.)
directions: (No directions were given; follow cake procedures.)

title: Cheesy Artichoke Heart Appetizers
directions: Unroll dough into rectangles; press onto bottom and sides of 15 x 10 x 1-inch jellyroll pan to form crust., Bake at 375° for 10 minutes., Combine remaining ingredients; mix well., Spread over crust., Bake at 375° for 15 minutes or until cheese is melted. Let stand 5 minutes before serving., Garnish with thin red pepper strips.

title: Layered Enchilada Pie
directions: Brown meat and onion, add seasonings and tomato sauce., This may be made ahead and used when ready., In casserole (round) alternate layers of tortillas, sauce, olives and cheese., Add water, cover and bake at 400° for 30 minutes., May be frozen before adding water for later use., Serves 5 to 6.

title: Hot Broccoli Dip
directions: Cook broccoli and drain., Saute onion in butter., Add broccoli, cheese, mushroom soup and mushrooms., Heat thoroughly. (Good in crock-pot.), Serve with plain Doritos.

title: Cauliflower Au Gratin With Almonds And Cheese
directions: Boil cauliflower in salted water until tender (about 20 minutes)., Drain., Make cream sauce., If desired, add part of cheese to sauce., Reserve other and sprinkle over top of cauliflower., Place whole cauliflower (or broken into flowerets) into casserole., Pour sauce over cauliflower., Just before serving, sprinkle with grated cheese and almonds., Brown in moderate oven for about 10 minutes., Serves 4.

title: Fruit Cake
directions: Use a tube pan., Cream margarine, sugar and eggs together. Sprinkle flour over nuts and fruit, covering good., Add to batter and add vanilla., Bake at 250° for 3 hours.

title: Party Meatballs
directions: Mix the first 5 ingredients and add ground beef., Make meatballs the size of a silver dollar and place in casserole dish. Mix the next 3 ingredients and pour over meatballs.

title: English Muffins In A Loaf
directions: Combine 3 cups flour, yeast, sugar, salt and baking soda. Heat liquids until very warm., Add to dry mixture and beat well. Stir in enough remaining flour to make a stiff batter., Spoon into two 8 1/2 x 4 1/2-inch pans that have been greased and sprinkled with cornmeal., Sprinkle top of batter with cornmeal., Cover, let rise in warm place for 45 to 60 minutes., Bake at 400° for 25 minutes., Turn out of pans while bread is still warm.

title: Barbara'S Pineapple Cream Pudding Cake
directions: Bake cake as directed in 13 x 9-inch pan., Meanwhile, combine pineapple and sugar in saucepan., Cook over medium heat 20 minutes., Poke fork into done cake., Pour on pineapple mix; spread evenly., Cool completely.

title: Quick Buttermilk Biscuits
directions: Sift together flour, baking powder, soda and salt., Work in shortening., Add buttermilk and stir until well mixed., Drop by teaspoonfuls onto greased baking sheet, leaving a little space between biscuits., Bake at 425 degrees until nicely browned, about 10-12 minutes.

title: Country Chicken Pie
directions: Melt margarine over low heat in saucepan., Blend in flour and seasonings., Gradually add buttermilk; cook, stirring constantly, until thickened., Add chicken and vegetables., Continue cooking ten minutes, stirring occasionally., Spoon into 1 1/2-quart casserole. Combine dry ingredients., Cut in margarine until mixture resembles coarse crumbs., Stir in chives., Reserve 2 tablespoons egg and combine remaining egg and buttermilk to flour mixture, mixing just until moistened., On lightly floured surface, knead dough ten times., Roll out dough to 10-inch circle., Place over chicken mixture., Brush with reserved egg., Bake at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes or until crust is golden brown., Serves 6 to 8.

title: Lemon Punch
directions: Blend all ingredients., Add enough water to make 1 1/2 gallons., Add large bottle ginger ale or more if you need to make more.

title: Jennie'S Broccoli Casserole
directions: Beat egg with fork., Add mayonnaise and chicken soup; blend well., Stir in broccoli, onion and cheese., Pour into 1 1/2-quart oblong dish., Sprinkle crumbs on top., Bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Old Fashioned Pound Cake
directions: Cream butter and sugar., Add eggs one at a time, beating well after each one., Add flour and vanilla beating well., Pour into greased and floured tube pan., Place in cold oven., Set oven at 350° and bake one hour.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
directions: Beat butter, eggs, sugars and vanilla until light and fluffy. Add dry ingredients; blend well., Stir in chips and nuts., Drop from teaspoon onto ungreased baking sheet 2 inches apart., Bake in a moderate oven (375°) for 7 to 9 minutes., Makes about 7 dozen.

title: Chicken Dip
directions: Mix together first 6 ingredients., Place in casserole dish; sprinkle with Cheddar cheese., Bake 20 minutes at 350°.

title: Enchilada Casserole
directions: Heat oven to 350°. Brown hamburger and onion together. Drain. Add salt, pepper, garlic, soup, chilies and enchilada sauce. Mix well. Line bottom of 13 x 9 casserole dish with tortillas. Cover with half of the meat mixture. Add another layer of tortillas, then meat sauce. Cover with cheese. Bake for 30 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Glorified Rice
directions: Drain pineapple, reserving the syrup., In a saucepan, combine rice, water, pineapple syrup and salt., Mix just to moisten the rice., Bring quickly to boiling, reduce heat, cover and simmer 5 minutes., Remove from heat and let stand 5 minutes., Add marshmallows, pineapple, banana and lemon juice. Stir and then allow to cool completely., Fold in cream., Chill before serving.

title: Broccoli Soup
directions: Combine broth, broccoli and butter., Simmer 5 minutes., Add remaining ingredients and let simmer 20 minutes.

title: Austrian Apple Torte
directions: Beat eggs until thick., Add sugar to eggs slowly, 1/2 cup at a time., Stir in vanilla., Sift flour, baking powder and salt together., Stir in flour mixture 1/2 at a time., Fold in apples. Stir in walnuts., Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

title: Cheeseburger Pie
directions: Cook meat, onions, pepper and seasoning in skillet until meat is brown. Put about 1/2 cup of cheese in the bottom of an unbaked pie shell., Pour drained, cooked meat mixture over cheese in shell., Mix mayonnaise, milk and eggs and pour over meat mixture. Sprinkle rest of cheese on top., Bake for 35 to 40 minutes, then cool for 10 minutes.

title: Stromboli
directions: Place dough on a large cookie sheet on foil., Pat out with hand, then sprinkle cheese., Spread pepperoni on dough and sprinkle with olive oil and oregano., Fold into thirds, seam faced down, on cookie sheet., Pinch ends closed., Bake around 20 to 30 minutes at 350°, in preheated oven, until golden brown., Can brush crust with egg white., Slice and serve.

title: Mammas Quick Dinner Rolls
directions: Dissolve yeast in warm water, add dry ingredients; cover and let rise in warm place until double., Turn out onto floured surface; knead just to coat with flour; flatten to even thickness. With a round cutter, cut rolls and place onto a lightly greased pan., Bake at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Hash Brown Casserole
directions: Mix well., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Apple Cake
directions: Put into mixing bowl the yellow cake mix, vanilla pudding, sour cream, eggs and oil., Beat as directed on package. Put half of batter into greased pan.

title: Irish Cream
directions: Mix first three ingredients in blender., Add remaining ingredients and blend well., Keep refrigerated.

title: Potato Smoked Sausage Casserole
directions: Pare and slice enough potatoes to equal 2 cups; set aside. Cook onion in 1/4 cup margarine until tender., Blend in flour and seasonings., Gradually add milk, stirring until smooth., Cook, stirring constantly, until mixture is slightly thickened., Place half of sausage in bottom of 2-quart ovenproof casserole., Add half of potatoes, half of peas and half of sauce., Repeat layers with remaining ingredients, ending with sauce., Combine crumbs and margarine; sprinkle over sauce., Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes or until crumbs are lightly browned., Makes 4 servings.

title: Shrimp, Crab And Crawfish Boil
directions: Add shrimp, crab, crawfish, corn and potatoes to pot of boiling water with shrimp boil., Wait a few minutes (not too long) and take out., Throw all ingredients on a table and enjoy!, A little messy but fun!

title: Overnight Crab Casserole
directions: Combine all ingredients in deep casserole dish (1 quart size). Cover and refrigerate at least 8 hours., Bake covered at 350° for 1 hour., May sprinkle little paprika on top.

title: Stuffed Bell Peppers
directions: In skillet over medium heat, brown meat and onions., Cook until done; drain., Stir in corn, tomato sauce, rice, steak sauce and pepper., Set aside.

title: Turkey Corn Chowder
directions: In a large saucepan, combine all ingredients except salt and pepper., Cook over low heat, stirring occasionally, until thoroughly heated., Season to taste with salt and pepper.

title: Cheese Cake
directions: Chill milk in freezer several hours., Dissolve jello in boiling water., Add lemon juice and undrained pineapple., Chill until slightly thickens., Whip margarine, cheese and sugar until fluffy., Fold into jello., Whip milk until it peaks., Fold into mixture., Butter dish and sprinkle with 1/2 of crumbs., Pour cheese mixture., Put remainder of crumbs on top., Chill several hours.

title: Orange Spiced Tea
directions: Peel oranges (no white), cut into thin strips, spread on cookie sheet., Bake at 250° for 10 minutes., Cool., Toss all ingredients. Cover., Store one week before use.

title: Mom'S Spaghetti Sauce
directions: Mix sauces, spices and pork together and simmer.

title: Dump Cake
directions: Into a 9 x 13-inch pan, pour the can of pineapple., Over it, spread the cherry pie filling., Spread the coconut over this, then sprinkle the dry cake mix over all these layers., Top with nuts. Put thinly sliced oleo over top., Bake for 1 hour in a 350° oven.

title: Spice Cookies
directions: Cream margarine and brown sugar., Add eggs, one at a time. Mix flour, cinnamon, cloves and salt., Add to creamed mixture. Add the raisins, juice and nuts; mix., Drop by spoonfuls onto cookie sheet., Bake at 375° about 10 minutes., This is a nice moist cookie.

title: Mexican Dip
directions: Layer the ingredients as stated in an 8 x 8-inch baking pan. Bake at 350° for about 10 minutes or until bubbly., Serve with Tostitos or a heavier chip.

title: Easy Salad
directions: Stir gelatin into boiling water until dissolved., Let stand until cool., Add carrot, celery and pineapple., Also add cheese if used., Refrigerate until gelatin is firm., Serves 6.

title: Lamb Shanks
directions: Put shanks in covered ovenproof casserole., Mix all other ingredients and cut large onion and put slices on top of shanks. Pour all over shanks and cover your dish., Potatoes and carrots may be added to dish., Bake 3 hours in 300° oven.

title: Diet Chicken
directions: Line baking pan with foil., Arrange chicken pieces in pan. Cover with foil., Mix together other ingredients and sprinkle over chicken., Place onion rings on top., Bake at 350° until tender.

title: Mrs. Lowell'S Thanksgiving Cornbread
directions: Beat eggs in bowl., Add corn muffin mix, sour cream, corn, melted butter and sugar., Grease an 8 x 8-inch pan., Bake at 350° for about 1 hour.

title: Chocolate Almond Brittle
directions: In a, 1 1/2-quart microwave-safe bowl, combine sugar, corn syrup and salt; mix well., Microwave on High for 4 minutes., Stir in almonds; microwave on High again 4 minutes., Add butter and vanilla; microwave on High 1 to 1 1/2 minutes., Stir in baking soda., As soon as the mixture foams, quickly pour onto a greased metal baking sheet., Cool completely., Break into 2-inch pieces. Melt chocolate in microwave., Drizzle over top., Yield:, About 1 pound.

title: Hot Water Cornbread
directions: Mix dry ingredients together well., Pour enough boiling water just to mix well., Add shortening., Form into palm size pones. Deep fry until golden brown.

title: Spiced Roast With Dijon Sauce
directions: Using a mortar and pestle, crush the fennel seed, mustard seed and pepper., Set aside.

title: Barley Sausage(Vedaras)
directions: Mix all ingredients well., Fill large, clean sausage casings with mixture., Boil in salt water or place in baking dish; bake at 350° for about 50 minutes.

title: Soup Enchiladas
directions: Beat: 6 eggs, add salt and pepper., Fry as pancakes.

title: Diabetic Sugarless Cake
directions: Chop raisins and boil water and raisins for 5 minutes in a 2-quart pan., Remove from heat and add apples, chocolate and margarine., When mixture is cool, stir in flour, baking powder and soda., Add egg, liquid sweetener (Sweet 10) and vanilla., Beat 1 minute by hand and stir in nuts., Bake in 9 x 9-inch pan for 40 minutes at 350°., Cut into pieces, wrap and store in freezer. Contains 175 calories per piece.

title: Hawaiian Fruit Cake
directions: Do not drain the pineapple., Mix flour, pineapple, sugar, eggs, nuts and baking soda well. Pour into a prepared 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake in a 350° oven for 35 to 45 minutes., Mix the powdered sugar, butter, cream cheese and vanilla., Beat until smooth. Spread immediately over hot cake and let cool.

title: Chicken Crescents
directions: Cook and chop chicken.

title: Custard Pie
directions: Combine above ingredients., Pour into unbaked pastry shell. Bake in 350° oven until a knife inserted in middle comes out clean.

title: Crab Dip Spectacular
directions: Combine and chill., A must for Christmas.

title: Punch With A Punch
directions: Mix juices, lemonade and sugar., Let stand until ready to serve., Then add ginger ale, strawberries, sherbet, ice cubes and rum., Enjoy!

title: Peach Cobbler
directions: Dredge peaches in flour., Add next 5 ingredients and mix well. Set aside., Roll 3/4 of pastry to 1/8-inch thickness on a lightly floured surface., Fit into a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish., Spoon in peach mixture., Roll remaining pastry out to 1/4-inch thickness on a lightly floured surface., Cut into 1/2-inch strips., Arrange in lattice fashion over peaches., Bake at 350° for 1 hour., Yields 8 to 10 servings.

title: Easy Rolls
directions: Mix well and drop by spoonfuls into muffin tin., Bake at 350° for 10 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Cream Chicken
directions: Cook chicken breasts until tender, 30 to 40 minutes., Cool and remove bones., Cook eggs approximately 10 minutes and slice. Combine milk and flour together and pour into chicken broth., Add chicken and eggs for a delicious dinner., Salt and pepper to your taste; serve over hot biscuits., Serves 2 to 4.

title: Crumb Cake
directions: Cream shortening with sugar and well beaten egg., Mix flour, salt and baking powder., Add alternately with milk (start and end with flour)., Beat altogether until batter is creamy., Pour into greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.

title: Godmother'S Flag Cake(4Th Of July Tradition)
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Grease 2 (15 1/2 x 10 1/2-inch) jelly roll pans., Prepare 1 package of cake mix, substituting orange juice for water., Spread batter evenly in cake pan., Bake 20 minutes., Cool cake for 15 minutes in pan., Invert on rack., Repeat steps for second cake mix., Slice 1 pint of strawberries., Cut remaining strawberries in half., Beat the whipped cream, powdered sugar, vanilla and salt until stiff peaks form., Put one cake layer on a flat serving board., Spread with about 2 cups whipped cream and top with sliced strawberries., Put the second cake layer on top., Put remaining whipped cream over top and sides of cake.

title: Baked Stuffed Eggplant
directions: Wash eggplant and cut in half lengthwise., Carefully remove pulp, leaving 1/2-inch of the outer shell., Dice pulp.

title: Chicken Breasts De Duxe
directions: Dust chicken with flour., Melt oleo in heavy skillet and add chicken., Cook over moderate heat about 15 minutes on each side. Pour mushrooms with broth into saucepan. Add bouillon cube and heat., Blend wine and cornstarch (to mushrooms) until thickened. Allow sour cream to come to room temperature., Place in bowl, stir until smooth., Add to sauce., Remove chicken to warm place., Pour sauce into skillet., Heat and serve over chicken and rice on platter.

title: Eagle Brand Milk
directions: Stir ingredients until dissolved., Beat until smooth (will be thin but will thicken later on)., Keep in refrigerator.

title: Betty'S Breakfast Casserole
directions: Layer first 3 ingredients in 9 x 13-inch pan., Mix together milk, eggs, salt, mustard, pepper and onions., Pour over dry ingredients., Refrigerate overnight., Bake 1 to 1 1/2 hours in 350° oven.

title: Creamy Chicken-Broccoli Soup
directions: Saute mushrooms and onion in butter until tender., Add flour, stirring until smooth., Cook 1 minute, stirring constantly. Gradually add half and half and broth., Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until thick and bubbly., Stir in remaining ingredients., Cover and simmer 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Yields 4 cups., To store, refrigerate up to 2 days; freeze up to 1 month.

title: Family Special
directions: In large pot, brown hamburger., Open macaroni and cheese box, reserve cheese package until later., Add 2 cups water, spinach and macaroni (only, not cheese) to hamburger and bring to boil. Reduce heat, simmer 10 minutes., Add cheese package, Cheddar, partially drained kidney beans and garlic salt to taste., Stir well., Let "sit" 10 minutes before serving., Serves 4., May be doubled.

title: Pecan Balls
directions: Mix butter, sugar, salt and vanilla., Work in flour., The last bit of flour may be worked in with hands., Add nuts., Chill dough. Roll into 1-inch balls., Place on ungreased baking sheet and bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes, until set, but not browned., Roll in sifted confectioners sugar while warm., Cool.

title: Fruit Punch
directions: Mix together and freeze until a mush., To 1 gallon of punch, add 1 quart of ginger ale., Serves 25 to 30.

title: Hot Or Cold Tuna Salad
directions: Cook shells according to package., Mix lemon juice, mayo, mustard, sugar, basil and salt.

title: Marinated Potato, Ham And Green Bean Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients and chill 2 hours before serving.

title: Kraut Salad
directions: Mix well., Let stand overnight before serving., You may make this and keep in refrigerator for a long time as it is used., The longer it stands, the better the flavor.

title: Collard Greens
directions: Steam ham hocks in a small amount of water for about 1 hour. Cut and wash collard greens very well., Add the greens, chopped green pepper, scallions, sugar and seasoning to the pot., Simmer for approximately 1 hour or until tender.

title: Saladmaster Meat Loaf
directions: Use #1 blade on Saladmaster machine to grate potato, carrot, celery and crackers to a fine mesh., Cut onion on #2 blade., Add 2 eggs and 1/2 the bottle of soy sauce., Mix to a consistent color. Add meat and knead thoroughly to a consistent color throughout. (Check for dry spots or lumps of unmixed meat; knead some more.)

title: Sausage Strata
directions: Line a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan with bread (may take more than six slices)., Spread cooked, drained sausage over bread; sprinkle with cheese., Combine remaining ingredients., Beat well. Pour over sausage and cheese., You can make the night before and refrigerate., Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes., Let sit a few minutes.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Tear chicken apart and place in casserole dish., Pour soup, celery and chicken in bowl., Mix in one can of milk and mix good. Pour this mixture over chicken., Melt 1 stick of butter with 1 can broth., Mix with stuffing mix., Spoon this mixture on top of 2nd layer., Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

title: Shoo-Fly Pie(Dry Bottom)
directions: Pour into 2 crusts and sprinkle flour mixture on top., Bake at 375° for about 50 minutes.

title: Mandarin Orange And Cashew Chicken
directions: Reserve 2 tablespoons syrup from oranges., Blend reserved syrup with stir-fry sauce., Set aside.

title: Sweet Potato Pie
directions: Beat egg yolks. Add sweet potatoes, brown sugar, margarine, spices, salt and sweetened condensed milk in a large mixing bowl; beat until fluffy., Add evaporated milk and lemon flavoring; beat just until blended. Stir in coconut. Beat egg whites with electric mixer until foamy; gradually add white sugar, one tablespoon at a time, beating until stiff peaks form.

title: Roll Biscuits
directions: Mix warm water and yeast together., Mix flour, sugar, soda and buttermilk. Add yeast and water., Mix and put in icebox. Pinch, off a small piece, roll and cut out., Bake in greased baking pan.

title: Fred'S Pound Cake
directions: Combine buttermilk and baking soda; set aside., (Baking soda will react with buttermilk and volume will increase.) Preheat oven to 325°., Cream together butter (at room temperature) and sugar. Alternately add eggs, one at a time, with flour and buttermilk mixture., Bake for approximately 1 hour and 15 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Cinnamon Apple Crisp
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Arrange apple slices in ungreased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan., Pour water over top., Combine cake mix, brown sugar, melted butter and cinnamon., Stir until thoroughly blended. Mixture will be crumbly., Sprinkle crumb mixture over apple slices., Bake at 350° for 50 to 55 minutes or until lightly browned and bubbly., Serve warm or cooled completely with whipped topping or ice cream, if desired.

title: Milky Way Cake
directions: Add sugar to melted Milky Ways and butter., Add eggs and beat well., Add flour, salt and baking soda., Add milk alternately. Bake 20 to 25 minutes at 325° (two 8 or 9-inch round pans).

title: Raw Potato Dumplings
directions: Grate potatoes fine and drain off brown liquid. Add the beaten eggs, salt, crumbs and flour to make a stiff dough., Drop into boiling salted water from a wet spoon., Dumplings should be about 1 1/2-inches long and 1/2-inch in diameter when cooked., They are done as soon as they float to the top.

title: Buttermilk Cake
directions: Cream shortening; add sugar gradually., Beat real good (several minutes), then add eggs, one at a time, beating each time., Add vanilla., Add soda to milk., Add flour and milk alternately to other ingredients., Bake in tube pan at 325° for 1 1/2 hours., This cake is good plain, frosted or frozen., Do not open oven door.

title: Apricot-Coconut Balls
directions: Blend apricots, coconut and pecans together in a large mixing bowl., Stir in condensed milk., Shape into small balls and roll colored coconut., Let stand in air until firm.

title: Applesauce Jello Salad
directions: Heat applesauce and mix with dry Jell-O., Measure juice of one orange., Add enough 7-Up to make one cup., Mix with Jell-O and applesauce., Add grated orange rind., Pour into mold and chill until firm.

title: Cheesy Ham Nuggets
directions: Combine with first 6 ingredients; mix well with fork., Cut ham into 20 (1-inch) cubes., Shape a thin layer of cheese mixture around each ham cube., Place on greased cookie sheet and bake at 400° for 15 minutes or until brown., Yields 20 appetizers.

title: Jumbo Cookies
