directions: Sift first four ingredients together., Mix second four ingredients in another bowl until well blended., Add mixtures together and blend well., Add nuts and chocolate drops., Do all blending by hand with a spoon., Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes in a 13 x 11 x 1 1/2-inch pan until looks flaky., Cool about 20 minutes., Cut into squares.

title: Cauliflower Cheese Soup
directions: Bring water to a boil in a large kettle; add next 6 ingredients., Reduce heat and simmer, covered, until all vegetables are tender, about 30 minutes., Stir in soup and cheese., Cook until soup is heated through and cheese is melted., Yields 10 to 12 servings (3 quarts).

title: Butterscotch Squares
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Beat dry cake mix, margarine and egg in large bowl on low speed until blended., Press on bottom of ungreased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan., Bake 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown; cool.

title: Chicken Fricassee
directions: In heavy pan, combine chicken, roux, onion, salt, pepper and water., Cook, covered, on low heat for about 1 hour or until chicken is tender., Add green onions and parsley., Cook another 10 minutes., Serve with cooked white rice.

title: Tea Dainties
directions: Mix together butter, dates and sugar., Cook over low flame, stirring constantly until mixture boils., Mix together egg (beaten), milk and salt., Add to date mixture., Cook 2 minutes and cool., Add nuts and Rice Krispies., Form into 1-inch balls and roll in chopped nuts or coconut., Store in refrigerator.

title: Whipping Cream Biscuits
directions: Mix flour and whipping cream together, then place dough on a floured pastry board. Roll out dough., Cut out biscuits and place on a greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350° for 12 minutes.

title: Tacoed Eggs
directions: In a bowl, combine eggs, cheese, onion, green pepper and hot pepper sauce., Cook and stir in a nonstick skillet until eggs begin to set., Add taco meat., Cook until eggs are completely set. Spoon onto a warmed tortilla and roll., Top with salsa.

title: Breakfast Casserole
directions: In skillet, cook sausage until browned, drain meat., In 2 qt. shallow baking dish, spread sausage., Top with bread cubes and cheese., Mix picante sauce, eggs, and milk and pour over bread and cheese., Cover and refrigerate overnight., Uncover and bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean., Makes only 6 servings, so I double this and put in 9 x 13 baking dish for our Sunday School class.

title: Barbecued Franks
directions: Split hot dogs lengthwise and layer in slightly greased casserole dish., Mix other ingredients and pour over franks., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

title: Quick Turtles
directions: Arrange pecans in clusters of 3 or 4 halves, 2 inches apart, on a greased baking pan., Top each cluster with 1 caramel, flattened slightly., Bake at 300° for 7 minutes or until caramel softens., Remove to wax paper., Flatten caramels with spatula; top each candy with 1 milk chocolate square while still warm., Spread chocolate when melted., Refrigerate a few minutes, until chocolate hardens.

title: Zucchini Bread
directions: Beat eggs, oil, sugar and vanilla until thick., Stir in remaining ingredients., Mix well., Pour into two greased loaf pans., Bake at 350° about one hour or until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Add all ingredients into glass baking dish and bake in 350° oven for 1 hour and 15 minutes., Top with favorite cheese about 10 minutes before done.

title: Chicken Casserole No. 2
directions: Microwave chicken (cover with Saran Wrap) for 10 minutes or more, depending on microwave., Layer bottom with 1 package of crackers (crumbled)., Add cut-up chicken., Mix together soups and sour cream., Pour over chicken., Top with crumbled crackers and butter., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Spinach Dip
directions: Mix together all ingredients, except bread., Hollow out inside of 1 loaf of rye bread., Put dip in bread., Use excess bread and the other loaf of bread for dipping.

title: Corny Biscuits
directions: Mix together and drop teaspoonfuls onto a baking sheet., Bake at 450° for 7 to 10 minutes.

title: Molasses Cookies
directions: Sift flour, salt, soda, baking powder, ginger, cloves, cinnamon and nutmeg together., Beat shortening, sugar and molasses until creamy., Beat in egg yolk., Blend in flour mixture., Chill dough for 1 hour., Roll dough 1/8 to 1/4-inch thick on lightly floured surface., Cut into shapes., Place 1/2-inch apart, on ungreased cookie sheets., Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes. Cookies may be decorated before or after baking, as desired.

title: Beaten Biscuits
directions: Beat forty-five minutes on a block with an axe.

title: Sausage Quiche
directions: Put 1/2 of cheese in cooled pie crust., Sprinkle drained sausage on cheese., Pour eggs and milk on cheese., Top with remainder of cheese., Bake at 375 degrees for 30-45 minutes or until knife comes out clean.

title: Cheese Filled Coffee Cake
directions: Mix yeast, water and 1 teaspoon sugar., Let stand for 10 minutes., Add egg., Cut margarine into flour and salt., Mix well. Add yeast mixture., Divide into 2 balls., Roll each into an 8 x 10-inch rectangle.

title: Water Chestnuts Wrapped In Bacon
directions: Wrap bacon around water chestnuts., Secure with a toothpick. Blend remaining ingredients, set aside., Broil bacon wrapped water chestnuts until bacon is crisp., Drain and place in oblong dish. Pour sauce over cooked chestnuts and bake at 350° for 20 minutes or until hot and bubbly., Serve immediately.

title: Bert'S Peanut Brittle(Microwave)
directions: Put sugar and syrup in a microwaveable bowl and cook on High for 4 minutes., Add peanuts and cook for 4 more minutes., Add butter and vanilla and cook for 1 more minute., Take out of microwave and add baking soda., Stir and pour into a buttered pizza pan., Cool.

title: Hamburger Noodle Casserole
directions: In a small skillet heat a small amount of oil and brown the onions., Add the ground beef and brown., Drain off the fat. Cook the macaroni according to the package and drain., Add the beef to the mixture, along with the soup., Heat through., Transfer to a casserole dish to serve.

title: Butter Nut Chewies
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Grease 13 x 9 x 2 pan with Pam., Beat eggs until foamy in large bowl of electric mixer., Beat in sugar, vanilla and Crisco (butter) until creamy., Combine flour with baking powder and salt., Add to egg mixture., Mix at low speed until blended., Stir in nuts at low speed (mixture will be stiff). Spread evenly in prepared pan., Bake at 350° for 25-30 minutes or until top is light brown., Cool 10-15 minutes and cut into bars., Yield:, 2 dozen.

title: Chocolate Chip Bundt Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients, except chips, for 2 minutes., Add chips. Bake at 350° for 45 to 55 minutes in Bundt pan.

title: Summer Fruit Cake
directions: Cream the margarine and sugar. Add eggs (one at a time) and soda in buttermilk. Add flour., Chop and flour dates, nuts and orange slices, cut up., Add to mixture. Cook at 250° for 2 3/4 hours., Mix orange juice and sugar., Pour over cake and let stand overnight.

title: Creamed Cucumbers
directions: Slice cucumbers very thin into bowl., Chop onion and add to bowl., Mix salad dressing, sugar, fresh ground pepper and parsley until creamy in separate bowl., Add to cucumber and marinate for at least two hours in refrigerator.

title: Cauliflower Morocco
directions: Saute mushrooms and onion in butter with juice of 1 lemon. Saute cauliflowerets in butter with garlic, basil, salt and pepper to taste., Mix all ingredients and put in greased casserole. Cover and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Walnut Butter Crunch
directions: Melt butter over low heat; add sugar, stirring constantly until dissolved., Add water and syrup., Cook on low until brittle (290°)., Remove from heat; stir in walnuts., Spread in greased jellyroll pan; cool until hard., Melt chocolate and pour over crunch; sprinkle with finely chopped nuts., Elevate pan to cool so it doesn't continue to cook.

title: Zucchini Squash Relish
directions: Sprinkle salt over squash, onions and peppers., Let stand overnight., Rinse and drain well., Bring remaining ingredients to a full boil., Pack in sterile jars., Seal.

title: Chicken Bake
directions: Melt butter; blend in flour., Add milk, chicken broth or half and half., Cook until thick., Add the chicken mixture (chicken, peas, pimientos and mushrooms); season to taste with salt and pepper., Pour into a large shallow baking dish., Cover top with 1 1/2 inch baking powder biscuits, press a slice of stuffed olive in center of each and bake at 450° for 12 to 18 minutes or until biscuits are done.

title: Cold Peach Soup
directions: Blend all ingredients in blender until frothy., Pour into soup bowls., Garnish with nutmeg and mint sprigs., Serve as a side dish to any spicy entree.

title: Seven-Up Cake And Icing
directions: Mix all ingredients., Bake in greased and floured pan at 325° for 30 minutes.

title: Whole Wheat Bread Pudding
directions: Mix bread crumbs, egg whites and skim milk together., Mix in cinnamon and nutmeg., Pour in dish and bake at 350° for 45 minutes., High in nutrition.

title: Custard Rice Pudding
directions: Cook rice in 1 quart slightly salted water for 20 minutes. Drain and place in a 2-quart casserole., Add other ingredients. Beat with eggbeater only until blended., Bake at 350° for 1 1/4 hours or until knife comes out clean.

title: Jalapinto Rice Casserole
directions: Saute onion in butter until tender., Add ground beef and brown., Stir in pinto beans, rice and tomatoes., Mix well., Pour into a 2-quart casserole dish., Sprinkle cheese over top., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes or until cheese is melted., Serves 6 to 8.

title: Watergate Salad
directions: Drain pineapple., Mix pudding in pineapple juice until dissolved., Add all other ingredients and mix., Refrigerate until serving.

title: Spoon Bread
directions: Scald milk (do not boil)., Stir in margarine, cornmeal and salt., Cook, stirring constantly, until cornmeal comes away from sides of pan and thickens., Set aside., Cool to lukewarm., Add beaten egg yolks and mix well., Fold in beaten egg white. Mix gently but thoroughly. Pour into a greased, floured baking dish. Bake at 375° for 1 hour.

title: 24 Hour Layered Salad
directions: Layer each in order.

title: Meat Loaf Casserole
directions: Brown ground beef in shortening until red disappears., Add chopped onion, green pepper, parsley, catsup, steak sauce, tomatoes and salt and pepper to taste., Simmer for 30 minutes.

title: Potato Casserole
directions: Mix potatoes, onions, sour cream, soup, margarine and cheese together., Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan sprayed with cooking spray., Mix cornflakes and 1/4 cup melted margarine., Sprinkle over potato mixture., Bake for 45 minutes at 350° or until brown.

title: Ham With Gingered Pineapple
directions: Bake ham on rack in roasting pan at 350° for 1 1/2 hours or until thermometer registers 140°., Blend juice from pineapple with sugar, soy sauce, ginger and cornstarch in saucepan., Cook, stirring until thickened., Twist pineapple slices and arrange on ham., Brush sauce over pineapple and ham., Bake 30 minutes longer, brushing with remaining sauce after 15 minutes.

title: Mexitalian Lasagna
directions: Heat oven to 350°., In large bowl, combine chili, drained salsa, mushrooms, Parmesan cheese and Italian seasoning., In small bowl, stir cottage cheese and parsley flakes., Layer noodles, cottage cheese, chili mixture and Mozzarella cheese in a 9 x 9-inch baking dish coated with vegetable cooking spray; repeat to make three layers., Bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until lasagna is thoroughly heated., Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

title: Sausage Quiche
directions: Cook meat and drain well., Spread on bottom of greased casserole dish., Sprinkle cheese on top., Mix milk, eggs, Bisquick, salt and pepper in bowl with wire whip., Add onion and pepper; pour over top of meat and cheese., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until firm in middle.

title: Hermits
directions: Set oven at 400°., Cream butter and add eggs one at a time, beating well after each., Mix other ingredients and add to butter and eggs in 2 or 3 portions, mixing until smooth., Drop 2 inches apart on cookie sheet sprayed with Pam by teaspoonfuls., Bake 10 minutes or until nicely browned., Makes about 3 1/2 dozen.

title: Chocolate Macaroons
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., In a large bowl, combine all of the ingredients. Mix well. Drop by teaspoonfuls 1-inch apart on greased foil lined baking sheets. Bake 10 to 12 minutes., Remove from baking sheets immediately or they will stick if allowed to cool on pan. Store, covered, at room temperature., Yields 5 dozen.

title: Apple Dump Cake
directions: Dump fruit filling in cake pan., Sprinkle some cinnamon over evenly., Add dry yellow cake mix., Place pats of butter evenly on top., Bake 45 minutes or until golden brown., Bake at 375°.

title: Asparagus Casserole
directions: Mix peas, asparagus and soup and put in casserole bowl., Slice margarine in small pieces and put on top., Sprinkle Cheddar cheese over top., Put in oven at 350° for 20 minutes.

title: Catalina Shell Salad
directions: Cook and drain macaroni., Add dressing and marinate in refrigerator with dill weed, preferably overnight., Add onions, tomatoes and cucumber., Salt and pepper to taste; mix together well., Serve chilled.

title: Old Time Fudge
directions: Cook sugar, milk, cocoa, salt and syrup to soft ball., Set aside and cool to lukewarm., Add to fudge the butter and vanilla; beat until creamy., Pour on buttered platter.

title: Fruit Filled Squares
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., Cream margarine, sugar and extracts; add eggs one at a time., Mix flour and baking powder; add to dough., Mixture will be very thick and stiff., Grease 13 x 9 x 2-inch cake pan., Place 1/2 of batter in pan; spread with spatula. Spread can of pie filling on batter., Drop rest of batter by spoonfuls, leaving space between; batter will spread during baking., Bake 35 minutes until top is browned and tests done. Cool in pan on rack and cut in squares or bars.

title: Coconut Chess Pie
directions: Beat eggs slightly; add remaining ingredients in order given, mix well. Pour into pie shell. Bake at 425° for 10 minutes. Reduce temperature to 350° and bake for 35 minutes.

title: Lasagna
directions: Heat oil in a large skillet., Add meat and cook, breaking up. Stir in tomatoes, tomato sauce, sauce mix and V-8 juice., Bring to a boil. Lower heat and simmer for 10 minutes.

title: Frosted Toffee Bars
directions: In a medium bowl, combine oats, sugar and margarine; mix well. Spread in a greased 9-inch square pan., Bake in preheated 350° oven for 13 minutes, or until light golden brown; cool., In a small, heavy saucepan over low heat (or in microwave), melt chips., Spread over oat mixture; sprinkle with nuts., Refrigerate until chocolate is set., Cut into 2 x 1 1/2-inch bars., Store in tightly covered container in refrigerator., Makes about 2 dozen bars.

title: Apple Cream Pie
directions: Combine sugar, flour and salt., Add cream, egg and vanilla and beat until smooth., Add apples and pour into unbaked pie shell. Combine flour, sugar and cinnamon and cut in butter., Sprinkle this topping on pie., Bake at 375° for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Bran Muffins
directions: Pour water over 100% Bran and mix in order given., Mixture may be stored in airtight container and baked when needed., Bake in greased muffin pans., Grease lightly even if they are teflon lined., Bake at 375° for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Cheese Soup
directions: Use a 3-quart saucepan., Fill 3/4 full of water., Add chicken broth or bouillon cubes., Finely chop carrot, onion and celery; add to water and cook until tender., Add cheese., When cheese melts, stir in cornstarch, mixed with small amount of water. Serve.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Boil chicken until tender. Cool. Remove meat from bone in small chunks., Place in greased casserole dish., Mix 1/2 cup milk with 1 can of chicken soup., Pour over chicken., Sprinkle water chestnuts over chicken., Pour 1/2 cup chicken broth over cornbread stuffing mix and stir., Put on top of casserole and bake at 350° for about 50 minutes.

title: Christmas Braid
directions: Dissolve yeast in a little warm water., Mix shortening, salt, sugar, egg, vanilla and milk., Add yeast mixture, then flour., Mix well., Add raisins, candied fruit and nuts., Let rise., Divide into 3 parts., Roll each portion into a long roll., Form into a braid., Let rise until light., Bake 25 to 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Mexican Casserole
directions: Brown meat., Add the next 2 ingredients and refried beans. Line a 13 x 9-inch pan with tortilla chips., Spread meat mixture. Layer chilies and cheese., Bake at 325° for 25 minutes., Let stand 10 minutes., Serve with taco fixings, such as chopped lettuce, tomato, black olives, sour cream, etc., I top it with crumbled tortilla chips., Enjoy.

title: Jam Cake
directions: Combine shortening and sugar in a bowl and mix., Add eggs. Measure and sift flour, baking powder, cinnamon and allspice together., Add to shortening, sugar and eggs, then add milk and jam., Pour into two greased and floured cake pans., Bake in preheated 350° oven for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Apple Cake
directions: Put apples in bowl and add next 5 ingredients., Mix., Add dry ingredients and mix., Add nuts., Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan at 350° for minutes.

title: Dinner In A Dish
directions: In a 2 quart casserole dish place in layers:

title: Matilda'S Divinity
directions: Boil sugar, water and salt to 250° on candy thermometer., Put Marshmallow Creme in large bowl. Pour sugar syrup slowly over Creme while stirring. Add vanilla and nuts., Pour in a buttered 8 x 8-inch pan. Cool. Cut into squares.

title: Pumpkin Bread
directions: Beat together sugar, pumpkin, oil and eggs., Sift together flour, soda, salt and spices; mix well with egg mixture., Add raisins, nuts and water., Pour into well-greased loaf pan (9 x 5 x 3-inches)., Bake at 350° for 65 to 75 minutes., Turn out on rack to cool completely before cutting.

title: Lemonade Pie
directions: Mix the ingredients together and then put into graham cracker crust shell., You may sprinkle a few graham cracker crumbs on top. Do not freeze. Chill in the refrigerator for a few hours., Serves 1 to 4.

title: Rice Stroganoff
directions: In, a 2-quart saucepan, melt margarine., Add mushrooms, scallions and, garlic, and	saute over medium heat until mushrooms are just tender, 1 to 2 minutes., Add remaining ingredients except rice, and sour cream and bring mixture to a boil. Add rice, and stir to combine., Reduce heat to low, cover and cook until	liquid is, absorbed, and rice is tender, 10 to 15 minutes., Stir	in sour cream and serve immediately., Healthy. Makes 4 servings with 160 calories per serving.

title: Versatile French Dressing
directions: For pizza sauce, add oregano and basil.

title: Mamma Mia Basic Pizza Dough
directions: Dissolve yeast in water and add oil., Sift flour and salt into bowl., Add yeast mixture and knead until smooth (approximately 10 minutes)., Cover., Let rise in warm place, approximately 2 hours (until double in size).

title: Mustard Greens
directions: Prepare mustards for cooking by stripping the stalk out. Wash leaves thoroughly and cut them up., Add to pot., Fry out your salt pork in pot you are going to cook the mustards., Add water and sugar; cook until tender.

title: Apple Cake
directions: Mix the first 5 dry ingredients together., Mix oil and sugar separately., Add the eggs and vanilla; stir., Add dry ingredients to oil, sugar and egg mixture, then add apples and nuts., Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 10 minutes in Bundt pan.

title: Ranger Cookies
directions: Cream margarine, shortening and sugar., Add eggs and vanilla. Beat; add dry ingredients., Mix well., Add cereals and coconut. Mix., Roll into small balls., Place on ungreased cookie sheet 3 inches apart., Press with fork., Bake at 325° for 12 to 15 minutes., Remove quickly; cool on rack., Do not overcook.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
directions: Mix in bowl on high the shortening, butter, sugar, brown sugar, eggs and vanilla., Mix until it tastes more like butter than sugar, about 5 minutes., Then add rest of the ingredients by hand., Bake at 375° for 8 to 10 minutes on an ungreased cookie sheet.

title: Apricot Nectar Pound Cake
directions: Prepare cake mix as directed on package., Mix together and put in Bundt pan., Bake at 350° until springs back when touched.

title: Chinese Lemon Chicken
directions: Combine dry jello, garlic salt and mustard., Add melted margarine., Mix well., Place mixture in oblong baking dish. Arrange chicken in single layer, turning to coat both sides. Sprinkle with almond slices; cover., Bake in 350° oven for 30 minutes, basting once., Remove cover; baste again and bake 15 more minutes or until done.

title: Mushroom Bread
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., Separate crescent roll dough into triangles., Place on cookie sheet; pinch seams together., Toss sliced mushrooms in melted butter to coat., Arrange mushrooms on top of dough., Sprinkle with cheese and Italian seasoning., Bake for 20 to 25 minutes., Cut into wedges or squares., Serve warm. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Cheese Ball
directions: In small pieces, tear apart dried beef., Mix together both cheeses, dried beef and onions., After mixed together, form into a small ball and roll in nuts., Refrigerate 1 hour, or until ready to serve.

title: Asparagus Casserole
directions: Mix all, ingredients and bake slowly in 325° oven for 1 hour or until firm.

title: Golden Punch
directions: Mix all ingredients and add a large can of water., May use a juice can., Stir., Add ginger ale before serving.

title: Orange Salad
directions: Add jello to fruit, then add cottage cheese and Cool Whip. Blend well and chill about 2 hours.

title: Beer Batter
directions: Mix all ingredients., Add beer to desired consistency. Excellent for fish or vegetable batter., Deep fry at 350°.

title: Taco Party Tray
directions: Blend avocado, cream cheese, sour cream, milk, lemon juice and salt., Spread evenly on dinner plate., Layer the rest of the ingredients on top., Serve with chips.

title: Jordan Marsh Blueberry
directions: Cream sugar and butter until fluffy., Add eggs one at a time. Sift dry ingredients and add alternately with milk., Add berries. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes in greased muffin pans.

title: Easy Making Cookies
directions: Cream together butter, peanut butter and sugars., Beat in syrup and vanilla., Sift and beat in flour and baking powder. Stir in oatmeal and coconut., Use greased cookie sheet., Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Kraut Slaw
directions: Mix kraut, onion, bell pepper, celery and pimentos., Pour sugar over vegetables and stir., Cover and refrigerate overnight (24 hours)., Next day, drain real good, stir to help with the draining., When drained good, add the oil and vinegar., Keep covered, will keep several weeks in refrigerator.

title: Hot Deviled Potatoes
directions: Prepare 2 servings potatoes to package directions., Stir in remaining ingredients., Spoon into 2 foil baking shells. Sprinkle with paprika., Bake at 350° about 20 minutes or until heated thoroughly., Makes 2 servings.

title: Divinitygreely, Colorado
directions: Boil syrup, water and sugar until it spins a thread., Pour over beaten egg white and continue beating until gloss is gone. Add vanilla and walnuts., Pour onto greased platter to cool.

title: Chicken Wing Appetizers
directions: Place chicken wings in single layer in shallow roasting pan. Mix remaining ingredients together., Heat on top of stove until sugar is dissolved., Pour sauce over chicken wings., Place, uncovered, in a 350° oven and bake for approximately 2 hours. Turn wings occasionally., After first hour, check frequently to prevent burning., Wings are done when sauce is thick and bubbly.

title: Nacho Bisque Potatoes
directions: Place Tater Tots in a 9 x 12-inch dish or pan., Pour the cheese soup that has been mixed with the milk over the potatoes. Next, pour the tomato bisque soup that has been mixed with the water over the nacho cheese soup., Mix soups with spoon gently (do not disturb potatoes)., Bake in a 350°, oven for 1/2 hour or so until Tater Tots test soft and are lightly browned and soups are thickened., Serve hot., Stir, slightly, when removed from the oven and ready to serve.

title: Angel Food Cake
directions: Sift flour and set aside., In large mixing bowl beat egg whites until foaming., Add cream of tartar and vanilla extract. Beat until very stiff, but not dry., Add sugar, 2 tablespoons at a time, and continue to beat., Using spatula, fold in flour., Pour batter into 10-inch ungreased tube pan., Using a knife, pop bubbles., Bake 45 minutes in 350° oven.

title: Puppy Chow
directions: In a microwave or in a double boiler on the stovetop, melt peanut butter, chocolate chips and margarine together., Stir until smooth., Pour over cereal and stir until all is coated., Put confectioners sugar in a clean bag and pour in cereal., Close bag and shake until all cereal is covered.

title: Sausage And Egg Casserole
directions: Brown sausage over medium heat. Drain fat. Place sausage in a greased 2 quart casserole dish.

title: Chicken Pasta Skillet
directions: In a 10-inch skillet, combine soup, milk and mustard., Over medium heat, heat to boiling., Stir in broccoli., Return to boiling., Reduce heat to low., Cover; cook for 5 minutes, or until broccoli is tender., Stir in pasta and chicken., Heat through, stirring occasionally., Garnish with red pepper slices.

title: Apple Pandowdy(Sugar Free)
directions: Peel, core and slice apples; place in bottom of 9-inch square baking dish., Combine flour, salt, vinegar and water in saucepan and cook over medium heat for 5 minutes., Remove from heat., Stir in vanilla, butter and brown sugar replacement; pour mixture over apple slices.

title: Punch Bowl Cake
directions: Bake cake as directed; split to make 3 layers., Dissolve Jell-O in two cups boiling water., Add 2 cups strawberries, juice and strawberry glaze., Place in refrigerator until mixture thickens., Mix pudding as directed., Place 1 layer of cake in bowl, layer of Jell-O mixture and a layer of pudding., Repeat until all is used., Top with Cool Whip.

title: Molasses Oatmeal Pancake Or Waffle
directions: Heat milk, and molasses in saucepan to 110°., Pour over oatmeal, in, large mixing bowl., Mix in remaining ingredients. Bake as, directed, in waffler or as pancake until bubbly; toss and bake until golden.

title: Aunt Emma'S Chicken And Dressing
directions: Debone cooked chicken and place in large casserole dish., Mix together soups, onions, celery and pour over chicken., Then mix sage, dry corn bread mix, milk, and eggs., Pour over chicken mixture., Then add 3 cups chicken broth over this.	(Looks like too much.)	Bake 1 hour at 350°.

title: Heavenly Delight
directions: Mix together ingredients and refrigerate., Let set until chilled.

title: Punch Bowl Cake
directions: Cut cake in half when cool., Crumble half in bottom of punch bowl., Mix one box instant pudding mix with milk as directed and pour over cake., Drain 1 can crushed pineapple and pour over pudding., Spread 1 can cherry pie filling over pineapple., Spread 1 tub Cool Whip over cherry pie filling., Repeat entire process and top with nuts and maraschino cherries.

title: Shrimp Santa Fe
directions: Mix all ingredients, except shrimp or fish and picante sauce. Bake in a 325° oven for 30 minutes. Stir in shrimp or fish. Continue to bake for another 30 minutes. Add picante sauce. Bake for 30 more minutes. Serve with rice and toasted French bread.

title: Brown Sugar Franks
directions: Wrap each frank with a slice of bacon., Marinate in mixture of butter and brown sugar overnight., Bake at 350° for 1 hour., Cut into bite sizes and secure with toothpick.

title: Turkey Crunch Casserole
directions: Mix together turkey, eggs, mushrooms, celery, almonds and onion., In another bowl, mix together the soup and Miracle Whip. Toss with the turkey mixture and turn into a two-quart casserole dish., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes., Top with chow mein noodles.

title: Cranberry Pear Crisp
directions: In lightly greased 1 1/2-quart shallow baking dish, thoroughly mix cranberries, pears, granulated sugar, cinnamon and 1 tablespoon of flour; set aside., In a medium bowl, mix remaining 3 tablespoons flour with the brown sugar., With a pastry blender, cut in margarine until mixture resembles coarse crumbs., Stir in oats and nuts; sprinkle evenly over fruit mixture., Bake in 375° oven for 40 minutes., Let stand at least 10 minutes before serving., Serve plain or with milk., Serves eight., Per serving without milk:, 331 calories, 4 g protein, 52 g carbohydrates, 14 g fat, 74 mg sodium.

title: Honey Cake
directions: Sift flour., Measure and sift with baking powder, baking soda, spices and salt., Beat eggs until thick and light, about 5 minutes., Add sugar gradually, beating well. Add honey, coffee and shortening., Blend well., Add dry ingredients., Beat until well blended., Sprinkle nuts on bottom of greased and waxed paper lined 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake in moderate oven (375°) for 35 to 40 minutes or until done., Let stand in pan 5 minutes, then turn out on rack., Cut into squares., Yield: 24 servings.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
directions: Add together sugar, eggs and oil; stir. Add cinnamon, salt and baking soda; stir. Add flour and mix well. Add apples and nuts. Pour into baking pan. Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Warmed Oysters
directions: Have oysters opened at market., Place oysters in deeper half shell in aluminum foil pan., Cut lemon juice to each oyster., Add small amount of water to bottom of pan., Cover with aluminum foil. Barbecue over low direct heat for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Pecan Pie
directions: Stir first 5 ingredients well. Stir in pecan pieces. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350° for 50 to 55 minutes depending on oven or until knife inserted in middle comes out clean.

title: Penuche Candy
directions: Combine and cook to soft ball stage., Remove from heat and beat in 1 cup chopped nuts and 1 teaspoon vanilla., Pour into buttered pan., Cool.

title: Bean Hamburger Dish
directions: Brown bacon and hamburger., Add onions., Mix other ingredients except beans., Drain kidney beans and rinse., Drain butter beans. Add them and the pork and beans to rest of mixture., Can be cooked in crock-pot or roaster.

title: Peanut Butter Eggs
directions: Mix together., Refrigerate overnight., Shape into eggs; dip in chocolate.

title: Green Bean Bundles
directions: Gather approximately 10 beans into a bundle and wrap with 1/2 bacon strip., Lay seam side down in glass 9 x 13 inch pan. Continue making bundles until pan is full., Top with marinade, cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight., Bake uncovered 350° for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Broccoli And Rice Casserole
directions: Saute onion and celery in oleo until soft., Set aside., Heat soups and Cheez Whiz., Add rice and broccoli to vegetables., Add soup to mixture., Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

title: Easy Quick Tamale Pie
directions: Put all ingredients in baking pan., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Hamburger Stroganoff
directions: Cook onion in fat., Add ground beef and brown., Place uncooked noodles over beef., Combine juice and seasonings., Pour over noodles., Cover and simmer 20 minutes., Add green pepper. Cover and cook 10 minutes more., Stir in sour cream before serving., Heat, but do not boil.

title: Mexican Corn Bread
directions: Combine all ingredients well., Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake at 375° for 35 to 45 minutes., Very good with chili.

title: Impossible Lasagne Pie
directions: Heat oven to 400°., Grease pie pan (10 x 1 1/2-inches). Cook and, stir, beef, until, brown;, drain., Stir in oregano, basil, tomato, paste and 1/2 cup of Mozzarella cheese., Layer cottage cheese and Parmesan cheese in pan.	Spoon beef mixture over, top. Beat, milk,, Bisquick, mix,, eggs, salt and pepper until smooth, 1 minute with mixer.	Pour into pan.	Bake until knife, comes, out clean,, 30	to, 35	minutes., Sprinkle with remaining cheese. Cool 5 minutes., Serve.

title: Anne'S Chocolate Chip Cookie Bars
directions: Place sugar, brown sugar, butter, eggs and vanilla in bowl; mix thoroughly., Sift flour, salt and baking soda together., Gradually add flour mixture to sugar mixture., Mix until well blended., Add chocolate chips and blend into mix with a spoon., Spread onto a 12 x 14-inch baking pan (greased)., Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes, until edges are lightly browned., Cool and then cut into squares. Keep in airtight container.

title: Orange Congealed Salad
directions: Put pineapple in a pan and bring to a boil., Add jello and mix well., Let cool., Add buttermilk, nuts and Cool Whip., Mix well. Pour into a large dish., Refrigerate until firm.

title: Hash Brown Casserole
directions: Mix together hash browns, onions, cheese, sour cream, soup, one stick margarine (melted) and pepper to taste., Cover top with bread crumbs and pour other stick of margarine, melted, over top., Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 10 minutes.

title: Persimmon Cookies
directions: Mix the persimmon pulp with the soda., Mix all ingredients together and bake for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Caribbean Fudge Pie
directions: Beat oleo and sugar until fluffy., Add eggs, one at a time, beating after each addition., Add chocolate and instant coffee. Mix well., Stir in flour and walnuts., Bake in lower third of oven for 25 minutes at 375°., Refrigerate for at least 1 hour before serving., Top with ice cream or whipped cream, if desired.

title: Fried Chicken
directions: Rinse the chicken and pat dry., Place the flour, salt, pepper, cinnamon, nutmeg and garlic powder in a shallow baking dish; stir to distribute all the ingredients evenly.

title: Apple Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients together well and spread into an 8 x 8-inch square cake pan., Bake at 350° for around 40 minutes. Recipe may be doubled for a 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Green Pepper Pickles
directions: Wash peppers., Stem and cut into lengthwise strips, discarding seeds., Mix 4 cups vinegar and 1 cup water., Pack pepper strips into jars, cover with vinegar mixture, add 1 tablespoon salt to each jar and put on lid tightly., Invert for 1 hour; then store. Ready for use in 3 months., Keeps unopened and unrefrigerated for more than 2 years.

title: Patio Potato Salad
directions: In a medium saucepan, combine milk, sugar, vinegar, 1 egg, butter, cornstarch, salt, celery seed and dry mustard., Cook and stir over low heat until thickened., Remove from heat; blend in onion and mayonnaise., Cool., Combine potatoes and hard-cooked eggs; carefully fold in dressing., Chill., Just before serving, sprinkle with paprika., Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Biscuits
directions: Sift flour, baking powder and salt into a bowl., Cut shortening in until fine., Stir in milk to a soft dough., Knead slightly on a floured board., Roll out and cut or pat into shape. Bake in a preheated 450° oven for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Cocoa Cola Cake
directions: Combine flour and sugar in a 2 1/2-quart bowl; set aside. Combine butter, cocoa and cola in a 2-cup glass measuring cup. Microwave at High 2 to 2 1/2 minutes., Stir cola mixture into flour and sugar., Add buttermilk, egg, soda, vanilla and marshmallows; beat well., Pour into a greased 13 x 9-inch baking dish., Spread marshmallows evenly in batter., Microwave at High 10 to 12 minutes; rotate dish 1/4 turn at 2-minute intervals., Frost cake while hot with Chocolate Cola Frosting.

title: Pinch Coffeecake
directions: Put rolls in Bundt pan., Sprinkle with sugar and pudding. Dribble butter over all., Let rise overnight., Cook for 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Raspberry Jam
directions: Boil tomatoes and sugar 20 minutes., Add Jell-O., Boil 1 minute., Put into jars/containers and refrigerate.

title: Small Chocolate Pie
directions: Heat milk in double boiler., Beat eggs; add dry ingredients a small amount at a time and mix thoroughly., Add to heated milk; cook until thickened., Take off heat; add chips, butter and vanilla., Have ready small baked pie crust., Beat remaining egg whites (1 additional egg white will make more meringue); add 1 tablespoon sugar for each egg white., Pour chocolate mixture in pie crust; top with meringue and bake until brown in 250° oven.

title: Blonde Brownies
directions: Mix flour, baking powder, soda, salt and pecans and set aside. Melt butter; add sugar and eggs., Beat well., Add vanilla, then add dry ingredients and mix., Pour into pan and place chocolate chips on top of batter., Bake in 350° oven for 20 to 25 minutes. Do not overbake.

title: Molasses Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Sift together flour, soda, salt and spices., Cream the shortening., Beat in sugar. Blend in egg and molasses. Beat well. Stir in sifted ingredients. Fold in raisins and rolled oats. Drop by teaspoonfuls 2-inches apart on lightly greased or Pam sprayed cookie sheet., Bake at 325° for 12 to 15 minutes., Let stand 1 minute. Remove to cooling rack.

title: Harvest Loaf Cake
directions: Grease 9 x 5-inch loaf pan., Combine flour with soda, salt and spices., Cream butter and sugar; cream well., Blend in eggs; beat well., At low speed, add dry ingredients alternately with pumpkin, beginning and ending with dry., Stir in chocolate chips and nuts. Bake at 350° for 65 to 70 minutes., Let stand at least 6 hours before slicing.

title: Kahlua Cheesecake
directions: For crust, blend cookie crumbs with 1/3 cup sugar and melted butter., Press firmly over bottom and halfway up sides of 9-inch spring-form pan., Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes., Cool.

title: Crab Ball
directions: Mix and shape into ball., Refrigerate., When ready to serve, spread cocktail sauce on ball., Serve with crackers., This appetizer is so easy and great for entertaining.

title: Sour Cream Banana Pudding
directions: Mix vanilla pudding according to directions on box., Add the sour cream and mix well. Add 1/2 container Cool Whip and mix well. Layer pudding, bananas, cookies and continue layering in this manner until all pudding is gone. Top the entire pudding with Cool Whip., Refrigerate. (The colder, the better.)

title: Texas Pecan Pie
directions: This recipe will make 1 deep pecan pie or 2 small pecan pies.

title: Honey Butter
directions: Whip together butter and yolks., Gradually add honey and vanilla; beat until quite stiff., Store in refrigerator., Use on fruit bread, French toast, waffles and pancakes.

title: Potato Cheese Balls
directions: Combine cheese, salt and potatoes., Form into balls., Roll in bread crumbs., Dip in egg, blended with milk., Place on baking sheet., Bake at 450° for 15 minutes.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Cook chicken and shred., Put on inside of crescent roll and roll up., Mix soup and milk together., Put crescent rolls in baking dish and pour soup mixture over., Put cheddar or american cheese on top., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Chicken Roll-Ups
directions: Sprinkle chicken with season salt. If using mushrooms, lay a slice on the tenderloin and roll up. Wrap a slice of bacon around the bundle and secure with a toothpick.

title: Vegetable Medley
directions: Prepare vegetables according to package. Saute onion and celery in 2 tablespoons butter., Pour into baking dish., Using same pan, make a sauce with 2 tablespoons butter, milk and soup. Add shredded cheese until melted. Add sauce to vegetables. Toss and bake at 350° for 25 minutes., Can be made ahead., Refrigerate and bake when ready.

title: Barbecue Sauce
directions: Cook cut up onions in oil until soft., Add all other ingredients., Simmer about 1/2 hour.

title: Good Dip
directions: Mix all ingredients together and serve.

title: Cajun Chicken Strips
directions: Combine dry ingredients in a bag; add chicken and shake. Cook in butter 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Copper Carrots
directions: Boil carrots briefly in salted water until barely tender. Drain., Slice onion and pepper and layer with carrots., Mix all remaining ingredients and heat until sugar dissolves., Pour over vegetables and store in refrigerator., Serve cold., Keeps several weeks.

title: Reese Imposters
directions: Combine crumbs, sugar, butter and peanut butter., Mix until smooth., Press into greased 9 x 13-inch pan., Melt chocolate chips in double boiler or microwave., Spread over dough., Refrigerate until firm., Cut into 1-inch squares.

title: The Magic Muffin
directions: Preheat oven to 425°., Butter 8 muffin cups., Mix oat bran, baking powder, cinnamon and salt (optional) in a bowl., Stir in almonds., In separate bowl combine milk, egg, honey and chopped apple., Make a well in dry ingredients and add milk mixture., Stir just until moistened., Spoon into prepared muffin cups., Bake for 15 minutes., Serves 8.

title: Hamburger Casserole
directions: Place ground beef in casserole dish with onion., Place potatoes on top. Mix cream of chicken soup with 1/2 can of water; pour over potatoes., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Chicken Chowder
directions: Cook chicken in water with tomatoes for about 45 minutes. Remove bones and skin from chicken and cut into small pieces., Put chicken back into the broth and add all ingredients except milk. Cook over medium-low heat for 1 1/2 to 2 hours., Stir occasionally to avoid sticking., Add milk when done., Yields 5 quarts.

title: Hush Puppies
directions: Mix all ingredients except milk., Add enough milk to form balls., Drop from teaspoon into hot fat., Cook until well browned and cooked through., Serve hot.

title: Cran-Ale Punch
directions: Mix, cranberry, juice and lemonade in large punch bowl. Just before serving, pour in ginger ale., Serves 25.

title: Homestyle Macaroni And Cheese
directions: Cook macaroni., Mix other ingredients with macaroni., Sprinkle with crushed Ritz crackers., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Moma'S Pecan Pie
directions: Beat first 4 ingredients together., Pour into unbaked pie shell., Add crushed pecans to top of mixture and dot with butter. Bake for 35 minutes at 325°.

title: Grated Sweet Potato Casserole
directions: Mix syrup and milk in a large bowl; add potatoes., Beat eggs and butter., Combine 2 mixtures., Add other ingredients and mix. Pour into greased 2-quart casserole dish and bake 1 hour at 350° or until done., Serves 12.

title: Glazed Meatballs
directions: Mix all ingredients well., Form into baseball size balls. Place in shallow baking dishes, sprayed with Pam., Bake uncovered at 350° for 40 minutes., Glaze with Brown Sugar Glaze below and bake 20 minutes., Makes 12 meatballs., Leftovers can be frozen and are great microwaved.

title: Chocolate Chip Pie
directions: Preheat oven to 3325 degrees., In large mixing bowl beat eggs until foamy., Beat in flour, sugar, and brown sugar until well blended., Beat in softened butter., Stir in chocolate morsels. Pour into pie shell and bake 55 to 60 mins.

title: Corny Bean Casserole
directions: Mix all the ingredients together, except margarine and crackers., Mix the melted margarine and the crushed Ritz crackers. Put this mixture on top of casserole., Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Swiss Chicken Casserole
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Mix all ingredients, except walnuts., Pour into casserole dish., Sprinkle with walnuts., Bake for 40 minutes at 350°., Makes 6 servings.

title: Pineapple Salad
directions: Put in icebox to set.

title: Pecan Pie
directions: Mix butter, sugar and syrup. Bring to a boil over low heat. Beat eggs gradually. Add syrup mixture. Mix in nuts, salt and vanilla. Pour into crust and bake about 35 to 40 minutes at 375°.

title: Peanut Butter Waldorf Salad
directions: Toss ingredients together., Serve on a bed of lettuce with dressing.

title: Chippy Blond Brownies
directions: In a large mixing bowl, cream margarine and brown sugar., Add the eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition., Beat in vanilla., Combine the flour, baking powder and salt; gradually add to the creamed mixture. Stir in the chocolate chips and pecans., Spread into a greased 11 x 7 x 2-inch baking pan., Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes or until a toothpick inserted near the center comes out clean., Cool on a wire rack., Yield: 2 dozen.

title: Corn Bake
directions: Mix and bake at 350° until set.

title: Pickled Shrimp
directions: Place shrimp in boiling salted water., Reduce heat and simmer for 3 to 5 minutes., Shrimp are done when they are pink and tender. Drain and rinse with cold water, then chill., Make alternate layers of shrimp and onion rings in a sealable container., Mix remaining ingredients and pour over shrimp and onions., Seal and place in refrigerator for 6 hours or more, shaking or inverting occasionally., Drain and serve., Makes 6 servings.

title: One Dish Meal
directions: Grease a 2-quart casserole. Spread rice on bottom., Mix flour, chili powder, salt and pepper., Spread over rice., Dot with 1/2 tablespoon butter., Mix beef and onions and put over rice. Repeat. Pour over the layers the tomatoes with liquid. Spread corn on top and dot with butter. Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Kraut Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients together and refrigerate., Better if stands for awhile.

title: Mexican Squash
directions: Melt margarine in a large skillet. Add onion and cubed pork. Cook until pork is tender. Add other ingredients., Season with garlic salt and pepper to taste.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
directions: Combine all ingredients., Pour into a large baking pan., Cover with crushed Ritz crackers., Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes, until golden brown., Serve hot.

title: Delicious Muffins
directions: Add dry ingredients to egg and milk., Just before blended, add melted shortening., Fold in cereal., Bake 20 minutes in a 400° oven.

title: Zucchini Bread
directions: Mix all ingredients., Bake for 1 hour at 350° in bread pans.

title: Silky Meringue
directions: Beat with an electric mixer on high speed for 1 minute or until soft peaks form (tips curl) when beaters are lifted out., A hand mixer works fine but beating time may be slightly longer., At soft peak stage, add sugar slowly while beating egg whites, so that sugar dissolves., Beat 7 minutes or until stiff peaks form (tips stand straight)., Spread the meringue over hot pie filling to avoid leakage between filling and meringue., Also, seal the crust well to prevent leakage and shrinking., Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes or until golden.

title: Everyday Meat Loaf
directions: Soak bread crumbs in milk., Add meat, eggs, onion and seasonings; mix well., Form in single loaf in 4 3/4 x 8 3/4-inch loaf pan., Bake in moderate oven at 350° for 1 hour., In 30 minutes, spread some ketchup on top and continue baking., Or, the recipe calls for a Piquant sauce that can be spread on meat loaf before you bake it.

title: Crab On Deck
directions: Put margarine and cheese in bowl; microwave until soft., Drain crab., Mix all ingredients together., Spread onto English muffins; partially freeze them., Cut into pieces and freeze for appetizers. When ready to eat, broil until golden and eat.

title: Caramel Corn
directions: Mix sugar, butter, corn syrup and salt in pan., Boil and cook 5 minutes (candy thermometer, 250°) and add vanilla., Pour over popcorn and mix well. Bake in a 225° oven for 1 hour, stirring at 15 minute intervals.

title: German Potato Salad
directions: Boil potatoes; peel and slice when cool enough., Chop onions fine; add to warm potatoes., Dice bacon and fry crisp., Remove from grease and put on the warm potatoes., To the grease, add the flour and brown slightly., Add the rest of the ingredients and boil until thick., Pour over potatoes and stir well., Best if served warm., This will serve 15 to 20 people.

title: Individual Ham Loaves
directions: Mix all ingredients together and form it in small loaves in shallow pan., Mix brown sugar, water, mustard and vinegar to make a sauce., Pour sauce over; cover with aluminum foil., Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours., Remove foil., Baste a couple times with sauce.

title: Orange Julius
directions: Put all, of the ingredients into a blender and mix well until ice cubes are crushed.

title: Cinnamon Ring Cucumbers
directions: Soak cucumbers for 24 hours in lime and enough water to cover. Drain and soak for 3 hours in clean clear water., Drain., Simmer for 2 hours in 1 cup white vinegar, red food coloring and enough water to cover., Drain.

title: Broken Glass Torte
directions: Dissolve each box of jello in 1 cup of hot water and 3/4 cup of cold water and pour into square cake pans; let set., Cut in 1/2 inch cubes., Soften gelatin in cold water and dissolve in hot pineapple juice; let thicken slightly., Whip cream, add sugar and vanilla, combine with gelatin and pineapple juice and fold in jello cubes.

title: Sloppy Joes
directions: Brown beef; add all ingredients and warm., Serve on hamburger buns., Makes 6 servings.

title: Cowboy Beans
directions: Cook chuck with onion and pepper until done; drain off fat. Add remaining ingredients., Pour into a crock-pot; turn on high until well heated, then turn on low and cook 4 to 5 hours.

title: Mushroom Sandwiches
directions: Saute mushrooms with butter or margarine., Add the cream and salt to taste., Thicken with flour (mix flour with water). While cooking, add the Worcestershire sauce to hot mixture and then refrigerate overnight to thicken., Use to make tea sandwiches.

title: Sweet Dill Pickles
directions: Drain pickle slices and return pickles to jar. Boil sugar, vinegar and celery seed. Pour over dill slices. Refrigerate at least 24 hours before serving.

title: American Flag Cake
directions: Line bottom of 9 by 13-inch baking dish with pound cake slices. Top with 1 c. of the strawberries and 1 c. of the blueberries. Then spread cool whip on top evenly., Use the remaining strawberries to make the strips of the flag and the remaining blueberries to make the stars of the flag., Chill and enjoy OLD GLORY!-

title: Mexican Cheese Dip
directions: Melt cheese in soup in top of double boiler or crock-pot., Add remaining ingredients., Serve warm with tortilla chips., Yields approximately 3 pints.

title: Barbecued Lima Beans
directions: Using a large skillet, fry bacon until crisp., Drain on paper towel., Use 1 tablespoon grease to saute onion., Add Worcestershire sauce, horseradish and catsup and stir., Add lima beans, tomato soup and bacon bits., Stir well., Pour into a 2-quart casserole and bake at 325° for 1 hour, uncovered., Serves 6 to 8., Very tasty.

title: Baked Pineapple Casserole
directions: Butter shallow 9 x 13-inch dish. Mix together sugar, flour and 3 tablespoons of the drained pineapple juice (it makes a paste). Pour in casserole and spread. Place pineapple chunks on top of paste. Cover pineapple with cheese. Mix cracker crumbs with melted margarine and sprinkle on top of cheese. Bake, uncovered, for 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Red Raw Onions
directions: Cover onions with cold water. Let stand 1 hour, changing water every 15 minutes (this takes the bite away from raw onion). Drain. Mix rest of ingredients. Put into 2-quart covered dish or jar. Chill at least 24 hours, stirring occasionally to mix well. Makes 2 quarts. Good with steak and good in sandwiches.

title: Hot And Spicy Shrimp
directions: Mix butter and oil in flame-proof baking dish., Add all spices and lemon juice., Bring to a boil, then decrease heat and simmer 10 minutes, stirring frequently., Remove from heat and let the flavors marry for 30 minutes.

title: Rhubarb Custard Pie
directions: Combine all together., Pour in unbaked pie shell., Bake at 350°., Later cover with egg whites.

title: Honeybun Cake
directions: Mix together brown sugar, cinnamon and pecans., Set aside. Mix together cake mix, eggs, oil, sugar and sour cream., Pour half of mixture into 9 x 13-inch greased pan., Pour half of brown sugar/cinnamon mixture over cake batter., Add remaining cake batter and then remaining brown sugar mixture., With fork, swirl brown sugar/cinnamon mixture into batter several times., Bake at 350° for 1 hour., Mix powdered sugar, milk and vanilla; pour on top to glaze.

title: Blanche'S Pickle Ginny
directions: Let green tomatoes stand overnight; drain, then peel tomatoes; grind peppers, celery, cabbage and onions., Add brown sugar, horseradish, pepper, mustard seed and vinegar., Boil 15 minutes and seal in hot jars.

title: Vegetables Confetti
directions: Cover bottom of an 11 x 17-inch ungreased pan with rolls spread out flat., Bake at 350° for about 20 minutes, until lightly browned., Cool., Mix the cream cheese, sour cream, mayonnaise and salad dressing mix; spread over baked rolls., Mix diced vegetables together; sprinkle over the cream cheese mixture. Cover with plastic wrap; press vegetables down into cream cheese. Keep covered., Chill 3 to 4 hours., Cut into small bars.

title: Pig Pickin' Cake
directions: Mix together oil, cake mix, eggs and mandarin oranges., Pour batter into greased and floured cake pans (2 or 3)., Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes (about 20 minutes if using 3 layers) or until toothpick inserted in center of cake comes out clean., Cool on wire racks.

title: White Bread And Cinnamon Rolls
directions: Dissolve yeast in lukewarm water; add 1 tablespoon of sugar. Let stand in a warm place for 45 minutes., Beat in the remaining ingredients, adding flour gradually., Place in a well-greased bowl. Let stand until doubled in size; knead well., Shape into loaves or rolls., Let rise again approximately 2 1/2 to 3 hours.

title: Mandarin Orange Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Makes 3 - 8 inch layers, 2 - 9 inch layers or 1 - 9 x 13 2 cake., Bake at 325° until done., Cool cake well before icing., Keep in the refrigerator.

title: Coconut Cake
directions: Bake your choice of yellow cake., While cake is baking, put evaporated milk, flavoring and sugar in a measuring cup., Add enough water to make 2 cups., Whip by hand.

title: Double Batch Chocolate Chip Cookies
directions: Beat shortening, sugars, vanilla, water and egg until light and fluffy., Add flour, soda and salt., Stir in nuts and chips. Drop from a teaspoon on greased baking sheets., Bake at 375° for 10 minutes or until golden brown., Makes 100.

title: Nacho Dip
directions: Brown hamburger and sausage in frying pan., Drain off fat. In saucepan, melt the Velveeta., Once melted, add soup and Ro-Tel. Pour ingredients from saucepan to a crock-pot., Stir in meat mixture and chopped onion., Serve hot with tortilla chips.

title: Anne'S Italian Biscuits
directions: Make a well in flour and mix in remaining ingredients., Divide dough in half., Make 2 long loaves and place on a greased cookie sheet., Bake at 400° for 15 minutes., Remove and cut in diagonal slices., Return to a cookie sheet, laying slices on cut side. Return to oven to toast approximately 5 minutes.

title: Apple Caramel Salad
directions: Mix pudding, pineapple and juice., Add rest of ingredients. Mix well and chill.

title: Dump Cake
directions: Dump above ingredients in order into a ungreased 11x13-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Lime Jello Salad
directions: Cream the cream cheese., Drain pineapple and add to cream cheese., Use 7-Up to mix Jell-O in place of cold water., Mix cream mixture in Jell-O., When Jell-O begins to harden (or congeal) sprinkle nuts on top or in cream mixture., Place in refrigerator until firm and ready to serve., Orange Jell-O is also good with this.

title: Crazy Pie
directions: Mix flour, baking powder, salt and sugar., Blend in shortening and water., Beat 2 minutes on medium speed with electric blender. Pour batter into a 9-inch pie pan., Do not spread., Pour favorite pie filling in center of batter., Do not stir., Bake 45 to 50 minutes in a 425° preheated oven.

title: Chocolate Cobbler
directions: Preheat oven to 350°. Mix flour, sugar, and cocoa in ungreased 2 quart pan (9 x 9). In a small bowl mix milk, butter, and vanilla; add to flour mixture and stir with a fork until mixed and smooth. Stir in nuts and spread the dough evenly in the pan. Sprinkle with brown sugar and 1/4 cup cocoa. Pour hot water over batter. Do not stir. Bake for 40 minutes.

title: Scrod Putanesca
directions: In saucepan or large skillet, add oil and garlic; simmer for 5 minutes., Add all other ingredients, except scrod and angel hair; simmer for 25 to 30 minutes., Wash scrod in cold water and towel dry., Add to tomato mixture.

title: Zucchini Bread
directions: Combine all ingredients and mix well., Pour into small greased and floured loaf pans., Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

title: Chicken Delight
directions: Cover bottom of dish with slices of beef., Wrap 1 strip of bacon around rolled half of chicken breast., Put 8 pieces of breast in casserole or pan which has been lined with 1 layer of beef., Mix sauce of sour cream and soup and pour over chicken., Cook, uncovered, for 3 hours at 300°., The bacon and beef will be almost absorbed and chicken crisp, brown outside and succulent inside.

title: Hermits
directions: Heat oven to 375°., Mix brown sugar, shortening, coffee, egg, soda, salt and spices., Stir in remaining ingredients., Drop dough by rounded teaspoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet., Bake about ten minutes.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Cook broccoli as directed; drain., Beat eggs and mix with broccoli, soup, cheese, mayonnaise and onion., Add melted margarine with ground crackers and place on top of casserole. Bake 25 minutes at 400° in 2 1/2-quart casserole., Serves 8.

title: Baby Pearl Tapioca
directions: Bring to a boil the water and salt., Add tapioca., Bring back to good boil again, cover and turn off heat., Let set covered an hour or longer, until balls are clear., Add Jell-O and sugar. Stir until dissolved., Chill., When ready to serve, add whipped cream and any fruit desired., Makes 12 to 15 servings.

title: Lemon Meringue Pie
directions: In a 2-quart saucepan, stir together 1 cup sugar and cornstarch., Gradually stir in water until smooth., Stir in egg yolks, stirring constantly., Bring to a boil over medium heat and boil 1 minute., Remove from heat., Stir in next two ingredients. Pour into pastry shell and top with egg whites, beaten stiff.

title: Company Vegetable Casserole
directions: In a bowl, combine beans, corn, soup, sour cream, cheese and onions., Pour into an ungreased 2-quart baking dish.

title: Pepper Biscuits
directions: Mix 1/4 cup warm water with yeast and let stand about 1/2 minute before mixing in the flour., Then add all ingredients, mix well and knead for about 10 minutes., Make small rolls and let rise in warm place for about 4 hours., Roll out small pieces of dough by hand into size of a cigarette and about 16 to 18 inches long, twist and make round circle's and brush with beaten egg. Bake in 375° oven for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Party Munchies
directions: Mix together oil, dill weed, lemon pepper and dressing., Add crackers., Put in large bowl; stir occasionally., Store in airtight container.

title: Bacon Roll-Ups
directions: Cut bread slices in half; cover bread with soup., Roll up and take one piece of bacon and wrap around bread and stick together with toothpick., Put on broiler pan and bake at 350° to 375° until bacon is cooked.

title: Del'S Crab Dip
directions: Very easy!, Just combine ingredients and serve surrounded by crackers., Japanese rice crackers are the best., I love this dip!

title: Tortilla Roll-Ups
directions: Spread each tortilla with cheese; heat until melted., In a bowl, toss chicken with salsa, peppers and onions., Spoon 1/2 cup mixture into each tortilla., Roll up tightly., Makes 24.

title: Mandarin Duck Salad
directions: In small skillet, melt margarine over medium-low heat., Add almonds., Cook until light golden brown, stirring constantly. Remove from heat; cool.

title: Coconut Pie
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Bake at 250° for 30 to 40 minutes, then at 350° until done.

title: Lasagne
directions: Cook lasagne noodles until tender., Drain on paper towel. Brown meat; drain off excess grease., Add spaghetti sauce and oregano., Blend eggs and cottage cheese together., Spread thin layer of meat mixture in 8 x 11-inch pan., Layer of noodles, all of egg mixture, noodles, then rest of meat mixture., Top with cheese. Bake at 350° for 35 minutes., Makes 8 servings.

title: Funnel Cake
directions: In a large mixing bowl, combine eggs and milk., Sift in flour, powder and salt., Beat until smooth., Pour mixture through funnel into hot oil in skillet., Cook until golden brown, turn carefully with tongs and/or spatula and cook one more minute., Drain excess fat., Dust with powdered sugar., Serve hot with honey or syrup for dipping.

title: Hash Browns
directions: Layer 3/4 stick of margarine, hash browns, onion, sour cream and chicken soup (mixed together) and cheese., Toss the corn flakes with 1 stick of margarine and use for top layer., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Coconut Bonbons
directions: Empty boxes of sugar into large bowl. Mash out the lumps, then add milk and melted butter; mix well. Add coconut., (May be easier to mix with hands.) Place in freezer for 1 hour, then roll into small balls. Put back in freezer for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Square Dance Cake
directions: Beat all ingredients together for 5 minutes., Use a 9 x 13-inch pan, greased and floured., Pour, 1/2 of batter in pan, then add 1/2 of topping, then remaining batter, then remaining topping., Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Fish Chowder
directions: In covered 5-quart Dutch oven, over medium heat, simmer potatoes, onions, celery, cloves, garlic, salt, bay leaf, dill seed and 1 cup water for about 25 minutes or until vegetables are tender., Discard cloves., Add fish, 1 cup water and remaining ingredients., Heat to boiling; reduce heat to low., Cover, simmer 5 to 10 minutes until fish flakes easily when tested with a fork. Garnish with parsley.

title: Buffalo Swingers Wings
directions: Fry unbreaded Wingflingers according to directions., Melt margarine and stir in remaining ingredients., Coat cooked Wingflingers with sauce and bake 10 minutes in oven at 350°. Serve with Blue cheese dressing, celery sticks and carrot sticks.

title: Tracey'S Vegetable Soup
directions: Combine broth, potato and carrots in soup pot; bring to a boil and simmer 30 minutes., Add rest of ingredients; cook on low for 15 minutes or until all ingredients are soft.

title: Patsy'S Christmas Cherry Salad
directions: Beat cream cheese at room temperature until fluffy., Add reserved juice from cherries., Add remaining ingredients and fold together., Chill in refrigerator 6 to 8 hours.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Boil broccoli in another pot., Drain., Put Cheez Whiz and melt., Add soup and broccoli., Put in dish and bake in 350° oven for 20 to 30 minutes or until brown., Serves 10.

title: Chicken Salad
directions: Cook diced Chicken until tender, let cool for 1 hour., Combine Chicken, Celery, Eggs, Onion, Relish, Mayonnaise, Salt and Pepper. Toss together., Cut the tops off the Tomatoes, scoop out a portion of the pulp and discard; fill each tomato with a portion of the Chicken Salad and put each Tomato on a portion of the shredded Lettuce., Chill for 1/2 hour in the refrigerator before serving.

title: Brown Sugar Cookies
directions: Mix and drop on cookie sheet with teaspoon., Bake at 350° for about 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Corn Pudding
directions: Mix all ingredients together well and bake until firm and brown.

title: Dad'S Meat Pie
directions: Brown hamburger and onion., Layer in microwavable pie pan; soft shell, beans, Cheddar cheese, Mozzarella cheese and picante sauce., Layer again and cover with shell., Microwave for 10 minutes or bake 10 minutes at 350° for 20 minutes., Top with more picante sauce; serve.

title: Chicken Spaghetti
directions: Boil chicken; remove from broth and cool., Save broth., Debone chicken., Cook 12 to 16 ounces spaghetti in chicken broth until tender., Do not drain., When spaghetti is tender, add onion and green pepper which have been sauteed in butter., Add Ro-Tel tomatoes and Velveeta cheese which have been cubed., Add chicken. Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan and bake at 350° until bubbly.

title: Spicy Pecans
directions: Combine first 6 ingredients in deep 3-quart casserole., Cover with wax paper., Microwave on High for 4 minutes., Stir well. Microwave again for 2 1/2 to 4 1/2 minutes, or until soft ball stage., Add pecans and stir to coat., Spread on wax paper and cool.

title: Butterscotch Sauce
directions: Put brown sugar, butter, half and half and salt into a 1-quart glass measuring pitcher., Cook, uncovered, in a microwave oven 2 minutes at High, or until sugar dissolves and butter melts., Stir until blended., Cook, uncovered, for 45 seconds at High, or until sauce comes to boiling.

title: Mrs. Logan'S Pound Cake
directions: Cream margarine, butter and sugar until light and smooth., Add eggs one at a time, beating well after each addition., Fill sugar box with flour (to rim)., Add to above mixture and beat well., Add 1 teaspoon vanilla., Grease tube pan., Add batter; shake down. Bake at 325° for 1 hour or until done., Remove from pan immediately.

title: Tomato Soup Cake
directions: Mix together and pour into 9 x 13 pan., Bake at 350° for 1/2 hour.

title: Spaghetti With Marinara Sauce
directions: In a 3-quart saucepan, cook onion, carrots and garlic in hot oil until tender, but not brown. Add undrained tomatoes, sugar, salt, oregano, pepper and red pepper. Bring to boiling; reduce heat. Simmer, uncovered, for 45 to 60 minutes or to desired consistency., Cook pasta in large amount of boiling salted water until tender; drain well. Serve with tomato mixture. Serves 8.

title: Corn Dogs
directions: Combine first 8 ingredients., Dry frankfurters and dip into combined ingredients., Fry until golden brown., Serves 10.

title: St. Louis Style Peanut Butter Pie
directions: Cream together peanut butter, sugar and, cream	cheese. Blend in 2/3 carton Cool Whip. Pour into pie, shell., Drizzle chocolate syrup over top., Refrigerate for 2 hours until firm. Top with remaining Cool Whip.

title: Summer Squash Casserole
directions: Cook squash and onion in a little salted water for 5 minutes; drain., Combine soup and milk; stir in carrots., Fold in drained squash and onion., Combine stuffing and butter., Spread half of stuffing mixture in bottom of 12 x 7-inch baking dish., Spoon vegetable mix on top., Sprinkle remaining stuffing mix over vegetables., Bake at 350° for 25 or 30 minutes or until heated.

title: Hot Crawfish Dip
directions: Saute green onions in butter., Stir in flour., Add crawfish tails and fat; continue to saute., Stir in mushrooms and seasoning., Fold in sour cream just before serving., Keep hot in chafing dish., To freeze, omit sour cream and add when ready to serve.

title: Cocktail Sauce
directions: Combine all ingredients and mix well., Chill until ready to serve., Makes 1 cup of sauce.

title: Hush Puppies
directions: Mix together the first 5 ingredients., Add egg, buttermilk and onion., Mix well., Drop batter by rounded teaspoons into deep hot grease (375°)., Cook, turning frequently, about 3 to 5 minutes until golden brown., Makes about 2 dozen.

title: Nell And Maxine Cheese Spread
directions: Beat with, mixer., Very good on rye bread., Can be made ahead of time and refrigerated.

title: Crab Souffle
directions: In 9 x 13-inch Pyrex pan place 1/2 of cubed bread., Mix crab, onion, mayonnaise, almonds, celery and green pepper., Put over bread., Put rest of bread on top., Cover and refrigerate overnight.

title: Strawberry Pie
directions: Combine sugar, cornstarch and dash of salt., Cook until clear. Add jello., Stir until dissolved., Cool., Add strawberries. Pour into baked pie shell., Refrigerate., Serve with whipped cream.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 325°. Grease cookie sheets. Work butter in a bowl until creamy., Add sugars and beat well., Add egg and vanilla. Beat well., Blend in water and peanut butter., Gradually add dry ingredients and beat until smooth., Drop by teaspoons onto cookie sheet, 2-inches apart. Crisscross with fork., Bake 12 to 15 minutes or until light brown.

title: Chocolate Chip Cake
directions: Beat first 4 ingredients well and stir in chocolate chips; leave in bowl., Sift together flour, sugar, cocoa, baking soda and salt., Beat water, oil, vinegar and vanilla., Combine with flour mixture., Pour into greased and floured square or tube pan., Spoon cheese mixture lightly on top, spreading with knife as you go. Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes., Sift confectioners sugar on top of cake.

title: Cherry Cheese Cake
directions: Beat cream cheese until fluffy; add condensed milk., Mix. Stir in lemon juice and vanilla; pour into crust., Chill 2 hours. Top with cherry pie filling just before serving.

title: Cheese Biscuits
directions: Mix flour, butter and cheese., Add salt, pepper sauce and Rice Krispies., Roll into small balls and flatten with a fork dipped in cold water., Bake at 350° for 12 to 14 minutes., Bake on ungreased pan., Makes a great snack.

title: White Bread
directions: Put sugar, shortening and salt in a bowl., Pour boiling water on top., Stir to dissolve., Cool to lukewarm and add yeast which has been dissolved in 1/4 cup lukewarm water., Add 4 cups flour and beat thoroughly., Add remaining flour gradually and mix to a dough that won't stick., Knead lightly on floured surface 8 to 10 minutes., Place in a greased bowl; cover closely and let rise in a warm place until doubled, 2 to 2 1/2 hours., Punch down or knead 2 minutes to reduce to original size., Let rise again until doubled, about 1 hour., Knead down; divide in 4 portions and let rest 10 to 15 minutes., Mold in loaves; place in greased pans., Cover loosely and set in warm place to double (about 1 hour)., Bake in a hot 400° to 425° oven for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Grandma'S Sugar Cookies
directions: Cream butter; add sugar., Add well beaten eggs and vanilla. Add dry ingredients., Chill thoroughly., Roll out on well floured board and cut with your favorite cookie cutter., Bake at 375° for 10 minutes on well-greased cookie sheet., Yields 4 or 5 dozen.

title: Crab Cakes
directions: Break up saltines., Mix all other ingredients except cracker meal., Let stand until crackers are moist., Add crabmeat; roll in cracker meal., Makes about 2 1/2 dozen medium crab cakes., Let stand in refrigerator at least an hour before frying.

title: Cheese Wafers
directions: Mix margarine and cheese with a mixer., Add remaining ingredients. Shape into small balls and place on ungreased cookie sheet, flattened with a fork., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

title: Pannukakka(Finnish Pancake)
directions: Melt oleo in 9 x 13-inch glass dish or 2 pie dishes.

title: Shrimp Dip
directions: Mix soup and cream cheese., Heat and stir until cheese is melted. Add mayonnaise and mix well., Add remaining ingredients. Serve with chips or crackers.

title: Stuffed Cabbage
directions: Trim off thick part of each cabbage leaf., Cover leaf with water; soak 2 minutes., Mix beef, onion, rice, tomato juice and pepper., Place about 3 tablespoons meat mixture on each cabbage leaf., Tuck in sides and roll up.

title: Italian Cream Cheese Cake
directions: Mix the buttermilk and soda and let stand. Beat egg whites until stiff. Cream sugar, oleo and shortening. Add egg yolks, one at a time, beating well after each. Add buttermilk alternately with flour to creamed mixture. Stir in vanilla. Fold in beaten egg whites. Gently stir in nuts and coconut. Bake in 3 or 4 layer pans at 325° for 25 minutes.

title: Chocolate Mint Brownies
directions: Melt butter and chocolate; cool., Beat eggs, salt and sugar. Add chocolate., Add remaining ingredients., Bake at 325° for about 20 to 25 minutes., Cool.

title: Mint Candy
directions: Beat egg white until bubbly., Blend in butter, sugar, flavoring and coloring., This should be like cookie dough., Knead well, then roll into balls., Let sit on wax paper; press down with a fork.

title: Clam Chowder
directions: Cook clams and bay leaf for 5 minutes with just enough water to cover., Remove bay leaf., Saute onion, celery and green pepper in butter and add to clams and clam juice., Add the thickened milk, potatoes and bacon bits; cook gently until potatoes are done., Season with salt, pepper and garlic.

title: Sugarless Coffee Cake
directions: Bake in oven at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes., Then, when cool, top with whipped topping.

title: Yum Yum Pie
directions: Mix cracker crumbs, oleo and 1/2 cup, sugar., Press 2/3 of this mix in large buttered casserole dish.

title: Chicken Pasta Salad
directions: Stew chicken and cook pasta in broth., Mix dressing, mayonnaise, cheese and olives., Cut chicken into bite sized pieces and mix all together., Store in tightly covered bowl., Will keep up to two weeks.

title: Chili
directions: Into a 2-quart pot, first add sauteed onion., Brown and drain the meat; add to pot., Then add tomato soup and chili powder. Simmer 10 minutes., Add kidney beans, stewed tomatoes, catsup and sugar., Mix together and simmer 15 to 20 minutes., Serve.

title: Hunter-Style Chicken(Makes 6 To 8 Servings)
directions: In large skillet, heat together butter and oil., Cook chicken pieces over medium heat for about 25 minutes, turning to brown. Remove chicken to a 12 x 7 1/2 x 2-inch baking dish., Keep warm. In same skillet, combine onion, mushrooms and garlic., Cook and stir until onions are tender., Stir in flour, salt and pepper; mix well., Add wine, chicken broth and tomatoes; mix well., Cook and stir over medium high heat until mixture is thickened and bubbly. Pour vegetable sauce over chicken., Bake, uncovered, in a 350° oven for 30 minutes, or until chicken is tender., Sprinkle with parsley., Serve with rice or noodles.

title: Grandma'S Tea Cakes
directions: Cream butter and sugar in bowl until light and fluffy., Add egg., Beat until smooth., Add milk, soda and vanilla., Mix well. Add enough flour to make stiff easily handled dough., Roll very thin, on floured surface., Cut as desired., Place on baking sheet., Bake at 450° for 10 to 15 minutes or lightly brown.

title: Grilled Sausage And Scallops With Peppers, Lemon, Basil And Garlic
directions: Blanch the scallops in boiling, salted water for 1 minute. Drain and allow to cool., Cook the sausage in boiling water until completely cooked, about 5 minutes., Drain and allow to cool. Thread the scallops, sausages and vegetables on skewers and season with salt and pepper., Cook the skewers over a medium fire until all the ingredients have attained some brown crusting, about 3 to 4 minutes., Slide the ingredients off skewers into a large bowl., Add basil, garlic, oil, lemon juice and balsamic vinegar., Shake the bowl until everything is well mixed.

title: Raspberry Punch
directions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water., Add sugar and then cold water and all juices., Yields 60 (4-ounce) servings.

title: Cranberry Salad
directions: Grind in food grinder or blender the cranberries, apple and orange., Dissolve jello in hot liquid., Combine all ingredients and store in refrigerator., Keeps well for days.

title: Cold Bean Dip
directions: Start with beans and layer each item in a glass dish., Serve cold.

title: Fresh Garden Salad
directions: Chop cauliflower, broccoli, onion and tomatoes., Mix mayonnaise, sugar, vinegar, sauce and lemon juice; stir over vegetables., Allow to set in refrigerator overnight before serving.

title: Power Cookies
directions: Cream together brown sugar, sugar, butter and shortening., Beat in eggs and vanilla., Combine flour, salt and soda and beat into 1st mixture., Add remaining ingredients and knead into first mixture., Drop by heaping teaspoons 2-inches apart on greased baking sheet., Bake at 350° for 8 minutes, or until brown., Makes 7 dozen cookies.

title: Lemon Cream Pudding
directions: Thoroughly mix sugar, salt and cornstarch in top of double boiler., Add cold water and milk; blend until smooth., Stir constantly over direct heat until mixture boils and becomes transparent-looking., Place over boiling water, cover and cook 15 minutes.

title: Cheezy Cheese And Macaroni
directions: Cook macaroni for 2 minutes less than the box calls for. Drain., Put under cold running water until macaroni is completely cool; drain., In saucepan, place cut up chunks of Velveeta, butter, milk and flour., Heat slowly, dissolving cheese and flour. Add all grated Cheddar cheese, except for 1/2 cup., Pour over macaroni in a 2 1/2-quart casserole dish., Top with 1/2 cup cheese and bread crumbs., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Lentil Stew
directions: In large kettle combine ham, onion soup, bay leaf, lentils, pepper, allspice, cloves, parsley flakes and salt. Bring to boil; reduce heat, cover and simmer for 1 1/2 hours, stirring occasionally., Add carrots, potatoes and celery. Return to boiling point, reduce heat, cover and simmer one hour or longer until ham and vegetables are fork-tender.

title: Egg Surprise Pie
directions: Cook sausage and drain., Combine eggs, milk, salt and pepper. Mix well., Layer pie shell with cheese and sausage., Pour egg mixture over this and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
directions: Saute onion and celery in oil., Add remaining ingredients. Pour into pie shell., Put on top crust., Moisten bottom crust around edges to seal., Prick with fork., Bake at 350° for about 45 minutes.

title: Summer Vegetable Pizza
directions: Other vegetables such as green peppers or onions may be used or included.

title: Gazpacho
directions: Mix all together except sour cream and croutons., Refrigerate at least 4 hours., Serve with sour cream and croutons on top., If you prefer, you can use tomato juice instead of the picante if you don't like it as spicy.

title: Cheese Ball
directions: Mix the first 6 ingredients together well., Roll into ball or log shape., Roll in chopped nuts., Refrigerate overnight to blend all flavors., Serve with crackers., Stays well in refrigerator several weeks.

title: Pickled Eggs
directions: Boil eggs, cool and peel. Place eggs in jar, fill with remaining ingredients. Top with onions and fill jar with vinegar, seal, leave untouched for 24 hours.

title: Cajun Corn
directions: Cook onions in melted butter until tender. Add Ro-Tel. Simmer for 7 minutes. Add corn. Cook on low for 12 minutes. Add salt to taste.

title: Sauerkraut Balls
directions: In skillet, cook sausage fully, then add onion until transparent. Drain well. Add to sausage mixture the next 7 ingredients; mix well. Chill for at least 2 hours. May do ahead and chill overnight. Then shape into small meatballs and roll in flour. Beat together milk and eggs. Dip meatballs into mixture, then roll in bread crumbs. Fry in oil until golden brown. Change oil when needed. Bake in 375° oven for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Grandma Hillesland'S "Romme Grod"(Cream Porridge)
directions: Bring cream to a boil and simmer for 20 minutes. Continue to boil while sifting flour into cream slowly, beating vigorously until mixture becomes heavy and butter starts to form., Remove butterfat as it appears., Add about 1 quart hot milk gradually and beat until smooth and the consistency of cooked cereal., Add salt to taste., Serve hot with butterfat, sugar and cinnamon.

title: Banana Bread
