directions: Sift together all the dry ingredients and set aside., Cream the shortening and gradually add the sugar., Continue to cream until light and fluffy., Add and beat well the eggs., Add alternately to the mixture the bananas and the flour mix., Beat all until smooth., Turn into a well-greased bread pan and bake for one hour at 350° or until bread is done., Yields 1 loaf.

title: Spiced Tea
directions: Tie spices loosely in bag and boil in water., Add tea tied loosely in bag and steep 5 minutes; remove bags., Heat frui juices and sugar; add to tea and serve., Serves 25.

title: Bean Casserole
directions: Combine the mayonnaise, mustard, Worcestershire sauce and 1 1/2 teaspoons lemon juice., Layer 1 cup beans, 1/2 cup peas, 1/2 teaspoon lemon juice, 1/2 of the onion and 1/2 of the water chestnuts., Spread 1/2 of the mayonnaise mixture and repeat., Top with crushed Ritz crackers., Bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes. Serves 8 or more.

title: Layered Vegetable Salad
directions: Layer first 5 ingredients., Mix Miracle Whip and sugar together and spread on top. Cover all with cheese and chill several hours or overnight., Serves 20.

title: Glenda'S 16 Bean Soup Recipe
directions: Place beans in large kettle and cover with water., Add salt to beans and water; soak overnight., Next morning, drain and add 2 quarts water., Add some ham or chicken pieces., Boil slowly for 2 1/2 to 3 hours. Add the rest of ingredients., Simmer another 30 minutes and serve with cornbread or crackers.

title: Chicken Salad
directions: Poach chicken breast in water seasoned with black peppercorns, a little salt, celery tops and sprinkle of garlic salt., Cook 5 minutes and turn off stove., Allow chicken to sit in broth until completely cooled., When the chicken is completely cooled remove from broth and cut into small dices., Combine sour cream and mayonnaise., Mix chicken, celery, apples, walnuts, and sour cream/mayonnaise mixture well., Refrigerate at least 2 hours (or overnight)., Serve on butter croissants with leaf lettuce or serve alone with slices of fresh fruit in the summer for a cool evening meal.

title: Party Chicken Sandwiches
directions: Blend all in an electric blender for about 1 minute., Spread thin sandwiches with this and freeze or else freeze., Spread in small amounts.

title: Potato Stuffing Casserole
directions: In a medium skillet, saute celery and onion in 2 tablespoons butter until tender., Add bread cubes and stir until lightly browned., Stir in potatoes, parsley, salt, pepper, milk and egg. Mix well., Spoon into a greased 1 1/2-quart baking dish., Dot with remaining butter., Bake at 350°, uncovered, for 30 to 40 minutes or until lightly browned., Garnish with additional parsley. Yield:, 6 to 8 servings.

title: Trappers
directions: Bottom Layer:, Blend together cake mix, margarine, 1 egg and pecans., Pat in bottom of 10 x 13-inch pan., Set aside.

title: Beets - Spiced
directions: Heat water, 1 tablespoon vinegar and 1 teaspoon salt to boiling., Add beets., Cover and heat to boiling; cook 30 minutes or until tender., Drain., Cut beets into slices., Mix olive oil, 1/4 cup vinegar, sugar, 1/2 teaspoon salt, cloves and onions., Pour over beets and marinate overnight.

title: Potato Casserole
directions: Thaw potatoes in 9 x 13 baking pan. Mix with other ingredients. Top with 1/2 cup crushed corn flakes and 1/4 cup melted butter. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Pickled Peaches
directions: Wash and peel peaches., Drop peeled peaches into cold salt and vinegar solution (2 tablespoons salt and 2 tablespoons vinegar, 1 gallon water) immediately to prevent discoloration., Mix sugar and vinegar and hot water; add spices (tied loosely in cloth bag). Boil and skim., Wash peaches in cold water and drain., Drop drained peaches into boiling syrup and cook 5 to 6 minutes., Pack in preheated jars., Cover with boiling spiced vinegar or let stand overnight in syrup, then pack in jars., Cover with boiling vinegar., Seal and process 30 minutes in hot water bath at simmering temperature.

title: Veggie Pizza
directions: Press crescent rolls in a cookie sheet and bake for 10 minutes (as on package)., Let cool., Mix the next four ingredients and spread on crust., Chop all the vegetables fine and press on cream cheese mixture., Next, press 1 cup shredded cheese on top of the vegetables., Refrigerate.

title: Cherry Bread Pudding(With Almond Cream Sauce)
directions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Combine the bread with the 4 cups of liquid. Mix well. Beat together the eggs, sugar and almond flavoring. Combine with bread mixture and then stir in the cherries. Melt the butter in a 9x13x2 inch baking pan. Pour bread pudding mixture into pan and bake for about an hour. Serve with Almond Cream Sauce.

title: Cream Candy
directions: Combine sugar, syrup, milk and salt., Cook until it forms a soft ball., Remove from heat; add butter and vanilla; set aside until lukewarm., Beat until it thickens and is creamy.

title: Chicken With Eggplant
directions: Sprinkle chicken with salt and pepper., Set aside., Trim off eggplant ends, cut in 1/2 lengthwise and each 1/2 in thirds lengthwise., Then cut across in 1-inch sections (total 5 cups). Cut onion in 1/2., Slice thin (total 1 cup)., Core tomatoes and cut into small cubes (total 1 1/2 cups).

title: Cheddar Chowder
directions: Combine water and bouillon cubes in a heavy Dutch oven., Bring to a boil., Add vegetables; cover and simmer 12 minutes or until vegetables are tender., Melt margarine in heavy pan; blend in flour and cook 1 minute., Gradually add milk and mix with a whisk. Cook over medium heat until thickened, stirring constantly., Add cheese, stirring over low heat until melted., Add all ingredients to Dutch oven, stirring over low heat., Do not boil., Serves 8.

title: Apricot Salad
directions: Combine Jell-O, water and pineapple and boil gently together for 10 minutes., Add cream cheese as soon as you remove boiling mixture from heat., When cooled and beginning to thicken, add celery and nuts., Fold in Cool Whip., Pour mixture into ring or mold and chill thoroughly.

title: Chicken Salad
directions: Mix the first 5 ingredients together., Toss; stir in dressing and chill.

title: Swiss Cheese Spread
directions: Combine all ingredients., Beat until smooth and of a spreading consistency., Chill., Makes about 2 cups.

title: Mixed Lobster And Haddock
directions: Mix together all ingredients while fish is warm., Place in refrigerator in a covered jar for at least 3 hours., The haddock will absorb the juice and taste from the lobster., Serve as a salad or lobster roll.

title: Easy Chicken Pie
directions: Grease a deep-dish pie pan and place a pie shell in bottom. Dump in all ingredients and mix., Use the other pie shell as the cover, pressing the edges closed and trimming the excess., Cut slits in top and bake at 425° for 45 minutes or until golden brown., Serves 6 to 8.

title: Bubble Pizza
directions: Grease 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan., Quarter biscuits and place in bottom of pan to cover., Mix hamburger and sauce and then pour on top of biscuits., Bake for 25 minutes at 400°., Top with cheese and bake an extra 5 to 10 minutes.

title: Hot Rolls
directions: Dissolve, yeast, in, warm water., In large mixing bowl, combine, salt,, sugar, and	shortening., Pour, 1/2 cup boiling water over this., Add egg, then lukewarm water and yeast., Add 3 cups flour and let rise until double in bulk (about 1 hour). Knead down, on, floured, board., Make, into, desired shape and allow to rise again about an hour.

title: Preacher'S Pie
directions: Beat eggs slightly., Add rest of ingredients and pour into 9-inch unbaked deep dish pie shell or 2 small shallow pie shells. Bake slowly in 350° oven for 55 to 60 minutes or until slightly set.

title: Cornbread Salad
directions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl. Cover and chill overnight.

title: Banana Bread
directions: Stir on low flame sugar, water, butter and bananas (mashed) until butter melts., Set aside to cool., Beat eggs and vanilla; add to bananas., Sift flour, salt, baking powder and soda., Add to batter and stir until blended., Bake at 350° for 1 hour in a greased loaf tin.

title: Stuffy Noses
directions: Mix water and salt., Place 1 or 2 drops in each nostril, then gently suction with bulb syringe.

title: Persimmon Cookies
directions: Cream well the sugar and butter., Add egg and pulp., Sift dry ingredients., Mix all together. Add in raisins and nuts., Mix. Drop onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 12 to 15 minutes at 350°.

title: Broccoli Salad
directions: Combine all ingredients., Top with fried, crispy bacon., Mix sugar and mayonnaise and spread over bacon., Let set in refrigerator covered 2 hours or longer before serving.

title: Banana Nut Bread
directions: In large bowl, mix sugar, flour and salt., Add and mix by hand the, shortening (oil), unbeaten eggs, vanilla and baking soda dissolved in buttermilk., Add pecans and bananas., Pour into 2 loaf pans or a large ring mold., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Garlic Chicken
directions: Cut chicken into bite size pieces., Roll into Italian bread crumbs until completely coated., Place in baking pan.

title: Cheerleaders Cream Cheese Snack
directions: *The hot and spicy is particularly good.

title: Southern Pecan Pie
directions: Mix all ingredients and pour into pie shell., Bake at 300° for 1 hour., (Very good.)

title: Lanette'S Sweet Potato Casserole
directions: Mix ingredients together and place in a casserole dish.

title: Hot Pretzels
directions: Heat oven to 475°., Grease cookie sheet., In a large bowl, mix the hot water and yeast., Add water (warm) and sugar slowly., Add 5 cups flour., Stir until smooth (not sticking to sides); knead it., Form dough into golf ball size balls and shape each into pretzels., Fill a frying pan with water., For each cup of water used, add 1 tablespoon baking soda., Place pretzels in gently boiling water for 30 seconds., Take out of the water and place on cookie sheet., Salt pretzels., Bake for 8 minutes until golden brown., Can be frozen before baking.

title: Crab Critter Fritters
directions: Remove	bone, from crab., In mixing bowl beat egg, beer and stir, in Bisquick.	Add remaining ingredients, and gently stir, in crab., In heavy skillet heat 2 or 3 inches oil., Drop batter, into hot, oil (about 2 tablespoons for each fritter); fry, until golden, brown., Drain, on paper towel., Serve with cocktail sauce.

title: Salmon With Linguini
directions: In a large bowl, mix the linguini and Parmesan cheese., In large skillet, heat oil over high heat., Cook onion and garlic 1 minute., Add peas, cooking an additional 2 minutes., Reduce heat to medium and cook 1 minute., Remove from heat and mix with linguini. Toss in salmon., Makes 6 servings less than 300 calories each.

title: Cabbage Beef Casserole
directions: In a 5-quart Dutch oven or saucepan over high heat., Cook ground beef and onions until pan juices evaporate and meat is well browned., Stirring occasionally, remove Dutch oven from heat., Add cabbage, carrots, pepper and 2 1/2 teaspoons salt; toss to mix well.

title: Quick Pound Cake
directions: Add all ingredients in bowl. Beat for 3 minutes. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Poor Man'S Steak
directions: Mix ingredients thoroughly., Spread on a cookie sheet 1/2-inch thick., Chill several hours., (Do not freeze.) Cut into squares and roll in flour., Brown on both sides., Put in a roasting pan. Add 1 can cream of mushroom soup mixed with 1/2 cup water., Cover and bake in a 350° oven for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Apple Crisp Or Paradise
directions: Slice the apples into a 7 x 7-inch pan., Dot with butter; sprinkle with lemon juice., With pastry blender, blend the remaining ingredients; mix well., Spread over apples., Bake at 375° for 30 minutes, or until crisp as desired.

title: Ambrosia Salad
directions: Combine all ingredients and chill thoroughly.

title: Fruit Pudding
directions: Mix vanilla pudding as directed on package., Mix Dream Whip as directed on package., Fold pudding and Dream Whip together., Drain fruit cocktail and oranges., Add to pudding mixture., Mix in marshmallows., Refrigerate., Can add bananas at time of serving.

title: Mazell'S Caramel Icing
directions: Add 1 cup milk and 2 3/4 cups sugar in a large boiler., Bring this to a rolling boil., In a small skillet, caramelize 1/4 cup sugar., Pour into milk and sugar mix., Boil, stirring constantly, until thick., Pour into mixing bowl with margarine., Beat well. (If too thick to spread easily, add milk 1 teaspoon at a time until right consistency.), Spread evenly over cake layers.

title: Black Forest Cake
directions: Prepare cake mix according to package directions., Bake in three 9-inch layer pans., Cool and remove., Spread cherry pie filling between layers., Layer plentifully on top layer., Ice sides with Cool Whip., Refrigerate.

title: Copper Pennies(Marinated Carrots)
directions: Boil carrots in salted water., Cool., Saute pepper and onion in small amount of oil., Alternate carrots, pepper and onion in bowl., Make a sauce of remaining ingredients and pour over vegetables., Refrigerate for at least 6 hours.

title: Streusel-Filled Spice Cake
directions: Stir together streusel ingredients until crumbly., Cool. Prepare cake.

title: Cola Salad
directions: Drain juice from cherries and pineapple., Heat., Dissolve gelatins and cool., Mix pineapple, cheese, nuts and cherries with gelatin., Add cola last and blend., Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan until firm.

title: Sweet Potato Pie
directions: Mash potatoes., Measure and add other ingredients., Pour into unbaked pie shell and bake at 400° for 15 minutes., Reduce heat to 325° and cook until firm.

title: Blarney Stones
directions: Heat sugar and eggs until like marshmallow consistency., Add dry ingredients and boiling water alternately to sugar and egg mixture., Pour into a greased and floured 11 x 17 x 1-inch pan and bake at 375° for 20 to 25 minutes., After baking, let stand 10 minutes and turn out to cool.

title: Casserole Cookies
directions: Beat eggs well., Add sugar gradually, beating until fluffy. Add remaining ingredients., Turn into ungreased 2-quart casserole. Bake in 350° oven for 30 minutes., Remove from oven and while still hot, stir well with wooden spoon., Cool., Form into small balls. Roll in granulated sugar.

title: Broccoli-Cauliflower Salad
directions: Mix all together and put following dressing over all.

title: Squash Dressing
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Pour into a buttered baking dish., Bake at 350° until top browns.

title: Old Fashion Rice Pudding
directions: Grease 2-quart casserole dish. Combine eggs, sugar and milk. Beat well. Fold in rice, lemon juice, vanilla, butter, nutmeg and raisins. Pour into casserole dish and put in pan of boiling water. Bake for 45 minutes or until custard is set. Bake at 350°.

title: Pumpkin Bread
directions: Mix sugar, oil and water., Beat in eggs; add pumpkin., Sift dry ingredients twice., Add 1/2 to batter, then add rest with nuts and the vanilla., Grease four Number 303 cans with shortening; sprinkle with flour., Fill cans 1/2 full; bake for 1 hour at 300°, or until done., Remove from cans in 10 minutes.

title: Sour Cream Deviled Eggs
directions: Slice eggs in half lengthwise., Put yolks in small bowl., Add other ingredients and mix., Fill the egg white halves with yolk mixture and top with sliced olives.

title: Swiss Fudge Toffee
directions: Combine., Boil for 20 minutes, stirring all the time., Take off stove and add nuts, if desired, then beat well until it thickens., Pour into a greased dish and cut in squares.

title: Caramel Fudge Cake
directions: Prepare and bake care as directed., While cake is in the oven, make the pudding as directed., When the cake is done, poke holes all over it., Then pour hot pudding over the hot cake., Cool ten to fifteen minutes., Then pour caramel topping over all this. Refrigerate., Serve with whipped topping.

title: Pound Cake
directions: Grease and flour tube cake pan., Place ingredients in mixing bowl in order listed., Mix slowly for 2 minutes., Mix fast for 4 to 5 minutes., Do not preheat oven., Bake at 300° for 1 hour and 30 minutes.

title: Pepper Steak A La Cheddar Noodles
directions: Melt butter., Add beef and sprinkle with garlic powder., Saute until browned., Remove meat from skillet., Add onion and green pepper; saute 2 minutes., Return to skillet with tomatoes and bouillon cube., Simmer 30 minutes., Blend together cornstarch, water, soy sauce, sugar and salt., Add to meat mixture and cook until thickened., Reduce heat and cook 2 minutes longer., Prepare noodles and toss with grated cheese., Serve meat over noodles.

title: Baked Salmon
directions: Combine margarine, bread crumbs and milk., Bring to a boil. Stir in salmon, egg and salt., Pour into casserole dish sprayed with Pam., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Raspberry Or Strawberry Pretzel Delight
directions: Mix pretzels, margarine and sugar., Press into a 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake 10 minutes at 350°., Let cool completely.

title: Cinnamon Almond Cookies
directions: Beat at low speed 8 of the egg whites and granulated sugar for 4 minutes or until the sugar is dissolved., Stir in ground almonds, cinnamon, flour, chocolate bits, lemon juice and cocoa., Chill for 2 hours., Put rounded teaspoonful of dough 1 inch apart on greased baking sheets.

title: Cherry Salad
directions: Mix cherries, sugar and jello., Cook in saucepan until comes to a boil., Let it cool and then add pineapple and nuts., Stir well and refrigerate., (May wish to use potato masher and mash cherries after cooking for better consistency.)

title: Sacromonte Omelette
directions: Cut up onions and pepper and fry until soft., Add the pimentos. Mix well., Add a pinch of salt to the eggs and beat well, then add 1/3 of the egg mixture to the pan, lifting the sides with a spatula so that the liquid covers the vegetables., Add the remaining eggs. Wait until the egg mixture has set, that is, until the bottom is slightly toasted and the surface is still moist (not runny)., Put the spatula under the omelette and detach it gently from the pan. Add more butter (or oil) if necessary., Slip the omelette back into the pan, this time undone side down., Cook until this side has set.

title: Microwave Hot Fudge Sauce
directions: In a 1 1/2-quart glass bowl, melt chocolate chips in microwave., Combine with milk and sugar., Cook for 4 minutes, stirring often., Mix in margarine, vanilla and salt., Beat with rotary beaters until smooth., Serve over ice cream., Makes 1 1/2 cups.

title: Creamy Potato Bake
directions: Cook potatoes in boiling water for 15 to 20 minutes until tender., Drain and mash., Spread potatoes evenly in a lightly greased 10 x 6 x 2-inch baking dish., Top with sour cream. Sprinkle with bacon and green onions., Top with cheese., Bake at 300° for 30 minutes., Yields 6 servings.

title: Scotch Clusters
directions: Melt morsels in top of double boiler, stirring constantly. Break up noodles and pour into melted butterscotch. Add chopped nuts., Using two spoons, spoon out clusters on waxed paper., Do not have heat too high or morsels will harden.

title: Mexican Cornbread
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., Use large cast iron skillet., Put small amount of oil in bottom of pan., Place in oven while you mix ingredients., Mix cornbread according to package directions; add 1 can creamed corn., When iron skillet is hot, remove from oven. Pour 1/2 mixture in bottom of pan., Layer meat, onion, chilies and cheese., Pour remaining batter on top to cover., Bake 45 to 55 minutes or until brown and firm., Cool slightly before cutting in pie wedges., Great as a meal with a salad.

title: My Cookies
directions: Mix sugar and butter., Mix in the rest as listed., Stir well. Drop on greased cookie sheet one teaspoon at a time., Bake for about 15 minutes at 375°., Do not half or double recipe.

title: Cranberry Nut Bread
directions: Grease and flour a loaf pan., In a large bowl, sift together the flour and baking soda., In a separate bowl, cream together the butter and sugar, then beat in the egg and salt., Alternately add the flour and orange juice to the creamed mixture., Mix well after each addition., Fold in the cranberries and pecans., Turn into loaf pan., Bake in a 350° oven for 1 hour.

title: Cranberry Orange Mold
directions: Dissolve gelatin completely in boiling water in large bowl. Stir in cranberry sauce, cold water, lemon juice, cinnamon and cloves., Refrigerate about 1 1/2 hours or until thickened., Stir in orange., Spoon into 5 cup mold., Refrigerate about 4 hours or until firm., Unmold; garnish as desired., Makes about 10 servings.

title: Seafood Fancies
directions: Preheat oven to 400°., Lightly grease cookie sheets., Separate dough into 12 pieces, then separate each piece into 3 equal layers., Place on prepared cookie sheets.

title: Mexican Cornbread
directions: Grease large iron skillet and heat. Lightly sprinkle with meat and let brown slightly. Pour half of batter in hot skillet. Sprinkle layer of cheese, then onion and then peppers. Pour remaining batter over contents. Bake 45 to 50 minutes at 350°.

title: Csorege (Hungarian Cookies)
directions: Sift together flour, sugar and salt., Make a well in dry ingredients and pour in mixture of egg yolks, sour cream and vanilla., Blend well., Let dough rest for 1 to 2 minutes., Roll out dough on lightly floured surface to 1/8-inch thick., Cut dough into diamond-shaped pieces 2-inches wide at center and 6-inches long., Make a 1-inch slice in center of each diamond; pull end through center, twisting slightly., Heat oil to 365° and fry diamonds for about 3 minutes or until lightly brown., Drain on paper towels., Sprinkle with confectioners sugar.

title: Hot Rolls
directions: Mix together water, sugar and salt., Add yeast to water., Stir in egg and shortening., Then add flour until you have soft dough. I add a little sugar to yeast water., They are real good.

title: Trifle Pineapple Dessert
directions: *To cut cake, cut into slices and then cube.

title: Cornbread Salad
directions: Make cornbread using yellow cornmeal and chilies., Cool. Crumble cornbread and bacon, then add the other ingredients., Add enough mayonnaise to moisten., (May need additional mayonnaise.) Yield:, 12 servings.

title: Sweet Potato Sun Wheels
directions: Boil sweet potatoes; peel and mash., Beat potatoes until smooth., Add egg, butter, sugar and vanilla., Slice each pineapple ring to make 2 thin rings., (Rings may break, but merely put together in a circle., Also, it helps to freeze the pineapple before slicing.), Place 8 thin rings of pineapple in a baking pan and place a mound of the potato mixture on each slice of pineapple., Cover with the remaining 8 rings., Bake at 325° until heated (about 30 minutes)., Remove and sprinkle with coconut. Place in oven to brown coconut or in broiler, watching carefully to avoid burning coconut., Serves 8.

title: Fat-Free Banana Muffins
directions: Spray 12 (2 1/2-inch) muffin cups with cooking spray., In a large bowl, combine flour, baking powder and salt., In medium bowl, using a wire whisk or fork, thoroughly mix sugar and orange juice., Whisk in egg whites, corn syrup and orange peel until blended., Gradually add to flour mixture, stirring until smooth. Stir in cranberries., Spoon into prepared muffin cups., Bake in 400° oven 25 minutes or until lightly browned and firm to touch. Cool in pan 5 minutes., Serve warm or cool completely on wire rack., Store in airtight container.

title: Coleslaw
directions: Mix sour cream, mayonnaise, sugar, mustard, seasoned salt and pepper., Toss with cabbage, carrot and onion., Sprinkle with paprika or dill weed, if desired., Makes 8 servings, 95 calories per serving.

title: Drop Nut Cookies
directions: Sift together the flour and salt., Beat the egg yolk and whites until thick., Gradually beat in the brown sugar., Mix in the nuts, oil, vanilla and flour until well blended., Drop by teaspoon onto lightly oiled cookie sheet., Bake in a preheated 350° oven for 12 minutes or until delicately browned., Makes about 36 cookies., Contains 40 calories per cookie.

title: Diabetic Pancakes
directions: Mix dry ingredients, then add egg, milk and butter., Mix well and measure 1/4 cup batter for each pancake., Pour into a warm nonstick skillet until brown, turning once., Makes 10 pancakes.

title: Bananas Foster(Serves 4 People)
directions: You need a gas stove or stove top heated with gas or propane. Melt butter with brown sugar and place bananas around the sauce. Heat for about 2 minutes., Pour creme de banana into the pan. Bring back to flame., Repeat with brandy., Pour sauce and bananas over ice cream., Sprinkle with cinnamon.

title: Snickerdoodles
directions: Mix thoroughly the oleo, shortening, 3 cups sugar and eggs. Blend in flour, cream of tartar, soda and salt. May need to chill dough for a little while, then shape rounded teaspoonfuls into balls (whatever size you want your cookies). Then roll the balls of dough in the sugar and cinnamon mixture. Flatten a little and place about 2-inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes until set. Move immediately from baking sheet.

title: Buttermilk Pancakes
directions: Beat white of egg until light and fluffy meringue forms., Set aside., Beat yolk of egg; add buttermilk, then dry ingredients and cooking oil., Fold mixture into beaten egg white., Pour batter onto hot griddle to form pancakes 4-inches in diameter., Serve with butter, syrup or jelly.

title: Cabbage Patch Stew
directions: Cook ground beef and onions until meat is browned., Drain off fat, return to heat and add beans and tomatoes., Cook for fifteen minutes., Add cabbage, water, salt, pepper and chili powder., Cook for an additional 15 minutes., Serve with cornbread., This stew is better served the next day.

title: Lazy Daisy Oatmeal Cake
directions: Mix boiling water, oats and butter; let stand for 20 minutes. Add sugar, brown sugar, vanilla, eggs, flour, soda, salt, nutmeg and cinnamon., Mix all ingredients together and bake in 9 x 13-inch pan, greased and floured, 50 minutes at 350°.

title: Quick Fried Oysters
directions: Drain oysters., Mix remaining ingredients together., Coat oysters with mixture., Fry in deep fat until golden brown.

title: Cracker Pie
directions: Beat egg whites, sugar and cream of tartar until stiff., Fold in cracker crumbs, nuts and vanilla., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Cool., Top with Cool Whip.

title: Caramel Brownies
directions: Mix cake mix with 1/3 cup evaporated milk and oleo., The dough will be stiff., Melt unwrapped caramels with other 1/3 cup milk until smooth., Spread half of batter in rectangle baking pan with fingers in a greased pan., Bake at 350° for 6 minutes., Remove from oven, sprinkle chocolate chips over baked batter and pour melted caramel over that layer., Add nuts., Drop remaining batter on this. It will look strange., Bake for 15 to 18 minutes., No longer! Dough may not look done, but that's due to the melted caramels. Let it cool for a few minutes and then loosen around pan edges. Wait about an hour before cutting into squares.

title: Beef Casserole Italiano
directions: Brown ground beef and onion; drain off fat., Stir in the tomato sauce, parsley, oregano, basil, 1/4 teaspoon salt and pepper. Simmer, uncovered, for 10 minutes stirring occasionally. Meanwhile, combine spinach, Ricotta cheese and remaining 1/4 teaspoon salt., Spoon spinach mixture around edges of 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish., Pour beef mixture into center., Cut each Mozzarella slice into 3 strips and arrange in a lattice pattern over meat., Bake at 375° for 20 minutes., Yields 8 servings.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
directions: Peel and slice potatoes., Melt margarine and add flour, salt and paprika., Stir until smooth., Add milk slowly., Cook over medium heat and stir until sauce thickens and boils., Put 1/2 of potatoes in greased casserole and add 1/2 of sauce., Place slices of cheese on top., Repeat layers, ending with cheese on top. Cover and bake at 350° for 60 minutes., Uncover and bake additional 30 minutes or until potatoes are soft.

title: Banana Bread
directions: Mix well., Pour into greased loaf pan., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes., Cool before slicing.

title: Baked Hawaiian Chicken
directions: In medium saucepan, melt margarine., Stir in ketchup, lemon juice, honey, soy sauce and ginger; stir until smooth., Marinate chicken with above for at least 1 hour, better if overnight.

title: Creamy Peas And Potatoes
directions: Prick potatoes and microwave on High (100% power) for 10 minutes or until fork-tender; set aside., In a 2-quart microwave-safe bowl, combine the peas and water., Microwave on High for 6 minutes or until peas are tender; set aside.

title: Shrimp Dip
directions: Mix with mixer all but shrimp., Then add shrimp and stir in with spoon so shrimp stays whole., Serve on crackers, chips or bread sticks.

title: Beef Casserole
directions: Brown beef., Pour off any accumulated grease., Add celery, peppers and onion; saute., Add tomatoes and their juice., Add remaining ingredients except for Cheddar cheese., Simmer 20 minutes., Pour into 9 x 13-inch casserole., Spread Cheddar cheese on top., Bake 20 to 30 minutes in 350° oven.

title: Campfire Potatoes
directions: Slice potatoes thin., Place on heavy-duty aluminum foil., Peel and dice onion; mix with potatoes., Cut margarine into pieces and drop on top., Add salt and pepper., Fold over aluminum foil; roll edges to close., Place over campfire or on grill for 45 minutes to 1 hour., Turn over every 15 minutes.

title: Chess Pie
directions: Beat eggs until fluffy., Gradually beat in sugar., Add other ingredients., Beat together., Pour into 9-inch unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350° for approximately 45 minutes.

title: Coconut Custard Pie
directions: Combine sugar, eggs and flour., Add butter, milk and 1/2 cup coconut., Put 1/2 cup coconut on top of pies., Bake at 425° for 20 minutes., Reduce heat to 350° for 25 minutes or until done. Yields two 9-inch pies.

title: Bread Pudding
directions: Cream butter and sugar. Add rest of ingredients except bread and mix well. Spray 11 x 13-inch baking dish (or pan) with Pam. Line with bread. Sprinkle raisins on top. Pour milk mixture over bread. Let set 30 minutes. Bake for 35 minutes at 375° or until done. Should shake like Jell-O when pan is gently shaken back and forth.

title: Cream Of Broccoli Soup
directions: Steam the broccoli until tender. Chop coarsely and set aside. Saute the onion in butter or margarine until soft, but not brown. Add flour and stir until paste-like., Blend in milk and cream. Cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until thickened and smooth., Add cheese by the handful, stirring until smooth. Add broccoli and salt and pepper., Serves 12.

title: Easter Cake
directions: Melt margarine; add sugar and evaporated milk., Bring to a boil., Boil 5 minutes more, stirring continuously., Add 1 capful vanilla., Pour over cake., Sprinkle fresh coconut and place a few jelly beans on each piece of cake.

title: Lemon Cake Pudding
directions: Mix sugar with flour and stir in beaten egg yolks and lemon juice/rind while gradually adding milk. Stir in butter. Set aside. Beat egg whites until stiff., Fold into first mixture., Pour into a greased 8 x 8-inch Pyrex dish., Place in a pan of hot water and bake at 350° until tests done. The top will have appearance of a cake with custard on the bottom.

title: Potato Soup
directions: In large kettle, cook potatoes, carrots and celery in water until tender (about 20 minutes)., Drain, reserving liquid and setting vegetables aside., In same kettle, saute onion until soft in margarine., Stir in flour, salt and pepper., Gradually add milk, stirring constantly until thickened., Gently stir in cooked vegetables., Add 1 cup or more of reserved liquid from vegetables until soup is of desired consistency.

title: Cheese Dip
directions: Cut cheese into squares and put in crock pot. Brown ground beef and add all ingredients and simmer on low until cheese is melted.

title: Quick Skillet Stew
directions: Drain potatoes, reserving 1/3 cup liquid; slice., In skillet, combine potatoes and reserved liquid with remaining ingredients. Heat; gently stir occasionally., Makes about 5 cups.

title: Broccoli Salad
directions: Discard tough parts and chop broccoli., Add chopped onions, raisins and sunflower seeds., Mix sugar, vinegar and mayonnaise and pour over broccoli, mixing well., Add bacon, crumbled, just before serving.

title: Chocolate Chocolate Chip Cookies
directions: In large bowl cream together until fluffy shortening, sugars and vanilla., Whisk in egg., Stir in cocoa and milk., Fold in flour and soda, mixed, and chocolate bits., Drop batter by rounded teaspoonfuls onto nonstick (or greased) baking sheets., Bake at 350° for about 12 minutes., Cool about 5 minutes before removing cookies from sheets., Makes 5 dozen.

title: Overnight Potatoes
directions: Boil and mash 8 potatoes., Mix cream cheese, sour cream, milk, egg and onion., Dot 1/2 stick oleo on top., Bake until brown at 350°, for 30 to 45 minutes., Can make 1 day ahead., Refrigerate and then bake.

title: Meatball Hoagies
directions: Mix hamburg, bread crumbs and egg., Add garlic salt, oregano, salt and pepper to taste., Roll meatballs and add to own spaghetti sauce., Cook on medium heat about 45 minutes., When meatballs are done, add to buns., Sprinkle Mozzarella cheese to top and bake in oven until cheese is melted., Serve with a side of spaghetti.

title: Ham Croissant Appetizers
directions: Unroll dinner rolls., Cut each one in half to form a small triangle., Spread a little mustard on each triangle., Place 1/2 teaspoon deviled ham and a small amount of cheese near the longest side of each triangle., Roll up.

title: Oatmeal Cookies With Dried Cranberries And Apricots
directions: Put rack in center of oven., Heat oven to 350°., Lightly grease baking sheet., Cream butter or margarine and sugar with an electric mixer or food processor fitted with a metal blade., Add egg and vanilla., Mix until smooth., Add flour, baking soda, salt and oats., Mix until just combined., Stir in cranberries and apricots., Drop batter by tablespoon onto a prepared baking sheet, spacing cookies 2 1/2-inches apart., (They spread considerably.) Bake until cookies are a medium brown, about 11 minutes., Let cool 1 minute on cookie sheet., Use metal spatula to transfer to wire rack to cool completely.

title: Zucchini Bars
directions: Cream sugar and oil. Add eggs and vanilla. Mix dry ingredients together and add to egg mixture. Fold in zucchini, coconut and oatmeal., Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes in greased and floured sheet pan.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Cook broccoli according to package directions., Mix eggs, soup, cheese and mayonnaise and add to broccoli., Place in greased baking dish., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes., Place 1/2 cup crushed soda crackers on top and bake 15 more minutes.

title: Banana Bread
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Mash bananas on plate with a fork. Combine all ingredients, adding bananas last., Mix well using a wooden spoon., Place batter in greased loaf pan, 9 x 5 x 4-inch. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Peaches 'N Cream Cake
directions: Mix cake and pour in cake pan., Drain peaches and place on top of cake., Mix cream cheese, sugar and peach juice and spread over top of peaches, to approximately 1 inch from edge of pan. Sprinkle with cinnamon., Bake at 325° for 35 to 40 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean.

title: Freezer Pickles
directions: Slice cucumbers and onion; add salt., Let this soak for 2 hours., Place cucumbers and onions in containers for freezing. Dissolve sugar with vinegar., Pour over cucumbers and onions just enough to cover., Put in freezer., When ready to use, remove and let thaw.

title: Chicken-Rice Bake
directions: In a 2-quart baking dish (shallow), mix soup, water, rice, paprika and pepper. Place chicken on rice mixture. Sprinkle with additional paprika and pepper. Cover chicken and bake at 375° for 45 minutes or until done. Makes 4 servings.

title: Zucchini Casserole
directions: Boil squash and onions for 5 minutes., Drain., Mix soup and sour cream together., Mix soup mixture with squash., Melt margarine and mix with stuffing mix., In a 7 x 12 x 2-inch pan, layer 1/2 stuffing mix, then vegetable mix, top with stuffing., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes., Serves 6 to 8.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Spread 2/3 of cornbread stuffing in bottom of 1 large baking dish, ungreased., Sprinkle chopped chicken over mixture., Mix soup, chicken broth, chopped celery, chopped onions and oleo together., Cook this mixture in large boiler until onions and celery are tender., Pour this over cornbread mix and chopped chicken., Bake at 325° for 25 to 30 minutes until light brown.

title: Mahogany Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., Cream butter and sugar; add 1 egg at a time., Beat well., Add flour and baking soda and alternate with 1/2 cup milk., Heat other 1/2 cup milk and chocolate., Add while warm; beat well., Bake at 375° for 35 minutes., Use 10 x 10-inch pan.

title: Cherry Goodies
directions: *If using apple, add a little cinnamon.

title: Crab Cake Casserole
directions: Combine all ingredients except breadcrumbs and cheese in 1 1/2-quart baking dish; sprinkle with breadcrumbs and grated cheese., Bake 20 to 25 minutes at 350° or until lightly browned and cheese has melted.

title: Mexican Cornbread
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Bake in a hot, greased skillet or pan at 400° for 30 minutes.

title: Blueberry Squares
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Mix together margarine, sugar, flour, eggs, vanilla and baking powder., After mixing all ingredients together, pour half of batter in ungreased 13 x 9-inch pan. Spread 1 can of pie filling over batter., Carefully spread remaining batter over pie filling., Bake at 350° for 55 minutes.

title: Scalloped Carrots
directions: In a saucepan, over medium heat, cook and stir butter and flour until smooth and bubbly, about 2 minutes., Gradually add milk and lemon juice., Cook and stir until thickened., Add celery salt, salt and pepper; mix well., Remove from heat.

title: Dirt Cake
directions: Put cookies in milk., Take them out almost immediately and layer in bowl with Cool Whip., Refrigerate.

title: Hearty Fiesta Burgers
directions: In mixing bowl, combine egg, crumbs, taco sauce, onion and salt. Add ground beef and mix well. Shape mixture into 6 patties. Brown on both sides. Mix soup, chili beans and peppers (if desired) and pour on top of patties. Cook, covered, over low heat for 10 to 15 minutes. Top with shredded cheese. Melt cheese and serve.

title: Strawberry-Nut Dessert
directions: Bring 1 cup water to boil., Stir in gelatin until dissolved. Add juice from frozen strawberries and pineapple., Chill until thickened but not set., Fold in remaining ingredients., Chill until firm.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
directions: Sift together dry ingredients., Cream oleo, Crisco, white and brown sugar., Add eggs and vanilla., Add dry ingredients., Mix well, then add peanut butter., Drop by tablespoonful on greased cookie sheet., Flatten with fork., Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Strawberry Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients., Pour into tube pan sprayed with Pam and bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until done., Serve plain or with whipped cream.

title: Tea Cookies
directions: Mix, together to make a dough, not too thin and not too thick. Roll, out, on, floured surface and cut out with cookie cutter. Bake at 375°.

title: Milky Way Ice Cream
directions: Melt candy, bars, over	low heat with 2 cups evaporated milk. Mix eggs and sugar in large bowl and beat well., Mix in melted candy bars and milk mixture., Pour into freezer can and finish filling, with, milk, to, within 2 inches of top of can. Freeze until ready.

title: Dumplings
directions: Put flour, Crisco and salt in mixing bowl until it resembles corn meal., Add milk and egg. Roll out on floured board and cut into strips.

title: Make Ahead Breakfast Bake
directions: Crumble sausage in medium skillet; cook over medium heat until brown, stirring occasionally., Drain well. Spread bread cubes in a buttered 12x8x2 in. dish., Top with sausage and cheese. In a separate bowl combine eggs, milk and seasonings. Beat well and pour over cheese., Cover and refrigerate overnight., The next morning bake at 350 degrees for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Banana Oatmeal Muffins
directions: Cream together butter and brown sugar., Mix in egg and buttermilk., Mix together oats, flour, baking powder, salt and allspice., Add to creamed mixture., Stir in bananas., Spoon into greased muffin pan, filling 3/4 full., Bake at 400° to 425° for 20 minutes or until golden brown., Makes 12 muffins.

title: Delicious Cake
directions: Mix cake as directed on box., Bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan., Cook pineapple and sugar together for 5 minutes., When cake is done, poke holes all over it and pour pineapple mixture over top while both are still hot., Let cool., Make pudding and pour over cooled cake., Put in refrigerator to cool set., Then spread whipped cream over top., Sprinkle with nuts and coconut., Keep refrigerated until ready to serve.

title: Hummingbird Cake
directions: Combine flour, baking soda, sugar, cinnamon and salt., Add eggs and oil (do not beat)., Stir in vanilla, pineapple, 1 cup pecans and the banana., Pour into 3 greased and floured 9-inch round cake pans., Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350°., Cool in pan for 10 minutes., Remove and cool completely.

title: Cream Of Rice Pudding
directions: The CoCo Lope and Harina de Arroz can be bought at Foodtown, by the Goya products.

title: Poppy Seed Bread
directions: Mix and pour into 2 greased loaf pans (9 x 5-inch)., Bake at 350° for 60 to 70 minutes. Remove from pans., Makes 2 loaves.

title: Chicken Salad
directions: Combine all ingredients together.

title: Pronto Potato Soup
directions: In small frying pan, brown bacon until crisp., Remove and drain on paper towel., Add onion to drippings in pan and saute 2 to 3 minutes., Drain fat off., Meanwhile, in 3-quart saucepan, mix cold potatoes and soup until smooth., Add milk gradually, stirring constantly, to desired consistency over medium heat., Add bacon and onions., Season with salt, pepper and parsley.

title: Corn Souffle
directions: Combine all ingredients. Bake 1 hour at 350°. Lightly grease bottom of pan.

title: Banana Bread
directions: Mix in order given., Put in greased loaf pan or 2 small loaf pans., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Banana Bread
directions: Cream shortening and sugar., Add vanilla and mix well., Add eggs and beat until light and fluffy., Sift flour, soda and salt together., Set aside., Mash bananas and combine with water., Add bananas and sifted ingredients alternately to creamed mixture, beating well after each addition., Pour into greased loaf pan. Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Fried Pies
directions: Sift dry ingredients., Cut in shortening., Add Milnot to which egg has been added., Mix well and chill overnight., Roll out thin on lightly floured board and cut circles., Place between wax paper., These can be made ahead of time., If they are wrapped, they will not dry out.

title: Rhubarb Pie For 1
directions: Wash, clean and cut rhubarb into bite size pieces (enough to fill 9-inch pie pan).

title: Plum Nutty Cake
directions: Sift together first 5 ingredients., Add remaining ingredients and beat until well mixed., Pour into a greased tube or Bundt pan and bake at 325° for 1 hour and 10 minutes., Cool and drizzle with glaze.

title: Cheese Biscuits
directions: Preheat oven to 450°., Combine all ingredients in a bowl, stirring until moistened., Knead dough 20 times on floured surface., Pat dough to 1/2-inch thickness and cut with round biscuit cutter., Place on lightly greased baking sheet and bake at 450° for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Bread
directions: Mix lukewarm water and yeast; set aside., Mix together oil, salt, sugar and 1 cup water; then add yeast., Add flour., Make into a dough ball; coat bowl and top of dough ball with oil., Cover with a tea towel and put in a warm place, or in sink with warm water. Let rise about 1 or 1 1/2 hours., Punch down., Let rise again about 1 1/2 hours or until doubled in size., Make rolls., Let them rise about 1 hour., Bake at 350° until light brown., If you like a soft crust, coat baked rolls with butter and cover with tea towel for 5 minutes., To make sweet rolls, add more sugar.

title: Apricot Delight
directions: Heat apricot nectar just under boiling point., Add jello and sugar; let cool., Add frozen orange juice, crushed pineapple, nuts, banana and marshmallows., Stir in salt and lemon juice. Congeal in refrigerator., Optional:, Serve with thin layer of Cool Whip.

title: Apple Bean Bake
directions: Cook apples in melted butter until tender., Add sugars., Cook until sugars melt., Add last four ingredients; stir together well. Combine with beans., Mix well!, Pour all into 2-quart casserole. Bake at 400° about 1 hour., Serves 6 to 8.

title: Mandarin Orange-Pineapple Salad
directions: Combine first 5 ingredients., Sprinkle gelatin over mixture; stir well., Spoon mixture into a 13 x 9 x 2-inch dish. Combine pecans and coconut., Sprinkle over salad., Chill 6 hours or overnight., Makes 15 servings.

title: Blueberry Pecan Delight
directions: Mix all together and congeal.

title: French Rolls
directions: Cream butter, sugar and salt., Add beaten eggs., Liquefy yeast in 1 teaspoon sugar., Add to mixture., Add milk and enough flour to make stiff, smooth dough., Let rise 5 hours., Take off large chunk off dough; roll thin on floured surface., Cut into wedges, spread with soft butter., Roll from broad end to narrow end., Place rolls on ungreased cookie sheet., Let rise 3 to 4 hours., Bake at 350° for 15 minutes., Yields approximately 60 rolls.

title: Chocolate Fudge
directions: Mix the ingredients all together except vanilla., Cook over medium heat for 1/2 hour, stirring constantly, or until it forms a soft ball when dropped in cold water., Add the vanilla and beat by hand for 1 minute., Then pour into a buttered pan., Cut into inch squares.

title: Parmesan Dip
directions: Melt cream cheese and milk in a double boiler., Add Parmesan cheese, salt and pepper., Sprinkle on top green onions and paprika., Serve with sliced French bread.

title: Elephant Stew
directions: Onion odor will cling to many containers, especially plastic, but is easy to remove.

title: Jalapeno Cornbread
directions: Heat iron skillet or heavy baking pan with a little oil. Sprinkle with 1 tablespoon meal and brown lightly., Then add batter and bake at 400° until browned on top, usually 20 minutes or so.

title: No Bake Fruit Cake
directions: Mix graham crackers, raisins, nuts and candied fruit., Heat milk; add marshmallows and heat until melted., Add butter and water; mix thoroughly., Pour over graham cracker mixture and mix. Line pan with waxed paper., Press mixture into pan., Cover with waxed paper., Refrigerate for 3 days before cutting.

title: Country Steak
directions: Pound steak., Cut into serving size pieces., In skillet, brown steak in oil., Pour off fat., Stir in soup and water., Cover and simmer 1 1/2 hours or until done., Stir often., Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Gourmet Cheese Potatoes
directions: Cook potatoes in skins., Peel and shred., In saucepan, combine butter and cheese., Stir until melted., Remove from heat and add remaining ingredients, except paprika., Fold into potatoes., Pour into a greased baking dish and sprinkle with paprika., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Squash Casserole
directions: Cut, the squash and onion., Boil, until, tender., Drain and mash., Add, salt,	pepper, eggs, soup,, butter, and, 1/2 cracker crumbs;, mix well.	Layer 1/2 of the squash mixture in a dish. Sprinkle this with 1 cup of cheese., Spread remaining squash, on top of cheese and sprinkle	the, remaining	cracker crumbs on squash., Sprinkle the remaining cheese on top of the crackers. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Sweet Potato Dish
directions: Combine sweet potatoes with 1/2 cup pineapple, salt, butter and honey or brown sugar., Turn into 2-quart casserole., Sprinkle top with nutmeg and garnish with remaining crushed pineapple. Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

title: Pickle Relish
directions: Combine cucumbers, peppers and onion., Sprinkle with turmeric. Dissolve salt in 2 quarts cold water and pour over vegetables., Let stand 3 to 4 hours., Drain., Cover vegetables with cold water and let stand 1 hour., Drain thoroughly., Tie spices in a cheesecloth bag., Add to sugar and vinegar., Heat to boiling and pour over vegetables., Cover and let stand 12 to 18 hours in a cool place. Simmer until vegetables are hot., Bring to boiling., Pack boiling hot into hot jars, leaving 1/8-inch headspace., Adjust caps. Process 10 to 15 minutes., Yield:, 6 pints.

title: Blueberry Cake Or Muffins
directions: At low speed cream butter and sugar until fluffy., Add eggs (1 at a time)., Mix until blended., Sift dry ingredients; add alternately with milk and vanilla., Mash 1/2 cup blueberries; stir in by hand., Fold in rest of blueberries., Pour in greased tube pan or muffin tins., Sprinkle with sugar on top. Bake at 375° for 30 minutes.

title: Granny'S Italian Cookies
directions: Beat sugar and Crisco until very creamy., Add eggs and beat very well., Add vanilla., Put flour, baking powder and salt through sifter and mix thoroughly into batter; should not be sticky., Grease cookie sheets., Drop by teaspoon onto sheets and form with fingers., Bake at 400° until cookies are light brown. Ice with powdered sugar and milk frosting.

title: Shepherd'S-Cheese Pie
directions: Brown your meat; drain your meat., Saute onions and bell peppers with butter., Add to the meat., Add season and sauce to meat., In your oblong casserole dish, spread meat evenly on bottom of dish., Spread creamed potatoes evenly over meat topped with shredded cheese., Place in oven at 400° for 25 minutes., Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Strata
directions: Line a buttered 13 x 9-inch pan with 10 slices of bread, then ham, cheese, bread (10 slices), ham and cheese., Mix eggs, milk, salt, onion salt and mustard; pour on top of bread, ham and cheese., Cover; let stand overnight., Take out 10 minutes. Uncover; bake for 50 to 60 minutes at 375°., Take out of oven; let stand 10 minutes before serving.

title: Stuffed Mushrooms
directions: Clean thoroughly and boil for 5 minutes 10 large mushrooms. Remove stems and boil as well., Saute onion., Add mushroom stems. When these are cooked add Parmesan, parsley and garlic., Fill mushrooms., Bake in preheated oven at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Mandarin Salad
directions: Drain, orange, segments and set aside., Combine gelatin and water,, stir until dissolved., Cool., Add sherbet and mix well. Add, orange segments and stir until well blended., Pour into lightly oiled mold and refrigerate.

title: Hot German Potato Salad
directions: Cook bacon until brown., Add onions and saute for a few minutes., Add brown sugar and vinegar, then chopped potatoes. Turn down heat and allow to season through., Salt and pepper to taste.

title: Pumpkin Bread
directions: Combine all ingredients in bowl and mix., Bake 1 1/2 hours at 325°., Makes 1 large loaf or 2 medium loaves.

title: Appetizer Meat Balls
directions: Combine all ingredients except cranberry sauce, and tomato sauce., Shape into balls about 1-inch in diameter., Brown on all sides., Remove from pan into a deeper pot, draining off extra fat. Combine cranberry sauce with tomato sauce., Pour over meat balls. Cover and simmer over low heat about 45 minutes., Serve in chafing dish., Provide toothpicks.

title: Mexican Cornbread Casserole
directions: Brown meat; drain., Add onion and cook until tender., Stir in Cheez Whiz until melted., Spoon into oblong casserole dish. Prepare cornbread mix as directed., Add remaining ingredients, mixing just until moistened., Spoon over meat and cheese mixture. Bake at 375° for 16 to 18 minutes.

title: Pizza Snack
directions: Put 1 tablespoon sauce on each tortilla slice., Sprinkle about 1 teaspoon of cheese onto each slice., Put slices on a tray and put in toaster oven or oven for 3 to 5 minutes on 350°., In microwave, only cook 1 to 1 1/2 minutes.

title: Classic Spinach Dip
directions: Drain spinach until dry., Stir together all ingredients. Refrigerate for at least 2 hours., Serve with bread, crackers, vegetables or chips.

title: Alpine Goulash With Buttered Noodles
directions: Brown meat well on all sides in hot drippings or shortening. Turn cubes to brown equally., Add balance of ingredients, cover and cook slowly until beef cubes are tender, about 2 1/2 hours.

title: Hominy Grits Casserole
directions: Bring water to boil., Add hominy and cook 3 minutes., Beat eggs in a cup and finish filling with milk., Stir in egg mixture, butter and garlic cheese., Pour into buttered casserole and bake at 350° for approximately 1 hour.

title: Refrigerator Bran Muffins
directions: Use a large bowl., Pour 2 cups boiling water over the shredded wheat and let stand. Cream sugar, shortening and eggs, well beaten., Add shredded wheat mixture and other ingredients., Let stand 36 hours before using., Fill muffin tins slightly over half and bake at 350° for 30 minutes., Batter keeps indefinitely in refrigerator.

title: Cherry Dessert
directions: Beat together cream cheese, powdered sugar and milk., Spread on crust., Spread pie filling over filling and top with whipped cream or Cool Whip.

title: Fruit Cocktail Cake
directions: Sift flour, sugar, salt, and baking soda., Then add 1 egg, beaten with juice of the fruit cocktail., Add medium can of Fruit Cocktail.

title: Easy Cheesy Rice And Broccoli
directions: Bring broccoli and water to boil in medium saucepan, separating broccoli with fork., Stir in Velveeta cheese., Reduce heat to low; cover and simmer 3 minutes., Stir in Minute rice; cover., Remove from heat., Let stand 5 minutes., Stir before serving., Makes 6 servings.

title: Perfect Corn Bread
directions: Sift flour with sugar, baking powder and salt; stir in cornmeal., Add eggs, milk and Wesson oil., Beat with rotary or electric beater until just smooth., (Do not overbeat)., Pour into greased iron skillet or 9 x 9 x 2-inch pan., Bake at 425° for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Fred'S Favorite Raisin Custard Pie
directions: Cook raisins, sugar, 1 1/2 cups water and vinegar about 10 minutes., Mix egg yolks, remaining water, cornstarch and butter. Add to raisins and cook until thick., Pour into baked pie shell. Serve with whipped topping.

title: Low-Sugar - Low-Fat Delight
directions: Make jello with 1 3/4 cups boiling water., When cool, add yogurt., Whisk to mix., Refrigerate.

title: Drop Donuts
directions: Stir with fork and drop by teaspoon into hot grease for about 3 minutes.

title: Ranch Crackers
directions: Mix together oil, dressing and dill weed., Pour over crackers in a Ziploc bag., Shake.

title: Bev'S Super Squash
directions: Wash zucchini and cut in 1-inch slices., Put in a large pot and cover with water., Bring to a boil and let boil for 5 minutes only., Drain squash very well., Cut scallions into very small pieces (use the green and white part)., Put the squash into a long baking dish, sprinkle scallions on top of squash., Salt and pepper to taste., Slice cheese and place on top., Bake in 350° oven until cheese is melted, about 15 to 25 minutes.

title: Favorite Chocolate Cake
directions: Beat together sugar, margarine, eggs and vanilla., Add the flour, baking powder, salt and cocoa., Gradually add the 1/2 cup sour milk and 1 cup boiling water., Batter will be thin., Grease and flour pans lightly., Frost with your desired frosting., Bake at 350°., Makes 2 layers, bake 25 minutes., With one 9 x 13-inch pan, bake 45 minutes; 30 cupcakes, bake 25 minutes.

title: Crab And Shrimp Dip
directions: Combine all ingredients together., Serve with crackers.

title: Apple 'N' Honey Scones
directions: Heat oven to 400°., Lightly spray large cookie sheet or grease lightly., Combine first 7 ingredients; cut in margarine until mixture resembles coarse crumbs., Add apple, milk and honey, mixing until dry ingredients are moistened., Turn dough out onto lightly floured surface; knead gently 5 to 6 times., Pat dough into a 9-inch circle.

title: Christmas Snack Mix
directions: Mix the first 4 ingredients all together in large pan. Over this pour the remaining ingredients. Cook 2 or 3 hours in oven at 250°, stirring very 15 or 20 minutes until crisp. Spread on paper towels to cool.

title: Cherry Mountain Ice Cream Pie
directions: Spoon ice cream into the crust., Freeze for 2 hours., Crumble pecan cookies over ice cream to form second layer., Place cherries over cookie layer.

title: Chicken Tetrazzini
directions: Combine spaghetti, chicken, olives, onion, seasoning and broth., Bake until hot., Add sour cream and stir., Place almonds on top and heat through., Serve with French bread and a salad., A great way to use leftover chicken or turkey.

title: Cream Cheese Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 325°. Grease and flour pan. Beat butter and cream cheese together in bowl until well blended. Add sugar to mixture and cream until light and fluffy. Add eggs, one at a time, and beat well after each addition. Add vanilla and lemon flavor. Sift flour and blend into creamed mixture. Cook 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Bacon Monkey Bread
directions: Combine bacon, Parmesan cheese and onion; set aside., Cut biscuits into fourths; dip each piece in butter., Layer one third in a 10-inch lightly greased Bundt pan., Sprinkle half of bacon mixture over biscuits., Repeat procedure, ending with biscuits. Bake at 350° for 40 minutes or until golden., Cool 10 minutes in pan., Invert onto a serving platter., Serve immediately.

title: Grandmom'S Yum Yum Cake
directions: Cook the first 7 ingredients slowly for approximately 15 minutes or until raisins are puffy., Set aside to cool, then add soda., Set aside until cold., Add flour and water last., Bake 45 minutes at 350° in Bundt pan., Do it right and it's yummy!

title: No Peek Chicken
directions: Put rice and water in dish and mix., Layer remaining ingredients and bake 2 1/2 hours at 350°.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Pour into greased casserole dish., Cover top with crackers., Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Jerusalem Artichokes With Cream Sauce
directions: Wash and peel the artichokes, slice in covered pan., Cook in small amount of water (salted)., Boil for 10 to 15 minutes until tender., Drain well., Melt butter in a saucepan., Blend in flour, salt and white pepper; add cream or milk, all at once., Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly., Remove from heat., Stir in parsley., Serve sauce over cooked artichokes., Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Frozen Cranberry Cups
directions: In food processor or blender, combine berries, sugar and pineapple until, finely chopped.

title: Macaroni Goulash
directions: Cook macaroni firm as directed., Brown turkey and onion together in 4-quart pot., Drain., Add stewed tomatoes, oregano, garlic, ketchup and salt., Simmer 20 minutes., Add macaroni and simmer 10 minutes more., Serve with salad.

title: Fudge Brownies
directions: Mix all ingredients except nuts., Add nuts and stir., Bake in small

title: Bread And Butter Pickles
directions: Wash and drain vegetables., Slice cucumbers and onions., Soak in salt solution (2 quarts water and 1/2 cup canning salt) for 3 hours., Mix vinegar, sugar and spices; bring to a boil., Add cucumbers and onions, just to heat thoroughly (until cucumbers change colors)., Pack hot cucumbers into jars, leaving 1/3 inch space., Cover with boiling hot liquid., Adjust lids and seal.

title: Peachy Fruit Salad
directions: Puree first 4 ingredients until smooth., Refrigerate 1 hour. Place remaining ingredients in large bowl., Pour peach sauce over fruit., Toss until covered., Chill., Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Cranberry Salad
directions: Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water; add cranberry sauce., Chill until syrupy., Add nuts and celery., Stir in sour cream., Chill at least 4 hours in a mold.

title: Vegetable Burgers(Serves 4)
directions: Will need aluminum foil squares.

title: London Broil Marinade(Serves 6)
directions: Mix ingredients together to blend., Pour over 2 pound cut of London broil., Marinate 3 hours or overnight., Broil over grill or in the oven., For medium rare, broil about 15 minutes on each side in the oven., If you are cooking on the outdoor grill, adjust the time according to the distance your rack is from the coals, 15 minutes on the first side and 10 minutes on the other side might produce the desired doneness., Slice diagonally, very thin. Serves 6., (The amount of marinade is enough for a large cut of steak.)

title: Belgian Waffles
directions: In medium bowl, combine first four ingredients., In separate bowl, sift dry ingredients., Add the liquid into the dry ingredients. Beat until smooth. Fold in beaten egg whites., Bake in Belgian waffle maker.

title: Spicy Shrimp Etouffee(Ay-Too-Fay)
directions: Saute onion and green pepper in butter; add garlic powder and celery seed., In a bowl, combine cornstarch, red and black pepper, 1/4 cup water and 1/2 teaspoon salt., Stir into cooked vegetables. Add tomato sauce., Stir in shrimp., Bring to a boil; then reduce heat and simmer briefly, just until heated through., Serve over hot, cooked rice., Makes 4 servings.

title: Chicken Rolls
directions: Toss chicken with olive oil, oregano and salt. Cook in skillet over medium heat until done. Add onions and heat through. Heat pita bread in microwave. Spread pita with sour cream and chicken mixture. Top with lettuce, tomatoes and cucumber. Fold and enjoy.

title: Meat Balls
directions: Mix all ingredients well., Shape into 2-inch balls and arrange in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish.

title: Doughnuts
directions: Shape or cut a hole in center., Cook in hot oil (skillet). Shake in a brown paper bag filled with sugar. Eat while warm.

title: Kid'S Barbecue Chicken
directions: Place mixture of half cornmeal/half flour with salt/pepper to season in paper bag., Dip chicken pieces in milk, then drop in paper bag; shake., Pan-fry until golden brown and done through.

title: Mexican Cornbread
directions: In a large skillet, cook beef and onion until beef is lightly brown and onion is tender; drain off fat. Stir in salsa, taco seasoning and water; cook over low heat 5 to 6 minutes or until mixture thickens. Stir in corn and olives. Spoon into 8-inch square baking dish.

title: Easy Apple Pie
directions: Peel and slice apples., Layer in 10-inch pie plate., Mix 1 tablespoon sugar and cinnamon., Sprinkle over apples., Mix melted butter, flour, 1 cup sugar, egg and chopped pecans., Pour over apples., Bake at 325° for 45 minutes.

title: Swedish Pineapple Cake
directions: Mix well and pour in ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean.

title: Apple Pie
directions: Peel apples and slice. Add remaining ingredients. Mix with apples and let stand while making crust.

title: California Pie
directions: Fold in crumbs and nuts to first 3 ingredients., Butter pie pan., Bake 30 minutes at 350°., Cool; top with Cool Whip, ice cream or whipped cream., I like it served without topping.

title: Lemon Chess Bars
directions: Mix and bake in 9 x 12 glass pan 20 minutes at 350°. Cool slightly.

title: Vanilla Ice Cream
directions: Beat, eggs, with electric mixer., Add sugar while beating. Other, ingredients, should be added in the order listed, beating well after each addition., Pour into ice cream freezer., Add enough, milk to fill container., Freeze in ice cream freezer according to directions.

title: Red Pepper Round Steak
directions: Partially freeze steak; slice diagonally across grain into 1/4-inch wide strips., Cut strips into 2-inch pieces., Sprinkle steak with salt and pepper.

title: Cauliflower And Broccoli Salad
directions: Cut cauliflower and broccoli into small pieces and pour mixture of ingredients over pieces.

title: Mexican Chili Bake
directions: In large skillet, cook onions, green peppers and garlic in butter until tender but not brown. Stir in rice, tomatoes and seasoning., Heat thoroughly., Saute beef; stir beef into rice mixture., Spoon half of beef-rice mixture into buttered, shallow 2-quart casserole dish., Sprinkle with 1/2 cup cheese and 1/2 cup corn chips., Repeat layers., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes, or until heated thoroughly.

title: Freezer Cole Slaw
directions: Let cabbage, green pepper and carrots set 1 hour., In saucepan, add vinegar, salt, mustard seed, celery seed and sugar. Bring to a boil., Pour this over cabbage, green pepper and carrots., Let set 2 hours., Drain well and place in freezer containers and put into freezer., When ready to use, thaw and mix in mayonnaise to taste.

title: Taco Crescent Pie
directions: Brown ground chuck and drain., Add taco mix, water and olives. Simmer 5 minutes. Separate rolls and put in ungreased 9 x 10-inch pie plate to make crust., Sprinkle 1 cup crushed chips over bottom crust. Spoon on meat mixture, the sour cream, cheese and top with remaining corn chips., Bake at 375° for 15 to 20 minutes. Slice and serve. Top individual servings with as much lettuce, tomato and taco sauce as desired., Freezes well.

title: Five Cup Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients together; chill.

title: Lotsa Layers Salad
directions: Twenty-four hours prior to eating, make in order by layering lettuce, celery, green pepper, water chestnuts, onions and peas in a bowl., Mix mayonnaise and sugar and spread with spatula over top., Layer remaining ingredients., Cover and keep in refrigerator.

title: Corn Pudding
directions: Beat eggs., Add all other ingredients., Pour into greased casserole and bake 1 hour and 20 minutes at 350° or until golden brown on top., Place casserole in pan of water to prevent burning. Serves 4 to 5.

title: Cheese Sauce
directions: Mix all ingredients and cook until, it	thickens, stirring to prevent lumping.

title: Pecan Pie
directions: Melt butter and set aside to cool., Mix flour and sugar together., Add milk and eggs., Beat well. Stir in vinegar and vanilla. Add butter and nuts. Pour into pie crust and place in cold oven., Bake at 300° for 1 hour.

title: Pecan Pie
directions: Beat eggs., Add remaining ingredients., Bake at 300° for 1 hour.

title: Sis Haack'S Black-Eyed Peas(Beans)
directions: Fry until cooked the oleo and hamburger., Add the other ingredients and let simmer 30 to 40 minutes. Add a little water, if dry.

title: Eggplant Pudding Cake
directions: Combine all ingredients in large mixing bowl and blend., Then beat at medium speed for 4 minutes., Pour into greased and floured fluted tube pan., Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 10 minutes or until cake tests done., Do not underbake., Cool in pan., Remove from pan and finish cooling on rack., Sprinkle with powdered sugar, if desired., For mellowing of flavors, cover and store overnight., Do not use cake mix that has pudding added.

title: Lasagna
directions: Brown ground beef in microwave for 10 minutes., Drain., Stir in tomato sauce, tomato paste, salt, pepper and garlic., Microwave for 10 minutes.

title: Melt Aways Cookies
directions: Cream together first 4 ingredients and add flour, nuts and coconut., Form balls using a teaspoon., Bake at 350° for 15 to 18 minutes., Roll or sift with powdered sugar.

title: Impossible Pie
directions: Beat eggs., Add sugar, flour and baking powder., Add milk; mix well., Add oleo, vanilla and coconut., Mix well., Pour into an 8-inch glass pie pan which has been lightly greased., Bake 30 minutes at 350°., Makes its own crust.

title: Hungarian Pastry
directions: Mix well by hand until no more yellow or white shows., Flatten out, wrap in waxed paper and store in refrigerator overnight.

title: Cabbage Vinegar Salad
directions: Chop and blend together all vegetables and 1/2 cup sugar., Mix and boil remaining ingredients together for 3 minutes., Pour over vegetable mixture., Chill before serving.

title: Cabbage Rolls
directions: Soften leaves in boiling water for 5 to 10 minutes., Mix together all remaining ingredients, then shape into small roll and roll up in cabbage leaves., Fasten with toothpicks., Place in greased baking dish and bake 45 minutes at 350°.

title: Chicken And Rice Casserole
directions: Heat oven to 325°., Grease 9 x 13 pan., Sprinkle rice in pan. Place chicken breasts on rice., Mix canned soup, with water; pour over chicken and rice (lift chicken enough to allow liquid to reach rice underneath)., Sprinkle dry onion soup mix over chicken and rice., Cover pan with foil., Bake about 1 1/2 hours, or until chicken is done (juices run clear when poked with fork).

title: Squash Dressing
directions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees., Saute onion in margarine., Mix all ingredients, adding salt and pepper to taste., Bake in oblong dish 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Nan'S Lime Delight Salad
directions: Mix jello according to directions and let chill until it begins to thicken., When thickened, take out of refrigerator., Add the cabbage, carrots and pineapple., Return to refrigerator to jell until served.

title: Tater Crisp Chicken
directions: Grease 13 x 9-inch baking dish., Rinse fryer in cold water and cut into serving pieces., Pat dry., Dip pieces in melted margarine and roll in potato flakes., Place skin side up in prepared dish and season to taste., Bake 50 to 60 minutes or until done.

title: Key Lime Pie
directions: Beat egg yolks slightly., Blend with milk, sugar, lime juice and cornstarch., Whip over hot water until slightly thick., Put into baked pie shell., Top with favorite meringue recipe.

title: Cauliflower Casserole
directions: Beat the eggs in a bowl., In separate bowl, add chopped onion, soup, mayonnaise and beaten eggs., Mix thoroughly., Add cooked, drained cauliflower to the first mixture; mix thoroughly., Mix melted butter and bread crumbs together; sprinkle over cauliflower mixture., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Peppered Rib Eye Steaks(Dry Marinade)
directions: Brush steaks with olive oil., In a small bowl, combine all seasonings., Sprinkle seasoning over steaks and press into both sides., Cover and chill for at least 1 hour., Grill steaks., We have used this on every cut of steak, even deer steaks, and it is very good.

title: Pepper Relish
directions: Combine all ingredients in a large Dutch oven and bring to boil., Reduce heat to medium., Cook uncovered 30 minutes, stirring occasionally., Discard hot pepper., Pack into hot sterilized jars, leaving 1/4 inch headspace., Cover with metal lids., Screw bans tight., Process in boiling water bath 5 minutes., Yield:, 11 half pints.

title: Southern Italy Meat Balls
directions: Add all ingredients; make 6 meat balls., Saute in olive oil until brown; drain and place meat balls in gravy.

title: Spanish Pie, Potato
directions: Cube the potatoes in very small, cubes., Put them in frying pan with, 2 tablespoons butter (melted)., Let them fry while stirring occasionally for 5 minutes., Cut slivers of green onions in very little pieces., Get a casserole bowl and preheat oven to 350°., Butter bottom and edges of bowl; take the slightly cooked potatoes and cover bottom of casserole dish, then mix green onions, grated cheese, 1/2 pound grated ham and put a layer of this mixture on first layer of potatoes., Repeat with putting final layer of potatoes on top., Beat 2 eggs and pour over top of whole mix and let eggs run through whole mixture., Bake in oven for 45 minutes approximately., This is sooo good you'll want to slap the cook, but don't, because he or she has feelings, too., I picked this recipe up in Spain.

title: Ginger Pickles
directions: Peel and cut cucumbers in small strips., Soak 24 hours (2 gallons water and 3 cups lime)., Rinse well., Soak 2 hours in alum and water to cover them., Wash 3 times., Soak 6 hours in ginger and water to cover., Rinse well., Drain.

title: French Onion Soup
directions: Peel onion and slice thinly. Melt butter slowly in pan., Add onion and cook slowly over low heat, stirring often, until onion is golden brown. Add 6 cups water and the bouillon cubes., Cook at least 1 hour. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese when served.

title: Strawberry Jam
directions: Mix Sure-Jell with strawberries in a saucepan., Bring to a boil while stirring., Add sugar and boil for 1 minute, stirring constantly., Seal in jars and let cool.

title: Cream Cheese Dip
directions: Blend the ingredients into a ball and serve with a variety of crackers.

title: Meal-In-A-Dish
directions: Brown beef in oil., Place in casserole dish., Layer remaining ingredients., Bake at 350 degrees for 1 1/2 hours., Cover with grated cheese return to oven until cheese is melted., Serve.

title: Barbecued Cheese Potatoes
directions: Mix all ingredients in a heavy skillet., Cover; cook over low heat for about 1 hour, or until potatoes are tender., Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Apple Crumb Cake
directions: Work first four ingredients like a pie crust (leave crumbly). Put 2/3 into a 9 x 13-inch pan and press down lightly., Slice apples on top., (If keeping apples very close you will need 7 or 8 to fill pan evenly.), Mix the last 3 ingredients in a dish; add this mixture and cover the entire apple pan., Add the remaining pie crust on top to cover., Bake at 350° for 1 hour., (Check on apple softness; different apples take a longer period of time for baking.)

title: Cherry Nut Cake
directions: Cream together shortening and lemon extract, add sugar and beat until fluffy., Add egg yolks and beat well after each addition., Sift together dry ingredients 2 times., Add liquids and dry ingredients alternately to creamed mixture, beating only until smooth after each addition., Stir in nuts and cherries., Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites., Bake at 375° for 25 minutes.

title: Stuffed Shells
directions: Thaw spinach and squeeze as dry as possible., Mix with yogurt cheese, egg whites, onion, 4 ounces Mozzarella cheese and spices. Cook pasta according to package directions., Stuff shells or manicotti with spinach mixture., Put in 11 x 14-inch casserole dish sprayed with nonstick baking spray., Cover with sauce, which has been diluted with water.

title: Chocolate Brownie Deluxe
directions: (Perry County Fair 2nd Place Hershey's Greatest Cocoa Cookie, Brownie, Bar Contest.)

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Cut 12 doughnuts and holes from bread., Remove crust from scraps, fitting scraps in bottom of 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Place cheese slices in layer over bread, followed by a layer of broccoli, then a layer of ham., Arrange bread doughnuts and holes on top., Combine remaining ingredients and pour over all., Cover and refrigerate at least 6 hours, or overnight., Bake uncovered in slow 325° oven for 55 minutes., Sprinkle some grated cheese over top 5 minutes before end of baking., Serves 12.

title: Garry'S Rum Cream Pie
directions: Beat the egg yolks until light in color, then gradually beat in the sugar., Soak the gelatin in the cold water and put on low heat, stirring until gelatin is dissolved., In a slow stream, pour the gelatin mixture into the egg mixture, beating constantly., Cool mixture., Stir in the rum.

title: Deep Dish Taco Squares
directions: Heat oven to 375°., Grease a 9 x 13-inch dish., Cook and stir beef until brown; drain., Put in taco seasoning., Mix sour cream, mayonnaise, cheese and onion and put aside., Mix Bisquick and water until soft dough forms., Pat into greased pan; press to 1/2 inch on sides of pan., Layer beef, tomatoes and then green peppers in pan over dough., Spoon sour cream mixture over top., Bake until edges of dough are light brown, about 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Beef Wellington
directions: Preheat oven to 425°, Place meat in lightly greased roasting pan. Sprinkle with pepper if desired. Roast at 425°, for 30 minutes or until thermometer reads 130°., Cover and refrigerate 1 hour.

title: Peach Ice Cream
directions: Mix ingredients in a large bowl., Chill first if possible. Pour in 4-quart freezer, then add sweet milk if not full to freezer line.

title: Tomatoes Provencale
directions: Halve tomatoes and place on cookie sheet., Crumb toast., Mix remaining ingredients and pour over the crumbs., Pile mixture on tomatoes and broil 5 to 7 minutes.

title: Grilled Steak And Vegetable Salad
directions: Grill steak over medium-hot coals to desired degree of doneness, about 20 minutes for medium, turning halfway through cooking time., Slice steak, diagonally across grain, into scant 1/4-inch slices., Combine sliced meat and vegetables in shallow serving bowl., Pour dressing over and toss., Serve immediately or refrigerate several hours., Serve chilled., Makes 6 servings.

title: Marinated Sweet And Sour Salad
directions: Cook carrots, in boiling salted water to cover, in a large saucepan, until crisp-tender, about 5 minutes., Drain; cool. Combine carrots, onion and green pepper in a serving bowl.

title: Crisp Oatmeal Cookies
directions: In saucepan mix brown sugar, shortening and butter., Cook and stir over low heat until butter and shortening melt., Remove from heat and stir in remaining ingredients, mixing well., Drop from teaspoon 3 inches apart on well-greased cookie sheet., Bake in moderate oven at 375° about 7 minutes., Cool slightly and remove from pan., Makes 4 dozen.

title: Crab Imperial
directions: Mix thoroughly first 7 ingredients., Turn over lightly with hands., Put in cleaned crab shells., Top with cracker crumbs. Next, spoon melted butter over cracker crumbs and sprinkle with paprika., Bake until browned.

title: Chicken Cheese Soup
directions: Cover vegetables with water and simmer until tender., Bring the bouillon cubes and 2 quarts of water to boil, being sure that the bouillon cubes are dissolved., Melt butter in another pan; add flour to butter slowly., Stir constantly., In just a few seconds, it will be thick., Then add to this mixture, stirring quickly, 1 cup of the boiling water with bouillon cubes, then add a little more, then add all of this mixture to the water mixture., Stir thoroughly., Add this mixture to the vegetable mixture., Do not drain vegetables., Add Cheez Whiz to soup and stir until dissolved. Add peas to soup., Add chicken cubes., Add bacon crumbles., Simmer for 10 minutes., You're done.

title: Stuffed Chicken
directions: Pound each chicken breast into long thin pieces., Place 1 piece of ham and cheese on each chicken breast., Fold chicken breast in half., Garlic salt each side of chicken., Place chicken in hot pan with a small amount of oil., Cook chicken until done, turning often (medium high heat; 20 minutes).

title: Applesauce Doughnuts
directions: Blend butter and sugar. Add eggs., Mix applesauce and soda and add alternately with dry ingredients to creamed mixture. Roll out and cut., Fry in deep fat (350° to 375°)., Drain., May coat with granulated sugar or powdered sugar.

title: Mexican Corn Bread
directions: Mix well and pour into a greased skillet or pan., Bake at 400° for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Coconut Pecan Pie
directions: Combine eggs, sugar, syrup, vanilla and salt in large bowl, and mix well., Combine butter and cocoa; stir into egg mixture. Add pecans and coconut, mix well., Pour into unbaked pie shell and bake at 350° about 50 minutes or until set., Yields:, 1 pie.

title: Romaine Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients together and enjoy.

title: Country Breakfast Pie
