directions: Cook sausage until done., Crumble, then drain., Mix cheese and sausage., Sprinkle into unbaked pie shell., Lightly beat eggs and combine with remaining ingredients., Pour into pie shell containing sausage mixture., Bake at 375° for 40 to 45 minutes. Cool 10 minutes on rack.

title: Shipwreck
directions: Use 2 1/2-quart dish, brown ground beef slightly., Layer potatoes, ground beef, onions, kidney beans, chili powder, salt and pepper to taste and pour tomato soup over top., Bake 1 1/2 hours in 350° oven.

title: Bread Pudding(Makes 6 Servings)
directions: Scald milk with butter., Stir in all other ingredients, except the eggs., Mix well, then add eggs last, stirring gently., Pour into greased pan., Place pan in hot water and bake about 30 minutes in 350° oven., Serve about 1 ounce butter sauce with each serving.

title: Never Fail Pie Crust
directions: Using a shortening cutter, cut margarine into flour until it is in coarse cornmeal sized granules., Add water 1 to 2 tablespoons at a time., Just enough to bind the dough together. Overlap 2 sheets of plastic wrap (14-inches long with 2-inch overlap)., Very lightly sprinkle them with flour., Put half dough on wrap., Sprinkle dough ball with flour, and put 1 more sheet of plastic wrap on top of ball., Roll thin., Remove half of plastic wrap and lay crust in pan., Do not remove top sheet until dough is shaped in pan., This way the dough doesn't stick and there isn't a mess., Makes 2 crusts.

title: Crab Quiche
directions: Melt butter., Add green onions and cook until tender, about 5 minutes., Mix eggs, cream, milk and salt., Stir in green onion mixture and remaining ingredients., Divide between 2 pie crusts and bake at 425° for 15 minutes. Then reduce heat to 325° and bake 45 to 55 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean., Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

title: Chicken Enchilada Casserole
directions: In a 2-quart casserole dish, line the bottom with the tortillas, then layer the chicken pieces, onion and the remaining liquid mixture combined with the seasoning., Cover with cheese and bake in a moderate oven for about 30 minutes.

title: Strawberry Dessert
directions: Cut butter into flour., Blend in 1/4 cup light brown sugar until smooth., Place in shallow dish and bake at 350° for 20 minutes., Stir occasionally.

title: Quickie Fruit Dip
directions: Mix together with a mixer until smooth. Serve with your choice of fruit.

title: Sweet-Sour Chicken
directions: Brown chicken wings in a single layer in shortening in electric skillet set at 300°., Remove as they brown; drain drippings., Add vinegar, sugar, pineapple juice, catsup, soy sauce, mustard and salt., Bring to a boil at 250° for 5 minutes, stirring constantly., Add chicken wings., Simmer, covered, for 5 minutes., Turn wings over and cook, uncovered, for 15 minutes more.

title: Easy Baked Beans
directions: Cook onion and bacon together in the microwave for about 2 minutes in a microwaveable dish., Add pork and beans and brown sugar., Mix together well., Place back in microwave., Cook for 10 minutes., Stir beans and cook for another 10 minutes.

title: Puppy Chow
directions: Melt peanut butter and chocolate chips., Pour over Chex in large bowl., Put powdered sugar in large grocery bag., Pour in mix and shake well.

title: Pumpkin Roll
directions: Line a 15 x 10 x 1-inch jellyroll pan with wax paper., Grease and flour., Set aside., Beat eggs in a large bowl at high speed until thick., Gradually add sugar and beat 5 additional minutes. Stir in pumpkin and lemon juice., Combine flour and next 5 ingredients., Gradually stir into pumpkin mixture., Spread batter evenly in prepared pan., Sprinkle with 1 cup pecans, gently pressing into batter., Bake at 325° for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Banana Pancakes
directions: Sift flour and combine with next 4 ingredients. Combine egg, buttermilk and margarine; add to dry mixture. Stir until smooth. Stir in banana. Use 1/4 cup batter for each pancake. Pour onto hot griddle coated with cooking spray. Turn only once when edges look done. Serve with maple syrup and strawberry preserves.

title: Crown Jewel Patties
directions: Combine first 7 ingredients., Add bread crumbs., Shape into patties and coat with corn flakes., Place on greased baking sheet and bake at 375° until brown.

title: Summer Relish For Cold Meats
directions: Mix well all ingredients and chill.

title: Heavenly Turtle Pie
directions: In medium saucepan, combine sweetened condensed milk, nuts and vanilla., Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until mixture thickens and begins to pull away from sides of pan, about 10 to 12 minutes., Spread nut mixture in bottom of baked pie shell.

title: Cheesy Baked Fish
directions: Bake fish until almost done., In the last 5 to 10 minutes of baking, lay cheese across fish, then cover with picante sauce. Return to oven., It is ready as soon as cheese melts., This is good with any mild flavored fish.

title: Strawberry Stuff
directions: This is a layer dessert., Tear cake into small pieces (about 1-inch cubes)., You want to smash up strawberries and have plenty of juice., I usually add a good cup of sugar to the strawberries while they are thawing., Spoon strawberries and juice over cake. This juice will soak into the cake, then spoon some Cool Whip over the top of the strawberries., First layer is cake, second is strawberries and third is Cool Whip., Repeat layers., Cool Whip should be on top., I usually make 6 layers., It is usually colorful in a glass dish., This is easy and tastes really good.

title: Chocolate Crinkle Cookies
directions: They seem not to firm until chilled. No extra flour., Mix oil, melted chocolate and sugar in a bowl. Beat in eggs one at a time. Add vanilla and dry ingredients and chocolate chips. Chill several hours., Roll into balls and top with powdered sugar. Bake at 350° for 8-10 minutes.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Place in casserole dish., Top with buttered stuffing mix or Ritz crackers., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Mom'S Vegetable Soup
directions: Add ingredients to a crock-pot and cook all day.

title: Pickled Okra
directions: Place 1/2 teaspoon dill seed in bottom of pint jar, approximately 4 pints., Wash okra and pack as tightly as possible in jars, being careful not to bruise., Add 1/2 teaspoon dill seed, 1 pod red and green peppers and 1 clove garlic to each jar., Bring vinegar, water and salt to a boil. Pour hot mixture over okra; seal and allow to stand 2 weeks., Serve icy cold.

title: Barbecue Hamburger
directions: Mix all ingredients., Place in a roaster and smooth it out. Cover and bake at 350° for 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

title: Mrs. Field'S Cookies(Makes 112.  Can Be Halved.)
directions: Cream together butter, sugar and brown sugar., Add eggs and vanilla., Mix together flour, oatmeal, salt, baking powder and baking soda., Mix together with other ingredients., Add chocolate chips and chocolate bar., Add chopped nuts., Bake on a greased cookie sheet at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes., Do not overbake.

title: Pecan Pie
directions: In a large bowl, stir together first 5 ingredients until well blended., Stir in nuts., Pour into pastry shell., Bake in 350° oven for 50 to 55 minutes or until knife inserted halfway between center and edge comes out clean., Cool., Serves 8.

title: Deluxe Potato Bake
directions: In a large bowl, combine eggs, bread crumbs, onion, milk, seasoned pepper and seasoned salt., Drain potatoes and stir in egg mixture., Add 1/2 of Cheddar cheese and 1/2 bacon., Spoon mixture into lightly greased 8 x 8 x 2-inch casserole., Bake, uncovered, in 350° oven for 20 minutes., Sprinkle with remaining cheese and bacon., Bake 5 minutes longer., Garnish with additional cooked bacon and parsley.

title: Hamburger Barbecue Sandwiches
directions: In a large skillet, cook beef, green pepper and onion, stirring to break up meat into small pieces., When meat is brown and vegetables are tender, pour off excess drippings., Mix vinegar, mustard, ketchup, sugar, Worcestershire and pepper; add to beef mixture., Cook over low heat for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally., Spoon onto hamburger buns., Serves 4 to 6.

title: Pecan Fingers
directions: Mix., Refrigerate 30 minutes., Shape into balls or crescent shapes, about 1/2 tablespoon in size., Bake 15 minutes. Cool. Roll in powdered sugar., Makes about 4 dozen.

title: Pear Mincemeat
directions: Grind fruit including peels of lemon and oranges., Cook in a large roaster pan in a 300° oven for 2 hours., (Cook, uncovered.) Stir every 20 minutes.

title: Miracle Whip Salad Dressing Cake
directions: Sift dry ingredients., Add salad dressing; mix well., Add vanilla and water; mix well., Pour into 8 x 12-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Lorie'S Pumpkin Whoopie Pies
directions: Mix all ingredients together until well blended., Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes., Cool and cut into small cakes.

title: Zucchini Brownies
directions: Spread on greased and floured cookie sheet., Sprinkle with 3/4 cup brown sugar and 1 cup chocolate chips., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Black And White Brownies
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Grease bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan., In large bowl, combine brownie mix, water, oil and egg., Beat 50 strokes by hand., Add 1 1/2 cups pecans, chocolate chips and coarsely chopped baking bar; mix well., Spread in greased pan., Bake at 350° for 33 to 39 minutes or until center is set., Remove from oven; immediately sprinkle with finely chopped baking bar., Let stand 2 minutes to soften; spread evenly over brownies.

title: Crab Meat Salad
directions: Mix in order., Mix well and chill for 1 hour.

title: Squash Casserole
directions: Chop squash and onion and boil together until tender., Remove from heat and drain, then stir in salt, pepper, milk, butter and egg; mix well., Crush crackers., Grate cheese, then pour into 2 layers., Start with squash, then cheese and crackers., Repeat again., Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Chocolate Pound Cake
directions: Sift dry ingredients together., Cream margarine and Crisco. Add sugar gradually., Add eggs separately., Beat well., Add dry ingredients and milk alternately., Add vanilla., Beat well., Pour into greased and floured tube pan., Bake 1 hour and 15 minutes at 325°.

title: Molasses Surprise Cookies
directions: Cream shortening, sugar and molasses., Add eggs; mix well. Sift together flour, salt, soda, ginger, nutmeg and cinnamon., Add small amount of dry ingredients and mix until blended., Stir in sour milk, nuts and chocolate chips., Mix in remaining dry ingredients., Drop from tablespoon on cookie sheet., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

title: Apple Walnut Bread
directions: Combine ingredients in order listed., Bake in a greased loaf pan for 1 hour at 350 degrees.

title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Bars
directions: Mix sugar, crumbs, peanut butter, and butter until well blended., Scrape into a 9x13 inch ungreased pan; press into an even layer., Spread melted chocolate over top., Refrigerate for 2 hours., Let stand at room temperature 15 to 20 minutes before cutting bars.

title: Pineapple Snow
directions: Mix all together and pour into an 8 x 8-inch Pyrex dish. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Casserole Supreme
directions: Brown hamburger; drain well. Add onion, chili powder, Heinz 57, tomato juice and salt and pepper to taste. Simmer 20 minutes. Combine pork and beans, ketchup, sugar and mustard; add to meat mixture. Grease a 2-quart casserole; alternate layers of meat mixture and spaghetti. Cover with enough additional tomato juice to completely cover top of casserole. Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 20 minutes.

title: Macaroni And Cheese
directions: Cook macaroni until done., Shred cheese., Crumble crackers until fine in a blender or use rolling pin., Layer macaroni, cheese and about 5 slices of margarine twice., Add milk about halfway up in bowl., Sprinkle on cracker crumbs and pepper (optional)., Bake in 350° oven until golden brown or 30 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Balls
directions: Mix first five ingredients together and form into bite size balls and chill., Melt the chocolate chips and paraffin in double boiler., Dip each piece with a toothpick and place on waxed paper to dry.

title: Potatoes Hamburger
directions: Brown hamburger, then add onion and peppers., Cook for 10 minutes, then add potatoes, sliced with skin left on., Cook until potatoes are tender., Add salt and pepper to taste.

title: Orange And Pineapple Chicken
directions: Heat oil in skillet over medium-high heat., Add chicken., Cook and stir 3 minutes. Drain., Reduce heat to medium., Stir in combined dressing, juice and sugar. Add rice and green pepper. Bring to a boil., Remove from heat. Add oranges and pineapple chunks., Let stand, covered, 5 minutes., Makes 4 servings.

title: Fruit Salad
directions: Pour peach pie filling in large bowl with lid., Drain all other fruit and add pineapple last., Stir and let stand overnight. Stir before serving., Good with any meal.

title: Twice Baked Potatoes
directions: Scrub potatoes., Bake in hot oven 45 to 60 minutes. When done, cut crisscross on top and scoop out potato; mash., Add milk, margarine and seasoning., Refill potato shells and sprinkle with grated cheese., Return to oven until cheese is melted.

title: Lane Cake
directions: Bake mix as directed on box., Let cool, split the layers once and set aside., Cook together the yolks, butter and sugar until thick; add the rest of ingredients and cook until it thickens again., Lay the first split layer on serving plate and spread the cooked ingredients over each layer., Do not put it on sides until you are finished and you know there is enough left over to do them., This cake is pretty if it doesn't have it on the sides. Also, you can place cherry halves on top of cake.

title: Cavitini
directions: Mix all ingredients, adding cooked and drained noodles and bake 25 minutes at 350°.

title: Swedish Meatballs
directions: Mix and shape into balls the size of a quarter., Bake on a foil-lined cookie sheet at 300° for 30 minutes.

title: Quick Cherry Dessert
directions: In a large mixing bowl, cream together the butter and sugar. Add the eggs., Beat until light and fluffy., Add the almond extract., Stir in the flour and baking powder., Mix until smooth. Butter a 13 x 9-inch cake pan., Turn the mixture into the pan. Spoon the pie filling into the cake in 16 spots, spacing 4 spoonfuls evenly in each directions., Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes or until golden., Filling will sink into the cake while baking.

title: Biscuits
directions: Sift the flour with baking powder and salt., Cut in shortening until mixture resembles coarse crumbs., Add water and milk all at once and mix just until dough follows fork around bowl., Preheat oven to 450°., Turn out on lightly floured surface; knead gently 1/2 minute., Roll out 1/2 inch thick and cut with biscuit cutter, glass or cup., Bake on ungreased cookie sheet for 12 to 15 minutes, just until golden brown on top., Yields, 16 medium biscuits.

title: Farmers Meal
directions: Fry hamburger and onion., Cook, peel and shred potatoes. Place hamburger, potatoes and soup in layers and bake 1 hour at 350°., Put cheese on top when nearly done.

title: Cabbage Lasagna
directions: Saute ground turkey, onion, and green pepper until meat is browned., Boil cabbage until tender., Save 2 cups liquid and drain off excess., Combine 2 cups liquid, oregano, pepper, salt, and tomato paste and simmer on low heat for 4 minutes., Add meat, onion, and pepper to mixture., In a 9x13 pan pour half of meat mixture, then add cabbage, Pour remaining meat mixture and then top with shredded mozzarella., Bake at 400 until cheese is browned, about 30-45 minutes.

title: Grecian Shrimp
directions: Saute onion, lemon juice, oregano, butter in oil., Add shrimp and cook until pink., Before serving, add feta cheese in large chunks into hot mixture., Serve hot over pasta or rice or serve cold on romaine lettuce.

title: B.B.  King'S Beale Street Blues Sauce
directions: In a large saucepan, combine ingredients., Bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low and simmer for 1 hour., Remove bay leaves. Serve warm., Refrigerate unused sauce for up to several weeks.

title: Cool Carrots
directions: Peel carrots., Cook until tender. Slice into pennies., Saute onion and pepper in small amount of oil until just tender., Add salt to cooking water., Mix oil, sugar and vinegar. Heat to dissolve sugar., Add other ingredients and pour over carrots. Cover and refrigerate at least overnight.

title: Shrimp Curry
directions: In microwave oven, simmer butter, onion and celery until soft in a 2-quart glass casserole dish., Add all other ingredients. Cook on simmer until shrimp are pink, approximately 15 minutes. Some microwaves vary.

title: Slaw
directions: Shred the cabbage, onion and pepper., Pour 1/2 cup sugar over the top., Do not stir., In a saucepan, combine the oil, vinegar, salt, celery seed and dry mustard., Bring to a boil and then pour over the cabbage, onion and green pepper., Do not stir. Refrigerate overnight., Stir before serving.

title: Vegetable Soup (Italian Style)(Very Unusual Soup)
directions: Saute onion, green pepper and garlic in olive oil., Add broth, tomatoes and rice., Simmer longer if using wild rice. Add zucchini, potato and beans., Add water as desired., Serve with grated Mozzarella or Parmesan cheese.

title: Turkey Salad Burritos(Serves 4)
directions: In medium mixing bowl, combine turkey, celery, black olives and cheese., In another bowl, whisk together salad dressing, picante sauce and salt., Pour sauce over turkey mixture., Blend well.

title: Chinese Spareribs
directions: Pour spices over meat and marinate for 15 minutes., Broil over a low flame for 10 minutes on each side., Serve hot., Makes 10 to 12 servings.

title: Cherries In The Snow
directions: Slice cake in thin pieces. Arrange 1/2 of cake pieces in bottom of a 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Beat the cream cheese and sugar. Beat in Cool Whip., Spread half of the cream cheese mixture over the cake. Layer more cake slices on top., Spread remaining cheese mixture over cake layer. Top with cherry topping., Chill.

title: Crab Stuffed Mushrooms
directions: Remove stems from mushrooms; finely chop stems., Melt 2 tablespoons butter over medium heat., Add mushroom stems and onion., Cook, stirring, until onion is limp., Remove from heat and stir in lemon juice, crab, bread crumbs, egg, dill and 1/4 cup cheese., Blend well.

title: Rhubarb Pudding
directions: Mix rhubarb and sugar together well and put into greased 13 x 9-inch pan or dish., Beat eggs and milk and pour over rhubarb. Finally, mix last three items together., Crumble and add on top. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Kidney Bean Salad
directions: Reserve 1 egg for garnish., Chop other 2 eggs; lightly toss together chopped eggs, beans, celery, relish, onions and salt to taste., Gently blend in sour cream., Cover and chill to blend flavors., Serve garnished with egg; 1 cup shredded Cheddar cheese may be added before the sour cream.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Cut up the chicken as you would for frying., Brown slightly in small amount of oil and set aside., In a 2-quart casserole dish, place a layer of sliced potatoes and then cover with a layer of peas., Arrange pieces of chicken over this., Add salt and pepper to cream and pour over the chicken., Cover and bake at 350° for 40 minutes., Remove cover and return to oven until chicken is brown. Add biscuits for topping if desired and bake 15 minutes or until chicken and/or biscuits are brown.

title: Red-Fruit Punch
directions: Mix all together in a gallon container., Finish filling with water and place in freezer., Take out morning of the day of serving.

title: Baked Corn
directions: Stir eggs., Add flour and all the other ingredients; mix well. Cook, uncovered, in a 350° oven for 45 minutes.

title: Chicken Breasts Diane
directions: Place chicken breast halves between sheets of waxed paper or plastic wrap., Pound slightly with mallet., Sprinkle with salt and black pepper., Heat 1 tablespoon each of oil and butter in large skillet., Cook chicken over high heat for 4 minutes on each side. Do not cook longer or they will be overcooked and dry., Transfer to warm serving platter.

title: Chess Pie
directions: Cream butter/oleo with the sugar., Add eggs, vanilla and vinegar., Pour into unbaked pie shell., Bake at 350° until top is nice and brown, approximately 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Easy Pork Chops
directions: Brown onion in melted oleo., Place pork chops in bottom of baking dish., Sprinkle browned onion over., Cover with mushroom soup., Bake in 350° oven for 30 minutes or until pork chops are done.

title: No Bake Cookies
directions: Mix together the first 5 ingredients and cook to a rolling boil. Boil 1 minute. Remove from heat and add the peanut butter, vanilla and oatmeal., Mix well and drop on wax paper.

title: Millionaire Salad
directions: Add lemon juice, sugar, butter and marshmallows to slightly beaten eggs., Cook until dissolved, then cool to room temperature. Add fruit and nuts., Fold in whipped cream., Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan and freeze overnight., Remove from freezer 1/2 hour before serving.

title: Poppy Seed Bread
directions: Grease and flour pans, 5 mini or 2 large loaf pans., Toast coconut in shallow baking pan in 350° oven for 7 to 12 minutes or until lightly browned, stirring frequently., Set aside., Mix together cake mix, pudding, water, eggs and oil., Mix for 1 minute., Add poppy seed and coconut., Pour into pans., Bake in 350° oven., Five mini loaf pans, bake about 30 minutes., Two large loaf pans, bake about 45 to 60 minutes., Done when knife comes out clean.

title: Baked Ham
directions: Stud ham with cloves., In a blender, combine the next four ingredients and pour over ham., Bake 1 hour at 350°, reduce heat to 300° and bake for 2 hours., As the pan juice cooks down, add ginger ale., Baste ham every 15 minutes, adding ginger ale as needed.

title: Frozen Fruit Salad
directions: Make paste of flour, sugar, salt and juice., Add butter., Cook until thick., Add egg., Cool., Add juice of 1/2 lemon., Chop pineapple, oranges, marshmallows, cherries and nuts., Add cooked dressing and whipping cream., Fold all together., Freeze.

title: Seven Can Casserole
directions: Mix together all ingredients., Bake for 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Tuna Pie
directions: Cook onion and celery in butter for 10 minutes., Add flour; stir until smooth., Add soup, salt and pepper; cook until thick, stirring constantly., Take off heat; stir in drained tuna., Chop eggs; stir in., Pour into small greased casserole; top with buttered crumbs., Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.

title: Texas Straw Hats
directions: Brown ground beef in one skillet and drain., Meanwhile, saute onions, pepper and celery in 3 tablespoons cooking oil just until onions are clear and celery is still crisp., Combine browned beef with sauteed veggies in a large pot., Add remaining ingredients and simmer 20 minutes., Serve over Fritos and top with grated cheese., Serves 6 + as main dish or many more when used as a "Dip" for holiday parties!, Learned this one when I was a girl scout.

title: Banana Split Cake
directions: Combine 1 cup oleo, powdered sugar and eggs. Beat with electric mixer for 15 minutes. While this is mixing, combine 1/2 cup oleo and the graham cracker crumbs. Pat this mixture real firm into a 9 x 13-inch pan., Spread the filling on top. Slice the bananas over the top of this., Sprinkle the pineapple over this. Top with Cool Whip., Garnish with nuts and cherries. Refrigerate 3 hours. Cut in squares and serve.

title: Chicken And Rice Casserole
directions: Place chicken in deep dish., Add all the other ingredients over chicken., Cook at 350° for 1 hour, covered., Remove cover and bake 1/2 hour or until brown and chicken is done.

title: New Potato Salad
directions: Wash potatoes; leave the peeling on., Slice potatoes in about 1/8-inch pieces., Cook in boiling water until done., Drain water and pour potatoes into bowl., Chop bacon and onion and put in bowl with potatoes., Pour Ranch dressing over mixture and toss., Salt and pepper to taste.

title: Tuna Cheese Souffle Sandwich
directions: Place 4 slices bread in greased 8-inch pan., Combine all ingredients, except soup and eggs., Spread evenly over bread in pan., Blend together soup and eggs, pour over sandwiches., Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes or until set and lightly browned.

title: Pumpkin Bread
directions: Stir together sugar and oil., Beat in eggs and pumpkin., Add and mix in dry ingredients., Pour into a greased bread pan., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Healthy Oven-Fry Chicken (Tenders Or Breast)
directions: Coat chicken lightly with melted margarine and dredge in seasoned dry bread crumbs., Place in an ungreased shallow baking pan., Oven fry at 425° for 5 to 9 minutes on each side until golden brown and cooked through., For crisper chicken, coat pan with 1 tablespoon melted margarine or vegetable oil and preheat oven for 5 minutes before adding chicken.

title: Cookies
directions: You first put some sugar in, then flour and beat 'em., Then you put in a last thing is to cook it., Then you eat it.

title: Cheese Ball
directions: Whip up cream cheese with fork until creamy., Put in all ingredients except 1 cup pecans., Mix and form in ball and roll in remaining pecans., Wrap in aluminum foil and let set overnight (so flavors will not be so strong)., Serve with Ritz crackers.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Place chicken in bottom of casserole dish., Slice eggs over. Dilute soup with 1/2 can chicken broth., Pour over above., Spread dressing mix over this., Pour 1 1/2 cups broth over dressing mix. Put pats of butter on top and sprinkle with black pepper., Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Cold Taco Dip
directions: Blend cream cheese with sour cream (with electric mixer)., Add taco seasoning and mix., Pour in dish., Drain salsa sauce well and sprinkle over mixture., Place shredded lettuce on top, then fresh tomato and then shredded cheese., Serve cold with taco chips. Serves 10.

title: Weight Watchers Breakfast Muffins
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Spoon into muffin pan sprayed with Pam., Bake 20 minutes at 350°., Makes 6 muffins.

title: Monkey Bread
directions: Cut biscuits into quarters and roll in butter., Roll in cinnamon and sugar mixture., Arrange in loaf pan., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

title: Zucchini Drop Cookies
directions: Cream sugar and butter together., Add eggs and zucchini., Add flour, soda, baking powder and cinnamon, sifted together., Add zucchini mixture, blending well., Add nuts and raisins., Drop by teaspoonfuls on cookie sheet and bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Meat Loaf
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Combine all ingredients, except ground beef., Mix well., Add ground beef; mix lightly but thoroughly. Place in loaf pan and bake 1 hour., Let stand 5 minutes before slicing.

title: Sweet Potato Pie
directions: Peel potatoes and slice., Boil in salted water until tender. Drain potatoes., Mash thoroughly and add eggs., Mix well., Add sugar and butter and milk and flavoring., Mix well., Pour into unbaked pie crust and bake on 350° until done., This mixture will be soupy.

title: German Chocolate Cheesecake
directions: For crust, mix cake mix, coconut, butter and 1 egg until crumbly., Press into ungreased 9x13 inch pan.

title: Salmon Croquettes
directions: Combine all ingredients., Shape into patties., Bake at 450° for 1 hour., Serves 8 to 10.

title: Open Face Tuna Sandwiches
directions: Layer first 4 ingredients in order (tuna on toast, with the onion over tuna and the eggs over onion)., Mix the soup, milk, parsley and lemon juice together., Pour over sandwiches and broil 5 to 10 minutes., Makes 4 sandwiches.

title: Eggplant Casserole(Wonderful!)
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Cover peeled and diced eggplant with water; add 1 teaspoon salt and simmer over low heat until tender, 10 to 15 minutes., Drain and set aside to cool., Combine eggplant with remaining ingredients and mix., Pour into square or round baking dish sprayed with nonstick cooking spray and bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes., Recipe makes 6 servings., Ultra low-fat.

title: Barbecue Kielbasa
directions: In large skillet, saute onion in butter until tender. Stir in remaining ingredients. Bring to boil. Reduce heat; simmer, uncovered, for 3 minutes or until sauce is slightly thickened, stirring occasionally. Yields 4 servings.

title: Browned Rice No. 2
directions: Cut up, onion, and, celery., Brown in butter., Add rice and brown., Place in casserole; add salt, pepper, consomme and water. Cover and bake for 1 hour at 350°.

title: Red Lobster Cheese Biscuits
directions: Mix the first 3 ingredients to a soft dough. Drop by teaspoon on greased baking sheet. Bake 10 minutes at 450°., Melt the last 3 ingredients. Brush mixture over biscuits immediately out of the oven!

title: Chicken-Fried Steak
directions: Pound steak 1/4-inch thick; cut into serving pieces., Blend egg and milk., Dip meat in egg mixture, then in crumbs., Slowly brown meat in hot oil, turning once., Cover; cook on low heat for 45 to 60 minutes, until tender., Season to taste., Serves 6.

title: Whipped Cream Icing
directions: Beat margarine and Crisco until creamy., Add sugar gradually; beat well., Add milk slowly, beating until light and fluffy.

title: Rhubarb Preserves With Jello
directions: Cook rhubarb until done., Add sugar and Sweet*10., Boil for 5 minutes., Pour this mixture over jello., Stir until jello is dissolved., Cool., Put in jars., Enjoy the preserves!

title: Three Layer Strawberry Jello Salad
directions: Mix and spread in 9 x 13-inch greased baking dish., Bake in 350° oven 7 minutes; cool.

title: Moo-Moo Good
directions: Brown meat with onions., Add tomatoes, beans and rice., Pour into casserole dish., Top with crushed Fritos and grated cheese. Bake in 350° oven until cheese is melted and bubbly.

title: Salmon Loaf
directions: Put milk, onion, lemon juice, Tabasco, celery salt, garlic salt, salt, pepper, and egg in a bowl. Add salmon that has been boned and dark skin removed. Flake with a fork. Add oleo and crumbs. If dry, add salmon juice. Pour into a buttered casserole dish and bake uncovered at 350 degrees for 45 minutes. Serves 4-6.

title: Velvet Salad
directions: Mix dry Jell-o, pineapple and sour cream. Mix cool whip, nuts, and marshmallows. Combine Jell-o mixture with cool, whip mixture. Chill in mold or bowl for at least 2 hours before serving.

title: Stir-Fry Chicken
directions: Stir-fry chicken in oil for 4 minutes., Combine chicken and vegetables; stir-fry 4 to 5 minutes., Add 1/2 cup mayonnaise and soy sauce to taste.

title: Chicken-Rice Casserole
directions: Mix, together rice, chicken, broccoli, cream of chicken soup, water,, salt,, pepper, and poultry seasoning., Top this with dabs of butter.	Sprinkle cracker crumbs on top., Drizzle melted butter over, the	crumbs., Bake, at, 350° until top is brown.

title: Mexican Hero
directions: Toast Chex crumbs in a 300° oven for 10 minutes; set aside. Combine egg, seasoned salt and taco sauce., Stir in ground beef and Chex., Shape into 4 oval patties to fit bread loaf., Broil or grill for 10 to 12 minutes, or until done., Turn midway., Place, end to end, on split French bread., Spoon on additional taco sauce., Top with tomato, lettuce and cheese., To serve, place top on loaf and slice crosswise.

title: Sweet And Sour Mustard
directions: Mix mustard and peppers with enough water to make a smooth paste., Add sugars and vinegar., Bring to a boil, stirring continuously., Add butter and stir until melted., Add a little of the hot mixture to the eggs; mix well. Pour this into hot mixture in pan., Continue to stir., Bring to a boil again over medium heat., Pour into jar., Cool and refrigerate. This is guaranteed to open your sinuses!!!

title: Reuben Sandwich
directions: Brush one side of one slice bread with melted butter., Spread Russian dressing on other side of bread slice., Place corned beef on dressing, put sauerkraut on top of corned beef and then the cheese on top of that., Cover with other bread slice., In a skillet, melt remaining 2 tablespoons butter; place sandwich in skillet and cook until browned and cheese is melted., Serves 1.

title: Uncooked Relish
directions: Put each vegetable through food chopper, using coarse blade. If vegetables are covered with liquid, drain off and discard liquid., Measure each vegetable after chopping.

title: Meat Loaf
directions: Combine all ingredients thoroughly and pack firmly into a loaf pan., Bake in, moderate, oven, (350°), for 1 hour., Let stand 5 minutes before slicing., Makes 8 servings.

title: Pumpkin Bread
directions: Beat eggs gently with sugar., Add oil, water and pumpkin., Add flour, soda, salt, cinnamon, dates and nuts., Bake at 350° for 1 hour in 2 loaf pans.

title: Slaw Salad
directions: Mix first four ingredients together., Set aside., Mix the rest of the ingredients together in saucepan., Bring to a boil., Pour over cabbage immediately; mix well., Refrigerate at least 4 hours before serving.

title: Acorn Squash
directions: Bake squash in oven or microwave until nearly tender. Saute apple and celery in butter for 5 minutes. Stir in crumbs and salt and pepper. Fill squash with mixture and top with cheese. Bake 15 minutes longer until tender. Serves 2.

title: Philadelphia Relish
directions: Let stand at least an hour before serving., Yield: 2 1/2 cups.

title: Hominy Casserole
directions: Mix soup, butter and Cheez Whiz in saucepan until melted and smooth., Add hominy and onion., Put crushed Fritos on top and bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: No Ball Sugar Cookies
directions: With mixer, mix sugars, oleo and oil, then beat in eggs and vanilla., Sift together the flour, baking soda and cream of tartar., Add them to mixture., Cover and place in refrigerator for several hours or overnight., Form into small balls and roll in sugar., Flatten with fork., Bake at 350° for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Mexican Cornbread
directions: Mix first 8 ingredients in large bowl., Add remaining ingredients., Pour in hot pan., Bake at 350° for 1 hour in a 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Reese'S Cup Candy
directions: Melt oleo., Add powdered sugar and creamy peanut butter; mix well., To this mixture, add graham cracker crumbs., Mix well and press into a 9 x 13-inch buttered pan., Melt chocolate chips and spread over top.

title: Snicker Cookies
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Chill overnight., Roll into balls the size of a quarter and bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Barbecue Cups
directions: Place sausage in iron skillet and bake at 500° until done.

title: Macaroni And Cheese Bake
directions: Cook box of macaroni., Combine soup and milk in a saucepan. Heat thoroughly but do not boil., Grease bottom and sides of a deep Corningware dish., Layer with cooked macaroni., Cut tomatoes in small pieces and layer; then add a layer of soup mixture and finally a layer of grated cheese., Continue layers, ending with a layer of grated cheese., Bake at 350° until bubbly around edges. This is great reheated in the microwave!

title: Banana Split Salad
directions: Drain pineapple reserving 1/2 cup of juice., Set aside.

title: Mexican Fruit Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Bake at 350° for 40 minutes. Frost with cream cheese frosting.

title: Wild Plum Jelly
directions: In a large kettle, simmer plums and water until tender, about 30 minutes., Pour through a damp jelly bag, allowing juice to drip into a bowl., Measure 5 1/2 cups of juice; return to the kettle. Add pectin; stir and bring to a boil., Add sugar; bring to a full rolling boil., Boil for 1 minute, stirring constantly., Remove from heat., Skim off any foam., Pour hot into hot jars, leaving 1/4-inch headspace., Adjust caps., Process for 5 minutes in a boiling water bath., Yield: about 8 half pints.

title: Maque Choux
directions: Saute onion for a few minutes in olive oil and butter, then add bell pepper., A couple of minutes later, add corn, stirring all the while., This mixture should just be about done, then add diced tomatoes., Cook about 2 more minutes, then season with salt, pepper and sugar., Makes 6 servings.

title: Wiener And Potato Casserole
directions: Melt butter and mix in next 4 ingredients., Add both milks. Bring to boil and boil for 1 minute or until thick., Stir in Parmesan cheese and parsley flakes., Boil potatoes and cut in cubes; place in casserole dish., Cut up wieners and add to potatoes; mix in sauce., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Apple Brownies
directions: Cream together oleo, Crisco, sugar and eggs., Sift together and add flour, baking powder, salt and cinnamon., Add apples and nuts., Bake in ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan for 45 minutes at 350°. Sprinkle top with a little sugar and cinnamon.

title: Sloppy Joes
directions: Melt shortening in skillet; add beef, onion, salt, pepper and flour., Cook until meat loses its red color, stirring occasionally., Drain off excess fat., Stir in water, Worcestershire sauce and ketchup; simmer, stirring occasionally, for 15 to 20 minutes or until of desired consistency., Serve in buns., Makes 8 sandwiches.

title: Cheese Cookies
directions: Blend softened margarine and grated cheese. Add flour, salt and cayenne pepper. Knead dough, finally adding Rice Krispies. Roll in small balls, then flatten with hand on cookie sheet. Bake at 350° until done, approximately 10 to 12 minutes, depending on the oven.

title: Rob'S Fried Zucchini
directions: Combine egg, milk, flour, salt and garlic salt in bowl; mix well to form batter., Dip each zucchini round into batter; fry in deep fat., Batter zucchini when ready to fry so each piece is coated., Fry until crisp and golden brown., Drain on paper towels., Serve hot., Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: No Bake Peanut Cookies
directions: Cook hard the sugar, milk and margarine for 1 1/2 minutes. Add the oats and peanut butter., Stir thoroughly and drop by teaspoons onto wax paper.

title: Freezer Slaw
directions: Mix cabbage, peppers, carrots and salt., Let stand 1 hour. Boil sugar, vinegar and celery seed for 3 minutes., Let cool. Pour over cabbage mixture., Pur into containers and freeze., To serve, simply thaw.

title: Fruit Cocktail Salad
directions: Mix cottage cheese and Cool Whip, then add fruit cocktail and jello., Let set for 2 hours before serving., Keeps in refrigerator for 2 weeks.

title: Spinach Salad
directions: Place all ingredients in blender except for oil and poppy seed., Process for 15 seconds in blender., Then add oil and seed. Mix well., Serve with salad of spinach, mushrooms, bean sprouts, mandarin orange, small red onion, fresh strawberries and sunflower seeds.

title: Aloha Cake
directions: Follow directions on mixing from the back of cake box., Use the pineapple juice in place of water., If pineapple juice is not enough just add water for the right amount required., Cook cake by using directions from cake box., Mix cream cheese, vanilla pudding and milk (that's required on pudding box)., Add sugar to taste. Next, spread whip topping., Then place cherries for the finishing touch., Add pecans if desired., Keep refrigerated until served.

title: Mostaccioli And Sausage Bake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Brown sausage; drain., In 2-quart baking dish, combine sausage, sauce, noodles and 1/2 of Mozzarella cheese., Mix well., Top with remaining cheese., Bake 25 minutes or until heated through., Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Banana Split Cake
directions: Mix first 3 ingredients and line cake pan with mixture., Beat egg whites, butter and powdered sugar for 10 minutes and spread over cracker mixture., Add pineapple, slice bananas long ways and place over pineapple., Top with whipped cream, nuts and maraschino cherries.

title: Erin'S Heavenly Salad
directions: Drain all fruit., Stir in sour cream thoroughly., Add marshmallows., Garnish with maraschino cherries.

title: White Chocolate Candy
directions: Melt, the chocolate and peanut butter. Add all ingredients and mix, well., Drop by teaspoon on wax paper., Let cool and place in a tin., Keeps well.

title: Coconut-Cranberry Chews
directions: Beat the butter, sugar, orange peel, and vanilla until smooth. Beat in the egg. Mix in the flour, baking powder, and salt. Mix until dough comes together. Mix in the cranberries and coconut. Shape into balls and place on a greased baking sheet. Bake at 350 for 10-15 minutes. Let cookies cool... and then enjoy!

title: Lo-Cal Summer Dip
directions: Combine ingredients., Cover and refrigerate 6 hours., Serve with assorted fresh vegetables., Yield: 2 1/4 cups.

title: Easy Chicken Breasts
directions: Combine all ingredients except chicken. Stir well. Pour over chicken., Bake 1 hour at 350°., Good with rice or mashed potatoes. Makes lots of gravy.

title: Cranberry Cherry Pie
directions: Let pie crust stand out of refrigerator for 1 hour.

title: Sugar Cookies
directions: Cream butter and sugars., Add egg and blend., Add remaining ingredients; mix well., Drop rounded teaspoonfuls of dough, about 1 inch apart, on cookie sheet., Bake for 8 to 10 minutes, until very light brown, at 350°., Makes 3 dozen.

title: Our Lord'S Old Scripture Cake
directions: Beat on low speed until pecky and fluffy.

title: Whiskey Balls
directions: Crush vanilla wafers in blender, also nuts and coconut., Mix all together, form in balls and roll in powdered sugar.

title: Venison Lasagna
directions: Cook noodles in salted water., Brown meat and onion in oil. Drain., Add oregano and sauce to meat., Simmer for 15 minutes. Layer noodles, cottage cheese, meat sauce and Mozzarella cheese in pan., Repeat., Bake at 375° for 30 minutes.

title: Slaw
directions: Mix vegetables., Combine remaining ingredients and bring to a boil., Simmer until well blended, then cool., Pour over vegetables., It will stay crisp for several days.

title: Super Macaroni Salad
directions: Cook macaroni., Drain and cool., Mix all ingredients and chill at least 4 hours., (Can use yellow or red bell peppers., Some of each looks pretty.)

title: Champagne Strawberries
directions: Combine strawberries and sugar in bowl., Stir in white wine. Chill several hours., Spoon sauce and strawberries into four 6 ounce goblets., Pour champagne over each.

title: Rhubarb Bread
directions: Combine all ingredients in order given., Mix thoroughly until moist. Pour into two greased bread pans., Combine 1/2 cup sugar and 1 tablespoon of butter., Mix until crumbly and sprinkle on top., Bake at 350° for about 1 1/2 hours.

title: Overnight Fruit Salad
directions: Combine fruit., Add marshmallows and mix well., Chill slightly and mix again., Fold in whipped topping and chill overnight.

title: Caramel Apple Slices(Microwave)
directions: Melt caramels with water in microwave bowl, stirring occasionally., When ready, spoon over apple slices.

title: Chess Squares
directions: Mix cake mix with 1 egg and butter., Spread into a 9 x 13-inch greased pan., Combine remaining eggs, sugar and cream cheese together, mixing well., Pour over cake mixture., Bake at 350° for 55 minutes., Cool and cut into squares.

title: Cheesy Chicken Soup
directions: Boil chicken until tender., Use water from chicken for soup. Shred the chicken, add other ingredients and enough water to cover everything good., Cook until potatoes are tender.

title: Flan
directions: Blend eggs and milk for 2 minutes., Heat sugar in pan over very low heat until caramelized., Immediately put caramel into large container, add remaining ingredients on top of caramel. Cover container and place into a larger pan filled with water. Heat over medium-low heat until ready.

title: French Onion Bread
directions: Soften yeast in the warm water., In a large bowl, combine shortening and hot water., Add the sugar, salt and soup mix and stir well., Add yeast mixture., Gradually add the flour to make a stiff dough., Knead on a floured board until smooth and elastic. Let rise in a warm place until double in bulk., Punch down and let rise again 1/2 hour., Shape in 2 loaves; it makes nice round ones in 8-inch cake pans., Let rise until light and bake 35 to 40 minutes at 375°.

title: Tater Tot Casserole
directions: Brown beef and drain., Place in greased 9 x 13-inch dish., In layers on top of hamburger, put cheese, chopped chilies and onion. Pour on cream of mushroom soup and put on Tater Tots in rows. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Egg Casserole
directions: Mix ingredients together and store in an airtight container for up to 6 months.

title: Tuna Goulash
directions: Mix in baking dish and pour 1 can mushroom soup over top. Bake 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Mrs. Ruth'S Cake
directions: Dissolve cocoa in 1 cup hot water., Mix well., Bake in greased and floured pan at 350°.

title: Mexican Spaghetti
directions: Cook spaghetti according to package directions; drain., Fry hamburger and drain., Mix together hamburger, sauce, chilies, onion, salt and pepper., Simmer 15 minutes., Combine spaghetti and sauce; mix well., Layer two 9 x 13-inch baking dishes with half the spaghetti; top with half of the cheese and cover with remaining spaghetti and cheese., Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes., (Half recipe fills one 9 x 13-inch pan.)

title: Wacky Cake
directions: Add all dry ingredients into sifter., Sift right into ungreased 9 x 9-inch pan., Make 2 small "holes" in pan., In one hole, add oil, the second hole, vinegar, then pour cold water over everything., Mix with fork until flour is wet., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Speedy Chili
directions: Melt fat; add hamburg, onion and pepper., Cook until meat is lightly browned., Add tomato sauce; simmer for 5 minutes., Add kidney beans, chili and salt., Simmer.

title: Peppermint Kisses
directions: Beat egg whites until stiff enough to hold in points., Add 8 tablespoons of sugar gradually and beat until fluffy., Fold in remaining sugar, salt, candy and chocolate bits., Cover cookie sheet with unglazed paper and drop mixture by spoonfuls onto sheet. Bake at 275° for 30 to 35 minutes, until delicately browned, firm and dry., Remove from paper immediatley., Kisses should be used within one week after baking, unless frozen., Makes 2 1/2 dozen.

title: Cranberry Salad
directions: Mix sugar and cranberries together and let stand overnight or several hours., Add gelatin to boiling water., Stir until dissolved., Add other ingredients and chill., Use the pineapple juice and less water if desired.

title: Beef N' Bean Pie
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Mix ground beef, half of the dry bread crumbs, 1/4 cup cream of mushroom soup, egg, thyme leaves, salt and pepper., Press mixture evenly against bottom and sides of an ungreased 9-inch pie pan., Cover meat mixture with the French-style green beans., Spread remaining cream of mushroom soup over the green beans., Bake uncovered for approximately 35 minutes., Serves 6.

title: Kentucky Biscuits
directions: Mix flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt and sugar in mixing bowl., Cut in butter or margarine with pastry blender until mixture resemble coarse crumbs., Add buttermilk., Mix quickly to make a soft dough., Turn out onto lightly floured surface., Knead a few times to make a soft dough; don't overknead or the biscuits will turn hard and dry., Roll out to a 6 x 6-inch square., Place on ungreased baking sheet., With knife, cut dough into 12 even portions; do not separate., Bake at 400° about 15 minutes., Dust with flour and melted butter.

title: One Rise Monkey Bread
directions: Grease a 12-cup fluted tube pan or 10-inch tube pan., In a large bowl, blend 1 1/2 cup flour, sugar, salt, yeast, water, margarine and egg at low speed until moistened., Beat for 3 minutes at medium speed., Stir in remaining flour by hand., Knead dough on floured surface until smooth about 1 minute., Press and roll dough to 15 x 2-inch rectangle., Using sharp knife, cut dough into diamond shaped pieces by cutting into 2-inch strips diagonally across dough., In shallow pan melt the 1/3 cup margarine, dip each piece of dough in melted butter and place in prepared pan, making layers., Sprinkle each with poppy seed., Cover., Let raise in a warm place until light and double in size (45 to 60 minutes)., Heat oven at 375°., Bake 20 to 25 minutes, deep brown., Butter top while still warm.

title: Jello Plum Pudding
directions: Dissolve gelatin dessert mix in boiling water., Stir in cold water and spices., Chill until very thick., Fold in the remaining ingredients and chill until firm., Good with hard sauce or whipped cream.

title: Butter Fingers
directions: Sift about 1/2 box confectioners sugar; measure out 4 tablespoons sugar., Cream butter and sugar; add flour and pecans. Make out in finger size rolls., Cook in slow oven, about 250° or 300°, until brown., Roll on remainder of sugar.

title: Hero Hamburgers
directions: Combine beef and 1/4 of barbecue sauce, eggs and salt., Mix lightly and divide into 16 portions., Gently shape into thin round patties., Place 1 teaspoon each:, barbecue sauce, cheese, relish and onions on 8 of the patties., Top them with remaining 8 patties., Press edges together; broil or fry 4 minutes on one side, turn, baste with remaining barbecue sauce and cook 4 minutes longer or until meat is done., Serve on buns., Makes 8 servings.

title: Dad'S Own Barbecue Sauce
directions: Saute onion in oil on medium high in a medium saucepan until soft (about 5 minutes). Add the garlic and saute for a minute more., Transfer the onions and garlic to a medium bowl., Add the ketchup, mustard, honey, Worcestershire sauce, vinegar, molasses, cinnamon, salt and cayenne pepper and mix well., Pour over or brush on meat during last 3 or 4 minutes of barbecuing., The sauce is best for chicken, ribs or pork chops., If you don't like this, you don't like barbecue.

title: Butterscotch Pie
directions: Mix egg, yolks	with, milk., Mix, cornstarch with brown sugar and, add, egg, and	milk, mixture, gradually., Add salt. Cook, stirring, constantly, until, thickened., Add butter and vanilla. Beat egg whites until they form soft peaks., Add 1/2 cup sugar and, beat until stiff peaks., Pour filling in baked pie shell. Top, with, meringue and bake at 400° until browned on top.	Cool and chill.

title: Frozen Berry-Melon Pops
directions: Combine all ingredients in a blender. Cover and blend until smooth. Press fruit mixture through a fine mesh strainer over a bowl to extract juices. Discard solids. Pour mixture into 3-ounce paper or plastic drink cups or pop molds. Cover with foil. Cut a slit in the foil and insert wooden sticks. Freeze several hours until pops are firm.

title: Spicy Chicken With Olives
directions: Preheat oven to 400°F., Crush garlic under flat blade of chef's knife; remove and discard peels., Set aside.

title: Whipped Cream Frosting
directions: Cook the first 3 ingredients until thick., Cool completely. Do not work with it if it is warm., Add oleo and shortening., Beat until creamy and frost.

title: Ham Rolls
directions: Mix the first 4 ingredients., Slice each tray of rolls through the middle., Spread sauce on both halves of each tray., Place ham on bottom halves., Top with remaining halves., Cover trays with foil., Bake at 350° to 400° for 10 to 15 minutes., Best served hot.

title: Hot Fudge Cake
directions: In a medium bowl, combine flour, white sugar, 2 tablespoons cocoa, baking powder and salt., Stir in the milk, oil and vanilla until smooth., Spread in an ungreased 9 x 9 square baking pan. Combine brown sugar and remaining cocoa., Sprinkle over batter. Pour hot water over all., DO NOT STIR., Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes., Serve warm., Top with whipped cream or ice cream if desired.

title: Osceola Cheese Dip
directions: Mix all but garnish and then top around edges or center of spread with them., Bake at 350° until bubbly, about 30 minutes, but check off and on., Serve with favorite cracker.

title: Holiday Ham And Chili Cheese Ball
directions: In a small bowl, combine cheeses, deviled ham, scallions and chilies; mix well., Shape mixture into a ball., Roll in chopped nuts., Wrap in plastic wrap; chill., Remove from refrigerator to soften slightly before serving., Serve with your favorite crackers. Makes 1 (2-cup) cheese ball.

title: Snow Caps
directions: Split hot dogs lengthwise., Place in shallow pan., Combine onions and potatoes., Put on top of hot dogs., Sprinkle cheese on top., Bake 20 to 25 minutes at 400°., Serves four.

title: Pizza Spaghetti
directions: Cook spaghetti and drain., Mix in 9 x 13-inch greased pan with egg, 1 cup cheese, milk and garlic salt., Pour spaghetti sauce over spaghetti., Add 3 cups cheese and arrange pepperoni on top. Bake in oven at 375° for 30 minutes., Cool 5 minutes before serving.

title: Old Fashioned Apple Cake
directions: Combine all ingredients., Stir until mixed well., Pour into a 9 x 13-inch greased pan., Bake 1 hour at 325°.

title: Mushroom Scalloped Potatoes
directions: Combine soup, 1/2 cup cheese, pepper, salt, mushrooms and onion in a bowl., Gradually add milk., Stir in potatoes., Place in a greased shallow 1 1/2-quart baking dish. Top with remaining cheese and butter., Bake at 350° for about 1 hour. Serves 6.

title: Cinnamon Bars
directions: Cream butter in a large mixing bowl. Add sugar, beating until light and fluffy. Add egg yolk, flour and cinnamon; mix until well blended. Press mixture into an ungreased 15 x 10 x 1-inch pan. Pour egg white over surface; drain off excess. Sprinkle chopped pecans over top. Press lightly into dough. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes. Cut into 3 x 1-inch bars; cool on wire racks. Yield: about 4 dozen.

title: Vanilla Sauce
directions: *Brandy, rum or sherry to taste may be used in place of vanilla.

title: Tomato Gravy
directions: Heat tomato juice and sugar almost to a boil., Dissolve flour in milk; mix to a thin paste and add to tomato juice., Stir until smooth and thick, cooking thoroughly.

title: Sugar Cream Pie
directions: Mix flour and sugar., Add water., Stir until shiny., Add milk. Mix well., Pour in deep pie shell., Dot with butter, cinnamon and nutmeg.

title: Impossible Cheeseburger Pie
directions: Heat oven to 400°., Grease a 10-inch pie plate and set aside.

title: Crab Dip
directions: Mix all ingredients except crab meat with mixer, then add crab meat and mix with a spoon., Bake at 325° for 30 minutes in Pam sprayed pan., Sprinkle extra cheese on top and return to oven to melt.

title: Cherry Something
directions: Prepare pudding mix according to package directions., Mix with Cool Whip and nuts., You can use a serving dish or individual dishes., Place angel food cake on the bottom of dish., Put pudding mixture on top of cake., Pour cherry pie filling over this and refrigerate.

title: Vegetable Dip
directions: Mix well in blender., Serve as a fresh dip for vegetables.

title: Zucchini Pie
directions: Bake at 375° for 40 to 50 minutes or until golden brown., Use 8 x 8-inch greased pan.

title: Rhubarb Pudding Cake
directions: Slice rhubarb into 1-inch lengths., Arrange in a greased 8-inch square pan., Cream the shortening and 3/4 cup of sugar. Blend in bran flakes., Sift flour with baking powder and salt; add alternately with milk to shortening and sugar mixture., Spread batter over rhubarb.

title: Spaetzels(Chewy European Dumplings)
directions: Mix to a stiff smooth dough., Drop by 1/2 teaspoon into boiling water, dipping the spoon into water between each dumpling to keep dough from sticking., Boil about 5 minutes; drain., Serve with goulash and stew.

title: Hot Or Mulled Cider
directions: Heat well, but do not boil., Serve warm.

title: Smoky Salmon Dip
directions: Drain salmon; reserve 2 tablespoons salmon liquid., Flake salmon and set aside., Combine and blend cream cheese, salmon liquid, lemon juice, horseradish and liquid smoke., Fold in salmon and green onions., Refrigerate until chilled to allow flavors to meld., Makes about 3 cups.

title: Orange And Cherry Cobbler
directions: In saucepan, combine pie filling, water and lemon juice., Heat to boiling., Pour into a round cake dish., Top hot cherries with rolls, cut side up., Bake at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes or until rolls are done., Spread tops with the icing that comes in the orange roll package., Serve warm., (Also try peach filling.)

title: Macaroni Salad
directions: Cook macaroni as directed, drain and rinse with cold water. Combine macaroni and other ingredients., Mix salad dressing and pour over salad.

title: Sad Cake
directions: Beat eggs., Add brown sugar and Bisquick mix; mix well., Add vanilla, nuts and coconut; mix well., Pour into a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch loaf pan., Bake at 350° for about 30 minutes. Cake is real chewy.

title: Corn Casserole
directions: Saute onion and pepper in the oleo., In a separate bowl, mix the eggs and corn., Mix the sauteed onion and pepper with sour cream and corn bread mix., Add eggs and corn to the mixture and spread in a greased 7 x 12 inch baking dish., Cover mixture with shredded cheese and bake at 350 degrees for 40 minutes.

title: Nuts Over Pound Cake
directions: Beat butter and shortening at medium speed with an electric mixer about 2 minutes or until soft and creamy., Gradually add sugar, beating at medium speed for 5 to 7 minutes., Add eggs, one at a time, beating just until yellow disappears.

title: Fabulous Ham And Cheese Souffle
directions: Grease 9 x 13-inch glass baking dish., Spread half the bread cubes evenly in dish., Add the ham and both cheeses, then cover with remaining bread cubes., Mix eggs, milk, onion, salt and mustard., Pour evenly over bread cubes and refrigerate overnight. Combine corn flakes and butter for a topping., Bake at 375° for 40 minutes., Serves 10.

title: Pinwheel Hash Ring
directions: Combine last 4 ingredients., Unroll each crescent roll., Place triangles of dough on greased cookie sheet with large ends of each triangle in the middle, overlapping slightly, with small ends pointing outward to edges of cookie sheet., Effect will be of a large sunburst with open circle in center., Place hash mixture in ring over base of triangles., Fold points over filling and tuck under the base of the center with filling showing between slits of the ring., Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes., Can be served with scrambled eggs, stewed tomatoes or celery soup if desired.

title: No Guilt Chicken Pot Pie
directions: Preheat oven to 400°., In a 9 inch pie plate, mix chicken, vegetables and soup., Mix milk, egg and baking mix., Pour over chicken mixture., Bake 30 minutes or until golden.

title: Doughy White Bread
directions: Melt butter and allow to cool., Follow package directions to activate yeast., Sift flour, sugar and salt., Combine with egg. Add butter and milk., Add yeast last., Beat well., Return to bowl and let rise covered for one hour or until doubled., Shape into two loaves and let rise in pans., Brush with melted butter., Bake at 350° until golden brown, approximately 30 minutes.

title: Meat Loaf With Piquant Sauce
directions: Combine all ingredients and mix lightly., Press into an 8 x 4-inch loaf pan., Bake at 350° for 1 hour to 1 hour and 15 minutes., Drain., Let set for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Sugar-Free Vegetable Gelatin Salad
directions: Dissolve Jell-O in 1 cup boiling water., Add cold water., Let set until partially thickened., Add remaining ingredients. Refrigerate until firm., Serves 4.

title: Quick Pepper Steak
directions: Remove fat from meat and brown., Cut steak into bite-size pieces., Add mushrooms and gravy., Cook noodles and drain., Serve steak and gravy over noodles., Excellent with rolls and tossed salad.

title: Graham Cracker Candy
directions: Cream together margarine, sugar and Pet milk., Cook on medium heat for 3 minutes., Add marshmallows and stir until melted. Remove from heat and add crumbs, coconut and nuts., Drop on waxed paper.

title: Deviled Clams
directions: Mix all of the ingredients and let stand for bread crumbs to absorb liquid., Mixture should be moist., Fill the half clam shells., Sprinkle each with bread crumbs and dot with butter. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

title: Rhubarb Strawberry Dessert
directions: Cut rhubarb into 1-inch pieces and put into saucepan with sugar and 1/4 cup water., Cover and cook about 15 minutes.

title: Baked Alaska
directions: Make cake as directed on box., Bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Remove from pan; let completely cool., Slice cake into 4 pieces. Slice ice cream lengthwise, about the thickness of the cake layers., On one layer, place ice cream., Place another layer of cake on top., This will make two cakes., Wrap one; freeze it for use later., Beat egg whites until very stiff., Add sugar and flavoring., Spread on one cake., Bake for 3 minutes, or until brown., Have oven preheated to 500°.

title: Nutty Canadian Cheese Ball
directions: Blend cheeses with 2 tablespoons maple syrup. Shape into a ball., Brush on the remaining syrup and coat with pecans., Serve with assorted crackers.

title: Low-Fat Chicken And Rice
directions: Season chicken with garlic salt and paprika and broil., Stir 1/2 bouillon into cooked rice and place in casserole., Place chicken on top of rice and pour remaining bouillon over all., Bake for 1/2 hour in a 325° oven.

title: Angel Biscuits
directions: Dissolve yeast in water. Sift dry ingredients together., Cut in shortening until well mixed., Add buttermilk and yeast. Work into flour with large spoon. Grease a large bowl., Put in dough. Cover and refrigerate until ready to use. Roll about 1/2-inch thick on a floured surface., Let rise about 1 1/2 hours. Brush with butter., Bake at 400° for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Oatmeal-Chocolate Morsel Cookies
directions: Combine all ingredients; stir well., Drop dough by rounded teaspoonfuls 2-inches apart onto lightly greased baking sheet. Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes., Yield:, 6 dozen.

title: Custard Pie(Makes Its Own Crust)
directions: Put all ingredients in blender and blend 4 to 5 minutes., You could add raisins or nuts or coconut if you like., Pour into a greased pie plate and bake for 45 minutes or until knife comes out clean., Sprinkle nutmeg on top of pie., Enjoy!

title: Jiffy Cinnamon Rolls
directions: Soften yeast in water; mix all ingredients well., Add 2 1/2 to 3 cups flour., Mix into a soft dough., Let rise until doubled in bulk., Work one half at a time., Roll out on a floured surface. Sprinkle with a mixture of the cinnamon and sugar., Roll up from the small end., Cut into half-inch pieces and put into a greased pan., Let rise until doubled in bulk., Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes or until lightly browned., May be frosted with a drizzle of powdered sugar and milk.

title: B-B-Q
directions: Combine all ingredients and bring to boil., Add meat and simmer about 45 minutes.

title: Sugar-Free Banana Bread
directions: Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes in greased loaf pan.

title: Layered Salad
directions: In a 9 x 13-inch pan, layer the lettuce, celery, peppers, eggs, onion and peas.

title: Octopus Sauce(Salsa Di Pulpo)
directions: Wash octopus in, salted water, pounding against sink to remove any sand that, may, be, in, suction, cups on tentacles. Rinse and wash again., Remove head and discard, using only the tentacles. Rinse again, and drain., In medium saucepan, saute onion in oil until, tender, but, not, brown., Add, octopus and saute until octopus, curls, and turns pinkish-red., To octopus add the rest of the ingredients., Cook on medium-low heat for 1, hour,, stirring occasionally., Serve, with, spaghetti, or metazanne, cooked according to package directions., Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Icing For Carrot Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Spread on cake.

title: Man Sized Steak Salad
directions: Boil meat at 550° for 13 minutes per side; cool., Cut into 3/8-inch strips., Arrange in baking dish (13 1/2 x 9 x 2-inch). Place mushrooms on meat., Top with pepper rings.

title: One Bowl Buttercream Frosting
directions: In a small mixer bowl, cream the butter., Add cocoa and sugar alternately with milk., Beat to spreading consistency (additional milk may be needed)., Blend in vanilla., Makes about 2 cups of frosting.

title: Fruited Macaroni Salad
directions: In a saucepan, combine the sugar, flour and salt. Drain juice from oranges and pineapple into a 1-cup measuring cup; cover and refrigerate fruit. Add enough water to the juice, if needed, to measure 1 cup; stir into the sugar mixture until smooth. Cook and stir over medium-high heat until thickened and bubbly., Reduce heat; cook and stir 1 minute longer. Remove from heat. Stir a small amount of hot mixture into egg; return all to pan, stirring constantly. Bring to a gentle boil; cook and stir 2 minutes longer. Remove from heat. In a bowl, combine the macaroni and cooked dressing. Cover and refrigerate for 8 hours or overnight.

title: Sweet 'N Sour Pork
directions: Thinly slice pork into bite-size strips; set aside., Preheat wok or large skillet to high heat., Make sauce in a bowl by stirring together teriyaki sauce, cornstarch and seasoning package from frozen vegetables., Set aside sauce., Add oil to skillet. Stir-fry pork over heat for about 3 minutes or until it is no longer pink, then remove from skillet., Add frozen vegetables, undrained pineapple and water to skillet., Add sauce., Cook and stir over medium-high heat until thick and bubbly., Cook 2 minutes; stir in meat and cook 30 seconds., Serve over chow mein noodles.

title: Artichoke And Basil Hero
directions: In a blender or food processor, combine basil, oil, Parmesan cheese, capers, vinegar, mustard and garlic., Cover; blend until nearly smooth., Set aside., Cut bread in half lengthwise., Hollow out each half, leaving a 1-inch shell., Spread basil mixture over each half of bread., On bottom half, layer artichoke hearts, Provolone cheese, tomato and spinach., Cover with top bread., Cut sandwich crosswise into 6 to 8 pieces.

title: Broccoli-Onion Deluxe
directions: Cook broccoli and onion until tender., Put in the bottom of a 1 1/2-quart casserole dish., In saucepan, melt half of the butter. Blend in flour, salt and a dash of pepper., Add milk., Cook, stirring constantly, until thickened and bubbly., Reduce heat; blend in cream cheese until smooth., Pour over broccoli and onion. Place cheese on top and then use other half of butter; melt and toss bread crumbs in and put on top., Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
directions: In a small mixing, bowl beat the cream cheese and sugar until fluffy., Add peanut butter and beat well., Gradually beat in milk. Fold in the cool whip., Pour into pie shell., Sprinkle with peanuts., Freeze until firm., Wrap in moisture proof wrap.

title: Baked Clams
directions: Melt butter in frying pan; add clams, crabmeat and bread crumbs., Refrigerate mix, then prepare in shells (real or aluminum) and bake at 350° until lightly brown., Add bacon if desired.

title: Graham Cracker Pie Crust
directions: In a small mixing bowl, combine crumbs, sugar and butter., Mix together well and press mixture evenly in the bottom of a 9-inch pan., Bake for 10 minutes at 350°., Cool., Add filling.

title: Oatmeal Refrigerator Cookies
directions: Make in rolls or pat down in ice cube trays, lined with waxed paper., Keep in refrigerator overnight., Slice thin and bake at 400° for 10 minutes.

title: Chocolate Sheet Cake
directions: Melt cocoa in water and bring to a boil., Pour over dry ingredients., Beat eggs, add buttermilk and vanilla., Add to mixture and beat., Pour on large cookie sheet., Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: California Blend Casserole
directions: In large, glass casserole (cake pan is too big), melt margarine., Add celery and onion., Saute on low heat for 5 minutes., Remove from heat and add rice., Stir well., Add bag of vegetables and mix together.

title: Sauerkraut Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients and let stand in refrigerator overnight. Serve as side dish.

title: Biscuits
directions: Cut margarine into flour., Add buttermilk., Grease pan., Pour in batter., Butter tops of biscuits., Bake at 450° for 10 minutes.

title: Seafood Salad
directions: Place cod in pan and pour enough water and chicken broth to cover., Remove fish and bring liquid to boil., Add cod; reduce heat to low and simmer about 5 minutes or until cod is opaque and separates easily into large flakes., Remove fish from liquid and cool., Flake fish, removing skin and bones.

title: Cream Cheese Roll-Ups
directions: Cut crusts on bread., Put light coat of butter on outside. Combine softened cream cheese, sugar and softened stick of butter. Spread this mixture on each sliced, then roll up., Make a mixture of sugar and cinnamon., Sprinkle this on outside; freeze., Bake at 375° for approximately 7 minutes.

title: Pork Chops And Rice
directions: Simmer together tomatoes, mushroom soup, onion soup and water. Put rice in baking dish., Set chops on top of rice., Pour mixture over rice and chops., Cover and bake at 350° for 45 minutes and then uncover and bake for additional 15 minutes.

title: Oatmeal Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Mix oats, water and butter., Let stand for 10 minutes., Mix sugars, eggs, salt, soda, cinnamon and vanilla., Add to oats mixture., Add flour and mix well., Pour into greased and floured 13 x 9-inch pan., Bake for 45 minutes.

title: Banana Bread
directions: Mix all ingredients together., (Mash ripe bananas first.) Grease a loaf pan., Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until a toothpick comes out clean.

title: Snickerdoodles
directions: Preheat oven to 400°., In a mixing bowl, mix thoroughly the margarine, shortening, sugar and eggs., Blend in flour, cream of tartar, baking soda and salt., Shape dough into 1-inch balls and roll in sugar-cinnamon mixture., Place 2-inches apart on lightly greased cookie sheet (vegetable spray works well)., Bake 8 to 10 minutes or until set., Makes 3 to 4 dozen cookies.

title: Francis B'S Salad
directions: Marinate overnight in Wish-Bone Italian dressing. Add raw cauliflower and cherry tomatoes. Shake (toss) and serve.

title: Mandarin Orange Salad
directions: Dissolve Jell-O in the 2 cups boiling water; stir gradually into the beaten cream cheese until melted., Drain oranges, reserving their liquid., Measure and add enough cold water to equal 1 1/2 cups liquid., Mix into Jell-O mixture., Chill until slightly thickened., Beat chilled topping mix (Dream Whip) according to directions on package., Fold into Jell-O mixture along with oranges, nuts and cottage cheese., Turn into lightly oiled 9 x 13 x 2-inch salad dish or pan.

title: Caramel Corn
directions: Cook brown sugar, butter, syrup and salt for 5 minutes at slow heat., Do not boil hard., Remove from heat., Add soda, pour over popcorn and stir well., Cook in oven for 1 hour at 200°., Stir every 15 minutes.

title: Banana Smoothie
directions: *With plain yogurt, add 2 tablespoons sugar and 1 teaspoon vanilla.

title: Debbie'S Vegetable Pizza
directions: Roll out and pat into a 13 x 15-inch cookie sheet the crescent rolls., Bake at 350° for 15 minutes., Let cool., Mix mayonnaise, cream cheese, garlic salt and dill weed., Dice a few green onions and add to mayonnaise mixture., Spread over cooled crust., Chop fine green onions, cauliflower, broccoli, mushrooms, green peppers, tomatoes and black olives., Sprinkle over crust. Refrigerate.

title: Peach Cobbler
directions: Combine first 3 ingredients; mix well., Add milk; stir., Pour mixture into a lightly greased shallow 2-quart casserole., Dot with butter., Combine 3 tablespoons sugar and cinnamon; add to peaches., Spoon mixture over batter; do not stir., Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes or until browned.

title: Broiled Icing
directions: Mix all ingredients together and spread on top of 9 x 13-inch white or yellow cake while it is still warm., Place very low under broiler; broil until icing bubbles all over surface and becomes brown., Take care that it does not burn.

title: Lemony Chicken Nuggets
directions: Measure first 7 ingredients into a plastic bag; close tightly and shake to blend., Moisten chicken with lemon juice., Let stand for 30 minutes., Place chicken chunks, a few at a time, into plastic bag., Shake to coat thoroughly., Pour oil into heavy saucepan, filling no more than 1/3 full., Heat to 375°., Carefully add chicken, a few pieces at a time., Fry, turning once, about 2 minutes or until tender., Drain on paper towels.

title: Chicken Spaghetti
directions: Mix everything together and bake at 350° for about 20 minutes.

title: Chipped Beef Spread(Microwave)
directions: Mix all ingredients together. Place in shallow baking dish. Microwave 4 to 5 minutes., Turn 1/4 turn during cooking., Serve hot as spread for crackers.

title: Fillet Of Flounder Florentine
directions: Dip fish in seasoned flour, then in beaten egg to which cheese, parsley, salt and pepper have been added., Saute in oil or butter until brown., While fish is sauteing, mix garlic, wine, lemon juice and butter together and bring to boil to evaporate wine, approximately 1/2 minute., Add cooked spinach to serving dish. (Have spinach warm.), Lay fish over spinach., Pour hot mix (garlic, wine, lemon juice, butter) over fish and spinach., Garnish with lemon slices., Please, no substitutes.

title: Greek Tomato Salad
directions: Cut tomatoes to bite size., Cut olives in half., Rub bowl with garlic; add tomatoes, olives and cheese., Sprinkle with vinegar and olive oil., Add seasonings and toss., Marinate for at least 4 hours on counter., If longer, store in refrigerate until 1 to 2 hours before serving., Taste improves the longer it stands at room temperature.

title: Taco Salad
directions: Fry hamburger:, drain., Rinse with boiling water to remove all grease., Add to lettuce, tomatoes, onion and Cheddar cheese which have been mixed together well., Add kidney beans, drained and rinsed.

title: Tuna Noodle Casserole
directions: Cook the egg noodles until tender; mix in the tuna., While stirring add chopped onion and mayonnaise and add salt, then add the sweet peas and mix thoroughly., Let stand for 5 minutes and restir., It's ready to eat., This can be served hot or cold!

title: Chowder(Winning Recipe)
directions: Saute bacon until crisp; drain (saving fat)., Crumble bacon and set aside., Slowly saute onions, green pepper, celery, carrots and garlic in bacon fat until tender., Boil potatoes in salted water until cooked., Combine vegetables; add seasonings and beat in a mixer until creamy., Do not beat longer or it will become too smooth and thick.

title: Pumpkin Cookies
directions: Cream shortening, sugar and eggs. Add pumpkin; mix well. Blend in flour, salt, baking powder and spices; mix well., Drop by spoonfuls on baking sheet. Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes. Raisins and/or nuts can be added. Freezes well., One can pumpkin will make 2 batches.

title: How To Make Pickles
directions: Heat beans, do not boil., Salt and pepper to taste., Pour off juice., While hot, add ingredients., Marinate 24 hours., Serve cold.

title: Maxine'S Chicken
directions: Place, chicken flat in baking dish,, salt, and	pepper, chop onion over top., Mix soups and sherry; pour over chicken. Grate cheese and spread over top., Bake 3 hours at 325°.	Cook rice according to directions., Brown small onion, in, part, of bacon grease., Blend bouillon soup, and, Worcestershire sauce; add in rice., Add onion and bacon., Cook, the, last 30 minutes that the chicken cooks.

title: Bourbon Pecan Pie
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., Beat together eggs, sugar and butter. Beat corn syrup and bourbon well in a separate bowl., Add bourbon mixture to egg mixture; beat well., Stir in pecans., Pour mixture into a 9-inch pie shell and bake 40 to 50 minutes, until set.

title: Candied Dills
directions: Let 25 pickles (4 inch size) stand 2 weeks in salt brine (9 pt. water, 1 pt. salt). Drain & wash. Cut in chuncks or chips & put in water with Alum - size of walnut (1 heaping Tbsp.). Next morning, wash & drain & pour dressing over pickles.

title: Tortellini Soup
directions: Slice sausage and brown in oil., Add onion, carrots and spices., Cook 5 minutes., Add remaining ingredients except for tortellini., Simmer, covered for 1 hour., Add tortellini and cook until done.

title: Reuben Dip
directions: Mix all ingredients well and place in 9-inch pie pan., Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes or until cheese bubbles., Serve with rye rounds or cocktail rye bread.

title: Barbecue Shrimp
directions: To make marinade, combine all ingredients except shrimp. Marinate the shrimp for 1/2 to 3 hours., Broil or barbecue for 3 minutes each side., Garnish with parsley and lemon.

title: Nana'S Turkey Stuffing(Mrs. Catherine Wissman)
directions: Chop cleaned celery into small diced pieces; also dice the onion., Cut bacon into pieces small enough to crumble when cooked. Combine celery, onion and bacon in large frying pan., Cook over medium heat until bacon is all crisp., Drain any fat off and pat with paper towel.

title: Bread Stuffing
directions: Night before:, Dice wheat and white bread., Cook celery and onion in margarine until translucent., Add to cubed bread., Mix broth, seasoning, egg, salt, pepper together., Add to cubed bread. Add water as needed so mixture is moist., Bake at 350° uncovered for 45 minutes.

title: Broccoli Supreme
directions: Blend soup, flour, sour cream, carrots, onions, salt and pepper., Then stir in broccoli (2-quart casserole)., Moisten stuffing mix with butter/margarine, then sprinkle on top., Bake for 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Crock-Pot Beans
directions: Put everything in a big pot and cook slowly for about 3 1/2 hours.

title: Cheese Delights
directions: Mix and roll in wax paper and place in refrigerator overnight. Slice thin and place on lightly greased cookie sheet and bake at 325° for about 15 minutes.

title: Oriental Chicken Salad
directions: Mix mayo, yogurt and lemon juice., Stir with remaining ingredients., Serves 4 to 6 people.

title: Peach Cobbler
directions: Mix peaches and 1/2 cup of sugar and set aside., Set oven to 350°., Put margarine in deep baking dish and set in oven to melt. Make batter of other ingredients and pour over melted margarine; do not stir., Put sugared peaches on top of batter; do not stir., Bake until crust is light brown., Peaches will sink to bottom., Can serve ice cream on top.

title: Mull Cider
directions: Bring to boil; simmer 20 minutes., Remove spices and serve hot.

title: Bishop Bread
directions: Mix eggs and sugar., Blend in dry ingredients, then fold in nuts, dates, chips and cherries., Put in greased loaf pan., Bake at 300°, for 90 minutes., Be sure to bake long enough.

title: Easy Oven Stew
directions: Combine all ingredients in a 5-quart Dutch oven., Cover and bake at 300° for 2 1/2 to 3 hours, stirring once each hour., Makes 8 servings.

title: Tomato Soup Cake
directions: Cream sugar, butter, eggs, cinnamon, cloves and nutmeg., Stir together the flour, baking soda and salt., Add dry ingredients to creamed mixture., Add soup; mix well., Blend in raisins and nuts. Pour into greased tube pan., Bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Soup
directions: Boil chicken stock, onions and celery together for 45 to 60 minutes., Strain out onion and celery and discard., Stir in peanut butter until dissolved., Mix flour with half and half, add together with remaining ingredients, simmer all together 15 minutes., Add dash of egg shade for coloring., Garnish with 1/2 teaspoon bacon crumbs or minced country ham., Serves 8 to 10.

title: Swedish Pecan Balls
