directions: Combine all ingredients, except powdered sugar, and mix well. Shape dough into balls the size of walnuts., Place on ungreased cookie sheet and bake at 275° for about 30 minutes or until light brown., Roll in powdered sugar after they're cooled.

title: Almond Crescent Cookies(A Christmastime Favorite)
directions: Cream butter., Add sugar; beat well., Add almonds and extract. Mix in flour and salt., Chill dough for 2 hours., Roll into pencil-thin strips, 2 1/2 inches long., Place 1 inch apart on baking sheets., Curl into crescents., Bake at 325° for 15 to 20 minutes., Cool on pan., Roll in confectioners sugar.

title: Baked Pineapple Casserole
directions: Mix the pineapple with the cheese., Put in buttered baking dish., Mix together the bread crumbs, sugar, flour and melted butter., Spread on the pineapple mixture., Bake 45 minutes to 1 hour at 350°.

title: Hamburger Mess
directions: Brown hamburger and onion in skillet while potatoes are cooking., Pour hamburger and onion into saucepan., Add mushroom soup., Fill can with milk and add to mixture., Add potatoes and peas., Let simmer 20 minutes.

title: Quick Cornbread Mix
directions: Sift together dry ingredients., Cut in shortening with pastry blender or two knives to mix thoroughly., Place mix in a jar or canister and store in a dry place until ready to use., This mix will keep in a cool place for about a month.

title: Pecan Pie
directions: Heat oven to 375°., Cream butter and sugar in mixing bowl. Beat in eggs, syrup and vanilla., Stir in pecans., Pour filling into unbaked pie shell., Bake at 375° for 5 minutes., Reduce heat to 325° and bake for 45 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean., Cool to room temperature before cutting., Makes 1 (9-inch) pie.

title: Orange Pie
directions: Mix sugar and cornstarch; add butter and egg yolks, mixing well., Add milk, juice and rind., Bake in crust until set at 350°. Use the egg white for meringue., Makes 2 small pies or 1 large.

title: Fruit Cobbler
directions: Beat together sugar, milk, flour and margarine., Pour into pudding pan., Spoon fruit over batter., Bake at 350° until brown on top.

title: White Cookies - Pink Icing
directions: Cream together sugar and Crisco., Add salt and vanilla., Mix and add to buttermilk, soda, baking powder and flour (add gradually)., Cool dough in refrigerator before rolling and cutting with cookie cutter., Bake at 375° for approximately 8 minutes.

title: Cherry Crunch(Serves 8)
directions: Preheat oven to 350°. Grease 8-inch square baking pan. Mix oats, flour and sugar. Cut in butter with pastry blender or 2 knives until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Spoon half of mixture into prepared pan. Top with pie filling. Sprinkle with remaining crumbs. Bake for 40 to 45 minutes. Spoon into dessert dishes. Serve warm with sweetened whipped cream or ice cream.

title: Three Bean Casserole
directions: Cut up bacon into 1/2-inch square pieces; dice onion., Combine with ground beef and brown and then drain., Combine all ingredients except cheese in a medium size roaster., Do not drain the beans., Bake for 1 1/2 to 2 hours in a 350° oven., (Fifteen minutes before removing from the oven, sprinkle grated cheese over the top.), Good served warm or cold.

title: Spinach Salad And Dressing
directions: Beat the first 7 ingredients with mixer or in blender., This dressing tastes better if refrigerated for several hours or overnight.

title: Cocoa-Lace Cookies
directions: Spray baking sheets with no-stick cooking spray; set aside., In medium saucepan melt margarine, stir in brown sugar and corn syrup. Bring to a boil, stirring constantly, until sugar is dissolved. Remove from heat; stir in remaining ingredients until blended. Drop mixture by teaspoons 3 inches apart on prepared baking sheets. Bake 9 minutes at 350° or until cookies spread thin and are deep brown (cookies will still be soft)., Cool 2 minutes on sheets. Working quickly with spatula, remove cookies to wire rack; cool completely., Sprinkle, if desired, with confectioners sugar., Makes about 2 1/2 dozen cookies.

title: Mom'S Stuffed Olives
directions: Large green olives with pits are used for this recipe., With a small paring knife, remove the olive from the pit (pare as you would an apple in corkscrew fashion so you have one continuous piece)., Wrap olive around small ball of meat stuffing., Roll olive in flour, beaten egg and then bread crumbs (Italian seasoned or plain dry bread crumbs may be used)., Fry slowly, turning to brown all sides evenly., It's work, but they are always a hit!

title: Hot Curried Fruit
directions: Drain all the fruit., In 3-quart baking dish, place peaches and pears with hollow side up., Place apricots on top., Sprinkle this with pineapple and cherries., Combine butter, sugar and curry powder., Sprinkle over fruit., Bake at 350° for 1 hour., Baste 3 or 4 times., Cool and refrigerate at least one day., Heat before serving.

title: Ginger Syllabub
directions: Mix Advocaat and preserves well together., Fold into the cream., Gently transfer into a serving dish., Put in refrigerator for a few hours., When set, decorate with a few ginger pieces. Serves 4 to 5.

title: Hot Chocolate Mix
directions: Mix it, all together., Makes 5 quarts of dry mix., Use 4 teaspoons (heaping) per cup hot water.

title: Frost Cookies
directions: Cream shortening and sugar., Add beaten egg yolks and the sifted dry ingredients., Add vanilla., Mix well and spread the beaten butter into a baking sheet as thin as possible.

title: Chicken-In-A-Crock
directions: Dissolve bouillon in hot water. Season chicken with pepper and onion salt., Place in crock-pot., Mix soup and bouillon together. Pour over chicken., Cook on low heat, covered, for approximately 5 hours.

title: Gail'S Vegetable Pizza
directions: Make a crust with rolls by unfolding and laying them in the bottom of a cookie sheet., Bake at 350° for 5 to 7 minutes., Watch carefully!, Cool., Mix cream cheese, dressing and mayonnaise; spread on crust., Put vegetables over this layer., Sprinkle with cheese.

title: Spiced Raisin Scones
directions: Preheat oven to 375°. Spray cookie sheet. In microwave-safe bowl, combine raisins and orange juice. Cover and microwave on High power for 2 minutes. Set aside.

title: Cold Oven Pound Cake
directions: Must start in cold oven., Cream the margarine, shortening and sugar., Add 1 egg at a time, beating well., Add flour and milk alternately., Add flavoring., Add baking powder last., Bake in a large greased tube pan., Place in a cold oven., Turn oven to 350° and bake for 1 hour and 20 minutes., Cool in pan., Excellent.

title: Orange Cake
directions: Grind raisins and orange peel together and add to flour., Mix cake by the conventional method for butter cake., Bake in moderate oven., Cover with orange juice and sugar after baking., Serve with whipped cream.

title: Mexican Corn Bread
directions: Combine all ingredients and bake 30 minutes at 400°.

title: Ham Sandwich Spread
directions: In medium bowl, combine all ingredients., Mix well., Cover and refrigerate., Yields 2 cups.

title: Danish Fudge
directions: Melt butter in a 3-quart saucepan. Add brown sugar and Pet milk. Stir to blend., Bring to a boil., Boil exactly 3 minutes. Remove from heat and let cool 2 minutes.

title: Taco Soup
directions: Brown hamburger, pepper and onion; drain., Mix remaining ingredients and add to hamburger mixture., Grate cheese on top. Serves well with corn bread.

title: Marinated Shrimp
directions: Marinate shrimp in Italian dressing several hours., Saute shrimp in the dressing with garlic and onion powders and dash of oregano (only long enough to cook the shrimp)., Cook pasta according to package directions., Serve shrimp over noodles. Serves 4.

title: Spiced Tea
directions: Mix all ingredients well. Store in an airtight container. To use, pour 3 heaping teaspoonfuls in cup; add hot water. Let stand a few minutes for spices to settle after stirring.

title: Creamy Vegetable Soup
directions: In a large kettle, saute onion in butter until transparent, not browned., Add the sweet potatoes, zucchini and broccoli., Saute lightly for 5 minutes or until crisp-tender., Stir in broth. Simmer for a few minutes., Add potatoes and seasonings., Cook another 10 minutes or until vegetables are tender., Stir in cream (milk) and heat., Makes about 4 quarts.

title: Rosie'S Taco
directions: Cook taco mix according to package directions., Place taco shell into a preheated skillet of oil, enough to cover the shell. Cook for 60 seconds., Prepare tacos by using the following:, place meat into the taco shell, a dab of hot or mild sauce and sprinkle a little shredded cheese., Top with shredded lettuce, shredded tomatoes and shredded cheese.

title: Snickerdoodles
directions: Baking Temperature: 350°., Baking Time: 8 minutes.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Cut chicken in bite size pieces., Mix celery, almonds, mayonnaise, onions, lemon juice and soup., Put in a two-quart casserole., Bake 25 minutes at 350°.

title: Diet Punch
directions: In pitcher, dissolve Crystal Light in 1 cup water., Add pineapple juice., Pour mixture into punch bowl with a little ice. When ready to serve, add Diet 7-Up.

title: Italian Ziti Medley
directions: In 4-quart saucepan, brown sausage., Remove from pan and drain., Melt butter and cook mushrooms, onion and pepper strips until tender, but not brown., Blend flour into vegetable mixture. Gradually stir in milk., Cook, stirring constantly, over medium-low heat until boil., Boil 1 minute., Blend in 1 1/2-cup Cheddar, Parmesan and pepper until cheeses are melted and mixture is smooth., Combine ziti, sausage and vegetable/cheese mixture. Pour into buttered 2-quart casserole., Sprinkle remaining 1/2 cup Cheddar on top., Bake, covered, at 350° for 30 minutes or bubbly.

title: Sausage Biscuits
directions: Combine all ingredients in bowl. Knead for 10 minutes. Shape into 36 small balls. Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Cheese-Potato Bake
directions: Place sliced potatoes in shallow greased baking dish., Combine milk, Tabasco and salt., Pour over potatoes., Dot with 1 tablespoon butter., Bake, uncovered, 40 minutes at 400° until tender., Top with cheese and sprinkle with paprika., Bake 5 minutes longer.

title: Fruit Salad
directions: Drain oranges and pineapple. Save juice., Mix all fruits and pecans, except bananas and strawberries.

title: Sour Cream Pie
directions: Mix all ingredients, stirring until dissolved.	Cook 15 minutes at 450°, then 25 to 30 minutes at 350°.

title: French Onion Soup
directions: In large saucepan, slowly cook onions, peeled and thin, in butter until soft and golden., Sprinkle onions with flour., Cook and stir for 1 to 2 minutes., Stir in condensed beef broth, water and Worcestershire sauce., Add salt and pepper., Bring to boil. Reduce heat; cover and simmer 30 minutes., Toast slices of French bread 1-inch thick., When soup is done, stir in Parmesan cheese. Ladle soup into individual ovenproof bowls., Float bread on top of soup., Place cheese on bread., Bake in 400° oven for 5 minutes until cheese melts., Serve immediately.

title: Coconut-Caramel Pie
directions: Bake pie shells to a golden brown and set aside to cool while mixing ingredients., Melt butter in large skillet., Add coconut and pecans; cook until golden brown, stirring frequently., Set aside.

title: Chocolate Cookies
directions: Melt butter., Add peanut butter, crackers, pecans, sugar and salt., Form into small balls., Melt together the paraffin and semi-sweet chocolate in double boiler., Dip cookies in chocolate-paraffin mixture and lay on waxed paper to dry.

title: Double Chocolate Mocha Trifle
directions: Prepare and bake brownie mix according to directions for a cake-like brownie., Cool completely and cut into cubes., In a mixing bowl, whisk pudding mix into the milk until mixture begins to thicken., Dissolve coffee granules into warm water, add to pudding mixture; mixing well., Fold in 2 cups whipped topping. Chop toffee bars. Layer 1/3 of brownie cubes in bottom of glass serving bowl., Top with 1/3 of the pudding mixture, pressing lightly, and 1/3 of chopped toffee., Repeat layers 2 more times. Decorate with remaining whipped topping and remaining toffee bar. Chill 30 minutes before serving.

title: Macaroni Salad
directions: Cook macaroni and drain., Rinse well with cold water., Chill thoroughly., Mix remaining ingredients, add dressing to chilled macaroni and toss until coated.

title: Sweet Blueberry Muffins
directions: Preheat oven to 400°., Grease muffin tins., Beat egg slightly; stir in milk and oil., Sift together the flour, sugar, baking powder and salt., Add flour mixture to liquids, stirring just until moistened., Carefully blend in blueberries and spoon into muffin tins until 2/3 full., Sprinkle with cinnamon sugar., Bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until toasty brown.

title: Heavenly Salad
directions: Split grapes in half lengthwise to remove seeds., Add chopped pineapple and marshmallows.

title: Egg And Cheese Rarebit
directions: In top of double boiler over hot water, melt cheese and butter until smooth., Add chicken broth, onion, parsley, nutmeg, salt and paprika., Beat eggs well, then stir in and cook and stir over boiling water until smooth and thickened., Serve on toasted English muffins or toast., Yield:, 4 servings.

title: Apple-Cabbage Mold
directions: Dissolve gelatin in water according to package directions. Chill until slightly thickened., Combine cabbage, vinegar and salt; let stand 20 minutes., Fold cabbage, apples and nuts into gelatin and turn into oiled mold., Chill until set., Unmold on crisp lettuce.

title: Cornish Game Hens
directions: For 2 hours, refrigerate game hens in a marinade of soy sauce, ginger and pineapple juice, covered., Preheat broiler., Preheat oven to 350°; remove hens from marinade., Put marinade aside. Place hens in skillet; boil 5 minutes on each side., Bake hens, uncovered, 30 minutes until done.

title: Easy Pudding Frosting
directions: Cream margarine, Crisco, sugar and pudding., Add milk and vanilla., Beat on high about 5 minutes., So good you'll want to eat it with a spoon!

title: Beefy Rice
directions: Melt butter in a 13 x 9-inch dish., Add rice., Mix soups and pour over rice., Bake for 1 hour at 350°.

title: Tamale Bites
directions: Combine corn bread crumbs, 1/2 cup of the enchilada sauce and the salt., Add ground beef; mix well., Shape into 1-inch balls. Place in shallow baking pan., Bake, uncovered, in a 350° oven for 18 to 20 minutes.

title: Deluxe Macaroni
directions: Make sauce; melt oleo and add flour., Blend., Add hot milk; stir until thickened., Add remaining ingredients., Add cheese to sauce; let melt.

title: Pepper Steak
directions: Brown steak; add onion, peppers, tomatoes, mushrooms and seasonings., Cover and simmer 30 minutes or until tender.

title: Dumb Bread
directions: Mix together and bake in a greased loaf pan in a preheated 350° oven for 45 minutes or until brown.

title: Anadama Bread
directions: Stir cornmeal slowly into boiling water., Boil 5 minutes., Add oil, molasses and salt; cool. When lukewarm add yeast which has been dissolved in the warm water., Add flour to make stiff dough. Knead well., Let rise until doubled., Shape into 2 loaves., Place in greased pans., Let rise., Bake at 400° for 15 minutes., Reduce to 350°., Bake 30 minutes more.

title: Overnight Spinach Dip
directions: Blend soup mix, sour cream, cream cheese and mayonnaise in bowl., Stir in spinach., Chill overnight., Hollow out bread; reserve bread pieces., Spoon mixture into bread shell., Serve with reserved bread.

title: Saucy Steak Skillet
directions: Coat steak pieces with flour., Pound into beef., Brown beef in oil in 10-inch skillet., Push beef to side., Cook and stir onion in oil until tender., Drain., Add enough water to potato liquid to make 1 cup., Mix liquid, catsup, Worcestershire sauce, pepper flakes, instant bouillon, salt, marjoram and pepper., Pour on beef and onion., Heat to boiling., Reduce heat., Cover and simmer until beef is tender, about 1 1/4 to 1 1/2 hours., Rinse frozen beans under running cold water to separate., Add potatoes, beans and pimiento to skillet., Heat to boiling., Reduce heat, cover and simmer until beans are tender, 10 to 15 minutes., Serves 4.

title: Banana Nut Bread
directions: Cream shortening and sugar in mixing bowl., Beat at speed 6 for 1 minute., Stop and scrape bowl., Beat 1 minute more at speed 6, then turn to speed 4 and add eggs., Beat 30 seconds., Stop and scrape bowl, then turn to speed 6 for 1 1/2 minutes., Stop.

title: Scalloped Corn
directions: Saute margarine, onion and green pepper., Put in greased casserole dish., Add 2 cans of corn, corn muffin mix and eggs. Mix all together in casserole., On top, spread sour cream and on top of that Cheddar cheese., Bake for 45 minutes at 350°.

title: Deep-Dish Peach Pie
directions: Place peaches in unbaked pie shell. Mix in separate bowl the sugar, salt, flour, nutmeg and cinnamon. When thoroughly mixed, add evaporated milk and mix. Pour mixture over peaches. Bake at 400° for 45 minutes.

title: Kathy'S Sauce
directions: Melt the margarine in a saucepan., Mix together with the margarine the soy sauce, Worcestershire and lemon juice., Mix cornstarch and cold water, then add to other ingredients., Stir frequently, until the mixture thickens., More cornstarch may be added if needed for thickening., Great on fajitas!

title: Hot Breakfast Tea
directions: Combine the first 3 ingredients and put in a cheesecloth bag. Bring the water to a boil in a large saucepan. Add the tea bags. Remove from the heat and cover., Let steep for 5 minutes. Remove the tea bags and squeeze gently. Add the spice mixture, sugar and juices. Bring to a boil. Cover and reduce the heat and let simmer 5 minutes. Remove the spice bag and serve hot. Garnish with orange slices., Yields 7 1/2 cups.

title: Caramel Topping
directions: Combine butter and cream in small mixing bowl., Microwave at Medium 1 1/4 to 3 minutes or until butter is melted., Stir in brown sugar, nuts and/or coconut. Spread carefully on warm cake. Microwave on High 2 to 3 minutes or until topping bubbles in a few spots., Use as frosting on Oatmeal Cake.

title: Sausage Casserole
directions: Drain browned hamburger and hot sausage, add celery, onion, and bell peppers. Mix. Simmer awhile. Drain meat mixture and add contents of soup mix packets and raw rice. Place in a large casserole and pour in hot water. Stir and bake covered 45 minutes at 350°. Top with almonds and bake 15 minutes more uncovered.

title: Old Atlanta Oatmeal Drop
directions: Combine and cook sugar, margarine, cocoa and milk for 1 1/2 minutes., Start timing when mixture has reached a full rolling boil., Remove from heat, add oats, vanilla peanut butter and chopped nuts., Beat until blended., When it begins to set, spoon quickly on wax paper., Yields about 50 cookies.

title: Salmon Patties
directions: Drain and flake salmon, reserving liquid., Combine salmon with bread crumbs and green onions., Stir in beaten eggs, lemon juice and reserved salmon liquid., Form into 6 patties., Fry patties in oil over medium heat until lightly browned on both sides., Serve hot with Dilled Cream Pea Sauce., Yield:, 6 patties.

title: Cheesy Ham Casserole
directions: Preparation Time: 15 minutes., Cooking Time: 30 minutes. Microwave Cooking Time: 10 minutes.

title: Pasta With Chicken, Steak And Shrimp
directions: Marinate chicken, steak and shrimp in 1 cup Italian dressing overnight., Grill steak and chicken; add shrimp last and cook until pink., (Don't overcook shrimp.), Cut chicken and steak into small pieces; leave shrimp whole., Cook pasta according to package directions; drain and rinse., Prepare seasoning mix according to package directions., Combine pasta, chicken, steak, shrimp, mushrooms, onions and pasta seasoning; toss to mix., Place in baking dish and cover with swiss cheese slices., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

title: Big Dave'S Dinner Rolls
directions: Mix dry ingredients in large enough bowl., Dissolve yeast in 1/4 cup warm water/flour mixture and wait until fully involved.

title: Buttermint Cookies
directions: Cream butter and sugar; beat in egg and extract., Gradually add flour; stir in peppermint., Dough will be soft., Divide dough into three parts., Shape into plastic wrap into 1 1/4-inch diameter logs., Chill 1 to 2 hours., Slice into 1/4-inch rounds. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 350° for 10 minutes or until light golden brown.

title: Chili
directions: Put all ingredients in a large pot and cook 1 to 2 hours until green pepper is tender.

title: Pecan Cream Cheese Pie
directions: In a mixing bowl, beat cream cheese on medium speed until smooth. Add 1/2 cup sugar, 1 of the eggs,1 teaspoon of the vanilla and the salt. Beat just until combined. Spread the cream cheese mixture onto bottom of the pastry. Spread pecans over the cream cheese mixture.

title: Maple-Glazed Ham
directions: Preheat broiler., Place ham slices on broiler pan., Combine syrup and mustard in small bowl., Brush each slice with about 1 1/2 tsp. of syrup mixture., Broil 4 inches below heat about 4 minutes or until ham starts to brown., Turn and brush with remaining syrup mixture., Broil until browned., Makes 4 servings.

title: Apple-Blueberry Squares
directions: Cream shortening and sugar thoroughly; add eggs., Beat until smooth., Add flour, baking powder and salt; mix well., Add vanilla; blend well., Spread 1/2 dough in 9 x 13-inch pan which has been greased., Place apples and blueberries with a little juice over dough., Drop remaining dough over fruit., Sprinkle top with cinnamon sugar., Bake at 350° for approximately 1 hour.

title: Gran'S Easter-Egg Cake
directions: Sprinkle gelatin over water and let soften., Blend yolks and 3/4 cup sugar in top of double boiler., Add lemon juice and rind and cook over simmering water, stirring constantly (do not let water touch bottom of pan)., When thick as medium white sauce, remove from heat., Add softened gelatin and stir until dissolved. Chill until mixture thickens and mounds.

title: Lemon Pudding Cake
directions: Add pudding mix to cake mix., Add water and eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition., Add oil and beat with electric beater at high for 10 minutes., Use angel cake pan., The secret is beating the mixture at high for 10 minutes., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Microwave Snack Cake
directions: Mix flour, cocoa, soda and salt in a 9-inch square microwave-safe pan., Mix remaining ingredients in 4-cup measure. Stir into flour mixture until well blended., Microwave on High for 6 to 7 minutes, rotating dish 1/4 turn twice until pick inserted near center comes out clean., Cool 10 minutes on flat surface. Moist spots will dry., Then place on wire rack., Serve warm.

title: Dill Dip
directions: Mix all ingredients., Refrigerate for 24 hours., Yield:, 2 cups., Carbohydrate 0 g, protein 0 g, fat 7 g, calories per serving 63., One tablespoon = 1 fat exchange.

title: Quick And Easy Jambalaya
directions: Mix all ingredients., Pour into greased heavy pot or casserole dish that covers tightly., Cover and bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours. Do not open until finished.

title: Chilaquilas(American Name: Enchilada Casserole)
directions: Very large bowl., Plug in crockpot; oil the bottom with the canola oil.

title: Apple Pudding
directions: Mix apples, eggs, sugar and cinnamon., Sift flour, baking soda and salt., Add to apple mixture., Add nuts., Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake 40 minutes at 350°.

title: Aunt Abbie'S Ginger Cookies
directions: Mix shortening and sugar; add egg, molasses and spices. Alternate milk and soda with flour to make stiff enough to roll. Roll out; cut., Sprinkle with white sugar., Bake at 375°.

title: Parma Breaded Steak
directions: Trim steaks., Dip steaks in eggs and then in a mixture of the cheese and crumbs., Let stand while preparing the sauce.

title: Cheese And Bacon Potato Bake
directions: In medium saucepan, over medium-high heat, heat broth to a boil; reduce heat., Add potatoes and onion; cover and simmer 5 minutes. Drain, reserving 1 1/2 cups broth., In skillet, over medium-high heat, cook bacon until crisp., Remove and crumble bacon; pour off all but 3 tablespoons drippings., Blend flour into reserved drippings., Gradually add reserved broth; cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until thickened., Stir in cheese until melted.

title: French Icing
directions: Cook milk and flour until thick., Beat until lumps are gone. Cool and add sugar, Crisco, vanilla and salt., Beat until it looks like whipped cream.

title: Vegetable Pizza
directions: Unroll crescent dough., Do not separate., Press seams together to fill the bottom of a 15 x 10-inch pan., Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes., Cool.

title: Easy Fresh Fruit Dip
directions: Add pudding to sour cream., Stir until smooth., If too thick, add a little bit of milk., Serve with sliced fresh fruit.

title: Oatmeal-Chocolate Chip Cookies
directions: In large bowl, mix all ingredients together, one at a time. Shape into cookies and bake at 375° until light brown., Don't overcook.

title: Huckleberry Pudding
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

title: Candy Apples
directions: *Insert a wooden ice cream bar or lollipop stick part way through stem end of each apple.

title: Baked Beans
directions: Mix first 4 ingredients., Cook in 350° oven for 15 minutes or microwave on High for 4 minutes., Add beans (I like B & W baked beans) and partially fry bacon and add., Heat at 350° for 30 minutes or microwave on High for 12 minutes.

title: Pork Chops In The Corn
directions: Note:, To serve 4, double the recipe, except use 3/4 teaspoon of salt.

title: Lemon Chicken
directions: Cut chicken breasts in half and filet. Then cut the filets in several pieces. Heat butter and oil mixture in skillet. Dredge chicken in flour and dip in egg. Brown lightly in skillet, about 3 minutes a side. Remove to warm baking dish. Continue until all chicken is browned. Add wine, capers and parsley to skillet and deglaze. Pour over chicken. Squeeze juice of 1 lemon over chicken. Bake 20 minutes at 350°.

title: Garay'S Santa Maria Beans
directions: Pick over and wash beans, draining well., Place in 6 to 8-quart kettle., Cover with water., Bury ham hock in beans., Add sliced onion, minced garlic, cilantro and 2 teaspoons salt., Cut top off tea bag and add tea leaves to mixture., Add Chipotle chile(s), one for medium heat and two for hotter., Bring beans to a boil., Cover and reduce heat., Add boiling water as needed to keep beans just slightly covered with water., Simmer for at least two hours.

title: Cherry Yum Yum
directions: Melt butter and mix with graham cracker crumbs., Mix sugar, milk, cheese and Dream Whip. Whip until stiff., Put half of this mixture over half of the graham crumbs., Put the cherries over the cream mixture and add another layer of the cream mixture and then add the remaining crumbs., Cover and put in refrigerator to chill.

title: Russian Pancakes Or Blini
directions: Dissolve yeast in 1/4 cup milk or enough to make a sponge. Let rise in a warm place about 3 hours., Cream egg yolks, butter and salt., Add yeast sponge, remaining flour and remaining milk. Beat until smooth., Cover., Let stand for 30 minutes., Beat egg whites until stiff and fold into batter., Butter a skillet lightly., Proceed like for pancakes, about 3 inches in diameter.

title: Hot Rolls
directions: Add 1 tablespoon sugar and yeast to 1/4 cup warm water; dissolve., To 1 cup water, add 2 cups flour, dry milk, salt, 2 tablespoons sugar and melted butter., Add this mixture to yeast mixture and beat thoroughly., Add 1 cup flour to mixture; stir.

title: Potato Strips
directions: Scrub potatoes., Slice lengthwise in 3 to 4 slices., Spread with butter and soup mix., Reassemble and wrap in foil., Bake at 400° for 1 hour.

title: Buttermilk Coconut Pie
directions: Pour melted butter in unbaked pie shells., Spread coconut over butter., Mix other ingredients and pour over coconut., Bake at 375°, until middle is set, about 35 minutes.

title: Corn Salad
directions: Mix first 7 ingredients and refrigerate overnight., Drain., Add 2 tablespoons sour cream (heaping), 2 tablespoons mayonnaise (heaping) and a sprinkle of parsley., Mix well.

title: Chicken And Noodles
directions: Put the chicken in a pot., Cover with the water; add the sliced carrots., Bring to a boil; cook until wing falls off. Remove chicken from pan; let cool before removing meat from bone.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
directions: Combine all ingredients and place in a well buttered casserole., Sprinkle 1/2 cup grated sharp Cheddar cheese on top, then sprinkle with Italian herbed bread crumbs., Bake at 450° for 15 minutes.

title: Brenda'S Cheese Ball
directions: Cream (room temperature) cream cheese., Add chopped beef, green onions (chopped) and desired amount of olives, chopped., Shape into ball and roll into nuts., Place on serving dish with crackers.

title: Guacamole Dip
directions: Chop the tomato and slice the scallions., Mince the garlic and jalapeno pepper., (You may use only 1/2 or 1/4 of the jalapeno or leave it out if you don't want it to be hot.) Halve and peel the avocados and cut the flesh into 1/2-inch cubes., Squeeze 1 teaspoon lime juice over the avocado and toss., Taste for seasoning and stir in additional juice, salt or jalapeno, if desired.

title: No Bake Cookies
directions: Mix first 4 ingredients and cook on medium heat., When it comes to a boil, boil for about 2 minutes., Remove from heat and quickly add peanut butter, oats and vanilla., Stir thoroughly and drop by spoonfuls onto waxed paper., Let harden.

title: Wendy'S Peanut Butter Cookies
directions: Heat oven to 375°., Combine peanut butter, Crisco, brown sugar, milk and vanilla in large bowl., Beat at medium speed until well blended., Combine flour, salt and baking soda and add to creamed mixture on low speed., Mix until blended., Drop by heaping teaspoonfuls 2 inches apart onto ungreased baking sheet., Flatten slightly in crisscross pattern., Bake for 7 to 8 minutes until light brown., Cool 2 minutes on sheets before putting on rack. (Don't sugar coat.)

title: Hoogie Poogie
directions: Brown ground beef and onion in skillet., While meat is cooking, combine rest of ingredients in slow cooker., When meat is done, add to slow cooker and cook on low for 6 to 8 hours.

title: Baked Apples
directions: Pare apples and place center up in baking dish sprayed with Pam., Mix brown sugar, white sugar and cinnamon; cover the apples. Dissolve cornstarch in cold water., Place over apples., Put dabs of oleo on top., Bake at 375° for 45 to 50 minutes until apples are soft but not mushy.

title: Meat Loaf
directions: Combine 1 3/4 cups cheese with remaining ingredients., Mix and shape into a loaf in 11 x 7-inch baking dish., Bake at 325° for 70 minutes., Brush with extra sauce and top with remaining cheese. Let stand for a few minutes until cheese has melted.

title: Cream Puffs
directions: On stove melt margarine and water., Bring to boil., Quickly add flour and stir with wooden spoon over low heat until it forms a ball., Take off heat and add 4 eggs., Mix with electric beater. Drop teaspoonful on ungreased pan., Bake at 400° for 30 to 35 minutes (place 2-inches apart)., Let cool., Make pudding., Slice puffs and fill.

title: Pork Chop Casserole
directions: Brown pork chops., While these are browning, peel and slice potatoes and place in 9 x 13-inch baking dish., Mix other ingredients and pour over raw potatoes., I usually melt this in the microwave before pouring over potatoes., Place browned pork chops on top of potatoes., Cover with foil and bake at 350° for one hour., Uncover and bake for about 10 minutes.

title: German Chocolate Upside-Down Cake
directions: Mix cake as directed on box., Melt butter in pan., Sprinkle pecans and coconut in pan., Pour cake mix on top.

title: White Chocolate Cream Puff
directions: Melt butter in water. When it starts to boil, stir in flour. Stir until dough forms a ball. Let this mixture cool at least 2 minutes. Beat in eggs, one at a time until well mixed or use the equivalent of 4 egg beaters.

title: Poppy Seed Dressing
directions: In blender, mix onion and vinegar., Add sugar, poppy seed and salt., Add oil slowly, or it will separate., Store in glass jar in refrigerator., Keeps up to 6 months.

title: Mexican Spoon Bread
directions: Mix all ingredients except chilies and cheese in order given (wet ingredients first, then dry ingredients).

title: Peach Cobbler
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., Butter a 2-quart baking dish., Put peaches on bottom and sprinkle with lemon juice and extract., In a large mixing bowl, mix flour, sugar, salt and egg until crumbly. Sprinkle over peaches; drizzle with margarine., Bake 35 to 45 minutes, until topping begins to brown., Great with ice cream or milk.

title: Creamy Rice Pudding
directions: In a medium pan, heat rice, water and salt to boiling over medium heat., Reduce heat to low; cover., Simmer 20 to 25 minutes or until rice is tender and all liquid is absorbed., Add milk, half and half and sugar., Mix; heat to boiling., Reduce heat and simmer 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.

title: Party Mix
directions: Place first 5 ingredients in a very large bowl. Mix oil and dressing mix. Pour over dry ingredients. Mix well. Stir occasionally to blend all ingredients. Let stand overnight. Serve next day.

title: Delicious Custard
directions: Melt butter. Blend in cornstarch, sugar and salt., Gradually add milk., Heat to boiling over direct heat., Stir into slightly beaten egg yolks., Return to heat and cook 2 minutes, stirring constantly. Add vanilla. Cool thoroughly., Makes 2 cups., Serve plain or with cream., (Excellent for banana cream pie.)

title: Traditional Wassail
directions: Combine all ingredients in a large saucepan or Dutch oven. Bring to a boil; reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, for 30 minutes. Remove cloves and cinnamon sticks. Serve wassail hot from Dutch oven or in a heatproof punch bowl. Yield: 32 (1/2 cup) servings.

title: Raisin-Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., Sift together flour, baking soda, salt and cinnamon., Stir in the oats., Combine egg whites, brown sugar, oil, milk, vanilla and raisins and add to flour mixture., Mix well.

title: Frozen Slaw
directions: Bring sugar, vinegar and salt to boil., Boil one minute., Pour over cabbage mixture., Stir., Cool., Freeze in small containers.

title: Cookies And Cream Pie
directions: Pour half and half into large bowl., Add pie filling mix. Beat with wire whisk until blended (approximately 1 minute)., Let stand 5 minutes., Fold in Cool Whip and cookies., Spoon into crust., Freeze until firm (6 hours or overnight)., Remove from freezer and let stand 10 minutes to soften before serving. Garnish top with additional cookie bits., Store leftovers in freezer.

title: Swiss Vegetable Medley
directions: Combine vegetables, soup, 1/2 cup cheese, sour cream, salt, pepper and 1/2 can onions., Put in 1-quart casserole., Bake, covered, at 350° for 30 minutes., Top with remaining cheese and onions., Bake, uncovered, 5 minutes longer.

title: Pot Roast
directions: Trim meat of all external fat., Use a deep, heavy pot with lid., Brown meat on all sides., Add onion and garlic; cook until the onion is soft, about 3 to 4 minutes, stirring occasionally. Stir in coriander, cumin, tomato paste, 3/4 cup water, chilies and black pepper., Bring to a boil, reduce heat, cover and simmer for 2 1/2 hours or until meat is tender., Yield:, 8 servings. Carbohydrate 10 g, protein 24 g, fat 15 g, calories 273.

title: Butterscotch Candy
directions: Boil the sugar, corn syrup and water to the firm ball stage. Add butter, salt and vanilla., Cook to soft crack stage., Pour into oiled pan., When partly cooled, mark into squares.

title: Toasted Pecans
directions: Combine all ingredients except for the pecans in a saucepan. Bring to boil over medium heat and boil for 3 minutes, stirring constantly., Stir in pecans quickly., Spread on a cookie sheet. Bake at 350° for 5 to 10 minutes., Remove from oven., Let cool and break apart., Store in an airtight container.

title: Sweet Potato Cake
directions: Mix the salt and sweet potatoes well., Add eggs, one at a time., Add, vanilla, and, remaining ingredients., Pour into greased tube pan and bake at 300° for 1 1/2 hours or longer if needed., Cool before removing from pan.

title: Cranberry Punch
directions: Pour juices into punch bowl., Add desired amount of sherbet. Use 1 quart of ginger ale for each gallon of punch.

title: Dressing For Slaw
directions: Cut up onion; blend all ingredients in blender for just a minute., Makes 2 pints of dressing., Pour over grated cabbage; chill.

title: Dill Weed Dip
directions: Mix all ingredients., Use for fresh vegetables., Refrigerate until ready to use.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Thaw and drain broccoli; set aside., Melt oleo., Beat 3 eggs. Mix melted oleo, eggs, water, minced onion, flour and Cheez Whiz. Add in broccoli and top with bread crumbs., Pour in baking dish and bake at 350° for 45 minutes; serve.

title: Stuffed Mushrooms
directions: Wipe mushrooms with a damp cloth and remove the stems., Chop the stems very finely., Beat cheese with milk and Worcestershire sauce until light and fluffy., Add chopped mushroom stems, water chestnuts, bell pepper, onion and bacon., Blend well, but gently. Fill the mushroom caps with the mixture and place on a baking sheet., Bake in a 350° oven for approximately 15 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Chicken Salad
directions: Cook and debone the chicken breasts., Add the macaroni, which has been rinsed in cold water and drained. Add remaining ingredients and refrigerate overnight. Serves 10 to 12.

title: Pineapple Dream Cake
directions: Bake the cake as directed on box in square pan., When done prick cake with a fork, while cake is still hot, pour crushed pineapple over the cake, spreading over entire cake., While cake is cooling, mix pudding with only 1 cup of milk; set aside., Mix whipped topping and combine with pudding., Spread over cake.

title: Blueberry Muffins
directions: Heat oven to 400°., Mix eggs, milk and margarine, then add dry ingredients., Mix only a little, then fold in blueberries as much or little as you want., Put in muffin tin about 2/3 full., Bake for 20 minutes.

title: Buster Bar Torte
directions: Mix crumbs and	Cool, Whip, and spread in a 9 x 13-inch freezeable pan., Cover with softened vanilla ice cream (1/2 to 3/4 gallon)., Put in freezer for several hours until solid.

title: Potato Casserole
directions: Mix cream of mushroom soup with sweet milk., In a 1 1/2-quart casserole, arrange the thinly sliced potatoes and chopped onion in layers adding soup mixture., Dot with butter., Cover and cook one hour at 375°., Uncover and bake 15 minutes more.

title: Classic French Silk Pie
directions: Beat sugar and butter until light and fluffy., Stir in vanilla, cream of tartar and chocolate., Beat in eggs until light and fluffy, about 3 minutes., Pour into pie shell., Refrigerate to set, 3 to 4 hours, or cover with plastic wrap and freeze at least 8 hours., If pie is frozen, remove from freezer 15 minutes prior to serving., Beat whipping cream and powdered sugar in a chilled 1 1/2-quart bowl until stiff., Top pie with cream and garnish with chopped nuts or chocolate curls.

title: Baked Squash
directions: Cut acorn squash in half lengthwise., Remove seeds., Bake cut side up; season with all other ingredients., Continue baking 20 minutes longer.

title: Eggs In A Basket
directions: Preheat oven to 400°., Trim crusts off bread; spread both sides of bread with butter., Fit bread slices into cups of muffin tin. Place in oven until lightly toasted; remove from oven., Break an egg into bread and top with cheese., Return to oven and heat 12 to 15 minutes., Slip baskets carefully from the tins., Cool a bit.

title: Curry Chicken
directions: Put chicken in pot and generously season with curry powder. Let sit several hours or overnight., When ready to cook, add some water to the pot (enough to cover the chicken)., Toss in some chopped onion and celery to suit your taste and add seasoned salt and pepper., Boil until chicken falls off the bones., When chicken is done, scoop out all meat, bones and pieces and pick out the good meat from the bones and "oocky" parts., While you are picking through the chicken, boil some chopped potatoes in the pot and when the potatoes are tender, add the chicken meat back into the pot., Stir all this together for a few minutes, then serve over rice.

title: Ginger Snaps
directions: Cream sugar and shortening, add egg, and then the remaining ingredients. When mixed, roll into small balls the size of a marble (about 1 teaspoonful) in palm of hand. Dip in mixture of sugar and cinnamon (additional to that in recipe). Bake at 350 about 15 minutes, leaving space on cooking sheet for them to spread. Do not mash the round balls down on cookie sheet.

title: Easy Chicken And Rice
directions: Mix all ingredients together and bake in oven for 1 hour at 350°.

title: Banana Nut Bread
directions: Cream sugar and butter until fluffy; add eggs and bananas. Mix in flour and milk; add nuts and vanilla., Add oil last., Pour into greased and floured pans., Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes or until golden brown., Yield: 2 regular or 3 small loaves.

title: Frozen Mocha Torte
directions: Combine 1 cup wafer crumbs, sugar and butter. Press onto the bottom and 1-inch up the sides of a greased 9-inch spring-form pan. Set aside.

title: Pumpkin Cake
directions: Mix ingredients lightly., Put into 9 x 13-inch pan., Reserve 1 cup of mix for topping.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
directions: Beat eggs. Add sugar, oil, vanilla, salt and soda, then add flour, chopped apples and nuts., Mixture will be stiff., Spoon into Bundt cake pan sprayed with Pam. Bake 1 hour at 350°.

title: Christmas Treat Cracker
directions: Mix Hidden Valley mix and oil in spices and mix well., Put on cookie sheet in slow oven for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: 5 Cup Salad
directions: Mix altogether and refrigerate.

title: Special Mac And Cheese
directions: Cook macaroni in 4 to 5 cups water until tender., Drain, if needed., Add butter, 1/2 teaspoon salt and 1/2 teaspoon pepper. Add 2 cups of the milk and the Velveeta (sliced)., Stir on low heat until cheese is melted., Pour into greased casserole.

title: Cheese Cake
directions: Crush graham crackers. Add 2 tablespoons of sugar and melted butter., Press into a 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Beef Stroganoff
directions: Cook mushrooms and onion in butter for 3 minutes., Remove and add floured 1 1/2-inch strips or chunks of beef., Add more butter or shortening, if necessary., Brown quickly., Add 2 cups stock or bouillon cubes and water., Add mushrooms, onion and gravy flavoring., Cover tightly and cook 1 hour or until meat is tender. Ten minutes before serving, stir in sour cream., Serve with noodles or mashed potatoes.

title: Peach Cobbler
directions: Combine peaches and sugar., Melt margarine in an 8 x 8-inch dish., Mix other ingredients by hand., Pour over margarine (don't mix)., Spoon peaches over batter., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Praline Cookies
directions: Grease a 15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 1-inch jelly roll pan., Line bottom of	pan, with whole graham crackers., Place brown sugar and butter in	saucepan., Bring to a rolling boil and cook for 1 1/2 minutes., Remove, from, heat., When mixture has stopped bubbling, stir, in, nuts., Spoon and spread over graham crackers., Bake in a, 350° oven for 10 minutes., Cool and cut into 48 (1 x 2-inch) bars.

title: Banana-Date-Nut Bread
directions: Cream butter and sugar., Add eggs and beat., Add soda to sour milk., Add bananas., Mix in nuts, dates and flour., Mix well. Grease 1 loaf pan., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Pecan Muffins
directions: Combine beaten eggs and brown sugar., Mix well and add melted margarine., Then add flour, vanilla and pecans., Bake in cupcake size muffin tins for approximately 25 minutes at 350°.

title: Never Fail Dumplings
directions: Mix flour, salt and shortening., Add water and egg, making soft dough., Divide into two parts., Roll out into very thin sheets and let dry for 15 minutes., Cut into small strips and drop in boiling broth., Cook until tender.

title: Quiche Lorraine
directions: Fry bacon., Drain and chop. Put in pie shell., Sprinkle with cheese, mushrooms and broccoli., Blend eggs, milk, salt and pepper., Pour over meat and vegetables., Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

title: Cabbage And Shells
directions: Coarsely chop cabbage and onion., In 12-inch skillet over medium-high heat, in hot oil, cook cabbage, onion, pepper and salt until cabbage and onion are very tender (about 20 minutes), stirring occasionally.

title: Crescent Casserole
directions: Combine all ingredients except dough and press mixture into a loaf pan., Bake in a preheated 350° oven for 1 1/2 hours., Cool in pan for 5 minutes., Drain off fat and invert meat loaf onto a cookie sheet., Separate roll of dough into 4 rectangles., Overlap slightly on a pastry cloth or floured board to form a large rectangle., Roll out to 10 x 5 inches., Drape over meat., Trim excess., Bake in 325° oven for 15 to 20 minutes., Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Pineapple Salad
directions: Take 5 graham crackers, mash fine and put in bottom of dish. Drain pineapple (save juice and mix lemon juice with the pineapple juice, then pour back into the pineapple)., Add the Jell-O, Borden sweetened condensed milk, marshmallows and Cool Whip., Mix well and pour over the cracker crumbs and refrigerate.

title: Potato Salad Dressing
directions: Mix together all ingredients., If too sour, add sugar., If too sweet, add vinegar and salt., Add to potatoes which have been diced and basted overnight in French dressing., Also add diced celery and 1 dozen boiled eggs.

title: Marie'S Easy Key Lime Pie
directions: Mix first three ingredients until thick, pour into pie shell. Sprinkle with cracker crumbs and freeze for 1 hour.

title: Heavenly Orange Cheesecake
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Mix wafer crumbs and oleo., Press in spring-form pan., Bake 10 minutes and cool.

title: Green Rice
directions: Cook rice; wash and drain., Mix rice, shredded cheese, parsley and onions., Beat eggs and add to rice mixture., Bake in 350° oven for 35 minutes or until firm.

title: Chicken Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients and refrigerate., Best if made a day ahead.

title: Pear Jam
directions: Note:, You will need canning jars, rings and new lids.

title: Skillet Cake
directions: Mix the first 5 ingredients, then add the rest., Mix well. Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch cake pan., Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

title: Garden Toss Spaghetti
directions: Saute veggies in oil until zucchini is tender., Prepare spaghetti; toss with half and half, cheese, salt and pepper., Add hot cooked veggies to spaghetti and toss well., Serve on warm platter.

title: French Dressing
directions: Mix ingredients and beat well., Pour in bottle and add salt and piece of garlic.

title: Caramel Fudge Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350., Prepare cake mix as directed., Pour 2 Cups of batter into greased 13 X 9 inch pan., Bake 15 minutes., In heavy saucepan over low heat, melt caramels and butter., remove from heat., Add sweetened condensed milk., Mix well., Spread caramel over cake., Spread remaining batter over caramel., top with nuts., Bake 30 minutes or until cake springs back when lightly touched.

title: Rice Casserole
directions: Melt margarine in casserole dish., Add all ingredients except peas, cover and bake in a 350° oven for one hour., Add peas, if desire leave in oven for another five minutes; then serve.

title: Puppy Chow Snack
directions: Melt together the first 3 ingredients., Add and stir in the cereal., Shake the mixture with the powdered sugar in a large container with a tight lid until cereal mixture is well coated.

title: Peach Butter
directions: Mix peaches, sugar and salt., Stir until well blended., Let stand., Put in a large, heavy pan., Boil rapidly, stirring constantly to prevent scorching., As mixture becomes thick, reduce heat to reduce splattering., Add spices and continue to cook until butter is thick to flake off spoon or approximately 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Honey Wheat Bread
directions: In saucepan, heat milk just until bubbles form around edge of pan., Remove from heat., Add shortening, honey and salt, stirring until shortening is melting., Let cool to lukewarm., Sprinkle yeast over water in mixing bowl., Stir to dissolve yeast., Stir in milk mixture and eggs., Combine flours, add 2/3 of flour., Mix at low speed., Mix rest of flour by hand., Cover bowl with wax paper and towel., Place in warm draft-free area one hour., Grease bread pans., Knead dough by hand and divide in equal parts, about 4. Place in pans and let stand 40 to 50 minutes., Preheat oven to 350°., Bake 45 to 50 minutes., Let cool.

title: Banana Coconut Bread
directions: Preheat oven to 325°., Into a large bowl, sift together flour, baking soda and salt; set aside., Put eggs, butter, lemon extract, sour cream and sugar in blender and mix, or mix by hand., Pour egg mixture into flour mixture, stirring thoroughly., Fold in nuts, bananas and coconut., Pour batter into 2 lightly buttered 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pans., Bake for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Graham Cracker Gems (Haystack)
directions: Mix sugar, cream and margarine and cook until mixture forms a soft ball., Add crumbs, coconut and nuts; beat well., Drop on waxed paper.

title: Ham Loaf
directions: Mix all ingredients together; make into loaf., Put into shallow pan., Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours., During the last 30 minutes, spoon on tangy mustard glaze., Save some for serving the Ham Loaf.

title: Chicken Breast Monterey
directions: Sprinkle chicken filets with seasoning., Coat with flour. Brown for 5 minutes on each side in butter over medium heat. Reduce heat to low., Add next 4 ingredients., Simmer, covered, for 45 minutes or until chicken is tender., Top each filet with one piece of cheese., Let stand, covered, for 5 minutes or until cheese begins to melt.

title: Beef And Biscuit Casserole
directions: Cook ground chuck and onion until tender; drain., Combine the tomato sauce, garlic salt and chili powder in a bowl., Add the egg and 1 cup of the cheese chunks., Combine this with ground chuck and onion., Divide each biscuit into 2 pieces., Place 10 pieces in the bottom of a casserole dish., Spread the ground chuck mixture on top of the biscuits., Place the remaining biscuit pieces on top of the meat mixture., Bake for 25 minutes at 300°., Sprinkle the remaining cheese on top of the browned biscuits and return to the oven long enough to melt the cheese.

title: Mrs. Hooper'S Fried Corn
directions: Melt bacon drippings and margarine in an iron skillet until hot., Reduce heat slightly and add corn., Stir constantly until done, about 10 to 15 minutes., Salt to taste.

title: Salmon Cakes
directions: Mix everything together., Shape into patties., Coat with cracker crumbs and fry., Makes about 8 to 10.

title: Green Bean Salad
directions: Cook beans and drain., Add red onion, sliced in rings., Then put into jar and shake all the ingredients together., Pour over beans., Refrigerate several hours., Serve sprinkled with crumbled bacon., Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Crispy Potato Quiche(Serves 6)
directions: Press thawed hash browns between paper towels to remove moisture., Fit hash browns into greased 10-inch pie plate, forming a solid crust., Brush crust with melted butter, making certain to brush tip edges., Bake at 425° for 25 minutes., Remove from oven. Sprinkle cheeses and ham evenly over bottom of crust., Beat half and half with eggs and seasoned salt., Pour over cheeses and ham. Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean., Frozen hash browns cut the preparation time for this spicy quiche.

title: Lemon-Vanilla Angel Food Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 325°., Spray vegetable coating spray lightly onto a tube pan.

title: Mexican Pinwheels*
directions: Add onion, olives and peppers to cream cheese., Mix well. Spread over tortillas and roll up (jelly roll style)., Wrap in plastic wrap and refrigerate about 4 hours., Slice into 3/4-inch sections (save the ends for yourself as this is all that will be left!)., Serve with salsa, if desired., Watch them disappear!

title: Baked Lasagne
directions: Cook the lasagne and drain., Brown the meat., Mix the Ricotta, parsley, nutmeg, cinnamon and eggs., Alternate in baking dish. Sprinkle some cheese and sauce until dish is filled. Bake at 375° for 30 minutes.

title: Swedish Rye Bread
directions: Pour the milk, over, the, salt,, molasses and oil., Add water when cool; add yeast and unbleached flour and beat until smooth. Stir in, caraway, seed., Gradually	add the rye flour and mix to make, a, medium stiff dough., Dough will be sticky. Turn it out onto a floured board and knead 10 minutes.	Cover, let rise until double,, 2 hours., Punch down, let rise again. Shape into 2, long rolls on cookie sheets with cornmeal., Let rise until double. Bake at 375° for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Pineapple Cookies
directions: Mix as usual when making cookies., Drop by teaspoon on cookie sheet., Bake at 325° to 350°.

title: Minestrone Soup
directions: In a large saucepan brown bacon and cook onion and celery with garlic and basil until tender., Stir in soups, water, tomatoes, macaroni and salt., Bring to boil; cover., Reduce heat; simmer 15 minutes., Add zucchini, cook 10 minutes more or until done., Makes 8 cups.

title: Applesauce-Graham Cracker Dessert(Low-Calorie)
directions: Combine apple sauce with dry Jello., Lay 6 graham crackers in bottom of 9x13 dish and cover with jello-applesauce mixture. Repeat crackers and mixture until all 36 graham crackers are used (6 layers)., End with applesauce on top and sides.	Use Cool Whip to cover the layers completely., Refrigerate for 24 hours.	Serves 12-15.

title: Cheddar Cheese Sauce
directions: Melt butter. Stir in flour and simmer. Briskly stir in warm milk. Blend well., Heat until boiling., Stir in cheese. Blend well.

title: Punch Bowl Cake(Small Size)
directions: In a small punch bowl, assemble 10 layers in the following order: thin layer of crumbled cake, all of vanilla pudding, thin layer of Cool Whip, thin layer of cake (crumbled), all cherry pie filling, thin layer of Cool Whip, thin layer of crumbled cake, all crushed pineapple, thin layer of Cool Whip and sliced bananas. Decorate top with Cool Whip, coconut and cherries.

title: Baked Potato Skins
directions: Scrub potatoes thoroughly and prick several times with a fork. Bake at 400° for 1 to 1 1/4 hours or until done., Allow to cool to touch., Cut potatoes in half lengthwise; carefully scoop out pulp, leaving about 1/4-inch thick shells., Cut each shell into 1 inch wide strips and place on ungreased baking sheets., Brush tops of strips with butter; sprinkle with seasoning and cheese., Bake at 400° for 10 to 12 minutes or until crisp., Serve warm with sour cream.

title: Bread Dumplings(Semmelknodel)
directions: Finely slice bread rolls and soak in milk for 15 minutes., Fry onion and parsley in butter; add to soaked bread., Mix in eggs, flour, salt and nutmeg., Bring water to a boil with salt., Form a test dumpling and cook in slowly simmering water 10 to 15 minutes., If it breaks apart, add bread crumbs to mixture to make it drier., If it is too firm, add a little more milk to mixture. Serve with goulash or roast beef.

title: Barbecue Baked Beans
directions: Combine all ingredients and bake at 450° for 40 to 50 minutes.

title: No Peek Stew
directions: Put all ingredients (except peas) in large casserole dish (2-quarts) or large rectangle cake pan with tight fitting* top. Bake at 250° for 5 hours., When done add frozen peas.

title: Peanut Crisp Bars
directions: In a large saucepan, combine granulated sugar, corn syrup and salt., Cook and stir until sugar is dissolved., Blend in peanut butter; stir in cereal., Pat evenly into a square pan., In a small saucepan, melt oleo and brown sugar., Remove from heat; add milk and vanilla., Stir in powdered sugar., Beat until smooth., Spread over cereal mixture., Cut into squares and enjoy., Makes 2 dozen.

title: Microwave Cream Pie Filling
directions: Mix egg yolks and milk with a whisk., Fluff up good., Mix dry ingredients together, then add to egg mixture., Cook in microwave on Full power for 6 to 8 minutes., Stir at 2 minute intervals until thickened., When finished, add margarine and vanilla. Makes 1 (9-inch) or 2 (8-inch) pies.

title: Cranberry Salad
directions: Combine sugar, 1/3 cup water and cranberries; let boil for 5 minutes., Take off and let cool., Mix jello and water and let it start to jell a little; add cranberries, pecans, pineapple and celery., Mix and refrigerate.

title: Coconut Bars
directions: Cream together the margarine and 1/2 cup brown sugar until light and fluffy., Add 1 cup flour; mix well., In a 9 x 13-inch pan, bake at 375° for 12 minutes., In another bowl, mix together the remaining 1 cup brown sugar and 1/4 cup flour., Blend eggs, vanilla and salt., Fold in pecans and coconut., Spread mixture evenly over baked layer., Bake at 375° for 15 minutes., Cool; cut into bars.

title: Zucchini Casserole
directions: Combine all ingredients and bake in large casserole dish at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Low-Fat Summer Delight
directions: For a low-fat, quick, cool summer treat, spread chocolate Cool Whip between 2 chocolate graham crackers.

title: Zesty Carrots
directions: Cut carrots, julienne style., Cook until tender (about 6 to 8 minutes)., Drain carrots, reserving 1/4 cup liquid., Turn carrots into a 1 1/2-quart baking dish., In small bowl, combine onion, horseradish, mayonnaise, reserved liquid from carrots and salt and pepper to taste., Pour over carrots, spreading evenly., Toss bread crumbs with butter; sprinkle over top., Bake 15 minutes at 375°. Makes 6 servings.

title: Raspberry Jello Salad
directions: Mix pretzels, sugar and butter well. Spread in a 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 5 to 7 minutes., Cool this crust.

title: Corn Pudding
directions: Combine corn and eggs, lightly beaten., Add mixture of next 5 ingredients., Stir in milk and melted butter. Pour into greased 3-quart casserole., Bake at 400° for 1 hour, stirring once.

title: Dominosaurus Pound Cake
directions: Combine flour, baking powder and salt in medium bowl; set aside., In separate bowl, cream butter and sugar; add vanilla. Add eggs one at a time, beating well after each., Alternately add flour mixture and milk., Line outside of spring-form pan with foil., Grease and flour pan., Pour in batter and bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean., Cool 10 minutes., Remove cake from pan., Makes 8 servings.

title: Fluffy Flapjacks
directions: Sift flour with baking powder, soda, sugar and salt., Combine buttermilk, melted butter and beaten egg., Add to dry ingredients, stirring only until flour is moistened., Batter will be lumpy and thick., Bake on hot, ungreased griddle., Makes 6 to 8 pancakes.

title: Coconut Bars
directions: Beat eggs until lemon color., Add brown sugar, oil, vanilla, flour, salt and soda., Mix well., Add coconut and nuts., Spread in a 9 x 13-inch pan., Cook at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Tuna Noodle Casserole
directions: Combine all ingredients and cook on simmer until warm.

title: Pickle Relish
directions: Heat to boiling vinegar, sugar, turmeric, ground mustard, celery seed and salt., Add cucumber mixture; let simmer for 15 to 20 minutes., Put in cans and seal.

title: Ham Casserole
directions: Cook macaroni; drain., Mix all ingredients in a casserole dish., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: What'S Cooking?(Beef Stew For One)
directions: Brown beef in butter., Add soup, vegetables and horseradish. Let simmer until vegetables are soft., Add water for desired thickness., For more servings, add more vegetables, horseradish and another can of soup.

title: Crustless Coconut Pie
directions: Beat eggs and mix with other ingredients., Pour into lightly greased or buttered 9-inch dish and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Sugar-Cured Hams
directions: Mix together. Pat on fresh hams; wrap in brown paper. Tie string around ham, to secure paper., Place in a cotton "sack." Hang in a cool dry place for ham to cure.

title: Crunchy Jumble Cookies
directions: Sift flour, salt and soda., Set aside., Mix margarine and sugar., Add egg and vanilla., Add flour mixture., Stir in Rice Krispies and butterscotch or chocolate bits., Drop by teaspoon on lightly-greased cookie sheet., Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Festive Cup
directions: Add to water all spices, sugar and rind., Bring to a boil., Add the bottle of wine., Simmer for 1/2 hour., Strain before serving.

title: Broccoli Cheese Casserole
directions: Prepare broccoli by boiling only 5 minutes, then drain. Combine eggs, mayo, soup and cheese. Stir in broccoli. Cover with crushed crackers. Bake in 350° oven for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Jenny'S Cornbread Salad
directions: Combine salad dressing mix, sour cream and mayonnaise; set aside., Place half of the crumbled cornbread in the bottom of a large serving bowl., Top with half of the beans., In a medium bowl, combine tomatoes, green pepper and onion; layer half of the cheese, bacon, corn and reserved salad dressing., Repeat layers using remaining ingredients., Garnish as desired., Cover and chill 2 to 3 hours before serving., Yields 10 to 12 servings.

title: Easy Oven Stew
directions: Mix beef cubes and flour in large ovensafe pot., Do not brown meat., Add other ingredients and stir., Bake covered at 300° for 3 hours or until meat is tender., Makes 12 (1 cup) servings.

title: Beef With Cabbage And Potatoes
directions: Place large skillet on high heat., Add water, beef, potatoes, onion, garlic, salt and pepper., Cook until 1/2 liquid is reduced. Add cabbage and carrots., Cook 35 minutes or until cabbage and carrots are tender., Serves 6.

title: 24 Hour Salad For The Holidays
directions: Combine eggs, vinegar and sugar in top of double boiler., Cook over low heat, beating constantly until smooth and thickened. Remove from heat and add butter., Cool., Fold in fruit, marshmallows and whipped cream., Cover and refrigerate 24 hours. Serves 12 to 14.

title: Blueberry Cobbler
directions: Mix all, except blueberries and 2nd cup sugar. Spread over bottom of well buttered pan. Add blueberries and a 2nd cup of sugar. Pour boiling water over blueberries and sugar layer. Dot with extra butter. Bake at 315° for 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Shrimp Delight
directions: Melt butter in casserole., Cut up and blend all ingredients. Bake for 1 hour at 250°. Stir after 30 minutes., This makes a big casserole.

title: Mexican Casserole
directions: Fry hamburger until brown., Drain., Add onion to meat., Spread beans in a 8 x 11-inch pan., Crumble chips and spread on beans. Add hamburger with onions to chips and beans., Pour diluted sauce on top of meat., Top with grated cheese and olives., Bake at 350° until bubbly and heated, about 20 minutes.

title: Poppy Seed Chicken
directions: Place chicken in casserole dish., Mix sour cream and soup. Pour over chicken., Pour melted butter over crackers., Add poppy seed (optional) and mix well., Put cracker mix on top of chicken. Bake until bubbly, about 30 minutes at 350°., Serve over rice or alone as a casserole.

title: Seven Layer Magic Cookie Bars
directions: Preheat oven to 350° (325° for glass dish)., In 13 x 9-inch baking pan, melt margarine in oven., Sprinkle graham cracker crumbs over margarine., Pour Eagle Brand milk evenly over crumbs. Top with remaining ingredients in order listed and press down firmly., Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until lightly browned., Cool. Chill, if desired., Cut into squares.

title: Garden Zucchini Pie
directions: In a large mixing bowl, combine 1 egg, onion and Parmesan cheese., Stir in potatoes., Put potato mixture in a 9-inch pie pan or 10-inch quiche dish., Pat the mixture over the bottom and up the sides of the pan., Bake, uncovered, in a 400° oven for 35 to 40 minutes or until golden brown., Cool slightly on a wire rack. Reduce oven temperature to 350°.

title: Potato Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients together and pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 1 hour., Can top with crushed cornflakes combined with melted margarine before baking.

title: Cube Steak
directions: Brown cube steaks., Place in casserole dish., Can add a little dry onion soup mix., Add the cream of chicken soup and a little water., Bake at 325° to 350° for 2 hours or until tender., Gravy can be used to put over potatoes., Can also cook on top of stove. Simmer for 1/2 to 1 hour or until tender.

title: Squash Casserole
directions: Mix, covering with crackers., Bake at 400° for 30 minutes.

title: Sweet Potato Balls
directions: Drain potatoes., Mash up., Add butter, brown sugar, nuts and coconut., Mix well., Form into balls around large marshmallows, then roll in crushed corn flakes., Place on greased cookie sheet. Warm for about 10 minutes in 350° oven.

title: Turtles
directions: Melt first two ingredients in top of double boiler., Add 3 cups chopped or broken pecans., Spoon out on greased cookie sheet. Put in freezer until hard or overnight., Melt chocolate and wax in double boiler., Dip candy in mixture using tongs., Place on wax paper to set up., Do not use foil because the candy will stick to it., When taking from freezer to dip in chocolate, wait only until you can stick a toothpick in it and then dip in chocolate.

title: Potato Soup
directions: Boil, potatoes	and, onion in small amount of water and cook until, soft., Add, milk,, salt, and pepper, then reheat. Brown flour, in, butter, and, blend, it slowly into the potato mixture. Add, a, little water to the beaten egg and stir into the soup. Let, cook for a few minutes, very slowly, and serve hot with a little chopped parsley, sprinkled on top., Yummy on a cold winter night.

title: Sugar Cookies
directions: Drop by teaspoon on greased cookie sheet., Bake 15 to 18 minutes at 350° or until light brown. Makes 3 or 4 dozen.

title: Moist Crispy Chicken
directions: Combine cereal, paprika, salt and pepper., Brush chicken breasts with mayo., Place crumb mixture in plastic bag and add chicken., Shake to coat well., Place chicken in a greased baking dish and bake at 425° for 40 to 50 minutes or until chicken is tender.

title: No Bake Cookies
directions: In a saucepan, combine milk, sugar, shortening and peanut butter., Bring to a boil; let boil for 1 minute., Remove from heat., Add cocoa, vanilla and oats., Mix well., Drop by teaspoon onto wax paper., Let cool completely until firm.

title: Corn And Chicken Chowder
directions: Melt butter and add onion., Cook and stir until onion is light yellow., Add chicken, potatoes, celery and chicken stock; simmer until vegetables are tender., Add corn, milk and seasonings; heat thoroughly., Add more salt and pepper, if desired.

title: Port Wine Cheese Ball
directions: Combine cheese food, softened cream cheese and 2 tablespoons margarine; mix until well blended., Add remaining ingredients; mix well., Mold into ball., Roll in chopped pecans., Refrigerate. Makes 1 ball.

title: Peach Cobbler
directions: Melt margarine in bottom of a large pan., Mix first 4 ingredients well., Pour batter in pan on melted margarine., Pour peaches (2 cups) over batter., Do not stir., Bake at 350° until bubbly and brown.

title: Orange Sangria
directions: Cut orange in half., Slice one half., With a vegetable peeler, cut off the thin outer peel of the other half of the orange., In a bowl, using a wooden spoon, mash peel into the sugar so sugar absorbs the oils; then add remaining ingredients., Cover and chill., Remove peels after 15 minutes., Serve over ice., Makes 1 1/2 quarts.

title: Alabama Camp Stew
directions: Boil all meat together in enough water to cover meats., Cook until tender., Remove bones and grind meat., Cook potatoes, tomatoes and onions in meat broth until potatoes crumble to touch. Stir well while cooking., When vegetables are done, add ground meat and stir well over low heat., Add all remaining ingredients, except corn and butter., Mix well and season to taste., Let simmer for about 1 hour, stirring frequently., Add corn and simmer, stirring constantly, for about 15 minutes., Serve with crackers.

title: Blender Corn Pudding
directions: Put corn, eggs, flour, salt and sugar in blender; turn on and off twice at low speed., Add milk and stir until blended., Grease baking dish and cut up rest of margarine in dish., Pour mixture in center., Stir twice during first 15 minutes of baking to distribute the margarine., Continue baking at 325° for 30 minutes., Serves 6 to 8.

title: Peanut Butter Chiffon Pie
directions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water., Cool to lukewarm., Whip cream cheese until soft and beat in sugar and peanut butter. Slowly add gelatin mix, blending thoroughly., Fold in whipped topping., Pour in graham cracker crust., Chill 1 to 2 hours.

title: Pizza Burgers
directions: Grind chipped ham and american cheese together in food processor., Cook sauce., Cook ground beef, salt, oregano and parsley., Place sauce and beef mixture in a crockpot., Then add ham and cheese mixture., Warm on low.

title: Pineapple Sherbet Punch
directions: Mix juices and water., Add sherbet and ice cream., Makes 7 1/4 quarts., Serves 60 or more punch cups.

title: Cherry Delight Salad
directions: Mix all together and chill before serving.

title: No Fail Pie Crust
directions: Mix first 3 ingredients with a pastry blender until it reaches consistency of coarse corn meal., Blend remaining ingredients into flour mixture.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
directions: Put potatoes into well buttered, baking dish, alternating layers, with, white sauce made, from, other, ingredients. Cover top with bread crumbs and chopped onions.

title: Homemade Chili
directions: Cook beans until done., Drain., Add tomato juice and tomatoes. Cook ground beef, onion and pepper until done., Drain., Add to the bean mixture., Add chili hot beans and chili powder, salt and pepper to taste., Add cooked macaroni (optional).

title: Chocolate Pound Cake
directions: Cream together the sugar and butter., Add shortening., Add eggs, one at a time., Sift the dry ingredients and add alternately with milk., Mix in vanilla., Bake in greased tube pan for 1 1/2 hours at 325°.

title: Veg-All Casserole
directions: Drain Veg-All and water chestnuts., Mix ingredients together and bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes., Cover while baking.

title: Super Seaside Sandwiches
directions: Combine salad dressing, cucumber and milk., Mix well., Combine tuna, bread crumbs, 1 cup salad dressing, eggs and onions., Mix lightly., Shape into 6 patties., Brown on both sides in margarine. Cover each bread slice with lettuce, tomato and patty., Top with cucumber mixture.

title: Mrs. Beck'S Brunswick Stew
directions: Cook the first 4 ingredients together on warm overnight. Remove chicken bones and skin., Cut up and add the other ingredients., Cook until corn is tender., Thicken with mashed potatoes.

title: Crabmeat Supreme
directions: Melt cheese and margarine in double boiler., (I prefer crock-pot.), Add other ingredients and let simmer., (Seafood flavor increases as it simmers.), Add olives at serving time. Serve in patty shells, over toast points, rice or noodles., Serves 12.

title: Romanian Chicken Breasts
directions: Fry chicken breasts in oil until brown. Season well with salt and pepper to taste. Remove from pan. To oil, add ham, onion, celery, and basil, simmer for 5 minutes, stirring. Add paste to broth. Return chicken back to skillet and simmer 1 hour or until done. Turn chicken breasts occasionally. Cook spaghetti in boiling water, drain well. Sprinkle chicken with parsley and serve over spaghetti. Makes 6 servings.

title: Jello Salad
directions: Mix jello and boiling water and let cool., Add remaining ingredients., Mix., Pour into jello mold sprayed with Pam. Congeal several hours., Serves 6 to 8.

title: Pork Chop Dinner
directions: Slice potatoes thin and put in bottom of casserole dish., Add sliced onions, pork chops and mushroom soup., Cover and cook at 325° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Veg-All Casserole
directions: Combine drained vegetables, onion, cheese, mayonnaise and soup; mix well., Pour mixture into a lightly greased 9 x 13-inch casserole dish., Bake at 350° for 1 hour., Sprinkle crushed crackers over top of casserole., Return to oven and bake until crumbs are lightly browned., Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Hamburger Casserole
directions: Mix sour cream, cream cheese and onion; let stand several hours., Brown beef, salt and sugar together., Add garlic and tomato

title: Chicken Or Turkey Salad
directions: Wash lettuce; dry thoroughly with paper towel., Toss with salad oil until well covered., Arrange on 4 salad plates., Put diced meat and celery into bowl., Moisten with a little salad oil and add mayonnaise, salt and pepper., Toss until well mixed. Spoon onto salad plates., Garnish with hard-cooked eggs and tomato slices., Makes 4 servings.

title: Breakfast Casserole
directions: Fry sausage; drain and let it get cold., Mix all ingredients together in a 9 x 13-inch pan., Stir well., Cover and refrigerate overnight., Preheat oven to 350° and set casserole out on counter for about 30 minutes., Bake at 350° for about 1 hour., This is great for company!

title: Alison'S Enchiladas
directions: Brown ground beef., Drain., Set aside., Simmer mild enchilada sauce with 1 can mashed, stewed tomatoes and chili powder., Simmer 10 minutes.

title: Hot Swiss And Almond Spread
directions: Combine cream cheese and salad dressing., Stir in remaining ingredients., Spread mixture into 9-inch pie plate., Bake at 350° for 15 minutes, stirring after 8 minutes., Serve with crackers. Makes 2 1/3 cups.

title: Mock Apple Pie
directions: Bring water, sugar and cream of tartar to a boil., Drop in your crackers, but	do, not, stir.	Pour, into, unbaked pie shell. Sprinkle, with cinnamon., Dot with butter., Bake until shell is browned.

title: Easy "Magic" Cookie Bars
directions: Pour melted butter onto the bottom of a 13 x 9-inch pan. Sprinkle crumbs evenly over butter., Sprinkle nuts over crumbs, then sprinkle chocolate or butterscotch, then sprinkle coconut, then over all, pour the milk., Bake at 350° for 25 minutes., Cool in pan and cut into bars.

title: Sour Cream Raisin Pie
directions: Combine sugar, salt, eggs and spices., Blend in cream and vinegar; add raisins., Mix well., Place in pie pan and bake 1 hour or until set in 350° oven.

title: 7-Up Cake
directions: Cream butter and sugar., Add eggs, then add flour, 7-Up and lemon extract., Bake in a 350° oven for 50 minutes.

title: Lanice'S Potato Soup
directions: Peel and grate potatoes in large pot., Dice onion and green pepper., Add water (enough to cover potatoes)., Bring to a boil; reduce to simmer and cover for 20 to 30 minutes or until potatoes are tender., Add cheese and milk; cook 10 minutes longer to melt cheese., Add salt and pepper to taste.

title: Scotch Shortbread
directions: Mix together thoroughly the first 3 ingredients., Sift in the flour; mix thoroughly with hands., Roll out to 1/3 to 1/2-inch thick., Chill; cut into finger size pieces., Place on ungreased cookie sheet., Prick with a fork; press edges with fork., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes., Watch closely, as they brown quickly.

title: Tomato Dumplings
directions: Heat the first five ingredients in saucepan with tight fitting cover.

title: Broccoli-Rice Casserole
directions: Cook rice per directions on box., After rice is cooked, combine all ingredients, except margarine, in 2-quart casserole. Melt margarine and mix in., Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

title: Chicken Parisienne(Crock-Pot Recipe)
directions: Sprinkle chicken lightly with salt, pepper and paprika., Place in crock-pot., Mix wine, soup and sour cream., Pour over chicken and sprinkle with more paprika., Cover and cook on low for 6 to 8 hours.

title: Kahlua(Coffee Liqueur)
directions: Dissolve sugar and instant coffee in hot water., Add alcohol and vanilla; stir., Store for 30 days (or 30 minutes), depending on urgency., Everclear is available at drug or liquor stores.

title: Layered Spinach Salad
directions: Combine cheese and bacon; mix well., In 2 1/2-quart bowl, layer spinach, cheese mixture, mushrooms, onions and peas. Combine mayonnaise, sour cream and sugar; mix well., Spread over salad to seal., Sprinkle 2 tablespoons cheese over top; cover. Refrigerate overnight., Makes 8 servings.

title: Honey Bun Cake
directions: Combine first four ingredients in bowl, mixing well., Pour into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Mix brown sugar and cinnamon in bowl., Sprinkle over batter. Swirl batter with knife. Bake, using cake mix directions. Combine remaining ingredients in small bowl., Drizzle over warm cake.

title: Coconut Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients and pour into 3 (9-inch) round cake pans. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes. Cool.

title: Macaroni Salad
directions: Boil macaroni and eggs., Mix all ingredients together in a large bowl., Garnish with paprika., Chill and serve.

title: Cranberry Cookies
directions: Heat oven to 375°., Mix sugars and margarine., Stir in milk, orange juice and egg., Stir in remaining ingredients except Browned Butter Glaze., Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls about 2 inches apart onto greased cookie sheet., Bake until light brown, 10 to 15 minutes., Cool; spread with glaze., Makes about 5 1/2 dozen cookies.

title: Mississippi Mud Cake
directions: Mix ingredients together except marshmallow cream., Spread into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake 30 minutes at 350°., Take from oven and spread immediately with marshmallow cream., Let cool, then ice.

title: Christmas Mints
directions: Cream all ingredients well., Form into small balls., Place on wax paper., Press flat with fork or bottom of glass., Let stand until firm.

title: Meat Loaf
directions: Mix it all together and bake 1 hour at 325°., Top with a small can of tomato sauce for the last few minutes of cooking, if you like.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Brown onion in 1 teaspoon butter., Add broccoli, soup, milk and cheese., Cook until cheese is melted., Add rice., Bring to boil and then remove from heat., Pour all contents into baking dish., Bake at 350° until brown on top.

title: Turkey And Black Bean Chili
directions: In a large saucepan over medium-low heat, cook onion, pepper, carrots and garlic in hot oil until golden brown and tender. Sprinkle with chili powder and ground cumin. Cook, stirring frequently, 7 to 8 minutes until spices are fragrant. Add ground turkey breast and cook, stirring with wooden spoon to break up meat, about 5 minutes or until cooked through and slightly brown. Add beans, broth, salsa and tomato paste. Bring to a simmer. Reduce heat to medium. Cook, stirring occasionally, 45 minutes or until thickened. Makes 8 servings.

title: Savory Vegetable Dip
directions: In a small bowl, combine all ingredients except vegetables; mix well., Chill 1 hour to blend flavors., Refrigerate., Serve with fresh vegetables.

title: Caramel Icing
directions: Cook the first 3 ingredients in saucepan until sugar is melted and mixture is hot., Stir in the confectioners sugar.

title: Rich Frosted Brownies
