directions: Drain beans in colander and rinse well., Mix sugar, oil and vinegar in covered jar., Shake well., Chop fine or mince pepper and onion. Mix all ingredients well in bowl., Tastes better when made a day ahead.

title: Plantation Pumpkin Pie
directions: Beat all the ingredients together., Beat egg whites stiff and fold into mixture., Pour into unbaked pie shell., Bake in very hot oven at 450° for 10 minutes., Reduce heat to 375° and bake until knife comes out clean.

title: Watergate Salad
directions: Mix pistachio mix and milk., Add other ingredients., Better to refrigerate.

title: Party Chicken Salad
directions: Sprinkle chicken with lemon juice and salt; chill several hours., Add celery, grapes, chopped eggs, mayonnaise and almonds; toss lightly., Season salad with salt to taste., Serve in lettuce-lined bowl.

title: Coconut Buttermilk Pie
directions: Slightly beat eggs and melt margarine., Combine all ingredients and pour in an unbaked pie shell., Bake at 425° for 15 minutes and then reduce oven temperature to 350°., Bake until knife inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Hamburger Bean Casserole
directions: Saute onions and bell peppers., Add ground beef and brown. Remove from heat., Add remaining ingredients and mix well., Bake for 30 minutes in 400° oven., Remove from oven and sprinkle with sharp cheese, if desired., It is better when made ahead of time. Very good for a picnic or covered dish to take out.

title: Lemon Snowballs
directions: Cream shortening and sugar together in bowl until light and fluffy., Add lemon rind and egg; beat well., Stir in lemon juice and water., Sift flour, baking soda, cream of tartar and salt into separate bowl., Add to shortening mixture and blend well., Stir in nuts., Refrigerate dough until well chilled.

title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Pie(No Bake)
directions: Mix peanut butter, chocolate syrup, milk and Cool Whip with a mixer until blended., Pour into pie shell and freeze for about 2 hours to set., Serve frozen!

title: Carrot Coin Coleslaw
directions: Combine cabbage, carrot, green pepper, radishes and enough salad dressing to moisten., Garnish with green pepper rings, if desired., Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Aunt Susan'S Waffles
directions: Mix dry ingredients and sift. Beat egg yolks until lemon colored and add with milk to dry ingredients., Add melted butter. Beat egg whites until stiff and fold into batter., Bake in preheated waffle iron.

title: Frito-Chili Pie
directions: Place 1 1/2 cups Fritos in baking dish., Arrange chopped onions and half of grated cheese over Fritos., Heat chili; pour over onions and cheese., Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.

title: Macaroni Salad
directions: Mix first 3 ingredients in pan and heat until sugar is dissolved., Cool, then add mayonnaise, turmeric, celery salt, salt and pepper., Cook macaroni until tender., Drain and pour cold water over it again and drain., Mix with dressing (it will be soupy). Cover and refrigerate overnight., Next day, add celery, onion, pepper and eggs., Cover and refrigerate several hours.

title: Quik Cookies
directions: Mix Bisquick and pudding together., Add oil and beaten egg. Mix all ingredients together., Shape into small balls., Place on cookie sheet and flatten with glass dipped into sugar, as it will stick otherwise., Bake at 375° for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: "Coffee" Fat Free Ice Cream
directions: Prepare mix and chill., Freeze in ice cream freezer according to manufacturer's directions.

title: Oatmeal Banana Muffins
directions: Blend the butter, eggs, bananas and honey., Add the yogurt and soda., Cream well., Add the flour and oats and mix., Fill 16 to 18 muffin cups 2/3 full., Bake at 375° for 18 to 20 minutes., These freeze well.

title: Deep Fried Turkey(My Son, Tracy, Cooks This)
directions: Thaw turkey., Rub with Tabasco sauce and rub in Tony's Creole seasoning; repeat overnight., Heat oil to 375°., Drop turkey in grease., Cook 3 minutes per pound., Turkey will float to top of oil when ready, just like fish., Turkey will come out golden brown., Oil must completely cover, whether frying whole turkey, breast or legs.

title: Mama'S Apple Salad
directions: Peel, core and dice apples., Pour vinegar over them; set aside. Pour remaining ingredients in saucepan; heat over medium heat, stirring constantly so as not to burn or scorch, until thickened. Pour over apples., Chill and serve.

title: Cool And Creamy Pumpkin Pie
directions: In a large mixing bowl, combine pumpkin, 1/2 carton whipped topping, pudding mix and spice., Beat at low speed until well blended, 1 to 2 minutes., Spread into crust. Top with remaining whipped topping. Quick chill in freezer for 10 minutes or until ready to serve. Dust with additional spice, if desired.

title: Traveling Cupcakes
directions: Melt margarine and chocolate in heavy saucepan., Add nuts and stir until well coated.

title: Angel Delight
directions: Mix marshmallows and milk; heat until melted., Cool., Whip the whipping cream and fold into marshmallow mixture., Add drained pineapple., Alternate layers of crushed graham crackers with salad in 2-quart glass serving bowl.

title: Scalloped Corn
directions: Combine corn, egg, onion, milk, crackers, salt and pepper. Pour into greased casserole dish., Dot with butter., Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Cook broccoli until tender., Drain; put chopped cheese and 1/2 stick butter on top to melt., Pour broccoli, cheese and oleo into casserole., Melt 1/2 stick oleo with tube of crackers and sprinkle on top of casserole., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Christmas Braid Bread
directions: Soften 1 package of dry yeast in warm water., Scald 1 cup milk, pour over sugar, salt and margarine., Cook to lukewarm., Add softened yeast and beat in flour., Turn dough onto floured board and let rise until double in bulk., Punch down and divide in 6 equal parts, cover and let stand 10 minutes., Roll each portion into lengthwise strips., Use 3 strips for each loaf, braid together.

title: Instant Potato Bake
directions: Prepare potatoes as directed on package, except skimp on milk., Add onions, cottage cheese and sour cream., Mix well and place in baking dish., Put lots of butter and paprika on top. Bake until hot.

title: Taco Casserole
directions: Brown ground beef., Drain fat., Add salsa and taco seasoning. Heat thoroughly over medium heat., In casserole dish, spread even layer of smashed tortilla chips, then layer of meat., Next, spread tomatoes evenly and sprinkle with Cheddar cheese., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes., Serve with sour cream (optional).

title: Hot Chicken Salad
directions: Combine all ingredients and place in a 9 x 13-inch dish., Bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes.

title: K. K.'S Italian Beef
directions: I use enough water in gravy mix to almost cover meat., I break whole bay leaves into pieces.

title: Chop Suey
directions: Cook pork in hot oil until brown., Add onion, celery and green pepper., Cook 4 to 5 minutes., Combine cornstarch with a little water, then stir in remaining water and bouillon cube., Add to vegetable mixture., Cook until just thick., Add bean sprouts, water chestnuts and soy sauce., Heat., Serve with rice., Garnish with toasted almonds, if desired.

title: Spinach Dip
directions: Mix all except spinach., Blend well., Add spinach., Mix well and refrigerate until served., Serve with fresh vegetables or Fritos., This keeps well and freezes well also.

title: Hearty Corn Chowder
directions: Saute onion in oil., Add water, potatoes and seasonings., Cook until potatoes are tender, about 15 minutes., Mash potatoes slightly., Add corn and milk., Heat until simmering., Be careful soup does not boil., Serve with parsley garnish, if desired.

title: Easy Chile Rellenos
directions: Use a big pan or electric skillet.

title: Brownies (Large Batch)
directions: Cream together sugar and shortening., Add eggs and milk., Sift together flour, baking powder, cocoa and salt., Add to the creamed mixture and stir in nutmeats and vanilla., Beat well., Pour into cookie sheet., Bake at 350° for 25 minutes., Frost, if desired.

title: Apple Pie With A Touch Of Butterscotch
directions: Heat oven to 425 degrees., Mix sugar with apple pie filling and pour into bottom pie crust., Sprinkle with cinnamon and dot with butter., Place second crust over filling; press together and seal. Sprinkle a small amount of sugar over top of second crust. Cut small slits in top of crust to vent., Bake 35 to 40 minutes. Let cool; top with pecan halves and zig-zag small streams of butterscotch over pie to decorate.

title: Refrigerator Pickles
directions: Mix all cold ingredients together thoroughly., Pour over thinly sliced cucumbers., Pour slowly so you can pack cukes in tightly., Place in refrigerator., Ready to eat in 2 to 3 days. Delicious and easy.

title: Chicken Risotto
directions: In a large skillet, melt 2 tablespoons butter., Add chicken and cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until pieces are browned, about 5 minutes., Remove chicken from skillet., Add remaining butter, rice and garlic to skillet and cook, stirring constantly, until rice is lightly browned, about 5 minutes., Add mushrooms and green onion., Continue cooking, stirring constantly, until mushrooms are tender, about 2 minutes., Stir in chicken broth and basil., Bring to a boil; cover and simmer 15 minutes. Gently stir in chicken., Continue simmering until chicken is heated through and rice is tender, about 5 minutes., Top with cheese and serve immediately., Serves 6.

title: New England Style Clam Chowder
directions: Saute onion, celery and potato in butter., Add clams and juice., Simmer for 15 minutes., Add potato soup., Simmer for 1 hour; stir often., Do not boil. Add evaporated milk and half and half., Bring to a high simmer without boiling., Add pepper and Texas Pete., Serve hot., Serves 8., Freezes well.

title: Chicken Roll-Ups
directions: Place Tater Tots in 13 x 9-inch pan., Combine margarine, garlic salt, marjoram and oregano., Mix. Pour over 1/2 mixture on Tater Tots., Take 3 whole chicken breasts, split in half, debone, remove skin and fat., Pound flat; on each flattened chicken breast, lay one slice thin ham, one slice cheese, roll up., Put seam side down on Tater Tots., Pour rest of herb butter over each chicken breast. Cover tightly with foil., Bake 30 minutes at 375°., Uncover., Bake 20 to 30 minutes more., Serves 6.

title: Tar Heel Pie
directions: Melt chocolate and margarine in microwave and stir until smooth., Blend all remaining ingredients except pie shell together and mix with chocolate., Pour into the pie shell., Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Meat Sauce For Spaghetti
directions: Saute beef, onion and green pepper., Add tomato soup and other ingredients., Turn heat down to simmer and allow to heat 1 hour. Add water as desired., Pour over cooked pasta.

title: Mexican Cabbage
directions: Brown ground beef., Add remaining ingredients, except cabbage and continue cooking over medium heat for 10 to 15 minutes, stirring occasionally., Add cabbage., Cover; reduce heat and simmer until cabbage is done.

title: Cornbread Salad
directions: Cook cornbread per package., Cool and crumble into bite-size chunks.

title: Hot Artichoke Spread
directions: Drain artichoke hearts and chop., Mix with mayonnaise and cheese., Bake at 350° until bubbly., Serve with Melba toast, sliced fresh bread or unsalted crackers.

title: Cheese Grits
directions: Cook grits in water & salt until thickening., Add rest of ingredients, stir well. Pour in greased 7x11 casserole., Bake at 350 degrees, uncovered for 30 minutes, or until set.

title: Peanut Butter Cake
directions: Cream sugar and shortening; add peanut butter, egg and milk. Add dry ingredients., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until done.

title: Grapefruit Salad With Champagne Dressing(Serves 6)
directions: Combine first five ingredients in a small bowl., Stir with a wire whisk until blended., Cover and chill.

title: Triple Onion Potato Lasagna(Original Recipe)
directions: Preheat oven to 350°. Brown the ground beef, onion and green pepper in skillet. Drain well. Stir in to your taste the garlic powder, Worcestershire, sauce, chili powder, Tabasco, Italian seasoning and pepper, spaghetti sauce, water and onion soup mix. Simmer 5 minutes. Slice Velveeta (or use shredded Cheddar). Place half of meat/sauce mixture in greased 9 x 13-inch. Place layer of fries over meat. Sprinkle potatoes with pepper. Top with cheese. Top with remaining meat/sauce mixture. Bake 30 to 40 minutes. Top with onion rings. Bake 5 more minutes.

title: Butter Bars
directions: Cream butter and sugar; add egg yolk, vanilla and flour. Spread evenly on cookie sheet., Beat egg white slightly (until foamy)., Spread and sprinkle nuts on top and bake in slow oven (300°) for 40 minutes.

title: Pizza Joes
directions: Brown sausage in a skillet; drain off excess fat., Add peppers, onions, mushrooms, seasonings and garlic., Cook 2 minutes., Stir in tomato sauce and simmer, uncovered, for 10 minutes., Top each muffin half with 2 tablespoons meat sauce; sprinkle with cheese., Broil until cheese melts and filling is hot., Serve immediately., Yields 12 servings.

title: Martha'S Cream Pie
directions: Mix all ingredients together except egg whites (reserved for meringue), margarine and vanilla. Bring these ingredients to a simmer on stove and stir until thick. Stir in margarine and vanilla. Pour into an 8-inch baked pie shell. Top with meringue and bake at 375° until golden brown, 5 to 8 minutes.

title: Church Punch
directions: Divide in thirds and mix, depending on bowl size.

title: Golden Pound Cake Suprise
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Beat extra well (3 or 4 minutes)., Bake at 350° for 35 - 40 minutes in a bundt pan or 45 minutes in a tube pan.

title: Lemon Supreme Cake
directions: Mix cake mix, sugar, oil and nectar together., Add 1 egg at a time, mixing after each addition., Bake 1 hour in a greased and floured Bundt or tube pan at 325°.

title: Mashed Potatoes With Cream Cheese And Onion Dip
directions: Boil potatoes and mash., Add cream cheese and onion dip., Whip as usual., Makes plenty for large crowd.

title: Mud Dessert
directions: Make and bake cake mix as directed on box., Make pudding as directed., Layer in large bowl, first cake (cut in small pieces), pudding, Cool Whip, then Heath bars., Repeat layers, then chill.

title: Sponge Cake
directions: Separate whites and yolks of eggs., Beat whites until stiff, yolks until thick and lemon colored., Add 1 cup sugar to yolks and beat until completely mixed., Add vanilla, lemon juice and salt. Fold yolk mixture into whites very gently., Lastly, add flour, folding in gently., Use large buttered and floured tube pan., Bake in 325° oven 45 to 60 minutes., (A smaller version may be made with 4 eggs, 7/8 cup sugar and 7/8 cup flour.), Also can be used for cupcakes.

title: Chocolate Layer Dessert
directions: Layer 1: Mix flour, sugar, pecans and butter. Press into bottom of 9 x 13 pan. Bake at 350° for 10 minutes. Watch carefully; burns easily. Let cool.

title: Waldorf Salad
directions: Mix together the honey, peanut butter and mayonnaise., Fold in the raisins, celery, walnuts and apples.

title: Cabbage And Noodles
directions: Fry cabbage and onion together with soft margarine until vegetables are soft., Pour boiling water on bouillon cubes., Let set until dissolved., Then pour over cabbage and onion., Add salt, pepper and garlic salt., Simmer until really soft., Cook noodles; drain and stir noodles together with onion and cabbage., Add more garlic salt and margarine to taste.

title: Chicken Divan
directions: Cook broccoli as directed. Fresh broccoli may also be used. Do not overcook. Bake chicken breasts until tender. Spread broccoli on bottom of buttered casserole dish. Sprinkle Parmesan cheese on top of broccoli. Spread small chunks of chicken on top of broccoli. Sprinkle a little more Parmesan cheese on top. Mix together soup, mayonnaise, sour cream, cheddar cheese and lemon juice; pour over chicken. Sprinkle a little more Parmesan cheese and paprika on top. Cook for 45 minutes at 350°.

title: Crab Delight Mold
directions: Melt cream cheese in mushroom soup (no water) over low heat. Stir until cheese melts., Mix all ingredients together except water and gelatine.

title: Cream Cheese Chocolate Dessert
directions: Whip cream cheese, milk, powdered sugar and Cool Whip until smooth and pour over crust.

title: Impossible Vegetable Pie
directions: Heat oven to 400°., Lightly grease pie plate., Mix broccoli, onion, green pepper and cheese in pie plate., Beat remaining ingredients until smooth., Pour over broccoli mixture in pie plate. Bake until golden brown, about 35 or 40 minutes., Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

title: Easy Spanish Rice
directions: In skillet, cook bacon until crisp., Remove and crumble., In drippings over low heat, cook rice and onion until rice is browned and onion is soft, stirring constantly., Add V-8 juice and green pepper., Reduce heat to low and cover., Simmer 20 minutes or until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed., Garnish with bacon., Makes 4 cups.

title: Congealed Cherry Salad
directions: Mix together gelatin, boiling water and juice from crushed pineapple., Stir slowly until blended., Add can of pie cherries and 1/2 of the crushed pineapple., Stir slowly until blended. Place into 9 x 12 inch pyrex dish and let set., Mix softened cream cheese with sour cream until smooth. Add sugar., Add chopped pecans and pineapple and blend together., Spread on top of gelatin.

title: Fred Quednau Clam Chowder
directions: Fry out a good bit of white bacon., Cut into small pieces. Cook slow as to get all the grease out., Chop or grind clams, white potatoes and onions., Add clams and juice and a small amount of water; mix., When done, add a 1/2 stick of butter, salt and pepper to taste.

title: Golden Lemon Chicken
directions: Dip chicken in rice, then flour., In 12-inch skillet (or use electric skillet), brown chicken in butter., Add soup mix blended with water; place lemon on chicken., Bring to boi; simmer covered 10 minutes or until chicken is done., Serve over or with rice. Makes 4 servings.

title: Baked Corn
directions: Beat eggs; add remaining ingredients to eggs and mix well. Bake in 1 1/2 quart baking bowl in 350° oven for 1 hour.

title: Cherry Cheese Spread
directions: Combine all ingredients until well blended.

title: Taco Dip
directions: Brown ground beef and drain fat., Mix with taco seasoning and pour into 9 x 13-inch pan., Combine cream cheese and onion dip and pour over ground beef mixture., Sprinkle Cheddar cheese evenly over cream cheese mixture., Put tomato and green pepper evenly over Cheddar cheese and bake for 20 minutes in 350° oven.

title: Gone-All-Afternoon Stew
directions: Heat oven to 275°., Mix all ingredients in a 3-quart casserole or Dutch oven., Cover and bake 5 hours or until meat is tender when pierced with a fork., Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Texas Tumbleweed Peach Cobbler
directions: Mix flour, sugar and baking powder., Add milk and whisk together., Melt a stick of oleo in a 12 x 9 or 13 x 9-inch pan. Pour batter over margarine., Do not mix margarine and batter. Arrange peaches over batter., Blend last 4 ingredients until crumbly and sprinkle over peaches., Bake about 60 minutes or until golden brown in a 350° oven., Serve warm with ice cream.

title: Ultra Quick Pasta Salad
directions: Cook noodles; drain., Add frozen vegetables and cover for 10 to 15 minutes., (Let heat from noodles unfreeze vegetables.) After 10 to 15 minutes, mix all remaining ingredients in same pan.

title: Sausage Balls
directions: Mix together and form into balls on a greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350° for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Mixed Raisin-Bran Muffins
directions: Combine dry ingredients in a large bowl., In separate bowl, mix milk, egg, molasses and oil., Add liquid ingredients to dry and mix only until dry ingredients are moistened (the mixture should be lumpy)., Spray muffin tin with cooking spray or line with baking cups., Fill each 3/4 full., Bake at 425° for 15 minutes or until tops are golden brown.

title: Sugar Cookies
directions: Sift together dry ingredients., In a separate large bowl, cream together shortening and sugar until light and fluffy., Beat eggs in one at a time., Add vanilla., Add dry ingredients and mix well (dough will be stiff)., Cover and chill dough 2 hours or more., Heat oven to 375°., Grease lightly 2 large cookie sheets. Roll about 1/3 chilled dough on lightly floured board to 1/8-inch thick., Cut out and place on a cookie sheet with a floured cookie cutter., Sprinkle cookies with sugar., Bake on top rack of oven 8 minutes or until light brown., Cool on rack., Makes 5 dozen 2-inch cookies.

title: Freezer Pickles
directions: Soak first 3 ingredients for 2 hours., Drain., Boil sugar and vinegar until sugar dissolves., Add celery seed., Put pickles in container., Pour liquid over them., Place lid on container. Freeze.

title: Icebox Fruitcake
directions: Heat juice and marshmallows until well blended., Mix all ingredients (except crumbs) in very large pan; stir in graham cracker crumbs and mix well., Pour juice mixture over fruit and stir until well blended., Pack into 10-inch tube pan., Better if prepared about 1 month before eating., Store in refrigerator.

title: Ham Ball
directions: Mix all ingredients (except pecans/pretzels) in a bowl. Chill in refrigerator for at least 2 hours. Form into a ball and roll in pecans or pretzels.

title: Curry-Cajun Chicken
directions: In a 3-quart rectangular baking dish, combine honey, water, mustard, melted margarine or butter, Cajun seasoning, curry powder, lemon juice and garlic powder; mix well., Add chicken, turning to coat., Arrange in a single layer., Bake, uncovered, in a 350° oven for about 30 minutes or until chicken is tender and no longer pink.

title: Grammer Youngblood'S Prune Cake
directions: In a large mixing bowl, add ingredients., This makes a 4 layer cake.

title: Aunt Toe'S Prune Cake
directions: Mix and pour into 9 x 13-inch pan (greased and floured)., Bake 40 minutes at 350°., Cut into squares while hot and pour Hot Mixture over cake.

title: Picante Dip
directions: Soften cream cheese and mix with picante sauce., Serve with any kind of chip.

title: Grandpa'S Chili
directions: Brown beef and onions., Drain fat., Add all the ingredients and bring to a boil., Simmer for 40 minutes; stir often., Serve with cornbread.

title: Punch
directions: Peel and core apples., Cut into quarters or eighths., Slice one gallon of apples., Put in a large churn., Put 2 tablespoons sulphur in a teacup and heat on live coals., Drop it on the sulphur that is in a cup, that's burning good or has a good blaze., Cover it up. Let it stay all day or night., Repeat the process for about 3 days. Repeat each time you add more apples., Make a little hole in center of apple so your teacup will set in., Stir apples each time you add more apples., If you fill a 10 gallon churn, don't put over a gallon a day or every other day., Stir before you add more apples. Put sulphur in each time you add more apples and burn sulphur. Cover churn with an old quilt about 4 thicknesses., Keep airtight while burning sulphur., Be sure the sulphur is burning at all times., Burn about 3 days and add more apples., You also can take a blow torch and heat a metal nut red hot and drop it in the sulphur. See that it is burning good before you put it in the apples.

title: Boston Baked Beans
directions: Rinse beans in cold water and drain., Bring to a boil and boil for two minutes., Remove from heat., Cover loosely and let stand for 1 hour., Return to heat and bring to a boil.

title: Pumpkin Pie
directions: *May use 2 1/4 teaspoons pumpkin pie spice instead of these spices.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
directions: Cook chicken breasts; bone and	cut into pieces., Place in 9 x 13-inch baking dish., Cover, with, vegetables, then add soups. Mix flour, margarine and, milk, together; pour on top. Bake at 375° for 45 minutes.

title: Friendship Tea
directions: Mix all ingredients. Store in jars., Use 2 to 3 teaspoons to a cup of hot water.

title: Mushroom-Potato Casserole
directions: Heat mushroom soup, water and 1 1/2 cups cheese., Pour mushroom mixture over potatoes and meat., Sprinkle with remaining cheese, salt and pepper to taste., Bake at 375° for 45 minutes or until potatoes are done., (If desired, cook in crock-pot for several hours on low.)

title: Velvet Smooth Pound Cake
directions: Combine butter and flavorings; gradually beat in sugar and cream until light and fluffy., Beat in 1 egg, 1/4 cup flour and repeat until eggs are used; add remaining flour and stir until smooth., Spread batter in greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan., Cut through with knife to break air bubbles., Bake at 325° for 1 hour. Remove from pan immediately., Cool on cake rack.

title: Quick Cheese Loaf
directions: Combine baking mix, milk, eggs and dry mustard in bowl; mix well., Stir in cheese., Spoon into greased 5 x 9-inch loaf pan. Bake at 350° for 40 to 50 minutes or until golden brown. Invert onto wire rack., Slice and serve warm.

title: Scrambled Eggs In Puff Pastry* * * * *
directions: Roll out the puff pastry 1/8-inch thick on a floured surface. Cut out 8 rounds with a 3 1/2 to 4-inch fluted cutter and invert them onto a buttered baking sheet., Score the rounds lightly in a cross hatch pattern with a sharp knife; brush them with some of the egg wash and bake in the middle of a preheated 400° oven for 12 to 15 minutes, or until they are golden and puffed., Let the rounds cool on a rack while preparing the eggs., In a large skillet, saute the mushrooms in 4 tablespoons of the butter over moderately high heat, stirring occasionally, until the liquid they give off is evaporated, then keep them warm, covered., In a bowl, beat together the eggs, white pepper and salt to taste., In a large heavy skillet, heat remaining butter over moderate heat until the foam starts to subside; add all but 1/2 cup of the eggs and cook the mixture, stirring constantly with a whisk, for 8 minutes or until it is very thick and creamy.

title: Scalloped Corn
directions: Butter your casserole and pour your mixture in and bake at 375° for 60 minutes.

title: Chicken And Broccoli Casserole
directions: Grease casserole., Put broccoli on bottom, then chicken. Combine soup, broth, lemon juice, mayonnaise and curry powder. Pour sauce over all., Sprinkle with bread crumbs and cheese., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Vegetable Soup
directions: Saute meat in skillet; season well. Add enough water to come halfway up on meat. Wash and clean vegetables and chop in 1/4-inch pieces. Use celery leaves with meat. Cover and cook until 1/2 slightly crunchy approximately 1 1/2 hours.

title: Gluten-Free Substitute Cream Based Soups
directions: Combine and mix well., Store in an airtight container., Mark the mix ingredients and directions on container.

title: Confetti Scalloped Potatoes
directions: In a skillet, melt butter over medium heat., Saute onion until tender., Stir in potatoes, soup and milk., Add cheese, green pepper and 1/2 cup of the crumbs and pimento., Pour in a shallow casserole., Top with remaining crumbs., Bake at 375° for 35 to 40 minutes., Serves 6 to 8.

title: Holiday Cheese Ball
directions: Mix together first 5 ingredients; add 1/4 cup pecans., Pour remaining pecans on wax paper or paper plate., Shape mixture into a ball and place in center of nuts., Place nuts around the ball until outside is covered., Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours.

title: Venician Pie
directions: Brown the ground beef and drain well., Add the remaining ingredients., Cover and simmer while making crust.

title: Curry Stew
directions: In Dutch oven, thoroughly brown meat in 2 tablespoons hot shortening, turning often., Add 2 cups hot water; bring to a boil. Add salt, pepper and garlic; cover and simmer until meat is tender, about 1 1/2 hours, stirring occasionally to keep from sticking. Add potatoes and carrots., Cover and cook for 30 to 40 minutes; test to see if vegetables are tender, then add celery and onions. Add more water if necessary., Cover and simmer for 15 minutes. Blend 1/3 cup cold water into the flour and curry powder., Stir slowly into hot stew mixture., Let simmer another 15 minutes. Serve stew over rice., Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Red Beans And Rice
directions: Simmer beans in water., After 1 1/2 hours, add onions, bell pepper, seasoning and sausage., Add water as required., Adjust seasoning as needed., When beans are tender, start cooking rice. Serve over cooked white rice.

title: Mock Filet Mignon
directions: Preheat oven, to, 450°., Combine, ground beef with rice and garlic,, Worcestershire, sauce,, salt, and pepper.	Blend well. Shape into	6 to 8 round patties (if 6 patties, will be about 1-inch, thick)., Wrap a strip of bacon around each patty and fasten, with, toothpick., Place, in ungreased shallow pan. Bake for 15, minutes or until bacon is cooked and beef patties are done as desired., Remove picks before serving.

title: Pepper Jack Stuffed Chicken
directions: Cut chicken into two 2 1/4 inch x 1 inch x 3/4 inch strips. Flatten chicken breast to 1/4 inch thickness., Place a strip of cheese down center of each breast., Fold chicken over cheese and secure with toothpicks., Rub mexican seasoning over chicken., In a large skillet, brown chicken in oil on both sides., Transfer to a greased 8 inch square baking dish., Bake uncovered at 350 degrees for 25 to 30 minutes or until chicken juices run clear.

title: Instant Cocoa Mix
directions: Sift together all ingredients., To serve, place 1/3 cup mix in a cup., Add 1 cup boiling water and stir hot., When you serve, try a cinnamon stick., Yields 5 cups mix.

title: Chicken And Dumplings
directions: In large pot, add water, salt, and chicken., Bring to a boil. Cover, reduce the heat and simmer for 1 hour or until tender (should almost fall off bone)., Remove the chicken from the broth and cool., Bone the chicken and cut meat into bite-sized pieces. Bring the broth to a boil and add pepper., Combine the flour, baking soda, and salt., Cut in the shortening., Add the buttermilk, stirring with a fork until moistened., Knead the dough 4 to 5 times and pat to 1/2-inch pieces and drop into boiling broth., Reduce the heat to medium-low, and cook for about 8 to 10 minutes, stirring occasionally., Stir in the chicken and serve.

title: Marinade For Steak Or Chicken
directions: Combine above ingredients., Marinate chicken or steak.

title: Macaroni And Cheese
directions: Cook macaroni; drain well. While hot, stir in beaten egg until coated well. Stir in grated cheese and margarine until melted. Add evaporated milk and water; salt to taste. Pour in pan or casserole dish; sprinkle with paprika. Bake in 325° oven 25 or 30 minutes. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Tahitian Pork Chops
directions: Note:, May use any hot cake syrup.

title: Microwave Light Quick Bacon Potato Salad
directions: Combine potatoes and water in 2-quart microwave casserole; cover and microwave on High 9 to 11 minutes or until tender, stirring halfway through cooking.

title: Ma~Ma'S Cornbread Dressing
directions: Cook cornbread according to recipe or package directions. Crumble. Cut or tear bread into small pieces. (Unseasoned bread crumbs can be used.) Mix breads together. Add onion, seasonings and egg. Mix well. Add hot water until moist. Add chicken/turkey stock until mixture is soupy. Bake at 350° in greased dish for approximately 30 minutes or until slightly browned on top.

title: Grilled Barracuda
directions: Marinate filleted barracuda in your favorite Italian salad dressing for 1 to 3 days in the refrigerator.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
directions: Cut chicken breasts into chunks and brown. Mix chicken broth, cream soup, frozen vegetables, salt and pepper and cornstarch together. Add in browned chicken chunks., Line large pan with first crust; pour mixture into crust., Cover mixture with second crust., Bake at 375° for 45 to 60 minutes.

title: Cheese Wafers
directions: Combine butter, cheddar cheese flour and cayenne pepper., Mix by hand to form a firm dough., Shape into a roll and chill until firm., Slice 1/4, inch thick., Place on an ungreased baking sheet. Bake at 350 degrees for 8 - 10 minutes., Remove from oven let cool for 2 minutes and remove to serving dish.

title: Punch
directions: Puree strawberries in punch bowl., Combine strawberries and remaining ingredients, except ginger ale., Stir until sugar dissolves., Before serving add the ginger ale., Float 1/2 gallon vanilla ice cream or orange sherbet in punch.

title: Zucchini Pepper Relish
directions: Grind all vegetables and mix together with salt., Let stand overnight., Rinse with cold water and drain well., Put into pot and add brine ingredients., Bring to boil and simmer for 30 minutes., Put in 6 to 8 small jars and seal., Process in boiling water for 5 minutes.

title: Stuffed Peppers
directions: Cut off tops of peppers and reserve., Clean and deseed peppers., Steam peppers in large covered pot with small amount of water until color has turned dull green., Drain and set aside. Saute onions, celery, garlic and pepper tops in butter., Add the selection of meat; cook until browned (except shrimp)., Add bread crumbs and croutons to make mixture thicken., Add fried bacon and parsley., Season to taste with salt, pepper and sauce., Spoon mixture into peppers., On top of each, make an "X" with raw bacon and fasten with toothpick., Place in pan with small amount of water in bottom., Bake at 350° for 40 minutes., Serves 8.

title: Haystacks
directions: Melt butterscotch morsels. Add nuts and stir. Add noodles and stir., Drop small spoonfuls onto waxed paper.

title: Jolly Gem Gelatin Cake
directions: Separately dissolve each package, leaving 1 lime; use 1/2 cup of boiling water each., Pour mixture of each into separate pan. When jelled, cut into 1/2-inch cubes, toss lightly., Dissolve remaining package of lime gelatin in 1 1/4 cups boiling water. Chill just until syrupy., Whip together heavy cream and 1/4 cup sugar., Fold in syrupy lime jello., Fold into jello cubes., Pour into graham cracker crust., Chill 4 hours or overnight.

title: Death By Chocolate
directions: Bake brownies according to package directions; let cool. Prick holes in top of cooled brownies and pour the coffee liqueur over brownies; set aside., Prepare chocolate mousse according to package directions., Break candy bars into small pieces., Break up half of brownies into small pieces and put in bottom of a large glass bowl or trifle dish., Cover with half the mousse, then half the candy, then half the whipped topping., Repeat layers with the remaining ingredients.

title: Hobo'S Hamburger
directions: Make 6 large hamburger patties, oval in shape., Place each patty on a large square of aluminum foil., Add a layer of potato strips., Season., On top of this, place a layer of sliced carrots. Season., Add a ring of bell pepper and 1 slice of onion., Season and top with a generous pat of butter., Fold foil up and seal tightly, making 6 separate servings., Bake for 1 hour at 275° or 300°., Serve with garlic bread and green salad.

title: Pumpkin Pie
directions: Cook all ingredients together until thick., Pour in unbaked deep dish pie crust. Bake at 300° for 1 hour.

title: Spanish Rice With Ham
directions: In a 3 quart saucepan, cook onions and green peppers in margarine until vegetables are tender, but not brown., Stir in cooked, ham,, undrained, tomatoes,, vegetable, juice cocktail, sugar and 1/4 cup water., Bring to boil., Remove from heat and stir, in, rice., Let, stand, covered, about 5 minutes or until rice is tender.

title: Strawberry Salad
directions: Pour hot water over jello., Put in frozen strawberries and pineapple., Let stand until partially jelled., Whip remaining ingredients.

title: Broccoli Cornbread
directions: Mix and bake at 350° for 40 minutes or until brown., (I put mine in a cake pan.)

title: Cajun Italian Spaghetti Sauce Mix(My Own Special Recipe; Um - Good)
directions: Cook beef and onion together and drain., Cook cocktail smokies and mushrooms and drain., Then add the remaining ingredients and simmer for about 10 minutes., This recipe can be cut in half.

title: Pumpkin Pie
directions: Mix all ingredients well., Remove pie crusts from freezer 20 minutes before baking time., Pour mixture into pie crusts., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until crust is brown., Makes 2 pies.

title: Rolled Chicken Breast
directions: Place chicken on board., Pound lightly to make cutlets., Salt or season., Place ham slice, cheese stick or two and chestnut on each cutlet., Tuck in sides and roll up., Skewer., Coat in flour (1/4 cup) and brown in butter., Remove to baking pan., In same skillet, combine 1/2 cup water, chicken base, mushrooms and wine. Simmer; deglaze., Pour over chicken in baking pan., Cover and bake at 350° for 1 to 1 1/4 hours., Blend 2 tablespoons flour and 1/2 cup water., Add to gravy in baking pan., Cook until thick., Pour over chicken., Place on serving plate.

title: Sausage Casserole
directions: Brown sausage, onion, celery salt and garlic., Drain well. Add remaining ingredients; bring to a boil., Lower heat and simmer, covered, for 18 minutes.

title: Party Cheese Ball(Makes About 24 Servings)
directions: Day Before:, Place deviled ham in a small bowl; freeze 1/2 hour or until firm., With hands, shape chilled ham into a ball. Cover evenly with cream cheese., Refrigerate until firm, then smooth surface with hands., Cover with plastic wrap; refrigerate.

title: Million Dollar Pie
directions: Preheat your oven to 350° and prepare pie crust., Then, with a hand beater or wire whisk, beat the eggs well., Beat in the next 5 ingredients until well blended., Now arrange the pecans in the bottom of the pie crust., Slowly pour the egg mixture over them. Bake for 1 hour, or until a knife inserted 1-inch from edge comes out clean., Let it cool, then serve it with good old whipped cream!

title: Layered Lettuce Salad
directions: Put lettuce in a 9 x 13-inch glass dish., Layer rest of ingredients, except mayonnaise mixture and cheese, as listed., Put mayonnaise mixture on top, then sprinkle on the cheese. Refrigerate at least 8 to 12 hours before serving.

title: Banana Pudding
directions: In saucepan, combine sugar, cornstarch and salt; gradually stir in milk. Cook and stir over medium heat until mixture boils and thickens. Cook 2 minutes longer. Remove from heat.

title: Easy Beef Tips
directions: Take a small boneless chuck roast, cut into small squares and roll in flour., Cover the bottom of a roasting pan with flour and add enough water to make a medium paste., Place meat in pan., Add salt, pepper, garlic powder, bouillon cubes and sliced mushrooms. Add enough water to completely cover meat ., Bake at 350° for about 1 1/2 hours or until tender., May need to add a little more water during cooking., This should make a thick gravy as it cooks. Serve over noodles or rice.

title: Stewed Chicken
directions: Wash, cut and dry chicken; brown in oil., Place in 3-quart casserole and add other ingredients., Cook, uncovered, 1 1/2 to 2 hours at 350° or until chicken becomes loosened from bone., Salt and pepper to taste., Serves 4.

title: Peanut Butter Crumb Cake
directions: Mix brown sugar, flour, salt and peanut butter. Add margarine. Mix until mixture is of corn meal consistency., Reserve 1/3 of this for topping (about 2 cups)., Add sour milk, baking soda, eggs and vanilla., Pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan and sprinkle with reserved crumbs., Bake 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Watergate Cake
directions: Mix together all ingredients except nuts and coconut., After mixing other ingredients, fold in nuts and coconut., Bake in greased and floured Bundt cake pan at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Sourdough Biscuits
directions: Mix together all ingredients except butter., Shape biscuits. Roll each one in melted butter as you place it in a 12 to 15-inch cast-iron skillet., Put skillet of biscuits in cold oven., Turn on to 375°; cook for 45 minutes., When done, turn out of skillet and wrap in dish towel to steam., When cool, they may be packaged if not eaten right away.

title: Brownies
directions: Mix all ingredients thoroughly., Beat for 3 minutes., Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes in a 6 inch square pan.

title: Four-Fruit Wassail
directions: Combine ingredients in a Dutch oven., Bring to a boil; reduce heat and simmer 30 minutes., Remove 4 cinnamon sticks; serve with fresh cinnamon sticks, if desired., Yields 5 quarts.

title: Sweet And Sour Pork
directions: In large skillet, combine pineapple syrup, water, vinegar, soy sauce, cornstarch, brown sugar and salt., Mix until smooth., Bring to boil, stirring constantly., Reduce heat and simmer until clear and thickened., Add pork and remaining ingredients., Cook 5 minutes or until heated., Serve over rice.

title: Quick Fruit Dip
directions: Combine the yogurt, marmalade and the cinnamon., Cover and chill for several hours., Serve with assorted fresh fruit.

title: Fruit Salad
directions: Mix cream cheese, milk and Cool Whip., Add all other ingredients., Chill overnight.

title: Whipped Sweet Potato With Yogurt And Chives
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Mash sweet potatoes., Blend in the eggs, add yogurt and whip with a hand-held mixer until potatoes are fluffy., Add more yogurt, if needed., Stir in the chives, parsley, salt and pepper., Bake for 30 minutes or until lightly browned on the top.

title: Potato Chip Cookies
directions: Chill about an hour before baking, at 350°., Makes approximately three dozen cookies.

title: Oatmeal Muffins
directions: Blend oats in blender or food processor 1 minute., Combine ground oats, sugar, baking powder, salt and cinnamon., Add blueberries, milk, oil and egg whites., Mix until dry ingredients are moistened., Fill lined muffin cups almost full., Bake 20 to 22 minutes at 400°., Makes 1 dozen.

title: Mississippi Mud Cakes* * * * *
directions: Pawley's Island is in South Carolina near Myrtle Beach., One of the places we used to go to eat, was an old weathered clapboard house, and no matter what time you went, you had to stand in line to get in.

title: Martha Washington Chocolate Candy
directions: Blend all ingredients and roll by hand into small balls about 3/4-inch in diameter., Chill in refrigerator (about an hour or longer)., Insert toothpick into each ball and dip into chocolate paraffin mixture to coat thoroughly.

title: Two Flavor Fudge
directions: Cook sugar and milk, over medium heat until sugar dissolves and mixture boils., Cook to soft stage for 3 minutes. Remove from heat and quickly add remaining ingredients., Pour into buttered 9 x 9 x 2-inch pan., Cool.

title: Baked Chicken And Rice
directions: Melt margarine in baking dish., Sprinkle onion soup mix over margarine., Salt and pepper chicken and place in dish., Pour rice over chicken., Pour water in dish., Cover., Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Salt Substitute Seasoning
directions: Mix all spices in a bowl; put in shaker and use to season foods instead of using salt.

title: Deep Freeze Fruit Cake
directions: Crush wafers in fine crumbs., Add sweetened condensed milk and mix thoroughly., Add raisins and pecans; mix well., Press out in a wax paper-lined pie tin., Chill or freeze., May be cut in thin slices.

title: Sausage-Egg Casserole
directions: Lightly grease a 9 x 13-inch baking dish., Arrange bread cubes on bottom of dish., Brown sausage in skillet about 15 minutes. Drain and spread over bread cubes., Mix together the eggs, cheese, milk and other optional ingredients as desired., Cover and refrigerate overnight.

title: Artichoke Dip
directions: Drain artichokes well., Shred Parmesan cheese., Blend all ingredients together., Pour into pan., Bake at 400° for 30 minutes., Serve with flat crackers.

title: White Cake(This Is A Good, Simple Cake To Make.)
directions: In a bowl, cream butter with sugar., Alternately add the milk and dry ingredients., In separate bowl, beat egg whites until light, then fold into mixture., Stir in vanilla., Place in lightly greased 9 x 13-inch cake pan and bake in a 350° oven for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Diane'S Delight
directions: Mix together and chill 3 hours before serving.

title: Chicken Crescents
directions: Mix all ingredients well., Separate crescent rolls and put approximately 2 tablespoons of chicken mixture in center of each crescent roll., Bring up edges and pinch closed., Bake on cookie sheet at 350° for 9 to 11 minutes or until done.

title: Potatoes Romanoff
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Mix together all ingredients, except cornflake crumbs and margarine., Spoon into 13 x 9-inch pan. Mix together cornflake crumbs and margarine; spread evenly over potatoes., Bake for 60 minutes or until potatoes in center are golden and bubbling., Makes 10 to 12 servings., Can be prepared and refrigerated overnight, then baked just before serving.

title: Spanish Rice
directions: Cook bacon until crisp in a large skillet., Remove bacon from pan and break into bits., Add onion and pepper to bacon drippings in pan and cook until soft., Add bacon bits and remaining ingredients., Cover and cook slowly 30 minutes, stirring occasionally., Remove cloves and bay leaf., Serve hot., Makes 4 servings.

title: Scalloped Potatoes(130 Calories Per Serving)
directions: In a 2-quart saucepan, over medium heat, cook onions in margarine until tender (approximately 5 minutes)., Stir in flour, salt and pepper until blended., Gradually stir in skimmed milk. Cook until mixture thickens, stirring constantly.

title: Chocolate Cake - Pudding
directions: Mix dry ingredients., Add liquid ingredients., Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch dish.

title: German Veranicks(Easy Way)
directions: Mix everything and place in casserole dish., Dot with 1 cube butter., Top with garlic and onion croutons., Bake in a 350° oven for 1 hour or until crusty brown.

title: St. Paul'S Rice
directions: In skillet, brown meat and drain. In saucepan, boil water. Add dry soup mix and rice. Cook for 7 minutes.

title: Swiss Cheese Chicken
directions: Place chicken in baking dish., Season with salt and pepper. Place cheese over chicken., Spread soup over cheese., Sprinkle stuffing; pour butter over casserole., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Combine chicken, soup and sour cream in a large bowl., Put into a casserole dish., Cover top with crushed Ritz crackers., Pour melted margarine over crackers., Cook at 350° until crackers are brown, 30 minutes.

title: M.J.M'S Quick Chili
directions: Brown beef; drain., Add chili mix, tomatoes, beans and water. Bring to a boil., Let simmer 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Oriental Chicken And Fruit Salad
directions: Combine all ingredients., Top with almonds or Chinese noodles. Add Ranch salad dressing to taste.

title: Tortellini Salad
directions: Dice peppers, onion, tomatoes and artichokes., In a large bowl, mix vegetables, tortellini and Parmesan cheese., Add Italian dressing., Serves 4.

title: Pizza Casserole
directions: Brown and drain beef., Add all ingredients except noodles and mix well., Cook noodles as directed., Add to the rest of the ingredients., Sprinkle Mozzarella cheese on top of the casserole. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes covered and 15 minutes uncovered. Makes 2 casseroles.

title: Pot Roast Pork
directions: Rub pork with salt and pepper., Make tiny knife slits in the meat., Insert garlic slivers in slits., Broil meat 15 minutes to remove excess fat., Place 1 sliced onion in the bottom of crock-pot., Add pork roast and remaining ingredients to crock-pot. Cover and cook on high heat for 5 hours or on low 10 hours.

title: Pudding In A Cloud
directions: Spoon whipped topping evenly into 6 dessert dishes using a spoon., Spread into bottom and up sides of each dish.

title: Barbecued Roast Beef Sandwiches
directions: Make Zesty Barbecue Sauce. Stir beef into sauce. Cover and simmer about 5 minutes or until beef is, hot. Fill buns with beef mixture.

title: Radican'S Seafood Shrimp Mold
directions: Soak gelatine in 1/4 cup cold water., Heat soup to boil., Add gelatine to soup and cool., Cream together cream cheese and mayonnaise; mix into gelatine., Add chopped vegetables., Place in a 2-quart mold and refrigerate until jelled., Serve with crackers.

title: Blackened Fish
directions: Dust the fillets with flour., Heat the butter and oil in large, heavy pan over medium heat., Add fillets and cook 3 minutes on one side; turn and sprinkle seasonings evenly over the browned side., Cook another 3 minutes and turn, sprinkling this side with seasonings., Turn the heat on high and sear each side for about 2 minutes., Garnish with parsley and serve immediately., Serves 4.

title: Chicken And Rice Casserole
directions: Melt margarine; blend in flour, onion, salt and pepper., Stir until smooth and bubbly., Stir in broth and milk., Heat to boiling, stirring constantly., When thickened, stir in chicken and vegetables., Pour into Jiffy pie crust bottom and cover with top crust., Cut slits to allow steam to escape., Cook, uncovered, at 425° for 30 to 35 minutes (until crust is brown).

title: Hot Fudge Pudding Cake
directions: Heat, oven, to, 350°., In medium mixing bowl combine 3/4 cup sugar, flour, 3 tablespoons cocoa, baking powder and salt. Blend in, milk,, melted butter and vanilla extract; beat until smooth. Pour batter into square pan (8 x 8 x 2-inches) or (9 x 9, x 2-inches)., In small bowl combine remaining 1/2 cup sugar, brown sugar and remaining 4 tablespoons cocoa; sprinkle mixture evenly over, batter., Pour, hot, water, over top; do not stir. Bake, 40 minutes or until center is set., Let stand 15 minutes; spoon, into dessert, dishes, spooning sauce from bottom of pan over top. Garnish as desired., Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Never-Fail Pie Meringue
directions: Mix cornstarch, sugar, water and salt in saucepan; cook until thick and clear. Cool slightly. Beat egg whites with electric mixer until frothy. Continue beating while pouring in cornstarch mixture. Beat 5 minutes. Use meringue to cover cooled filling in pie shell, sealing edges to crust. Bake at 450° for 5 to 7 minutes or until meringue is golden. Makes 1 pie.

title: Cathy'S Kraut
directions: Can be topped with sausage pieces. Bake in 350° oven for 2 1/2 to 3 hours.

title: Vegetable Oil Biscuits
directions: Combine, dry, ingredients;, stir in oil and milk at the same time., Roll, out dough between sheets of waxed paper on a dampened surface., Cut rolled out dough with a floured biscuit cutter or cut, into squares with a knife., Bake at 450° on an ungreased pan for 10 to 12 minutes., Makes about 1 dozen.

title: Pumpkin Swirl
directions: Grease bottom and sides of a 15 x 10 x 1-inch jellyroll pan or bread pan. Line with greased wax paper. Set aside. Beat eggs at high speed with an electric mixer until thick and pale. Gradually add sugar, beating until soft peaks form and sugar dissolves, 2 to 4 minutes. Fold in pumpkin. Combine biscuit mix and spices; fold into pumpkin mixture and spread evenly into prepared pan. Sprinkle with chopped pecans. Bake at 375° for 13 to 15 minutes. Sift the powdered sugar onto a 15 x 10 dishtowel. When the cake is done, immediately loosen from sides of pan and turn out onto sugared towel. Carefully peel off wax paper. Starting at narrow end, roll up cake and towel together and cool completely on a wire rack, seam side down. Beat cream cheese and butter at medium speed with mixer until creamy. Add powdered sugar and vanilla, beating well. Unroll cake; spread with cream cheese mixture and re-roll without towel. Place on a serving plate, seam side down. Ice the top with cream cheese mixture and sprinkle with pecans.

title: Infallible Rice
directions: Saute onion in butter until transparent. Combine onion, rice and hot broth. Bring to a boil on top of range. Cover and place in a 325° oven for 20 minutes. Serve and listen to the compliments!

title: Artichoke Dip
directions: Drain and chop hearts in food processor., Mix with mayonnaise, Parmesan cheese, Worcestershire sauce and red pepper; mix., Put in a baking dish and sprinkle more cheese on top before baking., Bake at 325° for about 30 minutes., Serve hot on Ritz crackers.

title: Fettuccine Alfredo
directions: In large saucepan combine cream cheese, parmesan, butter and milk, stirring constantly until smooth., Toss pasta lightly with sauce, coating well., Leftovers freeze well., Makes 4 servings.

title: Sausage-Cheese Puffs
directions: Combine ingredients thoroughly., Form into small balls., Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes., Yields 4 to 5 dozen.

title: Scalloped Oysters
directions: Melt butter in scalded milk., Add eggs., Layer oysters and crackers in a 2-quart bowl., Pour milk and egg mixture over salt and pepper to taste., Uncover for 1 hour., Bake at 350°.

title: Chicken Hawaiian
directions: Combine the first 5 ingredients and 2/3 of the sesame seed in bowl., Add mixture of mayonnaise and curry powder; toss to mix. Sprinkle with remaining sesame seed., May put on lettuce leaf.

title: Watergate Salad
directions: Mix pineapple and pudding with mixer until thickened., Add coconut and nuts and fold in Cool Whip and marshmallows., Chill at least 2 or 3 hours.

title: Din Din Chili
directions: Heat the oil in a pot; cook the meat until it turns brown. Add everything to the pot except the kidney beans., Stir well. Don't let stick., Let it simmer for about 40 minutes., Add the beans, water and all, if pot will hold it., Simmer 20 more minutes., Get 5 bowls ready and enjoy.

title: Pecan Pie
directions: Mix all together., Put in unbaked pie shells., Bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes., Make sure you can not shake pie in middle, it is done.

title: Nestle Cake
directions: Mix sifted flour, sugar and salt together., Set aside., In pot on the stove, mix margarine, water and chocolate and bring to boil., Pour over flour mixture; stir by hand until thoroughly blended., Add 2 eggs and buttermilk in which you have put vanilla and soda., Thoroughly mix and pour into a sheet cake pan, approximately 11 x 14-inch (greased)., Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes., Make icing and pour over hot cake.

title: Fluffy Pink Stuff
directions: Mix lemon juice with, Eagle Brand milk., Add cherry pie filling, pineapple, sour cream and nuts and fold in Cool Whip. Mix well and chill., Will serve 12 to 15 people.

title: Zucchini Bread
directions: Beat eggs well; add sugar, oil and zucchini., Add flour and mix well., Batter should be of cake-like consistency., Divide batter evenly between three 9 x 5-inch bread pans., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Pecan Pie(One Large Pie)
directions: Cream sugar, butter and flour., Beat eggs and add to mixture. Add milk and nuts., Pour into 1 large ready made or homemade pie shell., Bake at 375° until done, top is brown and knife comes out clean, about 30 minutes.

title: Lemon Glow Angel Cake
directions: Cook pudding according to directions., Cover with wax paper; cool., Cut a 1-inch slice from top of cake; set aside., Cut around 1 inch from hole in cake and 1 inch from outside of cake. Lift out to make a well in cake, leaving a 1-inch base., Beat pudding smooth., Fold half into lemon pie filling; set aside half of lemon mixture., Spoon remaining into cake., Replace top of cake. Prepare topping mix., Fold in remaining pudding., Frost top and sides of cake., Chill before serving., Spoon remaining pudding mixture over top of cake.

title: Breakfast Pie
directions: Cook sausage until done; drain grease., Add onion, green pepper and potatoes., Cook until potatoes are tender., In bowl, mix eggs and 1/2 cup of cheese., Add sausage mixture to eggs., Pour into pie shell and top with 1/2 cup cheese., Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Deep Fried Turkey
directions: Using a shaker, sprinkle turkey inside and out with salt and pepper., Pour enough oil into a 40-quart pot so turkey will be covered when lowered into pot., Make sure pot is large enough so oil won't overflow., Heat oil to 350° to 375°., Tie a heavy string to legs and slowly lower turkey into pot., Fry 3 to 4 minutes per pound., A 15 pound bird will be done in 50 or 60 minutes., Test for doneness at thigh joint., Carefully remove turkey and drain upright on legs so all oil will drain from cavity., Carve as usual.

title: Fajita Fish
directions: Combine marinade with other ingredients and beat., Preheat skillet at medium-high heat., Place fish and marinade in skillet. Saute about 5 minutes (or according to your desire).

title: Marinated Round Steak
directions: Saute garlic in canola oil 2 minutes; add tarragon, tomatoes and sherry and cook for 10 minutes on medium heat., Add salt, pepper and Worcestershire sauce., Pour over steak and marinate 3 to 6 hours, turning once in a while., Barbecue as usual, basting with sauce freely.

title: Chicken Delight
directions: Place fryer in a baking dish. Sprinkle onion soup mix over chicken. Spoon mushroom soup over chicken. Cover and bake at 350° for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

title: Lemony Green Beans
directions: Wash green beans., Trim ends., Remove strings., Drop beans into a large saucepan of boiling water., Cook 7 minutes or until crisp-tender., Drain well., Combine the beans and tomatoes in a large bowl; set aside., Combine lemon juice and the next 4 ingredients; stir well., Pour over vegetables, tossing gently to coat., Yields 8 servings.

title: Chicken Supreme
directions: Boil chicken and cut in pieces., Add to Stove Top stuffing. Pour melted oleo over Stove Top stuffing., Mix and add water chestnuts, celery, green pepper and dried parsley., Mix soup, mayonnaise (not Miracle Whip) and sour cream and add to stuffing mixture., Pour all in pan., I sometimes use 2 small pans., Top with crushed potato chips., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Eggplant Parmigiana
directions: Wash eggplant; do not peel., Season with salt and pepper., Roll in bread crumbs; dip in eggs and then again in bread crumbs. Depending upon the size of eggplant, more bread crumbs and eggs may be necessary., Place in refrigerator 30 minutes., Heat about 1/8-inch oil in skillet., Fry eggplant slices until tender and golden brown on both sides., Add more oil if necessary., Drain. Line a shallow 2-quart baking dish with sauce., Add a layer of Mozzarella slices, more sauce and a sprinkling of basil and Parmesan cheese., Repeat layers until dish is full., Bake in 350° oven for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Quick Beer Wheat Bread
directions: Combine biscuit mix, flour and sugar., Add eggs and beer. Beat about 1 minute or until well blended., Turn into a greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan, spreading evenly., Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes. Cool on wire rack.

title: Grandmother'S Pound Cake
directions: Combine flour, soda and salt., Cream butter and sugar., Add eggs, 1 at a time, beating well after each., Add dry ingredients to cream mixture, alternating with sour cream and ending with dry ingredients., Add flavor., Generously grease and flour 10-inch tube pan., Cover bottom of pan with nuts., Spoon batter over nuts. Sprinkle with nutmeg or mace., Bake at 300° for 1 1/2 hours. Remove from oven and remove from pan immediately.

title: Beer Bread
directions: Mix all together., Pour into greased and floured loaf pan. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes., Remove from oven and brush with melted oleo., Bake 30 minutes more.

title: Chicken Elegante
directions: Place chicken breasts in casserole dish., Sprinkle with onion. Mix soups and sherry., Pour over chicken., Sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Glennda'S Baked Potato Salad
directions: Boil potatoes with peeling on., Peel and dice potatoes., Salt to taste., Fry bacon crisp; break into pieces., Dice onions; add bacon and onions to potatoes., Heat cheese and mayonnaise until cheese is melted and mixture is smooth., Pour cheese mixture over potato mixture., Put in ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake at 350° until light brown.

title: Shrimp Macaroni Salad
directions: Cook macaroni according to package directions firm, drain and wash in colander., Pour into bowl; add rest of ingredients., Add more mayonnaise, if desired, so it's not dry., Salt and pepper to taste.

title: Summer Squash Casserole
directions: Cook squash and onion in boiling salt water 5 minutes; drain. Combine soup, sour cream and carrots., Fold in drained squash and onion., Combine stuffing mix and butter., Spread 1/2 of stuffing mix in bottom of baking dish., Add squash mixture., Spoon remaining stuffing on top., Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Caramel Crunch Apple Pie
directions: In a saucepan, combine caramels and water, cooking and stirring over low heat until smooth., In a pastry shell, layer apples and caramel sauce., In a mixing bowl, combine flour, sugar and cinnamon., Cut in margarine until mixture resembles coarse crumbs., Stir in nuts., Sprinkle crumb mixture over apples and caramel sauce., Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes, until apples are tender., Cool., Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Twice Baked Potatoes
directions: Bake potatoes at 375° for about 1 hour or until soft., Cut a thin slice off the top of each potato., Scoop out the pulp and put into a bowl., Separate eggs; add yolks to the potato pulp., Blend until smooth., Add butter and cream., Season with salt and pepper. Beat egg whites until stiff peaks form., Fold into potato mixture., Fill shells with mixture., Sprinkle with cheese., Bake in oven at 375° for about 15 minutes or until heated through.

title: Papoose Pie
directions: Blend flour and butter together., Pat into the bottom of a pie pan., Press the pecans into the pie crust., Bake until golden brown at 350°., Set pie crust aside to cool., Then cream together the powdered sugar and cream cheese., Spread this into the cooled crust., Slice the bananas and place on top of the cream cheese mixture., Cover with the Cool Whip., Spoon the cherry pie filling on top of the Cool Whip., Refrigerate until it is served.

title: Roast Corn
directions: Melt butter with chives and parsley., Brush corn with butter mixture, salt and pepper., Wrap in foil and bake at 400° for 30 minutes.

title: Hot Rolls
directions: Place these ingredients in a small bowl; let stand about 15 minutes., Add enough plain sifted flour to make a stiff dough. Place in a greased bowl., Let rise until doubled in bulk., Work down with hands and make into rolls., Let rolls rise 15 to 20 minutes., Brush lightly with margarine., Bake in a hot oven (450°) until brown, 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Shipwreck
directions: Grease large casserole dish or roasting pan., Layer ingredients in the order they are listed., If tomatoes don't have much liquid, add some water to keep casserole moist., Bake at 325 ° for 1 hour, covered., Then 10 to 15 minutes uncovered if ground beef not browned.

title: Chapatti
directions: Mix; break off small portions and roll in balls., Roll balls out flat and thin; cook in oiled hot skillet or on griddle., These are done when brown spots appear., Cook both sides., Eat plain or with butter or honey., Makes 5 to 6 Chapatti.

title: Pueblo Beans
directions: Wash beans. Put in a 6-quart kettle with 3 quarts water and simmer for about 4 hours. Mix remaining ingredients with beans and water. Place in a 4-quart casserole. Cover and bake at 350° for 2 to 3 hours. Add more water if necessary. Yields about 10 servings.

title: Frozen Citrus Pie
directions: Beat concentrate in large mixer bowl, about 30 seconds., Blend in ice cream., Fold in whipped topping until smooth., Freeze if necessary until mixture will mound., Spoon into crust., Freeze until firm, 4 hours or overnight., Let stand at room temperature 10 minutes before serving., Store leftover pie in freezer., Especially good in summer months.

title: Vegetable Soup
directions: Slice roast into small pieces 1/4-inch thick., Cook roast in pressure cooker for 25 minutes; add vegetables to roast., Cook until done., Add tomato juice and salt and pepper to taste.

title: Nancy'S Boiled Fish
directions: Preheat broiler., Rinse steaks or fillets; pat dry with paper towels., Season with salt and pepper., Spread 1 to 1 1/2 tablespoons mayonnaise over top of each steak or fillet., Sprinkle 1 1/2 teaspoons cheese on top of each., Place on broiling pan. Broil 4 to 6 inches from heat, 5 to 8 minutes or until top is puffed and brown and fish tests done., Serves 4.

title: Barbecued Frankfurters
directions: Melt butter, add chopped onion and cook until tender., Add paprika, pepper, sugar, mustard, sauce, catsup and vinegar., With sharp knife cut a 3 inch slit in each frankfurter., Place frankfurters in a flat baking pan, slit side up., Pour sauce over all and bake in a moderate oven 350° for 20 minutes basting frequently., Place frankfurters in split, toasted, buttered buns. Serve extra sauce separately.

title: Eagle Brand Chocolate Icing
directions: Melt the chocolate squares in the Eagle Brand. Add the cold water, vanilla and pinch of salt. Use small pan. Stir constantly until mixture thickens and becomes shiny. Pour immediately over cake.

title: Sunset Cherry Pie
directions: Combine cream cheese and sugar with electric mixer, mixing until well blended., Stir in 1 cup pie filling and 1/4 cup pineapple., Fold whipped topping into cream cheese mixture., Pour into crust., Top with remaining pie filling and pineapple., Chill until firm., Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Pumpkin Ice Cream Squares
directions: Mix crumbs with butter and sugar., Press into the bottom of a 9-inch square pan., Combine pumpkin with sugar, salt and spices. Fold in ice cream., Pour into crumb-lined pan., Cover., Freeze until firm., Cut into squares about 20 minutes before serving. Top with whipped cream and pecans., Makes 9 (3-inch) squares.

title: Mom'S One-Bowl White Cake
directions: Sift flour, sugar,, baking, powder, and salt into bowl. Drop in Crisco., Add about 2/3 cup milk, then vanilla and beat until smooth., Add, egg whites; mix thoroughly., Add remaining milk and beat until well, blended., Pour, batter, into 2 (8 or 9-inch) pans which have, been, greased, and, floured., Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes., Use desired frosting.

title: Cherry Salad
directions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl., Chill and serve.

title: Barbecue Muffins
directions: Separate dough into 10 biscuits., Flatten into 5-inch circles. Press each into the bottom and up sides of a greased muffin pan; set aside.

title: Pizza Crust
directions: Sift flour and salt., Add yeast to warm water and dissolve. Mix in the flour and salt., Knead for about 5 minutes, adding more flour only if necessary., Cover and let rise for 1/2 hour., Roll or pull by hand., Place on greased pizza pan., Makes 2 to 3 crusts., Bake at 375° for 25 minutes.

title: California Flank Steak
directions: Rub liberal amounts brown sugar into both sides of the flank steak., Don't be stingy!, Lay the steak into an oblong container and cover with soy sauce., Remember to lift the steak so the sauce gets underneath., Cover and marinate for 1 hour., Turn the steak over, re-cover and marinate for 1 hour more.

title: Mushroom Rice
directions: Mix liquid ingredients with melted butter and bouillon., Add olives, mushrooms and (last) the rice., Cook, covered, at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Cream Of Chicken Soup
directions: Place the chicken pieces in a large saucepan and cover them with the water., Add the celery, bay leaf, onion, salt and peppercorns., Place the pan over high heat and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat to low, cover the pan and simmer for 2 hours.

title: Pumpkin Roll
directions: Beat eggs at high speed for 5 minutes., Gradually beat in sugar., Stir in pumpkin and lemon juice., Combine flour, salt, baking powder and spices., Fold in flour mixture., Pour into a greased and floured (or Pam sprayed) jelly roll pan., Spread evenly., Bake at 375° for 15 minutes., Sprinkle powdered sugar on a soft towel, loosen cake and invert onto towel., Roll up cake in towel., Cool cake completely., Unroll and spread with filling.

title: Pecan Pie
directions: Cream butter, add sugar gradually and cream together until light and fluffy., Add remaining ingredients and blend well., Pour into a pastry shell and bake on lower shelf in a moderate oven (375°) 40 to 45 minutes., This makes one large pie.

title: Joyce'S Seven Layer Salad
directions: Combine lettuce, broccoli, cauliflower, onion and cucumber with mayonnaise., Blend well, making sure everything is covered with mayonnaise., Pour bottle of Italian dressing over mixture and garnish with tomatoes and shredded cheese.

title: Chocolate Chip Nut Cake
directions: Mix together, except chocolate chips and nuts, and beat 5 to 10 minutes., In another bowl, mix chocolate chips and nuts.

title: Turtle Cake
directions: Remove paper from caramels., Follow instructions on cake mix box to mix., Pour half of batter in a 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Bake this half for 15 minutes at 350°.

title: Penne With Tomato Cream Sauce
directions: Brown sausage meat; put aside., In a heavy saucepan, combine the tomatoes with juice, cream, garlic and tarragon; bring the liquid to a boil, breaking up the tomatoes., Add sausage; simmer mixture for 25 to 30 minutes or until sauce is thickened., Cook penne 12 to 15 minutes in boiling water; drain well., Toss with tomato sauce., Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and serve.

title: Pineapple Filling
directions: Drain pineapple (keep juice)., Beat sugar, eggs and butter until light and fluffy., Pour over bread cubes and drained pineapple., Add enough juice to moisten well., Bake at 350° for approximately 35 to 40 minutes., Serve from oven.

title: Aunt Bea'S Potatoes
directions: In skillet, saute onions in oil or margarine., Combine with hash browns, soup, sour cream and cheese., Spread in lightly greased 9 x 13-inch pan., Combine cornflakes and melted butter. Sprinkle over top., Bake in 350° oven for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Pie Crust Biscuits
directions: Using medium size mixing bowl, mix together pie crust mix, baking powder and baking soda., Make a well in the center and add buttermilk all at once., Stir only until dough clings together.

title: Good Corn Bread
directions: Preheat oven to 425° and bake for 25 minutes.

title: Cheese Grits Casserole
directions: In heavy saucepan, stir grits slowly into boiling water., Cook 5 minutes, stirring occasionally., Allow grits to cool., Mix well with beaten eggs., In greased 1 1/2-quart baking dish, alternate layers of grits and cheese., Pour milk over top., Sprinkle with bread crumbs and paprika., Bake in preheated oven at 325° for about 30 minutes., Serves 6.

title: Ralph'S Cream-Style Corn
directions: Open can; empty into pot., Heat on medium-high to desired warmth., Serves 1 to 2 people per can.

title: Chicken Spaghetti
directions: Boil chicken until it falls off bone., Reserve 4 cups broth. Take chicken off bone., Combine broth, chicken and all other ingredients in large pan., Cook over low heat until spaghetti absorbs most of liquid., (If you want more spaghetti, cook it first, then add remaining ingredients.)

title: Banana Nut Bread
directions: Sift together dry ingredients and set aside., Mash bananas. Beat eggs until light., Mix bananas and eggs together., Add dry mixture and mix. Add nuts and stir well., Put in a 9 x 5-inch buttered loaf pan. Some like to add 2 tablespoons melted butter to the batter., Bake 1 hour at 350°.

title: Angel Food Cake
directions: Beat egg whites, salt, vanilla and water until foamy., Add cream of tartar., Beat until slightly stiff., Add 1 cup sugar gradually, then fold in flour and sugar mixture gradually., Bake at 375°.

title: Amanda'S Picante Salsa
directions: Dip tomatoes in boiling water to remove skins., Chop all vegetables and put in large pot or dishpan., (I use food processor for peppers.), Cook on medium heat for 20 to 30 minutes or until starts to thicken., Dissolve 3 tablespoons cornstarch with 1/2 cup water., Add to salsa; cook a few minutes longer to thicken., Put in hot jars to seal., Makes about 14 pints.

title: Mom'S Cobbler
directions: Place fruit in pie dish., Mix sugar and Bisquick., Pour over fruit., Slice margarine over sugar mix., Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes or until well browned.

title: Bean Salad
directions: Wash beans in cold water and drain., Mix beans, bell pepper and onions., Mix vinegar, oil, sugar, pepper and salt., Pour over beans and toss lightly until well mixed., Cover and refrigerate overnight., Serves 12 to 15.

title: Ham Appetillas
directions: Remove tortillas from refrigerator., Combine cream cheese, mayonnaise, onions and olives., Spread thin layer of mixture on tortilla., Arrange four slices of ham over cheese., Tightly roll up tortilla., Wrap individually in plastic wrap., Place in refrigerator at least 3 hours or overnight., To serve, cut into 3/4-inch slices., Makes about 64 appetillas.

title: Crock-Pot Roast Beef
directions: Place vegetables in bottom of crock-pot., Salt and pepper meat., Place into pot., Add liquid and cover., Cook on low for 10 to 12 hours (high 5 to 6 hours)., Remove meat and vegetables with spoon., Thicken remaining liquid for gravy if desired.

title: Peanut Butter Cup Pie(Lite Choices)
directions: Mix together first 3 ingredients., Press crust ingredients into a 9-inch pie plate; chill.

title: Spaghetti Sauce
directions: Brown meat; drain off excess fat., Add onion, green pepper and garlic., Cook 1 minute., Add tomato sauce, tomato paste, water, Worcestershire sauce, salt and pepper., Cover and simmer for 2 hours., Serve with spaghetti noodles.

title: Marshmallow Puffs
directions: Line a 9-inch pan with foil; butter the foil., Arrange marshmallows in pan., In a double boiler or microwave-safe bowl, melt chocolate chips, peanut butter and butter., Pour over marshmallows., Chill completely., Cut between marshmallows. Yields 3 dozen., White chocolate chips can be substituted.

title: Cranberry Punch
directions: Dissolve jello in boiling water., Stir in lemonade., Add cold water and cranberry juice., Pour over ice in punch bowl; slowly pour in 28 ounce bottle of ginger ale., Chill., Yield:, 12 cups.

title: Taco Dip
directions: Mix cream cheese, sour cream, and taco mix., Spread on 8 inch pie plate., Layer refried beans, then salsa., Top with cheese, lettuce and olives., Refrigerate up to 1 hour then serve with crackers or tortilla chips.

title: Spinach Dip
directions: Mix together and let set overnight or several hours in refrigerator., Serve with vegetables or chips.

title: Curried Chicken Breasts
directions: Conventional Oven:, Preheat oven to 350°., Mix together gravy mix, curry powder and water., Place in large size brown-in-bag. Place in a 12 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish., Season chicken with salt, pepper and paprika., Place in single layer in the bag., Cut slits in the bag and bake for 45 minutes.

title: Apple Pie
directions: Sift together flour and salt., Cut in shortening with pastry blender., Add enough water to hold ingredients together, sprinkling evenly and mixing with fork to form ball., Makes enough for 8-inch or 9-inch pie, either 2-crust or bottom crust and crisscross strips on top.

title: Salsa
directions: Combine all ingredients in a small serving bowl and set aside for the flavors to meld, about 3 hours or overnight is best. Keeps about 1 week. Good on almost everything., Makes about 2 cups of salsa.

title: Pound Cake
directions: Cream margarine, shortening, and, sugar., Add eggs, one at a time and beat., Alternate, adding flour and cream (divide into thirds)., Cook at 300°, at, least 2 hours or until brown. Start in a cold oven!, "Makes a crusty, delicious cake."

title: Indian Fry Bread
directions: In a bowl, mix dry ingredients., Slowly add cold water, a little at a time, until dough forms., Divide into balls about the size of a softball., On a floured surface, roll balls out into an even circle about 1/4-inch thick., In a large frying pan, heat lard or oil on medium heat., Oil should be about 1-inch deep. Place fry bread in pan., Flip with tongs. When lightly brown on both sides, remove and place on paper towels., Serve as a meal with beans, cheese or add lettuce, tomatoes to make a Navajo taco. Serve as dessert with sprinkled powdered sugar.

title: Baked Chicken Reuben
directions: Place chicken in buttered baking pan; place sauerkraut over chicken., Top with cheese., Pour dressing evenly over cheese. Cover with foil., Bake at 325° about 1 hour., Serve sprinkled with chopped parsley., Serve over white rice.

title: Soup For A Winter Evening
directions: Mix all ingredients and pour in crock-pot., Cook on low for 3 to 4 hours.

title: Easy Festive Fudge(Chocolate Or Peanut Butter Or Butterscotch)
directions: Mix in a heavy 2-quart pan the sugar, milk, marshmallows, margarine and salt., Cook, stirring constantly, over medium heat to a boil (bubbling all over the top)., Boil and stir 5 minutes more., Take off heat.

title: Impossible Pie
directions: Place all ingredients in blender; mix 3 minutes. Meanwhile, butter a 10-inch pan and dust with flour. Pour mixture in pan. Bake at 350° for about 45 minutes.

title: Broccoli Salad
directions: Mix vinegar, sugar and mayonnaise and pour over broccoli and cauliflower., Chill before serving.

title: Rice Pudding
directions: Bring water to boil; add rice., Boil for 14 minutes., Drain rice (optional)., Mix remaining ingredients while boiling., Cook until thick; stir constantly., Serve warm or cold with cinnamon sugar., Can be rewarmed in microwave., Use 2-quart kettle or larger.

title: Baklava
directions: Grind nuts and combine with cinnamon and sugar in a large bowl., Melt butter. Brush bottom of a 14 x 20-inch pan with butter., Place one pastry sheet and brush with butter, repeating process until 6 pastry sheets line pan., Add nut mixture. Add another sheet. Brush with butter and sprinkle with nut mixture. Repeat process until all ingredients are used, ending with 4 layers of buttered filo on top. Cut into diamond shapes. Bake at 325° for 1 hour.

title: Cucumber Delight
directions: Combine cucumbers and onions in a bowl., In a separate bowl, mix sour cream, vinegar and seasonings., Pour over cucumbers and onions., Mix lightly., Let stand one hour before serving., Serves 6.

title: Texas Caviar
directions: Combine all ingredients and let set overnight., Serve with king size chips.

title: Wild Duck
directions: Brown dressed ducks in butter., Remove duck and make water, flour, salt and pepper gravy from butter., Add wine to gravy. Place ducks in roaster, breast down., Cover with gravy., Cover roaster and cook in very slow oven at 200° for at least 4 hours. Check often and add more water, wine and seasonings if necessary. Serve with wild rice.

title: Company Chicken
directions: Melt margarine in casserole dish., Add rice; lay chicken in rice., Sprinkle soup mix over all., Pour 2 cups water., Spread can of soup over chicken; add can of water., Bake at 350° for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

title: Tahini Sauce
directions: Combine all ingredients in a blender and blend well., Use as sauce for fish or make beef/lamb/onion and parsley patties and use as sauce for them.

title: Monkey Bread
directions: Butter a tube pan., Cut each biscuit in half and roll into a ball., Place 1/2 of them in pan., Bring rest of ingredients (except nuts) to a boil., Add nuts., Pour 1/2 of mixture over biscuits that are in the tube pan., Put remaining biscuits on top of first layer., Top with remaining mixture., Bake at 375° for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Sugared Peanuts
