directions: Put in heavy skillet over heat until water evaporates and sugar crystallizes., Spread on cookie sheet and bake at 325° for 20 minutes., Let it cool., Enjoy!

title: Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Combine first 4 ingredients and cook about 1 minute., Add the remaining ingredients and stir 1 minute., Drop by spoon onto wax paper.

title: Mandarin Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients together., (Drain mandarins and discard juice.), Refrigerate.

title: Apple Butter
directions: Use apple pulp left from preparing apple juice for jelly. Press through food mill., Measure pulp., Add sugar and spices; cook until the flavors are blended well, about 15 minutes., To prevent sticking, stir frequently as mixture thickens., (If too thick, add a small amount of water for desired consistency.) Makes 5 pints.

title: Congo Squares
directions: Sift together flour, salt and baking powder; set aside., Melt margarine and add to brown sugar., Mix well and let cool slightly. Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each., Add dry ingredients and mix well., Stir in nuts and chocolate chips., Bake in large 15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 3/4-inch greased jelly roll pan., Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Zucchini Bake
directions: Combine all ingredients except stuffing mix and butter., Place in 2-quart baking dish., Toss stuffing mix with butter and spoon over vegetables., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes., Makes about 6 cups.

title: Primavera Vegetables With Linguine
directions: In large skillet heat oil., Saute onion and garlic for 1 minute., Add zucchini, yellow squash and bell pepper., Saute 3 to 4 minutes., Stir in reserved tomato juice, tomato paste, water, salt and pepper., Simmer for 5 to 8 minutes or until vegetables are tender., Stir in tomatoes and basil and simmer 1 minute.

title: Beat 'N Eat Frosting
directions: Mix first 3 ingredients in small deep bowl., Add boiling water. Beat to stiff peaks with eggbeater or electric beater., Spread between layers and on top and sides of 8-inch cake., Sprinkle with coconut.

title: Rice Krispies Candy
directions: Melt chocolate and peanut butter in microwave., Stir in remaining ingredients., Drop by spoonful onto wax paper., Yields approximately 7 dozen., This is a holiday requirement at my house.

title: Ham Casserole
directions: Simmer butter, onion, pepper and red pepper; mix together soup, corn and Ro-Tel., Put ham, potatoes and spaghetti in casserole dish., Then pour over soup., Bake at 300° for 30 minutes., Then put Velveeta cheese on top., Put in oven for 5 minutes.

title: Stuffed Grape Leaves
directions: Drain liquid off grape leaves., Put leaves in 3-quart pan of cold water., Heat to boiling; drain.

title: Hawaiian Dessert(Diabetic Recipe)
directions: Bring juice to a boil; add gelatin, stirring until gelatin dissolves., Combine pineapple and milk in blender; blend well. Add gelatin mixture, almond extract and ice., Mix thoroughly in blender., Pour into dessert dishes., Chill until set, about 1 hour.

title: D.P. Whitmer'S Blueberry Muffins(This Recipe Won Third Place In "Connecticut Post" Contest.)
directions: Lightly spray the inside of muffin tins with nonstick spray. With a paper towel or tissue, gently wipe the spray inside each muffin cup., Spread soft butter around inside of each muffin cup liberally., Set aside tins in cool place., Into a bowl, put 1/3 cup flour, 1/3 cup confectioners sugar and 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon; mix well, then add the fresh or hard frozen berries and mix well. Reserve at room temperature.

title: Red Salt
directions: Excellent on all meats.

title: Strawberry Dessert
directions: Prepare strawberry Jell-O as on package, omitting 2 cups of cold water., Mix in strawberries., Place torn angel food cake in 9 x 13-inch pan and pour strawberries over cake., Let sit until firm and spread Cool Whip over strawberries., Keep in refrigerator.

title: Cheese Ball
directions: Mix all ingredients together by hand., Roll in chopped pecans.

title: Dry Mustard Pickles
directions: Mix all ingredients in a crock, except cucumbers., Wash cucumbers and add as they are available., Put plate over cucumbers in crock., Put large rock on plate to hold cucumbers under mixture until cucumbers lighten up., They are then ready to eat.

title: Low-Fat Oven Fried Catfish
directions: Preheat oven to 400° to 450° or adjust oven if it cooks fast. Dip fish in egg whites, then coat in meal., Arrange in pan lined with aluminum foil and sprayed with Pam., Place in oven; turn once., Place under broiler if you want fish crunchy and browned. Bake 7 to 8 minutes.

title: Sweet Potato Balls
directions: Mix sweet potatoes with sugar, milk, salt and orange rind. Scoop up about 1/4 cup potato mixture and shape into a ball around a marshmallow, using more, if needed, to cover., Roll in corn flakes (or pecans)., Place on baking dish sprayed with Pam and freeze, covered.

title: Champagne Cake
directions: Combine cake mix, club soda, pudding mix, eggs and oil., Beat with mixer., Stir in (by spoon) the cherries, nuts and pineapple. Make three layers., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes or until done.

title: Fun Castle
directions: Wash pieces, of, brick	and, rocks in plain water until they are thoroughly, wet., Wet sponge and wring it out.	Place rocks, bricks and/or, sponge, in, a shallow glass bowl (do not use metal of	any, kind)., Arrange to suit your fancy, placing on top of each, other, to get the desired shape you want., The good thing about the, sponge is that you can cut it to desired shapes., Mix water,, bluing, (you, can, still, get this at the grocery store, I just, called, to see) and ammonia in a glass jar.	Pour over, the rocks,, being sure to dampen all of them with the mixture., Put a, drop or two of food color and a few drops of bluing on, one, or two of the rocks., Sprinkle with 4 tablespoons salt, and, watch it grow., Add 2 tablespoons each water and ammonia	after, two days, to edge of bowl., This is straight from Heloise!

title: Marinated Carrots
directions: Layer carrots, onion and bell pepper., Boil remaining ingredients and pour over layered carrots, onion and bell pepper. Refrigerate until chilled or overnight., Lasts several days in refrigerator.

title: World'S Easiest Fudge
directions: Spray an 8 x 8 or 9 x 9 microwavable dish with nonstick spray. Place chocolate chips and Eagle Brand milk in dish., Stir. Microwave approximately 1 to 2 minutes., Stir., If using nuts, add those in., Microwave at 30 second intervals until chocolate chips are completely melted., Refrigerate., Takes approximately 4 to 6 hours to set up.

title: Broccoli Rice Casserole
directions: In a large skillet over medium heat, saute onion, celery and broccoli in butter for 3 to 5 minutes., Stir in cheese, soup and milk until smooth., Place rice in a greased 8-inch square baking dish., Pour cheese mixture over; do not stir., Bake, uncovered, at 325° for 25 to 30 minutes or until hot and bubbly., Yields 8 to 10 servings.

title: Coney Sauce
directions: Fry together., Drain hamburger and onions., Mix together in a large kettle sugar, vinegar, juice, tomato puree, chili powder, pepper, catsup, sauce, Worcestershire sauce and garlic salt., Add hamburger and onion to this mix., Salt to taste., Simmer over low heat for 1 hour., Cool; run it through a meat grinder., One pint makes 8 or 9 Coneys.

title: Strawberry Nut Bread
directions: Combine all ingredients in large mixing bowl and mix well. Pour into 2 greased and floured loaf pans., Bake at 350° for 40 minutes., Makes 2 loaves.

title: Chicken Enchiladas
directions: Mix soup, milk, sour cream, chilies, jalapeno and 1/4 teaspoon cumin in blender., Mix cream cheese, onion, chicken and 1/4 teaspoon cumin in large bowl., Roll mixture in flour tortillas. Place in a 13 x 9-inch pan and pour liquid mixture over top. Sprinkle cheese over top., Bake, covered, at 350° for 25 minutes, then uncovered for 5 minutes.

title: Chicken And Rice
directions: Preheat oven to, 350°.	Put all 3 cans of soup in large deep baking dish;, pour in cup of rice and stir together., Lay chicken pieces on, top;, cover and bake at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Boo'S Spicy Salsa
directions: Blend the first 3 ingredients in blender. Add the bell pepper. Mix all ingredients and cook for 1 1/2 hours or desired thickness. Then can.

title: Banana Drop Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees., Lightly grease to large baking sheets with butter or vegetable shortening., Sift together flour, sugar, baking soda, salt, cinnamon, ginger, and nutmeg., Using a pastry blender or two forks, work the margarine into flour mixture until, thoroughly mixed., Mix the chopped walnuts with the oatmeal., Stir into flour mixture., Beat in egg and bananas., Mix well., Drop rounded teaspoonfuls of batter onto baking sheets, about 2 inches apart., Bake for 12 - 15 minutes, or until the cookies have browned around the edges., Remove from oven., Cool cookies for 2 - 3 minutes and transfer to wire racks to cool completely.

title: Walnut Roast
directions: Mix all ingredients together except the last 3 and bake in an oiled meat loaf pan at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Banana Cream Pie
directions: Prepare whipped topping mix as directed., Prepare pie filling, reducing milk to 2 cups., Blend in half whipped topping., Arrange banana in shell and put pudding mixture in shell., Garnish with remaining whipped topping., Chill at least 1 hour.

title: Watergate Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients together and refrigerate.

title: Thousand Island Dressing
directions: Mix together and chill.

title: Candied Walnuts
directions: Bake walnuts for 15 minutes at 375°., Combine sugar, water, cinnamon and salt in saucepan; cook over medium heat to soft ball stage., Do not stir., Remove from heat; add vanilla and nuts. Stir until mixture becomes creamy and sticks to the nuts., Dump on cookie sheet and spread as it cools.

title: Pretzel Strawberry Salad
directions: Mix and spread on bottom of 9 x 13-inch Pyrex dish; bake at 400° for 6 to 7 minutes., Let cool.

title: Coconut Cream Cake
directions: In a large mixing bowl blend all ingredients on low setting, then beat 2 to 3 minutes on medium., Bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan at 350°., Cool.

title: Georgia Special
directions: Mix well and cook at 350° until done. Cool.

title: Fudge
directions: Combine all ingredients in a heavy saucepan., Cook over low to medium heat until mixture reaches 240 degrees on a candy thermometer., Remove from heat and add butter and vanilla., Beat until fudge starts to thicken and turns dull., Pour into buttered pie pan.

title: Punch For 25
directions: Make gelatin as directed on package., Add rest of ingredients except ginger ale and mix thoroughly., Add ginger ale just before serving., Sherbet may also be added when ready to serve.

title: Stackups Grande
directions: Brown meat; drain., Add onion and green pepper; cook until tender., Stir in Cheez Whiz and chili powder., Layer tortillas and meat mixture in two stacks in 13 1/2 x 8 3/4-inch baking dish. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes., Top with tomato; cut into wedges to serve., Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Frozen Salad
directions: Mix cream cheese and sugar in a small bowl until smooth., Set aside., Drain pineapple and mix in large bowl with banana pieces, strawberries, nuts and whipped cream., This should be well mixed. Add cream cheese/sugar mixture and mix well., Spread in a 9 x 11-inch pan and freeze for 3 hours before serving., This can be stored in the freezer for at least 3 weeks and can be used as either a salad or dessert.

title: "Grumbire" Soup(Hearty And Filling On Cold Winter Days.)
directions: First:, Cover potatoes and onion with water and cook until soft., Add milk and heat through, stirring gently., Add salt and pepper to taste.

title: Pork And Pea Pods
directions: Mix soy sauce, cooking sherry, garlic and ginger for a marinade., Add meat, tossing to coat evenly., Cover tightly. Refrigerate at least four hours or longer.

title: Kahlua
directions: Combine sugar, water and instant coffee granules., Simmer slowly for 40 minutes., Cool 15 minutes., Add vanilla., Add vodka. Pour into clean, empty bottles., Let set at least 3 weeks.

title: Nut Bread
directions: Mix sour cream and brown sugar together and let set overnight in refrigerator., In the morning, add other ingredients and bake at 350° for 45 minutes., Makes one regular bread pan loaf.

title: Spaghetti Sauce
directions: Brown meats, garlic and salt, add next 5 ingred. Then add 1 tsp each of chili powder, thyme, tarragon, basil, marjorum, oregano, celery salt, 1-2 bay leaves, sugar to taste, seasoning salt romano or parmesan. Simmer for 2-3 hrs.

title: Whole-Wheat Apple Cinnamon Muffins
directions: In a mixing bowl, combine the first 6 ingredients., Peel the apple and grate it into another bowl., Stir in the yogurt and the sugar until the sugar dissolves., Stir in the egg, molasses, oil and 1/4 cup water., Stir the flour mixture into the yogurt mixture until just combined., The muffin batter will be lumpy., Spoon into prepared muffin pans., Bake at 400° until edges start to brown, about 15 to 20 minutes., Make ahead and freeze., Great for breakfast.

title: Arroz Con Pollo(Chicken And Rice)
directions: Mix salt, garlic and oregano; rub chicken inside and out. Saute tomatoes, peppers and onion; add chicken and simmer 1/2 hour., Add achote coloring, rice, olives and capers; mix well. Add liquid; stir and cover., Cook until the rice is done and all water has been absorbed, about 25 minutes., Serve hot., Garnish with strips of pimentos and peas.

title: Carolyn Craig'S Mayonnaise Muffins
directions: Mix well and drop in greased muffin tins., Bake 15 to 20 minutes at 450°.

title: Cinnamon Sticks
directions: Mix and spread real thin on buttered cookie sheet (press and spread with palms of hands)., Brush top with slightly beaten egg white., Sprinkle with finely chopped pecans., Cook in 300° oven for 25 to 30 minutes., Cut in sticks 1 x 3-inches while hot and cool in pan.

title: Whipped Pound Cake
directions: Grease and flour tube pan., Preheat oven to 325°., Using electric mixer, mix sugar, margarine, Crisco and eggs; mix very well., Be sure to use whipped margarine; it's the secret to the cake because no baking powder or soda is used., Add flour and milk, then flavoring., Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Butternut Cake
directions: Cream the sugar, shortening and salt., Add eggs, one at a time., Add flour and milk alternately, ending with flour., Fold in flavoring by hand.

title: Chicken Enchiladas(Low-Fat)
directions: Wrap tortillas in foil., Heat in a 350° oven for 10 minutes.

title: Chicken Breasts With Vegetables
directions: Tear off 2 (12 x 18-inch) sheets of aluminum foil and rub them lightly with oil., Place onion slices on each sheet., Flatten breasts to 1/4-inch thick and place over onions., Combine mayonnaise and mustard., Spread over each chicken breast., Top with carrots, zucchini and mushrooms., Season with salt and pepper., Dot with butter., Sprinkle with basil, garlic powder and paprika., Seal edges tightly to make package., Bake at 400° for 30 minutes., Serves 2.

title: Breakfast Casserole
directions: Mix eggs and cream., Stir in cheese and sausage., Pour in greased casserole dish., Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

title: Tortilla Soup
directions: Puree chilies in blender., Saute in 2 tablespoons oil (use a 2-quart Dutch oven), onion, pureed chilies and garlic., Puree stewed tomatoes in blender and add to the sauteed mixture along with beef broth, cream of chicken soup, chicken broth, salt, sugar, lemon pepper, Worcestershire sauce, chili powder, cumin and Tabasco., Simmer 1 hour.

title: Hamburger And Sausage Casserole
directions: Combine all ingredients and bake at 350° until rice is tender.

title: Chicken & Dumplings
directions: Mix dough., Roll out to about the same thickness as pie crust, prick dough with fork & cut into 2 inch wide strips then break into pieces about 2 inches long., Add enough water to broth to make about 2 qts., Bring broth to boil, add chicken & dumplings & salt & pepper to taste., This makes enough to serve 8-10 people.

title: Seasoned Pork Roast
directions: Combine garlic salt and pepper. Rub over roast. Place roast on rack in roasting pan and roast in a 350° oven for 40 minutes per pound.

title: Fruity Banana Milk
directions: Put all ingredients into a blender or jar., Cover and blend or shake until mixed well., Makes 3 servings.

title: Preacher Cookies
directions: Combine butter, sugar and milk in a medium sauce pan; boil 3 minutes., Stir in cocoa, oatmeal, vanilla and nuts., Beat well; working quickly, drop by spoonfuls onto waxed paper., Cool 5 minutes., Yields: 3 dozen.

title: Earthquake Cake
directions: Mix coconut and nuts., Press into 9 x 13-inch pan., Mix cake mix as directed., Pour over nuts and coconut., Mix cream cheese, powdered sugar and margarine., Drop by teaspoonfuls on top of cake mix (will almost completely cover top)., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Molasses Cookies
directions: Melt shortening and cool., Add sugar, molasses and egg., Beat well., Sift together flour, salt, baking soda and spices., Add to first mixture., Chill good., Form into balls; roll in granulated sugar., Put onto greased cookie sheet., Bake 8 to 10 minutes at 375°.

title: Italian Beef
directions: Cook in crock-pot on low for 18 hours., Remove peppers., Use a fork and shred roast., Place in deep plate or bowl and pour juice over. Serve.

title: Herb Stuffed Mushrooms
directions: Clean mushrooms., Remove stems., Chop stems finely., Melt 1/4 cup butter in skillet., Saute mushroom caps briefly on both sides. Remove to shallow baking dish., Melt remaining butter and saute stems and onions., Remove from heat., Add bread crumbs and remaining ingredients., Toss to mix., Spoon into caps., Bake for 20 minutes at 350°.

title: Cantaloupe Sorbet
directions: Position, knife blade in food processor bowl; add cantaloupe and process until smooth., Mix cantaloupe, sugar and lemon juice; stir well., Cover and freeze until almost firm, stirring occasionally.

title: Chicken Enchiladas
directions: Heat soup and milk; dip tortillas in this mixture., Place small amount of onions, chicken, green chilies and cheese on each tortilla., Roll up and place in casserole dish., Pour soup mixture over tortilla., Sprinkle any remaining ingredients over top., Bake at 350° until bubbly hot.

title: Edee'S Crab Salad
directions: Mix ingredients together., Refrigerate several hours before serving.

title: Cinnamon Cream Pie
directions: Mix 1 cup sugar, flour and cornstarch., Stir in scalded milk; then very gradually, blend in beaten egg yolks., Add the half stick of margarine, cut in several pieces., Cook in double boiler until thick., Stir in vanilla., Cool.

title: Chinese Whatsit(Or You Name It Casserole)
directions: Saute beef; add salt and pepper to taste and a dash of sugar. Place cooked beef in a 9 1/2 x 13-inch baking casserole., Combine celery and onion and layer evenly over beef., Break up frozen peas and make another layer., (Celery, onion and peas may be combined to make 1 layer together.), Spread crushed potato chips over vegetables., Dilute soup with water and pour over all ingredients. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Sausage Cookies
directions: Lightly brown sausage in frying pan, breaking into pieces. Remove sausage to absorbent paper and reserve 1/4 cup drippings.

title: Easy Pot Roast
directions: Place roast in Dutch oven; add soup mix and mushroom soup. Add water to cover roast., Cover., Cook at 325° for about 2 hours. Add carrots and potatoes during last 45 minutes of cooking if desired.

title: Farmers Casserole
directions: Brown steak or boil chicken., Saute onions and pepper., Mix all ingredients together and bake at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes., Cook, covered.

title: Jello Balls
directions: Mix first 4 ingredients and refrigerate overnight., Roll into balls and roll in small box of Jell-O., (Use red for Christmas; orange for Thanksgiving.)

title: Mexican Mess
directions: Brown meat with onion and spices; drain well. Add corn, picante, beans and tomatoes; simmer for 30 minutes., Crush tortilla chips in a serving dish; spoon mixture over chips., Top with lettuce, tomatoes, cheese, taco sauce (if taco sauce used, I leave out other seasonings) and black olives., Quick, easy and great!

title: A Crock Of Beans And Meatless Sausage
directions: Add ingredients to crock-pot., Let cook on high until thickened; about 4 to 6 hours., Serve over brown rice, barley or bulgur wheat.

title: Onions And Rice
directions: Saute green onions in hot oil in a large skillet until tender. Add rice and next 5 ingredients., Cover and simmer 20 minutes or until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed., Garnish with a green onion fan., Yields 4 to 6 servings.

title: Corn Bread
directions: Sift dry ingredients., Add milk, egg and margarine., Beat well and bake in an 8-inch greased pan in a hot oven, 400°, for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Pineapple Pie
directions: Mix all ingredients well., Pour into shell and bake at 300° until knife comes out clean when inserted in center., Pie should be brown.

title: Pumpkin Bread
directions: Mix all ingredients well, adding sugar slowly., Bake at 325° for 1 1/2 hours., Makes a 1 pound loaf.

title: Chipped Beef Cheese Ball
directions: Mix together, 3/4 pkg. of chipped beef, (chopped) with cream cheese, onion, garlic powder and accent. Make into a ball and roll in reserved 1/4 pkg. chipped beef. Refrigerate until about 1/2 hour before serving. Serve with crackers.

title: Red Velvet Cake
directions: Cream sugar and oil., Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each., Sift flour and mix with salt and soda., Add to egg mixture., Add the remaining ingredients and beat until well blended., Bake in 3 greased layer pans at 350° until tested done. Let cool and frost.

title: New Orleans Pecan Pie
directions: In saucepan, combine egg yolks, sour cream, granulated sugar, flour, vanilla and salt., Cook and stir over medium heat until thickened (about 5 to 10 minutes)., Pour into baked pie shell. Set aside.

title: Sweet Blueberry Muffins
directions: Sift together flour, sugar, baking powder and salt., Cut in with pastry blender the shortening, egg and milk., Add blueberries., Drop batter into cupcake pan., Bake at 400° for 20 to 25 minutes., Makes 12 muffins.

title: Chili Sauce
directions: Combine all ingredients and cook down until thick., Then can. Let set for 30 days before use.

title: Country Sausage And Potatoes Au Gratin
directions: Cook and stir sausage and onion in oil in 10-inch or 12-inch skillet until onion is tender, about 5 minutes., Stir in potatoes, sauce mix, water and pepper., Heat to boiling; reduce heat., Cover and simmer, stirring occasionally, 10 minutes., Stir in carrot strips; cover and simmer until carrots are crisp-tender and potatoes are tender, about 10 minutes., Stir in broccoli and cheese., Cover and cook until broccoli is heated through and cheese is melted, 5 to 10 minutes., Makes 4 to 5 servings.

title: Crock-Pot Stew
directions: Toss, all, ingredients and place in crock-pot.	Cook on low-medium for, 8 hours., Mixture will thicken and be ready to eat!

title: Pound Cake
directions: Mix eggs, sugar, shortening, butter and vanilla until smooth. Add flour and beat on high for 10 minutes., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Pear Cake
directions: Sift all dry ingredients together., Add oil, eggs and vanilla. Mix well and add pears., Bake in greased and floured Bundt pan at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes., No icing needed for this moist cake., Great way to use up pears during pear season.

title: Bro. Don'S Corn Dish
directions: Fry bacon crisp., Set aside, keep drippings in pan., Cut corn off with sharp knife, cutting first a thin layer off tops of kernels., Repeat twice, getting all kernels off cob.

title: Mexican Potato Topper
directions: Microwave on High for 5 minutes; stir and return if needed to melt cheese thoroughly., Can also be used as topping for broccoli, cauliflower, etc.

title: Ribbon Fantasy Fudge
directions: Combine 1 1/2 cups sugar, 6 tablespoons margarine and 1/3 cup milk in heavy, 2-quart saucepan., Bring to a full rolling boil, stirring constantly., Continue boiling for 4 minutes over medium heat, stirring constantly, to prevent scorching., Remove from heat., Stir in chocolate pieces until melted., Add 1 cup (1/2 jar) Marshmallow Creme and 1/2 teaspoon vanilla., Beat until well blended.

title: Chicken And Mushroom Sauce
directions: Season chicken to taste., Place in ovensafe pan., Mix soup, milk and mushrooms., Pour over chicken., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Grapefruit And Crab Meat Cocktail
directions: Chill grapefruit and crab meat in cans., Drain grapefruit. Flake crab meat, removing bony tissue., Alternate grapefruit and crab meat in cocktail glasses., Mix remaining ingredients., Pour over grapefruit and crab meat., Serves 8.

title: Red Velvet Cake
directions: Cream shortening and sugar; add eggs., Make a paste of red coloring and cocoa; add to creamed ingredients., Then add vanilla. Mix buttermilk in same cup where red coloring was mixed., Use all clinging coloring., Sift flour, salt and soda together and add to mixture., Beat well; then fold in vinegar., Pour into 2 cake pans lined with greased waxed paper., Bake at 350° for 25 or 30 minutes.

title: Corn 'N' Dressing
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Dee'S Kitchen Soup
directions: Brown meat in large pan; drain grease., Celery and onion may be cooked at this time., Add water, seasoning and tomatoes., If using any fresh vegetables or rice, add at this time., Cook until tender., Add more water as needed., More seasoning may be needed, depending on taste., Cook for about 30 minutes., Serve with cornbread or biscuits.

title: Apple Dumplings
directions: Mix flour, salt, cold water and shortening like for pie crust. Cut up apples and place in center., Add butter, sugar and cinnamon., Shape the dough around apple., Jag around sides and top with fork., Bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes., Could possibly even take 1 hour. Keep checking.

title: Pecan Pie
directions: Melt butter in mixing bowl; add each of the following one at a time and stir until well mixed between each: Sugar, eggs, syrup, vanilla, salt, pecans., Pour into unbaked pie shell., Bake at 325° for 55-60 minutes or until pie appears set.

title: Broccoli Cornbread
directions: Mix all ingredients and put in a lightly greased pan. Bake at 400° for 30 minutes.

title: Mexican Corn
directions: Mix all ingredients together and chill for several hours before serving.

title: Green Enchiladas(Get Raves!!!)
directions: Combine soup, milk and Velveeta in top of double boiler., Heat until cheese melts., Add chilies and pimientos., Set aside., Brown meat; season with a little cumin powder and pepper, if desired. Layer torn tortillas, meat, onion, Velveeta sauce and grated cheese., Repeat layers., Cover and bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Enjoy!

title: Pavlova
directions: Line a baking sheet with foil., Draw six (3-inch) circles on the foil., Set aside., In a small mixer bowl combine egg whites, vinegar and salt., Beat with an electric mixer on medium speed until soft peaks form (tips curl)., Gradually add the 1/2 cup sugar, 1 tablespoon at a time, beating on high speed until very stiff peaks form (tips stand straight) and sugar is almost dissolved (about 4 minutes)., Use the back of a spoon to spread the meringue over the circles on the foil, building the sides up., Bake in a 300° oven for 35 minutes., Turn off oven., Let meringue shells dry in oven, with door closed, for at least 1 hour., Remove from foil., To serve, spoon fruit into meringue shells., Top with whipped topping., Makes 6 servings.

title: Broiled Chicken(Or Maybe Oiled-Foil-Broiled Chicken)
directions: Marinate the chicken breasts in lemon juice and herbs de Provence for 8 to 24 hours., Cover the broiler pan with aluminum foil, then oil the foil., Heat the broiler., Arrange the chicken on the oiled foiled pan; broil, it on one side, then turn it over and broil it on the other side.

title: Broccoli And Rice Casserole
directions: Cook frozen broccoli according to package directions., Drain well and set aside., Cook rice (not instant) and set aside., Saute chopped celery and onion in melted margarine over low heat., Stir frequently until wilted., Add cream of chicken soup and milk. Simmer until well mixed., Add Cheez Whiz and stir well until melted into mixture., Add rice, broccoli and salt and pepper to taste with 3 good dashes of Tabasco sauce., Stir until mixed., Pour into large casserole., Top with breadcrumbs and grated mild Cheddar cheese (optional)., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until bubbly and hot. Uncover last 15 minutes.

title: Roast Stuffed Turkey
directions: Rinse turkey thoroughly inside and out., Using your hands, rub turkey completely with vegetable oil., Sprinkle with salt and pepper., Place bread in bottom of roasting pan., Put turkey, breast side down, on the bread., Cook in 400° oven for 1 hour. Remove turkey from oven and place on large platter (we use oven mitts to turn the turkey onto its back)., Make the stuffing (recipe following), using the bread in the bottom of the roasting pan.

title: Manicotti
directions: Brown hamburger; drain., Add eggs, cheese, mushrooms, onion and dash of salt and pepper., Mix well; set aside., Cook manicotti according to directions (don't cook too long it makes the noodles hard to stuff)., Stuff with hamburger mixture and layer in bottom of baking dish., Cover with sauce and a little grated cheese., Bake for 30 minutes., Serves 8 to 10 people.

title: Chicken And Noodles
directions: Boil chicken breast until tender., Remove from broth., Cook pack of noodles in broth., Saute mushrooms, onions and green peppers in butter and garlic., Stir into noodles and broth., Add stewed tomatoes and cheese., Stir until melted., Add 1 tablespoon cornstarch with enough water to make a smooth paste., Add to other ingredients., Serve with salad and rolls., Enjoy!!

title: Broccoli And Rice Casserole
directions: Cook broccoli and drain., Cook cheese and soup together until smooth., Combine all ingredients in greased dish., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Peach Cobbler
directions: Heat oven to 400°., Mix baking mix, milk, brown sugar, oleo and nutmeg., Spread in ungreased square 9 x 9 x 2-inch pan., Drain peaches, reserving 1 cup syrup. Arrange peaches on mixture in pan. Pour reserved syrup over peaches. Bake until golden brown, about 40 minutes. Serve with whipped cream or ice cream., You can use fruit cocktail (30 ounces) for the peaches.

title: Pecan Pie
directions: Combine ingredients and pour in an unbaked pie shell., Bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes or until firm.

title: Zucchini Pie
directions: Use big zucchini, but still tender enough so you can pierce the skin easily with your thumbnail., Peel, cut into quarters lengthwise, remove the seeds and slice crosswise., Add zucchini to remaining ingredients after they are tossed together., Mix well. (It may be runny.), Dump into a 9-inch pie crust and bake 40 minutes at 400° or until golden brown., (You'll think you are eating apple pie, but it's more delicious.)

title: Baked Pineapple
directions: Mix ingredients all together., Pour into greased 2-quart casserole., Bake at 300° for 1 hour., Can be served warm or cold. Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Broccoli Salad
directions: Mix all of the ingredients together.

title: Cheese Ball
directions: Drain pineapple and cherries very well. Mold into a ball and refrigerate overnight. Roll in chopped pecans before serving. This is always a favorite at parties.

title: Jeff'S Potato Salad With Beer Dressing
directions: Boil potatoes until just tender. Peel and slice.

title: Chicken And Vegetable Casserole
directions: Mix Cheez Whiz and soup together., Add chicken, then Veg-All. Pour into casserole dish. Crush 1 tube Ritz crackers and melt 1/4 stick margarine., Toss together and put on top., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Corn Chowder
directions: Dice potatoes and onion; cook in grease from bacon slices until tender., Add celery soup and milk., Heat through., Crumble bacon on top.

title: Cherry Cream Puff Ring
directions: Puff:, Heat oven to 400°., Heat water and butter to boiling in a 1-quart saucepan., Stir in flour., Stir vigorously about 1 minute until mixture forms a ball., Remove from heat; add eggs, one at a time., Beat until smooth., Drop by tablespoonfuls onto a greased baking sheet to form an 8-inch ring.*, Smooth top with spatula., Bake until puffed and golden, 50 to 60 minutes., Cut off top with sharp knife., Pull out any soft dough.

title: Squash Fritters
directions: Combine squash,, onion, flour, pepper, sugar and salt., Beat eggs and add to squash., Add margarine., Drop by tablespoons on oiled griddle., Cook on both sides until golden brown., Serve immediately., Yields 6 servings.

title: Roquefort Dressing
directions: Break up cheese and mix in remaining ingredients until smooth. (Or place all in a blender and process until smooth.), If the dressing is too thick, add a little milk to make it pour better.

title: Almond Tea
directions: Mix well., Before serving, add 1 quart ginger ale.

title: Sugar Cookies
directions: Cream, sugar, and, butter, or, softened margarine., Add eggs; mix, well., Add 1/2 of the flour, salt and baking powder to, the creamed, sugar, mixture., Then add water, vanilla and remainder of flour mixture., Form into small balls on greased cookie, sheet. Bake at 350° until light brown., Sprinkle with sugar.

title: Cheesy Ham And Potato Casserole
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., In a large bowl, mix together potatoes, oleo, salt, pepper, soup, ham, onion and sour cream., Pour into 2-quart casserole., Crumble with Topping.

title: Banana Snack Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Lemon Lush
directions: Mix flour, butter and walnuts., Press into 9 x 13-inch pan. Cook 15 minutes at 350°., Cool., Beat cream cheese, powdered sugar and Cool Whip together., Spread over cool crust., Mix lemon pudding and cold milk together to make third layer., Top with thin layer of Cool Whip., Sprinkle with nuts., Refrigerate.

title: Lemon-Orange Salad
directions: Mix jello and 2 cups hot water., Stir in frozen orange juice. Cool., Then add mandarin oranges and pineapple., Refrigerate overnight.

title: Spice Cake
directions: Mix all well., Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes., Works well in tube pan or layers.

title: Gratin Potatoes(Serves 3 To 4)
directions: Rub the inside of 8 x 8-inch glass baking dish with the cut garlic clove; let it dry., Then smear the inside of the dish with butter or margarine., Cut potatoes into slices no thicker than 1/8-inch., Arrange slices in dish in rows, slightly overlapping both slices and rows., Lightly salt each layer., Do not fill dish more than 2/3 full., Pour milk into dish until potatoes are about half covered; then just barely cover the whole mixture with the half and half., Finally, sprinkle all liberally with the bread crumbs and some butter shavings., (Note:, I use plain skim milk; relying on the seasoned crouton crumbs for flavor; it works fine!)

title: Mexican Soup
directions: Cook meat; drain., In a large pot, add additional ingredients for 30 minutes., Serve with cornbread.

title: Grease And Flour Pan
directions: Mix together., Store in refrigerator and use on pans when recipes read, "grease and flour pans.", Works great on special occasion cake pans.

title: Whole Note Chicken
directions: Put celery, pepper and onion in melted oleo in a skillet., Cook until almost done., Cook 2 cups rice which will make 4 cups cooked rice., Mix chicken, rice, soup and cooked items together., Bake 35 to 40 minutes at 350°., The last 10 minutes, put cheese on top; bake until melted and a little brown on top.

title: Orange Fluff
directions: Combine pineapple and sugar in saucepan (don't drain)., Boil and remove from burner., Add jello and stir to dissolve., Add the cold water and slightly congeal., Fold in ground cheese., Add the Cool Whip and nuts, folding., Put in casserole dish and chill.

title: Calico Beans
directions: Brown beef, bacon and onion; drain off fat., Add beans, brown sugar, white sugar, vinegar, mustard, catsup, salt and pepper. Place in baking dish and bake 40 minutes at 350°., Yields 8 to 10 servings.

title: Tex Mex Dip
directions: In the bottom of a serving dish spread the bean dip, set aside. Mix together the avocado dip, lemon juice and picante sauce and spread over the bean dip. Mix together the mayonnaise and sour cream, spread this over the avocado mixture. Then sprinkle with the seasoning. Top with tomatoes, onions and cheese.

title: Choco Peanut Butter Dreams
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Beat together sugar, peanut butter and margarine until light and fluffy. Blend in water, egg and vanilla. Add combined dry ingredients., Mix well. Shape dough into 1-inch balls., Place on ungreased cookie sheet., Flatten to 1/4-inch thickness with bottom of glass dipped in sugar., Bake 8 to 10 minutes or until edges are golden brown., Remove to wire rack and cool completely.

title: Baked Turkey
directions: Preheat oven to 475°., Baste turkey with magarine., Stuff if desired., Put water, onion and apple in roaster., Put turkey, breast side down in water (this keeps the breast basted and moist)., Cover roaster., Bake at 475° for one hour., Turn oven off., Do not open oven door at all all night.

title: Peanut Butter Chocolate Squares
directions: Combine first 4 ingredients., Press into 9 x 13-inch pan. Melt chocolate in double boiler or microwave oven., Spread over peanut butter mixture., Cool in refrigerator about 30 minutes until edges harden., Chill again until completely hardened.

title: Tante Herta'S Green Tomato Relish(This Is A Double Recipe)
directions: Put tomatoes, onions and peppers through coarse grinder; add salt and let drain real dry., Put tomatoes, vinegar, sugar and spices in pot., Add red pepper and bring to a good boil. Simmer for 10 minutes, stirring well., Pour into jars and process in the recommended manner., Makes 4 1/2 quarts.

title: Pumpkin Pie
directions: Slightly beat the eggs in a blender., Add pumpkin, sugars, salt and spices., Add milk last and beat until mixed., Pour into unbaked pie shell., Bake in hot (425°) oven for 10 minutes. Reduce heat to 375° and continue baking for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Venison Stew
directions: Put in 5-quart stockpot, venison meat that is cut into chunks (as big as you like), onion, salt and pepper., Add water to cover meat; add bouillon cubes., Cover; let cook until meat is done. Put in potatoes and carrots (chopped); cook until done., Add canned vegetables as stated., Simmer., Add flour and water in separate bowl, make it pasty., Add salt and pepper., Add to stew, stirring constantly until thickened., Let simmer; serve.

title: Baked Shrimp A La Jessica
directions: Preheat oven to 450°., Combine first 9 ingredients in shallow 2-quart baking dish and mix well., Remove 1/4 cup of this mixture and set aside., Add shrimp to baking dish and mix thoroughly. Combine bread crumbs with reserved butter sauce and sprinkle over shrimp., Bake 10 to 15 minutes., Serves 6 to 8.

title: Best Ever Cornbread
directions: Mix ingredients well., Pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Stuffed Cabbage
directions: Saute beef and onion lightly., Do not brown; drain fat. Remove from heat., Add rice and water and mix., Place 1/2 of cabbage into ungreased 9 x 13-inch baking dish., Cover with meat mixture., Put rest of cabbage over meat., Pour soup over all. Cover and bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Baked Corn
directions: Mix together., Bake in a 350° oven for 40 to 50 minutes.

title: White Fruit Cake
directions: Dice all fruit., Cut up nuts. Add grated coconut. Dredge with 3 cups flour., Cream the butter, sugar, eggs and flavoring., Add remaining cup of flour., Pour this batter over dredged fruit and nuts., Mix thoroughly. Bake in oven about 275° for about 2 hours.

title: Reuben Sandwiches
directions: In small bowl, combine mayo, pepper and chili sauce., Spread about 1 tablespoon of this mixture on each bread slice., On each of 4 bread slices, place a cheese slice, 1/4 of the corned beef, 1/4 of the sauerkraut, a cheese slice and another bread slice, mayo side down.

title: K'S Brownies
directions: Mix cocoa and sugar., Add flour, melted margarine, eggs and vanilla., Bake at 375° for 35 minutes., Add nuts, if desired.

title: Freezer Pickles
directions: Combine cucumbers, salt and onion; let stand 2 hours. Drain well. Pack in freezer containers, leaving 1-inch headspace.

title: Norma'S Creamy Apricot Salad
directions: Drain pineapple; reserve 1/2 cup juice and set aside. Dissolve gelatin in boiling water; add marshmallows, stirring until slightly melted., Stir in the pineapple and apricot baby food., Chill until consistency of unbeaten egg, white., Combine cream cheese and the reserved pineapple juice, blending well. Stir in whipped topping., Fold in gleatin mixture., Arrange banana slices in bottom of a lightly greased 12 x 18 x 2-inch Pyrex dish. Spoon gelatin mixture over bananas., Sprinkle with chopped nuts (pecans)., Chill until firm., Yields 12 servings., A pretty orange color and delicious.

title: Bug Sandwich
directions: Take 2 pieces of plain bread, put dead spiders and flies and their guts on top., Put fur on it and roast it for 16,000 days. Roast it in a 36 oven., Turn it up to 70 or 80°., Then eat it.

title: Bean Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients and let stand overnight in refrigerator. Drain and serve.

title: Corned Beef Casserole
directions: Cook noodles in boiling, salted water until tender and drain. Add corned beef, cheese, soup, milk and onion., Pour into greased 2-quart casserole., Bake in moderate oven at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Mud Pie
directions: Make crust with cookies and oleo and refrigerate., Soften ice cream and add to chilled crust., Add sauce before serving.

title: Cheese Ball
directions: Soften cream cheese to room temperature., Finely chop green onions and chipped beef., Mix all ingredients together and shape into a ball., Chill several hours before serving.

title: Cherry Dump Cake
directions: Drain pineapple and set juice aside., In a 9 x 13-inch pan, pour pie filling in to cover bottom., Put drained or crushed pineapple on top of that., Pour dry cake mix on top of pineapple and spread evenly., Pour melted butter and pineapple juice on top of dry cake mix., Mix coconut and brown sugar together and spread over top of juice., Cover top of cake sufficiently., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until coconut is golden brown., Cherry juice should be coming through top.

title: Pound Cake
directions: In large mixing bowl, mix sugar and butter together., Add flour and eggs alternately, beginning and ending with flour (example: flour, 2 eggs, flour, 2 eggs, flour and etc.).

title: Squash Casserole
directions: Cook squash., Drain and season with salt and pepper., Mix with 1/2 stuffing., Add sour cream, pimentos, onion and soup., Mix other half stuffing with half cup melted butter., Line casserole with half stuffing; pour squash mixture into casserole., Top with rest of stuffing. Bake at 350° for 45 to 60 minutes.

title: Pol'S Apple Cake
directions: Mix in saucepan for 3 minutes;, pour over warm cake.

title: Mexican Fri Chik
directions: Saute onion and green chilies until onion is soft., Add to remaining ingredients except tortillas and Cheddar cheese., Grease a 3-quart casserole dish., Place a layer of tortillas in the bottom of the pan., Spoon some chicken mixture on tortillas and continue layering tortillas and chicken mixture., Top with Cheddar cheese., Bake, uncovered, at 300° for 1 hour., Top servings with your favorite picante sauce., Serves 8.

title: Lazy Man Cobbler
directions: Mix flour and sugar., Add milk and vanilla., Blend., Melt margarine in pan., Add milk mixture., Stir in canned peaches. Bake at 350° for about 30 minutes or until browned.

title: Potatoes With Herbs
directions: Preheat oven to 425°., Combine seasonings., Place 2 tablespoons oleo in nonstick skillet and melt., Arrange 1/3 of potatoes in a circular pattern, with about 1/4 of seasoning, 1/3 onion and 2 tablespoons soft oleo., Repeat layers 2 times., Cover tightly with foil and press down., Bake 20 minutes uncovered. Bake 20 minutes., Uncover; bake 20 minutes more or until potatoes are tender., Remove from oven; press down with spatula., Let stand 10 minutes; remove to a platter., Serve hot., Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Strawberry Crunch Salad
directions: Mix and spread in greased Pyrex 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake at 400° for 7 minutes., Cool.

title: Crunchy Chicken Cheese Bake
directions: In a 3-quart oblong baking dish, place chicken., Top with cheese., Stir soup and spread over cheese; top with tomato. Combine margarine and stuffing; sprinkle over tomato., Bake at 400° for 25 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink. Serve over rice., Makes 8 servings.

title: Fudge
directions: Mix cocoa, sugar, milk, salt and oleo in saucepan; cook until it comes to a boil., Boil only 1 minute and remove from heat, then mix in oatmeal and other ingredients., Place in buttered pan or drop by teaspoon onto wax paper., Makes 3 to 5 dozen.

title: Sausage Balls
directions: Saute sausage and drain., Add cheese, Bisquick and water., Roll into balls., Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes or until brown., Can also be frozen and cooked when needed.

title: Benedictine Spread
directions: In a large bowl, using an electric mixer, beat cheese until smooth and creamy., Slice cucumber in half lengthwise., Scrape pulp and seeds into a small sieve., Place sieve over a cup and, with the back of a spoon, push juice from pulp (if more juice is needed, rub peeled cucumber over sieve to extract juice)., Add cucumber juice, onion, mayonnaise, Tabasco, Worcestershire and only enough green coloring to give a faint green tint., Beat until thoroughly blended., Correct seasoning, if necessary., Refrigerate.

title: Individual Cheese Cake
directions: Place piece of graham cracker in bottom of muffin paper., Beat well the cream cheese, eggs and sugar., Pour over grahams and top with pie filling., Bake 15 minutes in 350° oven., Makes 12 to 15.

title: Mexican Cornbread
directions: Mix all together., Bake in a preheated oven at 475° for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Beef With Noodles
directions: Place a clean towel over wire cooling rack., Spread cooked noodles evenly over towel and let dry 3 hours., Combine water, 2 teaspoons soy sauce, salt and bouillon granules in a small bowl. Cut beef across the grain into thin slices, about 2 inches long.

title: Kraut Relish
directions: Combine sauerkraut, carrot, green pepper and green onion., Mix together Italian salad dressing and poppy seed., Add to vegetables and toss well to coat., Chill thoroughly., Makes 6 servings, 39 calories per serving.

title: Soft Sugar Cookies
directions: Mix together all ingredients., Drop batter by tablespoon on ungreased cookie sheet., Bake at 375° to 400° about 8 minutes.

title: Potato Stuffing Or Dressing
directions: Cook potatoes., Add salt., Drain., Add oleo and mash., Fry onions and celery until tender., Add to potatoes., Add bread, egg and poultry seasoning., Mix can be used to stuff a small chicken or put in greased bowl, cover with foil and bake in a 350° oven for 45 minutes., Take foil off to brown top., Good as a side dish with fried chicken.

title: Chocolate Gravy
directions: Mix dry ingredients and add milk gradually, stirring until smooth. Melt butter in iron skillet and add mixture; cook until thick.

title: Homos Bi Tahini
directions: Bring to a boil the contents of the can of garbanzo beans and simmer for 10 to 15 minutes., Save the juice from the beans to be used later if the mixture is too thick and needs thinning., Using a food processor, place all the ingredients (with the exception of the olive oil, paprika and parsley twigs) and blend until mixture is smooth., Taste to see if you want to add more lemon juice or salt to mixture., Pour into a nice serving dish; drizzle olive oil on top., Sprinkle with paprika and add a couple of parsley twigs for added decoration., Pita bread can be cut into triangles and used to dip into Homos., I usually double this recipe which serves 6 to 8 people., Import stores have the tahini.

title: Aunt Winnie'S Carrot Cake
directions: Mix sugar, oil and eggs for 1 minute., Separately combine flour, salt, cinnamon, baking soda and salt., Add the 2 mixtures together., Fold in the carrots and walnuts., Bake at 350° for 40 to 50 minutes.

title: Spinach Balls
directions: Blend by hand and roll into 1-inch balls., Should make about 1 dozen., Freeze on cookie sheet and put in Ziploc bags., Bake when needed at 350° for about 15 minutes or until firm and slightly browned.

title: Dreamy Cranberry Salad
directions: Grind cranberries (medium grind)., Pour sugar over cranberries and let set., Wash grapes, cut in half., Put marshmallows in same bowl with grapes., Mix chopped pecans, grapes, marshmallows and cranberries all together., Whip the cream and mix thoroughly., It is better for cranberries, grapes, nuts and marshmallows to sit in refrigerator overnight, then mix with whipped cream about 2 to 4 hours before serving, but this is not necessary., Serves 12.

title: Rumbledethumps
directions: Cook cabbage a few minutes., Remove with slotted spoon., In the same water, cook potatoes until done., Mash potatoes and butter with masher., In casserole stir all 4 ingredients together and top with cheese., Bake at 350° approximately 30 minutes.

title: Barbecued Beef
directions: Brown beef in shortening., Add water and simmer in covered skillet for 1 1/2 hours or until tender., Add remaining ingredients and cook until tender., Add more water, if needed. Serve on buns.

title: Crab Dip
directions: Mix all ingredients except cocktail sauce together., Form ball., Refrigerate several hours., Before serving, pour sauce on top.

title: Eggplant Casserole
directions: Saute meat with chopped onion; mix with eggplant which has been cooked and drained. Crumble crackers and add to meat mixture along with eggplant. Put in greased casserole and bake for 1 hour at 350°.

title: Cube Steak Casserole
directions: Roll cube steak in flour; salt and pepper to taste; brown in greased skillet on both sides., Place meat in casserole dish or crock-pot., Mix soup, gravy, and water., Pour over meat., Cover and cook 2 hours at 350° in casserole dish, or start on high for 1/2 hour in crock-pot, then cook on low until tender.

title: Lung Fever Salve - Draw Salve
directions: First put the lard and wax together and melt; then melt camphor in, it., Then, put in all the other ingredients except for turpentine, and, cook, until, they are all melted., Remove from stove, and, then add turpentine (turpentine is inflammable).

title: Cheese Ball
directions: Drain pineapple well., Mix together; form into a ball., Roll in chopped nuts., Top with a cherry.

title: Weight Watchers Casserole
directions: Mix all together in a large baking dish., Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 1 hour., Serves 6 to 8.

title: Louella'S Broccoli Salad
directions: Mix all together and serve.

title: Chicken Skanavis
directions: Put chicken in a casserole and cover with Swiss cheese., Pour over the breast, the can of soup which has been diluted with sherry., Top with stuffing and drizzle the melted butter over all. Bake at 350° for 1 to 1 1/2 hours., Serves 4.

title: Apple Pudding
directions: Grease and flour 9-inch baking dish. Cream 1 cup sugar and 1/4 cup butter. Add eggs. Sift together flour, soda, cinnamon and nutmeg. Add to creamed mixture. Mix in apples. Bake in shallow pan at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Clam Dressing
directions: Combine ingredients., Add sage to taste and bake in greased baking dish at 425° for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Pumpkin Bread(Makes 2 Loaves)
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Grease (not oil) and flour bottoms only of two 9 x 5-inch or 8 x 4-inch loaf pans.

title: Egg Rolls
directions: Stir-fry cabbage, carrots and onions in 2 tablespoons oil and soy sauce for one minute., Remove from wok and set aside., Add meat and salt and pepper to vegetables., Heat 2 cups oil in a skillet., Spoon 2 to 3 tablespoons of mixture on each egg roll wrapper, fold sides and roll diagonally., Brush with water to seal., Fry in hot oil until golden brown., Drain on paper towel.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
directions: Cook potatoes with onion until tender., Drain., Mix in salt, milk and cup of cheese (about 4 slices) until cheese melts., Pour a layer of potato-milk mixture in a casserole dish., Top with cheese slices., Continue layering potato mixture and cheese., Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes until cheese melts.

title: Japanese Fruit Pie
directions: Mix eggs, sugar, margarine and vanilla; add coconut, raisins and pecans. Pour into 2 unbaked pie shells and bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

title: Sausage With Fried Apples
directions: Shape sausage into 12 patties., Fry in a large skillet over low heat until well done but not crisp., Remove to heated platter; keep warm., Pour off all but 4 tablespoons drippings., Core apples but do not pare., Cut into rings about 1/2-inch thick., Arrange apple slices in skillet., Top with grape jelly and cinnamon., Cook over low heat., Cover for several minutes to soften apples. Uncover; cook until apples are tender and well glazed; turn often, being careful to keep shape of apples., Arrange on platter with sausage., Garnish with grape glaze., Serve immediately.

title: Cheese Dip
directions: Blend all ingredients together in mixer until smooth. Refrigerate., This dip is great with fresh vegetables.

title: Beef Paprika
directions: Cube beef., Heat drippings in a large skillet or flame-proof casserole.	Add, beef, and fry until brown on all sides. Peel and chop, onions, and garlic., Add to pan and cook until transparent. Sprinkle, in, flour, and stir into mixture., Add broth, marjoram, caraway, seed, a pinch of sugar, paprika and seasonings., Cover tightly and cook gently for 1 3/4 hours.

title: Hash Brown Casserole
directions: Melt margarine and saute onion; add potatoes, soup, cheese, sour cream and seasonings., Pour into buttered casserole dish. Mix melted margarine with crumbs., Pat into a crust, covering potatoes, during the last 10 minutes of baking., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Macaroni And Cheese Custard
directions: Boil macaroni in, generous, amount of water., Drain and mix with grated, cheese,, salt	and, butter., Lastly,, stir in eggs. Pour in greased baking dish and bake to light brown.

title: Baked Chicken Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients and pour into baking dish., Reserve 1/4 of potato, chips, to, crumble on top., Bake 20 minutes in 400° oven.

title: Pistachio Salad
directions: In large bowl, mix Cool Whip, pudding and pineapple., Then add mandarin oranges and marshmallows., Pour into mold or bowl and refrigerate overnight.

title: Babuska Peanut Butter Triangle Cookies
directions: Mix peanut butter and butter with powdered sugar until well blended., Stir in Rice Krispies and options., Roll into 4-inch triangles or your size you like., Roll in finely chopped nuts and chill., Slice as needed.

title: Toasted Pita Triangles
directions: Cut pita bread into quarters; separate into 2 pieces., Cream together softened butter with herbs and seasonings., Spread each pita piece with herb butter., Place pita pieces on baking sheet and bake at 375° until butter is melted and pita is crispy, about 5 to 8 minutes.

title: Lime Melon Balls
directions: Boil together the water and sugar., Cool to room temperature and add lime juice., Pour over melon balls in sherbet glasses. Garnish with pomegranate seeds, a sprig of mint or thin slices of lime.

title: Quick Chocolate Mousse
directions: Pour milk into large bowl., Add pudding mix., Beat with whisk until well blended (1 to 2 minutes)., Let stand 5 minutes., Stir in whipped topping., Refrigerate 1 hour.

title: Blueberry-Almond Blintzes
directions: Combine all ingredients, except butter, in a food processor or blender until smooth., Heat an 8-inch crepe pan or skillet over medium heat., Coat pan with about 1/2 teaspoon of butter., Add 3 to 4 tablespoons of batter to the butter, tilting pan to make an even layer of batter., Cook on one side only., When bottom begins to brown, turn out to cool on a plate., Repeat process with remaining batter., Makes 18.

title: Banana Cream Cake
directions: Mash bananas., Mix well sugar, oil, eggs and salt., Mix flour, spices, soda and pecans (optional)., Alternate flour mixture and bananas into the sugar mixture., Bake in two 9-inch pans or one 9 x 13-inch pan; grease well., Bake at 325° for 45 minutes., After cooled ice with cream cheese mix., It makes for smiles.

title: No Peek Casserole
directions: Mix soups, water, rice and parsley in bottom of flat baking dish., Place chicken pieces on top of mixture and sprinkle with onion soup mix., Cover with foil; bake 2 hours at 350°.

title: Zucchini
directions: Saute onion and garlic in butter; add quartered zucchini. Cook until tender., Add diced tomato and/or 1 can chili with or without beans., Cover and simmer 5 to 10 minutes., Add cheese and cover to let cheese melt and serve.

title: "Pink Christmas" Frozen Fruit Salad
directions: Mix in all ingredients., Fold in Cool Whip., Place in paper liners in muffin tins and freeze., Serve on lettuce leaf., Serves 12.

title: Lemon Sponge Pie
directions: Cream butter and sugar until fluffy., Beat in flour, egg yolks, lemon peel and juice, and milk., Beat egg whites until stiff, fold into first mixture., Pour into pie shell and bake in preheated oven., Bake at 375° for 15 minutes., Reduce heat to 300° and bake 45 minutes until golden or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Cheese Ball
directions: Combine both the cream cheese and American cheese in a bowl. Add the garlic powder., Roll into a ball., Put the chili powder (as much as needed) on a plate., Roll the cheese ball around until it is covered with chili powder., Serve with crackers.

title: Blackberry Cobbler
directions: Mix flour and sugar.

title: Ground Beef With Cornbread(Serves 4)
directions: Brown beef, pepper, onions and	salt., Add chili powder and tomato sauce., (If there is any, grease, drain well.) Pour beef and tomato mixture into oiled 9, x	13-inch, baking dish. Pour beans over meat mixture., Spread, cheese, over beans; set aside.

title: Vegetable Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Chill well before serving.

title: Broiled Red Snapper
directions: Place snapper on broiler pan. Brush with butter and squeeze a slice of lemon over each piece of fish., Sprinkle with a small amount of oregano and just a hint of paprika., Broil on top rack of oven for approximately 5 to 6 minutes., Crack door to keep fish warm until serving.

title: Tea Cakes
directions: Cream shortening and sugar., Add slightly beaten eggs, sweet milk, vanilla and nutmeg and stir well., Mix buttermilk and soda and then add to the mixture., Mix in enough flour to make a soft dough., Roll thin, cut into strips lengthwise and then across to make squares and rectangles., Place in greased pans and bake at 400° for 10 to 12 minutes., Yields 10 to 12 dozen tea cakes.

title: Cherry Crunch
directions: Spread pie filling in the bottom of a 9-inch square pan. Sprinkle lemon juice over., Combine cake mix, nuts and melted butter., Sprinkle over pie filling., Bake at 350° for 40 to 50 minutes, until golden brown., Serve with whipped cream or ice cream.

title: "Icebox" Pickles
directions: Bring ingredients, except cucumbers and onions, to boil. Alternate cucumbers and onions in jar., Pour hot liquid over cucumbers and onions., Let cool., Cover and refrigerate for 24 hours before serving.

title: Cooked Icing
directions: Combine flour and milk in a saucepan, adding milk slowly, and stirring until smooth., Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until thickened., Set aside to chill completely.

title: Cranberry Salad
directions: Grind together first 5 ingredients., Add pineapple and sugar. Dissolve jello and hot water., Cool., Add fruit mixture and refrigerate 4 hours.

title: Just For Kids Dough And Salt Art
directions: Knead flour and salt together adding water gradually., Arrange art shapes on cookie sheet and brush with egg whites before baking., Bake at 325° for 30 minutes., Art will be 1/2-inch thick.

title: Braised Cabbage
directions: In skillet heat butter until foamy., Add chives and sauce until tender., Add green cabbage and carrots.

title: Christmas Rum Balls
directions: Combine wafers and next three ingredients., Mix in pecans, syrup and rum., Blend well., Dust hands with sugar and shape dough into 1-inch balls., Press pecans in top of each ball., Let stand for 1 hour, then roll in sugar., Store in tightly closed jar for 3 days., Makes 5 dozen.

title: Bean Soup
directions: Cook lima beans until done., Mix 6 cups flour, 1 pint salt, eggs and water; roll dough and let dry 2 to 3 hours., Melt Crisco in little frying pan; let it get real hot and add 4 tablespoons flour one at a time so it doesn't get lumpy., Let brown and add 2 tablespoons garlic salt and 1 tablespoon paprika., Add to lima beans and water they were cooked in., Tear up dough and put in last., Dig in.

title: Indian Fry Bread
directions: Mix preceding ingredients with just enough water until dough forms., Roll out on floured surface., Cut into pieces and deep fry until golden., Top with honey or powdered sugar.

title: Amish Cream Pie
directions: Heat milk, sugar and cornstarch in pan until thick, stirring constantly., Add butter and vanilla., Stir and pour into baked pie shell., Sprinkle with nutmeg and bake at 375° for 15 minutes.

title: Oatmeal Blueberry Muffins
directions: In large bowl, stir together flour, oats, sugar, baking powder, soda and salt; set aside., In a small bowl, mix egg, water and oil; add all at once to oat mixture, stirring just until moistened., Stir in blueberries., Spoon into greased or lined muffin cups 2/3 full., Blend 2 tablespoons sugar and cinnamon; sprinkle over the batter in each muffin cup., Bake at 400° for 18 to 20 minutes., Makes 1 dozen., Muffins freeze well., Microwave for a quick breakfast.

title: Dumplings
directions: Combine 1 c. water and 1/4 c. butter and bring to a boil., Add 1 c. flour and 1/2 tsp baking powder to above mixture., Let cool. Beat in 3 eggs, 1 at a time., Drop by Tbsp in soup and cover., Cook about 20 minutes.

title: Pasta Salad (With Fruit)
directions: Boil pasta 10 minutes; drain and cool., Drain fruits, saving juice., Add to juice the eggs and flour and cook until thick., Add to pasta., Fold in fruit., Before serving, add about 10 ounces Cool Whip.

title: Coconut Supreme Dessert
directions: Mix butter and flour until creamy., Add pecans and press mixture onto bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake crust at 325° for 15 minutes (or until slightly golden)., Toast coconut in same oven., Watch carefully for it browns quickly., Next, mix 1 cup powdered sugar and the cream cheese., Add 1 carton Cool Whip to this mixture and spread mixture over the baked crust., Prepare instant pudding according to directions., Allow pudding to set before spreading over cheese layer., Cover pudding with 2nd carton of Cool Whip., Sprinkle coconut on top.

title: Taco Soup
directions: Brown ground beef and onion. Drain grease. Add the rest of the ingredients. Don't drain the vegetables. Bring to a boil and simmer.

title: Barbecued Duck Breasts
directions: Dissolve soda and salt in bowl of water., Soak duck breasts in this water 3 hours., Remove, pat dry, and place in shallow pan. Combine next 5 ingredients in plastic bag., Add duck breasts, close bag and marinate at least 1, 1/2 hours (or overnight in refrigerator)., Remove breasts form marinade., Wrap each in bacon and secure with toothpicks., Cook on grill for about 5 minutes on each side, basting with marinade., Serves 4.

title: Caramel Icing
directions: Melt butter in saucepan. Add brown sugar. Cook 2 minutes. Stir constantly. Add milk. Cook until mixture boils. Remove from heat and cool 10 minutes. Beat in confectioners sugar.

title: Secret Message Cookies
directions: Melt chips in a small saucepan over low heat and stir constantly., Place on graham cracker on top of another and dip 3 sides in melted chocolate to seal, allowing excess to drip off. Place on wax paper until set.

title: Peanut Butter Balls
directions: Bring first 2 ingredients to a rolling boil (do not overcook). Remove from stove., Add peanut butter; mix well., Add cornflakes; mix well., Shape by rolling small balls in wet hands., Let set on waxed paper 1/2 hour., Do not double recipe.

title: Classic Karo Pecan Pie
directions: In a large bowl, stir eggs, corn syrup, sugar, butter, and vanilla until well blended., Stir in pecans., Pour into pastry shell., Bake in 350° oven for 50-55 minutes or until knife inserted halfway between center and edge comes out clean., Cool. Makes 8 servings.

title: Hungarian Cheese Logs
directions: Mix with mixer., Roll into 6 rolls on wax paper., Sprinkle chili powder on wax paper and roll log in it., Keep refrigerated.

title: Hearty Potato Soup
directions: Cook potatoes until tender., Without draining them, mash until size of pea., Meanwhile, cook onion in margarine for 3 minutes. Sprinkle with flour., Cook and stir 1 minute., Gradually stir in milk and cook, stirring often, 5 to 7 minutes until simmering and thickened., Stir in potato mixture and remaining ingredients. Yields 4 servings, 234 calories.

title: Apples And Sweet Potatoes
directions: Boil first six ingredients until thick., Boil sweet potatoes until tender., Layer sweet potatoes and apples (apples need to be sliced thin)., Put in 9 x 13-inch casserole., Cook for 30 minutes in moderate (350°) oven.

title: Macaroni And Tomato Soup
directions: Cook the macaroni., Cook the ground beef with the onion and drain., Add the milk to the tomato soup and heat., Add the cooked macaroni and meat.

title: Dried Beef Cheese Ball
directions: Soften cream cheese., Cut dried beef in small pieces., Chop onions fine and mix with cream cheese and 2/3 of the dried beef together with other ingredients., Roll into a ball or log with hands., Roll ball in remaining dried beef., Refrigerate and set out 30 minutes before serving.

title: Applesauce Cake
directions: Cream shortening and sugar together and applesauce., Mix raisins with 1/2 cup flour., Sift remaining flour with spices, soda and salt., Add dry ingredients to liquid mixture., Beat well. Pour into oiled pan., Bake in very moderate oven 300° to 325° for 1 hour.

title: Bread Pudding
directions: I double this and bake at 350° for an hour.

title: Pepper Steak And Rice
directions: Sprinkle steak with paprika and set aside while preparing other ingredients., Brown garlic in margarine and add steak, onions and green peppers., Continue cooking until vegetables are wilted., Add tomatoes and broth., Cover and simmer on low heat about 15 minutes., Blend water with cornstarch and soy sauce. Stir into steak., Cook until thickened., Serve over fluffy rice. Makes 6 servings.

title: Fried Squash Sticks
directions: Slice squash in sticks., Mix flour, salt and pepper., Roll squash sticks and fry until golden brown.

title: Delicious Broccoli Salad
directions: Combine broccoli flowerets, chopped dates, bacon, onion and nuts or seeds in a large bowl., In separate bowl, combine mayonnaise, sugar, vinegar and milk., Pour over salad, mix well and serve!

title: Ice Cream(No Cooking)
directions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl and beat with a mixer until well, blended., Stir, in, any flavoring that you want to choose, such as:, strawberries, bananas, chocolate, etc., Pour into freezer., This, does not have a canned milk taste.	Makes about 5 quarts, depending on how much fruit is added.

title: Cheese And Pineapple Salad
directions: Mix and dissolve cream cheese in sugar and a little cream. Cook sugar, syrup and cold water until dissolved., Soften gelatin in cold water; add to juice., Chill until partially set., Add pineapple, cheese and whipped cream., Add English walnuts if desired.

title: Sweet Potato Pie
directions: Mix together and pour in a buttered casserole dish.

title: Holiday Cut Outs
directions: Cream the butter., Add sugar and beat until light., Beat in eggs., Add vanilla and sifted dry ingredients., Add cream; mix very well., Chill several hours., Roll to 1/8-inch thickness. Decorate, after cutting out, with tree, angel, bell, etc., cutters., Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes., Makes about 5 dozen. Dough can be made and frozen.

title: Karen'S Banana Bread
directions: Mix flour, soda and salt; set aside., Mix Crisco oil and sugar. Add eggs., Add flour mixture until well blended., Add bananas and nuts, alternating with buttermilk., Add vanilla., Bake at 375° until golden brown or approximately 45 minutes (use average loaf pan).

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Boil fryer; take the meat off the bone., Mix stuffing according to package directions., Mix each can of soup separately with a can of milk until creamy., Layer in casserole dish in this order: half stuffing mix, chicken meat, cream of celery soup, half stuffing mix and cream of chicken soup., Bake at 350° until golden brown.

title: Homemade Pimento And Cheese Spread
directions: Mix all ingredients together and use on bread, crackers or as a dip for raw vegetables.

title: Graham Cracker Squares
directions: Place a layer of graham crackers on bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Combine oleo, sugar, milk and egg and boil for 1 minute., Remove from heat and add crumbs, pecans and vanilla., Spread this mixture on top of graham crackers., Put another layer of graham crackers. Combine oleo, milk and powdered sugar and spread over top of graham crackers.

title: Cheese Snacks
directions: Mix all ingredients and form into balls., Flatten on cookie sheets and bake 20 minutes at 400°.

title: Mexican Casserole
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Bake in 11 x 13-inch pan or casserole. Dilute soup with 1/2 can water in a bowl; stir and set aside. Combine Ro-Tel tomatoes with salsa and set aside., Layer all ingredients in pan, starting with chips and ending with cheese and chips., You may make 2 or 3 layers of each ingredient., Bake about 15 minutes or until bubbly., Serves 6 to 8.

title: Pistachio Cake
directions: Preheat oven, to, 350°;, grease, and, flour a tube pan. Blend all ingredients in a large bowl., Beat 3 minutes on high speed. Scrape bowl, often., Bake, at, 350° for 1 hour in tube pan., Frost with cream cheese icing.

title: Melting Moments Cookies
directions: Sift cornstarch with flour., Cream butter and sugar; add flour mixture., Drop by teaspoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet. Flatten with fork dipped in water, if desired., Bake at 325° for 15 minutes.

title: Depression Days Vegetable Salad
directions: Mix salt, vinegar and water and pour over vegetables and let marinate a couple of hours or overnight., More salt and vinegar can be added to suit taste.

title: Easy Lasagne
directions: Fry ground beef and drain; add spaghetti sauce, let sit., In large bowl, mix cottage cheese, Mozzarella cheese, Parmesan cheese, eggs, parsley, salt and pepper., Pour 1 cup of sauce in 9 x 13-inch pan and add layer of uncooked lasagne., Cover with 1 1/4 cups of sauce and 1/3 of cheese mix., Continue with layer of lasagne, sauce and cheese mix., Cover with aluminum foil; bake at 350° for 55 to 60 minutes., Let stand 15 minutes before cutting.

title: Chicken Sour Cream Enchiladas
directions: Cut chicken into bite-size pieces. Set aside. Mix chicken soup, chilies and sour cream. Place a layer of tortillas (whole or strips) in bottom of a 2 1/2-quart casserole dish. Spoon on soup mixture, then chicken pieces. Sprinkle with cheese. Repeat all layers. Bake at 350° for 40 minutes. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Italian Salad
directions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Drain and cool. Drain artichokes, reserving 1/4 cup liquid; set aside. Cut artichokes into fourths. Set aside. Combine pasta, artichokes, reserved artichoke liquid and remaining ingredients in a large bowl; toss gently. Cover and chill. Yield: 6 servings.

title: German Potato Salad
directions: Peel and cut raw potatoes into quarters and then into 1/2-inch slices., Put in pot and barely cover with water., Add onion, parsley, salt, caraway, marjoram and bay leaf., Cook until potatoes are soft., Make a roux from the butter and flour and add a little water from the cooked potatoes to thin., Add this back to the potato mixture to thicken., Stir in vinegar as desired for taste.

title: Marshmallow Creme
directions: Cook sugar, corn syrup and water to 242° or medium ball stage. While this mixture is cooking, place the Karo syrup and egg whites into a bowl., Beat slowly until mixed, then beat hard until light and fluffy., Pour the first mixture into this in a fine stream., When the mixture is completely combined, beat hard for 3 minutes., Add vanilla and store in jars or cans., Do not cover until mixture is cold.

title: Instant Spiced Tea
directions: Combine in a large bowl., Mix well., Spoon in jars and seal. To serve, add 2 teaspoons to a cup of boiling water.

title: Sugar And Spice Cookies
directions: Cream shortening and sugar., Add egg and molasses., Sift together the flour, baking soda, salt, cinnamon, cloves and ginger. Add to first mixture., Put in refrigerator to cool (easier to handle)., Shape in small balls (flour hands to make easy)., Bake on ungreased cookie sheet 8 minutes at 375°., Dust with powdered sugar while warm., Makes 4 1/2 to 6 dozen.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Saut celery in butter until tender. Combine soup and cheese in large bowl. Mix in broccoli and rice; pour in dish. Bake 350° for 30 minutes until bubbly.

title: Miami "Vise"
directions: Combine all ingredients in container of electric blender; cover and process until smooth., Serve immediately., Yield: 4 cups.

title: Easy Shrimp
directions: Melt butter in blazer pan or chafing dish., Add garlic and cool slightly., Add shrimp; cook, stirring frequently, until shrimp are tender., Stir in wine and parsley., Heat to boiling. Serve with rice.

title: Ranch-Spinach Dip
directions: Combine ingredients., Chill for at least 1 hour., Serve in hollowed out round bread loaf.

title: Upside-Down German Chocolate Cake
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Grease or spray bottom of 9x13 inch pan. Sprinkle pecans and coconut over bottom of pan., Mix cake according to directions on the box and pour over pecans and coconut mixture., Mix cream cheese, butter, and sugar together. Pour over cake mixture, leaving 1/2 to 1 inch on each side., Bake for 50 minutes., This was always a favorite of Muggsy's when he came to the house., Without nuts, of course.

title: Chicken Spaghetti
directions: Cook spaghetti. Mix together soups, chicken and cooked spaghetti. Top with cheddar cheese and bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Lasagne Roll-Ups
directions: Cook pasta just enough so it is soft enough to roll., Don't overcook., Drain and lay flat on foil to cool., Combine Ricotta cheese, 1/2 cup of Mozzarella cheese, egg, Parmesan cheese, salt and pepper in bowl., Spread cheese filling on each noodle., Top with a little sauce, then roll them up., Place in baking dish seam side down., Top with more sauce., Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes., Top with remaining Mozzarella cheese., Continue to bake until cheese melts.

title: Eggplant Parmegiana
directions: Mix flour and salt., Place in shallow dish., Dip eggplant slices in egg and then in flour mixture., Brown slices until golden in hot oil., Drain well on brown paper., Place one layer of eggplant in glass 8 x 8-inch baking dish; top with half of Parmesan cheese, Italian sauce and Mozzarella., Repeat., Bake at 375° for 15 to 20 minutes or until cheese is completely melted.

title: Fried Okra
directions: Dip okra in, egg mixture, then in flour mixture., Fry in hot deep fat.

title: Cranberry Crunch
directions: Mix margarine, flour, brown sugar and oats., In separate bowl mix cranberry sauce and sugar., Grease cake pan with a little melted butter., Spread 1/2 of oats mixture in cake pan., Spread cranberry sauce mixture over oats mixture, then cover cranberry mixture with remaining oats mixture., Bake in 375° oven until golden brown.

title: Fresh Apple Pound Cake
directions: Sift together flour, soda and salt., Set aside., In a large bowl beat oil, sugar, eggs and vanilla at medium speed for 3 or 4 minutes., Gradually add flour mixture; beat until smooth., Fold in pecans and apples., Pour batter into a greased and floured Bundt pan., Bake in a preheated 325° oven for 1 hour and 20 minutes or until cake tests done., Cool on a wire rack for 20 minutes. Dribble with brown sugar topping while warm.

title: Healthful Date Bread
directions: In a medium bowl, combine dates and raisins., Pour boiling water over mixture., Set aside to cool slightly., Stir together flour, baking soda, baking powder and salt.

title: Louise'S Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Boil raisins in water; drain raisins, saving 1/3 cup juice. Cream shortening; add sugar and cream again., Add beaten eggs. Stir in oats., Sift flour with spices, baking soda, baking powder and salt., Add alternately with 1/3 cup raisin water., Add nuts and raisins., Spoon onto cookie sheet with tablespoon or roll into balls by hand., Bake for 20 minutes or until lightly brown at 350°. Do not overbake or the cookies will be hard.

title: Fresh Apple Or Pear Cake
directions: Sift together first 5 ingredients., Combine apples, eggs and oil., Stir into dry ingredients., Add pecans and coconut., Bake at 350° for 1 hour in tube pan.

title: Vegetable Pizza
directions: Spread crescent rolls in a 17 x 11 x 1-inch pan and pat together. Bake at 350° until light brown, 10 to 11 minutes., Cool.

title: Better Than Sex Cake
directions: Bake cake mix as directed in oblong pan., Put crushed pineapple on baked cake., then add vanilla pudding., Add sliced bananas, then add Cool Whip (spread across bananas), cherries (drain juice and crush), pecans (crushed) and coconut on top (optional)., Keep refrigerated.

title: Breakfast Egg Casserole
directions: Butter bread placing buttered side on bottom of pan., Layer the Cheddar cheese, Velveeta cheese and ham, sausage or bacon on top of bread., If bacon or sausage is used, brown and fry., Mix the rest of ingredients together and pour on top., Cover with foil and refrigerate overnight., Bake 1/2 hour, covered, then 1 hour uncovered in a 350° oven., Let stand 5 to 10 minutes before serving.

title: Pork Tenderloin With Onion-Raisin Sauce
directions: Brown tenderloin., Place in 275° oven until done, slightly pink in middle., In separate pan, heat 1 tablespoon butter or oil. Saute onion until caramelized., Add raisins., Mix wine and cornstarch., Add to onion and raisins., Cook until thick., Slice tenderloin; place on sauce., Serve with vegetable and potato or rice.

title: Chocolate Upside-Down Cake
directions: Sift together flour, sugar, cocoa, baking powder and salt, then add milk, shortening and vanilla., Beat well until fluffy., Mix in nuts and pour into well-greased and floured pan (about 7 x 10-inch pan).

title: Fettucini With Tomatoes, Basil And Feta Cheese
