In a round baking dish, add bread, apples and raisins., Pour egg mixture over all., Bake in 325° oven for 40 to 60 minutes or until knife inserted near center comes out clean., For a change, add the melted butter and sugar on bottom of dish., Make bread pudding with apples and raisins as directed., Cool., Turn dish upside down over another dish., The pudding will have a caramel type topping. Serve with whipped cream or Cool Whip., Enjoy.

title: Pistachio Salad
directions: Make pudding as directed on back of box; mix in pineapple. Fold in marshmallows and Cool Whip., Refrigerate until ready to serve., Serves 10.

title: Banana Bread
directions: Cream butter, sugar and well beaten egg., Mash bananas with fork and add to butter, sugar and egg mixture., Sift together dry ingredients and add to mixture., Pour into buttered loaf pan. Bake at 300° to 325° for 1 hour in 8 x 4 x 4-inch pan.

title: Potato Salad
directions: Cook potatoes until done. Add celery, onions and eggs. Mix mayonnaise, sour cream, vinegar and sugar. Toss over potatoes. Garnish with paprika.

title: Seven Layer Salad(Taco Flavored)
directions: Stir into drained meat the beans, and taco sauce., Heat. Layer:, meat mixture, sharp grated Cheddar cheese, 1 cup sour cream, chopped onion, olives, tomatoes and green peppers.

title: Luscious Lemon Pie
directions: Combine sugar and cornstarch. Add lemon rind and juice. Stir. Add egg yolks and milk. Add butter. Cook over medium heat until thick. Cool. Fold in sour cream. Pour in baked pie crust. Top with meringue and bake at 400° for 10 or 12 minutes.

title: No Bake Cookies
directions: Mix in saucepan milk, cocoa, sugar and butter., Bring to boil and cook 1 minute., Have ready and stir in immediately peanut butter, quick cooking oats and vanilla., Nuts are optional., Drop on wax paper by spoonfuls and cool.

title: Easy Popsicles
directions: Mix juice together., Cut hole in center of cover of 10 (1 ounce) cups with tops., Fill cup with juice., Place cover on top, then place craft stick or straw in hole securely., Put into freezer until frozen.

title: Poor Man'S Steak
directions: Mix together and press on a cookie sheet., Chill overnight or put into freezer until firm., Cut into 4-inch squares., Roll in flour and brown on both sides in hot oil., Place pieces in a baking dish., Cover with 1 can mushroom soup and 1 can water mixed., Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Plain Pastry
directions: Mix well and form into a ball., Let rest in refrigerator for about 20 minutes., Cut ball in half and roll half just thin enough to be able to handle into a pie plate., Place filling into pie plate with bottom crust in place., Roll out top crust to same thickness as bottom and place on the pie., Bake the pie according to the directions given with the filling., Most 2-crust pies cook best when baked in a hot oven (450°) for about 10 minutes and the rest of the time in a moderate oven (350°).

title: Jambalaya
directions: Chop up chicken breasts. Combine chicken with all ingredients except ham and rice. Bring to boil. Add ham and rice. Cover and simmer until rice is done.

title: Potato Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Put in 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake 1 hour at 375°.

title: Stuffed Manicotti Shells
directions: Mix ingredients and stuff in manicotti shells which have been boiled for 10 minutes., Pour spaghetti sauce over and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Macaroni Salad #2
directions: Cook macaroni; drain., Combine first 6 ingredients with 1 cup mayonnaise, sour cream and 1/2 cup milk., Blend well., Add macaroni and toss., Refrigerate, covered, several hours., Combine remaining ingredients., Stir into salad.

title: Sandwich Spread
directions: Soften cream cheese and mix with the dried beef and horseradish. This is great on pumpernickel bread.

title: Opera Chicken
directions: Sprinkle half of stuffing over bottom of 10 x 13-inch casserole., Layer rest in order given., Blend soup and milk, pour over top., Moisten remaining stuffing with melted butter and water, put on top., Bake at 400° for 40 minutes or until hot.

title: Chewy Cake
directions: Melt margarine, then add sugar and eggs., Cook together over low heat 10 minutes, stirring constantly., Add flour, nuts and vanilla., Mix well., Bake 35 minutes at 345° in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Cool., Cut into squares.

title: Amazing Coconut Pie
directions: Blend all the ingredients in a blender on low speed for 3 minutes., Pour in 9-inch greased pie plate., Let stand for 5 minutes, then sprinkle with coconut., Bake 40 minutes at 350°. Serve warm or cold.

title: Sweet Pickle Sticks
directions: Cut cucumbers into sticks., Pour boiling water over and let stand overnight., Next day, drain., Pack solidly into jars.

title: Caribbean Fudge Pie(Kraft General Foods, Inc.)
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., Beat butter and sugar in large bowl until light and fluffy., Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition., Add chocolate (melt in microwave or in double boiler), instant coffee and rum extract., Mix well., Stir in flour and 1 cup chopped walnuts., Pour into unbaked pie shell. Decorate top with 1/2 cup walnut halves., Bake in lower third of oven for 25 minutes., Cool on wire rack., Refrigerate for at least 1 hour before serving., Top with whipped cream or ice cream. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Caesar Salad
directions: Mix all dressing ingredients and pour over lettuce., Add croutons and stir once more., Use Parmesan cheese before serving, if desired.

title: Zucchini Bread
directions: Grease and flour one loaf pan., Mix ingredients and bake at 350° for 50 minutes.

title: Zucchini Lo-Cal Soup
directions: Saute the onion and zucchini in margarine until tender., Add broth and simmer 15 minutes., Pour into blender, 1/3 at a time, and whip until smooth. Add milk, dill, salt and pepper.

title: Pickled Green Beans
directions: Clean and cook whole green beans., Place them in a sterile pint jar., Boil the water, vinegar, sugar and 1/8 teaspoon salt. Pour over beans and seal jar., You may double recipe.

title: Raspberry-Rhubarb Salad
directions: Heat rhubarb with sugar until soft., Add Jell-O and stir., Add pineapple juice and lemon juice. Refrigerate until partially set. Add the rest of the ingredients and refrigerate again until completely set.

title: Magic Cookies
directions: Melt margarine in a 9 x 12-inch pan., Pour cracker crumbs over margarine and spread., Pour coconut on top and spread., Pour chips on top and spread., Pour nuts on top and spread., Pour Eagle Brand milk over top and bake in 350° oven for 30 minutes., Let cool before cutting in squares.

title: Mixed Vegetable Casserole
directions: Combine all ingredients except stuffing., Sprinkle stuffing over top., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes or until it begins to bubble.

title: Microwave Vegetable Soup
directions: Preparation time:, 1 hour., Use a 4-quart microwave pot with cover., Cook ingredients on High for 20 minutes, stirring at 10 minutes., Cook at 50% power for 25 minutes, stirring every 10 minutes., Taste softness of celery for doneness.

title: Bread Pudding
directions: Break up biscuits in a lightly greased or buttered dish., Beat eggs., Add other ingredients., Pour in dish., Bake at 350° for about 35 or 40 minutes or until lightly brown.

title: Chicken Pie
directions: Brown flour and onions in butter., Add about 2 cups broth and simmer., Use layer of chicken, then a layer of vegetables., Pour 1/2 of the gravy over the chicken and vegetables., Sprinkle with grated cheese., Pull biscuits apart and place on top of cheese. Pour remainder gravy over the biscuits., Bake until biscuits are browned, about 30 minutes at 375°.

title: Easy Meatballs For A Group
directions: Fill slow cooker with meatballs. Combine sauce and jam. Pour over meatballs. Cover. Cook on low 4 hours, stirring occasionally.

title: Barbecue Sauce
directions: Mix all ingredients in jar and shake well. Store and keep indefinitely., Good on chicken, beef and pork.

title: Turkey And Stuffing Bake
directions: Combine butter and water; stir until butter melts., Pour over seasoned stuffing crumbs; toss lightly., Stir in 1/2 can French fried onions., Spoon stuffing mixture into a 9-inch shallow baking dish (1 1/2-quart) or pie plate., Press stuffing across bottom and up sides of dish to form a shell., Mix condensed celery soup, milk, turkey and peas together, then spoon into prepared baking dish. Bake, covered, at 350° for 30 minutes., Top with remaining onions and bake, uncovered, for 5 more minutes., Serves 4 to 6.

title: Herbed Seasoning Blend
directions: Mix well and spoon into shaker., Makes 1/3 cup., Recipe from Hills and Pines Garden Club, Raleigh, North Carolina.

title: Corn Chowder
directions: Saute onion and celery in margarine in a Dutch oven until tender., Add flour and cook 1 minute, stirring constantly. Gradually add milk, stirring until mixture boils., Stir in corn and next 3 ingredients., Reduce heat; simmer 20 minutes, stirring occasionally., Spoon into bowls; sprinkle with paprika., Yield:, 3 servings.

title: Pumpkin-Nut Cookies
directions: Cream shortening., Add sugar gradually., Cream until light and fluffy., Add eggs and pumpkin; mix well., Sift flour, baking powder, salt and spices., Stir in dry ingredients., Mix well., Add raisins and nuts., Drop by teaspoon on greased cookie sheets. Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Coconut Macaroons
directions: Mix together in bowl., Spoon onto greased cookie sheet., Bake at 375° until desired color (approximately 10 to 15 minutes).

title: Easy Bread
directions: Combine shortening and boiling water in bowl, stirring until shortening is melted., Stir in salt and sugar., Let stand and cool to lukewarm., Dissolve yeast in very warm water and add to shortening mixture., Add eggs., Mix well., Gradually add flour to make soft dough.

title: Chicken Enchiladas
directions: Simmer chicken until cooked., Season if desired., Reserve water that chicken simmered in for sauce., Remove bones and cut into small strips or cubes., Allow 1 ounce of chicken per enchilada. Grate cheese., Allow 1/2 ounce cheese per enchilada., Cut whole chilies into very thin strips and chop a little for garnish on top. Combine soup, broth (2 soup can measures), and seasonings in a saucepan., Thicken with the cornstarch., Soften tortillas in the sauce., Remove tortillas from the sauce and fill each with 1 ounce of chicken, 1/2 ounce of cheese and 1 to 2 strips of green chilies. If desired, add 1 tablespoon of sauce and then roll., Make sure the tortilla is soft enough or it will crack when rolling., When pan is full, garnish with chopped chilies and grated cheese., Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes until cheese is melted and toasty on top. Serves 8.

title: Rev.  Vriesen'S Potato Pancakes
directions: Mix ingredients, drop on hot greased griddle and fry until golden brown.

title: Raisin Pie
directions: Mix and cook, stirring constantly over medium heat until thick., Put in a 9-inch unbaked pie shell with lattice top., Bake for 40 minutes at 400° or until done.

title: Sour Cream Enchiladas
directions: Fry tortillas until lightly fried, not crisp, in oil and dry, using paper towels. In a separate container, put cheese. Set aside. Mix together remaining ingredients in another large mixing bowl. Separately fill each tortilla with a small amount of "mix" and a small amount of grated cheese. Place "bed-fellow" style in a large baking dish. Bake at 375° for 45 minutes.

title: Spaghetti Pie
directions: Cook spaghetti; drain and set aside., Saute meat, onion and pepper; drain., Add tomatoes, paste, sugar, oregano and garlic; set aside., Combine spaghetti, margarine, Parmesan and eggs. Press in 10-inch pie plate., Spread with cottage cheese., Top with meat mixture., Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes., Sprinkle with Parmesan.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
directions: Combine cream cheese and peanut butter in a large mixing bowl; beat at medium speed of electric mixer until light and fluffy. Gradually add whipped topping and powdered sugar and continue beating until smooth., Spoon filling into prepared crusts., Freeze at least 8 hours or overnight., Garnish with chocolate shavings, if desired., Makes two 9-inch pies.

title: Potato Festival Bread
directions: Soften yeast in warm water., Mash potatoes while hot, then cool. Add potato water, scalded and cooled milk, salt, sugar and melted shortening to potatoes. Add softened yeast, then stir in flour., Mix thoroughly, using only enough flour to make a stiff, kneadable dough., Knead until smooth and elastic., Place in lightly greased bowl. Cover and let rise until doubled in bulk. Punch down and let rise again for about 1 hour., Shape into 2 loaves., Let rise in greased bread pans., Bake in hot oven at 400° for about 50 to 60 minutes or until done., Turn bread out onto racks to cool., Makes 2 loaves.

title: Spinach Balls
directions: Mix all ingredients well., Shape into balls., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes., Serve with sour cream, if desired., Makes approximately 40 (3-inch) balls.

title: Roman Apple Cake
directions: Cream sugar and butter and add sifted dry ingredients., Add milk, eggs and apples., Pour in a bottom oil and floured 9x12 pan.

title: Crackerjack Cookies
directions: Cream butter well and blend in sugars., Beat in egg and vanilla., Sift flour, baking powder and soda together and mix in. Stir in oatmeal, Rice Krispies and coconut by hand., Drop by teaspoons onto a greased baking sheet., Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes., Omit coconut if desired.

title: Sponge Candy
directions: Mix sugar, corn syrup and vinegar in saucepan., Cover tightly; bring to a boil., Uncover; place a candy thermometer in the pan. Without stirring, cook over medium heat to 300°., Gradually lower heat as mixture thickens to prevent scorching., Remove from heat; quickly stir in the baking soda and vanilla., Turn into a buttered 9 x 13-inch pan., Do not spread; candy will spread itself., Cool; break into pieces.

title: White Fruit Cake
directions: Cream Crisco and sugar; add eggs, 1 cup flour with baking powder and salt., Add vanilla; beat well., Cut fruit and nuts. Sprinkle the other cup flour over fruit and nuts., Pour batter over fruit and nuts., Mix with hands., Line pan with heavy brown paper (grocery bag works fine)., Put in cold oven and bake at 300° for 30 minutes., Reduce heat to 250° and bake for 2 1/2 hours. Place pan of water under cake while cooking.

title: Oven Porcupines
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Mix meat, rice, water, onion, salts, garlic powder and pepper., Shape mixture by rounded tablespoons into balls., Place meatballs in ungreased baking dish 8 x 8 x 2-inches., Stir together remaining ingredients; pour over meatballs., Cover with aluminum foil; bake 45 minutes., Uncover, bake 15 minutes longer., Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Lemon Pound Cake
directions: Frosting:, Grate peel and squeeze juice from lemon; mix confectioners sugar and add juice.

title: Never Fail Peanut Brittle
directions: Boil sugar, syrup and water until it spins a thread., Then add peanuts and stir continually., After peanuts are added, cook until it turns a light yellow., Remove from heat., Add soda, salt and butter., Spread thin on buttered cookie sheet., Break into pieces.

title: Lemon Broccoli Chicken
directions: Cut four thin lemon slices; squeeze 2 teaspoons juice from remaining lemon., Set aside., In skillet, in hot oil, cook chicken 10 minutes or until browned., Remove; set aside., Spoon off fat. In skillet, combine soup, milk, reserved lemon juice and pepper. Heat to boiling., Return chicken to skillet; top with lemon slices. Cover; cook over low heat 5 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink, stirring often., Garnish with fresh thyme if desired.

title: Cripple Creek Chicken
directions: Saute onion and garlic in margarine in small skillet; add paprika., Season chicken with salt and pepper., Roll in onion mixture., Arrange in 11 x 15-inch casserole., Spoon remaining onion mixture over chicken., Bake, covered, at 375° for 40 minutes.

title: Banana Pudding
directions: Stir in all ingredients except milk until moist and smooth, then add milk., On medium heat, cook until thick and boiling., In large bowl, put in alternating layers of vanilla wafers and bananas and pudding.

title: Six-Layer, One-Dish Dinner
directions: Layer potatoes, celery, ground hamburg steak, green pepper, onions and tomatoes., Sprinkle on each layer separately:, 2 teaspoons of salt and 1 teaspoon pepper., Dot with butter., Cover. Bake for 2 hours in moderate oven at 350°.

title: Blueberry Torte
directions: Mix all ingredients and bake crust at 350° until brown, about 20 minutes., Let cool and crumble into 9 inch x 13 inch dish. Save some to sprinkle on top.

title: Corn Dog Mix
directions: Mix well; dip hot dogs in batter and deep fry., This is enough for 2 pounds of hot dogs.

title: Huntington Chicken
directions: Cook celery and pepper in chicken broth., Put noodles and all other ingredients in pan., Add some grated cheese on top., Cook in oven at 350° for 30 minutes or until cheese is golden brown.

title: Pineapple Cake
directions: Icing: Bring sugar and water to a boil. Continue, boiling until mixture spins a thread and remove from heat. Beat egg whites while sugar mixture cooks. Egg whites, will form a peak. Add vanilla and heated sugar mixture to egg whites. Mix well.

title: Drop Fast Cookies
directions: Add sugar, chocolate and milk together and bring to a boil. Add peanut butter and stir until melted., Remove from heat and add oatmeal., If mixture seems too dry add a little more milk., Drop by spoonful on wax paper and refrigerate until cookies have hardened.

title: Pecan Tarts
directions: Blend cream cheese and 1/2 cup butter., Stir in flour and chill 1 hour., Heat oven to 325°., Roll dough into 24 (1-inch) balls and press into 1 1/2-inch muffin tins., Beat egg, brown sugar, 1 tablespoon butter, vanilla and salt together., Sprinkle 1/2 cup pecans on dough in tins., Add egg mixture and sprinkle with remaining nuts., Bake at 325° about 25 minutes or until set., Cool in pans., Makes 24 tarts.

title: Cousin Mary Dee'S Sugar Cookies
directions: Cream the sugar and shortening together, then add the eggs and vanilla., Sift flour and add gradually., Can make drop cookies or roll out, but cool the batter first if you are going to roll them out., Bake in 350° oven for 8 to 10 minutes or until brown.

title: Six Week Raisin Bran Muffins
directions: Pour 2 cups, hot water over bran and let it stand while mixing muffins.	 Mix, wet, ingredients	together., Add	wet ingredients to dry ingredients., Add soaked bran and mix well. Store in, refrigerator., Will, keep, 6, weeks. Bake at 350° in oiled muffin tins, or, cup	cases,	15, to 20 minutes., Do not overcook., Yields 6 dozen.

title: Tamale Pie
directions: Cook ground beef until all pink is gone; drain any grease. Add chopped onion., Cook until it is clear., Add remaining ingredients and simmer., In a large saucepan, put 4 cups cold water, cornmeal and salt., Bring to a boil; cook until the mixture is slightly thick., Add butter; stir it in until melted., Put meat mixture in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish., Spoon cornmeal mixture over meat mixture., Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Kidney Bean Salad
directions: Drain beans and sprinkle with lemon juice, salt and pepper. Mix all ingredients together with 1/2 cup salad dressing.

title: Cucumber And Raisin Salad
directions: Add all ingredients in serving bowl and mix well.

title: Blueberry Muffins
directions: Combine all ingredients, adding blueberries last., Bake at 375° for 15 to 20 minutes., Makes 1 dozen.

title: Beef Goulash
directions: In Dutch oven or heavy saucepan, heat shortening and brown meat well., Stir in Lipton onion soup mix, tomato paste and water. Simmer, covered, 1 1/2 hours or until meat is tender, adding more water, if needed., Serve over noodles.

title: Vegetable Bars
directions: Cover the bottom of a cookie sheet with the crescent rolls; flatten out and pat to make a solid crust., Bake according to the directions on the package until they are a light golden brown. Cool.

title: Chicken Livers And Bacon
directions: Cut chicken livers in 1-inch squares., Cut bacon strips in half., Wrap livers in bacon, securing with a toothpick., Place in a shallow pan., Bake 20 minutes at 350° or until bacon is crisp. Drain fat., Serve hot., Makes 24 bite-size hors d'oeuvres.

title: Dandelion Jelly
directions: Boil blossoms in 1 quart of water for about 3 minutes only. Drain off., Add 3 cups juice to Sure-Jell and lemon or orange extract., Bring to a boil., Add sugar., Boil about 3 minutes., Can seal and process 5 minutes in boiling water bath., Makes 5 (1/2 pints).

title: Cherry Delight
directions: Crush graham crackers in a medium size bowl., Add sugar and margarine;	mix well., Spread in bottom of large cake pan, evenly. Bake 10 minutes at 350°., Remove from oven and cool.

title: Spinach Salad Parmesan
directions: Toss together all ingredients., Serve with your favorite no or low-fat dressing., Makes 6 cups.

title: Spaghetti
directions: Brown hamburger and Italian sausage., Squeeze sausages out of skins., Add seasonings., Add tomato sauce, paste and water; stir. Simmer, uncovered, for 3/4 hour., Make enough pasta to serve 6 to 8.

title: Banana Split Dessert
directions: Make crust with first two ingredients., Crush crackers fine; add to softened stick of margarine., Press into 9 x 13-inch pan and refrigerate., With electric mixer beat next 4 ingredients for 20 minutes., Must be 20 minutes!, Pour over crust., Prepare Dream Whip according to package directions., Fold in well drained crushed pineapple and sliced bananas., Spread evenly over top. Keep refrigerated.

title: Chicken And Dressing
directions: Mix all ingredients together using broth from boiled chicken. Cook until light brown on top. Serve with cranberry sauce or giblet gravy.

title: Linda Kay'S Peanut Butter Pie
directions: (I suggest you double this recipe., I make 2 or more at a time. They don't last long.)

title: Baked Green Peppers And Onions
directions: Put all ingredients in a 1 1/2-quart casserole., Cover; bake in a 350° oven for about 45 minutes., Makes 4 servings.

title: Hash Brown Casserole
directions: Mix ingredients together, except corn flakes and 1/2 cup melted butter., Pour into lightly greased 9 x 13-inch pan., May be prepared the night before and refrigerated.

title: Sweet Potatoes
directions: Arrange potatoes in pan., Mix eggs, milk, 1/3 stick butter, white sugar, vanilla and orange juice; pour over potatoes. Combine brown sugar, flour, 1/3 stick butter and pecans., Sprinkle over potato mixture., Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

title: Spanish Squash
directions: Cook onion in a little oil until tender, but not brown., Add tomatoes, zucchini and salt and pepper to taste., Cook slowly, adding small amount of water if needed., Add bay leaf, if desired.

title: Poppy'S Tomato Sauce
directions: Put a little olive oil in bottom of pan., Brown onion and garlic., Add both cans of tomatoes and sugar., Top with oregano, black pepper and salt to taste., Simmer 1 to 2 hours.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Use a 3-quart baking dish., Stew chicken, cool and debone. Reserve 2 cups of broth., Combine soups with 1 cup of broth., Pour over chicken., Mix melted butter with second cup of broth and mix in stuffing., Spoon over chicken., Cook at 375° for 25 to 30 minutes or until brown.

title: Egg Custard
directions: Mix sugar and flour., Add eggs, milk and vanilla., Grease pie pan with butter and dust with flour., Combine ingredients and pour into pie pan., Bake 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Tamale Pie
directions: Brown onion in cooking oil and add ground beef, chili powder, tomato sauce, corn and olives., Place in mixing bowl and add 1 1/2 cups milk and 1 cup corn meal., Place in a greased baking dish and top with 1/2 pound grated Cheddar cheese., Bake 30 to 45 minutes at 350°.

title: Pumpkin Bread
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Grease 2 (9 x 5 x 3-inch) loaf pans or 3 (8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2 1/2-inch) loaf pans., In large bowl, cream shortening and sugar until fluffy., Stir in eggs, pumpkin and water., Blend in flour, soda, salt, baking powder, cinnamon and cloves., Stir in nuts and raisins., Pour into pans and bake about 70 minutes or until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Creamy Potato Soup
directions: Heat first 6 ingredients until milk is scalding., Stir in potatoes., Cook until smooth, stirring constantly.

title: Apple Chip Cake
directions: Beat together eggs and sugar., Add vegetable oil., In large bowl, mix together flour, baking soda, salt and cinnamon., Slowly mix dry ingredients into egg mixture., Blend well., Fold in apples and nuts., Spread into a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Avocado Dip
directions: Mash avocados., Peel tomato and dice to fine pieces., Chop onion into fine pieces., Mix these together and add salt and very finely chopped jalapeno peppers to taste., Sprinkle lemon juice over top of mixture., This helps it from turning brown., Chill and serve.

title: Fruit Cup With Lemon Creme
directions: In large bowl combine undrained pineapple chunks, undrained mandarin orange sections and undrained fruit cocktail with the flaked coconut and lemon juice., Sprinkle the instant lemon pudding mix over the fruits and toss lightly to combine., Chill. Just before serving, peel and slice bananas; fold into fruit mixture., Serve in dessert dishes; top with approximately 2 1/2 tablespoons Cool Whip., If desired garnish with tiny bit of grated lemon or grated orange peel., Serves 9.

title: Lemon Sponge Pie
directions: Cream butter, sugar, salt and flour., Add egg yolks and lemon juice; beat until fluffy., Stir in milk., Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites with a wire whisk, gently, until well blended.

title: Carob Chip Cookies
directions: Cream butter, honey and molasses; add egg., Sift dry ingredients., Mix together., Drop by teaspoonfuls onto greased cookie sheet., Bake 10 to 12 minutes at 375°.

title: Dirt
directions: Scrape filling off 1 roll Oreos; crush and save., Mix pudding, milk and cream cheese in mixer., Stir in Cool Whip., Crush 2 rolls Oreos, and stir into mixture along with filling from first roll. Spoon into plant pot., Sprinkle crumbs from first roll on top. Cover and refrigerate., Place flower in pot when ready to serve.

title: Sweet Yams
directions: Mix and bake at 400° for 40 minutes.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
directions: Mix oil, eggs, sugar and vanilla together., Sift together flour, soda, cinnamon and salt., Mix well into egg mixture. Blend in apples and nuts., Pour into a greased and floured tube pan., Bake for 1 1/2 hours at 325°.

title: Hawaiian Roast Bacon
directions: If necessary, remove casing from bacon., Place bacon, fat side up, in ungreased baking dish., Stir together pineapple (with syrup), honey, ginger and water., Pour over bacon., Roast, uncovered, for 1 to 1 1/2 hours., Baste occasionally.

title: Roasted Peppers Siciliano
directions: Preheat oven to 450°., Wash peppers and drain well., Place peppers on cookie sheet and bake about 20 minutes or until the skin of the peppers become blistered and charred., Turn the peppers every 5 minutes with tongs., Place hot peppers in a large kettle; cover kettle and let them stand 15 minutes., Peel off charred skin with sharp knife., Cut each pepper into quarters., Remove the ribs and seeds and cut out any dark spots., In large bowl, combine oil, lemon juice, salt and garlic., Put the pepper mixture, with or without anchovy fillets, into a 1-quart dish or jar, covered. Refrigerate several hours or overnight., Serve as an appetizer, a side dish or use in a tossed salad., Makes 1 quart., Excellent with lasagne or other Italian meals.

title: Miniature Chocolate Cookies
directions: Combine flour, salt and baking soda and set aside., Combine brown sugar and granulated sugar, butter and vanilla extract; beat until creamy., Add eggs; beat well., Add dry ingredients; mix well., Stir in semi-sweet chocolate mini chips and chopped nuts. Drop by rounded spoonfuls onto greased cookie sheet., Bake 8 to 10 minutes at 375°., Makes approximately 6 dozen cookies.

title: Zucchini Bread
directions: Sift dry ingredients together., Beat eggs; add oil, sugar and vanilla., Mix well, then add zucchini and pineapple., Add dry ingredients., Pour into loaf pans., Bake at 325° for 50 minutes. Makes 2 loaves.

title: Crab Meat Canapes
directions: Combine cheese spread, seasonings, butter, mayonnaise and crab meat in bowl; mix well., Spread on muffin halves., Freeze just until firm., Cut into quarters., Store, wrapped, in freezer. Preheat oven to 350°., Place on baking sheet., Bake for 15 minutes., Makes 4 dozen.

title: Sunshine Salad Dessert
directions: Strain all fruit and cut up in small pieces., In a large bowl, place all strained and cut fruit., Add sour cream and mix thoroughly., Add miniature marshmallows and mix.

title: Pumpkin Bread
directions: Combine the first 5 ingredients., Add remaining ingredients. Bake in 2 loaf pans lightly greased at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Watermelon Rind Pickles
directions: Select a melon that has a thick rind., Remove outer green skin and pink flesh; use only the greenish white part of the rind., Cut rind into 1 inch cubes. combine rind and cold water; soak overnight in refrigerator., Drain; cover with water and boil 30 minutes. Drain.

title: Puppy Chow
directions: Melt margarine, peanut butter and chocolate chips together. Pour over Crispix mixture., Put mixture and powdered sugar in paper grocery bag., Shake until coated., Allow to cool., Store in an airtight container.

title: Cherry Cobbler
directions: Preheat oven to, 350°., Melt, margarine, in a deep-dish pie pan., In one bowl, mix 1 cup of sugar, flour and milk., In another bowl, mix 1/2, cup, sugar and fruit., Pour batter into pie pan with melted butter., Add fruit., Do not mix., Bake for 1 hour. Serves 6.

title: Southern Pork Loin
directions: For basting sauce, saut onions and celery in the butter until soft. Add tomato puree, vinegar and molasses. Blend well. Place meat on a roasting rack in pan. Brush with part of the sauce. Bake at 350° for about 1 1/2 hours or until pork is tender and juices run clear when pierced with a fork. Do brush the pork from time to time during cooking for best flavor. Cooking time depends on thickness of meat. Makes 4 servings.

title: Skippy Quick Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 325°., In medium bowl, combine ingredients; stir making a dough., Shape dough into 1-inch balls., Put on ungreased cookie sheet., Place 2-inches apart and with a fork, gently flatten each cookie making crisscross pattern on each cookie., Bake 8 minutes or until lightly brown and slightly puffed., May be topped immediately with sprinkles, chocolate chips or Hershey Kisses if desired., Cool on rack completely.

title: Apple Caramel Dip
directions: Unwrap caramels., Place in bowl with a little milk., Microwave until partially melted., Add cream cheese and stir., Microwave until melted and smooth (add more milk if needed)., Slice apples and dip.

title: Spiced Zucchini Bread
directions: Beat eggs lightly in a large mixing bowl., Add sugar, oil and vanilla., Beat until creamy., In another bowl combine flour, baking soda, salt, baking powder, cinnamon and nuts; set aside. Add zucchini and pineapple to egg and sugar mixture., Add dry ingredients, stirring only until dry ingredients are moistened. Spoon batter into 2 well-greased loaf pans., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Nutty Sweet Potato Souffle
directions: Combine margarine with brown sugar., Add cornflakes and pecans., Sprinkle over the cooked mixture., Place maraschino cherries over top and return to oven for about 10 minutes.

title: Banana Loaf Cake
directions: Cream butter and sugar., Add eggs, well beaten., Add flour with baking powder., Sift in., Add milk and soda mixture., Add 4 mashed bananas and vanilla., Bake at 350°., Do not grease pan.

title: Shrimp Scampi
directions: In a shallow baking dish, combine all ingredients except for shrimp., Cook, uncovered, in microwave at High for 4 to 5 minutes, stirring twice., Stir shrimp into butter sauce., Cover., Microwave at High for 5 to 7 1/2 minutes or until shrimp are opaque., Let stand, covered, for 3 to 5 minutes before serving.

title: Apple-Nut Fruit Dip
directions: Beat cheese and apple juice in small mixing bowl until smooth. Cover and chill at serving time., Sprinkle with pecans., Serve with fruit dippers., Makes 1 1/3 cups.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
directions: Mix all dry ingredients and apples by hand in large bowl until apples are well coated., Combine with wet ingredients., Spread in a 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake for 1 hour, or until toothpick comes out clean, at 350° (may be less than 1 hour)., Sprinkle with powdered sugar., Good with, whipped cream or ice cream.

title: Homemade Bread And Buns
directions: Mix lard, sugar and salt., Beat in eggs with spoon into granite dish pan., Dissolve yeast in warm water., Add to mixture., Then add flour to warm water mix., Only then add flour to stiffen and not sticky; pat into ball., Leave in dishpan., Cover with tea towel. Let rise 2 hours., Pull off about 2-inch., Roll into ball., Put in greased pans or into loaf bread., Let rise 2 hours., Bake at 350° to 375° for 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown., Brush with butter after out of oven and pan., Let cool and serve warm.

title: Sour Cream Raisin Pie
directions: In a medium sized saucepan, mix the 1 cup sugar, salt, cinnamon, nutmeg, cloves and cornstarch. Beat in the egg yolks and then the sour cream and raisins. Cook over low heat about 10 minutes, stirring constantly, until well thickened. (Mix will thin on heating and then thicken again.) Remove from heat and cool 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Pineapple Cookies
directions: Cream together shortening, sugar and brown sugar., Add egg and crushed pineapple (drained)., Sift together flour, salt and baking powder., Add to pineapple., Add vanilla and nuts., Bake at 375° for 10 minutes.

title: Superfast Blueberry Cobbler
directions: Preheat oven to, 350°., Melt, butter in a shallow 1 1/2 quart baking dish., Combine, flour,, 1/4 cup sugar and milk in mixing bowl;, stir, to, blend., Pour batter evenly over melted butter. Stir together, berries,, remaining, 1/2 cup sugar and water; spoon evenly over batter., Do not stir., Bake for 45 to 50 minutes or until golden brown and bubbly.

title: Chili Con Queso
directions: In a large crock-pot, add the ingredients., Cook on low 2 hours before serving., Serve with chips.

title: Meat Loaf
directions: Mix, hamburger,, onions,, bell	pepper,, eggs,	cracker crumbs, potatoes,, salt, and, pepper., Mix	2/3, can of tomato sauce. Bake, for approximately 1 1/2 or 2 hours at 350°., When done, take out of skillet. Add 1 1/2 cups of water and 1/3 can of tomato sauce., Thicken with flour for gravy.

title: Banana Nut Bread
directions: In a bowl, cream sugar and butter., Add the eggs and banana and mix together., Sift together the flour, salt and soda., Combine with the creamed mixture; add walnuts and mix again., Pour into 2 greased and papered loaf pans., Bake 1 hour in a 375° oven.

title: Chocolate Eclair Cake
directions: Line bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan with graham crackers., Mix 2 packages jello pudding mix with 3 1/2 cups milk., Fold in Cool Whip., Spread 1/2 jello mixture over graham crackers., Top with another layer graham crackers and spread other half of jello pudding mixture over that., Cool in refrigerator at least 2 hours. Do not cover pan with Saran Wrap or waxed paper., Spread frosting over top and refrigerate., Should be made at least 24 hours ahead of time.

title: Sparkling Harvest Cider
directions: In punch bowl, combine cider, ReaLemon and sugar., Stir until sugar dissolves., Chill.

title: Cheese Biscuits
directions: Mix first 3 ingredients., When mixed well enough to work with, add cheese., Knead this and put on floured board., Roll out and cut biscuits., I melt some margarine in my pan and see that top and bottom of biscuits have margarine on them., Bake at 425° for 15 minutes or until brown.

title: Zucchini Bread
directions: In a large mixing bowl, combine sugar and oil., Mix in eggs and zucchini., Add salt, flour, soda, spices and vanilla., Mix well., Stir in raisins and nuts., Bake in 2 greased and floured loaf pans., Bake at 350° for 75 minutes.

title: Hot Dogs Roll-Ups
directions: Wrap bacon around hot dogs; secure with toothpicks., Place in crock-pot., Pour the brown sugar over the hot dogs., Simmer on high for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Saute celery and onions in margarine., In a separate pan, cook broccoli according to directions; set aside., Cook rice., Combine soup, water chestnuts, Cheez Whiz, rice, celery and onions until the cheese melts., Add broccoli and pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Cheese Roll
directions: Set cheese out until soft; add garlic powder, red pepper and pecans., Mix well with hands., Roll into two rolls., Sprinkle with chili powder., Refrigerate; slice when cool.

title: Lemon-Lime Mold
directions: Make jello and mix but substitute 1 pint of sour cream for 1 cup of water., (Beat some cream with some jello to avoid curdling) and then add 1 can crushed pineapple, drained., Let set and unmold., May garnish with avocado slices.

title: Freezer Slaw
directions: Mix salt and cabbage; let stand 1 hour. Squeeze excess moisture from cabbage. Add carrot and green pepper. Mix together in saucepan the vinegar, water, mustard seed, celery seed and sugar. Boil 1 minute. Cool to lukewarm; pour over cabbage mix and serve. This slaw freezes very well. Make a double amount and freeze half for a future meal and picnic.

title: Layered Bean Dip
directions: Spread on cake platter in order given., Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Lemon Or Orange Icebox Pie
directions: Mix all ingredients until smooth and creamy., Pour into pie crust., Chill until ready to serve.

title: Kraut With Dumplings
directions: Empty kraut in a deep pan., Add water and boil.

title: Lasagna
directions: Cook lasagna noodles according to package while browning one pound of hamburger., Drain hamburger., Drain lasagna noodles and run cold water over noodles., Then spread 3 of noodles in a cake pan making a layer., Spoon Ragu sauce over the noodles., Sprinkle the hamburger over the sauce., Then sprinkle the Mozzarella cheese over the hamburger.

title: Broccoli Salad
directions: Trim off large leaves of broccoli., Remove tough ends and wash thoroughly., Cut flowerets and stems into bite size pieces., Add bacon, onions and raisins., Combine remaining ingredients in separate bowl; stir well., Add dressing to broccoli mixture; toss gently., Cover and refrigerate 2 to 3 hours.

title: Quick Nut Fudge
directions: Combine all ingredients, except nuts, in top of double boiler. Place over simmering water and stir until smooth., Add nuts and mix.

title: Holiday Coconut Rum Balls
directions: In a large bowl, combine crushed cookies, nuts and coconut. Add sweetened condensed milk and rum; mix well., Chill 4 hours. Dip palms of hands in powdered sugar and shape batter into 1-inch balls., Roll in powdered sugar; cover and store in fridge., If desired, reroll in powdered sugar before serving., May be made ahead and stored in fridge for several weeks.

title: Meat And Veggie Bake
directions: Line bottom of a 9 x 13-inch baking dish with strips of bacon. Crumble raw ground beef over bacon., Slice potatoes and place over ground beef., Peel and slice carrots and put on top of potatoes., Slice onion and put on top of carrots., Pour 1 cup water over all., Bake at 350° for, 1 hour.

title: Italian Beef
directions: Cook all ingredients except onions on top of stove for 3 to 4 hours in covered pan., During last 1/2 hour, remove meat; slice thinly with electric knife., Return sliced meat to broth., Add sliced onion and cook another 1/2 hour or until onions are soft. Serve as roast or make sandwiches when served on kaiser rolls.

title: Orange Tea
directions: Pour 4 cups boiling water over the tea leaves and orange rind in a heat-proof bowl and let the mixture steep for 10 minutes. Strain the tea into a pitcher; add the orange juice, the lemon juice and the sugar, stirring until the sugar is dissolved and chill the mixture., Add the ginger ale; pour the mixture into tall glasses filled with ice cubes and garnish each drink with one of the orange slices., Makes 8 drinks.

title: Banana Bread
directions: Cream shortening and sugar., Add rest of ingredients., Bake in lightly greased loaf pan at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Baked Beans
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Bake 4 to 5 hours at 250°. (Can be made in a crock-pot 4 to 5 hours.)

title: Millie'S Spaghetti Sauce
directions: Make meatballs from the hamburger and set aside. (You can brown the meatballs if you wish, but they cook very well if added to the sauce raw.), Combine all ingredients except, meatballs and pasta and cook at least 8 hours., Add the meatballs to the sauce and cook until they are done., Serve over prepared pasta.

title: Custard Pie (Fruit)
directions: Place in unbaked pie shell., One cup of fresh fruit may be placed on top (such as rhubarb, strawberries, blueberries, cherries, etc.)., Bake at 350° until set (knife when inserted will come out clean).

title: Pioneer Skillet Bread
directions: Preheat oven to 425°., Prepare a fire so you will have hot coals on the hearth., Put dry ingredients unsifted in bowl., Mix in buttermilk and egg., Add 2 tablespoons of vegetable oil and mix thoroughly., Put remaining oil in 9-inch cast-iron skillet. (If baking in fireplace, use cast-iron skillet with legs, called spider pan.), Heat skillet in oven or over coals for 5 to 10 minutes., In oven, pour batter into skillet and bake 25 to 30 minutes or until brown., Cut into wedges and serve with butter.

title: Hobo Potatoes
directions: Slice potatoes, pepper and onion in strips. Layer 1/2 the potatoes, onions and pepper on a sheet of foil. Add 1/2 the butter and garlic powder. Layer the rest of the vegetables, add the rest of the butter and garlic. Wrap in aluminum foil. Bake in 350° oven 1 hour or until tender. Also great, cooked on the grill.

title: Roast Turkey Breast With Mushroom Gravy
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Place turkey in shallow roasting pan. Salt and pepper to taste., Mix remaining ingredients., Pour over turkey., Cover and bake until done (165° to 170° on meat thermometer), about 1 1/4 to 1 1/2 hours., Cut turkey into slices. Serve gravy with turkey and, if desired, with boiled or mashed potatoes., Yield: 4 to 6 servings.

title: Old Fashioned Walnut Balls
directions: Cream butter, sugar and vanilla until fluffy., Sift flour and salt together; add to creamed mixture., Mix well to make soft dough., Stir in walnuts (pecans)., Break off pieces of dough size of walnut; shape into balls., Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 375° for 12 to 15 minutes., Remove from cookie sheet with spatula. Cool slightly and roll in powdered sugar., Makes 4 dozen balls.

title: Baked Ahead Potatoes
directions: Scrub, pierce and bake potatoes at 425° for 1 hour or until tender., Cool slightly., Break in half lengthwise and scoop potatoes into a large bowl., Beat in butter, salt, pepper and sour cream., Refill shells., Sprinkle grated cheese on top., Bake at 350° for 30 or 40 minutes., Freeze or refrigerate as desired. Serves 6.

title: German-Style Red Cabbage
directions: Remove outer leaves, quarter, core and shred cabbage., Core and slice unpeeled apples. Combine cabbage, apples, bacon fat, salt and pepper in heavy saucepan. Add enough boiling water to cover. Cover pan and simmer until cabbage is tender, but still somewhat crisp (20 minutes)., Drain off liquid, reserve and keep hot.

title: Crab Delight Spread
directions: Dissolve Knox gelatine in water., Warm cream of mushroom soup and mix with the dissolved gelatin., Add the remaining ingredients and stir., Pour into 1 quart mold.

title: Whole Wheat Bread Pudding
directions: Remove crust., Cut in cubes., Soak in water and squeeze out. Place in 2-quart baking dish; mix and add milk., Put in hot oven. When it starts to bake well, then turn down heat., Stir often for 2 hours., Serve hot or cold with whipped cream.

title: Hot Pizza Dip
directions: In a bowl, combine cream cheese, Italian seasoning and garlic powder., Spread on the bottom of a greased 9-inch pie plate. Combine cheeses; sprinkle half over the cream cheese layer., Top with the pizza sauce and peppers., Sprinkle with the remaining cheeses., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes., Serve warm with tortilla chips or breadsticks.

title: Chicken Salad With Pecans
directions: Boil chicken until done, let cool and cut into small chunks. Fry bacon until very crisp, crumble into bacon bits., Chop celery medium fine., Crumble pecans under each half, is in about 6 pieces., Open canned mushrooms and drain., Put in large bowl: chicken, bacon bits, celery, pecans and mushrooms., Add sour cream, mayonnaise and lemon juice., Mix thoroughly and serve.

title: Ambrosia Cake
directions: Melt margarine in two 9 x 1 1/2-inch round cake pans in 325° oven., Stir in brown sugar., Spread mixture evenly in pans.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
directions: Cream shortening, salt and peanut butter in mixer., Add sugars; add eggs, milk and flour sifted with soda., Drop small spoonfuls on cookie sheet., Mash with fork., Bake at 325° until done., May also be used as icebox cookies., Makes 5 dozen.

title: Congealed Peach Salad
directions: Blend cream cheese and mayonnaise., Bring 1 cup of juice to a boil; add to Jell-O, stirring until dissolved., Add 4 tablespoons hot liquid to cheese mix and blend., Add to Jell-O mix and blend well.

title: Taco Dip
directions: First Layer:, Spread 2 cans of bean dip.

title: Meatball Sauce
directions: Combine all ingredients., Simmer for 15 minutes., Add to meatballs., Cook in crock-pot on low for 6 to 8 hours., (Italian meatballs can be gotten from Sam's.)

title: Taco Soup
directions: Brown meat and drain. Add all ingredients. Simmer for 20 to 30 minutes. Serve with tostado chips or corn bread.

title: Reuben Spread
directions: Mix all ingredients., Pour into casserole dish and bake at 325° for 30 to 45 minutes or until hot., Serve with cocktail rye and horseradish sauce if desired.

title: Broccoli Rice Casserole
directions: Steam broccoli until done. Drain. Saute onion and pepper in butter. Mix broccoli, rice, onion, pepper and mushroom soup together. Salt and pepper to taste. Pour into casserole dish. Top with grated cheese. Put in oven at 350° long enough to heat through and melt cheese.

title: Breakfast Casserole
directions: Cook sausage until done., Drain and set aside., Beat eggs. Add milk, salt and mustard., In a greased baking dish, layer bread, sausage and cheese., Pour eggs over this., Refrigerate overnight., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Potato-Peanut Candy
directions: Boil potato in	slightly, salted, water, until	cooked. Mash hot potato, adding as much powdered sugar as it will hold to make dough that can be rolled out., Add vanilla during this process. Roll out, on, powdered, sugar to 1/4-inch thickness. Spread with peanut, butter, generously., Roll, up, and	slice. This candy keeps very well.

title: Hamburger And Macaroni
directions: Brown hamburger in skillet., Cook macaroni until done in large pot., Put macaroni and hamburger in square 9 x 9-inch pan or larger if serving large crowd., Add spaghetti sauce., Sprinkle shredded cheese over top., Place in microwave or in oven at 350° until cheese melts.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Cook and drain broccoli. Mix other ingredients together. Set aside. Put broccoli in 9 x 11 baking pan. Pour mixture over it. Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes, uncovered.

title: Pumpkin Pie Cake
directions: Mix together., Put in bottom of a 13 x 9-inch greased pan.

title: Gingery Pea And Noodle Salad
directions: Stir mayonnaise, ginger, garlic salt, mustard and soy sauce. Chill. Dice green onions and celery. Combine with peas and water chestnuts., Cover and chill.

title: Macadamia Butterfingers
directions: Preheat oven to 275°., Lightly grease a 15 x 10-inch jelly roll pan., In a large mixing bowl, beat butter, brown sugar, granulated sugar, egg yolk and nutmeg until light and fluffy., Add flour; stir to combine., Pat dough over bottom of prepared pan.

title: Grandma'S Swiss Steak
directions: Get the round steak cut a little thicker than the regular round steak., Cut meat into pieces., Pour some flour on it and pound flour into meat., Have oil hot in pan; brown meat., Add green pepper, celery and tomato juice to meat., Salt to taste. Let simmer until well done., Add a little water if meat isn't done and the tomato juice is used up.

title: Miniature Cheesecakes
directions: Mix together., Place in paper lined cupcake tins, using about 1 1/2 tablespoons per cup., Reserve 1/2 cup for topping.

title: Fruit Punch
directions: Combine all and serve over ice.

title: Fried Ice Cream
directions: Roll a scoop of ice cream (any flavor) in crushed corn flakes. Freeze., Roll out a canned biscuit or pie pastry and wrap ice cream, being careful to seal all edges., This may be returned to freezer until ready to fry., Heat oil to 400° and drop ice cream in for 30 seconds to 1 minute., Drain., Top with maple syrup and nuts., Most any kind of ice cream topping will do fine., Serve at once.

title: Bacon Wrapped Water Chestnuts
directions: You will need toothpicks.

title: Memmie'S Chocolate Pie
directions: Bake pie crust according to directions on package., Heat milk in double boiler., While it is heating, mix sugar, salt, cornstarch and cocoa well; set aside., Beat egg yellows slightly, adding 1/3 cup of the warmed milk., Pour egg mixture back into milk in double boiler., Add sugar mixture., Stir constantly over medium heat until thick., Remove from heat., Add butter and vanilla., Allow to cool slightly., Pour into cool baked pie shell., Top with meringue.

title: Patti'S Chicken
directions: Beat eggs; add garlic, pepper and diced onions., Dip chicken breasts in mixture., Fry chicken until brown, then bake at 350° for 30 minutes., Add vegetables to chicken and bake an additional 15 minutes., Take chicken out of the oven and sprinkle the avocado over it before serving., Serves 4.

title: Meatballs
directions: Mix all ingredients and shape into small meatballs., Roll meatballs in paprika., Lightly brown in 1/4 cup margarine., Drain grease and cover meatballs with cream of mushroom soup mixed with 1/2 can water., Bake 1/2 hour at 350°.

title: Breakfast Casserole
directions: Tear bread into pieces and put in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Cook sausage and drain., Put over bread., Put cheese over sausage.

title: Low-Fat Jello Salad
directions: Cook Jell-O and pineapple juice for 5 minutes after it comes to a full boil., Cool., Mix Cool Whip, cottage cheese and pineapple together., Add Jell-O mixture., Blend well., Pour in mold and chill.

title: Orange Raisin Carrots
directions: Combine carrots, water and salt in saucepan., Bring to a boil. Cover and reduce the heat., Simmer for 5 to 8 minutes, until carrots are crisp-tender; drain., Combine orange juice and cornstarch and stir into carrots., Stir in raisins and sugar. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until smooth and thickened., Serves 4 to 6.

title: Peanut Butter Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Beat first 3 ingredients until creamy., Beat in water, egg and vanilla., Add combined dry ingredients., Mix well., Cover; chill about 2 hours., Heat oven to 350°., Shape into 1-inch balls., Place on ungreased cookie sheet; flatten with tines of fork dipped in granulated sugar to form crisscross pattern., Bake 9 to 11 minutes or until edges are golden brown., Cool 1 minute on cookie sheet. Remove to wire rack., Cool completely.

title: Frozen Chocolate Sundae
directions: Melt chocolate chips and marshmallows in evaporated milk on medium heat., Layer crushed cookies in a flat 9 x 13-inch dish with softened ice cream on top of that., Spread the chocolate mixture over the top of ice cream; sprinkle more cookie bits on top of chocolate mixture and freeze., When set, cut and serve.

title: Rich Chocolate Chess Pie
directions: Mix together thoroughly the dry ingredients., Add remaining ingredients and beat with mixture until well blended., Pour into unbaked pie shells., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Cocktail Sauce
directions: Mix all ingredients., Serve with boiled shrimp.

title: Potatoes For Mr. And Mrs. Party
directions: Melt 1/2 stick oleo in a 9 x 13-inch pan., Mix together onion and potatoes and put in pan., Heat mushroom soup and cheese., Pour over potatoes and onion., Top with corn flakes and drizzle with melted butter.

title: Heath Toffee Cake
directions: Cook German chocolate cake as directed on package., When cake is done, while hot, pour milk over cake., Next, pour caramel topping over cake., Next, put chopped nuts, then add chopped Heath bar., Punch holes in cake before adding topping ingredients.

title: Buttermilk Coconut Pie
directions: Cream sugar and butter., Add eggs, buttermilk and coconut. Pour in unbaked pie shell., Bake at 350° for about 1 hour or until browned.

title: Million Dollar Pies
directions: Mix ingredients and pour into prepared pie shells. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Coq Au Vin
directions: Wash and dry chicken., Combine salt, pepper and flour; rub into chicken., Brown chicken in butter in a Dutch oven or electric skillet., Add whole onions, garlic and mushrooms., Cook over low heat until onions brown lightly., Add wine, thyme and bay leaf. Cook covered over low heat 30 minutes or until tender.

title: Gladys' Baked Dessert
directions: Beat eggs; add dry ingredients., Mix well., Stir in melted butter. Add pecans and vanilla., Pour into an 11 x 7-inch pan. Set that pan in another pan of boiling water., Bake at 325°., Bake for 45 minutes or until set like a custard., Do not overbake. Cool., Cut into 2-inch squares., Can be served plain or topped with whipped cream and a cherry.

title: Pizza Potatoes
directions: Put potato slices and packet of seasoning mix into ungreased 2-quart casserole., Heat tomatoes, water and oregano to boiling; stir into potatoes., Mix in cheese and pepperoni (use as much or as little as you like)., Arrange more cheese and pepperoni on top. Bake, uncovered, for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Cream Squares
directions: Melt butter and pour into cake mix., Add egg., Mix and press into 9 x 13-inch pan or baking dish., Take cream cheese, powdered sugar, vanilla and eggs and pour over cake mix., Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350°.

title: Orange Cranberry Cake
directions: Drain pineapple., Combine flour, sugar, soda and salt., Stir in dates and almonds., Combine pineapple with eggs, cranberry sauce, oil and orange peel; stir into dry mixture.

title: Uncooked Finger Paints
directions: Mix flour and salt., Add water., Mixture will be grainy.

title: Easy Cherry Cake
directions: Melt the margarine in an 8 or 9-inch square pan., Combine flour, sugar, baking powder and milk., Pour over margarine., Pour cherry pie filling over dough., Bake 45 minutes at 350°.

title: Eggplant Parmesan
directions: Wash and peel eggplant. Slice into 3/8-inch slices., Dip into beaten eggs until coated well, then place into seasoned bread crumbs until well coated., Cook in electric pan at 300° for 3 to 4 minutes on each side., You may use olive oil, Pam or vegetable oil., Make 2 rows in a 13 x 9-inch dish., Pour sauce over fried eggplant., Sprinkle with cheese and sliced mushrooms., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes until slightly golden., Allow cheese to set for 10 minutes before serving., Serves 4.

title: Clam Chowder
directions: Bring to a boil all ingredients except clams., Cook for 20 minutes., Take off burner., Now, dump in clams and let set while you get another saucepan and melt 4 tablespoons of margarine. Stir in 2 tablespoons of flour and 1/2 cup evaporated milk., Add salt and pepper to taste., (It will appear lumpy.), Take off burner., Put soup back on burner and pour in the sauce., Stir frequently and cook for 10 more minutes.

title: Valentine Party Salad
directions: In a medium bowl, combine dry gelatin and cottage cheese. Fold in pineapple, marshmallows, pecans and cherries., Add Cool Whip lite., Mix gently to combine., Cover and refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Indoor S'Mores
directions: Butter baking pan, 13 x 9 x 2-inch., Heat corn syrup, butter and chocolate morsels to boiling in 3-quart saucepan, stirring constantly., Remove from heat., Stir in vanilla., Pour over cereal in large mixing bowl; toss quickly until completely coated with chocolate., Fold in marshmallows, 1 cup at a time., Press mixture evenly in pan with buttered back of spoon., Let stand until firm at least 1 hour., Cut into about 1 1/2-inch squares., Makes 48 squares.

title: Barbecue Slaw
directions: Mix with 1/2 large head of cabbage, chopped.

title: Quick And Easy Jello Salad
directions: Sprinkle dry gelatin into cottage cheese and mix thoroughly. Add remaining ingredients., Store salad in refrigerator at least 4 hours before serving.

title: Herb Dressing
directions: Combine all ingredients in advance., Chill and store and use as desired over salads., Use 2 tablespoons per serving.

title: Oatmeal Cake
directions: Combine oats and oleo in boiling water and let stand 20 minutes., Cream together sugars and eggs and add to oat mixture, then add flour, salt, cinnamon, soda and vanilla., Mix well., Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Bad Baked Beans
directions: Cook bacon until crisp., In pot, add beans, onions, bell peppers and remaining ingredients., Heat on low 15 minutes. Crumble bacon and add most of it to heating mixture., Put mixture in baking dish and top with remaining bacon., Cook at 325° for about 30 minutes.

title: Thanksgiving Potatoes
directions: Place the diced potatoes in a large saucepan and add water to cover., Heat to boiling., Reduce heat and simmer over medium heat until tender., Drain., Place the potatoes in a mixer bowl., Cut the butter and cream cheese into small pieces and add to the potatoes. Beat with an electric mixer until light and fluffy., Beat in the sour cream., Season with nutmeg, salt and pepper to taste., Serve immediately or reheat in a buttered casserole at 300° for 20 minutes, if you want to prepare them in advance., Yields 8 servings.

title: Hamburger Quiche
directions: Brown meat in skillet over medium heat., Drain fat and set aside., Blend next four ingredients until smooth., Stir in meat, cheese, onion and pepper.

title: Chocolate Sheet Cake
directions: Combine sugar, flour, cocoa, baking soda and salt in a large mixing bowl; mix well., Heat margarine and water in saucepan until boiling., Pour over dry ingredients; mix well., Beat in buttermilk, eggs and vanilla.

title: Eggplant Casserole
directions: Peel and dice eggplant., Cook for 10 minutes in boiling water. Drain in a colander., Place in a greased baking dish., Melt 3 tablespoons butter; stir in 3 tablespoons flour., Add tomatoes, then chopped onion and pepper., Add 1 tablespoon sugar, bay leaf and cloves; cook 5 minutes., Pour over eggplant., Cover with bread crumbs; add grated cheese on top., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Harvest Cake
directions: Dice apples., Mix well with sugar; let stand for 1 hour., Add flour, soda, salt, vanilla, oil, eggs, walnuts and fruit., Mix well., Pour into baking pan., Bake at 325° for 45 to 55 minutes.

title: Barbecued Pot Roast
directions: Rub roast surface with salt and pepper. Brown in butter on all sides. Add water, tomato juice, onion and garlic., Simmer meat 1 1\2 hours. Mix remaining ingredients and add to meat. Cook for 2 hours more. Add potatoes and carrots the last 2 hours.

title: Cranberry Conserve
directions: In a large saucepan, combine cranberries, orange peel, oranges, raisins and water., Cover and simmer over medium heat until cranberries are soft., Add pecans and sugar; stir well. Simmer, uncovered, 10 to 15 minutes, stirring often., Cool., Spoon into covered containers., Refrigerate., Serve as a relish with poultry or pork, or spread on biscuits.

title: Chow Chow
directions: Mix the mustard, flour, oil and turmeric together with 1 pint cold vinegar., Stir into 6 pints of vinegar and boil., Add vegetables and cook until tender., Put in jars and seal well.

title: Cheese Blitz
directions: Mix well the cream cheese, egg and 1/2 cup sugar. Spread mixture on bread., Roll up; dip in margarine and sugar., Mix 1/2 cup sugar with cinnamon., Melt margarine., Bake at 400° for 15 minutes.

title: Banana Bundt Cake
directions: Blend all ingredients together thoroughly in a large bowl. Pour into a "well" greased Bundt pan., Bake at 350° for 50 minutes., Cool in pan for 15 minutes., Turn out on a plate., A light powdered sugar glaze goes well with this cake.

title: Jello Pudding Pecan Pie
directions: Blend pie filling with corn syrup., Gradually stir in evaporated milk and egg., Add nuts., Pour into pie shell., Bake at 375° until top is firm and just begins to crack (about 40 minutes)., Cool at least 3 hours., Garnish, if desired.

title: Pink Fluff
directions: Take pineapple, Jell-O and sugar and heat on stove., Cool. Beat cold milk and softened cream cheese., Fold into jello mixture.

title: Tater Tot Casserole
directions: Saute onion in butter., Add meat., Brown and drain., Add tomatoes, corn, soup and ketchup., Top with Tots., Bake at 400° for 15 minutes or until Tots brown.

title: Pineapple Icebox Pudding
directions: Combine butter and sugar., Beat until light., Add beaten egg yolks and pineapple., Beat egg whites until stiff and fold into mixture., Roll wafers to crumbs and add crushed pecans., Place a layer of crumbs then a layer of fruit, alternating with crumbs on top., Refrigerate overnight., Serve with whipped cream.

title: Tater Tot Casserole
directions: In ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan, crumble raw ground beef and season with salt, pepper, onion and garlic powder., Cover evenly with Tater Tots., Add the undiluted cream of mushroom soup., Cover with foil and bake 45 minutes until bubbly., Bake at 350°., Serves 6 to 8.

title: Tex-Mex Soup
directions: In a 3-quart saucepan, brown onion and hamburger., Add remaining ingredients., Heat for 10 minutes., Serve with crushed corn or tortilla chips, cheese, sour cream and shredded lettuce.

title: Herbed Beef-Vegetable Stew
directions: In a Dutch oven, brown meat on all sides in hot oil., Drain off any excess fat., Stir in gravy, tomatoes, Heinz 57 sauce, garlic, bay leaves, thyme and pepper., Bring to boiling; reduce heat., Cover; simmer for 1 hour., Add carrots and onions; simmer 20 minutes more., Stir in mushrooms and, if desired, the olives. Simmer 15 minutes more, or until meat and vegetables are tender. Remove bay leaf; discard., Season to taste., Sprinkle with parsley.

title: Beef Summer Sausage
directions: Crumble ground beef in a large bowl., Mix the next 6 ingredients together and sprinkle over ground beef., Mix water and liquid smoke together and pour over ground beef., Add peppercorns and mix thoroughly, best method is to use your hands., Divide into 3 equal portions and shape into rolls., Wrap in foil., Refrigerate for 24 hours.

title: Chicken Sauce
directions: Mix together and heat until thick., Put chicken in oven for 15 minutes at 400°., Take out and pour sauce over chicken., Bake in oven for one hour.

title: Cranberry Dip
directions: Mix all ingredients together. Serve over a bar of cream cheese.

title: Surprise Pie
directions: Place eggs, oleo, sugar and flour into blender at high speed for 1 minute. Whether using chocolate chips or coconut, add and blend a few seconds., Pour into greased pie plate. Bake in preheated 350° oven for 35 to 40 minutes or until knife inserted 1-inch from center comes out clean., Pie forms its own crust.

title: Dilly Dip
directions: Combine all ingredients., Store in refrigerator overnight before serving.

title: Tuna Casserole
directions: Heat oven to 400°., Blend soup and milk and add all ingredients, except 1/2 cup cheese., Pour into greased casserole dish., Sprinkle with reserved cheese., Bake for 20 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Peanut Butter Candy
directions: Heat sugar and syrup slowly to boiling until sugar melts completely., Remove from heat and stir in peanut butter., Add Rice Krispies., Roll into balls with hands and place on waxed paper or spread on buttered cookie sheet and cut into 1-inch squares. Store in fridge.

title: Zucchini Casserole Imperial
directions: Cook zucchini until tender (not mushy); drain., In large bowl, beat eggs; stir in mayonnaise, onion, green pepper, celery, salt and pepper., Add zucchini., Turn into a greased 1 1/2-quart baking dish., Dot with butter and sprinkle with buttered breadcrumbs.

title: New Corn Bread
directions: Blend gently to mix, then bake in greased pan at 425° until brown and crusty.

title: Chalupa
directions: Combine in large kettle., Cover with water; bring to boil. Cover and simmer about 6 hours., Break up meat and cook, uncovered, until thick, about 45 minutes.

title: Banana Cream Supreme
directions: Place graham crackers in bowl and add butter and sugar. Press crumbs on bottom of baking dish., Mix sour cream, milk and pudding mix together., Add whipped topping,, mixing until blended. Spread 1/2 over crumb crust., Slice bananas over filling., Spread the remaining filling over that., Grate pecans over top., Garnish with raspberries and mint.

title: Fireplace Potatoes
directions: Combine potatoes, onions, parsley and pimiento., Add seasonings., Brown in hot fat until golden brown and crisp. Makes 6 servings.

title: Puppy Chow
directions: Melt together chocolate chips, peanut butter and margarine and pour over Crispix cereal (use a large bowl)., Stir well., Get a grocery sack., Shake out the dust., Take the powdered sugar and pour in the sack., Dump the cereal mixture in., Close the top of the sack., Shake it., Shake it some more, baby, shake, shake, shake, shake., Look in the bag., Is your chow well coated?, If not, add more sugar and shake it, baby, shake it some more., Pour out onto wax paper or foil., Eat some., Eat some more., Put it in a bowl with a lid and put it in a cabinet., Say you won't eat anymore., Swear you won't eat more!, Eat some more . . . get really fat!

title: Orange Raspberry Soup(Serve As An Appetizer Or As A Dessert.)
directions: Let orange concentrate and red raspberries thaw overnight in fridge., Combine all ingredients in blender., Turn on high for 1 minute., (Can be made ahead of time and kept in fridge until needed.)

title: Squash Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients except crackers and butter., Pour into well-greased baking dish., Sprinkle top with buttered cracker crumbs and bake at 375° for 40 minutes.

title: Hash Brown Potato Casserole
directions: Grease 9 x 13-inch pan., Melt margarine (reserve 1/4 cup). Mix other 1/4 cup margarine, salt, onion, sour cream, soup and cheese in pan until cheese melts., Put hash browns in pan., Pour cheese mixture over hash browns., Cover with crushed corn flakes and pour remaining margarine over all., Bake for 45 minutes to 1 hour at 350°.

title: Special K Bars
directions: Combine sugar and Karo syrup in pot and bring to boil., Be very careful not to burn, helps to keep stirring., Take off stove; stir in peanut butter, then add Special K. Mix well and spread evenly in greased pan or dish (14 x 9-inch works real good)., Sprinkle both types of chips on top and top broil in oven just to slightly melt chips., Remove and let cool., Cut and serve.

title: Cherry Crunch
directions: Mix brown sugar, oleo, 2 tablespoons flour and walnuts., Set aside., Sift flour, baking powder and salt., Beat eggs., Gradually add sugar, beating after each addition., Stir in melted oleo., Add flour mixture, alternately with milk., Beat until smooth., Spread 1/2 of batter in greased 9-inch pan., Spoon pie filling over batter., Cover with remaining batter., Sprinkle brown sugar mixture over top and bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Seafood Chowder
directions: Saute onion and carrots in butter until onion is tender. Sprinkle with flour and stir., Add water, salt and pepper and simmer 10 to 15 minutes., Add remaining ingredients and simmer approximately 30 minutes., Yield: 6 to 8 servings.

title: Butterfinger Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Combine flour, soda and salt in a small bowl. Beat sugar and butter in large mixing bowl until creamy. Beat in egg; gradually add flour mixture. Stir in Butterfinger pieces. Drop by slightly rounded tablespoon onto ungreased baking sheet. Bake for 10-12 minutes or until lightly browned. Cook on baking sheet for 2 minutes; remove to wire racks to cool completely.

title: Brownies
directions: Cream the margarine; add sugar., Mix in eggs; add vanilla. Stir in flour., Add chocolate and nuts., Bake 25 minutes at 325°.

title: Stuffed Mushrooms
directions: In a medium bowl, combine stems, cheese, parsley and dressing. Fill mushroom caps., Bake 30 minutes or until cheese is melted. Contains 15 calories each.

title: Borscht
directions: Chop beets, carrots and onion., Cover with water in a saucepan and bring to a simmer., Cook over medium heat for 15 minutes., Add cabbage, miso and apple cider vinegar., Cook for 10 more minutes. Add tamari or salt to taste., Serve hot in bowls with a dollop of sour cream on top.

title: Lasagna
directions: Cook ground beef., Mix the spaghetti sauce and onion together. In a 9 x 18-inch pan, layer the noodles, meat and cheeses until pan is full., Cook for 20 minutes in oven at 350°.

title: Mother'S Flaky Pie Crust
directions: Sift together flour and salt., Blend in Crisco., Mix together vinegar, egg and water and stir into flour mixture., Roll out and fit into pie pans., Fill with favorite fillings.

title: Monster Cookies
directions: Mix in order. Bake at 350 degrees for 15 minutes.

title: Coconut Delight
directions: Cut, butter into flour until it looks like coarse meal. Add pecans and press into 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes or until done., Cool.

title: Sourdough Biscuits
directions: Dissolve yeast in warm water., Add all other ingredients. Place dough in greased bowl., No need to let rise before baking. Keep covered in icebox and cook as you want them.

title: Peaches And Cream Cake
directions: Mix cake mix according to directions on box., Mix in dry pudding mix., Pour into 8 1/2 x 13-inch greased cake pan., Place sliced peaches on top of batter., Blend cream cheese, sugar and peach juice together and pour over top of peaches., Bake for 1 hour on 350°., Best when served warm!

title: Hominy
directions: Dissolve the lye in the cold water., Stir in the shelled corn and let stand for 15 hours., Drain off the lye water and put the corn in a sack., Rub and wash it in the sack through running water. After the hulls are off the corn, take it out of the sack and cook for 3 or 4 hours or until tender., Change the water 2 or 3 times while it is cooking.

title: Fudge Sauce
directions: Place ingredients into saucepan., Heat on high to a boil. Continue to boil, stirring constantly.

title: Raspberry Ribbon Salad
directions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water., Stir in raspberries, pineapple and pecans; blend well., Spoon 1 1/2 cups gelatin mixture into a lightly oiled 8-cup mold., Chill until set., Spread 1 cup sour cream over raspberry layer., Spread remaining raspberry mixture over sour cream., Chill until set., Spread 1 cup sour cream over raspberry layer., Top with remaining raspberry mixture. Chill until firm.

title: Dorito Casserole
directions: Brown hamburger and onion in skillet., Season with salt and pepper., Drain off fat., Add mushroom soup, milk, Cheddar cheese soup and Ro-Tel tomatoes., Mix well., Place layer of Doritos chips in the bottom of baking dish, followed by layer of mixture, then chips and more mixture., Place layer of grated cheese on top. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Chili
directions: In separate skillets, brown the meats, drain and spoon into large stew pot., Then, in no particular order, add everything else. Cover and simmer on medium heat until vegetables are tender.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
directions: Drain Veg-All., Mix with chicken, soup and broth.

title: Papaya Jam
directions: Measure fruit into 6 or 8-quart pot., Measure sugar into separate bowl; mix 1/4 cup of the sugar with 1 box of Sure-Jell. Stir sugar with Sure-Jell into fruit., Bring mixture to full rolling boil, stirring constantly., Quickly add remaining sugar to fruit., Bring to full rolling boil., Boil 1 minute, stirring constantly., Remove from heat., Fill jars., Quickly cover and seal., Invert for 5 minutes.

title: Ambrosia Dip
directions: Drain and rinse cherries., Drain pineapple., Place all ingredients in food processor., Process until well blended or mix well until blended., Chill 1 to 2 hours. Serve with assortment of fresh fruit or fat free cinnamon star cookies or angel food cake. Yields 8 servings (1/4 cup each)., Has 85 calories, 1 g. fat. Heavenly!

title: Buttermilk Cake
directions: Cream sugar and shortening., Add eggs, cocoa, molasses, cinnamon, cloves and salt., Add buttermilk., Add flour and mix well., Makes a 2 layer round cake or a loaf cake., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes for layer, a little longer for loaf.

title: Hamburg Vegetable Soup
directions: Brown hamburg; drain., Bring to boil the vegetables. Add the seasoning, cabbage and water., Bring to a boil again., Add the rice., Cover and simmer for 1 hour.

title: Corn Dogs
directions: Boil wieners as you would for hot dogs., Wipe dry., Insert stick in wieners if you have them., If not, serve on plate and eat with forks., Mix flour, sugar, baking powder, salt, corn meal, butter, milk and eggs together., Coat wieners with batter., Fry in deep fat, heated to 365° until golden brown., Drain on paper towel., Good served with mustard.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
directions: Chop apples fine. Add sugar; mix and set aside. Mix oil or oleo, vanilla and eggs. Add to apple mixture. Sift together flour, cinnamon, nutmeg, salt and soda. Add pecans. Mix and add to apple mixture. Pour into, Bundt or tube pan sprayed with Pam. Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Tuna And Rice Casserole
directions: Combine rice, albacore, celery, onion, lemon juice, diced eggs, sliced mushrooms and sliced chestnuts., Mix curry powder, pepper, mushroom soup and mayonnaise., Add to rice and tuna mix. Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan., Add crumbled potato chips on top., Bake at 350° for about 40 minutes or until it bubbles., If made ahead, add potato chips last and bake an additional 15 minutes.

title: Mock Clam Chowder
directions: Saute onion and chopped celery in butter., Add cream of potato soup with evaporated milk, water, parsley, chives and white fish. Simmer 1/2 hour.

title: Oyster Casserole
directions: Crush saltines to coarse meal., Spread a 1/2-inch layer of saltines in 1 1/2-quart casserole dish., Layer oysters and dots of butter with layers of crackers., Add salt and pepper to each layer to your taste., Fill to within 1-inch of top of casserole dish. Add milk to just cover cracker layer on top., Finish with a couple dots of butter., Bake in 325° oven for 30 minutes or until top is golden brown and crusty.

title: Easy Pot Pie
directions: Cut up enough meat to line the bottom of crusts., Pour a thin layer of mashed potatoes, a layer of peas, another layer of potatoes, a layer of carrots and another layer of potatoes., Put a pie crust on top and put butter on top of crust., Cook at 350° for 30 minutes., Makes 2 pot pies.

title: Holiday Cheese Ball
directions: Soften cream cheese; gradually add pineapple, green pepper, onion and seasoned salt., Mix well., Roll into ball and roll ball in chopped pecans., Chill., Serve with your favorite crackers. Will keep a week if kept refrigerated.

title: Fresh Fruit Butter
directions: Cream butter, stir in fruit or peel and lemon juice. Refrigerate or freeze., These will keep up to 3 months in the freezer., Makes 1 1/2 cups.

title: Meatballs
directions: Mix well., Make into balls., Roll in flour and brown in oil. Put in casserole dish., Add can of mushroom soup and can almost full of water. Cook about 30 minutes at 350° to 400°.

title: Christmas Punch
directions: Mix all ingredients except ginger ale., Wait until time to serve to add ginger ale.

title: Bread Pudding
directions: Soak raisins and dates in wine or brandy for at least 15 minutes., Add milk and bread., Bring to a boil., Add beaten eggs, mixed with sugar and vanilla., Let mixture come to boiling point. Pour into 8 x 12-inch pan, that has been sprayed with nonstick spray., Put this pan into a larger pan with hot water 1 1/2-inches deep., Pour melted butter over top and sprinkle with nutmeg., Bake in 375° oven until knife inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Strawberry Jam
directions: Combine strawberries and 2 c. sugar and bring to a boil for 5 minutes., Add remaining sugar and lemon juice., Boil 12 - 15 minutes., Remove from heat and stir until foam disappears. Let cool, put in jars and seal.

title: Squash Bread
directions: Beat together the first 3 ingredients., Mix in remaining ingredients., Grease and flour two loaf pans., Pour in batter. Bake in a 325° oven for one hour or until a toothpick comes out clean., Cool in pan for 5 minutes and turn out.

title: Lasagne
directions: Cook noodles 10 hours before baking time., Saute onion, celery and mushrooms., Add tomatoes, tomato sauce, dry spaghetti sauce mix, cottage cheese, mushroom soup and eggs., Simmer.

title: Greek Chicken Salad
directions: In a large bowl, combine chicken, cucumbers, Feta cheese, olives and parsley; set aside., In a small bowl, combine mayonnaise, yogurt and oregano., Add to chicken mixture., Toss lightly until coated., Cover and chill., Serve on Boston lettuce or whole wheat pita., Makes 8 servings.

title: Angel Pecan Pie
directions: Beat egg whites until frothy., Add sugar gradually with vanilla., Beat until mixture forms soft peaks., Add cracker crumbs and pecans together., Fold into egg white mixture., Bake in 9-inch pan for 30 minutes at 325°., Cool thoroughly., Top with 1 1/2 boxes Cool Whip mixed according to directions on box., Sprinkle with nuts and coconut, if desired.

title: Tex-Mex Meat Loaf
directions: Mix all ingredients., Shape into a loaf and bake at 350° for about 45 to 50 minutes.

title: No Bake Cookies
directions: Mix sugar, milk, oleo and cocoa; bring to a boil., Boil 1 1/2 minutes; take off heat and add peanut butter and vanilla, then add oats., Mix well; drop by teaspoonful on waxed paper.

title: Chicken Casserole Deluxe
directions: Wash chicken and place in pan with 2 quarts of boiling water and salt., Simmer, covered, until tender., Drain; reserve broth. Cool., Remove meat from bones., Heat oven to 350°., Arrange beans over bottom of greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish., Arrange half of chicken over beans., Top with 16 of the saltines, then half of the cheese., Combine soup, broth, onion flakes and remaining cheese and pour over chicken., Crumble remaining saltines. Sprinkle over casserole., Top with mushrooms., Drizzle with melted butter., Bake 30 minutes or until bubbling.

title: Sugar Pie
directions: Preheat oven to 300°., Blend sugar, flour, butter and salt with a pastry blender until smooth., Pour into unbaked pie shell.
