Add whipping cream and stir "gently" with a finger in a wavy motion., Do not tear bottom of pie shell., Mix vanilla and milk together and pour over cream mixture., DO NOT STIR., Sprinkle with nutmeg., Bake at 300° for 1 1/2 hours., This will thicken as it cools.

title: Chocolate Pie
directions: Mix sugar, salt, flour and cocoa., Add milk., Separate eggs. Beat yolks and mix well with other ingredients., Cook on medium heat until it thickens., Remove from heat., Add vanilla flavoring and butter., Pour into baked pie shell and top with meringue from the egg whites., Bake at 375° until lightly brown.

title: Hamburger Quiche
directions: Brown meat; drain and set aside., Blend next 4 ingredients until smooth., Stir in meat, cheese, onion, pepper and salt., Turn into pastry shell., Bake at 350° for 35 or 40 minutes until brown on top and knife in center comes out clean., Serves 4.

title: Turkey Barley Soup
directions: Combine stock, onions and barley in Dutch oven., Bring to a boil over high heat., Reduce heat to low; cover and simmer 30 minutes., Add potato and carrot and simmer 20 minutes more., Stir in turkey and peas and simmer 5 minutes more., Serves 8. Can be served hot over brown rice as a side dish.

title: Squash Pickles
directions: Bring to a boil., Add squash mixture., Boil 2 minutes and can.

title: Macaroni And Cheese
directions: Put cooked macaroni in large, buttered casserole dish., Add butter, milk and most of cheese., Stir until smooth., Add salt and pepper., Top with remaining cheese., Bake at 375° for 25 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Grilled Lemon Chicken
directions: Mix lemon juice and dressing mix., Set aside to thicken., With kitchen mallet, pound chicken to 1/2-inch thickness., Arrange chicken into single layer in pan and cover with lemon mixture. Marinate for 1 hour in refrigerator, turning after 30 minutes. Grill over hot coals 15 to 20 minutes, turning only once.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
directions: In large mixing bowl combine oil, sugar and eggs., Beat well. Sift flour and gradually fold into creamed mixture., Add vanilla. Gently fold in apples and nuts., Pour into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Hamburger Or Sausage Quiche
directions: Brown meat; add salt and pepper to taste. Blend together mayonnaise, milk, eggs and cornstarch until smooth. Stir in meat, cheese and onion. Pour into pie crust. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes at 350°.

title: Sausage Rolls
directions: Roll out rolls; press sausage on top and roll up and slice. Bake at 375° until brown.

title: Drop Sugar Cookies
directions: Nutritional Information:, Serving 1 cookie; calories 70; total fat 2 grams; saturated fat 0 grams; cholesterol 10 milligrams; sodium 60 milligrams.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
directions: Soften cream cheese slightly; blend in peanut butter, milk and sugar., Fold in softened Cool Whip; scoop mixture into pie shell. Freeze several hours., Thaw slightly before serving.

title: Homemade Pimento Cheese
directions: Grate cheese., Chop up pimentos small and add in with 1/2 of juice with cheese., Add vinegar, salt, pepper and mayonnaise. Beat with a mixer until smooth., If not smooth, add mayonnaise.

title: Taco Pie
directions: Cook ground beef and onion in a skillet until meat is browned, stirring to crumble meat., Drain., Add taco seasoning mix and water, stirring well., Bring to a boil; reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes, stirring occasionally., Combine refried beans and 1/3 cup taco sauce., Spoon half of bean mixture in bottom of pastry shell. Top with half of meat mixture, half of cheese and all of corn chips., Repeat layer with remaining bean mixture, meat mixture and cheese., Bake at 400° for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Broiled Hamburger Spread
directions: Note:, May substitute as desired, including finely chopped cheese.

title: Breakfast Casserole
directions: In greased 8 x 8 x 2-inch casserole, place the sausage on bottom with the rest of the ingredients on top., Cover with Handi-Wrap and refrigerate overnight., Bake for about 45 minutes at 350°., Serves 4 to 6.

title: Vegetable Dip
directions: Combine all ingredients. Chill and serve with fresh vegetables.

title: Mini Reubens
directions: On a cookie sheet, place cocktail rye., Spread with Thousand Island dressing., Add the sauerkraut, then the meat, placing Swiss cheese on top. Bake in a 350° preheated oven until cheese is melted.

title: Sugar Free Apple Pie
directions: Stir all ingredients together; let stand 10 minutes., Place in 9 inch pie crust; cover and make two slits in top crust., Bake at 400° for 50 minutes.

title: Lettie'S French Bread
directions: Mix all, the, ingredients together in large pan., Knead until smooth and elastic, about 5 minutes., Let rise for 1 1/2 hours in warm, place, covered;, then punch and work down every 15 minutes, six times.	Divide dough into 3 portions and shape into loaves. Put, in greased pans or cookie sheet., Cover and let rise again. Bake, at, 350°, for 35 to 45 minutes or until done.

title: Sausage Casserole
directions: Fry sausage in skillet with pepper and celery until tender. Drain well., Preheat oven to 325°., Add all remaining ingredients and pour in a 3-quart casserole dish., Bake for 1 1/2 hours, covered.

title: The World'S Easiest Tuna Casserole
directions: Cook the macaroni and cheese according to directions on the package., Add soup, milk and tuna and heat through., You can also add a cup of frozen peas that have been slightly cooked in the microwave., This is an easy one for kids to do!

title: Dill Pickle Pick-Ups
directions: Mix cream cheese, onion and mayonnaise., Spread on bread (with crust removed) thickly., Lay bread on damp paper towels., (Drain pickles.), Roll pickle up in bread., Chill overnight., Slice to serve.

title: Dried Beef Dip
directions: Mix all ingredients well, let chill 4 hours., Serve with vegetables, crackers or chips.

title: Cucumber Salad
directions: Chill cucumber until just before serving., Combine yogurt, chives, onions, salt and pepper and chill well to blend flavors. Place cucumber on a serving dish and top with dollops of the chilled dressing., Sprinkle with dill., For variety, add to the dressing mushrooms (sliced).

title: Rice Meat Balls
directions: Combine Minute rice with beef, egg, onion, salt, margarine, pepper and 1/2 cup tomato juice., Mix lightly., Shape mixture into 18 balls and place in skillet., Add sugar to remaining 2 cups tomato juice., Pour juice over meat balls in skillet., Bring mixture to a boil., Reduce heat and simmer, covered, 15 minutes, basting occasionally.

title: Old West Bean Pot
directions: Combine baked beans, kidney beans, navy beans, green pepper, tomatoes and seasoning mix in 2-quart baking dish., Sprinkle with cheese and paprika., Bake at 375° for 30 minutes until hot and bubbling., Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: W.W. Tuna And Bean Special
directions: Drain beans., Put in small baking dish., Mix tuna with beans. Sprinkle Cheddar cheese on top., Put in oven for a few minutes to melt cheese and warm beans and tuna through (350° for about 10 to 15 minutes).

title: Glazed Carrots(France)
directions: Cut carrots into 2-inch pieces., Heat carrots and remaining ingredients except parsley to boiling; reduce heat., Cover and simmer until tender, about 25 minutes., Remove carrots and boil rapidly to reduce liquid to glaze consistency., Add carrots; turn to coat evenly with glaze., Sprinkle with parsley.

title: Yummy Bars
directions: Combine candy bar, peanut butter and marshmallows in saucepan. Heat until melted, stirring to mix well., Fold in cereal., Press into greased 9 x 9-inch dish., Let stand until cool., Cut into bars., Yields 30 servings.

title: Frosted Pumpkin Cookies
directions: Mix together first 4 ingredients., Add remaining ingredients. Mix all ingredients and drop by heaping teaspoonfuls on greased cookie sheet., Bake at 350° for 15 minutes., Cool and frost.

title: Cauliflower Soup
directions: Melt butter in saucepan., Saute diced onion, celery and carrot in the butter until tender., Add chicken stock, ginger, pepper and cauliflower., Bring to a boil., Reduce heat and simmer until cauliflower is tender., Puree soup in blender.

title: Prune Cake
directions: Mix all together; pour into 2 (8-inch) or 1 (9 x 13-inch) greased and floured pan., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Strawberry Pretzel Salad
directions: Mix together pretzels, margarine and the 3 tablespoons sugar. Press in 13 x 10-inch pan., Bake in 400° oven for 8 to 10 minutes. Set aside., Mix Jell-O, boiling water and berries; stir until dissolved., Cool in refrigerator for 30 minutes., Mix softened cream cheese and sugar., Fold in Cool Whip., Spread over pretzel mixture and pour cooled Jell-O over., Refrigerate; let set 4 to 6 hours., You may top it with more Cool Whip if desired., Serves 8 people.

title: Hot Crab Dip
directions: Drain crab meat and remove shells; set aside., In a large bowl, mix together all ingredients, fold in crab meat., Turn into 1 1/2-quart casserole dish., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until bubbly and golden., Let stand 10 minutes., Serve with crackers.

title: Savory Spaghetti  Sauce
directions: In Dutch oven, cook ground beef and onion until meat is browned and onion is tender; drain., Add next eight ingredients; bring to a boil., Reduce heat; cover and simmer for 1 hour, stirring occasionally., Remove bay leaf., Yields 4 to 6 servings, about 1 quart.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
directions: Blend first 5 ingredients well., Pour into pie crust., Chill well.

title: Lemon Icebox Pudding
directions: 1., Beat together and freeze in refrigerator tray for 1 hour or more the 3 egg yolks, sugar and juice of 1 1/2 lemons.

title: Gobs
directions: Cream the sugar, Crisco and eggs together., Add buttermilk, water and vanilla., Sift together the remaining ingredients and add., Drop from spoon on cookie sheet., Bake at 450° for 5 minutes.

title: Jello Pudding Cake
directions: Prepare cake mix as on box and bake in a 13 x 9-inch pan. Remove and poke holes quickly down through cake with round handle of wooden spoon.

title: Spiced Pecans
directions: Mix in a small bowl., In another bowl, beat slightly 1 egg white., Add, a few at a time, 1 cup pecans., Rub the pecans in the egg white with your fingers to coat them thoroughly., Drop into the bowl of sugar and spices and coat each nut completely., Place on a buttered cookie sheet., Bake 30 minutes at 300°., Check last few minutes to avoid scorching.

title: Strawberry Jam
directions: Mix berries and sugar; mix Sure-Jell and water. Bring water and Sure-Jell to boil and cook for 1 minute. Pour cooked mixture over sweetened berries, stirring for 3 minutes. Pour into freezer containers and let stand 24 hours, then place in freezer.

title: Ladies Delight
directions: Combine tuna and mayonnaise in bowl and mix well., Place bread on cookie sheet and toast in broiler on one side., Remove from broiler and turn toasted side down., Spread bread with tuna mixture; place tomato slices on "open face" sandwiches., Top with slices of Cheddar cheese., Return to broiler and watch closely until cheese starts to melt and seems a bit bubbly., Serve.

title: Hollywood Chicken
directions: Brown beef and onion in skillet., Add chicken noodle soup and remaining ingredients, except potato chips., Cook over medium heat until mixture thickens., Crush the potato chips and spread them in a 9 x 11-inch baking pan., Reserve a few chips for garnish., Pour hot mixture over chips; sprinkle remaining chips over top., Bake 1 hour at 350°.

title: Broiled Salmon Steaks
directions: Buy two salmon steaks from the fresh seafood section of the supermarket., Rinse with cold water and pat dry., Preheat broiler (if using Jenn-Air, spray grill with Pam)., Lightly sprinkle both sides with garlic salt and fresh lime 15 minutes before cooking. Use more lime during cooking to prevent drying., Turn twice at least., Broil for a total of 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Louisburg Chicken Pie
directions: In large saucepan or Dutch oven, combine chicken or turkey with onions, celery, peppercorns and water., Cover and simmer about 30 minutes or until poultry is tender., Remove from stock., Strain stock and set aside to cool (about 3 cups)., Discard onion, celery and peppercorns., Skin and debone poultry, cut into bite-sized pieces; set aside.

title: 3-Point Nacho Spread
directions: Blend beans and 1/4 cup salsa in blender or food processor. Spoon into a 1-quart serving bowl., In small bowl, stir together 1/4 cup salsa and sour cream., Drop by spoonfuls over beans. Spread to cover., Spoon remaining salsa over sour cream., Sprinkle with cheese and cilantro., Cover and refrigerate for 2 to 24 hours., Serve with reduced-fat crackers or baked Tostitos.

title: Agua De Melon
directions: In the blender put melon, sugar and water; blend until it is pureed., Ready to serve.

title: Coconut Pound Cake(The Nashville Cookbook)
directions: Butter a 10-inch tube pan., Line bottom with waxed paper., In mixing bowl, beat butter, shortening and 3 cups of the sugar until creamy, about 4 minutes., Add eggs, one at a time, beating 2 minutes after each., Sift flour with salt; stir in flour in thirds alternating with milk., Add almond extract and 1/2 teaspoon coconut flavor, then fold in coconut., Place in cold oven; set oven to 350° and bake until cake tester comes out clean, about an hour and 15 minutes., Place cake on wire rack., In small pan, bring remaining 1 cup sugar, 1 cup water and 1 teaspoon flavor to a boil, about 1 minute., Pour syrup over hot cake., Cool 30 to 40 minutes., Remove cake from pan to a rack or plate after sugar syrup has soaked into cake., Eat and enjoy., Makes 1 (10-inch) cake.

title: Ribbon Cake
directions: Put 1/2 applesauce in 2 separate bowls., Mix red Jell-O in one and green in the other., Layer crackers in a dish (will be 4 crackers)., Then spread the red Jell-O on top, crackers, then green Jell-O until all is used up., Put Cool Whip on top, if desired., Cool., Cut into thin slices., Good for the holidays!

title: Tropical Fruit Pie
directions: Bake, pie shell., Line bottom with toasted pecans., Slice bananas on top of this., Boil together pineapple, sugar and cornstarch until thickens., Cool., Pour on top of bananas., Top with Dream Whip.

title: Honolulu Chicken
directions: Place chicken breasts in a baking dish., Sprinkle with salt and pepper., Combine preserves, barbecue sauce, onions and soy sauce., Pour over the chicken breasts., Cover and bake at 325° for 1 1/2 hours or until done., Add water chestnuts and green pepper for final 10 minutes.

title: Blueberry Boy Bait
directions: Blend first 3 ingredients together until it resembles coarse meal., Remove a cup for topping and set aside., Add baking powder, eggs, milk, salt and vanilla; mix until smooth., Grease and flour a 9 x 13-inch pan., Add blueberries., Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

title: *Low-Cholesterol Pound Cake*
directions: Cream the margarine, shortening and sugar in mixer bowl until light and fluffy., Add egg white; beat well., Add egg substitute; beat well., Add flour alternately with milk, beating well after each addition., Add flavorings., Pour into greased and floured tube pan., Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Cheese Soup
directions: Combine broth and veggies in big pot., Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes., Blend milk and flour together and stir into veggie mixture, cooking until slightly thickened. Add seasonings and cheese., Simmer until cheese melts., Serves 4.

title: Pistachio Salad
directions: Mix together in order.

title: Chicken A La King Casserole
directions: Mix all together., Put in greased casserole dish., Top with bread crumbs.

title: Creole Seafood Gumbo
directions: Melt butter in a saucepan; blend in flour and cook over low heat, stirring constantly until dark brown., Add liquid, okra, tomatoes, onion, pepper, Tabasco sauce (optional), thyme and bay leaf., Bring to a boil., Then cover and simmer 30 minutes, stirring occasionally., Add seafood and cook 10 to 15 minutes longer., Remove bay leaf., Serve in soup bowls with mound of hot rice in center., Serves 6.

title: Cherry Pudding
directions: Mix, in order given except the Cool Whip and pour in an ungreased, pan., This, can	be, baked in same pan or casserole dish, that	it's mixed in.	Bake at 325° until juice thickens. Serve with Cool Whip.

title: Easy Deep Dish Pizza
directions: Heat oven to 425°., Lightly grease a 15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 1-inch jelly roll pan or cookie sheet., Mix baking mix and water until soft dough forms; beat vigorously 20 strokes., Gently smooth dough into ball on floured cloth-covered board., Knead 20 times., Pat dough in bottom and up sides of pan with floured hands., Or roll into 13 x 10-inch rectangle and place on cookie sheet; pinch edges of rectangle, forming 3/4-inch rim.

title: Chocolate Pies(Makes 2 Pies)
directions: Mix the first 3 ingredients well, then add egg yolks, margarine, 1 teaspoon vanilla and Pet milk., Put milk in quart jar and finish filling jar up with water plus about half more can of water., Mix all together and cook on medium heat, stirring all the time, until it becomes thick and begins to boil., Pour in two cooked pie shells., Beat egg whites., Add a little vanilla and about 3 or 4 tablespoons sugar., Put on top of chocolate pies and put in oven; cook at about 300° until golden brown.

title: Mandarin Orange Salad
directions: Crush crackers., Add melted oleo and sugar; press in a 9 x 13-inch pan., Save some for garnish., Blend orange juice and milk; stir in Cool Whip and oranges., Fold in; do not beat., Pour over crumb crust., Top with reserved crumbs., Refrigerate or freeze.

title: Apricot Balls
directions: Mix all ingredients together thoroughly., Make into 1-inch balls., Can be frozen.

title: Rejoice Cake
directions: Mix flour, soda, cinnamon and salt. Beat oil, sugar and eggs thoroughly. Add flour mixture. Beat until smooth. Add pineapple, carrots, 1/3 cup coconut and nuts. Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes. Cool 10 minutes and remove from pan. Cool on rack.

title: Stuffed Cabbage Leaves
directions: Combine meats and saut with onion in butter until lightly browned. Add rice, dill, thyme, salt and pepper and mix well. Place cabbage leaves in boiling water for 1 minute. Drain and pat dry. Spoon meat mixture on center of leaves; fold over envelope fashion and secure with toothpicks. Place in greased shallow baking dish; pour tomato sauce over, cover and bake in a slow oven (325°) for 45 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Oriental Beef Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients and bake in a 9 x 12-inch pan at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Fettucine Primavera
directions: Cook broccoli, carrots, zucchini, green pepper, onion and seasoning in oleo in skillet until vegetables are tender., Stir in mushrooms. Toss vegetables with hot noodles. Stir in Parmesan cheese, if desired.

title: Sausage Balls
directions: Mix ingredients well., Form into small balls., Bake at 350° for approximately 15 minutes.

title: Poppy Seed Dressing
directions: Place all ingredients in the blender and blend until smooth. Serve over fresh fruit., Yields 2 1/2 cups (10 to 12 servings).

title: Chinese Casserole
directions: Brown ground beef and onion., Drain in ovenware dish., Put 1/2 of the can of mixed vegetables in bottom of dish., Top with half of ground beef and onion mixture., Add other half mixed vegetables., Add other 1/2 ground beef and onion mixture., Top with mashed potatoes., Heat before serving., Ready to eat with salad and rolls.

title: Szechuan Noodle Toss
directions: In a 5-quart saucepan, over high heat, bring 3-quarts water, the salt and 1 tablespoon of the vegetable oil to a rolling boil. Add pasta, stirring to separate strands., Cover pan until water returns to boiling., Uncover and cook pasta 7 to 9 minutes or until pasta is al dente; that is, cooked but firm to the bite., Pour hot pasta and water into a colander that has been set in the sink. Drain pasta thoroughly., Rinse with cold running water and drain pasta again., Transfer cooled pasta to a large bowl and set aside.

title: Yogurt Fluff
directions: Pour boiling water into blender, add Jell-O., Blend on low speed until dissolved, (about 1 minute)., Combine cold water and ice to make 1 cup cold water., Add to Jell-O and stir until almost melted., Then blend in yogurt and vanilla., Chill in dessert glasses or bowl until set (about 1 hour)., Makes 5 servings; 35 calories per serving.

title: Fudge Pie
directions: Combine butter, evaporated milk, egg yolks and brown sugar. Cook in double boiler over boiling water, stirring constantly, until thick., Add vanilla and nuts., Remove from heat; add chocolate pieces until melted., Set aside., Beat egg whites and salt until stiff., Fold into cooled chocolate mixture and pour into pie shell., Freeze until firm.

title: Frozen Cherry Cream Pie
directions: Beat cream cheese until smooth. Fold in pie filling and cool whip until blended. Spoon into crust, cover and freeze. Remove from freezer 15 minutes before serving.

title: Zucchini Bread
directions: Preheat oven to 325°., Mix eggs, sugar, oil and vanilla, then add all other ingredients, leaving the raisins and nuts until last., Pour into two 9 x 5-inch loaf pans and bake in preheated oven for 50 minutes., Makes 2 loaves.

title: Banana Pudding
directions: Blend milks and pudding., Add Cool Whip and sour cream., Layer wafers, bananas, chocolate syrup and pineapple., Chill.

title: Biscuits
directions: Heat oven to 450°., Lightly spoon flour into measuring cup and level off., Cut shortening into flour with fork until consistency of coarse meal., Add milk all at once; stir with fork just until a soft dough forms., Turn dough onto lightly floured surface; sprinkle dough lightly with flour., Knead gently 10 times or until no longer sticky., Roll out dough to 1/2 inch thickness; cut with 2-inch floured biscuit cutter., Place biscuits on ungreased cookie sheet., Bake at 450° for 8-12, minutes or until golden brown., Makes 12 biscuits.

title: Shanghi Casserole
directions: Brown meat, onions and garlic in oil., Add celery and soup. Cook mixed vegetables in 1/2 cup water 5 minutes., Add vegetables and liquid to meat mixture., Stir in rice and seasonings., Turn into a greased 2 1/2-quart casserole dish., Cover and bake 25 minutes in a 350° oven., Remove cover., Top with noodles., Return to the oven for 5 minutes., Makes 6 to 8 servings., Freezes very well.

title: Cheese Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 300°., Reserve one cup dry mix for filling. Mix 1 egg, oil and cake mix., Mixture will be crumbly., Press into bottom and sides of a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan., I find Pyrex best. Set aside.

title: Party Chicken With Shrimp
directions: Shell and devein shrimp, and, bone, chicken; set aside. In large skillet, cook, onion, in butter until tender., Remove onion to bowl with, slotted spoon., In drippings, cook chicken until browned on both, sides., Into, chicken skillet measure 3 tablespoons parsley., Add, onion,, tomato, sauce, water, wine, salt, pepper and basil., Bring quickly to a boil., Add shrimp; reduce heat to low; cover, and, simmer, for 5 minutes or until chicken and shrimp are tender., Serve with rice., Serves 6.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Cook and drain broccoli., Add Velveeta cheese and 1/2 stick butter or margarine., Bake covered at 350° for 25 minutes. Prepare Crumb Mixture.

title: Miracle Whip Cake
directions: Mix dry ingredients., Add water and vanilla., Blend well. Blend in Miracle Whip., Bake at 350° until done.

title: Pineapple Icebox Cake
directions: Bake cake as directed on package in a 9 x 13-inch pan., Simmer pineapple and sugar in small saucepan until sugar is dissolved. Poke holes in cake with long tined fork. Cover with warm pineapple mixture., Chill until completely cooled, at least 1 hour., Prepare pudding as directed on package., Stir in coconut., Spread over pineapple., Cover with Cool Whip. Sprinkle with pecans. Refrigerate until served. Serves 12 to 16.

title: Japanese Fruit Pie
directions: Beat eggs slightly., Add other ingredients (except pie shells). Pour into pie shells., Bake at 300° for 50 to 55 minutes.

title: Beef Ball
directions: Mix beef and onions together in food processor., Add cream cheese and mix., Take out and form ball., Wrap a slice of pressed beef around ball.

title: Calico Bean Bake
directions: Brown ground chuck, bacon and onions., Drain only the butter beans; mix all together in large dish., Bake at 350° for 40 minutes., You can use a crock-pot and cook for a couple of hours on medium., Keeps very well and tastes better the second day.

title: No Crust Apple Pie
directions: Fill pie plate 2/3 full with sliced apples., Sprinkle with first 3 spices., In a bowl, mix remainder of ingredients and pour over apples., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Beef And Corn Casserole
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Brown ground beef, then add the celery and chopped onions., Cook until soft., Reduce heat and stir in 1 can of tomato soup, cream-style corn, drained kidney beans and seasonings., Place in large casserole and bake, uncovered, 20 minutes., Top with 2 to 3 cups of crushed corn chips., Return to oven and bake 10 to 15 minutes, until toasted.

title: Gobs
directions: Mix cake mix as directed on box., Spoon onto cookie sheet by tablespoon., Bake as directed.

title: Baked Spareribs "Aloha"
directions: Cut after every third rib, about halfway through the strip. Sprinkle with salt and pepper., Place in shallow roasting pan. Bake in moderate oven (350°) for 1 hour., Carefully drain off all excess fat., While ribs are roasting, mix remaining ingredients and let stand to blend flavors., Pour over ribs after 1 hour baking., Bake 45 to 50 minutes longer, basting frequently to coat ribs with the flavorful sauce.

title: Spiced Beets
directions: Add all ingredients and bring to a boil., Boil about 10 minutes.

title: Jane'S Several Layer Dip(Low-Fat)
directions: Layer ingredients as listed in the recipe., Use with baked tostadas., Serves 2., Has 250 calories and 5 fat grams.

title: Ding Dong Cake
directions: Mix cake according to directions., Cook in a Bundt pan., When cool, slice in the middle to make 2 layers., Mix powdered sugar, cream cheese and Cool Whip and spread on top of the bottom layer. Place the other layer back on., Place the can of icing in the microwave for about 20 seconds; drizzle over the cake.

title: Refrigerator Yeast Biscuits
directions: Cream butter and sugar at medium speed until smooth., Add eggs and vanilla; beat for 5 minutes., Sift milk powder, baking powder and salt together., Add to mixture and beat 5 minutes., Add flour alternately with water, beating until smooth., Fold in blueberries by hand., Grease muffin tins lightly and flour., Fill about 2/3 full and bake at 350° until done, about 20 minutes.

title: Old-Fashioned Gingersnaps
directions: Sift flour, cinnamon and salt; set aside., Cream shortening and sugar until light., Add eggs and molasses., Dissolve soda in hot water and add to creamed mixture., Stir in dry ingredients and chill for easier handling., Roll into balls (tablespoon)., Place on a greased sheet., Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Cheeseburger Casserole(Yields 6 Servings)
directions: Combine beef and onion in skillet; cook until beef is lightly browned., Drain; add salt and pepper., Stir in catsup and tomato sauce; heat thoroughly., Turn into 8-inch square pan or 1 1/2-quart casserole., Sprinkle cheese over beef mixture., Top with biscuits., Bake at 425° for 20 to 25 minutes or until biscuits are golden brown.

title: Broccoli-Rice Casserole
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Grease 9 x 13-inch pan., Cook rice and broccoli separately., Chop broccoli and stir into rice., Heat soup, butter and cheese until melted., Place rice and broccoli in pan., Pour cheese over broccoli and rice., Bake 30 to 40 minutes. Pour onion rings over and serve.

title: Allen'S Cobbler
directions: Melt oleo in a 9 x 13-inch pan., Mix in flour, 1 cup sugar and milk; pour over oleo., Put fruit over batter; sprinkle 1/2 cup sugar over fruit., Add 1/2 cup water., Bake at 350° for 50 minutes.

title: Million Calorie Bars
directions: Melt caramels with milk in microwave., Mix flour, oats, sugar, soda,, salt, and butter., Press 3/4 of mixture into 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake	at, 350° for 10 minutes., Remove from oven and top with, chocolate chips and nuts., Drizzle caramel over top. Crumble remaining crumb mixture and bake 12 more minutes at 350°.

title: Sheath Chocolate Cake
directions: Mix the flour and sugar in a large bowl. Bring to a boil the cocoa, water and Crisco. Add to flour and sugar mixture. Add the buttermilk, eggs, soda and vanilla., Pour into greased and floured 11 x 16-inch pan. Bake at 400° for 20 minutes., Just as cake comes from oven, pour filling over it while still in pan.

title: Margarita Pie
directions: Mix condensed milk, lime juice, tequila and Triple Sec together., Fold in whipped cream., Fill pie shell., Refrigerate overnight (the longer you refrigerate, the better it is)., Top with more whipped cream and lime slices., Serves 8 comfortably. Great as a leftover.

title: Pecan Pie
directions: Combine sugar, margarine and eggs, one at a time., Beat to mix well., Add salt, vanilla and syrup., Mix well., Put pecans in crust and pour mixture in crust., Bake until done, about 1 1/4 hours at 300°.

title: Roasted Rosemary Chicken
directions: Rinse the chicken pieces, removing any excess fat and the wing tips., Pat dry., Place the olive oil in a Dutch oven over low heat and saute the onion, stirring occasionally, for 5 minutes. Add the garlic and cook, stirring, 5 minutes longer., Add the minced rosemary leaves., Preheat the oven to 375°.

title: Quick 'N Easy Cheese 'N Onion Bread
directions: Preheat oven to 400°., Grease and flour two loaf pans., Grate Cheddar cheese.

title: Scott'S "I Don'T Feel Like Cooking But The Kids Are Hungry"
directions: 1. Brown turkey or beef. Spice to taste (garlic, pepper, basil, whatever). Add diced sausage. Add diced, vegetables and corn. Simmer for 10-15 minutes (next, commercial)., 2. Add can of soup, thin to taste. Boil noodles and drain., Add to simmered ingredients (or visa versa depending on, pot size). Mix well.

title: Kiwi-Berry Pizza
directions: Prepare cake mix according to package directions., Pour into a greased and floured 12-inch pizza pan., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes., Let cool in pan 10 minutes; remove to wire rack and cool completely., Combine preserves and water in a small saucepan; heat until preserves melt., Cool., Set aside., Prepare whipped topping mix according to package directions., Spread over cake., Top with preserves., Arrange fruit over preserves., Yield:, one 12-inch pie.

title: Quick Lunch Box Cake
directions: Grease and, flour, 13, x, 8-inch cake pan., Combine all ingredients except	chocolate, and nuts in a large mixer bowl. Blend well	at low speed; pour batter into pan., Sprinkle with chocolate chips, and nuts.	Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes. Real good.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Cook chicken in water with onion, salt and pepper for 45 minutes., Cool and bone., Break chicken in large chunks and put in buttered casserole, mixed well with soup and sour cream

title: Tamale Pie (Scratch)
directions: Use cookie cutter to cut the cornmeal mixture into fun shapes, also fried onions in butter., In a 1 1/2-quart casserole, combine water, cornmeal, butter, salt, cumin and pepper., Cook uncovered, 100% power (High) for 4 to 6 minutes or until very thick, stirring every minute., Spread mixture on wax paper into an 8-inch square about 1/4 inch thick., Chill., Cut into 18 small shapes., Place shapes on a baking sheet in a single layer., Cover, chill or freeze until firm., Store frozen shapes in a sealed freezer bag.

title: Nutmeg (Donut) Muffins
directions: Beat egg with fork., Add oil and milk., Sift together flour, baking powder, salt, sugar and nutmeg., Add to egg, oil and milk. Fill muffin tins 2/3 full., Put bit of butter on top., Sprinkle with cinnamon and sugar., Bake at 375° for 20 minutes., Makes 9 large muffins.

title: Applesauce Cake
directions: Cream butter and sugar until smooth and fluffy., Add beaten egg yolks and applesauce., Sift the coarse husks out of flour 2 or 3 times, then sift the flour with soda and spices., Mix raisins through it., Add the dry ingredients to the first mixture., Last of all, fold in the stiffly beaten egg whites., Turn into two 8-inch square cake pans (greased and floured)., Bake for 25 minutes at 325°., Frost with mocha frosting.

title: Ratatouille
directions: Trim eggplant, then cut into 1-inch cubes (no need to pare). Saute onions, garlic and zucchini in olive oil in large frying pan for 5 minutes; stir in eggplant., Cover., Simmer 15 minutes., Stir in tomatoes, olives, parsley, chili sauce, basil and salt; cover. Simmer 15 minutes; uncover., Cook 10 minutes longer or until almost all liquid has evaporated.

title: Graham And Peanut Butter Bon Bon
directions: Set almond bark aside; mix remaining ingredients together in a bowl., Refrigerate for 1 hour., Melt almond bark., Form crumb mixture into balls and dip in melted almond bark, place on wax paper., Allow the almond bark to cool and set up., Preparation time:, 25 minutes., Makes 44 to 48 Bon Bons.

title: Cherry Jello Salad
directions: Mix, pie filling, sugar and water in saucepan; bring to boil. Add, jello; mix well., Remove from heat., Add Coke; mix well., Add pineapple;, mix well., Pour into container., Chill until set.

title: Dutch Apple Pie
directions: Mix together and place in pie shell the sugar, cinnamon, salt and apple slices., Blend brown sugar, flour and butter in small bowl., Mix until crumbly; sprinkle over apple mixture., Bake at 400° for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Japanese Fruit Pie
directions: Beat first 4 ingredients well; add last 3., Pour into unbaked pie shell., Bake at 325° until firm, about 40 to 50 minutes.

title: 7-Layer Salad
directions: Break lettuce in large salad bowl., Lay ingredients as listed. Cover with Saran Wrap to seal., Refrigerate and serve after 8 hours.

title: Ham And Lima Bean Soup
directions: Combine and cook on top of stove for 15 to 20 minutes., Quick and easy.

title: Arkansas Dirt
directions: Cream together in a big bowl cream cheese and oleo, then add powdered sugar and carton of Cool Whip., Next, mix pudding mix with milk, then add to other mixture., Layer in a pot with crushed Oreo cookies.

title: Vegetable Salad
directions: Note:, Canned beets may be drained and marinated in the mixture.

title: Uncooked Peanut Butter Candy
directions: Mix margarine and peanut butter well., Add confectioners sugar and mix well., Add almond flavoring., Pour into a 6 x 8-inch pan and smooth with hand., Let sit until firm.

title: Brown Rice
directions: Melt butter in skillet., Chop onion., Add onion and rice to butter and brown., Pour in Pyrex dish., Add beef consomme., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: One Dish Dinner
directions: Place bacon in bottom of pan., Add hamburger, crumbled up. Add vegetables, salt and pepper., Simmer 15 minutes., Add 1 cup water and finish cooking with cover on until vegetables are done.

title: Lumberjacks
directions: Cream sugar and shortening., Add molasses and eggs. Mix well. Sift dry ingredients and stir in., Drop on greased sheet., Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes., Yields 4 dozen cookies.

title: Zucchini Bread
directions: Mix sugar, oil and eggs., Add remaining ingredients and mix well., Pour into 2 greased and floured loaf pans., Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until done.

title: Cranberry Glaze For Pork
directions: Combine cornstarch, cinnamon and salt in small saucepan., Stir in orange juice and cranberries., Heat over medium heat, stirring occasionally until thick., I use this glaze to baste my pork roast., The kids love the sweet, but tangy taste.

title: Old Fashion Spice Cookies(Grandma Chamberlins)
directions: Cream sugar, shortening and molasses., Add egg, allspice, cloves, ginger and coffee., Mix., Add enough flour to make stiff dough., Chill., Roll out 1/4-inch thick., Cut with cookie cutters. May decorate with sugar toppings., Bake at 375° for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Lo-Fat Broccoli Skillet Quiche
directions: In Teflon-lined 9-inch skillet, melt margarine over medium heat., Add onion and cook until tender., Add broccoli, tomato, cheese, salt and pepper., Pour imitation eggs over vegetable-cheese mixture; do not stir., Reduce heat to low. Cover and cook 10 minutes or until quiche is set., Remove from heat and let stand 5 minutes., Cut in wedges to serve., Serves 4 to 6.

title: Blueberry Buckle
directions: Blend together until they are crumbs.

title: Christmas Punch
directions: Dissolve jello thoroughly in hot water; add sugar, pineapple juice and strawberries., Freeze in 1 gallon size Ziploc bag. Remove from freezer; place in refrigerator a few hours prior to serving time., While slushy, add ginger ale; serve., Great for showers!

title: Never Fail Pie Crust
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Roll out the same as any pie crust.

title: Party Punch
directions: Mix Kool-Aid, sugar and water., Then add pineapple juice. Chill., Pour over ice in punch bowl and add ginger ale., Serve at once., Yields 50 servings.

title: Self-Iced Cake
directions: Combine dates, water and soda; let stand until cool., Cream shortening and sugar., Add eggs and beat well., Slowly add flour, salt and cream of tartar., Stir until well blended., Add date mixture; mix well., Pour into a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Sprinkle chocolate chips and nuts over top of cake., Bake at 350° for about 30 minutes., Cool.

title: Shrimp De Tonghe
directions: Cream together butter, salt and garlic., Mix in bread crumbs, parsley, sherry, pepper and paprika., Peel and devein shrimp. Toss into simmering water and cook just a few minutes, only until they turn pink., Rinse with cool water and drain.

title: Strawberry Pie
directions: Mix flour and salt., Toss together with oil and water until dough forms a ball. Chill 10 to 15 minutes, then roll out on lightly floured surface., Place in a 9-inch pie pan., Prick sides and bottom and bake at 375° for 10 minutes., Cool.

title: Deviled Eggs
directions: Slice eggs in half; remove yolks and place in medium size bowl., Mash with a fork., Mix in remaining ingredients., Add mayonnaise 1 tablespoon at a time until mixture is creamy., Refill whites with mixture., Sprinkle with paprika for color.

title: Vanilla Glazed Pumpkin Bread
directions: Beat sugar and eggs until fluffy; add pumpkin and mix well. In another bowl, combine flour, salt, cinnamon, baking powder, baking soda and nutmeg., Stir dry ingredients into sugar mixture alternating with oil and water., Add vanilla and mix well., Beat for 3 minutes; fold in nuts., Divide and pour into greased 5 inch x 3 inch loaf pans (makes 3 to 4)., Bake at 350° for one hour; brush hot glaze over tops of warm loaves.

title: Barbecue Meat Loaf
directions: Combine beef, crumbs, onion, egg, salt, pepper and 1/2 can tomato sauce., Form into a loaf and put into shallow pan, 7 x 10-inches., Combine remaining ingredients; pour over loaf., Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes, basting occasionally., Serves 4 to 6.

title: Macaroni Fiesta Salad
directions: Combine macaroni, cheese, celery, salad dressing, pimiento, green pepper and onion; toss lightly., Season to taste., Serve in lettuce lined bowls., Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Party Franks
directions: In saucepan, saute onion in oil until tender., Stir in the next 11 ingredients., Add lemon slices., Bring to a boil., Reduce heat and simmer, uncovered for 20-25 minutes or until slightly thickened, stirring occasionally.

title: Navajo Fry Bread
directions: Mix dry ingredients and add water(enough a little at a time till you have a stiff dough), mix well., Knead dough on a floured board till it becomes elastic., Let dough rise 10 minutes, covered., Roll out dough till it is 1/2 inches thick., Cut into squares or circles., Deep fry at 370° till golden brown., Drain on paper towels and drizzle with honey.

title: Grasshopper Pie
directions: Combine milk and marshmallows in top of double boiler., Heat and stir over hot, not boiling, water until marshmallows are melted., Remove from heat., Cool, stirring every 5 minutes.

title: Doubly Chocolate Cookies
directions: Heat oven to 350°., In a large bowl, beat butter, sugar, eggs and vanilla until light and fluffy., Stir together flour, cocoa, baking soda and salt., Add to butter mixture., Stir in chips and nuts., Drop by teaspoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet., Bake 8 to 10 minutes or just until set., Cool slightly., Remove from cookie sheet to wire rack., Cool completely. Makes about 4 1/2 dozen cookies.

title: Egg Foo Young
directions: Mix first 6 ingredients., Drop by 1/2 cup into heated oil in skillet., Do not crowd omelets., Turn once when lightly browned. Transfer drained patties to warm platter., Serve omelets over rice topped with gravy made from last 6 ingredients (cook until thickens) or leftover roast gravy or canned gravy to which soy sauce and Chinese brown sauce has been added., Chinese noodles, green onions, celery, etc., make nice additions to meal.

title: Potato And Cabbage Soup
directions: Melt butter in large stock pot and saute onion, garlic and caraway seeds until onion is tender., Add broth, cabbage, potatoes, salt and pepper, bring to boil and then simmer for 1 hour., This soup may be pureed with a hand-held blender if you prefer.

title: Aunt Maud'S Poppy Seed Cake
directions: Soak poppy seed in 3/4 cup milk overnight., Sift dry ingredients., Add shortening and 2/3 of milk; beat well., Add poppy seed last., Pour into medium sized tube pan and bake at 375° to 400° for 1 hour., Ice with fudge frosting., Serves 12.

title: Calico Rice Bake
directions: Tear off a 36 x 18-inch piece of heavy-duty foil., Fold in half to make an 18-inch square., Fold up sides, using your fist to form a pouch., In a bowl, thoroughly combine vegetables, rice, water, cheese, salt, onion salt, rosemary and pepper., Place mixture in pouch., Dot with butter., Fold edges of foil to seal pouch securely., Grill over medium-hot coals, about 30 minutes or until done., Makes 6 servings.

title: Taco Salad
directions: Brown the hamburger, drain and add taco mix., Layer the first 6 ingredients in a large bowl., Right before serving, add cheese, broken taco chips and French dressing., Mix all together., Makes a large Tupperware bowl.

title: Spoon Bread
directions: Sift corn meal into boiling milk., Stir constantly over low heat until milk and meal are just blended and thickened., Beat in mayonnaise and salt., Cool; don't chill., Add beaten egg yolks and fold in stiffly beaten egg whites., Grease medium casserole in the bottom and part way up the sides., Pour in mixture and bake at 350° for 35 minutes., Serves 6.

title: Sweet Potato Custard
directions: Mix the flour and sugar well. Add all other ingredients., Beat with electric mixer until creamy., Pour into pie shell. Bake in preheated oven 10 minutes at 450°, then 30 minutes or until brown at 350°., Very important to bake correctly.

title: Pumpkin Roll
directions: Fold sugar, pumpkin and lemon juice into egg mixture., Mix remaining ingredients together, then fold into egg mixture., Line a 15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 1-inch cookie sheet or jelly roll pan (no larger) with wax paper or aluminum foil., Pour pumpkin mixture in., Bake at 375° for 15 minutes., Flip out onto towel with powdered sugar sprinkled., Peel off wax paper or aluminum foil and roll widthwise. Cool, then unroll and add cream cheese mixture or ice cream. Re-roll and freeze.

title: No Bake Peanut Butter Pie
directions: In a, large bowl, with an electric mixer, combine cream cheese,, peanut, butter,, sugar, and milk., Beat until smooth. Gently fold in whipped topping., Freeze 4 to 6 hours., Thaw 10 minutes before serving.

title: Applesauce Cake Or Cupcakes
directions: Combine all, ingredients, into large bowl., Blend, then beat 3 minutes., Bake at 350° for 50 minutes.

title: Weight Watchers Muffins
directions: Stir dry ingredients together., Add eggs and vanilla., Stir well., Add fruit., Bake at 375° for 20 minutes in greased (spray with Pam) tins or line with cupcake liners.

title: Marie'S Potato Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients (except cheese)., Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan, 1 1/2 hours at 350°, covered., Top with cheese, re-cover and bake 1/2 hour longer.

title: Raw Apple Cake
directions: Beat eggs; add sugar and oil., Beat until blended., Mix all dry ingredients together and add to egg mixture., Mix well and then add apples, vanilla and walnuts., Stir until completely blended., Pour into Bundt pan., Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Valerie'S Chicken Barbecue Sauce
directions: Mix ingredients; heat slowly until margarine is melted (do not boil)., Mop sauce onto chicken during last 15 minutes of cooking time.

title: Hawaiian Cake
directions: Bake cake mix according to directions., Let cool., Combine pudding and cream cheese (pudding according to directions)., Put on top of cool cake., Combine Cool Whip and pineapple, put on top of pudding., Cover with coconut.

title: Tijuana Pie
directions: Brown ground meat and season to taste., Mix together soups, beans, tomatoes and tomato sauce., Heat to mix well., Grease casserole dish and, using a third of each ingredient, layer chips, meat, soup mixture and cheese., Continue to layer until all ingredients are used., Be sure cheese is on top., Heat until cheese is melted., Serves 8.

title: Coca-Cola Salad
directions: Drain fruits, reserving 1 cup juice., Bring juice to boil and mix with gelatin until dissolved., Cool., Add remaining ingredients., Mix well and congeal., Serves 8.

title: Jello Salad
directions: Prepare jello, chill., Add prunes and pineapple.

title: Potluck Casserole
directions: Cook noodles; drain., Brown ground beef; drain., Mix all ingredients except cheese., Put in 9 x 13-inch pan., Sprinkle cheese over the top., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Mandarin Orange Salad
directions: Take thawed orange juice and pineapple juice. Add enough water to equal 4 cups liquid., Heat liquid and dissolve jello., Let cook. Add oranges, pineapple and pecans., Let set.

title: Cranapple Delight
directions: Mix and bring to a boil.

title: Congealed Salad
directions: Drain oranges and pineapple to make 1 cup liquid., (If not a cup, finish with water.), Boil and pour liquid over Jell-O; stir until dissolved. Add bottle of 7-Up., After it quits foaming, add oranges, pineapple and 1 cup nuts (optional)., Chill., Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Chewy Walnut Squares
directions: Mix in order and spread in pan; bake at 350° for 20 minutes in a greased 8-inch square pan., Cookies will be soft in center. Leave in pan., Cut into 2-inch squares.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: First, cook broccoli and chicken (separate), then pour off liquid., In a saucepan, combine soup, cream and cheese until melted and hot., Layer broccoli, chicken and sauce in a baking dish, then repeat this process., Top with fried onion rings., Cook at 350° for 20 minutes.

title: Baked Corn
directions: Melt butter in 2-quart saucepan., Sprinkle in flour; gradually add milk and bring to boiling point., Add corn, salt, pepper and sugar., Heat thoroughly; remove from heat and add beaten eggs., Pour into 2 1/2-quart buttered baking dish., Bake at 375 degrees for 35 minutes.

title: Broccoli Bread
directions: Cook broccoli until tender. Drain. Add butter (melted). Mix all ingredients. Bake at 400° in 11 x 7 x 1 1/2-inch pan 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Sausage Snacks
directions: Heat oven to 375°., Separate dough into 8 triangles., Cut each triangle lengthwise into thirds., Place sausages on shortest side of each triangle., Roll up, starting at shortest side and rolling to opposite point., Place on ungreased cookie sheets., Bake at 375° for 12 to 15 minutes, or until golden brown., Serve warm with ketchup or mustard.

title: Pancakes
directions: Whisk together all ingredients and bake on hot grill or frying pan., Makes 6 medium., I triple it for us!, Nice and light!

title: Golden Pineapple Layer Cake
directions: Combine undrained pineapple, whipped topping and pudding mix. Let stand 5 minutes., Cut cake lengthwise in thirds., Drizzle with liqueur., Spread one-third pudding mixture over bottom layer of cake., Top with second layer., Repeat., End with topping., Chill 30 minutes., Sprinkle with toasted, sliced almonds., Garnish with pineapple slices and/or raspberries or strawberries.

title: Ice Cream
directions: Mix first 6 ingredients and some of milk., Pour into freezer. Finish milk up to line., If adding fruit, use about 2 cups., If using fresh peaches, can change vanilla to almond.

title: Ground Beef Shepherds Pie
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Heat oil in large skillet over medium heat; add onion and saute for 5 minutes., Add ground beef and basil and saute 5 more minutes., Add garlic, green beans and tomatoes; stir well., Simmer 5 minutes., Pour mixture into a 2-quart casserole dish., In separate bowl, combine potatoes with egg and water., Mix well and spread over meat mixture., Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes or until potatoes start to brown on top. Sprinkle with cheese 5 minutes before done.

title: Molasses Crinkles
directions: Mix first 4 ingredients thoroughly, then add remaining ingredients., Chill dough., Roll into small balls and dip in sugar., Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes on greased cookie sheet.

title: Oyster Dressing
directions: Drain oysters, saving likker, and chop., Cook celery and onions in margarine until tender., Combine oysters, cooked vegetables, bread cubes and seasonings; mix thoroughly., If dressing seems dry, moisten with oyster likker., Bake in casserole at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes., Recipe will make dressing for a 4-pound turkey., For 10 to 15-pound bird, make 3 times recipe; 16 to 20 pounds 4 times and 21 to 25-pound bird 5 times.

title: Macaroni And Cheese(Serves 4 To 6)
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., In a quart pan, combine water and 1/2 teaspoon salt., Cover and bring to a boil., Add macaroni slowly, so that water continues to boil., Reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, for 8 to 9 minutes., Drain macaroni in colander., Place macaroni in a 1-quart casserole dish., Stir in butter, egg, salt, dry mustard and 2 1/2 cups of the grated cheese., Stir until evenly mixed., Pour milk over macaroni mixture., Top casserole with remaining 1/2 cup cheese., Cover with foil., Cook for 20 minutes., Uncover casserole and cook another 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Marinated Green Beans
directions: Combine sugar, vinegar, oil and water in a medium saucepan. Boil for 2 minutes., Combine beans and onion rings; add hot marinade., Set aside to cool., Refrigerate and marinate at least overnight., Yield:, 6 to 8 servings., Excellent for low-fat diets.

title: Sausage Potato Soup
directions: Brown crumbled sausage and drain well., Combine potatoes, onions, water, salt and celery seed in large pot., Cover., Bring to boil., Reduce heat and simmer 20 to 25 minutes., Mash potatoes slightly, leaving small lumps., Add drained sausage and milk., Heat well., Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Herbed Stuffed Eggplant(Low Calorie, Low Cholesterol And Low-Fat)
directions: Wash eggplant under cold water; dry with paper toweling., Cut each eggplant in half lengthwise., Add 1 inch of water to a large skillet; bring to boiling over high heat., Add 2 eggplant halves, skin side down., Cover and reduce heat to low., Simmer 5 minutes or until flesh is soft., Remove to wooden cutting board., Repeat with remaining eggplant., When eggplant are cool enough to handle, scoop out flesh with a large spoon, leaving 1/4 inch thick shell. Be careful not to break through the skins., Place shells in a 13 x 9-inch pan., Coarsely chop eggplant flesh; set aside.

title: Chicken Rice Casserole
directions: Mix rice, chicken, beans, cheese and mayonnaise., Melt butter and mix with crushed Ritz crackers., Sprinkle buttered cracker crumbs over rice and chicken mixture., Bake in a shallow baking dish at 350° until hot, approximately 30 minutes.

title: French Fries
directions: Peel and slice potatoes lengthwise into stick 1/4-inch thick. Place in a bowl, cover with water and refrigerate 16 hours., Drain potato sticks and lay out on dish towels to dry., Be sure they are completely dry before frying., In a deep-fryer with a candy thermometer clipped to the side, heat 2-inches of peanut oil to 300°., Add just enough potatoes to cover the base of the frying basket, and cook until slightly limp, 1 1/2 to 2 minutes., Do not brown., Lift basket and drain fries., Transfer potatoes to a baking rack and separate sticks., Repeat with remaining potatoes. Increase heat to 375°., Again, add potatoes in batches to the oil. Fry until chestnut brown on edges and crisp., Drain and transfer to a bowl lined with paper towels., Immediately season with salt, tossing to coat., Serve., Yields 4 servings.

title: Fresh Vegetable Dip
directions: Mix together., Sprinkle with grated egg yolk., Serve with fresh vegetables as a dip.

title: Salmon Loaf
directions: Drain salmon; remove skin and bones., Combine salmon with all other ingredients., Blend together well., Shape into a loaf and place into a greased loaf pan., Bake at 350° for about 35 minutes or until brown.

title: Quick Lemon Cake
directions: Blend dry mix with water, oil and eggs in a large bowl at low speed until moist., Add jello and beat 2 minutes at medium speed. Pour into greased Bundt pan., Bake at 350° for 38 to 43 minutes.

title: Turtle Candy
directions: Melt caramels and milk together., Add nuts and drop on waxed paper., Refrigerate until firm., Melt chocolate chips and paraffin. Dip turtles and return to wax paper., Makes 50.

title: Old-Fashioned Butter Crunch
directions: Toast almonds at 350° until golden, 5 to 10 minutes., Cool. Reserve 1 cup and blend to almost dust (1/2 to 1 cup)., Melt butter in a large, heavy saucepan on medium heat (3-quart pan)., Cook the sugar, corn syrup and water to hard crack stage (300°)., Stir often., When done, mixture will pull from side of pan., Remove from heat., Add 1 cup slivered almonds., Pour into a 13 x 9-inch buttered Teflon type pan., When almost cool, run scraper around sides of pan; use heat resistant scraper., Cool completely and turn out on waxed paper.

title: Punch
directions: Squeeze lemons., Combine juices, water and sugar., Mix well. Use food coloring for desired color., Makes 2 gallons., Very good.

title: Catfish Court Bouillon
directions: Cut onion and bell pepper into strips., Mix with tomato sauce and cook for 20 minutes., Pepper and salt to taste., Add Ro-Tel. Cut catfish into chunks., Add to mixture., Add juice of lemon. Simmer for 15 minutes., Serve over cooked rice.

title: Cream Cheese Brownies
directions: Melt chocolate and oleo., Cool., Beat eggs, sugar, flour, and baking powder into chocolate mixture., Add nuts and almond extract.

title: Dill Pickles With Garlic
directions: Soak cucumbers overnight in cold water., Put one dill in bottom of quart jars, then pack jars with cucumbers., Add garlic and second sprig of dill on top., Combine vinegar, salt and water. Bring to boil., Fill jars and seal., Store in dark, cool place.

title: Veg-All Casserole
directions: Cook in oven until it bubbles., Put buttered bread crumbs on top and bake until brown.

title: Mama Weber'S Lasagne Twisties
directions: Cook meat and onion; drain., Add seasonings and tomato sauce and simmer 30 minutes., Add buttered noodles and spinach., Put half of mixture in pan, then add half of Parmesan cheese., Repeat. Top with sour cream, Jack cheese and green onions., Cook 1 hour at 325° to 350°.

title: Punch
directions: Combine sugar and water., Stir over low heat until dissolved. Bring to a boil and simmer 5 minutes., Add tea and cool., Add juices and canned pineapple., Refrigerate., Add ginger ale just before serving.

title: Barbecue Beans
directions: Cook bacon, ground beef and onion., Add all other ingredients and mix together., Place in baking pan., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: For a less cheesier recipe, use Velveeta Lite cheese or use less Velveeta cheese.

title: Brunch Egg Bake
directions: Place cubed bread into greased 9X13 pan., Top with Cheddar. Beat eggs, milk, mustard and onion powder; slowly pour over bread and cheese., Bake at 325 degrees for 30-35 minutes., Cover with bacon and bake another 10 minutes or until knife in center comes out clean.

title: Napple-O-Tata
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Peel sweet potatoes., Slice into rounds 1 to 1 1/2-inches thick., Melt 2 of the tablespoons of margarine over low heat., In small bowl, mix cinnamon, nutmeg and ginger.

title: Mrs. Rose'S Potato Salad Dressing
directions: Cook all but vinegar until thickens, then add vinegar slowly. Let cool and then add 1 pint of Miracle Whip., Makes a generous portion; keeps well.

title: Garden Vegetable Pie
directions: Grease quiche pan or 10-inch pie plate., Add broccoli, onion, pepper and cheese., Combine remaining ingredients and stir until smooth; pour over all., Bake until golden brown, 40 to 45 minutes at 350°., Makes a delicious lunch with a salad or as hors d'oeuvres.

title: Cheese Rice Krispies
directions: Mix cheese and margarine., Add flour mixed with pepper., Add Rice Krispies., Shape into balls (small)., Place on greased cookie sheet., Flatten with a fork., Bake at 350° for 12 minutes; do not brown., They taste like they have nuts in them.

title: Mexican Cornbread
directions: Stir all ingredients together., Pour into greased cast-iron skillet, cornstick pan or muffin pan., Bake at 425° about 25 to 30 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Easy Potato Soup
directions: Combine first four ingredients in a Dutch oven; bring to a boil., Cover., Reduce heat and simmer 30 minutes., Stir in soups and milk; heat thoroughly., Garnish, if desired, with shredded Cheddar cheese, diced cooked ham or bacon.

title: Pineapple Sherbet
directions: Slice pineapple in half, lengthwise., Remove pulp and place in saucepan with the remaining ingredients., Cook 5 minutes.

title: Nana'S Vegetable Soup(Crock-Pot)
directions: Brown ground beef; pour off fat., Put in crock-pot along with other ingredients., Cook on low 6 to 8 hours.

title: Party Pizza
directions: Cook meat and drain., Add cheese; stir well until melted., Add spices; spread on bread., Bake at 350° for 8 minutes.

title: Fiesta Taco Bake
directions: Heat oven to 350°. Cook radiatore according to package directions; drain. Meanwhile, in 10-inch skillet, cook ground beef and onion, stirring occasionally, until browned, 5 to 7 minutes; drain off fat. Stir in corn, taco sauce, tomato sauce, chilies, cumin and salt. Stir in radiatore. Spoon into greased 2-quart casserole. Sprinkle cheeses over mixture in alternating rows to form 3 Cheddar and 2 Mozzarella strips. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until heated through. Garnish with tomato wedges and avocado slices. Makes 6 servings.

title: Pumpkin Roll
directions: Beat eggs at high speed for 5 minutes., Gradually add sugar in small amounts., Beat until thick., Fold in pumpkin and dry ingredients., Mix well., Grease a 15 x 10-inch pan and line with waxed paper., Pour batter into pan., Sprinkle with chopped nuts. Bake in a preheated 375° oven for 15 minutes., Turn out on a clean towel which is sprinkled with powdered sugar., Roll as a jelly roll and let cool., Unroll and spread with filling., Then re-roll, chill and keep refrigerated.

title: Miracle Peanut Butter Cookies
directions: Form into balls and press down with fork., Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Cracker Jacks
directions: Combine 2 cups brown sugar, 1/2 cup syrup and 2 sticks margarine., Bring to a boil and boil 5 minutes., Add salt, soda and vanilla., Pour over popcorn., Bake at 250° for 1 hour., Stir every 15 minutes.

title: Swiss Steak
directions: Trim excess fat from meat., Combine flour, salt and pepper. Lay meat on board; sprinkle with half of flour mixture., Pound into meat on both sides of meat until all flour is used., Meat may be cut in strips or left whole and cut later.

title: Strawberry Salad
directions: Dissolve gelatin in hot water., Add all other ingredients but sour cream., Pour half of mixture into dish., Chill until almost set., Spread sour cream on top., Pour remaining gelatin mixture over sour cream., Chill until firm.

title: Peixie A Lumbo (Shrimp And Fish Stew)
directions: Sprinkle fish with salt., Heat oil in large skillet., Saute onion and green pepper over medium heat until tender., Add tomatoes and cook until most liquid is gone., Stir often., Remove from heat and add coriander and red pepper., Arrange layer of half the fish, layer of shrimp, layer of vegetable mixture., Repeat layers in Dutch oven., Pour coconut milk over mixture and simmer for 5 minutes over medium heat., Reduce heat to low and partly cover., Simmer for 15 minutes or until seafood is done., Serve over rice.

title: Perfection Pie(Sugar-Free)
directions: Melt chips in boiling water; set aside to cool., Beat eggs. Blend in cornstarch and sugar replacement., Continue beating and add the shortening and gradually the chocolate mixture., Pour into the pie shell., Bake at 400° for about 35 minutes or until custard is set.

title: Molded Raspberry Jello
directions: Dissolve the gelatin in hot water., Add frozen raspberries and the juice., Pour into 8-inch cake pan., Chill until firm., Whip together the whipping cream, marshmallows and cream cheese until stiff., Spread over gelatin., Chill and serve., Serves 8.

title: Spinach Dip
directions: Combine all ingredients except bread and refrigerate overnight for soup mix to absorb completely., Cut top of Hawaiian bread and hollow out; fill with dip., Tear bread left into pieces for dipping.

title: Creamy Tacos
directions: Brown ground beef and drain., Add cheese and cook over low heat until melted., Add other ingredients and serve over corn chips or Doritos.

title: Todd'S Taters
directions: Wash potatoes and slice; boil until tender., Spread in glass 9 x 12-inch baking pan., Put in margarine., Coat well with lemon-pepper seasoning., Bake at 275° for 20 minutes., Serve.

title: Party Cheese Ball
directions: Blend all ingredients, except nuts, together., Refrigerate until workable., Shape into ball, roll in nuts.

title: Hot Pineapple Bake
directions: Break bread in a bowl (tear in small pieces)., Add beaten eggs and sugar., Add pineapple., Cut butter into chunks or slices and mix in., Butter casserole (2-quart size) and spoon mixture into casserole., Bake at 350° to 375° for 40 to 45 minutes, until bubbly., (Excellent side dish with baked ham.)

title: Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Cream the shortening and sugar. Beat in eggs and vanilla., Add salt and soda., Fold into creamed mixture along with oats and nuts., Roll in small balls and place on greased cookie sheet. Flatten with a fork., Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Refrigerator Cole Slaw
directions: Let mixture cool and pour over vegetables., Refrigerate 12 hours before serving., Will keep for weeks in the refrigerator.

title: Almost Heaven Cake
directions: Bake cake as directed on box., Punch holes in cake while hot. Spread pineapple over cake., Cool. Mix pudding in milk; spread over pineapple., Mix cream cheese, powdered sugar and Cool Whip together., Spread on top of cake., Let chill in refrigerator before serving., Keep refrigerated.

title: Corn Casserole
directions: Mix ingredients thoroughly., Pour into a greased casserole dish., Bake for approximately 35 to 40 minutes in another large cake pan with 1-inch of water in the bottom., Works like a double boiler only in the oven.

title: Hannah'S Seafoam Candy
directions: Beat egg whites until stiff; set aside. Boil water and brown sugar until it forms a soft ball; do not stir! Pour a small stream of mixture to the egg whites slowly. Cool and then drop onto wax paper.

title: Oreo Cookie Dessert
directions: Mix pudding as directed on box., Cream powdered sugar and cream cheese together., Add pudding to cream cheese., Gently fold in Cool Whip., Crumble Oreo cookies into mixture and gently stir. Refrigerate 2 hours before serving.

title: Pina Colada Cake
directions: Mix yellow cake mix according to directions and bake., When cake is done, punch holes in cake with end of wooden spoon., Spoon cream of coconut on cake and let cool., (You can use can of Eagle Brand milk to make cake richer, along with cream of coconut.), Mix Cool Whip and coconut together and put on cake (leave some coconut for topping)., You may also use crushed pineapple., Keep refrigerated.

title: Cheesy Beans
directions: Boil beans and drain., Add bacon pieces and onions in a casserole., Add Mozzarella and almond slivers just before removing from oven., Bake 30 minutes (350°)., Also can be heated easily in microwave.

title: English Goulash
directions: In skillet, fry cabbage and onion until browned; add tomatoes. In a skillet, brown hamburger, sugar and vinegar., Add to first ingredients and simmer 45 minutes., This may be put over mashed potatoes.

title: Cottage Cheese Dill Bread
directions: Sprinkle yeast on warm water and stir until blended., Stir in 2 teaspoons sugar and set aside., Combine cottage cheese, onion, dill weed, baking powder, salt, 2 tablespoons sugar and eggs., Mix thoroughly., Add yeast mixture and mix well., Add flour to make a stiff dough., Knead on lightly floured surface until smooth and elastic., Place dough in greased bowl; turn to bring greased side up., Cover and let rise in warm place until double in size (1 to 1 1/2 hours)., Punch down., Turn onto lightly floured surface, knead a few times., Divide into two equal portions., Shape each portion into loaf in well-greased loaf pan, 8 x 5 x 3-inches., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes., Remove from pans to rack and brush tops with melted butter., Makes two loaves.

title: Chicken Pie With Sweet Potato Crust
directions: Layer first 4 ingredients into a greased 2 1/2-quart casserole., Combine flour and a small amount of milk in saucepan, blending until smooth., Gradually stir in remaining milk and chicken broth., Place over low heat., Cook until thickened, stirring constantly., Add salt and pepper., Pour sauce over chicken and vegetables in the casserole., Cover mixture with sweet potato crust and bake at 350° about 45 minutes., Yield: 6 to 8 servings.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Mix together and bake at 350° for 45 minutes, uncovered.

title: South Of The Border Chicken And Rice
directions: Combine soups, broth and Ro-Tel in large saucepan., Heat until well-blended., Spread chicken in bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Sweet Potato Souffle
directions: Combine mashed potatoes, hot milk (mixed with rum), butter, nutmeg, salt, lemon rind and egg yolks., The fold in egg whites. Put in a buttered casserole and bake in a hot 400° oven for 25 minutes., Serves 4 to 6.

title: Chile Cheese Dip
directions: Spread cream cheese in oblong dish., Spread chili over cream cheese., Layer Cheddar cheese over chili., Heat until cheese is melted (can bake or microwave)., Serve with nacho chips.

title: Peanut Butter-Honey Dip
directions: Combine peanut butter, honey and milk in a medium-sized mixing bowl; stir until smooth., Stir in raisins and cinnamon; sprinkle with, toasted, almonds., Serve, with apple and banana slices. Yields 3 cups.

title: Cream Cheese Dip
directions: Mix all ingredients in mixer. Serve with carrot sticks, cucumber sticks, celery sticks, green pepper sticks or cauliflower. Children love it with potato chips.

title: Sweet Potato Pie
directions: Beat sweet potatoes with mixer until free of lumps., Add remainder of ingredients and beat well., Pour into one 9-inch unbaked crust and bake in preheated oven at 450° plus 10 minutes. Lower baking temperature to 350° and continue cooking for 30 minutes.

title: Cranberry Relish
directions: Grind cranberries and apples; add drained pineapple., Dissolve Jell-O and sugar in boiling water, then add cold water., Put all ingredients together and mix well., Pour into containers or Jell-O molds., Makes 4 to 5 pints., May be frozen or stored in refrigerator for a couple weeks.

title: Kourabiedes 2
directions: Melt butter, and, let, stand, until cool., Beat at high speed until light and fluffy (1/2 hour).	Add 1/4 cup powdered sugar, egg, yolk, and, whiskey;, beat, thoroughly., Add baking powder to flour, and	sift, together., Use, low speed and add flour to butter mixture. Add a little at a time until you have a soft dough., Shape, and	place on cookie sheet; bake at 325° for 20 minutes., Do, not brown., Place on waxed paper and sift powdered sugar over cookies.

title: Banana Nut Bread
directions: Cream shortening; add sugar gradually and cream well., Add eggs, one at a time., Add mashed bananas, nuts and sifted dry ingredients., Pour into greased bread pan., Bake 1 hour in 350° oven.

title: Elk Or Venison Steak & Gravy
directions: Slice onions and peppers in rings., Brown lightly in oil. Remove from heat and remove them from oil., Remove all fat from steaks., Pound steaks to tenderize., Mix flour, salt and pepper. Cover steaks in flour, shake off excess and brown both sides in oil used for peppers and onions., Pour off oil., Place onion and pepper rings on top of steak, then spread soup over all., Add water to almost cover meat., Simmer for 2 hours adding water as needed to keep meat nearly submerged., (Can be done in slow cooker.)

title: Barbecue Sauce
directions: Bring ingredients to a boil., Reduce heat; simmer for 15 minutes.

title: Spanish Rice
directions: Cook rice as directed on box., Cook hamburger., Mix together. Stir in cans of tomatoes., Cook for about 5 minutes., Then put cheese on top and let melt., Let stand 5 minutes., Then eat.

title: Green String Beans
directions: Crumble bacon and add to remaining ingredients., Simmer all ingredients 1/2 to 1 hour.

title: French Class Spinach Cheese Dip
directions: Defrost spinach and drain., Soften cream cheese., Stir in spinach, Parmesan cheese, mayonnaise, dill and garlic powder. Refrigerate until ready to serve., Warm to serve.

title: Chicken Gumbo
directions: In a large skillet, cook sausage, onion, pepper and celery until halfway done., Do not drain., In another skillet, add 3 tablespoons of oil and cook rice slowly until browned., Add other cooked ingredients in a large pot and add tomatoes and chicken broth; cook for 30 minutes., Add to mixture to thicken., Season to taste with ground red pepper, garlic powder, seasoned salt and pepper.

title: Cajun Cake
directions: Sift dry ingredients into a mixing bowl., Mix in the eggs and pineapple., Grease a 9 x 13 cake pan with oil or spray with Pam. Bake at 300° for 40 minutes.

title: Frozen Lemonade Pie
directions: Fold sweetened condensed milk and lemonade concentrate into whipped topping., Spoon into crusts., Freeze until firm., Garnish pies, if desired., Yield:, Two 9-inch pies., Freeze for 8 hours.

title: French Salad Dressing
directions: Combine ingredients in jar., Cap and shake well., Makes 2 servings., Contains 18 calories a serving.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
directions: Peel and parboil 2 to 3 pounds sweet potatoes., Mash and add salt, pepper and brown sugar to taste., Put in casserole; add 1 small can crushed pineapple., Cover with marshmallows., Bake in a moderate oven until the marshmallows are toasted.

title: Copper Pennies
directions: Cook carrots until tender but still crisp and drain., Bring sugar, vinegar, oil, tomato sauce, Worcestershire sauce, mustard, pepper and Italian seasoning to a boil., Pour over carrots; add chopped vegetables., Marinate overnight., This keeps a long time.

title: Crock-Pot Beans
directions: Cook ground beef. Drain. Fry bacon crisp and crumble., Combine the rest of the ingredients in crock-pot and cook all day.

title: Pumpkin Cake Roll
directions: Using electric mixer, beat eggs on high for 5 minutes. Gradually beat in sugar., Stir in pumpkin and lemon juice., Sift flour, baking powder, cinnamon, ginger, nutmeg and salt., Fold into pumpkin., Spread in well-greased and floured 15 x 10 x 1 1/2 pan (cake roll pan)., Bake at 375° for 15 minutes., Turn out on towel sprinkled with powdered sugar., Starting at narrow end, roll towel and cake together; cool., Unroll and spread with filling.

title: Eggplant
directions: Cook diced eggplant until mushy in salted water., Mash eggplant and combine with other ingredients., Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Chicken Kiev
directions: Place chicken breasts, one at a time, between 2 sheets of wax paper and gently pound with mallet until 1/4-inch thick., In a rimmed plate, combine bread crumbs, Parmesan cheese, 1 teaspoon of oregano, garlic salt and pepper; set aside., In a small bowl, stir together softened butter, parsley and remaining oregano., Spread about 1/2 tablespoon of the herb-butter mixture across each breast about an inch from lower edge; lay a strip of Jack cheese over butter mixture., Fold lower edge of breast over filling., Fold insides and roll up to enclose mixture., Dip each bundle into melted butter and drain briefly; roll in bread crumb mixture until evenly coated., Place bundles, seam side down, in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish., Cover and refrigerate 4 hours., Bake, uncovered, in a preheated 425° oven for 20 minutes, or until chicken is no longer pink when lightly slashed., Makes 4 to 8 servings.

title: Chicken Feathers Voo-Doo Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients, except noodles., Cook in 350° oven for 40 minutes or until bubbly., Sprinkle chow mein Chinese noodles over top and cook for about 5 minutes more.

title: Yankee Doodle Macaroni
directions: Heat shortening in pan., Add onion, garlic and mushrooms; saute until onion becomes pale yellow., Add meat; stir until brown., Add tomatoes, parsley and seasonings., Cover., Simmer about 45 minutes., While meat is cooking, cook macaroni in boiling water 7 to 10 minutes., Drain well., Toss in margarine., Turn macaroni onto hot platter., Pour sauce over; sprinkle with grated cheese.

title: Cheese Bread
directions: Combine 1 1/2 cups flour and yeast; set aside., Grate cheese into water with sugar and salt., Heat just until warm., Add to flour mixture with egg., Stir well., Add 2 to 2 1/2 cups flour; knead to moderately stiff dough., Shape into ball and let rise until double., Divide in half and let rest 10 minutes., Shape into two loaf pans; let rise until double., Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes., Cover with foil the last 20 minutes., Cut while warm and spread with garlic seasoned butter and sprinkle with Italian seasoning.

title: Chicken Fried Deer Steak
directions: Trim deer steak of all fat, etc., Soak in combination of milk and Worcestershire sauce for 2 to 3 hours.

title: Salmon Cakes
directions: Combine all ingredients and make into patties., Fry in margarine.

title: Pizza Casserole
directions: Cook egg noodles and drain., Mix mushroom soup with egg noodles, and put in a casserole dish., Brown hamburger and drain. Mix together hamburger and Pizza Quick., Place this mixture in casserole dish on top of noodles., Sprinkle cheese on top and bake at 350° until cheese is melted.

title: Zucchini And Eggplant
directions: Combine the vegetables in a pot., In a bowl, stir the tomato sauce and broth together until smooth., Stir in oregano or basil, then add to mixture in pot and simmer, covered, for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Apple Strudel
directions: Mix melted oleo, egg yolks and milk very well., Add flour; work in well., Divide dough into 6 parts., Cool dough in refrigerator overnight or at least for an hour., Roll out on a floured cloth., This should be about as thin as you would roll out noodles., Sprinkle well with cracker crumbs, sliced apples (very thin), sugar and cinnamon., Dribble melted oleo over all this about 3/4 of a stick., Roll up., Grease well with melted oleo. Bake at 375° for 1/2 hour until golden brown., Again, grease well with oleo and sprinkle with sugar., Different things one can put with apples include raisins, coconut and pecans., Use 1/2 cup sugar.

title: Sticky Buns
directions: Spray a tube pan with cooking spray and drop in frozen rolls. Mix pudding mix and brown sugar., Dump over rolls., Mix white sugar and cinnamon; dump over rolls., Add nuts., Pour on butter and let stand, uncovered, overnight., Bake 30 minutes at 350°., Invert onto pie plate.

title: Asparagus Casserole
directions: Place asparagus in casserole., Mix sour cream and dried soup mix together., Spread over asparagus., Place in 350° oven for about 20 minutes, until casserole is thoroughly heated.

title: Old-Style Pineapple Pudding
directions: Mix cornstarch, sugar and salt and dilute with cold water, pineapple juice and boiling water., Cook in double boiler, stirring constantly until mixture thickens., Cool slightly; add lemon juice, pineapple and beaten egg whites and pour in molds to chill and set., Serve with custard or whipped cream.

title: Crumb Chicken
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Coat a 13 x 9-inch pan with vegetable cooking spray., Put milk in a shallow dish., Mix remaining ingredients except chicken in a medium size bowl., Dip each piece of chicken in milk, then in crumbs, pressing so crumbs adhere to form a thick, even coating., Arrange meaty sides up in a single layer in prepared pan., Bake 1 hour or until browned and juices run clear., Makes 4 servings.

title: Hash Brown Potato Casserole
directions: Mix potatoes, sour cream, soup, onions, cheese and 1 stick butter., Pour into a large casserole dish., Mix 1/2 stick butter with crushed Ritz crackers. Sprinkle over top of casserole. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until top is brown.

title: Easy Angel Food Cake
directions: Sift flour and measure 1 cup., Add 1/2 cup sugar and sift 4 times., Separate eggs; measure egg whites., Place in large bowl and add 1/4 teaspoon salt., Beat until foamy., Add cream of tartar and beat until stiff peaks., Gradually add 1 cup sugar, 2 tablespoons at a time, beating after each addition., Fold in vanilla., Fold in flour mixture 1/4 cup at a time., Place in 10-inch tube pan., Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Chewy Mincemeat Bars
directions: Preheat oven to 400°., Combine muffin mix, butter and sugar; blend until crumbly., Reserve 1 cup mixture, loosely packed. Press remaining crust mixture into bottom of ungreased 9-inch square baking pan., Bake 10 minutes., Remove from oven; cool 5 minutes., Carefully spread with mincemeat; sprinkle remaining crumb mixture over mincemeat., Bake 25 minutes or until golden brown., Cool on wire rack., Makes 32 (1 x 2-inch) bars.

title: Chicken With Sage Cornbread Crust
directions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Sprinkle chicken with the salt and pepper and arrange on a rack in a baking pan., Bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until the juices run clear when the chicken is pierced with fork., Meanwhile, in a small bowl, combine the mustard and oil., In another small bowl, combine the crumbs and sage., Preheat the broiler, setting the rack 6 inches from the heat., Brush chicken with half of the mustard mixture and sprinkle with half of the crumbs. Place under broiler for 1 minute or until golden brown., Turn the chicken the chicken, coat it with the remaining mustard and crumbs and broil for 1 minute or until golden brown., Serve with corn-on-the-cob and steamed green beans or broiled tomatoes., Serves 4.

title: Fruit Pizza
