directions: Roll sugar cookie dough onto 2 pizza pans. Bake each for 10 to 12 minutes. Cool completely. Mix together cream cheese, sugar and vanilla. Spread onto cooled sugar cookie crust. Top with sliced fruit.

title: Okra Seafood Gumbo
directions: Boil crabs until they turn red (about 20 minutes). Set aside and reserve water., Wash okra and cut into 1/4-inch rounds., Put 2 tablespoons of bacon fat in an iron skillet and fry okra, stirring often, to prevent burning, until it is browned and dried out, with all trace of sliminess gone.

title: Curry Rice
directions: In large pan, simmer pork chop cubes in salted water (enough to cover) 45 to 60 minutes., Add more hot water; enough to make as much curry as you want; then put in onions, carrots and potatoes. Salt and pepper to taste., Bring to boil, lower heat and simmer 2 hours, stirring occasionally, covered., Add the green pepper and simmer another 15 minutes., Add flour to water to make sauce for thickening., Stir into vegetables., Add curry powder., Serve over regular cooked rice, not instant., Leftovers freeze nicely.

title: Zucchini Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients, and bake one hour at 325° or until done.

title: Kiddy Punch
directions: Mix orange juice according to directions. Then mix all together. Serve chilled.

title: Cream Cheese Cookies
directions: Combine first 3 ingredients., Divide dough in half and chill. Roll out 1/2 at a time, about 1/4-inch thick., Cut with small round cutter., Place 1/2 teaspoon jam on each cookie., Bake on ungreased sheet in moderate oven, 350°, for 20 minutes., Makes about 2 dozen cookies.

title: Persimmon Cookies
directions: Beat persimmon pulp, soda, sugar and margarine until creamy. Beat in egg, then add flour, cinnamon, nutmeg, cloves and salt. Fold in walnuts and raisins. Drop by spoonfuls on greased baking sheet. Bake at 375° for 12 to 15 minutes., Makes about 3 dozen.

title: Deluxe Macaroni And Cheese
directions: Cook macaroni per package directions; rinse and set aside. Combine the next 6 ingredients., Add macaroni; stir well., Spoon into lightly greased 2-quart casserole dish., Sprinkle with paprika; bake at 350° for 45 minutes., Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Pineapple Upside-Down Cake
directions: Melt the butter in a large pan., Spread brown sugar evenly in skillet and arrange pineapple slices on sugar, filling in spaces with nuts., Sift the flour, baking powder and salt together., Beat egg yolks until light, adding sugar gradually., Add pineapple juice and sifted flour., Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites., Pour batter over pineapple., Bake in moderate oven (375°) for 30 to 35 minutes., Turn upside down on cake plate., Serve with whipped cream, if desired.

title: Marinated Slaw
directions: Bring this mixture just to a boil., Let cool and pour over cabbage mixture., Place in airtight container and let stand for 24 hours, stirring occasionally.

title: Cheesy Chicken
directions: In a bowl, combine crumbs and cheese., Add seasonings and mix well to blend., Melt butter., Dip chicken into butter, then into crumbs., Arrange chicken in lightly oiled ovenproof baking dish. Bake chicken at 375° for about 30 minutes or until brown and done. Chicken should be tender.

title: Indiana Picnic Cake
directions: In a bowl, sift first 2 ingredients, add butter and nuts, and mix all together., Take out 1 cup, set aside., Add to bowl the rest of the ingredients., Beat well and put in greased square pan 9 x 9-inch, then sprinkle the cup of crumb mixture on top., Bake in preheated oven at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Crunch Top Broccoli Bake
directions: Heat oleo in small saucepan until melted., Stir in flour, salt, pepper, sugar and onion., Add sour cream., Stir until smooth. Cook, stirring constantly until mixture comes just to boiling point., Fold in broccoli., Pour into 1 1/2-quart greased baking dish., Toss together Chex cereal and cheese and sprinkle over broccoli mixture., Bake in preheated 350° oven about 20 minutes or until bubbly., Serves 6.

title: Vegetable Dip
directions: Mix until smooth., Place dip in center of serving tray and surround with vegetables of your choice.

title: Saccharine Pickles
directions: Boil together and cool., Pour over cucumbers packed in jars and seal., Makes about 8 quarts of pickles.

title: Baked Beans And Hamburger Casserole
directions: Brown ground beef and chopped onion., Mix meat and onion with ketchup., Add other ingredients., Place in casserole dish and bake covered for 45 minutes at 350°.

title: Cranberry Glazed Chef'S Prime
directions: Combine cornstarch, cinnamon and salt in small saucepan., Stir in orange juice and cranberry sauce., Cook and stir over medium heat until thickened., Set aside.

title: Chocolate Zucchini Cake
directions: Sift first 4 ingredients; set aside., Cream butter, oil and sugar until light., On medium speed, beat eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition., Blend in vanilla., Add dry ingredients alternately with buttermilk to creamed mixture., Beat well after each addition., Stir in zucchini., Pour in 13 x 9-inch pan., Sprinkle with chocolate chips and nuts., Bake at 325° for 55 minutes or until cake tests done.

title: Pumpkin Cookies
directions: Drop by spoonful on cookie sheet., Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes., Cool and ice., Put brown sugar icing on top.

title: Pepperoni Pizza Pinwheels
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., In small bowl, blend first 4 ingredients., Separate crescent dough into 8 rectangles., Firmly press perforations to seal., Spread about 1/4 cup pepperoni mix on each rectangle., Start at shorter side and roll up; seal., Cut into 6 pieces., Place, cut side down, onto ungreased cookie sheet., Bake 12 to 15 minutes at 375°, until golden brown.

title: English Apple Pie
directions: Arrange apples in a greased oblong baking dish., Sprinkle granulated sugar over apples., Mix brown sugar, flour, pecans and margarine; pour over apples, patting to cover entire surface. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes., Makes a sweet, gooey apple pie. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Mashed Potatoesdallas, Texas
directions: Boil potatoes until you are able to pierce with fork.

title: Quiche Stuffed Mushrooms
directions: Rinse mushrooms, pat dry and remove stems., Chop stems (makes about 1 1/2 cups) and set aside., In large skillet, saute bacon until crisp; drain on paper towel, crumble and set aside., Pour bacon drippings from skillet., In the same skillet, melt butter. Use about 4 tablespoons of melted butter to brush the outsides of the mushroom caps and place in large shallow 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan., To the butter remaining, add onion and saute, then add mushroom stems and saute 2 minutes longer., Remove from the heat. In bowl, combine eggs, cream, cheese and salt., Stir in bacon and mushroom mixture., Fill caps., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Dee Dee'S Peanut Butter Balls
directions: Mix together and roll into balls., Chill.

title: Taco Soup
directions: Brown meat and onions., Drain fat. Add remaining ingredients and simmer 1 hour.

title: Cole Slaw
directions: Grate cabbage and small carrot., Add celery seed, salt and pepper to taste., Combine vinegar and mayonnaise; add to cabbage. Use more or less vinegar, depending on how sour you like it.

title: Sourdough Bread
directions: Combine the yeast, flour, sugar and potato buds in a bowl. Gradually add the warm water until smooth. Place in a large glass or crock. Keep covered with plastic wrap in a warm place for 2 days, then refrigerate.

title: Peach Sunrise Cake
directions: Prepare cake mix according to package directions, baking in two 8 or 9-inch pans., Once layers are cooled, slice in half, making 4 layers.

title: Hash Brown Casserole
directions: Preheat oven to 425°., Combine the frozen hash browns, cheese and onion in a large bowl.	Combine the milk, beef stock, half of the melted butter, garlic powder, salt and black pepper in another bowl and mix until well blended., Pour over hash browns and mix well., Heat the remaining butter in a large, ovenproof skillet over high heat.	When the skillet is hot, spoon in the hash brown mixture., Cook the hash browns, stirring occasionally, until hot and all of the cheese is melted (about 7 minutes).	Put the skillet into the oven and bake for 45-60 minutes or until the surface for the hash browns are dark brown.

title: Refrigerated Cucumber Pickles
directions: Heat vinegar, sugar and seasonings to boiling.	Arrange sliced cucumbers,, onions and green pepper in jars., Pour hot liquid over and cool., Store in refrigerator.

title: Crock-Pot Barbecue Beef
directions: Place all ingredients in a crock-pot and cook on high until mixture boils., Then turn to low and simmer for 6 to 8 hours. Chop cooked meat and serve on sandwich rolls.

title: Clam Chowder
directions: Put bacon in a 2-quart casserole., Cover with paper towel. Microwave 1 1/2 to 2 minutes, until crisp., Remove paper towel and bacon; leave drippings in casserole., Crumble bacon and set aside. Add clams, liquid, potato, onions and water., Cover and microwave 8 minutes on High, stirring every 3 minutes., Add milk, bacon, seasonings and butter., Cover and cook 2 to 3 minutes until it comes to a boil., Let stand 2 minutes., Serves 3 to 4.

title: Hawaiian Cake
directions: Cream butter and sugar., Add eggs, beating into mixture one a a time., Add soda, baking powder, graham cracker crumbs, milk, coconut and nuts., Grease and flour 3 (9-inch) cake pans., Pour into 3 layers., Bake 25 to 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Fruit Slices
directions: Melt butter, add condensed milk and cocoa and heat gently until combined., Remove from heat and add chopped fruit, coconut and crushed/crumbled cereal., Stir well and press into a Swiss roll tin., When cool, ice with lemon icing.

title: Banana Layer Cake
directions: Cream Crisco and sugar; add eggs and beat well., Add dry ingredients alternately with milk., Add mashed bananas and vanilla., Bake in 350° oven for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Cherry Berry Pie
directions: Drain cherries and raspberries; reserve 1 1/4 cups juice and set fruit aside., In a saucepan, combine sugar and cornstarch; gradually stir in juice., Cook and stir over medium heat until the mixture begins to boil., Cook and stir 2 minutes longer., Remove from the heat; stir in butter, extract and food coloring., Gently fold in the fruit., Cool slightly., Pour into pie crust and top with a lattice crust., Bake at 375° for 45 minutes or until bubbly. Cool and serve plain or with ice cream.

title: Potato Salad
directions: Boil potatoes until tender., Drain., Add remaining ingredients and stir., Serve or chill and serve.

title: Beet Jam
directions: Grind beets in a food chopper., Measure 3 2/3 cups pulp and juice and add lemon juice., Add Sure-Jell and bring to a boil., Add sugar., Stir and bring to a full boil again., Boil for one minute. Put in glasses and cover with paraffin.

title: French Fried Cauliflower
directions: Roll flowerets in flour, dip in egg to which water has been added., Roll in bread crumbs and fry in deep fat., Bake at 350° until golden brown., Makes 4 servings.

title: Confetti Salad
directions: Cook macaroni according to package directions; drain well. Cool; rinse with cold water to cool quickly., Combine Italian dressing, mayonnaise, salt and pepper in a large bowl. Blend well. Add cooled macaroni, cauliflower, celery, green pepper, radishes, carrots, tomatoes and parsley to the mayonnaise mixture., Toss lightly until pasta and vegetables are evenly coated., Chill for 8 to 10 hours to enjoy.

title: Green Chile Soup
directions: Combine all the ingredients, except the cilantro, in a 2-quart casserole., Cover tightly and cook on High for 8 to 10 minutes, or until heated through., To serve:, Spoon the soup into 4 cups and sprinkle with cilantro.

title: Fresh Peach Pie
directions: Bake pie crust as directed on package., Prepare Dream Whip also as directed., Mix together sugar and cornstarch., Add water. Cook over medium heat until thick and clear., Color with yellow food coloring., Add almond extract., Pour over peaches and stir lightly., Pour into pie crust; top with whipped cream.

title: Mexican Lasagna
directions: Brown meat, onion and garlic in a large skillet; drain off fat., Add tomatoes, taco sauce, olives, green chiles, salt and pepper, stirring to blend mixture., Simmer 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.

title: Chocolate Chip Cake
directions: Mix all together except chocolate chips., Beat 4 to 5 minutes. Mix (by hand) the chocolate chips into the batter., Pour into a greased and floured Bundt pan., Bake at 350° for 40 to 50 minutes. Cool., Ice with chocolate frosting.

title: Art'S Aroma
directions: In large, deep skillet, fry Spam until brown., Add vegetables, tomato sauce and spices., Simmer until potatoes are tender to fork., Serve with French bread or sourdough bread.

title: Salmon Caesar
directions: In medium bowl, beat together eggs, milk and soup., Stir in croutons, flaked salmon, green pepper and onion., Pour into buttered 11 3/4 x 7 1/2 x 1 3/4-inch baking dish., Sprinkle Parmesan cheese over top., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until set in center.

title: Cheese And Mayo Potatoes
directions: Dice cooked potatoes., Add bacon and onion., Stir in mayo. Put in casserole and top with shredded Velveeta., Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
directions: Mix mashed sweet potatoes, sugar, melted margarine and vanilla together., Mix with mixer until fluffy., Pour into casserole dish.

title: Oven Baked Beef Stew
directions: Clean and cut potatoes., Cut all vegetables up into pieces. Combine ingredients in baking pan., Pour in 2 cans of broth., Salt and pepper to taste., Bake at 300° for 3 hours.

title: Grilled Corn On The Cob
directions: Butter each ear of corn and sprinkle with curry powder., Wrap each ear of corn in a sheet of aluminum foil., Place on grill for approximately 10 minutes, or until cooked.

title: Chicken Enchilada Casserole
directions: Heat oil and saut the onion., Add the chicken, tomatoes and taco seasoning., Bring to a boil., Reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes., Layer 4 corn tortillas on the bottom of a 9 x 13-inch glass pan., Layer 1/3 chicken mixture, olives and cheese., Repeat layers 2 times, ending with cheese., Bake, uncovered, in 350° oven for 30 minutes.

title: Broiled Quail
directions: Combine any commercial barbecue sauce or your own with oil, bay leaf, garlic and lemon and pepper seasoning., Pour over cleaned quail and marinate at room temperature for about 1 hour before cooking., Broil over charcoal, turning once or twice, until done, about 20 minutes., Do not overcook as this will dry out the tender white meat of the quail., Serve barbecue sauce separately. The legs make delicious hors d'oeuvres.

title: Prune Pecan Cake
directions: Cream sugar with Wesson oil., Add eggs 1 at a time, beating after each., Mix flour with spices., Beat in flour and milk alternately., Add nuts, prunes and raisins., Bake at 300° for 45 minutes.

title: Party Wieners
directions: Saute onions in oil until tender., Stir in catsup, water, vinegar, mustard, pepper, sugar and wieners., Bring to boil, stirring occasionally., Turn down heat, simmer for 20 minutes.

title: Cherry Salad(Pink Delight Salad)
directions: Mix all ingredients and chill for several hours.

title: Cabbage And Chicken
directions: In a paper or plastic bag, mix flour, seasoned salt and celery seed., Coat chicken legs a few pieces at a time and coat., Heat oil in a large frying pan; add chicken and cook turning until brown, about 10 minutes., Transfer to a large baking dish. Preheat oven to 350°., In the same pan, cook onion until tender. Add tomatoes, tomato sauce, apples, caraway seed, salt and sugar. Bring to a boil., Add cabbage and mix well., Spoon mixture over chicken., Cover with foil and bake 1 hour, until chicken is tender., Remove foil; sprinkle cheese over chicken., Return to oven for about 5 minutes to melt cheese.

title: Hot Taco Rice
directions: Brown meat and onion., Add salsa, tomato sauce and bouillon cube., Bring to a full boil., Reduce heat to low., Cover and simmer for 5 minutes., Meanwhile, prepare rice as directed on package., Put rice on the bottom of serving dish or casserole dish., Top with meat mixture.

title: Raisin Pie
directions: Put raisins in large saucepan., Cover with water, plus that amount of water also., Simmer until raisins are plump., While raisins are cooking, mix together the sugar, egg, flour and cornstarch., Pour small amount of hot liquid into the sugar-egg mixture, then gently pour all this into raisins., Stir constantly; it will thicken quickly., Remove from heat., Let cool while fitting crust in pie pan.

title: Pumpkin-Raisin Muffins
directions: Place sugar, vegetable oil, eggs, pumpkin and water in a bowl and mix., Sift flour, baking soda and salt in raisins and spices. Add to first mixture and mix., Stir in raisins and walnuts., Place in paper liners in cupcake tin., Bake at 400° approximately 15 minutes.

title: Banana Nut Bread
directions: Blend shortening with sugar until creamy., Sift dry ingredients together and add to the creamed mix, blending well. Add mashed bananas, lemon juice and nuts., Bake in 3 well-greased No. 2 cans (average size can in the home)., Fill cans only 1/2 full., Bake at 350° for about 50 minutes.

title: Fried Peach Pies
directions: Cover dried peaches with water., Cook in boiling water for 30 minutes until tender., Drain and cool.

title: Corny Corn Muffins(Lo-Fat)
directions: *No cream style corn?, Substitute 1/4 cup milk, buttermilk, or yogurt,, a, pinch of baking soda and corn kernels to make 1 cup.

title: Coconut Cream Pie
directions: Mix sugar, flour and salt together., Add all remaining ingredients, except coconut., Mix well., Cook over medium heat until mixture thickens, stirring with wire whip to prevent sticking., Add coconut and pour into pie shell., Top with meringue.

title: Pecan Sandies
directions: Cream the butter and sugar. Add water and vanilla. Mix well. Blend in flour, salt and nuts. Chill for 4 hours., Shape into crescents or fingers, using about 1 tablespoon of dough per cookie. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 325° for 20 to 25 minutes. Remove from pan., Cool slightly., Dust with powdered sugar., Makes about 3 dozen cookies.

title: Caramel Pecan Pie
directions: Melt caramels with water and margarine in covered double boiler or in a saucepan over low heat., Stir occasionally until smooth. Combine sugar, salt, vanilla and eggs., Gradually add caramel sauce; mix well., Stir in pecan halves., Pour into pie shell., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes., Pie filling will appear to be soft, but it becomes firm as it cools.

title: Yam Souffle
directions: Mix together the above and pour into greased 8-inch round baking dish.

title: Coffee Cake
directions: Mix the first 5 ingredients to make crumbs., Reserve about 3/4 cup, for topping., Add milk and eggs to remaining crumbs and mix until smooth., Put batter in prepared 13 x 9-inch pan., Add cinnamon to reserved crumbs and sprinkle on top., Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Applesauce Drop Cookies
directions: Mix together thoroughly shortening, sugar and eggs; stir in applesauce., Sift together flour, soda, baking powder, salt and spices; stir into sugar mixture., Mix in raisins and nuts., Drop by teaspoonfuls onto greased cookie sheet., Place 1/4 maraschino cherry on top for decoration., Bake 10 to 12 minutes at 375°.

title: Wasateh Mountain Ranger Cookies
directions: Cream butter., Gradually add both sugars, beating well., Add eggs; mix well., Stir in flour, baking powder, soda, salt and vanilla., Fold in oats, cereal, nuts, morsels, coconut and raisins.

title: Fantasy Fudge
directions: Heat all ingredients in a medium saucepan, except nuts and cook until smooth., Add nuts and pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan and refrigerate until set., Cut into squares.

title: Pineapple Casserole
directions: Grease casserole dish., Pour pineapple (drained) in dish. Sprinkle sugar and flour mixture over pineapple., Sprinkle cheese over sugar and flour mixture., Mix cracker crumbs and melted margarine., Pour over cheese., Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Mushroom Rice
directions: Make rice according to package directions., Saute onions and mushrooms in margarine until tender., In large casserole, combine cooked rice, mushrooms and onions and soy sauce., (Add more soy sauce to taste.), Mix well., Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

title: Chicken Salad
directions: Combine chicken, grapes and almonds. Combine mayonnaise and remaining ingredients. Add to chicken mixture and mix well.

title: Spinach Quiche
directions: Cook bacon; drain and crumble., Combine half the Swiss cheese and the other ingredients., Mix completely., Pour into deep dish pie shell., Cover with the rest of the cheese., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until firm in center., This is very good, even if you are not a lover of spinach.

title: Weight Watchers Raspberry Mousse With Strawberries
directions: Drain raspberries, reserving juice., Combine gelatins in small saucepan; stir in half the orange juice and raspberry juice., Let stand 3 minutes., Stir over medium heat until gelatin is dissolved.

title: Bacon Wrap Ups
directions: Wrap bacon around the water chestnuts and spear with toothpick., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes (can be frozen until needed)., Mix together the ketchup, sugar and soy sauce; dip the bacon wrap ups in this sauce., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

title: Eggless, Butterless, Milkless Cake
directions: Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan (greased and floured)., Bake at 350° for 50 minutes.

title: Pretzel Salad
directions: Mix pretzels, 3 tablespoons sugar and margarine., Press into a 13 x 9-inch dish., Bake for 10 minutes in preheated 350° oven. Cool.

title: Cheeseburger Pie
directions: Brown ground beef with chopped onion; drain., Add catsup and mustard; simmer for 5 minutes., In 2-quart casserole, layer beef mixture and slices of cheese., Top last layer of cheese with biscuits., Follow baking directions on can., Serve with salad or fries.

title: Turtles
directions: To make each turtle, use 1 whole (head) and 2 halves (4 legs) pecans., Place pecans in form and place softened caramel over pecans to make body., Pour a tablespoon of chocolate chip mixture over that and chill until firm.

title: Christmas Cookies
directions: Cream butter and sugar., Add eggs. Mix in flour and spice. Pour brandy over chopped up fruit and nuts., Add to cake mix. Refrigerate for 1/2 day before cooking., Grease cookie sheet. Cook for 15 minutes at 300°.

title: "Philly" Cheese Ball
directions: Combine cheese food, softened cream cheese and margarine; mix until well blended., Add remaining ingredients; mix well., Mold into bell shapes using the Cracker Barrel container coated with margarine. Chill until firm., Remove., Yields 2 bells.

title: Hot Roll Recipe
directions: Warm milk, sugar and Crisco. Dissolve dry yeast in the warm water. When dissolved, add to milk mixture. Add flour and beat with electric mixer. Set aside until double in size., Sift together baking powder, salt and baking soda., Add to mixture and enough flour to make a stiff dough (enough to handle; I use my hands.), Make out your rolls (use greased muffin tins or whatever kind of roll you are making) and let rise. (I make two balls in muffin pan.) Bake at 425° for 7 to 8 minutes. The dough can be placed, covered, in the refrigerator for several days., You can make a dozen at a time.

title: Graham Cookies
directions: Cover bottom of 9 x 12-inch pan with graham crackers., Mix margarine, egg, sugar and milk in saucepan and boil 2 minutes. Cover crackers with mixture., Remove from heat and add vanilla, coconut, cracker crumbs and nuts., Pour over crackers in pan and add another layer of crackers and press down gently., Cover with Icing.

title: Frosted Pineapple Squares
directions: Combine first 5 ingredients in heavy saucepan., Cook over medium heat., Stir constantly until thick and smooth; set aside to cool., Scald milk and add sugar., Set aside to cool., Mix yeast and warm water; let it sit for a few minutes., Cut butter into flour and add eggs., Combine flour, yeast and milk mixtures. Dough will be moist., Divide in half., Roll each half out on a floured surface to fit the bottom of a jelly roll pan., Spread cooled pineapple filling and cover with second half., Seal edges; snip surface of dough to let steam escape., Cover with clean towel and let rise in a warm place for about one hour., Bake at 375° for 35 to 40 minutes., Frost with confectioners sugar frosting., May want to use 2 cans of canned pie filling or substitute other canned fruit or fresh fruit or pineapple.

title: Fat-Free Pumpkin Bran Muffins(Tasty Muffins Without The Fat.)
directions: Spray 12 (2 1/2-inch) muffin cups with cooking spray., In medium bowl, combine pumpkin, cereal, milk, corn syrup and egg whites., In large bowl, combine flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda and salt., Add pumpkin mixture; stir until well blended., Stir in raisins., Spoon into prepared muffin cups., Bake in 400° oven 20 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean., Cool in pan 5 minutes., Remove; cool on wire rack.

title: Cranberry Punch
directions: Combine in blender and blend until smooth.

title: Energy Saver Bars
directions: Toast oats in shallow baking pan in preheated 350° oven for about 15 minutes or until golden brown., Line a 9-inch square baking pan with aluminum foil and butter., Melt marshmallows, peanut butter, honey and butter in medium saucepan over low heat, stirring constantly., Remove from heat and stir in toasted oats and raisins., Place in prepared pan, spreading evenly., Chill until firm., Remove from foil and cut into small squares. Refrigerate in sealed container.

title: Kidney Bean Salad
directions: In saucepan, combine beans and oil., Bring to boil., Let cool and drain off liquid., Add eggs, onions, pickles and salad dressing., Cover and refrigerate.

title: President Harding'S Pudding Pie
directions: Cream together butter and sugars., Add eggs, half and half and vanilla., Pour into pie shells that have been baked 4 to 5 minutes in a 350° oven., Sprinkle lightly with nutmeg and pecans., Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes., Serve with whipped cream.

title: Shrimp Spread
directions: Soften cream cheese and mix remaining ingredients in order given., Chill and use as spread for crackers or party bread.

title: Heloise Peking Roast
directions: Wash meat., Cut slits in meat and put in slivers of onion. Drizzle vinegar over meat., Cover tight and place in refrigerator overnight., Next day, drain off vinegar and wipe dry., Put meat in heavy pan and brown both sides in oil., Pour coffee and water over meat. Add salt and pepper., Cover and bake 5 to 6 hours in low degree oven until meat is fork-tender., Make drippings into gravy.

title: Punch
directions: Mix all ingredients together; chill, but add 7-Up just before serving.

title: Hot Spiced Cider
directions: Stir all ingredients together., Heat, but do not boil., Serve hot., Serves 16 to 18.

title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Fudge
directions: Boil to softball., Add 1 teaspoon vanilla., Stir until creamy syrup, then add peanut butter., Put in buttered 8 x 8-inch pan.

title: Watergate Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Pour in ungreased shallow casserole., Chill until set., Serves 6 to 8.

title: Apple Strudel
directions: Toss apple slices in lemon juice., Add nuts, raisins, salt, Sugar Twin and cinnamon; mix well., Lay out 1 sheet of fillo dough on waxed paper and brush carefully with 1 teaspoon melted margarine., Sprinkle with 1/2 tablespoon bread crumbs., Place second sheet on top of first and repeat the process., Now you are ready to fill and roll the strudel., Spoon 1/2 of the apple mixture in one strip along the edge of the fillo sheets that are nearest you., Using the waxed paper to help you get started, roll the dough like a jelly roll., Lay on greased baking sheet, seam side down and brush top with remaining tablespoon margarine. Score at 1-inch intervals., Repeat process with other two fillo sheets., Bake at 350° for about 30 minutes or until lightly brown; be careful not to let it burn., Cut into slices when cool.

title: Persimmon Raisin Cookies
directions: Cream butter; gradually add sugar, beating well., Add egg and beat well., Combine flour, spices and salt; add to creamed mixture, mixing well., Combine persimmon pulp and soda; stir well and add to creamed mixture., Stir in raisins and pecans., Drop dough by level teaspoonful onto greased cookie sheet., Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes or until done., Yields 3 dozen.

title: Marinated Italian Beans
directions: Wash beans, trim ends and string., Place beans in a 12 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish., Add water., Cover with heavy-duty plastic wrap and microwave at High for 12 to 14 minutes or until crisp-tender, stirring after 6 minutes., Let stand covered 2 minutes., Drain., Combine dressing and remaining ingredients in a small bowl., Stir well., Pour mixture over beans, cover and refrigerate 6 to 8 hours., Serves 6.

title: Hot Apple Cider Punch
directions: Heat cider, cloves, allspice, cinnamon and sugar to boiling; cover and simmer 20 minutes., Strain punch and pour into punch bowl., Float oranges in bowl., Makes 32 servings (about 1/2 cup each).

title: Fruity Pebble Bars
directions: Put cereal in a large bowl., Melt marshmallows and butter in pan on stove., Add marshmallow mixture to cereal; mix well., Put in greased 9 x 13-inch cake pan., Chill for 1 hour to harden., Cut into squares.

title: Tender Breaded Chicken Roll
directions: Preheat oven to 400°., Dip chicken in oil, then in flavored bread crumbs, flavored with garlic powder., Place 1 slice of cheese on cutlet, then roll., Put in pan sprayed with Pam., Cover with foil., Bake 50 minutes at 400°.

title: Corn Casserole
directions: Mix and bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: South Of The Border Dip
directions: Brown ground beef and onion; drain., Add taco seasoning mix; stir., Add refried beans and water; stir., Layer beef and bean mixture into a large oblong casserole dish (13 x 9 x 2-inch). Spread sour cream over mixture., Top with Cheddar cheese., Add taco sauce and jalapenos, if desired., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes, until cheese melts.

title: Spinach Salad
directions: Mix together lemon juice, oil, salt, pepper, sugar and basil. Add sliced onion and mushrooms., Marinate overnight in refrigerator.

title: Italian Meat Loaf
directions: Use a 9 x 13-inch baking pan., Form ingredients into a loaf. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes., Mix tomato paste and water and put on top of loaf., Sprinkle with cheese., Bake 10 to 15 minutes more.

title: Potatoes Deluxe
directions: Thaw potatoes for 30 minutes., Mix with remaining ingredients. Pour into 9 x 13-inch casserole., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Corn Relish
directions: Combine first 5 ingredients in saucepan and bring to a boil. Cook 2 minutes, remove and cool., Place remaining ingredients in bowl and add cooled mixture and blend., Chill., Keeps for days in refrigerator., Great for 2 people.

title: Squash Casserole
directions: Cook squash until tender; saute onions and bell pepper in small amount of margarine., Mix all ingredients, reserving 1/2 of cheese for top., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Canning Fish
directions: Mix the first 4 ingredients together., Cut fish into pieces to fit in jar., Fill about 1/2 full, then add 3 tablespoons of mixture., Finish filling jar with fish., Add 1/2 teaspoon salt to each pint., Do not add water., Pressure cook for 90 minutes. Yields 4 pints of fish.

title: Shipwreck(Turkey Casserole)
directions: In 10-inch baking dish, layer each ingredient; potatoes on bottom, onions, ground turkey, uncooked rice and kidney beans. Spread tomato soup on top., Pour water over all and cover tightly. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Buttermilk Coffee Cake
directions: Mix ingredients in order given until well blended., Place in 2 greased and floured bread pans., Place crumbs on top and bake in preheated oven at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Vegetarian Hamburger
directions: Saute onion with garlic for 1 minute; set aside., In a separate bowl, mash beans., Add cracker meal (enough to make a ball)., Add cider vinegar, egg white, onion and garlic., Grill or bake for 2 1/2 minutes on each side.

title: Hotel Peabody Vanilla Muffins
directions: Preheat oven to 400°., Mix all ingredients thoroughly. Liberally grease muffin tins (not with the nonstick spray) and heat muffin pans until almost smoking., Spoon muffin mixture into hot muffin tins., Bake at 400° for 20 minutes., Makes 3 dozen.

title: Lemon Squares
directions: Mix flour, margarine and confectioners sugar well., Press into ungreased 8-inch square pan., Build up edges about 1/2-inch., Bake 20 minutes at 350°., Meanwhile, combine remaining ingredients. Pour over hot crust and bake until no indentation remains when center is lightly touched, about 20 to 25 minutes., Cool and cut into squares., Dust with powdered sugar.

title: Blonde Brownies
directions: Mix flour, soda, powder and salt., Melt butter in saucepan., Add sugar., Blend in flour mixture gradually, mixing well., Spread in 13 x 9 pan., Sprinkle with chips and nuts., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes., Cool in pan, cut into bars.

title: Chocolate Pudding(Yields 2 Cups)
directions: Scald the milk in the top of a double boiler over direct heat. Mix the cocoa, sugar and add the 1/4 cup cold milk slowly, stirring all the time, to make a smooth paste., Combine the scalded milk with the other ingredients and cook over hot water, stirring constantly until the pudding thickens., Remove from the fire and chill before serving., If you use milk, for each half cup of pudding that you eat, subtract a half a cup of milk from your daily allowance of milk.

title: Baked Pineapple
directions: Dissolve cornstarch in water., Beat eggs until fluffy., Fold eggs and cornstarch into pineapple., Add salt and sugar., Put in baking dish., Cover mixture with cinnamon., Bake at 350° for about 1 hour or until golden brown all over., Serve with ham, like a vegetable.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
directions: In a bowl, mix the cream cheese, sugar and peanut butter with electric mixer., Fold in cool whip., Pour the mixture into pie shells and chill several hours before serving., Garnish with reserved cup of cool whip.

title: Ham Casserole
directions: Spray a 9 x 13 dish with vegetable spray., Layer ham slices on bottom, then add potato slices., Mix cream of mushroom soup with milk and pour over potatoes., Top with cheese., Bake at 350° for 1 hour., Can add Vidalia onion if desired.

title: Peasant'S Purse
directions: In medium skillet, saute (with 1 tablespoon butter) mushrooms, leeks (cut into pieces) and garlic., Add wine., Boil gently until wine evaporates., Stir in chives and rice., Set aside.

title: Quesadillas(Appetizers)
directions: Fry, each, tortilla, in 1/4 inch of hot oil until crisp and golden, turning once., Drain and place tortillas on paper towels. Sprinkle, each, tortilla, with, combined cheese, then tomato pieces and sprinkle of dried cilantro., Microwave each tortilla approximately 1 minute until cheese is melted.* Using scissors cut tortillas into quarters., Serve warm.

title: Fantastic Chicken
directions: Combine soup and cream and put half in bottom of baking dish. Lay chicken pieces over the mixture., Put other half on top of chicken., Salt and pepper chicken., Bake at 350° for one hour.

title: Beef Burgundy
directions: Combine ingredients in large casserole or a roaster., Cover and bake at 300° for 3 to 4 hours., Serve over rice or noodles.

title: 7 Stacked Layer Lettuce Salad
directions: Put first 4 ingredients in large dish in layers with lettuce on the bottom., Mix mayonnaise and sugar and put on top., Mix. Add shredded cheese and Bac*Os or bacon., Can substitute boiled eggs, onions and cauliflower.

title: Beer Batter Bread
directions: Combine flour and sugar; add beer and egg., Stir mixture with fork until blended., Pour batter into greased 9 x 5-inch bread pan., Bake at 375° for 60 to 70 minutes or until done., Remove from pan and cool on rack.

title: Turkey Or Crab Tetrazzini
directions: Saute the onion, green pepper, celery, mushrooms and pimento. Add wine and turkey or crab., Put pasta on bottom of casserole and Parmesan cheese on top, then sauteed mixture. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Dump Cake
directions: Layer in order given., Bake at 350° about 35 minutes., May use 2 cans favorite pie filling in place of pineapple.

title: Wild Rice Chicken Supreme
directions: Cook contents of rice and seasoning packet according to package directions., While rice is cooking, melt butter in a large saucepan., Add onion and cook over low heat until tender., Stir in flour, salt and pepper., Gradually stir in half and half and chicken broth., Cook, stirring constantly, until thickened., Stir in chicken, pimiento, parsley, almonds and cooked rice., Pour into a greased 2-quart casserole., Bake uncovered in 400° oven for 30 minutes.

title: Baked Corn
directions: Melt margarine., Add corn, sour cream and Jiffy corn muffin mix., Mix good and bake in a greased casserole., Salt and pepper to taste., Bake at 350° until top is lightly brown.

title: Better Than Almost Anything Cake
directions: Mix cake mix according to directions. Add water, oil and eggs.

title: Million Dollar Pound Cake
directions: Combine sugar and butter; cream until light and fluffy., Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each., Add flour alternately with milk, beating well after each addition., Add flavorings., Pour into greased and floured 10-inch tube pan., Bake at 300° for 1 hour and 40 minutes.

title: Orange Glazed Cranberry Pumpkin Bread
directions: In large bowl, mix flour, sugar, baking soda, pumpkin pie spice, salt and baking powder., In second bowl, stir together remaining ingredients until well mixed., Add pumpkin mixture to flour mixture and stir until all ingredients are well moistened. Pour batter into 2 (9 1/4 x 5 1/4-inch) greased loaf pans., Bake at 350° for 65 minutes., Cool 10 minutes, then remove., Cool, then drizzle with glaze.

title: Julia Child'S Sweet Onion Quiche
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., Heat olive oil in a large saute pan. Saute sliced onions until soft, but not browned., In a separate pan, heat butter and saute shallots briefly., Add to onions and continue cooking until the mixture is tender., Season with salt, pepper and nutmeg; let cool.

title: Sun-Drop Punch
directions: Pour into punch bowl over crushed ice.

title: Cherry Dream Squares
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Grease a 13 x 9-inch pan., In large bowl, combine cake mix, 6 tablespoons butter and 1 cup rolled oats., Mix until crumbly., Reserve 1 cup crumbs for topping., To remaining crumbs, add 1 egg and mix until well blended., Press into prepared pan., Pour cherry pie filling over crust., Spread to cover., To reserved crumbs in large bowl, add remaining 1/4 cup rolled oats, 2 tablespoons margarine, nuts and brown sugar., Beat until thoroughly mixed., Sprinkle over cherry mixture., Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes or until golden brown., Add whipped topping, if desired.

title: Nachos
directions: Cook meat and onion until browned. Drain and stir in beans. Arrange half of chips on each of two 12-inch plates., Layer half the meat-bean mixture, olives and cheese on top of chips for each plate., Bake at 350° for 5 to 7 minutes until cheese melts.

title: Mikey'S Tuna Salad
directions: Toss all ingredients. Chill and serve.

title: Coconut Cake
directions: Mix cake according to directions on box. Bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan; let cool. Puncture the cake full of holes. Combine cream of coconut and condensed milk; pour mixture over the cake. Top with whipped topping, then the coconut. Refrigerate.

title: Banana Pudding("Mmmmmmmmmm Good")
directions: Cream the pudding, milk, Cool Whip and sour cream together in a large bowl., Layer the pudding mixture, bananas and cookies in a big dish., Put pudding mixture on bottom and layer, finishing with cookies on top., Enjoy!!

title: Easter Basket Cake
directions: Make cake according to package directions., Bake in two 9 inch round pans., Cool., Put first layer on plate., Frost with icing; cut hole about 2 inches round in the middle of the second layer and put on top of first layer., (Save the middle part you cut out for another time.), Frost with icing., Put 1 c. tinted green coconut in the middle of hole., Put robbins eggs and/or jelly beans on top of coconut., Sprinkle rest of coconut around the bottom of cake to resemble green grass., Roll foil to resemble a handle and decorate with ribbon., Put on cake to make a handle of a basket., Enjoy!

title: World'S Best Pound Cake
directions: Cream shortening and sugar. Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each egg is added. Sift together flour, salt and baking powder. Add to creamed mixture alternately with milk. Add vanilla. Place in large tube pan which has been greased and floured. Bake at 325° for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
directions: Cream butter and sugar thoroughly., Beat in eggs, 1 at a time, beating thoroughly after each., Add flour, reserving 2 tablespoons., Add sour cream., Mix 1/4 teaspoon soda mixed with 2 tablespoons flour., Add to mixture with flavorings., Grease and flour tube pan., Bake 1 1/2 hours at 325°., Remove from pan when comfortable to handle.

title: Chicken Spaghetti
directions: Cook and debone chicken (reserve broth)., Saute onion until soft., Cook spaghetti and drain., Add milk, broth and 1/2 of the Velveeta cheese to spaghetti., Heat until cheese melts., Add bite size pieces of chicken and sauteed onion to mixture., Put into casserole dish and cook, covered, until it bubbles in the middle. Grate remaining Velveeta over top., Melt and serve.

title: Spinach Cornbread
directions: Melt margarine in pie plate., Mix all ingredients well and pour into pan., Bake at 400° for 1 hour.

title: Broccoli-Shrimp Casserole
directions: Cook broccoli 5 minutes until tender; drain., In saucepan over medium heat, cook soup and cream cheese, stirring constantly. Alternate broccoli and soup/cream cheese mixture in casserole. Bake at 325° for 25 minutes.

title: Bite Size Fruit Cake
directions: Mix thoroughly and drop by teaspoonful on cookie sheet. Bake at	325°, for 10 to 15 minutes., This does better if let set for a couple hours in refrigerator before cooking.

title: Potato Leek Soup
directions: Melt butter in soup pot., Cut off tough green tops of leeks and wash thoroughly to remove sand., Slice leeks thinly. Simmer slowly in butter until transparent. Dice potatoes and add to leek with broth. Simmer 1/2 hour., Puree in blender. Return to heat. Season and stir in milk., Heat through., Do not boil., Serve sprinkled with fresh parsley.

title: Hot Curried Fruit
directions: Arrange all fruit, except cherries, in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish or 1 1/2-quart casserole., Combine brown sugar, butter and curry powder; sprinkle over fruit., Bake at 325° for 1 hour. Garnish with maraschino cherries., Serve immediately., Fruit can also be served from chafing dish., Serve with ham., Makes 12 servings.

title: Oven Baked Spuds
directions: Cut potatoes in wedges and put in ice water for 30 minutes. Combine oil, garlic powder, paprika and salt and pepper., Coat potato wedges with mixture and lay in shallow baking pan., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

title: Baked Carrot Sticks
directions: Place carrots in shallow baking dish., Sprinkle with salt, sugar or Equal., Use either pepper or cinnamon., Stir to mix., Dot with butter., Cover tightly with foil., Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes., Stir once half way through., Kids love these; especially with cinnamon!

title: Easy Five Can Casserole
directions: Combine all ingredients, mixing lightly., Turn into baking dish and bake at 350° to 360° for 20 to 25 minutes or until brown.

title: Whipped Cream Frosting
directions: In small saucepan, mix milk gradually into flour with wire whisk., Cook over medium heat, whisking constantly, until mixture thickened., Remove from heat; cover with plastic wrap and set aside to cool.

title: Easy Oven Stew
directions: Mix together flour, salt, pepper and paprika; sprinkle over beef., Toss floured beef in oil that has been put in 3-quart casserole dish. Bake, uncovered, at 400° for 30 minutes.

title: 7 Layer Cookies
directions: Melt margarine in a 9 x 13-inch pan., Sprinkle the next five ingredients in the order given, in layers on top of the melted margarine., Pour the sweetened condensed milk over the layered mixture., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes., Cool and cut in squares.

title: Homemade Pizza Crust
directions: Sprinkle yeast into the water and stir until dissolved., Stir in sugar, salt and oil., Add 2 cups flour and beat until smooth, then gradually stir in the additional 1 1/2 cups flour., Dough should be as soft as biscuit dough., Turn out on lightly floured board and knead until smooth and elastic., Place in greased bowl and brush top with soft shortening., Cover and let rise in warm place (85°), free from draft, until doubled in bulk., Punch down and divide in half., Form each half into a ball and place on greased baking sheet., Press out with palms of hands into circles about 12-inches in diameter, making edges slightly thick.

title: Chocolate Chip Cake
directions: Mix first 5 ingredients and beat 2 minutes., Stir in chocolate chips., Pour in greased and floured Bundt or tube pan. Bake at 350° for 50 minutes., A frosting is not necessary, but I usually put a chocolate frosting or glaze on top.

title: Christmas Cherry Salad
directions: Mix Jell-O and hot water; let stand about 10 minutes., Add pie filling and pineapple; stir until blended., Pour 1/2 of mixture into 13 x 9 x 2-inch dish and chill until firm., (Let other half of mixture stand at room temperature until needed.)

title: Baked Squash Casserole
directions: Cook onion, celery, and, pepper, in water until tender. Drain. Mix all ingredients with squash and bake at 400° until firm and slightly, brown., Put, cheese, evenly, across, top of squash and cover casserole, with, lid to melt cheese., (Do not return to oven.)

title: Shrimp And Macaroni Salad
directions: Combine all ingredients except shrimp., Mix well and place in covered dish in refrigerator to chill.

title: Russian Tea
directions: Put, cinnamon, stick, and whole cloves in a cheesecloth bag. Place in saucepan with sugar and water., Bring to a boil and, boil for 15 minutes., Remove spices and add all remaining ingredients. Heat and serve., Yields 2 quarts.

title: Ham And Cheese Strata
directions: Remove crusts from bread; cube bread slices., Layer bread, broccoli, ham and cheese in a 9 x 13-inch buttered pan., Beat eggs, milk, onion, salt and mustard., Pour over bread, etc., in pan. Sprinkle paprika and parsley flakes on top., Bake 50 minutes at 325°., Cool 10 minutes., Cut and serve; great for brunch.

title: Cranberry Salad
directions: Dissolve jello in boiling water., Mash cranberry sauce until fine., Add pineapple, jello, orange juice and nuts., Put in long size Pyrex dish and let gel overnight., Good anytime, with meats or as a salad with crackers.

title: Chicken Fried Rice
directions: In a large skillet, or	wok, stir-fry chicken and white onions in oil until, chicken, is, completely cooked and onions are clear. Then mix, cooked, rice, green onions and mushrooms in skillet with chicken and onions., If, rice	is too dry, add 1/4 cup water in skillet or chicken broth., Sprinkle soy sauce over rice mixture to taste.

title: Sugar Cookies
directions: Cream butter and sugar. Add the beaten eggs, then the soda with milk mixture and vanilla. Roll out thin on flour surface. Cut with cookie cutter. Sprinkle with sugar and bake on greased cookie sheet in a 350° oven until light brown.

title: Pork Chop 'N Potato Bake
directions: Brown pork chops in lightly greased skillet. Sprinkle with seasoned salt and set aside. Combine soup, milk, sour cream, pepper and 1/2 teaspoon seasoned salt. Stir in potatoes, 1/2 cup of the cheese and 1/2 cup of the French fried onions. Spoon mixture into 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Arrange pork chops over potatoes. Bake, covered, at 350° for 40 minutes. Top with remaining cheese and onions and bake 5 minutes longer. Makes 6 servings.

title: Eggplant Fritters
directions: Combine flour, baking powder and salt; stir in eggs. Add to mashed eggplant, mixing well. Drop batter by tablespoons in deep hot oil and fry until golden brown, turning once.

title: Happy Marriage Recipe
directions: Combine love and warmth., Mix thoroughly with tenderness., Add forgiveness., Blend with friends and hope., Sprinkle all remaining tenderness., Stir in faith and laughter., Bake with sunshine. Serve daily in generous helpings.

title: Hamburg Casserole
directions: Cook hamburger and onion and put in casserole dish. Put soups on top and cover with French fries laid in rows. Bake at 350-375° for 20 minutes. You can put the hamburger in the casserole raw and then cook for 1 hour or until done.

title: Pineapple Cookies
directions: In large bowl of electric mixer combine sugars and butter. Beat until well mixed., Add eggs, one at a time., Continue beating until mixture is creamy., Next, add flour, soda, baking powder, salt, vanilla, crushed pineapple and nuts and mix on medium speed for a minute or two., Do not overbeat., Drop by teaspoons on greased cookie sheet and bake for about 10 minutes or until lightly browned., Do not overbake., Bake at 375°., Place on cookie rack to cool.

title: 3 Bean Dish
directions: Brown the bacon, hamburger and onion., Add drained cans of beans in a crock-pot., Add the rest of the ingredients., Cook on low for 4 hours.

title: French Fried Onion Rings
directions: For thicker batter:, Increase salt to 1 teaspoon; add another egg., Reduce milk to 1/2 cup and reduce oil to 1 teaspoon.

title: Chicken Barbecue Sauce
directions: Mix in bowl and beat with egg beater., Makes enough for about 6 halves of chicken.

title: Herb Shake Instead Of Salt
directions: Take one large field, a half dozen children, two or three small dogs, a pinch of brook and some pebbles., Mix the children and dogs together and put them on the field with flowers., Spread over all a deep blue sky and bake in the sun., When brown, set away to cool in the bathtub., Yield: Many years of memories.

title: Chili Con Carne
directions: Use cheaper cut of meat; cut in small chunks., Mix with Gebhardt's chili powder, garlic and flour., Melt fat and suet in deep pot; fry onion until tender; add meat mixture., Cook 15 minutes, add salt; gradually pour in hot water., Simmer 45 minutes or until tender., If chili with beans is desired, add Gebhardt's Mexican-style beans, heat thoroughly; serve.

title: German Chocolate Filling And Topping
directions: In medium saucepan, combine milk, egg yolks and butter., Cook, stirring constantly, until mixture comes to a boil., Remove from heat; add remaining ingredients., Cool until thick enough to hold shape, stirring occasionally., Frosts two 9-inch round layer cakes.

title: Cheese Spread
directions: Mash cream cheese with a fork and add mayonnaise., Blend well. Stir in 1/2 cup chopped pecans and 1 cup chopped olives., Add 2 tablespoons olive juice and a dash of pepper (no salt)., Stir well., Refrigerate overnight.

title: "Hershey" Candy Bar Cookies
directions: Beat until light and fluffy, then add flour until all flour is in., Spread on greased 10 x 15-inch cookie sheet., Bake at 350° for about 15 minutes., Melt 7 or 8 Hershey bars (without almonds); can do this in the microwave oven (only takes a few seconds). Stir and immediately spread on top as soon as cookies comes out of oven., Sprinkle crushed nuts over chocolate., Let set for 15 to 20 minutes and cut into 1 1/2-inch squares.

title: Meat Loaf
directions: Mix all together., Bake 1 hour at 450°.

title: Poppy Seed Cake
directions: Mix poppy seed with hot water and let stand., Combine all other ingredients and mix with electric mixer on low., Add poppy seed and water; continue mixing on low for 1 minute., Then, mix on high for 3 or 4 minutes., Pour into 2 greased loaf pans., Bake at 325° for 35 minutes (or in Bundt pan at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes).

title: Sausage Balls
directions: Take sausage out of refrigerator and bring to room temperature, about an hour., Mix all three items together and roll into tiny balls., Bake at 400° for 15 minutes.

title: Oven Fried Chicken
directions: Put flour in a brown paper bag., Add about three pieces of chicken at a time and shake until chicken pieces are well coated with the flour., Dip chicken in melted butter and place on a cookie sheet; salt and pepper to taste., Cook in oven at 375° for one hour or until golden brown.

title: Chess Pie
directions: Melt margarine and add other ingredients., Mix well., Bake in an unbaked pie shell at 350° for 50 minutes.

title: Play Dough
directions: Mix all ingredients in a saucepan and cook over low heat for 3 minutes., Stir constantly., When firm, transfer to waxed paper and knead dough., Store in airtight container and keep in refrigerator.

title: Chicken Corn Chowder
directions: In saucepan, blend cream of chicken soup and milk., Add remaining ingredients., Heat., Stir occasionally., Makes about 7 cups., Serve with crispy bread.

title: Apple And Lemon Punch(Serves 6 To 8)
directions: Make a simple syrup by dissolving sugar in hot water., Add lemon juice; let cool., Dilute syrup with water to taste., Just before serving add apples., Serve over ice.

title: Hush Puppies
directions: Sift or stir together dry ingredients., Add onions., Mix egg and milk., Mix all together., Drop with a small spoon into hot cooking oil., Cook only until light brown.

title: Hot Mushroom Dip
directions: Fry bacon until crisp; drain, saving 2 tablespoons of drippings in pan., Crumble bacon and set aside., Add mushrooms, onion and garlic to drippings., Cook over medium heat until tender and most of the mushroom liquid has evaporated, about 6 to 8 minutes., Mix in flour, salt and pepper., Add cream cheese, Worcestershire sauce and soy sauce., Reduce heat to low and stir until cheese melts., Remove from heat and stir in sour cream and bacon., Serve with crackers.

title: Indian Pickle(Splendid Way To Salvage Green Tomatoes)
directions: Chop coarsely, all the vegetables., Sprinkle with salt and let stand 12 hours or overnight.

title: Orange Crush Pound Cake
directions: Cream shortening, 1/4 cup margarine and sugar in mixer bowl until light and fluffy., Beat in eggs, one at a time., Sift flour and salt together., Add to batter alternately with orange soda, mixing well after each addition., Stir in extracts., Spoon into greased and floured tube pan., Bake at 325° to 350° for 1 hour and 10 minutes., Cool in pan and remove to wire rack to cool completely., Combine cream cheese, 1/4 cup margarine and confectioners sugar in mixing bowl., Mix until smooth., Spread over cake.

title: Chicken Stroganoff Casserole
directions: Blend soup and sour, cream., Stir in milk., Add chicken or tuna, parsley, pimento,, seasonings and noodles., Pour into 1 1/2 quart shallow baking, dish., Top, with, crumbs., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes., Makes 3, to 4 servings., All you need to complete the meal is tossed salad, rolls and dessert.

title: Party Punch
directions: Dissolve sugar, kool-aid, and concentrates in water., Add ginger ale just before serving.

title: Easy 10 Cup Cookies
directions: Mix ingredients well., Drop by teaspoon onto cookie sheet. Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Microwave Fudge
directions: Mix well., Cook on High 2 1/2 minutes., Remove from microwave. Add vanilla., Beat 50 strokes., Pour in buttered platter., Cool and enjoy.

title: Peanut Butter Balls
directions: Combine sugar and syrup., Bring to a boil., Remove from heat. Add peanut butter., Pour mix over corn flakes., Mix well., Drop by teaspoon on wax paper., Let cool.

title: Strawberry Trifle
directions: Bake cake according to directions in 9 x 9-inch pan., Cool. Cut crosswise in half., Arrange 1 layer of cake in 2-quart serving bowl., Pour 1/2 strawberries over cake, then 1 cup pudding. Repeat., Cover and chill 4 hours., When ready to serve, top with Cool Whip., Garnish with fresh strawberries.

title: Shipwreck
directions: Place ground beef in the bottom of a casserole., Top with a layer of sliced raw potatoes, then a layer of onions., Pour can of beans over this., Cover with tomato soup., Cook in 350° oven for 1 hour 15 minutes., Uncover and brown for 30 minutes.

title: Chicken Salad
directions: Combine chicken, cheese, almonds, celery and pineapple in bowl., Mix mayonnaise, salt and soy sauce in bowl., Add to chicken mixture; mix well.

title: Ham Roll-Ups
directions: Spread softened cream cheese spread onto slice of ham., Roll and secure with party picks., Continue until sufficient amount of ham slices and cheese is used for your particular party. Refrigerate., Before serving, slice in small jelly roll type slices and secure each with a pick., (I use Alouette herb and garlic cream cheese spread.)

title: Szechuan Pork And Peanut Stir-Fry
directions: In a bowl, mix sherry, cornstarch, soy and garlic; stir in pork strips., Refrigerate 1 hour., Heat oil in wok or skillet over medium heat., Stir in onion and and carrots; stir-fry 1 to 2 minutes., Remove from pan., Stir-fry marinated pork until browned. Return onion and carrots to pan; stir in red pepper, broth and brown sugar., Scrape bottom of pan to loosen browned particles and stir into liquid., Reduce heat to low; cover., Cook 5 to 6 minutes, until pork is thoroughly cooked., Increase heat to medium; add green pepper., Cook and stir 1 to 2 minutes, until pepper is crisp-tender., Stir in peanuts., Serve over hot rice.

title: Banana Nut Cake
directions: Mix bananas, soda and water; set aside., Mix shortening, sugar, eggs and milk., Add flour and baking powder mixture alternately with banana mixture., Add nuts; mix well., Grease and flour pan., Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Lemon Squares
directions: Crumble together the 1 cup flour, 1/2 cup butter and 1/4 cup powdered sugar., Press into an 8 x 8-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.

title: Cold Avocado Soup
directions: Peel and slice avocado and put in blender., Add heavy cream, lemon juice and salt., Blend until smooth., Place in soup bowls and sprinkle with oregano., Serves 2.

title: Zucchini Casserole
directions: Pt in 1 1/2-quart casserole., Top with remaining stuffing mix. Bake 30 to 40 minutes at 350°.

title: Gingerbread
directions: Grease an 11 x 7 x 1 1/2-inch pan., Sift dry ingredients. Beat eggs, sugar, cooking oil and molasses., Add dry ingredients to egg mixture and mix until smooth., Blend in boiling water. Stir lightly and quickly., Batter will be thin., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Rum Cake
directions: Grease and flour tube or Bundt pan., Preheat oven to 350°. Combine cake mix, sugar, oil, eggs and sour cream., Blend with electric mixer at low speed until ingredients are moistened., Beat at medium speed for 2 minutes., Stir in pecans., Pour half of batter into prepared pan., Combine cinnamon and brown sugar. Sprinkle over batter., Pour remaining batter into pan., Bake 45 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean., Remove cake from oven and allow to cool in pan 10 minutes., While cake is still in pan, pour Rum Sauce over cake and allow to cool 1 1/2 hours before turning out on cake plate., Serves 12.

title: Pork Chops Creole
directions: Brown the chops in a small amount of fat., Sprinkle rice between the chops and over the top., In bowl, dilute soup and add seasonings, then pour over the chops., Bake, covered, in oven at 350° for 45 minutes or until the rice has absorbed moisture.

title: Quick Cheese Bread
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Grease an 8 x 4 x 2-inch loaf pan., Beat eggs in a large bowl. Stir in water. Add biscuit mix and beat. Add mustard and 1 cup cheese., Mix thoroughly., Turn batter into pan. Sprinkle with remaining cheese and dot with butter. Bake 45 minutes. Cool in pan 15 minutes., Remove and cool on rack before slicing., Serve sliced, buttered and toasted with a green salad, soup or chili., Also makes delicious croutons., This bread will freeze well.

title: Zucchini Bread
directions: Beat eggs., Gradually beat in sugar, then oil., Combine dry ingredients; add to first mixture alternately with zucchini., Stir in raisins, nuts and vanilla.

title: Cream Puff Cake
directions: Boil water and oleo (margarine); stir in flour while on the stove until it pulls away from the side of the pan and forms a ball. Remove from heat; add eggs one at a time. Put in a 9 x 13 pan. Bake at 400° for 30 minutes. Lower heat to 350° and bake an additional 10 minutes. Let cool.

title: Strawberry Freezer Jam
directions: Combine strawberries and sugar, stirring well., Let mixture stand 20 minutes, stirring occasionally., Combine pectin and water in a saucepan, stirring well., Bring mixture to a boil and let it boil for 1 minute, stirring as it boils., Remove from the stove and stir well again., Pour the pectin mixture over the fruit. Stir for 3 minutes., Pour into sterilized jelly glasses or frozen food containers., Cover with lids and let stand at room temperature for 1 to 2 hours or until jelled., Store in freezer up to 1 year or in refrigerator up to 3 weeks., To serve, remove and allow to come to room temperature., Yields 5 cups.

title: Creamy Lemon Cheesecake(Sugar-Free)
directions: Dissolve lemon jello in the boiling water., Put cottage cheese, cream cheese and jello in blender; blend until smooth. Gently fold in the Cool Whip., Pour into the pie shell and chill at least 4 hours.

title: Chocolate Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Mix dry ingredients together., Then add liquid ingredients., Beat with electric mixer 3 minutes on high. Grease and flour 13 x 9-inch or 2 rounds., Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes., Test with toothpick., Usually cracks open.

title: Crunchy Ham Salad
directions: Blend the cream cheese and mayonnaise., Add the ham, parsley, onion, mustard and hot pepper sauce., Blend until mixed good. Chill., Serve on bread or crackers.

title: Deviled Eggs
directions: Boil eggs until hard-boiled., Cook; peel and slice in half. Take yolk and mix other ingredients with yolk., Add salt and pepper to taste., Put yolk mixture into egg halves.

title: Clam Dip
directions: Mix all ingredients together and sprinkle with paprika.

title: Low-Fat Quick And Easy Vegetable Soup
directions: Cook meat and onion in a Dutch oven over medium heat until beef is browned, stirring until it crumbles., Drain beef mixture and pat dry with paper towels., Wipe drippings from Dutch oven with a paper towel., Return beef mixture to Dutch oven., Stir in vegetable juice and remaining ingredients., Bring to a boil; cover, reduce heat and simmer 1 hour.

title: Rice Pudding
directions: Simmer all ingredients over low flame., Stir frequently to prevent sticking. When thick, pour into bowl. Sprinkle top of pudding with cinnamon., Chill., (Remove cinnamon stick and rind prior to chilling.)

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
directions: Mix first 4 ingredients., Add egg, vanilla, salt and cream of tartar., Sift and add flour, soda and chocolate chips., Drop by teaspoon on cookie sheet., Bake at 375° for about 8 minutes.

title: Seven Layer Cookies
directions: Melt butter in 9 x 13-inch pan., Crumble graham crackers over butter., Layer remaining ingredients exactly as listed., Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes., Cool., Cut into squares.

title: Ginger Lemon Marinade
directions: In a small bowl, combine lemon juice, water, vegetable oil, vinegar, sugar, sesame oil, ginger, coriander and fennel seed (optional); mix well., Use to marinate chicken, fish or veal. Remove meat and boil marinade for 3 to 5 minutes until thickened. Brush over meat before cooking., Makes 1/2 cup.

title: Pumpkin Bread
directions: Mix well all ingredients., Grease and flour 2 loaf pans., Bake in a 350° oven for 45 to 55 minutes.

title: Green Bean Casserole
directions: Warm green beans., Add soup., Put in casserole dish., Bake at 300° for 15 minutes., Cover with potato chips or deep fried onions.

title: Baked Red Snapper
directions: Melt oleo and saute bell pepper, onions, celery and green onions until tender., Add tomatoes, wine and seasoning., Cook slowly on medium heat for 20 minutes., Place fish in baking dish. Pour sauce over fish., Add sliced lemons over fish and bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes., Baste fish with sauce., Fish should be tender when stuck with a fork.

title: Ting-A-Lings
directions: In large bowl, combine butterscotch chips and peanut butter. Microwave at 7 for 1 1/2 to 2 1/2 minutes or until melted, stirring every 30 seconds., Add cornflakes and peanuts., Stir until coated., Drop by rounded teaspoonful onto wax paper., Chill until set.

title: Summer Stir-Fry
directions: Batter with flour and fry in oil., Serve with tossed salad.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Mix all together; pour in greased casserole dish., Cook 30 minutes in regular oven.

title: Calico Quiche
directions: Beat eggs with half and half., Stir in corn, asparagus, 1 cup cheese, flaked ham and onion., Add salt and pepper., Carefully pour filling into 10-inch pastry shell., Sprinkle remaining cheese over top., Bake in preheated 375° oven for 45 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean., Serves 8.

title: Chocolate Sheet Cake
directions: Sift together sugar and flour. Set aside. Put butter, cocoa and water and bring to boil. Pour over sugar and flour mixture. Add baking soda, vanilla, eggs and buttermilk. Mix well. Add cinnamon and bake 30 minutes at 400° in 13 x 9 x 2 dish.

title: Veggie Biscuit Bites
directions: Heat oven to 450°., Mix all ingredients until soft dough forms., Turn dough onto surface generously dusted with baking mix; gently roll in baking mix to coat., Shape into ball; knead 3 or 4 times., Roll dough 1/2-inch thick., Cut with 1-inch round cutter dipped in baking mix., Place with edges touching on ungreased cookie sheet., Bake 8 to 10 minutes., Makes about 2 dozen 1-inch biscuits., For mini drops, use teaspoon and drop dough on cookie sheet.

title: Sweet And Fruity Dip
directions: Cream the cheese., Add heavy cream, then the pineapple and cherries.

title: Cheese Corn Bread
directions: Prepare corn bread mix as directed; add cheese and bake.

title: Easy Lasagna
directions: Brown ground beef and onion in skillet; drain grease., Mix spaghetti sauce and water in with this mixture., Mix the egg into the container of cottage cheese., In large oven pan layer sauce mix and lasagna noodles., Spread cottage cheese on the noodles, then the Mozzarella and Cheddar., Make 2 to 3 layers and top with Parmesan cheese., Cook in 350° oven for 1 hour., Be sure to put aluminum foil over the pan.

title: Stuffed Green Peppers
directions: Cut peppers in half, lengthwise or remain whole., Remove seeds and parboil for five minutes., Remove casing from sausage; crumble and brown with onions in butter until both are lightly browned. Add dissolved tomato paste; salt to taste.

title: Zucchini-Squash Casserole
directions: Cook zucchini and onion in boiling water for 5 minutes, then drain., Combine soup, sour cream and carrot., Fold into drained zucchini., Combine stuffing mix with butter., Put half on bottom of a 12 x 7 1/2-inch casserole dish., Spoon vegetable mix over crumbs and top with remaining stuffing mix., The whole package of stuffing mix may be used, but is a lot of crumbs (your preference). Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes., Serves 6 to 8.

title: Cold Vegetable Salad
directions: Clean fresh vegetables, then cut up in bite size pieces., Put in a bowl (a glass bowl looks nice)., Then pour Italian dressing over this (I prefer Good Seasons packets)., Then you just marinate overnight, turning occasionally.

title: Candied Dill Pickles
directions: Tie spices in cheesecloth bag., Combine all ingredients; stir to mix., Let stand until sugar dissolves., Return 1/2 of the pickles to jar., Add spice bag., Add rest of pickles and syrup. Refrigerate 3 to 4 days before serving., You may remove the spice bag after a week.

title: Praline Pie
directions: Mix margarine, brown sugar and pecans together; pat into unbaked pie crust., Bake at 400° until pie crust is brown and praline mixture is bubbly., Cool., Next, add butterscotch pie filling to 2 cups cold milk., Mix until thick., Fold in Cool Whip and pour into cooled pie crust., Refrigerate., Serve with a scoop of ice cream.

title: Peanut Butter Tandy Cake
directions: Beat the eggs; add sugar., Then add flour and vanilla., Scald the milk and melt margarine in the milk and add to the other ingredients., Pour into greased jelly roll pan., Bake 20 minutes at 350°., Spread peanut butter on cake while its hot., Cool.

title: Wine Merchant Soup
directions: Heat beef broth in large kettle. Saut onions, celery and carrots in butter and oil until just tender., Transfer with slotted spoon to broth and simmer. Use same oil and butter to saut mushrooms. When done, pour mushrooms and liquid into soup. Add wine and bring to a boil. Combine cornstarch and cold water, then add to soup. Heat until slightly thickened and serve., Serves 6.

title: Asparagus Casserole
directions: Place layer of crumbs in bottom of greased casserole dish. Layer with cheese., Layer 1 can of asparagus and 1/2 of soup and liquid mixture on top., Repeat layers., Reserve some cheese and cracker crumbs for topping., Pour melted butter over topping. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Leona'S Chili
directions: Brown meat and season with next 7 ingredients., Add tomatoes. Simmer 3 hours or until thick., Add beans with liquid., Simmer 5 minutes.

title: Philly 3 Step Cheesecake
directions: Mix cream cheese, sugar and vanilla at medium speed with electric mixer until well blended., Add eggs; mix well., Pour into crust., Bake at 350° for 40 minutes or until center is almost set. Cool., Refrigerate 3 hours or overnight., Yields 8 servings., Can be served with fruit sauce on top.

title: Salmon Party Ball
directions: Flake salmon., Combine salmon, cheese, lemon juice, onion, horseradish and liquid smoke., Chill 6 to 8 hours., Shape salmon mixture into a ball., Combine pecans and parsley; roll the salmon ball into the mixture., Chill at least 4 hours., Serve with crackers., Makes 3-inch salmon party ball.

title: Baked Pineapple Salad
directions: Place 1/2 of drained pineapple in buttered 10x6 pyrex dish. Mix flour, sugar, and salt, sprinkle half of this over pineapple. Dot with butter. Spread 1/2 of mixed cheese over this. Repeat in same order. Bake at 325°-350° for 30 minutes., Remove and sprinkle with pecans. Bake 5 more minutes.

title: S'Mores Candy
directions: Pour cereal into very large bowl; set aside., Slowly bring to a boil, stirring constantly, chocolate chips, margarine and Karo syrup., Remove from heat., Add vanilla and stir., Pour chocolate over cereal., Toss until well coated., Fold in marshmallows. Spread mixture into greased 9 x 13-inch pan or shallow baking dish., Chill one hour and cut into squares.

title: Cobbler Pie
directions: Melt butter in pan. Mix sugar, flour and milk. Pour in berries or fruit. Pour mixture in a baking dish and bake at 400° for approximately 30 minutes until tested done with a fork.

title: Tomato Sauce
directions: Brown onion in hot oil., Stir in tomatoes, breaking them up with a spoon., Add other ingredients., Cover and simmer gently for 30 minutes.

title: One Step Cream Sauce
directions: Measure cold milk into saucepan., Thoroughly blend in flour, salt and pepper., Add butter and bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring constantly., Boil 1 minute., Makes 1 cup cream sauce.

title: Celery Seed Salad Dressing
directions: Shake well and serve over fruit or lettuce salad.

title: Mom Bekkering'S Stuffing
directions: In large pan, over low heat, saute onion in 1/2 cup butter until soft, but not brown., Add cubed bread., Sprinkle salt, pepper, sage, thyme and parsley over bread and then stir well. Simmer uncovered until bread becomes slightly browned and crispy, stirring every few minutes., Add 1/4 cup butter, melted and mixed into 1/2 cup water; mix well., Remove from heat and serve or refrigerate to reheat in the microwave before serving., (Can be made the day before.)

title: Cranberry Cream Mold
directions: Heat orange juice to boiling; add gelatin., Stir until dissolved., Break up cranberry sauce with a fork., Add to jello. Add water and lemon juice., Chill until slightly thickened., Fold in the whipped topping and pour into a 5-cup mold., Chill until firm., Enjoy!

title: Meltaways
directions: Combine butter and 10 tablespoons powdered sugar., Beat 30 minutes with mixer., Add flour, vanilla and pecans., Drop by teaspoonful on greased cookie sheet., Bake at 300° about 20 minutes., Roll gently in powdered sugar while warm.

title: Sausage Bread
directions: Cook sausage and onions., Mix with cheeses and eggs, salt and pepper., Spread one pizza dough in the bottom of 9 x 13 inch baking pan., Top with sausage mix., Spread second tube of pizza dough on top of sausage mixture., Bake in 350° oven for 30 minutes.

title: Cranberry-Pear Pie
directions: Peel, core and slice pears (approximately 5 cups). In mixing bowl combine sugar, flour, orange peel and cinnamon., Add pears and cranberries; toss to coat., Set aside.

title: Cream Cheese Cookies
directions: Mix ingredients and chill overnight., Roll into small balls. Press middle of cookie and put cherry or walnut in hole., Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Barbecue
directions: Mix ingredients together and pour over meat., Bake at 350° for 3 to 4 hours., Remove bone and fat and mash., Serve on buns.

title: Cauliflower Salad
directions: Break or cut cauliflower into small bite size florets., Fry bacon to a crisp and crumble., Slice green peppers and cut into small pieces., Chop onions fine., Mix all ingredients, except Miracle Whip.

title: Britt Pruitt'S Hot Corn Bread
directions: Mix all ingredients in order., Pour into prepared pans and bake at 400° for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Lemon Thins
directions: Sift flour and baking powder., Cream sugar., Add jello and sugar., Cream well., Add egg and vanilla; beat well., Add flour to butter mixture., Mix until smooth., Cook on ungreased cookie sheet at 400° for 10 minutes.

title: Eggplant Casserole
directions: Boil eggplant; drain and mash well., Add eggs to canned milk; beat well., Add butter, grated cheese and onion., Turn into greased casserole.

title: Banana Pudding
directions: Prepare pudding with 3 cups of milk; fold in 1/2 of whipped cream., Reserve vanilla wafers and 1 banana., Arrange in layers of wafers and bananas., Spread 1/4 of pudding over wafers; top with banana slices., Place wafers around sides of dish., Cover and chill 3 hours., Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Corn Supreme Casserole
directions: Mix first 7 ingredients together., Pour into greased 8 x 12-inch pan., Spread sour cream over the top., Sprinkle with grated cheese., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes., Enjoy.

title: Southern Moon Pie
directions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Lightly grease a cookie sheet. To make cookie crust: In a large mixing bowl, cream together 1/2 cup butter or margarine and white sugar. Add egg, evaporated milk and vanilla. Mix well. In a separate bowl, mix together flour, salt, cocoa powder, baking soda and baking powder. Add flour mixture slowly to sugar mixture while stirring. Mix just until all ingredients are combined. Drop the dough into greased cookie sheet by rounded tablespoonfuls. Leave at least 3 inches in between each one; dough will spread as it bakes. Bake for 6 to 8 minutes, until firm when pressed with finger. Allow to cool at least 1 hour before filling.

title: Corn Casserole
directions: Melt margarine; add flour., Mix well., Add remaining ingredients., Put in large baking dish and cook in slow oven until thick., Serves 8 to 10.

title: Creamy Broccoli Soup
directions: Heat 2 cups water to boiling., Add broccoli, celery and onion. Cook until tender., Do not drain., Heat margarine until melted. Stir in flour until smooth., Add 1 1/2 cups water until boiling. Add cooked vegies, broth, bouillon, salt and pepper., Heat until just boiling., Stir in cream., Heat but do not boil.

title: Minestrone Soup
directions: Remove meat from bones used in making stock and add to stock. Saute in 2 Tbsp. oil: onion, garlic clove, celery stalks, carrot, raw potato, and zucchini. Stir until veggies glisten. Add stock along with: kidney beans, can of tomatoes, and tomato sauce. Simmer 30 minutes stirring often. Add 1/2 cup uncooked spaghetti broken into 1 inch pieces. Add salt, pepper, chili powder, oregano, and parsley. Simmer 20 minutes.

title: Chicken Kelly
directions: Marinate cubed cutlets in egg in refrigerator overnight (at least 4 hours)., Then mix in breadcrumbs; brown in skillet in margarine.

title: Bean Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients and set overnight.

title: French Peas
directions: In a saucepan, cook green onions and lettuce in oil over low heat for 5 minutes., Combine flour with broth., Add to lettuce mixture and stir until thickened., Put in the cooked peas, sliced water chestnuts and seasoning., Heat through and serve., Makes 4 servings.

title: Spinach Rolls
directions: Mix first five ingredients and spread on tortillas; roll up. Chill in refrigerator, then slice.

title: Corn Pudding
directions: Mix all together., Place in casserole dish., Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes., Sprinkle with cinnamon (optional).

title: Teriyaki Beef Stir-Fry
directions: Trim fat from beef., Cut into strips., Combine next 5 ingredients in an 8-inch square pan., Add steak to marinade; turn to coat., Cover and marinate in refrigerator 30 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Peanut Butter Bars
directions: Mix ingredients together except the chocolate chips and pack into a, 9 x 13 inch pan. Pack down the mix hard so they don't crumble. Either put chocolate chips on top and put it in warm oven to melt and spread or melt the chips and pour over the peanut butter mix. Let stand 6 hours to cool and cut.

title: Chocolate Banana Fizz
directions: Peel banana and cut into large pieces., In blender, combine all ingredients., Cover and blend until smooth., Makes 1 serving.

title: Cheese Strada(Breakfast-Brunch Meal)
directions: Trim crusts, if desired., Layer bread, cheese and butter., Mix remaining ingredients and pour over layers., Cover and put in refrigerator for overnight or 8 hours., Bake at 325° for 45 minutes or until firm., Let stand for 15 minutes., Serve for breakfast or brunch.

title: Carrot Cake
directions: In a mixing bowl, combine eggs, oil, buttermilk, sugar and vanilla; mix well., Combine flour, cinnamon, baking soda and salt; stir into egg mixture., Stir in pineapple, carrots, raisins, nuts and coconut., Pour into a greased and floured 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan., Bake at 350° for 50 to 55 minutes, or until cake tests done., Do not overbake., Remove to a wire rack to cool.

title: Chicken-Potato Soup
directions: Melt oleo in deep saucepan., Add onion; cook until tender but not brown., Stir in chicken broth; add chicken and potatoes. Cover., Cook for 25 minutes or until potatoes are tender., Add milk; mash 1 or 2 pieces of potato with spoon., Stir well.

title: Vanilla Wafer Cake
directions: Cream butter and sugar together. Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition. Add milk and vanilla. Mix well. Add pecans, coconut and vanilla wafers. Mix well.
