Bake in well-greased and floured 12 x 9 x 2-inch pan or a tube pan for 1 hour at 350°. Serve plain or with whipped cream.

title: Microwave Dog Biscuits
directions: Place flour into bowl., Add egg and enough broth to moisten flour., Add remaining ingredients., Roll dough into a ball. Working on a floured surface, break off pieces of dough to form rings and rolls., Place on microwaveable dish., Bake on High for 10 minutes, until firm., Let them cool and harden before giving them to the dog., Yields 20 biscuits.

title: Sauerbraten (Sour Beef Pot Roast)
directions: Place meat, vinegar, spices and onion in bowl and refrigerate overnight, longer if need be., Place in iron pot and brown meat on all side., Meanwhile, strain vinegar and water and pour over brown roast and proceed to cook the same as pot roast (2 to 3 hours). Take meat out and keep warm., Add raisins and gingersnaps in 8 pot liquid., Gingersnaps will thicken the gravy., Add more crackers if you like a thicker gravy., Slice meat and serve with the gravy. Potato Rolls or noodles and red cabbage.

title: Turtles
directions: Melt caramels with 3 tablespoons water in a double boiler. Add pecans and stir., Drop this on buttered cookie sheet and put a toothpick in each one., Place in freezer., Melt Hershey bar and paraffin in double boiler., Dip candy in chocolate., Place on wax paper and remove toothpick., Makes 2 dozen.

title: Pecan Chiffon Pie(A Light Airy Take-Off Of The Real Thing.)
directions: Put to soak the gelatin and water., Meantime, combine in saucepan or double boiler the slightly beaten egg yolks, salt, milk and 1 cup of the brown sugar and cook slowly, stirring constantly, until thickened., When done, remove and stir in soaked gelatin and vanilla., Set aside to thicken only slightly while toasting until lightly browned in skillet the pecans and oleo., Make meringue using stiffly beaten egg whites and 1/4 cup brown sugar, beaten into whites., Now gently fold together the custard, meringue and 1/4 cup toasted pecans (cooled)., Pour into 9-inch pie shell and top with remaining 1/2 cup toasted pecans., Chill until set., Serve plain or with whipped cream.

title: Seafood Hot Crab Dip
directions: Beat cream cheese until smooth., Blend in remaining ingredients except almonds, paprika and crackers., Spread mix into 9-inch pie plate., Top with almonds and sprinkle with paprika. Bake at 375° for 20 minutes., Serve with crackers.

title: Sour Cream Banana Cake
directions: Cream shortening and sugar., Add eggs and vanilla; blend thoroughly., Combine flour, baking powder, soda and salt., Add to creamed mixture alternately with sour cream, ending with dry ingredients., Add bananas and nuts, mixing until just blended. Bake in a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan for 40 to 45 minutes., Cool and frost.

title: Cornflake Cookies
directions: Sift together flour, soda, salt and baking powder and set aside., Cream shortening and add sugar together and gradually beat until light., Add eggs and vanilla., Combine dry ingredients and creamed mixture., Add coconut and cornflakes., Drop by small teaspoon on greased sheet 1 1/2 inches apart., Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes or until delicately brown.

title: Parmesan Chicken
directions: Mix together Miracle Whip, cheese and oregano. Spoon mixture over chicken breasts. Bake at 375° for 30 minutes, covered and 15 minutes uncovered or until tender.

title: Coconut Pie(Make In Blender)
directions: Blend in blender for 3 minutes., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Potato Candy
directions: Cook potato and mash., In a large mixing bowl, blend potato and sugar together., Roll out on waxed paper. Spread peanut butter on this mixture and roll up in jelly roll fashion., Cut in pieces.

title: German Chocolate Cake
directions: Melt, chocolate, in, 1/2, cup, of boiling water (cool). Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy., Add egg yolks, one, at a, time,, beating after each., Add vanilla and melted chocolate and, mix, until, blended., Sift flour with salt and soda., Add sifted dry ingredients alternating with buttermilk, beating, after each, addition, until, batter is smooth., Fold stiffly, beaten egg, whites., Pour batter into an 8 or 9-inch round cake, pan, lined on bottom with paper., Bake in moderate oven (350°) for 35 to 40 minutes or until it springs back when lightly touched.

title: Angel Biscuits
directions: Mix flour, baking powder, salt, soda and sugar., Cut in vegetable shortening., Add yeast cake, dissolved in lukewarm water and buttermilk., Mix with large spoon until flour mix is moist. Keep covered bowl in refrigerator until ready to use., Take out amount needed., Roll on floured board to 1/2-inch thick., Cut and bake at 400° until brown., Makes about 5 dozen., Keeps a few weeks in refrigerator.

title: Potato Dumplings
directions: Grate potatoes; add eggs, salt and pepper., Add flour and bread crumbs., Make into dumplings using 2 teaspoons., Drop into salted, boiling water and cover., Cook until they float., Drain carefully and transfer to soup or serve with gravy and meat.

title: Pineapple Upside-Down Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350° (325° if using glass pan)., Fill baking dish (8 x 8 x 2-inches) with stick of butter already melted. Sprinkle in brown sugar until 1/4-inch high., Place pineapple in an arrangement with cherries., Set to one side.

title: Dirt Pudding
directions: Put half in bottom, rest on top.

title: Creamy Pralines
directions: Stir and mix well., Pour into saucepan., When mixture begins to boil, add pecans., Let cook until it reaches soft ball stage. Beat until it begins to thicken., Drop by spoon on waxed paper. Delicious!

title: Pasta Primavera
directions: In 4-quart saucepan, combine soup, milk, cheese, garlic powder and pepper., Add broccoli and carrot., Heat to boiling, stirring occasionally., Cover and cook over low heat 5 minutes or until vegetables are tender, stirring occasionally., Add spaghetti. Heat through, stirring occasionally., Serves 3 to 4.

title: Corn Salad
directions: Combine vegetables, mixing lightly., Combine remaining ingredients; mix well., Taste to see if it's sweet enough., Pour over vegetables., Put in covered dish., Put in refrigerator., Let stand overnight.

title: Spanish Rice
directions: In large frying pan, add ingredients in order given. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer, covered, for 20 to 30 minutes or until rice is tender.

title: Ice Cream Soda
directions: In the bottom of a tall soda glass, stir the half and half together with the chocolate syrup., Add about 4 ounces of club soda., Drop in the scoop of ice cream and fill the glass to the top with additional club soda., Serve with a long straw and a long handled spoon., Makes 1 soda.

title: Seafood Party Spread
directions: Blend together ingredients, then gently add 1 package "crab" or "lobster"., Add shredded cheese., Serve with "fancy" crackers.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
directions: Combine crust ingredients; press into a 9-inch pie plate. Bake at 375° for 10 minutes., Cool.

title: Quick Shepherd'S Pie
directions: Cook and mash potatoes with butter and milk or prepared potato mix with butter and milk., Brown ground beef in skillet., Drain and pour meat into baking dish., Cover the beef with mashed potato mixture, then coat mashed potatoes with creamed corn., Bake 20 minutes at 350° covered with foil., Remove foil and serve.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
directions: Peel potatoes, slice thin and place 1/3 of slices in bottom of 2-quart casserole dish., Dot with 1/3 of butter., Season with salt and pepper., Place thin onion slices on top., Sprinkle flour over onions and cover with 4 slices of cheese., Add the second layer the same as the first., Do the third layer the same., Top with cheese., Bake at 350° for 1 hour. Serve hot., Serves 8.

title: Cinnamon Swirl Raisin Bread
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Mix 3 cups flour, 1/2 cup sugar, salt and yeast in large bowl., Heat water and oil until very warm (120° to 130°); stir into flour mixture., Stir in eggs., Beat until smooth. Mix in enough remaining flour to make dough easy to handle., Turn dough onto lightly floured surface., Gently roll in flour to coat. Knead 8 to 10 times until smooth., Place in greased bowl; turn greased side up., Cover and let rise in warm place 1 hour or doubled in size., Grease 2 loaf pans (9 x 5 x 3)., Punch dough down; divide in half., Knead 1/2 cup raisins into each half., Roll out 18 x 9-inches; brush 1 tablespoon oil over rectangles.	Mix 1/2 cup sugar and the cinnamon., Sprinkle each rectangle with 1/2 of mixture., Roll up each rectangle, beginning at 9-inch side. Pinch edge of dough into roll to seal., Press ends with edge of hand to seal., Fold ends under loaf. Place loaves, seam side down in pans., Brush oil over loaves. Cover, let rise in warm place about 1 hour or until double., Move oven rack to lowest position. Bake 30 to 35 minutes or until loaves are deep golden brown or sounds hollow when tapped.	Remove from pans to wire rack to cool. Brush butter over loaves.

title: Apple Pecan Cake
directions: Beat the sugar, oil and eggs until well blended., Add the remaining ingredients., Cook for 1 hour and 20 minutes at 325° in an aluminum foil lined pan.

title: Shrimp Creole
directions: In a stew pan, add water, salt, bay leaf and lemon., Bring to boil, then add shrimp., Cover and cook 5 minutes., Drain and reserve liquid.

title: Apple Dessert Cake
directions: In a bowl, combine the apples and sugar; let this sit until the sugar is dissolved into the apples., Add remaining ingredients., Bake in 8-inch pan 30 minutes at 400° oven., Let cool slightly then put topping on cake.

title: Corn-Sausage Chowder
directions: Cook sausage and onion in large kettle; brown and drain., Add potato, salt, marjoram and water., Simmer until potatoes are cooked, about 15 minutes., Add corn and milk., Heat through and serve., Add pepper to taste.

title: Brownies
directions: Beat eggs in medium bowl., Gradually add sugar and vanilla. Beat well and then blend in butter., Combine flour and cocoa; gradually add to egg mixture until well blended., Spread into a well-greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan., Bake for 30 to 35 minutes at 350°., Cool in pan.

title: Potato Salad
directions: Boil potatoes until almost done; remove them and add pepper, onion and celery., Mix together mayonnaise, mustard and pickle relish., Add to potatoes; salt to taste and sprinkle top with paprika.

title: Rumaki
directions: Cut chicken livers in half., Pour teriyaki sauce over chicken livers and water chestnuts in large bowl; refrigerate about 4 hours., Drain., Cut bacon slices in half., Wrap a piece of liver and a piece of water chestnut in each slice of bacon., Secure with toothpick., Roll in brown sugar., Bake in oven at 350° for about 20 minutes., Turn oven to broil for about 10 minutes, turning occasionally., Serve with hot sauce.

title: Prune Cake
directions: Cream sugar, eggs and oil., Add sifted flour (save 1/2 cup to coat nuts)., Add spices and prunes. Mix., Add nuts., Bake in greased, floured tube pan for 1 hour at 350°.

title: Impossible Pie
directions: Mix butter, eggs, flour and sugar., Add milk, coconut and vanilla., Pour in ungreased pie pan., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Candied Apples
directions: Combine sugar, water and cinnamon Imperials in a large saucepan., Bring to a boil and simmer until Imperials dissolve. Add the apples, a quart at a time, and cook until firm, but done. Pour remaining syrup over cooked apples.

title: Buttered Rum Sauce
directions: Beat together the first 3 ingredients and freeze.

title: Onion Roasted Potatoes
directions: Preheat oven to 450°., In large bowl, coat potatoes with oil, then add soup mix and mix well., Empty potatoes into shallow baking or roasting pan., Bake, stirring occasionally, 40 minutes or until potatoes are tender and golden brown., Makes 8 servings.

title: Fruit Pizza
directions: Press out cookie dough into a well-greased round or square cookie sheet., Bake for approximately 8 minutes at temperature indicated on cookie dough package., Cool., Mix cream cheese, sugar and Cool Whip., Spread on cooled dough., Top with fruit.

title: Baked Beans And Ground Beef
directions: Brown meat and drain., Mix baked beans, ketchup, onion, mustard, brown, sugar,, garlic powder and Worcestershire., Top with bacon., Place, in, greased, 3 quart casserole., Cover and bake at 300° for 2 to 2 1/2 hours., Serves 8.

title: Hardtack Candy(Important:  Use A Wooden Spoon And Do Not Scrape Side Of Pan.)
directions: Mix sugar, Karo syrup and water well; boil to hard crack stage (300°)., Do not stir while boiling., Remove from heat; add flavoring oil and coloring., Stir until mixed., Pour into well buttered 8-inch square pan., Cool for a few minutes and score with a metal spatula., After it hardens enough, remove from pan, when cooled enough to touch., Crack with a knife handle., After cracked and cooled completely, shake small amount of powdered sugar on candy and toss around., Makes 1 pound.

title: Sweet And Sour Green Beans
directions: Drain green beans., Rinse well., Pour into saucepan., Add sugar and vinegar., In separate pan, fry bacon and onion., Add to green bean mixture and cook for 20 minutes.

title: Chocolate Chess Pie
directions: Mix well and pour in uncooked pie shell., Cook 45 minutes at 325°.

title: Peach And Melon Salad
directions: Toss fruit with juices, almonds and sugar., Cover and chill at least 3 hours., Serves 6.

title: Spinach Bake
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Mix spinach, beaten eggs, soup, cheese and dressing., Spoon spinach mixture into 8-inch square baking dish. Top with combined bread crumbs and margarine., Bake 45 to 55 minutes., Makes 6 servings., Delicious!

title: Beet And Carrot Bread
directions: Mix all together., Pour into greased and floured bread pans (1 pan for large loaf or 2 medium loaves)., Bake at 350°, for 1 hour.

title: Scalloped Corn
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Grease 1-quart casserole., Set aside. In 1-quart saucepan, melt 2 tablespoons butter., Add onion and celery., Cook and stir over medium heat until tender., Stir in flour, salt and pepper., Blend in evaporated milk., Cook and stir until mixture just thickens., Stir in corn and egg., Pour into prepared casserole., Set aside.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
directions: *Blended Oatmeal:, Measure and blend in a blender to a fine powder.

title: French Silk Pie
directions: Cream butter and add sugar gradually, creaming well., Blend in melted and cooled chocolate, then vanilla., Add 1 egg at a time, beating for 5 minutes after each addition., Turn into pie shell. Chill 1 to 2 hours., May be topped with whipped cream and nuts, if desired.

title: Toasted Coconut Pie
directions: Thoroughly combine eggs, sugar, margarine, lemon juice and vanilla. Stir in coconut and pour into unbaked pie crust., Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Spinach Souffle
directions: Cook spinach; drain well. Mix soup and sour cream; let set. Add crumbs soaked in melted butter to sour cream mixture., Mix in spinach and place in casserole., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

title: Pumpkin Pie Dessert
directions: Combine graham cracker crumbs, 1 cup sugar and melted margarine; mix well., Press into a 9 x 13-inch baking dish., Set aside., Combine eggs, 3/4 cup sugar and cream cheese; beat with electric mixer until light and fluffy., Pour over crumbs and bake at 350° for 20 minutes., Cool.

title: Butterscotch Brownies
directions: In heavy, pan,	put, in, light	brown sugar and oleo or butter., Heat, until mixed and melted., Stir often., Set aside to cool, then add vanilla and eggs., Add flour and salt., Mix; add nuts.

title: Fruit Cobbler
directions: Melt stick of butter in a casserole., Mix dry ingredients. Add milk to dry ingredients and pour over butter in casserole dish., Empty can of fruit on top and press in with a spoon., Bake at 350° for about 1 hour or until golden on top and done in center.

title: Meringue Snowmen
directions: Cover cookie sheet with heavy brown paper., Place egg whites in bowl., Add cream of tartar and beat at high speed until foamy. Gradually beat in sugar a tablespoonful at a time., Turn off mixer occasionally and scrape sides of bowl., Continue beating at high speed until stiff and glossy, about 6 or 7 minutes., For each snowman, drop two rounded tablespoonfuls of meringue, just touching each other, on brown paper; then add rounded teaspoonful of meringue at top for head., Place pretzel stick arms and cinnamon candy eyes, mouth and buttons on each snowman., Bake at 275° for 45 minutes., Turn off heat and leave snowmen in oven for one hour.

title: Scalded Corn Cakes
directions: Bring water to a boil; gradually mix meal with water., Set in refrigerator for 20 minutes., Deep fry at 350° for 5 minutes in skillet with 1-inch of fat.

title: Fudge Pie
directions: Beat eggs lightly., Melt butter and mix together with the dry ingredients., Add eggs., Pour in unbaked pie shell., Bake at 325° for approximately 30 minutes., Check with a toothpick.

title: Oven Fried Chicken
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Wash chicken and leave wet., (Chicken may be skinned, if desired.), Combine biscuit mix, paprika, salt and pepper in a large plastic bag., Place chicken in bag and shake until chicken pieces are evenly coated., Set aside.

title: Three Cheese Chicken Bake
directions: Cook noodles., Drain well., In saucepan, cook onions and pepper in small amount of water until tender., Drain., Add soup and mushrooms, pimiento, milk and basil to vegetables., Layer 1/2 of noodles, 1/2 mix, chicken and cheeses., Repeat., Bake in covered casserole in 350° oven for 45 minutes.

title: Oriental Pork
directions: Trim excess fat from pork., Combine egg, 1/4 cup cornstarch, flour, 1/4 cup chicken broth and 1/2 teaspoon salt (salt optional). Beat until smooth., Pour salad oil 1-inch deep in electric skillet. Heat to 375°., Dip pork in batter and fry 5 to 6 minutes or until golden.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Lightly brown rice in oil., Add onions and bell pepper., Cook 1 minute longer, being careful not to brown rice too much., Add chicken and broth; bring to a boil and cook until most of liquid is absorbed., Lower heat; cover and cook until rice is tender. Arrange cheese on top of rice., Cover and allow cheese to melt. Serves 4.

title: Chicken And Cheese Casserole
directions: Mix and bake until cheese melts at 350°.

title: Ultimate Brownies
directions: Melt chocolate and butter., Cream sugar and eggs., Add vanilla and salt., Add chocolate., Add flour., Add rest of ingredients and bake in 9 x 13-inch greased pan., Bake at 350° about 35 to 40 minutes or until done.

title: Buttery Sherry Bundt Cake
directions: Combine cake mix and pudding mix with oil, sherry wine, eggs and flavoring., Beat 8 minutes., Pour half of batter in well-greased Bundt pan which has been sprinkled with cinnamon, sugar and nut mixture., Then put rest of mixture on batter, then rest of batter., Bake at 50 to 60 minutes at 350°., When done, cool in pan on wire rack; cool before removing from pan.

title: Broccoli Supreme
directions: Cook and drain broccoli., Mix thoroughly with remaining ingredients., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes., Can also be microwaved on High for 10 to 12 minutes or until rice is tender.

title: Fudge Marble Bundt Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°; grease and flour Bundt pan., Combine yellow part of cake mix and rest of ingredients., Mix on low until moistened., Mix at high power for 2 to 2 1/2 minutes., Pour into a greased and floured Bundt pan, reserving 1/4 of batter., Mix reserved batter with chocolate mix and drop by tablespoonfuls on top of yellow batter., Swirl chocolate batter through yellow with butter knife, not touching bottom of pan., Bake in a 350° oven for 45 to 50 minutes or until cake springs back when touched on top or toothpick inserted comes out clean., Cool in pan for 20 minutes, then invert onto serving platter and cool completely.

title: Vegetable Casserole
directions: Mix soup and sour cream until smooth. Add all the rest of the ingredients and mix., Put in casserole and cover with topping.

title: Mississippi Mud Pie
directions: Mix together flour, oleo and pecans. Press into 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes. Let cool., Mix together cream cheese, powdered sugar and 1 cup Cool Whip. Spread over crust. Mix chocolate with 2 cups milk., Spread over cream cheese mixture. Mix vanilla pudding with 2 cups milk. Spread over chocolate pudding. Top with large Cool Whip. Grate Hershey bar on top. Chill at least 3 hours before serving.

title: Gnocchi (Potato Dumpling)
directions: Cook potatoes; drain and mash., Let the potatoes cool., Add the egg and mix well., Add all flour until stiff enough to handle without sticking.

title: Cocktail Sauce
directions: Mix all ingredients. Put in frig to cool.

title: Hot Mexican Dip
directions: Cook and drain ground beef., Add remaining ingredients and simmer until cheese is melted., Serve with Tostitos chips.

title: Stir-Fried Beef
directions: Fry beef in oil with onion; add vegetables and saute., Stir in cornstarch, tomato sauce, sugar, ginger, mushrooms and soy sauce. Cook until thick., Serve over rice.

title: Banana Nut Bread
directions: Mash bananas., Dump everything on top., Stir until moist. Bake in loaf pan at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Jessica And Mom'S Cornbread
directions: Stir all dry ingredients together, then add egg and stir into mixture., Add oil and stir again until well mixed., Preheat oven to 425°., Add milk to mixture, slowly, while stirring, until batter is slightly thick and not too thin., Pour into well-greased cast-iron skillet and bake at 425° until a knife, inserted in the middle, comes out clean.

title: Chess Bars
directions: Mix cake mix, 1 egg and butter and work into a dry batter. Press mixture into a 9 x 13-inch baking dish., Mix the remaining eggs, cream cheese, powdered sugar and vanilla together., Pour over pressed mixture., Bake at 350° for 35 minutes., Center will stay soft., Do not overcook., Cut into squares of desired size.

title: Frosted Strawberry Mold
directions: Dissolve jello in boiling water., Add frozen strawberries. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan and chill to set., Place cream cheese in bowl; cream., Add whipped cream, marshmallows and powdered sugar., Spread on jello.

title: Tuna Spread
directions: Mix all ingredients and serve with small knife and crackers. Serves 8.

title: Ribbon Jello Salad
directions: 1st Layer:, Mix, 1, package Jell-O, 1 cup boiling water and add 1/2 cup cold water., Chill until firm.

title: Sweet Potato Biscuits
directions: Mix flour, sugar, baking powder, salt and nutmeg., Mix sweet potatoes, milk and oil. Stir into flour mixture just to moisten. Turn onto floured surface with floured hands., Knead gently about 6 strokes., Roll out about 1/2-inch thick. Cut with biscuit cutter. Bake at 400° about 10 to 12 minutes. Serve hot with butter and honey.

title: Brownies
directions: Melt chocolate, butter and margarine; cool thoroughly., Then add sugar, eggs and vanilla; stir lightly, but don't beat., Add flour and nuts., Bake in 9 x 13-inch greased and floured pan at 350° for 20 minutes only., Sprinkle with powdered sugar while warm.

title: Pineapple Casserole
directions: Mix pineapple chunks, sugar and Cheddar cheese and place in a baking dish. Then mix pineapple juice, flour and margarine. Pour this mixture over pineapple. Sprinkle crushed Ritz crackers over pineapple. Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Chocolate Chip Cheesecake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Grease a 10-inch spring-form pan (or can use an 8-inch square casserole dish)., Combine cake mix and oil in large bowl; mix well., Press mixture into bottom of pan. Bake 22 to 25 minutes or until set., Remove from oven., Increase oven temperature to 400°.

title: Campfire Pineapple Upside Down Cakes(A Girl Scout Camp Favorite)
directions: Prepare cake mix as directed on box. Prepare tuna can by removing paper label, and washing thoroughly. Place 1 pat of butter in bottom of can. Add 1 Tbsp. brown sugar, 1 pineapple ring and a little of the juice. Place 2 Tbsp. of the cake batter on top of pineapple ring. Cover can tightly with aluminum foil. Bake in campfire coals for about 15 minutes. Each can serves one person.

title: Cocktail Meatballs
directions: Combine and simmer the chili sauce, 1/4 cup finely grated onion and the cranberry sauce., Combine ground beef and onion and make into 1-inch meatballs., Place in 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Pour sauce over the meatballs., Bake in 350° oven for 1 hour.

title: Cream Cheese Ball
directions: Mix all ingredients together, holding out 1 cup pecans., Roll into ball and refrigerate until cool and roll in remaining pecans.

title: Cranberry Relish
directions: Grind cranberries., Remove pulp and juice of oranges., Combine all ingredients., Makes about 1-quart., Keeps 1 to 2 weeks refrigerated.

title: Party Mix
directions: Melt oleo and all spices., Pour over dry mix; spread on cookie sheet., Bake at 250° for 1 hour., Stir every 15 minutes., Will fill 2 cookie sheets.

title: Lemon Bars
directions: Mix ingredients., Pat in an 8 x 8-inch baking pan., Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.

title: Sausage Balls
directions: Mix all ingredients together and form into small balls., Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Finger Jello
directions: Mix all together. When dissolved, pour into a 9 x 13 pan. When set, cut in squares.

title: Mayonnaise Rolls
directions: Preheat oven to 450°., In a mixing bowl, mix all the ingredients together., Put them in a well-greased muffin pan and bake until golden brown., Makes about 1 dozen.

title: Polish Sausage Dinner
directions: Peel and slice potatoes; core cabbage and slice in 1/2-inch pieces., Peel and slice onions; slice Polish sausage., Layer potatoes, onions, cabbage, then Polish sausage., Add another layer of everything, but end with cabbage this time., Salt and pepper as you later., Cook on High in microwave 20 minutes., Let set 20 minutes., Serve.

title: Banana Bread
directions: Mix well., Bake in 350° oven in well-greased and floured pans.

title: Pennsylvania Dutch Salad
directions: Clean spinach; chop coarsely and chill., Crumble bacon. Combine spinach, lettuce and onion in salad bowl., Sprinkle with egg and bacon bits., Toss with dressing and serve.

title: Dreamy Creamy Pie
directions: Mix cream cheese and powdered sugar in a large bowl until smooth and creamy., Add peanut butter and milk., Mix well., Add whipped topping., Mix well., Pour over pie crust., Refrigerate several hours.

title: Chicken Waldorf
directions: In large bowl, stir together mayonnaise, mustard and brown sugar., Fold in cubed chicken, apples, celery, walnuts and raisins; mix well., Apply lid and refrigerate for 2 to 6 hours.

title: Easy Tortilla Soup
directions: In saucepot, bring 3 cups water, dry vegetable soup mix and mixed vegetables to boil. Reduce heat and simmer, partially covered, for 8 minutes more. Add diced tomatoes. Cook 2 minutes more. Stir in minced cilantro. Garnish with crushed tortilla chips, sliced scallions and dollop of sour cream.

title: Cream Cheese Pound Cake
directions: Combine oleo, butter, cream cheese and sugar., Beat well; add salt and vanilla., Add eggs one at a time, beating well after each addition., Add flour and mix well., Pour batter into a greased and floured 10-inch tube pan., Place in a cold oven and set at 325°. Bake for 1 1/2 hours or until done., Cool in pan.

title: Divinity
directions: In saucepan combine sugar, corn syrup, salt, and 1.2 c. of water., Cook to hard boil stage (260 degrees), boiling about 20 minutes stirring until sugar dissolves., Meanwhile, beat the egg whites until they form stiff peaks., Pour syrup over stiff egg whites, beating at high speed with an electric mixer., Add vanilla and beat until the candy hold it's shape., Spoon onto waxed paper. Makes 40 pieces.

title: Strawberry Truffle
directions: Mix first 3 ingredients and chill., Add 12 ounce Cool Whip to pudding mixture after chilling., Layer starting with pudding mix, angel food cake, strawberries (frozen and fresh) and end with pudding mix., If not enough pudding mix, top with Cool Whip. Refrigerate.

title: Spinach Balls
directions: In large bowl, combine all ingredients; mix well., Shape into 1-inch balls and place on greased baking pan., Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes., Serve hot.

title: Sausage Dressing
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Use enough chicken broth to make mixture juicy., Pour into baking pan., Bake at 350° until brown.

title: Pecan Roll
directions: Combine the first 3 ingredients; mix with hands., Shape mixture into 5 (4 x 1-inch) rolls (mixture will be dry)., Combine caramels and water; melt in microwave or double boiler., Dip rolls in melted caramels; roll each in pecans., Chill for at least 1 hour before cutting in slices.

title: Sweet And Sour Pork Kabobs
directions: In a saucepan, cook carrots, covered, in a small amount of boiling water for 8 minutes; drain well., Drain pineapple, reserving juice., Cut pineapple slices into quarters; set aside.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Mix crumbs with 2 tablespoons of butter., Whisk egg, mayonnaise and soup., Then mix in broccoli, onion and cheese., Sprinkle with bread crumbs., Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

title: Cottage Lasagna(Scaled For 8 Servings)
directions: Brown beef in skillet over medium heat, tossing lightly with fork; drain off, fat., Stir, in, spaghetti	sauce, tomato sauce, tomato paste and, Parmesan cheese.	Cover and simmer 10 minutes. Cook noodles; drain and rinse in cold water., In a 7 x 11 x 2-inch baking dish spread 1/3 of the sauce, then 1/2 of the noodles, 1/2 of the cottage cheese and 1/2 of the parsley. Repeat the last step., Cover, with the remainder of the sauce. Cut the Mozzarella cheese into, strips and arrange them on the top., Bake at 350° for 30	minutes, or, until cheese melts and the sauce is bubbly.

title: Dr.  Pepper Glaze
directions: Mix Dr., Pepper and brown sugar., Place ham in baking pan basting frequently with sauce., You can still use your cloves or cherries for decor.

title: Harvest Loaf Cake
directions: Cream the butter with sugar., Mix in eggs and pumpkin., Sift flour with spices and salt., Add to first mixture., Stir in 1/2 cup of nuts and the chocolate chips., Pour into buttered 9 x 5-inch loaf pan., Sprinkle with 1/4 cup of nuts., Bake at 350° for 65 to 75 minutes.

title: Brown'S Corn Chowder
directions: Fry bacon in pan until almost done. Add onions and celery, and saute until lightly browned. Transfer to a cooking pot. Add cream-style corn, kernel corn, butter, and broth. Add carrots and potatoes. Cook for about 15 minutes. Mix together flour and a little water to form a paste. Add milk and flour paste. You might want to add more flour paste, depending on how thick you like your chowder. Simmer for 30 minutes or until you are ready to eat. Add salt and pepper to taste.

title: Crab Chowder
directions: Heat clam juice, sherry, brandy, shallots, garlic, parsley stems and bay leaves in large saucepan over high heat to boiling. Reduce heat to low; simmer uncovered 15 minutes, skimming surface as necessary., Strain through sieve lined with double thickness of dampened cheesecloth; keep warm., Boil potatoes in lightly salted water until tender, 5 to 8 minutes., Drain., Cook bacon in a large heavy saucepan over medium heat until fat is rendered and bacon is crisp., Add onions and celery; saute, stirring frequently, until tender., Add thyme, saute 1 minute., Stir in flour; cook, stirring constantly, over low heat 5 minutes., Do not brown flour., Gradually stir clam broth into roux over low heat. Heat to boiling over high heat., Reduce heat to low; simmer uncovered 20 minutes, skimming surface as needed., Stir in cream and potatoes; heat to boiling., Season to taste with salt if necessary and enough white pepper and red pepper sauce to give chowder a good peppery taste., Just before serving, stir in crabmeat., Heat until crab is hot., Ladle chowder into warmed individual soup bowls and garnish with chopped parsley.

title: Pepper Relish
directions: Grind all vegetables together; add 1/2 cup salt., Let stand at least 4 hours, then drain., Allow sugar and vinegar to come to a boil., Add spices and then the relish mixture., Boil on low heat 10 minutes., Jar and seal.

title: Pork Chops And Potatoes
directions: Brown chops well on both sides., In 2-quart Pyrex, layer potato rounds, onion rings, mushrooms and mushroom soup., Repeat another layer of each ingredient., Add about 1/4 of a soup can of water to mixture., Place chops on top of potato mixture and sprinkle with paprika., Bake in a preheated oven at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour until chops are completely cooked., Season to taste.

title: Instant Hot Chocolate
directions: Mix ingredients., Fill cup almost half full with mix and add very hot or boiling water.

title: Chicken Chianti
directions: Remove and discard visible fat from chicken., Cut meat into 1 1/2-inch cubes and reserve., Heat oil in large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat., Add mushrooms and saute until lightly browned., Remove with slotted spoon and set aside.

title: Banana Split Pie
directions: Combine, the, graham, cracker, crumbs,	1, stick melted margarine, and, 4, tablespoons, confectioners sugar., Shape in bottom of a large flat dish., Combine the 2 cups confectioners sugar, eggs and 2 sticks margarine and cream together., Spread over, graham, cracker mixture., Cut bananas and put over cream mixture., Put, crushed, pineapple over bananas., Top with Cool Whip and decorate with nuts and cherries.

title: Chocolate Cheese Cake
directions: In large bowl, combine cream cheese and sugar; beat well. Blend in cocoa., Add eggs and vanilla; blend well., Blend in whipped cream., Pour into crust., Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes; cool to room temperature., Cover and chill for several hours., Top with cherry pie filling before serving.

title: Classic Fettuccine Alfredo
directions: Prepare and cook dry fettuccine in large pot of boiling salted water, 6 to 8 minutes just until al dente (tender yet firm to taste); remove from heat., Drain well; return to dry pot., Place butter and cream in large, heavy skillet over medium-low heat. Cook and stir until butter melts and mixture bubbles., Cook and stir 2 minutes more., Stir in salt, pepper and nutmeg., Remove from heat., Gradually stir in cheese until thoroughly blended and smooth., Return briefly to heat to completely blend cheese, if necessary., (Do not let sauce bubble or cheese will become lumpy and tough.)

title: Pineapple Casserole
directions: Mix pineapple, cheese, sugar and flour; pour into casserole dish., Spread crushed crackers on mixture; pour melted butter on top., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Creamy Chocolate Pie
directions: Prepare, instant, pudding as directed on package, using only 1 cup milk., Blend in 1 1/2 cups thawed Cool Whip and 1/4 cup chopped, nuts., Spoon, into, a, cooled,, baked pie shell. Garnish with, 1/2, cup, Cool, Whip., Sprinkle with additional nuts, if desired., Chill at least 1 hour before serving.

title: Barbecue
directions: Cook pork and beef in water until fork-tender; shred., Add catsup, pickle relish, Worcestershire and paprika to meat., Add just enough broth to desired consistency., Makes 24 servings.

title: Treasured Macadamia Wreath Cookies
directions: Mix in, order, given., Fill cookie press using smallest star plate., Shape, into, wreaths, on ungreased baking sheets. Bake at 325° for, about 10 minutes, watching closely so cookie will not be too brown., When, cool,, you, may wish to ice them with Confectioners Sugar, Icing and decorate with red hots for holly berries., Makes about 180 wreaths.

title: Golden Capped Tomatoes
directions: Cut tomatoes in half., Place cut side up in a shallow baking dish., Add salt and pepper., Combine remaining ingredients. Spread a portion on top of each tomato., Bake at 400° for 15 minutes.

title: Cornbread
directions: Mix and sift together first 5 ingredients., Add milk, egg and shortening., Bake in shallow buttered 8 x 8-inch pan at 425° for 20 minutes., Can bake in muffin pan if desired.

title: Turkey Sopa
directions: Saute onion, green pepper and celery in oil., Stir in soup, tomatoes and milk., Mix well., Stir in turkey., Layer turkey mixture, tortillas and cheese in a greased casserole dish., Begin with the turkey mixture and end with it., Top with cheese., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes., Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Toll House Pie
directions: Mix all ingredients and pour into an unbaked crust., Bake at 325° for 1 hour.

title: Brussels Sprouts With Cheese
directions: In a shallow 1-pint casserole, combine Brussels sprouts, bouillon, nutmeg and pepper., Sprinkle with cheese and bake at 425° for 10 to 12 minutes., Makes 2 servings.

title: Corn Dogs
directions: Cook franks until fully cooked., In deep fryer, add mixture of remaining ingredients and fry until golden brown., If mixture is too thick to dip, add water.

title: Simple Breakfast
directions: Line pan with English muffins., Mix eggs and sour cream; pour over muffins., Put cooked sausage on top of eggs., Put Cheddar cheese on top., Bake at 350°.

title: Fig Cake
directions: Beat eggs., Add sugar and whip until light and fluffy., Add oil., Stir baking soda into buttermilk., Alternately add flour and buttermilk mixture into batter., Add remaining ingredients., Pour into a greased Bundt pan and bake at 350° for 60 minutes or until tests done.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
directions: Mix sugar, milk, salt, syrup and water., Cook in iron skillet, for best results, until mixture forms soft ball in cold water. Remove from fire and add peanut butter., Stir until creamy and loses glazed look., Pour into lightly greased square cake tin. When almost cold, cut in squares of 1 inch.

title: Lime Jello Salad
directions: Dissolve jello in hot water., In bowl, beat cream cheese; stir in vanilla, oranges, pineapple, soda and nuts., Let it set., Then stir in Cool Whip., Place in 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan., To serve:, Cut in squares and place whipped cream on top.

title: Cream Pie
directions: Bake pie shell in moderately slow oven (325°) for 20 minutes or until firm and delicately browned.

title: Jumbo Raisin Cookies
directions: Add water to raisins., Boil for 5 minutes., Cool., Cream shortening with sugar., Add eggs and beat well., Add vanilla and cooled raisin mixture., Add nuts., Sift together flour, baking powder, soda, salt, cinnamon, nutmeg and allspice., Add to raisin mixture and blend., Drop by teaspoon on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 400° for 12 to 15 minutes., Makes 60.

title: Easy Pickled Beets
directions: Drain beets, then put them in a glass jar., Bring to boil sugar and vinegar, stir and add this mixture to jar., Refrigerate overnight.

title: Apple-Almond Coffeecakes
directions: Dissolve yeast and 1 tsp. sugar in warm water in large bowl. Let stand 5 minutes or until mixture is bubbly. (If yeast does not bubble, it is no longer active and dough will not rise.)

title: Cream Of Broccoli Soup
directions: Clean broccoli; cut in 1/2-inch pieces., Steam broccoli in 1/2 cup water until tender., Do not drain; set aside.

title: Spinach Balls
directions: Cook spinach in microwave and drain., Add eggs.

title: Egg Pie
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Separate dough into 4 rectangles., Place 2 rectangles in ungreased 8 or 9-inch square pan., Press over bottom and 1/2-inch up sides to form crust., Place cheese and bacon in bottom of pan., Beat eggs and milk., Pour over bacon and cheese. Separate remaining dough and arrange in triangles over egg mixture., Do not seal., Bake for 30 to 35 minutes or until golden brown and filling is set.

title: Marbled Haupia
directions: Cook haupia as directed on the back of the coconut milk can (uses cornstarch, salt, sugar and water)., Add vanilla after haupia is cooked., Take out 1 cup of cooked haupia and stir chocolate into it (more for extra dark chocolate)., Pour remaining haupia in a pan., Drizzle chocolate mixture over poured pan of white haupia., Pull a knife zigzag through the haupia to marbleize the chocolate., Refrigerate to set.

title: Mile High Biscuits
directions: Combine flour, sugar, baking powder, cream of tartar and salt in bowl., Cut in shortening until crumbly., Stir in egg and milk, mixing to form soft dough., Knead lightly on floured surface. Roll to 3/4 inch thickness., Cut with biscuit cutter., Place on baking sheet., Bake at 475° for 12 to 15 minutes or until light brown., Yields 12 biscuits.

title: Himmel Torte
directions: Beat eggs and sugar, mixing well. Add flour and baking powder. Add dates and nuts., Mix gently., Pour into greased 8 or 9-inch square pan., Bake at 350° about 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown., When cool, break into pieces., Mix in drained pineapple. Add whipped cream atop., Serve in sherbet glasses.

title: Mississippi Mud
directions: Cream oleo, eggs and sugar., Add flour, cocoa, vanilla and nuts or coconut., Bake in 9 x 13-inch greased pan in 350° oven for 40 minutes., Remove from oven and spread 1 jar marshmallow cream over top., Cool and frost.

title: 7-Minute Frosting
directions: Put all ingredients except flavoring in top of double boiler and cook for 7 minutes. Add flavoring.

title: Pumpkin Crumble Cake
directions: Mix all, together, and	spread in bottom of 9 x 13-inch cake pan.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: An herb-seasoned spread in the pan crust filled with a hearty chicken and vegetable mixture.

title: Nutty Fingers
directions: Mix and form into fingers or balls., Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes. Roll in 4x sugar.

title: Stuffed Quail Breast
directions: Marinate quail breast overnight in Italian dressing., Split breast on both sides of bone; stuff with the jalapeno pepper slices., Drizzle mixture of melted butter and picante sauce over each breast., Wrap 1 slice bacon around each quail; secure with toothpick., Wrap in heavy foil., Bake for approximately 2 hours at 300°., Best results when put on smoker or pit for 2 hours.

title: Vegetable Roll-Ups
directions: In a small bowl combine cream cheese, dill and garlic powder. Blend well., Spread about 1 tablespoon mixture on each tortilla. Top each with carrot, broccoli and onions., Roll up each tortilla and cut in half.

title: Broccoli Corn Bread
directions: Beat eggs., Add corn meal and softened margarine., Beat together., Add other ingredients., Mix well., Add salt and pepper. Bake in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan at 400° for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Japanese Fruit Cake
directions: Cream butter, and, sugar together., Add eggs, flour and add milk, and vanilla.	Divide batter into equal parts. Cook 2 plain layers., Into, the	other, half, put, raisins,, nuts and spices. Stir well.	Bake, 2 more layers., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Put together with Filling.

title: Baked Eggs
directions: Combine all ingredients and pour into a greased, 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan or dish., Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 15 minutes., Can be made ahead, put in a pan, covered with heavy foil and refrigerated up to 24 hours, then reheated to serve., Makes 12 servings.

title: Caramel Pie
directions: Combine butter, flour and sugar together., Beat egg; add milk. Add to creamed mixture., Cook in top of double boiler until thickened, stirring constantly., Cool; add vanilla., Pour into baked pastry shell and chill., Makes one (9-inch) pie; spread with whipped topping.

title: Very Rocky Road Fudge(Microwave)
directions: A grandmother is a lady who has no children of her own, so she likes other people's girls and boys., A grandfather is a man grandmother., He goes for walks with the boys and they talk about fishing and tractors and like that., Grandmothers don't have anything to do but be there.

title: Macaroni And Cheese
directions: In 3-quart saucepan, melt 1/4 cup butter., Stir in flour; cook until smooth, 1 minute., Stir in milk, cream cheese, salt, pepper and mustard; cook until thick, 3 to 4 minutes., Add Cheddar cheese and mix., Add elbow macaroni., Pour into 2-quart casserole. Mix bread crumbs and melted butter; sprinkle over top., Bake at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Italian Cheese Pie(Pastera)
directions: Mix well into Ricotta all ingredients., Turn into pie crust. Top with lattice effect., Sprinkle with nonpareils., Bake at 350° for 3/4 to 1 hour.

title: Sourdough Basic Starter With Yeast
directions: After feeding, wait 3 to 4 days before using.

title: Lite Fruit Salad
directions: Stir preserves first for easier mixing., Drain all canned fruits., Add pineapple, apple, diced peaches, halved cherries, marshmallows and pecans to apricot preserves, then fold in gently the mandarin orange slices., Oranges will break up easily. Refrigerate., Make up early in the day for softer marshmallows.

title: Spinach-Orange Salad
directions: In a medium bowl, combine the oil, marjoram, pepper and nutmeg. Add the orange sections, radishes and green onion; toss well. Cover and chill in the refrigerator for 2 to 3 hours, tossing occasionally., Wash the spinach., Pat it dry with paper towels and tear it into bite size pieces., Just before serving, add the spinach and vinegar to the chilled ingredients., Toss well.

title: Stuffed Zucchini
directions: Brown sausage., Wash zucchini; cut off ends., Do not peel. Cook in boiling, salted water for 5 minutes., Halve lengthwise and remove pulp with spoon., Combine pulp, bread crumbs, sausage, cheese, onion, parsley, salt, pepper and eggs., Fill zucchini shells and top with sauce and Mozzarella cheese., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Winter Squash Muffins
directions: Preheat oven to 400°., Grease muffin tins with a small amount of oil or use paper liners., Measure and sift flours, baking powder, salt, sugar and spices into a large bowl., Stir in corn meal or wheat germ.

title: Chicken Noodle Casserole
directions: Combine all ingredients., Bake 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Tater Tot Casserole
directions: Brown ground beef and onion in skillet. Drain. Layer half of Tater Tots in bottom of a 13 x 9-inch baking dish., Put meat mixture on top of the Tater Tots., Mix soups together and spoon on top of the meat. Top with the rest of the meat., Top with the rest of the Tater Tots., Bake at 350° for 40 minutes. Remove from oven and sprinkle cheese on top. Bake for 5 more minutes or until cheese has melted. A great dish to bring to a dish supper. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Cornbread Casserole
directions: Boil chicken until done., Save 1 cup of broth., Cut up chicken in bite size pieces; set aside., Crumble up cornbread fine; pour melted margarine over cornbread., Set aside., To meat, add 1 cup of broth, soups and sage; mix well., Mix all with cornbread., Put in baking dish., Bake at 325° until golden brown and bubbly.

title: Bud'S Rum Cake
directions: Grease and flour a Bundt pan., Preheat oven to setting as directed on the cake mix box., In a mixing bowl, blend together cake mix, nuts, raisins and vanilla., Substitute one-half the liquid required in the cake mix with rum., Bake the cake according to package directions., Set aside to cool., When cool, remove cake from Bundt pan and place on a plate., At this time additional rum can be sprinkled on the cake for more flavor., Prepare a glaze in a pot atop the stove consisting of the butter, sugar and 1/2 cup rum., Heat and stir until smooth., Be careful as the rum may catch fire!, Spoon the glaze mixture over the cake., The cake is best served chilled.

title: Pound Cake
directions: Cream margarine and Crisco well., Add eggs one at a time, beat after each egg., Add sugar, beat well., Add flour and flavorings. Pour into tube pan., Bake 30 minutes at 350 degrees then turn oven to 325 degrees for 30 minutes.

title: Meltaway Monkey Rolls
directions: Thaw bread dough., Pull apart loaf of bread into walnut size chunks., Place in generously buttered 9 x 13-inch pan., Sprinkle with brown sugar, cinnamon and dry pudding., Pour butter and milk over top., Pull apart second loaf of bread and arrange evenly on top., Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Blueberry Cake
directions: Toss together and set aside the sugar, blueberries and flour. Mix all ingredients together, except egg whites and blueberries. Add egg whites and mix again. Then stir in blueberries., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Amazing Coconut Pie
directions: Combine milk, sugar, biscuit mix, eggs, butter and vanilla in electric blender., Cover and blend for 3 minutes.

title: Pecan Rolls
directions: Place pecans in greased pan., Place rolls on top of pecans; let rise overnight., Next morning, cook butterscotch pudding., Add butter, brown sugar and cinnamon., Bring to boil over low heat. Pour mixture over rolls., Cover and bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Dark Fudge Cookies("Godiva Chocolates Developed This Recipe")
directions: In a double boiler or microwave, melt chocolate over low heat; cool for 10 minutes., In large bowl, cream sugar, butter and eggs until smooth., Beat in the cooled chocolate until well blended. Gradually add the flour and salt; mix until smooth., Stir in nuts. Cover and chill until firm, about 1 hour.

title: Frozen Suckers
directions: Mix Kool-Aid, Jell-O, sugar and hot water., Then add cold water; stir until all is dissolved., Pour into molds or ice trays. Chill until frozen.

title: Homemade Canned Spaghetti Sauce
directions: Boil for 2 hours., Add 3 cups of sugar and cook 15 minutes more., Put in hot jars.

title: Breakfast Pizza
directions: Brown sausage; drain and crumble., Set aside., Place crescent rolls in bottom of pan., Place sausage on dough and cover with hash browns., Pour blended eggs with salt and pepper to taste over potatoes., Top with cheese., Bake at 375° for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Fudge Frosting
directions: Mix well. Bring to a boil and cook for only 2 1/2 minutes. Add 1 teaspoon vanilla and beat until thick.

title: Chili Chicken
directions: Heat tomatoes and chilies, soups and Velveeta cheese until cheese is melted., Add cubed chicken to cheese mixture., In a 9 x 13-inch pan, layer chicken and cheese mixture, layer of onion and layer of crushed Doritos., Repeat layers, ending with a layer of chicken and cheese mixture., Heat at 350° for about 30 minutes or until bubbly., Can be put together the day before and heated the next day.

title: Italian Chicken And Potatoes
directions: Place chicken and potatoes on cookie sheet., Add oil on top. Sprinkle garlic powder or garlic on top., Bake in a 375° oven until potatoes are golden brown, about 1 to 1 1/2 hours., Sprinkle with Romano cheese and bake 5 minutes more.

title: Val'S Layered Salad
directions: Layer in large deep bowl in the order listed. Stir before serving.

title: Black Forest Trifle
directions: In a large saucepan, slowly heat 4 cups milk with the chocolate just until bubbles form around edge of pan., In a small bowl, combine cornstarch, sugar, salt and remaining milk; mix well. Gradually stir cornstarch mixture into hot milk; bring to boiling, stirring., Boil 1 minute, stirring constantly., Remove from heat. Add vanilla., Spoon one-third of the chocolate pudding into a 2-quart bowl or souffle dish., Top with one-third of the crumbs. Set aside 1/2 cup cherry filling., Gently spoon half of remaining cherry filling onto crumbs.

title: 80 Calorie Salad
directions: Layer lettuce, onion and peas., Spread mayonnaise., Layer cheese; sprinkle Bac*Os., Refrigerate overnight to marinate. Keeps several days.

title: Broccoli Cheese Soup
directions: Boil 2 bouillon cubes in 2 cups water., Add broccoli and cook 15 minutes., Saute onions and/or mushrooms in margarine., Mix flour into cold milk and evaporated milk., Cook with sauteed mix until thick., Add sliced Velveeta cheese., Stir until melts., Add broccoli., Stir on low heat until thick (about 20 minutes).

title: Sour Cream Pecan Cake
directions: Grease and flour 10-inch tube pan., Cream margarine and 2 1/4 cups sugar until light; add egg yolks one at a time, beating well. Add vanilla, lemon and almond extracts., Stir together flour and baking soda, then add to batter mixture alternately with sour cream., Mix well; stir in pecans., Beat egg whites until stiff peaks form; add 1/2 cup sugar and fold egg whites into batter. Bake in a 325° oven for 1 hour and 20 minutes.

title: Chocolate Cool Whip And Cream Cheese Pie
directions: Mix Cool Whip and soft cream cheese; add sugar and blend thoroughly to dissolve sugar., Add chocolate syrup., Shred candy bar with paring knife over the pie.

title: Pineapple Rolls
directions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Lightly grease a baking sheet. Separate dough into two long rectangles. Place these rectangles with long sides together and press the edges and perforations to seal. Roll to a rectangle about 10x15 inch. Combine the pineapple spread with the spices. Mix well. Spread on the dough and roll up jelly-roll fashion, starting with the 15 inch side. Cut into 1 inch thick slices. Place cut side down on baking sheet. Flatten slightly with the fingertips., Bake for 12 to 15 minutes or until the rolls are lightly browned. Remove the rolls from the baking sheet and place on a rack to cool slightly., Place rolls in a large shallow serving dish. Pour the pineapple butter sauce over the rolls.

title: Chocolate Sunday Cake
directions: Combine brown sugar, cocoa and water., Mix well., Pour into a 13 x 9-inch pan., Place marshmallows evenly on top., Make cake batter following package directions., Pour into pan., Top with nuts., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes., Cool on wire rack., Cut into bars or squares to serve.

title: Williamsburg Tea Bread
directions: Set oven at 300°., Beat eggs and sugar together until creamy. Add flour, salt and baking powder., Stir in dates, nuts and vanilla by hand., Spoon into greased 9 1/2 x 4 1/2, x 2 1/4-inch loaf pan., Cover with foil and bake on middle shelf for 1 1/2 hours., Increase heat to 325°, remove foil and bake another 15 to 20 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean when inserted into middle of the cake., Turn out and cool completely before slicing.

title: Spinach Dip
directions: Boil frozen, chopped spinach and drain water., Squeeze excess water out of spinach after cooled., Combine leek soup mix, sour cream, mayonnaise and green onion tops., Add cooled spinach to mixture and refrigerate., Cut top of round loaf of bread and hollow out, making a bread bowl., Cut up pieces of bread for dipping., When ready to serve, place dip mixture in bread bowl and serve.

title: Cinnamon Munch
directions: Combine sugar and cinnamon; set aside., Melt margarine in a large skillet., Add Chex., Heat and stir gently until all pieces are coated., Continue to heat and stir 5 to 6 minutes., Sprinkle half the cinnamon/sugar mixture evenly over Chex; stir well. Sprinkle remaining mixture., Heat and stir 1 minute longer. Spread on absorbent paper towel to cool.

title: German Bread
directions: Set aside yeast, 1 teaspoon sugar and warm water., Heat milk, salt and sugar., Add milk mixture, eggs and yeast mixture to 3 cups flour., Mix well., Add anise seed and the rest of the flour, slowly mixing by hand to form a stiff dough.

title: Coconut Cake
directions: Prepare cake according to package directions., Bake in tube pan., Mix together coconut, sour cream and sugar., When cake is baked, punch at least 100 holes in the hot cake., Pour coconut mixture immediately over hot cake., Let stand about 8 hours, then remove from pan.

title: No Bake Chocolate Cookies
directions: Mix first 5 ingredients and cook until comes to a boil., Let boil until a piece comes to a small ball in a cup of water., Mix in oats and peanut butter., Drop on greased waxed paper or foil.

title: Lemon Icebox Pie
directions: Mix cream cheese with egg yolks until smooth. Add milk. Mix well. Add lemon juice and rinds. Stir until thickened. Pour into crust.

title: Mud Puddles
directions: Prepare or buy your favorite chocolate chip cookie dough.

title: Sugar Cookies
directions: Combine shortening, sugar, eggs, milk and vanilla., Beat until creamy., Add dry ingredients and mix well., Drop onto greased cookie sheet and press with glass dipped in sugar., Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: French Coconut Pie
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., Mix ingredients., Pour into pie shell and bake for 10 minutes., Reduce heat to 300° and continue baking until golden brown, about 45 minutes.

title: Breakfast Pizza
directions: In a small saucepan, heat 2 tablespoons butter. Add flour. Cook 1 minute., Stir in milk. Cook until mixture boils and thickens. Cool slightly., Heat oven to 400°.

title: Apple Pear Honey
directions: Cook approximately 30 minutes until it changes color., Place in clean jars and seal.

title: "My" Chili
directions: Cut or chop stew beef into 1/4-inch cubes., Mix with chopped onion and green pepper., Add garlic and olive oil; brown in skillet., Add balance of ingredients, except kidney beans, in slow cooker, along with meat and simmer for 4 hours., Add kidney beans and simmer additional 2 hours., Serve.

title: Peanut Butter Toast
directions: Toast bread in toaster., As soon as it pops up, spread peanut butter on one side of each slice., The peanut butter will melt slightly on the warm toast., Cut it diagonally., Great as a breakfast food or a snack.

title: Pasta Salad
directions: Boil pasta according to package directions. Rinse and chill.

title: Picnic Pasta
directions: Cook, drain and cool pasta., Add remaining ingredients; toss and chill., At serving time, toss again.

title: Chicken And Rice
directions: Dip chicken pieces in melted margarine., Arrange on top of mixture, of, rice,	water and soups in a 9 x 13-inch dish. Bake at 325° for 1 1/2 hours or longer., Cover dish.

title: Taco Pinwheels
directions: Mix ingredients together (except tortillas). Spread mixture onto tortillas. Refrigerate individual rolls in saran wrap. Slice and serve.

title: Hot And Hearty Ham Cheesers
directions: Grind ham and then cheese., Mix together in a bowl., In another bowl mix margarine, chives, parsley, dry mustard and garlic., Spread butter mixture on soft rolls (either side)., Place one scoop of ham and cheese mixture on the bun and wrap in foil. Heat at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Yellow Peppers
directions: Pack jars full with peppers., Boil water., Fill jars to brim cap and turn over for 24 hours, then store for eating.

title: Pineapple Carrot Cake
directions: Sift dry ingredients into bowl., Beat eggs, oil, buttermilk and vanilla; add to dry ingredients., Blend well., Add the rest of ingredients., Bake in greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan at 350° for 45 minutes., Remove from oven., With fork, poke holes in top to cover surface., Immediately spread with hot Buttermilk Glaze or Cream Cheese Frosting.

title: Beef Stroganoff
directions: Saute cubes of meat in butter along with the onions, then add soup., Simmer for 1 hour, then add mushrooms and garlic salt. Simmer 30 minutes longer., Take off heat and stir in sour cream. Serve over rice or noodles.

title: Heavenly Hash
directions: Mix cream, sugar and butter., Bring to a boil and let boil 10 minutes., After boiling point is reached, add Karo., Boil until it forms soft ball in water., Add vanilla; stir until creamy., Add nuts and cherries., Pour into greased pan.

title: Cookie Squares
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Pour melted butter in 13 x 9-inch baking pan., Sprinkle graham cracker crumbs over melted butter., Pour condensed milk evenly over crumbs., Sprinkle chocolate chips, coconut and nuts evenly over mixture; press down firmly., Bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until lightly brown., Allow to cool before cutting into squares., Makes 30 squares.

title: Dixon'S Barbecue Sauce
directions: Mix commercial sauce with tomato catsup in a 1 to 1 ratio. Add brown sugar., Add the sweet pickle juice to thin (replaces vinegar, the pickle juice is the secret ingredient)., Heat the sauce preparation to boil., Excellent for pork ribs, chicken, chops or beef.

title: Sloppy Joe
directions: Brown the ground beef, celery, onion and green pepper., Add remaining ingredients and bake at 250° for 2 hours., Serve on hamburger buns.

title: Speedy Beef Casserole For One
directions: In skillet, cook meat, onion and garlic until meat is brown and onion is tender; drain., Stir in Worcestershire sauce, salt and pepper., In saucepan, combine meat mixture, tomato sauce, rice and chili powder., Cook over medium-high heat for about 10 minutes, or until hot and bubbly, stirring occasionally. Stir in half of the cheese until melted., Spoon onto a plate., Top with remaining shredded cheese.

title: Yayi'S Chicken
directions: Blend butter and flour; add broth and milk. Cook, stirring constantly over low heat & sauce is thick. Saute onion in a little butter, add rest of ingredients to sauce. Add sherry (optional). Serve in pasta shells.

title: Carrot Cake
directions: In bowl, combine flour, sugar, baking soda, baking powder and cinnamon., Add carrot, oil and eggs., Beat with an electric mixer until combined.

title: Sweet Pickles Recipe(1960)
directions: Soak cucumbers in brine that will float an egg for 5 days. 2 cups of salt to 1 gallon of water., Then drain and put into a clean churn or earthenware large jars and sprinkle over the top one tablespoonful of powdered alum to each gallon of cucumbers; cover with boiling water., Let stand for 24 hours, then drain and reheat the solution and pour back on them for 24 hours., Split the cucumbers as desired and cover with syrup.

title: Fabulous Fudge
directions: Mix sugar, milk, marshmallow cream, margarine and salt in a heavy 2-quart saucepan., Cook, stirring constantly, over medium heat to a boil (when mixture is bubbling all over top)., Boil and stir 5 minutes more., Remove from heat., Stir in chocolate pieces until completely dissolved., Stir in vanilla and nuts., Spread in buttered 8-inch square pan., Makes 30 pieces.

title: Cream Of Broccoli Soup
directions: Cook broccoli until tender in water; cool., Then puree broccoli and cooking water in blender., Melt margarine., Saute onion in it until transparent., Blend flour into margarine and onion mixture; cook until foamy., Stir in milk., Gradually bring to a boil, stirring constantly.

title: Butterscotch Pound Cake
directions: Beat butter and cream cheese at medium speed about 2 minutes or until soft., Slowly add sugar and beat about 7 minutes., Add eggs, one at a time, beating until yellow disappears., Gradually add flour until blended., Add flavorings, pecans and morsels. Spoon batter into a greased pan., Bake at, 325° for 1 hour and 20 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean., Let cool a little. Pour the topping over cake while warm.

title: Dirt Cups
directions: Crush cookies in food processor or plastic bag with rolling pin., Pour milk into large bowl., Add pudding mix., Beat with wire whisk until well blended, 1 to 2 minutes., Let stand for 5 minutes., Stir in whipped topping and half of crushed cookies. Place 1 tablespoon crushed cookies in each cup., Fill cups about 3/4 full with pudding mixture., Top with remaining crushed cookies., Refrigerate for 1 hour., Decorate with gummy worms, frogs or your favorites.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: White wine may be substituted for milk.

title: Mississippi Cornbread
directions: Mix all ingredients in a large bowl., Bake in a 9-inch square baking pan or a 12-inch cast-iron skillet., Bake at 375° about 35 minutes.

title: Raisin Spice Cake
directions: Put in a pan, sugar,, shortening,, water,, raisins, and spices; boil for 5 minutes., Cool,	then add flour, salt, soda and baking powder., Bake in loaf pans at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Homemade Ice Cream
directions: Beat eggs several minutes., Beat in sugar one cup at a time. Add vanilla and evaporated milk and pour in 4-quart freezer container., Either add fresh milk to full line in freezer container or add sweetened fresh fruit, reducing sugar in ice cream mixture by 1/2 to 1 cup depending on taste desired., Yields 8 to 10 servings.

title: Cherry Rhubarb Jam
directions: Combine rhubarb, sugar and pie filling. Boil for 10 minutes. Remove from heat. Add butter and gelatin; mix good. Put in jars and seal.

title: Cappucino
directions: Combine and heat first 7 ingredients., Serve with a cinnamon stick in each cup and top with Cool Whip., Makes 8 cups.

title: Stroganoff Sandwich
directions: Cut loaf of bread lengthwise; wrap in foil and heat at 375° for 10 to 15 minutes., In a skillet cook beef with onion until brown. Drain, stir in sour cream, milk, Worcestershire sauce and garlic powder., Add 3/4 teaspoon salt., Heat but do not boil., Remove bread from oven., Scoop out some of the middle, pour meat mixture into bread., Top with shredded cheese, then heat until cheese is melted., Once out of oven add tomato and green pepper rings., Slice and serve while still warm.

title: Snickerdoodles
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Sift together flour, cream of tartar, soda and salt., Set aside., In a large bowl with electric mixer, beat shortening until fluffy., Gradually beat in 1 1/2 cups sugar. Beat in eggs and vanilla., Gradually beat in flour mixture.

title: Zucchini Bread
directions: Sift all dry ingredients., Beat eggs, sugar and oil., Add other ingredients and mix., Bake at 325° for 1 hour., Makes 2 large loaves or 3 small loaves.

title: Spoon Bread
directions: Mix cornmeal and boiling water., Cool to lukewarm., Add yolks of eggs, well beaten, with milk, salt and baking powder., Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites., Bake in greased 2-quart baking dish at 325° for about 1 hour.

title: Strawberry Puree
directions: Wash and hull fresh berries. In a blender or food processor, puree the berries; add almond extract and vanilla. Sweeten with sugar.

title: Onion Rice
directions: Cook onion in margarine until soft., Add broth and bring to boil., Add rice., Reduce heat to low., Cook covered for about 25 minutes or until rice is soft and relatively dry., Add freshly ground black pepper to taste.

title: Bread Bowl With Dip
directions: Hollow out bread; save bread.

title: Kentucky Spoon Bread
directions: Stir all ingredients together., Bake in 9 x 9-inch casserole at 350° for 45 minutes or until golden.

title: Chili Pizza
directions: Brown ground beef; drain. Stir in seasoning mix and tomatoes. Cook 5 to 10 minutes. Arrange tortillas in a circle on a 12-inch pizza pan; overlap edges where needed. Spoon ground beef mixture onto tortillas. Top with cheese and olives. Bake in 400° oven 5 to 10 minutes or until cheese is melted. Makes one 12-inch pizza.

title: Butterscotch Cookies
directions: Cream together first 6 ingredients., Mix together the flour, soda, and cream of tartar., Add to cream mixture with the vanilla. Roll into balls., Place on ungreased cookie sheet., Bake at 350°F. for a minute or two until lightly browned., They will be chewy.

title: Party Potato Skins
directions: Scrub potatoes and rub skins with oil., Prick each potato several times with a fork., Bake at 400° for 30 to 45 minutes or until done., Allow to cool to touch., Cut top third off each potato., Discard tops., Carefully scoop out pulp, leaving about 1/8-inch thick shells., (Pulp can be used for mashed potatoes.) Fry potato skins in 375° oil for 3 to 4 minutes or until brown. Drain on paper towels., Place skins, cut side up, on ungreased baking sheet., Sprinkle with garlic salt and cheese., Broil 6 inches from heat for 30 seconds or until cheese melts., Top skins with bacon and 1 tablespoon of chives., Press green chiles between paper towels to remove excess moisture., Combine chiles, sour cream and red pepper in a small bowl., Stir well., Top with remaining tablespoon of chives., Serve with potato skins., Yields 8 servings.

title: Swiss Steak
directions: Cut meat into serving size pieces; coat in flour. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. In a skillet or Dutch oven, brown meat on both sides in oil. Top with the onions and celery., Combine tomatoes, Worcestershire sauce and oregano; spoon over vegetables. Cover and simmer for 1 1/2 to 2 hours or until meat is tender. Serve over noodles if desired. Or even rice. Can also use venison for beef.

title: Almond Arfa
directions: Melt almond bark and mix in peanut butter., When smooth, stir in Rice Krispies, peanuts and marshmallows., Drop by teaspoonfuls onto waxed paper and let set up.

title: Steak Diane
directions: Trim fat from steak and cut into moderate size pieces., Melt the butter over low heat and saute the garlic., Coat the steak pieces with Worcestershire sauce and place in the frying pan., Add the lemon juice and pepper., Turn when brown, then simmer until done.

title: Honey-Pecan Sweet Potatoes
directions: Boil sweet potatoes until tender; drain., Peel and cut into quarters., Place quartered potatoes in a greased, shallow casserole dish., In a small saucepan, combine honey, brown sugar, salt and butter., Bring mixture to a boil, stirring constantly. Pour syrup over sweet potatoes., Sprinkle chopped pecans on top. Preheat oven to 375°., Bake sweet potatoes for 30 minutes. Serves 4.

title: Chicken Enchiladas
directions: Stir-fry chicken for 2 minutes., Add peppers, onions and cilantro; stir-fry 3 to 4 minutes until chicken is done., Remove from heat and stir in beans., In medium bowl, combine enchilada and tomato sauce, blend well., Spoon 2 tablespoons of sauce into bottom of baking dish; reserve remaining sauce., Spoon 1/2 cup chicken filling down center of each tortilla, roll up., Place seam side down in baking dish., Pour remaining sauce on enchiladas., Cover. Bake 30 to 40 minutes at 350°., Sprinkle with cheese., Serve with yogurt.

title: Dressing Bread
directions: Bake about 20 minutes at 450°.

title: Banana Bread
directions: Cream all ingredients together., Bake 35, minutes at 350° or longer if not done when checked.

title: Favorite Apple Crisp
directions: Butter a 10 x 6 x 2-inch baking dish., Peel apples and slice. Sprinkle with cinnamon, salt and water., Put flour, sugar and butter together; mash with a fork., Drop over the apples., Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

title: Fruit Cobbler
directions: Mix all ingredients to make dough., Save 1 cup for top of cobbler., Pat dough into ungreased cookie sheet., Pour 1 large can pie filling on top of dough., Use 1 cup of dough to drop here and there on top of filling., Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

title: Lemon Meringue Pie
directions: Combine ingredients and cook over low heat until thick., Put in baked pie shell., Cover with meringue and bake at 350° until brown.

title: Fruit Cake
directions: Do not mix cake mix according to directions., Mix ingredients all together and bake., Cool, then spread whipped cream on cake. On top of that, spread 1 can cherry pie filling., Looks good and is good., Easy to make.

title: Cheese-Corn Bread
directions: Heat oven to 400°. Grease square pan, 8 x 8 x 2-inch or 9 x 9 x 2-inches. Measure all ingredients in order listed into a bowl; stir just until flour is moistened. Batter will be lumpy. Spread evenly in pan. Bake 8-inch pan 45 minutes; 9-inch pan 35 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Hot Cross Buns
directions: Preheat oven to 400°., Combine milk, shortening, 1/3 cup sugar and salt., Cool to lukewarm., Mix the 1 teaspoon sugar with the yeast that has been softened in lukewarm water and add to lukewarm milk mixture., Add egg, raisins, cinnamon, allspice and as much sifted flour as can be stirred into the dough., Place in a greased bowl, cover and let rise in a warm place until doubled in bulk. Knead and shape into 2-inch balls and arrange on a greased pan. Brush each bun with egg white, cover and let rise until double in bulk., Snip in deep cross in the top of each with scissors., Bake for 15 minutes., Remove from pan immediately., Cool on wire rack. When cool, fill cross with powdered sugar frosting., Makes 2 dozen.

title: Zesty Chicken Cutlets With Apricot Sauce
directions: In food processor or blender, process apricots until smooth. Place in small saucepan. Simmer, covered, over low heat 8 to 10 minutes until reduced in volume by half., Stir occasionally.

title: Lemon Icebox Pie
directions: Mix milk, lemonade, lemon juice, food coloring and not quite half of Cool Whip., Put into a cooked crust., Put rest of Cool Whip on top of pie.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Cook broccoli as directed on package., Drain., Add soup and milk together, then combine with broccoli and stuffing., Put in casserole and bake 30 minutes in a 350° oven.

title: Jumbo Raisin Cookies
directions: Sift dry ingredients. Add water to raisins and boil 5 minutes or until liquid has decreased to 1/2 cup. Cool. Cream shortening; add sugar and blend well., Add eggs, one at a time, to creamed mixture, beating well after each addition., Add vanilla, nuts and cooled raisin mixture., Add sifted dry ingredients and blend well. Drop by teaspoons onto greased cookie sheets., Bake at 400° for 12 to 15 minutes. Makes 5 dozen.

title: Party Mashed Potatoes
directions: Mix together and place in buttered casserole dish., (I use a 9 x 13-inch pan.), Refrigerate until ready to bake., Bake 1 hour at 350°., Serves 10 to 12.

title: Quick Meatballs
directions: Heat oven to 425°., Mix ground meat, bread crumbs, milk, egg and seasonings thoroughly., Shape by tablespoon in 1 1/2-inch balls., Place on ungreased pan., Bake until done, about 10 minutes., Now add the meatballs to your favorite recipe.

title: Steak Marinade
directions: Mix all ingredients, except oil, and rub into steaks., Splash on olive oil. Coat all sides. Cover and refrigerate, turning occasionally, 6 to 8 hours or overnight. Grill as desired.

title: Easy Popcorn Balls
directions: Cook until 260° for soft-crack stage. Pour over 2 quarts salted popcorn. Mix thoroughly and mold into balls.

title: Fudge Pie
directions: Cream the sugar and butter., Add eggs and beat. Add flour, vanilla and melted chocolate and pour in a greased Pyrex plate. Bake 25 minutes at 300°., Serve topped with vanilla ice cream.

title: Low-Fat Macaroni And Cheese
directions: Cook macaroni and drain., Saute onion, garlic and oil until tender; stir in flour, pepper and Tabasco sauce., Blend and add milk slowly and cook on medium heat until boiling., Add cheese and stir until smooth and add to macaroni and pour into a greased 2-quart casserole dish and bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

title: Egg Custard Pie
directions: Combine sugar, flour and salt. Beat eggs until lemon colored. Blend in dry ingredients. Add melted butter and milk; mix well. Pour into a pastry shell. Sprinkle top with nutmeg. Bake in a 375° oven for 30 minutes. Allow to set before serving.

title: Breakfast Casserole
directions: Unroll can of crescent rolls and place flat in a 9x13-inch Pyrex dish., Spread sausage over rolls and then pour eggs over sausage., Spread cheese evenly over top of eggs., Bake at 350 degrees until eggs are set, 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Sweet Potato Biscuits
directions: Sift flour, baking powder and salt., Add sugar and shortening to hot sweet potatoes., Combine potatoes with flour mixture. Roll or pat 3/4-inch thick., Bake at 425° for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Soda Cracker Chocolate Candy
directions: Line a 15 x 10 x 1-inch baking pan with foil and coat with nonstick cooking spray., Place crackers in rows on foil.

title: Peanut Candy
directions: Melt chocolate., Add peanut butter and mix well., Stir in Rice Crispies and marshmallows., Add peanuts., Mix well., Spoon by heaping spoonfuls onto waxed paper.

title: Toffee Cake
directions: Bake cake according to package directions in a 9 x 13 pan. Cool on wire rack for 5 minutes. Make slits across the top of the cake, making sure not to go through to the bottom.

title: Peanut Butter (Fudge) Critters
directions: Mix all ingredients until it feels like dough., Press into pan. Cut into squares., Can make critters by breaking off pieces of dough and make dogs, clowns, bears, hearts, etc.

title: Spanish Rice
directions: In a medium to large skillet, heat butter and add onions, red pepper and green pepper., Cook until slightly tender., Add rice; mix together., Lower heat and add water., Cover and simmer 20 to 25 minutes., When done, add chili powder, mix and serve., Serves 4.

title: Fish Fillets Au Gratin(Niel'S And Oj'S Favorite Fish)
directions: *Suggested Fish:, Pike, trout, halibut, haddock, cod, red snapper, sok or flounder.

title: Salmon Pie
directions: Flake the salmon., Combine with crackers, beaten eggs, white sauce and seasonings., Turn into a baking dish., Top with the mashed potatoes., Bake in the oven (375°) about 25 minutes.

title: Fruit Cobbler
directions: Melt margarine in dish. Mix rest of ingredients, except fruit, and pour over melted margarine. Pour fruit on top and sprinkle with brown sugar then place pats of margarine on top. Bake at 350° for 45, to 50 minutes.

title: Tuna Pate Pyramids
directions: In large round bowl, place layers of:

title: Lasagna(World Famous!)
directions: Brown hamburger slowly. Add next 5 ingredients., Simmer, uncovered, for 30 minutes., Cook the noodles (according to package directions). Combine remaining ingredients together, except Mozzarella cheese., Place half the noodles in a 13 x 9-inch pan. Spread half cottage cheese filling, half Mozzarella cheese and half meat sauce., Repeat., Bake at 375° for 45 minutes., Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

title: Rice Krispies Cheese Cookies
directions: Mix cheese and oleo at room temperature., Mix thoroughly with flour and pepper., Add Rice Krispies., With hands, easily roll into small balls and put onto cookie sheet., Press with a fork to make pattern on top of each cookie., Bake 20 to 25 minutes at 275°. Makes 3 dozen.

title: Ballgame Mix
directions: Mix all dry ingredients., Coat cereal in oil., Toss dry mix with cereal., Microwave on High for 5 minutes, stirring once.

title: Baked Beans
directions: Mix all ingredients and put into a baking dish. Cover with bacon slices and bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Sherried Shrimp With Garlic
directions: Thaw shrimp, if frozen., Peel and devein, leaving tails intact; set aside., In large skillet, combine sherry, orange juice, red pepper strips, olives, parsley, garlic, capers, tomato paste and black pepper., Bring to boiling., Add shrimp., Cook and stir for 1 to 3 minutes or until shrimp turns pink., Remove from heat., Stir in olive oil., Serve with bread.

title: Beef Stew
directions: Heat oil in dutch oven. Add beef and brown on all sides starting on medium high and reducing to medium as it cooks. Add onion and garlic. Add water, salt, lemon juice, sugar, worcestershire sauce, bay leaf and allspice. Simmer for 1 to 2 hours, stirring occasionally. When almost done, remove bay leaf, and add veggies. Thicken with flour or cornstarch mixed with cold water.

title: Buttermilk Salad
directions: Heat pineapple. Remove, from heat and stir in dry jello mix. Let chill 10, to 15 minutes (don't let it congeal)., Add buttermilk and Cool Whip., Stir, and, pour, in 8 x 8-inch pan. Refrigerate until firm., Cuts easily in lovely squares., Easy, 10 calories and yummy!

title: Homemade Hamburger Helper(Beef Noodle)
directions: In a large skillet, cook ground hamburger meat with chopped onion., If a lot of grease is left over, drain., Add cream of mushroom soup and stir while adding milk., Add brown gravy mix. Stir in cooked noodles., Serves 4 to 6.

title: Fresh Creamed Corn
directions: Melt margarine in heavy skillet or pan., Add other ingredients and cook very low, stirring constantly., May need to add more water as corn thickens., Cook and stir for about 30 to 40 minutes. Place in oven until brown.

title: Chocolate Mousse
