directions: Melt the chocolate and water together in a small pan., Stir in the vanilla flavoring and butter, then the egg yolks, 1 at a time. Beat the egg whites until stiff., Fold the chocolate mixture into the egg whites, using a rubber spatula or a metal spoon., When thoroughly mixed, pour into a glass bowl., Cover and chill overnight., Serve with whipped cream on top.

title: Easy Jello Salad
directions: Dissolve Jell-O with boiling water as directed on Jell-O package., Add cold water., When Jell-O becomes slightly thickened, add pineapple and carrots., Stir and refrigerate for 2 hours. This is easy, healthy and it tastes good, too!

title: Chile-Cheese Quesadillas With Salsa Cruda
directions: To make 1 quesadilla, spread 2 teaspoons Ricotta over tortilla., Sprinkle with heaping tablespoonful Monterey Jack cheese and 2 teaspoons diced chilies., Top with 1 tortilla. Repeat to make 2 more quesadillas.

title: Spring Tonic
directions: Mix above and drink one glass each morning to improve energy.

title: Sausage-Cheese Balls
directions: Have sausage and cheese at room temperature., Combine and mix well., Add paprika and biscuit mix and mix well., Roll into small balls and bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes., Makes 100 sausage-cheese balls., May be baked and frozen for unexpected company.

title: Bacon-Potato Chowder
directions: Fry bacon; saute onion and drain., Add potatoes and water; cook until tender., Stir in remaining ingredients; heat thoroughly., Do not boil., Add more milk if chowder becomes too thick., Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Crawfish Fettucini
directions: Saute onion, bell pepper and green onions in butter., Add half and half and cheese and melt on slow/low heat., Once melted, add crawfish., Continue cooking for about 5 minutes., Place cooked fettucini in 3-quart casserole dish., Add crawfish mixture., Stir well., Bake in covered dish at 325° for 1 hour.

title: Savory Turkey Casserole
directions: Heat oven to 400°., In large bowl, blend contents of sauce mix envelope and poultry seasoning., Stir in boiling water., Using wire whisk, stir in soup., Add potato slices, turkey,, carrots, celery and onion; mix well., Spoon mixture into ungreased 2-quart casserole., Bake for 45 to 55 minutes, or until potatoes are tender., Serves 6.

title: Microwave Parched Peanuts
directions: Put a thin to medium layer of peanuts in a microwaveable dish., Set heat on highest setting and run for about 2 minutes. Take out of microwave (use an oven mitt or small towel to keep from getting burned)., Stir peanuts very good and put back and run for 1 more minute., Remove and stir again., Then run for 1 more minute., You can sample peanuts at various times and get the stage of parched peanuts you like best., You may want to run for extra time if desired., Peanuts will continue to cook some after removing from the microwave., Cooking time 4 to 5 minutes.

title: Butterscotch Morsels
directions: Melt butterscotch in double boiler., Then stir in peanut and noodles., Drop by teaspoonfuls onto wax paper and let harden (about 45 minutes).

title: Spinach-Phyllo Triangleshouston, Texas
directions: Drained thawed spinach well, pressing between paper towels until barely moist., The drier the better., Saute onion in 2 Tbsp. butter in a skillet until tender., Add spinach, Parmesan cheese, and the 7 ingredients on the right hand list., Stir well.

title: Nanaimo Bars(Makes 16 Bars.)
directions: Measure crumbs, coconut and nuts into a bowl., Blend and reserve., Heat butter and 1/4 cup granulated sugar in small saucepan until butter is melted., Stir in cocoa., Mixture should be smooth and sugar dissolved., Blend in egg and vanilla, mixing well., Combine mixture with crumb mixture., Turn into a lightly oiled 8-inch cake pan., Press firmly to make a smooth surface. Place in freezer while preparing next layer.

title: Minnie'S Baked Beans
directions: Soak beans overnight., Cook in water until they crack., Drain water and add onions, sugar, bacon and tomato juice in a large roaster., Bake at 350° for about 4 hours., If they become dry and beans are not tender, add water and bake a little longer., Can be frozen., Makes a large roaster full.

title: Zucchini Bread
directions: Cream eggs and sugar., Add oil, zucchini and vanilla., Then add sifted flour, salt, baking powder, baking soda and spices. Mix all together., Bake at 325° for 1 hour in two loaf pans.

title: Quick And Easy Cobbler
directions: Place stick of butter in a Pyrex bowl; melt in a 350° oven. Mix sugar, flour and milk in a mixing bowl., Pour into melted butter, canned peaches., Pour other 3 ingredients over peaches and butter., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes until dough is done.

title: Gran'S Lemon Chess Pie
directions: Melt butter and set aside., Grate lemon rind lightly on tiny side of grater., Squeeze juice from lemon., Beat eggs until light. Combine all ingredients., Bake at 350° until lightly browned and doesn't shake.

title: "Pink Stuff"(Or Whatever Color You Like)
directions: Drain fruit cocktail., Mix all ingredients together and chill until it sets.

title: Mock Apple Pie
directions: Mix sugar, water and cream of tartar in a saucepan and bring to a boil., Add crackers and boil for 2 minutes; stir constantly. Cool., Pour cooled mixture into unbaked pie crust and sprinkle top with cinnamon and butter pats., Bake at 350° until pie crust browns.

title: Date Loaf Candy
directions: Stir, sugar,, salt,, cream,, syrup and butter., When it first boils,, put in dates., When nearly done, put in pecans. When done, take from stove., Let cook, then beat until stiff. Roll in wet cloth.

title: Bread And Butter Pickles
directions: Let pickles stand 1 hour or longer., Then drain.

title: Lemon Pie
directions: Mix cold water and cornstarch to a thin paste., Combine hot water with sugar until sugar is dissolved., Add cornstarch mixture and bring to boil over medium heat, stirring constantly., Stir a small amount into slightly beaten egg yolks., Combine with remaining mixture and cook for while longer., Add lemon rind and juice and butter; blend well (until butter has melted)., Pour into baked pie shells., Top with meringue., Place in 325° oven until meringue is browned.

title: Meat Loaf Dinner
directions: Preheat oven 375°. Mix up all ingredients and cook about 45 minutes. Cut, the middle and if it is grey it is done.

title: Waldorf Salad
directions: Put pineapple juice in 2-cup measuring cup., Fill up to top with orange juice., Add 2 tablespoons sugar., Mix a small amount of juice with 2 1/2 tablespoons cornstarch., Bring the rest of the juice to a boil and slowly add cornstarch mix., Cook until thick. Remove from heat and add 1 tablespoon butter., Cool, then add to apples and nuts., Mix.

title: Sour Cream Yeast Dough
directions: Heat sour cream over low heat until lukewarm., In large bowl, dissolve yeast in warm water., Add sour cream, butter, sugar, eggs and 2 cups flour; beat until smooth and stir in remaining flour until cleaves to the bowl., Knead on well-floured board until smooth (about 10 minutes)., Place in greased bowl, turn once to bring greased side up, cover and let rise in a warm place (85°) until double, about 1 hour.

title: 2 - 2 Cake
directions: Blend all ingredients., Pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

title: Chicken Marinade
directions: Mix together. Place in bowl or Ziploc bag with chicken for 40 to 45 minutes. Grill or broil.

title: Scalloped Carrots
directions: Cook carrots in boiling salted water until crisp-tender., Saute onion in margarine., Combine with carrots, soup, salt, pepper and cheese., Put in baking dish., Top with croutons tossed with margarine., Bake at 350° for 1/2 hour.

title: Orange Julius
directions: Combine all ingredients in blender., Cover and blend until smooth, about 30 to 45 seconds., Serve immediately.

title: Kathleen'S Strawberry Angel Jello
directions: Make angel food cake according to directions and tear into small pieces., Make jello according to package directions; chill until firm., Whip jello and blend in Cool Whip., Add strawberries and fold in angel food cake pieces., Chill until set.

title: Buttermilk Jello Salad
directions: Mix in saucepan jello, sugar and pineapple., Boil 2 minutes. Cool and add buttermilk and Cool Whip., Mix well and let set in refrigerator several hours or overnight., Can be made with other flavors of jello., Garnish top with few chopped pecans or chopped maraschino cherries, if desired.

title: Ham Loaf
directions: Mix well and bake at 350° about 2 hours., After first hour, cover with glaze.

title: Magic Cookie Bars
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Melt margarine in pan., Sprinkle cracker crumbs over margarine., Pour condensed milk over this. Add chocolate morsels, pecans and coconut., Press down firmly. Bake 25 to 30 minutes, until light brown.

title: Tn Pudding Cake With Orange Topping
directions: Preheat oven to 300°., Grease and flour tube pan., Cream shortening and sugar., Add eggs one at a time, beating after each. Add flour, soda and buttermilk to creamed mixture., Blend pecans, dates and coconut., Pour in tube pan and bake 1 1/2 hours., As soon as cake is done, make slits in top with knife to bottom of cake., Pour Orange Topping over cake.

title: Taco Chip Dip
directions: Beat together cream cheese and dip., Spread into the bottom of a greased 9 x 13-inch pan., Fry ground beef and drain., Add taco seasoning and prepare according to directions on package., Put meat mixture on top of cream cheese mixture., Sprinkle with grated cheese., Bake for 1/2 hour at 350°., Serve with Tostitos chips.

title: Beef Garden Casserole
directions: Brown ground beef and drain., Place butter in casserole dish and melt., Add all ingredients, except biscuits, and mix well. Top with biscuits and place in a 400° heated oven., Bake until mixture bubbles and biscuits are browned.

title: Wonderful Pie Crust(No Big Deal...)
directions: Cut Crisco into flour and salt., Sprinkle in cold orange juice and "stir" only until dough leaves sides of bowl., The secret is, do not handle the dough very much., Divide dough into two equal parts and roll out, one at a time on well floured area., Place in pie plate and flute, poke holes in it and bake for your one crust pies., Bake at 425° until lightly brown.

title: Aunt Judy'S Pecan Pie
directions: Melt butter and mix in flour., Add remaining ingredients except vanilla and pecans and mix well., When all mixed, add vanilla and pecans., Bake at 300° for 1 hour., Makes one 8-inch pie.

title: Microwaved Corn Pudding
directions: Combine all ingredients with milk being added last., Microwave on High for 8 minutes.

title: Delightful Ham Rolls
directions: *May use finely minced onions instead of garlic.

title: Shrimp In The Pink
directions: In large skillet, heat oil, margarine and garlic powder and cook shrimp over medium-high heat, stirring constantly, until shrimp turns pink., Remove and set aside., Add water and milk; bring to boiling., Stir in noodles and sauce; reduce heat and simmer, stirring occasionally, 8 minutes or until noodles are tender., Stir in shrimp and green onions., Heat through., Makes about 2 servings.

title: Deviled Eggs
directions: Put eggs in a large saucepan with enough water to cover 1/4 to 1/2 inch above eggs., Bring to a boil., Set timer for 10 minutes, drain., Run cold water over eggs to cool., Peel and slice eggs lengthwise., Separate yolks., Mix yolks, mustard and mayonnaise., Stuff into whites with spoon and fork., Garnish with paprika.

title: Yellow Squash Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients, except cheese and paprika., Place in buttered casserole dish., Top with grated cheese and sprinkle with paprika., Bake 25 minutes in 350° oven until bubbly., Serves 8 to 10.

title: Apricot Salad
directions: Heat crushed pineapple just to boil., Stir in 6 ounce box of apricot jello., Add sugar., Blend well., Let cool until partially set., Add softened cream cheese. Fold in Cool Whip., Put in a 9 x 13-inch pan and refrigerate.

title: Noodle Salad
directions: Cook and cool noodles., Mix vegetable oil, vinegar, sugar, Accent, salt and pepper., Pour mixture over slaw, noodles, almonds, onions, green pepper and sunflower kernels., Let stand in refrigerator for at least 2 hours., Serve cold.

title: Bread Pudding
directions: Blend the first 4 ingredients with wire whisk., Tear or cube bread into 8-inch round baking dish., Add sweets., Pour custard over all., Bake at 325° for 25 to 30 minutes or until near set in center., Serve warm or cold.

title: Blueberry Crunch
directions: Top with 1 can Comstock blueberry pie filling., Refrigerate overnight., Cut into squares.

title: Frozen Pops
directions: Dissolve jello, Kool-Aid and sugar in boiling water., Add cold water., Pour into ice cube trays, small paper cups or popsicle molds., Freeze until firm, 2 to 3 hours., Makes 20 to 24.

title: Blueberry Salad
directions: Spread over salad and top with chopped nuts.

title: Teriyaki Steak
directions: Freeze steak for 1 hour., Slice thin, cross grain., Combine remaining ingredients in shallow dish., Add steak slices. Marinate for 1/2 hour., Place on broiler rack., Broil 4-inches from heat., Cook for 7 to 9 minutes or until brown, turning to other side., Serve immediately.

title: Hot Spiced Tea
directions: Mix all ingredients well., Store in dry, sealed container. Use 3 heaping teaspoons to each cup of hot water.

title: Cheese Fondue
directions: Divide bread into thirds., Butter baking dish., Layer 1/3 bread, 1/2 cheese, repeat with bread on top., Add eggs to milk and salt., Pour over bread and cheese mixture., Let stand in refrigerator overnight., Before baking, pour melted butter over top., Set casserole in pan of hot water., Bake at 325°, uncovered., When brown and crusty, put on cover and continue to bake for 45 minutes.

title: Punch
directions: Mix all but last ingredient., I put it in a plastic Ziploc bag (make sure it is locked) and freeze., Take out of freezer a couple of hours before serving, put into your punch bowl and add the ginger ale.

title: Squash Casserole
directions: Cook squash and onions until tender., Drain., Mix in rest of ingredients, except for bread crumbs., Place in greased baking dish., Sprinkle bread crumbs on top., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Inside Outside Pistachio Cake
directions: Mix cake mix according to directions on box., Add 1 box pistachio pudding and mix., Pour into Bundt pan., Bake, cool and cut cake into 3 layers.

title: Hot Chicken Salad Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients except almonds and corn flakes., Turn into buttered casserole dish., Top with flakes and almonds and bake in 375° to 400° oven for 30 to 40 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Pizza Casserole
directions: In a skillet brown meat., Drain off fat., Stir in pizza sauce, mushrooms and olives., Simmer ingredients while you cook macaroni. Drain macaroni and add 2/3 cup milk.

title: Oatmeal Banana Bread
directions: Combine first three ingredients and set aside. Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy., Beat in eggs, one at a time. Stir in bananas and milk., Add dry ingredients all at once, stirring just until all are moistened. Turn into greased loaf pan. Bake at 350° for about 40 minutes or until done., Remove from pan and cool.

title: Crock-Pot Soup
directions: Brown and drain hamburger., Place in crock-pot., Add in layers the Ranch Style beans, minestrone soup and Ro-Tel tomatoes., Add water and salt and pepper to taste., Simmer in crock-pot.

title: Abby'S Favorite Caramel Cinnamon Rolls
directions: Cut 1 loaf of bread into small pieces (about 1/2-inch squares); place in bottom of 9 x 13-inch greased pan., Mix pudding mix, brown sugar, melted margarine, milk and cinnamon with spoon. Pour 1/2 of pudding mixture on bread cubes in pan., Cut second loaf of frozen dough into 1/2-inch squares and layer in pan., Pour remaining pudding mixture on dough., Let rise overnight in refrigerator (10 to 12 hours)., Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes. Immediately invert onto cookie sheet.

title: Pinkie'S Brunswick Stew
directions: In a 4-quart saucepan, place tomatoes, chopped, and liquid from the can., Add 1 cup of water and 1 cup chicken broth., Deskin as much chicken as you want meat in the stew., Add onion, salt and pepper to taste and 1 teaspoon of sugar., Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer about 1 hour., During the last 30 minutes, add the diced potatoes., Remove the chicken; cook and take meat off the bones., Chop the meat and return it to the pan., Add the corn and butter beans and continue cooking until the beans are done.

title: Fried Green Tomatoes
directions: Slice tomatoes; do not peel., Put slices between paper towels to absorb liquid., Mix batter of eggs, corn meal, chives, water, salt and pepper., Fry in an iron skillet after battering each slice., Don't over heat oil., Turn to brown each side.

title: Fresh Prune Or Apple Cake
directions: Sift flour, salt, sugar and baking powder together twice., Put in large mixing bowl., Add eggs, beating well. Add just enough milk to make a firm batter., Put batter in a 12 x 18-inch greased pan., Split prunes and place halved prunes in rows on dough, pressing in lightly. Sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon. Bake at 325° for 20 minutes, then at 350° for about 10 more minutes until done.

title: Tomato Aspic
directions: Dissolve jello in hot water and then add remaining ingredients., Pour into individual molds or in 9 x 9-inch square pan. Refrigerate until set.

title: No Bake Cookies
directions: Mix together sugar, milk, butter and cocoa., Boil for 2 minutes., Mix together oats and peanut butter., Put both mixtures together., Drop on wax paper.

title: Spanish Rice
directions: Brown meat; add onions, seasoning, tomatoes, corn and bouillon., Bring to a boil., Stir in green peppers., Boil again. Stir in rice and remove from heat., Cover and let stand for 5 minutes., Serves 4.

title: Chocolate Ganache
directions: Gently warm the cream in a small saucepan over medium heat until small bubbles begin to appear at the edges., Remove from heat., Stir in chocolate until mixture is smooth and the chocolate has melted completely., Do not stir so vigorously that bubbles form., If there are any visible lumps, strain the mixture through a fine mesh sieve.

title: Rice Casserole
directions: Cook 1 hour at 325°.

title: Heath Bar Cake
directions: Bake cake as directed on box., When cake is done, poke several holes in top of cake., Pour condensed milk over cake., Pour caramel topping over milk., Let cake cool completely., Top with Cool Whip. Break candy bars into small pieces and scatter on top of Cool Whip. Refrigerate.

title: Rice Delight
directions: Saute celery and onion in butter., Add soup, milk and 1/3 jar Cheez Whiz., Make layers of rice, asparagus, chestnuts and soup mixture in a buttered casserole dish. Add remaining Cheez Whiz on top of last layer in teaspoonfuls., Bake, covered with foil, 25 to 30 minutes in a 350° oven.

title: Sweet And Sour Dressing For Cabbage Slaw
directions: Mix flour and sugar., Beat egg., Put all ingredients in double boiler and cook, stirring constantly until thick enough for dressing., Keep in refrigerator.

title: Buttercream Frosting
directions: Looks messy., Beat, beat and beat until mixture is smooth and creamy!, Put on cooled cake.

title: Cousin Sue'S Great Beans
directions: Place onions, vinegar, sugar, mustard, garlic powder and salt in a skillet., Cover and cook over low/medium heat for 20 minutes (onions should become transparent)., Combine all beans (do not drain the baked beans)., Combine both mixtures in a casserole. Bake in 350° oven, covered, 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

title: Dry Jello Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients together; chill and serve.

title: Gloria'S Pinch-Me Cake
directions: Cut biscuits in quarters and roll in sugar and cinnamon mixture., Place in buttered tubular pan., Melt butter and brown sugar together and pour over biscuits., Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes., Invert on platter and sprinkle with chopped nuts.

title: Quick Beef Pie
directions: Heat beef stew and put in casserole while hot., Mix buttermilk biscuits with the water., Drop on hot stew., Bake in a 450° oven for 10 minutes or until biscuits are done.

title: Lime Congealed Salad
directions: Boil water and add jello and gelatin., Stir until melted., Add cream cheese to hot mixture and dissolve well., Chill until partially congealed., Add rest of ingredients., Pour into mold and refrigerate.

title: Watergate Salad
directions: Mix well and chill before serving.

title: Buttermilk Biscuits
directions: Preheat oven to 450°., Sift dry ingredients together in large mixing bowl., With a fork, mix in shortening well., Stir in enough milk to form a soft dough., Knead gently for 30 seconds. If dough is too moist, add flour., Form dough into 10 balls; flatten and place on baking sheet., Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown., Serve hot with butter., Makes 10 to 12 biscuits.

title: Rhubarb Custard Pie
directions: Beat egg yolks., Add sugar, flour and milk, then add rhubarb. Pour into unbaked pie shell that has been sprinkled with 1 tablespoon flour., Bake in a 350° oven for 3/4 hour or until custard is set.

title: Egg Souffle(Breakfast Casserole)
directions: Use a 9 x 13-inch buttered baking dish.

title: Caramels
directions: In a 3-quart pan, cook sugar, corn syrup, nulomoline, cream and lecithin., Stir often at beginning to dissolve sugar., Bring to a boil and cook for 3 minutes. Add broken pieces of butter and cook to 230°. Continue to cook and stir until mixture reaches 246°., Remove from heat. Add salt and vanilla. Gently stir with wooden spoon., Pour into buttered pan. Add nuts, if desired.

title: Zucchini Bread
directions: Mix eggs, sugar, zucchini and add flour, cinnamon, vanilla, salt, baking powder, soda and nuts., Grease and flour 2 loaf pans. Bake at 350° for about 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Creamy Herb Dressing
directions: In blender container, combine sour cream, milk and mayonnaise. Process until thoroughly combined, scraping down sides of container as necessary. Stir in remaining ingredients. Transfer to a bowl or jar with tight fitting cover. Cover and refrigerate until ready to use., Just before serving, stir well., Makes, 8 servings.

title: Cherry Crumb Pie Topping
directions: Mix, and, take, out, 1/2 for on the top then mix egg in rest. The rest, put on the pie., Sprinkle the 1/2 on the top.

title: Broiled Shrimp Parmigiana
directions: Add lemon juice to a bowl of cold water., Clean shrimp and devein under cold running water., Remove tail shell as well., Split shrimp along vein cavity, but do not separate., Place in bowl of lemon water and let set.

title: Jan'S Cherry Cheesecake
directions: Soften margarine and mix with flour and pecans. Spread into a 9 x 13 baking dish. Brown in a 350° oven until lightly browned. Cool.

title: Easy Apple Pie
directions: Put all ingredients into pie shell., Cover and bake 20 minutes at 350°.

title: Blender Hollandaise Sauce
directions: In blender or food processor, combine first 3 ingredients; mix until blended., Remove cap and pour melted butter in slow, steady stream until mixture is thoroughly mixed., Keep warm over hot, boiling water.

title: Brunch Egg Bake
directions: In a large bowl, lightly toss cheeses together., Sprinkle half of cheese mixture in ungreased 9 x 13-inch baking dish., In medium skillet, cook mushrooms, green onion and red pepper in margarine until onions and pepper are tender., Arrange vegetables over cheese., Arrange ham strips over vegetables., Sprinkle remaining cheese over ham.*, Heat oven to 350°., Lightly spoon flour into measuring cup and level off., In a large bowl, using wire whisk, blend flour, milk, parsley and eggs., Pour over layers in baking dish., Bake for 35 to 45 minutes or until mixture is set and top is lightly browned., Let stand about 10 minutes., Cut into squares.

title: Low-Fat Maple-Glazed Sweet Potatoes
directions: Cut the sweet potatoes and apples into 1/4-inch slices., Layer in a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish., In a saucepan, bring syrup, cider, butter and salt to a boil., Pour over potatoes and apples., Cover and bake at 350° for 1 hour., Uncover and bake 10 to 15 minutes more or until tender., Yields 8 to 10 servings.

title: Custard Filling
directions: Combine dry ingredients thoroughly., Add milk and eggs., Cook over boiling water until thick like pudding., Add vanilla and butter., Mix well., Cool.

title: Cranberry Relish
directions: Put all ingredients into food processor; chill to serve. Will keep well.

title: 5 Cup Salad
directions: Mix together and let set several hours in refrigerator before serving.

title: Cranberry Fruit Salad
directions: Drain pineapple., Save juice., In saucepan, mix juice, 1/2 cup water and lemon juice., Heat to boiling; remove from heat and add gelatin., Stir well., Break up cranberry sauce with fork., Stir into gelatin mixture., Refrigerate until mixture begins to gel. Stir in pineapple, celery and apple., Pour into 4 cup mold., Chill until firm.

title: Vegetable Dip
directions: Mix well and serve with assorted vegetables.

title: Chicken And Dumplings
directions: Boil chicken until tender; remove from bone and cut into small pieces., Reserve liquid for stock., If necessary, add enough water to stock to make 2 quarts., Add soup, butter, salt and pepper. Make dumplings according to directions; cut into strips., Drop dumplings into boiling chicken stock., Boil 2 to 3 minutes, stirring gently., Fold in chicken and eggs., Simmer for 20 to 30 minutes., Serves 6 to 8.

title: Pasta Salad
directions: Mix ingredients with mayonnaise., Season to taste (use Nature's Seasons blend and Accent flavor enhancer).

title: Taco Soup
directions: Brown hamburger meat and drain grease. Add all other ingredients in a large soup pot with lid. Simmer 30 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Candy
directions: Mix well peanut butter, soft butter, corn syrup, vanilla and salt., Stir in powdered sugar and nuts., Knead well., Spread into buttered cookie sheet., Press smooth., Refrigerate.

title: Refrigerator Pickles
directions: Sprinkle cucumbers and onion with salt., Let stand 1 1/2 hours. Drain and rinse., Mix but do not heat dressing., Pour over cucumbers and onions in jars., Let stand in refrigerator, the longer the better., More cukes and onions can be added to the same solution several times.

title: Pita Snacks
directions: Preheat broiler., Split pita breads., Combine butter and dill weed; blend well., Spread dill butter on pita; cut each half into 4 wedges., Broil until crisp.

title: Pet-Ritz Easy Caramel Apple Pie
directions: Combine caramel candies each, cut into 4 pieces and 1/3 cup flour., Add apples,, ice, cream, topping, and lemon juice. Mix well., Pour mixture, into a frozen regular 9-inch Pet-Ritz pie crust and sprinkle with, 1/2, cup, pecan, pieces., Bake at 375° on a preheated baking, sheet for 40 to 45 minutes., Store at, room temperature., When using a Pet-Ritz deep dish crust, please substitute, 15, caramel candies, 1/2 cup flour, 5 cups apples, 1 cup caramel ice cream topping and 1 tablespoon lemon juice.

title: Crustless Vegetable Quiche
directions: Light grease 10-inch pie plate., Mix together first 4 ingredients., Put into pie plate., Put remaining ingredients into blender and blend until mixed well., Pour liquid mixture over ingredients already in pie plate., Bake at 400° for 35 to 40 minutes., Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

title: Christmas Sugar Cookies
directions: Lightly grease a 15 x 12 x 1-inch cookie sheet., In a large bowl, cream the 1 cup of butter., Gradually add the sugar, beating until fluffy.

title: Meatball Stew
directions: Broil ground beef until rare and crumbled., Combine with egg white and dill weed., Shape into 24 equal sized meatballs., In a large nonstick skillet saute meatballs until browned on all sides. Add green pepper and onion to skillet., Cover and steam 1 minute. Stir in tomatoes and salt., Then stir in beans and macaroni., Cover and cook over medium heat about 20 minutes or until macaroni is tender., Serves 4.

title: Pretzel Salad
directions: Combine pretzels, 2 teaspoons sugar and margarine; press into a 13 x 9-inch pan., Bake for 7 minutes at 400°., Cool., Mix cream cheese, confectioners sugar and whipped topping; spread on pretzel mixture., Dissolve strawberry and lemon jello in boiling water. Add pineapple and strawberries., Allow mixture to cool., Spread jello and fruit on cream cheese mixture., Refrigerate., Cut into squares., Serves 16.

title: Corn Casserole
directions: Mix all., Pour into a casserole dish., Bake at 350° for approximately 30 minutes.

title: Meat Cholent
directions: Soak the beans overnight in water., Drain., Use a heavy saucepan or Dutch oven and brown meat and onions in the fat (or margarine)., Sprinkle with salt, pepper and ginger., Add beans, barley and small potatoes (peeled) and sprinkle with flour and paprika., Place uncooked eggs in shells on top., Add enough boiling water to cover one-inch above the mixture., Cover tightly., Cholent may be baked for 24 hours at 250° (125°C) or for quicker cooking, bake at 350° (180°C) for 4 to 5 hours., Serves 8 to 10.

title: Mexican Dip(This Dip Can Also Be Made Into Roll-Ups.)
directions: Mix all ingredients (except for tortillas) together. To make roll-ups, spread dip mixture over tortillas. Roll up and slice into 1 inch pieces. Place on tray and garnish with cilantro.

title: Date Balls
directions: Cook dates, sugar, butter and egg together until soft., Cool slightly and add vanilla, Rice Krispies and nuts.

title: Chicken And Rice
directions: Mix all of above., Place in 13 x 9-inch baking dish., Cook in oven at 350° for 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

title: Nutty Buns
directions: Separate biscuits; cut each in half., Brush biscuits with mayonnaise., Combine sugar, cinnamon and pecans; roll biscuits in mixture., Place 2 pieces in each greased muffin cup., Bake at 400° for 10 to 12 minutes or until golden.

title: Dirt Cake
directions: In food processor, crush cookies until they resemble dirt., Set aside., Cream together cream cheese, margarine and powdered sugar. Mix pudding and milk until well blended., Fold pudding into cream cheese mix., Fold in whipped topping., In an 8 - 10 inch plastic flowerpot, alternate layers of cookie dirt and pudding mixture. End with dirt., Top with worms., Chill several hours., Serve with sand shovel.

title: Cheese Puffs
directions: Blend cheese and butter until soft., Add flour; blend well and chill well., Roll into small balls., Bake at 500° for 7 minutes, or until brown., Makes 40., May be frozen., You may stuff olive in the cheese ball before baking.

title: Old-Fashioned Tea Cakes
directions: Mix all ingredients, except water or milk with fingertips. Add enough water or milk to make dough stiff enough to be rolled out., Roll out dough fairly thin., Sprinkle surface of dough with additional sugar., Cut dough into rounds., Place on greased cookie sheet and bake at 350° for 10 minutes or until brown., Makes about 3 dozen cookies.

title: Famous Smorgasbord Cheese Cake
directions: Mix together., Line bottom of 9 x 3-inch baking dish with this mixture (consistency of wet sand)., Pour batter over crust slowly. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until knife comes out clean.

title: Breakfast Casserole
directions: Grease a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan and preheat oven to 325°. Place bread on the bottom of pan., Sprinkle on cheese (1/2 amount)., Add 1/2 of ham or sausage., Layer cheese and remainder of meat., In a bowl beat eggs; add milk, salt and dry mustard. Pour mixture over cheese., Dot with butter., Cover and refrigerate overnight., Bake for 50 minutes to 1 hour in 325° oven., Serves 8 to 10.

title: Christmas Fudge
directions: Combine sugar, milk, syrup and salt in saucepan; mix well. Cook over low heat, stirring constantly until mixture boils and sugar dissolves., Cook to 238°, stirring frequently., Remove from heat., Add butter and vanilla., Cool to 110° without stirring. Beat until mixture loses its gloss and a small amount dropped from a spoon will hold its shape., Quickly stir in pecans, coconut and cherries., Pour into slightly greased pan, 8 x 8 x 2-inch., Let cool and cut into squares.

title: Rolled Chipped Beef
directions: Let cream cheese stand until it is room temperature., Add seasonings and mix., Spread on slice of beef., Roll and put in foil and freeze., When ready to serve, cut into bite-sized pieces and serve with toothpicks.

title: Chicken Divan
directions: Drain cooked broccoli and spread in a casserole dish., Place chicken on top and pour sauce over both., Can be made ahead. Before serving, crush 2 cups of Pepperidge Farm dressing and add about 2 sticks margarine., Cover casserole with dressing crumbs and cook at 350° for 20 minutes., Uncover and cook for 15 minutes more., This may be frozen to heat and use later.

title: Coleslaw
directions: Gather ingredients in a large bowl and mix in the order they are listed.

title: Frizzled Steak
directions: Cook steak in small amount of oil until slightly browned., Add onions, cook until transparent., Add soy sauce, sugar and 2 cups water., Cook until meat is tender, 1 1/2 to 2 hours, adding water as necessary., Add mushrooms and celery., Cook for 15 minutes longer and thicken with desired amount of cornstarch mixed with water., Serve on rice.

title: Pearl Huffman'S Wilted Lettuce Salad
directions: Mix the drippings, flour, sugar, salt, water, vinegar and egg thoroughly and boil 2 to 3 minutes., Pour over bowlful of mixed lettuce and onions., Stir in bacon bits and serve immediately.

title: Vegetable Dip
directions: Mix all ingredients in a saucepan, cook slowly, constantly stirring until cheese is melted and smooth., Cook until thick and then cool, use with cauliflower, broccoli, celery, carrots and radishes.

title: Southwest Shepherd'S Pie
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., In a large skillet over medium-high heat, cook ground beef and onion until meat is brown and onion is tender, about 5 minutes., Meanwhile, prepare potatoes according to package directions, but use 2 cups water and 3/4 cup skim milk and omit butter or margarine and salt., Place cooked meat mixture in a colander and rinse under hot water., Drain well., Wipe skillet with a paper towel., Return meat mixture to skillet over medium heat., Stir in remaining ingredients, except cheese, and heat through, about 7 minutes., Transfer meat mixture to a 2-quart casserole., Drop potato mixture in mounds on meat mixture or spread it over meat mixture., Bake, uncovered, 25 to 30 minutes or until hot., Sprinkle with cheese.

title: Blondies
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Grease 13 x 9-inch baking pan., In large bowl, stir flour, baking powder and salt., In another bowl, cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy., Beat eggs, 1 at a time., Mix vanilla., Stir in flour mixture., Fold in walnuts and chocolate chips., Spread batter in pan.

title: Chocolate Cake With Cherries
directions: Beat eggs into cake; mix powder., Add almond extract., Add 20 ounce can cherry pie filling and mix well., Grease 9 x 13-inch pan., Pour mixture into pan., Bake 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Broiled Peaches(Dresses Up Plain Meats)
directions: Place peach halves, cut side up, in baking dish., Combine allspice, orange rind, brown sugar and chopped nuts., Sprinkle mixture over peaches., Broil in preheated oven about 5 minutes or until sugar mixture is bubbling., Makes nice accompaniment for meats.

title: Baked Mostaccioli
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Cook noodles in boiling water until al dente (still a little firm); drain and place in a large bowl., In a medium-sized bowl, combine the Ricotta cheese and half the Mozzarella cheese; add to the noodles and mix., Grease a 9 x 13-inch baking dish., Cover bottom of dish with half the spaghetti sauce., Spoon the noodle mixture over the sauce., Cover with the remaining sauce., Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and the remaining Mozzarella cheese., Bake for 20 to 30 minutes., Remove from oven and let stand for 20 minutes for easier serving., Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Delightful Dill Bread Boat
directions: Soak in water the chipped beef to remove salt., Drain and chop. Mix mayonnaise, sour cream and all spices., Remove center of loaf of rye leaving a bread "bowl"., Cube bread removed plus second loaf., Fill center of bread bowl with mayonnaise mixture., Arrange bread cubes around bread bowl for dipping.

title: No Cook Fudge
directions: Melt cheese and oleo., Pour over mixed sugar, cocoa, vanilla and nuts., Mix and pour into pan., Cut in squares after it hardens.

title: Monkey Bread
directions: Cut biscuits in 1/4 pieces., Dip in margarine, roll in sugar. Put in Bundt pan in layers., Sprinkle nuts and raisins on each layer., Repeat process until 1-inch from top of pan., Drizzle remaining margarine (mixed with cinnamon and sugar) over top. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour or until top is brown.

title: Almond-Turkey Bake
directions: Heat oven to 400°., Toss 3/4 cup cheese with flour., Mix cheese mixture, turkey, celery, 1/3 cup almonds, mayonnaise, juice and seasonings., Roll pastry to 15-inch square on lightly floured surface., Place in 12 x 8-inch baking dish; trim 1-inch beyond edge., Turn under edge; flute., Fill with turkey mixture., Top with remaining cheese and almonds., Bake 30 to 35 minutes or until golden brown., Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Crawfish Dressing
directions: Saute first 4 ingredients., Add next 5 ingredients., Mix in cheese and bread crumbs., Shape into patties and dredge lightly with flour., Saute in small amount of oil until crisp or put in flat shell dishes and heat in oven., Drizzle with lemon juice or serve with lemon slices., Very good stuffing for flounder.

title: Cabbage Casserole
directions: Cook cabbage with enough water to cover cabbage and onion until tender., Drain and add soups., Gently fold together. Crumble sausage in pan and fry out grease., Drain thoroughly and chop or break up larger chunks real fine., Put on top of cabbage and serve., May need to reheat before serving.

title: Mayonnaise Cake
directions: Cream margarine and sugar; mix with dry ingredients, then add vanilla and water., Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Claudine'S Chili Con Carne
directions: Brown beef, garlic and onion in small amount of olive oil. Add remaining ingredients and mix well., Just cook until everything is hot., Recipe can be doubled for larger crowd.

title: Pecan Tassies
directions: Let cream cheese and margarine soften at room temperature. Blend together the cheese and margarine., Stir in flour., Chill 1 hour., Shape in 1-inch balls and press in mini muffin pan, bottom and sides.

title: Split Pea Chowder
directions: In 5-quart Dutch oven, combine all ingredients; bring to a boil., Reduce heat, cover and simmer approximately 2 hours or until chowder has thickened, stirring occasionally., Makes 8 (1 1/2 cup) servings.

title: Pink Cloud Salad
directions: Mix and chill., Best to set overnight.

title: Cherry Cheese Pie
directions: Soften cream cheese at room temperature., Mix cream cheese, canned milk, lemon juice and vanilla all together., Pour into a graham cracker pie shell., Chill 1 hour., Pour 1 can cherry pie filling over chilled pie., Spread evenly and serve.

title: Pineapple Salad
directions: Boil pineapple in saucepan., Add Jell-O and bring to a boil again., Remove from heat., Set in water until cool, but not set. Add other ingredients., Place in molds and refrigerate until set. Eat and enjoy.

title: Polish Steak Rolls
directions: Cut meat in approximately 3 x 3-inch pieces., Pound with meat tenderizer., Chop onion and fry with chopped bacon, until almost done., Put spoonful of drained bacon and onion in each steak piece., Roll up and put toothpick through., After you have done all meat, dip in flour and salt and pepper., Brown in skillet. Remove and make a gravy out of drippings, adding mushroom soup with some milk., Put meat in pot, pour gravy over, cover and bake in oven for 1 1/2 hours at 350°, or until tender.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Blend eggs, oil and sugar until creamy., Add flour, salt and baking soda, a little at a time; blend well (batter will be stiff)., Fold in apples, vanilla and nuts., Pour into tube pan., Bake for 1 hour., Remove from pan after about 30 minutes.

title: Applesauce Banana Bread
directions: Place bananas in large bowl and mash with electric mixer., Stir in the sugar and let stand 15 minutes., Add the applesauce and eggs and beat well., Beat in the baking soda, baking powder, salt and vanilla, then gradually beat in the flour, mixing thoroughly., Pour into a 9 x 5-inch loaf pan that has been coated with nonstick spray., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the center of the loaf comes out clean., Remove from oven and let stand 10 minutes before removing from the pan., Makes 1 loaf.

title: Mandarin Orange Cake
directions: Mix and bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes. Cool.

title: Noodle Casserole
directions: Cook rigati 12 minutes; drain., Cut up tomatoes, keeping juice; add seasonings., Slice cheese in uniform slices., Put a layer of noodles, then tomatoes, then cheese; continue until you end up with sauce and cheese., Place cubed buttered bread over entire top of dish., Bake in 325° oven for 1 hour.

title: Blueberry Coffee Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., Grease 9 x 9-inch pan., Cream together sugar and butter until light and fluffy., Add eggs and blend well. Stir in the rest of the ingredients except the blueberries. Spread half the dough in the pan., Spoon the pie filling on the top; spread the other half of dough over the pie filling., Bake about 40 minutes or until cake tests done.

title: Slush Punch
directions: Dissolve all ingredients in hot, water;, add to 1 large unsweetened pineapple juice in a gallon container; finish with water., Freeze to slush and serve with vanilla ice milk.

title: Lemon Broccoli Chicken
directions: In skillet in hot oil, cook chicken for 10 minutes, or until browned., Combine soup and milk; stir in lemon juice and pepper. Pour over chicken; top with lemon slices., Reduce heat to low. Cover; simmer for 5 minutes, until tender.

title: Kahlua Kreme Torte
directions: Bake cake according to directions, adding 1 tablespoon Kahlua to batter., Bake in 2 (9-inch) pans and cool., Split layers into 4., Melt chocolate bits over water., In large bowl, combine cream, milk and 2 tablespoons Kahlua., Slowly add instant pudding until thickened., Lay cake, cut side up., Spread 1/2 raspberry preserves., Cover 1/4 pudding., Next, add 2nd layer of cake and 1/2 chocolate., Next, 1/4 pudding mix., Repeat layers, ending with chocolate layer on top., Decorate with fresh raspberries and chocolate curls.

title: Leona'S Caramels
directions: Melt butter in heavy 3-quart saucepan. Add sugar and salt. Stir in syrup., Mix well. Gradually add milk, stirring constantly. Cook on medium heat until firm ball stage (245°) or for about 15 minutes. Remove from heat. Add vanilla and pour into well buttered 9 x 9-inch pan. Cool for 4 to 5 hours., Flip on board and cut with sharp knife and wrap each piece in wax paper.

title: Whole Wheat Italian Bread
directions: In a large bowl, sprinkle yeast over warm water and let stand for 5 minutes to soften., Stir in sugar, oil and salt., Add whole wheat flour and 1 1/2 cups all-purpose., Mix to blend., With a heavy-duty mixer or wooden spoon, beat until dough is elastic. Stir in wheat germ and 1 cup all-purpose flour., Turn out onto floured area with remaining flour., Knead until smooth., Place in greased bowl., Cover and let rise., Punch dough down; turn out onto floured surface and divide in half., Shape into loaf shape., Place on greased baking sheets; cover lightly and let rise., Bring cornstarch mixture to a boil., Brush loaves while mix is warm. Bake at 375° for 25 to 30 minutes or until browned., Cool on wire rack.

title: Salmon Casserole(Low-Fat)
directions: Coat a 2-quart shallow casserole with nonstick spray; set aside., In a large bowl, toss together the onion, crumbled salmon, celery, bell pepper, mustard, parsley and bread crumbs., Place milk in a 2-cup measure., Blend in mayonnaise., Pour over the salmon mixture and thoroughly combine., Spoon mixture into the prepared casserole., Bake in the preheated 350° oven for about 35 minutes.

title: Delicious Prune Cake
directions: Beat eggs., Add sugar and oil and beat well., Mix dry ingredients and add alternately with buttermilk., Add nuts, prunes and vanilla and bake at 350° for 30 minutes., Remove from oven and poke cake full of holes with a fork and pour the topping over the cake hot and spread.

title: Angel Food Cake
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Have ready a tube pan., Stir flour and first amount of sugar together to blend., Measure egg whites, cream of tartar and salt into large mixing bowl., Beat until foamy. Gradually add second amount of sugar, 2 tablespoons at a time. Continue beating until meringue holds stiff peaks., Add flavoring. Sprinkle sugar-flour mixture over meringue., Fold in gently until mixed., Bake in ungreased tube pan for 30 to 35 minutes., Invert on a funnel to cool.

title: Funnel Cake
directions: Beat egg., Add milk., Sift salt, sugar, flour and baking powder., Add egg and milk., Beat until smooth., Pour batter into funnel., Allow batter to run into deep fat at 375°., Make swirl in fat from center out., Drain on paper., Sprinkle with powdered sugar.

title: Hot Polish Sausage
directions: Cook Polish sausage in skillet to brown a bit., Drain off fat. Cut into 1/4-inch slices., Mix with other ingredients and cook in microwave for 5 minutes., Then cook 15 minutes more at Medium power., Stir occasionally., Serve warm with toothpicks or on small plates.

title: Microwave Meat Loaf
directions: Mix together all ingredients except ketchup., Shape into a loaf in a 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf dish., Spread ketchup over top. Cover; microwave on medium-high for 22 to 24 minutes or until no longer pink., Allow to stand, covered, for 5 minutes, before serving.

title: Championship Choco-Chip Bars
directions: In medium bowl, combine flour and sugar., Cut in oleo until crumbly., Stir in 1/2 cup chocolate chips., Press firmly into 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 15 minutes., In same bowl, combine sweetened condensed milk, egg and vanilla., Stir in remaining chocolate chips and nuts., Spread on prepared crust., Bake 20 to 25 minutes., Cool and cut into bars.

title: Vegetable Dip
directions: Mix all ingredients., Serve with fresh vegetables.

title: Turkey
directions: Thaw turkey 2-3 days., Put turkey in clean sink and remove gibblet and neck., Wash godd and dry with paper towels., Butter inside and outside of turkey., Put salt, pepper and seasoning salt on turkey., Add 1/2 cup butter inside., In roasting bag put 1 tsp. flour; shake bag and pour out., Poke holes in bag; put turkey in bag and bake at 250 degrees for 7 hours, checking every hour until golden brown.

title: Cheese Cake
directions: Pour cold water in cup and sprinkle Knox on top., Set aside. Crush graham crackers and place them in a buttered 9 x 13-inch pan and bake at 350° for 10 minutes., In a double boiler, cook next 6 ingredients until very smooth, stirring occasionally., Add Knox mixture and stir until dissolved., Pour over cooled crust. Refrigerate to set., You can add a small can of drained, crushed pineapple.

title: Fruit Dip
directions: Combine ingredients and mix well., Easy, quick and delicious!

title: Sherry Trifle
directions: Arrange layer of ladyfingers in attractive dish or serving bowl, 1-quart size., Sprinkle ladyfingers with sherry., Make up Jell-O according to package directions; pour Jell-O over ladyfingers., Chill until set.

title: Banana Nut Cake
directions: Cream shortening, sugar and flavoring., Add 1 egg at a time. Sift flour, soda and salt together., Add alternately with milk. Add bananas and nuts., Bake at 325° in greased and floured cake pans until toothpick comes out clean.

title: Plantation Potatoes
directions: Place potatoes in a buttered 9 x 13-inch baking dish., Add bell pepper and pimentos., Mix lightly., Combine milk and salt and pour over potato mixture., Cover with foil., Bake in a 350° oven for 1 1/2 hours or until potatoes are fork-tender., Remove foil., Cover with mixture of bread crumbs and cheese., Drizzle 1/3 cup butter over top., Continue baking for 15 minutes or until cheese melts.

title: One Of A Kind Meat Loaf
directions: Mix all ingredients well., Mold into loaf pan., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour., Serves 4 hungry people.

title: Zesty Mexican Chicken
directions: Boil chicken until cooked thoroughly, cool and separate. Preheat oven to 425°. In a large casserole dish, combine all ingredients and mix well. Sprinkle top with 1/2 cup of both cheeses and bake for about 30 minutes or until cheese is melted.

title: Amazing Coconut Pie
directions: Combine sugar, Bisquick, butter and vanilla. Add eggs and beat well. Add milk, mixing well. Pour into 9-inch pie pan. Sprinkle with coconut. Bake at 350° for 40 minutes. Serve warm or cold.

title: Brown Rice
directions: Melt the butter in a, small skillet., Add the onion and cook until transparent.	Put into a casserole dish and add the soup and rice., Stir and bake for one hour at 375°.

title: Tropical Banana-Nut Cake
directions: Sift together in large bowl the flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda and salt., Add shortening, bananas and 1/3 cup buttermilk; stir to dampen flour., Beat at medium speed 2 minutes with mixer or 300 hand strokes., Add eggs, vanilla and remaining buttermilk., Beat 2 minutes longer (or 300 more strokes)., Fold in chopped nuts., Pour into 2 paper lined 9 x 1 1/2-inch round pans. Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes., Cool and frost as desired.

title: Uncooked Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Combine sugar, cocoa, butter and milk; heat to boiling point in large pan, stirring constantly., Boil for 1 minute and 30 seconds., Remove from heat; add oats and beat well., Add vanilla and peanut butter., Beat well., Drop on wax paper and let cool.

title: Diabetic Peanut Butter Cookies
directions: Mix and stir all ingredients in order given:, flour, baking soda, baking powder and salt., These can be sifted once if you prefer., Add beaten egg and mix well with vegetable shortening, peanut butter and Sweet 'N Low., Add dry ingredients., Drop by large teaspoonful on greased cookie sheet., Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.

title: Snap Peas And Peppers
directions: About 30 minutes before serving or early in day, cut yellow peppers into 2 x 3/4-inch pieces., Cut celery diagonally into 1/4-inch thick slices., Remove stem and strings along both edges of each pea pod., In nonstick 12-inch skillet over medium-high heat, in 1 tablespoon hot olive or salad oil, cook yellow peppers, celery, 3/4 teaspoon salt and 1/4 teaspoon black pepper, stirring frequently, until vegetables are tender and lightly browned, about 10 minutes., Remove vegetables to bowl., In same skillet, in 2 teaspoons hot olive or salad oil, cook snap peas, 1/2 teaspoon salt and 1/4 teaspoon black pepper, stirring frequently, until peas are tender-crisp, about 4 minutes., Stir pepper mixture into snap peas in skillet., Spoon vegetables onto platter., If not serving right away, cover and refrigerate to serve cold later., Garnish with basil sprig if you like., Makes 6 accompaniment servings.

title: Cheese Cake Cookies
directions: Mix and bake at 375° for 12 minutes.

title: Hot Crab, Artichoke And Jalapeno Dip With Pita Triangles
directions: In a small heavy skillet, cook the bell pepper in the oil over moderate heat, stirring, until it is softened and let it cool., In a large bowl, combine the bell pepper, artichokes, mayonnaise, scallions, pimiento, Parmesan, lemon juice, Worcestershire sauce, jalapeno peppers and celery salt., Blend the mixture until it is combined well and stir in the crab meat gently.

title: 7-Up Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients well., Bake in greased and floured 8 or 9-inch pans for 35 minutes., Bake and remove from pans., Frost cake with 7-Up Cake Custard.

title: French Fried Hot Dogs
directions: Combine dry ingredients in bowl., Add onion and water., Beat with rotary beater for 2 minutes., Dip hot dogs in batter, holding with kitchen fork or tongs., Drain off excess batter over the bowl. Fry in hot, deep fat (375°) for 2 to 3 minutes., Drain on paper towel., Insert wooden skewers., Serve with mustard.

title: Greek Spinach Pie(Spanakopetes)
directions: Thaw frozen spinach at room temperature for 2 hours., Drain and chop into small pieces., Heat oil and saute scallions until soft and wilted., Add spinach and simmer until moisture evaporates. Rinse feta in cold water, drain and crumble it into bowl., Blend in pot cheese, parsley, pepper and dill., Add beaten eggs and mix well., Add spinach and scallions and mix well., Butter 11 x 14 x 2-inch pan and line it with about 12 to 15 sheets of phyllo, each sheet individually brushed with warm melted butter., Spread spinach and cheese mixture on top., Cover with about 12 to 15 more individually buttered phyllo sheets on top of one another., Roll or push edges of phyllo down all around the pan to hold in mixture. Brush entire top and edges with warm melted butter.

title: Microwave Monkey Bread
directions: Cut refrigerated biscuits into quarters., Place butter in round microwave cake dish and microwave for 1 minute, 30 seconds or until butter milts., Stir brown sugar and ground cinnamon into butter., Add biscuits and stir to coat with mixture. Arrange biscuits evenly in dish., Microwave on high for, 4 or 5 minutes. remove from oven and sprinkle, with cinnamon sugar., Best when served hot.

title: Snack Crackers
directions: Combine oil, dry Ranch dressing mix and dill weed; stir well. Pour over crackers., Let stand at room temperature for 2 hours, stirring occasionally., Store in airtight container.

title: Three-Minute Coconut Pie
directions: Combine cooled margarine, sugar, eggs, buttermilk and vanilla in a bowl; mix well., Stir in coconut., Pour into pie shell., Bake at 325° for 35 to 45 minutes or until set., Yields 8 servings.

title: Vegetable Pizza
directions: Open crescent rolls and flatten on cookie sheet, pinching seams together., Bake until brown., Mix Miracle Whip, cream cheese and salad mix together; spread on baked rolls., Chill overnight. In blender, chop vegetables., Put vegetables and cream cheese over baked rolls about 1 to 2 hours before serving.

title: Easy Hot Rice
directions: Mix in frying pan., Add water., Cook until rice is tender.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
directions: Mix all ingredients together; drop by teaspoon and press with fork on ungreased cookie sheet., Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes., Makes 30 to 36 cookies.

title: Gazpacho
directions: Puree all ingredients in blender. Chill., Serve in well chilled soup bowls., Pass as a garnish croutons, finely diced cucumbers, onion and green pepper.

title: Broiled Coconut Topping
directions: In small bowl, combine all ingredients., Spread evenly over top of hot 8-inch or 9-inch square cake., Run under broiler, 4 inches from heat, 2 to 3 minutes, or until topping is bubbly and golden., Cool cake in pan on wire rack; serve slightly warm.

title: Chili
directions: After sauteing meat and onion together, add other ingredients. Cook over medium heat or in a crock-pot for approximately 1 hour.

title: Lemon Tea Bread
directions: Grease a 9 x 5 x 3-inch pan., Preheat oven to 325°., Heat the milk with the herbs and let steep until cool.

title: Three Bean Salad
directions: Drain beans and peas., Add onion, pepper and pimento., In a saucepan, combine sugar, vinegar, salt and chili powder., Mix and bring to a boil., Simmer., Mix vegetables and sauce together and refrigerate.

title: Eggplant Casserole
directions: Peel and slice eggplants; boil with onion and bell pepper until done., Drain and mash., Add oleo, beaten egg and milk; mix, then add soup and stuffing mix., Put into casserole., Cover; bake at 350° for about 35 minutes., Top with cheese; bake until cheese is melted.

title: Easy Quiche
directions: Mix in blender., Put in anything else such as ham, bacon, cheese, green peppers or mushrooms., Pour into greased pie pan and bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Mrs. Truman'S Ozark Pudding
directions: Mix first 6 ingredients., Pour over apples and nuts., Bake in buttered pie dish at 350° for 35 minutes., Serve with ice cream or whipped cream.

title: Frozen Daiquiris
directions: Mix rum, 7-Up, sugar, lemonade and limeade concentrates and water together., Place in a large plastic container; cover and freeze., When ready to serve, spoon some of mixture into glass and add the same amount of extra 7-Up.

title: Snow Ice Cream
directions: Mix condensed milk in medium size bowl of snow., Add vanilla and taste; add snow until it is as you like it.

title: Gingerbread
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Pour boiling water over shortening. Add sugar, molasses and egg, then beat well., Add sifted dry ingredients and beat until smooth., Pour in ungreased 8 x 8-inch pan and bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350°.

title: Banana Cake
directions: Combine all ingredients in order given, combining baking powder with the flour., Use just enough hot water to dissolve the soda. Bake at 350°.

title: Punch Bowl Cake
directions: Crumble 1/2 of cake in punch bowl., Add chocolate pudding and cherries., Crumble remaining cake and add vanilla pudding., Spread blueberries over vanilla pudding., Spread Cool Whip on top. Garnish with pecans.

title: Amish Peanut Butter Pie
directions: Mix peanut butter and sugar together until very crumbly., Put layer of Jif and sugar mixture in bottom of baked pie shell., Add pie filling, then layer of Jif and sugar mixture., Top with Cool Whip or whipped cream., Add rest of Jif and sugar mixture on top of pie., Keep refrigerated.

title: Wonderful Pound Cake
directions: Cream together shortening and sugar., Add eggs, one at a time, mixing well., Blend in flour and vanilla; mix well., Pour into greased and floured tube pan., Place in cold oven., Turn oven to 325°., Bake for 1 1/2 hours., Do not open oven door during baking time., If desired, add 1 teaspoon lemon or butter flavoring instead of vanilla flavoring.

title: No Cook Cookies
directions: Boil first 3 ingredients 1 minute., Mix together and then spoon onto cookie sheet or plate and allow to firm and cool.

title: Seven Layer Salad
directions: Break head of lettuce in small pieces., Place in bottom of dish., Dice onion., Layer on top of head of lettuce., Dice bell pepper., Layer on top of onion., Grate carrots., Layer on top of bell pepper., Dice celery., Layer on top of carrots., Layer peas on top of celery., Grate the eggs and layer on top of peas., Mix sugar with Hellmann's mayonnaise., Cover salad with mayonnaise., Sprinkle fancy shredded cheese over the mayonnaise.

title: Cheese Sticks
directions: Finely grate cheese., Blend with butter and flour., Roll in small balls and put on cookie sheet., Flatten with spatula. Refrigerate for 4 hours., Bake 7 minutes at 350°., Makes about 24., Place pan under broiler for a minute to brown them.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Cook and drain broccoli., Add milk and Minute rice., Add cream of chicken soup., Stir in grated cheese., Place in greased casserole dish and bake 25 minutes at 350°.

title: Banana Nut Bread
directions: Mix sugar and oleo; add eggs one at a time., Mix flour and soda., Add to sugar and egg mixture., Add bananas, milk and vanilla., Mix well; pour in greased and floured tube pan., Bake 1 1/2 hours at 325°.

title: Souper Sausage Cornbread
directions: In bowl, combine soup, eggs and milk., Stir in muffin mix just until blended., Fold in sausage., Spoon mixture into a greased 9 x 13-inch baking pan., Bake at 400° for about 20 minutes or until lightly brown.

title: Garden Stuffed Mushrooms
directions: Heat oven to 350°., In small bowl, stir together all ingredients except mushrooms., Stuff each mushroom cap with 1 tablespoon filling., Place in buttered 13 x 9 baking pan., Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until tender.

title: Banana Cream Pie
directions: Mix sugar, cornstarch and salt in saucepan., Blend milk and egg yolks., Gradually stir into sugar mixture., Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until mixture thickens and boils., Boil and stir 1 minute., Remove from heat and blend in butter and vanilla., Place plastic wrap onto filling in saucepan and cool to room temperature.

title: Sweet And Sour Chicken
directions: Combine pineapple and juice, salad dressing and onions in baking dish., Place chicken in mixture., Bake at 375° for 45 minutes., Stir once., Other pieces of chicken can be used.

title: Zucchini And Squash Provincial
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Place the zucchini in the bottom of a 9 x 13-inch dish., Top with onion., Sprinkle uncooked rice over the onion., Cut 1 tablespoon margarine into pieces and dot over casserole; top with yellow squash., Add tomatoes, spices and juice. Dot with 2 tablespoons margarine., Cover tightly with foil and bake 50 minutes., Remove from oven., Remove foil and top with cheese. Bake an additional 5 to 10 minutes until the cheese is melted.

title: Company Ham Casserole
directions: Cook the spaghetti; drain, rinse and set aside., Saute onions lightly in butter or margarine in pan; stir in flour., Stir in broth, milk and half and half., Cook, stirring, until thickened. Take off heat.

title: Chocolate No-Bakes
directions: Mix together milk, sugar, cocoa, margarine and salt in a pan. Bring to a boil., Let boil 3 to 4 minutes., Remove from heat and add last 3 ingredients., Mix and drop by spoonful on wax paper. Let harden.

title: Cranberry Mold
directions: Dissolve Jell-O in 1 cup hot water., Add cranberry sauce. Dissolve., Add drained pineapple., With the pineapple liquid you have saved, make 1 1/2 cups, adding water if necessary., Mix. Pour into mold and refrigerate until ready.

title: Mini Micro Meat Loaves
directions: Mix all ingredients together. Form into oblong mini loaf pans (about 8)., Bake on High or full power in your microwave for 8 minutes. Remove and drain grease. Turn loaves over and cook another 5 minutes., Remove and let stand 5 minutes before serving.

title: Sharon'S Gingersnaps
directions: Add sugar, shortening, molasses and egg together in mixing bowl., Blend well., Stir in remaining ingredients., Chill., Form into 1 inch balls and roll in sugar., Place on lightly greased cookie sheet 2 inches apart., Bake at 375° for 8 to 10 minutes. Makes 48 cookies.

title: Zucchini Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Olive Balls
directions: Grate cheese and let soften., Blend in butter and paprika. Work in flour until smooth and deep yellow color., Let stand for 15 minutes., Pinch 1 teaspoonful off; roll in palm and flatten. Place around a well drained olive., Chill for 10 minutes or freeze., Heat at 375° for 20 to 25 minutes, 30 if frozen.

title: Spanish Beef In A Bun
directions: Chop stuffed olives in blender., Place beef, olives and tomatoes in a Dutch oven., Simmer until beef falls off the bones. Skim off any fat and remove bones., No additional seasoning is needed., Heap on buns or French rolls., Serve with a salad and beans, if desired.

title: Coconut Cake(Portuguese)
directions: Mix everything until it bubbles., Put in the oven in a round mold., Sprinkle with butter. Bake at 350° for 1 hour., Wait until it is cold to put it on a plate., Preparation time:, 10 minutes.

title: Pink Champagne Salad
directions: Mix sugar and cheese., Add other ingredients and refrigerate.

title: Buttermilk Coconut Custard Pie
directions: Melt margarine or butter., While butter is melting, hand beat 6 eggs., Add the eggs to sugar, then margarine., Mix buttermilk well, then coconut and vanilla flavoring., Makes 2 pies., Put in unbaked pie crusts and bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Squash Fritters
directions: Cover squash with enough water to cover., Boil until tender and add salt and pepper., When tender, drain and add 2 eggs and butter., Mix ingredients with enough crushed crackers to make the mixture into patties; then roll in crushed cracker crumbs, and you're ready to deep-fry in hot oil., Cook until golden brown and serve.

title: Watergate Cake
directions: Mix the first 5 ingredients., Beat 2 minutes., Fold in nuts. Pour into a greased and floured tube pan., Bake at 350° for 45 to 55 minutes.

title: Chess Cake
directions: Mix cake mix, butter and egg., Pat in greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Mix rest of ingredients together and pour on top., Bake 30 to 40 minutes at 350°., Cool., Cut in 1 1/2-inch squares.

title: Oven Beef Stew
directions: Mix all in covered casserole., Bake at 350° for 3 1/2 to 4 hours., Serves 4., Good with corn bread.

title: Sausage Cooked In Wine
directions: Cut sausage any length desired., Pour wine and water over it. Cook in a 450° oven until done.

title: Mama'S Biscuits - Uuuuuuum Good!
directions: Add buttermilk until they are moist, and sticky to the touch. Put on floured pastry cloth or I use some waxed paper with flour on it., Just wet the countertop a little and place the waxed paper on it and it will not move., Disposable after you're through and easy clean up., I just take the dough and put it on the flour and press it with my hands and then use a cutter and make the biscuits., I do not use a rolling pin., Do not work the dough or they will be dough., Try it; you'll love it!, Easy and delicious!

title: Mexican Meat Loaf
directions: Mix all ingredients well., Shape into loaf., Bake in a 350° oven for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Delicious Rye Bread
directions: Dissolve yeast in lukewarm water to which you have added the sugar., Let stand till yeast is thoroughly dissolved., Add syrup, honey, brown sugar, molasses, rye flour, shortening and salt together in large mixing bowl., Add warm water and stir till well mixed., Add enough white flour to make a soft dough., Pour onto pastry sheet and knead till dough is still sticky when touched by hands., Dough should not be to stiff., Place in large mixing bowl and cover., Let rise in warm place till double., Place on pastry sheet and pinch of enough to make a round ball., There should be enough for 5 or 6 balls., Let stand for 10 minutes shape into loaves., Place in a well greased pans and set in warm place to rise till doubled in bulk., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes., Remove from pans and cool on cake racks., This should make 5 or 6 loaves, depending on size of pans. 9 1/2 x 5 1/2 is about right., This bread freezes well and makes delicious toast.

title: English Muffin Bread
directions: Combine 3 cups flour, yeast, sugar, salt and baking soda., Heat liquids until very warm (120-130 degrees F)., Add to dry mixture, beat well., Stir in enough flour to make a stiff batter., Spoon into 2 (8 1/2 x 4 1/2) pans that have been greased and sprinkled with cornmeal., Sprinkle tops with cornmeal., Cover and let rise in warm place for 45 minutes., Bake at 400 degrees for 25 minutes. Remove from pans immediately and cool on racks.

title: Sour Cream Lemon Pie
directions: Cook sugar, flour, milk, salt and egg yolks in a double boiler until it starts to thicken., Then add lemon juice; cook until it thickens., Cool., Fold in sour cream and place in a pie crust. Add topping of Cool Whip and chopped pecans.

title: Crepes Suzette(Low-Fat)
directions: Mix all ingredients until very smooth., Heat skillet; spray with Pam., Pour 2 tablespoons of mixture in skillet and spread over bottom of skillet., Brown crepe on both sides., Spread crepe with butter, jelly, syrup or fresh fruit., Can be rolled up like jelly roll and sprinkled with nuts and powdered sugar.

title: Twinkies Delight
directions: Put Twinkies in bottom of pan., Place fruit with juice over Twinkies., Put Cool Whip over fruit and chill for 1 hour., Great afternoon snack.

title: Lemon Cheese Salad
directions: Mix the first 3 ingredients with 1 3/4 cups boiling water. When partly set, add the remaining ingredients., Mix everything together and refrigerate until set.

title: Asparagus Casserole
directions: Cook asparagus as directed until barely tender; drain., Melt butter in a small pan; stir in flour, salt and pepper, blending until smooth., Add milk and cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until thickened and bubbly., Turn half of the asparagus into a 1-quart casserole., Top with half the eggs., Pour half the sauce over the asparagus., Repeat with remaining asparagus, eggs and sauce., Bake 20 to 30 minutes at 325°., One pound fresh or one pound drained canned asparagus can be used.

title: Macadamia Yokan
directions: Tear kanten into, pieces; soak in water for 30 minutes. Cook until dissolved., Add, sugar, and, salt; stir until sugar dissolves.	Add, koshian; cook over medium flame until mixture comes to a boil., Add, nuts., Pour into an 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Cool.

title: Chocolate Mayonnaise Cake
directions: Stir flour, sugar, cocoa, baking powder, baking soda and salt; mix thoroughly. Add mayonnaise, water and vanilla and beat well for 3 minutes. Grease and flour a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Pour mixture into pan. Bake in a 350° oven for 40 to 45 minutes. When cake cools, frost or use whipped cream.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
directions: Cream butter and sugars together., Add in eggs and vanilla. Mix well together., Add baking soda and salt (if desired) in. Gradually mix in flour., After everything is mixed together and batter is smooth, add in chocolate chips and nuts., Drop in spoonfuls on cookie sheet., Bake at 350°, for 7 to 10 minutes. Edges should just be browning.

title: Stuffed Green Peppers
directions: Remove seed from peppers and wash., Combine salt, pepper, rice, browned ground beef, milk and onion.	Stuff peppers lightly and place in pan., Add tomato soup and water, then cover., Cook for 30 minutes at 300°.

title: Unbaked Fruit Cake
directions: Melt margarine and marshmallows in a saucepan over low heat. When melted, add crumbs., Mix.

title: "You Got Chocolate On My Peanut Butter" Candy
directions: Mix together peanut butter, sugar and butter., Spread in a 9 x 13-inch pan., Melt chocolate bars over low heat, stirring constantly., Smooth over pressed mixture., Refrigerate., When cooled, cut into squares.

title: Pork Chops And Apples
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Brown chops on all sides in hot oil. Place apple slices in baking dish sprayed with no-stick cooking spray., Sprinkle apples with sugar and cinnamon., Dot with butter. Top with pork chops., Cover and bake 1 hour.

title: Beef Stroganoff
directions: Brown meat strips in 1/4 cup butter., Push meat to one side; add mushrooms and onion., Cook just until tender., Add broth. Heat to boiling., Blend sour cream and flour; stir into broth. Cook and stir until mixture thickens (sauce will be thin)., Season to taste., Serve over rice or buttered noodles., Makes 4 to 5 servings.

title: Easy Pie
directions: Melt margarine in baking dish., Combine sugar and flour; stir in milk., Add baking powder, salt and egg, mixing well., Pour into baking dish., Add 1 cup fruit in center of batter., Bake at 400°. Yield:, 6 servings.

title: Grandma Burgess' Banana Bread
directions: Cream together brown sugar and shortening., Add bananas, vanilla and egg., In separate bowl combine soda, flour, salt and baking powder., Add sour milk to brown sugar/banana bowl and stir thoroughly., Add nuts if desired., Pour into bread pan after spraying generously with Pam., Bake at 350° for 50 minutes or until toothpick inserted in middle comes out clean.

title: Chili
directions: Brown chili meat and drain grease., Add all other ingredients and cook slowly for 3 hours.

title: Pizza Casserole
directions: Brown hamburger and onion and season with salt, pepper and garlic., Drain hamburger of grease and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese., Cook noodles; drain and add enough milk and butter to keep moist., Sprinkle with Parmesan.

title: No Bake Strawberry Pie
directions: Nine packets of Sweet 'N Low may be substituted for sugar.

title: Angel Hash Salad
directions: Combine in saucepan the cornstarch and sugar., Mix well; combine and add egg yolks and syrup from pineapple and cocktail. Blend well., Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until thickened., Cool thoroughly., Fold in cream, walnuts, marshmallows, crushed pineapple and fruit cocktail., Cover and chill overnight., Just before serving, you may add bananas., Serve on lettuce leaves.

title: Cheesy Vegetables
directions: Boil vegetables until just tender; drain well and put in shallow casserole dish (approximately 8 x 8-inch)., Salt and pepper vegetables., Place slices of Velveeta cheese to cover top of all vegetables., Make crumb topping of oleo and crackers. Sprinkle over top., Bake at 350° until cheese melts, approximately 20 to 30 minutes., This can be made ahead of time and refrigerated until mealtime.

title: Lasagna
directions: Cook the first 4 ingredients in 3 tablespoons oil until soft, but not brown., Add meat and stir until meat loses red color., Add tomatoes, tomato sauce and tomato paste., Cook for 1 hour.

title: Squash Casserole
directions: Cook squash in small amount of water until tender. Drain well and mash. In a separate bowl, beat eggs. Saute onion in margarine. Add squash, eggs, milk, brown sugar and salt to onions. Mix well. In buttered 2-quart casserole dish, put 1 layer of crackers, 1 layer of squash mixture and 1 layer of cheese. Repeat 3 layers; top with cracker crumbs and dot with butter. Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Souper Corn Bread
directions: Preheat oven to 400°. Combine soup, eggs and milk. Stir in muffin mix just until blended. Gently fold in sausage., Grease 9-inch baking pan. Pour in mixture and bake 20 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean from center., Serves 6.

title: My Sister'S Lemon Pound Cake
directions: Cream butter, Crisco and sugar., Add eggs, 1 at a time., Sift flour and baking powder., Add alternately flour, milk and extracts to mixture., Bake in tube pan 1 hour and 15 minutes at 325°.

title: Dried Beef Casserole
directions: Stir milk into soup until well blended and remaining ingredients., Pour into well greased 1 1/2 qt baking dish., Store covered in refrigerator 3-4 hours or overnight., Bake uncovered at 350° for 1 hour., Serves 4-6.

title: Hay Stacks
directions: Melt butterscotch morsels over hot water in double boiler. Add oil, marshmallows and noodles., Drop by spoonfuls on cookie sheet or wax paper.

title: Peanut Butter And Jelly Cookies
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Mix about half the cake mix, the peanut butter, margarine, water and eggs in a large bowl until smooth. Stir in remaining cake mix., Shape dough into 1-inch balls., Roll balls in chopped peanuts., Place about 3 inches apart on cookie sheet sprayed with Pam., Press thumbprint deeply in center of each ball., Bake 8 to 10 minutes., Cool., Fill thumbprints with jelly. Makes about 6 dozen.

title: Crawfish Etouffee
directions: Saute chopped vegetables in oleo for about 20 minutes on medium heat., Add soups, Ro-Tel and seasonings., Cook 15 minutes on low heat, stirring frequently., Add seafood and cook 20 minutes., Just before serving, add parsley., You may also add chopped green onion tops., Serve over rice.

title: Hummingbird Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°. Sift flour, sugar, soda, salt and cinnamon in electric mixer on "blend" speed; add eggs, bananas, oil, vanilla, nuts and pineapple. Bake in two 10-inch layer cake pans 1 hour and 20 minutes. Cool and frost.

title: Spanish Rice
directions: Brown the rice with the margarine., When it is as brown as you like it, add the onion, bell pepper, garlic and cilantro., Also add salt and pepper to taste., Continue to stir until the onion becomes clear looking., Add the tomatoes; stir., Cover; let simmer until rice is done., You may want to add water, also., Just don't add too much; otherwise, you will lose the flavor and it will be flat. Continue to watch it so it does not scorch.

title: Shrimp Mold
directions: Heat soup., Add dissolved gelatine while stirring constantly. Mash the cream cheese and add soup mixture., Add mayonnaise and mix. Add shrimp and crab meat, then other ingredients., Mix well (with a mixer)., Pour into a greased mold and chill.

title: Orange Cake
directions: Cream shortening and sugar., Add eggs, one at a time., Add flour mixture alternately with buttermilk., Add one grated orange rind and vanilla., Bake at 325° to 350°., Bake in tube pan.

title: Spinach And Eggs, Italian-Style
directions: Saute green onions (use blades, too) in a little butter or oleo and olive oil., Mix spinach (drained) into skillet., Stir 2 beaten eggs into the mixture and stir until eggs are done., Top with Parmesan cheese.

title: French Dressing
directions: Mix together and refrigerate.

title: Dump Cake
directions: In a greased 9 x 2 x 13-inch pan dump undrained pineapple and spread evenly., Dump dry cake mix evenly over pineapple., Cut margarine into thin slices and cover cake mix., Sprinkle pecans over top and then sprinkle brown sugar., Bake at 375° 50 minutes approximately.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Melt margarine and stir in dressing mix. In a large baking dish (9 x 13), place a layer of crumbs and a layer of chicken. Dilute mushroom and chicken soups with 2 cans of broth from stewed chicken. Pour soups over the crumbs and chicken. Top well with a few crumbs. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Creamy Zucchini Soup
directions: Saute onions and garlic in butter until tender but not browned., Combine in a large saucepan the broth, zucchini, celery, parsley, salt, dill weed, basil and pepper., Heat to boiling. Stir in onion mixture., Simmer 30 minutes., Blend soup in 2 or 3 batches in blender until smooth., Return to pan and stir in milk. Heat., May be served hot or cold., Garnish with grated Parmesan cheese or lemon slices., You can substitute broccoli, spinach or cauliflower for zucchini.

title: Cranberry Nut Loaf
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Grease two 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pans. Sift dry ingredients., Cut in shortening until mixture resembles coarse cornmeal., Combine orange juice, rind and egg., Pour all at once into dry ingredients., Mix slightly. Carefully fold in cranberries and nuts. Spoon into prepared pans., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Chocolate Pie
directions: Mix all ingredients and cook over medium heat until done. Pour into cooked pie shell., Top with beaten egg whites and brown.

title: Baskin Robbins Pie
directions: First fix crust with first three ingredients., Bake at 350° about 25 minutes., Let cool.

title: Mary Frances Glass' Chicken And Rice Salad
directions: Combine cooked chicken, rice, dressings and chopped ingredients., Prepare and refrigerate 12 to 24 hours before serving., Serve cold.

title: Cajun Seafood Gumbo
directions: Dissolve roux in water and boil about 1/2 hour., Add chopped onions., Cook additional 1/2 hour., Add okra., Add salt and pepper to taste with crawfish boil added., Add tomato sauce and seafood. When gumbo comes to boil, lower heat and cook 15 to 20 minutes. Add file if desired., Serve over rice.

title: Grandma Mary'S Fudge
directions: Mix chocolate chips, Marshmallow Creme, vanilla, nuts and oleo in big bowl., Cook evaporated milk and sugar together., Stir constantly until boiling., Lower heat and continue cooking for 10 minutes., Pour over mixture in large bowl., Stir until all chocolate is melted., Pour into pans and let set for 4 to 6 hours.

title: Yuletide Kisses
