directions: Beat egg whites with electric mixer until foamy. Sprinkle salt and cream of tartar over top and continue beating until point that egg whites will stand upright. Add sugar gradually, beating meanwhile. Add vanilla and mix well., Fold in pecans. Drop by spoonfuls on lightly greased baking sheets. Bake in preheated oven at 275° for 15 to 20 minutes., Yields approximately 5 dozen. Store in airtight container.

title: Russian Tea Cakes
directions: Sift flour and salt together. Add powdered sugar, margarine and vanilla. Add nuts. Chill dough. Roll into 1-inch balls., Place on ungreased sheet., Bake until set but not brown. While still warm, roll in powdered sugar., Cool. Roll in sugar again. Bake in a 400° oven for 10 minutes., Makes 4 dozen.

title: North Carolina Corn Pone
directions: Mix ingredients well., Bake or fry in pones (small cakes) until light brown., If baking, bake at 400° for 15 minutes.

title: Fresh Peach Cake
directions: Combine oil and sugar, beating well. Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition., Combine flour, soda, salt and cinnamon., Mix well., Gradually add to creamed mixture, mixing until blended., Stir in peaches and pecans., Spoon into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch glass pan., Bake at 325° for 40 to 45 minutes. Serve with whipped cream.

title: Fudge Pie(Easy)
directions: Melt the chocolate and margarine over low-medium heat., Add sugar, flour, eggs, vanilla and salt., Pour into a greased and floured 9-inch pie pan., Top with pecan pieces., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes., Makes a brownie-like pie., Good served with a dollop of ice cream.

title: "Mike'S Buffalo Chicken"
directions: Mix red devil sauce, vinegar, Worcestershire and soy sauce and pour over chicken., Chicken should be face down. Put in fridge overnight.

title: Forgotten Cookies
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Beat egg whites until foamy and start to get stiff., Add sugar gradually and continue to beat until very stiff., Fold in pinch of salt., Add chocolate chips, chopped pecans and vanilla; mix well., Drop by teaspoonfuls onto greased foil., Place foil on oven rack and turn oven off., Leave in oven overnight., Be sure to turn oven off and put a note on oven "do not turn on."

title: Chicken Divan
directions: In 13 x 9-inch pan layer broccoli and sliced Fri Chik that has been sauteed with chopped onion., Mix together next 5 ingredients and pour over broccoli and Fri Chik., Layer on grated cheese and cover with buttered crumbs., Bake 45 minutes at 350°., Serve over rice.

title: Mississippi Mud
directions: Melt the oleo and cocoa in saucepan., In a medium bowl, mix sugar, flour and eggs., After mixed, add nuts and melted mixture. Chill for 30 to 60 minutes.

title: Tomatoes Au Gratin(Low-Fat)
directions: Cut the tomatoes in half crosswise., Gently squeeze the pieces to remove the excess juice., Place cut-side up in a small casserole dish., Bake at 350° for 10 minutes., In a small bowl, mix the bread crumbs, Parmesan, parsley, lemon juice, oil and garlic powder., Carefully spoon the mixture over the tomatoes and into the cavities left by the seeds., Bake for 15 minutes or until the tomatoes are softened and the crumbs are lightly browned.

title: String Pasta
directions: Cook pasta and drain., Place into large bowl and add other ingredients., Chill.

title: Hamburger-Noodle Bake(Party Fare)
directions: In a large skillet, cook beef, onion and green pepper, half at a time, until meat is brown., Drain off fat., Cook noodles according to package directions; drain well., Return noodles to kettle., Stir in meat mixture and next 7 ingredients., Add 2 cups water and mix well.

title: Chocolate Pie
directions: Melt butter in microwave., Mix in cocoa, flour, 1 1/2 cups sugar and egg yolks., Add milk., Microwave on High for 3 minutes; stir., Microwave on High 4 more minutes., Stir in vanilla; pour into prepared pie crust., Whip egg whites on high., Gradually add 1/4 cup sugar and 1 teaspoon vanilla; whip until peaks., Fold into pie., Bake at 375° for about 5 minutes.

title: Spoon Bread
directions: Heat milk to scalding., Add butter and salt slowly., Stir in corn meal., Boil gently for 1 minute, stirring constantly., Remove from heat., Cool 5 minutes; then stir in well beaten egg yolks. Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites., Pour into greased 5 cup casserole and bake in a 375° oven for 35 to 40 minutes., Serve spooned from dish with butter., Makes 5 servings.

title: Wedding Cookies
directions: Mix shortening, water, vanilla and egg white., Mix in cake mix, nuts and chips until dough holds together., Shape dough into balls., Place on ungreased cookie sheet., Bake in a 375° oven until almost set., Dip tops in powdered sugar.

title: Potato Salad
directions: Stir all ingredients well., Garnish with boiled eggs, onion rings and paprika., Chill.

title: Hot Roll Mix
directions: Dissolve yeast into water; set aside., Scald milk; add oil, sugar, eggs, salt and flour., Knead and put back into bowl., Let rise; punch down and rise again., Roll into balls; put into greased pan., Let rise again., Bake at 375° for 15 to 20 minutes. Take out and put butter on top.

title: Peanut Butter Cups
directions: Mix peanut butter, powdered sugar and margarine; pat into bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan., Melt chocolate and smooth over top. Chill., Cut in squares.

title: Beef Steak In Soy Sauce
directions: Pound meat with the dull edge of a cleaver to tenderize it. Slice into strips about 2 x 4-inches.

title: Punch
directions: Mix ingredients with water needed for Kool-Aid, lemonade and orange juice., Chill., At serving time, add 7-Up, Sprite or ginger ale., Serves 50.

title: Crock-Pot Scalloped Potatoes
directions: First, peel and slice potatoes thick and put in kettle. Bring to boil., Remove immediately and drain., Grease crock-pot and layer them in there; cook until done., Sprinkle paprika on top and always end up with soup on top., You can also bake this in a 9 x 13-inch pan for 15 minutes, uncovered and cook for 45 minutes at 375°.

title: Sweet Pea Guacamole
directions: In food processor bowl with metal blade or blender container, combine all ingredients except tomato., Blend until smooth., Spoon into serving dish., Cover., Refrigerate 1 or 2 hours to blend flavors.

title: Easy Lasagne I
directions: Brown beef in 3 quart saucepan; drain fat., Add sauce and water, simmer about 10 minutes., Combine remaining ingredients, except noodles, for filling., Pour about 1 cup of sauce on bottom of 9 x 13 x 2-inch baking dish., Lay 3 pieces of uncooked lasagne on top, followed by about 1 1/2 cups sauce., Spread half of cheese filling over sauce., Repeat layers of lasagne, sauce and cheese filling., Top with layer of lasagne and remaining sauce., Cover with foil and bake at 350° 55 to 60 minutes., Remove foil; bake about 10 minutes longer., Allow to stand about 10 minutes before cutting for easier handling., Freezes well., Serves 8 to 10.

title: Golden Ham Pie
directions: Heat oven to 450°., Saute onion and green pepper in oil. Remove from heat., Blend in flour., Stir in milk and soup gradually., Cook over low heat 1 minute, stirring constantly. Remove from heat., Stir in ham and lemon juice.

title: Best Cookies
directions: Put in enough flour to make a soft dough., When rolled as thin as possible they are delicious., Be sure to use plenty of flour on the rolling board.

title: Peanut Blossoms
directions: Combine all ingredients, except candy, in a large bowl., Mix on lowest speed of mixer until dough forms., Shape dough into balls, using rounded teaspoonful for each., Roll balls in sugar. Place on ungreased cookie sheet.

title: Sweet Pastry Crust
directions: In a large bowl, beat butter with sugar, egg yolks and dash of salt until blended., Sift 1/4 flour into bowl, beat; add 1 teaspoon ice water., Repeat with remaining flour and 1/2 to 2 teaspoons water, only enough to hold pastry together., Form into ball. Refrigerate at least 1 hour before rolling out.

title: Sop A(Mexican Side Dish)
directions: In medium saucepan, add cooking oil and elbow macaroni. Brown macaroni lightly. Add water and tomato sauce. Add seasonings.

title: Chilled Berry Soup
directions: *Alternate fruits may be used: 20 ounces frozen strawberries (thawed), fresh or frozen blueberries, fresh or frozen blackberries.

title: Very Good Tea
directions: Boil water; add tea bags to 2 cups of water. Add sugar to remaining cup of water and boil for 7 minutes without stirring. Mix juices. Remove tea bags and add sugar mixture. Let cool and pour into gallon jug (I use 2 half-gallon jugs). Mix half-gallon with 2 liter bottle of 7-Up, Sprite or ginger ale.

title: Cameo Cake
directions: Combine butter and water in a medium saucepan., Bring to a boil over medium heat; stirring occasionally., Remove from heat. Add white chocolate stirring until chocolate melts., Stir in buttermilk, eggs and vanilla., Set aside., Combine 1/2 cup flour and pecans, stirring to coat., Set aside., Combine remaining flour, sugar and soda in large mixing bowl., Gradually stir in white chocolate mixture., Fold in pecan mixture., (Batter will be thin.)

title: Low-Fat Potato Salad(Diabetic Recipe)
directions: Combine yogurt, mustard and horseradish in a large bowl., Add potato, celery, cucumber, onion and chives. Toss lightly to mix well. Chill., Makes 8 servings., Each serving has 60 calories, 2 vegetable and 2 fat exchanges.

title: Mom'S Buttermilk Biscuits
directions: Combine all dry ingredients; cut in shortening., Add buttermilk and yeast to mixture., Cover and refrigerate., Will keep for 2 weeks., When ready to use, roll out as much dough as needed., Cut into biscuit-size., Bake in a greased pan at 400° for 12 minutes.

title: Crab Stuffed Potatoes
directions: Cut baked potatoes lengthwise., Scoop out potatoes and save the skins., Beat the potatoes with all ingredients, except crab and paprika., Fold in crab meat., Refill potato shells and sprinkle with paprika., Heat about 15 to 20 minutes in a 350° oven before serving., Grated cheese may be sprinkled on top., Very good.

title: Spinach And Rice Casserole
directions: Blend sour cream, soup and eggs., Add rice, spinach, cheese, onion and sliced mushrooms., Put in buttered baking dish., Bake covered at 325° for 45 to 60 minutes.

title: Savory Crescent Chicken
directions: Blend softened cream cheese and 2 tablespoons oleo until smooth., Add next 6 ingredients., Mix well.

title: Hot Fudge Sauce For Ice Cream
directions: Melt the butter; mix in sugar and cocoa., Add, milk slowly. Simmer until thick, about 20 minutes.

title: Vegetable Casserole(Cream Corn And Green Pepper)
directions: Saute green pepper in butter until soft., Pour green pepper into a 1 1/2 qt. baking dish and add corn, pimento, egg and 1/2 cup onions., Bake at 350° for 25 minutes till firm., Add remaining 1/2 cup french fried onions to top., Bake 5 minutes more.

title: Apple Crisp
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., In 8-inch square pan, place apple slices., Sprinkle water, cinnamon and salt over apples., Mix flour and sugar together; cut in butter until crumbly., Sprinkle over apples., Bake 40 minutes, uncovered, until the topping is light golden brown and apples are tender., Serve warm with whipped cream or ice cream.

title: Sugar-Free Lemon Pie
directions: Mix jello with boiling water., Add rest of ingredients and pour into graham cracker crust., Chill.

title: Turkey With Cranberry Sauce
directions: Mix all ingredients (except cranberry sauce) in a bowl., Roll into bite size balls and insert toothpicks. Bake in oven at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes (golden).

title: Chicken Salad Supreme
directions: Mix salad oil, vinegar, orange juice and salt., Add chicken and marinate overnight., Add all the rest of the ingredients and mix well., Serves 25.

title: Twinkie Delight
directions: Slice Twinkies in half and lay in bottom of a 13 x 9-inch pan. Mix pudding and spread on top of Twinkies., Spread pineapple on pudding., Slice bananas on top of pineapple., Top with Cool Whip. Spread nuts on last., You may put cherries on top and drizzle caramel, chocolate or strawberry topping on top of Cool Whip.

title: Sour Cream Chicken
directions: Bake chicken at 350° for 1 hour in a casserole dish., Cook rice; set aside., Take chicken out; set aside., Put pan over burner until it sizzles and stir in sour cream., Put the flame on low to keep warm., Serve and put sour cream gravy on rice and chicken., Enjoy.

title: Lemon Tartlets With Coconut Crusts(Makes 8 Tartlets)
directions: Process coconut and sugar in food processor until coconut is minced., Blend in egg whites., Press mixture into well-greased 4-inch tartlet pans with removable bottoms., Bake at 325° for 25 to 30 minutes or until golden., Remove from pans.

title: Game Pot Pie
directions: In a large stock pot, put in game (it doesn't matter how much of what you have, I find that about 3 or 4 pounds of meat is good). Fill pot 3/4 full with cold water, add the seasoning., Bring to a boil 1/2 hour., Add onion, celery, carrots and potatoes and simmer about 2 to 3 hours., Pull meat from pot and debone., Add meat to pot and boil; add pot pie bows or make your own dough and add to pot., When noodles are done, serve.

title: Cherry Yum-Yum
directions: Cream sugar and cream cheese; add vanilla., Mix Dream Whip by instructions and combine with cheese and sugar mixture., Mix margarine with crumbs., Layer crumbs in a clear bowl, then cream cheese, Dream Whip mixture, then pie filling., Repeat layers and top with crumbs., Chill 24 hours before serving., This is very pretty in a glass bowl.

title: Snickers Pie
directions: Melt 6 Snickers bars (I use microwave)., Add softened cream cheese and Cool Whip., Blend until smooth., Pour into crust. Chill (or freeze).

title: Cucumber Salad(Lo-Cal)
directions: Combine cucumber and onion slices in a bowl., Combine remaining ingredients and pour over slices., Toss., Serve immediately.

title: Cherry Tomato Treats
directions: Cut a thin slice from the top and bottom of each tomato. Scoop out the insides and reserve for adding to meat mixture. Brown meat and add onion; drain., Add seasonings and simmer for 5 minutes., Remove from heat and cool slightly., Add bread crumbs and tomato pulp and mix., Stuff each tomato with the meat mixture. Sprinkle the top of each tomato with grated Parmesan cheese and snipped parsley.

title: Pfeffernuessen (Peppernuts) Von Heinrichs
directions: Cream the shortening, sugars and eggs., Combine baking soda with the cream and add to first mixture., Add vanilla, nuts, spices (mix spices with a portion of the flour) and flour (enough to make stiff dough., Chill.

title: Donna'S Dip
directions: Mix all ingredients with mixer until mixed well.

title: Taco Salad
directions: Cook ground meat until all red color is removed, but do not brown; drain., Mix other ingredients and add meat after it has cooled., This salad is best while lettuce is still very crisp., It keeps well in refrigerator for another meal.

title: Strawberry Cake
directions: Combine cake mix, oil, water and jello in mixing bowl., Add eggs, one at a time; beat well., Add strawberries; mix well., Pour into three greased 9-inch cake pans or greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake for 20 to 30 minutes, or until done, at 350°.

title: Jello Pies
directions: Beat eggs., Add sugar and pineapple juice., Cook until thick, stirring often., Remove from heat and add Jell-O., Put into refrigerator to chill., Beat milk until it stands in peaks. Gently fold Jell-O mixture to milk., Pour into 2 vanilla wafer pie crusts., Keep refrigerated.

title: Swiss Steak
directions: Trim excess fat from steak., Pound flour into the meat. Sprinkle with salt and pepper., In a large skillet heat oil., Add steak and brown meat on both sides over medium heat., Place steak in baking dish, about 12 x 8 x 2-inch.

title: Cooked Fudge Icing
directions: Mix all ingredients except butter., Cook until firm ball forms when dropped into cold water., Remove from heat., Add butter. Beat until spreading consistency., Frost 3 layers or 1 pound cake.

title: Mama Lassie'S Butter Rolls
directions: Put flour in a large mixing bowl., Make a hole in the middle of flour., Add shortening and buttermilk., Gradually mix with flour until dough is stiff., Roll out thin., Cut circles out of dough with a small saucer., Cut up 1/2 stick butter or margarine and put on each circle., Roll each circle up and place in an iron skillet., Bake at 350° until golden brown.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
directions: Heat oven to 375°., Mix peanut butter, Crisco, brown sugar, milk and vanilla in large bowl., Beat at medium speed until well blended., Add egg; beat together., Add everything else on low speed, until blended., Spoon onto ungreased cookie sheet., Press with fork., Bake for 7 to 8 minutes.

title: Chicken Paprika
directions: In large skillet, heat oil over medium heat., Add chicken, mushrooms and onion., Saute over medium-high heat until tender. Add broth, paprika, dill and pepper., Simmer for 10 minutes or until chicken is tender., Cook noodles as package directs using unsalted water., In a small bowl, blend water and cornstarch., Cook for 1 minute; stir constantly., Remove from heat., Stir in yogurt. Put pasta on bottom., Top with chicken medley and yogurt., Makes 4 servings.

title: Oven Beef Stew
directions: Combine all except potatoes and peas., Bake, covered tightly, in a 325° oven for 2 1/2 to 3 hours., Stir and add potatoes and peas., Continue baking 1 1/2 hours or until potatoes are done.

title: Spinach Salad
directions: Place spinach and tomatoes in salad bowl., Arrange eggs, onion and cheese on top.

title: Lo-Fat Strawberry Shake
directions: Puree all ingredients in blender until thick., Makes 2 servings., Contains 181 calories, 10 gm protein, 2 gm fat and 27 gm carbohydrates.

title: Butternut Pound Cake
directions: Sift flour 4 times and set aside., Beat the first 5 ingredients until real fluffy., Add flour and milk in four parts, blend well., Place in large greased tube pan and bake at 325° for approximately 1 hour and 45 minutes.

title: Cheese Ball
directions: Have cheeses at room temperature., Combine with other ingredients., Roll into a ball., Roll in chopped pecans or parsley., Good with Triscuits.

title: Beef Stroganoff
directions: Soak crumbs in milk., Add remaining ingredients, except chili sauce., Mix well and pack into 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2 1/2-inch loaf pan to shape., Invert on shallow baking pan., Score loaf diagonally with handle of wooden spoon., Bake in moderate oven at 350° for 1 hour., Fill scored marks on top with chili sauce., Bake 15 minutes longer., This will make 6 to 8 servings.

title: Pizza Burgers
directions: Brown meat., Add rest of ingredients and cook 10 minutes., If not thick enough, add more flour., Spoon on buns and top with grated cheese or thinly sliced., Bake at 375° until cheese is melted.

title: Peanut Brittle
directions: Boil sugar, water and syrup until spins a thread; add peanuts. After adding peanuts, stir continually until syrup turns golden brown., Remove from heat; add remaining ingredients., Stir until butter melts., Pour quickly on 2 cookie sheets with sides., As mixture begins to harden around edges, pull until thin.

title: Winter Strawberries
directions: *Use an electric blender or chop very fine.

title: Tuna Or Chicken Casserole
directions: Cook noodles according to pkg. directions., Add cooked noodles to other ingredients., Stir well., Put in a 9 x 13 dish, crumble potato chips on top and bake at 350 for about 20 min. or until golden brown.

title: Dieter'S Apple Cobbler
directions: Preheat oven to 425°. Spray 8 x 8-inch pan with vegetable cooking spray. Peel, core and thinly slice apples. In a large bowl, toss apples with lemon juice, cornstarch, cinnamon, nutmeg and 1/4 teaspoon salt. Arrange mixture in baking dish. In a medium bowl, combine flour and 1/4 teaspoon salt. With pastry blender, cut in butter until coarse and crumbly. Sprinkle flour mixture over apple mixture. Bake 40 to 45 minutes until crust is golden and apples are tender. Immediately sprinkle with sweetener. Serves 9.

title: Stuffed Mushrooms
directions: Blend all the above together., Put in mushroom caps., Bake until golden brown at 325°.

title: Lemon Icebox Pie
directions: Combine condensed milk, lemon juice, lemon flavoring and egg yolks., Pour into pie crust., Top with Cool Whip.

title: Banana Cake
directions: Mix all together and beat 4 minutes., Pour into prepared Bundt pan., Bake at 350° over 50 minutes., Let cool 15 minutes before turning out., Sprinkle with powdered sugar.

title: Breakfast Sausage Casserole
directions: Combine milk, eggs and mustard., In large oblong dish, layer bread, sausage, cheese and mushrooms., Pour liquids over all., Let stand overnight in refrigerator., Before baking, spread 1 can cream of mushroom soup diluted with 1/3 can of milk., Bake at 325° for 1 hour or until firm.

title: Party Pretzels
directions: Mix dill weed, lemon, pepper, garlic powder and dressing mixes and shake in bag with pretzels., Pour oil and hot sauce over pretzels., Mix well., Bake at 300° for 10 minutes., Stir and bake 10 more minutes., Cool and keep in airtight container.

title: Ranch Burgers
directions: Simply add salad dressing mix to ground beef., Mix well., Form into 4 patties and grill or broil until done., Serves 4.

title: Zucchini Casserole
directions: Cook chopped zucchini in water., Drain and add onions cooked in 1 tablespoon butter., Add corn, cheese, salt and eggs., Mix well., Pour in greased dish and top with mixture of Parmesan cheese, melted butter and bread crumbs., Bake at 375° for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Evie'S Candy Cake(Mama'S)
directions: Cream the sugar and butter., Beat eggs separately., Save 4 whites for frosting., Add eggs and cream until fluffy., Sift flour and soda together., Add alternately with the milk., Add vanilla. Use Pam in cake pans or grease and flour the pans., Bake in 4 layers in moderate oven at 350°.

title: Strawberry Salad
directions: Dissolve jello in boiling water and add partially thawed strawberries., Add pineapple and bananas., Put 1/2 mixture into 9 x 12-inch dish and place into refrigerator to set., When set, spread sour cream over top and add remaining mixture., Place into refrigerator to set., Cut into squares.

title: Chocolate Chip Tea Cake
directions: Beat butter and powdered sugar in large mixer bowl until creamy., Beat in vanilla., Gradually beat in flour and nuts., Stir in 1 1/2 cups chocolate chips., Roll dough into 1-inch balls; place on ungreased baking sheet., Bake in preheated 350 degree oven for 10-12 minutes or until set and light golden brown on bottom., Cool for 2 minutes on baking sheets; remove to wire racks to cool completely., Microwave remaining morsels in heavy-duty plastic bag on high power for 30 seconds; knead., Microwave an additional 10 to 20-second intervals, kneading until smooth., Cut tiny corner from bag; squeeze in drizzle over cookies., Chill cookies for about 5 minutes or until chocolate is set., Store at room temperature in airtight containers.

title: Skillet Beef And Rice
directions: Brown in skillet beef, onion and pepper., Add remaining ingredients and heat to boiling., Reduce heat, cover and simmer 25 minutes or until rice is tender.

title: Mom'S Oatmeal Refrigerator Cookies
directions: Mix in order given., Make into a roll and wrap in waxed paper. Chill in refrigerator overnight., Slice thin and bake at 375° for 8 to 12 minutes.

title: Chicken Cordon Bleu
directions: Flatten the boneless chicken with a kitchen mallet Season with lemon pepper seasoning Sprinkle equal portions of the chopped ham and cheese on 1/2 of each chicken breasts., Fold the chicken breast in half making a "sandwich", again sprinkle with lemon pepper seasoning., Place in lightly greased pan place in oven cook for approx. 30 min or until completely cooked., Remove from pan cover with hollandaise sauce., Excellent when served with new potatoes and asparagus.

title: Rhubarb Cake
directions: Cream shortening and sugar well., Add molasses and rhubarb sauce and blend together., Sift dry ingredients together and add to first mixture., Add fruit and nuts and bake in a greased loaf pan in a moderate oven at 350° for about 50 minutes or until done.

title: Potato-Ham Scallop
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Place, half, of the ham in a 2-quart casserole., Cover with half the potatoes and half of the onion. Sift half of the, flour, over;, season, with, salt, and pepper. Repeat layering ham, potatoes and onion., Season with additional salt and pepper., Sift remaining flour atop., Pour milk over all. Bake, covered, in oven, for, 1, to, 1, 1/4 hours or until potatoes are nearly tender., Uncover., Combine bread crumbs and melted butter;, sprinkle, atop, casserole., Top, with, parsley. Bake 15 minutes more., Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Chinese Chicken Soup
directions: Boil chicken broth and water., When boiling, add bok choy. Return to boil; cook, uncovered, for 4 minutes., Add noodles. Cook chicken., Reduce heat to medium and cook for 4 minutes., Add mushrooms and pea pods and heat through., Season to taste and serve.

title: Delicious Sausage And Rice Casserole
directions: Brown sausage in skillet, stirring until crumbly; drain. Combine with remaining ingredients in 9 x 13-inch casserole., Bake, covered with foil, at 375° for 40 minutes.

title: Quick And Easy Dessert
directions: Dip cookies in milk one at a time., Place in a 1-inch or 2-inch deep dish., Spread Cool Whip over layer., Continue layer. For last layer, crumble cookies on top of Cool Whip., Refrigerate for 1 hour or longer.

title: Macaroni Salad
directions: Cook macaroni until done., Drain macaroni, then rinse in cold water., Then let drain real good., Then add all ingredients.

title: Easy Jello Fruit Salad
directions: Add 1 cup boiling water to gelatin and stir to dissolve. Drain peaches., Use juice and enough cold water to make 1 cup, add to gelatin mixture, stir, add peaches and pour into 8-inch square dish and refrigerate for 45 minutes to 1 hour until gelatin begins to set., Then fold in freshly cut apples and banana., Chill 2 hours until set., Serves 8., Recipe can be used in many fruit and gelatin combinations.

title: Mocha Logs
directions: Mix all ingredients. Roll into logs. Roll logs into powdered sugar and sprinkle with grated chocolate.

title: Cherry Delight
directions: Line a 9-inch square pan with whole graham crackers., Mix pudding and milk., Allow to stand for 5 minutes., Blend in whipped topping., Spread half over crackers; top this with a layer of cherry pie filling., Add another layer of crackers., Add remainder of the pudding mixture, then top with a final layer of pie filling. Chill for 3 hours.

title: Spinach Lasagna
directions: Saute the onion and garlic in the olive oil, adding water as needed to keep from sticking., Combine the Ricotta, tofu, Parmesan, spinach, egg whites (beaten), black pepper, parsley and sauteed onion and garlic, mixing well., Cook the lasagna according to package directions.

title: Peach Pie
directions: Mix, cream, cheese, and, Cool Whip; pour into baked pie shell. Mix, jello according to box., Mix peaches in jello and half jell., Place over Cool Whip and cream cheese;, refrigerate.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Fully cook chicken; bone and put into 9 x 13-inch pan., Pour soup over chicken., Make stuffing as directed on box; spread over soup., Bake about 1/2 hour at 375° to 400°.

title: Beer Cheese Soup(Microwave)
directions: Combine carrot, onion and butter in a 2-quart glass measuring cup., Cover partially with plastic wrap; microwave on High 3 minutes, or until vegetables are tender., Stir in flour, bouillon granules, mustard, ginger, salt and pepper., Using whisk, blend in 2 cups milk., Cook on High 5 minutes, whisking midway through cooking., Once thickened, stir in cheese until melted., Blend in remaining 1 cup milk and beer., Microwave on 70% (Medium-high) for 2 minutes, or until heated through., Makes slightly more than 1 quart.

title: German Farina Glsse (Dumplings)(Makes 4 To 5 Servings)
directions: Boil peeled and quartered potatoes in small amount of water. When cooked, do not drain. Mash the potatoes in the water and add the farina and potato starch mixture. Mix well. While mixing mixture, bring to a boil a large pot of water. Form the mixture into balls. Stuff a few croutons in each ball as you make them. Be careful, the mixture will be very hot! Run your hands under cold water between making each ball. Place balls into boiling water until they float to the top. Remove with slotted spoon. Serve with meat gravy.

title: Orange Muffins
directions: Cream butter and sugar well., Add eggs, orange juice, rind and vanilla., Mix dry ingredients., Add to liquid., Stir lightly until batter is only slightly moist but still lumpy., Fill greased 1 3/4-inch muffin tins 1/2 full., Bake at 350° for 15 minutes. Remove and dust with powdered sugar.

title: Lasagna
directions: Sauce is best made the day before.

title: Waffle Cookies(Harde Vafler)
directions: Melt and cool butter., Cream sugar and egg yolks., Sift cornstarch and baking powder and add to sugar mixture, alternating with melted butter., Fold in beaten egg whites., Cook on a Norwegian heart waffle iron until light tan.

title: Italian Biscotti
directions: Cream sugar with butter in mixer., Add eggs and flavoring. Sift flour, salt and baking powder., Fold dry ingredients into other mixture., Shape into a flat loaf on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 18 to 20 minutes., Take out and cut into slices., Put back into oven and brown 10 minutes.

title: Broccoli
directions: Cook broccoli according to directions., Drain., Combine cracker crumbs and margarine., Then place half of broccoli in casserole dish; top with half the cheese, then half the cracker crumbs., Repeat layers and heat until cheese melts., May be frozen and used later.

title: Taco Salad
directions: Brown ground beef, drain well and let cool., In a large bowl tear lettuce in medium pieces, and cut tomatoes in small chunks over top of lettuce., Slightly crush the taco chips and dump over lettuce and tomatoes., Add ground beef and cheese., Pour half of salad dressing over mixture., Mix all together., Add remaining dressing and mix.

title: Strawberry Crumble
directions: Beat egg whites stiff, adding sugar and lemon juice., Add this to whipped topping., Add strawberries last.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
directions: *Use Quaker old-fashioned oatmeal, premeasured in blender until powdery.

title: Almond-Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Mix sugars, butter, vanilla and egg., Stir in oats, flour, ground almonds, baking soda, baking powder and salt., Stir in sliced almonds., Drop by rounded tablespoonfuls onto an ungreased cookie sheet., Bake at 375° about 10 minutes., Cool 2 minutes.

title: Banana Bread
directions: Cream together margarine and sugar., Add eggs and bananas. Sift and add soda and flour., Then add vanilla and nuts., Pour into loaf pan., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Easy Seasoned Beef
directions: Tenderize meat, if desired, flour lightly and brown in small amount of oil over medium heat., Add soup mix while stirring., Cook meat to taste., (If too dry, add more oil; if too oily, add more soup mix.), Serve over fried or steamed rice., Simple, fast and unbelievably delicious!

title: Bakerei(Traditional German Cookies)
directions: Combine butter and flour (traditional way is to use fingers!) Add beaten egg yolks, sugar and lemon., Roll out on floured board to 1/4-inch thickness., Brush with egg white and sprinkle on colored sugars or other decorations., Bake for 30 minutes in 350° oven.

title: Spinach Balls
directions: Roll in balls (size of quarters); chill or may be frozen until ready to bake., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes on foil lined cookie sheet.

title: Cherry Cobbler
directions: Melt 1 stick of margarine in deep dish or pan., Make batter of sugar, flour and milk., Pour batter into pan or dish., Pour cherries on top of batter., Do not stir., Cook for 40 minutes in 375° oven., Do not open oven for at least 30 minutes of cooking time.

title: Sauteed Greens
directions: You can saute spinach, chard or beet greens without pre-boiling; just saute them as below for about 5 minutes or until wilted. Serve with fresh lemon wedge or about 1/2 cup mushrooms (optional).

title: Spinach With Cheese
directions: Melt butter in skillet., Add flour and stir until smooth., Add onion and brown lightly., Add spinach, eggs, cheese, salt and pepper., Cook and stir together for at least 5 minutes.

title: Shrimp Scampi
directions: Mix all ingredients., Broil 5 to 8 minutes.

title: Crab Stuffed Hard Rolls Appetizers
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Scoop out most of soft inside of rolls and butter generously., Saute pepper and onions in small amount of butter., When glossy, add all other ingredients., Mix until cheese is melted., Fill rolls with mixture., Do this early since this is better if left to stand, 2 to 3 hours before baking., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes before serving.

title: Frosted Pretzels
directions: Heat frosting on low until it is liquid., Remove from heat. Dip pretzels into the frosting with your fingers., Then place them on waxed paper., Let dry for 8 hours.

title: Barbecue Pork Chops
directions: Mix ingredients together., Mash and slice lemons and rinds. Pour ingredients over pork chops., Cook in oven about 1 hour at 350°.

title: Tamale Pie
directions: Cook onions and ground beef., Drain off fat., Add oil, tomatoes, chili powder, salt, eggs, red pepper, mango, corn, corn meal and milk., Mix well., Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan (greased). Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Vicki'S Cheese Ball
directions: Mix together and roll in pecan pieces.

title: Hawaiian Chicken
directions: Arrange chicken breasts in 1 1/2 qt. microwave-proof casserole., Combine remaining ingredients; blend well., Pour over chicken., Cover with plastic wrap., Cook on High 10 minutes. Rearrange chicken., Cover and cook on High 10 to 12 minutes, or until chicken is tender., Let stand 5 minutes before serving., 2 - 4 servings.

title: Chicken And Rice
directions: Put rice (uncooked) in bottom of greased roaster., Cover with soups, mixed together with milk., Put chicken pieces on top of this mixture and sprinkle with seasonings., Cover tightly with aluminum foil and put on roaster cover., Bake at 275° for 3 hours.

title: Strawberry Mold
directions: Dissolve jello in water., Add frozen strawberries and stir until thawed., Add can of pineapple, bananas diced., Pour half of mixture into an 8 x 8-inch pan., Put in refrigerator until firm, leave the remainder out., Take firm mixture out and spread sour cream over it., Pour rest of jello mixture on top and chill until firm.

title: Bread Pudding
directions: Butter bread and take off crusts., Cut into cubes., In a double boiler, put brown sugar with bread cubes on top., In separate bowl, beat eggs, milk and vanilla., Pour over bread cubes., Do not stir., Cover the double boiler and cook for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Maple Syrup
directions: Cook and stir until sugar dissolves., Add few drops of maple flavoring and 1 tablespoon butter., Add butter in the beginning.

title: Sugarless Apple Pie
directions: Place apples and undiluted apple juice into a large pan. Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer, covered, for about 5 minutes., Dissolve cornstarch in water., Gently stir cornstarch into apple mixture., Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer, covered, for 10 to 15 minutes or until apples begin to soften. Stir in cinnamon., Fill pastry shell with apples and cover with top crust., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes., Baste with melted margarine after baking.

title: Italian Oyster Stew
directions: Saute onion in olive oil until transparent., Add canned tomatoes, seasoned salt and oregano., Cook about 10 minutes on medium, heat., Add	oysters, and juice., Stir as they cook for about 3, to 5 minutes., The edge of the oysters will curl.	If you want, your oysters well done, cook longer., Can be served over rice or spaghetti.

title: Classic Stuffed Shells
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Evenly spread 1 cup sauce in a 17 x 12-inch bake pan., In a large bowl, combine cheeses, eggs, parsley and pepper., Fill shells with cheese mixture and arrange in a single layer in baking pan., Evenly top with remaining sauce. Bake 45 to 50 minutes or until bubbly., Serves 8.

title: Raw Apple Cake
directions: Mix together apples, sugar, oil and vanilla in large bowl. Let stand for one hour., Add flour, salt, baking soda, cinnamon and eggs., Mix well and pour in ungreased oblong cake pan., Bake at 350 degrees for 40-55 minutes.

title: Lima Bean Delight
directions: Cook all ingredients but milk until beans are done., Add milk; heat but do not boil milk., Can be baked.

title: Cucumber Dressing
directions: Mix ingredients well; pour over sliced cucumbers.

title: Rosemary Roasted Potato Wedges
directions: Toss potato wedges with oil; place in a shallow roasting pan and sprinkle evenly with rosemary and salt., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to an hour, until golden brown and fork-tender.

title: Dill Dip
directions: Mix all ingredients well., This is delicious for a fresh vegetable dip., Use carrots, cauliflower, radishes or sweet pepper., Also good for potato chips.

title: Cowboy Cookies
directions: Measure, first	4, ingredients	and, set, aside., Cream shortening and sugars., Add egg and fold in dry mixture., Then add vanilla,, oatmeal and bits., Drop on cookie sheet and bake at 350° for 15 minutes.

title: Chocolate Chip Pound Cake
directions: Mix together all ingredients, except chocolate chips, in a large bowl for 4 minutes on med. speed., Fold in chocolate chips. Pour batter into a greased and floured bundt pan., Bake at 325 degrees for 1 hour.

title: Puppy Chow
directions: Melt chocolate chips, peanut butter and butter in microwave. Pour over cereal; toss to coat., Pour powdered sugar in paper., Add cereal mixture and shake., Leave cereal in bag and place in freezer until the chocolate sets., Serve in "new, clean" dog dishes and watch it disappear as Fido devours his version.

title: Cheese 'N Ham Roll
directions: Dice up 2 packages ham; slice up onion tops fine., Mix cheese, onion tops, ham, Accent and sauce together; form into ball., Roll into the third pack of ham (diced); cover the entire ball. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Halusky (Potato Dumplings)
directions: Add salt and flour to potatoes and mix well., Dough should be thin., More or less flour can be used according to size of potatoes., Boil a large pan of water., Put dough on plate., Use a knife or spoon to scrape off small portion at a tie into boiling water., Boil about 15 minutes., Stir frequently to prevent scorching., Drain., Rinse with cold water., Do not leave Halusky Set.

title: Spinach Dip
directions: Mix all ingredients together and refrigerate at least 3 hours.

title: No Bake Cookies
directions: Place the sugar, milk, cocoa and butter/margarine in a large saucepan., Cook over a medium-high heat until bubbly., Stir often., Pour this into a large mixing bowl., Stir in the oats and peanut butter until well mixed., Drop by teaspoonfuls onto waxed paper., Refrigerate until firm., Makes about 36 cookies.

title: Pineapple-Upside Down Cake
directions: Melt margarine in 13 x 9 inch pan., Sprinkle brown sugar on top., Top with pineapple., Mix cake using juice as part of water. Pour batter over pineapple., Bake at 350 degrees for 35-40 minutes., When done immediately invert onto cookie sheet., Frost cake with pineapple brown sugar on bottom of pan.

title: Delicious Apple Cake
directions: Sift first 4 ingredients together. In large bowl, cream sugar, Crisco and egg yolks together. Use a little of the flour mixture over the raisins and nuts. Combine flour mixture and apples with creamed mixture. Then add raisins and nuts. Beat egg whites until they peak. Fold in cake mixture. Bake 1 hour at 350° in tube pan.

title: German Chocolate Cheesecake
directions: Combine wafer crumbs and butter, mixing well., Press into bottom and 1 3/4-inches up sides of a 9-inch spring-form pan, and set aside.

title: Stuffed Bacon Rolls
directions: Partially cook bacon., Drain, reserve 2 tablespoons drippings. Set bacon aside., Cook onion and garlic in reserved drippings until tender, but not brown., In bowl, add all ingredients except bacon., Mix well., Divide into 4 parts., Place 2 slices of bacon side by side on wax paper., Cut another slice in half crosswise. Place 2 half slices at one end of bacon slices, overlapping slightly., Pat 1/4 of meat mixture evenly over bacon., Roll up jelly-roll style, starting from narrow end.

title: Sour Cream Apples
directions: Mix well and pour in casserole dish., Bake at 400° for 30 minutes.

title: Sausage Casserole
directions: Brown sausage; drain., Stir in beans, soup and pepper., Place apple slices on top and sprinkle with brown sugar., Bake 20 minutes at 450°.

title: John Hoosier Cake
directions: Cake:, Sift sugar, flour, soda and salt into bowl., Melt 2 sticks oleo and 4 Tbsp cocoa with 1 cup water., Bring to a rapid boil, then pour over dry ingredients in bowl., Add 1/2 cup buttermilk and 2 beaten eggs along with 1 tsp vanilla., Mix well. Bake in greased cookie sheet pan with edge for 15-20 minutes at 350 degrees.

title: Savory Texas Hash
directions: Brown and drain ground beef., Add all other ingredients, except tomato and cheese., Simmer, covered, 20 to 25 minutes. Remove from heat and add tomato and cheese.

title: Chicken-N-Dumplings
directions: Cook chicken with salt and pepper in crock-pot filled with water for 1 hour., Keep chicken covered with water., Let cool. Debone.

title: Coconut Bars
directions: Mix together cake mix, 2 eggs, oil, chopped pecans and coconut with hands., Put in greased 13 x 9-inch pan.

title: Sweeter Muffins
directions: Grease muffin pan., In mixing bowl, beat egg slightly., Stir in milk and shortening., Add dry ingredients and mix well. Fill muffin cups about 2/3 full. Bake at 400° for 20 to 25 minutes. You can fill cups 1/3 full and put in 1/2 teaspoon of favorite jelly., Then finish filling with batter.

title: Manicotti Florentine
directions: Saute onion and garlic in butter until tender., Combine sauteed vegetables, spinach, cheeses, eggs, lemon juice, salt and pepper; mix well., Fill noodles with spinach mixture, place in 13 x 9-inch baking dish., Cover; bake at 350° for 40 minutes., Heat sauce; pour over noodles., Sprinkle with additional Parmesan cheese, if desired.

title: Green Rice
directions: Mix all ingredients and pour in buttered casserole dish., Bake at 375° until center is firm.

title: Macmurray Frozen Dessert
directions: Roll wafers into crumbs., Cream powdered sugar and margarine; add eggs, nuts and strawberries., Fold in whipped cream., Put a layer of crumbs in bottom of pan; pour in mixture and sprinkle balance of crumbs over top., Freeze for at least 24 hours.

title: Bacon Potato Casserole
directions: Place half the mashed potatoes (freshly cooked) in a well buttered casserole., Sprinkle with half the cheese, bacon and onion., Cover with remaining potatoes., Repeat topping of cheese, bacon and onion., Bake in 350° oven for 30 minutes.

title: 7 Layer Salad
directions: Layer the first eight ingredients., Spread mayonnaise on top of lettuce., Sprinkle Hidden Valley dressing (dry) on top of mayonnaise., Sprinkle croutons on top., Serves 6 to 8 (depends on bowl size).

title: Banana Bread
directions: Add soda to milk; set aside. Cream sugar and shortening, and blend in eggs. Mix dry ingredients together and add to egg mixture, alternating with milk. Add bananas and nuts. Pour into greased and floured loaf pan. Bake for one hour at 350°.

title: Chocolate Cream Cheese Cake
directions: Combine cake mix and pudding., Add 3 eggs, water and oil. Blend well.

title: Shrimp Dip
directions: Place all ingredients in mixing bowl and mix until consistency desired., Use either celery, cauliflower or crackers to dip with.

title: Super, Super Easy Cookies
directions: Mix all ingredients together and gradually add flour., Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Chicken Spaghetti
directions: Saute celery, pimento and mushrooms in a little butter., Mix soup and broth., Mix with spaghetti, then grate cheese on top and mix in., Bake at 350° until good and hot.

title: Jewell'S Sweet Potato Casserole
directions: Mix last 4 items (margarine, brown sugar, pecans and cornflakes) together and set aside for topping.

title: Easy Peanut Butter Cookies
directions: Mix peanut butter and sugar., Stir in beaten egg and vanilla. Shape into 1-inch balls., Place on ungreased cookie sheet., Press down slightly., Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Chicken Prosciutto With Mushroom Sauce
directions: Pound chicken breasts between 2 pieces of plastic wrap with meat mallet or rolling pin., Over medium heat, melt 2 tablespoons margarine., Cook chicken until browned (5 minutes).

title: Shrimp Dip
directions: Mix all ingredients together several hours before serving, for best flavor., Make all tablespoons heaping.

title: Peaches And Cream Cheese Cake
directions: Mix and spread over filling., Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes., Filling will appear soft., Store in refrigerator.

title: Hearty Bean Soup(Vegetarian Recipe; Serves 8)
directions: Cook the beans in extra water so it can be used as stock. Heat the olive oil in a soup pot., Add the onion and celery and saute until golden., Add the potato and string beans, along with enough water or cooking liquid from the beans to cover., Bring to a boil, then simmer, covered, over moderate heat until the vegetables are just tender, about 20 to 25 minutes., Add the beans and the remaining ingredients plus 2 more cups of water or stock from beans., Simmer, covered, over low heat for another 20 to 25 minutes., Taste to be sure that everything is done to your liking.

title: Gingersnaps
directions: *May use 3 teaspoons pumpkin pie spice.

title: Pregnant Pigs
directions: You will need toothpicks, if using olives.

title: Date Nut Bran Muffins(Makes 5 Dozen)
directions: Sift together flour, sugar, baking soda and salt., Set aside. Combine remaining ingredients in 6-quart bowl., Mix well., Add dry ingredients, stirring just enough to moisten., Fill greased muffin tins 2/3 full., Bake at 400° for 20 minutes.

title: Italian Spiced Potatoes
directions: Wash and cut unpeeled potatoes into 1-inch cubes., Place in bowl., Pour on dressing and mix well., Place on cookie sheet. Sprinkle on cheese., Bake at 400° for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Creole Jambalaya
directions: Melt the butter; cook the sausage and ham until lightly browned and stir in the flour., Add the onions, scallions and garlic and cook until the vegetables are soft and transparent., Stir in the chopped tomatoes and their juice., Stir in the bay leaf, thyme and creole seasoning., Add the broth and mix well., Add the raw shrimp and the chicken., Stir in the raw rice., The liquid in the pot should just cover the contents., Add more broth if necessary. Bring to a boil and cook until the rice is done., Serves 8 to 10.

title: Seafood Cakes
directions: Mix tuna, mustard, onions, pepper, seasoning and Miracle Whip and seasoning with 1/2 cup bread crumbs., Shape into balls; roll in remaining crumbs., Flatten and refrigerate 30 minutes., Heat oil and brown 5 minutes each side.

title: Spaghetti Sauce
directions: In hot oil in large kettle, cook garlic, peppers and onion 5 minutes., Add meat; cook over high heat until all red color disappears., Add water and rest of ingredients., Simmer uncovered 2 hours., Cool quickly and freeze if you want to freeze the sauce. While simmering, stir occasionally., Serve over spaghetti.

title: Mushroom Soup
directions: Saute mushrooms, onion and garlic in 1 tablespoon butter., Add flour and stir., Add milk, broth and celery soup and stir., Let cook 1/2 hour and it is ready to eat.

title: Pink Arctic Salad(Frozen Cranberry Salad)
directions: In mixing bowl, beat cream cheese, sugar, salt and mayo until smooth., Stir in cranberry sauce, pineapple and pecans until well mixed., Fold in Dream Whip., Pour into 13 x 9-inch pan and freeze at least 24 hours., Let sit out for 5 to 10 minutes before serving., Cut into squares to serve.

title: Baked Lemon-Pepper Fish Or Chicken(Diet)
directions: Oil a shallow pan with 1 tablespoon of canola oil., Mix together flour, salt and Molly McButter., Lightly coat fish or chicken in flour mixture., Lay in pan., Lavish on lemon and pepper seasoning., Bake at 350° until done., (If using chicken, remove skin.)

title: Spritz Cookies
directions: Sift flour and salt together., Cream butter; add sugar., Cream together well., Add egg and flavoring; beat well., Blend dry ingredients in gradually., Press through cookie press onto ungreased cookie sheet., Bake at 375° for 7 to 10 minutes.

title: France-Chocolate Delight
directions: Break up the chocolate and put it in a heatproof bowl., Stand the bowl in a pan of boiling water., Stir the chocolate until it melts, then leave it to cool., Fold it into the yogurt., Pour it into serving dishes., Top with extra yogurt and grate extra chocolate over the top., Chill for 1 hour., If you prefer, you could flavor the yogurt with orange or lemon juice., (Add honey or sugar to sweeten.)

title: Taco Salad
directions: Add taco sauce to browned chopped meat in frying pan., Mix lettuce, onion, olives, cheese, tomatoes and dressing., Toss., Add chips; toss again., Spoon warm meat mixture over the top., Serve immediately.

title: Eth'S Donuts
directions: Mix sugar, eggs and shortening., Put flour, salt, nutmeg, ginger, soda and baking powder in sieve., Add to sugar mixture alternately with sour milk.

title: Pull-A-Part(Breakfast Cake)
directions: Cut rolls in thirds; melt oleo, sugar and cinnamon and add pecans., Pour over rolls and put in Bundt pan and let rise., Also they can be placed in the refrigerator overnight and will rise and be ready to bake., Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

title: Caramel Popcorn Balls
directions: Heat brown sugar, corn syrup, butter and salt to simmering in 4-quart Dutch oven over medium-high heat, stirring constantly. Pour mixture over popcorn until well coated, about 2 minutes., Cool slightly., Use hands, dipped in cool water, to make balls., Put in Baggies.

title: Peggy'S Pickled Mostaccioli
directions: Prepare pasta according to package directions, adding food coloring to water., Drain., Toss with small amount of oil to prevent sticking., Place remaining ingredients in blender., Blend and pour over mostaccioli., Refrigerate., Let set 3 days., Will keep for 4 weeks.

title: Amaretto Chocolate Cream Pie
directions: Combine first 4 ingredients in heavy saucepan; stir well. Gradually stir in milk; add chocolate., Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly until mixture thickens and reaches 160°. Remove from heat., Stir in 1/4 cup Amaretto and vanilla., Pour into pastry shell., Place a piece of plastic wrap directly on top of filling., Chill 8 hours., Combine whipping cream, 1 tablespoon Amaretto and powdered sugar., Beat until soft peaks form., Remove plastic wrap and spread mixture on pie.

title: Party Mints
directions: Combine sugar, salt, brown sugar, syrup and milk in medium saucepan., Cook over medium heat until temperature reaches 234° on candy thermometer., Add butter, vanilla and pecans., Stir until thick., Drop by teaspoonfuls onto waxed paper., Cool.

title: Blue Ribbon Pumpkin Pie Squares
directions: Combine flour, rolled oats, 1/2 cup brown sugar and 1/2 cup butter in bowl., Mix until crumbly using electric mixer on low speed., Press into ungreased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.

title: German Chocolate Cake
directions: Spray bottom of baking dish (10 x 15-inch) with Pam., Mix coconut and pecans and cover bottom of dish., Prepare cake mix according to directions on box., Pour over pecan mixture., Melt oleo. Add cream cheese and sugar., Mix well., Pour over the top of cake mix., This mixture will sink to the bottom during cooking. Bake in 350°, oven for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Pool Room Slaw
directions: Mix together and bring to boil on low heat., Simmer for 20 minutes and pack in hot jars., Seal., Makes 8 pints.

title: Chilled Avocado Soup(Serves 8 To 10)
directions: Mix avocados, broth, lemon juice, salt, peppers and sherry in blender. Blend at low speed until well blended. Chill for at least two hours. Serve in chilled bowls, garnished with chives and bacon.

title: Fried Yams
directions: Soak sliced yams in water with salt for 30 minutes., Remove from water; drain and pat dry., Melt butter in large, heavy skillet until bubbly., Add yams and brown quickly on both sides. Sprinkle with sugar., Stir gently to coat both sides., Cover; reduce heat to low heat., Simmer for 15 to 20 minutes or until tender.

title: Scottish Shortbread
directions: Beat together butter and sugar until light and fluffy., Beat in flour gradually (last 1 to 2 cups will need to be stirred in by hand)., Turn onto generously floured board and roll out 1/4 to 1/2-inch thick., Cut into triangles or rectangles., Transfer to cookie sheet with spatula., Prick tops with fork several times. Bake at 350° for approximately 25 minutes or until firm and lightly brown., This dough is extremely soft, but generally not sticky, a gentle touch is called for.

title: Refrigerator Mashed Potatoes
directions: Cook potatoes in salted water, then drain., Mash until smooth. Add all the ingredients and beat with mixer., Pour into greased casseroles., Dot with butter., Bake 30 minutes at 350°., Serves 14 to 16., Keeps in refrigerator a week.

title: Jim Fox'S "To Die For" Charcoaled Catfish Fillets(You Can Substitute Your Favorite Fresh Fish)
directions: You will need charcoal, hickory chunks and covered grill. Also fish basket to contain the fillets while charcoaling (these may be called burger baskets at your discount store).

title: Peanut Butter Bread
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Beat egg and add peanut butter, sugar and oil., Beat until creamy., Sift flour, baking soda, baking powder and salt., Alternately add sifted mixture and buttermilk to peanut butter mixture., Mix well after each addition., Pour into greased loaf pan and bake 1 hour or until it tests done., Serves 10., Serve plain or with fruit and whipped cream.

title: Low-Fat Snicker Pie
directions: Combine all ingredients and mix well., Pour into 2 graham cracker crust pies., Freeze!, Cut each pie into 8 pieces., One slice counts 2 fat grams.

title: Hamburger Goulash
directions: Boil macaroni., Drain., Do not rinse., Combine ground beef, onion, pepper, salt and pepper in a large skillet., Fry on medium heat until onions and peppers are almost done., Drain off fat and add tomatoes and tomato soup., Cook on low heat 10 to 15 minutes or as long as desired., Cover while cooking., Add macaroni and cook another 10 minutes on low heat.

title: Chicken And Dumplings
directions: Boil chicken until tender., Debone and separate meat from stock., Add soup and heat to boiling., Add cut up tortillas and milk., Reduce heat to low., Add chicken and simmer 20 minutes.

title: Spaghetti Casserole
directions: Mix together cheeses, sour cream and onion., Set aside., Cook spaghetti according to package instructions., Spray 9 x 13 casserole dish with Pam., Spread half of spaghetti in dish. Spread cheese mixture over spaghetti., Spread remaining spaghetti over cheese mixture., Mix browned beef and spaghetti sauce., Pour over spaghetti, filling dish to top., Pour melted butter over sauce. Cover with foil or lid., This will taste better if you chill overnight, but it is okay to go straight to oven., Bake covered at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Egg Beaters
directions: Blend in blender real well., One-fourth cup is equal to 1 egg for baking., Will keep in refrigerator for a week.

title: Tater Tot Hot Dish
directions: Saute green peppers and celery in margarine., Add meat and brown., Spread meat mixture in bottom of baking dish., Next, spread on soup, then a layer of the beans, drained well., Cover with a layer of Tater Tots., Bake for 35 minutes at 350°.

title: Water Chestnut Casserole
directions: Cook celery halfway in salt water and drain., Add soup and chopped water chestnuts., Put in casserole dish., Mix remaining ingredients., Saute in skillet., Pour over celery mixture., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Strawberry Buttermilk Salad
directions: Heat pineapple; add, jello, and, stir, until dissolved. Cool. Add buttermilk, Cool Whip and nuts., Stir and mix well. Pour in mold and chill until firm.	Good recipe for diabetics!

title: Molasses Doughnuts
directions: Mix sugar, molasses and egg together., Add lard., Put soda into milk., Sift in remaining ingredients., Make mix as soft as can be handled.

title: Holiday Punch
directions: Combine punch, sugar and lemonade in punch bowl., Just before serving, add Collins and ice.

title: Quick Mexican Casserole
directions: Spray Pam in a 9 x 13-inch or 8 x 8-inch baking dish., Put cooked rice in dish., Place hot tamales, which have been unwrapped and cut into 1 to 2-inch pieces, on top of the rice., Spread the can of chili on top of the hot tamales., Slice or grate cheese on top of hot tamales., Bake in a 350° oven for about 25 minutes or until bubbling., You may heat in microwave., Serve warm with chip and cheese dip.

title: Molded Lime Salad
directions: Dissolve Jell-O in 1 1/2 cups boiling water., Add and mix pineapple with juice, cottage cheese, salad dressing and nuts. Pour into a mold. Chill until firm.

title: Blueberry Muffins
directions: Cream butter and sugar together., Add all other ingredients except blueberries and stir until just mixed., Fold in blueberries and spoon into paper-lined muffin tins., Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes., Makes 1 to 2 dozen.

title: Grandmother'S Cookies
directions: In a bowl of love, mix together faith, patience and sympathy. Whip in forgiveness, kindness and courage until well blended. Pour into a heart of joy flavored with harmony and top with understanding., Sweeten with respect., Bake in an oven of faith! Serve with a smile.

title: Crunchy Chicken Balls
directions: In a bowl, combine the first 5 ingredients; mix well. Shape into 3/4-inch balls. Roll in parsley. Cover and chill. Yield: 8 servings (2 dozen).

title: Hamburger Cheese Casserole
directions: Saute first 3 ingredients together until all meat is browned. Add next four ingredients., Continue to cook until cheese is melted., Line bottom and sides of a 2-quart casserole dish with corn chips., Pour meat and cheese mixture in baking dish., Top with additional chips, grated cheese and green onions., Bake at 400° for 15 minutes to melt cheese or serve as is., Garnish with parsley, chopped tomato and sliced olives.

title: Louisiana Date Balls
directions: Boil the sugar and butter for 6 minutes., Combine the first 5 ingredients and add Rice Krispies and vanilla., Cool, Roll into balls about 1 inch in diameter and then roll in angel flake coconut.

title: Harvest Bean Soup(6 Servings)
directions: Rinse beans., In a 4-quart Dutch oven or large saucepan, combine beans and enough water to cover., Bring to boiling. Reduce heat; simmer for 2 minutes., Remove from heat., Cover; let stand for 1 hour (or cover beans with water and soak overnight). Drain off the water., Rinse and return the beans to the Dutch oven., Stir in in 3 1/2 cups water, the pieces of ham or sausage, chopped carrots, chopped potato, chopped onion, salt, oregano, sage and pepper., Bring to boiling; reduce heat., Cover and simmer for 2 to 2 1/2 hours, or until beans are tender, adding more water, if necessary., Stir milk into the bean soup., Cook the soup until heated through, stirring the mixture occasionally as it heats., Season the soup mixture to taste with salt and pepper, if you like.

title: Currant Scones
directions: Heat oven to 400°., Lightly spoon flour into measuring cup. In medium bowl, combine flour, sugar, baking powder and salt. Blend well., Using fork etc., cut butter until mixture is crumbly. Stir in currants., Combine milk and egg; add all at once, stirring just until moist.

title: Cheddar Quiche
directions: Combine cheese and flour in a bowl. Toss to coat., Add eggs, milk, ham and seasonings. Mix well., Pour into pie shell., Bake at 350° for 50 to 55 minutes or until set., Yields 4 to 6 servings.

title: Dump Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Grease 9x13 pan., Dump undrained pineapple into pan., Spread evenly., Dump, in pie filling-spread evenly., Dump dry cake mix onto fruit layers. Spread evenly. Sprinkle nuts on top., Cut butter into pats, and space evenly over dry cake and nuts., Bake approx. 50 min. until cake is brown.

title: Graham Cracker Cookies
directions: Cover bottom of a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan with whole graham crackers.

title: Corned Beef Noodle Casserole
directions: Combine all ingredients, except cracker crumbs., Place in greased baking dish., Sprinkle with crumbs., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Cheese Souffle
directions: Grease a 1 1/2-quart baking dish., Layer bread and cheese. Mix eggs, milk, salt and mustard. Pour over bread., Cover and refrigerate overnight., Place in cold oven at 325° for 30 minutes. Turn off oven and allow souffle to sit 10 minutes.

title: Apple Sauce
directions: Mix apples, water and lemon juice., Add sugar to taste., Add a dash of cinnamon and cook over medium heat until tender.

title: Turkey Salad
directions: Mix cabbage with chicken or turkey which has been sliced in thin strips., Add chopped onions and honey mustard., Chill.

title: Chicken Noodle Casserole
directions: Mix chicken broth with soup., Cook until well mixed, if you need to add a little cornstarch to thicken., Cook noodles and drain them well. Mix in large baking dish, noodles, chicken, peas, and corn., Add gravy mix., Sprinkle with cheese., Bake at 350° until cheese is melted.

title: Apple Dumplings
directions: Prepare dough from first five ingredients., Roll into walnut-sized balls., Roll each ball out thin with rolling pin. Fill with apples., Form into dumplings and place into baking dish.

title: Milky Way Cake
directions: Melt bars, margarine and pecans over low heat; let cool., Mix sugar, buttermilk, soda, eggs, flour and vanilla., Beat for 2 minutes., Fold in candy mixture., Pour into greased and floured 10-inch tube pan and bake at 350° for 70 minutes or until done.

title: Jud'S Pancakes
directions: Put milk, eggs, shortening and baking powder in bowl., Mix real good., Do not use mixer., Add flour; stir in just enough to make moist (do not beat)., Preheat ungreased griddle to 350°. Pour batter onto griddle; flip when edges get dry and bubbles form in middle., Makes the best pancakes you ever laid a lip over!, May be mixed and refrigerated., Batter will keep one week.

title: Buttered Turnips
directions: Peel turnips, dust with salt and cook tender., Caramelize sugar., Melt butter in same pan., Add parsley and pour this over turnips., Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

title: Creamy Banana Pudding
directions: Mix pudding according to directions on box., Add Eagle Brand milk and Cool Whip thoroughly., In a 2 to 3-quart casserole, layer cookies, bananas and pudding., Repeat and then top with cookies. Refrigerate.

title: Stuffed Peppers
directions: Cut tops from green peppers; discard seeds and membranes. Place peppers in an 8 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish., Cover peppers. Microcook on High for 3 minutes., Remove peppers., Drain liquid. Sprinkle peppers with salt and pepper.

title: Peach Bread
directions: Peel skin off peaches and cut into small chunks., In a medium size bowl and using a potato masher, mash the peaches; pour into a strainer and drain., In large bowl, mix together flour, sugar, baking soda and salt., Set aside., In medium size bowl blend together peaches, beaten egg and melted margarine., Stir in the nuts and raisins., Add to the flour mixture and blend well., Pour into a 5 x 9-inch greased and floured loaf pan and let stand for 20 minutes., Bake in 350° oven for 55 minutes., Cool bread in pan for 15 minutes.

title: Crab Casserole
directions: Layer broccoli, crab meat and 1/2 of the soup mixture, then the stuffing mix., Place the other half of soup on top, then sprinkle the cheese on top., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Hot Potato Salad
directions: Cook bacon; crumble. Combine 1/3 cup bacon drippings, 1 egg, salt, pepper, vinegar and water. Heat and stir until thickened. Add potatoes, onion and bacon. Toss. Heat through.

title: Pineapple Bavaria Torte
directions: Mix the graham crackers and melted butter and press into a 9 x 13-inch pan., Slice the bananas into drained pineapple juice. Drain juice and place bananas on crust., Beat powdered sugar, eggs and soft butter for 10 minutes. Spread over bananas. Top with crushed pineapple. Add dollops of Cool Whip., Refrigerate.

title: Hot Cranberry Drink
directions: In large saucepan, bring 1 quart water and cranberries to a boil. Reduce heat; cover and simmer for 8-10 minutes or until berries begin to pop. Drain, reserving liquid and berries. Put berries through a fine strainer or food mill. In a Dutch oven or large kettle, combine the sugar, red hots, lemon juice, cranberry liquid and pulp, and remaining water.

title: Spinach-Stuffed Shells
directions: Place a large saucepan over medium heat., Spray with cooking spray and saute onion until tender., Add tomatoes and next 6 ingredients and stir well., Bring to boil; cover and simmer for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally., Cook the shells and drain.

title: Sauerkraut Salad
directions: Drain kraut and chop it into 1-inch pieces with kitchen shears., Using large mixing bowl, add all other ingredients and mix well., Cover; refrigerate 24 hours., Keeps well.

title: Praline Cheese Cake
directions: Grease well 8 or 9-inch round pan., Prepare crumb crust and line sides and bottom of pan to about 1/4-inch thickness., Set aside.

title: Scripture Cake
directions: Cream butter, sugar and, honey., Add, eggs,, one, at, a time, beating well after, each., Combine flour, baking powder, salt and spices., Blend, into, butter mixture alternately with milk., Stir in raisins, figs and almonds., Bake in greased and floured 12-cup tube or Bundt pan, in, 350°, oven, for 40 to 50 minutes., Use toothpick to test for doneness., Cool 10 minutes and then invert on serving plate.

title: Doughnuts
directions: Combine shortening, sugar and eggs., Cream., Add dry ingredients alternately., Add milk into flour mixture., Blend well., Cover and chill 1 hour.

title: Pumpkin Cookies
directions: Cream together shortening and sugar., Beat in pumpkin, vanilla, and salt until blended., Sift together flour, baking powder, baking soda, and cinnamon., Beat into creamed mixture. Fold in raisins and nuts (if desired)., Drop on greased cookie sheet., Bake at 325 degrees for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Strawberry Cake
directions: Pull your sponge cake apart. Layer in 8 x 13 pan. Mix your cream cheese and confectioners sugar together until smooth. Spread over your cake. Mix strawberry glaze and frozen strawberries together and spread over cream mixture. Let it set for about 2 hours and serve.

title: Italian Brisket
directions: Put meat and mixes into crock-pot with only 2 cups of water. Cook long time, 6 to 8 hours is fine., Add green peppers last 30 to 45 minutes of cooking., Serve on French rolls, with little Au Jus on bread., Excellent!

title: Chocolate Zucchini Cake
directions: Put everything but nuts in a large mixing bowl. Beat about 4 minutes. Add nuts. Pour into 10-inch fluted tube pan., Bake at 350° for 1 hour. Let cool and turn out on cake plate. Melt 6 ounces of chocolate chips with a little oil in top of double boiler and drizzle on top and down sides of cake.

title: Chocolate Meringue Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Beat egg whites and sugar until stiff. Fold in the chips. Drop onto brown-paper lined cookie sheets. Place in preheated oven. Turn oven off and leave in with door closed for 8 hours.

title: Creamy Orange Dip
directions: Combine cream cheese and Marshmallow Creme; beat on medium speed with an electric mixer until smooth., Stir in remaining ingredients., Cover and chill for 1 to 2 hours., Serve with assorted fresh fruits., Yield:, 1 3/4 cups.

title: Low Cholesterol Lemon Bars
directions: *If using fresh lemons, takes 2 average size lemons to make 2 tablespoons of grated rind.

title: Sweet Ginger Chicken Wings
directions: In a bowl, combine flour, salt, paprika and pepper., Coat chicken wings in flour mixture., Shake off excess., Place wings on a large greased baking sheet., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes., Remove from the oven and drain.

title: Pasta Flora
directions: Beat butter until creamy., Add	sugar, and, beat, well. Add egg yolks, one at a, time, and blend well after each., Add vanilla, the 2 cups flour, and, baking powder; blend., Add the third cup of flour very slowly,, a little at a time, and blend by hand (or dough hook in, mixer), until you have a soft dough that doesn't stick to your hands, and you can roll.

title: Chicken Enchiladas With Sour Cream Sauce And Chile Con Queso
directions: Heat oil in a large skillet., Add onion and garlic; saute over medium heat until the onion is translucent., Do not brown., Stir in tomatoes, chicken, herbs and spices., Set aside while you prepare tortillas.

title: Bread Pudding And Sauce
directions: Soak the bread in the milk. Add the remaining ingredients and mix well., Pour into a 9 x 12-inch baking dish (buttered)., Bake 25 to 30 minutes in a 350° oven (or until firm).

title: Ann'S Braunschweiger Dip
directions: Mix all ingredients well., Chill for 2 hours (if you can). Serve with dark bread or crackers.

title: Great Punch
directions: Mix all together (except ginger ale) and refrigerate overnight., Add ginger ale at time of serving.

title: Easy Fruit Cake
directions: Combine cake mix with applesauce, eggs and orange and lemon extracts., Mix well., Toss cherries, pineapple, dates and nuts with flour to coat., Stir fruit and nuts into cake mixture., Mix well., Turn into 2 greased pans (waxed paper)., Bake at 275° for 1 3/4 hours.

title: Vanilla Cream Pie
directions: In saucepan, combine sugar, flour, and salt:, gradually stir in milk., Cook and stir over medium heat till mixture boils and thickens., Cook 2 minutes longer., Remove from heat.

title: Fudge Pudding Cake
directions: Pour this hot mixture over entire cake., Bake at 350° for 50 minutes., When done, cake is on top and fudge sauce on bottom. Serve warm., May add ice cream or whipped cream on top., Very good!, Serves 8.

title: Drop Hermits
directions: Combine in mixing bowl., Mix well., May need more flour., Drop batter by spoonfuls on greased cookie sheet., Bake 8 to 10 minutes in 350° oven.

title: Pizza Dip
directions: Mix first 4 ingredients well., Heat in microwave 30 seconds to 1 minute., Dip tortilla chips lightly., Enjoy!

title: Imperial Chicken
directions: Mix bread crumbs with cheese, parsley, garlic, salt and pepper., Dip each piece of chicken into melted butter, then into the crumb mixture., Be sure each piece is well covered., Arrange in shallow pan., Pour remaining butter over all the chicken and bake for 1 hour or until tender., Bake in a 350° oven.

title: Mountain Muffins
directions: Mix flour, baking powder, salt, and, sugar in bowl., Add egg, milk and oil., Also add, raisins, or cinnamon if you like. Pour into 6 greased muffin cups, and, bake, at 375° for 20 minutes.

title: Deli-Style Italian Pasta Salad
directions: Cook pasta according to package directions; drain., Rinse with cold water and drain again.

title: Prune Cake
directions: Mix all dry ingredients., Add eggs and oil., Mix in a large bowl., Pour in Bundt pan., Bake at 350° until done.

title: Apple Raisin Loaves
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Beat eggs, oil, apples, sugar and vanilla on low speed of electric mixer for 1 minute., Add flour, soda, baking powder, salt and spices., Mix for 45 seconds., Stir in nuts and raisins., Bake for 55 to 60 minutes., Cool in pan for 10 minutes; then remove loaf from pan.

title: Never Fail Pie Crust
directions: Mix flour, sugar and salt together., Cut in Crisco., Blend egg, vinegar and water., Add to dry mixture., Makes 2 large 2 crust pies or 5 single crusts., Any crusts not needed may be frozen and used later.

title: Frugal Gourmet Italian String Beans *
directions: Cook all ingredients, except lemon juice, in covered pan over medium heat for 15 minutes., Sprinkle with lemon juice and serve.

title: Honey Glazed Carrots
directions: Clean and slice carrots longways., Then cut in half to desired thickness., Boil until tender., Drain water; add butter until melted, then add brown sugar to sweetness desired., Stir until carrots are glazed.

title: Midwest Baked Beans
directions: Brown bacon; drain., Brown ground beef; drain., Drain off all grease., Mix up all ingredients., Bake for 1 1/2 or 2 hours at 350°., Serve hot., A little goes a long way.

title: Carrot Salad
directions: Cook carrots; cool and slice., In a large bowl, add vinegar to tomato soup, also oil., Add rest of ingredients., Add carrots; cover and marinate overnight., Can be stored in quart jars kept in refrigerator for weeks.

title: Poppy Seed Bread(Makes 1 Loaf)
directions: Sift together first 3 ingredients; set aside., In a large bowl, beat eggs; add sugar and oil or applesauce and mix well. Add vanilla and poppy seed., To this mixture, alternately add flour mixture and evaporated milk., Bake 60 to 90 minutes at 350° (325° in granite pan)., Let stand 5 minutes.

title: Grandma'S Apple Butter-Jelly
directions: Cut apples in quarters and cook until soft., Squeeze through colander. Put 5 cups of apples into pot., Bring to a boil. Add 7 cups of sugar and three shakes of allspice., Bring to a boil again., Add 1 box of Sure-Jell., Bring to a boil again for one minute., Pour into jars and seal., Makes approximately 80 pints.

title: Pickled Beets
directions: Bring ingredients to a boil., Cook beets and slip the skins off., Cut up and put into jars., Pour hot liquid over beets and seal., Process jars in boiling water bath for 10 minutes., Makes approximately 10 pints.

title: Corn Fritters
directions: Combine, flour, salt and baking powder., Beat eggs with milk and, add shortening and corn., Combine mixtures lightly. Fry like pancakes until center is done.

title: Tea Cakes
directions: Cream sugar and shortening., Add other ingredients., Drop by teaspoonful on cookie sheet., Bake at 350° until brown on top.

title: Chocolate Cookies(Soft)
directions: Blend margarine, sugar and egg., Add chocolate., Add dry ingredients, which have been sifted together, alternately with milk to mixture., Stir in nuts., Drop from teaspoon onto cookie sheet., Bake at 375° for 12 to 15 minutes on greased pan., Makes 3 dozen.

title: Jiffy Clam Chowder
directions: Combine all ingredients, including clam juice, in saucepan and simmer for about 10 minutes.

title: Spaghetti Tetrazzini
directions: Mix water and milk with mushroom soup., Combine with remaining ingredients., Place in the casserole dish provided in the church office., There is no need to bake it as it is baked before serving at the soup kitchen., You can easily prepare this ahead and freeze it!

title: Rhubarb Cobbler With Oat Dumplings
directions: In a small saucepan, stir together the 3/4 cup sugar and the cornstarch., Stir in water and orange juice., Cook and stir over medium-high heat until the mixture is thickened and bubbly., Add the fresh or frozen rhubarb pieces; cook and stir until the mixture returns to boiling., Remove from the heat., Cover the mixture to keep warm.

title: Chicken And Rice Casserole
directions: Melt butter and add three soups and water., Remove 1 cup of the mixture and reserve for topping., To the remaining soup mixture, add 1 cup uncooked brown rice., Spread rice mixture on bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan., Place chicken pieces on top of mixture and top with the 1 cup reserved mixture, Parmesan cheese and almonds., Bake in 350° oven for 1 hour.

title: Easy Rhubarb Dessert
directions: Cube the rhubarb and spread on bottom of greased 9 x 13-inch pan., Sprinkle dry Jell-O over rhubarb, then scatter marshmallows on top., Prepare yellow cake according to box directions; pour over top., Bake according to box directions., Serve warm, plain or with whipped cream or ice cream.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Cook broccoli as usual and lay broccoli on bottom of greased casserole., Combine 1/2 pint sour cream and mayonnaise., Break fried bacon into small pieces over broccoli., Pour sour cream mix over broccoli., Sprinkle with 1/2 cup Parmesan cheese., Sprinkle paprika., Cook 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Slow Cooker Kalua Pork
directions: Place pork fat side up in slow cooker (crock-pot)., Combine water and liquid smoke; pour over meat and sprinkle with salt. Cover and cook on medium 8 to 12 hours; remove pork butt from cooker and shred, then add the juices from the cooker (at least 1 cup; the flavor is in the juice)., Ready to eat.

title: Zucchini And Cheese Casserole
directions: Combine ingredients and put in well-buttered casserole., Bake 1 hour at 350°.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., In a small bowl, combine butter, sugar, brown sugar and vanilla., Beat until creamy., Beat in eggs. Gradually add flour mixture., Mix well., Stir in morsels and nuts. Spread into greased 15 x 10 x 1-inch baking pan., Bake for 20 minutes., Cool; cut into 35 (2-inch) squares.

title: Cheesy Vegetable Casserole
directions: Saute celery and onion in a bit of oil., Combine all of the listed ingredients, except cheese crackers., Pour into a 2-quart casserole., Combine 2 cups crushed cheese crackers and 1/4 cup melted margarine., Stir in 1/2 cup grated Cheddar cheese., Spread over vegetable mixture in casserole., Bake in 300° oven for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Nanamo Squares
directions: Blend., Spread this icing over mixture in pan and let it set. Place in cool (not cold) place until set and cut into squares and serve.

title: Amazing Chicken Pie
directions: Boil chicken breasts for about 30 minutes. Put eggs in same pot with boiling chicken and boil for an additional 15 minutes. Drain water from chicken and eggs. Spray cool water on chicken and eggs to help cool faster. Spray rectangular casserole dish with Pam. Tear chicken breasts into small pieces and layer the bottom of rectangular casserole dish. Take hard-boiled eggs and remove shells. Press eggs with fork to make smaller pieces. Layer egg pieces on top of chicken and then season the top of chicken and eggs with salt and pepper. (You may also add a pinch of garlic.) Put cream of chicken soup (or chicken broth) on top of the layer of chicken and eggs and smooth with spoon. Mix flour, butter and milk together. Pour onto the top of chicken and eggs. Bake in oven at 375° for about 45 minutes or until the top is golden brown.

title: Hot Curried Fruit
directions: Melt butter; add sugar and curry powder., Drain fruits. Arrange fruit in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish and pour sauce over fruits., Bake at 325 degrees for 1 - 1 1/2 hours., Serve with sour cream if desired.

title: Poppy Seed Cake
directions: Mix the cake mix, eggs and vanilla pudding., Stir in poppy seed with a spoon., Bake in tube pan at 350°.

title: Smashing Squash
directions: Add melted margarine to 1/2 of stuffing., Add to cooked squash., Add carrot, onion, sour cream and soup., Mix all together., Put into a large greased casserole dish., Sprinkle rest of stuffing on top., Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

title: Cabbage Wedges With Cheese Sauce
