directions: Cook chicken with salt and pepper until done., Cut into strips., Brown in skillet with 2 tablespoons of margarine or butter., Remove from skillet.

title: Italian Baked Chicken
directions: Combine first 5 ingredients in a medium saucepan., Cook over medium heat until butter melts., Place chicken in an 8 x 12 x 2-inch baking dish., Sprinkle with salt and pepper., Pour sauce over chicken., Bake, uncovered, at 325° for 1 hour or until tender., Also good cooked on grill.

title: Cheese Ball
directions: Mix all ingredients, except pecans., Form into a ball; roll in pecans., Chill.

title: Cheesy Mostaccioli
directions: Preheat oven to 400°., Combine pasta, meat, soup and spaghetti sauce., Add pepper, seasoning and 2 cups cheese., Mix together. Place in casserole., Sprinkle with remaining cheese., Bake for 25 minutes., Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Crab Meat Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients in a greased baking dish., Bake for 15 minutes., Sprinkle with cheese and bake for 5 minutes longer at 300°.

title: Cheesy Scalloped Potatoes
directions: Mix soup, milk, salt, pepper, butter and cheese, then add potatoes., Pour in large baking dish., Bake 1 hour covered., Stir and bake 1/2 hour uncovered at 375°.

title: Jam Cake
directions: Cream butter and sugar., Add 5 well beaten eggs., Sift spices, baking powder, cocoa and flour; add alternately with soda-buttermilk mixture to the other ingredients., Add nuts, raisins, preserves and vanilla to batter., Bake at 375°., This makes either a four layer cake, or divide and make two cakes according to size of pans.

title: Turkey Casserole
directions: Cut the onion paper thin., Slice cooked potatoes., Layer ingredients in order, then repeat.

title: Cheeseburger Pie
directions: Sauce:, Combine 1 can tomato paste, melted oleo and 1/2 teaspoon of Italian seasoning.

title: Chicken And Dressing
directions: Cook a hen or thighs and legs., Bake cornbread to make dressing., Add celery and onions to broth after chicken is removed., Add salt and pepper to taste; add margarine., Crumble bread into broth., Add eggs., Add deboned chopped chicken., If mixture is too dry, add milk; if too thin, add more cornbread. Pour into greased baking dish and bake until a light brown at 350°.

title: Prize Winning Meat Loaf
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Combine all ingredients except ground beef; mix well., Add ground beef; mix lightly but thoroughly. Press into 8 x 4-inch loaf pan., Bake 1 hour., Drain., Let stand 5 minutes., Makes 8 servings.

title: German Potato Salad
directions: Peel potatoes and slice them thin., Set aside. Cut bacon in squares, dice medium onion and fry both together until bacon is crisp., Remove bacon and drain on paper.

title: Cowboy Cookies
directions: Cream together shortening, sugar and brown sugar., Add peanut butter, eggs, oatmeal and sifted dry ingredients., Add chips and nuts. Mix well. Bake at 325° for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Fat-Free Carrot Muffins
directions: Mix the first 7 ingredients., Whisk the next 7 ingredients. Mix all together until moistened., Sprinkle with powdered sugar when done., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Goulash
directions: Cook macaroni., Drain., While macaroni is cooking, brown ground meat and onion with salt to taste., Add all ingredients in large pot or Dutch oven., Cook on low until cheese is melted and all ingredients are blended, stirring often to prevent sticking. Serves 8.

title: Sweet Potato And Apple Casserole
directions: Place apples and potatoes in baking dish., Mix together other ingredients and pour over apples., Bake until light brown in 350° oven.

title: Creamed Crabmeat
directions: Mix ingredients together., Spread on toasted bun or English muffin., Run under broiler until bubbly., Makes 4 servings.

title: Tuna Log
directions: Combine all ingredients except parsley., Shape into log or ball., Roll in parsley., Chill.

title: Green Bean Salad
directions: Drain green beans, corn and peas., Mix vegetables with onion, pimento and celery., Heat sugar, vinegar and salt., Pour over vegetables., Best if refrigerated overnight., Yields 10 servings. Preparation time is 15 minutes.

title: Slender'Rific Dip
directions: Combine all ingredients and chill., Serve with veggies or crackers., This is low calorie.

title: Daily Bread Stew
directions: Combine all ingredients in a large pan or pot., Cook to boiling, then simmer until it seems done., Can be cooked in a crock-pot on high for a few hours.

title: Broccoli Dip
directions: Mix and heat., Use warm chafing dish to keep warm.

title: Chocolate Trifle
directions: Follow all directions on chocolate cake box and pudding., Make whipped cream., Add confectioners sugar to heavy cream and beat until fluffy.

title: Veggie Pizza
directions: Flatten croissants on cookie sheet., Bake as directed., Cool. Top with Ranch dressing., Then top with veggies and cheese. Refrigerate 1 hour., Slice and serve.

title: Western Hash
directions: Brown beef and onions., Add rest of the ingredients., Cover and simmer for 25 minutes.

title: Time-To-Spare Ribs
directions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees., Shake flour in oven cooking bag. Place in 13 x 9 inch baking pan., Add barbecue sauce, onion and green pepper., Squeeze bag to blend ingredients., Cut ribs in serving pieces; place in bag., Turn bag to coat ribs., Arrange ribs in even layers., Close bag with nylon tie, cut six 1/2-inch slits in top., Bake 1 1/2 hours or until tender.

title: Drop Sugar Cookies
directions: Mix shortening, sugar and eggs; stir in sour cream and vanilla., Blend flour, soda and salt., Stir in., Add nuts if you want to., Chill dough if soft., Drop by tablespoons on greased pan. Bake at 375° for about 10 minutes., Cool.

title: Salmon Loaf
directions: Preheat oven to 350°. Use 7 1/2 x 2 1/2-inch loaf pan and spray with cooking spray., Drain salmon, saving liquid. Discard skin, but save bones., Flake salmon lightly, but well with fork., Crush bones (calcium bonus) and mix., Add vinegar to salmon liquid and enough cold water to make 1/2 cup total liquid., Add to salmon., Add all remaining ingredients and mix well., Pack into loaf pan., Bake for 1 hour., Leave loaf in pan for 5 minutes before unmolding onto serving plate.

title: Jello Surprise
directions: Pour uncooked jello into bowl., Add cottage cheese and mix well., Blend in Cool Whip., Drain pineapple., Mix in with jello and other ingredients., Add walnuts., Stir well (it will be thick)., Refrigerate and let chill for 1 hour.

title: Mary May'S Pecan Candy-Cake
directions: Cream butter and sugar., Add eggs; mix well., Add flour that has been sifted with salt and baking powder, alternately with milk., Add vanilla., Pour into three (8 or 9-inch) pans., Bake at 375°, 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Buttermilk Crumb Cake
directions: Mix with a spoon., Do not beat.

title: Corn Chowder
directions: In large saucepan, cook bacon until crisp., Remove bacon; crumble and set aside., Reserve 3 tablespoons bacon drippings in saucepan; discard remainder., Add onion slices to saucepan and cook until lightly browned., Add diced potatoes and water; cook over medium heat until potato is tender, 10 to 15 minutes., Add corn, milk, salt and pepper; cook until heated through., Pour into warmed bowl; top each serving with crumbled bacon and a pat of butter or margarine., Serve with crackers., Makes 4 to 5 servings.

title: Red Velvet Cake
directions: Pour oil into mixing bowl and add sugar., Beat until blended. Add eggs, one at a time., Continue beating until thick and smooth. Blend together red food coloring, cocoa and vinegar., Beat well. Add vanilla and blend.

title: Apple Crisp
directions: Arrange apples in a buttered 8 x 8-inch pan., Mix together remaining ingredients and sprinkle onto apples., Bake at 375° for 30 minutes., Serve warm with ice cream or enjoy it all by itself. A quick and easy dessert all will love!

title: Danish Squares
directions: Grease 9 x 13 cake pan., Unroll one tube of crescent rolls on bottom of pan., Pinch seams together., Beat together cream cheese, sugar, vanilla and egg yolk., Spread mixture on top of crescent rolls., Unroll other tube of crescent rolls and place on top of cheese mixture., Beat egg white until foamy and spread on top. Sprinkle with cinnamon & sugar., Bake at 350° for 25-30 minutes. Cool.

title: Key Lime Pie
directions: Combine the egg yolks and condensed milk and last, add the lime juice., Pour into graham cracker crust and top with either meringue or whipped cream.

title: Homemade Banana Ice Cream
directions: Mash bananas and eggs., Mix in half and half, sugar and milk. Pour into ice cream freezer., Add milk to fill line., Makes 1 gallon.

title: Lemon Cream Pie
directions: Combine 1/2 cup sugar and milk and heat., Beat egg yolks., Add flour combined with sugar and salt., Pour into hot mixture and cook until it begins to thicken., Add lemon juice and grated rind and cook 1 minute; stir., Add butter; stir well., Pour into baked pie shell., Beat 2 egg whites combined with 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar., Add 4 teaspoons of sugar., Beat until stiff., Bake at 375° for about 15 minutes.

title: Lemon Fruit Salad
directions: Use 2 cups of drained fruit juice and mix with instant lemon pudding., Let thicken a little., Combine with completely drained fruit., Add lemon juice and bananas before serving.

title: Pineapple Delight
directions: Mix like pie crust (no water)., Press into lightly greased 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake 15 minutes at 400°., Cool.

title: Chicken And Broccoli
directions: Arrange cooked broccoli in the bottom of greased casserole dish., Spread chicken over broccoli, then add mixture of first 4 ingredients., Top with bread crumbs and grated cheese., Bake for 25 minutes at 350°.

title: Coffee Can Bread
directions: Dissolve yeast	in water., Blend in ginger and 1 tablespoon sugar., Let, stand	until, bubbly.	Add, rest, of sugar, milk, salad oil and salt., Put, on, low speed of mixer and add flour 1 cup at a time., Beat, in, last, cup, with heavy spoon. Add flour until dough is heavy, and, stiff, but, too sticky to knead., Place dough in, two, well-greased 1 pound coffee cans. Cover with well-greased plastic, can lids., You may freeze the dough at this point., It will keep for two weeks., Let covered cans stand until dough pops	off, lids., Bake in moderate oven at 350° for 45 to 60 minutes., Crust, will, be	brown.	Brush lightly with butter. After, cooling, 10	minutes, remove from can.

title: Diet Orange Cake
directions: Grind orange and raisins together; set aside., Cream Sweet 'N Low and butter until fluffy., Beat in eggs, buttermilk, soda and orange mixture., Add oatmeal and flour; beat well., Turn into 8 or 9-inch square pan., Bake at 350° for 35 minutes or until cake tests done.

title: Ellen'S Broccoli Casserole
directions: Cook broccoli and drain., Mix with rice and set aside., Over low flame, or in microwave,, melt together the soup and cheese. Pour over broccoli and rice mix., Add water chestnuts and mix well., Pour into 2-quart casserole dish and cover., Heat in 350° oven for 30 minutes or until done., (Can use microwave instead.)

title: Olive Garden Sangria
directions: Mix all ingredients except for ice., Pour Sangria in glass and then add ice., Make sure there is fruit in every glass. Maraschino cherries can also be added.

title: Turkey Casserole
directions: Cook macaroni until, almost tender., Drain., Put macaroni into a large baking dish., Add the rest of the ingredients; mix well. Cook, uncovered, in preheated 350° oven for about 1 hour., Serves about 12., Costs about 8 cents per serving.

title: Toasted Pumpkin Seeds
directions: Mix pumpkin seeds, salt and oil together and spread single layer on a cookie sheet., Bake at 250° for 30 minutes, turning seeds every 10 minutes.

title: Sliced Baked Potatoes
directions: Peel potatoes if skin is tough; otherwise, just rinse and pat dry., Cut potatoes into thin slices but not all the way through. (Use handle of spoon to prevent knife from cutting through.) Place in microwave safe bowl and sprinkle with melted butter and herbs., Microwave on high 10 minutes, rearranging after 5 minutes. Let rest 5 minutes., Sprinkle with grated cheese and parmesan cheese., Microwave for another 4 to 6 minutes on high until cheese melts and potatoes are soft., Sprinkle with salt and serve.

title: Hot Dog Roll-Ups
directions: Place frankfurter in center of each slice bread., Mix mayonnaise, onion, relish and mustard., Spoon about 2 teaspoons mayonnaise mixture over frankfurter; secure with wooden picks. Place roll-ups, seam sides down, in ungreased rectangular baking dish, 13 x 9 x 2-inch., Brush with margarine., Bake uncovered in 350° oven until hot and golden brown, about 20 minutes., Yields 8 sandwiches.

title: Hot Turkey Salad
directions: Combine turkey, celery, almonds, onion, lemon juice, mayonnaise and salt in bowl; mix well., Spoon into baking dish. Sprinkle with cheese and crushed chips., Bake at 450° for 10 minutes., Serves approximately 6.

title: Lemon Bisque
directions: Whip chilled milk until stiff peaks form., Add lemon juice, jello and sugar., Mix well., Pour into dish lined with crumbs. Sprinkle top with crumbs and chill before serving.

title: Hot Ham And Cheese Dip In Bread
directions: Cut off top of round loaf of bread., Scoop out pieces., Mix all ingredients together., Pour into hollow of bread., Put top on. Cover with foil., Bake at 350° for 35 minutes., Serve with scooped out pieces of bread.

title: Cucumber Salad
directions: Peel cucumbers (optional), then slice thin; set aside., Mix all other ingredients in bowl large enough to accommodate cucumbers., Add cucumbers and mix well., Put in refrigerator until ready to use., Will stay nice for approximately 1 week.

title: Zucchini Pineapple Bread
directions: Beat eggs; add oil, sugar and vanilla., Beat until thick and foamy., Stir in zucchini and pineapple., Combine dry ingredients; add to mixture and mix well., Bake in two well-greased and floured loaf pans at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Tater Tot Casserole
directions: Crumble hamburger in casserole dish., Cover with onion slices and then put your cheese over the onion., Pour undiluted mushroom soup over layers., Cover with Tater Tots., Do not salt., Bake for 1 hour at 350°.

title: Sunny Fruit Salad
directions: Layer in casserole., For last layer, pour cherry pie filling over top, then pour sherry over whole salad., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Caramel Apple Delight
directions: Blend the first 4 ingredients, using electric mixer., Use as dip for apple slices., Tastes like caramel apples., Makes 1 cup.

title: Cheese Ball
directions: Mix all ingredients together and roll into ball(s)., Roll ball(s) into nuts., Serve with crackers.

title: Roasted Ratatouille
directions: Set oven racks at 2 lowest levels., Heat oven to 450°., Peel papery skin from garlic and wrap head in aluminum foil., Bake 30 minutes; cool., Meanwhile, coat 2 baking sheets with vegetable oil or nonstick spray and arrange tomatoes, eggplant, zucchini, squash, onions and peppers on baking sheets., Roast 20 minutes, turning once, until tender and brown., Cool.

title: Corn Fritters
directions: Combine all ingredients except corn., Blend until smooth., Fold in the corn., In a large skillet heat the shortening or oil and drop batter by tablespoons into the very hot fat., Fry until browned on both sides.

title: Grape Blueberry Salad
directions: Dissolve Jell-o in boiling water. Add all other ingredients, stirring well. Congeal in 13 x 9, glass, dish.

title: Apple Pie
directions: Sprinkle lemon juice over sliced apples., Coat well and pour into pie shell., Combine remaining ingredients and sprinkle over apples., Bake at 425° for 30 to 40 minutes., Yield:, 8 servings. Calories per serving 103.

title: Pasta-Sausage Soup
directions: Remove casings from the sausages and cut into 1-inch pieces. In a Dutch oven, brown sausage over medium heat., Remove sausage and drain all but 2 tablespoons of the drippings., Saute onion, pepper and garlic until tender., Add sausage and all remaining ingredients., Simmer, uncovered, stirring occasionally, until pasta is tender, about 15 to 20 minutes., Yield:, 3 quarts.

title: Wonderful Wheat Waffles
directions: Mix dry ingredients., Combine yolks, milk and oil., Stir into dry ingredients until smooth., Fold in stiff egg whites, leaving it slightly fluffy (curdled looking)., Bake in waffle iron.

title: Hamburger-Rice Casserole
directions: Brown hamburger in butter., Add salt, pepper and onion., Add rest of ingredients., Mix., Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 30 minutes., Serves 8.

title: Tuna Balls
directions: Combine., Form mixture into 1-inch balls and roll in crushed corn flakes., Bake in oven at 425° for 20 minutes., Serve with favorite sauce.

title: Punch
directions: Mix all ingredients, except ginger ale, well and chill., Just before serving, add the ginger ale., Serve.

title: Oatmeal Chocolate Chip Cookies
directions: Cream butter, sugars, eggs and vanilla., Add dry ingredients and mix well., Stir in oats (quick or regular oats) and chocolate chips., Drop by rounded teaspoon on greased cookie sheet., Bake 12 minutes at 350°.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes. Stir halfway through baking., Will be golden brown.

title: Cherry Coffee Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Grease and flour a 9 x 9-inch pan., In large bowl, combine margarine and sugar; beat until creamy., Beat in eggs and sour cream., Sift together flour, salt, baking powder and baking soda., Gradually add sifted dry ingredients to creamed mixture, beating after each addition., Add vanilla., Pour half of the batter into prepared pan; spread with cherry pie filling, then pour remaining batter over pie filling.

title: Yellow Cookies
directions: Mix., Roll into cookie size balls., Roll in white sugar., Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Green Enchiladas
directions: Cook meat, onion, chili blend or chili powder, salt and pepper together until done., Mix milk, soups and green chilies together. Start with tortillas or chips on bottom of 10 x 13-inch pan. Layer tortillas or chips, meat mixture on top, then soup mixture on top of meat., Repeat layers until all is gone., Top with cheese., Bake in a 350° oven for about 20 to 30 minutes., Top with cheese., Cook until hot through and through.

title: Mound Balls
directions: Melt chocolate chips and wax in double broiler., May need teaspoon or so of milk., Mix first 4 ingredients and make into balls., Roll around in chocolate chips and wax., Place on waxed paper and let cool.

title: Black Bean And Salsa Salad
directions: In a large bowl, combine first 5 ingredients; mix well., Blend the salsa with red vinegar dressing;, pour over salad and toss well., Cover and chill., Serves 8.

title: Texas Matador
directions: Brown ground meat., Add tomatoes, onion and tomato sauce. Bring to a boil and simmer 10 minutes., Boil noodles 10 minutes and drain., Add noodles and meat mixture with cream cheese, salt, pepper and sugar., Put in casserole dish., Sprinkle with cheese. Bake 35 minutes at 350°.

title: Hot Dip
directions: Brown sausage and hamburger until crumbled; drain excess fat. In crock-pot, melt cheeses., Add all other ingredients., Mix well. Serve with favorite chips., Makes a large amount and it can be frozen.

title: Date Pinwheel Cookies
directions: Cook dates in water a few minutes, stirring constantly., Set aside and let cool., When cool, add nuts., Thoroughly cream sugar and oleo, add egg and beat well., Add vanilla and sifted dry ingredients and mix., Knead dough, divide in half, roll one part on floured board 1/4-inch thick in a rectangular shape., Spread half of date mixture all over the dough and roll like a jelly roll, wrap in waxed paper and chill in refrigerator overnight., Repeat with the remaining dough and filling., Cut in 1/4-inch slices and place on greased cookie sheet., Bake in 400° oven 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Raisin Zucchini Bread
directions: Shred zucchini., Set aside., Cream sugar and oil., Add eggs, zucchini, and vanilla. Mix flour, raisins, nuts and cinnamon., Add to above., Pour into 2 greased loaf pans., Bake 350° for 1 hour.

title: Salad Apple Ring
directions: Dissolve gelatin and dash of salt in 2 cups hot water; cool to room temperature and add lemon juice., Carefully pour lemon-lime beverage down side of bowl; stir gently with up and down motion. Chill until partially set., Meanwhile, core apples and slice very thinly., Add apples and grapes to gelatin mixture, stirring gently with up and down motion., Pour into 2-quart ring mold., Chill until firm., Unmold.

title: Japanese Pie
directions: Mix margarine, sugar and eggs., Add remaining ingredients; pour into unbaked pie shell., Bake at 325° for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Barbecued Pork Chops
directions: Bake chops in oven approximately 15 minutes., To mix barbecue sauce, mix remaining ingredients., Pour over chops and finish cooking another 15 minutes.

title: Lubee (Green Beans)
directions: Brown onion and ground beef (you do not have to use oil)., Add tomato paste, spices, water and green beans., Simmer for about 40 minutes., May be served with rice., Serves about 4.

title: Broccoli And Cauliflower Casserole
directions: Cook broccoli and cauliflower according to package directions. Drain., Place in a greased casserole dish., Melt together soup and cheese., Pour over broccoli and cauliflower., Mix together melted butter and cracker crumbs., Bake in a 350° oven for 30 to 35 minutes., Serves 10.

title: Sugar Cookies
directions: Cream oil, sugar, butter and powdered sugar., Add vanilla and eggs., Sift the dry ingredients in and blend well., Chill the dough before shaping., Roll 2 teaspoons of dough for each ball. Roll the balls in granulated sugar., Put balls on greased cookie sheet., Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Baked Vegetable Omelet
directions: Lightly grease a 9 x 13-inch baking dish., Layer Pepper Jack cheese, vegetables, then Cheddar cheese in dish., Beat milk, flour, salt, pepper and eggs until smooth; pour over cheese. Bake, uncovered, for 40 to 45 minutes at 350° until the egg mixture is set., Let stand 10 minutes before serving., Great for brunch!!

title: Janice'S Chicken Noodle Soup
directions: Boil chicken in large pot of water seasoned with Tony's seasoning, a little cayenne pepper and bouillon cubes., When chicken is cooked, remove and debone., Add chopped celery and carrots to broth; cook 15 minutes., Then add chopped chicken and vermicelli., Cook another 15 minutes.

title: Baked Soybeans
directions: Pressure cook soybeans in water 1 hour., Drain juice from tomatoes and add to sauteed onions in heavy skillet., Simmer., Cut tomatoes in small pieces and add to juice., Add brown sugar, oil and salt., Mix., Add to cooked soybeans., (I often just add all these ingredients to beans without any precooking.), Bake at 350° until juice is thickened., Add lemon juice and sweet basil., Add 1/2 can plain tomato paste., Yield:, 8 servings.

title: Sad Cake
directions: Mix well., Bake in a 350° oven in an oblong baking dish., Cool and cut into squares.

title: Cavatini
directions: Cook macaroni shells., Put spaghetti sauce, garlic, onion, green pepper and oregano into saucepan and cook for 30 minutes. Add rest of ingredients (except cheeses) together., Layer into casserole dish, layer of macaroni, layer of sauce and layer of cheese., Repeat until all mixture is used up., Bake 15 minutes at 350°.

title: Easy Ambrosia
directions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl., Serve immediately or chill several hours., Yield: 8 servings.

title: "Sitting Pretty" Cookies
directions: Sift together flour and salt; set aside., Mix together the butter, sugar, vanilla and egg yolk., Add slowly to flour mixture. Roll into small balls; dip into egg white., Roll into chopped nuts., Bake at 350° for 5 minutes., Remove and make thumbprint in center of each cookie., Put back in oven for 5 to 7 minutes longer., Let cool completely, then fill each hole with sour cream frosting., Garnish by placing 1 peanut M&M in center of frosting.

title: Scalloped Pineapple
directions: Grease 2-quart casserole., Just mix all ingredients together in casserole., Bake at 375° for 40 to 50 minutes.

title: Wild Plum Tree Muffins
directions: Combine ingredients., Pour into miniature muffin tins about 1/2 full., Bake at 325° for about 15 minutes., Watch carefully!

title: Banana Cranberry Jam
directions: Simmer cranberries and water for 10 minutes. Add mashed bananas and sugar; bring to a boil and boil hard for 1 minute. Remove from heat. Add pectin. Stir and skim. Put in sterile jars and seal., Yield:, Eight 8-ounce jars.

title: Cracker Mix
directions: You will need 1 large Ziploc plastic bag.

title: Jalapeno Bloody Marias
directions: In a blender put half of tomato juice and jalapeno chili. Process until chili is pureed., Fill a cocktail shaker with ice and add tomato-jalapeno mixture and remaining ingredients., Shake well and strain into highball glasses.

title: India Chicken Curry
directions: Simmer onion and celery in butter., Add flour; mix thoroughly. Add chicken stock and cook until smooth., Add tomato juice, seasonings and chicken., Arrange rice in a ring and pour hot curried chicken in the center.

title: Brittany Stew
directions: Boil 1/2 package of egg noodles according to directions on bag., On medium to low heat, warm beef stew in saucepan., When noodles are ready, drain and place in bowl., Add beef stew and serve., Add salt and pepper to taste., Clean up mess.

title: Pudding Cake
directions: Mix pudding with 3 cups milk., Mix in blender and pour over cream cheese mixture., Top with Cool Whip., Sprinkle with grated Hershey bars and pecans., Refrigerate before serving.

title: Cheryle'S Golden Punch
directions: Dissolve sugar in some of water; combine juice with remaining water., Pour into punch bowl with ice cubes or ice ring., Top with cold ginger ale.

title: Soft Sugar Cookies
directions: Cream together the sugar and shortening., Add eggs., In a separate bowl, sift together the flour, salt, baking powder and soda., Add to sugar mixture, alternating with milk., Add vanilla. Drop by teaspoons on greased cookie sheet., Bake until slightly golden in a 350° oven., Frost with lemon icing.

title: Strawberry Dessert
directions: Mix with rubber spatula., Freeze or chill before serving.

title: Aunt Poly'S Sweet Pickles
directions: Drain off and throw away all vinegar from the jug of dill pickles., Cut pickles into wheels, do not cut too thin., Return the pickles to gallon jug and add the sugar to pickles., (It works best if you layer the pickles and sugar a couple times.), Tighten the lid on jar and turn; shake the jar several times a day until all sugar has dissolved., Add 1 ounce of Tabasco hot sauce and mix well., You can do this by turning jug upside down several times. The pickles will be crisp in a week to 10 days.

title: Spiced Tea Mix
directions: Combine., Use 2 heaping teaspoons for each serving., Makes 1 pound.

title: Peanut Blossoms(Cookies)
directions: Combine all ingredients except kisses in a large mixer bowl. Shape dough into balls., Roll balls in sugar and place on cookie sheet., Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes., Top each cookie immediately with a candy kiss., Press down firmly so cookie cracks around edge.

title: Easy Chicken Pie
directions: Take chicken off bones and put in bottom of flat 3-quart casserole dish., Mix soup and water and pour over chicken., Mix flour, milk and margarine and spread over soup and chicken., Do not stir., Pour 2 cups of chicken broth on top; do not stir. Bake at 350° until done, about 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Cheese Bits
directions: Chill dough thoroughly., Roll into small balls and press down with fork., Bake at 350° to 375° about 15 minutes.

title: Cornmeal Scrapple
directions: In a saucepan, combine the cornmeal, milk, sugar and salt; gradually stir in water., Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly. Reduce heat; cook, covered, 10 minutes longer or until very thick, stirring occasionally., Remove from heat and stir in sausage., Pour into buttered loaf pan., Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate. To serve, cut 1/3-inch slices; dip in flour on both sides., Fry in skillet in melted butter over medium heat until browned on both sides., Serve warm with syrup.

title: Lemon Butter Shrimp With Angel Hair Pasta
directions: Melt butter in a large skillet., Add next 8 ingredients. Bring to a boil., Add shrimp., Cook over medium heat about 5 minutes., Stir occasionally.

title: Sunset Dip
directions: Spread cream cheese in 9-inch microwave safe pie plate. Sprinkle with cheese., Microwave on High 2 to 3 minutes or until cheese melts., Top with salsa and serve with chips.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
directions: Mix first 8 ingredients together., Top with cheese and potato chips., Bake at 450° for 15 minutes., Excellent for parties.

title: Country Corn Muffins
directions: Combine first 6 ingredients in a large bowl; make a well in center of mixture., Combine remaining ingredients; add to dry ingredients, stirring just until moistened., Spoon into greased muffin pans., Bake at 400° for 12 to 15 minutes or until golden brown., Yield:, 2 dozen.

title: Asparagus And Green Pea Casserole
directions: *Or toasted slivered almonds., This is my preference.

title: Chicken Dressing
directions: Mix all ingredients together real well except margarine., Put in baking dish and top with margarine., Bake at 325° for at least an hour (onion needs to fully cook)., You can saute onion before adding and bake only about 1/2 the original time.

title: Corn Popovers
directions: Mix together and drop by teaspoonful into hot grease to deep fry., Fry until golden brown., Roll in powdered sugar.

title: Orange Julius
directions: In blender, blend orange juice, sugar, milk, water and vanilla. Add ice cubes. Blend well. Serve immediately.

title: Ricotta Balls
directions: Mix all ingredients in a bowl, drop by spoonful in oil and deep fry., Sprinkle with powdered sugar while warm., Keep refrigerated, if any are left.

title: Pecan-Crunch Sweet Potato Pie
directions: Blend together pecans, 1/3 cup brown sugar and butter., Press gently onto bottom of pie shell. Mix and beat gently to blend remaining ingredients., Pour into pie shell., Bake for 55 to 60 minutes at 400° or until knife inserted in center comes out clean. Makes 8 servings.

title: Breakfast Pizza
directions: Cook sausage until brown; drain, chop and set aside., Separate rolls and press into a 12-inch pizza pan to the center., Spoon sausage on crust; top with hash browns and cheese., Combine eggs, milk and spices; pour over sausage mixture., Sprinkle half of Parmesan cheese over egg mixture., Bake at 375° for 20 minutes. Remove from oven and sprinkle with remaining cheese; return to oven and bake 5 minutes.

title: Basic Streusel Topping
directions: Combine, the, sugars, and, flour in a medium size bowl. Add the, margarine;, mix well.	Very good on baked apple pie, rather than a top crust., Sprinkle a little cinnamon on top.

title: Salad Delight
directions: Mix all together and chill for 2 hours.

title: Olive-Cream Cheese Bagels
directions: In a medium saucepan, combine first 5 ingredients., Cook over medium-low heat, stirring occasionally, until mixture reaches 115°. Remove from heat; transfer to a large bowl., Add yeast and stir until dissolved., Let stand 3 minutes.

title: Easy Chip Dip
directions: Mix deviled ham and cream cheese., Thin to desired consistency with milk.

title: Pizza Lasagna
directions: In large skillet, brown ground beef, green pepper, onion and Italian seasoning., Drain., Add soup and pizza sauce., Mix together.

title: Glenn'S Chicken Wings
directions: Put half of mixture in bowl and marinate overnight., Drain wings when ready to cook., Cook on grill, turning frequently. When almost done, put wings in bowl with rest of marinade to which 2 tablespoons of butter has been added., Return wings to grill, turning once.

title: Cucumber Salad(Very Tasty!)
directions: Mix Jell-O and hot water; cool slightly., Add rest of ingredients; mix well., Chill until set and serve.

title: Fabulous Fudge
directions: Mix first 5 ingredients in a heavy 2-quart saucepan., Cook, stirring constantly, over medium heat., Mixture will be bubbling all over the top., Boil and stir 5 minutes more., Take off heat. Stir in chocolate pieces until completely melted., Stir in pecans and vanilla., Spread on buttered pan.

title: French Pastry Pie Crust
directions: Mix flour, salt, Crisco and sugar until it resembles corn meal., In small bowl, put egg, water and vinegar., Mix well with fork., Add to flour mixture and mix until well blended, then roll out for crusts., Makes 4 single crusts or 2 double crust pies. Freezes well.

title: Venison Stew
directions: Saute venison cubes in small amount of oil until brown., Add celery, pepper, carrots, onion and shallots., Take some of drippings from pan and make a roux with the flour (cook until brown like for gravy)., Add this to the pot, then add enough water to cover., Cook about 3 hours or until tender.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Sprinkle rice in bottom of casserole dish., Place chicken over rice., Pour onion soup mix over chicken., Add cream of chicken mushroom soup., Add water to entire mixture., Cover casserole dish and bake for 1 1/2 hours at 325°.

title: Coconut Cake
directions: Bake cake in a 9 x 13-inch pan., Bring to a boil the sugar, milk and coconut., Punch holes in hot cake with handle of wooden spoon or fork., Pour hot mixture over hot cake., Cool., Top with whipped topping., Sprinkle with coconut.

title: Baked Clams With Walnuts
directions: Chop and mash together the shallots, walnut halves, parsley and vermouth., Knead in butter, bread crumbs and Parmesan cheese. Spoon topping on each clam., Cover with freshly grated Parmesan (best quality)., Make a bed of loosely crumpled aluminum foil on a pan., Arrange clams on foil and bake, loosely covered with a layer of aluminum foil, in a 450° oven for 3 to 5 minutes., When just barely done, remove foil and brown close to the broiler., Serves 4.

title: Dip For Crackers
directions: Shred dried beef; chop the green onions and add to softened cream cheese. Form into a ball. Cover cheese ball with small pieces of dried beef.

title: Cranberry Orange Nut Bread
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Grease a large loaf pan., Mix all dry ingredients together. Combine the orange juice, butter and eggs together and mix with dry ingredients, mixing just until moistened. Stir in cranberries and nuts., Place mixture into greased pan and bake for 65 minutes or until wooden pick inserted in center of pan comes out clean. Cool 5 minutes. Remove from pan and cool on wire rack.

title: Grilled Chicken Tostadas
directions: Combine tomatoes, beans, jalapeno and cumin in skillet. Add cooked chicken. Heat 5 minutes or until thickened.

title: Lemon Cake Mix Cookies
directions: Mix cake mix with Cool Whip. Add lemon rind. Beat well., Add well beaten egg., Roll in powdered sugar, about 3/4 teaspoon at a time., Bake on a well-greased cookie sheet 10 to 12 minutes at 350°., Remove onto a rack to cool as they tend to stick., Makes about 5 1/2 dozen.

title: Snowball Dessert
directions: Mix ingredients well and pour into bowl (or mold) and freeze. Can be cut while frozen or thaw slightly and serve.

title: Orange Jello
directions: Mix together and mold., Good for summer as it stays molded in hot weather.

title: Butterscotch Pie
directions: In a heavy saucepan, combine brown sugar, 2 tablespoons butter and water; cook over medium heat to boiling., Reduce heat and cook gently until caramel is dark and syrup-like., Remove from heat and set aside., Melt remaining 2 tablespoons butter in saucepan over medium heat., Remove from heat; whisk in flour until smooth., Return to heat and cook, stirring constantly., Pour in milk and heat to boiling.

title: Zesty Italian Bake
directions: Brown the hamburger and onions., Drain., Add spaghetti sauce mix (water may need to be added if mixture is too thick)., Cover and simmer for 10 or 15 minutes.

title: Guacamole Dip
directions: Mix with mixer. Spread in 9 x 9 dish. Cover with finely shredded cheese. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Sauerkraut Salad
directions: Drain, rinse and chop sauerkraut. Put in a bowl the sugar, oil and vinegar., Mix until well blended., Add the vegetables and refrigerate for 2 days.

title: Pineapple Casserole
directions: In a 9 x 12-inch casserole, pour the two cans of pineapple, leaving out about 1/2 the juice., Sprinkle the flour-sugar mixture all over, then sprinkle the cheese.

title: Aunt Jo'S Easy Pie (Lemon Icebox)
directions: Mix and pour into prepared crumb or plain pie crust and top with Cool Whip when served.

title: Shrimp Spread
directions: Mix together all ingredients., Add just enough mayonnaise to make it creamy., Add a little ketchup for color., Serve with veggies or crackers.

title: Scrabble Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., In a 13 x 9-inch cake pan, pour pineapple and juice, and then spread the cherry pie filling over the pineapple., Spread dry cake mix over the entire top of the filling., Slice margarine in small slices over the top of the dry mix., If desired, add walnuts or pecans on top of the margarine. Bake about 30 to 35 minutes or until golden brown., Serve warm or chilled.

title: Crispy Ranch Chicken
directions: Place crushed potato chips on a sheet of wax paper. Sprinkle on pepper, if desired.

title: Banana Punch
directions: Dissolve water and sugar., Add rest of ingredients except ginger ale., Freeze in 2 gallon container., Before serving, thaw to slush and add 2 (28 ounce) bottles ginger ale., Makes 60 (6 ounce) glasses or 75 (4 ounce) cups.

title: Guacamole
directions: Position knife blade in food processor bowl., Add all ingredients except onion., Process 1 minute or until lumpy., Stir in onions., Yields 2 cups.

title: Onion Pie
directions: Crush crackers and mix butter, melted., Put in pan saving few tablespoons for top., Saute onions in 1/4 stick oleo and put on top of crackers., Make white sauce with cheese melted in it., Pour over onions., Put reserved crumbs on top and bake 15 minutes at 350°.

title: Candied Cucumbers
directions: Soak whole cucumbers in salt water for 14 days., Remove from salt water; slice and soak overnight in 1/2 box alum water. Remove from alum water., Rinse and soak in 1 gallon apple cider vinegar for 6 hours., Remove from vinegar., Pour vinegar out., Put pickles and sugar in layers with spice., Use 10 pounds sugar., Let stand in stone or glass jar for several days before using. Pickles do not have to be sealed.

title: Orange Pineapple Cake
directions: Prepare cake mix as directed., Add all juice of pineapple to cake mix and 2 tablespoons of pineapple., Bake as directed on box.

title: Baked Beans With Hamburger
directions: Use medium skillet., Cook bacon until crisp; set aside., Empty grease and use same pan., Saute onion and beef until brown. Remove onion and beef with slotted spoon., Put in 2-quart casserole and stir in salt., Discard drippings., Add cooked bacon. Preheat oven to 375°., In skillet add remaining ingredients and heat until hot, stirring occasionally., Pour into casserole and stir well., Bake uncovered for 60 minutes.

title: Baked Beans
directions: Cut one squash in half. Scoop out seeds and strings., Place in baking dish, cut side down., Add a little water and bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until tender., Fill cavity with dabs of butter, brown sugar and pecans. Salt and pepper to taste. Serve hot.

title: Layered Vegetable Salad
directions: In large bowl, layer lettuce and onions., Spoon 1/2 cup mayonnaise evenly on top., Layer celery, green pepper and peas. Spread remaining mayonnaise over top., Sprinkle sugar, cheese and bacon over top., Cover and refrigerate 8 hours., Add water chestnuts., Toss before serving., Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Fresh Strawberry Pie
directions: Mix jello, cornstarch and sugar together., Add 1 cup boiling water., Return to stove., Bring to boil and continue boiling and stirring until thick; cool., Add about 3 cups sliced strawberries. Pour into baked and cooled pie crust., Chill and serve with whipped cream.

title: Raisin Bran Muffins
directions: In large bowl, combine sugar and oil,, Add soda to milk; salt to flour and mix all to sugar/oil mixture., Mix well., Add beaten eggs and raisin, bran., Bake as many muffins as needed., Batter keeps 6 weeks refrigerated.

title: Sour Cream Pie
directions: Mix all together., Pour into 3 pie shells. Bake at 400° for 50 minutes.

title: Bran Muffins
directions: Mix soda in small amount buttermilk., Mix together bran, flour, sugar and salt; add slightly beaten eggs., Add oil, rest of buttermilk and soda solution., Mix thoroughly., Let stand until thickened., Will keep in refrigerator up to 2 months., When ready to bake, pour into muffin tins lined with paper., Bake at 400° for 18 to 20 minutes., Makes about 5 dozen.

title: Manhattan Clam Chowder
directions: Cook bacon (leave whole). Saute onions in drippings. Add rest of ingredients and cook until vegetables are tender., Add clams. Heat thoroughly. Remove bacon and serve.

title: Debbie'S Famous Barbecue Sauce
directions: Combine all ingredients and adjust seasoning to taste, especially vinegar., Use as a basting sauce on all meats., Warm in microwave or saucepan before using as a table condiment.

title: Pound Cake
directions: Cream butter or margarine and sugar together., Beat in the eggs, one at a time., Add flour, one cup at a time., Add flavorings; mix well., Pour into a greased and floured tube pan and bake at 325° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Cajun Meat Loaf
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., Melt butter in a skillet over medium-low heat., Add next 7 ingredients and cook until veggies are tender, stirring frequently (about 10 minutes).

title: Chocolate Zucchini Cake With Chocolate Chip Topping
directions: Cream the sugar, butter and oil., Add eggs, one at a time. Add vanilla and buttermilk; mix well., Add measured dry ingredients, then grated zucchini., Blend well., Pour into a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan., Sprinkle chocolate chips over top; bake at 325° for 45 minutes.

title: Miniature Mounds Balls
directions: Mix first 4 ingredients together. Roll into balls. Let sit in the refrigerator overnight.

title: Boston Brown Bread
directions: Mix all ingredients in order., Bake at 350° for about 45 minutes., Makes 2 loaves.

title: One Cup Cookie
directions: Melt butterscotch chips and peanut butter over low heat., Stir until blended., Remove from heat and pour over 4 c. rice krispies. Stir until coated and press half in bottom of pan., Melt 6 oz chocolate chips, 2 Tbsp butter, 1 Tbsp water, 1 c. powdered sugar, in top of double boiler., Stir until chips are well blended., Pour this over the chilled cereal mixture., Spread rest of cereal over the top.

title: Cheese Dip
directions: Brown ground beef on medium-high., Drain extra grease off of ground beef., Melt Velveeta cheese into ground beef., Add margarine to make mixture loose., If you desire dip to be thinner, add a few drops of milk slowly!

title: Raisin Exquisite Pie
directions: Cover raisins with hot water; bring to a boil., Simmer for 5 minutes; drain well., Combine raisins with remaining ingredients, mixing well.

title: My Grandmother'S Slaw(No Fat - Low Calorie)
directions: Stir vinegar and sugar into finely grated (or chopped) cabbage., Then use your hands to squeeze the mixture over and over for about 2 minutes., The bruising of the cabbage allows it to absorb the vinegar mixture., Refrigerate overnight.

title: Bounty Rice
directions: Saute beef, onions and green peppers., Stir in tomatoes, seasonings, rice and cabbage., Cover and cook 10 to 15 minutes or until cabbage is tender., Stir in sour cream., Sprinkle with cheese., Cover 2 to 3 minutes to melt cheese.

title: Fruit Bars
directions: Cream the sugar and butter together; add the eggs and beat well., Sift the dry ingredients together and mix into the creamed mixture., Mix all together very well., Add the fruit and nuts and blend all together., Put bar mixture into a greased jelly roll pan., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes., When cooled, cut into bars.

title: Ray'S Chicken Spaghetti
directions: Cook chicken breasts or whole chicken, celery and onion in pressure cooker or broil., Cook thin noodles per package instructions., Saute butter, onion, celery, bell pepper, poultry seasoning and garlic powder or granules., Mix all ingredients together in baking pan and bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until cheese bubbles.

title: Chicken Divan
directions: Cook broccoli and drain., Place in a greased 9 x 13-inch baking pan., Top with chicken., Cover with soups, mayonnaise and onion salt., Sprinkle with cheese and top with potato chips., Bake 1 hour at 350°., Serve over rice.

title: Egg-Strata
directions: Butter bread on both sides. Alternate layers of bread, sausage and cheese. Two layers are usually enough to fill a 13 x 10 x 2 baking dish., End with cheese on top. Mix eggs, milk and seasoning; pour over layers., Cover and refrigerate overnight. Cook in 350° oven for 50 to 60 minutes or until brown.

title: Linda'S Walnuts
directions: Boil 6 cups water in large pan., Add walnuts; bring to boil. Boil 1 minute., Drain and rinse., Drain well., Toss with sugar until well coated., Fry in hot oil.

title: Mounds Cake
directions: Bring to a boil the sugar and milk; when boiling, add marshmallows., When melted, add coconut and spread over warm cake. Place in fridge to cool.

title: Chocolate Berry Pie
directions: Spread softened ice cream into bottom of crust., Freeze until firm., Spread fudge sauce evenly over ice cream., Cover with Cool Whip., Freeze 4 hours or until firm., Let stand approximately 30 minutes before serving., Garnish with strawberries and drizzle with fudge sauce., Makes 8 servings.

title: South Dakota Baked Dinner
directions: Brown hamburger, onion and celery., Add the chili powder, salt and pepper., Add the carrots and tomatoes., Mix and add the potatoes., Bake at 350° until potatoes are soft.

title: Three-Step Cake
directions: Mix and bake cake according to directions, using a 9 x 13 inch baking pan. While hot, poke entire top with fork and spread Eagle Brand milk over top. Cool completely. Frost with Cool Whip and sprinkle with crushed Heath bars., Refrigerate.

title: Lazy Lasagne
directions: Mix together cottage cheese, Parmesan cheese, salt, pepper, parsley flakes and eggs., Brown beef and sausage; drain., Add spaghetti sauce plus 2 1/2 cups water., Put 1/2 sauce on bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan., Spread evenly., Top with about half of noodles, overlapping slightly., Spread half of cottage cheese mixture over noodles., Sprinkle with about a third of Mozzarella cheese., Repeat layers as follows:, 1 1/2 cups sauce, remaining noodles, remaining cottage cheese, another third of Mozzarella, remaining sauce and remaining cheese., Seal tightly with foil and place on cookie sheet (makes a large batch and tends to run over)., Bake 1 hour at 350°. Let stand a few minutes before cutting.

title: Peach Cobbler
directions: Melt margarine in dish., Pour peaches in dish. Mix flour and milk together., Add sugar and vanilla., Pour over peaches and stir. Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes., Batter can be used with apples, pears and berries.

title: Onion-Roasted Potatoes(1993 Taster'S Luncheon)
directions: Preheat oven to 450°., In a large plastic bag or bowl, add all ingredients., Close bag and shake or toss in bowl until potatoes are evenly coated. Empty potatoes into shallow baking or roasting pan., Discard bag., Bake, stirring occasionally, 40 minutes or until potatoes are tender and golden brown. Garnish, if desired, with chopped fresh parsley., Makes 8 servings.

title: Blondies
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Pour into buttered 13 x 9-inch dish. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Peanut Brittle
directions: Cook until peanuts are done, then add soda., Stir and pour on greased pans.

title: Green Bean Casserole
directions: Mix green beans and soup into 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Heat in oven for 30 minutes at 350°., Sprinkle casserole with the can of French onions., Place under broiler for 5 minutes.

title: French Toast
directions: Beat egg whites with salt; add sugar gradually., Beat until stiff., Beat egg yolks until thick and lemon colored; add milk. Fold yolks in white mixture., Dip 8 slices of bread in mixture and bake for 8 to 10 minutes., Turn and bake 5 minutes more.

title: Barbecue Sauce
directions: In a 1-quart saucepan, combine Wesson oil and onions together and simmer until soft; add balance of recipe and bring to a boil.

title: Citrus Frost
directions: In blender, combine orange sherbet, tangerine juice concentrate, ice cubes and 1 cup cold water., Cover; blend until smooth., Pour into 6 tall glasses., Pour carbonated beverage down sides of glasses., Stir gently., Makes 6 servings.

title: Potato Casserole
directions: Place partially thawed potatoes in a greased casserole dish. Mix next 7 ingredients and pour on top of potatoes., Sprinkle corn flakes and remaining butter on top., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Pumpkin Pancakes
directions: Mix altogether and fry.

title: Tuna Casserole
directions: Mix; pour into greased casserole dish., Top with crushed corn flakes or potato chips., Bake at 350° for about 45 minutes.

title: Frosted Pineapple Cookies
directions: Drain pineapple, reserving 3 tablespoons juice., Set pineapple aside; set juice aside for frosting.

title: Buttermilk Pancakes
directions: Beat eggs and buttermilk together., Stir in dry ingredients just to incorporate (do not overmix, should not be smooth)., Stir in melted butter; cook on 400° grill., May be used for waffles also.

title: Mustard Base Barbecue Sauce
directions: Bring all ingredients to a boil., Simmer for 25 minutes and stir., Store in airtight container.

title: Creamed Potatoes
directions: Peel, slice and boil potatoes until done., Beat with margarine, softened cream cheese, sour cream, salt, pepper and garlic salt., Top with Cheddar cheese and bake at 350° until melted (15 to 20 minutes).

title: Lasagna
directions: Saute onion, garlic and beef until brown., Add tomatoes, tomato sauce, water, salt, basil, sugar, pepper and bay leaf and simmer uncovered about 1 1/2 hours., Remove bay leaf., Spread 1/2 cup meat sauce in 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan, starting with noodles. Make 3 layers, each of noodles, cottage cheese, Mozzarella cheese, meat sauce and Parmesan., Bake at 325° for 45 minutes.

title: Apricot-Coconut Balls
directions: Blend apricots, coconut (1 cup) and pecans together in a large bowl., Stir in condensed milk., Shape into small balls and roll in remaining coconut., Let stand in air until firm., Store in airtight container.

title: Black-Eyed Pea Casserole
directions: Brown beef; drain., Mix in other ingredients in the order listed., Stir., Pour into 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

title: Black Bean Salad
directions: Combine first 6 ingredients; set aside. Combine black beans, tomatoes and avocado. Stir dressing with bean mixture and serve. Serves 6.

title: Broccoli Cornbread
directions: Blend all ingredients together., Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan at 400° for 25 minutes or until done.

title: Easy Beef Stroganoff
directions: Cook beef until tender., Cut beef in very small pieces., Add diced onion to beef and fry until onion is cooked., Add soup and 1/2 can of water to meat and onions., Add cream and heat., Add flour to water to make paste., Add flour paste to meat and stir until thickened., Serve hot over rice or noodles.

title: Pasta With Fresh Asparagus
directions: Boil a pot of water for pasta and begin cooking., Spinach and egg fettuccine is especially good with this dish., Clean asparagus and slice across stalks in 1/2-inch pieces., In wok (or large frypan), heat oil and garlic; then add cut-up asparagus., Stir-fry about 3 minutes.

title: Apple Cake(From 1975 Edition)
directions: Put apples in bowl., Add sugar and mix., Let stand 10 minutes. Add egg and oil., Sift and measure flour., Mix all ingredients and add to apple mixture., Add raisins and nuts., Bake in 9-inch square pan at 350° for 50 to 55 minutes.

title: Tea Biscuits
directions: Dissolve yeast in water., Put Crisco, milk, sugar and salt on stove., Get lukewarm., Add flour., Mix and knead., Let set 15 minutes., Knead and roll., Let stand 15 minutes, then bake at 425° for 15 minutes.

title: Banana Shake(Low Carb)
directions: Mix all ingredients in a blender until creamy. Makes 1 serving.

title: Coated Peanuts
directions: Beat egg whites until stiff. Add brown sugar. Beat until stiff. Cover all pecan halves. Drop by halves on greased cookie sheet., Bake at 250° for about 25 minutes. Do not overcook.

title: Easy Coconut Icing
directions: Mix and refrigerate overnight.

title: Easy Oven Fried Chicken
directions: Heat oven to 400 degrees., Melt fat in a shallow roasting pan in the oven., Meanwhile, wash the chicken and dry with paper towels., Place the flour and seasonings in a plastic bag., Drop in 2 or 3 pieces of chicken at a time,, hold the bag closed and shake, coating the pieces., Place the floured chicken in the baking pan in a single layer, skin side down., Bake for 30 minutes,, turn the chicken skin side up and continue to bake for 30 minutes or until tender.

title: Grandma Eichler'S No Bake Cookies(No Bakes)
directions: Bring first 4 ingredients to a boil, then boil for 1 minute, stirring constantly., Remove from heat., Stir in remaining ingredients., Drop tablespoonfuls onto wax paper., Let cool.

title: Taco Stack
directions: Let cream cheese soften, mix taco seasoning mix and cream cheese., Spread onto a medium-size platter., Top cream cheese mixture with taco sauce, followed by lettuce, tomato and shredded cheese., Keep refrigerated until ready to serve.

title: Sweet Pickle Chips
directions: Drain and rinse pickles. Slice pickles 1/4 to 1/2-inch thick. Stir into sugar mixture. (Do not use metal container or spoon.) Let stand 24 hours at room temperature; stir occasionally. Put into jars and pour juice evenly into each jar. Store in refrigerator one to two weeks.

title: Luscious Layer Bars
directions: Blend cake mix, oleo, sour cream and eggs., Stir in nuts. Spread in greased and floured large jelly roll pan (15 x 10-inch). Bake 18 to 20 minutes at 350°., Combine coconut and milk; gently spread over base., Return to oven., Bake 15 to 20 minutes or until lightly brown., Cool slightly and frost.

title: Blueberry Pancakes
directions: Mix dry ingredients together well., Heat butter in skillet. Beat eggs and pour buttermilk into beaten eggs., Mix good with sugar., Add milk; mix together well with the blueberries.

title: Vanilla Wafer Crumb Cake
directions: Cream oleo., Add sugar gradually., (The long beating makes the cake.), Beat in eggs, one at a time, and the sweet milk., Fold in the crumbs, nuts and coconut., Put in a well-greased and floured pan., Bake 1 hour and 15 minutes at 325°.

title: Lemon Herb Chicken Breasts(Great On The Grill)
directions: Wash chicken breasts, pat dry, sprinkle generously with garlic powder and oregano., In large bowl, preferably with airtight lid, squeeze juice of lemon and stir in 2 tablespoons of olive oil. Add chicken, place lid on bowl and shake., If possible let chicken marinate awhile., Cook on the grill until done or cook at 350° in oven (or toaster oven)., Good served as an entree or as a sandwich.

title: Zucchini Bread
directions: Beat eggs; add sugar, vanilla and oil., Blend well., Stir in zucchini., Add flour, salt, soda and baking powder; mix well and fold in nuts., Pour into greased and floured loaf pan and bake 1 hour at 350°.

title: Simple Homemade Ice Cream
directions: Mix all ingredients and finish filling 1 gallon freezer with milk until 3/4 full.

title: Pizza Sauce
directions: Cook sauce 60 minutes or longer., Use Mozzarella cheese and Parmesan cheese, about 1/2 pound of each for topping.

title: Broiled Garlic Shrimp
directions: Preheat broiler., Wash and dry shrimp., Pour margarine in a shallow baking pan and add lemon juice, onion, garlic and pepper. Add shrimp and toss to coat., Broil for 5 minutes, turn and broil 5 more minutes., Serve on platter with strained pan juices. Sprinkle with parsley., Serves 5; about 2 1/2 ounces shrimp per serving.

title: Best Pecan Pie
directions: Brown butter in saucepan over medium heat until golden brown, stirring constantly to prevent burning., Cool., Beat corn syrup, sugar and eggs in bowl., Add lemon juice, vanilla and salt; mix well., Stir in pecans and browned butter.

title: Banana Pie
directions: Mix vanilla pudding as directed on box less milk (instant). Cut bananas in quarters and place on bottom of chocolate crust pie., Put in refrigerator for 3 hours, until pudding hardens and put chocolate Cool Whip on top.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Boil the chicken with the onion, salt and pepper until chicken is tender. Cool. Take chicken off bones., Cook the vermicelli spaghetti in the chicken broth until tender. Add the cheese, peas, soup and Ro-Tel tomatoes., Mix together and bake until bubbly.

title: Stuffed Potatoes
directions: Bake the potatoes until soft., Mix all other ingredients except paprika., Cut the potatoes in half lengthwise., Scrape most of the potato, from the skins and add to the mixture. Beat., Spoon the mixture into the shells and sprinkle with paprika., Bake in a 350° oven for 20 minutes.

title: Frozen Salad
directions: Freeze., This may be stored for days, well covered.

title: Chocolate Chip Butterscotch Bars
directions: Preheat oven to 300°., Grease an 8 x 8-inch baking pan. Combine flour and soda in a warm bowl., Mix well with a wire whisk; set aside., In large bowl use an electric mixer to blend the sugar and butter. Add egg and vanilla; beat at medium speed until light and smooth. Scrape down the sides of the bowl, then add the flour mixture, pecans and chocolate chips., Blend at low speed until just combined., Do not overmix., Transfer batter into prepared pan and level top with a rubber spatula., Bake in center of oven for 35 to 45 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean, but center is still soft., Cool on rack to room temperature., Cut with sharp knife into 1 x 2-inch bars., Makes about 16 bars.

title: Oatmeal Cake
directions: Mix oats and margarine with 1 1/4 cups of boiling water and let stand 20 minutes., In separate bowl, mix the other ingredients, then mix with the oatmeal, margarine and water mixture., Mix well and pour into a buttered 13 x 9-inch cake pan. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Banana Nut Bread
directions: Cream shortening until fluffy., Gradually beat in sugar., Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each., Beat in sifted dry ingredients., Stir in crushed bananas and nuts., Bake in a greased loaf pan at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes., Slice and serve.

title: Syrup For Sweet Dills
directions: Heat and pour hot over 2 quarts dills, sliced., Put in refrigerator., Syrup can be reused once., A good way to use old dills.

title: Heavenly Easter Delight
directions: Mix together and serve frozen.

title: Two Fruit Smoothie
directions: Combine all ingredients in electric blender., Add enough ice cubes to bring to 4-cup level., Blend until smooth., Serve immediately., Each serving contains 100 calories/cup., Nutritious during pregnancy (consult your physician).

title: Chicken Divan
directions: Boil chicken until done., Layer in a 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan, the broccoli, sprinkle with Parmesan cheese., Add chicken and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese., Mix all other ingredients together and spread over., Bake at 350° for 45 to 60 minutes until brown.

title: Blueberry Cream Pie
directions: Wash and drain berries., Combine berries, lemon juice, rind and water., Cover and bring to boil., Simmer 5 minutes., Mix sugar, cornstarch and salt., Add to blueberries., Cook and stir until thickened., Cook very slowly 10 minutes., Cool., Pour into cold baked pie shell., Whip cream cheese and cream until fluffy. Use to garnish pie.

title: Shrimp, Peas And Rice
directions: Add rice and black-eyed peas., Combine with shrimp mixture. Season with salt and pepper., Serve with green onions.

title: Oatmeal Harvest Cake
directions: Pour water over oatmeal and let stand 20 minutes., Cream shortening, brown sugar and white sugar., Add eggs, oatmeal mixture, flour, cinnamon, soda and salt., Grease 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan., Bake 30 to 35 minutes in 350° oven.

title: Zucchini Pie
directions: Drain squash and put in cold water immediately., Drain and add remaining ingredients., Put in crust and dot with butter; add top crust and bake in 400° oven for about 40 minutes.

title: Chicken Stuffing Bake
directions: In a quart saucepan, heat 3/4 cup of the milk and butter to scalding., In a large bowl, pour hot milk mix over stuffing., Toss to mix well., Put half of this mixture into buttered 12 x 8-inch baking dish.

title: Baked Haddock Fillets
directions: Spray shallow pan with nonstick coating., Place fillets in a pan., Combine ingredients and spoon over fillets., Bake at 450° for 8 to 10 minutes or until fish flakes easily., Serves 4.

title: Shortcake
directions: Sift dry ingredients and cut in shortening., Add beaten egg and milk and mix well., Put in muffin tins and bake at 400° until browned., Makes 12 and that depends on the size of the muffin tin. Good with any fresh fruit, especially strawberries.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Mix flour with baking soda and set aside., In a large mixing bowl, combine butter, sugars and pudding mix; beat until smooth and creamy., Beat in eggs., Gradually add flour mixture to creamy mixture., Stir in oats., Batter will be stiff., Drop by rounded teaspoonful about 2 inches apart onto ungreased baking sheets. Bake at 375° for 8 to 10 minutes., Yields about 5 dozen cookies.

title: Chocolate Angel Food Cake
directions: Combine flour packet from cake mix and cocoa; stir well with wire, whisk., Prepare, cake, according to package directions. Fold, chocolate flavoring into batter., Bake according to, package directions., Sprinkle, cooled, cake with powdered sugar., Garnish with, strawberries,, if, desired.	Yield:	16 servings (107 calories and 2% fat per serving).

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
directions: Thoroughly cream butter, peanut butter, sugars, egg and vanilla. Sift together dry ingredients. Blend into creamed mixture. Shape in 1-inch balls., Roll in granulated sugar., Place 2-inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet. Press with fork tines. Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes., Cool slightly and remove from pan., Makes 4 dozen.

title: Violet'S Salad Dressing Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Chicken Kiev
directions: Place breast halves between Saran Wrap. Beat until thin (about 1/4 inch). Sprinkle each breast with condiments., Place one of the butter sticks in each roll-up. Dust with flour. Dip in beaten egg. Roll in breadcrumbs. Place in Pyrex dish. Pour in wine. Bake, covered, at 350° for 45 minutes. Uncover to brown.

title: Peach Crisp
directions: In a bowl, combine flour, brown sugar and salt., Cut in butter until crumbly., Pat into a greased 9 inch square baking pan., Bake at 350 degrees for 15 minutes., Meanwhile, drain the peaches and reserve juice in a medium saucepan., Add the sugar and cornstarch; bring to a boil, stirring constantly., Boil for 2 minutes or until thickened., Remove from the heat;, stir in peaches., Pour into crust., For topping, combine oats, brown sugar and flour., Cut in the butter until crumbly., Sprinkle over filling., Bake at 350 degrees for 25 - 30 minutes or until golden and bubbly.

title: Potatoes Romanoff
directions: Place potatoes and water in 3-quart casserole., Cook, covered, on Full power for 10 to 14 minutes, or until potatoes are tender. Drain., Stir in cottage cheese, sour cream, green pepper, garlic, salt and pepper., Sprinkle with shredded cheese., Cook on half power for 7 to 10 minutes, or until heated through and cheese is melted., Serves 6 to 8.

title: Raspberry Cake
directions: Follow directions on cake mix for two 8-inch or 9-inch layers. Allow cakes to cool., Whip one container of cream, 1 tablespoon of sugar and 1 teaspoon of extract., Use a serrated knife to cut each cake into two layers., Line a 2 1/2-quart bowl with plastic wrap. Place one layer in bowl and spread 3 tablespoons of jam over layer and then 1/3 of whipped cream over jam., Repeat until all layers are used., Cover bowl with plastic wrap while pressing down layers. Chill in refrigerator for at least 4 hours., Whip second container of cream with remaining sugar and extract and a few drops of food coloring., Invert cake onto plate and cover with whipped cream.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., Mix Crisco and margarine., Add sugar and brown sugar; mix., Add eggs and vanilla; mix., Slowly add flour, salt and baking soda., Add chips, nuts and coconut., Drop by teaspoon on ungreased baking sheets., Bake about 8 minutes., May be baked as pan cookie.

title: Banana Shake
directions: Put ingredients in blender and blend on high until well blended., Yields four (1-cup) servings., Great quickie for teens to make.

title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
directions: Cream sugar and butter until light and fluffy., Add 1 egg at a time and beat well., Add sour cream., Combine flour, salt and soda and add mixture to creamed mixture., Add flavorings., Bake at 325° for 50 to 60 minutes or until done.

title: Graham Cracker Bars
directions: Line a 9 x 13-inch pan with whole graham crackers., Melt the oleo. Add the milk, egg and sugar., Bring to a boil and add the coconut, graham cracker crumbs and nuts., Spread over the crackers and cover with whole graham crackers., Frost with fudge frosting. Let set overnight and cut into bars.

title: Hot Roll Mix
directions: Mix together as for pie crust.

title: Quick Chicken Parmesan
directions: Whatever number of chicken patties needed, cook in microwave according to directions on package., Place chicken in casserole dish and spoon spaghetti sauce over chicken., Then add lots of Parmesan cheese and cooked spaghetti., Top with more sauce and Mozzarella cheese., Bake at 350° until cheese melts.

title: Three Layer Casserole
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Brown the ground beef, drain and set aside., Drain the liquid from the corn and set aside., Cover the bottom of a 2-quart casserole dish with a layer of sliced potatoes. Put a layer of the cooked ground beef over the potatoes., Put a layer of corn over the ground beef., Continue layering the potatoes, ground beef and corn until all used., In a bowl, mix the soup and pour over the top of the other ingredients., Cover and bake 1 to 1 1/4 hours, or until potatoes are done.

title: Pink Lady Punch
directions: Combine all ingredients; stir well., Serve over ice., Makes 1 gallon.

title: Pineapple Upside-Down Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Melt butter in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Sprinkle brown sugar evenly in bottom., Arrange pineapple halves on top of sugar., Drain cherries and slice in half., Put cherry slices on top of each pineapple slice., Mix cake according to directions., Pour over fruit fruit and spread evenly., Bake for 45 to 48 minutes., Loosen cake from pan and turn onto platter.

title: Sukiyaki
directions: Prepare beef dinner as package directs., Meanwhile, in large frypan, brown meat in hot oil., Add onion slices; cover and cook 10 to 15 minutes., Add mushrooms, green pepper, celery, bean sprouts, spinach and soy sauce., Cover and cook 5 to 8 minutes until vegetables are crisp-tender., Add cooked rice., Mix and serve.

title: Chocolate Pecan Pie
directions: Mix sugar, cocoa and flour. Add eggs, vanilla, milk and butter., Mix well., Add nuts., Pour into unbaked 9-inch pie shells., Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes., Makes 2 pies.

title: Stuffed Shells With Cheese
directions: Prepare shells according to package directions., Drain portion of water, allowing shells to remain in warm water., Mix cheeses, eggs, parsley and salt., Remove one shell at a time from warm water., Stuff each shell with mixture, using a tablespoon., Pour 1/2 jar sauce into shallow casserole., Arrange stuffed shells in casserole., Add remaining sauce to top., Cover; bake at 375° for 30 minutes or until warm through.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
directions: Mix, all, ingredients, in order given.	Top with cheese and potato chips and bake 25 minutes at 325°.

title: Chicken Surprise
directions: Boil and debone chicken and cut into pieces., Crush enough crackers to fill bottom of Pyrex dish., Layer crackers, chicken and sliced water chestnuts and cover with remaining ingredients that you have mixed together to create a sauce. Bake at 350° for 1/2 hour.

title: Baked Small Wild Game In Sour Cream
directions: Soak the meat overnight in salted water., Dry and roll in flour., Saute in margarine until browned., Remove the meat and spread with mustard on all sides., Saute onion, carrots and mushrooms., Add salt and pepper to taste; add the garlic powder and then stir in the sour cream over low heat., Pour the resulting sauce over the meat and bake at 350° about 1 hour or until the meat is tender.

title: Fruit Delight
directions: Prepare angel cake as directed., Cool and slice in 1/4-inch slices., Put layer in bottom of 9 x 12-inch pan.

title: Fruit Cobbler
directions: Use about 3 cups of fruit.

title: French Silk Chocolate Pie
directions: Cream butter and sugar until well blended., Beat in chocolate. Add 1 egg; beat on high 5 minutes., Add second egg; beat on high at least 5 minutes or until all sugar is melted., Pour in pie shell and chill., Cool Whip (optional).

title: No Fail, No Fuss Basic Gravy
directions: One tablespoon cornstarch equals 2 tablespoons flour.

title: Cheezy Fries
directions: Cook fries according to package., Place fries in a big bowl. Sprinkle shredded cheese all over bowl of fries., Sprinkle bacon bits over top., Place in the oven until cheese melts., Serve.

title: Cream Puffs
directions: Put the butter and water in a saucepan over heat., When water boils, add flour all at once., Stir until mixture leaves sides of pan., Remove from heat and cool., Add one unbeaten egg at a time and beat hard., Continue until eggs are all added.

title: Sausage Bread
directions: Let sausage mixture cool a little., Add eggs, beaten well with cheese., Stir to mix., Grease cookie sheet and spread dough with hands (to cover pan)., Fill with mixture., Fold up., Put seam on bottom., Let rise and bake.

title: Florida-Style Flank Steak
directions: Combine all ingredients in a ceramic or glass dish., Marinate for at least 6 hours (for best flavor) turning steak now and then. Cook on grill until done (about 7 minutes per side)., Allow to stand a few minutes before slicing., Slice very thin diagonally.

title: Strawberry Dessert
directions: I Layer:, Break angel food cake in small pieces.

title: Mama'S Pecan Pie Cake Bars
directions: Mix margarine, cake mix and 1 egg together., Reserve 2/3 cup of this mixture for topping and pat remainder in 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 15 minutes., Mix brown sugar, Karo syrup and eggs, vanilla, reserved 2/3 cup of cake mixture and chopped nuts. Pour over partially baked cake., Return to oven at 375°., Bake until cake tests done., Cool., Cut into small squares.

title: Coconut Cream Cookies
directions: Cream margarine., Add sugar; beat until fluffy., Add egg; beat with electric or wire beater, until well blended., Add sour cream, soda and salt., Add 1 cup flour., Beat well., Add the coconut, then remaining flour., Drop with teaspoon on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Pickled Okra
directions: Pour hot vinegar solution over okra, etc. in the jar., Seal; do not crowd okra in the jar., It takes at least three weeks to pickle and get crisp.

title: Cottage Cheese Muffins
directions: Sift the first 5 ingredients into bowl and mix in oats and cornflakes., Beat egg yolk; add fat, cheese and milk., Pour liquid mixture into a "well" in the dry ingredients and beat., Fold in the beaten egg whites., Bake in muffin tins in a slow oven at 300°, about 1 hour.

title: Mother'S Cookies
directions: Mix all together in bowl., Turn out on floured cloth or board and roll thin; cut with cookie cutter., Bake in moderately hot oven until brown.

title: Grilled Potatoes
directions: Drain potatoes., Pour into aluminum pan., Chop onions and peppers (green and red) and place in pan., Add salt to taste., Add 1/2 stick of margarine., Add 2 teaspoons of bacon bits., Cover with foil and place on hot grill., Cook for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Ham And Cheese Strata
directions: Place 6 slices bread on bottom of 12 x 8-inch baking dish. Cover with 1 cup Cheddar cheese, broccoli, ham and remaining bread slices, cut in half diagonally., Beat cream cheese until light and fluffy., Add eggs one at a time, mixing well after each addition. Blend in milk and mustard; pour over bread., Top with remaining Cheddar cheese., Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes or until set. Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

title: Banana Pudding
directions: Add sugar and flour; mix well., Beat eggs., Add to sugar mixture; mix until smooth., Add vanilla and milk., Cook on medium flame, stirring constantly until quite thick., Remove from burner. Layer the following in a large bowl: one layer of wafers, one layer of sliced bananas and one layer of pudding mixture., Repeat until all pudding is used., Top with layer of vanilla wafers. Scrumptious!

title: Crockpot Chicken Breast
directions: Combine soup, sour cream, wine and mushrooms., Place chicken breast in crockpot., Sprinkle with salt, pepper and paprika., Cut onion into 1/4 inch slices and break apart into rings., Spread over chicken., Pour soup mixture over all and spread evenly. Sprinkle some more paprika over top., Cook on low setting 6-8 hours., Serve over rice., Yield: 4-6 servings.

title: Italian Marble Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Grease and flour pan., Prepare marble cake mix as directed and pour into pan., In a mixing bowl, mix Ricotta, sugar, 4 eggs and vanilla., Layer over marble cake batter., Bake at 350° for 45 to 60 minutes., Allow cake to cool. Serve.

title: Potato Pie With Brandy Hard Sauce
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., In a small bowl, beat at high speed the egg whites into soft peak., With mixer at low speed, beat egg yolks, potatoes, milk, sugar, cinnamon, ginger, nutmeg, cloves and salt until well blended., Fold in egg whites., Pour mixture in crust and bake until set.

title: Sylvia'S Stuffed Acorn Squash
directions: Cut acorn squash in half (1/2); scoop out seed with spoon. In greased pan, bake face down at 350° for 30 minutes., Cook bacon; remove and crumble., Retain grease., In retained grease, saute onions, bell peppers, hot peppers and tomatoes until tender. Add milk, cheese, butter, sugar and crumbled bacon., Take squash and scoop out the squash; save shell., Mix squash with ingredients., Spoon mixture into shells., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

title: Apricot Chicken
directions: Mix preserves, soup and dressing., Pour over chicken. Marinate for several hours or overnight., Put chicken in casserole., Cover with marinade., Cover with foil and bake at 300° until done., Uncover and brown.

title: Italio Spaghetti
directions: In skillet, brown beef and onions; drain grease off., Return to skillet. Reduce temperature., Add thyme, oregano, salt, pepper and dry mustard., Mix in browned beef., Pour tomato juice over mixture., Add broken spaghetti., Press spaghetti into mixture until it is covered with juice., Cover skillet and simmer for 30 minutes.

title: Sesame Twist Quick Bread(Three Star)
directions: Mix all ingredients thoroughly., Form dough into smooth ball and knead 30 seconds of floured board., Roll into rope 2 inches thick and cut into 16 pieces., Roll each piece 8 inches long, lapping ends., Fold in half, twist once and pinch ends together. Place on buttered baking sheet; brush with slightly beaten whole egg., Sprinkle with lots of sesame seed., Bake in upper third of preheated 450° oven for 15 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Don'S Rotisserie Chicken
directions: Put green pepper, salt, pepper, margarine and onion inside chicken., Lay bacon over breast area and tie chicken well., Put on spit and rub a little margarine over chicken., Put on rotisserie and cook on medium or low until well done.

title: Quick And Easy Quiche
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Put pie crust into pie pan as directed on package., Combine all other ingredients (except vegetables, etc.), in mixing bowl and mix lightly., Add vegetables, bacon, meats, etc., if desired., Pour into crust., Mixture will look lumpy due to Cheddar cheese., Put in oven and bake 55 to 60 minutes., Quiche should have a slight brown coating when cooked completely.

title: Vegetable Stew
directions: Saute in oil the onions, garlic and pepper., Flour the eggplant and brown on all sides in the oil., Add the vegetables. Cover and steam 6 to 8 minutes until just barely tender., Add grated cheese., Serve over cooked egg noodles., Yield: 4 to 6 servings.

title: A B C Sweet Treats
directions: You will need waxed paper.

title: Orange Pork Chops
directions: Place chops in a roasting pan; mix other ingredients and pour over chops., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Tuna Patties
directions: Combine all ingredients and place by heaping spoonfuls into greased skillet., Flatten into patties., Makes 8 patties.

title: Koinonia Granola
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Melt in a large roasting pan the oil, margarine, molasses, vanilla, brown sugar, honey and salt., When mixed, let cool slightly and add the oats, sesame seed, chopped nuts, garage nuts, wheat germ, coconut and sunflower seeds., Stir thoroughly. Bake in shallow pans for 20 to 25 minutes., Stir every 5 to 7 minutes., After granola has cooled, add the raisins., Very good as a snack.

title: Waist Watchin' Popcorn Snack
directions: In a large bowl, combine hot popped corn, nuts, pretzels and bran squares., In a small saucepan, melt margarine with mustard. Pour over popcorn mixture, tossing gently to coat., Sprinkle herb and spice mix over coated corn and toss again. Spread coated corn on baking sheet and bake at 350° for 3 to 5 minutes. Serve immediately or store in airtight container., Makes 2 1/2 quarts.

title: Texas Caviar
directions: Drain all canned ingredients., Put in bowl., Add bell pepper, onion, and Italian dressing., Cover and let sit overnight., Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Dried Beef Cheese Ball
directions: Mix well the first 6 ingredients., Roll in chopped pecans. Refrigerate and serve with crackers.

title: Cool Cucumber Rice Salad
directions: Combine rice, cucumber, green pepper and radishes., Blend remaining ingredients (dressing, mustard and pepper)., Toss dressing mixture lightly with rice mixture and chill., Makes 6 servings.

title: Coconut Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Combine margarine and sugars., Add eggs; mix well. Add flour, soda and salt., Stir in oatmeal, pecans and coconut., Chill dough., Make into rolls, 1 1/2 inches., Refrigerate overnight or freeze rolls., Slice thin and bake at 375° for 7 minutes., Leave plenty of space between cookies on cookie sheet; they spread a lot.

title: Betty'S Banana Nut Cake
directions: Cream, together eggs, margarine and sugar., Add bananas.
