Into another, bowl,, sift, together, flour, salt and soda., Add flour mixture,, a, little, at, a time, to sugar-butter mixture, mixing well after each addition., Add nuts., Pour batter into a well greased, and floured angel cake pan and bake for 1 hour at 300°. Can be frozen.

title: Rolls
directions: Sift dry ingredients together., Cut in fat., Mix with warm water., Let rise 1 hour or until it doubles its size., Add 1 or 2 tablespoons flour and knock down., Put in refrigerator with cover and use as needed.

title: Velvet Angel Pie
directions: Melt chocolate with the coffee in saucepan over low heat until blended; cool., Stir in vanilla, then fold into whipped cream. Fill meringue shell., Refrigerate overnight or approximately 12 hours., Garnish with additional whipped cream, shaved chocolate and pecan halves.

title: Mexican Cornbread
directions: Mix all, ingredients; place in iron skillet and bake in oven at 400° until done.

title: Sun-Dried Tomato Dip
directions: Combine tomatoes, water, garlic and herbs in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch glass or ceramic dish and cover tightly with microwave plastic wrap., Cook at 100% in a high-wattage microwave oven for 8 minutes. Prick plastic to release steam., Remove from oven and uncover; stir well., Re-cover and cook for 8 minutes longer., Prick plastic to release steam., Remove from oven and uncover; stir well and allow to stand, stirring occasionally, until cool and most of liquid is absorbed., Transfer to 1 1/2-quart dish; pour both oils over tomato mixture., Cover tightly with plastic wrap; cook for 5 minutes more. Prick plastic; remove from oven and uncover., Stir and leave until cool., Transfer to food processor and puree until smooth, scraping down sides of bowl., Serve at room temperature with thinly sliced Italian bread, crackers or cut up vegetables., Will keep in refrigerator (tightly covered) for up to one month., Makes approximately 3 cups.

title: Sour Cream Softies
directions: Measure flour, salt, baking powder and soda into a sifter. Cream the butter or margarine with sugar until well blended in a large bowl., Beat in eggs and vanilla., Sift in flour mixture, adding alternately with sour cream and blend well to make a thick batter., Drop by rounded tablespoonfuls 4 inches apart on greased cookie sheets., Spread into 2-inch rounds., Sprinkle with cinnamon-sugar, if desired., Bake in hot oven (400°) for about 12 minutes or until light golden around edges., Remove from cookie sheets and cool completely on wire racks.

title: Lemon Meringue Pie
directions: Mix all together., Pour into graham cracker crust and top with meringue; brown.

title: Mexican Corn Bread
directions: This makes a thin batter., Bake at 400° or 450° for 30 minutes.

title: Cheddar Baked Potato Slices
directions: In a small bowl, combine soup, paprika and pepper., In a greased 2-quart oblong baking dish, arrange potatoes., Sprinkle with cheese., Spoon mixture over cheese., Cover with foil and bake at 400° for 45 minutes, covered., Uncover and bake 10 more minutes or until tender.

title: Chocolate Gem Pie
directions: For crust, combine flour, pecans and brown sugar., In a heavy saucepan, melt shortening and 1 square of chocolate over low heat, stirring constantly., Stir into flour mixture until combined., Mix vanilla and water and sprinkle over mixture while tossing., Form into a ball., Roll out to make a 12-inch circle between 2 sheets of wax paper., Remove waxed paper., Place crust into a 9-inch pie plate; flute edge., Prick well., Bake until surface appears dry. Cool.

title: Coconut Custard
directions: Add all ingredients together., Blend well., Bake in oblong Pyrex dish lightly sprayed with Pam., Cook in preheated oven at 375° for 40 to 50 minutes., Serve warm or cold.

title: Microwave Parmesan Potatoes
directions: Melt margarine in baking dish., Add potatoes, onion and garlic., Cover loosely with Saran Wrap and cook on Full power for 5 minutes in microwave., Add green pepper, salt and pepper and toss., Add cheese and sprinkle with paprika., Cook for 6 minutes or until potatoes are tender.

title: Chicken Pasta Salad
directions: You will need 1 large bowl.

title: Cream Cheese Pie Crust
directions: Cream, butter, and, cream cheese, slowly add flour, then add vanilla., Good, for any type pie, may also be used for tart shells.

title: Blueberry Pie
directions: Cook the, bottom, crust., Cook butter, water, sugar and cornstarch until it, boils., Pour, 1/2 over bottom crust; pour fresh berries on next, leveling down; next add pie filling and then, top, crust., Pour, the rest of syrup on top and brown in oven.

title: Pumpkin Bread
directions: Mix oil and sugar; add eggs one at a time and continue mixing. Add pumpkin and mix well., Sift together dry ingredients and add to wet mixture., Add water and mix by hand well until smooth. Pour into greased loaf pans and bake for 50 to 60 minutes in a 350° oven., Watch at the end of baking and cover top with foil if getting too brown., Makes 2 large loaves.

title: "No Peek" Casserole
directions: Combine ingredients in a 2-quart casserole., Cover and bake at 300° for 3 hours., Do not peek until it is done., Serve over noodles or rice., Serves 4 to 6.

title: Swedish Meatballs
directions: Keep warm until ready to serve.

title: Mexican Cheese Soup
directions: Peel and cube potatoes., Boil potatoes and garlic in salt water until tender., Drain., Turn heat to simmer; add butter, milk, tomatoes, chilies, Tabasco and green onions., Do not allow milk to boil., When warm, drop in cheese., As cheese just starts to melt, the soup is ready to serve., Feeds one Mexican Army.

title: Diet Butternut Squash
directions: Pour into a casserole dish., Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Chili Cheese Log
directions: Mix together, shape into log., Roll in chopped nuts., Chill until firm., Serve with crackers and vegetables.

title: Mexican Pasta Salad
directions: Cook pasta., Rinse with cold water and drain., Drain and chop tomatoes. Save liquid., Melt cheese with 2 Tbsp. tomato liquid in microwave or on stove top., Add 1/3 cup liquid to cheese. Mix everything together in large bowl. Serve cold or at room temperature., Stir when ready to serve., Makes a lot.

title: Shoney'S Strawberry Pie
directions: Boil sugar, water and Jell-O for 1 minute., Cool., Have baked pie shell., Place strawberries in shell., Pour the mixture over the strawberries., Refrigerate to set., Before serving, cover with whipped cream.

title: Oatmeal Pie
directions: Mix and bake in unbaked pie shell until firm.

title: Lumpiaphillipines
directions: Brown the beef and drain. Mix together all remaining ingredients except lumpia wrappers. Cook for 20-30 minutes, drain away excess liquid. Sit for 10 minutes before wrapping. Put some of the mixture onto a wrapper, fold over each side, then roll up. Making a little package. Fry in the oil until golden brown.

title: Cashew Chicken
directions: Blanch all ingredients until al dente.

title: French Dressing
directions: Beat together or mix in blender; refrigerate.

title: Cinnamon Munch
directions: Combine sugar and cinnamon, set aside., Melt butter over low heat in skillet., Add Chex and stir to coat., Heat for 5 minutes more, sprinkle with half of sugar/cinnamon mixture and stir to coat cereal pieces., Add remaining sugar/cinnamon and stir. Spread on paper towels to cool.

title: Chicken And Vegetable Salad(Servings:  6)
directions: Cook chicken breast., Add Japanese cucumbers and bean sprouts. Mix these ingredients.

title: Chicken Salad
directions: Chop chicken in food processor., If you are going to use your chicken salad for sandwiches, chop medium fine., To serve on lettuce, chop and leave it in medium-small chunks., Mix all ingredients together and enjoy.

title: Cherry Crunch
directions: Spread pie filling in bottom of 9-inch square pan., Sprinkle with lemon juice., Combine cake mix, nuts and melted butter. Crumble mixture over pie filling., Bake at 350° for 40 to 50 minutes.

title: Southern Cannon Balls
directions: Combine all ingredients, mixing well. Roll into walnut-size balls. Place on ungreased baking sheet and bake at 400° for 15 minutes. Drain on absorbent paper. Serve hot!

title: Hot Chicken Salad
directions: Mix all the ingredients and place in prepared 9 x 3 cake pan. Top with 1 cup crushed potato chips. Bake at 350° for about 20 minutes.

title: Sharon'S Gourmet Potato Casserole
directions: Cook potatoes (cook whole in skin)., Cool thoroughly., Shred potatoes coarsely., Combine mild and sharp cheeses, 1/4 cup butter and 1/2 cup sweet milk; cook over low heat until cheeses melt., Add sour cream, onion, salt and pepper., Put shredded potatoes in 9 x 13-inch glass pan, pour mixture over potatoes and dot with remaining butter., Bake at 350° for 25 minutes, until golden brown., Serves 4 to 6.

title: Khyar Bil-Laban (Lebanese)(Cucumber-Yogurt Salad)
directions: Mash garlic with salt and fresh mint in bowl., Add yogurt, blending well., Peel and cut cucumbers in half lengthwise, then slice in thin half rounds., Add cucumbers to yogurt mixture., Fold together gently., This is especially refreshing in summer., Serves 4., Garnish with fresh mint.

title: Honey Mustard Baked Beans
directions: In small saucepan, combine first 6 ingredients and cook over medium heat for 5 minutes., Add beans and simmer for 2 minutes. Serves 2 to 4.

title: Italian Zucchini Crescent Pie
directions: Cook and stir sliced zucchini and chopped onion in margarine for 10 minutes., Stir in parsley, salt, pepper, garlic powder, basil and oregano leaves., Combine eggs and cheese; stir into zucchini mixture.

title: Blueberry Cream Cheese Muffins
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Fill muffin tin with cupcake liners. In processor, whip cream cheese, lemon juice and vanilla until smooth., Beat in eggs., Add milk and butter and blend., Combine next 5 ingredients and beat into cream cheese mixture until well blended., Fold in blueberries., Pour into muffin tins., Fill 3/4 full., Sprinkle tops with sugar and cinnamon mixture., Bake 30 minutes.

title: Fruit Salad
directions: Mix all together and serve.

title: Dressing
directions: Combine cornbread and biscuits in large baking dish and pour 4 cups chicken broth over cornbread and biscuits. Let soak. Chop onions and celery. Cook onion and celery in margarine over low heat until tender. Mix together remaining ingredients. Add celery, onion, eggs, salt, pepper, sage and broth to first mix. Stir as little as possible. (Overstirring will cause dressing to be soggy.) Bake, uncovered, at 325° for 1 hour.

title: Lemon Pie
directions: Beat egg yolks, add other ingredients and cook over hot water until the mixture is of a jelly-like consistency., Pour into pastry shell; cover with meringue and bake in a slow oven about 15 minutes.

title: Blueberry Dessert
directions: Mix cracker crumbs and butter., Put in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Push down firmly., Melt marshmallows in milk in double boiler. Cool., Fold in Cool Whip., Spread on crumb mixture., Spread pie mix., Chill 4 or more hours.

title: Fried Cabbage
directions: Cut the cabbage very fine., Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Stir well and let stand for 5 minutes. Drop lard onto a hot iron kettle; then the cabbage, stirring briskly until cabbage is quite tender., Add cream and remove kettle from the fire., Then stir in cider vinegar.

title: Chicken And Broccoli With Mushroom Sauce
directions: Mix margarine and flour together in saucepan., Cook briefly over medium heat., Blend in chicken broth, stirring constantly until thickened and smooth., Stir in mushrooms and their liquid. Season to taste., Place broccoli pieces in a shallow baking pan. Cover with sliced chicken and pour mushroom sauce over all., Top with parsley and bread crumbs., Bake at 375°, uncovered, for 15 to 25 minutes or until bubbly and brown on top.

title: Facelift Casserole(Breakfast Casserole)
directions: Brown and drain sausage and set aside., Beat eggs and milk, salt and mustard., Gently stir in bread, cheese and sausage., Put in 8 x 12-inch buttered pan and refrigerate overnight., Cook at 350° for 45 minutes., Let stand 5 to 10 minutes before serving. Yields 6 servings.

title: Pecan Tart
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Beat first 2 ingredients until fluffy. Stir in combined flour and 3/4 cup oats., Press onto bottom and sides of 9-inch tart pan or pie plate., Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown., Cool completely., Beat eggs, corn syrup, brown sugar, 1/4 cup margarine and bourbon until blended., Stir in 1 cup pecans and remaining 2/3 cup oats., Pour into crust., Decorate top with pecan halves., Bake an additional 25 to 30 minutes or until filling is set., Makes 8 servings.

title: Chocolate Covered Grapes
directions: Wash grapes and drain thoroughly on paper towels., Do this several hours before ready to dip., If one drop of water gets into melted mixture, it will cause the chocolate to harden up and become unusable., Line a cookie sheet with waxed paper; set aside., In a small saucepan combine chocolate pieces and shortening., Heat and stir over low heat until chocolate is melted., Holding grape bunch by stem, dip grapes partially into melted chocolate., If necessary spoon over grapes to coat., Let excess drip off; place on prepared cookie sheet., Chill until chocolate is firm, about 30 minutes or up to 6 hours., Makes 1 bunch (about twenty, 3-5 grape servings).

title: Grandmother'S Old-Time Egg Custard
directions: Mix ingredients well., Place in unbaked pie shell., Cook at 300° until golden brown., Dust top of custard with cinnamon.

title: Quick Peach Cobbler
directions: Pour peaches into a 2-quart casserole dish., Sprinkle the cake mix over the top of the peaches (do not stir; this is the crust!), covering well., You may not need the entire box., Sprinkle the cinnamon sugar over the top and then follow with the melted butter., Cook at 325° for about 45 minutes or until the top browns.

title: Mother'S Swedish Meatballs
directions: Mix all well., Brown slightly in fat., Add 1/2 cup or more water., Cover tightly and simmer about 1 hour, until tender., Or, bake in oven for 1 hour at 300°., Makes 15 meatballs.

title: Spanish Pork Chops
directions: In large skillet, brown chops in hot oil., Remove chops., Add celery and onion and cook lightly, about 3 minutes., Drain fat. Stir in remaining ingredients; add chops., Bring to a boil., Lower heat., Cover and simmer 30 minutes.

title: Short Ribs Of Beef
directions: Saute onion in butter and add the mushroom soup, mushrooms and 1 can of water., Add chicken or turkey, salt, pepper and curry powder., Mix well and heat., Serve this on Minute rice., Serves 4 to 5.

title: Ham-Aghetti Casserole
directions: Place 1-inch pieces of bacon into a 2-quart casserole. Microwave on High 4 to 5 minutes. Remove half the fat., Add ham, tomatoes, spaghetti, onions, green pepper, salt and pepper. Stir well., Cover., Microwave on High 18 to 20 minutes until spaghetti is tender, stirring after 8 minutes., Sprinkle with cheese. Microwave on High 1 to 2 minutes, uncovered, until cheese is melted., Makes 6 servings.

title: Meat Loaf
directions: Combine ingredients., Mix well., Form in a meat loaf., Bake at 375° for about 1 hour., Pour favorite tomato sauce or gravy over and serve., Enjoy.

title: Swedish Nut Cake
directions: Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

title: Italian Sausage
directions: Cut sausage into pieces., Slice onion and pepper., Fry in covered pan until browned., Place noodles in 6 quarts boiling water., Return to second boil, stirring occasionally, until tender., Add sausage mixture and spaghetti sauce and pour over drained noodles., Makes approximately 8 (1/2 cup) servings.

title: Guacamole Dip
directions: Combine all ingredients., Cover and chill., Makes about 1 3/4 cups.

title: Baked Meat Balls
directions: Combine beef with onion, green pepper, egg, seasonings and rice cereal. Form into 10 balls. Roll balls in flour and brown in hot shortening., Place balls in a large casserole and pour tomato soup which has been diluted with 1 can of hot water., Bake, covered, at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Quick Key Lime Pie
directions: Break eggs lightly, then add condensed milk to the yolk and beat again., Add lime juice and beat until smooth., Pour mixture into a 9-inch baked pastry shell., Top with meringue and bake in a slow oven until meringue is brown.

title: Quick Caramel Frosting
directions: Melt butter in saucepan., Add brown sugar; boil over low heat for 2 minutes, stirring constantly., Add milk, stirring until milk comes to a boil., Cool., Add sugar, beating after each addition, until spreadable.

title: Pineapple Nut Squares
directions: Melt butter and cream with sugar., Add eggs, one at a time; mix well., Sift flour, soda and salt together., Drain pineapple well., Add butter, sugar and eggs, mixing alternately with flour mixture., Add nuts and pineapple., Pour into a 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes., Sprinkle with confectioners sugar.

title: Cheese Crunchies
directions: Blend ingredients. Roll into balls and mash with fork. Chill for 15 minutes. Bake at 350° for 15 minutes or until lightly browned. (These freeze well.)

title: Icebox Cake No. 1
directions: Cream sugar and butter., Drop one egg yolk at a time in the sugar and butter., Beat whites and add to the above.

title: Come For Coffee Cake(Quick And Easy)
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Place brown sugar in a pot on the stove top at medium heat., Add eggs and stir., Sugar should start to dissolve., Stir in the flour, one cup at a time., Add vanilla to taste and stir., Add pecans and stir., Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan that has been greased with oleo., Bake in oven for 20 to 25 minutes., Remove and sprinkle with powdered sugar., Cool, cut and serve.

title: Eclair Cake
directions: Layer one-third of graham crackers in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch dish. Combine pudding mix and 3 cups of milk in a large bowl., Beat at low speed with an electric mixer until blended, about 2 minutes. Fold in whipped topping., Spoon half of mixture on graham crackers., Repeat layers, ending with graham crackers.

title: Pudding Delight
directions: Mix together cracker crumbs, margarine or butter and sugar. Spread in 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Homemade Pancake Syrup
directions: Mix brown sugar, water, butter and salt in saucepan. Bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring constantly., Remove from heat. Stir in maple flavoring., Serve warm.

title: Buttermilk Biscuits
directions: Mix dry ingredients together., Cut in shortening until mixture resembles corn meal., Add buttermilk., Turn onto floured surface and knead very briefly., Pinch off and roll biscuits., Place in greased pie plate with sides touching., Bake at 350° until golden brown., Do not overbake.

title: Cheese Ball
directions: Chop lean beef and green onion tops., Mix all ingredients. Shape into ball., Refrigerate until chilled.

title: Mushroom Potatoes
directions: Peel,, slice, and cook potatoes., Arrange in glass pan; add salt., Cook soup, milk, margarine and cheese until cheese melts. Pour, over, potatoes., Sprinkle, with, cracker crumbs. Bake until mixture bubbles.

title: Rice Side Dish
directions: Combine all ingredients in 2 1/2-quart casserole and bake at 275° for about 1 1/2 hours.

title: Tina'S Tasty Tater Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients in a large bowl, adding potatoes last. Chill and serve., Recipe can be halved.

title: Chocolate Fudge
directions: Add sugar to cream cheese., Mix well after each., Add remaining ingredients., Mix well., Put in greased 8-inch pan. Chill several hours., Cut into squares., Makes 1 3/4 pounds.

title: 1, 2, 3 Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients., (Can be mixed in same pan as baked in.) Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes., Makes 1 (9 x 13-inch) or 2 (8-inch round) pans.

title: Orange Buttermilk Salad
directions: Mix Jell-O and pineapple juice and all in small pan., Heat until Jell-O is dissolved., Do not boil., Let cool until slightly thick., Add buttermilk and nuts., Fold in Cool Whip., Chill until firm., (You may use diet Jell-O if you so desire.)

title: Pumpkin Cheese Cake
directions: Mix crumbs with 1 tablespoon sugar and melted butter., Press into bottom of 10-inch spring-form pan., Chill.

title: Cauliflower Salad
directions: Chop cauliflower into bite size pieces in large bowl., Add black olives and diced onion., Add salt and pepper., Mix mayonnaise, mustard, sugar and vinegar., Stir well., Cover bowl and refrigerate several hours before serving.

title: Banana Split Cake
directions: Melt oleo and mix with graham cracker crumbs; pat in pan., Mix powdered sugar, eggs and butter; beat 15 minutes and pour on crust., Slice bananas on this and pour pineapple on top., Top with Cool Whip and sprinkle with pecans and cherries., Put in refrigerator overnight.

title: Chess Pie
directions: Melt oleo., Add sugar and vinegar; bring to boil., Add this mixture to beaten eggs, salt and vanilla., Beat good; pour into unbaked pie shell., Bake at 325° for 40 minutes.

title: Turkey Drumsticks
directions: Put all the soups in a big bowl., For each can of soup, add 1/2 can of water., Mix well and pour over the drumsticks., Bake for about 2 hours in a covered pan at 350°., Serve over rice or noodles.

title: Spinach Dip Casserole
directions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees., Cook spinach until just done. Drain well., Mix spinach with cream cheese, butter and salt., Put in casserole dish and cover with parmesan cheese., Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes or until cheese melts., Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Spring Egg Rolls Pancakes
directions: Mix flour, salt, eggs and water until smooth., Lightly oil 6-inch skillet and heat., Pour as little of the batter as necessary to cover the bottom into the skillet., Bake over very low heat until set, then turn over for a few seconds.

title: Meat Loaf
directions: Mix 1/2 cup mushroom soup with remaining ingredients., Shape into loaf., Place in shallow baking dish., Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours., Blend remaining soup, 1/4 cup water and 2 tablespoons drippings., Heat and stir often., Serve with loaf., Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Hershey Pie
directions: Melt the two Hershey bars in a double boiler., Fold in Cool Whip and put in the baked crust overnight with a few almonds on top, if desired., Put in the freezer.

title: Sour Cream And Squash Casserole
directions: Cook together squash, carrot and onion, then drain., Place squash mixture and alternate with mixture of cream of chicken soup and sour cream., Bake at 200° for 30 minutes., During last few minutes, place grated cheese on top., Secret is slowing cooking.

title: Frozen Strawberry Jam
directions: The rest is the same as for jam.

title: Macaroni Vegetable Salad
directions: Cook macaroni and vegetables according to directions., Cool. Mix in small bowl the Ranch dressing, mustard, salt and pepper. Set aside., Mix radishes and onions with macaroni and vegetables. Cover with dressing and mix well., Top with Parmesan cheese and bacon bits., Cover; let marinate in refrigerator 3 to 4 hours or overnight.

title: Two-Corn Casserole
directions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Grease a 2-quart casserole dish. Saute pepper and onion in butter until soft. Mix all ingredients together and pour into casserole dish. Bake until set.

title: Swedish Meatballs
directions: Combine first 7 ingredients, mixing well. Shape into 1-inch meat balls. Brown for 15 to 20 minutes in hot oven (450°). Combine sauce and juice of pineapple in skillet. Heat and add meatballs. Bring to a boil and simmer 30 minutes. Add pineapple chunks and olives. Simmer at least 15 minutes. The longer they simmer, the better they become. Cook about 2 hours with pineapple. Add olives the last 45 minutes. Yield: about 6 dozen meatballs. Crock-pot is the best to cook them in.

title: Mayor Sal Mancini'S Summer Rice Salad
directions: Cook rice and drain well., Follow directions on the Good Seasons packets., Combine all ingredients while rice is warm. Chill. Serves 10.

title: Chocolate Chip Pie
directions: In mixing bowl, beat eggs., Add flour and white and brown sugar to eggs, beating until well blended., Add melted butter, chocolate chips and nuts., Pour in unbaked pie shell., Bake 30 minutes at 325°., Fills one pie shell.

title: Butter Dumplings
directions: Mix together egg, butter, salt, spices, parsley and chives; then stir in flour. Let batter stand at room temperature for about an hour. Bring broth, soup or salted water to gentle boil, then using a teaspoon drop batter into liquid. When dumplings rise to surface they are cooked. Makes approximately 20.

title: Almond Curried Fruit
directions: Place first 4 ingredients in a, 13, x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Sprinkle the fruit with almonds., Combine butter, brown sugar and curry powder., Top, fruit, with brown sugar mixture. Bake at 325° for 1 hour.

title: Last-Minute Rolls
directions: About 1 1/2 hours before dinner:, Into scalded milk in large bowl, stir sugar, salt, and shortening., Cool until lukewarm., In small bowl, sprinkle or crumble yeast into warm water., Stir until dissolved., Stir into lukewarm milk mixture., Add flour; stir until well blended, about 1 minute., Cover with towel and let rise until doubled., Stir batter well, then beat vigorously about 1/2 minute., Fill greased muffin pan cups or pinch off and put in pan. Bake at 400° for about 25 minutes., Makes 1 dozen.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookie
directions: Heat oven to 375°., Mix thoroughly butter, sugar, eggs and vanilla., Stir in remaining ingredients., Drop by teaspoonful 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet., Bake for 8 to 10 minutes. Cool slightly before removing., Makes about 7 dozen cookies.

title: Nutty Delight
directions: Preheat oven to 350°. Spread almonds in a single layer in baking pan. Bake 8 to 10 minutes until lightly toasted. Remove from oven and cool completely, about 30 minutes. Reduce oven temperature to 300°. Generously grease 2 baking pans.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Saute onions and mushrooms in oil., Season with salt, pepper and garlic powder., Add broccoli., Cook until tender in skillet. Place in casserole dish and cover with cream of mushroom soup, undiluted., Cover with shredded cheese., Bake in 350° oven until cheese is melted, 10 or 15 minutes.

title: Popsicles(Kids Recipe)
directions: Mix dry ingredients together., Store in closed containers.

title: Bean And Rib Soup
directions: Sort, and, wash, beans;, place, in, a large Dutch oven. (Cast-iron, if, you, have one.) Fill with water 2 inches above beans and, bring to a boil; cook 2 minutes., Remove from heat. Cover and let soak 1 hour; drain and remove.

title: Carrot Pennies
directions: Cook carrots, until, tender., Add onions, green peppers, salt and pepper., Heat, just, to boiling the remaining ingredients and pour over carrot mixture., Chill well.

title: Guacamole Taco Dip
directions: Put a layer of bean dip, followed by layer of guacamole, onions, cheese, olives, peppers and tomato., End with a layer of cheese., Makes about 2 cups.

title: Mexican Plate Bean Dip
directions: Spread bean dip over plate., Mix taco mix and salad dressing together., Spread over bean dip., Put shredded lettuce on top, then put tomatoes., Sprinkle shredded cheese over the top., Serve the dip with chips.

title: Lanita'S Red Rice
directions: Fry bacon; set aside., Saute onion and pepper in bacon grease. Stir in cold rice, then tomato sauce and crumbled bacon., Simmer 5 minutes.

title: Lemonade
directions: Cut lemon into about 6 slices., Put lemon, lemon juice, sugar and water into a food processor or blender., Blend until lemon is in very small pieces., Strain the mixture into a pitcher and discard the pulp., Serve well chilled.

title: Broccoli-Carrot Stir-Fry
directions: For sauce, in a bowl, stir together orange juice, dry sherry and cornstarch; set aside., Preheat a wok or large skillet over high heat. Add cooking oil (add more cooking oil as necessary during cooking). Stir-fry ginger root in hot oil for 15 seconds. Add carrots and stir-fry for 1 minute. Add broccoli and stir-fry for 3 to 4 minutes or until, crisp-tender. Push vegetables from the center of the wok or skillet., Stir sauce; add to center of wok. Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly. Cook and stir for 1 minute more. Stir in vegetables and walnuts to coat. Serve immediately. Makes 4 servings.

title: Banana Bread
directions: If using self-rising flour, do not use soda. Mix all ingredients together. Bake 35 minutes at 350° or until done.

title: Pumpkin Dessert Bread
directions: Place dry ingredients in a large mixing bowl., Make a well in the center, then add all of the other ingredients., Put into 2 loaf pans, which have been greased and floured., Bake at 350° for about 1 hour.

title: Hot Cranberry Punch
directions: Combine water, spices and sugar in large saucepan; boil, uncovered for 5 minutes., Add remaining ingredients except lemon slices; heat until warm, but do not boil., Strain., Serve in mugs with fresh lemon slices.

title: Shrimp Scampi
directions: Preheat broiler; in a shallow 2-quart casserole dish, arrange shrimp on bottom., In small bowl, combine remaining ingredients. Pour mixture over shrimp and stir., Broil 3 to 4 inches from heat until shrimp are golden brown., Usually 2 to 4 minutes.

title: Mushroom Caps
directions: Remove stems from mushrooms and save for other use., Clean caps and brush outsides with melted butter., Mix rest of ingredients and mound into caps., Place onto broiling pan and broil 6 inches from heat, approximately 3 to 5 minutes until bubbling and brown.

title: Simmered Franks
directions: Heat jelly and mustard over low heat. Cut wieners up. Pour mixture over wieners. Cook in slow cooker 2 or 3 hours., Serve hot.

title: Rolls
directions: Dissolve yeast cake in water., Add egg, salt, sugar and flour. Work until smooth., Let rise., Work again., Let rise and make out into rolls., Let rise and bake in oven at 350° until light brown or to your desire.

title: Smoked Salmon Spread
directions: Remove skin and debone salmon., Blend all the ingredients. Mold or shape as you like., Roll in parsley and pecans, attractive and delicious on crackers.

title: Party Dip Or Breakfast Bread Treat
directions: Brown sausage and ground beef together., Add spices., Add cheese and let melt over medium heat., Place on loaves and freeze. Use as a party dip.

title: Ice Cream
directions: Mix all ingredients real good, then add enough milk to fill freezer.

title: Cracker Candy
directions: Mix margarine and brown sugar and boil for 2-3 min. Line 13x9 in pan with saltine crackers. Pour sugar mixture. Bake for 5 min. at 375°. Let cool a few minutes. Melt almond bark and pour over brickle. Top with chopped pecans. Let cool completely, then break apart.

title: Chicken With Eggplant In Garlic Sauce
directions: Heat oil over medium-high heat., Add chicken and stir-fry. Transfer chicken to plate., To same skillet add eggplant, garlic and ginger; stir in beef broth and boil., Reduce heat and simmer about 15 minutes., Combine cornstarch, soy sauce, vinegar, sugar and sesame oil., Add mixture and radishes., Cook until sauce thickens and comes to a boil., Add chicken; heat through., Sprinkle with crushed red pepper., Makes 6 servings; per serving 425 calories.

title: English Pea Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients., Place in ungreased casserole dish. Sprinkle with cracker crumbs on top., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Pecan Bars
directions: Cream butter and sugar., Add flour, cinnamon and egg yolk to butter and sugar; mix well., Put into ungreased 11 x 16-inch pan. Pour unbeaten egg white over top and spread with back of spoon. Pour off excess., Press nuts over top., Bake for 25 to 30 minutes at 325°., Remove from oven., Cut after 3 to 5 minutes.

title: Fried Rice (Japanese)
directions: Mix eggs, 1 tsp. DASHI sauce, sugar and pepper until well blended., Heat skillet, add sesame oil, and egg mixture., Scramble and remove from skillet., Add vegetable oil to the hot skillet. Stir in green onion, ginger and egg mixture., Add cooked rice and ham until crisp and hot., Mix with 2 Tbsp. DASHI sauce and a little pepper to taste., If you prefer, you can use any kind of meat instead of ham.

title: Coriander And Mint Chutney
directions: Clean and wash coriander, mint, chili, tomato and onion., Put small amounts of each in blender and blend., Add yogurt and salt a little at a time., Blend until smooth., Store in a container with a tight lid., Will last approximately 2 to 3 weeks, just stir each time you use it.

title: Banana Cake
directions: Cream sugar with shortening until creamy., Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition., Sift cake flour before measuring, then sift with baking powder 3 times., Dissolve soda in hot water and add to buttermilk, then add alternately with flour mixture to creamed sugar and shortening., Mix in finely mashed bananas., Pour in greased, floured pan and bake at 325° for 45 minutes.

title: Blueberry Cake
directions: Beat egg whites., Add 1/4 cup sugar., Cream shortening and add salt and vanilla., Add rest of sugar, then egg yolks., Beat., Sift flour and baking powder., Add to creamed mixture and 1/3 cup milk. Fold in egg whites and blueberries (dusted with flour)., Sprinkle sugar over batter in 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 50 minutes.

title: Pickled Okra
directions: Put into a large kettle and bring to boil., Fill jars with okra, as desired., Hot peppers may be added also as taste desires. Pour boiling liquid over okra., Fill jars to neck and seal.

title: Potato Dumplings
directions: Boil potatoes and let stand for a few hours or overnight, still in their jackets., Peel potatoes and mash them or put through a ricer, then add the eggs and flour., Roll the mixture into little balls., Chill in refrigerator for about an hour before cooking., Cook in lightly salted water that is just under the boiling point., When dumplings are done, will rise to top., Serve hot with melted brown butter and crumbs.

title: Queen Of Hearts Tarts
directions: Cream together thoroughly the butter and sugar., Stir in the egg yolk and vanilla., Sift together the flour and salt and add to creamed mixture., Mix well., Shape into 3 dozen small balls and dip each into unbeaten egg white., Roll in chopped nuts (pecans or peanuts) and place 2 inches apart on lightly greased cookie sheet. Do not flatten balls., Bake at 300° for 30 minutes., After baking 10 minutes, remove pan from oven and with a thimble, make a dent into each cookie., Return pan to oven., Work as quickly as possible and if the thimble sticks, dip into cold water., When cookies are done, remove to cooling rack and fill each dent, while warm, with jam or marmalade., A tart jam is best (plum, apricot or pineapple).

title: Mexican Bean Dip
directions: Combine all ingredients in a food processor or blender; mix until blended., Taste to determine amount of hot sauce you wish to add., If it's too thick for dipping, add a little water., Make ahead so flavors mingle., Serve with low calorie tortilla chips. Contains 62 calories in 1/4 cup.

title: Azar'S Strawberry Pie
directions: Stir and cook water, corn syrup and cornstarch until clear and thick., Add jello and some red food coloring., Cool and pour over berries in pie shell.

title: Old Lady Cake
directions: Cream butter and sugar together., Add egg and beat thoroughly. Sift flour, baking powder, soda, nutmeg, allspice, cloves, cinnamon and salt together 3 times., Add dry ingredients and milk alternately to creamed mixture., Bake in a greased tube pan in a moderate oven (350°) for 45 to 60 minutes., Makes one (9-inch) cake.

title: Cheese Straws
directions: Heat, oven, to, 450°., Prepare, pie, crust as directed, stirring, in cheese with cold water., Roll each half into 13 x 10-inch rectangle; place on ungreased baking sheets.

title: The Very Best Spaghetti Sauce
directions: Brown ground beef in a large 8-quart saucepan; pour off fat. Add onion and continue to saut until onion is golden., Add wine and deglaze pan., Add tomato using just enough water to rinse out each can., Add other seasonings and simmer 5 to 6 hours or until sauce is desired thickness., If it gets too thick, thin with tomato sauce., Thick sauce is best for pasta and meat dishes. Thinner sauce is better for lasagna or stuffed pastas., Can even be used as a pizza sauce., Will freeze well., Yields 6 quarts.

title: Sour Cream Candy
directions: Combine first 5 ingredients in saucepan; bring to a boil, stirring slowly until sugar melts., Then boil without stirring over medium heat to soft ball stage., Remove from heat., Let stand 15 minutes., (Do not stir.), Add vanilla; beat until it starts to lose its gloss, about 8 minutes., Add cherries and nuts., Pour into buttered pan.

title: Dressing For Vegetables
directions: Mix well with hand mixer the first 4 ingredients., Pour over the raw veggies about 2 hours before serving.

title: Pumpkin Bars
directions: Mix all ingredients together well and bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan at 350° until done; cool.

title: Layered Salad(Vegetable)
directions: Layer vegetables in order given., Seal with mayonnaise. Sprinkle with garlic salt., Let set overnight., Toss to serve.

title: Chocolate Zucchini Cake
directions: Melt the chocolate in double boiler., Sift the flour, salt, baking powder and soda., Beat the eggs and gradually add sugar; beat well., Add oil and chocolate; beat until well blended., Add sifted dry ingredients and beat until smooth., Stir in zucchini and nuts., Pour in greased and floured tube pan., Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Deep Dish Apple Pie
directions: Place apples in 10 x 6 x 2-inch baking dish., Combine sugar and cinnamon; set aside 1 teaspoon of mixture., Stir cornstarch and salt into sugar mixture., Sprinkle over apples., Stir together flour and nutmeg., Cut in margarine until mixture resembles coarse crumbs., Sprinkle 1 tablespoon of water over part of mixture. Toss with fork., Repeat until all moistened., Form into a ball and roll dough into a 12 x 8-inch rectangle., Place pastry atop apples., Cut vents in pastry and flute edges., Bake at 375° for 40 minutes., Brush pastry with milk and sprinkle with reserved sugar mixture.

title: Creamy Baked Cheesecake
directions: Be careful in your selection., Do not choose too young., When once selected, give your entire thoughts to preparation for domestic use., Some insist upon keeping them in a pickle, others are constantly getting them into hot water., This may make them sour, hard and sometimes bitter; even poor varieties may be made sweet, tender and good.

title: Sausage Snack Wraps
directions: Heat oven to 375°., Separate dough into 8 triangles., Cut each triangle lengthwise into thirds., Place sausages on shortest end of each triangle., Roll up, starting at shortest end and rolling to opposite point., Place on ungreased cookie sheets., Bake at 375° for 12 to 15 minutes or until golden brown., Serve warm with ketchup and mustard, if desired., Yields 48 snacks.

title: Holiday Cranberry Salad
directions: Wash cranberries., In a medium saucepan, add cranberries and 1 cup water., Cook berries until they pop open., Take off heat., Add sugar and jello., Stir well until dissolved., Add crushed pineapple (juice and all), apples and nuts., Mix well., Pour into glass bowl and refrigerate until jelled., May be topped with Cool Whip.

title: Chocolate Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Beat the margarine and sugars until fluffy., Add eggs and vanilla., In separate bowl, stir flour, cocoa, baking soda and salt., Gradually add to butter mixture, mixing well., Stir in oats and nuts., Drop by tablespoon on ungreased cookie sheet., Bake 11 to 12 minutes at 350°., Cookies will be slightly moist in centers. Do not overbake., Makes 4 dozen.

title: Spaghetti
directions: Saute hamburger, chopped green pepper and chopped onion together., Cook until well done., Add spaghetti and other ingredients., Put in a casserole and sprinkle with shredded cheese., Bake at 370° until well warmed.

title: Chocolate Chip Christmas Cookies
directions: Cream margarine and sugar., Add wet ingredients., Add dry ingredients and chips and/or nuts., Bake at 350° for 12-14 minutes.

title: Peanut Brittle
directions: Mix sugar, syrup and water; cook to form a soft ball., Add oleo and nuts; continue cooking until it turns brown., Remove from heat; add vanilla and soda, stir until it foams., Pour quickly into a greased pan and break into pieces.

title: Butterscotch Peanut Butter Fudge
directions: Combine Marshmallow Creme, evaporated milk, butter, sugar and salt in a saucepan. Stir over moderate heat until mixture comes to a full rolling boil. Boil 5 minutes, stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Add butterscotch chips, peanut butter and vanilla, stirring until smooth. Pour into greased 9-inch square pan. Chill until fudge is firm. Cut into squares. Makes 2 1/2 pounds.

title: Lazy Day Cabbage Rolls
directions: Lightly brown meat and onion., Drain., Add remaining ingredients., Mix well and pour into a casserole., Cover and bake at 350° for about 60 minutes., Serves six.

title: Welch Cookies
directions: Mix the first 6 ingredients like pie crust, then add currants, eggs and milk., Roll to 1/2-inch thick., Cut with cutter or water glass., Spray with Pam., Fry on griddle until golden in color. Turn to do other side., Cool on rack.

title: Tuna Stuffed Zucchini Boats
directions: Cut zucchini lengthwise and remove seeds., Parboil zucchini in a large pan of salted water until slightly tender., Test for doneness with skewer., Combine and mix thoroughly tuna, egg, cheese, parsley, salt and pepper in bowl., Stuff zucchini with tuna, mixture., Add tomato sauce and top with bread crumbs., Place in greased ovenproof dish, or on cookie sheet on top of aluminum foil., Bake at 300° until heated, about 20 minutes.

title: Pizza Hot Dish
directions: Brown hamburger with chopped onion., Spread 1 can crescent roll dough in 9 x 13-inch baker., Place pepperoni in next, then sprinkle Cheddar, then Mozzarella and pour sauce over all., Layer second rolls on top and bake 45 minutes at 350°.

title: Sour Cream Banana Pudding
directions: Mix pudding mix with milk in a large bowl until thick., Add sour cream and 1 carton Cool Whip., Mix until blended., Layer bananas, cookies and half the pudding. Repeat layers., Top with second carton of Cool Whip and sprinkle with cookie crumbs.

title: Macaroni Salad
directions: Cook macaroni according to package., Mix all ingredients in large mixer bowl; set aside., Mix salad dressing, mustard and salt and pepper together., Pour over other ingredients and mix well.

title: Reuben Sauerkraut Spread
directions: Drain sauerkraut., Mix all together., Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes or in microwave for 3 to 4 minutes until cheese is melted., Serve on crackers or party rye bread., Can also be mixed and put in crock-pot.

title: Strawberry Glace Pie(Serves 6)
directions: Bake and cook pie crust shell., Wash and hull fresh strawberries., Cut up 1 cup of berries., Mix 1 cup sugar and 3 tablespoons cornstarch in 2-quart saucepan., Stir in 1 cup water gradually, until smooth., Add cut up strawberries., Cook and stir over medium heat until thick and clear., Stir in remaining berries, saving 1/4 cup for garnish., Pour in pie crust., Chill until firm, about 3 hours., Garnish with whipped topping and berries.

title: Orange Julius
directions: Place all ingredients in blender., Mix well.

title: Seafood Hush Puppies
directions: Mix dry ingredients with milk., Mixture will be thick., Add onion and egg; beat., Refrigerate until chilled., Drop batter from spoon into hot deep fat., Cook 3 to 5 minutes until golden brown. Yields 3 dozen.

title: Grandma'S Cake And Pudding
directions: Mix cake according to instructions on box., Save out 1 cup of batter., Pour the rest of the batter in cake pan and bake until done.

title: Hot Tea Toddy
directions: Combine water, sugar, cloves and cinnamon stick in medium saucepan., Bring to boil., Pour mixture over tea bags in tea pot. Brew 4 minutes., Remove tea bag., Stir in juice., Heat and serve in mugs with clove studded orange slices., Makes 6 servings.

title: Yeast Rolls
directions: Soak the yeast in warm water., Scald milk and cool., Beat the eggs until light., Measure salt, sugar and shortening; stir into eggs., Add scalded milk., (Milk should be body temperature when dropped on wrist.), Stir in yeast., Add 1/2 flour, then continue to add flour until dough is stiff., Knead about 5 minutes.

title: Quick Red Velvet Cake
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Grease and flour two 9-inch round or heart-shaped pans., In a large bowl, combine all cake ingredients at low speed until moistened; beat 2 minutes at high speed., Bake at 350° for 25 to 35 minutes or until top springs back when lightly touched in center., Cool 15 minutes; remove from pans. Frost with Cream Cheese Frosting.

title: Calico Salad
directions: Mix vegetables together (do not use frozen mixed vegetables that contain potatoes).

title: Chicken Pie
directions: Cook chicken until tender, stewed., Remove from bone and put in deep dish or long casserole dish sprayed with Pam., Melt margarine and pour over chicken., Make a batter of flour and milk. Pour batter over chicken., Add mixed vegetables to chicken., Mix chicken or celery soup with broth from cooked chicken., Pour over chicken, vegetables and batter., Season with salt and pepper to taste and bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until crust is golden brown.

title: Banana Split Cake
directions: Mix and simmer for 15 minutes., Stir occasionally., While simmering, make crust.

title: Skyline Chili(Ala Clark)
directions: Chop onions., Put hamburger and water in a large pot first, then all the other ingredients at one time., Simmer for 3 hours. Makes 2 quarts., Serve over spaghetti., Top with Cheddar cheese and oyster crackers.

title: Easy Egg Custard Pie
directions: Grease and flour (real thick) 9-inch deep pie pan., Beat eggs, add, to, flour, and sugar., Gradually add evaporated milk and vanilla., Pour, into, pie pan and top with nutmeg., Bake 40 minutes or until knife comes out clean at 350°.

title: Sweet And Sour Carrots
directions: Cook all the preceding together except for carrots, until tender, then drain carrots and add to this mixture., Bring everything back to a boil and pour in dish for serving.

title: Orange Roughy Pasta Florentine
directions: Coat a 2-quart casserole with cooking spray., Add garlic. Microwave on High 30 seconds; add cornstarch and next 3 ingredients., Gradually add milk, stirring with a wire whisk until blended., Microwave on High 3 to 4 1/2 minutes or until slightly blended, stirring every 1 1/2 minutes., Stir in spinach and fish. Cover with lid; microwave on High 4 minutes or until fish flakes. Let stand one minute., Stir in cheese and serve over pasta.

title: Bran Muffins
directions: Combine 1 cup bran with boiling water; cool and add oil., Sift together dry ingredients., Combine eggs and buttermilk., Add the dry ingredients., Add 2 cups bran., Bake at 400°.

title: Chocolate Crunch Brownies
directions: In a mixing bowl, cream butter and sugar. Add eggs. Stir in flour, cocoa, vanilla and salt. Spread into a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes or until a toothpick near the center comes out clean. Cool in pan on a wire rack., Spread Marshmallow Crme over cooled brownies.

title: Lemon Pie
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Separate eggs and beat yellows real well., Add can of Eagle Brand milk., Mix well and beat in lemon juice until thick., Pour into vanilla wafer pie crust., Add meringue and brown lightly.

title: Pickled Squash Relish
directions: Combine squash, peppers, onions and salt., Cover with ice and water; soak 3 hours., Pour off water and rinse., Mix together vinegar, mustard seed, sugar and celery seed; heat until sugar dissolves., Add squash, pepper and onions; boil 3 to 5 minutes. Seal in hot jars., Great over beans and cornbread!

title: Texas Hash
directions: Brown beef, onions and green peppers in oil., Pour off excess grease., Add remaining ingredients and bake covered in casserole at least 1 hour at 350°., May add sliced or grated cheese on top when done.

title: Chocolate Snowballs
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Sift together flour and salt., Set aside., Blend margarine, sugar and vanilla; beat in egg., Stir in flour mixture, nuts and chocolate chips., Shape into 1-inch balls. Place on an ungreased cookie sheet., Bake for 15 to 20 minutes. Cool slightly, then roll in confectioners sugar.

title: Manicotti
directions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Spray 13 X 9 inch baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. Cook pasta according to package directions. Drain; rinse with cool water. Let pasta dry on paper towels. For filling, in medium bowl, stir together 3 c. mozzarella with the ricotta and fresh basil. Using a teaspoon, carefully stuff pasta shells with prepared cheese mixture. Spoon 2 c. spaghetti sauce into prepared baking dish. Arrange stuffed pasta over sauce. Pour remaining spaghetti sauce over top of pasta. Sprinkle with remaining mozzarella. Bake manicotti for 15 minutes. Sprinkle with the Parmesan; bake for 10 minutes longer. Serve immediately.

title: Noodle Pudding
directions: Boil noodles 4 minutes., Leave cream cheese and margarine out of the refrigerator for 2 hours., After they are softened, put the cream cheese and margarine in the microwave to further soften. Whisk them together., Beat the 4 eggs with milk., Mix all the ingredients together including the noodles., Put all into a 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Pico De Gallo
directions: Mix first four ingredients in a bowl., Mix last three ingredients in a separate bowl. Combine and chill 2 to 4 hours. Drain and serve with chips.

title: Penuche
directions: Blend together sugar, milk, butter, corn syrup and salt in a 3-quart casserole dish., Microwave on High for 5 minutes, or until sugar is dissolved., Stir well., Microwave 12 to 15 minutes on High or until small amount dropped in very cold water forms a soft ball., Cool to lukewarm., Using wooden spoon, beat vigorously until mixture begins to thicken., Stir in vanilla and nuts. Continue beating until candy is thick and difficult to work. Spread evenly in buttered 8 x 8-inch pan., Cool until firm., Cut into squares.

title: Glorified Brownies
directions: Combine eggs, sugar and flour.	Mix margarine and cocoa and add to, mixture., Add, nuts, and, vanilla.	Spread	in 9 x 13-inch pan and bake at 350° for 10 minutes., Remove from oven and spread small, marshmallows, over top., Return to shut-off oven to puff up	and, spread marshmallows., Cool slightly and frost.

title: Cherry Breeze
directions: Mix corn flake crumbs and margarine thoroughly in 9-inch pan. Press firmly and evenly over bottom and sides of pan., Chill. Beat the cream cheese until light and fluffy., Add condensed milk and blend thoroughly., Stir in lemon juice and vanilla. Turn into crust., Refrigerate 3 to 4 hours or until firm., Top with chilled cherry pie filling before serving.

title: Reuben Meat Loaf(Makes 8 Servings)
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., Rinse, drain and coarsely chop sauerkraut., Crumble ground beef., In a large bowl, place sauerkraut, ground beef, bread crumbs, corned beef, egg, parsley and garlic;, mix until well blended., Pat one-half of the mixture into a shallow 1 1/2-quart round baking dish, forming a slight rim along outer edge of dish.

title: Oven Fried Chicken
directions: Preheat oven to 400°., Spray large cookie sheet with nonstick spray., Rinse chicken in cold water., Dip in yogurt, then in bread crumbs., Bake for about 1 hour, turning once., When turning, spray chicken with butter flavor Pam.

title: Marshmallows(And You Thought They'D Always Come In Plastic Bags!)
directions: Soak gelatine in 10 tablespoons water., Heat sugar in another 10 tablespoons water until dissolved, add gelatine and let cool. Beat until almost stiff., Pour into pans, thickly dusted with powdered sugar., When stiff, cut in cubes and roll in powdered sugar.

title: Apple Dapple Cake
directions: Sift first 4 ingredients together and add next 3 ingredients. Fold in nuts and apples., Bake in tube pan for 1 hour at 350°.

title: Homemade Pie Crust
directions: Mix flour and shortening until mixture is like coarse cornmeal., Beat egg slightly and add to wet ingredients., Mix wet ingredients with dry and mix with a fork until blended., It will be sticky. Refrigerate 1 1/2 hours, then sprinkle pastry cloth with flour and roll out.

title: Peach Cobbler
directions: Peel peaches, cut up and discard seed., Combine flour and sugar., Add milk and mix well., Place fruit in 9-inch baking dish. Cover with sugar and flour mixture., Bake at 325° for 35 minutes.

title: Enchiladas
directions: Prepare Chili-O mix., Add flour, shortening, tomato paste and water., Mix well., After browning tortilla shell, dip the whole shell into sauce, then fill as desired., Roll like jelly roll. Leave seam on the bottom of pan.

title: Skillet Cabbage
directions: Chop vegetables coarsely., Heat large skillet or wok to medium-high setting, using bacon drippings or two teaspoons of vegetable oil., Pour all vegetables into skillet or wok and cover. Cook 8 to 10 minutes only to heat vegetables and remove from heat while slightly crisp., May top with crisp crumbled bacon.

title: Potato Casserole
directions: Brown sausage in skillet; drain grease and set aside., Place a layer of potatoes in baking dish., Sprinkle some cooked sausage, diced onion and shredded American cheese over potatoes; repeat layers until all ingredients have been used., Mix soup with 1/2 cup of water in bowl., Pour this over casserole., Slice 1/2 stick butter into pats and place on top., Bake at 375° for 1 1/2 hours or until potatoes are tender.

title: Campbell'S Golden Divan
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Prepare stuffing as directed., Spread on bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan., Sprinkle turkey or chicken over stuffing., Sprinkle onions, mushrooms and broccoli over chicken. Sprinkle cheese on top., Spoon soup (undiluted) over all., Bake for 30 to 35 minutes at 350°., Serves 6., Enjoy.

title: Pizza
directions: Toast English muffins (each muffin will make 2 pizzas). Spread spaghetti or pizza sauce on top of toasted muffin (and/or meat)., Sprinkle Parmesan cheese on top., Place in oven until bubbly.

title: Classic Lasagne
directions: Saute onion and garlic in saucepan in 2 tablespoons of oil until lightly browned., Add tomatoes, tomato paste, 1/2 cup water, 1/2 teaspoon salt, herbs and red pepper., Simmer, covered, for 1 hour., Combine beef, pork, parsley, eggs, bread crumbs, 2 tablespoons Parmesan cheese, pepper and 1/2 teaspoon salt., Shape into 1/2-inch meatballs., Saute in remaining oil until browned; add to sauce., Simmer for 15 minutes.

title: Light Carrot Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 400°., Spray a 9-inch square baking pan with Pam or Baker's Joy., In a small mixing bowl, soak raisins in Port and set aside., In a mixing bowl, sift together oat bran, flour, baking powder and cinnamon., Place in another bowl the brown sugar, oil, milk, corn syrup, vanilla and egg substitute; mix with an electric beater for a minute or two., Add carrots to the liquid mixture, then stir in the flour mixture, then the raisins and Port., Pour mixture into prepared baking pan; bake for 40 to 45 minutes or until a toothpick, when inserted in center of cake, comes out dry., Let cool to room temperature, then cut into squares.

title: Popcorn Balls
directions: In saucepan, combine butter, brown sugar and syrup., Stir well and bring to boil., Stir in condensed milk., Simmer, stirring constantly, until it reaches 234° to 238° or soft ball., Stir in vanilla., Pour over popped corn., Stir well., Butter hands lightly and shape into balls.

title: Joyce Yawn'S French Onion Soup
directions: Saute onions and margarine until tender but not brown., Add flour, broth and water., Simmer for 45 minutes covered., Pour servings in soup bowls., Top with sliced cheese (2 slices make it better)., Put a few croutons on top of cheese and place under broiler until cheese melts.

title: Zucchini Bread
directions: Add oil, sugar, zucchini and vanilla to eggs., Mix together dry ingredients and nuts; add to egg mixture., Pour into 2 greased and floured loaf pans., Bake at 350° about 1 hour.

title: Helen'S Golden Wedding Punches
directions: Serves 1 cup punch to 50 persons.

title: Stuffed Cabbage
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Mix meat, rice, oregano and parsley together., Layer cabbage, meat mixture, sauerkraut and tomato juice., Pour remaining ingredients over., Cover and bake for 1 1/2 hours., Uncover and let bake 15 minutes longer.

title: Mom'S Soup
directions: Brown hamburger, onion, pepper and celery., Put all ingredients in Dutch oven and simmer about 1 hour.

title: Yam Casserole
directions: Cook yams, drain., Add canned yams (pour off some of the juices)., Mash all yams., Add pineapple, orange juice and rum. Blend., Pour into greased Pyrex pan., Sprinkle with marshmallows. Bake at 400° until bubbly (20 to 25 minutes).

title: Rich Dinner Rolls
directions: Scald milk; stir in sugar, salt and margarine., Cool to lukewarm., Measure warm water into large warm bowl., Sprinkle yeast; stir until dissolved., Add lukewarm milk mixture, eggs and 2 cups flour., Beat until smooth., Stir in enough remaining flour to make soft dough., Turn out onto lightly floured surface; knead until smooth and elastic, about 8 to 10 minutes., Place in greased bowl, turning to grease top., Cover; let rise in warm place, free from draft, until doubled in bulk, about 30 minutes., Punch down. Turn out on lightly floured board., Shape into rolls.

title: Cheesecake Cookies
directions: Cream butter with brown sugar in a small bowl., Add flour and nuts; mix to make a crumb mixture., Reserve 3/4 cup for toppings. Press remainder into bottom of an 8-inch square pan., Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Asparagus And Cheese Sauce
directions: Melt butter; add flour., Add milk to make sauce., Add cheese, pimentos and asparagus., Salt and pepper to taste., Server on toast.

title: Soy-Marinated Flank Steaks
directions: Poke the steak all over with the tines of a fork; cut in half against the grain to make 2 steaks. In a non-reactive bowl or large resealable plastic bag, combine the soy sauce, Worcestershire sauce, vinegar, oil, garlic, sugar and pepper to taste. Add the steak and turn to coat. Cover to reseal the, bag and marinate at room temperature for about 1 hour or refrigerate for up to 6 hours. Remove the steak from the marinade and pat dry with paper towels. Position the rack in the top position in the oven and preheat the broiler. Remove the steaks from the marinade and pat dry. Cook the steaks for 5 to 8 minutes on each side for rare to medium rare. Set aside on a cutting board for 5 minutes. Cut the steak against the grain, on an angle, into very thin slices. Arrange the slices on a warmed platter.

title: Mothers Roast Beef And Dumplings
directions: Place the beef roast in a large cooking vessel with salt, pepper and other seasonings; cover roast with cold water about two inches over top. Cook on medium high heat until roast is tender. Remove roast from boiling stock and let cool for several minutes. Slice or tear roast into strips. Place back into stock; bring to a boil and add prepared dumplings. Cook for about 15 minutes.

title: Squash Patties
directions: Add all ingredients together and mix well., Drop by spoonful in hot grease or butter., Use Teflon coated skillet when frying in butter.

title: Homemade Cocoa
directions: Mix ingredients together, slowly a little at a time., Use lemonade scoop for 1 cup cocoa., Add hot water., Keep in airtight container., Makes a large amount of cocoa.

title: Chicken Tetrazzini
directions: Cook chicken breasts and take off bones (save broth)., In a large bowl, put chicken (chopped), onion and bell pepper., Salt and pepper to taste.

title: Layered Chicken And Broccoli(Microwave Needed)
directions: Stir broccoli, onion, garlic, salt and pepper in a round baking dish, 8 x 1/2-inch., Cover tightly and microwave on High (100%) until vegetables are crisp-tender, 3 to 4 minutes. Stir. Arrange chicken and water chestnuts evenly on broccoli. Cover with waxed paper and microwave on High (100%) for 3 minutes.

title: Lemonade
directions: Combine in saucepan the sugar, 1 cup water and lemon rinds. Stir over low heat until sugar is dissolved., Boil about 7 minutes., Cool., Add lemon juice and ice water., Pour over ice in pitcher or tall glasses.

title: Dirt Cake
directions: You will also need a plastic flowerpot.

title: Shrimp Curry
directions: Blend curry powder into Kraft mayonnaise., Gradually blend in the evaporated milk., Add the rest of the ingredients., Heat, stirring occasionally., Serve over hot cooked rice., Serves 4.

title: Apple Pie In A Jar
directions: Peel and slice apples., Fill hot jars with apples leaving 1 inch headspace.

title: Crisp
directions: Place fruit in bottom of glass dish., Mix sugar and flour, then add egg., Pour over fruit., Pour margarine over everything. Bake at 350° for 35 minutes., Serve warm with ice cream.

title: Spinach Dip
directions: Mix mayo, sour cream, water chestnuts, soup mix and spinach together., Hollow out the bread and use it as a serving dish for the dip., Use pieces of bread for dippers.

title: Redi-Cheese Burger
directions: Mix all ingredients well., Make burgers., Bake in oven or fry. Serve on roll with alfalfa sprouts and a slice of red onion.

title: Baked Chicken Supreme
directions: In a large bowl, combine the first 8 ingredients., Place chicken in mixture and turn to coat., Cover and marinate overnight in the refrigerator., Remove chicken from the marinade and coat each piece with crumbs., Arrange on a shallow baking dish., Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 45 minutes or until juices run clear and chicken is tender.

title: Corn Pudding
directions: Place egg in 1 1/2-quart greased casserole; beat well with fork., Stir in milk, sugar, corn, crackers and butter., Cover; microwave at Medium-high for 10 minutes., Stir well., Sprinkle with paprika., Cover; microwave at Medium-high 5 to 6 minutes. When done, center will be just barely set., Makes 4 servings.

title: Nacho Cheese Dip
directions: Combine first 4 ingredients in large crock-pot., When this is completely combined, add 1 pound Velveeta cheese and let this completely melt., Stir constantly.

title: Lois' Chocolate Chip Cookies
directions: Blend oats in blender to a fine powder., In bowl with mixer, cream butter and both sugars until fluffy., Beat in eggs and vanilla., In another bowl, combine oatmeal powder, flour, salt, baking powder and soda., Add oat mixture to butter mixture; beat until just blended., Stir in chocolate pieces, grated chocolate and nuts.

title: Quick And Easy Rolls
directions: Mix all together about 2 minutes., Pour into a well-greased muffin tin., Bake 10 minutes or until golden brown at 450°., Makes 12.

title: Corn Casserole
directions: Saute onions, bell pepper, jalapeno pepper and pimento in butter., Mix cooked rice and corn to the sauteed mix., Add sugar, salt and pepper., Place in a buttered dish., Cook for 20 minutes at 300°., Grate cheese on top the last 5 minutes or until melted. (Can be frozen., Leave cheese off until ready to cook.)

title: Popcorn Balls
directions: Cook sorghum, sugar, butter and water until it forms crystal ball when dropped in cold water, then add 1/4 teaspoon soda., Pour over popcorn., Make balls or leave loose.

title: Barbecued Beans
directions: Combine all ingredients in 1-1/2 qt casserole dish., Cover. Microwave 10-12 minutes on high., Let stand, covered, for 2 minutes before serving.

title: Fudge Ribbon Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Prepare cake mix as directed on package., Pour batter into a well greased and floured 10-inch Bundt pan., In small mixing bowl, beat cheese, margarine and cornstarch until fluffy., Gradually beat in sweetened condensed milk, then egg and vanilla until smooth., Pour evenly over cake batter., Bake 50 to 55 minutes or until wooden pick near center comes out clean., Cool 15 minutes; remove from pan and cool. Sprinkle with confectioners sugar or drizzle with chocolate glaze.

title: Plain Pound Cake
directions: Sift flour., Cream together sugar, margarine and Crisco., Mix in flour and flavoring, then beat in eggs one at a time until blended., Pour into well-greased tube pan., Bake 45 minutes at 350 degrees.

title: Soda Cracker Delight
directions: Beat egg whites until frothy; add cream of tartar., Beat until stiff, gradually adding sugar., Beat well; add vanilla., Fold in soda crackers and chopped nuts., Bake in 12 x 8-inch glass pan, well greased and floured, at 350° for 25 minutes., Let cool.

title: Dried Fruit And Coconut Macaroons
directions: Preheat oven to 325°., Lightly grease cookie sheet., Coarsely chop the dried fruit., In a medium bowl, combine coconut, sugar, flour and salt., Stir in the egg whites and vanilla., Stir in the chopped fruit and walnuts., Drop rounded teaspoonfuls of dough 1-inch apart onto the cookie sheet., Bake for 15 minutes or until edges of the macaroons are golden., Remove macaroons to cool. Repeat with remaining dough.

title: Punch
directions: Mix all the juices together., Add ginger ale and sherbet last.

title: Sausage-Cornbread Bake
directions: Preheat oven to 425°., Grease a 10-inch skillet or 2-quart baking dish; set aside., Brown sausage and onion in medium skillet; drain well., Combine eggs, corn meal, corn, milk and oil. Pour half of corn meal mixture into prepared dish., Sprinkle with sausage mixture and cheese., Pour remaining batter over top., Bake 30 to 40 minutes., Let cool 10 minutes., Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Spoon Burgers
directions: Brown meat and drain well., Add soups and a dash of Worcestershire sauce., Cook over medium heat and then turn heat down and let flavors blend., Serve on buns.

title: Spicy Hot Refresher
directions: In covered blender or food processor, combine V-8 juice, cucumber, lime juice and chili powder., Blend until smooth., Add ice cubes, one at a time, blending until ice is finely crushed. Serve immediately.

title: Delicious Pork Roast
directions: Wash pork roast and pat dry., Sprinkle pepper and paprika liberally over roast., Place in 250° oven and cook until well done.

title: Broccoli Salad
directions: Discard stems and break into small bite sizes (can be shredded). Combine with remaining ingredients., Marinate 24 hours for extra good flavor or eat it immediately. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Turkey Apple Salad
directions: In medium bowl, gently stir together turkey, apple, celery and raisins., In cup, stir together dressing and brown sugar., Pour over turkey mixture., Toss gently to coat., Serve on lettuce leaves., Makes 2 servings.

title: Apple Bread
directions: Stir all ingredients (except apples) together with large spoon., Add apples. Grease and flour pans., Bake at 350° for 1 hour., Makes 2 loaves.

title: Rye Boat
directions: Mix together the mayonnaise, parsley, dill weed, sour cream and onion., Make sure they are mixed well. Dice corned beef and combine with the previous mixture, making sure that the slices separate. Chill mixture overnight.

title: Hummingbird Cake
directions: Combine dry ingredients in a large mixing bowl. Add eggs and oil; stir until dry ingredients are moistened. Don not beat. Stir in vanilla, pineapple, nuts, and bananas. Spoon into 3 greased and floured 9- inch cake pans. Bake at 350 degrees for 25-30 minutes. Cool. Frost with cream cheese icing. Sprinkle chopped nuts on top.

title: Dry Orange Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Do not mix Jell-O with water; use dry., Chill overnight.

title: Rice Lasagna
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Spray a 9 x 13-inch pan with nonstick cooking spray., In medium skillet, brown beef and onion; drain. Stir in spaghetti sauce; mix well., In small bowl, combine Ricotta cheese, Mozzarella cheese and egg whites; mix well., In the prepared pan, spread 1/3 of meat sauce, 1/2 of rice and 1/2 of Ricotta cheese mixture; repeat layers., Spread remaining sauce on top; sprinkle with Parmesan cheese., Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes or until hot and bubbly., Let stand for 10 minutes before serving., Yields 8 servings.

title: Quick And Delish Chicken Soup
directions: Heat oil in large pot., Add mushrooms and onions and cook 5 minutes., Add broth, chicken and garlic., Simmer 10 minutes., Stir in pasta, tomatoes, parsley and thyme., Cook 5 minutes., Yield: 9 cups.

title: Easy Cookies
directions: Mix well with mixer; roll into balls and mash with a fork onto a greased cookie sheet., Bake at 350° until light brown.

title: Mexican Cornbread
directions: Preheat oven to 400°. Grease 9 X 13 baking pan. In large bowl, mix first 5 dry ingredients. In a medium bowl, beat cheese, corn and chilies with their liquid. Stir in onion, eggs, milk and margarine until blended. Stir into flour mixture just until flour is moist. Spread batter in pan. Bake 30 minutes until golden brown and toothpick in center comes out clean. Makes 15 servings.

title: Salisbury Steak And Onion Gravy
directions: In a bowl, combine 1/3 cup of the soup with the beef, bread crumbs, egg, salt and pepper., Shape into 6 patties and brown; pour off fat., Gradually blend in remaining ingredients, stirring to loosen browned meat bits., Cover and cook over low heat 20 minutes or until done., Stir occasionally.

title: Breakfast Casserole
directions: Cook sausage; drain. Break into pieces. Beat eggs and add milk, salt and mustard. In greased baking dish, layer bread, sausage and cheese. Pour egg mixture over these layers. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Brisket With Rub
directions: Mix first 6 ingredients in a bowl., Preheat oven to 250°. Apply rub to both sides of brisket (fatty side last)., Place in pan, fatty side up, and cover with heavy-duty foil or use roasting pan with lid., Bake for 10 to 12 hours., Can be cooked on grill.

title: Tater Tot Hot Dish
directions: Mix hamburger and dry soup mix., Spread in bottom of a 9 x 13-inch cake pan., Drain vegetables and spread on top of hamburger mixture., Mix together soups (do not add water)., Spoon or spread on top of vegetables, then place Tater Tots neatly atop of soup mixture., Heat in oven at 350° for 1 hour or until done., Let cool 10 minutes before serving.

title: Easy Chicken Spaghetti
directions: Mix all of the ingredients together and heat thoroughly., Good for large crowds., Leftovers are even better.

title: Pound Cake
directions: Cream the butter and sugar together until very smooth. Add eggs, one at a time. Beat just until yellow is all through the mixture. Add flour, one cup at a time, beating only until mixed after each cup. Add vanilla. Stir until stirred in., Spoon into tube pan and cook at 300° for 1 hour and 20 minutes or until done.

title: Broccoli And Rice Casserole
directions: Saute chopped onions and celery in butter., Cook chopped broccoli in water., Melt together cream of mushroom soup and Cheez Whiz., Combine., Add uncooked Minute rice., Bake in greased casserole dish at 350° for 1/2 to 1 hour., Serves 6.

title: Chili Corn Taco
directions: Saute celery and onion in oil until tender., Brown meat and drain., Add celery and onion., Stir in remaining ingredients and simmer, uncovered, for 15 minutes., Serve as chili or spoon into taco shells or over chips.

title: Crisp Oven Fried Chicken
directions: Combine ingredients., Dip chicken or fish in water, then in crumbs., Put on nonstick sheet, sprayed with Pam., If any crumbs remain, sprinkle on., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes or until done. Makes 2 servings.

title: Congo Bars
directions: Mix; spread in a 13 x 11-inch greased and floured pan., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes., Cut while warm.

title: Chili
directions: Slice sausage., Brown sausage, ground beef and onion., Lower the heat to simmer., Drain the oil from meats., Add remaining ingredients to meats., Simmer for 2 to 3 hours., Season to taste. Makes a big pot . . . enough to feed 12 hungry basketball players.

title: Brunswick Stew
directions: Cook meats and cut in small pieces. Cool stock and remove grease. Cook bacon and brown onions in fat., Cook 2 stalks celery with chicken or add 1 can cream of celery soup., Cook corn in bacon drippings and let stand with creamed potatoes (add to stew last to prevent sticking)., Cook very slowly several hours. Season with salt, pepper, 2 tablespoons Worcestershire sauce and hot sauce.

title: Fried Potatoes
directions: Cut bacon into 1-inch pieces., Lightly brown. Add all other items and fry. Salt and pepper to taste., Cabbage may be added halfway through cooking potatoes. Add 1/2 stick butter. Cover and complete cooking.

title: Cream Cheese Cookies
directions: Beat brown sugar and oleo until fluffy., Stir in baking mix and nuts., Mix until crumbly (reserve 1 cup)., Press mixture in pan and bake 12 minutes at 350°., Mix cream cheese and sugar. Beat in remaining ingredients., Pour over mixture in pan. Sprinkle with reserved crumbs., Bake 25 minutes at 350°.

title: Candy'S Chicken In Wine Sauce
directions: Flour and brown chicken., Place in shallow baking dish., Stir and heat in saucepan cooking wine, soy sauce and sugar., Pour over chicken., Bake at 250° for 2 hours or until sauce of barbecue consistency., Turn chicken over at least once.

title: Poor Man'S Steak
directions: Mix together hamburger, cracker crumbs and water., Pat into a jelly roll pan (about 1-inch thick) and put into the refrigerator overnight to chill well.

title: Turkey, Swiss And Mushroom Crepes
directions: Lay turkey breast, skin up, on some sprigs of rosemary and oregano and bake in a covered dish with 1/2 cup water. Salt and pepper., Cut turkey into 1/2-inch cubes., Put approximately 3 tablespoons of turkey and 1 tablespoon grated Swiss cheese in the center of each crepe. Add 2 tablespoons of hot Mushroom Sauce. Roll up the crepe. Add 1 tablespoon Mushroom Sauce over the top of the crepe., Garnish with rosemary sprigs.

title: Quick Apple Dessert
directions: Mix flour, sugar and oleo until crumbly., Pour apples in buttered baking dish, 8 x 8-inch., Sprinkle jello over apples and pour water over apples and jello., Next sprinkle flour mixture over apples., Bake 40 minutes in a 350° oven or until apples are tender and topping is golden brown., Can be served with ice cream.

title: Praline Sweet Potatoes And Apples
directions: Melt butter in a large skillet over medium heat. Add sweet potatoes; cover and cook over medium heat for 5 minutes or until golden brown. Turn potato slices over. Reduce heat; cover and cook 5 more minutes. Remove potatoes from skillet. Add apples; cook 5 minutes on each side or until tender and golden brown. Return potatoes to skillet. Add sugars, pecans, cinnamon and salt, tossing to coat. Add 2 tablespoons water, stirring to mix. Cook 5 minutes, until potatoes and apples are glazed and tender.

title: Mexican Dip
directions: Brown hamburger meat and onion., Add soups, enchilada sauce, green chilies and picante sauce. Cook until hot., Stir in cheese until melted., Serve hot with tortilla chips.

title: Lemon-Pepper Potatoes
directions: In a 9 x 13-inch pan, combine Butter Buds, onion tops and lemon-pepper seasoning. Stir in water., Add the potatoes., Toss to coat well. Bake, uncovered, in a 375° oven for 45 to 50 minutes until potatoes are tender and beginning to brown, stirring twice. Goes great with Tangy Baked Chicken and has no fat., Makes 4 side dish servings.

title: Rich Shortcake Biscuits
directions: Mix first 4 ingredients (flour through salt)., Cut in margarine., Combine egg and milk; add to dry ingredients., Stir until moist., Knead gently on floured surface a few times., Pat out to 1/2-inch thickness., Cut and bake on ungreased sheet 10 minutes at 450°., Add pecans and raisins (English style).

title: Kalua Pig(Hawaiian-Style Luau Pork)
directions: Pierce pork all over with a carving fork. Rub salt, then liquid smoke over meat. Place roast in a crock-pot slow cooker. Cover and cook on low for 16 to 20 hours, turning once during cooking time. Remove meat from slow cooker and shred, adding drippings as needed to moisten.

title: Cooked Finger Paint
directions: Mix salt and flour; add cold water gradually and beat mixture with egg beater until smooth., Add hot water and boil until mixture loses chalky appearance., Beat until smooth., Color with food coloring.

title: Key Lime Pie
directions: In large bowl, beat softened cream cheese until fluffy. Gradually add condensed milk and beat until fluffy., Add lime juice and green food coloring., Mix until creamy and smooth., Fold in Cool Whip; mix well.

title: Mini Kisses
directions: Heat oven to 275°., Grease and flour two cookie sheets., Beat egg whites until stiff, but not dry., Slowly add the 2/3 cup sugar and 1/2 teaspoon of salt., Beat until smooth and shiny., Stir in with a spoon 1 cup of chocolate chips and 1 cup of nuts., Drop by teaspoons onto cookie sheet., Bake 15 minutes at 275° (or can turn off oven and leave kisses in oven overnight)., Makes about 4 dozen.

title: 24-Hour Cole Slaw
directions: Place the cabbage and onion in a large bowl; set aside. Combine the vinegar, sugar, salt, celery seed and mustard and bring to a boil. Set off heat and add 1 cup oil. Bring to a second boil and pour over cabbage and onion. Let set for 24 hours. Stir before serving.

title: Apple Cake
directions: Beat eggs and sugar. Stir in oil and remaining ingredients. Batter will be stiff. Add apples last. Pour into a 9 x 13 cake pan. Bake at 350° for 50 minutes.

title: Fig Preserves
directions: Wash the figs by filling a bowl large enough to submerge them in water., Dissolve the salt and baking soda in the water., Using your hands, toss gently so as not to bruise the figs., Drain the water, rinse in clear water and drain again., Put the figs and sugar in a large pot over medium-low heat., Stir gently as they begin to cook., Raise the heat to medium when syrup forms and let it come to a gentle boil., Simmer, uncovered, for about 3 hours or until a foam appears around the edges of the pot., Stir occasionally., Spoon the hot mixture into 5 hot sterilized pint-sized preserving jars, filling to within 1/2-inch of the top. With a clean damp towel, wipe the rim and fit with a hot lid. Tightly screw on a metal ring., Process in a hot-water bath for 15 minutes., Using tongs, remove the jars., Place on a towel and let cool., Test the seals., Tighten the rings., Store in a cool, dark place., Let age for at least 2 weeks before using., Yield:, 5 pints.

title: Chicken Salad
directions: Cook chicken in water, salted to taste, until tender., Cool; remove from bone and chop fine., Combine chicken, celery, eggs, pickle relish and broth., Moisten with mayonnaise., Chill., Can be served on lettuce., Makes good sandwiches.

title: Fresh Apple Cake #3
directions: Blend sugar and eggs; add vanilla., Sift flour, soda, cinnamon and salt., Gradually add flour mixture and oil., Mix well., Stir in apples and nuts., Bake in greased and floured 9 x 13-inch or tube pan at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Layered Fiesta Spread
directions: In a 10-inch skillet, cook onion and beef until onion is tender and beef is no longer pink., Drain off fat., Stir in chili powder, then refried beans., Cook, covered, until heated through. Stir., Spread avocado dip over mixture., Top with shredded cheese. Heat until cheese is soft., Before serving, dollop sour cream over cheese., Serve with chips.

title: Hot Johnny Tomato Catsup
directions: *If you like it mild, leave out cayenne pepper.

title: Baked Chicken Sandwich
