directions: Combine cake mix, melted butter and egg., Press into 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake 10 minutes at 350°., Place marshmallows on top and return to oven about 3 minutes until marshmallows puff up.

title: Frosty Strawberry Squares
directions: Stir together first 4 ingredients; spread evenly in shallow baking pan., Bake 20 minutes in 350° oven, stirring occasionally. Sprinkle 2/3 of the crumbs in 9 x 13 pan., Combine egg whites, sugar, berries and lemon juice in large bowl., With electric beater, beat at high speed to stiff peaks., Fold in Cool Whip. Spoon over crumbs; top with remaining crumbs., Freeze 6 hours or overnite., Cut in squares; trim with fresh whole strawberries.

title: Low Crab Brownies
directions: Preheat oven to 350°. Lightly coat an 8 x 8 baking dish with butter-flavored cooking spray. In a large mixing bowl, stir together soy flour, whole-wheat flour, Splenda, cocoa powder, baking powder and salt. In a medium mixing bowl, combine canola oil, vanilla extract, egg whites, applesauce and water. Pour applesauce mixture into the flour mixture and stir just until well combined. Pour the brownie batter into a baking dish. Bake until edges spring back when you touch them gently (the center will be soft), about 15 minutes. Allow the brownies to cool and then cut into 12 pieces.

title: Broiled Frosting
directions: Blend ingredients., Spread on hot baked single layer cake. Place cake under broiler until frosting bubbles.

title: Date Nut Bars
directions: Beat egg yolks; add sugar, flour and baking powder., Add nuts, dates and vanilla., Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites., Bake in square pan; cut into squares while warm., Put in a bag with powdered sugar and shake.

title: Oven-Baked Mexi-Fries
directions: Preheat oven to 450., Combine all ingredients in a bowl. Toss well., Arrange potatoes in a single layer on a baking sheet. Bake for 15-20 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Silver Champagne Punch(Serves 38.)
directions: Mix and serve; frozen fruit ring adds some color.

title: Banana Nut Bread
directions: Sift flour, salt and soda., Cream sugar and margarine; add eggs., Add dry ingredients, buttermilk, nuts and bananas., Bake at 350° for 1 hour in greased loaf pan.

title: Layer Spinach Salad
directions: Toss together., Mix 1 cup salad dressing and 1 cup sour cream and add.

title: Pumpkin Bread
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Grease three 8 x 4 x 3-inch pans., Set aside., Combine flours, baking soda and spices., Set aside., In a large bowl, cream sugar and butter until light and fluffy., Add pumpkin, water and eggs., Mix well., Stir in flour mixture until well blended., Fold in raisins and nuts., Pour in pans and bake until cake tester comes out clean (35 to 40 minutes)., Cool 10 minutes, then turn on wire rack.

title: Coconut Cream Cake
directions: In large mixing bowl, beat with mixture until fluffy the oleo, Crisco and sugar., Separate egg yolks and add to previous mixture. (Beat the egg whites until stiff and set aside.), Sift together and add the flour and soda by hand (will be stiff)., Blend in then beat well with mixer the buttermilk and salt., Mix by hand the coconut and vanilla., Fold in gently by hand the egg whites and bake in 3 or 4 round greased and floured pans at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: No-Beat Popovers
directions: Break eggs into bowl, add milk, flour, salt., Mix well with spoon (disregard lumps)., Fill muffin pan 3/4 full., Put in oven set control 450° and bake for 30 minutes.

title: Chocolate Mint Squares
directions: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs. Add other ingredients in order. Blend well. Pour into 13 x 9 greased pan. Bake 20 to 25 minutes at 350°.

title: Citrus Cooler
directions: Combine sugar and water in a medium saucepan; bring to a boil, stirring until sugar dissolves., Pour sugar mixture into a 4 1/2-quart freezer container., Stir in fruit juices and freeze until firm., Remove from freezer several hours before serving (mixture should be slushy)., Stir in ginger ale., Garnish with fruit slices., Yield:, 30 cups.

title: Zucchini Bread
directions: Mix egg and oil., Add sugar and then zucchini and vanilla. Sift flour, soda, salt, baking powder and cinnamon together., Add rest of ingredients to flour., Cook in 2 greased and floured loaf pans at 325° for 1 hour.

title: J.T.'S Mixed Vegetables
directions: Melt butter, with, onion., Mix	with all other ingredients, except, cracker, crumbs., Put in 8 x 8-inch baking dish; sprinkle cracker crumbs on top., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: O'Henrys
directions: Cook sugar and syrup, stirring constantly; bring just to a boil. Do not overcook! Remove from heat. Add peanut butter until dissolved and pour over cereal. Mix well and spread into greased 9 x 13 pan. Melt butterscotch and chocolate over low heat. Pour over top; spread and chill for 2 hours.

title: Baked Tomato And Cheese Casserole
directions: Place 1 cup tomatoes in bottom of casserole. Cover with 1/3 of the bread crumbs and 1/4 cup cheese, then onion. Add remaining tomatoes, crumbs, cheese and onion. Dot with butter., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

title: Blueberry Crunch
directions: Cook blueberries, sugar and water for 15 minutes., Put berry mixture in square pan., Sprinkle with corn flakes., Pour butter over flakes., Bake at 375° for 25 minutes., Serves 4.

title: Bacon Wrapped Dates
directions: Insert 2 slices of almond into each date. Wrap with 1/3 slice bacon. Secure with toothpick. Bake at 350° until bacon is cooked.

title: Bacon Rollups
directions: Combine cream cheese and milk, stirring until spreading consistence., Spread 1 scant teaspoon of cream cheese mixture on each slice of bread and roll tightly., Wrap each rollups with bacon, securing with a toothpick., Place rollups on a broiler pan; bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes, turning if necessary to prevent over browning., Garnish with parsley, if desired., Yields approximately 4 dozen.

title: Caramel Corn Crunch
directions: Preheat oven to 225°., Combine popcorn and nuts., In saucepan, mix sugar, butter and corn syrup., Bring to a boil, stirring constantly., Cook until mixture turns caramel colored, about 280°. Remove from heat, stir in vanilla., Place popcorn in a 13 x 9-inch pan., Carefully pour mixture over popcorn mixing well., Turn out onto counter., Quickly break into pieces., Store in tightly covered container., Yields 9 cups.

title: Barbecue Sauce For Chicken Or Ribs
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Pour over meat and marinate for 2 hours., Bake or grill as desired., Baste with extra sauce while baking or grilling.

title: Mother'S Old Fashioned Homemade Meatballs
directions: Mix all ingredients (except tomato soup) together and form into balls., Place meatballs in deep baking dish., Spoon over them tomato soup (do not dilute)., Bake at 325° for 2 hours., Can be served with mashed potatoes and gravy from meatballs.

title: Quick Mexican Prize Dish
directions: Heat oven to 375°., Grease a 12-inch pie plate or square dish is fine., Mix Bisquick, water and beans., Spread in dish., Layer remaining ingredients on bean mixture, hamburger, salsa and cheese (in that order)., Bake 30 minutes., Top with sour cream, lettuce, black olives, onions and diced tomatoes. Delicious!

title: Orange Julep
directions: Mix orange juice, sugar, lime juice and mint., Refrigerate for 1 hour.

title: Corn Fritters
directions: Mix all ingredients; drop by spoonfuls in hot grease., Fry until golden brown.

title: Sweet Cucumber Pickles(Superb)
directions: First Step:, Wash and slice cucumbers in the usual eating size., Soak in brine for 14 days., Prepare brine in a churn or large glass jar., Fill with cold water and dissolve salt in water to float an egg., Place sliced cucumbers in jar., Stir from the bottom each day.

title: Mexican Cornbread
directions: Mix in order as given., Bake in greased iron skillet at 425° until done.

title: Nut Ball
directions: Cream butter; add sugar, vanilla and water., Mix well., Add flour and salt., Mix well., Add crushed nuts., Shape into bite size balls., Bake on ungreased cookie sheet for 8 to 10 minutes at 325°., When cool, roll in powdered sugar.

title: No-Bake Cookies
directions: Melt butter in saucepan; add sugar, cocoa and milk., Bring to a boil., Cook over medium heat for 2 minutes, stirring constantly. Remove from heat., Add vanilla, oats and peanut butter; mix well. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto waxed paper., Cool.

title: Squash Casserole
directions: Cook squash until tender; drain and mash., Add cheese to squash while squash is hot., Add all other ingredients to squash mixture., If desired, saute onions and bell pepper in oleo until clear, then add to squash mixture., Put mixture into buttered casserole dish and top with Ritz crackers., Dot with butter or oil., Put into preheated 350° oven and bake for 30 minutes.

title: Sarah Of Oxford Fudge
directions: Mix marshmallow cream, chocolate chips, butter and vanilla. Mix sugar and condensed milk; bring to a boil (12 to 14 minutes), stirring constantly., Add first mixture and stir until creamy., Add nuts last.

title: Gage'S Jam Cake
directions: Combine shortening, sugar and eggs. Add jam and mix well. Sift together dry ingredients and add alternately with buttermilk. Pour into layer pans and bake 30 to 40 minutes at 350°.

title: Easy Chicken Casserole
directions: Boil chicken until done., While chicken is boiling, mix Veg-All, cream of chicken soup and cheese., When chicken gets done, let cool, then tear apart and add to vegetables., Mix together; cover with cheese., Bake at 350° for about 20 minutes. Serve with rolls.

title: Second Best Casserole In The World
directions: Boil chicken; skin and debone., Cut meat into bite size pieces., Cook noodles in chicken broth; drain., Combine chicken, noodles and remaining ingredients., Put bread crumbs on top., Pour melted butter over top., Bake at 375° for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Icebox Pickles
directions: Mix and let stand for 2 hours; then drain.

title: Cream Puff Cake
directions: In medium saucepan, heat water and margarine., When it starts to boil add flour., Mix well., Remove from heat., Add eggs one at a time., Pour into slightly greased 9x13 inch glass dish. Bake at 425° for 35-45 minutes., Spread filling (recipe to follow) on top of crust., Add Cool Whip on top of filling., Drizzle with chocolate sauce.

title: Rice Krispie Bars
directions: Melt first 4 ingredients until smooth., Add Rice Krispies and peanuts., Press into greased 9 x 13-inch pan., Cut into squares.

title: Caramel Nut Logs
directions: Nougat - Step I:, Combine 3/4 cup sugar, 2/3 cup syrup and 1/4 cup water in 1 1/2-quart pan., Stir over medium heat until sugar dissolves;, boil to 238° on candy thermometer., Pour over beaten egg whites, beating constantly until slightly cooled, about 5 minutes., Spoon into well-buttered bowl and make well in center. Let stand.

title: Italian Spaghetti And Meat Balls
directions: Combine tomato paste, water and tomato sauce in pan., Add onion and garlic; let simmer for 5 to 10 minutes., Add remaining ingredients to sauce, including cheese., Bring to simmering point; drop in meat balls., Cook slowly for 1 hour.

title: Grandma'S Sugar Cookie
directions: Cream sugar and Crisco. Add eggs and mix well. Add soda, salt, vanilla and sour cream; mix well. Gradually add flour using enough to make dough stiff. Chill overnight., Bake at 350° until light brown, 8 to 12 minutes.

title: Blender Banana Pudding
directions: Cut up hard-boiled eggs., Put all ingredients, except eggs, in blender., Blend on high, adding pieces of eggs, one at a time. Blend until pudding is smooth and free of any lumps., Cool in refrigerator and eat cold., (Also great for freezing into popsicles.)

title: Macaroni And Cheese Casserole
directions: Brown, seasoned meat., Make macaroni and cheese according, to directions, on, box., Lastly,, combine, browned meat, macaroni and soup., Pour into a casserole dish., Lay slices of cheese over top. Heat, in, 350°, oven for 15 to 20 minutes or until cheese is melted., Let cool and enjoy.

title: Scrambled Eggs
directions: Get the milk out and the eggs out., Crack the eggs in the bowl., Stir it up., Cook it in a pan on the stove for 20 minutes. Put it in a bowl and eat it.

title: Chicken Stew
directions: Boil chicken, onions, salt and pepper until done., Take chicken off bone; chop this up small., Put back in broth., Add remaining ingredients; cook real slow., You can add cooked rice, but watch closely, because it will stick., We add small diced potatoes., Salt and pepper to taste.

title: Cabin Stew
directions: Combine onion, ham, broth, water, sausage and potatoes., Cook until potatoes are fork tender but not mushy., Add bacon, garbanzo beans, black pepper, salt, and garlic butter., Simmer for 30 to 35 minutes or until garbanzo beans are tender., Stir occasionally. Makes 6 servings.

title: Fruit Cobbler
directions: Put fruit in pie pan. Sprinkle with sugar., Blend flour, salt, sugar, baking powder and egg., Sprinkle over fruit., Melt margarine., Pour over top. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

title: Easy Peanut Butter Cookies
directions: Mix all ingredients., Cook at 350° for 10 minutes.

title: Cool Salad
directions: Mix cottage cheese and dry Jell-O together., Add drained, crushed pineapple., Fold in Cool Whip and chill., Use Jell-O directly from box., Do not dissolve.

title: Peanut Butter Candy
directions: Butter plate. Melt butter in saucepan over low heat. Add vanilla and peanut butter; melt. Take off heat, then add sugar until thick. Put in plate.

title: Breakfast Casserole
directions: Grease 9 x 13 inch pan., Place bread in pan as a liner in bottom., Sprinkle cheese and sausage over., Mix eggs, milk, salt, pepper and mustard., Pour over bread, sausage and cheese., Chill overnight., Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Fudge Clusters
directions: In medium saucepan, melt butter in water. Stir in dry frosting mix until smooth., Heat over low heat for five minutes, stirring constantly., Remove from heat and stir in nuts., Drop mixture by teaspoonfuls onto waxed paper., Let stand until firm.

title: Divinity Fudge
directions: Combine sugar, corn syrup, water and salt in a 2-quart heavy saucepan., Cook and stir over high heat until sugar is dissolved. Continue cooking without stirring over medium heat until syrup reaches the hard ball stage (255°)., Wipe away any sugar crystals that form on sides of pan.

title: Sour Cream Icing
directions: Cook about 5 or 10 minutes after it boils.

title: Candy Cane Cookies
directions: Mix shortening, butter, sugar, egg and almond extract., Mix in flour and salt., Divide dough in half; mix red coloring into one half., Dip out 1 teaspoon of each color; roll into ball and roll into 4-inch strip., Twist together and crook top., Bake 7 minutes in a 375° oven.

title: Chipped Beef Dip
directions: Mix first 8 ingredients well. Place in ovenproof casserole. Garnish with almonds. Bake in 350° oven (uncovered) about 10 minutes or until warm. Serve warm with toast squares or crackers.

title: Peanut Brittle
directions: Bring the 1/2 cup of water to a boil., Add sugar and syrup. Stir until dissolved and boil until 240° on candy thermometer. Now add peanuts and cook to 300° on thermometer., Immediately add butter, baking soda and the vanilla., Stir quickly., Spread on well buttered cookie sheets., Place on a cool area, then break into pieces.

title: Sweet Potatoes
directions: Stir together and put into baking dish.

title: Creamy Chicken Broccoli Skillet
directions: Completely cook chicken in Miracle Whip about 8 minutes., Stir in remaining ingredients., Heat until cheese is melted., Serve over hot cooked rice, if desired. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Ice Cream Sandwich
directions: Place 10 ice cream sandwiches in bottom of "ungreased" 3-inch deep 13 x 9 x 3-inch pan., Spread half the Cool Whip over sandwiches., Spoon caramel, layer of sandwiches, Cool Whip, hot fudge and sprinkle with pecans.

title: Hash Brown Omelet
directions: Fry bacon; drain and crumble., In 2 tablespoons of bacon drippings, cook potatoes, onion, green pepper and 1/2 teaspoon salt., Pat mixture in bottom of skillet and cook 20 minutes until bottom is brown.

title: Holiday Special
directions: Combine flour, nuts and butter., Spread in a 9 x 12-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes., Cool.

title: Pumpkin Cake Roll
directions: Gradually add granulated sugar to eggs mixing until well blended., Stir in pumpkin., Add combine dry ingredients; mix well. Spread batter evenly into lightly-oiled wax paper lined 15 x 10 x 1-inch jelly roll pan., Bake at 350° for 14 minutes or until cake begins to pull away from sides of pan., Loosen sides immediately; invert onto towel sprinkled with powdered sugar., Carefully remove wax paper., Roll up cake and towel starting at narrow end; cool on rack.

title: Jumbo Gumbo Soup
directions: Heat butter in deep kettle., Add onion, green pepper and celery., Cook, stirring occasionally, about 5 minutes., Blend in flour., Gradually add reserved stock and cook (stirring occasionally) until mixture comes to a boil., Add remaining ingredients, except okra., Bring to boil., Reduce heat; simmer one hour., Add okra and reserved chicken pieces., Simmer until okra is hot.

title: Pumpkin Bread
directions: Cream sugar and oil., Add eggs to pumpkin; mix well., Sift together flour, baking soda, salt, baking powder, nutmeg, allspice, cinnamon and cloves., Add to pumpkin mixture alternately with water., Mix well after each addition., Pour into 2 well-greased and floured 9 x 5-inch loaf pans., Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours until loaves test done., Let stand for 10 minutes. Remove from pans to cool., Makes 2 loaves.

title: Mexican Spoon Bread
directions: Butter Pyrex casserole., Cover bottom of 8-inch square baking dish with chilies and top with cheese.

title: Marinated Vegetables
directions: Mix dressing ingredients., Add to vegetables and toss. Marinate for several hours.

title: Hamburger Casserole
directions: Pat hamburger in bottom of pan., Salt and pepper it., Slice onion thin over hamburger., Put potato tots over onion., Then spread soup over all., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Quick Lemon Cake
directions: Beat together until smooth., Bake in two 8-inch layer pans or a 9 x 13-inch oblong pan at 350° for 40 minutes., Frost immediately.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
directions: Work the shortening, peanut butter, sugar and eggs together with a spoon until fluffy and creamy, then add flour and baking powder., Mix together real good, roll into balls and press on cooking sheet with a fork., Put in oven at 375° until done., Makes about 76 cookies.

title: Fresh Fruit Dip
directions: Stir sour cream and brown sugar together until sugar dissolves., Add a few drops of food coloring to make a light pink color., Serve over sliced, fresh fruit., Delicious!

title: Robin'S Sloppy Joe'S
directions: Brown hamburger, drain off fat., Add onions and cook until tender., Stir and add remaining ingredients., Heat until hot. Serve on bun, or as a coney sauce.

title: Festive Prune Cake
directions: Bake cake in 3 layers following box directions. Cool., Combine the remaining ingredients, except vanilla and cook until thick. Add vanilla. Cool slightly. Spread filling between layers. Frost with caramel frosting and garnish with plumped prunes.

title: Texas Chili
directions: Brown meat and onions; drain., Add garlic salt, pepper and oregano., When thoroughly browned, add remaining ingredients. Simmer about 1 hour.

title: Fruity Citrus Slush
directions: In a blender combine banana, pineapple juice, sugar, and orange juice concentrate., Cover and blend until smooth., Pour into large freezer containers., Stir in the 1 1/2 cups water and lemon juice., Apply seal and freeze for six hours or until firm.

title: Easy Pineapple Dessert
directions: Crush graham crackers; cover the bottom of an 8 x 10-inch pan. Mix the softened margarine and 2 slightly beaten eggs., Gradually add 1 cup of powdered sugar., Spread the mixture over the crushed crackers., Drain the pineapple and spread over the egg mixture. Cover the pineapple with Dream Whip., Cover the Dream Whip with graham crackers for the top layer., Chill and serve.

title: Chess Pie
directions: Melt butter and sugar and then add beaten egg yolks., Add dry ingredients with milk., Put in pie shell and bake at 325° for 45 to 60 minutes.

title: Boursin Cheese
directions: Put everything except cheese in food processor and mince., Add cheese, then process., Serve with French bread, Triscuits or crackers.

title: Brown Sugar Blueberry Muffins
directions: These muffins would be good on a holiday brunch menu.

title: Earthquake Cake
directions: In a 9 x 15-inch cake pan, put the chopped nuts, then coconut. Mix cake mix according to directions., Place on top of nuts and coconut.

title: Egg And Cheese Brunch Dish
directions: Spray 9 x 13-inch casserole with Pam., Spread 1 package of crescent rolls into casserole., Top with thin slices of cheese (Swiss and Muenster).

title: Yogurt Mash Potatoes
directions: Place potatoes and onion in a steamer over boiling water; steam until the potatoes are tender., Remove skins and mash potatoes with cooked onion, yogurt, chives and beaten egg., Spoon into a nonstick casserole dish., Bake in a 350° oven for 20 minutes or until top is lightly brown., Makes 4 servings.

title: 5 Layer Salad
directions: Mix peas with mayonnaise and eggs.

title: Pork Chops And Potatoes
directions: Place cubed potatoes in baking dish., Add enough to cover bottom of pan., Sprinkle with chopped onion., Sprinkle 1/2 package of Lipton soup mix., Put pork chops on top of mixture., Sprinkle chops with rest of soup mix., In saucepan, heat mushroom soup and milk until warm., Pour over pork chops and potatoes., Cover with foil; bake for approximately 1 to 1 1/2 hours in a preheated oven at 300°.

title: Cherry Salad Supreme
directions: Dissolve raspberry Jell-O in 1 cup boiling water., Stir in cherry filling., Pour into 13 x 9-inch pan., Chill until partly set., Dissolve lemon Jell-O in the other cup of boiling water. Beat cream cheese and mayonnaise together; gradually add lemon Jell-O., Stir in undrained pineapple., Chill until partly set. Fold Cool Whip and marshmallows into lemon mixture., Spread on top of cherry mixture., Top with nuts; chill until set.

title: Dill Pickles
directions: Pack cucumbers in jars of course., Wash good., While filling jars put in some dill, a few pickling spices and alum., Mix water, vinegar and salt., Heat and pour over pickles while hot and seal. These are easy fixed and we all like them.

title: Good Easy Biscuits
directions: Mix and add to muffin tins until brown.

title: Guacamole Dip
directions: Cut the onion, tomato and avocados in rough chunks., Mash them in bowl with a sturdy knife or fork, then add the remaining ingredients.

title: Boiled Cookies
directions: Cook first 4 ingredients for 1 1/2 minutes; remove from heat and add peanut butter, oatmeal and vanilla., Drop with a spoon onto waxed paper to cool.

title: Spinach Momma'S Way
directions: Thaw and drain spinach., Place in greased casserole in alternate layers, the spinach, onion and mushrooms, adding a few shakes of salt and pepper as you go, then top this with the cheese., Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Mashed Potato Casserole
directions: Mix thoroughly 1/2 cup soup, hamburger, onion, egg, bread crumbs, parsley and seasonings., Press firmly into a 9-inch pie pan., Bake for 25 minutes at 350°., Spoon off fat., Frost with potatoes., Top with remaining soup and cheese., Bake for 10 minutes, or until done., Garnish with bacon.

title: Quick Apple Butter
directions: Combine all ingredients and cook 20 minutes after boiling starts., Seal while hot.

title: Persimmon Pudding
directions: Stir flour, soda and spices, together., Combine sugar, pulp, half of flour mixture and milk., Add remaining flour, melted butter, vanilla and raisins., Spread softened butter on bottom and sides of 1-quart baking dish., Pour batter into dish and spread with a spatula., Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes., Serve hot with whipped cream.

title: Candied Yams With Pineapple
directions: Place yams in baking dish and top with pineapple., Sprinkle brown sugar and cinnamon over pineapple., Use small amount of reserved pineapple juice to dissolve sugar; dot with butter., Cover with foil and bake 30 minutes at 375°.

title: Eggplant Casserole
directions: Peel eggplant and cut in cubes., Boil in salted water until tender; drain and mash., Heat 6 tablespoons margarine in skillet; add onions and saute until tender, but not brown., Add mashed eggplant, tomatoes, cheese and 1/3 cup crumbs., When hot, add eggs. Cook and stir until eggs are done., Add salt and pepper., Pour into 2-quart baking dish., Heat 1 cup dry crumbs in 1/4 cup margarine in oven until light browned to make buttered crumbs for topping the casserole., Bake about 1 hour at 350°.

title: Coconut Sponge Roll
directions: In a bowl, combine eggs, salt and baking powder., Beat gradually, adding sugar and vanilla., When mixture is thick and lemon colored, fold in sifted cake flour and coconut., Bake in a jellyroll pan, 10 x 15 x 1-inch, which has been greased and the bottom lined with waxed paper and greased., Bake in a hot oven (400°) for 12 to 13 minutes., Turn out onto a towel that has been sprinkled with confectioners sugar., Quickly remove the waxed paper and trim off the crisp edges., Roll the cake, rolling the towel in the cake., Let stand for 20 minutes; unroll., Frost with a chocolate frosting or Coconut Whipped Cream.

title: Peanut Butter Blossoms
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., Sift flour, baking powder and salt. Blend shortening and peanut butter in mixing bowl., Gradually add brown sugar, creaming until light and fluffy., Add egg and vanilla; beat well., Blend in dry ingredients gradually; mix thoroughly. Shape into balls, using a rounded teaspoonful for each., Roll balls in granulated sugar; place on ungreased cookie sheet., Bake for 8 minutes., Top each cookie with a candy Kiss, pressing down until cookie cracks around edge., Bake 2 to 5 minutes longer, until golden brown., Yields about 36.

title: Breakfast Pizza
directions: Grease 10 x 15-inch jelly roll pan., Line with crescent roll strips., Layer with meat, potatoes and cheese., Combine eggs, milk and spices., Pour over the top., Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Chocolate Delight
directions: Melt margarine in 9 x 9-inch casserole., Mix in flour with fork and then pecans., Spread in bottom of casserole., Bake at 350° until light brown., Cool.

title: Carolina Delights
directions: Combine sugar, butter, cocoa and milk., Boil 1 1/2 minutes. Remove from heat and add remaining ingredients., Drop by teaspoonfuls onto waxed paper and let cool., Store in airtight container.

title: Garlic And Herb Dipping Oil
directions: Stir together oil and seasoning. Let stand for 10 minutes to blend flavors. Pour onto bread plates and serve with crusty bread.

title: Pink Champagne Salad
directions: Mix cheese and sugar., Add pineapple, strawberries, bananas and Cool Whip., Place in a 9 x 13-inch pan and freeze., Before use, take out 1 1/2 hours to soften.

title: Chili Bean Soup
directions: Brown ground pork., Then add each ingredient., Stir after adding each ingredient.

title: Pea Salad
directions: Bring sugar and vinegar to a boil., Pour over remaining ingredients.

title: "Can-Opener" Casserole
directions: Cook chicken breasts; cool and cut into chunks., Mix mushroom soup, chicken soup, evaporated milk, mushrooms, chicken, celery, green pepper, pimento and almonds., Put into casserole dish and cover with Chinese noodles., Bake at 325° for 1 hour., Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Banana Oatmeal Bars
directions: Cream vanilla, margarine, sugars and eggs., Add flour, oatmeal, soda, baking powder and salt., Fold in mashed bananas and nuts., Spread batter in greased 11 x 15-inch cookie sheet pan. Bake at 350° until slightly browned and springs back to touch. Remove from oven and glaze.

title: Woodsman'S Soup
directions: In large saucepan, heat all ingredients to boiling, stirring occasionally., Simmer 30 minutes., Makes 10 servings (about 1 cup each).

title: Chicken Marsala
directions: Pound breasts slightly and dredge in flour mixed with seasonings., Melt margarine in skillet; brown chicken on both sides., Add 1 cup wine, cover and simmer 1/2 hour or until tender.

title: Overnight French Toast
directions: Butter a 9 x 13-inch pan., Cut bread into 1-inch slices and lay in pan., Beat eggs with milk, sugar, salt and vanilla., Pour over bread., Cover with foil and refrigerate., Next day, uncover and dot with butter., Bake at 350° until puffy and brown., Serve with syrup., Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Carrot Bars
directions: Mix all ingredients., Beat with mixer 4 minutes., Bake in greased jelly roll pan at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Eggs Au Gratin
directions: Add milk, seasoning and cheese to slightly beaten eggs., Turn mixture into greased baking dish., Place in pan of hot water and bake in moderately slow oven (325°) for 20 to 25 minutes or until firm., Remove from oven., Let stand 3 minutes and unmold onto platter., Serve with tomato sauce.

title: Monkey Bread
directions: Cut each individual biscuit into quarters and roll into a ball., In a freezer size plastic bag, mix sugar and cinnamon. Drop rounded balls into bag and shake., Drop into greased Bundt pan., Melt 1 stick oleo; pour on top., Sprinkle remaining sugar mixture over top., Bake approximately 40 minutes at 350°., When cooled, pull apart with fingers.

title: Velveeta Fudge
directions: In a large heavy pan, over medium heat, melt oleo and cheese, stirring constantly until smooth., Blend powdered sugar and cocoa into cheese mixture., Add vanilla and nuts; mix well., Spread in buttered 9 x 13-inch pan., Cut into pieces when cooled.

title: Homemade Chili
directions: Cook beef, garlic, onion and green pepper in, a heavy skillet over medium-high heat, stirring frequently to break up meat., Cook until onion is soft and meat has lost its pink color., Add remaining ingredients., Bring to a boil., Cover and reduce heat. Simmer the chili for 45 minutes, stirring frequently., Chili often tastes better the second day after its ingredients have had a chance to blend overnight.

title: Vondell'S Miracle Pecan Pie
directions: Beat egg whites until stiff; gradually add sugar and vanilla. Blend in other ingredients., Pour into greased pie pan., Bake at 325° for 25 minutes., Chill and top with Cool Whip.

title: Potato Soup
directions: Peel and cut potatoes into cubes wash and drain. Put into a large pot. Add water, milk, salt, pepper and butter. Cook until done or tender. Add cheese and soups, stir until cheese is melted.

title: Snickerdoodles
directions: Heat oven to 400°., Mix butter, shortening, 1 1/2 cups sugar and eggs., Blend in flour, cream of tartar, baking soda, baking powder and salt. Shape into balls., Mix 2 tablespoons sugar and cinnamon. Roll balls in mixture., Place 2-inches apart on ungreased baking sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes., Makes 6 dozen cookies.

title: Holiday Delight Cheesecake
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Combine graham cracker crumbs, sugar and margarine; mix well., Pat onto bottom of 9 or 10-inch spring-form pan., Set aside.

title: Baked Corn
directions: Mix all ingredients together in bowl and bake uncovered at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Meat Loaf Cups
directions: Take canned biscuits and press them thinly into a cupcake pan. Take meat loaf and put a nice size spoon in each biscuit., Cook in oven for 5 minutes at 350°.

title: Barbecue Sauce
directions: Mix and heat., Pour over pork barbecue.

title: Raisin Cake
directions: Boil water, lard, sugar and raisins until lard forms on top. Put soda in enough water to dissolve., Add to mixture., Add nuts and flour., Bake at 350° until done (45 minutes to 1 hour).

title: Lamb And Veggie Kebabs
directions: In large bowl, combine oil, lemon juice, parsley, oregano, salt and pepper., Add lamb cubes; turn to coat in marinade. Cover., Refrigerate 2 hours or overnight.

title: Wrapped Franks
directions: Pat frankfurters dry., Mix baking mix and water until soft dough forms; beat vigorously 20 strokes., Divide dough into 10 equal parts., Pat 1 part dough around each frankfurter with fingers floured with baking mix, completely covering frankfurter., (At this point, wrapped franks can be covered and refrigerated up to 24 hours.), Brush cooking grill with oil., Grill frankfurters about 4 inches from hot coals, turning frequently until brown, about 15 minutes., Serves 5.

title: Miss June'S To Die For Chocolate French Silk Pie
directions: Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy., Add melted chocolate, cocoa powder and vanilla; blend well., Add 1 egg at a time, beating for 10 minutes after each addition (total 30 minutes)., Pour into shell and chill at least 4 hours., Garnish with Cool Whip and toasted sliced almonds, if desired.

title: Corn Soup]
directions: Saute onions in butter., Add soup and milk, stirring to blend. Add other ingredients and heat; do not boil.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Boil chicken breasts until done, saving broth., Chop onion, celery, and bell pepper., Melt margarine, saute onion, celery, and bell pepper., When vegetables are cooked until almost done, stir in bread crumbs and stir until moist., Mix the soups together. Spray 2 1/2, or 3 quart casserole dish., Put half of bread crumbs and vegetables in bottom of dish., Put soups and chicken on top of this., Put rest of crumbs on top., Pour broth over all of it. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Homemade Lasagna
directions: Brown beef with onions and mushrooms; drain., Add tomato paste, sauce and tomatoes; bring to a boil., Add seasoning and sugar. Cook, covered, for 1 hour or until thick., Boil lasagna noodles 20 minutes in 2 quarts water.

title: Chili Cheese Dip
directions: Combine cheese and chili in, a bowl., Microwave on High for 5 minutes or until cheese melts, stirring occasionally to mix well. Serve with corn chips.

title: Milk Punch
directions: Boil sugar and water for five minutes., Add to milk., Add bourbon., Freeze and stir frequently for first 24 hours., Serve slightly thawed.

title: Vegetable Relish
directions: Grind vegetables using coarse blade., Sprinkle with salt; let stand overnight., Rinse and drain., Combine remaining ingredients. Pour over vegetables., Heat to boiling., Simmer for 3 minutes. Makes 8 pints.

title: Cauliflower Bake
directions: Combine first 3 ingredients in a large saucepan, bring to a boil., Cover, reduce heat and cook for 5 minutes or until tender. Drain and set aside., Combine butter and next 4 ingredients in a large bowl, stir in cauliflower, 1 cup cheese, onion, chopped green pepper and tomatoes., Spoon into a greased 13x9x2 inch baking dish., Bake at 350° for 35 minutes., Add remaining 1/2 cup cheese and bake 5 additional minutes.

title: Ricotta Cheese Cookies
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Drip by teaspoon onto greased cookie sheet., Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes., Yield: Makes 110 cookies.

title: Beverly'S Cheese Ball
directions: Soften, cream, cheese, to, room temperature and combine with drained, pineapple, and 1/2 cup pecans and green onions. Roll into, ball, and, roll in 1/2 cup pecans. Refrigerate and serve with crackers.

title: Corn And Green Bean Casserole
directions: Mix together corn, beans, soup, onion and cheese., Pour into casserole dish., Crumble crackers over the top, then pour melted butter over crackers., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Cinnamon Jelly
directions: Combine candies, sugar and water; bring to a boil., Add Certo. Boil 1/2 minute., Pour into sterilized jars.

title: Shortbread Cookies
directions: Cream butter and sugar until fluffy., Add remaining ingredients; mix well., Roll dough into small balls and place on cookie sheet., Flatten each one with fork., Bake 20 to 25 minutes at 325°., Makes 30 to 40 cookies.

title: Corn And Potato Chowder
directions: In a large, heavy saucepan, heat oil and sherry or water until bubbling., Add onion and saute 5 minutes, stirring frequently, to prevent browning., (If mixture appears dry, add 1 to 2 tablespoons water.), Add carrot, celery, bay leaf, potatoes and stock., Cover pan, bring to a boil and cook over medium heat 10 to 15 minutes or until potatoes are tender., Add milk and corn., Simmer 3 minutes or until corn is tender. Discard bay leaf., Puree 1 cup soup in a food processor or blender, then return it to the pot., Season with cayenne., If desired, garnish with a dollop of yogurt., Makes 4 servings.

title: Praline Cake
directions: Mix oleo, brown sugar, corn syrup and pecans., Spray 9 x 13-inch pan., Add mixture in pan., Prepare cake mix and pour over pecan mixture and bake at 350° for 45 minutes., Great with ice cream!

title: Corn, Corn Bread(10 Servings)
directions: Preheat oven to 400°., Grease a 13 x 9-inch pan., Combine dry ingredients., Add sour cream, eggs, corn and oil; stir to mix. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes, until center springs back when touched. Pour melted butter over corn bread.

title: Holiday Egg Nog
directions: Beat eggs., Add ginger, nutmeg and cloves., Mix with 2 quarts orange juice and lemon juice., In punch bowl, put chunks of ice cream., Slowly pour ginger ale down sides of bowl., Gently stir in juice and egg mixture.

title: Butterfinger Cake
directions: Cook cake mix just like box says., Let cool., Mix sugar, Cool Whip and crumbled up Butterfingers together., Crumble up half cakemix and put into bowl, then layer topping and repeat again.

title: Crisp Pickle Slices
directions: Mix in alternate layers cucumbers, salt and ice. Let stand for 3 hours. Drain, combine sugar, vinegar and spices. Heat to a boil. Add cucumbers and let them get hot. Pack, sterilized jars. Let syrup mixture continue boiling. Pour over cucumbers and seal. Makes about 6 pints.

title: Beef On Noodles Or Rice
directions: Brown beef in Dutch oven in cooking oil., Add 3 cups hot water, 1/2 teaspoon salt and 1/8 teaspoon pepper., Heat to boiling., Reduce heat; cover and simmer for about 20 to 30 minutes (until beef is tender)., Add onion, bouquet sauce, bouillon cube and bay leaf., Cover and simmer until onion is tender (about 10 minutes)., Shake cold water and flour in covered container; stir into beef mixture slowly., Heat to boiling, stirring constantly. Boil and stir 1 minute., Prepare noodles or rice according to package directions., Serve beef over the noodles or rice.

title: Beef Tips In Gravy
directions: Place meat in a bowl with the next 3 ingredients., Marinate 1 hour., Heat margarine and oil in skillet. Stir in meat and sear. Add bouillon, coffee and water., Simmer, covered, for 30 minutes. Blend flour in 1/2 cup water. Stir in skillet and thicken., Serve over noodles or rice.

title: Gravy
directions: Skim excess fat from broth., Add enough water to broth, if necessary, to measure 1 cup., Mix flour and cold water until smooth., Gradually stir into broth., Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until gravy is smooth and thickened., Season with salt and pepper.

title: Mississippi Mud Cake
directions: Melt margarine and cocoa together. Remove from heat. Stir in sugar and eggs. Mix well. Add flour, salt, nuts and vanilla. Mix well. Spoon into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes. Sprinkle marshmallows on hot cake and cover with Chocolate Frosting when cake is cool.

title: Sweet Potato Puff
directions: Cook sweet potatoes until tender., Cool and peel., In large bowl, mash., Add marmalade, sugar, orange juice and extract., Beat until smooth., In separate bowl, beat egg whites to stiff peaks. Fold into potato mixture., Coat a 6-cup casserole with nonstick spray., Add mixture; sprinkle with almonds., Bake at 350° until puffy and set, about 40 minutes.

title: Quick And Easy Dump Cake
directions: Butter a 9 x 13-inch cake pan., Put cherry pie filling in pan and crushed pineapple over that., Sprinkle sugar over the pineapple, then yellow cake mix. Dot the top with 2 sticks margarine. Sprinkle pecan pieces over top of butter., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Homemade Rolls From Marie'S Kitchen
directions: Pour 1 cup boiling water over 1 cup Crisco., Dissolve yeast in 1 cup cold water at least 5 minutes., Pour into Crisco mixture. Add sugar and eggs, beaten slightly., Put 6 cups flour in large bowl and add salt., Add the liquid mixture, a little at a time, to flour mixture and mix until it pulls away from bowl., Put into large bowl, brush with melted oleo., Cover and put in refrigerator.

title: Chicken Cheese Spaghetti
directions: Boil one chicken; skin and debone it., Cool and tear into bite size pieces., Cook spaghetti in chicken broth saved from boiling chicken (add water if necessary)., Drain most of broth off spaghetti, but save it., To spaghetti add chicken pieces, olives, pimentos (optional) and Cheez Whiz., (I use an 8-ounce jar of regular Cheez Whiz and an 8-ounce jar of mild Mexican Cheez Whiz. You can use all of one if you want.), Mix all together in a large dish., This makes a lot.

title: Brownies
directions: Mix ingredients together until smooth., Bake 25 minutes at 325° in a jelly roll pan (or small cookie sheet).

title: Baked Chicken Chinese Style
directions: Mix together soy sauce, oil, mustard, ginger, pepper and garlic., Add chicken strips to mixture., Marinate 1/2 hour, stirring frequently., Place chicken and mixture in a shallow baking pan., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes., Baste every 10 minutes.

title: Aloha Loaf
directions: Cream together butter and sugar., Add eggs and mix well., Stir in bananas., Sift dry ingredients and add to mixture., Fold in pineapple, coconut, cherries and nuts., Makes 3 loaves of bread. Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 10 minutes or until done., This will freeze good.

title: Outrageous Chocolate Chip Cookies(Yields About 2 Dozen)
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Beat sugars, margarine, peanut butter, vanilla and egg in medium bowl with wooden spoon until creamy and well blended., Mix in flour, oats, baking soda and salt., Stir in chocolate chips., Drop dough by rounded teaspoonfuls, about 2-inches apart onto ungreased cookie sheet., Bake 10 to 12 minutes., Cool 1 minute before removing from cookie sheet.

title: Happy Hour Mushrooms
directions: Remove stems from mushrooms and save for other uses., Brush melted butter over mushroom caps, coating thoroughly., Stir together remaining ingredients until well blended., Place mushrooms, cavity side up, on large rimmed baking sheet., Evenly mound filling into each mushroom, pressing it in lightly., Broil about 6 inches below broiler until bubbly and lightly browned (about 3 minutes)., Serve warm with napkins., Makes 10 stuffed mushrooms., Can be doubled, tripled, etc., as is necessary., They are so good, they won't last long.

title: Orange Slice Candies
directions: Mix all ingredients well and pour into greased jelly roll pan. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes., Remove from oven., Cool 5 minutes., Use teaspoon to dip small portion and form small balls. Roll in powdered sugar.

title: 7 Layer Dip
directions: Layer in a 13 x 9-inch pan., Mix in taco seasoning with sour cream., Smash avocados; season with garlic salt., Grate the cheese., Spread ingredients in order as shown, then chill for 30 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Marinated Veggies
directions: Mince garlic fine; add all other ingredients.

title: Old-Fashioned Corn Bread Dressing
directions: Mix cornmeal, baking powder, soda and 1 teaspoon salt in large mixer bowl., Add 2 eggs, buttermilk and bacon drippings; mix well. Pour into hot greased 10-inch baking pan., Bake at 450° for 35 minutes or until light brown., Cool., Crumble corn bread into large bowl., Saute celery and onion in butter in skillet until tender., Add to crumbled corn bread., Add crumbled bread slices, chicken broth, milk, 2 eggs, 1 teaspoon salt, poultry seasoning and pepper; mix well., Spoon into greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Bake at 450° for 25 to 30 minutes or until brown., Yield:, 12 servings.

title: Sunday Breakfast Casserole
directions: Cook sausage., Drain well and crumble., Spread each slice of bread with butter., Cut into cubes., Place bread cubes in a greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish., Sprinkle with sausage and top with cheese.

title: Hungarian Coffee Cake
directions: Mix together milk, sugar and salt; crumble into this mixture the yeast., Stir until yeast is dissolved., Stir in egg and shortening., Mix in first with spoon, then by hand the flour., Add flour in 2 additions, enough to make it easy to handle and soft as possible., Knead until smooth and elastic., Let rise until double, punch down, turn over and let rise again., Cut dough into pieces the size of walnuts., Form into balls, roll each ball in melted butter, cinnamon, sugar and nuts., Place 1 layer of balls in well-greased 9-inch pan., Sprinkle with raisins., Add layer; sprinkle with more raisins., Let rise 45 minutes., Bake 35 to 40 minutes at 375°., Loosen from pan; invert so butter sugar mixture runs down.

title: Mr. Bill'S Hot Cornbread
directions: Grease yo skillet 'r muffin tin 'r yo corn stick pan., Git hot, then pore in mixture 'n bake fur an hour at 350°., This

title: Cheesy Manicotti
directions: Mix all ingredients together and fill noodle shells with about 2 tablespoons., Cover with 2 cups of spaghetti sauce and sprinkle with 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese.

title: John Massetti
directions: Fry onion and green pepper., Add meat and brown., Add soup, water and cheese., Put in casserole., Top with crumbs and cheese. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Almond Bark Cooky
directions: Put peanut butter between 2 Ritz crackers., Use all crackers. Heat on low, 1 pkg. of Chocolate almond bark., Do not add anything to bark., Remove from heat., Dip crackers in bark till coated evenly., Place on foil to cool, about 1 hour., You can use white almond bark for colors add several drops of food color.

title: Peanut Brittle
directions: Cook sugar, water and syrup until soft ball stage., Stir occasionally over medium heat., Add peanuts; cook until 300°, hard crack stage., Stir constantly., When it reaches hard crack stage, take from stove., Add vanilla, butter and soda., Pour on buttered cookie sheet., Break after it cools.

title: Creole Tomato Soup
directions: *Canned shrimp may be used., After rice is tender, add canned shrimp and heat through.

title: Pretzel Salad
directions: Melt margarine in square Pyrex dish., Stir in pretzels and 1/3 cup sugar., Bake in 400° oven for 7 minutes., Stir pretzels after removing from the oven., Mix cream cheese and 1/2 cup sugar; fold in the Cool Whip and the pineapple., Pour over the pretzels and place in the refrigerator.

title: Peanut Butter Custard Pie
directions: Prepare pie shell; refrigerate until ready to fill., Preheat oven to 375°., In large bowl of electric mixer, at low speed, cream peanut butter and vanilla., Combine sugar and salt. Gradually add to peanut butter, creaming after each addition until fluffy., With mixer at medium speed, add eggs gradually., At low speed, blend in milk and beat until mixture is smooth., Strain into unbaked pie shell., Bake 45 to 50 minutes, or until filling is set in center when pie is gently shaken.

title: Corn Bread
directions: Mix all ingredients., Add milk to make batter to desired thickness., Heat cooking oil or meat grease in a 9-inch pan. Sprinkle dash of corn meal in oil to prevent sticking., Pour batter into pan and cook at 400° to 450°, about 30 minutes, until done.

title: Instant Mashed Potato Donuts
directions: Mix yeast, water and sugar together and let stand about 15 minutes., Add rest of ingredients; let stand 15 minutes., Roll out on floured board and cut into shapes., Let stand another 15 minutes, then fry in vegetable oil until golden brown and glaze.

title: Spinach And Mushroom Salad
directions: Prepare spinach, tearing leaves into bite-size pieces and placing in a salad bowl. Add eggs, mushrooms and bacon.

title: Kid'S Party Pizzas
directions: Slice frozen muffins., Put ingredients into separate cups or dishes., Give each child a paper towel to work on., Let children make their on pizza by spooning on sauce, cheeses and pepperoni. Put assembled pizza on cookie sheet and broil 2 to 3 minutes., Let cool briefly., Serve and enjoy.

title: Apple Dumplings
directions: May use pastry dough.

title: Surprise Carrot Cookies
directions: Cream the butter and sugar. Stir in carrots and egg. Add flour, baking powder, salt and rum flavoring. Drop on greased baking sheet. Bake at 375° for 12 to 15 minutes., Frost immediately with confectioners sugar and orange juice mixed to a spreading consistency.

title: Ragu That Rocks
directions: Brown ground beef and drain thoroughly., Combine remaining ingredients and add ground beef., Bring to a light boil, stirring occasionally., Lower heat to a low simmer and cook for 45 minutes.

title: Homemade Applesauce(Yield: 4-6 Servings)
directions: 1. Place apples in heavy saucepan., Add water to cover. Bring to a boil over medium-high heat.

title: Marinade-Barbecue Sauce
directions: Mix well., Use for marinating meat or as a barbecue sauce.

title: Tangy Brunch Sausages
directions: Purchase pineapple slices in heavy syrup., Drain and reserve syrup from pineapple., Cut each pineapple slice in half; set aside., In medium size bowl, mix brown sugar, water, cornstarch, vinegar, horseradish and reserved syrup from pineapple; set mixture aside., Cut pork sausage meat into 1/4-inch slices., With sharp knife, make a few slashes in each cocktail frankfurter., In a 12-inch skillet over medium heat, cook sausage slices, a few at a time, until well browned, removing slices as they brown to paper towels to drain well., Keep warm., Pour off fat from skillet.

title: Blender Orange Date Bread
directions: Sift in bowl flour, baking powder, salt and soda., Add 1/2 cup nuts (optional)., Blend (in order) egg, milk, unpeeled orange, dates, shortening and sugar., Blend well then add to dry ingredients., Bake in greased loaf pan at 350° for 50 minutes. Slices better next day., Serve with cream cheese mixed with powdered sugar and orange juice to taste.

title: Taco Salad
directions: Brown ground beef and drain off fat., Let cool., Set aside. Dice the green pepper and onion; set aside., Wash lettuce and break into bite-sized pieces., Add cheese, onion and green pepper to lettuce; mix., Mix beans with ground beef separately.

title: Cabbage Pie
directions: Cook ground beef., Add flour and 1/4 to 1/2 cup water., Add chopped cabbage, onion, salt and pepper., Cook 20 minutes, stirring often., Take off heat., Add sour cream.

title: "Six Week" Muffins
directions: Blend together., Don't overstir., Store in a large covered container in the refrigerator., Batter will keep for up to 6 weeks., Bake as needed in greased muffin tin at 400° for 20 minutes.

title: Chicken Salad
directions: In a large bowl with fork, combine mayonnaise, mustard and pepper. Add remaining ingredients except lettuce. Toss well. Cover and refrigerate 2 hours. Serve over lettuce. Makes 4 servings, 1/2 cup each.

title: Asparagus Tarts
directions: Mix together with fork and press into pie plate.

title: Italian Chocolate Cookies
directions: Mix sugar, Crisco and eggs., Sift in dry ingredients., Add milk in., Roll dough into balls (golf ball size)., Place on an ungreased cookie sheet., Bake at 375° for 10 to 15 minutes., Top with optional confectioners sugar and nuts.

title: Heath Bar Cake
directions: Bake cake by directions and cool. Poke holes in cake with straw. Pour milk over entire cake. Pour caramel topping over cake. Spread Cool Whip over cake. Crush Heath bars and sprinkle on top.

title: Pear Relish
directions: Mix all ingredients together and bring to a boil. Simmer for 15 minutes. Pour in jars and seal.

title: 7 Layer Salad
directions: In large serving bowl (clear one looks pretty), layer all vegetables., All ingredients should be chopped or shredded. After all vegetables are in put a layer of mayonnaise over them, making sure to cover all vegetables., Sprinkle sugar over mayonnaise and top with a layer of shredded cheese and crumbled bacon., Let sit overnight and mix well before serving.

title: Spinach, Gorgonzola And Walnuts Over Fettuccine
directions: Heat oil in large skillet., Add garlic and cook over low heat 5 minutes., Add spinach and cook over medium heat until limp, about 5 minutes, stirring frequently., Stir in cheese and nuts. Add fettuccine and toss well to melt cheese into spinach and pasta., Season well with pepper., Makes 2 servings.

title: Cheese Fried Cube Steak
directions: Sprinkle steaks with salt., Press into cracker crumbs on both sides., In a large frypan, brown coated steaks in butter, cooking about 5 minutes on each side., Serve hot., Makes 4 servings.

title: Cherry Nut Loaf
directions: Drain cherries, reserving juice., Cream butter and sugar; add egg yolks, sour cream and reserved juice., Sift together flour, baking powder and baking soda and add to creamed mixture and mix well., Beat egg whites until stiff and fold into batter., Add cherries and nuts., Bake in 350° oven for 45 minutes in 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
directions: Mix ingredients, and, pour into well-greased casserole, 11 3/4 x 1 3/4-inches.

title: Stuffed Pears
directions: In a small bowl of mixer, beat cheese, milk and extract until well blended and fluffy. Stir in raisins., Using ice cream scoop or 2 spoons, shape mixture into 4 balls., Place on cut sides of pear halves., Sprinkle with almonds. Serve at once.

title: Neiman-Marcus Cake
directions: * Can use lemon, strawberry, chocolate, orange, or any cake mix you desire; it's always good!

title: Chili Beans
directions: Brown ground beef in a large kettle., Add onions, garlic, cumin, oregano, salt, red pepper and oil., Cook until onions are tender., Next add tomatoes (in juice), kidney beans and chili powder., Simmer for 1 hour, stirring frequently.

title: Old Fashioned Molasses Cookies
directions: Cream shortening and sugar and add eggs., Dissolve baking soda in water., Combine with salt, spices and molasses., Add alternately with flour., Roll out on a floured board., Cut in desired shapes., Bake at 350° for 10 minutes or until done.

title: Pigs In The Blanket
directions: Mix ground beef and sausage, onions and seasoning together. Add milk and eggs., Add rice and mix well., Roll in balls., Wrap in cabbage leaves and hold together with toothpicks., Cook in a 350° oven for 2 hours in tomato juice and ketchup.

title: Blueberry Cake(Low-Cal)
directions: Combine margarine and sugar., Add egg substitute and vanilla. Mix together dry ingredients; add to egg mixture, alternating with milk., Fold in floured blueberries., Pour into greased and floured 10-inch tube pan or 2 loaf pans., Sprinkle with sugar before baking., Bake at 350° for 45 to 55 minutes or until toothpick is clean.

title: Erika'S Appetizer
directions: Heat oven to 375°., Cut bacon slices in half., Wrap each piece of watermelon rind with bacon; secure with toothpick., Place in a greased baking dish., Bake at 375° for approximately 20 minutes. Bacon should be done well., Serve warm.

title: Cranberry Chiffon Pie
directions: Add 1 cup of boiling water to gelatin to dissolve., Cool and add cranberries., Let slightly congeal and fold in whipped topping., Place in prepared pie crust., Refrigerate 1 or 2 hours to set.

title: Coca-Cola Fried Chicken
directions: Remove skin from chicken and place in skillet., Mix Coca-Cola and ketchup together., Pour mixture over chicken., Bring to a boil, then lower heat and simmer., Let simmer until chicken is tender.

title: Salsa Dip
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Chill in refrigerator for 3 to 4 hours., Serve with salsa chips.

title: Cheddar Potatoes
directions: Combine all but the last 2 ingredients in a casserole., Mix the corn flakes crumbs with 1/4 cup melted butter and spread over the potato mixture., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes., Serves 6.

title: German Potato Salad
directions: Place unpeeled potatoes in large pan containing enough boiling water to cover them completely. Boil over medium heat until potatoes can just be pierced through with sharp knife., Do not overcook. Drain at once in colander. Cool, peel and slice potatoes 1/4-inch thick into large flat pan., Set aside.

title: Cherry Crunch
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Mix butter or oleo with cake mix (reserve 1 cup)., Put remaining mixture into 13 x 9 x 2-inch oblong pan, pressing all in bottom and 1/2 inch up edge., Spread pie filling over the crust., Blend chopped nuts and the reserved mixture. Sprinkle over top., Bake 45 minutes., Serve with ice cream.

title: Chicken Divan
directions: Boil chicken until done., Cut up in cubes., Steam fresh broccoli until fork can go through.

title: Light Lasagna
directions: Prepare noodles according to package directions., Preheat oven to 375°., Brown ground beef and drain well., Add spaghetti sauce. Bring to boil., Remove from heat., In 9 x 13-inch pan, layer sauce, noodles, cottage cheese and Mozzarella cheese., Repeat layers, ending with sauce., Sprinkle Parmesan cheese on top. Cover dish with foil and bake for, 1 hour., Let stand for 5 or 10 minutes before cutting into squares.

title: Holiday Salad
directions: Dissolve Jell-O in hot applesauce and add the remaining ingredients., Mix well and put in refrigerator to chill., Serves 15.

title: Peppered Beef(Appetizer)
directions: Trim all fat and membrane from meat., Cut meat into 1-inch cubes., Put all ingredients in Dutch oven (covered)., Bake at 300° for 4 to 5 hours., Check after 3 1/2 hours; if too dry, add water. After 4 1/2 to 5 hours use potato masher., Meat should look like a spread., Serve warm on bread., Especially good on party rye.

title: Lbj Barbecued Chicken
directions: Melt butter in sauce pan, add lemon juice, vinegar, catsup and Worcestershire sauce. Add salt, pepper, tabasco and red pepper to taste. Bring to boil. Pour over meat to be barbecued.

title: Stuffing Balls
directions: Saute onion and celery., Add to bread and seasonings., Add half of soup and water mixture., Make into balls and bake 30 minutes, covered, at 350°. Add rest of soup mixture., Bake, uncovered, 10 more minutes., Cooking time: 40 minutes.

title: Praline No-Bake Cookies
directions: Mix and boil 1 minute sugar, milk and oleo., Remove from heat and add other ingredients., Stir until well mixed., Drop with teaspoon on cookie sheet., Let set until hardened., Store in container.

title: Butterscotch Bars
directions: Cream the oleo and 1 cup brown sugar. Add 1 beaten egg and mix well. Add the flour., Spread on jelly roll pan like pie crust. Beat 2 eggs and pour or brush evenly over crust., Sprinkle 1 cup brown sugar over entire crust. Sprinkle the pecans on top. Bake at 350° until set and brown.

title: Barbecue Brisket
directions: Pour liquid smoke over brisket; sprinkle both sides generously with celery, onion and garlic salts., Wrap brisket in heavy foil and refrigerate overnight.

title: Buttery Peas And Zucchini
directions: Cook peas according to package., Pour into serving bowl; cover and set aside.

title: Venison With Mushroom Gravy
directions: One 12 inch deep sided frying pan with lid., Place frying pan on stove, turn heat on medium., Pour in 1/3 cup olive oil while heating., Cut deer hearts up into 1 inch pieces., Add salt and pepper and flour., When oil is hot, place meat in pan and brown. Add one can of soup and 1/2 cup of water, stir., Place lid on pan, turn heat down to low and let simmer for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally., Goes well on mashed potatoes or rice.

title: Sweet Potato Pie
directions: Combine all ingredients; beat until fluffy., Pour into 2 pie shells., Bake at 325° until knife comes out clean.

title: Citrus Jello Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients and beat according to cake mix directions. Bake in a greased tube pan at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes., When done, take out of oven and glaze with a mixture of 1/4 cup powdered sugar and 1 cup of lemon or orange juice., Juice may be used without the sugar, particularly if you like a tart lemon flavor.

title: Apple Nut Cake
directions: Combine all ingredients; let set, then stir and bake at 350° for 45 minutes in an 8 x 8-inch pan.

title: Apple Salad
directions: Chop fruit, and mix to your taste.

title: Pumpkin Pie
directions: Mix eggs (well beaten), sugar, spices, salt and pumpkin., Add milk and stir until smooth., Pour into shell., Bake at 375° for 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Pie Crust
directions: Mix sugar, flour and salt., Cut in shortening., In another bowl mix water, egg and vinegar., Combine with sugar mixture. Divide into five parts.

title: Argentine Spinach Pie
directions: Have ready the pie shell and crust for top., Cook, drain and chop the spinach., Saute the onion in the oil until tender. Combine the spinach, sauteed onion, nutmeg, oregano, salt, beaten eggs and Swiss cheese., Pour into pie shell., Arrange top crust and seal., Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes., Serve hot in wedges.

title: Chris'S Manicotti
directions: Mix ingredients, saving 2 cups Mozzarella, cheese for topping.

title: Chocolate Frosting
directions: In small saucepan, combine sugar, oleo and milk., Boil, stirring constantly, 1 minute., Remove from heat and add chocolate chips., Mix until smooth., Cool and pour over 9 x 12-inch cake.

title: Cherry Cream Cheese Pie
directions: Let cheese stand at room temperature until soft., Beat until fluffy., Add sweetened condensed milk, stirring until well mixed; turn into crust., Chill 2 to 3 hours and top with cherry pie filling.

title: Coconut Pies
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Divide into two pie shells. Bake at 300° for 45 minutes.

title: Saucy Asparagus
directions: In 2-quart saucepan over medium heat, combine soup and milk. Heat to boiling, stirring often., Add asparagus., Cover; cook over low heat for 10 minutes or until asparagus is tender, stirring occasionally., Serve with grated Parmesan cheese, if desired. Makes 8 servings.

title: Potato Stuffing Bake
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Grease a 2-quart casserole dish., In large saucepan, heat water, margarine and salt to boiling., Remove from heat., Add milk to potato flakes and stir until well combined. Stir in 3 cups of croutons, celery, onion and hot pepper sauce. Spoon into prepared casserole dish., Crush remaining croutons and sprinkle around edges., Grate sharp Cheddar cheese and sprinkle around in middle., Bake for 35 to 40 minutes until light golden brown.

title: Meat Loaf
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Place in pan about 1/4 inch away from the edge of pan., Pour a little water around edge and bake at 400° for 45 minutes., To make gravy, add 1 can tomato soup to the meat juice and simmer on top of stove for 5 to 10 minutes.

title: S.O.S.
directions: Brown hamburger until done., Drain grease., Sprinkle about 3 tablespoons flour over the hamburger., Stir in until thick., Add enough milk to cover hamburger., Add salt and pepper to taste. Simmer until gravy is thick., Serve over toast.

title: Caramel Corn
directions: Combine brown sugar, butter, corn syrup and salt in 2-quart microproof batter bowl or measuring cup., Microcook on High 4 minutes, stirring after 2 minutes., Stir until blended., Add baking soda and vanilla., Place popped popcorn in large brown paper bag., Pour syrup over popcorn; roll top of bag tightly to close., Microcook on High 1 1/2 minutes., Shake bag; microcook on High 1 1/2 minutes., Shake bag; microcook on High 1 minute., Pour onto flat surface; spread out and allow to cool.

title: Mexican Quiche
directions: Line a 9-inch pie pan with chilies., Top, with cheese., Mix milk, chili juice and egg. Pour over cheese. Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes or until golden brown and bubbly., Cut into wedges. Serve hot.

title: Lemon Fluff
directions: Put can of milk in freezer until ice crystals form., Mix water in Jell-O and put in refrigerator until it begins to thicken. Whip milk until thick., Add lemon juice and sugar., Fold thickened Jell-O into whipped cream., Layer pan with vanilla wafers and pour Jell-O and cream mixture over., Garnish with wafer crumbs and chill.

title: Oven Fried Eggplant
directions: Spray 15 x 10 x 1-inch cookie sheet with Pam.

title: Yummy Potatoes
directions: Mix all ingredient together in a large bowl and put into a 9 x 13-inch ungreased pan.

title: Crab Delight Mold
directions: Dissolve gelatine in water., Heat soup and add dissolved gelatine., Add rest of the ingredients, mixing well., Rinse a 1-quart mold with cold water., Pour in mixture and refrigerate overnight.

title: Chocolate-Drizzled Peanut Bars
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Prepare Bar Cookie Crust (recipe in this book).

title: Mandarin Salad
directions: Combine first 5 ingredients in a jar., Shake well., Pour over lettuce and other ingredients in a large salad bowl., Toss and serve., Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Sweet And Sour Loaf
directions: Mix tomato sauce, sugar, vinegar and mustard until sugar dissolves., Mix egg, onion, cucumber, beef, salt (optional), pepper and 1/2 cup tomato sauce mixture., Shape in a loaf pan and pour the rest of the tomato sauce over the top., Preheat oven to 400° and bake for about 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Whole Wheat Dinner Muffins
directions: In a large bowl, mix all-purpose flour, whole wheat flour, wheat germ, baking powder and salt until blended., Make a well in center., In another bowl, lightly beat egg., Stir in butter, sugar and milk., Pour all at once into flour well and stir just until dry ingredients are evenly moistened., Spoon batter into greased 2 1/2-inch muffin cups, filling 2/3 full., Bake in a 350° oven until muffins are well browned and tops spring back when touched (about 25 minutes)., Makes 1 dozen.

title: Cranberry Fruit Nut Bread
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Generously grease and lightly flour a 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan., Prepare cranberries, nuts and orange peel. Set aside.

title: Tee'S Ranch Potatoes
directions: Cut potatoes into cubes and place in baking dish. Cut butter into pats and place on potatoes. Sprinkle packet of dry dressing mix on top. Bake for approximately 1 hour at 350° or until potatoes are tender. Stir occasionally.

title: Enchilada Casserole
directions: Heat enchilada sauce, water and tomato sauce in a frying pan. Brown meat with onions and garlic salt in another frying pan., Add egg, olives, salt and 1/2 cup sauce., In a large casserole dish, layer tortillas (dipped first in sauce) meat mixture and cheese. Pour remaining sauce into casserole and top with cheese., Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

title: Good Quickie Punch
directions: Freeze strawberry soda until slushy., Put yogurt ice cream into punch bowl and pour strawberry soda over it.

title: Fabulous Chocolate Cake
directions: Grease and flour 2 (8-inch) round cake pans., Combine chocolate, butter and water in top of double boiler and heat until melted; let cool., Sift flour, soda and salt into large bowl. Beat eggs with sour cream until blended in medium bowl., Beat in sugar and vanilla., Stir in cooled chocolate., Beat into flour half at a time, just until smooth., It will be thin., Pour evenly into pans., Bake in moderate oven (350°) for 40 minutes., Cool in pans.

title: Cherry Pie Cobbler
directions: Melt butter in a baking dish., Combine sugar, flour and milk. Beat until smooth., Pour over melted butter in a baking dish., Add fruit., Do not stir., Bake at about 400° for 30 minutes or until brown.

title: Turkey Casserole
directions: Saute onion and celery in 2 tablespoons of butter., Mix all ingredients., Save a little dressing mix to sprinkle on top., Put in baking dish., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Boil Cookies
directions: Mix first 5 ingredients in saucepan; bring to boil., Cook 1 minute., Add peanut butter and oatmeal., Stir good., Drop on wax paper by spoonfuls.

title: Lasagne
directions: Brown meat in oil., Add onion and garlic; cook until tender. Add tomato sauce and seasonings., Cover and simmer 20 minutes. Place half of noodles in bottom of, 11 x 9-inch baking dish. Spread with half of cottage cheese and Parmesan cheese over noodles., Top with half of the meat sauce., Repeat layers., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Swiss Steak
directions: Cut steak into pieces., Season flour with salt and pepper. Put meat in flour., Place onions in bottom of crock-pot., Add meat, top with carrots, celery and tomato sauce., Cook on low 6 to 8 hours or high 3 to 5 hours.

title: Beef And Bean Casserole
directions: Brown beef in skillet., Drain fat., Put beef in slow cooker. Brown bacon and onions., Drain fat., Mix all remaining ingredients together in slow cooker. Stir well., Cover and cook.

title: Ground Beef Casserole
directions: Brown ground beef, drain and mix with soup., Spread in bottom of pan., Layer cheese and Tater Tots., Cook at 350° until brown (30 minutes).

title: Shrimp Salad Mold
directions: Bring soup and water to boil., Dissolve gelatin into it over low heat., Stir in softened cream cheese until melted., Cook, adding the remaining ingredients., Pour into a greased mold. Refrigerate overnight., Unmold onto platter lined with lettuce.

title: Mom'S Scalloped Potatoes
directions: In a 13 x 9-inch baking dish, place a few slices of butter. Follow with a layer of potato slices, then layer of onions. Sprinkle with 4 tablespoons flour, salt and pepper, then several pats of butter., Repeat layer of potatoes, onions, flour, salt, pepper and butter., Add enough milk to cover the entire first layer., Cover with foil and cook 1 hour and 15 minutes., Remove foil and cook another 15 minutes., Bake at 350°.

title: Oven Fried Chicken
directions: Season all the chicken parts with salt and pepper as desired. Place the chicken in a large bowl and pour on enough flour to evenly coat all pieces. Pour the oil into a nonstick baking sheet to coat it. Place the chicken side by side on the sheet and place in the oven at 400°. Turn every 30 minutes until done.

title: Sausage Souffle
directions: Crumble and cook sausage; drain well., Mix with all other ingredients., Pour into 9 x 13-inch ungreased glass dish., Cook at 350° for 1 hour., This tastes best when covered and refrigerated overnight before cooking., A great breakfast dish!

title: Salisbury Steak
directions: Shape beef into patties., Dust with flour on both sides., Brown in large skillet until done., Add water (about 1/2 cup) and simmer until water becomes like gravy., Saute onion and bell pepper in about 1/2 stick butter and then add to beef and gravy., Ready to serve., Also good made with any steak cuts., Gravy is good over mashed potatoes.

title: Meat Loaf Roll
directions: Brown ground beef and drain off grease; add chopped pepper and onion also and let them get tender as beef browns., After draining off grease, add cheese soup and Worcestershire sauce.

title: Lo-Cal Brownies
directions: Stir all ingredients by hand until well blended. Turn into 8-inch square pan (Teflon-coated) or sprayed with Pam. Bake 30 minutes at 350°. Cut into squares while still warm.

title: Haystack And Chips
directions: On a large plate or platter layer each ingredient in order given., Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Snickerdoodles
directions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees., In a large bowl, beat sugar and butter on medium speed until well blended., Beat in egg and vanilla until light and fluffy., Add flour mixed with baking powder and salt and beat on low speed until stiff dough forms, scraping down side of bowl frequently with a rubber spatula., In a small bowl, stir together cinnamon and sugar., Drop spoonfuls of batter in the cinnamon sugar mixture., Cover completely and roll into a ball., Place cookies 2 inches apart on lightly greased baking sheets., Bake cookies 8 to 10 minutes or until flattened and firm in center., For a softer cookie, take out of oven when cookie is turning brown around the edges., Let cookies cool 2 minutes on sheets, then remove to racks and let cool completely. Makes about 36 cookies.

title: Jello Pound Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Pour into, a tube pan that is well-greased and floured., Bake at 300° for 25 to 30 minutes. Turn onto cake plate and cool.

title: Family Corn Puff
directions: Preheat oven to 325°., Grease a 1 1/2-quart casserole., Cook corn as directed on package and drain., Beat Bisquick, milk, eggs and salt until smooth., Stir in corn and cheese., Pour into dish; bake about 1 hour until puffed and golden., Serve immediately. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Cranberry Nut Pudding Pie
directions: Spread cranberries on bottom of buttered 9 inch pie plate. Sprinkle with brown sugar and nuts., Beat eggs until thick; gradually add granulated sugar, beating until thoroughly blended.

title: Caramel-Chocolate Chip Cake
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Grease and flour rectangular 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan., Beat all ingredients, except Caramel Fluff, in a large bowl on low speed 30 seconds, scraping bowl constantly., Beat on high speed 3 minutes, scraping bowl occasionally., Pour into pan. Bake until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean, 40 to 45 minutes., Cool completely., Frost with Caramel Fluff., Store in refrigerator.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
directions: Combine sweet potatoes, sugar, eggs, 1/2 cup butter, vanilla, cinnamon, brown sugar, pecans and milk in large bowl; mix well. Spoon into a 2-quart greased casserole., Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes or until bubbly., Cover with marshmallows., Bake until marshmallows are brown.

title: Hershey Pie
directions: Melt the bar and then mix in the Cool Whip., Pour into crust and cool in refrigerator for an hour.

title: Hot Dog Relish
directions: Grind vegetables coarse., Sprinkle with salt., Let stand overnight., Rinse and drain., Combine remaining ingredients; pour over vegetable mixture., Heat to just boiling and simmer 3 minutes., Seal in sterilized jars., Makes 8 pints.

title: French Onion Soup
directions: Peel and slice onions., Heat large soup pot., Melt butter and onion and cook over very low heat until light brown in color (15 to 20 minutes)., Add stock; cover and simmer for 20 to 30 minutes. Season to taste with salt and pepper., Pour into oven safe soup bowls., Sprinkle with croutons and cheese., Broil to melt cheese.

title: Strawberry Nut Bread
directions: Combine flour, salt, soda, cinnamon and sugar., Make a "well" in dry ingredients., Add oil and eggs, stirring only until dry ingredients are moistened., Stir in strawberries and nuts., Spoon batter into loaf pan and bake 1 hour or until done at 350°., Let stand overnight before slicing., I usually double the recipe and make 2 loaves or 3 mini loaves.

title: Cheese-Topped Zucchini
directions: Cut zucchini in half lengthwise., In a large skillet, cook onion in hot oil until tender, but not browned., Add zucchini halves, cut side up., Sprinkle with salt, pepper and oregano. Pour tomato sauce over., Cover., Cook just until tender, about 10 minutes., Top zucchini with Mozzarella cheese slices., Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.

title: Beef-Noodle-Cheese Casserole
directions: Brown meat and onion in butter; stir in tomato sauce., Remove from heat., Cook noodles in boiling salted water until almost tender; drain., Blend milk, cream cheese, sour cream, cottage cheese and green pepper into noodles., Alternate layers of noodle mixture with meat sauce in a 2-quart casserole, ending with meat sauce., Sprinkle cheese on top., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Creamy Fruit Salad
directions: Drain fruit, reserving liquid., Add water to syrup to make 1/2 cup total., Combine gelatin and boiling water in a blender., Cover and blend at low speed until it is dissolved, approximately 1 minute. Add measured liquid syrup, cream cheese and mayonnaise. Cover and blend on high speed about 15 seconds., Chill until slightly thickened., Fold in fruit cocktail. Spoon into a jello mold and chill about 2 hours., Unmold and garnish.

title: Chicken And Water Chestnut Casserole
directions: Set oven to 325°., Arrange chicken in single layer in greased baking dish., Mix soup, milk, mayonnaise and water chestnuts. Pour over chicken., Top with stuffing., Cover., Bake for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Fresh Strawberry Pie
directions: Cook until thick:, sugar, cornstarch and Sprite., Add the strawberry Jell-O., Cool., Fold in the sliced strawberries., Line baked pie shell with softened cream cheese., Pour strawberry mixture into pie shell., Chill about 4 hours., Garnish with cream. Serves 8.

title: Cream Puffs
directions: Bring water and margarine to boil; heat until margarine is melted., Add salt, then dump in flour all at once., Over medium heat, stir constantly as mixture cooks., It will be done when the mass forms around the spoon (about 1 minute)., Remove to mixing bowl., With beater at medium speed, beat in eggs, one at a time. Drop by spoonfuls onto greased cookie sheet., Bake at 400° for 10 minutes., Reduce heat to 350° and bake for 15 minutes longer. Turn off oven., Prick each puff with cake wire and leave in oven, heat off, for 30 minutes., Cool thoroughly before filling., Makes 2 1/2 to 3 dozen.

title: Edible Play Dough
directions: Mix all the ingredients together in, a, bowl., Knead, a little, then refrigerate until chilled., Place portions on wax paper., Roll or shape into objects desired.

title: Brenda'S Beefy Baked Beans
directions: Brown ground beef with onion and pepper., Add rest of ingredients., Let simmer until hot all the way through., Optional: Can bake in oven at 350°.

title: Dustin'S Cheese Straws
directions: Cream cheese and butter until very light in color., Sift dry ingredients together and add to cheese-butter mixture., Mix well. Put through a cookie/pastry press, making each piece about 5/8-inch wide in long strips., Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes. Cool on racks and then break into about 50 (2-inch) pieces., Store in airtight container.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
directions: Sift flour and spices together., Cream sugar and oil., Add eggs, one at a time, to sugar-oil mixture., Add vanilla. Alternately, add sifted dry ingredients and juice of cherries. Fold in cherries, apples and nuts., Bake in tube pan at 325° for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

title: Swedish Nuts
directions: Bake walnuts in oven at 325° for about 10 minutes or until light brown., Take out and cool., Beat egg whites with sugar. Beat very well., Mix the nuts into the egg whites.

title: Hawaiian Chicken
directions: Wash and dry chicken., Put in shallow baking dish, skin up. Simmer remaining ingredients for 5 minutes., Pour over chicken. Bake 1 hour at 350°.

title: Guinea Garbage
directions: Slice peppers and onions, then saute them in a large skillet with a little oil., Transfer when tender to a large pot., Add one can of tomato sauce and the spices listed., Let simmer after mixing well., Cook the sausages and drain the fat., Place whole sausages in the sauce and cover them well with the sauce., Taste sauce and spice accordingly., Serve on sub rolls.

title: Cheese And Eggplant Bake(Serves 4)
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Grease shallow pan., Cut eggplant 1/4-inch thick., Heat the oil in pan; put a layer of eggplant slices in skillet and saute 3 to 4 minutes on each side, turning once, until golden brown and drain on paper towels., Place layers of eggplant and cheese alternately in casserole dish with layer of cheese on top., Blend egg, canned tomatoes, onion, tomato paste and water until smooth., Season with salt and pepper; pour over eggplant and cheese., End with tomato slices on top., Bake, uncovered, for 25 minutes., Serve with French bread and salad.

title: Janice'S Pecan Pie
