title: Hamburger Noodle Casserole
directions: Cook hamburger and onion together; drain., Mix all ingredients together in pan where noodles are cooked., Pour in large deep round or square baking dish that has been greased., Put grated cheese on top and bake at 350° (or microwave) until cheese is melted and all ingredients are hot., (This will make 2 dishes full.)

title: Peanut Butter Delights
directions: Mix sugar, cocoa, butter, milk and salt in saucepan and bring to a rolling boil., Boil one minute, then remove from heat and add oats, peanut butter and vanilla., Blend well., Drop by teaspoon on waxed paper., Let stand until cool and firm; remove from paper. Ready to eat.

title: Pudding Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients and pour into well-greased and floured Bundt pan., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Hot-Sweet Mustard
directions: Combine mustard and vinegar., Refrigerate overnight., Next day, combine that with the sugar and eggs in a double boiler. Cook until thickened.

title: Chicken Broccoli Casserole
directions: Cook chicken breasts in water, about 45 minutes., Debone and cut into bite sized pieces., Layer chicken and thawed broccoli cuts in a Pyrex 9 x 13 x 2-inch casserole, mixing gently., In medium bowl, mix soup, mayonnaise and lemon juice., Spread on top of chicken and broccoli., Top with bread cubes and cheese., Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 45 minutes., May be frozen., Bake thawed.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole(From Barbara Deskins)
directions: Heat potatoes and pour off liquid., Add margarine, sugars and salt., Adjust amount of sugar to individual taste., Mash potatoes with mixer., Beat eggs and mix in potatoes., Add milk until consistency is similar to regular mashed potatoes., Add vanilla.

title: Pasta Salad Surprise
directions: Chill Veg-All thoroughly., Prepare macaroni according to package directions., Drain; combine macaroni, Veg-All, bacon and 1/2 can of onion rings., Add mayonnaise, 1/2 of the parsley and seasoned salt., Toss gently., Serve immediately or chill 1 to 2 hours.

title: Candied Walnuts
directions: Combine sugar, water and orange juice in saucepan and stir until blended., Cook slowly until small amount forms a ball in cold water., Remove from heat and add rest of ingredients., Make sure nuts are coated., Pour out on waxed paper or cookie sheet and separate with fork., Cool and store refrigerated in tightly covered containers.

title: Sunday'S Deer Steak
directions: Season, flour and dip in melted shortening or oleo. Lay on bread pan or cookie sheet. Place in 200° oven while at Sunday school or church (2 hours total). Turn oven to 350° to brown or place under broiler for a few minutes.

title: B'S New England Clam Chowder
directions: Wash and open the clams, reserving the liquid., In a large pot saute the bacon over low heat., When bacon is cooked through, remove the slices and reserve., Mince the clams and the onion. Saute the clams and the onion in the bacon fat in the pot., Add the thyme., Sprinkle flour into the mixture., Add clam juice, bay leaves, pepper (if you like) and the diced potatoes., Crumble and add the reserved bacon strips., Cook until potatoes are tender. Add milk, cream and butter., Do not let mixture boil at this point. Correct seasoning., Enjoy!, (Makes about 4 to 6 servings.)

title: Cream Cheese Icing
directions: Let cheese and butter soften to room temperature., Add vanilla. Sift sugar in mixture while beating with mixer., Sprinkle with chopped pecans and coconut.

title: Cheese Ball
directions: Mix and shape in ball. Chill in refrigerator 2 hours, then roll in the 1 1/2 cups chopped nuts.

title: Pumpkin Bread
directions: Mix ingredients as listed in order., Pour into 2 loaf pans. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Bolt And Nuts
directions: Melt butter and add sauces., Pour over mixed cereals and nuts in shallow pan, (9 x 13 x 2-inch) or larger., Sprinkle with seasoned salts., Bake in a slow oven at 300° for 30 minutes., Stir carefully every 10 minutes.

title: Breakfast Casserole
directions: Brown sausage., Tear up 4 slices of bread and place in a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish., Spoon sausage over bread. Sprinkle cheese over sausage., Beat eggs, milk, salt and pepper together., Pour over mixture in the dish., Bake in a 350° oven for 35 to 40 minutes., The cheese will rise to the top., This can be made the night before, refrigerated and baked the next morning. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Scalloped Chicken
directions: Mix all but cheese and chips., Put in casserole., Sprinkle cheese, then chips on top., Bake 1 hour at 350°.

title: Dough For Fried Pies
directions: Sift dry ingredients together., Cut in butter with knife or blender until it resembles coarse crumbs., Mix egg yolk and milk; stir in flour, adding only enough to hold the dough together. Shape into a ball., Wrap in wax paper and chill 1 hour., Roll out to 1/16-inch thick., Place 1 1/2 tablespoons filling in center and fold over., Moisten edges with cold water., Press with fork., Fry at 315° for 2 or 3 minutes on each side in hot oil.

title: Pork Jambalaya
directions: Season chops with salt and pepper., In a small lightly greased ovenproof skillet, brown chops on both sides., Remove chops; set aside., Pour off all but 2 teaspoons drippings., Add celery, scallions and green pepper., Saute until tender., Stir in rice, broth and seasonings., Bring to a boil., Return chops to pan. Cover; bake in 375° oven for about 30 minutes or until chops are tender., Fluff rice with fork., Makes 2 servings.

title: Dirt Cake
directions: Crush cookies into fine crumbs; set aside., Mix cream cheese, butter and sugar in separate bowl., Mix pudding and milk well. Combine the cheese mixture and pudding in large bowl., Add Cool Whip., In large pan or bowl, alternate layers of cookies and pudding, starting and ending with cookies., Refrigerate until served., Can be decorated with gummi worms or flowers and served with a trowel.

title: Tuna Fish With Rice
directions: Cook rice in double boiler., Add butter and salt., Mix lightly., Line well-oiled with rice., Pour tuna fish into rice mold., Cover with white sauce which has been combined with the egg., Bake in moderate oven (375°) for 30 minutes., Sprinkle with paprika., (If desired, minced beef, chicken or salmon may be used instead of tuna.)

title: Seven-Up Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 325°. Mix all ingredients and pour 1 1/2 cups batter per pan and bake for 15 minutes.

title: Cabbage Casserole
directions: Cook cabbage and celery in water for 8 minutes and drain., Add chopped onion.

title: Escalloped Potatoes
directions: Thaw potatoes, preheat oven to 350°., Combine all except corn flakes and 1/4 c. melted oleo., Place in 3 qt. casserole or large baking dish., Sprinkle buttered flakes over top and bake 45 minutes., Serves 10-12.

title: Hillbilly Apple Cake
directions: Mix all together and bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes., Time depends on the variety of apples used., Some are juicier so test cake with cake tester or toothpick until it tests done.

title: Crispy Nut Shortbread
directions: Heat oven to 300 degrees., Grease 13 x 9 inch baking pan., Beat margarine and sugar until fluffy; blend in egg and vanilla., Add meal, flour and nuts; mix well., Spread onto bottom of prepared pan., Bake 40 to 45 minutes or until edges are golden brown.

title: Tostada Dip
directions: Add or take away portions according to taste.

title: Old Settler Baked Beans
directions: Brown and drain hamburger, bacon and onion., Drain and mix other ingredients., Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan for 1 hour at 350°.

title: Whoppers Candy Milkshake
directions: Mix in blender and serve.

title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
directions: Cream butter and sugar., Add eggs one at a time, beating well. Add flour, soda and sour cream, alternately., Add vanilla. Bake in tube pan which has been greased and floured for 1 1/2 hours at 300°., Start checking baking time at 1 1/4 hours.

title: Chow Mein
directions: Brown meats in hot fat; add soy sauce and 1 cup water., Simmer 2 minutes., Add celery and onion; simmer 1 1/2 hours., Blend cornstarch and water; stir into meat mixture., Add chestnuts, bean sprouts and mushrooms; heat through., Season., Serve over cooked rice.

title: Shrimp Cocktail Rolls
directions: Combine first 6 ingredients., Add yeast., Let stand 5 minutes; mix well., Blend in flour, a little at a time, mixing thoroughly after each addition., Cover and let stand 10 minutes.

title: Thousand Island Dressing
directions: Combine all ingredients., Cover and chill at least 4 hours or overnight before serving., (On rubens, this dressing is great.)

title: Anise Cookies
directions: Cream eggs, sugar and oleo., Add soda, cream of tartar, oil and vanilla, then add flour., Make into big balls; chill 1 or 2 hours., Flour and cut out., Bake at 325° for 4 to 6 minutes.

title: Chicken Elegante
directions: Combine stuffing mix, water and 2 tablespoons butter., Let stand 5 minutes., Mix gravy, mushrooms and wine; set aside., In skillet/oven, lightly brown chicken in 2 tablespoons butter in skillet., Place in baking pan; top each piece with stuffing, broccoli and gravy mixture., Cover and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: E-Z Dinner Muffins
directions: Mix ingredients together in a bowl., Grease muffin pans well. Spoon into pans., Bake at 350° to 375° for 8 to 10 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Chocolate Marvel Pie
directions: Melt and blend the chocolate chips, sugar and milk., Cool. Separate the eggs., Beat the egg whites., Beat in, one at a time, the egg yolks, then the vanilla or rum flavoring., Fold in the beaten egg whites., Pour into pie crust., Refrigerate., Serve with Cool Whip.

title: Italian Beef Casserole
directions: Brown, meat, and, mushroom, pieces., Drain, excess oil. Cook broccoli as directed on package; drain., Add all ingredients except, cheese and mix well., Put thin layer in casserole dish, 9 x, 13-inch., Sprinkle with half of both cheeses., Add remaining mixture, and, sprinkle again with remaining cheese. Bake at, 350° for, 30, minutes, if using immediately., If for future use,, cover tightly, with, foil wrap before baking and freeze.

title: Italian Scallops
directions: Combine olive oil, butter and garlic., Coat scallops with mixture and let marinate 1 to 4 hours at room temperature., In a large skillet, heat 1 inch of oil to 350°., Bread scallops and fry in oil, about 2 minutes on each side., Place on paper towels. Serve with lemon wedges and cocktail sauce for dipping., Use as main course or an appetizer.

title: C.Y.M.  Brownies
directions: Hey kids, this is so easy to make and Mom usually has all the ingredients in the kitchen, except the cocoa, so buy some cocoa and enjoy brownies for a long time.

title: Broccoli Salad
directions: Mix first 3 ingredients and toss., Pour Ranch dressing over and toss again., Pour warm bacon drippings over and toss., Refrigerate for 1 hour and serve.

title: German Chocolate Pie
directions: Melt chocolate with margarine over low heat., Remove. Gradually blend in milk., Mix sugar, cornstarch and salt together; add beaten eggs and vanilla to dry mixture., Blend into chocolate mixture., Pour into unbaked 10-inch pie shell., Mix the coconut and pecans; sprinkle over top., Bake at 375° for 45 minutes or until top is puffed., Filling will be soft but will set while cooling., Cool 4 hours before serving.

title: Easy Oven Meatballs
directions: Place in greased or Pammed 13 x 9-inch metal baking pan. Preheat oven to 400°., In large bowl, combine bread crumbs, onion, turkey, spinach, salt, pepper and egg., Shape into 16 meatballs. Place in greased or Pammed 13 x 9-inch metal baking pan., Bake about 25 minutes until meatballs are lightly browned and cooked thoroughly., Heat pasta sauce., Add cooked meatballs and simmer 10 minutes to blend flavor., Serve over rice or spaghetti.

title: Swedish Roasted Potatoes
directions: Slash potatoes into thick slices, but do not cut all the way through., Add seasoning to hot water and pour over potatoes. Baste while cooking., About 15 minutes before removing from the oven, drain off most of the broth and thicken slighlty with flour. Pour over potatoes., Sprinkle with grated cheese., Bake in oven at 300° for 2 to 2 1/2 hours.

title: Ricotta Pie
directions: Mix first 4 ingredients with a mixer on low for 2 minutes. Add eggs, milk and extracts and mix 1 more minute., Pour into pie shell and bake at 450° for 15 minutes, then at 325° for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Fried Chicken
directions: You will need 1 large iron skillet.

title: Rice Krispies Treats
directions: Melt margarine in a large saucepan over low heat., Add marshmallows and stir until melted., Remove from heat., Add Rice Krispies cereal, stir well until coated.

title: Honey Baked Chicken
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., In a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan, melt the butter., Add honey, mustard and curry powder and mix well. Coat both sides of chicken pieces with the honey mixture as you place them in the pan, skin side down., Bake for 1/2 hour on each side, basting occasionally., Serve with rice.

title: 3 Cheese Lasagna
directions: Brown beef and set aside., Boil lasagna noodles and set aside. Layer ingredients one by one into buttered cake pan until all ingredients are used., Bake at 400° for 45 to 55 minutes.

title: Jam Cake
directions: Measure soda and buttermilk into quart size bowl., Beat together "until it sounds thick.", Stir in blackberry jam and molasses., Set aside., Cream butter, adding sugar and beating until light and fluffy., Add egg yolks one at a time, beating well after each., Have ready the 1 cup of flour sifted with spices., Add this cup of flour and spices., Add blackberry jam mixture., Mix well. Add 2 cups of flour gradually., Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites. Blend well., Last of all, fold in raisins, cherries and nuts floured in remaining 1/2 cup of flour., Stir just to mix evenly. Pour into 10-inch tube pan lined with wax paper and lightly greased., Spread evenly on the top., Bake in low oven (300°) for 1 hour., Reduce heat to 275° and continue baking (without peeking!) another hour., Turn on cake rack to cool., Test for doneness before turning.

title: Kentucky Fried Chicken
directions: *Combine pancake mix with paprika, sage and black pepper.

title: Ground Beef Casserole
directions: *You must use one of these to get the true flavor of this casserole.

title: Chocolate Zucchini Cake
directions: In a large bowl, cream the butter with the sugar., Beat in the eggs., Add the melted chocolate, vanilla, grated orange rind and the milk., Stir in the grated zucchini.

title: Skillet Beef Stew
directions: In saucepan, cook noodles and drain., In medium bowl, combine soy sauce, catsup, cornstarch and 1/2 teaspoon of salt., Add flank steak to mix and stir until covered., In skillet over medium-high heat, add 2 teaspoons of oil and cook carrots and onions until crisp and lightly browned., Remove to another bowl., In same skillet over high heat, add 2 more teaspoons of oil., Cook mushrooms until tender and liquid evaporates., Remove to bowl with carrots and onions., Add steak to oil with mixture., Cook about 5 minutes., Stir in veggies and 1/2 cup of water; heat through. Stir occasionally., Serve over noodles.

title: Veal Parmigiana
directions: Cut veal into serving pieces., Cook onion and garlic in 3 tablespoons olive oil for 5 minutes., Add tomatoes, salt and pepper; simmer, uncovered, for 10 minutes., Add tomato sauce and oregano., Simmer 20 minutes longer., Combine crumbs and 1/4 cup of grated cheese., Dip veal into egg, then into crumbs., Brown in 3 tablespoons olive oil in skillet.

title: Strawberries And Cream
directions: Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water., Add frozen strawberries. Stir occasionally until thawed., Add crushed pineapple and bananas which have been diced., Pour 1/2 of mixture into a large glass bowl., Chill until firm., Decorate with cream, if desired.

title: Orange Julius
directions: Fill blender with water, juice, malt and sugar; blend together., Serves 4.

title: Baked Cornbread Dressing
directions: Bake Homestead Yellow Cornbread (see recipe in this cookbook), crumble when cool in a 2-quart bowl., Lightly brown onions and celery in margarine or butter., Add eggs, pepper and poultry seasoning to the crumbled cornbread., Add the onions and celery. Add chicken or turkey stock., Stir and pour into a well-greased pan (6 or 8-inch square)., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or browned to your liking.

title: Chili Beans
directions: In skillet, cook meat, stirring until brown., Discard excess fat., Add 1/2 cup onion., Stir in remaining ingredients., Cover and simmer about 20 minutes., Stir occasionally.

title: Corn Pudding
directions: Mix flour, sugar, baking powder and salt., Beat eggs one at a time and pour into ingredients., Add milk, vanilla, melted margarine and corn; mix well., Pour into baking dish and bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Poppy Seed Bundt Pound Cake
directions: Bake in greased (not floured) pan at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes. Cool 10 to 15 minutes., Turn out of pan and glaze with 1 cup 10x sugar and 3 tablespoons lemon juice., Do this while cake is still warm.

title: Picante Chicken
directions: Sprinkle chicken breasts with salt; set aside., Cook onion and garlic in oil in 10-inch skillet 2 minutes., Add chicken broth and salsa., Bring to boil., Stir in rice., Arrange chicken breasts over rice., Cover tightly and simmer 20 minutes., Remove from heat., Let stand, covered, until all liquid is absorbed, about 5 minutes. Garnish with tomato, avocado and cheese., Serve with tortilla chips or soft flour tortillas.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Put 1 teaspoon soda in 1/4 cup hot water., Add cinnamon, allspice and vanilla., Mix well., Nuts or raisins may be added. Bake at 350° for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Walnut Waffles
directions: Combine eggs, milk and vanilla., In separate bowl, combine dry ingredients., Add wet ingredients to dry., Add melted butter. Whisk until batter is smooth, but do not overmix., Nuts can be added at this point, or sprinkled on waffle prior to cooking. Cook waffles until golden brown., Top with whipped cream and grated walnuts, if desired.

title: Blueberry Salad
directions: Dissolve the jello in 1 cup boiling water. Add 2 1/2 cups cold water. Add blueberries and pineapple., Let jello set.

title: Almond Chicken
directions: Remove bones and skin from chicken., Pound flat with heavy pan; cut in half., Arrange slice of cheese and ham on each piece of chicken., Fold short sides over filling; roll up lengthwise. Secure with wooden toothpicks., Dust with flour; dip into beaten egg., Coat with crumbs., Arrange rolls on microwave tray or baking dish; dot with butter., Cover lightly with waxed paper., Microwave on High for 4 minutes., Uncover; microwave 2 minutes more or until chicken is tender., Season to taste with salt and pepper., Serves 4.

title: Shrimp Cocktail
directions: Peel shrimp., Mix together shrimp, tomato, onion, garlic, and jalapeno., Stir in olive oil and parsley; season to taste with salt and pepper., Top with sliced avocado., Serves 4.

title: Taco Soup
directions: In a large saucepan, brown beef and onion; drain., Add corn, tomatoes, kidney beans, tomato sauce and taco seasoning., Cover and simmer for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally., Serve with corn chips, cheese and/or sour cream, if desired., Yield 4 to 6 servings (1 1/2 quarts).

title: Veal Chops Parmesan
directions: Season the chops to taste with salt, pepper and garlic., Put bread crumbs and cheese in one bowl., In another bowl, put eggs, milk and salt.

title: Onion Dip
directions: Mix all ingredients well. Bake at 350° until brown on top (approximately 20 to 25 minutes). Serve with Club crackers.

title: Chocolate Bar
directions: Mix all ingredients and spread on waxed paper., Freeze., Can be divided into small servings., A good snack.

title: Oriental Vegetable Soup
directions: In a pot, combine vegetables, garlic and ginger., Saute 10 minutes in 1/2 cup broth., Add all the rest of the ingredients. Simmer 1 minute.

title: Chicken Enchilada Casserole
directions: Spread buttered tortillas in bottom of 13 x 9 x 2-inch dish. Spread all of chicken over tortillas., Sprinkle half of cheese over chicken., In a saucepan, put onions, chilies, oleo, soup and milk. Simmer 10 minutes., Pour over chicken layers., Add another layer of tortillas and rest of cheese., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or cover and freeze for later.

title: Sausage Cheese Balls
directions: Melt cheese in top of double boiler., Mix all ingredients thoroughly; roll into small balls., May be frozen at this point or baked at 375° until lightly browned.

title: Peanut Brittle
directions: Grease 2 (15 1/2 x 12-inch) baking sheets., Keep warm., Put sugar, syrup and water in a 3-quart casserole., Cook in microwave oven on Full Power for 8 to 10 minutes or until soft ball stage. Stir occasionally while cooking., Stir in peanuts., Cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until hard ball stage., Stir in butter and soda. Pour half of candy on each sheet, spreading to 1/4-inch thick. Cool., Break into pieces., Store in airtight container.

title: Chicken And Rice
directions: In large roasting pan with lid, mix onion soup mix, mushroom soup, milk, and hot water together. Add rice, mix well. Lay chicken pieces on top of liquid mixture. Cut butter over top. Cover pan. Cook at 350° for 1 1/2 -2 hours. Rice should be soft, some liquid. Don't cook too long or rice will be dry. Start checking for doneness after 1 1/2 hours.

title: Apple Streusel Pie
directions: Place apples in pie shell and sprinkle with cinnamon., Cream 4 tablespoons of butter, sugar and eggs; add salt, vanilla flavor and cream cheese until just smooth., Pour over apples., Combine brown sugar, flour, 4 tablespoons butter and pecans., Crumble this mixture on top of pie., Bake at 375° for 45 minutes., Reduce heat to 350° and continue to bake for 15 minutes.

title: Apple Pumpkin Dessert
directions: Heat oven to 400°. Spoon apple filling into 8 to 10 custard cups.

title: Lemon-Frosted Gingerbread Cookies
directions: Combine flour, baking soda, ginger, cinnamon, cloves and salt. In another bowl, mix margarine, egg, molasses, vinegar and milk until smooth., Add dry ingredients to this mixture, beating well. Cover., Chill 1 1/2 hours.

title: Crunchy Cauliflower Salad
directions: Wash and break cauliflower into flowerets., Combine with next 3 ingredients in medium mixing bowl., Toss gently., Stir together remaining ingredients and pour over vegetables., Stir well., Spoon into serving bowl., Cover and chill.

title: Pacific Salmon With Roasted Garlic
directions: Separate garlic into cloves and peel. Place in small ramekin and cover with olive oil. Wrap with foil. Bake at 400° for 30 minutes. Place garlic and 1 tablespoon of oil from baked garlic in food processor. Add butter and puree; season with salt and fresh ground pepper.

title: Fagioli
directions: Rinse and pick over beans., Place beans and water in, a stock pot; bring to a boil., Reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes., Cover and let sit one hour., Return to heat and simmer 1 hour longer. Drain, reserving 2 cups liquid., Set aside., Brown meat, onions, garlic, carrots and green pepper in the pot., Add tomatoes, tomato sauce and seasonings., Return beans and reserved liquid to the pot., Cook 1 hour., Add cooked macaroni and a splash of wine. Serves a crowd and freezes well.

title: Savory Green Beans
directions: Combine vinegar, salt, pepper and dill weed., Combine bacon, onion and remaining combined ingredients and pour over beans in 2-quart casserole dish., Bake at 350° for 1 hour or microwave until done.

title: Italian Zucchini Soup
directions: In a Dutch oven, brown sausage with onion; drain excess fat. Add the celery, green pepper, sugar, salt, basil, oregano, pepper and tomatoes., Cover and simmer 1/2 hour., Add zucchini; simmer 1/2 hour or more., Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese, if desired. Yield: 2 quarts.

title: Party Salad
directions: Prepare cherry Jell-O according to package directions and let congeal., Combine Eagle Brand milk and Cool Whip., Refrigerate 1 hour., Add remaining ingredients along with Jell-O (cut into small pieces)., Toss to mix well and refrigerate overnight.

title: Strawberry Cheese Cake Squares(Great For Christmas Or Valentine'S Day)
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., In a, 13 x 9-inch pan, combine graham cracker crumbs and margarine., Press into bottom and up sides of pan. Bake 10 minutes. Set aside., In medium bowl with electric mixer on medium speed, beat pudding mix, cheese, dry milk, sugar, vanilla and 1 1/2 cups water until blended., Pour over crust.

title: Creamy Fruit Salad
directions: In a large bowl, combine fruit cocktail, bananas, apples, grapes, cherries and marshmallows., Fold in whipped cream; refrigerate., Just before serving, garnish with strawberries.

title: Congealed Applesauce Salad
directions: Heat applesauce; add cherry jello and cool., Add ginger ale and orange juice., Congeal.

title: Old Fashioned Barbecue Ribs
directions: Brown ribs in iron skillet., Mix ketchup, water, brown sugar, vinegar and onion., Pour over ribs in baking dish., Cover and bake 1 1/2 hours at 350°.

title: Bean Dip
directions: Brown hamburger and drain., Add catsup, chili powder and beans., Cover with grated cheese and onions last., Bake at 300° for 20 to 30 minutes., Delicious with taco chips!

title: Natural Room Freshener
directions: Place cinnamon in a large pot with water and orange rind. Bring to a boil., Reduce heat and let simmer., The combination of cinnamon and orange will fragrance every room in your home., It will smell clean, fresh and delicious.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Melt margarine in heavy skillet; saute celery and onion until tender., Pour into greased casserole., Dribble soup over., Add cheese and rice; stir in salt and cooked broccoli., Bake, uncovered, in a 350° oven for about an hour.

title: I Can'T Believe It'S A Cookie
directions: Roll tablespoon of dough in a ball., Dip fork in sugar and press to flatten cookie., Bake at 350° until light brown.

title: Eggplant Chutney
directions: Peel and chop eggplant., Core and chop apples., Finely chop onions., Put the pickling spice in cheesecloth., Put all ingredients in pan, except sugar, and simmer for 30 to 40 minutes. Add sugar and simmer until thick and lustrous.

title: Green Bean Casserole
directions: Mix first 7 ingredients. Put in Pam sprayed casserole and top with shredded cheese. Bake at 350° until it bubbles., Remove from oven and spread French fried onions on top., Bake 15 minutes more.

title: Beef Stick
directions: Mix well and form into 2 rolls., Chill overnight., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Jello Salad
directions: Mix Jell-O and pineapple and bring to a boil., Add marshmallows, stir and cool for a few minutes., Add sour cream and nuts., Fold in Cool Whip., Add sugar if needed., Pour into Jell-O mold and chill.

title: German Slaw
directions: Alternate a layer of cabbage with a layer of onions., Put 7/8 cup sugar on top., Bring remaining ingredients to a boil for 2 to 3 minutes., Pour over cabbage and cool completely., Refrigerate. Next day, stir and repeat for 3 days., Can also be eaten immediately.

title: Hanky Pankys
directions: Brown meat in large skillet; season with garlic salt and Worcestershire sauce., Make sure meat is in a crumbly texture. After meat is cooked, place chunks of cheese on top and cover pan with lid., Simmer on low until the cheese melts and stir mixture thoroughly., Spoon meat mixture on party rye slices and serve warm.

title: Green Bean Casserole
directions: Add all ingredients together except onions using only 1/2 of these now., Bake in casserole dish at 350° for 1/2 hour, then add remaining 1/2 of onions on top., Don't stir., Bake until onions are crunchy, about another 5 minutes.

title: Forgotten Cookies
directions: Beat egg whites until foamy., Gradually add sugar and beat until stiff., Add pinch of salt and vanilla., Add red or green food coloring if you like., Fold in pecans, cereal and coconut. You may use corn flakes or miniature chocolate chips if desired.

title: Chicken Pot Pie Casserole
directions: Mix together margarine, flour and milk., Set aside. Combine all other ingredients. Pour into 3-quart casserole dish., Pour first mixture on top for crust. Bake at 375° for 1 hour or until crust is brown.

title: Toasted And Seasoned Pecans
directions: Heap pecans in middle of cookie sheet., Pour melted butter or margarine over pecans and sprinkle onion salt or powdered on pecans., Mix this mixture around with a fork or spoon and spread to all corners., May want to add regular salt to taste., Bake at 200° for about 1/2 hour., Turn with spatula every 15 minutes. Bake until lightly toasted., Delicious!

title: Hot Dog Stew
directions: In stew pot filled 1/2 with water, put in peeled whole potatoes, carrots and whole peeled onions., Add salt and pepper to water and taste., When potatoes and other vegetables are almost cooked, add frankfurters and simmer for 15 to 20 minutes., Serve with French or Italian bread., Serves 4 to 5.

title: Rice And Broccoli Casserole
directions: Heat one large chopped onion with frozen broccoli and oleo until onion is tender and broccoli is thawed (you can put in 1/2 cup of celery with onion, if desired)., Add milk, Cheez Whiz and cream of chicken soup., Bring to a boil., Measure 1 cup of regular rice, before it is cooked, and cook as directed., Mix cooked rice and broccoli mixture together., Put in a casserole pan and bake at 375° until bubbly hot.

title: Chicken Biscuit Pie
directions: Heat oven to 450°., Stir soup; add water., Slowly blend in chicken, peas and pimento., Put in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan., Top with biscuits., Bake at 450° for 15 to 20 minutes., Serves 6.

title: Hobo Vegetables
directions: Cut 4 pieces of foil. To each piece, add 1 carrot, 1 onion, 1 potato and 1 tbsp. butter; salt & pepper to taste. Wrap snugly and seal. Bake on a cookie dish at 350 degrees for 45 60 minutes or until done.

title: Kool-Aid Frosty Winter Fizz
directions: Mix soft drink mix with water., Add ice cream., Stir until melted., Just before serving, pour in carbonated beverage., Makes 32 servings, 1/2 cup each.

title: Candied Sweet Potatoes
directions: Cut potatoes in serving size., Put in pan and almost cover with water., Add remaining ingredients., Cook until tender, but not soft., Place in a baking pan., Slice 1 medium size orange thin; add to syrup., Cook until syrup drops heavy off spoon., Pour over potatoes., Bake 20 to 25 minutes at 350°.

title: Agnes Party Rolls
directions: Melt first 5 ingredients together., Split dinner rolls and spread on both sides., Place a slice of ham and cheese in each roll., Heat until cheese melts.

title: Curried Shrimp Dip
directions: Mix in blender or food processor and add more mayonnaise if necessary.

title: Easy Ice Cream
directions: In a pint-sized Ziploc bag, put milk, sugar and vanilla in bag. Mix well.

title: Peaches And Cream Pie
directions: Combine first 9 ingredients., Pour into 9-inch pie plate. Drain peaches and arrange on top of crust mixture leaving 1/2-inch between the sides., Combine cream cheese, peach juice, sugar and vanilla and spread on top of peaches., Sprinkle with cinnamon. Bake at 300°, for 30 to 45 minutes., Cool and enjoy.

title: Meat Loaf(For 50 People)
directions: Mix well and pack firmly into greased loaf pans, 3/4 full. You will need 3 loaf pans, about 12 x 4-inch. Bake in moderate oven for 1 hour.

title: Hot Fudge Pudding Cake(No Fat)
directions: Combine 3/4 cup sugar, flour, 3 tablespoons cocoa and baking powder., Blend in milk, applesauce and vanilla., Beat until smooth. Pour into an 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan., In small bowl, combine remaining sugar, brown sugar and 4 tablespoons cocoa., Sprinkle evenly over batter., Pour hot water over top., Do not stir., Bake 40 minutes at 350°.

title: Chicken Fried Steak And Milk Gravy
directions: Season meat with salt, and, pepper in shallow dish with flour and 1 teaspoon, pepper., Dredge, steak in flour., Dip in eggs, and then back in flour again.

title: Broccoli And Rice Casserole
directions: Saute celery and onions in butter., Cook broccoli and rice as directed on package., Combine remainder of ingredients., Stir in broccoli., Sprinkle paprika on top., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: German Chocolate Coconut Pecan Topping
directions: In a medium saucepan, combine sugar, evaporated milk, beaten egg yolks and shortening., Cook and stir over medium heat until mixture comes to a boil., Remove from heat., Stir in vanilla, coconut and pecans., Cool 15 minutes., Spread only between layers and on top of cake.

title: Chicken Nuggets
directions: Remove skin from chicken and cut chicken into 1-inch strips. Mix flour, salt and pepper., Lightly coat chicken strips with flour mixture., Melt butter in a frying pan over medium heat., Add chicken and cook on both sides until browned, about 8 to 10 minutes., Serve with mild salsa, meatless spaghetti sauce or plain yogurt mixed with green onions.

title: Poppy Seed Cake
directions: Dust well-greased Bundt pan with first 2 ingredients., Mix together cake mix, pudding and poppy seed., Beat in remaining ingredients., Pour into prepared Bundt pan and bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes until toothpick comes out clean.

title: Shrimp De Jonghe
directions: To melted butter, add garlic, parsley, paprika, cayenne and cooking sherry; mix well., Add bread crumbs., Place shrimp in a 11 x 7-inch baking dish., Spoon butter mixture over., Bake at 325° for 20 to 25 minutes., Sprinkle with chopped parsley before serving.

title: Pear And Gorgonzola Salad
directions: Puree berries in blender., Strain through a sieve to remove seeds., Whisk the puree together with syrup, vinegar, mustard, tarragon, sugar and sour cream., Chill.

title: Layered Mexican Casserole
directions: Brown ground chuck, then add seasonings and finish cooking. Put small amount picante sauce in bottom of 9 x 12-inch baking pan., Line with flour shells., Cover with refried beans and thin layer of picante sauce., Layer shells, then ground chuck, then shells, then cheese (save shredded cheese for top) and picante sauce, then shells., Cover with picante sauce and shredded cheese. Bake at 350° for 35 minutes or until melted and sauce is bubbling.

title: Creamy Salmon Spread
directions: In medium bowl, combine all ingredients; blend well., Spoon into crock or small bowl. Cover; refrigerate until firm., Serve with assorted crackers.

title: Easy Chicken Pie
directions: Boil chicken., Debone and cut or tear into small pieces., Add soup and broth, salt and pepper (pre-mixed) to chicken and add eggs., Toss until chicken is coated., Pour into buttered casserole.

title: Fingerpaint
directions: Thoroughly dissolve cornstarch in water., Stir constantly while cooking over medium heat until mixture comes to a boil, loses whiteness and starts to thicken., Lower heat and continue stirring about 2 minutes until mixture is very thick and smooth. Let cool slightly., Color by stirring in powdered or liquid tempera or food coloring., Leftover can be stored in a covered jar in the refrigerator.

title: Savory Mushrooms
directions: Bring bouillon to a boil., Add washed wild rice; cover and simmer for 1 hour., Remove from heat., Saute mushroom caps in butter., Mix rice, almonds, herbs and spices and fill mushroom caps., Drizzle with fresh lemon juice., Bake on cookie sheet at 300° for 15 minutes., May easily be prepared a day prior to re-heating.

title: Lemon Broccoli
directions: Trim off large, leaves of broccoli and remove tough ends of lower stalks. Wash broccoli thoroughly and cut into spears. Arrange spears in a vegetable steamer over boiling water. Cook and stem for about 5 minutes or until crisp-tender. Drain. Transfer to a serving platter. Sprinkle with grated lemon rind, salt and pepper. Garnish with lemon rind curls, if desired.

title: Jewish Gradnies(Chicken Soup)
directions: Pull skin off necks, remove backs.

title: Sourdough Bread #3
directions: For best results, use unbleached flour., Scald milk and stir in butter; cool to lukewarm., Add yeast and stir until dissolved., Add this to the basic batter from Sourdough Bread #2., Add 2 cups flour; mix well., Blend sugar, salt and soda; sprinkle over top of dough and stir in gently., Cover bowl and set in warm spot., Let rise for 30 minutes., Stir down; add remaining flour until too stiff to stir with spoon., Turn out on floured board and knead, adding flour as required until dough is smooth and satiny., Better too wet then dry., Divide in half; place in greased bread pans and butter tops., Bake for 20 minutes at 425°, then 40 minutes at 325°.

title: Apple Puff Pancakes
directions: Preheat oven to 425°., Melt 1 tablespoon butter in a skillet. Add brown sugar and apples; stir to coat., Cook over medium-low heat for about 1 minute, stirring occasionally., Remove from heat; set aside., Melt 4 tablespoons butter in a 10-inch ovenproof skillet, tilting pan to coat the sides., Whisk milk, flour, eggs and cinnamon in a medium bowl., Pour into skillet; cook for 1 minute., Place into oven; bake until puffed and golden, 12 to 15 minutes., Sprinkle with powdered sugar; serve immediately.

title: Barbecue Chicken Sauce
directions: Combine all ingredients in a saucepan and cook over low flame for about 10 minutes. Stir.

title: Dishpan Cookies
directions: Mix sugar, brown sugar, eggs, cooking oil and vanilla., Add plain flour, baking soda, salt, nuts, dates or raisins, cornflakes, rolled oats and coconut., Mix well and drop on greased cookie sheet., Cook at 325° until done.

title: California Seafood Brunch Bake
directions: Saute mushrooms in butter in skillet over low heat for 8 minutes, remove from heat., Stir in crabmeat, green onions and cheese., Layer bread cubes and seafood mixture, half at a time, in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish, pressing down layers., Whisk eggs and remaining ingredients in bowl., Pour over layers., Chill, covered, for 4 hours or overnight., Bake at 350° for 40 to 50 minutes or until set., Yield: 12 servings.

title: Easy Cheese Cake
directions: Combine ingredients in mixer except for crust., Beat eggs in one at a time., Pour into unbaked pie crust., Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350°., Chill and serve with your favorite fruit topping.

title: Savory Snack Mix
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Mix popcorn, cereal, peanuts and pretzel sticks in an ungreased rectangular pan (13 x 9 x 2-inch)., Heat margarine over low heat until melted., Remove from heat, stir in remaining ingredients., Pour over cereal mixture and mix until well coated., Bake 15 minutes, stirring twice., Turn into a bowl and cool., Store loosely covered., Makes about 9 cups of snack, 300 calories per cup.

title: Strawberry Dessert
directions: Crumble cake into 9 x 13 x 2-inch dish., Mix sugar, cream cheese and 1 carton of whipped topping., Spoon over crumbled cake. Spread strawberries over mixture., Spread glaze over strawberries., Top with remaining carton of whipped topping., Keep refrigerated until ready to serve.

title: Macaroni And Ham Salad
directions: Cook rotini according to package directions; drain., Cool. Rinse with cold water to cool quickly; drain well., Combine cooled rotini with remaining ingredients and toss lightly., Chill.

title: Edna'S Punch
directions: Mix tea base, pineapple and orange juices together., Chill in freezer for several hours until ice crystals form., Stir every 2 - 3 hours., When ready to serve, pour into punch bowl, add ginger ale., May be chilled in refrigerator and served over ice., Makes 2 1/2 - 3 gallons.

title: Pineapple Casserole
directions: Combine drained pineapple with other ingredients, cutting margarine in small pieces and stirring in., Sprinkle crushed Ritz crackers about 1/2-inch thick over mixture., Bake in 350° oven about 40 minutes.

title: Creole Sauce
directions: Heat butter or oleo in saucepan., Toss in vegetables and cook, stirring frequently, until onions are limp., Add and stir in soup, 1/2 cup of water and drained mushrooms, pimento, parsley and salt. Cook until heated through.

title: Sourdough Starter
directions: Bread:, In a large bowl make a stiff batter of ingredients. Grease large bowl; put in dough, grease or Pam spray top of dough. Cover with waxed paper., Let rise 12 hours., Punch dough down. Divide in 3 parts., Knead each part on floured pastry sheet a few times (8 to 10)., Put into 3 loaf pans or into rolls., Grease pans and brush top of dough with oil., Let rise 4 to 5 hours., Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes; rolls for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Zucchini Chocolate Cake
directions: Mix ingredients in order, excluding the nuts and chocolate chips., Pour into well greased 9 x 13-inch pan., Sprinkle nuts and chips over top of the batter., Bake 40 to 45 minutes at 350°.

title: Crab Quiche
directions: Combine eggs, half and half, onion, salt and cayenne pepper. Blend until smooth., Drain crabmeat on paper towels until very dry., Sprinkle crab, mushrooms and cheese over bottom of pie shell., Pour in egg mixture and top with chopped parsley., Bake at 425° for 15 minutes., Reduce heat to 300° and bake for 30 minutes. Let stand 15 minutes before serving., Serves 8 to 10.

title: Hot Chocolate Mix
directions: Mix all ingredients together. Store in airtight container.

title: Onion Bake Fish
directions: Mix sour cream, mayo and dressing mix., Dip both sides of fish into this sauce., Crush onions and coat fish with crushed onions. Place in baking dish and bake at 350° until fish flakes with fork, about 15 to 20 minutes., Serves 6 to 8.

title: Chicken, Cheese And Rice Bake
directions: Cook chicken and rice., In a large casserole dish, layer chicken, rice and cheese., Bake for 20 minutes at 350° or until cheese melts.

title: Sweet Corn Pudding
directions: Mix all ingredients together in a square baking dish., Cover and bake at 350° for 45 minutes., Stir occasionally., Bake until moist but not dry., Makes 8 servings.

title: Mexican Lasagna
directions: Brown meat, celery and onion; drain., Add tomatoes and chillies, sauce, olives, salt and pepper., Simmer, uncovered, for 10 minutes; stir occasionally., Break up shells or chips; set aside., Mix cheeses and egg., Spread 1/3 of meat mixture on bottom of 12 x 7 1/2 x 2-inch pan., Top with 1/2 of cheese mixture, then 1/2 of the chips., Repeat layers, ending with meat., Top with chips, either broken or whole., Bake, uncovered, in 350° oven for 30 minutes., Let stand 5 minutes before serving., Serves 4 to 5 people.

title: Mexican Cornbread
directions: Mix cornmeal, corn and eggs., Pour half into 2-quart baking dish., Add uncooked sausage evenly on top., Put cheese evenly on top., Add rest of cornmeal to this., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Pumpkin Bread
directions: Mix all ingredients together, except raisins and pecans. Blend well., Then add pecans and raisins., Fill well-greased and floured 1 pound coffee cans to 1/2 full., Bake 1 hour at 350°. Makes 4 cans.

title: Sweet Potato Souffle
directions: Boil sweet potatoes until tender., Peel and mash well., Add sugar, melted margarine, coconuts, pecans and spices., Mix well. Spray 9 x 13-inch baking dish with Pam., Pour mixture in dish. Top with marshmallows., Bake 5 to 6 minutes at 250° or until marshmallows are brown.

title: Layer Cookies
directions: Melt butter in pan to be cooked in, approximately 12 x 8 x 2-inch., Add graham cracker crumbs, coconut, chocolate and butterscotch chips and nuts., Drizzle condensed milk over top of all., Bake in 350° oven for 25 minutes., Cut into squares., Makes approximately 24 squares.

title: Punch Bowl Dessert
directions: In a punch bowl, layer the following twice., Makes a good colorful dessert.

title: Baked Celery Casserole
directions: Cook celery for 8 minutes in small amount of salted water; drain., Mix with all remaining above ingredients., Pour into a 1-quart rectangular baking dish, buttered.

title: Confetti Rice
directions: In a large skillet, dry saute the onions and green pepper until tender., Add corn, oregano, paprika, pimento and cook 1 to 2 minutes., Add rice, peas and soy sauce and heat through., Serve hot or cold.

title: Mandarin Pork Chops
directions: In a large skillet, brown chops in oil on both sides., Remove from skillet., In the skillet, add remaining ingredients, except orange segments and green pepper., Cook and stir until slightly thickened., Add chops; cover and simmer for about 20 minutes or until tender., Add orange segments and green pepper., Simmer a few minutes until thoroughly heated., Serves 4.

title: Spicy Steamed Clams
directions: In a heavy saucepan, cook the garlic, pepper flakes and oregano in the oil over moderately low heat, stirring, for 1 minute., Add the onion and fennel; cook the mixture over moderate heat, stirring, until the fennel is softened., Add the tomatoes with the reserved juice, wine and salt and pepper to taste; simmer the mixture, uncovered, stirring occasionally, for 5 minutes., Add the clams; steam them, covered, for 5 to 7 minutes, or until they have opened., Discard any unopened ones.

title: Gingerbread On The Coals
directions: Cut tops from oranges., Remove fruit from shells., Save for fruit salad., Mix gingerbread mix and water., Place batter in orange cups and carefully set cups upright in hot coals., Cook about 12 minutes or until tops of cakes lose their sheen., Remove from coals and cool slightly., Top with small dab of oleo and eat with a spoon.

title: Lemon Cake Icing
directions: Cook all ingredients, except butter, until thick in a pot on low heat., Add butter and beat., Makes enough icing to ice 5 thin layers of cake., Ice first layer and beat icing., Ice each additional layer and beat icing each time., Allow icing to air dry on cake before covering cake.

title: Chicken Spaghetti
directions: Boil chicken., Saute onions in butter and add tomatoes and soup., Season with garlic, salt and pepper., Cook noodles., Mix all in baking dish., Top with Cheddar cheese., Bake at 350° until cheese melts.

title: Meat Loaf
directions: Mix all together., Shape into 2 loaves., Bake at 350° for 60 minutes.

title: Butterscotch Bars
directions: Melt peanut butter and chips in double boiler., Add cereal and pour in square pan., Cool and cut in squares.

title: Mushroom-Bacon Stuffing
directions: Cook bacon until crisp., Drain., Crumble into bowls., Pour off all but 1/4 cup bacon drippings., Add melted margarine, mushrooms, celery, onion, sage, marjoram, salt and pepper., Saute 10 minutes until veggies are tender., Remove from heat., Add bread crumbs, broth and vegetable mixture., Toss well., Spread in a large greased baking dish., Bake 1/2 hour to 45 minutes at 375°.

title: Icebox Pickles
directions: Combine sugar, vinegar, spices and salt; let boil., Pour over cucumbers and onions., Cool; place in refrigerator., Ready to eat in 4 days.

title: Peanut Butter Cup Cookies
directions: Cut cookie roll in 8 equal slices., Cut each slice in fourths. Bake 8 to 9 minutes at 375°., Immediately put a miniature peanut butter cup in middle.

title: Corn Soup
directions: Blend corn, milk, salt and pepper on high 4 minutes., Add margarine and heat to desired temperature.

title: Ground Beef-Filled Squash
directions: Cut squash in half lengthwise; remove seeds., Place cut sides down in baking pan; add 1/4-inch boiling water to pan., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until almost tender., Saute ground beef until crumbly., Add stuffing mix, parsley, salt, onion, pepper and bouillon; toss lightly to combine., Turn squash, cut sides up. Fill with beef mixture; return to oven and bake for 20 or 30 minutes longer., Saute mushrooms in butter; arrange over stuffed squash.

title: Lemonade
directions: Pour over ice cubes in 12 ounce glass., Fill glass with water and serve.

title: Punch
directions: Dissolve Kool-Aid and sugar in water., Add fruit juice and chill., Just before serving, add ginger ale., Serves 25.

title: Cheese Puffs
directions: Lightly butter bread slices and cut in fourths (square)., Take squares and form buttered side in small tart pans., Fill with mixture of remaining ingredients and bake at 350° for 20 minutes. Freezes well.

title: Halloween Bread(A Spook Brings This To Us)
directions: Combine and mix well the sugar, brown sugar, pumpkin, salad oil and eggs., Sift together and add flour, soda, salt, nutmeg, cinnamon and ginger., Stir in water., Add pecans and raisins., Mix well and spoon into greased and floured loaf pan., Bake in preheated 350° oven for 1 hour or until toothpick inserted comes out clean., When done, turn out on a rack to cool., Yields 1 loaf.

title: Chocolate Chip Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Grease and flour a 10-inch tube pan.

title: Icebox Rolls
directions: Scald milk; cool to lukewarm. Combine sugar and potatoes in a large mixing bowl; mix well. Add milk and shortening., Stir in yeast. Sift 6 cups flour, salt, baking powder and soda. Stir into yeast mixture. Cover dough; let rise for 2 hours.

title: Macaroni Salad
directions: Cook and drain macaroni., In a large bowl, stir together last 6 ingredients until smooth., Add other ingredients and toss to coat well., Cover and chill.

title: Marinated Vegetable Salad
directions: Combine all vegetables in large bowl and toss lightly., Combine remaining ingredients in a medium saucepan, bring to boil over low heat, stirring gently to blend and dissolved sugar., Pour cooled vinegar mixture over vegetables, cover and chill for 24 hours. Serve and enjoy., Serves 6-8 people.

title: Red Beans And Rice
directions: Soak beans overnight., Drain., Cook beans and hambone in water slowly for three hours., Add all ingredients except seasoned salt. Cook slowly for 1 1/2 hours., Add seasoned salt to taste., Serves 8., Serve over rice.

title: Homestead Garden'S Holiday Mulled Cider
directions: Bring to a boil to dissolve sugar., Simmer 15 minutes or put in crock-pot on low.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
directions: Cook milk and sugar until it forms a soft ball in cold water. Remove from heat and add remaining ingredients., Stir well, then pour into buttered pan(s)., When cool, cut into 2-inch squares and serve.

title: Orange Balls
directions: Mix crushed vanilla wafers, powdered sugar and pecans., Add melted butter and thawed orange juice. Mix well., Roll into small balls. Roll in finely grated coconut., Store in refrigerator overnight., These freeze well., Makes about 5 dozen.

title: Texas Pecan Cake
directions: Cream butter and sugar., Add beaten egg yolks and flavoring. Roll nuts and fruit in 3/4 cup flour; mix remainder of flour in batter., Add fruit and mixture into batter., Beat egg whites until stiff; fold into batter (mix with hands)., Bake in greased Bundt pan at 300° for 1 1/2 to 2 hours., Turn out of pan when completely cool.

title: Barbecue Wieners
directions: Cut wieners in 1-inch pieces., Chop onion and brown in large skillet., Add tomatoes (broken into smaller pieces) and wiener pieces., Season with garlic powder, salt and pepper to taste., Let simmer until wieners plump up (5 to 7 minutes).

title: Zucchini Bread
directions: Mix dry ingredients with liquid., Bake for 1 hour.

title: Scripture Cake
directions: Combine as any other cake mixture., Bake in moderate (350°) oven for approximately 1 hour., Where different ingredients are mentioned in the same verse, use common cooking sense., King James or Revised Standard contains the best terminology for translation of modern ingredients.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Combine broccoli, soup, eggs, onion, mayonnaise, salt and pepper in casserole dish., Combine melted margarine with croutons. Cover broccoli mix., Spread cheese over top., Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes., Let stand 15 minutes before serving.

title: Mexican Cornbread
directions: Mix dry ingredients; add eggs, oil and sour cream., Stir until blended., Stir in corn., Add chilies., Pour 1/2 of batter into greased 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan., Cover with 1/2 cup grated cheese. Repeat with remaining batter and cheese., Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Buttermilk Rolls
directions: Stir yeast into warm water., Hold aside., Heat buttermilk, margarine, salt and sugar (works great in microwave!)., Cool to lukewarm., Stir in 1 cup flour that has the soda and baking powder added., Beat well.

title: Sandy'S Potatoes
directions: Mix all ingredients and put in a 9 x 13-inch pan., Melt 1 stick of margarine and mix with crushed cornflakes., Put mixture on top of casserole., Bake for 1 hour at 350°., Will freeze, thaw and cook.

title: Easy Chicken Divan
directions: Steam broccoli until you can pierce with fork, cut into bite-size pieces, and cover bottom of medium casserole dish. Parboil chicken, about 8 minutes., Cut into cubes, layer on top of broccoli., Combine mayonnaise, soup and cheese, spread over chicken., Cook at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Onion Dressing
directions: Mix dry ingredients and dissolve with vinegar., Add onion juice or grated onion., Then add salad oil slowly and blend with rotary beater.

title: Chicken Corn Soup
directions: Stew chicken; reserve broth., Remove meat from bones., Discard skin and chop into small pieces., Cook celery until tender., Add all ingredients to broth; simmer for 15 to 20 minutes., Yields 5 servings.

title: No Bake Cheese Cake
directions: Let cream cheese get to room temperature., Whip together cream cheese and condensed milk., Add vanilla and lemon juice., Pour into pie shell and refrigerate at least 2 hours., Just before serving, add pie filling to top of pie and serve.

title: Blueberry Torte
directions: Mix the graham cracker crumbs, sugar and butter., Use mixture to line a 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Brownies
directions: Mix together., Bake until done at 350°.

title: 2-Step Vegetable Soup
directions: Drain liquid from all vegetables except tomatoes. Combine all ingredients in large pot. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer 3 minutes. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Serve with crackers or warm bread.

title: Million Dollar Pie
directions: Drain fruit; mix Eagle Brand milk, Cool Whip and lemon juice. Fold fruit into mixture., Pour into 2 graham cracker pie crusts. Refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Aunt Mickie'S Fruit Delight
directions: Drain juice from all the fruit and mix sour cream and coconut together., Chill for a couple of hours before serving.

title: Delicious Cake
directions: Combine all ingredients with electric mixer. Pour into prepared 9 X 13 pan and bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Chicken Divine
directions: Arrange broccoli in baking dish; place chicken on top. Combine soup, mayonnaise, lemon juice and curry powder and pour over chicken., Sprinkle with cheese., Combine butter and bread crumbs and sprinkle over all., Bake at 350°, for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Frozen Cranberry Salad
directions: Let cream cheese come to room temperature., Add sugar, salad dressing and whipped cream., Blend all together., Mix together cranberry sauce, well drained, crushed pineapple, marshmallows and pecans., Add to cream cheese mixture., Place in a Pyrex dish and freeze.

title: Easy Pudding Cake
directions: In large bowl, mix together pie filling, flour, salt, baking soda, sugar and chopped nuts., Beat together eggs, oil and vanilla., Add to first mixture and beat well with a spoon., Bake in a greased 13 x 9-inch pan at 350° for 40 to 50 minutes.

title: Cornbread Dressing
directions: Melt butter and lightly saute onions and celery in pan., Add to bread crumb mixture, which has been crumbled in bowl., Add other ingredients and mix well with hands or large spoon., Spoon into shallow pans and press., Bake at 400° for about 20 or 25 minutes., Serves 8., Serve with turkey, hen or duck.

title: Nigerian African Stew
directions: Cut meat into small cubes and place in pot of water 2 inches above meat., Next add all ingredients, except tomatoes, tomato paste, tomato sauce, tomato puree and spinach., When meat is almost cooked, add tomatoes, tomato paste, puree and tomato sauce as well as spinach., (Cooking time is approximately 1 hour.) Serve over cooked white rice., Serves 10 to 12.

title: Egg Rolls
directions: Cook and drain meat. Place in large bowl., Add remaining ingredients., Can use 1/2 package slaw mix instead of cabbage. Mix together and follow directions on wraps to rolls.

title: Pie Crust
directions: In large bowl sift together flour, sugar, and salt., Cut in shortening with a pastry blender until crumbly., In a small bowl beat water, vinegar and egg., Add to flour., Cover bowl and chill at least 1/2 an hour before rolling., This can be kept in the refrigerator for a week.

title: Party Rye Pizzas(Great For Snacks Or A Party!!)
directions: Brown ground beef and sausage until done., Drain; add seasonings., Combine with melted Velveeta cheese and spread on party rye bread., Top with Mozzarella cheese and bake on cookie sheet for 10 minutes at 400°.

title: Carmen'S Crab Spread
directions: Chop onions, tops and all, finely., Add to soft cream cheese with remainder of ingredients., Use fork to flake crab and mix well., Can shape into a log roll in foil., Refrigerate until firm and flavors blend., Put in middle of platter and arrange favorite fancy crackers around when ready to serve.

title: Blue Cheese Dressing
directions: Whip the cream., Crumble in Blue cheese., Fold cream and Blue cheese into mayonnaise., Add lemon juice., Refrigerate for 2 hours., Yields 2 cups., Thin with 1 to 2 tablespoons of milk to use the next day.

title: Whitney'S Delight
directions: Make 1 envelope of Lipton soup over medium heat., When soup is ready, turn off and add rice., Cook bacon and drain., Saute celery., Mix rice, celery and bacon in casserole dish., Top rice with cheese., Bake until cheese melts., Enjoy!

title: Sausage Quiche
directions: Punch holes in pie shell and bake before pouring mixture. Preheat oven to 375°., Fully cook sausage; add cheese, onion and flour., Beat eggs, milk and parsley flakes., Slowly pour over sausage mixture in pie shell., Bake on cookie sheet for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Hawaiian Holiday Punch
directions: Combine all ingredients in punch bowl. Serves 14.

title: Brunch For A Bunch
directions: Cook sausage in skillet until brown, stirring to crumble. Drain., Place hash browns in lightly greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish., Sprinkle with salt., Layer with sausage, cheese and green peppers., Combine eggs and milk, stirring well., Pour over green peppers., Bake at 350° for about 50 minutes., Serves 12 to 15.

title: Cornbread
directions: Combine all ingredients and bake in 8 1/2 x 13-inch greased pan at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Chicken And Dumplings
directions: Mix baking powder, 1/2 teaspoon salt and 2 cups flour., Add shortening and ice water., May need to add a little flour., Roll on floured surface very thin., Cut into strips about 1 x 3-inches. Cut up chicken and add to 1 quart of water., Add salt and pepper and half an onion., Boil until done (if you like, you may debone chicken, but not necessary)., Lay dumplings on top of broth very gently., Simmer slowly., Move them around with a fork in the juice., Heat milk and pour into pot slowly., Cook approximately 45 minutes or until dumplings are done.

title: Marinated Veggies
directions: Add any type of vegetables that you like; let it set for 24 hours., You can continue to add veggies as they are eaten., Will keep about 2 weeks in the refrigerator.

title: Chicken Perlo
directions: Boil chicken and sausage., Add spices together until tender. Debone chicken., Cut sausage and chicken into small pieces., Mix rice with broth., Put ingredients together and bring to a boil. Cut on low heat, cover tightly, 20 minutes., Then cut burner off and wait until rice has softened, about 15 minutes.

title: Snowball Salad
directions: Combine all ingredients and pour into a 13 x 9-inch pan. Cover tightly and freeze., Remove from freezer 30 minutes before serving., Can be used as salad or dessert.

title: Cabbage Salad
directions: In a small bowl, mix together oil, vinegar, sugar, salt, pepper and chicken flavor packet from Ramen noodles and set aside. Chop head of cabbage and slice onions., Put in a large bowl. Crush Ramen noodles and add to cabbage.

title: Tuna Casserole
directions: Place 6 slices of toast in an oblong pan., Mix together tuna, onion, mayonnaise and noodles., Spread over toast in dish., Cover with slices of American cheese., Put rest of toast (6) on top. Mix soup, milk and salt; pour onto center of toast within 2 inches of sides., Cook, uncovered, in 350° oven for 30 minutes or until bubbly.

title: The Scripture Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients together to create divine fruitcake., Bake at 325° for approximately 1 hour and 15 minutes., Bake in 10 x 4-inch tube pan.

title: Anise Christmas Cookies
directions: This eye-catching and mouth-watering treat uses a mix of several sliced fruits (except apples) such as plums, kiwi, bananas, strawberries, etc., and/or whole small berries or cherries, grapes, etc., The fruits are not cooked.

title: Appetizer Pastry(Tart Shell)
directions: Cut chilled butter into 1/2-inch slices., In a medium bowl, combine flour and salt., Use a pastry blender to cut in butter slices until mixture resembles oatmeal; set aside.

title: Parsley-Basil Clam Sauce
directions: Saute garlic in butter and oil 3 minutes or until soft., Stir in clams and liquid clam juice, parsley, basil and pepper., Simmer 5 minutes., Spoon clam sauce over hot spaghetti or linguini. Makes 3 cups.

title: Fresh Strawberry Pie
directions: In medium saucepan, combine sugar and cornstarch., Add the water and lemon juice., Over high heat, bring to a boil., Reduce heat., Cook and stir until slightly thickened and clear (4 to 5 minutes)., Add gelatin., Stir until dissolved., Cool to room temperature., Stir in strawberries., Pour into baked shell. Chill 4 to 6, hours., Serve with whipped cream.

title: Pam'S Bars
directions: Combine first 6 ingredients in bowl., Cut in butter until crumbly., Add eggs., Spread in greased 13 x 9-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 8 minutes., Remove., Top with chips., Pour milk over; sprinkle with coconut., Bake for 20 minutes more., Melt 1/2 cup chocolate chips and shortening., Drizzle over top.

title: Prime Rib Roast
directions: Pat optional ingredients into meat., Place roast, fat side up, in baking pan., Add water., Bake at 375° for 1 hour., Do not open oven door., You can do this in the morning., Then, before serving, cook at 375° for 30 minutes rare, 45 minutes for medium or 1 hour for well done., Cook uncovered., Serves 6.

title: Party Mix
directions: Combine cereal, crackers, pretzels, dressing and dill weed; stir well., Sprinkle oil over it and stir well., Pour in paper bag and let sit for 2 hours, shaking occasionally.

title: Crab Meat Appetizers
directions: Spread cream cheese on 9-inch dinner plate., Add cocktail sauce on top and sprinkle crab meat on top., Chill., Spread on crackers.

title: Spinach Balls
directions: Mix all ingredients, and make balls.

title: Artichoke Squares
directions: Drain 1 jar artichoke hearts and use juice to saute onion and garlic., Chop hearts and add to sauteed mixture., Beat eggs in bowl; add bread crumbs, salt, pepper, oregano, Tabasco sauce and parsley., Add sauteed mixture., Mix well and add cheese., Bake at 325° in a 7 x 11-inch baking dish for 30 minutes.

title: Jalapeno Cornbread
directions: Mix all ingredients together well. Bake at 400° for about 35 minutes or until done.

title: Zucchini Jam
directions: Cook zucchini 10 to 15 minutes., Remove from heat and stir in jello., After jello is dissolved, pour into jars and seal or put in freezer.

title: Creamy Hash Browns(Crock-Pot)
directions: Place potatoes in an ungreased 5-quart slow cooker. In a bowl, combine the remaining ingredients. Pour over potatoes and mix well. Cover and cook on low for 4 to 5 hours or until potatoes are tender and heated through. Yield: 14 servings.

title: Tomato Aspic
directions: Dissolve jello in boiling water., Add the rest of the ingredients; mix well and pour into a lightly greased mold.

title: Tiramisu(Sugar-Free)
directions: Pour 1/2 cup of milk into blender container., Add cream cheese; cover., Blend until smooth., Blend in the remaining 1 cup milk., Dissolve coffee in water; add to blender with brandy., Add pudding mix; cover., Blend until smooth, scraping down sides. Pour into large bowl., Gently stir in whipped topping., Cut ladyfingers in half crosswise., Cover bottom of 8-inch spring-form pan with ladyfingers halves., Place remaining halves, cut ends down, around sides of pan., Spoon pudding mixture into pan., Chill until firm, about 3 hours., Remove side of pan., Sprinkle with grated chocolate., Serves 12.

title: Pretzels Dipped In Dark Or White Chocolate
directions: Melt chocolate over hot water in a double boiler., Dip pretzels until fully covered., Let excess chocolate drip back into pot., Cool on waxed paper., Store in refrigerator or freezer. Makes about 40.

title: Miniature Fruit Strawberries
directions: In blender grind nuts and coconut., Mix all ingredients together., Place in refrigerator 3 to 4 hours to harden., Mold into strawberry., Shape by hand., Roll in fine red sugar., Dip ends in green sugar to form stems, or small pieces of almonds dyed green can be stuck on end as stem., Use 2 per strawberry., Yields 50 or more., Store in airtight container in refrigerator or can be frozen.

title: Cherry Chip Cake
directions: Combine all ingredients., Beat for 1 to 1 1/2 minutes., Pour into tube pan lined with wax paper., Cook for approximately 1 hour at 350°., Leave in pan., Cool a little., Punch full of holes with fork.

title: Homemade Dinner Rolls
directions: Dissolve yeast in warm water., Beat eggs in large mixing bowl. Add sugar, yeast and oil., Mix well., Add 6 cups of flour, salt and scalded milk alternately., Beat until satiny looking., Let rise until double in bulk., Turn onto bread board with 2 cups flour and knead., Roll and cut into biscuits., Brush with melted butter., Bake 8 to 10 minutes at 375°.

title: New Zealand Panlova
directions: Beat egg whites, water and salt until stiff., Add 3/4 cup of sugar and beat again., Into remaining 1/4 cup of sugar add cornstarch., Add this to egg mixture and beat some more., Keep beating until mixture looks marshmallowy, then add vanilla and beat into mixture., Spray Pam on baking sheet., Cut a piece of waxed paper to fit and place in baking sheet., Spray waxed paper with Pam., Pour egg white mixture on the waxed paper., Put in oven at ???° for 5 minutes., Reduce heat to ???° and bake for 1 hour., Do not open oven door., Turn off heat and allow to set for 1/2 hour.

title: Tropical Fruit Ice Cream
directions: *Or can use fresh medium sized soursop (extract with 1 1/2 cups water; 3 or 4 large mangos (blend pulp); or 2 large coconuts (extract with 2 cups water in blender).

title: Zesty Cheese Ball
directions: Grate cheese., Add olives and remaining ingredients., Mix well. Cover bowl and chill thoroughly., Shape chilled mixture into ball. Roll in parsley or nuts.

title: Peach Cobbler
directions: Presweeten fruit with 1 cup sugar and 1/4 cup flour., Put in baking dish., Mix all other ingredients together., Pour over fruit., Bake at 350° until golden brown., Use an 8 x 12-inch glass baking dish.

title: Broccoli Cauliflower Salad
directions: Toss, chill and serve.

title: Banana Split Dessert
directions: Combine crumbs and 1/2 cup butter, melted., Press in 9 x 13 pan., Chill., In small mixing bowl, combine eggs, 1/2 cup butter and powdered sugar., Beat on high speed about 5 minutes until thick and creamy., Spread on chilled crust., Arrange sliced bananas, slightly overlapping, to cover creamed mixture., Spread well drained pineapple over bananas., Top with Cool Whip. Sprinkle with nuts and cherries., Cover and refrigerate 10 to 12 hours.

title: Butter Pecan Dessert
directions: Crush Ritz crackers. Melt butter and mix with crumbs in a 13 x 9 pan.

title: Pineapple Cheese Ball
directions: Mix all ingredients except nuts thoroughly., Form into ball. Place in refrigerator to chill and become firm., Take out and roll in pecans., Keep refrigerated.

title: Sausage Pinwheels
directions: Cut margarine into flour until mixture resembles coarse crumbs., Add buttermilk and stir until dough clings together. Knead dough 10 to 12 strokes on lightly floured surface., Roll out to a 16 x 12-inch rectangle., Sprinkle sausage evenly atop dough. Roll up (jelly roll) style, starting from long side., Slice into 1-inch slices., Place cut side down on ungreased baking sheet. Bake at 450°, for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Chocolate Drops(Soft Cookies)
directions: Cream shortening, sugar and egg., Sift flour, baking powder and salt., Add milk alternately with dry ingredients to egg mixture., Add cocoa and mix well., Add vanilla, maple flavoring and nuts., Drop by teaspoonfuls on greased pans., Bake at 400° for 10 minutes.

title: Raisin Cookies
directions: Cook 5 minutes and cool the first 3 ingredients., Mix shortening, sugar, eggs and vanilla., Sift dry ingredients - add to sugar mixture., Mix well, then add raisin mixture and stir. Drop on greased baking sheet and bake for 9-10 minutes at 350°.

title: Pineapple Cake
directions: Cook cake mix as directed, but in 3 cake pans., Stir 3/4 cup sugar and crushed pineapple together., Set aside., In a large bowl, mix sour cream and 1 3/4 cup sugar until blended., Add Cool Whip and set aside., When cake layers are cool, spoon pineapple mixture over each layer, letting juice soak into cake., Top with sour cream mixture., Continue with each layer.

title: Salami
directions: Combine all ingredients in a large mixing bowl and mix thoroughly with your hand., Shape into 3 (10-inch) logs., Wrap in plastic wrap and refrigerator for 24 hours., This step is mandatory.

title: Easy Italian Pasta Casserole
directions: Cook macaroni., Mix in casserole with chopped onion and spaghetti sauce., Top with Cashew Cheese and sprinkle with sesame seed., Bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Bean Soup
directions: Wash beans., Add salt., Add water and soak overnight., Drain the beans., Add 2 quarts of water and ham hocks., Bring to a boil. Simmer 2 1/2 to 3 hours., Add onion, tomatoes, chili powder, lemon juice, salt, pepper and garlic powder., Simmer another 30 minutes.

title: Lemon Vinaigrette
directions: Puree lemon juice and garlic in food processor., With machine running, gradually add olive oil and blend until smooth., Add Parmesan cheese, blend until thickened., Season with salt and pepper.

title: Peach Cobbler
directions: Preheat oven to 450°., Cover the bottom of 2-quart deep pie dish or casserole with pie crust., Cover sides also if you wish more crust., Place peaches in mixing bowl., Mix sugar and flour. Add water and mix well., Pour over peaches., Mix lightly and pour into pie dish., Sprinkle a bit of cinnamon and nutmeg over top of peaches and dot with butter., Make a lattice of pie crust across top of pan and bake 10 minutes., Now cool oven to 350° and bake about 40 minutes longer.

title: Pecan Pie
directions: Mix all ingredients well, except nuts., Spread nuts in unbaked pie shells and divide batter between pie shells., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Hello Dollies
directions: Crumble graham crackers., Mix with all ingredients., Spoon tablespoons of batter onto cookie sheet., Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

title: Butter Crust
directions: Mix flour and, salt, in, pie, pan., Add milk and butter mixture., Work out to sides of pan with fingers., Bake at 350° until brown., This is good for cream pies.

title: Scuppernong Pie
directions: Beat eggs slightly., Add sugar, flour and butter to eggs and beat until well mixed., Stir in grapes and sugar in which they were canned., Pour into 9-inch pie shell., Cover with top crust, also., Bake 10 minutes at 425°., Reduce heat to 375° and continue baking for 35 minutes.

title: Pineapple Fluff
directions: Mix all ingredients and refrigerate., Very good and low-fat!

title: Icebox Fruit Cake
directions: Snip dates, figs and marshmallows with scissors., When scissors get sticky, dip them in powdered sugar., Add nuts, salt and cherries., Mix in 1 1/2 cups cracker crumbs., Add cream and mix well., Line a deep 9-inch round pan with waxed paper., Shape mixture into a round cake and coat with remaining crumbs., Press firmly into pan; cover with waxed paper., Chill overnight., Turn out and pull off waxed paper.

title: Seafoam Lime Mold
directions: Dissolve lime jello in boiling water., Add cold water and lemon juice., Gradually add to cream cheese and blend., Chill until almost firm., Fold in marshmallows, pineapple and nuts. Pour into one-quart mold., Chill until firm.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Cook broccoli and drain., Place in casserole baking dish., Add mushroom soup., Crush enough Ritz crackers over top to cover., Pour over crackers the melted butter (may use less)., Top with cheese slices or Cheez Whiz., Place in moderate oven until cheese melts.

title: Cappuccino Coffee Mix
directions: Mix together., To serve, use 2 teaspoons mix to a cup of boiling water., Excellent gift.

title: Un-Apple Pie
directions: Peel and seed zucchini., Cut into lengthwise strips and slice like you would an apple., Cover with water and boil two minutes. Drain and set aside to cool., Mix remaining ingredients together and stir gently through zucchini., Pour into a 9-inch unbaked pie crust and cover with top crust., Bake at 400° for 10 minutes. Lower heat to 350° for 20 minutes or until brown., Tastes just like an apple pie!

title: Banana Bread
directions: Cream together shortening and sugar., Combine flour, baking soda and salt in separate bowl., Mix all ingredients and put in greased loaf pan., Bake 1 hour at 325° to 350°.

title: Banana Cake
directions: Combine all ingredients and mix well., Pour into a 9x13x2 inch baking pan that has been greased and lightly floured on bottom only., Bake at 350 degrees for 30 to 35 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean when inserted into center of cake., As soon as cake comes from oven, add topping and broil as directed.

title: Glazed Acorn Squash
directions: Place squash in shallow baking dish., Combine remaining ingredients., Pour over squash; cover., Bake in a 350! oven for 30 minutes until almost tender., Baste several times with pan juices during baking., Uncover; baste., Bake for 10 to 15 minutes longer until squash is tender.

title: Dirt Pie
directions: Grind cookies fine., Mix all other ingredients., Beat with mixer until thick.

title: Golden Shrimp Rice
directions: Saute vegetables in margarine until tender., Add shrimp and cook until shrimp turns pink., Add rice, water, salt and pepper to taste., When it comes to a boil, turn to simmer., Cover and cook until rice is done, about 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Apple Streusel Muffins
directions: Prepare muffin mix according to package directions; fold in apple. Fill greased muffin cups 3/4 full. In a small bowl, combine the walnuts, flour, brown sugar and butter; sprinkle over batter.

title: Oreo Trifle
directions: Crumble Oreos until they are like potting soil. Cream margarine, cream cheese, confectioners sugar and vanilla. Mix pudding and milk. Mix pudding mixture with cream cheese mixture. When thick, fold in Cool Whip. Layer in trifle bowl, cookies first, then filling, until there are 4 layers of cookie and 3 layers of filling. Refrigerate 4 hours. Can be frozen.

title: Marinated Pork Party Sandwiches
directions: Combine first 6 ingredients; cover and chill at least 8 hours.(Mayonnaise mixture), Trim fat from tenderloins., Place tenderloins in a large heavy-duty, zip-top plastic bag., Combine oil and next 6 ingredients; pour over tenderloins., Seal bag; marinate in refrigerator 8 hours, turning bag occasionally., Remove tenderloins from marinade, reserving marinade., Place tenderloins on a rack in a shallow roasting pan., Insert meat thermometer into thickest portion of 1 tenderloin., Bake at 425° for 10 minutes. Reduce heat to 350° and bake an additional 30 minutes or until meat thermometer registers 160°, basting occasionally with marinade. Let stand 10 minutes., Cut tenderloins into 1/4 inch slices and arrange on a serving platter lined with kale leaves, if desired. Serve with mayonnaise mixture and cocktail rolls.

title: Chicken In Golden Sauce
directions: Combine flour, pepper and salt., Dust chicken with mixture and in a single layer, skin side down, lay in buttered dish, 12 x 18 x 2-inch., Drizzle margarine over chicken., Bake in moderate oven at 350° for 20 minutes., Turn and bake 20 more minutes., Stir soup and pour over chicken., Bake 20 minutes longer., Delicious!

title: Pumpkin Cake
directions: Mix dry ingredients; stir well., Make a well in the middle and add all other ingredients except pecans and vanilla., Bake in a greased and floured tube pan at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Parisian Onion Soup
directions: Simmer thinly sliced onions in water until tender., Dissolve bouillon., Add to onions., Simmer a few minutes., Place a few croutons and a slice of toast in each bowl., Add a slice of cheese., Pour soup over cheese., Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Let stand for a minute or two to melt cheese.

title: Bagels
directions: Combine the yeast and 1 3/4 cups flour., Add water, sugar and salt to yeast mixture., Beat at a low speed for 1/2 minute, constantly scraping the sides of the bowl., Then beat at high speed for 3 minutes., Stir in enough of the remaining flour to make a moderately stiff dough., Turn onto a lightly floured board and knead until smooth., Cover and let rest for 15 minutes., Divide dough into 12 portions., Shape into balls and punch a hole in center of each with a floured finger., Pull gently to enlarge hole. Keep in uniform shape., Cover and let rise for 20 minutes.

title: Preacher Dan'S Mega Peanut Butter Chip Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 325°., In small bowl, combine flour, salt, baking soda; set aside., In large bowl, beat butter, brown sugar, white sugar, vanilla and egg until creamy., Gradually beat in flour mixture., Stir in oats, pecans and peanut butter chips. Drop onto ungreased cookie sheets, any size you prefer (the bigger, the better).

title: Quickest Peach Cobbler
directions: Melt butter in pan that you cook the cobbler. Mix together the cake mix and milk. Pour the batter in the middle of pan with the melted butter (don't spread the batter). Now pour 1 can peaches and juice on top of batter and sprinkle with cinnamon sugar. Cook in 325° oven. Do not boil cobbler, remove when top is gloden brown.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
directions: Mix together and put into casserole dish., Add topping.

title: Apple Crisp
directions: Place apples in buttered 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan., Sprinkle with orange juice., Combine sugar, flour, spices and salt., Cut in butter with 2 knives or a pastry blender to form crumbs., (Batter will be quite stiff, makes nice large firm crumbs)., Put crumbs over apples., Bake at 375° approximately 45 minutes.

title: Easy Biscuits
directions: Mix flour, milk and oil with fork until makes soft dough. Pat out on floured surface., Make into biscuits., (Makes about 4 large ones.), Bake at 450° on greased cake pan about 20 minutes.

title: Seven Layer Salad
directions: Layer each of the vegetables in a bowl., Mix Miracle Whip and sugar together and spread on top of vegetables., Top with Cheddar cheese and bacon bits., Refrigerate, covered, and add tomatoes before serving.

title: Swiss Chicken
