directions: Melt butter in a 2-quart casserole., Sift together the flour, sugar, baking powder and salt., Stir in milk., Pour into butter; do not stir., Sprinkle fruit on top of butter; do not stir., Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Shrimp Creole
directions: Melt butter in frying pan., Add cleaned shrimp., Saute 5 minutes., Add Creole sauce and water or stock and simmer 5 minutes., Serve on hot platter in ring of boiled rice.

title: Hello Dolly Bars
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., In a 13 x 9-inch pan, melt margarine in oven., Sprinkle crumbs over margarine; mix together and press into pan., Pour milk over crumbs., Top with remaining ingredients. Press firmly., Bake 25 minutes., Cool before cutting.

title: Lithuanian Goulash
directions: Brown ground beef or turkey and drain., Add garlic, onion, celery, cabbage, water and potatoes; season with salt and pepper. Cook until tender., Add about 1 cup of sour cream., Serve with salad, rye bread and butter.

title: Chocolate Fudge
directions: Cook sugar, milk and butter to soft ball stage 236°, stirring frequently., Remove from heat; add chocolate pieces, Marshmallow Creme, vanilla and 1 cup nuts., Beat until chocolate is melted and blended., Pour into well buttered 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Immediately score into squares., Cool and when set, cut into squares.

title: Pizza Sticks
directions: Preheat oven to 450°., Prepare Basic Biscuits, rolling dough about 1/4-inch thick., Using a sharp knife or pizza cutter, cut dough into narrow strips, 1/2-inch wide., Cut strips into 3-inch sticks., Dip sticks into melted butter and roll in mixture of Parmesan cheese, oregano and garlic salt., Place on lightly greased baking sheet, about 3/4-inch apart., Bake 8 to 10 minutes or until golden brown., Makes about 3 dozen sticks.

title: Taco Dip
directions: Brown ground beef and drain., Add tomato sauce and chili mix to ground beef., Spread cream cheese in bottom of 9 x 13-inch ovenproof dish., Spread chili mixture over cream cheese., Sprinkle Cheddar cheese on top., Bake 10 to 15 minutes in a 350° oven, or in microwave until "bubbly"., Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Pudding Cake
directions: In bottom of long, ungreased cake pan, mix the cocoa, brown sugar and water., Sprinkle the marshmallows over this., Pour the cake batter over this (prepared according to package directions). Sprinkle with chopped nuts., Bake at 350° for 40 to 50 minutes. Serve warm with ice cream or Cool Whip.

title: Pie Crust
directions: Mix first 2 ingredients until pea like, then add other mixture., Chill and form into balls., Wrap well and freeze., Take out and thaw as needed.

title: Apple-Caramel Dip
directions: Soften cream cheese in microwave., Add sugars and vanilla. Stir until mixed well., Dip apples in caramel sauce.

title: Mocha-Frosted Spice Cake
directions: Bake cake in layers as directed., Prepare our creamy white frosting mix as directed, except dissolve 2 teaspoons powdered instant coffee in the hot water before adding to the dry mix.

title: Marinated Sweet Potato Salad
directions: In a large saucepan, cook sweet potatoes in boiling salted water just until tender, about 20 minutes., Cool completely. Meanwhile, in a small bowl, combine the next nine ingredients; set aside., Peel potatoes; cut in half lengthwise, then into 1/4-inch slices., In a large bowl, combine the sweet potatoes, onion and green pepper., Add dressing and gently toss to coat., Cover and refrigerate for at least 3 hours., Discard bay leaves before serving., Yields 14 to 16 servings.

title: Healthy Snacks
directions: In a large bowl, combine 2 cups of Triscuits crumbs, honey, raisins, peanut butter and dry milk., Shape into one-inch balls. Roll balls in Triscuits crumbs., Serve immediately or store in refrigerator., Yield:, 5 dozen.

title: Ham Cheese Ball
directions: Form ingredients into a ball., Chill; roll in chopped pecans. Refrigerate until serving.

title: Apricot Buttons
directions: Blend together the first 6 ingredients., Shape the dough into walnut size balls., Dip in reserved egg whites., Roll in chopped walnuts., Place on cookie tray; press thumb in center., Bake at 325°., When cool, fill centers with apricot jam.

title: Green Bean And Corn Casserole
directions: Drain green beans and corn., Put green beans in a long casserole dish and spread corn on top., Mix together sour cream, soup and salt and spread on top of beans and corn.	Mix cheese, butter and crackers., Put on top and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Petunia Bread Pudding
directions: Put brown sugar in top of double boiler., Add cubed bread. Combine eggs, vanilla, salt, milk and raisins., Pour mixture over bread., Don't stir., Cook for 1 hour in double boiler (undisturbed)., When done, turn upside down on serving dish.

title: Potato-Tomato Soup
directions: In large saucepan, combine first 6 ingredients., Bring to boiling., Reduce heat; cover and simmer 20 minutes or until vegetables are tender.

title: Pineapple Delight
directions: Mix pineapple, cheese, sugar and flour in bowl., Put in baking dish., Place crackers over top., Pour melted butter over crumbs. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Sauerkraut
directions: Put salt and cabbage in pan and fill with boiling water. Seal., Keep in warm place a few days.

title: Boxman'S Chocolate Pies
directions: Mix sugar, cocoa and flour together., Add enough milk to this mixture to make a paste., Add salt and two beaten eggs, then add the rest of the milk., Cook until thick., Take off stove and add butter and vanilla., Mix well., Pour into baked pie shells., Makes two 8-inch pies.

title: Savory Pot Roast
directions: In 6-quart Dutch oven, in 2 tablespoons oil, brown roast. Spoon off fat., Stir in mushroom soup, onion soup mix and 1 cup water., Cover; simmer 2 hours, turning occasionally., Add vegetables., Cover; cook 40 minutes or until roast and vegetables are fork-tender., Remove roast and vegetables to platter.

title: Flaky Baking Powder Biscuits
directions: Sift together flour, sugar, baking powder and salt in a bowl. Cut in shortening until crumbly., Beat together egg and milk., Add to flour mixture all at once, stirring just enough with fork to make a soft dough.

title: Magnificent Stuffed Eggplant
directions: Carefully scoop out the eggplant from the skin, taking care not to puncture what should be a thin shell, less than a quarter of an inch thick., Place the eggplant pieces in salted boiling water to cover and cook until very tender.

title: Oatmeal Cookies With Chocolate Covered Raisins
directions: Heat oven to 375°., Beat butter and sugars until creamy., Add eggs, milk and vanilla; beat well., Add combined flour, baking soda and salt; mix well., Stir in oats and chocolate covered raisins. Drop by rounded tablespoonful onto ungreased cookie sheet., Bake 10 minutes., Cool 1 minute on cookie sheet, then remove.

title: French Bread Dip
directions: Cook for 1 hour at 350°., Serve with sliced toasted French bread.

title: Aunt Ethel'S Potato Salad Dressing
directions: To potato, add onion, celery seed, eggs, sugar and flour., Mix together., Use pickle juice, if you have it., Add vinegar and water., Cook., Add oleo and mustard last., Add 1/2 of this mixture with 1/2 of Hellmann's mayo.

title: Kosher Style Dill Pickles
directions: Pack cucumbers in jar and pour over, after boiling, vinegar and water., Put in each jar dill, grape leaves, garlic, pepper and alum., Cap and seal., (Green tomatoes, bell pepper and sliced onions may be added too.)

title: Pork Chops And Apples
directions: Brown chops on all sides in hot fat. Mix apples, brown sugar and cinnamon. Place 3/4 of apple mixture in 8 1/2 x 11-inch pan. Dot with 3 tablespoons butter. Top with chops. Place remaining 1/4 apple mixture on top of chops and dot with remaining 1 tablespoon of butter. Cover and bake in preheated 400° oven for 1 1/2 hours. Makes 6 servings.

title: Buttermilk Biscuits
directions: Add dry ingredients to mixer bowl., Whisk to blend., Cut cold shortening and butter into small pieces and add to bowl., Mix on stir for 1 minute until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Continue on stir while adding the 3/4 cup of cold buttermilk., Mix just until moistened., Form dough into a ball and turn out onto lightly floured board., Knead 5 to 6 times and roll out to 1/2-inch thick., Cut into 2 inch rounds., Arrange biscuits on greased baking pan., Brush with 1 tablespoon buttermilk., Bake at 450° for 15 minutes., Yield:, 16 biscuits.

title: Mom'S Carrot Cake
directions: Mix eggs, oil and baby food well, then add remaining ingredients., Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes., Toothpick should come out clean.

title: Fruit Shake
directions: Place all ingredients in blender, except strawberries., Blend on high speed until well mixed, about 30 seconds., Garnish each shake with 1 strawberry.

title: Tabooley
directions: Soak wheat in water a few minutes., Squeeze dry between palms of hands., Chop onions, parsley, mint and tomatoes very fine., Add wheat, lemon juice, oil, salt and pepper., Mix well., Serve on fresh lettuce., Serves 6.

title: Easy Barbecued Chicken
directions: Combine cola and barbecue sauce., Pour into skillet., Add chicken and bring just to boiling., Cover, reduce heat and simmer for 1 hour., Serves 4.

title: Seafood Casserole
directions: Mix all together and put in casserole and sprinkle top with bacon crumbs., Bake in 350° oven for 30 to 40 minutes, covered. Yields 8 to 10 servings.

title: Italian Tomato Soup(Preparation Time:  30 Minutes)
directions: Peel and chop onion., In a large skillet or pan, heat oil. Saute onion in oil for a few minutes, until soft., Add pressed garlic., Sprinkle with whole wheat flour., Stir to combine., Add vegetable broth., Heat, stirring constantly., Dip tomatoes in hot water; peel and chop., Add tomatoes to soup, stirring., Add chili sauce, bay leaves, basil and herb salt., Bring to a boil., Cook, covered, over medium-low heat for about 15 minutes., Add cream to soup just before serving., Sprinkle with parsley.

title: Taco Salad
directions: Brown ground beef; drain., Add minced onion, taco sauce and stewed tomatoes., Simmer 5 to 10 minutes., Add meat mixture to shells and arrange lettuce, cheese and tomatoes., Toss lightly. Serve at once., Yields 6 servings.

title: E-Z Fruity Barbecue
directions: Salt and pepper ribs and brown in broiler or flour, salt and pepper chicken; brown in skillet., Place in large flat pan or Pyrex with 2-inch sides., Lay in single layer., Pour sauce mixed with jam over the top., Cover with foil, lightly., Bake 1 hour at 350°.

title: Trifle
directions: Bake cake; make pudding as directed., Cool them both., In large bowl, break cake in small squares and layer it in bowl. Then pour 1/4 Schnapps over cake., Make 1 layer of pudding, 1 layer of pie filling and layer of whipped cream., Sprinkle with coconut and pecans (crushed)., Then repeat layers and refrigerate until served., Hope you enjoy.

title: Apple Bread
directions: Cream sugar and butter together; add remaining ingredients and mix together., Pour into 2 greased and floured loaf pans.

title: Buttermilk Chess Pie
directions: Cream butter and sugar until fluffy; mix in eggs, one at a time (do not beat)., Add buttermilk, flour and vanilla and mix well., Pour mixture into 2 pie shells (uncooked) and bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Chicken Spaghetti Supreme
directions: Remove skin and bone from cooked chicken; cut into bite size pieces., Cook celery and bell pepper in bite size pieces., Cook spaghetti., Combine all ingredients except bread crumbs and transfer to a 10 x 15-inch baking pan sprayed or buttered., Top with bread crumbs and bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Cookies
directions: I use milk chocolate chips, baby M&M's and toffee pieces.

title: Pineapple Banana Bread
directions: Combine dry ingredients, stir in nuts., Add rest of ingredients (oil, bananas, eggs and pineapple)., Stir until moistened., Spoon batter into 2 greased and floured 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pans., Bake for 1hour or until done., Cool 10 minutes in pan, then put on rack to cool., Bake at 350°.

title: Do-Ahead And Chill Chocolate Angel Torte
directions: Combine sugar and cornstarch in a medium saucepan; mix to blend., Stir in Carnation and water., Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until mixture begins to thicken., Stir a small amount of hot mixture into egg., Return egg mixture to saucepan., Continue cooking until mixture just comes to a boil and thickens., Stir in vanilla and chocolate., Cover surface of filling with wax paper; chill., Slice cake horizontally, making three layers., Fill and frost cake layers., Sprinkle nuts over top of cake., Chill several hours before serving.

title: Stew For All Occasions
directions: Heat oven to 325°., Mix in a heavy 5 to 6-quart Dutch oven the first 9 ingredients., Stir in beef chuck., Add carrots, celery and onions., Cover and bake about 3 hours, stirring twice, until the meat is tender and sauce thickened., Discard bay leaves before serving or refrigerating.

title: Eggs Lorraine
directions: Grease a 9 x 13-inch cake pan., Put 12 eggs in pan; break yolks., Put chopped onion and pepper on top of eggs and salt and pepper., Add mushrooms, sausage and cheese., Pour over whipped cream., Cover and refrigerate overnight., Uncover and bake 45 minutes to 1 hour at 350°., Let stand 5 to 10 minutes., Cut and serve.

title: Original Bourbon Cake
directions: Combine cherries, raisins and bourbon., Cover and let stand overnight., Drain fruit and reserve bourbon., Preheat oven to 275°., Cream butter and sugars until light., Add egg yolks, a little at a time, and mix well., Combine 1/2 cup flour with the nutmeg, baking powder and chopped pecans., Set aside., Add remaining flour and bourbon alternately to the butter mixture, beating well after each addition., Beat egg whites until stiff and fold into the batter., Then fold in soaked fruit and pecan flour. Turn into a greased 10-inch tube pan that has been lined with greased waxed paper., Bake for 3 1/2 hours., Cool before removing from pan.

title: Doughnuts
directions: Soften yeast in water., Add 1/2 teaspoon of the 1/4 cup sugar and set aside., Add fat or shortening, rest of sugar and salt to hot milk., Stir until sugar is dissolved., Cool, then add egg; stir in softened yeast., Stir flour into liquid ingredients until well mixed., Turn dough out onto lightly floured board., Knead quickly until smooth and elastic., Form into, smooth ball and place in a greased bowl., Turn over to grease the surface., Cover and let rise in warm place (about 85°) until double in bulk, about 1 hour., Turn onto board and knead well., Roll out and cut with doughnut cutter., Place on waxed paper and let rise again until double in bulk., Cook in cooking oil until brown., While still hot, roll in powdered sugar icing made by mixing 1 box powdered sugar and enough milk to make it thin enough to dip the doughnuts in.

title: Chicken Scarparella
directions: Rinse arugula well; pat dry., Reserve half for garnish. Discard tough stems from remainder; slice thin., Set aside.

title: Guacamole
directions: Combine ingredients in an electric blender or with the potato masher., Delicious with pita bread, as a dip, or as a sandwich on whole wheat bread.

title: Chicken Cordon Bleu
directions: Pound breasts thin., Salt and pepper chicken., First put chicken, slice of ham and cheese., Roll up in jelly roll fashion. Secure with toothpicks., After all are rolled, flour chicken. Melt 2 tablespoons butter over medium heat., Brown on all four sides, about 4 minutes., Remove chicken; melt remaining butter. Add mushrooms and onion., Saute until tender., Then add water and bouillon, parsley and chives., Bring to boil., Return chicken to sauce., Cook in oven 1 hour or until tender., Remove chicken., Add cream., Simmer several minutes until thickened.

title: Baked Roast Beef
directions: Sprinkle onion soup mix on roost beef. Bake according to directions., Keep drippings for sauce. Make regular gravy with cornstarch. Stir into roast beef. Put in crock pot to keep hot. Put on buns.

title: Rice Krispies Treat
directions: Melt butter and marshmallows; add Rice Krispies and vanilla. Press mixture into a 9 x 13-inch buttered pan., Melt chocolate chips and pour over the top., Let set in refrigerator for awhile.

title: Banana Split Dessert
directions: Grind crackers to make crumbs and combine with melted margarine. Press into bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Banana Cake
directions: Mix together and bake in greased pan at 350°, about 30 minutes., Cool and add icing.

title: No Cook Fondant
directions: Mix cream cheese and flavoring., Add coloring.	If more than one, color	is desired, separate batch at this time., Mix in sugar,, kneading with hands until consistency of stiff pie dough. You, may need more sugar., Place one side in sugar and push sugar side into mold., Unmold at once.

title: Stuffed Green Peppers
directions: Mix all ingredients., Stuff in peppers and wrap in foil., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Salmon Ball
directions: Mix the first 6 ingredients; form into a ball., Roll in fine cut parsley., Refrigerate until ready to serve., Serve with crackers.

title: Calico Beans
directions: Cook bacon in large skillet until crisp; remove to paper toweling to drain, then crumble., Cook beef in fat remaining in skillet until no pink remains., Add onion; saute just until tender. Combine beef, onion, catsup, salt, brown sugar, mustard and vinegar in a 3-quart baking dish., Partially drain all the beans, add to baking dish, stir gently to mix., Sprinkle bacon on top. Bake at 350° for 40 minutes., Makes 8 servings as a main dish.

title: Exquisite Pie
directions: Mix all ingredients and pour in unbaked 9 inch pie shell and bake at 325° for about 40 minutes.

title: Creamed Chopped Spinach
directions: Cook and drain spinach., Add mushroom soup and mix well., Heat in microwave oven for approximately 3 minutes or until steaming hot.

title: Gingersnaps
directions: Preheat oven to 325°., Cream together the butter and sugar. Stir in the eggs, molasses and vinegar., Sift and add dry ingredients., Mix until well blended., Form the dough into 3/4-inch balls by rolling dough in between your palms., Bake on a greased cookie sheet for 12 minutes.

title: Reuben Pie
directions: In glass pie plate, layer kraut and cheese., In separate bowl beat biscuit mix, milk, mayo, eggs and chili sauce., Slowly pour over meat and cheese and allow to soak in., Makes own crust., Bake at 325° until puffed and brown on top.

title: Barbecued Meat Balls
directions: Mix hamburger, rice, milk, onion, pepper, parsley and salt and pepper together and form into balls., Place in baking dish or crock-pot.

title: Strawberry Layer Gelatin
directions: Prepare gelatin according to the recipe on the box., Divide in half., Place other half in serving bowl and refrigerate until set. Refrigerate other half until thick., I use the quick-set recipe on box being careful to remove all remaining ice cubes.

title: Almond Caramel Crunch
directions: Place cereal in large bowl and set aside., In small saucepan over low heat, melt caramels with water, stirring until smooth. Add almond extract and stir., Pour over cereal, stir until all pieces are coated., Spread on wax paper or lightly greased pan to cool., Separate pieces while cooling., Store in airtight container. Makes 4 cups.

title: Clam Chowder Soup
directions: Mix first 9 ingredients and heat., Before serving, top with remaining ingredients., Serves 8 to 10.

title: Chicken Burritos
directions: On each flour tortilla, place sour cream down center, chunks of chicken, salsa, onions, cheeses, peppers and more salsa (as desired)., Roll side of tortilla up and secure with a toothpick. Place burritos on a baking sheet and broil in oven for a few minutes, until burritos begin to brown and crisp., Serve., Good with Spanish rice.

title: Fluffy White Frosting
directions: Blend all ingredients on low speed., Turn mixer to high speed and beat until fluffy and of proper consistency.

title: 5 Fruit Salad
directions: Drain pineapple and oranges., Mix all ingredients together. Slice bananas., May add nuts or coconut for variation.

title: Corn Bread Salad
directions: Mix and bake corn bread according to directions on package. Cool and crumble the corn bread., Meanwhile, cook the sausage, crumbling as it cooks., Drain., Chop pickles, tomatoes, onion and cucumber., Stir in sausage and all but 1/2 cup crumbled corn bread. Mix well., Use reserved corn bread to decorate the top., Also garnish with green pepper strips., Makes about 6 servings.

title: Chocolate Devils
directions: Cream butter and sugar thoroughly and add eggs, one at a time. Mix well., Add dry ingredients and milk alternately., Add melted chocolate, vanilla and nuts., Mix well., Bake in a 7 1/2 x 11 1/2 x 1 1/2-inch pan at 350° for about 25 minutes., Cut in strips or squares while warm and dust with powdered sugar.

title: Noodle Pudding
directions: Cook noodles and drain., Melt butter in hot noodles in a large bowl., Once butter has melted, add beaten eggs, sugar and cottage cheese., Stir well., Add all other ingredients., Bake in 13 x 9-inch pan., Bake 1 1/2 hours at 350°, or until noodles turn golden brown., Allow to cool somewhat before serving., Good either warm or cold, as a side dish or dessert.

title: "Whimpies"
directions: In a large frying pan or Dutch oven, cook the meat and vegetables over medium heat until the meat is browned and the vegetables are tender, about 30 minutes., Stir in the V-8, catsup, sugar, vinegar and Worcestershire and simmer, uncovered, over low heat for 2 hours., The mixture will resemble spaghetti sauce. (Remove lid during last 30 minutes of cooking if it seems too thin.), Sauce keeps well and freezes well., This dish can be used on cocktail rolls as an hors d'oeuvre or piled on hamburger buns for lunch.

title: Thumbprints(An Old Family Recipe)
directions: Sift flour and baking powder., In medium bowl with mixer, cream butter, sugar, egg yolks and vanilla until fluffy. Gradually mix in flour and baking powder until well blended. Cover bowl with wax paper and refrigerate until easy to handle, about 1 hour.

title: Raspberry Vinegar
directions: Drain raspberries carefully in fine strainer., Don't push pulp through strainer., Let stand 10 minutes., Place a disposable coffee filter in a strainer over a medium bowl., Pour raspberry juice into filter., Should have 1/2 cup clear juices.

title: Molasses Barbecue Ribs
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Parboil ribs about 15 minutes., Put in baking pan., Pour sauce over and bake slowly in a 350° oven until done.

title: Graham Streusel Cake
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Grease 13 x 9-inch pan., Mix crumbs, nuts, sugar, cinnamon and butter., Set aside., Prepare cake mix according to directions., Pour half the batter in pan., Sprinkle half the crumbs over batter., Cover with remaining batter. Sprinkle the rest of crumbs over top., Bake 45 to 50 minutes, until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Mudslide
directions: Combine all ingredients in a blender and process until smooth., Makes 1 tall glass.

title: Strawberry Shortcake
directions: In a bowl, mash strawberries, then stir in sugar., Ready for shortcake!

title: Crock-Pot Beef Stew
directions: Place meat in crock-pot., Mix flour, salt and pepper., Pour over meat., Stir to coat meat with flour., Add remaining ingredients and stir to mix well., Cover and cook on low 10 to 12 hours (best way!) or high 4 to 6 hours., Stir stew thoroughly before serving.

title: Brown Sugar Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., In large mixing bowl, cream butter, brown sugar, egg and vanilla until light and fluffy., Mix in flour, baking soda and salt., Shape dough into 1-inch balls., Place 2 inches apart on ungreased baking sheet., Bake at 350° for 12 to 14 minutes or until golden brown., Remove to cooling rack after 1 minute., Makes 4 to 4 1/2 dozen cookies.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
directions: Beat eggs and add other ingredients., Bake in tube pan at 325° for 1 hour and 20 minutes.

title: Finger Lickin' Pork Ribs
directions: Preheat gas grill on high for 15 minutes., Lightly garlic salt both sides of ribs., Put ribs on grill., Close lid., Rotate ribs frequently.

title: Red Cabbage
directions: Saute bacon and chopped onion in bacon fat., Do not drain. Mix all ingredients and cook on very low heat (in heavy bottom pot or kettle) for about 1/2 hour., Very good with pork chops, ham or fried chicken., Makes 5 servings.

title: Nanny'S Dump Cake
directions: Do not preheat oven., Use an ungreased tube pan., Put all ingredients in a bowl and mix for 20 minutes., Bake for 1 hour at 350°.

title: Strawberry Pretzel Dessert
directions: Combine pretzels, 3 tablespoons sugar and butter., Pat in 13 x 9-inch baking dish., Bake at 375° for 10 minutes., Cool crust.

title: Microwave Rice
directions: Combine all ingredients in a 2-quart covered container. Microwave on High power for 5 minutes., Reduce setting to 50% power and microwave for 15 minutes., Fluff with a fork.

title: Sweet Potato Biscuits
directions: Mix egg, sweet potato, sugar and shortening in a bowl; beat until smooth., Stir in enough flour to make a dough stiff enough to turn onto a floured surface., Knead a few times; then roll out 1/2-inch thick., Cut with a biscuit cutter or jar lid and bake on an ungreased baking sheet at 350° for about 15 minutes.

title: Southern Sweet Potato Pie
directions: In large mixing bowl, combine the flour and sugar., Add potatoes, eggs, corn syrup, nutmeg, salt, butter and evaporated milk., Beat well., Pour into pie shell and bake at 350° for 55 to 60 minutes.

title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
directions: Cream butter and sugar until fluffy., Add eggs one at a time; add, flavorings., Sift all dry ingredients together and add alternately, with, sour, cream to first mixture., Bake at 325° for one hour.

title: Pecan Cookie Bars
directions: Mix cake mix (save 2/3 cup), margarine and 1 egg until moist. Press flat into 13 x 9-inch pan., Bake 15 to 20 minutes at 350° until lightly browned., Mix sugar, remaining eggs and vanilla together., Add corn syrup and 2/3 cup dry cake mix., Lightly stir in pecans., Pour this filling over browned crust., Return to oven. Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350°., Let cool and cut into bars.

title: Heavenly Onions
directions: Saute onions and mushrooms in butter., Arrange onions and mushrooms in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan., Top with Swiss cheese, then the bread., Mix soup, milk and Worcestershire., Pour over top., Refrigerate overnight., Bake uncovered 30 to 40 minutes at 350°.

title: Overnight Fruit Salad
directions: Drain fruits, pineapple and oranges. Save 1 cup juice. Mix with pudding. Fold in fruits and cherries. Put in dish.

title: Primo Pesto!
directions: Combine all ingredients, except cheese, in food processor or blender., Puree until smooth., Stir in cheese., Yields 1 cup.

title: Cherry Coke Salad
directions: Drain juice into saucepan and heat until boiling., Stir in both pkgs. of jello., Set aside to cool., Add water and coke. Chill until partly thickened., Fold in pecans, cream cheese, pineapple and cherries., Spray jello mold with non-sticking spray.

title: Holiday Fruitcake Cookies
directions: Sift together flour, soda and salt (or use self-rising flour). Cream shortening; add sugar and eggs; beat until light and fluffy. Add buttermilk and flour, alternately., Then fold in nuts, cherries, dates and candied fruit., Chill dough., Drop teaspoonfuls about 2 inches apart on lightly greased baking sheet., Top each with a cherry half., Bake in moderate oven (375°) 8 to 10 minutes. Makes 8 dozen.

title: Asparagus Casserole
directions: Cut asparagus into 1-inch lengths., Cook until barely tender. Make a cream sauce of margarine, flour, milk and seasonings. Arrange alternate layers of asparagus, sliced cooked eggs, cream sauce and cheese in greased 1 1/2-quart casserole., Sprinkle with buttered crumbs., Bake in a moderate oven, 350° for 30 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Apple Pie Pizza
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan., In a large bowl, combine cake mix, 1 cup of oats, cheese and 6 tablespoons of margarine at low speed until crumbly., Reserve 1 cup of crumbs for topping., To remaining crumbs, blend 1 egg., Press into prepared pan., Bake at 350° for 12 minutes.

title: Pasta Salad
directions: Cook pasta according to package, rinse and drain., In large bowl, mix all ingredients; toss, chill and serve.

title: Cold Garden Pizza
directions: Mix 2 packages of softened cream cheese with mayonnaise, dill weed and chopped onions., Bake crescent rolls at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes., Spread out on a cookie sheet or pizza pan; let cool.

title: Blackened Shrimp Stroganoff
directions: Place shrimp shells in saucepan with 2 cups of water; bring to a boil and reduce heat., Simmer, uncovered, 10 minutes., Strain and discard shells (may substitute 1 cup chicken broth instead). In small bowl, combine shrimp, oil and blackened seasoning, stirring to coat shrimp; set aside., Cook mushrooms and shallots in butter until tender., Remove from skillet., Cook shrimp over medium heat until pink., Remove from skillet and add vermouth to skillet., Boil, uncovered, about 2 to 3 minutes., Stir together the sour cream, cornstarch and 1 cup of broth., Add to skillet; cook and stir until thickened and bubbly., Cook 1 minute longer. Add shrimp, red pepper, mushroom mixture and capers., Heat through., Season with salt., Serve over noodles.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Cook broccoli as directed on package., Drain well and put in bottom of casserole dish., Spot casserole with 1/2 stick of margarine or butter., Slice cheese and place all across top of broccoli., Crush 1 stick (37) Ritz crackers and place on top., Melt other 1/2 stick margarine or butter and pour over top., Cover and bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

title: Impossible Pumpkin Pie
directions: Put everything in blender and beat until mixed., Put in greased 10-inch pie pan., Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes or until firm.

title: Breast Of Chicken On Rice
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Mix mushroom soup with milk; reserve 1/2 cup of the mixture. Mix remaining soup mixture wit rice, mushrooms (including liquid) and half of the onion soup mix., Pour into oblong baking dish, 11 1/2 x 7 1/2 x 1 1/2-inch., Place chicken breasts on top., Pour reserved soup mixture over chicken breasts; sprinkle with remaining onion soup mix., Cover and bake 1 hour; uncover and bake 15 minutes longer., Makes 4 servings.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
directions: Blend in 8, ounces, Cool Whip., Put into graham cracker crust and freeze.

title: Iced Tea
directions: Bring water to a boil., Pour tea bags in a teapot or glass container., Pour the hot water over the tea bags and let sit for 5 minutes., Remove the tea bags., If you want to sweeten the tea, now is the best time to add sugar., Add water until it is the strength you like., Let sit until cool and pour over ice to serve.

title: Easy Spice Cake
directions: Mix and spread in jelly roll pan., Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes., Cool., Frost with Caramel Frosting.

title: Picnic Stuffed Eggs
directions: Slice eggs in half lengthwise; remove yolks and set whites aside. In a small bowl, mash yolks with a fork. Add the mayonnaise, pickle relish, mustard, garlic salt, Worcestershire sauce and pepper; mix well. Stuff or pipe into the egg whites. Refrigerate until serving. Makes 2 dozen.

title: Garden Salad
directions: Mix together lettuce, cauliflower, broccoli and peas in a large bowl., Blend together salad dressing, dressing mix and sugar; mix into vegetables., Top with bacon bits and shredded cheese., (Other vegetables may be used if desired, such as green pepper, cucumber, carrots, celery or tomato.)

title: Pineapple Pound Cake
directions: Cream, shortening,, margarine and sugar., Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition., Fold in flour, 1 cup at a time., Add baking powder with last cup., Blend well. Add pineapple, and, milk., Beat 3 minutes., Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 20 minutes.

title: Chicken Croquettes
directions: Chicken Filling:, Cook chicken with salt, savory, garlic, onion and 4 cups water., Take off broth, remove chicken bones and break meat into 1-inch pieces., Cook a few minutes more., Strain broth and reserve 3 cups.

title: Blue Ribbon Chocolate Chip Cookies
directions: Cream together butter, brown sugar, eggs and vanilla, then add remaining ingredients, except chocolate chips., Stir in chips. Drop by teaspoon on greased baking sheet., Bake at 375° for 9 to 11 minutes.

title: Breakfast Pizza
directions: Toast the English muffin., Place on a plate., In a skillet, fry the bacon until crisp., Drain on a paper towel., Reduce the heat., Break the egg into the skillet; cook to desired firmness. Slide egg onto the muffin., Crumble the crisp bacon over the egg. Pour excess fat out of the skillet., Heat pizza sauce and pour over egg., Sprinkle cheese over all.

title: Marinated Carrots
directions: Combine all ingredients and let set several hours.

title: Butterscotch Drops
directions: Melt morsels in double boiler, stirring constantly to smooth consistency., Add peanuts and chow mein noodles and mix well. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto waxed paper until hardened., Store in airtight container., Does not need to be refrigerated.

title: 4-Layer Dessert
directions: First Layer:, Mix flour, margarine and nuts. Pat in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350° until golden brown.

title: Spinach Salad Dressing
directions: Blend all in blender and pour over salad of fresh spinach, mushrooms, boiled eggs and bacon., Sprinkle with grated cheese.

title: Lacey Cookies
directions: 1. Fold in 1 c. chocolate chips., 2. Drop by teaspoons on a lightly greased cookie sheet., 3. Bake 12-15 minutes at 375°.

title: Dump Cake
directions: Pour pie filling in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan., Add pineapple. Sprinkle cake mix over pineapple., Pour margarine over cake mix. Add coconut., Sprinkle pecans over., Bake at 325° for 1 hour. Yields 15 pieces.

title: Chili
directions: Brown ground beef; drain., Combine all ingredients except noodles and cook 1 hour., Add noodles and cook for 20 minutes.

title: Champagne Punch
directions: Mix and decorate with grapes., Serves 20 people.

title: Shoo-Fly Pie (Pennsylvania Dutch Pie)
directions: Cut butter into small bits; reserve 2 tablespoons for on top. Dissolve soda in hot water., Stir in molasses., Pour in unbaked shell., Mix dry ingredients: flour, sugar, cinnamon, nutmeg, baking powder and soda., Spread mixture into shell., Bake at 425° for 15 minutes., Reduce to 350° for 25 minutes or until the center is firm., Sprinkle 2 tablespoons mix (reserved) on top., Bake 10 minutes., Serves 8.

title: Cottage Cheese Dill Bread
directions: Sprinkle yeast on warm water; stir until blended., Stir in 2 teaspoons of sugar; set aside., Combine cottage cheese, onion, dill weed, baking powder, 2 tablespoons of sugar and eggs., Mix well., Add yeast mixture and mix well., Add flour to make a stiff dough., Knead on lightly floured surface until smooth and elastic. Place dough in greased bowl; turn to bring greased side up. Cover; let rise in warm place until doubled (1 to 1 1/2 hours). Punch down., Turn onto floured surface; knead a few times., Divide in half., Shape into bread pans and let rise until doubled., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes., Remove from pans to rack., Brush tops with butter.

title: Easy Donuts
directions: Place oil in skillet, about 1-inch., Let it get hot., Cut small hole in center of biscuits with salt shaker lid., Drop into oil., Turn when brown., Brown other side., Drain on paper towel. Roll in sugar, powdered sugar or cinnamon., Makes 20 donuts and 20 holes.

title: Ham Croquettes(Leftovers)
directions: Melt butter; blend in flour., Add milk all at once., Cook and stir until thick and bubbly; cook and stir 1 minute more., Remove from heat., Add ham, onion and mustard., Chill well., Shape mixture into 8 to 10 balls., Roll in bread crumbs., Shape into cone, handling lightly., Combine egg and water; dip cone in mixture and roll again in crumbs., Fry in deep, hot fat (365°) for 1 1/2 to 2 minutes., Drain.

title: Baked Spaghetti
directions: Cook spaghetti and drain., Brown ground beef and onion., Stir in American cheese., Mix all together, then pour into oven baking dish., Sprinkle with Mozzarella and Cheddar cheese., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

title: Butter Pecan Cake
directions: Empty both mixes into mixer bowl; add eggs, oil and water. Mix on medium speed for two minutes., Add chopped nuts and coconut and mix until well blended., Pour into greased and floured tube or Bundt cake pan., Bake 1 hour at 350°., Remove from oven and cool in pan for 10 minutes on wire rack if possible., Remove from pan and allow to cool completely., Good with powdered sugar or whipped topping.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
directions: Mix apples, sugar, oil, eggs and vanilla., Sift dry ingredients together and add to first mixture., If using nuts and/or raisins, add them now., Bake in oblong pan (9 x 13-inch) in a 350° oven for 45 minutes., Serve plain or with whipped cream or Cool Whip.

title: Bean And Cabbage Casserole
directions: In saucepan, cook bacon until crisp., Remove and crumble., Set aside., Pour off all but 2 tablespoons drippings., Add remaining ingredients., Mix and stir now and then., Garnish with crumbled bacon., You can double this recipe many times for a crowd.

title: Chess Bars
directions: Beat together the cake mix, butter and 1 egg; press in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan., Mix together the remaining 3 eggs, cream cheese and confectioners sugar; pour over cake mix layer., Bake in a 350° oven for 40 minutes., Leave in pan to cool 1 hour before slicing.

title: Layered Lettuce Salad
directions: Tear lettuce into small pieces., Place in 9 x 13 glass pan., Layer rest of ingredients in order given., Add sugar to mayonnaise and spread over top., Top with grated cheese., Cover and refrigerate 8 to 12 hours or overnight.

title: Pumpkin Bread
directions: Mix sugar, cinnamon, nutmeg, ginger and salt., Set aside., In a separate bowl, with a hand wire whip, whip eggs for 10-15 seconds., Add in vegetable oil, water and pumpkin., Add to sugar & spices and mix for 60 seconds., Gradually add to flour and baking soda., Fold in pecans.

title: Zucchini Bread
directions: In mixing bowl, beat together zucchini, sugar and eggs., Add cooking oil and mix well., Stir together the flour, cinnamon, baking soda, nutmeg, baking powder, lemon and salt., Stir in zucchini mixture., Pour into oblong cake pan., Bake at 325° for about 60 to 65 minutes.

title: Hunter'S Stew(A Polish Recipe)
directions: In large Dutch oven, place cabbage, sauerkraut and pork chops. Sprinkle with salt and pepper., Add bay leaf, mushrooms and water; cook, covered, for 1 hour and 30 minutes, or until chops are tender., Cool mixture, then remove bones from chops., Cut chops into bite size pieces., Refrigerate all until 1 hour before serving, then peel and slice kielbasi about 1/2-inch thick and add to cabbage with pork and tomato sauce., Cook, covered, about 1 hour, or until pork is tender and stew is piping hot., Serve with boiled potatoes.

title: Fruit Roll
directions: Combine first 5 ingredients, mixing well., Divide into 3 equal portions., Roll each into an 11-inch log., Roll in powdered sugar and wrap in plastic wrap., Refrigerate until firm., Cut in 1/2-inch slices., Can be frozen., Makes 5 dozen.

title: *Banana Cocktail
directions: Mix together the ketchup, lime juice, scallions, celery, Worcestershire sauce and Tabasco sauce., Fold in the bananas. Chill for 30 minutes., Serve in lettuce cups or sherbet cups. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Cornbread Salad
directions: Prepare and bake cornbread as directed on package., Crumble into a large bowl., Mix with other ingredients and chill., Keeps well.

title: Hungry Jack Casserole
directions: Brown meat; drain., Stir in beans, sauce, sugar, salt and onion., Pour into a 2-quart casserole., Cut biscuits in halves to form 20 halves., Place, cut side down, over meat mixture. Sprinkle with cheese., Bake at 375° for 30 minutes.

title: O' Henry Bars
directions: Bring to a boil the Karo and sugar., Add peanut butter and Rice Krispies., Press into a 15 x 10-inch jelly roll pan (greased)., Cover with melted chocolate chips.

title: Cream Puffs
directions: Melt butter in boiling water., Add flour and salt all at once; stir vigorously., Cook, stirring constantly, until mixture forms a ball that doesn't separate., Remove from heat and cool slightly. Add eggs, one at a time, beating vigorously after each until smooth., Drop dough by heaping tablespoonfuls 3 inches apart on greased cookie sheet., Bake in very hot oven (450°) 15 minutes, then in slow oven (325°) 25 minutes., Remove cream puffs from oven; split., Turn oven off and put cream puffs back in oven to dry out, about 50 minutes., Cool on rack.

title: Cream Cheese Cookies
directions: Soften cream cheese and butter., Blend well. Combine flour and sugar., Add to butter mixture. Add vanilla and mix well. Shape into small balls and place on ungreased cookie sheet., Press chocolate chips or pecans into each cookie., Bake at 350° for 12 minutes or until lightly browned., Yields 5 to 6 dozen.

title: Everlasting Pickles
directions: Sprinkle salt over thinly sliced cucumbers and let set for 1 hour., Dissolve sugar in vinegar and add rest of ingredients to cucumbers, slicing onion and pepper thinly., This makes a nice and crispy pickle and will keep indefinitely in the refrigerator.

title: Barbecue Sauce
directions: Blend ingredients., Bring mixture to a boil and simmer for at least 1/2 hour.

title: Hummingbird Cake
directions: Combine dry ingredients in large mixing bowl., Add eggs and oil and stir until dry ingredients are moistened., Do not beat. Stir in vanilla, chopped nuts and bananas., Spoon batter into 3 well-greased and floured 9-inch pans., Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Black Walnut Cake
directions: Cream, butter, and, shortening., Gradually, add, sugar, beating until, light, and fluffy and sugar dissolves., Add egg yolks, beating well., Combine buttermilk and soda.	Stir until soda dissolves., Add flour to creamed mixture alternately with buttermilk mixture, beginning and, ending with flour., Stir in vanilla., Add 1 1/2, cups, walnuts and coconut, stirring well. Beat egg whites (at, room, temperature), with, cream of tartar until stiff peaks form., Fold egg whites into batter.

title: Hawaiian Pie
directions: Bake the pie shells., Cook the pineapple, sugar and flour until it thickens., Cool, then add the coconut and pecans., Divide the bananas into the pie shells., Pour pineapple mixture over the bananas., Top with Cool Whip.

title: Mama'S Colorvision Cake(Our Family'S Favorite)
directions: To ice, mix all remaining fruit gelatin in package with egg whites, sugar, cream of tartar and water., Place over boiling water and beat with electric mixer on high speed or rotary beater until icing holds stiff peaks., Remove from over boiling water and beat about 1 minute longer.

title: Strawberry Banana Ice Cream
directions: Dissolve Jell-O in hot water., Stir in Eagle Brand milk, half and half, strawberries, bananas and vanilla., Add milk and make by freezer directions., Makes 1 gallon.

title: Creamy Rice Pudding
directions: Cook rice in boiling water for 8 minutes., Stir, add margarine and milk; cook for 45 minutes to 1 hour., Beat eggs, sugar and extract., Remove rice from heat and slowly add egg mixture. Sprinkle with cinnamon.

title: Corn Pudding
directions: Mix softened oleo, sugar and onion with corn, cornbread mix and 1 egg, beaten., Put in casserole and cover with sour cream. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Cinnamon Sticks
directions: Cream butter and sugar; add beaten egg yolks., Sift flour and cinnamon together and add to mixture., Spread thin on a large cookie sheet that has been lightly greased., Press chopped pecans into dough., Spread beaten egg white over top., Bake 1 hour at 300°., Check after 45 minutes., Do not cook until brown as they will taste scorched., Cool and then slice in slender pieces.

title: Chewy Chocolate Cookies
directions: Cream butter and sugar in a large mixer bowl., Add eggs and vanilla;, blend, well., Combine, flour, cocoa, baking soda and salt;, blend into creamed mixture., Stir in finely chopped nuts, if, desired., Drop by teaspoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at, 350°, for, 8 to 9 minutes., (Do not overbake. Cookies will, be, soft., They, will, puff, during, baking, and flatten upon cooling.) Cool on cookie sheet until set, about 1 minute; remove to wire rack to cool completely., Makes about 4 1/2 dozen.

title: Quick Rolls
directions: Mix well (will be thin)., Bake in muffin pans for 12 to 15 minutes at 450°.

title: Party Potatoes
directions: Prepare potatoes as directed on package., Mix in other ingredients., Cover and refrigerate overnight., Uncover and bake for 1 hour at 350°.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Saute celery, green peppers, mushrooms, and onions in butter. Cook chicken and save broth. Cut chicken into bite size pieces. Cook noodles in broth. Drain. Layer noodles, chicken, and other ingredients. Save 1/2 c. cheese for top. Bake 35 minutes at 350.

title: Air Pudding
directions: Mix all ingredients in a bowl., Beat until whites are very stiff, then bake in moderate oven ten minutes.

title: Garlic-Cheese Biscuits
directions: Heat oven to 450°., Mix milk, Bisquick, cheese and 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder until soft dough forms., Beat vigorously for 30 seconds.

title: Salt Free Diet Seasoning
directions: Any seasoning can be added that you like., Keep in shaker and pass up the salt!

title: Squash Casserole
directions: Cook squash and onion until tender., Remove from heat, drain off any excess liquid., Then mash squash and onions; add salt, pepper and butter., Add cracker crumbs, half of the cheese, milk and egg., Stir until well blended., Pour into greased casserole dish., Bake at 350° until set, about 45 minutes, sprinkle rest of cheese on top and return to oven until melted and lightly browned.

title: Chicken And Rice
directions: Place cut up chicken in the bottom of a baking dish., Pour rice over chicken., Sprinkle package of Lipton soup over rice. Mix all soups with equal parts of water., Mix until smooth, and pour over rice and chicken., Cover tightly, with lid or foil, and bake at 375° for approximately 2 hours or until rice and chicken are done.

title: Layered Taco Dip
directions: Brown ground meat, drain and let cool., Put ground meat in bottom of 9 x 12-inch pan., In bowl, mix taco seasoning mix and sour cream, then put on top of ground meat., Place lettuce, tomato and onion on, then top with shredded Cheddar cheese., Enjoy with tortilla chips.

title: Mushroom Florentine
directions: Saute whole mushrooms in butter., Set aside., Cook spinach and drain., Combine spinach, butter, onion salt, garlic powder and pepper., Place in a 10-inch quiche or pie pan., Sprinkle with 1/2 cup cheese., Arrange sauteed mushrooms over spinach., Cover with remaining cheese., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

title: Apple Betty
directions: Mound apples in buttered 9-inch pie plate; sprinkle with orange juice., Combine sugar, flour, spices and dash of salt., Cut in butter until mixture is crumbly; sprinkle over apples., Bake at 375° for 45 minutes or until apples are tender and top is crisp.

title: Cornbread Stuffing
directions: Mix crumbled cornbread and all other ingredients together, put in casserole dish (2 1/2 qt.) and bake at 400° for 45 minutes or until brown., Chicken parts and mushrooms may be added if desired., 10 to 12 servings.

title: Broccoli, Rice And Chicken Casserole
directions: Cook rice., Saute onion in oleo and add rice and uncooked broccoli., Boil or bake chicken breasts; then debone and cut up into bite size pieces., Add to mixture., Add soup and Cheez Whiz. Mix well., Bake in a buttered casserole about 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Spiced Viennese Coffee
directions: Put the orange extract and the sugar in coffee., Keep warm. Top with Cool Whip mixed with nutmeg and cinnamon.

title: Chicken And Sausage Casserole
directions: Boil chicken; debone and chop. Cook sausage. Cook rice as directed on package using chicken broth. Combine all ingredients and top with cracker crumbs or bread crumbs. Bake at 375° for 30 minutes. (Use chicken broth as needed.)

title: Asparagus Casserole
directions: Butter or grease casserole dish. Drain asparagus. Make layers of asparagus, eggs and cheese. Salt and pepper to taste., Repeat. Add cream of mushroom soup., Top with crumbs., Bake, uncovered, at 325° for 30 minutes.

title: Oatmeal Waffles
directions: Soak the ingredients overnight., Next morning, add 1/4 cup oil., Mix well., Add extra water a little at a time to make lighter waffles., Bake in waffle iron on high., This recipe is for a large crowd.

title: Sherry Zucchini Cake
directions: Combine flour, cinnamon, soda, salt and baking powder, mixing well., Set aside., Beat together oil and sugar., Beat in eggs one at a time., Mix dry ingredients with wet ones., Add vanilla, sherry, zucchini (leave peel on unless tough) and lemon peel., Mix in nuts and raisins., Turn into well-greased 10-inch tube pan or 9-inch Bundt pan., Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 15 minutes or until a pick comes out clean when inserted in cake.

title: Green Pepper Steak
directions: Cut beef into thin strips. Combine soy sauce, garlic and ginger., Add beef., Toss and set aside., Heat oil in wok., Add beef and toss over high heat until browned. Add vegetables and cook 10 minutes., Mix cornstarch with water and add to beef., Stir and cook until thickened., Add tomato wedges.

title: Chicken Divine
directions: Put cheese on top of chicken in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix soup and milk and pour over the cheese. Top with dry stuffing., Cover tightly with foil and bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours., Makes 6 to 8 servings., This can be easily cut in half or doubled.

title: Lemon Cake
directions: Cream butter and sugar., Add eggs, lemon extract, flour and 7-Up., Grease and flour Bundt pan very good., Bake 1 hour and 15 minutes at 325°., Do not underbake., Make sure all ingredients are room temperature.

title: Peanut Butter Stew
directions: Cook sausage until browned; drain all drippings except 2 tablespoons., Saute onion in drippings until tender., In a greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish, layer the ingredients., Begin with 1/2 of the bread, then 1/2 sausage, 1/2 onions and 1/2 cheese., Repeat layers., Beat together the eggs, milk, salt, pepper and dry mustard, then pour over the layers., Cover and refrigerate for at least overnight before cooking., When ready to bake, remove dish from refrigerator 1 hour before baking to bring to room temperature, then bake at 350° for 50 minutes., Serves 10 to 12.

title: Steak A La Genevieve(This Is An Original)
directions: Break up tomatoes, placing about 1/2 the amount in baking dish. Place chicken steaks on top of tomatoes., Slice onions and peppers into strips about 1/2 inch wide., Place on top of meat., Pour remainder of broken-up tomatoes and juice on top., Sprinkle with salt and pepper as desired., Bake at 325° for 1 1/4 hours, tightly covered with foil.

title: Date Nut Pudding
directions: Beat eggs well., Add sugar and vanilla., Mix well., Add flour with baking powder and salt., Add bread, dates and nuts., Place in greased baking dish., Bake at 325° for 45 minutes or until brown. Serve with whipped cream.

title: Ground Beef Stew
directions: Brown meat and onion; drain., Add flour, salt, pepper and mushrooms., Simmer 5 minutes., Add soup; simmer 10 minutes., Stir in sour cream and noodles; sprinkle with parsley.

title: Layered Salad
directions: Put ingredients in layers., Lettuce in the bottom and peas on top., Spread 1 pint mayonnaise on top., Sprinkle with 1 or 2 tablespoons sugar., Cover with Romano or Parmesan cheese., Garnish with crumbled bacon or Bac*Os., Make 24 hours in advance.

title: Alex'S Favorite Zucchini Bread
directions: Sift dry ingredients together., Beat eggs well., Gradually add in oil and sugar., Add vanilla., Combine with flour mixture., Add grated zucchini.

title: Breakfast Pizza
directions: Cook sausage until browned; drain off excess fat., Separate crescent dough into 8 triangles., Place in an ungreased 12-inch pizza pan with points toward the center., Press over bottom and up sides to form a crust; seal perforations., Spoon sausage over crust., Sprinkle with potatoes., Top with Cheddar cheese.

title: Chicken In A Blanket
directions: Dice and brown the chicken in oil., Follow directions for cooking the soup., When the soup is done, add 1/2 of the package of cheese., Cook until melted.

title: French Bread
directions: Dissolve yeast in warm water in large bowl., Add salt and sugar., Stir in flour., Add enough flour to make dough thick enough to knead., Turn on floured board and knead 5 to 7 minutes., Place in greased bowl, turning to grease., Cover; let rise in warm place until double (about 1 to 1 1/2 hours)., Punch down., Divide into 2 balls., Let rest on lightly floured board, covered, 5 minutes. Grease hands and cookie sheets., Shape into 2 long French loaves. Make diagonal slits in top with razor blade or sharp knife., Cover; let rise until double (1 1/2 hours)., Bake in moderate oven., When lightly browned, remove from oven., Smooth over tops and sides of loaves, 1 slightly beaten egg white., Return to oven for 2 minutes.

title: Curried Rice
directions: Saute onion and green pepper in butter until onion is tender. Stir in curry powder, slightly beaten egg, salt, pepper and cayenne., Mix into hot rice; sprinkle with chopped olives if available.

title: Tea Cakes
directions: Cream sugar, oleo and egg and mix thoroughly., Add flour and soda., Gradually add vanilla., Roll in logs, about 2-inches in diameter., Make 4 to 5 rolls., Freeze and slice thin as needed. Cook in oven at about 350°.

title: Coca-Cola Salad
directions: Drain juice from pineapple and cherries., Combine and add 1 package each of cherry and strawberry jello., Bring to a boil, stirring lightly just to mix., Put in refrigerator; chill until it begins to thicken., Fold in pineapple, nuts and cut up cherries. Add the 2 regular size bottles of chilled Cokes., Stir lightly to mix, then chill for several hours until firm.

title: Pineapple Cookies
directions: Mix Crisco and sugar; add egg yolks., Then add dry ingredients., Add orange juice and work as a pie crust., Roll dough out on floured board rectangle shape., Cut dough into 2-inch squares, then spoon small amount of jam on each square., Fold two opposite corners overlapping each other., Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 350° until light brown., When cool, sprinkle with powdered sugar.

title: Orange Baked Pork Chops
directions: Cut fat from pork chops, if necessary., Place chops in large shallow baking dish., Combine the remaining ingredients; pour over chops., Bake at 350° for 1 hour., Baste occasionally while baking.

title: Sugar Cookies
directions: Mix well the oleo, oil, sugar and eggs., Add dry ingredients. Add vanilla., Drop by teaspoon onto greased cookie sheet or roll dough out and cut with cutter., Makes large batch., Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Cabbage And Potatoes
directions: Peel and cut potatoes into bite size pieces., Wash and cut cabbage into bite size pieces., Place in medium saucepan and cover with water., Add salt, pepper and margarine., Cook until potatoes and cabbage are tender., Serve hot.

title: Layered Hamburger Casserole
directions: Mix seasoning and salt and pepper to taste with hamburger or any seasoning you like., I also use Lipton onion soup mix or herb soup mix (1 package)., Add raw egg to meat and seasonings and mix thoroughly.

title: Mandarin Orange Salad
directions: Mix jello, hot water, cold water; let cool. Add sherbet, pineapple, and mandarin oranges. Use juice from pineapple and oranges. Let set till firm.

title: Aunt Jean'S Fruit Dessert
directions: Put all ingredients in bowl and mix., Ready!

title: Bananas Foster
directions: In chafing dish, flambe pan or large skillet., Melt brown sugar and butter; add bananas., Roll bananas in melted sugar and butter. Sprinkle with cinnamon, then saute until tender., Add banana liqueur and warm a few seconds and flambe., Baste bananas until flame is out., Serve banana slices and sauce over ice cream., Serve immediately., Yields 6 servings.

title: Sour Cream Chocolate Torte
directions: Prepare the package of fudge brownies according to box directions., Add vanilla extract, walnuts and cashews., Mix well. Spread in well-greased 15 x 10 x 1-inch pan., Bake in preheated 400° oven 10 to 12 minutes., Cool., Cut crosswise into three equal parts., Put layers together with layer of raspberry jam and chocolate frosting., Spread remaining frosting on top and garnish with coconut.

title: Kathy Thompson'S "Oh So Good" Cake
directions: Cream the margarine, Crisco and sugar., Add eggs, one at a time., Alternate cake mix and milk., Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes in a 9 x 13-inch pan or tube pan.

title: Pecan Pie
directions: Combine ingredients and pour into pie crusts., Cook in oven at 325° until done.

title: Chris' Tomato Beef Stew
directions: Brown meat in a large pot, then add garlic and saute., Add next 6 ingredients and add enough water to cover., Simmer until the meat is tender., Peel and cut the raw vegetables, then add to stew with drained beans., Cook until vegetables are also tender. Remove the bay leaves before serving.

title: Corn Fritters
directions: In a large bowl, beat the egg yolks until light yellow., Add the corn, flour, salt and pepper., In another large, grease-free bowl, use an hand-held electric mixer set at medium-high speed and beat the egg whites until they just start to form stiff peaks when the beaters are lifted., Using a rubber spatula, fold 1/3 of the beaten egg whites into the corn mixture to lighten it., Fold in the remaining egg whites., Heat the oil to 375° in a deep-fat fryer or a heavy saucepan., Drop the batter from a measuring tablespoon into the oil., Only cook 5 to 6 at a time, turning occasionally so that they brown evenly., Using a slotted spoon, remove the fritters to several layers of paper towels to drain., Keep warm in a 250° oven until ready to serve., Makes 4 servings.

title: Herb Marinated Chicken
directions: Prick chicken parts on all sides with a fork., Marinate chicken, turning occasionally for at least 2 hours., Bake at 350° for 50 minutes, uncovered.

title: Clam Mushroom Salad
directions: Core, rinse and drain lettuce., Chill in disposable plastic bag or plastic crisper., Clean mushrooms with damp paper towels; trim stems., Slice lengthwise., Combine clam juice, oil, vinegar, salt, tarragon and Tabasco in large jar or juice container; cover and shake well., Add mushrooms and onion., Shake to coat., Chill., Tear enough lettuce to make 5 cups., Chill remainder for use another time., Cut tomato into wedges., Combine with lettuce and mushroom mixture in large salad bowl; toss lightly., Add fresh clams to taste., Makes 5 to 6 servings.

title: Cheesecake Squares
directions: With fork, stir until crumbly the flour, brown sugar, nuts and butter., With spoon, reserve enough to fill a cup and press the rest into an 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan., Bake in preheated 350° oven for 12 to 15 minutes., Beat together remaining ingredients until smooth., Pour into crust., Sprinkle with saved topping., Return to oven for 25 minutes., Cool completely., Cut into bars., Store in refrigerator.

title: Chewy O'S
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Melt butter and pour in 9 x 13-inch pan or jelly roll pan., Cover bottom., Sprinkle cake mix over butter. Sprinkle marshmallows, chocolate chips and Cheerios.

title: Squash Dressing
directions: Saute onion and celery in butter until tender., Add to corn bread and squash and stir well., Stir in remaining ingredients, mixing well., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes until lightly browned.

title: Country Style Chicken Noodle Casserole
directions: Cook noodles as directed; drain., In saucepan, melt 1/4 cup butter; blend in flour., Add broth and cream, stirring until thickened., Add cooking wine, salt and pepper., In medium skillet, melt remaining butter., Add mushrooms., Cook until tender., Add mushrooms and chicken to sauce., Pour in a greased 2-quart casserole., Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes until cheese is golden., Serves 6.

title: Cocoa
directions: In a saucepan, combine sugar, cocoa, water and salt., Cook over low heat., Stir in milk., Cook over medium heat (don't boil).

title: Mimosa Mold
directions: Stir boiling water into Jell-O in large bowl at least 2 minutes until completely dissolved., Stir in Club soda. Refrigerate 1 1/2 hours or until thick (spoon dragged through leaves definite impression)., Stir in oranges and strawberries. Pour into 6 cups Jell-O mold sprayed with nonstick spray. Refrigerate 4 hours.

title: New Pumpkin Pound Cake
directions: Have, all ingredients room temperature., Beat margarine at medium speed 2 minutes. Gradually add sugar beating continuously over, 7, minutes., After, 7 minutes, add eggs, one at a time, just until yellow disappears., Combine flour and next 6 ingredients., Combine, pumpkin, and, next 2 ingredients. Begin with flour mixture and, end with flour mixture. Alternate with pumpkin mixture., Mix at, lowest, speed, just, until, blended. Grease well and flour a tube, pan. Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 25 to 30 minutes. Test, for doneness. Cool on rack 10 minutes. Remove from pan., Ice with a cream cheese icing.

title: Miniature Reuben Sandwiches
directions: Butter one side of party rye slice., Place buttered side down on a cookie sheet., Spread each slice with Thousand Island dressing., Cover bread with corned beef., Spread sauerkraut over corned beef., Place slice of Swiss cheese over sauerkraut., Cover with second slice of party rye, Thousand Island side over Swiss cheese., Stick toothpick into sandwich., Bake 10 minutes in a 325° oven.

title: Banana Mallow Pie
directions: Combine 2 cups vanilla wafer crumbs and 1/3 cup Parkay margarine (melted)., Press into 9-inch pie plate., Bake at 375° for 8 minutes.

title: Hash Brown Quiche
directions: Press hash brown potatoes between paper towels to remove moisture., Press hash browns onto bottom and up sides of a 9-inch pie plate to form a crust., Drizzle melted margarine over crust. Bake crust in preheated 425° oven for 20 to 25 minutes until lightly browned., Remove from oven., Reduce oven temperature to 350°., Toss together the ham; cheeses and hot pepper sauce., Place in crust., Beat the eggs, milk and seasoned salt together to form a smooth mixture., Pour over ham and cheese., Bake uncovered in 350° oven for 25 to 30 minutes until knife comes out clean., Let stand for 10 minutes.

title: Sugarless Applesauce Cake
directions: Combine raisins, fruit and water in a pan; cook, uncovered, until water is evaporated and fruit is soft., Set aside to cool.

title: Mayonnaise Cake
directions: Sift and mix dry ingredients together., Add mayonnaise, coffee and vanilla., Mix with dry ingredients until moist., Grease and flour two 9-inch round pans or one 13 x 9-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes., Test center with a toothpick.

title: Salmon Cakes Deluxe
directions: Drain juice from salmon into a bowl., Set salmon aside., Add bread crumbs to juice; let stand until thick., Stir next 6 ingredients and mix well., Add salmon and stir., Makes 6 or 7 cakes., Fry as you would crab cakes.

title: Macaroni And Cheese
directions: Cook macaroni in 4 cups boiling salted water., Stir often to prevent sticking., When tender, add cheese and margarine to drained macaroni., Beat eggs well; add milk and flour, using a wire whisk to dissolve lumps., Put macaroni mixture in a greased casserole dish., Pour milk and egg mixture over macaroni., Bake at 400° until "set" and slightly browned on top.

title: Almond Roca
directions: Melt butter., Add sugar, water and syrup., Cook slowly until mixture reaches hard crack., Pour into buttered pan., When slightly cool, cover with melted chocolate and almonds., When cold, break into pieces.

title: Lauren'S Favorite Tuna Sandwich
directions: Mix all together., Add whatever more mayo you want., Chill. Serve on wheat bread topped with sliced tomato and cucumbers.

title: Potato-Broccoli Cheese Soup
directions: Cook potatoes until tender., In the meantime, cook celery and carrots in small saucepan with a little water., Fry bacon with onion and drain., When potatoes are tender (do not drain water), mix with electric mixer until potatoes are small., Add bacon, onion, carrots, celery, bouillon cube and frozen broccoli., Simmer and add cheese until melted., Salt and pepper to taste., If too thick, add milk to thin.

title: Orange Mallow Frost
directions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water., Add sherbet; stir until dissolved., Chill until almost set; fold in fruit and marshmallows., Fill 6 dessert dishes; chill until firm., Garnish with extra orange slices., Makes 6 servings.

title: Praline Coffee
directions: In Dutch oven, combine coffee, milk and sugar; stir., Cook over medium heat until boiling; remove from heat., Stir in ice cream, vodka, vanilla and maple flavoring., Serve hot., Yield: 20 (6 ounce) servings.

title: Creme Brulee With Fresh Fruit
directions: Early in day or day ahead:

title: Old Fashioned Cream Pie
directions: Mix together sugars and flour., Add the rest of the ingredients., Stir together well and pour into two 9-inch pie shells., Sprinkle nutmeg over top of pies., Bake at 375° for 10 minutes and 350° for 30 minutes until firm in the middle.

title: Crusty Beef Casserole
directions: Cook ground beef, onion and garlic in a skillet until meat is browned, stirring to crumble., Drain off pan drippings., Stir in tomato sauce and chili powder., Pour into a lightly greased baking dish., Top with cheese., Spoon beans over cheese., Prepare cornbread., Pour over beans., Bake at 400° for 25 minutes or until cornbread is golden brown.

title: Chocolate Sheet Cake
directions: Heat oleo, oil and water to boiling., In mixing bowl, combine remaining ingredients., Pour boiling mixture over dry ingredients. Mix well., Add 1/2 cup buttermilk to which 1 teaspoon baking soda has been added., Stir and add 2 eggs and 1 teaspoon vanilla., Mix well., Mixture will be thin., Pour in a jelly roll pan (or 10 x 15-inch pan), greased with butter., Bake 20 minutes at 400°.

title: Pork Barbecue
directions: Mix all ingredients., Bake, covered, 3 1/2 hours at 350°., Take meat apart with fork., Bake 10 minutes longer, uncovered.

title: Spinach Dip
directions: Thaw and squeeze spinach., Add remaining ingredients in order; blend well., Cover and refrigerate until ready to use., Serve with fresh cut vegetables.

title: Rhubarb Jello Cake
directions: Mix dry ingredients and cut in butter., Add egg and milk., Mix well., Put into ungreased 6 1/2 x 10 1/2-inch pan., Push up on side of pan., Spread 3 cups cut up rhubarb on top., Sprinkle with 1 (3 ounce) package cherry jello.

title: Surprise Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 325°., Cream margarine and sugar until light and fluffy., Stir in flour, rum extract and nuts; blend well. Wrap a tablespoon of dough around each cherry., Place on ungreased cookie sheet., Bake for 25 minutes, cool slightly., Roll in additional powdered sugar and finely chopped nuts.

title: Ice Cream Pie
directions: Small mixing bowl; mix together 1 1/3 cup crumbs and sugar. Stir in butter., Press into 9-inch pan., Bake in preheated 350° oven for 5 minutes., Cool on wire rack.

title: Blueberry Cake
directions: Cream shortening; add sugar and flavoring., Beat until fluffy., Add egg; beat well., Add milk alternately with mixed and sifted dry ingredients; beat until smooth., Fold in floured blueberries. Turn into greased and paper-lined 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan and bake in moderate oven, 375°, for 40 minutes.

title: Ginger Ale Salad
directions: Dissolve Jell-O in 1 cup hot water., Add ginger ale and chill until slightly thickened., Fold in peaches, nut meats, and diced celery., Turn into 1 quart mold or individual molds., Chill until firm., Unmold on crisp lettuce., Serve with whipped cream or mayonnaise., Makes 6 servings.

title: Vegetable Pizza
directions: Line 10 x 15-inch baking pan with roll dough, pressing edges and perforations to seal., Bake at 350° for 12 minutes., Cool to room temperature.

title: Humus Tahini
directions: Partially drain chick peas., Place all ingredients in a blender; blend until smooth., Let it sit in refrigerator for at least 8 hours., Serve with crackers or fresh vegetables.

title: Turned-On Burgers
directions: Combine pepperoni, cheese and mustard., Shape ground beef into 12 thin patties., Top 6 patties with cheese mixture; cover with remaining 6 patties., Press edges together and seal., Broil or pan-fry., Serve on buns garnished with onion, tomato, pepper and radish., Makes 6 servings.

title: Basic Syrup Recipe
directions: Boil for, 3, minutes, (stir, and keep full boil)., Pour into hot sterile jars with sterile lids and seals.

title: Baked Caramel Corn
directions: Melt butter., Stir in brown sugar, syrup and salt., Bring to a boil, stirring constantly., Remove from heat., Stir in baking soda and vanilla., Gradually pour over popped corn and peanuts., Mix well with greased hands., Turn into 2 large shallow pans., Bake at 250° for 1 hour, stirring every 15 minutes., Remove from oven. Cool., Break apart and store in covered containers.

title: Hamburger Noodle Bake
directions: Melt butter in skillet., Toss in meat., Crush garlic and mix meat, salt, pepper and tomato sauce., Cover and cook slowly 15 to 20 minutes., Cook and drain noodles., Chop onions and mix with cream cheese and sour cream., In large casserole, put 1/3 noodles in bottom., Spread 1/3 scallion mix over noodles with 1/2 meat sauce., Repeat layers twice., Sprinkle Cheddar cheese over., Bake at 350° for 25 minutes., Serves 6.

title: Pizza Dough
directions: Mix flour, salt, sugar, shortening and yeast., Add water and mix by hand until mixture is not sticky (add more flour if needed)., Let rise until pan is full, then make into pizza crust or bread., Bake until golden brown at 375°.

title: Choplets And Pasta
directions: In a large pot, boil 10 cups of water., Make sure the water is very hot and boiling., Add 1 teaspoon oil and 1/2 teaspoon salt to boiling water., Add noodles, stir and boil about 5 to 6 minutes. Test for doneness by cutting with fork and tasting., Drain in colander; do not rinse in cold water., Pour pasta into dish and put in margarine; let melt., Add Accent and stir to avoid noodles sticking.

title: Stoby'S Cheese Dip
directions: Bring first 6 ingredients to a boil., Add Velveeta., In another bowl mix margarine and flour., Add to other mixture., Add picante sauce, chili and lemon juice. Simmer.

title: Layered Shortbread Bars
directions: Preheat oven to 325°., Grease and flour 8-inch square pan. In large bowl, cream sugar, margarine and egg., Stir in flour, one cup at a time., Stir in pecans., Divide dough into 2 balls; wrap 1/2 in plastic while preparing remainder., Press remaining dough into pan., Spread with preserves to within 1/2-inch from edge of pan., Sprinkle with chocolate chips and cinnamon., Pat out remaining dough between plastic wrap to shape of pan and cover over mixture., Press edges to seal., Bake until golden, about 60 minutes., Score while hot; cut when cool.

title: Gelatin Layer Salad
directions: Mix lime Jell-O, pineapple, 2 cups boiling water and 1 cup cold water., Let set., Whip cream and set aside.

title: Slush Punch
directions: Dissolve Jell-O in hot water., Add sugar and pineapple juice. Freeze., Remove from freezer in time for it to thaw just to slush stage., Add cold ginger ale before serving.

title: Beef Rolls Warsaw Style
directions: Cut flank steak into wide strips or buy them in the store. Pound each strip well., Fry the bacon until golden., Remove from the drippings., Mix the bacon, onion and bread crumbs., Add 2 tablespoons bacon drippings and as much water as needed to get a sour cream consistency., Season with salt and pepper to your taste., Spread stuffing on each strip of meat., Roll and fasten with toothpicks., Sprinkle with flour., Brown them in hot drippings, then transfer beef rolls to a baking dish., Add 1/2 cup water., Cover and bake in moderate oven at 350° for 1 hour., Serve with noodles or rice and a tossed salad., Serves four.

title: Venus De Milo Soup
directions: Cook beef with butter and onion., Add water, tomatoes and paste; cook for about 20 minutes., Add shells and let cook., Add Veg-All and mushrooms., Salt and pepper to taste.

title: Gram Schrauder'S Custard With Peaches
directions: Beat eggs, then add sugar, salt and cornstarch., Last, add hot milk and vanilla., Cook slow, stirring all the time, until thick. Add sliced peaches when cool.

title: Peanut Butter Pie (No Bake)
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Place in a baked pie shell. Do not bake., Place in refrigerator for 2 to 3 hours before serving.

title: Sweet And Sour Chicken(Chinese)
directions: In large skillet or wok, stir-fry onion in garlic and ginger in hot oil for 1 minute., Add peppers and stir until crisp-tender., Remove from pan and add chicken., Stir-fry until cooked., Return vegetables to pan., Mix cornstarch with soy sauce, pineapple juice, vinegar and sugar., Pour into pan., Add pineapple chunks., Bring to a full boil., Serve with hot rice., Makes 4 servings.

title: Frog Eye Salad
directions: Cook macaroni until tender, drain., Cook fruit juices, eggs, sugar and flour until it thickens., Cool, add fruit, soup macaroni and Cool Whip., Add marshmallows and refrigerate., Makes large salad and can be frozen.

title: Easy Fudge (Fantasy Fudge)
directions: Combine sugar, margarine and milk in heavy 2-1/2 quart saucepan., Bring to full rolling boil, stirring constantly. Continue boiling 5 minutes over medium heat, stirring constantly to prevent scorching., Remove from heat, stir in chocolate pieces until melted., Add marshmallow creme, nuts and vanilla, beating until well blended., Pour into greased 13 x 9 pan., Cool to room temperature., Cut into squares., Makes 3 lbs.

title: Dry Hot Chocolate Mix
directions: Mix all ingredients well., Store in tight container., The mix can be put in decorated jars or small tins and be given at Christmas., Use 1/3 cup of the powder to 1 cup of hot water.

title: Mom'S Macaroni And Cheese
directions: Combine macaroni in 2 cups warm water., Microwave for 4 minutes on High., Stir., Microwave 4 minutes more., Stir again. Mix cornstarch with milk., Heat milk and cornstarch mixture with butter until butter melts; stir to prevent lumping, then add cheese and mustard., Stir well., Add salt and pepper to taste. Combine mixture with macaroni in casserole dish., Bake until cheese melts., Dot bread crumbs with butter., Brown in oven until butter melts.

title: Oma'S Crepes
directions: Whisk together eggs, milk and flour., Melt about a heaping teaspoonful of shortening in large frying pan (cast-iron or Teflon works best)., When hot, put large ladle of batter in pan, moving pan side to side to thin out batter to size of bottom of pan. When lightly browned, quickly turn with spatula and brown a minute on other side., Put on plate., Fill center with fruit, jam or sprinkle with powdered sugar., Roll up and serve., Serves 4, about 8 crepes.

title: Hot Chocolate Mix
directions: Mix all ingredients together and store in a tight container. Use 1/2 cup mix to 1 cup hot water for 1 cup hot chocolate.

title: Double Peanut Butter Cookies
directions: Combine the first 4 ingredients; beat in eggs and vanilla. Stir together the flour and soda; blend into batter., Stir in nuts., Form into 1-inch balls., Place on ungreased cookie sheet; flatten slightly with fingers., Bake at 350° for 10 minutes, or until slightly tan on edges., Cool slightly on cookie sheet; remove to wire rack to cool completely., Makes 6 dozen small cookies or 3 dozen large cookies.

title: Green Tomatoes
directions: Mix flour, salt and pepper., Coat tomatoes., Fry in oil or butter., Sprinkle with brown sugar., Garnish with onion and pepper.

title: Date Bars
directions: Beat egg, add sugar and mix well., Add oil, mix well. Add dates and walnuts., Sift dry ingredients and add, mixing well. Bake in a greased and floured 8 x 8 x 2-inch baking pan at 325° for 25 minutes., Cut into bars and sprinkle with powdered sugar.

title: Sugarless Cookies(Yield: 32 To 34 Cookies)
directions: Preheat oven to 375°. Combine dry ingredients. Add remaining ingredients; mix well. Drop by teaspoon on ungreased cookie sheet to make 32 to 34 cookies. Bake about 15 to 20 minutes. When done, remove from pan and cool.

title: Chicken Kelly(For A Party, Serves 25)
directions: Cut up chicken in bite size pieces., Beat eggs and pour over chicken., Refrigerate for 2 hours., Pour bread crumbs into bag with garlic and parsley., Shake., Put chicken into bag and shake until the chicken is coated., Heat 1 1/2 cups oil in frying pan and brown chicken., Place chicken in baking dish, layering chicken and mushrooms alternately., Put sliced or grated cheese on top. Dissolve 4 bouillon cubes in 2 cups boiling water and pour over cheese., Cover and bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Popovers
directions: Heat oven to 425°., Beat eggs with rotary beater until light and thick., Add flour, salt and 1/2 the milk., Continue to beat slowly until all flour is moistened (30 seconds)., Gradually add remaining milk and melted butter., Beat until free from lumps (1 to 2 minutes)., Fill greased pans a little less than 1/2 full. Bake at 425° for 40 to 45 minutes., Serve at once.

title: Cheeseburger Casserole(Yield 4 To 6 Servings)
directions: Cook beef and onion until meat is lightly browned; drain., Add salt in ketchup and tomato sauce and heat thoroughly; turn into 8 inch square or 1 1/2 quart casserole dish., Cut cheese into thin strips and lay over meat., Top with pizza crust., Bake at 425° for 20 to 25 minutes or until crust is brown.

title: Melissa'S Coffee Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., Lightly grease a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan., Sift 2 3/4 cups flour with baking powder and salt., In large mixing bowl, with electric mixer at medium speed, beat butter with brown sugar and eggs., Beat until mixture is light and fluffy., At low speed, blend in milk, then flour mixture; beat just to combine., Turn batter into prepared pan, spreading evenly.

title: Twice-Filled Potatoes(Makes 4 Servings)
directions: Bake foil-wrapped potatoes in a 375° oven for 1 hour, until they give when lightly squeezed; turn after 30 minutes., Remove foil., When cool enough to handle, slice top quarter off., Scoop out inside without breaking skin; place flesh in a large bowl., Add cottage cheese, yogurt, celery, red pepper, chives, mustard, horseradish and thyme., Fill shells with filling., Sprinkle with Mozzarella cheese., Bake on cookie sheet in a 375° oven until cheese is melted.

title: Strawberry Pie
directions: Mash half of strawberries and put in heavy pan with sugar combined with cornstarch, butter and lemon juice., Cook until thick and clear., Mix cream cheese with milk and powdered sugar and spread over baked pie shell., Put rest of berries on cheese. Spread cooked mixture on this., Chill for 2 hours.

title: Ambrosia Fruit Salad
