Place on a greased baking sheet., Cut 1 1/2 inches toward center, 1 inch apart, 1/3 way through., Bake at 400° for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Eggplant Patties
directions: Peel eggplant and cut into small pieces., Boil in salted water until tender., Drain well., Mash and stir in other ingredients. Mix well., Drop by teaspoon onto well-greased griddle., Fry on both sides until golden brown.

title: Cream Cheese Pound Cake
directions: Cream the cream cheese, butter and sugar; add vanilla., Add flour 1 cup at a time alternately with eggs., Bake in greased and floured tube pan at 325° for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Glorified Chicken
directions: Skillet:, In skillet over medium heat, in hot oil cook chicken 10 minutes or until browned on all sides., Spoon off fat., Stir in soup, pepper and thyme., Reduce heat to low., Cover; simmer 35 minutes or until chicken is fork-tender, stirring occasionally. Oven:, Substitute 1 tablespoon melted margarine for oil., In 12 x 8-inch baking dish arrange chicken skin side up., Drizzle with margarine., Bake at 375° for 40 minutes., Spoon soup, pepper and thyme over chicken., Bake 20 minutes more or until chicken is fork-tender., Stir sauce before serving., Skillet cook time is 45 minutes; oven cook time is 60 minutes.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Boil chicken until tender; remove skin and debone., Cut in small pieces., Cook wild rice according to directions on box. Saute chopped onion, green onion, celery and bell pepper in oleo; mix with chicken., Alternate rice mixture and chicken in casserole dish., Add mushroom soup on top., Add mushrooms and juice., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Ritz Chicken Casserole
directions: Boil chicken until done and remove from bone., Cut into small pieces., Place on bottom of a casserole dish., Combine chestnuts, sour cream, water, and soup., Spread over chicken., Crush crackers and spread them over the soup mixture., Melt butter and drizzle it over the crackers., Bake at 350 degrees for 30 - 35 minutes.

title: Meat Pie
directions: Press hamburger into pie pan., Press up on to edge., Lay cheese on top of hamburger. Spread tomato paste on top of cheese. Bake in a 350° oven until hamburger is done (about 25 to 30 minutes).

title: Hash Brown Hot Dish
directions: Mix and cover in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Refrigerate overnight. Before baking, cover with 1 cup crushed corn flakes mixed with 3 tablespoons melted butter., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Believe It Or Not Cookies(Made Without Flour)
directions: Mix all ingredients lightly until evenly blended., Do not overmix., Roll in small ball; put on ungreased baking sheet. Press flat with fork., Bake for 10 minutes at 350°., When cool, roll in powdered sugar., Makes 100 cookies., Absolutely delicious!

title: Chocolate Butter Fudge Candy
directions: Mix sugar and dry gelatin in saucepan., Add milk, syrup, chocolate and margarine and cook over medium heat, stirring frequently, until candy reaches 238° on candy thermometer or a few drops tested in cold water form a soft ball which flattens on removal from water., (Candy will be much thicker than ordinary candy.), Remove from heat; add vanilla and cool 15 minutes., Beat until thick; stir in nuts and spread on buttered pan., If candy is not hard enough, chill for an hour or so.

title: Marinated Salad
directions: Marinate in Good Seasons Italian dressing., Add raw spinach for filler and color if needed., Sprinkle with a little Feta cheese.

title: Red Cabbage
directions: Shred red cabbage; slice apples, peel onion and spike with cloves and add all other ingredients to large pot, adding enough water to keep cabbage from burning., Bring to boil, stirring occasionally., Add more water if necessary and simmer on low heat until cabbage is done.

title: German Chocolate Upside-Down Cake
directions: Butter bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan., Place nuts and coconut in bottom., Mix cake mix as directed on box., Pour over coconut and pecans., Melt butter and cream cheese., Add sugar., Mix and pour over cake mix., Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Gingersnaps
directions: Cream butter and sugar in mixing bowl., Add egg and molasses; beat well. Sift together dry ingredients; gradually add to creamed mixture., Mix well. Chill dough 1 to 2 hours., Roll into 1 1/4-inch balls and dip in sugar., Place 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet., Bake at 375° for about 10 minutes or until set and surface cracks., (Cookies will be chewy.), Cool on wire rack. Yields approximately 4 dozen.

title: Melt Away Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients together and pat into a greased 10 x 13-inch glass dish.

title: Vinegar Pie
directions: Mix water, vinegar and salt., Sift dry ingredients and add to the boiling vinegar, water and salt., Stir constantly., Cook until flour is well done., If you like, add a little nutmeg., If mixture becomes stiff become the flour is done, add a little hot water. Pour into baked pie shells.

title: Dora Marsh'S Own Cake For Strawberry Shortcake
directions: Mix thoroughly., Bake in an iron skillet at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Meat Loaf
directions: Mix all ingredients and form into a loaf. Bake in a 350° oven for 45 minutes.

title: Spiced Venison
directions: Roll deer meat in flour., Fry in vegetable oil at a slow fry. Sprinkle in salt and pepper to suit you., Sprinkle in Italian and oregano seasonings (small amounts)., Sprinkle in a pinch of sage. Add 1 cup fresh diced onions., Fry at low temperature under lid until brown and tender.

title: Stuffed Cabbage Bundles
directions: Boil cabbage until leaves are wilted; separate leaves., Mix all other ingredients and mold into egg-size balls., Place each on a cabbage leaf; wrap and fasten with toothpicks., Brown lightly in a greased skillet., Cover and simmer 1 1/2 hours., Add a small amount of water if necessary., You may serve with tomato sauce or plain. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Mayo Salad Dressing
directions: Mix all ingredients together with blender on high speed until thick and creamy.

title: Angel Biscuits
directions: In mixer with flat beater, mix first 6 ingredients., Let yeast mixture proof until foamy., Add to dry ingredients along with buttermilk., Mix until well blended and turn out onto well floured board and knead into a nice smooth ball., Roll out to 1/2-inch and cut with cutter., Place on well-greased sheet pan., Allow to rise 3 to 4 hours., Preheat oven to 400°., Cook until a nice golden brown (approximately 20 minutes)., Wonderful buttered with a slice of Smithfield ham!, Bet you can't eat just one!

title: Breakfast Sausage
directions: Mix all ingredients well in bowl., Chill overnight., Form into 8 patties., Fry slowly until brown on each side.

title: Philly Fruit Pizza
directions: *Fruit may be fresh or frozen (thawed and drained).

title: Not-Too-Sweet Pecan Pie
directions: Cream sugar, butter and salt., Beat in eggs, one at a time. Add corn syrup and mix well., Stir in pecans and vanilla., Pour into unbaked nine-inch pie shell., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes, until knife inserted one-inch from edge comes out clean.

title: Breakfast Pizza
directions: Line a deep dish pizza pan or a 13 x 9-inch pan with crescent rolls., Crumble browned, drained sausage over rolls., Cook hash browns and spread over sausage., Sprinkle cheese over potatoes. Break eggs; add milk., Beat and pour over cheese., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Fluffy Dumplings
directions: Sift dry ingredients and mix., Combine milk and oil., Add to dry ingredients., Stir until moist., Drop from tablespoon on top of bubbling broth, or stew., Cover tightly., Bring to a boil and then reduce heat., (Do not lift lid.), Simmer 12 to 15 minutes. Makes 5 servings.

title: Meat Loaf
directions: Soak bread crumbs in milk., Add meat, eggs, onion and seasonings., Mix well., Place in greased pan., Cover and bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Cranberry Salad
directions: Pour 1 cup boiling water over gelatin and stir., Mash sauce with fork until mushy., Combine all ingredients and allow to set.

title: Sun Pickles
directions: Bring to boil the water and salt; set aside to cool.

title: Strawberry Shortcake
directions: Beat the eggs., Beat with the shortening and sugar until fluffy., Sift together the flour, baking powder and salt., Add to the egg mixture alternately with the milk until the batter is smooth., Pour into a 9 x 13-inch baking pan., Bake in a 350° oven for 50 minutes.

title: Butter Pecan Dessert
directions: Mix, graham cracker crumbs and Ritz cracker crumbs with melted margarine., Press	into, 13, x 9-inch glass casserole. Bake at 350° for 10 minutes and cool., Mix ice cream with milk and pudding., Pour, over crust., Top with Cool Whip., Sprinkle crushed Heath bars on top.	Freeze.

title: Chocolate Crumb Bars
directions: Mix butter, flour, sugar and salt until crumbly., With floured fingers, press 2 cups crumb mixture onto bottom of pan, reserving remaining mixture., Bake at 350 for 10-12 minutes.

title: Mashed Potato Cakes(Makes 4 Servings)
directions: Combine potatoes, egg, onion and parsley., Shape into round cakes about 3/4-inch thick., Brown cakes on both sides in hot Crisco., Serve hot with eggs for breakfast.

title: Hummus
directions: Cook the chickpeas with salt for 20 minutes in the pressure cooker (or until peas are soft)., Drain chickpeas., Combine with other ingredients in blender., Blend until creamy.

title: Banana Nut Bread
directions: Sift together the flour, baking powder, soda and salt., Cream butter and sugar; add eggs., Add bananas and milk., Mix well. Blend in dry ingredients., Stir in vanilla and nuts., Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes in a 9 x 5-inch pan or 40 to 50 minutes in 2 (7 x 3 1/4-inch) pans.

title: Quick Guacamole Dip
directions: Mix all together and chill., Serve with Fritos., Makes about 2 cups.

title: Smoked Arctic Salmon Log
directions: Combine all ingredients, except fish and pecans., After mixing these items, stir in fish., Chill in a fish mold, or shape into a log after rolling in pecans., Serve with cocktail rye squares or crackers.

title: Cheese Ball
directions: Let cheese soften., Mix all ingredients together and roll in pecans.

title: Queen'S Chocolate Cake
directions: Place chocolate morsels in top of a double boiler; bring water to a boil., Reduce heat to low; cook, stirring occasionally, until chocolate melts., Remove from hot water; let cool completely. Stir in rum., Combine egg whites, cream of tartar and salt in a small mixing bowl; beat at medium speed of an electric mixer until foamy., Add 2 tablespoons sugar, 1 tablespoon at a time, beating at high speed until stiff peaks form., Cover; set aside.

title: Fried Squash Patties
directions: Mix all ingredients and fry in hot skillet, turning once. Easy to make., Even squash haters will like it.

title: Italian Cheese Bread
directions: * Such as garlic, pepper, etc.

title: Asparagus-Cucumber Mold
directions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling, water;, let cool.	Combine soup, mayonnaise and pepper;, stir, into gelatin mixture., Add remaining ingredients, mixing well., Pour into a lightly oiled 4-cup mold; chill until firm., Yield: 8 servings.

title: Melting Moments
directions: In a bowl stir flour, cornstarch and sugar together. Add softened butter and mix., Roll into 1-inch balls and roll in sugar., Place on ungreased cookie sheet., Stamp top of balls with a glass, etc., to make a design., Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes. Don't brown.

title: Congealed Salad
directions: Mix Jell-O and water and let set until partially jelled., Mix in other ingredients., Top with pecan halves and chill until completely jelled.

title: Heavenly Combo
directions: Mix Tang and pineapple juice with vanilla pudding until well blended., Fold in fruit; chill thoroughly., Serve with whipped topping.

title: Tomato-Topped Fish Fillets
directions: About 30 minutes before serving:, Preheat oven to 350°., In a large, shallow baking dish in oven, melt butter or margarine. With pot holders, remove dish from oven; stir in lemon juice., Dip fillets in mixture, turning to coat both sides.

title: Off-Beat Carrots
directions: Scrape, wash and slice carrots., Cook with some water in saucepan until tender., Drain., Mix mayonnaise, horseradish and onion and add to cooked carrots., Mix bread crumbs and melted butter., Spread on top of carrots., Bake at 350° for 15 minutes or until brown.

title: Best Ever Cheese Ball
directions: Mix all together (can be divided to make different flavors). Roll in chopped nuts and chill.

title: Creamy Baked Chicken Breasts
directions: Arrange chicken in lightly greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish., Top with ham and cheese slices., Combine soup and wine together., Spoon soup mixture over chicken and sprinkle with stuffing mix., Drizzle butter over crumbs., Bake at 350° for 45 to 55 minutes.

title: 7-Up Cake
directions: Cream together sugar, oleo and Crisco., Add eggs and mix well. Add flour, 7-Up and extract., Mix well., Bake 1 hour and 15 minutes at 350° in greased and floured tube pan.

title: Smoked Top Round Of Beef
directions: Marinate meat 1 or 2 days before smoking., Keep meat in cooler at	32° to	40°, while marinating.

title: Quick Lemon Pie
directions: *Equals 2/8 of a cup + 1 tablespoon.

title: Cheese Straws(In Cookie Form)
directions: Soften margarine and cheese., When soft, mix with flour and add salt and red pepper., Mix well., Add Rice Krispies., Make in small balls and mash flat., Bake at 325° for 15 to 20 minutes. Let cool and store in airtight container., (Makes approximately 35.)

title: Mayonnaise Cake
directions: Sift flour, sugar, soda, cocoa and salt into large bowl. Combine mayonnaise, cold water and vanilla in small bowl; mix well., Add to flour mixture; mix well., Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes., Use your own frosting mix or serve with Cool Whip.

title: Graham Yogurt Bread
directions: Remove one end from each of four 1-pound cans (the kind used for canned fruits and vegetables); rinse cans, dry and grease well., In a large bowl, combine the graham and all-purpose flours, soda and salt., Stir in yogurt, molasses, raisins and walnuts; mix well., Divide batter evenly between cans., Bake in a 350° oven for about 1 hour or until a wooden pick inserted in the center comes out clean., Cool in cans 10 minutes; then turn out and stand loaves upright on a wire rack to cool completely., Cut loaves crosswise to make thick or thin slices as you prefer., Makes 4 small loaves.

title: Overnight Fruit Salad
directions: Cook pudding mix as directed on package, using 1 1/2 cups pineapple juice for the liquid instead of milk., Cool., When cooled, fold in fruit., Put into a glass serving bowl., Cover and refrigerate overnight.

title: Dump Cake
directions: Melt 3 tablespoons butter in 9 x 12-inch cake pan., Add pie filling and, pineapple., Smooth as it is mixed., Dump cake mix on top, of, fruit., Dot, with remaining butter., Sprinkle with brown sugar., Bake 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Big Soft Ginger Cookies
directions: Combine flour, ginger, soda, cinnamon, cloves and salt., Set aside., In large mixing bowl beat oleo or other shortening with electric mixer on low speed for 30 seconds to soften., Gradually add the 1 cup of sugar and beat until fluffy., Add eggs and molasses and beat well., Stir dry ingredients into beaten mixture. Shape into 1 1/2-inch balls (1 heaping tablespoonful dough each). Roll in 2 tablespoons sugar and place on ungreased cookie sheet 2 1/2 inches apart., Bake at 350° about 11 minutes or until light brown and still puffed., (Do not overbake.), Let stand for 2 minutes to cool., Makes 24 (3-inch) cookies.

title: Hamburger Stroganoff
directions: Brown hamburger with onion., Add soups and sour cream; simmer at least 30 minutes., Serve hot over noodles or rice., Freezes well., Serves 6.

title: Meat Ball And Kidney Bean Casserole
directions: Combine milk, bread crumbs, salt, pepper, chili powder and meat., Mix thoroughly. Shape into small size balls., Place shortening in skillet. When it is hot, drop in meat balls and brown lightly. Turn frequently to brown evenly. Remove meat balls. Cook onion in same shortening until lightly brown. Add tomato sauce and cheese squares. Stir gently until mixed. Drain liquid from beans and pour into greased baking dish. Arrange meat balls on beans., Add sauce., Place pepper rings on top., Bake in moderate oven at 350° for 50 minutes.

title: Swiss Vegetable Medley(Serves 6)
directions: Combine vegetable soup, 1/2 cheese, sour cream, pepper and 1 can Durkee onions., Pour into 1-quart casserole., Bake, covered, at 350° for 30 minutes., Top with remaining cheese and onions. Bake, uncovered, 5 minutes longer.

title: Macaroni And Cheese
directions: Fill pot halfway with water., Put on stove until water bubbles., Pour macaroni in and stir. Cook 10 to 15 minutes or until soft., Strain water out of macaroni., Put in bowl and mix in butter, milk and cheese. Eat up!

title: Party Casserole
directions: Brown meat; add onion and cook until tender., Drain off liquid. Stir in milk and cheese., Stir until blended., Add corn, soup and pimento., Season with salt and pepper., Pour into 2 quart casserole., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes., Mixture may be divided into 2 (1 1/2 quart) casserole dishes and can be frozen., Serves 6.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Cook broccoli., Add 1 cup cheese, 1 stick margarine and mushroom soup., Mix 1 stick margarine in saucepan., Add rest of Velveeta cheese and crackers., Pour over broccoli and bake at 350° for 15 minutes.

title: Tuna Macaroni Salad
directions: Cook macaroni and mix all together, adding salad dressing or mayonnaise.

title: Strawberries And Cream Roll
directions: Take sliced strawberries and mix with sugar., Take whipped cream or Cool Whip, mix with 3 tablespoons of sugar., Spread on cake roll., Place strawberries on whipped cream., The cake roll will be rolled the same way you rolled it when warm., Refrigerate for 24 hours., Ice across the top with whipped cream and decorate with sliced strawberries., Add mint leaves for color., Cut like a jelly roll and serve.

title: Marinated Pork Tenderloin
directions: Mix well., Use 1/2 to 3/4 to marinate pork tenderloin at least 4 hours before cooking., Cook on grill for 20 to 25 minutes or to 160°.

title: Lily Salad
directions: Prepare pudding mix, plus brown sugar., Allow pudding to cool 5 minutes, then add marshmallows., Add crushed pineapple and oranges (both drained)., Allow mixture to cool.

title: Chicken Royal
directions: Cut chicken (boneless) into 1-inch cubes., Soak 2 hours in eggs., Bread chicken with combination garlic powder and bread crumbs., Brown in oil in skillet., Place in 9 x 9-inch baking dish, layering chicken with cheese., Pour broth over all., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes until cheese browns.

title: "Oh So Good" Salad
directions: Drain pineapple., Mix ingredients and let set.

title: Cheese Dip
directions: Mix well with mixer; serve warm.

title: Overnight Salad
directions: Layer each of the ingredients beginning with lettuce. Let these ingredients set overnight in the refrigerator.

title: Colonel'S Corn Bread
directions: Preheat oven to 425°., In bowl, combine and mix together eggs, milk, butter and creamed corn., Stir in dry ingredients., Pour into lightly greased 8 x 8 x 2-inch baking pan., Bake at 425° for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Orange Julius Drink(Great For Kids)
directions: Combine ingredients in blender and blend for 1 minute, until thoroughly mixed.

title: Sugar Cookies
directions: Sift the last 4 ingredients together., Mix all well and make small balls., Flatten out with hands on cookie sheet., This is easier if you put it in the refrigerator to harden., Bake at 325° for 10 to 12 minutes., Do not overbake.

title: Curried Rice Mix
directions: Combine all ingredients; stir well., Store in an airtight container., Yields 7 cups mix., To cook, see the next recipe.

title: Waldorf Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients together and chill., Apples will not turn brown if tossed in lemon juice before mixing into salad.

title: "Souperior" Meat Loaf
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., In a large bowl, combine all ingredients., Shape into loaf and place in baking dish., Bake 1 hour or until done.

title: Microwave Asparagus
directions: Put asparagus spears into a 10 x 6-inch microwave dish., Add 1/4 cup water., Sprinkle with fines herbes., Microwave on Medium-High until almost cooked, about 11 minutes., Drain water. Place sliced cheese on top of asparagus spears., Cover again. Microwave on Medium-High until cheese melts, about 1 to 2 minutes.

title: Banana Bread
directions: Cream shortening. Add sugar and cream., Add eggs and cream again., Add flour mixture of baking powder, soda and salt; add bananas., One cup nuts may be added., Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

title: Cheddar Baked Potato Slices
directions: Mix first three ingredients. Set aside., Put potatoes in bottom of casserole dish, then cheese next, last pour mixture evenly over cheese., Bake at 400° for 45 minutes., Last 10 minutes uncover to brown top.

title: Oatmeal Cake With Broiled Topping
directions: Place the oats and butter in a bowl and pour on the coffee. Let stand 20 minutes., Stir in the sugars and eggs. Mix well., Add flour, salt and soda., Stir in spices., Bake in a 13 x 9 greased baking pan at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Quick Saucy Chicken Stir-Fry
directions: Heat 1 tablespoon oil in wok or large skillet over medium-high heat., Add vegetables and garlic. Stir-fry 4 to 5 minutes or until tender. Remove vegetables from pan., Add remaining oil and chicken to pan., Stir-fry 4 minutes or until tender. Reduce heat. Stir in vegetables and remaining ingredients; simmer 1 minute, stirring occasionally. Serve over the cooked rice. Sprinkle with crushed red pepper flakes.

title: Sand Cups
directions: Pour milk in large bowl; add pudding mix., Beat until well blended., Let stand 5 minutes., Stir in Cool Whip and half of the cookies., Place 1 tablespoon cookies in cup., Fill cups 3/4 full with pudding mixture., Top with remaining cookies., Refrigerate 1 hour.

title: Caramel Fudge Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Prepare cake mix as package directs. Pour 2 cups batter into greased 9 x 13-inch pan and bake 15 minutes.

title: Squash Casserole
directions: Cut up and boil squash until tender., In 3-quart casserole dish, mix together all ingredients; stir until thoroughly mixed. Cook at 450° for approximately 45 minutes.

title: Devil'S Food Cake
directions: Mix in order given. Add the 3 egg whites, beaten stiff., Fold into the cake batter and bake at 350°., Frost with Seven Minute Icing or Chocolate Frosting.

title: Sugar 'N Spice Cookies
directions: Mix together shortening, sugar, egg and molasses., Add remaining ingredients., Mix thoroughly., Form in balls the size of walnuts., Place about 2 inches apart on greased baking sheet., Bake 10 to 12 minutes at 375°., Roll in confectioners sugar while still warm.

title: Sourdough Biscuits
directions: Dissolve yeast in warm water., Add oil, sugar and milk., Add flour a little at a time to liquid mixture., Beat until smooth. Cover tightly and refrigerate., Bake as needed at 450°.

title: Chocolate Covered Cherries
directions: Cream together sugar, margarine and syrup., Cut cherries in half., Make creamed mixture into walnut-sized portions., Make a thumbprint hole in each and place a cherry half inside., Then work into a ball and chill.

title: Shrimp Log
directions: Mix above items well, except shrimp sauce., Shape into log and chill., When serving, pour cocktail sauce on top., Serve with crackers.

title: Fruit And Nut Bread Pudding
directions: Tear bread into 1-inch pieces., In large bowl, combine bread and sugar, set aside., In another bowl beat eggs, milk, cinnamon, salt and vanilla., Pour over bread and sugar., Mix well, cover and refrigerate 2 hours., Stir in the apple pie filling (cut slices in half), nuts, raisins and butter., Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes, until firm., Cut in squares., Serve warm or cold with whipped cream, if desired.

title: Pumpkin Bread
directions: Sift together the flour, baking powder, salt, cinnamon, cloves and nutmeg., Mix all together and bake at 350° about 1 hour., Add 1/2 coconut, if you like.

title: Pretzel Jello
directions: Mix the first 3 ingredients., Press into a 9 x 13-inch non-buttered pan., Bake for 4 minutes at 400°., Let cool.

title: Twice Baked Potatoes
directions: Peel and boil potatoes until done., Blend together potatoes, margarine, salt, pepper, onion bits, sour cream and 1 cup cheese. Top with remaining cheese and bacon bits., Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes in greased casserole dish.

title: Chicken Cheese Soup
directions: Saute vegetables in butter for 10 minutes., Add broth and simmer 15 minutes., Cut cheese into cubes, add to broth mixture. Stir until cheese melts., Add milk and chicken., Season with pepper to taste., Heat to simmer., Never boil.

title: Pork And Bean Casserole
directions: Pour beans in bowl. Drain pineapple and pour pineapple into bowl. Cut meat into cubes. Pour into bowl. Add barbecue sauce in bowl. Mix well. Pour into baking dish. Bake at 375° for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Ham And Cheese Special
directions: Split sandwich	buns, in, half., Heat margarine, grated onion, mustard, and salad dressing in saucepan., Spread dressing on buns. Place, slice, of, ham, and Swiss cheese in buns. Wrap in aluminum foil., Heat in a 350° oven for 20 minutes.

title: Ranch Pretzels
directions: Mix oil and dressing. Pour over pretzels. Place on cookie sheet. Bake 15 minutes at 300°.

title: Tomato Stack-Ups
directions: Cook broccoli using package directions for 1/2 time; drain. Slice tomatoes 3/4-inch thick., Reserve 2 tablespoons cheese. Combine remaining cheese, broccoli and onion in bowl; mix well. Arrange tomatoes in shallow baking pan., Spoon broccoli mixture over tomatoes., Sprinkle with reserved cheese., Broil 7 to 8 inches from heat source for 6 to 8 minutes or until cheese is bubbly and tomato slices are heated through.

title: Pecan Pie Squares
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Grease jelly roll pan, 15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 1-inch., Beat flour, sugar, margarine and salt in large bowl on medium speed until crumbly (mixture will be dry)., Press firmly in pan., Bake until golden brown, about 20 minutes.

title: Dream Cookies
directions: Drop teaspoonfuls on ungreased cookie sheet., Bake at 325° for 15 minutes., Sprinkle on sugar.

title: Maple Bread(Yields 6 Servings)
directions: Combine first 7 ingredients., Cool to lukewarm., Dissolve yeast in lukewarm water., Add syrup mixture., Blend in eggs. Gradually add flour mixture until smooth., Add enough flour to make a stiff dough., Place in a greased bowl, cover and let rise until doubled., Knead a little., Divide into 2 loaves and let rise again in pans until doubled., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Deep Dish Taco Squares
directions: Grease 8 x 8 x 2-inch dish., Brown meat and drain., Mix sour cream, salad dressing, cheese and onion., Keep this., Mix Bisquick and water until dough forms., Put in dish 1/2-inch high up sides of dish., Layer beef, tomatoes and green pepper., Spoon over sour cream mixture., Bake 25 or 30 minutes at 375°., Makes 5 or 6 servings.

title: Peanutty Ice Cream Pie
directions: Combine corn syrup and peanut butter; mix well, then add to the vanilla ice cream and 2/3 cup peanuts., Pour 1/2 of mixture into pie shell, then drizzle and swirl chocolate syrup over ice cream mixture., Finish pouring rest of ice cream mixture into shell, then drizzle and swirl chocolate syrup over top., Sprinkle a few chopped peanuts over that to make it look pretty., Freeze until real firm (at least 4 hours)., Let stand for 5 to 10 minutes before slicing., Yields 1 scrumptious pie!

title: Shoo-Fly Pie
directions: Combine, molasses,, soda and water and	pour, into, pie shell. Rub together flour, shortening,, sugar, and, cinnamon. Sprinkle on top of molasses, soda and water	mixture., Bake in moderate oven at 350° until filling is a rich, brown, about 35 minutes.

title: Texas Brownies
directions: In large bowl, combine sugar and flour., Set aside., In heavy saucepan, combine butter, Crisco, coffee and cocoa., Stir and heat to boiling., Pour over flour and sugar., Add buttermilk, eggs, soda and vanilla., Mix well at high speed on mixer., Pour into well buttered jelly roll pan, 17 x 11-inch., Bake 20 minutes in 400° oven.

title: Tangerine Buttermilk Pound Cake
directions: In food processor, grind fine the peel. With motor running, add sugar and blend; mix well., In a large bowl with electric mixer, cream the butter and sugar mixture (a little at a time) until light and fluffy. Add eggs, one at a time., In a bowl, add and sift dry ingredients. Add to butter mixture alternately with buttermilk., Pour into two buttered and floured loaf pans. Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes., Will keep 4 days wrapped.

title: Cinnamon Red Hot Pickles
directions: Peel, core and slice large, overripe cucumbers., Soak cucumbers in lime and 1 gallon water for 24 hours., Wash; soak in ice water for 2 hours.

title: Ham Glaze Dijon
directions: In small saucepan, heat pineapple, brown sugar and mustard to a boil., Reduce heat; simmer 5 minutes., Spoon 1/2 cup glaze over ham during last 30, minutes of baking., Heat remaining glaze mixture and serve with sliced ham., Makes about 1 1/4 cups.

title: Maple Syrup
directions: Mix sugar, brown sugar and water., Bring to a boil., Cook 1 minute., Cool slightly., Add vanilla and flavoring., Cover pan for a few minutes as syrup cooks to prevent later crystallizing.

title: German Style Cabbage Rolls
directions: Boil cabbage heads until leaves look transparent, then remove from head and allow to cool., Cut thick vein out so leaf won't split when cooking., Mix together the following ingredients: ground beef, Italian sausage, rice, onion, garlic, salt and pepper. Form mixture into hot dog shapes just large enough to fit each cabbage leaf., Place rolled mixture into cabbage leaf and roll, tucking sides as you go, then place into deep pot., When a row is complete, top it with sauerkraut, and so on, until pot is full. Now, pour your tomato sauce over top, fill pot with water (enough to cover cabbage rolls), cover pot with lid and cook 2 to 4 hours.

title: Marinated Carrots
directions: Cook carrots until medium tender. Drain., Add onion and green pepper. Mix oil, sugar and vinegar., Heat until sugar dissolves. Add dry mustard and tomato soup., Mix and pour over vegetables. Cover and refrigerate., Keeps 6 weeks.

title: Sheet Cake Brownies
directions: In a pan, melt margarine and add cocoa and water., Bring to a boil., Pour over flour and sugar mixture while hot., Add milk, eggs, soda, vanilla and cinnamon., Bake in a greased jelly roll pan for 15 to 20 minutes at 400°.

title: Banana Nut Bread
directions: Cream butter and sugar., Add eggs, nuts and bananas., Mix flour and soda together., Pour in bowl with bananas, butter, sugar, eggs and nuts., Beat with mixer until well blended., Bake in greased loaf pan 50 to 60 minutes at 325°., Bake at least 1 hour and 10 minutes.

title: Rice Casserole
directions: Cook rice in bouillon with onion, celery and green pepper added., Seed, wash and cut up chili peppers., In buttered casserole, put a layer of rice, 1/3 of the sour cream, 1/3 of the chilies and 1/2 of the Jack cheese., Repeat layers., Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes., The last 5 minutes, cover with Cheddar cheese.

title: Chicken A La King
directions: Boil chicken breasts until done, cool and remove chicken from bones., Cut or shred chicken to make approximately 4 cups. Discard skin., In large pot, melt butter; add mushrooms and saute 5 minutes., Stir in flour, salt and pepper until smooth., Slowly stir in chicken broth, continue to stir until flour is mixed in. Slowly stir in table cream and whipping cream., Drain pimentos from juice in jar and add pimentos to the mixture., Add cooked chicken and sherry., Continue to cook over low heat until thickened., Serve over cooked rice (or noodles)., This recipe can be prepared the night before and refrigerated., To warm, just add a little milk to thin the mixture out if needed.

title: Jello Mold
directions: Let cream cheese soften., Pour jello into a bowl., Mash cream cheese into dry jello with pastry blender., Add 1 cup boiling water., Mix with wire whisk., Drain pineapple and set aside juice. Add very cold water to pineapple juice to equal 1 cup., After hot water add pineapple juice water to jello., Put in refrigerator to thicken, about 1 1/2 hours., Fold in pineapple and Cool Whip; chill.

title: Sweet 'N Sour Meatballs
directions: Mix first 4 ingredients and shape mixture into bite size balls; brown., Add pineapple juice to oil and cook slightly over low heat. Add a mixture of cornstarch, soy sauce, vinegar, water and sugar. Cook until thick, stirring constantly., Add meatballs, pineapple chunks and green/red pepper., Cook for about 3 minutes, until heated through., Enjoy!

title: Banana Bread
directions: Cream the shortening, salt and sugar., Add eggs, flour, soda, banana pulp and nuts., Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

title: Microwave Italian Chicken
directions: In a lightly greased 12 x 8 x 2-inch dish, arrange chicken with meatiest pieces to the outside edges of the dish., In mixing bowl, stir together tomato soup, tomato paste, onion salt, garlic salt, oregano and mushrooms. Generously spoon sauce over chicken. Cover with wax paper., Microwave on High for 20 to 22 minutes, rotating dish 1/2 turn after 10 minutes. Sprinkle cheese over chicken., Microwave on High 2 to 4 minutes until cheese is melted. Let it sit 5 to 7 minutes before serving., Makes about 4 servings.

title: Pretzels
directions: Preheat oven to 425°., Grease 2 large baking sheets., In large bowl, sprinkle yeast over water., Stir until well blended and yeast is dissolved., With spoon, gradually stir in sugar, salt and 3 1/2 cups flour until dough is soft and slightly sticky., Turn dough onto floured table or board., Knead., Turn 1/4; repeat. Knead 5 to 7 minutes adding another 1/2 cup flour if needed until dough is smooth and elastic., Dough should not stick., Cut dough in half and cut each half into 6 equal size pieces., With floured hands, roll one piece of dough back and forth between palms of hands to form a dough rope.

title: Crab-Cream Cheese Bake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., In a medium bowl, combine cream cheese, onions and dill weed., Unroll crescent roll dough onto a greased pan., Don't separate dough., Press dough into an 8 x 11-inch rectangle pan., Spoon crabmeat lengthwise along center of dough. Spoon cream cheese mixture over crabmeat., Fold long edges of dough over cream cheese mixture, slightly overlapping edges. Pinch together to seal., Place seam side down on baking sheet. Lightly brush top of dough with egg yolk., Cut slits in top of dough., Bake 20 to 22 minutes or until golden brown and flaky. Cut into 1-inch slices and serve warm.

title: Waldorf Chicken Salad
directions: Toss apples with lemon juice., Combine with chicken, celery, walnuts and raisins, adding just enough mayonnaise to hold salad together., Refrigerate before serving.

title: Baked Rice
directions: Put milk, rice, and salt in bowl and bake at 350° until almost thick., Then stir in sugar and vanilla., Bake few minutes longer. Raisins may be added if desired., Total baking time will be 2-3 hours; rice needs to be stirred every 15-20 minutes while baking.

title: Microwave English Casserole
directions: Make meatballs to your taste; set aside., In 2-quart casserole dish, mix ketchup, water, olives and onion., Add meatballs., Put in microwave on High for 15 minutes, then set microwave on Roast for 30 minutes., Besides making great meatballs, it makes a great gravy for boiled potatoes or rice.

title: Seven Layer Cookies
directions: Melt butter in a 9 x 13-inch pan., Sprinkle next 4 ingredients evenly in layers in order given., Do not mix layers or stir., Pour on milk., Sprinkle top with chopped nuts., Bake in a 350° oven for 30 minutes., Cool slightly and cut into small bars.

title: Cherry Yum Yum
directions: Melt butter and mix with graham cracker crumbs., Cover bottom of pan with 1/2 of this mixture; meanwhile, have Dream Whip and milk mixing., When whipped, add sugar and then cream cheese., Mix well., Pour 1/2 mixture over crumbs; then spoon both cans of cherry pie filling over cream., Top cherries with remaining half of whipped cream mixture., Then sprinkle remaining half of crumbs over pie for topping., (Strawberries, peaches, blueberries or pineapple can be substituted for fruit filling.)

title: Dumplings
directions: Mix like pie crust. Chill in refrigerator. Roll dumplings thin. Cut in small pieces and drop in boiling chicken broth.

title: Taco Chip Chicken
directions: Mix the first 5 ingredients together., Grease a 10 x 13-inch baking dish., Line with chips., Top with 1/3 meat mixture and 1/3 cheese., Repeat layers, ending with cheese., Pour chicken broth over casserole., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Taco Casserole
directions: Brown beef; stir in beans, tomato sauce, taco sauce, chili powder and garlic salt and heat to boiling., Place chips in a greased casserole., Top with beef mixture., Spread on sour cream. Sprinkle on onions, tomato and cheese., Cook, uncovered, 20 to 30 minutes., Arrange additional chips around edge if desired., Serve with a salad.

title: Bacon Poles(Microwave)
directions: With scissors, cut bacon strips in half lengthwise, making 2 long, thin strips from each slice., Wrap 1 slice in a spiral "barber pole fashion" around each breadstick.

title: Glazed Sweet Potatoes
directions: If using fresh potatoes, place in a pan; cover with water and cook, covered, for 25 to 35 minutes or just until tender., Drain; cool slightly., Peel and cut into chunks., Place cooked or canned sweet potatoes in 2-quart baking dish.

title: Oven Fried Chicken
directions: Roll chicken pieces in melted butter; season with salt, pepper and Tony's., Roll in crushed potato chips., Place in baking pan and bake uncovered at 350° for 1 hour., Barbecue chips add extra flavor.

title: Pork Tenderloin With Honey Mustard Sauce
directions: You will need 1 large 14 x 20-inch Reynolds oven cooking bag.

title: Barbecue Sauce(Large Quantity)
directions: Melt butter in saucepan., Add onions and celery; cook gently for 10 minutes., Add all the remaining ingredients except lemon juice., Cook until smooth and thickened., Just before removing from heat, add the lemon juice.

title: Latkes
directions: Grate onion., Peel potatoes and grate them., Combine onion and potatoes; rinse, and drain in a sieve; squeeze out excess liquid. Put in a bowl and stir in egg, flour, 1/2 tsp. salt and 1 T. pepper., Heat about 1/4-inch of oil in a large frying pan., Drop about 2 T. batter making several pancakes at a time., Cook until golden brown, 4 to 5 minutes a side., Drain on paper towels.

title: Gourmet Broccoli
directions: Cook broccoli until tender-crisp (5 to 7 minutes)., Drain well. Spread in 9 x 13-inch dish or pan., Melt 1/4 cup margarine., Add flour and cook to smooth paste., Add next 4 ingredients., Cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until thickened., Spread over broccoli., Melt 6 tablespoons margarine in hot water., Pour over stuffing and toss until evenly moist., Spread over sauce., Bake at 350° until stuffing is slightly brown, about 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Banana Bars
directions: Mix together the peanut butter, mashed bananas, butter, brown sugar and eggs with an electric mixer on medium speed., Sift together the flour with the baking powder., Add to the peanut butter-banana mixture., Mix on low speed just until blended., Stir peanuts and chocolate chips into batter., Spread into a greased 15 x 10-inch jelly roll pan., Bake at 325° for 30 minutes., Cool completely in pan on a wire rack., Cut into bars.

title: Hash Brown Casserole
directions: Thaw potatoes; mix rest of ingredients (except corn flakes and butter)., Put in a 9 x 13-inch pan., Top with corn flakes and butter., Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: German Pancakes
directions: Mix dry ingredients together., Stir in rest and beat with rotary beater until smooth., Heat skillet and small amount of oil. Add a scoop of batter; rotate skillet until batter covers the entire area., Cook on each side until brown spots appear., Serve with sugar and applesauce; roll up to eat.

title: Cantaloupe Sundae
directions: Combine cornstarch and water in a saucepan; stir well., Add raspberries., Cook 1 minute, stirring constantly., Cool.

title: Zucchini-Pineapple Cake
directions: Drain pineapple; grate zucchini., Mix in order given., Bake in greased and floured Bundt or tube pan at 325° for 1 hour and 20 minutes., Cool 10 minutes in pan, then finish cooling on a rack.

title: Broccoli And Rice
directions: Mix all ingredients and pour into a greased casserole., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Sour Cream Muffins
directions: Mix butter, sugar and salt until light., Add eggs, sour cream, soda and flour; mix., Pour into greased muffin tins., Sprinkle with nutmeg and sugar., Bake at 375° for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Easy Beef Kabobs
directions: Whisk together the olive oil, lemon juice, water, mustard, honey, oregano and pepper in a large bowl., Add beef, bell pepper, onion and mushrooms, turning to coat., Thread onto skewers, alternating pieces., Season with salt., Grill or broil to desired doneness, turning occasionally., Makes 4 servings.

title: Cranberry Punch
directions: Cut 2 lemons in thin slices and freeze in blocks of ice., When ready to serve., Mix first 3 ingredients., Pour over ice., Then add ginger ale or 7-Up.

title: Strawberry Nut Salad
directions: Dissolve jello in boiling water in a large kettle., Stir until dissolved., Add sliced bananas, pineapple, strawberries and nuts. Pour half of mixture in oblong pan., Set until jelled (about 45 minutes)., Then add layer of sour cream on mixture and pour rest of mixture on and let set.

title: Quiche
directions: Bake pie crust at 350° for 8 minutes., In a bowl, mix rest of ingredients (except cheese)., Add to pie crust., Top with cheese. Bake for 40 minutes.

title: Fresh Citrus Pasta Salad
directions: Combine corn oil, lemon peel and juice, mustard, sugar, garlic salt and tarragon in large bowl., Add remaining ingredients., Toss gently., Chill before serving.

title: Rice Salad
directions: Boil the rice and cool. Dissolve the jello in the water and juice. Let set until partly set, then whip., Add pineapple or fruit cocktail and sugar., Fold in the whipped cream and add rice. Refrigerate until ready.

title: E Z Kraut
directions: Shred the cabbage and fill quart jars, pressing cabbage down tightly in jars., Add 1 tablespoon salt and 2 tablespoons vinegar to each jar., Put on lids and rings; tighten., Let set 2 weeks before using.

title: Pumpkin Bread
directions: Mix ingredients., Bake at 325° for 30 minutes.

title: Banana Split Cake
directions: Crush graham crackers., Combine with 1/4 cup of butter that has been melted., Spread in bottom of bread pan., Chill.

title: Hershey Bar Pie
directions: Fold room temperature melted chocolate in Cool Whip., Fill pie shell., Garnish with additional Cool Whip and shaved chocolate, if desired.

title: Stuffed Mushrooms
directions: Remove stems from mushrooms; set caps aside., Chop stems. Combine stems, zucchini, onion and water., Cook, stirring constantly over medium heat until vegetables are tender., Drain. Stir in cheese., Stuff caps with mixture., Place in 13 x 9-inch baking dish., Bake at 375° for 8 to 10 minutes or until caps are tender., Serve warm.

title: Sugar Cookies
directions: I put vinegar in milk and let it stand 5 minutes until it curdles.

title: Open House Punch
directions: Put frozen lemonade and orange juice with ReaLemon juice in punch bowl., Put in ice cubes or block of ice., Pour 7-Up over this., Add lemon, orange or rainbow sherbet on top for added zip.

title: Bavarian Pot Roast
directions: In a Dutch oven, brown roast in hot oil., Combine water, beer or broth, tomato sauce, onion and spices., Pour over meat and bring to a boil., Reduce heat, cover and simmer until meat is tender, about 2 1/2 or 3 hours., Remove meat and discard bay leaf. If desired, thicken juices with cornstarch and water.

title: Orange-Coconut Balls
directions: Crush vanilla wafers to fine crumbs., Add next 4 ingredients, mixing well. Form into balls and roll each in flaked coconut. Freeze. Serve frozen., Yields 6 dozen.

title: Chicken Cordon Bleu
directions: Roll chicken with ham and Swiss and secure with toothpicks. Roll in flour mixture., Dip in egg., Roll in bread crumbs.	Heat oil and saute to brown., Add water (1/2 cup) and 1/2 cup wine. Cover and cook 10 minutes longer until done.

title: Red Velvet Cake
directions: Cream shortening and sugar., Add eggs and blend., Add food coloring and water, then cocoa., Blend in buttermilk and add flour and salt., Gradually add vanilla and beat until mixed., Mix vinegar and soda and stir in last., Do not beat., Pour into 2 greased and floured 9-inch pans., Bake at 325° for 25 to 30 minutes or until done., Cool and frost with white icing.

title: Pat Blankenship'S School Rolls
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Prep yeast by adding to the 1 1/2 cups of warm water and sprinkling a teaspoon of sugar on top. Add to flour mixture., Mix well but do not overmix., Make into rolls., Can be baked immediately or let rise., Bake at 350° until golden brown.

title: Popcorn Cake
directions: Melt together margarine, oil, marshmallows and caramels., Mix together popcorn, salted peanuts and M&M's and pour over first mixture., Press mixture into greased Bundt or tube pan and cool. Remove from pan to serve.

title: Mexican Pork Stew
directions: Brown pork cubes in salad oil., Add onion and garlic and cook 2 minutes., Stir in remaining ingredients, bring to a boil and simmer 15 minutes., Makes 4 servings, 235 calories each.

title: Easy Taco Pie
directions: Preheat oven to 400°., Grease a deep dish pie plate. Brown ground beef and onions in skillet; add seasonings, then spread in the pie plate. Sprinkle the green chilies on top. Mix the Bisquick, milk and eggs until blended. Pour over the meat mixture in the pie plate. Bake for 25 minutes, then remove from the oven and sprinkle with cheese. Return to oven for 8 to 10 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Green Rice
directions: Saute celery and onion in butter., Combine all ingredients in a 2 quart casserole dish., Bake 40 minutes at 350°.

title: Rocky Road Candy
directions: Melt chocolate in covered top of double boiler over hot, not boiling, water., Pour half of chocolate into buttered 8 x 10-inch pan., Top with marshmallows., Mix nuts into remaining chocolate and pour over marshmallows., Refrigerate until firm., Cut into squares., Makes 15 to 20 large squares.

title: Egg Casserole Bread
directions: In a large mixing bowl mix 1 1/2 cups flour, sugar, salt and dry yeast., Add butter., Gradually add warm water to dry mixture and beat 2 minutes at medium speed., Add eggs and 1/2 cup flour. Beat at high speed 2 minutes., Stir in enough flour to make a soft dough., Cover., Let rise in a warm place until doubled in bulk about 35 minutes., Stir down., Divide into 2 greased 1 1/2-quart casserole dishes., Cover., Let rise about 40 minutes., Bake at 375° about 35 minutes., Remove from dishes and cool on racks.

title: Macaroni Salad
directions: Cook macaroni and drain., Mix with celery, green pepper and French dressing., Toss well and marinate several hours or overnight., Just before serving, mix remaining ingredients and fold into macaroni mixture., Serves 8 to 10.

title: Sweet Potato Pie
directions: Mix all the ingredients and pour into a pastry shell., Bake at 325° for 45 minutes or until firm., If using canned sweet potatoes; drain liquid before mashing., If using fresh sweet potatoes, peel, cut into small pieces and cook until soft., Drain and mash., A pat or two of butter adds flavor.

title: Pork Chops With Mushroom Gravy(Quick, Easy And Delicious)
directions: Sprinkle pork chops generously with garlic salt and pepper. Brown chops in Teflon frying pan., No oil added (use a little Pam spray before browning)., Add soup and milk., Stir well and mix into pan drippings., Turn pork chops over., Cover and let simmer 20 to 30 minutes, stirring occasionally., Serve with mashed potatoes.

title: Parmesan Chicken
directions: Mix butter, basil, rosemary, celery salt and garlic salt., Dip chicken in butter mixture. Mix crumbs and cheese. Roll chicken in crumb mixture. Place in buttered baking dish., Sprinkle remaining butter and crumb mixture over top if desired. Cover. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Peanut Brittle (1)
directions: Mix sugar, syrup, water and salt in saucepan. Heat to 230° using candy thermometer and then add 1 lb. raw peanuts., Keep stirring and boil to 300°.	Remove from stove and add: (pre-measured and in order) vanilla, butter and soda., Hold soda until nearly cool enough to pour. Pour right after foaming reaches mix. While foaming pour on warmed, buttered cookie sheet and spread with wooden spoon., While still hot, skid off cookie sheet onto buttered aluminum foil on counter top and spread with fingers to desired thickness.

title: Italian Cheese Whip Dip
directions: Combine ingredients; refrigerate at least 1 hour., Serve with Wheat Thins or cut up veggies.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients and pour into 2-quart casserole., Cover with Topping.

title: Church Window Cookies
directions: Melt over double boiler the butter and chocolate chips., Add marshmallows and coat., On a long sheet of waxed paper, sprinkle powdered sugar., Pour mixture on waxed paper and sprinkle top with powdered sugar., Shape and refrigerate., Slice when ready to eat.

title: Potato Kentucky
directions: Mix all together in a 9 x 13-inch dish., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Homemade Pancakes
directions: Mix dry ingredients and set aside., Mix remaining ingredients together., Combine both mixtures and stir just until dry ingredients are moist., Spoon onto greased hot griddle., Turn pancakes as soon as bubbles begin to burst on top., Turn only once., Serve piping hot (sour milk may be used instead of buttermilk).

title: Chicken Waldorf Salad
directions: In medium size bowl, combine chicken, apple, celery, nuts and grapes., In small bowl, combine mayonnaise, lime juice and honey; blend well., Season to taste with salt and pepper., Spoon dressing over chicken salad and toss to coat., Serve on bed of leaf lettuce with croissants.

title: Gooey Butter Cake
directions: Mix one egg, butter and cake mix., Press mixture in bottom of a 13 x 9-inch greased pan., Combine confectioners sugar, cream cheese and two eggs., Mix well., Pour over mixture in pan., Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes or until golden brown., Soft center will firm upon cooling.

title: Chocolate Walnut Pie
directions: Beat eggs lightly; add flour and sugar., Melt butter and chocolate; add egg mixture and blend., Put in walnuts and vanilla and pour into a 9-inch pie shell., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes. Can be topped with vanilla ice cream while warm.

title: Golden Apricot Chicken
directions: Mix dry onion soup, apricot preserves and French dressing together in a bowl., Place skinned chicken in a flat casserole dish., Pour the mix over the chicken and cover with aluminum foil. Bake for 50 minutes in a 350° oven., Uncover and bake for 10 minutes more., Great served over rice.

title: Stuffed Mushrooms
directions: Dice shallot and mix with cream cheese, sausage and pepper. Remove stems from mushrooms and fill with mixture. Place stuffed mushrooms in glass baking dish. Bake at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Pumpkin Pie Cake
directions: Mix first 6 ingredients and pour into an ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan., Sprinkle the dry cake mix over all., Drizzle the melted margarine over this., Top with the chopped nuts., Bake at 350° for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

title: 24-Hour Layered Salad
directions: Layer all the ingredients, ending with cheese and bacon bits.

title: Framed Eggs
directions: Butter skillet., Cut hole in center of bread with a glass. Cook separately in skillet., When golden brown, turn over., Take one egg and scramble in bowl., Pour egg in hole of bread., Cover hole of bread with center of bread., Cook until egg is done. Makes 1 serving.

title: Strawberry Or Cherry Pie
directions: Mix pie filling, pineapple and Eagle Brand milk., Stir in lemon juice, food coloring, pecans and coconut., Fold in Cool Whip., Pour into graham cracker crust., Chill.

title: Fudge Candy
directions: Mix pudding, butter and milk together and boil for one minute. Add sugar, vanilla and nuts., Put in square pan to cool., Cut.

title: Caramel Crunch Apple Pie
directions: Slice apples and set aside., Melt caramels in water and layer apples with caramel sauce alternately in pie shell., Combine cinnamon, nuts, flour and sugar., Cut in butter until crumbly; sprinkle over apples., Bake at 375° for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Scripture Cake
directions: Beat together until fluffy and light, butter, sugar and honey. Beat egg yolks until light and add to mix., Add sifted mixture of flour, baking powder, cinnamon, ginger, nutmeg, cloves and pinch of salt in alternate portions with milk., Stir in figs, raisins and almonds., Fold in 6 egg whites, beaten stiff., Bake in well-greased 10-inch tube pan 2 hours at 300°., Pan may be first lined with greased brown paper for extra protection in the oven.

title: Spinach Balls
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Beat eggs lightly in large bowl., Add remaining ingredients and blend well., Roll into walnut size balls., Transfer to baking sheet., Bake until golden, about 20 minutes., Serve hot., Spinach balls can be partially baked for 10 minutes, cooled and frozen., Reheat thawed balls in 350° oven for 10 to 15 minutes before serving hot., Makes about 6 dozen.

title: Cheese And Shrimp Casserole
directions: Cook mushrooms in butter or margarine for 4 to 5 minutes or until tender., Stir in rice, cheese, cream, cocktail sauce, Worcestershire sauce, salt and pepper., Cover and chill 6 shrimp. Half remaining shrimp lengthwise; stir into rice mixture., Spoon mixture into a 12 x 7 1/2 x 2-inch baking dish or 2-quart au gratin dish., Bake, covered, in a 350° oven for 30 minutes or until hot., Garnish with reserved shrimp and parsley., Serves 8.

title: Potato-Cheese Chowder
directions: Cook vegetables slowly with milk, until well done., Mash with potato masher., Add cheese., Season and serve at once.

title: Dixie Peanut Brittle(Stove Top Method)
directions: In a heavy saucepan, heat sugar, syrup, water and salt to a rolling boil. Add peanuts. Reduce heat to medium and stir constantly. *Cook to hard-crack stage (300° to 310°). Add butter, then baking soda. Beat rapidly and pour on a buttered surface, spreading to 1/4-inch thickness. When cool, break into pieces. Store in an airtight container.

title: Breakfast For A Crowd
directions: Place hash browns in greased baking dish., Layer sausage (crumbled), grated cheese and chopped onions., Pour in milk and whipped eggs over sausage mixture., Bake at 350° for 50 minutes.

title: Taco Dip
directions: Mix sour cream, taco seasoning and cream cheese., In large, shallow bowl, place a layer of chopped lettuce., Top with diced tomato, onion, black olives and cheese., Spoon taco dip on top. Serve with chips.

title: Chewy Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Heat oven to 375°., Grease a baking sheet with butter flavor Crisco., Combine butter flavor Crisco, light brown sugar, egg, milk and vanilla in a large bowl., Beat at medium speed of an electric mixer until well blended., Combine oats, flour, baking soda, salt and cinnamon., Mix into creamed mixture at low speed just until blended., Stir in raisins and nuts.

title: Crazy Crust Pie
directions: Melt butter in baking dish., Mix flour, sugar and milk together., Pour into baking dish., Add pie filling., Do not stir. Bake at 350° for one hour or until golden brown.

title: Cantaloupe Jello Salad
directions: Mix Jell-O with water and sugar., Add 7-Up., Measure 2 1/2 cups (set remainder aside) and pour into a 13 x 9-inch baking dish., Chill until slightly set., Add cantaloupe and chill until firmly set.

title: Luncheon Chicken Salad
directions: Saute mushrooms in margarine until tender in saucepan over medium flame; set aside., Combine next 8 ingredients; mix well. Stir in mushrooms, chicken and water chestnuts., Chill several hours or overnight., Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Shrimp With Broccoli Rice Casserole
directions: Combine all ingredients., Pour into 2 1/2-quart casserole. Cover and bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

title: Chocolate Fudge
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Allow them to come to a rolling boil., Boil exactly 3 minutes., Do not stir after you start timing; remove from heat., Beat with an electric beater until mixture begins to thicken., You may add nuts at this time, if desired. Pour onto a greased dish and let stand until cool.

title: Fruit Cookies
directions: Pour sherry over cut fruit and let stand overnight in refrigerator., Cream butter, sugar and eggs., Sift flour, soda and cinnamon 4 times., Add flour to butter, sugar and eggs., Add fruit and nuts., Drop on well-greased cookie sheet., Bake 15 to 20 minutes at 300°.

title: Pecan Fruit Pie
directions: Spread into 9-inch pie pan., Bake at 325° for 30 minutes. Cool.

title: Easy Sauerbraten
directions: Marinate meat in pickle marinade for 3 days. Cook slowly at 350° for 2 to 3 hours in marinade. May add water. Meat should be cut into medium sized pieces.

title: Easy But Delicious Peanut Butter Fudge
directions: Melt 2 sticks oleo (or butter) and 1 cup peanut butter in saucepan., Take off stove and add 1 pound powdered sugar., Spread in 9 x 12-inch pan., Melt 6 Hershey bars and pour over top.

title: Pumpkin Cheesecake
directions: Combine graham cracker crumbs, sugar and butter in bowl. Press into bottom and 1-inch up side of 9-inch spring-form pan. Bake in 350° oven 6 to 8 minutes., Cool.

title: Cucumber Relish
directions: Mix cucumber and salt., Let set for 4 hours., Drain well., Mix cucumbers and all other ingredients in dishpan., Cook for 20 minutes., Pack in pint jars while hot enough to seal., This is good with hot dogs or beans., (Be sure to drain salty water out as good as you can.)

title: Gingerbread
directions: Mix all ingredients., Pour in oblong pan and bake at 350° about 30 minutes.

title: Chicken No Peek
directions: Spread cream of mushroom soup over bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan. Sprinkle rice over top, then chicken., Sprinkle onion soup mix on top of chicken., Add 1/2 to 3/4 soup can of water over the top. Cover tightly with foil and bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
directions: Heat oven to 325°., Grease and flour tube pan or 2 loaf pans. Beat sugar, margarine, egg yolks and vanilla in a large bowl on low speed constantly for 30 seconds., Beat on high for 2 minutes. Beat in flour, salt and baking soda alternately with the sour cream on low speed., Beat egg whites in, a large bowl until stiff. Fold egg whites into the batter., Pour into pan(s)., Bake 80 to 90 minutes.

title: Chocolate Loaf Cake
directions: Mix together sugar and flour., Set aside., Mix together margarine, water, oil and cocoa in a saucepan., Bring to a boil. Cool a little., Stir into first mixture., Add remaining 4 ingredients., Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan and bake in a 350° oven for 25 to 30 minutes., Pour topping over hot cake.

title: Rhubarb Jam
directions: Add ingredients together and cook until rhubarb is tender. Add strawberry jello and stir until dissolved., Store in refrigerator.

title: Barbecue Ribs
directions: Boil ribs until tender and done. Drain and place in baking dish. Bake at 350 degrees for 5 minutes. Mix all other ingredients in saucepan, stirring often on medium heat until onions are tender. Brush sauce on ribs and bake for 20 minutes longer. May need to brush on more sauce. Bake 8 to 10 minutes longer. Bake uncovered 10 minutes or until ribs have soaked up sauce.

title: Zucchini Bread
directions: Sift the dry ingredients together., Beat the eggs with the sugar, oil and vanilla., Gradually beat in the dry ingredients. Stir in zucchini, adding raisins and nuts if desired., Divide between 2 greased 9 x 5-inch loaf pans and bake in a preheated 350° oven for 50 to 60 minutes., Makes 2 loaves.

title: Nut Bread
directions: In a bowl, sift together flour, sugar, baking powder and salt. Add to this the egg, sweet milk and nutmeats., Mix all ingredients together., Pour into bread tin and bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes or until crust is golden brown.

title: Baked Sliced Potatoes
directions: Wash potatoes., Do not peel; slice 1/4-thick., Grease a 9 x 13-inch glass pan., Place potatoes in layers., Mix butter and oil; brush over slices., Pour remaining ingredients in pan., Sprinkle spices., Bake at 400° for 25 to 30 minutes., No need to cover. Too easy to taste so good.

title: Scalloped Cucumbers And Onions
directions: Pare cucumbers and cut in thin slices. Cut onions into thin slices. Alternate onions and cucumbers in baking dish. Sprinkle each layer with flour, salt and pepper. Then pour the ketchup or chili sauce over all. Dot with butter. Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes or until tender.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
directions: Lightly mix all ingredients except cheese and chips., Pour into 8 x 8 baking dish., Sprinkle with cheese then chips., Bake at 300 degrees for 30 minutes.

title: Chocolate Covered Cherries
directions: Cream together sugar, margarine and milk until smooth., Chill until firm., Place 1 teaspoon mixture in palm of hand., Gently pat and form an even layer large enough to cover a cherry., Place cherry (with stem) in center and mold mixture to cover cherry. Place on foil-lined cookie sheet., Repeat with remaining cherries. Chill until firm., Melt chocolate in double-boiler., Holding cherry by stem, dip into melted chocolate., Cool on foil sheet., Remove stem and cover with a dot of chocolate.

title: Peach Fuzz
directions: Blend with ice in blender.

title: Baked Potato Soup
directions: Melt margarine; stir in flour., Slowly add milk to make a white sauce., (I use microwave as does not scorch.), Fry bacon and remove., Saute onions in bacon drippings., Add potatoes, bacon, onions, cheese, salt and pepper to heated milk mixture., Return to microwave; heat thoroughly., Remove; add sour cream., Serves 4 to 6.

title: Bead Clay
directions: Mix dry ingredients., Add water a tablespoon at a time until stiff dough forms., Knead., Children can use this as modeling clay., After forming it into shapes, wait a couple days to dry and then paint., A necklace can be made by forming the dough into 1/2 to 1-inch balls., Use a toothpick to make a hole., Paint when dry., String yarn through the holes.

title: Chicken Pie Deluxe
directions: Mix together stuffing and melted butter and put 1/2 mix in 9 x 13-inch pan., Mix soup, milk, chicken, peas, onion and pepper. Pour over mixture in pan and cover with remaining crumb mixture. Bake at 375° for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Potato Casserole
directions: Mix together in large bowl all ingredients except 1/2 stick margarine and corn flakes., Put in 9 x 13-inch pan., Melt 1/2 stick margarine and mix with corn flakes., Put over top of mixture., Bake uncovered 1 hour and 15 minutes at 350°., May divide in half and freeze until ready to bake.

title: Chicken Salad Dressing
directions: Combine all ingredients in a bottle; shake well., Refrigerate.

title: Gingersnaps
directions: Mix all (except flour) with a spoon as long as possible, then knead in flour with the hands until sufficient flour is used to make a delicate dough. Roll out thin, cut with cookie cutters and bake in a quick oven (375° to 400°) for 7 to 10 minutes; less for thin cookies. Keep ingredients in a cool place until mixed.

title: Barbecue Bean Bake
directions: Brown beef, bacon and onion; drain., Add all other ingredients, except beans; stir well., Add beans and mix well. Bake at 350° for 1 hour., Makes 20 to 24 servings.

title: Cheese Cake
directions: Blend cream cheese and condensed milk until well mixed., Add lemon juice and vanilla., Mix until well blended., Pour into baked crust.

title: Green Beans In Tomato Sauce
directions: Put onion and garlic in food processor and chop until fine. Saute onion and garlic in oil in large pan until translucent (don't burn)., Add fresh beans and stir., Cover and cook on low heat for about 10 to 15 minutes., Add tomatoes (with juice), salt and pepper to taste., (If you want, you may add a little tomato sauce to make it thicker.), Cover and cook on low heat for at least an hour, depending on how hard or soft you want the green beans to be., Or you can bake in a 350° oven for 1 1/2 hours., Stir occasionally. Add water, if needed.

title: Shoo-Fly Pie
directions: Mix flour mixture together.

title: Bourbon Slush
directions: Mix together, making sure sugar is well mixed., Freeze at least 24 hours., Fill glass 1/2 to 3/4 full of slush, then add 7-Up or Sprite., Add maraschino cherry, if desired.

title: Cheesy Bacon Bits
directions: Combine cream cheese, bacon, onion and pepper; mix well. Separate crescent rolls into 2 rectangles and pinch seams together. Spread cheese mixture on each rectangle., Roll up, starting at longer side, and seal end of roll., Cut each roll into 16 slices. Place slices cut-side down on cookie sheet., Bake at 350° for 15 minutes, or until golden brown., Serve warm.

title: Meatballs
directions: Mix first nine ingredients together., Shape into balls., Melt shortening in large skillet; brown meatballs., Pour off fat., Heat chili sauce and jelly until jelly is melted., Add balls, stir and simmer 30 minutes., Makes approximately 5 dozen.

title: 9 Day Pickles(Makes 4 Gallons)
directions: Day 1:, Put 1 pound salt with enough water to cover.

title: Peach Cobbler
directions: Preheat oven to, 350°., In 13 x 9-inch baking pan, melt 1 stick of, butter, or margarine., In large mixing bowl, blend sugar, flour, and milk until smooth., After butter has melted, remove from, oven, and, pour, peaches, across, bottom, of pan. Slowly pour batter, across, top of peach layer and bake for 45 minutes to 1, hour, or, until golden brown., Peaches will rise while baking.

title: Pesto Sauce
directions: In blender, blend basil, garlic, olive oil and parsley., Mix in nuts, then the cheese., Serve over pasta.

title: Fresh Coconut Cake(3 Layers)
directions: Mix eggs, sugar and cream. Add flour, salt and vanilla. Mix well. Pour in 3 greased pans. Bake at 350°. Cool and spoon next mixture over cake before frosting: Make 1 cup sugar and 1 1/2 cups fresh coconut soupy with coconut milk. Add water if necessary. Frost with "Never Fail Frosting, " then sprinkle with remaining coconut.

title: Unstuffed Cabbage
directions: In a 4 to 5-quart Dutch oven, cook ground beef, onion and garlic, 5 to 6 minutes., Add cabbage until wilted., Add remaining ingredients; cook 25 minutes., Serve over cooked rice or noodles. Makes 4 servings.

title: Squash Casserole
directions: Cook squash and drain., Mix the remaining ingredients, using 3/4ths box of croutons and 1/2 of the melted butter., Top with remaining croutons and drizzle butter over all., Bake for 30 to 35 minutes at 350°.

title: Reda'S Lebanese Green Beans
directions: Saut onion in oil and garlic until transparent (about 5 to 10 minutes)., Add tomatoes, spices, salt and pepper; bring to a boil and add green beans., Turn to simmer and cook until beans are tender.

title: Pineapple Cheese Bake
directions: Layer the ingredients as they are listed., Drain pineapple. Mix syrup with sugar and flour., Alternate layers of cheese and pineapple., Pour syrup over all., Bake for 40 minutes in a 350° oven., Good with baked ham.

title: Pork Chops And Dip
directions: Place pork chops in casserole pan., Salt to taste., Mix all other ingredients in small saucepan and heat just enough to melt butter., Pour over pork chops; cover and cook at 375° for 45 minutes., Chicken can be used in place of pork chops.

title: Peanut Butter Icing
directions: Mix with mixer until fluffy., Great on chocolate cake.

title: Sloppy Joes
directions: Crumble and brown hamburger in fat., Drain off excess fat. In a separate pan, add all remaining ingredients and heat thoroughly., Add to hamburger., Serve over buns., This can be increased to serve a large crowd and is fast and easy.

title: Sesame Tossed Salad
directions: *Use 2 or 3 different types of greens, depending on the season, iceberg, curly leaf, romaine, Boston, bibb lettuce, spinach leaves, etc.

title: Carrot Bread
directions: Mix together like a sponge first 8 ingredients; let rise 20 minutes., Add to sponge the carrots (raw), parsley, basil and flour., Knead; let rise until double in bulk., Form into 2 loaves. Let rise again., Bake at 375° for 35 minutes.

title: Dusty Cream Frosting
directions: Soften cream cheese and blend in vanilla., Sift sugar and cocoa together and gradually add to cream cheese., Blend thoroughly., If too stiff to spread, add milk or cream, one teaspoon at a time until desired consistency is reached.

title: Sweet And Sour Meatballs
directions: Mix first 6 ingredients and shape into small balls and fry in Crisco until brown., Bring 5 remaining ingredients to boil., Add cooked meatballs and simmer 30 minutes before serving.

title: Zucchini Casserole
directions: Mix first 5 ingredients., Add remaining ingredients which have been mixed together., Melt butter; pour over., Bake at 400° for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Corn Salad
directions: In large bowl combine corn, kidney beans, onion, green pepper and cheddar cheese.

title: Chicken In Onion Gravy
directions: Sprinkle 1/2 teaspoon of the "Poultry Magic" over each chicken breast., In a hot skillet, melt 2 tablespoons butter, add onion. Cook about 5 minutes and onion browns., On medium heat, continue cooking 5 to 6 minutes, until onion is caramelized., Put onion in another container., On high heat add 3 tablespoons butter., Dredge the seasoned chicken through flour., Cook about 1 to 2 minutes per side or until golden brown., Remove chicken., To pan add 1 cup bouillon to deglaze pan, stirring and scraping pan bottom., Stir in caramelized onion and return browned chicken., Stir in remaining bouillon and "Poultry Magic" and bring to boil., Reduce heat and simmer, stirring occasionally, about 20 minutes or until sauce thickens., Serve with rice.

title: Pat'S Great Easy Peach Cobbler
directions: Layer ingredients in a 13 1/2 x 9-inch disposable dish., Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Fruit Salad
directions: Drain all juices from fruit., Mix milk with Cool Whip., Mix sugar with cream cheese., Mix all together and refrigerate.

title: Baked Spaghetti
directions: Fry hamburger and onions until slightly brown., Fry bacon and break into small pieces., Mix tomato soup, mushrooms, mushroom soup and tomato juice., Season with salt, pepper and a little sugar. Put in alternate layers in 9 x 13-inch baking dish the hamburger, cooked spaghetti, liquid mixture, bacon and cheese., Cover with a few crumbled Ritz or saltine crackers., Bake about one hour at 350°., Save a little cheese to put on top., (Be sure to drain spaghetti well after cooking.)

title: Eclairs
directions: Melt butter in 1 cup boiling water., Add flour and salt all at once; stir vigorously., Cook and stir until mixture forms a ball that doesn't separate., Remove from heat; cool slightly., Add eggs, one at a time, beating after each until smooth., Put through a pastry tube or paper one making 4-inch strips, 3/4-inch wide on greased cookie sheet., Bake, split and dry., Bake in 450° oven for 15 minutes, then at 325° for 25 minutes., Turn oven off and put eclairs back in to dry, about 20 minutes., Cool on rack., Fill with double recipe of French Custard Filling just before serving and frost with Chocolate Frosting.

title: Peanut Clusters
directions: In large mixing bowl, melt chocolate chips, milk chocolate, and white chocolate in microwave on medium heat., Stir until all melted., When melted, add the peanuts and mix well., Drop by tsp. on waxed paper., When set up and cool, store in tins., Makes 5 to 6 dozen clusters.

title: 1-2-3 Peanut Butter Cookies
directions: Blend peanut butter, sugar and water., Mix in Bisquick mix. Drop by small teaspoonfuls onto lightly greased cookie sheet. Flatten with fork., Bake in a 400° oven about 8 minutes., Makes 6 1/2 dozen.

title: Egg Nog
directions: Separate eggs., Add sugar to egg yolks., Add cream and milk. Beat egg whites stiff., Fold into liquid mixture., Sprinkle with nutmeg.

title: Coconut Caramel Dessert
directions: Combine first 3 ingredients and press into 9 x 13-inch pan, lightly brown., Cool completely., Melt 1/4 cup butter., Add coconut and 1/2 cup chopped pecans., Cook over low heat, stirring often until coconut is golden brown., Cool completely., Combine cream cheese and condensed milk, beat at medium speed with an electric mixer until smooth., Fold in whipped topping., Layer 1/3 each of cream mixture, caramel sauce and coconut mixture over crust., Repeat process twice., Cover and freeze until firm.

title: Carbonara Ala Diane
directions: Cook spaghetti, drain and set aside., Slice onions and mushrooms., Cut the pound of bacon in half then in half again; set aside., Saute the onions and mushrooms in margarine, remove and set aside., In same frying pan cook bacon until almost done (not crisp)., Drain bacon grease., Add onions and mushrooms to bacon. Add oregano, spaghetti, half and half and stir over medium heat. Add Parmesan cheese., Mix well., Cook 1 to 2 minutes and remove. Serve with a salad and garlic bread.

title: Turkey Party
directions: In a large casserole dish lay 1 layer of dried beef., Wrap turkey cutlets in bacon and lay on dried beef., Mix cream of mushroom soup and sour cream well., Then spread over meat. Refrigerate overnight., Bake at 275° for 3 hours, uncovered, or until very brown and crispy on top., Serve with dried parsley and steamed fresh broccoli., Makes a nice company dinner.

title: Kahlua
directions: Simmer first 2 ingredients for 30 minutes, with lid on. Simmer next 2 ingredients for 1 hour, with lid on., Cook coffee and sugar mixtures separately., Be sure the coffee mixture has cooled, then drain through a linen napkin 6 times., Combine strained coffee with the sugar-water mixture., Add vanilla. Bottle and let the Kahlua sit 1 month before drinking., This makes a great holiday gift!

title: Pistachio Salad
directions: Dissolve pudding mix in pineapple., Mix well., Add coconut, marshmallows and fold whipped topping into mixture., Refrigerate overnight and enjoy!

title: Chicken Supreme
directions: Mix all ingredients except Chinese noodles., Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan., Place Chinese noodles on top., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Vern'S Favorite
directions: Cream together shortening, sugars and egg. Add flour, soda and cream of tartar. Mix well. Add vanilla and coconut. Mix. Roll dough in walnut size balls. Dip tops in water and then sugar. Place on cookie sheet, sugar side up. Bake at 350°until golden brown.

title: Cookies 'N Cream Pie
directions: Pour half and half into large bowl., Add pie filling mix., Beat with wire whisk until well blended, 1 minute., Let stand 5 minutes. Fold in whipped topping and crushed cookies., Spoon into crust. Freeze until firm, about 6 hours or overnight., Remove from freezer and let stand 10 minutes to soften before serving., Store any leftover pie in freezer.

title: Cooked Apples
directions: Combine all ingredients in a 4-quart Dutch oven; bring to a boil over medium-high heat. Reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.

title: Sausage Casserole
directions: Cook and drain sausage; cut celery up fine., Mix all ingredients together., Put in casserole dish and grate cheese over top., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: House Ranch Dressing
directions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl and whisk until thoroughly blended., Pour into a lidded container and refrigerate for up to a week., Shake before serving.

title: Caramel Pecans
directions: Mix together butter and sugar., Coat pecans well with mix. Bake on cookie sheet at 350° for 10 minutes.

title: Hilda'S Ham Dip
directions: Hollow one loaf of bread to hold dip., Mix remaining ingredients., Make the day before to bring out the flavor., Break bread into pieces for dipping.

title: Zucchini Bread
directions: Mix together eggs, sugar, oil, zucchini, sour cream and vanilla., Sift together and add dry ingredients., Grease and flour two large loaf pans (or five mini loaf pans)., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to one hour.

title: Ragged Relish
directions: Shred tomatoes, peppers, onions, and cabbage together., Soak in salt water 3 hours, then drain.

title: Maui Crispy Cookies
directions: Cream together first 6 ingredients., Combine flour, cream of tartar and baking soda., Add flour mixture to creamed mixture., Add cereal, nuts and chocolate chips., Form into 1-inch balls., Arrange on cookie sheet., Press with fingers., Bake at 300° for 10 minutes. Aloha from Hawaii.

title: Hot And Spicy Sloppy Joes
directions: In a large skillet, cook ground beef, onion and garlic., Drain. Meanwhile in a crock-pot combine remaining ingredients except buns and cheese., Stir in meat mixture; cover and cook on low heat for 10 to 12 hours or on high setting for 3 to 5 hours., Toast buns and spread meat mixture over buns., Sprinkle with cheese.

title: Cheese Potatoes
directions: Combine the first 5 ingredients., Put in a 2-quart casserole. Combine bread crumbs with butter and spread over potatoes., Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes., Add Cheddar cheese.

title: Microwave Peanut Brittle
directions: Grease baking sheet and set aside.

title: Baked Beans
directions: Bake at 400° for 1 hour, then lower heat to 300° for 1 hour.

title: Chicken-Broccoli Casserole
directions: Layer cooked chicken and cooked broccoli in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix the chicken soup, water and mayonnaise and pour over chicken mixture., Next, add shredded cheese and bread crumbs.

title: Chocolate Balls
directions: Mix and form into balls., Melt 1/2 block paraffin with a small package of semi-sweet chocolate drops., Use a double boiler., Dip balls in chocolate., Place on rack to cool.

title: Curried Meatballs
directions: In a medium bowl combine crumbs, 2/3 cup mincemeat, meat, egg, salt and pepper., Mix well., Shape into 1 1/2-inch meatballs., In a large skillet, brown meatballs in oil; remove as browned., In same skillet, cook onion and green pepper until tender., Add remaining mincemeat, curry and ReaLemon., Mix well., Return meatballs to skillet., Cover; simmer 30 minutes, stirring occasionally., Serve with rice.

title: Puke In A Pot
directions: Brown meat and drain., Dump in crock-pot., Add all other ingredients, except cheese., Cut up cheese in chunks and drop in pot., Cook on low until melted., Serve with large corn chips.

title: Peanut Soup
directions: In top of double boiler, melt margarine., Add onion and celery., Saute until tender., Place over boiling water., Add creamy peanut butter and flour; blend well., Stir in beef bouillon and lemon juice., Cook for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally. When serving, garnish with chopped peanuts.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
directions: Mix powdered sugar and cream cheese., Add peanut butter., Fold in Cool Whip., Spread on pie crust which has been baked and cooled.

title: Meat Loaf
