directions: Mix all ingredients together., Put in a baking pan., Cook at 400°.

title: English Muffins
directions: Combine 2 cups white flour and next 7 ingredients in a large bowl., Mix well., Heat water and oil to 120° to 130° and add, blending at low speed until moistened., Beat 3 minutes at medium speed., Stir in remaining flour to make a firm dough., Knead for 5 minutes., Place in a greased bowl., Cover and let rise until doubled., Punch down; sprinkle cornmeal on surface and roll dough to 1/2-inch thickness., Cut into 3-inch circles., Place muffins on ungreased cookie sheet., Cover; let rise to double., Handle carefully., Bake on griddle at 325°, cornmeal side down, for about 8 minutes on each side., Cool on rack., Split with fork, toast and serve.

title: Peaches And Cream Cake
directions: Mix pudding and pour in greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Take one large can of peaches, drain juice and save., Arrange peaches on top of cake batter., Mix cream cheese, sugar and 5 to 6 tablespoons of peach juice., Spread on top of peaches., Bake at 350° in oven for 50 to 60 minutes., Sprinkle with powdered sugar on top when cool.

title: Turtle Chocolate Brownies
directions: Combine caramels and 1/3 cup milk over low heat; stir until melted., Combine cake mix, 1/3 cup milk, margarine and nuts. Press half of mixture into greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake 6 minutes at 350°., Remove from oven and sprinkle chocolate pieces on top. Pour on caramel evenly., Crumble remaining cake mixture on top and bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes., Cool and cut into bars.

title: Red Christmas Punch
directions: Mix cranberry juice and apple cider or apple juice. Just before serving, add ginger ale.

title: Irish Cream
directions: Blend in blender at high speed., Refrigerate.

title: Pork Chops Supreme
directions: Pare and slice potatoes; place in a medium-sized casserole dish., Lightly salt and pepper potatoes., Mix soups and milk., Fry pork chops until brown., Drain chops and arrange on top of potatoes., Pour soup mixture on top of chops., Bake at 350° for one hour.

title: Ms. Flo'S Soup
directions: Cook soup according to package directions., Add vegetables and seasonings; cook for 10 minutes., Add ground beef, breaking it up into small pieces., Cook for about 30 minutes until meat and veggies are done.

title: Better Than Anything Cake(Heavenly Or Sinful, You Make The Call)
directions: Mix cake mix according to directions and bake in a 9 x 15-inch pan., See box for baking time., Remove cake from oven when done and immediately poke holes all over the cake with the end of a wooden spoon., Pour the jar of caramel sauce all over the cake and then do the same with the sweetened condensed milk., Let cake cool in refrigerator., Spread Cool Whip on top of cake and top with broken Skor bars.

title: French Coconut Pie
directions: Combine all ingredients and pour into unbaked pie shell., Bake at 350° for one hour.

title: Chicken In Tomato And Onion Sauce
directions: Heat oil in pan., Add chicken pieces and brown., Remove from pan., Drain fat from pan., Add butter and sliced onion; cook until tender., Add undrained, chopped, mashed tomatoes, soup mix, soy sauce and 3/4 cup water and heat through., Place chicken in ovenproof dish and pour sauce over., Cover., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes., Remove chicken., Pour sauce in saucepan., Stir in blended cornstarch and 1 tablespoon extra water; stir until sauce boils and thickens., Pour over chicken.

title: Classic Pecan Pies
directions: Heat oven to 400°., Combine eggs, sugar, flour, syrup, butter and vanilla., Blend well., Pour into unbaked shell., Arrange pecans on top., Bake in lower part of oven for 15 minutes., Reduce temperature to 350°., Bake 35 to 45 minutes or until center appears set., Cool completely.

title: Old Fashion Ice Cream
directions: Heat over low heat one quart milk., Stir in until dissolved sugar and salt., Next add already beaten eggs., Beat with beater while cooking over low heat until mixture is thick and smooth., Do not boil., Cool and then add vanilla and remaining quart of cold milk., Pour into ice cream freezer and crank away., You can add 2 cups of fresh fruit for variety., If you want richer, add 1 pint whipped cream.

title: Tuna Fish Pick-Me-Up
directions: Crush crackers coarsely into a large bowl., Add tuna, onion, salt, pepper, green peppers, egg and milk., Blend well and form into four individual loaves., Place loaves in greased, shallow baking dish., Brush with melted butter., Bake in oven for 30 minutes at 375°., Heat soup and sliced eggs., Pour over loaves placed on a platter., Can be made into one large loaf.

title: Puppy Chow(People Food)
directions: Microwave peanut butter, chips and margarine one minute on High., Place cereal in plastic bag; mix with first mixture and add 2 cups powdered sugar., Toss to coat.

title: No Bake Cookies
directions: Cook sugar, milk and butter for 1 1/2 minutes., Start counting when mixture reaches full boil (234° on candy thermometer). Remove from heat and add oats, nuts, vanilla and peanut butter. Stir until well blended., Spoon onto wax paper and let cool.

title: Shrimp Dip
directions: Cream the first 5 ingredients together and set aside., Take your frozen shrimp and boil as directed on package., Rinse thoroughly in cold water and the cut into small pieces., You can also use canned shrimp., For best results, chill for at least 1 hour before serving.

title: Microwave Ham Steaks(Serves 1)
directions: Remove the rind and snip around the edges at 1/4-inch intervals to prevent the steak from curling., Put on a dish or plate and cover with waxed paper., Microwave on High 2 minutes., Brush with honey and mustard and cook for a further 30 seconds or until just cooked., Let stand for 3 minutes, during which time the ham will finish cooking., (Ham steaks tend to "pop" when cooking.) Transfer to a warm plate and garnish with pineapple, peaches, mandarin oranges or apple rings.

title: Marshmallow Treat
directions: Melt margarine in large pan over low heat., Add marshmallows; cook, stirring constantly, until marshmallows are melted., Mixture is very syrupy., Remove from heat., Add Rice Krispies; stir until well coated., Using buttered spatula or waxed paper, press mixture evenly and firmly in buttered 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan., Cut into squares when cool., Yields 24 (2 x 2-inch) squares.

title: Pumpkin Cake Roll
directions: Beat eggs at high speed for 5 minutes., Gradually add sugar. Stir in flour, baking powder, cinnamon and salt., Stir in pumpkin and lemon juice., Spoon into greased and floured 15 x 10 x 1-inch pan., Top with nuts., Bake at 375° for 15 minutes., Turn out on towel; sprinkle with powdered sugar., Starting at narrow end, roll towel and cake together., Cool., Unroll for filling.

title: Becky'S Chili Beans
directions: In a large pot over medium heat, cook beef until all red disappears, keeping beef in small chunks., Pour off fat., Add onion, green pepper, garlic, chili powder, oregano, basil and cumin and mix well., Cook, stirring until onion and green pepper are tender, about 5 minutes., Stir in sugar, salt, tomatoes, tomato sauce and tomato paste., Mix well., Bring to a boil, breaking up tomatoes with a fork., Simmer slowly, covered, stirring occasionally until thickened and all flavors are blended, about 1 hour., Add kidney beans, simmer covered, for about 15 minutes, or until hot., Makes 12 to 16 servings.

title: Sour Bread - Starter
directions: Mix milk with flour., Let stand, uncovered, in a warm (preferably sunny) place., When mixture begins to bubble and has a sour odor, it is ready.

title: Corn Meal Pound Cake
directions: Cream sugar, oleo until light and fluffy., Add vanilla and yolks, one at a time, beating until fluffy., Sift flour, corn meal and soda., Add alternating with sour cream., Beat egg whites and salt together until peaks form., Fold gently into batter., Bake in well greased and floured 10-inch tube pan., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Broccoli Soup
directions: Saute the onion and carrots in the oil until tender. Add the water and chicken bouillon; cook 10 to 15 minutes. Cook and drain the noodles, then add the noodles and thawed broccoli to the water. Bring to a slow boil, then add the garlic salt, milk and Velveeta cheese. Heat slowly until cheese melts.

title: Ranch Salad
directions: Toss all ingredients except Fritos and dressing, which should be added at serving time to each salad., This will keep leftovers fresher.

title: Pecan Cookies
directions: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs and beat well. Add dry ingredients. Drop onto greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Easy-Go Apple Pie
directions: Mix apples, with, 1/2 cup sugar and lemon juice., Place in graham cracker pie shell.

title: Cheesy Chicken Noodles
directions: Boil chicken., When done, debone., In boiler of chicken stock, add Velveeta cheese., Start with 1/2 pound and add more to your taste., When melted, add noodles., When done, serve., Can be refrigerated and warmed up.

title: Puppy Chow
directions: Melt margarine, peanut butter and chocolate chips., Then, in a large bag, place powdered sugar., Pour melted mixture over cereal. Cool., Put cereal in bag., Shake to coat the chocolate covered Rice Chex. Serves best when it has cooled.

title: Copper Pennies
directions: Chop pepper and onion., Add to other ingredients., Serve hot or cold., Serves 6., Use cooked fresh or canned carrots.

title: Million Dollar Bars
directions: Melt margarine in bottom of a 9 x 13-inch Pyrex baking dish. Sprinkle crumbs over margarine and stir., Add layers of chocolate chips, pecans, butterscotch chips and coconut., Pour the milk over top and bake at 325° for 30 minutes., Cool in pan and cut into bars.

title: Cherry Yum Yum
directions: Melt oleo; mix with crumbs., Beat Dream Whip with milk until stiff., Add sugar and cream cheese; mix well., Pour one half of the crumbs into dish., Add one half of the Dream Whip mixture. Then add pie filling., Add remaining Dream Whip mixture., Top with remaining crumbs.

title: Chicken Spaghetti
directions: Boil chicken with bay leaves until done., Save chicken broth. Take out chicken and let cool., Cut into bite size pieces., Cook spaghetti in chicken broth; drain and set aside., Saute vegetables in butter; do not overcook., Mix all canned items together., Add vegetables and spaghetti., Pour mixture into a baking pan, then top with grated Cheddar cheese., Place in oven or microwave to heat for a few minutes., Makes about 6 servings., Serve with green salad and garlic bread.

title: Hungarian Chicken
directions: Put the chicken, in a bag with flour and seasonings and shake well., Heat, the butter and oil in a heavy skillet until quite hot, and, brown, the, chicken thighs well on both sides. Transfer to a, piece, of, foil, or, absorbent, paper., Add the onions to the, skillet, and brown very well, using additional butter and oil if, needed., Return, the chicken thighs to the pan with, the broth, and	the, additional paprika and simmer, covered, until the, chicken is just tender, about 20 minutes. If the broth is absorbed, add more., Transfer the chicken to a hot serving dish. Add, the sour cream to the pan off the heat and stir into, the pan juices., Heat 1 minute., Pour over the chicken thighs. Sprinkle the lemon rind on top.

title: Pastitos(Serves 4 To 6)
directions: Melt the butter in a saucepan., Blend in the flour until smooth., Gradually add the milk, stirring constantly, to the boiling point., Mix in 1/4 cup of the cheese and cook over low heat for 5 minutes., Beat the egg in a bowl., Gradually add the hot sauce, beating constantly, to prevent curdling., Taste for seasoning.

title: Little Venice Spaghetti Sauce
directions: Crush garlic clove and saute with olive oil., Add tomato paste and simmer 15 minutes., Add crushed tomatoes, basil, parsley, applesauce, salt and pepper., Simmer for 40 minutes., Add Romano cheese.

title: Hamburger Pie
directions: Crumble ground beef in greased casserole dish., Spoon part of soup over meat., Top with mixed vegetables and spoon rest of soup over., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Overnight Salad
directions: Combine all ingredients and refrigerate overnight.

title: Pork Tenderloin Marinade
directions: Mix together ingredients and marinate tenderloin.

title: Stuffed Baked Potatoes
directions: Scrub potatoes under cold water., Dry with a paper towel. Pierce each potato twice with a fork., Place 1-inch apart on a paper towel in the microwave oven., Microwave at High (100%) until center is slightly firm, 10 to 12 minutes., Let stand 5 minutes. Cut potatoes in half lengthwise., Scoop out inside, leaving small amount next to outer skin., Add margarine, parsley, cheese, sour cream, salt and pepper., Mash well with a potato masher or electric mixer., Spoon mixture into potato shells., Place stuffed shells in a 2-quart oblong baking dish (microwave-safe)., Top with chopped green onions., Sprinkle with paprika; just a few sprinkles on each., Cover with wax paper., Microwave at Medium heat (70%) until heated through, 4 to 5 minutes., Makes 6 servings.

title: Tea Cakes
directions: Mix sugars and melted oleo; put in eggs, soda, vanilla and flour., Then cream in Crisco., You may need to add a little more flour., Roll in small balls and place between wax paper; press with bottom of a glass., Bake on an ungreased cookie sheet at 350° until light brown.

title: Hamburger Pie
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Mix meat, 1 1/3 cups of instant potatoes (dry), egg, salt, pepper, onion, catsup and milk., Spread in ungreased pie pan (9 x 1 1/2-inch)., Bake, uncovered, for 35 to 40 minutes., Prepare remaining instant potatoes as directed on package for 4 servings., Top baked meat loaf with mashed potatoes; sprinkle with cheese., Bake 3 to 4 minutes longer, or until cheese melts., Makes 4 or 5 servings.

title: Baked Spinach
directions: Cook spinach per package directions., Drain., Combine with drained artichoke hearts., Saute chopped onion in chopped oleo. Add sour cream, artichoke hearts and spinach., Season with celery seed., Put in casserole; cover with grated Parmesan cheese. Sprinkle with paprika., Heat in 325° oven for about 20 minutes., (I sometimes make in advance and refrigerate until ready to heat 25 or 30 minutes.)

title: Mallory'S Brownies
directions: Mix ingredients. Bake in greased pan at 350° for 25 minutes. Serves 9 to 10.

title: Marble Cake
directions: Cream butter, sugar and eggs; add flour, baking powder, salt, milk and vanilla., Mix well and reserve 1 cup of batter., Melt candy bars; add to reserved batter., Mix with other batter and pour into greased and floured pan., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until done., Frost with Fudge Icing.

title: Pineapple Casserole
directions: Mix pineapple, flour and sugar., Add cheese and put into casserole dish., Mix cracker crumbs and melted margarine., Spread on top., Bake at 325° for about 30 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Lemon Ice Dessert
directions: The night before you plan to prepare this dessert, punch two holes in the top of the can of milk and place in a pan of boiling water., Let simmer for 10 minutes., Leave in can and place in refrigerator overnight.

title: Payday Cookies
directions: Combine cake mix, egg and 1/3 cup butter or margarine., Press into a 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 12 to 18 minutes. Spread marshmallows over crust while still hot., In double boiler, place corn syrup, peanut butter chips, 1/4 cup butter or margarine., Cook until smooth., Add Rice Krispies and peanuts. Immediately spread over marshmallows using back of spoon., Cool; cut into squares.

title: Marinated Noodles And Cabbage
directions: In a mixing bowl combine oil, vinegar, sugar, 1/4 teaspoon salt, dash of pepper and seasoning packet from noodles., Stir to dissolve seasonings., Stir in broken noodles, cabbage, chicken, onion and sesame seed., Cover and refrigerate for at least 3 hours. Before serving, stir in almonds and garnish with green pepper rings., Serves 8 to 10.

title: Taco Pie
directions: Spread rolls in pie pan., Press seams together to form flat crust., Bake until light brown., Brown hamburger and drain., Add taco seasoning., On baked crust, layer crushed taco chips, hamburger, cottage cheese, hamburger, chips and cheese., Bake until cheeses are melted., Bake at 350°.

title: Imperial Chicken
directions: Mix together all ingredients, except butter and chicken., Dip chicken in butter and then into crumb mixture., Bake for 1 hour at 300°.

title: Sauerbraten Meatballs
directions: Combine beef, egg, salt, pepper, bread crumbs and milk., Shape into tiny meatballs., Brown in butter, shaking pan occasionally to brown evenly., Mix water, vinegar, catsup, brown sugar, peppercorns, bay leaf, salt, raisins and gingersnap crumbs., When meat is browned, add sauce mixture., Bring to a boil., Cover skillet; lower heat and simmer 25 to 30 minutes., Stir gently several times while meat is simmering., Keep hot in a chafing dish and serve with toothpicks.

title: Martha Washington Candy
directions: Mix all ingredients together and make out into small balls. Melt semi-sweet chocolate bits and a small piece of paraffin in a double boiler., Dip balls into chocolate mixture and place pecan half on top of each., Yields approximately 6 dozen.

title: Ugly Duckling Cake
directions: Beat fruit cocktail in large bowl., Pour in 1 cup coconut, eggs and cake mix., Blend., Pour in 9 x 13-inch greased and floured pan., Top with brown sugar over batter., Bake at 325° for 45 minutes or until toothpick comes out dry., While cake is still hot, mix in small pan the butter, sugar and cream., Boil until margarine is melted., Add rest of coconut., Pour over hot cake. Cool and serve.

title: Monkey Bread(Easy)
directions: Preheat oven to 350°. Prepare a well-greased Bundt pan. Remove biscuits from tube, separate and cut into quarters; set aside. Mix together white sugar and cinnamon. Roll biscuit quarters into sugar mixture and then place into Bundt pan. Sprinkle nutmeats over all. Melt oleo and brown sugar in saucepan. Bring to a boil just enough to dissolve sugar. Pour sauce over biscuits and bake for 35 minutes. Remove and let stand 10 minutes. Turn out onto a large plate.

title: Cranberry Muffins
directions: Combine flour, sugar, baking powder and salt., Mix., Add combined milk, margarine and egg., Fold in 2 teaspoons sugar and berries., Spoon in greased muffin pan 2/3 full., Bake at 400° for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Broccoli And Rice
directions: Cut up the tough end of the broccoli and cook along with the rice in the bouillon., When half done, add the rest of the broccoli pieces and finish cooking.

title: Chicken Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients and serve on rye or wheat bread.

title: Cantonese Shrimp And Beans
directions: Heat oil in skillet, saute shrimp, garlic and green peppers 5 minutes., Stir in ginger, salt, pepper, chicken broth and beans. Cover and simmer 6 to 8 minutes., Combine cornstarch with cold water, stir into shrimp, mixture and simmer 1 minute longer. Serve on bed of steaming hot rice.

title: Sky-High Strawberry Pie
directions: In a large bowl, mash enough berries to equal 3 cups., In a saucepan, combine the sugar and cornstarch., Stir in the mashed berries and water; mix well., Bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring constantly., Cook and stir for 2 minutes., Remove from the heat; add food coloring if desired., Pour into a large bowl. Chill for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until mixture is just slightly warm., Fold in the remaining berries., Pile into pie shell., Chill for 2 to 3 hours., In a small mixing bowl, whip the cream until soft peaks form; sprinkle pudding mix over cream and whip until stiff., Pipe around edge of pie or dollop on individual slices., Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Bar Cheese Spread
directions: Melt cheese in top of double boiler over boiling water. Combine the horseradish, mayonnaise, Tabasco sauce and chopped chives., Stir into melted cheese., Pour into jar., Cool., Cover and let stand in refrigerator 24 hours., Makes a generous pound of cheese spread.

title: Pear Relish
directions: Chop pears, onions and peppers., Soak in water., Heat sugar and vinegar., Pour over mixture., Seal jars., Heat lids and rings.

title: German Chocolate Pie
directions: Melt chocolate and butter., Beat egg yolks., Add sugar, milk and vanilla., Add chocolate mixture., Beat again., Add coconut and nuts., Bake in an unbaked pie shell at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes. Top with meringue.

title: Basic Chutney
directions: Cook in saucepan on low heat until thick and tender., This is do your own thing recipe.

title: Crunchy Chocolate Peanut Clusters
directions: Melt margarine in 3-quart saucepan over low heat., Add marshmallow cream and chocolate chips., Stir until smooth., Add corn flakes and peanuts; toss until well coated., Drop rounded tablespoonfuls of mixture onto waxed paper or cookie sheet and cool., Makes 2 1/2 dozen.

title: Easy Fudge Cookies
directions: In a medium saucepan, over very low heat, melt chocolate and shortening., Remove from heat and add sugar, egg, flour, salt and vanilla., Stir well., Pour into a greased 8 x 8 x 2-inch baking pan and sprinkle with chopped nuts, if desired., Bake in a preheated 400° oven for 12 minutes or until cookies test done. Remove from oven; cool in pan and then cut into 2-inch squares. Makes approximately 16 squares.

title: Ono Biscuits
directions: Mix all ingredients together and pour into pan., It will be very sticky., Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Pink Punch
directions: This is a good non-sherbet punch., We serve it sometimes at church special occasions.

title: Strawberry Pie
directions: Cook until thick., Add red food coloring., Add strawberries and pour into baked pie shell.

title: Banana Cream
directions: Place bananas in baking dish., Roast 15 minutes., Cool. Process bananas, sugar and rum., Puree., Add cream., Process until fluffy (approximately 2 minutes)., Can be made up to 4 hours ahead., Cover., Chill.

title: Momo'S Pecan Pie
directions: Mix together all ingredients and pour into uncooked shell. Bake at 375° for 45 minutes or until done.

title: Texas Hash
directions: Saute onions and green pepper in melted shortening until onions are yellow. Add ground beef; fry until mixture falls apart. Stir in remaining ingredients. Pour into greased 2-quart baking dish. Cover and bake at 350° for 1 hour. Remove cover the last 15 minutes. Serve hot with cornmeal muffins and salad.

title: Strawberry Salad
directions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water., Add crushed pineapple, strawberries, bananas and walnuts., Pour half of mixture in a pan and refrigerate until firm., Spread with sour cream and pour remaining mixture over sour cream., Chill until firm.

title: Green Pea Casserole
directions: Put drained peas in 9 x 12-inch casserole., Saute onions, celery and pepper in butter., Add to peas., Add rest of ingredients., Top with bread crumbs., Cook at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Best Deutsch Plowlines(Funnel Cakes)
directions: Stir together the first 5 ingredients., Mix egg and milk; add to flour mixture., Stir until batter is smooth., Pour oil into deep skillet to a depth of 1-inch (fill pan no more than 1/3 full)., Heat over medium heat to 375°.

title: Jalapeno Rice
directions: Saute onions, bell peppers and celery., Mix everything together in rice cooker and stir often., "The hotter, the better.", Sausage or shrimp may be added for variety.

title: Popcorn Ball Clowns
directions: You will also need 8-inch paper doilies (1 for each clown) and plastic foam cups (1 for each clown).

title: Yum Yum Pie
directions: Mix together., Press into 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 3 or 4 minutes., Let cool.

title: Eggplant Pasta Sauce
directions: Remove casings from Italian sausage and brown., Remove from pan., Drain off fat., Add 1/2 cup water to pan., Add onion, garlic, eggplant, carrots, basil and oregano., Simmer 10 to 15 minutes., Sprinkle the flour over the vegetables; stir., Slowly pour in milk and cook until the sauce thickens a little, 5 to 10 minutes., You may add more flour for thicker sauce., Season with pepper (optional) and serve over pasta., Yield: 4 to 6 servings.

title: Cheesy Potatoes
directions: Place sliced potatoes in cold water., Before using, drain and dry on paper towel., In 3-quart greased "with butter" casserole, layer potatoes with cheese, onion, salt and pepper., Top with remaining cheese., Beat eggs with milk and Ranch dressing and pour over top of potatoes and bake until tender., Dot with butter.

title: Spinach Dip
directions: Cut slice from top of bread; remove center, leaving a shell. Cut removed bread into bite-size pieces., Save., Brush inside of shell with 3 tablespoons margarine., Place on cookie sheet with cubed bread., Bake at 325° for 20 minutes.

title: Pecan Pie
directions: Beat eggs and mix with all ingredients., Line pan with pastry. Pour in the mixture and bake 1 hour.

title: Hershey'S Great American Chocolate Chip Cookies
directions: Cream butter or margarine, sugar, brown sugar and vanilla until light and fluffy., Add eggs; beat well., Combine flour, baking soda and salt; gradually beat into creamed mixture., Stir in chocolate chips and nuts., Drop by teaspoons onto ungreased cookie sheet., Bake at 375° for 8 to 10 minutes or until lightly browned., Cool slightly; remove from cookie sheet.

title: Kool-Aid Play Dough
directions: Mix and knead; store in Ziploc Baggies.

title: Pancit
directions: Fry the garlic and onion. Add the chicken, carrots and the cabbage. Set aside. Boil the chicken broth then add the rice noodles until it is cooked. Then add the vegetable mixture and stir until almost dry. Arrange on a platter and serve.

title: Banana Nut Bread
directions: Sift flour, baking powder, soda and salt. Cream the sugar and shortening., Add eggs, one at a time, and beat well., Add dry ingredients alternately with bananas, stirring just enough to blend. Do not beat. Add nuts with last addition of flour mixture. Pour into a greased loaf pan. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Pecan Pie Cookies
directions: Beat butter and sugar at medium speed with electric mixer until light and fluffy., Add 1/2 cup corn syrup and egg yolks, beating well., Gradually stir in flour, cover and chill for 1 hour., Melt 1/4 c. butter in a heavy saucepan over medium heat, stir in powdered sugar and 3 tablespoons corn syrup., Cook, stirring often until mixture boils., Remove from heat and stir in pecans., Chill for 30 minutes., Shape mixture by 1/2 teaspoon fulls into 1/4 inch balls., Place 2 inches apart on ungreased baking sheets., Beat egg whites until foamy and brush on dough balls., Bake at 375° for 6 minutes., Remove from oven and place pecan balls in center of each cookie., Bake 6 to 8 more minutes or until lightly browned., Cool 5 minutes on baking pans., Remove to wire racks to cool completely., Freeze if desired and serve.

title: Wok Sweet And Sour Chicken
directions: Place wok over high heat., When wok is hot, add 2 tablespoons oil., When oil is hot, add chicken and garlic., Stir-fry until chicken is opaque (4 minutes)., Remove from wok., Add 1 tablespoon of oil to wok., When hot, add onion and green pepper., Stir-fry for 1 minute., Return chicken to wok., Add Sweet and Sour Sauce and pineapple chunks., Stir until liquid boils and thickens (about 1 minute)., Serve over bed of rice.

title: Spinach Artichoke Dip
directions: Mix all ingredients., Spoon into 9-inch pie plate or 3-cup shallow baking dish., Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes., Serve with assorted crackers, veggies or pita triangles.

title: Strawberry Applesauce Jello
directions: Bring water to a boil and add red hots, stirring until melted. Add jello and stir to dissolve., Add lemon juice, then applesauce. Pour into any type pan to jell, 13 x 9-inch preferred., Top with whipped cream or serve plain.

title: Puffy Baked German Pancakes
directions: Preheat oven to 425°., Heat two 9-inch cast-iron skillets or heavy cake pans. (You need sturdy pans that can hold and conduct heat.)

title: Chocolate Cherry Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Spray 9 x 13 pan with Pam., Stir together the cake mix and milk until moistened., Pour into pan. Pour the pie filling evenly over the top., Most of the fruit will sink to the bottom., Bake 30 minutes., Sprinkle with walnuts and bake 20 minutes longer until nuts are toasted.

title: Glorified Rice
directions: Cook rice and cool., Add pineapple, whipped cream, rest of sugar, vanilla and marshmallows., Mix well and chill.

title: Cherries In The Snow
directions: Press graham cracker crust into bottom of 8 x 8-inch square pan., Beat cream cheese and sugar until fluffy., Add vanilla. Fold in whipped cream and marshmallows., Spread into pan and refrigerate several hours or overnight., Serve topped with cherry pie filling., Makes 9 to 12 servings.

title: Mexican Cornbread
directions: Brown ground beef., Chop onion in ground beef and drain well. Mix pork and beans with ground beef; set aside., Mix Jiffy mix, egg and milk together., Stir enough to moisten well., Pour ground beef and pork and beans into casserole dish., Pour corn bread mixture over beef and bake until golden brown for about 35 minutes at 350°., Will serve 4.

title: Soft Molasses Cookies
directions: Sift together dry ingredients., Cream wet ingredients., Stir both mixtures together., Drop by tablespoon on greased cookie sheet., Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.

title: Low Sugar Fruit Compote
directions: Break up cake into egg size pieces in large serving bowl., Add fruit and juice, then prepare pudding mix made with only 2 cups milk (rather than 3)., Mix lightly., Arrange a small amount of fruit on top., Top with Cool Whip., This is good with fresh strawberries.

title: Orange Salad
directions: Mix and let jell.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., In a large bowl, combine sweet potatoes, egg, butter and sugar., Turn into an 8 x 8-inch casserole dish., Cut off edges of bread and cut into cubes., Dip cubes into melted butter and place in rows on top of marshmallows and pineapple layer., Bake for 30 minutes.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
directions: Mix all together lightly and place into casserole dish., Bake 1/2 hour at 350°, then add 1 cup shredded Cheddar cheese and 1 cup crushed potato chips., Bake another 1/2 hour and serve.

title: Skillet Squash
directions: Heat corn oil in skillet over medium heat., Add onion; saute, stirring frequently until tender., Stir in zucchini, squash, salt, basil leaves, pepper and bay leaf., Cover and simmer about 20 minutes or until tender., Makes four 3/4-cup servings.

title: Sausage Hash Brown Bake
directions: In a large skillet, cook sausage over medium heat until no longer pink; drain on paper towels., In a large bowl, combine 1 3/4 cup of cheese and the next seven ingredients; fold in potatoes. Spread half into a greased shallow 3 qt. baking dish., Top with sausage and remaining potato mixture., Sprinkle with remaining cheese., Cover and bake at 350° for 45 minutes., Uncovered; bake 10 minutes longer or until heated thoroughly., Serves 10-12.

title: Marshmallow Treats
directions: Melt butter in saucepan., Add marshmallows; cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until marshmallows are melted., Remove from heat; add Rice Krispies., Stir until well mixed., Cool; cut into squares.

title: Fruit Salad
directions: Combine all ingredients in large bowl., Mix well and chill.

title: Tandy-Kakes
directions: Mix flour, sugar, milk, eggs and oil together., Pour into a greased 13 x 15-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

title: "Old Austrian Recipe"
directions: In large heavy skillet, saute chopped onion in oil., Add the mixed, cubed meat; fry 30 minutes., Stir in sauerkraut, drained and crumbled bay leaf., Simmer covered for 1 1/2 hours, until meat and sauerkraut are tender., Season to taste with salt and pepper. Just before serving, stir in the sour cream.

title: Candied Yams
directions: Place potatoes in pan and add water., Steam in oven at 350° for about 10 minutes or until potatoes begin to get tender, then add salt, sugar and creamed butter after mixing well., Pour this over potatoes and cook in oven for 30 minutes or until syrup is thickened., The potatoes will have a glazed look., Don't overcook!

title: Peanut Butter Fudge Frosting
directions: Cook over medium heat the sugar, milk and salt to soft ball stage., Remove from heat., Stir in peanut butter, butter, vanilla, coconut and chopped nuts., Wait 5 minutes., Beat with spoon until spreading consistency., Spread over 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Hot Chocolate Mix
directions: Mix well and store., Use 2 coffee measures to 1 cup hot water.

title: Blueberry Lemon Pound Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Grease an 8 x 4-inch loaf pan and set aside. Cream the butter., Gradually add 1 cup sugar, beating at medium speed until well blended., Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition., In separate bowl, combine 1 1/2 cups flour, baking powder and salt., Add to sugar mixture alternately with milk, beginning and ending with flour mixture. Stir in lemon rind., Dredge blueberries in 2 teaspoons flour. Fold into batter. Pour batter into prepared loaf pan. Bake at 350° for 55 to 60 minutes or until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean. Combine 1/3 cup sugar and lemon juice in a small saucepan., Heat until sugar dissolves., Pierce top of bread in several places with a wooden pick or long fork tines., Pour lemon juice mixture over warm bread and let it soak in., Cool bread in pan for 30 minutes. Makes 1 loaf.

title: Candy
directions: Mix sugar and Karo together in heavy saucepan., Bring to a boil, stirring constantly., Add crunchy peanut butter., Pour over corn flakes in a large bowl., Toss to coat., Spoon in small pieces on waxed paper.

title: Chicken-Noodle Casserole
directions: Cook noodles according to directions., While cooking, combine soups and milk; add chicken, peas, salt, pepper and mushrooms. Drain noodles and stir in., Pour all in a 9 x 13-inch dish sprayed with Pam., Bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Apricot Cream Cheese Salad
directions: Combine jello and pineapple., Heat until mixture simmers. Add sugar, apricots and softened cream cheese., Continue heating, stirring occasionally, until cheese melts., Remove from heat; chill until mixture mounds when dropped from spoon., Whip chilled evaporated milk until stiff peaks form; fold into apricot mixture. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan., Chill until firm., Top with chopped nuts., Serves 15.

title: Easy Chili Vegetable Soup
directions: Chop onions; brown hamburger and onions., Drain., Mix in chili beans and mixed vegetables., Cook on low heat for 1 hour.

title: Date Nut Bread
directions: Mix dates, soda and boiling water and let stand until cool. Mix remaining ingredients and add to date mixture; bake at 350° for 1 hour., I bake in round fruit tins.

title: Squash Dressing
directions: Spray 9 x 9-inch baking dish with Pam., Mix all ingredients together in a bowl., Pour into baking dish., Bake at 425° until brown.

title: Dessert Crepes
directions: Combine first 5 ingredients, beating until smooth., Add eggs and beat well; stir in butter., Refrigerate 2 hour., (This allows flour particles to swell and soften so crepes are light in texture.), Brush bottom of a 6-inch crepe pan or heavy skillet with oil; place over medium heat until just hot, not smoking., Pour 2 tablespoons batter into pan; quickly tilt in all directions so batter covers pan in a thin film., Cook 1 minute or until lightly browned., Lift edge of crepe to test for doneness., Crepe is ready for flipping when it can be shaken loose from pan., Flip crepe and cook about 30 seconds on other side., (This is rarely more than spotty brown and is the side on which the filling is placed.) Place crepes on a towel to cool., Stack between layers of waxed paper to prevent sticking., Repeat until all batter is used.

title: Lazy Peach Cobbler
directions: Melt butter in baking dish., Mix together flour, egg and milk. Pour over butter., Dissolve sugar in peaches., Add vanilla; pour on top., Bake at 350° or until lightly browned.

title: Tortilla Pizza
directions: Combine chili sauce and refried beans in saucepan over medium heat until well blended., Spread on tortilla shells., Add remaining toppings of choice and bake at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes or until cheese is melted.

title: Green Beans Oregano With Pimientos
directions: Combine all ingredients, except pimientos, in a saucepan. Bring to a boil., Separate beans with a fork., Reduce heat; cover and simmer 6 to 8 minutes or until beans are tender-crisp., Add pimientos and heat 1 minute.

title: Strawberry Shortcake
directions: Sift together dry ingredients. Cut in butter to dry ingredients until mixture is like coarse crumbs. Combine egg and milk; add to dry ingredients all at once, stirring only to moisten. For big biscuit style, spread dough into a greased 8 x 1 1/2-inch round pan, slightly building up dough around edges. Bake at 350° for 15 to 18 minutes or until golden brown. Remove from pan. Cool on rack about 3 minutes. Serve with strawberries and whip cream. Makes 1 shortcake.

title: Carrot Cake
directions: Mix sugar and oil; add 3 eggs., Mix well., Add carrots and pineapple; add dry ingredients (sifted together)., Bake in a well greased and floured pan at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Coconut Cream Pie
directions: Mix the first 5 ingredients and cook until thickened., After cooling, stir in 1 1/2 cups coconut. Top with beaten egg whites. Sprinkle with 1/2 cup coconut on top. Brown in a 400° oven about 8 or 9 minutes.

title: Blueberry Delight
directions: Mix melted butter with cracker crumbs. Press mixture down firm on a 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Potato Pancakes(Placki)
directions: Mix liquid raw potatoes, salt and egg., Gradually add flour (you may not need to use the full cup of flour)., Using shortening heated in iron skillet, drop batter into hot liquid and spread to size placki you want., Fry on both sides., Serve with sour cream.

title: Taco Casserole
directions: Cook ground chuck and onion in a large skillet. Add taco seasoning, tomatoes, tomato sauce and nacho cheese soup., Let simmer for 10 minutes., In casserole dish, add crushed chips. Pour hot mixture on top of chips. Stir well., If too dry, add about 1 cup water or tomato juice. Top with cheese and microwave 5 minutes.

title: Apple Pie With Pecan Crumble
directions: Combine 1, 1/2 cups flour and 1/2 teaspoon salt., Cut 4 tablespoons of, the, butter, and, the, shortening into the dry ingredients until, the mixture resembles coarse meal., Add the water 1, tablespoon, at, a	time, tossing until the dough just holds together., Wrap, in, plastic and refrigerate at least 30 minutes.

title: Brenda'S Peanut Butter Cookies
directions: Mix flour, salt and soda., Set aside., Mix butter and peanut butter., Add both sugars., Mix well., Add eggs and beat well. Stir flour mixture into peanut butter mixture., Drop dough from a teaspoon onto a baking pan., Flatten with a fork., Bake at 375° for 10 to 15 minutes, until lightly browned., Makes 4 to 5 dozen cookies.

title: Pork Chops In Olive Gravy
directions: Brown chops., Place chops in baking pan with remaining ingredients., Bake, uncovered, at 325° for 1 hour.

title: Beef Barbecue
directions: Brown and drain hamburger., Mix with all other ingredients. Cook on simmer until thoroughly cooked and flavors blended (about 45 minutes)., Stir frequently., Thicken with 3 tablespoons flour and cook an additional 30 minutes., Serve on bread or buns.

title: Green Rice
directions: Use no salt., Saute onion and green pepper in margarine until transparent., Add water and bouillon cubes., Bring to a boil to dissolve cubes., Add rice, parsley and pepper., Bake in a deep 2-quart casserole, covered, for 3/4 to 1 hour or until water is absorbed and rice is tender., Oven should be at 350°., Remove from oven, flake rice with fork, replace cover and let steam for 10 minutes before serving.

title: Spiced Chiffon Cake
directions: Preheat, oven, to, 325°., In, bowl sift together flour, sugar, baking powder, salt and spices., Make a well in center of mixture, and, add, oil, egg yolks, water and grated orange rind. Beat, with, a wooden spoon until smooth., In large bowl beat together egg whites and cream of tartar until stiff, but not dry. Slowly pour egg yolk mixture over beaten egg whites, folding just until blended., Do not stir., Pour batter into an ungreased 10-inch, tube pan., Bake 55 minutes., Increase oven temperature to 350° and bake 10 minutes longer., Invert pan on a funnel, or bottle., Cool cake completely., Remove from pan. Makes one 10-inch tube cake.

title: Marinated Pork Roast
directions: Combine first 6 ingredients in a shallow pan, stirring well. Place roast in dish (pan)., Cover and marinate 3 to 4 hours in the refrigerator, turning occasionally., Remove roast from marinade and place on a rack in a shallow roasting pan., Insert meat thermometer at an angle into thickest part of meat., Bake, uncovered, at 325° until thermometer registers 170° (2 1/2 to 3 hours) total cooking time.

title: Broccoli And Rice
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Mix all ingredients together and put in casserole dish., Bake for 30 minutes or until heated through.

title: Cream Cheese Mints
directions: Beat, cream cheese with milk until smooth., Add remaining ingredients, blend., Press small amounts into candy molds. Remove from, molds, and, air, dry at room temperature, 4 to 6 hours. Store in airtight containers., Yields 4 dozen.

title: Raspberry Almond Thumbprint Cookies
directions: Cream powdered sugar, butter, salt and almond flavoring until light and fluffy., Stir in flour., Shape dough into 1 1/2-inch balls., Roll cookies in finely chopped almonds., Place on an ungreased baking sheet about 2-inches apart., Make a depression in the center of the cookie with thumb., Bake at 350° for 12 to 16 minutes or until edges are lightly brown., Fill depression with 1/4 teaspoon raspberry jam or enough to fill center., Melt white confection baking bar in double boiler; drizzle over cookie.

title: Prayer Bars
directions: First Layer:, Melt over hot water butter and cocoa., Add powdered sugar, egg and vanilla., Set aside., Mix together crumbs, nuts and coconut., Press into 9 x 13-inch pan and chill.

title: Nut Bread
directions: Heat oven, to 350°., Mix sugar, egg, milk and Bisquick, then beat, vigorously, for, 30, seconds., Batter, may still be slightly lumpy., Stir in walnuts., Pour into well greased loaf pan, 9 x, 5 x 3-inches., Bake 45 to 50 minutes until toothpick stuck into center comes out clean., Cool and slice.

title: Sweet-N-Sour Pork
directions: Drain pineapple, reserving juice. In large skillet, heat corn oil over medium heat., Add green pepper (cut into 1-inch squares), onion (cut in thin wedges) and garlic., Stir-fry 2 minutes or until tender-crisp., Remove from skillet., Stir-fry pork, half at a time, for 3 minutes. Return all pork to skillet.

title: Chili
directions: Brown meat, onion, bell pepper and garlic in pot., (Drain grease if necessary.), Add rest of ingredients and bring to a boil., Lower heat and simmer for an hour, covered.

title: Self-Filling Cupcakes
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Prepare cake mix according to package directions. Spoon into paper lined muffin tins, filling 3/4 full. Mix the softened cheese, egg, salt and sugar together until light and fluffy. Add the chips., Drop by teaspoon into each cupcake. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes; check for doneness., Makes about 2 dozen cupcakes. Frost with favorite icing, if desired.

title: To Make Self-Rising Flour(1 Pound)
directions: Mix all ingredients well., Store in tightly covered can or jar and use soon., Use in any recipe calling for self-rising flour.

title: Gingerbread
directions: Cream oleo and sugar; add beaten eggs; add dry ingredients, which have been sifted together alternately with water., Mix thoroughly; pour into well greased 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake for 40 minutes at 350°.

title: Brenda'S Mississippi Mud Cake
directions: Mix ingredients and bake in oblong cake pan at 300° for 30 to 45 minutes., Cover with small marshmallows when removed from hot oven.

title: Double Chocolate Mocha Trifle
directions: Prepare brownies according to package directions., Bake. Allow to cool.

title: Chicken Rice Casserole
directions: Melt oleo in large pan., Place sliced onions on top of oleo. Pour rice on top., Add beef consomme and water., Place chicken pieces on top and season., Pour mushroom soup over all., Cover with foil and bake 1 hour at 400°., Remove foil and bake 30 minutes.

title: Roasted Potatoes
directions: Mix all together., Bake in casserole dish at 450° about 40 minutes., Stir several times while cooking to coat potatoes.

title: Flock Of Geese Chicken Salad
directions: In a large bowl combine the first 4 ingredients., Set aside. In a small bowl combine mayonnaise, sour cream and vinegar; mix well., Pour over chicken mixture., Toss to coat., Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour., (Wonderful on croissant rolls.) Recipe can be cut in half.

title: Mexican Chicken Pizza
directions: Heat oven to 425°., Grease 12-inch pizza pan with oil; sprinkle with cornmeal., Unroll dough; press in greased pan., In large bowl, combine chicken, chili powder, cumin and garlic salt. Mix well., Spoon chicken evenly over dough; top with tomato, olives, onions, green chilies, Monterey Jack and Cheddar cheese. Bake at 425° for 20 to 24 minutes or until golden brown., Serve topped with avocado slices and salsa., Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Mrs. Sallie E. Nunnally'S Chess Pie
directions: Melt the cup of butter., Beat the two eggs thoroughly., Add the melted butter to the eggs and beat., Add the two tablespoons of water and the cup of sugar. Beat until all ingredients are mixed well. Pour the mixture in the pie crusts., Bake at 325° for approximately 20 to 25 minutes, until the mixture is "set."

title: Pecan Pie
directions: Set oven to 350°., Beat first 5 ingredients. Add pecans., Pour into pie shell., Bake 45 to 60 minutes until knife inserted halfway between center and edge comes out clean.

title: Chicken Spaghetti Casserole
directions: Reserve some cheese; mix all other ingredients., Put in a baking dish and top with reserved cheese., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Chicken And Dumplings
directions: Cook until done; let cool., Debone., Add enough salt to broth to suit your taste., Add 1 teaspoon yellow coloring.

title: Apple Fritters
directions: Sift flour, sugar, and	cinnamon together., Combine egg and milk., Stir in dry ingredients and add grated apples., Fry at 350° for 3, minutes., Sprinkle, with confectioners sugar or glaze.

title: Stuffed Tomatoes
directions: Cut tomatoes into fourths, about two-thirds of the way down. Put a leaf of lettuce on a plate and place tomato on top., Set aside., Mix tuna (drained) and mayonnaise together., Add eggs and onions., Carefully fill tomatoes with tuna salad., Serve with crackers., Great for the summer.

title: Every Kind Cookies
directions: Mix first five ingredients together until smooth., Add oats, flour, soda and salt., Mix well., Put in nuts and chocolate; mix just enough to blend., Spread batter into a cookie sheet., Bake 20 minutes at 350°.

title: Delicious Peach Cobbler
directions: Preheat the oven to 350°., Mix peaches with 1 cup of the sugar and 1 teaspoon cinnamon., Set aside., Put butter in 9-inch square pan and place in oven to melt., In a mixing bowl, combine remaining sugar, flour, baking powder, salt and milk., Blend with spoon until smooth and pour over melted butter (do not stir)., Top with peaches (do not stir)., Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until golden brown., Serve with a pitcher of sweet cream or ice cream. Serves 9.

title: Crabmeat Mornay
directions: Melt butter in heavy pot and saute onions and parsley., Blend in flour, cream and cheese until cheese is melted., Add remaining ingredients and gently fold in crabmeat., May be served fancy in chafing dish with Melba toast or in patty shells or just warm with crackers., Serves 8.

title: Fried Chicken
directions: Pour milk and eggs into bowl, Add cut up chicken pieces and soak for 15-20 minutes., Mix flour, salt, and pepper., Roll chicken in the mix., Heat oil in a frying pan and cook chicken until done.

title: Mary'S Delight
directions: Dip cookies in milk., Lay in 9 x 13-inch pan., Top with layer of Cool Whip, then continue with layers, cookies in milk layer and Cool Whip until all is in layers., Top with crumbled cookies. Refrigerate 1 hour., (Gallon Ziploc to crush cookies for top.)

title: Heloise'S Sweetened Condensed Milk
directions: Mix in a blender until all the sugar is dissolved. A few drops of water can be added to the mixture, if necessary. This will make it look like sweetened condensed milk.

title: Crescent Crust Taco Pie
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., Brown beef and onion. Drain well. Stir in seasoning mix, water and olives. Simmer 5 minutes.

title: Sliced Apple Cake
directions: Mix well all dry ingredients., Add oil and eggs., Stir in apples., This is very thick., Press into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 50 minutes or until done., (Hint: Put a cover on cake as soon as it comes from oven.)

title: Colby Apple Cobbler
directions: Combine sugar, flour and cinnamon; toss with apples., Pour into 9-inch square pan.

title: Artichoke Dip
directions: Drain and chop artichoke hearts., Add mayonnaise, Parmesan cheese and chopped green chilies., Mix thoroughly and put into baking dish. Bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes until brown around the sides. Serve hot or cold.

title: Chicken Liver Pate
directions: Cook liver in simmering water for 10 minutes., Drain and chop fine., Blend liver and remaining ingredients to smooth paste. Cover and refrigerate.

title: Spicy Chicken Spaghetti
directions: Cover and cook 5 to 6 pound hen until tender; remove and debone., Cook spaghetti in broth; may need to add water and do not drain., Saute peppers and onions in butter for 45 minutes on low heat., Add this to spaghetti; add peas, also juice from peas., Add chopped chicken and Ro-Tel., Add cheese in hunks; place in greased casserole dish., Place in hot oven about 350°; cover until cheese melts.

title: Broccoli Cheese Soup
directions: Combine all ingredients in slow cooker; stir to blend., Cook on low for 4 hours., Yields 8 servings.

title: Mother'S Sunshine Pickles
directions: Peel and cut up cukes, removing all seeds., Cook until slightly tender and place in jars and seal., Very good!

title: Potato Dumplings
directions: Mix instant potatoes with water and salt., Blend eggs into cooled potatoes., Slowly add the flour., Dip a tablespoon into salted, boiling water to get it hot., Use hot spoon to chop off a 1/2 tablespoon of dough and drop it into the hot water., Keep doing this until all dough is used up., Let the dumplings boil until all are expanded and look spongy and are floating., Take out with slotted spoon and toss with butter., Use in soups, stews, casseroles, etc.

title: Nut And Jam Cake
directions: Mix shortening and sugar well; add eggs; add milk and flour. Then add all of the spices and coffee., Mix well; add raisins and nuts., Bake in round layer pans at 325° until done.

title: Breakfast Pizza
directions: Place crescent roll dough on round pizza pan or cookie sheet. Place dough in pan as pizza dough., Beat eggs in bowl, then spread over dough and top with other ingredients such as green pepper, onion, mushrooms, bacon (fried and crumbled), sausage (cooked) or ham., Now top with grated cheese., Bake at 375° until eggs and crust are set, about 15 minutes.

title: Salmon Croquettes
directions: Heat water to boiling., Remove from heat and add instant potatoes; mix., Add to the rest of the ingredients and mix well. Shape into patties., Roll in a mixture of 1 cup flour and 1 cup cracker meal., Fry in cooking oil in skillet until golden brown. Drain on paper towel.

title: Scalloped Chicken
directions: In a mixing bowl, combine bread cubes and 1 cup cracker crumbs., Stir in broth, eggs, salt, celery, onion, chicken and mushrooms., Spoon into a greased 2-quart casserole.

title: Banana Cake With Peanut Butter Icing
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Grease and flour a 9 x 13-inch baking pan., In a medium bowl combine flour, baking powder, soda and salt., Set aside., In a small bowl combine bananas and buttermilk; set aside.

title: Potato Casserole
directions: Boil potatoes until tender; drain., Mix with remaining ingredients and place in casserole dish., Bake at 325° for 45 minutes, uncovered., Sprinkle with paprika, if desired.

title: Pea Salad
directions: In bowl, mix peas, onion, celery and pepper., In serving bowl, place lettuce to cover bottom., Place 1/2 the pea mixture on top of lettuce; sprinkle 1 teaspoon sugar over that., Cover with another layer of lettuce pieces,, then rest of pea mixture. Sprinkle 1 teaspoon sugar over top., Empty mayonnaise on top and spread evenly., Place cheese on top of mayonnaise, covering it evenly., Empty bacon bits on cheese and spread evenly., Decorate with celery leaf, if desired.

title: Pasta Chicken
directions: Cook pasta; set aside., Cut up chicken; stir-fry with some garlic and parsley., Mix together the milk, bouillon, cornstarch and margarine; add to chicken., Pour over pasta.

title: Peanut Butter Bars
directions: Mix together and press into oblong pan all but chocolate chips., Melt chips and pour over other mixture; spread evenly. Let cool and cut into squares.

title: Corn Casserole
directions: Combine and pour into buttered casserole dish. Bake 35 to 40 minutes in a 350° oven.

title: Easy Chicken Casserole
directions: Lay chicken in 9 x 13-inch pan., Place cheese on top., Mix soup with 1/2 can water; cover chicken., Mix stuffing with butter and water according to package directions., Place on top of casserole and cover with foil., Bake 1 hour at 350°.

title: Zesta Steak
directions: Cut beef in 8 pieces., Combine flour, cracker crumbs, garlic, onion, salt and pepper., Mix egg and Worcestershire sauce together., Dip steak into egg and Worcestershire sauce mixture, then in crumbs mixture., Fry in skillet in oil, then place in 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish and put on onion slices., Combine tomato sauce, chili sauce, brown sugar, chili powder, dry mustard and vinegar., Pour over steak., Put on green pepper slices (on top). Cover and bake at 325° for 2 hours or until tender.

title: Honey-Lime Chicken
directions: Mix mustard, lime juice, garlic, soy sauce and lime peel until well blended., Reserve 1/2 cup of the mustard mixture for serving with cooked chicken., Grill or broil chicken 15 minutes or until cooked through, turning and brushing occasionally with remaining mustard mixture., Serve with reserved 1/2 cup mustard mixture.

title: Tasty Snack
directions: Mix together in a bowl. Spread out on waxed paper to harden.

title: Divinity
directions: Stir sugar, corn, syrup, and, water over low heat until sugar is	dissolved., Cook, without, stirring, until, a, small amount of mixture dropped into cold water forms a hard ball or the candy thermometer, reads	260°., In, mixing, bowl beat egg whites until stiff peaks form., Continue beating while pouring hot syrup in a thin stream into egg whites., Add vanilla; beat until mixture holds its shape and becomes slightly dull.	Fold in nuts., Drop mixture, from tip of buttered spoon onto waxed paper., Four dozen is this recipe's yield.

title: Armenian Pilaf
directions: Melt butter in heavy pan., Break vermicelli into small pieces; saute in butter until golden brown, stirring constantly., Add rice; keep stirring until rice is well coated, 2 to 3 minutes. Add boiling chicken broth and salt., Cook, covered, on medium-low heat for 20 minutes, until liquid is absorbed., Fluff with fork. Serves 8.

title: Gingerbread
directions: Beat the first five ingredients together., Add flour, sifted with salt, cinnamon, ginger, allspice and soda., Bake in 350° oven for 45 minutes.

title: Vanilla Ice Cream
directions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl; beat at medium speed of an electric mixer until well blended., Pour mixture into freezer can of electric freezer (or hand-turned)., Freeze according to manufacturer's directions., Let ripen at least 1 hour (if you can wait!)., Yields 5 quarts.

title: Almond Fantasy Cookies
directions: Work first 6 ingredients together to form a smooth paste., Add toffee chips., Roll a spoonful of dough between the palms of hands. Flatten with bottom of glass or cookie press., Bake on ungreased cookie sheet for 25 minutes at 325° until golden brown.

title: Oyster Crackers
directions: Wrap raw oysters with bacon (Sizzlean is better)., Place in pan., Cook in oven under the broiler., When done on first side, turn over., Seasoning comes from bacon.

title: Don'T Stir Cherry Pie
directions: Melt margarine in baking dish., Mix flour, sugar and milk; pour batter over butter., Don't stir; just leave alone., Pour fruit over batter; don't stir., Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until brown.

title: Poppy Seed Chicken
directions: Cook chicken and debone., Cut into bite size pieces and put in bottom of greased casserole., Mix soup and sour cream and spread over chicken., Sprinkle crushed crackers over soup., Pour melted margarine over crackers., Sprinkle poppy seed on top., Bake at 325° about 30 minutes.

title: Cheese Wafers (Snacks)
directions: Process cheese and butter in a food processor until blended., Add flour, salt and paprika; process until mixture forms a ball, stopping often to scrape down the sides., Add cereal and almonds; process until blended., Stop twice to scrape the sides., Shape dough into 1 inch balls., Place balls about 2 inches apart on an ungreased baking sheet., Flatten each ball in a crisscross pattern with a fork dipped in flour., Bake at 350° for 12 -14 minutes or until lightly browned., Remove to wire racks to cool., Store in an airtight container.

title: Sugared Nuts
directions: Preheat oven to 225°., In medium bowl, beat egg white until foamy., Stir in sugar, cinnamon and nuts, coating well., Spread on a greased baking sheet., Bake 1 hour, stirring every 15 minutes. Cool completely., Store in airtight container.

title: Good Relish
directions: Grind or chop all vegetables together., Put on salt; stir and set aside for 5 minutes., Drain off excess water., Add sugar, vinegar and water., Put in hot jars and seal.

title: Fran'S Broccoli Casserole
directions: In saucepan, melt butter; add flour, salt, milk, cream cheese and Cheddar cheese., Cook and stir until sauce boils., Remove from heat., Cook broccoli until crisp/tender., Combine broccoli and cheese sauce; pour into casserole dish.

title: Sugarless Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Bake in greased and floured tube pan for 40 minutes at 300°.

title: Lo-Cal Tuna Salad
directions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl and chill., Use for sandwiches or with crackers., Will also stuff 8 tomatoes.

title: Grandpa Griffin'S Squirrel And Rice
directions: Shoot a squirrel., Bring home, skin and dress (head and all). Put in pot; season and boil until tender., Add rice and cook until done., Serve with hot homemade biscuits and baked sweet taters.

title: Too Easy Peach Cobbler
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Place fruit in a buttered 8 x 8-inch baking dish., Cut crusts from bread slices and cut each slice into 5 fingers., Place the bread fingers over peaches., In a bowl, mix sugar, flour, egg and butter., Bake for 35 to 45 minutes or until golden brown., Serves 4 to 6.

title: Impossible Chicken-Vegetable Pie
directions: Heat oven to 400°., Grease pie plate, 9 x, 1 1/4-inch., Mix chicken, zucchini, tomato, onion and cheese., Spoon evenly into pie plate., Beat remaining ingredients 15 seconds in blender on high speed, 1 minute with wire whisk or hand beater or until smooth., Pour evenly over chicken mixture.

title: Quick Chicken Enchiladas
directions: Warm shells slightly to prevent cracking., In each shell, place chicken, a sprinkling of cheese and 1 tablespoon picante sauce., Roll and place in greased baking dish., Continue with each roll., Pour remaining picante sauce and spread cheese evenly over dish., Bake at 400° until cheese is bubbly, about 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Pasta With Tomato Vodka Sauce
directions: Heat oil in a large skillet. Add onion; saute until tender (not brown), 5 minutes., Stir in garlic., Add tomatoes, vodka and red pepper; break up tomatoes with side of spoon., Cook until sauce is reduced by 1/3 and thickened, 15 minutes., Stir in cream; simmer, stirring (do not allow to boil) 5 minutes. Season with salt.

title: Baked Apple French Toast
directions: Preheat oven to 400°., Spray a 9 x 13-inch baking pan or dish with vegetable oil spray. slice bread into 1-1/2 inch slices. Place bread tightly together in one layer in 9 x 13-inch baking dish or pan., Place eggs in batter bowl and beat lightly., Add milk, 1/4 c. sugar and vanilla and mix with 10 inch whisk., Pour half of liquid over bread., Peel, core and slice apples., Cut into rings., Place apple rings on top of bread to cover., Pour remaining egg mixture over apples., Mix remaining 1/2 c. sugar with cinnamon and place in flour/sugar shaker., Sprinkle evenly over apples., Dot with butter., Bake for 35 minutes., Cool for 5-10 minutes before serving., Serve with maple syrup.

title: Fruit Salad
directions: Drain all the fruit (reserve juice)., Chop all fruit and cut cherries in halves., Mix all together in a large mixing bowl. Sprinkle instant pudding mix over fruit., If fruit seems too thick, add some of the reserved juice. Chill.

title: Sugar Creme Cake
directions: Mix cake mix with butter and 2 eggs., Pour into greased sheet cake pan (13 x 9-inches)., Mix cream cheese, powdered sugar and the additional 2 eggs., Pour over cake mixture., Bake at 325° for 25 to 35 minutes.

title: Green Bean Casserole
directions: Melt butter., Add flour, sugar and salt to make a paste., Add cheese until it melts., Remove from heat., Add sour cream to beans., Top with corn flakes and butter., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Far East Celery
directions: Cook celery in a little boiling water until crisp done, about 8 minutes., Mix celery with water chestnuts which have been drained and thinly sliced., Add chicken soup and diced pimento. Place in a one-quart casserole., Toss breadcrumbs with almonds and melted butter., Sprinkle over casserole., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until hot., Serves 6.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
directions: In medium saucepan, melt butter; stir in brown sugar and milk. Bring to a boil; boil 2 minutes while stirring., Remove from heat and add peanut butter and vanilla., Stir until smooth., Mix in confectioners sugar 1 cup at a time, mixing well after each addition., Spread into buttered 9-inch square pan., Cool and cut into squares.

title: German Chocolate Upside-Down Cake
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Oil pan and sprinkle coconut and pecans over a 9 x 13-inch pan., Mix cake mix according to box., Pour over coconut and pecans.

title: All-Bran Icebox Rolls
directions: Dissolve yeast in warm water., Combine cereal, sugar, salt, shortening and boiling water., Stir until shortening is melted. Cool until lukewarm., Add yeast mixture and stir in eggs. Gradually add flour and mix thoroughly., Place in large bowl, cover and refrigerate overnight., When ready to use, shape as desired., Brush with melted butter and let rise in warm place until doubled in size., Bake at 400` for 20 minutes., Makes 2 1/2 dozen large rolls.

title: Blueberry Buckle
directions: Mix all ingredients and sprinkle on top of batter., Bake in 375° oven for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Strawberry Jam
directions: Measure strawberries into 6-quart pot., Measure sugar into bowl., Stir sugar into fruit; mix thoroughly., Bring mixture to full rolling boil over high heat, stirring constantly, and quickly stir pectin into fruit mixture., Bring to full rolling boil, stirring constantly, then continue boiling for 1 minute, stirring constantly., Remove from heat., Fill jars immediately to 1/8-inch from tops of jars., Wipe jar rims and threads., Cover quickly with lids; screw bands tightly., Check to see if sealed in 4 to 5 minutes., Makes about 4 (8 ounce) jars.

title: Baked Lasagna
directions: Saute meat, breaking into small parts as it browns., Remove casing from sausage as it browns., Set aside., Add tomato paste, juice, salt and oregano to meat and simmer 1 hour., Cook noodles in salted, boiling water until tender., Prepare a filling by mixing cheese, eggs, oregano, salt and pepper., Put a layer of sauce in the bottom of a greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish., Then alternate with a layer of meat sauce, cheese and noodles. Sprinkle with cheese and bake at 375° for 40 minutes., Let set 15 minutes before serving.

title: Chocolate Pecan Pie
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., In medium bowl with fork, beat eggs slightly., Add sugar, corn syrup, butter, vanilla and chocolate. Stir until well blended., Stir in pecans., Pour into pie crust. Bake 50 to 55 minutes., Cool on wire rack.

title: Meat Loaf
directions: Mix well in large bowl., Either divide and make 2 small loaves or make 1 large, topping both with tomato catsup., Cook at 250° for about 2 1/2 hours., Pack small potatoes and carrots around meat loaf., Cover with foil and cook the same as meat loaf.

title: Banana Brunch Cake
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Grease 13 x 9-inch baking pan., Combine pancake mix, 3/4 cup brown sugar and cinnamon., Add banana, milk, egg and oil; mix well., Spread into prepared pan., Combine nuts, 1/4 cup brown sugar and margarine; sprinkle evenly over batter. Bake about 30 minutes or until golden brown., Yields 12 servings.

title: Chicken Cheese Ball
directions: Mix first 5 ingredients and form ball., Roll in pecans and refrigerate.

title: Five-Cup Salad
directions: In a large decorative bowl, combine all ingredients., Chill several hours or overnight.

title: Smoked Sausage Antipasto Salad
directions: Brown smoked, sliced sausage in a skillet and drain well on paper towels., Arrange lettuce on a large serving dish and top with vegetables and sausage., Add Feta cheese., Pour dressing over salad and serve., Total preparation and cooking time:, 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Cheese Ball
directions: Combine first 4 ingredients., Form into a ball and cover with dried beef.

title: Ripe Tomato Relish
directions: Combine cabbage, bell peppers and salt; let set for 1 hour, then drain., Combine with remaining ingredients; mix well and cook for 40 minutes, stirring frequently., Make a paste of 1/2 cup flour and 1 cup cool water to which is added some of the hot relish mixture to prevent lumping; add this to mixture, stirring rapidly until thick., Place in hot jars and seal., Process filled jars in a hot water bath for 10 minutes., Yield: 6 to 8 pints.

title: Chicken Rotel
directions: Saute green pepper in margarine., Add spaghetti, Ro-Tel, pepper and onion to cooked chicken., Stir well until melted., Add peas and mushrooms., Place in 9 x 13-inch casserole dish, bake at 325° for about 20 to 30 minutes., Feeds 10 people., Freezes well.

title: Banana Bread
directions: Cream sugar and shortening., Add and mix eggs (one at a time); add walnuts., Sift and add next four ingredients, then add bananas., Pour into loaf pan., Bake at 350° for 55 minutes.

title: Magic Shell Delight
directions: Mix Cool Whip and pudding mix together., Add milk and mix. Layer crackers in bottom of baking dish (9 x 13); cover with 1/2 of pudding mix., Make another layer., Cover with Magic Shell syrup., Refrigerate several hours or over night.

title: Applesauce Nut Cake
directions: Mix all together and put in a 9 x 13-inch ungreased pan. Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

title: Vanilla Pudding
directions: Mix sugar, cornstarch and egg with a little milk to moisten. Scald milk and add to sugar mixture., Place in double boiler. Stir constantly until thick. Add vanilla and butter until blended. May add sliced banana for banana pudding.

title: Rice Krispies Peanut Butter Balls
directions: Combine syrup, sugar and butter in saucepan and bring to a boil., Reduce heat and add peanut butter, stirring until melted. Pour peanut butter mixture over Rice Krispies in a large bowl. Stir until well mixed and spread into greased 9 x 13 inch pan and press down lightly and cool, cut into bars.

title: State Fair Funnel Cakes
directions: Combine flour, baking powder, salt, eggs, and milk., Mix thoroughly., Heat cooking oil in a deep skillet., Cover tip of funnel with finger and fill with batter., Hold funnel over skillet; release batter in circular motion, then crisscross batter to form funnel cake., Batter will rise and expand while cooking. Cook until golden brown on both sides. Sprinkle with powdered sugar or coat with glaze., Serve warm.

title: Ruth Rubendunst'S Tomato Sauce
directions: Scald tomatoes in boiling water., Peel and seed., Cut into quarters., Heat oil in large soup pot over medium heat., Saute onion, garlic and celery until wilted., Add tomatoes, tomato paste, herbs, salt and pepper, bay leaf and sugar., Bring to a boil and simmer 2 hours., Remove bay leaf, cool and pack into freezer containers or 18 ounce jars., Makes about 6 (18 ounce) containers.

title: Sour Cream Raisin Pie
directions: Cover raisins with water and cook 5 minutes. Drain., Combine sugar, flour and salt., Add to raisins, along with sour cream, egg yolks (that have been beaten good) and oleo. Cook very slowly, stirring, until mixture thickens., Add vanilla., Pour into baked pie shell. Top with meringue and brown.

title: Old Fashioned Tea Cakes(1920)
directions: Cream butter and sugar., Add egg, milk, soda, baking powder and flour in small amounts until dough is stiff enough to roll. Roll out or cut in shape desired., Bake at 300° until lightly colored.

title: Grape Pie
directions: Slip skins; cook insides and bring to a boil., Rub out seeds. Add skins and pulp together., Mix in other ingredients and place in pie shell., Put crust on top., Bake in 400° oven until crust is brown, 45 minutes.

title: Hearty Omelet
directions: Beat all ingredients in a deep bowl with a fork., Pour into heated, nonstick frypan., Brown on one side; turn carefully and brown the other side., Also good for a light meal in the evening.

title: Almond Fingers
directions: Roll into little fingers., Bake at 325° for 14 to 16 minutes. When cool, roll in confectioners sugar.

title: Green Chili Enchiladas
directions: Brown beef and onion., Add chilies., Heat through., Add soup and milk to meat and heat through., Put thin layer of sauce in bottom of baking dish., Put each tortilla into sauce and cover with sauce., When bottom of dish is covered with one layer of tortillas, sprinkle layer of cheese., Keep layering until sauce and tortillas are used., Sprinkle top with cheese., Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Oatmeal Crispies
directions: Mix oil and sugar. Add eggs and vanilla and beat well. Sift all dry ingredients together and add to sugar mixture. Add oats and nuts and mix well. Dough will be stiff (use hands). Shape into rolls and wrap in waxed paper. Chill in the refrigerator. Slice 1/4-inch thick and bake on ungreased baking sheet for 10 to 15 minutes at 350°. Yield: about 60 cookies.

title: Dinner Pockets
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Grease large baking dish., In skillet, cook sausage, onion and vegetable until sausage browns and vegetables are soft., Pour off fat; stir in soup., Divide dough into 6 equal parts., On floured surface, roll out 1 part to a 6 inch round., Spread mixture in skillet on 1/2 of round., Sprinkle with cheese., Fold over and pinch sides together., Place on baking dish., Brush with egg and sprinkle with sesame seeds., Bake 25 minutes or until golden brown.

title: How To Cook A Christmas Turkey
directions: Put black syrup on it., Just a little salt, just a little pepper., Put soup on top of it., Stuff with ice cream., Cook 5 minutes at 1°., Serve with macaroni.

title: Molasses Cake(Very Old Family Recipe)
directions: Cream together shortening and sugar until fluffy., Add egg, then molasses., Mix together flour, baking soda, cinnamon, nutmeg and salt., Add to creamed mixture., Last, add water., Bake in 8-inch square pan approximately 30 to 35 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean.

title: Lemon Pound Cake
directions: Combine all ingredients and beat 2 to 4 minutes., Pour into a greased and floured 10-inch tube pan., Bake 50 to 60 minutes in a 350° oven.

title: Punch Bowl Cake
directions: Crumble 1/3 of the cake into the bottom of a large bowl., Add a layer of pudding, then cherries, pineapple, Cool Whip and then top off with pecan pieces., Repeat the process again ending with Cool Whip and pecans.

title: Catfish Soup
directions: Place all ingredients into stew pan and put on slow fire. Stir occasionally and cook until fish is ready to fall to pieces. Serve hot.

title: Cranberry Surprise Loaf
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Grease and flour BOTTOM ONLY of a 9 x 5 loaf pan., In a small bowl, beat cream cheese until light and fluffy., Add 1 egg and blend well., Set aside., Lightly spoon flour into a measuring cup; level off., In large bowl, mix together flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda and salt., Stir in apple juice, margarine and beaten eggs., Fold in cranberries and nuts., Spoon half of batter into prepared pan., Spoon cream cheese mixture evenly over batter., Top with remaining batter. Bake at 350° for 65 to 75 minutes or until top springs back when lightly touched., Cool 15 minutes., Remove from pan and cool on wire rack.

title: Orange Sherbet Mold
directions: Dissolve Jell-O in hot water and allow to jell slightly., Mix in sherbet thoroughly., Add drained pineapple and oranges., Mix well. Refrigerate until firm.

title: Blueberry Bread
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Grease a 9 x 5-inch loaf pan., Mix the flour, sugar, baking powder, soda and salt., Blend in shortening. Stir in egg., Add enough boiling water to orange juice and rind to measure 1 cup., Stir into flour mixture., Add blueberries and nuts; stir gently., Pour batter into prepared pan., Bake for 60 minutes., Makes 1 loaf.

title: Fruit Cobbler
directions: Melt oleo in 9 x 13 x 6-inch ovenproof dish., Heat water and sugar until sugar melts., Cut shortening into flour until particles are like fine crumbs., Add milk and stir only until dough leaves side of bowl., Turn out on floured board into ball or rectangle about 1/4-inch thick., Roll like jelly roll, slice into 16 slices, 1/2-inch thick., Place fruit on bottom of prepared dish, then put dough slices over fruit., Pour sugar syrup over rolls., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Oven-Fried Potatoes
directions: Halve potatoes lengthwise and slice into 1/2-inch thick strips., Put margarine and olive oil in bowl., Add potatoes, tossing to coat well., Arrange potato strips in single layer on nonstick baking sheet., Sprinkle with paprika., Bake in preheated 450° oven for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Oven Fried Chicken
directions: Combine ingredients in a shallow bowl or bag., Melt butter and shortening in pan., Place chicken skin side down., Cook, uncovered, 30 minutes., Turn chicken; cook, uncovered, 30 minutes more.

title: Italian Garlic Dressing
directions: Combine all ingredients in blender; blend., Keep in refrigerator.

title: Fresh Coconut Cake
directions: Lightly grease three 9-inch layer pans., Have all ingredients at room temperature., Cream the butter and sugar and add 1 egg at a time., Add flour which has been sifted once, then measured, alternately with milk., Beat after each addition until smooth. Add vanilla and a handful of coconut., Bake 25 to 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Ginger And Peach Chicken
directions: Spray a large skillet with nonstick cooking spray., Over medium heat, cook chicken in skillet 8 to 10 minutes until browned and no longer pink, turning., Remove from skillet; keep warm.

title: Lemon Pudding Cake
directions: Beat and mix well the egg yolks, lemon juice, rind and butter; set aside. Mix sugar, flour and salt. Measure milk. Whip egg whites. Add sugar mixture alternately with the milk. Fold into beaten egg whites. Pour into 8-inch square pan. Place this pan in a pan of water. Bake for 45 minutes in 350° oven. Pudding will be in the bottom of pan. Turn over when served and, top with Cool Whip.

title: Corn Bread
directions: Mix first 4 ingredients., Beat egg and milk together., Stir in melted butter., Mix all together., Bake in 8 x 8-inch pan at 425° for 25 minutes.

title: Applesauce Cake No. 1
directions: Bake in slow oven for 3/4 hour.

title: Cheese Biscuits
directions: Preheat oven to 350., Mix flour, baking powder, and sugar together using a fork., Cut in shortening until it has the consistency of cornmeal., Add cheese., Stir in buttermilk all at one time until just blended., Do not overmix., Drop by tablespoonfuls (or use an ice cream scoop) onto a well-greased baking sheet., Bake 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Strawberry Pie
directions: Bake pie crust and let cool., Place chopped strawberries in pie crust., Combine all other ingredients in boiler and bring to a boil., Pour into pie crust., Place in refrigerator., Add Cool Whip or whipping cream when ready to serve.

title: Shrimp Or Crawfish Delight
directions: Saute onion and bell pepper in oleo., Add soups, tomatoes, seasoned shrimp or crawfish and parsley., Bring to a boil, then add raw rice., Mix well., Bake in a 350° oven, covered, for 1 hour. Stir (with a fork) after first 30 minutes., Finish baking.

title: Potato Casserole
directions: Peel potatoes., Boil and mash with butter and cream cheese. Add remaining ingredients and mix well., Pour into a buttered casserole dish and refrigerate mixture overnight., Bake the next day in 350° oven for 50 minutes., Serves 4.

title: Apple Cake Pie
directions: Peel and slice apples into greased 10-inch pie pan., Cover with 1/4 cup sugar., Cream butter, 1/2 cup sugar and beaten egg., Add dry ingredients; mix., Spread over fruit., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Spaghetti Bake
directions: In Dutch oven, cook ground beef, onion and garlic until beef is browned and onion tender., Drain off fat., Stir in next 7 ingredients., Bring to boil., Simmer for 20 minutes., Stir occasionally., Remove meat sauce from heat and stir in drained spaghetti.	Place half in a 9 x 13 pan., Sprinkle with Mozzarella cheese., Top with rest of spaghetti mix., Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese., Bake in 350° oven for 30 to 45 minutes or until heated.

title: Kahlua Cake
directions: Mix first 6 ingredients by hand., Don't use mixer., Will be very thick., Add chocolate chips., Pour into well-greased and floured Bundt pan or tube pan., Bake 60 minutes in 350° oven. Cool upright at least 25 minutes., Dust with powdered sugar.

title: Chocolate No-Bake Cookies
directions: Combine sugar, cocoa, oleo and milk., Bring to a boil for 1 minute., Remove from heat; stir in peanut butter, oatmeal and vanilla., Drop on wax paper.

title: Chocolate Crinkles
directions: Preheat oven to moderate 350° (175°C) if you use shiny metal cookie sheet., Or, heat to 325° (165°C) for dark metal sheet.
