Cream together thoroughly the shortening, sugar and vanilla., Beat in eggs., Beat chocolate., Sift together the flour, baking powder and salt., Measure milk; blend in dry ingredients with milk., Add nuts., Chill 3 hours., Form 1-inch balls., Roll in confectioners sugar., Place on greased cookie sheet, 2 or 3 inches apart., Place cookies in center of oven., Bake for about 15 minutes., Cool cookies slightly., Remove from the cookie sheet with turner; place on racks or paper toweling to cool.

title: Pumpkin Chiffon Pie
directions: Combine eggs, brown sugar, milk, pumpkin, salt and spices. Cook in double boiler until thick, stirring constantly., Beat egg whites; add sugar and beat until stiff., Soak gelatine in cold water., Stir into double boiler., Chill until pumpkin mixture is partly set., Fold in egg white mixture., Pour in pie shell and chill until set., Garnish with whip cream.

title: Mexican Fudge
directions: Grate cheeses together., Mix eggs and picante sauce together. Put 1/2 of cheeses in bottom of Pyrex dish (oblong)., Put the egg and picante mixture on top of cheese., Cover with the remaining cheese., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes., Cut in squares and place each piece on Doritos or tortilla chips.

title: Chicken Salad
directions: Combine all ingredients except almonds and chill overnight. Sprinkle toasted almonds on top of chicken salad just before serving., If you like, serve on lettuce garnished with wedges of your favorite melon., Yields 12 servings.

title: Tater Tots Casserole
directions: Brown ground beef, onions, salt and pepper in a skillet. Drain., Pour meat mixture into a 9 x 13-inch baking dish.

title: Turkey Loaf
directions: Mix together and put in loaf pan., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Cider Punch
directions: Makes 2 gallons., It is good hot., I omit the ginger ale.

title: Date Surprise Balls
directions: Beat eggs with a spoon in a 2-quart pan., Add sugar, butter and dates. Cook slowly for 10 to 12 minutes on a low fire., Remove from heat and cool. Add Rice Krispies and nuts., Shape into small balls. Roll in shredded coconut.

title: Emily Lee Ann'S Poppy Seed Bread
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Grease and flour 1 (9 x 5 x 3-inch) loaf pan or 2 (8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2 1/2-inch) loaf pans., Mix all ingredients and beat 30 seconds., Pour into pan(s)., Bake until wooden pick comes out clean; 9-inch loaf for 55 to 65 minutes or 8 1/2-inch loaves for 55 to 60 minutes., Take out of oven and cool for 2 to 3 minutes, then take out of pan., Leave to cool (upright) on wire rack.

title: Earthquake Cake
directions: Mix pecans and coconut., Put in bottom of pan., Mix cake according to box directions. Pour over pecans and coconut., Mix sugar, cream cheese, butter and vanilla., Spoon over cake mix. Bake 50 minutes at 350°.

title: Light Rolls
directions: Dissolve yeast in water., Mix with other ingredients., Let rise until double in size., Push down., Let rise again., Push down., Make into rolls and put into pan., Let rise., Bake in 400° oven until done., Handle dough easy and lightly or rolls will be tough.

title: Spanish Rice Casserole
directions: Prepare Rice-A-Roni and tomatoes according to directions on the box., Mix in hamburger., Pour into a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Top with shredded Cheddar cheese., Bake at 350° for 10 to 15 minutes, or until cheese melts.

title: Favorite Family Recipe - Christmas Stollen
directions: Soften active dry yeast in warm water., Scald milk in sugar, salt and butter; cool to lukewarm., Mix in 2 cups flour, yeast, eggs, cardamom and fruit., Add enough remaining flour to make a stiff dough., Knead on floured surface; place in a greased bowl and grease top of dough., Cover.

title: Rum Balls
directions: Cream all ingredients, but only half the nuts., Chill for 2 hours., Roll into 1-inch balls and then roll balls into remaining nuts to coat., Keep chilled.

title: Melt-A-Way
directions: Preheat oven to 400°., Mix ingredients and roll or drop small amount on a greased cookie sheet., Cook 6 to 8 minutes (until set and not brown)., Remove from cookie sheet and roll in confectioners sugar.

title: Peach Cheesecake Ice Cream
directions: In a large mixer bowl, combine softened cream cheese and sugar., Beat with an electric mixer on medium-high speed until fluffy., Reduce mixer speed to low and gradually add whipping cream, milk, peach nectar or orange juice, lemon juice, vanilla and apple pie spice., Beat until ingredients are combined., Stir in the chopped peach., Freeze the ice cream mixture in a 1 or 2-quart ice cream freezer, according to manufacturer's directions. Makes about 1 quart.

title: Orange Danish Rolls
directions: Combine cream cheese, sugar and peel; mix until well blended. Unroll dough from cans and lay on floured surface., Overlap long edges to shape into a rectangle (13 x 7-inch), pressing all edges together to seal., Spread rectangle with cream cheese mixture (3/4 of mixture, save 1/4 for icing)., Roll up dough, starting at long side, roll up (jelly roll fashion)., Cut or slice 1-inch pieces. Lay on cookie sheet on cut side about 2 inches apart., Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Cool Summer Lemon Roll
directions: In bowl, blend together cake mix and lemon pie filling., On a parchment paper lined cookie sheet, spread batter evenly to within 1-inch of edge of cookie sheet., Bake in a 350° oven for 13 to 16 minutes or until lightly browned., Carefully take cake out of pan by lifting up ends of parchment paper at the same time., Leave on counter for exactly 8 minutes., Then roll up cake into a roll and cover ends with paper towels or plastic wrap., Let it cool completely before unrolling, approximately 2 hours.

title: Pretzel Salad
directions: Cream butter and 3 tablespoons sugar., Blend in pretzels. Press in a 9 x 13-inch pan and bake at 350° for 10 minutes., Cool. Cream together cream cheese and 1 cup sugar., Fold into Cool Whip. Pour into cooled crust., Dissolve jello in boiling water and add undrained strawberries., When jello mixture is partially set, pour it over the cream mixture in shell., Chill., Serves 12.

title: Chicken Salad
directions: Cut up chicken., Add and mix all other ingredients together.

title: Holiday Cranberry Freeze
directions: Mix ingredients and put in freezer., Serve semi-frozen., Great for Christmas or Thanksgiving dinner.

title: Brown Sugar Chess Pie
directions: Mix all ingredients and pour into an unbaked pastry shell. Bake at 325° for 30 minutes or until center of pie is firm when shaken.

title: Lasagne
directions: Cook and stir ground beef; drain off all fat., Add spaghetti sauce to meat and mix well., Heat oven to 350°., Mix Ricotta cheese, 1/2 cup Parmesan cheese, parsley flakes and oregano., In an ungreased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan, layer 1/4 each of noodles, meat sauce, Mozzarella cheese and the cottage cheese mixture., Repeat 3 times., Add meat sauce over top and sprinkle (cover well) with Parmesan cheese., Bake, uncovered, for 45 minutes., Let stand 15 minutes before serving.

title: Black-Eyed Pea Salad
directions: Drain peas., Rinse with cold water and drain well. Add chopped celery and onion. Combine oil, vinegar, mayonnaise, salt and cayenne pepper., Mix well., Pour over peas., Stir gently. Allow to chill in refrigerator several hours or overnight.

title: Chicken Tetrazzini
directions: Saute pepper in butter until tender., Blend in flour., Add milk and stock., Cook until smooth., Add cheese, pimento and soup. Cook spaghetti in broth and drain., Add sauce and chicken., Pour into casserole., Sprinkle with additional cheese., Bake at 250° to 300° for 45 minutes., Yields 6 servings.

title: Cherry Delight Dump Cake
directions: Dump cherry filling in a 9 x 13-inch oblong pan., Then dump pineapple., Then sprinkle cake mix on top of that., Melt margarine and pour over cake mix., On top of this add Angel Flake coconut and top with pecans., Bake for 1 hour at 325°., Serve warm with ice cream or it's good cold., Serve from the same pan.

title: Bacon Greens
directions: Cook bacon completely, but not crispy., Cook greens for about 3 to 5 minutes., Add remaining ingredients; stir thoroughly. Makes approximately 4 servings.

title: Flan(Spanish Caramel Custard)
directions: Pour milk into a large saucepan., Add salt and scald., Remove from fire and add 1 cup of sugar, stirring until it is dissolved; set aside.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
directions: Cream together powdered sugar, evaporated milk and peanut butter., Mix in cream cheese, half of dry peanuts and Dream Whip. Once all mixed, pour into pie shell of your choice., Sprinkle remaining dry peanuts on top., Freeze for 2 hours, then refrigerate until ready for use., Serve with chocolate syrup and Cool Whip.

title: Colorful Slaw
directions: In a large bowl, combine mayonnaise and lemon juice., Mix well., Add remaining ingredients and mix well., Refrigerate several hours., Serves 6.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
directions: Grease (Crisco) a 9x13 baking dish., Peel and slice potatoes. Make a layer of potato slices, top with velveeta cheese and 4 tsp butter on cheese., Repeat layers., Mix milk and flour together. Pour over layers., Cover and Bake at 350 - 400 degrees for 1 1/2 hours or until potatoes are tender.

title: Enchiladas
directions: Cook beef with onions., Prepare tortilla and assemble one at a time., Fry tortilla in hot oil for a few seconds on each side. Dip into 1 can of heated enchilada sauce and remove immediately. Place on a plate and put olives, cheese and meat mixture on tortilla., Roll up and place seam side down in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish., When all enchiladas are in baking dish, cover with remaining sauce., Sprinkle top with grated cheese, olives and raw chopped onions., Bake at 350° until bubbly.

title: Diabetic Pineapple Cookies
directions: Sift the first 3 ingredients., Add egg, margarine and rest of ingredients., Drop by teaspoonfuls on greased cookie sheet. Sprinkle coconut on each cookie and level with a fork., Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Juanita Cole Farlowe'S Pound Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients., Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Baked Custard
directions: Beat eggs slightly with fork., Add sugar, salt and vanilla. Add cold milk., Stir until thoroughly mixed., Pour into custard cups., Sprinkle with nutmeg, if desired, and place in 2 or 2 1/2-inch deep pan., Pour boiling water around cups to come almost level with custard., Bake in oven at 350° for 40 to 50 minutes or until a silver knife comes out clean when inserted in center. Makes 6 average sized custards.

title: Corn Salad
directions: Combine vinegar, sugar, oil, salt and pepper; add to other ingredients. Set in refrigerator overnight, then drain and serve.

title: Nut Brittle
directions: Melt sugar over low flame until sugar is golden brown., Add butter., Add nuts and stir until nuts are covered., Pour into well buttered dish., When cold, break into pieces.

title: Cherry Mash Candy
directions: Mix, ingredients, together, well., Chill, and form into balls or	any, shape, you, prefer., Chill another 30 minutes. Melt, over simmering	water 1 pound dark chocolate (sometimes called almond bark)., Dip chilled balls into melted chocolate, after, stirring in	8 ounces finely chopped, unsalted peanuts into melted chocolate.

title: Cheese Cake
directions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water; chill until it starts to jell., Mix together cream cheese and confectioners sugar until smooth., Whip Milnot until it peaks; slowly add cream cheese mixture and gelatin., Mix cracker crumbs with margarine, reserving 1/4 cup., Line a cake pan with rest of crumbs., Pour in cream cheese mixture., Sprinkle with rest of crumbs., Chill.

title: Dirt Cake
directions: Crumble Oreos; set aside., Fold together the remaining ingredients., Layer as follows: pudding, Oreos, pudding, Oreos, etc., for a total of 4 or 5 layers., End with one inch of Oreos on top., (These may be ground fine in a blender so as to resemble dirt.), Optional: Add gummy worms to layers.

title: Frosting For "Lazy Daisy" Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients together and spread on a baked Lazy Daisy Cake., Place under the heated broiler in oven until it bubbles. Delicious!

title: Cheese Cake
directions: Mix jello with 1 cup boiling water and set aside to cool. Beat Milnot until stiff and set aside., Cream sugar and cream cheese together., Add cooled jello to whipped Milnot, then cheese mixture and vanilla.

title: Banana Muffins
directions: In mixing bowl, combine all dry ingredients., In small bowl, combine remaining ingredients., Mix dry with moist ingredients, stirring until all are moist.

title: Sweet And Sour Chicken
directions: Brown chicken in melted margarine., Remove chicken from pan. Drain pineapple, reserving juice. Combine brown sugar, cornstarch and salt in skillet., Gradually add vinegar, soy sauce and pineapple juice., Stir. Cook over medium heat until thick., You may need to add about 1/2 cup water. Add pineapple, green pepper, onion and chicken., Cover and simmer 5 to 10 minutes., Serve over rice.

title: Shrimp Casserole
directions: Cook broccoli; drain., Saute onion and shrimp in butter until tender., Add broccoli; simmer 5 minutes., Add cheese soup and rice., Put mixture in casserole dish., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Chili Chill Chasen(Microwave)
directions: Combine onion, green pepper and crumbled ground beef in a plastic container and microwave on High for 6 minutes., Drain and place in a 2-quart container., Add tomato sauce, tomatoes, beans, salt, pepper, chili powder and dry mustard., Cover and microwave on High for 10 to 12 minutes, stirring halfway through cooking. Standing time is 10 minutes., Cooking time is 16 to 18 minutes. Serves 4 to 8.

title: Oven Fried Parmesan Chicken
directions: Combine first 5 ingredients; set aside., Dip chicken in salad dressing; dredge in bread crumb mixture., Place chicken bone side down in 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan coated with cooking spray. Bake at 350° for about 45 minutes or until tender., Yields 6 servings.

title: Hamburger Stroganoff
directions: Saute onion and garlic in margarine over medium heat until soft., Add meat and brown., Add flour, salt, pepper and mushrooms. Cook 5 minutes., Add soup and simmer uncovered for 10 minutes. Stir in sour cream., Heat thoroughly., Sprinkle with parsley. Serve with noodles.

title: Dirt Cake
directions: In blender or food processor, add 8 to 10 cookies at a time and blend until finely crushed., Set aside.

title: Banana Split Cake
directions: Mix pudding according to package directions., In a 2-quart casserole dish, layer half the Trefoils, half the bananas, half the pudding and half the whipped topping., Repeat layers., Refrigerate 4 hours., Before serving, top with crushed Juliettes.

title: My Hawaiian Pudding
directions: Mix first 7 ingredients together, then add remaining ingredients., Mix thoroughly, about 3 to 4 minutes.

title: Cake Mix Cookies
directions: Mix cake mix, butter, banana and egg until well blended., Stir in chocolate or butterscotch bits., Drop by teaspoonful on ungreased cookie sheet., Bake 10 to 12 minutes at 350°.

title: April Fools Apple Pie
directions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees., In a saucepan, combine sugar, water, cream of tartar and butter., Bring to a boil, add cinnamon and continue to boil for approximately 4 minutes stirring constantly., Crush the saltine crackers and put in a 9 inch unbaked pie crust., Pour mixture from saucepan into crust and sprinkle extra cinnamon over top., Bake for 40 minutes or until done.

title: Strawberry Dessert
directions: Mix Jell-O with boiling water until dissolved. Add frozen berries. Cool until slightly thickened. Tear cake into pieces. Put in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix Cool Whip and strawberry mixture. Fold in slightly. Pour over cake. Refrigerate until set. Yield: 12 to 15 servings.

title: Hot Cheese Puffs
directions: Measure all ingredients except flour into a small bowl., Beat until mixture is soft and well blended., Add flour and mix to a stiff dough., Measure by level tablespoonful., Roll each measure of dough into a small ball, placed on ungreased cookie sheets., Press down lightly with fork., Bake in 350° oven for 10 to 15 minutes or just until very lightly browned., Remove from oven and serve warm. Also very good reheated.

title: Fresh Peach Pie(Variations For Strawberry And Blueberry)
directions: Cook sugar, water and cornstarch until thick., Remove from stove and add peach jello., Cool., Add peaches and stir until coated and thickened., Put into prebaked pie shell., Add Cool Whip or topping.

title: Butter Cake
directions: Grease a 9 x 11-inch oblong pan with margarine., Mix first three ingredients by hand., Press into bottom of pan.

title: Mandarin Salad
directions: Cook the almonds and sugar over low heat, stirring constantly, until sugar is melted and almonds are coated., Cool and break apart., Store at room temperature.

title: Pumpkin Pie Anytime Of The Year
directions: Put all ingredients in a blender and blend on medium for 1 minute., Let stand 2 minutes., Pour into buttered pie pan., Bake 350 degrees for 50 minutes., Let cool and serve with low fat whipped cream.

title: Pinto Beans
directions: Soak beans overnight., Add all ingredients and cook very slow until tender in enough water to cover the beans., Add any other spices to suit your taste.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Boil chicken until done., Save broth., Melt butter., Mix with stuffing and seasonings., Mix both soups with broth., Cook mixed vegetables in separate container with grated cheese., In greased casserole, layer dressing mix, chicken and soup., Repeat, ending with dressing mix., Bake in 350° oven for 30 minutes.

title: Fluff Cakes(Pan Cakes)
directions: Mix in order and fry on a griddle.

title: Sausage Brunch Casserole
directions: Place 6 slices buttered bread, buttered side up, in large baking pan., Place 1/2 sausage that has been cooked and drained and 1/2 cheese over bread., Beat eggs and milk together., Pour 1/2 of this over sausage mixture., Place other 6 slices of bread on top, rest of sausage, cheese, milk and eggs., Push down with hands., Make the day before and refrigerate overnight., Bake at 350° for 1 hour., Top should be crusty brown.

title: Creamy Freezer Pie
directions: Pour milk into ice trays and freeze until almost frozen at edges., Put ice cold milk into cold bowl and mix with cold beaters at high speed until fluffy., Add sugar and your favorite flavor Kool-Aid; whip until stiff., Pour into a 9-inch pie pan that has been lined with vanilla wafers; piling high., Freeze until firm 3 to 4 hours.

title: Fried Green Tomatoes
directions: Salt and pepper tomato slices., Dip tomato slices into beaten eggs, then into flour., Drop into deep hot oil; let fry until golden brown., Makes about 2 dozen., Serve alone or with meal.

title: Ice Cream And Rice Chex Dessert
directions: Brown 1 package slivered almonds in 2 tablespoons margarine. Melt 1/4 cup butter/margarine; add remaining ingredients. Put 1/2 mixture in bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan., Add 2 quarts ice cream., Cover with other half of Chex mixture., Freeze.

title: Potato, Ham And Cheese Casserole
directions: Heat oven to 400°., Combine ham, potatoes, margarine, salt, pepper and milk, in a large saucepan, with just enough water to cover ham and potatoes., Cook until potatoes are done., Add flour and water to thicken., Add 1 cup of cheese and pimiento; stir until well-mixed.

title: Taco Casserole
directions: Cook hamburger according to taco seasoning directions., In a 9 x 13-inch pan layer the crushed chips, meat, refried beans, sour cream, cheese and finally sprinkle on the tomatoes and/or olives. Put in 350° oven until cheese is melted.

title: Russian Tea
directions: Bring to a boil and continue to boil for 5 minutes the water, sugar, cloves and cinnamon sticks., Add tea bags and brew for 10 minutes., Remove tea bags and add orange juice, pineapple juice and lemon juice., Better next day after refrigerated.

title: Mama'S Coffee Cake
directions: Mix all dry ingredients; then add the milk and egg., Put in a 9 x 13-inch greased pan.

title: Pumpkin Crunch
directions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Spray bottom of 9 X 13 pan. Combine pumpkin, milk, eggs, sugar, cinnamon and salt in a large bowl. Pour into pan. Sprinkle dry cake mix evenly over pumpkin mixture, top with pecans. Drizzle with melted butter over pecans. Bake 50-55 minutes, or until golden brown. Cool and serve chilled. Top with cool whip when serving.

title: Wanda'S Vegetable Soup
directions: Cook and dice meat., Save broth., Saute onions, celery, green peppers and garlic in olive or vegetable oil; add remaining ingredients., Add choice of rice, pasta or potato., Add salt and pepper.

title: Squash Casserole
directions: Mix these ingredients., Line 1 1/2-quart casserole with Pepperidge Farm seasoned bread crumbs., Pour in squash mixture. Top with more bread crumbs and melted butter., Bake at 350° for about 30 minutes.

title: Aggression Cookies(Make With Children)
directions: Mix with hands until smooth., Shape into balls; flatten on cookie sheet (ungreased)., Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Brown Rice
directions: Melt, 1 stick (or less) margarine in iron skillet., Add 1, cup rice, and	brown, lightly,, stirring, constantly.	Put browned rice, in casserole; add 1 can undiluted beef consomme and, 1 can undiluted onion soup., Place in preheated 325° oven and, cook, for 1	hour, and, 15 minutes in covered casserole. Delicious!!

title: Punch Bowl Cake
directions: Crumble half of cake and layer half of the ingredients in order listed., Continue layering, beginning with last half of cake and ending with Cool Whip., Garnish with nuts, coconut, cherries, etc., Be sure to use punch bowl., It makes a large quantity.

title: Taco Soup
directions: Add all ingredients together., Simmer for 1 hour., Salt and pepper to taste., You can add hot sauce, if desired., This can be frozen.

title: Blueberry Salad
directions: Mix water with jello; then add pie filling and pineapple., Let jell in fridge., Mix cream cheese, sour cream, sugar and vanilla and spread over top of jello mix., Sprinkle 1/2 cup chopped pecans on top., Store in refrigerator.

title: Simple Meat Loaf
directions: Mix all ingredients in the order in which they are listed. Stir thoroughly., Press into a greased loaf tin and bake in a 350° preheated oven for one hour.

title: Banana Pudding
directions: Mix pudding and milk., Add sour cream and topping., Layer wafers, bananas and pudding., Chill.

title: Cherries Emily
directions: Combine cracker crumbs and margarine; press into 1 1/2-quart oblong Pyrex dish., Bake at 325° for 15 minutes., Cream the cheese and milk., Gradually add sugar., Spread mix over graham cracker crust., Sprinkle pecans over cream cheese mixture., Whip cream with vanilla., Spread over pecans., Chill., When cold, spread cherry pie filling on top., Chill overnight.

title: One-Pot Pork Chop Supper
directions: In skillet, brown chops., Pour off fat., Add remaining ingredients. Cover; cook over low heat 45 minutes or until tender. Yields 4 servings.

title: Alligator Fingers
directions: Add salt, pepper and garlic powder to flour and cornmeal., Coat gator strips with the mixture., Deep fry in vegetable oil.

title: San Francisco Oyster Loaf Ala Chase
directions: Cut lid off bread., Hollow out loaf., Clean the oysters and dredge in flour or cracker meal., Place oysters in frying pan with the olive oil and simmer on both sides until done, approximately 6 minutes. Butter inside of loaf., Place oysters in loaf., Replace lid and bake in a 325° oven for 10 minutes., Add and season with remaining ingredients to taste, especially the lemon which brings flavor to its peak. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Poppy Seed Chicken
directions: Begin by melting 3 tablespoons of butter in pan; allow to melt and become hot., Roll chicken strips in flour and place in pan. Cook chicken halfway and then add spices, onions and peppers. When chicken is almost done, add stock, rest of the vegetables and poppy seed dressing., Toss all ingredients in pan and serve over a bed of rice., Only toss for 30 to 40 seconds.

title: Carol'S Strawberry Pie
directions: Mix together syrup, sugar, cornstarch, salt and add water slowly and cook until clear., Add Jell-O; stir until dissolved. Cool and add berries., Pour into pie shell., Chill, then add Cool Whip on top.

title: Strawberry Cream Puffs
directions: Melt butter with boiling water in a small saucepan., Stir in flour and salt; cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until mixture leaves sides of pan in a smooth ball., Remove from heat and cool., Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition., Drop mixture by heaping spoonfuls about 2 inches apart onto a greased cookie sheet., Bake at 400° for 40 minutes., Cool. Cut top off cream puffs and fill with sweetened strawberries., Top with whipped cream., Replace tops and garnish with whipped cream and whole strawberries., Yields 6 servings.

title: Apple Crisp
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Layer apples in the bottom 8 by 8 inch square of baking dish., Combine water, cinnamon and salt, sprinkle mixture over apples., Work together the sugar, flour and butter until crumbly. Spread crumb mixture over apples., Bake uncovered about 40 minutes., Serve warm.

title: Marshmallow Salad
directions: Mix coconut, sour cream and the entire bag of marshmallows, torn into halves., Drain pineapple chunks, reserving juice., Add pineapple., Drain mandarin oranges and discard juice., Add oranges to mixture, reserving about 1 dozen to garnish., Blend together gently., Add some juice and mix again., Refrigerate.

title: Sweet Potato Puff
directions: Combine potatoes, margarine and seasonings; mix well., Place in 1-quart casserole., Top with Marshmallow Creme., Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Butter Nut Chewies
directions: Mix together and put in 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Oatmeal Chocolate Chip Cookies
directions: Cream shortening and sugars; add eggs and vanilla and mix thoroughly., Add dry ingredients and water, then stir in oatmeal, chocolate chips and nuts., Bake at 350° for 10 minutes., Do not overbake!

title: Vegetable Tray
directions: On a large round serving plate, place lettuce in the center. Around the lettuce, place the onions, sliced tomatoes, radishes, cucumbers, celery and carrots. Serve with a Curry Dip.

title: Pineapple Sour Cream Cake
directions: Combine pineapple with juice and soda; mix well., In large bowl, combine cake mix and remaining ingredients., Add pineapple mixture., Beat at medium speed for 4 minutes., Pour into greased and floured 10-inch tube pan., Bake at 350° for 50 to 55 minutes. Do not under bake., Cool in pan, for 15 minutes., Remove from pan, finish cooling on rack.

title: Eggplant Bake
directions: Heat oven to 400°., Mix crumbs, oregano and garlic., Dip eggplant slices in butter, then in crumb mixture., Place in single layer on sprayed jelly roll pan., Spread evenly with sauce. Sprinkle with cheese., Bake 20 to 30 minutes., Serves 4 to 6.

title: German Hot Potato Salad
directions: Cook potatoes with skins on; salt lightly., Put cold water on them to hasten cooling to handle., Peel and cut into cubes., Mince bacon; fry until crisp., Combine onion, vinegar, water, sugar, salt, pepper and mustard; heat., Add potatoes, bacon and parsley. Heat slowly and mix to flavor potatoes.

title: Oriental Pork And Noodles
directions: Bring large pot of water to a boil., Add pasta; cook until tender., Drain and rinse with cold water., While pasta cooks, spray a large nonstick skillet with cooking spray., Heat over medium-high heat., Add pork., Cook 2 to 3 minutes., Stir often. Remove from skillet., Spray skillet again., Add bell pepper and carrots., Stir over medium-high heat 2 to 3 minutes until veggies are crisp and tender., Stir in corn and scallions., Mix remaining ingredients until well blended., Stir into skillet., Bring to a boil., Boil 30 seconds or until thickened and clear., Stir in pasta and pork., Cook until heated through.

title: Haystacks
directions: *White chocolate or dark chocolate may be substituted for butterscotch.

title: Buttermilk Salad
directions: Bring pineapple (not drained) to boil., Add jello; stir well. Let mixture cool., Add buttermilk., Let cool., Let Cool Whip soften., Stir in last., Sprinkle top with chopped nuts.

title: Patti'S Icing
directions: Mix together at high speed for 5 minutes.

title: Tex-Mex Dip
directions: Peel, pit and mash avocados in medium size bowl, with lemon juice, salt and pepper., Combine sour cream, mayonnaise and taco seasoning mix in another bowl.

title: Raisin Sauce For Ham
directions: Mix cornstarch in cold water., Add remaining ingredients. Cook on medium heat to desired thickness., Yields 1 1/2 cups.

title: Oven Fried Chicken
directions: Mix flour, salt, pepper, paprika, thyme and onion., Set aside. Melt margarine in a shallow baking pan in a 400 degree oven. Remove baking pan from oven., Dip chicken pieces in buttermilk, then in flour mixture., Place in buttered pan and turn to coat with butter., Bake in 400 degree oven for 30 minutes., Turn chicken. Bake another 30 minutes or until tender.

title: Chinese Chicken Salad
directions: Break up Ramen noodles (do not use seasoning packet). Saut in margarine with sunflower seeds until noodles are light brown. Add almonds; mix.

title: Rum Pie
directions: Beat eggs and sugar., Soak gelatin in water, put over flame until boiling., Add nutmeg., Pour over sugar and eggs slowly., Mix well., Beat cream until stiff and add rum., Fold in egg yolk mixture., Pour into shell and chill., Sprinkle with shaved chocolate.

title: Neiman-Marcus Cake
directions: Mix cake mix, 2 eggs and butter together., Press into a 13 x 9-inch baking dish., Mix with beater the cream cheese, powdered sugar, 2 eggs and pecans., Spread on cake., Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

title: Earthquake Cake
directions: Grease and flour 9 x 13-inch cake pan., Layer coconut; layer pecans., Prepare cake mix according to package directions., Spread over pecans., Mix together margarine, powdered sugar and cream cheese., Glob over cake by teaspoonfuls., Bake for 45 to 55 minutes at 350°., Cake will be shakey but will set up when cool.

title: Carrot-Raisin Salad
directions: Shred carrots to make 4 cups., Stir in raisins and salt., If your raisins are too hard, steam them for 1 minute in the microwave.

title: Dawn'S Focaccia Bread
directions: Spread even coat of olive oil on each piece of bread. Preheat oven to 400°., Combine all above ingredients in a bowl and mix., Spread a generous amount of topping on each piece of bread and bake in oven for 15 - 20 minutes.

title: Hot Dog Sauce
directions: In large pot, combine everything, except catsup., Boil until water is gone., Drain and discard grease., Add catsup and simmer about 30 minutes., Makes approximately 1 gallon.

title: Sauerkraut With Spareribs
directions: Put ribs in pan, season and bake at 450° for 20 minutes. Take ribs out of pan and put sauerkraut and remaining ingredients in., Place ribs on top of sauerkraut and bake at 350° for 1 1/2, to 2 hours.

title: Brown Rice
directions: Melt margarine in dish in oven., Add rice and onion and bake at 350° for 5 minutes., Add consomme and stir., Add mushrooms and bake 1 hour at 350°.

title: Chocaroons
directions: Start the oven at 300°. Add salt to egg whites. Beat until eggs are frothy. Beat in sugar, about 2 tablespoons at a time. Add vanilla. Gently stir in coconut, corn flakes and chocolate. Drop by teaspoonfuls on greased cookie sheet. Bake for 20 minutes. Makes 3 1/2 dozen.

title: California Curried Couscous(Serves 6)
directions: Bring chicken broth with curry to boil in medium saucepan. Stir in couscous; cover and reduce to low heat., Cook 5 minutes. Remove from heat and fluff with a fork., Cover until needed. While couscous cooks, saute garlic, celery and onion in olive oil over medium heat until soft, but not browned, about 5 minutes. Combine chutney and lemon juice in small bowl., Toss couscous with onion/celery mixture., Stir pine nuts, currants and green onions into chutney mixture in small frying pan over low heat., Pour over couscous and stir to combine.

title: Quick Macaroni And Cheese
directions: Place macaroni in microwave bowl, layering with butter and cheese., Pour milk over mixture., Microwave on High 3 to 4 minutes, stirring several times., Salt and pepper to taste.

title: Goblin Bread
directions: Mix well and spread into cake pan. Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

title: Tortellini Salad
directions: Cook tortellini; drain and add spinach, cheese and ham., Toss with dressing.

title: Vegetables Dip
directions: Mix together the Hidden Valley Ranch dressing and onion soup mix with sour cream., Let stand overnight before using., Makes a good dip for vegetables.

title: Unbaked New Year'S Cookies
directions: Melt chips over hot water and add remaining ingredients., Drop by teaspoonfuls onto waxed paper., Let dry and store in airtight container.

title: Hawaiian Wedding Cake
directions: Make cake according to package directions. When cool, spread crushed pineapple on top of cake.

title: Chicken And Dressing
directions: Cook chicken until tender in a large pot of boiling water. Remove chicken, saving broth!, Remove meat from bone., Mix all the dressing ingredients well (it will be real soupy)., Pour half of the mixture into a greased oblong baking dish., Place chicken pieces on top and cover with remaining dressing mixture., Bake at 450° for 30 minutes.

title: Mammy'S Chicken And Dumplings
directions: Wash chicken very good., Put whole chicken in large roaster with water covering chicken., Put 1/2 stick butter on top of chicken and cook until tender., Remove chicken to pan to be browned under broiler before serving.

title: Stuffed Oranges
directions: Mash potatoes, vanilla extract, sugar, margarine, eggs and orange extract together; set aside., Cut oranges in half and remove pulp (do not use veins)., Mix into potato mixture and place in orange shell., Bake 20 to 30 minutes at 350°., Remove and put marshmallows on top, place 1 cherry on top and return to oven at 350° until top is melted and lightly brown.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
directions: Combine all ingredients, except cheese, potato chips and almonds., Place in a large rectangle dish., Top with cheese, chips and almonds. Bake at 400° for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Frozen Rocky Road
directions: Mix all, together, then fold in 1 cup of whipped cream. Freeze in Pyrex pan., Let thaw just enough to cut in squares.

title: Pimento Cheese
directions: Grate cheese. Add Miracle Whip, milk and pimentos. Mix thoroughly. Use for sandwiches or as a dip.

title: Potato Casserole
directions: Slice potatoes thin., Line bottom of dish., Slice onion over potatoes., Shake Krazy salt over., Sprinkle Parmesan cheese over this., Keep adding layers to make amount you want., Add milk to dish., Dot generously with butter., Cook at 325° for 1 hour., May add peppers., Makes it pretty as well as adds flavor.

title: Mary Jane'S Squash
directions: Slice squash crosswise into wheels., Layer in saucepan with sliced onion, salt, pepper and butter (dotted on squash)., Put pan on medium heat and when lid is hot, turn down to simmer and stir from time to time until tender, about 1/2 hour altogether.

title: Cherry Pie With Crumble Top
directions: Pour pie filling into greased 9 x 13-inch pan., Mix all other ingredients together until well mixed., Sprinkle over top of pie filling., Bake at 375° for 35 minutes.

title: Garlic Cheese Ball
directions: Mix all ingredients except chili powder and paprika., Shape and roll into this.

title: Cream Cheese Rhubarb Pie
directions: Preheat oven to 425°., In a 2-quart saucepan, combine the rhubarb, cornstarch, salt and 1 cup of the sugar., Cook over medium heat, stirring often, until the mixture boils and thickens., Pour the rhubarb mixture into the unbaked pie shell., Bake 10 minutes. Remove from the oven and set aside., Reduce the oven temperature to 350°.

title: Spinach Dip
directions: Mix all ingredients. Cover and refrigerate to blend flavors about 1 hour. Serve with crackers.

title: Chocolate Oat Dream Candy
directions: Stir until cool, and, drop, on, waxed paper or put into lightly buttered dish until fully cooked.

title: Tea Cakes
directions: Put butter and margarine on stove and let it melt., Put flour in bread tray and sprinkle cinnamon over it., Mix eggs and sugar in a bowl and stir and beat until smooth., Then pour this into the flour., Add melted butter and margarine., Mix good until real stiff., Roll out dough real thin and use a saucer to cut out the tea cakes., Sprinkle sugar on top and cook.

title: Watergate Salad
directions: Put Cool Whip in a large bowl., Add pudding mix, pineapple and nuts., Mix and store in refrigerator., May be topped with cherries.

title: Sangria
directions: Combine first 4 ingredients in a large pitcher, stirring to dissolve sugar., Add club soda just before serving., Serve over ice., Makes about 1 quart.

title: Beefsteak Pizzaiola
directions: While flank steak is partially frozen, slice into 1/4 x 2-inch strips. Allow to completely thaw., Heat oil in a large skillet until almost smoking., Sear steak on both sides., Add onion, garlic, tomatoes, bell pepper and herbs., Simmer, covered, for 1 hour, adding water if liquid boils off. Add mushrooms and wine. Continue to simmer until mushrooms are cooked. Serve with white rice., Serves 6 people.

title: Apple Dessert
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Place in layers in greased 9 or 10-inch square baking dish apples, sugar and dry cake mix., Pour melted margarine over top of cake mix., Bake for 35 minutes.

title: Cloud Biscuits
directions: Sift dry ingredients and cut into shortening., Combine egg and milk with a fork., Add to first mixture., Bake in 450° oven for 10 to 14 minutes., Very light and delicious.

title: Leftover Meat Pie
directions: Heat gravy., Add cubed meat, cubed or mashed potatoes and peas., Cover with pie crust., Bake in a 400° oven for 10 minutes and then for about 20 additional minutes at 350°.

title: Punch Bowl Cake
directions: Let Cool Whip stand at room temperature., Drain juice from fruit; mix pudding., Put some of each on each layer of cake., Save a few for top layer., This will fill a large punch bowl and costs about $15.00., Make cake and let cool.

title: Fruit Cocktail Cake
directions: Combine cake mix, fruit cocktail with syrup, 1 cup coconut and the eggs in large mixing bowl., Blend, then beat at medium speed for 2 minutes., Pour into greased 13 x 9-inch pan and sprinkle with brown sugar., Bake at 325° for 45 minutes.

title: Two-Corn Casserole
directions: Saute first three ingredients., Place in 2 qt. casserole dish. Add next 3 ingredients., Blend until mixed., Sprinkle cheese on top., Bake 45-55 minutes at 350 degrees.

title: Romanian Cabbage Soup With Bacon(Ciorba Teraneasca)
directions: You will, need a large soup pot., Chop up one slice of bacon, and fry it in a heavy stewpan until the fat runs., Fry the onions in the fat until they are golden., Add the peppers and fry them, too., Remove the stewpan from the heat., Layer the cabbage and the rest of the bacon into the soup pot., Season between the layers with salt, pepper and the herbs., Pour the water over it all and bring to a boil.

title: Grilled French Bread
directions: Mix butter, parsley, onions, garlic powder and celery salt. Cut bread into 1-inch slices, cutting to bottom crust but not through., Spread butter mixture on each slice., Wrap in heavy-duty aluminum foil., Heat over hot coals for about 20 minutes., Turn often during heating.

title: French Vanilla Ice Cream
directions: Mix sugar, salt, milk and egg yolks in saucepan., Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, just until bubbles appear around edge of mixture in pan., Cool to room temperature., Stir in vanilla and cream., Pour into freezer can and freeze., Makes 6 quarts.

title: Rise 'N Shine Shake
directions: Reserve 3 strawberries., In blender, put in remaining strawberries, banana, milk, yogurt and honey., Cover; blend at medium-low until thick and smooth., Pour into chilled glasses; sprinkle with nutmeg., Garnish with strawberry.

title: Caramel Brownies
directions: Soften butter., Add remaining ingredients except confectioners sugar and mix together well., Pour into greased pan., Bake for 25 to 30 minutes at 350°., Sprinkle confectioners sugar on top of brownies while they are still hot.

title: Banana Bread
directions: *Can use buttermilk or 2 tablespoons milk and 1 tablespoon vinegar, combined.

title: Red Snapper Court-Bouillon(Serves 6 To 8)
directions: Pour tomatoes in a large roasting pan over stove., Cut garlic into tiny pieces and add to pan., Add mushrooms., Salt and pepper a whole dressed snapper., Place in roasting pan., Pour sauce over fish and bake at 350° for 40 to 60 minutes or until fish flakes easily., Baste every 15 minutes with sauce., Remove fish and thicken sauce with flour., Add Worcestershire., Serve over hot rice.

title: Nachos
directions: Spread out the nachos in a single layer on a baking sheet. Cook the onion with the meat until no pink remains, but do not brown., Add tomato sauce and seasoning; combine well., Place a spoonful of meat mixture on each chip and sprinkle grated cheese over all., Place under preheated broiler for 2 to 3 minutes or until cheese has melted., Sprinkle tomato and lettuce over all. Serve at once.

title: Pumpkin Pie Cake
directions: Mix ingredients and press into a 9 x 13-inch baking dish.

title: Applesauce
directions: Put in, a crock-pot (slow cooker) and cook on low for 8 to 10 hours.

title: Cole Slaw For Freezing
directions: Shred these ingredients medium fine., Mix all together and let stand 1 hour., Make syrup for cole slaw and let cool.

title: Orange Nut Bread
directions: Heat oven to 350°., In a large bowl, combine all ingredients except nuts; stir just until moistened., Stir in nuts., Pour into greased 8 x 4-inch loaf pan., Bake for 50 to 60 minutes., Check with toothpick., Cool 10 minutes., Remove from pan.

title: Chicken And Rice
directions: In a large nonstick Dutch oven, heat the oil on medium heat. Add chicken. Cook until lightly browned, turning once, about 8 minutes., Transfer to a plate and keep warm. Add bell pepper, onion and jalapeo pepper to pan. Cook for 5 minutes. Stir in rice. Saut for 1 minute. Add the broth, water and tomatoes with liquid. Break up tomatoes with a spoon. Return chicken to pan.

title: Bean Dip
directions: Mix all ingredients until well blended., Serve hot. (Hamburger or sausage may be added.)

title: Cranberry-Apple Waldorf
directions: In large bowl, mix unflavored gelatine with sugar., Add boiling water and stir until gelatine is completely dissolved, about 5 minutes., Stir in cranberry juice., Chill, stirring occasionally, until mixture is consistency of unbeaten egg whites, about 45 minutes., Fold in remaining ingredients.

title: Delicious Vegetable Dip
directions: Mix ingredients in a large bowl., Then serve with fresh vegetables., Mixture is best made day before and refrigerated overnight.

title: Nany'S Pound Cake
directions: Start with cold oven., Cream butter, Crisco and sugar together., Add eggs, one at a time, mixing thoroughly after each addition., Add flour and milk alternately, mixing well., Add flavoring and mix well., Grease and flour tube pan., Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 15 minutes., Frost with Cream Cheese Icing.

title: M&M Cookies
directions: Cream oil, sugar, milk, vanilla and egg., Slowly add and stir in flour, salt and soda., Stir in M&M's, but do not overstir., Add cookie dough to baking sheet (1 tablespoon for larger cookies) and bake at 375° for 8 to 10 minutes or at 350° for 12 minutes.

title: Skillet Meat Loaf
directions: Combine ground beef, soup mix and sour cream., Add bread crumbs or oatmeal if too runny., Form into loaf., Place in skillet and cover with tomato soup., Cover and cook on medium heat for 50 minutes or until done.

title: Lazy Day Cobbler
directions: Put margarine in deep dish and melt in oven or microwave., Mix sugar, flour, baking powder, salt and milk., Beat to a smooth batter., Pour over melted butter., Do not stir., Empty cherries (not drained) over batter., Sprinkle with sugar., Bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes., Butter will rise to top.

title: Light And Lively Salad
directions: Mix together pudding and pie filling and pineapple., Add marshmallows and Cool Whip., Chill in mold in refrigerator. Unmold and sprinkle with nuts., (Cherries may be added, if desired.)

title: Easy Chicken Pie
directions: Put chicken in bottom of baking dish. Cut up boiled eggs on top of chicken. Mix can of cream of chicken and can of chicken broth. Pour over chicken. Mix flour with partly melted butter. Mix in milk and pour over chicken. Bake at 375° for 45 minutes, until golden brown.

title: Funnel Cakes
directions: In mixing bowl combine eggs and milk. Sift together flour, baking powder and salt. Add to egg mixture. Beat until smooth. In deep skillet heat oil to 360 degrees. Cover funnel spout with finger. Pour 1/4 cup batter into funnel. Remove finger and release batter into oil in a spiral, starting in the center and working out. Fry from 2-3 minutes until golden brown. Turn carefully. Cool 1 minute. Drain on paper towel and dust with powdered sugar.

title: Cranberry Christmas Punch
directions: Dissolve cherry gelatin in boiling water., Stir in the lemonade concentrate., Add cold water and cranberry juice cocktail., Place 2 trays of ice cubes or a molded ice ring in a large punch bowl., Pour punch over ice., Pour in chilled ginger ale., Yields 25 servings.

title: Roommate'S Hodgepodge(Herb Lucas)
directions: Brown together beef, garlic, onion and celery, then drain. Add remaining ingredients and simmer 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Mushroom Bites
directions: Combine cream cheese, milk, thyme and parsley., Fill mushroom caps with cheese mixture., Bake in oven at 350° for 15 minutes.

title: Slender Soup
directions: Mix together and cook on medium heat until vegetables are tender.

title: Never Fail Rice Pudding
directions: Cook rice, milk and margarine in top of double boiler, stirring occasionally for 1 hour. Stir eggs, sugar, extract and a dash of salt in buttered 2-quart casserole., Pour hot mixture into egg mixture and stir well., Place casserole in pan of hot water in oven., Stir coconut in after 15 minutes at 325°., Pudding is done when knife comes out clean.

title: Meatballs
directions: Mix together ground beef, bread crumbs, onions, milk, egg, parsley, salt, pepper, Worcestershire sauce and shortening., Form into small balls., Place on broiler rack and broil for 8 minutes.

title: Hot Fudge Sauce
directions: Combine in a saucepan and bring to a boil over medium heat and boil gently for 5 minutes, stirring constantly., Add 1 teaspoon vanilla and beat with mixer for 1 minute., Store in refrigerator.

title: Crock-Pot Chicken And Dumplings
directions: Mix gravy and broth in crockpot until smooth., Stir in chicken, vegetables and mushrooms., Cover and cook on low 4 hours. Stir in peas; mix sour cream and flour., Stir into chicken. Cover and cook on high 20 minutes., Mix Bisquick and milk until just moistened., Drop spoonfuls onto chicken mixture., Cover and cook on high 45 to 50 minutes until dumplings are done., Makes 4 servings.

title: Zucchini Soup
directions: Make crisscross, deep vertical cuts in zucchini and slice in thick 1/4-inch slices which will yield quarters.

title: White Fruit Cake
directions: Sift flour and mix with fruit and nuts., Mix sugar and butter well and add eggs and flavoring. Add fruit and nuts until mixture is smooth., Put into a greased tube pan., Put into a cold oven and bake at 225° for 2 to 2 1/2 hours.

title: May'S Muffins
directions: Mix flour, mayonnaise and milk; stir until smooth., Spoon into 6 well-greased muffin cups., Bake at 425° for 20 minutes.

title: Divinity
directions: Beat egg whites until stiff. Put aside., Combine sugar, syrup, water and salt in a 3-quart pan., Bring to a boil, 252°, using a candy thermometer, if available., If not, drop a little of the mixture into cold water., If it forms a hard ball, it is ready. Remove from heat and begin to pour in a fine stream into stiffly beaten egg whites., Beat on high speed with electric mixer until mixture holds its shape and loses its gloss., Add 1 teaspoon of vanilla and walnuts., Spoon out on waxed paper and let cool (approximately 2 hours).

title: Cherry Cheese Bars
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Grease a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Cream the butter and sugar with electric mixer in large mixing bowl until light and fluffy., Add 1 egg; beat well., Stir in 1 1/2 cups flour and salt until well blended., Reserve 1 cup of mixture by spooning lightly in measuring cup; set aside., Press remaining crust mixture into prepared pan., Bake for 15 minutes.

title: Milky Way Ice Cream
directions: Melt candy bars with small amount of milk in microwave., Add Eagle Brand milk; mix well., Put in 5-quart ice cream freezer and fining filling with milk to full line., Freeze as usual in your ice cream freezer.

title: Frosted Cauliflower
directions: Boil whole head of cauliflower for about 20 minutes, or until tender., Do not overcook., Take it out of the water and drain it well., Using two forks to handle it works best., Place the cauliflower on the center of the serving plate with the stem side down., If it does not sit straight, you may have to cut the stem some., Mix mayonnaise and mustard in a cup, and "frost" the cauliflower with the mixture., Remove the lid from a jar of cheese whiz and microwave it until it is hot., Pour the cheese whiz over the cauliflower., Sprinkle top with creole, and Voile!, Serve while hot.

title: Homemade Sloppy Joes
directions: Saute celery and onion in about 2 tablespoons butter in skillet on low heat.

title: Oven-Fried Catfish
directions: Place bread crumbs in a shallow bowl; set aside., Combine mayonnaise, water and lemon juice., Stir well., Dip fish in mayonnaise mixture., Dredge in bread crumbs., Place fish on a baking sheet coated with cooking spray., Bake at 450° for 17 to 20 minutes or until fish flakes easily when tested with a fork. Yields 8 servings (197 calories and 24% fat per serving).

title: Apricot Nectar Cake
directions: Mix ingredients together well. Pour into greased and floured tube pan and bake at 325 until done approximately 45-50 minutes. Cool 10 minutes. Remove from pan.

title: Perfect Rice
directions: Cook rice on medium heat., As rice begins to swell and absorb water, continue to add more water, stirring often., Sample rice to determine when it is soft and done., When done, fill pot full with hot water, stirring well., Strain in colander and serve.

title: Pasta Lacqua
directions: Cook green beans al dente., Melt butter over medium heat; do not brown., Add diced tomatoes and toss., Add chicken stock and wine., Let boil., Add cheese and al dente green beans., Add salt and pepper., Toss with fettucine.

title: A Man'S Salad
directions: Boil 1 cup pineapple juice., Dissolve jello in it while hot; let, cool.	Mix cream cheese, pineapple, chopped pimento, pecans and celery., Add, to jello., Stir thoroughly, then fold in whipped cream., Congeal., May, be cut in squares and served on lettuce leaf with cherry on top.

title: 5 Minute Lemon Pie
directions: Mix Cool Whip and milk in large bowl., Then pour in lemonade concentrate., Mix well., Pour in graham cracker crust., Chill for 30 minutes.

title: Raised Doughnuts
directions: Dissolve yeast in warm water., Cream together butter, salt, sugar and eggs., Add the scalded milk to the creamed mixture, then cool this mix by adding several cups of flour., Add yeast and enough white flour to make a soft dough., The dough should rise until double., Roll out to 1/2-inch., Cut out and let rise again. Deep-fat fry until brown on each side., Ice while hot.

title: Pineapple Salad
directions: Mix Jell-O and water., Beat cream cheese; add a little of the hot mixture and beat well., Add Cool Whip and beat., Add to Jell-O., Add celery and pineapple., Chill until set., Chopped nuts may be added or sprinkled on top.

title: Porcupine Meatballs
directions: Mix ground beef and seasonings together (Worcestershire sauce, onion,, salt,, pepper,, oregano, garlic salt and onion salt). Add, uncooked, rice., In, deep, skillet or large Dutch oven,, put tomato, juice,, sugar, and a little Worcestershire sauce., Make meat mixture into balls., Place in sauce and cook 1 1/2 to 2 hours on low or simmer.

title: Strawberry Cheese Pie
directions: Note:, Make glaze first so it will have time to cool before you put it on the pie.

title: Toffee Bar Crunch Pie
directions: Mix milk and pie filling about 1 minute; let stand 5 minutes. Fold in Cool Whip and chopped toffee., Spoon into crust. Freeze until firm, about 6 hours., Remove from freezer and let stand 10 minutes to soften before serving.

title: Baby Carrots
directions: Trim stems from carrots., Combine all ingredients in a small dish and bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Salmon Loaf
directions: In a bowl, combine first 5 ingredients. Combine milk and egg. Add to salmon mixture. Mix well. Shape into loaf and put into pan. Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Hot Fudge Cake
directions: Cook cake in sheet pan., Cut into squares., Split squares lengthwise., Put ice cream in middle., Pour sauce over it.

title: Butternut Pound Cake
directions: Cream, Crisco,	sugar, and, eggs for one minute at high speed. Add, 1 cup flour and beat for one minute.	Add 2 other cups flour, alternately with milk., Add flavoring and bake at 325° for one hour., Turn heat up to 350° for 10 to 20 minutes or until golden brown., Use tube pan.

title: Tamale Pie
directions: Saute onion, green pepper and clove of garlic., Saute vegeburger in separate pan until light brown., Mix all together and add chili powder as desired., Add tomatoes and cornmeal, still cooking over low heat., Add olives. Put into buttered casserole and bake at 350° for 35 minutes., Uncover for the last 15 minutes.

title: Angel Mallow Frosting
directions: Combine sugar, egg whites and water in double boiler., Beat with electric mixer over boiling water until soft peaks form., Add Marshmallow Creme., Continue beating until stiff peaks form. Remove from heat., Beat in vanilla.

title: Roadside Potatoes
directions: Heat cream with margarine., Add salt., Place potatoes in a 9 x 13-inch pan., Pour cream mixture over the top., Sprinkle on Parmesan cheese., Bake 1 hour at 325°.

title: Colorful Dragon Stir-Fry
directions: Cut chicken into 1/2-inch strips., Remove florets from broccoli., Set aside., Peel stalks and cut into thin slices., Coat chicken with 1 tablespoon stir-fry sauce., Heat 1 tablespoon oil in hot wok or large skillet over high heat., Add chicken and stir-fry three minutes., Remove.

title: Bass With Asparagus And Cream Sauce
directions: Poach the fish in a buttered baking dish with wine, 1/3 cup water, peppercorns, onion, garlic and bay leaf for 15 minutes at 325°., Steam the asparagus for 7 to 8 minutes.

title: Pumpkin Pie(Grandpa'S Favorite)
directions: Blend all ingredients together except egg whites, cream of tartar and pie shells., Beat egg whites until stiff, then add cream of tartar., Beat until blended, about 1 minute., Fold egg whites into pumpkin mixture until well blended., Do not beat., Pour pie mixture into unbaked shells., Bake at 400° for 10 minutes, then turn down to 350° and bake for 45 minutes., Yields 2 pies.

title: Quaker Chocolate Oat-Chip Cookies
directions: Heat oven to 375°., Beat margarine and sugar until creamy. Add eggs, milk and vanilla; beat well., Add flour, salt and baking soda; mix well., Stir in oats, chocolate chips and nuts; mix well. Drop by round measuring tablespoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet., Bake 9 to 10 minutes for a chewy cookie., For a crispier cookie, bake 12 to 13 minutes., Cool 1 minute on cookie sheet. Remove to wire rack and cool completely.

title: Quick Caramel Corn
directions: Melt butter in saucepan., Stir in brown sugar., Heat to boiling, stirring constantly., Boil and stir over low heat 2 minutes., Stir in honey, heat to boiling., Pour boiling syrup in thin stream over popped corn in bowl, stirring until corn is well coated.

title: Long Island Clam Spread
directions: Saute onion in butter or margarine until transparent., Remove from heat and add the clams, one of the cans drained, the other with its liquid., Stir in remaining ingredients., Bake, uncovered, for 25 minutes at 350°., Serve on seasoned crackers or rye bread thins.

title: California Enchiladas
directions: Sauce:, Drain broth from chicken rice soup. Add tomato sauce and enchilada sauce to drained chicken and rice., Simmer., Add 1 or 2 teaspoons of cornstarch to thicken.

title: Microwave Peanut Brittle
directions: In casserole dish, stir peanuts, sugar, Karo syrup and salt. Cook 4 minutes in microwave on High., Take out and stir., Return to microwave for 4 minutes on High power., Take out, stir in butter and vanilla., Cook 2 minutes on High, take out and add baking soda., Stir until foamy., Immediately pour onto lightly greased baking sheet, spread out thin with back of spoon., Let cool (refrigerate 10 minutes)., Break apart and store in tight container.

title: Gooey Butter Cake
directions: Mix together the cake mix, 2 eggs and margarine., Spread in a 9 x 13-inch greased and floured pan., Mix together the powdered sugar, 2 eggs, lemon juice and cream cheese., Spread on first mixture., Cover with light layer of nuts (optional) and additional powdered sugar., Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes; do not overbake.

title: Grilled Potatoes
directions: In heavy-duty aluminum foil, place potato slices, onion slices and butter slices., Salt and pepper as desired., Roll edges (top and ends) of foil (3 times) for a tight seal., Place on grill and cook 20 minutes on each side.

title: Chicken Casserole Supreme
directions: Place several chicken diced on bottom of dish., Add chopped green bell peppers; layer on top of 1st chicken layer., Mix brown rice with onion and tomato sauce., Pour over bottom layer of chicken and bell peppers; top with mushrooms and cheese sauce. Top with remaining chicken dices., Bake for 1 hour or until chicken is tender.

title: Judy'S Cheese Ball
directions: Mix margarine, cream cheese and cheese spread together., Add chopped onion., Form into ball; refrigerate overnight., Next day, roll in finely chopped nuts.

title: Spaghetti Salad
directions: Break spaghetti into 1-inch pieces., Boil until tender in salted water., Drain and wash in cold water., Drain well., Put in large bowl and add remaining ingredients., Mix well and let marinate at least 4 hours or overnight (or longer)., Keeps well up to a week or more in refrigerator.

title: Broccoli Salad
directions: Cook bacon. In mixing bowl cut up broccoli, break bacon into small pieces., Add raisins and onion., Toss together., chill.

title: Macaroni Salad
directions: Cook macaroni as directed., Mix all ingredients together and add to macaroni., Chill and serve.

title: Pavlova'S Dewdrops
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., Sift together flour, baking powder and salt., Cream butter with sugar and add egg and marmalade. Gradually add flour mixture to butter mixture and work until smooth., Stir in sprinkles.

title: Cherry Salad
directions: Combine all ingredients; mix well. Chill for 2 hours before serving.

title: Tangy Cranberry Conserve
directions: Combine all ingredients in saucepan. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer 10 minutes or until tender, stirring occasionally. Cool slightly. Store in refrigerator until serving time. Makes 2 cups.

title: Chix Casserole
directions: Thaw mixed vegetables, then combine with chicken, onion and celery in a 2-quart baking dish., Set aside., Combine cream of chicken soup and milk in a small bowl., Stir until ingredients are well mixed, then add mixture to chicken and vegetables., Stir. Put biscuits on the top of mixture and bake for 15 minutes at 425°.

title: Fudge Frosting
directions: Mix first 4 ingredients until smooth., Add milk and boil. Remove from heat and add butter and vanilla.

title: Breaded Ranch Chicken
directions: In a shallow bowl, combine cornflakes, Parmesan cheese and salad dressing mix. Dip chicken in butter, then roll in cornflake mixture to coat. Place in an ungreased 13 x 9 x 2 baking dish. Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 45 minutes or until chicken juices run clear.

title: Aunt Faye'S Punch
directions: Put sugar and Kool-Aid in large!!! pitcher. Add 7-Up and pineapple juice, stirring well. Then add water.

title: O'Henry Bars
directions: Heat margarine, sugar and syrup until melted; add oats. Spread in greased cookie sheet or 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan., Bake 8 to 10 minutes at 350°., Melt chocolate chips; add peanut butter. Spread on hot bars., Chill and serve., Will need to be kept in refrigerator.

title: Fruit Pizza
directions: Roll out sugar cookie dough and place on cookie sheet or round pizza pan (pre-grease with Pam)., Bake according to directions on package., Blend soft cream cheese, 1 cup Cool Whip and 1 cup powdered sugar., Beat well., Spread over cookie mix., Place 1 can fruit pie filling mix on Cool Whip mix., Layer on this, pineapple, sliced bananas, sliced strawberries, sliced kiwi and any fresh fruit you desire., Top with Cool Whip., Garnish with fresh fruit and nuts., Eat and enjoy.

title: Ginger Beef
directions: Slice beef thin against grain., Coat with cornstarch, soy sauce and 1/2 tablespoon oil., Put the ginger into a mixing bowl. Add 1 teaspoon salt; let stand 10 minutes, then drain and squeeze to get juice out., Heat 1 cup oil in wok., Add beef; cook until meat loses red color., Drain, saving 2 tablespoons of oil., Blend sugar, wine and monosodium glutamate and set aside., Heat 2 tablespoons oil., Add ginger juice., Add beef and coriander leaves., Cook 1 minute., Add wine; heat, then serve over rice or noodles., Makes 4 to 8 servings.

title: Tuna Casserole
directions: Combine soup, milk and onions in 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Mix well., Stir in peas, tuna and 1 cup crushed chips., Sprinkle remaining chips on top and bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Cavatini
directions: Mix cooked ground beef, pepperoni slices, onion, green pepper and mushrooms in spaghetti sauce., Cook rigatoni and spiral shells until tender in boiling water and drain., Grease a 2-quart casserole dish and layer meat mixture, pasta and cheese., Bake until bubbly in 350° oven for 30 minutes., Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Holiday Ham Pockets
directions: Spread insides of pita with cream cheese., Stuff with lettuce, ham, pineapple and onions., Cut in half again., Makes attractive appetizers and they are good.

title: Rolled Chicken Breasts
directions: Pound chicken to 1/4-inch thickness., Place 1 slice cheese and 1 slice ham on each breast and roll., Arrange in baking dish. Saute mushrooms in butter in skillet., Add flour., Add broth, soup, sherry and cheese spread., Cook until well blended, stirring constantly., Pour over chicken and top with almonds., Yields 6 servings.

title: Honey Buns
directions: Preheat oven to 425°., Grease round pan (9 x 1/2-inch)., Mix baking mix, whipping cream, sugar, nutmeg and egg until dough forms., Gently smooth dough into ball on cloth covered board, dusted with baking mix., Knead 10 times., Divide dough into 16 equal parts., Shape each into a ball., Place 12 balls around edge of pan, 4 in center., Bake until golden brown (15 to 20 minutes). Remove from pan., Spread honey over buns; sprinkle with pecans.

title: Lemon Sauce
directions: Boil the water and sugar., Add the remaining ingredients. Delicious served over gingerbread., Yields 1 cup.

title: Fried Green Tomatoes
directions: Cut tomatoes into 3/8-inch thick slices., Mix flour with salt and pepper., Coat tomatoes with mixture and let set 15 minutes.

title: Mother'S Banana Pudding
directions: Mix milk and water., Add stick of margarine, sugar and egg yolks and beat., Bring to a boil., Keep stirring until it changes color, then slowly add cornstarch., In 4-quart pan, layer vanilla wafers, sliced bananas and mixture., Beat egg whites until stiff add sugar to taste., Spread on top., Brown in oven.

title: Crumb Pie
directions: Mix crushed crackers, dates, sugar and nuts., Fold into beaten egg whites and flavoring., Bake for 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Pecan Pie
directions: Mix syrup and sugar., Add melted butter., Mix in eggs and vanilla., Let stand 1 hour., Place pecan pieces in unbaked 9-inch pie shell., Pour filling over pecan pieces and cover with pecan halves., Bake 45 to 50 minutes at 325°.

title: Ginger-Tomato Preserves
directions: Combine sugar, water, thinly sliced lemon, cinnamon and ginger and, simmer, 20, minutes., Remove spices., Add tomatoes and boil gently, until, they are bright and clear., Cover and let stand overnight., Drain off syrup; boil until thick., Add tomatoes, reheat to boiling and seal in sterilized jars.

title: Keeps Forever Coleslaw
directions: Bring liquids, sugar, salt and spices to a boil, stirring frequently., Boil 3 minutes., Pour over vegetables., Mix well, cover and refrigerate., Keeps forever and improves with age.

title: Chalupa
directions: Saute half of onion until soft., Add meat and cook until brown., Add flour and chili powder., Cook 5 minutes., Add water. Cook until thick., Mix soup, cream, rest of onion and cheese together; set aside.

title: Cajun Cheese Ball
directions: Blend cream cheese, cheddar cheese, onions, and worcestershire sauce., Mix well., Shape into a ball and log., Mix pecans and parsley., Roll ball in pecan mixture until completely covered., Refrigerate for one hour, or until chilled., Serve with crackers.

title: Weight Watchers Cheese Dip
directions: Blend all ingredients in electric blender., Double quantities for large groups., Serve with raw vegetables as dippers.

title: Elvis Sugar Cookies
directions: Sift flour and soda;, Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Refrigerate 3 hrs., Shape into balls and place on ungreased baking sheet., Flatten cookies with fork;, Sprinkle with sugar. Bake in 375° gas oven 6 to 8 mins., Makes 6 dozens.

title: Fresh Vegetable Dip
directions: Mix and chill., Chill about 1 hour prior to serving.

title: Chop Suey
directions: Into a hot skillet, place 3 tablespoon oil and bring to a boil. Fry meat until nearly done., Stir in chop suey sauce, sprouts, celery, onions, salt and 1 cup water; cook for 15 minutes., Make a thickening from flour and stir into mixture thoroughly for several minutes., This may be prepared several hours before serving time. Open the can of noodles and heat in the oven for several minutes. Arrange the noodles on a large platter and place chop suey in center.

title: Vegetable Pizza
directions: Pat crescent rolls out in pan and bake., Let cool., Combine cream cheese, salad dressing and Hidden Valley Ranch dressing until smooth., Spread evenly over cooled crescent rolls., Combine all vegetables and spread evenly over dressing., Top with shredded cheese.

title: Sausage Pinwheels
directions: Spread hot sausage thinly on pie crust. Roll it up jelly roll. style. Freeze until firm, then slice into 1/4 inch pieces and bake at 400 degrees until brown.

title: Peanut Brittle
directions: Put sugar, water, vinegar and syrup in a black skillet or heavy saucepan., Cook vigorously until the mixture will spin a thread., Reduce heat, add peanuts and cook until they turn a golden brown, stirring constantly., (Be sure to let them brown because this is the key to the good taste of this recipe.), Reduce heat again and add butter and stir well., Add soda and mix well. Pour onto 2 well-buttered cookie sheets or marble., Let cool slightly and pull., (I loosen all sides first and then pull and hack off with knife.)

title: Quick Apple Crisp
directions: You will need 1 square pan.

title: Hamburger Pie
directions: Cook meat and onion until meat is browned., Add salt and pepper., Add drained vegetables and soup; pour into greased 1 1/2-quart casserole., Mash potatoes while hot; add milk and egg. Season with salt and pepper., Spoon mounds over casserole. Sprinkle potatoes with cheese., Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Pumpkin Bread
directions: Sift flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt, allspice, powdered cloves, cinnamon and nutmeg., Cream oil and sugar; beat in 1 egg at a time., Add pumpkin., Add sifted ingredients., Add chopped nuts., Pour into 2 loaf pans., Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Strawberry Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 320°., Grease and flour 13 x 2-inch pan., Mix preceding ingredients and bake until done. Top with icing.

title: Cabbage Casserole
directions: Cut cabbage; boil in salted water until tender., Drain, keeping 1 cup juice., In large skillet, brown meat, onion and garlic., Drain., After browning, add cabbage, soups, rice and enough cabbage juice so it won't be dry., Spoon into greased casserole dish., Top with grated cheese and bake at 300° for 20 minutes.

title: Ham, Broccoli And Cheese Casserole
directions: Cook broccoli 3 to 5 minutes., Combine all ingredients and place in 9 x 11-inch baking dish., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Stir once or twice during baking., Can substitute turkey or chicken in place of ham.

title: Delicious Tuna Bake
directions: Melt butter and saute pepper and onion., Blend in flour, salt, pepper, milk and mayonnaise., Stir until thick., Add vegetables and tuna., Turn into buttered casserole., Place tomato wedges on top., Bake at 375° for 25 minutes, until slightly brown.

title: Date Loaf Cake
directions: Chop dates; add soda and boiling water and set aside to cool. Combine, oleo, sugar, and, egg, and, cream, well., Add vanilla and grated rind of, the, orange, and, add, to the date mixture. Add flour and salt, and, beat until smooth., Bake in tube pan for 1 hour in 350° oven.

title: Cherry Salad
directions: Combine syrups and add enough cola drink to make 2 cups. Bring to a boil in saucepan and add cherry jello to dissolve. Crumble cream cheese in gelatin mixture and cool., Fold in cherries and pineapple (you may also add chopped nuts.), Chill and serve on lettuce.

title: Pineapple Delight
directions: Mix condensed milk, pineapple and lemon juice in a large bowl. Pour in pie crust and top with chopped nuts., Let set in refrigerator overnight or for several hours.

title: Creamy Lemon Pie
directions: In medium bowl, beat eggs., Blend in Eagle Brand milk, lemon juice and food coloring., Pour into pie shell., Top with whipped cream or whipped topping., Garnish as desired., Refrigerate.

title: Zesty Baked Chicken
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Mix crumbs with cheese, parsley, pepper and salt., Combine garlic and margarine., Brush on chicken breasts, then roll each piece in the bread crumb mixture., Place chicken in a single layer in shallow baking dish., Sprinkle with remaining bread crumb mixture., Bake 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Mom'S Jello Cookies
directions: *Do not substitute lo-cal type.

title: Banana Cinnamon Cake(Low-Fat)
directions: Preheat oven to 400°., Spray 9-inch square baking pan with vegetable oil spray., Combine flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, cinnamon and salt in large bowl., Whisk together yogurt, banana, oil, egg and vanilla in medium bowl or food processor. Pour over dry ingredients and stir gently until just blended., Do not overmix., Spread batter in prepared pan., Bake until top of cake is lightly brown and the sides pull away from the sides of the pan, approximately 20 minutes., Cool cake in pan on rack 10 minutes., Loosen sides with spatula and turn over on rack., Invert cake and let cool completely., Sprinkle lightly with powdered sugar.

title: Almond Bars
directions: Cream margarine, sugar and egg yolk., Add flour., Spread 1/4-inch thick in a 10 x 15-inch pan., Beat egg white stiff and spread on top., Sprinkle with nuts., Bake 45 minutes at 275°., Cut into squares at once.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
directions: Melt margarine., Add flour and salt., Stir milk in slowly. Cook until thickens., Now add slices potatoes and bring milk mixture and potatoes back to a boil., Pour into a buttered dish. Dot with margarine and bake at 350° for 1 hour 15 minutes or until potatoes are tender.

title: Genoa Veggie Dip
directions: Early in the day, chop or grind salami., Mix thoroughly with sour cream., Cover and refrigerate for several hours until thickened., Use with crackers or bread.

title: B. Q. Salad Dressing
directions: Blend all ingredients together well., Chill., Serve on favorite green salad.

title: Home Pride Meat Loaf
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Heat Crisco oil in small skillet on medium heat., Add onion., Saute until softened., Combine onion, meat, oats, tomato juice, 1/4 cup ketchup, egg white, Worcestershire sauce, salt, pepper and garlic salt., Stir until well blended. Press into 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2 1/2-inch loaf pan (or shape into loaf)., Turn out into larger baking pan., Bake at 350° for 50 minutes., Remove from oven., Spread remaining 1/4 cup ketchup over top., Return to oven., Bake 10 minutes., Remove from oven., Let stand 5 minutes., Place on serving plate., Slice. Serve., Makes 8 servings., Contains 240 calories, fat 9 g (78 cal or 32% of total calories), sat fat 3 g (10% of total calories), carb 13 g, protein 27 g, chol 70 mg and sodium 495 mg.

title: Curry In A Hurry
directions: In saucepan, cook the apple, onion and curry in butter until onion is tender. Stir in soup, water and meat., Heat, stirring occasionally., Serve over rice and garnish with coconut., Serves 4.

title: Dried Beef Spread
directions: Combine all except nuts in ovenproof dish., Top with chopped nuts., Heat at 350° until bubbly., Serve with crackers.

title: Rocky Road Candy
directions: Cook chocolate chips and peanut butter in microwave at 50% power for 3 minutes, stirring each minute., Add marshmallows and nuts., Spread in a foil-lined 8 x 8-inch pan., When set, cut into squares.

title: Jello Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 400°. Mix flour and baking powder in medium bowl. Beat butter in large bowl. Gradually add sugar and 1 package of Jell-O until fluffy. Beat in egg and vanilla. Gradually add flour and baking powder mixture. Mix well. Shape dough in 1-inch balls. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Flatten cookie dough with bottom of a glass. Sprinkle each cookie with remaining package of Jell-O. Bake 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Crunchy Tuna Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients, except tomatoes and cucumbers. Refrigerate., Serve with tomatoes and cucumbers., Makes 4 servings.

title: Taco Salad
directions: Brown beef; drain and add tomato sauce, taco mix and water. Follow directions on taco mix (simmer, uncovered 20 to 25 minutes)., Toss vegetables and meat mixture together., Crumble taco chips on top., When ready to serve, add Catalina dressing to taste., Toss the whole thing!

title: Peach Cobbler
directions: Mix together milk and flour., Melt butter and add to flour mixture., Chop up peaches and add to mixture, including syrup. Pour into medium casserole dish and bake at 325° for 30 minutes.

title: Lemon Sunshine Pie
directions: Stir all the ingredients together and let stand about 5 minutes., Pour into a 9-inch graham cracker crust or a baked pie shell., (Bake pie shell before adding lemon filling.), Top with Cool Whip.

title: Veg-All Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients together and put in a greased casserole dish., Put crushed Ritz crackers on top., Dot with margarine. Bake at 350° for approximately 30 minutes.

title: Cathedral Window Jello Salad
directions: Dissolve jello in 1 1/2 cups hot water each separately., Set aside to cool., When set, cut in cubes., Mix crumbs, sugar and oleo together., Line bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan with 1/2 of crumbs., Save rest for top., Dissolve gelatine in 1/4 cup water., Add hot pineapple; set aside to cool., When cool, add Cool Whip and cubed jello., Put in pan., Cover with remaining crumbs., I often use a jello mold and when sliced it is very pretty.

title: Creamy Pumpkin Pie
directions: Beat all together with eggbeater until blended and creamy; pour into pastry lined pie pan., Bake just until a silver knife inserted into side of filling comes out clean., For a lighter color and milder flavor, omit cloves., Temperature:, 425°., Time: Bake 45 to 55 minutes.

title: Molasses Crinkles
directions: Cream together butter, shortening, sugar, egg and molasses. Mix dry ingredients together and add., Roll dough into balls the size of marbles., Roll in sugar., Bake at 350° for about 6 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Blossom Cookies
directions: Sift flour, soda and salt together., Cream shortening and peanut butter; gradually add sugars, creaming well., Add egg, milk and vanilla; beat well., Combine with dry ingredients, mixing thoroughly., Shape by rounded teaspoonfuls into balls and roll in granulated sugar., Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 375° for 8 minutes., Remove from oven and place chocolate kiss on top of each cookie, pressing down so cookie cracks around edges., Return to oven for 2 to 5 minutes., Makes 4 dozen cookies.

title: French Lick Persimmon Pudding
directions: Mix all ingredients thoroughly and pour into 9 x 9 x 2-inch pans (greased)., Bake in 350° oven for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Russian Tea Mix
directions: Mix all ingredients together and store in an airtight container., Use from 2 to 3 heaping teaspoonfuls per cup of hot water.

title: Taco Salad
directions: Mix together with mixer until smooth., Arrange on large glass cake plate.

title: Fruit Delite
directions: Mix together and put in bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake 10 minutes., Let cool.

title: Peanut Butter Balls
directions: Cream sugar and peanut butter., Stir in melted butter, just enough to thicken to make small balls., Refrigerate until firm. Melt chocolate and dip into chocolate.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Make a white sauce of the last 3 ingredients and stir into the remaining ingredients., Pour into casserole and top with crushed corn flakes or potato chips., Bake at 350° for about 1 hour or until brown and bubbly all through.

title: Fruit Pizza
directions: Press mixed cookie dough into a 12-inch pizza pan., Bake at 350° for 15 minutes; cool.

title: Texas Hash
directions: Cook onions and peppers in oil until tender., Add hamburger and cook until meat falls apart., Drain fat if necessary., Add tomatoes and 1 cup uncooked macaroni or spaghetti or 1/2 cup rice., Pour into buttered casserole and bake for 45 minutes or until tender in 375° oven., Stir occasionally.

title: Real Red Devil'S Food Cake
directions: Sift together into bowl flour, sugar, soda, salt and cocoa. Add shortening and 2/3 cup milk., Beat 2 minutes., Add another 1/3 cup milk, the eggs and vanilla., Beat 2 more minutes., Pour into prepared pans., Bake at 350° until cake tests done., Cool., Finish with White Mountain Frosting., Bake 8-inch layers 35 to 40 minutes, 9-inch layers 30 to 35 minutes and oblong 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Salmon Patties
directions: Stir together all ingredients., Makes 3 patties or 1 serving. Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Almond Torte
directions: Combine cracker crumbs and baking powder., Combine egg whites, almond flavoring and salt and beat until stiff., Gradually add sugar, beating well after each addition., Fold crumb mixture and nuts into beaten egg whites., Spread in bottom of 9-inch pie plate., Bake at 350° for 25 minutes or until golden brown., Cool. Put peaches into crust and top with Cool Whip.

title: Spanish Rice
