directions: Melt drippings in a skillet., Add onion, green pepper and rice., Cook and stir over high heat until lightly browned., Add hot water, tomato sauce and seasonings; mix well., Bring quickly to a boil; cover tightly and simmer 10 minutes.

title: Carrot Cake
directions: Place sugar, oil, eggs and vanilla in mixing bowl., Beat with wire whip until well mixed., Stir in pineapple and carrots.

title: Oreo Dessert
directions: Crush cookies (keep aside a handful for topping)., Melt margarine and mix with cookies in 9 x 13-inch dish., Press to bottom of dish., Mix cream cheese and sugar until smooth; fold in 1/2 of Cool Whip., Spread over cookie crust., Mix pudding with milk and pour over cream cheese layer., Spread Cool Whip on top. Sprinkle with crushed cookies on top., Enjoy!

title: Over Seas Fudge
directions: Melt butter., Add milk and sugar., Bring this to a slow boil and boil for 10 minutes., Turn off heat and add chocolate chips, stirring until all have melted., Then add the marshmallow and whip until smooth., Add nuts and vanilla., Pour into buttered pan. Cool and cut into squares.

title: Salt Substitute
directions: Mix and put in salt shaker.

title: Cheesy Asparagus Casserole
directions: Layer asparagus, egg and cheese 1/2 at a time in well-greased casserole., Top with mushroom soup and cashews., Toss crumbs with butter., Sprinkle over top., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes., Yields 6 servings.

title: Summer Squash Casserole
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Slice and cook squash until tender, but firm., Drain. Melt margarine mix with stuffing., Pat 1/2 of stuffing into bottom of a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish., Add chicken soup, onions and squash., Pour over crumbs., Add remaining crumbs to top of squash., Bake 45 minutes.

title: Frozen Fruit Salad
directions: Mix water and sugar; boil until clear., Remove from heat., Add bananas, pineapple, oranges, cherries and orange juice; mix well and freeze.

title: Old-Fashioned Pound Cake
directions: Cream together shortening, sugar and eggs., Gradually add flour and mix well, then add vanilla., Cherries, coconut or nuts may be added., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean.

title: Blueberry Buckle
directions: Mix sugar, margarine, egg and milk until blended., Add dry ingredients that have been sifted together., Add blueberries, blending carefully (2 cups)., Sprinkle with topping.

title: Broccoli Dip
directions: Saute beef and drain fat., Melt butter and saute onion and broccoli., Melt cheese rolls in microwave., Add cream of mushroom soup, green chillies, onion, beef and broccoli., Heat over low heat and serve as a dip with Tostitos or use as a main dish over rice or noodles.

title: Sealed Salad
directions: Break lettuce into small pieces., Cut up cauliflower and onion., Mix together in a large bowl; set aside., Mix sugar and mayonnaise and spread over mixture., Top with cheese and bacon. Cover and refrigerate for 24 hours.

title: Doughnuts
directions: Combine first 4 ingredients and then cool., Mix the warm water and yeast together., Sprinkle a little flour and sugar over the dissolving yeast., This makes yeast work better., Add the rest of the ingredients., Roll out immediately and let rise., Bake in deep fat at 375°.

title: Cheesecake With Raspberry Glaze
directions: Mix together graham cracker crumbs, 3 tablespoons sugar, cinnamon and 1/2 cup butter., Spread in 10-inch spring-form pan. Blend cream cheese in mixer at room temperature., Add eggs, 2 teaspoons vanilla, 3/4 cup plus 2 tablespoons sugar and lemon juice., Beat well., Pour into crust., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes. Cool 5 minutes., Blend together sour cream, 4 tablespoons sugar and 2 teaspoons vanilla., Spread over cheese layer and return to 350° oven for 5 minutes., Chill.

title: Granny'S Chicken Spaghetti
directions: Cook spaghetti according to package directions., Saute onion, peppers and mushrooms in a small amount of garlic butter., Combine all ingredients in large pot., Heat 10 minutes over medium heat, or until desired thickness., Serve with tossed salad, Italian dressing and garlic bread.

title: Party Bread
directions: Mix all ingredients together in a bowl and put into a greased loaf pan., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Taco Salad
directions: Mix cream cheese and sour cream in bowl., Put refried beans in small bowl., Mix well., In 9 x 13 pan, layer meat, beans over meat, sour cream mixture, chopped (small) lettuce, chopped onions, chopped tomatoes, shredded cheese and sliced olives., Put in refrigerator until ready to eat., Serve with taco chips or nachos.

title: Boiled Okra
directions: Wash okra thoroughly in cold water., Drain off water., Do not cut the caps off the okra., (This prevents the vegetable from falling apart in the cooking.), Cover the okra with water in a small saucepan., Add the baking soda and salt., Cook for 20 to 25 minutes until okra is tender

title: Orange Slice - Date Cake
directions: Mix cake in order given.

title: Skillet Pizza
directions: Brown meat and onion in skillet., Add uncooked noodles to meat and onions., Mix water, tomato paste and spices together., Pour over noodles and meat., Cover and cook 20 to 30 minutes, until noodles are done., Top with cheese, melt and serve.

title: Spicy Poached Pears
directions: In a 3-quart saucepan, combine wine, orange juice, brown sugar and stick cinnamon or ground cinnamon., Cook and stir over medium-low heat until sugar is dissolved., Add pear halves., Cover and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until pears are barely tender. Uncover and cook about 20 minutes more or until pears are translucent., Remove stick cinnamon., Serve pears warm with vanilla ice milk., Yield:, 6 to 8 servings.

title: Salmon Casserole
directions: Spray baking dish with Pam., Put salmon in bottom of dish. Season with salt and pepper to taste., Spread diced onion on salmon., Add peas, potatoes, Cheez Whiz or Cheddar cheese., Pour soup over top and bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Grace'S Pecan Pie
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Pour in pie shell., Layer nuts on top., Bake at 375° for 40 minutes.

title: Cheese Meat Loaf
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Combine all ingredients; mix well. Shape into loaf., Bake for 1 hour, until brown.

title: Deviled Baked Beans
directions: Place 1/2 of the beans in a greased baking dish., Cover beans with relish., Combine next 6 ingredients., Spoon about 1/3 of this mixture over relish and cover with remaining beans., Spread remaining sauce mixture on top of the beans., Mix butter and muffin crumbs and sprinkle thickly over top of casserole., Bake at 375° for 30 minutes.

title: Pepperoni Spread
directions: Add 1 tablespoon of milk at a time until you reach desired consistency.

title: 5-Way Chili
directions: Brown hamburger., Add all ingredients., Simmer 3 to 4 hours. Remove garlic clove and bay leaves., Serves 5 ways:

title: Peach Upside-Down Cake
directions: Melt butter in 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan., Sprinkle brown sugar evenly in pan., Drain peaches and arrange with cherries in sugar mixture., Mix cake as directed; spread over fruit., Bake at 350° until done (45 to 50 minutes).

title: Lemon Jello Cake
directions: Mix 1/2 of water with cake mix and Jell-O until lumps are out. Add rest of water, oil, eggs and extract., Beat well., Bake in 9 x 12-inch 25 to 35 minutes at 350°., Mix powdered sugar and lemon juice., Put on cake as removed from oven., Makes a glaze.

title: Apple Puff Muffins
directions: Mix together Bisquick, sugar, cinnamon and applesauce., Add remaining ingredients and mix together with spoon for 30 seconds. Drop into muffin tins., Bake 12 minutes at 400°., When removed from oven, dip tops of muffins in melted butter and then in cinnamon sugar (1/3 cup sugar plus 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon)., Makes 12 muffins.

title: Cappuccino Mix
directions: Mix all ingredients together., To serve, use 1 tablespoon and 1 teaspoon mix in cup., Add boiling water., Stir well.

title: Hot Spiced Tea
directions: Mix all ingredients together and store in a covered container. Use about 3 teaspoons per cup., Add boiling water.

title: Ham And Broccoli Casserole
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Cook broccoli as directed on package; drain., Spread in an ungreased 9 x 13-inch baking dish., Layer ham and cheese over broccoli., Beat remaining ingredients until smooth., Slowly pour over casserole., Bake, uncovered, for 1 hour. Serves 10 to 12.

title: Chicken Salad
directions: Mix last 4 ingredients together and pour over and toss with first 4 ingredients., Chill and serve.

title: Lemonade Cake
directions: Mix the first 5 ingredients for 3 minutes., Pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake for 30 minutes at 300°., Poke holes in warm cake and add syrup over top that is made with the sugar and lemonade and dribble over cake., Bake for 5 minutes more.

title: Burnt Cream Brulee
directions: Heat 1/2 cup whipping cream and chocolate morsels in a saucepan over low heat, stirring until chocolate melts., Cool slightly., Pour mixture evenly into 6 round baking dishes and set aside., Whisk together the remaining 2 whipping cream, egg yolks, 1/2 cup sugar, and vanilla until sugar dissolves and mixture is smooth., Pour evenly into prepared baking dishes, and place on 13 x 9 inch baking dish., Add hot water to large dish to depth of 1/2 inch., Bake at 275° for 1 hour and 30 minutes., Cool custards in water in pan on wire rack., Remove custards from pan, cover and chill for 8 hours., Sprinkle 1/2 tablespoon brown sugar over each custard and place in baking pan., Broil 5 1/2 inches from heat until sugar melts., Let stand 5 minutes to allow sugar to harden. Yields 6 servings.

title: Punch
directions: Bring the first three ingredients to a boil, then cool., Add 4 cups water, the pineapple juice and lemon juice., Freeze., Two hours before serving, pour ginger ale over punch.

title: Mideastern Dish
directions: Brown beef and pour off fat., Add curry powder and water to cover., Simmer 1 hour., Add water as needed., Prepare rice.

title: Sue'S Molasses Cookies
directions: Stir together, soda, flour, salt, cinnamon and ginger., In another bowl blend sugar, oil, eggs and molasses., Add dry ingredients to the 2nd mixture., Stir well. This will take two people., One to hold the bowl, another to stir., Very hard to stir and the dough is quite stiff., Chill several hours., Roll into 1-inch balls and roll each ball in sugar., Place on ungreased cookie sheet 1 1/2 to 2 inches apart., Bake at 325 for 8 minutes. When they come out of the oven, they will be a little puffy., Drop the cookie sheet on the counter to flatten., Do not overbake.

title: "Wind Between The Houses" Casserole
directions: Shred corned beef., Mix all ingredients together in a casserole dish., Let set at least 3 hours or overnight., Bake 1 hour at 350°.

title: Skillet Beef And Mac
directions: In medium skillet over medium high heat, cook beef, onion and Italian seasoning until beef is browned, stirring to separate meat. Pour off fat. Add soup, water and corn. Heat to a boil. Reduce heat to low. Cover and cook 5 minutes or until corn is tender. Add macaroni and heat through. Sprinkle with cheese. Garnish with tomatoes and fresh oregano.

title: Thirty Minute Biscuits
directions: Sift flour, baking powder, salt and soda together., Heat buttermilk to lukewarm; add sugar and yeast., Let stand 5 minutes. Add oil, stir in dry ingredients; mix well., Roll on floured board; knead., Shape biscuits and place on well greased (or buttered) baking pan., Grease tops with melted butter., Cover, allow to rise 30 minutes., Bake in 375° oven for 12 to 15 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Quick Pecan Pie
directions: Combine sugars, melted butter and syrup., Add beaten eggs and pecans., Pour into pie shell., Bake at 375° for 40 minutes., Serve warm with vanilla ice cream., Serves 6.

title: Deep Dish Biscuit Pizza
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Brown and drain ground beef and onions. Stir in tomato paste and spices., Simmer for 10 minutes., Press biscuits into a greased 9-inch pie pan to form crust., Spoon meat mixture into crust., Sprinkle with cheese and bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until golden brown., Let stand for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Oven Smoked Clams
directions: Mix and pour over clams in shallow pan., Sprinkle with paprika., Bake in 350° oven for 1 1/2 hours if raw and 45 minutes for cooked clams., Stir frequently., (I left in oven a little longer after I turned it off and kept stirring.)

title: Hamburger Goulash
directions: Brown ground beef; drain most of fat., Add onion and green pepper; saut., Add tomatoes and pork and beans and seasonings. Cook macaroni and add to beef/bean mixture.

title: Cranberry Bread
directions: Sift together dry ingredients., Beat in egg, orange juice, oil and water., Add 1 cup cranberries and 1/2 cup chopped nuts., Bake at 350° for 1 hour in a greased loaf pan.

title: Pumpkin-Pecan Pie
directions: Mix all together, except pecans., Pour into shell., Top with pecans., Bake at 350° for 40 minutes or until set.

title: The Pusser'S Pain Killer
directions: Without ice, blend, shake or stir all ingredients., Pour into a big glass filled with ice. Grate fresh nutmeg on top., Makes 1 serving.

title: Cloud Nine Dip
directions: Soften cream cheese to room temperature., With an electric mixer cream the cheese and sugar., Add the orange peel, ginger and Marshmallow Creme., Mix well., Serve with assorted fruit slices.

title: Pickled Shrimp
directions: Clean and cook shrimp., Slice onions., Alternate layers of shrimp and onion., Add bay leaves., Combine oil, vinegar, salt, celery seed, capers and juice and Tabasco., Mix and pour over shrimp., Refrigerate; best if made the night before., Before serving, sprinkle parsley on top.

title: Chess Pie
directions: Mix all ingredients well., Pour in uncooked pie crust., Cook at 300° for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Peaches And Cream Dessert
directions: Mix together flour, pudding and baking powder., Add eggs, milk and melted butter., Pour into greased cake pan., Drain peaches, reserving 2/3 peach juice., Chop peaches; sprinkle on top of batter., Beat together cream cheese, 1 cup sugar and peach juice. Pour on top of chopped peaches., Combine 2 tablespoons sugar and cinnamon and sprinkle on top of cake pan., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: 1-2-3-4 Cake
directions: Mix butter and sugar; beat in eggs one at a time and add vanilla., In bowl mix flour, salt and baking powder., Alternately add to batter the milk and flour mixture., Bake at 350° for 35 minutes or until done.

title: Blue Cheese Dip
directions: Reserve 1 ounce Blue cheese., Blend all other ingredients until smooth., Add reserved Blue cheese.

title: Red Lobster Quick Bread Biscuits
directions: Mix baking mix, milk and cheese until a soft dough forms. Beat vigorously for 30 seconds., Drop dough by spoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet., Bake at 450° for about 10 minutes or until lightly brown.

title: Quick Chicken And Dressing
directions: Prepare the stuffing according to directions., Cook the chicken breasts and chop., Add the soup and sour cream; heat., Spread half the dressing in bottom of a 9 x 12-inch pan., Spoon chicken mixture on top., Use remainder of dressing to spread to cover chicken. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Corn Rice Casserole
directions: Cook rice per directions., Mix all ingredients together., Pour into casserole dish and bake at 350° for 25 or 30 minutes.

title: Lou Abate'S Pizza Dough(Low-Fat)
directions: In a large bowl, dissolve the yeast in the water., Let stand for 5 minutes to soften., Add the sugar, salt and olive oil., Let stand for 1 minute., Add the 1 1/3 cups of flour and mix to blend until dough is elastic., Stir in 1/2 cup more flour to make the dough soft., Knead on a floured surface for 10 to 12 minutes or until the dough is smooth and springy., Place in a greased bowl, turn the dough to grease the top., Cover and place in a warm place until it rises to double its size (about 1 hour)., Punch the dough down, knead for 3 to 5 minutes, cover and let rise for another hour.

title: Pork Chops With Scalloped Potatoes
directions: In a saucepan, melt butter; stir in flour, salt and pepper. Add chicken broth; stir constantly until mixture boils., Cook for one minute; remove from heat and set aside.

title: Cheesy Rice Bake
directions: In a 1 1/2-quart casserole, combine water, bouillon cube and cheese., Stir until cheese is partially melted., Add milk, soup, rice and pimentos; mix well., Garnish with paprika when it comes out of the oven.

title: Picklets
directions: Beat eggs., Add sugar, then milk, flour and baking powder. Mix well., Add rest of milk., Put into pan and spread thin., Cook until golden brown.

title: Barbecue Ribs
directions: Trim all fat and excess from meat., Wash in cold salt water. Rinse meat at least twice to remove salt., Let soak in cold water for 15 minutes., Drain all water from meat., Sprinkle with meat tenderizer on both sides., Place meat in a deep pan., Refrigerate 1 hour., Remove from refrigerator, marinate in Viva Italian dressing., Cover and refrigerate 24 hours., Remove and drain excess dressing., Do not wash., Meat is ready for grill.

title: Tartar Sauce
directions: In a saucepan, put butter, milk and flour over low fire., Stir continuously to prevent lumping., Boil until it is as thick as mayonnaise., Remove from heat and let cool., When sauce is cold, add as much Hellmann's mayonnaise as sauce., Add garlic to taste. Season with salt and pepper to taste.

title: Spaghetti
directions: Brown ground chuck, onion and mushrooms in skillet., Drain off fat. Add all of the rest of the ingredients to the meat mixture and simmer for about 30 minutes, stirring occasionally. While this is simmering cook desired amount of vermicelli until done., Drain vermicelli and add to spaghetti sauce., Let simmer another 10 minutes or so., Serve with warm garlic bread and a side salad for a great meal!

title: Mary'S Basic Cookie Dough
directions: Cream together margarine and sugar; blend and add in eggs. Add vanilla., Add sifted dry ingredients., Blend well., Divide dough into 4 parts., Each part can be used for another cookie. You can roll into a log and pour colored sugar on wax paper and roll dough over it and freeze., When it is solid, you can slice cookies or you can add a tablespoon of cocoa to another roll and then freeze until solid, then slice and bake., Or you can put part into cookie press or you can roll out on floured board and make cut out cookies., Bake at 350° approximately 15 minutes., You can also add nuts to one part.

title: Ham Biscuits
directions: Blend above ingredients in blender., Split Pepperidge Farm party rolls., Spread both sides with mixture., Add ham slices., (I usually use thin slices of boiled ham.), Seal in foil., Bake at 400° for 10 minutes.

title: Blackberry Jelly
directions: Sort and wash berries; remove any stems or caps., Crush berries to extract 4 cups juice., Combine juice and sugar in large saucepan and mix well., Place over high heat and stir until mixture comes to a boil., Boil hard 1 minute, stirring constantly. Add pectin and bring to a full rolling boil., Boil 1 minute, stirring constantly., Remove from heat., Skim off foam with metal spoon., Pour quickly into hot sterilized jars, leaving 1/2-inch headspace., Seal with 1/8-inch layer of paraffin., Cover with lids., Yields about 4 pints.

title: Sweet-Sour Dressing
directions: Place all in blender or processor. Blend well. Serve on fresh salad mix.

title: Strawberry Fruit Frost
directions: Combine all ingredients, except ice cubes into blender and blend., Gradually add ice cubes and keep cutting blender on and off until all cubes are crushed., Serve.

title: Snickerdoodle Cookies
directions: Mix first 3 ingredients., Add everything but the 2 tablespoons sugar and 2 teaspoons cinnamon., Form dough into balls and roll in cinnamon sugar., Place 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Ranch Style Beans
directions: Drain lima and kidney beans., Mix with pork and beans., Saute onion and ground beef until done., Cook bacon and crumble when crisp., Add beef and bacon to beans along with remaining ingredients., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Mock Chopped Liver
directions: In a heavy saucepan, cook at a simmer the lentils and chicken stock., Cool until room temperature.

title: Pineapple Dessert
directions: Bake the cake., After it cools, drain pineapple and spread it over the cake., Beat the cream cheese and 1/2 cup of milk until mixed thoroughly., Then add 2 1/2 cups milk and 2 packages of pudding., Beat for 2 minutes and spread over cake., Spread Cool Whip evenly over cake., Place in cool place until served.

title: Molasses Cookies
directions: Combine first four ingredients., Blend well., Add remaining ingredients and bake at 375° for 8 to 10 minutes., Frost with Maple Butter Glaze.

title: Peppery Cheese Bread
directions: Dissolve yeast in water., Add the sour cream, egg, sugar, salt and 2/3 cup flour; beat until smooth., Stir in enough remaining flour to form soft dough., Fold in cheese and pepper., Divide dough in half., Place in two greased pans., Cover; let rise in warm place about 1 hour., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Babci'S Pork Chops
directions: Dip chops in milk., Sprinkle with spices., Dip in bread crumbs., Fry in Crisco or Mazola oil until brown on both sides. Remove from pan; set aside., Fry several onions in pan fat until soft; remove from pan., Put meat in baking pan., Cover with onions and ketchup., Bake for 1 hour at 300°.

title: Stella'S Vegetable Soup
directions: Mix all vegetables together. Pour in stockpot. Bring to a boil, stirring often. Turn down to low heat and simmer until vegetables are done.

title: New England Clam Chowder
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Heat until piping hot., Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Quickie Fudge(4 To 5 Dozen Pieces)
directions: Blend together confectioners sugar and cocoa in an 8 x 8 x 2-inch dish., Pour in milk., Place butter on top., Heat on High for 2 minutes or until butter is melted., Stir well to mix ingredients.

title: Italian Potatoes
directions: Cut potatoes into squares., Add onion, Italian dressing and Italian seasoning to taste., Microwave for 15 minutes or oven cook until done.

title: Breakfast Pizza
directions: Cook and drain sausage., Put the 8 roll wedges in ungreased 12-inch pizza pan., Press over bottom and up sides to form crust. Seal perforations., Put on sausage and potatoes; top with cheese. Beat eggs, milk, salt and pepper., Pour into crust., Sprinkle Parmesan cheese over all., Bake in a 375° oven for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Vegetable Dip
directions: Mix all the ingredients together and use as a dip for fresh vegetables.

title: Linguine With White Clam Sauce
directions: Cook clams, garlic and parsley in butter., Add remaining ingredients and cook 10 minutes on low heat., Stir occasionally. Pour over cooked linguine noodles., Serves 2.

title: Macaroni And Cheese
directions: Cook macaroni conventionally or microwave for 7 minutes on High., Drain and set aside.

title: Strawberries
directions: Mix., Roll into balls, forming a strawberry shape., Roll in sugar tinted with red food coloring and dip stem end in green sugar tinted with green food coloring.

title: Jelly Sandwich Cookies
directions: Cream butter; gradually add sugar, creaming until light., Add yolks, salt and rind and blend., At lowest speed, add flour, alternating with cream, until well blended dough forms., Chill 1 hour or overnight.

title: Pecan Holiday Treat
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Melt butter in a 12 x 15-inch pan in oven. Add nuts and dredge in melted butter., In a separate bowl, combine granulated sugar, salt, vanilla and egg whites., Dribble mixture over nuts and mix so all nuts are coated., Put in oven for 40 minutes, stirring every 10 minutes to evenly coat nuts., Remove from oven., Put powdered sugar in Ziploc bag or large bowl with lid, then add nuts and shake to cover all the nuts., Remove and spread on cookie sheet to cool.

title: Zucchini Bread
directions: Add all ingredients together., Pour into cake pan and cook at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Tomato-Raspberry Jam
directions: Bring, tomatoes, sugar and lemon juice to boil; boil 20 minutes., With, heat, off,, stir in gelatin., Let stand 5 minutes. When cool, pour into containers and freeze.

title: Pound Cake
directions: Just beat all the ingredients, adding the eggs last, one at a time., Bake in a 300° oven for 1 hour and 25 to 30 minutes in loaf pan, greased with melted butter or margarine.

title: Grandma Annie'S Cream Pie
directions: Mix sugar and flour together, then add cream slowly until smooth., Add vanilla., Pour into unbaked pie crust., Sprinkle with cinnamon., Bake at 375° until bottom of crust begins to brown, then lower heat to 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Jessie Jones 100Th Birthday Peanut Butter Fudge
directions: Boil to soft ball stage the sugar and milk., Have ready in medium size bowl the Marshmallow Creme and peanut butter., Add sugar and milk mixture to peanut butter and Creme, mixture., When it reaches the soft ball stage, beat until creamy., Spread in jelly roll size pan., Cool and enjoy.

title: Chicken Mozzarella
directions: Heat oven to 425°., Brush bottom of rectangular pan, 13 x 9 x 2-inch, with oil., Mix Bisquick, Parmesan cheese, Italian seasoning, paprika and pepper; coat chicken., Arrange skin-sides down in pan., Bake 45 minutes., Turn chicken; divide chili sauce among breast halves., Sprinkle with Mozzarella cheese., Bake until melted, about 5 minutes longer., Sprinkle with snipped parsley if desired., Makes 6 servings.

title: Round Steak
directions: Cut round steak in small pieces., Brown meat and add sliced onion., Remove from frying pan and put in glass pan., Pour gravy over all., No need to add salt or pepper., Bake in a 350° oven for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Broccoli Bread
directions: Mix together all ingredients., Pour into greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan., Bake 20 to 30 minutes at 400°., Store leftovers in refrigerator.

title: Fireside Chili Pot
directions: Combine chili, rice, onion and green pepper in a pot., Heat over low heat, stirring occasionally, about 20 minutes or until bubbly., Sprinkle with cheese and continue heating until cheese melts, about 10 minutes.

title: Cherry Delight
directions: Mix all ingredients well. Chill and serve.

title: Barbecue Shrimp
directions: Combine all the ingredients except the shrimp., Add the shrimp and marinate for at least 1 hour., Cook over charcoal grill or bake in a 350° oven for 30 minutes., Baste often.

title: Uncooked Angel Cookies
directions: Beat together milk, cheese and vanilla., Gradually add sugar. Beat until well blended., Beat in cooled chocolate., Stir in oats, nuts and marshmallows., Mix until well blended., Shape dough into two 7-inch logs., Roll in coconut., Roll in waxed paper. Refrigerate overnight., Slice 1/2-inch thick and serve cold.

title: Millionaire Pie
directions: With hand mixer, cream cream cheese; add sugar gradually., Add pineapple., Fold in Cool Whip and pecans., Pour into graham cracker crust., Refrigerate., Makes 2 pies.

title: Hunters Stew
directions: Brown meat in hot bacon fat in Dutch oven., Add enough water to cover meat., Salt and pepper to taste. Simmer 1 hour, covered. Add bay leaf and carrots, then simmer 30 minutes more. Add onions and potatoes and simmer 20 to 30 minutes., You may have to add more water to keep ingredients covered., Add cabbage and cover; simmer 15 minutes more.

title: Strawberry Jello Cake
directions: Combine all ingredients in mixing bowl and mix at medium speed for 3 minutes., Pour into 3 (9-inch) cake pans, lined with wax paper., Bake in 350° oven for 25 to 30 minutes or until top bounces back to touch., Add icing to cake, making sure cake is cool!

title: Pineapple Dip
directions: Mix all together and serve with assorted crackers.

title: Easy Breakfast Casserole(Mix The Night Before And It Works Well!)
directions: Crumble bread into a 9 x 13 baking dish, greased., Crumble and sprinkle sausage over bread., Add cheese., Mix well eggs and milk., Add salt, mustard (if desired) and dash of pepper., Pour over mixture., Add green pepper and onion (optional)., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Blueberry-Lemon Bread
directions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees., In a large bowl, cream shortening, butter, sugar and lemon peel., Add eggs and lemon juice, mixing well., In a separate bowl, sift together 1 1/2 c. flour, baking powder and salt., Blend into creamed mixture with milk., Toss blueberries with 2 Tbsp. flour., Gently fold into batter., Pour batter into a greased and floured 9 x 5 x 3 in. loaf pan and bake for 50 to 55 minutes, testing for doneness with a toothpick., Remove from pan and cool on a wire rack., Yields:, 1 loaf of bread.

title: Lettuce Cauliflower Salad
directions: Arrange in layers in salad bowl: lettuce, cauliflower, diced onion, Miracle Whip, Parmesan cheese, sugar and crumbled bacon. Chill for 24 hours., Stir before serving., Yield: 8 to 10 servings.

title: Quick Cheese Danish
directions: Unroll dough:, pat into 10 1/2 x 8-inch rectangle on baking sheet; seal seams., Combine cheese, egg yolk and sugar; beat until smooth., Spread on dough to 1/2 inch of edges; sprinkle with cinnamon (may add 1 or more of the optional items)., Fold in thirds lengthwise, seal edges., Combine egg white and water, brush over top., Bake at 350° approximately 20 minutes., Sprinkle with confectioners sugar.

title: Rumachi(Yields 40 To 50 Pieces)
directions: You also need toothpicks to hold bacon around chestnuts.

title: Pineapple Salad
directions: Dissolve jello in 2 cups of hot water., Pour over sour cream. Blend until smooth., When partially thickened, add pineapple, including juice., Place in 1 1/2-quart mold., Chill thoroughly.

title: Shrimp Casserole
directions: Cook shrimp (according to directions)., Break bread into pieces, size of a quarter., Break cheese into bite size pieces. Arrange shrimp, bread and cheese in several layers in a greased 2-quart casserole., Pour melted margarine over., Beat eggs., Add mustard and salt to eggs, then milk., Stir and pour over casserole., Let stand at least 3 hours (or overnight, covered, in refrigerator)., Bake for 1 hour at 350°, covered., Can be made with crab, sliced smoked sausages or crumbled bacon.

title: Chili
directions: Brown ground beef and onion. Drain. Add remaining ingredients and mix together. Bring to a boil and simmer for at least 1 hour. (Can cook it in the crock-pot for 2 or 3 hours.)

title: Take It Easy Chicken
directions: Mix rice with soup and water in 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Sprinkle 1/2 package of onion soup mix., Cover rice with chicken. Top with remaining onion soup mix., Cover pan tightly with foil. Bake at 250° for 2 1/2 hours.

title: Twice Baked Potatoes
directions: Grease potatoes well and bake in a 400° oven for 45 minutes or until soft., Split lengthwise; scoop out center into mixing bowl and set shells aside., Add butter, sour cream, salt, pepper and cheese to potatoes and mash until well mixed., Mound into shells. Place on cookie sheet and bake at 350° until lightly browned on top., May be frozen after filling and baked for about 40 minutes when ready to use.

title: Grandma'S Leftover Pie Crust
directions: Using the scraps left from Mom's pie baking, roll them out to fit a cookie sheet., Carefully put the pie crust on the cookie sheet., Spread the butter on the crust., Sprinkle with sugar, cinnamon and nutmeg to taste., Bake in 400° oven for about 20 minutes.

title: Hello Dollies
directions: Combine ingredients., Bake for 30 minutes at 350° in a 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Corn Flake Chicken
directions: Crush up amount of corn flakes desired., Spread on bottom of cake pan wrapped in aluminum foil., Mix eggs and milk; dip chicken., Place in pan; cover with corn flakes., Put a little square of butter on top of each chicken piece., Cover pan with foil., Bake 1 hour at 350°.

title: Chicken Livers With Scrambled Eggs
directions: Melt butter in a large skillet., Brown livers., Push livers to one side., Add mushrooms; cook and stir until mushrooms are light brown., Mix livers and mushrooms., Sprinkle with salt and Worcestershire sauce., Reduce heat, cover tightly and simmer for 5 minutes, or until livers are done., Serve with scrambled eggs. Makes 2 to 3 servings.

title: Vanilla Ice Cream
directions: Mix together with mixer., Pour into 4-quart container and freeze according to manufacturer's instructions., If fruit is added, cut milk to about 4 1/2 cups.

title: Pork Stir-Fry With Vegetables
directions: Mix soy sauce, cornstarch, ginger and orange juice for marinade., Toss with pork and set aside while you prepare the vegetables., When all ingredients are assembled beside wok or skillet, drain the pork, reserving marinade.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Melt 1 stick margarine; pour into 9 x 12-inch baking dish. Crumble 2 packs Ritz crackers into bottom of dish; place chicken evenly into dish., Mix soup and sour cream; pour over chicken. Crumble remaining 2 packs Ritz crackers over mixture., Sprinkle 2nd stick margarine (melted) over crackers., Bake 45 minutes at 350°.

title: Pecan Cookies
directions: Mix and drop by teaspoon on greased cookie sheet., Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes or until light brown.

title: Dilly Oyster Crackers
directions: In a large bowl, combine dressing mix, dill weed and garlic powder., Add crackers and stir thoroughly., Pour oil over crackers and dry mix and stir thoroughly; allow crackers to absorb oil and seasonings., Store in airtight container., Great munchie material!

title: Macaroni And Cheese
directions: Put 1 1/2 quarts water on stove., Add salt, margarine and macaroni., Boil until macaroni begins to turn white., Cut cheese into chunks and add to macaroni., (Do not drain macaroni.), Mix milk and eggs together., Add to macaroni and cheese., Pour into a baking dish., Spread shredded cheese on top., Place into a very hot oven of 400°., Bake until brown.

title: Chicken Almondine
directions: Brown chicken in pan over medium/high until lightly browned. Remove to baking dish., Add almonds to pan and brown., Add soup and sherry to pan and stir., Pour over chicken and bake at 325 ° for 50 minutes., Do not cover., Good over bed of rice.

title: Black Bottom Cups
directions: Cream together the first 4 ingredients., Add chocolate bits and nuts; set aside., Add flour, sugar, cocoa, soda and salt to water, oil, vinegar and vanilla; mix well., Put paper baking cups in medium size muffin pans., Fill 1/3 full of chocolate batter. Drop spoonfuls of cream cheese mixture on top., Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

title: Lemon Squares
directions: Mix flour, confectioners sugar and melted butter or margarine and press in 8 x 8-inch pan., Bake for 20 minutes at 350°., Mix sugar, baking powder, flour, lemon juice and eggs., Pour over first baked mixture and return to oven., Bake for 25 minutes at 350°., When cool, sprinkle lightly with confectioners sugar and cut into squares.

title: Zucchini Squash Relish
directions: Mix zucchini, onions and salt together., Cover with water and let stand overnight., Drain and rinse under water., Add the remaining ingredients and bring to a boil., Boil 3 minutes and seal in hot, sterilized jars., Makes 6 pints.

title: Applesauce Pie
directions: Mix together all ingredients. Place mixture in pie crust. Place second crust on top. Press edges to seal. Sprinkle cinnamon sugar on top., Bake at 425° for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Seasoned Crackers Or Pretzels
directions: Preheat oven to 300°., Mix oil and seasoning., Stir well. Place crackers in cake pan., Pour mixture over crackers, stirring well., Season with garlic salt., Place in pan of crackers in oven and gently roast 20 to 30 minutes, stirring occasionally., To make pretzels, follow same directions., Store in airtight container.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
directions: Place sugar, brown sugar, butter, eggs and vanilla in bowl. Mix for about 30 seconds., Stop and scrape bowl., Mix for another 30 seconds., Sift flour, salt and baking soda together., Slowly add flour mixture to sugar mixture, stirring slowly., Increase speed; beat a little longer., Add chocolate chips., In teaspoonfuls, drop onto a greased pan about 2 inches apart., Bake at 375° until brown., Yields 3 1/2 dozen.

title: Eggplant And Seafood Casserole
directions: Peel eggplant; chop in medium pieces., Add onion, margarine and garlic., Place mixture in heavy pot., Smother mixture until done. Place buns and beaten eggs in bowl until soaked, then add to eggplant mixture and add crab meat, shrimp, green onions, parsley and seasoning., Mix well., Place in 1 to 1 1/2-quart casserole dish., Sprinkle plain bread crumbs., Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes., Serves 4 to 6.

title: Christmas Salad
directions: Mix raspberry jello by directions on box and let cool., Mix all other ingredients together., Pour into 9 x 13-inch dish and let gel until firm., Pour cooled jello over top and let gel.

title: Roast Beef Enchiladas
directions: Heat roast beef and chopped onion in a saucepan., Break up chunks of roast beef with a fork., Set aside to cool.

title: Cherry Dessert
directions: Mix crushed graham crackers, melted butter and sugar; spread in buttered 9 x 13-inch oblong pan., Whip cream stiff and add powdered sugar., Spread on cracker mixture., Lightly spread a can of cherry pie filling on top and chill.

title: Caramel Corn
directions: Mix butter or margarine, white syrup and brown sugar in a saucepan., Bring to boiling; let boil for 6 minutes, stirring all the time., Take off heat and add cream of tartar, salt, baking soda and vanilla., Stir until foamy and pour over popcorn., Spread in cookie sheet after mixing well and coating corn., Bake at 200° for 1 hour.

title: Russian Tea
directions: Boil the water, cloves and cinnamon 5 minutes., Add tea bags for 10 minutes and remove., Add the remaining ingredients.

title: Nik'S Guacamole(From Deaf Smith Country Cookbook:  Collier Books 1973)
directions: Blend all ingredients together in a blender., Chill., Serve as a salad on lettuce leaves, a dip with corn munchies or a garnish on chili., Also used in guacamole tacos., Serves 4 to 6.

title: Cranberry Salad
directions: In a large pan combine jello, pineapple, marshmallows, cream cheese and cranberry until cream cheese and marshmallows are melted., Add Milnot and nuts., Pour into bowl and chill until firm.

title: Easy Trifle
directions: Make one envelope of English custard mix according to package directions., Low-fat milk or skim condensed milk can be used to reduce the fat content., Cover and cool., Spread angel food cake with raspberry jam and cut into small pieces., Place 1/3 of cake into a glass bowl and sprinkle with sherry wine., Pour 1/3 of custard on top of cake., Continue to layer cake and custard., Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 4 hours or overnight., Prior to serving, cover with whipped cream or Cool Whip., May be garnished with sliced almonds or fresh raspberries., This recipe serves about 8 to 10 persons and can easily be doubled.

title: Scalloped Potatoes And Ham
directions: Add potatoes and onions to medium saucepan., Cover with water and bring to a boil; cook until tender., Melt butter in a medium saucepan; remove from heat., Add flour, pepper and salt, stirring until smooth., Stir in milk., Return to heat., Boil until mixture thickens., Layer mixture of potatoes, ham and onions in a greased casserole dish, topping each layer with sauce., Bake, uncovered, for 35 minutes., Serves 8.

title: Chess Pie
directions: Mix all ingredients well., Pour into pie crust and bake at 325° to 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Taco Pie(Microwave)
directions: Crush taco chips in paper bag, using rolling pin to lightly go over chips 2 or 3 times., Place in pie plate., Press refried beans against taco chips, using a wooden spoon, to form a shell., Set aside., Brown meat in a mixing bowl., Microwave 8 to 10 minutes on High, stirring occasionally., Add taco seasoning mix and recommended amount of water according to package directions. Microwave 5 minutes on High until mixture is at a boil., Reduce setting to Medium for 3 to 5 minutes or thick., Fill crust with filling., Micro for 3 to 5 minutes on High., Top with lettuce, tomato, cheese and sauce.

title: Corn Bread
directions: Mix dry ingredients well in a mixing bowl and add eggs and milk., Pout into a well-greased baking pan., I put Pam in my pan first., Bake at 475° until golden brown.

title: Angel Biscuits
directions: Sift together the dry ingredients., Set aside., Put yeast into 1/4 cup of warm water, stir, then let stand., Cut shortening into dry ingredients., Add yeast and buttermilk., Stir well., Pour onto floured board., Knead., Roll out and cut into biscuits., Bake at 425°.

title: Cream Of Broccoli Soup(Microwave)
directions: Microwave frozen broccoli on High for 3 to 4 minutes., Let stand., In 3-quart casserole, microwave butter and onion for 1 1/2 to 2 minutes., Stir in flour and seasoning; add milk and broth. Stir until smooth., Cover and microwave on High 8 to 10 minutes, stirring 2 to 3 times., Squeeze excess moisture out of broccoli and add to mixture., Cover and microwave 3 to 4 minutes., Stir once until broccoli is tender and soup is thick and bubbly., Let stand for 3 minutes., Depending on microwave, soup may have to be cooked longer to thicken.

title: Corn Casserole
directions: Combine all ingredients into a 9 x 13-inch baking dish., Mix well. Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Vegetable Soup
directions: Cook potatoes and onions and drain. Cook macaroni and drain. Scramble hamburger meat and drain, then mix all of the ingredients in a large pan and cook for about 15 minutes on medium heat. Season to taste.

title: Peach Stuff
directions: Drain peaches, reserving 1/2 cup of syrup., Combine Jell-O, boiling water, sugar, salt and syrup., Boil until bubbles., Add peaches and cream cheese., Add almond extract., Mix well and chill until partly set., Add Dream Whip and place in 9-inch square pan. Chill.

title: Strawberry-Rhubarb Pie
directions: Roll a little more than half of pastry about 1/8-inch thick and line a 9-inch pie pan., Mix sugar, cornstarch and salt; sprinkle a small amount in pastry-lined pan., Combine remaining sugar mixture with rhubarb and berries., Put in pie pan and dot with butter. Roll remaining pastry 1/8-inch thick., Put on pie; trim edges and flute., Cut a few slits for steam to escape., Bake in preheated hot oven at 425° for 40 to 50 minutes.

title: Taco Soup
directions: Cook beef and onion in a Dutch oven until meat is browned; drain., Add tomatoes and remaining ingredients; cover, reduce heat and simmer 1, hour, stirring occasionally., Yields 13 1/2 cups.

title: Turtles
directions: Place 5 pieces of pecans on a greased cookie sheet., Top each with a caramel., Bake at 350° for 4 to 6 minutes., Press each caramel with a buttered spatula., Melt some chocolate chips and frost each turtle., Cool and eat.

title: Tomato Pot Roast
directions: Sprinkle roast with garlic salt, salt and pepper., Roll in flour., Brown on all sides in hot fat., Place in a Dutch oven; add onion soup mix and water., Cook 1 1/2 hours or longer, covered, on simmer or low, adding water as needed., Then add potatoes, carrots, tomato sauce and Worcestershire sauce., Cook slowly for another hour., Serves 6.

title: Marinated Green Beans
directions: Combine sour cream and Italian dressing., Mix thoroughly., Add beans, tomato and onions., Mix well., Chill 3 to 4 hours.

title: Turkey Salad With Honey Cream Dressing
directions: Spoon yogurt into a yogurt cheese funnel or a strainer lined with cheesecloth., Set over a glass and allow to drain about 10 minutes., Cook pasta in a pot of boiling water 10 minutes or just tender., Drain and rinse with cold water., Place in a large bowl. Add turkey, celery, oranges, water chestnuts and parsley., Toss well., Transfer yogurt to a small bowl., Whisk in the honey, orange juice, mustard, pepper and poppy seed., Pour over the salad and toss., Line plates with kale., Top with the salad.

title: Vegetable Casserole
directions: Mix Veg-All, cheese, mayonnaise, celery, onion and mushroom soup together., Place in casserole dish and cover with cracker crumbs., Drizzle butter over cracker crumbs and bake 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Vanilla Wafer Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 300°., Cream together the margarine and sugar. Add 6 eggs, one at a time, mixing well after each. Add the crushed vanilla wafers. Fold in the coconut and nuts. Pour into an ungreased tube pan. Bake for 1 hour and 15 minutes. Cool and frost.

title: Shrimp Slaw
directions: Combine all ingredients; mix well., Cover and place in refrigerator for 1 hour before serving.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
directions: Mix peanut butter, vanilla, salt and butter together until well blended., Beat eggs slightly., Add syrup and sugar., Stir until well blended., Add egg mixture to peanut butter mixture. Stir well., Pour into 9-inch pie shell., Bake at 450° for 10 minutes., Reduce heat to 350° and bake 30 to 35 minutes longer. Refrigerate if not eaten shortly.

title: Taco Dip
directions: Brown hamburger and onion in frying pan and drain., Add tomato sauce, refried beans, taco seasoning and chili powder., Put in pie dish and top with sour cream and cheese., Bake at 350° for 15 minutes or until hot., Serve with tortilla chips while hot.

title: Cornbread Dressing (Stuffing)
directions: If your broth has a lot of fat, use 4 sticks of margarine. If you buy your broth in cans, use 6 sticks., Cook onions and celery in butter about 8 to 10 minutes in microwave., Mix all ingredients well., If more broth is needed, add water to make dressing like cornbread., Bake at 350° for 1 to 1 1/2 hours., Do not overbake., This makes a very large roasting pan full.

title: Frosted Delights
directions: Sift together dry ingredients., Set aside., Cream together shortening and sugar., Blend in eggs., Add dry ingredients. Spread in 9 x 13-inch greased pan.

title: Edith'S Salmon-Macaroni Salad
directions: Combine salmon, green pepper, green onion, salad dressing, Worcestershire sauce, seasoned pepper and lemon juice in a large bowl., Toss gently to mix., Add hot cooked macaroni., Toss gently again to coat ingredients with dressing.

title: Orange Bread
directions: In a bowl, beat eggs until light., Stir in milk., Stir in dry ingredients., Stir in orange peel., Pour into greased loaf pan and allow to stand for 30 minutes., Bake for 45 to 60 minutes at 350°. Do not slice for several hours., It is especially good toasted and buttered or with cream cheese.

title: Oatmeal Wafers
directions: Heat oven to 375°., Lightly grease 2 baking sheets; set aside. In a medium bowl mix first 5 ingredients; set aside., In a small saucepan or skillet melt margarine over moderate heat., Add margarine, maple syrup and vanilla to dry ingredients; mix well. Drop dough by tablespoonfuls onto baking sheets, spacing cookies about 2 inches apart., Pat each cookie down lightly to form 1/2 inch thick rounds., Bake for 8 minutes or until lightly browned. Remove cookies from oven and let harden on baking sheets for 2 minutes before transferring to wire racks to cool.

title: No Peek Chicken
directions: Lightly grease casserole., Mix first 6 ingredients and place chicken on top., Sprinkle chicken with onion soup., Seal with foil and bake at 350° for 2 1/2 hours., Don't peek!, Serves 5 to 6.

title: Banana Bread
directions: Mix sugar, margarine and eggs until fluffy., Sift flour, baking powder and baking soda together., Add 1 cup mashed bananas and stir ingredients together until smooth., Pour into two 7-1/2 x 3-1/2 inch bread pans., Bake at 350 degrees for 35 - 40 minutes.

title: Scalloped Bacon And Eggs
directions: Cook onion in butter until tender. Blend in flour. Add milk. Cook, stirring constantly until mixture thickens. Add cheese. Stir until melted. Place a layer of egg slices in 8-inch square dish. Cover with half the cheese sauce, half the potato chips and half the bacon. Repeat layers. Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes. Serves 4.

title: Easy Carrot Cake
directions: Mix flour, sugar, baking soda, cinnamon and salt with a fork in a, 9-inch square pan., Add carrots, oil, eggs and vanilla., Mix briskly with fork until thoroughly blended., Stir in pineapple, coconut and walnuts. Bake in a 350° oven for 40 to 45 minutes until done. Place the pan on a rack to cool., Spread with frosting.

title: Bramborova Polevka(Potato Soup)
directions: Cut, and peel potatoes into bite-sized pieces., Cook in salted water, until, potatoes, are done., Mix cream and flour together. Add, to, cooked, potatoes, and, cook again for five minutes. Serve this soup with homemade bread., This recipe is from relatives in Czechoslovakia.

title: Old Fashioned Candied Yams
directions: Peel and cut yams in quarters., Sprinkle sugar, nutmeg and butter., Cover and simmer over medium heat until liquid forms a syrup., Remove from heat and serve.

title: Texas Hash
directions: In large skillet, cook meat and drain grease., Add onion and green pepper; saute for 5 minutes., Add all other ingredients. Cook until rice is heated through on simmer approximately 20 to 25 minutes, stirring often.

title: White Enchiladas
directions: Saute chicken, green chiles and onion in oil., Add sour cream and cream of chicken soup., Grease dish., Layer Doritos, meat mixture and cheese., Bake at 375° for 1/2 hour.

title: Strawberry Cream Cheese Cake
directions: Mix, cream cheese and Eagle Brand milk; add lemon juice and whip, for 4 minutes or until thick., Add 1 teaspoon vanilla., Set in, refrigerator, for, 2 hours., Fold in fillings on top.

title: Boiled Chocolate Icing
directions: Combine cocoa, sugar and salt., Add milk and bring to a boil, stirring often., Cook to 232° or until a small amount forms a soft ball in cold water., Remove from heat and drop in butter., Cool to lukewarm., Add vanilla and beat until mixture thickens slightly. Spread on cake.

title: Cheese Biscuit
directions: Cream, cheese, and, margarine;	add, flour, and pepper. Roll into small balls., Flatten on cookie sheet., Bake at 325° for 20 minutes., Press pecan half in center before cooling.

title: Cherry Blink Cookies
directions: Heat oven to 375°., Mix flour, baking powder, soda, salt, sugar, shortening, egg, milk and vanilla., Stir in raisins and nuts., Drop by teaspoonfuls into cereal; roll until coated. Place balls 2 inches apart on greased baking sheet., Top each with a piece of cherry., Bake for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Spinach Salad And Dressing
directions: Toss with dressing and serve.

title: Barbecue Sauce
directions: Combine all ingredients and simmer for 10 minutes.

title: Portuguese Sweet Bread (Pao Doce)(Makes 5 Large Round Loaves)
directions: Bring milk to a boil, dissolve yeast in warm water., In a large bowl, sift flour, salt, and sugar., Add butter and mix well. Add the beaten eggs, lemon extract, and yeast and mix well. Knead dough for 20 minutes, gradually adding milk as needed. Knead until no dough sticks to your hands., Let rise in a pan until it doubles in size., Push down, then shape into 5 round balls and place each in a greased pan., Let rise until double in size., Brush tops with whole beaten egg., Bake at 350° for one hour.

title: Beef Stew
directions: In a large dutch over or stainless steel pan, brown Beef until browned on all sides., Then pour Water over meat., Add Onions, Mrs. Dash and Salt., Cook on medium heat for one half hour., Cut all vegies to bite size and add to above ingredients., Cook one more hour on low.

title: Pumpkin Muffins
directions: Combine butter, brown sugar and molasses and beat until creamy., Add pumpkin and egg., Mix flour and seasonings together. Add dry mixture to pumpkin mixture and beat until smooth., Grease muffin pans or use muffin cups., Fill 2/3 full., Bake at 400° approximately 15 minutes or until toothpick is clean.

title: Barbecued Chipped Ham For Sandwiches
directions: Simmer first 7 ingredients 1 hour., Add ham and heat well. Can be kept hot in crock-pot and frozen also.

title: Layer Cookies
directions: Melt, margarine, in a 9 x 13-inch pan., Sprinkle crumbs in pan., Add, each, ingredients in a layer, pouring condensed milk on last., Bake for 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Blueberry Salad
directions: Dissolve 1 package of gelatin in 2 cups boiling water., Add raspberry flavoring., Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan; chill until firm., Soften unflavored gelatin in 1/2 cup cold water., Heat cream and sugar in pot until hot, but not boiling., Remove from heat. Add vanilla and cream cheese; blend until smooth., Cool., Pour over first layer., Chill until firm., Dissolve remaining gelatin in 1 cup boiling water., Stir in blueberries and flavoring., Cool., Pour over cream cheese layer; chill until firm.

title: Candi'S Chicken Recipe
directions: In 9 x 13-inch greased pan, lay the dried beef., Wrap each breast in bacon and place in pan., Mix sour cream and soup; pour on top., Bake at 275° for 3 hours (time and temperature may be adjusted.)

title: Mexican Bean Dip
directions: In medium saucepan, heat oil., Saute bell pepper and onion for 2 minutes., Lower heat and add paprika and taco seasoning., Stir well., Add can of beans and mash with potato masher., Add 1/3 cup water., Cover and simmer for 8 minutes on low heat., Add picante sauce and serve in shallow round bowl., Top with both cheeses and heat in microwave for 3 minutes., Top with sour cream and serve with chips.

title: Microwave Apple Crunch
directions: Combine apples, 1/3 cup of brown sugar and lemon juice., Toss gently., Place in 8-inch square baking dish; set aside., Combine remaining sugar and flour in medium bowl., Cut in butter until mixture resembles a coarse meal., Stir in oats and pecans., Spoon mixture over apples., Microwave, uncovered, at High for 12 to 13 minutes, rotating a half turn at 6 minutes., Spoon in dessert dishes; top with ice cream., Yields 6 to 8 servings., Quick and easy.

title: Nana'S Pepper Stuffing
directions: In large skillet saute	chopped, up onions, peppers and tomatoes in bacon grease., Cook until soft and well done., Add ham bits, cook until, most, of	liquid	is gone, 30 minutes or more. Add bread one, slice, at, a, time, until, thickness, is reached, stirring constantly, as, it, will, stick, now., Fill parboiled peppers that, have	been, placed in an 8-inch square pan and top with, any kind of cheese., Place in preheated oven (400°) until cheese melts.

title: Crumb Crust Peach Cobbler
directions: In a baking dish, mix together the peaches, cornstarch, cinnamon and lemon or vanilla flavoring., In a separate dish, mix the cake mix and margarine together., Make sure margarine is at room temperature., With your fingers, mix well together until the mixture looks like crumbs., Spread the crumbs on top of the peaches evenly., Bake in oven at 350° until cobbler browns evenly (approximately 30 minutes).

title: Blueberry Coffee Cake
directions: Mix butter, sugar and coconut., Set aside., Prepare blueberry mix as directed on package., Fold in well-drained pineapple., Pour into 9-inch square pan., Spoon coconut mixture over batter., Bake at 400° for 25 to 30 minutes., Serve warm.

title: Jane'S Fruit Salad
directions: Cut, into bite size pieces all ingredients., Use all the juice of, the, pineapple and 1/2 of the cherry juice., Put all ingredients, in, a large bowl and mix well., Let salad marinate in refrigerator, several, hours, overnight if possible, before serving.

title: Orange-Zucchini Bread
directions: Mix eggs, sugar and oil., Add zucchini and orange., Mix thoroughly., Add flour, salt, baking soda, baking powder, cinnamon and vanilla., Mix well., Add nuts if desired.

title: Diabetic Applesauce Cookies
directions: Sift together flour, salt, spices and soda., Mix shortening, sweetener and eggs; beat until light and fluffy., Add flour and applesauce alternately, mixing well after each addition., Fold in raisins and oatmeal., Drop by level tablespoons onto greased cookie sheet 1 inch apart., Bake at 375° for 20 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Grated Sweet Potato Pudding
directions: Beat eggs until light., Add brown sugar, butter and other ingredients., Blend well., Put in well-greased baking dish., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes; stir., Cook 15 minutes longer.

title: Ole Tyme Cinnamon Cookies
directions: Cream butter and sugar; add egg., Stir in buttermilk and vanilla., Now add all dry ingredients except 1/4 cup sugar and 1 teaspoon cinnamon., Chill., Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls 2 inches apart on greased cookie sheet., Sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon. Bake 8 to 10 minutes at 400°.

title: Cherry Yum-Yum
directions: In one bowl mix Dream Whip by package until it peaks., Add cream cheese and mix well., In second bowl, melt butter and pour in graham cracker crumbs., Take 1/2 of mixture and make crust in bottom of casserole dish (9 x 12-inch)., Then take 1/2 of Dream Whip mixture and layer over crumbs., Add pie filling, the last of Dream Whip mixture, then on the top the last of the graham cracker crumbs., Chill and serve.

title: Pineapple Casserole
directions: Mix flour and sugar; sprinkle over pineapple that has been spread over bottom of 1-quart casserole dish., Sprinkle cheese over this., Next, sprinkle layer of Ritz crackers., Melt margarine or butter and pour over top., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Quick Skillet
directions: Brown beef and onion in shortening in an electric skillet. Drain off excess grease., Stir in hot water, tomatoes, catsup, salt, sugar and pepper., Add macaroni., Mix well., Bring mixture to a boil., Reduce heat to low., Simmer, uncovered, 15 or 20 minutes. Stir occasionally or until macaroni is tender.

title: Spinach And Artichoke Bake
directions: Cook and drain spinach., Add soup, bread and egg., Season with salt, pepper and garlic to taste., Grease large casserole dish and line bottom with artichoke hearts., Place layer of spinach mixture on top, then sprinkle with a thick layer of Parmesan cheese. Continue to alternate spinach and cheese layers., Sprinkle top with cheese and dot with butter., Bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Potatoes With Vegetarian Chili
directions: Preheat oven to 400°., Scrub potatoes and prick them with fork., Bake for 1 hour or until tender., Keep warm., Coat a large saucepan with olive oil., Place over medium heat, add mushrooms, onion, green pepper and garlic; saute 5 minutes or until tender. Stir in next 6 ingredients; cook over low heat until thoroughly heated, stirring occasionally., Split tops of potatoes lengthwise and fluff pulp with a fork., Arrange in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish., Spoon vegetable chili mixture evenly over potatoes; top with cheese., Bake 5 to 7 minutes or until cheese melts., Garnish with green onion., Serves 8.

title: Cheese Strata
directions: About 2 hours before serving, remove crusts from bread. Arrange 6 slices in greased 12 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish., Cover with cheese, then rest of bread., Beat eggs., Blend in milk and rest of ingredients., Pour over bread., Refrigerate 1 hour.

title: Almond Candy
directions: Melt butter in a large heavy saucepan., Add sugar, syrup and water., Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally to a hard crack stage (300°)., Quickly stir in nuts., Pour in a well-greased pan, 13 x 9-inches., Cool thoroughly in refrigerator., Turn out onto wax paper., Spread top with half of the Hershey bar, melted. Return to refrigerator to set chocolate., Invert candy and spread other side with other half of chocolate bar., Break into pieces when chocolate is set., Store in refrigerator.

title: Diabetic Chocolate Chip Cookies
directions: Sift dry ingredients together., Cream margarine; add sweetener, vanilla and egg., Blend well., Add flour mixture and beat well., Stir in chocolate chips., Drop by teaspoon onto lightly greased cookie sheet., Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Salad
directions: Mix dry jello into cheese., Add oranges and pineapple; add baby marshmallows and nuts, if desired., Refrigerate.

title: Wine-Marinated Lamb Chops
directions: Place chops in a plastic bag set in a deep bowl., For marinade, in a small mixing bowl, combine wine, onion, oil, rosemary, basil, oregano, thyme, mustard and pepper., Pour marinade over chops., Close bag., Marinate in refrigerator for 6 to 24 hours, turning occasionally., Drain chops, discarding marinade., Preheat gas grill., Adjust heat for direct cooking. Place lamb chops on grill rack over medium heat., Cover and grill for 10 to 16 minutes or until desired doneness; turn once., Yield: 4 servings.

title: Mounds Cake
directions: Blend milk with creme of coconut., While cake is hot from the oven, poke holes with a toothpick over whole cake., Slowly pour mixture over cake., Let cool completely, then spread Cool Whip on cake top and sides.

title: Meat Casserole
directions: Place cubed meat in bottom of buttered casserole., Pour mushroom soup over meat., Rinse cans out with water and add to meat., Then add 1 pkg onion soup mix and cooking sherry., Bake in 375° oven until almost done., The last 1/2 hour of cooking add mushrooms and sour cream., Serve on potatoes, rice or noodles.

title: Buttermilk Biscuits
directions: Mix dry ingredients; mix well., Cut shortening in slowly., Add buttermilk., Mix well., Roll on floured board; knead and roll out about 1/2 to 3/4-inch., Cut to desired size., Place in greased iron skillet., Bake at 425° until golden brown.

title: Nut'S Cake
directions: Grind the nuts and mix them with the egg yolks, sugar, cocoa, lemon rind and baking soda., Then fold into the mixture the whipped egg whites., Bake in nonstick pan for 1 hour on medium heat., When ready, sprinkle the cake with confectioners sugar.

title: Peach Congealed Salad
directions: Cream the cream cheese and jello together., Add water., Drain fruit and add., Fold in Cool Whip. Sprinkle with nuts (optional).

title: Bean Dip
directions: In bottom of a large shallow baking dish, spread bean dip, then chilies, then chopped pimentos., Top with shredded cheeses and sprinkle chopped black olives on top., Bake at 325° until heated and cheese browns, about 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Pumpkin Bread
directions: Put all ingredients (dry) in a big bowl., Make a well., Add oil, eggs, water and pumpkin., Mix well., If using nuts, add last. Divide into 2 loaf pans., Bake at 350° for about 1 hour., Let stand 10 minutes before removing from pans.

title: German Apple Cake
directions: Pour 1/2 batter into greased and floured bundt pan. Mix 2 teaspoons cinnamon, 4 tablespoons brown sugar, 1/2 cup chopped nuts together and sprinkle on top of batter. Pour rest of batter over this., Bake 350 degrees for 1 hour. Test for doneness. Cool 15 minutes. Mix some powdered sugar, cinnamon and 1/2 teaspoon margarine in pan, melt, and pour on top of cake as glaze.

title: Coconut-Cream Cheese Pound Cake
directions: Preheat oven to, 325°.	Grease and flour a 10-inch tube pan. Cream, the	butter, shortening and cream cheese together in large bowl., Gradually, add sugar, beating at medium speed, until light and fluffy., Stir in coconut flavoring and vanilla extract., Add the eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition. Combine flour,, salt, and, baking powder and add to the butter. Stir, just until blended., Fold in coconut., Pour the batter into prepared, tube, pan., Bake	for an hour and 15 minutes or until tester, comes, out	clean.	Remove	cake and allow to cool.

title: Spinach Salad With Sweet Parsley Dressing
directions: In a screw-top jar combine first 8 ingredients., Cover and shake well., Chill for at least an hour.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Cook and drain broccoli., In large bowl, mix broccoli, sour cream and dried onion soup., Spread in 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Sprinkle Cheddar cheese over broccoli., Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Molasses Cookies
directions: Mix together thoroughly the margarine, brown sugar, egg and molasses., Sift together and stir in flour, soda, salt, cinnamon and ginger., Chill dough., Roll out 1/4-inch thick., Cut into desired shapes., Place 1-inch apart on greased baking sheet., Bake until when touched lightly with finger, no imprint remains., Bake at 375° for 8 to 10 minutes., Yield:, about 5 dozen 2 1/2-inch cookies.

title: Dreamy Spaghetti Casserole
directions: Cook spaghetti and drain. Saute beef in 1 tablespoon butter until brown., Add tomato sauce, salt and pepper., Remove from heat., In a separate bowl, combine cottage cheese, cream cheese, sour cream, onions and green pepper., In a 2-quart casserole, spread 1/2 the spaghetti. Cover with cheese mixture and remainder of spaghetti., Pour the 2 tablespoons melted butter over the spaghetti and spread tomato meat sauce on top., This is best if it is made the day before and allowed to chill overnight., If you serve it the same day it is made, it should be chilled for 20 minutes in the refrigerator., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Boil broccoli and onions until tender., Salt and pepper. Drain., Mix broccoli and cheese, put in a casserole dish., Melt margarine in bowl in microwave and put Ritz crackers in margarine. Mix well., Top casserole with cracker mix., Bake 1 hour at 350°.

title: Squash Casserole
directions: Cook squash in small amount of water until tender; drain well and mash., Combine soup, sour cream, oregano, pimento, onion and butter., Blend well; add squash, stirring gently., Lightly grease 2-quart casserole dish., Alternate squash mixture and cheese (cut into strips)., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until lightly brown.

title: Chocolate Torte
directions: Mix flour, margarine and chopped nuts and bake 20 minutes at 350° to a nice brown crust., Spread thin in an 11 x 14-inch sheet cake pan, on bottom of pan only.

title: Chex Party Mix
directions: Preheat oven to 250°., Bake 1 hour, stirring once every 15 minutes., Spread on paper towels to cool., Store in tight sealed container.

title: Mom'S Peach Cobbler
directions: Melt butter in a 9 x 13-inch pan., Put peaches in melted butter., Mix flour, sugar and baking powder and add milk., Pour over peaches., Bake until brown on top, 35 to 40 minutes at 375°. May use 1 quart of any fruit with juice.

title: Cherry Cheese Pie
directions: Beat cheese until fluffy., Add milk and blend thoroughly. Stir in lemon juice and vanilla., Pour into crust., Chill 3 hours. Top with pie filling, then slice and serve.

title: Grilled Ham And Egg Salad Sandwiches
directions: Slice bread horizontally into 5 equal layers., Spread bottom layer with horseradish; top with roast beef., Place next slice of bread over beef; spread with mustard on top with ham or turkey and Swiss cheese., Add next slice of bread and top with American cheese and onion., Cover with remaining bread., Combine butter, sesame seeds and onion salt., Brush over top and sides of loaf. Place on baking sheet; loosely tent with heavy duty aluminum foil. Bake at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes or until heated through. Carefully slice into 8 wedges., Makes 8 servings.

title: Summer Sausage
directions: Mix all ingredients well., Refrigerate in covered bowl for 3 days., Form into rolls and place on rack and drip pan., Bake at 250° for 10 hours., Makes five 1 pound rolls.

title: One Crust Cherry Pie
directions: In bowl, mix pie filling, lemon juice and orange rind., Spoon over pie crust., Beat eggs, sugar, vanilla and almond flavoring until thick (about 5 minutes)., Stir in sour cream. Pour over cherries., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until crust is golden brown., Serve chilled.

title: Heavenly Banana-Nut Bars
directions: Cream sugar and shortening together, a little at a time., Add egg yolks and mix well., Add mashed banana., Sift flour with soda and salt., Add dry ingredients alternately with sour cream to creamed mixture., Mix thoroughly., Add vanilla; fold in well beaten egg whites and chopped nuts., Pour mixture into an 8 x 13-inch oblong pan that has been greased and floured lightly on the bottom., Bake in preheated 350° oven for 45 minutes to an hour., Cool; cut in strips and roll in powdered sugar.

title: Cheese Ball
directions: Soften cheese; mix with deviled ham., Add chopped olives. Make into ball., Roll ball in nuts., Place in freezer until hard.

title: Date Nut Ritz Cracker Cookies
directions: Put in double boiler and cook slowly, it burns over burner. Lay Ritz crackers (Aldi's cheaper), salty side down, on ungreased cookie sheet with sides to it, they'll slip off., Place 1 teaspoon date mixture on each cracker., Bake in slow oven at 325° for 5 minutes only; set out to cool.

title: Dieter'S Stir-Fry
directions: Cut fish fillets into bite-size pieces., (If using frozen fish, let it thaw slightly.), Cut broccoli stems into 1/4-inch slices, reserve florets., In a wok or large skillet, heat oil just to smoking point., Add sliced broccoli, onion, celery, garlic and oregano; stir-fry over high heat for 5 minutes., Add fish pieces, salt, pepper and lemon juice., Bring to a boil., Add reserved broccoli florets., Reduce heat and simmer covered 5 to 10 minutes or until fish flakes easily with fork., Serve immediately., Makes 4 servings.

title: Vegetable Sandwich Spread
directions: Combine carrots, green pepper, cucumber, celery and onion in bowl., Mix well., Stir in cream cheese., Add enough mayonnaise to make of spreading consistency., Stir in salt., Add dash of horseradish, if desired.

title: Marinated Carrots
directions: Drain carrots., Mix the remaining ingredients together., Mix well and pour over drained carrots and refrigerate 24 hours before serving.

title: Icebox Fruit Cake
directions: Roll vanilla wafers to crumbs., Mix the coconut, raisins, nuts and cherries., Add milk., Mix well and pour in pan., Set in refrigerator.

title: Vegetable Beef And Biscuit Casserole
directions: Brown and drain ground beef. Stir in soups, water, vegetables and seasonings. Cook until heated through. Spoon into baking dish and top with cheese and biscuits. Bake 10 minutes or until biscuits are brown.

title: Susan'S Brownies
directions: Put butter and brown sugar in pan over low heat and stir until melted., Let cool, then stir in eggs and then dry ingredients, vanilla and nuts., Mix well., Pour into greased and floured pan. Bake 20 to 25 minutes at 350°.

title: Lace Cookies* * * * *
directions: Shrimp, Mousse is another first apartment menu from the same gal who was from Northern Wisconsin and what a cook! The broiled peach halves are from England., They love their mincemeat and this is really different., I have used canned peaches, but they weren't as good as the fresh.

title: Golden Harvest Pound Cake
directions: Grease and flour 12 cup Bundt pan., Blend all ingredients in large bowl at low speed for 4 minutes and medium speed for 2 minutes., Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes., Cool for 10 minutes and remove from pan., When completely cooled, sprinkle with confectioners sugar and/or serve with whipped cream.

title: Microwave Shish Kabobs
directions: Cut steak into cubes., Mix ingredients for marinade (next 7 ingredients)., Pour over meat and let stand 1 to 2 hours., Cut onions and green peppers into pieces., On bamboo skewers, thread tomatoes, onions, green peppers, mushrooms and meat, alternating. Cook 3 minutes for each 6 skewers., Turn skewers 1/2 way through cooking and baste with sauce., Don't overcook.

title: Shrimp Dip
directions: Mash shrimp with fork. Combine all other ingredients. Refrigerate for at least 2 hours.

title: Shepherd'S Pie
directions: Cook up hamburger meat., Then cook potatoes on stove in water. After potatoes are done, mash., Grate your cheese., Layer with hamburger meat on bottom, then can of tomatoes, then layer of grated cheese and layer of whipped potatoes on top., Put in oven for 20 to 25 minutes at 325°.

title: Chicken And Mushrooms
directions: Melt butter in skillet over medium heat., Add chicken and cook 10 minutes., Turn chicken; add mushrooms and shallots., Sprinkle with salt and pepper., Cook 10 minutes or until tender., Transfer chicken to platter., Sprinkle cheese over chicken; cover and let stand for 5 minutes or until cheese melts.

title: Fat Free Strawberry Dream
directions: Blend Cool Whip, yogurt and strawberries by hand. Pour into crust, chill 2 hours. Then slice and enjoy.

title: Peanut Butter Chocolate Chip Cookies
directions: Beat eggs, water, margarine, peanut butter and half of the cake mix (dry) until smooth., Stir in remaining cake mix and chocolate chips., Drop by rounded teaspoonful onto ungreased cookie sheet., Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Omelette Casserole
directions: Melt 2 tablespoons butter, add potatoes, mushrooms and peppers (optional)., Cook until done, slightly browned., Mix eggs and milk, blend with beater; set aside., Melt 2 tablespoons butter, add egg mixture, stir frequently, cook until eggs are fully cooked., (There should be a watery liquid remaining with eggs.) Add potatoes and mushrooms, ham, scallions, salt, pepper and cheese.

title: Vegetables Mornay
directions: Cook vegetables as directed on package; drain., Place in large bowl., Stir in mushrooms., Meanwhile, melt margarine in small saucepan over medium heat., Stir in flour, salt, nutmeg and pepper., Cook until smooth and bubbly, stirring constantly. Remove from heat., Gradually stir in milk., Cook over medium heat until thickened, stirring constantly., Remove from heat; stir in Parmesan cheese., Pour over vegetables; stir until well coated. Pour into serving dish., Sprinkle with bread crumbs., Makes 12 (1/2 cup) servings.

title: Chicken Fricassee
directions: In large frying pan, put oil, chicken and prosciutto. Sprinkle with salt and pepper., Brown chicken thoroughly over low heat, turning frequently., When brown, add chopped garlic and wine., Cook until wine has evaporated, then add tomatoes., Add a little stock or water if necessary., Increase heat and cook about 20 minutes., The chicken should be well done by this time., The gravy should be thick, dark and not too abundant., Serves 4.

title: Easy Cheese Ball
directions: Mix together cream cheese, package of vegetable dip and 1/2 cup pecans., Form in shape of a ball., Roll mixture on top of 1 cup pecans until covered.

title: Kraut Salad
directions: Mix and let stand several hours in refrigerator before serving.

title: No Bake Banana Pudding
directions: Beat pudding mix and milk with mixer until firm (2 to 4 minutes)., Fold in Eagle Brand milk and half of Cool Whip., Begin to layer ingredients, starting with vanilla wafers., Spread remaining Cool Whip on top and sprinkle with cookie crumbs. Chill., Makes large dish.

title: Vegetable And Beef Soup
directions: Brown beef and drain off fat., Add all other ingredients and simmer over low heat for 1 1/2 hours., Serve over corn chips or rice.

title: Beef-Cabbage Casserole
directions: Brown chuck in shortening., Add onion and celery; cook 5 minutes., Add tomatoes, salt and pepper., Place 1/2 in casserole; cover with 1/2 of cabbage., Repeat layers., Top with bread crumbs. Bake at 375° for 45 minutes.

title: Best Ever Broccoli Casserole
directions: Beat eggs, thawed broccoli, flour, cottage cheese, margarine and American cheese., Pour into buttered 1 1/2-quart casserole. Sprinkle top with Parmesan cheese., Bake at 350° for one hour or until golden brown., Recipe may be doubled and baked in a 9 x 13-inch pan., May be mixed ahead of time and refrigerated until ready to bake.

title: Mrs. Hummel'S Cheesecake
directions: Mix ingredients; spread in pie pan., Bake 5 minutes at 325°. Set aside (put back into shape if necessary).

title: Cabbage Rolls
directions: Partially cook cabbage leaves in boiling salt water about 2 minutes; remove from water and drain., Combine next 6 ingredients; divide meat mixture into 12 parts and wrap each portion in a cabbage leaf., Secure with toothpick., Place in baking dish., Mix tomato soup with water and pour over cabbage leaves., Cover with foil., Bake, covered, at 350° for 45 minutes., Uncover and bake 15 minutes.

title: Chili Pie
directions: Layer 2 cups of corn chips, onion, 1/2 cup cheese and chili in a 1-quart casserole., Top with remaining corn chips., Bake in a preheated oven at 375° for about 20 minutes., Top with remaining cheese and continue baking 5 minutes., Garnish with sour cream and ripe olives (optional)., Makes 3 to 4 servings.

title: Quick Pepper Steak
directions: Saut onions and bell pepper in oil. Add meat and fry lightly. Sprinkle flour over mixture and stir to coat. Add tomatoes and mushrooms. Cover and simmer for about 30 minutes.

title: Lemon Carrots
directions: Cook carrots until crisp tender; drain., In saucepan, melt margarine., Add brown sugar and melt., Add lemon juice and blend well., Add carrots back to sauce and toss to coat carrots.

title: Spicy Spinach And Artichoke Dip
directions: Melt butter in a large saucepan or skillet over medium heat. Add onion and cook until soft, about 5 minutes., Stir in spinach, artichokes, cream cheese, sour cream, 3/4 cup Monterey Jack cheese, 3/4 cup Parmesan cheese, TABASCO Pepper Sauce and salt., Stir until well blended and heated through., Pour mixture into a 1/2 quart casserole dish and top with remaining Monterey Jack and Parmesan cheese., Bake in a 350 oven until cheese starts to brown, about 10 minutes., Serve with corn chips or crackers., Makes 4 cups.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
directions: Peel and chop apples; set aside., Pour oil into a large mixing bowl., Add sugar and eggs and mix well., Sift flour with salt, soda and baking powder., Gradually add flour mixture to creamed mixture., Stir in apples and nuts., Mix well.

title: Jiffy Fudge
directions: Bring to full boil on medium heat, marshmallows, sugar, milk, butter and salt, stirring constantly., While boiling, add chocolate chips until melted., Add nuts, then vanilla., Pour into square pan, buttered., Chill until firm., Makes 2 1/2 pounds.

title: Veg-All Casserole
directions: Combine Veg-All, mayonnaise, onion and cheese in casserole dish., Mix crackers and margarine together and sprinkle on top of vegetable mixture., Bake at 300° for 35 minutes., Yields 8 servings.

title: Pepperoni Casserole
directions: Cook macaroni., Stir in sauce and cheeses., Place pepperoni on top and bake at 400° for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Angel Cake
directions: Boil the first 3 ingredients until transparent, then cool. Mix the egg whites, sugar, vanilla or almond extract and salt. Beat until very stiff., Add mixtures together. Beat both together with a mixer until very stiff., Pour into a graham cracker crust.

title: Shrimp-Rice Casserole
directions: Prepare the rice mix according to package directions., Combine rice and all other ingredients., Spoon into lightly greased 2 1/2-quart casserole., Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes or until bubbly., Yield:, 6 servings.

title: Chicken Crunch
directions: Mix all ingredients together and bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Apple Dessert Crunch
directions: Mix together oats, brown sugar, flour and butter., Combine apples, cinnamon and sugar., Arrange in a well buttered 8 x 11-inch pan., Sprinkle the oats mixture over the apple mixture. Bake at 350° for approximately 30 minutes., Serve warm with whipped cream or ice cream.

title: Thanksgiving Cranberry Cobbler
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Cut peach slices in half lengthwise. Combine peach slices and cranberry sauce in ungreased 9-inch square pan., Knead swirl packet from mix for 10 seconds., Cut off one end of packet., Squeeze contents evenly over fruit.

title: Green Bean Casserole
