directions: Boil, bone and cut chicken into pieces., Saute onion and bell pepper in oleo., Heat soups, chili seasoning, Ro-Tel tomatoes and chicken broth., Add sauteed onion and bell pepper., Grease with oleo large pan, small roaster or 9 x 13 1/2 x 2-inch Pyrex., Soak tortillas in small amount of broth., Tear into sixths or eighths. Put layer of tortillas, layer of chicken, soup mix, grated cheese and repeat another time with cheese on top., Bake at 300° for 1 hour., Cover casserole with foil.

title: Asparagus Wrapped In Prosciutto
directions: Wrap each spear of asparagus with a slice of Prosciutto from stem to just below the tip., Divide among four plates and set aside.

title: Quiche Lorraine
directions: Preheat oven to 425°. Prepare pastry. Sprinkle bacon, cheese and onion in pastry-lined pan. Beat eggs slightly and beat in remaining ingredients. Pour in pie pan. Bake 15 minutes. Reduce oven temperature to 300° and bake 30 minutes longer until knife inserted 1-inch from edge comes out clean. Let stand 10 minutes before cutting.

title: Broccoli-Rice Dish
directions: Saute onion and celery in butter., Cook and drain broccoli. Cook rice., Combine broccoli with soup, cheese, rice, onion and celery., Pour into casserole dish., Sprinkle with paprika., Bake at 375° for 15 to 20, minutes.

title: Cheese Stuffed Rice Balls
directions: In a bowl, lightly beat 2 eggs. Stir in the rice, butter, Parmesan cheese, parsley, salt and pepper. Cover and refrigerate for 20 minutes. Roll into 1 1/2-inch balls. Press Mozzarella cube into each; reshape balls.

title: Pineapple Rum Salad
directions: Beat cheese with sugar and rum until smooth., Fold in 2 cups Cool Whip, pineapple with syrup and 2 cups coconut., Spread in an 8-inch layer pan lined with Saran Wrap., Spread with remaining Cool Whip and sprinkle coconut on top and sides., Put cherries and pineapple tidbits on top., Freeze until firm, about 2 hours.

title: Jello Triple Treat
directions: Mix together very well., Spread it evenly at the bottom of a rectangular crystal dish or baking pan., Bake at 350° for 15 minutes or until light brown., Set aside to cool.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Cook broccoli as directed., Add margarine and crumbled Velveeta cheese., Stir until melted., Put in baking dish., Sprinkle with crumbled crackers., Pour melted 1/2 stick butter on top.

title: Hot Beef Dip
directions: Mix above ingredients, folding in sour cream last., Place in baking dish and bake at 350 degrees for 20 minutes., Serve with crackers.

title: Sourdough Starter
directions: Stir yeast, water, milk and sugar in 2 1/2-quart crock or other nonmetallic bowl until yeast is dissolved., Stir in flour until a smooth batter forms., Let stand loosely covered in a warm place for 3 to 5 days., Stir down occasionally., Store loosely covered in refrigerator.

title: Cream Cheese Pound Cake
directions: Have oleo, cream cheese and eggs at room temperature., Cream oleo and cream cheese until blended., Add sugar gradually; cream for about 5 minutes., Add eggs one at a time and mix well., Fold in flour gradually and stir until well blended., Add vanilla; blend well., Grease and flour bottom of pan., Spoon batter into pan., Put into cold oven; bake for 15 minutes at 350°; then reduce to 275° and bake for 1 hour and 45 minutes.

title: Six Can Casserole
directions: Mix all together in casserole and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Angel Food Cake
directions: Step 1:, In a large bowl, let egg whites, warm to room temperature (about 1 hour)., Sift flour with 3/4 cup sugar., Resift 2 more times., Preheat oven to 375°.

title: Teriyaki Chicken
directions: Mix ingredients before adding chicken., Toss chicken to coat well and marinate 4 hours in refrigerator, turning several times. Reserve marinade. Broil, bake or barbecue until near done. Replace chicken in marinade for an additional 30 minutes. Finish by cooking each piece more each side.

title: Chili Beans
directions: Combine all ingredients and cook in slow cooker for 1 to 2 hours.

title: Bernice Park'S Chicken Pie
directions: Place chicken in 9 x 13-inch baking dish., Pour broth over chicken and spread can of chicken soup over chicken and broth. Sprinkle with salt and pepper., Mix melted butter, flour and milk together and pour over evenly., Bake at 350° for 40 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Basque Vegetable Stew(Serves 8)
directions: Melt butter in a Dutch oven and saute onions and garlic until onions, are, translucent, and soft., Add potato slices; cover, and simmer,, stirring	often until potatoes are almost tender, about 20 minutes., If necessary, add more butter., Add tomatoes, carrots, celery, salt and pepper; cover and continue cooking, on low, heat until carrots are tender, about 20 minutes.

title: Crab Meat Hors D'Oeuvres
directions: Add mayonnaise and crab meat to beaten egg white., Sprinkle with lemon juice and mix thoroughly., Put 1 tablespoon of mix on each Triscuit cracker., Sprinkle with paprika., Broil until lightly brown (watch carefully)., Serve hot.

title: Mama Ethel'S Homemade Ice Cream
directions: Mix flour, sugar and salt together., Combine egg yolks and milk., Thoroughly mix in cold water., Mix thoroughly with flour mixture., Cook over medium low heat until slightly thickened., (Be sure to cook mixture in a grease-free pot.), When thickened, strain mixture through a very fine strainer., Add vanilla., Cool to lukewarm., Freeze in a hand-cranked or electric ice cream freezer. Do not allow salt used to freeze the ice cream get inside the freezer canister., When frozen, pack well.

title: Baked Salad Potatoes
directions: Boil red salad potatoes in salted water until almost tender. Cool., Peel potatoes., Dip in melted butter, then in bread crumbs. Place in shallow baking dish., Bake until golden brown, turning once in 350° oven.

title: Chocolate Chippers
directions: Cream shortening, sugars, egg and vanilla until light and fluffy., Sift together dry ingredients; stir into creamed mixture and blend well., Add chocolate., Drop from teaspoon 2 inches apart on a greased cookie sheet., Bake in moderate oven (375°) for 10 to 12 minutes., Remove from sheet immediately., Makes 3 dozen.

title: Southern Grits
directions: Bring water to a boil in a large pan., Add salt, margarine, grits, eggs, Tabasco sauce and cheese., Stir well., Bake in a greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish., Sprinkle on paprika before baking., Bake at 250° for 1 hour.

title: Dirt (And Sand)
directions: Mix all ingredients except the cookies together in a large mixing bowl., Beat on low and gradually increase speed., Beat on high speed for several minutes until the mixture is consistent. Line a bowl, pie shell or flowerpot with crushed cookies., Pour the mixture into the bowl so that the cookies surround the mixture., Chill for an hour., Serve cold.

title: Creamy Macaroni And Cheese
directions: Melt butter; add flour	to, smooth paste., Add milk and cook until thick., Add, grated, cheese, to cooked macaroni and sprinkle with more cheese and, a, dash of paprika., Bake until cheese melts.

title: Cheesecake Brownies
directions: Make brownie mix as directed on back of box., In a separate bowl, mix the cream cheese, sugar, egg and chocolate chips., Pour on top of brownie mix., Swirl., Bake as directed on brownie box. This can be made as cupcakes, also.

title: Chocolate Pie
directions: Mix dry ingredients. Then mix liquid ingredients., Gradually add liquid to dry ingredients and cook over medium, heat until thick, stirring constantly., Pour into 2 baked pie shells and top with meringue or Cool Whip.

title: Green Beans With Fresh Tomatoes
directions: Cook green peppers and onion in hot oil in skillet over medium heat until soft, 3 minutes., Add tomatoes, oregano and salt. Simmer 10 minutes., Trim beans. Cut into 1-inch lengths., Cook until tender, about 8 to 10 minutes; drain., Stir sauce into beans., Cook just to heat through., Serves 4., Contains 120 calories, 3 g protein, 5 g fat and 280 mg sodium per serving.

title: Marinated Mushrooms
directions: Place all ingredients, except mushrooms and wine, in a large pot., Bring to boil., Add mushrooms and wine; boil 5 minutes. Place in hot jars; cover with the marinated juice., Will keep in fridge for about 2 weeks.

title: Spritz Butter Cookies
directions: Stir together flour and baking powder., In large mixing bowl, beat butter and sugar until soft., Add egg and beat until fluffy. Add vanilla and almond extract; beat well., Gradually add flour mixture and beat until well mixed.

title: Beef And Broccoli
directions: Slice meat in strips., Quickly cook beef in hot oil until meat loses its redness., Remove meat and place in a shallow bowl. Sprinkle with 2 tablespoons soy sauce and garlic powder., Prepare brown gravy mix according to package directions and add to pan juices with remaining soy sauce., Add meat and juices to gravy. Cook slowly for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally., Cook broccoli until just a fraction underdone., Drain., Add to meat and gravy with bean sprouts and water chestnuts., Stir gently; heat through. Serve over rice.

title: Water Chestnuts
directions: Cut water chestnuts in half. Cut bacon strips into thirds. Wrap a piece of bacon around each half water chestnut and secure with toothpick. Make a sauce of remaining ingredients and place all together in a 9 x 13 baking dish. Bake at 350° for 45 to 60 minutes until bacon is crisp.

title: Pineapple Cheese Ball
directions: Beat cheese until smooth., Add pineapple, 1 1/2 cups pecans, onion, bell pepper, salt and sauces., Mix well and chill until workable., Form into large ball or log., Roll in remaining pecans. Can be made ahead of time and frozen until ready to use.

title: Italian Salad Dressing
directions: Mix mustard, salt and garlic thoroughly., Add vinegar; stir. Add oil; stir vigorously until all ingredients are well blended.

title: Cold Oven Pound Cake
directions: Cream margarine and Crisco with sugar until fluffy., Add eggs, one at a time, beating after each., Add dry ingredients alternately with milk and flavorings., Beat until smooth., Pour into a greased, floured tube pan., Place in a cold oven and turn to 325°., Putting batter into a cold oven is what makes the smooth texture of this cake., If you desire a coarser texture, preheat the oven. Flavoring can also be changed to your own taste., Bake at 325° for 1 1/2 hours or until straw inserted in cake comes out clean., Cool 5 minutes and turn out on wire rack to finish cooling., Serves 16.

title: Broccoli With Garlic And Lemon
directions: Cut off broccoli tops and divide them into florets., Peel and slice stems., Mince garlic., Cook all the broccoli in a large pot of boiling water until tender, about 8 minutes, and drain., Just before serving, heat oil with the garlic over medium heat until fragrant, about 2 minutes., Add broccoli and toss until heated through., Add the lemon juice and season with salt and pepper. Sprinkle with cheese.

title: Hash Brown Potato Casserole
directions: Crumble potatoes into a greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish., Mix butter, cheese, soup and salt; heat in microwave or on top of stove until melted and combined., Remove from heat and stir in sour cream., Smooth mixture over potatoes., Cover with corn flakes and drizzle remaining butter., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes. Serves 10 to 15.

title: Sour Cream Potatoes (Dort)
directions: Peel and boil potatoes until tender., Mix all ingredients together and place in 10 x 13-inch baking dish., Bake at 400° for 40 to 60 minutes.

title: Apple Cream Tart
directions: In a large bowl, stir together flour, 3 tablespoons sugar and salt., Cut in butter or margarine until consistency of cornmeal., Pack into bottom and 1-inch up the sides of a 9-inch spring-form pan or 9-inch square pan., Press crumbs firmly.

title: Baked Frosting Spice Cake
directions: Cream shortening and sugar together until light and fluffy. Beat egg and egg yolk together and add to mixture, blending to a smooth cream., Add vanilla extract., Sift flour and spices together and add alternately with milk., Mix to smooth batter. Pour into paper lined cake pan, 8 x 8 x 2-inch and spread batter with topping.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Cook broccoli according to package directions and drain. Combine chicken soup, mayonnaise, cheese and eggs; fold into broccoli., Cover with cracker crumbs., Dot with butter., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes., Makes 8 servings.

title: Cheese Dip
directions: Brown ground beef and drain the grease., In crock-pot (or the like) combine ground beef, Velveeta and Ro-Tel tomatoes (do not drain liquid from the can tomatoes)., Heat, stirring occasionally until cheese is completely melted and dip is warm.	Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Filet Mignon Dinner Salad
directions: Marinate filets for about 30 minutes before grilling. Saute sliced onion and mushroom caps (sliced into strips) in olive oil until tender. Dress spring salad mix (lightly) with balsamic dressing and place on dinner plates. Add slices of Brie and sun-dried tomatoes. Grill filet until done to your taste. Place filet on salad bed and top with mushrooms and onions.

title: Cheese Chili With Rice
directions: Soak red beans overnight in cold water., In a large saucepan, combine tomatoes, kidney beans, tomato sauce, and tomato paste. Bring to a boil., Brown chuck in frying pan., Drain grease., Add to tomato mixture along with both cheeses., Bring to boil., Add rice and water., Simmer 1 1/2 hours.

title: Crown Jewel Dessert
directions: Prepare the first 3 flavors of Jell-O separately, using 1 cup boiling water and 1/2 cup cold water for each., Pour each flavor into an 8-inch square pan., Chill until firm or overnight.

title: Peaches And Cream Cobbler
directions: Heat oven to 400°., In a large bowl, stir together all ingredients, except peaches., Stir in peaches., Pour into a 13 x 9-inch baking pan.

title: Chicken Soup
directions: Bake chicken for 2 hours at 350 degrees., While chicken is baking, chop celery and carrots into bite size pieces., Chop onion finely. Fill large kettle with water, add chopped veggies, along with corn., Bring to boil., Add approx. 10 bouillon cubes., Add salt and pepper to taste., Let simmer to cook veggies.

title: Raspberry Whip
directions: Beat raspberries (or strawberries) into egg white-sugar mixture., Serve over angel food or sponge cake.

title: Lemonade Punch
directions: Dissolve Jell-O according to box directions., Cool., Combine lemonade and water; mix well., Pour into punch bowl., Add Jell-O mixture; stir well., Add ice cubes., Garnish with lemon slices.

title: Pork Chops And Dressing
directions: Brush both sides of chops with Kitchen Bouquet; set aside. Combine croutons, onion, butter and egg mixed with 1/4 cup water. Spread in bottom of 8 x 12-inch glass baking dish., Place chops on dressing., Cover with foil., Bake at 350° for 1 hour., Yields 4 servings.

title: Cheesy Noodle Casserole
directions: While noodles are still hot, combine all ingredients except 1/4 cup cheddar cheese and bread crumbs. Pour into well greased 2 qt. casserole dish. Sprinkle with the remaining cheese and bread crumbs. Dust with paprika. Bake at 400 degrees for 25-30 minutes or until hot and bubbly.

title: Hamburger Casserole
directions: Layer the potatoes, onion, carrots, celery and peas. Salt and pepper as you go., Add the meat to the top layer., Mix pea juice with the soup. Add a little water if needed., Pour over the top. Bake 1 1/2 hours at 350°, covered.

title: Pan Cabbage Rolls
directions: Cook rice and onion soup together. Set aside. Cool., Mix meat with spices and eggs. Add rice mixture., Chop or shred cabbage. Layer cabbage., Spread meat mixture., Pour some tomato soup and put cabbage on top., Put tomatoes and soup on top., You may use sauerkraut also. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Gingered Brussels Sprouts
directions: Cook sprouts until tender., Drain., Stir in butter and ginger. Serve.

title: Spice Cookies
directions: Mix this all together., Roll in little balls in 4 tablespoons sugar and 2 teaspoons cinnamon, then bake in oven.

title: Hamburger Brown Gravy Dish
directions: Brown hamburger and onion, then drain., Add cooked noodles, thickened gravy and mushrooms., Serve warm.

title: Chocolate Chip Cream Cheese Brownies
directions: Soften 1 roll of cookies and press into bottom of a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan., Mix the cream cheese, sugar and egg; spread onto the pressed cookies., Cut the second roll into cookie-size slices and place on top of the cream cheese mixture., Bake in a 350° oven for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Porcupines
directions: Mix uncooked rice and meat with the seasonings., Shape into small balls., Place in deep baking dish and cover with the tomato puree., (A bay leaf, a small amount of onion, salt and pepper may be needed to season the tomato puree.) Bake at 350° for 60 to 80 minutes., Makes approximately 6 servings.

title: Rich Butter Cookies
directions: Cream butter; add sugar gradually, creaming until fluffy., Add unbeaten egg and vanilla; beat well., Sift together dry ingredients., Blend with creamed mixture., Drop by teaspoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet., Bake at 375° for 8 minutes.

title: Grandma'S Tea Cakes
directions: Cream the shortening and sugar., Add eggs and extract and beat well., Add remaining ingredients; mix well., Chill for 1 to 2 hours., Shape into 1 1/4-inch balls and place 2 1/2 inches apart on a lightly greased baking sheet., Bake at 375° for 11 to 13 minutes., Do not overbake., Cool 1 minute on the pan before removing to a wire rack., Yields 5 1/2 dozen.

title: Stuffed Sweet Banana Peppers
directions: Wet bread with water., Squeeze out excess water., Break into small pieces in bowl., Grind onion, parsley flakes and garlic together in a blender with a little water., Strain., Saute in a skillet with small amount of butter and olive oil., Add to pieces of bread., Add egg, cheese, salt and pepper., Take seeds out of peppers., Fill with stuffing., Rub peppers with oil., Rub bottom of pan with oil., Cook on lowest heat., Turn often., Cook 1 hour.

title: Diet Cabbage Soup
directions: Chop all vegetables; cover with water in a large pot., Boil for 30 minutes., Lower heat; simmer until vegetables are tender. Use garlic salt or bouillon for seasoning., This soup may be eaten any time you feel hungry., You may eat as much as you want; will not add calories.

title: Mississippi Mud Bars
directions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees., Line a 9 inch square pan with foil; grease foil., Beat sugar and butter in large bowl until blended and smooth., Beat in egg and vanilla until light., Blend in baking soda and salt., Add flour, mixing until well blended., Stir in 3/4 cup each semisweet and white chocolate chips and nuts. Spread dough in prepared pan., Bake 23 to 25 minutes or until center feels firm., DO NOT OVER BAKE.

title: Corn Casserole
directions: Combine eggs and corn., Heat butter. Add spices and flour and cook about 1 minute., Combine with corn mixture., Pour half the mixture into greased 1-quart casserole., Cover with the cheese and add rest of corn mixture., Bake at 350° for 1 hour., Serves 4.

title: Diabetic Tapioca Pudding
directions: Separate eggs., Beat egg whites until stiff but not dry., Mix slightly beaten egg yolks with milk in saucepan., Add tapioca and salt., Cook over low heat or in a double boiler, stirring constantly, until mixture comes to a boil., Cool., Add sweetener and vanilla., Fold in beaten egg whites., Makes 4 (1/2-cup) servings.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
directions: Cook chicken breast and cut into bite size pieces., Add mixed veggies and cream of chicken soup. Pour into a casserole dish.

title: Country Ribs And Beans
directions: Chop onion. Cut up bacon and fry until crisp., Add onion, crisp bacon, 2 tablespoons bacon drippings, sugar, mustard, catsup and garlic salt to beans in a 3-quart casserole., Cover mixture with country-style pork ribs. Cover and bake 3 to 4 hours at 350°. Makes 6 servings.

title: Potato Chip Cookies
directions: Cream margarine and sugar., Add vanilla, flour and potato chips., Mix well., Drop onto ungreased cookie sheet., Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Egg Nog Candy
directions: Combine egg nog, sugar, corn syrup and salt in a Dutch oven; cook over low heat, stirring frequently, until mixture reaches soft ball stage (234°)., Cool to lukewarm., Add butter and beat until mixture is no longer shiny (about 5 minutes)., Stir in fruit or raisins and pecans., Spread in a buttered 8-inch square pan. Cool and cut into squares., Yields 25 squares.

title: Fettucini Broccoli
directions: Cook and drain noodles., Meanwhile, in hot oil, saute garlic and broccoli for 5 minutes., Add broth, basil, parsley, Parmesan cheese, cottage cheese and pepper., Stir over low heat until blended (about 2 minutes)., Toss broccoli mixture with noodles. Serves 6 to 8 people.

title: Dilled Tomatoes
directions: Wash and stem tomatoes., (Be sure they have not started to turn.), Place dill in bottom of 1-quart jar., Fill jar to about 1 1/2 inches from top of jar with uncut tomatoes., To each jar, add garlic and another head of dill.

title: Hush Puppies
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Mix, well and drop by teaspoonfuls into hot oil.

title: Braised Beef
directions: Brown meat, then add other ingredients in a microwave safe bowl., Microwave for 6 to 7 minutes., Serve over mashed potatoes.

title: No Fry Pecan Meatballs
directions: Combine and form into balls., Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan with oil., Put meatballs in pan., May pour tomato sauce on top of some or all, depending on your taste., Bake at 325° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Cayman Chicken Salad
directions: In large bowl, combine chicken, fruit and celery; mix well. Cover; chill., In small bowl, combine remaining ingredients. Cover; chill., Just before serving, combine chicken mixture, dressing and nuts.

title: Watergate Salad
directions: Mix together pineapple and pistachio pudding mix., Add marshmallows, Cool Whip and walnuts., Let set overnight in refrigerator.

title: Apricot Jello Salad
directions: Bring pineapple juice and jello (no water) to a boil., Cool, then add milk and Cool Whip., Fold together very well., Pour into bowl and jell.

title: Russian Tea
directions: Mix together thoroughly., Add 2 teaspoonfuls to one cup of boiling water., Makes great gift!

title: Chicken Tetrazzini
directions: Fry bacon and crumble., Add onion and green pepper., Cook and brown slightly., Add cheese, pimento, peas and chicken., Heat thoroughly, using chicken broth if more liquid is needed., Add 2 cups cooked macaroni., Put in casserole., Bake 20 minutes at 350°. Garnish with tomato slices and olives.

title: Hash Brown Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients together except margarine., Melt and pour over top of other ingredients in casserole dish., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes until bubbly and slightly brown.

title: One Pound Sloppy Joes
directions: Brown hamburger and drain off fat. Add remaining ingredients and simmer for about 1 hour. Serve on hamburger buns.

title: Chicken And Dressing
directions: *If fryer is used instead of hen, add butter as required.

title: Zucchini Casserole
directions: Layer into 2 or 3 layers the zucchini, tomato slices, onion rings, pepper rings., Dot with salt, pepper and margarine., Grate generously on top with cheddar cheese., Cover and bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Mock Cornish Hen
directions: Line a 9 x 13-inch baking dish with dried beef., Wrap each chicken breast with slice of beef and place in casserole dish. Mix together soups in a small bowl and pour over chicken., Bake in a preheated 225° oven for 4 to 5 hours, watching last hour to prevent overcooking., Yields 10 servings., Preparation time is 5 hours.

title: Pasta Primavera
directions: Cook pasta according to directions, drain well., Meanwhile, for sauce, in a medium saucepan, combine water, mushrooms, frozen beans, green pepper, garlic, 1/4 teaspoon salt and 1/4 teaspoon pepper., Bring to boiling, reduce heat., Cover and simmer for 4 minutes or until vegetables are tender., Do not drain., Stir together milk and cornstarch; stir into vegetable mixture., Cook and stir over medium heat until thickened and bubbly., Cook and stir for 1 minute more., Stir in cheese until melted., To serve, pour over pasta., Garnish with tomato wedges., Makes 4 servings.

title: Coconut Pound Cake
directions: Separate egg whites and yolks., Beat egg whites until stiff. Fold in last., Cream sugar, shortening and egg yolk until a lemon color., Put flavoring in milk., Add flour, milk and everything else., Fold in egg whites last., Use a greased tube pan (do not flour it)., Bake 2 hours at 300°., Cake should be brown and crusty on top., Allow cake to cool.

title: Pineapple Casserole
directions: Drain pineapple; reserve 3 Tbsp juice., Combine flour, sugar and juice., Add cheese and pineapple., Spoon mixture into casserole dish., Combine melted butter and Ritz crackers. Sprinkle on top of pineapple-cheese mixture., Bake 30 minutes at 350° or till top is brown.

title: Party Dogs
directions: Stir together jam and chili sauce, then combine with hot dogs which have been sliced into 1/2-inch pieces., Heat thoroughly until warm., Spear with toothpick and enjoy.

title: Chocolate Chip Summer Pie
directions: In large bowl, combine 1/4 cup water and sweetened condensed milk., Add pudding mix., Combine thoroughly., Fold in 1/2 cup sour cream; mix., Add Cool Whip again; mix., When mixed, pour into prepared crust., Cover and refrigerate 4 hours or until set.

title: Oyster Stew
directions: In a large saucepan, combine milk and half and half; heat slowly until just beginning to bubble., In a medium saucepan, melt butter., Add oysters and onion., Cook over low heat for 8 to 10 minutes or until edges of oysters begin to curl., Stir oyster mixture, parsley, salt, pepper and Worcestershire sauce into hot milk., Heat gently, stirring frequently., Be careful and do not boil., Serve with oyster crackers.

title: Baked Macaroni And Cheese
directions: Put macaroni in greased casserole dish., Pour tomato juice on top., Put thick slices of cheese on top of juice., Bake 55 minutes at 350°.

title: Slaw
directions: Shred cabbage; slice pepper and onion very thin., Mix with 3/4 cup sugar., Bring to a full boil last 5 remaining ingredients, stirring, over high heat., Pour over slaw mixture., Keeps well; better the second day.

title: Toffee Candy(Candy)
directions: Slowly melt butter with sugar, corn syrup and water in a heavy 2 qt saucepan., Cook and stir constantly over moderate heat until mixture reaches 290° on a candy thermometer., Add 1 cup sliced almonds, stirring constantly., Pour in buttered pan and flatten out thin (1/8 inch)., When cool, melt 4 ounces of chocolate and spread on candy., Sprinkle with almonds., When this hardens turn candy over and melt the other 4 ounces of chocolate and spread on candy, sprinkle the remaining almonds on candy. When this hardens break into pieces.

title: Chicken Pasta Dish
directions: Saute onion and mushrooms in small amount of oil and margarine (medium heat)., Stir-fry chicken pieces in Pam-sprayed pan with thyme., Cook spaghetti., Cook broccoli.

title: Cracker Pie Casserole
directions: Place ingredients in casserole dish in layer as listed., Make as many layers as needed. Beat 2 eggs. Mix eggs with enough milk to cover entire casserole. Bake at 350° until brown and milk mix is absorbed.

title: Lemon Chicken
directions: Dip chicken in egg, then bread crumbs and brown., Place in baking dish., Add lemon juice, wine, broth and oregano to pan used to brown chicken., Simmer, loosening bits stuck to pan, for 5 minutes., Pour over chicken., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes., (Can be assembled early in the day and then baked immediately prior to serving.), Serves 6 to 8.

title: Cookie'S Fruit Cocktail Salad
directions: Mix all cans together with vanilla pudding mix., Refrigerate. Add one chopped banana an hour or so before serving.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
directions: Combine sugar, oil, vanilla, eggs, lemon juice and salt in mixing bowl., Beat well., Mix flour and soda;, add to first mixture., Beat well., Add, apples, and pecans; mix well., Bake in tube pan 1 1/2 hours at 325°.

title: Chicken And Rice Casserole
directions: Brown chicken in oil., Remove from skillet., Saute vegetables in skillet until tender., Add rice., Pour into 9 x 9-inch casserole dish., Season., Place chicken on top of rice and vegetables., Pour chicken bouillon over chicken and rice., Cover. Bake for about 1 hour., Pork chops may be used instead of chicken.

title: Chicken Continental
directions: Roll chicken in flour, brown in butter., Stir soup, seasonings and water into chicken drippings., Cook and stir to a boil., Spread Minute Rice (right from box) in 1 1/2-quart shallow casserole dish. Pour all but 1/3 cup soup mixture over rice., Stir to moisten., Top with chicken and rest of soup mix., Bake, covered at 375° for 30 minutes or until chicken is tender., Makes 4 servings.

title: Grammies Crawford Woodcock
directions: Melt butter in top of double boiler., Add flour, salt and pepper; cook until smooth., Add milk, asparagus and some of the liquid until smooth., Cut eggs lengthwise into quarters and add to mixture., Add pimentos., Serve hot on thin crackers.

title: Joel'S Favorite Tomato Aspic
directions: Make jello with 1 cup boiling water., Add 1 cup Hunt's tomato sauce instead of cold water., Add vinegar, salt and pepper, diced vegetables, olives and shrimp., Pour into mold and let set in refrigerator until firm., Unmold onto plate., Garnish with hard-cooked eggs.

title: Peg'S Barbecued Baked Beans
directions: Mix bacon, ground chuck and sauteed onion. Blend in catsup, vinegar and brown sugar (*or use 1/4 cup brown sugar and 1/4 cup molasses). Stir in remaining ingredients and mix well. Bake 45 to 55 minutes in a 350° oven or 2 to 3 hours in a crock-pot. Serves several.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Blend soups together in separate bowl.	Add cut up carrots, celery and onions.	Put over first layer of chicken in casserole. Sprinkle with Pinch of Herbs, Lawry's, generously.	Pour half of soup mixture over the chicken and veggies.	Do another layer of chicken and veggies and soups., Sprinkle generously with Pinch of Herbs., Julienne the celery and carrots; cut onion in thin round slices., Cover; bake approximately 1 1/2 hours at 350°., Sauce plentiful for over noodles or mashed potatoes.

title: World War 1 Cake
directions: Put first 6 ingredients in a saucepan., Bring to a boil and cook for 3 minutes., Add shortening., Cool., Add soda that was dissolved in small amount hot water., Add flour and baking powder and stir until well blended., Pour into greased tube pan and bake at 325° for 1 hour.

title: Apple Dumpling Bake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Unroll crescent rolls and separate dough into 16 triangles., Cut each apple into eight wedges., Wrap a crescent dough triangle around each apple wedge., Place in a greased 13 x 9 x 2 inch baking dish., In a bowl, combine sugar and butter; sprinkle over rolls., Slowly pour the soda around the rolls (do not stir)., Sprinkle with cinnamon., Bake, uncovered, for 35 to 40 minutes or until golden brown., Serve warm with ice cream. Yield:, 16 dumplings.

title: Tourtiere
directions: Mix pork, ground beef, onions, cloves, celery salt, salt and pepper together., Cook for 1 1/2 hours over low heat., Pour into unbaked pie shell; top with crust., Cut steam vents with a knife. Bake at 375° for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Rice Pie
directions: Cook rice as directed., In bowl, beat together butter, sugar and eggs., Add salt, vanilla and milk., Stir cooled rice into mixture., Pour into pie crust., Bake at 400° for 15 minutes., Turn oven down to 350°., Bake 1 hour longer.

title: Almond Fudge Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Chop almonds and toast at 350° for 3 to 5 minutes., Sprinkle 1/2 cup on bottom of well-greased 10-inch tube pan (chiffon pan)., Set aside remaining almonds and chocolate chips., Measure remaining ingredients into a mixing bowl; blend, then beat at medium speed for 4 minutes., Stir in chips and almonds., Pour into pan and bake at 350° for 70 minutes, or until cake begins to pull away from sides of pan., Cool in pan for 15 minutes., Remove and continue cooling on rack.

title: Meat Loaf
directions: Mix ground beef, onion soup mix, milk and bread crumbs., Shape into loaf., Mix honey and catsup and add to top of loaf., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Double Fudge Soft Pan Brownies
directions: Heat oven to 325°., Stir together flour, soda and salt; set aside., In medium saucepan combine sugar, butter and water., Cook over low heat and stir constantly., Bring to boil., Remove from heat., Immediately add 1 cup chocolate chips., Stir until melted. Add eggs and vanilla until well blended., Gradually add flour mix, blending well., Stir in remaining chocolate chips and nuts., Pour into 9-inch square baking pan., Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until pulls away from sides of pan., Makes 1 1/2 dozen.

title: Popcorn Balls
directions: Keep popcorn hot in 300° oven., Stir and cook sugar, corn syrup, water, butter and salt until sugar is dissolved., Continue cooking, without stirring, to 270° or until syrup forms a brittle ball in cold water., Add vanilla., Pour syrup slowly over popped corn, mixing well to coat every kernel., Grease hands with butter before shaping in balls., Makes 12 medium-size balls.

title: Angel Food Pineapple Cake
directions: Mix cake mix with pineapple. Pour into bundt pan. Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes or until brown.

title: Pickled Eggs
directions: Hard-boil eggs and peel., Combine all other ingredients; bring to boil and pour over eggs., Cool and refrigerate for 10 days in tightly closed quart jar before serving., Keep refrigerated.

title: Chicken Parmesana
directions: Put chicken in pan (for oven)., Cover with cheese, ham, and spaghetti sauce and sprinkle with oregano., Bake 30 to 45 minutes at 325°., Serve over pasta., Serve with salad and bread.

title: Stuffed Potatoes
directions: Bake potatoes., Cut potatoes in half; scoop out inside of potatoes in mixing bowl., Add onion, bacon, margarine, milk, salt and pepper., Mix well., Spoon mixture into potato shells and top with cheese., Put back in oven and melt cheese., Makes 5 servings.

title: No Knead Yeast Bread
directions: Dissolve yeast in warm water., Add remaining ingredients, one by one., Mix by hand until moist., Seal in bowl and let rise until double its size., Divide into 4 parts., Put into pans and let rise., Bake at 350°., Makes 4 loaves or you can use the dough for cinnamon rolls., Just add cinnamon, sugar and butter to taste.

title: Broccoli 'N Cheddar Dip
directions: In 1-quart casserole dish, combine vegetable recipe soup mix, sour cream, broccoli and 3/4 cup cheese until smooth., Top with remaining 1/4 cup cheese., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Slush Punch
directions: Mix gelatin, sugar and boiling water together until dissolved. Add pineapple juice, then enough water to make 1 gallon., Freeze overnight., Just before serving, put in punch bowl and add lemon-lime soda., Stir until slushy.

title: Stuffed Zucchini
directions: Cut zucchini in half lengthwise and seed., Mix corn, bread crumbs, onion, salt, pepper, and pimentos and stuff zucchini halves, dot with butter., Place in baking pan with 2 tablespoons water, tent, and bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Fruit Salad Dessert
directions: Cut in bananas right before serving., Add dry mix to fruits in their own juices.

title: Breakfast Egg Casserole
directions: Combine and pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan., Refrigerate overnight or 12 hours., Bake at 350°, for 35 minutes.

title: Pork Chops, Apples, And Sauerkraut
directions: Brown pork chops in non-stick pan; set aside, omit this step if in a hurry. Place in a slow cooker half of onion rings, garlic flakes, sauerkraut, apple juice, caraway seed, salt and pepper. Add pork chops. Place the remaining half of ingredients on top of the chops. Top with apple slices. Cover slow cooker and cook on low 6 to 8 hours or on high for 4 hours.

title: Butter Brickle Dessert
directions: Break cake into bite size pieces., Mix cake pieces, 3/4 bag of Bits 'O Brickle and Cool Whip in a large bowl., Spread into a 9 x 13-inch pan., Cover and refrigerate for 36 hours., Sprinkle remaining bits over dessert just prior to serving.

title: Butterscotch Cookies
directions: Mix the first 2 ingredients together and set aside., Melt butterscotch morsels, then add peanut butter., Heat only until smooth., Pour dry ingredients into hot mixture., Drop by teaspoonful on waxed paper.

title: Walnut Wafers
directions: Drop by teaspoonfuls on buttered pan., Bake in 250° moderate oven until light brown.

title: Easy Caramel Frosting
directions: Combine the margarine and brown sugar in a small saucepan. Heat until sugar dissolves and the margarine is melted., Pour into a large mixing bowl., Add the cream cheese, confectioners sugar and milk., Beat until smooth., If icing is too thick, add a little more milk.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Saute onion and celery in 2 tablespoons butter., Spread one-half herb stuffing mix in greased 9 x 13-inch dish., Heat one-half cup butter and 1 cup water., Pour over stuffing mix.

title: Coleslaw
directions: Add mayo until it holds together.

title: Cherry S'Mores
directions: Place 1 piece of candy on each cracker., Microwave 4 crackers at a time on 100% for 45 seconds to 1 minute, until chocolate starts to melt., Place 1 marshmallow on each cracker., Microwave 15 to 30 seconds until soft., Top each with a spoonful of cherry filling., Makes 8 servings., Preparation Time:, 7 minutes.

title: Harvard Beets
directions: Drain beets and keep liquid., Combine cornstarch and sugar. Stir in vinegar and beet liquid, stir over low heat until thickened., Add beets and butter., Heat., Makes 5 servings.

title: Hot Crabmeat Dip
directions: Drain crabmeat., Pour lemon juice over crabmeat., Combine remaining ingredients and add to crabmeat and lemon juice., Put in saucepan and heat at low temperature., Place in serving bowl or chafing dish and serve hot with Bleu cheese crackers.

title: Blueberry Muffins
directions: Mix together flour and 2 tablespoons sugar., Combine egg and 1/3 cup milk; add to flour mixture., Add shortening, then mix in only enough milk to dampen flour., (Batter will be lumpy.) Sprinkle 2 tablespoons sugar over berries until added to mixture. Add blueberries.

title: Mandarin Orange Cake
directions: Blend cake mix, eggs, oil and oranges well., Beat for about 2 minutes., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes., Top with icing.

title: Pork Chop And Apple Bake
directions: In a 10-inch skillet,, cook, pork, chops, in shortening until browned on both sides., Pour, off fat., In a 12 x 8-inch baking dish, combine beans and cinnamon., Top with pork chops. Cover and bake at 350° for 30 minutes., Remove from oven., Put brown sugar in small bowl, and, dip, apple slices in sugar and place on and around pork, chops and beans., Cover and continue baking until pork chops and apples are tender.

title: Cheese Meat Loaf
directions: Soak bread in milk., Beat eggs and mix all ingredients together., Shape into a loaf and put into a greased loaf pan. Bake at 375 degrees for 1 hour.

title: Pound Cake
directions: Cream sugar and shortening., Beat in eggs; add milk and extract., Blend in flour, baking powder and salt., Pour into greased and floured large loaf pan., Bake at 300°, for 1 hour and 25 minutes.

title: Nappa Cabbage Salad
directions: Trim and core cabbage., Cut lengthwise, then crosswise into bite size pieces., Chop onions, including tops., Mix onions and cabbage. Discard flavor packets from Ramen packages and break up noodles., Brown noodles in oleo., As soon as noodles start to brown, add sunflower seeds and pecans. Brown whole mixture., Allow to cool.

title: Yum Yum Cake
directions: Mix first 4 ingredients 3 or 4 minutes., Prepare three cake pans; bake at 350° for 18 minutes., While cake is baking, mix pudding mix with pineapple., Put in refrigerator to thicken., When thick, fold in Cool Whip., Return to refrigerator and frost cake when cool.

title: Upside-Down Pizza
directions: Preheat oven to 450°., In 10-inch ovenproof skillet over medium heat, cook ground beef and sausage until meat is browned, stirring to separate meat., Spoon off fat., Stir in spaghetti sauce and Parmesan cheese., On floured surface, press dough into a 10-inch round; place over meat mixture in skillet., Gently tuck edge of dough between mixture and side of skillet., Bake 20 minutes or until crust is lightly browned., To serve, invert onto serving platter., Sprinkle with Mozzarella cheese., Let stand 5 minutes., Makes 8 servings.

title: Earthquake Cake
directions: Grease and flour 9 x 13-inch pan., Spread coconut and pecans in pan., Mix cake and pour over pecans and coconut., Melt butter; add cream cheese and powdered sugar., Mix well., Spread over cake and bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes until toothpick comes clean.

title: Puppy Chow
directions: Melt butter, mix in chocolate chips and peanut butter., After everything is melted,, pour Crispix cereal into chocolate sauce and mix until blended., Put in refrigerator to cool., After mixture is cooled, place cereal mixture in paper bag and toss with confectioners sugar., Blend well., Serve and enjoy.

title: Red Velvet Cake Frosting
directions: Cook milk, flour and salt until thick, stirring constantly. Let cool., (Be sure to cover, so it doesn't form a film on top.) Cream shortening and sugar very well., Add vanilla., Combine with the first mixture; beat until fluffy., Spread on cake.

title: Campfire Ragtime Stew
directions: Layer ingredients in Dutch oven., Cook 1 1/2 hours over campfire., Serves 10.

title: Herb-Tomato Grilled Chicken
directions: Mix together and blend well the oil, ketchup or chili sauce, lemon juice, garlic and herbs used., Place the chicken pieces on rack. Brush both sides with basting sauce.

title: Jam Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients., Fold in jam last., Bake in 350° oven for 25 minutes.

title: Honey Mustard Wings
directions: In large bowl, mix soup mix, honey and mustard; set aside. Cut wings at joints and discard tips., Add to soup mixture and toss to coat., Place chicken in baking pan., Bake at 400° for 45 minutes or until chicken is done, turning once.

title: Meat Loaf
directions: In bowl, mix meat, onion, bell pepper, crackers, egg, 1/2 can tomato sauce and 1/2 cup ketchup all together in bowl., Form into loaf in baking dish and pour remaining tomato sauce and ketchup over top., Bake at 350° in oven for 50 minutes.

title: Zucchini Brownies
directions: Mix first 6 ingredients together in a bowl and then add rest of ingredients. Mix by hand and pour into well-greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes. Cool.

title: Strawberry Jello Salad
directions: Mix all together (excluding IMO dressing)., Pour half of mixture in 9 x 13-inch glass dish or pan., Refrigerate until solid., Spread IMO on top., Pour rest of jello mixture over the IMO., Refrigerate until solid.

title: Louisiana Pear Cake
directions: Mix margarine, sugar and egg together.	Sift flour, salt, soda and cinnamon together., Add to sugar and egg mixture., Add vanilla, pears and nuts and mix well., Pour into a greased and floured baking dish or 8 x 8-inch pan., Bake at 300° for 1 hour., Serve with whipped cream.

title: Norwegian Coffee Cake
directions: Rub with fingers into crumbs the flour, sugar and butter. Save 2 cups for top., Mix the remaining ingredients; add remaining crumb mixture., Pour into greased and floured 8 x 8-inch pan. Sprinkle crumbs on top., Bake for about 30 minutes in a 350° to 400° oven.

title: Pecan Pie
directions: Mix all ingredients and bake in 2 pie shells for 35 to 40 minutes at 350°.

title: Decadent Chocolate Cake With Raspberry Sauce
directions: Heat oven to 325°., Grease spring-form pan., Heat 1 cup chocolate chips and 1/2 cup margarine in 2-quart saucepan over medium heat until chips are melted; cool 5 minutes., Stir in flour until smooth., Stir in egg yolks until well blended., Beat egg whites in large bowl on high speed until foamy., Beat in sugar, 1 tablespoon at a time, until soft peaks form., Fold chocolate mixture into egg whites; spread in pan., Bake for 30 to 40 minutes. The top will appear dry and cracked, or until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean., Cool 10 minutes., Run knife along sides of cake to loosen; remove from pan., Invert onto wire rack., Place on serving plate.

title: Mexican Special
directions: Cook and drain macaroni., Add other ingredients and place in casserole dish., Sprinkle cheese on top., Bake at 350° until cheese starts to slightly brown.

title: Caramel Biscuit Ring
directions: In an 8 or 9-inch round microwave-safe baking dish, combine brown sugar, butter and water., Cook in microwave uncovered for 1 minute, stirring after butter melts., Stir in nuts., Separate can of biscuits., Arrange in ring around edge of dish, turning to coat with caramel mixture., Cook uncovered 2 1/2 to 3 minutes or until biscuits are firm and no longer doughy, rotating once., Invert onto serving plate., Serve warm.

title: Watergate Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients together well and chill.

title: Tomato Sauce
directions: Saute onion and garlic in small amount of olive oil., Add green pepper, puree and sugar and simmer about 30 minutes., Add can of sliced water chestnuts, including the juice, and simmer a little longer., Season with salt, pepper and the chopped basil.

title: Rich Corn Surprise
directions: Mix all ingredients well, adding salt and pepper to taste. Pour into a 10 x 6 x 2-inch baking dish and top with 1/4 of bread crumbs., Bake 25 minutes at 350°., Serves 5.

title: Butterscotch Pudding
directions: Put sugar and flour together and a little bit of water first; make a smooth paste or else it gets lumpy., Cook together until thick., When cold, add salted peanuts, fruit cocktail and marshmallows.

title: Mini Carrot Cake
directions: Sift dry ingredients; set aside., Beat egg, oil, sugar and vanilla., Stir in carrots and nuts., Pour into greased 1-quart Corning Ware dish or other dish., Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Connecticut Beef Supper
directions: Brown meat with onion in large skillet in vegetable oil., After browning, drain off oil., Drain mushrooms, reserving liquid., Add enough water to mushroom liquid to make one cup., Stir mushrooms and liquid into meat and onions., Heat to boiling; reduce heat and cover., Simmer 2 hours if you use stew meat; 1 hour if you use hamburger., Watch that it doesn't cook dry., Add water if necessary.

title: Orange Slice Cookies
directions: Separate eggs., Beat egg whites until stiff, then set aside. Mix together water, brown sugar and egg yolks., Fold in egg whites., Add gently salt, baking soda, cinnamon, minced orange slices and flour., Bake at 350° in a greased and floured 12 x 15-inch pan for approximately 50 minutes., Cool and cut into desired slices.

title: Mexican Rice And Chicken
directions: In Dutch oven, stew boned chicken breasts in water for 20 minutes; remove chicken from water and add onion, green pepper, salsa and corn., Bring to boil; add rice and chopped chicken. Reduce heat to simmer and cook, covered, for 15 minutes., Put in serving dish and sprinkle with grated cheese., Serve with sour cream and salsa., Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Spanish Chicken
directions: Cut boned chicken into bite size pieces., Mix soup, broth, chiles, onion and chicken., Layer a 13 x 9-inch pan with Doritos, half of mixture, another layer of chips, remainder of mixture and final layer of chips., Top with cheese and dash of paprika., Bake at 325° for 45 minutes.

title: London Broil In Ginger And Onion Marinade
directions: In a shallow glass dish, spread 1/2 onions., Sprinkle both sides of meat with ginger, 1/4 teaspoon salt and 1/4 teaspoon pepper., Place meat on top of onions., Spread the remaining onions on top of the meat., Cover the dish with plastic food wrap and refrigerate 1 to 3 hours.

title: Caramel Apple Dip
directions: Mix all ingredients, except apples., Refrigerate several hours (overnight is best)., Serve on chip-n-dip tray surrounded by sliced apples.

title: "Frozen Peach Cup"
directions: Put several spoonfuls of peaches in dessert cups., Add Cool Whip.

title: Jewish Apple Cake
directions: Pour oil and orange juice together before adding dry ingredients., Mix well., In separate bowl, cut paper thin slices of apples with skins on., Dip in mixture of cinnamon and sugar (more if needed)., Layer batter and apples in tube pan, ending with apples on top., Bake at 350° for 1 3/4 hours., Check at 1 1/4 hours for doneness.

title: Psychiatrist'S Cake
directions: In large bowl, mix all ingredients together., Batter is very stiff., Turn it into a buttered and floured Bundt pan and bake 50 to 55 minutes in a preheated 350° oven until the cake springs back when touched lightly., (A cake tester will still be sticky; this is a very moist cake.), Invert on cake plate when slightly cooled and dust lightly with powdered sugar., Strong men will weep and sigh and psychiatrists will offer bribes for the recipe.

title: Squash Bacon Casserole
directions: Cut squash in small pieces and simmer until tender; drain well. Combine sour cream or yogurt, butter, cheese, salt and paprika. Stir over low heat until cheese is melted., Remove from heat., Stir in egg, chives and bacon., Add squash., Place in a baking dish and cover top with bread crumbs., Dot with butter., Brown at 350°. Yield:, 6 to 8 servings.

title: French Toast
directions: Mix together the beaten egg, milk, salt, sugar and cinnamon. Dip the bread (either whole or cut) into the mixture., Saute in butter until lightly browned on both sides in an electric skillet at 325°., Top with powdered sugar, fresh fruits, honey or the syrup of your choice.

title: Corn Meal Mush
directions: Bring water to boil in iron frying pan., Add meal to water slowly, stirring constantly., When thickened, add oleo or bacon drippings., Cook only to mix seasoning in., Serve in soup bowl with buttermilk., Don't stir in., When milk is used up, add another topping of buttermilk.

title: Soy Milk Pudding
directions: Boil soy milk., Dissolve cornstarch in 1/4 cup cold water and combine., Cool., Add nuts as topping.

title: Meat Loaf
directions: In small bowl, mix tomato sauce, brown sugar, vinegar and mustard., Set aside.

title: Dill Dip
directions: Mix the first 3 ingredients with the sour cream and mayonnaise.

title: Shamrock Punch
directions: Mix all ingredients in order listed., Refrigerate until ready to use.

title: Chili-Cheese Casserole
directions: Mix cheeses together., Spray a 10 x 6 x 2-inch pan with Pam. Layer cheese, then chilies, then cheese., Mix eggs, flour and milk., Pour over mixture., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes., Top casserole with salsa; bake another 10 minutes., Let set for 5 minutes., Serve with sour cream.

title: Soda Water Sherbet
directions: Mix and freeze in ice cream freezer., Makes 1 gallon.

title: Chicken Roll-Ups
directions: Forty-five minutes before serving, cut breast into one inch chunks. In a bowl toss with oil, oregano, and 1 tsp. salt., Set aside. Peel cucumber and cut lengthwise in half., With a spoon, scrap out seeds., Coarsely shred cucumber and mix with yogurt, garlic, and 1 tsp. salt., Warm pitas in foil at 300 degrees., Over medium high heat, cook chicken until lightly browned., Remove chicken from pan., Saute onions about 10 minutes., Spread cucumber mixture, chicken, and onion on pitas., Roll and wrap with foil, Serves six.

title: Ham And Potato Casserole
directions: Layer all ingredients in a baking dish: ham, potatoes, cheese, onion and salt and pepper to taste., Pour milk over ingredients. Cover dish with aluminum foil and bake for 45 to 60 minutes at 350° or until potatoes are tender.

title: Homemade Candy Bars
directions: Mix margarine and cookie crumbs together., Press in 9 x 13-inch pan., Top with caramel topping., Pour milk and pudding into medium bowl and whip with wire whisk for 1 to 2 minutes., Let stand 5 minutes., Fold in whipped topping., Chop chocolate and add peanuts., Spread over caramel topping., Freeze for 4 hours or until firm., Melt remaining chocolate with 3 tablespoons margarine., Spread over pudding., Cut into squares., Store in freezer.

title: No Bake Banana Pudding
directions: Mix together milk, sour cream, Cool Whip and instant vanilla pudding., Set aside., In a 2 qt. container layer vanilla wafers and bananas., Spread pudding evenly over layer., Top with vanilla wafers., Refrigerate.

title: Zucchini Casserole
directions: Preheat oven to 325°., In small bowl, combine cracker crumbs and butter, reserve 1/4 cup of the cracker mixture for topping., In medium bowl, stir together remaining cracker mixture, zucchini, cheese, egg, onion and garlic., Place zucchini mixture in 8-inch square baking pan., Sprinkle with reserved cracker mixture., Bake 1 hour., Preparation:, 10 minutes., Total time:, 1 hour and 10 minutes.

title: Mayo Cake
directions: Mix together and then pour into greased and floured pan. Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes., Cake will be very moist.

title: Meat In One Casserole
directions: Preheat oven to 400°., Spoon macaroni and cheese around edges of a lightly greased 2-quart baking dish., Combine beans and mustard., Spoon bean mixture in center of casserole., Arrange sausage on top of macaroni and cheese., Sprinkle with grated cheese., Bake for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Chimachanga
directions: Put ingredients in pan with just enough water to cover and simmer until onions are done., Add 2 tablespoons cornstarch to thicken., Wrap mixture in flour tortillas like enchiladas., Place far apart on a greased cookie sheet., Brush with melted butter. Bake until tortillas are brown at 350°., Top with cheese, lettuce, sour cream, etc.

title: Taco Casserole
directions: Cook meat; drain., Add taco mix., Cook rice., Add cheese soup and tomatoes to rice., Place in dish in layers., Start with rice mixture., Put grated cheese on top., Bake until cheese is melted.

title: Apricot Bread
directions: Soak apricots in warm water for 30 minutes., Meanwhile, in a mixing bowl, cream the sugar, butter and egg., Stir in orange juice., Combine flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt., Stir into creamed mixture just until combined., Drain apricots well; add to batter with nuts., Pour into greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan., Bake at 350° for 55 minutes or until bread tests done., Cool 10 minutes in pan before removing to a wire rack., Yields 1 loaf.

title: Bran Muffins
directions: Use 3 to 4 quart bowl., Mix sugar, eggs, oil and buttermilk. Mix flour, salt and soda., When, mixing, I alternate buttermilk with flour until mixed thoroughly, ending with flour., Then add cereal, stirring from the bottom of bowl, mixing well., Raisins can be added before or after cereal., Cover and store in refrigerator up to 6 weeks.

title: Stuff
directions: All vegetables are grated., Brown ground beef., Place 3/4 in bottom of casserole dish., Layer vegetables, beginning with carrots., Sprinkle rest of ground beef on top; then cheese., Cover and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Best Yet Cheesecake
directions: Crust:, Mix graham cracker crumbs with sugar, then with butter., Line sides and bottom of a 9-inch spring-form pan with this mixture., Refrigerate at least 15 minutes.

title: Ugly Duckling Pudding Cake
directions: Blend all ingredients except brown sugar and nuts in large mixing bowl., Beat 4 minutes at medium speed of electric mixer. Pour into greased and floured 13 x 9-inch pan., Sprinkle with brown sugar and nuts., Bake at 325° for 45 minutes or until cake springs back when touched and pulls away from the sides of the pan., Cool in pan for 15 minutes., Spoon hot glaze over warm cake.

title: Zwieback
directions: Mix white sugar, flour, yeast, Carnation milk and salt., Add lukewarm water., Stir., Add melted margarine., Stir., Add beaten egg., Beat by hand 2 minutes., Add 3 cups flour gradually., Stir and begin to knead.

title: Pumpkin Cheesecake Bars
directions: Combine flour and brown sugar., Cut in butter to make crumb mixture., Stir in nuts., Set aside 3/4 cup mixture for topping. Press remaining mixture in bottom of 8 x 8 x 1 1/2-inch baking pan. Bake in 350° oven for 15 minutes., Cool slightly., Combine cream cheese, sugar, pumpkin, eggs, spices, vanilla in large mixing bowl. Blend until smooth., Pour over baked crust., Sprinkle with reserved topping., Bake 30 minutes to 35 minutes at 350°., Cool before cutting into bars.

title: Easy Garden Vegetable Pie
directions: Heat oven to 400°., Lightly grease pie plate., Mix broccoli, onions, green pepper and cheese in pie plate., Beat remaining ingredients until smooth., Pour into pie plate., Bake until golden brown and knife inserted in center comes out clean, 35 to 45 minutes., Let stand 5 minutes before cutting.

title: Cranberry Raspberry Jello
directions: Dilute jello in hot water., Add cranberry sauce and put in mold.

title: Pumpkin Pudding
directions: Add sugar, spices and salt to pumpkin and blend., Mix eggs and milk (do not beat) and stir into mixture., Pour into baking pan or pie shell., Bake at 450° for 10 minutes., Reduce temperature to moderate 325° and bake for 40 minutes., To test for doneness, inserted knife blade must be clean.

title: Pork Chops Mexicana
directions: Brown chops under broiler., Arrange in bottom of pan in single layer., Sprinkle bouillon and rice around chops., Combine taco mix, tomato sauce and water. Pour over chops., Cover tightly and bake at 350° for 1 hour., Remove from oven and arrange green pepper rings on top., Cover with cheese. Replace cover and return to oven for 15 minutes.

title: Taco Hot Dish
directions: Brown hamburger; drain off grease., Mix hamburger with taco seasoning; add sour cream., Grease 9 x 13-inch cake pan., Roll out crescent rolls; press dough into cake pan., Crush Doritos and pour 1/2 of them on dough., Add hamburger mixture., Top with grated cheeses., Put rest of Doritos on top., Bake for 20 minutes at 350°., Top individual pieces with lettuce, grated cheese, tomatoes and taco sauce, if desired.

title: Pepsi-Cola Chicken
directions: Place chicken in a frying pan., Pour ketchup and Pepsi over chicken., Place lid on pan., Cook on medium heat until tender (45 minutes)., Serve with mashed potatoes or rice.

title: Macaroni And Cheese
directions: Cook macaroni in salt water; drain., Melt butter and cheese in hot macaroni., Beat eggs well with milk added., Mix all together. Put in casserole; bake slowly for about 45 minutes at 350°, or until firm.

title: Hawaiian Dessert
directions: Mix cake batter according to package directions., Pour into two greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pans., Bake at 350° for 15 minutes or until the cakes test done., Cool completely., In a large mixing bowl, combine pudding mixes, milk and extract., Beat for 2 minutes., Add the cream cheese and beat well., Stir in pineapple. Spread over the cooled cakes., Top with whipped cream; sprinkle with coconut., Chill for at least 2 hours., Yield:, 24 servings.

title: Mexican Lasagna
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Brown ground meat and onions., Stir in tomato sauce and green beans., Stir in taco sauce until you obtain the spicy flavor you prefer., Bring to a low boil, reduce heat and simmer., If sauce appears thick, add a little water., While meat mixture simmers, grate cheese and slice olives.

title: Cabbage And Beef Soup
directions: In, a Dutch oven, brown beef., Add all remaining ingredients; bring to a boil., Reduce heat and simmer, covered, for one hour. Yields 3 quarts.

title: Cheese Ball
directions: Mix all ingredients (except pecans) well., Form into 1 large ball or 2 small balls and roll in pecans., Wrap well and chill for at least 8 hours.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Boil broccoli and onion together and drain well., Add garlic cheese and soup; mix well., Layer in greased casserole dish with bread crumbs in between layers., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Apple Date Cake
directions: This makes 1 large cake in tube pan or 2 loaf pan cakes., Bake at 300° for 1 hour and 25 minutes or bake loaf pans for 1 hour.

title: Irish Cream
directions: Put all the ingredients into a blender., Blend until well mixed., Refrigerate until you are ready to enjoy!!!

title: Apricot Bars
directions: Rinse apricots., Cover with water and boil 10 minutes; drain. Chop and cool., Grease an 8-inch square pan., Mix butter, sugar and 1 cup of flour until crumbly., Press down in bottom of pan and bake 25 minutes at 350°.

title: Roast Beef Salad Filling
directions: Mix together all ingredients., Add mayonnaise with milk, sugar and mustard., Mix well., Chill., Serve on bread of your choice.

title: Macadamia Nut Brittle
directions: Combine sugar, syrup, and nuts in a microwave safe container. Microwave, covered on HIGH for 3 minutes., Add butter and vanilla and microwave on HIGH for 1 minute., Add baking soda and stir until foamy and smooth., Pour into a large greased tupperware container and cool for 1 hour., When hardened, remove from tupperware, crack, and serve.

title: Tennessee Brisket
directions: Trim excess fat to 1/4-inch thick., Place brisket in large plastic bag or glass baking dish., Combine remaining ingredients in measuring cup; add water to equal 2 cups water and pour over brisket., Cover tightly; refrigerate 8 hours.

title: Sugar Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 400°., Sift flour, baking powder and salt together., Cream together butter and sugar., Add eggs and vanilla, beating until light and fluffy., Gradually add sifted dry ingredients., Form dough into 1-inch balls and place 2 inches apart on greased sheet., Butter bottom of large flat tumbler glass; dip in sugar and then press balls of dough until they are 1/8-inch thick., Bake 10 minutes., Also, dough may be dipped by rounded teaspoonfuls.

title: Pork Chop Supreme
directions: Place pork chops in a baking dish. Place 1 slice of onion and 1 tablespoon each of catsup, ReaLemon and brown sugar on each pork chop. Bake, covered, for 45 minutes at 325°; uncover and bake an additional 15 minutes.

title: Pepperidge Farm Party Rolls
directions: Freeze rolls., Cut off tops and scoop out top of roll., Mix cream cheese, crab, mustard and onion., Stuff this mixture in scooped out section of roll., Bake in 350° oven for 10 to 15 minutes or until piping hot., Serve., (These freeze easily.)

title: Hardy'S Biscuits
directions: Dissolve yeast in warm water and set aside., Mix dry ingredients in a large bowl., Cut in shortening, then add buttermilk and yeast water., Mix well., Cover dough with towel and let set overnight., Next morning, pour dough out on floured board and knead lightly for a minute or two., Roll out and cut biscuits. Bake at 500° until done.

title: Brisket
directions: Rub meat with seasonings and place onions on meat., Place in large aluminum pan., Pour in hot coffee (if large brisket, you may need 2 pots coffee)., Now, cover tightly with foil., Place in pan on grill with low heat and cook all night., (Do not allow brisket to cook dry; add more coffee if necessary.), Remove brisket from pan and smoke on grill 45 minutes to 1 hour, depending on amount of smoked flavor you like., Allow brisket to cool completely. Remove excess fat and slice., Brisket slices better when cool or even cold., Place sliced brisket back in juice and reheat when ready to serve.

title: Scalloped Corn
directions: Mix all ingredients and put in greased casserole., Cover top with crushed chips., Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Bread Pudding
directions: Cut biscuits into small pieces and place in buttered baking pan., Mix together eggs, vanilla, nutmeg, melted oleo, milk and sugar., Pour over bread and bake at 350° for an hour or until set.

title: Joanie'S Fruitcake(For Those Who Don'T Like Candied Fruit)
directions: Mix nuts, dates, raisins, red and green cherries., Coat with flour, sugar, baking powder and salt., Mix well with eggs and vanilla., Grease well 1 large loaf pan or 3 small ones., Bake at 300° for 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

title: Grandma'S Apple Corn Bread
directions: In the top of double boiler, mix the corn meal, sugar, salt, milk and butter., Set over hot water and cook about 10 minutes. Cool and add eggs, soda (dissolved in water) and apples., Bake in greased 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan at 400° about 25 minutes or until done.

title: Happiness Cookie
directions: Blend with 1 cup of unselfishness and a dash of interest., Mix all ingredients with a pint of sympathy and understanding combined. Flavor with loving companionship., Bake well all your life., Frost with kisses, fond hopes, and tender words., These cookies keep well and should be served often.

title: Swedish Pancakes
directions: Combine in blender the eggs, vanilla extract and milk., Add flour, salt, sugar, oil and cinnamon (optional)., Blend until smooth., Ladle mixture onto a lightly greased skillet., Size of the pancakes should be 2 1/2-inches in diameter and have the looks of a miniature crepe.

title: Cherry Cheese Cake
directions: Mix cream cheese and sugar then fold in Cool Whip., Place cherry pie filling on top of graham cracker crust., Cover cherry pie filling with cream cheese mixture., Refrigerate overnight.

title: Bea'S Fruit Cake
directions: Mix chopped nuts and fruits; set aside., Cream margarine and sugar., Separate eggs and beat yolks., Blend egg yolks with margarine and sugar mixture., Add rum, brandy and wine; mix well.

title: Blueberry Sour Cream Cake
directions: Heat oven to 350°. Butter a 9 or 10-inch spring-form pan. Combine first 6 ingredients. Press into pan. Sprinkle with the blueberries. Combine remaining ingredients. Pour over blueberries. Bake about 1 hour or until lightly browned. So easy and tasty and serves about 12.

title: Sugared Peanuts
directions: Put sugar and water in medium saucepan., Dissolve over medium heat., Add peanuts and cook, stirring until peanuts are coated with sugar and no syrup is left., Spread in large ungreased pan and bake at 300° for about 30 minutes., Stir every 5 minutes.

title: Buttermilk Pie
directions: Beat eggs well, add buttermilk and vanilla., Combine sugar and flour; add to egg mixture., Add melted butter and mix well., Pour into unbaked pie shell., Bake at 350° until set (about 45 minutes, or until inserted knife comes out clean).

title: Steak And Noodles
directions: Cut steak into bite-size pieces., Brown in skillet with onion and green peppers in small amount of oil., Mix soup and milk in crock-pot., Add gravy and bouillon., Stir in meat, onion and green peppers., Cook 8 to 10 hours on low in crock-pot., (The longer it cooks, the more tender the meat.), Cook noodles according to directions., Drain., Spoon steak and gravy oven noodles., Serve.

title: Garlic Pretzels
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Whisk all ingredients together. Reserve 1/2 mixture for a future batch (store in refrigerator). Put 1 large bag of small pretzels in a baking pan., Pour mixture in and stir well., Bake for 1 hour, stirring every 10 minutes.

title: Elegant Eggnog
directions: Beat eggs until foamy., Beat sugar and salt into eggs until lemon colored and thickened., Add whole milk and whipping cream; whip until thick.

title: Shredded Apple Pie
directions: Combine dry ingredients in a large bowl. Fold in peeled and shredded apples. Mix melted butter with beaten egg and stir into apple mixture. Pour into pie shell. Bake 40 to 45 minutes at 350°.

title: Sausage Stew
directions: Cook and drain sausage., Add all ingredients to pot., Cook until potatoes are done., Remove bay leaf.

title: Lemon Cheese Bars
directions: Mix cake mix, 1 egg and 1/3 cup oil until crumbly., Reserve 1 cup and put remaining lightly in ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake 15 minutes in 350° oven., Beat cheese, sugar, lemon juice and 1 egg until light and smooth., Spread over baked crust., Sprinkle remaining cup of crumbs over top., Bake 15 minutes longer., Cool and cut.

title: Pumpkin Cake Roll
directions: Mix dry ingredients and set aside., Beat eggs; add sugar and then pumpkin and lemon juice., Fold dry ingredients into pumpkin mixture., Spread in greased and floured 15 x 10 x 1-inch pan., Top with nuts., Bake at 375° for 15 minutes., Turn out on towel sprinkled with powdered sugar., Roll cake and towel together., Let cool and unroll.

title: Sausage Gravy
directions: Fry sausage., Add onion and flour., Slowly add milk until thickens; pour over toast or biscuits.

title: Tea Cakes
directions: Add oil and flour together. Add eggs and sugar and mix all together. Drop with spoon and mash with fork. Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.

title: Pineapple Burgers
directions: Drain pineapple well., Divide meat into 8 thin patties. Place a pineapple ring between 2 patties, sealing edges., Broil 6 inches from broiler unit 5 minutes on each side., Pour Spicy Sauce over burgers.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Prepare chicken base in saucepan. Melt butter and saute onion and pepper., Mix dry ingredients and stir into vegetables. Gradually add stock, stirring constantly, until thickened. Remove from heat and add chicken. Add noodles and mushrooms., Turn into buttered 3 to 4 cup casserole., Mix dry milk and Parmesan cheese. Sprinkle on top of casserole., Drizzle 3 tablespoons melted butter over all., Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Carrots
directions: Peel, wash and slice carrots., Cook in water until tender. Add butter and sugar and let it cook down until it thickens, about 20 minutes., Serve warm.

title: Dump Cake
directions: Place all ingredients (except butter) into a 9 x 13-inch glass baking dish., Do not mix!, Place butter on top., Bake 1 hour at 350°., Serve with ice cream.

title: Strawberry Shortcake
directions: Generously grease bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan., Sprinkle marshmallows evenly over bottom of pan., Thoroughly combine berries and gelatin and set aside., In large bowl combine flour and other ingredients., Blend at low speed until moistened, then 3 minutes at medium speed., Pour batter over marshmallows; spread strawberry mixture evenly over batter., Bake at 350° for 40 to 50 minutes.

title: Sue'S Cranberry Salad
directions: Grind cranberries with whole orange and sugar., Add dissolved Jell-O and other ingredients., Let chill.

title: Chicken Mexicana(Low Calorie)
directions: Mix salt, pepper, paprika, oregano and garlic powder; rub into chicken., Heat oil in skillet and saute onions and green pepper. Brown chicken., Add remaining ingredients, cover and cook until tender, about 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Meatball - Potato Scallop
directions: Mix first 6 ingredients lightly, but thoroughly. Shape in 16 balls and brown on all sides in the oil in skillet., Remove meatballs and pour off all but 1 tablespoon fat., Add onion to skillet and saute for 2 to 3 minutes., Add soup, Worcestershire and about 1/2 cup water., Simmer 5 minutes.

title: Tea Cakes
directions: Cream shortening and sugar; add eggs and vanilla., Beat well. Add milk; beat., Add dry ingredients., Roll out and use cookie cutters or form into balls and press out., Place on greased cookie sheet., Bake at 400° for 6 to 10 minutes or until brown.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients and put in 2 quart casserole., Cover and bake for 45 minutes at 350., This recipe improves by being made a day ahead, refrigerate, then baked., Good served with rice and pineapple chunks., Serves 6 - 8.

title: Corn Meal Muffins
directions: Add well-beaten egg to corn meal which has been sifted with salt, then add melted margarine and thin to right consistency with sweet milk., Add lastly the baking powder and pour into hot margarinized muffin tins., Bake as other corn breads., This recipe may be baked in a pan, muffin rings or a deep iron skillet, but always remember in baking all corn bread, it should be poured into a sizzling hot pan to bake., Yields 24 muffins.

title: Chinese Steak And Vegetables
directions: Tenderize steak according to package directions., Slice thinly into strips., Heat enough oil in frying pan just to coat bottom of pan., Add 1 tablespoon margarine., Quickly stir-fry onions and garlic until onions are limp., Remove from pan., Add zucchini and carrots and saute until limp., Add mushrooms and stir until heated. Remove vegetables from pan., Add meat and brown lightly (add a little more oil if necessary)., Return all vegetables to pan with meat and add soy sauce, Accent, pepper and gravy mix., Mix well. Turn heat to low and cover pan., Simmer until meat is tender, about 15 to 20 minutes., Serve over rice., Makes 2 to 3 servings.

title: Sugar Coated Peanuts
directions: Put in heavy pan., Boil at medium high stirring until water is gone., Spread on tin foil on cookie sheet., Bake at 300° for 45 minutes., Stir after 15 minutes.

title: Happiness
directions: Cook it for 3 minutes. Pop it in the oven then Boom!, you are happy.

title: Blueberry Cobbler
directions: After cooked and melted, fill a pie crust with blueberry filling., Sprinkle 1/2 cup of crushed pecans over top of filling. Cut a second pie crust into lattice pieces and place over the top of the pie.

title: Poor Man'S Steak
directions: Mix all together, except the soup., Spread on cookie sheet. Chill., When firm, cut into squares., Dust with flour and brown. Place browned squares in baking dish., Pour the can of mushroom soup, diluted over the squares and bake for 1 hour at 325°., A family favorite!

title: Frosting
directions: In top of double boiler, over hot water, melt chocolate, milk and marshmallows., Remove from heat and chill., Fold in the cream and frost cake., Yields 3 1/2 cups.

title: Blender Hollandaise Sauce
directions: Melt butter until bubbling., Do not brown., Measure remaining ingredients into blender container., Blend at low speed 5 seconds. Remove cover insert., Quickly pour in hot butter, in a steady stream, while blending at low speed., Blend until sauce thickens. Makes 3/4 cup.

title: Grilled Turkey Breast
directions: Marinate turkey in mixture of ingredients 8 hours in refrigerator., Grill 10 minutes on each side.

title: Chicken Tetrazzini
directions: Place chicken in Dutch oven, cover with water, and simmer until tender., Remove chicken from pot (reserving cooking broth) to cool. Cook pasta in the reserved chicken broth; drain., Remove chicken from bones and cut into bite-size pieces.

title: Chili
directions: Clean beans and rinse., Place in large bowl., Add water to cover and let stand overnight., Drain beans and place in large kettle., Add water to cover and heat to a boil., Cover and simmer about 45 minutes or until skin of bean bursts when you touch., Add tomatoes., Simmer 5 minutes and set aside., Saute green pepper in oil., Add onion and cook until soft; add garlic., In large skillet, melt butter and brown ground beef., Add beef to onion mixture. Stir in chili powder and cook 10 minutes., Add beef mixture to beans; stir in remaining ingredients., Cover and simmer 1 hour. Remove cover and cook for 30 more minutes.

title: Deviled Egg Sandwich Spread
directions: Put boiled eggs in food processor and chop until fine., Add other ingredients and process until smooth enough to spread.

title: Beef Stroganoff
directions: Brown the meat quickly in oil, then add mushrooms and onion. Cook, stirring, until the onion is tender, about 3 minutes., Add broth, Worcestershire sauce, paprika and tomato paste., Bring to a boil., Stir in rice., Cover and remove from heat., Let stand for 5 minutes., Stir in sour cream., Makes 4 servings.

title: Chicken Panang Curry
directions: In a large saucepan, combine coconut milk and curry base and cook until blended over medium heat., Add chicken, seasoning sauce and lemon juice and simmer for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add remaining ingredients, except mushrooms and garlic chili pepper sauce., Cover and simmer for 5 minutes., Add mushrooms and garlic chili pepper sauce to taste., Cover and simmer for 2 minutes., Serve hot with rice.

title: Raisin Egg Puffs
directions: Beat egg with rotary beater until fluffy. Add other ingredients, beating meanwhile., Pour over raisins, sprinkled in the bottom of tart pastry in tart pans., Bake at 350° for about 25 minutes until tops are firm and tan in color., Makes about 1 dozen tarts.

title: Hominy Salad
directions: Mix and bake for 30 minutes in a 350° oven.

title: Chocolate Buttermilk Layer Cake
directions: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs and beat, then alternate dry ingredients and liquid. Pour into two 9-inch cake pans, greased and floured. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes. Frost with your favorite chocolate frosting.

title: Ham Fluff
directions: Melt butter in saucepan., Blend in flour, salt, pepper, onion and mustard., Stir in milk and cook, stirring constantly, until very thick., Beat egg yolks until thick and lemon-colored., Fold a little sauce into egg yolks and then add this to remaining sauce. Fold in ham., Whip egg whites until stiff, but not dry., Fold ham mixture into egg whites., Place in greased 1 1/2-quart casserole dish., Bake at 325° for 1 hour, until top is brown and puffy. Yields 4 servings.

title: Slush
directions: Allow teabags and boiling water to sit for at least a half an hour., Remove teabags., Mix all ingredients and freeze., Add desired amount to wink.

title: Scalloped Corn
directions: Mix all ingredients., Bake at 375° for 45 minutes., (Oven temperature and cooking time may vary.)

title: Holiday Fruit Salad
directions: Mix 8 ingredients well., Garnish with cherries and mandarin oranges., Chill and serve.

title: Chicken Salad
directions: Mix in a large bowl. Serve alone or on bread.

title: Mashed Potato Casserole
directions: Boil the potatoes. Drain and mash with mixer. Season to taste. Add cream cheese and beat thoroughly., Blend in eggs, parsley and onion; beat until fluffy., Place in buttered casserole. Bake, uncovered, at 325° for 25 minutes., Place French fried onions on top and bake 5 minutes more., May be prepared in advance and refrigerated., Serves 8 to 10.

title: Smoothie
directions: Mix in blender 30 seconds.

title: Whoopee Pies
directions: Cream, the margarine and sugar., Add egg yolks., Sift dry ingredients and add, alternating with milk and vanilla., Drop on greased cookie sheet by tablespoonful., Bake at 350° for 10 minutes., When cool, put together with the following filling.

title: Sour Creamed Green Beans(Serves 4 To 6)
directions: Saute onion in 1/4 cup margarine., Combine sauteed onion, green beans, sour cream, flour, salt and pepper; mix lightly. Pour into greased, 1 1/2-quart casserole., Sprinkle with cheese. Top with bread crumbs, tossed with 1/4 cup melted margarine., Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

title: Doy'S Pumpkin Pie(Makes 2 Pies)
directions: Preheat oven to 425°., Mix filling ingredients in order given. Bake for 15 minutes., Reduce heat to 350° and bake for 45 minutes or until ice pick inserted in middle comes out clean., Garnish. Optional Garnishes:, Whipped topping and chopped nuts or crushed peanut butter and 1/4 cup brown sugar or 2 tablespoons melted oleo or graham cracker crumbs mixed with melted oleo or Mandarin orange yogurt or plain whipped topping.

title: Potato Kugel(Pudding)
directions: Beat 2 eggs until fluffy., Add rest of ingredients., Spoon into buttered baking dish., Bake at 400° for 15 minutes, then at 350° for 45 minutes until golden brown and crispy.

title: Leonard'S Biscuits
