directions: Mix flour and dry ingredients in mixing bowl., Pour in milk and oil., Mix well., Pour on floured board or wax paper., Mix with hands until smooth., Pat out 1/2-inch thick and cut., Lay on cookie sheet with oil., Bake at 500° until golden brown.

title: Five Flavor Bundt Cake
directions: Cream butter, shortening and sugar. Add eggs, one at a time and beat after each egg., Add flour, salt and baking powder alternately with milk., Add extracts., Grease and flour Bundt pan., Pour into pan., Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Wendy'S Frosty
directions: Mix well. Can add additional chocolate syrup, if desired. Pour into freezer can., Freeze according to manufacturer's instructions., Makes 1 gallon.

title: Swiss Dill Loaf
directions: In large, mixing, bowl,, combine, 2 cups flour, cheese, yeast, sugar, salt and dill weed.	Heat water, milk and butter in saucepan, over medium-low heat to 125°., Stir in dry ingredients; blend well., Continue adding flour to make soft dough. Knead 4 minutes, until smooth and elastic.	Cover; let rest 10 minutes. Roll, dough, into, a 12 x 8-inch rectangle., Roll up from short end of loaf; seal ends and seams., Place in greased 8 x 4, x, 2 1/2-inch loaf pan; cover., Place large shallow pan on counter; half, fill	with boiling water., Set loaf on rack over boiling water; let dough rise until double in size, about 30 minutes., Cut 4	diagonal, slashes in top., Brush with egg white;, sprinkle with dill seed., Bake at 375° for 25 minutes.

title: Fruit Bars
directions: Cream butter and sugar; add eggs, salt and flour., Grease pan (biscuit pan) real good., Put nuts on bottom of pan and then the batter., Put pineapple and cherries on top and press into batter. Bake at 300° for 1 hour and cut in squares when cool.

title: Pecan Pie
directions: Add all ingredients to beaten eggs, except pecans, and mix well., Add pecans and pour into unbaked pie crust., Bake at 425° for 10 minutes, then reduce heat to 325° and bake for about 40 more minutes.

title: Boston Baked Beans
directions: Soak beans in 4 cups water overnight., Heat beans to boiling in same water; cover and simmer until tender, 1 to 2 hours., Drain beans, reserving liquid.

title: Sweet And Sour Red Cabbage
directions: In medium saucepan, combine all ingredients., Simmer covered about 1 hour, stirring occasionally., Serves 5 to 6 persons.

title: Greek Spaghetti
directions: Meat, Sauce:, Thin, tomato, paste, with, water., Brown ground beef, and onion in butter about 10 minutes., Add tomato paste, cinnamon, and garlic., Salt and pepper to taste., Add 1 cup of water and cook over low heat for 45 minutes until sauce is thick.

title: Garden Bean Salad
directions: In large bowl mix beans, celery, green pepper, pimientos and green onions; set aside., In saucepan, put vinegar, sugar, water and salt; boil for 5 minutes., Remove from heat and immediately pour over vegetables., Refrigerate overnight.

title: Crawfish Etouffee
directions: Saute vegetables in butter until soft; adding Tony Chachere's seasoning., Add crawfish and cook over medium heat 2 to 4 minutes. Add 6 cans of soup and lower heat to low., Do not add water and don't bring to a boiling state., Serve over white rice.

title: Mexican Dip
directions: Mix ingredients and chill., Top with shredded Cheddar cheese, chopped tomatoes, green pepper, black olives and onions., Serve with taco chips.

title: Easy Strawberry Mousse
directions: Pour boiling water into blender., Add gelatin and blend at low speed until dissolved (about 30 seconds)., Add ice cubes and stir until ice is partially melted., Add the Cool Whip. Blend at high speed for 30 seconds or until smooth., Pour into individual glasses., Chill until set, at least 30 minutes., Garnish with strawberries., Makes about 6 servings.

title: Mac Sausage And Broccoli Bake
directions: Prepare Kraft dinner as on package., Cut broccoli into 1-inch pieces., Add ingredients to dinner and mix well., Spoon mixture into 2-quart casserole and cover., Bake at 350° for 50 minutes. (Make ahead as directed except for baking.)

title: Mother'S Fudge
directions: Mix together cocoa and sugar., Add milk, Karo, and vinegar. Cook until candy reaches soft ball stage (234° on candy thermometer)., Add margarine and vanilla., After cooling, beat with spoon until fudge loses it's gloss., Drop by teaspoonfuls on waxed paper.

title: Bierocks(German Dish)
directions: Brown hamburger and onion., Add all other ingredients, except cheese, and cook until cabbage is done., Separate crescent rolls into 4 rectangles and place on an ungreased cookie sheet., Press middle perforation together., Spoon 1/2 c. meat mixture onto one half of each rectangle., Add cheese (optional)., Fold dough in half, covering the filling, and seal the side., Bake at 375° for 12 to 18 minutes.

title: Cauliflower Soup
directions: Cut up cauliflower and cook until soft., Add rest of ingredients to the cauliflower and bring to a boil.

title: German Chocolate Pound Cake
directions: Grease and flour a 10-inch tube pan., Line bottom of pan with wax paper., Set aside., Place chocolate in top of a double boiler; bring water to a boil., Reduce heat to low; cook until chocolate melts., Let cool., Cream butter; gradually add sugar, beating well at medium speed of an electric mixer., Add eggs and yolk, one at a time, beating well after each addition., Add chocolate, mixing well., Combine flour and next 4 ingredients; add flour mixture to chocolate mixture alternately with milk, beginning and ending with flour mixture., Mix after each addition., Stir in vanilla., Pour batter into pan., Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 5 minutes or until a wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean., Cool in pan 15 minutes; remove from pan and let cool on a wire rack., Pour Sweet Chocolate Glaze over top of cake.

title: Graham Bars
directions: Spread in a well-greased 9 x 9-inch baking pan., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes., Cool before cutting.

title: Basil And Potato Soup
directions: Cook onion and mushrooms in hot oil over medium-high heat until onion is tender and light brown., Add potatoes, beef broth and chicken broth; bring to boil., Cover and simmer about 30 minutes or until potatoes are tender., Fry bacon until crisp; drain and crumble.

title: Apple Dumplings
directions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees., Peel and core apples., Cut each apple into 6 pieces., Microwave apples until tender, about 3 minutes., Roll each apple slice in one crescent roll., Place in a 9 x 16 baking dish., Melt butter, and mix in sugar, cinnamon, and nutmeg., Spread the butter and sugar mixture over each roll. Gently pour Sprite over each roll, careful not to remove sugar mixture., Bake for 30 - 35 minutes.

title: Mushroom Salad
directions: Mix mushrooms, cheese and green onion together., Then mix the oil, vinegar and Cavender's Greek seasoning for dressing., After mixing well, pour over mushroom mixture., Serves 10.

title: Chocoholics' Cheesecake Muffins
directions: In a small bowl, beat cream cheese and 2 tablespoons of sugar until light and fluffy., Set aside.

title: Oatmeal Cake
directions: Mix oatmeal, oleo and boiling water; set aside for 20 minutes. Mix flour, salt, baking soda, nutmeg and cinnamon., Bake in 13 x 9-inch pan for 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Banana Bread
directions: Mix sugar and shortening., Add eggs., Add mashed bananas alternately with flour, soda and salt., Add nuts., Pour into a greased loaf pan., Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until done.

title: Mexican Casserole
directions: Brown ground beef and drain., Add to other ingredients and mix in a big casserole dish., Top with grated cheese.

title: Peanut Butter Cream Pie
directions: Whip cheese until soft and fluffy., Beat in sugar and peanut butter., Prepare whipped topping as directed on package., Fold topping into peanut butter mixture., Pour into baked pie shell. Sprinkle with chopped peanuts., Chill until firm., Makes one 8-inch pie.

title: Cabbage Noodles
directions: While cooking noodles in Dutch oven, cut up cabbage and onion. When noodles are done and drained, put butter, bacon grease and/or bacon in bottom of pan., Add cabbage and onion., Cover and cook on low heat until cabbage is transparent., When cabbage is done, mix in noodles and heat through.

title: Pinto Bean Casserole
directions: Brown meat and onion together., Add tomatoes, beans and water. Cook for 20 minutes., Put in casserole dish., Mix muffin or cornbread following directions on box., Put on top of casserole. Cook in oven until cornbread is brown.

title: Raspberry Bars
directions: Put first 5 ingredients into a mixing bowl and mix well. Grease a 9 by 13 inch pan. Take 4 cups of the mix and press into the pan. Spread the raspberry jam over the mix and then sprinkle the rest of the mix on top of the jam. Press lightly into jam.

title: Sara'S Great Pie
directions: Mix well and pour in a Keebler graham cracker pie shell. Decorate with a blob of Cool Whip when being served.

title: Sweetheart Fruit Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients and refrigerate.

title: Wendy'S Chili
directions: Blend the French onion soup in blender on high for about 5 seconds., Pour over ground beef in skillet., Cook until done., Mix all ingredients, including ground beef, in a big pan., Cook on low for about 25 minutes.

title: Ice Cream Muffins
directions: In a large mixing bowl mix flour, brown sugar, baking powder, salt and cinnamon., Mix together egg, ice cream and oil., Stir this into dry ingredients just until moistened., Fill greased muffin tins 2/3 full., Bake in a 375° oven about 18 minutes. Makes 12 muffins.

title: Beef Patties
directions: Combine 1/4 cup soup with remaining ingredients except water. Mix good; shape into 6 patties., Place in dish., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes., Drain off fat., Combine rest of soup and water., Pour over patties., Bake 10 minutes more.

title: Seven-Up Salad(Serves 10 To 12)
directions: Drain pineapple and reserve 1 cup of juice., Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water., Add Seven-Up, crushed pineapple, marshmallows and banana slices., Refrigerate until firm., Make a custard by cooking the butter, flour, eggs, sugar and 1 cup of pineapple juice until very thick., When cool, fold in whipped cream and spread over salad., Sprinkle top with grated cheeses.

title: Hot Chocolate Mix
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Use 1/3 cup to 1 cup hot water.

title: Mud Pie
directions: Heat oven to 325°., Grease a round 8-inch pan or pie plate with shortening., Mix sugar, margarine, vanilla, salt, flour, eggs and cocoa in a medium bowl with wooden spoon., Stir in nuts., Pour into pan., Bake until wooden pick inserted comes out clean, about 25 minutes., Immediately prick holes in pie with pick; spread fudge sauce over top., Cool completely. Beat the whipping cream and powdered sugar, in a small bowl until stiff. Drizzle fudge sauce on top., Store in refrigerator.

title: Annette'S Chili
directions: Brown meat and drain., Combine all ingredients., Simmer for a couple of hours.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
directions: Mix with mixer and pour into casserole dish.

title: Cheesy Vegetable Pasta
directions: In a 10 inch skillet over medium heat, in hot oil, cook zucchini with garlic until tender-crisp.

title: Mrs. See'S Fudge
directions: Into large mixing bowl, add margarine, nuts, vanilla, chocolate chips and marshmallow cream., Set aside., Make syrup of sugar and evaporated milk., Mix over medium heat and stir constantly., Bring to a boil., Boil exactly 12 minutes.

title: Caramel Corn
directions: Melt butter in 2-quart saucepan., Stir in sugar, syrup and salt., Bring to boil for 5 minutes; stir constantly., Remove from heat., Add vanilla and soda., Stir briskly so that soda can foam. Stir over popcorn in large container., Then spread out on 2 cookie sheets., Bake at 250° for 1 hour., Turn every 15 minutes., Remove and cool., Break apart and place in airtight container.

title: Berry Red Punch
directions: In punch bowl, mix the lemonade diluted according to directions., Mix in partially thawed strawberries.

title: Dirt Cake
directions: Crush cookies (reserve one for top)., Pack bottom of a 13 x 9 x 2-inch with half of cookies; press firmly., Beat cheese and sugar until creamy., Add milk and vanilla., Add the 2 boxes of pudding; beat until thick., Pour over cookies, then add other half of cookies on top., Spread Cool Whip on top., Grate cookies on top for dirt effect., Refrigerate.

title: Stuffed Mushrooms
directions: Clean mushrooms and cut stems off; fill with cream cheese filling and bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

title: Fruit Pies
directions: Bake at 400° for 15 minutes, then 35 minutes at 350°.

title: Banana Pudding
directions: Mix pudding by directions on box and add 1/2 of the Cool Whip and milk., Mix well., Alternate mixture with bananas and wafers in glass bowl., Top with remaining Cool Whip., Chill well., Makes 12 to 14 servings.

title: Pecan Pie
directions: Combine sugar, corn syrup and butter in saucepan., Bring to a boil on high, stirring constantly, until butter is melted., Remove from heat and gradually add hot syrup to beaten eggs, stirring constantly., Add pecans and cool until lukewarm., Pour into 9-inch unbaked pie shell; bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Angel Biscuits
directions: Dissolve yeast in warm water., Sift flour, baking powder and soda together., Cut in shortening., Stir in yeast mixture and buttermilk., Roll out on floured board., Cut into biscuits and allow to rise., Brush with melted butter., Bake for 10 to 20 minutes at 400°., Yields 4 dozen biscuits.

title: Punch
directions: Make, Kool-Aid	according, to, color desired and chill. Mix other, ingredients	at, time of use., For added flavor and beauty, use, 1/2 gallon pineapple sherbet, softened slightly, pouring the ginger ale over it last in the punch bowl.

title: Chocolate Chocolate Chip Cookies
directions: Cream butter, sugar, eggs and vanilla until light and fluffy. Combine soda and salt and stir together with flour and cocoa., Add to butter mixture., Stir in chips and nuts., Drop by rounded teaspoonful onto ungreased cookie sheet., Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes or just until set., Leave a few (2 to 3) minutes to cool before removing from pan.

title: Glaze For Ham
directions: Mix together and spoon over ham the last 15 minutes of baking.

title: Cottage Cake
directions: Cream sugar, butter and eggs until fluffy., Sift flour and baking powder together and add to creamed mixture alternately with milk., Pour into greased square baking pan., Bake in preheated 350° oven for 25 minutes or until done., Serve cake squares with warm sauce spooned on top.

title: Oatmeal Coconut Cookies
directions: Cream sugars, eggs and shortening., Add remaining ingredients. Mix well., Form into small balls (do not flatten)., Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes., You may use butterscotch or chocolate chips to give a different flavor., Makes 5 dozen or more.

title: Squash Casserole
directions: Cook, drain and mash squash., Add soup, sour cream and onion to squash., Melt butter in casserole., Add stuffing mix and blend well., Leave half of stuffing in bottom of the dish., Pour squash mixture on top and put rest of stuffing on top., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Watergate Pudding
directions: First Layer:, Mix well the flour, sugar, oleo and pecans in9 x 13-inch pan., Pat flat., Bake at 350° until light brown., Cool.

title: Tuna Or Chicken Casserole
directions: Add egg to cooked rice when cool enough., Spoon into 1 1/2-quart round buttered baking dish on the bottom and up sides of 1/2-inch wide rim., Mix Cheddar cheese soup and Worcestershire sauce., Bring to a boil, stirring constantly., Remove from heat and stir in green peas, tuna, sliced mushrooms and chopped pimiento. Pour into rice shell., Cover and bake at 375° for 20 minutes, until hot throughout.

title: Lemon Chiffon Pie(Diabetic)
directions: Mix gelatin with lemon juice and rind., Beat egg whites until soft peaks form., Beat egg yolks with water, salt, sweetener and flour until blended; add boiling water., Pour into saucepan; bring to a rapid boil., Stir vigorously as mixture thickens, about 1 minute., Remove from heat., Add softened gelatin immediately; stir until blended., Fold beaten egg whites into lemon mixture., Fold in whipped cream and food coloring., Brush 9-inch pie plate with oil., Coat sides and bottom of plate with crumbs., Add lemon mixture., Chill.

title: Krebbles
directions: Cook until thick, about 10 minutes., Pour into loaf pan to shape., Slice and fry in butter., It's good.

title: Chocolate Zucchini Cake
directions: Mix all together and pour into 2 greased and floured loaf pans., Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Manicotti With Cheese Filling
directions: Cook manicotti according to package directions. Drain. (Cool in single layer on wax paper or aluminum foil to prevent manicotti from sticking together.) Combine cheeses, parsley, salt and pepper for filling. Spoon into manicotti. Spread thin layer of sauce on bottom of 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Arrange manicotti in single layer over sauce. Cover with aluminum foil. Bake at 350° for about 40 minutes. Remove foil. Bake 15 minutes longer. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Corn Chowder
directions: Cook bacon and onion until tender, not brown. Add water, potatoes and corn. Cook slowly until potatoes are tender., Add salt and pepper., Just before serving, add evaporated milk and butter.

title: Sara Lee Style Cheesecake
directions: Mix and press into 8-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 10 minutes. Cool.

title: Apple Crisp
directions: Blend the first 4 ingredients with pastry blender., Place apples in 2-quart baking dish., Sprinkle with sugar mixture., Bake at 350° for 1 to 2 hours.

title: King Ranch Casserole
directions: Boil the fryer or breasts; debone and cut it to pieces., Soak tortillas a few seconds in chicken stock until wilty., Layer all ingredients in order listed., Bake in a 9 x 12-inch dish for 30 minutes at 375°., Yields 16 to 20 servings.

title: Creamy Broccoli Soup
directions: Chop onions., Peel and dice potatoes., Cook onions and potatoes in chicken broth until tender., Puree broth, potatoes and onions in blender or food processor until smooth.

title: Red Beef Curry(Low Sodium)
directions: Brown beef in shortening., Add all seasoning and tomato paste. Stir to blend., Stir in enough water to cover meat (about 1 1/4 cups)., Cover and simmer until meat is tender, about 45 minutes to 1 hour., Remove cinnamon stick., Serve over brown rice.

title: Tortilla Roll-Ups
directions: Mix first five ingredients well., Spread mixture onto flour tortillas and roll them up., Chill., Cut into slices like cinnamon rolls., Great appetizers or party snacks.

title: Plum Dipping Sauce
directions: Combine all ingredients in a small saucepan over low heat. Stir just until jam is melted.

title: Christmas Fruit Cookies
directions: Cream oleo and sugar., Add eggs and milk., Fold in soda, flour and vanilla., Steam raisins for 15 minutes; add to batter., Mix nuts, fruit and coconut with an extra cup of flour; mix in batter. Drop by spoonful onto greased cookie sheet., Bake at 350° for 12 minutes.

title: Cabbage Soup
directions: Combine all ingredients in large soup pot., Simmer for 1 hour or until cabbage is tender., Add other vegetables to suit tastes or to recycle leftovers.

title: Sugared Nuts
directions: Cook above to soft ball stage., Add 3 cups walnuts after removing from heat., Mix well., Spread quickly on wax paper to separate.

title: Valley Ranch Pinwheels(A Southwest Missouri Delicacy)
directions: Mix together cream cheese and salad dressing mix., Spread evenly over the tortillas., Drain vegetables and blot dry on paper towels., Sprinkle equal amount of remaining ingredients on top of cream cheese mixture., Roll tortillas tightly (dampen edge to seal and secure it with toothpicks)., Chill at least 2 hours., Cut rolls into one-inch pieces., Discard ends., Serve with spiral facing up., Makes about 3 dozen.

title: Sour Cream Apple Pie
directions: In a large bowl, beat eggs., Add sour cream; stir in sugar, 2 tablespoons of flour, vanilla and salt., Mix well., Stir in apples., Pour into pie shell. Bake at 375° for 15 minutes. Meanwhile, combine butter, brown sugar and remaining flour. Sprinkle over top of pie., Return to oven for 20 to 25 minutes or until filling is set., Cool completely on a wire rack., Serve or cover and refrigerate., Yields 8 servings.

title: Cheese Bread
directions: Combine egg, buttermilk, baking mix and cheese in a bowl., Mix well., Pour into 2 small or 1 large greased loaf pan., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes., Let cool for several minutes., Cut into slices to, but not through, bottom., Spread slices apart. Drizzle mixture of melted margarine and garlic salt over and between slices., May wrap in aluminum foil and reheat several times.

title: Herb Bread
directions: Mix the butter, onion, parsley, basil and lemon juice and spread on the bread slices., Heat on a cookie sheet at 250° for 25 minutes., Separate slices before serving.

title: Squash Relish
directions: Mix in a large container., Simmer for 20 minutes., Put in hot jars and seal., Makes approximately 10 pints.

title: Smothered Pork Chops
directions: Place chops in baking dish., Do not need to brown them., Mix remaining ingredients and pour over chops., Bake 1 1/2 to 2 hours depending on thickness of chops at 375°.

title: Artichoke Pickle
directions: Mix all ingredients except onion in a large pot and bring to a boil., Pack jars with artichokes and pour hot liquid over., Place 2 or 3 onion rings on top of pickle., Seal jars while still hot. You can add 1 hot pepper to each jar if you like them hot.

title: Chinese Chicken-Cabbage Salad
directions: Preparation takes 30 minutes; prepare at least 1/2 day ahead.

title: Apple Pudding Cake
directions: Peel apples in thin wedge slices., Grease small pie dish well and flour., Mix all ingredients., Pour in pan., Arrange apple wedges around the top (slightly overlap)., Fill in center., Mix 2 tablespoons of sugar and 1 teaspoon of cinnamon; sprinkle over top., Dot generously with margarine or butter., Bake at 400° for 30 to 35 minutes., Peaches can be substituted for apples.

title: Mom'S Peanut Butter Cookies
directions: Mix shortening, peanut butter, sugars and egg thoroughly. Blend all dry ingredients and stir into shortening mixture., Roll dough in 1 1/4-inch balls., Place 3 inches apart on lightly greased cookie sheet., Flatten crisscross style with fork dipped in flour., Bake 10 minutes in a 350° oven., Makes 3 dozen.

title: Chess Pie
directions: Mix and pour into 2 unbaked pie shells., Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

title: Dump Cake
directions: Place one layer on top of the other in the order given in a 9 x 13 baking pan., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Strawberry Bavarian
directions: Pour boiling water over Jell-O to dissolve., Stir in sugar and berries., May use up to one cup of juice from berries., Mix well. Put in refrigerator until mixture is starting to set up., Remove from refrigerator and beat mixture until foamy., Fold in Cool Whip.

title: Vanilla Sour Cream Sauce
directions: Gently combine and chill for 2 hours., Serve with fresh fruits: cantaloupe chunks, green grapes, orange sections, banana slices, etc.

title: Pecan Tarts
directions: Mix and let pastry set in refrigerator overnight.

title: Quaker Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Heat oven to 375°., Beat butter and sugars until creamy., Add eggs, milk and vanilla; beat well., Add flour, baking soda and salt; mix well., Stir in oats., Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet., Bake 9 to 10 minutes for a chewy cookie or 12 to 13 minutes for a crisp cookie., Cool 1 minute., Makes 5 dozen 2 1/2-inch cookies.

title: Nutty Fingers
directions: Cream, margarine, and, powdered sugar.	Add vanilla and water. Add flour., Mix well, then add nuts., Roll batter into finger shaped, dough, about 1 1/2-inches long., Bake for about 20 minutes or, until	they turn lightly brown at 300°., Cool. While still a little warm roll in powdered sugar.

title: Egg Custard
directions: Mix flour, sugar, baking powder and egg, yolks. (Keep egg whites in a separate bowl for meringue.) Add sweet milk to mixture of flour, sugar, powder and yolks. Mix until smooth and pour into crusts. Bake at 325° until, crust and filling are brown.

title: Fruit Salad
directions: Mix together and refrigerate.

title: Pralines
directions: In a large saucepan, mix sugar, soda, salt and buttermilk. Cook on medium heat until boils., Cook for 5 minutes after starting to boil., Add butter and pecan pieces; cook until soft ball forms., Mixture will be a dark brown color., Let stand for 1 to 2 minutes., Add pecan halves; beat until creamy and thick. Drop by spoonfuls onto waxed paper.

title: Praline Cheese Cake
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Combine crumbs, sugar and margarine; press onto bottom of 9-inch springform pan., Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.

title: Applesauce Cake
directions: Reserve 1/4 cup flour to dredge walnuts and raisins., Sift all dry ingredients into large bowl., Make a well in sifted dry ingredients., Add applesauce, oil and eggs; mix., Dredge raisins and walnuts with 1/4 cup flour., Add to cake mixture., Bake in well-greased and floured angel food cake pan at 325° for first 20 minutes and at 350° the last 40 minutes., Let cool in pan before removing.

title: Beef Stir-Fry
directions: May substitute or add other vegetables (carrots, celery or zucchini, etc.).

title: Strawberry Pretzel Dessert
directions: Combine ingredients, pat into 13 x 9-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.

title: Fudge
directions: Combine sugar and milk; mix thoroughly., Add margarine; bring to a full boil, stirring constantly.

title: Hot Dip
directions: Cream all ingredients. Put in greased dish., Cover with chopped pecans., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes., If doubled, bake at 325° for 30 minutes., Can make in advance., Best served with Triscuits or other snack crackers.

title: Jalapeno Corn Bread
directions: Preheat oven to 425°., Mix all ingredients together., Pour into hot 8-inch cast-iron skillet., Bake 20 minutes., Enjoy!

title: Carolina Peach Pie
directions: Cut 1/2 cup butter into mixture of 1 1/2 cups flour and 1/2 teaspoon salt until crumbly., Pat into 9-inch pie plate., Sprinkle peaches with 1/4 cup sugar., Combine 2 tablespoons flour, 3/4 cup sugar, egg, 1/4 teaspoon salt, vanilla and sour cream in bowl; mix well., Fold in peaches., Spoon into prepared pie plate., Bake at 400° for 15 minutes., Reduce temperature to 350°., Bake 20 minutes longer., Sprinkle mixture of remaining 1/3 cup sugar, 1/3 cup flour and cinnamon over pie., Bake 10 minutes., Delicious served with peach or pralines and cream, ice cream or whipped cream.

title: Fresh Strawberry Pie
directions: Combine sugar, cornstarch and water in saucepan., Cook until thick and clear., Add jello powder and mix well., Cool slightly and pour over strawberries., Top with whip cream or ice cream.

title: Scallop Casserole
directions: Fill a buttered casserole dish with alternate layers of scallops and cornflakes., Dot top layer of cornflakes with butter. Season cream with salt, pepper and sherry., Pour slowly over scallops and cornflakes., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes., Serves 4.

title: Brown Bread
directions: Mix together., Steam 3 hours., Grease 2 coffee cans., Put in a canner with 3 inches of water., Put covers on cans and boil 3 hours.

title: Shrimp Dip
directions: Cream the cream cheese and chop the onions fine., Mix together remaining ingredients with mixer., Chill several hours and serve with crackers.

title: Pineapple Cake
directions: Prepare yellow cake mix as directed., Bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan., After cake is baked, poke holes in the top with fork and spread pineapple over top., Cool., Add milk to pudding., Beat at low speed until blended., Fold Cool Whip into pudding mixture and spread over cooled cake., Refrigerate.

title: Strawberry Shortcake
directions: Combine dry ingredients., Combine egg, milk and butter., Mix together both mixtures just until moist., Spread in greased 9x9 baking dish.

title: Scallops In Chafing Dish (Or Electric Skillet)
directions: Heat butter in top of chafing dish over low flame., Add enough scallops to cover bottom of chafing dish; cook until scallops lose their transparency (7 to 8 minutes)., Push to side and continue until all scallops are cooked., Sprinkle with salt, pepper, dash of cayenne and either chives or parsley., Stir in lemon juice or wine., Heat thoroughly., Place top-pan over hot water to keep warm without over cooking scallops., Makes 6 servings.

title: Apple Bread
directions: Grease 2 loaf pans., In a large bowl, beat together the sugar, oil and eggs., In a separate bowl, sift together the flour, salt, baking soda and cinnamon., Add the dry ingredients to the sugar mixture., Add the vanilla, apples and nuts., Pour the batter into the prepared pans., Bake in 325° oven for 1 hour.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Stir together flour, baking powder, baking soda and 1/4 teaspoon salt.

title: Quick Chicken Pot Pie
directions: Combine first 5 ingredients., Spoon into prepared pie crust. Cover with top pie crust; crimp edges to seal., Slit top crust. Bake at 375° for 40 to 60 minutes., Cool 10 minutes.

title: Carrot Cake
directions: With a mixer, beat eggs., Fold in flour, soda, cinnamon, walnuts, oil and raw carrots., Pour into an ungreased cake pan and bake for 1 hour at 300°.

title: Pork Chops And Rice For Slow Cooker
directions: Brown pork chops., Put rice and mushroom slices on each pork chop., Mix rest of ingredients, adding a can of water in order to have enough liquid to cover chops., Bring to a boil and then simmer until rice is cooked and pork is well done.

title: Hot Pineapple Salad
directions: Drain and save juice from both cans of pineapple., Mix reserved juice, flour and sugar; add to the pineapple and mix. Pour in a medium Pyrex dish., Grate cheese; sprinkle over pineapple., Mix crackers and butter and put on top of the cheese. Bake in 350° oven for 30 minutes, uncovered.

title: Penne With Stir-Fried Beef And Red Bellpepper
directions: In a bowl whisk together the cornstarch, the soy sauce, the broth, the Scotch, the sugar and the sesame oil., In a large heavy skillet or a wok heat 1 tablespoon of the vegetable oil over high heat until it just begins to smoke and in it stir-fry the beef, patted dry, in 2 batches, for 30 seconds, or until it is browned but still pink within, transferring it with a slotted spoon as it browns to a bowl., In the skillet heat 1 tablespoon of the remaining vegetable oil over moderately high heat until it is hot but not smoking, in it stir-fry the bell peppers for 2 minutes, or until they are crisp-tender, and transfer them to the bowl with the beef., In the remaining 1 tablespoon vegetable oil, stir-fry the garlic and the ginger root over moderately high heat for 30 seconds, stir the cornstarch mixture, and add it to the skillet. Cook the sauce, stirring, until it is thickened and stir in the beef mixture, the scallions, the red pepper flakes, and salt to taste., In a kettle of boiling salted water boil the penne until it is al dente, drain it well and in a large bowl toss it with the beef mixture., Serves 4 to 6.

title: Hamburger Pot Pie
directions: Fry hamburger and onion until tender., Add salt, pepper, mixed vegetables, milk and tomato soup., Pour all together in a large baking dish., Add cheese., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes., Place biscuits on top of baked mixture., Bake until brown.

title: Cutout Cookies
directions: Cream sugar and shortening. Add eggs and vanilla, mixing well. Mix dry ingredients and add to creamed mixture. Roll out and cut in your favorite shapes. Bake at 400° for 8 to 12 minutes. Cool on racks.

title: Easy Chicken Casserole
directions: Place cut up chicken breast pieces (bite-size) in 9 x 13-inch casserole dish., Mix sour cream and undiluted soup together and pour over chicken pieces., Sprinkle crackers on top and pour melted margarine over crackers., Bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes or until chicken is tender.

title: Caramel Cake
directions: Place a rack in the center of the oven and preheat the oven to 350°., Generously grease cake pan with solid vegetable shortening, then dust with flour., Shake out the excess flour. Set the pans aside., Place the cake mix, milk, melted butter, eggs and vanilla extract in a large mixing bowl., Blend with an electric mixer on low speed for 1 minute., Stop the machine and scrape down the sides of the bowl with a rubber spatula., Increase the mixer speed to medium and beat 2 minutes more, scraping the sides down again if needed., The batter should look well blended.

title: Breaded Deboned Chicken
directions: Dip chicken in beaten eggs; add dash of salt and pepper., Dip in Ritz crackers (crumbled), then dip in melted oleo, on one side only., Place in pan with butter dipped side up., Bake at 350° for 1 hour (1/2 hour with covered foil and 1/2 hour without covered foil).

title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
directions: Measure flour and sift 3 times., Measure sugar and sift 3 times., Cream butter well., Add sugar gradually to butter, creaming until light and fluffy., Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each., Add flour and soda that have been sifted together, alternately with sour cream., Use any desired flavoring., Bake at 300° for 2 hours or 325° for 1 1/2 hours in a greased and floured tube pan., Cool in pan about 10 minutes., Turn out.

title: Refrigerator Pickles
directions: Mix the vinegar, sugar, salt and celery seed. Stir well until dissolved., Pour over cucumbers and onions., Store in refrigerator.

title: Chili
directions: Brown meat and onion., Drain grease., Add remaining ingredients; bring to a boil., Cover and cook for 1 hour on low.

title: Mexican Chicken Casserole
directions: Mix water and butter in an 8 x 12-inch baking dish until butter is melted., Stir in stuffing mix and 1/4 cup salsa. Arrange chicken over stuffing., Pour remaining salsa over chicken. Cover dish with foil; bake for 30 minutes, or until chicken is done., Remove foil., Sprinkle with cheese., Bake for 5 minutes, until cheese is melted., Serves 4.

title: Chocolate Pound Cake
directions: Sift salt, baking powder and flour together in a bowl., Cream Crisco and sugar together with mixer., Add eggs, one at the time; beat well., Add milk, a little at the time, with flour mixture and and also cocoa., Add add vanilla., Mix well.

title: Sweet Potatoes Anna
directions: Toss potatoes with butter, sugar and seasonings., Mix well. In foil-lined 9-inch cake pan arrange a layer of potatoes, closely overlapping slices., Sprinkle with cheese., Layer remaining potatoes on top., Loosely cover pan., Bake at 425° for 60 minutes or until fork-tender., Remove foil and invert onto serving plate. Makes 6 servings.

title: Tona'S Arroz Con Pollo
directions: Simmer chicken, garlic and 1/2 teaspoon of salt in water in large saucepan for 30 minutes., Remove chicken; drain, reserving 2 cups stock., Cool chicken to touch., Remove skin and bones., Cut chicken into bite size pieces. Cook rice in oil in 10-inch skillet over low heat, stirring occasionally, until golden brown., Stir in reserved stock, chicken, picante sauce, cumin, pepper and remaining 1 teaspoon salt., Bring to a boil, reduce heat, cover and continue cooking until most of the liquid is absorbed, about 5 minutes., Serve with additional picante sauce., Makes 6 servings.

title: Holiday Mold Salad
directions: Mix lemon Jell-O with 2 cups boiling water., Mix in cream cheese., Add crushed pineapple and juice., Pour into favorite mold., Refrigerate 6 to 8 hours or overnight.

title: Mmmate'S Masterpiece Macaroni Salad
directions: Chop onions., Place onions and whole eggs in boiling water; lower heat to simmer and cook for 20 minutes., Drain eggs, and onions, being careful not to lose onions., Let eggs cool; peel. Chop whites and mash yolks.

title: Oatmeal Chewies
directions: Combine the oats and sugar with the oil., Let stand at room temperature for an hour., Add the egg, salt, vanilla and coconut and combine well., The dough will have a crumbled appearance. Place level tablespoons of the dough on greased cookie sheets and bake in a moderate oven, 325°, for 12 to 15 minutes or until lightly browned., Remove immediately from the cookie sheets. Makes 3 dozen., I always bake this as a bar cookie in a 7 x 11-inch pan.

title: Chicken Noodle Casserole
directions: Cook noodles and drain., Mix all ingredients in casserole dish and bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Easy Make Dressing
directions: Bake a cake of cornbread., When cool, crumble and mix together with all the soups., Add pepper and sage to taste., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Chocolate Pudding
directions: Mix dry ingredients together., Beat egg yolks well and mix slowly with milk., Combine with dry ingredients in large saucepan. Cook over low heat (or double boiler), stirring constantly., Add margarine and vanilla., Pour over vanilla wafers in large Pyrex bowl after chocolate mixture thickens.

title: Italian Bundles
directions: Cut each sheet of dough into 4 squares., Layer ingredients in center of each square., Repeat to form second layering., Fold up all sides and use water to stick., Place on baking sheet, folded side down., Brush with beaten egg., Bake at 400° for 15 minutes or until brown., Makes 8 bundles, approximately 2 per person.

title: Popcorn Cake
directions: Cook until syrup holds popcorn and nuts together., Pour and pack into tube pan to form cake.

title: Southern Pound Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°. Mix all ingredients. Grease and flour tube pan or Bundt pan. Bake for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

title: Burgundy-Berried Ham(Microwave Recipe)
directions: In a 2 cup glass measure, combine brown sugar, cranberry sauce, wine and mustard., Heat, uncovered, at High for 4 minutes until sugar is melted and mixture blended and heated through, stirring after 2 minutes.

title: Sixty Minute Rolls
directions: In large bowl, mix 1 1/2 cups of flour, sugar, salt and yeast. In saucepan, combine milk, water and oleo., Heat until very warm., Add to dry ingredients., Add more flour until soft dough; knead in rest and let rise 15 minutes., Bake at 425°.

title: Banana Split Supreme
directions: Combine melted margarine and graham cracker crumbs., Pat in bottom of a 13 x 9-inch baking dish., Combine sugar and flour with pineapple., Cook over medium heat until thickened; remove from heat and cool completely., Prepare pudding as directed on box. Layer bananas on graham cracker crust, then pudding, followed by pineapple mixture, coconut and pecans., Cover top with softened Cool Whip., Sprinkle more coconut and pecans on top., Chill to serve.

title: Spicy Lemon Marinade
directions: Combine ingredients., Use to marinate poultry or veal.

title: Chex Party Mix
directions: Melt butter, stir in Worcestershire sauce and salt., Pour over cereal and mixture., Bake 1 hour, stirring every 15 minutes. Spread out to cool.

title: Chocolate Cake
directions: Combine flour, cocoa and salt., Set aside., Cream sugar and shortening, then blend in eggs and vanilla., Mix together cold water and baking soda., To creamed mixture, alternately add flour mixture and water mixture, beginning and ending with dry ingredients., Sprinkle chocolate chips and chopped nuts over top and bake in 9 x 13-inch pan at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Pasta Salad
directions: Fix noodles according to package, let cool., Mix together onion, cucumbers and green pepper., Add mayonnaise., Enjoy!

title: Hush Puppies
directions: Mix well., Do not add water until ready to cook., Spoon into hot clean oil.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
directions: Place sliced potatoes and onions in layers. Sprinkle salt, pepper, parsley and oregano on each layer., Dot with butter., Pour soup and milk over potatoes., Bake in covered casserole dish for 1 hour at 350°.

title: Coconut-Almond Butter Cookies
directions: In large mixer bowl, cream butter or margarine and 1 cup powdered sugar until fluffy., Add coconut and extract., Gradually mix in flour; stir in nuts., Shape dough into 1-inch balls., Bake on ungreased cookie sheet in 325° oven for 15 to 17 minutes. Place on rack., Combine remaining sugar and cinnamon., Sprinkle over warm cookies., Makes 5 1/2 dozen.

title: Cocktail Meatballs
directions: In mixing bowl, mix together the ground beef, egg, water, bread crumbs and onion., Roll into small meatballs., Bake in 350° oven for 20-25 minutes, turning once.

title: Chocolate Clouds(Makes Approximately 30 Cookies.)
directions: Beat egg whites and cream of tartar in large mixing bowl until soft peaks form., Gradually add sugar and vanilla, beating until stiff peaks hold, sugar is dissolved and mixture is glossy., Sift cocoa onto egg white mixture; gently fold just until completely combined., Fold in chocolate chips (or chunks)., Drop by heaping tablespoons onto foil covered insulated baking sheet., Bake at 300° for 35 to 45 minutes or just until dry., Carefully peel cookies off foil., Cool completely., Store covered at room temperature.

title: Angel Food Cake
directions: Sift flour with 3/4 cup sugar and salt 4 times., Beat egg whites with cream of tartar until soft peaks form., Add remaining sugar, 2 tablespoons at a time., Beat well after each addition. Sift 1/4 cup flour mixture by fourths., Turn into 10-inch tube pan. Bake in preheated 375° oven for 35 to 40 minutes or until cake tests done., Invert pan on funnel., Cool completely., Remove from pan., Yields 10 to 12 servings.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
directions: Mash potatoes., Mix in sugar, margarine, eggs, vanilla and milk., Put in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish., Melt margarine and mix in brown sugar, flour and pecans., Sprinkle on top of potato mixture., Bake at 350° for 25 minutes., Serves 10 to 12.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Cream the butter and sugar., Add eggs., Sift all dry ingredients and add to egg mixture., Stir in oats, nuts and raisins., Drop 1 heaping teaspoonful at a time on ungreased pan and bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Pat'S Chicken
directions: Defrost spinach and squeeze dry. Spread it in a 9 x 12 oiled pan. Add chicken. Pour soup and mayonnaise over dish. Add seasoned crumbs, then sprinkle with Parmesan cheese., Bake at 400° for 3/4 hour.

title: Aunt Susan'S Carrot Cake
directions: Mix salad oil and sugar., Add eggs, one at a time, beating well., Add to mixture the flour, baking powder, salt, baking soda and cinnamon., Add carrots, pineapple and pecans., Blend well. Pour into waxed paper lined pans., Bake at 350° for 35 minutes for layers or 45 to 50 minutes for loaf., Makes 3 layers or 10 x 13-inch loaf pan cake.

title: Green Bean Casserole
directions: Drain green beans; mix with soup., Spread in casserole dish and sprinkle with salt and pepper., Top with onion rings., Bake uncovered at 350° for 20 to 40 minutes.

title: Mexican Roll-Ups
directions: Beat the cream cheese until creamy., Beat in sour cream., Add chilies, onion and cheese., Mix., Heat the flour tortillas. Spread mixture on the tortillas., Roll up and refrigerate., Slice when chilled and serve with salsa.

title: Twice Baked Potatoes
directions: Bake potatoes until done., Slice top quarter off., Scoop the insides out., Leave 1/4-inch all the way around., Mash the scooped out potato and the insides of the cap together with butter, Velveeta cheese and enough milk to make it creamy., Salt and pepper to taste., Put back in potato peels., Bake to heat through.

title: Pumpkin Pie Cake
directions: Mix and pour in greased 9 x 13-inch pan., Sprinkle box of yellow cake mix over this mixture., Top cake with 1 cup of chopped nuts., Bake at 325° for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Easy Scalloped Potatoes
directions: Combine potatoes with onion, salt and milk in electric skillet., Cook, covered, with vent closed, at simmer for 30 to 40 minutes or until tender., Sprinkle cheese, pepper and bread crumbs over top., Continue cooking, uncovered, for 15 to 20 minutes. Reduce to warm for serving., Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Fruit Dip
directions: Mix and serve as dip for fresh fruit.

title: Orange Jello
directions: Make Jell-O according to package, but use 1/2 cup less water. When Jell-O starts to jell, add mandarin oranges and whipping cream., Stir until smooth., Add cottage cheese and nuts., Stir and put back into refrigerator until jelled.

title: 7-Up Jello Salad
directions: Mix Jell-O with cream cheese., Boil 7-Up; add coconut, nuts, pineapple and marshmallows.

title: Chess Cake
directions: Mix cake mix, butter and 1 egg., Spread in pan., Mix cream, 2 eggs and powdered sugar., Pour on top of cake mixture., Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes., Do not overcook; let top get lightly brown.

title: Buttermilk Salad
directions: Bring pineapple juice and jello to a boil., Take off and let cool., Stir in Cool Whip and four cups buttermilk., Add pineapple and nuts and stir., Let congeal.

title: Quick Cookies
directions: Mix ingredients., Just drop from teaspoon., Bake at 350° for 9 to 12 minutes., Cool 1 minute and eat.

title: Apple Butter(Using Apple Pulp)
directions: Cook apples whole in about 2 cups of water until soft. Press through a sieve or food mill. Measure pulp. Add sugar and spices. Cook pulp until thick enough to round up in a spoon. As pulp thickens, stir frequently to prevent sticking. (If too thick, add a small amount of water.) Pour into hot sterilized jars leaving 1/4 inch head space. Adjust caps. Process pints and quarts 10 minutes in boiling water bath. Yield about 5 pints. Very good.

title: Meatballs
directions: Combine milk, 2 teaspoons Worcestershire sauce and soup mix and blend well., Let stand 5 minutes and add beef., Mix well. Shape into balls, using 1 teaspoon for each., Broil 5 to 6-inches from heat for 10 to 12 minutes., Do not turn., Combine remaining ingredients in saucepan., Cook until heated through., Add meatballs and serve.

title: Squash Casserole
directions: Cook squash and onion until tender., Drain and season with salt, pepper and 1 tablespoon of margarine., Stir in chicken soup and sour cream., In a bowl, combine 1/2 cup margarine and dressing mix, stirring until well blended., Combine one half of dressing mix with squash mixture., Spoon into casserole dish and top with remaining dressing mix., Bake at 375° for 30 minutes.

title: Pineapple Pie
directions: Combine pineapple, cornstarch, sugar and salt., Cook until thick and clear, stirring constantly., Add butter and lemon juice; pour into pie crust., Bake at 425° for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Deer Bologna
directions: Mix deer and pork meats together., Mix all dry ingredients together, then add to meat mixture., Add liquid smoke., Mix well. Roll into loaves and cover., Refrigerate for 24 hours., Bake at 250° for 2 hours., Freeze loaves if not used right away., Unthaw and slice.

title: Angel Custard Royal
directions: Divide cake into 3 parts., Break into small pieces and line bottom of pan with 1/3 of cake., Combine sugar, egg yolks, lemon juice and grated peel., Cook over hot water (not boiling) until mixture coats spoon., Remove from fire and add gelatin which has been soaked in cold water., Cool until almost set., Beat egg whites; fold in 1 cup sugar and add food color., Arrange 1/3 cake in pan and alternately cake with custard., Chill overnight. Remove from pan and cover with whipped cream.

title: Icebox Christmas Cookies
directions: Roll out dough. Sprinkle with fruits and nuts. Then shape into a roll. Refrigerate before baking. (Makes it easy to slice.) Will keep for 2 months. Bake in 350° oven as needed, 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Peach, Blueberry Or Blackberry Crisp
directions: Place berries or peaches in long baking dish., Sprinkle with brown, sugar, and, dot, liberally with oleo., Mix flour, sugar, baking, powder and egg until crumbly., Sprinkle evenly over fruit. Bake, 45, minutes	or, until brown on top in 350° oven.

title: Drop Biscuits
directions: Sift dry ingredients together., Cut in butter or margarine. Add milk and stir., Drop onto a greased baking sheet., Bake at 450° for 12 minutes., Makes 12.

title: Strawberry Congealed Salad
directions: Dissolve jello in water., Add strawberries, pineapple and bananas to jello., Congeal 1/2 ingredients in dish, then spread sour cream, add rest of ingredients and congeal.

title: Zucchini Bread
directions: In a large bowl, mix zucchini, sugar, oil, eggs and vanilla with a big spoon., Add flour, baking soda, salt and cinnamon., Mix well., Fold in nuts and raisins., Grease and flour two 9 x 5-inch loaf pans., Divide batter into 2 pans., Bake 70 minutes at 350°. Cool 10 minutes in pan, then cool on rack., Freezes well.

title: Chicken Curry
directions: Sprinkle chicken pieces with salt and pepper., Melt 4 tablespoons of butter in skillet., Add chicken pieces and cook 5 minutes on one side until golden., Add onion, celery, garlic and curry powder., Stir well and cook 5 more minutes., Add bay leaf, apples and banana and cook 5 more minutes, stirring gently., Add chicken broth and simmer 15 minutes or until chicken is tender. Remove chicken pieces and stir cream or yogurt into sauce., Return chicken to sauce., Serve with rice.

title: Unexpected Company Casserole
directions: In casserole dish, put a layer of potatoes, a layer of ground meat and a sprinkling of onions., Repeat 4 or 5 times., Salt and pepper to taste as you layer., Pour gravy over, adding 1/2 can of water., Place in oven at 375° for 1 hour., Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Chocolate Trifle
directions: Bake cake and cut into cubes., Make pudding., In glass bowl, layer cake, pudding, Cool Whip and Skor bars twice., Chill 12 to 24 hours and serve.

title: Dump Cake
directions: Layer all ingredients in pan as such: pineapple, pie filling, dry cake mix and nuts., Drizzle butter all over top., Bake at 350° for 48 to 53 minutes.

title: Little Hats Cavandele(Curl Noodles)
directions: Make a well with flour., Add beaten eggs., Add butter gradually., Add enough water to firm dough., Knead until smooth. Pinch off dough with thumb., Boil in salted water until done.

title: Grandma'S Sugar Cookies
directions: Mix together in order given., Frost with your favorite frosting.

title: Rice Salad
directions: Combine all ingredients except corn chips., Chill and add corn chips at serving time.

title: Corn Cob Jelly
directions: Boil, broken cobs in water for 30 minutes., Remove from heat. Strain, liquid., Add, enough water to make 3 cups.	Add pectin. Bring to a rolling boil., Add sugar and boil for 2 or 3, minutes. Remove, from heat.	Pour into sterilized jars and seal.

title: Baked Pineapple
directions: Mix first 4 ingredients in a casserole and bake for 15 minutes at 325°., Brown cubed bread in butter., Mix some of the bread with the pineapple, then cover top of pineapple with remainder of bread cubes., Bake at 325° for 1/2 to 3/4 hour.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
directions: In a large oblong pan, put chicken broth, cream of chicken soup, cream of mushroom soup, salt and pepper., Stir all ingredients well., Add cubed potatoes, onion, English peas and corn., Add cubed chicken and mix thoroughly., Cook in oven at 375° for 40 minutes., Remove from oven and cover top of mixture with 20 halves of flaky biscuits. Return to oven and cook until biscuits are done and a golden brown., This will brown in a few minutes as mixture is already hot., Biscuits are broken in halves to cover the top of mixture in pan.

title: Cocoa Syrup(Good On Ice Cream)
directions: Mix sugar, salt and cocoa dry., Add sufficient water to make a paste, then remainder of water., Bring to boil, stirring constantly., Boil 3 minutes and add vanilla., Pour at once into a jar., When cool, keep in refrigerator.

title: Oatmeal-Carrot Cookies
directions: In a large mixing bowl, beat margarine or butter with an electric mixer on medium to high speed for 30 seconds or until softened., Add about half of the flour, then the brown sugar, sugar, egg, baking powder, vanilla, cinnamon, baking soda and cloves., Beat until combined, scraping the sides of the bowl occasionally., Beat or stir in remaining flour., Stir in oats, carrots and raisins, if desired., Drop dough by rounded teaspoonfuls 2 inches apart onto an ungreased cookie sheet., Bake in a 375° oven for 10 to 12 minutes or until the edges are golden. Remove from the baking sheet; cool on a wire rack., Makes about 4 dozen.

title: Chocolate And Butterscotch Peanut Clusters
directions: Melt wax, then add chips and peanut butter., Then add peanuts. Drop onto wax paper.

title: Barbecued Spareribs
directions: Trim any excess fat from ribs., Place in large, shallow baking pan so that ribs are in a single layer., Measure seasonings and spices and mix together., Sprinkle generously over ribs on both sides., Slice onion over top and pour tomato sauce over all., Add water and sprinkle sugar over sauce., Bake in moderate oven (325°) for 2 to 2 1/2 hours or until very tender., Baste often and turn ribs several times during cooking., Add more water if necessary, but sauce should be thick enough to cling to meat when done.

title: Country Cafe'S Shrimp Spread
directions: Mix all of the ingredients with fork., Chill., Serve with crackers.

title: Angus Barn Sour Cream Pound Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Grease and flour tube pan., Beat sugar and butter until light and fluffy., Add eggs one at a time until well incorporated., Sift cake flour and measure., Add baking powder to flour., Alternately add flour and sour cream to sugar and egg mixture., When well mixed, add vanilla., Pour mixture into pan and bake at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Cajun Breakfast Casserole
directions: In 9 x 13-inch baking dish, butter bottom and sides of dish. Layer bottom with 8 slices of bread., Cover bread with drained, browned ground sausage., Sprinkle cheddar cheese until sausage is covered., Cover with remaining 8 slices of bread., Mix together in a large bowl beaten eggs and all other ingredients except butter and corn flakes., Pour over top of bread., Cover with foil and refrigerate overnight., When ready to serve, melt butter and pour over top of casserole., Top with cornflakes., Bake, uncovered, for 1 hour at 350°., Let stand 10 minutes before serving., Serves 16.

title: Nuggets
directions: Cream sugar and shortening; add eggs., Mix well., Add flour, salt, baking powder and cinnamon which have been sifted together. Stir until dry ingredients are moistened., Add nuts and raisins or chopped dates., Drop by heaping teaspoonfuls onto greased cookie sheets., Bake at 375° about 15 minutes., Remove to wire rack., Cool and store in tight container.

title: Simple Baked Ham
directions: Select right size baking pan., Lay aluminum foil in pan and then put ham on top of foil., Put brown sugar and pineapple on top of ham., Wrap the foil around ham., Bake in oven at 350° to 400° for about 2 1/2 to 3 hours., Pour a little water around ham to prevent burning at bottom, if ham starts to burn.

title: Grandma'S Biscuits Supreme
directions: Sift together flour, baking powder, salt, cream of tartar and sugar; cut in shortening until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Add milk, all at once., Stir only until dough is moist., Bake 10 to 12 minutes at 450°.

title: Tortilla Chip Dip
directions: Brown ground chuck and drain., Prepare taco mix according to directions on package., Mix in refried beans., Let simmer 15 minutes., Top with cheese, sour cream and taco sauce., Dip with chips.

title: Turkish Shish Kebab
directions: Place lamb in a bowl., Add remaining ingredients and marinate for at least 3 to 4 hours., Cook on skewers over charcoal fire after sprinkling meat lightly with salt.

title: Basic Cream Pie
directions: Combine first 3 ingredients in top of double boiler., Stir in cold milk., Cook until thick, stirring constantly., Stir a little of the mixture into the egg yolks., Add to remaining mixture. Cook 2 minutes longer, stirring constantly., Cool and stir in vanilla., Pour into pie shell and cover with meringue.

title: Corn Casserole(Yield:  6 Servings)
directions: Melt margarine; stir in flour until smooth., Add half and half and simmer until it thickens., Put drained corn in baking dish. Pour sauce over it., Bake at 325° for 15 minutes.

title: Green Pepper Steak
directions: Cut beef across grain into thin strips (1/8-inch thick). Combine soy sauce, garlic and ginger., Add beef, toss and set aside while preparing vegetables., Heat oil in large frypan or wok., Add beef, toss until brown., Cover and simmer 30 minutes.

title: Pumpkin Bread
directions: In a large bowl, sift all dry ingredients., Add oil, pumpkin and water., Mix well with beater., Add whole eggs, one at a time. Beat in each egg., Pour batter into 2 greased and floured loaf pans., Bake 1 hour at 350°.

title: Ranch Potatoes
directions: Boil potatoes until tender., Place in baking dish., Layer butter on potatoes., Then drizzle on dressing and bacon bits and top with cheese., Bake 20 minutes or until cheese is melted.

title: Mud Cake
directions: Melt margarine., Mix all other ingredients together and pour over cake., Work in with marshmallows.

title: Crescent Roll Appetizer
directions: Blend together mushrooms, cream cheese and seasoned salt. Divide crescent rolls into rectangles and spread with mixture. Cut into one-inch strips and roll up., Sprinkle with poppy seed and bake at 375° for 12 minutes.

title: Shrimp Chowder
directions: Saute celery and onions in margarine., Add cream cheese and milk; stir over low heat until cream cheese is melted., Add remaining ingredients; heat thoroughly, stirring occasionally. Makes approximately four 1-cup servings.

title: Christmas Nuts
directions: Beat egg white with fork until frothy; add in water and beat again. Mix in nuts. On the side, mix together sugar, salt and cinnamon. Pour over nuts and mix. Place nuts on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 250° for 1 hour, stirring every 15 minutes.

title: Chicken-Cheese Chowder
directions: In large saucepan, cook carrot and onion in butter until tender (not brown)., Blend in flour; add milk and broth., Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly., Stir in chicken, wine, celery seed and Worcestershire sauce., Heat through., Do not boil., Add cheese; stir until melted., Makes 4 servings.

title: Luscious Lime-Berry Parfait
directions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water., Beat together cream cheese and sugar., Gradually add gelatin, orange juice, lime peel and juice to cream cheese mixture, beating until smooth., Chill until slightly thickened., Fold in whipped cream., Chill until partially thickened., Alternate gelatin mixture and raspberries with syrup in parfait glasses., Serves 6.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Grease bottom and sides of casserole dish., Layer ingredients as listed., Mix soup and water together., Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes or until chicken is done.

title: Potato Pancake
directions: Put 1 tablespoon oil and 1 tablespoon butter in a large skillet., Set over medium heat until butter melts., Put potatoes in the skillet., Press them down into an even compact layer. Cook, covered, for 5 minutes., Uncover, turn heat to low and cook for 15 minutes more., Slide the pancake onto a plate., Put 1 tablespoon oil and 1 tablespoon butter into the skillet., When the butter melts, put the pancake back into the skillet with the browned side up., Press down to compact the potatoes and cook, uncovered, for 15 minutes more. Cut into 4 wedges and serve warm.

title: Cheesy Chicken Chowder
directions: Combine first five ingredients in a large saucepan., Cover and cook over medium heat until vegetables are tender., Melt butter in Dutch oven over low heat; add flour stirring until smooth., Cook 1 minute stirring constantly., Gradually stir in milk; cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until thick and bubbly., Gradually stir in vegetable mixture, soy sauce, cheese and chicken., Cook until cheese melts.

title: Chili Soup
directions: Brown hamburger and onion., Drain off grease., Add rest of ingredients plus 1/2 can of water per can added., Simmer all day.

title: Easy Vegetable-Cheese Casserole
directions: Slice all vegetables into small pieces., In an oblong casserole, arrange slices of vegetables in layers or randomly. Last, season with salt and pepper and sprinkle shredded sharp cheese and Monterey Jack cheese on top of vegetables and bake in 350° oven until vegetables are tender and cheese is melted, about 1/2 to 3/4 hour., Also, can dot with butter or margarine., Yields 4 to 6 servings.

title: Chuck Wagon Skillet
directions: Saute onion until tender in butter, melted in large roast pan. Add meat., Sprinkle with salt and pepper., Brown slowly, stirring occasionally., Add layers of cheese, celery and noodles., Pour stewed tomatoes and tomatoes on top., Cover and heat to steaming. Do not remove., Cover., Turn heat to low and simmer 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Curried Chicken And Rice
directions: Season chicken with sweet basil, salt, pepper and curry powder. Saute chicken, onion and green pepper together in olive oil (stir-fry)., After it starts browning, add 1/2 cup water, cover and simmer 20 minutes., Wash rice and stir in; let water level with mixture., Cover tight on low fire., Yields 6 servings., Garnish with parsley.

title: Cream Cheese Tortilla
directions: Mix cream cheese, olives and chiles., Spread on the tortillas. Roll up., Let set in refrigerator overnight., Cut in slices.

title: Bryant'S Favorite Meal
directions: Microwave 2 hot dogs until warm., Cut in bite size pieces. Mix mustard and ketchup together for dipping.

title: Dill Pickles
directions: Boil vinegar, water and salt., Prick each cucumber; pack in jars., Put 3 nice heads of dill and 1 or 2 cloves of garlic in each jar., Pour boiling solution into each jar., Seal.

title: Special Baked Chicken
directions: Mix together first 3 ingredients and pour over chickens or same amount of pieces., Cook 1 hour or until done in a 375° oven.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Melt butter., Place chicken and all other ingredients in a large casserole., Bake at 300° for 2 1/2 hours.

title: Green Bean Casserole
directions: Melt together the cheese, onion, soup and sour cream., Stir in with the beans and corn., Put in large casserole dish., Combine the crackers and margarine and sprinkle over top. Cook 45 minutes at 350°.

title: Sweet Potato Biscuits
directions: Preheat oven to 400°., Mix well the potatoes, flour, sugar (1/4 cup with canned sweet potatoes, 1/2 cup with fresh sweet potatoes), butter, salt and baking soda., Mix in enough buttermilk to form a soft dough., Coat hands with flour and toss dough gently back and forth to get the right consistency., Roll out on floured board to about 1/2-inch thick., Cut with biscuit cutter and bake on lightly greased pan for 15 minutes.

title: Shrimp Dip
directions: Mix all ingredients, except shrimp, with hand mixer., Add diced shrimp., Serve with Bugles.

title: Hash Brown Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients together. Put in a 9 x 13-inch casserole. Bake at 350° for 1 hour. Garnish with crushed potato chips, if desired.

title: Date Nut Balls
directions: Combine flour, cheese, margarine and red pepper., Place one pecan half in each pitted date., Mold dough around each date. Place on cookie sheet., Bake 15 minutes at 400°., Yield:, 2 dozen.

title: Pumpkin Pie
directions: Mix ingredients and pour into unbaked pie shell., Bake at 400° for 15 minutes., Reduce heat to 350° for 50 to 60 minutes, or until done.

title: Angel Biscuits
directions: Sift dry ingredients; cut in shortening., Dissolve yeast in warm water and add to flour mixture., Add buttermilk and mix well. Turn out on a, floured board or wax paper., Roll about 1-inch thick., Cut out biscuits., Dip in melted butter and fold over. Bake 15 minutes in 400° oven., Dough can be stored in refrigerator and baked later., They do not have to rise before baking.

title: Pizza Rounds
directions: Brown and drain meats., Combine meats with cheese until cheese is melted., Add all remaining ingredients, except bread, and mix until thoroughly mixed., Spread mixture on each slice of bread. Place on cookie sheet and freeze., Transfer, when frozen, to freezer bags., Use as many as needed., When you bake them, bake on a cookie sheet at 350° for 15 minutes., May be kept frozen indefinitely.

title: Oatmeal Pie
directions: Beat egg whites and cream of tartar until foamy. Add sugar, very gradually, beating constantly, until stiff., Fold in crackers, then oatmeal, then nuts or coconut., Gently stir in vanilla., Pour into a well-greased 9-inch pie pan., Bake in a preheated 375° oven for 25 minutes. Top with whipped cream and fresh strawberries. This pie makes its own crust.

title: Vegetable Salad(Very Good)
directions: Mix pieces of broccoli, onions, cauliflower, cheese and bacon bits in a large salad bowl.

title: Oven Fried Chicken
directions: Coat chicken in seasoned flour., Lightly brown on all sides in butter., Arrange chicken in Dutch oven or small roaster., Cover and bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Granola
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Grease cookie sheet., In large bowl mix oats, seeds, wheat germ and flour., In large measuring cup mix honey, oil and water; heat in microwave just until warm., Add vanilla to liquid., Mix liquid into bowl with oat mixture., Spread in pan (cookie sheet)., Bake 20 minutes or until brown., Add dates and coconut., Store in covered container; if there's any left. Makes 7 cups.

title: Cajun Soup
directions: Brown ground meat and drain., Add remainder of ingredients with ground meat and, enough, water, to cook., Cook 1 1/2 hours.

title: Mexican Bread
directions: Fry meat; drain., Set aside., Mix first 6 ingredients., Grease skillet, pour in 1/2 of batter., Sprinkle cheese, pepper and onions into pan., Pour in remaining batter., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until done.

title: Bread And Butter Pickles
directions: Cover cucumbers, salt and onions with water; soak for 3 hours., Drain and wash thoroughly.

title: Chicken In A Pot
directions: Put all ingredients into a crock-pot and cook on low 8 hours. Serves 4.

title: Hot Cheese Dip
directions: Put in crock-pot., Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Molasses Bars
directions: Mix together flour, sugars, salt and shortening., Add eggs, molasses and soda dissolved in water., Make into rolls 1 inch thick and brush with beaten egg., Bake at 375°.

title: Raw Cranberry Salad
directions: Mix and let stand overnight the cranberries, marshmallows and pineapple., Then add sugar, cream and pecans., Combine ingredients and chill until ready to use.

title: Festive Chicken Salad Log
directions: Mix all ingredients except pecans., Stir well., Form mixture into log and roll in pecans.

title: Chocolate Cherry Cake
directions: Fold eggs and cherry pie filling into cake mix., Pour into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch cake pan., Bake in 350° oven for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Rocky Road Ice Cream
directions: In a large bowl, mix coca powder and sugar., Gradually stir in milk., Stir over low heat until sugar and cocoa dissolve., Cool to room temperature., Stir in vanilla, salt and whipping cream. Set aside., Shred chocolate with coarse side of grater., Stir shredded chocolate, marshmallows and nuts into cocoa mixture. Pour into ice cream cannister., Freeze according to manufacturer's directions., Stir marshmallows evenly throughout frozen mixture before ripening.

title: Hawaiian Beans
directions: Fry hamburger in chunks., Season with salt and pepper., Add S & W beans., Add a little water to thin.

title: Grandma Helen'S Chinese Beef Skillet
directions: Slice, beef, in, very thin strips (easier when slightly frozen)., Preheat, frypan, on, medium heat for 1 1/2 to 2 minutes. Add, oil, and, stir., Fry	half, of, beef	until brown; remove. Brown, remainder in onion and garlic., Return browned beef to pan. Add celery; cover and simmer for 5 minutes, then add, pea pods and water chestnuts until tender., Transfer meat and, vegetables to serving dish., Combine cornstarch with 1/2 cup of, water, and soy, sauce;, stir, into pan juices., Cook, stirring, until mixture thickens., Pour over meat and vegetables., Serves 4 to 6.

title: Poor Man'S Lobster
directions: Add salt, seasoning and vinegar to hot water and bring to boil., Add fish and boil 20 minutes., Drain and serve with melted butter.

title: Lela'S Salad
directions: Mix ingredients., Sprinkle 1 package vanilla instant pudding over this; stir and chill., You may add 3 or 4 bananas before serving (optional).

title: Italian Sausage Soup With Tortellini
directions: Remove sausage from casing., In a 5-quart Dutch oven, brown sausage., Remove sausage from Dutch oven and drain, reserving 1 tablespoon drippings., Saute onions and garlic in reserved drippings in Dutch oven until onions are tender., Add beef broth, water, wine, tomatoes, carrots, basil, oregano, tomato sauce and sausage., Bring to boil., Reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, 30 minutes., Skim fat from soup., Stir in zucchini, tortellini, parsley and green pepper., Simmer, covered, an additional 35 to 40 minutes, or until tortellini are tender., Sprinkle Parmesan cheese on top of each serving.

title: Summer Sausage
directions: Mix together thoroughly., Make into 8 rolls., Wrap in foil, twist and tie ends., Refrigerate for 24 hours., Put in a large pan and boil for 60 minutes, at a slow boil., Remove from water, unwrap and cool., Rewrap to freeze or refrigerate., Serve hot or cold.

title: Chicken Francaise(Yields 4 Servings)
directions: Beat approximately 2 to 3 eggs in one bowl and set aside., Fill another bowl with flour., Dip chicken in the flour completely, then dip in the egg., Repeat 2x's, always end with egg., Set aside chicken on a plate ready for cooking., In a nonstick frypan, melt approximately 1/2 stick butter until good and hot., Add chicken and brown both sides., Cook chicken on medium heat for approximately 10 to 15 minutes until done., Dress chicken in frypan with parsley and lemon slices., There should be a lot of butter still in pan., If not, add at least another 2 to 3 teaspoons more., Heat pan on medium-high to high for sauteing after chicken is dressed with parsley and lemons., When it's good and hot, add 1/2 cup of white wine., The white wine will boil and turn the butter and drippings into a sauce., Serve immediately., Enjoy!

title: Mom'S Peanut Butter Cookies
directions: Mix together the shortening, peanut butter, sugar and brown sugar., Add eggs and mix well., Add dry ingredients and mix well. Drop by spoonfuls onto a greased baking sheet., Dip a fork in flour and press into the top of the cookie to squash them down and make the traditional mark of peanut butter cookies, pressing first one way and then the other., Bake 325° for 15 minutes.

title: Butter Pecan Nut Bars
directions: Mix all ingredients well., Grease and flour 9 x 13-inch pan. Spread mixture in pan, bake 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Puppy Chow(Party Mix)
directions: In large bowl with a lid, melt chocolate, margarine and peanut butter., Pour cereal in the bowl., Stir well with spoon., Pour powdered sugar in with mix., Put the lid on the bowl and shake well., Enjoy!

title: Broccoli Cornbread
directions: Mix all together., Pour in a 10-inch square pan and bake at 400° for 30 minutes.

title: Robert Redford Dessert
directions: For crust, mix flour, pecans and melted butter; spread in 13 x 9-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

title: Chinese Celery Casserole
directions: Place celery, water and salt in covered pan. Simmer and cook 10 minutes. Drain and turn into a buttered casserole. Add water chestnuts, pimento and soup. Mix gently. Top with bread crumbs and almonds. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Avocado Cocktail Dip
directions: Halve and peel avocado, reserving 1 shell., Cube avocado and put in container of an electric blender., Add lemon juice, onion, mayonnaise, Tabasco and salt., Process until pureed.

title: Chicken Lynn
directions: Boil, chicken, until, tender;, cool and remove meat off bones. Cover, bottom, of a 9 x 12-inch pan with chicken.	Mix sour cream with undiluted chicken soup and spread over chicken.	Crush crackers, and, spread, on, top of casserole., Melt margarine and dribble over crackers., Sprinkle poppy seed over crackers.	Bake in	350° oven for 30 minutes or until bubbly. Yields 6 servings.

title: Chess Cake
directions: Mix and press in 9 x 13-inch baking dish.

title: Vegetarian Casserole
directions: Cook potatoes in boiling water until soft., Drain and mash potatoes and mix with yogurt (or 1/4 cup milk), chives and parsley., Set aside.

title: Huckleberry Jam
directions: Cook huckleberries with water until they start to boil., Add sugar and boil hard for 2 minutes., Add pectin, juice of lemon and 2 teaspoons of grated lemon rind., Boil hard for 1 minute more. Remove from heat and pour into 8 (1/2-pint) sterilized jelly glasses., Seal with paraffin.

title: Chicken Milano(Serves 4)
directions: Prepare rice or orzo as directed., Remove skin and bones from chicken breasts; cut meat into 1 1/2-inch chunks., In 10-inch skillet over medium heat in hot butter or oleo, cook onion and garlic until onion is tender, stirring occasionally., Add chicken chunks; cook until chicken is lightly browned on all sides, stirring frequently., Stir in undiluted tomato soup and remaining ingredients., Over high heat, heat to boiling., Reduce heat to low; cover and simmer 20 minutes, stirring occasionally., To serve, spoon chicken over rice or orzo., Contains 460 calories per serving.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Boil broccoli 5 minutes, drain well., Combine the next 5 ingredients to make sauce, add broccoli., Pour into a greased casserole dish and top with crackers., Bake at 325° for 35 minutes.

title: Porcupine Bread
directions: Grease two 8 or 9-inch round cake pans., Measure bread flour and set aside., Combine wheat flour, oats, yeast, sugar and salt in a mixing bowl., In a saucepan heat buttermilk, water and oil until 120° to 130°., Add to wheat flour mixture., Blend with mixer at low speed until moistened; heat 3 minutes at medium speed., By hand, stir in 1 to 2 cups bread flour, raisins, nuts and sunflower seeds to form a sticky dough., On a floured surface, knead 1/4 to 1 cup flour until dough is smooth and elastic (10 minutes)., Place in a greased bowl; cover loosely with plastic wrap and towel., Let rise in a warm place until doubled in size (1 to 1 1/2 hours).

title: Microwave Fudge
directions: Melt chocolate chips, condensed milk and butter in microwave on High for 3 minutes., Take out and stir., Put in a buttered 9 x 9-inch pan., Put in refrigerator until hard., Cut into squares.

title: Hamburg Gravy
directions: Brown hamburg, add mushroom soup mix., Pour over potatoes or noodles., Can use deer meat, cut up, in place of hamburg also.

title: Strawberry Jello
directions: Mix together and chill.

title: Zucchini Appetizer
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Combine ingredients and pour into greased 9 x 9-inch pan., Bake 45 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Jalapeno Cornbread
directions: Mix cornmeal, flour, salt and soda; add buttermilk, oil, eggs and corn., Beat and mix well., Stir in jalapenos and onions. Grease 9 x 13-inch baking dish., Heat well, pour in half of batter; sprinkle with half of cheese, repeat., Bake at 350° for 50 to 55 minutes or untildone.

title: Cherry Cream Crescents
directions: Separate rolls into 16 triangles. Spread cream cheese onto each one and top with pie filling. Roll up as per directions on container. Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Pineapple-Cheese Christmas Casserole
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Mix together pineapple and cheese; set aside., Mix sugar and flour together., Add to fruit and cheese mixture., Spread mixture in an 8 x 11-inch or 9 x 12-inch casserole dish., Spread crushed Ritz crackers over top., Pour melted butter over all., Bake 35 to 40 minutes., Let cool and serve., This dish is good hot or cold.

title: Broccoli And Rice Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients together and bake at 325° for 30 minutes. Stir as butter starts to melt and broccoli thaws.

title: Italian Tomato Dip
directions: Mix the soup mix with Italian dressing and sour cream., Serve with potato chips or crackers.

title: Zucchini Pie
directions: In skillet, cook zucchini and onion in butter until tender. Stir in parsley and rest of seasonings. In large bowl, blend eggs and cheese; stir into vegetable mixture. Pour into pie crust. Bake at 375° for 30 minutes or until center comes out clean. Let stand for 10 minutes before serving.

title: Pork Chop Casserole
directions: Chop pork chops into cubes and brown in 2 tablespoons oil. Cut up vegetables into cubes., Mix browned pork, vegetables, mushroom soup and water until well blended., Bake at 350° for about 1 hour or until vegetables are tender.

title: Homemade Ice Cream
directions: Beat eggs., Add sugar and beat well., Add condensed milk and 1 can of warm water., Mix well., Add other ingredients., Freeze in electric freezer., Makes 1 gallon.

title: Light Caesar Salad
directions: In small bowl, stir together mayonnaise, parmesan, sugar, mustard, anchovy paste, Worcestershire and garlic., Gradually stir in lemon juice., Cover and chill several hours or overnight., In medium salad bowl, toss lettuce with dressing., Sprinkle croutons over top., Serve immediately., Makes 6 servings.

title: Mustardy Beef Tenderloin
directions: In a small bowl, stir together 1 tablespoon of the mustard with the olive oil, pepper, tarragon and salt. Spread mixture over the top and sides of meat. Let stand 15 minutes at room temperature or refrigerate up to 4 hours.

title: After Dinner Mint Pie(A Luxurious Frozen Dessert That'S Quick And Easy.)
directions: Combine crumbs and margarine; reserve 1/2 cup for topping. Press remaining crumb mixture onto bottom of 9-inch spring-form pan or pie plate. Chill. Gradually add milk to Marshmallow Creme, mixing until well blended. Add extract and food coloring; fold in whipped cream. Pour into pan; freeze until firm. Sprinkle with remaining crumbs or garnish with mint, if desired.

title: Salmon Burgers
directions: Drain salmon, remove skin and bones., Combine all ingredients and mix well., Form into four patties., Pan fry in small amount of vegetable oil until browned on both sides.

title: Cooked Ice Cream
directions: Mix eggs, sugar and milk until smooth., Add remaining ingredients., Cook until thick., Cool, then add one large can Pet milk and 1 teaspoon vanilla., Finish filling gallon freezer with milk.

title: Mom'S On Strike Casserole
directions: Brown beef; drain. Add dry egg noodles, water and salt and pepper. Bring to a boil. Reduce simmer until noodles are done, then add vegetable soup. Continue to simmer until done.

title: Orange Nut Bread
directions: Grease loaf pan and set aside., Preheat oven to 350°., In a large mixing bowl combine butter, orange juice and rind, dates, sugar and egg., In a separate bowl combine remaining ingredients. Add dry ingredients to wet ingredients and stir just until batter is moist and uniform., Bake 50 minutes or until done.

title: Dump Cake
directions: Pour pineapple into long pan, 9 x 12-inch., Sprinkle dry cake mix over pineapple., Cut margarine into pieces over the pineapple and dry cake mix., Bake at 350° to 375° for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Mrs. Bretel'S Noodle Recipe
directions: Mix well; roll out and cut as desired.

title: Dumplings
directions: Combine all ingredients; roll out., Cut in strips both ways, and let dry., Put in boiling broth and cook uncovered.

title: Gelatin Finger Paints
