directions: In a saucepan, blend cornstarch and 1/4 cup cold water., Add the hot water and heat until boiling, stirring constantly. Remove from heat., Mix gelatin powder with the remaining 1/4 cup cold water., Add the liquid soap; stir., Add the gelatin-soap mixture to cornstarch mixture; stir., Stir in powdered drink mix. Store in covered jar in refrigerator for 12 hours before using.

title: Chocolate Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Mix in large saucepan and boil 1 minute., Remove from heat and stir in 1 cup peanut butter and 4 cups uncooked oats., Mix well with spoon., Add 2 teaspoons vanilla., Drop onto wax paper with tablespoon to cool.

title: Broccoli Soup
directions: Saute oleo and onions., Add water and noodles; bring to a boil., Add broccoli and garlic powder., Cook until noodles and broccoli are done, about 15 minutes., Cool and add milk and cheese., Return to burner and stir until cheese is melted., Cook on low until ready to serve.

title: Hamburger Stroganoff
directions: Brown hamburger, adding onion when about halfway done., Cook until onion is tender., Drain about 1/2 of liquid; add flour, salt, pepper and garlic powder., Cook for about 3 minutes, stirring constantly., Add soups and water., Cook for 10 minutes, stirring constantly., Reduce heat and add sour cream; let reheat to serving temperature., Serve over cooked egg noodles.

title: Mexican Rice Casserole
directions: Brown hamburger; drain., Mix with all ingredients, except cheese, in casserole dish., Bake for 30 to 35 minutes at 350°. Top with cheese the last 5 minutes of baking time., Freezes well.

title: Tomato Soup
directions: Cook tomatoes, onion, salt and pepper, cayenne and sugar for 15 minutes., Melt butter; blend in flour., Add milk gradually. Gradually add tomato mixture to milk mixture, stirring constantly. Serve.

title: Kiwi Fruit Sherbet
directions: Combine 1/2 cup sugar and water., Bring to a boil; stir until sugar dissolves., Boil, covered, over medium heat, for 5 minutes. Beat egg whites until stiff; gradually add remaining 1/4 cup sugar. Slowly pour hot syrup into whites; beat constantly until mixture has cooled., Pare and puree kiwi fruit to measure 3/4 cup. Gradually beat lemon-lime soda, kiwi fruit puree and lime juice into egg white mixture., Partially freeze., Spoon mixture into chilled mixer bowl and beat with chilled beaters until mixture is light and foamy., Return to freezer until firm.

title: Spaghetti Sauce
directions: Heat oil and add onion, celery, green pepper and meat., Cook until all meat changes color., In a large Dutch oven, combine meat mixture and all remaining ingredients except Parmesan., Simmer on low heat until liquid is almost gone and mixture is slightly thickened (about 30 minutes), stirring occasionally., Add Parmesan cheese just before serving.

title: Taco Casserole
directions: Brown beef, onion and green pepper., Add 2/3 can of the tomato sauce and 2/3 of taco seasoning., Season with pepper and simmer until well blended., Set aside 1/2 cup of chips and 1/4 cup cheese., In 3-quart casserole, layer rest of ingredients twice in the following order:, taco chips, stewed tomatoes, meat mixture, fresh tomatoes, beans, tomato sauce and cheese., Bake at 375° for 25 minutes, covered. Bake uncovered another 5 to 8 minutes., Serve with bottled hot sauce., Serves 10 easily.

title: Pecan Dainties
directions: Beat egg whites until stiff., Fold in sugar and pecans., Drop by spoonfuls onto greased cookie sheet., Bake at 250° for 30 minutes., Do not store in airtight container.

title: Potato Filling
directions: Cook, potatoes	in, water, and	mash, with milk or used leftover, mashed, potatoes., To, the, potatoes, add bread (cut into, cubes), 2 eggs, parsley and broth., In tablespoon butter cook, celery, (that, has, been diced), onion and parsley until soft (saute or in microwave)., Add to filling mixture., Butter ovenproof, casserole, dish;, put mixture into dish and bake at 350° or until brown on top for 30 minutes.

title: Chocolate Cake With Cream Cheese Filling
directions: Mix together the first 10 ingredients., Cream together remaining ingredients (except chocolate chips)., Use half of the chocolate cake batter; spoon out the cream cheese and half of the chocolate chips., Spread over the top of the cake batter and pour rest of the batter over the top and top with chocolate chips. Bake at 350° for approximately 45 minutes.

title: Potato Skins
directions: Brown hamburger with onions., Add salt and pepper., Drain grease., Add taco seasoning and simmer., Bake potatoes and cut in half lengthwise., Scoop out center of potato, leaving 1/4 inch around edges., Place potatoes in baking dish and sprinkle with cheddar cheese., Add about 2 Tbsp. seasoned hamburger and top with mozzarella and cheddar cheese., Sprinkle on onion, chives, and bacon bits., Heat until cheese is melted and serve with sour cream.

title: Salisbury Steak
directions: Mix thoroughly. Form small flat cakes., Broil until brown. Serve with sauce.

title: Microwave Green Bean Casserole
directions: Combine green beans, soup, milk, salt, pepper and 1/2 can fried onions in a casserole dish.

title: Pumpkin Pie Supreme(Easy)
directions: Place marshmallows, pumpkin, spices and salt in saucepan. Heat over low flame stirring until marshmallows are melted., Cool. Stir in half of the whipped cream. Carefully fold in remaining cream., Pour into pie shell. Chill until firm., Makes 6 servings.

title: Baskin-Robbins Pie
directions: Mix oleo, flour and pecans together., Press into pie shell (oblong pan)., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes or until light brown. (Let cool.)

title: Seafood Newburg
directions: Wash scallops, cut in 3/4-inch pieces., Poach in boiling water 3 minutes., Drain and cover with cold water., Cook shrimp in boiling water and lemon, bay leaves and whole cloves 5 minutes. Drain and cool in cold water., Clean shrimp and cut in half lengthwise., Melt 1 1/4 pounds butter; add flour., Cook 8 to 10 minutes, do not brown., Add scalded milk and stir until thick and smooth., Clean lobster, remove bones and intestinal vein from tail. Cut in chunks., Saute lobster in butter until lobster is hot., Add shrimp and paprika; saute until seafood is done, about 3 minutes. Heat scallops to boiling., Remove from heat; drain., Add all seafood to sauce., Incorporate wine., Season lightly with salt. Garnish with parsley., Can be served in patty shell or toast, etc. Makes 50 portions.

title: Chocolate Eclair In A Pan
directions: Mix pudding and milk together., Add Cool Whip., Make layer of crackers, then pudding., Repeat this until you have a layer of crackers on top., Put frosting on top layer of crackers. Wonderful.

title: Outback Steak House Ranch Salad Dressing
directions: Combine all ingredients in a medium bowl. Mix well. Cover bowl and chill dressing for at least 30 minutes before serving.

title: Macaroni And Cheese
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Cook macaroni until almost done (bakes easier this way)., Beat egg together with milk and set aside. Layer grated cheese and macaroni in 2 quart casserole dish. Repeat layer., Pour milk and egg mixture over layered macaroni and cheese., Place pats of butter on top of mixture and sprinkle bread crumbs on top., Bake at 350° for one hour., Makes 6 servings.

title: Pecan Pie Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients; pour into a 9 x 13-inch greased and floured pan., Cook at 350° until brown.

title: Jambalaya
directions: Saute sausage in oil (lard or bacon drippings)., Remove from pot., Season and brown chicken., Remove from pot., For brown jambalaya, add heaping tablespoon of brown sugar to oil and caramelize., For red jambalaya, delete this step.

title: Whole Wheat Bread
directions: Combine all ingredients except buttermilk in large bowl., Mix well., Add buttermilk; mix well., Knead on a floured surface. Place in a greased loaf pan., Bake at 400° for 45 minutes.

title: Hershey Brownies
directions: Mix sugar, milk and oleo in pan., Bring to rolling boil for 1 minute., Remove and add chocolate chips., Stir to spreading consistency and ice brownies.

title: Toffee Bar Crunch Pie
directions: Spread dessert topping on bottom of crust., Pour milk into large bowl., Add pudding mix., Beat with wire whisk 2 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes., Stir in Cool Whip and chopped toffee bars. Spoon into crust., Freeze 4 hours or until set., Let stand at room temperature 15 minutes or until pie can be cut easily.

title: Onion Soup
directions: Pour stock and heat in covered pot., Cook onions slowly in skillet in butter until transparent., Cool 15 minutes., Add salt, sugar, flour and vermouth in pan., When mixed well, add to stock. Simmer in pot 1 hour.

title: Broccoli Salad
directions: Mix the first 5 ingredients., Combine mayonnaise, wine vinegar and sugar and let stand at room temperature., When ready to serve, pour on the dressing and mix.

title: Ritz Slices
directions: Bring this to a boil for 2 minutes., Then add 72 Ritz crackers. Boil 2 minutes more., Set aside for 2 1/2 to 3 hours.

title: Anna'S Hot Potato Salad
directions: Cook potatoes until tender. Remove skins and slice potatoes. Put in buttered baking dish. Add sauteed onion and green pepper, pickles and cheese. Crisp fry bacon. Crumble and put on top. Place in 350° oven and heat long enough for cheese to melt. This can be made ahead of time.

title: Date Nut Bread
directions: Cut up dates and add soda., Pour boiling water over dates and cover., Cream shortening and sugar., Add beaten eggs alternately with flour and date mixture., Bake in moderate oven at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Chocolate Dessert(Make In 13-Inch Pyrex Dish)
directions: First Layer:, Combine flour, oleo and pecans., Mix well and spread into dish., Cook 10 to 15 minutes at 375°., Let cool completely.

title: Stuffed Camel
directions: Skin, trim and clean the camel, lamb and chickens., Boil until tender., (Be sure your pot is large enough.), Cook rice until fluffed., Fry nuts until brown; mix with rice., Hard boil the eggs and peel them., Then stuff the chickens with eggs and rice., Stuff the lamb with five of the chickens and some rice. Stuff the camel with the lamb and more rice., Broil in large oven or near a gas flame until brown., Spread the remaining mixed rice on a large tray and place the camel on top., Place the remaining stuffed chickens around the camel., Decorate rice with boiled eggs and nuts., And don't worry if there are more guests than you've expected, the recipe serves 80 to 100.

title: Stromboli
directions: Thaw bread dough and let raise., Roll each loaf out on cookie sheet., Spread approximately 1 tablespoon mustard on each loaf. Layer alternately ham, cheeses, salami and pepperoni., Overlap middle section and pinch ends together., Pour melted butter on top and sprinkle with garlic salt., Bake at 350° uncovered 30 minutes.

title: Avocado Orange Salad
directions: Peel and stone avocados; cut into cubes., Combine avocados and onion in a medium size bowl., Toss gently to mix well., In a small bowl combine oil, lemon juice, scotch, sugar, salt and pepper; mix well., Pour over avocado mixture., Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours, stirring occasionally., To serve, place orange sections on lettuce, pile on avocado mixture in center., Makes 6 servings.

title: Lasagna
directions: Brown ground beef. Add onions, green pepper, parsley and celery. Cook until tender. Drain. Add tomatoes, tomato paste, tomato sauce, sugar, salt, garlic and pepper (to taste). Cook slowly 20 to 30 minutes. Add 1/2 cup Parmesan cheese. Lightly grease 9 x 13-inch pan. Layer as follows: meat sauce, noodles, meat sauce and cheeses. Bake for 45 minutes at 350°.

title: Turkey Hash
directions: Mix all ingredients except flour together and cook over low heat until vegetables are tender., Add flour mixed with a little water until smooth., Add salt and pepper to taste.

title: World'S Best Potato Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients., Bake in a 350° oven about 45 minutes. Bake a little longer if you don't defrost the spuds first.

title: Scalloped Potato Casserole
directions: Combine 1 1/2 cups cheese, both soups, onion and evaporated milk into saucepan and place on medium heat., Stir occasionally. Heat until all ingredients are mixed well and cheese is melted.

title: Black-And-White Creme Brulee
directions: Cook 3/4 c. whipping cream and 7 1/2 squares of chocolate in a heavy saucepan over low heat, stirring constantly, until chocolate melts and mixture is smooth., Pour into a large bowl., Whisk together remaining 3 cups of whipping cream, 9 yolks, 3/4 c. of sugar and 1 1/2 tsp. vanilla until sugar dissolves and mixture is smooth., Whisk 1 1/2 c. of egg mixture into chocolate mixture until smooth., Cover and chill remaining egg mixture., Pour chocolate mixture evenly into 9 (8 oz.) custard cups; place cups in a 13x9-inch pan., Add hot water to pan to a depth of 1/2 inch., Bake at 325° for 30 minutes or until almost set., (Center will be soft.) Slowly pour remaining egg mixture evenly over custards and bake 20 to 25 more minutes or until set., Cool custards in water in pan on a wire rack., Remove from pan; cover and chill at least 8 hours. Sprinkle each custard with 1 Tbsp. brown sugar; place custards in a pan., Torch top of custard with hot flame until sugar melts., Let stand for a few minutes to allow sugar to harden., If you do not have a torch you can use the broiler; 5 1/2 inches from heat (with electric oven door partially open) about 2 minutes.

title: Hamburger Romanoff
directions: Brown hamburger; drain off fat., Cook noodles; in casserole dish, combine cooked noodles, margarine, milk, soup and cheese sauce., Add meat; mix well., Microwave for 5 minutes., Serve hot.

title: Bread Hush Puppies
directions: Mix together and let it set a while so it can rise, then drop by teaspoon into hot oil., Cook until golden brown.

title: Squash Pudding
directions: Cook and mash squash., Mix all ingredients together in greased baking dish., Bake at 425° for 15 minutes, then at 350° for 35 minutes.

title: Honey Baked Ham
directions: Using a sharp knife, remove the layer of skin from ham, leaving a thin layer of fat to keep the meat juicy while baking. Score the surface of the ham in diamond pattern without cutting into the meat., Place a whole clove in center of half the diamonds., Brush top of ham with Dijon mustard and place in roasting pan.

title: Hamburger-Cabbage Casserole
directions: Cook meat in oil until lightly browned., Mix in onion, salt, pepper and rice; cook 3 to 4 minutes., Remove from heat., Place cabbage in casserole., Pour meat mixture over it., Do not stir. Cover and bake at 325° for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Potluck Potatoes
directions: Mix all ingredients except corn flake crumbs and butter., Pour mixture into 13 x 9-inch buttered casserole., Mix melted butter and corn flake crumbs., Spread evenly over top of casserole and bake for 45 minutes at 350°.

title: Shrimp Dip
directions: Cream the cream cheese, Miracle Whip and milk., Spread on dinner size plate about 1/4 inch thick., Spread 2/3 bottle cocktail sauce on top., Sprinkle shrimp on top of that., Dip into with your favorite kind of crackers.

title: Chicken, Beans And Rice Chili
directions: Heat oil in large saucepan over medium heat. Add chicken; cook 5 to 10 minutes or until lightly browned, stirring frequently. Add onion; cook 3 to 5 minutes. Stir in remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium; cover and cook 30 to 40 minutes or until rice is tender. Stir occasionally so rice does not stick. Yields 9 to 10 cups.

title: Apple Cake
directions: Break eggs over apples, mixing very well. Add sugar, nuts and cinnamon. Add dry ingredients. Add oil and vanilla. Bake 60 or 70 minutes at 325° in, 13 x 9 pan.

title: Healthier Banana Pudding
directions: Combine sugar, flour and salt., Blend together with egg substitute in top of a double boiler., Cook, uncovered, over boiling water, stirring constantly until thickened., Reduce heat and cook for 4 to 5 minutes, continuing to stir., Remove from heat; add vanilla and nutmeg., Spread a small amount of custard on bottom of a 1 1/2-quart bowl or casserole., Add a layer of wafers, sliced bananas, custard, wafers, sliced bananas and ending with custard to make 3 layers., Place marshmallows on top and bake at 450° for 3 to 4 minutes until marshmallows are slightly brown. Serve warm or room temperature., Makes 8 servings.

title: Beans And Onions
directions: Place 1/2 of beans in a 2-quart casserole. Top with 1/2 of onions; repeat. Combine catsup with sugar and pour over onions. Sprinkle bacon over top. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

title: Green Bean Dish
directions: Saute onion, bacon and mushrooms until done., Add drained green beans to pan., Melt butter in mixture and heat through.

title: Blueberry Jello Salad
directions: Mix Jell-O and boiling water together., Mix pineapple and pie filling with the Jell-O water.

title: Mild Or Hot Nacho Dip
directions: Cook sausage and drain., Cook hamburger meat and drain., In a crock-pot, put sausage on high., Cut Velveeta and put on sausage. Mix well., Then put hamburger meat and then put Mexican Velveeta, hot or mild; mix well., Then add large jar taco salsa, hot or mild., Serve from crock-pot with nachos.

title: Mild Mexican Casserole
directions: Brown the meat, onions and peppers., Drain the fat., Add the milk, enchilada sauce and 2 soups., (It works better if you combine all this before you add it to the pan.), In a Pyrex casserole, alternate the tortilla chips, meat mixture and a little cheese twice, ending with the bulk of the cheese on the top. Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Sauerkraut Salad
directions: Boil the sugar and water until stringy. Dice the green pepper, onion and celery; toss with the sugar mixture and sauerkraut. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Boiled Chitterlings
directions: Put all ingredients and 4 cups water in kettle. Bring to boil and then simmer, covered, 2 hours or until tender. Serve plain or deep-fry.

title: Chinese Spareribs
directions: *Available in Chinese section of supermarkets.

title: Cheese Souffle(Recipe Originated With Joanne Hall, Kokomo, Indiana)
directions: Melt cheese and butter in pan., In large bowl, break bread. Beat egg yolks and the rest of the ingredients together with bread. Then add melted cheese and butter mixture., Beat egg whites and fold into mixture., Bake at 325° for 40 minutes until browned. Serves 6.

title: Squirrel Stew
directions: Add all vegetables to broth and cook over medium heat for 20 minutes., Substitute vegetables as desired., Serves 6. Preparation Time:, 30 minutes.

title: Coconut Cream Cake
directions: Mix and bake cake according to package directions adding almond extract and 1/2 of the coconut., After baking and while still hot, poke holes in top of cake with fork and pour a can of cream of coconut over the top., Cool completely and cover cake completely with Cool Whip and remainder of coconut.

title: Comfort Fruit Salad
directions: Combine pineapple chunks, grapefruit sections, orange sections, cherries, peaches and warm orange marmalade slightly. Remove from heat and mix with Southern Comfort., Pour over fruit and mix well., Serves 6 to 8.

title: Party Pretzels
directions: Place pretzels in 9 x 13-inch pan., Pour melted oleo over pretzels., Stir in dry onion soup mix., Bake for 1 hour at 200° (or low heat)., Stir occasionally.

title: Apricot Salad
directions: Combine water, sugar and Jell-O in pan., Bring to a boil. Stir until dissolved., Remove from heat., Stir in baby food and pineapple., Combine cream cheese and milk until smooth., Mix with Jell-O., Add nuts., Pour into a 9 x 12-inch dish and chill until solid.

title: Open-Faced Cherry Tart
directions: Press the first 4 ingredients (mixed) in bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake at 350° for about 15 to 20 minutes., Cool and crumble in pan for crust.

title: Black Cat Cookies
directions: Mix thoroughly the shortening, sugar and vanilla., Blend in egg and milk., In separate bowl, sift remaining ingredients., Add to first mixture; blend well., Drop by teaspoon 2-inches apart on lightly greased cookie sheet., Grease bottom of glass; dip in sugar and use to flatten dough., Bake at 400° for 8 to 10 minutes., While still hot, place Hershey's Kiss in center of cookie, 2 chocolate chips for head and 1 for tail., With toothpick, spread chocolate to make cat shape.

title: Quick Beer Rolls
directions: Mix Bisquick and sugar well., Add beer., Beat and pour into well-greased muffin tin., Bake at 375° until brown.

title: Beef Stroganoff
directions: Mix, together the soups, steak and mushrooms., Place in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish., Bake, covered, for 2 1/2 hours at 325° or longer., Add, 8, ounces, sour, cream to meat mixture. Serve over cooked noodles.

title: Magic Cookie Bars
directions: Preheat oven to 350° (325° for glass dish)., In a 13 x 9-inch cake pan, melt margarine in oven. Sprinkle crumbs over margarine. Pour sweetened condensed milk evenly over crumbs., Top with remaining ingredients., Press down., Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until lightly brown., Cool., Chill, if desired. Cut into bars. Store loosely covered at room temperature.

title: Strawberry Banana Salad
directions: In a bowl, dissolve gelatin in boiling water., Stir in strawberries, pineapple, bananas, and nuts., Pour half of mixture into a 13 x 9 x 2 in. dish., Refrigerate for 1 hour or until set. Set the remaining gelatin mixture aside., Combine the sour cream, sugar, and vanilla; mix well., Spread over the chilled gelatin. Spoon remaining gelatin mixture over top., Chill overnight., Yield: 12 - 15 servings.

title: Cutout Chocolate Cookies
directions: Cream butter, sugar, egg and vanilla until light and fluffy. Combine flour, cocoa, baking powder, soda and salt., Add to creamed mixture., Mix well., Chill dough about 1 hour., Preheat oven to 325°., On lightly floured surface or between 2 pieces of waxed paper roll small portion at a time to 1/4 inch thickness. Cut into shapes., Place on ungreased cookie sheet., Bake 5 to 7 minutes., Cool slightly., Remove and frost., Makes 3 dozen cookies.

title: Carrot Bread
directions: Beat eggs; stir in remaining ingredients., Place into 2 loaf pans., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Delicious Fruit Salad
directions: Drain fruit., Save juice from the pineapple and fruit cocktail., Mix juice with instant pudding., Stir until thick. Pour over fruit., Add sliced bananas and cherries., Chill.

title: Sweet And Sour Sausage
directions: Slice sausage in quarter slices., Brown on both sides., Drain off fat., Add other ingredients., Simmer 10 minutes., Serves 5 to 6.

title: Hot Dip Snacks
directions: Cook sausage, stirring as to blend., Saute jalapenos in this until changes color., Add cheese, stirring constantly to melt cheese and mix well., Pour in shallow dish and cool.

title: Pineapple Cream Pie
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., In saucepan, combine sugar, flour and salt., Stir in undrained pineapple, sour cream and lemon juice until thoroughly blended., Cook and stir until mixture thickens and bubbles; cook and stir 2 minutes., Remove from heat., Stir a moderate amount of hot mixture into egg yolks; return to hot mixture, stirring constantly., Cook and stir 2 minutes more. Spoon hot mixture into cooled pastry shell., Spread meringue atop pie, sealing meringue to edge of pastry., Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes, or until golden., Cool before cutting.

title: Pork And Sausage Jambalaya
directions: Put 1 cup water in pot., Add cubed pork and start browning. When pork turns light brown, add sausage and brown until dark brown., Remove excess grease from pot., Brown onions., Add green onions and bell pepper., Cook down., Add 4 cups water., Add seasoning and bring to a boil., Add rice and stir until water becomes thick., Cover and put fire as low as possible., Wait 10 minutes and turn rice over (do not stir) from the bottom of the pot., Re-cover., Wait 10 minutes and turn over again., Turn fire off., Let sit 5 minutes and serve.

title: Heavenly Fruit Dip
directions: Cook all the ingredients except Cool Whip over medium heat until thick., Cool in refrigerator for 2 hours. Fold in 1 cup Cool Whip., Store in refrigerator.

title: Pork Chops And Browned Rice
directions: Brown chops and set aside., Pour rice into pan where chops were browned., Stir constantly until golden brown, about 10 minutes., Add onion and cook until tender., Add bouillon water; simmer over low heat until liquid is gone, 20 to 25 minutes., Lay chops on top of rice for the last 10 minutes.

title: Tater Tot Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients except Tater Tots in large casserole dish. Cover with 1 layer of Tater Tots., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Orange Cake
directions: Mix all together and beat until orange slices are broken up and fluffy., Pour into three 8-inch cake pans., Grease and flour pans. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes or until done.

title: Taco Dip
directions: Mix together the first 2 ingredients and then spread on large platter., Layer on top of that mixture the remaining listed ingredients in the order given., Refrigerate., Serve with taco chips.

title: Ham And Potato Casserole
directions: Saute onion in oleo in skillet., Stir in flour and dry mustard. Season with salt and pepper., Add milk., Cook until thickened, stirring constantly., Stir in cheese until melted., Alternate layers of potatoes, celery, ham, green pepper and cheese sauce in 9 x 13-inch pan until all ingredients are used, ending with cheese sauce., Bake, covered, at 350° for 1 hour., Bake, uncovered, for 30 minutes., Makes 6 servings.

title: Vegetable Dip
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Cover and refrigerate until used.

title: Sweet 'N Sour Cabbage And Kielbasa Saute
directions: In 10-inch skillet, heat oil., Add kielbasa and onions and saute until browned., Add cabbage and stir thoroughly., Add remaining ingredients and cook, stirring occasionally, until cabbage is tender and liquid has evaporated., Makes 2 servings.

title: Punch Bowl Cake
directions: Make cake according to package directions., Pour into rectangular pan and bake., Cool and cut in half., Make pudding, using 2 1/2 cups milk per package.

title: Pinto Bean Casserole
directions: Brown ground beef and onion., Drain., Add pinto beans, tomato sauce, salt, pepper and Worcestershire sauce., Simmer for 15 minutes., Spray baking dish with Pam., Pour meat mixture into baking dish.

title: Won Ton Mushroom Ravioli With Mushroom Sauce
directions: Food process mushrooms coarse rather than fine., Pit olives and process finer than mushrooms., Heat butter and oil in skillet., Add onion, oregano, parsley and mushrooms., Salt lightly and cook over brisk heat, stirring constantly 5 to 6 minutes., Mushrooms should start to color and onion softens., Add garlic during the last few minutes of cooking so it doesn't burn pepper., Set aside.

title: Squash Casserole
directions: Cook squash and onion in a small amount of salted water until tender; drain., Add bread or cracker crumbs (reserving 1 tablespoon for top), cheese, egg, salt, pepper and 2 tablespoons margarine., Spoon into greased casserole., Top with remaining crumbs; dot with 2 tablespoons margarine., Bake at 375° for 10 minutes or until brown., Yield:, 4 servings.

title: Turkey Chili
directions: Saute onions and garlic over low heat., Add turkey hamburger to saucepot., Cover., Stir frequently until meat is lightly cooked and separated., Add chili powder, tomatoes and pepper., Cover and simmer for 30 minutes., Uncover; add drained kidney beans to sauce., Cook slowly about 30 minutes., Add tomato puree with a little water if mixture is too thick., Tastes better when cooked in advance (24 hours).

title: Dirt
directions: Cream margarine and cream cheese; add powdered sugar, mixing well., Set aside.

title: Fruit Salad
directions: Drain pineapple and oranges., Use 1 1/2 cups liquid; if not enough, add water., Mix with pudding mix and cook until thick. Then cool., Add fruit and mix., Add bananas and cherries last and mix gently.

title: Butterhorn Rolls
directions: Soften yeast in 3 tablespoons warm water., Combine sugar, shortening, 1 cup warm water, salt and eggs in large bowl., Mix well., Add yeast and flour; beat until smooth., Cover and refrigerate overnight.

title: Mission Fact Treats
directions: Mix peanut butter and marshmallow cream in a bowl until smooth., Roll dough into small balls., Roll balls in graham cracker crumbs., Place balls on waxed paper., Stick toothpicks into the balls.

title: Spicy Shrimp-Noodle Soup
directions: Combine lemon juice, chili powder, cumin and pepper., Add shrimp., Toss to coat.

title: Potato Salad
directions: Cook potatoes until fork-tender., Drain and cool slightly. In a large bowl, combine potatoes and all other ingredients; toss gently to mix well., Sprinkle paprika on top., Cover., Refrigerate at least 3 hours for best taste.

title: Instant Chocolate Pie
directions: Prepare pudding mix according to directions, using only 1 cup milk., Blend in 1 1/2 cups whipped topping and 1/4 cup pecans. Spoon into pie shell., Decorate with remaining 1/2 cup whipped topping and additional nuts., Chill at least 1 hour., Serves 6.

title: Mama'S Potato Salad
directions: In a large kettle, cook potatoes in boiling salted water until tender., Drain and cool., Peel potatoes; cut into chunks. Separate egg yolks from whites., Set yolks aside., Chop whites and add to potatoes with onion.

title: Soupe Aux Legumes
directions: Heat oil in deep heavy pan and add the onions, carrots, celery, turnips and potatoes., Cook for a few minutes; then add the green beans., Cook the vegetables for another 5 to 10 minutes. Add the stock and vermicelli and season with salt to taste. Reduce heat and simmer until vegetables are tender but still crisp., Add the peas to the soup with the spinach, tomatoes and zucchini., Continue cooking for another 20 to 30 minutes., This keeps well for several days in the fridge., Serve with a dollop of pesto sauce and hot French bread.

title: Easy Peanut Butter Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Mix all ingredients together in mixing bowl., Drop dough by spoonfuls on lightly greased cookie sheet. Press with a fork., Bake in oven for 5 to 8 minutes or until light brown.

title: Grandma'S Macaroni Pie
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., Divide macaroni and cheese into two parts., Layer 1/2 macaroni, then 1/2 grated cheese in 2-quart buttered baking dish., Repeat with second layer, finishing with cheese., Dissolve the mustard and salt in 1/4 cup milk., Beat eggs; stir in mustard mixture and rest of milk., Pour over macaroni and cheese., Bake for 40 to 50 minutes or until knife stuck, comes out clean.

title: Corn Pudding
directions: Mix well together., Cook at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Golden Brownies
directions: Melt 1 stick margarine and pour into an oblong pan., Mix all chips and crushed wafers., Pour condensed milk over mixture., Mix. Pour into pan., Cook at 350° for 30 minutes, until golden., Cool and cut into squares.

title: Shrimp Dip
directions: Beat cream cheese, gradually adding milk., Beat until smooth. Add lemon juice, Worcestershire sauce, garlic, salt and pepper. Add shrimp and stir in cream cheese mixture., Chill., Makes about 1 1/2 cups dip.

title: Eggplant Casserole
directions: Peel and cut up eggplant., Then boil until they are done enough to mash up., Remove from the boiling water and mash the eggplant., Then add cream of chicken soup, onion (chopped), eggs, salt, pepper, cornbread (crumbled), light bread and sage to your taste., Mix well.

title: Katy'S Delight
directions: Dissolve Jell-O in cottage cheese., Mix well., Drain and add oranges and pineapple., Stir in Cool Whip., Refrigerate.

title: Famous Pumpkin Pie
directions: Preheat oven to 425°., Mix ingredients in order given., Pour into unbaked pie shell., Bake 15 minutes., Reduce heat to 350°. Continue baking 45 minutes or until knife inserted near center comes out clean., Cool completely and garnish, if desired, with whipped cream.

title: Cauliflower Slaw
directions: Slice raw cauliflower thin., Combine with other ingredients. Serve in salad bowl., Salt to taste., Chill overnight.

title: Risotto
directions: Brown chopped onion and rice in hot oiled pan., Add water and bouillon., Cook for 15 to 20 minutes., Turn off., Add Cheddar cheese., Serve with meat, vegetables and rolls.

title: Stove Top Baked Beans
directions: In skillet, cook bacon or ground beef., Use meat drippings to cook onion and bell pepper., Drain., Add all ingredients., Bring to boil, then simmer for 20 minutes.

title: Rolls
directions: Put shortening and milk in saucepan; let heat until shortening melts., (We use oleomargarine.), Remove from heat and let cool. In a large mixing bowl, dissolve the yeast in water., Add sugar and salt., Add the cooked milk mixture and the beaten eggs (whole), then sifted flour., Mix well., Cover the bowl with cloth or waxed paper., Let rise until double in bulk., Turn on lightly floured board and knead lightly., Roll out 1/4-inch thin., Spread with melted butter and fold over to make two layers., Cut in shapes., Place about 1/2-inch apart to rise in greased pans., Let rise again until double in bulk (about 2 hours)., Bake in medium oven at 350° for about 10 to 15 minutes., This will make 40 extra large rolls.

title: Chicken Divan
directions: Cook broccoli in boiling water until tender., Drain., Arrange broccoli in greased 11 1/2 x 7 1/2-inch dish., Place chicken on top., Combine soup, curry powder, mayonnaise and lemon juice. Pour over chicken., Sprinkle with cheese., Combine bread crumbs and butter., Sprinkle over mixture. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Date Pudding
directions: Mix, all, dry, ingredients, together., Add, milk and egg whites, beaten stiff., Set in pan of water and bake in moderate oven for 50 minutes., Take out of pan of water last 5 minutes.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Place cooked broccoli in greased casserole., Combine remaining ingredients and pour over broccoli., Sprinkle 1/2 cup sharp, grated cheese over top., Top with 3/4 cup fresh bread crumbs. Melt 1 tablespoon margarine and dribble over top., Bake until bubbly, approximately 35 to 45 minutes at 350°.

title: Braunschweiger Ball
directions: Bring cream cheese and braunschweiger to room temperature. Combine half of the cream cheese with remaining ingredients except nuts. Mix well., Spread in mold and chill for several hours. Unmold., Frost with remaining cream cheese., Garnish with chopped nuts., Serve with crackers or a party loaf bread.

title: Pennsylvania Dutch Sugar Cakes
directions: Cream butter and sugar thoroughly., Mix in beaten eggs., Sift dry ingredients and add to creamed mixture alternately with sour milk., Add almonds and vanilla flavorings., Pour into 3 greased 8-inch pie pans., Sprinkle 1 tablespoon sugar on top of each. Bake at 350° about 25 minutes.

title: Shrimp Spread
directions: Place cream cheese in a bowl and stir until very smooth., Add all remaining ingredients and stir until thoroughly blended. Transfer to serving bowl and garnish with sliced olives, if desired., Serve with assorted crackers., Makes 1 1/2 cups.

title: Peanut Butter Rocky Road Fudge
directions: Place chocolate chips, peanut butter chips and the peanut butter in 2-quart dish in microwave, uncovered, on Medium until melted, 2 to 3 minutes., Stir until smooth., Mix in marshmallows and peanuts until evenly coated; spread in buttered square 8 x 8 pan., Refrigerate until firm, at least 1 hour; cut into bars.

title: Crock-Pot Chicken
directions: Sprinkle chicken with seasoned salt; place in crock-pot on high., Mix remaining ingredients., Pour over chicken., Cook for 3 to 4 hours, stirring occasionally., Serve over cooked rice. Enjoy!

title: Oyster Rockefeller Soup
directions: Cook spinach in the bouillon., Puree in food processor with oysters., Add enough milk to make 1 quart of soup., Serves 4.

title: Ham Loaf
directions: Mix together and shape into loaf., Place in casserole and pour over it a syrup made of 1 cup brown sugar, 1/2 cup vinegar and 2/3 cup water., Bake 1 1/2 hours at 350°., Baste with syrup 3 or 4 times.

title: Quick Shaker Cake
directions: Combine the first 4 ingredients and shake (mix or blend), then add flour, baking powder and salt., Mix well., Pour into a greased 8-inch square pan and bake at 375° for 30 to 35 minutes., Top with fresh strawberries and whipped topping when completely cooled.

title: Red Velvet Cake
directions: Cream butter, sugar and eggs in bowl until light and fluffy. Add mixture of cocoa and food coloring; mix well., Add salt, buttermilk, flour and vanilla; mix well., Stir in mixture of vinegar and baking soda., Spoon into 2 greased and floured 8-inch cake pans., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes., Cool., Split layers horizontally; spread with Fluffy White Frosting between layers and over top of cake.

title: Bagel Chips
directions: Heat oven to 325°. Mix oil, margarine and garlic; brush onto bagel slices., Bake slices on cookie sheet for 10 to 12 minutes or until bagels are crisp., Store in tightly covered container.

title: Barbecue Roast
directions: Put inside cooking bag (make few slits in top of bag)., Put cooking bag inside crock-pot., Cook approximately 10 hours on low. Take the roast out of the crock-pot and cooking bag and tear up with a fork, then put the roast back in crock-pot., Cover with barbecue sauce and heat until hot through.

title: Wild Berry Cobbler
directions: Place butter in a 2 qt. rectangular baking dish., Heat in oven for 5 minutes until butter is melted., Remove dish from oven. Stir together, flour, sugar, powder and salt., Add milk and stir until just combined., Pour this over melted butter; do not stir. Spoon fruit over batter.

title: Hush Puppies
directions: In bowl, combine cornmeal, flour, salt, baking powder and soda., Add onion, buttermilk and then egg; blend., Drop from tablespoon, a few at a time, into deep shortening heated to 375°. Fry, until golden., Drain on paper toweling.

title: Wackey Cake
directions: Mix all dry ingredients in 8 x 8-inch baking pan., Add the liquids., Mix and bake in moderate oven 350° for 30-35 minutes.

title: Chicken And Creamed Noodles
directions: Bake chicken at 350° for 30 minutes; drain juice off the chicken., Add the noodles., Mix water and soup; pour over the chicken., Sprinkle spices from the noodle packs over the chicken. Bake for 30 minutes in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan., If the noodles are not tender, cook a little longer.

title: Celery Seed Salad Dressing
directions: Combine all ingredients., Keep refrigerated., This recipe makes enough to keep extra on hand.

title: Old Fashion Pumpkin Pie Filling Or Sweet Potato
directions: Beat all ingredients well., Pour into 9-inch deep dish pie shell., Bake at 425°, for 15 minutes., Reduce oven to 350° and bake, 45 minutes more until knife inserted comes out clean., Cool.

title: Soft Molasses Cookies
directions: Mix sugar and molasses., Add melted shortening and eggs; mix well., Add vanilla., Dissolve the soda in hot water., Sift flour, cream of tartar, spices and salt together, then mix all together. Let mixed dough stand in a cool place for 1 hour., Roll out to about 1/8-inch thick., Bake at 350° on a well-greased cookie tin for 10 minutes, or until well done.

title: Turkey
directions: Have turkey at room temperature., Rub inside and out with salt., Preheat oven to 475°.

title: Pinto Beans
directions: Soak beans overnight in large pot., Drain and rinse thoroughly., Put back in large pot; cover with cold water., Add salt and bacon or bacon grease., Cook slowly for several hours until tender and nice broth has formed., Enjoy with corn bread and onions.

title: Cranberry Tea
directions: Bring water and tea to gentle boil and let steep; add sugar. Remove tea bags, pour into 1 gallon container., Add Ocean Spray cranberry juice concentrate., Fill remainder of container with cool water., Serve hot or cold with lemon wedge or cinnamon stick.

title: Favorite Pancakes
directions: Beat egg well., Add milk and soda., Beat in the rest of ingredients until smooth., Cook on heavy griddle., Makes about 16 (4-inch) pancakes.

title: Egg Foo Yong
directions: Combine eggs, bean sprouts, meat or seafood, onion, salt and pepper., Mix together lightly. Melt 1 teaspoon butter in 6-inch skillet., Pack 1/2 cup of mixture into skillet., Cook until set and brown on edges., Turn and brown on other side.

title: No Bake Cookies
directions: Boil first 3 ingredients one minute., Remove from heat., Stir in remaining ingredients., Press into greased pan., Cut into squares.

title: Red Beans And Rice
directions: Cook beans according to package directions., Add meat and all ingredients and simmer together for about 4 hours., Smash several beans on the side of the pan.

title: Sour Cream-Lemon Pie
directions: Combine sugar, cornstarch, lemon rind, juice, egg yolks and milk in a heavy saucepan; cook over medium heat until thick, stirring constantly., Stir in butter and cool mixture to room temperature., Stir in sour cream and pour into pie shell., Cover with whipped cream and garnish with lemon twists., Store in refrigerator.

title: Hermits(Portuguese)
directions: Combine ingredients. Drop in spoonfuls on buttered pan or cookie sheet. Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Corn Bread
directions: Mix all ingredients together except oil., Heat oil in 10-inch iron skillet., Pour hot oil into cornbread mix., Blend., Pour mixture into hot skillet., Bake at 425° until done, 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Diabetic Low Calorie Punch
directions: Mix first 5 ingredients., Add 7-Up and ice ring just prior to serving.

title: Pumpkin Muffins
directions: Combine ingredients as listed., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Baked Fish
directions: Salt and pepper fish., Arrange pepper slices and onion slices over fish., Mix chicken broth, lemon juice and basil., Pour mixture over fish., Bake 1/2 hour at 350°.

title: Corn Fritters
directions: Sift flour, baking powder and salt into mixing bowl., Add egg and creamed corn, mix well., Heat corn oil in skillet., Drop corn mixture by tablespoons into hot corn oil and fry until golden brown on both sides., Makes 18.

title: Blizzard Of 1993 Soup
directions: Soak beans for several hours., Wash and put in a large pot and cover with 3-quarts water., Add onions and garlic, both slightly browned in butter., Salt to taste., Add ham hock, parsley, bay leaves, juice of 1/2 lemon and several drops of Tabasco sauce. Cover and cook slowly for 3 to 4 hours., Add smoked sausage and pepper to taste and cook about 45 minutes longer.

title: Punch Bowl Cake
directions: Bake cake in 2 layers., Put one layer, broken in pieces, in bottom of bowl and add 1/2 pie filling, 1/2 crushed pineapple and 1/2 nuts., Repeat with second layer of cake., Add cherries last. Refrigerate.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Melt butter in skillet and cut up onion. Cook until the onion is tender. Add soups; stir until smooth. Add 1/2 cup of milk. Debone chicken; layer chicken, rice and soup mixture. Top with cheese. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Clam Chowder
directions: Fry first four ingredients in butter or margarine. Add remaining ingredients; simmer until the potatoes are soft, but firm. Add light cream and a pinch of sugar to the pot. Serve with a baguette and a nice white wine. BON APPETITE!

title: Oven Browned Potatoes
directions: In a large plastic bag or bowl with secure lid, combine all ingredients., Shake to be sure all potato pieces are coated with oil and onion soup mix., Pour coated potatoes into medium size casserole dish., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until potatoes are tender., Stir once during cook time.

title: Quick Chicken Pie
directions: Cook and take chicken off bone., Reserve 2 cups broth., Cut chicken into pieces and place in bottom of baking dish., Melt margarine and pour over chicken., Mix together dry ingredients and mix well with milk., Pour over chicken., Heat soup and broth to the boiling point and pour over all., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes., Makes its own crust.

title: Zucchini Sweet Pickles
directions: In a large canner container, add zucchini, water and lime. Soak, weighted down, overnight. Drain and wash well., Cover with clean water. Let stand for 2, hours and drain.

title: New England Dinner
directions: In a large pan, put water., Cut potatoes, carrots and onion up. Put into pan., Cut sausage up., Lay on top of vegetables., Quarter cabbage and put on top., Bring water to boil., Cook until done. Place on large platter., Serve., Put salt and pepper to season. Add butter to season also.

title: Ranger Cookies
directions: Mix well., Make into walnut size balls, mash down and put on a cookie sheet., Bake at 350° for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Pepper Steak
directions: Brown steak in hot fat. Add all other ingredients. Simmer in a pan for 2 hours or in pressure cooker for 15 minutes at 10 pounds pressure. Serve over rice.

title: Rice Chicken Dinner
directions: Put rice in bottom of greased roasting pan., Place serving pieces of chicken on top., Pour the can of soup over., Pour water over all., Sprinkle dry soup mix on top., Cover and bake at 325° for 2 1/2 hours.

title: Crispy Rice-Peanut Butter Sandwich
directions: Make spread out of first 3 ingredients., Place mixture between bread slices., Serves 4.

title: Easy Fettuccine
directions: Cook pasta as directed on package. In a large pan, melt butter slowly. Add drained noodles. Pour in Sweet Sue chicken broth, half and half, garlic powder, grated cheese, salt and pepper to taste. Gently stir until heated and the cheese is melted. Yield: 6 servings.

title: Braided Sausage Bread
directions: Place wide ends of crescent rolls together. Roll into rectangle shape on cookie sheet that's been sprayed with Pam. In large skillet, brown sausage; drain. Add chopped green onions, chopped celery, chopped onions, chopped bell pepper and minced garlic clove. Cook until vegetables are tender. Add cream cheese. Keep stirring until melted. Let cool. Place down middle of rectangle. Cut strips down each long side crisscross over top of sausage mix. Bake in oven preheated to 375° for 20 to 25 minutes, until golden brown.

title: Twinki Cake
directions: Mix and bake cake mix according to box instructions., Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan., Cool and split cake (best use a thread)., Take top layer off and ice first layer with filling., Replace second layer on top and sprinkle with powdered sugar.

title: Chocolate Chip Muffins
directions: Beat egg; stir in milk and oil., Stir in remaining ingredients except chocolate chips just until flour is moistened (don't overmix)., Fold in chocolate chips., Put batter into a dozen paper muffin cups and bake about 20 minutes.

title: Shrimp Canapes
directions: Mix shrimp, onion, mayonnaise, salt and pepper., Spread on Ritz crackers or Club crackers., Place slice of cheese on shrimp and sprinkle with paprika., Bake at 375° for 10 minutes or until cheese starts to melt., Serve hot.

title: Appetizer Cheese Sandwiches
directions: Mix first 5 ingredients well and chill before spreading., Trim whole wheat bread slices and spread with mixture., Cut into 3 fingers. Refrigerate until serving.

title: No Cook Divinity
directions: Combine frosting mix (dry), corn syrup, vanilla and boiling water in a small mixer bowl., Beat on highest speed until stiff peaks form, about 5 minutes., Transfer to a large mixer bowl., On low speed or by hand gradually blend in sugar., Stir in nuts. Drop mixture by teaspoon onto waxed paper., When outside of candy feels firm, turn over and allow to dry at least 12 hours., Store candy in airtight container., Makes 5 to 6 dozen pieces.

title: Gingerbread
directions: Sift together the flour, baking soda, salt, cinnamon, ginger, allspice and cloves., Melt shortening in hot water., Add molasses and stir., Pour liquid mixture into flour mixture and beat well. Pour into an 8-inch square greased pan., Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes or until top of gingerbread is light brown and springs back to the touch., Serve warm and top with whipped cream, if desired.

title: Australian Pavlova
directions: Beat egg whites with electric mixer until stiff and dry. Gradually add sugar until all the sugar is dissolved., Mix baking powder and cornstarch together., Sprinkle over meringue while mixing., Add vanilla and vinegar., Beat for another minute. Preheat oven to 300°., Line a cookie sheet with aluminum foil. Grease foil and sprinkle with cornstarch., Mark out an 8-inch circle on the foil and spoon meringue into circle, heaping it up in the center as much as possible.

title: Cream Cheese Pound Cake
directions: Cream margarine and cream cheese together until light and fluffy, then add sugar., Cream until fluffy., Add sugar and cream until fluffy., Add eggs one at a time, then add flavoring., Add flour., Pour into tube, Bundt pan or loaf pans., Bake in 300° oven for 1 1/2 hours or until tested done.

title: Sock-It-To-Me Cake
directions: Mix brown sugar and cinnamon., Pour 1/2 batter in greased Teflon Bundt pan., Sprinkle brown sugar and cinnamon over., Add rest of cake batter on top., Bake at 350° for 50 minutes., Cool 10 minutes in pan., Glaze.

title: Raisin Bran Muffins
directions: Combine flour, soda, salt, sugar and cereal., Add milk, shortening and eggs., Bake at 400° for 15 to 18 minutes or microwave on Medium 4 1/2 minutes., Unbaked batter keeps in Tupperware in refrigerator for up to 6 weeks.

title: Mock Boursin Cheese
directions: Blend all ingredients together., Chill a few hours., Serve with crackers or fill small puffs., Will keep a week refrigerated.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Beat butter and sugar until fluffy., Beat in egg and vanilla. Add flour, spices and soda., Stir in oats., Bake at 375° for 8 to 9 minutes for soft cookies.

title: Apple Pie In A Bucket
directions: Combine all ingredients in saucepan. Cook for 15 to 20 minutes until liquid is clear and slightly thickens., Apples do not need to be done. Cool. Pour into an ice cream bucket. Freeze. Two batches fill one bucket. Thaw for 1 hour to get enough to fill a pie when needed.

title: Beef Shortribs Supreme
directions: Brown shortribs on all sides in a large skillet without shortening. Cover and cook over low heat 1 hour. Drain off drippings. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over ribs. Cover and cook over low heat 1 1/2 hours. Serve over mashed potatoes.

title: Oyster Crackers
directions: Combine first 6 ingredients and pour over crackers., Mix until crackers have "dull" finish., Store in airtight container.

title: Hot Punch
directions: Simmer ingredients 10 minutes before serving., Add small amount of butter in each cup for serving, if desired.

title: Quick Green Beans
directions: Stir flour, salt and pepper into melted butter in saucepan. Stir in milk., Cook until thickened., Pour over green beans. Sprinkle with Cheddar cheese., Brown under broiler.

title: Magic Pumpkin Pie
directions: In large mixing bowl, blend together all ingredients., Turn mixture into pie shell., Bake in 375° oven until sharp bladed knife inserted near center comes out clean, 50 to 55 minutes., Cool. Refrigerate at least 1 hour., May press 1/4 cup chopped pecans into shell before pouring in filling.

title: One Dish Chicken
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., In a 3 quart casserole dish, place uncooked rice., Sprinkle onion soup mix on top of rice, spoon cream of celery on next., Pour boiling water over the whole thing. Place chicken on top., Bake uncovered for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Pickled Cauliflower And Carrots
directions: Cut cauliflower and put in bowl with 2 tablespoons salt., Do the same with carrots; let stand 2 hours., Rinse and drain. Combine vinegar, sugar, onion flakes, mustard seed, turmeric and peppercorns., Bring to a boil; add carrots and return to boil. Simmer 5 minutes., Add cauliflower; return to boil and simmer 8 minutes., Put in jars and seal.

title: Amish Yeast Bread
directions: Scald milk; remove from heat., Add 1/4 cup sugar, salt, butter and mashed potatoes., Cool., Dissolve yeast in water, then mix with milk., Add raisins and flour., Stir., Let rise in warm place 1 1/2 hours.

title: Beef Stroganoff
directions: Saute hamburger, pepper and onions until meat is done., Add salt, pepper and soups., Cook for 20 minutes., Before serving, add 1 container of sour cream., Serve over noodles or rice.

title: Microwave Baked Lima Beans
directions: You will need a 3-quart microwave-safe casserole.

title: Turtle Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Prepare cake mix according to package directions., Pour 1/2 batter into a Pam-sprayed 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake for only 15 minutes., In top of double boiler over hot water, melt together caramels, milk and butter., Pour this over baked portion of the cake., Sprinkle the pecans and chocolate chips over the caramel mixture., Spread the remaining batter over this mixture., Bake an additional 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Blondies
directions: Preset oven to 325°. Line 13 x 9-inch metal pan or butter it. Cook in center. Melt butter and white chocolate over low heat (or microwave). Stir until smooth. Cool for 10 minutes. Stir in sugar and eggs (one at a time), using a wooden spoon. Stir well after each addition. Stir in flour, raisins, coconut, vanilla and salt. Spread in prepared pan. Bake at 325° for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Brocoli Delight
directions: Cut tops of broccoli into bite size pieces., Cut bacon into bite size pieces and fry until crisp., Drain., Combine broccoli, bacon, onion, raisins and cashews in salad bowl., Make dressing of mayo, sugar and vinegar., Let dressing set until sugar dissolves. Add more broccoli if desired and serve.

title: Texas Cookies
directions: Cream first 3 ingredients., Add egg., Add remaining ingredients., Drop from teaspoon onto greased cookie sheet., Bake in 350° oven about 10 minutes or until slightly brown.

title: Chocolate Confection Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°, grease and flour jelly roll pan., Prepare cake following package directions for basic recipe., Pour into pan. Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes or until toothpicks inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Reuben Casserole
directions: Press sauerkraut between paper towels to remove excess moisture., Combine kraut, onion, sour cream and garlic powder; stir well., Spoon mixture into lightly greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish., Sprinkle corned beef evenly over kraut mixture; top with cheese.

title: Baked Vegetables Au Gratin
directions: In skillet, melt butter and saute onion and garlic salt., In casserole, mix beans, corn, celery, green pepper and basil., Add sauteed onion and mix well., Mix 1 cup of cheese in mixture., Take bread cubes and place along outer edge of casserole, leaving the middle open., Sprinkle the rest of cheese over top of it all. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Grandma'S Goulash
directions: Brown hamburger meat with onions., Add uncooked macaroni, chopped tomato, sugar and ketchup., Simmer with lid until macaroni is tender.

title: Heavenly Waffles
directions: Mix all ingredients together. Pour in hot waffle iron. Brown to preference. Serves 6 (2 waffles each); makes 12 (4 x 4-inch) waffles.

title: Hamburger Patties
directions: Combine 1/4 cup soup, ground beef, bread crumbs, egg and onion. Mix; shape into patties., Brown patties; drain off grease., Combine soup and water., Spoon over beef patties and let simmer, covered, over low heat for 20 minutes.

title: Sauerkraut Casserole
directions: Preheat oven to 350., In large skillet or Dutch oven., Cook Italian Sausage and onion until sausage is brown and onion is tender., Drain fat., Stir in apples, sauerkraut, water, sugar and caraway seed., Transfer to a 2-1/2 qt. baking dish., Cover and bake for 1 hour., Serves 4.

title: Tom'S Corn Fritters
directions: Combine corn, flour, sugar, eggs, salt and oil and mix in blender., Add milk if necessary., Fry in hot fat., Use a teaspoon as a measure., Keep warm on paper towels in oven until ready to serve., Serve with pancake syrup, jelly, powdered sugar or plain.

title: Potato Soup
directions: Cook together potatoes, carrots, celery and onion until tender., Save water., Cook 4 to 8 strips of bacon and crumble. Melt margarine; add soup, milk and sour cream., Add vegetables, bacon and as much reserved water as you like., Salt and pepper as desired., Simmer.

title: Ham Loaf
directions: Mix all this together.

title: Crispy Cheese Wafers
directions: Mix first 6 ingredients., Add Rice Krispies., Roll in small balls., Press with fork., Bake at 350° for 15 minutes., Yield:, 4 to 5 dozen.

title: Broccoli-Rice Casserole
directions: Cook broccoli until just thawed., Drain and mix with rice. Mix soup and milk; pour over rice mixture., Stir in cheese cubes. Bake 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Sausage Balls
directions: Mix all ingredients well with hands and shape into small balls about the size of walnuts., Place on cookie sheet about 1-inch apart., Will not spread when baked so can be placed close together., Bake at 350° for about 15 minutes., Will be brown on bottom., Do not overcook., Can be stored at room temperature in airtight container., Makes about 100 balls.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
directions: Boil and mash potatoes., Mix in sugar, butter, eggs, vanilla and milk., Put in 13 x 9-inch baking dish.

title: Impossible Pie
directions: Mix together all ingredients for 3 minutes., Pour into ungreased 10-inch pie plate (glass is best)., Bake at 375° for 45 minutes., Do not open oven at all until 45 minutes is up.

title: Corn Casserole
directions: Mix the first 8 ingredients together., Pour into a greased casserole dish., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes., Sprinkle cheese over top before the last 15 minutes of baking.

title: Strawberry Dip
directions: Mix ingredients well., Chill., Serve with strawberries and other fresh fruit.

title: Roasted Chili Peppers(To Roast And Peel Green Chilies)
directions: Preheat oven to 500 degrees.

title: Peter Paul Mounds Cake
directions: Heat milk and sugar., Add marshmallows until melted., Add coconut., Spread on cake while it is still hot., Cool completely.

title: Orange Supreme Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Combine dry cake mix, coconut, 1 tablespoon orange peel, evaporated milk, 1/3 cup orange juice, 3 eggs and oil in large mixer bowl., Mix cake as directed on package. Divide batter evenly in 2 layer pans; bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes., Cool in pans on racks 10 minutes., Remove from pans; cool completely on racks., Refrigerate for ease in splitting., For orange filling, beat 3 eggs until blended in saucepan., Stir in sugar, 3/4 cup orange juice and 1 tablespoon orange peel., Cook; stir over low heat until thick., Cool., Whip cream until stiff. Fold whipped cream, vanilla extract and almond extract into egg mixture., Split each layer into 2 thin layers., Spread filling between layers and on top of cake., Decorate with mandarin orange segments and toasted almonds, if desired., Refrigerate.

title: Applesauce Cinnamon Muffins
directions: Mix these six ingredients and add to the mixed dry ingredients., Pour into prepared muffin tins and bake for 15 to 20 minutes at 375°., Makes 12 muffins.

title: 7 Minute Icing
directions: Mix and heat about 7 minutes (beat) over boiling water in double boiler., Remove from heat; beat 1 minute., Add 1 teaspoon vanilla flavoring.

title: Sandy'S Sticky Buns
directions: Butter Bundt pan., Put frozen rolls in pan., Sprinkle pudding mix over rolls., Mix margarine, sugar, pecans and cinnamon; pour over rolls., Cover with plastic wrap and leave sitting out overnight to rise., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

title: Vegetable Salad
directions: Place all the ingredients in large bowl., Marinate overnight in the Italian dressing.

title: Punch
directions: In blender, puree raspberries., Add all ingredients; stir until sugar dissolves., Add sherbet and champagne., Stir gently.

title: Kim'S Potato Salad
directions: Boil potatoes until done., Drain well., While potatoes are still hot, pour Garlic Expressions over and toss lightly., Add onions, parsley, dill and seasonings and lightly toss again., Add mayonnaise and mix., Serve immediately or refrigerate.

title: Chili
directions: Brown ground beef in skillet on medium heat., Drain off fat. Using fork, crumble ground beef into pea size pieces., In large pot combine beef and remaining ingredients., Bring to a simmer over low heat., Cook, stirring every 15 minutes for about 2 to 3 hours.

title: Tuna Casserole
directions: Cook noodles as directed; drain., Add margarine and enough milk to cover half of noodles., Add tuna and cream of chicken soup., Stir and mix well., Pour half of mixture into casserole dish and cover with cheese., Next, pour remaining mixture and top with more cheese., Bake at 400° until brown, about 15 minutes.

title: Cutlets Du Tofu
directions: Bake in preheated oven 25 minutes at 350°., Slice tofu, roll in seasoned bread crumbs., Place on greased cookie sheet, turn every 15 minutes., Saute onion, garlic and green peppers in 2 tablespoons oil., Pour over cutlets when done., Serve.

title: Green Pepper Steak
directions: Combine soy sauce, garlic, onion, peppers, celery, tomatoes and 1 cup water., Cook about 20 minutes., Fry hamburgers in small patties until done., Pour off grease and then pour first mixture over hamburgers in skillet., Make 3/4 cup water and 1 tablespoon flour or cornstarch in cup., Shake well and pour over hamburgers; simmer about 15 minutes., Serve with rice or fried potatoes., If it's too thick, add a little more water and stir in.

title: Cherry Drops
directions: Cream butter and sugar., Add egg yolk and vanilla; beat well. Add flour and drop from teaspoon onto ungreased cookie sheet. Decorate with halved, dried maraschino cherries., Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes., Yields 2 dozen.

title: Zucchini Cookies
directions: Mix well then add:, 1 cup grated zucchini, 1 cup grated walnuts (optional)., Mix well., Chill for 2 hours.	Drop by teaspoon on greased baking sheet., Bake at 375° for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Malt Shoppe Pie
directions: Combine softened ice cream and Cool Whip until blended. Reserve 8 Whoppers for garnish., Add remaining crushed Whoppers to ice cream mixture., Pour into pie shell., Sprinkle remaining crushed Whoppers to garnish., Freeze., Also good with chocolate wafers and cookie pie crust.

title: Refrigerator Vegetable Salad
directions: Drain first 4 ingredients., Add celery, onion and green pepper., Bring to boil the vinegar, sugar, salt, pepper and water. Pour over vegetables., Keeps well in refrigerator.

title: Chicken And Cheese
directions: Place chicken breasts in a greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Alternate pieces of cheese over the chicken. In a separate bowl mix soup, milk and water., Pour over chicken and cheese., Sprinkle with bread crumbs., Serve over rice or with potato., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour until top is golden brown and sides bubbling.

title: Chris' Belly Buttons
directions: Separate ham slices and blot moisture off with paper towel. Spread cream cheese on slice., Place green onion on edge and roll the slice of ham around the onion., Slice across, making belly buttons., They're very attractive at parties and delicious, too!

title: Hot Milk Cake
directions: Place on the stove the milk with butter in it and let it scald., Break the eggs into the sugar and beat well., Add the flour to which has been added the baking powder and salt., Lastly add milk, then vanilla.

title: Marriage Cake
directions: Sift understanding once through his love, once through her love and once through the love of Christ., Add teasing and spunk; sift once more., Separate tempers., Beat his until tender and hers until light and frothy., To his, add patience and sharing; add to understanding to which has been added a sense of humor., Fold in hers with spice of your own choice., This can be varied from time to time, for variety is the spice of life., Handle all ingredients tenderly., Bake in 4 loving arms, well prepared with forgiveness, at a comfortable temperature., Put layers together with hugs and kisses., Slice in generous slices and share often.

title: Hudson Bay Bread
directions: Blend margarine,, sugar, syrup and honey., Add oats and almonds and mix well., Place batter in greased baking pan into a 14-inch Dutch oven., Cover and bake 20 minutes., Remove from the pan and allow to cool on rack.

title: Cherokee Casserole
directions: Brown and crumble hamburger. Add all ingredients except cheese to the hamburger and mix. Place in a microwaveable casserole dish. Sprinkle cheese on top. Microwave on HIGH (covered) for 10 minutes.

title: Neiman-Marcus Bars
directions: Mix together., Pat into a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch cake pan.

title: Lentil Vegetable Soup
directions: Saute chopped garlic lightly in olive oil in an 8-quart pot. Add all ingredients, except ditalini., Simmer about 2 hours, until vegetables are tender., Add water as needed to fill 7 quarts. Cook and serve ditalini separately., Accompany this hearty meal with Italian bread.

title: Perfect White Bread
directions: In large mixing bowl combine 2-1/2 cups of the flour and the yeast. In saucepan heat milk, sugar, shortening, and salt just until warm (115-120 degrees), stirring constantly until shortening almost melts. Add to dry mixture in mixing bowl. Beat on low speed of electric mixer for 1/2 minute, scraping sides of bowl constantly. Beat 3 minutes at high speed. By hand, stir in enough of the remaining flour to make a moderately stiff dough. Turn out onto a lightly floured surface and knead until smooth and elastic, 8 to 10 minutes. Shape in a ball.

title: Poppy Seed Cake
directions: Mix everything until smooth., Pour into 10-inch tube pan (greased and floured)., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Sloppy Joes
directions: Mix all ingredients together and cook for 5 minutes.

title: Chocolate Cake
directions: Boil water, butter and cocoa. Add remaining ingredients. Beat well. Pour into greased 13 x 8 pan. Bake at 400° for 20 minutes. Ice while hot.

title: No-Nothings
directions: Add water or milk to make a soft dough., Roll 1-inch thick. Cut with doughnut cutters and fry as doughnuts.

title: Sweet And Sour Salmon(Low Calorie)
directions: Mix all ingredients except salmon and Equal., Marinate salmon for 2 to 3 hours in the mixture., Drain marinade into a small shallow pan or skillet., Heat to a simmer., Use a spatula to place the salmon steaks into the hot liquid., Cover lightly with foil. Cook salmon until it flakes., Remove salmon to platter., Add Equal to sauce and garnish each steak with 1 tablespoon of poaching liquid., Makes 5 servings, 155 calories per serving., Exchange diet 3 meats.

title: Summer Lunch Salad
directions: Marinate 24 hours., When serving, layer torn bits of mixed greens and marinated mixture in a large salad bowl; sprinkle with fried bacon bits on top., Good with grilled cheese sandwiches.

title: Spurgeon Cranberry Cookies
directions: Mix all ingredients in order given., Preheat oven to 375°. Spoon cookies onto greased cookie sheet., Bake for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Pineapple Casserole
directions: Drain crushed pineapple and spread in dish., Mix sugar and flour and sprinkle over pineapple., Sprinkle well with grated cheese., Crush Ritz type crackers and mix with melted margarine. Spread over cheese., Bake at 350° for about 30 minutes.

title: Corn Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients well and pour into a well buttered casserole dish., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Crab Cakes
directions: Mix first 8 ingredients together and cook until thick. Mix with crab meat and when cool, make patties. Roll in beaten egg and crumbs. Refrigerate for 1 hour, then fry until golden brown.

title: Cocoa Mints
directions: Combine all ingredients in a large mixing bowl., Mix with hands until well blended., Add more water, 1/4 teaspoon at a time, if needed to hold mixture together., Shape mixture into a ball; place on a sheet of wax paper and roll out to 1/4-inch thickness., Cut into desired shapes with cookie cutters; chill several hours. Store in an airtight container in a cool, dry place., Makes 2 3/4 pounds mints.

title: Tuna Patties
directions: Beat eggs and add milk., Mix with tuna., Add crumbs, salt and pepper., Shape in patties and fry in skillet with enough oil to cover bottom.

title: Sourdough Pancakes
directions: Combine the first 4 ingredients in a glass bowl; let stand overnight loosely covered., Mix all remaining ingredients together., Add to first mixture until smooth., Pour 1/3 cup at a time onto hot, lightly greased griddle., Turn pancakes as soon as bubbles form; cook other side until golden brown.

title: Lasagna
directions: Brown beef; add onion, juice, special sauce, tomato paste, garlic seasoning, oregano and salt to taste, also Tabasco sauce. Simmer gently 45 minutes., Put in layers:, first 1/2 of the meat sauce, then noodles, Mozzarella cheese, cottage cheese, Swiss cheese, then rest of meat sauce., Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake 45 minutes to 1 hour at 350°.

title: Cherry Delight
directions: Mix crumbs with sugar., Pour melted butter over mixture and toss lightly to coat., Pat firmly over entire bottom of 9-inch square baking dish., Cream the cream cheese well, add vanilla and confectioners sugar and beat until fluffy., Blend in whipped cream., Spread mixture over crust., Pour pie filling over top. Refrigerate 8 hours or overnight.

title: Cherry Punch
directions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water., Add sugar and stir until dissolved., Cool to room temperature (this is very important)., Do not chill in refrigerator., Add fruit juices and ginger ale just before serving., Yields 25 to 30 servings.

title: Apple Crisp
directions: Sift first 5 ingredients together., Add egg and mix until crumbly., Sprinkle over sweetened apples and then pour over mixture the melted butter or oleo., Bake until apples are done in a 350° oven.

title: Chalupa (Mexican Main Dish)
directions: In frying pan, cook hamburger and dry onion until done., Add refried beans and cook until hot., Place meat on large platter. Add part of cheese., Add all remaining ingredients as a tossed salad on top of meat., Use salsa as a dressing.

title: Chocolate Refrigerator Cookies
directions: Mix shortening, sugar, brown sugar, eggs and vanilla., Blend in melted unsweetened chocolate., Sift together and stir in flour and salt., Mix in chopped nuts., Mix thoroughly with hands., Press and mold into a long, smooth roll., Wrap in waxed paper and chill until stiff., With a thin, sharp knife, cut into thin slices. Place a little apart on an ungreased cookie sheet., Bake at 400° for 6 to 8 minutes.

title: Chicken Delight
directions: Put rice in a 9x 12-inch glass pan., Mix half the dry soup with rice., Place chicken over rice., Mix mushroom soup with 2 cans of water. Pour over chicken., Sprinkle other half of dry soup on top., Bake at 325° for 2, hours., Serves 10.

title: Pineapple Filling
directions: Cook until clear and thick enough to spread on cake.

title: Chocolate Marshmallow Bars
directions: Combine sugars and shortening., Add beaten eggs., Sift flour and soda; add to mixture., Add vanilla, chips and nuts., Bake in greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan in a 325° oven for 20 minutes. Top with marshmallows; return to oven for 15 minutes at 300°.

title: Macaroni Salad
directions: Mix together the first three ingredients. Cook the elbow macaroni. Drain and rinse in cold water. Then add other ingredients. Chill; the longer it sets, the better.

title: Toasty Oats Snack
directions: Heat oven to 250°., Spread oats and walnuts in ungreased roasting pan., Bake uncovered 1 hour, shaking pan occasionally. Cool., Mix with raisins and dates., Spoon individual servings into small plastic bags., Makes 24 servings (about 1/3 cup each).

title: Lemon Garlic Oil
directions: Place garlic and lemon peel in bottle., Add oil; cover and chill at least 1 week, no longer than 2 months., Bring to room temperature before using., Use on salads or to brush over fish or poultry before broiling., Makes 1 to 1 1/2 cups.

title: Raspberry Divinity
directions: Cook sugar, syrup and water together over moderate heat to hard ball stage or 252° on the candy thermometer., Stir often. Beat egg whites until foamy., Add dry gelatin., Beat until egg whites form peaks., Slowly beat in hot mixture; continue beating until a test spoonful will hold shape., Add nuts., Drop quickly onto waxed paper.

title: Southern Stewed Corn
directions: Cut corn from cob., Heat butter or margarine in skillet and add corn., Cook at medium for about 5 minutes, stirring often (may stick to bottom of pan if not stirred often)., Sprinkle flour, sugar and salt on top of corn and stir well., Add milk and stir again., Continue cooking at low heat for another 10 to 15 minutes, stirring often., Serves 6.

title: Leftover Soup
directions: Cook macaroni until done., Cook potatoes., Cook meat., Put carrots, peas, beans and tomatoes in pot together and cook., Add meat, potatoes and macaroni until done, about 5 minutes., Ready when you are.

title: Broccoli And Cauliflower Salad
directions: Mix together and top with bacon bits.

title: Bean And Corn Casserole
directions: Drain corn and beans., Mix all ingredients together; salt and pepper to taste., Put in buttered casserole dish.

title: Hawaiian Wedding Cake
directions: Place all ingredients in a large bowl and mix by hand until well blended., Pour into a greased jelly roll or sheet cake pan and bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

title: Zucchini Spice Squares
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Combine flour, baking powder and spices; set aside., Cream butter in a large bowl; beat in sugars., Add eggs and vanilla; stir in flour mixture until smooth., Stir in zucchini, coconut and walnuts; blend well., Spread in a well-greased 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake 35 to 40 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean., Cool., Frost with Cinnamon Icing., Cut into squares.

title: Gourmet Scallopini In Mustard Sauce
directions: Heat oil and margarine over moderately high heat in 12-inch skillet or 2 smaller ones., While skillet heats, put breasts in plastic bag and pound 1/4 to 1/2-inch thick with rolling pin. Sprinkle chicken with salt and pepper; then dredge in flour., Add to skillet and cook about 4 minutes on each side until golden brown., Transfer chicken to heated platter and cover with foil to keep warm., Drain any fat that remains into one of the skillets. Add broth, sherry and mustard to that skillet., Scrape brown bits from bottom of skillet to blend with sauce., Add light cream and simmer 2 to 3 minutes, stirring constantly, until mixture thickens slightly., Pour sauce over chicken and serve hot., Yields 4 servings.

title: Honey Mustard Chicken
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., Lightly grease 15 x 10 x 1 1/2-inch pan or spray with vegetable cooking oil spray; set aside., Combine mustard, honey and lemon juice in shallow dish., Place crumbs in another dish., Dip chicken pieces in mustard mixture, turning to coat, then in bread crumbs., Place on pan., Drizzle evenly with oil., Bake in oven 30 to 35 minutes or until golden brown and cooked through.

title: Spring Salad
directions: Drain peas, corn and beans., Set aside., Place onions, celery, pepper and pimentos in bowl.

title: Mini Pizzas
directions: Split English muffins in half to make 12 rounds., Spread butter on each half., Put about 2 tablespoons of sauce on each half and spread., Spread some of the cheeses on each half and then pepperoni or hamburger., Top with sprinkled Parmesan cheese., Put all halves on cookie sheet and bake at 425° for 20 to 25 minutes or until brown., These are fun for kids to make!

title: Angel Biscuits
directions: Dissolve yeast in water and set aside for 5 minutes., Mix flour, baking soda, baking powder, salt and sugar., Cut in shortening., Stir in buttermilk and yeast mixture., Turn on lightly floured board and knead lightly a minute or two., Roll to 1/2-inch thick., Cut with round 2-inch cutter., Put in greased pan 1 inch apart., Cover and let rise 1 hour., Bake 400° for 10 minutes.

title: Scripture Cake
directions: Blend butter, sugar, spices and salt., Beat egg yolks and add to mixture., Sift in baking powder and flour., Add water and honey., Put fruit and nuts through food chopper; dust well with flour and add to mixture., Follow Solomon's advice for making good boys (first clause for Proverbs 23:14)., Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites.

title: Sour Cream Drop Cookies
directions: Cream butter., Add sugar until smooth., Add eggs and beat well., Add sifted dry ingredients and soured cream., Mix well. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto cookie sheets., Put raisins or nuts in center of each., Sprinkle with sugar., Bake in moderate oven, 350°, about 12 minutes., Makes 7 dozen.

title: Quick And Easy Nutty Cheese Bars
directions: Grease and flour a 9 x 13-inch rectangular baking pan., Preheat oven to 350°.

title: Sidewalk Chalk
directions: Mix plaster of Paris and cold water together slowly., Add colored paint., If mixture is a little dry, add a little more water., Pour into styrofoam egg cartons and let dry overnight.

title: Brown Refrigerator Cookies
directions: Blend all ingredients thoroughly., Roll into 1 1/2-inch roll on waxed paper., Cover with wax paper., Cut into 2-inch lengths. Wrap in foil and freeze., Remove from freezer after 4 hours or more., Slice and bake at 350° for 15 minutes.

title: Venison Jerky
directions: Debone venison, removing as much fat and gristle as possible. Using very sharp knife or electric knife, slice venison into 1/8-inch strips.

title: Tuna Casserole
directions: Drain and flake tuna., Cook noodles according to package. Drain and rinse in hot water., Combine noodles with tuna, celery and green onions., Blend in sour cream, mustard, mayonnaise, thyme and salt., Spoon half of mixture into buttered 2-quart casserole., Top with half of the zucchini., Repeat layers., Top with grated cheese., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until hot and bubbly., Sprinkle with chopped tomatoes.

title: Pimento Cheese
directions: Mix cheese, pimentos, sandwich spread, onion and beer., Flavor to taste with Tabasco sauce and refrigerate.

title: Squash Casserole
directions: Cook squash and onion until done., Drain. Add eggs, bacon (crumbled), shredded cheese and bread crumbs to squash and onion. Add salt and pepper. Bake until cooked thoroughly., Add Mozzarella cheese to top and melt.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Mix seasoned dressings, oleo, and broth together. Put 1/2 in greased 9x23 inch pan. Mix vegetables soup, milk and chicken together. Put on top of dressing. Cover with remaining dressing. Bake 350 degrees for 1 hour or until done.

title: Nana Puddin
directions: Line bottom and sides of 8-inch square or 1 1/2-quart baking dish with wafers., Combine pudding mix, milk and butter in saucepan., Cook and stir over medium heat until mixture comes to a full boil., Remove from heat; lay slices of bananas over wafers, then add a layer of pudding., Repeat layer, wafers, bananas and pudding., Chill 3 hours., Serve whip creme topping., Mother used meringue topping., Garnish with bananas.

title: Apple Crisp
directions: Butter the bottom of pan., Slice whole bag of apples thin. (Put in pan.), Put dash of salt, cinnamon, water and apples as well., Mix.

title: Greek Lentil Soup
directions: Mix all ingredients, except the vinegar, in a soup pot; cook until the lentils are very soft, about 1 hour., Stir in vinegar at the end and serve.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Boil, a, large	fryer, until, tender., Salt, to, taste. Remove skin and remove meat from bone., Cut into small pieces.
