While chicken, is, cooling, cook 1 large package of noodles in chicken broth., Mix the soups, pimientos, green pepper and 1/2 of the grated, cheese, together., Add, chicken., Pour, into a greased casserole, dish, and, sprinkle remainder of cheese on top.	Bake for 30 to 40 minutes in a 350° oven.

title: Jessie'S Congealed Salad
directions: Pour crushed pineapple & juice in a mixing bowl. Dissolve Jell-o in pineapple. Mix in sour cream, then cool whip, and nuts. Pour into dish and refrigerate overnight.

title: *Kinklings
directions: Dissolve yeast in water., Scald milk and shortening., Beat eggs and add sugar and salt., Add all ingredients to yeast mixture., Add flour until all has been used., Let rise until double in bulk., Roll on lightly floured surface and cut in 1 1/2 to 2-inch strips, diamond shapes or triangles., Let rise again and fry in heated oil.

title: Holiday Pecan Pie
directions: Beat egg whites with sugar., Add baking powder and vanilla. Crumble crackers and blend with chopped pecans., Fold egg white mixture into pecan mixture., Bake in a greased 9-inch pie plate at 350° for exactly 28 minutes and no longer., Serve with whipped topping.

title: War Cake
directions: Mix first 7 ingredients in a medium size sauce pan and bring to a boil; boil for 5 minutes. Allow this mixture to cool until it is completely cold (mixture must be cold). Stir in flour; mix well. Dissolve baking soda in 2 tsp. hot water; add and mix well. Pour into a greased tube pan. Bake for 1 hour at 350° to 375°.

title: Stewed Hard Crabs
directions: Place crabs in a large pot., Add potatoes, onion, salt and pepper, grease from fatback or oil and water., Cook over medium heat for approximately 15 minutes or until full boil begins.

title: Ginger Cookies
directions: Cream sugar and oleo., Add egg., Add molasses., Sift dry ingredients; add to creamed mixture., Place in refrigerator about 2 hours., Roll in balls; dip in sugar and place on greased cookie sheet, 2 inches apart., Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes., Loosen with spatula 1 minute after removing from oven.

title: Salmon Party Log
directions: Drain and flake salmon, removing skin and bone. Combine salmon with next 6 ingredients; mix thoroughly. Chill several hours. Combine pecans and parsley. Shape salmon mixture in 8 x 12 log. Roll in nut mixture. Chill well and serve with crackers.

title: Hot Reuben Dip
directions: In a 2-quart casserole, mix all ingredients well., Cover and bake for 40 to 45 minutes at 250°., Serve hot with cocktail rye.

title: Dry Apple Stack Cake
directions: Mix ingredients and add enough flour to make stiff dough., Pat a thin layer into cake pans., Make about 8 layers., Put together with cooked dried apples., Bake at 350° for approximately 20 to 25 minutes or until cakes begin to brown.

title: Fruit Salad
directions: Cut banana, apple and orange into bite size pieces. Drain juice from fruit cocktail and pineapple., Save juice in a bowl. Mix all the fruit together., Add lemon juice to other juice and blend in pudding mix., Mix well and pour over fruit., Chill well and serve.

title: Lemon Cream Pie
directions: Mix the 1 cup sugar with flour and salt in pan., Stir in milk until smooth., Cook slowly over direct heat, stirring constantly until mixture boils and thickens., Slowly stir in a little of hot mixture into yolks and return yolks to pan., Cook 2 minutes longer., Remove from heat and stir in juice and rind gradually in small portions., Stir in butter., Pour into cooled shell., Then cool and beat egg whites until stiff and gradually beat in 1/4 cup sugar., Beat until thick., Place on top of filling and bake until brown.

title: Low-Fat "Refried Beans"
directions: Finely chop the onion and peppers and mince the garlic., Saute in 1 tablespoon oil in a Dutch oven., Drain the pinto beans, reserving the fluid., Add beans to onion, pepper and garlic and simmer for about 1 hour., Mash beans., If beans are dry, add reserved fluid., Use mixture for burritos, nachos, etc., (See Topoppo Salad recipe.)

title: Carrot Pie
directions: Mix together eggs, sugars and other ingredients., Pour into raw crust and bake for 1 hour in moderate oven.

title: Popcorn Cake
directions: Have ready an angel food or Bundt pan; spray with Pam (grease pan generously with oleo)., Melt last 2 ingredients in saucepan. Mix popcorn, peanuts and M & M's., Pour melted mixture over popcorn mixture., Stir quickly., Pack tightly in pan., Let stand for awhile., Turn out on foil., Freezes well.

title: Pineapple Fruit Compote
directions: Mix the sugar and melted oleo; add flour, stirring until smooth., Add juice and pineapple chunks., Top with grated cheese. Crumble Ritz crackers over to cover evenly., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes., Good with baked ham.

title: Caramel Custard
directions: In the top part of a double boiler, pour 1 cup sugar. Add enough water so as to get all of the sugar wet. Place on high heat until medium gold. Then take it off the heat and move the pan around until the sides, as well as the bottom, are covered with the caramel and caramel has stopped moving.

title: Yogurt Dressing
directions: In a jar or bowl, combine yogurt, olive oil, onion, chopped parsley, mustard, salt and pepper. Shake vigorously., Yields approximately 1 1/4 cups. Serve with tossed salad, sliced tomatoes or cold vegetables.

title: Lemon Pie
directions: Combine flour and sugar in double boiler. Add boiling water, stirring constantly. Add egg yolks, stirring vigorously. Cook until mixture drops in thick sheets. Add butter, lemon juice and rind. Cool., Pour in baked shell., Top with meringue.

title: Salmon Rub
directions: Blend spices. Rub mixture over salmon. Allow to stand 5 minutes. Grill or broil until fish flakes easily with a fork.

title: Pork Chops With Potatoes
directions: Brown pork chops., In a 2-quart casserole, layer potatoes, sprinkle with flour, salt and pepper., Repeat ending with potatoes. Dot with butter, sprinkle with cheese and top with pork chops. Pour milk over casserole., Bake covered at 375° for 45 minutes. Remove cover and bake for 20 minutes., Serves 2 to 4.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
directions: Cook sweet potatoes, mash and mix with other ingredients. Place in baking dish and cover with topping.

title: Pistachio Cake
directions: Blend all of the ingredients., Pour into greased, floured bundt pan., Bake at 350 F for 50 minutes.

title: Ponche De Pina
directions: Simmer sugar, water, cinnamon and cloves for 30 minutes. Strain, removing cinnamon and cloves., Add pineapple, orange and lemon juice., Pour over ice or frozen pineapple juice cubes.

title: One Dish Chicken & Rice Bake
directions: In 2 qt. shallow baking dish mix soup, water, rice, paprika, and pepper., Place chicken on rice mixture., Sprinkle with additional paprika and pepper., Cover. Bake at 375°F for 45 min. or until done., Serves 4.

title: Shepherd'S Pie(British)
directions: *If not available, use a good quality Cheddar, preferably sharp.

title: Peanut Blossom Cookies
directions: Sift together flour, soda and salt., Set aside., Cream together butter, sugars and peanut butter., Add flour mixture gradually and cream well., Add egg and vanilla and mix thoroughly., Shape into balls with teaspoon and roll in granulated sugar., Place on ungreased cookie sheet., Bake at 375° for 8 minutes., Remove from oven and place chocolate candy kiss in center of each cookie., Return cookie sheet to oven and bake 2 more minutes.

title: Taco Pie
directions: Brown ground, beef, and, onion., Drain	fat., Add, taco seasoning mix, and	water.	Bring, to, boil., Reduce, heat and simmer, 20	minutes,, stirring, occasionally., Combine refried beans and 1/3 cup taco sauce., Spoon half of bean mixture into bottom of, pastry, shell., Top with half of meat mixture, half of cheese and all of corn chips., Repeat layers with remaining bean mixture, meat mixture and cheese., Bake at 400° for 20 to 25 minutes., Top, with lettuce and tomato., Serve with remaining taco sauce., Yield:, 6 servings.

title: Southern Green Beans
directions: Slice bacon into 1/2-inch pieces and saute until crisp. Drain, reserving 1 1/2 cups fat., Saute onions in fat until golden., Cook green beans in kettle with onions, vinegar and pepper until beans are desired degree of doneness., Add bacon bits and chopped peanuts., Makes 50 (2 1/2 ounce) servings.

title: Old-Fashioned Butter Cookies
directions: Blend dry ingredients; set aside., Cream the butter and sugar, creaming well., Add egg, milk and vanilla., Add dry ingredients gradually., Chill dough 1 hour., Roll out on floured surface, half at a time, to 1/8-inch thickness., Cut into desired shapes., Place on ungreased cookie sheet., Bake at 375° for 5 to 8 minutes.

title: Egg Nog
directions: Mix in blender or with beater.

title: Pecan Pie Squares
directions: Preheat oven, to, 350°., Grease, and flour 10 x 13-inch pan. Mix cake mix, 1 egg and 1/2 cup salad oil until crumbly. Press into, bottom of pan and bake 20 minutes., Beat remaining eggs, syrup,, sugar, and butter.	Stir in pecans., Pour on top of cake batter, and, bake, 45 minutes or until set., Cool and cut.

title: Hungry Jack Butter Roll
directions: Roll each biscuit real thin; spread with butter and sprinkle with 1 cup of the sugar., Sprinkle with cinnamon., Roll each biscuit jelly roll style and cut in half., Place in a 9 x 12-inch pan or casserole., Melt rest of sugar (2 cups) in about 2 1/2 cups boiling water (more if needed)., Pour over rolls., Be sure to have enough water to cover well., Bake until brown.

title: Pork Boulettes
directions: Preheat the fryer. In a saute pan, over medium heat, brown the pork meat. Remove the meat from the pan and drain on, a paper-lined plate. In a large saute pan, over medium heat, melt the butter. Add 3 tablespoons of the flour and, stirring constantly, for 4 to 5 minutes, make a dark brown roux the color of chocolate. Add the onions and bell peppers., Stir constantly for 3 to 4 minutes until wilted., Add the garlic and cook, stirring, for 1 minute. Add the pork and cook, stirring constantly, for 2 to 3 minutes. Add the water. Season the mixture with salt and cayenne. Reduce the heat to medium-low. Simmer for 45 to 50 minutes, stirring occasionally. Stir in the rice, green onions, dash of Tabasco pepper sauce and 1/2 cup of the bread crumbs. Mix well. Remove from the heat and let cool for about 20 minutes.

title: Cold Homemade Soap
directions: Have lye water cold and fat lukewarm before mixing., Stir until it starts to thicken, then add turpentine and Borax., Add enough bluing to tint.

title: Thrifty Meat Balls
directions: Combine beef, onion, rice, cracker crumbs, milk, salt, pepper and seasoning., Mix well., Shape into balls; brown on all sides. Add soup which has been diluted with water., Cover and simmer about 1 1/4 hours., Remove from heat., Add mushrooms., Bring to boil and serve with mashed potatoes and green beans.

title: The Country Bake Beans
directions: Mix all ingredients except bacon., Fry bacon and drain on paper towel., Bake beans 30 minutes and crumble bacon on top of beans just before serving.

title: Fruit Dip
directions: Blend all ingredients and chill. Serve with cut up fruit (apples, bananas, kiwi, etc.).

title: Salsa Layer Dip
directions: Bake at 350° until melted., Do not overcook (cream will curdle).

title: Easy-Time Dessert
directions: Gradually add sugar to butter in a large mixer bowl, creaming at medium speed of mixer until light and fluffy., At medium speed, add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each., At low speed, add flour and lemon extract., Pour batter into well-greased 15 x 10 x 1-inch jelly roll pan., Mark off into 20 squares., Place 1 heaping tablespoonful of pie filling in center of each square. Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes., While warm, sift confectioners sugar over cake., Cool; cut into squares., Makes 20 servings.

title: Coconut Pie
directions: Mix, sugar,, cornstarch and salt; blend well., Add milk and beaten, egg yolks.	Stir until well blended and cook over medium heat until thick., Add vanilla and coconut; stir well. Pour, into baked, pie	crust.	Top with meringue and sprinkle with coconut. Brown in a 350° oven.

title: Carrot Casserole
directions: Combine carrots with the soup and cheese., Mix butter and bread crumbs and sprinkle over carrots., Bake at 350° for about 20 minutes or until crumbs are brown.

title: White Sauce
directions: Combine all ingredients and refrigerate for 24 hours., (Do not blend in blender.), Thin with buttermilk., Dip with tortilla chips.

title: Strawberries And Cream Shortcake
directions: Prepare pound cake mix as package directs; pour into prepared 9-inch round pans. Bake according to package directions; remove from oven and cool.

title: Dumplings For Soup
directions: Beat egg, add sugar and salt., Mix well., Add milk., Fold in flour which has been mixed with baking powder., Place dumplings in broth by spoonfuls., Cover and cook for 15 minutes.

title: Sour Cream Enchilada Casserole
directions: Rub the shells over with margarine., Combine all ingredients except cheese and shells and mix., Layer in 9 x 13-inch dish in this order:, shells, meat mixture and shredded cheese., Repeat, ending with cheese., Bake 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Chicken And Broccoli Casserole
directions: Mix chicken soup, broth and mayonnaise in bowl., Cook chicken and broccoli., Line baking pan with broccoli and dot with butter. Cut chicken over broccoli., Then pour soup mixture over chicken. Then layer grated cheese, then Pepperidge Farm dressing., Bake at 350° until bubbly, about 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Cheese Nips
directions: Mix first 3 ingredients and sift., Add butter; fold in cheese and nuts., Bake 10 to 20 minutes at 350°., Roll to the size of a marble; press flat with fork.

title: Orange-Pineapple Punch
directions: Mix and freeze ingredients., Set out 1 hour before serving. Pour 1 quart of club soda for every 2 quarts of punch.

title: Mexican Quiche
directions: Crumble sausage and brown with onions and drain., Mix everything together and bake in a greased pan at 325° for 35 minutes or until brown.

title: Old Fashioned Tea Cakes
directions: Cream sugar and shortening together; add eggs., Beat until light and fluffy; add dry ingredients with milk alternating until soft dough is formed., Roll thin., Bake at 350 degrees for 10 minutes.

title: Ham And Cheese Baked Chicken
directions: Wash and dry chicken or hens., Sprinkle inside with salt, pepper and/or nutmeg., Place chicken or hens on rack, breast side down, in shallow pan., Stuff cavities with apples., Roast at 350° for about 45 minutes (35 minutes for hens) or until juices run fairly clear when pierced., Turn chicken (hens) upside down., Brush with melted butter., Fold ham and cheese slices around chicken. Roast at 400° for another 20 to 35 minutes or until chicken is tender and nicely browned.

title: Peanut Butter Play Dough
directions: Mix and have fun., Use raisins, candy, etc., to decorate your creations.

title: Chicken Salad
directions: Sprinkle lemon juice over chicken and toss well., Add celery, Miracle Whip, almonds, onion and salt and mix thoroughly., Just before serving, stir in croutons or sprinkle them on top.

title: Chicken Wings
directions: Mix together bread crumbs, cheese and spices., Melt margarine. Dip wings in melted margarine and roll in bread crumb mixture. Place in greased shallow pan or cookie sheet., Make sure sides of wings are not touching., Bake 1 hour at 350°.

title: Dirt Cake
directions: Cream the cream cheese, butter and powdered sugar together in bowl., Mix milk and pudding until creamy, then add Cool Whip.

title: Sausage Gravy
directions: Cook sausage in a large skillet over medium heat, stirring until it crumbles and is no longer pink., Remove sausage, and drain on paper towels, reserving 1 tablespoon drippings in skillet. Whisk flour into hot drippings until smooth; cook, whisking constantly, 1 minute., Gradually whisk in milk, and cook, whisking constantly, 5 to 7 minutes or until thickened and bubbly. Stir in sausage, salt, and pepper., Serve immediately over biscuits.

title: Raisin Cookies
directions: Mix together eggs, lard and milk, then your dry ingredients. Bake at 350°.

title: Choplet Patties
directions: Prepare tofu as in Tofu Salad Delight, cutting in strips instead of cubes., Whole wheat flour, plain white flour (unbleached) or cornmeal can be used to coat the tofu.

title: Lithuanian Beets And Chicken
directions: Put all into pot and cover with water., Cook until meat is tender., Meat will be very sweet., You can use the stems and leaves of fresh beets also.

title: Punch Bowl Cake
directions: Mix first 3 ingredients., Bake cake as directed in 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan; cool., Take half of cake; break into pieces., Put in large bowl, layer with half pudding, half pineapple, half cherry pie filling, half bananas, half coconut and half Cool Whip. Repeat layers., Top with nuts., Chill and serve.

title: Squash And Sausage
directions: Peel, chop into cubes, then boil squash until tender., Saute onion in butter in a frying pan., Add sausage; cook until completely browned., Add cooked squash to sausage mixture., Salt and pepper to taste.

title: Candy
directions: Mix together and put into 8 x 8-inch pan., Refrigerate.

title: Tropical Cheese Ball
directions: Soften cream cheese; mix all ingredients., Let firm in refrigerator, then roll in coconut.

title: Blueberry Fritters
directions: Thaw the blueberries well; drain off syrup and save., Sift together the dry ingredients., Measure the blueberry syrup. There should be about 1/2 cup., If not, add water to complete the measure.

title: Monkey Bread
directions: Line greased Bundt pan with nuts., Quarter biscuits and roll in cinnamon and sugar., Put in greased pan and sprinkle nuts on biscuits., Melt butter, brown sugar and water., Boil 2 minutes and pour over biscuits., Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

title: Enchilada Casserole
directions: Brown ground beef and drain., Add soup and salsa to beef., Set aside., Line a 9 x 13-inch pan with 2 large tortilla shells. Layer with 1/2 beef mixture., Sprinkle 1/2 of the cheese, then put the other 2 shells on top., Put remaining beef on top of the shells., Bake for about 30 minutes at 300°., Top with remaining cheese and let melt (you could use chicken instead of beef).

title: Cheesy Jalapeno Appetizer
directions: Put grated cheese in buttered 9 x 13-inch pan., Pour peppers on top., Pour beaten eggs over entire pan., Bake at 300° for 45 minutes., Serve warm or cold.

title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Bars
directions: Mix flour, sugar and margarine with hands., Pat into a 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes., Spread with thick layer of peanut butter while warm., Melt chocolate chips with water and syrup., Spread., Cool and cut.

title: Tuna Chow Mein Casserole
directions: Heat oven to 350°., In large skillet, cook and stir celery, onion and green pepper in butter until onion is tender., Stir in tuna and remaining ingredients.

title: Death By Chocolate
directions: Make chocolate cake in a long flat pan., Using a large glass bowl, put in ingredients in order:, cake (cut up to fit in bowl), Skor bars (crushed into small pieces), Cool Whip and top with cherries., Serve chilled.

title: Glazed Carrots
directions: Steam carrots just until tender., Transfer to serving bowl and keep warm., Combine orange juice, sugar and margarine in a saucepan and heat almost to boiling point., Dissolve cornstarch in water; stir in and cook until clear and thickened., Add ginger. Pour over carrots.

title: Pie Crust
directions: Mix good and chill., Keeps for a week in refrigerator., Roll on floured board when going to use.

title: Weight Watchers Baked Buffalo Chicken
directions: Preheat oven to 400., Coat large nonstick skillet with cooking spray., Place over medium high heat until., Add chichen, cook 4 minutes on each side (or until browned)., Place chicken in an 11 x 7 inch baking dish coated with cooking spray., Combine hot sauce and next 4 ingredients:, Pour over chichen., Bake, uncovered, at 400 for 25 minutes.

title: Pancakes
directions: Combine flour, sugar, baking powder and salt in a medium-size bowl., Beat egg slightly in small bowl., Mix in oil and milk., Add to dry ingredients., Stir., A few small lumps in batter is good. Add more or less milk to have thicker or thinner pancakes., Pan is ready when drops of water bounce all over it., Drop batter by spoonful onto lightly greased hot pan at 380°., When bubbles appear and edges begin to dry, turn to brown the other side., Serve hot with butter and maple syrup., Makes 12.

title: Raisin Cake
directions: Boil raisins and water 10 minutes., Drain and cool; add enough water to make 2 cups liquid., Add sugar, margarine, flour, soda, salt, cinnamon, cloves and add raisins last., Bake in greased 9 x 13 pan in slow oven about 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Fat Man'S Misery
directions: Grease 1 1/2-quart rectangle glass dish. Line the bottom (not the sides) with chocolate wafer crumbs. Cream butter and confectioners sugar, adding the egg and bourbon. Spread this mixture on crumbs. Cover and set in the refrigerator for an hour. Whip cream with sugar and add vanilla. Fold in chopped pecans and spread this mixture on top of mixture. Cover with more crushed wafers. Let stand in the refrigerator, covered, for overnight. Cut in 8 pieces.

title: Whipped Cream Pound Cake
directions: Cream sugar and butter., Add flavorings., Add beaten eggs., Add a little flour and whipping cream until flour is gone., Pour into a greased and floured mold., Bake at 325° in cold oven for about 1 1/2 hours.

title: Pie Crust
directions: Mix flour, salt and shortening together., Add vinegar to milk. Blend all together., Roll on floured board., Makes a double crust.

title: Dalhousie Delight
directions: If you figure out what to do with these ingredients, please let Mac know., Thank you.

title: Orange Fruit Cake
directions: Cream shortening and sugar., Add 1 tablespoon orange rind. Add eggs, one at a time, flour, salt, soda, buttermilk, dates and pecans., Bake in a greased and floured tube pan for 1 hour and 20 minutes in a 350° oven.

title: Macaroons
directions: Melt chocolate with margarine in saucepan over very low heat, stirring constantly until smooth., Remove from heat., Blend in sugar, eggs, salt and vanilla; beat well., Stir in coconut., Drop from teaspoon onto greased baking sheets., Leaving 1 1/2 inches between., Bake at 325° for 15 minutes., Cool on racks., Makes about 3 dozen.

title: Biscuits With Oil(Low Cholesterol)
directions: Mix together flour, milk and oil until flour is damp., The mixture is thick but able to be stirred with a fork., Whip mixture with fork for a few seconds., Turn dough onto a floured surface and knead 8 to 10 times or until dough becomes firm and smooth. Pat out dough into 3/4-inch thickness., Cut with biscuit cutter. Bake at 400° for 15 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Hungarian Hot-Pot
directions: Brown ground beef, onions and green bell peppers., Drain; add chili beans and tomato sauce., Simmer and serve hot.

title: Jiffy Salad
directions: Drain pineapple and oranges., Mix cottage cheese, Cool Whip and Jell-O (dry) together., Add fruit., Serve immediately.

title: Pink Punch
directions: Combine the juices and lemonade., Put a block of ice in a punch bowl., Add the juices and club soda., Serves 35.

title: Spanish Rice
directions: Saute bacon in skillet until crisp., Remove bacon and drain on paper towels., Add rice to bacon dripping remaining in pan and cook until browned., Add onions and cook until golden., Add bacon and remaining ingredients., Cover and cook until rice is tender., More liquid may be added in the form of tomato juice or beef or chicken stock., Serves 4.

title: Make Ahead Batter For Bran Muffins
directions: Sift together baking soda, flour and salt., Pour boiling water over whole bran cereal and set aside., Cream together sugar and shortening in a 6-quart bowl until light., Add eggs and beat well. Blend in buttermilk, bran buds and the soaked whole bran cereal. Add sifted dry ingredients., Mix well., Store in tightly covered container in refrigerator., Batter will keep up to 6 weeks., Makes enough for 5 dozen muffins., To bake muffins, fill greased muffin pan cups 2/3 full., Bake at 400° for about 20 minutes.

title: Broccoli Dip
directions: Cook broccoli and onion until broccoli is done and cooked down., Salt and pepper to taste., Add rest of ingredients and cook until cheese melts., Serve warm in chafing dish., Serve with chips.

title: Applesauce
directions: About 30 minutes before serving, in medium saucepan over medium heat in 1/2 cup boiling water, heat first 3 ingredients to boiling. Reduce heat to low, cover and simmer 8 to 10 minutes until apples are tender (for chunky applesauce) or 12 to 15 minutes for smoother applesauce., During last minutes of cooking time, stir in sugar. Makes about 4 cups.

title: Chicken And Rice Casserole
directions: Do not dilute soups., In a bowl, dice up some chicken., Add rice and soup mix and put in casserole sprayed with Pam., Dot with butter., Bake 45 minutes at 350°.

title: Maytime Salad
directions: Dissolve jello and salt in hot water., Add vinegar, grated onion and pepper., Chill until slightly thickened., Fold in remaining ingredients., Chill until firm.

title: Kerrington Chili
directions: Drain and rinse beans., Brown ground beef., Drain excess fat. Add beans, tomatoes, tomato paste, onion, pepper, chili powder and water., Simmer 45 minutes.

title: Moose'S Famous Ribs
directions: Season ribs on one side., Place in baking pan., Bake at 325° for 30 minutes., Turn ribs over; season liberally., Sprinkle red pepper flakes to personal taste (medium to hot depending on amount)., Return to 325° oven for 30 minutes., Pour excess fat from baking pan., Turn ribs again., Apply red pepper flakes in light dosage (also liberal amount of Lea & Perrins)., Return to oven at 325° for 30 minutes., Turn ribs for last time., Apply liberal amounts of Lea & Perrins., Return to oven at 325° for 30 minutes., Apply more Lea & Perrins and warm up before serving (if you like juicy ribs).

title: Peanut Brittle
directions: Mix peanuts, sugar, Karo and water in a saucepan., Bring mixture to a boil and cook over medium heat until mixture reaches 300°., Remove from heat; add baking soda and stir well., Pour onto buttered cookie sheet to cool.

title: Sloppy Joes
directions: Brown meat., Add onions, celery and green pepper., Saute until tender., Add other ingredients and simmer 10 minutes.

title: Pumpkin Cake
directions: Mix eggs with sugar., Mix all ingredients and bake in a greased and floured 13 x 9-inch pan at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Squash Fritters
directions: Wash and grate squash., Add eggs and flour, sifted with salt, pepper and baking powder and sugar., Mix well and add melted butter. Drop from tablespoon into 1-inch salad oil hot enough to brown bread cube in one minute., Turn once., Makes about 12 fritters., Delicious serves with fried chicken.

title: Caramel Morsel Bars
directions: Melt caramels with water in saucepan over low heat., Stir until sauce is smooth., Pour over cereal and nuts., Stir well. Press into greased 13 x 9-inch baking pan., Sprinkle chips over top., Place in 200° oven for 5 minutes., When chips are melted, spread to form frosting., Cut into bars.

title: Tiramisu(Restaurant Style)
directions: Prepare a 9-inch square baking pan by tearing a piece of aluminum foil about 36 inches long and folding it over to make a long piece 3 inches wide., Place around the inside of the baking pan to make the pan 3 inches tall., Or, use a 12 to 15-cup baking pan with a flat bottom and 3-inch sides.

title: White No-Bake Cookies
directions: Mix the first 3 ingredients together in pan; bring to a boil. Simmer well for 2 minutes., Add vanilla., Mix this into the remaining ingredients which have been put into a large bowl., Drop by spoonfuls onto wax paper., Cool.

title: Chocolate Eclair Cake
directions: Mix pudding and milk., Fold in Cool Whip., Line a 9 x 13-inch pan with graham crackers., Pour 1/2 of pudding mix over graham crackers., Do another layer of graham crackers and pour rest of pudding mix., Top with layer of graham crackers and put icing on. Put in refrigerator for 5 or 6 hours before serving.

title: Layered Salad
directions: Layer in a large bowl or other large container in order given. On top of bacon, spread Miracle Whip dressing, just as you would frost a cake., Sprinkle granulated sugar over Miracle Whip., Cover and refrigerate overnight., Stir first before serving., If desired, tomato chunks may be added before serving.

title: Green Tomato Casserole
directions: Place sliced tomatoes in a buttered 13 x 9 casserole., Cover with onions., Sprinkle with salt, pepper and lemon pepper., Top with grated cheese and crushed crackers., Dot with butter., Bake, covered, for 45 minutes at 400°., Bake, uncovered, for an additional 10 minutes.

title: Orange Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients well and refrigerate.

title: Ranger Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 375., Mix shortening, sugars, egg, and vanilla., Stir in remaining ingredients., Drop by rounded teaspoonful 2 inches apart on ungreased baking sheet., Bake 10 minutes., Remove immediately from baking sheet.

title: Chuck Wagon Stew
directions: Coat beef in a mixture of flour, paprika, 1 teaspoon chili powder and salt., Brown in hot fat in large Dutch oven., Add onions and garlic and cook until soft., Then add tomatoes, chili powder, cinnamon, cloves and peppers., Cover and simmer 2 hours., Add potatoes and carrots and cook until vegetables are done, about 45 minutes., Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Broiled Salmon
directions: On a broiler rack set 8-inches from the heat, broil salmon for 2 to 3 minutes. Turn salmon and broil another 2 to 3 minutes or until fish is opaque when tested with a fork in the center. Transfer to a platter and serve with Cucumber-Dill Sauce.

title: "Grandma'S Jelly Donuts"("Depression Days")
directions: In large bowl, combine eggs, milk, vanilla, sugar and salt. Mix until well blended., In a small bowl, mix flour and baking powder., Stir flour into egg mixture until smooth; set aside. Stack 2 slices of bread sandwich style., With sharp knife, remove crust from bread., Repeat with other breads., Spread thin layer of jelly or jam on each bread., Cut sandwich into quarters; dip doughnuts into batter., Fry in oil or shortening., After browned, sprinkle with confectioners sugar.

title: Buckwheat Pancakes
directions: Mix dry ingredients., Add buttermilk to pour consistency.

title: Freezer Pickles
directions: Put all in glass dish, crock or enamel pan., Sprinkle with 1 tablespoon salt., Let sit 2 hours., Bring syrup to boil, then let cool.

title: Seafood Curry
directions: Melt butter; add apples., Cook 5 minutes., Combine flour, curry powder and salt., Stir into apples., Add milk slowly., Cook and stir until thickened., Add shrimp., Serve over hot fluffy rice., Sprinkle with paprika.

title: Applesauce Cake
directions: Cream butter and sugar., Add eggs and beat., Mix the baking soda in the applesauce and add to the first mixture., Sift the dry ingredients together and add to the mixture., Beat until well mixed., Pour into 3 greased and floured 8-inch cake pans., Bake at 350° until done.

title: Russian Salad
directions: "Great to take places, congeals real firm."

title: Stuffed Shells
directions: Make shells according to directions., Then lay out on wax paper to cool., Brown hamburger; add salt, pepper, garlic powder and oregano to taste., Drain grease and set aside., Add cottage cheese, Mozzarella cheese, mayonnaise and egg; stir well., Stir in hamburger.

title: Mexican Casserole
directions: Saute together ground beef and onion; drain., Add remaining ingredients (except tortilla chips and shredded cheese); mix well.

title: Hawaiian Punch
directions: Mix punch, lemon-limeade, and orange juice in a bowl., Pour ginger ale down the side of the bowl., Blend well.

title: Cinnamon Rolls In Milk
directions: Prepare your favorite biscuit dough and roll out into a thin rectangle., Spread dough generously with softened butter. Sprinkle generously with sugar and cinnamon., Roll up as for cinnamon rolls and slice the roll into 1-inch thick slices., Place about 1 1/2 inches apart in a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish.

title: Refried Beans
directions: Heat water, beans, onion and garlic to boiling in 2-quart saucepan., Boil 2 minutes., Remove from heat, cover and let stand 1 hour., Add just enough water to cover beans and add salt., Heat to boiling; reduce heat and simmer 1 1/2 hours., (Add water if necessary!), When done, mash beans and top with crumbled bacon. Great for burritos or nachos., Can be frozen for later.

title: Impossible Cheeseburger Pie
directions: Heat oven to 400° and grease a 10-inch pie plate with shortening., Cook and stir over medium heat the onions, ground sirloin and pepper until brown., Pour meat mixture into pie plate after draining any fat., Spread meat mixture evenly in pie plate. Put milk, eggs and baking mix in blender and blend on high 15 seconds (or use egg beater or wire whisk)., Pour mix into pie plate., Bake 25 minutes., Remove from oven., Top with tomato slices and sprinkle with cheese., Bake 5 to 8 minutes longer or until knife inserted inc enter comes out clean., Cool 5 minutes., Serves 6.

title: Deep Baked Beans
directions: Mix beans, sugar, sauce and onion in 2-quart casserole dish. Top with bacon slices., Bake at 350° for 2 hours, uncovered, until beans are deeply browned.

title: Crustless Custard Pie
directions: Beat eggs and sugar until light and fluffy., Add flour; mix well., Add milk and vanilla., Pour into pie pan lightly greased with butter., Sprinkle nutmeg on top., Bake about 50 minutes at 350° or until knife inserted in center comes out clean., Flour settles to bottom during baking to form a very light crust.

title: Sauerkraut Casserole
directions: Drain, rinse and squeeze dry sauerkraut., Mix all together and bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Cornbread
directions: Mix dry ingredients in a mixing bowl., Add egg, milk and shortening., Beat until smooth., Bake in a greased 8-inch square pan at 425° for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Chicken A La Michelle
directions: Boil chicken breasts., Remove skin and debone chicken breasts. If using boneless chicken, do not boil!, Fry in nonstick pan in margarine or butter (enough to coat pan) or white wine., Mix together soups and white wine., Add chicken pieces and simmer. Simmer at least 1 hour., The longer you can simmer the chicken, the more tender the chicken will be!, (It will melt in your mouth.)

title: Banana Pudding(Microwave)
directions: Combine, dry, ingredients, thoroughly, and, set, aside. Whisk remaining	ingredients, (except, bananas, and, vanilla wafers) in a 6 to 8 cup microwave container., Add dry ingredients and whisk all ingredients thoroughly., Cover with plastic wrap, leaving, a small vent., Microwave for 6 to 8 minutes or until thick, stirring each minute.

title: Chicken Tetrazzini
directions: Cook spaghetti according to package directions., Melt butter in large Dutch oven, saute green pepper and onion., Stir in chicken, mushrooms, pimento, soup, milk, garlic powder and salt. Drain spaghetti and add to mixture, toss., Pour into greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan or baking dish., Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes., Sprinkle with cheese., Bake 10 minutes longer or until cheese melts.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Melt butter in 11 x 13-inch dish., Add uncooked rice., Lay chicken, which has been cut into 2-inch pieces, on rice and sprinkle soup mix on top., Pour 2 cups water over mix., Spread cream of chicken soup over mixture and add 1 soup can of water. Sprinkle with paprika., Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours, uncovered.

title: Ovenbaked Pork Loin
directions: For basting sauce, saute onion and celery in the butter until soft., Add tomato puree, vinegar and molasses., Blend well.

title: Heavenly Cake
directions: Mix and bake cake according to package direction., While cake is baking, mix sweetened condensed milk and caramel ice cream topping., While cake is hot, make holes in cake with a large fork, then pour mixture over the cake., Let cool., Top with Cool Whip. Sprinkle over that the crushed Butterfinger bars and pecans.

title: Spanish Rice
directions: Mix all ingredients except cheese., Pour into baking dish. Bake at 400° for 1 hour., Remove from oven; top with cheese. Return to oven and allow cheese to brown.

title: Pork Chop Potato Dinner
directions: Put potatoes in greased 2-quart casserole; pour over mixture of soup, milk, salt, pepper and onions., Season and trim fat from chops; brown in skillet on both sides., Put on top of potatoes. Cover and bake at 375° for 1 hour or until done.

title: Ginger Cookies
directions: Beat together oleo, brown sugar, egg and honey until smooth. Add flour, soda, salt, cloves, cinnamon and ginger., Stir until well combined., Divide dough into balls (approximately 24)., Dip balls into granulated sugar and place 3 inches apart on baking sheet., Bake until tops are crinkled and just firm, 10 to 12 minutes., Cool completely., Store in airtight container., Bake at 375°.

title: Potato Soup
directions: Cook diced potatoes and onion until done., Add all other ingredients and simmer on very low heat for 15 to 20 minutes, stirring frequently, making sure it doesn't stick or scorch.

title: Tomato Soup Cake
directions: Mix well and spread on cake.

title: Raisin Drop Cakes
directions: Dissolve soda in hot water., Mix all ingredients., Drop by spoonfuls onto greased pan., Bake at 425° for 15 minutes., Lower heat to 300° for 5 minutes.

title: Crab Appetizer
directions: Drain crabmeat and mix by hand with softened cream cheese. Form into a ball., Place on a serving plate., Cover and chill. Right before serving, pour sauce over the crab ball., Serve with crackers.

title: Frosty Orange Cooler
directions: In pitcher, combine water, juice concentrate, ReaLemon and sugar; stir until sugar dissolves., Chill., Just before serving, add ginger ale., Scoop sherbet into glasses., Pour in juice mixture.

title: Squash Casserole
directions: Melt butter and mix with dressing., Line dish with the mixture., Save some to sprinkle on top., Mix the 4 remaining ingredients and pour into the dressing lined pan., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Shrimp Creole
directions: Heat oil in a large heavy pot., Stir in flour and make a medium roux., Add onion, celery, green pepper and green onion. Saute until limp., Add garlic, tomato sauce, tomatoes, bay leaves, black pepper, thyme, basil, salt and cayenne., Cook 15 minutes. Add Worcestershire and water and bring to a boil., Add shrimp and simmer about 20 minutes., This dish improves upon resting several hours or overnight., Serve over rice., Serves 6.

title: Kathy'S Favorite Ham And Cheese Broccoli Rolls
directions: Cook broccoli according to package; drain., Drain off pineapple juice to make 1/2 cup juice., In saucepan, melt butter or margarine., Stir in flour, horseradish, mustard, onion, Worcestershire sauce and salt., Add milk all at once., Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly., Cook and stir for 1 minute more. Combine egg yolk and pineapple juice., Add half of the hot mixture to egg yolk; return all to pan., Cook and stir over low heat until thickened.

title: Never Fail Fudge
directions: Melt butter in heavy 2-quart saucepan; stir in milk and sugar. Bring to full, rolling boil, stirring constantly., Continue boiling over medium heat until mixture reaches 234° or soft ball stage, stirring constantly to prevent scorching., Remove from heat and stir in chocolate pieces until melted., Add Marshmallow Creme and nuts, stirring until well blended., Pour into well-greased 13 x 9-inch pan., Cool at room temperature., Cut into squares., (If fudge is too soft, chill.), Makes about 3 pounds.

title: Gourmet Mashed Potatoes
directions: Peel and cook potatoes., Mix with electric mixer., Add stick of oleo and softened cream cheese., Mix well., Add sour cream, a little at a time, to get the desired consistency of mashed potatoes., Put in baking dish, dot with oleo and sprinkle with paprika., Heat in oven until lightly browned., Can be prepared a day ahead.

title: Potato Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients together but corn flakes and butter., Pour in a 13 x 10-inch pan., Stir together corn flakes and butter. Spread topping over potatoes., Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until potatoes are done.

title: Zucchini Fruit Bread
directions: *Currants can be used instead of raisins.

title: Chili Con Carne
directions: Brown beef in a Dutch oven or large pot., Add all ingredients except beans and simmer 1 hour., Add beans and cook to heat through., Cooked elbow macaroni can be added for a hearty one-dish meal.

title: Shirley Knox Pie
directions: In a small pan, sprinkle gelatin over water., Let stand 1 minute., Stir, over low heat until dissolved., Stir in 1 cup cream. Bring, to a boil., Pour into blender. Add chocolate and process until, chocolate, melts., Add, 1/2 cup cream, eggs and vanilla., Continue	until well blended. Pour into bowl., Chill until thick, about 30 minutes.

title: Molded Pineapple Salad
directions: Dissolve, jello, in boiling water., Chill until mixture begins to thicken, and, is, firm, to touch (1 to 1 1/2 hours). Whip jello until fluffy., Fold in remaining ingredients., Pour into mold or baking dish.

title: Chili Rellenos
directions: Place chilies under broiler., Roast until blistered, remove and place in damp cloth., Peel and remove seeds and veins from chilies. Fill chilies with cheese strips; roll in flour., Beat egg whites with salt until stiff., Fold in beaten egg yolks., Dip floured chilies in egg mixture., Fry in deep hot fat until golden brown., Remove from, grease; place on towel to drain., Serves 6.

title: Apricot Cake
directions: Cream the butter, sugar and eggs., Add flour and baking powder., Pour into a single round, greased cake pan., Drain and slice apricots; pour on center of cake batter., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Chipped Beef Casserole
directions: Place all ingredients in 9 x 12-inch baking dish and top with 6 to 8 ounces grated sharp Cheddar cheese., Bake at 300° for 1 hour.

title: Overnight Coffee Cake
directions: Combine butter and sugar; cream until light and fluffy., Add eggs and sour cream., Combine next 5 ingredients., Add to batter and mix well., Pour into a greased and floured 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.

title: Hamburger Casserole
directions: Brown hamburg and onion in a large skillet., Sprinkle in some parsley flakes., Drain hamburg and place in a 2-quart casserole. Cover with cream-style corn, then cover with mashed potatoes. Sprinkle with parsley leaves., Top with cheese (optional).

title: Italian Biscotti
directions: Cream butter and sugar thoroughly., Add eggs, one at a time, beating mixture until light and fluffy., Add vanilla, anise and nuts., Add flour sifted with baking powder and salt., Mix well. Knead like bread., Shape into 6 to 7 loaves., Brush top of loaves with 1 beaten egg., Bake 30 to 40 minutes at 350°., Remove from oven; cut diagonally into small pieces., Return to oven., Toast until light brown.

title: Very Best Cheese Cake
directions: Combine crushed graham crackers with melted butter until well blended., Pat down firmly to, form crust in bottom of well greased 9-inch spring pan, making sure, edges, of, the, pan are sealed. Beat eggs well., Add, cream, cheese, and, beat, until mixture is smooth., Next, add 1, cup sugar, lemon juice and the flour., Beat until all ingredients, are	well, mixed., Add sour cream, vanilla and 4 tablespoons sugar., After mixture has been well blended, pour into spring, pan, with, the, graham, cracker crust., Bake at 375° for one, hour	or, until, outer edges have turned brown. Cool, then remove sides and refrigerate. Cake is at, its best after, being, refrigerated	overnight, or, longer. Before serving,, cake may	be, topped, with, prepared, cherry, blueberry or pineapple pie filling., Serves about 15.

title: Everlasting Cole Slaw
directions: Toss cabbage, peppers, celery and onion together., Heat sugar, vinegar, salt, celery seed, mustard seed and oil together; cool. Add to cole slaw.

title: Western Meal In One
directions: Brown meat and crumble., Add garlic, onion, pepper, salt and chili powder., Saute until vegetables are limp., Mix in tomatoes, beans and rice.

title: Marinated Scandinavian Salad
directions: Combine green beans, green peas, celery, green pepper, onion, pimento, vinegar, oil, sugar, paprika, salt and pepper in bowl; mix well., Chill for 24 hours to several days., Drain before serving., Yield:, 10 servings.

title: Zucchini Relish
directions: Let zucchini, onion, and salt stand overnight; drain and rinse with cold, water., Add, all, ingredients, to zucchini and onion. Cook 30 minutes., Seal in hot clean jars.

title: Calico Beans
directions: Brown bacon, hamburger and chopped onion in saucepan., Then add remaining ingredients and mix well., Bake at 300° for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Beefy Cheese Ball
directions: Mix together and form into a ball., Serve with crackers.

title: Quick Skillet
directions: Boil, then reduce to a simmer for 15 to 20 minutes, uncovered. Makes 5 servings.

title: Fried Rice (Chinese)
directions: Use chopsticks or a fork to separate rice grains., In a small bowl, combine the eggs, soy sauce, sesame oil, salt and pepper. Set aside., Heat wok and add oil around the rim (this seals the wok and heats the oil quickly)., Add shrimp, bacon, and green onion., Immediately add rice and stir-fry over high heat; after a few minutes, the grains will separate., While stirring rice, pour in egg mixture., Stir-fry one minute., Serve rice in a warm Chinese bowl to retain heat during serving., Serves 6.

title: Garlicky Clams
directions: In a large saute pan, with a lid, add the oil. Heat the oil over medium heat. When the oil is hot, add the clams. Season with salt and pepper. Cover and saute for 6 to 8 minutes. Add the onions, garlic and wine. Continue to saute for 2 minutes or until the shells completely open; discard any shells that do not open. Add the pasta. Season with salt and pepper. Continue to saute for 2 minutes. Add the parsley and mix well. Serve on a large platter. Drizzle with olive oil and serve. Yield: 4 to 6 servings.

title: Cog Au Vin
directions: Fry bacon until crisp, drain and crumble., In a bit of bacon grease, saute onions and mushrooms, then remove from pan. Lightly dredge chicken in flour, salt and pepper., Add butter to frying pan and brown chicken., Remove to casserole and sprinkle with garlic and herbs., Add bacon, onions and mushrooms and pour on wine., Cover and bake at 350° for one and one-half hours. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Shrimp Rolls
directions: Cut bacon in half while in the package. Set aside., Mix Bisquick with eggs, milk and spices. Stir in shrimp last. Separate cold bacon slices., Put 1 spoonful of mixture on the end of 1/2 slice of bacon. Roll up individually. Brown in skillet in hot oil. Serve hot or cold.

title: Dandelion Wine
directions: Boil dandelion blossoms, water and sugar together 15 minutes. Cool., Add yeast and sliced lemon., Let stand 5 days; strain and let stand 5 more days., Put in gallon jugs and put a balloon on top until it quits working, then cork.

title: Strawberry Cream Pie(Serves 8)
directions: Combine softened cream cheese, granulated sugar, vanilla and nutmeg, mixing until well blended., Mash 3/4 cup strawberry slices; stir into cream cheese mixture., Whip cream with confectioners sugar until stiff peaks form., Fold into cream cheese mixture. Fold remaining strawberries into cream cheese mixture., Spoon into pie crust., Chill overnight.

title: Poor Man'S Crab Cakes
directions: In a large bowl, combine all ingredients, mixing well., Form into cakes and dip in flour., Panfry until golden brown., Makes a great main dish with a salad and simple dessert., Serves 4 to 6.

title: Mom Z'S Molasses Cookies
directions: Mix together in bowl the flour, cinnamon, soda, salt and ginger., Cream shortening, sugar, eggs and molasses in separate bowl., Add sour milk and raisins., Stir until mixed well., Add dry ingredients., Drop by tablespoon onto greased baking sheets., Bake in a 350° oven for 12 minutes.

title: Aunt Donna'S Cheese Ball
directions: Place cheeses in small bowl., Let stand at room temperature until soft., Blend in onions and Worcestershire sauce at low speed. Beat on medium speed until fluffy, scraping side and bottom of bowl frequently., Cover and chill 3 to 4 hours., Shape into ball., Roll in parsley and pecans., Cover and chill 2 hours or until firm.

title: Lizzies
directions: Cream sugar and butter thoroughly., Add beaten eggs., Sift together flour, soda and spices., Add to egg mixture., Add milk and bourbon; mixing well., Add nuts, citron and candied cherries. Drop on greased cookie sheet and bake in moderately slow oven (325°) for 25 minutes., These are wonderful for eggnog or Tom and Jerry parties., Yields six dozen cookies.

title: Excellent Broccoli Cornbread
directions: Thaw broccoli and by hand squeeze out water., Mix all ingredients well with a wooden spoon., Use a well-greased oblong pan (9 x 13-inches)., Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes., Serve hot.

title: Grits
directions: Cook grits in 3 cups water., Let cool or may be cold., Add other ingredients and bake at 375° until done.

title: Swiss Bliss
directions: Place 20-inch sheet of foil on baking sheet; brush with margarine., Lay pieces of meat in center., Combine next 7 ingredients and spread evenly over meat., Mix A.1. and cornstarch and pour over meat., Fold foil to seal tightly., Bake 2 hours in 375° oven.

title: Jean'S Sweet Potato Casserole
directions: Mix and put in baking dish.

title: Never Fail Pecan Pie
directions: Melt margarine and add sugar and syrup., Mix good; beat eggs good and add to margarine, sugar and syrup., Add pecans and put in an unbaked pie shell and bake for 30 to 35 minutes at 350°.

title: Nancy'S Potatoes
directions: Cook until thick., Add 6 slices fat-free cheese., Cut 30 ounces potatoes into baking dish., Cover with ingredients and bake at 425° for 1 hour or until potatoes are tender.

title: Buddy'S Tater Soup
directions: Fry bacon. Drain grease. Crumble into small pieces. Saute onions in bacon grease. In another pan, put potatoes, carrots and 1 cup water. Bring to a boil until potatoes and carrots are soft. Add bacon, onion, 1 cup milk and soup. Cook until hot, but do not boil. When all is hot, add shredded Cheddar cheese.

title: Sinful Salad
directions: In medium bowl, combine gelatin and boiling water., Stir with rubber spatula until gelatin is completely dissolved., Cool., Add bananas, pecans, strawberries and pineapple to gelatin and stir to combine; divide in half.

title: Macaroni With Ham-Broccoli
directions: Cook macaroni as package directs; drain.

title: Barbecued Beans
directions: Brown beef and onions; drain., Add remaining ingredients; mix well., Pour into 1 1/2-quart casserole., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Hot Crab Dip
directions: Mix ingredients together using only 1/2 of the grated cheese. Reserve 1/2 (or rest) of the grated cheese for top., Pour into 1 1/2-quart baking dish., Sprinkle top with paprika., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until bubbly and crusty.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
directions: Heat oven to 375°., Note:, Do not preheat oven until you are ready to slice cookies.

title: Grits Casserole A La Donna Ford
directions: Cook grits until medium consistency., While grits are cooking, brown sausage., Grate cheese., Beat the eggs slightly.

title: Fruit Cobbler
directions: *Canned peaches, strawberries, blueberries, etc., can be used.

title: Sausage Dip
directions: Fry sausage until done., Drain real well., In a crock-pot, add all ingredients, except chips., Heat until all is mixed well. Serve hot with chips.

title: Peanut Butter Caramel Corn
directions: Preheat oven to 200°., Lightly oil a 9 x 13-inch baking pan with oil., Place popcorn in oiled pan and keep popcorn warm in oven while preparing peanut butter syrup., In a large saucepan, combine brown sugar, peanut butter, corn syrup, water, oil and salt., Bring to a boil, stirring frequently., Stir in baking soda and quickly pour syrup over popcorn., Gently stir until popcorn is well coated. Bake at 200° for 1 hour, stirring every 20 minutes., Remove from oven., Stir and let cool., Break into clusters., Store in airtight container., Makes 12 cups caramel corn.

title: Beth'S Sugar Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Combine egg, butter, sugar and vanilla. Add flour., Drop by tablespoonfuls on a greased cookie sheet. Bake for 8 to 10 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Shrimp-Avocado Salad
directions: Dissolve gelatin in hot water., Add cold water, vinegar, mayonnaise, salt and pepper., Blend with rotary beater., Pour into refrigerator tray., Quick chill in freezing unit until firm, about 1-inch from edge, but soft in the center, about 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Mini Pizzas
directions: Flatten biscuits., Brown ground beef in skillet and drain. Put pizza sauce on biscuits and top with ground beef and then both cheeses., Bake at 400° for 10 minutes or until done.

title: Choplet Casserole
directions: Dip choplets in soy milk mixture, then in bread crumbs., Place in skillet with small amount of olive oil., Fry until brown; turn choplets over., Place sliced onion on top of choplets., To the broth, add the George Washington seasoning and enough water to make 1/2 can., Pour over choplets., Reduce heat, cover and simmer until onion is tender., (Green pepper can be added with the onion.) Delicious.

title: Cranberry Salad
directions: Combine and refrigerate for 2 hours the ground cranberries and sugar., Prepare Dream Whip., Fold in marshmallows., Refrigerate for 2 hours., Combine the two mixtures and add crushed pineapple and pecans.

title: Barbecued Beef Ribs(Los Angeles Times Cookbook)
directions: Arrange beef ribs on rack in baking pan., Saute onion and garlic in oil until golden., Add mustard, tomato puree, sugar, soy sauce, vinegar, bay leaves, hot pepper sauce, barbecue spice and salt., Simmer about 15 minutes., Strain., Brush barbecue sauce generously over beef ribs, covering them thoroughly., Bake at 375° to 400° for 45 minutes, basting frequently with sauce until beef ribs are tender and well done., Store any remaining sauce, covered, in refrigerator.

title: Lemon Pecan Cake
directions: Cream oleo, and, sugar, add 1 egg at a time., Add 3 cups flour, flavoring and pecans., Add 1 cup flour to chopped fruit, then add to mixture., Makes two cakes, baked in angel food cake pans., Bake, at 250° until done., After 1 hour put pan of water under cake.

title: Chocolate Macadamia Bars
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Melt chocolate chips, unsweetened chocolate and butter together., Cool 10 minutes., Stir in sugar. Add eggs and vanilla, beating by hand until blended., Stir in flour, baking powder and salt that has been mixed together., Fold in nuts and white baking chocolate., Pour into a greased 9-inch square pan., Bake 30 to 40 minutes until they test done., Cool. Sift powdered sugar over before cutting into 24 bars.

title: Puppy Chow Chocolate Wheat Chex
directions: Melt peanut butter, chocolate chips and margarine together. Add Wheat Chex and mix well., Place confectioners sugar in a bag and shake Wheat Chex until coated., Freeze it., It can be left out after frozen.

title: Peanut Butter Cups
directions: Blend together the first 3 ingredients; roll into small balls. Melt the last 2 ingredients over medium heat, stirring constantly., Use small pitcher or creamer to pour chocolate., Pour a little chocolate into tiny paper cups., Drop in small peanut butter ball., Pour more chocolate on top., Let stand until hard. These freeze well.

title: Broccoli Delight Salad
directions: In a large salad bowl, combine broccoli, raisins and onion. In a small bowl, combine sugar, vinegar and mayonnaise., Pour over broccoli; toss to coat., Refrigerate., Just before serving, sprinkle with bacon and sunflower seeds; toss., Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Natalie'S Specialty Fish
directions: Let fish defrost (block) just long enough so that you can cut it into 4 or 5 pieces., Place in casserole with enough oil on the bottom of the casserole to keep from sticking at 400°, for about 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Easy Fettuccine Alfredo
directions: Prepare the fettuccine according to package directions. Meanwhile, combine cream cheese, Parmesan cheese, margarine and milk in a saucepan. Stir over low heat until smooth. Combine with hot cooked noodles. Add cooked small shrimp or imitation crab or lobster meat to the sauce to make a delicious seafood alfredo.

title: Potato And Cheese Casserole
directions: Cook potatoes in boiling salted water for 15 minutes or until tender; drain well., Meanwhile, saute garlic and green onion in butter for 2 minutes or until softened., Mash potatoes, beat in garlic butter mixture, cream cheese, half and half, salt and pepper., Fold in Brie or Camembert cheese., Place in 1 1/2-quart casserole., Bake at 450° for 15 minutes or until top begins to lightly brown., Garnish with thyme or parsley., Serve at once.

title: No-Bake Chocolate Oatmeal Candy
directions: Combine first 4 ingredients., Bring to a full boil and stir 2 minutes., Remove from heat., Add peanut butter, vanilla and oatmeal., Mix well., Drop by teaspoon on waxed paper., Let stand 20 minutes.

title: Quick Pasta Dish
directions: In a bowl, mix pasta (cooked) of your choice with mixture and serve immediately., Top with grated cheese.

title: Orange Balls
directions: Mix first 5 ingredients well., Shape into balls., Roll in powdered sugar., Store in refrigerator.

title: Pasta
directions: Cook pasta according to package directions., Heat oil in skillet; add garlic and saute 1 minute., Add tomatoes; heat to boiling., Stir until thickens, about 10 minutes., Stir in cream and sun-dried tomatoes and simmer about 5 minutes., Add salt and pepper.

title: Zucchini Bread
directions: Grease and flour 2 loaf pans., Beat eggs, oil, sugar, zucchini and vanilla., Sift and measure flour., Sift together with soda, powder, salt and cinnamon; add sifted ingredients to creamed mixture., Mix to blend; add nuts., Bake at 325° for 40 to 50 minutes., Makes 2 loaves.

title: Gram'S Clam Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients (except milk) together and let set 2 hours., Pour in milk and stir gently., Bake at 350° for 50 to 55 minutes.

title: Rice-A-Roni Chicken
directions: Boil and debone chicken., Save broth; cook rice by directions using broth instead of water., Combine all ingredients and bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

title: Cranberry Salad
directions: Make jello as directed on package., Delete one cup of water. Put in refrigerator until jelled halfway., Add other ingredients and chill.

title: Crunchy Vegetable Spread
directions: Chop in food processor until fine but not mushy the cucumbers, carrots, green peppers and small onion., Chop by hand the tomatoes. Add to vegetables the mayonnaise, Worcestershire sauce, prepared mustard and salt., Dissolve unflavored gelatin in lukewarm water. Stir into mixture., Refrigerate overnight.

title: Corn Fritters
directions: Sift flour, baking powder, salt and sugar together., Stir in corn., Add beaten eggs., Drop tablespoons into hot fat or oil in deep fryer., Cook until golden brown; drain on paper towels before serving.

title: Jill'S Mulled Cider
directions: Mix in crock-pot and cook slowly for 3 to 5 hours.

title: Lobster Dip
directions: Break up lobster and remove bones., Mix all ingredients together and sprinkle with paprika., Put in Corning Ware dish. Bake for 20 minutes in 350° oven.

title: Kool-Aid Pie
directions: Mix ingredients together well in a large bowl., Pour mixture into pie crust., Place in freezer and chill well., In 3 hours, cut and serve.

title: Tater Tot Hot Dish
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., In skillet, brown ground beef with onion; drain., Stir in mixed vegetables and soup., Pour into 2 1/2-quart casserole dish., Top with Tater Tots., Bake 30 minutes. Makes 8 servings.

title: Cranberry Relish
directions: Put cranberries through food chopper; add sugar and mix well. Sprinkle gelatine on 1/2 cup cranberry juice to soften., Place over low heat and stir in remaining 1/2 cup cranberry juice, pineapple and nuts., Chill until firm., Apples may be substituted for pineapple.

title: Creamed Salmon And Peas
directions: Melt butter or margarine., Blend in flour, salt, pepper and sugar., Gradually add milk., Cook in top of double boiler over hot water, stirring constantly until thick., Add salmon and peas. Serve on toast.

title: Butterscotch Cookies
directions: Melt butter in 2-quart saucepan; add sugar and mix well., Add egg; beat until light colored., Sift flour with soda., Stir into egg mixture., Add vanilla and nuts., Chill., Roll in small balls. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 375° for 7 to 10 minutes. Remove at once., Makes 3 dozen.

title: White Cake
directions: Cream together shortening and sugar., Add milk alternately with flour, baking powder and salt, sifted together., Add whites of eggs or fold in last, stirring gently., Use any flavoring to suit taste., Bake in layer-cake pans for 30 minutes at 325°.

title: Sausage Omelet
directions: In a 10-inch skillet, melt butter., Add broken up sausage and chopped onion., Mix eggs, milk, soy sauce and garlic in a small bowl., Pour over sausage in skillet, then simmer on low heat until bubbly.

title: Cheesy Chicken Fajitas
directions: Spray a large skillet with no-stick cooking spray., Add pepper and onion., Cook and stir until tender., Remove from skillet. Spray skillet with no-stick cooking spray., Add chicken., Cook and stir until cooked through., Add cooked vegetables, chilies, cumin and garlic; simmer 5 minutes., Place each tortilla on microwavable plate., Top with 2 cheese slices., Microwave each tortilla on High 20 seconds., Top each tortilla with half of chicken mixture., Fold sides to middle., Serve with salsa., Makes 2 servings.

title: Low-Fat Chicken Gumbo
directions: Brown cornstarch over medium-high heat (without any oil or butter) stirring occasionally., When the cornstarch is brown add dehydrated onions., Crumble up and brown with cornstarch., Add chicken, cut up, and water., Let it come to a boil, then cover and reduce heat to medium-low., Cook 30 minutes., When done, add file, salt and pepper and serve with rice.

title: Fruit Pizza
directions: Grease a round pizza pan., Slice the cookie dough and pat it onto the pizza pan, making sure that the whole pan is covered. Bake in a 375° oven for 12 minutes or until golden brown., Let cool.

title: Crock Pot Cantonese Dinner
directions: Brown pork strips in oil., Remove excess fat., Drain on paper towel., Place in crock pot along with remaining ingredients. Cover and cook on low for 6 - 8 hours., Serve with rice.

title: Easy Chili
directions: Cook ground beef., Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Cover and simmer 45 minutes.

title: Whipped Shortbread
directions: Mix all ingredients in a bowl and beat for 10 minutes with electric beater. Drop by spoonful on cookie sheet and bake at 300° until lightly brown.

title: Oceania Chicken
directions: Mix flour, salt and seasonings., Coat chicken., Put chicken in buttered pan., Combine syrup from pineapple with soy sauce and sugar., Pour over chicken and cover., Baste occasionally., Bake at 350° for 1 to 1 1/2 hours., Add pineapple slices 15 minutes before done., Serves 4 to 6.

title: Ginger Cookies
directions: Cream butter and sugar., Add beaten egg and molasses., Sift flour with soda, salt and spices., Add to oleo., Roll in balls and roll each ball in sugar., Place on greased cookie sheet., Bake at 350° to 375° until browned.

title: Christmas Cranberry Salad
directions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water., Stir in cold water; chill until slightly thickened., Stir in remaining ingredients; mix well. Pour into 1 1/2-quart mold; chill until set., Unmold; garnish as desired., Serves 8.

title: Hungarian-Style Goulash
directions: In 5-quart Dutch oven over medium-high heat, in hot margarine or butter, cook onions until lightly browned., Add meat, paprika and salt., Reduce heat to low., Cover and simmer 1 1/2 to 2 hours until meat is fork-tender., Stir in sour cream; heat through (do not boil)., Serve over noodles., Makes 8 servings.

title: Pam'S Cheese Ball
directions: Mix these all together in a big ball., Let set overnight. Serve with crackers.

title: Pizza Cups
directions: Brown and drain beef. Stir in tomato paste, onion and seasoning (mixture will be thick). Cook over low heat for 5 minutes. Place biscuits in a greased muffin tin. Spoon about 1/4 cup of meat mixture into biscuit-lined cups and sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 400° for 12 minutes.

title: Banana Nut Bread
directions: Cream shortening and sugar., Add eggs and mashed bananas. Mix the dry ingredients and add to the mixture., Alternate with the buttermilk., Add chopped nuts and pour into two loaf pans and bake at 350 degrees for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Squash Casserole
directions: Melt butter; add next 5 ingredients., Heat and stir to mix. Pour into casserole dish., Sprinkle bread crumbs and cheese., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until brown on top.

title: Iced Coffee Punch
directions: Mix coffee and sugar and dissolve in 2 cups boiling water. Add 14 cups cold water., Add half and half and vanilla. Refrigerate until needed or overnight., At serving time, put one gallon softened ice cream into large punch bowl., Add coffee mixture., Serves 40.

title: Raspberry Jello
directions: Mix jello and water; cool slightly., Add raspberries, pineapple, bananas and nuts., Pour 1/2 of mixture in a small square pan., Chill until firm.

title: Sauerkraut
directions: Mix water, salt, vinegar and sugar together., Pour over chopped cabbage, which has been packed in jar., Make enough of the solution to come up over your cabbage., Place a white cloth over it and a plate, then put something heavy on top of plate to hold it down., Let set 12 to 14 days, then dip it out and put in clean quart cans., Seal and put in canner; let them get just hot enough to seal your lids (to just a boil).

title: Italian Anise Cookies
directions: Sift dry ingredients., Beat eggs; add flour, milk and shortening., Mix with dry ingredients to make a dough., More flour may be added if needed., Break dough into pieces and roll into 1/2-inch diameter; cut into 3-inch pieces., Bring ends together to form a ring., Bake on greased cookie sheet in a 400° oven until light and brown.

title: Turkey Bean Soup
directions: After beans have been soaked overnight, drain beans and rinse. Put all ingredients into an 8-quart kettle., Rinse tomato cans with water and pour water into soup mixture., Start cooking on high until hot., Lower heat., Cover and let simmer, stirring occasionally., I let mine simmer on lowest heat most of the day. The soup will be thick like a stew., Soup may be frozen for future use.

title: Austrian Scramble
directions: Peel amount of potatoes to feed your family., Cut potatoes in very small cubes., Deep fry potatoes until done., When done, put potatoes in a dry skillet (do not turn burner on)., Scramble enough eggs for your family., When eggs are done, pour them into skillet with potatoes., Add salt and pepper to taste., Mix potatoes and eggs together, then sprinkle enough Italian seasoning, garlic powder and parsley flakes to suit your taste. Turn skillet on low long enough to get the ingredients warm. Ready to serve., Great for breakfast!

title: Spinach Casserole
directions: Fold all ingredients together. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Chicken Divan
directions: In a buttered, casserole, dish,, place cooked broccoli, then cooked chicken pieces., Mix mushroom soup, mayonnaise and lemon juice together and place mixture over chicken., Sprinkle cheese. Top with, buttered, bread crumbs., Bake uncovered for 30 minutes in 350° oven or until crumbs are brown., Serve over rice.

title: Marinated Carrots
directions: Arrange first 3 ingredients in layers., Combine the rest and bring to boil., Pour over carrots, etc., Chill at least 12 hours. When serving, remove carrots, etc. with a slotted spoon, from the marinade which can be used again., Can be made days ahead of time.

title: Fruit Salad
directions: Mix pudding, buttermilk and Cool Whip together., Add oranges, pineapple, bananas and any fruit., Chill.

title: Best Ever German Chocolate Cake
directions: Bake cake as directed on package in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Take out of oven and poke holes in the cake with a fork or round wooden spoon handle. Pour sweetened condensed milk into holes. Pour ice cream topping over the cake. Frost with Cool Whip (or may use whipped cream). Crush candy bars and sprinkle over top. Refrigerate.

title: Filled Cookies
directions: Mix first 4 ingredients and cook over medium heat until mixture bubbles., Add coconut, pecans and graham cracker crumbs. Mix well.

title: Cheese Log
directions: Mix altogether with hand until well mixed., Roll on wax paper and sprinkle with chili powder., Refrigerate.

title: Chicken And Rice Casserole
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Boil chicken breasts until tender; let cool., Tear into strips., Prepare Rice-A-Roni as directed on the box., Combine all ingredients except 1/2 cup of cheese (save this for the topping)., Cook for 30 minutes., Top with cheese; let stand to melt., Serve hot., Yields 12 servings.

title: White Chili
directions: After chicken has boiled, take chicken out to cool; then pull into pieces., Place all other ingredients in chicken broth and simmer long enough to cook the bell pepper and green onion., Serve in bowls topped with grated Monterey cheese.

title: Camp Fire Stew
directions: Melt butter in pan., Brown meat and onions., Add soup and seasonings., Cook 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Mock Steak
directions: Mix together the first 3 ingredients., Press flat on cookie sheet., Refrigerate overnight., Cut into squares., Roll in flour and brown in skillet., Place in baking dish and add mushroom soup, brown gravy and 3 cups water., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Candied Fruitcake
directions: Sift together flour, salt, baking powder and spices into big bowl (or dishpan)., Chop dates and pineapple into coarse pieces. Add whole cherries and mix all fruit with flour mixture, distributing fruit as evenly as possible., Beat eggs with sugar and add to other ingredients, mixing with hands., Add whole pecans and continue, mixing until nuts are evenly distributed.

title: Baked Beans
directions: Cook hamburger and onion; drain., Add ingredients, mixing well. Pour into dish and bake 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Swiss Cheese Appetizers
directions: Mix ingredients together., Spread on party rye bread., Place on cookie sheet and bake for 15 minutes at 350°.

title: Creamy Florentine Dip
directions: Thaw and drain frozen spinach., Place spinach, onion, garlic, salt and allspice into food processor bowl with metal blade. Process until smooth., Transfer to medium bowl and add mayonnaise and yogurt., Blend., Chill.

title: Bojangle Biscuits
directions: Sift dry ingredients together., Cut in Crisco and then add buttermilk., Dough will be very soft., Pour out on floured wax paper., Pat down and cut out., Bake at 500° until golden brown. Yields 12 large biscuits.

title: Spicy Cocktail Wieners
directions: Heat mustard and currant jelly until mixed well., Cut the frankfurters into bite size pieces., Add to mustard and jelly mixture., Heat thoroughly., Spear with toothpicks and serve.

title: Jimmy'S Favorite Clair Dessert
directions: Line a 9 x 13-inch pan with chocolate grahams., Prepare pudding mix with 3 cups of milk., Blend whipped topping mix into pudding. Pour pudding mixture on top of grahams., Add another layer of chocolate grahams (you won't use the whole box)., Microwave frosting until it's easy to pour., Pour frosting over grahams. Refrigerate for 6 hours.

title: Vegetables For Brunch
directions: Pour frozen vegetables into 1 (9 x 13-inch) casserole, sprayed with Pam to prevent sticking, approximately 1/2-inch deep. Sprinkle some of the cheese over vegies., Sprinkle a small amount of lemon pepper over cheese., Then, add remaining vegies and cheese., Pour egg mixture over top., Bake in 350° oven until cheese melts and vegies are done (1 hour)., Cooking time can be reduced if vegies are precooked 8 minutes in microwave., Shanghai vegetables are available at Price Club.

title: Saucy Enchiladas
directions: Combine ground beef and onion in skillet; brown and drain., Fry tortillas, one at a time, in 1/4-inch hot oil., Cook 5 seconds on each side., Drain on paper towels., Spoon meat mixture evenly on center of each tortilla and roll them up., Place tortillas, seam side down, in a jelly roll pan., Combine remaining ingredients, except Cheddar cheese, in a small saucepan; cook over medium heat until the slices of American cheese melt., Pour evenly over the enchiladas and sprinkle with Cheddar cheese., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
directions: Cream butter, eggs, sugar and vanilla., Combine flour, soda and salt; blend into butter mixture., Stir in chips and nuts. Drop teaspoonful drops 2 inches apart on buttered cookie sheet. Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Honey Punch
directions: Mix honey and 1 quart of hot water., Add juices, Kool-aid and remaining 2 quarts water., Add 7-Up just before serving., Makes 1 gallon.

title: Blueberry Surprise Cake
directions: Sprinkle over batter., Pour 1 cup boiling water over top. Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Cold Rice Salad
directions: Prepare rice by package directions and let cool., Add remaining ingredients, cutting up artichoke hearts and adding oil from the jar., Add mayonnaise, salt and pepper to taste. Refrigerate at least 2 hours., Better if served the next day.

title: Brisket
directions: Brown brisket in pan on all sides., Add chopped onions, paprika, allspice, black pepper and celery., Mix., Add tomato sauce., Cook, covered, until meat flakes with a fork., Remove and slice meat., Strain gravy and return sliced meat to gravy and serve.

title: French Onion Soup With Cheese Toast
directions: Melt butter in 5-quart Dutch oven or stock pot over medium heat., Stir in onions and garlic., Cook 20 to 30 minutes or until onions are very soft., Stir in broth, wine, salt and pepper. Cook, uncovered, for 40 to 60 minutes or until flavors are blended., Just before serving, toast bread; place cheese on hot bread.

title: French Chocolate Pie
directions: Cream butter and sugar., Melt chocolate squares and stir in with butter and sugar mixture., Add eggs, beating in one at a time, for 5 minutes each, at high speed., Add Cool Whip and mix together., Put in pie shell and chill 2 hours.

title: Rice Dressing
directions: In a large pan, brown ground beef., Drain well., Add spices and veggies., Cook on medium heat until veggies are tender., Add Kitchen Bouquet (or soy sauce), rice and water., Cover and cook until rice is done.

title: Miniature Drumsticks
directions: Remove wing tips and cut chicken wings in half at joint., Cook wings in Dutch saucepan in salad oil for about 7 minutes, stirring constantly., Reduce heat to medium and add remaining ingredients. Cover and cook about 25 minutes, stirring occasionally., Uncover and cook 10 minutes more; liquid should be absorbed and wings tender.

title: Cabbage Roll Casserole
directions: Brown ground beef, salt, pepper, Worcestershire sauce and onion; drain., Add Minute rice, tomato soup and water., Place cabbage in bottom of casserole dish., Top with meat mixture., Bake in 325° oven for 1 1/2 to 2 hours., Add grated cheese on top the last 1/2 hour of baking.

title: Crescent Vegetable Squares
directions: Preheat, oven, to, 375°., Place, crescent roll dough in bottom of, an ungreased 15 x 10-inch jelly roll pan., Press to seal edges together., Bake 8 to 10 minutes until golden brown. Set, aside to cool., Combine softened cream cheese, mayonnaise and dip, mix, blend well and spread over cooled crescent roll crust., Top, cream cheese, layer with grated cheese., Combine all, vegetables, and sprinkle over cheese., Garnish with tomatoes., It's ready to eat. Yields 25 squares.

title: Barbecue Hamburger Sandwich Mix
directions: Lightly brown hamburger meat in small amount of shortening. Add chopped onion and saute., Add other ingredients., Simmer, stirring occasionally, until mixture is thick, but not dry., Serve over hamburger buns.

title: Jim Faye'S Fresh Peach Pie
directions: Peel and slice peaches., Put into bowl., Put all other ingredients into a saucepan., Cook until thickened., Let cool., Add to sliced peaches., Pour all of this into a graham cracker crust. Whip cream., Add on top., Put into refrigerator until cold.

title: Orange Cider
directions: Heat cider until hot., Pour hot cider into mug and add drink powder, nutmeg and cinnamon., Stir and serve while hot.

title: Cranberry Salad
directions: Drain oranges; reserve syrup., Add water to get 2 cups., Bring to a boil., Add gelatin until dissolved., Chill until partially set., Fold in cranberry sauce, walnuts and orange segments., Pour into a 9 x 13-inch dish and chill overnight.

title: Braided Bread (Challah)(Makes Two Loaves)
directions: In large bowl, dissolve yeast and sugar in water., Stir in one cup flour, salt, two eggs and oil., Add remaining flour gradually, stirring until combined., Turn out onto a lightly floured board. Knead 8 to 10 minutes until smooth and elastic (adding small amounts of flour as needed)., (Pretend you are making pottery.) Put dough in a large oil-coated bowl, turning over once to coat whole ball., Cover bowl with large dish cloth and let rise in warm place for one hour., Punch down dough, turn over in bowl, re-cover with cloth and let rise another 45 minutes., Punch down again, place dough on lightly floured board and cut in two.

title: Oven Baked Potato Wedges
directions: Set oven to 400°., Melt butter into baking pan., Set aside. Cut clean potatoes into wedges., Mix Ranch package, flour and cheese in a small paper or plastic bag., Shake potato wedges in bag until well coated., Bake in butter-coated pan until lightly brown and tender in the middle., You should turn them over while baking to brown both sides.

title: Lemon Jello Pound Cake
directions: Mix, jello, and hot water together., Let cool., Combine cake mix,, oil and eggs; beat well., Add lemon flavoring; mix again. Pour, in, jello;, mix thoroughly., Pour into tube pan, greased and floured., Bake at 325° for 1 hour.

title: Congo Bars
directions: Melt butter., Stir in sugar, eggs, vanilla and dry ingredients., Mix well., Add chocolate chips and nuts., Bake at 350° for 25 minutes in a 13 x 9-inch or 14 x 11-inch greased pan.

title: Orange Cake Recipe
directions: Combine ingredients in large mixing bowl., Beat on low speed of mixer for 2 minutes to blend., Beat 3 minutes longer on high speed of mixer., Pour into 2 greased and floured 9-inch cake pans. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes., Cool and slice layer horizontal to make 4 layers., Put filling between layers., Frost as directed in filling recipe., Refrigerate 24 hours before serving.

title: Apple Cake
directions: Sift dry ingredients together; beat eggs and sugar together and add oil and vanilla to this., Add these two mixtures together and then add apples., Put in Bundt pan and cook at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes., Test with toothpick., Do not overcook.

title: Potato Soup
