directions: Cream sugar and oil., Add eggs and beat well., Add vinegar and food coloring; beat well., Sift dry ingredients., Add alternating with milk., Add vanilla; beat well., Pour into cake pan., Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Hearty Corn Chowder
directions: Cook bacon until crisp., Remove to paper towels, crumble and set aside., Drain all but 2 tablespoons of drippings., Saute onion and celery in drippings, until onion is lightly browned., Add potatoes and water., Cover and cook over medium heat for 10 minutes., Stir in corn, milk, sausage, dill and bacon., Cook until the potatoes are tender, about 30 minutes., Makes 4 (6 ounce) servings.

title: Crowd-Pleasing Potato Salad
directions: Place potatoes in large salad bowl., Separate eggs., Chop whites and add to potatoes with onion., Toss gently., In another bowl, mash yolks with mayonnaise, cream, vinegar, sugar, mustard and salt., Pour over potatoes and stir to coat., Cover and chill. Yields 16 to 20 servings.

title: Sweet And Sour Chicken Wings
directions: Mix sauce ingredients and simmer 5 minutes., Pour over wings and toss lightly to coat., Bake 20 minutes at 350°.

title: Caramel Sticky Buns
directions: Thaw bread dough., When thawed, break half the loaf into small pieces and place in well-greased pie plate., Melt margarine in saucepan, adding dry pudding, brown sugar, cinnamon and milk. Bring just to a boil., Pour over broken pieces., Add walnuts or pecans, if desired., Break up remaining bread dough and place on top., Let rise to top of pan and bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until brown., Invert on plate and serve warm.

title: Mexican Pork Or Beef Chile Verde(Microwave)
directions: In 2-quart casserole dish, combine onion and garlic., Cover. Microwave High 2 minutes., Stir in meat in cubes, flour, salt and pepper., Add tomatoes and green chiles., Stir to break up tomatoes., Cover., Microwave High 5 minutes., Stir., Reduce power. Cover for 30 minutes., Stir., Microwave uncovered for 15 to 20 minutes until meat is tender., Serve with warm tortillas., Serves 4 to 6., Total Cooking Time:, 57 minutes.

title: Chocolate-Peanut Butter Bars
directions: Use a 13 x 9-inch baking pan., Mix confectioners sugar, cracker crumbs, peanut butter and butter in a medium size bowl until blended., Scrape into ungreased baking pan and press into an even layer., Spread melted chocolate over top., Refrigerate for at least 2 hours until chocolate is firm., Let stand at room temperature 15 to 20 minutes before cutting with sharp knife into bars., Makes 36.

title: 7-Up Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients well., Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes or until done., Let cool.

title: Breast Of Chicken
directions: Soak chicken in beaten eggs at least 2 hours, better if overnight., Roll the chicken in bread crumbs., (I use the Italian seasoning crumbs.), Brown pieces in skillet in butter or oleo. Place chicken in baking dish., Do not pile chicken on top of pieces, just one layer., Add mushrooms, including juice., Cover container with foil and bake 1 hour in 350° oven., Uncover and put a slice of cheese on each piece., Put back in oven until cheese melts.

title: Cocoa Fudge Brownies
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan., Stir flour and cocoa together; set aside., In saucepan, melt margarine and shortening., Mix in sugar, eggs and vanilla; stir until smooth. Blend in flour-cocoa mixture and nuts., Spread in greased pan. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes., Makes 2 dozen 2-inch bars.

title: Stove Top Meat Loaf
directions: Mix all ingredients together and shape in meat loaf shape. Brown top and bottom in frying pan (you can also make individual 1/4 pound loaves)., Add 1 can whole tomatoes with some chopped celery., Cover and simmer for 1 hour.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Cook and drain broccoli and put into buttered casserole dish. Slice Velveeta cheese over top of broccoli or slice enough to cover., Melt oleo and crush one tube of crackers., Mix crushed crackers into oleo and spread on top of casserole., Bake, uncovered, in 300° oven for 45 minutes.

title: Butter Finger Bars
directions: Blend above into coarse crumb mixture and press firmly into bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake 12 to 15 minutes at 350°.

title: Smothered Steak
directions: Cut meat into serving sizes., Sprinkle with salt and pepper to taste., Dip meat into 1/4 cup milk, then coat with flour, salt and pepper mixture., Brown meat on both sides in oil., Remove to shallow baking dish., Blend 2 tablespoons flour into oil in skillet., Stir in milk and soup., Pour this mixture over meat in baking dish., Bake, uncovered, 1 1/2 hours in 350° oven.

title: Easy Fudge
directions: Melt chocolate chips in microwave; add icing and nuts, pour into cake pan and refrigerate.

title: Lemon Squares
directions: Mix dry cake mix with 1 egg and 1/2 cup of oil (makes crunchy bottom layer)., Reserve 1 cup of this mixture and pat out in pan. Bake for 10 minutes at 350°., Remove from oven., Beat cream cheese, sugar, lemon and egg until light and soft., Spread this over baked layer and sprinkle with reserved mixture., Bake at 350° for another 15 minutes., Allow to cool, then cut into squares.

title: Simple Baked Crab
directions: Combine first 6 ingredients in a casserole., Mix bread crumbs and butter and sprinkle over top of casserole., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until browned., Serves 4.

title: Sugar Cookies
directions: Mix first 3 ingredients well., Stir in flour as long as you can stir., Put in tray and work just enough to handle soft dough. Roll real thin, cut and bake., Leave plenty of room between cookies.

title: Chafing Dish Meat Balls
directions: Simmer until brown., You may use a crock-pot and cook for several hours., Yields 5 to 6 dozen.

title: Fried Rice
directions: Cook 1 cup of dry rice in 2 cups of water., It's better if it stands a little and dries out a bit after cooking, so make the rice early in the day and let it stand then., In a heavy skillet, brown 4 or 5 slices of bacon until crisp., Remove the bacon and turn down the heat., Slightly beat 3 or 4 eggs and pour them in the hot bacon drippings (after removing the bacon)., Add the rice and 3 or 4 cut up green onions., Mix it all together., Add the bacon and if you have leftover pieces of pork, beef or ham, chop into small pieces. Last but not least, add soy sauce until the rice is as brown as you like it., Stir well and simmer on low heat, 15 to 20 minutes, then serve.

title: Vegetable Chip Dip
directions: Mix sour cream and cream, cheese., Add, the rest of the ingredients to taste.

title: Ham Bake
directions: Early in the day, take one pound of ground chuck out of freezer., Spend rest of day cleaning up messes, comforting sick little ones, doing laundry and soothing colicky baby., Thirty minutes before husband is due home, remember that you have a pound of thawed meat on kitchen counter that will ruin if you don't do something with it.

title: Greater Potato Casserole
directions: Thaw potatoes a little., Then mix all ingredients and bake at 375° for 45 minutes.

title: Strawberry Salad
directions: Mix all except sour cream., Pour half of mixture in pan and let congeal., Spread sour cream on this add remaining half of mixture and let congeal.

title: Chick Dip
directions: Drain and rinse chickpeas., Put everything into blender and blend on high until smooth., Makes a great dip for vegetables and chips or spread on rice cakes, Melba toast or pocket bread.

title: Beef Bourguignon
directions: Put all ingredients into crock-pot and cook 8 hours., Before serving, juice may be thickened with flour or cornstarch., Serve over rice or buttered cooked noodles.

title: Taco Salad Plate
directions: Spread cream cheese on 8 or 9-inch plate., Add rest of ingredients as listed one by one in layers on plate., Top with cheese., Eat with nacho chips.

title: Easy Chicken Dressing
directions: In a saucepan, pour in cream of chicken soup and water; cook until boiling. Add remaining ingredients. Put in a baking dish and bake for 20 minutes at 350°.

title: Banana Split Cake
directions: Melt 1 stick margarine and mix with the 2 cups graham cracker crumbs., Pat mixture firmly in the bottom of an 8 x 11 x 2-inch pan.

title: Cheese Ball
directions: In large mixing bowl, mix cream cheese and Cheddar cheese using fork., Add pepper, garlic salt, onion salt, chopped onions and parsley., Mix well., Shape into ball or small log., Roll in finely chopped pecans and sprinkle generously with paprika., Wrap in foil and store in refrigerator a day before using., Serve on crackers. Freezes well.

title: Easy Shrimp Casserole
directions: Combine all, ingredients, and bake 1 1/2 hours at 350°, covered., Serves 6 to 8.

title: Everyday Broccoli Cheese Chicken
directions: In skillet, over medium heat, heat chicken in margarine., Cook chicken 10 minutes or until brown on both sides., Stir in soup, water and pepper., Heat until boiling., Add in broccoli and reduce heat to low., Cover and simmer 10 minutes or until chicken and broccoli is fork-tender.

title: Brown Bread
directions: Boil raisins, and water for 4 minutes., Cool, add other ingredients., Mix well., Fill Number 2 cans half full. Bake at 300° for 45 minutes.

title: Three-Bean Salad
directions: Mix last 5 ingredients well., Add the rest of the ingredients and stir or toss to blend., Refrigerate for several hours before serving.

title: Potato Salad I
directions: In a large kettle, cook potatoes in boiling, salted water until tender., Drain and cool., Peel potatoes; cut into chunks. Separate egg yolks from whites., Set yolks aside., Chop whites and add to potatoes with onion., In a bowl, mash yolks., Stir in mayonnaise, milk, vinegar, dill relish, mustard, sugar, salt and pepper., Pour over potatoes; toss well., Garnish with hard-cooked egg slices and paprika.

title: Sugar Cookies
directions: Make balls., Dip in sugar and press with fork., Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
directions: In a 2-quart casserole, combine all the ingredients except for the croutons. Cook at Medium-high heat 9 to 10 minutes., Stir twice. Crumble croutons over chicken mixture to form a crust. Continue cooking 4 to 5 minutes.

title: Goleer'S Rolls
directions: Melt butter., Add milk and heat to lukewarm (105° and 115°). Place yeast in a bowl., Add milk mixture and stir until yeast is dissolved., Add salt, anise, fennel, cardamon (if used), syrup and rye flour., Mix., Add about 3/4 of all-purpose flour., Knead until dough is soft., Cover and let rise in warm place for 45 minutes. On lightly floured surface, knead dough until smooth and satin, adding flour as needed., Roll out to long roll and cut into 12 even pieces., Form pieces into oblong rolls., Place on lightly greased baking sheet., Let rise about 35 minutes., Bake at 450° for 15 to 18 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Dora'S Hungarian Cucumber Salad
directions: Pour over cucumbers., Mix and serve., Very good and low in calories.

title: Cheese Fondue(Serves 6)
directions: Rub garlic halves around a saucepan and discard., Pour wine and lemon juice into pan and place over low heat., When liquid is hot, add the cheese cubes and stir until they melt and mixture is blended., Add cornstarch mixture, pepper and cayenne., Cook, stirring constantly, for 2 minutes or until mixture thickens., Do not allow to boil., Stir in Kirsch and beat for 1 minute., Pour cheese mixture into fondue pot over low heat., Serve with bread cubes., Makes 6 servings.

title: Frank-Veggie Hot Pot
directions: Cut frankfurters into 1-inch pieces., Set aside., Heat to boiling, chicken broth and water in a heavy saucepan or Dutch oven., Add macaroni, basil, salt and black pepper., Return to boiling., Cook, uncovered, for 5 minutes., Stir in frankfurters, vegetables and onion., Simmer 5 minutes longer until macaroni is tender, vegetables are cooked and water is almost all absorbed. Fold in sour cream and mayonnaise., If used, garnish with chopped fresh green parsley, chives or green peppers before serving.

title: Bacon Potato Treats
directions: Arrange slices of potato in rectangular dish, this may require a couple of layers, depending on the size of potatoes., Cover dish with plastic wrap and microwave on High 4 minutes., Rotate and microwave another 4 minutes., When potatoes are cooked, top with grated onion., Sprinkle with jalapeno; add bacon and cheese. Season very well with salt and pepper., Microwave on High 2 minutes, uncovered., Serve.

title: Feather Light Pancakes
directions: Heat griddle to 400°., Mix all ingredients together in blender on high., Wipe small amount of salad oil over top of griddle. Pour batter onto griddle for pancake size desired., When bubbles occur, flip and brown., Makes 12 small or 8 large pancakes.

title: Myrtle School Cafeteria Peanut Butter Bars
directions: Mix all together., Put thin layer in pan., Cook until done. Cool. Frost.

title: 6 Week Bran Muffin
directions: Mix dry ingredients., Add wet ingredients., Mix well and store in refrigerator., Fill muffin tins 2/3 full., Bake at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Chocolate Fudge Pie
directions: Mix sugar, cocoa and salt., Mix well. Add melted butter., Mix well. Add eggs, vanilla and milk., Mix well., Bake at 400° for 10 minutes. Turn to 325° for 25 minutes.

title: Hot Wings
directions: In saucepan, melt butter., Add remaining ingredients., Let simmer 10 minutes., In large bowl add sauce to wings., You may preboil the wings or use wings frozen., Put in refrigerator for 2 to 3 hours., Cover baking sheet with aluminum foil., Bake 35 to 45 minutes at 375°.

title: Quick Fudge Frosting
directions: In a medium mixing bowl, stir together sugar and cocoa., Add margarine, water and vanilla., Beat with electric mixer on low speed until combined., Beat on medium speed for 1 minute more. Cool for 20 to 30 minutes or until spreading consistency.

title: Kahlua Pound Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients and pour into a greased and floured bundt pan., Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes., Check often with toothpick., If you don't add pecans, you don't have to flour pan.

title: Italian Casserole(Can Be Frozen; Easy To Make.)
directions: Cook and drain macaroni., Saute sausages, mushrooms and onion in skillet., Season with salt and pepper., Arrange layers of macaroni, sausages, mushrooms and onion in two-quart casserole dish., Top with cheese slices., Make second layer., Top with marinara sauce., Bake in a 375° oven about 30 minutes or until cheese melts., Serves 6.

title: Hamburger Stroganoff
directions: Brown onion and garlic in butter in large skillet., Add meat and brown., Add salt, pepper, flour and 1 can of soup., Heat for 5 minutes, covered., Add other can of soup and heat 10 minutes, covered., Stir in sour cream and mushrooms (optional) and heat through.

title: Peach Cobbler
directions: Mix sugar, flour and milk., Melt butter in saucepan and pour into 9 x 13-inch cake pan., Pour peaches with juice on top of butter in cake pan., Pour sugar, flour and milk mixture on top of peaches., Bake in 450° oven until golden brown., Different fruits can be used, as well as sweet potatoes, sugar and nutmeg., Eat warm or cooled, tastes great either way., Enjoy!

title: Green Tomato Mince Meat
directions: Combine all ingredients and cook slowly for three hours. Place in pint or quart jars.

title: Chicken Vegetable Soup
directions: Saute celery and onion in margarine until tender., (You can use broth instead of margarine to cut down on fat.) Add remaining ingredients, except peas., Simmer about 20 minutes until potatoes and carrot are tender., Add peas and heat through., Makes 6 servings.

title: Refrigerator Rolls
directions: Soften yeast in lukewarm water., Pour hot water over sugar and shortening; cool to lukewarm., Add 1/2 cup flour; mix thoroughly. Stir in softened yeast, half of remaining flour and egg; beat thoroughly., Add enough flour to form a soft dough., Turn out on lightly floured board; let rest 5 or 10 minutes., Knead until smooth and elastic., Place in greased bowl, turning once to grease top., Cover; let rise until double in bulk., Punch down; grease top., Cover with damp towel and refrigerate., When ready to bake, shape into rolls and place in a well-greased pan., Let rise until double., Bake at 425° for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Vegetable Beef Soup
directions: In a bowl, combine meat, nutmeg, pepper and salt., Shape meat into large patties and place on a rack., Broil 4 minutes on each side., Break patties into small pieces and place in a large saucepan., Add remaining ingredients., Simmer over low heat about 1 hour., Divide evenly., Yield: 4 servings.

title: Buffalo Bills Chili
directions: Brown the beef in your microwave on High (approximately 5 to 6 minutes)., In microwave safe dish, crumble beef and drain any fat. Add onion, green pepper, salt and pepper to taste, chili powder, crushed tomatoes, tomato paste and kidney beans and microwave on High for approximately 23 to 25 minutes., Dish into bowls and serve., Enjoy!

title: Cream Cheese Party Ball
directions: Combine all ingredients, except bacon, parsley or nuts; form into a ball., Roll in bacon, parsley or nuts., Refrigerate., Can also be used to fill cherry tomatoes.

title: Georgia Peach-Glazed Pork Roast
directions: Heat oven to 325°. Coat a roasting pan with cooking spray.

title: Apricot Steak
directions: Season steak accordingly., Dredge in flour. Brown in skillet. Add onions, 4 teaspoons flour and juice from canned apricots. Place in baking dish and bake at 350° for about 45 minutes. Thirty minutes into baking, put apricots on top of steak and return to oven.

title: Snickers Bars
directions: Layer in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Don't grease., Boil the sugar, milk and butter., Add the peanut butter, marshmallow cream and vanilla. Cover the peanuts., Melt the caramels and hot water. Melt the chocolate chips, peanut butter and butterscotch chips. Keep in refrigerator so chocolate doesn't stick to bottom of pan.

title: Hot Fudge Pudding Cake
directions: Mix buttermilk baking mix, 1/2 cup sugar and 3 tablespoons cocoa in greased 8-inch square baking dish., Stir in milk and vanilla until well blended., Sprinkle evenly with remaining 1/3 cup of cocoa and 1/2 cup sugar., Pour hot water evenly over top., Bake in preheated 350° oven for 40 minutes or until top is firm., Dust with confectioners sugar., Serve at once in dessert bowls with the sauce spooned over cake., Makes 6 servings., Good.

title: Low-Fat Lasagna
directions: Cook noodles; add olive oil to prevent them from sticking together., Brown ground beef, onion and bell pepper. Drain fat from meat by putting in a strainer and "washing" meat with hot tap water., Put meat back in skillet once drained and add mushrooms, sauce, oregano, salt and pepper., Spray large pan with Pam., Layer sauce first, noodles second, cottage cheese, then Mozzarella and/or Cheddar., Start over with sauce., Continue until pan is full.

title: Taco Crescent Pie
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., Brown ground beef in pan; drain., Stir in seasoning mix, water and olives; simmer 5 minutes., Separate crescent dough into 8 triangles., Place triangles in ungreased 9 or 10-inch pie pan; press over bottom and up sides to form a crust., Sprinkle 1 cup corn chips over bottom of crust., Spoon meat mixture over crust and crushed corn chips., Spread sour cream over meat mixture; cover with cheese., Sprinkle remaining chips over top., Bake 20 to 25 minutes until golden brown., If desired, serve in wedges topped with shredded lettuce and avocado slices. Refrigerate any leftovers., Makes 5 to 6 servings.

title: Quick And Easy Vegetable Soup
directions: Cook vegetables, potatoes and cabbage in three cups water until soft., Add tomato juice and canned beef., Simmer a short time to blend flavors.

title: Michigan Pasties
directions: Combine flour and salt., With pastry blender or 2 knives used scissor fashion, cut in lard until it resembles coarse crumbs. Add water and work until the dough can be handled and is not sticky. Wrap in wax paper and refrigerate. Frozen pie crusts can be substituted.

title: Gourmet Potatoes
directions: Mix first 5 ingredients with mixer., Place in buttered dish. Top with cheese. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Chocolate Chess Pie
directions: Mix milk, sugar and cocoa., Add vanilla and eggs; mix well. Add flour and butter., Mix well and pour into unbaked pie shell. Sprinkle nuts on top., Bake at 325° for 45 minutes.

title: Zucchini Bread
directions: Beat eggs., Add sugar and beat again. Add oil, vanilla and zucchini. Add dry ingredients and raisins or nuts., Pour into 2 well-greased and floured loaf bread pans or four 3 1/2 x 7 1/2-inch pans. Bake at 325° for 40 to 50 minutes., Test with toothpick to be sure it is done.

title: Six Week Muffins
directions: Mix dry ingredients, together. Add liquid mixture. Store batter in refrigerator up to 6 weeks., Make muffins as needed. Bake at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Jalapeno Potato Salad
directions: Steam potatoes until tender., Cool slightly and cut into large pieces., Transfer to a large serving bowl., Cook bacon very crisp and mince., Pour off all but 2 tablespoons bacon grease and return bacon to pan with onion., Cook about 1 minute, then stir in flour and sugar., Gradually mix in vinegar and water and stir over low heat until mixture thickens., Pour the sauce over the potatoes; sprinkle with parsley, celery seed and peppers., Serve warm or chilled.

title: Killers(Serves 30 To 50)
directions: Place sour cream in microwave to soften., Unwrap cream cheese and remove from aluminum foil wrapping and place in microwave to soften., Mix sour cream and cream cheese in a large bowl., Add in olives, jalapenos and garlic; mix well., Using a rubber scraper or similar instrument, spread some of the mixture onto a tortilla, leaving approximately 1-inch of the tortilla free from the mixture around the circumference of the tortilla., Starting at the bottom of the tortilla, fold the edge into the center of the tortilla; next, fold the opposite edge into the center of the tortilla., Now fold the top half of the tortilla onto the bottom half of the tortilla and press gently to make sure the filling is squeezed to, but not out of the ends of the tortilla shell; set aside., When finished with the tortillas, wrap tightly in plastic and place in refrigerator for several hours to stiffen (can be made a day in advance)., Before serving, slice folded tortillas on a bias into quarters., Arrange pieces on platter in a geometric design of your choice and garnish plate with thin strips of red, green and yellow bell peppers amongst the killers.

title: Corn Sticks
directions: Sift meal, flour, salt and soda 3 times., Add the milk and beaten egg yolk, melted margarine and lastly, beaten egg white. Pour small amount into piping hot, greased corn stick pans and bake in hot oven (425°) for 15 minutes., Serve hot and with a generous amount of margarine., Yields 8 to 10 sticks.

title: Pecan Glaze
directions: In a saucepan, combine sugar, tartar and water; stir as mixture heats until sugar dissolves., Wipe away any sugar crystals that may form on the side when dripped from a spoon., Using a long, sharp pin, dip pecan halves, one at a time, into glaze and place on a buttered dish., Work fast for glaze hardens rapidly. Dates, almonds, Brazil nuts, Malaga grapes, orange sections and even violets may be treated in this way.

title: Marshmallow Fudge
directions: Mix together sugar, evaporated milk, margarine and salt. Then bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring constantly. Remove mixture from heat and add remaining ingredients., Pour into buttered pan and chill.

title: Peanut Brittle
directions: Heat and stir sugar, syrup and 1 cup water in a heavy 3-quart saucepan until sugar dissolves., Cook over medium heat to soft ball stage (234°)., Add nuts and 1/2 teaspoon salt., Cook to hard crack stage (305°), stirring often., Remove from heat., Quickly stir in butter and soda., Pour at once onto 2 well-buttered 15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 1-inch pans, spreading with spatula., If desired, cool slightly and pull with forks to stretch., Break up when cold., Makes 1 1/2 pounds.

title: Hidden Valley Ranch Buffalo Wings
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Dip chicken in mixture of melted butter, pepper sauce and vinegar., Put in baking pan., Sprinkle with 1 package dry dressing mix., Sprinkle with paprika.

title: Orzo With Onions And Peppers
directions: Cook orzo until al dente., Melt butter; fry onion, pepper and frozen peppers., Sprinkle with soup mix powder., Mix with orzo.

title: Baked Peaches And Cream
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., Drain peaches, reserving 1/2 cup liquid. Arrange peaches, cut side up, in an 8 x 8 x 2-inch baking pan., Add reserved liquid., Combine sugar and cinnamon; sprinkle evenly over peaches.

title: Ambrosia
directions: Mix sugar with sour cream., Stir into other ingredients.

title: Hawaiian Bread
directions: Combine pineapple and coconut., Add beaten eggs and mix., Sift together the sugar, flour, salt and soda., Add to pineapple mixture., Pour into well-greased and floured pans., (Makes 2 large or 3 small pans.), Bake at 325° for 1 hour.

title: Million Dollar Pie
directions: Mix all ingredients together and pour into pie crusts., Top with Cool Whip., Place in refrigerator overnight or several hours. Makes 2 pies.

title: Peach Preserves
directions: Boil peaches, sugar and pineapple for 15 minutes., Remove from stove., Add jello and stir well and put in jars., Seal in hot water bath 10 minutes or turn jars upside down overnight.

title: Sausage Corn Bread Wheel
directions: Brown links in pan over low heat., Drain off drippings. Arrange in pinwheel on bottom of round pan., Sift together dry ingredients into medium sized bowl., Add egg, milk and drippings. Beat until smooth, about 1 minute., Do not overbeat., Pour over sausage links., Bake at 425° for 25 minutes., Invert on platter. Garnish with parsley and apple slices if desired., Serve with sausage gravy.

title: Savory Pot Roast
directions: Heat oil in large kettle, then brown meat on all sides., Spoon off fat., Stir in mushroom soup, onion soup mix and 1 cup water. Reduce heat to low., Cover and cook 2 hours., Add vegetables, cover and cook 45 minutes, or until vegetables are tender., Remove meat and vegetables., Stir together flour and remaining 1/4 cup water until smooth., Gradually stir into soup mixture and thicken, stirring constantly., Garnish with fresh parsley, if desired.

title: Apricot Jello Mold
directions: Dissolve the jello in the sugar and water., Add cream cheese, pineapple and baby food., Blend until smooth., Fold in Cool Whip. Pour into mold and refrigerate.

title: Blueberry Yum-Yum
directions: Combine blueberries, 1 cup sugar and 1/4 cup water in a medium saucepan., Cook over low heat until berries are soft, about 15 minutes., Combine cornstarch and 3 tablespoons water in a small mixing bowl., Stir well., Add cornstarch to blueberry mixture. Cook, stirring constantly, until thickened., Set aside to cool.

title: Honey Bread
directions: In a large mixing bowl, pour 1 1/2 cups of very hot water. Add salt, butter and honey; stir until melted., Dissolve yeast in 1 cup of warm water and then add to other ingredients., Add flour, mixing well after each cup is added., Dump dough onto a floured board and knead 10 minutes., Grease a large bowl with butter. Place dough into buttered bowl and turn once to coat entire surface of dough., Place wet cloth on top and allow to rise for 1 1/2 hours., Test dough by pressing with finger; when hole remains in dough, punch down., Turn onto work table., Divide into 4 parts. Place each into a greased loaf pan., Let rise again about 1 hour. Bake 45 minutes in a 350° oven.

title: Fruit Salad
directions: Mix all fruit together., Sprinkle instant pudding 1 box at a time., Chill before serving., If desired, use sugar-free puddings and lite fruit.

title: Japanese Fruit Pie
directions: Mix well., Pour into uncooked pie shell., Bake about 1/2 hour or until set in the middle at 350°.

title: Nut Cups
directions: Mix together., Roll into 24 balls the size of a quarter. Refrigerate until firm while preparing filling.

title: Cheddar Cheese Chowder
directions: In large pot, bring chicken stock to boil., Add vegetables. Cover and simmer 10 minutes, or until they are tender., Melt butter in saucepan., Blend in flour; cook 1 minute., Gradually add milk., Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until thickened., Add cheese; stir until melted., Stir cheese sauce into vegetables., Cook over low heat until thoroughly heated., Do not boil., Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Fruit Dip
directions: In medium size bowl, mix Marshmallow Creme and cream cheese with mixer until well blended., Put in refrigerator until cool.

title: Cherry Yum-Yum
directions: Melt margarine and add to crumbs and place on pie plate in dish, 11 x 8 or 12 x 9.

title: Sweet Sandwich Filling
directions: Combine sugar, egg and lemon in double boiler., Cook until thick., Allow to cool and add pecans, raisins and mayonnaise. Spread onto bread; makes 2 dozen sandwiches.

title: Baked Spareribs
directions: Bake ribs., Salt and pepper 1 1/4 hours, uncovered at 350°. Mix all other ingredients and pour over baked ribs and bake 1 hour more, uncovered., Serves 4.

title: Salmon With Lemon Mushroom Sauce
directions: Saute onion in heated butter until golden., Set aside., Drain salmon, pouring liquid into measuring cup., Add enough milk to liquid to make 1/2 cup., Mix together onion, salmon, liquid, bread crumbs, eggs, poultry seasoning, parsley, salt and nutmeg., Shape into 4 mounds and place in medium shallow baking dish., Mix together 1/2 cup milk, soup, lemon juice and paprika., Pour around salmon., Top each mound with 3 olive slices., Bake uncovered at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Spiced Muffinsfort Morgan, Colorado
directions: Mix all ingredients in usual manner., Put soda in hot applesauce to dissolve it and add to batter.

title: No Peek Casserole
directions: Add all ingredients into a Dutch oven with lid; mix., Cook, covered, in 300° oven for 3 hours., Do not peek! Serve on hot rice or noodles., May use sour cream, if desired.

title: Cole Slaw With Buttermilk Dressing
directions: Combine first 5 ingredients in a large bowl; toss well and set aside., Combine sugar and next 7 ingredients and stir well., Pour over cabbage mixture and toss gently., Cover and chill 1 hour. Serves 8.

title: Hush Puppies
directions: Place all ingredients in bowl and begin adding buttermilk until batter is stiff., Drop from spoon in hot cooking oil.

title: Cherry Salad
directions: Dissolve Jell-O in water, add pineapple and pie filling., Stir and congeal., Beat cream cheese until smooth., Gradually add sugar. Blend in sour cream., Spread over top congealed mixture., Top with nuts.

title: Fruit Bars
directions: Mix all together like pie dough., Put half on bottom (pressed down) on cookie sheet with sides., Add prepared apricot filling or other fruit., Enough to cover the dough, don't over do it., Put rest of dough on top., Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

title: Golden Potato Bake
directions: Heat, oven, to	375°., Mix, cornflake, crumbs and salt. Brush potatoes with margarine., Coat with crumbs., Arrange in ungreased baking pan., Bake until tender, 1 to 1 1/4 hours.

title: Broccoli And Rice Casserole
directions: Brown onion and celery in margarine., Combine all ingredients and bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

title: Banana Nut Bread
directions: Cream margarine, sugar and eggs well., Sift flour, soda and salt together., Add alternately to creamed mixture with mashed bananas., Mix well; add nuts and vanilla., Bake in greased loaf pan 1 hour at 350°., Before serving, cover with a layer of whipped cream and sprinkle some grated American cheese on top (optional).

title: Easy Baked Chicken
directions: Rinse chicken and pat dry., Arrange in a 9x13-inch baking dish., Mix together soup and sour cream., Spoon mixture over chicken., Drizzle water over chicken mixture in dish., Sprinkle with salt and pepper.

title: New West Chicken Salad
directions: Combine mayonnaise, ginger and salt., Stir in remaining ingredients., Cover and chill.

title: Italian Beef
directions: Mix all together and pour over roast in crock-pot., Cook all night for lunch, all day for dinner., While still in crock, take fork and shred apart, leaving in crock in gravy., Serve over rice, potatoes or makes great submarine sandwiches.

title: Spanish Rice
directions: Mix all ingredients, except sharp cheese., Cook in oven for 1 1/2 hours at 325°., Add sharp cheese; cook until melted.

title: Jackie'S Quiche
directions: Combine ingredients and pour into pie shells., Bake 40 to 45 minutes in 350° oven.

title: Three Cheese Dip
directions: Mix the first 4 ingredients together; sprinkle with Cheddar cheese., Microwave for 5 to 7 minutes.

title: Carrot Cake
directions: Set aside grated carrots, cherries and nuts., Combine dry ingredients and sift into a large bowl., Add oil, carrots and vanilla; stir by hand until well done, then beat for 3 minutes. Add nuts and cherries., Bake in greased and floured angel cake pan for 1 1/4 hours.

title: Moist Dressing
directions: Melt margarine., Cook onion and celery until tender., Mix with bread crumbs and cornbread crumbs., Add spices., Pour soup over mixture and mix all ingredients well., Pour enough chicken broth over mixture until desired moistness., Spread in pan and bake at 350° for 30 minutes or stuff in turkey and roast., Serves 12.

title: Nachos Grande
directions: Brown meat in large skillet; drain., Add taco sauce; simmer. Melt cheese with milk to make cheese sauce., Add more milk if needed for desired consistency.

title: Party Potatoes
directions: Peel potatoes and cut into quarters. Cover with water and bring to a boil. Boil for 20 minutes or until tender. Drain potatoes and mash with sour cream, cream cheese and chives. Grease large casserole dish, add potato mixture and sprinkle with grated cheese and paprika. Bake at 350 degrees for 35-40 minutes. Can be frozen before baking for up to 3 months.

title: Choc-Oat-Chips Cookies
directions: Heat oven to 375°., Beat margarine and sugars until creamy. Add eggs, milk and vanilla; beat well., Add flour, baking soda and salt; mix well., Stir in oats, chocolate morsels and nuts; mix well.

title: Jalapeno Cocktail Pie
directions: Sprinkle peppers on well-greased 9-inch square pan; cover with cheese., Pour eggs over cheese., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until firm., Cool and cut into 1-inch squares.

title: At-Home Cappuccino
directions: Combine all ingredients in covered shaker and shake until well blended., Pour in tall glass and relax!

title: Fresh Apple Cake
directions: Blend oil, eggs, sugar and vanilla flavoring., Sift together flour, soda, salt and cinnamon., Combine mixture., Fold in nuts and apples., Bake in a tube pan 1 hour and 20 minutes at 325°.

title: Elegant Zucchini
directions: Parboil the zucchini, carrots and onion., Place 1 1/2 cups of croutons in buttered baking dish., Save 1 1/2 cups for top., Mix chicken soup and sour cream., Add vegetables to the soup mixture. Pour over croutons and cover with rest of croutons., Drizzle melted oleo over all., Bake at 325° for 25 minutes or until golden brown., Wonderful!

title: Spicy Oatmeal Cookies(A Delicious Cookie That Many Don'T Believe Are Oatmeal)
directions: *Chop raisins and oatmeal together in food processor.

title: Microwave Fudge
directions: Pour morsels and milk into Pyrex dish and cook on High 3 to 4 minutes. Stir in vanilla and nuts., Let cool before cutting.

title: Hot Fudge Sauce
directions: Pour sugar, salt, cocoa and cornstarch in saucepan; mix well. Stir in hot water., Add vanilla., Cook over medium heat until thick; stir constantly., Add butter.

title: Raspberry Quick And Easy Salad
directions: Dissolve Jell-O in hot water., Stir in raspberries and applesauce., Gel., Put a layer of sour cream or nonfat yogurt on top before serving.

title: Wheat Salad
directions: In large bowl, mix together Cool Whip, pineapple and softened cream cheese., Sprinkle with pudding mix., Lastly stir in drained cooled wheat and mix well., Refrigerate.

title: Milwaukee German Toffee(To Make About 4 Pounds)
directions: Use heavy pot, like pressure cooker.

title: Taffy
directions: Butter an 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan., In a 2-quart saucepan, combine sugar, corn syrup, water, cornstarch, butter and salt., Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, to 256° on candy thermometer (above 200° on meat thermometer) or until firm., Remove from heat and add vanilla., Pour into pan., When cool enough, pull taffy until satiny and hard., Butter hands if taffy is sticky., Put into long strings., Cut into pieces and wrap., Serves 6.

title: Turkey Divan
directions: In a flat Pyrex dish, put a layer of broccoli and turkey. Prepare sauce by mixing remaining ingredients except bread crumbs and margarine., Pour sauce over broccoli and turkey., Top with bread crumbs and margarine., Make at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes. Can be made ahead and heated.

title: Cream Of Spinach Soup
directions: Drain spinach thoroughly; set aside., Saute onion in butter in a large saucepan until tender and add flour, stirring until smooth., Cook 1 minute, stirring constantly., Gradually add milk and stir in spinach, salt and pepper., Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until mixture is thickened and bubbly., Makes about 1 quart.

title: Italian Chicken
directions: Empty one envelope Shake 'n Bake into its plastic shaker bag. Add Parmesan cheese and oregano., Place chicken breasts in the bag, one at a time, and coat.

title: Zucchini Bread
directions: Beat eggs until fluffy. Add sugar, zucchini, vanilla, oil, salt, soda, powder and cinnamon. Add nuts, if desired., Pour into greased and floured pan. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Breakfast Pizza
directions: Cook sausage in a medium skillet until browned; drain and set aside., Separate crescent dough into 8 triangles; place triangles with elongated points toward center in a greased 12-inch pizza pan. Press bottom and sides to form a crust, seal perforations; sprinkle with hash brown potatoes, Cheddar cheese and sausage., Bake at 375° for 25 minutes., Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and bake an additional 5 minutes., Garnish with fresh oregano if desired.

title: Play Dough
directions: Mix dry ingredients together., Add oil, water and food color. Stir and knead until smooth., Fun for kids and grandmas., Store in covered, tight containers.

title: Cornbread Dressing
directions: Precook cornbread and cool., Precook 1 cup water, 1/2 stick butter, 1 chopped onion and 1/2 cup celery., In extra large pan, mix (by hand with a whisk) chicken, soups, eggs and seasonings. Add cornbread, milk and toast., Add precooked items while slightly warm., If dry, add another can of broth and milk. This makes two large casserole dishes. Cook at 350° until middle is firm., Time varies depending on size of dish., A clean knife test will work. This can also be prepared ahead of time and frozen.

title: Inferno Dip
directions: Mix all ingredients in a crock-pot., Stir often until the cheese is melted.

title: Cherry Jubilee
directions: For crust, add flour, sugar, pecans and melted oleo together and bake in 13 x 9-inch pan for 25 minutes at 350°., Let cool and crumble in same pan or one of equal size., Reserve 1/2 cup. Spread 2 cans of pie filling over crumbled crust.

title: Holiday Cheese Ball
directions: Beat together cream cheese, sugar and vanilla until smooth. Stir in 1/4 cup cereal, chocolate chips and raisins. Cover and chill several hours or overnight. Shape into ball. Roll into remaining cereal to coat. Serve with apple or pear wedges, unsalted crackers or graham crackers. Can make up to 3 days ahead.

title: Oven French Fries
directions: Combine Parmesan cheese and oregano and set aside., Cut each potato lengthwise into 8 wedges., Dip into egg white and dredge in Parmesan cheese mixture., Place fries on a baking sheet coated with vegetable cooking spray., Bake at 425° for 25 minutes., Makes 4 servings.

title: Fruit Dessert
directions: Wash and cut up strawberries., Mix oranges and pineapple with strawberries., Beat pudding, buttermilk and Cool Whip until thick. In large dish, layer fruit, then pudding., Top layer will be fruit.

title: Hawaiian Wedding Cake
directions: Prepare 1 box yellow cake mix as directed on the box., Bake in a 1 x 13 x 22-inch jelly roll pan for 25 minutes at 350°., Let cool., Mix the pudding, milk and cream cheese with a mixer., It will be thick., Fold in 9 ounces of Cool Whip., Place in refrigerator to set up a little., Place rest of ingredients of the cake in the following order: spread pudding mixture on the cake thickly, sprinkle well drained pineapple over pudding, sprinkle chopped pecans over the pineapple and sprinkle coconut on top. Place the cake in the refrigerator until ready to serve., You may freeze the cake for a later day., Just thaw and serve.

title: Cheese Danish
directions: Grease 11 x 13 Pyrex dish. Layer bottom of dish with 1 can rolls. Mix cream cheese, sugar, egg yolk and vanilla. Pour this mixture over rolls. Top with other can of rolls. Brush with egg white and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Snappy Barbecue Beef Sandwiches
directions: Place beef in a Dutch oven., Combine all ingredients except the rolls; pour over beef., Cover and bake at 350° for 5 hours, turning beef occasionally., Shred beef with a fork., Serve on rolls or buns., Yield:, About 24 servings.

title: Chicken Spaghetti
directions: Cook spaghetti and combine all ingredients, except part of cheese., Place in casserole dish and top with remaining cheese. Heat in 350° oven.

title: Rhubarb Jelly
directions: Cook rhubarb, sugar and water until tender., Remove from heat. Add jello., Put in hot jars and seal.

title: Chicken Divan
directions: Place broccoli in baking dish., Top with sliced chicken. Sprinkle with cheese., Combine chicken soup, mayonnaise, lemon juice and curry powder., Pour this over chicken and cheese. Sprinkle bread crumbs on top with additional cheese., Bake in a 350° oven for 30 minutes., Serve with yellow rice.

title: End Of Garden Relish
directions: Grind the first 6, ingredients and mix with 6 tablespoons of salt., Let stand for 20 minutes., Drain.

title: Breakfast Pizza
directions: Cook sausage until brown (skillet)., Drain excess fat. Separate crescent dough into 8 triangles., Place on a greased 12-inch pan with points toward center., Press bottom and sides to form a crust., Seal perforations., Spoon sausage over crust. Sprinkle with potatoes., Top with Cheddar cheese., In separate bowl, beat eggs, milk, salt and pepper., Pour into crust. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese., Bake at 375° for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Taco Soup
directions: Brown hamburger and onion together. Add remaining ingredients; mix well. Simmer for 1 hour.

title: Payday Cake
directions: Mix yellow cake mix, 1/3 cup oleo and 1 egg in 9 x 13-inch pan for 12 to 18 minutes at 350°., When baked and while still hot, put 3 cups mini-marshmallows on top., Then add following topping: heat corn syrup, 1/4 cup oleo, peanut butter chips and vanilla. Heat until smooth, stirring constantly., Then add rice crispies and salted peanuts., Spread over marshmallows., Tastes like a Payday candy bar.

title: Scalloped Salmon For Two
directions: Drain salmon, reserving liquid; remove skin and bones if desired., Flake salmon with fork., Dissolve bouillon in boiling water in a bowl., Add salmon liquid, milk, egg, parsley and onion; mix well., Add salmon, stuffing mix and cheese, mixing well. Place in 2 greased 10-ounce custard cups or casseroles., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes., Serve with vegetable sauce if desired. (Vegetable sauce can be found in the Soup, Salads and Sauces section of this cookbook.)

title: Chicken Stir-Fry
directions: In measuring cup, combine first 5 ingredients., Heat wok and add next 4 ingredients., Fry 3 minutes., Remove chicken., Add next 5 ingredients., Add sauce., Heat until it bubbles., Add chicken and serve over hot rice.

title: Pineapple Pie(Low Sugar)
directions: Combine pineapple, sour cream and pudding in bowl., Beat at medium speed until blended., Spoon mixture into crust., Top with whipped topping., Cover and chill at least 3 hours.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Cook broccoli until tender; drain., Mix together soup, egg, onion, cheese and salt and pepper., Pour over broccoli., Cover with bread crumbs., Pour on melted butter., Sprinkle with paprika., Bake at 350° for 1/2 hour.

title: Chicken Imperial
directions: About 1 1/2 hours before serving, in 1-quart saucepan, over high heat, heat all ingredients except chicken., Arrange chicken halves, skin side up, in large open roasting pan., Pour liquid mixture over chicken., Bake at 375° for approximately one hour, basting frequently with pan juices.

title: Quick Italian Quiche
directions: In a large bowl, beat eggs and then add all remaining ingredients., Mix thoroughly and pour into lightly greased glass baking dish (13 x 8-inch)., Bake in 350° oven for 25 to 30 minutes, or until set and lightly browned., Cut into squares., Serve hot or cold., Can be frozen and reheated.

title: Spaghetti Pie
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Lightly grease a 10-inch pie plate. Set aside.

title: Oatmeal Cake
directions: Mix the first 3 ingredients together and let stand a full 20 minutes., Combine the next 9 ingredients with oatmeal mixture. Bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan at 325° for 35 minutes., While cake is baking, combine butter, sugar, milk and vanilla., Combine in saucepan over medium heat., Beat until butter melts and sugar dissolves., Add 1 cup pecans and 1 cup coconut., Spread over cake. Put back into oven until coconut browns slightly.

title: Janis' Marinated Vegetables
directions: Combine all ingredients., Cover and marinate for 24 hours. Drain., Reserve some of liquid in the event some of vegetables are left over., Store in refrigerator in closed Tupperware container. Will keep for several weeks.

title: Chocolate Chip Brandy Balls
directions: In bowl, beat cream cheese, sugar, cream, brandy extract, salt, cinnamon and nutmeg until creamy., Stir in Toll House semi-sweet morsels., Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls onto cookie sheet; chill 5 minutes., Roll into balls and roll in the nuts., Makes 3 dozen balls.

title: How To Preserve Children
directions: Mix children with dogs and empty into field, stirring constantly., Sprinkle field with flowers., Pour brook gently over pebbles., Cover all with deep blue sky and bake in hot sun., When children are well browned, they may be removed and placed in bathtubs to cool.

title: Memories Chicken Salad (Caf Memories In Iuka)
directions: Boil chicken breasts until tender, then shred.	Mix chicken with remaining ingredients and serve with fruit on lettuce leaf and croissant.

title: Lemon Fluff
directions: Dissolve Jell-O and sugar in hot water; add lemon juice and rind., Chill until partly set., Whip canned milk until stiff, then add Jell-O., Pour into glass baking dish in which crumbs are on bottom., Put crumbs over top., Set in refrigerator overnight.

title: Crab Bites(Great Appetizer)
directions: Mix together., Serve on 6 split English muffins., Bake at 350° for 10 to 15 minutes., Slice like pizza., Serve hot.

title: Olive'S Omelet
directions: Layer bread cubes, sliced sausage and shredded cheese in a casserole., Beat eggs., Add milk and seasonings., Pour over casserole and refrigerate overnight., Bake one hour at 325°.

title: Banana Pudding
directions: Mix sugar, flour and sweet milk and add beaten egg yolks. Cook in a double boiler until thick. Pour over layer of bananas, then top with wafers. Brown at 400°.

title: Apple Crisp
directions: Place apples in 9 x 13-inch baking pan., Add enough water to cover apples., Mix first six ingredients to a crumbly stage. Sprinkle on top of apples., Bake in oven at 350° until browned.

title: Laine'S Carrot Cake
directions: Sift together the flour, sugar, baking soda and cinnamon. Add oil, then add the beaten eggs and the salt., Beat batter; it will be thick., Fold in chopped walnuts, carrots and raisins (optional)., Grease pan with margarine., Bake at 350° in a 13 x 9-inch pan for 45 minutes to 1 hour, or in a 10 x 4-inch pan for 40 minutes.

title: Rachel'S Sweet Muffins
directions: Heat oven to 400°., Grease bottom of muffin pan or use muffin paper cups., Beat egg., Stir in milk, oil and salt., Add egg., Add baking powder, flour and sugar., Mix together all ingredients. Batter should be lumpy., Pour batter into muffin pan or muffin cups., Bake about 20 to 25 minutes., Serve with your favorite beverage!

title: Sweet Potato Biscuits
directions: Combine sugar and flour., Add sweet potatoes, melted margarine and water., Mix well., If needed, add more water to make mixture moist., Roll into small biscuits., Bake at 400° until brown.

title: Mystery Drops
directions: Boil sugar and milk 3 minutes., Remove from heat., Stir in other ingredients., Stir until thickened., Drop on wax paper.

title: Chocolate Bread Pudding(Microwave)
directions: Melt butter with milk in microwave., Add dry ingredients; stir in beaten eggs., Pour over bread., Cook in microwave for 9 to 12 minutes.

title: Baked Corn
directions: Melt margarine in saucepan., Sprinkle in flour, gradually add milk and bring to a boil., Add corn, salt, pepper and sugar., Heat thoroughly; remove from heat and add beaten eggs., Pour into 2 1/2-quart buttered casserole dish., Bake at 375° for 35 minutes.

title: Italian Pizzaburgers
directions: Mix turkey, cereal, herbs and onions and form into 4 patties. On a nonstick pan sprayed with Pam, fry until browned., Sprinkle on the cheese., Cover and cook until the cheese is melted.

title: Potato Casserole
directions: Salt and pepper hash browns., Cream together the sour cream, butter, onion, milk and soup., Mix creamed mixture with potatoes and place in casserole. Top with grated cheese and corn flakes. Drizzle 1/4 cup melted butter over top. Bake 45 to 60 minutes at 350°.

title: Mexican Fruit Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients well., Pour into 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until done.

title: Skillet Cookies
directions: Melt oleo in an electric skillet. Add sugar, dates, and egg. Cover and cook over medium heat for 10 minutes, stirring constantly. Remove from heat, add cereal, nuts and vanilla. Form into balls and roll in coconut.

title: Cube Steak Casserole
directions: Place steak in large Pyrex dish., Layer onion, carrots and potatoes on top., Heat soup with margarine and pour over casserole., Cover and bake at 375° for 1 hour.

title: Honey Bars
directions: Cream the first 4 ingredients together., Then add all other ingredients., Grease 9 x 13-inch pan., Level the dough evenly with a spoon., Bake in 350° preheated oven for 30 minutes., Do not overbake., Bars are real chewy and moist.

title: Special Day Cake
directions: Mix the first 5 ingredients altogether; pat down in a 9 x 13-inch pan., Beat the eggs, powdered sugar and cream cheese together for 5 minutes., Pour the mixture over the first mixture in the pan., Bake at 300° for 1 hour., May add chocolate chips, if you wish.

title: Refrigerator Pickles
directions: Mix all ingredients in a large glass bowl., Put into jars with tight covers., Refrigerate for 2 weeks before using., These will keep for 2 years in the refrigerator., (A gallon sun tea jar works well if you have a glass one and enough room in the refrigerator.)

title: Jalapeno Hominy
directions: Melt cheese in soup and mix with hominy., Add onions and top with Fritos., Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

title: Corn Pone
directions: Mix cornmeal, bacon drippings, salt and green onions., Pour enough boiling water to stick mixture together without being too dry or mushy., Form into oval cakes and fry in bacon drippings in skillet, about 3 minutes on each side.

title: Spinach Dip
directions: Make day before., Serve in hollowed out French bread.

title: Sausage Egg Casserole
directions: Slice 2 of the eggs into 1 1/2 qt. casserole. In a sauce pan melt butter, blend in flour, 1/2 tsp. and dash pepper. Add milk all at once. Cook, stirring constantly until mixture thickens and bubbles. Cook sausage: drain. Stir sausage and corn into sauce, pour over eggs. Slice remaining eggs: arrange atop mixture. Sprinkle with bread crumbs. Bake at 375 degrees for 20-25 minutes.

title: Coffee Cake
directions: Mix in order., Let stand overnight., Put mixture in a 9 x 13-inch greased pan.

title: Tender Roast
directions: Put all ingredients into a 10 x 10 x 3-inch Corning baking dish., Add 1-inch of water., Cover with lid., Cook at 300° for 3 hours.

title: Carrot Cake
directions: Sift together flour, baking powder, soda, salt and cinnamon. Add sugar, oil and eggs (mix well)., Add carrots, drained pineapple and nuts., Turn into 8-inch layer pans (greased and floured)., Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes., Cool in pan, then turn out and cool on wire racks., Spread layer top and sides with Cream Cheese Frosting.

title: Flaky Pie Crust
directions: Sift flour, salt and baking powder together., Use fork to mix in shortening., Then add cold water and vinegar., Mix well., Makes 2 pie crusts.

title: Rosemary'S Pink Salad
directions: Mix together Cool Whip and sour cream., Add remaining ingredients., Refrigerate.

title: Pineapple Cake
directions: Mix cake as directions indicate on package., Bake for 25 to 30 minutes., Cool cake., Then mix cream cheese and milk together until cheese dissolves., Add instant pudding and mix until thickened., Pour this over cake., Next, pour drained pineapple on cake and top with Cool Whip., Sprinkle with nuts.

title: Pepperoni Salad
directions: Mix broccoli, onions, mushrooms, pepperoni and dressing., Let stand for 2 hours., Toss in lettuce and top or toss with cheese.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
directions: Pour this mixture in a casserole dish and top with topping. Use Pam in dish first.

title: Pecan Pie
directions: Mix all ingredients and pour into uncooked pie shell., Bake at 350°.

title: Chocolate Pie
directions: Mix dry ingredients. Combine with remaining ingredients. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until thick. Pour in baked pie shell.

title: Jalapeno Cornbread
directions: Preheat the oven to 350°., Grease a 9 x 13 baking pan., In a large bowl, mix jalapenos and creamed corn., Beat in the baking soda, salt, sugar, and eggs (beating well)., Add the buttermilk, oil, cheese, and cornmeal., Mix well., Pour the batter into the greased pan and bake for 35 minutes or until golden brown., Serve it hot with butter!

title: Linguini Salad
directions: Toss all ingredients together and refrigerate for several hours., May be served immediately, if preferred.

title: Lasagna
directions: Heat oil; add onion, garlic and beef., Lightly brown meat-stir occasionally., Add tomato paste, seasonings and tomatoes., Cover and cook over low heat approximately 1 hour. Stir occasionally., Alternate layers of cooked, drained lasagna, meat sauce, cottage cheese, Mozzarella slices, and Parmesan. Repeat and end with Parmesan., Bake in large Pyrex dish, approximately 13x9x2., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
directions: Combine sugar, salt and cornstarch with milk over hot water. Cook over water on low heat until slightly thickened, about 15 minutes., Beat egg yolks and add a little of hot milk mixture. Return to first mixture, stirring constantly.

title: Yeast Biscuits
directions: Dissolve yeast in warm water., Sift together dry ingredients; cut in shortening., Add yeast and buttermilk to dry ingredients. Knead enough to hold together., Roll out and cut with biscuit cutter., Bake at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes., Will keep uncooked in covered pans in refrigerator for 2 to 3 days., No need to let rise.

title: Escalloped Corn
directions: Pour egg into a 6-cup buttered casserole., Heat corn and milk; gradually stir into beaten egg., Add salt, breadcrumbs and cheese; mix thoroughly., Bake, uncovered, in a 325° oven for 30 minutes.

title: Freida'S Low Calorie Dessert
directions: Pour in cooled pie crust and top with low-fat Cool Whip.

title: Potato Cake
directions: Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy., Add beaten egg yolks., Continue to beat, adding milk and hot potatoes, sifted flour with baking powder and beaten egg whites., Bake., Makes 6 layers.

title: Chocolate Delight
directions: Combine flour, pecans and butter in bowl; mix well., Press into 9 x 13-inch baking dish., Bake at 350° for 15 minutes. Cool.

title: Banana Split Salad
directions: Mix banana pudding mix with crushed pineapple., Then add other ingredients, leaving the whipped topping to be added last. Refrigerate.

title: Sandra'S Crab Soup
directions: Boil crabs for 10 minutes., Turn heat off; let crabs soak in seasoned water for 20 to 30 minutes., Cool crabs and pick, saving "roe" if fortunate to have "she crabs.", (The more crabs, the better.)

title: Turtle Stew
directions: Scald the turtle with boiling water and the hard shell., Clean well with lime, then season with salt, black pepper and garlic. Sprinkle with capers and Worcestershire sauce and let stand for 1 to 2 hours., Chop onions, tomatoes and sweet pepper., Saute these ingredients in oil and butter., Add turtle and allow to brown, then pour on 2 cups of warm water and steam until tender., Quarter potatoes and add to stew., Let simmer until gravy thickens., Add sherry just before serving., Serve piping hot.

title: Baked Onions
directions: Layer in greased casserole onions, cheese and bread., In a separate bowl, mix egg, milk, salt and pepper., Pour mixture over the top., Cover., Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes., Serves 6.

title: Peanut Butter Cake
directions: Mix together margarine, water, peanut butter and oil in a large pan., Bring to boil., Take off heat and add remaining ingredients., Stir until well mixed., Pour into well-greased and floured pan (10 x 15-inches or 9 x 13-inches)., Bake for 20 to 30 minutes in 10 x 15-inch pan at 350°., Bake for 30 to 35 minutes in 9 x 13-inch pan at 350°.

title: B~B~Q Tomato
directions: Cut 1/2 way in the tomato in several spots. Wrap in aluminum foil. Cut butter and place in foil also. Wrap good and cook until tender.

title: Icebox Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Pour into tube pan., Put into icebox for 24 hours.

title: Butterfingers
directions: Mix thoroughly; shape dough into 2 1/2-inch logs and place on greased cookie sheet., Bake at 350° for 17 minutes., Roll in powdered sugar while still warm.

title: Aunt Fanny'S Baked Squash
directions: Wash and cut up squash., Boil until tender; drain thoroughly, then mash., Add all ingredients except 1/2 of butter to squash. Melt remaining butter., Pour mixture in baking dish, then spread melted butter over top and sprinkle with cracker meal or bread crumbs., Bake in 375° oven for approximately one hour or until brown on top.

title: Chop Suey
directions: Cut all vegetables into serving pieces, preferably diagonally and in uniform sizes., Cut all meats and shrimp in bite size pieces and set aside., Wash Chinese mushrooms and soak them in 1/2-cup warm water., Saute garlic and onions in hot oil until all are golden brown., Add sliced shrimp, chicken livers, previously cut up and the cooked pork., Season with soy sauce and salt and pepper. Pour in chicken stock., Allow to cook for about 5 minutes., Then add carrots, cauliflower, cabbage and Chinese mushroom with the 1/2 cup water it was soaked in., Allow to cook in an open pan., Add the rest of the vegetables., Cook until vegetables are cooked.

title: Banana-Apple Bread
directions: Cream shortening; gradually add sugar, beating well., Add eggs one at a time, beating after each addition., Stir in apple and bananas., Combine flour, soda and salt., Add to creamed mixture, stirring just enough to blend., Spoon batter into greased and floured pan., Bake for 1 hour., Cool in pan 10 minutes., Cool completely on wire rack.

title: Hot Dip
directions: Brown the meats; drain., Heat tomatoes and cheese together until cheese melts, then add this to the meat mixture., Add hot sauce to taste., Serve over tortilla chips.

title: Easy Mini Cheesecakes
directions: Mix crumb mixture as directed on package., Press onto bottoms of 12 paper-lined muffin cups., Prepare filling mix as directed on package., Spoon over crumb mixture., Refrigerate at least 1 hour or until ready to serve., Garnish as desired., Makes 12 servings.

title: Spaghetti Casserole
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Brown ground beef; drain., Mix spaghetti sauce, season and ground beef., Add a dash of oregano or to your taste; let simmer., Boil spaghetti until tender., Mix spaghetti sauce and spaghetti; take half and pour into casserole dish., Top with Mozzarella and Cheddar cheese., Add the rest of the mixture; top with Mozzarella cheese and Cheddar cheese., Place in the oven for 5 to 10 minutes, then serve.

title: Magic Cookie Bars
directions: Preheat oven to 350°. Place butter in a 13 x 9 inch pan, put in oven to melt butter. Remove from oven and sprinkle crumbs over butter, pressing down with a fork. Sprinkle coconut over crumbs, add a layer of chips and one of almonds. Drizzle condensed milk evenly over top. Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until golden brown. Cool before cutting.

title: Peanut Butter Balls
directions: Cream this together and add 1 box powdered sugar. Mix with oleo and peanut butter. Make into balls. Refrigerate for 1 to 2 hours.

title: Mama'S Tea Cakes *
directions: Cream sugar and oleo., Add egg and vanilla and beat well. Sift together soda and flour; add to first mixture., Drop by spoonfuls on cookie sheet., Bake at 350° until light brown.

title: Brunch Casserole
directions: Brown sausage and drain well., Grease a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan and line bottom of pan with crescent rolls, firmly pressing perforations to seal., Sprinkle sausage and Mozzarella cheese over dough., Combine eggs and milk and pour over sausage and cheese. Bake 25 minutes at 350°., Put Cheddar cheese on top and bake 10 minutes longer.

title: Chicken Salad
directions: Cook chicken until thoroughly done and falls off the bone., Do not chop or grind chicken., Just cut into bite size pieces. Amounts of mayonnaise, pickle cubes, salt and pepper will vary to suit the taste of the cook.

title: Mrs. Lombardi'S Meatballs
directions: Brown meatballs in olive oil., Remove., Saute onion and garlic in oil., Add meatballs., Pour on tomato sauce., Simmer in sauce about 3 hours., (Add 3 bay leaves.), Tremendous!

title: Peanut Brittle
directions: Bring Karo, sugar and water to a boil., Drop in peanuts., Cook until peanuts are done (they will pop and turn darker)., Put in soda, salt and vanilla., Pour on buttered plate; cool about 30 minutes and break.

title: Mexican Velveeta Cheese Dip
directions: Saute onion, chili and shortening., Add tomato juice and garlic salt., Mix all ingredients into melted cheese., If too thick, add more tomato juice., Serve hot with corn chips.

title: Bubble Bread
directions: Thaw loaves of bread., Place in greased pan (9 x 13-inch) in small chunks., Mix remaining ingredients., Pour over bread., Let rise for 30 minutes., Bake 30 minutes at 350°., Turn out on wax paper while hot.

title: Ritz Dessert
directions: Press into a 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Fried Zucchini
directions: Heat oil in a skillet., Mix all ingredients together., Drop by tablespoon into skillet. Fry until golden brown, approximately 1 minute on each side., Serves 5 to 8.

title: Cream Cheese Frosting
directions: Beat cream cheese, milk and vanilla in medium bowl on low speed until smooth., Gradually beat in powdered sugar, 1 cup at a time, until smooth and of spreading consistency., Frosts a 13 x 9-inch or fills and frosts two 8 or 9-inch cake layers. Refrigerate any remaining frosting.

title: Oatmeal Drops
directions: Heat oven to 375°., Combine flour, baking powder, cinnamon, nutmeg and salt., Cream butter and sugar., Beat in eggs until light and fluffy., Add flour mixture alternately with milk., Beat well after each addition., Stir in oats, raisins and nuts., Mix well., Drop by heaping teaspoonfuls onto ungreased baking sheet. Bake 12 to 15 minutes., Cool on wire rack., Makes about 5 dozen.

title: Easy Pork Chops
directions: Brown pork chops, leaving drippings in pan., Add both soups and let simmer for 30 minutes., Serve with any rice or potato.

title: Sweet And Sour Cukes And Onions
directions: Peel, cucumbers, and slice very thin., Place in a glass bowl. Peel, onion;, slice, very thin and separate into rings. Add to bowl with the cucumbers., Add sugar, water, vinegar and vegetable oil., Add salt and pepper to taste., Add dill weed. Stir, and let stand at room temperature at least 1 hour before serving.

title: Tequila Berry Salad
directions: Combine all ingredients. Serve on shredded lettuce.

title: Shrimp And Rice Rockefeller
directions: Cook onions in butter until tender, but not browned., Add shrimp and cook until shrimp are just pink, about 2 minutes., Stir in soup, Swiss cheese and sherry; heat until soup is warm., Add rice, water chestnuts, spinach, lemon juice and 2 tablespoons Parmesan cheese., Season to taste., Turn into greased shallow (2-quart) casserole., Sprinkle with remaining Parmesan cheese. Bake, uncovered, 25 to 30 minutes or until hot in a 350° oven. Serves 8.

title: Boston Baked Beans
directions: Soak beans overnight. Drain water off in morning., Add fresh water and boil gently about 1/2 hour. Drain. Cut salt pork into 4 pieces. Add beans, salt and remaining ingredients to bean pot. Cover. Cook all day at 300° (at least 8 hours for best results). Add water if necessary., Great for a picnic!, Freezes well.

title: Creamy Banana Pudding
directions: In large bowl, combine sweetened condensed milk and water. Add pudding mix; beat well., Chill 5 minutes., Fold in Cool Whip. Spoon 1 cup pudding mixture into a 2 1/2-quart glass serving bowl. Top with 1/3 each of the wafers, bananas and pudding., Repeat layering twice, ending with pudding., Chill thoroughly., Garnish as desired., Refrigerate.

title: Fried Rice
directions: Bring water to a boil., Stir in rice., When rice is cooked, remove from heat and let stand 5 minutes.

title: Canned Venison
directions: Pack jars with raw meat to 1/2 inch from top., Add 1/2 teaspoon salt to a quart jar., Add no liquid., Process in pressure canner for 90 minutes (70 minutes for pint jars)., Or, cook in a hot water bath for 3 1/2 hours.

title: Crab Pie
directions: Beat eggs, crush onion rings., Combine all ingredients and pour into pie shell., Bake at 325° for about 20 minutes until brown.

title: Spanish Slaw
directions: In a bowl, combine cabbage and green pepper. In a jar with tight-fitting lid, combine remaining ingredients; shake well. Pour over cabbage mixture just before serving; toss to coat. Serve with a slotted spoon. Yield: 6 servings.

title: Tori Age(Fried Chicken - Japanese-Style)
directions: Mix all ingredients thoroughly., Let stand at least 2 to 3 hours., Deep fry at 350°., Serve with mustard/shoyu sauce, if desired.

title: Good For You, Chicken
directions: Dip chicken breasts in, mixture, of, egg and milk, then shake in bag with herb, mix., Place, oil in large flat pan and place chicken, skin side down., Bake, in, a, 400°, oven for 30 minutes, then turn chicken over for 15 minutes more.

title: Strawberry Cake Dessert
directions: Grease bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan and sprinkle marshmallows on the bottom., Combine strawberries and gelatin and set aside (use the syrup and don't add water to the gelatin).

title: Spiced Apple Spread(Using Sure-Jell Light)
directions: Combine, pectin, with 1/4 cup of the sugar., Mix applesauce and spices in large bowl., Add pectin mixture gradually to, fruit, stirring, vigorously., Set, aside, for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally., Stir, remaining, sugar gradually into fruit mixture until sugar is dissolved, about 3 minutes., Pour into plastic containers; cover., Let stand at room temperature 24, hours. Spread is now ready to use., Store in refrigerator up, to, 3 weeks or freeze extra containers up to 1 year., Thaw in refrigerator. Makes about 5 (1 cup) containers.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Mix together, and, bake, at, 350°, for 1 hour., You can saute the onion and celery in the butter if you like, first.

title: Holiday Cranberry Punch
directions: Mix all together and serve.

title: Sweet Potato Sausage Ball
directions: Combine all ingredients well. Roll into balls and place on greased sheet pan., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

title: Fantastic Squash Casserole
directions: *Dried minced green onion can be used as a substitute.

title: Hot Fudge Sauce
directions: Heat first 4 ingredients in saucepan until well mixed., Add milk, vanilla and salt., Cook until thick., Serve over ice cream.

title: Tomato Soup Cake
directions: Mix sugar, eggs and shortening., Add dry ingredients alternately with tomato soup.

title: Polish Raisin-Walnut Puffs
directions: In a medium sized saucepan, bring raisins, water and butter to a boil., Stir in cornstarch mixture and cook, stirring constantly, until thick., Remove from heat and stir in walnuts, lemon peel, juice and vanilla., Cool completely., Thaw puff pastry for 20 minutes and unfold., On a lightly floured surface, roll each sheet to a 9 x 15-inch rectangle, then cut into 3-inch squares., Put about 2 teaspoons of filling in the center of each square; moisten corners of pastry with water and bring together to make a four cornered puff., Press firmly to seal., Bake on a cookie sheet in a preheated 400° oven for 12 to 15 minutes until golden., Unbaked puffs may be wrapped tightly in plastic wrap and frozen until ready to bake., Makes 30 puffs.

title: Easy Peach Cobbler
directions: Combine all ingredients except peaches in baking dish., Lay peaches on top., Bake for 35 to 40 minutes at 350°.

title: White Bread
directions: Mix 2 cups water, 2 packages yeast and 2 tablespoons sugar. Let mix double. Add 2 cups very warm water, salt and oil; add flour until stiff and knead., Put in greased pan and raise., Bake at 400° until brown.

title: Stew
directions: Cook ingredients until tender., Tiny shell macaroni, 1/2 package., Add not too long before other ingredients are done.

title: Calizonas
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Place frozen bread in bread pans and let thaw., Do not let rise, just thaw., Scramble sausage in a skillet until browned., Shred cheese(s)., Pinch bread into 3 to 4 separate sections (each loaf)., Butter hands and press flat and stretch dough until about 6 inches across., Add sausage 4 to 5 tablespoons each on pressed dough., Add cheese about 1/3 cup each., Fold over to make a pastry like fold., Bake on a cookie sheet for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Family-Styled Short Ribs
directions: Brown short ribs on all sides in oil., Pour off drippings. Season with salt and pepper., Add water, bouillon, vinegar, Worcestershire sauce and the onion slices., Cover tightly and cook slowly for 2 hours or until meat is fork-tender., Pour out cooking liquid to measure 1 1/2 cups., Use water if needed., Thicken the liquid for gravy., Serve with mashed potatoes.

title: Frozen Chocolate Delight(Good Summer Dessert)
directions: Combine first 2 ingredients in top of a double boiler., Bring water to a boil., Reduce heat to low., Cook until chocolate is melted., Remove from heat; set aside to cool.

title: Spinach Salad Dressing
directions: Mix all ingredients together and serve on spinach salad.

title: Mrs. Field'S Cookies
directions: Cream together butter, sugar and brown sugar., Add eggs and vanilla., Put oatmeal into blender in small amounts and blend until it turns to powder., Measure first and then blend., Mix all dry ingredients together and then mix with sugar mixture., Add chocolate chips, Hershey bar and nuts., Make golf ball sized cookies and place on cookie sheet 2 inches apart., Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 375° for 6 minutes., Makes 112 cookies.

title: Old-Fashioned Sweet Potato Pie *
directions: Boil sweet potatoes, peel and mash, then add margarine, syrup, white sugar, flour and seasoning., Bake in 9-inch crust., Cook at 350° for 35 minutes.

title: Vanilla-Butter And Nut Pound Cake
directions: Cream Crisco, margarine, sugar and salt for 7 minutes. Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each., Add flour and milk alternately, beginning and ending with flour. Fold in flavoring. Bake in greased and floured tube pan for 1 hour and 45 minutes at 325°., Start in COLD oven and do not open door while baking., Cool on rack and sprinkle with powdered sugar.

title: Cheese-Spinach Soup
directions: In 3-quart saucepan, cook onion and celery in butter until onion is tender., Stir in flour, salt and pepper., Add milk all at once., Cook and stir until thickened., Stir in spinach and cheese. Cook and stir until cheese is melted.

title: Pineapple Sheet Cake(Easy And Good For Potlucks!)
directions: Grease and flour cookie sheet pan., Mix all together and pour into pan. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Spinach Balls
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Beat eggs lightly in large bowl., Add remaining ingredients and blend well., Roll into walnut sized balls., Transfer to baking sheet., Bake until golden, about 20 minutes., Serve hot.

title: Mother'S Mexican Casserole
directions: Brown hamburger., Layer bottom of casserole dish with tortilla strips, hamburger meat, tomatoes, beans, onion and cheese., Mix soups together with small amount of water and spread over top of casserole., Begin layering again and end up with cheese on top. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or microwave on High for 10 minutes.

title: Mom'S Barbecue Buns
directions: In a, large bowl, thoroughly mix 2 cups flour, dry milk solids, sugar, salt and undissolved yeast., Add margarine.

title: Chocolate Syrup For Drinks
directions: Boil sugar and water 5 minutes., Add chocolate, salt and the cornstarch dissolved in cold water., Stir until smooth., Cook 3 minutes., Cool., Add vanilla., Store in a jar in refrigerator.

title: Key Lime Pie
directions: Thoroughly mix the gelatin, sugar and salt in a saucepan. Beat together the egg yolks, lime juice and water; stir into the gelatin mixture. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, just until the mixture comes to a boil., Remove from the heat; stir in the grated peel., Add the food coloring sparingly to give a pale green color., Chill, stirring occasionally, until mixture mounds slightly when dropped from spoon. Beat the egg whites until soft peaks form; gradually add 1/2 cup sugar, beating to stiff peaks. Fold the gelatin mixture into the egg whites; fold the whipped cream., Pile into the pastry shell., Chill until firm., Spread with additional whipped cream and edge with grated lime.

title: Country Cookies
directions: In the large bowl of an electric mixer, cream shortening, granulated sugar and brown sugar., Add eggs and vanilla; beat until blended., Add flour., Sprinkle baking soda and salt over top., Beat until no traces of flour can be seen., With a wooden spoon, work in oats and coconut.

title: Peanut Butter Cake
directions: Sift flour, sugar, baking powder and salt in a big bowl., Add shortening, peanut butter, milk and vanilla., Beat well., Add eggs and beat again., Bake in 2 (9-inch) pans at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes or until done.

title: Mother Ruth'S Pimiento Cheese
directions: Blend in mixer, blender or food processor. Add salt, pepper, hot sauce and garlic powder to taste. Fix a day ahead and keep in sealed container. Will keep for 2 to 3 weeks in refrigerator. Makes 1 1/2 pounds.

title: Easy Baked Crock Pot Beans
directions: Brown meat, green peppers and onions. Combine all ingredients in slow cooker for 4 to 6 hours on low.

title: Broccoli Salad
directions: Cut flowerettes from broccoli., Layer broccoli, raisins, onion, bacon and water chestnuts in bowl. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over salad., Refrigerate overnight.

title: Stain Glass Candy
directions: Heat first three ingredients to 290° with a candy thermometer. Remove from heat. Quickly add flavoring oil and food coloring. Pour onto cookie sheet that has been covered with aluminum foil. Let harden. Peel foil off. Hold one end up with one hand and break candy into small pieces with back of a spoon. Be sure to store in an air tight container.

title: Marinated Carrots
directions: Cook carrots until tender; cool., Combine all ingredients. Marinate at least 12 hours., Drain.

title: Broccoli-Beef Pie
directions: Brown beef and onion., Drain off fat., Stir in flour, salt and garlic., Add milk and softened cream cheese., Cook and stir until bubbly., Add moderate amount of hot mixture to beaten egg. Return to mixture in skillet., Cook until thickened, 1 to 2 minutes., Stir in broccoli., Set aside.

title: Easy Banana Nut Bread
directions: Cream shortening and sugar in mixer bowl until light., Beat in eggs, one at a time., Combine flour, baking soda and salt in large bowl., Add to shortening mixture alternately with bananas, mixing well after each addition., Stir in nuts., Spoon into greased 5 x 9-inch loaf pan., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until brown., Cool in pan for 15 minutes., Remove to wire rack to cool completely.

title: Jiffy Oatmeal Bread
directions: Lightly grease 2 loaf pans., Put salt, molasses, oil and oats in a large bowl., Add boiling water., When the mixture is lukewarm, add eggs and yeast; let stand until yeast is dissolved, then add flour., Stir and let stand 20 minutes (no kneading)., Turn out on floured board; knead and cut into 4 equal parts., Put 2 parts in each bread pan., Let rise until doubled in bulk., Bake at 375° for 1 hour.

title: Skillet Hamburger Pie
directions: In skillet, cook beef, celery and onion until meat is browned and vegetables are crisp and tender., Stir in Worcestershire sauce, salt, beans, gravy mix and 1 cup water., Simmer to thicken and blend flavors., Whip potatoes according to directions., Spoon in mounds over meat., Top with paprika and shredded cheese. Cover., Heat until cheese melts., Serves 6.

title: Macaroni-Cheese Salad
directions: Add all ingredients to the macaroni., Serves 6.

title: Microwave Chili Con Queso Dip
directions: Place all of the ingredients in a microwave-safe bowl and microwave on High power for 1 minute., Stir and microwave for 1 additional minute., Serve immediately with tortilla chips.

title: Chocolate Filled Eggs(Easter Treat)
directions: One egg at a time, use a pin or the tip of a sharp knife to make a small hole in the top of each egg and a larger hole in the bottom (3/8-inch)., (Hold egg over bowl.), Blow the egg white and yolk into the bowl (can be used for cooking)., Carefully fill the egg with water and blow it out again., Rinse repeatedly to remove all traces of egg., Let the eggs drain and dry (an old egg carton is good for this) in a warm place for several days., Melt the chocolate over very low heat, stirring constantly, to 125°., When completely melted, remove from heat and stir constantly while cooling until a dab placed just above your lip feels cool., Pour chocolate into hollow eggs., Let cool., Makes a great Easter surprise.

title: Pasta With Cauliflower
directions: First, brown bread crumbs in a nonstick frying pan over medium heat., Stir constantly; pour into a bowl., Set aside for later use., Clean cauliflower., Cut into small flowerets., Cover bottom of 4-quart pot with olive oil., Add garlic and cauliflower. Season to taste with salt and pepper., Cook, covered, over medium heat 10 to 15 minutes., Stir often., Add chicken broth., Turn heat to high; bring to a boil., Lower heat and simmer 10 minutes.

title: Snack Crackers
