directions: Mix crackers and oil until well coated., Add remaining ingredients and mix well., Store in Ziploc bag and enjoy.

title: Orange Sherbet Salad
directions: Dissolve jello in hot water., Add sherbet., Allow to cool and thicken., When mixture is thick, add pineapple, oranges and bananas. Fold in whipped cream., Let set several hours or overnight.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
directions: Melt butter; stir in sugar., Cook and stir over low heat for 2 minutes., Add milk; bring to a boil., Cool to room temperature. Beat in powdered sugar until like fudge., Stir in nuts; pour in buttered 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan., Chill until firm.

title: Cheese Ball
directions: Grate cheese in blender., Mix all ingredients together and form into a ball., Roll in chopped nuts., Wrap and refrigerate to set. Better overnight.

title: Fruit Punch
directions: In large punch bowl, combine sugar and water., Stir until sugar is dissolved., Add lemon juice, orange juice, pineapple juice, grape juice, tea and grapefruit juices., Mix well (chill thoroughly)., At serving time, stir in ginger ale and garnish with orange slices studded with whole cloves, lemon slices and cherries.

title: Coconut Pie
directions: Preheat oven to 375°. Mix all ingredients and pour into pie shells. Bake 30 minutes or until light brown.

title: Bean-Pea Salad
directions: Drain canned vegetables well., Add to chopped vegetables., Set aside., In small saucepan, bring vinegar, oil, and sugar to a boil. Pour over vegetables., Mix well., Refrigerate overnight before serving.

title: Nacho Dip
directions: Cut the Velveeta into 5 blocks., Place in crock-pot on high. Add jar of salsa., Stir frequently until all cheese is melted. Reduce heat to low and continue to stir occasionally., Serve with nacho chips.

title: Sudden Russian Tea
directions: Mix well., Use 2 teaspoonfuls of mixture to one cup boiling water for each cup of this tea.

title: Hot Potato Salad
directions: Cook bacon crisp. Add onion and seasonings to bacon grease. Simmer for a few minutes. Add potatoes and crumble bacon on top. Serve hot.

title: Sugar Cookies
directions: Blend together first 3 ingredients., Then mix in lard like pie dough., Add eggs, vanilla or lemon flavoring and buttermilk with soda. Roll out and cut.

title: Spinach Souffle Pie
directions: Do not prick the pastry shell before baking., Partially bake the pastry shell in a 450° oven for 5 minutes; remove from oven and cool on rack.

title: Pumpkin Cheesecake
directions: Preheat oven to 400°., Cream margarine and sugar, blend in eggs., Add flour; mix well., Spread on bottom and 2 inches high around sides of 9-inch cheesecake spring-form pan., Bake at 400° for 5 minutes., Reduce oven to 350°.

title: Ground Meat Casserole
directions: Brown meat and season with salt, pepper and garlic powder. Add onion and green pepper., Simmer 30 minutes and then drain off any excess grease., Next, add tomato and mushroom soup., Simmer for 10 minutes., Cook macaroni and drain., Add macaroni and beans with meat mixture in casserole dish., Top with grated cheese and place in oven at 350° for about 15 minutes or until cheese melts. Serves 8.

title: Good Corn Relish
directions: Combine all ingredients; bring to a boil and simmer 10 minutes., Thicken with 1/4 cup cornstarch, dissolved in 1/2 cup water., Bring to boil again., Seal in jars, 6 or 7 pints., I make this at Christmas time and use it for gifts.

title: Chicken Broccoli Casserole
directions: Cook broccoli in water in a covered saucepan or microwave until crisp-tender; drain. Place broccoli in a greased 11 x 7 x 2-inch (2-quart) baking dish; set aside. Combine chicken, soup, mayonnaise, Parmesan cheese and curry powder; spoon over broccoli. Top with bread cubes and butter. Bake chicken casserole, uncovered, at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes or until heated through. Chicken casserole serves 4.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
directions: Boil on low heat until soft ball forms in cold water., Beat until smooth., Pour into pan and let cool., Cut into very small pieces., Candy is very rich.

title: Orange Balls
directions: Mix all ingredients, except coconut. Form into balls and roll in coconut.

title: Drum Stick Cake
directions: Mix first 3 ingredients and press into 9 x 13 glass pan. Spread ice cream over Cocoa Krispie mixture., Spread hot fudge over ice cream., Sprinkle peanuts on last., Freeze overnight. Serve frozen.

title: Dump Cake
directions: Pour cherries and pineapple in cake pan., Stir in coconut. Pour cake mix on top of mixture., Slice butter in pats and place on top of cake., Bake at 350° for about 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Sarah'S Strawberry Jello
directions: Mix first 5 ingredients., Chill 1/2 of this mixture., Spread sour cream over chilled Jell-O., Top with rest of the Jell-O mixture., Chill and cut to serve., Serves 15.

title: Cauliflower With Cheese
directions: Microwave whole cauliflower in a covered casserole dish for 10 minutes. Mix together the mayonnaise, grated cheese and mustard in a small bowl., Pour on cauliflower and microwave on High for 3 minutes, uncovered.

title: Salad Dressing Chocolate Cake
directions: Beat all ingredients, mixing well., Bake in moderate (350°) oven for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Pumpkin Bread
directions: Mix well and put into a loaf pan., Bake at 325° for 1 hour or more.

title: Corn Pudding
directions: Mix all together., Pour into buttered casserole., Bake at 300° for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Hot Ham And Cauliflower
directions: Cook cauliflower and/or broccoli in a small amount of boiling salted water., Cover until crisp-tender. Drain well. Remove from pan., Melt 1/4 cup margarine in the same pan., Stir in flour. Add milk all at once., Cook and stir until mixture is very thick and begins to bubble., Add cheese and sour cream., Cook and stir over low heat until cheese is melted. Stir in ham, mushrooms and cooked vegetables., Turn in a 2-quart casserole pan. Combine bread crumbs and 1 tablespoon melted margarine or butter., Sprinkle atop casserole., Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 40 minutes., Makes 6 servings.

title: Sand Tarts
directions: Cream butter and sugar., Add vanilla and egg., Mix dry ingredients and add to creamed mixture., Chill dough., Roll very thin on floured surface and cut out with favorite cookie cutters. Decorate, if desired., Bake at 325° for 10 minutes.

title: Salmon Puffs
directions: Combine ingredients., Drop by tablespoonfuls into hot fat, about 3/4-inch deep., Turn each puff when brown on one side, 3 to 5 minutes required., (These may also be fried in deep fat.)

title: Dearing Street Casserole
directions: In a large saucepan, saute celery, onions, green pepper and mushrooms in butter. Combine with rice, shrimp, crab and mushroom soup. Add salt and pepper. Pour into a buttered baking dish, sprinkle with cheese and bread crumbs. Place baking dish in a larger pan of water and bake at 350° about 1 hour.

title: Buttercream Frosting
directions: Cream together Crisco, margarine and vanilla., Add sugar and milk (1 spoon at a time) until desired consistency.

title: Irish Creme
directions: Blend all ingredients in blender., Chill overnight and enjoy.

title: Cream Tacos
directions: Brown meat and drain., Mix next 3 ingredients for chili., In separate pan melt cheese, then add cream., Then add to chili. Serve over Doritos., Top the taco (chili sauce) with shredded lettuce and chopped tomatoes., Top salad with Thousand Island dressing.

title: Pesto Sauce
directions: Puree basil, nuts and garlic., Mix in cheese., Add oil while machine is running., Toss into any textured pasta., Sprinkle top with cheese if desired or extra nuts.

title: Homemade Noodles
directions: Beat eggs slightly., Add salt and flour., Blend thoroughly. Knead dough in 2 balls., Roll balls paper thin into 16-inch circles., Roll up like jelly rolls., Cut with sharp knife or piece of thread in 1/4-inch strips., Unwind strips and store in airtight container until ready to use., Drop into boiling soup; allow to cook for 2 minutes before serving soup.

title: Spinach Dip
directions: Mix together and chill., Serve with King's Hawaiian bread.

title: Pecan Pie (1)
directions: Beat eggs lightly, mix all ingredients well., Bake at 325°F for about 45 min., Put foil over top if crust gets too dark.

title: John Wayne Beans
directions: Cook bacon until almost done., Add pepper and onion., Cook until soft., Add ground beef; cook until done., Add green chilies, tomatoes, soup and beans., Just before serving stir in grated Cheddar cheese., Add German Polish sausage when you add the beans.

title: Butternut Squash
directions: Wash squash and cut in half, lengthwise., Remove seeds and string fiber., Sprinkle with salt., Dot with butter., Add one tablespoon of honey or syrup to each half squash., Place in a baking pan in oven at 375°., Bake until tender about 45 minutes. Baste occasionally with the butter-honey mixture., After squash has browned, which will take 30 minutes, add a little water to the pan. Cover for remainder of baking period.

title: Divinity
directions: Boil sugar, water and Karo until it spins a thread., Beat egg whites., Pour half of syrup mixture over whites and beat at medium speed., Cook other half of syrup until hard-ball stage (250° to 266° on candy thermometer)., Add to the egg white mixture and beat by hand until stiff., Add vanilla (and nuts if desired). Put by teaspoon onto waxed paper.

title: Ham-And-Cheese Pie
directions: Unroll crescent rolls, separate into 8 triangles. Fit triangles into a 9-inch pie plate, pressing edges together to seal. Combine chopped ham and next 4 ingredients, spoon into pie plate. Cut remaining 3 triangles into thin strips; arrange over mixture. Bake on lower oven rack at 325 degrees for 1 hour. Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

title: Macaroni Casserole
directions: Prepare macaroni according to package directions; drain. Combine soup, milk and cheese., Simmer, stirring occasionally, until cheese is melted., Mix macaroni, cheese sauce, luncheon meat and green pepper., Pour into 1 1/2-quart casserole dish., Bake at 325° for 30 minutes., Makes 4 servings.

title: Chili Con Carne
directions: Brown ground beef and onion., Add all other ingredients and bring to a boil., Lower heat and simmer until done.

title: 7-Up Jello Salad
directions: Heat to boiling 7-Up and drained pineapple juice; dissolve jello with this., Pour into square or rectangle container., Mix cottage cheese, Cool Whip, pineapple and almost all nuts (leave a few to sprinkle on top)., Mix with jello and chill.

title: Filling A Trifle Bowl
directions: Break up or slice cake to fit bottom of trifle rifle bowl (or glass bowl)., Brush liberally with chocolate liqueur., Cover with 1 layer of fruit and drizzle with sludge., Spread on whipped cream. Repeat layers until top of bowl is reached., Drizzle chocolate sauce on top., Chill for several hours or overnight.

title: Pepper Relish
directions: Chop peppers and onion fine., Cover with boiling water and let stand 10 minutes; drain., Cover again with hot water and let come to boil., Let stand 10 to 15 minutes., Drain dry and add salt, vinegar and sugar., Cook for 15 minutes and pack in hot jars. Process in water bath can at 212° for 10 minutes.

title: Sauerkraut Salad
directions: In a large bowl, combine sugar and oil; mix well., Add all remaining ingredients., Chill several hours or overnight., Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Curried Rabbit
directions: Soak the rabbit in salted water about 30 minutes., Wash and drain., Saute onion, garlic and ginger in butter., Add curry powder, chili, salt and sage., Heat for about 1 minute and add the tomatoes., Saute and add the yogurt., Allow to cook with stirring for 20 to 30 minutes or so.

title: Crab Dip
directions: Drain crab meat and combine with other ingredients., Mix well. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour before serving., Good with crackers, chips or vegetables.

title: Squash Pie
directions: Mix all ingredients and pour into a baking dish., Cook for 10 minutes at 375°., Lower temperature to 350° and bake 45 minutes longer.

title: Chocolate Tea Cake
directions: Cream margarine, sugar and vanilla. Sift flour with cocoa and salt. Blend dry ingredients into creamed mixture. Add pecans and mix well. Shape into balls. Place on cookie sheet. Bake at 325° for 25 minutes. While, warm, roll in powdered sugar.

title: Meat Loaf
directions: Mix well and pour into greased loaf pan., Cover top with ketchup and bake, uncovered, in preheated oven at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Peach Pie
directions: Cook all until thick (except shell)., Cool and pour over 1 1/2 cups sliced peaches that have been placed in pie shell.

title: Blonde Brownies
directions: Melt margarine and brown sugar in saucepan., Add vanilla and salt., Beat eggs, one at a time; add to butter mixture., Add flour and pecans., Pour mixture into greased 8 x 8-inch pan., Bake for 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Stuffed Rigatoni
directions: Saute in pan., When cooked, stuff into partially cooked large rigatoni., In baking dish, put layer of rigatoni and cover with spaghetti sauce over all., Put in oven at 350° for 30 minutes to consume.

title: Microwave Oven-Fried Chicken
directions: Mix ingredients together; coat chicken., Arrange pieces, skin side up, in rectangular dish (12 x 7 1/2 x 2-inch) with thickest part toward edges., Cover with waxed paper., Microwave on High for 10 minutes., Rotate dish 1/2 turn., Microwave until done, 8 to 12 minutes longer., Makes 6 servings.

title: Mama Susanna'S Chicken
directions: Pour half the cooking wine in bottom of casserole dish., Put chicken, artichokes, olives, onion, garlic and oregano in and then add the rest of the wine., Cover and bake at 375° for 1 hour. Garnish with Romano cheese., Put over your favorite pasta.

title: Four Bean Casserole
directions: Cook on low in crock-pot 4 hours or 2 hours at 325° in oven.

title: Spinach Casserole
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Beat eggs and flour until smooth., Cook and drain spinach., Add all ingredients to egg mixture and stir. Melt margarine in 10-inch square pan., Pour mixture in; bake 30 minutes., Let set after baking for about 10 minutes.

title: Glazed Bacon Strips
directions: Roll each slice of bacon in brown sugar, covering both sides. Place on broiler pan or rack., Bake at 325° for 15 to 30 minutes. Keep checking until bacon is browned and fat cooked from it., Place cooked bacon on foil to cool., It will crisp as it cools., Serve at room temperature.

title: Boston Cream Candy
directions: Mix all together and cook until it forms a soft ball when tested in cold water., Add nuts and beat until creamy.

title: Cheese Roll
directions: Soften and mix together., Make into 2 or more rolls., Roll in chili powder or Parmesan cheese.

title: Fruit Salad
directions: Mix dry pudding and Tang gently with fruit mixture., Chill. May be used as salad or dessert.

title: Cinnamon Sugar Treats
directions: Thaw pie crust for 10 to 20 minutes in pan., Prick sides of crust thoroughly with a fork., Dot bottom and sides of thawed pie crust with butter., Sprinkle with cinnamon-sugar mixture., Bake in preheated oven at 425° for 8 to 13 minutes or until golden brown. Cool, then cut into pieces for serving.

title: Cream Cheese Corn
directions: Mix all ingredients in saucepan., Heat until cheese melts and corn is tender., This recipe can be doubled easily and kept warm in a crock pot.

title: All Meat Spaghetti With Sauce
directions: Prepare spaghetti by directions on package., Mix ground beef, onions and salt; cook until well done., Drain; set aside.

title: Brown Rice #3
directions: Brown onions in margarine., Add to remaining ingredients. Pour into casserole dish., Cover and bake at 250° for 1 hour.

title: Hungry Jack Beef Casserole
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., Brown ground beef; drain., Stir in next 5 ingredients; heat until bubbly; pour into 2-quart casserole dish., Cut biscuits in half to form 20 half circles., Place cut side down around edge of casserole., Sprinkle with cheese., Bake at 375° for 25 to 30 minutes, until biscuits are golden brown. Refrigerate any leftovers., Serves 4 to 6.

title: Rich Dinner Rolls
directions: Add heated liquids to flour mixture and beat., Add 2 beaten eggs and enough flour to make soft dough.

title: Cheese Ball
directions: Drain pineapple well, maybe overnight., Mix with mixer, all ingredients., Roll into ball., Roll into crushed nuts., Serve with favorite crackers.

title: Nutty Glazed Pastries(Easy And Tasty!)
directions: Blend powdered sugar, butter or margarine and water., Add vanilla extract. (Or if in a hurry, you can use white vanilla or almond flavor canned frosting.)

title: Pinto Beans
directions: Soak beans overnight in water, salt and pepper., Keep water over the top of beans., Stir and discard bean pieces which float to the top., Cover with fresh water., Boil 1 hour; drain., Return beans to kettle., Add all ingredients and water to cover beans. Simmer several hours., Stir occasionally (too much stirring causes beans to get mushy)., Always keep enough water in kettle., Eat as is or add to chili, refried, etc.

title: Czeck Cookies
directions: Cream butter, gradually adding sugar., Beat until light and fluffy., Add egg yolks., Blend well., Gradually add flour and mix well., Fold in nuts., Pat half of batter into greased 8-inch square pan., Spread with filling., Cover with remaining batter. Bake 1 hour at 325°., Cool and cut into 1-inch squares.

title: Butterscotch Pie
directions: Mix flour, brown sugar and salt., Add to milk and butter. Cook until thick., Add beaten egg yolks., Cook about 15 minutes longer until real thick., Remove from heat and add vanilla and 1/2 cup granulated sugar., Pour into baked pie shell and top with meringue.

title: Almond Butter Krunch
directions: Combine butter, sugar and 1/2 cup almonds in heavy 3-quart saucepan., Heat slowly to boiling point., Boil gently until 305°, stirring constantly., Pour into large buttered sheet pan sprinkled with 1/2 of chocolate chips., Spread with spatula., Sprinkle with 1/2 cup almonds., Cool and turn over and put rest of chocolate chips and almonds., Place under broiler until chips melt., Spread chocolate chips and rest of almonds.

title: Cherry Delight
directions: Cream together graham crackers, margarine and 1/2 cup powdered sugar., Line bottom of 2 1/2 quart baking dish., Mix cream cheese, 1/2 to 1 cup powdered sugar, and vanilla together and add to Cool Whip,, Mix thoroughly., Spread mixture evenly over graham crackers crust., Spread cherry pie filling over whipped cream., Place in refrigerator and chill for several hours before serving.

title: White Potato Pie
directions: Peel and quarter the white potatoes; boil them until tender. Put cooked potatoes in a large bowl., Mash potatoes until smooth, then mix them with butter, sugar, salt, lemon and vanilla., Add eggs, milk and baking powder; beat until smooth., Add more sugar, if desired., Pour mixture into pie crust shells and sprinkle lightly with grated coconut., Bake in a preheated 350° oven until done.

title: Baked Flounder
directions: Arrange fish in 9 x 13 inch baking dish,, lightly greased or sprayed with Pam., Drizzle dressing over fish, then sprinkle crumbs on top., Bake 10 minutes at 400° or until fish are flaky.

title: Apple Nut Cake
directions: Divide the quantities by 450 and you will have plenty of mincemeat for two 10-inch pies.

title: Chicken Salad With Vegetables
directions: Combine all ingredients except eggs and peas, then carefully fold in eggs and peas., Place on crisp lettuce leaf and arrange quarters of tomatoes around.

title: Dessert Bars
directions: Mix melted oleo and brown sugar., Let cool., Add beaten eggs and vanilla., Sift flour, soda, baking powder and salt and add to first mixture., Add chocolate chips, coconut and nuts., Bake in greased 9 x 13-inch pan at 350°.

title: Cut-Out Cookies
directions: Sift the dry ingredients together; cut in the Crisco., Beat the eggs in a one cup measuring cup; add enough milk to make 1 cup., Add to dry ingredients with vanilla., Roll on floured covered surface; cut as desired., Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.

title: Orange Balls
directions: Mix all ingredients except coconut and form into balls., Roll in coconut., Can use food coloring on coconut for holidays.

title: Sausage Balls
directions: Mix ingredients together and form into balls., Bake in 400° oven about 15 to 20 minutes., May use mild or sharp cheese. May also use mild or hot sausage.

title: Delightful Cheesecake
directions: Sprinkle 3 tablespoons graham cracker crumbs in 9-inch pan. Set aside., Soften gelatin in 1/2 cup water., Bring 3/4 cup juice to boil and stir in gelatin., Beat cottage cheese smooth., Add egg yolks, skim milk, lemon juice, sweetener, vanilla and salt., Beat well., Blend in gelatin at low speed., Chill., Stir occasionally until thick, but not set, about 1 hour., Beat egg whites until soft peaks form, then fold into gelatin mixture by hand., Spoon over crumbs in pan., Sprinkle remaining crumbs on top., Add pineapple tidbits on top., Chill overnight in refrigerator.

title: Cornbread Salad
directions: Crumble cornbread., In separate bowl, mix beans, corn, tomatoes, onions, peppers, cheese, and bacon., Mix in layers of vegetable mixture., Mix sour cream and picante sauce together. Combine with cornbread and vegetable mixture just before serving.

title: Broccoli Or Cauliflower Soup
directions: Cook vegetables in large covered saucepan in chicken broth until almost tender (10 to 15 minutes)., Do not drain., Set aside., In another bowl, gradually add cream of potato soup; mix thoroughly., Blend water in cornstarch (in small cup)., Pour into potato soup mixture., Mix together, then pour all white mixture into vegetables and broth., Cook and stir until thick and bubbly (on medium heat).

title: Cabbage With Caraway
directions: Melt margarine in a large nonstick skillet coated with cooking spray., Add cabbage and next 4 ingredients; cover and cook over medium heat for 5 minutes., Sprinkle with caraway seed; cover and cook 1 minute., Yield:, 5 cups., Contains 39 calories per 1 cup serving.

title: Date Walnut Balls
directions: Melt butter in heavy skillet., Stir in sugar, egg yolk and dates., Cook and stir over low heat 5 minutes or until mixture is thick., Remove from heat., Stir in lemon juice, peel and nuts. Cool., Drop or roll into balls and roll in powdered sugar. Delicious!!, I double this recipe.

title: Viking Stew
directions: Salt and pepper meat and dredge in flour; set aside., Fry bacon in large, heavy pot and brown beef in remaining bacon drippings., Sprinkle with sugar., Add diced bacon, onion, garlic, tomato sauce, wine, broth and seasonings., Cover and cook slowly for 1 1/2 hours., Add vegetables and continue to cook, uncovered, until vegetables are tender., If desired, stew can be thickened. Mix 2 to 4 tablespoons flour with 2 cups water., Stir into stew and heat to boiling., Serves 8.

title: Gumdrop Cookies
directions: Cream sugars and shortening., Add egg, flour and all other ingredients; blend., Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.

title: Grandma Wheeler'S Banana Cake
directions: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs and beat well. Add flour mixture (including salt and soda), sifting, alternately with milk. Beat after each addition. Add vanilla and beat. Stir in mashed bananas and nuts. Pour into greased and floured rectangle pan. Bake at 350° about 40 minutes.

title: Chili Cheese Squares
directions: Combine ingredients., Put equal amount in two 9-inch square pans that have been sprayed with Pam or Cooking Ease., Bake at 350° (preheated) for 35 minutes., Chill in icebox and cut in bite-size pieces., Serve as hors d'oeuvres., Yields 180 bite-size squares.

title: Cherry Cobbler
directions: Spread pie filling on bottom of Pyrex dish., Mix remaining ingredients until crumbly., Spread over cherry filling., Bake at 350° until brown.

title: One Bowl Pecan Pie
directions: Mix all ingredients together in bowl., Mix well and pour in unbaked pie shell., Bake at 350° for approximately 40 minutes.

title: Barbecue Party Franks
directions: Mix all ingredients. Marinate overnight. Cook over medium heat in a saucepan for 30 minutes. Serve in a bowl with small amount of sauce; keep warm. Serve with toothpicks.

title: Taco Casserole
directions: Brown onion and ground beef., Add green pepper, taco seasoning and tomatoes., While meat mixture is cooking, cook noodles., Rinse and drain noodles., Put noodles in buttered baking dish., Add sour cream and 1/2 cup grated cheese., Mix together., Pour meat mixture over noodles and cover with remaining cheese., Bake for 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Seven-Up Salad
directions: Let set until solid in 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Zucchini Bread
directions: Mix eggs, sugar and oil; beat well., Sift dry ingredients together., Add to first mixture., Stir in zucchini, nuts and vanilla., Bake in two loaf pans at 325° for 1 hour., Turn out of pan.

title: Cherry Dream Salad
directions: Mix pineapple, pie, filling, condensed milk and nuts in a large bowl., Fold in, whipped topping., Place in mold or a 9 x 13-inch pan., May be served immediately or chilled or frozen for later use.	Yield:	12 to 15 servings.

title: Chicken And Rice
directions: Cook rice as directed on box. Brown onion in oil on medium heat., Add chicken and cook until tender., Add salt, pepper and 1 tablespoon soy sauce., Add eggs., When eggs are cooked, add rice and reduce heat., Add 2 to 3 more tablespoons soy sauce and serve.

title: Smoked Salmon And Dill Rollups
directions: Combine the softened cream cheese with the fresh dill. Spread on the thin slices of smoked salmon and roll up jelly-roll fashion., Chill., Just before serving, cut the rollups into slices about 1/2 inch thick.

title: Huevos Mexicana(Great For Using Up Leftover Hard-Boiled Eggs)
directions: Lightly grease 13 x 9-inch pan., Stand 8 tortilla halves upright along sides of pan., Cover center of pan with 4 tortilla halves., Spread with 11 ounces of enchilada sauce., Top with eggs. Mix next 7 ingredients., Spread over eggs., Top with remaining 12 tortilla halves, remaining enchilada sauce and cheese., Bake for 30 to 35 minutes at 350°., Garnish with sour cream and olives.

title: Brownies
directions: Melt chocolate and margarine over low heat or in double boiler. Take off burner and add sugar, eggs, flour and salt mixed together and vanilla, stirring after each addition., Add nuts last., Bake in a 7 x 9-inch greased pan for 25 minutes at 350°.

title: Seafood Casserole
directions: Finely chop the pepper, onion and celery., Flake the crabmeat. Combine all together, except for the cracker crumbs., Place in a buttered baking dish., Cover with bread crumbs., Bake 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Creamy Fresh Fruit Dip
directions: Soften cream cheese and add Marshmallow Creme to blend. Add orange, juice, and	orange peel until well blended., Good with chunks, of cantaloupe, honeydew melon, pineapple, apple, banana, grapes, strawberries, etc.

title: Chocolate Covered Cherries
directions: Stir well., Let stand, in, freezer, at, least, 2, hours (overnight is preferable)., Make into small balls and place on wax paper., Put back in, freezer, and freeze for about 1 hour. Melt 12 ounce chocolate chips with 3/4 of one bar of paraffin. Dip balls by toothpick into chocolate mixture and place on wax paper., Keep in freezer until set good.

title: Spinach Salad
directions: Shake well in jar.

title: Stuffed Zucchini
directions: Cut ends off the zucchini., Cut zucchini lengthwise., Do not pare the zucchini., Scoop out pulp., Cook (boil) pulp, bread crumbs, salt, pepper, onion and eggs for 5 minutes., Spoon into zucchini shells., Dot with butter., Sprinkle on cheese., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Dressed Eggs
directions: Cut eggs in half., Remove yolks, mash and mix with the remaining ingredients., Fill white with the mixture and serve.

title: Vegetable Casserole
directions: Mix together and pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan., Top with Pepperidge Farm dressing., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Veg-All Casserole
directions: Mix first 5 ingredients; pour into casserole dish. Top with roll of crushed Ritz crackers. Pour melted margarine over top. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Seafood Casserole
directions: Butter two large casseroles., Heat oven to 325°., Crush crackers into crumbs., In skillet saute mushrooms with 2 tablespoons butter., In bowl mix soup, mushrooms and light cream. Put 1 fish fillet on bottom of each casserole., Add a layer of mushroom sauce, then a layer of crumbs., Continue layering seafoods in casseroles with a layer of sauce and crumbs between each., Finish each with crumbs., Cut remaining butter into thin pats and place on top., Bake casseroles in a water bath for a little more than an hour., This dish may be frozen.

title: Cheesy Potato Bake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Lightly spray a 9 x 13 baking dish. Layer the pan with frozen Tater Tots., Mix together cream of chicken, sour cream and cheese in a separate bowl.	Pour over the Tater Tots and evenly distribute the mixture., Top with shredded cheese and bake at 350° for about an hour.

title: Peach Crisp
directions: Heat oven to 375°., Grease square pan, 8 x 8 x 2-inches. Place peaches in pan., Mix remaining ingredients and sprinkle over peaches., Bake 30 minutes or until topping is golden brown., Serve warm and if desired, with light cream, ice cream or hard sauce. Makes 6 servings.

title: Toll House Pie
directions: Preheat oven to 325°., In large bowl, beat eggs at high speed until foamy, about 3 minutes., Beat in flour, sugar and brown sugar until well blended., Beat in softened butter., Stir in walnuts and chocolate chips., Pour into pie shells., Bake 55 to 60 minutes or until knife inserted halfway between edge and center comes out clean and top is golden brown., Cool on wire rack. Serve with Cool Whip or ice cream, if desired.

title: Seven Up Cake
directions: Combine all ingredients putting seven up in last.

title: No Bake Cheese Cake
directions: Note:, Save some of crumb mixture for top.

title: Chew Bread
directions: Butter pan well., Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Strawberry Cake
directions: Mix the cake mix with the pie filling (do not add water)., Bake mixture in 9 x 13 dish for 30 to 40 minutes at 350°., Let cool. Cut into 12 equal pieces., Each piece is 2 points.

title: Quick Krimmel Pie
directions: Beat egg whites until stiff., Gradually add in sugar while beating, then add baking powder and vanilla., Beat well on slow speed and fold in crumbs and nuts., Press out into greased pie plate., Bake in preheated 350° oven for 35 minutes., Cool for 20 minutes., Serve topped with whipped cream, Cool Whip or vanilla ice cream.

title: Craig'S Stuffed Shells
directions: Boil shells and let cool., Finely dice onion and pepper. Brown hamburger and sausage in frying pan while sauteing onion and pepper at same time., Drain grease from hamburger and sausage, onion, and peppers., In mixing bowl combine Ricotta cheese with hamburger, sausage, onions, and peppers., Mix together., Add salt and pepper to taste to the mixture., Stuff large shells to capacity with mixture., Add 1/4 inch sauce to cover bottom of casserole dish., Place shells side by side, filling dish., Cover shells with light coating of red sauce., Cover with foil and bake at 350° for 1 hour., Remove dish and cover with Mozzarella cheese. Bake uncovered for 10 minutes, let cool for 15 minutes., Serve.

title: Cherry Salad
directions: Mix Dream Whip as directed on box., Add all other ingredients and chill for 1 hour.

title: Dora'S Chicken Pie Casserole
directions: Combine all soups, chicken, peas, carrots, broth and cream. Pour mixture in a "large" casserole dish., Tear biscuits in half and cover top of casserole.

title: Cream Of Broccoli Soup
directions: In large saucepan, cook broccoli in 1 cup water with bouillon cubes., Bring to a very low boil; reduce heat to medium-low and cook about 7 minutes or until broccoli is tender., Put milk, cheese cubes and flour in a blender., Process on medium speed., Add milk mixture to cooked broccoli mixture., Add cream., Cook, stirring frequently, over medium heat until mixture is thickened., Reduce heat., Simmer about 10 minutes.

title: Blackberry Jam Cake
directions: Add sugar gradually to creamed butter., Beat in eggs and jam. Alternate flour, allspice with buttermilk., Add nuts, raisins and coconut., Bake in well greased pan at 300° for about 40 minutes.

title: Quiche
directions: Cook bacon; drain and chop up., Saute onion in bacon fat; drain., Combine eggs, milk, cream cheese, bacon and seasonings. Pour into pie crust., Bake at 375° for 25 to 35 minutes., If you like, add more cheese, mushrooms, crab meat or vegetables., Makes 1 pie., Serves 8.

title: Barbecue-Sauce Kabobs
directions: Preheat broiler., In a bowl, combine catsup, brown sugar, lemon juice, vinegar and Worcestershire sauce., Brush zucchini pieces lightly with cooking oil., On 4 long skewers, alternately thread beef, potatoes and zucchini., Brush with catsup mixture. Broil the kabobs 4 to 5-inches from heat for about 20 minutes. Turn once and brush occasionally with sauce., Serve kabobs on rice., (Can be cooked on grill.), Makes 4 servings.

title: Noodles With Mushrooms
directions: Saute first 5 ingredients for 6 minutes., Add broth and bring to a boil., Add noodles., Cook until all ingredients are absorbed, about 7 minutes., Serves 4 to 6 as a side dish.

title: Date Fingers
directions: Combine sugar, margarine, beaten egg and dates in a boiler. Cook over low heat, stirring often, until thick., Cool, then pour date mixture over Rice Krispies and chopped nuts., Stir to mix well., Take small amounts and roll between hands to form finger shapes., Roll fingers in Angel Flake coconut., Yields approximately 1 dozen.

title: Corn Light Bread
directions: Mix meal, flour, sugar, eggs and buttermilk thoroughly., Add melted shortening., Pour into loaf pan to within 1-inch of top. Bake for 1 hour at 350°.

title: Buffalo Style Hot Wings
directions: Brown and drain meat; add onion., Spread half of the potatoes and carrots in a baking dish and cover with half of the meat and onion mixture., Season to taste., Cover with half of a can of condensed tomato soup., Layer remaining ingredients in same order, topping with remaining half can of soup., Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours., Serves 8.

title: Oatmeal Crackers
directions: Stir sugar, salt, 1 1/2 cups of water and oil together., Add oats and flour with more water if necessary to make a moist dough. Roll very thin on Pammed cookie sheets., Cut into squares and prick with a fork., Bake until light brown in a 300° oven., Watch carefully as crackers around the edges will brown first., Remove these as they brown.

title: Minestrone Soup
directions: In water, put beef, carrots, parsley, celery, onion and bay leaf and simmer, uncovered, for 3 hours. Remove beef and carrots and strain. Combine remaining ingredients. Cook, covered, for 45 minutes. Cut up beef in small pieces. Makes 3 1/2 quarts of soup.

title: Pineapple Pound Cake
directions: Grease and flour a 10-inch tube pan; set aside., In a large bowl, cream the shortening, butter and sugar., Add the eggs, one at a time, beating thoroughly after each addition., In another bowl, sift the flour and baking powder., Add the flour in small batches to the creamed mixture alternately with the milk, beginning and ending with the flour.

title: Sugar Free Coconut Pie
directions: Cook pudding by directions., Then add extracts and 1/2 of the coconut., Cool and top with Cool Whip and the rest of the coconut.

title: Wonderful Chicken Casserole
directions: Pick cooked chicken from bone in large chunks; place in pan. Mix the sour cream and soup together; pour over chicken., Cook stuffing according to directions, using chicken broth in place of water., Drop over chicken mixture., Bake for 25 minutes at 350°.

title: Thousand Island Dressing
directions: Stir together and serve.

title: Italian Cream Cake
directions: Mix sugar and egg yolks., Cream oleo and shortening together. Combine both mixtures., Mix buttermilk and soda; add alternately with flour., Beat slowly; add coconut and pecans., Fold in well beaten egg whites with sugar added to egg whites; add vanilla.

title: Carrot Cake
directions: In large bowl, stir together the flour, cinnamon and baking soda., In another bowl, cream the sugar, oil and eggs. Stir in carrots, then add this mixture to the dry ingredients., Bake in 3 (9-inch) round pans or in a 9 x 13 pan.

title: Nacho Supreme
directions: Spread refried beans in shallow dish., Mix sour cream with taco seasoning and spread over beans., Top with cheese, tomatoes and black olives., Use tortilla chips for dipping.

title: Golden Sausage Egg Rolls
directions: Cook sausage over medium-high heat in large skillet, stirring frequently until no longer pink., Remove from heat and add the cole slaw mix, ginger, garlic, pepper and salt; mix well. Transfer to colander to drain; cool 15 minutes., Assemble egg rolls as directed on wrapper package, using 1/3 cup sausage mix for each roll., To cook in a wok, Dutch oven or fryer, add oil to 3-inches deep and heat to 375°., Fry 4 at a time for 3 minutes or until golden; drain on paper towels., Serve with your favorite dipping sauce., Yields 18 to 20 appetizers.

title: Savory Bran Muffins
directions: In a medium mixing bowl, stir together all-purpose flour, whole bran cereal, Parmesan cheese, snipped chives, baking powder, salt and Italian seasoning., Make a well in the center of the dry ingredients., In a small mixing bowl, combine egg, skim milk and cooking oil., Add all at once to flour mixture., Stir just until moistened (batter should be lumpy)., Spray 12 muffin cups with nonstick coating., Divide batter evenly among muffin cups., Bake in a 400° oven for about 20 minutes or until golden., Remove from pan; serve warm., Yield:, 12 muffins.

title: Stuffed Potatoes
directions: Bake potatoes and let sit and cool., Cut lengthwise and hollow out with a spoon., Set shells aside.

title: Fruit Cake
directions: Boil sugar, water, raisins and carrots for 5 minutes., Add cloves, cinnamon, shortening, soda, flour and fruits., You may vary the amount of citron to your taste., Bake at 325° for 1 hour.

title: Velveeta Cheese Dip
directions: Cube cheese and put in crock-pot on low., Brown meat., Add meat and salsa to cheese., When melted, serve with tostito chips.

title: Corn Flake Cookies
directions: Sift flour, baking powder, soda and salt., Cream margarine, white sugar, brown sugar and vanilla., Mix these together and add corn flakes and coconut., Bake in 350° oven for about 14 minutes.

title: Fresh Strawberry Pie
directions: Clean and slice strawberries; sprinkle sugar on top and let set for 1 hour. Drain strawberries and fold into Cool Whip. Put in baked pie crust. Put pie in freezer for 10 to 15 minutes to set. Then refrigerate and serve. Serves 8.

title: Tomatillo Salsa
directions: Combine diced tomatillos, sweet red pepper, yellow pepper and onion in a large glass bowl., Stir well. Add vinegar, sugar and juices; stir well to combine., Stir in cilantro, cumin and red pepper. Stir well again to combine. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours., Serve salsa with unsalted tortilla chips, beef, pork or chicken., Makes 1 3/4 cups.

title: Almond Roca
directions: In a heavy saucepan, melt butter., Add sugar and chopped, untoasted almonds., Stir mixture occasionally with a wooden spoon over medium to medium-low heat., Cook until candy thermometer reads 280°., Quickly remove from heat., Pour into ungreased jelly roll pan and spread out evenly with knife., While still hot, sprinkle chocolate chips, wait a bit and spread when melted. Sprinkle toasted almonds over top., Let cool several hours., Break into small pieces.

title: Braised Chicken Breasts With Mustard Sauce
directions: Remove, skin, from chicken breasts., Place on a rack in an electric, frying pan or in frying pan on top of stove., Add 1 cup water, to, frying, pan., Cover, and, cook on high until breasts are, almost, done., Remove, breasts, from frying pan. Heat, grill. Place, breasts on very hot grill for 10 minutes. Turn often and baste with honey/lemon mixture., Place on a bed of wild rice and top with 3 tablespoons of Mustard Sauce.

title: Sugar Cookies
directions: Combine ingredients in a medium size bowl., Spoon onto a greased cookie sheet., Sprinkle with sugar., Bake at 325° until golden brown.

title: Scalloped Tomatoes
directions: Melt butter; add bread cubes and onion and brown lightly. Then combine all ingredients and spoon into a casserole dish. Sprinkle fine bread crumbs on top and bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Cheesy Garlic Pork Chops
directions: Place pork chops on pan. Smear 1/2 to 1 teaspoon of minced garlic on each pork chop. Cover each pork chop with a thin, layer of cheese, then sprinkle Mrs. Dash. Broil pork chops until cooked, but be sure to frequently check to ensure moist pork chops.

title: Pork Sausage And Sauerkraut
directions: Form sausage into 12 patties; brown on both sides. Cook noodles in boiling water as directed on package. Drain and mix with 2 tablespoons pork fat. Spoon the noodles into buttered 11 3/4 x 7 1/2 x 1 3/4-inch rectangular dish. Mix sauerkraut with brown sugar and celery seed. Place on top of noodles. Place sausage on top. Pour beef broth over all and sprinkle top with buttered bread crumbs. Place, uncovered, on rack in large electric skillet preheated to 400°. Bake for 1 hour. Have skillet covered and vents closed. Yields 4 to 6 servings.

title: Toad In The Hole
directions: Cook bacon until crisp; drain., Set aside 1 tablespoon drippings., Crumble bacon; set aside., In same skillet, brown sausage; drain off fat., Stir together flour, baking powder and salt., Add milk and eggs; beat until smooth., Spread reserved bacon drippings in a 10 x 6 x 2-inch baking dish., Place sausage pieces in dish; sprinkle with crumbled bacon., Pour batter over all., Bake uncovered at 400° until set, 30 to 35 minutes., Makes 4 servings.

title: Taco Dip
directions: Soften cream cheese and gradually add sour cream., Beat with mixer until creamy, then add taco mix., Spread mixture in a glass pan., Top with lettuce, cheese, peppers, onions, olives and tomatoes., Serve with Doritos chips.

title: Honey Bites
directions: Combine honey and peanut butter with dry milk powder; mix well., Chill thoroughly., Shape into 1 1/2-inch balls., Roll in coconut., Yields 36 candies.

title: Tater Tot Casserole
directions: Heat beef and onion until meat turns color, but do not brown it. Drain. Pour meat and onion mixture into a shallow casserole dish. Pour undiluted soup over mixture. Place Tater Tots on top and bake for 30 to 45 minutes at 359° until it bubbles. Serves 12. Preparation time: 20 minutes.

title: Funshine Fizz
directions: Mix orange juice, pineapple juice, club soda and orange sherbet, in blender., Blend on low speed until mixed completely. Makes, a, good, summertime	treat,	or, good for birthday parties!

title: Low Cholesterol Apple-Oat Bran Muffins
directions: Stir together all dry ingredients., In small bowl, combine buttermilk, egg whites and oil., Add to dry ingredients; stir until moistened., Add apples., Spoon about 1/4 cup batter into muffin pan that has been sprayed with Pam coating., Bake at 375° for 18 to 20 minutes., Makes 12 muffins., 124 calories.

title: Harvest Pork Chops
directions: In large skillet, brown pork chops in butter., Remove and set aside., Cook apples and onions in skillet drippings until onion is tender., Stir in cider, water, brown sugar, bouillon, salt and pepper., Return pork to skillet and simmer, covered, for 30 to 35 minutes, until pork chops are tender., Combine cornstarch and apple cider; stir into hot liquid., Cook until mixture thickens. Serve with rice., Serves 6.

title: Phyllis' Corn Chowder
directions: Fry bacon., Remove bacon; leave 3 tablespoons of grease in pan., Add onion; cook until lightly browned., Add remaining ingredients and a dash of pepper., Heat to boiling., Reduce heat and simmer 1 to 2 minutes., Top with crumbled bacon., Serves 6.

title: Chess Cake
directions: Mix together 1 egg, melted butter and cake mix., Pat this mixture down in a 9 x 13 inch pan.

title: Apple Pudding
directions: Beat eggs., Add sugar., Add dry ingredients to egg mixture. Mix well and fold in apples, vanilla and nuts., Top with coconut. Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes., Use a 9 x 9-inch pan.

title: Sliced Frozen Fruit Salad
directions: Drain fruit., Put 1/4 cup juice and marshmallows in medium saucepan., Heat on low heat until marshmallows melt., In large mixing bowl, soften cream cheese with a little whipping cream. Whip the remaining cream., Add salt and melted marshmallows to the cream mixture., Fold in whipped cream and fruit., Spoon into four (No. 2) cans., Cover with foil and freeze.

title: Sweet And Sour Meat Balls
directions: Make meat balls; cook in large pot with sauce.

title: Reuben-Kraut Casserole
directions: Drain sauerkraut and mix with onions and sour cream., Spread the mixture in the bottom of a 9 X 13 pan.	Evenly distribute the corned beef and Mozzarella cheese over the top., Top with broken bite-sized bits of rye bread., Drizzle the entire dish with melted butter and bake in a 350 degree oven for 45 minutes., Serves 8.

title: Lemon Herb Baste For Cornish Hens
directions: Brush mixture on hens while grilling for a delicious lemon flavor.

title: Stuffed Shells
directions: Brown ground chuck, onion and garlic; cool., Add Mozzarella cheese, bread crumbs, parsley, egg, salt and pepper., Spoon enough sauce to cover bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan., Stuff cooked shells and place in pan., Cover with sauce and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 400° for 20 to 25 minutes or until hot.

title: Glazed Meatballs
directions: In medium bowl, combine ground beef, bread crumbs, onion, salt and eggs; mix well., Shape into 3/4-inch balls., In a large skillet, brown meatballs in oil, turning occasionally., Drain. Add remaining ingredients., Simmer 15 minutes, stirring occasionally to coat meatballs with glaze., Serve warm in chafing dish., Makes 48 meatballs.

title: Coca-Cola Cake
directions: Sift flour, sugar and soda in mixing bowl., Bring to a boil the shortening, butter and cola., Remove from heat and pour over dry ingredients., Add eggs and buttermilk; beat well. Stir in marshmallows and vanilla. Bake 35 minutes at 350°.

title: Scallops And Bacon
directions: Cook scallops in margarine for 5 minutes., Cut bacon into 2-inch pieces., Arrange bacon and scallops alternately on skewer. Sprinkle with salt and pepper., To bake, insert skewers in uncooked potato halves, so they will stand upright., Bake at 475° for 20 minutes., Serves 4.

title: Sausage Casserole
directions: Slice sausage into 1/2-inch pieces., Pre-boil potatoes, carrots and onion., Mix brown gravy by package directions., Mix all ingredients and bake in casserole dish for 30 to 40 minutes at 350°.

title: Stuffed Mushrooms
directions: Wash mushrooms, remove stems and chop enough to make 1 cup. In a saucepan, cook mushroom stems, onion and garlic in margarine until tender., Stir in bread crumbs and cheese., Spoon mixture into mushroom caps., Arrange caps in a 15 x 10 x 2-inch pan., Bake at 425° for 8 to 10 minutes or until heated through.

title: Tomato And Basil Rice
directions: Heat olive oil and saute onion until translucent., Add tomatoes and water., Bring to a boil and add salt, pepper, garlic powder and basil., Bring to a second boil and add rice and stir., Reduce to low heat and cover., Cook until liquid is absorbed, 15 to 20 minutes., Stir in Parmesan cheese before serving.

title: Tuna Casserole
directions: Using fork, break up tuna and place half of it in bottom of medium-size casserole dish., Pour half of the soup over it and cover with half of crackers, which have been finely crushed. Repeat with rest of ingredients., Dot with margarine, if desired. Bake 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Orange Wild Rice With Raisins And Apples
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., In mixing bowl, combine cooked rices. Gently toss together raisins, almonds, parsley, zest, apple, oil, orange juice, salt and pepper with combined rices., Place mixture in casserole., Cover with foil; heat thoroughly for 20 minutes.

title: Graham Cracker Pudding
directions: Roll graham crackers (or use a food processor)., Mix with 1/2 cup sugar and butter., Line 9 x 13-inch pan with mixture, saving 1 cup for top of pudding., Cook milk, 1 cup sugar, salt, egg yolks, flour and vanilla until thick., Pour into lined pan., Cover with meringue made with the egg whites left from the pudding., Then cover with reserved crumb mixture., Bake for 15 minutes at 350°.

title: Pumpkin Nut Squares
directions: Mix first 8 ingredients and pour in a greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Sprinkle with cake mix., Drizzle melted butter over top., Top with nuts., Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 25 minutes., Serve cold with whipped cream.

title: Layered Salad Deluxe
directions: Layer first 6 ingredients in order listed in a large salad bowl., Combine salad dressing, sour cream and dressing mix; mix well., Spread over top of vegetables, sealing to edge of bowl. Garnish with chopped parsley, if desired. Cover tightly and refrigerate several hours or overnight., Toss gently before serving., Yield:, 12 to 15 servings.

title: Oatmeal Pie
directions: In blender, mix all ingredients except pie shell, coconut and chopped nuts., Blend until thoroughly mixed., Stir in coconut and pour into pie shell., Sprinkle with chopped nuts., Bake at 375° for 45 to 60 minutes.

title: Mom'S Chicken Casserole
directions: Place cut up chicken in 9 x 12-inch pan., Mix soup, milk, vegetables and onion in saucepan., Heat until blended and vegetables are slightly cooked., Pour over chicken., Melt margarine and pour over cornbread stuffing., Add 1 cup chicken broth and stir well., Spread over chicken mixture., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
directions: Combine sugar, salt and milk and bring to boil, stirring frequently., Cook to 232° or until small amount of mixture forms a ball when dropped in cold water., Remove from heat and drop in oleo and peanut butter., Cool to lukewarm and add vanilla and beat until mixture thickens., Pour into buttered pan and cut into squares.

title: My French Dressing
directions: Place all ingredients in a screwtop jar., Shake well., Store in refrigerator.

title: Salmon Mousse
directions: Empty envelope of gelatin into blender., Add lemon juice, onion slices and boiling water; cover blender and blend at high speed for 40 seconds., Add mayonnaise, paprika, dill and salmon. Cover and blend at high speed briefly., Add cream, 1/3 at a time, and blend after each addition., Blend 30 seconds longer., Pour into 4-cup mold which has been lightly coated with salad oil. Chill for at least 4 hours., Unmold.

title: Chicken Spaghetti
directions: Saute bell pepper, onion, garlic and squash in 1 tablespoon oil., Add mushrooms., Remove. Add sausage and saute; drain and discard remaining grease., Pour Hunt's in skillet and add all of the ingredients., Serve over spaghetti and top with Mozzarella cheese., You may also layer spaghetti, sauce and cheese and bake in oven at 350° until cheese melts.

title: Snowballs
directions: Cream butter and sugar together., Add flour and nuts., Chill for several hours., Roll dough into small marble size balls. Place 2-inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet., Bake at 325° for 20 minutes., Cool for 5 minutes and roll in powdered sugar., After real cool, roll them in powdered sugar again.

title: Butter Glazed Carrots
directions: Steam carrots until tender; drain., Over medium heat combine in skillet the butter, sugar, lemon juice and salt., When bubbly add carrots and parsley., Remove from heat., Stir until carrots are coated., Serve immediately.

title: Pina Colada Punch
directions: Stir ingredients together until lemonade mix is dissolved. Just before serving, add 1 quart of ice cubes and 1 to 2 bottles of sugar-free 7-Up or ginger ale.

title: Raisin Squares
directions: Cook raisins in water for 10 minutes., Add butter; let melt, then cool., Add egg, flour, sugar, nutmeg, cinnamon, baking soda, allspice, cloves and salt., Pour into ungreased cookie sheet with edges., Bake at 375° for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: 1-2-3 Shortbread
directions: Knead the flour into the softened butter; then knead the granulated sugar into the flour-butter mixture. Press firmly into a well-greased 8-inch square pan or shortbread mold. Bake 40 to 45 minutes at 325° or until a delicate brown. Cut in 36 squares while still hot. Return to oven a few minutes to dry out edges. Let cool in pan or on wire rack.

title: Tunnel Of Fudge Cake
directions: Cream butter in large bowl at high speed., Add eggs, one at a time, beating well., Add sugar slowly., Continue until light and fluffy., By hand, stir in flour, frosting mix and nuts until blended., Pour into well-greased tube or Bundt pan., Bake at 350° for 60 minutes., Cool 2 hours and remove from pan.

title: Seafood Pie
directions: Heat oven to 400°., Lightly grease 10 x 1 1/2-inch pie plate. Mix crabmeat, cheese and onions., Place in pie plate., Beat remaining ingredients until smooth (15 seconds in blender on high speed or 1 minute by hand)., Pour into pie plate., Sprinkle with nutmeg.

title: Chocolate Drop Cookies
directions: Put sugar, milk, cocoa and butter in saucepan. Bring to boil and boil for 4 minutes. Set aside off heat. Add peanut butter, vanilla and oats; mix. Drop onto cookie sheets to cool.

title: Watergate Pudding
directions: Mix crushed pineapple and instant pistachio pudding in a bowl. Add Cool Whip and mix well with spoon., Add nuts, if desired. Decorate with sliced pineapple and cherries., Put in refrigerator to cool.

title: Pork Chop Casserole
directions: Put pork chops in casserole dish, then add a layer of potatoes and then a layer of onion., Salt and pepper, then add cream of chicken soup., Bake at 375° for about 45 minutes to an hour.

title: Orange Coconut Balls
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Make into balls., Refrigerate for 30 minutes or overnight., Then dip in chocolate.

title: Molasses Cookies
directions: Cream shortening and sugar., Add egg and molasses., Add dry ingredients., Chill., Form into balls and roll in sugar., Bake at 350-375 degrees for 10 minutes.

title: Eggs Portugal
directions: Brown sausage (Deans or Owens); drain., In a 9 x 13-inch pan, cover bottom with 8 slices of bread, cut in cubes., Sprinkle shredded Cheddar cheese., Add drained sausage., Mix eggs (beaten) in milk and mustard and pour over sausage., Cover with Saran Wrap and refrigerate overnight., In morning, top with can of mushrooms (drained) and bake at 350° for 1 hour., Serves 6 to 8 people. Serve with fruit and pastries.

title: Savory Eggs(Christmas Brunch)
directions: To yolks, add ingredients and mix thoroughly., Replace yolk mixture in whites.

title: Spinach Dip
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Cover and chill., Makes 3 cups.

title: Apple Fritters(Club Member: Brandi Cook)
directions: Beat egg with milk; stir 1 tablespoon melted Crisco with the fruit. Combine dry ingredients. Add to egg mixture and stir. Drop from tablespoon into deep Crisco. Fry about 4 minutes until brown. Serve hot. Makes 16.

title: Easy Chicken Loaf
directions: Beat eggs slightly in a bowl., Add remaining ingredients; mix well., Pack mixture into a greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan., Bake at 350° for about 40 minutes., Unmold onto hot platter., Garnish with parsley and hard-cooked egg segments., Yields 8 to 10 servings., Contains 191 calories per serving.

title: Faye And Hildy'S Celery Seed Dressing
directions: Put all ingredients in blender and blend.

title: Cole Slaw
directions: Mix together, sprinkle with sugar or Sweet 'N Low to taste. Mix all ingredients together and refrigerate for at least an hour.

title: Cracker Pudding
directions: Beat eggs and add sugar., Add milk and crackers, then coconut and vanilla., Cook until thick.

title: Pumpkin Crisp
directions: Mix together all ingredients, except dry cake mix, pecans and melted butter., Line pan with wax paper., Pour mixture in pan., Sprinkle yellow cake mix on top (dry)., Sprinkle pecans on that., Pour melted butter on top., Bake at 350° for 50 minutes., Turn upside-down., Take paper off and let cool.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
directions: Mix the flour and soda., Combine the butter, sugar, vanilla and pudding mix., Beat in eggs., Slowly add flour mixture and stir in chocolate chips and nuts., Drop by teaspoon onto baking sheet. Bake at 375° for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Molded Salad
directions: Combine jello with boiling water., Add the cool water., When cool and jello-like, fold in the remaining ingredients.

title: Sweet Potatoes
directions: Mash, sweet, potatoes, and, mix in all the ingredients. Bake until, firm and browned on top., Then add topping and let cook for 15 minutes on 375°.

title: Oatmeal Pie
directions: Mix eggs, sugar, syrup and butter., Beat together well., Add oatmeal and coconut, stirring together well., Pour into unbaked pie shell., Bake 40 to 45 minutes at 350°., This is a rich pie very much like pecan., Pie is done when filling is set.

title: Linzertorte
directions: Preheat oven to 350°, butter a 10 inch spring form that is 2 inches high., Work the flour, hazelnuts, butter, sugar, egg, 1 egg yolk, cinnamon and lemon zest to a dough., Press 3 quarters of the dough into the bottom and sides of the pan., Fill with jam., Roll out the remaining dough 1/4 inch thick, cut into strips, criss-cross them over the filling, brush with 1 egg yolk., Bake for 45 minutes., Cool and serve.

title: Chocolate Mint Sugar Cookie Drops
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., In small bowl, combine flour, baking powder and salt and set aside., In a large bowl, combine 1 cup sugar and oil., Mix well., Beat in eggs and vanilla., Gradually add flour mixture., Stir in mint chips., Shape into balls., Roll in remaining sugar and place on ungreased cookie sheet., Bake 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Lemon Lush
directions: Blend in oleo, flour and nuts and spread in the bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake 20 minutes at 350°., Combine cheese, powdered sugar and Cool Whip., Spread on the baked crust., Add cold milk to pudding and beat with mixer until thick., Spread pudding on top of second layer., Refrigerate., More Cool Whip can be spread over top when pudding sets., Sprinkle chopped nuts over top.

title: Low-Fat Spanish Rice
directions: In medium saucepan, over high heat, bring broth to a boil. Add rice, cover and reduce to low setting., Cook 50 minutes or until rice is tender., Saute garlic, onion, green pepper and celery in 3 to 4 tablespoons juice from tomatoes in a large skillet over medium-high heat for 5 to 7 minutes or until softened., Add tomatoes to skillet with remaining juice., Stir in seasonings and honey and bring to a boil., Cover and reduce heat to simmer., Cook for 10 minutes., When rice is tender, stir into tomato mixture., Heat until hot, approximately 5 minutes.

title: Rhubarb Cake
directions: Mix the sugar, eggs and oil., Sift together the cinnamon, salt, soda and flour., Add to the first mixture. Stir in the rhubarb., Mix and pour into a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle on 3 tablespoons brown sugar and 1 tablespoon cinnamon. Bake at 350° for 45 to 55 minutes.

title: Shrimp Dip
directions: Mix cream cheese, Miracle Whip and ketchup together with mixer., Add onion and shrimp., Blend all ingredients; serve with crackers or vegetables.

title: Breakfast Pizza
directions: *You can use bacon (crumbled up), Canadian bacon or ham.

title: French Bread
directions: Mix 1 1/2 cups flour, sugar, salt and yeast; add margarine. Gradually add water to dry ingredients and beat for 2 minutes. Stir in enough additional flour to make stiff dough., Turn on floured board and knead until smooth, 8 to 10 minutes., Cover with plastic wrap or towel; rest 20 minutes., Divide dough in half. Roll out on lightly floured board to size of 15 x 10-inches; roll up taper ends.

title: Grilled Potatoes
directions: Peel potatoes or leave on skins., Cut each potato into wedges (4 each)., In mixing bowl, combine oil, salt, garlic powder and pepper., Add cut-up potatoes; toss to coat., Wrap potatoes in heavy foil., Seal edges tightly., Grill packet on medium to hot grill about 35 minutes or until potatoes are tender., These can also be cooked in the oven.

title: Sweet Potato Biscuits
directions: Mix the top ingredients in a bowl and use this mixture in place of your usual milk when making biscuits., When your biscuits are done, sprinkle with powdered sugar while hot.

title: Grandma Froning'S Rhubarb Pie
directions: Note: Fresh rhubarb is best!, If frozen rhubarb is used, defrost prior to adding to filling., Canned rhubarb must be drained first and isn't as good.

title: Easy Chocolate Cream Pie
directions: Mix together and pat in a pie pan., Prick with a fork., Bake 12 to 15 minutes at 350°., Cool.

title: French Dressing
directions: Use a blender to mix.

title: Mexican Dip
directions: Brown hamburger, drain grease., Cook hamburger with the taco seasoning mix according to package directions., Line a 13 x 9-inch baking pan with the refried beans., Layer the hamburger, onion, salsa and cheese over the refried beans., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes., Mix olives and sour cream and top the baked mixture. Serve with nachos.

title: Party Potatoes
directions: Melt together oleo and cream cheese., Add soup and onion; mix together until smooth., Put 1/2 of potatoes in a greased pan and pour on half of the sauce., Sprinkle the rest of the potatoes and add the remainder of sauce., Top with 1 cup grated Cheddar cheese. Bake at 325°, covered, for 1 hour.

title: Oven Fried Chicken
directions: Mix ingredients together and roll chicken., Bake in lightly buttered pan for 1 hour at 350° until brown.

title: Edna'S Punch
directions: Stir sugar and water until sugar dissolves., Add all of the other ingredients except Sprite., Freeze overnight.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
directions: Butter sides and bottom of pan., Cook 10x sugar, oleo and evaporated milk., Stir constantly., When it starts to boil, boil for 3 minutes., Remove from stove and add peanut butter, Marshmallow Creme and vanilla., Stir and pour in pan., Cool completely., Cut and enjoy!

title: Easy Yeast Rolls
directions: Melt yeast in warm water., Add egg, oil, sugar and flour., Mix well., Pan out., Bake in muffin pan at 425°.

title: Cajun Dirty Rice
directions: In 10-inch skillet over medium-high heat, cook livers, green pepper, celery and garlic in butter until vegetables are tender, stirring often., Stir soup mix, water and hot pepper sauce into skillet., Heat to boiling; stir in rice., Reduce heat to low. Cover; simmer 20 minutes or until rice is tender., Makes 6 servings.

title: Cranberry Salad
directions: Dissolve jello in boiling water., Add cranberry sauce., Use fork or wire whisk to dissolve cranberry sauce in jello mixture. Add pineapple, undrained., Stir to blend., Let jello chill.

title: One-Pot Sunday Dinner
directions: Dust roast with flour and brown., Put into large Dutch oven and surround it with potatoes, carrots and the green beans., Slice onions over the top and cover with both cans of the soup, which have been mixed together with 1/2 can of water to blend., Bake at 325° for 3 hours, or until done.

title: Hidden Hot Dogs
directions: Turn oven to 450°., Open package of rolls and separate the little triangles., Flatten each triangle a little bit with your hands., Open hot dogs and wrap each one in a flattened roll. Pinch the dough together on top so that each hot dog stays wrapped., Put the wrapped hot dogs on a baking pan., Bake until they puff and are light brown, about 10 minutes.

title: No Bake Fruitcake
directions: In large bowl thoroughly combine first 7 ingredients, then stir in next 4 ingredients., Add to graham cracker mixture and blend thoroughly., Pack firmly into 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2 1/2-inch aluminum foil pan., Cover and refrigerate at least 2 days., Let stand about 2 hours at room temperature before serving., Makes 1 (8 ounce) loaf.

title: Arctic Salad
directions: In a bowl, blend cream cheese and Miracle Whip., Stir in raspberries, pineapple and pecans., Fold in whipped cream., Pour in 9 x 5-inch loaf pan., Freeze 8 hours., To serve, set out 15 to 20 minutes., Cut and serve., Serves 12 to 18.

title: Pretzel Dessert
directions: Mix first 3 ingredients together., Press into 13 x 10-inch dish., Bake at 300° for 8 to 10 minutes., Do not overbake!, Cool. Mix next 3 ingredients and spread over cooled pretzel mix., Stir together remaining ingredients; put mixture in the refrigerator to chill for 10 minutes., Pour over top of dish and refrigerate., All ingredients can be substituted for low calorie products.

title: Oatmeal Chocolate Cake
directions: In a mixing bowl, pour water over oatmeal and allow to stand 10 minutes. Add sugars and butter, stirring until the butter melts., Add eggs, one at a time, mixing well after each addition. Sift flour, cocoa, soda and salt together., Add to batter., Mix well. Stir in half of the chocolate chips., Pour into a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan., Sprinkle top of cake with walnuts and remaining chips. Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

title: Chicken Divan
directions: Cook chicken and cut into bite-size pieces., Lightly butter a large casserole dish., Cover bottom of dish with broccoli florets. Spread chicken over broccoli., Mix soup, mayonnaise and cooking sherry and stir together well., Pour mixture over chicken and spread out evenly., Cover sauce with grated cheese., Place in 350° oven for 45 minutes., Serve with rice.

title: Jalapeno Pie
directions: Spray pie pan with Pam; line bottom of pan with peppers., Put grated cheese over the peppers., Beat eggs and pour over top of cheese., Bake at 350° for 15 minutes, until cheese and eggs are firm and will cut in slices., Great with seafood.

title: Mexican Rice
directions: Cook rice as directed., Put in casserole., Blend 2/3 cup Cheddar cheese, peppers and sour cream., Put remaining cheese on top., Bake at 350° for 25 minutes or until thick.

title: Blackberry Pie
directions: Boil sugar and cornstarch with 1-cup water until thick; remove from fire and add blackberry gelatin., Thaw and drain 4 cups blackberries; fold into gelatin mixture., Pour into baked pie shell and cover and refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Brown Sugar Custard Pie
directions: Mix sugar and flour., Break eggs into mixture and fold in. Don't beat., Melt butter and add to milk., Stir the two mixtures together., Add salt and vanilla., Pour into pie shell., Bake 1/2 hour at 400°, then reduce heat to 375° until a knife inserted into center comes out clean.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Add rice, can of broth (and enough water to make 2 cups), 2 tablespoons butter or oleo and onions., Cook according to rice directions., Mix with cream of chicken soup; salt and pepper to taste., Pour into casserole., Top with chicken breasts; salt and pepper chicken., Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

title: Southern Banana Pudding
directions: Combine Jell-O pudding, egg yolks and milk in saucepan., Cook and stir over medium heat until mixture comes to a full boil. Remove from heat., Arrange layer of vanilla wafers on bottom and sides of 1 1/2-quart baking dish., Add a layer of banana slices and of pudding., Continue layering wafers, bananas and pudding, ending with pudding.

title: Pecan Pie Bars
directions: Combine flour, sugar and salt in large bowl; cut in 3/4 cup butter thoroughly with pastry blender until mixture resembles very fine crumbs., Press mixture evenly into greased 13 x 9-inch pan, using a piece of plastic wrap to press crumb mixture firmly in pan. Bake at 350 degrees for 17 to 20 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Cool 'N Easy Pie
directions: Stir boiling water into gelatin in bowl for 2 minutes or until dissolved., Mix water and ice to make 1 1/4 cups., Stir into gelatin until slightly thickened., Remove any remaining ice., Stir in whipped topping until smooth., Refrigerate 10 minutes or until mixture will mound., Spoon into crust., Refrigerate 4 hours or until firm., Garnish with additional whipped topping, if desired.

title: Corn Fritters
directions: Drain corn, reserving 1/4 cup liquid. Sift together flour, baking powder, salt, parsley flakes and paprika. Combine eggs, melted butter and liquid from corn., Mix well. Add to dry ingredients all at once and stir until smooth. Fold in drained corn. Drop batter from a tablespoon into deep fat heated to 375°. Fry, a few at a time, until golden brown on all sides., Remove from fat., Drain on paper towel. Keep hot while frying remaining fritters.

title: Taco Salad
directions: Cook macaroni; drain and rinse with cold water., Drain again. Brown meat; drain off fat., Add taco seasoning and mix well; cool. In large bowl, mix macaroni, green pepper, onions, cheese, tomatoes, lettuce and seasonings; chill., Just before serving, stir in seasoned meat, French dressing and chips; toss lightly. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Yogurt-Grilled Chicken
directions: Mix all ingredients in a 1-gallon Ziploc bag., Marinate in bag several hours or overnight in the refrigerator., Lift from marinade and grill over charcoal grill., (Based on Iranian cooking with yogurt!)

title: Pumpkin Squares
directions: Mix first 5 ingredients., Spread in a 9 x 12-inch pan (sprayed with Pam)., Sprinkle yellow cake mix over pumpkin., Add pecans. Dot top with oleo., Bake at 250° for 50 minutes.

title: Potato Casserole
directions: Mix margarine, cloves, mashed garlic, salt, celery seed and black pepper together., Set aside.

title: Zucchini Dessert
directions: Boil 30 minutes all ingredients together., Pack in pint jars. Process for 20 minutes in pressure canner., Yield 6 to 7 pints. Tastes just like real pineapple.

title: Chocolate Spice Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Prepare 10-inch tube baking pan., Cream shortening and sugar., Mix flour, soda, cocoa and spices., Blend in eggs, dry ingredients and applesauce until well mixed., Fold in raisins, nuts and dates., Bake 35 to 45 minutes or until done.

title: Light And Lively Salad
directions: Mix together with reduced calorie Ranch dressing.

title: Almost Better Than Sex Cakes
directions: Prepare the cake mix and bake in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish according to package directions., When done, remove from oven and while still hot, poke holes in cake with end of wooden spoon. Pour sweetened condensed milk, then caramel topping into holes. Spread entire cake with whipped topping., Sprinkle crushed candy bars on top of cake., Refrigerate cake until serving time., Cake can be frozen.

title: Chicken And Vegetable Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients except Ritz crackers and margarine., Pour into 9 x 13-inch dish., Mix crushed crackers and margarine and cover top., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Refrigerator Pickles
directions: Put sliced onion in bottom of an empty 3-pound peanut butter jar, then fill with sliced cucumbers., Mix remaining ingredients and pour over cucumbers., Refrigerate for 5 days, then eat and enjoy.

title: Marshmallow Fudge
directions: Combine sugar, milk and marshmallows in a saucepan., Cook and stir until sugar and marshmallows melt., When bubbles cover entire surface, boil and stir over medium heat for 5 minutes., Remove from heat., Beat in butter, salt, chocolate bits and vanilla until chocolate bits are melted., Add nuts, if desired., Spread into buttered 9 inch square pan., Chill until firm., Cut into 64 squares and enjoy.

title: Peanut Patties
directions: Cook sugar, Karo, milk and peanuts until 240°; remove from fire., Add remaining ingredients; stir good and spoon out on foil.

title: No Bake Cookies
directions: Mix all ingredients, except peanut butter and oatmeal., Stir well., Cook for 1 minute., Remove from heat., Add peanut butter and oatmeal; mix well., Drop by spoonfuls onto wax paper.

title: Little Barbecue Wieners
directions: Empty package into a medium sized saucepan. Let simmer in the whole bottle of barbecue sauce. This is a great appetizer.

title: Beefy Mushroom Roast
directions: Salt and pepper roast., Brown roast in a pot on top of stove in Crisco., Drain grease; add beefy mushroom soup., Bake in a 350° oven for about 2 hours (depending on size of roast)., Will have enough for gravy.

title: Holiday Cheese Ball
directions: Have cheese at room temperature. Mix cheese, onion, Worcestershire sauce and Accent until blended., Add 1/2 cup pecans and 1/4 cup parsley., Shape mixture into ball., Place in bowl lined with waxed paper., Chill overnight.

title: Marinated Onions And Cucumbers
directions: Slice cucumbers and onions., Sprinkle with salt and let stand 6 hours., Drain., Mix sugar and vinegar., Dissolve, then add sour cream., Mix and pour over vegetables., Let stand 24 hours.

title: Fresh Strawberry Pie
directions: Bring to boil until clear and thick and bubbling., Cook for about 5 minutes, then add 2 to 3 cartons of clean, fresh, cold strawberries., Put in prepared pie crust., Just before serving, top with whipped cream.

title: Pumpkin Cake
directions: Place sugar, oil and pumpkin in large mixer bowl and beat well at medium speed., Add eggs one at a time, beating well after each. Sift flour, baking powder, soda, cinnamon and salt together and fold into batter., Stir in nuts and raisins., Pour into greased and floured 10-inch tube pan., Bake at 350° for 1 1/4 hours or until done., Do not open oven door under 1 hour., Let cool slightly in pan before turning onto cake rack.

title: Egg Salad
directions: Hard boil eggs; remove 1/2 to 2/3 yolks., Chop remaining yolks and whites., Add chopped olives., Mix in mustard and salad dressing to taste.

title: Potato Salad
directions: Beat eggs., Add sugar, vinegar and mustard., Boil this, stirring constantly, on low heat until thick., Chill., Then add real Kraft mayonnaise dressing., Mix dressing with sliced, cooked potatoes, 8 boiled chopped eggs, celery and onion.

title: Flavored Applesauce
directions: Bring to boil 1 1/2 cups applesauce and 3/4 cup water., Add jello; apricot is great, raspberry is good, too., Stir well; add pineapple (no need to drain)., Add remaining applesauce., To keep the sugar content low, I use unsweetened applesauce and sugar-free jello.

title: Apple Turnovers
directions: Mix all ingredients, set aside.

title: Sweet Potato Balls
directions: Drain potatoes and mash well., Add vanilla, flour, margarine, egg and sugar., Make small balls and put a marshmallow in center of each ball., Roll in coconut., Place on greased baking dish and bake in 350° oven for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Hash Brown Bake
directions: Mix together first 7 ingredients. Put in large pan. Melt butter. Mix with potato chips. Spread on top. Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: T.V. Snacks
directions: Combine last 5 ingredients., Pour over cereal and stir., Cook 2 hours at 200°.

title: Pump Up Your Pumpkin
directions: Mix cream cheese, 1 tablespoon half and half and whipped topping., Whip together., Spread on bottom of crust., Pour 1 cup half and half and add pudding., Wire whip and let stand 3 minutes. Stir in pumpkin and spices., Spread over cream cheese layer., Chill 2 hours., Top with whipped topping and nuts (optional).

title: Baked Crackers
directions: Mix ingredients and pour over crackers., Bake at 200° for 1 hour., Stir every 20 minutes.

title: Cucumber Salad
directions: Slice cucumbers and onion., Toss with a dressing of remaining ingredients., Refrigerate for at least 2 hours before serving.

title: Baked French Donuts
directions: Mix butter and sugar until creamy., Add eggs., Sift dry ingredients and add to other mixture alternately with milk., Fill muffin tins 1/2 full., Bake at 350° for 25 minutes., Brush with melted butter., While hot, sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon. Makes about 12.

title: Hash Brown Potato Casserole
directions: Combine all ingredients. Spoon into buttered shallow 3-quart casserole. Bake at 350° until bubbly (about 1 hour).

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Boil chicken breasts until tender (1 hour)., Cool, deskin, debone and cut into bite-sized pieces., Set aside., Saute onions and butter., Add remaining ingredients except asparagus and almonds., Simmer until cheese melts., Add chicken and asparagus. Put into a 3-quart casserole and top with almonds., Bake at 350° unti bubbly (about 30 minutes).

title: Cream Cheese Cookies(For Christmas)
directions: Cream shortening until fluffy. Gradually add sugar and cream cheese making sure mixture is smooth. Beat in egg yolk, vanilla, and flour. Use a cookie press or chill until firm, roll and cut with decorative cutters. Decorate for the holiday. Bake at 375° for 15 minutes. Yield 3-4 dozen.

title: Any Flavor Slush
directions: Boil water., Stir in Jell-O and sugar until dissolved., Add pineapple juice and water., Freeze., Makes a gallon of frozen slush base., Scrape and serve with 7-Up.

title: Hot Chocolate Mix
directions: Mix thoroughly., Store in an airtight container., Use 1/4 cup of mix to a cup of boiling water.

title: Grandmother'S Homemade Noodles
directions: Bone raw fish and run through food chopper., Add vegetables, salt and pepper., Stir in milk, crumbs and egg., Mold into loaf and bake, uncovered, in fairly hot oven for 1/2 to 3/4 hour. Serve accompanied with sauce.

title: Dutch Apple Cake
directions: Cream butter with 7/8 cup of sugar., Add well beaten egg, then the milk and vanilla., Mix the dry ingredients together and add alternately to the milk mixture, beating thoroughly.

title: Quick Corn Chowder
directions: Saute the veggies in bacon drippings., Mix the soup and the milk and evaporated milk together and heat; add the sauteed veggies and heat through; don't boil., Serve in big soup cups. Makes 3 large soup cups or 4 small ones of chowder., Crumble bacon atop each as you serve the soup.

title: Fruited Ice Tea
directions: Combine instant tea powder and the cold water; stir until the tea is dissolved., Add sweetener, orange juice and lime juice. Mix thoroughly., Chill., Serve over ice in tall glasses., Makes 6 servings., Garnish with orange slices and fresh cranberries.

title: Oatmeal Caramel Bars
directions: Mix first six ingredients together and pat one-half of mixture into 9 x 13 pan., Melt caramels with evaporated milk. Pour over crust., Sprinkle nuts and chocolate chips over caramel mixture and top with remaining crust mixture., Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.

title: Cranberry Salad
directions: Dissolve Jello in 2 c. boiling water., Add the cherry syrup plus enough cold water to make 1 1/2 c., Put in the refrigerator to thicken., When partially set, add the cranberry sauce, cherries, cut in half, and the nuts, apples and marshmallows., Mix well., Refrigerate until set., This keeps well and can be made ahead.

title: Spinach Lasagna
directions: Grease a 9 x 13 x 2 1/2-inch casserole dish., Cook noodles; drain well., Make layer of noodles, layer of sauce, 1/2 cottage cheese, 1/3 of the nuts, layer of spinach, layer of Mozzarella and Parmesan, layer of sauce and layer of noodles., Repeat., Top with cheese and nuts.

title: Sugarless Blueberry Muffins
