directions: In a large mixing bowl, sift together the flour, salt, baking powder, cinnamon and nutmeg., In a small bowl, whisk together the eggs, oil and orange juice and add to the flour mixture., Before the flour and liquid ingredients are completely combined, fold in the blueberries, stirring gently., Fill well-greased muffin tin about 2/3 full., Bake in a preheated 400° oven for 20 to 25 minutes., Makes 12 muffins.

title: Spanish Chicken And Rice
directions: Heat oil in large skillet over medium heat., Add chicken, onion and pepper., Cook and stir until chicken is done., Add broth and tomatoes; bring to a boil., Stir in rice and cover., Simmer for 10 minutes., Remove from heat., Let stand 3 minutes., Makes 4 servings.

title: Nancy'S Macaroni Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients well., Refrigerate for several hours before serving., Vegetable may be changed to your favorites.

title: Glorified Rice
directions: Mix rice, water, juice and salt just to moisten in pan, then bring to quick boil., Cover and simmer 5 minutes., Add marshmallows, fruits and nuts., Cool to room temperature or in fridge., Fold in the cream., Chill at least 1 hour.

title: Vegetable Pizza
directions: To make pizza crust:, Spread rolls on greased jelly roll pan. Bake crust according to package directions.

title: Beef Cabbage Soup
directions: Combine all ingredients and cook until veggies are tender, about 1 hour.

title: Little Grandma'S Divinity
directions: In a 1 qt. heavy saucepan, combine sugar and corn syrup with 1/2 c. water, over low heat cook stirring until sugar is dissolved., Cover, cook 1 minute or until sugar crystallize on the side of pan melts., Uncover and bring to boil without stirring. Cook to 238° on candy thermometer or until a small amount in cold water forms a SOFT ball., Meanwhile in large bowl with an electric mixer at high speed, beat the egg whites with salt until stiff peaks form when beaters are slowly raised., In a thin stream, pour half of hot syrup over egg whites, beating constantly at high speed, until stiff peaks form., Continue cooking rest of syrup to 256° on candy thermometer (bringing it to 260° won't hurt), or until a small amount in cold water forms a HARD ball.

title: Max'S Hush Puppies
directions: Mix wet ingredients and add to mixed dry ingredients., Let rise for 1/2 hour., Spoon into 375° deep fat oil., Cook until golden brown., Remove and serve., Makes 30 hush puppies., *Hot peppers chopped into batter makes them good.

title: No Peek Beef Casserole
directions: In crock-pot, put all ingredients except wine., Mix together well., Cover and cook on low heat for 8 to 10 hours., During last hour of cooking, add wine and stir., Serve over egg noodles or rice.

title: Chicken A La King
directions: In a saucepan, cook mushrooms and green pepper in butter until pepper is tender. Blend in soup. Gradually stir, in milk., Add chicken and pimento., Heat, stirring now and then. Serve in patty shells or on toast.

title: Shrimp Spread
directions: Soften cream cheese to room temperature., Combine all ingredients, except bread., Beat until well blended., Chill until fairly stiff., Spread on pumpernickel rounds.

title: Six Weeks Bran Muffins
directions: Mix bran cereal, sugar, flour, baking soda and salt in a large bowl., Add eggs, oil and buttermilk., Mix well., Grease muffin tins and fill 2/3 full., Bake at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Chicken Chow Mein
directions: In saucepan, cook green pepper and celery in oleo until crisp. Stir in soup, water and soy sauce., Add vegetables and chicken; heat through., Serve with rice.

title: Lettuce Salad
directions: Tear lettuce into, small, pieces., Add nuts and berries and pour salad dressing over all and mix.

title: Mexican Corn Bread
directions: Brown meat and onion; drain., Grate cheese; set aside., Mix corn bread batter., Heat greased iron skillet., Put half batter in skillet, then add browned beef with onions., Sprinkle cheese on top of this., Add remaining batter., Cook approximately 1 hour. Be careful not to let cheese touch sides of skillet or it will stick when turned out.

title: Homemade Bread
directions: Mix all ingredients except flour and let stand until dissolved., Add about 1/2 the flour., Beat 5 minutes., Gradually add remaining flour to make a soft dough., Knead until smooth and no longer stretchy (about 10 minutes), adding a small amount of flour as needed., Place in greased bowl., Turn over to grease top. Cover with towel and let rise in warm place until double in size. Punch down; let rise again., Make into 5 or 6 loaves., Let rise. Bake at 400° for 45 minutes., This recipe will serve 40 people.

title: Taco Casserole
directions: Cook meat; mix taco season package in meat., Mix both cans of chili., Heat oven to 350°., First put some chips on bottom of pan. Make sure you mix chili with meat, then put meat with chili on top of chips., Put more chips on top.

title: Texas Hash
directions: Lightly brown meat; drain off grease., Add onion and peppers and cook with meat for about 5 minutes., Add remaining ingredients and mix well., Pour into greased casserole dish; cover., Bake 45 minutes., Last 15 minutes remove lid and spread desired amount of cheese on top.

title: Magic Bars
directions: Mix graham cracker crumbs with melted margarine and press lightly into a 13 x 9-inch pan.

title: Bread Starter
directions: Dissolve yeast in 1/2, cup, warm, water., Add, remaining ingredients., Leave at room temperature for 24 hours., Feed 3/4 cup sugar, 3 tablespoons instant potatoes and 1 cup warm water. Leave out 12 hours., Use 1 cup starter for baking and put 1 cup back in refrigerator.

title: Wanda'S Noodles
directions: Mix together very gently and place in a greased casserole. Sprinkle with grated cheese or cover with spaghetti sauce and meat., Bake at 350° for 40 minutes., Serves 12.

title: Green Rice Casserole
directions: Cook spinach according to directions; drain., Mix all ingredients together; put into a casserole bowl., Bake for 1 hour at 350°., (This will freeze.)

title: Slow Country Boil
directions: Fill pot half full of water., Add salt to Worcestershire sauce and margarine., Add sausage; boil 5 minutes., Add potatoes; boil 5 minutes., Add onions; boil 5 minutes., Lift strainer and check potatoes and onions for tenderness., Add corn; boil 5 minutes., Add shrimp boil and hot sauce; let come to boil., Remove vegetables after draining and place in a large container., Add medium size shrimp (1/2 pound per person); boil 3 minutes., Remove and serve. This is good for a family gathering.

title: Colorful Candy Popcorn Balls
directions: Pour popcorn, peanuts and M&M's into huge bowl., Mix. Put margarine and marshmallows in large microwavable bowl., Microwave on High 1 1/2 to 2 minutes., Using pot, remove bowl., Mix. Add Jell-O gelatin to marshmallow mixture., Stir until mixture is same color., Pour mixture over popcorn., Stir with spoon until popcorn is covered., Grease hands with margarine., Shape mixture into balls., Place on waxed paper until cool.

title: Greek Herbal Chicken
directions: Combine seasonings with butter., Rub butter seasonings onto chicken., Bake in slow 300° oven 1 1/4 hours., Serves 4.

title: Caramel Corn
directions: Melt butter with corn syrup in a 2-quart saucepan over medium heat., Add brown sugar and stir to dissolve., Cook syrup to hard ball stage., To check, drop some syrup into cup of cold water and when it forms a firm ball it is done., Takes about 5 minutes. Remove from heat and add baking soda, stirring to blend., Pour over popcorn; stir to coat evenly.

title: Caramel Corn
directions: Blend brown sugar, oleo, salt and Karo together and boil 8 minutes., Take pan off heat and add baking soda and butter., Into very large mixing bowl, pour mixture over 6 quarts popped corn. Peanuts or pecans can be added to popped corn., Mix thoroughly. Bake on 2 cookie sheets at 200° for 1 hour, stirring every 15 minutes., M - M - M - M - Good.

title: Better Baked Ziti
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., In a large bowl cook ziti until just barely tender; drain and place in a large bowl., Mix the Ricotta and 1/2 of Mozzarella cheese with ziti., Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan. Cover bottom of pan with 1/2 spaghetti sauce., Spoon the ziti mixture into pan., Cover with remaining sauce., Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and top with remaining Mozzarella., Bake 20 to 30 minutes until lightly brown.

title: Skillet Chicken In Golden Gravy
directions: Put oil in frypan., Brown chicken about 10 minutes each side. Take out of pan. Stir onion in and cook until tender., Blend in soup and water., Return chicken to pan and spoon soup mixture over chicken., Cover and cook about 30 minutes or until tender. Serve with noodles.

title: Cream Cheese Cake
directions: Cream butter and cheese., Add sugar., Add small amount of flour then 1 egg over and over until used up., Place in cold oven at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Meat Loaf
directions: Put hamburger, soup mix, crackers and barbecue sauce in mixing bowl., Beat egg in separate bowl., Mix together with hands until well mixed., Put in baking pan., Put in oven at 375° for about 30 to 45 minutes, or until light brown.

title: Mrs. Bratcher'S Cream Candy
directions: In a heavy deep pan mix sugar and salt., In a small bowl mix the half and half and baking soda., Add this to the sugar and salt., Blend well., Add 1/2 cup boiling water., Turn the heat on medium and begin stirring., Stir constantly until it begins to boil., You do not stir any more., Let boil until it reaches hard crack on a candy thermometer, or when dropped in a cup of cold water, it becomes a piece that when tapped on the cup will make an audible sound., (On my stove this is always 30 minutes.)

title: Easy Pralines
directions: Mix ingredients in heavy, 2-quart saucepan, then stir and cook over low heat until sugar dissolves., Then add pecans and stir and cook to a full, all-over boil., Then boil slowly about 3 to 5 minutes, stirring often, until candy reaches soft ball stage (234°)., Remove from heat and beat until candy thickens, but still looks shiny.

title: Harold'S Old Fashion Collard Greens
directions: Boil cured ham hocks until tender., Remove ham hocks from boiler., Add collard greens to liquid in boiler., Put ham hocks on top of greens., Then put bacon drippings in and bring to a boil. Simmer on low heat until tender., Add a pinch of salt and chopped onion.

title: Crab Delicious
directions: Melt butter in saucepan, add flour and mix well., Add milk and cook until creamy sauce forms, stirring constantly., Add seasoning, ketchup and crabmeat., Cook for 2 minutes. Add egg and cheese and mix well until cheese melts.

title: Ripe Tomato Relish
directions: Grind tomatoes, celery, onions and peppers through food chopper. Sprinkle with salt and let stand overnight., Drain., Add brown sugar, mustard, cinnamon and vinegar., Mix all together. Mix well and put in jars. Requires no cooking and will keep., This is a very good relish.

title: Shrimp Mold
directions: Heat soup., Melt in cream cheese. Stir or beat until smooth. Remove from stove. Add gelatin and remaining ingredients., Pour into mold., Refrigerate until firm, preferably overnight.

title: Apple Cakes
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Grease and flour 9 x 13-inch pan., Beat eggs well., Add remaining ingredients., Fold in apples (mixture will be thick)., Spread in pan., Bake 45 to 60 minutes or until toothpick stuck in middle of cake cakes out clean., Serve with vanilla ice cream or frozen yogurt., Makes 10 to 15 servings.

title: China Sun Pork
directions: Drain pineapple., Reserve 3 tablespoons of the juice., Mix reserved juice with 1/2 cup of water, soy sauce, cornstarch, vinegar and pepper flakes., Set aside.

title: Cold Dill Peas
directions: Cook and drain peas thoroughly., Mix together other ingredients very thoroughly., Carefully combine with peas. Chill and garnish with more dill or chives.

title: Blueberry Peach Coffeecake
directions: Preheat oven to 450°., Wash berries until blue color is gone. Drain peaches; lay on paper towel., Set juice aside., In small bowl, combine flour, sugar and cinnamon., Cut in margarine., Set aside., Make muffin batter, substituting juice along with liquid for correct amount., Pour into greased 8-inch pan., Cut peaches in half., Press into batter, fat-side up., Sprinkle berries on top. Add flour/sugar/cinnamon mixture over top., Bake 25 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Tortilla Roll-Ups
directions: Dice ham in a medium size bowl; add sour cream a little at a time so you will not get too much. Add chopped cream cheese and picante sauce. Mix ingredients well. Spread on flour tortillas and roll up. You may cut in half or leave whole.

title: My Mother'S Applesauce Spice Cake
directions: Cream shortening and sugar., Add applesauce and beaten egg. Mix and sift dry ingredients., Add nuts and combine the 2 mixtures., Bake in loaf pans 45 to 60 minutes at 350° to 375°.

title: Rich Cocoa Fudge
directions: Line an 8-inch or 9-inch square pan with foil; butter foil., In heavy 4-quart saucepan stir together sugar, cocoa and salt; stir in milk., Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly until mixture comes to full rolling boil., Boil without stirring to 234° or until syrup, when dropped into cold water, forms a soft ball which flattens when removed from water., (Bulb of candy thermometer shouldn't rest on bottom of pan.), Remove from heat., Add butter and vanilla., Do not stir., Cool at room temperature to 110° (lukewarm)., Beat with wooden spoon until fudge thickens and loses some gloss., Quickly spread into prepared pan., Cool; cut into squares., Makes 36 pieces; 1 3/4 pounds.

title: Chocolate Pie
directions: Mix sugar, flour and cocoa together in saucepan. Add milk, eggs, vanilla and margarine. Cook until thick; have to keep it stirred as you cook. Pour in baked pie shell. Top with meringue or Cool Whip.

title: Pumpernickel Dip
directions: Mix well and chill overnight., Cut top off pumpernickel round and carefully hollow out., Fill round with dip., Cut up the bread and use to dip.

title: Angel Biscuits
directions: The above measurements may be cut in half for smaller families.

title: Banana Split Pie
directions: Add 1 stick butter and graham cracker crumbs together; press in bottom of glass pan.

title: Spinach Dip
directions: Combine all ingredients and chill for several hours before serving.

title: Taco Salad
directions: Brown ground beef; drain., Add package of taco seasoning mix and about half of taco sauce., Simmer., Put tortilla chips on bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan, then ground beef mixture., Layer cheese on meat., Then add lettuce, onion and tomato., Mix remaining taco sauce and 1/2 of bottle of Zesty Italian dressing and pour over salad.

title: Strawberry Icing(Strawberries Make A Good Frosting.)
directions: Stem and wash strawberries., Crush in a medium sized bowl, and stir in sugar and lemon juice., Let stand until juicy, then gradually add powdered sugar., Whip until creamy.

title: Ham Roll-Ups
directions: Cream cheese, chilies, sour cream, picante sauce and ham together., Spread on flour tortillas and roll up into a roll. Place in Saran Wrap and place in refrigerator to cool, then cut in pieces and serve.

title: Sandies (Cookies)
directions: Cream butter and sugar; add 2 teaspoons water and vanilla., Mix well., Blend in flour and nuts; chill for 4 hours., Shape into ball or fingers., Bake on ungreased cookie sheets at 325° about 20 minutes., Remove from pan; cool slightly., Roll in confectioners sugar.

title: Yams And Apples For 50
directions: Combine sugar, 1/2 cup butter, salt and water., Bring to rolling boil, stirring constantly., Cook 2 to 3 minutes., Remove from heat., Slice cooked yams 1-inch thick., Slice apples 1/2-inch thick., Carefully arrange yams and apples in alternate layers in steam table pan., Pour over with syrup., Top with melted butter. Bake in 375° oven for 1 hour until apples are tender., May garnish with coconut.

title: Banana Cake
directions: Grease 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan and a small loaf pan., Place large marshmallows 2 inches apart in pan., Mix sugar, flour, soda and salt together., Add mashed bananas, shortening, buttermilk and vanilla., Mix thoroughly., Add unbeaten egg whites and mix thoroughly., Stir in chopped nuts. Carefully spoon over marshmallows in greased pans., Bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes, according to pans used.

title: Corn Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients together and let sit in refrigerator for 2 to 3 hours before serving., Really better made a day ahead.

title: Ginger Chicken Stir-Fry
directions: In skillet, over medium-high heat, in 2 tablespoons hot oil, stir-fry chicken until no longer pink; remove., Set aside., In same skillet, in remaining 1 tablespoon oil, stir-fry vegetables and garlic until tender-crisp.

title: Breakfast Pizza
directions: Place rolls in 9 x 13-inch ungreased pan; press into pan for crust., Fry sausage; pour off grease., Add onion and fry until tender., Mix eggs, milk and cheese with seasoning., Add sausage mixture., Pour into pan lined with rolls., Bake at 350° about 25 minutes.

title: Simple Salmon Pate
directions: In mixing bowl, blend all ingredients until smooth., Pack into small, oiled bowl., Chill overnight., Unmold and garnish with fresh parsley., Yields 3 pounds.

title: Breakfast Casserole
directions: Grease a 2-quart casserole dish., Combine sausage, cheese and croutons., Layer in bottom of dish., Mix remaining ingredients; pour over sausage, etc., Bake at 325° for 35 minutes., May be frozen before baking.

title: Microwave Banana Pudding
directions: Combine 3/4 cup sugar, flour and salt in 3-quart bowl; stir in milk., Microwave on High for 10 to 11 minutes, stirring about every minute and 30 seconds., Beat egg yolks., Gradually stir in hot mixture., Return to microwave; cook on High for 1 1/2 to 3 minutes, stirring every 20 seconds., Remove from microwave and stir in vanilla flavoring., Let custard cool partly before lining bottom of casserole dish with vanilla wafers and bananas., Pour a portion of custard over the bananas., Continue to layer wafers, bananas and custard, ending with custard on top.

title: Barbecued Wieners
directions: Mix together ingredients until well blended., Split 1 package hot dogs lengthwise, making sure not to cut completely through the hot dogs., Spoon some of the barbecue mixture into each hot dog and place in a flat pan, slightly touching each other., Pour any remaining sauce over the hot dogs., Bake 30 minutes in a 375° oven.

title: Steamed Crabs "Maryland Style"
directions: Put water and vinegar in 10-gallon pot., Place a layer of crabs on an elevated platform in the pot., Sprinkle each layer generously with seasoning mix., Put lid on pot and steam about 25 minutes.

title: Old-Fashioned Cookies(White)
directions: Cream shortening and sugar., Add egg and vanilla., Then add vinegar, and dry ingredients., Beat., Roll into balls size of walnuts., Press, down, with, bottom of glass., Dip glass in water or sugar, to prevent sticking., Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Buckeyes
directions: Mix powdered sugar, peanut butter and margarine in a large bowl using your hands., After the mixture is smooth, shape into balls and place in a cool area.

title: Super Fudge
directions: Heat honey and peanut butter., Quickly add carob and then all the seeds, coconut and fruit., Pour into greased 8 x 8-inch pan and refrigerate until it hardens., Cut into squares and keep refrigerated., Yields 25 squares.

title: Holiday Beef Dip
directions: Blend all ingredients except, the walnuts and turn into a shallow greased casserole, dish., Top, with, the walnuts and bake 20 minutes at 350°., Serve with a selection of crackers.

title: Southern Fried Chicken With Gravy
directions: Sift together flour, baking powder and salt., Beat eggs until fluffy., Add milk, salad oil and lemon juice., Add this mixture to flour mixture and blend., Pour 2 inches of oil into a large, heavy skillet and heat., Dip chicken pieces into batter and drop into hot oil., Reduce heat to medium and fry about 45 minutes, turning frequently to brown all sides of chicken., Remove chicken to platter., Pour most of oil from skillet., Add amount of milk desired for gravy, heat, stirring brown particles from bottom of skillet.

title: Joyce'S Gingerbread
directions: Cream eggs and sugar until smooth., Add molasses and water, blending well after each., Sift all dry ingredients and add, blending well., Stir in melted shortening and boiling water., When all ingredients are mixed well, pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes., When cake is cool, sprinkle with powdered sugar or eat plain.

title: Sour Cream Pecans
directions: Mix sugar, sour cream and vanilla in a large pot., Stir and bring to a boil., Boil 3 minutes, stirring often., Pour in roasted pecans., Stir until liquid is absorbed., Pour onto waxed paper; separate so pecans will dry without sticking together., Allow to dry., Store in airtight container.

title: Sherbet
directions: Mix in 1 gallon ice cream freezer and churn freezer until hard., Let sit 10 to 15 minutes., Serve.

title: Short 'N Sweet Peach Crisp
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Place peaches in greased shallow 1-quart baking dish., Sift dry ingredients together., Add egg; mix with fork and spread over peaches., Bake 30 minutes., Serves 6 to 8.

title: Party Cheese Ball
directions: Combine softened cream cheese and shredded Cheddar cheese., Mix until well blended, add remaining., Mix well., Chill overnight. Shape into ball., Roll in fine chopped nuts.

title: Banana Pudding
directions: Slice bananas into 1/2-inch slices., Arrange bananas and wafers in the bottom of a large bowl., Mix milk, cold water and Jell-O in a separate bowl., In another bowl, whip the cream with an electric mixer until fluffy., Fold the cream into the pudding mixture. Slice the 3 bananas into 1/2-inch slices and add to pudding mixture., Next, add the 36 wafers and mix well., Pour the mixture over the bananas and wafers that have been arranged in the bowl. Garnish the top of the pudding with additional banana slices and wafers., Refrigerate for at least 1 hour.

title: Steve'S Snickerdoodles
directions: Blend shortening, sugar and eggs., Add flour, baking soda, cream of tartar and salt. Mix well., Roll mixture into balls., In sandwich bag shake together the 4 tablespoons of sugar and 2 teaspoons of cinnamon., Place balls into bag and shake., Put balls on ungreased cookie sheet., Bake at 375° for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Homemade Spaghetti Sauce
directions: Brown in 5-quart Dutch oven:, ground beef, onion, garlic clove and green pepper., Drain off excess grease., Add tomatoes, tomato paste, brown sugar, parsley, oregano leaves, salt, cracked pepper and bay leaf., Bring to a boil., Reduce heat to medium-low. Partially cover and cook 30 minutes., Discard the bay leaf., Best over thin spaghetti noodles.

title: Chicken Ala King
directions: Melt butter, blend in flour, salt and pepper., Gradually stir in broth., Heat and stir until thick., Add all other ingredients. Serve over pastry shells.

title: Spicy Shrimp Dip
directions: Cook, peel and chop shrimp into small bite size pieces, enough to make 2 cups; set aside., Mix chili sauce, Worcestershire sauce, horseradish (found in the dairy products at most grocers) and lemon juice., Place cream cheese on platter., Mix shrimp into sauce and pour over cream cheese., Chill., Serve with your favorite crackers.

title: Sourdough Starter
directions: Combine flour, sugar and dry yeast in large bowl., Gradually add warm water and beat until smooth., Cover with Saran Wrap., Let stand in warm place for 2 days., To use in bread recipe as directed to replenish starter, add to the remaining starter 1 1/2 cups flour and 1 cup warm water., Beat until smooth., Cover and keep in a warm place., Stir before using., If not used in 1 week, remove 1 1/2 cups starter and follow directions for replenishing.

title: Corn Pudding
directions: Melt, margarine, in casserole dish and add to remaining ingredients., Bake at 350° until set.

title: Chicken And Rice Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients except chicken and cheese in casserole dish. Place chicken on top and bake at 350° for 1 hour or until done. Remove and add grated cheese over top of casserole. Return to oven until cheese melts.

title: Cranberry Salad
directions: Grind the cranberries, orange and orange peel., Add the sugar and mix well., Let stand overnight., Mix the Jell-O and water. When half set, add to cranberry mixture., Then add remaining ingredients., Pour into mold and set in refrigerator until completely set.

title: Raw Apple Cake
directions: Mix dry ingredients in a large bowl., Cream sugar, oil and eggs until well blended., Gradually add dry ingredients to creamed mixture., Stir in apples and nuts., Pour into greased and floured Bundt cake pan., Bake for 1 hour and 10 minutes in a cold 350° oven., Top with glaze.

title: Baked Salmon In Sour Cream
directions: Season salmon., Cover with capers, lemon juice and vinegar. Spread with sour cream., Arrange slices of lemon on top, sprinkle with seasoned salt and paprika., Bake at 350 degrees for 20 minutes., Serves 4.

title: Garden Vegetable Pasta
directions: In a 10-inch skillet over medium heat in hot oil, cook mushrooms and green onions with garlic until tender and liquid is evaporated, stirring often., Stir in mixed vegetables, tomatoes, half and half, cheese and basil., Add spaghetti., Heat through, stirring occasionally.

title: Lucky To Have Any Left
directions: Mix flour, margarine and pecans together., Spread in a 9 x 13-inch pan and bake at 375° until light brown. Cool completely.

title: Confetti Pie
directions: In a 9-inch pie pan, mix sugar and graham cracker crumbs., Mix in butter., Press mixture firmly and evenly against sides and bottom of pie pan., Set aside in refrigerator.

title: Pa'S Favorite Sweet Potato Pie
directions: Combine all ingredients except pie shell., Blend well with electric mixer., Pour into pie shell., Bake in preheated oven at 400° for about 30 minutes or until golden and puffy., Top with whipped cream.

title: Scampi Primavera
directions: Cut carrots into 2-inch thin strips., Cut zucchini and red pepper into thin strips., Cook pasta as directed., Heat oil in large skillet; cook and stir garlic and lemon peel about 30 seconds., Add vegetables and shrimp., Stir over medium heat until shrimp turn pink, about 3 to 4 minutes., Sprinkle with lemon juice, salt and pepper., Stir in basil and parsley., Spoon over pasta; toss well., Serves 8.

title: Peanut Brittle
directions: Cook sugar, syrup and hot water over medium heat until it spins a thread., Add peanuts., Cook until peanuts are brown and syrup starts to turn., Add butter and soda., Pour on a greased cookie sheet (the thinner on sheet the better).

title: Easy Pound Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients (save eggs for last and mix one at a time)., Pour into a greased and floured tube pan and bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Easy Chili
directions: Mix all ingredients in large pot over medium heat just until starts to boil, stirring frequently., Reduce heat and simmer for about 1 hour.

title: Cabbage Rolls
directions: Mix rice, ground beef and onion., Steam cabbage in pot of hot water., Drain and gently remove leaves., Put tablespoon of mixture on leaf and roll., Place in casserole dish., Add tomato sauce and 1/2 cup water., (Use water that cabbage was steamed in.), Cover and bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Cauliflower Salad
directions: Layer the ingredients in a dish.

title: Pear Butter
directions: Cook 4 hours in crock pot. Put in pint jars and seal.

title: Garlic Pretzels
directions: Break up pretzels., Mix all other ingredients., Place pretzels in large baking dish., Pour mixture evenly over pretzels., Bake at 300° for 10 minutes., Stir and bake for 10 more minutes., Cool and store in airtight container.

title: Sausage Balls
directions: Combine sausage, eggs, stuffing mix and sage., Mix thoroughly. Shape into balls., In dry skillet, brown all sides and drain on paper towels., Drain fat from skillet., Add catsup, chili sauce, soy sauce, brown sugar, vinegar and water; stir well., Return meatballs to skillet; cover and simmer 30 minutes., Refrigerate or may be frozen., When ready to serve, reheat.

title: Beef Stroganoff
directions: Mix beef, salt, pepper and A. 1. sauce together., Form a loaf. Place on a rack over a pan with a small amount of water., Cover with foil., Bake at 350° until done., Remove from oven and let cool., Prepare gravy lite, using double the amount of water called for., Add vinegar, bay leaf, garlic powder and mushrooms., Simmer until mushrooms are tender., Remove from heat., Crumble meat into the gravy mix., Stir in the milk and continue to stir until milk is dissolved., Place 1/2 cup cooked noodles on plate., Pour meat mixture over all., Remove bay leaf before serving.

title: Spinach Casserole
directions: Stir, all ingredients together., Place in casserole and bake 30 to 45 minutes at 350°.

title: Amaretto Cream
directions: In a 1 to 2-quart pan, sprinkle gelatin over water; let stand for 5 minutes to soften., Heat over medium heat for 30 seconds or until mixture begins to simmer., Remove from heat., In a small mixer bowl, beat eggs on high speed for 2 minutes or until slightly thick., Slowly beat in sugar, liqueur and gelatin., In a large mixer bowl, beat cream until it mounds softly., Add egg mixture and fold in to blend., Pour into a 1-quart mold or into individual serving dishes., Refrigerate for 3 hours or until mold is set. Unmold onto serving plate or serve from individual dishes., Garnish with fresh sliced strawberries and mint, if available., Sprinkle servings with toasted almonds.

title: Pineapple Cheese Ball
directions: Mix all ingredients together and shape into a ball., Roll in chopped walnuts and place cherry on top., Garnish with parsley and serve with assorted crackers., The cheese ball freezes well.

title: Easy Creamy Pasta
directions: Cook the pasta according to the package directions., Drain well., Pour the pasta into a large bowl and quickly add the margarine, heavy cream and about half of the Parmesan cheese., Toss until well mixed., Serve immediately topped with pepper and the remaining cheese., Serves 5 to 6 people.

title: Broccoli Puff
directions: Stir together soup, cheese, milk, mayonnaise and eggs., Pour over broccoli., Sprinkle cracker crumbs over top., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Cranberry Jelly
directions: In kettle, combine cranberry juice and pectin., Bring to full, rolling boil., Stir in sugar., Bring again to boil., Boil hard, uncovered, 1 minute, stirring constantly., Remove from heat., Stir in lemon juice., Skim off foam., Pour into hot, sterilized jars. Cover with hot wax or water seal.

title: Cracker Candy
directions: Cover a 9 x 13-inch cookie sheet with foil and line with saltine crackers. Boil the butter with the sugar for 3 to 4 minutes., Stir constantly., Pour over saltine crackers and bake for 10 minutes at 350° (until bubbly and brown)., Spread the chocolate chips on top and spread until completely covering butter mixture., Put in refrigerator until cool., Break into small pieces., Enjoy!, Keep in airtight container.

title: Shrimp Pasta Salad
directions: Combine bouillon granules, water, white wine, lemon, onion, garlic, bay leaves and red pepper flakes., Bring to a boil; add shrimp and cook 3 to 5 minutes., Remove shrimp from broth, reserving broth., Rinse shrimp under cold water., Chill., Peel and devein., Set aside., Strain broth mixture, reserving 1/2 cup liquid and garlic., Discard lemon, onion and bay leaves., Add reserved liquid and cook macaroni according to package directions., Drain. Rinse under cold water and drain again.

title: Jello Dessert
directions: Beat the Jell-O; blend in cream and pineapple and set.

title: Zucchini Frittata
directions: Wash and grate zucchini into a bowl., Mince garlic and shallot and saute in oil until soft., Wash spinach and shake dry., Drain off excess moisture from zucchini., Add with spinach and seasonings to pan and cook until softened and liquid is absorbed.

title: Hot Fudge Sauce
directions: Heat butter and cocoa in top of a double boiler until melted. Stir in salt and sugar in small amounts., Blend well after each portion; then stir in milk and vanilla very slowly., Cook until it gets thick.

title: Pan-Fried Cabbage
directions: Pan-fried cabbage is simple and delicious., It can also be incorporated into a vegetarian appetizer or main dish strudel.

title: Peppery Cheese Spread
directions: Combine all ingredients and beat with a hand mixer until thoroughly mixed., Pack into covered crock and refrigerate.

title: Sweet Potato Muffins
directions: Preheat oven to 400°., Grease muffin pan., Cream butter, sugar and eggs; mix well., Blend in sweet potatoes., Sift flour, baking powder, salt and spices., Add to other mixture alternating with milk., Do not overmix., Fold in nuts and raisins., Fill tins 1/2 full., Bake 25 minutes., Batter can be made ahead and refrigerated for 3 or 4 days.

title: Golden Potato Salad
directions: Combine potatoes, celery, eggs, pimiento and seasonings., Add combined salad dressing and mustard; mix lightly., Chill.

title: Chicken Enchiladas
directions: Spread 1/2 can enchilada sauce in 3-quart oblong baking dish. Set aside. Combine chicken, 1 cup cheese, chilies and onion. Spread about 1/3 cup mixture along one side of tortilla. Roll jelly roll fashion and place seam side down in dish. Pour remaining 1/2 can of enchilada sauce over enchiladas. Sprinkle remaining 1/2 cup of cheese on top. Cover with foil and bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

title: Hot Dog Sauce
directions: Cook in crock-pot for 1 hour., Add hot dogs.

title: Potato Ragout
directions: Put bacon in saucepan, cover with cold water and bring to a boil., Drain bacon; dry on paper towels., Saute bacon in heavy skillet for 3 to 5 minutes., Remove all but 2 tablespoons fat., Add onions and garlic., Cook until onions are transparent., Add potatoes, stock, tarragon and salt and pepper to taste., Cover and simmer 15 minutes or until potatoes are tender, but not mushy, and liquid is absorbed., Add vinegar and oil and toss lightly. Sprinkle with parsley; serve hot., Serves 6.

title: Swiss Pork Chops
directions: Pour over pork chops in baking pan. Bake 1 hour at 375° or until chops are done., May be used over other meats such as steak, beef or pork roast.

title: Birthday Party Punch
directions: Mix all juices at least 3 hours before., Pour ginger ale just before serving., Pour over ice or sherbet.

title: Cream Taco
directions: Mix all ingredients together in crock-pot except whipping cream., Heat until cheese is melted, stirring occasionally., Add whipping cream to mixture 1/2 hour before serving., Stir., Serve over Fritos or tortilla chips.

title: Parisian Sweets
directions: Put fruit and nuts through food chopped, then mix with orange juice and honey., Press well together and let stand in cool place for 24 hours., Shape into balls and roll in grated sweet chocolate, coconut or chopped nuts.

title: Tuna Casserole
directions: Combine first five ingredients., Pour into casserole and top with remaining potato chips., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Party Mix
directions: Melt, margarine,, then	add, sugar., When, syrupy,, add peanut butter., Peanut, butter burns easily, so keep stirring over, low heat., Place cereals, pretzels and nuts in roasting and, baking pans., (I, use top and bottom of roasting pan and two, 9, x 13-inch pans.) Pour melted mixture over cereals; mix well.	Bake in	a, 250°, oven, for, a, couple of hours, until cereals, are dry and crispy., While baking, mix every 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Banana Nut Bread
directions: Cream shortening and sugar, add eggs and beat well., Sift all dry ingredients together and add to mixture alternately with bananas., Stir in nuts., Bake in well-greased loaf pan for 40 to 45 minutes in 350° oven., Remove from pan and cool.

title: Best Meat Loaf Ever
directions: Mix thoroughly 1/2 cup soup, beef, bread crumbs, onion, egg and salt., Shape firmly into an 8 x 4-inch loaf; place in shallow baking pan., Bake at 375° for 1 hour and 15 minutes., Blend remaining soup, water and drippings., Heat; stir occasionally. Serve with meat loaf., Makes 6 servings.

title: Chocolate Gravy
directions: Mix the dry ingredients; add milk., Stir and cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until smooth and creamy (gravy consistency)., Serve over hot buttered biscuits.

title: Spinach With Crab Meat
directions: In a small saucepan, cook spinach over low heat without adding water., In a skillet heat oil., Add onion and chilies., Fry for 3 or 4 minutes until lightly browned., Add garlic and cook 1 minute. Stir in crab meat and turmeric., Cook 1 minute., Stir in spinach and cook 5 minutes over low heat., Add salt., Sprinkle with lime juice and serve immediately with rice., Yields 4 servings.

title: Graham Cracker Treats
directions: Put in saucepan and boil 2 minutes the margarine, butter, sugar and nuts., Line crackers on cookie sheet. Pour mixture over crackers., Bake only 7 minutes at 350°, being careful not to burn them.

title: Candied Carrots With Apples
directions: Cook carrots in salted water until tender; drain., Place in a greased, 1-quart casserole., Put apples on top., Sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon., Dot with butter., Bake at 325° for 40 minutes.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Cream butter and brown and white sugar together., Add egg, water, vanilla, flour, salt and soda., Beat well., Stir in oats, raisins and nuts., Drop by teaspoon on greased cookie sheet., Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes., Makes 5 dozen.

title: Fruit Pizza(Great Item For A Brunch)
directions: Spread cookie dough in a 9-inch pizza pan or cookie sheet. Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Nut Bread
directions: Mix sugar with eggs, then add milk., Stir in flour with the salt and baking powder., Add nuts., Bake 1 hour at 350°.

title: Potato Soup
directions: Cube six cups potatoes. Top off each cup with water, and pour one by one into soup kettle. Slice 1 carrot, 1 stalk celery, and diced 1 onion. Put in cup and top off with water and put in soup kettle. Cook until tender. Add 2 chicken bouillon cubes and simmer until dissolved. Add 1 cup condensed, 1/2 stick butter, and salt and pepper to taste, bring to simmer, serve.

title: Mexican Rice
directions: Saute garlic, onion and bell pepper in oil until tender-crisp. Add rice and brown slightly., Add tomatoes, then liquid., Add 1 teaspoon chili powder and salt and pepper to taste., Bring to boil, cover and simmer for 15 minutes or until done.

title: Beef Stew
directions: Dump all the ingredients into crock-pot., Cover and set on high., Cook for 6 to 8 hours., Test for doneness and stir a couple of times.

title: Peanut Butter Temptations
directions: Cream butter, peanut butter, sugar, egg and vanilla. Stir in dry ingredients. Blend and roll into 1-inch balls. Press into 1/2-inch muffin tin. Bake at 350° for 12 minutes. Remove from the oven and press 1, candy into each hot cookie. Allow to cool. Makes 4 dozen.

title: Delicious Lo-Fat Quiche
directions: Prepare pastry., Sprinkle bacon, cheese and onion in pastry lined pie plate., Beat eggs slightly; beat in remaining ingredients., Pour egg mixture into pie plate., Cook uncovered in 425° oven for 15 minutes., Reduce oven temperature to 300°., Cook uncovered until knife inserted halfway between center and edge comes out clean (about 30 minutes)., Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

title: Love Bars
directions: Mix, the, sugar, raisins, water, oleo and cinnamon in a pan and, bring to a boil., Add the soda dissolved in 1 tablespoon, hot water., Slowly, boil, 5 minutes (watch closely; it will, boil over)., Remove from heat., Add the chopped nuts and cool., Sift the, flour	and, baking, powder into mixture; mix well., Spread into, greased and floured pan., Bake 25 minutes at 350°.

title: Vegetable Salad
directions: Cut vegetables into pieces., Put in chopped onions., Break bacon into small pieces., Cut cheese into cubes., Then add all ingredients together; mix well.

title: Chocolate Chip Zucchini Bread
directions: Combine sugars, butter and oil in a large bowl. Add eggs, vanilla and buttermilk; mix well. Sift the flour and cocoa into a bowl, then add to sugar mixture. Add grated zucchini and mix well. Mix in chocolate chips, saving some to sprinkle on top. Bake at 350° in a greased and floured 13-inch pan for 45 minutes or until knife comes out clean.

title: Rhubarb Custard Pie
directions: Line a 9-inch pie plate with pastry., Mix the sugar, flour, nutmeg and salt; add to beaten eggs., Beat until smooth., Stir in rhubarb; dot with 1 tablespoon butter., Bake at 400° for 40 to 50 minutes, or until pie is "set" and lightly browned.

title: New Year'S Black-Eyed Peas And Sausage
directions: Fry bacon., Drain grease, leaving 2 tablespoons in pan., Add celery, green pepper, onion and garlic to the bacon drippings and saute until onion is clear., Transfer to Dutch oven and add peas, water, salt, pepper and tomato., While bringing peas to a boil, fry sausage and drain well., Add sausage to peas and simmer for 40 minutes or until desired thickness of broth.

title: Herbed Cheese Puffs
directions: In medium saucepan, combine 1 cup water, butter and salt. Bring to boil, then remove from heat., Add flour and cayenne pepper all at once and beat vigorously with a wooden spoon until dough is smooth., Return to low heat and stir continuously for 5 minutes or until the mixture pulls away from the sides and forms a ball.

title: Salmon Loaf
directions: Flake salmon, discarding bones., Combine salmon, bread crumbs, chopped onion, oleo, salt and pepper., Mix well., Combine milk and egg., Shape into a loaf and bake at 350° in a greased loaf pan for 35 to 45 minutes., If desired, serve with cheese sauce.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
directions: Beat eggs until thick and fluffy., Mix sugar and oil; beat into eggs., Mix together flour, cinnamon, soda and salt., Add to the egg mixture., Stir in walnuts., Peel and core apples; slice into greased pan 9 x 12-inch., Pour batter over apples., Bake at 350° for 1 hour., Ice with cream cheese icing.

title: Cranberry Jello
directions: Cook cranberries in 1 cup of water. Add 1 cup of sugar. Cook 5 minutes or until cranberries split.

title: Pumpkin Cookies
directions: Combine flour, oats, baking soda and cinnamon. Cream butter. Add sugars., Beat until light and fluffy., Add egg and vanilla. Alternate dry ingredients with pumpkin, mixing well after each addition., Stir in chocolate chips and raisins. Bake in a 350° oven for 20 to 25 minutes until firm and lightly browned.

title: Sliced Baked Potatoes
directions: Peel potatoes, if skins are tough, otherwise just scrub, rinse and dry., Cut potatoes into thin slices, but not all the way through., Use a handle of a wooden spoon to prevent knife from cutting all the way., Put in baking dish; fan them slightly. Sprinkle with salt., Drizzle with butter., Sprinkle with herbs.

title: Liver And Onions
directions: Place liver in a strainer. Let cold water run over liver to wash it until it's clear. Place oil in skillet. Heat it slowly. Mix milk and egg; beat well. In another bowl, mix flour, salt and pepper. Place liver in milk mixture, then dip well in flour mixture. Place in hot oil. Turn stove to medium or lower. Cook until liver is brown on both sides, then place your sliced onions on top. Add 1/2 cup water. Cover and simmer 1/2 hour. Turn over once while it steams.

title: Jello Punch
directions: Heat water, sugar and jello., Add pineapple juice and orange juice., Mix well and freeze., Take from freezer 3 hours before serving and add ginger ale or Sprite just before serving.

title: Rhubarb Pie
directions: Mix first 5 ingredients and let stand while making the crust. Pour mixture into pie crust. Sprinkle with nutmeg. Bake until a knife comes out clean. Bake at 375° for 15 minutes. Then at 325° for 45 minutes.

title: Bacon, Egg And Cheese Casserole
directions: Butter a 9 x 13-inch casserole., Arrange buttered bread crumbs on the bottom., Top with grated cheese, then the meat., Blend milk and seasonings; pour evenly over bread, cheese and meat., Cover and refrigerate overnight., Bake at 350° for 35 minutes, or until golden brown on top., Sausage or ham may be substituted for bacon.

title: Shrimp Dip
directions: Mix all ingredients together and refrigerate until ready to use.

title: Chicken Enchiladas
directions: Cook butter in skillet until melted., Sprinkle in flour., This makes a paste., Add broth; stir all together., Add sour cream. This will be thick and creamy.

title: Glazed Chicken Wings
directions: Cut, each, wing, at, joint to make 3 pieces, discard the wing tips., Place, wings, in shallow container.	Mix remaining ingredients., Pour	over, wings,, reserving 1/4 cup., Cover and refrigerate, 8 to 10 hours, turning occasionally., Put wings in shallow baking dish and drizzle the reserved 1/4 cup over them. Cook at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Golden Chiffon Cake
directions: Step 1:, Mix flour, sugar, baking powder and salt., Add oil, egg yolks, cold water and vanilla or lemon., Beat well.

title: Garlic Cheese Biscuits
directions: Combine biscuit mix, half of melted butter, milk, cheese and half of garlic powder., Mix until soft dough forms., Drop dough by spoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet., Bake at 450° for 8 to 10 minutes, or until golden brown., Mix remainder of butter and garlic powder and brush over warm biscuits before removing from cookie sheet., Makes 10 to 12 biscuits.

title: Stuffed Potato Skins
directions: Preheat oven to 450°. Brush the potatoes all over with oil. Prick them in several place on all sides with a fork. Place in a baking dish. Bake until tender, about 1 1/2 hours.

title: Marinated Vegetable Salad(Low-Fat)
directions: Cut vegetables up in large bowl., Marinate in Kraft free Italian dressing (small bottle)., Salt and pepper to taste., Keep in refrigerator.

title: Fruit Cake Squares
directions: In a small saucepan, melt oleo., Pour into a 15 x 10 x 1-inch baking pan; spread evenly by tilting., Sprinkle crushed vanilla wafers evenly over oleo., Arrange nuts and fruits over crumb mix and press down gently., Mix sweetened condensed milk and other milk and pour evenly over top., Bake in 350° oven for 20 to 25 minutes or until set., Cool; cut into squares., Makes 60 squares.

title: Hush Puppies
directions: Mix well., Drop by teaspoonfuls into hot fat (375°) and fry until golden brown., This makes about 2 dozen.

title: Moist N' Chewy Brownies
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., In a large saucepan sprayed with Pam or other pure vegetable cooking spray, over low heat, melt chocolate chips and butter. Stir occasionally until well blended., Remove from heat., Add baking mix, sweetened condensed milk and egg. Stir well. Stir in walnuts. Spray Pam on bottom and sides of a 13 x 9-inch baking pan or dish., Pour brownie mixture into dish., Bake 20 to 30 minutes., Cool slightly, then cut into squares.

title: Green Bean Casserole
directions: In a 1 1/2-quart casserole dish, mix soup, milk, soy sauce, pepper, beans and 1/2 can onions., Bake at 350° for 25 minutes or until hot., Stir., Sprinkle remaining onions over bean mixture. Bake 5 minutes or until onions are golden., Serves 6.

title: Sweet Cherry Relish
directions: Combine all fruits and put through food chopper., Sprinkle with sugar., Cover and let stand several hours or overnight in refrigerator., Serve as relish for cold meats or as a dessert topping., Makes 1 pint.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Cook broccoli according to package directions., Drain well. Mix broccoli, onion, soup, mayonnaise, eggs and cheese., Put into casserole dish., Cut butter into pieces and arrange over mixture. Crush crackers and cover top of casserole., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes., Let stand about 20 minutes before serving.

title: Potato Crust Quiche
directions: Cook potatoes, covered, in boiling salted water until tender. Drain and mash., Stir in butter and spoon into a greased 9-inch pie plate., Spread over bottom and up sides, building up sides with a spoon to form a crust., Arrange vegetables in bottom of potato crust., Sprinkle with cheese., In a small bowl, combine eggs, milk, salt and pepper., Pour over cheese and sprinkle with bread crumbs or wheat germ., Bake at 375° for 40 to 50 minutes.

title: Arrie'S Brownies
directions: Melt chocolate and oleo over low heat; set aside to cool., Mix sugar and eggs until slightly fluffy., Add chocolate, oleo, flour, baking powder, salt and vanilla., Mix well., Last, add walnuts. Bake in a 9 x 9 x 2-inch pan in a preheated 300° oven., Bake 30 minutes., Cool in pan; cut into squares., This recipe may be doubled, if so desired.

title: Easy Pie Crust
directions: Cut shortening into flour and salt with pastry blender or fork until mixture is consistency of cornmeal., Sprinkle water over mixture; blend lightly with fork., Use as little water as possible., Form into 2 balls., Roll out between 2 layers of waxed paper, that have been sprinkled with flour., Makes 2 (8-inch) shells or one double pie crust.

title: Strawberry Pie
directions: Cream the cheese, sugar and milk until fluffy; spread on bottom of pie shell and set aside.

title: Chow Mein Paulene
directions: Brown meat; add soy sauce and 1 cup water., Simmer, then add onion and celery., Simmer 1 1/2 hours., Blend cornstarch and water and add to mixture., Add chestnuts, mushrooms and bean sprouts. Heat through., Serve over rice or chow mein noodles.

title: Pumpkin Bread
directions: Combine sugars, pumpkin, oil and eggs., Mix until well blended., Add flour, soda, salt and spices., Mix well., Stir in walnuts., Pour into well-oiled loaf pan., Bake at 350°, for 65 to 70 minutes.

title: Corn-Stuffed Pork Chops
directions: Cut a pocket in each chop., Or use butterfly chops., Season cavity with salt and pepper.

title: Monkey Bread
directions: Combine sugar, 1 teaspoon cinnamon and chopped nuts., Shake biscuits in this mixture (cut biscuits in quarters before shaking in the mixture)., Arrange in angel cake pan., Boil brown sugar, oleo and 1 1/2 teaspoons cinnamon., Pour over biscuits., Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Moist Pumpkin Bread
directions: Put, all, dry, ingredients, in bowl and add oil, water, pumpkin and eggs., Add nuts last., Grease and flour 5 small or 2 large, baking pans., Divide batter into pans and bake 1 hour at 350° or until top is no longer moist.

title: Sour Cream Cheese Enchiladas
directions: Fry tortillas in oil until soft., Place some cheese and onion in each shell and roll., Place, seam side down, in lightly greased cake size pan.

title: Sweet And Sour Chicken And Rice
directions: Cut up chicken into cubes., Put in skillet and cook until chicken is no longer pink., Add all ingredients and cook on low heat. Boil rice and mix rice with chicken mixture.

title: Roll-Out Sugar Cookies
directions: Cream the sugar and butter., Add the egg, salt and vanilla. Blend in the flour., Refrigerate dough at least 1 hour before using (can be overnight)., Roll thin on floured surface., Cut out cookies., Bake at 350° until lightly browned., Decorate or frost.

title: Seasoned Seeds
directions: Remove membrane from seeds., Wash and pat dry., Place in a 9-inch glass pie plate., Add remaining ingredients., Microwave on High for 8 to 10 minutes until slightly toasted, stirring 4 to 5 times.

title: Seven-Layer Salad
directions: Beginning with lettuce, layer each ingredient on top of the other in oblong dish., Spread the mayonnaise over the layer of hard-boiled eggs., Sprinkle shredded Cheddar cheese on top of mayonnaise., Add bacon bits if desired., Cover and set in refrigerator overnight before serving.

title: Broccoli-Cauliflower Salad
directions: Break the cauliflower and broccoli into small flowerets into a bowl., Cut up onion, real, fine, and, then, add chopped tomatoes. Mix together the, mayonnaise, sour cream, sugar and vinegar., Pour over vegetables., Mix well and chill.

title: Pillsbury Oreo Cake And Icing
directions: Mix cake and add cookie crumbs., Bake in layers or 9 x 13-inch pan, greased and floured, at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes., Cool 10 minutes in pan before removing or frost in the pan.

title: Pennies From Heaven
directions: Mix tomato soup, oil, sugar, vinegar, mustard, Worcestershire sauce, salt and pepper., Pour over cooked carrots, bell pepper and onions., Toss slightly and refrigerate overnight before serving.

title: Mocha Frosting
directions: Dissolve coffee and cinnamon in hot water., Mix all ingredients together with a hand-held mixer until desired spreading consistency.

title: Sweet Broccoli Salad
directions: Break broccoli into florets and chop some of the stems into small pieces. Mix broccoli, raisins, pecans and onion in a salad bowl. Refrigerate. Mix mayonnaise, sugar and vinegar in a bowl. Let stand, covered, in the refrigerator overnight. Pour dressing over the salad just before serving.

title: Sawdust Pie
directions: Mix egg whites, sugar, crumbs, pecans and coconut., Stir by hand., Pour into unbaked pie crust., Bake in a preheated 325° oven until glossy and set, about 25 to 30 minutes., Do not overbake. Serve warm with whipped cream.

title: Crabbies
directions: Split muffins., Mix all ingredients and spread on 12 muffin halves, then cut each muffin half into eight., Broil or freeze (then heat).

title: Cranberry Pork Chops(Serves 4)
directions: Flour chops and brown in a small amount of hot oil in skillet. Mix rest of ingredients and pour over chops. Cover and simmer for 1 hour or until fork tender.

title: Smoke Sausage And Cabbage
directions: Cut cabbage in quarters; cut sausage in 2-inch lengths., In, a large pot, pour in 3 cups water, 1 tablespoon salt and sausage pieces., Bring to a boil on medium heat., Reduce heat; put cabbage in water and cover., Cabbage should be done in about 25 minutes.

title: Crunchy Potato Balls
directions: In a bowl, combine the potatoes, ham, cheese, mayonnaise, egg, mustard and pepper; mix well., Add enough of the flour to make a stiff mixture., Chill., Shape into 1 inch balls; roll in cornflakes., Place on a greased baking sheet., Bake at 350° for 25-30 minutes or until heated through. Serve hot.

title: Maple Pecan-Glazed Sweet Potatoes(Low-Fat)
directions: In small bowl, combine 2 tablespoons of the apple juice and the cornstarch; mix well., Set aside., In large skillet or Dutch oven, combine remaining apple juice, syrup, cinnamon, margarine and salt; mix well., Bring to a boil., Add potatoes; stir to coat well. Return to a boil., Reduce heat; cover and simmer 8 to 10 minutes or just until potatoes are tender., Stir cornstarch mixture into potato mixture; cook and stir over medium-high heat until bubbly and thickened.* Pour into ungreased 8-inch square (1 1/2-quart) baking dish; cover tightly with foil., Refrigerate up to 24 hours.

title: Sweet And Sour Salad Dressing
directions: Pour all ingredients into a pint jar with a tight lid., Shake well, until mixed., Set in refrigerator for a few days (the longer, the better)., This thickens with age., Use on fruit, cole slaw or just over lettuce.

title: Sweet Potato Pie(Makes 8 Servings. Prep Time: 15 Minutes.)
directions: Bake potatoes in microwave, allowing about 5 minutes per potato to cook., When soft, let cool and peel into measuring cup., Use about 3 cups of potatoes., Put stick of butter on top and put back into microwave and melt butter into potatoes., Add dash of salt, cinnamon and sugar and blend with mixer., Add eggs and mix well. Mix in vanilla., Add condensed milk and blend well., Stir in coconut (optional) and blend., Pour into 3 frozen pie shells and bake in 350° oven for about 30 to 35 minutes or until center is set.

title: Amaretto Pound Cake
directions: Cream butter, cream cheese and sugar until light and fluffy. Add sugar and flavorings., Beat well., Add eggs, one at a time; beat well after each addition., Stir in flour., Spoon mixture into greased 10-inch tube pan., Bake at 325° for about 1 1/2 hours.

title: German Potato Salad
directions: Place potatoes, onions, eggs and parsley in a greased casserole or baking pan., Pour dressing over potato mixture and mix to coat all., Heat oven to 350° and cook for 30 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Turkey Slow Grilled
directions: Preheat covered barbecue grill to 300°., Move coals to side and place pan large enough to catch all drippings under the grate. Wash and pat dry bird., Blend herbs and butter to a paste. (Experiment with whatever herbs you like or, better yet, fresh herbs!), Separate the skin from the breast from the back., Insert paste and rub between the skin and meat., Grill for 10 minutes per pound., Fresh cooks faster!, Turkey is so moist and tender!

title: Nevada Beans
directions: Cook bacon and onion about 10 minutes., Combine with rest of ingredients and pour into greased 2 quart casserole., Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 1 hour., Makes 10 to 12 servings.

title: Pineapple Or Any Other Fruit Pie
directions: Stir all above ingredients together., Pour into 2 baked pie shells., Let set overnight in refrigerator.

title: Coconut Pie
directions: Mix dry ingredients, add milk and bring to boil., Pour beaten egg yolks in and cook until it thickens., Add extract, coconut and vanilla., Pour into 9-inch baked pie shell., Beat egg whites for meringue., Sprinkle coconut on top., Brown in oven.

title: Taco Seasoning
directions: Mix all ingredients in small bowl., Add to 1 1/2 cups of water and 1 pound cooked hamburger., Simmer for 10 minutes just as you would packaged seasoning.

title: Cheese Cake
directions: CRUST:, Mix first three ingredients and place in spring form pan.

title: Champagne Salad
directions: Mix together cheese and sugar., Fold in berries, bananas, pineapple and walnuts., Blend in 12 ounces Cool Whip., Pour in 9 x 13-inch pan and freeze., Remove from freezer 1 hour before you serve.

title: Party Punch
directions: Combine juices and water., Stir until thawed, add 2 trays ice cubes., Just before serving, carefully pour the ginger ale and club soda into bowl., Makes 25 servings.

title: Kentucky Chocolate Pie
directions: Stir all ingredients together., Pour into unbaked pie shell and bake for 30 minutes in a preheated 350° oven.

title: Little Pizzas
directions: Mix together tomato paste, sugar, salt, garlic and Worcestershire sauce and spread thinly on muffins. Sprinkle cheese over tomato mixture. Top with pepperoni.

title: Asparagus Casserole
directions: Crush Ritz and line bottom of casserole., Drain peas and layer half over crackers., Drain asparagus; layer half over peas. Sprinkle half of cheese over all., Add half cream of mushroom soup., Repeat layer, peas, asparagus, mushroom soup., Bake at 375° to 400° until bubbly., Sprinkle remaining cheese over top and bake 2 to 3 minutes or until cheese melts., Baking time:, 45 minutes.

title: Chicken Breasts In Cream
directions: Rub chicken breasts with poultry seasoning., Saute in butter and cook, uncovered, for 15 minutes., Remove to a buttered casserole dish., Cover with the ham and a slice of cheese on each piece of chicken, parsley and thyme to taste., Pour heavy cream over all and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese., Bake for 15 minutes at 350°., Then broil for 5 minutes until light brown., Serve with Wild Rice Sausage Bake.

title: 1-2-3-4 Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees (if using Tube or Bundt Pan 325 degrees)., Cream Butter and Sugar., Add Eggs and beat well., Sift dry ingredients together and add alternately with Milk, then beat well., Add Vanilla., Turn into greased pan for 25 minutes or in Tube pan for 1 hour., Ice with your favorite icing and give thanks for God's Blessings.

title: Cinnamon Pudding
directions: Place batter in pan; then add nuts., Then add syrup., Bake in a 350° oven for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Spinach Balls
directions: Mix all ingredients together and chill well (may be chilled overnight)., Make into balls the size of walnuts., Put on cookie sheet., Bake 15 to 20 minutes at 350°., Serve hot or cold., Can be frozen.

title: Devilishly Decadent Pudding Cake(Low Fat)
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Coat 8 inch square baking pan with vegetable cooking spray, set aside., In mixer bowl beat milk and prune puree to blend thoroughly; add flour, sugar, 2 tablespoons of cocoa, baking powder and salt., Beat just to blend thoroughly. Spread evenly in pan., In small bowl,, mix brown sugar and the remaining 1/4 c. cocoa powder., Sprinkle evenly over top., Bake in center of oven about 45 minutes until cake is springy to the touch., Cool 15 minutes on rack.

title: Easy Butterscotch Pecans Rolls
directions: Melt margarine in small pan and set aside., Grease 9 x 12-inch pan and sprinkle pecans over the bottom., Arrange frozen rolls in pan over nuts, 4 across and 6 down., Sprinkle pudding (dry) over rolls., Sprinkle cinnamon and brown sugar mix over top., Pour melted margarine over the rolls., Let stand overnight covered with wax paper., In the morning, bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes. Cool for 10 minutes., Turn upside down on cookie sheet.

title: Hamburger And Corn Casserole
directions: Brown, drain and crumble hamburger with onion and garlic added., Cook noodles., In skillet, mix meat, corn, soup, tomato sauce and chili powder and simmer 5 to 10 minutes., Layer the noodles, cheese, meat sauce and Parmesan cheese twice., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes., Serves 6 to 8.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
directions: May add chocolate chips, butterscotch chips or anything else.

title: Cheesy Broiled Appetizers
directions: Mix cheese, bacon bits, mayonnaise, olives and onions., Spread 1 tablespoon over each bread slice., Broil until cheese melts, 1 to 2 minutes.

title: Earthquake Cake
directions: Grease 9 x 13-inch pan; sprinkle bottom with coconut, then pecans., Mix cake mix as directed., Pour over coconut and pecans. Beat until creamy, remaining ingredients and spoon over other mixture., Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

title: Pork & Sauerkraut Supper
directions: Layer in casserole., Pour beer on top., Bake at 325 degrees for 2 hours.

title: White Chili
directions: Mix all ingredients and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer until ready to serve.

title: Jam Cake
directions: Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy., Beat in egg yolks, one at a time, mixing well., Stir in jam, add flour which has been sifted with spices, alternately with sour cream and ending with flour., Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites., Bake in four 9-inch layers in 350° oven until center springs back when pressed with finger., (May also be baked in a tube pan.), Frost with Never Fail Frosting.

title: Lemon Chicken
directions: Put chicken in a shallow pan., Sprinkle salt and pepper on top., Inset lemon in cavity., Bake, breast up, at 350° for 1 hour, breast down at 350° for 1/2 hour and breast up at 400° for 1/2 hour.

title: Squash Casserole
directions: Mix ingredients., Spray casserole dish with Pam., Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Gumbo
directions: Boil 4 to 6 large chicken pieces until chicken falls off bones. Use the 2 quarts water to boil chicken in., Cut up onion and place in with chicken., Season with salt, pepper and 1 sprig of thyme. Add okra, cut in cubes., Add tomatoes., At this point you can add shrimp, crab or sausage or leave it with just the chicken., Boil slowly for 3 hours., To be eaten with rice.

title: Old Settler'S Baked Beans
directions: Brown ground beef, bacon and onion; drain., Mix together sugars, ketchup, barbecue sauce, pepper, mustard, chili powder and salt., Stir into kidney beans, lima beans, pork and beans and ground beef mixture., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Honey Lemon Barbecued Chicken
directions: Mix well honey, lemon juice mustard and salt., Barbecue chicken over medium hot coals and brush generously with glaze mixture., (Sometimes I marinate in a Ziploc bag in mixture for an hour before barbecue.), Cook chicken until fork tender., Brush often with honey glaze.

title: Stuffed Mushrooms
directions: Heat milk and butter; add cracker crumbs., Add other ingredients, except butter., Take out stem of mushrooms; fill with stuffing., Dip mushrooms in butter., Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Pat'S Appetizers
directions: Wrap bacon around water chestnut; place on cookie sheet., Bake at 400° until bacon is done.

title: Coach'S Delight
directions: Nabisco Snack Wells (optional) may be substituted for the fat gram counters.

title: Easy White Sauce
directions: Forget all that butter and flour and beating to get rid of lumps!, This is the easy low-fat way., Mix dry ingredients together thoroughly., Add water slowly., Heat over slow heat (or higher heat for the brave, but stir constantly)., Cook until it bubbles., Add salt, pepper or other spices of your choice., Add cubes of yellow cheese to make a cheese sauce., I sometimes add the cheese, a dab of mustard and serve over macaroni.

title: Cheese Biscuits
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Knead and make into small balls. Place pecan on each ball to flatten., Bake at 350° for about 14 to 16 minutes.

title: Italian Sausages And Peppers
directions: Fry sausages in 1/2 cup oil for 5 minutes., Remove from pan and slice when cool., In same oil that sausages were cooked in, add sliced onions and peppers., Cook for 10 minutes., Add tomatoes and sausages and simmer for 20 minutes., Add salt and pepper to taste (garlic salt and parsley may also be added to taste).

title: Peanut Butter Play Dough
directions: Mix all ingredients together, knead lightly. Ready to use or eat!

title: Cinnamon Cake
directions: Quarter each biscuit and place in a bowl (large)., Add sugar and cinnamon., Place lid on bowl and shake well., Melt butter; pour over mixture in bowl., Add 1 more cup of sugar and 3 tablespoons of cinnamon., Shake well., Pour into a greased tube pan., Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Judy'S Pancakes
directions: In large bowl, combine yeast, water and teaspoon of sugar. Add mixture of eggs, oil and buttermilk., Combine all dry ingredients in a second bowl and add them to the liquid., Fry pancake batter as desired.

title: Chess Pie Cake
directions: Mix cake mix, 1 egg and butter together., Press into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Cream sugar, cheese and 3 eggs together., Pour on top. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Lemon Squares
directions: Mix flour, butter and sugar., Pat into bottom of a 9-inch square pan., Bake at 325° for 25 to 30 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Karen'S Banana Cake
directions: Cream butter and sugar., Add eggs and beat well., Add vanilla. Mix together dry ingredients., Add to egg mixture alternately with bananas, rum and milk., Mix well., Stir in nuts., Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes., Makes two 8-inch layers or 1 loaf., Cool and frost with cream cheese frosting.

title: Strawberry-Nut Cake
directions: Mix ingredients together and beat until smooth and creamy. Bake at 350° until done.

title: Broccoli Ham Quiche
directions: Place hash browns in a greased 9-inch microwave-safe dish. Microwave, uncovered, on high for 4 minutes or until thawed., Press onto botom and halfway up the sides of rhe dish., Microwave, uncovered, on high 3 minutes, sprinkle with cheese, ham and broccoli., In a bowl, beat the eggs, milk and seasonings., Pour over the ham mixture., Cover with wax paper., Microwave at 70% power for 10-12 minutes or until set., Let stand for 5 minutes before cutting., Yield:, 4-6 servings.

title: Olive Burger Pie
directions: Brown ground chuck in skillet; drain well. Add onions, garlic salt, pepper and water. Cook until dry. Layer meat, olives, cheese and sliced tomatoes in bottom crust. Repeat, then cover with top crust. Make 3 or 4 holes near center of top crust with a fork to help vent the pie. Cook at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Mom'S Peach Cobbler
directions: Mix sugar, flour, vanilla and egg together., Put fruit in bottom of pan., Pour egg mixture over it., Add butter and cut in pieces., Cover with dough.

title: Hawaiian Chicken
directions: Brown chicken in a little oil in a large Dutch oven., Drain oil and add all other ingredients and stir well., Cover and cook slowly until chicken is done., Serve with unsalted rice.

title: Creamed Cucumbers
directions: Mix all ingredients., Chill at least 1 hour.

title: Easy Penuche Icing
directions: Combine oleo and brown sugar in saucepan, stirring constantly, over medium-low heat until brought to boil., Boil for one minute. Add milk, stirring constantly., Bring to second boil and remove from heat; cool., Mix in powdered sugar., If too thick, add small amounts of evaporated milk.

title: Caramel Nut Pound Cake
directions: Cream butter and shortening., Add brown sugar and white sugar. Add one egg at a time., Beat until well creamed., Add flour, salt, baking powder and vanilla, then add nuts., Blend well. Place mixture in greased and floured 10-inch tube pan and bake at 325° for one hour., Test for doneness.

title: Caramel Krispie Treats
directions: Unwrap approximately 60 caramels., Microwave with 3 tablespoons of water in a glass mixing bowl, stirring constantly, so caramels don't stick or burn., Add Rice Krispies, 1 cup at a time, while stirring., Pat mixture into a glass casserole, after spraying with Pam.

title: Berry Muffins
directions: Sift dry ingredients, into small mixing bowl., Add egg, milk and melted butter., Stir, just until blended., Fold in berries. Spoon into greased muffin pan., Bake, 20 to 25 minutes at 400°. Makes 1 dozen., I have found that when, I, use frozen berries, they get nicer if I reduce the milk to 1/3 cup.

title: Mrs. Dobias' Kit Kat Bar
directions: Mix all ingredients, except Club crackers, and boil 5 minutes, stirring constantly., Line a 9 x 13-inch pan with Club crackers; pour 1/2 mixture over crackers., Add layer of Club crackers; pour mixture over crackers., Add another layer of Club crackers., Then top with Topping.

title: Sweet Rolls
directions: Pour hot water over 1/2 cup sugar; stir., Add yeast and let dissolve., Scald milk with shortening., Let cool to lukewarm., Add salt., Beat eggs until light., Add to milk and yeast., Mix well.

title: Chicken Salad Oriental
directions: Remove strings from pea pods and cut diagonally in half., Mix oil, sugar, vinegar and soy sauce in large bowl., Add remaining ingredients; toss to coat., Serve immediately.

title: Poor Man'S Cookie
directions: Mix sugar, eggs and raisin mixture., Sift flour and other ingredients., Mix into creamed mixture., Pour into greased and floured cookie sheet., Bake 25 minutes at 375°.

title: Fruit Punch
directions: Pour strawberry soda into ice cube trays; freeze., Boil sugar and water for 5 minutes; add fruit juices and chill.

title: Pea Salad
directions: Drain peas., Dice tomatoes, onions and cheese., Tear lettuce into small bits., Mix with salad dressing and serve.

title: Candy Apple Walnut Pie
directions: In large bowl, toss together apples, walnuts & candies, 2/3 c. sugar & 1/3 c. flour., Pour into 1 frozen pie crust., Break or crumble second pie crust and toss with remaining 2 Tbsp. of sugar and 1 Tsp. cinnamon., Sprinkle over apples., Bake in preheated 375° oven on a preheated baking sheet for 55-60 mins. or until candies melt and bubble up., Cool completely before serving.

title: Apricot Salad
directions: Dissolve Jell-O in hot water and add apricots, marshmallows and crushed pineapple., Let set., Cook together last 6 ingredients; let sauce cool and then fold in 1 cup whipped cream. Spread over Jell-O., You can put grated cheese or coconut on top.

title: Lebanese Potato Salad
directions: Boil potatoes with skins on., Do not overcook., Cool until you can handle them., Peel and salt while still warm., Mix other ingredients thoroughly., Add to diced potatoes., Mix and chill until served.

title: Pineapple Angel Food Trifle
directions: Drain pineapple, reserving 1 cup juice; set aside., Combine pudding mix, 1/2 cup reserved juice and milk in a large bowl; beat at low speed 2 minutes or until thickened., Fold in sour cream and pineapple tidbits., Place 1/3 of cake cubes in the bottom of 16 ounce glass bowl, drizzle with 2 to 3 tablespoons remaining pineapple juice., Spoon 1/3 of pudding mixture over cake., Repeat process twice, ending with pudding mixture., Cover and chill at least 3 hours before serving., Top with Cool Whip if desired.

title: Grasshopper Pie
directions: Mix well., Divide between 2 unbaked 9-inch pie shells., Bake at 325° for 35 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Fudge Pie
directions: Melt chocolate over low heat;, add sugar and beat well. Add eggs, one at a time;, beat well after each one., Add flour and beat, well;, add, vanilla and nuts., Pour into Pam sprayed pie plate and bake at 350° for 25 minutes., Good stuff.

title: Pumpkin Bread
directions: Cream the shortening and sugar., Add water, eggs, and pumpkin. Combine dry ingredients; add to mixture., Bake in loaf pan at 350°., When cool, serve with whipped cream., This bread freezes well.

title: Oven Roasted Vegetables
directions: Preheat oven to 450°., In a plastic bag or bowl, shake or toss all ingredients until vegetables are coated., Empty into a 13 x 9-inch baking pan., Bake, stirring once, 20 minutes or until vegetables are tender., Makes 4 servings.

title: Tuna Mac And Cheese
directions: Prepare macaroni and cheese according to package directions. Mix in remaining ingredients, except Parmesan cheese. Pour into a 1 1/2-quart microwavable serving dish. Cover with plastic wrap and microwave on High for 2 minutes. Stir casserole and continue heating on High for 2 1/2 to 3 1/2 minutes or until cheese is melted and mixture is heated through. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Preparation time: 20 minutes. Makes 5 to 6 servings.

title: Potato Casserole
directions: Peel and wash potatoes., Pat dry with paper towel., Cube potatoes., Toss in a large mixing bowl with other ingredients until well coated., Bake at 300° to 325°, uncovered, in a large casserole dish for 1 1/2 hours., Stir once halfway through.

title: Chicken Divan
directions: Cook chicken breasts in boiling salted water until tender. Drain, reserving 2 cups broth., Let chicken cool and set aside. Cook broccoli in small amount of boiling salted water; drain and set aside., Melt butter in heavy saucepan over low heat., Add flour, stirring until smooth., Cook 1 minute, stirring constantly; gradually stir in broth, whipping cream and sherry., Continue to cook over medium heat until thickened and bubbly, stirring constantly., Stir in salt and pepper., Arrange broccoli in 13 x 9 inch baking dish; top with 1/2 sauce., Arrange chicken pieces over broccoli., Stir 1/4 cup parmesan cheese into remaining sauce and spoon over chicken., Sprinkle on the 2 Tbsp. parmesan cheese. Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes; then broil for 2 minutes.

title: Cinnamon Twists Rolls
directions: Combine sugar and cinnamon. Roll biscuits, each to a 9-inch rope., Bring ends together and seal. Dip in melted butter, then in cinnamon and sugar mixture. Twist., Place on greased baking sheet. Sprinkle with nuts. Bake in a 450° oven for about 10 minutes. Makes 10 rolls.

title: Cream Cheese Cake Squares
directions: Preheat oven to 325°., Mix cake mix, butter, 1 egg and nuts. Press into 13 x 9-inch pan., Mix cream cheese, 2 eggs and powdered sugar., Pour over pressed mix., Bake for 35 to 40 minutes or until barely brown.

title: Yakitori(Japanese)
directions: Soak chicken in combined sauces for 20 minutes or longer., Put 4 or 5 pieces of chicken on bamboo stick., Simmer down remaining sauce until quantity is half., May need to use a little cornstarch in water to thicken., Broil on charcoal grill., Brush several times., (Buy mirin in Oriental food store; purchase Oriental grater., Saki is found in wine specialty stores.)

title: Sour Cream-Glazed Pecans
directions: Combine sugar and sour cream in a heavy 1 1/2 to 2-quart saucepan., Cook over medium-high heat to boiling, stirring constantly., Reduce heat to medium and cook about 5 minutes more, stirring constantly., Remove from heat., Stir in vanilla., Add pecans and stir to coat well.

title: Easy Chicken Dish
directions: Place chicken in baking dish., Salt lightly, if desired., Add onions., Mix soup and sherry; pour over chicken., Sprinkle cheese on top.

title: Chocolate Mousse
directions: Melt butter and chocolate chips in top of double boiler (or on low power in microwave)., Beat in egg yolks, one at a time., Cool slightly., Stir in brandy (or Kahlua or any flavored liquer). Beat egg whites into stiff peaks., Fold whites into the chocolate mixture, gently blending., Spoon into 8 separate dishes or 1 large dish., Refrigerate., Before serving, garnish with whipped cream and shaved chocolate curls.

title: Honey Orange Chicken
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Cut chicken into strips and dip into orange juice., Roll strips in bread crumbs and bake for 30 minutes., Use an aluminum foil covered pan., Boil 1 cup water and stir in bouillon cube, then 1/2 small jar of honey., Take chicken out of oven; pour chicken broth over the top., Leave uncovered and bake for another 30 minutes., Be sure to baste chicken every 5 minutes, until desired thickness is reached., Serve on a bed of rice and French-cut green beans.

title: Earthquake Cake
directions: Layer the coconut and pecans in a 9 x 13-inch pan (do not stir)., Mix the cake mix as directed on box., Pour over pecans (do not stir)., Mix the powdered sugar, softened cream cheese and softened margarine., Drop on top of cake mixture by tablespoon (do not stir)., Bake at 350° for 50 minutes.

title: Dirt Pudding
directions: Crumble 2/3 package of cookies in 9 x 13-inch pan., Mix together Cool Whip, cream cheese, butter and powdered sugar., In large bowl, mix together pudding and milk., Combine cream cheese mixture with pudding mixture; blend well., Pour over cookies. Crumble remaining cookies and sprinkle on top., Chill before serving.

title: Million Dollar Salad(Frozen Salad)
directions: Mix first five items., Cut cherries in half and mix Cool Whip. Put in refrigerator until it gels.

title: Pumpkin Cookies
directions: Mix and drop on cookie sheet and bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes., Ice with powdered sugar mixed with orange juice and a lump of butter.

title: Yorkshire Pudding
directions: Stir, milk, into flour and salt., Beat egg slightly and add to	batter., Add water., Beat well to cause bubbles., Let sit and rebeat at intervals., Put, a, teaspoon of hot meat fat into round 8 or 9-inch, tin, and, heat, tin, in oven.	Pour in batter and bake at 425° for about 15 minutes, reducing oven to 350° for 15 minutes, longer., Batter should rise like popovers and be served with roast beef and pan gravy.

title: Corn Dogs
directions: You will need 8 popsicle or wiener sticks.

title: Danish Potato Salad
directions: Heat butter and cook onion over slow heat., Add salt, pepper, vinegar and sugar., Bring to a boil and add cream., Mix well and slowly add potatoes while blending., Simmer 5 to 10 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Black Walnut Pound Cake
directions: Beat butter, shortening and sugar until soft and creamy., Add eggs, one at a time, beating until blended., Sift flour and baking powder., Add to creamed mixture alternately with milk., Stir in vanilla and nuts., Pour into a greased and floured 10-inch tube pan., Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 30 minutes or until done., Cool in pan 10 to 15 minutes., Cool completely on a wire rack.

title: Fruit Cocktail Cake
