directions: Preheat oven to 325°., Roast 40 minutes per pound., With a sharp knife, cut 10 or more one-inch deep holes in top surface of ham; press garlic slivers and pinch of black pepper in each hole. Place roast on rack in open pan., Rub surface with sherry and sprinkle with salt and pepper., Roast 40 minutes per pound or until meat thermometer is 185°., Pour off fat and combine with 2/3 cup sherry; thicken with cornstarch for sauce.

title: Sweet And Sour Meat Loaf
directions: Slightly mix ingredients together.

title: Fluffy Chocolate Peanut Butter Pie
directions: Prepare whipped topping., Mix with 1 cup of milk as directed on package in small mixer bowl., Measure 2 cups of the prepared whipped topping and set aside., Add 1 cup milk and chocolate pudding mix to remaining topping in bowl., Blend and then beat at high speed for 2 minutes., Spoon into pie shell.

title: Enchiladas(Joe And Sonya Kuykendall, 11-3-78)
directions: Put can of tomato sauce and enchilada mix in pan and mix. Heat over low fire., Brown beef and onion over low fire in skillet., After sauce heats 10 minutes, add to the beef, just enough to be slightly soupy (to your preference).

title: Pickled Jalapeno Peppers
directions: Wash, split and remove stems from peppers; set aside., In a medium saucepan, combine vinegar, water and oil; bring to a boil. Drop in peppers, onion and carrot slices; cook just long enough for peppers to change color., Place peppers and vegetables into pint jars to which 1/2 teaspoon of salt, 1 garlic clove and 1 bay leaf have been added to each., Distribute liquid into jars., Seal.

title: Warm Brie Salad With Hazelnut Vinaigrette(4 Persons)
directions: Preheat the oven to 350°., Place hazelnuts on a baking sheet and bake for 20 minutes., Cool and rub in a dish towel to remove the skin., Chop the hazelnuts finely and set aside.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Cook broccoli with onions., Mix together soup, mayonnaise and eggs., Stir into broccoli., Add cheese; mix well., Melt butter and mix with crackers., Add cheese, then crackers on top as crumbs. Bake at 350° for 30 to 50 minutes.

title: Mexican Dish
directions: Brown beef and onions; drain., Add taco seasoning, beans and tomato sauce and simmer five minutes., Press dough in a 9 x 13-inch pan and up the sides one inch., Brush on oil and sprinkle corn meal over dough., Pour meat sauce over dough and bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes and cook until melted., Cut into cubes., Top with shredded lettuce, chopped tomatoes, taco sauce and sour cream.

title: Seafood Souffle
directions: Line bread on the bottom of a slightly greased 9 x 13-inch glass dish., Combine the next 9 ingredients and pour on top. Sprinkle with Old Bay seasoning., Bake at 350° for 40 minutes. Let sit 10 minutes., Serve.

title: Happy Days
directions: Take all of the ingredients and add a pinch of warm personality and a dash of humor., Measure the words carefully, the heaping amount of time and patience., Keep temperature low., Do not boil., Add a dash of humor and a pinch of warm spice of life. Serve to individuals garnished with a big smile.

title: Peach Fruit Salad
directions: Whip together the milk, cream cheese and Cool Whip. Fold in pie filling, pineapple and nuts. Refrigerate.

title: Peachy Dessert Off The Grill
directions: Cut bananas and peaches into bite size pieces., Place fruit in a foil pan or make your own pan with heavy duty foil., In a bowl, stir together honey, butter and 1/2 tsp. cinnamon., Spoon over fruit and toss to coat fruit.

title: Rich'S Irish Creme
directions: Combine all ingredients in jug or container; shake vigorously.

title: Spinach Balls
directions: Mix all ingredients and refrigerate for one hour., Make small balls., Bake 15 minutes at 350°.

title: "Steak-On-A-Stick Over An Open Scaly-Bark Fire"
directions: You will need 3 sticks (1 healthy and long, 2 in shape of a "Y") and scaly-bark fire.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
directions: In large pan, melt margarine., Add flour and make a roux. Stir and add chicken broth and 1 can cream of chicken soup (add water, broth or milk if this is too thick)., Add remaining ingredients and stir., Pour in 9 x 13 pan., Put uncooked biscuits on top., Bake at 350° until brown.

title: Chicken Salad
directions: Combine chicken and celery., In a separate bowl, combine all other ingredients., Add chicken and celery., Let chill for 1 hour.

title: Sweet And Sour Chicken
directions: Cook and stir in hot oil 2 to 3 minutes., Mix cornstarch and soy sauce; add to pan., Add other ingredients., Bring to boil and turn down to simmer for 10 to 15 minutes, uncovered.

title: Rhubarb Cream Pie
directions: Blend sugar, flour, nutmeg and margarine. Add eggs; beat until smooth., Pour over cut up rhubarb in 9-inch pastry lined pie pan. Top with pastry cut fancy shapes or just bake in a 450° oven for 10 minutes, then at 350° for about 30 minutes.

title: Rice Pudding
directions: Cook rice 10 minutes., Remove from heat. Add sugar, eggs, butter and vanilla. Mix well until eggs are cooked in hot rice. Add milk and raisins. Return to low heat, stirring continuously for about 5 minutes., Pour into serving dish., Sprinkle with nutmeg and brown sugar.

title: Oyster Cracker Snack
directions: Heat the oil; add dry salad dressing., Mix dill weed and garlic salt., Mix and pour over the oyster crackers., Stir with a wooden spoon.

title: Cheese Wafers
directions: Mix in bowl by hand., Bake 8 to 12 minutes at 350°.

title: Gumbo
directions: In a pot (not iron), saut okra, onions, celery and garlic until done or all the stringiness is gone from the okra.

title: Pie Crusts
directions: Mix, flour,, salt and Crisco until fine like meal., Add water, egg and vinegar., Makes 3 pie crusts.

title: Ambrosia Pie
directions: Combine cream cheese, powdered sugar and pineapple juice. Beat until smooth., Add Cool Whip., Fold in coconut, drained pineapple and oranges., Pour into chilled cookie crust., Chill until firm.

title: Melt In Your Mouth Chicken Pie
directions: Cook chicken until tender., Remove meat from bones., Reserve broth., Cut chicken into small pieces and place in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch or 11 x 8 x 2-inch pan.

title: Scalloped Corn
directions: Cook bacon until crisp., Drain on paper towel, crumble and set aside., Cook green onions in bacon drippings until tender., Stir in flour, salt, dry mustard, paprika and pepper., Blend well., Cook until mixture is smooth and bubbly stirring constantly., Beat eggs in small bowl, stir in milk., Gradually add to flour mixture., Cook until mixture thickens, stirring constantly., Stir in corn., Cook until thoroughly heated., Sprinkle with bacon.

title: Sharon'S Cinnamon Christmas Cut-Outs
directions: Mix together; roll out using cinnamon for dusting., Cut out with, cookie, cutters., Let dry on cookie sheet for 3 to 4 days. Poke hole in top with toothpick and/or decorate., These make your house, smell really nice., You can paint on them or stencil, after they, are, dry., Probably, frosting would work also.

title: English Rose Cherry Whip
directions: Dissolve cherry jello in water., Chill until slightly set, then whip., Add pineapple, drained well., Pour into pan greased well with oleo and lined with crushed vanilla wafers.

title: Outrageous Blueberry Muffins
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., Use liners or grease and flour pans.

title: Chicken And Dumplings
directions: Boil chicken until it easily comes off the bone., Mix flour and shortening well; add beaten egg and milk., Roll onto floured surface, about 1/4-inch thick., Cut and drop into boiling chicken broth., Put chicken meat back into the dumplings and broth. Cover and cook until dumplings are tender, about 20 minutes.

title: Key Lime Pie
directions: Mix together milk, egg yolks and lime juice., Beat 1 egg white stiff and fold into mixture. Pour into baked pie shell., Beat 3 egg whites and gradually add sugar and cream of tartar., Spread over filling and bake at 350° until egg whites are golden brown.

title: Peanut Butter Cup Cookies
directions: Combine butter, sugars, egg, peanut butter and vanilla; beat until smooth. Add flour, soda and salt. Cover dough and chill until firm (1 hour). Make into walnut size balls and place in greased mini muffin tins. Bake at 375° for 8 to 9 minutes. Press a peanut butter cup in each and let cool in pan.

title: Pretzels
directions: Put pretzels in cake pan., Break pretzels into smaller pieces. Mix all the mixture together, then pour over pretzels., Bake in oven at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes., Mix about three times while it is baking.

title: Old Fashioned Egg Custard Pie
directions: Beat eggs until light and foamy., Add sugar and salt; blend well., Add milk and vanilla., Line a 9-inch pie pan with your favorite pastry recipe., (The secret of the crust is not to have it too thin., It should be thick so the custard won't run through.), Brush the pastry with melted butter, pour custard into pastry shell and sprinkle with nutmeg., Bake in 450° oven for 10 minutes, then reduce heat to 325° and bake for 25 minutes.

title: Baked Chicken Supreme
directions: Combine flour, salt and paprika; coat chicken well., Melt butter; brown chicken on both sides., Remove from pan; place into casserole dish., Add potatoes and carrots., Combine chicken soup with 1 can water; pour over chicken and vegetables., Bake for 1 1/2 hours at 375°.

title: Pumpkin Cake
directions: Blend together eggs and sugar until light and well blended. Add oil and continue to beat., Sift and stir dry ingredients together and thoroughly beat into egg mixture., Add pumpkin and mix well again., Pour into greased and floured 9-inch tube pan. Bake at 350° for 55 minutes or until done., Let stand in pan for 10 minutes before removing.

title: Crawfish Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients thoroughly., Bake in covered dish for 1 hour at 350° or until done., Do not add salt.

title: Cut-Out Sugar Cookies
directions: Mix all ingredients together and chill dough for 3 hours. Roll out on floured table for cutouts., Bake 6 to 8 minutes at 375°., Cool before icing.

title: Divinity
directions: In 2-quart saucepan, combine sugar, corn syrup, salt and water., Cook to hard ball stage (260°) stirring only until sugar is dissolved., Meanwhile, beat egg whites to a stiff peak. Gradually pour syrup over egg whites beating at high speed on electric mixer., Add vanilla and beat until candy holds its shape in 4 to 5 minutes., Quickly drop from teaspoon onto wax paper. Makes about 40 pieces.

title: Mexican Lasagna
directions: Layer the following in casserole dish:

title: Cranberry Delight
directions: Beat cream cheese and sweetened condensed milk. Beat in cranberry sauce and nuts. Chill for 45-60 min. Use as a dessert or late night snack. Makes 8-10 servings.

title: Donna'S Low-Fat Chili
directions: Brown turkey in skillet., Drain off any fat., You may even wash over turkey with water if you wish., Mix all ingredients in a crock-pot and cook on low all day or all night., You can soak pintos in water all night first before putting into crock-pot. This will make pintos softer., Be sure to add enough water so chili does not dry out., Great for low-fat nachos.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Boil and debone chicken., Add soups and sour cream., Pour melted butter on top., Put cracker crumbs on top., Cook until cracker crumbs are brown at 425°.

title: Dipped Chocolate Candy
directions: Work all but last, two, ingredients, together, and make into balls (for Easter I make, mine the shape of Easter eggs). Melt chocolate chips and 1/2, block paraffin in double boiler. Dip candy, using toothpick, ice pick, or two tine fork., Drain and put on wax paper., I find it works better to make my candy at night and dip it in the morning.

title: Oven Barbecue Country Spareribs
directions: Brown ribs in oil for 20 minutes., Add cut up green pepper, sliced onion rings and cut up celery to pan drippings (remove ribs before to baking dish)., Mix tomato sauce, paste and water; add to sauteed vegetables., When hot, pour over ribs., Cover with foil. Bake for 2 hours at 350°.

title: Baked Beans 'N Meat
directions: Heat in crock-pot for 2 hours.

title: Peanut Blossom Cookies
directions: Cream together shortening, peanut butter, sugar and brown sugar until blended., Add egg and vanilla., Beat well., Blend in dry ingredients., Shape scant teaspoon of dough into balls., Roll in sugar and place on greased cookie sheet., Bake 8 to 10 minutes at 350°., Remove from oven., Top each cookie with Kiss, pressing down until cookie cracks., Makes about 6 dozen.

title: Pull Apart Cinnamon Rolls
directions: Grease and flour Bundt pan. Layer pecans and dinner rolls. Combine sugar, cinnamon and pudding. Sprinkle over top of rolls. Melt butter and pour over everything. Cover with a towel and let stand overnight. In AM, bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Chiffon Cake
directions: Sift together flour, sugar, baking powder and salt., Make a well and add in order, corn oil, egg yolks, water, lemon peel and vanilla., Beat with spoon until smooth., Add cream of tartar to egg whites., Beat until egg whites form very stiff peaks., Fold first mixture into egg whites until well blended., Do not stir., Turn batter into ungreased 10-inch tube pan., Bake at 325° for 70 to 75 minutes., Invert pan and cool., Loosen sides with spatula.

title: Popovers
directions: Sift together flour and salt., Gradually add milk to flour in a small bowl., Add butter., Beat eggs well and add to batter. Beat batter for 2 minutes with mixer., Fill hot muffin pans 2/3 full., Bake in a 450° oven for 14 minutes., Reduce heat to 350° and bake 20 more minutes., Serve hot., They can be filled with creamed vegetables or creamed meat.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients, except noodles., Place 1/2 noodles on bottom of casserole., Add ingredients and top with remaining noodles., Bake at 375° for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Black Walnut Cake
directions: Cream margarine and vegetable oil., Add sugar and eggs. Combine flour and soda., Add alternately with buttermilk., Stir in maple flavoring., Add coconut and nuts., Bake in 3 greased and floured 8-inch pans at 350° for 25 to 35 minutes.

title: Santa'S Whiskers
directions: Cream together margarine and sugar., Blend in milk and vanilla., Stir in flour, cherries and nuts., Form into 2 rolls (each 2 inches in diameter and 8 inches long)., Roll in coconut. Wrap in waxed paper and chill several hours or overnight., Slice 1/4-inch thick., Place on ungreased cookie sheet., Bake at 375° for 12 minutes., Makes 5 dozen.

title: Meat Loaf With Cheese
directions: Combine meat with next	8, ingredients., Place	half of this mixture in a loaf pan., Cover with half of cheese and top with half of the, parsley., Repeat, with, the, remaining meat, cheese and parsley., Bake at 350°	for, 1	hour or until done. Sprinkle with paprika and let stand 10 minutes before slicing. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Sunshine Salad
directions: Dissolve Jello and sugar in hot water., Add pineapple and Mandarin oranges., Refrigerate., Add sour cream and nuts., Chill until firm.

title: Corn Dog Bites
directions: Combine first 3 ingredients in large bowl., Combine oil, egg and buttermilk., Stir in flour mixture., Cut frankfurters into 5 pieces., Dip each piece into batter., Coat completely., Use wooden picks to aid in dipping., Pour oil 3 to 4-inches deep in Dutch oven or pan., Heat to 375°., Fry until golden brown., Turn once while frying., Serve with mustard and ketchup.

title: Cheese Fudge
directions: Melt cheese in margarine., Add other ingredients and mix in a blender; cool., Pour into greased 12 x 9-inch cake pan. Refrigerate.

title: Mexican Chicken
directions: In a 9 x 13 pan, layer chicken on bottom, onions and Doritos (crushed). Mix cream of chicken and Ro-Tel together. Pour soup mixture over Doritos. Slowly pour chicken broth over soup mixture. Cover with cheese. Cover with foil. Bake 45 minutes in a 325° oven. Carefully remove foil. Bake additional 15 to 25 minutes.

title: Hot Chicken Salad Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients, except cheese and potato chips., Turn ingredients into shallow buttered casserole dish., Combine cheese and chips; spread over top., Bake, uncovered, at 375° for 20 minutes., Serve hot., Makes 6 servings.

title: Less-Than-An-Hour Vegetable Soup
directions: Brown ground meat, draining away as much grease as possible; add chopped onion and brown with meat., Add seasonings and undrained tomatoes., Peel potatoes and cut into small cubes., Chop carrots and celery finely., Simmer 45 minutes or more, according to size of vegetable pieces., Serves 4 meals., It freezes perfectly.

title: One Dish Pork Chop Dinner
directions: Coat pork chops in flour; reserve excess flour. In a large Dutch oven, heat oil., Brown pork on both sides. Season with salt and pepper., Remove and set aside.

title: Hamburger Casserole
directions: Cook ground beef and onion with salt and garlic; drain. Put into bottom of casserole dish. Add cooked potatoes, then Cheddar cheese. Top with soup and sprinkle remaining cheese on top. Bake at 400° for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Bean Dip
directions: Mix together., Bake for 20 minutes at 300°., Sprinkle cheese on top to melt.

title: Bacon Wrapped Chicken
directions: Lay chipped beef on bottom of pan., Wrap bacon around chicken breasts., Mix sour cream and chicken soup; pour over chicken., Bake at 250° for 3 hours.

title: Fried Venison Backstrap
directions: Mix flour and milk in medium sized bowl with whisk until all lumps are out., Add spices and mix well.

title: Mother'S Icebox Sugarless Cake
directions: In large saucepan, heat milk and marshmallows, stirring constantly until marshmallows are melted., Add in all the other ingredients and place in bowl or pan that has been lined with waxed paper and lightly greased with softened margarine., Cover, refrigerate overnight., Take out of refrigerator the next day and remove from bowl, discarding the waxed paper., Wrap in Saran Wrap and keep in refrigerator or freezer until time to eat.

title: Eggplant Casserole
directions: Cook eggplant in salted water until tender., Mash eggplant and combine with next 7 ingredients., Place in casserole and bake at 350° for 30 minutes., Cover top with bread crumbs., Bake 15 minutes longer.

title: Herbed Spinach Bake(Serves 6 To 8)
directions: Combine ingredients., Pour into 10 x 6 x 1 1/2-inch baking dish., Bake in moderate oven (350°) for 20 to 25 minutes or until knife inserted between center and edge comes out clean., Cut into squares.

title: Cashew Chicken
directions: Toss chicken in bowl with mixture of soy sauce, rice wine and cornstarch; set aside., Refrigerate for a couple of hours.

title: Cranberry-Orange Salad
directions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water., Add orange juice and let stand until almost jelled., Combine cranberry-orange relish, chopped apple and pecans. Fold into the almost jelled mixture. Pour into 1-quart mold., Chill until firm., Makes 10 small servings.

title: Chicken Enchilada Pie
directions: Tenderize onion in stick of oleo., Add soups, pimento, green chilies and chicken., Cover bottom of casserole with torn soft tortillas., Add soup mixture., Top with cheese., Bake 1 hour at 350°.

title: Homemade Spaghetti And Meat Sauce
directions: On stove cook in large saucepan the tomatoes and tomato paste. Saute celery and onions in separate skillet., When celery and onions begin to get tender, add to tomato mixture., Brown ground beef in skillet, drain and add to tomato sauce., Add seasonings to taste., Cook slowly and stir often., Prepare spaghetti noodles separately., Serve sauce over noodles and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese, if desired.

title: Zucchini Casserole
directions: Boil the squash in salt water to which the minced garlic has been added., When tender, drain well., Thicken the tomatoes with the cornstarch and add the butter and minced onion, salt and pepper to taste., Brown the ground beef in a skillet; add a little salt and pepper., In a greased casserole, put a layer of squash, beef, tomatoes and cheese; then repeat in the same order., Cover the top with the crushed corn flakes., Bake 1 hour in a 350° oven.

title: Easter Ham Loaf
directions: Mix well together pork, ham, one well beaten egg, breadcrumbs and milk., Press evenly into a 10 x 10-inch casserole or cake pan. Bake for one hour in 350° oven, uncovered., Remove from oven, pour off juices and brown pineapple slices in juice in a frying pan., While pineapple is browning, mix together brown sugar, vinegar, water and mustard., Pour this syrup over ham loaf and return to oven at 350° for at least 15 minutes., Arrange pineapple slices over loaf before serving.

title: Italian Cream Liqueur
directions: Place all ingredients in a blender or food processor fitted with a steel blade., Process briefly until completely blended. Pour into bottles or airtight container and refrigerate., Serve chilled., Yields about 2 1/2 pints of liqueur.

title: Praline Biscuits
directions: Place 2 teaspoons margarine, 2 teaspoons brown sugar and 3 pecan halves in each of 12 muffin cups, 2 1/2 x 1 1/4-inch. Sprinkle cinnamon in each cup., Heat in oven until melted., Mix Bisquick, applesauce and milk until dough forms., Beat 20 strokes. Spoon onto mixture in cups., Bake about 10 minutes at 450°.

title: Spoon Rolls
directions: Mix water and yeast together., Mix flour, sugar, margarine and egg together., Combine all ingredients., Put in airtight bowl and seal., Place in refrigerator., Dough is best if allowed to stand overnight., Grease muffin tins, spoon out as needed., This dough does not have to sit out before baking., Will keep for 6 days in refrigerator., Bake in a 350° oven for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Jello Salad In A Jiffy
directions: Mix dry jello and cottage cheese, then add pineapple., Stir in Cool Whip., It's done and ready to serve!, Sprinkle with chopped nuts if desired.

title: Shrimply Cauliflower
directions: Combine cauliflower with a small amount of water in a glass dish., Microwave on High for 6 to 7 minutes or until tender; drain., Place in a 9 x 11-inch baking dish., Combine milk, onion and dill in a small saucepan., Bring to a boil., Remove from heat and strain; keep warm., Blend flour and margarine in a saucepan. Cook for 1 to 2 minutes, or until smooth but not brown., Stir in warm milk gradually., Cook over low heat until thickened and smooth, stirring constantly., Season with salt and white pepper. Stir in shrimp., Spoon over cauliflower; top with cheese., Bake at 325° for 30 minutes.

title: Baked Beans
directions: Parboil beans until tender and drain., Mix all ingredients together and bake in a 325° oven for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Ableskiver(Swedish Shaped Pancakes)
directions: Combine mix, eggs, butter and half and half., Beat until smooth., Heat Ableskiver pan over moderate heat until drop of water bounces or use muffin pan.

title: Heavenly Pineapple Pie
directions: Whip the cream in small bowl., Refrigerate., Drain pineapple, reserving juice., Beat together cream cheese, reserved juice and pudding in medium bowl until smooth., Gently fold pineapple and whipped cream into pudding mix., Spoon into pie crust., Place in freezer until hard, 8 hours or overnight., Remove from freezer 1 1/2 hours before serving., Sprinkle top with more crumbs., Serves 8.

title: Cream Puffs
directions: Place water and margarine in a saucepan; bring to a boil. When margarine is melted, add the flour while saucepan is still on the stove., Stir with a fork until dough forms a ball around the fork, then remove from heat., This takes only a minute., Add the eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition., Do not underbeat., Drop batter by heaping tablespoonfuls onto a well-greased cookie sheet., Bake for 15 minutes in a 425° oven, then reduce heat to 350° and bake for another 20 minutes., Turn off heat and open door, but do not remove puffs from oven until they are cool.

title: Orange Slice Cookies
directions: Mix the first four ingredients with 1/4 cup flour., Cream butter, brown sugar and white sugar., Add eggs and vanilla., Sift together 1 3/4 cups flour, baking powder, soda and salt., Add to creamed mixture., Fold in candy mixture by hand., Drop on cookie sheet with teaspoon., Bake at 325°.

title: Aunt Jan'S Southern Style Ham
directions: Remove rind from ham., Rub fat with cinnamon, ginger, allspice and nutmeg., Prepare the pastry., Sift flour, salt and baking powder., Blend in shortening., Add water to make dough., Roll out 1/4-inch thick., Place rolled dough around ham, joining at the bottom or side., Cover pastry with well-greased and floured paper. Bake in slow oven at 300° for about 6 hours., At the end of the fourth hour, remove paper to brown the dough.

title: Sour Cream And Apple Coleslaw
directions: Mix sour cream and egg yolks in medium bowl., Add lemon juice, horseradish, paprika, sugar and salt; mix well., In large bowl, mix shredded cabbage and apple., Pour dressing over all; toss until well coated., Refrigerate at least 1 hour before serving.

title: Red Pudding(Rodgrot)
directions: In a large saucepan, place berries and water and cook for 5 minutes., Strain through a sieve; there should be about 4 1/2 cups of juice., Mix the cornstarch and sugar and add enough water to make a thin paste., Return the juice to the pan and again bring to a boil., Remove from heat and stir in cornstarch mixture., Bring quickly back to a boil for 2 minutes and then remove from the heat., Cool somewhat., Pour carefully into a large glass bowl or individual glass dishes., Sprinkle a little sugar on the top to prevent a skin from forming., Best made several hours to a day ahead., Serve with whipped cream.

title: Ernie'S Goulash
directions: Let simmer, uncovered, 15 or 20 minutes.

title: Mini Fruitcake
directions: Cut fruit; mix all ingredients well., Bake at 325° for 20 minutes., Makes 11 to 12 dozen., Buy mini cupcake cups.

title: Marinated And Grilled Shrimp
directions: Combine all ingredients, except shrimp, in a shallow dish and mix well., Add shrimp, tossing gently to coat., Cover and chill for 2 to 3 hours, stirring occasionally., Drain shrimp, reserving marinade., Place shrimp in 6 (14-inch) skewers., Grill over medium-hot coals for 3 to 4 minutes per each side, basting frequently with marinade., Yields 4 to 6 servings.

title: Round Steak Casserole
directions: Cut steak into strips; brown in small amount of oil., Slice raw vegetables according to family size; pour over meat.

title: Aunt Georgie'S Scalloped Cabbage
directions: Cook cabbage in boiling, salted water for 7 minutes; save 3/4 cup water., Make white sauce with margarine, flour, water and milk., In buttered casserole, put layer of cabbage, layer white sauce, 1/2 of cheese; repeat., Melt 2 tablespoons margarine with 1/2 cup bread crumbs; top casserole., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Shoe Peg Corn Casserole
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., In a large bowl, combine beans, corn, soup, onion, sour cream, cheese and almonds., Mix together and turn into a 9 x 13-inch glass casserole dish., Melt butter or margarine in medium saucepan., Crumble crackers into margarine. Spread cracker mixture over top of casserole., Bake 35 to 40 minutes., Serves 6 to 8.

title: Romano Cheese Salad Dressing
directions: Blend well together and coat each serving with dressing, then sprinkle with Romano cheese.

title: Deep-Fried Zucchini
directions: In medium mixing bowl, combine 1 cup flour, cornstarch, baking powder, salt, lemon pepper, onion powder, milk and egg., Blend until smooth., Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes., Cut zucchini into 1/4-inch diagonal slices., Rinse and pat dry., Shake slices in remaining 1/2 cup flour to coat.

title: Giblet Gravy
directions: Mix all up and put into jar and shake real well.

title: Jiffy Cake
directions: Mix cake mix, eggs and water on medium speed until thoroughly mixed., Pour in Bundt pan., Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Microwave Creamy Beef-Cheese Dip
directions: Place unwrapped block of cream cheese in a 1-quart glass casserole., Microwave on High 45 seconds to 1 minute or until cheese is softened. Add remaining ingredients and stir until well blended., Cover and microwave on High 1 1/2 minutes., Stir. Microwave on Medium an additional 2 to 2 1/2 minutes., Serve with chips, toast rounds or crackers., Yields 2 cups.

title: Jello Cake
directions: Bake cake as directed on package., Make Jell-O and let stand until a little thick., Let cake cool; poke holes in cake with fork., Pour Jell-O over cake so it runs into the holes., Mix pudding and Cool Whip together and ice cake with mixture.

title: Achiote
directions: Adobo is simply a mix of black peppercorns, oregano and garlic. Sprinkle the meat with ground pepper, garlic powder, dried oregano and sometimes onion powder., Then marinate it in olive oil and vinegar., Others prefer fresh lime juice to the vinegar., If you adhere to strict standards, then a basic Adobo mix would be:

title: Impossible Seafood Pie
directions: Heat oven to 400°., Grease a 10 x 1 1/2-inch pie plate., Mix crabmeat, cheese, onions and pimento in plate., Beat remaining ingredients until smooth., Pour into plate; bake until knife inserted between center and edge comes out clean, 35 to 40 minutes., Cool 5 minutes.

title: Bacon, Tomato And Herb Dip
directions: In medium bowl, stir together ingredients until well blended.

title: Mexican Cornbread
directions: Heat oven to 450°., Prepare 6 muffin cups or one 10-inch cast-iron or other heavy ovenproof pan., Mix dry ingredients together., Stir pepper and cheese into the dry ingredients., In a small bowl, whisk wet ingredients together., Mix dry and wet ingredients together and pour into prepared pan or muffin cups. Bake 15 to 20 minutes., Makes half a dozen muffins or one 10-inch skillet.

title: Sliced Baked Potatoes
directions: Peel potatoes., Cut potatoes into slices, but not all the way through., Put potatoes in a baking dish., Fan them slightly. Sprinkle with salt and drizzle with butter., Sprinkle with herbs at 425° for 50 minutes.

title: Tuna Crunch Salad
directions: Combine tuna and water chestnuts in a medium-size bowl; stir in lemon juice, then mayonnaise or salad dressing and salt and pepper to taste., Chill.

title: Tuna Pasta Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients., If too dry, add more mayo and vinegar. I garnish with spanish olives., Chill and serve.

title: Oven Fried Chicken
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., In a small bowl, add all seasonings. Reserve 1/2 tablespoon of seasonings., Sprinkle majority of seasonings on chicken., Add the 1/2 tablespoon of seasonings to flour and corn meal., In a mixing bowl, beat milk, mustard and white wine., Dip the chicken in this mixture, then dredge in flour and corn meal., Spray pan with vegetable spray, then spray chicken., Bake 30 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Italian Beef Au Jus
directions: Place beef roast in slow cooker; combine sauce ingredients and pour over beef., Cover and cook on low for 8 hours., Meat may be sliced and served with hard rolls; or shredded and served over rice or noodles., Thicken broth with flour.

title: Baked Ziti Casserole
directions: Cook pasta as directed, drain. Brown ground beef and flavor with garlic and onion powder., Mix pasta, beef and spaghetti sauce., Put 1/2 of mixture in large casserole, put 1/2 of cheese on top. Finish with rest of pasta mixture and top with rest of the cheese.

title: Mayonnaise Spice Cake
directions: Mix mayo, sugar and honey., Sift dry ingredients and add alternating with water.

title: Holiday Ham Balls
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Lightly grease baking pan., Mix all ingredients thoroughly., Shape mixture into 1-inch balls., Place about 2-inches apart in pan., Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until brown., Immediately remove from pan., Serve warm., This makes about 7 dozen appetizers.

title: Chocolate Pie
directions: In a bowl, mix sugar, self-rising flour and cocoa well., In a saucepan, pour milk and add egg yolk., Gradually stir in sugar mixture and mix well., Cook on medium heat until thick (about 20 minutes)., Add butter and vanilla., Pour into baked pie crust. Top with meringue and brown in oven at 325°.

title: Banana Nut Bread
directions: Sprinkle sugar substitute over bananas and stir; blend in eggs., Sift together flour, baking powder and salt., Add walnuts. Blend thoroughly into banana mixture., Pour batter into greased loaf pan.

title: French Market Soup(Southern Living Magazine)
directions: Sort and wash soup mix; place in Dutch oven., Cover with water 2 inches above soup mix; let soak 8 hours., To speed soaking time: boil 2 quarts water; add bean mixture and boil 3 minutes., Remove from heat; cover and let stand 1 hour., Drain and proceed as directed., Drain soup mix and return to pan; add 2 quarts water and ham hock., Bring to boil; cover., Reduce heat and simmer 1 1/2 hours., Stir in tomatoes and next 4 ingredients., Bring to boil; reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, 30 minutes., Remove ham hock; remove meat from bone., Chop meat and return to soup., Stir in salt and pepper., Yields 3 quarts.

title: Wheeling Station Pesto
directions: Puree pine nuts and garlic with olive oil in food processor. Add basil, spinach and pepper., Process on puree for 2 minutes. Add cheeses and puree for 1 additional minute., Serve over pasta for a very healthy and filling meal.

title: Apple Pecan Pancakes
directions: In a bowl, combine dry ingredients., Stir in milk, egg yolks and vanilla., Add apples and pecans., Beat egg whites until stiff peaks form; fold into batter.

title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Fudge
directions: Combine chocolate, sugar, salt and milk in a saucepan and cook to 235° or soft ball stage., Remove from heat and cool., When cool, add butter, vanilla and peanut butter., Pour into buttered pan and cool until set.

title: French Breakfast Puffs
directions: Cream 1/2 cup sugar, egg and shortening., Sift together flour, baking powder, salt and nutmeg., Add creamed mixture alternately with milk, beating well after each addition., Fill 12 greased muffin pan holes 2/3 full with batter., Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes., When done, dip puffs, while hot, in melted butter, then roll into 1/2 cup sugar and 1 teaspoon cinnamon mixture., Freezes well., Serve hot or cold.

title: German Chocolate Upside-Down Cake
directions: Grease a 9 x 13-inch cake pan., Sprinkle coconut and nuts in the bottom of pan., Mix the cake mix according to directions on box., Pour over nuts and coconut., Soften cream cheese and oleo. Add confectioners sugar and mix with mixer., Pour over cake and bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes., Leave in pan if too sticky to invert.

title: Refrigerator Bran Muffins
directions: In a large bowl, mix bran cereal with boiling water, stirring to moisten evenly. Set aside to cool. Add eggs, buttermilk, oil and fruit., Blend well. Stir together soda, salt, sugar and flour. Add to bran mixture. Bake now or refrigerate in a tightly covered container for up to two weeks., Spoon batter into muffin cups 2/3 to 3/4 full. Bake at 425° for 20 minutes., Makes 2 to 2 1/2 dozen.

title: Fantasy Fudge(Microwave)
directions: Microwave margarine in microwave dish on High for 1 minute, or until melted., Add sugar and milk; mix well., Microwave mixture on High for 5 minutes, or until mixture begins to boil., Stir after 3 minutes; mix well., Continue to microwave 5 1/2 minutes more, again stirring at 3 minutes., Add chips, stirring until melted. Add Fluff, nuts and vanilla; mix well., Pour into greased 9-inch square pan or 13 x 9-inch baking pan., Cool at room temperature; cut into squares.

title: Dutch Pumpkin Nut Bread
directions: In mixing bowl, blend pumpkin, water, egg, cinnamon and mace. Add bread mix and stir until moistened., Turn into greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 50 minutes or until done., Remove from pan and cool., If desired, frost with confectioners sugar.

title: Chili Rellenos Bake
directions: In a large skillet, crumble together the beef and sausage. Cook over medium heat, stirring until meat is browned., Add onion and garlic; cook until onion is limp., Drain off fat., Line a 9 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish with half the chilies; top with 1 1/2 cups cheese., Add meat mixture and top with remaining chilies; set aside., Beat together eggs and flour until smooth; add milk, salt and Tabasco., Blend well., Pour egg mixture over casserole., Bake, uncovered, at 350° for about 40 minutes or until knife inserted off center comes out clean., Sprinkle remaining 1/2 cup cheese on top. Let stand 5 minutes before serving., Makes 6 servings.

title: Chili
directions: Brown ground beef and onion in a skillet., In a large pot add beans, seasoning mix, chili powder and canned tomatoes together. Add ground beef and onion., Salt and pepper to taste., Cover and simmer for 1 to 2 hours.

title: Deviled Eggs
directions: Shell, rinse and split eggs., Place whites on a tray., Set aside. In large bowl, mix yolks, onion, pickles, juice, mustard and mayonnaise., (If mixture is too dry, add a little more mayonnaise.) Add salt and pepper., Fill egg whites with yolk mixture., Sprinkle with paprika., Refrigerate until serving time.

title: Cream Cheese Dainties(Sugary Or Sugar-Free)
directions: In a mixing bowl, beat the butter and cream cheese until well blended., Mix in flour., Divide dough into 4 sections., Cover and refrigerate until easy to handle.

title: Hush Puppies
directions: Mix dry ingredients together in large bowl., Combine eggs, milk and onion., Add to dry ingredients and mix well., Drop by large teaspoonfuls into hot, deep oil at 360° and fry about 2 minutes, turning over once or twice until golden., Drain on paper towels.

title: Applesauce Cake
directions: Mix all but raisins, then blend in raisins., Use greased and floured Bundt pan., Bake at 250° for 20 minutes, then at 350° for 1 hour more.

title: Quick Egg Drop Soup
directions: Bring soup to a boil., Sprinkle pasta in slowly, so that boiling does not stop., Cook until tender., Reduce heat below boiling point., Drop beaten egg in by teaspoons, stirring constantly., Do not return to a boil after adding egg.

title: Cornbread Dressing
directions: Combine cornbread, onions, celery, salt and pepper., Add chicken broth; mash and mix with potato masher., Add egg and mix well., Bake in a roasting pan at 450° for 1 hour.

title: Pancakes
directions: Combine flour, eggs, sugar, soda, baking powder, salt and enough buttermilk to make it the consistency you prefer., Beat by hand until well blended., Best if made the night before you need it.

title: Teresa'S Cinnamon Raisin Popcorn
directions: In greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan, place popcorn and raisins. In 2-quart saucepan, stir together remaining ingredients, stirring occasionally., Bring to boil over medium heat and boil for 5 minutes.

title: Hello Dolly Bars
directions: Layer ingredients as listed in a 9 x 12-inch pan. Do not mix. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Cheese Cake
directions: Have cream cheese at room temperature., Place cheese, sugar, vanilla and 1 egg in a large mixing bowl. Beat with electric mixer until slightly blended. Beat in remaining eggs, one at, a time. Beat until lumps are gone. Pour over graham cracker crust in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 375° until toothpick inserted in cake comes out clean, about 40 minutes. Yields 20 servings.

title: Holiday Fruit Bars
directions: Sift together flour, baking powder and salt., Beat oleo and sugar., Add eggs; beat well., Mix bran cereal, milk and vanilla. Stir in dry ingredients with cherries, nuts and dates; mix well. Spread batter into two greased 9 x 9-inch baking pans., Bake at 350° for about 40 minutes., When cool, sprinkle with powdered sugar., Cut in squares and serve.

title: Cheese Log
directions: Toast almonds at 350° for 10 minutes; cool., Chop 1/4 cup of the almonds and set aside., Grind together 1 cup almonds, cheese (Cheddar) and cream cheese., Add lemon juice, Worcestershire sauce, onion and salt., Blend thoroughly and shape into log about 8 inches long by 2 inches in diameter., Roll in 1/4 cup chopped almonds., Wrap in moisture-proof wrap., Chill overnight and slice to serve.

title: Pumpkin Bread
directions: Blend butter and sugar together until smooth., Add eggs, one at a time; mix thoroughly after each one., Add water and pumpkin until blended and set aside., In a separate bowl, mix all dry ingredients., Add nuts and raisins., Add dry mixture into pumpkin mixture, a little at a time; blend thoroughly., Pour into 2 greased and floured loaf pans., Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 10 minutes.

title: Chili'S Cheese Cake
directions: Crush crackers and mix with melted butter or margarine., Mix and press hard in bottom of two 9-inch pans., Put in freezer for a while until cheese mixture is poured into them.

title: Corn Pudding
directions: Beat eggs slightly., Add milk, sugar and salt., Combine corn and other ingredients., Put in baking dish and bake for 1 hour. Serve hot with cheese., Serves 6.

title: Lasagna
directions: Mix in large pot the tomato sauce, tomato paste, 2 1/2 to 3 cans water (15 ounces), onion, 1 tablespoon sugar, 15 to 20 shakes Italian seasoning, 25 shakes sweet basil, 3 to 4 chunks bell pepper., Sprinkle garlic powder to cover lightly., Cook on medium to high until boiling., Turn to low, stirring occasionally.

title: Poor Man'S Cake
directions: Boil raisins in 2 cups of water slowly for 20 minutes., When done, add 1 cup water., Sift together dry ingredients., Blend in 1 cup shortening., Mix with raisins., Bake in greased and floured tube pan for 1 hour at 350°.

title: Jello Delight
directions: Drain fruit juice into 2 cup measuring cup and add milk to make 2 cups., Add Jell-O and mix well, then add fruit and refrigerate., Very low in fat., I use this for a quick dessert when I need one fast.

title: One Bowl Rocky Road Brownies
directions: Microwave chocolate and margarine in large microwavable bowl at High (2 minutes) or until completely melted., Stir until chocolate is completely melted., Stir in sugar; mix in eggs and vanilla., Stir in flour and 1 cup nuts., Spread in greased 13 x 9-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 35 minutes., Immediately sprinkle marshmallows, chips and remaining nuts over brownies.

title: Jane'S Cranberry Chutney
directions: Drain juice from pineapple and place in saucepan., Add sugar, cranberries, raisins and spices., Heat to boiling., Lower heat and simmer 25 minutes, stirring occasionally., Add nuts and pineapple. Excellent served with ham, turkey and chicken., Keeps well in refrigerator for up to 2 weeks., Freezes well.

title: Chocolate Cinnamon Buns
directions: In mixer bowl, dissolve yeast in warm water. Add shortening, salt, sugar, egg, cocoa and 1 cup flour. Beat 2 minutes on medium speed of mixer or 300 vigorous strokes by hand. Scrape sides and bottom of bowl. Stir in remaining flour. Blend well. Scrape sides of bowl. Cover with cloth. Let rise in warm place until double in bulk, about 1 hour. (If kitchen is cool, place dough on rack over bowl of hot water. Cover completely with towel.) Stir down by beating 25 strokes. Turn soft dough on well floured cloth-covered board. Roll into rectangle, 12 x 9-inch. Spread with butter. Sprinkle with cinnamon-sugar mixture. Roll up, beginning at wide side. Pinch edge into roll. Cut 12 pieces. Place on greased 9-inch square pan. Let rise in warm place until double, about 40 minutes.

title: Party Punch
directions: Fill gallon container with the ingredients.

title: Chocolate Ice Cream
directions: Mix the ingredients; pour into 1 to 1 1/2 gallon ice cream mixer and freeze., Taste like Wendy's Frosty.

title: Chocolate Cookie Cheesecake(Preparation Time: 38 Minutes)
directions: Combine ingredients in a medium bowl; firmly press mixture in bottom and 2 inches up sides of a lightly greased 10 inch spring form pan., Bake at 325° for 12 minutes., Set aside.

title: Apple Bread
directions: Chop apples and cover with sugar., Add oil and egg., Add dry ingredients; mix well., Bake in loaf pan in a 350° oven for 45 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Chewies
directions: Bring sugar and syrup to a boil., Stir in peanut butter. Remove from heat., Pour over cornflakes., Mix and spread on buttered cookie sheets., Cool and cut into squares.

title: Peach Salad
directions: Drain pineapple and add to Cool Whip., Stir dry peach jello in Cool Whip and chill.

title: John Bigotti (Honest John)(Casserole)
directions: Cook noodles and drain., Brown meat, add pepper, onion, mushroom soup and cheese; cook together., Add noodles and tomato soup., Pour into baking dish, cover with grated cheese and bake at 350° until bubbly.

title: Fancy Cookies
directions: Add pecans or chocolate chips to other ingredients., Drop by teaspoonful 1-inch apart on well-greased baking sheet., Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes., Moisten spatula and remove immediately from cookie sheet.

title: Buttermilk Pie No. 2
directions: To mix, add sugar and flour to butter and blend., Add eggs one at a time., Add vanilla and buttermilk and pour into unbaked pie shell., Bake 40 to 45 minutes at 350°.

title: Cornish Hens With Pear Or Apricot Preserves
directions: Fill each hen with 1/4 cup grapes which have been tossed lightly into sugar., Brush each hen generously with hot mixture of melted butter, preserves, salt and pepper.

title: Jabchai(Chop Suey)
directions: Put noodles into boiling water of more than 180° and cook 5 to 6 minutes., Rinse noodles with cold water and drain 2 or 3 times. Stir-fry sliced meats and vegetables., Flavor the rinsed noodles with such various spices as sesame oil, sesame powder, soy sauce and sugar., Add vegetables and meat.

title: Skinny Spinach Dip
directions: Mix together and serve with chips of your choice (bagel, tortilla or crackers).

title: Hawaiian Chicken
directions: Mix first 5 ingredients and heat until melted., Flour and brown chicken., Place in baking dish and pour sauce over chicken and bake 1 hour at 350°., Serve over rice (if desired)., For large groups, use chicken wings.

title: Peanut Rounders
directions: Combine sugar, syrup, milk and peanuts in a heavy saucepan. Cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until it reaches soft ball stage (236°)., Remove from heat., Add butter, vanilla and food coloring. Beat until mixture is creamy. Drop by spoonfuls on waxed paper., Let cool., Makes 25 to 30 patties.

title: Tarheel Chocolate Pie
directions: Melt together the butter and cocoa; add sugar, flour, eggs, vanilla, milk, salt and nuts., Mix well and pour into two unbaked pie shells., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes., Serve with Cool Whip.

title: Latin Coleslaw
directions: Combine first 5 ingredients., Mix remaining ingredients for dressing. Toss all and chill.

title: Jan Hagel
directions: Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy., Add egg yolk. Beat until light., Add flour and cinnamon; mix well., Spread evenly on a greased jelly roll pan (2 x 15 x 1-inch)., Brush on egg white. Sprinkle chopped nuts and sugar on mixture., Bake at 300° for 15 to 20 minutes until light brown., Cut while warm.

title: Spicy Quesadillas
directions: In small bowl, combine tomatoes, taco sauce, 3 tablespoons onions, lemon juice and peppers., Combine cheese with remaining onions., For each quesadilla, sprinkle about 1/2 cup cheese mixture over it., Spoon 2 tablespoons sauce over cheese., Top with another tortilla, pressing gently., Fry in skillet in small amount of hot oil until golden and cheese has melted, turning once., Repeat with remaining ingredients., Heat remaining sauce and serve with quesadillas for dipping., Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Stuffed Zucchini
directions: Cut squash in half lengthwise and scoop out all seeds. Combine the hamburg, rice, onion, salt and pepper, oregano, whole tomatoes and 1/2 can tomato paste., Mix well and fill squash with this mixture., To remainder of stuffing, add the tomato juice (reserved), 1/2 can tomato paste and water to make very soupy. Extra rice may also be added., Put pan in a 350° oven; cover and bake until squash is tender, approximately 1 1/2 hours.

title: Oreo Icebox Cookies
directions: Put crumbled Oreos in bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Wedding Cookies
directions: Cream, Crisco, and, sugar., Add vanilla, salt and nuts. Gradually, add, flour. Roll into balls. Bake for 30 minutes at 325°. Roll in powdered sugar when hot, then again when cool.

title: Eggplant Quiche
directions: Partially bake crusts in preheated 450° oven for 6 minutes. Cook eggplant covered in boiling, salted water for 8 to 10 minutes; drain well., Cook onion and pepper in butter until tender., Blend in flour, soup, salt, sugar, oregano and black pepper., Heat until bubbly., Remove from heat; stir into beaten eggs., Fold in tomato, cheese and eggplant., Pour into pie shells; top with Parmesan cheese (sprinkle on top)., Bake for 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Hot Onion Dip
directions: Mix and bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

title: Hawaiian Style Pork Chops, Rice And Savory Green Beans
directions: Several hours before cooking, wash and season pork chops well. Cover and refrigerate about an hour.

title: Special Chicken Breast
directions: In shallow baking pan (13 x 9 x 2-inch), arrange single layer of beef., Top with chicken., Blend soup and sour cream., Pour over all. Top with bacon. Cover and bake 3 hours at 250°. Then bake uncovered for 1 additional hour.

title: Fried Tomato Cakes
directions: Mix all ingredients except bread crumbs in a large bowl., Now add just enough bread crumbs to make it stiff enough to drop ty tablespoonful into hot oil in frying pan., Brown on both sides. Serve hot., Makes about 10 or 12 cakes.

title: Mauntaine Cookies
directions: Put butter, brown sugar, eggs, baking soda, flour, nuts and raisins in bowl; mix and put on cookie sheet with spoon., Bake at 350° for 3 to 4 minutes.

title: 7-Up Salad
directions: Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water; add cream cheese and beat until smooth., Add sugar, vanilla and pineapple and beat again. Add food coloring and 7-Up cola and beat., Refrigerate.

title: Spinach Rice Salad
directions: Cook rice according to package., Transfer to large bowl; cool slightly., Combine dressing, soy sauce and sugar., Stir in warm rice., Cover and chill., Fold in remaining ingredients before serving.

title: Great American Potato Salad
directions: Combine salad dressing, mustard, salt, pepper and celery seed; mix well., Add potatoes, eggs, celery, sweet pickles and onion; mix lightly, then chill.

title: Simmered Smoked Links
directions: Place sausages in slow cooker., Combine brown sugar, ketchup and horseradish and pour over sausages., Cover and cook on low for 4 hours. Serve with toothpicks.

title: No Crust Quiche
directions: Cook broccoli according to package directions; drain., Spread in ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan., Layer, ham, then cheese over broccoli.

title: Chocolate No Bake Cookies
directions: Bring milk, butter, sugar and cocoa to a boil., Remove from heat and add peanut butter, vanilla and oats., Drop by teaspoon on wax paper or foil until cooled.

title: Salmon Loaf
directions: Drain juice and remove bones from salmon., Break up salmon in bowl., Add bread crumbs and milk; mix well., Distribute butter bits throughout., Add salt and pepper., Mix., Place in greased loaf pan., Sprinkle top with bread crumbs., Bake at 400° for 1/2 hour.

title: Spanish Rice
directions: In large skillet, combine rice, and 2 tbsp. butter. Cook until rice is brown, stirring frequently. Slowly stir in 2 c. water, seasoning mix, and, canned tomatoes, bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cook on low 15 minutes or until rice is tender.

title: Pork Chop-Potato Casserole
directions: Layer pork chops in casserole dish., Peel potatoes; slice in half, layer on chops., Slice onion., Lay around over potatoes. Pour tomato soup on top., Cover with foil., Cook 1 hour in 400° oven.

title: Wedding Punch
directions: Mix all together., Freeze (in plastic garbage bag)., When ready to use, take out of freezer 4 to 5 hours before using; let thaw partially., Place in punch bowl and chip up with large fork. Then put ginger ale over punch., Will be icy., Serves approximately 25 people.

title: Cheesy Broccoli Surprise
directions: Cook macaroni and drain., Add broccoli, ham, milk and cheese. Cook over low heat until thick and creamy.

title: Stuffed Peppers
directions: Cook rice; mix hamburger and rice., Cut top off green peppers. Stuff rice and ground beef in peppers., Pour tomato sauce over peppers and bake., Stuffs about 6 green peppers.

title: Nut Fudge
directions: Combine everything but nuts in double boiler. Stir until smooth., Pour in nuts. Spread candy in buttered pan. Cool., Cut into squares.

title: Kountry Doughnuts
directions: Cut off crusts 'n feed to chickens...make sandwitches wid the jelly..cut enyway you lak.

title: Baked Potato Salad
directions: Heat oven to 425°., Place potatoes on a 15 x 10 x 1-inch baking pan sprayed with nonstick cooking spray., Bake 30 minutes or until potatoes are tender and golden brown, stirring once., Mix mayonnaise, bacon, eggs, onions, salt and pepper in large bowl. Add potatoes; mix lightly., Serve warm or chilled., Makes 6 servings.

title: School Rolls
directions: In, mixer combine 1/2 cup yeast and 1/2 cup sugar., Mix well with, hand., Then add 1 quart warm water or 1 cup butter or 1 cup vegetable oil., Let rise until yeast works well.

title: Chili Relleno Bake
directions: In a skillet, brown together the meat, onion and garlic. Grease an 8 inch or 9 inch square baking pan., Place one can of chilies on the bottom of the dish., Top with 1-1/2 c. cheese., Add meat mixture and top with second can of chilies., Beat together the eggs and flour., Add milk and seasonings and pour over the meat mixture., Top with remaining cheese., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Old Fashioned Carrot Cake
directions: Sift dry ingredients together., Add oil and eggs., Mix well. Add remaining ingredients and mix., Pour into greased and floured Bundt pan., Bake at 325° for 1 hour.

title: Orange Spinach Salad
directions: Drain oranges; wash spinach and pat dry., Combine all ingredients; add dressing and serve.

title: Emma Janes Southern Casserole
directions: Brown onions and meat in butter., Cook noodles until just tender., Mix all ingredients together., Garnish with olives., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Grilled Cheeseburgers
directions: Cook desired number of hamburgers and grilled cheese sandwiches., Before putting the 2 pieces of bread together, add a hamburger patty and your favorite condiment (ketchup, mustard, onion, pickle, etc.)., Delicious!

title: Pancit Canton(Sauteed Noodles, Canton Style)
directions: Slice chicken breast thinly; sprinkle with 1 tablespoon of cornstarch and patis. Mix to coat chicken slices evenly and set aside., Drain mushrooms., Discard tough stems and slice thinly.

title: Chicken Broccoli Casserole
directions: Place broccoli in lightly greased 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Put chicken on top of broccoli., Combine the remaining ingredients, except cracker crumbs, stirring well., Spoon mixture over chicken; top with crumbs., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes, or until bubbly.

title: Hot Bean Dip
directions: In a large saucepan, combine refried beans, picante sauce and taco seasoning mix., Stir over medium heat until thoroughly heated., Garnish with sour cream and serve with tortilla chips. Makes 10 to 12 servings.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
directions: Mix the apples, sugar and nuts., Let stand an hour, stirring occasionally so the mixture makes its own juice., Add dry ingredients to apple mixture., Add oil, eggs and vanilla., Stir by hand., Pour batter into a greased tube pan., Bake 1 hour 15 minutes at 350°.

title: Sesame Seed Cookies
directions: Sift first four ingredients into bowl., Cut in shortening until size of small peas., Stir in egg; add milk, tablespoon at a time, until roughly forms into soft dough., Form into 1-inch balls. Wet balls in beaten egg, then roll in sesame seed., Place on greased cookie sheet., Flatten balls a little., Bake at 375° for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Sweet Pickles From Dills
directions: Drain juices off dill pickles and pour boiling water over and let cool., Cut length wise and cover with the following syrup: Boil sugar, water and vinegar., Pour over split pickles. Refrigerate for 3 or 4 days.

title: Fried Green Tomatoes
directions: Heat some oil in, a cast-iron skillet., Cut tomatoes in thick slices., Dip in bread, crumbs,, then, in, beaten egg and milk, then back in crumbs, again., Fry until tender and golden brown, topping with cheese during last few minutes of cooking.

title: Pizza Burgers
directions: Brown ground chuck in skillet and drain off fat; cool., Add remaining ingredients., Mix all ingredients., Spread on split semi-hard rolls or buns., Bake at 350° for about 10 minutes, until bubbly., Serve immediately.

title: Stuffed Peppers
directions: Saute the ground beef and onion in the fat., Add the tomato sauce, water, rice, salt, pepper, sugar and flour., Simmer for 15 minutes., Clean peppers; boil for 2 minutes and drain., Stuff the peppers with hamburger mixture., On top, add 4 tablespoons buttered bread crumbs and 4 tablespoons grated cheese., Bake for 1/2 hour at 375°.

title: Josephine'S Recipe For Out Of This World Pie
directions: Measure sugar and cornstarch into saucepan; mix well., Add pineapple with its juice; mix well so no lumps form., Stir in pie filling and food color., Use a wooden spoon; stir gently to avoid mashing the cherries., Cook over medium heat until mixture comes to a boil and is well thickened, about 5 to 8 minutes., Remove from heat; stir in dry gelatin., Let cool.

title: Bully Pudding
directions: Put all ingredients into a buttered baking dish; stir well and bake 1 hour in a moderate oven., Serve with cream., It is not necessary to cream the sugar and butter for the cake.

title: Gingerbread
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Allow vinegar and milk to clabber while mixing remaining ingredients (except soda) in order., When ingredients are well blended, dissolve soda in clabbered milk. Stir into flour mixture., Spread in greased 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until top springs back when touched lightly., Cool in pan on wire rack before cutting.

title: Mandarin Orange Salad
directions: Stir sherbet and orange sections into jello and chill thoroughly.

title: Asparagus With Mock Hollandaise Sauce
directions: Place asparagus and water in a 8 x 8 x 2-inch microwave dish. Cover with plastic wrap., Turn back one corner to vent., Cook on High for 7 to 9 minutes or until crisp-tender., Let stand, covered, while cooking sauce.

title: Spaghetti Sauce
directions: Cook beef, onion and shortening in hot skillet., Stir with fork until meat has lost its redness., Pour off fat., Add tomato sauce, tomato paste, mushrooms, seasonings and Worcestershire sauce. Cover skillet., Lower heat and simmer 2 hours, stirring occasionally., Pour over spaghetti.

title: Rice Casserole
directions: Grease pan., Put in oven for 45 minutes to 1 hour., Bake at 350°.

title: Impossible Quiche
directions: Preheat oven to 400°., Grease a 10-inch pie pan., Layer bacon and cheese in pan., Beat together the milk, mayonnaise, eggs, Bisquick, salt and pepper until smooth (15 seconds in blender on high or 1 minute with hand beater)., Pour into pan., Bake until knife inserted in center comes out clean, 30 to 35 minutes., Cool 5 minutes., Garnish with lettuce and tomatoes.

title: Chicken And Sour Cream Enchiladas
directions: Mix together diced chicken, soup, sour cream, chilies and flavor in saucepan., Cook over medium heat until boiling., Fry tortillas in oil, until flexible., Place 2 heaping tablespoonfuls chicken mixture on each tortilla., Place in casserole., Top with cheese and onion., Bake, uncovered, at 350° about 30 minutes.

title: Midwest Chowder
directions: Melt margarine. Add flour and milk. Thicken to make sauce. Add cheese to create cheese sauce.

title: Dump Cake
directions: Layer in a 9 x 13-inch pan in the order given., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Corn Dog Munchies
directions: Prepare corn muffin mix according to directions except with milk instead of water. Pour batter into mini-muffin pan with 24 cups. Fill to 3/4 full. Cut each wiener into 4 bite size pieces. Place one piece in each filled muffin cup. Bake at 375° for about 15 minutes.

title: Hamburger Casserole
directions: Brown 1 pound ground beef in frypan., Season with garlic, salt and pepper to taste., Add tomato soup and simmer 5 minutes., In second pan, cook egg noodles as directed on package., Drain., Add 1 cup chopped onion and cottage cheese., Layer alternately in casserole dish beginning with noodle mixture and ending with meat mixture (about 2 layers of each)., Top with grated cheese and bake in a 350° oven until onion is tender and cheese is melted. Freezes well., Serves 8.

title: Ham Bone Soup
directions: Soak and cook beans according to instructions on package. Saute onion, ham and garlic., Combine all ingredients, except the sherry, into a 6-quart pot., Simmer 4 hours., Add sherry just before serving., Serves 8 to 10 generous servings.

title: Chess Squares
directions: Mix until smooth and pour over first layer., Bake at 325 degrees for one hour. Cool completely before cutting into bars.

title: Chocolate Delight Cheese Cake
directions: Cut in together flour, oleo and nuts., Press into 13 x 9-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes., Let crust cool., Mix cream cheese, sugar and Cool Whip together and spread onto cooled crust., Mix milk and both packages of pudding together and spread onto cheese mixture., Cool 6 to 8 hours., Top with Cool Whip (optional)., Serves 10.

title: Cheese Sheet Cake
directions: Roll out 1 package of crescent rolls to fit bottom of 9 x 13-inch or 13 1/4 x 9 1/4 x 5/8-inch pan., Beat until creamy the cream cheese, vanilla and sugar., Spread on top layer; roll out other crescent rolls., Put over cream cheese., Melt butter and spread on top., Sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon., Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Black-Eyed Peas Mexicana
directions: Brown sausage; drain and crumble., Saute onion and garlic with sausage., Add black-eyed peas, tomatoes, water, chili powder and salt., Simmer for 25 or 30 minutes.

title: Oyster Cracker Snacks
directions: Place ingredients in a 1-gallon plastic bag and shake well. Let it set for 24 hours.

title: Heavenly Hash
directions: Blend cottage cheese and yogurt in blender to remove all curds. Add skim milk to thin if necessary., Blend in coconut extract. Combine mixture with drained fruits., Refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Salmon Quiche
directions: Saute onions in butter until tender., Add mushrooms, reserving a few slices., Saute for a few more minutes.

title: Strawberry Pretzel Salad
directions: Crush pretzels., Mix, pretzels with butter and 3 tablespoons sugar. Press into, a 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake at 400° for about 8 minutes. Remove from oven and cool.

title: Impossible Quiche
directions: Heat oven to 350° and lightly grease a 9 x 10-inch pie plate. Sprinkle bacon, cheese and onion evenly over bottom of pie plate. Place remaining ingredients in blender., Blend on high speed for 1 minute., Pour into pie plate., Bake until golden brown., Bake 50 to 55 minutes., Let stand 5 minutes before cutting., Serves 6.

title: Butter Thin Cookies
directions: Cream butter, sugar and flour together until it forms little beads., Add cream and yolks., Mix very well., Roll out on floured board as thin as desired., Cut with cookie cutter., Dip in unbeaten egg whites; sprinkle with mixture of cinnamon and sugar. Place a few chopped nuts on top (optional)., Bake at 350° about 10 minutes or until light brown.

title: Poppy Seed, Almond Bread
directions: Mix together sugar, vanilla, almond flavoring, oil and milk. Add eggs and poppy seeds., Blend in flour, salt and baking powder. For 1 loaf, bake 1 hour and 15 minutes at 350°., For 6 mini-loaves, bake 35 minutes at 350°., For 12 muffins, bake 30 minutes at 350°., Cool and glaze with confectioners sugar, milk and vanilla or almond extract.

title: Cranberry Nut Mold
directions: Make jello as directed., Add can of cranberries., Allow to chill and set slightly., Add balance of ingredients and mix well. Pour into mold and let set.

title: Dill-Lightful Sour Cream Dip
directions: Combine sour cream, lemon juice, dill weed and salt., Cover and chill., Serve with crackers or vegetables., Yields 2 cups.

title: Macaroni And Cheese
directions: Put 1 tablespoon of butter and salt into water and bring to boil., Add macaroni., Use just amount of water that when macaroni is done, it won't have to be drained., Watch closely., Add 1/4 of the cheese to macaroni quickly., Mix well until cheese melts. Melt butter; add to milk and stir into macaroni so it won't be dry., (Add more milk, if needed.), Pour into a 9 x 13-inch baking dish and poke rest of cheese cubes into macaroni., Sprinkle paprika on top., Bake at 350° for 1/2 hour or until it bubbles.

title: Rolled Biscuits
directions: (If using self-rising flour, omit salt and baking powder.)

title: Pizza Beef Casserole
directions: Mix together the first 5 ingredients well; do not brown meat. Spread meat mixture into a 9 x 13-inch pan., Spread with tomato sauce., Place Mozzarella cheese on top., Top with oregano, basil, seasoned salt and Parmesan cheese., Bake in a 350° oven for about 60 minutes., Nice served with tossed salad and Italian bread.

title: Currant Jelly Fondue
directions: Heat jelly and mustard together to boiling point. Put in fondue dish and keep hot. Provide skewers for people to dip the bread cubes into the fondue.

title: Pear Bread
directions: Cream the butter and sugar., Add eggs, one at a time. Alternate dry ingredients with liquid., Bake in greased pans at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Chicken Easy(Servings 6 To 8)
directions: Layer first 4 ingredients as listed., Dribble melted butter over crumbs., Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

title: Old Fashioned Sugar Pie
directions: Mix eggs, flour, sugars and milks in blender; pour into pie shell., Sprinkle top of pie with cinnamon and dot with butter. Bake at 375° for 30 minutes, then at 350° until center is set, about 10 minutes., Do not overbake.

title: Bread And Butter Pickles
directions: Slice cucumbers, onions and bell peppers into thin slices and sprinkle with salt., Add 1 quart of cracked ice., Cover for 3 hours.

title: Oven-Fried Chicken
directions: Preheat oven to 425°., Melt margarine in 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan in oven. Mix Bisquick, paprika, salt and pepper; coat chicken. Bake 35 minutes., Turn chicken., Bake 15 minutes or until done.

title: Lagniappe Red Beans And Rice
directions: Rinse beans twice., Place in at least 4-quart heavy pot., Add water, ham and sausage., Place on medium heat., While beans are soaking and warming, chop onions., Add to pot., When the mixture boils, reduce and cover., Stir every 20 to 30 minutes for 3 hours. Then, with a wooden spoon mash about 1/4 of the beans against the side of the pot., Forty minutes after mashing beans, add cayenne pepper (not too much)., Cook 30 minutes more while cooking rice. Serve over rice., Vegetables cook away to nothing., The mashed beans thicken sauce., Even better the next day.

title: Sweet And Sour Chicken
directions: Brown chicken., Add water and cover., Simmer., Drain pineapple, reserving juice., Combine brown sugar and cornstarch. Add pineapple juice, vinegar, soy sauce and salt., Pour over chicken., Let stand 10 minutes., Add pineapple, green peppers and onion., Cook 5 minutes., Serve over rice.

title: Nana'S Chili Soup
directions: In pan, fry hamburger; set aside., Peel potatoes, cut into small pieces and boil with macaroni., (When it is finished boiling do not drain water.), Add onion, chili, stewed tomatoes, salt to taste and chili powder to taste, then add fried hamburger., The longer you let it simmer the better, at least 30 minutes., Add water as needed., Goes really good with Nana's cornbread.

title: Baked Zucchini
directions: Simmer all ingredients together for 1/2 hour., Layer in casserole dish with shredded Mozzarella cheese and cooked bacon (any amount)., Bake at 350° until cheese melts, approximately 15 minutes.

title: Chalupas
directions: Put all ingredients in large pan and cover with water., Cook, covered, over low heat., Add water as needed., After approximately 6 hours, take bones out of meat and break meat up., Then cook with lid off into thick mixture for 1 to 2 hours., Serve over corn chips and add the following as desired:, grated cheese, chopped onion, shredded lettuce, diced tomatoes, diced avocados and hot salsa., Serves 12 to 14.

title: Fat-Free Fruit Dip
directions: Combine cream cheese and marshmallow cream., Stir about 30 strokes, or until mixed well., Chill about 1 hour before serving. Dip fresh fruit into fruit dip.

title: Dianes Delicious Dip
directions: Mix and heat until cheese melts, stirring occasionally.

title: Broccoli-Corn Bake
directions: Combine first 8 ingredients in 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Blend 1/4 cup cracker crumbs with 2 tablespoons butter and sprinkle over top., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes., Serves 6.

title: Oriental Pork Loin
directions: Mix marinade, marmalade, garlic, dry mustard and ground ginger in a bowl. Put pork tenderloins in gallon-sized Ziploc and pour marinade in bag and close. Marinate several hours; overnight is best.

title: Scotchy Peanut Bars
directions: Cream butter. Add brown sugar and cream well. Blend in flour (mixture may be crumbly)., Press into bottom of ungreased 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Sweet And Sour Salad Dressing
directions: Combine all, ingredients in food processor. Blend until well mixed. This is a very pungent dressing, but good on spinach salad. (Note: Don't expect anyone to kiss you after eating this dressing!)

title: Tomato-Mushroom Hors D'Oeuvres
directions: Remove mushroom stems., Place mushrooms, round side down, in a shallow baking dish., Cut cherry tomatoes in half.

title: Angel Biscuits
directions: Sift together flour, sugar and soda., Add remaining ingredients and mix as biscuits., Pinch off dough, about the size of a walnut and roll out biscuits., Let stand a few hours to rise. Bake in 425° to 450° oven for 10 to 12 minutes., May store dough in refrigerator in a sealed bowl and use as needed., This will keep 4 or 5 days.

title: 8 Dozen Buns
directions: Dissolve yeast and 1 Tbsp. sugar in 2/3 cup water., In 2 quarts water, dissolve sugar, lard and salt., Stir in egg, yeast mixture and 5 cups flour., Mix well and add enough flour to make a soft dough., Knead lightly and place in a greased pan, and let rise until double., Punch down and let rise again., Shape and place on greased jellyroll pan., Let rise until double and bake at 375 degrees for 25 minutes or until golden brown., OR... you can use this recipe to make cinnamon rolls., You roll out the dough into a rectangle, spread with butter or margarine and sprinkle with cinnamon and sugar., If desired you can add walnuts or pecans., Roll the dough up like a jellyroll and cut into 1 to 1 1/2 inch pieces., Place into a pan and let rise until double and bake at 325 degrees for 25 minutes., OR... you can make donuts by cutting circles and a hole in the middle, letting them rise till double and deep fat frying them., Immediately dip in sugar or glaze after they have cooled a short time., OR...you can take a piece about the size of a lemon and stretch it out and deep fat fry it and put butter and jelly on it., They are better if you eat them right away while they are still hot.

title: Corn And Bean Casserole
directions: Combine all ingredients., Spoon into a lightly greased 2-quart baking dish., Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Pumpkin Spice Cake
directions: Mix baking soda and water together., Beat in eggs., Dump in cake mix and pumpkin pie mix., Beat all together., Pour in greased 9 x 13-inch greased pan., Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Baked Zucchini With Cheese(Serves 3)
directions: Put the zucchini in a colander or on towels to drain off the moisture., Combine the remaining ingredients., Add the zucchini and mix well., Pour into lightly oiled 2-quart casserole dish. Bake in 350° oven for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Beef Fiesta
directions: Brown beef and drain. Mix all ingredients together except for potatoes. Put in a casserole dish. Spoon potatoes around top of casserole. Sprinkle a little chili powder on top of potatoes. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes or until potatoes are slightly brown. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Chicken Croquettes
directions: Melt butter or margarine; add flour and blend to a paste., Stir in heated stock and cook, stirring until sauce is thickened., Cool. Combine remaining ingredients., Add sauce to chicken mixture; mix and chill., Shape into croquettes., Dip croquettes in milk or beaten egg; roll in bread crumbs., Place croquettes in greased pan. Bake at 400° for about 30 minutes.

title: Walnut Angel Food Cake
directions: Whip egg whites until foamy., Add salt and cream of tartar and continue to whip until they hold a point and are not dry., Add 1/2 cup sugar slowly, then the extract., Add flour, remaining sugar and nuts., Bake in an ungreased pan for 30 to 40 minutes in a 350° oven.

title: Corn Pudding
directions: Beat eggs; add to corn., Add salt, pepper, flour, cream and butter., Grease 2-quart casserole., Pour in mixture., Bake at 325° for 1 hour.

title: Iced Tea(Flavored And No Calories)
directions: Place tea bags in coffee filter of automatic coffee maker. Make tea as if making coffee., While hot, add lemonade mix and Sweet 'N Low., Place in a container and add two additional coffee pots of water (1 to 2 proportions)., This is very good to have on hand and I use decaffeinated tea bags.

title: Rich Chocolate Pudding
directions: Melt butter in a small pan., Set aside., In a separate pan, warm milk., Stir cocoa and boiling water together to make a paste, then mix in melted butter., Combine sugar, cornstarch and salt and add to warm milk., Add the cocoa-butter mixture and egg., Cook over medium heat, stirring until thickened, 15 to 20 minutes. Don't let mixture boil., Remove from heat and mix in remaining butter and vanilla.

title: Broccoli Casserole(Serves 8 To 10)
directions: Cook frozen broccoli for 10 minutes; drain it., Melt butter and mix to Ritz crackers that should be crushed; set aside., In a large bowl, mix together onion, cream of celery soup, beaten eggs, Parmesan cheese, mayonnaise, salt and pepper, then add broccoli. Pour mixture into a greased casserole and top with moistened crumbs., Bake in a 350° oven for 40 to 45 minutes., Bake uncovered., When top is light brown, it's done.

title: Nanaimo Bars
directions: Melt 1/2 cup of the butter and mix with egg, cocoa, vanilla, crumbs, coconut and sugar., Press into a 9 x 9-inch pan.

title: Pound Cake
directions: Add all ingredients together., Beat well., Bake in Bundt pan at 350°.

title: Potato Squares
directions: Boil potatoes in jackets until fork-tender., Cool., Peel and grate., Melt oleo over low heat., Stir in cheese., Add mixture to potatoes along with sour cream, onion, salt and pepper., Turn into a greased, shallow 3-quart baking dish., Sprinkle with paprika. Bake in a 350° oven for 30 minutes or until heated through., Cut into squares to serve., Makes 10 servings.

title: Sugar & Spice Cookies
directions: Mix shortening, sugar, eggs, honey, milk and vanilla., Add rest of ingredients., Put dough in refrigerator for 1/2 hour. Form in balls and flatten.	Bake at 350° for 8 minutes.

title: Sugarless Banana Bread(Makes 2 Loaves)
directions: Mix cornmeal, salt and sugar together., Scald with boiling water., Add melted butter., Beat eggs and add milk to eggs., Put the 2 mixtures together., Add baking powder., Pour into baking pan and bake 30 to 40 minutes in oven at 350°.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
directions: Combine marshmallow cream, sugar, milk, butter and salt in, a 2-quart saucepan., Bring to a full, rolling boil, stirring constantly., Continue, to boil over moderate heat, stirring constantly,, for, 5, minutes., Remove from heat; stir in chocolate and, vanilla., Beat, until, smooth., Spread, into a greased, pan. Sprinkle, with a few peanut butter chips.	Melt the rest of the peanut butter chips and spread over the fudge. Chill in refrigerator until firm.

title: Microwave Peanut Butter Fudge
directions: Put candy in a bowl and microwave for 2 minutes., Take out and stir., If not melted completely, put back in microwave for 15 second intervals until all melted., Take out and stir in peanut butter and nuts (any amount you want)., You can add marshmallows if you want., Stir quickly until all melted., Pour out on waxed paper or in pan., Let stand until firm., Cut into squares., Easy and good!

title: Cranberry Pie
directions: In saucepan, combine sugar and cornstarch; mix well., Add corn syrup, water and orange rind., Bring to a boil., Stir in almond extract, raisins, nuts and cranberries., Cover and cook until cranberry skins burst, stirring occasionally., Remove from heat. Dot with butter., Allow to cool; do not stir.

title: Roasted Rosemary Chicken
directions: In a small saucepan, cook garlic cloves and rosemary in hot oil over low heat for 8 to 10 minutes or until garlic is soft (avoid burning)., Remove garlic with a slotted spoon and set aside., Let oil mixture cool., Stir lemon juice, pepper and salt into oil., Wash the chicken thoroughly; pat dry with paper towels. Season body cavity with salt., Twist wing tips under the back. Place chicken, breast side up, on a rack in a shallow roasting pan., Cut five slits randomly in the chicken skin., Insert the five cloves of garlic under the skin., Brush chicken with some of the oil mixture., Insert meat thermometer into the center of one of the inside thigh muscles., Roast at 375° for 1 1/4 to 1 3/4 hours or until thermometer registers 180°.

title: Dump Cake
directions: Mix pie filling and pineapple together in an ungreased 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Sprinkle dry cake mix over this. Add melted butter over cake mix. Add coconut and nuts. Bake at 350° for 1 hour. (I put a brown bag over the cake for a little while, or it will get too brown before it gets done.)

title: Dip For Fresh Fruit
directions: Mix all ingredients together and use as dip for fresh fruit.

title: Pineapple Pie
directions: Into bowl, put crushed pineapple; do not drain., Add pudding. Mix well and add Cool Whip., Mix thoroughly., Pour into graham cracker crust., Sprinkle top with graham cracker crumbs., Let chill.

title: Best Ever Apple Pie
directions: Mix all ingredients. Pour into pie crust.

title: Family Griddle Cakes
directions: Mix all dry ingredients together., Beat eggs and milk., Beat well., Add melted shortening., Pour in pitcher., Pour on hot grill., Cook both sides.

title: Zucchini Bread
directions: Beat eggs and sugar., Add vanilla and oil., Sift dry ingredients and add to egg mixture., Add zucchini and nuts., Bake in 2 greased loaf pans at 350° for 1 hour or until done.

title: Maple-Pecan Pie
directions: Combine first 6 ingredients, mixing well. Sprinkle pecans evenly in pastry shell., Pour syrup mixture over pecans., Bake at 325° for 45 minutes or until set. Yields 1 (9-inch) pie.

title: Taco Pie
directions: Add taco seasoning mix, water and olives to browned and drained ground beef., Simmer 5 minutes., Layer the following into pie crust:, refried beans, Doritos, ground beef mixture and sour cream, Cheddar cheese and more crushed Doritos., Bake at 375° for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Pookey'S Oreo Cookie Dessert
