Grease cookie sheet., Drop meringue by teaspoon onto cookie sheet. Place in oven, close door, turn off the heat and leave until morning., Do not peek!, Makes approximately 4 dozen., Store in an airtight container.

title: Mexican Dip
directions: Brown ground beef; drain., Put a layer of beef, layer of refried beans, layer of sour cream and layer of cheese., Repeat. Bake at 350° for 10 minutes., Eat with chips.

title: Spinach Madeleine
directions: Cook spinach and drain., Reserve liquor., Melt butter in saucepan over low heat; add flour, stirring until smooth (but not brown)., Add liquids, slowly, constantly stirring., Cook until smooth and thick., Add seasonings and cheese., Stir until all melted., Combine spinach., This can be frozen and heated slowly before needed.

title: Ground Beef Chili
directions: In a Dutch oven, cook beef, onion, green pepper and celery over medium heat until meat is no longer pink and vegetables are tender. Drain. Stir in the beans, tomato puree, salsa, tomatoes, broth, water, seasonings and browning sauce, if desired. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat. Simmer, uncovered, for 30 minutes or until chili reaches desired thickness. Garnish with chopped onion, if desired. Yield: 16 servings.

title: Tartar Sauce
directions: Grate onion., Add other ingredients and mix well.

title: Sweet And Sour Meatballs With Rice(About 10 Servings)
directions: Beat eggs in soup and water with fork., Add ground beef and shape in about 40 meatballs., Combine remaining ingredients (except rice)., Pour 1/2 mixture in 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Brown meatball mixture in 10-inch skillet, about 1/3 at a time. Remove and drain off fat., Add on top of, sauerkraut in baking dish. Pour remaining sauerkraut mixture over meatballs., Cover with foil and bake at 325° in oven for 20 minutes., Uncover, bake 15 to 20 minutes longer., Serve over hot rice.

title: Noodle Bake Supreme
directions: Combine first 4 ingredients., Pour into a lightly greased 1 1/2-quart oblong baking dish., Sprinkle Parmesan cheese over noodle mixture, then dust with paprika., Bake in a 350° oven for 30 to 35 minutes or until hot., Let stand 5 minutes before serving., Makes 6 servings.

title: Hawaiian Grilled Chicken
directions: Marinate boneless chicken breasts for 36 hours before grilling.

title: Peach And Cream Cheese Pie
directions: Mix flour, baking powder, salt, dry pudding mix (not instant), egg and milk., Pour into a greased 9-inch pie plate., Place drained peaches on top., Mix cream cheese, sugar and peach juice and spread over peaches about 1-inch away from edge of pan., Mix 1 tablespoon of sugar and cinnamon and sprinkle on top. Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Magic Coffee Cake
directions: Combine first 3 ingredients in a saucepan and bring to a boil. Set aside., Spray bottom of a Bundt pan with nonstick cooking spray and sprinkle 1/3 cup pecans in the bottom of the pan., Cut up 2 cans of biscuits into 1/4's., Put on top of pecans in Bundt pan. Pour 1/2 of the mixture in saucepan over biscuits., Put another 1/3 cup pecans on top., Cut up other 2 cans of biscuits and put on top. Pour remaining mixture over biscuits., Sprinkle remaining pecans on top and bake at 325° for 45 minutes., Invert onto serving plate immediately (be careful; contents of pan will be hot!)., Allow to cool., Serve warm.

title: Taco Salad
directions: Brown meat and onion; drain off grease., In separate pan, prepare Rice-A-Roni by directions.	Stir in meat, salsa and chili powder with rice and simmer for 5 minutes.	Arrange chips, lettuce, meat, cheese and tomato., Add taco sauce if desired.

title: Dilly Beans
directions: Wash 4 pt. jars and keep them hot until needed., Prepare lids per manufacturers directions., Wash beans; trim stem ends so beans are 1/2 inch shorter than jars., Combine water, vinegar and pickling salt in a saucepan and bring to a boil., Keep hot., In each hot jar, place 1 dill sprig, 1 garlic clove and 1/8 tsp. red pepper flakes., Pack beans lengthwise in 1 jar at a time., Add hot vinegar mixture to cover, leaving 1/2 inch headspace., Release trapped air by slipping a plastic knife between the beans and the side of the jar., Wipe jar rim with a clean, damp cloth., Attach lid., Fill and close remaining jars., Process in a boiling water bath 5 minutes.

title: Peach Cobbler
directions: Melt butter in baking dish., Mix next 3 ingredients., Pour in pan., Do not stir.	Pour in peaches., Bake in 350° oven for 50 minutes.

title: Pork Chop Tots
directions: Put pork chops in 9 x 13-inch baking pan., Pour soup, that has been mixed with a small amount of water, over pork chops., Top with Tater Tots., Bake at 300°, for 35 to 45 minutes., Top with cheese the last 3 to 5 minutes.

title: James Eggplant Parmesan
directions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees., Lightly oil a baking tray and a 9 x 13 inch pan.

title: Chilies Rellenos Bake
directions: Mix ingredients until uniform., Pour into a well greased 9 by 13 baking dish and bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Shanghai Noodles With Spicy Meat Sauce
directions: Cook and drain noodles., Put ground beef, onion and garlic in large skillet and stir-fry until meat is brown., In small bowl, combine 1/4 cup chicken broth, hoisin sauce and beef broth., Stir into meat mixture., Cover, reduce heat and simmer 10 minutes, stirring once or twice., Dissolve cornstarch in remaining chicken broth., Slowly stir into meat mixture; cook until thick. Serve over hot noodles., Serves 4 to 6.

title: Mexican Enchiladas
directions: Dip tortillas into enchilada sauce., Place large spoonful of tortilla filling on each and roll up., Arrange in an 11 1/2 x 7 1/2 x 1 1/2-inch baking dish., Cover with more enchilada sauce; sprinkle with remaining tortilla filling., Heat to 375°., Serve to 6 Mexicans.

title: Chocolate Caramel Dessert Bar
directions: Mix cake mix, water, eggs, brown sugar and butter until smooth. Stir in chocolate chips., Spread mixture in 9 X 13 pan., Bake at 375 for 24 - 27 minutes until toothpick comes out almost clean.

title: Texas Cake
directions: Cream flour, butter and pecans together; pat into 9 x 12 x 2-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 25 minutes., Freeze for 1 hour., Mix cream cheese, sugar and Cool Whip together., Spread over crust. Sprinkle with half of coconut., Prepare pudding by mixing with milk for 3 minutes., Spread over cheese layer., Top with Cool Whip and remaining coconut., Chill overnight.

title: Grape Butter
directions: Into a large heavy kettle, place grapes and sugar. Bring to a boil, stirring often. Boil rapidly 20 minutes., Put hot mixture through a sieve., Ladle into jars and seal.

title: Pumpkin Bread
directions: Mix eggs, sugar, pumpkin, oil and water, then add the rest of the ingredients., Mix well., Grease loaf pans and add mixture. Bake at 325° for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

title: Cheese Cookies
directions: Combine all ingredients and roll into balls., Place on ungreased cookie sheet., Put a pecan half in center of each ball and flatten., Bake at 350° until lightly browned.

title: Baked Mushrooms
directions: Saute mushrooms in own juice., Set aside., Mix stuffing as directed on package., Set aside., Layer all ingredients in a 9 x 12-inch pan using 1/2 of each., Repeat layers., Dot with butter. Bake at 325° to 350° for 30 minutes or until thoroughly heated.

title: Beef And Barley Mulligan
directions: In large skillet, cook ground beef with onion and ground pepper until meat is browned; drain. Stir in remaining ingredients. Bring to boil. Reduce heat; cover and simmer for about an hour or until barley is tender, stirring occasionally. Serve with salad and fresh baked bread.

title: Strawberry Freeze
directions: Place strawberries and Equal in a food processor or blender. Mix until coarsely chopped., With motor running, gradually add evaporated skim milk., Mix until smooth., Serve immediately. Serves 4.

title: Poppy Seed Cake
directions: Mix together and put in tube pan., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Venison Stew(Crock-Pot Style)
directions: This is a cook's delight., In the morning, just before going to work, place the ingredients in your crock-pot and season with Morton Nature's Seasons., When you return home your stew will be ready.

title: Five Flavor Pound Cake
directions: Note:, If large eggs are used, only use 3/4 cup milk.

title: Baked Halibut Parmesan
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., Lightly grease a flat baking dish, preferably one that can be brought to the table., Place halibut steaks in a single layer in baking dish., In a small bowl, blend together the sour cream, Parmesan cheese, dill weed, salt, pepper and butter., Cover fish with the sauce., Bake for 20 to 25 minutes, or until the fish loses its translucency., Sprinkle lightly with paprika and serve at once, garnished with lemon wedges.

title: Vegetable Dip
directions: Mix ingredients together until smooth., Refrigerate., Serve with assorted raw vegetables.

title: Yum Yum Salad
directions: Heat pineapple, water and salt to boiling point., Add jello and cream cheese., Stir until dissolved and set until firm., Top with topping and sprinkle with, nuts or graham crackers.

title: Irish Soda Bread
directions: Sift dry ingredients., Add raisins; coat with flour., Add remaining ingredients; stir until well blended., Pour into greased and floured layer cake pan., Bake at 375° for 60 minutes.

title: Soft Oatmeal Applesauce Cookies
directions: Cream shortening and sugar; beat in egg., Sift flour with baking powder, soda, cinnamon, cloves and nutmeg., Mix in raisins and oats., Add to creamed mixture alternately with applesauce and beat well., Drop with teaspoon onto baking sheet., Bake at 375°.

title: Kathy'S Chocolate Chip Cookies
directions: Cream shortening and sugars., Add pudding mix, vanilla and eggs., Beat well., Stir in flour and soda, mixed., Add chips. Bake on ungreased sheets for 8 to 10 minutes at 375°.

title: Chocolate Crackles(Cookies)
directions: Combine cake mix, eggs, water and shortening., Mix with a spoon until well blended., Shape dough into a ball the size of a small walnut., Roll balls in confectioners sugar., Place on greased baking sheets., Bake in moderate oven (375°) for 8 to 10 minutes., Makes 48 cookies., These cookies made with cake mix have a moist, fudge center.

title: Ripe Tomato Pickle
directions: Combine all, ingredients, in, a, large pan. Cook 2 to 3 hours until desired consistency.	Place in jars and seal.

title: Yummy Yum Punch
directions: Make Kool-Aid; pour into punch bowl., Add sherbet (1/2 gallon). Roll gently with plastic or wooden spoon (large)., Pour in 7-Up, 1 ginger ale and 1 bottle of club soda., Roll gently again with spoon and serve.

title: Savory Crescent Chicken Squares
directions: Heat oven to 350°. Blend cheese and 2 T. margarine until smooth., Add next 6 ingredients and mix well., Separate dough into 4 rectangles., Firmly press perforations to seal., Spoon 1/2 c. meat onto center of each rectangle., Pull four corners of rectangles to center of chicken mixture., Twist slightly and seal edges., Place on ungreased cookie sheet., Brush edges with reserved margarine., Bake at 350° for 20 - 25 minutes or until browned., Serves 4.

title: Cinnamon Sauce
directions: Mix sugar and flour., Add cinnamon and water., Cook over medium heat until thickened and transparent., Makes about 2 cups.

title: Banana Nut Bread
directions: Cream sugar, shortening and eggs until light., Spoon flour into dry measuring cup., Add soda and salt to flour., Stir to blend., Add dry ingredients to creamed mixture alternately with banana and lemon juice., Stir until all ingredients are moistened. Stir in nuts., Spread in well-greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Bake at 350° for 55 to 60 minutes., Remove from pan immediately. Cool on rack.

title: Cinnamon Pound Cake
directions: Mix together all ingredients except the brown sugar and cinnamon., In separate container, mix together brown sugar and cinnamon., Grease, and, flour Bundt cake pan., Sprinkle 1/3 of brown, sugar-cinnamon, mix in bottom of cake pan., Pour 1/2 of batter, over, brown sugar-cinnamon mixture., Sprinkle 1/3 more brown, sugar-cinnamon, mixture on batter., Pour remaining cake batter, in	pan, and, top, with remaining brown sugar-cinnamon mixture., Bake at 400° for 10 minutes and 35 minutes at 325°.

title: Zucchini Butter Fried
directions: Cut zucchini in 1/4-inch slices. Dip in eggs and flour. Put 1/2 cup butter in skillet over medium. Turn over when browned. Sprinkle with lemon pepper seasoning. Add butter as needed to skillet.

title: 7-Up Cake
directions: Cream together sugar, butter, Crisco and vanilla., Add eggs and flour alternately with 7-Up. Bake at 325° for 1 1/2 hours in a tube pan., Check cake at 1 hour and 20 minutes.

title: Chinese Vegetable Pouches
directions: Pour 1 tablespoon oil around top of a preheated wok, coating sides., Heat on high for 1 minute., Add carrot and cook 1 minute, stirring constantly., Add cabbage and cook, stirring constantly, 5 minutes or until tender., Stir in greens and next 6 ingredients. Mix cornstarch and water, stirring until smooth; add to cabbage mix., Cook, stirring constantly, 1 minute or until thickened., Let cool.

title: Egg Noodles
directions: Beat eggs slightly., Add water, salt and flour., Roll paper thin and cut thin strips., Can be cooked immediately, frozen or kept in refrigerator for up to 3 days.

title: Pumpkin Squares
directions: Mix first four ingredients until crumbly., Press in bottom of unbuttered 9 x 13-inch pan and bake at 350° for 15 minutes. Combine all remaining ingredients and beat well., Pour over crust. Then combine 1/2 cup pecans, 1/2 cup brown sugar and 2 tablespoons melted butter together., Sprinkle over top and bake at 350° for 20 minutes or until it sets.

title: Wedding Cookies
directions: Cream the butter and 1/2 cup sugar until light and fluffy. Add vanilla and flour., Continue beating until well mixed., Stir in nuts., Cover., Chill dough 1 hour., Shape dough into 1-inch balls., Bake on ungreased cookie sheet for 15 minutes., Roll in confectioners sugar., Cool completely, then roll in sugar again. Makes 3 dozen., Can freeze up to 3 months.

title: Speedy Beet Sauce
directions: Cook for 5 minutes., Pour over 1 dozen small beets., Add 2 teaspoons of butter before serving.

title: Brownies
directions: Mix together., Bake in 350° oven until done., Cool and cut.

title: Peanut Brittle
directions: Stir together the peanuts, sugar, corn syrup and salt in 8-cup measure., Place in microwave and cook on High 7 to 8 minutes, stirring well, after 4 minutes., (Wooden spoon can be left in bowl.), Add butter and vanilla to syrup, blending well., Return to microwave and cook 1 minute more., Peanuts will be lightly browned and syrup very hot., Add baking soda and gently stir until light and foamy., Pour and spread mixture quickly onto lightly greased (flexible) cookie sheet; let cool 1/2 hour.

title: Crispy Crunch Bars
directions: Line a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan with foil., Butter the foil. In a large saucepan, melt marshmallows and 3 tablespoons butter or margarine over low heat, stirring constantly, until marshmallows are melted., Remove from heat., Stir in vanilla. Stir in half of the cereal at a time., Fold in raisins, peanuts, sunflower seeds, nuts or snipped gumdrops if desired., Turn mixture into prepared pan., Press evenly with the back of wooden spoon or with buttered hands., Cool; cut into bars., Makes 24 bars.

title: Carrot Cake
directions: Mix together flour, brown sugar, baking soda, salt and cinnamon., Add oil and water., Stir well., Add eggs and carrots. Beat well., Pour into greased pan., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Creamy White Chili
directions: In a large saucepan, saut chicken, onion and garlic powder in oil until chicken is no longer pink. Add beans, broth, chilies and seasonings. Bring to boil. Reduce heat; simmer, uncovered, for 30 minutes. Remove from heat; stir in sour cream and whipping cream. Serve immediately. Makes 7 servings.

title: Vanilla Peanut Butter Fudge
directions: In a saucepan, mix white sugar, brown sugar and milk., Cook 1 1/2 minutes., After it boils, add peanut butter, walnuts and Marshmallow Fluff; mix well., Pour into large 13 x 9 x 2-inch lightly greased pan., Cool.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
directions: Mix fat and peanut butter., Add both kinds of sugar (one at a time) and beat well. Beat in eggs. Sift flour, salt and soda together., Stir into peanut butter mixture. Drop by teaspoons onto baking pan. Bake at 375° for 10 to 15 minutes., Makes 2 to 2 1/2 dozen cookies.

title: Reuben Casserole
directions: Layer sauerkraut and noodles in bottom of 9 x 13-inch greased baking dish., Crumble corned beef on top, then cheese., Mix crumbs with butter., Sprinkle on top., Cover with foil and bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Hash Brown Au Gratin
directions: Mix all ingredients together and put into 9x13-inch baking dish., Bake at 350 degrees for 1 to 1-1/4 hours.

title: Hidden Valley Ranch Chicken
directions: Dip washed and dried chicken in melted butter., Dredge in bowl of dressing mix, the cheese and crumbs., Bake, uncovered, in well-greased baking dish at 350° for 45 minutes or until golden. Serves 4.

title: Savory Egg And Sausage Bake
directions: Heat oven to 350°. Grease rectangular 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Layer sausage, mushrooms, onions, tomatoes and cheese in dish. Stir remaining ingredients until blended. Pour over cheese. Bake, uncovered, for 30 to 35 minutes or until golden brown and set. Makes 12 servings.

title: Texas Hash
directions: Brown ground beef and mix with other ingredients., Bake 1 hour at 350° in covered dish.

title: Pumpkin Crunch Cake
directions: Line a 9 x, 13-inch pan with wax paper., Melt butter or margarine; cool., Mix together and pour into the lined pan the pumpkin, evaporated, milk, sugar, cinnamon and eggs., Sprinkle yellow cake mix, over, mixture., Sprinkle, chopped nuts., Pour melted butter over all., Bake, in, a, 350°	oven, for, 1 hour. After it's baked, wait, about, 5 to 10 minutes, then turn over while hot onto a, serving, tray., It may be a little soft when hot, but hardens as, it, cools., Top with Cool Whip when cool, or before serving.

title: Lemon Pecan Cake
directions: Mix and let set in tube pan overnight., Bake at 275 for 2 1/2 hours.

title: Ambrosia
directions: Put 1 tablespoon pineapple juice over cheese in saucepan over low heat until melted and completely cooled., Whip the cream and add remaining ingredients.

title: Chocolate Sheet Cake
directions: Mix and add to other ingredients. Hand beat until all are mixed well. Bake at 350° approximately 20 minutes in 13 1/2 x 9-inch pan. Check for doneness with a straw.

title: Orange Fluff Salad
directions: Put cottage cheese and crushed pineapple in bowl., Sprinkle powdered Jell-O over top., Stir well., Stir in Cool Whip.

title: Happy Home Recipe
directions: Take Love and Loyalty; mix thoroughly with Faith., Blend with Tenderness, kindness, understanding and Forgiveness., Add Friendship and Hope; sprinkle abundantly with Laughter., Bake with Sunshine., Serve daily with generous helpings.

title: Date And Nut Bread
directions: Pour water over dates., Add next four ingredients., Mix and let cool a little., When cooled, add flour, baking powder and nuts., Pour into a greased loaf pan., Let rise (set) for 20 minutes., Bake in a moderate oven (350°) about 1 hour.

title: Festive Roast Duck
directions: Preheat oven to 450°., Mix apples, parsley, celery and leaves, shallots and juniper berries., Stiff ducks with mixture and sew up cavity.

title: Pecan Pie
directions: Combine sugar, syrup and margarine., Add eggs; mix well. Place pecans in unbaked pie shell., Pour in filling. Bake at 325° for 30 to 40 minutes or until center is set.

title: Quick Baked Pasta
directions: Saute garlic and beef in oil., Drain fat., Add all remaining stuff, except mozzarella and pasta., Simmer while boiling pasta. Drain pasta and mix with above., Pour, into 3 quart baking dish, and top with mozzarella cheese., Bake uncovered at 350 degrees for 25 minutes., Serves 6.

title: No Crust Sweet Potato Pie
directions: Place all into a bowl; blend well., Spoon into a lightly greased 9-inch pie plate., Bake at 450° for 25 minutes until lightly brown., Cool., Top with whipped cream.

title: Rhubarb-Strawberry Dessert
directions: Cook rhubarb, sugar and water until tender., Remove from heat. Add jello and stir until dissolved., Pour into serving dish and chill., Top with Cool Whip, if desired.

title: Monkey Bread
directions: Quarter biscuits and shake in a large bowl with cinnamon and sugar., (Let this sit while dissolving other ingredients:, then shake again.), Dissolve brown sugar and margarine., When dissolved, add nuts., Grease a Bundt pan., Then place 1/2 biscuits in pan. Pour 1/2 dissolved mixture over them, and then add remaining biscuits and mixture., Bake at 350 for 30 minutes., Serves 10.

title: Zucchini Quiche
directions: Combine ingredients as listed., Turn into buttered 13 x 9-inch pan and bake for 30 minutes at 350°., (This is a good way to use a large amount of extra zucchini from your garden; good for a light summer supper or brunch.)

title: Pancakes For A Crowd
directions: Beat eggs., Add milk. Add dry ingredients and oil., Mix well. Yields 85 servings.

title: Texoma Beans
directions: Cook pinto beans. Saute onions and garlic with the ground beef. Mix all other ingredients into this mixture; add to the cooked beans and cook all together until the flavors are well blended.

title: French Lemon Pie
directions: Cream butter and sugar., Add eggs, one at a time., Mix all. Add lemon juice last., Pour into unbaked pie crust., Bake 35 minutes at 350°., Use 8-inch pie pan.

title: Chicken Parmesan
directions: Combine crumbs, cheese, salt and pepper., Dip chicken in melted margarine, then in cracker crumbs, being sure to coat each piece heavily., Place chicken in baking dish and bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes uncovered., Do not turn chicken.

title: Salmon Loaf
directions: Drain salmon; remove skin and bones and flake into a bowl. Add remaining ingredients. Shape into a loaf and place in a well-buttered pan. Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until the top is a delicate golden brown and loaf is firm, but still moist and tender. Serve as is or with sauce.

title: Crystal Garden
directions: Place the water, bluing, salt and ammonia in a jar and stir thoroughly., Set the coal or briquettes in an old pie tin in a single layer., Pour the solution on top., Put several drops of food coloring on coal (or briquettes), leaving some areas plain. Set it in a quiet place., The next day, you will see gorgeous crystal-formations.

title: Ice Cream Salad
directions: Let Jell-O set until it is almost jelled. Add the cream cheese, nuts, cherries and pineapple. Fold in the ice cream. Chill several hours.

title: Toll House Pie
directions: Preheat oven to 325°., In a large bowl, beat eggs until foamy. Beat in flour, sugar and brown sugar until well blended., Blend in melted butter., Stir in chocolate morsels and walnuts., Pour into pie shell., Bake 1 hour., Remove from oven., Serve warm with whipped cream or ice cream.

title: Fudge
directions: Mix and cook the sugar, milk, cocoa and salt on heat until soft ball stage., Take off fire and cool enough to hold in hands., Beat and add the vanilla, butter, marshmallow cream and peanut butter. Pour into buttered greased pan.

title: Low-Fat Pudding Frosting
directions: Blend first 3 ingredients slowly until well blended., Fold in whipped topping.

title: Deep Dish Chicken Pie
directions: Mash potatoes with milk, oleo, salt, pepper and nutmeg until light and fluffy., In another large bowl, mix remaining ingredients., Turn this mixture into a deep 4-inch pie plate. Cover with the mashed potatoes., Bake at 375° for 30 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

title: Home Made Boursin Cheese
directions: Blend all ingredients and chill for 24 hours before serving.

title: Pumpkin Dip
directions: Blend cream cheese, powder sugar, pumpkin pie filling and ginger together until well blended., Serve on ginger snaps.

title: Shrimp And Vegetable Dip
directions: Mix sour cream, soup and Miracle Whip in bowl., Chop shrimp and add., Refrigerate overnight., Serve with crackers.

title: Apple Pound Cake
directions: Mix sugar and oil., Add eggs., Beat well., Combine flour, salt and soda., Add to oil mixture., Stir in vanilla, apples, coconut and walnuts., Mix well., Spoon batter into 9-inch tube pan and bake at 325° for 1 hour and 20 minutes or until cake is done.

title: Oven Barbecued Chicken
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Place chicken in pan with a little water and bake 30 minutes., Prepare sauce by melting butter and adding onion and browning lightly., In another bowl, mix mustard and catsup, then add all other ingredients., Pour into pan with butter and onion and bring to a boil and simmer at least 5 minutes., When chicken has baked 30 minutes, pour sauce over chicken and bake another 30 minutes., Drain chicken before adding sauce.

title: Rotel Chicken
directions: Cook chicken in water and keep the broth to cook spaghetti in. Add more water if necessary., Cook the spaghetti to soak up all of the water into the noodles., In frying pan, melt butter., Saute bell pepper, onion, mushrooms and olives until tender., Add Ro-Tel to mixture., Add mushroom soup., Stir., Cut Velveeta and add to mixture and blend thoroughly., Add 3/4 of the Cheddar cheese to mixture., Stir mixture into noodles., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Cheddar-Squash Bake
directions: Cook squash until tender, 15 to 20 minutes., Drain and sprinkle with salt., Set aside a few slices for garnish., Mix sour cream, egg yolks and flour; fold in egg whites., In a 12 x 7 1/2 x 2-inch baking dish, put half the squash, then 1/2 the egg mixture. Sprinkle with 1/2 the cheese., Layer remaining squash, egg mixture and cheese., Combine bread crumbs and butter; sprinkle over top., Top with bacon and parsley., Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Seafood Pizza Spread
directions: Drain crabmeat (if using canned)., Blend cream cheese, lemon juice, Worcestershire sauce, mayonnaise, onion and garlic powder. Spread on a round serving plate., Spread cocktail sauce over cream cheese., Sprinkle shredded crabmeat and shrimp on top. Refrigerate several hours before serving., Serve with crackers.

title: Pea Salad
directions: Mix mayonnaise, vinegar and sugar., Pour over salad and chill at least 1 hour.

title: Caramel Brownies
directions: Mix 1/2 cake and 1/3 cup evaporated milk together., Press in bottom of a greased pan (13 x 9-inch)., Bake at 350° for 6 minutes., Melt caramels with remaining milk, stirring until smooth., Add margarine; mix well., Sprinkle nuts and chocolate chips over cake., Pour caramel mixture over, spreading to edge of pan., Sprinkle remaining cake mix over top, pressing into caramel mixture., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes., Cool slightly. Refrigerate., Cut into bars.

title: Crab Dip
directions: Combine yogurt or sour cream, mayonnaise, cream cheese and seasoning., Mix well, then stir in Cheddar cheese and crab. Cover 2 hours., Sprinkle with paprika., Serve with crackers, bread sticks or vegetables.

title: Bacon-Wrapped Shrimp
directions: Cut bacon in half; wrap bacon around the shrimp., Secure with wooden toothpick., Place in 9 x 13-inch baking dish., Pour teriyaki sauce over shrimp., Cover and refrigerate 1 hour., Bake at 400°, uncovered, for 20 to 25 minutes or until bacon is crisp.

title: Lemon Poppy Seed Bread
directions: Mix together and pour into oiled loaf pans., Makes 2 loaves. Bake at 350° for 40 to 50 minutes.

title: Poor House Cookies
directions: Cream butter and sugar; beat in egg., Mix together flour, salt and baking soda., Add this to butter-sugar mixture., Add chopped nuts on greased cookie sheet., Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes. Makes 4 dozen.

title: Bev'S Vegetable Spread
directions: After grating and chopping vegetables, use paper towels to press out excess liquid., Mix all ingredients., Spread on white sandwich bread with crusts trimmed., Cut into quarters or triangles., (Bread may need a thin spread of mayonnaise.)

title: Crab-Broccoli Bisque
directions: Saute butter and onion until transparent., Add flour, half and half and milk., Stir until thick., May thicken with cornstarch, if preferred., Add pepper, crab meat and broccoli and heat thoroughly., Add grated Parmesan cheese just before serving., Top with croutons or oyster crackers., May serve with warm, crusty French bread.

title: Beef Tips On Rice
directions: Combine all ingredients in a crock-pot and simmer all day. Prepare rice as directed on package.

title: Overnight Salad
directions: Mix and chill overnight.

title: Peanut Butter Chocolate Chip Cookies
directions: Cream butters and sugars until light and fluffy., Add vanilla and eggs, mix well., add dry ingredients., Then add chocolate chips., Roll into 2 inch balls and put onto cookie sheet., Bake at 350° for 10-12 minutes., About 10 dozen cookies., They go fast, so you'll need this big of a batch.

title: Broccoli Salad
directions: Cook broccoli until tender., Chop it and the hard-boiled eggs. Soften the gelatine with cold water and melt into the heated consomme., Add this to the first mixture, fold in mayonnaise. Season in amounts prescribed., Mold until firm., Serves 10 people.

title: 1, 2, 3, 4 Layer Cake
directions: Mix together all ingredients., Beat 350 strokes by hand., Bake at 325° in three (3) greased pans (round).

title: Crystal Pickles
directions: Wash cucumbers., Put in a stone jar., Put a brine over them made of 2 cups coarse salt to 1 gallon of water., Don't boil the brine., Place a plate over the pickles with a weight on it to hold the pickles in the brine., Leave them for 2 weeks and skim the brine off every day., When you take them out, drain and wash. Slice or chunk as desired and cover with cold water to which has been added 2 tablespoons alum., Let stand 24 hours; drain and wash., Make syrup.

title: Swedish Meatballs
directions: Mix bulk pork sausage, eggs and soft bread crumbs., Using palms of hands shape into meatballs., Saute in frying pan until browned on all sides; drain., Combine catsup, brown sugar, white wine, vinegar and soy sauce., Pour over meatballs and simmer 30 minutes, stirring occasionally., Serve hot.

title: Shake
directions: Blend and pour into tall glass.

title: Cabbage Casserole
directions: Combine cabbage wedges and water in a large saucepan; cover and cook over medium heat 15 minutes., Drain well and place cabbage wedges in a 12 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish., Melt butter in a heavy saucepan over low heat., Add flour, stirring until smooth. Cook over low heat 1 minute, stirring constantly., Gradually add milk; cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until mixture is thickened and bubbly., Stir in salt and pepper., Pour mixture over cabbage and bake at 375° for 20 minutes., Combine cheese, mayonnaise, chili sauce, onion and green pepper., Stir well and spread over cabbage., Bake at 400° for 20 minutes.

title: Cucumber Pickles
directions: Cut cucumbers, unpeeled, in 3/8-inch slices., Dissolve pickling lime in cold water., Soak cucumbers in cold water solution 24 hours., Rinse cucumbers well and soak in clear water 3 hours. Dissolve the sugar in vinegar. Add salt, cloves, celery seed and pickling spices., Soak cucumbers in vinegar solution overnight., Cook on stove 35 minutes or until slices are clear. Put in hot jars and seal.

title: Homemade Chili
directions: Brown hamburger and drain., Crumble very fine., Add tomato soup and chili powder to taste. Simmer for 1 to 2 hours.

title: Shrimp Mold
directions: Dissolve gelatin in water., Cream the cream cheese and add along with gelatin to heated soup., Allow mixture to cool., Add mayo, celery, onions and seasonings., Let stand in refrigerator until thickened, about 5 minutes., Add shrimp., Place in well oiled mold and chill until firm., Serve with crackers.

title: Party Cheese Ball
directions: *All chopped very fine.

title: Spiced Pecans
directions: Beat egg white with water until frothy; coat pecans., Add sugar, cinnamon and salt mixture., Bake on buttered cookie sheet in 225° oven for 1 hour, tossing every 15 minutes.

title: Cream Of Coconut Cake
directions: Bake cake mix according to directions on box in a 9 x 13-inch sheet cake pan., While cake is still warm, pour can of condensed milk over cake., (Pole holes in cake so milk will go into cake.) Let cool., Mix Cool Whip, cream of coconut and 1/2 bag flaked coconut together., Pour over cooled cake., Add remaining coconut to top of frosting., Refrigerate several hours or overnight before serving.

title: Watergate Salad
directions: Fold dry pudding mix into whipped topping., Add pineapple and juice., Add marshmallows and nuts., Mix and pour into pan. Refrigerate until set.

title: Spicy Pecans
directions: In a medium mixing bowl, combine the egg white and water., Add the nuts., Mix well., In a small bowl, combine the sugar and cinnamon., Sprinkle the sugar mix over the nuts, mixing well, until the nuts are coated.

title: Black Bean Salsa
directions: Combine all ingredients; cover and refrigerate 8 hours., Drain liquids., Serve with tortilla chips., Yields 3 cups.

title: Rice Krispies Treats
directions: Put in a saucepan over low heat 1/4 cup margarine; add marshmallows and stir until completely melted., Add Rice Krispies; stir until well coated., Using buttered spatula or waxed paper, press mixture evenly into 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan coated with cooking spray., Cut into squares when cool.

title: Hash Brown Casserole
directions: Thaw potatoes., Mix with soup, sour cream, onion, oleo, 1 cup cheese and salt and pepper to taste., Pour into a well-greased baking dish (9 x 13 x 2-inch)., Bake for 45 minutes in 350° oven. Makes 8 servings., Each has 243 calories, 14 gr fat and 33 mg cholesterol.

title: Quick Crescent Pecan Pie Bars
directions: Preheat oven at 375°. Lightly grease 13 x 9-inch pan. Spread rolls over bottom and 1/2-inch up side, closing all holes. Bake at 375° for 5 minutes. Pour combined ingredients over partially baked crust. Bake at 375° for 18 to 20 minutes.

title: Homemade Orange Sherbet
directions: Mix well and pour into can of ice cream freezer., Freeze until freezer stops or, if you use hand-turned freezer, until firm.

title: Orange Julius
directions: Keeps in refrigerator but separates., Shake well., Makes 1 quart.

title: Jiffy Creamy Corn Pudding
directions: Starting with muffin mix, stir in all ingredients., When thoroughly blended, bake, uncovered, in a 350° oven for 40 minutes., Simple but delicious.

title: Zucchini Crisp
directions: Peel zucchini., Slice lengthwise in half, remove seeds and cube., Place zucchini in a large skillet with the lemon juice. Cover and cook until zucchini becomes transparent and soft (about 15 to 25 minutes)., Add sugar and cinnamon., Simmer for 2 minutes. Add 1/2 of remaining crumb mixture to zucchini., This will thicken it., Spread zucchini onto baked crust., Sprinkle remaining half of crumb mixture on top., Bake at 375° for 35 minutes., Tastes like apple pie.

title: Mexican Cornbread Casserole
directions: Preheat oven to 400°., Rinse beans with cold water and drain. In a 9 x 13-inch baking dish, combine beans with peppers, corn, tomatoes, dip, Cheddar, chili powder and cumin., In a medium bowl, stir together the cornbread mix, egg substitute, skim milk and oil., Spoon evenly over bean mixture., Bake until heated through and cornbread topping is lightly browned, 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Cranberry Chicken
directions: Melt butter in a saucepan., Add cranberry sauce and soy sauce. Mix well over medium heat., Place chicken in a baking pan., Pour mixture over chicken., Bake, uncovered, at 425° for 1 hour.

title: Cranberry Orange Cupcakes
directions: Put softened butter, sugar and orange rind of orange into food processor and process until soft., Add egg and segments of orange and process until smooth., Add orange juice and cranberries and process until the cranberries are coarsely chopped.

title: Homemade Macaroni And Cheese
directions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees., Coat an 8-inch square baking dish with nonstick cooking spray., Cook the macaroni according to the package directions until firm; drain and set aside., In a large saucepan, melt the butter over low heat., Stir in the flour, and cook for 1 to 2 minutes., Add the milk, salt, and pepper, and cook over medium heat, until the mixture starts to bubble, stirring occasionally., Remove the mixture from the heat and add 2 cups cheese, stirring until melted., Add the macaroni; mix well then pour into the baking dish., Top with the remaining 1/4 cup cheese and sprinkle with the bread crumbs., Bake for 20 to 25 minutes, or until the mixture is bubbly and the top is golden.

title: Heath Bars
directions: Cream butter, blend in sugar, egg yolk and vanilla., By hand, mix in flour, 2/3 cup Heath bits and nuts., Press into ungreased 15 x 10-inch jelly roll pan., Bake in 350° oven for 18 to 20 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Never Fail Fluffy Frosting
directions: Put all ingredients in top of double boiler., Have water in bottom part hot or almost boiling., Begin to beat with mixer at once., Beat until desired thickness., Spread on cool cake., Enough for a 2 layer (9-inch) cake.

title: Granola
directions: Mix first five ingredients in large mixing bowl. Add melted margarine and vanilla., Stir., Spread evenly on a 10 x 15-inch cookie sheet., Bake at 300° for 30 minutes., Stir after 15 minutes., Add raisins after baking and sprinkle over top of granola.

title: Calico Beans
directions: Brown hamburger, onion and bacon; add other ingredients. Bake for 40 minutes at 350°., Freezes good.

title: Beef Stroganoff
directions: Brown meat in butter., Add tomato sauce, salt, pepper and Worcestershire sauce., Cover and simmer until meat is tender., Mix cornstarch and water until smooth., Stir into meat mixture., Cover and cook 10 more minutes, stirring to keep from sticking., Cool slightly and stir in sour cream., Serve over flat noodles.

title: Potatoes In Salsa(Serves 4)
directions: Peel and cut potatoes 1/2 inch thick., Mince onion and garlic and saute gently in oil; add flour., Add potatoes and seasonings. Cover with water; cover pan and simmer slowly for 15 or 20 minutes.

title: Cracker Jack
directions: Combine sugar, syrup, margarine and cream of tartar., Bring to a hard boil., Boil 5 minutes., Remove from heat; stir in soda. Pour over corn., Place in large roaster; bake at 250° for 1 hour. Stir occasionally.

title: Millionaire Salad
directions: Drain artichoke hearts, hearts of palm, olives, pimentos and red peppers., Place with sliced mushrooms in a large glass container with lid., Combine other ingredients., Marinate vegetables in oil mixture overnight., Remove veggies from marinade with slotted spoon., Serve chilled in lettuce-lined bowl.

title: Rainy Day Vegetable Soup
directions: Mix beef bones, garlic clove, salt, barley, celery tops and chopped onion in 2 quarts of water in kettle., Cover and simmer 3 hours., Skim soup; remove bones and meat., Add tomatoes., Melt butter in skillet; slightly cook carrots, green beans, potatoes and cabbage for 7 minutes, stirring often., Add to soup., Cover; simmer for 20 minutes., Add peas and meat (cut into bite size pieces)., Season with salt and pepper., Serve., Makes 5 quarts.

title: Carrot Pecan Crunch Pie
directions: Puree carrots in a blender or food processor until smooth. Carrots should measure 2 cups., Set aside., Combine eggs, sweetened condensed milk, pumpkin spice and salt., Add carrots and mix well. Pour mixture into unbaked pie shell., To make a topping, combine the last 3 ingredients and mix well., Sprinkle evenly over pie. Cover the crust of pie with foil to prevent overbrowning and bake at 375° for 20 to 25 minutes., Remove foil., Continue to bake for 20 to 25 more minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean., Makes 8 servings.

title: Dirty Rice
directions: Brown hamburger and onion., In a 2 1/2-quart baking dish, mix all together., Bake at 350°, for 1 1/2 hours, covered.

title: Mexicali Meat Pie
directions: Brown the ground beef and drain., Stir in remaining ingredients., Pour into 8-inch baking dish., Bake at 425° for 25 minutes.

title: Fantasy Fudge
directions: Combine sugar, oleo and evaporated milk in heavy 2 1/2-quart saucepan., Bring to a full boil, stirring constantly to prevent scorching (boiling 5 minutes over medium heat)., Remove from heat. Stir in chocolate pieces until melted., Add Marshmallow Creme, nuts and vanilla., Beat until well blended., Pour into 13 x 9-inch greased pan., Cool room temperature., Cut into squares., Makes 3 pounds.

title: Lemon-Cheese Tarts
directions: Beat eggs in top of double boiler until thick and fluffy. Continue beating while gradually adding sugar, lemon juice and rind., Place over hot water and cook, stirring constantly, until custard is thick and smooth., Cool slightly., Gradually blend custard into cream cheese and when smooth, fill tart shells. Makes 6 servings.

title: Apple Pie
directions: Heat oven to 425 degrees., Prepare crust of your choice. Stir together first 4 ingredients; mix with apples., Turn into crust; dot with butter., Cover with top crust that has slits cut in it; seal and flute., Cover edge with 2 to 3 inch strip of aluminum foil to prevent excessive browning; remove foil last 15 minutes of baking.

title: Decorating Icing
directions: Beat 5 minutes., Increase speed on mixer., Used for decorating wedding cakes., Very good icing.

title: Lemon Pie
directions: In a bowl, combine 3/4 cup flour and salt with pastry blender or two knives., Cut in 3 tablespoons margarine until mixture resembles coarse meal. Add yogurt and mix thoroughly., Form dough into ball and refrigerate at least 1 hour.

title: Exotic Spinach
directions: Cook spinach in small quantity of water for 5 minutes; drain. Combine with dry soup mix and sour cream., Pour into casserole dish., Cover with crumbs., Bake in 350° oven for 30 minutes.

title: Sunday Steak
directions: Heat oven to 350°. Cut steak in serving size pieces. Pour oil in skillet. Roll steak in flour and brown on both sides. Remove to baking dish. Add onions to skillet and brown lightly. Add rest of ingredients to make sauce. Simmer a few minutes and pour over browned meat. Bake in covered baking dish until tender, about 3 hours.

title: Michigan Cherry Torte
directions: Make cake according to package directions., Let cool., In a 9 x 13-inch pan crumble cake., Pour pudding over cake., Spread evenly with pie filling and chill., Mix whipped topping and spread evenly over pie filling., Cover and chill until serving.

title: Rotel Chicken
directions: Boil chicken and save 2 quarts of broth., Saute onions and bell peppers., Cook vermicelli in broth saved; don't drain., Add Ro-Tel tomatoes and Worcestershire sauce; cook 3 or 4 minutes. Add drained peas, mushrooms, onions and peppers., Add cheese, cut in chunks, and stir until cheese is melted., Add cut-up chicken and stir thoroughly., Cook 45 minutes at 350°., Freezes well.

title: Hamburger And Macaroni Casserole
directions: Cook macaroni in salted water., Cook hamburger and onions together until done., Drain macaroni and put in casserole dish.

title: Sloppy Joes
directions: Saute pepper and onion strips in a small amount of oil until tender., Add hamburger and cook until brown., Then add sugar and vinegar., Stir., Add can of tomato sauce and stir., Heat on low for 10 minutes., Serve on buns.

title: Chocolate Pound Cake
directions: Sift dry ingredients together, cream butter, shortening and sugar., Add other ingredients (eggs one at a time and beat after each one) before adding dry ingredients alternately with milk. Bake 1 hour and 25 minutes in 300° oven.

title: Freezer Green Beans
directions: Use large pot., Place frozen beans from freezer in pot., After peeling onion, cut in several pieces and place in pot., Open can of round potatoes and place in pot., Add the country cured ham., Pour water in pot., Cook on medium to medium-high for approximately 1 hour., Watch closely and check to see if salt is needed., Some salt will come from ham.

title: Main Dish Potato Salad
directions: Combine salad dressing, mustard, celery seed, salt and pepper; mix well., Add potatoes, broccoli, cheese, ham, eggs, celery, onion and pickles., Mix lightly., Chill.

title: Do Ahead Breakfast
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Lightly grease a 13 x 9 baking pan. Arrange bread slices in two layers.

title: Beefy Spanish Rice
directions: In a large skillet, cook ground beef, onion, green pepper and garlic until the meat is browned; drain., Stir in the next eight ingredients; bring to a boil., Reduce heat; cover and simmer for 20 minutes or until the rice is tender., Stir in tomato paste and heat through., Serve with French bread., Yield:, 4 to 6 servings.

title: Refrigerator Relish
directions: Chop vegetables., Mix sugar, vinegar and oil together; pour over vegetables and eat and enjoy., This will keep in the refrigerator for days.

title: Basic Mayonnaise
directions: Put egg, seasonings, vinegar, lemon juice and 1/4 cup oil into blender., Process on whip; remove feeder cap and pour in rest of oil in a steady stream., Turn blender off and use rubber spatula to remove from blender.

title: Coconut Pie
directions: Mix and pour into pie shell., Bake for 10 minutes at 425°, then reduce to 350° and cook 30 to 40 minutes, until firm.

title: Broccoli Salad
directions: Toss broccoli, onion and raisins together., Mix mayonnaise, sugar and vinegar and let stand 10 to 15 minutes to allow sugar to dissolve., Pour dressing over broccoli and toss., Refrigerate until just prior to serving., Before serving, add bacon, cheese and nuts and toss again.

title: Butterscotch Brownies
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Melt butter over low heat., Blend in sugar. Cool., Stir in egg, flour, powder and salt., Mix in vanilla and nuts., Spread in well greased square pan., Bake for 25 minutes. Do not over-bake!

title: The Ultimate Dip
directions: Spread a layer of cream cheese on the bottom of a microwave-safe dish., Cover completely with chili and top with Cheddar cheese., Microwave on High for two minutes or until cheese is melted., Serve warm with plenty of corn chips.

title: Chicken And Spaghetti
directions: Brown onion lightly in oil., Add chicken soup, milk, Cheez Whiz, pimentos, cooked chicken and the cooked spaghetti., (Can be topped with shredded cheese, if desired and cooked at 375° for about 25 minutes)., I make mine in iron skillet., After you mix all the ingredients, just simmer until it's as thick as you desire.

title: Sand Tarts
directions: Mix sugar and butter in mixer until fluffy., Add eggs and continue to beat., Add flour, a cup at a time., Mix until mixer won't mix anymore., Then add remaining flour by mixing with your hands., Roll in logs., Let stand overnight in refrigerator., Cut log in sections and roll as thin as possible on floured surface. Cut in desired shapes., Bake at 350° for 5 to 8 minutes.

title: Spaghetti Casserole
directions: Cook spaghetti., Drain., Mix with margarine, egg and Parmesan. Put in 13 x 9-inch pan., Cover with cottage cheese, then spaghetti sauce., Cover and bake at 350°, for 30 to 45 minutes. Remove cover and top with Mozzarella., Return to oven until cheese melts.

title: Breakfast Casserole
directions: Tear bread into pieces., Place in a 3 x 9-inch greased baking dish., Brown and drain 1 pound sausage., Drain and spoon over bread., Sprinkle with cheese., Beat eggs, milk, mustard, salt and pepper., Pour over mixture and bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Mabel'S Buttermilk Biscuits
directions: Mix together dry ingredients and sift., Add shortening and cut in with pastry blender., Add buttermilk, all at once, and mix with a fork until dough follows fork., Add just enough flour to work until able to roll out.

title: Chicken Marengo
directions: Heat oil in large skillet., Brown chicken., Pour off oil. Stir in remaining ingredients., Cover., Cook over low heat 45 minutes or until tender., Stir now and then., Uncover., Cook until desired consistency., Serve with buttered noodles., Serves 6.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Mix dry ingredients together in a large bowl., Add raisins. In a separate bowl, mix egg, water, vanilla and oil well., Make a well in the dry ingredients and add the liquid mixture., Mix well. Drop from teaspoon onto ungreased cookie sheet., Bake for 10 minutes at 350°.

title: Blond Brownies
directions: Mix well flour, baking powder and salt; set aside., Melt butter., Add sugar and mix well., Beat egg and vanilla., Stir in flour mixture, then nuts., Spread in greased 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

title: Chili
directions: Brown onions and garlic in shortening., Add meat and brown. Drain., Add salt, sauce, water, chili powder and beans (drained and washed)., Simmer 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Fruit Salad
directions: Mix pie filling with 3 tablespoons Tang and mix with pineapple juice., Mix in fruit., Let chill.

title: Red Velvet Cake
directions: Mix coloring and cocoa and set aside., Cream butter, sugar and eggs., Sift flour and salt., Add alternately with buttermilk., Mix vinegar and baking soda and add to mixture., Add vanilla and coloring mixture., Put in greased pans and bake at 350° for about 30 minutes.

title: Gourmet Potatoes
directions: Mix all the ingredients, except the corn flake crumbs and the 1/4 cup melted butter together.

title: Chocolate Mint Bars
directions: Mix in order given and put into a greased 10 x 15-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes or bake in 9 x 13-inch pan. Cool.

title: Fresh Vegetable Dip
directions: Mix well; let stand in refrigerator at least 10 to 12 hours. Makes 1 quart.

title: Frozen Pops
directions: Dissolve Jello, Kool-Aid and sugar in hot water., Add cold water; stir., Makes 14 (3-ounce) paper cups., Freeze and enjoy.

title: Orange Sherbet Party Punch
directions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water., Add sugar and stir until dissolved., Add cold water., Combine juices and add to Jell-O mixture., Chill., Spoon sherbet into punch and add ginger ale just before serving., Serves 40.

title: Greek Tortellini Salad
directions: In a large bowl combine cooked pasta, peppers, onion, and olives.

title: Apple-Walnut Cake
directions: Mix apples and sugar., Let stand while mixing other ingredients., Mix eggs, oil and vanilla., Add to apple mixture. Mix dry ingredients and walnuts into apple mixture., Bake for 40 minutes at 350°.

title: Easy Oven Potatoes
directions: Amounts of ingredients are not listed, as you may add any amount you desire according to your individual taste.

title: Cinnamon Graham Crackers
directions: Spread whole graham crackers over a cookie sheet., Melt together margarine and brown sugar., Add nuts to this mixture. Spread mixture over graham crackers., Bake for 10 minutes in 350° oven., Take out of oven and place on wax paper., Break apart for serving.

title: Olive Mccready'S Sweet Potato Souffle
directions: Mash potatoes with mixer., Add butter and rest of ingredients; top with topping and bake in greased pan., Cook for 35 minutes in 350° oven.

title: Oatmeal Crunchies(Diabetic)
directions: Cream margarine and brown sugar in large bowl until light and fluffy. Add eggs and vanilla. Beat until smooth. Combine flour, Equal, salt and baking soda; blend into egg and margarine mixture. Then stir in oats. Drop by teaspoons onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350°.

title: Caramel Apple Salad
directions: Mix the first 5 ingredients; cook until thick., Let cool. Peel and dice the apples; mix with 1/2 cup, chopped peanuts., Pour cooled mixture over apple mixture., Mix in the Cool Whip., Top with 1/2 cup chopped Spanish peanuts., Chill until ready to serve.

title: Frozen Strawberry Margarita Pie
directions: Combine crumbs, sugar and oleo in a small bowl., Press into bottom and sides of a 9-inch pie plate., Beat condensed milk, lime juice, tequila and Triple Sec in a large bowl with mixer on medium speed for 3 minutes or until smooth., Lower speed; beat in strawberries and syrup for 1 minute., Fold whipped cream into strawberry mixture until no streaks of white remain.

title: Irresistible Peanut Butter Cookies
directions: Heat oven to 375°., Combine peanut butter, Crisco, light brown sugar, milk and vanilla in a large bowl., Beat at medium speed until well blended., Add egg; beat just until blended.

title: Pizza Rounds
directions: Brown both meats together over medium heat in skillet., Add the onion, spices and then the cheese., Heat and mix until cheese melts., Top each slice of cocktail rye with a tablespoon of mixture., Freeze on cookie sheets., Once frozen, you can freeze in Ziploc bags or plastic containers.

title: Baked Spiced Peaches
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Arrange peaches cut side up in 1-quart shallow casserole dish., Combine syrup, brown sugar, cinnamon and nutmeg., Pour over peaches., Sprinkle with corn flakes and dot with margarine., Bake 10 minutes.

title: Pasta E Fagioli(Pasta And Bean Soup)
directions: In a 4-quart saucepan, heat oil over high heat; add onions, celery and garlic and saute until onions are translucent., Add tomatoes and cook, stirring constantly for 1 to 2 minutes; add water and kidney beans and bring to a boil., Reduce heat to medium. Cover and cook until beans are tender, 20 to 30 minutes., Add zucchini, carrots, green beans and peppers to soup and stir to combine., Cover and cook until vegetables are tender, about 15 minutes., Stir in ditalini, basil, parsley and salt; cover and cook until macaroni is just al dente, about 8 minutes., Serve each portion sprinkled with 1/2 ounce cheese., Yield:, 4 servings.

title: One Pan Banana Bread
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Generously grease the bottom of loaf pan, 9 x 5 x 3-inch., Stir all ingredients in pan with fork until moistened., Beat vigorously 1 minute., Bake until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean, 55 to 65 minutes., Cool 5 minutes.

title: Spinach Dip
directions: Thaw and squeeze water from spinach., Mince onion., Chop water chestnuts., Blend ingredients., Chill 1 to 2 hours., Hollow out round loaf of bread to form bowl for dip., Serve with crackers.

title: Amish Salad Dressing
directions: Mix thoroughly the oil, egg, mustard, salt and 1/3 cup sugar. Set aside., Over low heat, blend flour, 1/3 cup sugar, vinegar and water., Bring to a boil, stirring constantly until thickened. Combine well with first mixture., Makes 3 cups., Tastes like Marzetti slaw dressing., Good with cabbage or any dish you want to have a sweet and sour taste.

title: Broccoli And Rice Casserole
directions: Cook fresh broccoli until tender., Chop it up and put in a 1-quart casserole bowl., Add your 1 cup of cooked rice to broccoli., On stove, melt butter and cook onion until tender., Mix in cream of mushroom soup and stir mixture together., Pour over broccoli and rice., Put cheese on top and cook for 20 minutes at 400°.

title: Pumpkin Pie
directions: Mix all ingredients together while pumpkin is warm., Use electric mixer., Pour in 2 brown pie shells., Cook at 325° for 45 minutes.

title: Puppy Chow
directions: Melt together the butter, peanut butter and chocolate chips. Pour over Crispix cereal., Coat with powdered sugar., Lay out flat to dry 5 minutes.

title: Dinner Potatoes With Herbs
directions: Choose uniform potatoes, scrub and pare. Roll in flour which has been seasoned with salt, pepper and herbs, fresh or dried. Place in buttered casserole dish and dot with butter. Add bay leaf and garlic. Cover and bake in 450° oven for 45 - 60 minutes or until potatoes are done.

title: Orange French Toast
directions: Combine eggs and orange juice., Dip bread in egg mixture, then into crumbs., Pan-fry in butter until lightly brown., Serve with your favorite syrup or honey.

title: Irish Kisses
directions: To your favorite butter frosting, add mint extract and green food coloring to your liking.

title: Mama'S Chocolate Pound Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 325°., Cream together butter and shortening; add sugar and eggs., Sift dry ingredients together and add with milk to other ingredients., Add vanilla and mix well., Bake for about 80 minutes.

title: Chicken - Mushroom Casserole
directions: Cut chicken into bite-size pieces., Cook chicken in 1 tablespoon of the margarine about 10 minutes., Remove from pan. In the remaining margarine, cook onion, mushrooms and garlic until onion is tender., Stir in the soup, milk and pepper., Heat to boiling, then add chicken and cook on low for 5 minutes., Mix with noodles and serve.

title: Cheese Ball
directions: Combine the cream cheese and Cheddar cheese., Mix until blended, add remaining ingredients., Roll into ball., Chill, roll in pecans.

title: French Baked Squash
directions: Heat oven to 350 degrees., In medium saucepan, bring 2 quarts water to a boil., Add squash and zucchini., Cook 3 to 4 minutes or until almost crisp-tender., Drain., In 10 inch skillet, cook bacon until crisp., Remove with slotted spoon and reserve., Add onion to bacon drippings., Cook and stir over medium heat for 2 minutes. Drain off drippings., Add reserved bacon, soup, red pepper, salt and pepper., Mix well., Remove from heat., Fold in vegetables. Transfer to 2 quart baking dish., Cover with foil., Bake 30 minutes., Remove foil., Sprinkle with cheese., Place under broiler to lightly brown cheese, if desired., Makes 8 servings.

title: Peanut Butter Squares
directions: Mix ingredients together as for a pie crust., Press into a 9 x 13-inch ungreased pan., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes., Frost while warm with chocolate frosting., Cut immediately into squares.

title: Monkey Bread
directions: Generously grease Bundt pan with butter., In plastic bag, mix sugars and cinnamon., Shake a few biscuits at a time in plastic bag and place in Bundt pan., Spread remaining sugar on top., Melt butter and pour on top.

title: Barbecue Pork Sandwiches
directions: In a large pot, combine all ingredients, except 1 teaspoon sweet pickle relish., Cover and simmer for about 4 hours or until meat falls apart easily., Skim off any excess fat., Remove meat from liquid; shred and return to liquid and heat through., Serve on hamburger rolls with sweet pickle relish for each sandwich.

title: Glazed Carrots
directions: Heat brown sugar and butter until sugar dissolves., Add carrots (already cooked) and dash of cinnamon., Turn carrots until well glazed and tender, about 12 minutes.

title: Terry'S Favorite Casserole
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., Brown meat with onions; drain., Cook macaroni according to package directions., Drain macaroni and return to pot., Add meat., Stir in tomatoes, soup, tomato paste and sour cream., Transfer to a 9 x 13 x 2-inch baking dish., Top with shredded cheese., Bake 25 to 30 minutes until hot through and bubbly.

title: Eggplant Casserole
directions: Peel eggplant; cook in small amount of water until tender. Drain., Mash with potato masher., Add other ingredients and top with grated cheese.

title: Instant Spiced Tea
directions: Mix all ingredients together and store in a dry container (sealed).

title: Coconut Pie
directions: Cream margarine with sugar and add buttermilk., Add eggs, beating after each., Add vanilla and coconut., Pour into 2 unbaked pie shells and bake at 350° for 1 hour or until brown.

title: Perfect Cornbread
directions: Sift flour with sugar, baking powder and salt., Stir in corn meal., Add eggs, milk and shortening., Beat with rotary or electric mixer until smooth, about 1 minute., Pour into greased 9 x 9 x 2-inch pan., Bake in hot oven (425°) for 20 to 25 minutes. For sticks, spoon batter into pans, filling 2/3 full., Bake in hot oven at 425° for 12 to 15 minutes or until brown.

title: Pumpkin Roll
directions: In a large bowl, combine eggs and sugar, beating well., Add pumpkin and lemon juice, mixing well until blended., In a separate bowl, combine flour, baking powder, spices and salt., Add to egg mixture, mixing well., Spread batter into greased and waxed paper lined 10 x 15-inch jelly roll pan., Bake at 375° for 15 minutes. Remove from oven., Cool for 15 minutes., Place cake on clean tea towel., Cool 10 minutes longer., From 10-inch side, roll the cake up in the towel; set aside.

title: Mildred'S California Casserole
directions: Saute onions in oleo until golden., Cook rice and add while hot to onion mixture., Add sour cream, cottage cheese, bay leaf, salt and pepper., Mix well., Grease a 13 x 9-inch pan., Layer 1/2 of rice mixture, half the chilies and half the cheese., Repeat layers., Bake at 375°, uncovered, for 25 minutes., Sprinkle top with parsley.

title: Myrtle'S Turtles
directions: Grease 8 x 8-inch pan with butter., Layer ingredients as listed., Pour milk over all., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes or until golden.

title: Pidgeon Poop
directions: Melt almond bark and mix with cereal and pretzels., Add marshmallows., Spread on wax paper., Cool and break.

title: Mystery Casserole
directions: Slice potatoes., Put in ungreased casserole., Next, put layer of celery., Then layer of raw hamburger; add onion., Pour over this the undiluted soup., Bake at 350°, for 2 hours.

title: Dietetic Dessert
directions: Mix., Pat in a 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake 15 minutes at 350°.

title: Cheddar Dip
directions: Toss ingredients with mayonnaise to desired consistency. Chill overnight. Serve with corn chips or crackers.

title: Microwave Fudge
directions: Stir milk, sugar and butter in a large microwave-safe bowl. Cook on High temperature of microwave oven for 9 to 10 minutes. Stir twice during cooking. Remove from microwave oven and stir in chocolate chips, marshmallow cream and vanilla. Stir until chocolate is melted. Add nuts., Pour into greased 8 x 11-inch dish., Let cool and cut into squares.

title: Stuffed Burger Bundles
directions: Prepare stuffing mix according to package directions., Add cranberries., Combine beef and milk., Divide into 5 portions., On waxed paper, pat each into 6-inch circle., Place 1/4 cup of stuffing in center and close meat over., Place meatballs in 1 1/2-quart casserole., Combine remaining ingredients; pour over meat., Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes., Makes 5 servings.

title: Salmon Pie
directions: Mix salmon with potatoes., Add butter, salt, pepper, eggs and milk; mix well., Add enough milk to make a thick batter., Beat well; turn into a buttered pan., Cover with bread crumbs., Bake for 45 minutes at 350°.

title: Zucchini Muffins
directions: Grease muffin tins (do not use paper cups)., Beat the first 3 ingredients., Add the other ingredients; mix well., Fill muffin tins to the top; will not run over., Bake for 20 minutes at 350°.

title: Cream Of Broccoli Soup
directions: In medium size saucepan, combine celery soup and milk. Add onion and broccoli; bring to a boil over medium heat. Reduce heat and simmer until broccoli is tender. This will take about 10 minutes.

title: Pink Smoothie
directions: Place all ingredients in blender; process until smooth.

title: Baked Chicken Rolls With Cheese And Mushrooms
directions: Preheat oven to 425°., On each chicken cutlet, spread 1/4 of cheese; roll tightly., Secure with toothpick., Place rolled chicken in 8 x 8-inch baking dish., In small bowl, mix undiluted soup with wine (or both)., Blend until smooth., Pour mixture over rolled chicken., Bake for 20 minutes until chicken is tender. Remove chicken to platter; spoon sauce over., Remove toothpicks. Garnish with parsley., Contains 270 calories per serving.

title: Banana Nut Bread
directions: Cream the shortening and sugar., Add eggs one at a time., Add mashed banana and vanilla., Add dry ingredients alternately with buttermilk and nuts., Put into two 9 x 5-inch loaf pans and bake 45 to 50 minutes at 350°., Cool for 10 minutes, then remove from pan., Slice when cold., Keeps moist when tightly wrapped., Freezes well.

title: Lemon Delight
directions: Mix good and put on second layer., Top with cool whip & sprinkle with pecans., (Use any flavor of pudding you want, but lemon is the best.)

title: Chicken Loaf
directions: Boil chicken with cut up onion and celery until done., Mix all together and pack into greased loaf pan., Bake until brown on top. Cool some before slicing., Bake in 350° oven for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Watermelon Slices
directions: Line a 1 1/2-quart bowl with plastic wrap., Set aside., In another bowl, mix 1/2 of the topping with the food coloring. Spread on bottom and sides of the prepared bowl., Freeze 30 minutes., Spread remaining topping over the green layer and freeze 1 hour., Mix sherbet with chopped chocolate and spoon into center of topping., Freeze at least 4 hours.

title: Prize Winning Meat Loaf
directions: Heat oven to 350°., Combine all ingredients except ground beef; mix well. Add ground beef; mix lightly but thoroughly. Press into 8 x 4-inch loaf pan., Bake 1 hour., Let stand 5 minutes before slicing.

title: Bob'S World Famous Cancun Enchiladas
directions: Chop crab meat to about 1/2-inch pieces. Mix crab with shrimp and Monterey Jack. Mix nacho cheese and Cheddar cheese soups together. Pour half into crab/shrimp/cheese mix and mix thoroughly. Roll generous amount of mix into soft shells, but do not overstuff. Place stuffed shells into baking dish side by side. Sprinkle more cheese over top of rolls, then pour remainder of soup over top of shells. Bake at 350° for approximately 45 minutes or until hot and bubbly and cheese is melted.

title: Stuffed Cheezy Chicken
directions: Prepare stuffing as on box and set aside., Cut pockets in chicken breasts., Spray baking dish (9 x 13) with Pam., Stuff mixture into chicken pockets., Place into dish., Top with 2 slices of cheese per breast., Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Spaghetti Salad
directions: Cook spaghetti. Dice very finely the tomatoes, cucumbers and onions., Mix all ingredients and refrigerate overnight., Makes very large quantity, but keeps well refrigerated and can be halved.

title: Mom'S Banana Bread
directions: Mash bananas, add flour, shortening, egg, baking soda, sugar and salt., Mix well, add nuts if desired., Grease 2 loaf pans and split the batter evenly., Bake at 350 degrees for 45 to 50 minutes., Cool on the side.

title: Vegetable Soup(Nutritional)
directions: Cooking time is 4 hours in crock-pot., Serve with cornbread muffins or saltines.

title: Egg And Mushroom Casserole
directions: Spread half of cheeses on bottom of 9 x 13 dish. Add mushrooms on top of cheeses. Add pepper and onion and finish cheese on top of this. Mix Egg Beaters, milk and flour and pour into dish. Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Sugar Cookies
directions: Cream butter and sugar., Add vanilla., Mix in flour and salt gradually, mixing well., Roll in small balls, then flatten out on ungreased cookie sheet., Bake at 400° until it turns golden brown.

title: Dutch Apple Dessert
directions: Preheat oven to 325°., Combine apples, condensed milk and cinnamon; set aside., In a large bowl, cut 1/2 cup butter into 1 cup biscuit mix until crumbly., Stir in apple mixture., Pour into greased 9-inch square baking pan., Combine 1/2 cup biscuit mix and sugar., Cut in 2 tablespoons butter until crumbly., Add nuts and sprinkle evenly over apple mixture., Bake one hour or until golden brown., May serve with ice cream.

title: Dorito Casserole
directions: Brown ground beef in large skillet, drain. Add soups, enchilada sauce and chiles, mix well. Cook until mixture is bubbly. Place Doritos in bottom of 9 x 13 Pyrex dish, pour ground beef mixture evenly over chips. Top with shredded cheese and bake at 350° until cheese is melted.

title: Meatballs
directions: Mix ingredients and form into balls., Pour sauce over meatballs., Bake in oven at 350° for 60 minutes or until done.

title: Peanut Butter And Fudge Swirl
directions: In bowl, with electric mixer, beat cream cheese, sugar and peanut butter until smooth., Gradually fold in whipped cream. Spoon into prepared crust., Drizzle fudge sauce over filling, draw a knife through sauce to swirl., Chill until firm, about 4 hours. Makes 6 servings.

title: Minnie Byerly'S Sugar Cookies
directions: Cream the margarine and sugars., Add eggs, milk and flavorings., Sift dry ingredients together., Stir flour mixture into other ingredients until you have a soft dough., Chill overnight., Roll out thin and cut with a cookie cutter., Bake at 375° for 10 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Mom Hornke'S Czeck Plum Kuchen
directions: Combine milk and 1/2 teaspoon of sugar., Heat to lukewarm. Crumble in yeast and let rise., With fingers, crumble butter into sifted flour., Add sugar/milk/yeast mixture, salt, slightly beaten egg yolks and lemon rind., Mix well until dough is medium stiff. Divide into 2 parts and refrigerate or freeze one-half for another time.

title: Apple Pie Filling Cake
directions: Cream sugar, eggs and oil with mixer., Mix rest of ingredients by hand., Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes or until done. Enjoy.

title: Potato Candy
directions: Mix potato and vanilla., Add sugar to make stiff dough., Roll out like pie crust., Spread with peanut butter., Roll up like jelly roll., Cut into slices.

title: Dill Dip
directions: Combine all ingredients and chill., Use as a dip for any raw vegetables.

title: Sugar Cookies
directions: Cream sugar, shortening, egg and vanilla., Add flour, soda, baking powder and sour cream with creamed mixture., Roll on floured surface., Cut with cookie cutter., Bake at 350° for about 12 minutes.

title: Oatmeal Muffins
directions: Combine the oats and buttermilk to soften for 1/2 hour., Mix slightly beaten eggs with oatmeal and buttermilk after softening. Add to dry ingredients., Add oil last., Bake in greased muffin pans for 15 minutes at 400°., Dough will keep in refrigerator for 5 weeks., (Bake a little longer if taken from refrigerator.)

title: Strawberry Shortcake
directions: In mixing bowl, stir together the flour, sugar, baking powder and salt., Cut in butter to resemble coarse crumbs., Combine the egg and light cream., Add all at once to flour mixture, stirring with fork just to moisten., Spread dough in greased 8 x 1 1/2-inch round baking pans or 8 x 8 x 2-inch baking pan, building up edges slightly., Bake in 450° oven for 15 to 18 minutes or until done. Remove from pan and cool., Using a sharp knife, gently split shortcake into 2 layers., Spread bottom layer with soft butter. Whip cream to soft peaks., Spoon half of strawberries and whipped cream over bottom layer., Top with second layer., Spoon remaining strawberries and whipped cream over top., Serve while still warm.

title: Chicken Breasts Lombardy
directions: Place chicken between 2 sheets of wax paper; flatten to 1/8-inch thickness using a meat mallet or rolling pin. Dredge chicken lightly in flour. Place 4 pieces at a time in 2 tablespoons melted butter in a large skillet; cook over low heat 3 to 4 minutes on each side or until chicken is golden brown. Place chicken in a lightly greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish, overlapping edges. Repeat procedure with remaining chicken, adding 2 tablespoons butter. Reserve drippings. Saute mushrooms in remaining 1/4 cup butter; sprinkle evenly over chicken. Stir wine and chicken broth into pan drippings in skillet. Simmer 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Spoon sauce evenly over chicken. Bake at 400° for 10 minutes. Combine cheeses and sprinkle over chicken. Bake an additional 5 minutes.

title: Ricotta Balls
directions: Mix all ingredients except oil and powdered sugar; mix until well blended., Heat oil in deep fryer until it reaches 350°., Now drop by 1 teaspoon into the hot oil and it will form a ball on its own., Fry until they turn golden brown in color., Put on paper towels to drain excess oil., Place on cake dish and sprinkle with powdered sugar.

title: Hot Chocolate Mix
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Store in tightly covered container., Mix with hot water to drink.

title: 7 Flavor Cake
directions: Beat all ingredients well., Bake at 325° for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Salata
directions: Hand crush tomatoes to render juice., Add green onions, garlic, oil and vinegar to tomatoes; mix well., Add salt and pepper to taste., Chill in refrigerator at least two hours; the longer the better., Serve in individual bowls with French bread pieces and don't forget your spoon.

title: Homemade Baking Mix
directions: In a very large bowl, stir together the first 5 ingredients until well blended., With a pastry blender, cut in shortening until coarse crumbs form., Store in airtight container in cool, dry place up to 3 months., Stir before measuring., Makes about 16 cups.

title: Mothers Fruitcake
directions: Preheat oven to 300°., Line four 7x2 1/4 inch loaf pans with parchment paper., Grease paper., Combine dates, pecans and candied fruit in large bowl and mix well., Add 1 cup of flour and toss to coat., Combine sugar and eggs in another bowl and blend until smooth., Stir in remaining flour, and baking powder and mix well. A7dd fruit mixture and blend well., Pack mixture evenly into prepared pans., Place pan filled with water in bottom of oven., Set loaves on rack above., Bake until tester comes out clean, about 2 hours., Cake will be moist., Let cool completely., Turn cakes out of pans, cover with plastic wrap or foil., Store in cool, dark place., Can be frozen.

title: Quick No-Cook Play Dough
directions: Add food coloring to water., Mix flour and salt well., Add oil., Add water slowly until it begins to ball up (like pie crust)., Knead until soft and smooth.

title: Kentucky Cream Cake
directions: Cream shortening, oleo and sugar; add egg yolks one at a time. Add dry ingredients alternately with buttermilk., Add vanilla, coconut and nuts., Fold in beaten egg whites., Bake in two layers at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Pasta Primavera
directions: Mix all ingredients together and serve cold as a main dish or side dish with chicken, turkey, etc.

title: Cheese Soup
directions: Saute vegetables in the butter until soft., Stir in flour and cornstarch., Cook until bubbly., Slowly add stock and milk, stirring to make a smooth sauce., Add soda and cheese., Heat gently until the cheese is melted., Salt and pepper to taste.

title: Macaroni And Cheese
directions: In a 4-quart glass mixing bowl, melt butter or margarine in microwave; mix in flour and add warmed milk., Microwave, stirring occasionally, until thickened., If it gets lumpy, beat with a wire whisk or mixer., Then add the cheese and microwave until cheese melts., Add macaroni, salt and pepper to taste., Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes., Yields 6 (1/2 cup) servings.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Saute, onion and celery in margarine., Mix with broccoli, rice, Cheez Whiz and soup.	Pour in large casserole dish. Bake, at 350° for 45 minutes., (Do not add any salt or pepper. Cheez Whiz is very salty.)

title: Poor Man'S Cookies
directions: Combine oats, sugars, salt and flour., Combine soda and water. Stir in oats mixture along with shortening and vanilla., Make into walnut-size balls., Place on greased cookie sheet., Bake at 350° about 10 minutes or until golden brown., Allow to stand 2 minutes before removing from pans to wire rack., Makes about 3 1/2 dozen.

title: Pineapple Carrot Salad
directions: Drain pineapple juice and add enough water to make 1 cup. Heat to a boil., Add to Jell-O., Stir well until dissolved., Add sugar., Chill until slightly thickened., Add pineapple and carrots., Whip together whipped topping and cream cheese., Fold into Jell-O mixture., Pour into 8 x 10-inch mold., Chill until firm., Serves 8 to 10 people.

title: Frozen Fruit Salad
directions: Soften cream cheese and add bananas., Mix well., Add remaining ingredients and mix well., Spoon into paper baking cups which have been placed in muffin tins., Freeze., When frozen, remove from tins and place in plastic bags and return to freezer., Serve as a salad or dessert., Serves 24.

title: Creamy Dressing
directions: Put cottage cheese, soup supplement and water in blender and puree., Season to taste.

title: Baked Sweet Potatoes
directions: Drain potatoes., Mix all ingredients., Butter baking dish. Bake 45 minutes to 1 hour until firm at 300°., Remove from oven and add topping.

title: Chocolate Eclair Cake
directions: Mix pudding with milk. Fold in whipped topping., Place layer of crackers in bottom of 6 x 12-inch dish. Pour half of pudding over crackers., Layer crackers and pudding again., Top with third layer of crackers. Top with frosting., Chill overnight., Store in refrigerator.

title: Bubbles And Squeak
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Butter a 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Cook sausage in skillet, breaking it up with a fork as it cooks. When no pink is showing, transfer sausage to a bowl., Place chopped onions to the sausage drippings and cook until limp., Drain and add to sausage and mix well., Spread the meat mixture in the bottom of casserole dish., Cover with cabbage leaves., Add salt., Pour White Sauce over mixtures and bake for 30 to 40 minutes or until bubbling hot.

title: Molasses Cookies
directions: Mix all ingredients together, then knead and roll out., Use any shape cookie cutter., Bake at 350° for about 15 minutes., Use cake tester until it comes out clean.

title: Fresh Fruit Ice Cream
directions: In ice cream freezer container, combine all ingredients; mix well., Freeze according to manufacturer's instructions.

title: Hot Cocoa Mix
directions: Mix well., Put 2 large scoops of mix in 1 cup of hot water. Stir and enjoy!

title: Easy Drop Biscuits
directions: In bowl, combine flour, baking powder and salt., Cut in Crisco until mixture resembles coarse meal., Add milk; stir until blended., Knead lightly 8 to 10 times., Drop from spoon onto an ungreased baking sheet., Bake at 425° for 12 to 15 minutes., Makes 12 to 15 biscuits.

title: Primavera Salad
directions: Blanch broccoli and plunge in ice water., Cook pasta.

title: Sweet And Sour Chicken
directions: Combine sugar, soy sauce, ketchup and vinegar., Mix well in saucepan and heat to an easy boil, stirring constantly., In a bowl, mix water and cornstarch until smooth., Gradually add to sauce, stirring often., Fry chicken until brown, arrange in casserole dish and pour sauce over chicken., Cover., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Autumn Punch
directions: Combine all ingredients in saucepan; bring to a boil., Flavor improves if mixture stands a couple of days., Reheat to serve.

title: My Friend Betsy'S I Hate To Cook Chili
directions: Brown beef in large skillet or saucepan. Add Manwich sauce, kidney beans (with juice) and chili powder., Cook over low heat at least 15 minutes longer is even better.

title: Chocolate Stickies
directions: Combine flour, Crisco and cold water., Knead into stiff dough. Place on floured board; roll out to 1/4-inch thick., Butter large iron skillet; place dough in skillet with dough hanging over sides., Mix sugar and cocoa; sprinkle evenly over dough in pan. Dot with 1 stick of butter., Fold in dough; dot top with other stick of butter., Bake in a 400° oven for 30 minutes, or until brown on top., Cut into 1-inch pieces; pour 2 cups of water over Stickies while hot., Place back in oven for about 5 or 10 minutes, until Stickies are bubbly.

title: Rhubarb Bread
directions: Mix in given order., Put into two greased bread pans., Crumble 1 tablespoon melted butter and 1/2 cup brown sugar mixture on tops., Bake 1 hour at 350°.

title: Summer Strawberry Drink
directions: Place frozen lemonade, strawberries and water in blender., Add a few cubes of ice and blend quickly., Serves 4.

title: Asparagus Hors D'Oeuvres
