directions: Mix dry ingredients in medium saucepan., Add milk and cook until thick., Remove from heat and add butter and vanilla., Keep refrigerated., May be reheated or serve cold.

title: Coconut Caramel Dessert
directions: Combine first 3 ingredients; press into a lightly greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish., Bake at 350° for 18 to 20 minutes or until lightly brown., Cool completely., Melt 1/4 cup margarine. Add coconut and 1/2 cup chopped pecans., Cook over low heat, stirring often until coconut is golden brown., Cool.

title: Cinnamon Rolls
directions: Pour scalded milk over shortening, sugar and salt., When cool, add 2 cups flour; beat well., Add eggs., Beat., Add yeast which has been dissolved in 1/2 cup warm water., Add rest of flour to make stiff mixture., Let rise until doubled., Melt 1/2 cup oleo, 1/2 cup brown sugar and 1 tablespoon corn syrup., Spread in 9 x 13-inch pan., Sprinkle on nuts., Roll dough until 1/4-inch thick. Spread with butter, 1/4 cup brown sugar and sprinkle cinnamon on. Roll like jelly roll., Cut in 1-inch slices., Let rise 1 hour. Bake at 375° for 30 minutes., Turn upside-down on foil., Let stand 2 minutes., Makes 2 pans of rolls.

title: Funnel Bread
directions: You will need 1 pie plate (bottom cut away).

title: Congress Tarts
directions: Make pie crust., Either your own or pie crust mix., Cut pie crust with cutter and line muffin tins., Put teaspoon of jam on pie crust and then large tablespoon of batter mix on top., Bake until golden brown at 300° to 350°.

title: Red Lentil Chili
directions: Wash lentils., Drain., Cover with vinegar and tomato juice. Let soak for 2 hours., Brown beef cubes and chopped onion., Add spices; add to lentils and simmer 1 1/2 to 2 hours, adding hot water as necessary., Freshness and quality of the spices makes a lot of difference, so check the flavor and correct the seasoning 15 to 20 minutes before serving.

title: Apple Crisp
directions: Wash apples; peel very thin., Core, slice and place in shallow baking dish., Mix together white sugar, spices and 1/4 teaspoon salt; sprinkle this and lemon juice over apples., Blend flour, brown sugar, dash of salt and margarine until crumbly., Sprinkle over apples; pat down gently with back of spoon., Bake 40 to 45 minutes at 350°.

title: Instant Russian Tea
directions: Combine all ingredients and mix thoroughly., Store in tightly covered container., To serve, dissolve 1 tablespoon of mixture in cup of hot water., Yields 8 cups.

title: Coconut Pie
directions: Heat milk on stove. Add to hot milk the sugar, flour and salt (stir these together before adding to milk). Stir constantly and let boil on medium heat. Separate the eggs; beat egg yolks with fork until foamy. Stir eggs in fast when batter is ready. Put back on heat and stir constantly until it boils. Take off heat. Add vanilla, 1 tablespoon of butter and coconut.

title: Oatmeal Brownies
directions: In a bowl, combine the first seven ingredients; mix well, set aside 1 c for topping., Pat the remaining mixture into a greased 15x10x1 baking pan., Prepare brownie batter according to package directions., Spread over the crust., Sprinkle with the reserved oat mixture., Bake at 350 degrees for 25 to 30 minutes or until a toothpick inserted near the center comes out clean., Cool on a wire rack., Cut into bars., Yields 5 dozen.

title: Stew(Leprechaun Stew)
directions: Heat oil in a 4-quart heavy, covered kettle., Add lamb and garlic; cook until meat is browned., Add boiling water; cover and simmer for 3 minutes., Add carrots, celery, onion, potatoes, salt, pepper and bay leaf., Cover and simmer until all is tender., Mix flour and cold water into a smooth paste., Stir into hot stew. Keep stirring until thickened., Serve with a garnish of chopped parsley., Stew tastes better next day or two days later.

title: Horseradish Sauce
directions: In a bowl, combine all the ingredients., Serve with beef.

title: Olive Corn Pie
directions: Mix crumbs with melted butter., Reserve 1 cup; press remainder onto bottom and sides of a 9-inch pie plate., Set aside.

title: Cape Cod Clam Chowder
directions: Fry bacon until crisp and cut small., Remove from pan., Fry pork until golden brown., Remove from pan., Saute onions until soft., Drain clams, saving juice, then chop clams fine., Add to clam juice enough water to make 3 cups., Bring to a boil and add potatoes, browned pork, onions and bacon., Simmer until potatoes are done, about 15 minutes., Blend flour to a smooth paste with cold water, add to the potatoes, stirring until it boils and thickens., Add clams and seasonings., Add the milk and add slowly to hot clam mixture., Add 2 tablespoons butter when done., Serves 6.

title: Drop Doughnuts
directions: Cream sugar and eggs., Add other ingredients., Drop from teaspoon into hot lard until brown.

title: Chess Pie No. 1
directions: Combine, butter, sugar and vinegar in a saucepan., Stir constantly, over, low heat until sugar is dissolved., Pour hot mixture over beaten eggs, beating constantly., Fold in vanilla and salt., Pour into pie shell., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Tomato Basil Linguine
directions: In a large serving bowl, combine the first seven ingredients. Let stand at room temperature for up to 1 1/2 hours., Cook linguine according to package directions; drain., Toss with cheese mixture., Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese., Serve immediately.

title: Clam Dip
directions: Stir all ingredients. Serve with crackers or chips.

title: Sweet And Sour Chicken
directions: Boil vinegar, sugar and water., Mix together cornstarch, brown sugar and pineapple juice., Add to liquid, cook until thickens. Saute pepper, onions and chestnuts., Add oranges, pineapple and chicken., Pour thickened mixture over., Cook rice as directed. Serve chicken over rice or Chinese noodles, if preferred.

title: Sugar Cookies
directions: Cream shortening; add sugar and well beaten egg., Add remaining ingredients., Chill for 1 hour., Bake at 375° for 8 to 12 minutes.

title: Date Torte
directions: Beat eggs well., Add sugar slowly, while beating., Fold in dates and nutmeats., Bake in buttered cake pan for 60 minutes at 325°., Serve with whipped cream.

title: Schnitzel Beans
directions: Fry bacon until crisp; take out of skillet and drain., Add sugar and vinegar to bacon grease., Cook until sugar is dissolved. Add green beans and bacon, crumbled., Simmer 20 minutes., Add onion.

title: Black Forest Cake (Schwarz Wald Torte)
directions: Combine first 6 ingredients in a large bowl, stir until well mixed., Add shortening, eggs, milk and vanilla., Beat 3 minutes at low speed.

title: Lemon Glazed Persimmon Bars
directions: Combine eggs, sugar and oil; mix well., Stir 1 1/2 teaspoons lemon juice and baking soda into pulp., Combine flour, salt and spices., Add to egg mixture alternately with persimmon mixture, mixing well after each addition., Stir in walnuts and raisins. Spread in greased and floured oblong pan., Bake at 350° for 25 minutes or until lightly browned., Cool for 5 minutes.

title: "Uptown" Beer Meat Balls
directions: Combine first five ingredients and mix well., Make small size (1-inch diameter) meat balls and fry in small amount of oil (if necessary) evenly on all sides., Drain on paper towel.

title: Seven Layer Salad
directions: Layer each ingredient, beginning with the lettuce.

title: Meat Filled Jumbo Shells
directions: Cook jumbo shells according to package directions; drain., Cool on paper., Brown beef and pork in skillet; drain., Combine meat, eggs, bread crumbs, Mozzarella cheese (if desired), onion, oregano, salt and pepper., Fill each shell with 2 tablespoons., Spread a thin layer of sauce on bottom of 13 x 9-inch baking pan., Place shells open side down, in a single layer in the pan; cover with sauce., Cover with aluminum foil; bake at 350° about 45 minutes. Fills 36 shells., Makes 10 to 12 servings.

title: Cherry Congealed Salad
directions: Mix Cool Whip, cottage cheese and crushed pineapple., Add pecans and chopped cherries (save some for garnish). Add dry jello. Stir well. Chill.

title: J.G.'S Macaroni And Cheese
directions: Will need a 2 quart casserole dish.

title: Italian Sausage And Cabbage
directions: Put sausage in large pot., Cover with water at least 1 inch over top of sausage., Boil about 30 minutes., Remove sausage from broth; put into a bowl and refrigerate 3 to 4 hours or overnight. Strain through a tea strainer to remove all of the fat., Put broth in pot., Add cabbage, cut into wedges., Place sausage on top and cook until done., Season to taste.

title: Ice Cream
directions: Beat eggs until they form peaks. Add sugar gradually to the egg mixture. Continue to beat until mixture is very stiff. Add remaining ingredients and mix thoroughly., Pour into gallon freezer and freeze as directed by ice cream maker.

title: Edith'S Chicken Pie
directions: Cook chicken until it comes off the bone easily., Cool and debone., Put pieces into baking dish (9 x 13-inch)., Pour cream of chicken soup and broth over chicken., At this point, you can put into refrigerator or freezer., Mix flour, buttermilk and oleo; pour over chicken mixture., Bake 1 hour at 350°.

title: Dorito Delight
directions: Brown ground beef., Once beef is brown, mix all other ingredients in a skillet., Bring to a boil., Cover the bottom of a casserole dish with the Doritos., Pour in other ingredients., Top with the Cheddar cheese., Put in oven at 350° until cheese melts. If you wish, you may top with salsa and sour cream., Serves 8 to 10 people.

title: Hidden Valley Ranch Buffalo Wings
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Dip chicken in mixture and melted butter, pepper sauce and vinegar., Put in baking pan., Sprinkle with 1 package dry dressing mix., Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until browned., Sprinkle with paprika., Serve with celery sticks and prepared Hidden Valley Ranch dressing as dip.

title: Chile Con Queso
directions: Cut cheese into pieces. Chop the peeled chiles and the peeled tomato; add the other ingredients. Cook in the top of a double boiler, stirring occasionally. Serve hot with Fritos, tostados or crackers. This mixture should cook or rather melt down, about 3 hours. If possible, serve in a chafing dish or in some utensil over hot water.

title: Watergate Salad
directions: Fold each of the ingredients into the Cool Whip., Cool to enhance the flavor., Maraschino cherries placed on the top add a festive touch at Christmas.

title: Salmon Croquettes
directions: Mix onions and salmon., Let stand for 30 minutes, then add other ingredients., Deep fry until golden brown.

title: Fast Fixin' Chocolate Chip Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Pour oil into 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan., Tilt pan until bottom is covered with oil., Put remaining ingredients into pan; stir with a fork or spoon until blended (about 2 minutes)., Scrape sides and spread batter evenly in pan., Bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes until toothpick inserted near center comes out clean., Cooled cake may be sprinkled with powdered sugar. Use a knife to loosen cake from sides, cut and serve directly from pan., Store leftover cake, loosely covered.

title: World Famous Meat Loaf
directions: Beat thoroughly., Put into loaf pan., Cover with 2 strips bacon, if you like that flavor., Pour over all one 8 ounce can Hunt's tomato sauce., Bake one hour at 350°., Serves six.

title: Chicken And Broccoli
directions: Parboil broccoli., Place chicken breasts on top of broccoli in casserole dish., Add cream of chicken soup and mayonnaise., Mix and pour on top of chicken., Add Cheddar cheese and bread crumbs. Bake at 350° for 1 1/4 hours.

title: Festive Pumpkin Or Sweet Potato Bread
directions: Sift first 9 ingredients together., Cream the sugar and oil in a large bowl., Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition., Blend 1/3 cup water and pumpkin or sweet potato in bowl. Add pumpkin or sweet potato mixture alternately with dry ingredients to sugar mixture, blending well after each addition. Stir in raisins and nuts. Pour into 2 small greased and floured loaf pans., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until bread tests done.

title: Pickled Shrimp
directions: Boil the shrimp in their shells with the celery leaves, pickling spices and 1 tablespoon salt for 5 minutes., Drain shrimp and clean., Place shrimp in covered container with a mixture made from the remaining ingredients for 24 hours., Serve on toothpicks with pineapple cubes, green peppers and cheese cubes.

title: Bountiful Cream Of Broccoli Cheese And Clam Bisque
directions: Microwave broccoli, onions, broth and salt, covered, 20 minutes., Put aside 6 cooked broccoli flowerets for garnish. Puree broth mixture in food processor for a count of 20 seconds. Uncover.

title: Orange Slice Cookies
directions: Cut orange slices into small pieces., Use 1/2 cup of your flour to keep your knife clean., Cream butter and sugar., Add eggs; beat until very light., Sift flour, salt and soda; add alternately with the coconut and nuts., Add orange candy to creamed mixture., Add vanilla., Drop by small teaspoon onto greased cookie sheet., Bake for 10 minutes, or until light brown, at 350°., Makes 5 dozen cookies.

title: Instant Russian Tea
directions: Mix all ingredients together and store in tightly covered container.

title: Captain'S Choice Easy Holiday Cheese Ball
directions: In food processor or blender, finely chop beef and onions, then pour into mixing bowl and add cream cheese., Shape into ball. Serve with crackers!

title: Chocolate Chess Pie
directions: Mix sugar and cocoa., Add eggs and mix well., Add margarine, milk, vanilla and salt., Mix well and pour in pie crust., Bake 30 to 35 minutes in 350° oven., Cool before cutting.

title: Three Pepper Pasta
directions: Saute ingredients in pan., Be generous with lime juice., Put over any kind of pasta (linguini or angel hair pasta).

title: Pineapple Cheese Ball
directions: Place chopped green pepper, onion and pineapple on paper towel to absorb liquid., Blend ingredients well., Refrigerate and chill at least 1/2 hour., Shape into ball., Roll in chopped pecans, if desired.

title: Glazed Candied Sweet Potatoes
directions: Wash sweet potatoes, cover with water and partially cook until just tender enough to be pierced with a fork., Do not over cook. Drain well and set aside., Combine the oil or butter, brown sugar and juice and rind in a small saucepan., Heat to boiling and cook for 2 minutes., Peel the sweet potatoes and cut them in half lengthwise., Place sweet potatoes in a shallow 8 inch square pan. Pour syrup over them., Bake in a slow oven 300° for 55 minutes or until well glazed., After the fist 15 minutes turn the potatoes and baste.

title: Coffee Cake
directions: Cut first 3 ingredients like pie meal. Take out 1 cup and reserve. Mix in other ingredients. Batter will be lumpy., Pour into 9 x 12-inch pan. Top with remaining 1 cup. Bake 25 minutes at 350°.

title: Crunchy Strawberry Dessert
directions: Combine sugar and margarine; pour over pretzels., Mix and press into 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 9 minutes., Cool.

title: Blueberry Cake
directions: Sift together baking powder, flour and salt., Beat 2 egg whites until mounds form., Set aside., Cream shortening and sugar. Add 2 egg yolks., Add dry ingredients to creamed mixture alternately with 1/3 cup milk., Fold in egg whites; add 1 teaspoon vanilla., Add blueberries., Bake in greased small tube pan at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes., Sprinkle top with granulated sugar., This cake is light and moist.

title: Quick And Easy Brownies
directions: Melt margarine in microwave., Mix in cake mix and egg (will be stiff)., Add chocolate bits., Pat into 9 x 13-inch pan (not greased)., Bake in 350° oven for 15 minutes., (Take from oven while still soft.)

title: Phyl'S Famous Egg Rolls
directions: Saute pork and onions., Add celery, cabbage and salt., Cook 2 to 3 minutes., Drain., Add bean sprouts., Cook 3 to 5 minutes. Drain., Fill wrappers as directed on package., Deep-fry, may cook in wok or deep skillet (peanut oil works best).

title: Spinach Dip
directions: Thaw, spinach.	Drain.	Chop, spinach, fine and fold in other ingredients., Cut, off, slice from top of a 1-pound loaf Hawaiian bread., Hollow, out, center, leaving a 1-inch shell. Break or, cut removed, bread into pieces., Put dip into bread shell., Use bread pieces to dip.

title: Frozen Coconut Pound Cake
directions: Cream, butter and sugar., Add eggs, one at a time., Add dry ingredients, alternating with sour cream., Add vanilla and fold in, coconut., Pour, into, large greased and floured tube pan. Using table knife, make 8 or 9 circles around, extending knife about 2 inches in batter., Bake in a 300° oven approximately 1 1/2 hours.

title: Low-Fat Pumpkin Bread
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Combine prunes and water in container of food processor; pulse on and off until prunes are finely chopped., In mixer bowl, blend prune mixture with sugars., Beat in egg substitute and pumpkin just to blend.

title: Twentieth Century Pound Cake
directions: Cream well the Crisco and sugar., Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition. Sift flour, baking powder and salt together. Add milk and flour alternately. Add flavoring. Bake in a 350° oven for 1 hour in tube pan., If desired, this can be used for cupcakes or layers., Adjust time accordingly.

title: Congealed Strawberry Salad
directions: Mix jello and boiling water., Add banana, strawberries and pineapple., Pour half in dish and let chill until partially congealed., Cover with sour cream., Top with remaining half mixture., If desired, use 4 ounces sour cream and 4 ounces cream cheese.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Cook frozen speared broccoli (10 minutes)., Spread broccoli on bottom of container., Slightly beat eggs., Shred cheese., Do not dilute soup., Mix the 5 ingredients and pour over the broccoli. Cover with cracker crumbs., Bake at 350°, for 50 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Rich Dinner Rolls
directions: Mix milk, sugar, salt and butter; stir until sugar dissolves. Cool to lukewarm., Pour warm water into a large warm bowl. Sprinkle in yeast and stir until dissolved., Stir in milk mixture, eggs and 2 cups flour, beating with a wooden spoon until smooth. Mix in enough flour a little at a time to make a soft dough. Knead on lightly floured board until smooth and elastic., Shape into ball and place in greased bowl., Cover and let rise in a warm spot until double in bulk., Punch down., Roll out and form rolls. Let stand, covered, for 1/2 hour., Cook 10 to 12 minutes at 375°.

title: Parmesan Bread
directions: Mix yeast with warm water and gently stir to dissolve completely., Add cooled margarine, sugar, salt, egg, bran and Parmesan cheese., Blend well., Mix in flour., Cover and let stand in a warm place about 2 hours or until doubled., Punch down and turn out onto lightly floured board., Knead just enough to form a smooth ball., Place on lightly greased baking sheet (or any pan you like)., Cover and let rise about 40 minutes., Bake at 375° for 25 to 30 minutes or until a dark golden brown., Serve hot or cold.

title: Nutty Snickers Pie
directions: Finely chop Snickers bars., Mix cream cheese and confectioners sugar; fold in remaining ingredients and pour into crusts., Keep refrigerated until served., Serves 12 to 16.

title: Tomato Basil Soup
directions: Saute the onions and garlic in the olive oil in a saucepan until transparent., Stir in the tomatoes, stock, dried herbs, salt and pepper., Simmer for 45 minutes., Puree in small batches in a blender and return to saucepan., Use caution when pureeing hot soup., Season with salt and pepper., Stir in the cream, fresh basil and fresh parsley., Divide the rice between 6 soup bowls and ladle the soup over the rice., Garnish with additional chopped fresh basil or parsley leaves., Serves 6.

title: Corn Pudding
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Grease 1-quart casserole dish., In 2-quart saucepan, melt butter or margarine., Stir in flour, sugar and salt until blended., Slowly stir in milk and cook, stirring constantly until thickened., Remove from heat; stir in corn and eggs., Pour into casserole dish and bake 1 hour or until knife inserted in middle comes out clean.

title: Chocolate No-Bake Cookies
directions: Combine sugar, margarine, milk and cocoa in saucepan., Boil for 3 minutes exactly., Remove from heat and quickly add the remaining ingredients., Drop by teaspoonfuls on wax paper., Let set for 30 minutes., Makes 40 to 50 small cookies.

title: Instant Spice Tea
directions: Stir and store in covered container.

title: Taco Casserole
directions: Brown the hamburger; add the taco mix and onions and mix as directed., Put in layers in cake pan:, cooked rice, chili beans, cheese, hamburger mixture and crushed Doritos chips., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes., When serving, top with lettuce, tomatoes and taco or cheese sauce.

title: "Lazy Man" Peach Cobbler
directions: In large casserole dish put butter and melt in oven., Mix in another bowl, flour, sugar, milk and peaches (with juice)., Add this to the butter in dish., Sprinkle with sugar., Bake for 1 hour at 350°.

title: Pecan Pie
directions: Mix all items., Pour into pie shell., Bake at 350° or slower until done., For a candied type pie, stir carefully every 10 or so minutes., This keeps the pecans evenly distributed.

title: Hot Taco Dip
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Blend cream cheese and taco seasoning in baking dish., Pour chili on top., Layer with cheese., Top with olives., Bake for 30 minutes.

title: Lite Broccoli Casserole
directions: Cook broccoli and drain., Add beaten egg, cottage cheese and seasonings., Pour into sprayed casserole, sprinkle with grated cheese., Bake in 350° oven for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Hello Dolly
directions: Mix all ingredients., Bake in 8 or 9-inch square pan for 45 minutes at 350°., Cool., Cut into squares.

title: 100 Years Old Ice Box(Refrigerator Cookies)
directions: Stir dry ingredients in a large bowl, including nuts., Melt butter, cool before it comes in contact with eggs., Beat the eggs a little by hand., Add all the wet ingredients and stir together with a spoon., Roll off about 4 or 5 sheets of wax paper., spoon the mixture onto the paper and form into a roll about 1 1/2 inch diameter. Roll up in the paper and twist the ends., Store in the refrigerator overnight or until the dough is hard., Take out of the paper, place on a cutting board and cut into thin slices with a sharp knife., Here is where the advantages of a sharp knife comes in, cutting through those nuts!, Place them on a nonstick cookie sheet., They won't spread out very much., Bake at 325° for about 8 to 10 minutes, depending on how hot your oven is and how brown you want the cookies., Cool and store in an airtight container., They keep very well.

title: Chalmer'S Spinach Squares
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Put butter in 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Melt in oven., Remove.

title: Enchilada Casserole
directions: Put milk, Velveeta cheese, chicken soup, mushroom soup and diced green peppers in large saucepan., Heat until cheese is melted., Brown beef and add onions., Drain fat., Add taco seasoning., Spray a 9 x 13 x 12-inch pan with Pam., Layer tortillas, meat and sauce alternately in pan., Sprinkle top with Cheddar cheese., Cover with foil and bake for 25 minutes at 375°.

title: Cheesy Hash
directions: Thaw frozen hash browns to a point where you can break them up easily in baking dish., Melt all ingredients (except potatoes) and pour mixture over potatoes, in a 9 x 13-inch greased baking dish. Let stand 1 hour, then bake 1 hour at 350°.

title: Snickerdoodles
directions: Combine., Roll into walnut size balls in sugar., Add 2 teaspoons of cinnamon to sugar., Bake at 350° for 10 minutes. Makes 3 1/2 dozen.

title: Shoo-Fly Cake
directions: Mix flour, shortening and brown sugar., Save 1 cup of crumbs for top., Add soda to boiling water., Add table syrup., Mix with flour, shortening and sugar mixture., Pour in greased and floured 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Shrimp Creole
directions: Melt butter in skillet., Add onions, celery, green pepper and garlic., Cook until onions are tender., Remove from heat., Add tomato sauce, water and seasoning and stir., Return to heat and simmer uncovered for 10 minutes., May add additional water if needed., Stir in shrimp and heat to boiling., Cover and reduce heat to medium and cook 10 to 20 minutes or until shrimp are pink and tender., Serve over hot cooked rice.

title: Rocky Road Brownies
directions: Sift together in sifter the flour, sugar, salt and cocoa., Melt in pan the margarine and Crisco., When cool, add to sifted ingredients., Add the eggs, one at a time or beat together and add a little at a time, vanilla and nuts., Pour in greased baking sheet and bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

title: Spiced Tea Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350° (325° for colored fluted tube pan)., Using solid shortening, grease pan and flour (12-cup tube pan)., (Also grease if nonstick finish.), In large bowl, blend first 8 ingredients; beat 2 minutes at highest speed., Pour into prepared pan., Bake for 50 to 60 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean., Cool upright in pan 15 minutes; turn on serving plate.

title: Okra-Tomatoes
directions: Cook 4 slices bacon and take out of frying pan., Cook 1 medium onion and green pepper and cook 2 cups sliced okra until half done., Then add 4 medium sliced ripe tomatoes and crumble bacon in it and cook all of this until tomatoes and okra are tender.

title: Doughnut Muffins
directions: Cream shortening and 1 cup sugar., Add egg; beat well., Mix and sift flour, baking powder, salt and nutmeg., Add alternately with milk to egg mixture., Fill greased muffin pans 2/3 full. Bake in moderate oven (350°) for 20 to 30 minutes or until golden brown., Remove from pans at once and roll in melted butter, then in mixture of remaining 1/2 cup sugar and cinnamon., Makes 12 medium or 18 small muffins.

title: Cheese Dip
directions: Beat the egg and milk together in a Corning Ware dish., Mix cheeses with milk mixture., Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes. Serve with nacho chips or crackers.

title: Caramel Frosting
directions: Cook first 3 ingredients together until it strikes a boil, then boil 2 minutes., Have powdered sugar sifted and remove from heat; stir in., Add vanilla., Beat until it gets thick enough to spread., Makes enough for 3 layers of cake.

title: Fettucine Au Gratin
directions: You can tell if fish is fresh if the gills are pink with fresh red blood., Fish should not smell fishy and the eyes should be clear and firm, not cloudy., The inside should be clean and the meat should be firm.

title: Georgia'S Tea Cakes
directions: Mix sugar, butter, eggs and other ingredients., Chill well before rolling out; cut with cookie cutter., Place on ungreased cookie sheet; bake in an oven that has been preheated to 450°. Let the cookies stay in the 450° oven for about 1 minute, then turn oven to 375° and bake for 7 to 8 minutes.

title: Baked Chicken
directions: Place chicken in baking dish., Salt and pepper to taste., Peel and thinly slice potatoes and onion., Place on top of chicken and lightly salt., Cover with aluminum foil., Bake in 350° oven for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Buttermilk Biscuits(A Great Complement To Any Meal)
directions: Mix flour, baking powder, soda and salt together., Cut in butter and mix together lightly., Add buttermilk and mix just enough to blend together. Do not overmix.

title: Easy Wassail
directions: Stick cloves around middle of oranges about 1 inch apart, then several close together at stem and bottom ends., Bake, uncovered, in shallow pan for 30 minutes at 350°., Remove from oven., Combine Tang, water, cider and cinnamon sticks in large saucepan., Bring to a boil., Reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
directions: Mix 1/2 pint of peanut butter and 1 pint jar of marshmallow cream. Mix until blended. Set aside.

title: Egg Strata
directions: Saute sausage until brown; remove from skillet and drain. Place sausage in bottom of casserole., In same skillet, melt oleo; lightly saute thawed hash browns., Cover sausage with hash browns; sprinkle cheese on top., Beat eggs; add milk and salt., Pour over ingredients in casserole., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Mexican Stack Ups
directions: Brown hamburger, drain; mix with taco seasoning as directed on package., Heat refried beans on low in medium pan., Microwave tortillas 3 to 4 minutes in package, turning once., Place tortilla on plate., Spread tablespoon of beans and tablespoon of meat on it. Add cheese, lettuce, tomatoes and onions., Place second tortilla on top and repeat steps (beans, meat, cheese, lettuce, tomatoes and onions)., Serves 6.

title: Apple Crisp
directions: Preheat oven to 400°., Slice apples into bottom of baking dish., Dissolve cinnamon in water and pour over apples., Mix together the flour, sugar and butter until smooth and crumbly. Spread over apples and bake for 30 minutes.

title: Dolores' Crab Soup
directions: To make beef broth:, Cook soup bone with plate beef in 6 cups water, about 1 hour.

title: Breakfast Casserole
directions: Cream butter and cheese., Line 9 x 13-inch pan with bread slices., Spread cheese mix over bread., Put on a layer of meat. Beat eggs, add milk and mix together., Pour over meat; put another layer of bread on top., Bake 1 hour at 325° until puffy and brown. Can be fixed at night and baked in the morning.

title: Chicken And Dressing Casserole
directions: Put breasts in a greased 9 x 11-inch pan., Put 1 piece of cheese over each piece of breast., Mix chicken soup with 3/4 can of water., Put dressing over chicken and cheese, then pour soup over all., Bake at 300° for 1 1/2 hours., Serves 6.

title: Sponge Cake (Hot Milk)
directions: Whip eggs and sugar together., Heat milk and butter. Alternate adding 1/4 flour and baking powder with 1/4 milk into egg mixture on low speed on your mixer., After all of the flour mixture has been added to the egg mixture add the vanilla.

title: Corn Pudding
directions: Separate eggs., Mix first four ingredients and egg yolks. Beat egg whites and fold into corn mixture., Cover with bread crumbs., Dot with butter and sprinkle with 1 teaspoon sugar., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Hot Cheese Bread
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Grease a 9 x 13-inch loaf pan., Combine Bisquick, cheese and sugar in a large bowl. Combine other ingredients in a second bowl., Mix well., Stir in dry mixture and blend thoroughly., Beat slightly to remove lumps., Turn into pan and bake until golden, 45 to 50 minutes., Makes 14 to 17 servings.

title: Mexican Lasagna(Low-Fat)
directions: In large skillet brown turkey with onion and pepper., Add tomatoes and taco seasoning., Simmer, uncovered, 5 minutes., In bowl, combine cottage cheese, 4 ounces Cheddar cheese and eggs. Place 3 tortillas on bottom of a sprayed 9 x 13-inch or 8 x 12-inch baking dish., Spoon meat mixture evenly over tortillas., Top with 3 tortillas then cheese mixture., Bake, covered, at 350° for 40 minutes., Sprinkle remaining cheese over top of lasagna and continue baking, uncovered, for 5 minutes or until cheese melts. Garnish with tomatoes and lettuce., May add taco sauce or sour cream, if desired.

title: Chicken Tarragon(Basilla)
directions: *Add to broth for added flavor.

title: Oatmeal Scotch Chippies
directions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees., Combine Crisco, brown sugar, and granulated sugar in large bowl., Beat at medium speed with electric mixer until well blended., Beat in eggs., Add peanut butter., Beat until blended.

title: Alice'S Spanish Pork Chops
directions: Brown pork chops in vegetable oil., Place in large casserole. Top with remaining ingredients., Cover and bake at 350° for 1 to 2 hours or until tender., This is a meal in itself., Serve with tossed salad.

title: Shrimp And Smokies
directions: Thoroughly wash the shrimp in cold water., Pour the beer in a large soup pot., Add the kielbasa slices to the pot along with the bay leaves, coriander seed and salt and pepper., Bring ingredients to a boil over high heat., Lower the heat and simmer, uncovered, for about 10 minutes., Add the shrimp to the pot and bring back to a boil., Boil until shrimp are firm and pink, about one to two minutes., Drain off the cooking liquid and discard the bay leaves. Serve the shrimp and sausage in separate bowls., Shell shrimp before eating., Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Hot Dutch Potato Salad
directions: Dice bacon and panfry., Add chopped onion and green pepper. Cook 3 minutes., Add vinegar, salt, pepper, sugar and beaten egg. Cook slightly., Add cubed potatoes, grated carrot and diced, hard-cooked eggs., Blend slightly and serve hot.

title: French Bread
directions: Sprinkle yeast over water and honey., Stir., Slowly add flour and salt; beat with wooden spoon. Turn dough out on floured board and knead 8 to 10 minutes., Place dough in lightly greased bowl. Cover and let rise 2 hours., Sprinkle corn meal in well-greased loaf pans., Bake at 400° for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Sad Pancakes
directions: Blend in mixer., Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes., Cool before cutting.

title: Little Hot Dogs
directions: Wrap each hot dog with 1/2 slice of bacon., Secure with toothpick., Place in crock-pot and cover with brown sugar., Cook on low for 8 hours.

title: Chopstick Tuna
directions: Combine soup and water; add 1 cup of chow mein noodles, tuna, celery, nuts and onion., Toss lightly., Place in ungreased 10 x 6 x 1 1/2-inch baking dish., Sprinkle over with remaining noodles. Bake in a 375° oven for 15 minutes or until heated through., If you double recipe, bake in larger baking dish for 25 minutes., Can be prepared ahead of time and refrigerated.

title: Orange Smoothie
directions: Place all ingredients in blender. Cover and blend until smooth. Serve immediately. Makes 4 servings.

title: Amazing Peanut Butter Cookies
directions: Mix all ingredients., Form into balls the size of a large walnuts., Flatten on lightly greased cookie sheet with a fork. Bake for 8 to 10 minutes, until lightly browned, at 350°., Remove from pan carefully to cool.

title: Bourbon Hot Dogs
directions: Add all ingredients to crock-pot., Cook on low until all flavors are blended and hot dogs are plump.

title: Old Fashioned Sugar Cookies
directions: Cream together shortening and 1 1/2 cups sugar., Add eggs and beat until light and fluffy., Combine flour, soda, cream of tartar and salt., Add to mixture., Chill for at least 1 hour in refrigerator., Roll in a mixture of 2 tablespoons sugar and 2 teaspoons cinnamon., Cut into desired shapes., Bake on ungreased cookie sheets at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes., Yield:, 4 to 5 dozen.

title: Stir-Fried Garden
directions: Melt butter in a large (10-inch or larger) skillet., Add cabbage and spinach., When this cooks down a little, add the rest of your vegetables, stir and fry until done, about 15 to 30 minutes., Add garlic powder, salt and pepper while cooking., You can use your own mixture of vegetables.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
directions: Mix butter, sugar and cream., Bring to boil over medium heat. Continually stir and boil 5 minutes., Remove from heat., Add marshmallows, peanut butter and vanilla., Stir until well mixed. Pour in pan., Put nuts on top.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Grease a casserole dish., Place bite size pieces of chicken on bottom., Mix soups together., Pour and spread on top of chicken. Spread prepared dressing on top., Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

title: Egg Pie
directions: Beat together the eggs, sugar and butter., Add vanilla, then milk., Pour in pie shells and bake at 325° to 350° until firm.

title: Chocolate Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Combine first 4 ingredients in a saucepan. Bring to boil and continue boiling 1 1/2 minutes after mixture has reached a full rolling boil. Remove from heat. Put the rest of the ingredients in the boiled mixture. Drop by tablespoon onto wax paper.

title: Veggie Bars
directions: Press rolls in large cookie sheet and bake as directed on package., Mix cream cheese, Hidden Valley mix and sour cream together., Spread over rolls when cooled., Top with grated and chopped veggies., Spread the grated cheese on top., Cut into squares and serve.

title: Cocoa Cola Cake
directions: Combine all ingredients, except cola and the marshmallows, in large bowl., Blend well and beat 1 minute at medium speed of mixer., Add cola; blend well and stir in marshmallows., Pour into 9 x 13-inch cake pan., Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

title: Easy Pumpkin Cake
directions: Blend first 8 ingredients; pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle with cake mix; scatter nuts on top., Pour melted butter over all., Bake at 350° for 1 hour., Cool and refrigerate; may be frozen.

title: American Indian Fry Bread
directions: Sift flour, salt and baking powder together., Stir in beaten egg., Add water to make soft dough., Round up on lightly floured surface., Knead lightly., Roll or pat out 1/2-inch thick., Shape in forms of turtles, snakes, pretzels or just plain strips., Slit centers., Drop into hot oil in skillet., Brown on both sides. Serve hot., Good too with pinto beans, soup, or with maple syrup.

title: Corn Flakes Candy
directions: Boil sugar, syrup and cream until it reaches the soft-ball stage. Stir in remaining ingredients. Drop by spoonfuls on waxed paper and let cool.

title: Beef Stew
directions: Brown beef in oil., Remove from dish., Saute celery, onion, garlic and parsley., Add beef to pot again., Add beef cube, water, tomato sauce and spices., Simmer about 3/4 hour., Add vegetables. Cook until tender., Simmer, covered, about 1/2 hour longer., Add beer anytime after vegetables.

title: Jello Salad
directions: Mix all together and serve.

title: Chess Bars
directions: Mix all ingredients and press in a 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake for 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Herbed Broccoli
directions: Cook broccoli according to package directions; drain., Combine broccoli and remaining ingredients., Spoon into greased, shallow 1-quart casserole dish., Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes or until set.

title: Banana Bread
directions: Cream together sugar and butter., Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition., Stir in bananas., Combine flour, baking powder and salt; stir into creamed mixture., Mix in nuts, if desired., Spoon into greased 9 x 5-inch loaf pan., Bake at 350° for 1 hour, or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean., Cool on rack., Makes 1 loaf.

title: Low-Fat Turkey Meat Loaf
directions: Mix ground turkey and oats., Add in garlic salt., When well mixed, place in loaf pan, reserving some of the turkey mixture. Form a ditch in the middle of the turkey loaf., Place sliced tomatoes in the ditch., Cover with Mozzarella cheese and sprinkle basil over top., Take remaining turkey mixture and cover over tomatoes and cheese., Bake for about 1 hour at 350°.

title: Hash Brown Casserole
directions: Mix first 3 ingredients well., Add 1 1/2 cups of the Cheddar cheese and hash browns., Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes., Top with remaining cheese and bake for another 5 minutes or until cheese melts.

title: Chicken Burritos
directions: Combine soup and milk; set aside., Combine chicken, broccoli and 1/2 cup of cheese., Stir in 3/4 cup soup mixture., Divide chicken mixture evenly between the tortillas and roll up., Place, seam side down, on lightly greased 9 x 13-inch baking pan., Stir tomato into remaining soup and pour over top of tortillas., Bake, covered, at 350° for 35 minutes., Sprinkle remaining cheese on top of tortillas., Cook for 5 more minutes., Makes 6 Chicken Burritos.

title: Chicken Pie
directions: Layer first 4 ingredients in pan., Mix soups and broth together, heat and pour over chicken.

title: Eggplant Italian
directions: Peel and cut eggplant into pieces; cook until soft., Drain and set aside., Saute onion in olive oil until soft., Add garlic and saute until just before browned.

title: "Gen. Creasy'S Favorite Dish"
directions: Wash and pick clean., Have water with meat boiling., Add greens; salt to taste., Cook until tender., Serve with hot pepper.

title: Chicken Marsala (For One)
directions: In a saucepan, heat oil. Dredge chicken in flour and place in pan., Cook until done, making sure not to burn chicken., Add mushrooms. Deglaze pan with Marsala wine. Add beef stock; reduce by half. Slowly add half and half and cook for 1 minute.

title: Carolina Apple Cake
directions: Mix oil, sugar and eggs together., Sift flour, soda and salt together; add to mixture., Mix thoroughly., Add vanilla, apples and nuts., Pour into greased and floured tube cake pan; bake for 1 hour at 350°.

title: All American Barbecue
directions: Cook beef and onions in Dutch oven until tender, drain. Combine ketchup, mustard, Worcestershire sauce, vinegar, sugar, salt and pepper., Stir., Heat through., Serve on hamburger buns.

title: Stuffed Eggs
directions: Cut eggs in half and remove yolks., Mash & mix with the other ingredients and fill each egg.

title: Sour Cream Pecan Coffee Cake
directions: Cream butter with, 1, cup, of, sugar, until light., Add eggs, 1 at a, time, beating well., Add vanilla., In a separate bowl, mix flour,, baking, powder and soda., Alternate blending flour mix and sour, cream, into	the, margarine mixture., Mix well., Combine in a, separate, bowl the rest of the sugar with the cinnamon and pecans., Spread half of batter mixture into a greased 13 x 9-inch pan., Sprinkle, with, half of cinnamon nut mixture., Top with the rest of the batter and spread out, then top with the rest of the cinnamon, mixture.	Bake at 350° for 40 to 50 minutes., Drizzle melted, butter, or	squeeze butter over top during the last 5 minutes of baking.	(Could also be put into 2 smaller pans.)

title: Spaghetti Salad
directions: Mix together and let stand in refrigerator overnight.

title: Coconut Pound Cake
directions: Beat egg yolks, shortening and margarine at high speed until well blended., Gradually add sugar and beat until fluffy., Add extracts and beat.

title: Easy Orange Pound Cake
directions: Preheat, oven, to, 350°., Combine, ingredients and mix. Pour into, a prepared tube pan., Bake for 40 to 45 minutes or until done., Top with glaze while still warm.

title: Mini Fish Pizzas
directions: Microwave fish fillets as directed on package., Arrange muffin halves on microwavable plate or platter., Place 1 hot fillet on each muffin half., Mix tomato sauce and oregano., Spoon over fish. Top with cheese., Microwave, uncovered, until cheese begins to melt, 20 to 30 seconds., Makes 4 pizzas.

title: Twinkie Delight
directions: Slice Twinkies lengthwise; place in bottom of 9 x 13-inch dish., Twinkies should cover the bottom of the dish., Cover Twinkies with thawed strawberries., Add layer of sliced bananas. Cover with instant vanilla pudding., Top with Cool Whip., Garnish with fresh strawberries., Refrigerate one hour., Serve immediately.

title: Corn Casserole
directions: Butter 1 1/2-quart casserole., Mix all ingredients together and put in casserole., Bake, uncovered, 35 to 45 minutes at 350°.

title: Pat'S Cheese Bread
directions: Mix all together and spread on French or Italian bread., Put under broiler until it sizzles.

title: Spinach Vegetable Dip
directions: Combine all ingredients and refrigerate.

title: Chicken Tamale Pie
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., In bowl, combine muffin mix and cheese. Prepare according to package directions., Set aside., In saucepan, stir remaining ingredients until blended., Heat through.

title: Mexican Corn Bread
directions: Mix all ingredients well., Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Punch
directions: Mix Jell-O and Kool-Aid according to package directions., Add pineapple juice., Freeze in gallon plastic container., When ready to serve, thaw several hours., Put in punch bowl and pour Sprite or 7-Up over the frozen mix.

title: Chive Cheese Balls(Finger Food)
directions: Divide the cream cheese into 30 equal pieces., Separate biscuits and cut each into thirds., Wrap a cube of cheese inside each piece of dough, forming a small ball., Place the balls on a lightly greased cookie sheet and bake in a preheated 350° oven until lightly browned.

title: Sherbet Pineapple-Orange
directions: Mix together., Yields 1 gallon freezer ice cream sherbet.

title: Asparagus-Egg Bake
directions: Wash and trim asparagus., Cook in unsalted, boiling water until almost tender., Drain the spears, reserving liquid., Add 3 cups water to liquid and bring to a boil., Stir in egg noodles and cook until limp but still slightly firm., Drain well.

title: Couscous Porridge A La Golden Russets
directions: Heat the milk until just short of scalding, melting the butter in it, having added the salt already., Dump in the couscous, then a generous handful of currants., Remove from heat; stir it up, cover and let sit for five minutes.

title: Rolls
directions: Cook milk, shortening and sugar until boiling, then set aside. When, lukewarm,, dissolve, yeast in it and sift enough flour in to make it the consistency of cake batter., Let stand in warm place, for, 2, hours,, then sift salt, soda and baking powder. Work in, enough, flour to make stiff dough, then roll out and cut as, many, rolls, as you wish., Set in a warm place and let rise for 2 hours before baking., Put the rest of dough in the icebox. Will keep a week or more.

title: Pat In The Pan Pie Crust
directions: Place all ingredients in pie pan and mix with hands until mixture forms a soft dough., Press firmly and evenly against bottom and sides of pie pan (not on the rim)., Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes until light brown., Cool and fill with any cream filling.

title: Italian Ricotta Pie(Traditional Easter Dessert)
directions: Mix all ingredients except sugar and eggs., Beat eggs and sugar., Add to cheese mixture., Pour into pie crust shell (thick). Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Joyce'S Chinese Cabbage
directions: Shred as much cabbage as you want to eat at a meal., Chop or dice your celery, carrots and apples according to how much you want in proportion to your cabbage.

title: Banana Cream Trifle
directions: In a large mixing bowl prepare pudding mix as directed on pkg. using two cups of milk., Layer half of the bread cubes, pudding mix, banana slices and whipped topping in a 2 quart serving bowl., Repeat with remaining ingredients; then cover and refrigerate.

title: Golden Nuggets
directions: Cream butter and 1 1/4 cups sugar., Add eggs one at a time. Sift flour, salt and cinnamon and add to creamed mixture., Shape into small balls., Mix 1/4 cup sugar and 1 teaspoon cinnamon and roll balls in the mixture., Place on greased baking sheet., Press walnut halves on each and bake 10 to 12 minutes at 375°.

title: California Blend Casserole
directions: Mix vegetables, mushroom soup and approximately 3/4 can of onions together. Put half of mixture in baking pan., Lay slices of cheese on top., Cover with remaining mixture of vegetables., Cover with cheese., Add rest of onions on top when approximately 15 minutes of cooking time left., Bake 30 to 45 minutes at 350°.

title: Tator Candy
directions: Boil tator until done., Peel while hot., Mash until lumps are gone., Add vanilla and sugar using about 1 cup sugar at a time. Add milk when mixture becomes stiff., Roll out on sugar., Spread with peanut butter., Roll into a loaf., Chill for 5 minutes. Slice in quarters and dip in powdered sugar.

title: Fiesta Potatoes
directions: Peel and boil potatoes until tender, then drain., Place in casserole dish., Add rest of ingredients., Bake for 15 minutes at 350°.

title: Low-Fat Berry Bavarian
directions: Stir boiling water into gelatin in large bowl for 2 minutes or until completely dissolved., Mix cold water and ice cubes to make 2 cups., Add gelatin, stirring until slightly thickened., Remove any remaining ice., Stir in whipped topping with wire whisk until smooth., Spoon into 8 dessert dishes., Refrigerate for 2 hours or until firm., Garnish with whipped topping and raspberries.

title: Tropical Apple Slaw
directions: Combine all ingredients, except mayonnaise; mix well., Add mayonnaise; toss until all ingredients are well coated., Makes 8 servings.

title: Shrimp Dip
directions: Blend all ingredients well until smooth and creamy. Refrigerate at least 1 hour before serving in covered container.

title: Scotch Oatcakes
directions: In bowl mix all ingredients except milk., Once mixed, blend in milk., Mix well., Divide the dough into 6 parts., Roll each part into a five inch circle., Cut each circle into quarters (pie slice sections)., Bake at 450° on a greased pan for 15 minutes.

title: Cold Oven Pound Cake
directions: Cream margarine and Crisco with sugar., Add eggs, one at a time., Add vanilla, lemon and almond flavorings., Sift flour 3 times, then add alternately with milk, starting and ending with flour., With last bit of flour, add baking powder., Bake 1 hour and 20 minutes in a 350° oven., Turn oven on after putting in cake.

title: Cranberry Bread
directions: Mix well all of the ingredients, except nuts and cranberries. Fold in nuts and cranberries., Bake at 350° in 1 big loaf pan or 2 small pans.

title: Zucchini Squares
directions: In large bowl, combine sugar, oil, oatmeal, baking soda, salt, baking powder, flour, eggs, zucchini and vanilla., Fold in nuts. Spoon onto a well-greased jelly roll pan., Bake 15 to 20 minutes at 350° or until brown., Let cool.

title: Broccoli And Rice Casserole
directions: Bring celery, onion and broccoli to boil., Cook 5 minutes and drain., Add rice, butter and soup., Mix well., Pour into casserole; spread Cheez Whiz over top., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Mistakes
directions: Brown sausage in large skillet., Drain., Melt cheese in skillet with sausage., Mix in garlic and Worcestershire., Remove from heat., Arrange bread on cookie sheet in a single layer., Put about one tablespoon of sausage mixture on each piece of bread. Bake in oven at 350° for about 10 to 15 minutes., Makes about 6 dozen.

title: Squash Casserole
directions: Mix, dressing mix and melted margarine together. Spread half of	mixture, in, a	small casserole dish (greased)., Fold remaining ingredients together and put on top of dressing. Use the other, half, of, dressing, on top.	Bake for 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Fabulous Cheesecake
directions: Preheat oven to 325°., Grease a 9-inch spring-form pan., In a large bowl with electric mixer at high speed, beat cream cheese with cottage cheese until creamy and well combined.

title: Coffee Cake
directions: Cream the margarine or butter and sugar., Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each., Sift flour, baking powder, salt and baking powder., Add dry ingredients with the evaporated milk and vanilla.

title: Diet Oatmeal Raisin Cookies
directions: Set oven at 375°., Mix and sift dry ingredients., Spread oats and nuts on ungreased cookie sheet and toast 5 to 7 minutes and set aside., Simmer raisins in 1/2 cup water until plump and drain. In mixer, beat sugar, apple butter, egg, oil and vanilla until light and fluffy., Stir in flour mix, oats, nuts and raisins. Drop on greased sheets about 2 inches apart., Bake 8 to 10 minutes until lightly browned., Makes about 40 medium size cookies. Calories, 114, fat 3g, sodium 46 mg, cho 9 mg.

title: Chop Suey Casserole
directions: Brown the pork in the soy sauce., Add the celery and onion. Add the mushroom soup, mushrooms, bean sprouts and noodles., Put into casserole dish and bake at 350° for 1 hour or until pork is done., During the last 10 minutes of baking, sprinkle chow mein noodles on top.

title: Marinated Mushrooms
directions: Day before serving:, In 10-inch skillet over medium heat, heat to boiling all ingredients except mushrooms; cover and simmer over low heat 10 minutes., Stir in mushrooms until coated., Cook over medium heat 3 to 5 minutes or until fork tender., Cover and refrigerate.

title: Black Bean Soup(With Secret Ingredient)
directions: In a large soup pot, heat oil. Add onions and cook over medium heat until lightly brown. Add garlic, cumin, cinnamon and cayenne pepper. Cook for 1 minute. Add all remaining ingredients except cheese. Bring to boil, reduce heat and simmer for 30 to 40 minutes or until ready to serve. Add extra chicken broth if it gets too thick.

title: Coconut Macaroon Pie
directions: Beat sugar, eggs and salt until mixture is lemon-colored., Add butter and flour and blend well., Add milk and fold in 1 cup coconut., Pour into pie shell., Top with remaining coconut., Bake at 325° about 1 hour.

title: Oven Fried Vegetables(A Weight Watcher Recipe)
directions: Put vegetables in a bowl and toss with oil., Arrange in a shallow layer on a nonstick cookie sheet; sprinkle with seasoned salt., Cook 20 to 30 minutes at 425°.

title: Riley'S Homemade Bailey'S
directions: Put all ingredients in blender; mix well., Can be stored up to 2 weeks in refrigerator.

title: Sausage Italian
directions: Brown sausage in a large frying pan., When sausage is cooked, cut into 1-inch pieces., Put remaining ingredients into crock-pot; add sausage., Cook on high 1 hour., Cook on low 7 to 8 hours. Serve over spaghetti.

title: Anasazi Veggies
directions: In white wine saute onions and peppers., Add other ingredients, sauteing over medium heat until squash is tender.

title: Sausage And Egg Casserole
directions: Put sausage in bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan., Cover with cubed bread., Beat eggs and pour over the top., Top with Cheddar cheese. Pour milk over it., Refrigerate overnight., Bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Cheese Ball
directions: Form into ball and cover with chopped pecans.

title: Mexican Chicken
directions: Boil chicken and save broth. Mix all ingredients in a large pan and top with shredded cheese. Bake 45 to 60 minutes at 350°.

title: Glen'S Soup
directions: Brown beef; drain., Add sausage and brown some more., Add water, tomato sauce, tomatoes, Veg-All, beans and starter mix. Cook in large pot on high for 15 to 20 minutes, then let simmer for 30 to 45 minutes., The best soup in Ware County!

title: Oatmeal Drop Cookies
directions: In a saucepan add cocoa, sugar, butter and milk together. Bring to a rolling boil, about 3 minutes. Keep ingredients stirred. Remove from heat and add peanut butter and oatmeal. Mix together. Spoon or drop onto wax paper.

title: Sherry Icebox Cake
directions: Line a medium size spring-form pan with ladyfinger halves. Combine egg yolks and sugar., Beat cream until stiff., Beat egg whites until stiff., Soak gelatin in cold water; dissolve in hot water and combine with egg yolk mixture., Fold in whipped cream and egg whites., Add flavoring; pour into ladyfinger lined pan and chill until firm.

title: Peanut Butter Cups
directions: Mix ingredients together and press into greased or Pam sprayed 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Peanut Butter Fingers
directions: Cream brown sugar, margarine and white sugar together., Blend in egg, 1/3 cup peanut butter, soda, salt and vanilla. Stir in flour and oats. Spread in greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes. Sprinkle with package of chocolate chips. Let stand until melted, then smooth over top. Combine powdered sugar, 1/4 cup peanut butter and milk. Drizzle over top. Cool. Cut into bars.

title: Potato Soup
directions: Simmer on medium-low heat, water, hash brown potatoes, broth, celery and onion., Add chicken soup, milk and celery soup. Melt in Velveeta cheese.

title: Chinese Casserole
directions: Chop meat into 1/2-inch cubes and brown in small amount of oil., Drain when done., Cook celery and onions in small amount of water until soft; drain., Add the cooked vegetables to the prepared meat; also add the soy sauce, rice (uncooked), chicken and rice soup and cream of mushroom soup; mix together and place in casserole dish., Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 1 1/2 hours. Remember to stir a few times while cooking., Serves 6 to 8.

title: Baby Food Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients together, beginning with your dry ingredients., Put in 9 x 13-inch pan or loaf pan., Bake 45 minutes to 1 hour at 350°.

title: Dumplings
directions: Sift flour, salt and baking powder together., Put into a bowl and stir in, slowly, butter and broth., Drop by tablespoonfuls into a pan of boiling salted chicken broth., Cover the pan and let boil slowly for about ten or fifteen minutes., Drop in boned chicken and simmer.

title: Popcorn Cake
directions: Mix popcorn, pecans and peanuts before you melt marshmallows. Melt oil, oleo and marshmallows., Drizzle over popcorn, pecans and peanuts., Put in M&M's last., Butter hands good., Spray pans with Pam., Make cakes and make sure mixture is firm before removing from pan.

title: Hot Dog Chili
directions: Combine all ingredients (do not brown ground beef), adding water one can at a time., Cook slowly, about 1 1/2 hours., You can use a crock-pot.

title: Banana Oat Muffins
directions: Combine butter, eggs, bananas and honey; mix until smooth. Mix together yogurt and baking soda; add to banana mixture., Cream well, then add flour, bran, wheat germ and oats and stir until just blended., Bake at 375° for 20 minutes., Don't overbake.

title: Italian Pork Noodles
directions: Cut boneless pork; stir-fry in 1/2 teaspoon vegetable oil, onion and mushrooms., Stir in tomatoes and Italian seasoning. Cover and simmer 10 minutes., Serve over hot cooked noodles. Serves 4.

title: Minestrone Soup
directions: *Can use an equal amount of reconstituted beef bouillon.

title: Egg Custard
directions: Mix ingredients and pour into 1 unbaked pie crust., Bake at 450° for 10 minutes., Reduced to 350° and cook until set in center., Cover with meringue, if wanted.

title: Macaroni Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients and bake at 375° for 40 minutes., Serves 16.

title: Corn Casserole
directions: Mix together and pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Enchilada Casserole
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., Crumble six cups Doritos with your hands into a large mixing bowl., Add onion, chili, enchilada sauce, tomato sauce, and 1 1/2 cup cheddar cheese to the Doritos. Stir with a rubber spatula to combine., Place mixture in a 8 1/2x11 oven proof casserole dish., Bake for 20 minutes.

title: Funnel Cakes
directions: Beat egg and add the milk., Add egg and milk mixture to sifted dry ingredients and beat until smooth., Holding your finger over the bottom of funnel, pour some batter into it.

title: Chicken Tetrazzini
directions: Garlic salt may be substituted for regular salt if desired.

title: Hearty Tomato Soup
directions: Mix all ingredients together and heat.

title: Apple Crumb Pie
directions: Pare apples, cut in eighths and arrange in a 9-inch pastry-lined pie pan., Sprinkle with 1/2 cup sugar mixed with cinnamon., Sift remaining 1/2 cup sugar with flour., Cut in butter until crumbly., Sprinkle over apples., Bake in hot oven (450°) for 10 minutes., Then in moderate oven (350°) for about 40 minutes, until apples are tender.

title: Lemon Tarts
directions: Combine first 5 ingredients in saucepan; stir in milk., Cook over medium heat, stirring, until thick., Cool., Fold in sour cream., Chill., Serve in pastry shells., Serves 6 to 8 dessert-size shells., More in smaller shells.

title: Caramel Dip
directions: Heat and stir all ingredients in microwave until smooth and warm., Pour over apple slices or dip apples into mixture.

title: Cool Whip Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients together and refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Fudge
directions: Put into a large bowl chocolate chips, butter and vanilla. Put into a large saucepan (thick bottomed) sugar and milk., Bring to boil and boil exactly 6 minutes from start of boil over medium heat., Remove from stove and pour over ingredients in bowl and stir until butter and chips are melted and mixture begins to thicken., Pour into lightly greased pan; let stand for 6 hours and cut into squares., Top with nuts, if desired.

title: E-Z Company Chicken
directions: Trim fat off chicken., Place chicken in a greased 12 x 8 x 2-inch casserole., Sprinkle with garlic powder., Mix oleo, sour cream and can of creamy chicken mushroom soup together until smooth., Pour over chicken., Sprinkle with onions (Durkee) as much as you desire., Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Pasta Fruit Salad
directions: Cook pasta; drain and rinse well in cold water. Place in a large bowl. Add the fruit. Combine yogurt and orange juice concentrate. Pour over salad and toss to coat. Cover and chill for several hours. Yield: 10 servings.

title: Pickled Beets
directions: Make enough liquid from sugar, cider vinegar and water until all jars of beets have been filled to very top and sealed., Wash beets., Trim off tops and roots., Place in large pot and cover with water., Cover pot and bring water to boil., Continue to cook beets until just fork-tender to center., Pour off hot water and add cold to cover., Change cold water until beets have cooled., If beets overcook, pickles will be mushy!, Skin and slice cooked beets., Loosely fill sterile jars., Put 2 cloves in each jar. Boil together sugar, vinegar and water 5 minutes., Fill each jar with liquid; seal and process on rack covered with boiling water for 5 minutes.

title: Oven Roasted Potatoes
directions: Preheat oven to 450°., In a large bowl, add all ingredients. Stir until potatoes are evenly coated., Place potatoes into a shallow baking pan., Bake, stirring occasionally, for 40 minutes or until potatoes are tender and golden brown., Makes about 8 servings.

title: Corn And Hominy Surprise
directions: Combine all ingredients and bake in casserole dish at 350° for 25 minutes.

title: Creamed Cabbage Slaw
directions: Chop cabbage fine and mix with other ingredients.

title: Mandarin Orange Salad
directions: Mix Jell-O and water until dissolved. Stir in orange juice and oranges. Mix well and let congeal. Mix pudding and milk. Fold in Cool Whip. Spread over congealed jello. Refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Fudge Icing
directions: Bring to full boil; boil 1 minute., Cool and beat in cold water until firm., Frost cake.

title: Green Tomato Relish
directions: Bring to boil and boil for 1 minute., Pack in jars and seal. Serve with fish.

title: Broccoli Cornbread
directions: Mix all ingredients (except muffin mix) well., Add muffin mix., Stir., Pour into greased 9 x 12-inch pan., Bake at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Melt butter in skillet. Cut up chicken breasts and cook for about 10 minutes until almost done. Mix Stove Top Stuffing according to box recipe. Place stuffing in large casserole dish. Place chicken on top of stuffing. Heat soup as directed on can., then pour over chicken and stuffing. Place in oven at 400 degrees for at least 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Can Do Chocolate Cake
directions: Grease and flour 2 round pans or 1 oblong pan., In large bowl, combine all ingredients., Beat on low speed 30 minutes, scraping sides and bottom of bowl., Beat 3 minutes on medium speed, scraping bowl frequently., Pour into prepared pans., Bake at 350° until done.

title: Banana Bread
directions: Cream butter and sugar., Sift dry ingredients together., Add eggs; mix well., Add bananas and mix well., Add dry ingredients, nuts and vanilla and mix well., Pour into greased pan and bake at 350° for 45 to 60 minutes.

title: Chicken Curry
directions: Cube chicken and put in a casserole with chopped celery, uncooked rice and the seasonings., Add the liquid which may be either milk or gravy and water., Cover and bake at 375° for 1 1/4 hours.

title: Chicken Tetrazzini
directions: Cook spaghetti in chicken broth along with 1 cup water., Melt 1 stick oleo in skillet and brown celery and onions., Mix flour, milk, cheese, soup and 1 cup chicken broth., Drain spaghetti when cooked and combine with sauce in pan., Add chicken and mix well. Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan and sprinkle with bread crumbs., Bake at 375° for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Hamburger-Onion Pie
directions: Mix Bisquick and cream well., Knead 10 times on floured board. Roll dough in a circle to fit a 9-inch pie pan., Saute beef and onions until brown., Add seasonings and Bisquick., Pour into dough-lined pan., Beat eggs and blend with cottage cheese., Pour over meat., Sprinkle cheese on top., Bake at 375° for 30 minutes.

title: Canned Salsa
directions: Combine tomatoes, peppers, onion, salt, garlic and vinegar in a large saucepan and bring to a boil., Reduce heat and simmer about 20 minutes., Pour into hot jars, leaving 1/4-inch headspace. Adjust caps and process in boiling water bath for 30 minutes. Makes about 6 half pints.

title: Sausage Balls
directions: Mix, all, ingredients., Shape into balls; bake on cookie sheet at, 350°, for 15 minutes if not frozen, but if frozen 30 minutes.

title: Chocolate Eclair Cake
directions: To make frosting, place first 5 ingredients in saucepan and bring to a boil. Boil 1 minute. Set aside to cool. Mix vanilla pudding with milk. Stir in Cool Whip.

title: Caramel Corn
directions: Combine evaporated milk, margarine, maple syrup and caramels. Cook slowly over low heat until melted and smooth, stirring often. Add vanilla; stir and pour over popcorn and peanuts., Mix well.

title: Holiday Ham Balls
directions: Heat oven to 350°. Lightly grease 15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 1-inch jelly roll pan. Mix all ingredients thoroughly. Shape mixture into 1-inch balls. Place about 2-inches apart in pan. Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until brown. Remove immediately from pan. Serve pan. Yield: about 7 dozen appetizers.

title: Marcene'S Whole Wheat Muffins
directions: Preheat oven to 350° to 375°., Sift flour, sugar, salt and baking powder into bowl., Combine eggs, milk and melted butter. Stir into dry ingredients., Grease muffin tin and fill 2/3 full with mixture.

title: Broccoli Supreme Garden Vegetables
directions: Saute the first 4 ingredients in butter (leave a little crunchy)., Prepare, Rice-A-Roni, as, directed., Mix, together. Real good with fried, roasted or baked chicken.

title: Lemon Sherry Chicken
directions: Season chicken, then flatten using meat mallet or rolling pin. Melt butter in heavy large skillet over medium heat., Add chicken. Cook until brown, about 5 minutes. Add sherry and lemon juice. Bring to a boil., Turn., Add lemon peel., Place on plate., Pour juice over chicken, then top with Parmesan cheese.

title: Strawberry Delight
directions: Crumble vanilla wafers along bottom of pan., Heat margarine, sugar and egg in saucepan until melted., Pour over vanilla wafers. Put strawberries on top of this, then top with Cool Whip., (May sprinkle with chopped pecans.)

title: Mexican Cornbread
directions: Mix all the ingredients together, reserving about 1 cup of shredded cheese to scatter on top., Bake in a 13 x 9-inch pan at 350° until done, about 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Mom'S Christmas Pecan Cake
directions: Cream butter and brown sugar., Add eggs., Beat well., Add flour, pecans, cherries and pineapple., Mix well., Add lemon extract and blend well.

title: Beef Stroganoff
directions: Brown the meat with the onion and garlic until meat is cooked through., Drain any fat., Add remaining ingredients and stir. Heat but do not boil., Serve over noodles.

title: Cranberry Molded Salad
directions: Dissolve jello in hot water., Add sour cream and cranberry sauce until well mixed., Mold and chill.

title: Artichoke Dip
directions: Place artichoke hearts in chopping bowl., Chop into small pieces., Combine artichokes and all other ingredients in large bowl., Mix together., Reserve 1/2 of chopped pimentos for the top. Transfer to casserole and smooth out top., Refrigerate until 40 minutes prior to serving., (This can be done up to 1 day ahead.)

title: Cereal Crunch Cookies
directions: Cream the sugars, margarine and oil., Add eggs, then remaining ingredients in order given., Bake at 350° for about 10 minutes until lightly browned.

title: Barley Soup
directions: Brown meat in oil. Add water or stock and bring to a boil. Skim off foam if present. Add parsley and spices; cover and simmer 30 minutes. Add barley and vegetables; cover and simmer an hour or until barley is done. Add Tamari sauce and garnish with chopped fresh parsley.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 325°., Grease a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Sift flour with sugar, soda, cinnamon, nutmeg and salt., Add apples, nuts, margarine and eggs., Beat until just combined (it will be thick)., Turn into pan., Bake for 1 hour or until top springs back when lightly pressed with fingertip., Serve warm. Top with whipped cream.

title: Pinata
directions: Will also need 1 (9-inch) round balloon and a newspaper.

title: Randy'S Smoked Turkey
directions: Thaw, turkey, in, refrigerator., Boil 2 quarts of water and add, brown	sugar, and Tender Quick., Mix well., Pump this into turkey, with, a, cooking, syringe.	Leave in brine in the refrigerator, for 3 days before cooking., Then cover with foil or use a, cooking bag and bake in oven or smoker at 325° until thermometer reaches 180° to 185°.

title: Fat Ladies
directions: Mix cake with melted butter and 1/3 cup canned milk. Spread 1/2 of mix in 9 x 13 pan. Bake at 325° for 6 minutes. Remove from oven and sprinkle with nuts and chocolate chips. Melt caramels with remaining milk (1/3 cup). Pour over nuts and chocolate chips. Spread remaining cake mixture over the top. Bake about 15 to 20 minutes more. Cool and slice in small pieces.

title: Twelve Layer Chocolate Cake
directions: Cream butter and sugar., Add eggs, one at a time., Sift flour and add alternately with milk and oil., Cook layers in oven on highest temperature (not broil), using an iron griddle., Use 1/2 cup of batter per layer.

title: Hamburger Stroganoff
directions: Saute onion and garlic in butter over medium heat., Stir in meat and brown., Stir in flour, salt, pepper and mushrooms., Cook 5 minutes.	Stir in soup., Simmer uncovered 10 minutes., Stir in sour cream., Heat.	Serve over noodles.

title: Tuna Stroganoff
directions: Dip dove breasts in soy sauce., Wrap with 1/2 slice of bacon and secure with a toothpick if necessary. Place on grill or in the oven (350°) on a rack in a pan., Cook for approximately 30 minutes or until the breast is tender.

title: Angel Food Dessert
directions: Put cake pieces into 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan., Drizzle jello over top., Let set for a few minutes in refrigerator., Pour prepared pudding over this and add slices of banana over top., Frost with Cool Whip.

title: Great Gazpacho
directions: Dice onion, tomatoes, green pepper and cucumber., Combine all ingredients and chill for 2 hours. Top with chopped scallions. You may puree the soup, if desired., Serves 6 people.

title: Skillet Scramble
directions: In a large skillet, saute the potatoes, green pepper and onion in oil., Sprinkle with onion powder, garlic powder and seasoned salt; mix well., In a bowl, combine the eggs, ham, water, salsa, salt and pepper., Add to the potato mixture,, Cook until the eggs are set., Sprinkle with cheese; cook 2 minutes longer or until cheese is melted., Serves 6-8.

title: Lasagna Roll-Ups
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., Cook noodles according to package directions; drain noodles., Rinse with cold water., Mix Ricotta, egg, parsley and 1 cup Mozzarella in a bowl; set aside.

title: Corn Casserole
directions: Melt butter and cream cheese together., Pour in corn and chilies., Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

title: Quick Hot Rolls
directions: Mix. Bake in muffin pan at 450° for 10 minutes., Makes 6 good size rolls.

title: Crunchy Tuna Pockets
directions: Rinse tuna in colander 1 minute; let drain 1 minute., Combine tuna with next 5 ingredients and toss gently., Combine mayo, lemon juice and dill., Toss gently with other combined ingredients. Cover and chill for 1 hour or until serving., When ready to serve, spoon into halved pita pockets., Use celery leaves to garnish. Makes 6 servings., Great for picnics, summertime entertaining or lunch anytime!

title: Crunchy Chicken Casserole
directions: Melt 1/4 cup butter., Stir in 1/4 cup flour., Add chicken broth, stirring constantly until mixture thickens., Lower heat and add cheese., Stir until cheese melts., Remove from heat., Stir in chicken, carrots and the pimento., Spread in shallow 2-quart casserole., Preheat oven to 375°., Melt 1/4 cup butter., Add seasoned stuffing mix and mix well., Spread over chicken mixture. Bake for 30 minutes., Serves 8 to 10.

title: Chicken Rotel
directions: Boil chicken in salt water; cool and debone., Take 1 1/2 quarts broth from chicken and boil vermicelli in it., Do not drain., Saute bell pepper, celery and onion in margarine; add this to vermicelli along with Ro-Tel tomatoes, chicken and cheese. Heat until cheese is melted., Bake in casserole dish at 350° until bubbly.

title: Fresh Strawberry Cake
directions: Mix cake mix, jello, oil, milk and eggs and beat until well blended., Put in 1/2 package frozen strawberries, 1/2 cup pecans and 1/2 cup coconut., Bake in three greased and floured cake pans. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes., Cool cake on wire racks.

title: Microwave Nachos
directions: Place paper towel on a microwave-safe plate., Arrange tortilla chips on Bounty-lined plate., Sprinkle with cheese, olives and pepper., Microwave at 50% (Medium) for 2 to 5 minutes or until cheese melts, rotating plate once or twice., Makes 4 servings.

title: Herb-Roasted Potatoes
directions: Peel and cut potatoes in bite-size chunks., Place oil and soup mix in a large Ziploc bag., Add potatoes and mix well till all covered., Pour potatoes into a baking dish sprayed with pan spray., Bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes., Stirring every 15 minutes.

title: Brie Almondine
directions: Saute almonds in butter until just toasted., Place Brie with rind in small ovenproof serving dish., Pour almond mixture over cheese., Bake at 325° for 5 to 7 minutes, until cheese starts to melt., Serve immediately with crackers.

title: Porcupine Meatballs In Chili Sauce
directions: Combine ground chuck, rice, onion and bell pepper., Form into small to medium balls., In large saucepan, combine remaining ingredients., Bring chili sauce to boil over medium heat., Add meatballs., Cook for 10 minutes., Reduce to simmer for 20 minutes. May be served over hot rice.

title: Black Forest Seasoning Salt
directions: Mix all ingredients together.

title: Seven Bean Bake
directions: Saute pork, celery and onion., Mix all ingredients together in roaster pan., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Chicken Sandwich Deluxe
directions: In a medium bowl, place chicken., Sprinkle with seasoned salt and pepper., Sprinkle with lemon juice and let set for 5 minutes.

title: Chicken Nacho Dip
directions: Reserve 1 teaspoon taco seasoning mix; set aside., Combine remaining taco seasoning mix, chicken, beer and chiles in a large skillet., Bring to a boil., Reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, for 5 minutes or until mixture is thickened., Remove from heat; stir in salsa.

title: Cole Porter'S Three Fruit Cole Slaw
directions: In a large bowl, combine all of the ingredients except the mayonnaise., Cover and chill., Just before serving, stir in the mayonnaise., Serves 6 to 8.

title: Pumpkin Bread
directions: Combine dry ingredients., Add nuts and mix., Combine slightly beaten eggs with remaining ingredients., Pour all at once into dry ingredients., Blend lightly., Bake in 2 well-greased and floured loaf pans at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Poverty Sop
directions: Brown the flour with the bacon drippings until brown and thick., Add the salt and pepper., Mix well and add milk, cooking and stirring until desired thickness., Sop with biscuits.

title: Lemon Lush
directions: Mix oleo, flour and pecans., Pat into 9 x 13-inch pan and bake at 375° for 15 minutes., Combine sugar, cream cheese and 1 cup topping., Mix pudding and cold milk; spread over cream cheese mixture in pan., Spread rest of whipped topping over mixture and refrigerate.

title: Bloody Mary Mix
directions: Mix and refrigerate., Add vodka to mix or serve as Virgin Mary., Adjust spices to your own taste.

title: Grandma Ferry'S Dumplings For Snitz And Knepp
directions: Sift together dry ingredients., Cut in fat; add milk., Drop by spoonfuls on top of the stew., Cook, uncovered, for about 5 minutes., Now cover and cook slowly for 15 minutes., Do not uncover until they have steamed 15 minutes.

title: Taco Dip
directions: Layer in large oblong pan the refried beans, ground beef cooked in taco seasoning mix, green chiles, black olives, cheese and taco sauce., Bake for 20 minutes in oven at 425°., Stir in one cup of sour cream., Serve with Doritos or nachos.

title: Cinnamon Raisin Biscuits
directions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees.

title: Apple Butter
directions: Cook apples in cider until tender., Press through a sieve or food mill; measure 3 quarts of apple pulp., Cook pulp until thick enough to round up in a spoon., As pulp thickens, stir frequently to prevent sticking., Add sugar and spices., Cook slowly, stirring frequently until thick, about 1 hour., Pour hot, into hot jars, leaving 1/4-inch headspace., Adjust caps., Process pints and quarts for 10 minutes in boiling water bath.

title: Chocolate Icing
directions: Bring cocoa, milk and margarine to good boil., Remove from heat and beat in powdered sugar, vanilla and nuts, if desired.

title: Chocolate Mint Patties
directions: Mix all ingredients until stiff., Form into patties., Dip in chocolate; place on wax paper to set.

title: Oyster Casserole Or Dip
directions: Cook and drain spinach and set aside., Melt butter; add all spices., Drain oysters and blot with towel., Combine butter mixture with drained spinach., Add bread crumbs and oysters and stir gently., Place in a greased casserole and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese., Cover and bake at 350° for 30 minutes., Then uncover for 15 minutes., Serve with Melba toast for appetizer.

title: Creamy Fudge
directions: Line 8-inch square baking pan with foil., Combine sugar, Marshmallow Creme, milk, butter, Kahlua and salt in 2-quart saucepan., Bring to rapid boil, stirring constantly for 5 minutes. Remove from heat and add all chocolate., Stir until melted., Add nuts and vanilla., Turn into pan., Refrigerate until firm (overnight)., Cut into squares., Keep in refrigerator until desired use.

title: Marge Birsky'S Hamburger Soup
directions: Brown beef; drain fat., Add rest of ingredients (tomatoes, undrained) in saucepan., Bring to boiling; reduce heat, then simmer, covered, for 1 hour, until vegetables are tender., Season to taste with salt and pepper; remove bay leaf.

title: Salmon Ball
directions: Drain liquid from salmon and remove skin and bones., Add next 5 ingredients., Mix well., Add cream cheese., Chill overnight. Form into a ball and roll in chopped nuts and parsley.

title: Fast Fixin' Chocolate Chip Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Pour oil into a 13 x 9-inch pan., Tilt pan until bottom is covered with oil., Put remaining ingredients into pan., Stir with fork or spoon until blended (about 2 minutes)., Scrape sides and spread evenly in pan., Bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes until toothpick inserted near center comes out clean., Use a knife to loosen cake from sides., Cut and serve directly from pan., Store leftover cake loosely covered.

title: Chocolate Chip Bundt Cake
directions: Combine all ingredients except chocolate chips and beat 2 minutes., Fold in the chocolate chips., Bake in well greased and floured bunt pan for 50-55 minutes at 350 degrees., Let cool in pan about 20-25 minutes.

title: No Cholesterol Egg
directions: Beat in blender., Keeps, in, refrigerator, for	up to 1 week; 3 to 4 tablespoons equals one egg.

title: Gourmet Veal Burger
