directions: Heat oven to 400°., Stir hot water, margarine and contents of vegetable/seasoning packet in bowl until margarine is melted., Add stuffing crumbs and egg; stir until moistened., Spoon stuffing onto each chicken breast; wrap chicken around stuffing., Place seam side down, in greased shallow baking dish., Brush with melted margarine., Place any remaining stuffing in center of dish., Bake 30 or 35 minutes or until chicken is thoroughly cooked., Heat soup, water and dill in a saucepan., Serve over chicken.

title: Chicken And Rice Casserole
directions: Boil the chicken (2 to 3 cups water)., Bone it., Save the broth., Cook onion, celery and carrot in chicken broth along with rice., Cook until rice is tender., Add 1/2 cup mushroom soup and the mushrooms., Bake at 275° for 1 hour., Watch for dryness.

title: Cream Cheese Mints
directions: Combine cream cheese and peppermint extract., Add powdered sugar until smooth., Knead in the food coloring., Form into small balls., Dip into the sugar., Press with glass (one with a design on the bottom)., Dry (let dry overnight).

title: Banana Nut Bread
directions: Sift flour, soda and salt together; cream shortening and sugar thoroughly., Add eggs and bananas, beating until light. Alternately add flour mixture and milk., Beat after each addition until smooth., Add nuts., Pour batter into greased 9 x 5-inch loaf pan., Bake in moderate oven at 350° for 1 hour and 5 minutes or until done., Remove pan; cool on rack and store overnight before slicing.

title: Blueberry Buckle
directions: Heat oven to 375°., Mix thoroughly sugar, shortening and egg. Stir in milk., Add flour, baking powder and salt., Stir., Blend in berries., Spread in greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle with crumb topping., Bake 45 to 50 minutes until toothpick comes out clean.

title: Blueberry Congealed Salad
directions: Add 2 cups boiling water to jello., Stir in pie filling and pineapple with juice and some pecans, if desired., Pour in oblong dish; cover and let congeal overnight.

title: Chicken Salad
directions: Mix mayonnaise, curry powder and soy sauce together., Mix into remaining ingredients., Refrigerate and let stand for several hours., Serves 12.

title: Salisbury Venison Steak
directions: In a large bowl, combine first 10 ingredients, Mix well. Shape into 10 patties; thoroughly coat each patty with flour. Heat 1/3 cup oil in skillet over medium heat., Add patties and brown on both sides., Transfer patties to a greased roasting pan. Place onion and mushrooms over meat.

title: Spinach Casserole
directions: Mix all the ingredients above., Put in a casserole dish., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Old Fashion Cocoa Fudge
directions: In medium saucepan, mix cocoa and sugar; add canned milk and mix well., Over low heat, bring mixture to boil; lower heat and continue cooking to soft ball stage., Remove from heat and add vanilla, butter and nuts., Let stand about 10 minutes., Beat mixture until it starts to lose its shine., Pour quickly into buttered 8 x 8-inch cake pan., Cool part way in fridge; cut into squares and return to fridge until completely cool.

title: Chicken Enchiladas
directions: Blend tomatoes and soup until smooth., In a 9 x 13-inch baking dish, layer 1/2 of each of the chicken, tortillas, onion, soup-tomato mixture and cheese., Repeat a second layer, ending with cheese., Bake in preheated 350° oven for 40 to 50 minutes, or until bubbly., Yields 8 servings.

title: Deluxe Corn Bread
directions: Beat eggs, then mix in sour cream, oil and corn., Add cornmeal., Bake in 8 x 8-inch pan for 40 to 45 minutes at 375°. Can be doubled for 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Hot Chocolate Mix
directions: Mix well., This makes a lot!, You can half with a friend or give as gifts., Add boiling water.

title: Jacob'S Pound Cake
directions: Beat sugar and butter and a little more milk and flour gradually. Add vanilla. Bake in cold oven at 300° for 1 hour and 45 minutes to 2 hours.

title: Fae'S Kwik-N-Easy Party Dip
directions: Mix all ingredients in small bowl., Cover., Refrigerate 1 hour., Serve with assorted vegetable dippers.

title: Baked Asparagus
directions: Drain liquid off asparagus. Add juice to mushroom soup, chopped pimientos and chopped mushrooms in a saucepan. Cook over low heat to pouring consistency. Place in layers in greased casserole, starting with 1/2 the asparagus, egg slices, cheese, cracker crumbs and soup mixture; repeat, ending with grated cheese. Garnish with paprika. Bake until thick and bubbly at 300°.

title: Lemon Carrots
directions: Boil carrots in salted water until tender-crisp., Drain., In saucepan, mix sugar, lemon juice and butter., Heat until boiling. Boil for 2 to 3 minutes., Add carrots and coat well., Serve warm.

title: Crawfish Iberia
directions: Saute onions in butter until clear., Add crawfish and saute for 3 minutes., Add flour; stir until smooth., Add milk; simmer for 3 to 5 minutes., Stir in cooked spinach., Top with grated cheese., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes., Serves 8 to 10.

title: Green Chili Cheese Casserole
directions: Place peppers, cut and seeded, in buttered casserole dish. Add grated cheese., In another dish, beat eggs., Add milk gradually to eggs, Bisquick and salt., Pour this over cheese and peppers., Bake in oven at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Super Duper Bean Pot
directions: Place all beans in casserole., Brown garlic and onion in grease., Add all other ingredients., Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

title: Perfect Apple Pie
directions: Combine sugar, flour, spices and dash of salt; mix with apples., Fill pie shell with apple mixture., Dot with butter. Adjust top crust, cutting slits for escape of steam., Seal and sprinkle with sugar., Bake at 400° for 50 minutes or until done.

title: Homemade Noodles
directions: Combine first 4 ingredients, beating well., Add as much flour as can be worked in with a spoon., Roll the dough out thin as tissue paper., Let dry on one side, then turn to dry on the other side., Use a noodle cutter to cut noodles.

title: Beef Stroganoff
directions: Combine flour and seasonings; roll meat in mixture., Preheat electric frypan or skillet to 340° or hot., Add fat; when melted, add meat., Brown, turning to brown all sides., Add onion, garlic and mushrooms., Saute until partially tender., Add liquid, all sauces and green pepper., When boiling, turn down to simmer.

title: Pansy'S Raw Apple Cake
directions: Beat all ingredients together by hand, adding apples and nuts last., Put in greased and floured tube pan., Bake 1 hour and 15 minutes at 350°.

title: Strawberry Patch Punch
directions: Combine first four ingredients in a blender. Whirl to consistency of thick slush. Place 2 ice cubes in each glass. Fill 3/4 full of fruit slush. Fill remainder with ginger ale or 7-Up. Serves 4.

title: Famous Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Beat together shortening, sugar, eggs, water and vanilla until creamy., Add combined remaining ingredients., Mix well., Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls onto greased cookie sheet., Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Banana Split Cake
directions: Mix graham crumbs with 1 stick melted butter and put in bottom of 9 x 12-inch pan., Next, beat eggs, 2 sticks butter and powdered sugar for 13 minutes at high speed and put on top of crumbs., Put a layer of sliced bananas and a layer of pineapple. Top with thawed Cool Whip and garnish with cherries and pecans.

title: Mississippi Mud Cake
directions: Combine all ingredients except marshmallow cream., Bake in greased pan for 30 minutes at 350°., When removed from oven, spread marshmallow cream on top while hot., Top with icing.

title: Sweet And Sour Beef
directions: Brown meat in skillet., Remove and set aside., Combine brown sugar and cornstarch in skillet., Add vinegar, soy sauce and juice from canned pineapple., Cook, stirring constantly until thickened. Add pineapple chunks and meat., Simmer until 5 minutes before serving time., If necessary, add water, pineapple juice or apple juice to thin the sauce., Five minutes before serving time, stir in carrots and green pepper.

title: Orange Baked Pork Chops
directions: Cut fat from chops. Place in shallow baking dish., Combine remaining ingredients and pour over pork chops., Cover with foil and bake at 350° for 1 hour or until tender., Makes 6 servings.

title: Teenagers Favorite Taco Casserole
directions: In a skillet, cook ground beef and onions until beef is browned and onion is tender; drain., In a greased 9 x 13-inch dish, spread refried beans; sprinkle beef mixture over beans., Add layers of olives (reserving some for garnish), green chilies and cheese., Spread taco sauce over all., Bake at 400° for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Banana Homemade Ice Cream
directions: Mix ingredients well., Stir in 4 mashed bananas., You can substitute strawberries or peaches for the bananas., Freeze. Yield:, 5 quarts.

title: Hot German Potato Salad
directions: Fry bacon slowly., Drain., Saute onion in fat., Blend in flour, sugar, salt, pepper and celery seed., Cook until smooth and bubbly., Add vinegar and water., Stir and boil for 1 minute., Add potatoes and bacon., Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Randy'S Favorite
directions: Slice bananas and arrange on plate., Microwave peanut butter for 30 to 45 seconds., Pour over banana slices., Drizzle with chocolate syrup., Serve while still warm.

title: Hamburger Casserole
directions: Brown ground beef in skillet; drain., Sprinkle and mix with flour (about 1/4 cup); stir in milk to make gravy., Cook on medium heat, stirring occasionally, until thick., Salt and pepper to taste.

title: Fudge Pie
directions: Melt butter in saucepan., Add sugar and cocoa; stir well., Add eggs, one at a time, and stir well after each addition., (Do not beat.), Add milk and vanilla., Pour into 2 pie crusts., Bake at 400° for 10 minutes., Reduce heat to 350° and bake for 25 minutes. Test center with a toothpick., If it comes out clean, it's done.

title: Perfect Pumpkin Pie
directions: Mix ingredients in order given., Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 425° for 15 minutes., Reduce heat to 350° and bake 45 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean., Cool completely on wire rack.

title: Chocolate Cake
directions: Combine cake mix, pudding mix, milk, eggs, and oil., Mix at medium speed for 2 minutes., Fold in grated german chocolate bar. Pour into greased and floured baking pan and bake at 350 degrees for 50 minutes., Let cool for 15 minutes., Remove from pan and sprinkle with powdered sugar.

title: Squash Casserole
directions: Cook squash; drain and add other ingredients., Bake in glass baking dish until bubbly and slightly brown, approximately 30 minutes.

title: Chocolate Custard(For 2 Pies)
directions: Makes 2 pies., Have pie crust already cooked and cooled.

title: Okie Corn
directions: Saute onion and pepper in butter. Mix the cream-style corn, whole kernel corn, butter, eggs, onion and green pepper with cornbread mix. Bake in a greased 9 x 13 pan 25 minutes at 350°. Remove from oven. Add on top the sour cream and cheese. Return to oven until cheese melts.

title: Homemade Hamburger Helper
directions: Brown hamburger meat in a large skillet; drain meat and return to skillet., Add macaroni and cheese and water., Simmer until macaroni is tender., More cheese may be added for cheesier flavor.

title: Walnut Beer Bread(Makes Two Loaves)
directions: Heat beer to 105° to 115° and pour 1/2 cup into a small bowl. Stir in the yeast and let stand 10 minutes., Mix the flours, sugar and salt in large bowl., Make a well in center., Pour yeast mixture, oil and remaining 1 cup beer into the well and stir until blended., Knead dough on a floured surface until smooth and elastic, about 10 minutes, adding more flour if necessary., Grease large bowl with walnut oil., Cover with damp towel and let rise until double., May also let rise in fridge overnight.

title: Dr. Pepper Icing
directions: Heat margarine, Dr. Pepper and cocoa until well blended., Stir in remaining ingredients. If necessary, add more powdered sugar or a small amount of margarine until of the proper spreading consistency. Frost cake.

title: Johnnie Mac Casserole
directions: Boil macaroni according to package directions., Brown hamburger and drain., Add Sloppy Joe mix, tomato paste or sauce (according to directions)., Mix drained macaroni, hamburger mixture and corn., Use half of cheese in mixture., Pour into casserole dish., Sprinkle top with remaining cheese., Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Hash Brown Casserole
directions: Crumble the hash browns into a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Combine, 1/2 cup melted margarine, cream of chicken soup, sour cream,, salt, and, onion;, spread, over, hash browns., Cut the cheese, into, cubes, and spread over the top of the casserole. Sprinkle, the corn flakes over top., Drizzle the remaining 1/4 cup margarine over all., Bake 45 to 60 minutes at 350°.

title: Appleberry Salad
directions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water., Add frozen berries., Stir until fruit is thawed., Add applesauce and mix well., Pour into serving dishes., Chill until firm.

title: Easy Hamburger Stroganoff
directions: Brown hamburger with onion and drain., Salt and pepper to taste., Add soups and sour cream and simmer for a few minutes. Serve over cooked noodles.

title: Rotel Dip
directions: Melt cheese in pan., Add Ro-Tel tomatoes., Brown hamburger and then add to cheese mix., Serve hot with tortilla chips.

title: 6 Month Slaw
directions: Chop cabbage, onion and sweet pepper and add salt., Mix and let stand 10 minutes.

title: Hungry Jack Casserole
directions: Brown ground beef in skillet, stirring until crumbly., Drain. Stir in next 3 ingredients., Add seasonings., Spoon into a 2-quart baking dish., Sprinkle with cheese., Cut biscuits into halves. Place cut side down around edges and over top of casserole., Bake at 350° for 15 minutes or until brown.

title: Pork Chop Casserole
directions: Place pork chops in large baking dish (13 x 9) sprayed with Pam. Mix soup, broth and rice. Pour over the pork chops. Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Chocolate Chip Pecan Ice Cream
directions: Mix all together; add enough milk to fill freezer.

title: Sour Cream
directions: Mix in blender., This makes a perfect sour cream that can be used in any recipe calling for sour cream.

title: Mexican Cornbread Casserole
directions: Lightly oil a heavy skillet over high heat and brown the meat. Add the onion and peppers and cook until tender, about 4 minutes. In large mixing bowl, combine the cornmeal, milk, creamed corn, eggs, bacon fat and soda., Mix thoroughly.

title: Emerald Squares
directions: Bottom Layer:, Combine 1/2 cup butter and cocoa in saucepan over low heat., Stir until well blended., Remove from heat; add 1/2 cup sugar, egg and vanilla. Stir in crumbs., Mix well and press into bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Tuna Salad
directions: Drain tuna, chop eggs and mix it all together., Chill and serve on crackers or in a sandwich for school!, Enjoy!!!

title: Mother'S Cobbler
directions: Melt the margarine in sheath cake pan., Sift the flour, baking powder, salt and sugar., Mix with the milk and pour over butter. Add fruit, cinnamon and more sugar., Bake at 400° for 15 minutes. Lower heat to 350° and cook until done.

title: Blueberry Muffins
directions: Melt butter; beat in egg well., Add yogurt, soda, baking powder and sugar., Fold in flour., Pour in cupcake holders and bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

title: Salt Water Taffy
directions: Mix sugar and cornstarch in 1 1/2-quart saucepan., Stir in next 4 ingredients., Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly until mixture boils and sugar is completely dissolved., Continue cooking without stirring until temperature reaches 260°., After boiling has ceased, stir in flavoring and coloring., Pour onto lightly greased cookie sheet., Let stand until cool enough to handle., Grease hands and pull until it has a satin like finish and light color., Cut into 1-inch pieces., Wrap in waxed paper.

title: Frozen Cranberry Salad
directions: Mix cream cheese, mayonnaise, sugar and lemon juice., Add pineapple; fold in Cool Whip., Freeze until firm., If kept in freezer, good as long as lasts.

title: Easy Layer Bars
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Melt butter in 9 x 13-inch pan in oven, then add graham cracker crumbs., Press down., Put coconut and chips in pan., Drizzle milk over all., Bake 25 minutes., Cool completely and cut.

title: Pasta Salad
directions: Cook pasta following package directions and drain well., Mix in pepper, onion, olives, artichokes and nuts., Toss together and set aside.

title: Diet 3 Bean Salad
directions: Combine all ingredients in large bowl., Toss, cover and chill. Serve with slotted spoon., One-half cup serving equals 1/2 vegetable, 1/2 bread or 1/2 protein; 10 optional calories.

title: Cream Of Broccoli Soup
directions: Cook broccoli and drain well., Combine next three ingredients in heavy saucepan., Cook over low heat until cheese is melted, then add broccoli.

title: Dutch Apple Cake
directions: Combine Bisquick mix and sugar., Blend eggs and milk with shortening and vanilla., Add liquid all at once to dry ingredients. Mix only until dampened., Pour into greased wax paper lined 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan., Peel apples and slice thin., Place over top of batter in pan.

title: Red Cabbage Salad
directions: Toss sliced apples with lemon juice., Mix all ingredients and serve.

title: Meat Dish
directions: Add onion, green pepper and celery to spaghetti and meat; salt and pepper., Put in baking dish., Pour over all the tomato sauce or tomato juice., Bake 45 minutes at 325°.

title: Pineapple Dip
directions: Drain pineapple., Reserve 3 tablespoons syrup., Combine ingredients, except pecans., Form into ball., Top with chopped pecans.

title: Kahlua
directions: Simmer water, coffee and sugar for 2 hours., Cool and add vanilla and vodka., Let stand 3 to 4 weeks.

title: Mock Crab Cakes
directions: Drain oil from tuna and put tuna in a small bowl., Break bread into small piece, add to tuna., Add all other ingredients and mix thoroughly., Shape into cakes, fry in hot oil until brown.

title: Tang Drink
directions: Dissolve- drink mix in pineapple juice in pitcher or punch bowl., Stir in ginger ale and add ice cubes. Garnish with orange slices.

title: Parsley Potatoes
directions: Cut a 1/2-inch strip of peel from around the middle of each potato., Place potatoes in 2-quart casserole dish., Add water. Cover with lid and cook at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes or until tender., Drain potatoes and stir in parsley, butter, salt and pepper., Makes 4 servings.

title: Beef Tips And Rice
directions: Brown meat and onions in margarine., Add rest of ingredients. Simmer 1 hour., Serve over rice.

title: Pork Chop Casserole
directions: Brown pork chops in oil., Layer on bottom of Pyrex dish. Layer sliced raw potatoes over all chops, to the top of dish. Pour 1 jar Heinz chili sauce over potatoes., Add salt, pepper and garlic to taste., Cover with foil., Bake 1 hour at 350°., Remove foil., Top with 1 package frozen peas., Bake 20 minutes longer. May be doubled in a larger dish.

title: Country Style Cabbage
directions: Cook ham with some water until tender., Put cabbage and potatoes with the ham; cook for 30 minutes., Take up and drain. Cut cabbage as small as you want.

title: Fluffy White Icing
directions: Mix ingredients and put in double boiler., Mix with electric mixer while cooking until it forms peaks or is at spreading consistency.

title: Peach Ice Cream
directions: With electric mixer, beat eggs; add sugar and beat until creamy., Add Eagle Brand and vanilla; beat well., Add peaches and milk., Freeze as usual in ice cream freezer.

title: Butterscotch Pie
directions: In skillet, cook until brown the brown sugar, shortening and cream., Add milk, flour and egg yolk., Continue cooking until thickened., Pour into pie pastry and cool.

title: Brown Sugar Cookies
directions: Put first 3 ingredients in mixing bowl and mix until smooth. Stir in flour, one cup at a time until thoroughly mixed., Mix in nuts., Spray cookie sheet with Pam., Drop from soup spoon onto cookie sheet., Cook at 300° until done.

title: Cheese Ball
directions: Combine first three ingredients together to form a ball., Roll in chopped nuts and refrigerate.

title: Swiss-Gruyere Fondue
directions: Toss together cheeses, flour, mustard and garlic powder., In a 2-quart microwave-safe casserole, microcook the wine, Worcestershire sauce and 1/4 cup water, uncovered, on 100% power (High) 1 to 1 1/2 minutes, or until hot., Add cheese mixture to hot liquid., Microcook, uncovered, on 50% power (Medium) for 8 to 9 minutes, or until cheese is melted, stirring every 2 minutes. Serve with bread cubes., Reheat as necessary in the casserole on 50% power (Medium) for 3 minutes., Makes 8 servings.

title: Sauerkraut Soup
directions: Slice Polish sausage into 1/2 in pieces., Drain and rinse sauerkraut.

title: Cornish Game Hens
directions: Thaw, wash and remove giblets from hens., Rub salt all over inside and out., Sprinkle with tenderizer., Place in roasting pan, breast side up., Bake at 425° about 1 hour or until brown and very tender., Baste with liquid several times during cooking to keep moist., (To keep more juicy, bake breast down and turn last 15 minutes to brown., It's more trouble, but worth it.), Serve with wild rice and English peas.

title: Sugar Cookies
directions: Cream together oleo and sugars., Add eggs., Sift together dry ingredients., Mix well., Chill dough 1 hour or overnight., Drop by teaspoons on cookie sheet., Press with small glass dipped in sugar., Bake at 350° for 8 minutes.

title: Breakfast Casserole
directions: Mix eggs, onions and mushrooms., Heat soup before pouring over top., Sprinkle grated cheese over top and bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes., If refrigerated before baking, bake for 1 hour., Bake uncovered.

title: Mrs. Whitten'S Happi Time Punch
directions: Use green food coloring and red cherries for a festive air.

title: Bill'S Fried Catfish
directions: Wash fillets in lemon or lime juice., Place on paper towel to dry at room temperature for 30 minutes., Salt to your taste, using a mixture of garlic salt, cayenne, black pepper, chili powder and red pepper.

title: Microwave Sliced Bake Potatoes
directions: Peel potatoes if skin is tough., Cut potatoes into thin slices but, not, all, the way through., Put in microwave-safe dish, and sprinkle with melted butter and parsley., Microwave on, High power 10 minutes; rearrange potatoes after 5 minutes. Let, rest, for, 5 minutes., Sprinkle with Cheddar and Parmesan cheese., Microwave, 4 to, 6 minutes on High until cheeses are melted and potatoes are soft.

title: Momma'S Coffee Cake
directions: Melt 1/2 of butter with brown sugar and pour into Bundt pan. Top with nuts and cherries.

title: African Rice Dishes
directions: Wilt greens in hot oil., Do not brown., Add water to cover. Cook rice according to the directions on box., Set aside, keeping rice hot., Add 2 tablespoons tomato paste., Add 3 or 4 beef bouillon cubes, crushed., Add meat, halfway cooked., Simmer 1 hour or until meat is tender., Serve over hot rice.

title: Darlene'S Delight
directions: Mix butter and graham crackers and pat down in bottom of cake pan., Mix cream cheese, powdered sugar and 1/4 cup milk., Pour over graham crackers., Mix pudding and pour over sugar mixture. Top with Cool Whip.

title: Sunday Chicken And Dressing Casserole
directions: Saute onion and celery in margarine. Heat broth and undiluted soups and pour over cornbread crumbs. Add onion and celery. Mix well. Season with salt and pepper. Pour half of dressing mixture in greased deep 3-quart casserole. Add chicken and top with rest of dressing. Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Baby Food Cake
directions: Separate egg whites; beat until stiff., Beat egg yolks (yellows)., Blend egg whites and egg yolks with oil., Mix flour and other ingredients., Bake 1 hour in 350° oven.

title: Cream Of Tomato Soup(Yields 4 Servings)
directions: Cook tomatoes, onion, pepper, cayenne, sugar and bay leaf together for 15 minutes; strain., Melt butter and blend in flour. Add milk gradually, stirring constantly., Garnish with watercress.

title: Parmesan Chicken Breasts
directions: Heat oven to 400°., Spray 15 x 10 x 1-inch baking pan with nonstick cooking spray.

title: Baked Pineapple
directions: Beat eggs; mix sugar and flour together to keep down lumps. Add sugar and flour mixture to well beaten eggs., Add pineapple juice and butter., Cook to a cream sauce., Pour over pineapple and bake at 300° for about 20 to 25 minutes or until slightly brown on top.

title: Fruit Cake
directions: Heat oven to 275° (slow)., Line two loaf pans with brown paper. Mix oil, sugar, molasses and eggs., Beat vigorously with spoon or mixer two minutes.

title: Watergate Salad
directions: Mix pudding, and pineapple; add Cool Whip, marshmallows and nuts., Mix well and refrigerate.

title: Beef Stroganoff Skillet
directions: In skillet, brown beef and cook onion until tender., Drain fat from beef., Blend in mushroom soup and sour cream; add remaining ingredients., Bring to boil., Reduce heat., Cover., Cook 10 minutes or until noodles are done., Stir often., Makes about 5 cups.

title: Vegetables In Cheese Sauce(Melts In Your Mouth.)
directions: In a 3-quart microwave-safe casserole dish, stir soup until smooth., Stir in milk, basil and garlic., Mix well., Add cauliflower, onion and peas., Stir to coat well., Cover with lid. Microwave on High 15 minutes or until vegetables are tender, stirring twice during cooking., Let stand, covered, 5 minutes. Makes about 5 1/2 cups.

title: Mary'S Devil'S Food Cake
directions: Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy., Add eggs and cream until light., Add chocolate and mix well., Sift together flour and soda Add flour and sour cream alternately, ending with flour., Add vanilla., Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean.

title: Coconut Cake
directions: Prepare cake., Mix as directed for 2 (9 inch) layers., Cool and slice into 4 layers.

title: Creamed Onions
directions: Cook onions in boiling salted water 20 minutes if using fresh onions., Drain onions; add milk, margarine or butter, salt and pepper., Heat over low heat until hot.

title: Grape Jelly
directions: Wash off grapes., Pick off grapes and put in a pan. Cook without water until done., The way you know when grapes are done, the inside will come out of the hull (skin)., Strain and let the juice set. Add 2 cups of juice with every 2 cups juice and add 3 cups sugar. Stir and put on stove., Cook until it comes to a rolling boil. Stir until sugar dissolves., Pour in glass jars and seal., Let set until jelly becomes jelly.

title: Breakfast Casserole(Easy And Quick)
directions: Tear up bread and place pieces in greased baking dish (13 x 9 x 3-inch)., Brown and drain sausage in skillet., Drain off fat. Spoon meat over bread., Sprinkle with cheese., Beat together eggs, milk, salt and pepper., Pour over mixture in baking dish., Bake in preheated 350° oven for 35 to 40 minutes., Cheese will rise to top during baking., Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Tender Brisket
directions: You also need a cooking bag.

title: Chowder Parmesan
directions: Add all of this to 2 cups boiling water; simmer until tender.

title: Hot Tamales
directions: Soak corn shucks in hot water for about an hour or more; the longer, the better., Boil the meat until tender; save the liquid broth., Chop the meat real good., On the stove, put a frying pan with a little Crisco., Put the chopped pork in and brown a little. Add garlic salt, cumin and a small amount of chili powder., Pour a little broth in and stir and cook for 10 minutes.

title: Potato Soup
directions: Saute leeks and parsley in a saucepan with butter., In a large saucepan, place potatoes, sauteed leeks and parsley and add enough water to cover., Bring to a boil., Add salt., Reduce heat and simmer until potatoes are cooked., Put entire mixture through a sieve or puree in an electric blender., Return to a saucepan and add milk., Beat in egg yolks., Serve with a teaspoon of butter and croutons in each bowl.

title: Candy Nuts
directions: Combine sugar, cinnamon, milk and water., Cook on slow heat until it forms a soft ball. Pour out on waxed paper and separate.

title: Lemon Chicken
directions: Place chicken in square metal pan sprayed with Pam., Combine remaining ingredients., Pour mixture over chicken., Bake for 40 minutes at 400° (uncovered) or until done., Serve over egg noodles., Garnish with sliced lemons, if desired.

title: Potato Soup
directions: Combine first 6 ingredients and simmer until potatoes are tender., Add remaining ingredients and heat thoroughly.

title: Sloppy Joe Pie
directions: Heat oven to 375°., In large skillet, brown ground beef and onion; drain., Stir in tomato sauce, corn, water (optional) and seasoning mix., Heat mixture until hot and bubbly; reduce heat and simmer while preparing crust., Separate dough into 10 biscuits; flatten slightly., Dip each in milk; dip in cornmeal., Arrange 7 biscuits around sides and 3 in the bottom of 9-inch pie pan; press biscuits to form crust., Sprinkle crust with 1/2 cup of the cheese. Spoon hot meat mixture over cheese; sprinkle with remaining cheese., Bake at 375° for 20 to 25 minutes or until crust is deep golden brown., Let stand 5 minutes before serving., Makes 8 servings.

title: Rich And Thick Milk Shake
directions: Pour milk into electric blender container., Add pudding mix, ice cream and ice., Cover and blend at high speed for 1 minute. Serve at once., Makes about 5 cups.

title: Chocolate Sauce
directions: Melt chocolate over low heat; stir in sugar, milk, vanilla and mace., Mix well., Cook over low heat, stirring constantly until smooth and thickened., Excellent over pound cake, sponge cake, bread pudding or ice cream., Makes 2 1/2 cups.

title: Macaroni Salad
directions: Mix well and serve.

title: Chicken Old Mill
directions: Layer broccoli and chicken in baking pan., Heat soup, mayonnaise, milk and sherry., Pour over layers., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes., Sprinkle with cheese and paprika., Serve over rice. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Shipwreck
directions: Brown meat; then layer everything in a greased casserole in order given., Bake at 275° for 2 to 2 1/2 hours.

title: Marble Squares
directions: Blend the butter, vanilla, water and sugars., Beat in egg., Mix in flour mixture., Stir in 1/2 cup chopped nuts, if desired.

title: Creamy Waldorf Salad
directions: Combine cream cheese, sugar and juice in a small bowl; stir well and set mixture aside., Combine remaining ingredients., Add cream cheese mixture to apple mixture; toss gently., Cover and chill., Toss again before serving., Serve in lettuce lined bowl. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Clam Spaghetti
directions: Heat sauce to boiling and add drained clams to sauce; cook for a few minutes for flavor., Serve over cooked noodles.

title: Easy Stuffed Potato
directions: Split potatoes and wrap in tinfoil. Bake until done. Scoop out inside and mix with butter, cheese and bacon bits. Replace in shell and sprinkle with cheese. Broil until cheese melts.

title: Picadillo Tarts
directions: Cook ground chuck beef and onion in a skillet until meat is browned; drain well., Stir in almonds and the next 6 ingredients. Place 1 sheet of phyllo on a damp towel (keep remaining phyllo covered)., Lightly brush phyllo with melted butter., Top with another sheet and brush again with melted butter., Fold in half, placing long edges together to make a 17 x 6-inch rectangle., Cut into 10 equal portions using a sharp knife., Repeat procedure with remaining phyllo., Press each portion of phyllo into a lightly greased miniature muffin cup, forming a shell., Spoon about 1 teaspoon of the beef mixture into each shell., Cover with plastic wrap; refrigerate until ready to bake., Remove plastic wrap., Bake at 400° for 8 minutes, or until golden brown., Gently remove from pan; serve warm or at room temperature., Garnish with chopped parsley., Makes 50 appetizers.

title: Coconut Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Melt butter and mix all ingredients. Roll into balls and place on a greased cookie sheet., Bake at 350°., Makes about 4 dozen.

title: Chicken Enchilada Casserole
directions: Cut chicken into bite size pieces., Saute onion in butter in a large saucepan., Add soup, milk and green chiles and blend well on top of stove or in microwave at Medium., Roll tortillas with chicken and 1/2 the cheese and set side by side in casserole., Pour sauce over top., Work down in between., Sprinkle with cheese. Bake, uncovered, 30 to 40 minutes at 350° or microwave 20 minutes on High., Serves 8.

title: Apple Pie
directions: Mix first 7 ingredients together well., Put in unbaked 9-inch pie shell and cut margarine up and place all over top., Cover with strips., Bake in 425° oven., Check in 20 minutes and bake until done (heat may need to be lowered after 20 minutes).

title: Potato Dressing
directions: Cook onion and celery in butter until tender., Combine with potatoes, bread crumbs, eggs, parsley and seasonings., Mix thoroughly., Bake at 375° for 45 minutes in covered dish.

title: Luscious Flan(Pleases Eye As Well As Palate)
directions: Sprinkle 1/4 cup sugar in a heavy saucepan; put over medium heat., Cook, stirring constantly, until sugar melts and syrup is light golden brown., Pour syrup into six 6-ounce custard cups., Let cool.

title: Zucchini Appetizer
directions: Mix all ingredients and pour in a well-greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 45 to 55 minutes., Top should be golden., Cool on a rack and cut into squares.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
directions: Boil chicken breasts, set aside., Boil mixed vegetables and drain., In a bowl mix vegetables, soups and deboned chicken with 1 cup of reserved chicken broth., Pour in casserole dish.

title: Quick Peach Cobbler
directions: Melt butter in a 9 x 13-inch pan., Combine flour, 1 cup sugar and milk., Mix well., Pour over melted butter., Do not stir. Combine peaches and remaining 1 cup sugar in saucepan; bring to a boil., Pour over batter; do not stir., Bake at 375° for 30 minutes or until browned., Yield: Approximately 10 servings.

title: Rufus'S Vegetable Stew
directions: Cook meat in large saucepan until tender and add the vegetables and cook until done.

title: Pumpkin Roll
directions: Grease 15 x 10-inch pan., Line with wax paper and grease. Beat eggs 5 minutes., Add gradually sugar, then pumpkin., Add flour, salt, baking powder and cinnamon., Pour into pan; sprinkle with nuts., Bake at 375° for 15 minutes., Take it out of the oven and turn over onto a towel with 10x sugar sprinkled on it., Roll long ways; let cool 1 1/2 hours., Roll out and spread with filling (recipe follows)., May be frozen or refrigerated.

title: Cream Cheese Pecan Frosting
directions: Mix powdered sugar, softened cream cheese, softened margarine, salt and milk until smooth., Add pecans and coconut., Spread over cake layers.

title: Cinnamon Pickles
directions: Mix lime, and, water, together and pour over cucumbers; let stand 24 hours., Add enough water to cover pickles., Wash, drain and put in fresh, cool water for 3 hours; drain., Simmer alum, 1 cup, vinegar,, red, color, and, enough, water to cover cucumbers; simmer 2, hours,, then drain., Make syrup of 3 cups vinegar, sugar,, red, hots,, 3, cups, water, salt and cinnamon sticks; boil for 5 minutes,, then, pour, over cukes., Pour off syrup for 4 mornings;, bring, to boil and pour over cucumbers. On fourth morning, pack in jars., Cover with boiling syrup and seal.

title: Chewy Coconut Macaroons
directions: In large mixer bowl, beat egg whites until soft mounds form. Gradually add 1/4 cup sugar and beat until stiff peaks form., Fold in 1 cup sugar and remaining ingredients carefully, half at a time, until thoroughly blended.

title: Garlic Pasta Chicken
directions: In large skillet, generously cover bottom with olive oil. Saute garlic salt and fresh garlic., Add chopped chicken., Cook, stirring, 15 minutes., Add chopped red pepper., Stir and cook 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Orange Delight
directions: Mix together tapioca pudding, vanilla pudding, orange extract and the 3 cups of water., Let stand for 10 minutes so tapioca gets soft., Cook until thick., Boil for 1 minute., Cool., Add Cool Whip, pineapple and oranges., Stir until blended good. Refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Marinated Carrots
directions: In a large bowl, combine ingredients., Blend together and chill (can be made ahead).

title: Graham Cracker Cookies
directions: Spread graham crackers in cookie pan., Mix margarine, brown sugar and pecans in a saucepan., Bring to a boil., Pour over crackers., Cook on broil 2 to 3 minutes., Topping will look bubbly.

title: Speedy Taco Bake
directions: Cook beef and onion until done. Spoon into baking dish., Stir in taco mix, tomato sauce and corn., Sprinkle on cheese.

title: Cold Oven Pound Cake
directions: Sift flour, measure and sift two times., Cream margarine and Crisco., Add sugar and cream well., Add eggs, one at a time, beating after each., Add flour and milk alternately., Begin with flour and end with flour., Add flavoring., Beat at slow speed. Bake in greased tube pan at 325° for 1 hour and 15 minutes., Start in cold oven., This does not use baking powder., May use 2 teaspoons vanilla instead of almond.

title: Spanish Spaghetti
directions: Heat oil; add onions and green peppers., Cook until soft., Add ground beef, salt, black pepper and chili pepper., Cook until browned., Add tomato sauce, tomato paste and 4 cups tomatoes and 1 teaspoon sugar., Cook together 15 minutes on medium heat., Break spaghetti into pieces and cook according to directions on package. Do not overcook., Drain and add to sauce mix and put into casserole., Put into oven at 350° for 20 minutes.

title: Betty Bowen'S Noodles And Cabbage
directions: Fry cabbage "slowly" in 1 stick butter (should take about 1 hour on low). Be careful not to burn, light brown is okay., While cabbage is cooking, make noodles.

title: Pork Chop Casserole
directions: Season pork chops with salt and pepper., Brown on both sides in a skillet., In a 9 x 13-inch pan, layer the vegetables and pour soup over., Remove chops from pan, remove fat from skillet and add water to rinse and scrape particles from bottom of skillet., Pour this over vegetables., Sprinkle with thyme., Place chops on top. Bake 1 hour at 350°., If chops get too brown during cooking, cover with glass lid or foil.

title: Chili Dip
directions: Soften cream cheese., Add chili and mix well., Heat in microwave or on stove., Serve with corn chips.

title: Tuna Casserole
directions: Cook noodles in boiling water until tender; drain., Combine noodles, drained tuna, mayonnaise, vegetables and salt., Add soup, milk and cheese., Bake at 425° about 20 minutes.

title: Butterscotch Refrigerator Cookies
directions: Cream sugar and margarine., Beat in eggs and vanilla., Sift remaining ingredients together and blend into mixture., Form into rolls; wrap in waxed paper., Refrigerate overnight., Slice and bake at 350° for 8 to 12 minutes.

title: Reuben Sandwich
directions: Combine kraut, onion and parsley; toss until well mixed. Spread dressing on each slice of bread., Top 8 slices of bread with corned beef, cheese and kraut mixture; top with remaining bread., Lightly butter both sides of sandwiches., Grill slowly until cheese melts and bread browns.

title: Chicken Soup With Meatballs
directions: Bring chicken broth and water to boil., Add pasta and cook 5 minutes., Add spinach and simmer 5 minutes longer., Mix the ground meat, cheese and garlic and drop from teaspoon into soup., Simmer 7 minutes until no longer pink inside., Stir in 3 cups of vegetables and simmer until done (onion, carrots, celery, zucchini).

title: Banana Split
directions: Blend the first 4 ingredients 5 minutes in mixer., Spread over crumbs made of graham cracker crumbs and melted butter., Mix and pat in a 9 x 13-inch pan., Refrigerate., Cut 5 bananas in 1/2 pieces., Layer in pan., Next, layer pineapple., Spread with Cool Whip., Garnish with coconut, maraschino cherries and chopped nuts. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Tuna Salad Mold
directions: Heat soup and water to boiling point., Add Jell-O., When mixture is partly set, add remaining ingredients., Pour into molds. Chill until set., Makes 8 molds.

title: Old-Fashioned Creamed Corn
directions: Remove husks and silks from corn., Rinse corn and pat dry., Cut corn from cobs (about 3 cups); to cut corn from cob:, with very sharp knife, first cut, just barely take the top of the kernels, second cut, take about half-way of kernels and third cut, use blade of knife and scrape down to cob., This gets the milk out of corn. Place butter in 2-quart casserole; microwave at High for 55 seconds, until butter melts., Add corn, 1/4 cup water and sugar, stirring well., Cover with heavy-duty plastic wrap., Cook on High 8 to 9 minutes or until corn is tender, stirring after 4 minutes. Shake 1/2 cup water, salt, pepper and flour in pan until flour is blended smooth., Stir into corn, mixing well., Cook on High 3 minutes or until mixture slightly thickens.

title: Tartar Sauce
directions: Mix all ingredients together and let set till dry onions are limp and no longer crunchy. Use for fish topping or anything else you like to use tartar sauce on.

title: Picadio
directions: Brown and drain beef. Add onion, tomatoes, garlic, vinegar, oil, cinnamon, cloves, salt, raisins with stock and green olives. Simmer for 30 minutes.

title: Slush . . . . Slush
directions: Mix and put in freezer.

title: Corn Pone
directions: Blend sugar and Crisco., Add egg which was beaten slightly to sugar and Crisco., Add sour milk., Sift together soda, cornmeal, flour and salt., Stir into mixture., Pour into a greased pan and bake for 25 minutes at 350°.

title: Pineapple Spoon Bread
directions: Cream butter and sugar; add eggs then cream again., Add bread and pineapple including juice from can., Pour into buttered dish and bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Stuffed Eggplant
directions: Halve eggplant lengthwise., Hollow out center., Cook sausage; drain., In a large bowl, mix sausage, eggplant centers, tomatoes, squash, onion, salt and pepper., Mix well., Stuff into eggplant shells., Spoon 4 tablespoons of tomato sauce over each., Mix bread crumbs, oregano, egg and remaining tomato sauce., Spoon over eggplant., Cover with cheese., Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours. Serves 6.

title: Cream Of Broccoli Soup
directions: Combine all ingredients in a 2-quart pan or slow cooker. Simmer for 45 minutes., Add more milk, if needed., Add salt to taste., Serves 6 to 8.

title: Coconut Meringue Cookies
directions: Beat egg whites until foamy, white and double in volume in a medium bowl., Beat in sugar, 1 tablespoon at a time, beating all the time until meringue stands in firm peaks., Fold in vanilla and coconut., Drop by teaspoon, 2 inches apart, on greased and floured large sheets., Bake in very slow oven (250°) for 35 minutes or until lightly golden., Remove from sheet to wire racks., Let stand to cool completely.

title: Williamsburg Salad(Serves 12)
directions: Soften gelatine in cold water., Add sugar, pineapple juice, vinegar, salt and green coloring., Chill until slightly thickened, then add pecan meats, India relish, pineapple and olives., Pour into molds or a flat serving dish which has been rubbed with oil. Chill until firm and serve., Unusual!

title: Fresh Apple Cake
directions: Combine sugar, flour, salt, soda, baking powder,, cinnamon and Wesson oil., Beat 2 minutes., Add eggs and vanilla and beat 2 more minutes., Fold in apples and nuts., Bake in a tube cake pan for 45 to 50 minutes in a 350° oven.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Combine, mushroom, soup, and, 1 cup of broth and put in bottom of	pan., Add, half, of, stuffing, on top of soup.	Add chicken on	top of stuffing., Put chicken soup with other cup of, broth on chicken., Add the remaining stuffing on top., You can, use frozen broccoli, if desired, on top of chicken., Bake with aluminum foil on pan at 350° for 50 minutes., Serve.

title: Zucchini Bread
directions: Sift together flour, salt, soda, cinnamon, allspice, nutmeg, cloves and baking powder., Beat eggs until light and foamy., Add oil, sugar, zucchini and vanilla., Mix light, but well., Add dry ingredients., Divide into 3 loaf pans, greased., Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until done.

title: Squash Casserole
directions: Cook squash and onion together., Drain; mash well., Drain again., Melt margarine in 9-inch baking dish., Pour melted margarine into squash., Mix all ingredients well except cracker crumbs., Pour in casserole dish., Top with cracker crumbs., Bake at 350° for 25 minutes or until firm and top is brown.

title: Pear Relish
directions: Grind pears, peppers and onions in food chopper or processor. Add all the ingredients to the vinegar and sugar., Boil 30 minutes., Put in jars and seal.

title: Chocolate Chip Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients except the chocolate bits and beat for 3 minutes., Fold in bits and pour into a greased and floured Bundt pan., Bake at 325°., After 1 hour check with cake tester., Bake until batter does not stick to tester., Cool 10 minutes before removing from pan.

title: O'Charley'S Loaded Potato Soup
directions: Bring water to a boil in large pot. Add potatoes to water along with chicken stock base, salt and pepper. Cook 12 minutes or until potatoes are about half-done. Add Cheddar cheese soup and simmer 10 minutes. Melt butter or margarine in a heavy saucepan. Add flour and cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, for 3 to 4 minutes. Do not brown. Whisk flour mixture into the potato mixture and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer an additional 3 to 4 minutes. Stir in half and half and heat to serving temperature. Do not boil. Serve with chives, bacon bits and parsley.

title: Fran'S Easy Cobbler
directions: Defrost pie crust. Butter 1 large baking pan., Line bottom and sides of pan with two of the pie crusts., Pour peaches into bowl. Mix all ingredients., Squash peaches and mix until flour is mixed well., Pour into pan and cut the two crusts you have left into strips. Cover top and bake at 375° for 45 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Highland Griddle Scones
directions: Sift together flour, baking powder, salt and sugar into mixing bowl., Cut in Crisco thoroughly, until particles are fine. Break egg into measuring cup; add enough milk to measure 3/4 cup. Blend together., Add all at once to flour mixture; stir just until moist.

title: Easy Chili
directions: Brown meat; drain., Add spices and simmer 5 to 10 minutes. Then add tomatoes, V-8 and rice., Cook until rice is done., You may add more V-8, if desired.

title: Cashew Drop Cookies
directions: Cream butter and sugar until fluffy., Add egg and vanilla; mix thoroughly., Add dry ingredients which have been sifted together alternately with sour cream., Blend well., Fold in nuts., Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls onto greased cookie sheet., Bake 8 to 10 minutes at 400°., Cool and top with golden butter glaze.

title: Strawberry Pie
directions: Cook 7-Up,, sugar and cornstarch until thick and clear. Cool, then pour over strawberries., Serve with Cool Whip.

title: Macaroni And Cheese
directions: Mix all together; put in crock-pot., Cook for 2 or 3 hours. Great to take for carry-ins.

title: Decorating Dough
directions: Mix flour and salt in a large bowl., Slowly add water., Form ball., Knead dough for 5 to 10 minutes., Add flour (if sticky) and water (if stiff)., May refrigerate dough up to 5 days., Make ornaments, crafts, etc.

title: Egg Rolls
directions: Brown onion in butter., Add chicken, carrots, bean sprouts, corn and seasonings., Cook on simmer 10 to 15 minutes., Cool completely., Wrap 2 tablespoonfuls of mixture in each egg roll skin and seal edges., Place in deep fryer until browned.

title: Cream Cheese Dessert
directions: Melt margarine and mix with other ingredients and press into a 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Baked Potato Casserole
directions: Combine the first 5 ingredients., Place in 9 x 13-inch pan and top with bacon., Bake at 350° for 1/2 hour to 45 minutes.

title: Crab Bisque
directions: Drain crabmeat, and remove any bits of shell., Set aside.

title: French Omelet
directions: Separate yolks from whites., Beat whites until light; add salt and beat until stiff and dry., Beat egg yolks until thick and lemon colored; add milk and pepper., Fold egg whites and baking powder into the yolks., Melt butter in frying pan; pour in egg mixture and heat slowly until omelet has set., Put in a 325° oven for 30 minutes, or until omelet browns on top., Serve immediately with Spanish sauce., Yield:, 5 servings.

title: Venison Roast
directions: Combine first 10 ingredients., Place in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan., Add meat., Spoon remaining mixture over roast. Combine water and wine., Pour over roast., Cover and marinate for 2 days in refrigerator, turning occasionally., Bake at 300° for 2 1/2 to 3 hours or until tender, basting occasionally with pan drippings., Yield: 8 servings.

title: Cranberry Salad
directions: In pan bring 1 cup pineapple juice to boil., Take off heat and add Jell-O., Mix real good, then add Sprite., Mix pineapple, cranberries and pecans., Mix and pour into 9 x 13-inch casserole dish., Chill until set.

title: Pickled Peaches
directions: Stew peaches with 2 or 3 cloves., Simmer other ingredients 3 to 4 minutes., Pour over peaches., Store in refrigerator.

title: Vegetable Pizza
directions: Roll out crescent rolls and press in jelly roll pan, pressing seams together., Bake for 10 minutes at 375°., Let cool., Mix cream cheese, mayonnaise and Ranch mix; spread on cooled crescent crust., Add vegetables, making sure you press them into the cream cheese mixture., Top with grated cheese., Refrigerate overnight.

title: Sloppy Jewels
directions: Cook and drain beef., Saute onions, pepper and garlic for 5 minutes., Add remaining ingredients., Cook 15 minutes., Serve on rolls.

title: Mustard Sauce
directions: Mix sugar, mustard, cornstarch and a pinch of salt in a heavy saucepan. Add egg yolk and mix well., Heat coffee cream to near boil. Add to egg mixture and mix well., Place over medium heat and stir until thick., Slowly add vinegar, beating constantly. Serve warm over meat.

title: Shrimp Creole
directions: Cook and stir onion in butter until onion is tender., Stir in remaining ingredients except shrimp, rice, flour and water., Cook until pepper and celery are tender., Add flour, shrimp and last of all water., Cook over low heat until shrimp are tender., Serve over rice.

title: *Little Jewels Salad
directions: Mix lime jello with 1 cup of hot water and 1/2 cup of cold water., Put into pan to set., Do the same with the cherry and orange jellos., Chill in the refrigerator., Mix sugar, pineapple juice and 1/4 cup water in saucepan; let come to a boil., Mix with lemon jello., Let set on counter until it jells., Mix the Dream Whip and milk., When thoroughly whipped, add lemon jello mixture. Cut lime, cherry and orange jellos into small cubes., Fold into whipped mixture and refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Weight Watchers Soup
directions: Use broth from chicken., Throw in chicken and other ingredients., Cook until thick.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Season to taste., Bake at 375° for approximately 45 minutes.

title: Congealed Salad
directions: Pour hot water over Jell-O; add pineapple juice and while still warm., Add marshmallows and cheese., When cool, add pineapple and nuts., When it begins to thicken and congeal, fold in whipped cream., Chill.

title: Jessie'S Front Flip Fudge
directions: Prepare pan by buttering bottom and sides of 9-inch square pan., Dice marshmallows., Set aside., Mix evaporated milk, sugar and salt in saucepan., Heat mixture over low heat until it just boils, then cook for 5 minutes, stirring constantly with wooden spoon., Remove from heat., Stir in marshmallows, chocolate chips, nuts and vanilla., Stir until marshmallows melt., Pour in pan. Cool., Cut in squares.

title: Cheese Soup
directions: Melt, oleo in soup pot., Add onion, carrots and celery. Saute until, soft., Add, flour, and, cornstarch.	Cook, until bubbly. Add broth and milk and make a smooth sauce., Add soda and cheese. Garnish with parsley before serving.

title: Stir Crazy Cake
directions: Put flour, 1 1/2 cups sugar, cocoa, soda and salt into an ungreased 13 x 9 x 2-inch metal baking pan., Stir with a fork to mix., Form 3 wells in the flour mixture. Pour oil into one well, vinegar in the second and vanilla in the third., Pour cold coffee over all ingredients and stir with fork until well mixed., Do not beat., Combine remaining sugar and cinnamon and sprinkle over batter., Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Pixie Pound Cake
directions: Cream the Crisco, butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Add eggs, one at a time; beat well., Sift flour, salt and baking powder., Add to creamed mixture alternately with milk., Add vanilla and lemon flavoring; beat well., Bake in a tube pan at 325° for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Black Bottom Cupcakes
directions: Combine cream cheese, egg and salt., Beat until smooth., Add chocolate and butterscotch chips; set aside., Mix flour, soda, salt, cocoa and sugar., Add oil, vanilla and water., Beat together until smooth.

title: Chocolate Cake And Icing
directions: Combine first 4 ingredients., Bring butter, water, shortening and cocoa to boil., Pour over flour mixture and mix well., Add eggs, buttermilk and vanilla., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes in a 13 x 9-inch pan.

title: Macaroni Salad
directions: Cook macaroni. Drain and rinse in cold water., Add tuna, peas, onions, cheese and salt to taste., Blend in enough mayo to make creamy.

title: Pizza Cups
directions: Saute onion in oil until tender., Add ground beef., Cook until brown, stirring until crumbly., Add tomato sauce and seasonings; mix well., Simmer for 3 to 5 minutes or until heated through.

title: Salmon Salad
directions: Cook macaroni., Drain., Chop eggs., Mix mayonnaise and Ranch dressing. Mix all ingredients with macaroni., Chill in refrigerator or serve warm., Serve with Ritz crackers.

title: Chicken-Rice Twosome
directions: Coat chicken with flour, onion powder, paprika and pepper., In skillet, brown chicken in hot margarine., In a small saucepan, heat water and bouillon cubes until dissolved., Stir in sherry., In bottom of a 1 1/2-quart casserole, combine water mixture, rice, mushrooms, celery and onion., Place chicken on top., Cover and bake at 375° for 50 to 60 minutes or until all liquid is absorbed and chicken is tender., Makes 2 servings.

title: Chicken And Stuffing Scallop
directions: Prepare stuffing according to package directions., Spread in 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish., Top with layer of chicken., In large saucepan melt butter., Blend flour and seasonings., Add cool broth., Cook and stir until mixture thickens., Stir small amount of mixture into eggs., Return to hot mix., Pour over chicken. Bake at 325° for 40 to 45 minutes., Let stand 5 minutes to set. Cut in squares to serve with pimento mushroom sauce., Serves 12.

title: Fluffy Pink Salad
directions: Mix together and chill.

title: Calico Bean Pot
directions: Combine all ingredients in crock pot and cook on high for at least 4-6 hours.

title: Pineapple Coconut Pie(2 Pies)
directions: Beat eggs until foamy., Add other ingredients., Pour into unbaked pie shells., Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Banana Cake
directions: Cream sugar, shortening and eggs until light and fluffy. Combine dry ingredients, then add alternately with milk, beating well., Beat in bananas and vanilla., Pour in greased and floured pan (9 x 13 x 2-inches)., Bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Tasty Taco Pie
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., Brown meat. Drain., Stir in tomato sauce and seasoning mix., Simmer 5 minutes. Unroll dough., Press onto bottom and sides of ungreased 12-inch pizza pan., Prick bottom and sides with fork., Bake 10 to 12 minutes or until golden brown. Cover crust with meat mixture and cheese., Continue baking until cheese begins to melt., Top with remaining ingredients. Serve with sour cream, if desired., Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Lib'S Crab Appetizer
directions: Spread cream cheese on bottom of a platter., Cover with the chopped onions., Sprinkle Worcestershire sauce over the onions. Mix ketchup, horseradish and Tabasco and spoon over the layered ingredients., Top with the crab., Sprinkle a little lemon juice over crab., Finish off with chopped parsley., Serve with crackers. Delicious!!

title: Mini Blintzes
directions: Mix the cream cheese, sugar and yolks together., Cut crusts from the bread and roll, the bread thin., Spread the slices with the cream cheese mixture., Roll up bread., Dip each in melted oleo, then roll in the cinnamon and sugar mixture., Bake for 10 - 15 minutes at 400 degrees., Cut in half., Serve plain or with sour cream., You can freeze these to cook later.

title: Frozen Champagne Salad
directions: Soften and blend cream cheese with sugar., Mix together drained pineapple, strawberries with juice, bananas, nuts and whipped topping., Combine 2 mixtures., Put in a 9 x 13-inch pan and freeze.

title: Rhubarb-Cherry Pie
directions: Combine all ingredients., Let stand 15 minutes., Line 9-inch pie plate with pastry., Add filling., Add top crust., Flute edges., Bake at 400° for 40 to 50 minutes., Serve warm.

title: Chicken And Dressing Casserole
directions: Shred cooked chicken breasts in a baking dish., Saute onions and celery., Mix celery soup, chicken soup, celery and onions. Pour on top of chicken., Mix Stove Top stuffing according to package directions., Top chicken mixture., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Cheese Cake
directions: Beat cream cheese until fluffy. Add vanilla, lemon juice and condensed milk and mix., Pour into graham cracker crust. Chill 2 hours.

title: Sweet-Treat Fried Ice Cream
directions: With scoop, form 6 ice cream balls., Place on wax paper-covered tray; cover and freeze several hours or until very firm.

title: Marsha'S Casserole
directions: Cook hamburger meat and drain., Add spaghetti sauce, sugar and mushroom soup., Cook for 10 minutes on medium., Pour in casserole dish cooked noodles and sauce., Then put cheese all in the casserole., Cut in 1-inch strips., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until cheese is melted.

title: Olive Macaroni Salad
directions: Cook macaroni according to package directions; drain., Mix with remaining ingredients and chill., Serves 8 to 10.

title: Ambrosia Salad
directions: Drain fruit cocktail, oranges and cherries., In a large bowl, mix fruit cocktail, oranges and cherries., Add sour cream, chopped walnuts, marshmallows and coconut., Mix until all is blended. Place in another dish., Cool in refrigerator for 2 hours and serve.

title: Chile Cheese Casserole
directions: Beat eggs; add salt and pepper to taste and a pinch of garlic. Open chilies and clean seeds from them., Spread in the bottom of well buttered 8 x 8-inch Pyrex baking dish, alternating cheese and chilies in layers., Pour eggs over and bake 40 minutes at 350°. Cut into one-inch squares or smaller.

title: Watergate Salad
directions: Mix pudding and pineapple well. Add remaining ingredients. Mix. Refrigerate.

title: Puppy Chow
directions: Melt chocolate chips in microwave; stir., Mix in all of peanut butter., Mix in all of Crispix., Make sure Crispix is covered with first mixture., Pour enough powdered sugar into a bag; add cereal. Shake well., Place in a covered container.

title: Fried Chicken
directions: Season chicken with salt, pepper and paprika., Combine egg and milk., Dip chicken in egg mixture., Drop into paper bag with flour., Shake to coat., Place in hot oil in heavy deep skillet. Cover., Fry at 350° to 400° until brown., Serves 4.

title: Stuffed Peppers
directions: Mix ground beef, rice and onion together., Stuff it inside peppers., Pour jar of spaghetti sauce in pan., Add 1/2 jar of water., Add peppers and cook at medium heat for 2 to 3 hours.

title: Easy Pineapple Cake Frosting
directions: Mix the pineapple with juice into the dry pudding mix., Stir until pudding mix dissolves., Stir in nondairy topping., Spread between and on the outside of your cake layers., Refrigerate cake after icing., Yields enough to frost 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan cake or 2 layers., Use white or yellow cake mix.

title: B~B~Q Sauce
directions: Simmer 15 to 20 minutes. Makes 1 qt.

title: Vegetable Shira-Ae
directions: Place tofu on paper towel, changing paper towel until most of water has drained out., Put tofu in bowl and mash with fork or potato masher., Grind roasted sesame seed and add with rest of ingredients to tofu., Mix well., Use as dressing on boiled vegetables., Serves 4 to 6.

title: Rice Krispies Treats
directions: Spray saucepan and cooking pan., Melt margarine over low heat in large saucepan., Add marshmallows; stir until melted., Remove from heat., Add cereal; stir until coated., Use buttered spatula to press mixture into baking sheet., Remove from sheet and add decorations (decorations optional).

title: No Knead Refrigerator Rolls
directions: Dissolve yeast in 1/2 cup water., Measure sugar, salt and shortening; add 1 1/2 cups warm water in a large bowl., Beat in yeast and eggs., Add 2 cups flour and beat until smooth., Stir in enough flour to make soft dough and mix well., Place in a greased bowl; cover and let rise until doubled (about 1 1/2 hours)., Punch down, cover tightly and refrigerate., (Dough keeps 3 to 4 days.) Remove dough from refrigerator., Shape rolls., Let rise until doubled (about 45 minutes)., Bake in a preheated 400° oven for 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown., Brush top with butter., Makes 24 servings.

title: 10 Day Cole Slaw
directions: Boil sugar, oil, salt, dried mustard and celery seed for 5 minutes., Pour over cabbage, onions and green pepper., Let cool; mix and refrigerate., This will keep at least 10, days.

title: Chili
directions: Brown meat and leave juice in meat., Add diced onion and pepper., Let simmer 5 to 10 minutes, then add remaining ingredients, preferably tomatoes first., Also, add 1 cup of water. Cook for about 2 hours and remove lid for the last 45 minutes for thicker chili.

title: Blueberry Oatmeal Muffins
directions: Fold together blueberries and 2 tablespoons flour., Set aside. Mix remaining ingredients and add floured blueberries., Put into muffin cups (may use liners and put 1/2 cup mixture into each). Bake at 400° for 20 minutes.

title: Potato Soup
directions: Cook potatoes, and onion in enough water to cover, with salt and pepper, until, almost done. Add milk and butter. Cook until done, stirring, often. Can be thickened with cornstarch, if desired.

title: Roasted Potato Salad
directions: Heat oven to 425°., Place potatoes on a 15 x 10 x 1-inch baking pan sprayed with nonstick cooking spray., Bake 30 to 35 minutes or until potatoes are tender and golden brown, stirring once.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients but stuffing and nuts., Empty into a greased 8 x 12-inch baking dish., Sprinkle with stuffing and nuts. You may drizzle top with melted margarine., Bake at 350° for approximately 1 hour.

title: Very Good And Easy Zucchini Cheese Quiche
directions: Beat eggs until foamy., Add cheese, zucchini, Bisquick and margarine., Mix thoroughly., Mix soda, baking powder and milk and pour into zucchini mixture., Mix well and pour into buttered, 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

title: Maple Nut Chiffon Cake
directions: Sift flour, sugar, baking powder and salt into bowl., Make a well and add Wesson oil, egg yolks, water and maple flavoring. Beat until smooth with electric mixer using medium speed for one minute., In a large bowl, add cream of tartar to egg whites., Beat with electric mixer until whites form very stiff peaks on high speed for 3 to 5 minutes., Do not underbeat., Pour egg yolk mixture gradually over beaten egg whites, gently folding with rubber spatula, just until blended., Add nuts., Do not stir., Pour into ungreased 10 x 4-inch tube pan., Bake 55 minutes at 325°, then increase to 350° for 10 to 15 minutes longer or until top springs back when lightly touched., Turn pan upside-down and cool., Let hang until cold., Remove and frost with the following.

title: Punch Bowl Chocolate Mousse Cake
directions: Punch holes in cake and pour Amaretto over; let set., Layer: Crumbled cake, mousse, whipped cream and Heath bars., Make several layers with all ingredients.

title: Coca-Cola Cake
directions: Combine all ingredients except Coca-Cola and marshmallows in large bowl; blend at low speed., Beat one minute at medium speed; add Coca-Cola and blend well by hand., Stir in marshmallows., Pour batter into a greased 13 x 9-inch pan., Bake 35 to 40 minutes at 350°.

title: Hungarian Goulash
directions: In a large frypan, flour beef with 1/2 cup flour; add onions and oil and brown., Stir in paprika, marjoram, pepper, green pepper, garlic, tomatoes and 1 cup of water., Bring to a boil. Reduce heat to simmer., Cook approximately 90 minutes or until meat is tender.

title: Fettucini Alfredo
directions: Melt butter in heavy skillet over low heat., Add chopped onion and saute until onion is transparent., Stir in whipping cream. Mix well., Now, stir in Parmesan cheese., When this is mixed well, add cooked peas., Continue to cook over low heat for 3 to 5 minutes., Serve over fettucini noodles., You can use broccoli, shrimp, etc. instead of peas.

title: Sweet Potato Biscuits
directions: Mix the flour, buttermilk and oil together in a bowl until mixture becomes a dough., Sprinkle occasionally with flour as you knead this a few times., In another bowl, mix the sugar and sweet potatoes together., Press dough in the center and add sweet potatoes to this., Begin kneading the dough until well mixed. Roll or pat out to desired thickness., Cut biscuits., Bake in oven oven at 450° for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Heavenly Hash
directions: Mix softened cream cheese and Cool Whip., Mix the drained fruits and mix all ingredients together., Garnish, if desired, with halved cherries., Store in refrigerator.

title: Pepparkokar(Swedish Christmas Cookies)
directions: Mix butter, sugar, egg and molasses together in mixer., Add flour, soda and spices., Chill dough in refrigerator; roll thin and bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes., (Dough may also be shaped into "logs", frozen and sliced from ends; not as pretty, but much easier!)

title: Chocolate Brittal Chip Cookies
directions: Mix dry ingredients in a bowl., Add butter, vanilla and eggs. Mix again., While mixing, add chocolate chips and Bit-o-Brittal. Bake at 375° for 6 to 8 minutes.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Prepare chicken and let cool., Cook stuffing as directed on box., Do not cook peas or preheat gravy., Take glass baking dish and put either 1 box stuffing or a half of box to cover bottom. Layer chicken, then peas and stuffing., Pour gravy on top and heat until hot or warm., Serves 8.

title: Easy Coconut Pie
directions: Melt butter in saucepan, add coconut. Mix until coconut is coated with butter; add milk, eggs and sugar., Mix well., Place in unbaked pie shell., Bake in 350° oven until brown., Makes 2 pies.

title: Non-Alcoholic Punch
directions: Mix together the first 6 ingredients., Float orange slices on top. Add cherries.

title: Chocolate Dessert
directions: Crust:, Mix flour, sugar and oleo until crumbly and press into 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 15 minutes or until lightly brown.

title: Delicious Orange Cookies
directions: Cream shortening; add sugar, vanilla and orange rind., Add milk alternately with dry ingredients., Drop by teaspoons onto baking sheet., Bake at 375° for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Meat Loaf
directions: Mix together well; form into loaf and bake at 350° for 50 minutes.

title: Peach Salad
directions: Combine Jell-o, pineapple (juice included), 1 cup water and 2 Tbsp. sugar in saucepan. Dissolve Jell-o and cook until mixture comes to a boil. Set aside to cool completely.

title: Herb Roasted Potatoes
directions: Preheat oven to 425°., Cut potatoes in slices like French fries and place in large bowl with other ingredients., Toss well and place on a nonstick baking sheet and bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Guyanese Garlic Pork(Traditional Christmas Breakfast Dish)
directions: You will also need 2 large airtight glass jars (Mason jars ideal).

title: Quick Cinnamon Twist
directions: Pull each biscuit out to about 6-inches long., Dip in melted butter and roll in mixture of nuts, cinnamon and sugar., Bake in 425° oven for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Tomatoes Yemistess(Greece)
directions: Cook meat, butter and onion until browned in saucepan or electric skillet., Add parsley, almonds, cinnamon, salt and sugar. Simmer 5 minutes., Add rice., Cook over low heat 5 minutes. Hollow out tomatoes, reserving pulp and juice., Fill with rice mixture.

title: Salmon Croquettes
directions: Combine salmon, cracker crumbs, egg, onion, parsley and pepper., Blend well., Shape into patties., Fry over medium heat.

title: Yummy Pie
directions: Mix lemon juice and milk., Add fruit (drained) and fold in topping. Put in icebox until set, about 30 minutes.

title: Winter Soup
directions: Simmer ham and sausage in 3 1/2 quarts of water., Cook for 1 to 1 1/2 hours until tender., Remove ham and sausage and cut up. Return to water., Add remaining ingredients and simmer until vegetables are tender.

title: Persimmon Cake
directions: Cream together sugar and butter., Add egg and continue beating the egg., Add persimmon pulp., Sift together flour, soda and baking powder., Add to mixture., Pour into an 8 x 8-inch square pan which has been greased and floured., Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Old-Fashioned Sugar Cookies
directions: Cream butter thoroughly., Add sugar gradually and cream together until light and fluffy., Add eggs and flavorings., Sift dry ingredients together., Do this sifting 3 more times., Blend both mixtures together., Chill dough overnight., Roll dough out on floured cloth or board and cut in desired shapes., Bake on a greased cookie sheet at 400° for 5 to 6 minutes., Watch carefully to avoid burning., Yields 10 dozen round cookies 3 inches in diameter.

title: Heavenly Salad
directions: Blend sugar and cream cheese., Mix all other ingredients with sugar and cream cheese., Add the Cool Whip. Blend again. Spread all in buttered 9 x 13-inch pan and freeze., Will keep for a long time. Thaw 15 to 20 minutes before serving.

title: Spinach Pie
directions: Cook and drain spinach., Use either a 9 x 13-inch baking pan or a jelly roll pan/cookie sheet approximately 1 inch deep., Spray bottom of pan with Pam before you begin to layer sheets of filo dough., You will layer 10 to 12 sheets of filo dough, making sure you brush butter on top of each new sheet., Keep a damp cloth over the filo dough so it does not dry out., After you have layered your last sheet of dough, spread your cheese/spinach mixture., Now begin laying the next 10 to 12 sheets of filo dough, again brushing butter on top of each sheet., Be sure to cut off excess dough and score or cut into squares before baking., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes., Cheese/spinach mixture:, Mix together the eggs, drained spinach, cheese, salt, pepper, dill, garlic and onion.

title: Self-Filled Cupcakes
directions: Mix cake according to directions., Cream the cream cheese with sugar., Beat in egg., Stir in chocolate chips., Drop 1 rounded teaspoonful of mixture in each cupcake paper., Top with cake batter., Bake as directed on cake box.

title: Punch
directions: Mix Kool-Aid according to package directions. Combine Kool-Aid and pineapple juice., Just before serving, add ginger ale and mix well.

title: Two Minute Chocolate Fudge
directions: Combine all ingredients except vanilla and nuts in large glass bowl., Microwave for 2 minutes on High power., Blend in vanilla and nuts., Pour into greased dish and chill.

title: Icebox Delite
directions: Heat oven to 325°., Cream together eggs, margarine and sugars; sift together flour, soda and cream of tartar., Mix into cream mixture., Form into rolls (logs)., Wrap in wax paper and refrigerate., Slice and bake in a moderate oven for 10 to 12 minutes., Bake on lightly greased pan.

title: Whoopie Pie Cake
directions: Beat several minutes and bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes in middle of oven., Grease, flour and line 9 1/2 x 13-inch cake pan with wax paper., After it is baked and cooled, lift cake out of pan onto oblong serving tray., Cut lengthwise through the middle. Lift carefully with both hands under top part., Put icing in the middle and replace the top.

title: Chinese Jello Salad
directions: Completely dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Combine cold water and ice cubes to make 1 cup. Add to gelatin; add soy sauce and lemon juice. Stir until ice is melted and gelatin is slightly thickened. Remove any unmelted ice. Add remaining ingredients and spoon into individual dishes or a bowl. Chill until set, at least 30 minutes. Makes 2 1/2 cups or 5 servings. Contains 25 calories per serving.

title: Parmesan Sauce
directions: Combine milk and margarine., Bring to a boil., Add cheese, seasonings and mushrooms; stir well.

title: Sweet And Sour Meatballs
directions: Combine first 7 ingredients and blend well., Shape into 1-inch meatballs., Combine remaining ingredients in medium saucepan and mix well., Add meatballs, stirring lightly to coat with sauce. Simmer about one hour, stirring occasionally., Makes 32 to 36 meatballs.

title: Tomato-Sherried Eggs
directions: Combine, first, 3, ingredients, with 1/2 teaspoon salt. Place in, a, buttered, 10, x 6 x 1 1/2-inch casserole., Form 8 wells in tomato mixture., Crack 1 egg into each well. Sprinkle with cheese and, remaining, 1/4 teaspoon salt. Bake in a preheated oven, at 375°, until eggs are set, about 10 to 15 minutes. Serve, with cooked, bacon, or sausage and toast or biscuits, if desired. Serves 4 to 8.

title: Zucchini Bread
directions: Combine oil, sugar, eggs and vanilla., Add zucchini and then sifted dry ingredients., Add nuts and raisins if desired., Bake 60 minutes at 350°., Yield:, with nuts and raisins, 2 regular or 6 small loaves., Without nuts and raisins, 2 medium or 3 small loaves.

title: Vidalia Onion Casserole(Serves 6)
directions: Melt butter; stir in flour, broth and evaporated milk., Stir constantly until mixture begins to thicken and is smooth., Stir cheese into sauce., Drain onions and add to sauce with salt and pepper., Pour into buttered 1 1/2-quart casserole dish., Cover with cracker crumbs., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Beef Stroganoff
directions: Fry beef and garlic gently and keep juice., Also add mushrooms and big onions., Mix ingredients and place in casserole.

title: Mom'S Muffins
directions: Mix all together and bake in muffin cups at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Low-Fat Chili
directions: Cook and stir hamburger, onion and garlic in 3-quart saucepan. Drain., Stir in tomatoes (with liquid), celery, chili powder, salt, sugar and Worcestershire sauce., Heat to boiling., Reduce heat, cover and simmer 1 hour., Stir in beans; heat to boiling. Reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, about 15 minutes. For thicker chili, continue simmering., Can be stored frozen for no longer than 4 months.

title: Sweet And Sour Chicken
directions: Mix together dressing, soup mix and preserves., Place chicken in baking dish., Pour mixture over chicken., Cover with foil and bake at 375° for 1 hour., Uncover and return to oven for 15 minutes., Serve over rice.

title: Chocolate Mint Creams
directions: Stir together flour and baking soda., In a medium saucepan, heat and stir brown sugar, margarine and water over low heat until butter is melted., Add chocolate pieces., Heat and stir until chocolate is melted., Pour into a large mixing bowl and let stand for 10 to 15 minutes or until cool.

title: Christmas Cookies
directions: Mix margarine, sugar and eggs, then dry ingredients, nuts and cherries., Roll in small rolls., Roll in waxed paper and store in refrigerator., Cut very thin and bake in 325° oven., This makes approximately 15 dozen.

title: Lorraine'S Apple Strudel
directions: Grease and flour a 9 x 13-inch pan., Mix dry ingredients and add margarine., Blend well., Add eggs and mix well., Spread all but one cup in the pan., Use a wet spoon and push in place., Place apples in rows on the dough, not too many (makes the dough soggy). Sprinkle with 1/2 cup sugar and 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon., Form the last dough and rub between hands over the apples., Bake at 350° until the apples are soft, about 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Evergreen Punch
directions: Mix and chill mixture., If using unsweetened Kool-Aid, use 4 packages to amount.

title: Ginger Soy Sauce
directions: In small 1-quart saucepan, combine a small amount of soy sauce and ginger to form a paste., Heat on low, simmer setting on range. Stir and gradually add soy sauce until mixture reaches a boil. Serve hot or cold., Makes 1/2 cup sauce.

title: Coffee Cake
directions: Melt butter., Cut biscuits into quarters., Mix all ingredients together., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes., If using pecans, put in oven last 10 minutes of baking time or they may burn!

title: Gingerbread
directions: Combine first 3 ingredients and heat., Mix next 7 ingredients in a large mixing bowl., Mix in sorghum mixture; beat 1 minute. Last, beat eggs., Put in mixture and continue to beat 1 minute. Bake in a greased 8-inch square baking dish at 300° approximately 20 minutes., Wonderful served warm with Cool Whip.

title: Layered Mexican Dip
directions: In a medium bowl, empty both cans of refried beans., You can add a package of taco seasoning., Whip with blender for 2 to 3 minutes., Spread into 9 x 13-inch casserole dish., Spread lettuce over beans., Pour salsa over lettuce evenly., Spread sour cream over salsa., Sprinkle green onions and black olives over sour cream., Top with Cheddar cheese., Chill for 1 hour., Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Broccoli Salad
directions: *If using Miracle Whip, add 1 tablespoon of sugar.

title: Beef Barley Soup
directions: In a Dutch oven or soup kettle, place soup bones, water, onion, bouillon, vinegar, salt, pepper and bay leaves., Slowly bring to boil; skim foam with slotted spoon., Reduce heat; cover and simmer for 3 to 4 hours., Discard bay leaves., Set bones aside to cool; remove meat from bones and dice., Skim fat from the broth surface. Add meat, carrots, celery, potatoes, barley, thyme and dill., Cover and cook for 1 hour or until barley and vegetables are tender. Serves 9.

title: Hot Pasta And Asparagus
directions: In a skillet, cook garlic, pepper flakes and hot pepper sauce in oil and butter for 2 minutes., Add asparagus, salt and pepper; saute until asparagus is crisp-tender, about 10 minutes., Add most Parmesan cheese; mix well., Pour over hot pasta and toss to coat. Sprinkle with a little more Parmesan., Serve immediately., Serves 6 to 8 main course or 10 to 15 side dish.

title: Half Hour Apple Butter
directions: Combine ingredients in heavy 1 1/2-quart saucepan., Bring to a boil; cook 30 minutes., Makes 1 1/4 cups.

title: Coke And Pie Cherry Salad
directions: Bring cherries, water and sugar to boil in saucepan., Add Jell-O and food coloring, then let cool., Add Coke, pineapple and nuts or celery., Chill as you would Jell-O.

title: Wonderful Roast
