directions: Place roast in heavy aluminum foil., Spread dry Lipton onion soup on top., Spoon cream of mushroom soup on top of the onion soup., Fold foil down to seal roast., Bake at 350° for 3 to 4 hours, until done.

title: 4 Cheese Pasta
directions: Cook pasta and drain., Brown meat and drain grease., Add tomatoes; cook, uncovered, until thickened., Stir in onions and cream cheese., Toss in remaining cheeses., Cook until cheeses melt. Serve with Italian bread.

title: Cindy'S Layered Salad
directions: First Layer: Tear lettuce in bite-sized pieces to cover bottom of dish.

title: Creamy Lemon Pie(Makes 8 Servings)
directions: Preheat oven to 325°., In medium bowl, beat egg yolks with condensed milk, lemon juice and food coloring., Pour into prepared pastry shell; bake 30 minutes., Cool., Chill., Spread with whipped cream; garnish as desired., Refrigerate leftovers., Preparation time is about 10 minutes.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Cook broccoli according to package directions and drain (no salt)., Combine eggs and cheese., Mix egg mixture with broccoli, soup and mayonnaise., Pour into casserole dish (lightly greased). Sprinkle crushed crackers on top and pour melted margarine on crackers., Bake for 25 to 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Cherry Jello
directions: Dissolve jello in 2 cups boiling water., Add undrained pineapple and pie filling., Chill until firm.

title: Oreo Delight
directions: Melt the butter., Crush all cookies., Set aside half for topping., Mix cookies and melted butter; press into pan., Mix the cream cheese, milk and pudding and beat on low speed., Pour over crust., Fold in Cool Whip and sprinkle remaining crumbs on top.

title: Stella'S Green Salad
directions: Mix the first 3 ingredients and set aside in refrigerator. Mix Dream Whip according to directions on package and fold into pudding mix.

title: 5 Can Casserole
directions: Combine chicken, milk, noodles and soups in a bowl; mix well. Spoon into greased casserole., Top with chips., Bake for 30 minutes in a 350° oven.

title: L.B.J. Mop Sauce For Barbecue Meats
directions: Make the bone stock; buy good stout beef soup bones from butcher shop and boil them., Add all other ingredients and let stand overnight before using., Makes about 6 quarts., Baste the meat frequently., As you use it, the flavor will improve from the smoke and grease from the barbecue., I freeze what's left in 1-quart plastic freezer containers.

title: Vegetable Pizza
directions: Press crescent roll dough onto a large cookie sheet and bake as directed on can for 7 to 8 minutes., Mix cream cheese, Miracle Whip and dressing mix and spread onto cooled crust., Chop vegetables and place on top., Top with shredded Cheddar cheese. Refrigerate.

title: Pistachio Salad
directions: Mix pudding with pineapple; add remaining ingredients and chill.

title: Swiss Steak
directions: Season both sides of steaks with garlic powder, pepper and salt., Heat 1 teaspoon butter in a 10-inch nonstick skillet over medium high heat until butter is foamy., Add 4 steaks and cook about 2 minutes per side until browned., Remove to plate., Repeat with remaining butter and steaks., Add remaining ingredients to skillet., Bring to boil, stirring to scrape up browned bits in bottom., Add steaks along with any accumulated juices., Reduce heat to low., Cover and simmer 50 to 60 minutes until meat is tender.

title: Caramel Brownies
directions: Combine the cake mix, melted butter and 1/3 cup canned milk. Press 1/2 of the mixture into a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 6 minutes.

title: Red Clam Sauce
directions: Saute clams in oil and butter mixture for 2 minutes; add garlic, onions and parsley to clams., Saute for 2 more minutes; add wine, parsley and tomato sauce., Salt and pepper to taste. Cook on low heat (simmer for 10 to 15 minutes)., Serve hot over linguine or spaghetti., Serves 2 to 4, depending on desired amount of sauce your guests like.

title: Clam Chowder
directions: Bring clams to a boil., Drain water off., Fry fatback meat and brown onion in the grease., Add meat and onions to clams; add 6 cups water., Salt and pepper to taste., Dice up potatoes and add to clams., Boil for 30 minutes., Cut biscuits up into quarters and roll into balls., Drop into boiling clam broth and cook until done.

title: Apple Dumplings
directions: Peel and quarter large apples (if small, use 1/2)., Roll out biscuits, thin, and, cut, in, halves (20 halves)., Take 1/2 biscuit and wrap around each apple quarter., Place on greased 9 x 12-inch, pan., Melt, 2 sticks butter and pour over dumplings. Mix together water, sugar, cinnamon and apple pie spice., Pour over dumplings.	Bake, at, 375°	for, 1 hour., One can biscuits equal 20 dumplings., May halve recipe.

title: Golden Chicken Cutlets
directions: Place chicken breasts on wax paper and pound flat to 1/4-inch. Mix flour, salt, pepper, nutmeg and marjoram in shallow dish., Have egg mixture ready in shallow dish., Mix crumbs and cheese in 3rd dish., Coat chicken in flour, egg and bread crumbs., Simmer butter and oil., Add chicken, turning 1 time, 2 to 3 minutes., Remove. Add wine to cooking pan and bring to a boil, scraping particles free., Pour sauce over chicken., Delicious served with Risotto.

title: Great Salad
directions: Mix the first 4 ingredients., Pour over remaining ingredients. Toss and serve., Refrigerate any leftovers.

title: Festive Cranberry Salad
directions: Mix jellied cranberry sauce and 1 cup boiling water in mixer until smooth., Dissolve both packages of gelatin in 1 cup boiling water., Mix cranberry sauce and gelatin., Add pecans., Put half of mixture in an 8-inch square pan and chill in freezer until firm, about half hour., Leave other at room temperature., Spread sour cream over top of chilled gelatin., Add other half of gelatin over sour cream., Refrigerate until firm., Serves 12.

title: Apple Dumplings
directions: Peel and slice the apples into the bottom of a deep baking dish (9 x 9-inch approximately)., Sprinkle with cinnamon and sugar., Make a syrup of the brown sugar, water, nutmeg and butter; heat until hot., Blend the flour, salt, baking powder, sugar and shortening., Add the milk; stir until moistened., Drop small portions of dough on apples, leaving space for dough to expand. Pour hot syrup over dumplings and apples., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes., Serve plain or with ice cream.

title: Enchiladas From Texas
directions: Heat chili in skillet on stove with 1/2 cup of water., Place one corn tortilla at a time in skillet until soft., Coat both sides with chili., Fill with cheese and onion., Roll up., Place side by side in baking dish., Fill all tortillas (continuing to add water to chili if too thick)., Pour remaining chili, onion and cheese on top., Bake for 30 minutes in 350° oven., Will feed 4 to 6 hungry Texans.

title: German Potato Salad
directions: Boil potatoes with the skins on; cool, peel and slice., Dice bacon, onion and green pepper., Fry bacon pieces in a skillet. Saute onion and green pepper with bacon., Dice eggs; add to potatoes., Mix vinegar, sugar and 2 teaspoons salt with 1/2 cup water., Add to bacon-onion-pepper mixture; heat to a boil., Pour over potatoes and eggs., Mix well; serve immediately.

title: Fruit Dip
directions: Use all of the marshmallow cream., Put half of the cream cheese in and mix together., Then put fruit on plate and dip.

title: Fluffy Cocoa Frosting
directions: Mix cocoa and sugar., Cream part of the cocoa and sugar mixture with margarine and butter., Blend in vanilla and half of the milk., Add remaining cocoa and sugar mixture and blend well.

title: Spinach Dip
directions: Stir all ingredients until well mixed., Cover; chill., Makes 3 cups.

title: Saucy Baked Beans
directions: Drain juice from beans., Mix with remaining ingredients., Bake in a 2-quart casserole at 400° for 35 minutes or until desired consistency.

title: Angel Biscuits
directions: Dissolve yeast in warm water. Add 3 cups flour and rest of ingredients; MIX WELL with electric mixer. Add remaining 2 cups of flour. Bake at 400° for 15 minutes.

title: Cherry Torte
directions: Press into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Stuffed Green Peppers
directions: Place ground beef, onion, celery and garlic in 2 quart microproof bowl., Cook on HI for 5-6 minutes, stirring once to break up beef., Stir in rice, egg, 3/4 c. tomato sauce, parsley, Worcestershire sauce, salt and pepper., Fill green peppers with beef mixture, mounding top., Arrange peppers in a ring in round or oval microproof baking dish just large enough to hold peppers upright., Cover with casserole lid and cook on 70 for 12-14 minutes., Spread 1 Tbsp. of the remaining tomato sauce on top of each pepper., Serve with crusty garlic bread, if desired., 4 servings., Total cooking time:, 17-20 minutes.

title: Chewies
directions: Melt margarine and add all ingredients. Blend well. Bake at 325 degrees in a greased 9 x 13 pan for 30-35 minutes. Cool cut into squares.

title: Festive Appetizer Spread
directions: Boil the water and sugar together in a medium saucepan for 5 minutes., Add the rest of the ingredients to sugar water and boil 10 to 15 minutes until thickened., Cool., Spread the sauce over the cream cheese and serve with crackers of your choice., Yield:, 3 cups.

title: Cherry Pudding
directions: Melt butter in a loaf pan., Mix flour, sugar, eggs and cherries., Pour in pan and bake for 35 to 45 minutes at 350°.

title: Tomato Relish
directions: Drain juice off tomatoes and mix all together and cook about 45 minutes to 1 hour., Put 1 tablespoon of canning salt.

title: Lemonade Cake
directions: Mix and bake at 350°.

title: Crispy Bacon Shrimp
directions: Combine all ingredients except bacon in a large bowl., Cover. Marinate in refrigerator overnight., Drain shrimp from marinade saving liquid., Wrap each shrimp in a half slice of bacon., Broil until bacon is crisp., Cook marinade slowly down to 1 cup liquid. Put in a cup., Serve shrimp surrounding liquid with toothpicks for dunking., Serves 6.

title: Reese'S Pie
directions: Combine peanut butter, honey and cereal., Press into 9-inch pie plate., Make pudding with milk, pour into crust and chill.

title: Potatoes And Carrots Au Gratin
directions: In a greased 2-quart casserole dish, place potatoes, carrots, green pepper and onion., Combine half the cheese and remaining ingredients., Pour over vegetables., Gently toss., Bake at 350°, covered, for 35 to 40 minutes, or until potatoes are tender., Top with remaining cheese., Bake, uncovered, for 10 to 15 minutes more., Yield: 6 servings.

title: Mott'S "Fabulous Fudge" Brownies
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Grease bottom of a 13 x 9-inch pan. Mix brownie mix, water, applesauce and egg., Beat 50 strokes by hand., Don't undermix., Spread in greased pan., Bake for 30 to 35 minutes., Don't overbake., Cool completely., Store covered.

title: Shrimp Casserole
directions: Heat all ingredients in saucepan, except for the shrimp., When warm, add shrimp., Place in baking dish., Bake in 350° oven 45 minutes., Serve over rice.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
directions: Cream together Crisco, butter, sugars, eggs and vanilla., Add dry ingredients., Mix thoroughly., Add chocolate chips., Mix. Drop by teaspoon on ungreased cookie sheets., Bake 8 to 10 minutes at 350°.

title: Corn Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients except chilies and cheese., Pour half of the mixture in dish, then cover with the chilies and cheese., Pour remaining mixture over this and bake at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Favorite Meat Loaf
directions: Combine all ingredients. Cook until done., Cover top with more catsup and serve hot!!

title: Ham Rolls
directions: Unroll crescent rolls into triangles., Place ham on dough. Sprinkle with cheese and roll up., Place rolls in greased pan. Mix soup and yogurt., Add a small amount of salt and pepper. Spoon mixture over rolls. Cook at 350° for about 30 minutes or until rolls appear done.

title: Bean Salad
directions: Toss beans, celery, green pepper and onion in a large bowl. Thoroughly mix sugar, salad oil and vinegar; pour over vegetables, tossing with a fork evenly., Cover; set in refrigerator for at least 8 hours, tossing several times during this period.

title: Crab Dip
directions: Melt all together., Serve warm with cracker of your choice.

title: Layered Pea Salad
directions: Layer first 6 ingredients in a salad bowl in the order given (i.e. lettuce, green onions, celery, green peppers, water chestnuts and frozen peas)., Spread a thin layer of mayonnaise over the peas. (Two cups is generally a bit much.)

title: Cherry Cake
directions: Prepare cake mix according to package directions, adding almond extract to batter., Remove 1/3 of batter to another bowl; stir in 10 to 12 drops red food coloring., Spoon in pink and white batters alternately into two greased and floured 9 x 1 1/2-inch layer cake pans., Cut through batter with knife or spatula to marble., Bake in moderate oven (350°) for 25 to 30 minutes., Cool for 10 minutes., Remove from pans; cool on racks., Stir together pie filling and orange peel., Prepare Cool Whip, adding 8 to 10 drops red food coloring.

title: Sausage Saute
directions: Saute, sausage meat (drain if you like)., Add margarine and curry, powder., Add, onions, and green peppers., Cook for about 5 minutes., When ready to serve, add tomato wedges, just until heated through., Excellent served over rice.

title: Shortcake
directions: Mix all ingredients together and knead for a minute or two. Pat dough into cake pan or use a biscuit cutter and cut individual rounds., Bake 12 minutes at 400° or until done.

title: Taco Dip
directions: Layer in serving dishes as follows:, First layer, bean dip; second layer, mayonnaise and sour cream mixed with the taco seasoning; third layer, diced onion; fourth layer, chunk tomatoes; fifth layer, shredded Cheddar cheese, olives on top (optional).

title: Pumpkin Cake
directions: In a medium bowl, combine pumpkin, sugar, evaporated milk, spices and eggs., Pour into a 9 x 13-inch lightly greased baking pan., Sprinkle dry cake mix over mixture., Top with chopped walnuts, patting topping down., Pour melted butter over all., Bake at 350° for 1 hour., Allow to cool in pan for 10 minutes; invert cake onto a platter., Cool before frosting.

title: Sausage Rolls
directions: Let bread dough thaw and rise to double in bulk., Roll dough out thin., Brown crumbled sausage and drain well., Add eggs, cheese and bread crumbs and mix well., Put half of the sausage mixture on each rolled out dough., Roll up like a jelly roll., Brush outside with beaten egg whites., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes., When cool, you can slice and freeze.

title: Bean Casserole
directions: Brown ground beef., Add the next 6 ingredients; simmer for about 5 minutes., Put this mixture into a casserole dish., Add remaining ingredients., Bake, covered, at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Cranberry Salad
directions: Soak cranberries in sugar., Add pineapple, orange, celery and nuts., Dissolve gelatin in 2 cups water and pour over cranberries. Pour into large pan and chill.

title: Brownies
directions: Mix all together., Pour into slightly greased pan., Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Special Baked Beans
directions: Combine all ingredients., Refrigerate overnight to blend flavors., Bake at 375° for 50 to 60 minutes or place in crock-pot on low for 6 to 8 hours.

title: Pork Chop And Dumplings
directions: Brown chops in skillet in 2 tablespoons vegetable oil., Drain fat and add chunky soup., Cover and simmer on low for 20 to 30 minutes., Remove lid and lay biscuits on top., Cover and cook until biscuits are done., Serve with baked potatoes or over rice.

title: Cowboy Stew
directions: Brown meat., Drain fat. Add all other ingredients., Cook in crock pot all day or all night.

title: Strawberry Salad
directions: Dissolve gelatines in boiling water; cool., Add strawberries and pineapple., Chill half of mixture in 9x13-inch pyrex dish until firm., Spread sour cream over firm layer., Cover with remaining gelatin mixtuer and chill until firm., Serves 8.

title: Barbecue Ribs
directions: Cut ribs into single ribs., Liberally salt ribs on both sides and set aside., Spread a layer of brown sugar on bottom of a deep pan large enough to hold all your ribs., Coat each rib with brown sugar with your hands., Layer coated ribs in pan, refrigerate overnight and cook the next day., Take out of refrigerator 2 to 3 hours before cooking time so that the sugar can melt into a syrup. Cook on a hot charcoal fire., Pour barbecue sauce and sugar syrup over both sides of ribs while cooking., Serves about 6 people.

title: Seven Layer Salad
directions: Layer in 9 x 13 container: lettuce, onion, pepper, celery, and peas., Combine mayonnaise and sugar., Cover vegetable mixture with dressing, cheese and bacon., Cover tightly., Refrigerate overnight., You may substitute the mayonnaise and sugar mixture with Miracle Whip.

title: Breakfast Pizza
directions: Brown sausage and drain., Separate crescent rolls into triangles., Place on ungreased pizza pan., Press to make crust. Seal perforations., Spoon on sausage., Sprinkle on potatoes and top with cheese.

title: Pink Stuff
directions: Chill all ingredients., Mix and serve., You can substitute cherry pie filling for the strawberry.

title: Strawberry Bread
directions: In mixing bowl, cream butter, sugar, vanilla and lemon extract until fluffy., Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition., Sift together flour, salt, cream of tartar and soda. Combine jam and sour cream., Add to the mixture and beat well., Add nuts., Divide among 5 greased pans, 4 1/2 x 2 3/4 x 2 1/4-inch loaf pans., Bake at 350° for 50 to 55 minutes.

title: Sod Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients., Pour into a 9 X 12 pan that has been sprayed with PAM., Bake at 350 for approximately 30 minutes.

title: Pecan Pie
directions: Beat eggs thoroughly with sugar, salt, syrup and melted margarine., Add pecan halves., Pour into 9-inch unbaked pastry shell., Bake at 350° for 50 minutes or until knife edge comes out clean., Cool.

title: Chicken Italiano
directions: Combine Parmesan, parsley, oregano, garlic and pepper., Dip chicken in melted butter, then in cheese mixture., Place in baking dish and bake at 375° for 25 minutes.

title: Apache Cheese Bread
directions: Cut the top off the bread, reserving top, and scoop out the inside. Combine remaining ingredients and mix well., This will be a very stiff mixture., Fill the bread with the cheese mixture, replace the top and place on a cookie sheet., Bake in a 350° oven for 1 hour and 10 minutes., Serve with tortilla chips or tear and dip with the bread.

title: Burrito Bake
directions: Grease a large pie plate., Mix Bisquick, water and beans. Spread in bottom of pie plate., Layer remaining ingredients on bean mixture., Bake at 375° for 30 minutes.

title: Grape Pie
directions: Remove seeds from grapes., Boil 15 minutes., Stir in sugar, tapioca and rind., Spoon into an unbaked pie shell., Cut a slit in top crust., Bake at 450° for 10 minutes, then reduce heat to 350° and bake 30 minutes.

title: Strawberry Soup
directions: Mix water, wine, sugar, lemon juice, salt, cinnamon and cornstarch., Bring the mixture to a boil, stirring just until cornstarch is fully dissolved., Chill., Stir in sliced strawberries., Serve garnished with mint sprigs., Makes 4 servings.

title: Non-Fattening Salad
directions: Put pineapple (do not drain) in saucepan and add jello., Heat and stir until jello dissolves., Remove from heat and cool about 15 minutes., Stir in buttermilk., Fold in Cool Whip and mix well. Place in large oblong dish., Refrigerate., Cut into squares to serve.

title: Old Fashioned Tea Cakes
directions: Cream sugar and butter., Add well beaten eggs and oil., Cream all well, then add flour, cream of tartar and vanilla., Roll in marble size balls., You can put dough in refrigerator to cool for easier rolling., Put on greased cookie sheet., Wet bottom of glass., Put a few spoons of sugar in a small bowl or saucer. Stamp glass in sugar, then flatten cookie with bottom of glass.

title: Mexican Casserole
directions: Brown ground beef, onion and garlic., Drain., Add soups and tomatoes and green chilies., Cook 5 minutes., Line a 13 x 8-inch pan with Doritos chips., Pour ground beef mixture over the chips. Bake 15 minutes at 350°., Remove from oven and top with Mozzarella cheese., Bake only 5 minutes more., Take out of oven and let set 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Vegetable Salad
directions: Shred all vegetables., Mix oil, vinegar, sugar and spice. Boil and pour over vegetables., This keeps a long time in the refrigerator.

title: German Crumb Cake
directions: Sift flour, brown sugar, white sugar, cinnamon and nutmeg together., Combine Crisco and butter., Rub both mixtures together with hands until it forms crumbs., Take out 1 cup of this mixture for top of cake., To the remaining mixture add eggs, buttermilk or sour milk and baking soda dissolved in vinegar., Bake in greased and floured pie pans or cake pans., Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Whipped Topping
directions: Place ice water in a small bowl; gradually add milk powder, beating at high speed of an electric mixer until stiff peaks form. Gently fold in lemon juice and sugar substitute., Cover and refrigerate until thoroughly, chilled., A serving amount is 1/4 cup at 11 calories., Diabetic Exchange:, free.

title: Pie Crust
directions: Mix flour, Crisco, sugar and salt with a fork until crumbly. Mix in remaining ingredients and form a dough that is easy to roll out.

title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
directions: Cream sugar and butter., Add yolks one at a time, beating well after each addition., Add sour cream., Mix thoroughly., Add flavorings., Beat egg whites until stiff., Fold into mixture. Pour into well-greased and floured pans (Baker's Joy)., Bake in preheated oven at 300° for 1 1/2 hours., Makes 15 to 20 servings.

title: Impossible Coconut Pie
directions: Cream butter and sugar., Add remaining ingredients., Pour in greased deep pie plate., Bake 45 minutes at 350°.

title: Quick Baked Beans("A La Tomas...")
directions: Brown bacon in saucepan., Remove bacon and set aside., Wilt onion in bacon grease., Add all remaining ingredients (including bacon)., Simmer uncovered 30 minutes., Stir occasionally.

title: Chicken Spaghetti
directions: Cook chicken in water until tender; reserve broth., Cut chicken into bite size pieces. Saute bell pepper and onion in butter., Mix soup, salt, pepper and jalapenos., Add to sauteed ingredients together with chicken and broth. Heat until hot. Cook spaghetti in remaining chicken broth. Drain and rinse., In a large casserole dish, layer ingredients, starting with spaghetti, then sauce mixture, then generous amounts of cheese. Repeat layers, ending with cheese. Bake at 350° for 45 to 60 minutes until cheese melts and is light brown on top. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Icebox Fruit Cake
directions: Melt marshmallows., Mix together in melted marshmallows and milk., Press together and place into a buttered dish., Refrigerate and let harden.

title: Fantasy Fudge
directions: Bring sugar, butter and milk to a boil over medium heat. Stirring constantly, boil 5 minutes., Remove from heat and using a wooden spoon, add salt, marshmallow cream, chocolate chips and nuts., Stir vigorously until well blended, melted and smooth. Pour onto greased pan., Cool and cut into squares.

title: Cheesy Broccoli Casserole
directions: In 2-quart casserole, combine margarine, celery and onions. Cover., Microwave at 100% (High) 3 to 3 1/2 minutes or until tender, stirring once., Add all remaining ingredients to casserole, blending well., Cover., Sit casserole on inverted dish in oven and microwave at High for 10 minutes., Rotate dish 1/4 turn., Microwave at 50% (Medium) for 5 additional minutes or until mixture is bubbly and rice is tender.

title: Five Flavored Cake
directions: Cream butter, shortening and sugar until light and fluffy. Add eggs, which have been beaten until lemon colored., Combine flour and baking powder and add to creamed mixture alternately with milk., Stir in flavoring., Spoon mixture into greased 10-inch tube pan or Bundt pan and bake at 325° for 1 1/2 hours or until cake tests done., Add glaze, if desired., Cool in pan about 10 minutes before turning out.

title: Chocolate Cream Cheese Pie
directions: Place pie crust in pan., Mix cream cheese and Cool Whip with rubber spatula until very smooth., Spread in bottom and up side of pie crust., In mixing bowl, combine milk and chocolate pudding mix; beat with a rotary beater for 1 to 2 minutes until pudding starts to thicken., Pour over cheese mixture and let set in refrigerate., Then spread more Cool Whip on top., Sprinkle with shaved chocolate if you wish.

title: Party Punch For 100
directions: Make syrup of sugar and 4 cups of water., Boil until sugar is dissolved., Add gelatin; stir to dissolve., Cool., Add remaining ingredients and 1 gallon water; mix well., Freezing some of the punch in trays prevents weakening from addition of ice., Better to make a couple of days before needed and freeze.

title: Sangria
directions: Combine sugar and water in saucepan., Heat, stirring, until sugar is dissolved., Bring to boil., Add sliced fruit to hot syrup and marinate at least 4 hours before using., When ready to serve, put about 12 ice cubes in a tall glass pitcher; add marinated fruit (reserving 2 slices of fruit for each glass) and 1/2 cup of the syrup, then add wine and carbonated water., Place 2 slices fruit in each glass and fill glasses from pitcher., Makes 8 servings.

title: Cherry Cheesecake
directions: You will need one disposable 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.

title: Cheesecake Bars
directions: Stir together first 4 ingredients., Add Karo; mix until crumbly., Pat into ungreased 9 x 9 x 2-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 12 minutes., Cream together cream cheese and 1/3 cup sugar., Add egg and lemon juice and mix well., Pour over baked layer., Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes., Sprinkle with 2 tablespoons of graham crackers., Cool; cut into squares., Store in refrigerator.

title: Rice Balls
directions: Mix these 5 ingredients together real good., Shape into balls (about 1 to 1 1/2-inches round).

title: Easy Baked Potatoes
directions: Place cubed potatoes in lightly greased 12 x 8-inch baking dish., Dot with margarine and sprinkle with onion soup mix (dry). Cover with foil and bake at 400° for 30 minutes., Stir mixture and bake an additional 30 minutes., Uncover and sprinkle with cheese and onion.

title: Spinach Dip
directions: Mix together ingredients. Hollow out 1 round Swedish rye bread. Put spinach dip in bread shell. Cube bread taken from center and use for dipping.

title: Oatmeal-Raisin Cookies
directions: Beat salad oil, vanilla, eggs and 1 1/4 cups powdered sugar until smooth., With mixer at low speed, beat in flour, soda and salt until blended., With spoon stir in oatmeal, raisins and nuts.

title: Squash Casserole
directions: Cook squash and onion in boiling salted water for 5 minutes; drain., Combine chicken soup and sour cream., Stir in shredded carrots., Fold in drained squash and onion., Combine stuffing mix (dry) and margarine., Spread half of stuffing mixture in bottom of 12 x 7-inch baking dish., Add vegetable mixture; top with remaining stuffing., Bake in a 350°, oven 25 to 30 minutes or until heated through., Makes 6 servings.

title: Peach Crunch Cake
directions: Empty peaches and juice in 9 x 13-inch cake pan., Cut peaches into small pieces., Sprinkle dry cake mix over peaches (do not stir)., Spoon melted oleo over cake mix, especially around edges (do not stir)., Cover with chopped nuts., Bake on 325° for approximately 1 hour.

title: Rhubarb Crunch
directions: Mix together 1 cup flour, 5 tablespoons sugar and butter. Press on bottom of an 8 or 9-inch square baking dish., Bake 15 minutes at 350°.

title: Refrigerator Rolls
directions: Mix yeast and warm water., Set aside., Pour boiling water over shortening, sugar and salt; cool., Add beaten eggs and yeast mixture., Add flour., Beat well with mixer., Add remaining flour until dough feels sticky., Refrigerate overnight., Three hours before baking, take out of the refrigerator., Roll dough on floured board., Cut with biscuit cutter., Place on greased pan. Let rise 3 hours., Bake at 350° for 15 minutes or until brown.

title: Fiesta Corn Bread (Quick Form)
directions: Put all dry ingredients in large bowl., Beat eggs in separate small bowl; add milk., Beat., Pour into middle of flour (corn meal)., Add corn, onions and bacon; mix well., If it seems too stiff to spread easily, add the corn juice.

title: Rice Casserole
directions: Melt butter., Add all other ingredients., Bake at 300° for 40 minutes.

title: Tuna-Noodle Casserole
directions: Cook noodles., Combine the noodles with tuna, mayonnaise, celery, chopped onion, chopped green pepper and salt., Blend cream of celery soup and milk., Heat through., Add Cheddar cheese., Heat and stir until cheese melts., Add to noodle mixture., Turn into 2-quart casserole., Bake, uncovered, at 425° for 20 minutes.

title: Corn Muffins
directions: Mix flour, corn meal, salt, sugar and baking powder together. Beat egg; add milk and oil., Mix together., Bake at 375° for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Potato Casserole
directions: Melt Velveeta cheese and mayonnaise over low heat., Add potatoes; mix well., Spread in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Sprinkle Bac*Os on top., Bake until brown, approximately 45 to 60 minutes at 350°., (Recipe is easy to half.)

title: Breakfast Casserole
directions: Place bread, cheese, broccoli, cauliflower and ham (if desired) into a 9 x 13-inch baking pan., In a bowl, whisk eggs and milk together until blended., Pour mixture over ingredients in pan. Spoon soup over top of ingredients and spread it so that it covers them., Cover with foil and refrigerate overnight., The next morning, uncover and bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes., Serve with breads and fruit., Great for breakfast and brunch guests.

title: Italian Style Swiss Steak(Makes 4 Servings)
directions: Preheat broiler., Broil beef on rack 4-inches from heat 2 minutes on each side., Set aside., In large nonstick skillet, heat oil., Add mushrooms, onions, carrot and celery; cook over medium heat until onions are translucent, about 2 minutes., Stir in tomato sauce, wine, oregano, garlic powder, pepper, salt and 1 cup water., Return meat to skillet., Cover and simmer over low heat 1 hour., Add green pepper and potatoes., Simmer until meat is tender, about 35 minutes.

title: Sugar Cookies
directions: Mix the sugar, margarine and vanilla together., Add egg, milk, flour, baking powder, salt and baking soda., Roll out and cut to desired shapes., Bake 8 to 10 minutes at 400°.

title: Pineapple Upside Down Cake
directions: Melt stick of butter in skillet., Put brown sugar on top of melted butter., Place pineapple on top of sugar; pour cake mix over this and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: French Stew
directions: Mix together all ingredients., Place in a casserole dish. Bake, tightly covered, at 325° for 4 hours., You can put small potatoes, carrots and mushrooms with it.

title: Chocolate Almond Cream Pie
directions: Melt candy bars and set aside. Whip cream with almond extract. Stir chocolate into whipped cream until blended. Pour mixture into pie crust. Refrigerate 4 hours or more.

title: Rhubarb Jelly
directions: Boil rhubarb and pineapple in an uncovered pan until it makes a sauce., Add sugar; boil until sugar dissolves., Remove from heat; stir in Jell-O., Put in jars and seal.

title: Upside-Down Apple Pie
directions: Coat a deep-dish pie plate with cooking spray and line with wax paper. Coat wax paper with cooking spray. In a small bowl, combine 4 tablespoons butter, brown sugar and pecans; mix well. Spread over bottom of pie plate. Unfold first pie crust and place it in the pie plate, pressing the crust firmly against the nut mixture and sides of plate. Set aside.

title: Eggnog Supreme
directions: Blend yolks with sugar; add brandy, milk and creams., Beat egg whites until stiff., Fold in., Sprinkle top with nutmeg.

title: Zeppola Puffs
directions: Mix first 3 ingredients, then add eggs and mix., Add milk and mix., Add water and mix., Mixture should be a smooth consistency. Get a deep pot; add Crisco to make at least a half a pot of oil. Make oil very hot; drop a tablespoon of the mixture into the pot. Put enough tablespoons of the mixture that will fit in the pot to float comfortably., When puffs are golden brown, they are done. You may turn puffs so each one gets brown on both sides., Sprinkle with confectioners sugar.

title: Strawberry Pie
directions: Mash 1/2 of the strawberries well., Add cornstarch and salt, then water., Cook mixture until thick and transparent; cool., Add remaining strawberries to the cooked filling., Pour into cooled crust., Garnish with whipped cream.

title: Salad Superb
directions: In a big salad bowl, place in order:, lettuce, celery, onion rings and cucumber., Then mix sour cream and sugar and pour over orderly layered salad., Then mix vinegar and salad dressing or mayonnaise and pour over first salad dressing., Then sprinkle crumbled bacon (fried crisp) over the top of the salad and top off with a few shakes of Parmesan cheese (maybe some croutons, egg slices, whatever)., Fix at least 2 to 4 hours ahead.

title: Lime Punch
directions: Mix and add just a few drops of green coloring., Refrigerate. Add ginger ale just before serving., Yield: 100 cups.

title: Mandarin Orange Pie(Mother'S Favorite)
directions: Mix ingredients in order listed., Be sure to add the lemon juice last., Pour into pie crust., Chill.

title: Pumpkin Cookies
directions: Dissolve soda in pumpkin., Cream the butter and sugar., Add eggs., Stir dry ingredients and mix with fruit., Add pumpkin and fruit mixture to batter., Drop by teaspoonfuls onto greased cookie sheets., Bake at 300 degrees for 15 minutes., Yields 4 dozen.

title: Martha'S Baked Potatoes
directions: Boil potatoes until done., Mash with small amount of milk and butter., Add dry mustard, onion powder, 2 eggs, butter and sour cream., Bake uncovered for one hour at 350°.

title: Tuna Salad
directions: Flake tuna with fork., Add apple, orange juice, green pepper, celery, onion and pepper., Stir in yogurt, applesauce and mustard. Mix., Serve on a bed of lettuce.

title: Mac'S Stew
directions: Mix meat marinade as instructed on package., (Leave out oil if called for in directions.), Place beef cubes in large bowl., Pour marinade over beef., Stir until all pieces are covered., Marinate for up to 4 hours in refrigerator., In a large pot (6 to 8-quart size), place meat and any juices from the bowl., Add 1 cup water. Cook until meat is done or until water has boiled off., Add beef stew mix (do not add water to mix; use it dry), French onion soup, Manwich, tomatoes, mushrooms, beef gravy and 1 can of water., Stir until boils., Add carrots and potatoes., Simmer over medium heat until potatoes are done., Add water as needed., Stir often. Prepare macaroni as usual., Serve stew over macaroni when done (when carrots and potatoes are tender).

title: Hot Buttered Rum
directions: Cream together the butter (room temperature) and the sugars. Add ice cream., Add nutmeg and cinnamon., Blend well and freeze mixture.

title: Pat'S Jello Pie
directions: Blend cheese and sugar; blend in Jell-O (dry), a little at a time., Add lime/lemon juice or rind and orange juice (optional). Fold in whipped topping., When filling gets thick, pour into graham cracker crust., Chill.

title: Potato Casserole
directions: Thaw potatoes in a large, oblong Pyrex dish., Mix all ingredients, except Ritz crackers, and pour over potatoes., Stir lightly., Melt 1 stick oleo or butter and mix with Ritz crackers. Place this on top of potato mixture., I also add some extra cheese to the top., Bake in a 350° oven for about 45 minutes., This will serve about 12 people.

title: Chicken Medley Casserole(Serves 6)
directions: Preheat oven to 350., Cook noodles according to package directions, adding onion and bay leaf to cooking water, drain noodles, discard onion and bay leaf., Toss together noodles, butter, onion salt and pepper., Spoon into buttered 13 x 9 inch baking dish., Sprinkle chicken pieces with salt and pepper; place on noodles., Combine soup, milk, 1/3 cup cheese, chives and sage. Pour over chicken., Sprinkle remaining cheese and paprika., Bake for 45 minutes., Add carrots., Bake an additional 20 minutes or until chicken is tender.

title: Strawberry Jello
directions: Dissolve jello., Add fruit., Chill until partially set., Add half in mold and place in freezer until set., The rest goes in the refrigerator., Spoon sour cream over half in mold and add the remaining jello.

title: Coconut Cream Pie
directions: Add sugar, cornstarch and salt to eggs., Pour scalded milk into this., Put in double boiler., Stir and cook until thickened., Add butter, coconut and vanilla., Put in pie shell., Bake at 450° until crust is set, then reduce to 325°.

title: Whoopie Pies
directions: Note:, Make filling before cookies and icing when warm.

title: Southwest Baked Beans
directions: Drain and rinse beans., Refrigerate 2 hours until firm., Saut onions., Add garlic., Do not brown., Remove pan from heat., Add remaining ingredients., Stir., Gently fold in beans., Put into bean pot and bake at 350°, covered, for 45 minutes., Remove cover, stir and bake, uncovered, 1 hour longer., Add more molasses or brown sugar, if necessary.

title: Sticky Buns
directions: Mix yeast and water first., Add other ingredients (sugar, oil and salt)., Then take 5 pounds flour; mix until dough comes off your hands., Set dough in warm place to rise (about 1/2 hour). Put wet towel over top of it., Let rise 3x double volume.

title: Angel Muffins
directions: Stir all ingredients together and fill lightly greased muffin tins half full., Bake at 375° for about 15 to 20 minutes or until lightly browned., Yum-yum-make all!, Won't last long or go far; better double this recipe!

title: Squash Casserole
directions: In a baking dish, layer squash, onion, cracker crumbs and cheese., Repeat to make 3 layers., Mix egg, milk, salt and pepper. Pour over squash layers., Bake at 400° for 30 minutes.

title: Bean Supper
directions: Brown hamburger, bacon and onion., Drain grease., Add remaining ingredients., Steam until thick.

title: Crab Salad
directions: Dissolve jello in hot water with salt and onion., Chill., Add remaining ingredients to jello mixture and pour into a flat pan. Cut in squares., Serves 15.

title: Celery Savory
directions: Chop celery, onion and green peppers., Fry slowly in margarine until tender., Serve with steak.

title: Coconut Cake(4 Layers)
directions: Cook until bubbly and slightly thick., Add 1 teaspoon of vanilla and begin to stack cakes., Soak by punching holes and dipping on caramel sauce., Cover with Seven Minute Frosting and sprinkle with coconut., Repeat until all is used and cover top and sides with frosting., Cover with coconut.

title: Fruit Tea Punch
directions: Pour boiling water over tea bags; steep 3 minutes., Remove tea bags., Blend in juices; sweeten with honey., Wash, hull and cut in half the strawberries., Add to tea., Cover., Refrigerate punch at least 6 hours to blend flavors., Just before serving, add bottle of soda water., Yield:, about 10 cups.

title: Chocolate Fudge Pudding Cake
directions: Sift flour, baking powder, salt and sugar., Mix in 3 tablespoons cocoa., Add milk, shortening and vanilla., Mix all ingredients only until smooth., Stir in pecans., Pour into a greased 1-quart baking dish., Mix brown sugar and remaining 3 tablespoons cocoa; sprinkle over mixture in the baking dish., Pour 1 1/2 cups boiling water over the top., (When baked, this pudding cake has a sauce on the bottom and cake on top!), Bake at 350° for 40 minutes., Serve warm or cold.

title: Pineapple Cake
directions: Blend together butter, cream cheese, sour cream and sugar. Add pineapple and coconut., Blend all together., Sprinkle with dry pudding mix as it comes from the package., Fold in Cool Whip., Use to fill cake layers., Slice the 2 layers in half and make 4 layers., Sprinkle almonds on top.

title: Pear Relish
directions: Grind and mix pears and onions., Mix and boil ingredients for 20 minutes., Put in Ball jars.

title: Creamy Pecan Pie
directions: Combine graham crackers, butter and finely chopped pecans. Press into bottom and sides of a 9-inch pie pan. Chill for 20 minutes. Beat cream cheese until fluffy, then add 1 1/4 cups sugar and toasted chopped pecans until mixed. Spoon into chilled crust. Bake at 325° for 20 minutes. Remove from oven., Mix sour cream, 2 tablespoons sugar and vanilla. Spread over baked filling. Bake again at 350° for 10 minutes., Garnish with whole toasted pecans. Chill for 3 hours.

title: Pecan Pie
directions: Beat eggs; add remaining ingredients., Pour into pie shell. Put pecan halves on top., Bake at 400° for 15 minutes, then at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Sloppy Joes
directions: Brown, ground, beef, and, onion in skillet; drain well. Stir in	remaining ingredients except buns., Cook over medium low, heat until vegetables are tender and sauce is thickened, about	10 to 15 minutes., Fill buns with meat mixture., Yield: 6 sandwiches.

title: Spinach Salad
directions: Place spinach in a salad bowl. Add chopped vegetables., Pour dressing over and toss., Sweet Catalina dressing is a good complement to spinach., Yields 4 servings., Has 75 calories, fat free.

title: Lasagne
directions: Brown meat; pour off fat., Add next 4 ingredients., Cover and simmer 40 minutes., Stir occasionally., Salt to taste unless garlic salt is used., Cook noodles tender., Drain in cold water. Place half in large baking pan., Cover with 1/3 sauce., Add 1/2 of Mozzarella cheese and 1/2 of cottage cheese., Repeat layers, ending with the sauce., Top with Parmesan cheese., Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes., Let cool 15 minutes., Cut in squares.

title: Mixed Nut Bars
directions: Mix first 4 ingredients together like pie crust. Pat into 9 x 13-inch greased pan. Bake for 10 minutes at 350°. Melt butterscotch chips, syrup, butter and water over medium heat. Pour over baked crust. Sprinkle with nuts. Return to oven. Bake for 10 minutes more. Do not overbake.

title: Cooked Asparagus
directions: Cook fresh asparagus until just starting to get soft. Use just enough water to cook without burning., If frozen, do not thaw. Cook frozen until turns soft. Drain water off., Add margarine and Italian dressing.

title: Cherry Crunch
directions: In an 8 x 12-inch or oblong baking dish, smooth the cherry pie filling, then pineapple with juice., Sprinkle on sugar., Smooth cake mix over this, then pour on melted margarine and nuts (or graham cracker crumbs)., Bake in a 350° oven for 45 minutes, or until brown.

title: Potato Dish
directions: Dice up potatoes; dice up green peppers and onions., In a baking dish melt enough butter to cover bottom of baking dish. Add a small amount of water to keep potatoes from sticking., Then layer potatoes, green peppers and onions., Bake at 350° for about 45 minutes or until potatoes are done., Add browned ground beef, if desired.

title: Shoestring Salad
directions: Mix the carrots, celery, onions and tuna with salad dressing and refrigerate. When ready to serve, add the can of shoestring potatoes.

title: Snowballs
directions: Cream butter and sugar., Add beaten egg yolk., Next, nuts and pineapple., Beat egg white; add salt., Fold egg white into mixture. Spread between crackers, but not on top until ball is 4 crackers high., Let stand overnight., Whip the cream and add powdered sugar to sweeten to taste., Cover balls with cream and sprinkle all over with shredded coconut., Top each with bright red maraschino cherry. Makes 15 snowballs.

title: Ginger Cookies
directions: Thoroughly cream the shortening and sugar. Add syrup and well beaten eggs., Add dry ingredients and beat until smooth. Roll into small balls (size of walnuts). Roll in granulated sugar and place 2-inches apart on a greased baking sheet. Bake at 350° until done, about 12 minutes., Store in airtight containers., The longer kept, the better the cookies.

title: Apple Oatmeal Coffee Cake
directions: Make cake as directed on package. Add apples and 1 teaspoon cinnamon, pour into a greased and floured (9x13 inch and 9x9 inch pans or 14x10inch jelly roll pan). Mix quick cook oats, butter, brown sugar, and 1 teaspoon cinnamon to make crumb topping. Sprinkle crumbs over apple batter mixture, run a knife thru batter mixture - you will want some crumbs on top. Bake at 375 degrees for 30 to 45 minutes. Keep an eye on it, may have to bake longer, it is a little difficult to tell with apples.

title: Texas Pecan Pie
directions: Mix together and pour into 2 unbaked pie shells. Bake at 325° for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Rice Refrigerator Rolls
directions: Scald milk; stir in sugar, salt and shortening., Cool to lukewarm., Dissolve yeast in warm water., Add rice to milk., Add yeast and eggs., Add about half the flour; stir until mixed well. Add enough of the remaining flour to make a very stiff dough. Stir until dough leaves the side of the bowl., Knead until smooth. Place dough in a large greased bowl., Grease top of dough., Cover with plastic wrap or foil; place in refrigerator for at least 12 hours., Remove from refrigerator 2 to 3 hours before serving and shape., Let rise and bake at 400° for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Microwave "Fried" Fish
directions: On sheet of wax paper or a paper plate, combine bread crumbs, cheese, basil and pepper, stirring to thoroughly combine; set aside.

title: Holiday Cheese Ball
directions: Mix all ingredients together, using only 1 1/2 cups pecans. Place in a covered bowl in refrigerator overnight. Shape into a ball and roll in reserved 1/2-cup chopped pecans. Serve with crackers of choice.

title: Harvard Beets
directions: Drain beets; save 1/4 cup of the liquid., Melt butter or margarine., Blend in flour., Add 1/4 cup beet liquid., Cook stirring constantly, until thickened., Add remaining ingredients and stir until sugar dissolves., Add drained beets., Heat to serving temperature., Makes 6 servings.

title: Fudge
directions: In pot, mix sugar, Pet milk and oleo., Let come to a boil. Cook for 5 minutes., Remove from heat and add both chocolates. Stir until dissolved., Add jar of Marshmallow Fluff, then nuts. Let stand for 8 hours.

title: Pancakes
directions: Mix dry ingredients., Add eggs and milk., Then add butter. Yields 20 (3-inch) pancakes.

title: Blueberry Cake
directions: Cream shortening and sugar., Beat 1 egg in at a time with shortening and sugar., Add remaining ingredients., Fold in blueberries last., Pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Chili Con Queso
directions: Heat all ingredients over low heat, stirring constantly, until cheese is melted., Serve warm with tortilla chips.

title: Sock-It-To-Me Cake
directions: Mix all together by hand.

title: Jiffy Cobbler Pie
directions: Combine all ingredients except fruit., Por into a flat baking dish., Top with fruit., Bake at 400° until crust floats to the top and is golden brown.

title: Pancakes
directions: Mix ingredients together and cook in frying pan that has been greased and is hot.

title: Lovelight Chiffon Layer Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Set out eggs 1 hour before and separate. Grease and flour 8 or 9-inch pans or line with waxed paper., Beat egg whites until frothy., Gradually add 1/2 cup sugar., Beat until stiff and glossy., In large bowl, put remaining sugar, flour, baking powder and salt., Pour in oil and half of milk., Beat for 1 minute., Add remaining milk, egg yolks and vanilla., Beat for 1 minute., Fold beaten egg whites into batter., Turn into pans., Bake for 30 to 35 minutes., Cool in pans for 10 minutes., Remove and cool on racks.

title: Fruit Pie
directions: Mix Eagle Brand milk and lemon juice., Let stand 5 minutes. Add pineapple, pecans and Cool Whip to this mixture., Pour into graham cracker crust., Refrigerate 2 to 3 hours., Then serve.

title: Flemish Beef In Beer
directions: Sprinkle flour over meat and brown in butter or oil., Add onion and garlic., Cook until slightly browned., Add beef broth and cook and stir to loosen bits in bottom of pan., Add remaining ingredients and simmer until meat and vegetables are tender or about 7 hours on low in crock-pot.

title: Pecan Or Coconut Pie
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Put in unbaked pie shell and bake at 325° until done, about 45 minutes.

title: White Chip Dream Cookies
directions: Heat oven to 350°. Grease 2 large cookie sheets. Combine flour, baking soda and salt in bowl. Cream butter and sugars in large mixer bowl at medium-high speed. Beat in egg and orange peel. With mixer at low speed, gradually add dry ingredients just until blended. Stir in white chocolate chips.

title: Make-Ahead Breakfast Eggs
directions: In bowl, beat eggs; stir in milk, salt and pepper., Set aside. In large skillet over medium to low heat, melt butter, pour in egg mixture., Cook, stirring occasionally until eggs are set but still moist., Remove from heat to cool., Stir in sour cream.

title: Ice Cream Pie
directions: Finely crush wafers., Fry in butter., Line in a lightly greased pie plate., Fill with ice cream., Top with strawberries.

title: Game Hens With Spinach Stuffing
directions: Prepare spinach-rice stuffing., With kitchen scissors, cut hens in half lengthwise., Rinse and pat dry., Rub some cream of chicken soup into cut side of hen., Press 3/4 cup of the stuffing onto cut side of each hen half., Holding stuffing in place with your hand, arrange hens, skin side up, in a greased shallow baking pan., Melt butter in a small pan over low heat; stir in onion., Brush over hens., Bake, uncovered in a 375° oven for 45 to 60 minutes or until leg joint moves easily., During last half-hour, baste occasionally with pan drippings., Makes 6 servings.

title: Oatmeal Fruit Crunch
directions: Place fruit pie filling in bottom of 9-inch square pan. Mix other, ingredients together., Pour this crumbly mixture on top.

title: Arctic Salad
directions: Soften cream cheese., Blend in mayonnaise and sugar., Add nuts, cranberry sauce and pineapple., Fold in Cool Whip., Pour into a 10 x 10-inch or larger pan., Freeze., When ready to serve, let stand about 5 minutes., Cut into squares., Serves 10, depending on size of portion desired.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
directions: Bring sugar and milk to boil., Boil until soft ball stage, approximately 5 minutes, stirring continuously., Take from heat, add remaining ingredients., Pour in buttered dish and let cool.

title: Fried Rice
directions: Heat oil in skillet., Add rice; cook until hot and golden. Add onions, salt and meat., When these ingredients are well mixed, hollow a center in the rice., Break eggs into hollow well and scramble until semi-cooked, then stir into rice mixture., Sprinkle with soy sauce and coriander.

title: Best Bran Muffins
directions: Add baking soda to boiling water and set aside., Cream shortening and sugar., Add eggs, flour, buttermilk, salt and water., Mix well, then add remaining ingredients., Bake at 375° for 20 minutes., Refrigerate dough up to 6 weeks in covered bowl. Do not stir., Makes 72 muffins.

title: Breakfast Strata
directions: Lay sausage in a 9 x 13-inch pan., Cover sausage with cubed toast., Cover with cheese., Beat eggs and milk together and pour over sausage, toast and cheese., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes, until brown., Will puff up and pull away from sides when done.

title: Black Bean Soup
directions: Rinse beans. Put them in a bowl with salt and cover with water. Soak over night. In morning, drain and rinse well., Place broth, beans and garlic in soup kettle and boil., Cover and simmer for about 3 1/2 hours. Add remaining ingredients and simmer for 1 more hour. Season to taste., Remove ham from hocks before serving. Makes about 4 qts., Enjoy!

title: "Church Punch"(Strawberry)
directions: Combine the dry jello and then add 2 cups of boiling water; stir to dissolve., Stir in cold water, pineapple juice, orange juice and lemon juice., Chill in refrigerator., Stir occasionally. When ready to serve, spoon in orange sherbet and ginger ale. Several other bottles of ginger ale may be added as needed., Large recipe that looks very pretty in a glass punch bowl.

title: Lo-Cal Whipped Topping
directions: Mix sugar and gelatin in a large bowl., Add boiling water and stir until completely dissolved., Stir in cold water and let set to room temperature., Add remaining ingredients and beat at high speed until soft peaks form., Refrigerate., Stir before using. One-fourth cup equals 24 calories.

title: Baked Macaroni And Cheese
directions: Boil macaroni; put in casserole dish., Melt 2 tablespoons margarine and toss in bread crumbs; set aside for topping., Melt 2 tablespoons margarine; add chopped onion., When onion is cooked, add flour, salt and mustard., Mix and add milk; cook until slightly thickened, then add cheese., Remove from heat and stir., Pour over macaroni; sprinkle on topping., Bake for 20 minutes in a 400° oven.

title: Ken'S Beans
directions: *If you like it a little hotter, use 2 tablespoons liquid Crystal pure cayenne pepper or you can use 1/8 teaspoon of regular cayenne pepper.

title: Easy Mexican Dip
directions: Mix all ingredients and serve with corn chips.

title: Southern Strawberry Pie
directions: Combine sugar, cornstarch, corn syrup and water., Cook, stirring constantly until clear and thick., Add jello, stirring until dissolved; cool., Place strawberries in baked pie shell; pour in gelatin mixture., Chill until firm., Yields one 9-inch pie., Serve with Cool Whip, vanilla ice cream or whipped cream.

title: Cheesy Snow-Capped Franks
directions: Preheat oven to 400°., Grease a casserole dish., Slice franks long ways., Lay them in bottom of dish, then cut franks in halves. Put a layer of potatoes., Make layer 1 to 1 1/2-inch thick. Sprinkle onions and cheese onto potatoes., Repeat process, ending with cheese on top., Put into oven and cook 30 to 40 minutes or until cheese is bubbly.

title: Mamma Jo'S Calico Bean Hot Dish
directions: In a large skillet, fry together bacon, hamburger and onion. Pour into a large Dutch oven or crock-pot., Bake on low in crock-pot or in Dutch oven for 1 1/2 hours or until heated through.

title: Super Coconut Cake
directions: Bake cake as directed on box in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan., While cake is hot, punch holes in it with fork and pour Eagle Brand over it., Let the cake cool., Mix together coconut juice and whipped topping., Spread over cake., Sprinkle coconut over top of cake. Keep in refrigerator.

title: Green Tomato Pickles
directions: Soak 7 pounds of green tomatoes, sliced, overnight in 2 gallons of water in which 1 cup of lime has been dissolved. Drain after soaking. Wash and soak in fresh water for 4 hours, changing water every hour.

title: * Meatball Stew *
directions: Mix beef, egg, bread, onion and salt., Shape into 24 meatballs., Brown in shortening in skillet., Pour off fat., Add remaining ingredients., Cook over low heat for 20 minutes., Stir now and then., Top with chopped parsley., Makes 6 servings.

title: Rice Salad
directions: Cream sugar and cheese together., Mix remaining ingredients. Put in refrigerator.

title: Chili Con Carne
directions: Crumble and brown ground beef in a heavy skillet, then drain. Add onion and green pepper; cook until tender, approximately 1 1/2 hours., Add tomatoes and seasonings., Cover., Simmer gently 2 hours, adding beans and liquid and water a little at a time, if needed to keep consistency of thick soup., Add kidney beans., Heat through., Remove bay leaves., Serve.

title: Dirt Cake
directions: Prepare two packages of vanilla pudding and mix with cheese, margarine and sugar mixture., Fold 12 ounces whipped topping into this mixture., Starting with the cookie crumbs, layer in deep dish or plastic flower pot; layer of crumbs, layer of pudding mix, layer of crumbs, etc., ending with a layer of crumbs on top. Refrigerate overnight before serving.

title: Sausage Balls
directions: Mix first three ingredients with hands., Add 1 teaspoon of horseradish mustard and mix well., Form into balls and bake in 425° oven about 15 minutes., These freeze well.

title: Deluxe Sugar Cookies
directions: Mix thoroughly butter, sugar, egg and vanilla., Blend in remaining ingredients., Cover dough and chill about an hour., Heat oven to 350°., Divide dough in half., Roll about 1/4 to 1/8-inch thick on a floured board., Cut into desired shapes and sprinkle with granulated sugar., Place on a greased baking sheet (shiny preferred)., Bake 7 to 8 minutes or until lightly browned around edges., Immediately remove cookies from baking sheet with spatula.

title: Stuffed Pork Chops
directions: Trim excess fat from pork chops., Make a slit to form a pocket in fat end of each pork chop., In a bowl, combine apples, raisins, bread crumbs, brown sugar, pepper, salt and cloves., Add melted butter and chives or parsley; mix well., Let stand for a few minutes for flavors to blend., Stuff each pork chop with a generous portion of stuffing., Skewer shut with toothpicks., Heat butter in heavy skillet., Brown chops slowly over medium heat, about 5 minutes each side., Add beef broth; bring to simmer., Simmer over low to medium heat about 30 minutes, or until tender., Remove toothpicks., Place on serving platter., Pour pan juices over chops and serve immediately.

title: French Onion Soup
directions: Saute onions in margarine in a Dutch oven until tender., Blend in flour, stirring until smooth. Gradually add chicken broth, beef broth, water and wine. Bring to a boil., Reduce heat and simmer 15 minutes. Add pepper.

title: Beef Chiang Mai
directions: In a wok or wide frying pan over medium heat, toast rice, shaking pan frequently, until golden (5 to 8 minutes)., Remove from heat; transfer to a blender or food processor., Whirl until finely ground., Crumble beef into pan; cook over low heat, stirring, just until meat begins to lose its pinkness., Add ground rice, sugar, pepper, onions, chopped mint, coriander, lemon juice and soy; stir until well combined., Pour into a serving dish; surround with lettuce leaves and mint sprigs., Spoon beef mixture into lettuce., Top with a mint sprig, roll up and eat out of hand. Makes about 12 appetizer servings or 3 or 4 main dish servings.

title: Polka-Dot Muffins
directions: Heat oven to 400°., Mix all ingredients except cranberries; beat vigorously 1/2 minute., Fold in cranberries., Fill 12 greased medium muffin cups or paper-lined muffin cups 2/3 full., Bake 15 minutes or until golden brown., Makes 12 muffins.

title: French Onion Soup
directions: Chop onions., Place in medium saucepan with butter., Cover and cook until tender, not brown., Add bouillon., Simmer for 20 minutes., Sprinkle bread or slice rolls with cheese and toast in hot oven., Pour soup in deep bowl., Place toasted bread on top just before serving.

title: Stuffed Mushroom Caps(Italian Style)
directions: Parboil mushrooms for 2 minutes., Drain., Chop onion, mushroom stems and garlic., Put in a heavy frying pan with oil and saute until tender., Add bread crumbs and herbs., Mix., If mixture is too dry, add more oil., Fill mushroom caps., Place in a shallow pan., Cover with foil., Bake 20 minutes in 350° oven.

title: Pretzel Strawberry Salad
directions: Combine first 3 ingredients in a bowl., Mix well., Press into a 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake at 400° for 6 minutes. Cool., Combine cream cheese and sugar in a bowl., Fold in whipped topping. Spread over cooled crust. Chill until set., Dissolve gelatin in boiling water., Add berries. Stir until thawed. Chill until partially set., Pour over cream cheese layer. Chill until set.

title: Hazelnut Brownies
directions: In a saucepan, melt the chocolate., In a medium sized bowl, cream together the butter and sugar., Add eggs one at a time and beat well after each addition., Mix in vanilla and melted chocolate.

title: Five Cup Salad With Nuts
directions: Mix well and chill several hours before serving.

title: Cheese Dip
directions: Brown sausage in skillet until done., Put sausage into crock-pot., Add cheese and salsa., Stir occasionally until cheese is melted., Takes approximately 1 hour to prepare., Serve over tortilla chips.

title: Green Bean-Chicken Casserole
directions: Use boneless, skinless chicken breasts. Pound (with crab mallet or hard object) fairly flat., Spread cream cheese with chives thickly over chicken breast., Roll chicken (jelly roll style, cheese side out) and wrap a slice of bacon around roll. Secure with toothpicks, (not really necessary though)., Bake at 400° for about 40 minutes.

title: Apricot Punch
directions: Chill ingredients and combine in a large bowl, adding ginger ale last., Serve over nectar ice ring or cubes., Freeze extra nectar and strips of lemon rind into ice cubes or salad ring mold.

title: Marvelous Fruit Mix-Up
directions: In a large bowl, stir 3/4 cup of boiling water with jello to dissolve completely., Add ice cubes, stirring constantly for 3 to 5 minutes until mixture slightly thickens., Using a slotted spoon, remove unmelted ice.

title: Beet Salad
directions: Dissolve jello in hot beet juice, add remaining ingred., Chill until set in 8 in. sq cake pan or 1 qt. container.

title: Peanut Butter Cornflake Balls
directions: Mix brown sugar and corn syrup and bring to a boil., Remove from heat and add peanut butter., Stir until smooth and add cornflakes., Pour onto waxed paper., Let cool and roll into balls.

title: Pork Chop Plus
directions: Slice potatoes and onions thin., Place pork chops in bottom of large casserole pan., Place sliced potatoes and onions over pork chops., Add garlic powder, salt and pepper., Cover all ingredients with tomato juice., Cover and bake at 350° until potatoes are tender, about 1 1/2 hours., Serves 6.

title: Cheese Ball
directions: Chop two pkgs. dried beef and mix with other ingredients. Form into ball. Cover ball with other pkg. of dried beef.

title: Cheese Blintz
directions: Mix cream cheese, sugar, vanilla, and egg yolk until creamy. Trim crusts from bread and roll with rolling pin until thin. Spread with filling and roll in crescent roll shape., Melt butter. Dip blintz in butter and roll or sprinkle in mixture of 1 cup sugar and 2 teaspoons cinnamon., Add more cinnamon and sugar as needed., Bake 350° for 15 minutes.

title: Eagle Brand Cookies
directions: Mix all dry ingredients., Add vanilla to milk; mix well., Add to dry ingredients., Bake as for brownies in a 350° oven for about 40 minutes., Cut into bars; remove from greased pan (11 x 16-inch) at once, or they will stick to pan., A Teflon pan works wonderful, but still must remove at once, then cut into bars.

title: John'S Spinach Dip
directions: Blend sour cream and salad dressing mix., Stir in remaining ingredients., Chill.

title: Apple Cake
directions: Beat eggs; add oil and sugar., Sift dry ingredients., Add apples to sugar-egg mixture., Mix., Add dry ingredients., Add flavoring last., Bake 1 1/4 hours at 325°.

title: Jewish Cake
directions: Beat the sugar into the beaten dry egg whites., Add the vanilla and vinegar. Butter a square cake pan (8 x 8-inch)., Line with wax paper., Put mixture into wax paper lined pan., Bake 35 minutes in a 350° oven. When cool, cut in half.

title: Cream-Style Corn Bread
directions: Heat bacon grease in an iron skillet until very hot., Combine remaining ingredients and pour into hot skillet., Place in oven and bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes until set., Slice in wedges to serve.

title: Baked Bean Dinner
directions: Drain pineapple., Add green pepper and onion to microwave dish., Cover microwave on High for 3 minutes.

title: Baked Corn
directions: Butter dish; put corn, eggs, flour, sugar, salt and butter in dish., Beat., Add 2 cups scalded milk., Bake in oven at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Pierogi Casserole
directions: Cook, lasagna, according, to directions., Mash potatoes. Add cheese, to potatoes and beat well., Saute onions in butter until soft., Add, 1/2, of onion mixture to potatoes., Salt and pepper. Generously, butter 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish., Place a, layer of noodles, then a layer of potatoes., Repeat, ending with noodles., Pour, butter, and, onions over all., Cover with foil and bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Yum Yum Cake
directions: Prepare cake according to directions, using pineapple juice instead of water., Bake in greased and floured 17 x 11-inch jelly roll pan at 350° for 30 minutes, checking after 25 minutes to see if cake is done., Cool cake., Mix together cream cheese, skim milk and pudding and spread on cooled cake., Top with drained pineapple; then top with whipped topping., Yields 20 servings.

title: Impossible Pie
directions: Put everything in a blender., Mix well. Pour into a well buttered 10-inch pie plate., Bake at 400° for 25 to 30 minutes, until custard sets.

title: Blueberry Crunch
directions: Butter 9 x 13-inch baking dish., Spread following in layers: pineapple in bottom, sprinkle blueberries over pineapple, 3/4 cup sugar sprinkled over fruits, then sprinkle dry cake mix over sugar., Pour margarine over top of cake mix and add nuts., Then add 1/4 cup sugar onto top., Cook at 325° for 35 to 40 minutes or until brown., Serve warm or cool., Can put Cool Whip on top, if desired.

title: Shrimp Creole
directions: Saute all ingredients (except shrimp and rice) until tender. Simmer 20 minutes., Add shrimp; stir until shrimp are pink., Serve immediately over rice., Serves 5 to 6.

title: French Silk Pie
directions: In a bowl, beat sugar and butter with an electric mixer on medium for 4 minutes., Stir in chocolate and vanilla., Add eggs, one at a time, beating on high speed., Scrape sides of bowl constantly., Transfer mixture to baked pastry shell., Cover and chill 5 to 24 hours., Top with whipped cream and shaved chocolate curls., Serves 10.

title: Tater Tot Casserole
directions: Spread in 9 x 13 x 2 pan the ground beef. Sprinkle with salt, pepper and garlic powder. Spread soup (mixed with small amount of water and warmed) over meat. Cover with Tater Tots. Spread cheese over top. Cover with foil. Bake at 350° for 1 hour. Enjoy!

title: Cheddar Cheese Soup
directions: Saute bacon in butter until crisp and brown., Remove bacon and drain., Add vegetables to bacon drippings and cook, stirring occasionally, until onion is transparent., Add vegetables to soup pot with stock and water., Heat to boiling and simmer until vegetables are tender., Scald milk over medium heat., Combine cheese and flour mixture., Cook and stir until cheese melts and mixture thickens., Add to soup pot with cream., Season to taste with salt and pepper., Heat to serving temperature., Garnish with parsley, croutons or paprika if desired., Serves 6.

title: Homemade Boursin
directions: Have butter and cream cheese at room temperature., Blend all ingredients (I use a food processor)., Serve with crackers., Can be frozen.

title: Saltless Spice Mix
directions: Mix all ingredients together and put in a shaker bottle., Use in casseroles or vegetable dishes and on meats for flavor., Having it already mixed saves getting out several spice bottles each time you cook., You can make a mix using you own favorite spices.

title: Peanut Butter Piece Cookies
directions: Cream butter, sugar, egg and vanilla until light and fluffy. Combine flour, cocoa, baking powder and salt; add alternately with milk to creamed mixture., Stir in 1/2 cup peanut butter pieces. Drop by teaspoon, 2 inches apart, onto lightly greased cookie sheet., Bake at 350° for 7 to 9 minutes, or until set, but not dry., Cool slightly., Remove from cookie sheet onto wire rack.

title: Baked Pineapple Chicken(6 Servings)
directions: Drain pineapple, reserve juice., Combine juice with garlic, cornstarch, Worcestershire sauce, mustard and rosemary., Arrange chicken in shallow broiler-proof dish, skin side up or skinless. Broil until browned., Stir sauce; pour over chicken., Bake at 400° for 30 minutes., Arrange lemon slices and pineapple around chicken., Spoon sauce from baking pan over all; continue baking 5 minutes.

title: Farm-Style Potato Frittata
directions: Cook bacon crisp., Heat 2 tablespoons drippings in 10-inch skillet., Add potatoes., Cover and saute over medium heat, stirring occasionally, for 15 minutes or until tender., Uncover and saute until brown, adding more drippings if necessary. Sprinkle with salt and pepper., Add onions and green pepper; saute about 5 minutes, stirring frequently., Beat eggs with water, 1/2 teaspoon salt and 1/4 teaspoon black pepper., Pour ingredients in skillet., Cook as for omelette, lifting edge with spatula as it cooks, allowing eggs to run under., When firm and browned on bottom, sprinkle with cheese., Cover and let stand 2 to 3 minutes until cheese melts., Sprinkle with bacon and parsley (if used)., Serve:, Cut in wedges., Serves four., Great for brunch, lunch or supper.

title: Triple Mint Ice-Cream Angel Dessert
directions: Split cake horizontally into four equal layers., Place bottom cake layer on a serving plate; spread top of layer with half of chocolate-mint ice cream to within 1/2-inch from edge., Top with second cake layer; cover and freeze 45 minutes or until firm. Spread second cake layer with pink peppermint ice cream., Add third cake layer; cover and freeze 45 minutes or until firm., Spread third cake layer with remaining chocolate-mint ice cream, and top with remaining cake layer; freeze until firm.

title: Pasta Salad
directions: Cook 6 cups macaroni., Drain and rinse., Place in very large bowl., Add 8 ounce bottle of Viva Italian dressing and mix to cover., Add 3/4 bottle of Salad Supreme seasoning and mix well. Let cool., Add chopped onion, green pepper and tomatoes., Mix. Add 3/4 of the 16 ounce bottle of Viva Italian dressing or to taste. Mix and refrigerate overnight., Stir well before serving.

title: Sourdough Starter
directions: Mix well., Add to starter., Let stand out of refrigerator 6 to 8 hours., Take out 1 cup and save 1 cup to put in refrigerator. After 3 to 5 days, make again., If not making bread, throw away 1 cup of starter.

title: Molasses Sugar Cookies
directions: Cream shortening and sugar., Add molasses and egg and beat well., Sift dry ingredients and add to first mixture., Mix well and chill.

title: Pears With Wine
directions: Peel pears., Cut 1/2-inch off stalk end and remove core., Put pears into covered dish with jam and wine and cook at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes or until a knife enters pear easily., Turn pears 3 to 4 times during cooking., Serve hot or cold with cream or ice cream.

title: Cream Raisin Pie
directions: Mix sugar and flour., Add half and half and cooked raisins. Add egg yolks., Cook until thick., Put in baked pie shell.

title: Spaghetti Sauce
directions: Saute onion and garlic in olive oil until tender., Cook ground chuck until brown., Mix all ingredients together., Simmer, uncovered, over low heat, about 2 hours, stirring occasionally.

title: Cheese Cake
directions: Mix the last 3 ingredients and put in spring-form pan that has been dusted on bottom and sides., Beat egg yolks until thick and lemon colored., Beat in sugar., Break up cream cheese; add sour cream and egg mixture, beating until smooth., Add sour cream, flour and vanilla., Continue beating until smooth., Beat egg whites until stiff, but not dry., Gently fold into cheese mixture., Heat oven to 275°., Bake 70 minutes., Turn oven off and leave in 1 hour without opening oven door.

title: Orange Corn Muffins
directions: In a mixing bowl, combine cornmeal, flour, sugar and salt., In another bowl, combine egg, milk, oil and orange peel., Add to cornmeal mixture, stirring until ingredients are combined., Fill greased muffin tins 2/3 full., Bake at 425° about 15 minutes.

title: Fresh Zucchini Bread
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Grease and flour a 9 x 5-inch loaf pan. Chop walnuts., Grate zucchini., Mix together sugar, eggs, oil, cinnamon, vanilla, baking soda, baking powder and salt., Mix well. Add flour., Mix well., Add walnuts and zucchini., Pour into a greased pan and bake 1 1/4 hours.

title: Chocolate Treats
directions: Prepare pudding with milk according to directions., Cool., Add cake mix and beat., Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan, greased., Sprinkle with chocolate chips., Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Olive Cheese Dip
directions: Mix all ingredients., Spread in a casserole dish., Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

title: Pound Cake
directions: Beat real good the Crisco, sugar, eggs and all flavoring. Then add flour and milk alternately., Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 15 minutes or until done.

title: Chinese Chewies
directions: Mix all ingredients and pour in greased glass dish., Bake at 325° for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Meat Loaf
directions: Mix thoroughly the hamburger, bread crumbs, milk, egg, salt, pepper, dry mustard, sage, celery salt, garlic salt, onion and Worcestershire sauce., Form into a meat loaf., Top with piquant sauce.

title: Chili Pie
directions: Cook beef, onion, salt and pepper until done. Mix remaining ingredients in saucepan. Cut in quarters 1 package tortillas and put some in bottom of casserole, then a layer of meat-soup mixture and cheese. Continue until all is used up. Bake in 350° oven for 1 hour.

title: Syrup Cake
directions: Bake at 350° for 30 minutes., Guaranteed to fill a hungry boy's appetite.

title: Cherry Pie
directions: Heat the ingredients to a boiling point., Pour into a double 9-inch pie crust.

title: Italian Baked Beans
directions: Cook beans over high heat until boiling point; add salt and butter., Cover, reduce heat and cook at simmering for 2 hours or until beans are tender but not mushy., Drain beans and reserve liquid., Cook onion, garlic and celery in oil over low heat until lightly yellowed., Add parsley, herbs, chopped tomatoes and reserved bean liquid., (Bean liquid and tomato juice should total 2/3 cup.), Heat all to boiling point., Add bits of meat (I prefer Italian sausage)., Mix with beans in a 2-quart casserole or baking dish., Cover and cook for 50 minutes at 350°., Remove and sprinkle with cheese and return to oven for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Chocolate Refrigerator Pie
directions: Use either Short Crust or Flaky Pastry.

title: Party Punch
directions: *Use just half of it.

title: Tuna Casserole Chinese
directions: Mix all together., Save some noodles to put on top, or use 1/3 cup cashews on top., Bake at 300° for 1 hour., You want vegetables crisp.

title: Calico Beans
directions: Brown hamburger and bacon., Mix together ketchup, brown sugar, vinegar, mustard and salt., Drain beans, reserving all the pork and beans liquid and 1/2 of the kidney beans liquid., In a large casserole, mix all ingredients with meat sauce., Bake in 350° oven for 1 hour (add extra liquid from kidney beans if needed during baking)., Yields 8 to 10 servings., Wonderful for family picnics and gatherings., Recipe can be easily doubled.

title: Brandy Chicken
directions: Coat chicken with tarragon, flour, salt and pepper mixture. Melt butter in large frypan., Add coated chicken and turn every 10 minutes; cook until brown., Add warm brandy and light., Stir in broth., Cover and simmer for 10 minutes., Remove chicken; add sour cream to pan., Warm and pour over chicken.

title: Quick Cobbler
directions: Sift dry ingredients together., Mix in 1/2 cup sweet milk. Then pour batter over butter in pan., Sweeten fruit to taste; pour over batter., Put a few dabs of butter on fruit., Cook at 350° until golden brown.

title: Chocolate Cream Cheese Pie
directions: Combine first 3 ingredients in a mixing bowl; beat at medium speed with electric mixer until soft and creamy. Add whipped topping, mix until smooth. Spread over crumb crust. Chill at least 4 hours.

title: Hawaiian Fruit Dessert
directions: Drain fruit; cut cherries in half., Add all the ingredients and stir in Cool Whip., Refrigerate in covered bowl overnight.

title: Nut Butter Balls
directions: Cream butter and sugar., Add salt, extract, flour and nuts. Mix well., Chill dough until easy to handle., Shape dough into 1-inch balls., Place on ungreased cookie sheet., Bake until brown, 12 to 15 minutes in a 350° oven., While cookies are warm, roll in powdered sugar., These keep well., Makes 4 to 5 dozen.

title: Hot Spiced Cider
directions: In a Dutch oven, combine the first five ingredients., Place the cinnamon sticks, cloves and allspice on a double thickness of cheesecloth; bring up corners of cloth and tie with string to form a bag., Add to the pan.

title: Refrigerator Pineapple Preserves
directions: In heavy saucepan, simmer all the ingredients 40 to 50 minutes over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until liquid has thickened., Pour into hot sterilized jar; cool., Cover tightly. Refrigerate up to 1 month., Makes 2 pints (4 cups)., Serve with ham or smoked meat., Use as a filling between cake layers or on the bottom of an upside-down pineapple cake.

title: Cranberry Pie Cake
directions: Line a 10 inch pie plate with your favorite pie crust., Add cranberries, 1/2 c. sugar and chopped nuts., To make batter: Cream butter and 1 c. sugar., Add eggs and flour., Mix well., Pour batter over cranberries oven and bake at 350° for 60 minutes. Serve with vanilla ice cream or whipped cream., Yield 1 - 10 inch pie cake.

title: Chess Pie
directions: Mix all ingredients and pour into pie crust., Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Baked Potato Soup
directions: Place bacon in large, deep skillet. Cook over medium heat until browned. Drain, crumble and set aside.

title: Lasagna
directions: Mix meat, mushrooms, onions, olives and spaghetti sauce; simmer 20 minutes., Cook noodles; drain., Layer one layer in a baking dish., Spread softened cream cheese on top., Add one layer of meat, another layer of noodles, sauce and top with Mozzarella cheese., Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Apple Cobbler
directions: Empty pie filling and pineapple chunks with juices in a baking dish. Sprinkle cinnamon on top., Pour cake mix on top of cinnamon. Pour melted margarine to cover cake mix., Sprinkle more cinnamon on top., Place in oven., Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until bubbly, brown and firm., Serve alone or a la mode.

title: Slumgullion
directions: Brown ground beef and onions., Add carrots, soy sauce and rice., Cook, adding water as needed, until carrots are done.

title: Chicken-Rice-Broccoli Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients together except cheese., Put in 9-inch square casserole., Cover with cheese., Cover with foil or lid and cook at 350°, about 45 minutes.

title: Dirt Cake
directions: Melt butter and stir in with cookie crumbs.

title: Sugar Cookies
directions: Heat oven to 375°., Combine sugar and butter., Beat at medium speed until well blended., Add eggs, syrup and vanilla., Beat until well blended and fluffy., Combine 3 cups flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt., Add gradually to creamed mixture at low speed., Mix until well blended., Divide dough into 4 quarters.

title: Marshmallow Fruit Dip
directions: Set aside 1 teaspoon of orange rind., Combine the remaining 2 teaspoons of orange rind and next 5 ingredients in a bowl., Beat at medium speed of electric mixer until smooth and blended., Spoon into serving container and sprinkle with reserved orange rind. Serve with assorted fresh fruits., Yields about 1 1/2 cups.

title: French Silk Pie
