directions: In a bowl beat sugar and butter with an electric mixer on medium speed about 4 minutes or until fluffy., Stir in chocolate and vanilla., Add eggs, one at a time, beating on high speed after each addition and scraping sides of bowl constantly., Transfer to baked pie crust., Cover., Chill for 5 to 24 hours or until set. If desired, top with unsweetened whipped cream and chocolate curls., Serves 10.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
directions: Mix peanut butter, powdered sugar and cream cheese together, then add Cool Whip. Pour into pie shell and let chill 1 hour. Yields 2 pies.

title: Aunt Angie'S Clam Chowder
directions: In a large kettle, fry bacon crisp. Add onion and let fry a few minutes, then add potatoes and cover with water., Let boil until tender. Add butter, milk and crackers., When hot, add clams, salt and pepper., Heat 5 minutes., Do not boil. Serve at once.

title: Chocolate Cake
directions: Cream butter and sugar thoroughly., Add chocolate., Add egg yolks, which have been beaten well with water., Sift flour, soda and salt 3 times., Add to first mixture alternately with buttermilk until all are used., Beat until well mixed., Add vanilla., Bake in 2 large layer pans (1 1/2 x 9-inch) for about 35 minutes in a 350° oven., Use a seven minute frosting between layers and a chocolate frosting on top and sides.

title: Taco Salad
directions: Mix ingredients together and simmer in crock-pot on high for 2 hours or on low for longer., Place the following ingredients on plate in the order given:, Doritos tortilla chips, chopped lettuce, chopped onions, chopped green pepper, chopped tomatoes, meat sauce mixture, shredded Cheddar cheese., Serves 8.

title: Braised Pork Chops
directions: Cook pork chops over medium heat until brown; drain., Sprinkle with salt and pepper., Reduce heat; pour pineapple juice on pork. Cover and simmer until done, 20 to 25 minutes., Remove chops to warm platter; keep warm., Prepare pan gravy.

title: Mardi Gras Creole Chicken
directions: In small bowl, combine prunes and bouillon; set aside., Heat oil in large skillet over medium heat., Add chicken and brown 5 minutes on each side., Transfer chicken to shallow baking dish. Drain all but 2 tablespoons fat from skillet., Add onions, green pepper and garlic., Cook and stir 5 minutes., Stir in tomatoes, salt, basil, pepper and thyme., Simmer 10 minutes., Pour tomato mixture over chicken., Bake in 375° oven 25 minutes., Pour prune mixture evenly over chicken., Bake 15 minutes.

title: Meat Ball Soup
directions: Heat oil in a large sauce pan and saute onion and celery for 5 minutes or until tender., Add tomatoes and bouillon, cook over medium heat until mixture boils., Reduce heat and simmer. Meanwhile combine beef, egg, 1 tbsp Parmesan, salt & pepper to taste., Shape into 3 dozen small (about 1 inch) meat balls and drop in simmering tomato soup., Stir in macaroni, cover and simmer 20 minutes or until macaroni is tender., Taste and correct seasoning. To serve sprinkle with Parmesan cheese, if desired and parsley. Makes about 2 quarts.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: In a 2-quart casserole, place 1/2 of crackers in bottom., Mix chicken, sour cream, cream of chicken soup and broth together. Salt and pepper to taste., Pour over crackers., Then top with remaining crackers., Bake at 350° until brown.

title: Pineapple Sheet Cake
directions: Beat with mixer until thoroughly blended., Add more powdered sugar if needed to thicken., Spread on cake.

title: Cold Oven Pound Cake
directions: Cream butter and Crisco well., Add sugar and beat until fluffy., Add eggs, one at a time, and beat well after each addition., Sift together flour and baking powder., Add flour alternately with milk, beginning and ending with flour, beating well after each., Add vanilla or lemon., Pour into greased and floured tube pan., Turn oven to bake at 325°., Do not preheat oven., Bake for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Hearty Chicken Stew
directions: In a deep skillet or Dutch oven, heat oil over medium-high heat., Saute onion, ginger and garlic until onion is soft, about 3 minutes., Add flour and cook 1 minute, stirring quickly to prevent sticking., Stir in tomatoes and allow to cook another 2 minutes.

title: Nacho Dip
directions: Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Mini Oreo Magical Pizza
directions: Reserve 20 cookies., Prepare brownie mix according to package directions; stir in remaining cookies., Spread batter in a greased 12-inch pizza pan., Bake in a 350° oven for 18 to 20 minutes or until done.

title: Green Congealed Salad
directions: Dissolve the Jell-O in 2 cups of boiling water., Put cream cheese (cubed) and marshmallows in blender., Add some of the gelatin and blend., Mix all together and chill.

title: Hamburger Stroganoff
directions: Saute onion in butter. Add meat and brown., Add flour, salt, pepper and mushrooms., Cook 5 minutes., Add soup and simmer uncovered for 10 minutes., Just before serving, stir in sour cream., Serve over egg noodles.

title: Company French Toast
directions: Melt margarine in 13 x 9-inch pan., Add brown sugar and cinnamon., Cover with 2 layers of bread., Beat eggs and milk and pour over bread., Cover pan with foil and let stand overnight in a refrigerator., Bake, uncovered, 35 minutes at 350°, then 10 minutes at 425°., Remove from pan and flip over., Serve warm. Delicious!

title: Mama'S Chocolate Pound Cake
directions: Cream butter, Crisco and sugar. Sift all dry ingredients together and add alternately with milk and vanilla. Add eggs, 1 at a time, blending with all other ingredients. Coat tube pan with shortening. Use a small amount of flour and cocoa to flour pan. Pour mixture into prepared tube pan and place in COLD oven. Turn oven on and let it heat to 325°. Cook for 1 hour and 20 minutes or until done. Cool in pan for 10 minutes.

title: Spiced Tea
directions: Mix well., Store in tightly covered jars., To serve, add 2 teaspoons to cup of boiling water.

title: Crock-Pot Apple Butter
directions: Mix all ingredients together and put into crock-pot., Turn on high until boiling., Leave uncovered., After it's boiling, turn crock-pot to low for 24 hours., Seal in jars when cooked thick like darkened apple butter., Yield: 10 to 12 (4 ounce) containers.

title: Fruit Pizza
directions: Flour or spray Pam on pizza pan., Spread out dough on pan. Bake at 375° for 13 to 15 minutes., Cool., Mix cream cheese and half of cherries (you may need to pour a little cherry juice in this mixture)., Spread on cooked dough., Layer strawberries, bananas and oranges like a pizza., Spread Cool Whip over the top and garnish with remaining cherries.

title: Zucchini Fritters
directions: Combine all ingredients with a spoon and drop by spoonsful on a hot griddle with melted margarine., Cook until brown on one side, turn., Serve immediately while they are hot.

title: Sausage Pinwheels
directions: Mix Bisquick with milk., Add more milk if needed to make stiff dough., Knead slightly., Roll out on floured board, with some flour spread over dough, until very thin, about 12 x 18-inches.

title: Teriyaki Beef
directions: Blend all the liquid ingredients and the seasonings. Marinate the steak strips in this sauce for 2 hours (or more). Drain and cook quickly over charcoal or in a small amount of cooking oil in a very hot frying pan. Quickly is the key word; the steak slices should be pink inside and are much better underdone than overdone.

title: Beef Brisket
directions: Mix all sauce ingredients together and pour over brisket. Marinate all day or overnight., Bake 8 hours at 225 degrees.

title: Creamy Grouse Breast
directions: Fillet the meat from the bone and slice thin., Heat butter. Add grouse and brown on all sides., Frying time about 3 minutes. Add wine and turn heat to high., Add cream and toss grouse pieces in mixture while it cooks down to a thick sauce.

title: Pork And Bean Casserole
directions: Mix ingredients together; place in a casserole dish., Bake at 350° for approximately 30 minutes.

title: Pralines
directions: Combine pudding mix, brown sugar, milk and butter in medium size heavy saucepan., Heat slowly, stirring often until sugar dissolves, then cook without stirring until it forms a soft ball in cold water., Remove from heat; stir in pecans., Let cool slightly, then stir with wooden spoon until mixture starts to thicken., Drop by tablespoon on wax paper.

title: Frozen Delight
directions: Mix sour cream and sugar together., Put everything else in leaving bananas last., Fold in Dream Whip., Put in containers, then freeze., Thaw 30 minutes before serving.

title: Asparagus Casserole
directions: Layer asparagus in bottom of a casserole dish., Add English peas., Spread cream of mushroom soup on top., Slice boiled egg and layer on top., Sprinkle grated cheese on top., Bake at 350° until bubbly, 20 or 30 minutes.

title: Strawberry Bavarian Cream
directions: Sprinkle lemon juice over mashed berries and stir in sugar. Sprinkle gelatin into the 3 tablespoons of water in a cup., Stir in the 3 tablespoons of boiling water and let dissolve., Let cool to room temperature., Pour dissolved gelatin into a medium bowl. Whip the cream., Fold in whipped cream and mashed berries., Pour into a wet mold and chill 12 hours.

title: Crescent Chicken Squares
directions: Mix all ingredients well.

title: Hot Chocolate Mix
directions: Mix together., Store in airtight container., Add 1/3 cup to 6 ounces hot water., Quick and easy!

title: Carrots
directions: Slice carrots and cook in water., Drain., Mix brown sugar, butter, water, cinnamon and nutmeg., Pour over carrots., Heat and serve.

title: Peanut Pie
directions: Warm syrup and sugar, then add butter and melt in sugar., Beat eggs good and then add them and flour to syrup mixture., Add ground or chopped peanuts and vanilla. Pour in pie crust and bake.

title: Party Punch
directions: Dissolve Kool-Aid in hot water, put in sugar and dissolve. Mix pineapple juice and orange juice., Add water to make one gallon., Serve with pineapple or orange sherbet.

title: Apricot Fluff Salad
directions: Dissolve Jell-O in hot water., Add pineapple and orange juice concentrate., Stir well and chill until partially set., Fold in apricots., Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan., Beat pudding mix and milk. Fold in whipped cream., Spread on firm Jell-O., Chill and serve.

title: Creamy Chicken Or Turkey Lasagna
directions: Reserve 2/3 cup Mozzarella cheese for top layer., Combine in bowl: soup, milk and pepper; set aside., In another bowl, mix spinach, egg and Ricotta cheese; mix well., In bottom of 9 x 13-inch baking dish, spread 1/2 cup soup mixture., Arrange 4 noodles on mixture., Top 1/3 soup mixture, 1/2 spinach mixture, 1/2 Mozzarella cheese and 1/2 chicken., Repeat layers, ending with noodles., Top with reserved 2/3 cup Mozzarella cheese and Parmesan cheese., Cover., Bake at 350° for 40 minutes or until bubbling. Let stand 15 minutes before serving.

title: Chicken A La Can Can
directions: Combine soup, water, chicken and 1/2 onions., Add rice; stir to mix., Bring quickly to boil., Cover., Reduce heat., Cook until rice is done (several minutes)., Transfer to casserole dish., Top with the other half of onions., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Broccoli Cornbread
directions: Preheat 10-inch iron skillet., Mix all ingredients and blend well., Pour batter into preheated skillet and bake for 30 minutes at 400°.

title: Corn Chip Dip
directions: Mix all ingredients in a microwavable container., Cook on High until hot and cheese is melted., Eat with your favorite corn chips.

title: Spaghetti Salad
directions: Chop all vegetables finely., Mix with cooked spaghetti and chill., Note:, Any kind of pasta may be used in place of spaghetti.

title: Pretzel Congealed Salad
directions: Combine pretzels, melted margarine and 3 tablespoons sugar; spread in a 13 x 9-inch pan., Bake for 8 minutes at 350°, then cool., Combine cream cheese, 1 cup sugar and Cool Whip., Spread over pretzel crust when it has completely cooled., Prepare jello according to package directions., Thaw and drain frozen strawberries., Mix strawberries into dissolved jello and chill until mixture thickens to a syrupy stage., Pour jello mixture over cream cheese mixture., Chill until firm., Cut into squares to serve., Serves 15.

title: Lasagna
directions: Brown the ground beef., Add the next 6 ingredients., Simmer meat mixture for 45 minutes; stir occasionally., Combine the cottage cheese, eggs, salt, Parmesan cheese and parsley., Set the cottage cheese mixture aside until ready to use., Prepare 6 lasagna noodles., Grease a 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan., Place 3 noodles on bottom., Cover with 1/2 of the cottage cheese mixture., Cover with 6 slices Mozzarella cheese., Cover with 1/2 of the meat mixture., Place remaining 3 noodles on top of mixture., Cover with remaining cottage cheese mixture, 6 more slices Mozzarella cheese and remaining meat mixture., Bake at 375° for 45 minutes., Let stand 20 minutes before serving.

title: Potato Cheese Bake
directions: Cook potatoes in jackets until tender., Peel and shred. Combine potatoes with sour cream, 1 cup of cheese and remaining ingredients except paprika., Turn into buttered 1 1/2-quart baking dish., Sprinkle with remaining cheese and paprika., Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes., Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Coconut Custard Pie
directions: Beat egg yolks with the sugar., Add milk gradually, salt, then coconut and stiffly beaten whites., If desired, mix 1/2 tablespoon cornstarch with the sugar and use only 2 eggs., Fill shell and bake 30 minutes at 300°.

title: Chinese Pepper Steak
directions: Heat oil in pan., Add beef, braise until brown., Stir frequently., Add onions, celery, garlic, seasoning, and bouillon (dissolved in 1 cup of water)., Simmer until peppers and celery are cooked (DO NOT OVER COOK)., Then add cornstarch blended with 1/4 cup cold water., Cook until thickened, then add soy sauce. Serve over hot rice., Add chow mein noodles on top of pepper steak.

title: Barbecued Ribs
directions: Preheat oven to 325°., Mix barbecue sauce, onion and seasoning in baking dish., Place ribs in sauce., Roast, covered, for approximately 2 hours, until meat is done., For quicker cooking, can be cooked in oven bag; cook approximately 1 1/2 hours.

title: Apple Cake
directions: Combine oil, sugar, eggs, vanilla and salt., Beat well., Add soda and cinnamon to flour; mix well, then add to oil mixture. Mix well., Add apples and nuts., Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan at 350° for about 45 minutes.

title: Oven Buttered Cornsticks
directions: Melt butter or margarine in shallow pan., Combine biscuit mix and corn; stir until soft dough is formed., Knead about 15 strokes on lightly floured surface., Roll out and cut., Roll in melted butter., Bake at 450° for 10 to 12 minutes., Makes approximately 20 cornsticks.

title: Baked Potato Casserole
directions: Cook, peel and dice potatoes., Slice cheese in strips., Chop onion., Fry bacon crisp and crumble., Combine first 4 ingredients. Place in a 9 x 13-inch pan., Top with bacon., Bake 1 hour at 325°., Serves 12.

title: Dream Pie
directions: Mix together and put in pie crust., Chill about 2 hours.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Melt butter., Stir in Cheez Whiz., Mix well with other ingredients., Pour into greased casserole., Bake 1 hour at 350°.

title: Chocolate Sauce
directions: Combine chocolate morsels and evaporated milk in a small, heavy saucepan., Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until chocolate morsels melt., Stir in powdered sugar., Cook mixture over medium heat, stirring frequently, for 5 minutes, or until sauce thickens., Yields 2 cups.

title: Chocolate Peppermint Brownies
directions: Melt chocolate and butter. Add eggs and sugar after beating together. Stir in remaining ingredients. Bake in buttered 8 or 9-inch square pan at 350° for 25 minutes.

title: Double Crust Pizza Casserole
directions: Crust:, Combine flour, potatoes, milk and margarine or butter and set aside.

title: Pineapple Rice Pudding
directions: Cook rice. Combine cooked rice with milk, salt, sugar, eggs, vanilla and pineapple. Pour into 1 1/2 quart baking dish. Sprinkle with cinnamon. Cover with foil. Place on bottom of oven, watch so it doesn't burn. Cook about 30 minutes at 350 degrees or until done.

title: Cocoa Mix
directions: Mix all ingredients in large bowl., Dissolve 2 scoops of the mix in 1 cup of boiling water for instant hot chocolate., Yields 50 servings.

title: German Potato Salad
directions: Boil potatoes until fork-soft., Cool potatoes until you can comfortably peel them., While you slice potatoes in large container, fry bacon pieces and boil eggs.

title: Cheese, Pea And Pickle Salad
directions: Drain peas, and, add, chopped pickle, cheese and grated onion. Mix together with enough mayonnaise to moisten., Serve on crisp lettuce leaf.

title: Coconut Creme Pie
directions: In heavy saucepan, mix sugar and cornstarch., Separate egg yolks from whites, putting yolks in mixture., Add milk, small amount at a time, with egg and sugar until thin., Then add rest of milk., Cook on medium heat, stirring constantly, so not to stick, until thick.

title: Lime Fluff(Cooking For  A Crowd)
directions: In a large bowl, combine whipped topping, gelatin and cottage cheese. Fold in oranges., Chill until serving., Makes 100 servings.

title: Easter Bread
directions: Combine warm water, 1 tablespoon sugar and yeast; let stand for 15 minutes., Combine remaining sugar and rest of ingredients in large mixing bowl., Add yeast mixture., Knead and turn dough until it becomes dry and springy when pushed down., Fold dough over; sprinkle with a small amount of flour., Cover; let rise in a warm place for 3 hours or until doubled in bulk., Knead again; let rise for 1 hour., Shape dough into 7 round loaves; cover., Let rise for 2 hours., Brush top of loaves with additional beaten egg. Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Veggie Dip
directions: Combine all ingredients and refrigerate until ready to serve. Can be used on baked potatoes or fish.

title: Willie'S Chili
directions: Fry garlic, onion and chili peppers until lightly brown., Add meat and brown., Add water, tomato sauce, chili powder and cumin powder., Cook for 30 minutes., Cook longer for better flavor. Last, add oats to thicken.

title: 24-Hour Cauliflower Salad
directions: Layer the first 4 ingredients in a covered dish or Tupperware container.

title: Toasted Pumpkin Seeds
directions: Separate the fiber from pumpkin seeds. Do not wash the seeds. Add the margarine or oil and the salt to the seeds., Spread in shallow pan and bake at 250° about 1 hour, stirring every 15 minutes, until crisp and brown.

title: Asparagus-Potato Casserole
directions: The listed amounts are just an idea., You may vary the amounts of any of the ingredients to suit the dish and amount needed.

title: Cheese Ball
directions: Mix all ingredients together well., Shape into a ball.

title: Easy Yeast Rolls
directions: Mix yeast with 1/4 cup of warm water., Set aside., Cream sugar and Crisco., Add egg., Stir in the 1 cup of water., Add yeast. Stir in flour., Put in a large bowl., Let rise in warm place until double., Punch down and shape into rolls., Let rise until double in bulk., Bake at 425° for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Cook and chop up 4 chicken breasts., Add cream of chicken and mushroom soup, then, mix chicken ala king, chopped small onion, Cheddar cheese (grated) and chicken broth to mixture for moisture. Place in casserole and top with can of dried onion rings., Bake in oven at 350° until bubbles through and through.

title: Chicken Tetrazzini
directions: Cook celery and onion in butter until tender, not brown., Add chicken broth and seasonings., Simmer 15 minutes., Slowly add soup and cheese., Add spaghetti and let stand for 1 hour., Add chicken and olives.

title: Cottage Cheese And Salsa Spread
directions: Crumble goat cheese coarsely and stir into cottage cheese. Spread should be slightly lumpy., Cover and refrigerate until ready to serve., Heat oil in saucepan., Add garlic and onion and green pepper., Saute until onion in translucent being careful not to brown., Stir in tomatoes., Simmer, uncovered, for 5 minutes. Add jalapeno., Cool to room temperature., Refrigerate, covered, if to be kept overnight. Pile cheese mixture onto plate., Drizzle salsa around it to form a red pool around creamy cheese., Surround with additional fresh chopped tomatoes and green peppers if desired., Serve with crackers or chips.

title: Card Party Cheesecake
directions: Place rolls on the bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan., Beat cream cheese, sugar and sour cream., Add eggs, 1 at a time, beating all the time., Add vanilla., Pour over rolls., Sprinkle with cinnamon. Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Shirley Mckenzie'S Breakfast Dish
directions: Place 4 slices of bread, butter side down, in oblong baking dish., Place a slice of cheese on each piece., Top cheese with the cooked sausage., Beat the eggs, milk and salt together., Place remaining 4 bread slices, butter side up, over the sausage., Pour eggs over all., Cover with foil and refrigerate overnight., Bake 50 minutes at 350°.

title: Chris' Magic Brown Rice
directions: Saute onion and mushrooms in butter. Add remaining ingredients except for rice. Bring to a boil. Add rice., Cook, uncovered, for 20 minutes until liquid disappears.

title: Fish Fillet Skillet
directions: Partially defrost the fish so that fillets can be easily separated., Pour oil into a skillet., Add chopped onion and cook over medium heat about 5 minutes., Add the other ingredients, except for the fish, and cook about 5 minutes., Add the fish; cover and simmer for 10 minutes or until done.

title: Pineapple Raisin Cookies
directions: Mix shortening, sugar and egg thoroughly., Stir in pineapple. Measure flour by dipping method or by sifting., Stir together flour, soda, salt and nutmeg and blend., Mix in nuts., Chill at least one hour., Heat oven to 400°., Drop rounded teaspoonfuls of dough about 2 inches apart on lightly greased baking sheet., Bake 8 to 10 minutes or until no imprint remains when touched lightly. Makes about 5 dozen cookies.

title: Ham Chowder
directions: Cook vegetables until tender and blend flour into milk. Simmer 10 minutes., Garnish with paprika and parsley., Add salt to taste., Serve with garlic bread and tossed salad.

title: Cheese Ball
directions: Shape in ball. Roll in pecans.

title: Squash Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients., Pour into a buttered casserole., Bake in oven at 350° until set.

title: Chicken Cacciatore
directions: Heat oil and cook the chicken pieces in it until they are golden brown, turning frequently., Add onions; cook a few minutes longer., Add garlic, tomatoes, basil, salt and pepper., Cover pan and cook gently until chicken is done and tomatoes are cooked to a sauce., Stir occasionally., Continue cooking for about 45 minutes. Add wine., Cook another 15 minutes., Serve with Italian Rice and a green salad.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
directions: Mix Veg-All and soup together and pour into a casserole dish. Mix flour, milk and melted butter together., Pour over the soup and Veg-All mixture., Bake 45 minutes at 400°.

title: Sunday Pot Roast
directions: Pour carrots and potatoes in bottom of crock-pot without draining off the liquid., Season the pot roast to taste and put on top of carrots and potatoes., Pour Pepperidge Farm gravy on top. Cook on high about 4 to 5 hours., If you put this in the crock-pot about 8:00 on Sunday morning, this will be ready for lunch right after 11:00 church.

title: Grandma Aggie'S Ranger Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.

title: Tuna Pie
directions: Cook onion and green pepper in boiling, salted water until tender, then drain.

title: Pralines
directions: Combine first 6 ingredients in saucepan., Cook about 20 minutes over medium heat until it comes to a boil., Stir occasionally and continue cooking until mixture forms a small ball in cold water. Remove from heat., Add vanilla and stir until mixture begins to lose its gloss., Drop small portions onto waxed paper., (Put foil under waxed paper to keep it from sticking to your countertop.) Work fast, keeping saucepan over a warm surface, if it seems to harden too fast., Let pralines cool before removing from waxed paper.

title: Creole Chicken Salad
directions: Combine the mayonnaise, Creole seasoning, dill weed and paprika., Mix well and set aside., Combine chicken, bell pepper, celery, onion, and relish., Toss to mix., Add flavored mayonnaise and mix well., Makes about 6 servings.

title: Chocolate Icing
directions: Melt margarine in saucepan. Add salt, cocoa, confectioners sugar, vanilla and milk., Mix well. Put on warm cake.

title: Uncle Steve'S Bean Delight
directions: Wash beans until all bubbles disappear., Mix beans, salsa and chopped vegetables in large bowl., Season to taste with Old Dutch dressing; mix well., Let marinate 1/2 hour., Delicious!

title: Yum Yum Dessert
directions: Bring pineapple and juice, sugar and water to a boil., Add jello and cream cheese., Stir until cream cheese is dissolved. Chill until it starts to set., Add cool Whip and mix thoroughly. Sprinkle nuts over top.

title: Meat Goulash
directions: Combine meat, salt, pepper and onion; mix well., Brown in skillet., Add red beans, corn, spaghetti, tomato juice and chili powder., Simmer for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: The "Aiken" Cake
directions: Cream butter and sugar; add eggs 1 at a time., Add flour sifted with mace., Pour in greased 9-inch tube pan and bake 1 hour beginning in cold oven., Can be baked as sheet cake with butter icing for teas.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
directions: Bring to boil the sugar, butter and milk., Boil until soft ball stage, then remove from heat and add peanut butter and marshmallow cream., Beat until smooth., Pour into buttered dish to cool.

title: Snowy Chocolate Pudding
directions: Combine flour, baking powder, sugar, 2 tablespoons cocoa and salt. Stir in milk, vanilla and shortening., Pour into greased 8-inch baking pan.

title: Scalloped Potatoes And Pork Chops
directions: Peel and slice potatoes thin., Mix onion, cream of mushroom soup and milk., Layer potatoes with butter., Add salt and pepper. Lay pork chops on top., Cook for 1 hour at 350°.

title: Potato Casserole
directions: Defrost patties., Crumble 4 patties in 9 x 13-inch dish., Salt and pepper., Top with margarine and 1/2 of cheese., Repeat layers. Pour half and half over mixture., Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Dirt Pudding
directions: Spread crushed cookies on bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan, reserving 1/2 cup crumbs for later use., Mix whipped topping, cream cheese, powdered sugar and butter., In separate bowl, mix the pudding with the milk., Mix with cream cheese mixture; spread over the cookies. Top with the leftover crumbs., Chill well.

title: Northern Chicken Wings
directions: Mix first four ingredients., Marinate chicken wings in mixture for as long as possible., If cooking a lot of wings, double recipe., Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Seven Layer Salad
directions: Layer lettuce, celery, green pepper, onion and peas. Spread mayo over all. Sprinkle sugar over mayo. Sprinkle cheese. Top with bacon. Refrigerate overnight or at least 4 hours before serving.

title: Potato-Vegetable Skillet
directions: Line a 10-inch skillet with 4 lettuce leaves., Set aside. Peel a 1/2-inch wide strip around center of each potato., Layer potatoes and next 3 ingredients over lettuce leaves., Add water and sprinkle with sugar, salt and pepper., Dot with butter.

title: Easy Chicken Pot Pie
directions: Mix together chicken, soup and vegetables. Pour into baked pie crust. Sprinkle grated cheese on top of chicken mixture. Crumble Ritz crackers on top. Bake at 350° until hot, about 20 minutes.

title: Pineapple Cheese Casserole
directions: Drain pineapple, save juice., Mix sugar and flour together. Add pineapple and cheese., Put in buttered casserole dish., Cover top with crushed Ritz crackers., Melt butter; add pineapple juice. Pour over casserole., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Chocolate Buttermilk Cake
directions: Bring margarine, cocoa and water to boil., Pour over sugar and flour., Mix eggs, buttermilk and soda and add., Pour in 9 x 13-inch greased and floured pan., Bake at 300° for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: French Dressing
directions: Mix all together in blender., Beat well for 5 minutes.

title: Rum Sauce
directions: In double boiler, melt sugar and butter in milk., Dissolve cornstarch in a little water and add to hot milk., Stir until thick, remove from heat and add rum.

title: Fiddle Faddle
directions: Combine and pour over 8 qt. popped corn., Bake at, 250° for 1 hour.

title: Cauliflower And Pea Salad
directions: Mix together dressing mix and mayo. Drizzle dressing over peas and cauliflower., Let stand overnight and mix together before serving.

title: Cranberry Punch
directions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water., Stir in lemonade., Add cold water and cranberry juice cocktail, chilled., Pour over ice in punch bowl., Slowly pour in ginger ale, chilled., Makes 12 cups.

title: English Toffee Bars
directions: Sprinkle pecans evenly in 9 x 9-inch pan., In saucepan, combine brown sugar and butter., Bring to a boil, stirring constantly. Boil for 7 minutes., Pour hot mixture over nuts., Sprinkle chocolate chips on top., Cover so chocolate chips melt., Spread chocolate evenly., Slice when warm or refrigerate and break into pieces.

title: Chunky Applesauce
directions: Peel and core apples., Slice apple in quarters., In a pan add water and apples., Cook over low heat., Lightly mash apples; add cinnamon and stir., Serve chunky warm or cold.

title: Peach-Orange-Pineapple Preserves
directions: Combine ingredients in saucepan and cook for about 30 minutes. Seal in sterilized jars.

title: Strawberry Pudding
directions: Heat strawberries and jello together; let cool., Mix instant pudding, milk, sour cream and Cool Whip together., Place in dish a layer of wafers, layer of pudding and then layer of strawberries. Put another layer of wafers and strawberries; top with pudding. Keep cool!

title: Spaghetti Casserole
directions: Cook first 5 ingredients until butter is melted., Add beef; when browned, add tomato sauce.

title: Ham Delights
directions: Mix first 5 ingredients to make spread; cook over low heat for a few minutes to soften onions., Cut the rolls apart as one, lengthwise (leave bottom half in the aluminum pan)., Cover bottom half of rolls with spread., Add ham and sprinkle with cheese., Replace top half of rolls., Bake for approximately 20 minutes at 350°.

title: Mayonnaise Dressing
directions: Cook until thick., Cool; pour over slaw.

title: Camellia Chocolate Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Grease and flour two 9-inch round cake pans., In a large mixer bowl, beat the sugar, butter, eggs and vanilla for about 5 minutes., Add water, whole wheat flour, cocoa, baking soda, salt, ginger and white of orange rind., Beat until blended., Pour into pans., Bake 28 to 33 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean., Cool 5 minutes., Remove from pan. Cool completely., Can be eaten plain or with a white frosting. The more adventurous might try a coconut frosting.

title: Mini Morsel Pound Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 325°., In small bowl, combine flour, baking powder and salt; set aside., In large mixer bowl, beat sugar, butter and vanilla extract until creamy., Beat in eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition., Gradually add flour mixture alternately with milk., Stir in mini morsels., Pour into greased and floured 10-inch fluted tube pan or 2 greased and floured 9 x 5-inch loaf pans., Bake for 70 to 80 minutes, or until toothpick inserted in center of cake comes out clean., Cool in pan for 15 minutes., Remove from pan; cool completely., Sprinkle with powdered sugar, if desired., Makes 16 to 20 servings.

title: Ham-Swiss Cheese Buns(Power Level: Low, 30% And High, 100%)
directions: Mix all ingredients except meat and buns in a 1-quart casserole., Microwave on High (100%) for 2 to 3 1/2 minutes or until boiling., Stir occasionally.

title: Southern Meat Loaf
directions: Combine all together and cook for 1 hour., Drain fat and cover top with ketchup and brown top., If using cheese, brown top after adding catsup.

title: Shakertown Inn Corn Pudding
directions: Blend butter, sugar, flour and salt., Add eggs, beating well. Stir in corn and milk., Pour ingredients into buttered casserole and bake at 325° for 45 minutes., Stir once when halfway through cooking period., When done, pudding will be golden brown and a silver knife inserted will come out clean., Shakertown uses frozen corn, however, canned or fresh corn may be used.

title: Taco Pie
directions: Cook hamburger and drain. Add taco seasoning, peppers, mushrooms and onions and cook until mixed well (about 5 minutes. Cover bottom and sides of baking dish with tortillas. Layer meat mixture, cheese, and salsa. Top with tortillas and layer again. Bake in 350° oven cheese is melted.

title: Banana Split
directions: Mix together and put in a 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake 10 minutes at 350°., Cool.

title: Dirt Cake
directions: Crush cookies into crumbs in a food processor; set aside. Cream sugar, cream cheese and butter; set aside., In a very large bowl, mix pudding, Cool Whip and milk., Add cream cheese mixture and blend it until it has a pudding consistency., Layer cookies and pudding into container., Begin and end with cookies., Chill 1 hour before serving., Put candied flowers on top and serve with a miniature shovel.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
directions: Cook until thickening., Pour into cooked, cool pie crust.

title: Watergate Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients together and chill.

title: Baptist Meatballs
directions: Combine milk, bread, onion, egg and salt., Add hamburg., Form into patties (will be very moist)., Brown in a skillet, then put into a casserole., Pour soup over the meatballs., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Shrimp Bacon Bites
directions: Mix shrimp, garlic, chili sauce and hot sauce., Cover and refrigerate for several hours., Cut bacon slices into halves. Cook bacon until limp; drain., Wrap each shrimp with a bacon piece; secure with a toothpick., Set oven to broil., Broil until bacon becomes crisp.

title: Persimmon Pudding
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Pour in a greased and floured 13 x 9-inch pan and bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes or until done.

title: Lemon Custard Cake
directions: Tear the angel food cake into bite size pieces., Place in a 13 x 9-inch pan., In a mixer bowl, combine pudding mix, milk and sour cream., Beat until thickened, about 2 minutes., Spread over cake. Spoon pie filling on top., Chill until serving time., Yield:, 12 to 16 servings.

title: Grandmie'S Peach Cobbler
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., In an 8 x 12-inch baking pan, melt butter., In large bowl or in blender container, combine 1 cup sugar, flour, milk and baking powder., Mix well., Pour mixture over butter in baking pan; do not stir., Arrange peaches on top.

title: Zucchini Cake
directions: Combine vegetable oil, butter, eggs and sugar., Add remaining ingredients except walnuts and dates., Mix well, then add nuts and dates., Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350°., Makes 3 layers.

title: Negative Calorie Soup
directions: Chop cabbage into small pieces., Drain French-cut green beans., Bring water to a boil., Add bouillon cubes, cabbage, onions, celery, green beans and tomatoes., Cook (in large pot) until cabbage is tender., This soup is called "Negative Calorie" because you will burn more calories making and eating this soup than are contained in the soup.

title: Holiday Salad
directions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water., Stir in cranberry sauce and undrained pineapple and finely chopped water chestnuts., Stir in with coarsely chopped walnuts., Pour into mold and chill until firm.

title: Holly Wreaths
directions: Cream butter and cream cheese., Add sugar, beat in vanilla. Add flour., Blend., Chill. Use cookie press to make various cookies., Bake at 375° for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: One-Step Yellow Cake
directions: Place all the ingredients in a large mixing bowl., Beat on high speed with a mixer for 4 minutes., Place in a 9 x 13 x 2-inch greased pan and bake at 375° for 20 minutes.

title: Applesauce Cake
directions: Put dry ingredients in bowl; add shortening, water and applesauce., Beat., Add egg; beat well., Fold in raisins and nuts. Bake 35 minutes or longer at 350°., Makes large cake., Frost with boiled brown sugar frosting.

title: Rice And Beans
directions: In covered pan, bring beans to boil until skins start to crack., Drain., Add water to cover beans., Add garlic., Heat large knife on fire until hot., Bang and fold salt pork until it becomes a paste texture, keeping knife hot., Add salt pork to beans., Add black and red pepper., Dash of salt is optional., Simmer 1 1/2 hours., Add rice to beans., Cook 25 minutes.

title: Pretzel Salad
directions: Place pretzels in bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan., Melt oleo and 3 tablespoons sugar and pour over pretzels., Bake at 400° for 8 minutes., Cool., Mix cream cheese, rest of sugar and Cool Whip and spread over pretzels., Mix jello according to directions on box. Let partially jell., Add apples and pecans., Pour over casserole mixture and refrigerate to set.

title: Blueberry Muffins(Low-Fat)
directions: Mix all ingredients well., Spray muffin tins with Pam., Bake at 375° for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Swiss-Basil Broccoli
directions: Melt margarine in a small nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add breadcrumbs and basil; saute 2 minutes or until lightly toasted; set aside.

title: Chili-Cheese Dip
directions: Combine all ingredients in a saucepan; cook over medium heat until cheese melts, stirring often., To serve, transfer dip to a chafing dish., Serve warm with tortilla chips., Yield:, 5 3/4 cups.

title: Lime Jello Salad
directions: Mix first 3 ingredients and cool., Add remaining ingredients. Refrigerate until set.

title: Strawberry Pretzel Salad
directions: Mix melted margarine and pretzels in 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake 10 minutes at 400°., Cool., Mix cream cheese and sugar., Add Cool Whip and put over cooled pretzels., Heat pineapple juice to boiling and dissolve jello in juice., Add frozen strawberries and cool until starts to gel., Pour over pretzels.

title: Hominy Casserole
directions: Fry bacon in skillet; remove and drain., Saute onion and green pepper in two tablespoons drippings., Add mushrooms, hominy and remaining ingredients to skillet., Simmer for a few minutes, until cheese is melted, stirring often., Put mixture in baking dish and top with crumbled bacon., Bake at 350° for at least 20 minutes, until bubbly.

title: Strawberry Punch
directions: Dissolve sugar in boiling water., Stir in orange juice and next 3 ingredients., Pour mixture into a large, plastic container, then freeze until firm.

title: Vegetable Dip
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Chill overnight., Serve with your favorite vegetables or chips.

title: Strawberry Jam Bread
directions: In a large bowl, cream the butter and sugar., Blend in vanilla and lemon extracts, then eggs., Beat mixture thoroughly., In a separate bowl, combine dry ingredients; set aside., In a third, smaller bowl, blend together the sour cream and jam., Stir dry ingredients into sugar-butter-egg mixture alternately with jam mixture., Stir until well blended., Stir in nuts., Pour batter into a greased and floured bread pan., Bake in preheated 350° oven for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Old Time Fruit Cake
directions: Mix together; add enough flour to make a stiff dough., Roll out each time for 1 layer at a time., Cut out with a pie pan., Put in a greased pan and bake., Will make 5 layers of cake., Put cooked apples or apple butter between layers.

title: Pasta Salad
directions: Cook pasta according to package directions, rinse and drain. Mix together., Refrigerate several hours before serving.

title: Walnut Caramels
directions: In a large, heavy, saucepan, combine sugar, corn syrup, butter and half of the, cream., Heat, to, boiling	over medium heat, stirring constantly., Stir	in remaining cream, nuts and vanilla. Cook over, medium heat, stirring occasionally, until mixture reaches a temperature, of, 244° on a candy thermometer (small amount dropped into very, cold, water, will form a firm ball)., As mixture becomes thick, stir constantly., Immediately pour mixture evenly, into a well-greased 8-inch square pan. Let stand until cool., Cut into 1-inch squares., Wrap individually in waxed paper or plastic film.

title: Pacific Northwest Barbecue For Salmon, Steelhead Or Trout
directions: Salmon/steelhead fillet or steak, cut out fins.

title: Tex-Mex Stew
directions: In Dutch oven, brown meat with garlic and chopped onion. Drain off grease., Drain and coarsely chop the tomatoes., Reserve juice. Add tomatoes, juice, picante sauce, cumin, salt and pepper to meat mixture. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat. Add corn and beans. Cover and simmer for 20 to 30 minutes. Serve with additional picante sauce., One dish dinner needs only a pan of cornbread or nacho chips.

title: Sausage And Tomatoes
directions: Fry sausage until done., Pour off oil., Add pepper and water, onion, tomatoes and paste., Let simmer for 20 minutes., Add mushrooms and cook until done., If it's too thick, add water until desired consistency., Serve hot over rice.

title: Grandma Gongdon'S War Cake(Circa 1916)
directions: Mix everything together, except the flour and soda., Boil 5 minutes., Cool., When cool, add the flour and soda, sifted together., Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake 45 to 55 minutes in 350° oven.

title: Hobo Dinner
directions: Layer ingredients in order given in a large pot., Simmer on low for 1 to 2 hours, according to amount you have in pot., Do not overcook., Do not let potatoes go to mush., Meat will flavor the whole pot of vegetables., When potatoes are tender, it is ready! Serve with cornbread., Very convenient and very good!

title: Deep Dish Apple Pie
directions: Sprinkle sugar, water, cinnamon and nutmeg over apples in loaf pan., Mix oleo, flour and brown sugar together and top apples. Bake at 325° for 50 minutes.

title: Broccoli-Grape Salad
directions: Stir together mayonnaise, sugar and vinegar., Stir in broccoli, and grapes.

title: Cornmeal Mush
directions: Mix dry ingredients with 1/2 cup water to make a smooth paste. Add paste slowly to 1 1/2 cups boiling water, stirring constantly until the mixture is thick and bubbly (approximately 10 minutes). Remove from heat and stir in eggs.

title: Saucy Dip
directions: Heat wieners in hot water., Score through center., Add 1/2 slice of cheese., Dip tortilla in hot fat., Place wiener in tortilla and add sauce., Roll up and secure with toothpick. Deep-fry until crisp., Serve with refried beans.

title: Mock Pineapple Cheese Pie(Low-Fat)
directions: Pour hot water in blender with gelatin., Blend., Add pineapple and blend for 3 minutes., Add sweetener and flavorings., Slowly add powdered milk., Blend well, pour into 9-inch pie pan., Sprinkle with cinnamon, refrigerate.

title: Mexican Fruit Cake
directions: Stir together. Pour into greased and floured 9 x 13 pan. Bake in 350° oven about 40 minutes or until firm to the touch.

title: Chicken Pie
directions: Saute celery and onion until tender., Mix with other ingredients, adding broth until desired consistency is reached. Bake, uncovered, 45 minutes in 350° oven.

title: Hancock'S Harbor Crab Cakes
directions: Fold crabmeat into white sauce., Roll into round cake shapes. Dip into egg and milk mixture, roll in "Shake and Blend" flour. Roll in Italian flavored bread crumbs., Deep fry until brown.

title: Strawberry Pretzel Dessert(Serves 4)
directions: Mix crushed pretzels (small pieces) with melted margarine and 3 teaspoons sugar., Spread in a 9 x 13-inch pan, press down and bake 8 minutes at 400°., Mix well cream cheese and 1 cup sugar. Fold into medium Cool Whip and spread over cooled pretzel layer; chill until firm.

title: Chicken Vermicelli
directions: Boil chicken and remove from broth and bone., Skim fat from broth., Add next 8 ingredients plus oregano., Cook until potatoes are tender., Add vermicelli noodles., Cook on low for 1 hour., Add water to broth as needed., Serve with Parmesan cheese.

title: Marie'S Gingered Carrots
directions: Peel and slice carrots. Place in saucepan with water and salt. Cook on medium heat until almost done. Add sugar, butter and ginger. Simmer until most of the liquid is gone., Serve hot.

title: Panettone(Easter Or Christmas Fruit Bread)
directions: Dissolve yeast in 1/4 cup warm water., Add warm milk, sugar and sifted flour., Cover and let rise for 1 hour., Cream butter with sugar; break in whole eggs and beat well., Add egg yolks and mix well., Add egg mixture to yeast sponge and rest of flour until dough is not sticky (loose from bowl)., Knead good.

title: Turkey Pasta Salad
directions: Cook pasta according to package directions., Drain and rinse. Place in a 2 1/2-quart salad bowl., Add turkey, celery, onion and green pepper; toss to mix.

title: Caramel Date Drops
directions: Cream butter, sugar and egg together until fluffy., Mix in vanilla., In separate bowl, stir together flour, soda, baking powder and salt., Add to creamed mixture alternately with sour cream., Stir in dates and nuts., Drop by a rounded teaspoonful onto greased baking sheets., Bake in a 400° oven for 10 minutes or until golden brown., Remove immediately to wire racks and let cool., Spread with frosting. Makes about 3 1/2 dozen.

title: Mulberry Pie
directions: Lightly mix and pour into unbaked pie shell., Bake at 350° until crust is light brown.

title: Congo Bars
directions: Melt butter in saucepan over low heat. Remove from heat and add sugar and mix well. Stir in eggs, then sift dry ingredients into mixture. Mix in chocolate chips and nuts. Cook in a greased 13 x 9-inch pan for 30 to 35 minutes at 350°. Cool in pan and cut when cooled.

title: Gnocchi, Fisherman-Style
directions: In a food processor, smoothly puree fish, adding eggs one at a time., Pour in cream with motor running., (If using a blender, smoothly puree fish and eggs; scrape container sides., Add cream with motor running.), If making ahead, cover and chill up to 3 hours.

title: Creamy Swiss Egg Bake
directions: In saucepan, combine soup, milk, onions and mustard., Cook and stir until smooth and heated through., Remove from heat., Stir in cheese until melted., Pour 1 cup of sauce into each of two 10 x 6 x 1 1/2-inch baking dishes., Break 6 eggs into sauce in each casserole., Carefully spoon remaining sauce around eggs., Stand bread slices around outside edge of casseroles., Bake in a 350° oven for 15 to 20 minutes, until eggs are set., Garnish with parsley.

title: Egg Rolls
directions: Dice the cabbage and onions., Dice sausage., In skillet, brown sausage., Add cabbage and onions to sausage., Season with soy sauce and a pinch of pepper., Cook all ingredients until cabbage is cooked.

title: Easy Caramel Frosting
directions: Melt butter in saucepan., Stir in brown sugar., Cook and stir 2 minutes., Cool to lukewarm., Put in mixing bowl., Add sugar and vanilla., Beat until of spreading consistency., Put on cool cake.

title: Bursa Danasi(Baked Veal With Noodles)
directions: Season veal with garlic, pepper, salt, herbs and wine and marinate in the refrigerator for 5 hours., Turn steak after 2 hours., Drain., Pat dry with paper towels.

title: Tuna Casserole
directions: Cook noodles and drain according to directions on box., Mix with celery and bell pepper (diced), pickles, tuna and Miracle Whip., Salt as needed., Better served chilled.

title: Pepperoni Cake
directions: Mix yeast, water and 1 cup flour; set aside., Beat eggs well; add flour, mixing thoroughly., Add yeast mixture, cheeses and pepperoni., Pour mixture in a greased (spray with Pam) Bundt pan. Let rise 1 hour., Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

title: Broccoli Balls
directions: Mix all ingredients except for Swiss or Cheddar cheese and broccoli., Add well drained broccoli and mix well., Make into balls using ice-cream scoop (this can be frozen at this time)., Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes., Remove and add cheese (if you like, you can also add cracker crumbs or onion rings at this time)., Place back in oven and bake until cheese is melted., I usually make half of mine with Cheddar and half with Swiss cheese., You can also make this into a casserole instead of the balls., Makes 12.

title: Palm Sunday Brunch Quiche
directions: Spray 9x13-inch glass baking dish with non-stick spray., Put bread in pan., In a bowl, whisk eggs, add mustard and stir, then add milk and pepper and stir., Pour over the bread., Top with chopped ham, onion, green pepper, and cheese., Cover and refrigerate at least 8 hours or over night.

title: Sale Ham And Bean Soup
directions: Cook ham hock until soft., Trim off all fat., Cook all vegetables separately., Mix together with cubed ham., Heat and serve., Good luck!

title: Fruit Dip
directions: Bring the cream cheese to room temperature., Add fruit juice to consistency desired., Add powdered sugar to thicken, then whipped cream., Blend.

title: Paella
directions: Heat 3 tablespoons of the oil in 14-inch paella pan or heavy ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat until hot., Add chicken; brown lightly on all sides, 10 to 15 minutes., Remove chicken with slotted spoon.

title: Charlene'S Spinach Dip
directions: Heat cheese soup and cream cheese until soft; add bacon, spinach and all other seasonings., Hollow out a loaf of round rye bread., Put spinach dip (hot) into loaf for serving., Cut the bread you hollowed out into pieces for dipping into dip.

title: Pasta Salad
directions: Cook pasta as directed; drain and let cool., In large bowl, combine pasta and cut up vegetables., Pour dressing over pasta combination., Chill at least 1 hour before serving to marinate.

title: Noel Cherry Pie
directions: Drain cherries; add juice and milk until thick., Fold in cream, cherries and nuts., Pour in pie shell and chill!

title: Low-Fat Chicken And Rice Soup(Serves 6 To 8)
directions: Combine broth and uncooked rice. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cover and simmer for 40 to 45 minutes. Stir in onions and carrots and cook for 5 more minutes. Combine, milk, flour and pepper. Stir into rice mixture., Cook and stir until slightly thickened and bubbly. Cook and stir 1 minute more. Stir in sherry. Garnish with fresh parsley or chives before serving.

title: Potatoes "Pooche"
directions: Cube raw potatoes., Place in saucepan., Add butter., Add remaining ingredients and pour over this just enough water to cover., Bring to a boil; lower heat and cook until potatoes are done., Above all, don't disturb, stir or mix., Let potatoes soak up flavor and juices which will thicken to nice consistency.

title: Deep Dark Chocolate Cake
directions: Combine dry ingredients together., Add remaining ingredients except boiling water., Beat for 2 minutes, then add boiling water. Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Monster Cookies
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Place on greased cookie sheet and flatten slightly., Cookies should be about 5-inches in diameter., Bake at 350° for 12 minutes., Makes a huge amount.

title: Lemonade Or Limeade
directions: Mix lemon or lime juice, sugar, water and ice cubes., Add peel. Chill.

title: Peanut Butter Balls
directions: Cream together oleo, peanut butter and powdered sugar., Then mix in Rice Krispies cereal., Shape into balls., Put on cookie sheet., Refrigerate until firm., Melt chocolate chips and wax together in a double boiler., Dip balls in chocolate and place on waxed paper to set., Refrigerate.

title: Spaghetti Squash Casserole
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Place whole squash in a large pot with enough water to cover., Bring to a boil; simmer, covered, for 30 minutes or until skin is tender., Remove from water; cool., When cool enough to handle, cut in two and scrape out inside, discarding seeds and stringy center part., Butter casserole dish. Layer squash, Mozzarella and sauce, repeating layers., Top with Parmesan., Leftover squash may be served with butter and Parmesan at another meal., Freezes well., Serve both dishes hot.

title: Marinated Vegetables
directions: Drain vegetables and mix., Bring last three ingredients to a boil., Pour over vegetables; refrigerate.

title: Crab Dip
directions: Heat soup and large cream cheese together, then beat until smooth., Add gelatin (softened first in 3 tablespoons water)., Add celery, mayonnaise, green onions and crab., Pour into mold. Chill.

title: Lazy Daisy Oatmeal Cake
directions: Pour boiling water over oats., Let stand 20 minutes., Beat butter until creamy., Gradually add sugar and beat until fluffy. Blend in vanilla and eggs., Stir in oats., Sift together flour, soda, salt and spices and add to creamed mixture., Mix well., Pour into greased and floured 9-inch square pan., Bake in preheated oven at 350°, for 50 to 55 minutes., Do not remove from pan.

title: Mom Pepp'S Date Drops
directions: Sprinkle soda on dates; pour hot water over., Cream the butter and sugar together., Add eggs and vanilla., Mix flour and salt; add to egg mixture., Stir in date mixture; mix well., Drop from a spoon onto greased cookie sheet., Bake in a 350° oven until brown.

title: Creamy Cranberry Salad
directions: Dissolve gelatin in hot water., Blend in relish, chill until partially set., Beat together cream cheese and sour cream., Blend in cottage cheese and nuts., Fold cream cheese mixture into gelatin., Pour into a 4 cup mold., Chill until set., Unmold on bed of lettuce.

title: Baked Bananas
directions: Place the unpeeled bananas in a shallow baking pan., Bake the bananas in a 325° oven for 20 to 25 minutes or until a fork will pierce the bananas easily., To serve, make 2 lengthwise slits, 1/2 to 3/4-inch apart, through the peel of each banana., Remove the peel between the slits., Sprinkle each banana with a little lemon or lime juice and a little brown sugar., Top each banana with a few finely chopped peanuts., Makes 4 servings.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Thaw and mix broccoli with soup, eggs, mayonnaise, cheese, oil and salt., Top with crumbs and dot with butter., Bake 35 to 45 minutes at 350° or double and bake 1 hour.

title: Simple Pesto Sauce
directions: Combine all ingredients in a food processor., Blend until well incorporated., Use by tossing into hot cooked pasta.

title: Strawberry Cookies
directions: Mix ingredients, except red crystal sugar., Shape into strawberry shape and roll in red crystal sugar., Cut leaves from construction paper or silk green leaves., Dye toothpicks green and cut in half for stems.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Combine and bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Pepper Relish
directions: Mince or chop peppers and onions., Cover with boiling water and let stand for 15 or 20 minutes; drain., Add the seed, vinegar, salt and sugar., Boil 20 or 25 minutes., Pack in jars.

title: Marinated Chicken
directions: Combine first 8 ingredients., Add chicken breasts., Coat well and refrigerate overnight., Remove chicken and roll in cracker crumbs., Arrange in shallow pan., Pour 1/4 of margarine over chicken and bake at 1 hour at 300°., Spoon rest of margarine over chicken and bake 45 minutes more.

title: Million Dollar Fudge
directions: Bring Carnation milk, sugar, margarine and salt to boil and boil 4 1/2 minutes, stirring constantly., Remove from stove and pour over the Marshmallow Creme, nuts, chocolate and chocolate chips., Stir with large spoon continuously until all chocolate is melted., Add vanilla., Pour into buttered pans and refrigerate until firm.

title: Mexicali Dip
directions: Combine all ingredients and cook over low heat until cheese is melted and mixed well., Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Pear Honey
directions: Peel pears and crush enough to make 8 cups., Combine crushed pears with the other ingredients., Simmer until thickened., Put in hot jars and seal.

title: Fried Rice
directions: Chop beef in very small pieces., Brown meat with onion, carrots, peppers and celery., Scramble eggs very dry., Add this mixture together with cooked rice., Then, add remaining ingredients.

title: Quick Salad
directions: Mix cottage cheese, jello and pineapple., Add Cool Whip. Sprinkle with ground nuts., Chill.

title: Springtime Lime Slushy
directions: In freezer container, dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Stir in the cold water and sherbet until combined., Freeze for 4 hours or until set., Remove from freezer 45 minutes before serving., For each serving, place 1 cup of slush mixture in a glass; add 1/3 cup ginger ale., Yields 8 servings.

title: Dill Dip For Vegetables
directions: Mix together and keep refrigerated.

title: Lentil Soup
directions: Simmer lentils and water covered 1 hour., Saute onion, green pepper and garlic in margarine until tender., Add to cooked lentil stock remainder of ingredients., Simmer for 30 minutes., Serve with Italian bread.

title: French Cream Mint Brownies
directions: Cream sugar and butter; blend in eggs, chocolate, flour and baking powder. Put into greased jelly roll pan. Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes., Chill.

title: "Impossible" Quiche
directions: Heat oven to 400°., Grease pie plate., Cook beef and onion and put in plate., Sprinkle cheese over meat., Beat remaining ingredients until smooth and pour over cheese., Cook 30 minutes; let stand 5 minutes before cutting.

title: Hamburger Monterey
directions: Dice bacon and fry until crisp., Set aside., Shape beef into tiny balls., Cook in bacon fat until brown., Remove., Slice onion and dice pepper., Cook until lightly brown., Add beans, tomato soup,, chili powder, macaroni, salt and Accent., Simmer 10 minutes., Grate cheese., Add and stir until cheese melts., Add bacon and meat balls., Simmer 15 minutes. Serves 6., Delicious with corn bread.

title: Salmon Party Spread
directions: Dissolve gelatin and salt in boiling water., Blend in sour cream, mayonnaise, lemon juice, onion and horseradish; chill until thickened., Fold in salmon and dill weed., Spoon into mold., Chill until firm at least 3 hours., Unmold., Serve as an appetizer surrounded with crackers or raw vegetables.

title: Cabbage Relish
directions: Cut up vegetables and set aside., Bring remaining ingredients to boil and pour over cabbage while hot., Can keep in refrigerator for two weeks.

title: Cowboy Cookies
directions: Sift together and set aside the flour, soda, salt and baking powder. Blend together shortening and sugars. Add eggs and beat until light and fluffy. Add flour mixture and mix well. Stir in oats, vanilla and chocolate. Dough is crumbly. Drop by teaspoonful on a greased cookie sheet and bake 15 minutes in 350° oven. Makes 11 dozen.

title: Chicken Divan(Recipe Serves 5 To 6 People)
directions: Simmer chicken until tender., Cook broccoli in salted water; drain., Arrange broccoli in greased casserole dish., Place halved chicken breast on top of broccoli., Combine soup, mayonnaise, lemon juice, curry powder and pour over chicken., Sprinkle cheese and bread crumbs on top., Bake at 350° for 25 minutes., Prepare rice for six people and serve.

title: Layered Taco Dip
directions: Using a 9 x 13-inch pan, first layer the bean dip, then browned hamburger, then sour cream and cream cheese (creamed together with 1the taco seasoning), then spread 1 jar of salsa over top., Top with shredded lettuce, diced tomatoes, onions, shredded cheese and olives.

title: Ham Rolls
directions: Slice rolls., Put on cheese and ham., Put top on., Mix other ingredients and pour over rolls., Leave uncovered until margarine sets. Cover and bake 15 minutes at 350°., Can be frozen.

title: L. B. J. (Pres. Johnson'S) Favorite Pecan Pie
directions: Mix together sugar, syrup, butter an salt and cook until dissolved., While this is cooking, beat eggs until foamy., Add small amount of hot mixture gradually to eggs (stirring constantly with whisk)., This will raise temperature of eggs to prevent separation when gradually added to the remaining hot mixture (stirring rapidly)., Add pecans and vanilla., Pour into unbaked pie shell and bake at 350 for 30 to 40 minutes, or until the pie has set., Cool on rack.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Boil fryer, celery, onion and poultry seasoning until chicken is done., Remove chicken from bone and chop. Save broth., Toss stuffing mix with melted margarine and place a layer of stuffing mix in large Pyrex dish., Cover with a layer of chicken, a can of mushroom soup and 1 1/2 cans of broth., Place another layer of chicken, a can of cream of chicken soup and 1 1/2 cans of broth. Finish with layer of stuffing mix., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Coleslaw, Sweet And Sour
directions: Bring sugar and water to boil. Let cool and add vinegar. Pour over shredded cabbage. Season as desired. Refrigerate.

title: Gingerbread
directions: Cream the sugar and butter., Add beaten egg and molasses, then the dry ingredients. Add boiling water last., Beat until smooth. Bake in a greased shallow pan at 350° for 35 minutes or until cake springs back when touched lightly., Very good when served warm with whipped cream.

title: Brownies
directions: Combine ingredients., Beat flour mixture at medium speed. Spread in buttered 8 x 8-inch pan., Bake at 325° for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Hot Chocolate Mix
directions: Mix well., Will make 2 gallons., To make 1 cup: Use 1/3 cup mix., Add boiling water to make 1 cup hot cocoa., Store in an airtight container., Keeps indefinitely.

title: Favorite Beef Stew
directions: Brown meat in hot shortening in Dutch oven., Add water, lemon juice, Worcestershire sauce, onion, bay leaf and seasonings. Bring to a boil., Simmer, covered tightly, for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Homemade Vanilla Ice Cream
directions: Beat eggs. Add sugar gradually to eggs and continue to beat until mixture is very stiff., Add milk, heavy cream, vanilla and salt., Mix thoroughly., Pour into can and freeze as directed with ice cream maker.

title: Cranberry Salad
directions: Mix jello and hot water, then add cranberries., Let cool, but not gel., Add the pineapple, orange, celery and pecans. Refrigerate until firm., Serve., Keep refrigerated.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
directions: Bake potatoes until soft; peel., Beat in oleo, sugar, cinnamon, nutmeg and vanilla; cool., Beat in egg and enough cream to make mixture smooth and thick.

title: Chicken Enchilada Casserole
directions: Mix chicken, soups, chilies and 1/2 bag Doritos., Put in casserole dish and top with cheese and remaining Doritos., Cook until bubbles at 350°., Serves 6 to 8.

title: Corn Pudding
directions: Combine whole kernel corn, creamed corn and beaten eggs., Add mixture of dry ingredients and minced onion., Stir in each: 1/2 cup milk and 1/2 cup melted butter., Pour into greased 3-quart casserole., Bake in 400° oven 1 hour, stirring once during baking.

title: Rice Pudding
directions: Combine half and half, water, sugar, rice, oleo and salt in large saucepan and bring to a boil., Simmer, stirring frequently, for 40 minutes or more., Add raisins., Remove from heat., Beat eggs with enough water to make 1 cup., Add to rice mixture, beating in quickly with a spoon., Add vanilla., Return to stove and bring to a boil., Refrigerate.

title: Peanut Butter Candy
directions: Cook the first 4 ingredients until a drop forms a ball in cold water., Remove from heat and add the peanut butter; stir until it is thick enough to spread., Pour in a platter; let it cool a while. Cut in squares.

title: Chesapeake Baked Beans
directions: Combine all ingredients, except bacon; mix well., Pour into large casserole., Lay bacon across the top of the beans., Bake at 375° for 45 minutes.

title: 1-2-3-4 Cake
directions: Cream butter and sugar until fluffy; add eggs, one at a time. Beat in well., Sift flour, salt and baking powder 3 times., Add flour and milk in small amounts, starting and ending with flour. Add lemon and vanilla extracts., Bake in a 350° oven about 60 minutes in 10 1/2-inch angel food pan or 35 to 40 minutes in deep 9-inch layer pans., Ice as desired.

title: Cheesy-Broccoli Soup
directions: Cook broccoli according to package directions, omitting salt. Drain well., Saute onion and green pepper in butter in medium saucepan., Add broccoli and remaining ingredients to saucepan. Cook over medium heat until cheese melts, stirring often., Serve immediately.

title: Burrito Casserole
directions: Cook beef with onion and garlic; drain fat. Mix tomato sauce with browned hamburger and onions; set aside. Soften tortillas in microwave. Spread first tortilla with refried beans; sprinkle heavily with grated cheese. Put in the bottom of a round 1 1/2-quart casserole.

title: Sawdust Pie
directions: Combine first 7 ingredients in a large bowl, mixing well. Stir in egg whites just until blended., Pour into pastry shell. Bake at 350° for 35 minutes., Top each slice with whipped cream and banana slices., Serve warm.

title: Onion Pie
directions: Slice onions; add salt and pepper and smother in butter until tender., Cover bottom of casserole with cracker crumbs., Cook bacon until crisp., When onions are very tender, place on top of crackers along with butter they were cooked in., Crumble bacon on top of onions., Top with grated cheese., Beat eggs well; add sour cream and blend well., Pour over the cheese., Sprinkle with paprika., Cover with foil and bake at 350° until set, about 35 minutes.

title: Egg Custard
directions: Mix together all ingredients and pour in deep pie crust, uncooked., Cook at 350° until done.

title: Chicken Salad
directions: Combine first 5 ingredients., Combine mayonnaise, sour cream, lemon juice and sugar and pour over chicken mixture., Toss gently and chill thoroughly., Serve on lettuce leaves.

title: Country Carrot Frosting
directions: Cream well the butter and cream cheese., Add sugar and vanilla., Beat well., Add pineapple.

title: Come On Over Cake
directions: Grease a 9 x 13-inch baking pan., Crush crackers., Mix with nuts and baking powder., Beat egg whites and sugar with vanilla. Fold cracker mix into egg whites and bake at 300° for 40 minutes. Cool completely.

title: My Mom'S Chocolate Cake
directions: Mix as usual, adding the hot water last. Bake at 350° for 35 minutes. Use chocolate buttercream frosting for the icing.

title: Corinne'S Moist Meat Loaf
directions: Mix all ingredients well and place in loaf pan., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Hamburger Bake
directions: Press hamburger in 8 x 8-inch baking dish., Add seasonings, chopped green pepper and onion., Add undiluted soup on top., Top with Tater Tots., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Homemade Zucchini Bread(Makes 2 Loaves)
directions: Beat eggs until foamy., Stir in sugar, zucchini, oil and vanilla., Gradually add dry ingredients and spices., Stir in nuts.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 375°., Mix flour, baking soda, and salt., Set aside., Cream butter or margarine and sugars., Beat in eggs and vanilla until light and fluffy., Blend in flour mixture., Stir in chocolate chips., Drop dough by teaspoonfuls onto ungreased baking sheet., Bake 8-10 minutes and let cool.

title: Meat Loaf - Barbecue Style
directions: Mix together beef, crumbs, onion, egg, salt, pepper and 1/2 can tomato sauce., Form into loaf and place into shallow 8 x 10-inch baking dish., Combine rest of sauce and all other ingredients; mix well., Pour over loaf., Bake in a 350° oven for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Outrageous Chocolate Chip Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Beat sugars, margarine, peanut butter, vanilla and egg in medium bowl with wooden spoon until creamy and well blended., Mix in flour, oats, soda and salt; stir., Stir in chocolate chips; drop rounded teaspoonfuls about 2 inches apart. Recipe may be doubled.

title: Crusty Coconut Pie
directions: Pour milk over coconut and set aside while creaming butter and sugar., Add eggs and beat mixture well., Add milk, coconut and flavoring., Pour into unbaked pie shell., Bake at 350° for about 30 minutes or until pie is golden brown.

title: Ground Meat On Rye(Great Do Ahead)
directions: Cook beef and sausage; drain well., Add cheese., Mix well. Spread on bread., Put on flat tray., Freeze., When frozen, put into freezer bag., To serve:, Put under broiler until hot and bubbly.

title: Diamond Jubilee Dip
directions: Blend milk, mayonnaise and lemon juice until smooth., Add all other ingredients and stir., Serve with crackers or fresh veggies as a dip.

title: Fruit Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients well in a large bowl., Refrigerate.

title: Bean Soup
directions: Cook hamburger and sausage in crock-pot., Drain off grease. Add 4 cups water, lima beans, onion (cut-up) and seasonings. Cover and cook all day on medium heat.

title: Basil Chicken And Rice
directions: Remove skin and fat from chicken., Wash and place in a large skillet on high heat., Turn chicken on both sides until meat is cooked white on the outside., Add soy sauce, basil, garlic powder and Worcestershire., Make sure all pieces of chicken are coated in sauce., Turn heat to low and cover skillet., Cook until chicken is tender, about 30 to 45 minutes., Serve juice as a gravy for rice.

title: Hot Rolls
directions: Scald milk., Add sugar, salt, shortening and 1/2 cup water. Add yeast to other 1/2 cup of water., Add flour., When dough is stiff, turn out on floured board and knead until smooth., Place in greased bowl and let rise., Punch down., Let rise again., Roll out and cut and let rise in pan., Ready to bake for 1 hour.

title: Ham Roll-Ups
directions: Clean mushrooms and chop finely., Add to cream cheese and chives., Place 1 teaspoon of mixture on ham slice, add green onion and roll up., Serve chilled.

title: Bread And Butter Pickles
directions: Combine cucumbers, onions, garlic and salt in large stockpot. Cover with cracked ice (about 2-inches). Cover and refrigerate for 3 hours. Drain mixture well. Remove garlic. In same stockpot combine sugar, vinegar, mustard seed, turmeric, and celery seed. Heat to a rolling boil for 2 minutes. Add cucumber mixture. Return to boiling.

title: Ruby Wine Punch
directions: In saucepan, combine sugar, water, cinnamon sticks, cloves and salt., Boil., Reduce heat; simmer 10 minutes., Strain spices., Add to liquid and chill., Yield:, 7 cups.

title: Baked Lasagna
directions: In skillet, brown beef and garlic., After browned, drain oil and add everything except cheese and simmer for 30 minutes., Cook lasagna noodles., Mix cheeses together., Make two layers in baking dish: noodles, meat sauce and cheese mixture., Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Hamburger Home Made Vegetable Soup
directions: Leave vegetables in the water., Then, mix the vegetables and spaghetti sauce., While this is cooking take a pan and brown meat. When vegetables are done, mix in the meat, and simmer. If more liquid is needed, add blended tomatoes, or add water., Add salt and pepper to taste., Nature seasoning is good instead of salt and pepper.

title: Cantaloupe Preserves
directions: Peel cantaloupe and cut in thin slices 1-inch long., Mix sugar and cantaloupe and let stand overnight., Add lemon juice; cook until clear., Pour into Kerr half-pint jars to within 1/2-inch of top., Put on cap; screw band firmly tight., Process 5 minutes in boiling water bath., Yield:, 4 (8 ounce) jars.

title: Bran Muffins
directions: Sift flour, baking powder and salt., Mix in sugar or honey, bran and milk., Let set a few minutes., Add egg and shortening and beat well., Add dry ingredients and stir only to mix., Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Fruit Cake For Diabetics(No Sugar)
directions: Cook raisins in water until water disappears., Add applesauce, eggs, Sweeta and oil., Mix well., Combine dry ingredients and add to first mixture., Add vanilla and mix well., Pour into one large, greased loaf pan and two smaller ones., (I use a tube pan.), Bake at 350° for 1 hour., (Exchange for each 3 x 3-inch square: 1 bread and 1 fruit.)

title: Ham And Cheese Balls
directions: Mix magarine, mustard, Worcestershire sauce, poppy seed and onion together in skillet., Cook over low heat until onion is tender., Split rolls in half; brush margarine mixture over bottom and top half of rolls., Put ham on each slice of bottom layer; next spread cheese evenly and over ham layer., Put top of rolls back on ham and cheese., Place in same pan rolls came in., Cover with aluminum foil., Bake for 25 to 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Beef Stuff
directions: Cut meat in 1/4-inch slices., Put meat, onion and garlic in a large frying pan and brown., Add vegetables and water., Simmer for 30 minutes., More water may be needed., Mix 2 tablespoons flour and 2 tablespoons water to make gravy., Add to meat and vegetables., Serve over rice or noodles., This is a great way to use leftover vegetables.

title: Cheese Ball
directions: Combine all ingredients and mix well., This is best done using your hands to mix., Shape into a ball and roll in nuts or chopped olives, if desired., Wrap in waxed paper and then in airtight container.

title: Easy Coffee Cake
directions: Combine and heat in microwave., Pour about 1/2 cup mixture in greased Bundt pan., Separate and arrange 2 cans Hungry Jack biscuits in pan., Pour remaining sauce over., Bake at 375° for 20 minutes.

title: Old Fashioned Sugar Cookies
directions: Cream first 4 ingredients together., Sift flour, baking powder and salt together., Add dry ingredients alternately with milk. Roll and cut., Sprinkle with sugar, then place on cookie sheet. Bake 8 to 12 minutes in preheated oven at 350°.

title: Sherry'S Sandies
directions: Cream butter, sugar, water and vanilla and mix well., Blend in flour and nuts., Chill 4 hours., Shape in balls or fingers., Bake at 325° for 20 minutes.

title: Turtle Cake
directions: Mix the cake according to directions., Grease and flour a 9 x 13-inch pan and pour 1/2 the batter into pan., Put this half of cake in oven and bake at 350° for 15 minutes., In a saucepan over low heat, melt caramels with butter and milk., Remove cake from oven and pour the caramel mixture over the half-baked cake., Top with chocolate chips and pecans., Pour remaining cake mix over the top and return to oven., Bake at 350° for another 20 minutes.

title: Curried Rice Salad
directions: Saute curry in butter, stir in chicken broth and bring to boil., Add rice and green pepper, cover and simmer 20 minutes. Remove from heat, add onion and lemon juice; chill., Stir in mayonnaise, milk, peas and almonds.

title: 1 Dish Pork Chops
directions: Mix brown sugar, Worcestershire sauce and soy sauce together for sauce., Quickly brown pork chops on both sides in a deep skillet and put onion slice, then the apple, then the yam on top of each pork chop., Pour the sauce over., Put lid on and cook on low on top of the stove or 325° in oven for 1 hour., You may add raisins if desired.

title: Dijon Chicken Salad
directions: In a bowl, combine the chicken, celery, green grape halves, red grape halves, apricots and onions., In a small bowl, combine the mayonnaise, honey, mustard, salt and pepper. Mix well., Stir into chicken mixture., Cover and refrigerate until serving., Serve on lettuce-lined plate., Sprinkle with almonds.

title: Taco Casserole
directions: Cook meat, onion, tomato sauce, chili powder, salt and pepper. Put beans in casserole dish; cover with tortillas, then half of cheese., Pour meat mixture over this; cover with rest of cheese. Cover with foil., Bake for 20 minutes at 375°., Freezes well.

title: Delmonico Potatoes
directions: In greased 12-inch baking dish, arrange potatoes., Pour cream over all and sprinkle with salt, pepper and cheese., Bake in 400° oven for 25 minutes.

title: Creamsicles
directions: Whip dry milk powder with 2/3 cup ice water to soft peaks. Stir in juice concentrate and 1 cup of water., Pour into 6 popsicle molds and freeze firm.

title: Creamy Roquefort Dressing
directions: Combine ingredients., Serve on tossed salad greens., Makes about 1 cup.

title: Poor Man'S Butter
directions: Blend well and put into refrigerator., Do not eat until chilled.

title: Lemon-Glazed Nectar Cake
directions: Mix cake mix and sugar., Blend in eggs and oil., Beat 6 minutes at medium speed., Pour batter into greased and floured tube pan., Bake in 350° oven about 50 minutes., Remove from pan onto cake rack; place rack on waxed paper., Top with Lemon Glaze.

title: Chicken Spaghetti
directions: Cook spaghetti	according, to package directions;, then place in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan., Place deboned chicken all across spaghetti.	Saute onions and bell pepper with margarine until onions are	clear.	Then, add pimentos, mushrooms, black olives and water chestnuts., Add soup and milk., Mix thoroughly., Pour on top of spaghetti and chicken., Place thin slices of Velveeta cheese all	over top., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until cheese is bubbling.

title: Moon Cake
directions: Boil water and butter.	Remove from heat and add 1 c. flour. Add eggs, one at a time., Spread on large cookie sheet., Bake at 400° for 30 minutes. Cool.	Make vanilla pudding., Mix in cream cheese and spread on top of cake., Top with Cool Whip. Drizzle chocolate syrup over top.

title: Broccoli Corn Bread
directions: Boil broccoli and onion for 3 minutes., Beat eggs; melt margarine in microwave and mix all ingredients together., Butter or spray two 13 x 9-inch pans., Pour into pans., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until done., Recipe may be halved.

title: Haystacks
directions: Mix together and drop by teaspoon on wax paper.

title: Italian Chicken Pasta
directions: Boil pasta in 6 cups water with bouillon. Drain and set aside. In skillet, pour 1 tablespoon olive oil and heat., Saute chopped garlic, zucchini, basil, oregano, salt and pepper for 1 to 2 minutes. Add chicken and cook until chicken is done and zucchini is tender, tossing lightly., Add tomatoes; reduce heat., Cook for 15 to 20 minutes., Serve over pasta., Garnish with freshly grated Parmesan., Serves 2.

title: Cheese And Broccoli Soup
directions: Melt butter in large saucepan., Add onion and garlic; saute until tender., Sprinkle flour over and cook, stirring constantly to make thickening., Gradually add broth and water, stirring constantly., Bring to boil, stirring frequently., Add broccoli, thyme, and pepper., Cover and simmer until broccoli is tender. Stir together cream and egg yolk., Stir a little soup into cream mixture until warm., Add to saucepan, stirring constantly., Add cheese; stir until smooth and blended., Do not let boil., Serves 6.

title: Baked Pineapple Dish
directions: Cream sugar and margarine., Add eggs, pineapple and bread., Put in buttered baking dish and bake 40 to 50 minutes at 350°.

title: Peach Smash
directions: In blender combine 2 ripe peaches (unpeeled) and cut in chunks (canned peaches will work) with can of frozen lemonade concentrate and rum., Fill blender with crushed ice and blend.

title: Chicken Rice Casserole(Serves 12 To 15)
directions: Mix chicken, rice, celery, cream of chicken soup, onion and lemon juice. Add mayonnaise which has been mixed with water. Add hard-boiled eggs. Fold all together gently and place in 9 x 13 greased pan. Make the day ahead. Take out 1 hour before baking. Top with crushed barbecue or regular crushed potato chips. Bake at 375° for 45 to 60 minutes. Don't overcook.

title: Bran Muffins
directions: Mix and store in refrigerator. Let stand at least 2 days before using. Keeps up to 6 weeks. Bake in greased muffin pans at 400 for 15 minutes. Yields 6 dozen. These can be baked immediately after mixing if you desire.

title: Spinach Lasagna
