directions: Cook spinach and reserve liquid (strain spinach). Mix spinach, Ricotta, Mozzarella and eggs together., Place 1 layer of uncooked noodles into a 9 x 13 pan. (I always spray with cooking spray first and put a bit of sauce on pan bottom.) Spread with a layer of cheese mixture. Sprinkle top with garlic, oregano and Parmesan. Repeat process and end with top layer of noodles. Pour jar of sauce on top. Use spinach juice and added water to make 1 cup of liquid. Pour liquid along the perimeter of noodles. Cover tightly with foil. Cook 45 minutes to 1 1/2 hours at 350°.

title: Tang Salad
directions: Make dressing for salad using reserved pineapple juice; dissolve Tang in juice., Add instant pudding to juice., Stir until smooth., Mix fruits in bowl; add dressing and stir well. Refrigerate.

title: Salsa Dip
directions: Mix ingredients together. Chill. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Vegetable Dip
directions: Combine softened cream cheese and salad dressing, mixing until well blended., Stir in egg and parsley., Serve with crisp vegetables or cubes of dark bread.

title: Tomato Relish
directions: Prepare tomatoes for canning, then cut in chunks., Chop onions and peppers., Mix all ingredients in a large boiler and simmer for 2 to 3 hours or until thick., Pour into sterilized jars; seal.

title: Sandwich Spread
directions: Grind up all vegetables., Add 2 tablespoons salt., Let stand 10 minutes., Drain., Mix together mustard, flour, sugar, and vinegar. Bring to a boil., Boil hard 20 minutes with ground vegetables., Let stand overnight., In the morning, add Miracle Whip and can cold. Seal with paraffin., You must use Miracle Whip., If it doesn't seal, store in refrigerator., Yield:, 12 (8 ounce) jars.

title: 5 Minute Creamy Coconut Pie
directions: Beat sugar and milk into cream cheese until smooth or put in blender., Fold in coconut then Cool Whip., Put in crust; freeze until firm., Warm at room temperature 15 minutes before serving.

title: Pastel Shower Jello(Great For Bridal Or Baby Showers)
directions: Prepare 1 package jello using ice cream in place of cold water., Pour into 8 x 12-inch glass pan., When 1st jello is set, spread with 1/3 pint sour cream., Prepare next package jello and spoon over sour cream gently., Repeat until all 4 jellos are used. When set, frost with 1 carton Cool Whip.

title: Osso Bucco
directions: In 8-quart Dutch oven over medium heat, pour in olive oil. Cook veal, a few pieces at a time, until well browned on all sides., In drippings over medium heat, cook onion, celery, carrots and garlic until browned and tender., Return veal to Dutch oven. Add tomatoes and next 5 ingredients over high heat to boiling. Reduce heat to low, cover and simmer 1 1/2 to 2 hours, until veal is pork tender, stirring occasionally., When veal is done, skim off fat., Stir in parsley and lemon peel., Serve with rice and green beans.

title: Chow-Chow
directions: Mix first four vegetables., Sprinkle 2 tablespoons salt over and let stand 2 to 3 hours., Mix well again., Squeeze out vegetables (by hand).

title: Barbecue Turkey Loaf
directions: Can substitute ground beef.

title: Squash Souffle
directions: Cook squash and onion together until tender; drain off water and mash squash and onion until fine., Add salt, pepper, cheese, butter, egg yolks and finely crumbled crackers., Beat egg whites until stiff; fold into mixture., Bake in buttered casserole dish at 350° until brown., Serve hot.

title: Baked Chicken Salad
directions: Cook and drain macaroni., Combine with all other ingredients. Turn into buttered 2-quart baking dish., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes., Garnish with parsley., Serves 4 to 6.

title: Twice Baked Cheese Potatoes
directions: Bake potatoes in microwave or oven until soft., Carefully split potatoes lengthwise., Scoop out contents leaving about 1/8-inch of potatoes in skins all around.

title: Burnt Sugar Pie
directions: Mix together the 3/4 cup sugar, cornstarch, salt, Burnt Sugar Syrup*, egg yolks, milk, butter and vanilla., Stir over heat and cook until thickened., Pour into a baked 9-inch pie shell., Top with meringue and bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Chicken Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients and spread on bread.

title: Chocolate Caramels
directions: Combine cocoa, sugar, milk and corn syrup in saucepan., Cook slowly, stirring occasionally, until when a small quantity dropped into cold water forms a hard ball., Remove from heat; add vanilla, margarine and salt., Drop by teaspoonful onto a greased baking sheet., Cool and enjoy.

title: Parsleyed Scalloped Potatoes
directions: Peel potatoes and slice., Place in a covered 1 1/2-quart casserole., Microwave on High until just tender (approximately 10 minutes, depending on size of potatoes)., Add butter to hot potatoes; sprinkle with flour and lightly stir potatoes to coat. Add cream, salt and pepper and stir lightly., Add additional seasonings as desired., Microwave on High for 3 minutes more. Wash parsley and dry with paper towel., Chop parsley with food processor and sprinkle over potatoes to garnish.

title: Russian Tea
directions: Boil the first four ingredients for a few minutes., Pour over the tea and let stand 5 minutes., Strain and add the juice of the oranges and lemons., Add enough water to make one gallon.

title: Donnybrook Oatmeal Cookies(Diabetic)
directions: Combine butter, Sweet*10, vanilla and egg in large mixer bowl; beat for 2 minutes, or until well blended at high speed of electric mixer, scraping bowl occasionally., Add water, flour, soda, salt and cinnamon., Beat at low speed for about 2 minutes, or until well combined., Stir in oatmeal and raisins., Dough will be soft., Drop from teaspoon, 2 inches apart, onto ungreased cookie sheet., Bake at 375° for 12 to 15 minutes., Store in refrigerator., Yields 36 cookies.

title: Fruit Loaf
directions: Chop cherries, pineapple, nuts and candy., Mix all of the ingredients together in a large bowl., Mix well., Line loaf pan with foil and butter it real good., Bake for 1 1/2 to 2 hours at 275°., Best if put in freezer for a month or longer.

title: Chess Cake
directions: Mix together cake mix, margarine and 1 egg., Pat this in 9 x 13-inch pan., Mix for 5 minutes the cream cheese, confectioners sugar and 2 eggs., Pour on top of other mixture., Bake for 35 minutes at 325°.

title: "No Peek" Chicken
directions: Mix together soups., Pour liquid into 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Sprinkle dry rice into liquid., Lay chicken on top., Sprinkle dry onion soup mix over chicken., Cover tightly with foil., Bake at 350° for 2 hours., (Don't peek.)

title: Peanut Butter-Oatmeal Bread
directions: Sift flour, sugar, baking powder and salt into a bowl., Cut in peanut butter until crumbly., Add oats, egg and milk; stir just until moistened., Pour into a greased 5 x 9-inch loaf pan., Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until loaf appears golden brown., Cool on a wire rack., Makes 12 servings.

title: Chicken-Rice Casserole
directions: Oil a Pyrex 9 x 13-inch casserole dish. Spread rice evenly over the bottom., Place chicken pieces on top of the rice. Sprinkle paprika over chicken (liberally)., Pour remaining ingredients over chicken after mixing in a bowl. Cover tightly with foil. Bake at 300° for 2 hours.

title: Molded Chicken Salad
directions: Dissolve Jell-O in 1 cup hot chicken broth., Stir well., Add another cup chicken broth, grated onion, salt and lemon juice. Mix well using a wire whip., Beat in mayonnaise, chicken, celery, green pepper and pimiento., Pour into mold; sprinkle with paprika and chill.

title: Hot Shrimp Salad Or Scallop Appetizer
directions: Clean lettuce, dry and arrange on salad plates., Heat saute pan, add olive oil and melt butter., Saute shallots first, then add garlic and saute until wilted., Saute shrimp or scallops until done., Serve on bed of lettuce and dress with pinch of salt and ground black pepper., For more intense flavor, brown 1/2 pound lean bacon, reserve bacon and substitute bacon drippings for butter.

title: Sausage Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350., Cook raisins in water for 5 minutes. Strain; add soda into the hot juice., When cold, add sugar, cinnamon, salt and sausage., Beat well; add raisins, dredged in 1 cup flour and nuts., Sift 2 1/2 cups flour with baking powder. Must be real stiff, no liquid at all., Must not drop from spoon.

title: Onion Buns
directions: About 1 1/2 hours before serving or early in the day: Prepare dough for hot roll mix as label directs, but add instant minced onion with flour; let rise., Meanwhile, in a small saucepan, heat hot butter or margarine; cook chopped onion until tender., Stir in milk, egg yolk and salt., Cover and refrigerate.

title: Spaghetti Sauce
directions: Cook beef, pepper and onions together., Then add all other ingredients., Cook on low for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Pineapple Yogurt Nut Loaf
directions: Stir dry ingredients in one bowl., Stir wet ingredients in a second bowl., Then stir wet ingredients into dry ingredients just until moistened., Stir in raisins, dates and nuts.

title: Shrimp Appetizer
directions: Combine ingredients; season with salt and form into ball.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
directions: Boil chicken (keep 3/4 cup of chicken water), lightly brown 1 pie crust., In 2 quart baking dish tear chicken into strips, mix chicken, water, soup and veg. all., Pour into browned crust. Place 2nd crust over mixture, slit top crust 4 or 5 times., Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: English Muffin Loaves
directions: Combine 3 cups of flour, yeast, sugar, salt and soda., Heat liquids until very warm (120° to 130°). Add to dry ingredients. Beat well., Stir in rest of flour to make a stiff batter., Spoon into 2 (8 1/2 x 4 1/2-inch) pans that have been greased and sprinkled with cornmeal., Cover and let rise in warm place for 45 minutes., Bake at 400° for 25 minutes., Remove from pans immediately and cool.

title: Oven Roasted Potatoes(Serves 8)
directions: In a large plastic bag, add all ingredients., Close bag and shake until potatoes are evenly coated., Empty potatoes into shallow baking dish., Bake, stirring occasionally, at 450° for 40 minutes or until potatoes are brown and tender.

title: Brunswick Stew
directions: Mix all ingredients and simmer about one hour. Makes approximately 2 quarts.

title: Greek Chicken Casserole
directions: Melt butter in a 9 x 13-inch cake pan.	Layer (snuggly) with breaded chicken, strips., Sprinkle	with, rice,, celery, onion and green, pepper., Sprinkle liberally with lemon pepper and Greek seasoning.	Mix, soup, and	water, and pour over all other ingredients., Bake at, 350°, for 30 minutes., Add grated cheese and bake for 10 more minutes.

title: Easy Low-Fat Chocolate Cheesecake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°. Coat an 8-inch pan with nonstick cooking spray. In blender, puree yogurt, cream cheese, Ricotta cheese, syrup, cocoa, egg whites, cinnamon and coffee liqueur. Pour into pan. Bake for 50 minutes or until set. Let cool.

title: Southern Cornbread
directions: Preheat oven to 425°., In a large bowl, combine cornmeal mix and sugar., Add vegetable oil to a 10 or 11-inch cast-iron skillet., Place in oven to heat for 10 minutes., Meanwhile, in medium bowl, combine egg, buttermilk and 1/4 cup melted butter. Add all at once to cornmeal mixture., Stir until just moistened (batter should be lumpy)., Remove skillet from oven and swirl oil to coat bottom and side., Pour batter into hot skillet., Bake for 18 to 22 minutes or until golden brown and a wooden toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean., Brush remaining 1/4 cup melted butter over top., Serve warm.

title: Taco Dip
directions: Mix together the cream cheese, mayonnaise and garlic., Spread on bottom of a 9 x 13-inch dish., Pour picante sauce over mixture. Sprinkle chopped tomatoes on mixture along with olives and a few green onions., Top with cheeses., Refrigerate., Serve with corn chips.

title: Scalloped Green Beans
directions: Melt margarine in casserole in microwave., Stir in flour., Add milk and stir., Add salt and pepper, green beans, water chestnuts, mushrooms, minced onion and cheese., Stir well., Bake at 325° until cheese is melted., Stir occasionally., Ready to serve when hot and bubbly.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Cook broccoli and onions until still crisp., Place in 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan., Make cream sauce with 2 tablespoons melted butter. Stir in flour, then add milk., Stir over medium-high heat until starts to boil, then add cream cheese and stir until melted., Add Cheddar cheese and stir until melted., Pour over broccoli and onions; stir., Place American cheese over the top., Cover with foil., Cook for 30 minutes at 375°., Remove foil and add bread crumbs over casserole., Bake another 30 minutes, uncovered.

title: Enchilada Casserole
directions: Heat cream of mushroom soup over medium heat., Add green chilies., Dip tortilla in hot oil for a few seconds, then into soup mixture., Place the coated tortillas in the bottom of casserole dish., Layer the tortillas with chopped onion and grated cheese., Repeat until all tortillas are used., Top with remaining soup and chili sauce, onion and cheese., Bake for 30 minutes at 350°., Serve with picante or other hot sauce.

title: Gus' Double Dip Chicken
directions: Cut chicken up your way., Salt and pepper all pieces., Mix together eggs, mustard and milk., Dust chicken in salt, pepper and flour mixture, then put into egg mixture, then roll in flour mixture., In a heavy iron skillet, pour about 1 to 1 1/2 inches of oil., Heat to 325° to 350°., Fry a few pieces at a time until golden brown, about 7 to 10 minutes.

title: Cool Whip Pistachio Cake
directions: Mix together margarine, flour and nuts., Pat on bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes., Let cool!!, Mix together softened cream cheese, sugar and 2/3 of Cool Whip. Spread over crust., Mix milk and pudding; spread over cheese mixture., Put rest of Cool Whip on top and sprinkle with nuts. Refrigerate!

title: Cheese And Chicken Ball
directions: Drain chicken well; add salt and pepper. Place in a mixing bowl. Add cream cheese and chopped green onions. Mix well; shape into a ball on serving dish. Sprinkle with parsley for garnishment. Refrigerate until firm, about 1 hour. Serve with Wheat Thins.

title: Hawaiian Fruit Cake
directions: Mix all together., Bake at 350° for 35 minutes., Let cake cook before icing., Use a 9 x 13-inch cake pan., I use glass.

title: Spinach Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients well., Place in refrigerator one hour or longer to bring out flavor.

title: Lemon Sponge Pie
directions: Prepare your favorite single crust pie shell, baking for 5 minutes in a 450° oven. Remove double thickness foil bottom lining and bake for 5 minutes more., Lower temperature to 350°., In a large bowl, beat egg yolks slightly with fork. Stir in next 5 ingredients., Gradually stir in milk., In a small bowl, beat egg whites until stiff peaks form., Fold whites into yolk mixture. Pour into partially baked pastry. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Quick-N-Easy Pineapple Inside-Out Cake(Microwave)
directions: Mix all three items together thoroughly in a bowl., Spread evenly in a Bundt pan made to be used in the microwave., Wait 5 minutes, then place in microwave for 13 minutes on high to cook.

title: Dirty Rice
directions: Fry ground chuck; drain., Mix all together., Cook about 2 hours.

title: German Roast
directions: Slowly brown the roast on all sides., When roast is browned to suit, remove roast from pan and leave enough fat to make a gravy. Add ingredients, also the browned roast and cook slowly until roast is tender.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
directions: Cook sugars, milk and margarine to soft ball stage., Take off heat., Add peanut butter and marshmallow cream; don't stir until this dissolves some., Add vanilla., Stir until smooth., Pour into a 9 x 13-inch buttered dish.

title: Easy Rice Meal
directions: Put all ingredients in a crock-pot, stir and cook., When done, serve over rice fixed on package directions.

title: Coconut Pie
directions: Mix sugar and flour., Melt butter and mix well., Beat eggs and add eggs, milk, coconut and vanilla to flour mixture., Pour into unbaked pie shell., Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes until golden brown.

title: Rosettes
directions: Dip rosette iron in hot grease then in batter. They slip right off.

title: Aunt Jack'S Cake
directions: Mix together the first 4 ingredients., Pat into ungreased sheet cake pan., Next, combine the powdered sugar, 2 eggs, 2 caps vanilla and the cream cheese., Mix together and pour over other mixture. Bake in a 350° oven for 30 to 40 minutes., Store, covered, in refrigerator.

title: Apple Butter
directions: Cook apples in cider until tender., Press through a sieve or food mill., Measure 3 quarts of apple pulp., Cook pulp until thick enough to round up in a spoon as pulp thickens., Stir frequently to prevent sticking., Add sugar and spices., Cook slowly, stirring frequently, until thick., Pour hot into hot jars, leaving 1/4-inch headspace., Adjust caps., Process pint and quart jars 10 minutes in boiling water bath.

title: English Pea Salad
directions: Top salad with one sliced egg., Sprinkle with paprika.

title: Karen'S Dill Dip(Servings:  4)
directions: Mix and refrigerate for 1 hour., Put inside round 2 pound rye bread or use for vegetable dip.

title: Peanut Brittle
directions: Spray large microwave-safe bowl with Pam., Spray pizza pan with Pam., Mix sugar and Karo syrup in large bowl., Heat in microwave for 3 to 5 minutes., Stir halfway through time and when time is up, mix peanuts in with sugar and syrup., Heat for 3 to 5 minutes. Stir halfway through time and when time is up, stir in vanilla and butter., Heat for 1 minute., Stir in soda well., (This will cause it to "foam up."), Pour into greased pizza pan., Do not try and spread with spoon; tilt pan to spread., Let cool for 30 minutes. Break into pieces., For an extra treat, after breaking into pieces, dip in chocolate.

title: Cheese Potatoes
directions: Mix all ingredients and bake at 350° for one hour.

title: Lasagna
directions: Cook meat until brown., Add tomatoes, sauce, spaghetti mix and V-8 juice., Bring to a boil; turn stove down and simmer 10 minutes. Grease pan 17 x 9 x 4-inch., Cover with uncooked noodles and add a layer of meat sauce., Dot with cottage cheese., Use half the Mozzarella cheese., Repeat layers., Pour all remaining sauce on top., Sprinkle with Romano or Parmesan cheese., Cover with foil and seal edges., Bake 1 hour at 300°.

title: Lemonade
directions: Boil sugar and water to form syrup., Cool., Add juice of lemons and oranges., Pour mixture over mint leaves and let stand one hour., Strain into large pitcher., Refrigerate overnight. Serve over crushed ice., Garnish with cherry or fresh mint leaves. Makes one quart.

title: Simply Delicious
directions: Unwrap Twinkies and lay at the bottom of a baking dish., Mix both puddings in separate bowls., Pour one over the top of the Twinkies, then the other., Chop Skor candy bars in small pieces. Sprinkle over top of pudding., Spread Cool Whip on top., Sprinkle with chopped nuts.

title: Refrigerator Slaw
directions: Alternate layers of cabbage, onion and sugar., Combine remaining ingredients and bring to a boil., Pour boiling liquid over cabbage mixture and stir to mix., Refrigerate., Should keep up to 4 weeks in refrigerator.

title: Dixie Okra Gumbo
directions: Heat oil and stir in flour; lightly brown onion, garlic, green pepper and celery., When onion is clean, add okra, tomatoes, salt and pepper., Stir and add 2 cups boiling water., Cook for 45 minutes and serve over rice.

title: Watergate Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients together well., Cool before serving.

title: Garden Pizza
directions: Spread crescent rolls in bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan until bottom is covered., Bake at 400° until golden brown., Mix cream cheese, ranch dip mix and sour cream together until creamy., Spread over baked crust (rolls)., Top with vegetables and cheese.

title: Party Loaf
directions: Slightly oil frozen loaves before thawing., Let rise., Spread dough to edges of an oiled cookie sheet., Layer with salami, peppers, mushrooms and then cheese., Fold to center., Fold under edges., Turn over so seam is on bottom., Repeat with other loaf. Bake at 350° until slightly browned.

title: Maple Syrup
directions: Boil 1 cup of distilled water., Into water, place honey and salt., Mix arrowroot powder or flour, 1/2 cup water and maple flavoring in small bowl., Pour into honey mixture and stir as mixture continues to boil., Boil about 2 minutes longer., Makes about 2 cups.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
directions: Pare potatoes and slice., Cook in salted water until slightly tender., Drain and arrange in buttered casserole., Slice butter over potatoes., Add milk to about 3/4-inch the depth of potatoes. Sprinkle with pepper., Cover with thick layer of cheese., If desired, add onion., Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes., Serves 4 to 6.

title: Daddy'S Chicken
directions: Preheat oven to 350°., Mix in a bowl the soup and sherry. Place chicken in a 9 x 13-inch pan., Pour mixture over chicken. Sprinkle with cheese and almonds., Serve with rice., Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Lower-Calorie Eggnog
directions: In large saucepan, beat together eggs, sugar, and salt, if desired., Stir in 1 1/2 cups milk and powdered milk., Cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until mixture is just thick enough to coat a metal spoon and reaches 160°., Remove from heat and stir in the rest of the milk and vanilla., Refrigerate until thoroughly chilled., Before serving, garnish with dash of nutmeg or cinnamon, and a cinnamon stick for stirring.

title: Deluxe Fajita Nachos
directions: In medium skillet, combine chicken, spices and seasonings for fajitas and water; blend well., Bring to a boil; reduce heat and simmer 3 minutes., In large shallow ovenproof platter, arrange chips., Top with chicken and cheese., Place under broiler to melt cheese., Top with tomato, olives, green onions and desired amount of salsa., Serve with guacamole and sour cream., For a spicier version, add sliced jalapenos.

title: Refrigerator Bran Muffins
directions: Cream the shortening and sugar., Add eggs., Add flour, soda, salt and buttermilk; mix until smooth., Meanwhile, soak 100% Bran in hot water until soft., Add to batter; blend., Add Bran Flakes and raisins., Bake at 400° for 20 minutes.

title: Chicken And Grape Salad
directions: Combine the dressing and ginger., Set aside., Mix the other ingredients; add the dressing and mix well., Spoon this over cantaloupe wedges.

title: Pizza Fondue
directions: Brown meat in frying pan., Add sauce and seasoning., Stir in cheese., Pour into fondue dish to keep warm., Cut up French bread in cubes., Dip in.

title: Mandarin Orange Bavarian
directions: Dissolve gelatin and sugar in boiling water., Drain fruits, reserving 3/4 cup of the combined syrups., Add the measured syrup and orange rind to gelatin., Chill until slightly thickened (approximately 1 to 2 hours)., Stir whipped topping into gelatin mixture until blended., Fold in fruits., Pour into mold and chill until firm.

title: Chicken And Rice
directions: Boil chicken until tender., Debone., Place back in broth. Stir-fry onion in oil., Put in broth., Add salt, pepper and cream of chicken soup., Cook until smooth., Add 1/2 stick butter and rice., Bring to a boil., Remove from heat; let stand 5 minutes. Stir twice while you wait., Serve with French bread.

title: Green Rice
directions: Mix all the ingredients, except egg whites, until thoroughly combined., Fold in the stiffly beaten egg whites., Grease a 1 1/2-quart baking dish with butter and add mixture., Preheat oven to 350° and bake 25 minutes., Serves 6.

title: Missouri Chili
directions: Soak beans 2 to 3 hours., Boil beans for 4 to 6 hours, adding water as needed., While boiling, add garlic and salt to taste. Fry hamburger; add to beans when brown., Add chili powder and beef powder; simmer 45 minutes., Grate cheese and serve with chili. Drink plenty of water.

title: Unreal Mayonnaise
directions: Blend with 1 cup hot water, then add 1 cup cold water and blend well., Slowly add oil while blender is running., Add Clearjel 1 tablespoon at a time and blend well., Add citric acid and let it sit overnight before using.

title: Turnip Slaw
directions: Mix first 4 ingredients in a large bowl., Using processor fitted with grating disk, grate turnips., Transfer to bowl with dressing., Grate carrots and onion., Add to bowl with dressing and toss to coat., Season to taste with salt and pepper., Cover and chill 30 minutes., Makes 8 servings.

title: Pretzel Pie
directions: Mix the first 3 ingredients and bake at 400° for 8 minutes in a 9 x 13-inch pan., Cream the cream cheese and sugar together and spread on cooled crust., Mix jello and boiling water together. Add strawberries., Let stand for 10 minutes., Pour over cream cheese mixture and refrigerate for at least 2 hours., When you are ready to serve, cover top generously with Cool Whip.

title: Delicious Hot Caramel Dip
directions: Stir first 4 ingredients together in a saucepan (double boiler works best) and bring to a boil., Then add sweetened condensed milk., Continue to stir and cook, being careful not to allow mixture to stick to bottom of pan or scorch., Use candy thermometer and bring to 230° (just before soft ball stage). Remove from heat and add vanilla., If very thick, mixture can be thinned with a little milk or water., Serve warm., Makes about 3 cups of dip or sauce., Very good with sliced apples or over vanilla ice cream.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge Bars
directions: Combine cake mix, peanut butter, 1/2 cup melted butter and eggs., Stir until well blended., Press 2/3 of mixture onto bottom of ungreased, 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan., Reserve remaining mixture for topping.

title: Fruit Bowl
directions: Mix box of pudding, 1 tablespoon of Tang and juice from drained pineapple., Add fruit and refrigerate.

title: Sunny Broccoli Salad
directions: In a large mixing bowl, stir together the mayonnaise, onion, raisins, sugar and vinegar. Add broccoli and stir to coat. Cover and chill for 2 to 24 hours., Stir in sunflower kernels and bacon just before serving. Makes 12 to 16 servings.

title: Strawberry Bread
directions: Place strawberries in medium bowl., Sprinkle lightly with sugar., Thaw., Slice., Preheat oven to 350°., Butter and flour two 9 x 5-inch loaf pans., Combine flour, sugar, cinnamon, salt and soda in large bowl and mix well., Blend oil and eggs into strawberries., Add to flour mixture., Stir in pecans, blending until dry ingredients are just moist., Divide batter between pans. Bake 45 to 50 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean., Let cool 10 minutes., Turn loaves out to cool completely.

title: Mexican Dip
directions: Spread bean dip on a platter., Mix mayonnaise, sour cream and taco seasoning; spread over bean dip., Chop avocados; spread over mixture., Chop green onions and spread over avocados., Chop tomatoes and layer over onions., Chop black olives; spread over tomatoes., Sprinkle top with Cheddar cheese., Refrigerate., Serve with taco chips.

title: Chicken Broccoli Triangles
directions: Note:, Be, sure, phyllo dough has been thawed and is at room temperature.

title: Jeannette'S Pie Crust
directions: Beat the egg with a fork., Add vinegar and fill the cup with cold water., Mix flour, salt and Crisco; add liquid., You can add 1 tablespoon sugar, except for pork pies.

title: Spinach Souffle
directions: Steam or microwave spinach., Stir into butter; set aside., In large bowl, combine cheeses, flour and seasonings, mixing well. Add beaten eggs and stir until mixed. Stir in spinach., Pour into 1 1/2-quart baking dish., Bake at 350° for 55 to 60 minutes. Allow to cool for 10 minutes before serving.

title: Easy Lasagna
directions: Brown ground beef; drain well., Add spaghetti sauce, water and salt; bring to a boil., Layer in casserole dish the sauce, uncooked lasagna noodles, cottage cheese and Mozzarella cheese; repeat layers., End with sauce., Top with Parmesan cheese., Cover tightly with foil., Bake at 375° for 1 hour.

title: Rocky Roads
directions: Combine chocolate bits and peanut butter., Heat in microwave for 3 or 4 minutes, until soft and melted., Add raisins which have been dipped in boiling water to soften., (Omit this step if raisins are fresh.), Stir in marshmallows., Turn into an 8 x 8-inch buttered pan., Cut into pieces when cold., Store in an airtight container in freezer until ready to use.

title: "First Down" Cheese Spread
directions: Combine cheeses., Mix at medium speed with mixer until well blended., Add deviled ham and onion; mix well., Chill., Mold in shape of a football., Decorate with chopped nuts., Use pimento for football laces., Serve with assorted crackers.

title: Enchilada Casserole
directions: Brown beef with onions, garlic and butter., Drain., Add mushroom soup, tomato sauce, tomato paste, salt and green chilies. Simmer about 30 minutes., Pour over crushed corn chips., Top with large package Cheddar cheese (melt cheese and serve).

title: Leftover Meat And Potatoes
directions: Brown beef and onion in butter., Mix in other ingredients. Place in casserole and bake 30 to 40 minutes., Use your imagination and add leftover vegetables, too.

title: Strawberry Salad
directions: Cook macaroni. Add strawberries, pineapple and marshmallows. Let stand overnight., Add whipping cream., Place whole strawberries on top.

title: Bluebarb Pie(Or Variation Of Peach, Apple, Strawberry.)
directions: Roll out the bottom crust and fit into a 10-inch pie pan., Mix together the fruit, sugar and flour., Pour this mixture into the crust and dot with butter., Roll out the top crust and place it over the fruit. Crimp edges. Cut a few steam vents with a knife or fork., Brush the crust with beaten egg and bake pie for 20 to 25 minutes at 400°., Turn oven down to 350° and continue baking for 20 minutes or more., Remove pie from oven and allow to cool.

title: Pancakes
directions: Beat eggs, margarine and milk in a large bowl until well blended., Add flour and sugar to liquid ingredients and mix just enough to make a creamy batter.

title: Cabbage Wedges With Tangy Hot Dressing
directions: Cook bacon in large skillet over medium heat until crisp. Remove bacon with slotted spoon to paper towel; set aside. Meanwhile, dissolve cornstarch in apple juice in a small bowl. Stir in vinegar, brown sugar and caraway seeds; set aside., Add onion to hot drippings., Cook and stir until onion is soft but not brown., Place cabbage wedges, on flat side, in drippings mixture. Pour cornstarch mixture over cabbage wedges. Cook over medium heat 4 minutes., Carefully turn cabbage wedges over with spatula.

title: Banana Nut Cake
directions: Sift dry ingredients into bowl., Add Crisco, buttermilk and bananas., Beat, hard, for two minutes., Add buttermilk and eggs. Beat, two, more, minutes., Fold, in chopped nuts., Pour into greased, and floured pans.	Bake in moderate oven (350°) for 30 to 35 minutes., Frost with White Mountain Icing.

title: Old Fashion Sugar Cookies
directions: In a large mixing bowl with mixer at medium speed, cream butter and both sugars. Beat in eggs, one at a time, until light and fluffy., Add shortening, vanilla and lemon peel., Beat until well mixed.

title: Chocolate Chip Squares
directions: Beat oil, eggs, sugars and vanilla until fluffy., Add dry ingredients; mix well., Stir in chips and nuts., Spread in ungreased sheet cake pan., Bake at 375° for 18 minutes., Cool and cut.

title: Meat Loaf Italiano
directions: In a large bowl, combine all ingredients except 1/4 cup sauce. Shape loaf in a 10 x 6-inch baking dish., Bake at 350° for 1 hour., Top with remaining sauce., Let stand 10 minutes before serving., Makes 6 servings.

title: Pumpkin-N-Spice Tea Bread
directions: Blend sugar and oil well with electric mixer., *Beat in eggs, one at a time and continue beating until light., Add pumpkin; blend., Sift flour, baking soda, baking powder, cinnamon, nutmeg, cloves and salt into creamed mixture., Beat at low speed until blended., Pour batter into 4 greased 6 x 3 1/2 x 2-inch loaf pans or 2 greased 9 x 5 x 2 3/4-inch loaf pans., Bake in a moderate oven (350°) for 1 hour or until lightly browned., When done, leave in pans for 10 minutes on wire rack., Remove from pans and cool completely on wire rack., Sprinkle confectioners sugar.

title: British Tea Cookies
directions: Cream sugar and oleo., Add egg and vanilla and mix well., Sift flour and baking powder together; add to sugar mixture., Using 2 teaspoons, make cookie into nut size balls., Roll each in a dish of oatmeal so it can be handled., Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Flatten with glass dipped in oatmeal., Replenish oatmeal as needed., Bake at 325° for 15 minutes.

title: Homemade Nut Cake
directions: Mix eggs and butter and add all other ingredients except flour. Mix together good, then add flour a little at a time., Grease and flour 2 pans and pour batter into them., Bake for 30 minutes or until done, in a 400° preheated oven.

title: Barbecue Sauce
directions: Mix all ingredients; bring to a boil for a few minutes.

title: Shrimp Spread
directions: In saucepan, melt cream cheese, tomato soup, gelatine and lemon juice until very smooth., Stir in drained shrimp (which should be crushed), onion and mayonnaise., Pour into mold and chill., Serve with crackers.

title: Coconut Pie
directions: Combine sugar, coconut and flour in saucepan., Add milk, eggs and margarine., Cook to thick., Add vanilla.

title: Zucchini Squash Casserole
directions: Boil zucchini for 5 minutes along with the onion., Drain water off and remove onion., Mix soup and sour cream together. Add to zucchini., Mix stuffing in a bowl with melted margarine. Put half of the stuffing mixture into a rectangular 13 x 9 baking dish., Press into pan., Pour zucchini mixture on top., Sprinkle with remainder of stuffing mixture., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Mama'S Green Beans
directions: Drain cans of beans., Refill one can with water., Make a light roux with oil and flour., Saute onions in roux., Add the green beans plus one can of water to the onions., Season to taste. Cover and simmer 1/2 hour., If using fresh beans, add water and cook the same., Also, you can cook 2 slices of bacon and make a roux with bacon grease., Break up bacon and add to beans.

title: Sliders
directions: Mix corned beef, sour cream and onion soup mix., Spread mix on bottom of roll., Top with slice of pickle., Put top on roll., Put rolls on cookie sheet and cover with foil., Bake at 350° for 20 minutes., Makes 40 appetizers that taste just like White Castle burgers.

title: Baked Beans
directions: Brown ground beef and drain., Mix all the other ingredients and cook at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Hot Fudge Cake
directions: Mix first 5 ingredients and pour into pan.

title: Lime Iceberg Pickles
directions: Soak cucumbers in water for 24 hours., Rinse well., Soak another 3 hours in ice water and drain., Mix remaining ingredients; add cucumbers and soak overnight., Bring to a boil; simmer 35 minutes., Pack in jars and seal.

title: Fruit Dip
directions: Mix with wire whisk., Serve with fresh fruit.

title: Baked Chop Suey
directions: Combine ingredients., Bake 1 hour at 350°, uncovered.

title: Apple Dumplings
directions: Separate rolls into 8 triangles. Quarter each apple and peel. Wrap a quarter of the apple with a roll triangle. Put seam on the bottom. Place in 8 or 9-inch square Pyrex dish. Bring to a boil the orange juice, butter and sugar. Pour on top of rolled apples. It will be a lot of liquid but will absorb when cooking. Sprinkle with a dash of cinnamon. Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes. Serves 4 to 8.

title: Watergate Salad
directions: Sprinkle pudding over pineapple and stir until dissolved., Add remaining ingredients and stir until well blended., Refrigerate overnight.

title: Corn Salad
directions: Chop zucchini, onion, pepper and celery., Mix with corn., Add dressing and mix together., Chill, if desired., Serves 8.

title: Orange Sherbet Salad
directions: Dissolve gelatin in hot water and fruit juice., Add sherbet. Stir until melted., Add fruit and chill., Add sour cream and small marshmallows to fruit mixture., Spread over gelatin., Serves 12.

title: White Chili
directions: Saute the first three ingredients in olive oil., Place in 3 1/2 qt. or larger crockpot and add chicken broth., Add remaining ingredients, save the cheese., Stir, cover and cook for 3 hours on high or 7-8 hours on low., Prior to serving stir in cheese.

title: Cabbage Casserole
directions: Boil cabbage in salt water until tender., Drain., Add oleo, cheese and soup., Mix while hot., Put in baking dish and top with crumbled baked corn bread., Dot with oleo., Bake at 400° until brown.

title: Helen Mcnair'S Punch
directions: Note:, Use Jell-O and Kool-Aid flavor to obtain desired color.

title: Hot Sonoma Cheese Dip
directions: 1st Layer:, 2 cans jalapeno bean dip.

title: Monkey Bread
directions: Roll each piece of biscuit in white sugar and cinnamon mixture., Arrange in Bundt pan sprayed with Pam., Heat brown sugar, cinnamon, oleo and water until melted., Pour over biscuits and bake at 350° for 30 minutes., You can put nuts in or fruit, if desired., When cool, invert Bundt pan and serve.

title: Champagne Punch
directions: Place sherbet in punch bowl., Pour champagne and Sauterne over top., Stir., Add ginger ale, if desired., Serves 18 punch cups.

title: Corned Beef Spread
directions: Mix corned beef and cream cheese together., Add garlic salt and seasoned salt to your own taste.

title: Scalloped Tomatoes
directions: Season tomatoes with salt, pepper and sugar., Alternately arrange layers of tomatoes, cheese and bread crumbs in a baking dish., Dot with butter., Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Penne Pasta
directions: Melt butter., Add tomatoes, salt, pepper and red pepper., Cook 15 minutes., Turn heat to low; add cream., Stir with wire whisk for another 10 to 15 minutes., Serve 1/2 sauce on pasta and other half in serving bowl.

title: Two Bean Chili
directions: Combine onion and green pepper in a 2-quart microwave casserole; cover., Microwave on High 2 minutes or until tender. Stir in remaining ingredients including tomato liquid., Microwave on High 10 to 12 minutes or heated thoroughly.

title: French Toast
directions: Melt margarine, syrup and sugar. Pour into greased 9 X 13 pan. Place 6 slices Texas toast on top of mixture. Beat together eggs, milk, vanilla and salt. Pour over top of the bread. Cover with foil. Refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350° uncovered for 30 to 40 minutes. When ready to serve, turn pieces of bread over and caramel will be on top.

title: Combo Casserole
directions: Combine soup and cheese; add vegetables., Turn into greased 9 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish., Cut corned beef into 6 slices; arrange atop vegetables., Toss crumbs with butter., Sprinkle over mixture. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Apple Cheese Pudding
directions: In saucepan, combine soup, milk, brown sugar and cinnamon. Bring to boil; reduce heat., Simmer 2 minutes to blend flavors. Add butter, toast, almonds and raisins., Spoon 1/2 of soup mixture in bottom of 1 1/2-quart casserole; top with apples and remaining toast mixture., Cover; bake at 350° for 25 minutes, or until hot. Uncover; sprinkle with cheese., Bake 5 minutes more., Serve with whipped cream., Makes 6 servings.

title: Elgie'S Grandmother'S Breakfast Gems
directions: Mix all together., Bake in Gem pans 20 minutes at 350°.

title: Marinated Carrots
directions: Good hot or cold., Best made a day ahead., Mix and simmer 10 minutes.

title: Chili
directions: Brown onions, green pepper, garlic and meat, then add beans and balance of ingredients in Dutch oven., Simmer 1/2 hour and serve.

title: Fruited Cottage Cheese Salad
directions: Mix cottage cheese and whipped topping until blended., Stir in dry jello., Fold in the pineapple and oranges., Chill 1 or 2 hours before serving.

title: Vegetable Pizza
directions: Roll dough to fit a 15 x 10 1/2 x 1-inch pan., Bake according to package or until lightly browned., Mix cream cheese and mayonnaise until creamy., Spread on dough., Top with vegetables (red radishes, cauliflower, broccoli, carrots, etc.).

title: Amy'S Hot Fudge Cake
directions: Grease a 9-inch baking dish., Mix flour, sugar, cocoa, milk and margarine., Blend in nuts., Spread in greased dish., Sprinkle brown sugar and 1/4 cup cocoa over batter., Pour hot water over entire batter., Bake 35 to 40 minutes at 350°.

title: Susan'S Summer Salad
directions: Wash and dry lettuce and tear into bite-size pieces., Cut papaya and avocado into small chunks and add to lettuce.

title: Monkey Bread
directions: Place sugar, cinnamon and nuts in a plastic bag., Cut each biscuit in half and place all of them in the bag and shake until coated., It is best to use a Teflon Bundt pan., Arrange half of biscuits in pan and put half of margarine over this., Put remaining biscuits on top with rest of butter and sprinkle remaining sugar and cinnamon over top., Bake at 450° for 15 minutes.

title: Easy Brunswick Stew
directions: Combine all ingredients in a large saucepan; heat until bubbling, stirring occasionally to prevent sticking.

title: Apricot Salad
directions: Combine Jell-O, sugar, pineapple and its juice in pan., Heat until mixture comes to a simmer., Add baby food., Set in refrigerator until it begins to thicken., Whip chilled Pet milk, adding softened cream cheese as you beat milk., Fold into Jell-O mixture., Pour into large pan (9 x 12-inch glass dish is nice). Top with chopped nuts, if desired.

title: Death By Chocolate Dessert
directions: Bake brownies as directed on box., Make instant pudding as directed on box., Break brownies into chunks., Put 1/2 into 9 x 13-inch pan., Pour pudding over chunks., Put rest of brownie chunks over pudding., Spread Cool Whip over pudding., Crush candy bars and sprinkle over Cool Whip and then sprinkle nuts over also. Refrigerate.

title: Creamy Rice And Broccoli Soup
directions: Cook and stir onion in hot margarine in medium saucepan until tender, but not browned., Stir in flour., Add bouillon cubes, milk, water, broccoli, garlic powder and thyme., Bring to a boil; reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes., Stir in rice; simmer 5 minutes longer.

title: Grandma'S Sweet Potato Pie
directions: Combine dry ingredients and mix with sweet potatoes., Mix milk and eggs and combine with potato mixture., Bake at 450°, for 10 minutes. Reduce to 350°, and bake 35 minutes longer.

title: Juicy Roast Chicken
directions: Combine all except chicken., Bring to boil., Add whole chicken, cover and cook 10 minutes., Remove pan from heat., Let stand 20 minutes., Remove chicken from liquid., Place on rack and roast at 375° about 40 to 50 minutes or until done.

title: Yeast Rolls
directions: Bring milk to a boil. Add shortening, sugar and salt. Cool to lukewarm., Sprinkle yeast over warm water. After 5 minutes, stir and combine with cooled milk mixture., Add flour gradually. Beat well after each addition. Add enough flour to make a soft dough. Turn out on flour dusted board., Cover with mixing bowl and let rest 10 minutes., Knead about 10 minutes until smooth., Place dough in a warm, greased bowl. Brush surface lightly with shortening., Cover and let rise in warm place (80° to 85°) or place in refrigerator until time desired for rolls.

title: Polish Sausage Appetizers
directions: You will need toothpicks.

title: Chicken Loaf
directions: Soak gelatine in stock. Heat stock and melt gelatine. Mix remaining ingredients. Pour in loaf pan or mold.

title: Pizza Picnic
directions: Brown meat and set aside., Beat eggs until light., Add grated cheese and set aside., Grease a 10 x 13-inch pan., Line bottom with 1 package rolls., Spread 1/2 of cheese-egg mixture over rolls., Layer the following over cheese-egg mixture: meat and green pepper, half Provolone, ham, remaining Provolone, remaining egg mixture and salami slices., Cover with second package of rolls., Cover with foil., Bake at 350° for 1 hour., Uncover; bake at 375° for 15 minutes or until brown.

title: Death By Chocolate
directions: Prepare and bake brownies according to package directions; let cool., Set aside., Prepare chocolate pudding according to package directions., Break candy bars into small pieces.

title: Broccoli And Rice Casserole
directions: Grease baking dish; brown the celery and onion with butter. Cook broccoli until just thawed., Mix all in baking dish and top with crushed Ritz crackers., Bake at 350° for 35, minutes.

title: Quick 'N Easy Salad
directions: Cut vegetables into small pieces., Mix dressing mix, mayonnaise and milk; pour over vegetables, coating all pieces. Store in refrigerator.

title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Mix all together in casserole., Top with one cup cornflakes and 1/8 cup melted oleo., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Pierogi Casserole
directions: Cook noodles., Make instant potatoes., Add the cheese to potatoes after they are made., Saute onions in butter until soft. Add 1/3 cup of butter and onion mixture to potato mixture., Add salt and pepper to taste., Generously butter 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan with butter., Put first layer of noodles in pan with part of the potato mixture on top., The top layer should be noodles., Pour remaining butter and onions over all., Cover with foil and bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Crab Dip
directions: Mix all ingredients and chill for 1 to 2 hours., Serve with crackers.

title: Orange Julius
directions: Blend ingredients in blender and add ice, blending on high speed.

title: Golden Delicious Apple Cake
directions: Mix thoroughly., Pour in well-greased pan., Sprinkle with brown sugar and 1/2 cup nuts., Bake at 350° for 55 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Chiffon Pie
directions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water., Cool to lukewarm., Whip the cream cheese until soft and fluffy., Beat in sugar and peanut butter., Slowly add gelatin, blending thoroughly., Fold whipped cream into mixture., Pour in pie shell., Sprinkle with peanuts. Chill for about 2 hours.

title: Cauliflower Salad
directions: Mix ingredients together and refrigerate.

title: Lemon Pie
directions: Beat well lemonade, milk and Cool Whip on high speed., Pour into crust., Freeze.

title: Chocolate Devil'S Food Cake
directions: Cream Crisco and sugar; add eggs., Sift and add flour and spices together with salt., Dissolve chocolate in hot coffee and soda in buttermilk., Stir until it foams., Add to other ingredients with vanilla and cake coloring., Bake 45 to 50 minutes at 350°., Ice with your favorite icing such as chocolate, cream cheese or 7 minute icing.

title: Packet Potatoes
directions: You will need 1 sheet (18 x 24-inch) aluminum foil.

title: Herb Mix
directions: Combine herbs in blender and blend on high speed until powdery., About 1 minute.

title: Macaroni Casserole
directions: Brown meat, diced onion and pepper in a frying pan., Add can of tomatoes, ketchup, Worcestershire sauce, salt and pepper., Set steam on low for about 45 minutes., While this is steaming, boil macaroni until tender., Drain and put in 2-quart casserole dish. Add and mix in the meat mixture., Top with a layer of cheese., Cook in 325° oven for about 30 minutes, until brown on top.

title: American Fried Rice
directions: Fry pork or chicken in large pot; set aside., Saute onions, celery and peppers., Add chopped (bite size pieces) meat; saute together until done., Make hole in bottom of pot and drop mixed eggs., Stir immediately until eggs are cooked., Add rice, soy sauce and salt; mix well.

title: Molasses Crinkles
directions: Mix first 4 ingredients thoroughly., Blend in all dry ingredients; stir in and chill., Heat oven to 375°., Roll dough into balls size of walnuts., Dip tops in sugar., Place, sugar side up, 3 inches apart on greased sheets., Bake for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Salmon Spread
directions: Drain salmon and remove any bones., Cream salmon and cream cheese, onion and horseradish., Put in bowl., Spread on crackers. Can be chilled and then rolled in crushed nuts.

title: Chocoholic Pudding Cake
directions: Pour hot (not boiling) water into 9 x 15-inch sheet cake pan, ungreased., Add brown sugar, cocoa and marshmallows., Prepare cake mix according to package directions., Spoon over water mix., Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes., Serve warm with ice cream or whipped cream.(optional)

title: Chicken Piccata
directions: Beat egg with 1 tablespoon lemon juice. Combine flour, garlic powder and paprika in another bowl. Dip chicken in egg, then coat with flour mixture. Brown chicken in margarine/butter in a skillet. Dissolve, bouillon in boiling water and add to skillet with remaining lemon juice. Cover; simmer 20 minutes, until tender.

title: Cauliflower Dip
directions: Mix together., Refrigerate overnight and serve with fresh cauliflower or other vegetables.

title: Cranberry Muffins
directions: Preheat oven to 400., Grease bottom only of 12 medium muffin cups or line with paper liners., Beat milk, egg and cranberry sauce slightly in medium bowl., In separate bowl, mix flour, salt, baking powder and sugar; add dry mixture to other ingredients and stir until moistened. Fill muffin cups one-half full; sprinkle on topping., Bake 18 minutes or until golden brown., Cool slightly before removing from pan.

title: Mom'S Homemade Apple Butter
directions: Put diced apples in crock-pot with cider; cook 10 to 12 hours. Sieve through food mill., Add sugar, cloves and cinnamon., Cook 3 more hours., Ladle into 6 sterile pint jars and seal.

title: Country Tavern Sauce For Ribs
directions: Mix and cook slowly for about 30 minutes.

title: Twice-Baked Potatoes
directions: Slice potatoes into halves., Scoop potato from skins, leaving 1/8-inch shell., Mash potato in large bowl., Add salt, pepper, butter, milk and crumbled bacon; mix well., Spoon into shells. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes or until heated through., Yield:, 8 servings.

title: Burger Bundles
directions: Make 4 large patties from ground beef., Place pattie in the center of a sheet of aluminum foil approximately 12 inches long. Slice potatoes and carrots thinly and place on top of beef pattie. Top with slice of onion and green pepper., Salt and pepper to taste., A.1. sauce or margarine can be sprinkled on top., Bring ends of foil together and seal., Seal all edges of foil so no steam can escape., Place on cookie sheet and bake in a 350° oven for 45 minutes.

title: No Bake Cheese Cake
directions: Dissolve jello; add juice and cool (do not let jell)., Cream the cream cheese, sugar and vanilla., Mix in jello., Beat Milnot to stiff peaks in separate bowl., Fold jello mixture into Milnot. Crush crackers and add melted margarine; pack all but 1 cup cracker crumbs in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan to form crust., Pour cake mixture into pan., Sprinkle with reserved crumbs., Chill several hours., Will get more firm when thoroughly cold.

title: Hearty Winter Soup
directions: Brown sausage in a dutch over or large saucepan; drain well and remove from pan., Drain fat from pan and add bell pepper, zucchini and onion., cook over medium heat for 3 minutes., Stir in tomatoes, kidney beans, broth, water and cooked sausage., Bring to a boil, reduce heat cover and simmer about 15 minutes to blend flavors.

title: Caramel Candy
directions: Cook sugar, milk and Karo over medium heat until soft ball stage., Remove., Add 1 stick butter, 1 teaspoon vanilla and a pinch of salt., Beat until thick and add pecans., Drop by spoonfuls on wax paper.

title: Applesauce Breakfast Ring
directions: Line a 2 1/2-quart ring mold with plastic wrap or wax paper.

title: Pear Salad
directions: Heat pear juice and dissolve Jell-O., Cool., Put pears, cottage cheese and cream cheese in blender or sieve until smooth. Put all in a bowl; add pineapple., Mix well., Turn into well-greased mold and chill until firm.

title: Lemony-Icebox Pie
directions: Whip the condensed milk and lemonade together until it thickens and gets fluffy., Add Cool Whip., Fold into lemonade-milk-Cool Whip mixture the crushed pineapple (well drained), cherries (drained and cut up) and pecans., Pour into pie crusts and let chill about, 2 hours., Bananas or strawberries could be added.

title: Fiesta Ribeye Steak
directions: Sprinkle both, sides of steaks with lime juice., Grill steaks turning once when steaks are just about done place shells wrapped in foil on the edge of the grill., When done, place each steak on to shells and top with cheese and salsa., Add a salad, for a fine dinner.

title: Apple Coffee Cake
directions: Cream together the shortening and 1 cup sugar. Add salt and vanilla, and, mix well., Add eggs and beat well., Combine flour, soda, and baking powder. Add to creamed mixture alternately, with sour cream. Stir in apples., Spoon batter into a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.

title: Cow Pies
directions: In a double boiler over simmering water, melt the chocolate chips and shortening, stirring until smooth., Remove from the heat; stir in raisins and nuts., Drop by tablespoons onto waxed paper., Chill until ready to serve., Yields 2 dozen.

title: Hamburger Rice Casserole
directions: Brown hamburger, celery and onion until meat is done., Turn into casserole or roaster., Add other ingredients., Bake at 350° for 1 hour., More water may be added if the casserole seems too dry.

title: Fried Mush
directions: Boil water, salt and margarine in a pot., Put corn meal in and cook it until it thickens., Add a spoonful of flour to the corn meal while it is cooking., Mix well., Pour out into a loaf pan until it cools and sets up., Slice it and fry in a skillet.

title: Perfection Salad
directions: Soak gelatin in cold water., Add boiling water and stir until gelatin is dissolved., Add sugar, salt, vinegar and lemon juice. Cut vegetables into small pieces and add to gelatin mixture when it is cool., Put into molds and chill.

title: Sneaky Cheese Souffle
directions: Remove crust from bread., Layer bread, then cheese in baking dish., Combine remaining ingredients and pour over bread and cheese., Store in refrigerator for 12 hours., Bake for 1 hour in 300° oven., Serve immediately.

title: Seasoning Salt
directions: Mix all ingredients together., Store in a closed container. Store in a dry place., Use for salads, steaks and vegetables.

title: Six Week Muffins
directions: Mix corn flakes, flour, baking soda, sugar and salt in a large bowl., Add remaining ingredients and mix well., Fill greased muffin tin 2/3 full., Bake in preheated oven (400°) for 15 to 20 minutes. Keep rest of batter in refrigerator for up to 6 weeks.

title: Cheese Stuffed Shells
directions: In medium bowl, combine eggs, Ricotta cheese, Mozzarella cheese, 3/4 cup Parmesan cheese, parsley, salt and pepper., Spoon about 2 tablespoons mixture into each shell., Arrange in a 13 x 9-inch baking dish., Top with spaghetti sauce., Sprinkle with remaining Parmesan cheese., Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Chili Con Queso #3
directions: Cut cheese up and place in microwave safe bowl., Add milk and soup to cheese; cover with Saran Wrap., Microwave on medium heat 8 to 10 minutes or until cheese melts., Stir and serve.

title: Grandmother Holmes' Oyster Stew
directions: In Dutch oven, saute onions in butter until tender., Add remaining ingredients to onions., Cook over low heat until edges of oysters begin to curl and mixture is hot., Do not boil., Serve with crackers.

title: Potato Puff
directions: Bring first 5 ingredients just to a boil., Remove from heat and stir in Potato Buds and cottage cheese., Mix well and put into casserole dish., Dot with butter and sprinkle with grated cheese and paprika., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour or until hot.

title: Oatmeal Applesauce Yummies
directions: Melt margarine and shortening in preparation to mixing with dry ingredients., Alternately mix the dry and wet ingredients until it is totally mixed., Keep stirring until no dry ingredients remain; the batter will be very stiff., Drop in small spoonfuls onto a greased cookie sheet at least 2-inches apart., They will need a cooking time of up to 15 minutes or until golden., Small drops are best because they are so dense., Bake at 375°.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: In skillet, saute onions and celery in margarine until lightly browned., Boil rice and drain., Over low heat in skillet with onions and celery, add soups and cheese., Cook over low heat stirring often until cheese has melted and blended well with soups., Add broccoli and rice to mixture., Pour in casserole dish lightly greased with margarine., Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Napa Valley Salad
directions: Saute oleo, almonds, sesame seed and noodles., Heat and cool vinegar, sugar, oil and soy sauce.

title: Turtle Cheese Cake
directions: In 1 1/2-quart saucepan, melt candy with milk over low heat, stirring frequently, until smooth., Combine wafer crumbs and butter; press into 9-inch spring-form pan., Bake at 350° for 10 minutes., Pour melted mixture into crust; top with pecans.

title: Texas Vegetable Soup
directions: Heat all ingredients to boiling in 2-quart saucepan; reduce heat., Break up tomatoes., Cover and simmer 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.

title: Squash Casserole
directions: Cook squash and half of onion in salted water until tender. Drain and mash., Add margarine first (to melt)., Add rest of ingredients, with cheese last., Pour in small casserole., Bake at 400° until starts to brown.

title: Baked Mashed Potatoes
directions: Peel potatoes and cut into 1 inch chunks., Boil until tender. Drain., Mash potatoes, then add 6 tbsp of the butter and milk. Whip until they are smooth., Stir in the cheese and salami. Season to taste with salt and pepper., Use some of the, remaining butter to grease the sides and bottom of a high sided 3 quart casserole dish., Coat the bottom and sides with bread crumbs. Spoon the mixture into the dish., Dot with butter. Bake at 350° until the top is golden brown.

title: Curried Chicken Mole
directions: Have all ingredients ready to stir-fry in wok or heavy skillet (high heat)., Saute garlic, ginger and fenugreek in 2 teaspoons sesame oil and 2 to 3 tablespoons olive or canola oil for 1 minute. Add carrots and onions., Saute until onions are golden., Remove and reserve., Add oil, heat, then stir-fry chicken fast until very golden and crispy; remove and reserve., Add oil; stir-fry fenugreek, poppy seed and broccoli or asparagus quickly as bhaji. Add reserved onions, carrots and chicken., Cover with yogurt (may substitute or use part coconut milk)., Dissolve curry paste and mole paste in a little liquid; add to mix and stir., Lay pepper over mixture and allow it to steam., Cumin or paprika may be added. Let simmer for 30 to 60 minutes., Serve over basmati or jasmine rice.

title: Chicken And Dressing Casserole
directions: Melt margarine; mix with stuffing., Put half of stuffing in 2-quart baking dish., Layer chopped chicken over stuffing. Microwave milk, soup and onion until boiling., Pour over chicken and top with remaining stuffing., Pour broth over top of casserole., Bake at 400° for 30 to 45 minutes until brown and bubbly around edges.

title: Boston Baked Beans
directions: Slice bacon into 1/2-inch strips., Combine bacon, onion and garlic in a 1-quart microwave-safe dish., Microwave at High power for 5 minutes or until onion is soft., Drain beans., Add beans and remaining ingredients to onion mixture., Microwave covered with waxed paper at High power for 7 minutes, stirring once or twice during cooking time., Makes 4 servings.

title: Strawberry Butter
directions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl., Mix until smooth., Store in refrigerator.

title: Chocolate Coconut Balls
directions: Combine vanilla wafer crumbs, flaked coconut and confectioners sugar., Add syrup and vanilla; mix well., Shape into 1-inch balls. Roll in confectioners sugar and store in an airtight container. Reroll in confectioners sugar before serving., Makes 3 dozen.

title: Chicken Pie(Melt-In-Your-Mouth)
directions: Cook chicken., Remove meat from bones, cut up and put in 9 x 13-inch pan., In saucepan, mix soup and broth and bring to a boil. Pour over chicken., In another bowl, combine margarine, pepper, flour and buttermilk., Mix thoroughly to form batter., Spoon on top., Bake at 425° for 30 minutes.

title: Fudge Nut Oatmeal Bars
directions: In, mixing bowl, cream butter and brown sugar., Add eggs and vanilla; mix well., Combine oats, flour, baking soda and salt. Add to creamed mixture., Spread 2/3 in the bottom of an ungreased 15 x 10 x 1-inch baking pan; set aside.

title: Plum Nutty Cake
directions: Mix, oil, and, sugar; add eggs., Sift flour, cloves and cinnamon;, add, alternately, with, plums., Add nuts; mix well. Bake, at 300° in lightly greased Bundt pan., Cake is done when toothpick inserted comes out clean., Very moist and tasty!

title: No Bake Chocolate Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Mix sugar, cocoa, milk and margarine in medium saucepan. Bring to a boil while stirring., Boil 2 minutes., Take off stove. Add peanut butter, oats and vanilla., Stir well., Drop on wax paper with a tablespoon., Let cool.

title: Fruit Drop Cookies
directions: Combine shortening, sugar and eggs and mix well., Stir in buttermilk., Combine flour, soda and salt and stir in., Stir in pecans, cherries and dates., Chill at least 1 hour., Preheat oven to 400°., Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls about 2 inches apart on lightly greased cookie sheet., Place a pecan half on each cookie. Bake for 8 to 10 minutes until almost no imprint remains when touched lightly with finger., Makes 8 dozen.

title: Chicken-Basil-Cashew Pat
directions: Cut chicken into 1/2-inch pieces. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Melt butter in heavy skillet over medium-high heat. Add chicken and garlic and saute until chicken is cooked, about 3 minutes. Stir in cashews. Remove from heat and cool. Pour cooled chicken mixture into food processor. Add mayonnaise, onion, cheese and Tabasco. Process until smooth. Add chopped basil and process. Transfer to bowl; cover and chill at least 2 hours. Can be made 2 days ahead.

title: Sour Cream Muffins
directions: Mix ingredients until moistened., Use in, muffin pan or drop method in a 9 x 9-inch pan., This is yummy ., ., .	especially for those really cold mornings., Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Vegetable Casserole
directions: Mix all the ingredients in a large bowl., Pour into, a greased 9 x 13-inch casserole dish., Crumble 1 pack Ritz crackers into 1 stick melted butter., Sprinkle on top and bake until bubbly.

title: Swiss Steak
directions: Pound flour into sides of steak., Brown in hot fat in heavy skillet., Add tomatoes, onion and celery., Cover., Cook over low heat or in 300° oven for 2 to 2 1/2 hours., Uncover the last 30 minutes to cook down the sauce until thick., Serve hot.

title: Mexican Meat
directions: Brown ground round, breaking into small pieces (crumbled). Drain and add Ro-Tel and jar of picante sauce., Mix thoroughly. May rinse jar with small amount of water and add to meat., Lower heat and simmer 15 minutes., Serve as filling for tacos or see Mexican Pie recipe, Mexican Taco Salad or Mexican Goulash recipes.

title: Breakfast Casserole
directions: Make this recipe the night before., Fry sausage and drain off grease., Combine eggs, salt, mustard and onion; beat well., Add half and half., Grease a 9 x 13-inch glass pan and line with bread cubes., Sprinkle sausage and cheese on top., Pour egg mixture over all., Refrigerate overnight., Bake at 350° for 40 to 50 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Barley Hot Dish
directions: Combine ingredients., Bake in covered casserole dish at 350° for 1 hour.

title: All Butter Cake
directions: Cream butter; add sifted flour., Beat 5 minutes., Add eggs, one at a time, beating after each addition., Add sugar and baking powder; mix, then add flavoring., Bake in greased tube pan at 325° until done.

title: Creamed Tacos
directions: Brown ground beef; drain., Cook chili according to package directions., Combine ground beef with chili., Add Ro-Tel and Velveeta (cut up)., Simmer 15 minutes, stirring often., Add whipping cream and simmer 5 minutes longer., Place Doritos in a plate., Pour creamed taco mixture over Doritos., Sprinkle lettuce and tomato on top., Delicious and quick!

title: Chocolate And Cherry Ring Cake
directions: In a large mixing bowl, stir together flour, sugar, soda, cinnamon and salt., In another bowl, combine eggs, oil and vanilla., Add to flour mixture; mix well., Stir in cherry pie filling, chocolate pieces and nuts., Pour mixture into a greased and floured 10-inch fluted tube pan., Bake at 350° for 1 hour. Cool in pan on a wire rack for 15 minutes., Remove from pan; sift powdered sugar on top of cake., Makes 12 to 14 servings.

title: Rhubarb Cake
directions: Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350° in 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Layered Bean Dip
directions: Mix together the refried beans, chilies and taco seasoning mix., Spread on 12-inch round platter., Spread on sour cream next. Top with lettuce, cheese, tomatoes and olives., Spoon on taco sauce.

title: Rigatoni And Chicken Dijon
directions: Cook rigatoni as directed, drain., Meanwhile, in large skillet, melt butter, brown chicken in butter., Add beans., In small mixing bowl, combine broth, cream, mustard and flour until smooth., Stir into chicken and beans., Stir in hot rigatoni. Cover and simmer 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Caramel Pudding
directions: Remove can labels., Using a canner or other large pan, boil unopened cans of Eagle Brand for 4 hours., Keep water line above cans!, (Great to do on cold, dry winter days!), After cooked, store unopened can(s) in cupboard., Chill when ready to use. Open can at both ends and push out roll of caramel pudding., Slice (and maybe halve or quarter the slices) and serve with a dollop of whipped cream.

title: Cherry Cottage Pudding
directions: This will look very messed up., Bake for 35 to 40 minutes at 350°., Very good with ice cream or whipped cream., Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Dilly Bread
directions: All ingredients must be at room temperature., Use 1 1/2 or 2-quart, casserole, dish., Dissolve, yeast in 1/4 cup warm water. Stir, in cottage cheese, sugar, egg (unbeaten), butter and, salt. Add flour., Mix well using your hand., Let rise 50 minutes. Remove from dish and punch down., Wash casserole and grease well. Return dough., Let rise again for 50 minutes.

title: Quick Cobbler Crust
directions: Mix all ingredients well. Pour into a pan a little smaller than 9 x 13-inch., Spoon sweetened peaches or fruit on top and bake at 350° until done.

title: Mexican Rice
directions: Saute rice, onion, pepper and garlic in oil until browned. Stir in chicken broth, salsa and Tabasco., Bring to boil., Cover, reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes.

title: Cherry Pie Salad
directions: Combine all ingredients and serve.

title: Ambrosia
directions: *If you don't like coconut, but like the flavor, use 1/2 teaspoon coconut flavoring.

title: Drop Sugar Cookies
directions: Cream sugar and butter; add eggs and vanilla., Mix in dry ingredients., Add alternately to creamed mixture with buttermilk. Drop on cookie sheet and top with colored sugar., Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Apple Butter
directions: Wash, quarter and remove stems from apples., No need to peel or core., Cook apples slowly in cider until tender., Put through a food processor., Add 1/2 cup (or more) sugar for each cup of apple pulp., Add spices., Cook in the oven or in a slow cooker for several hours., Stir often., Test for desired thickness by spooning some mixture on a cold plate., When no liquid oozes around the edges, it's thick enough., (May be canned while hot, and it may be frozen., Although, if you've just made some fresh bread in your bread machine, your family may just eat it all up.), Keep refrigerated.

title: Banana Boats
directions: Slice skin off top side of a banana; leave it attached at the stem., Peel this back and make 3 slits at 2-inch intervals; pop out the pieces of banana., (Pop these in your mouth and enjoy them.) In each slit, put 1 section of Hershey bar (about 1-inch square) and 1 marshmallow (or half a marshmallow if it doesn't fit)., Place toothpicks beside each slit to hold banana peeling over the top so it looks like a little "boat."

title: Banana Layer Cake
directions: Mix shortening and sugars., Beat the eggs and vanilla. Dissolve soda in milk., Add with bananas to creamed mixture., Add dry ingredients and beat until smooth., Put in greased layer pans and bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Creamy Peanut Butter Pudding
directions: In a small bowl, mix cornstarch with 1/2 cup milk., In medium size saucepan, over moderate heat, heat remaining 1 1/2 cup milk. When milk is just under boiling, add peanut butter, honey and salt. Mix thoroughly, then stir in cornstarch mixture and continue cooking about 5 minutes until thick and creamy., Pour about 1/2 cup of the hot mixture into beaten egg then return this mixture to the saucepan and cook 1 minute longer., Remove pan from heat, add vanilla and heat about 1 minute., Cool., Pour into individual dessert dishes, cover and refrigerate several hours before serving. Yield:, 4 servings.

title: Double Plain Cake With Caramel Icing
directions: Pour the milk in a double boiler with water in the bottom boiler., Heat the milk until almost hot., Add the butter., Add the granulated sugar., Stir constantly until the sugar is dissolved. Add the vanilla., Cook until the soft ball stage, then remove from the heat., Spread between the layers and on the top of the cake while still warm.

title: Easy Salad Dressing
directions: Put in jar and shake well., Refrigerate., This salad dressing is not tart., Especially good on pasta salad or mixed green salad.

title: Rigatoni In Vodka Sauce
directions: Melt butter and saute thinly-sliced garlic in saucepan., Drain juice from tomatoes and pour tomatoes into saucepan., Cook on medium heat., Boil for approximately 1 hour., Season to taste (basil, oregano, parsley, salt and pepper)., While this is cooking, add crushed red pepper to vodka and soak for the hour.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Mix in order given, place in casserole dish., Bake 45 minutes to an hour in 350° oven.

title: Mexican Cornbread
directions: Mix all and bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Cappelini And Zucchini And Gargonzola
directions: In a wok, stir-fry oil, garlic paste and garlic., Then add zucchini., Stir-fry until coated with garlic and oil., Add broth and wine or vermouth., Add Gorgonzola cheese until melted., Do not cook away broth., Add to this mixture the cappelini., Delicious.

title: Watergate Salad
directions: Mix pineapple and juice with pudding mix., Add marshmallows and pecans., Fold in whipped topping., Refrigerate in covered container overnight.

title: Copper Carrots
directions: Cook carrots in boiling, salted water until fork-tender., When cool, alternate layers of carrots with green pepper and onion slices., Combine Worcestershire sauce and remaining ingredients over heat., Pour sauce mixture over layered vegetables., Cover and refrigerate., Flavor is best after a few days of refrigeration.

title: Barbecue
directions: Cook all ingredients except hamburger together for 3 minutes. Add cooked hamburger., Cook 3 minutes longer., Serves 6.

title: Funnel Cake
directions: Mix dry ingredients first then add milk and egg., Fry in deep fat or oil 375° until light brown, turning once., Drain on paper plate lined with paper towel., Dust with powdered sugar.

title: Bread Pudding
directions: Toast and butter bread., Break bread into casserole dish., Mix all ingredients and add to bread., Bake at 350° until done (about 1 hour).

title: Almond Joy Cake
directions: Mix and bake cake according to package directions., Punch holes in cake., Combine 1 1/2 cups sugar and 1 cup Pet milk. Bring to a rolling boil., Boil for 1 minute., Stir in marshmallows and coconut., Spread over hot cake., Bring 1/2 cup Pet milk, 1 1/2 cups sugar and butter to a full boil boiling for 1 minute., Then add chocolate chips and almonds and spread over coconut mixture.

title: Stuffed Cabbage
directions: In covered 12-inch skillet in 1-inch boiling water, cook cabbage leaves 5 minutes., Drain., Set aside., In same skillet over medium heat, in hot butter, cook onion 5 minutes or until tender, stirring occasionally., Add tomato sauce, brown sugar, 1 teaspoon salt and 1/4 teaspoon pepper., Mix well., Set aside., In large bowl, combine remaining ingredients, 1 teaspoon salt and 1/4 teaspoon pepper., Divide mixture into 12 portions., In center of each cabbage leaf, place a portion of meat mixture., Fold 2 sides of leaf towards center., From one narrow edge leaf, roll up jelly roll fashion., Place filled leaves, stem sides down, in sauce in skillet., Over medium heat, heat sauce and filled leaves to simmering., Reduce heat to low; cover and simmer 45 minutes.

title: Polynesian Shrimp Dip
directions: Cut 1-inch thick slices from top of pineapple, leaving green leaves on top., Reserve top., With curved knife, cut out fruit from shell, leaving 1/2-inch wall., Cut fruit into cubes, removing any fibrous core., Place olive in curve of each shrimp; skewer with plastic pick., Place pineapple cube on pick., Stir together sour cream, curry powder and salt., Place in custard cup in pineapple shell., Cover with reserved pineapple top., Attach shrimmp and pineapple cubes in spiral design to shell of pineapple., Serve immediately or cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate., Serves 6.

title: Swiss Chicken
directions: Place 4 chicken breasts (halved and boned, 8 fillets) in mayonnaise coated casserole dish., Cover with slices of Swiss cheese., Mix 1 can cream of mushroom soup with 1/4 cup sherry or wine; pour over chicken and cheese., Cover top with bread crumbs or croutons and dot with butter., Bake at 325 degrees for 3/4, to 1 hour.

title: Popcorn Cake
directions: Melt marshmallows, oil and margarine; pour over other ingredients., Press into Bundt or angel food pan (greased)., Let set 1 to 2 hours., Turn out on tray.

title: Egg Custard
directions: Line pan with pastry and brush with egg whites, beaten. Combine eggs, vanilla, sugar and salt., Add milk; mix well., Pour in pie crust., Sprinkle nutmeg on top., Bake 30 to 40 minutes at 350°.

title: Baked Spaghetti
directions: Brown hamburger., Season with salt, pepper, garlic powder and oregano to your taste., Add spaghetti sauce., Combine 1/2 of mixture to cooked spaghetti.

title: Beef Stew With Dumplings
directions: Cook beef until tender; add chopped vegetables., Add 1 tablespoon of cornstarch, dissolved in 1 cup of cold water., Add 1 teaspoon of salt and a dash of black pepper.

title: Mango Ice Cream
directions: Start with a good portion of love, stir in a few smiles and one or two good belly laughs., Add a pinch of each: understanding, cheerfulness, compassion, a prayer or two or three and honesty.

title: Meat With Rice And Lentils
directions: Combine meat with yogurt and all the spices and leave to marinate for 2 to 3 hours., When you're ready to cook, fry the onion in a large stew pot with oil., Add the marinated meat mixture and simmer until liquid is slightly thickened., Set aside.

title: Kiwi Fruit Popsicles(Serves 10)
directions: Peel kiwi fruit., Process in blender or food processor just until smooth; do not crush seeds., Stir in lemonade concentrate and water.

title: Bean Bake
directions: Combine all ingredients; mix gently but well., Place in beanpot or casserole., Bake at 300°, uncovered, for 5 to 6 hours. Cover last hour., Or place in a slow cooker and heat on low overnight., Makes 10 to 12 servings.

title: Baked Spareribs And Sauerkraut
directions: Heat oven to 450°., Cut ribs into serving size pieces., Place in 9 x 13-inch pan., Season with salt and pepper., Bake, uncovered, for 20 minutes., Reduce temperature to 350°., Remove ribs; drain fat from pan.

title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Cook broccoli and drain., Beat eggs; add all the other ingredients., Stir in broccoli., Top with 1 stick margarine. Sprinkle 1 stack Ritz crackers on top., Bake at 400° for 15 minutes.

title: Cornbread
directions: * If using self-rising flour, decrease baking powder to 1 teaspoon and omit salt.

title: Delicious Yams(Microwave)
directions: Arrange jams in 1 1/2-quart casserole., In medium bowl combine orange juice and cornstarch; stir until cornstarch is completely dissolved., Blend in brown sugar and butter., Add walnuts and pour over yams., Microwave at High (10) for 10 to 12 minutes., Arrange marshmallows on top and microwave at High (10) for 1 to 2 minutes. Rotate casserole 1/4 turn after 45 seconds., Total Microwave Cooking Time:, 11 to 14 minutes., Makes 4 servings.

title: Easy Apple Pie
directions: Slice apples., Mix cinnamon and sugar together., Mix flour, sugar, egg and margarine., Put apples on bottom of pie dish., Do not grease., Sprinkle cinnamon and sugar over apples., Dab flour mixture over apples and bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Waldorf Salad(Jellied)
directions: Let raisins stand in boiling water; drain., Combine raisins, carrots, apples and walnuts., Divide equally into three individual molds., Dissolve gelatin in hot water; add cold water., Pour over mixture in the molds., Chill until firm., Serve on crisp lettuce leaf., Yield:, 3 servings., Carbohydrate 11 g, protein 1 g, fat 4 g, calories 84., One serving = 1 fruit exchange, 1 fat exchange.

title: Apricot Cheese Ball
directions: Combine all ingredients until well blended., Form into a ball. Chill.

title: Carrot Salad
directions: Cook carrots until just tender.

title: Microwave Spaghetti
directions: In a covered 2 1/2 to 3-quart dish, break up spaghetti and add 4 cups water with about 1 tablespoon oil., Place in microwave for 10 minutes on High., Pour into colander and rinse with cold water. Leave draining while preparing sauce.

title: Party Mix
directions: Mix together and serve.

title: Broccoli Salad
directions: In a bowl thin the mayo with the dressing., Add remaining ingredients, except peanuts., Toss to coat with dressing., Add the peanuts just before serving., Makes 4 servings.

title: Chocolate-Cherry Squares
directions: In a large mixing bowl, combine flour, butter, and brown sugar., Blend on low speed to form fine crumbs (about 2 or 3 minutes)., Stir in nuts., Reserve 3/4 c. crumb mixture for topping. Pat remaining crumbs into an ungreased, square 9 X 9 X 2 inch pan. Bake 10 minutes, or until lightly brown, at 350., Meanwhile, prepare filling., Remove the crumbs from the oven and spread filling over warm crust., Sprinkle with reserved crumb mixture. Garnish with cherry halves., Return to oven and bake until lightly brown., Cool, cut into squares, and store in the refrigerator.

title: Apple Crisp
directions: Fill a 9 x 13-inch greased baking dish 1/2 to 3/4 full with cooking apples., Mix 1/2 cup white sugar and 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon; sprinkle over apples., Mix brown sugar, cooking oats, flour and melted margarine in amounts stated, then press and place over apple mixture., Bake in a 350° oven until brown., If desired, can serve with a scoop of vanilla ice cream.

title: Chocolate Eclair Cake
directions: Layer crackers in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan., Add a layer of pudding onto crackers., Continue layers of crackers and pudding and end up with crackers on top., Spread icing on top layer of crackers and top with layer of Cool Whip., Let chill for several hours before serving.

title: Broccoli Salad
